transliteration: ūcuśca paramaprītāssarve daśarathaṃ vaca:| sambhārāssambhriyantāṃ te turagaśca vimucyatām
translation: सर्वे all of them, परमप्रीता: highly pleased, दशरथम् addressing king Dasaratha, वच: words, ऊचुश्च also spoke, सम्भारा: requisite articles, सम्भ्रियन्ताम् be collected, ते your, तुरगश्च  horse also, विमुच्यताम् be released.
explanation: Highly pleased, they all said to king Dasaratha, "Requisite articles be collected for the sacrifice and the  horse be released."

shloka_text: सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रानभिप्रेतांश्च पार्थिव। यस्य ते धार्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्रार्थमागता।।1.8.12।।
transliteration: sarvathā prāpsyase putrānabhipretāṃśca pārthiva| yasya te dhārmikī buddhiriyaṃ putrārthamāgatā
translation: पार्थिव O King, यस्य ते since to you, पुत्रार्थम् for sons, इयम् this, धार्मिकी just and right, बुद्धि:  mind, आगता arose, अभिप्रेतान् desired ones, सर्वथा by all means, प्राप्स्यसे you will obtain.
explanation: 'O king, the wish that arose in your mind is just and right. You will definitely obtain sons as desired by you.'

shloka_text: तत: प्रीतोऽभवद्राजा श्रुत्वा तद्विजभाषितम्। अमात्यांश्चाब्रवीद्राजा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षण:।।1.8.13।।
transliteration: tata: prīto'bhavadrājā śrutvā tadvijabhāṣitam| amātyāṃścābravīdrājā harṣaparyākulekṣaṇa:
translation: तत: thereafter, राजा king, तत् द्विजभाषितम् those brahmin's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रीत: अभवत् was pleased, राजा king, हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षण: with eyes excited with delight, अमात्यान् ministers, अब्रवीत् informed.
explanation: On hearing the words of the brahmins, the king was pleased and said to his ministers with eyes excited with delight.

shloka_text: सम्भारास्सम्भ्रियन्तां मे गुरूणां वचनादिह। समर्थाधिष्ठितश्चाश्वस्सोपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्।।1.8.14।।
transliteration: sambhārāssambhriyantāṃ me gurūṇāṃ vacanādiha| samarthādhiṣṭhitaścāśvassopādhyāyo vimucyatām
translation: इह here, मे गुरूणाम् of my  spiritual preceptors', वचनात्  on words, सम्भारा: articles required for performing the sacrifice, सम्भ्रियन्ताम् be procured, समर्थाधिष्ठित: under the protection of able men, सोपाध्याय: with main priest, अश्व: horse, विमुच्यताम् be released.
explanation: "Let the  articles required (for performing the sacrifice) be procured in accordance with the words of my spiritual preceptors and the horse be released under the protection of able men.

shloka_text: सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्। शान्तयश्चाभिवर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि।।1.8.15।।
transliteration: sarayvāścottare tīre yajñabhūmirvidhīyatām| śāntayaścābhivardhantāṃ yathākalpaṃ yathāvidhi
translation: सरय्वा: of river Sarayu, उत्तरे तीरे on the northern bank, यज्ञभूमि: sacrificial pavillion, विधीयताम् be constructed, यथाकल्पम् according to prescribed ritual code, यथाविधि  according to the ordinance, शान्तयश्च expiatory rites, अभिवर्धन्ताम् may be wished.
explanation: On the northern bank of  Sarayu, a sacrificial pavillion be prepared according to the  methods ordained in the 'Kalpa'. Auspicious rites be performed in accordance with the ordinance for its uninterrupted completion.

shloka_text: शक्य: प्राप्तुमयं यज्ञस्सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता। नापराधो भवेत्कष्टो यद्यस्मिन्क्रतुसत्तमे।।1.8.16।।
transliteration: śakya: prāptumayaṃ yajñassarveṇāpi mahīkṣitā| nāparādho bhavetkaṣṭo yadyasminkratusattame
translation: अस्मिन् in this, क्रतुसत्तमे best of sacifices, कष्ट: difficulties, अपराध: omissions, न भवेत् यदि  does not happen, अयं यज्ञ: this sacrifice, सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता indeed by every king, प्राप्तुम् to obtain, शक्य: possible.
explanation: If obstructions and omissions do not occur in the conduct of this best of sacrifices, it will be possible for every king to get the results.

shloka_text: छिद्रं हि मृगयन्तेऽत्र विद्वांसो ब्रह्मराक्षसा: । निहतस्य च यज्ञस्य सद्य: कर्ता विनश्यति ।।1.8.17।।
transliteration: chidraṃ hi mṛgayante'tra vidvāṃso brahmarākṣasā: | nihatasya ca yajñasya sadya: kartā vinaśyati
translation: अत्र in this sacrifice, विद्वांस: learned men, ब्रह्मराक्षसा: Brahmarakshasas (celestial beings turned into demons), छिद्रम् flaw, मृगयन्ते हि will be looking out for, निहतस्य struck down यज्ञस्य of sacrifice, कर्ता च the doer, सद्य: immediately, विनश्यति will be destroyed.
explanation: The learned brahmarakshasas always look out for flaws in the sacrifice so that they can spoil it. If a flaw finds place, the doer of the sacrifice is immediately destroyed.

shloka_text: तद्यथा विधिपूर्वं मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते । तथा विधानं क्रियतां समर्था: करणेष्विह।।1.8.18।।
transliteration: tadyathā vidhipūrvaṃ me kratureṣa samāpyate | tathā vidhānaṃ kriyatāṃ samarthā: karaṇeṣviha
translation: तत् for that reason, मे my, एष: क्रतु: his sacrifice, विधिपूर्वम् in accordance with scriptures,  यथा समाप्यते as it could be completed, तथा in that manner, विधानम् arrangement, क्रियताम्   may be done, इह (you) here, करणेषु in actions, समर्था: experts.
explanation: Therefore let the arrangements be made in a manner this sacifice is completed in accordance with the scriptures. And in this, you are experts".

shloka_text: तथेति चाब्रुवन्सर्वे मन्त्रिण:प्रत्यपूजयन्। पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यं यथाज्ञप्तं निशम्य ते।।1.8.19।।
transliteration: tatheti cābruvansarve mantriṇa:pratyapūjayan| pārthivendrasya tadvākyaṃ yathājñaptaṃ niśamya te
translation: ते मन्त्रिणा: those ministers, सर्वे all, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य king Dasaratha's, तत् वाक्यम् those words निशम्य having heard, प्रत्यपूजयन् honoured, यथा as, आज्ञप्तम् ordered, तथा इति may it be so, अब्रुवन् च replied.
explanation: Having heard these words of this Indra on earth (king Dasaratha) all the ministers with due respect replied: "May it be as ordered".

shloka_text: तथा द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञा वर्धयन्तो नृपोत्तमम्। अनुज्ञातास्ततस्सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्।।1.8.20।।
transliteration: tathā dvijāste dharmajñā vardhayanto nṛpottamam| anujñātāstatassarve punarjagmuryathāgatam
translation: धर्मज्ञा: knowledgeable in prescibed conduct and duties, ते द्विजा: those brahmins, तथा in that manner, नृपोत्तमम् Dasaratha, the best among kings, वर्धयन्त: while greeting him, अनुज्ञाता: obtaining permission to leave, तत: thereafter, सर्वे all, यथागतम् as in the manner they came, पुन:जग्मु: returned.
explanation: Bowing to this best of kings (Dasaratha), all the brahmins who were experts in austerities left all the knowledgeable brahmins as they camewith his permission.

shloka_text: विसर्जयित्वा तान्विप्रान्सचिवानिदमब्रवीत्। ऋत्विग्भिरुपदिष्टोऽयं यथावत्क्रतुराप्यताम्।।1.8.21।।
transliteration: visarjayitvā tānviprānsacivānidamabravīt| ṛtvigbhirupadiṣṭo'yaṃ yathāvatkraturāpyatām
translation: तान् विप्रान् those brahmins, विसर्जयित्वा after sending, सचिवान् ministers, इदम् अब्रवीत्  addressed saying, ऋत्विग्भि: by priests officiating at sacrifice, उपदिष्ट: as directed, अयम्  this, क्रतु: sacrifice, यथावत् as enjoined by scriptures, आप्यताम् may be obtained .
explanation: After sending away the brahmins, the king said to his ministers: "Let this sacrifice be performed as enjoined by scriptures and as directed by the officiating priests".

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा नृपशार्दूलस्सचिवान्समुपस्थितान्। विसर्जयित्वा स्वं वेश्म प्रविवेश महाद्युति:।।1.8.22।।
transliteration: ityuktvā nṛpaśārdūlassacivānsamupasthitān| visarjayitvā svaṃ veśma praviveśa mahādyuti:
translation: महाद्युति: highly brilliant, नृपशार्दूल: preeminent among kings, समुपस्थितान् sitting nearby, सचिवान् ministers, इति उक्त्वा having thus ordered, विसर्जयित्वा after sending them away, स्वम् own, वेश्म inner apartment, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: Having thus ordered his ministers sitting nearby, sent this highly brilliant, this preeminent among kings them away and entered the inner apartment.

shloka_text: ततस्स गत्वा ता:पत्नीर्नरेन्द्रो हृदयप्रिया:। उवाच दीक्षां विशत यक्ष्येऽहं सुतकारणात्।।1.8.23।।
transliteration: tatassa gatvā tā:patnīrnarendro hṛdayapriyā:| uvāca dīkṣāṃ viśata yakṣye'haṃ sutakāraṇāt
translation: तत: thereafter, स:नरेन्द्र: that king, हृदयप्रिया: dearer to his heart, ता:पत्नी: his wives, गत्वा  reaching, अहम् I, सुतकारणात् in order to obtain sons, यक्ष्ये I shall perform sacrifice, दीक्षाम्  religious discipline, विशत you may enter, उवाच said.
explanation: Thereafter the king said to his dearest wives: "I intend to perform a sacrifice in order to obtain sons. Therefore, you, too, commence religious discipline."

shloka_text: तासां तेनातिकान्तेन वचनेन सुवर्चसाम्। मुखपद्मान्यशोभन्त पद्मानीव हिमात्यये।।1.8.24।।
transliteration: tāsāṃ tenātikāntena vacanena suvarcasām| mukhapadmānyaśobhanta padmānīva himātyaye
translation: अतिकान्तेन by the excessively charming, तेन वचनेन by  these words, सुवर्चसाम् of those endowed with brightness, तासाम् their, मुखपद्मानि lotuslike countenances, हिमात्यये departure of winter season, पद्मानीव like lotuses, अशोभन्त were resplendent.
explanation: On listening to these exceedingly charming words, their bright countenances shone resplendent like lotuses after the departure of winter. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा रहस्सूतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्। ऋत्विग्भिरुपदिष्टोऽयं पुरावृत्तो मया श्रुत:।।1.9.1।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā rahassūto rājānamidamabravīt| ṛtvigbhirupadiṣṭo'yaṃ purāvṛtto mayā śruta:
translation: एतत् this matter, श्रुत्वा having heard, सूत: king's charioteer, राजानम् addressing king, रह:  in privacy, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, ऋत्विग्भिः by officiating priests, उपदिष्ट: advised, अयम् this solution, पुरा ancient, वृत्त: happened, मया श्रुत: heard by me.
explanation: The charioteer tells the king in privacy that he has heard the advice given by the offciating priests.
comments: Sumantra relates the story of sage Rsyasringa to Dasaratha tells him he would get sons after performance of a sacrifice by Rsyasringa--Dasaratha plans to get Rsyasringa to Ayodhya.

shloka_text: सनत्कुमारो भगवान्पूर्वं कथितवान्कथाम्। ऋषीणां सन्निधौ राजन् तव पुत्रागमं प्रति।।1.9.2।।
transliteration: sanatkumāro bhagavānpūrvaṃ kathitavānkathām| ṛṣīṇāṃ sannidhau rājan tava putrāgamaṃ prati
translation: राजन् O King, भगवान् possessing divinity, सनत्कुमार: Sanatkumara, तव your, पुत्रागमं प्रति    about the birth of your sons, कथाम् story,  ऋषीणां सन्निधौ in the presence of sages, पूर्वम्   earlier, कथितवान् narrated.
explanation: "O king, the divine Sanatkumara had narrated a story about your posterity in the presence of sages.

shloka_text: काश्यपस्यतु पुत्रोऽस्ति विभण्डक इति श्रुत:। ऋष्यशृङ्ग इति ख्यातस्तस्य पुत्रो भविष्यति।।1.9.3।।
transliteration: kāśyapasyatu putro'sti vibhaṇḍaka iti śruta:| ṛṣyaśṛṅga iti khyātastasya putro bhaviṣyati
translation: काश्यपस्य for Kasyapa, विभण्डक: इति named Vibhandaka, श्रुत: famous, पुत्र: अस्ति has a son, तस्य for him, ऋष्यशृङ्ग इति named Rsyasringa, ख्यात: wellknown, पुत्र: son भविष्यति will be born.
explanation: Kasyapa has a famous son named Vibhandaka. It was prophesied that he would have a son named Rsyasringa.

shloka_text: स वने नित्यसंवृद्धो मुनिर्वनचरस्सदा । नान्यं जानाति विप्रेन्द्रो नित्यं पित्रनुवर्तनात् ।।1.9.4।।
transliteration: sa vane nityasaṃvṛddho munirvanacarassadā | nānyaṃ jānāti viprendro nityaṃ pitranuvartanāt
translation: वने in the forest, नित्यसंवृद्ध: grown up, सदा always, वनचर: a person moving in the forest, विप्रेन्द्र: foremost among brahmins, स: मुनि: that sage, नित्यम् always, पित्रनुवर्तनात्  by following his father, अन्यम् others, न जानाति will not know.
explanation: Grown up in the forest and always moving with his father, that sage knows none other than his father.

shloka_text: द्वैविध्यं ब्रह्मचर्यस्य भविष्यति महात्मन:। लोकेषु प्रथितं राजन्विप्रैश्च कथितं सदा।।1.9.5।।
transliteration: dvaividhyaṃ brahmacaryasya bhaviṣyati mahātmana:| lokeṣu prathitaṃ rājanvipraiśca kathitaṃ sadā
translation: राजन् O King, महात्मन: eminet one, लोकेषु in the worlds, प्रथितम् celebrated, सदा always, विप्रै: by brahmins, कथितम् described, ब्रह्मचर्यस्य of Brahmacharya (life of celebacy), द्वैविध्यम्  twofold, भविष्यति will happen.
explanation: O eminent king, sage Rsyasringa celebrated in the three worlds who practises a twofold brahmacharya life (life of celebacy) described by brahmins (as vratitva and prajapatya).

shloka_text: तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य कालस्समभिवर्तत । अग्निं शुश्रूषमाणस्य पितरं च यशस्विनम्।।1.9.6।।
transliteration: tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kālassamabhivartata | agniṃ śuśrūṣamāṇasya pitaraṃ ca yaśasvinam
translation: अग्निम् firegod, यशस्विनम् enowned, पितरम् च his father also, शुश्रूषमाणस्य while attending, एवम् in this manner, वर्तमानस्य living, तस्य for him, काल: time, समभिवर्तत will be spent.
explanation: Worshipping the firegod and attending on his renowned father, he will spend a long time living in this manner (practising vratitva mode of brahmacharya).

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु रोमपाद: प्रतापवान्। अङ्गेषु प्रथितो राजा भविष्यति महाबल:।। 1.9.7।।
transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu romapāda: pratāpavān| aṅgeṣu prathito rājā bhaviṣyati mahābala:
translation: एतस्मिन्नेव काले at this time, अङ्गेषु in the country of Anga, प्रतापवान् mighty, महाबल:  possessing great strength, प्रथित: celebrated, रोमपाद: king Romapada, भविष्यति will be living.
explanation: At this time a powerful king Romapada, mighty and celebrated would be living in the country of Anga.

shloka_text: तस्य व्यतिक्रमाद्राज्ञो भविष्यति सुदारुणा । अनावृष्टिस्सुघोरा वै सर्वभूतभयावहा ।।1.9.8।।
transliteration: tasya vyatikramādrājño bhaviṣyati sudāruṇā | anāvṛṣṭissughorā vai sarvabhūtabhayāvahā
translation: तस्य that, राज्ञ: king, व्यतिक्रमात् violation of code of conduct, सुदारुणा सुघोरा dreadful, सर्वभूतभयावहा frightening all living beings, अनावृष्टि: drought, भविष्यति will set in.
explanation: Because of violation of code of conduct by the king, a terrible, dreadful drought frightening all living beings will set in the kingdom.

shloka_text: अनावृष्ट्यां तु वृत्तायां राजा दु:खसमन्वित:। ब्राह्मणान्श्रुतवृद्धांश्च समानीय प्रवक्ष्यति।। 1.9.9।।
transliteration: anāvṛṣṭyāṃ tu vṛttāyāṃ rājā du:khasamanvita:| brāhmaṇānśrutavṛddhāṃśca samānīya pravakṣyati
translation: अनावृष्ट्याम् when drought, वृत्तायाम् will be prevailing, राजा king, दु:खसमन्वित: filled with grief, श्रुतवृद्धान् men who grow old by learning, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, समानीय summoning,  प्रवक्ष्यति will say.
explanation: With drought prevailing, the griefstricken king, would summon all those grown old with learning and tell them.

shloka_text: भवन्तश्श्रुतधर्माणो लोकचारित्रवेदिन: । समादिशन्तु नियमं प्रायश्चित्तं यथा भवेत् ।।1.9.10।।
transliteration: bhavantaśśrutadharmāṇo lokacāritravedina: | samādiśantu niyamaṃ prāyaścittaṃ yathā bhavet
translation: भवन्त: all of you, श्रुतधर्माण: are conversant in duties (enjoined by scriptures), लोकचारित्रवेदिन: wellversed in the ways of the world, यथा in whichever manner, प्रायश्चित्तम् expiation, भवेत् happens, नियमम् religious observance, समादिशन्तु instruct.
explanation: You all, conversant with the scriptural duties and well-versed in the ways of the world, instruct me in the religious observance by which expiation may be made.

shloka_text: वक्ष्यन्ति ते महीपालं ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगा:। विभण्डकसुतं राजन्सर्वोपायैरिहानय।।1.9.11।।
transliteration: vakṣyanti te mahīpālaṃ brāhmaṇā vedapāragā:| vibhaṇḍakasutaṃ rājansarvopāyairihānaya
translation: वेदपारगा: those learned in vedas, ते ब्राह्मणा: those brahmins, महीपालम् addressing the king, वक्ष्यन्ति will say, राजन् O king, विभण्डकसुतम् son of sage Vibhandaka, Rsyasringa, सर्वोपायै: by all means, इह here, आनय bring.
explanation: Those brahmins versed in the Vedas, said, to 'O king bring here Rsyasringa, son of the sage Vibhandaka by all means'.

shloka_text: आनाय्य च महीपाल ऋश्यशृङ्गं सुसत्कृतम्। प्रयच्छ कन्यां शान्तां वै विधिना सुसमाहित: ।।1.9.12।।
transliteration: ānāyya ca mahīpāla ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ susatkṛtam| prayaccha kanyāṃ śāntāṃ vai vidhinā susamāhita:
translation: महीपाल O Monarch, सुसत्कृतम् greatly honoured, ऋश्यशृङ्गम् Rsyasringa, आनाय्य having brought, समाहित: with due reverence, कन्याम् your daughter, शान्ताम् Shanta, विधिना  according to religious ceremonies, प्रयच्छ offer.
explanation: "O monarch, on having brought Rsyasringa here, honour him, and offer him your daughter Santa with due reverence.

shloka_text: तेषां तु वचनं श्रुत्वा राजा चिन्तां प्रपत्स्यते । केनोपायेन वै शक्य इहानेतुं स वीर्यवान् ।।1.9.13।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā rājā cintāṃ prapatsyate | kenopāyena vai śakya ihānetuṃ sa vīryavān
translation: तेषाम् their, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, राजा king, वीर्यवान् with controlled senses, सः   he, इह here, आनेतुम् to bring, केन उपायेन by what means, शक्य: capable of being done, चिन्ताम् contemplating, प्रपत्स्यते will obtain.
explanation: On hearing their words, the king in a thoughtful mood said, 'How can the mighty sage be brought here'?

shloka_text: ततो राजा विनिश्चित्य सह मन्त्रिभिरात्मवान्। पुरोहितममात्यांश्च तत: प्रेष्यति सत्कृतान्।।1.9.14।।
transliteration: tato rājā viniścitya saha mantribhirātmavān| purohitamamātyāṃśca tata: preṣyati satkṛtān
translation: तत: thereafter, आत्मवान् intelligent, राजा king, मन्त्रिभि: सह in consultation with his ministers, विनिश्चित्य having decided, तत: thereafter, सत्कृतान् duly honouring, पुरोहितम्  priest, अमात्यांश्च counsellors, प्रेष्यति send on a mission.
explanation: Thereafter the confident king, having decided, in consultation with his ministers to bring him (Rsyasringa), sent the priest with the counsellors on this mission.

shloka_text: ते तु राज्ञो वचश्श्रुशृत्वा व्यथिता विनतानना:। न गच्छेम ऋषेर्भीता अनुनेष्यन्ति तं नृपम् ।। 1.9.15।।
transliteration: te tu rājño vacaśśruśṛtvā vyathitā vinatānanā:| na gacchema ṛṣerbhītā anuneṣyanti taṃ nṛpam
translation: ते they, राज्ञ: king's, वच: words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ऋषे: from the Rishi, भीता: frightened, व्यथिता: distressed, विनतानना: with faces bent down, न गच्छेम we will not go, तम् that, नृपम्  king, अनुनेष्यन्ति will appeal.
explanation: On hearing the king's words, distressed and frightened by rishi's power, they   appealed to the king, faces bent down, 'We will not go'.

shloka_text: वक्ष्यन्ति चिन्तयित्वा ते तस्योपायांश्च तत्क्षमान्। आनेष्यामो वयं विप्रं न च दोषो भविष्यति।। 1.9.16।।
transliteration: vakṣyanti cintayitvā te tasyopāyāṃśca tatkṣamān| āneṣyāmo vayaṃ vipraṃ na ca doṣo bhaviṣyati
translation: ते they, चिन्तयित्वा having thought about it, तत्क्षमान् useful in bringing him, उपायान् means, तस्य ते for that king, वक्ष्यन्ति will tell, वयम् we, विप्रम् that sage, आनेष्याम: will bring, दोष:  blame, न भविष्यति च will not accrue.
explanation: After thinking  about the means to be employed to bring the rishi to the court, they told him they would bring the sage if they are not to blame (in case anything untoward happens).

shloka_text: एवमङ्गाधिपेनैव गणिकाभि: ऋषेस्सुत:। आनीतोऽवर्षयद्देवश्शान्ता चास्मै प्रदीयते।।1.9.17।।
transliteration: evamaṅgādhipenaiva gaṇikābhi: ṛṣessuta:| ānīto'varṣayaddevaśśāntā cāsmai pradīyate
translation: एवम् in this way, अङ्गाधिपेन by the king of Anga region, Romapada, गणिकाभि: with the help of courtesans, ऋषे: सुत: son of sage Vibhandaka, आनीत: was brought, देव: god (Indra), अवर्षयत् poured rains, अस्मै for Rsyasringa, शान्ता Shanta, प्रदीयते च will be offered.
explanation: Thus with the help of courtesans of the king of Anga, when the son of the sage (Rsyasringa) was brought rains followed. The king offered his daughter Santa (in marriage to the sage).

shloka_text: ऋश्यशृङ्गस्तु जामाता पुत्रांस्तव विधास्यति। सनत्कुमारकथितमेतावद्व्याहृतं मया।।1.9.18।।
transliteration: ṛśyaśṛṅgastu jāmātā putrāṃstava vidhāsyati| sanatkumārakathitametāvadvyāhṛtaṃ mayā
translation: जामाता soninlaw, ऋश्यशृङ्गस्तु Rsyasringa, तव your, पुत्रान् sons, विधास्यति will ordain to be born, एतावत् till that instance, सनत्कुमारकथितम् the account communicated by Sanatkumara, मया by me, व्याहृतम् told to you.
explanation: 'Risyasringa, your soninlaw, would help you to obtain sons'. Thus said Sanathkumara which I have related to you.

shloka_text: अथ हृष्टो दशरथस्सुमन्त्रं प्रत्यभाषत। यथर्श्यशृङ्गस्त्वानीतो विस्तरेण त्वयोच्यताम्।।1.9.19।।
transliteration: atha hṛṣṭo daśarathassumantraṃ pratyabhāṣata| yatharśyaśṛṅgastvānīto vistareṇa tvayocyatām
translation: अथ now, हृष्ट: pleased, दशरथ: king Dasaratha, सुमन्त्रं प्रति addressing Sumantra, अभाषत spoke, ऋष्यशृङ्ग: Rsyasringa, यथा by whatever means, आनीत: was brought, त्वया by you, विस्तरेण in detail, उच्यताम् be described.
explanation: Thereupon Dasaratha, pleased, (with him), said to Sumantra, "Describe in detail the  means by which Rsyasringa was brought (to the court of Romapada)". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे नवमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana of the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सुमन्त्रश्चोदितो राज्ञा प्रोवाचेदं वचस्तदा। यथर्श्यशृङ्गस्त्वानीत श्श्रुणु मे मन्त्रिभिस्सह।।1.10.1।।
transliteration: sumantraścodito rājñā provācedaṃ vacastadā| yatharśyaśṛṅgastvānīta śśruṇu me mantribhissaha
translation: राज्ञा by the king, चोदित: prompted, सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, तदा then, इदम् these words, प्रोवाच said, स:ऋश्यशृङ्ग: that Rsyasringa, मन्त्रिभि:सह with ministers, यथा in what manner, आनीत: was  brought, मे to me, शृणु listen.
explanation: Thus prompted by king Dasaratha, Sumantra said,  "I shall relate to you the manner in which Rsyasringa was brought to the court. Listen to me along with your ministers".
comments: Sumantra narrates the manner in which Rsyasringa was brought to Anga--Romapada sends courtesans to lure Rsyasringa and to get him to faminestricken Anga--rains follow ending  famine Rsyasringa marries Santa, daughter of Romapada.

shloka_text: रोमपादमुवाचेदं सहामात्य: पुरोहित:। उपायो निरपायोऽयमस्माभिरभिचिन्तित:।। 1.10.2।।
transliteration: romapādamuvācedaṃ sahāmātya: purohita:| upāyo nirapāyo'yamasmābhirabhicintita:
translation: सहामात्य: along with ministers, पुरोहित: the priest, रोमपादम् to Romapada, इदम् these words, उवाच addressed, अस्माभि: by us, निरपाय: without danger, अयम् this, उपाय: plan, अभिचिन्तित: is thought over.
explanation: The priest accompanied by ministers said to Romapada, "We have thought over a plan which will never fail."

shloka_text: ऋश्यशृङ्गो वनचरस्तपस्स्वाध्ययने रत:। अनभिज्ञस्स नारीणां विषयाणां सुखस्य च।1.10.3।।
transliteration: ṛśyaśṛṅgo vanacarastapassvādhyayane rata:| anabhijñassa nārīṇāṃ viṣayāṇāṃ sukhasya ca|1.10.3||
translation: ऋश्यशृङ्ग: Risyasringa, वनचर: residing in forests, तप: स्वाध्ययने रत: delighted in the  study of vedas, स: he, नारीणाम् of women, विषयाणाम् of pleasures, सुखस्य च of worldly enjoyments, अनभिज्ञ: not acquainted with.
explanation: "Rsyasringa, residing in the forest, is engrossed in the study of the Vedas. He is not acquainted with women and sensual pleasures.

shloka_text: इन्द्रियार्थैरभिमतैर्नरचित्तप्रमाथिभि: । पुरमानाययिष्याम: क्षिप्रं चाध्यवसीयताम्।। 1.10.4।।
transliteration: indriyārthairabhimatairnaracittapramāthibhi: | puramānāyayiṣyāma: kṣipraṃ cādhyavasīyatām
translation: नरचित्तप्रमाथिभि: overpowering the minds of men, अभिमतै: dear, इन्द्रियार्थै: with sensual  pleasures, पुरम् town, आनाययिष्याम: we will prompt him to come over, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अध्यवसीयताम् may it be determined.
explanation: By means of  such things that can cause sensual pleasures and overpower the minds of men, we shall be able to bring him to the town. Let it be decided quickly (said the ministers)

shloka_text: गणिकास्तत्र गच्छन्तु रूपवत्यस्स्वलङ्कृता:। प्रलोभ्य विविधोपायैरानेष्यन्तीह सत्कृता:।।1.10.5।।
transliteration: gaṇikāstatra gacchantu rūpavatyassvalaṅkṛtā:| pralobhya vividhopāyairāneṣyantīha satkṛtā:
translation: रूपवत्य: beautiful, स्वलङ्कृता: wellattired, गणिका: courtesans, सत्कृता: welltreated by you, तत्र there, गच्छन्तु let them go, विविधोपायै: by various means, प्रलोभ्य alluring him, इह here, आनेष्यन्ति will bring him here.
explanation: Beautiful and welladorned courtesans, may be sent there. They will allure him by various means and honourably bring him here.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तथेति राजा च प्रत्युवाच पुरोहितम्। पुरोहितो मन्त्रिणश्च तथा चक्रुश्च ते तदा।।1.10.6।।
transliteration: śrutvā tatheti rājā ca pratyuvāca purohitam| purohito mantriṇaśca tathā cakruśca te tadā
translation: राजा king, श्रुत्वा having listened, तथा इति let it be done in that way, पुरोहितम् priest, प्रत्युवाच replied, तदा then, पुरोहित: priest, ते those, मन्त्रिणश्च ministsers, तथा in the same way, चक्रु: acted.
explanation: The king, having listened to these words, conveyed his approval saying, 'Let it be done that way'. The priests and ministers acted accordingly.

shloka_text: वारमुख्याश्च तच्छ्रुत्वा वनं प्रविविशुर्महत्। आश्रमस्याविदूरेऽस्मिन् यत्नं कुर्वन्ति दर्शने।।1.10.7।। ऋषिपुत्रस्य धीरस्य नित्यमाश्रमवासिन:।
transliteration: vāramukhyāśca tacchrutvā vanaṃ praviviśurmahat| āśramasyāvidūre'smin yatnaṃ kurvanti darśane ṛṣiputrasya dhīrasya nityamāśramavāsina:|
translation: तत् श्रुत्वा having heard this, वारमुख्या: beautiful courtesans, महत् great, वनम् forest, प्रविविशु: entered, आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अस्मिन् अविदूरे not at a distance, धीरस्य of that man having controlled senses, नित्यम् always, आश्रमवासिन: residing in the forest, ऋषिपुत्रस्य son of rishi, दर्शने sight of, यत्नम् effort, कुर्वन्ति made.
explanation: Having heard this, beautiful courtesans entered the great forest and remaining at a  place not far from the hermitage made efforts to steal a sight of this son of a sage (Rsyasringa), this forest dweller, this controller of the senses.

shloka_text: पितुस्सनित्यसन्तुष्टो नातिचक्राम चाश्रमात्।।1.10.8।। न तेन जन्मप्रभृति दृष्टपूर्वं तपस्विना। स्त्री वा पुमान्वा यच्चान्यत्सर्वं नगरराष्ट्रजम्।। 1.10.9।।
transliteration: pitussanityasantuṣṭo nāticakrāma cāśramāt na tena janmaprabhṛti dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tapasvinā| strī vā pumānvā yaccānyatsarvaṃ nagararāṣṭrajam
translation: नित्यसन्तुष्ट: always contended, स: Rsyasringa, पितु: father's, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, नातिचक्राम never stirred out, तपस्विना by the ascetics, तेन by him, जन्मप्रभृति from his birth, स्त्री वा neither a woman, पुमान्वा nor a man, नगरराष्ट्रजम् born in towns or cities, सर्वम् all, यत् अन्यत् other creatures, न दृष्टपूर्वम् did not see earlier.
explanation: He (Rsyasringa) was always content and never stirred out of his father's hermitage. Absorbed in penance he had never seen  a woman or a man nor any of the creatures born in towns or cities right from his birth.

shloka_text: पितुस्सनित्यसन्तुष्टो नातिचक्राम चाश्रमात्।।1.10.8।। न तेन जन्मप्रभृति दृष्टपूर्वं तपस्विना। स्त्री वा पुमान्वा यच्चान्यत्सर्वं नगरराष्ट्रजम्।। 1.10.9।।
transliteration: pitussanityasantuṣṭo nāticakrāma cāśramāt na tena janmaprabhṛti dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ tapasvinā| strī vā pumānvā yaccānyatsarvaṃ nagararāṣṭrajam
translation: नित्यसन्तुष्ट: always contended, स: Rsyasringa, पितु: father's, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, नातिचक्राम never stirred out, तपस्विना by the ascetics, तेन by him, जन्मप्रभृति from his birth, स्त्री वा neither a woman, पुमान्वा nor a man, नगरराष्ट्रजम् born in towns or cities, सर्वम् all, यत् अन्यत् other creatures, न दृष्टपूर्वम् did not see earlier.
explanation: He (Rsyasringa) was always content and never stirred out of his father's hermitage. Absorbed in penance he had never seen  a woman or a man nor any of the creatures born in towns or cities right from his birth.

shloka_text: तत: कदाचित्तं देशमाजगाम यदृच्छया। विभण्डकसुतस्तत्र ताश्चापश्यद्वराङ्गना:।।1.10.10।।
transliteration: tata: kadācittaṃ deśamājagāma yadṛcchayā| vibhaṇḍakasutastatra tāścāpaśyadvarāṅganā:
translation: तत: thereafter, कदाचित् on one day, विभण्डकसुत: son of Vibhandaka, यदृच्छया accidentally, तं देशम् towards that place, आजगाम came, तत्र there, ता: those, वराङ्गना: beautiful women, अपश्यत् saw.
explanation: One day this son of Vibhandaka (Rsyasringa) accidentally came to the place where he saw the beautiful women.

shloka_text: ताश्चित्रवेषा: प्रमदा गायन्त्यो मधुरस्वरा:। ऋषिपुत्रमुपागम्य सर्वा वचनमब्रुवन्।। 1.10.11।।
transliteration: tāścitraveṣā: pramadā gāyantyo madhurasvarā:| ṛṣiputramupāgamya sarvā vacanamabruvan
translation: चित्रवेषा: beautifully attired, मधुरस्वरा: having sweet voices, गायन्त्य: singing, ता: those प्रमदा: women, सर्वा: all, ऋषिपुत्रम् Rsyasringa, उपागम्य having approached, अब्रुवन् said.
explanation: Those wonderfully attired women singing with sweet voices approached the son of the sage (Rsyasringa) and said:

shloka_text: कस्त्वं किं वर्तसे ब्रह्मन् ज्ञातुमिच्छामहे वयम्। एकस्त्वं विजने घोरे वने चरसि शंस न:।। 1.10.12।।
transliteration: kastvaṃ kiṃ vartase brahman jñātumicchāmahe vayam| ekastvaṃ vijane ghore vane carasi śaṃsa na:
translation: ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, त्वं क: who are you? किं वर्तसे how are you subsisting? त्वम् you, एक: alone, विजने in a lonely, घोरे dreadful, वने in the forest, चरसि you are roaming, वयम् we, ज्ञातुम् to know, इच्छामहे desirous, न:शंस tell us.
explanation: 'O brahman Who are you? How are you subsisting? We wish to know why you are roaming alone in this dreadful forest? Could you tell us.'

shloka_text: अदृष्टरूपास्तास्तेन काम्यरूपा वने स्त्रिय:। हार्दात्तस्य मतिर्जाता व्याख्यातुं पितरं स्वकम्।।1.10.13।।
transliteration: adṛṣṭarūpāstāstena kāmyarūpā vane striya:| hārdāttasya matirjātā vyākhyātuṃ pitaraṃ svakam
translation: काम्यरूपा: women of charming appearance, ता: स्त्रिय: those women, तेन by him, वने in the forest, अदृष्टरूपा: whose forms were never seen before, हार्दात् due to affection, तस्य for him, स्वकं पितरम्  about his father, व्याख्यातुम् narrating, मति: intention, जाता arose.
explanation: He had never seen such charming women in the forest. He developed affection towards them and a desire arose in him to speak about his father.

shloka_text: पिता विभण्डकोऽस्माकं तस्याहं सुत औरस:। ऋश्यशृङ्ग इति ख्यातं नाम कर्म च मे भुवि।।1.10.14।।
transliteration: pitā vibhaṇḍako'smākaṃ tasyāhaṃ suta aurasa:| ṛśyaśṛṅga iti khyātaṃ nāma karma ca me bhuvi
translation: विभण्डक: Vibhandaka, अस्माकम् our, पिता father, अहम् I, तस्य his, औरस: सुत: his own son, मे my, ऋश्यशृङ्ग Rsyasringa, इति thus, नाम name, कर्म च through result of an action (having one horn on his head), भुवि world over, ख्यातम् is known.
explanation: 'My father is Vibhandaka. I am his own son. My name is Rsyasringa. I am known the world over by this name associated with my karma'.

shloka_text: इहाश्रमपदोऽस्माकं समीपे शुभदर्शना:। करिष्ये वोऽत्र पूजां वै सर्वेषां विधिपूर्वकम्।।1.10.15।।
transliteration: ihāśramapado'smākaṃ samīpe śubhadarśanā:| kariṣye vo'tra pūjāṃ vai sarveṣāṃ vidhipūrvakam
translation: शुभदर्शना: O auspicious looking women, अस्माकम् our, आश्रमपद: hermitage, इह here, समीपे nearby, अत्र here, व: सर्वेषाम् to all of you, पूजाम् hospitable reception, विधिपूर्वकम् according to scriptural injunctions, करिष्ये I will extend.
explanation: 'O auspiciouslooking women, our hermitage is nearby. I will extend to you due hospitality'.

shloka_text: ऋषिपुत्रवचश्श्रुत्वा सर्वासां मतिरास वै। तदाश्रमपदं द्रष्टुं जग्मुस्सर्वाश्च तेन ता:।। 1.10.16।।
transliteration: ṛṣiputravacaśśrutvā sarvāsāṃ matirāsa vai| tadāśramapadaṃ draṣṭuṃ jagmussarvāśca tena tā:
translation: ऋषिपुत्रवच: words of the son of ascetic, Rishyashringa, श्रुत्वा having listened, सर्वासाम् for all those women, तत् आश्रमपदम् that hermitage, द्रष्टुम् to see, मति: desire, आस वै arose, सर्वा: all of them, तेन with him, जग्मु: च accompanied.
explanation: After listening to the words of the sage's son (Rsyasringa), all the beautiful women with a desire to see the hermitage  accompanied him.

shloka_text: आगतानां तत: पूजामृषिपुत्रश्चकार ह। इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यमिदं मूलमिदं फलं च न:।।1.10.17।।
transliteration: āgatānāṃ tata: pūjāmṛṣiputraścakāra ha| idamarghyamidaṃ pādyamidaṃ mūlamidaṃ phalaṃ ca na:
translation: तत: thereafter, ऋषिपुत्र: son of ascetic, इदम् this one, न: our, अर्घ्यम् respectable offerings, इदम् this, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, इदम् this, मूलम् roots, फलं च fruits also, आगतानाम् for all those who have come, पूजाम् homage, चकार ह performed.
explanation: Thereafter the son of ascetic respectfully received the the strangers saying, "(Accept) our offerings, here is water for washing feet and  here are roots and fruits".

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य च तां पूजां सर्वा एव समुत्सुका:। ऋषेर्भीताश्च शीघ्रं ता गमनाय मतिं दधु:।।1.10.18।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca tāṃ pūjāṃ sarvā eva samutsukā:| ṛṣerbhītāśca śīghraṃ tā gamanāya matiṃ dadhu:
translation: ता: सर्वा: all of them, समुत्सुका: anxious persons, तां पूजाम् those offerings, प्रतिगृह्य having  received, ऋषे: of the ascetic, भीता: feared, शीघ्रम् immediately, गमनाय to return, मतिम्  minds, दधु: decided.
explanation: The anxious courtesans received the offerings and afraid of the ascetic's return, made up their minds to withdraw immediately.

shloka_text: अस्माकमपि मुख्यानि फलानीमानि वै द्विज । गृहाण प्रति भद्रं ते भक्षयस्व च मा चिरम्।।1.10.19।।
transliteration: asmākamapi mukhyāni phalānīmāni vai dvija | gṛhāṇa prati bhadraṃ te bhakṣayasva ca mā ciram
translation: द्विज O Brahmin, अस्माकम् our, मुख्यानि excellent, इमानि फलान्यपि these fruits also, प्रतिगृहाण you may accept, भद्रम् ते prosperity to you, भक्षयस्व you may eat, चिरम् मा do not delay.
explanation: 'O brahmin, these are excellent fruits. May prosperity be to you. Accept them and eat them without delay.'

shloka_text: ततस्तास्तं समालिङ्ग्य सर्वा हर्षसमन्विता:। मोदकान्प्रददुस्तस्मै भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् बहून्।।1.10.20।।
transliteration: tatastāstaṃ samāliṅgya sarvā harṣasamanvitā:| modakānpradadustasmai bhakṣyāṃśca vividhān bahūn
translation: तत: there upon, ता: सर्वा: all of them, तम् him, समालिङ्ग्य embracing, हर्षसमन्विता: they were filled with joy, तस्मै for him, बहून् plentiful, मोदकान् sweetmeats, विविधान् various, भक्ष्यांश्च other articles of food, प्रददु: gave.
explanation: Then, all the courtesans embracing him with joy, offered plentiful sweetmeats and various items of food.

shloka_text: तानि चास्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानीति स्म मन्यते। अनास्वादितपूर्वाणि वने नित्यनिवासिनाम्।।1.10.21।।
transliteration: tāni cāsvādya tejasvī phalānīti sma manyate| anāsvāditapūrvāṇi vane nityanivāsinām
translation: तेजस्वी Rsyasringa, possessing the lustre of Brahma, वने in the forest, नित्यनिवासिनाम् of  those who are always residing in the forest, अनास्वादितपूर्वाणि which were not tasted earlier, तानि them, आस्वाद्य having tasted, फलानि इति as fruits, मन्यते स्म thought about them.
explanation: The lustrous (Rsyasringa) who had never tasted any food other than what was offered by the permanent forestdwellers mistook them for fruits.

shloka_text: आपृच्छ्य च तदा विप्रं व्रतचर्यां निवेद्य च। गच्छन्ति स्मापदेशात्ता भीतास्तस्य पितुस्स्त्रिय:।।1.10.22।।
transliteration: āpṛcchya ca tadā vipraṃ vratacaryāṃ nivedya ca| gacchanti smāpadeśāttā bhītāstasya pitusstriya:
translation: तदा then, ता: स्त्रिय: those women, विप्रम् Rsyasringa, आपृच्छ्य bidding farewell, व्रतचर्याम् observance of religious austerities, निवेद्य having made known, तस्य his, पितु: for his father, भीता: afraid of, अपदेशात् on that pretext, गच्छन्ति स्म went away.
explanation: The ladies apprehensive of (the arrival of) his father took leave of him on the pretext of  observance of (evening) rites.

shloka_text: गतासु तासु सर्वासु काश्यपस्यात्मजो द्विज:। अस्वस्थहृदयश्चासीद्दु:खं स्म परिवर्तते।।1.10.23।।
transliteration: gatāsu tāsu sarvāsu kāśyapasyātmajo dvija:| asvasthahṛdayaścāsīddu:khaṃ sma parivartate
translation: तासु सर्वासु when all of them, गतासु (सतीषु ) having departed, काश्यपस्य Kasyapa's, आत्मज: son, द्विज: brahmin, अस्वस्थहृदय: restless in mind, आसीत् remained, दु:खम्  sorrow, परिवर्तते स्म moved him around.
explanation: When they all departed, Kasyapa's son, the brahmin roamed (Rsyasringa) with a restless mind  charged with sorrow.

shloka_text: ततोऽपरेद्युस्तं देशमाजगाम स वीर्यवान्। मनोज्ञा यत्र ता दृष्टा वारमुख्यास्स्वलङ्कृताः।।1.10.24।।
transliteration: tato'paredyustaṃ deśamājagāma sa vīryavān| manojñā yatra tā dṛṣṭā vāramukhyāssvalaṅkṛtāḥ
translation: तत: afterwards, वीर्यवान् possessing the power of penance, स: he, अपरेद्यु: on the following day, मनोज्ञा: pleasing  to the mind, वारमुख्या: courtesans, स्वलङ्कृता: welladorned, ता: the courtesans, यत्र at which place, दृष्टा: were seen, तं देशम् that place, आजगाम came.
explanation: On the following day, the sage armed with the power of penance, came to the place where he had seen those enticing, welladorned courtesans.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वैव च तास्तदा विप्रमायान्तं हृष्टमानसा:। उपसृत्य ततस्सर्वास्तास्तमूचुरिदं वच:।।1.10.25।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaiva ca tāstadā vipramāyāntaṃ hṛṣṭamānasā:| upasṛtya tatassarvāstāstamūcuridaṃ vaca:
translation: तदा then, ता: they, आयान्तम् approaching, तं विप्रम् that brahmin, दृष्ट्वा एव after seeing him, हृष्टमानसा: rejoiced in mind, ता: सर्वा: all of them, तत: thereafter, उपसृत्य having approached, तम् addressing him, इदं वच: these words, ऊचु: uttered.
explanation: All of them were rejoiced on seeing the brahmin approaching them, came nearer to him and said:

shloka_text: एह्याश्रमपदं सौम्य ह्यस्माकमिति चाब्रुवन्। तत्राप्येष विधिश्श्रीमान् विशेषेण भविष्यति।।1.10.26।।
transliteration: ehyāśramapadaṃ saumya hyasmākamiti cābruvan| tatrāpyeṣa vidhiśśrīmān viśeṣeṇa bhaviṣyati
translation: हे सौम्य O Gentleman, अस्माकम् our, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, एहि you may come, तत्र there, श्रीमान् lovely, एष: विधि: this hospitable treatment, विशेषेण special, भविष्यति will be extended, इति च also, अब्रुवन् spoke.
explanation: 'O handsome one, come to our hermitage. A special, sumptuous hospitality will be extended to you', they said.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तासां सर्वासां हृदयङ्गमम्। गमनाय मतिं चक्रे तं च निन्युस्तदा स्त्रिय:।।1.10.27।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ hṛdayaṅgamam| gamanāya matiṃ cakre taṃ ca ninyustadā striya:
translation: तासां सर्वासाम् all theirs, हृदयङ्गमम् pleasing to the mind, वचनम् speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, गमनाय to go forth, मतिम् decison, चक्रे made, तदा then, स्त्रिय: those women, तं निन्यु: took him away.
explanation: Having heard their words pleasing to the mind, he agreed to go with them. And the women took him away.

shloka_text: तत्र चानीयमाने तु विप्रे तस्मिन्महात्मनि। ववर्ष सहसा देवो जगत्प्रह्लादयंस्तदा।।1.10.28।।
transliteration: tatra cānīyamāne tu vipre tasminmahātmani| vavarṣa sahasā devo jagatprahlādayaṃstadā
translation: महात्मनि when the illustrious, तस्मिन् विप्रे ascetic, आनीयमाने was being brought, तदा then, देव: Parjanya, Presiding deity for rains, जगत् earth, प्रह्लादयन् pleasing, सहसा at once, तत्र there, ववर्ष rained.
explanation: As the illustrious sage was being brought (to Anga) the god of rain (Parjanya) suddenly inundated the earth which looked cherful (with rain).

shloka_text: वर्षेणैवागतं विप्रं विषयं स्वं नराधिप:। प्रत्युद्गम्य मुनिं प्रह्वश्शिरसा च महीं गत:।।1.10.29।।
transliteration: varṣeṇaivāgataṃ vipraṃ viṣayaṃ svaṃ narādhipa:| pratyudgamya muniṃ prahvaśśirasā ca mahīṃ gata:
translation: नराधिपः king Romapada, वर्षेणैव along with rain, स्वम् his own, विषयम् country, आगतम् arrived, मुनिम् ascetic, विप्रम् brahmin, (Rsyasringa), प्रत्युद्गम्य gone out to welcome, प्रह्व: bowed down humbly, शिरसा with head, महीम् ground, गत: touched.
explanation: The king (Romapada) went out to welcome the ascetic, the brahmin who brought along with him rains to his country. He humbly bowed down his head and prostrated before him.

shloka_text: अर्घ्यं च प्रददौ तस्मै न्यायतस्सुसमाहित:। वव्रे प्रसादं विप्रेन्द्रान्मा विप्रं मन्युराविशेत्।।1.10.30।।
transliteration: arghyaṃ ca pradadau tasmai nyāyatassusamāhita:| vavre prasādaṃ viprendrānmā vipraṃ manyurāviśet
translation: सुसमाहित: concentrating his mind, तस्मै to him, अर्घ्यम् च offerings, न्यायत: righteously, प्रददौ gave, विप्रेन्द्रात् from the brahmin (Rsyasringa), प्रसादम् favour, वव्रे sought, विप्रम् sage Vibhandaka, मन्यु: anger, आविशेत् did not pervade.
explanation: He gave that Indra among the brahmins offerings righteously with unstinted devotion and asked for his favour that he should not incur the wrath of the sage (his father Vibhandaka for having brought him to Anga).

shloka_text: अन्त:पुरं प्रविश्यास्मै कन्यां दत्त्वा यथाविधि। शान्तां शान्तेन मनसा राजा हर्षमवाप स:।।1.10.31।। एवं स न्यवसत्तत्र सर्वकामैस्सुपूजित:।
transliteration: anta:puraṃ praviśyāsmai kanyāṃ dattvā yathāvidhi| śāntāṃ śāntena manasā rājā harṣamavāpa sa: evaṃ sa nyavasattatra sarvakāmaissupūjita:|
translation: स: राजा the king, अन्त:पुरम् inner apartment, प्रविश्य having entered, कन्याम् daughter, शान्ताम् Shanta, अस्मै for him, यथाविधि in accordance with rules, दत्वा united him in marriage, शान्तेन peaceful, मनसा mind, हर्षम् satisfaction, अवाप experienced. स: Rsyasringa, एवम् in this way, सर्वकामै: all desires, सुपूजित: respectfully ministered, तत्र there, न्यवसत् lived.
explanation: The king entered the inner apartment, duly offered him his daughter Shanta in marriage and experienced peace and satisfaction. Thus he (Rsyasringa) lived there, with all his desires fulfilled" (said Sumantra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे दशमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: भूय एव हि राजेन्द्र शृणु मे वचनं हितम्। यथा स देवप्रवर: कथायामेवमब्रवीत्।।1.11.1।।
transliteration: bhūya eva hi rājendra śṛṇu me vacanaṃ hitam| yathā sa devapravara: kathāyāmevamabravīt
translation: राजेन्द्र O Great king, स: that Sanatkumara, देवप्रवर: great among celestial beings, यथा in what so ever manner, कथायाम् in the story, अब्रवीत् narrated, एवम् in this way, मे my, हितम्  beneficial, वचनम् words, भूय: एव again, शृणु listen.
explanation: "Great king, I shall tell you the way Sanatkumara, great among the celestials further narrated the story. Listen to my words which may prove useful to you (said Sumantra)".
comments: Sumantra gives further details of the  story narrated by Sanatkumara--on the advice of Sumantra, king Dasaratha goes to Romapada  requests Rsyasringa's help to conduct aswamedha yaga Rsyasringa comes to Ayodhya.

shloka_text: इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले जातो भविष्यति सुधार्मिक:। राजा दशरथो नाम्ना श्रीमान्सत्यप्रतिश्रव:।।1.11.2।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule jāto bhaviṣyati sudhārmika:| rājā daśaratho nāmnā śrīmānsatyapratiśrava:
translation: श्रीमान् auspicious one, सत्यप्रतिश्रव: true to his promise, राजा king, दशरथो नाम्ना named Dasaratha, सुधार्मिक: highly righteous, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of Ikshvaku kings', कुले in the race, जात: भविष्यति will be born indeed.
explanation: A highly righteous and auspicious king named Dasaratha, ever true to his word, will be born in the race of the Ikshvakus.

shloka_text: अङ्गराजेन सख्यं च तस्य राज्ञो भविष्यति। कन्या चास्य महाभागा शान्ता नाम भविष्यति।।1.11.3।।
transliteration: aṅgarājena sakhyaṃ ca tasya rājño bhaviṣyati| kanyā cāsya mahābhāgā śāntā nāma bhaviṣyati
translation: तस्य राज्ञ: to that king (Dasaratha), अङ्गराजेन with the king of Anga, सख्यं च friendship, भविष्यति will develop, अस्य for that king of Anga, महाभागा highly virtuous, शान्ता नाम named Shanta, कन्या daughter, भविष्यति will be born.
explanation: That king (Dasaratha) will develop friendship with the king of Anga. A highly virtuous daughter named Santa will be born to  king of Anga.

shloka_text: पुत्रस्तु सोऽङ्गराजस्य रोमपाद इति श्रुत:। तं स राजा दशरथो गमिष्यति महायशा:।।1.11.4।।
transliteration: putrastu so'ṅgarājasya romapāda iti śruta:| taṃ sa rājā daśaratho gamiṣyati mahāyaśā:
translation: स:अङ्गराज्यस्य पुत्रस्तु that Anga king's son, रोमपाद इति Romapada by name, श्रुत:will be wellknown, महायशा: very famous, स: that, राजा king (Dasaratha), तम् him, गमिष्यति will approach.
explanation: The famous king Dasaratha will approach the son of the king of Anga known as Romapada.

shloka_text: अनपत्योऽस्मि धर्मात्मन् शान्ताभर्ता मम क्रतुम्। आहरेत त्वयाज्ञप्तस्सन्तानार्थं कुलस्य च।।1.11.5।।
transliteration: anapatyo'smi dharmātman śāntābhartā mama kratum| āhareta tvayājñaptassantānārthaṃ kulasya ca
translation: धर्मात्मन् O Follower of righteousness, अनपत्य: अस्मि I am without children, शान्ताभर्ता husband of Shanta, त्वया by you, आज्ञप्त: ordered, मम my, कुलस्य of race, सन्तानार्थम् for the sake of children (for perpetuation of my race), क्रतुम् sacrifice, आहरेत he may perform.
explanation: O righteous king I am issueless. Let Rsyasringa, husband of Santa be ordered to perform the a sacrificial ceremony so that I shall be blessed with I son for the perpetuaion of my race.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा राज्ञोऽथ तद्वाक्यं मनसा स विचिन्त्य च। प्रदास्यते पुत्रवन्तं शान्ताभर्तारमात्मवान्।।1.11.6।।
transliteration: śrutvā rājño'tha tadvākyaṃ manasā sa vicintya ca| pradāsyate putravantaṃ śāntābhartāramātmavān
translation: आत्मवान् prudent and wise, राज्ञ: king's, तद्वाक्यम् that statement, श्रुत्वा having heard, अथ thereafter, स: he, मनसा विचिन्त्य च after thinking over deeply in the mind, पुत्रवन्तम् him who has sons, शान्ताभर्तारम् husband of Shanta, प्रदास्यते will offer.
explanation: On hearing his words and deeply thinking over the matter, the prudent Romapada  agreed to send, Santa's husband (Rsyasringa), capable of blessing him with a son.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य च तं विप्रं स राजा विगतज्वर:। आहरिष्यति तं यज्ञं प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना।।1.11.7।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya ca taṃ vipraṃ sa rājā vigatajvara:| āhariṣyati taṃ yajñaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
translation: स: राजा that king, तं विप्रम् that brahmin, प्रतिगृह्य च having received (along with him), विगतज्वर: relieved of his mental suffering, प्रहृष्टेन with highly delighted, अन्तरात्मना heart, तं यज्ञम् that sacrifice, आहरिष्यति will perform.
explanation: The king relieved of his suffering, was highly delighted. He would take the brahmin with him and  perform the sacrificial ritual.

shloka_text: तं च राजा दशरथो यष्टुकाम: कृताञ्जलि:। ऋश्यशृङ्गं द्विजश्रेष्ठं वरयिष्यति धर्मवित्।। 1.11.8।। यज्ञार्थं प्रसवार्थं च स्वर्गार्थं च नरेश्वर:। लभते च स तं कामं द्विजमुख्याद्विशांपति:।।1.11.9।।
transliteration: taṃ ca rājā daśaratho yaṣṭukāma: kṛtāñjali:| ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ varayiṣyati dharmavit yajñārthaṃ prasavārthaṃ ca svargārthaṃ ca nareśvara:| labhate ca sa taṃ kāmaṃ dvijamukhyādviśāṃpati:
translation: यष्टुकाम: desirous of performing sacrifice, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, नरेश्वर: lord of the people, दशरथ:राजा king Dasaratha, कृताञ्जलि: with folded palms, द्विजश्रेष्ठम् best among  brahmins, ऋष्यशृङ्गम् Rsyasringa, यज्ञार्थम् for the sake of sacrifice, प्रसवार्थं च in order to obtain children, स्वर्गार्थं च to attain heaven, वरयिष्यति will choose him, स: विशांपति: lord of the people, द्विजमुख्यात् from that prominent brahmin, तं कामम् those desires, लभते च will get.
explanation: King Dasaratha, lord of the people, and knower of dharma and truth, desirous of performing the sacrifice would ask Rsyasringa, with folded palms for granting a boon to perform a sacrifice in order to obtain children and to attain heaven. The king will get those desires fulfilled through that chief brahmin.

shloka_text: तं च राजा दशरथो यष्टुकाम: कृताञ्जलि:। ऋश्यशृङ्गं द्विजश्रेष्ठं वरयिष्यति धर्मवित्।। 1.11.8।। यज्ञार्थं प्रसवार्थं च स्वर्गार्थं च नरेश्वर:। लभते च स तं कामं द्विजमुख्याद्विशांपति:।।1.11.9।।
transliteration: taṃ ca rājā daśaratho yaṣṭukāma: kṛtāñjali:| ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ varayiṣyati dharmavit yajñārthaṃ prasavārthaṃ ca svargārthaṃ ca nareśvara:| labhate ca sa taṃ kāmaṃ dvijamukhyādviśāṃpati:
translation: यष्टुकाम: desirous of performing sacrifice, धर्मवित् knower of dharma, नरेश्वर: lord of the people, दशरथ:राजा king Dasaratha, कृताञ्जलि: with folded palms, द्विजश्रेष्ठम् best among  brahmins, ऋष्यशृङ्गम् Rsyasringa, यज्ञार्थम् for the sake of sacrifice, प्रसवार्थं च in order to obtain children, स्वर्गार्थं च to attain heaven, वरयिष्यति will choose him, स: विशांपति: lord of the people, द्विजमुख्यात् from that prominent brahmin, तं कामम् those desires, लभते च will get.
explanation: King Dasaratha, lord of the people, and knower of dharma and truth, desirous of performing the sacrifice would ask Rsyasringa, with folded palms for granting a boon to perform a sacrifice in order to obtain children and to attain heaven. The king will get those desires fulfilled through that chief brahmin.

shloka_text: पुत्राश्चास्य भविष्यन्ति चत्वारोऽमितविक्रमा:। वंशप्रतिष्ठानकरास्सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुता:।।1.11.10।।
transliteration: putrāścāsya bhaviṣyanti catvāro'mitavikramā:| vaṃśapratiṣṭhānakarāssarvalokeṣu viśrutā:
translation: अस्य to him, अमितविक्रमा: men of immense prowess, वंशप्रतिष्ठानकरा: bringing glory and fame to their dynasty, सर्वलोकेषु in all the worlds, विश्रुता: renowned, चत्वार: four, पुत्रा: sons, भविष्यन्ति will be born.
explanation: Four sons of immense prowess would be born to him bringing glory and fame to their dynasty. They would be renowned in all the worlds.

shloka_text: एवं स देवप्रवर: पूर्वं कथितवान्कथाम्। सनत्कुमारो भगवान्पुरा देवयुगे प्रभु:।।1.11.11।।
transliteration: evaṃ sa devapravara: pūrvaṃ kathitavānkathām| sanatkumāro bhagavānpurā devayuge prabhu:
translation: देवप्रवर: great among devatas, भगवान् holy, प्रभु: competent, स: that, सनत्कुमार: Sanat kumara, पुरा in the early period of, देवयुगे in Krita yuga, कथाम् this story, एवम् in this way, कथितवान् narrated.
explanation: In early times of Kritayuga, this story was narrated by the holy and competent  Sanatkumara, the great one among the devatas".

shloka_text: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल तमानय सुसत्कृतम्। स्वयमेव महाराज गत्वा सबलवाहन:।।1.11.12।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla tamānaya susatkṛtam| svayameva mahārāja gatvā sabalavāhana:
translation: पुरुषशार्दूल greatest among men, महाराज O King, स: त्वम्  such a man you are, सबलवाहन: along with his foreces and vehicles, स्वयमेव personally, गत्वा having gone, सुसत्कृतम् wellhonoured, तम् him, आनय bring.
explanation: "Greatest among men, O king, along with vehicles and retinue, you may go and bring him (Rsyasringa) personally with due respect".

shloka_text: अनुमान्य वसिष्ठं च सूतवाक्यं निशम्य च। सान्त:पुरस्सहामात्य: प्रययौ यत्र स द्विज:।।1.11.13।।
transliteration: anumānya vasiṣṭhaṃ ca sūtavākyaṃ niśamya ca| sānta:purassahāmātya: prayayau yatra sa dvija:
translation: सूतवाक्यम् the charioteer's (Sumantra's) words, निशम्य having heard, वसिष्ठं च अनुमान्य obtaining the consent of Vasishta, सान्त:पुर: accompanied by queens, सहामात्य: along with courtiers, स:द्विज: that brahmin, यत्र to the place where he resided, प्रययौ departed.
explanation: Having heard the charioteer's words and having obtained the consent of Vasishta, he    along with his queens and courtiers departed to the place where the brahmin (Rsyasringa) resided.

shloka_text: वनानि सरितश्चैव व्यतिक्रम्य शनैश्शनै:। अभिचक्राम तं देशं यत्र वै मुनिपुङ्गव:।।1.11.14।।
transliteration: vanāni saritaścaiva vyatikramya śanaiśśanai:| abhicakrāma taṃ deśaṃ yatra vai munipuṅgava:
translation: शनै: शनै: slowly and slowly, वनानि forests, सरितश्चैव rivers, व्यतिक्रम्य crossing, मुनिपुङ्गव: foremost of ascetics, यत्र where he was, तं देशम् that place, अभिचक्राम reached.
explanation: Crossing forests and rivers slowly, the king reached the place where that foremost of ascetics lived.

shloka_text: आसाद्य तं द्विजश्रेष्ठं रोमपादसमीपगम्। ऋषिपुत्रं ददर्शादौ दीप्यमानमिवानलम्।।1.11.15।।
transliteration: āsādya taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ romapādasamīpagam| ṛṣiputraṃ dadarśādau dīpyamānamivānalam
translation: आसाद्य having reached, रोमपादसमीपगम् seated beside king Romapada, दीप्यमानम् glowing, अनलमिव like fire, द्विजश्रेष्ठम् best of brahmins, तं ऋषिपुत्रम् that  son of sage, आदौ in the begining, ददर्श beheld.
explanation: He reached the spot and saw the son of the ascetic, the best of brahmins glowing like fire seated next to Romapada.

shloka_text: ततो राजा यथान्यायं पूजां चक्रे विशेषत:। सखित्वात्तस्य वै राज्ञ: प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना।।1.11.16।।
transliteration: tato rājā yathānyāyaṃ pūjāṃ cakre viśeṣata:| sakhitvāttasya vai rājña: prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā
translation: तत: then, राजा king Romapada, प्रहृष्टेन with delight, अन्तरात्मना in the heart, यथान्यायम् as per tradition, सखित्वात् due to friendship, विशेषत: specially, तस्य of that, राज्ञ: king Dasaratha, पूजाम् respectful salutations, चक्रे offered.
explanation: Then the king (Romapada), delighted at heart out of friendship with the king (Dasaratha), offered special hospitality with respectful salutations in accordance with propriety.

shloka_text: रोमपादेन चाख्यातमृषिपुत्राय धीमते। सख्यं सम्बन्धकं चैव तदा तं प्रत्यपूजयत्।।1.11.17।।
transliteration: romapādena cākhyātamṛṣiputrāya dhīmate| sakhyaṃ sambandhakaṃ caiva tadā taṃ pratyapūjayat
translation: रोमपादेन by Romapada, सख्यम् friendship, सम्बन्धकं चैव relationship, धीमते to the intellectual, ऋषिपुत्राय son of the sage, आख्यातम् narrated, तदा then, तम् him (Romapada), प्रत्यपूजयत् in return felicitatetd.
explanation: Romapada explained his friendship and relationship with him (Dasaratha). Rsyasringa of great intellect in return felicitated Dasaratha.

shloka_text: एवं सुसत्कृतस्तेन सहोषित्वा नरर्षभ:। सप्ताष्टदिवसान्राजा राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.11.18।।
transliteration: evaṃ susatkṛtastena sahoṣitvā nararṣabha:| saptāṣṭadivasānrājā rājānamidamabravīt
translation: एवम् in this manner, सुसत्कृत: wellhonoured, नरर्षभ: the great among men, राजा king Dasaratha, तेन सह along with him, सप्ताष्ट seven or eight, दिवसान् days, उषित्वा having dwelt, राजानम् addressing Romapada, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: In this manner, the great among men, the king wellhonoured by Romapada, spent seven or eight days there.And then spoke this to Romapada:

shloka_text: शान्ता तव सुता राजन् सह भर्त्रा विशांपते। मदीयनगरं यातु कार्यं हि महदुद्यतम्।।1.11.19।।
transliteration: śāntā tava sutā rājan saha bhartrā viśāṃpate| madīyanagaraṃ yātu kāryaṃ hi mahadudyatam
translation: विशांपते O Lord of people, राजन् king, तव सुता your daughter, शान्ता Shanta, सह भर्त्रा along with her husband, मदीयनगरम् to my city, यातु let her go, महत् important, कार्यम् religious rite, उद्यतम् is planned.
explanation: O lord of people, O king, It has been decided to commence an important sacrificial rite. You may send your daughter Santa along with her husband to my city.

shloka_text: तथेति राजा संश्रुत्य गमनं तस्य धीमत:। उवाच वचनं विप्रं गच्छ त्वं सह भार्यया।।1.11.20।।
transliteration: tatheti rājā saṃśrutya gamanaṃ tasya dhīmata:| uvāca vacanaṃ vipraṃ gaccha tvaṃ saha bhāryayā
translation: राजा king, तथा इति be it so, धीमत: of the wise man, तस्य गमनम्  for his departure, संश्रुत्य having agreed, त्वम् you, भार्यया सह along with your wife, गच्छ please go, विप्रम् brahmin, वचनम् words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Having agreed to the departure of the sage Romapada said, 'Be pleased to go (to Ayodhya) together with your wife'.

shloka_text: ऋषिपुत्र: प्रतिश्रुत्य तथेत्याह नृपं तदा। स नृपेणाभ्यनुज्ञात: प्रययौ सह भार्यया।।1.11.21।।
transliteration: ṛṣiputra: pratiśrutya tathetyāha nṛpaṃ tadā| sa nṛpeṇābhyanujñāta: prayayau saha bhāryayā
translation: तदा then, ऋषिपुत्र: son of sage, प्रतिश्रुत्य having assented, नृपम् the king, तथा इति so it shall be done, आह said, नृपेण by king, अभ्यनुज्ञात: having been permitted, भार्यया सह along with his wife, प्रययौ departed.
explanation: The son of the sage assented to the king's command saying 'So be it'. And permitted by him, departed along with wife (for Ayodhya).

shloka_text: तावन्योन्याञ्जलिं कृत्वा स्नेहात्संश्लिष्य चोरसा। ननन्दतुर्दशरथो रोमपादश्च वीर्यवान्।।1.11.22।।
transliteration: tāvanyonyāñjaliṃ kṛtvā snehātsaṃśliṣya corasā| nanandaturdaśaratho romapādaśca vīryavān
translation: तौ both, दशरथ: Dasaratha, वीर्यवान् valiant, रोमपादश्च and Romapada, अन्योन्याञ्जलिम् each other wishing with folded palms, कृत्वा having done, स्नेहात् with friendship, उरसा heart to heart, संश्लिष्य embracing each other, ननन्दतु: were pleased.
explanation: Dasaratha and Romapada, pleased with this, wished each other with folded palms and hugged each other with love.

shloka_text: ततस्सुहृदमापृच्छ्य प्रस्थितो रघुनन्दन:। पौरेभ्य: प्रेषयामास दूतान्वै शीघ्रगामिन:।।1.11.23।।
transliteration: tatassuhṛdamāpṛcchya prasthito raghunandana:| paurebhya: preṣayāmāsa dūtānvai śīghragāmina:
translation: तत: then, रघुनन्दन: Dasaratha, सुहृदम् friend, आपृच्छ्य having taken leave, प्रस्थित: set out, शीघ्रगामिन: swiftly going, दूतान् messengers, पौरेभ्य: to the citizens, प्रेषयामास despatched.
explanation: Then king Dasaratha, took leave of  his friend and set out. He despatched swiftfooted messengers to the citizens with the command.

shloka_text: क्रियतां नगरं सर्वं क्षिप्रमेव स्वलङ्कृतम्। धूपितं सिक्तसम्मृष्टं पताकाभिरलङ्कृतम्।।1.11.24।।
transliteration: kriyatāṃ nagaraṃ sarvaṃ kṣiprameva svalaṅkṛtam| dhūpitaṃ siktasammṛṣṭaṃ patākābhiralaṅkṛtam
translation: सर्वम् the entire, नगरम् city, क्षिप्रमेव immediately, स्वलङ्कृतम् well decorated, धूपितम् perfumed, सिक्तसम्मृष्टम् sprinkled with water and cleaned, पताकाभि: with flags, अलङ्कृतम् decorated, क्रियताम् let it be done.
explanation: "Let the entire city be welldecorated, perfumed, sprinkled with water and cleaned with flags hoisted."

shloka_text: तत: प्रहृष्टा: पौरास्ते श्रुत्वा राजानमागतम्। तथा प्रचक्रुस्तत्सर्वं राज्ञा यत्प्रेषितं तदा ।।1.11.25।।
transliteration: tata: prahṛṣṭā: paurāste śrutvā rājānamāgatam| tathā pracakrustatsarvaṃ rājñā yatpreṣitaṃ tadā
translation: तत: then, ते पौरा: the people of Ayodhya, राजानम् the king, आगतम् arrival, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रहृष्टा: overjoyed, राज्ञा by king, यत् यथा as per, प्रेषितम् sent, तत् सर्वम् all that, तथा in the same manner, प्रचक्रु: fulfilled.
explanation: The people of the city having heard the king's arrival were overjoyed. They did everything as by the king.

shloka_text: ततस्स्वलङ्कृतं राजा नगरं प्रविवेश ह। शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषै: पुरस्कृत्य द्विजर्षभम्।।1.11.26।।
transliteration: tatassvalaṅkṛtaṃ rājā nagaraṃ praviveśa ha| śaṅkhadundubhinirghoṣai: puraskṛtya dvijarṣabham
translation: तत: then, राजा king, द्विजर्षभम् foremost of brahmins, पुरस्कृत्य keeping in the forefront, स्वलङ्कृतम् welldecorated, तत् that, नगरम् city, शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिर्घोषै: with conches blowing and drums beating, प्रविवेश ह entered.
explanation: Then the king entered that welldecorated city amidst blares of conches and the beating of drums, with the best of the brahmins (Rsyasringa) in the forefront.

shloka_text: तत: प्रमुदितास्सर्वे दृष्ट्वा तं नागरा द्विजम्। प्रवेश्यमानं सत्कृत्य नरेन्द्रेणेन्द्रकर्मणा।।1.11.27।।
transliteration: tata: pramuditāssarve dṛṣṭvā taṃ nāgarā dvijam| praveśyamānaṃ satkṛtya narendreṇendrakarmaṇā
translation: तत: then, सर्वे नागरा: all citizens, इन्द्रकर्मणां equivalent to Indra in valiant, नरेन्द्रेण by that king, सत्कृत्य having been honoured, प्रवेश्यमानम् entering, तम् that, द्विजम् brahmin, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, प्रमुदिता: were delighted.
explanation: The citizens were delighted to behold that brahmin entering the city duly honoured by the king who was equivalent to Indra in valiance৷৷

shloka_text: अन्त:पुरं प्रवेश्यैनं पूजां कृत्वा च शास्त्रत:। कृतकृत्यं तदात्मानं मेने तस्योपवाहनात्।।1.11.28।।
transliteration: anta:puraṃ praveśyainaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā ca śāstrata:| kṛtakṛtyaṃ tadātmānaṃ mene tasyopavāhanāt
translation: एनम् Rsyasringa, अन्त:पुरं प्रवेश्य having taken him to the inner apartment, शास्त्रत: traditionally as enjoined by the scriptures, पूजां welcome, कृत्वा having made, तदा then, तस्य उपवाहनात् for bringing him here, आत्मानम् himself, कृतकृत्यम् has accomplished his object, मेने thought.
explanation: He (king Dasaratha) took him in to the inner apartment and extended welcome. He thought that he has as enjoined by the sastras accomplished his objective by bringing him (Rsyasringa).

shloka_text: अन्त:पुरस्त्रियस्सर्वाश्शान्तां दृष्ट्वा तथागताम्। सह भर्त्रा विशालाक्षीं प्रीत्यानन्दमुपागमन्।।1.11.29।।
transliteration: anta:purastriyassarvāśśāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāgatām| saha bhartrā viśālākṣīṃ prītyānandamupāgaman
translation: अन्त:पुर स्त्रिय: royal ladies, सर्वा: all, तथा in that manner, भर्त्रा सह along with her husband, आगताम् arrived, विशालाक्षीम् wideeyed lady, शान्ताम् Shanta, दृष्ट्वा having seen, प्रीत्या affectionately, आनन्दम् delight, उपागमन् experienced.
explanation: All the royal ladies, experienced immense delight when they saw the largeeyed Shanta arriving  along with her husband in that manner.

shloka_text: पूज्यमाना च ताभिस्सा राज्ञा चैव विशेषत:। उवास तत्र सुखिता कञ्चित्कालं सहर्त्विजा।।1.11.30।।
transliteration: pūjyamānā ca tābhissā rājñā caiva viśeṣata:| uvāsa tatra sukhitā kañcitkālaṃ sahartvijā
translation: सा she, ताभि: with them, विशेषत: especially, राज्ञा चैव with the king, पूज्यमाना honoured and worshipped, सुखिता comforted, ऋत्विजा सह along with sage Rsyasringa, कञ्चित् कालम् for some time, तत्र there, उवास dwelt.
explanation: Honoured and worshipped by royal ladies, especially by king Dasaratha, Santa dwelt there for some time comfortably with the sage. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तत: काले बहुतिथे कस्मिंश्चित्सुमनोहरे। वसन्ते समनुप्राप्ते राज्ञो यष्टुं मनोऽभवत्।।1.12.1।।
transliteration: tata: kāle bahutithe kasmiṃścitsumanohare| vasante samanuprāpte rājño yaṣṭuṃ mano'bhavat
translation: तत: afterwards, बहुतिथे काले after a lapse of long time, सुमनोहरे charming, कस्मिंश्चित्   some time, वसन्ते spring season, समनुप्राप्ते having arrived, राज्ञ: for the king, यष्टुम् to perform sacrifice, मन: अभवत् desire arose.
explanation: After a long time, at the advent of charming spring a desire arose in the mind of the king (Dasaratha) to perform the sacrifice.
comments: Dasaratha requests Rsyasringa to perform the sacrificethe priests order him to procure necessary materials and to release the sacificial horse--Dasaratha orders his ministers to get the preparations done.

shloka_text: तत: प्रसाद्य शिरसा तं विप्रं देववर्णिनम्। यज्ञाय वरयामास सन्तानार्थं कुलस्य वै।।1.12.2।।
transliteration: tata: prasādya śirasā taṃ vipraṃ devavarṇinam| yajñāya varayāmāsa santānārthaṃ kulasya vai
translation: तत: then, देववर्णिनम् effulgent like a celestial being, विप्रम् that brahmin, शिरसा bowing his head low in respect, प्रसाद्य having won his grace, कुलस्य of the dynasty, सन्तानार्थम् for preserving uninterrupted continuity, यज्ञाय to perform sacrifice, वरयामास appointed him as official priest to preside over the ceremony.
explanation: Then bowing his head in respect to that brahmin who was effulgent like a celestial  and having won his grace he chose him to conduct a sacrifice for a son for (the continuity of) his dynasty.

shloka_text: तथेति च स राजानमुवाच च सुसत्कृत:। सम्भारा सम्भ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्।।1.12.3।।
transliteration: tatheti ca sa rājānamuvāca ca susatkṛta:| sambhārā sambhriyantāṃ te turagaśca vimucyatām
translation: सुसत्कृत: wellhonoured, स: that brahmin, तथेति be it so, राजानम् king, उवाच said, सम्भारा: requisite materials, सम्भ्रियन्ताम् be procured, ते your, तुरग: sacrificial horse, विमुच्यताम् च let it be released.
explanation: The wellhonoured brahmin agreed, saying, "Be it so, let the requisite materials be procured and the sacificial horse, released".

shloka_text: ततो राजाऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्। सुमन्त्रावाहय क्षिप्रं ऋत्विजो ब्रह्मवादिन:।।1.12.4।। सुयज्ञं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ काश्यपम्। पुरोहितं वसिष्ठं च ये चान्ये द्विजसत्तमा:।।1.12.5।।
transliteration: tato rājā'bravīdvākyaṃ sumantraṃ mantrisattamam| sumantrāvāhaya kṣipraṃ ṛtvijo brahmavādina: suyajñaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālimatha kāśyapam| purohitaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca ye cānye dvijasattamā:
translation: तत: thereafter, राजा king, मन्त्रिसत्तमम् best of ministers, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, सुमन्त्र: O Sumantra, क्षिप्रम् immediately, ब्रह्मवादिन: wellversed in vedas, ऋत्विज: official priests, सुयज्ञम् Suyajna, वामदेवम् च Vamadeva, जाबालिम् Jabali, अथ and, काश्यपम् Kashyapa, पुरोहितं वसिष्ठं च family priest Vasistha, अन्ये other, द्विजसत्तमा: foremost among brahmins, आवाहय summon.
explanation: Thereafter the king said to Sumantra, "Summon immediately, Suyajna, Vamadeva, Jabali and Kasyapa, family priest Vasishta and other foremost and learned brahmins who are the official priests wellversed in the Vedas".

shloka_text: ततो राजाऽब्रवीद्वाक्यं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्। सुमन्त्रावाहय क्षिप्रं ऋत्विजो ब्रह्मवादिन:।।1.12.4।। सुयज्ञं वामदेवं च जाबालिमथ काश्यपम्। पुरोहितं वसिष्ठं च ये चान्ये द्विजसत्तमा:।।1.12.5।।
transliteration: tato rājā'bravīdvākyaṃ sumantraṃ mantrisattamam| sumantrāvāhaya kṣipraṃ ṛtvijo brahmavādina: suyajñaṃ vāmadevaṃ ca jābālimatha kāśyapam| purohitaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ ca ye cānye dvijasattamā:
translation: तत: thereafter, राजा king, मन्त्रिसत्तमम् best of ministers, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, सुमन्त्र: O Sumantra, क्षिप्रम् immediately, ब्रह्मवादिन: wellversed in vedas, ऋत्विज: official priests, सुयज्ञम् Suyajna, वामदेवम् च Vamadeva, जाबालिम् Jabali, अथ and, काश्यपम् Kashyapa, पुरोहितं वसिष्ठं च family priest Vasistha, अन्ये other, द्विजसत्तमा: foremost among brahmins, आवाहय summon.
explanation: Thereafter the king said to Sumantra, "Summon immediately, Suyajna, Vamadeva, Jabali and Kasyapa, family priest Vasishta and other foremost and learned brahmins who are the official priests wellversed in the Vedas".

shloka_text: ततस्सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितं गत्वा त्वरितविक्रम:। समानयत्स तान्विप्रान् समस्तान्वेदपारगान्।।1.12.6।।
transliteration: tatassumantrastvaritaṃ gatvā tvaritavikrama:| samānayatsa tānviprān samastānvedapāragān
translation: तत: thereupon, त्वरितविक्रम: a man with swift movements, स: सुमन्त्र: that Sumantra, त्वरितम् immediately, गत्वा had gone, वेदपारगान् mastered fully vedas, समस्तान् gathering together, तान् विप्रान् all of those brahmins, समानयत् brought.
explanation: Then Sumantra, a man of smart movement went immediately and brought all those brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas.

shloka_text: तान्पूजयित्वा धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्तदा। धर्मार्थसहितं युक्तं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.12.7।।
transliteration: tānpūjayitvā dharmātmā rājā daśarathastadā| dharmārthasahitaṃ yuktaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: धर्मात्मा virtuous, दशरथ: राजा king Dasaratha, तदा then, तान् them, पूजयित्वा after paying respects, धर्मार्थसहितम् full of truth and duty, श्लक्ष्णम् gracious, (इदं) युक्तं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् uttered.
explanation: After paying respect to them (learned brahmins), virtuous king Dasaratha graciously uttered these words charged with dharma and artha.

shloka_text: मम लालप्यमानस्य पुत्रार्थं नास्ति वै सुखम्। तदर्थं हयमेधेन यक्ष्यामीति मतिर्मम।।1.12.8।।
transliteration: mama lālapyamānasya putrārthaṃ nāsti vai sukham| tadarthaṃ hayamedhena yakṣyāmīti matirmama
translation: पुत्रार्थम् to have sons, लालप्यमानस्य suffering from intense sorrow, मम for me, सुखम् happiness, नास्ति वै not there, तदर्थं for that reason, (अहम् I), हयमेधेन यक्ष्यामि I shall perform HorseSacrifice, इति thus, मम my, मति: intention.
explanation: "There is no happiness for me. I am overwhelmed with grief as I have no son. Therefore, I intend to perform a horsesacrifice.

shloka_text: तदहं यष्टुमिच्छामि शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा। ऋषिपुत्रप्रभावेन कामान्प्राप्स्यामि चाप्यहम्।।1.12.9।।
transliteration: tadahaṃ yaṣṭumicchāmi śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā| ṛṣiputraprabhāvena kāmānprāpsyāmi cāpyaham
translation: तत् for that reason, शास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा according to scriptural procedures, यष्टुं इच्छामि desirous of performing sacrifice, ऋषिपुत्रप्रभावेन by the grace of sage Rishyashringa, अहम् I, कामान् desires, प्राप्स्यामि च will obtain.
explanation: I wish to perform the yaga acording to scriptural procedures. And I will have my desire fulfilled by the grace of the sage (Rsyasringa)".

shloka_text: ततस्साध्विति तद्वाक्यं ब्राह्मणा: प्रत्यपूजयन्। वसिष्ठप्रमुखास्सर्वे पार्थिवस्य मुखाच्च्युतम्।।1.12.10।।
transliteration: tatassādhviti tadvākyaṃ brāhmaṇā: pratyapūjayan| vasiṣṭhapramukhāssarve pārthivasya mukhāccyutam
translation: तत: then, वसिष्ठप्रमुखा: Vasishta and others, ब्राह्मणा: brahmins, सर्वे all, पार्थिवस्य king's, मुखात् from the mouth, च्युतम् delivered, तत् वाक्यम those words, साधु इति well said, प्रत्यपूजयन् extolled.
explanation: When they heard these words from the king's month, those brahmins heades by Vasishta extolled the king's decision exclaiming, "wellsaid":

shloka_text: ऋष्यशृङ्गपुरोगाश्च प्रत्यूचुर्नृपतिं तदा। सम्भारास्सम्भ्रियन्तां ते तुरगश्च विमुच्यताम्।।1.12.11।।
transliteration: ṛṣyaśṛṅgapurogāśca pratyūcurnṛpatiṃ tadā| sambhārāssambhriyantāṃ te turagaśca vimucyatām
translation: ऋष्यशृङ्गपुरोगा: priests led by Rsyashringa, तदा then, नृपतिम् addressing king, प्रत्यूचु: replied, सम्भारा: sacrificial articles, सम्भ्रियन्ताम् be procured, ते your, तुरग: sacrificial horse, विमुच्यतां च be released.
explanation: The priests led by Rsyasringa replied to the king, saying, "Let the sacrificial articles be procured and your sacrificial horse released."

shloka_text: सर्वथा प्राप्स्यसे पुत्रांश्चत्वारोऽमितविक्रमान्। यस्य ते धार्मिकी बुद्धिरियं पुत्रार्थमागता ।।1.12.12।।
transliteration: sarvathā prāpsyase putrāṃścatvāro'mitavikramān| yasya te dhārmikī buddhiriyaṃ putrārthamāgatā
translation: यस्य ते for you whose, पुत्रार्थम् for begetting children, इयम् this, धार्मिकी बुद्धि: righteous thought, आगता having come to your mind, सर्वथा surely, अमितविक्रमान् men of immense  prowess, चत्वार: four, पुत्रान् sons, प्राप्स्यसे shall you get.
explanation: "Since this righteous thought for begetting children has entered your mind, you shall surely get four sons of immense prowess".

shloka_text: तत: प्रीतोऽभवद्राजा श्रुत्वा तद्विजभाषितम्। अमात्यांश्चाब्रवीद्राजा हर्षेणेदं शुभाक्षरम्।।1.12.13।।
transliteration: tata: prīto'bhavadrājā śrutvā tadvijabhāṣitam| amātyāṃścābravīdrājā harṣeṇedaṃ śubhākṣaram
translation: तत: thereafter, राजा king, द्विजभाषितम् brahmin's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रीत: अभवत्  felt happy, राजा king, हर्षेण with delight, शुभाक्षरम् containing auspicious letters,  इदं this,  अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Pleased to hear the brahmins' words, the king happily addressed his ministers with auspicious words:

shloka_text: गुरूणां वचनाच्छीघ्रं सम्भारास्सम्भ्रियन्तु मे। समर्थाधिष्ठितश्चाश्वस्सोपाध्यायो विमुच्यताम्।।1.12.14।।
transliteration: gurūṇāṃ vacanācchīghraṃ sambhārāssambhriyantu me| samarthādhiṣṭhitaścāśvassopādhyāyo vimucyatām
translation: (इह now), मे गुरूणाम् my spiritual preceptors', वचनात् words, सम्भारा: articles required for performing the sacrifice, सम्भ्रियन्तु be procured, समर्थाधिष्ठित: under the protection of warriors, सोपाध्याय: along with main priest, अश्व: horse, विमुच्यताम् be released.
explanation: "In accordance with the instructions by my spiritual preceptors let the articles (required for performing the sacrifice) be procured and the horse  released under the protection of warriors accompanied by the chief priest".

shloka_text: सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे यज्ञभूमिर्विधीयताम्। शान्तयश्चाभिवर्धन्तां यथाकल्पं यथाविधि।।1.12.15।।
transliteration: sarayvāścottare tīre yajñabhūmirvidhīyatām| śāntayaścābhivardhantāṃ yathākalpaṃ yathāvidhi
translation: सरय्वा: of river Sarayu, उत्तरे तीरे on the northern bank, यज्ञभूमि: sacrificial pavillion, विधीयताम् be constructed, यथाकल्पम् according to prescribed ritual code, यथाविधि according to the scriptural stipulation, शान्तयश्च expiatory rites, अभिवर्धन्ताम् may be wished.
explanation: Let a sacrificial pavillion be constructed on the northern bank of Sarayu according to prescribed methods ordained in the 'kalpa' and other scriptures for the uninterrupted completion of the sacrifice.

shloka_text: शक्य: प्राप्तुमयं यज्ञस्सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता। नापराधो भवेत्कष्टो यद्यस्मिन्क्रतुसत्तमे।।1.12.16।।
transliteration: śakya: prāptumayaṃ yajñassarveṇāpi mahīkṣitā| nāparādho bhavetkaṣṭo yadyasminkratusattame
translation: अस्मिन् In this, क्रतुसत्तमे best of sacifices, कष्ट: difficulties, अपराध: omissions, न भवेत् यदि does not happen, अयं यज्ञ: this sacrifice, सर्वेणापि महीक्षिता indeed by every king, प्राप्तुम् to obtain, शक्य: possible.
explanation: If in this best of sacrifices aswamedha, obstructions and omissions do not occur it will be possible for the king to get the results.

shloka_text: छिद्रं हि मृगयन्तेऽत्र विद्वांसो ब्रह्मराक्षसा:। निहतस्य च यज्ञस्य सद्य: कर्ता विनश्यति।।1.12.17।।
transliteration: chidraṃ hi mṛgayante'tra vidvāṃso brahmarākṣasā:| nihatasya ca yajñasya sadya: kartā vinaśyati
translation: अत्र in this sacrifice, विद्वांस: learned men, ब्रह्मराक्षसा: brahma rakshasas(celestial beings turned into demons), छिद्रम् flaw, मृगयन्ते हि will be looking out for, निहतस्य struck down, यज्ञस्य of sacrifice, कर्ता च the doer, सद्य: immediately, विनश्यति will be destroyed.
explanation: The learned brahmarakshasas always look out for flaws in the sacrifice so that they can strike into it. If the sacrifice is damaged, the doer of the sacrifice will be immediately destroyed.

shloka_text: तद्यथा विधिपूर्वं मे क्रतुरेष समाप्यते। तथा विधानं क्रियतां समर्था: करणेष्विह।।1.12.18।।
transliteration: tadyathā vidhipūrvaṃ me kratureṣa samāpyate| tathā vidhānaṃ kriyatāṃ samarthā: karaṇeṣviha
translation: तत् for that reason, मे my, एष: क्रतु: this sacifice, विधिपूर्वम् in accordance with scriptures, यथा समाप्यते as it could be completed, तथा in that manner, विधानम् arrangement, क्रियताम् may be done, इह(You) here, करणेषु in actions, समर्था: experts.
explanation: Therefore let the arrangements be made in a manner by which this sacifice is completed in accordance with the prescriptions in scriptures and you are experts in doing so".

shloka_text: तथेति च ततस्सर्वे मन्त्रिण: प्रत्यपूजयन्। पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य तद्वाक्यं यथाज्ञप्तमकुर्वत।।1.12.19।।
transliteration: tatheti ca tatassarve mantriṇa: pratyapūjayan| pārthivendrasya tadvākyaṃ yathājñaptamakurvata
translation: तत: then, मन्त्रिण: ministers, सर्वे all, पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य of that king's, तथेति let it be so, प्रत्यपूजयन् honoured, यथाज्ञप्तम् as ordered, अकुर्वत performed.
explanation: Honouring the words of the king, all the ministers did as ordered.

shloka_text: ततो द्विजास्ते धर्मज्ञमस्तुवन्पार्थिवर्षभम्। अनुज्ञातास्ततस्सर्वे पुनर्जग्मुर्यथागतम्।।1.12.20।।
transliteration: tato dvijāste dharmajñamastuvanpārthivarṣabham| anujñātāstatassarve punarjagmuryathāgatam
translation: तत: after that, ते द्विजा: those brahmins, धर्मज्ञम् knower of righteousness, पार्थिवर्षभम् great king, अस्तुवन् praised, अनुज्ञाता: having been permitted, तत: from there, पुन: again, यथागतम् in the manner as they came, जग्मु: returned.
explanation: Admiring the great king, the knower of righteousness, the brahmins permitted by him  returned to their places as they had some.

shloka_text: गतेष्वथ द्विजाग्य्रेषु मन्त्रिणस्तान्नराधिप:। विसर्जयित्वा स्वं वेश्म प्रविवेश महाद्युति:।।1.12.21।।
transliteration: gateṣvatha dvijāgyreṣu mantriṇastānnarādhipa:| visarjayitvā svaṃ veśma praviveśa mahādyuti:
translation: अथ thereafter, द्विजाग्य्रेषु when great brahmins, गतेषु (सत्सु) had departed, महाद्युति: great and glorious, नराधिप: king, मन्त्रिण: those ministers, विसर्जयित्वा having sent them, स्वं वेश्म his palace, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: When the great brahmins  departed, the glorious king (Dasaratha) sent away his ministers and entered his palace. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्वादशस्सर्ग:।।2 Thus ends the twelfth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: पुन: प्राप्ते वसन्ते तु पूर्णस्संवत्सरोऽभवत्। प्रसवार्थं गतो यष्टुं हयमेधेन वीर्यवान्।।1.13.1।।
transliteration: puna: prāpte vasante tu pūrṇassaṃvatsaro'bhavat| prasavārthaṃ gato yaṣṭuṃ hayamedhena vīryavān
translation: पुन: again, वसन्ते in spring, प्राप्ते सति having returned, संवत्सर: one year, पूर्ण: अभवत् completed, वीर्यवान् valiant, प्रसवार्थम् for begetting sons, हयमेधेन by Horsesacrifice, यष्टुम् to worship celestial beings, गत: entered sacrificial pavilion.
explanation: After completion of one year when spring returned, the valiant king (Dasaratha) entered the sacrificial pavilion to worship celestial beings for begetting sons.
comments: Dasaratha requests Vasishta to commence the sacrifice-- orders various people skilled in their profession to attend to the preparations--Vasishta asks Sumantra to invite kings from various countries--extends hospitality-- Dasaratha commences the sacrificial ceremony with his wives

shloka_text: अभिवाद्य वसिष्ठं च न्यायत: परिपूज्य च। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं प्रसवार्थं द्विजोत्तमम्।।1.13.2।।
transliteration: abhivādya vasiṣṭhaṃ ca nyāyata: paripūjya ca| abravītpraśritaṃ vākyaṃ prasavārthaṃ dvijottamam
translation: द्विजोत्तमम् best among brahmins, वसिष्ठम् sage Vasishta, अभिवाद्य offering salutations, न्यायत: in accordance with prescribed ordinance, परिपूज्य च having worshipped, प्रसवार्थम् for begetting children, प्रश्रितम् with obedience, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: After offering humble salutations and worshipping sage Vasishta in accordance with prescribed ordinance for begetting children, he obediently said:

shloka_text: यज्ञो मे क्रियतां ब्रह्मन्यथोक्तं मुनिपुङ्गव। यथा न विघ्न: क्रियते यज्ञाङ्गेषु विधीयताम्।।1.13.3।।
transliteration: yajño me kriyatāṃ brahmanyathoktaṃ munipuṅgava| yathā na vighna: kriyate yajñāṅgeṣu vidhīyatām
translation: मुनिपुङ्गव O Foremost among ascetics, ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, मे my, यज्ञ: sacrifice, यथोक्तम् according to the tradition, क्रियताम् let it be performed, यज्ञाङ्गेषु essential requisites, विघ्न: obstruction, यथा in such manner, न क्रियते will not take place, विधीयताम् let it be performed.
explanation: "O foremost among ascetics O brahman, may the sacrifice be performed according to  tradition in such a manner that the sacrifice is performed unhindered.

shloka_text: भवान् स्निग्धस्सुहृन्मह्यं गुरुश्च परमो महान्। ओढव्यो भवता चैव भारो यज्ञस्य चोद्यत:।।1.13.4।।
transliteration: bhavān snigdhassuhṛnmahyaṃ guruśca paramo mahān| oḍhavyo bhavatā caiva bhāro yajñasya codyata:
translation: भवान् you, मह्यम् to me, स्निग्ध: affectionate one, सुहृत् friend, परम: great, महान् reverential, गुरु: spiritual guide, यज्ञस्य sacrifice, उद्यत: has commenced, भार: burden of performing the sacrifice, भवता चैव by you alone, ओढव्य: shall be borne.
explanation: You are an affectionate friend and most reverential spiritual guide to me. The burden of performing the sacrifice which has since commenced shall be borne by you".

shloka_text: तथेति च स राजानमब्रवीद्द्विजसत्तमः। करिष्ये सर्वमेवैतद्भवता यत्समर्थितम्।।1.13.5।।
transliteration: tatheti ca sa rājānamabravīddvijasattamaḥ| kariṣye sarvamevaitadbhavatā yatsamarthitam
translation: द्विजसत्तम: foremost among brahmins, स: sage Vasishta, भवता by you, यत् which ever, समर्थितम् as decided by you, एतत् that, सर्वम् all, तथा in that manner, करिष्ये will be performed, इति thus, राजानम् to the king, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The great among brahmins answered him saying "I shall do everything as proposed by you".

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीद्विजान्वृद्धान्यज्ञकर्मसु निष्ठितान्। स्थापत्ये निष्ठितांश्चैव वृद्धान्परमधार्मिकान्।।1.13.6।। कर्मान्तिकान् शिल्पकरान्वर्धकीन् खनकानपि। गणकान्शिल्पिनश्चैव तथैव नटनर्तकान्।।1.13.7।। तथा शुचीन्शास्त्रविद: पुरुषान् सुबहुश्रुतान्। यज्ञकर्म समीहन्तां भवन्तो राजशासनात्।।1.13.8।। इष्टका बहु साहस्राश्शीघ्रमानीयतामिति। 0 उपकार्या: क्रियन्तां च राज्ञां बहुगुणान्विता:।।1.13.9।।
transliteration: tato'bravīdvijānvṛddhānyajñakarmasu niṣṭhitān| sthāpatye niṣṭhitāṃścaiva vṛddhānparamadhārmikān karmāntikān śilpakarānvardhakīn khanakānapi| gaṇakānśilpinaścaiva tathaiva naṭanartakān tathā śucīnśāstravida: puruṣān subahuśrutān| yajñakarma samīhantāṃ bhavanto rājaśāsanāt iṣṭakā bahu sāhasrāśśīghramānīyatāmiti| 0 upakāryā: kriyantāṃ ca rājñāṃ bahuguṇānvitā:
