translation: तत: after that, यज्ञकर्मसु in the sacrificerelated activities, निष्ठितान् experienced, वृद्धान् venerable, द्विजान् brahmins, वृद्धान् venerable, परमधार्मिकान् most righteous people, स्थापत्ये in the science of architecture, निष्ठितांश्चैव skilled, कर्मान्तिकान् workers, शिल्पकरान् makers of bricks, वर्धकीन् carpenters, खनकानपि diggers, गणकान् men adept in calculations, शिल्पिनश्चैव artisans, तथैव and, नटनर्तकान् dancers and actors, तथा and, शुचीन् men having clean back ground, शास्त्रविद: wellversed in the scriptures, सुबहुश्रुतान् wellinformed and knowledgeable, पुरुषान् people, भवन्त: all of you, राजशासनात् by king's command, यज्ञकर्म sacrificial work, समीहन्ताम् be planned, बहुसाहस्रा in thousands, इष्टका: bricks, शीघ्रम् immediately, आनीयताम् let them be brought, राज्ञाम् kings', बहुगुणान्विता: commanding all comforts, उपकार्या: temporary residential buildings, क्रियन्ताम् be erected.
explanation: Thereafter Vasishta summoned those brahmins who are experienced in the sacrificerelated activities venerable and righteous architects skilled workers brick makers, carpenters, diggers, artisans, account keepers, dancers and actors, men versed in scriptures and honest, wellinformed people and addressed them saying, "In accordance with the king's command let the work of the sacrificial ceremony be inauguarated. Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीद्विजान्वृद्धान्यज्ञकर्मसु निष्ठितान्। स्थापत्ये निष्ठितांश्चैव वृद्धान्परमधार्मिकान्।।1.13.6।। कर्मान्तिकान् शिल्पकरान्वर्धकीन् खनकानपि। गणकान्शिल्पिनश्चैव तथैव नटनर्तकान्।।1.13.7।। तथा शुचीन्शास्त्रविद: पुरुषान् सुबहुश्रुतान्। यज्ञकर्म समीहन्तां भवन्तो राजशासनात्।।1.13.8।। इष्टका बहु साहस्राश्शीघ्रमानीयतामिति। 0 उपकार्या: क्रियन्तां च राज्ञां बहुगुणान्विता:।।1.13.9।।
transliteration: tato'bravīdvijānvṛddhānyajñakarmasu niṣṭhitān| sthāpatye niṣṭhitāṃścaiva vṛddhānparamadhārmikān karmāntikān śilpakarānvardhakīn khanakānapi| gaṇakānśilpinaścaiva tathaiva naṭanartakān tathā śucīnśāstravida: puruṣān subahuśrutān| yajñakarma samīhantāṃ bhavanto rājaśāsanāt iṣṭakā bahu sāhasrāśśīghramānīyatāmiti| 0 upakāryā: kriyantāṃ ca rājñāṃ bahuguṇānvitā:
translation: तत: after that, यज्ञकर्मसु in the sacrificerelated activities, निष्ठितान् experienced, वृद्धान् venerable, द्विजान् brahmins, वृद्धान् venerable, परमधार्मिकान् most righteous people, स्थापत्ये in the science of architecture, निष्ठितांश्चैव skilled, कर्मान्तिकान् workers, शिल्पकरान् makers of bricks, वर्धकीन् carpenters, खनकानपि diggers, गणकान् men adept in calculations, शिल्पिनश्चैव artisans, तथैव and, नटनर्तकान् dancers and actors, तथा and, शुचीन् men having clean back ground, शास्त्रविद: wellversed in the scriptures, सुबहुश्रुतान् wellinformed and knowledgeable, पुरुषान् people, भवन्त: all of you, राजशासनात् by king's command, यज्ञकर्म sacrificial work, समीहन्ताम् be planned, बहुसाहस्रा in thousands, इष्टका: bricks, शीघ्रम् immediately, आनीयताम् let them be brought, राज्ञाम् kings', बहुगुणान्विता: commanding all comforts, उपकार्या: temporary residential buildings, क्रियन्ताम् be erected.
explanation: Thereafter Vasishta summoned those brahmins who are experienced in the sacrificerelated activities venerable and righteous architects skilled workers brick makers, carpenters, diggers, artisans, account keepers, dancers and actors, men versed in scriptures and honest, wellinformed people and addressed them saying, "In accordance with the king's command let the work of the sacrificial ceremony be inauguarated. Let thousands of bricks be brought. Let temporary residential buildings be erected with all the comforts to accommodate royal guests."

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणावसथाश्चैव कर्तव्याश्शतशश्शुभा:। भक्ष्यान्नपानैर्बहुभिस्समुपेतास्सुनिष्ठिता:।।1.13.10।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇāvasathāścaiva kartavyāśśataśaśśubhā:| bhakṣyānnapānairbahubhissamupetāssuniṣṭhitā:
translation: शुभा: auspicious, बहुभि: by many, भक्ष्यान्नपानै: with eatables and drinks, समुपेता: furnished with, सुनिष्ठिता: well arranged, ब्राह्मणावसथा: चैव residences for brahmins, शतश: in hundreds, कर्तव्या: be prepared.
explanation: Let auspicious residences for the brahmins be prepared in their hundreds, well arranged and furnished with abundant food and drink.

shloka_text: तथा पौरजनस्यापि कर्तव्या बहुविस्तरा:। आवासा बहुभक्ष्या वै सर्वकामैरुपस्थिता:।।1.13.11।।
transliteration: tathā paurajanasyāpi kartavyā bahuvistarā:| āvāsā bahubhakṣyā vai sarvakāmairupasthitā:
translation: तथा in the same manner, पौरजनस्यापि people from other towns, बहु विस्तरा: widely spread, बहुभक्ष्या: many items of food, सर्वकामै: by all kinds of entertainment, उपस्थिता: provided with, आवासा: residential accommodation, कर्तव्या: should be done.
explanation: In the same manner let widely spread residential accommodation be furnished with many items of food and all kinds of entertainment be provided for people from other lands.

shloka_text: तथा जानपदस्यापि जनस्य बहुशोभनम्। दातव्यमन्नं विधिवत्सत्कृत्य न तु लीलया।।1.13.12।।
transliteration: tathā jānapadasyāpi janasya bahuśobhanam| dātavyamannaṃ vidhivatsatkṛtya na tu līlayā
translation: तथा in the sameway, जानपदस्य for the rural, जनस्यापि people also, बहुशोभनम् extremely good, अन्नम् food, विधिवत् according to tradition, सत्कृत्य treated with good respect, दातव्यम् given, लीलयातु न not casually in a careless way.
explanation: In the same way people coming from rural areas also should be duly, not casualy treated with respect.

shloka_text: सर्वे वर्णा यथा पूजां प्राप्नुवन्ति सुसत्कृता:। न चावज्ञा प्रयोक्तव्या कामक्रोधवशादपि।।1.13.13।।
transliteration: sarve varṇā yathā pūjāṃ prāpnuvanti susatkṛtā:| na cāvajñā prayoktavyā kāmakrodhavaśādapi
translation: सर्वे all, वर्णा: castes, सुसत्कृता: well treated, यथा in whatever manner, पूजाम् homage, प्राप्नुवन्ति will receive, कामक्रोधवशादपि through greed, anger or lust, अवज्ञा insult, न प्रयोक्तव्या not to be meted out.
explanation: People from all castes should be welltreated with respect. There should be no insult to any one through lust on greed on anger.

shloka_text: यज्ञकर्मसु ये व्यग्रा: पुरुषाश्शिल्पिनस्तथा। तेषामपि विशेषेण पूजा कार्या यथाक्रमम्।।1.13.14।। ते च स्युस्सम्भृतास्सर्वे वसुभिर्भोजनेन च।
transliteration: yajñakarmasu ye vyagrā: puruṣāśśilpinastathā| teṣāmapi viśeṣeṇa pūjā kāryā yathākramam te ca syussambhṛtāssarve vasubhirbhojanena ca|
translation: ये पुरुषा: those people, तथा and, शिल्पिन: sculptors, यज्ञकर्मसु in sacrificerelated activities, व्यग्रा: deeply immersed, तेषामपि for them also, विशेषेण specially, पूजा honour, कार्या should be given, ते सर्वे all of them, वसुभि: with money, भोजनेन च with food, सम्भृता: स्यु: made contended.
explanation: The people deeply immersed in performing sacrificerelated activities and sculptors be specially honoured according to their nature of work. All of them should be satisfied with money and food.

shloka_text: यथा सर्वं सुविहितं न किञ्चित्परिहीयते।।1.13.15।। तथा भवन्त: कुर्वन्तु प्रीतिस्निग्धेन चेतसा।
transliteration: yathā sarvaṃ suvihitaṃ na kiñcitparihīyate tathā bhavanta: kurvantu prītisnigdhena cetasā|
translation: सर्वम् all, यथा in whatever manner, सुविहितम् well managed, किञ्चित् even little, न परिहीयते not left out, तथा in that manner, भवन्त: you, प्रीतिस्निग्धेन with love and affection, चेतसा with mind, कुर्वन्तु let it be done.
explanation: Every thing should be wellmanaged. In whatever manner you do, not even the smallest things be left out. Carry out the work with love and affection in your hearts".

shloka_text: ततस्सर्वे समागम्य वसिष्ठमिदमब्रुवन्।।1.13.16।। यथोक्तं तत्सुविहितं न किञ्चित्परिहीयते। यथोक्तं तत्करिष्यामो न किञ्चित्परिहास्यते।।1.13.17।।
transliteration: tatassarve samāgamya vasiṣṭhamidamabruvan yathoktaṃ tatsuvihitaṃ na kiñcitparihīyate| yathoktaṃ tatkariṣyāmo na kiñcitparihāsyate
translation: तत: then, सर्वे all, समागम्य approached, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, इदम् this statement, अब्रुवन् said, यथा in the manner, उक्तम् has been told, तत् that, सुविहितम् well arranged, किञ्चित् even little, न परिहीयते will not be left out, यथोक्तम् in the manner it has been told, तत् that, करिष्याम: we will do, किञ्चित् even a little, न परिहास्यते will not be left out.
explanation: Then all of them approached Vasishta and said, "everything has been wellarranged in accordance with your instruction. There is no deficiency. Everything will be done as instructed by you without leaving out anything."

shloka_text: ततस्सर्वे समागम्य वसिष्ठमिदमब्रुवन्।।1.13.16।। यथोक्तं तत्सुविहितं न किञ्चित्परिहीयते। यथोक्तं तत्करिष्यामो न किञ्चित्परिहास्यते।।1.13.17।।
transliteration: tatassarve samāgamya vasiṣṭhamidamabruvan yathoktaṃ tatsuvihitaṃ na kiñcitparihīyate| yathoktaṃ tatkariṣyāmo na kiñcitparihāsyate
translation: तत: then, सर्वे all, समागम्य approached, वसिष्ठम् Vasistha, इदम् this statement, अब्रुवन् said, यथा in the manner, उक्तम् has been told, तत् that, सुविहितम् well arranged, किञ्चित् even little, न परिहीयते will not be left out, यथोक्तम् in the manner it has been told, तत् that, करिष्याम: we will do, किञ्चित् even a little, न परिहास्यते will not be left out.
explanation: Then all of them approached Vasishta and said, "everything has been wellarranged in accordance with your instruction. There is no deficiency. Everything will be done as instructed by you without leaving out anything."

shloka_text: ततस्सुमन्त्रमानीय वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। निमन्त्रयस्व नृपतीन्पृथिव्यां ये च धार्मिका:।।1.13.18।।
transliteration: tatassumantramānīya vasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt| nimantrayasva nṛpatīnpṛthivyāṃ ye ca dhārmikā:
translation: तत: then, वसिष्ठ: Vasishhta, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, आनीय having summoned, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, धार्मिका: righteous ones, ये those, नृपतीन् kings, निमन्त्रयस्व you may invite.
explanation: Then Vasishta, having summoned Sumantra said to him "Invite all the righteous kings on earth".

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणान्क्षत्रियान्वैश्याञ्छूद्रांश्चैव सहस्रश:। समानयस्व सत्कृत्य सर्वदेशेषु मानवान्।।1.13.19।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇānkṣatriyānvaiśyāñchūdrāṃścaiva sahasraśa:| samānayasva satkṛtya sarvadeśeṣu mānavān
translation: सर्वदेशेषु residing in all countries, मानवान् people, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, क्षत्रियान् kshatriyas, वैश्यान् merchants, शूद्रांश्चैव sudras also, सहस्रश: in thousands, सत्कृत्य with due honours, समानयस्व convene them.
explanation: "Extend an honourable invitation to brahmins, kshatriyas, merchants and sudras in their thousands residing in all countries.

shloka_text: मिथिलाधिपतिं शूरं जनकं सत्यविक्रमम्। निष्ठितं सर्वशास्त्रेषु तथा वेदेषु निष्ठितम्।।1.13.20।। तमानय महाभागं स्वयमेव सुसत्कृतम्। पूर्वसम्बन्धिनं ज्ञात्वा तत: पूर्वं ब्रवीमि ते।।1.13.21।।
transliteration: mithilādhipatiṃ śūraṃ janakaṃ satyavikramam| niṣṭhitaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu tathā vedeṣu niṣṭhitam tamānaya mahābhāgaṃ svayameva susatkṛtam| pūrvasambandhinaṃ jñātvā tata: pūrvaṃ bravīmi te
translation: मिथिलाधिपतिम् king of Mithila, शूरम् greatest of warriors, सत्यविक्रमम् a man with real heroic valour, सर्वशास्त्रेषु in all scriptures, निष्ठितम् proficient, तथा and, वेदेषु in vedas, निष्ठितम् proficient, महाभागम् distinguished, तं जनकम् that Janaka, पूर्वसम्बन्धिनम् an ancient allay, ज्ञात्वा knowing, सुसत्कृतम् with due honours, स्वयमेव personally, आनय bring him, तत: for that reason, पूर्वम् well before, ते to you, ब्रवीमि telling.
explanation: You may personally go and bring with due honour king Janaka who is the distinguished king of Mithila, a warrior whose truth is his strength proficient in all scriptures and the Vedas. Since he is an old ally, I am telling you in advance.

shloka_text: मिथिलाधिपतिं शूरं जनकं सत्यविक्रमम्। निष्ठितं सर्वशास्त्रेषु तथा वेदेषु निष्ठितम्।।1.13.20।। तमानय महाभागं स्वयमेव सुसत्कृतम्। पूर्वसम्बन्धिनं ज्ञात्वा तत: पूर्वं ब्रवीमि ते।।1.13.21।।
transliteration: mithilādhipatiṃ śūraṃ janakaṃ satyavikramam| niṣṭhitaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu tathā vedeṣu niṣṭhitam tamānaya mahābhāgaṃ svayameva susatkṛtam| pūrvasambandhinaṃ jñātvā tata: pūrvaṃ bravīmi te
translation: मिथिलाधिपतिम् king of Mithila, शूरम् greatest of warriors, सत्यविक्रमम् a man with real heroic valour, सर्वशास्त्रेषु in all scriptures, निष्ठितम् proficient, तथा and, वेदेषु in vedas, निष्ठितम् proficient, महाभागम् distinguished, तं जनकम् that Janaka, पूर्वसम्बन्धिनम् an ancient allay, ज्ञात्वा knowing, सुसत्कृतम् with due honours, स्वयमेव personally, आनय bring him, तत: for that reason, पूर्वम् well before, ते to you, ब्रवीमि telling.
explanation: You may personally go and bring with due honour king Janaka who is the distinguished king of Mithila, a warrior whose truth is his strength proficient in all scriptures and the Vedas. Since he is an old ally, I am telling you in advance.

shloka_text: तथा काशीपतिं स्निग्धं सततं प्रियवादिनम्। वयस्यं राजसिंहस्य स्वयमेवानयस्व ह।।1.13.22।।
transliteration: tathā kāśīpatiṃ snigdhaṃ satataṃ priyavādinam| vayasyaṃ rājasiṃhasya svayamevānayasva ha
translation: तथा thereafter, स्निग्धम् affectionate, सततम् ever, प्रियवादिनम् speaking pleasantly, राजसिंहस्य lion among kings, वयस्यम् friend, काशीपतिम् king of Kasi, स्वयमेव personally, आनयस्व ह bring him.
explanation: Similarly, you may personally escort king of Kasi who is always affectionate and sweettongued. He is a friend to our king who is a lion among rulers.

shloka_text: तथा केकयराजानं वृद्धं परमधार्मिकम्। श्वशुरं राजसिंहस्य सपुत्रं त्वमिहानय।।1.13.23।।
transliteration: tathā kekayarājānaṃ vṛddhaṃ paramadhārmikam| śvaśuraṃ rājasiṃhasya saputraṃ tvamihānaya
translation: तथा then, परमधार्मिकम् very righteous, राजसिंहस्य our king Dasaratha's, श्वशुरम् fatherinlaw, वृद्धम् aged, केकयराजानम् king of Kekaya, सपुत्रम् along with his sons, त्वम् you, इह here, आनय bring.
explanation: Likewise bring here the aged and very righteous king of Kekaya along with his sons. He is fatherinlaw to this lion among kings (Dasaratha).

shloka_text: अङ्गेश्वरम् महाभागं रोमपादं सुसत्कृतम्। वयस्यं राजसिंहस्य समानय यशस्विनम्।।1.13.24।।
transliteration: aṅgeśvaram mahābhāgaṃ romapādaṃ susatkṛtam| vayasyaṃ rājasiṃhasya samānaya yaśasvinam
translation: अङ्गेश्वरम् king of Anga, महाभागम् prosperous, राजसिंहस्य lion among kings, Dasaratha's, वयस्यम् friend, यशस्विनम् famous, रोमपादम् Romapada, सुसत्कृतम् well honoured, समानय bring.
explanation: Bring with honour king of Anga, Romapada, famous and prosperous. He is an intimate friend of the king (Dasaratha).

shloka_text: प्राचीनान्सिन्धु सौवीरान्सौराष्ट्रेयांश्च पार्थिवान्। दाक्षिणात्यान्नरेन्द्रांश्च समस्तानानयस्व ह।।1.13.25।।
transliteration: prācīnānsindhu sauvīrānsaurāṣṭreyāṃśca pārthivān| dākṣiṇātyānnarendrāṃśca samastānānayasva ha
translation: प्राचीनान् kings from the countries on the eastern side, सिन्धुसौवीरान् kings from Sindhu and Sauvera countries, सैराष्ट्रेयान् पार्थिवान् kings from Saurashtra, दाक्षिणात्यान् नरेन्द्रांश्च kings from south, समस्तान् all, आनयस्व ह bring (invite) them.
explanation: Bring kings from the countries of the eastern and southern regions, from Sindhu, Sauvera and Saurashtra৷৷

shloka_text: सन्ति स्निग्धाश्च ये चान्ये राजान: पृथिवीतले। तानानय यथाक्षिप्रं सानुगान्सह बान्धवान्।।1.13.26।।
transliteration: santi snigdhāśca ye cānye rājāna: pṛthivītale| tānānaya yathākṣipraṃ sānugānsaha bāndhavān
translation: पृथिवीतले on this earth, स्निग्धा: friendly, अन्ये other, राजान: kings, तान् all of them, सानुगान् along with their retinues and families, सह बान्धवान् along with their relatives, यथाक्षिप्रम् as quickly as possible, आनय bring (invite)them.
explanation: Bring all other kings of this earth, who are friendly with us. Along with their retinues, families and relatives".

shloka_text: वसिष्ठवाक्यं तच्छ्रुत्वा सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितस्तदा। व्यादिशत्पुरुषांस्तत्र राज्ञामानयने शुभान्।।1.13.27।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhavākyaṃ tacchrutvā sumantrastvaritastadā| vyādiśatpuruṣāṃstatra rājñāmānayane śubhān
translation: तत् that, वसिष्ठवाक्यम् words of Vasishta, श्रुत्वा having heard, सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, तदा then, त्वरित: speedily, तत्र there, राज्ञाम् kings, आनयने in bringing, शुभान् virtuous, पुरुषान् emissaries, व्यादिशत् ordered.
explanation: Having heard the words of Vasishta, Sumantra speedily despatched virtuous and auspicious emissaries to bring the kings.

shloka_text: स्वयमेव हि धर्मात्मा  प्रययौ मुनिशासनात्। सुमन्त्रस्त्वरितो भूत्वा समानेतुं महीक्षित:।।1.13.28।।
transliteration: svayameva hi dharmātmā  prayayau muniśāsanāt| sumantrastvarito bhūtvā samānetuṃ mahīkṣita:
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous, सुमन्त्र: Sumantra, मुनिशासनात् in accordance with ascetic's order, त्वरितो भूत्वा become quick, महीक्षित: kings, समानेतुम् to escort, स्वयमेव himself, प्रययौ set out.
explanation: In accordance with the ascetic's order, righteous Sumantra himself quickly set out to escort Janaka and other kings.

shloka_text: ते च कर्मान्तिकास्सर्वे वसिष्ठाय च धीमते। सर्वं निवेदयन्ति स्म यज्ञे यदुपकल्पितम्।।1.13.29।।
transliteration: te ca karmāntikāssarve vasiṣṭhāya ca dhīmate| sarvaṃ nivedayanti sma yajñe yadupakalpitam
translation: ते those, कर्मान्तिका: workers, सर्वे all, यज्ञे in the sacrifice, यत् which, उपकल्पितम् was well arranged, सर्वम् all that, धीमते to the wise, वसिष्ठाय Vasishta, निवेदयन्ति स्म informed.
explanation: All the workers reported to the wise sage, Vasishta about the tasks completed for the sacrifice.

shloka_text: तत:प्रीतो द्विजश्रेष्ठस्तान् सर्वानिदमब्रवीत् । अवज्ञया न दातव्यं कस्यचिल्लीलयाऽपि वा।।1.13.30।। अवज्ञया कृतं हन्याद्दातारं नात्र संशय:। 28
transliteration: tata:prīto dvijaśreṣṭhastān sarvānidamabravīt | avajñayā na dātavyaṃ kasyacillīlayā'pi vā avajñayā kṛtaṃ hanyāddātāraṃ nātra saṃśaya:| 28
translation: तत: then, प्रीत: pleased, द्विजश्रेष्ठः best among brahmins, तान् सर्वान् addressing all of them, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, कस्य चित् to any one, अवज्ञया with insult, लीलयापि वा or casually, न दातव्यम् should not be gifted, अवज्ञया with contempt, कृतम् done, दातारम् donor, हन्यात् destroys, अत्र in this aspect, संशय: न no doubt.
explanation: Then, well pleased, the best among brahmins (Vasishta) said to them all "Nobody should be offered any thing with disregard. Anything given with contempt undoubtedly  results in the destruction of the donor."

shloka_text: तत: कैश्चिदहोरात्रैरुपयाता महीक्षित:।।1.13.31।। बहूनि रत्नान्यादाय राज्ञो दशरथस्य वै।
transliteration: tata: kaiścidahorātrairupayātā mahīkṣita: bahūni ratnānyādāya rājño daśarathasya vai|
translation: तत: after that, महीक्षित: kings, राज्ञ: दशरथस्य for king Dasaratha, बहूनि several, रत्नानि gifts, आदाय having brought, कैश्चित् by some, अहोरात्रै: days, उपयाता: arrived.
explanation: Meanwhile kings from several countries to travelling nights and days arrived bringing with them various kinds of (precious) gifts.

shloka_text: ततो वसिष्ठस्सुप्रीतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.13.32।। उपयाता नरव्याघ्र राजानस्तव शासनात्। मयापि सत्कृता: सर्वे यथार्हं राजसत्तमा:।।1.13.33।।
transliteration: tato vasiṣṭhassuprīto rājānamidamabravīt upayātā naravyāghra rājānastava śāsanāt| mayāpi satkṛtā: sarve yathārhaṃ rājasattamā:
translation: तत: there upon, सुप्रीत: wellpleased, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, राजानम् addressing Dasaratha, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, नरव्याघ्र O Best among men, तव your, शासनात् by the  command, राजान: kings from various countries, उपयाता: have arrived, राजसत्तमा: noble kings, सर्वे all, यथार्हम् according to their merit, मया by me, सत्कृता: अपि were honoured also.
explanation: Thereupon, wellpleased, Vasishta addressing Dasaratha said "O best among men, beacuse of your command, kings from various countries have arrived. I have extended due hospitality to those noble kings according to their station."

shloka_text: ततो वसिष्ठस्सुप्रीतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.13.32।। उपयाता नरव्याघ्र राजानस्तव शासनात्। मयापि सत्कृता: सर्वे यथार्हं राजसत्तमा:।।1.13.33।।
transliteration: tato vasiṣṭhassuprīto rājānamidamabravīt upayātā naravyāghra rājānastava śāsanāt| mayāpi satkṛtā: sarve yathārhaṃ rājasattamā:
translation: तत: there upon, सुप्रीत: wellpleased, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, राजानम् addressing Dasaratha, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, नरव्याघ्र O Best among men, तव your, शासनात् by the  command, राजान: kings from various countries, उपयाता: have arrived, राजसत्तमा: noble kings, सर्वे all, यथार्हम् according to their merit, मया by me, सत्कृता: अपि were honoured also.
explanation: Thereupon, wellpleased, Vasishta addressing Dasaratha said "O best among men, beacuse of your command, kings from various countries have arrived. I have extended due hospitality to those noble kings according to their station."

shloka_text: यज्ञीयं च कृतं राजन् पुरुषैस्सुसमाहितै:। निर्यातु च भवान्यष्टुं यज्ञायतनमन्तिकात्।।1.13.34।।
transliteration: yajñīyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ rājan puruṣaissusamāhitai:| niryātu ca bhavānyaṣṭuṃ yajñāyatanamantikāt
translation: राजन् O King, सुसमाहितै: with composed minds, पुरुषै: by persons, यज्ञीयम् pertaining to  the sacrifice, कृतम् made, भवान् you, यष्टुम् to perform sacrifice, अन्तिकात् nearby, यज्ञायतनम् sacrificial ground, निर्यातु be pleased to leave for.
explanation: "O king, persons with composed minds have made preparations for the yaga. Now be pleased to leave for sacrificial altar nearby to perform yaga.

shloka_text: सर्वकामैरुपहृतैरुपेतं च समन्तत:। द्रष्टुमर्हसि राजेन्द्र मनसेव विनिर्मितम्।।1.13.35।।
transliteration: sarvakāmairupahṛtairupetaṃ ca samantata:| draṣṭumarhasi rājendra manaseva vinirmitam
translation: राजेन्द्र O Foremost of kings, उपहृतै: well arranged, सर्वकामै: articles of entertainment, समन्तत: every where, उपेतम् endowed with, मनसा by mind (imagination), विनिर्मितम् इव as though constructed, द्रष्टुम् अर्हसि you deserve (should) to see.
explanation: O foremost of kings, you ought to see the sacrificial ground full of sources of entertainment arranged everywhere, as though improvised by imagination".

shloka_text: तथा वसिष्ठवचनादृश्यशृङ्गस्य चोभयो:। शुभे दिवसनक्षत्रे निर्यातो जगतीपति:।।1.13.36।।
transliteration: tathā vasiṣṭhavacanādṛśyaśṛṅgasya cobhayo:| śubhe divasanakṣatre niryāto jagatīpati:
translation: तदा then, तथा वशिष्ठवचनात् following the words of Vasishta, ऋश्यशृङ्गस्य च also of Rsyasringa, उभयो: of both of them, जगतीपति: lord of the world, शुभे on an auspicious occasion, दिवसनक्षत्रे day and star, निर्यात: had set out to the sacrificial pavillion.
explanation: In response to the words of Vasishta and Rsyasringa, the Lord of the earth (Dasaratha) entered the sacrificial pavilion on a favourable day presided over by an auspicious star.

shloka_text: ततो वसिष्ठप्रमुखास्सर्व एव द्विजोत्तमा:। ऋश्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य यज्ञकर्मारभन् तदा।।1.13.37।। यज्ञवाटगतास्सर्वे यथाशास्त्रं यथाविधि। 3
transliteration: tato vasiṣṭhapramukhāssarva eva dvijottamā:| ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ puraskṛtya yajñakarmārabhan tadā yajñavāṭagatāssarve yathāśāstraṃ yathāvidhi| 3
translation: तत: then, वसिष्ठप्रमुखा: Vasishta, being foremost in the group, सर्व एव all, द्विजोत्तमा: brahmins, यज्ञवाटगता: entered the sacred sacrificial enclosure, यथाशास्त्रम् in accordance  with scriptural laws, यथाविधि in accordance with the tradition, तदा then, ऋश्यशृङ्गम् Rsyasringa, पुरस्कृत्य headed by, यज्ञकर्म sacrificial rites, आरभन् began.
explanation: At that moment the best of brahmins led by Vasishta and headed by Rsyasringa, entered the sacrificial enclosure and began the sacrifice in accordance with traditions and scriptural stipulations. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रयोदशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथ संवत्सरे पूर्णे तस्मिन्प्राप्ते तुरङ्गमे। सरय्वाश्चोत्तरे तीरे राज्ञो यज्ञोऽभ्यवर्तत।।1.14.1।।
transliteration: atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe tasminprāpte turaṅgame| sarayvāścottare tīre rājño yajño'bhyavartata
translation: अथ after that, संवत्सरे when one year's time, पूर्णे (सति) was completed, तस्मिन् when that, तुरङ्गमे sacrificial horse, प्राप्ते (सति) had returned, सरय्वा: of river Sarayu, उत्तरे तीरे on the northern bank, राज्ञ: यज्ञश्च sacrifice by the king, अभ्यवर्तत commenced.
explanation: After completion of one year when the sacrificial horse had returned, the sacrifice by the king (Dasaratha) commenced on the northern bank of river Sarayu.
comments: Dasaratha performs aswamedhayaga on the bank of  Sarayu according to vedic rites

shloka_text: ऋश्यशृङ्गं पुरस्कृत्य कर्म चक्रुर्द्विजर्षभा:। अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मन:।।1.14.2।।
transliteration: ṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ puraskṛtya karma cakrurdvijarṣabhā:| aśvamedhe mahāyajñe rājño'sya sumahātmana:
translation: सुमहात्मन: of the exceedingly magnanimous, अस्य राज्ञ: this king's, अश्वमेधे महायज्ञे Aswamedha sacrifice, द्विजर्षभा: best among brahmins, ऋष्यशृङ्गम् Rsyasringa, पुरस्कृत्य led by, कर्म चक्रु: performed the rituals.
explanation: The best of brahmins led by Rsyasringa performed the rituals of aswamedha organised by the exceedingly magnanimous king.

shloka_text: कर्म कुर्वन्ति विधिवद्याजका वेदपारगा:। यथाविधि यथान्यायं परिक्रामन्ति शास्त्रत:।।1.14.3।।
transliteration: karma kurvanti vidhivadyājakā vedapāragā:| yathāvidhi yathānyāyaṃ parikrāmanti śāstrata:
translation: वेदपारगा: scholars who mastered vedas fully, याजका: chief priests, विधिवत् in consonance with tradition and scriptures, कर्म tasks, कुर्वन्ति carried out, यथाविधि in conformity with duties laid down in vedas, यथान्यायम् according to law, शास्त्रत: as laid down in scriptures, परिक्रामन्ति move about (officiated).
explanation: The chief priests, masters of the Vedas, conducted the rituals in consonance with traditions and scriptures. They officiated in conformity with duties laid down in the Vedas and according to law.

shloka_text: प्रवर्ग्यं शास्त्रत: कृत्वा तथैवोपसदं द्विजा: चक्रुश्च विधिवत्सर्वमधिकं कर्म शास्त्रत:।।1.14.4।।
transliteration: pravargyaṃ śāstrata: kṛtvā tathaivopasadaṃ dvijā: cakruśca vidhivatsarvamadhikaṃ karma śāstrata:
translation: द्विजा: brahmins, प्रवर्ग्यम् Pravargya (a particular part of the sacrifice), शास्त्रत: according to scriptures, कृत्वा having done, तथैव and, उपसदम् Upasada (another part of the sacrifice), विधिवत् as per tradition, अधिकम् still other, सर्वं कर्म ceremonies, शास्त्रत: according to ordinance, चक्रु: performed.
explanation: Brahmins performed pravargya and upasada and other ceremonies as per the scriptures and traditions.

shloka_text: अभिपूज्य ततो हृष्टास्सर्वे चक्रुर्यथाविधि। प्रातस्सवनपूर्वाणि कर्माणि मुनिपुङ्गवा:।।1.14.5।।
transliteration: abhipūjya tato hṛṣṭāssarve cakruryathāvidhi| prātassavanapūrvāṇi karmāṇi munipuṅgavā:
translation: तत: thereafter, मुनिपुङ्गवा: eminent ascetics, हृष्टा: rejoiced in their hearts, अभिपूज्य worshipping those celestial beings, प्रातस्सवनपूर्वाणि starting with Pratah savanadi (morning ablutions etc), कर्माणि rituals, यथाविधि as prescribed, चक्रु: performed.
explanation: Thereafter the eminent ascetics, rejoicing in their hearts performed the worship (of celestial beings) and conducted the prescribed rituals starting with morning ablutions etc.

shloka_text: ऐन्द्रश्च विधिवद्दत्तो राजा चाभिषुतोऽनघ:। माध्यन्दिनं च सवनं प्रावर्तत यथाक्रमम्।।1.14.6।।
transliteration: aindraśca vidhivaddatto rājā cābhiṣuto'nagha:| mādhyandinaṃ ca savanaṃ prāvartata yathākramam
translation: ऐन्द्रश्च Indra's portion of Havis (oblations of clarified butter), विधिवत् according to tradition, दत्त: offered, अनघ: faultless or pure, राजा च Soma plant (acid juice of this plant mixed with clarified butter offered in libations to the gods), अभिषुत: was pressed for extracting juice, माध्यन्दिनम् ablutions to be performed during midday, सवनम् Savanam, यथाक्रमम् according to the order, प्रावर्तत took place.
explanation: Havis was duly offered to Indra daily. The juice was extracted in the morning by pressing the soma plant. Midday ablutions were performed. All in proper sequence.

shloka_text: तृतीयसवनं चैव राज्ञोऽस्य सुमहात्मन:। चक्रुस्तेशास्त्रतो दृष्ट्वा तथा ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवा:।।1.14.7।।
transliteration: tṛtīyasavanaṃ caiva rājño'sya sumahātmana:| cakrusteśāstrato dṛṣṭvā tathā brāhmaṇapuṅgavā:
translation: तथा in the same way, ते ब्राह्मणपुङ्गवा: those eminent brahmins, शास्त्रत: in conformity with Shastras, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सुमहात्मन: of the exceedingly noble, अस्य राज्ञ: this king's, तृतीयसवनं चैव third pressing of the Soma in the evening, चक्रु: performed.
explanation: Those exceedingly noble and eminent brahmins performed third pressing of the soma, in conformity with the sastras.

shloka_text: न चाहुतमभूत्तत्र स्खलितं वापि किञ्चन । दृश्यते ब्रह्मवत्सर्वं क्षेमयुक्तं हि चक्रिरे।।1.14.8।।
transliteration: na cāhutamabhūttatra skhalitaṃ vāpi kiñcana | dṛśyate brahmavatsarvaṃ kṣemayuktaṃ hi cakrire
translation: तत्र in that sacrifice, आहुतम् omissions in the offerings, नाभूत् did not take place, किञ्चन any thing, स्खलितम् defects or mistakes, नाभूत् did not take place, सर्वम् everything, ब्रह्मवत् with mantras (prayers), दृश्यते appeared, क्षेमयुक्तम् in a safe manner, चक्रिरे हि performed.
explanation: There were no omissions in the offerings nor any lappes in the performance. Everything was done through recitation of mantras and in a wholesome way.

shloka_text: न तेष्वहस्सु श्रान्तो वा क्षुधितो वापि दृश्यते। नाविद्वान्ब्राह्मणस्तत्र नाशतानुचरस्तथा।।1.14.9।।
transliteration: na teṣvahassu śrānto vā kṣudhito vāpi dṛśyate| nāvidvānbrāhmaṇastatra nāśatānucarastathā
translation: तेषु in those, अहस्सु days, श्रान्त: a tired man, क्षुधितो वापि or hungry one, न दृश्यते was not to be seen, तत्र there, अविद्वान् not learned, ब्राह्मण: brahmin, न दृश्यते not to be seen, तथा similarly, अशतानुचर: a man followed by less than hundred people, न दृश्यते was not seen.
explanation: During the days (of sacrifice) none felt tired or hungry. There was no brahmin who was not learned or had less than a hundred followers (or disciples).

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणा भुञ्जते नित्यं नाथवन्तश्च भुञ्जते। तापसा भुञ्जते चापि श्रमणा भुञ्जतेतथा।।1.14.10।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇā bhuñjate nityaṃ nāthavantaśca bhuñjate| tāpasā bhuñjate cāpi śramaṇā bhuñjatetathā
translation: नित्यम् continually, ब्राह्मणा: brahmanas, भुञ्जते are eating, नाथवन्तश्च those who have  masters, भुञ्जते are eating, तापसाश्चापि ascetics, भुञ्जते are eating, तथा and, श्रमणा: monks, भुञ्जते are eating.
explanation: During that period brahmanas as well as those who have masters, (the sudras), ascetics and monks had enough to eat.

shloka_text: वृद्धाश्च व्याधिताश्चैव स्त्रियो बालास्तथैव च । अनिशं भुञ्जमानानां न तृप्तिरुपलभ्यते।।1.14.11।।
transliteration: vṛddhāśca vyādhitāścaiva striyo bālāstathaiva ca | aniśaṃ bhuñjamānānāṃ na tṛptirupalabhyate
translation: वृद्धा: aged persons, व्याधिताश्चैव sick people, स्त्रिय: women, तथैव च and also, बाला: children, अनिशम् continually, भुञ्जमानानाम् although feasting, तृप्ति: full satisfaction, न उपलभ्यते is not acheeved.
explanation: The aged, the sick, women and also children ate there and knew no limit to their enjoyment.

shloka_text: दीयतां दीयतामन्नं वासांसि विविधानि च। इति सञ्चोदितास्तत्र तथा चक्रुरनेकश:।।1.14.12।।
transliteration: dīyatāṃ dīyatāmannaṃ vāsāṃsi vividhāni ca| iti sañcoditāstatra tathā cakruranekaśa:
translation: अन्नम् food, दीयतां दीयताम् may be given, may be given, विविधानि various kinds of, वासांसि च clothes also, इति in this manner, तत्र in that sacrificial ground, सञ्चोदिता: persuaded by, अनेकश: profusely, तथा in the same manner, चक्रु: performed.
explanation: "Give food, give, various kinds of clothes" echoed the organisers. And they (in charge of distribution) did.

shloka_text: अन्नकूटाश्च बहवो दृश्यन्ते पर्वतोपमा:। दिवसे दिवसे तत्र सिद्धस्य विधिवत्तदा।।1.14.13।।
transliteration: annakūṭāśca bahavo dṛśyante parvatopamā:| divase divase tatra siddhasya vidhivattadā
translation: तत्र there, तदा then, विधिवत् in accordance with scriptures, सिद्धस्य kept ready, अन्नकूटा: heaps of food, बहव: many, पर्वतोपमा: looking like mountains, दिवसे दिवसे every day, दृश्यन्ते were to be seen.
explanation: There, could be seen day after day heaps of nicely cooked food, looking like mountains.

shloka_text: नानादेशादनुप्राप्ता: पुरुषास्स्त्रीगणास्तथा। अन्नपानैस्सुविहितास्तस्मिन्यज्ञे महात्मन:।।1.14.14।।
transliteration: nānādeśādanuprāptā: puruṣāsstrīgaṇāstathā| annapānaissuvihitāstasminyajñe mahātmana:
translation: महात्मन: Illustrious king's, तस्मिन् यज्ञे in that sacrifice, नानादेशात् from various countries, अनुप्राप्ता: arrived, पुरुषा: men, तथा and, स्त्रीगणा: women in groups, अन्नपानै: with food and drink, सुविहिता were well entertained.
explanation: Men and women who had come from various countries to that sacrifice were entertained with food and drink by the magnanimous (king).

shloka_text: अन्नं हि विधिवत्साधु प्रशंसन्ति द्विजर्षभा:। अहो तृप्ता: स्म भद्रं ते इति शुश्राव राघव:।।1.14.15।।
transliteration: annaṃ hi vidhivatsādhu praśaṃsanti dvijarṣabhā:| aho tṛptā: sma bhadraṃ te iti śuśrāva rāghava:
translation: द्विजर्षभा: the twiceborns, विधिवत् cooked in prescribed manner, साधु good (delicious), अन्नम् food, प्रशंसन्ति praised, राघव: son of Raghu, Dasaratha, अहो Ah, तृप्ता: स्म fully satisfied, ते to you, भद्रम् prosperity, इति such words, शुश्राव were heard.
explanation: Brahmins having tasted the delicious food cooked in prescribed manner, praised saying "Ah We are fully satisfied. Prosperity to you". Such were the words heard by king Dasaratha.

shloka_text: स्वलङ्कृताश्च पुरुषा ब्राह्मणान्पर्यवेषयन्। उपासते च तानन्ये सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डला:।।1.14.16।।
transliteration: svalaṅkṛtāśca puruṣā brāhmaṇānparyaveṣayan| upāsate ca tānanye sumṛṣṭamaṇikuṇḍalā:
translation: स्वलङ्कृता: well dressed, पुरुषा: men, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, पर्यवेषयन् served with, सुमृष्टमणिकुण्डला: wearing pendents bedecked with shining jewels, अन्ये च some others, तान् them, उपासते assisted.
explanation: While brahmins were being served with food by welldressed men, some others wearing pendents studded with shining jewels assisted them.

shloka_text: कर्मान्तरे तदा विप्रा हेतुवादान्बहूनपि। प्राहुश्च वाग्मिनो धीरा: परस्परजिगीषया।।1.14.17।।
transliteration: karmāntare tadā viprā hetuvādānbahūnapi| prāhuśca vāgmino dhīrā: parasparajigīṣayā
translation: तदा then, वाग्मिन: eloquent, धीरा: sagacious, विप्रा: brahmins, तदा then, कर्मान्तरे in between ceremonies, परस्परजिगीषया mutually desirous of victory, बहून् various, हेतुवादान् disputations, प्राहु: च engaged.
explanation: In the interval between ceremonies, eloquent and sagacious brahmins were engaged in various disputations, desirous of victory.

shloka_text: दिवसे दिवसे तत्र संस्तरे कुशला द्विजा:। सर्वकर्माणि चक्रुस्ते यथाशास्त्रं प्रचोदिता:।।1.14.18।।
transliteration: divase divase tatra saṃstare kuśalā dvijā:| sarvakarmāṇi cakruste yathāśāstraṃ pracoditā:
translation: संस्तरे in the sacrifice, कुशला: skilful, द्विजा: brahmins, दिवसे दिवसे every day, तत्र there, प्रचोदिता: persuaded by sage Vasistha, सर्वकर्माणि all their duties, यथाशास्त्रम् as per tradition, चक्रु: performed.
explanation: Every day in that sacrifice brahmins, skilful in rituals, persuaded (by sage Vasishta), performed all their duties as per tradition.

shloka_text: नाषडङ्गविदत्रासीन्नाव्रतो नाबहुश्रुत:। सदस्यास्तस्य वै राज्ञो नावादकुशला द्विजा:।।1.14.19।।
transliteration: nāṣaḍaṅgavidatrāsīnnāvrato nābahuśruta:| sadasyāstasya vai rājño nāvādakuśalā dvijā:
translation: अत्र in this sacrificial pavillion, अषडङ्गवित् not versed in six vedangas, नासीत् not there, अव्रत: unfaithful to vowed observances, न not there, अबहुश्रुत: not learned in many shastras, न not there, तस्य राज्ञ: that king's, सदस्या: assistants at a sacrifice, नावादकुशला: not skilful in disputations in shastras, न वै not there.
explanation: Here (in this sacrificial pavillion), there was none who was not versed in six Vedangas, not true to vows, not learned in many sastras nor adept in discussions (on sastras).

shloka_text: प्राप्ते यूपोच्छ्रये तस्मिन्षड्बैल्वा: खादिरास्तथा। तावन्तो बिल्वसहिता: पर्णिनश्च तथापरे।।1.14.20।। श्लेष्मातकमयस्त्वेको देवदारुमयस्तथा। द्वावेव विहितौ तत्र बाहुव्यस्तपरिग्रहौ।।1.14.21।।
transliteration: prāpte yūpocchraye tasminṣaḍbailvā: khādirāstathā| tāvanto bilvasahitā: parṇinaśca tathāpare śleṣmātakamayastveko devadārumayastathā| dvāveva vihitau tatra bāhuvyastaparigrahau
translation: तस्मिन् in that sacrifice, यूपोच्छ्रये in erecting sacrificial posts, प्राप्ते (सति) when the time, बैल्वा: bilva wood, षट् six, तथा and, बिल्वसहिता: along with bilva posts, तावन्त: as many, खादिरा: Khadira, तथा and, पर्णिन: च having leaves, अपरे some more posts, एक: one, श्लेष्मातकमय: made of Sleshmataka, तथा and, देवदारुमय: made of trees of Devadaru, तत्र there, द्वौ two, बाहुव्यस्तपरिग्रहावेव at a distance of two outstretched hands, विहितौ were erected.
explanation: When the time came to erect sacrificial posts, six posts, each made of bilva, khadira, parni, sleshmataka and two of devadaru wood, with a distance of two outstretched hands between them were erected.

shloka_text: प्राप्ते यूपोच्छ्रये तस्मिन्षड्बैल्वा: खादिरास्तथा। तावन्तो बिल्वसहिता: पर्णिनश्च तथापरे।।1.14.20।। श्लेष्मातकमयस्त्वेको देवदारुमयस्तथा। द्वावेव विहितौ तत्र बाहुव्यस्तपरिग्रहौ।।1.14.21।।
transliteration: prāpte yūpocchraye tasminṣaḍbailvā: khādirāstathā| tāvanto bilvasahitā: parṇinaśca tathāpare śleṣmātakamayastveko devadārumayastathā| dvāveva vihitau tatra bāhuvyastaparigrahau
translation: तस्मिन् in that sacrifice, यूपोच्छ्रये inerecting sacrificial posts, प्राप्ते (सति) when the time has come  nearer, बैल्वा: Bilva wood, षट् six, तथा and, बिल्वसहिता: along with Bilva posts, तावन्त: as many, खादिरा: Khadira, तथा and, पर्णिन: च having Parnas leaves, अपरे some more posts, एक: one, श्लेष्मातकमय: made of Sleshmataka, तथा and, देवदारुमय: made of trees of Devadaru, तत्र there, द्वौ two, बाहुव्यस्तपरिग्रहावेव at a distance of two outstretched hands, विहितौ were erected.
explanation: When the time came to erect sacrificial posts, six posts each made of bilva and khadira wood and many made of parni wood along, one of sleshmataka and two of devadaru wood, with a distance of two outstretched hands between them were erected.

shloka_text: कारितास्सर्व एवैते शास्त्रज्ञैर्यज्ञकोविदै:। शोभार्थं तस्य यज्ञस्य काञ्चनालङ्कृताऽभवन्।।1.14.22।।
transliteration: kāritāssarva evaite śāstrajñairyajñakovidai:| śobhārthaṃ tasya yajñasya kāñcanālaṅkṛtā'bhavan
translation: शास्त्रज्ञै: by the knowers of shastras, यज्ञकोविदै: who well versed in performance of sacrifice, कारिता: were made, एते सर्वे एव all these posts, तस्य यज्ञस्य of that sacrifice, शोभार्थम् for elegance, काञ्चनालङ्कृता: decorated with gold, अभवन् became.
explanation: All these posts were prepared by knowers of sastras and by those wellversed in the performance of sacrifices. They were decorated with gold to add elegance to the sacrifice.

shloka_text: एकविंशतियूपास्ते एकविंशत्यरत्नय:। वासोभिरेकविंशद्भिरेकैकं समलङ्कृता:।।1.14.23।।
transliteration: ekaviṃśatiyūpāste ekaviṃśatyaratnaya:| vāsobhirekaviṃśadbhirekaikaṃ samalaṅkṛtā:
translation: एकविंशत्यरत्नय: measuring twenty one 'Aratni ' (distance from elbow to the tip of little finger), ते those, एकविंशतियूपा: twenty one posts, एकविंशद्भि: by twenty one, वासोभि: pieces of cloth, एकैकम् one for each post, समलङ्कृता: well decorated.
explanation: These twentyone sacrificial posts, each measuring twentyone 'aratni' height, were welldecorated wrapped in a piece of cloth.

shloka_text: विन्यस्ता विधिवत्सर्वे शिल्पिभिस्सुकृता दृढा:। अष्टाश्रयस्सर्व एव श्लक्ष्णरूपसमन्विता:।।1.14.24।।
transliteration: vinyastā vidhivatsarve śilpibhissukṛtā dṛḍhā:| aṣṭāśrayassarva eva ślakṣṇarūpasamanvitā:
translation: सर्वे all of them, शिल्पिभि: by the sculptors, सुकृता: were well carved, दृढा: strong, अष्टाश्रय: having eight sides, श्लक्ष्णरूपसमन्विता: had finely finished surfaces, सर्वे all those, विधिवत् as per tradition, विन्यस्ता: were erected.
explanation: All those posts, strong with eight sides and finely finished surfaces, wellcarved  by sculptors were duly erected.

shloka_text: आच्छादितास्ते वासोभि: पुष्पैर्गन्धैश्च भूषिता:। सप्तर्षयो दीप्तिमन्तो विराजन्ते यथा दिवि।।1.14.25।।
transliteration: ācchāditāste vāsobhi: puṣpairgandhaiśca bhūṣitā:| saptarṣayo dīptimanto virājante yathā divi
translation: वासोभि: with cloths, आच्छादिता: were covered, पुष्पै: with flowers, गन्धैश्च with sandalwood paste, भूषिता: decorated, ते those posts, दीप्तिमन्त: glowing, दिवि in the sky, सप्तर्षय: seven sages, यथा in a similar manner, विराजन्ते illuminated.
explanation: Decorated with flowers and sandal paste and covered with cloths, stood the  bright sacrificial posts shining like seven sages in the sky.

shloka_text: इष्टकाश्च यथान्यायं कारिताश्च प्रमाणत:। चितोऽग्निर्ब्राह्मणैस्तत्र कुशलैश्शुल्बकर्मणि ।।1.14.26।।
transliteration: iṣṭakāśca yathānyāyaṃ kāritāśca pramāṇata:| cito'gnirbrāhmaṇaistatra kuśalaiśśulbakarmaṇi
translation: तत्र there, यथान्यायम् as per shastras, प्रमाणत: with standard measurement, इष्टका: bricks, कारिता were made, शुल्बकर्मणि in the science of construction using a measuring rope, कुशलै: accomplished, ब्राह्मणै: brahmins, अग्नि: sacrificial fire place, चित: gathered and laid bricks were prepared as per standard measurment mentioned in shastras.
explanation: The sacrificial fireplace was constructed with bricks with standard measurement by brahmins who were experts in the art of measuring land with a string or single strand.

shloka_text: सचित्यो राजसिंहस्य सञ्चित: कुशलैर्द्विजै:। गरुडो रुक्मपक्षो वै त्रिगुणोऽष्टादशात्मक:।।1.14.27।।
transliteration: sacityo rājasiṃhasya sañcita: kuśalairdvijai:| garuḍo rukmapakṣo vai triguṇo'ṣṭādaśātmaka:
translation: कुशलै: by the skilled, द्विजै: brahmins, रुक्मपक्ष: golden winged, त्रिगुण: thrice, अष्टादशात्मक: eighteen in number, गरुड: like eagle, राजसिंहस्य of Dasaratha who was lion among kings, सचित्य: sacrificial altar, सञ्चित: was erected.
explanation: That sacrificial altar of the lion among kings, (Dasaratha), erected by welltrained brahmins was in the shape of the golden winged 'Garuda' it had three ranges and thrice as many fireplaces i.e eighteen in number.

shloka_text: नियुक्तास्तत्र पशवस्तत्तदुद्दिश्य दैवतम्। उरगा: पक्षिणश्चैव यथाशास्त्रं प्रचोदिता:।।1.14.28।।
transliteration: niyuktāstatra paśavastattaduddiśya daivatam| uragā: pakṣiṇaścaiva yathāśāstraṃ pracoditā:
translation: तत्र there, यथाशास्त्रम् as per tradition, प्रचोदिता: prompted, पशव: animals, उरगा: serpants, पक्षिणश्चैव birds also, तत्तत् that respective, दैवतम् deity,  उद्दिश्य intended for, नियुक्ता: were fastened.
explanation: Animals, serpents and birds were kept ready after the sastras intended (for sacrifice) for those respective deities.

shloka_text: शामित्रे तु हयस्तत्र तथा जलचराश्च ये। ऋत्विग्भिस्सर्वमेवैतन्नियुक्तं शास्त्रतस्तदा।।1.14.29।।
transliteration: śāmitre tu hayastatra tathā jalacarāśca ye| ṛtvigbhissarvamevaitanniyuktaṃ śāstratastadā
translation: तदा then, शामित्रे तु in the act of killing animals, तत्र there, हय: horse, तथा and, ये other, जलचरा: aquatic animals, एतत्सर्वम् all these, ऋत्विग्भि: by chief priests, शास्त्रत: in accordance with tradition, नियुक्तम् tied up.
explanation: When the time came to sacrifice the animals, the chief priests, in accordance with tradition, tied up the horse and all the aquatic animals to the sacrificial posts.

shloka_text: पशूनां त्रिशतं तत्र यूपेषु नियतं तदा। अश्वरत्नोत्तमं तस्य राज्ञो दशरथस्य च ।।1.14.30।।
transliteration: paśūnāṃ triśataṃ tatra yūpeṣu niyataṃ tadā| aśvaratnottamaṃ tasya rājño daśarathasya ca
translation: तदा then, तत्र there, पशूनाम् of animals, त्रिशतम् three hundred, तस्य राज्ञ: that king's, अश्वरत्नोत्तमम् the excellent of the horses from the stables, यूपेषु to the sacrificial posts, नियतम् was bound.
explanation: Three hundred animals and the jewel of the horses (from the stables) belonging to king Dasaratha were bound to the sacrificial posts.

shloka_text: कौसल्या तं हयं तत्र परिचर्य समन्तत:। कृपाणैर्विशशासैनं त्रिभि: परमया मुदा ।।1.14.31।।
transliteration: kausalyā taṃ hayaṃ tatra paricarya samantata:| kṛpāṇairviśaśāsainaṃ tribhi: paramayā mudā
translation: तत्र there, कौशल्या Kausalya, तम् that, हयम् horse, समन्तत: from all sides, परिचर्य having worshipped worship, परमया with immense, मुदा glee, त्रिभि: by three strokes of, कृपाणै: scimitar, एनम् this, विशशास severed.
explanation: Kausalya, with immense glee having gone round and worshipped that horse, severed it with three strokes of scimitar.

shloka_text: पतत्रिणा तदा सार्धं सुस्थितेन च चेतसा। अवसद्रजनीमेकां कौशल्या धर्मकाम्यया।।1.14.32।।
transliteration: patatriṇā tadā sārdhaṃ susthitena ca cetasā| avasadrajanīmekāṃ kauśalyā dharmakāmyayā
translation: तदा then, कौशल्या Kausalya, सुस्थितेन चेतसा with a stable mind, धर्मकाम्यया with devotion to duty, पतत्रिणा सार्थम् near that horse, एकाम् one, रजनीम् night, अवसत् spent.
explanation: Kausalya, in her devotion to duty and with a happy state of mind, passed one night near that horse.

shloka_text: होताऽध्वर्युस्तथोद्गाता हस्तेन समयोजयन्। महिष्या परिवृत्त्या च वावातां च तथापराम्।।1.14.33।।
transliteration: hotā'dhvaryustathodgātā hastena samayojayan| mahiṣyā parivṛttyā ca vāvātāṃ ca tathāparām
translation: होता Hota, अध्वर्यु: Adhvaryu, तथा and, उद्गाता Udgata, महिष्या with Mahishi (principal queen at the time of coronation), परिवृत्त्या च (overlooked wife) Parivritti, वावाताम् (a courtesan) Vavaata, अपराम् (attender on the king) other woman (known as Palakali), हस्तेन with hand, समयोजयन् touched.
explanation: Hota, Adhvaryu and Udgata arranged Mahishi, Parivritti, Vavaata and another woman known as Palakali to touch (keep the company of) the sacrificial horse.

shloka_text: पतत्रिणस्तस्य वपा मुद्धृत्य नियतेन्द्रिय:। ऋत्विक्परमसम्पन्न: श्रपयामास शास्त्रत:।।1.14.34।।
transliteration: patatriṇastasya vapā muddhṛtya niyatendriya:| ṛtvikparamasampanna: śrapayāmāsa śāstrata:
translation: नियतेन्द्रिय: a man of restrained senses, परमसम्पन्न: very rich in the knowledge of scriptures, ऋत्विक् official priest, तस्य that, पतत्रिण: horse's, वपाम् marrow, उद्धृत्य having removed, शास्त्रत: according to tradition, श्रपयामास cooked.
explanation: The official priest, highly knowledgeable in scriptures and having restrained senses, removed the marrow from the horse and cooked it according to tradition.

shloka_text: धूमगन्धं वपायास्तु जिघ्रति स्म नराधिप:। यथाकालं यथान्यायं निर्णुदन्पापमात्मन:।।1.14.35।।
transliteration: dhūmagandhaṃ vapāyāstu jighrati sma narādhipa:| yathākālaṃ yathānyāyaṃ nirṇudanpāpamātmana:
translation: नराधिप: king Dasaratha, यथाकालम् in an appropriate time, यथान्यायम् in agreement with the scriptures, आत्मन: his own, पापम् sins, निर्णुदन् while getting rid of, वपाया: of the  marrow, धूमगन्धम् good odour of the smoke, जिघ्रति स्म inhaled.
explanation: The king at appropriate time and in agreement with the scriptures inhaled the odour of the smoke (from the burnt marrow) and absolved himself of his sins.

shloka_text: हयस्य यानि चाङ्गानि तानि सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणा:। अग्नौ प्रास्यन्ति विधिवत्समन्त्राष्षोडशर्त्विज:।।1.14.36।।
transliteration: hayasya yāni cāṅgāni tāni sarvāṇi brāhmaṇā:| agnau prāsyanti vidhivatsamantrāṣṣoḍaśartvija:
translation: हयस्य horse's, यानि अङ्गानि those limbs, तानि सर्वाणि all of them, समन्त्रा: with prayers, षोडश ऋत्विज: sixteen officiating priests, ब्राह्मणा: brahmins, विधिवत् as per the customs,  अग्नौ in the fire, प्रास्यन्ति offered.
explanation: The sixteen officiating priests (brahmins) offered all the horse's limbs with prayers as per the customs.

shloka_text: प्लक्षशाखासु यज्ञानामन्येषां क्रियते हवि:। अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य वैतसो भाग इष्यते।।1.14.37।।
transliteration: plakṣaśākhāsu yajñānāmanyeṣāṃ kriyate havi:| aśvamedhasya yajñasya vaitaso bhāga iṣyate
translation: अन्येषाम् of other, यज्ञानाम् sacrifices, हवि: oblations, प्लक्षशाखासु in the brahches of Plaksha tree, क्रियते was offered, अश्वमेधस्य यज्ञस्य of Aswamedha sacrifice, भाग: one portion of Havis, वैतस: cane creeper, इष्यते chosen.
explanation: In other sacrifices oblations are offered with branches of a plaksha tree but in Aswamedha a branch of cane creeper is chosen instead.

shloka_text: त्र्यहोऽश्वमेधस्सङ्ख्यात: कल्पसूत्रेण ब्राह्मणै:। 37 चतुष्टोममहस्तस्य प्रथमं परिकल्पितम्।।1.14.38।।
transliteration: tryaho'śvamedhassaṅkhyāta: kalpasūtreṇa brāhmaṇai:| 37 catuṣṭomamahastasya prathamaṃ parikalpitam
translation: ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, कल्पसूत्रेण according to Kalpa sutra, अश्वमेध: Aswamedha, त्र्यह: having three days duration, सङ्ख्यात: is reckoned, तस्य of that, प्रथमम् first, अह: day, चतुष्टोम: chatushtoma, परिकल्पितम् planned.
explanation: According to Kalpa sutra, aswamedha in conducted for three days. In the first day, chatushtoma is arranged.

shloka_text: उक्थ्यं द्वितीयं संख्यातमतिरात्रं तथोत्तरम्। कारितास्तत्र बहवो विहिताश्शास्त्रदर्शनात्।।1.14.39।।
transliteration: ukthyaṃ dvitīyaṃ saṃkhyātamatirātraṃ tathottaram| kāritāstatra bahavo vihitāśśāstradarśanāt
translation: द्वितीयम् on the second day, उक्थ्यम् Ukthya, तथा and, उत्तरम् on the following day, अतिरात्रम् Atiraatra, सङ्ख्यातम् is declared, तत्र In that sacrifice, शास्त्रदर्शनात् according to scriptural knowledge, विहिता: imposed, बहव: many, कारिता: were performed.
explanation: On the second day Ukthya and on the third day Atiraatra were performed. Many sacrifices fixed according to the scriptures were also performed.

shloka_text: ज्योतिष्टोमायुषी चैवमतिरात्रौ विनिर्मितौ। अभिजिद्विश्वजिच्चैवमप्तोर्यामो महाक्रतु:।।1.14.40।।
transliteration: jyotiṣṭomāyuṣī caivamatirātrau vinirmitau| abhijidviśvajiccaivamaptoryāmo mahākratu:
translation: ज्योतिष्टोमायुषी Jyotishtoma and Ayuryaga, एवम् and, अतिरात्रौ in Atiratri, विनिर्मितौ were advised, अभिजित् Abhijit, विश्वजित् Viswajit, एवम् and, अप्तोर्याम: Aptoryama, महाक्रतु: great sacrifice, were performed.
explanation: Jyotishtoma and Ayuryaga in Atiratra, Abhijit, Viswajit and Aptoryama ceremonies constituting the great sacrifice were performed in the prescribed manner.

shloka_text: प्राचीं होत्रे ददौ राजा दिशं स्वकुलवर्धन:। अध्वर्यवे प्रतीचीं तु ब्रह्मणे दक्षिणां दिशम्।।1.14.41।। उद्गात्रे च तथोदीचीं दक्षिणैषा विनिर्मिता। हयमेधे महायज्ञे स्वयंभूविहिते पुरा।।1.14.42।।
transliteration: prācīṃ hotre dadau rājā diśaṃ svakulavardhana:| adhvaryave pratīcīṃ tu brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ diśam udgātre ca tathodīcīṃ dakṣiṇaiṣā vinirmitā| hayamedhe mahāyajñe svayaṃbhūvihite purā
translation: स्वकुलवर्धन: promoter of his dynasty, राजा Dasaratha, होत्रे to Hotar, प्राचीं दिशम् easten region, ददौ gave, अध्वर्यवे to Adhvaryu, प्रतीचीम् western side, ब्रह्मणे to Brahma, दक्षिणां दिशम् southern region, तथा and, उद्गात्रे to Udgata, उदीचीम् northern region, पुरा long ago, स्वयम्भूविहिते prescribed by Brahma, हयमेधे महायज्ञे in the mighty horsesacrifice, एषा this, दक्षिणा offering, विनिर्मिता is fixed.
explanation: In order to promote his dynasty, king Dasaratha gave away eastern region to Hotar, western region to Adhvaryu, southern region to Brahma and northern region to Udgata. These offerings were made in accordance with theprescriptions by Brahma long all.

shloka_text: प्राचीं होत्रे ददौ राजा दिशं स्वकुलवर्धन:। अध्वर्यवे प्रतीचीं तु ब्रह्मणे दक्षिणां दिशम्।।1.14.41।। उद्गात्रे च तथोदीचीं दक्षिणैषा विनिर्मिता। हयमेधे महायज्ञे स्वयंभूविहिते पुरा।।1.14.42।।
transliteration: prācīṃ hotre dadau rājā diśaṃ svakulavardhana:| adhvaryave pratīcīṃ tu brahmaṇe dakṣiṇāṃ diśam udgātre ca tathodīcīṃ dakṣiṇaiṣā vinirmitā| hayamedhe mahāyajñe svayaṃbhūvihite purā
translation: स्वकुलवर्धन: promoter of his dynasty, राजा Dasaratha, होत्रे to Hotar, प्राचीं दिशम् easten region, ददौ gave, अध्वर्यवे to Adhvaryu, प्रतीचीम् western side, ब्रह्मणे to Brahma, दक्षिणां दिशम् southern region, तथा and, उद्गात्रे to Udgata, उदीचीम् northern region, पुरा long ago, स्वयम्भूविहिते prescribed by Brahma, हयमेधे महायज्ञे in the mighty horsesacrifice, एषा this, दक्षिणा offering, विनिर्मिता is fixed.
explanation: In order to promote his dynasty, king Dasaratha gave away eastern region to Hotar, western region to Adhvaryu, southern region to Brahma and northern region to Udgata. These offerings were made in accordance with theprescriptions by Brahma long all.

shloka_text: क्रतुं समाप्य तु तदा न्यायत: पुरुषर्षभ: । ऋत्विग्भ्यो हि ददौ राजा तां धरां कुलवर्धन:।।1.14.43।।
transliteration: kratuṃ samāpya tu tadā nyāyata: puruṣarṣabha: | ṛtvigbhyo hi dadau rājā tāṃ dharāṃ kulavardhana:
translation: पुरुषर्षभ: best among men, राजा king Dasaratha, कुलवर्धन: upholder of his dynasty, क्रतुम् समाप्य having concluded the sacrifice, तदा then, न्यायत: according to law, तां धराम् that  earth, ऋत्विग्भ्य: for priests, ददौ offered.
explanation: The king best among men and upholder of his dynasty, having concluded the sacrifice according to law, offered this entire earth as gift to priests.

shloka_text: ऋत्विजस्त्वब्रुवन्सर्वे राजानं गतकल्मषम्। भवानेव महीं कृत्स्नामेको रक्षितुमर्हति।।1.14.44।।
transliteration: ṛtvijastvabruvansarve rājānaṃ gatakalmaṣam| bhavāneva mahīṃ kṛtsnāmeko rakṣitumarhati
translation: सर्वे all, ऋत्विजस्तु priests on their part, गतकल्मषम् purged of all sins, राजानम् the king, अब्रुवन् said, भवान् you, एक:एव you alone, कृत्स्नाम् entire, महीम् earth, रक्षितुमर्हति are worthy of protection.
explanation: But all the priests said to the king purged of his sins, "O Lord of men you alone are capable of protecting this earth".

shloka_text: न भूम्या कार्यमस्माकं न हि शक्तास्स्म पालने। रतास्स्वाध्यायकरणे वयं नित्यं हि भूमिप।।1.14.45।। निष्क्रयं किञ्चिदेवेह प्रयच्छतु भवानिति। 4
transliteration: na bhūmyā kāryamasmākaṃ na hi śaktāssma pālane| ratāssvādhyāyakaraṇe vayaṃ nityaṃ hi bhūmipa niṣkrayaṃ kiñcideveha prayacchatu bhavāniti| 4
translation: भूमिप O Ruler of the earth, भूम्या with earth, अस्माकम् for us, न कार्यम् have nothing to do, पालने in ruling, न हि शक्ता: we are not capable, वयम् we, नित्यम् constantly, स्वाध्यायकरणे in  studying of vedas, रता: हि are dedicated indeed, भवान् you, इह in the matter of this offering, किञ्चित् whatever, निष्क्रयम् in lieu value, प्रयच्छतु may confer.
explanation: "O ruler of the earth We are constantly engaged in the study of the Vedas. We are not capable of ruling the earth and we cannot do anything with its possession. Give some other charity in lieu of that.

shloka_text: मणिरत्नं सुवर्णं वा गावो यद्वा समुद्यतम्। तत्प्रयच्छ नरश्रेष्ठ धरण्या न प्रयोजनम्।।1.14.46।।
transliteration: maṇiratnaṃ suvarṇaṃ vā gāvo yadvā samudyatam| tatprayaccha naraśreṣṭha dharaṇyā na prayojanam
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O best of men, मणिरत्नम् a precious gem, सुवर्णं वा or gold, गाव: cows, यद्वा or else,  समुद्यतम् is ready, तत् that, प्रयच्छ give, धरण्या with earth, प्रयोजनं न no use.
explanation: O best of men give us gems or gold or cows or whichever is readily available. We have no use with this earth".

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो नरपतिर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगै:।।1.14.47।। गवां शतसहस्राणि दश तेभ्यो ददौ नृप:। 4 शतकोटीस्सुवर्णस्य रजतस्य चतुर्गुणम् ।।1.14.48।।
transliteration: evamukto narapatirbrāhmaṇairvedapāragai: gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi daśa tebhyo dadau nṛpa:| 4 śatakoṭīssuvarṇasya rajatasya caturguṇam
translation: नरपति: lord of men, नृप: king Dasaratha, वेदपारगै: by scholars who were well learned in vedas, ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: having spoken, तेभ्य: for them, गवां दश शतसहस्राणि ten hundred thousands, सुवर्णस्य gold, शतकोटी: hundred crores, रजतस्य of  silver, चतुर्गुणम् four times as much, ददौ bestowed.
explanation: Lord of men, the king having been thus addressed by brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas, bestowed on them ten hundred thousand cows, a hundred crore of gold coins and four times as much in silver coins.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो नरपतिर्ब्राह्मणैर्वेदपारगै:।।1.14.47।। गवां शतसहस्राणि दश तेभ्यो ददौ नृप:। 4 शतकोटीस्सुवर्णस्य रजतस्य चतुर्गुणम् ।।1.14.48।।
transliteration: evamukto narapatirbrāhmaṇairvedapāragai: gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi daśa tebhyo dadau nṛpa:| 4 śatakoṭīssuvarṇasya rajatasya caturguṇam
translation: नरपति: lord of men, नृप: king Dasaratha, वेदपारगै: by scholars who were well learned in vedas, ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: having spoken, तेभ्य: for them, गवां दश शतसहस्राणि ten hundred thousands, सुवर्णस्य gold, शतकोटी: hundred crores, रजतस्य of  silver, चतुर्गुणम् four times as much, ददौ bestowed.
explanation: Lord of men, the king having been thus addressed by brahmins who were wellversed in the Vedas, bestowed on them ten hundred thousand cows, a hundred crore of gold coins and four times as much in silver coins.

shloka_text: ऋत्विजश्च ततस्सर्वे प्रददुस्सहिता वसु। ऋश्यशृङ्गाय मुनये वसिष्ठाय च धीमते।।1.14.49।।
transliteration: ṛtvijaśca tatassarve pradadussahitā vasu| ṛśyaśṛṅgāya munaye vasiṣṭhāya ca dhīmate
translation: तत: thereafter, ऋत्विज: priests, सर्वे all, सहिता: together, वसु wealth, ऋश्यशृङ्गाय मुनये for sage Rsyasringa, धीमते to the man endowed with prudence, वसिष्ठाय to vasistha,  प्रददु: gave.
explanation: All the priests collectively offered that wealth to sage Rsyasringa and Vasishta endowed with prudence.

shloka_text: ततस्ते न्यायत: कृत्वा प्रविभागं द्विजोत्तमा:। सुप्रीतमनसस्सर्वे प्रत्यूचुर्मुदिता भृशम्।।1.14.50।।
transliteration: tataste nyāyata: kṛtvā pravibhāgaṃ dvijottamā:| suprītamanasassarve pratyūcurmuditā bhṛśam
translation: तत: then, सुप्रीतमनस: highly pleased, ते द्विजोत्तमा: those brahmins, सर्वे all, न्यायत: with equity, प्रविभागम् share, कृत्वा having made, भृशम् exceedingly, मुदिता: delighted, प्रत्यूचु:  replied.
explanation: Then those highly pleased brahmins, having distributed that wealth with equity, again said to the king.

shloka_text: तत: प्रसर्पकैभ्यस्तु हिरण्यं सुसमाहित:। जाम्बूनदं कोटिसंख्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ तदा।।1.14.51।।
transliteration: tata: prasarpakaibhyastu hiraṇyaṃ susamāhita:| jāmbūnadaṃ koṭisaṃkhyaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tadā
translation: तत: thereafter, तदा then, सुसमाहित: with earnestness, प्रसर्पकैभ्य: to those who have come to see the sacrifice, ब्राह्मणेभ्य: to brahmins, कोटिसंख्यम् one crore of, जाम्बूनदम् gold, ददौ bestowed.
explanation: Thereafter, with earnestness king Dasaratha bestowed a crore of gold coins to brahmins who had come to see the sacrifice.

shloka_text: दरिद्राय द्विजायाथ हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम्। कस्मैचिद्याचमानाय ददौ राघवनन्दन:।।1.14.52।।
transliteration: daridrāya dvijāyātha hastābharaṇamuttamam| kasmaicidyācamānāya dadau rāghavanandana:
translation: अथ there after, राघवनन्दन: Dasaratha, याचमानाय soliciting, कस्मैचित् one such, दरिद्राय poor, द्विजाय brahmin, उत्तमम् excellent, हस्ताभरणम् bracelet, ददौ gave.
explanation: Dasaratha then gave his excellent bracelet to a poor brahmin who solicited alms.

shloka_text: तत: प्रीतेषु नृपतिर्द्विजेषु द्विजवत्सल:। प्रणाममकरोत्तेषां हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षण:।।1.14.53।।
transliteration: tata: prīteṣu nṛpatirdvijeṣu dvijavatsala:| praṇāmamakarotteṣāṃ harṣaparyākulekṣaṇa:
translation: तत: then, द्विजवत्सल: affectionate towards brahmins, नृपति: king, द्विजेषु when brahmins, प्रीतेषु (सत्सु) were highly pleased, हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षण: with his eyes filled with delight, तेषाम् for them, प्रणामम् अकरोत् bowed low before them.
explanation: When the brahmins were pleased, king Dasaratha who was fond of brahmins bowed to them with his eyes filled with delight.

shloka_text: तस्याशिषोऽथ विधिवद्ब्राह्मणैस्समुदीरिता:। उदारस्य नृवीरस्य धरण्यां प्रणतस्य च ।।1.14.54।।
transliteration: tasyāśiṣo'tha vidhivadbrāhmaṇaissamudīritā:| udārasya nṛvīrasya dharaṇyāṃ praṇatasya ca
translation: अथ there after, उदारस्य of the generous, नृवीरस्य of him who was mighty among men, धरण्याम् on the earth, प्रणतस्य prostrated, तस्य for him, ब्राह्मणै: by brahmins, विधिवत् according to procedure, आशिष: blessings, समुदीरिता: were uttered.
explanation: Brahmins uttered blessings upon the generous king when he prostrated before them according to procedure.

shloka_text: तत: प्रीतमना राजा प्राप्य यज्ञमनुत्तमम्। पापापहं स्वर्नयनं दुष्करं पार्थिवर्षभै:।।1.14.55।।
transliteration: tata: prītamanā rājā prāpya yajñamanuttamam| pāpāpahaṃ svarnayanaṃ duṣkaraṃ pārthivarṣabhai:
translation: तत: there after, राजा king Dasaratha, पापापहम् capable of removing sins, स्वर्नयनम् leading to heaven, पार्थिवर्षभै: for monarchs, दुष्करम् incapable of being done, अनुत्तमम् greatest, यज्ञम् sacrifice, प्राप्य having performed, प्रीतमना: cheerful heart.
explanation: Sacrifice destroys sins. It leads to heaven. It is incapable of being done by other monarchs. King Dasaratha was very much pleased after performing this great sacrifice.

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीदृश्यशृङ्गं राजा दशरथस्तदा। कुलस्य वर्धनं त्वं तु कर्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत।।1.14.56।।
transliteration: tato'bravīdṛśyaśṛṅgaṃ rājā daśarathastadā| kulasya vardhanaṃ tvaṃ tu kartumarhasi suvrata
translation: तत: there after, दशरथ: राजा king Dasaratha, तदा then, ऋष्यशृङ्गम् addressing Rsyasringa, अब्रवीत् said, सुव्रत O Adherent of vows, कुलस्य of the race, वर्धनम् continuity, त्वम् you,कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि deserve.
explanation: King Dasaratha then addressing Rsyasringa said "O Adherent of vows you can help the continuity of my race".

shloka_text: तथेति च स राजानमुवाच द्विजसत्तम:। भविष्यन्ति सुता राजंश्चत्वारस्ते कुलोद्वहा:।।1.14.57।।
transliteration: tatheti ca sa rājānamuvāca dvijasattama:| bhaviṣyanti sutā rājaṃścatvāraste kulodvahā:
translation: द्विजसत्तम: best of brahmins, तथेति be it so, राजानम् addressing king Dasaratha, उवाच said,  राजन् O king, ते to you, कुलोद्वहा: perpetuating race, चत्वार: four, सुता: sons, भविष्यन्ति will be born.
explanation: Rsyasringa, the best of brahmins, addressing the king said, "O King Let it be. Four sons perpetuating your race will be born to you". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुर्दशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fourteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: मेथावी तु ततो ध्यात्वा स किञ्चिदिदमुत्तरम्। लब्धसंज्ञस्ततस्तं तु वेदज्ञो नृपमब्रवीत्।।1.15.1।।
transliteration: methāvī tu tato dhyātvā sa kiñcididamuttaram| labdhasaṃjñastatastaṃ tu vedajño nṛpamabravīt
translation: तत: then, मेथावी great retentive intellectual, वेदज्ञ: knowledgeable in vedas, स: he, किञ्चित् for a little while, ध्यात्वा having pondered, तत: there after, लब्धसंज्ञ: recollected his memory, तम् that, नृपम् king, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Rsyasringa, a highly  intellectual and knowledgeable one in the Vedas, pondered for a while, revived his memory  and said to the king.
comments: Dasaratha commences putreshti under the guidance of Rsyasringa--Gods approach Brahma, the creator to suggest means of killing Ravana who could not be killed by anyone except man, monkeys and bears--Visnu appears--gods request Visnu to  incarnate in the world of men as son of Dasaratha--He agrees

shloka_text: इष्टिं तेऽहं करिष्यामि पुत्रीयां पुत्रकारणात्। अथर्वशिरसि प्रोक्तैर्मन्त्रैस्सिद्धां विधानत:।।1.15.2।।
transliteration: iṣṭiṃ te'haṃ kariṣyāmi putrīyāṃ putrakāraṇāt| atharvaśirasi proktairmantraissiddhāṃ vidhānata:
translation: अहम् I, ते for you, पुत्रकारणात् for begetting sons, अथर्वशिरसि in 'Atharva Siras' portion of veda, प्रोक्तै: declared, मन्त्रै: by mantras, सिद्धाम् realising the desires, पुत्रीयाम् capable of bestowing sons, इष्टिम् sacrifice, विधानत: as per tradition, करिष्यामि I will perform.
explanation: "I shall perform putriyeshti to help you beget sons. This is to be done in accordance with tradition for fulfilment of desires through mantras as declared in a portion of the Vedas, 'atharva siras'" .

shloka_text: तत: प्राक्रमदिष्टिं तां पुत्रीयां पुत्रकारणात्। जुहाव चाग्नौ तेजस्वी मन्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा।।1.15.3।।
transliteration: tata: prākramadiṣṭiṃ tāṃ putrīyāṃ putrakāraṇāt| juhāva cāgnau tejasvī mantradṛṣṭena karmaṇā
translation: तत: then,  पुत्रकाराणात् for begetting  sons, पुत्रीयाम् for the sake of begetting children, ताम् इष्टिम् that sacrifice, प्राक्रम्यत् having commenced, तेजस्वी effulgent Rsyasringa मन्त्रदृष्टेन in accordance with mantras, कर्मणा with sacrificial acts,  अग्नौ in the fire, जुहाव च poured oblations.
explanation: To help Dasaratha beget sons, brilliant Rsyasringa  commenced putriyeshti, a sacrifice for begetting children, by pouring oblations into sacrificial fire and chanting mantras in accordance with traditions.

shloka_text: ततो देवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्च परमर्षय: । भागप्रतिग्रहार्थं वै समवेता यथाविधि।।1.15.4।।
transliteration: tato devāssagandharvāssiddhāśca paramarṣaya: | bhāgapratigrahārthaṃ vai samavetā yathāvidhi
translation: तत: thereafater, सगन्धर्वा: along with gandharvas, देवा: (celestial deities) devatas, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षय: great sages, यथाविधि according to tradition, भागप्रतिग्रहार्थम् to receive their share of offerings, समवेता: वै assembled.
explanation: All the celestial deities etc., along with gandharvas according to tradition, gathered at the sacrifice to receive their share of offerings.

shloka_text: तास्समेत्य यथान्यायं तस्मिन्सदसि देवता:। अब्रुवन् लोककर्तारं ब्रह्माणं वचनं महत्।।1.15.5।।
transliteration: tāssametya yathānyāyaṃ tasminsadasi devatā:| abruvan lokakartāraṃ brahmāṇaṃ vacanaṃ mahat
translation: ता: देवता: those devatas (celestial deities), यथान्यायम् as per custom, तस्मिन् in that, सदसि assembly place, समेत्य having assembled, लोककर्तारम् creator of the worlds, ब्रह्माणम् lord Brahma, महत् important, वचनम् these words, अब्रुवन् addressed.
explanation: All devatas assembled there as per tradition and thus addressed Lord Brahma the creator of the worlds:

shloka_text: भगवन्त्वत्प्रसादेन रावणो नाम राक्षस:। सर्वान्नो बाधते वीर्याच्छासितुं तं न शक्नुम:।।1.15.6।।
transliteration: bhagavantvatprasādena rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasa:| sarvānno bādhate vīryācchāsituṃ taṃ na śaknuma:
translation: भगवन् O Revered lord, रावणो नाम by name Ravana, राक्षस: rakshasa (demonical in nature), त्वत्प्रसादेन by your grace, वीर्यात् by the prowess, न: us, सर्वान् all, बाधते is oppressing, तम् him, शासितुम् to punish, न शक्नुम: we are not capable.
explanation: "O lord a rakshasa by name Ravana who had obtained prowess through your grace is oppressing us. We are unable to punish him.

shloka_text: त्वया तस्मै वरो दत्त: प्रीतेन भगवन्पुरा। मानयन्तश्च तं नित्यं सर्वं तस्य क्षमामहे।।1.15.7।।
transliteration: tvayā tasmai varo datta: prītena bhagavanpurā| mānayantaśca taṃ nityaṃ sarvaṃ tasya kṣamāmahe
translation: भगवन् "O Venerable lord, पुरा earlier, प्रीतेन by the well pleased, त्वया by you, तस्मै for him, वर: boon, दत्त: granted, तम् that, मानयन्त: honouring, तस्य for his, सर्वम् entirely, नित्यम् always, क्षमामहे we endure.
explanation: Pleased with his penance, Lord, you had granted him a boon. By honour that boon and daily endure all his cruelty.

shloka_text: उद्वेजयति लोकान्स्तीनुच्छ्रितान्द्वेष्टि दुर्मति:। शक्रं त्रिदशराजानं प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छति।।1.15.8।।
transliteration: udvejayati lokānstīnucchritāndveṣṭi durmati:| śakraṃ tridaśarājānaṃ pradharṣayitumicchati
translation: दुर्मति: evil minded, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, उद्वेजयति inflicting pains, उच्छ्रितान् the guardians of earth, द्वेष्टि hates, त्रिदशराजानम् lord of celestial beings, शक्रम् Indra, प्रधर्षयितुम् to assault him, इच्छति he is desirous.
explanation: The evilminded Ravana is inflicting pains on the three worlds. He hates the guardians of the earth and intends to assault Indra, lord of the celestials.

shloka_text: ऋषीन्यक्षान्सगन्धर्वानसुरान्ब्राह्मणांस्तथा। अतिक्रामति दुर्धर्षो वरदानेन मोहित:।।1.15.9।।
transliteration: ṛṣīnyakṣānsagandharvānasurānbrāhmaṇāṃstathā| atikrāmati durdharṣo varadānena mohita:
translation: दुर्धष: the unassailable one, वरदानेन because of the boons, मोहित: is puffed with pride, ऋषीन् sages, यक्षान् yakshas, सगन्धर्वान् along with gandharvas, असुरान् asuras, तथा and, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, अतिक्रामति tresspasses.
explanation: Because of your boon he has become unassailable and puffed with pride deties sages, yakshas, gandharvas, demons and brahmins.

shloka_text: नैनं सूर्य: प्रतपति पार्श्वे वाति न मारुत:। चलोर्मिमाली तं दृष्ट्वा समुद्रोऽपि न कम्पते।।1.15.10।।
transliteration: nainaṃ sūrya: pratapati pārśve vāti na māruta:| calormimālī taṃ dṛṣṭvā samudro'pi na kampate
translation: एनम् for him, सूर्य: Sun, न प्रतपति does not torment him, मारुत: wind, पार्श्वे near, न वाति does not blow, चलोर्मिमाली incessantly moving waves, समुद्रोऽपि even the ocean, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, न कम्पते does not stir (shake).
explanation: The Sun does not scorch him  and the wind does not blow by him. Even the ocean with its incessantly moving waves becomes still in his presence.

shloka_text: तन्महन्नो भयं तस्माद्राक्षसाद्घोरदर्शनात्। वधार्थं तस्य भगवन्नुपायं कर्तुमर्हसि।।1.15.11।।
transliteration: tanmahanno bhayaṃ tasmādrākṣasādghoradarśanāt| vadhārthaṃ tasya bhagavannupāyaṃ kartumarhasi
translation: तत् for that reason, घोरदर्शनात् from the one of dreadful appearance, तस्मात् from him, राक्षसात् rakshasa, न: for us, महत् great, भयम् terror, भगवन् O Lord, तस्य for his, वधार्थम्   destruction, उपायम् means, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you are capable.
explanation: His dreamful appearance of that rakshasa strikes terror into us. O Lord do find some means to kill him".

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्सुरैस्सर्वैश्चिन्तयित्वा ततोऽब्रवीत्। हन्तायं विदितस्तस्य वधोपायो दुरात्मन:।।1.15.12।।
transliteration: evamuktassuraissarvaiścintayitvā tato'bravīt| hantāyaṃ viditastasya vadhopāyo durātmana:
translation: सर्वै: by all, सुरै: devatas, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: spoken, चिन्तयित्वा having reflected, तत: then, अब्रवीत् said, तस्य that, दुरात्मन: wickedminded, अयम् this, वधोपाय: means of destrction, विदित: is known, हन्त Oh
explanation: After listening to the words of the devatas and reflecting over the matter, Brahma said,    "Oh, the means of destruction of that wicked (rakshasa) has struck my mind".

shloka_text: तेन गन्धर्वयक्षाणां देवदानवरक्षसाम्। अवध्योऽस्मीति वागुक्ता तथेत्युक्तं च तन्मया।।1.15.13।।
transliteration: tena gandharvayakṣāṇāṃ devadānavarakṣasām| avadhyo'smīti vāguktā tathetyuktaṃ ca tanmayā
translation: तेन by him, गन्धर्वयक्षाणाम् of (by) gandharvas and yakshas, देवदानवरक्षसाम् gods, demons and rakshasas, अवध्य: अस्मि I am incapable of being destroyed, इति in this manner, वाक् words, उक्ता spoken, मया च by me also, तत् that one, तथा be it so, उक्तम् said.
explanation: When he asked gandharvas, yakshas, gods, demons or rakshasas should never be able to kill him, I said, "So be it".

shloka_text: नाकीर्तयदवज्ञानात्तद्रक्षो मानुषान् प्रति। तस्मात्स मानुषाद्वध्यो मृत्युर्नान्योऽस्य विद्यते।।1.15.14।।
transliteration: nākīrtayadavajñānāttadrakṣo mānuṣān prati| tasmātsa mānuṣādvadhyo mṛtyurnānyo'sya vidyate
translation: तत् रक्ष: that rakshasa, अवज्ञानात् due to disdain, मानुषान् प्रति about the men, न अकीर्तयत् did not mention, तस्मात् for that reason, स: he, मानुषात् by man, वध्य: is fit to be destroyed, अस्य for him, अन्य: any other, मृत्यु: means of death, न विद्यते is not possible.
explanation: "The rakshasa did not include man monkey and bear because of his disdain for men. As such he is fit to be destroyed by a man and not by any other means".

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वा प्रियं वाक्यं ब्रह्मणा समुदाहृतम्। सर्वे महर्षयो देवाः प्रहृष्टास्तेऽभवंस्तदा।।1.15.15।।
transliteration: etacchrutvā priyaṃ vākyaṃ brahmaṇā samudāhṛtam| sarve maharṣayo devāḥ prahṛṣṭāste'bhavaṃstadā
translation: तदा then, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, समुदाहृतम् mentioned, एतत् these, प्रियं वाक्यम् delighted  words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ते देवा: those devatas (celestial deities), महर्षय: maharshis, सर्वे all, प्रहृष्टा: अभवन् felt happy.
explanation: Having heard these pleasing words uttered by Brahma, all the devatas and maharshis were overwhelmed with joy.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे विष्णुरुपयातो महाद्युति:। शङ्खचक्रगदापाणि: पीतवासा जगत्पति:।।1.15.16।।
transliteration: etasminnantare viṣṇurupayāto mahādyuti:| śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇi: pītavāsā jagatpati:
translation: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे at this juncutre, माहाद्युति: highly effulgent, शङ्खचक्रगदापाणि: bearing in his hands Conch, Discus and Mace, पीतवासा: attired in yellow apparel, जगत्पति: lord of the world, विष्णु: Visnu, उपयात: arrived.
explanation: At this juncture Visnu the lord of the world, highly effulgent and bearing conch, discus and mace in his hands and in yellow apparel arrived.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मणा च समागम्य तत्र तस्थौ समाहित:। 1 तमब्रुवन्सुरास्सर्वे समभिष्टूय सन्नता:।।1.15.17।।
transliteration: brahmaṇā ca samāgamya tatra tasthau samāhita:| 1 tamabruvansurāssarve samabhiṣṭūya sannatā:
translation: ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, समागम्य having met, तत्र there, समाहित: with composed mind, तस्थौ remained, सुरा: devatas, सर्वे all, सन्नता: prostrating, तम् him, समभिष्टूय paying homage with hymns, अब्रुवन् spoke.
explanation: Lord Visnu stayed there with a composed mind after meeting Brahma Then thus spoke the devatas prostrated before Visnu and paying him homage with hymns.

shloka_text: त्वान्नियोक्ष्यामहे विष्णो लोकानां हितकाम्यया। 1 राज्ञो दशरथस्य त्वमयोध्याधिपते: प्रभो:।।1.15.18। धर्मज्ञस्य वदान्यस्य महर्षिसमतेजस: । 18 तस्य भार्यासु तिसृषु ह्रीश्रीकीर्त्युपमासु च।।1.15.19।। विष्णो पुत्रत्वमागच्छ कृत्वाऽऽत्मानं चतुर्विधम्। 1
transliteration: tvānniyokṣyāmahe viṣṇo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā| 1 rājño daśarathasya tvamayodhyādhipate: prabho:||1.15.18| dharmajñasya vadānyasya maharṣisamatejasa: | 18 tasya bhāryāsu tisṛṣu hrīśrīkīrtyupamāsu ca viṣṇo putratvamāgaccha kṛtvā''tmānaṃ caturvidham| 1
translation: विष्णो O Visnu, लोकानाम् for all the worlds, हितकाम्यया desirous of doing benefit, त्वाम् you, नियोक्ष्यामहे we are appointing, विष्णो OVisnu, त्वम् you, अयोध्याधिपते: of the Sovereign of Ayodhya, प्रभो: of the king, धर्मज्ञस्य of the righteous, वदान्यस्य of the generous, महर्षिसमतेजस: of one equalling rishis in lusture, तस्य his, दशरथस्य राज्ञ: king Dasaratha's ह्री श्री कीर्त्युपमासु comparable to Hri (Modesty), Shree (auspiciousness), Kirti (fame) the daughters of Daksha, तिसृषु among the three, भार्यासु wives, आत्मानम्  thy self, चतुर्विधम् in four ways, कृत्वा having divided, पुत्रत्वम् in the form of sons, आगच्छ come.
explanation: "O Visnu we pray for the welfare of all the worlds. The sovereign of Ayodhya, king Dasaratha is a righteous, virtuous and  generous king equal with rishis in lusture. Pray form into four and incarnate in the of four sons of his three wives, resembling hri (modesty), shree (auspiciousness), kirti (fame).

shloka_text: त्वान्नियोक्ष्यामहे विष्णो लोकानां हितकाम्यया। 1 राज्ञो दशरथस्य त्वमयोध्याधिपते: प्रभो:।।1.15.18। धर्मज्ञस्य वदान्यस्य महर्षिसमतेजस: । 18 तस्य भार्यासु तिसृषु ह्रीश्रीकीर्त्युपमासु च।।1.15.19।। विष्णो पुत्रत्वमागच्छ कृत्वाऽऽत्मानं चतुर्विधम्। 1
transliteration: tvānniyokṣyāmahe viṣṇo lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā| 1 rājño daśarathasya tvamayodhyādhipate: prabho:||1.15.18| dharmajñasya vadānyasya maharṣisamatejasa: | 18 tasya bhāryāsu tisṛṣu hrīśrīkīrtyupamāsu ca viṣṇo putratvamāgaccha kṛtvā''tmānaṃ caturvidham| 1
translation: विष्णो O Visnu, लोकानाम् for all the worlds, हितकाम्यया desirous of doing benefit, त्वाम् you, नियोक्ष्यामहे we are appointing, विष्णो OVisnu, त्वम् you, अयोध्याधिपते: of the Sovereign of Ayodhya, प्रभो: of the king, धर्मज्ञस्य of the righteous, वदान्यस्य of the generous, महर्षिसमतेजस: of one equalling rishis in lusture, तस्य his, दशरथस्य राज्ञ: king Dasaratha's ह्री श्री कीर्त्युपमासु comparable to Hri (Modesty), Shree (auspiciousness), Kirti (fame) the daughters of Daksha, तिसृषु among the three, भार्यासु wives, आत्मानम्  thy self, चतुर्विधम् in four ways, कृत्वा having divided, पुत्रत्वम् in the form of sons, आगच्छ come.
explanation: "O Visnu we pray for the welfare of all the worlds. The sovereign of Ayodhya, king Dasaratha is a righteous, virtuous and  generous king equal with rishis in lusture. Pray form into four and incarnate in the of four sons of his three wives, resembling hri (modesty), shree (auspiciousness), kirti (fame).

shloka_text: तत्र त्वं मानुषो भूत्वा प्रवृद्धं लोककण्टकम्। अवध्यं दैवतैर्विष्णो समरे जहि रावणम्।।1.15.20।।
transliteration: tatra tvaṃ mānuṣo bhūtvā pravṛddhaṃ lokakaṇṭakam| avadhyaṃ daivatairviṣṇo samare jahi rāvaṇam
translation: विष्णो: O Visnu, त्वम् you, तत्र there, मानुष: in the form of man, भूत्वा having been born, प्रवृद्धम् increasingly becoming arrogant, लोककण्टकम् source of vexation and terror to the worlds, दैवतै: by gods, अवध्यम् invincible, रावणम् Ravana, समरे in the battle, जहि slay.
explanation: "O Visnu assuring human form, kill Ravana in the battle. He has become a source of torment to the worlds and is invincible by gods.

shloka_text: स हि देवांश्च गन्धर्वान्सिद्धांश्च मुनिसत्तमान्। राक्षसो रावणो मूर्खो वीर्योत्सेकेन बाधते।।1.15.21।।
transliteration: sa hi devāṃśca gandharvānsiddhāṃśca munisattamān| rākṣaso rāvaṇo mūrkho vīryotsekena bādhate
translation: स: that, मूर्ख: dull headed, राक्षस: rakshasa, रावण: Ravana, देवांश्च gods, गन्धर्वान् gandharvas, सिद्धांश्च siddhas, मुनिसत्तमान् great rishis, वीर्योत्सेकेन by his haughty prowess, बाधते हि is tormenting indeed.
explanation: "That stupid rakshasa, Ravana, with his haughty prowess, is terrorising the gods, gandharvas, siddhas and great rishis.

shloka_text: ऋषयश्च ततस्तेन गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा। क्रीडन्तो नन्दनवने क्रूरेण किल हिंसिता:।।1.15.22।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaśca tatastena gandharvāpsarasastathā| krīḍanto nandanavane krūreṇa kila hiṃsitā:
translation: तत: thus, तेन that, क्रूरेण by the cruel one, ऋषयश्च rishis, तथा and, नन्दनवने in Nandana groves, क्रीडन्त: sporting, गन्धर्वाप्सरस: gandharvas and apsaras, हिंसिता: किल are reported to be tortured.
explanation: It is reported that a cruel rakshasa with his haughty prowess has tortured rishis, gandharvas and apsaras sporting in Nandana groves.

shloka_text: वधार्थं वयमायातास्तस्य वै मुनिभिस्सह। सिद्धगन्धर्वयक्षाश्च ततस्त्वां शरणं गता:।।1.15.23।।
transliteration: vadhārthaṃ vayamāyātāstasya vai munibhissaha| siddhagandharvayakṣāśca tatastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā:
translation: वयम् we, सिद्धगन्धर्वयक्षाश्च siddhas, gandharvas and yakshas, मुनिभि: सह along with ascetics, तस्य his, वधार्थम् in order to kill him, आयाता: have come, तत: for that reason, त्वाम् you, शरणम् गता: we have taken refuge in you.
explanation: We siddhas, gandharvas and yakshas along with ascetics, have hence come here to devise ways of his death. We take refuge in you.

shloka_text: त्वं गति: परमा देव सर्वेषां न: परन्तप:। वधाय देवशत्रूणां नृणां लोके मन: कुरु।।1.15.24।।
transliteration: tvaṃ gati: paramā deva sarveṣāṃ na: parantapa:| vadhāya devaśatrūṇāṃ nṛṇāṃ loke mana: kuru
translation: परन्तप OTormentor of enemies, देव OVisnu, त्वम् you, न: सर्वेषाम् for all of us, परमा supreme, गति: refuge, देवशत्रूणाम् of the enemies of gods (rakshasas), वधाय for the destruction, नृणाम् लोके in the world of men, मन: mind, कुरु resolve.
explanation: O tormentor of enemies, O Visnu, you are the supreme, refuge for all of us. Resolve to be born in the world of men for the destruction of enemies of the gods (rakshasas)".

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेशो विष्णुस्त्रिदशपुङ्गव:। पितामहपुरोगांस्तान्सर्वलोकनमस्कृत:।।1.15.25।। अब्रवीत्त्रिदशान्सर्वान्समेतान्धर्मसंहितान् ।।1.15.26।।
transliteration: evamuktastu deveśo viṣṇustridaśapuṅgava:| pitāmahapurogāṃstānsarvalokanamaskṛta: abravīttridaśānsarvānsametāndharmasaṃhitān
translation: त्रिदशपुङ्गव: foremost of gods, सर्वलोकनमस्कृत: bowed by all in the worlds, देवेश: lord of devatas, celestial beings, विष्णु: Visnu, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: addressed, समेतान् assembled, धर्मसंहितान् guided by law of righteousness, पितामहपुरोगान् led by the grand  sire, तान् those, सर्वान् all, त्रिदशान् gods, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Visnu, the lord of the celestials, foremost among the gods and bowed by all in the worlds addressed the assembled devatas who were guided by the law of righteousness and were led by the grand sire, Brahma.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेशो विष्णुस्त्रिदशपुङ्गव:। पितामहपुरोगांस्तान्सर्वलोकनमस्कृत:।।1.15.25।। अब्रवीत्त्रिदशान्सर्वान्समेतान्धर्मसंहितान् ।।1.15.26।।
transliteration: evamuktastu deveśo viṣṇustridaśapuṅgava:| pitāmahapurogāṃstānsarvalokanamaskṛta: abravīttridaśānsarvānsametāndharmasaṃhitān
