shloka_text: वसिष्ठस्याश्रमपदं ब्रह्मलोकमिवापरम्। ददर्श जयतां श्रेष्ठो विश्वामित्रो महाबल:।।1.51.28।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasyāśramapadaṃ brahmalokamivāparam| dadarśa jayatāṃ śreṣṭho viśvāmitro mahābala:
translation: जयताम् of the conquerors, श्रेष्ठ: foremost, महाबल: highly powerful, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, अपरम् a second, ब्रह्मलोकमिव like Brahmaloka, वसिष्ठस्य sage Vasishta's, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Highly powerful Viswamitra, foremost among the conquerors, (thus) saw the hermitage of Vasishta which looked like another Brahmaloka. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशस्सर्ग:। Thus ends the fiftyfirst sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतो विश्वामित्रो महाबल:। प्रणतो विनयाद्वीरो वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्।।1.52.1।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā paramaprīto viśvāmitro mahābala:| praṇato vinayādvīro vasiṣṭhaṃ japatāṃ varam
translation: महाबल: very mighty, वीर: heroic, स: विश्वामित्र: that Visvamitra, जपताम् वरम् greatest among those performing religious prayers, वसिष्ठम् Vasishta, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमप्रीत: exceedingly happy, विनयात् out of respect, प्रणत: offered respectful salutations.
explanation: Overwhelmed with joy the mighty, heroic Viswamitra upon seeing Vasishta, the greatest among ascetics, was and offered respectful salutations.
comments: Vasishta orders Kamadhenu to create things necessary for the hospitality to king Viswamitra.

shloka_text: स्वागतं तव चेत्युक्तो वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। आसनं चास्य भगवान् वसिष्ठो व्यादिदेश ह।।1.52.2।।
transliteration: svāgataṃ tava cetyukto vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā| āsanaṃ cāsya bhagavān vasiṣṭho vyādideśa ha
translation: तव to you, स्वागतम् इति welcome (saying so), महात्मना by the magnanimous, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, उक्तश्च spoken also, भगवान् adorable, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, अस्य for him, आसनं च  seat also, व्यादिदेश ह ordered.
explanation: Adorable Vasishta received Viswamitra with words of welcome and ordered a seat for him.

shloka_text: उपविष्टाय च तदा विश्वामित्राय धीमते। यथान्यायं मुनिवर: फलमूलमुपाहरत्।।1.52.3।।
transliteration: upaviṣṭāya ca tadā viśvāmitrāya dhīmate| yathānyāyaṃ munivara: phalamūlamupāharat
translation: तदा then, मुनिवर: excellent  of ascetics, उपविष्टाय having seated, धीमते sagacious, विश्वामित्राय for Visvamitra, यथान्यायम् in accordance with tradition, फलमूलम् fruits and roots, उपाहरत् offered.
explanation: With the sagacious Viswamitra seated the great ascetic, duly offered him fruits and roots.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां वसिष्ठाद्राजसत्तम:। तपोग्निहोत्रशिष्येषु कुशलं पर्यपृच्छत।।1.52.4।। विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वनस्पतिगणे तथा । सर्वत्र कुशलं चाह वसिष्ठो राजसत्तमम्।।1.52.5।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu tāṃ pūjāṃ vasiṣṭhādrājasattama:| tapognihotraśiṣyeṣu kuśalaṃ paryapṛcchata viśvāmitro mahātejā vanaspatigaṇe tathā | sarvatra kuśalaṃ cāha vasiṣṭho rājasattamam
translation: राजसत्तम: foremost among kings, महातेजा: highly splendrous, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, वसिष्ठात् from Vasishta, ताम् पूजाम् that hospitality, प्रतिगृह्य having received, तपोग्निहोत्रशिष्येषु with regard to his austerities, his firesacrifices and his disciples, तथा and, वनस्पतिगणे trees (in his hermitage), कुशलम् welfare, पर्यपृच्छत enquired, वसिष्ठ: च Vasishta also, सर्वत्र in all of them, कुशलम् welfare, राजसत्तमम् for the best of kings, आह informed.
explanation: Foremost among kings, the brilliant Viswamitra, having received  hospitality from Vasishta, enquired about his welbeing his austerities, his firesacrifices, his disciples and trees (in his hermitage). Vasishta, too, informed him of the welfare of all.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां वसिष्ठाद्राजसत्तम:। तपोग्निहोत्रशिष्येषु कुशलं पर्यपृच्छत।।1.52.4।। विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वनस्पतिगणे तथा । सर्वत्र कुशलं चाह वसिष्ठो राजसत्तमम्।।1.52.5।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu tāṃ pūjāṃ vasiṣṭhādrājasattama:| tapognihotraśiṣyeṣu kuśalaṃ paryapṛcchata viśvāmitro mahātejā vanaspatigaṇe tathā | sarvatra kuśalaṃ cāha vasiṣṭho rājasattamam
translation: राजसत्तम: foremost among kings, महातेजा: highly splendrous, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, वसिष्ठात् from Vasishta, ताम् पूजाम् that hospitality, प्रतिगृह्य having received, तपोग्निहोत्रशिष्येषु with regard to his austerities, his firesacrifices and his disciples, तथा and, वनस्पतिगणे trees (in his hermitage), कुशलम् welfare, पर्यपृच्छत enquired, वसिष्ठ: च Vasishta also, सर्वत्र in all of them, कुशलम् welfare, राजसत्तमम् for the best of kings, आह informed.
explanation: Foremost among kings, the brilliant Viswamitra, having received  hospitality from Vasishta, enquired about his welbeing his austerities, his firesacrifices, his disciples and trees (in his hermitage). Vasishta, too, informed him of the welfare of all.

shloka_text: सुखोपविष्टं राजानं विश्वामित्रं महातपा:। पप्रच्छ जपतां श्रेष्ठो वसिष्ठो ब्रह्मणस्सुत:।।1.52.6।।
transliteration: sukhopaviṣṭaṃ rājānaṃ viśvāmitraṃ mahātapā:| papraccha japatāṃ śreṣṭho vasiṣṭho brahmaṇassuta:
translation: जपताम् among those performing religious prayers, श्रेष्ठ: greatest, महातपा: possessing great asceticism, ब्रह्मण: Brahma's, सुत: son, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, सुखोपविष्टम् sitting at ease, राजानम् king, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra,पप्रच्छ enquired.
explanation: Vasishta, son of Brahma, the greatest among those who recite prayers and possess rich asceticism enquired of king Viswamitra comfortably seated (before him):

shloka_text: कच्चित्ते कुशलं राजन् कच्चिद्धर्मेण रञ्जयन्। प्रजा: पालयसे वीर राजवृत्तेन धार्मिक।।1.52.7।।
transliteration: kaccitte kuśalaṃ rājan kacciddharmeṇa rañjayan| prajā: pālayase vīra rājavṛttena dhārmika
translation: राजन् O King, ते कुशलम् कच्चित् is it well with you?, धार्मिक O Righteous one, वीर O Heroic one, प्रजा: subjects, धर्मेण conforming to morality, रञ्जयन् delighting, राजवृत्तेन in accordance with the duties enjoined upon the king, पालयसे कच्चित् are you ruling?
explanation: "O King, is it all well with you? O righteous one O  heroic one are you ruling (your subjects) in accordance with the duties enjoined upon the king? Do you rule them in conformity with the code of moralit in order to make them happy.

shloka_text: कच्चित्ते सम्भृता भृत्या: कच्चित्तिष्ठन्ति शासने। कच्चित्ते विजितास्सर्वे रिपवो रिपुसूदन ।।1.52.8।।
transliteration: kaccitte sambhṛtā bhṛtyā: kaccittiṣṭhanti śāsane| kaccitte vijitāssarve ripavo ripusūdana
translation: कच्चित् whether, ते your, भृत्या: servants, सम्भृता: are well provided? शासने in your commands, तिष्ठन्ति abide?, रिपुसूदन O Destroyer of foes, ते your, रिपव: foes, सर्वे all, विजिता: have been conquered.
explanation: Are your servants provided well with their requirements? Do they abide by your command? O Destroyer of foes have all your enemies been conquered ?

shloka_text: कच्चिद्बलेषु कोशेषु मित्रेषु च परन्तप। कुशलं ते नरव्याघ्र पुत्रपौत्रे तवानघ ।।1.52.9।।
transliteration: kaccidbaleṣu kośeṣu mitreṣu ca parantapa| kuśalaṃ te naravyāghra putrapautre tavānagha
translation: कच्चित् whether, परन्तप O Tormentor of enemies, अनघ O Sinless one, नरव्याघ्र O Tiger (best) among men, बलेषु in your army, कोशेषु in your treasury, मित्रेषु in your friends, तव your, पुत्रपौत्रे sons and grandsons, ते कुशलम् is it well with you?
explanation: O Tormentor of enemies O Sinless one O Tiger among men is it all well with your army, treasury, friends, sons and grandsons?

shloka_text: सर्वत्र कुशलं राजा वसिष्ठं प्रत्युदाहरत्। विश्वामित्रो महातेजा वसिष्ठं विनयान्वित:।।1.52.10।।
transliteration: sarvatra kuśalaṃ rājā vasiṣṭhaṃ pratyudāharat| viśvāmitro mahātejā vasiṣṭhaṃ vinayānvita:
translation: महातेजा: highly lustrous, राजा king, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, वसिष्ठम् Vasishta, विनयान्वित: with great discipline, वसिष्ठम् प्रति addressing Vasishta, सर्वत्र all that, कुशलम् welfare, उदाहरत् conveyed.
explanation: Highly brilliant king Viswamitra, humbly informed Vasishta that all was well.

shloka_text: कृत्वोभौ सुचिरं कालं धर्मिष्ठौ ता: कथा: शुभा:। मुदा परमया युक्तौ प्रीयेतां तौ परस्परम्।।1.52.11।।
transliteration: kṛtvobhau suciraṃ kālaṃ dharmiṣṭhau tā: kathā: śubhā:| mudā paramayā yuktau prīyetāṃ tau parasparam
translation: धर्मिष्ठौ virtuous, तौ उभौ both of them, परमया with great, मुदा delight, युक्तौ abosrbed, सुचिरम् कालम् for a long time, शुभा: auspicious, ता: कथा: anecedotes relating to various matters, कृत्वा having made, परस्परम् each other, प्रीयेताम् were pleased.
explanation: Both the righteous personalities dwelt at length on various matters and interesting anecdotes with great delight and derived mutual pleasure.

shloka_text: ततो वसिष्ठो भगवान् कथाऽन्ते रघुनन्दन । विश्वामित्रमिदं वाक्यमुवाच प्रहसन्निव।।1.52.12।।
transliteration: tato vasiṣṭho bhagavān kathā'nte raghunandana | viśvāmitramidaṃ vākyamuvāca prahasanniva
translation: रघुनन्दन O Descendent of Raghu, तत: then, भगवान् venerable, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, कथाऽन्ते after the conversation had ended, प्रहसन्निव smiling as it were, विश्वामित्रम् addressing Viswamitra,  इदं this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच spoke.
explanation: O Descendent of Raghu at the end of the conversation, venerable Vasishta, smiling as it were said to Viswamitra

shloka_text: आतिथ्यं कर्तुमिच्छामि बलस्यास्य महाबल । तव चैवाप्रमेयस्य यथार्हं सम्प्रतीच्छ मे।।1.52.13।।
transliteration: ātithyaṃ kartumicchāmi balasyāsya mahābala | tava caivāprameyasya yathārhaṃ sampratīccha me
translation: महाबल O Highly powerful, अस्य of this, बलस्य for army, अप्रमेयस्य incomparable, तव चैव to you as well, यथार्हम् in an appropriate manner, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कर्तुम् to offer, इच्छामि I am desirous, मे from me, सम्प्रतीच्छ you may accept.
explanation: O Highy powerful Viswamitra I wish to offer appropriate hospitality to you and to your incomparable army. Be pleased to accept it.

shloka_text: सत्क्रियां तु भवानेतां प्रतीच्छतु मयोद्यताम्। राजा त्वमतिथिश्रेष्ठ: पूजनीय: प्रयत्नत:।।1.52.14।।
transliteration: satkriyāṃ tu bhavānetāṃ pratīcchatu mayodyatām| rājā tvamatithiśreṣṭha: pūjanīya: prayatnata:
translation: भवान् you, मया by me, उद्यताम् extended, सत्क्रियाम् honours, प्रतीच्छतु accept, राजा king, त्वम् you, प्रयत्नत: through every effort, पूजनीय: worthy of, अतिथिश्रेष्ठ: distinguished guest.
explanation: Please accept the honour I extend. Being a king, you are a distinguished guest. you deserve to be treated respectfully in all possible ways".

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन विश्वामित्रो महामति:। कृतमित्यब्रवीद्राजा प्रियवाक्येन मे त्वया।।1.52.15।।
transliteration: evamukto vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitro mahāmati:| kṛtamityabravīdrājā priyavākyena me tvayā
translation: वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: spoken, महामति: greatminded, राजा king, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, त्वया by you, प्रियवाक्येन with pleasing words, कृतम् इति  hospitality has been extended, मे to me, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: To these words of Vasishta, the great intellectual Viswamitra said, "you have spoken pleasing words. This in itself is hospitality for me".

shloka_text: फलमूलेन भगवन् विद्यते यत्तवाश्रमे। पाद्येनाचमनीयेन भगवद्दर्शनेन च।।1.52.16।। सर्वथा च महाप्राज्ञ पूजार्हेण सुपूजित:। गमिष्यामि नमस्तेऽस्तु मैत्रेणेक्षस्व चक्षुषा।।1.52.17।।
transliteration: phalamūlena bhagavan vidyate yattavāśrame| pādyenācamanīyena bhagavaddarśanena ca sarvathā ca mahāprājña pūjārheṇa supūjita:| gamiṣyāmi namaste'stu maitreṇekṣasva cakṣuṣā
translation: भगवन् O Worshipful one, यत् which, तव your, आश्रमे in the hermitage, विद्यते is available, फलमूलेन with fruits and roots, पाद्येन with the water for washing feet, आचमनीयेन च with water for sipping, भगवद्दर्शनेन by meeting  your revered self, पूजार्हेण worthy of homage, सर्वथा in all ways, सुपूजित: excellently honoured, महाप्राज्ञ O Profoundly wise one, गमिष्यामि   I shall go, ते नम: अस्तु reverence to you, मैत्रेण filled with friendship, चक्षुषा with eyes, ईक्षस्व look upon me.
explanation: "O Worshipful one O Profoundly wise one you are worthy of homage. You have excellently honoured me in all possible ways with whatever fruits and roots available in your hermitage, with water for washing feet and for sipping. You have permitted me darshan with your revered self. I shall leave (now). My regards Look upon me with eyes of friendship".

shloka_text: फलमूलेन भगवन् विद्यते यत्तवाश्रमे। पाद्येनाचमनीयेन भगवद्दर्शनेन च।।1.52.16।। सर्वथा च महाप्राज्ञ पूजार्हेण सुपूजित:। गमिष्यामि नमस्तेऽस्तु मैत्रेणेक्षस्व चक्षुषा।।1.52.17।।
transliteration: phalamūlena bhagavan vidyate yattavāśrame| pādyenācamanīyena bhagavaddarśanena ca sarvathā ca mahāprājña pūjārheṇa supūjita:| gamiṣyāmi namaste'stu maitreṇekṣasva cakṣuṣā
translation: भगवन् O Worshipful one, यत् which, तव your, आश्रमे in the hermitage, विद्यते is available, फलमूलेन with fruits and roots, पाद्येन with the water for washing feet, आचमनीयेन च with water for sipping, भगवद्दर्शनेन by meeting  your revered self, पूजार्हेण worthy of homage, सर्वथा in all ways, सुपूजित: excellently honoured, महाप्राज्ञ O Profoundly wise one, गमिष्यामि   I shall go, ते नम: अस्तु reverence to you, मैत्रेण filled with friendship, चक्षुषा with eyes, ईक्षस्व look upon me.
explanation: "O Worshipful one O Profoundly wise one you are worthy of homage. You have excellently honoured me in all possible ways with whatever fruits and roots available in your hermitage, with water for washing feet and for sipping. You have permitted me darshan with your revered self. I shall leave (now). My regards Look upon me with eyes of friendship".

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवन्तं राजानं वसिष्ठ:पुनरेव हि। न्यमन्त्रयत धर्मात्मा पुन:पुनरुदारधी:।।1.52.18।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvantaṃ rājānaṃ vasiṣṭha:punareva hi| nyamantrayata dharmātmā puna:punarudāradhī:
translation: एवम् in this way, ब्रुवन्तम् speaking, राजानम् king, धर्मात्मा righteous minded, उदारधी: sagacious, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, पुनरेव in return, पुन: पुन: again and again, न्यमन्त्रयत implored.
explanation: As the king was addressing thus the righteous and generous Vasishta, repeatedly requested him to accept his hospitality.

shloka_text: बाढमित्येव गाधेयो वसिष्ठं प्रत्युवाच ह। यथा प्रियं भगवतस्तथाऽस्तु मुनिपुङ्गव।।1.52.19।।
transliteration: bāḍhamityeva gādheyo vasiṣṭhaṃ pratyuvāca ha| yathā priyaṃ bhagavatastathā'stu munipuṅgava
translation: गाधेय: the son of Gadhi, वसिष्ठम् addressing Vashishta, मुनिपुङ्गव O Preeminent among sages, बाढम् be it so, भगवत: venerable, यथा in whatever way,  प्रियं (अभिमतम्) desire, तथा अस्तु let it be done in that way.
explanation: The son of Gadhi said to Vasishta, "O Preeminent among sages, be it so, O venerable one they will be done".

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो महातेजा वसिष्ठो जपतां वर:। आजुहाव तत: प्रीत: कल्माषीं धूतकल्मष:।।1.52.20।।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā vasiṣṭho japatāṃ vara:| ājuhāva tata: prīta: kalmāṣīṃ dhūtakalmaṣa:
translation: महातेजा: highly splendrous, जपतां वर: greatest among those who perform religious meditation, धूतकल्मष: free from sins, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, प्रीत: pleased, तत: thereafter, कल्माषीम् the speckled cow, आजुहाव called.
explanation: Vasishta who was highly brilliant the greatest among those who meditate (on Brahman) and free from sins was pleased. Thereafter he called the speckled cow (Kamadhenu):

shloka_text: एह्येहि शबले क्षिप्रं श्रृणु चापि वचो मम। सबलस्यास्य राजर्षे:कर्तुं व्यवसितोऽस्म्यहम्।।1.52.21।। भोजनेन महार्हेण सत्कारं संविधत्स्व मे।
transliteration: ehyehi śabale kṣipraṃ śrṛṇu cāpi vaco mama| sabalasyāsya rājarṣe:kartuṃ vyavasito'smyaham bhojanena mahārheṇa satkāraṃ saṃvidhatsva me|
translation: शबले O Sabala, क्षिप्रम् quickly, एहि (एहि) come on, मम my,  वच: words, श्रृणु च अपि also listen, अहम् I, महार्हेण in a befitting manner, भोजनेन with food, अस्य राजर्षे: for this royal saint, सबलस्य together with his army, सत्कारम् honour, कर्तुम् to extend, व्यवसित: अस्मि I have decided, मे to me, संविधत्स्व make arrangemets.
explanation: "O Sabala, come on quick Listen to my words. I have decided to honour this royal saint and his army with excellent food. Make necessary arrangemets.

shloka_text: यस्य यस्य यथाकामं षड्रसेष्वभिपूजितम्। तत्सर्वं कामधुक्क्षिप्रमभिवर्ष कृते मम।।1.52.22।।
transliteration: yasya yasya yathākāmaṃ ṣaḍraseṣvabhipūjitam| tatsarvaṃ kāmadhukkṣipramabhivarṣa kṛte mama
translation: कामधुक् O Kamadhenu, यस्य यस्य  to whom so ever, षड्रसेषु among six kinds of tastes, अभिपूजितम् which is desired, तत्सर्वम् all that, यथाकामम् in a manner desired, मम कृते for my sake, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अभिवर्ष rained (grant).
explanation: O Kamadhenu quickly entertain them for my sake with the food of six kinds of tastes (varieties of rich dishes) as desired by each.

shloka_text: रसेनान्नेन पानेन लेह्यचोष्येण संयुतम्। अन्नानां निचयं सर्वं सृजस्व शबले त्वर।।1.52.23।।
transliteration: rasenānnena pānena lehyacoṣyeṇa saṃyutam| annānāṃ nicayaṃ sarvaṃ sṛjasva śabale tvara
translation: शबले O Sabala, in the form of liquid, अन्नेन with solid food, रसेन पानेन with liquids  which can be drunk, लेह्यचोष्येण which can be licked and sipped, संयुतम् endowed with, सर्वम् all that, अन्नानां of the food items, निचयम् in collecion, सृजस्व create, त्वर hasten.
explanation: O Sabala create at once all food items consisting of liquids and solids for drinking, tasting and siping." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विपञ्चाशस्सर्ग:। Thus ends the fiftysecond sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता वसिष्ठेन शबला शत्रुसूदन। विदधे कामधुक्कामान्यस्य यस्य यथेप्सितम्।।1.53.1।।
transliteration: evamuktā vasiṣṭhena śabalā śatrusūdana| vidadhe kāmadhukkāmānyasya yasya yathepsitam
translation: शत्रुसूदन O Destroyer of foes, Rama, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, एवम् in this manner, उक्ता spoken, कामधुक् wishfulfilling (cow), शबला Sabala, यस्य यस्य to whomsoever, यथा in whatever manner, ईप्सितम् desired, कामान् desires, विदधे arranged (fulfilled).
explanation: "O Destroyer of foes (Rama)" addressed thus by Vasishta the wishfulfilling Sabala satisfied each one's  desires.
comments: Vasishta entertains Viswamitra and his army--Viswamitra asks Vasishta for Kamadhenu-- Vasishta declines.

shloka_text: इक्षून्मधूं स्तथा लाजान्मैरेयांश्च वरासनान्। पानानि च महार्हाणि भक्ष्यांश्चोच्चावचां स्तथा।।1.53.2।।
transliteration: ikṣūnmadhūṃ stathā lājānmaireyāṃśca varāsanān| pānāni ca mahārhāṇi bhakṣyāṃścoccāvacāṃ stathā
translation: इक्षून् sugarcane, मधून् honey, तथा and, लाजान् fried grain, (वरासवान् quality liquor,)         वरासनान् in good containers, मैरेयान् invigorating liquors, महार्हाणि excellent, पानानि च syrups, उच्चावचान् with different kinds of, भक्ष्यांश्च of food.
explanation: Sugarcane, honey and fried grain, invigorating liquors in good containers, excellent drinks and varieties of food (were served).

shloka_text: उष्णाढ्यस्योदनस्यात्र राशय: पर्वतोपमा:। मृष्टान्नानि च सूपाश्च दधिकुल्यास्तथैव च।।1.53.3।। नानास्वादुरसानां च षाडबानां तथैव च। भाजनानि सुपूर्णानि गौडानि च सहस्रश:।।1.53.4।।
transliteration: uṣṇāḍhyasyodanasyātra rāśaya: parvatopamā:| mṛṣṭānnāni ca sūpāśca dadhikulyāstathaiva ca nānāsvādurasānāṃ ca ṣāḍabānāṃ tathaiva ca| bhājanāni supūrṇāni gauḍāni ca sahasraśa:
translation: अत्र here, उष्णाढ्यस्य hot, ओदनस्य of rice, पर्वतोपमा: resembling mountains, राशय: heaps, मृष्टान्नानि च savoury (delicious) foods, सूपाश्च pulses, तथैव and, दधिकुल्या: rivers of milkcurds, नानास्वादुरसानाम् of various kinds of tastes, षाडबानाम् edibles with all six  tastes, सुपूर्णानि completely filled, भाजनानि containers, गौडानि च preparations made of Jaggery, सहस्रश: in thousands, (distributed).
explanation: Heaps of hot rice as high as mountains, savoury food, condiments and on abundance of curd, various kinds of soups, containers in their thousands completely filled with edibles with all six tastes and preparations made of jaggery (were distributed).

shloka_text: उष्णाढ्यस्योदनस्यात्र राशय: पर्वतोपमा:। मृष्टान्नानि च सूपाश्च दधिकुल्यास्तथैव च।।1.53.3।। नानास्वादुरसानां च षाडबानां तथैव च। भाजनानि सुपूर्णानि गौडानि च सहस्रश:।।1.53.4।।
transliteration: uṣṇāḍhyasyodanasyātra rāśaya: parvatopamā:| mṛṣṭānnāni ca sūpāśca dadhikulyāstathaiva ca nānāsvādurasānāṃ ca ṣāḍabānāṃ tathaiva ca| bhājanāni supūrṇāni gauḍāni ca sahasraśa:
translation: अत्र here, उष्णाढ्यस्य hot, ओदनस्य of rice, पर्वतोपमा: resembling mountains, राशय: heaps, मृष्टान्नानि च savoury (delicious) foods, सूपाश्च pulses, तथैव and, दधिकुल्या: rivers of milkcurds, नानास्वादुरसानाम् of various kinds of tastes, षाडबानाम् edibles with all six  tastes, सुपूर्णानि completely filled, भाजनानि containers, गौडानि च preparations made of Jaggery, सहस्रश: in thousands, (distributed).
explanation: Heaps of hot rice as high as mountains, savoury food, condiments and on abundance of curd, various kinds of soups, containers in their thousands completely filled with edibles with all six tastes and preparations made of jaggery (were distributed).

shloka_text: सर्वमासीत्सुसन्तुष्ठं हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतम्। विश्वामित्रबलं राम वसिष्ठेनाभितर्पितम्।।1.53.5।।
transliteration: sarvamāsītsusantuṣṭhaṃ hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāyutam| viśvāmitrabalaṃ rāma vasiṣṭhenābhitarpitam
translation: राम O Rama, विश्वामित्रबलम् army of Visvamitra, सर्वम् (एव) whole of it, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, अभितर्पितम् having been satisfied, सुसन्तुष्ठम् highly pleased, हृष्टपुष्टजनायुतं आसीत् was filled with wellfed and rejoiced people.
explanation: "O Rama, Vasistha entertained everybody in Viswamitra's army to their full satisfaction. They were all wellfed and happy.

shloka_text: विश्वामित्रोऽपि राजर्षिर्हृष्ट: पुष्टस्तदाभवत् । सान्त:पुरवरो राजा सब्राह्मणपुरोहित:।।1.53.6।।
transliteration: viśvāmitro'pi rājarṣirhṛṣṭa: puṣṭastadābhavat | sānta:puravaro rājā sabrāhmaṇapurohita:
translation: तदा then, सान्त:पुरवर: with excellent from female apartments, सब्राह्मणपुरोहित: together with priests and brahmins, राजर्षि: royal sage, विश्वामित्र: राजापि  king Viswamitra also, हृष्ट: delighted, पुष्ट: अभवत् became satisfied.
explanation: King Viswamitra along with ladies, priests and brahmins including the royal sage were fully satisfied and delighted.

shloka_text: सामात्यो मन्त्रिसहितस्सभृत्य: पूजितस्तदा। युक्त: परमहर्षेण वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.53.7।।
transliteration: sāmātyo mantrisahitassabhṛtya: pūjitastadā| yukta: paramaharṣeṇa vasiṣṭhamidamabravīt
translation: तदा then, पूजित: honoured, सामात्य: with counsellors, मन्त्रिसहित: together with ministers,  सभृत्य: with attendants, परमहर्षेण with great delight, युक्त: filled with, वसिष्ठम् addressing Vasishta, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having received the hospitality along with his counsellors, ministers and attendants, Viswamitra, filled with great delight, said to Vasishta":

shloka_text: पूजितोऽहं त्वया ब्रह्मन् पूजार्हेण सुसत्कृत:। श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि वाक्यं वाक्यविशारद।।1.53.8।।
transliteration: pūjito'haṃ tvayā brahman pūjārheṇa susatkṛta:| śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi vākyaṃ vākyaviśārada
translation: ब्रह्मन् O Brahman, पूजार्हेण by (one) worthy of being worshipped, त्वया by you, अहम् I, पूजित: was received with warmth and respect, सुसत्कृत: well honoured, वाक्यविशारद O One conversant with speech, वाक्यम् these words, अभिधास्यामि I shall tell you, श्रूयताम् let it be heard.
explanation: "O Brahman you are worthy of worship. I was received with reverence and wellentertained by you. O Sage conversant with speech listen.

shloka_text: गवां शतसहस्रेण दीयतां शबला मम। रत्नं हि भगवन्नेतद्रत्नहारी च प्रार्थिव:।।1.53.9।। तस्मान्मे शबलां देहि ममैषा धर्मतो द्विज।
transliteration: gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa dīyatāṃ śabalā mama| ratnaṃ hi bhagavannetadratnahārī ca prārthiva: tasmānme śabalāṃ dehi mamaiṣā dharmato dvija|
translation: गवाम् of cows, शतसहस्रेण one hundred thousands, शबला Sabala, मम to me, दीयताम् let it be given, भगवन्,O Respectable one, एतत् this, रत्नं हि indeed gem, पार्थिव: king, रत्नहारी acquirer of jewels, द्विज O Brahmin, तस्मात् for that reason, शबलाम् Sabala, मे to me, देहि give, एषा this, धर्मत: by right, मम is mine.
explanation: "I shall give you a hundred thousand cows in exchange for Sabala. O Respectable one this cow is a gem. A king (along) has a right on jewels, O Brahmin, for that reason, Sabala rightfully belongs to me. Therefore, give this cow".

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान्वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तम:। विश्वामित्रेण धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्।।1.53.10।।
transliteration: evamuktastu bhagavānvasiṣṭho munisattama:| viśvāmitreṇa dharmātmā pratyuvāca mahīpatim
translation: विश्वामित्रेण by Visvamitra, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: addressed, भगवान् the revered one, धर्मात्मा virtuous, मुनिसत्तम: eminent among ascetics, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, महीपतिम् addressing the king, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: Addressed the by Viswamitra venerable and righteous Vasishta who was of the earth  ascetic replied:

shloka_text: नाहं शतसहस्रेण नापि कोटिशतैर्गवाम्। राजन् दास्यामि शबलां राशिभी रजतस्य च ।।1.53.11।।
transliteration: nāhaṃ śatasahasreṇa nāpi koṭiśatairgavām| rājan dāsyāmi śabalāṃ rāśibhī rajatasya ca
translation: राजन् O King, अहम् I, गवाम् of cows, शतसहस्रेण in  hundreds of thousands, शबलाम् Sabala, न दास्यामि shall not give, कोटि शतै: अपि by hundreds of crores also, न shall not, रजतस्य of silver, राशिभि: च heaps of (shall not give).
explanation: "O King I shall not exchange Sabala for a hundred thousand for even or a hundred crore cows or heaps of silver.

shloka_text: न परित्यागमर्हेयं मत्सकाशादरिन्दम । शाश्वती शबला मह्यं कीर्तिरात्मवतो यथा।।1.53.12।।
transliteration: na parityāgamarheyaṃ matsakāśādarindama | śāśvatī śabalā mahyaṃ kīrtirātmavato yathā
translation: अरिन्दम O Tormentor of enemies, Visvamitra, इयम् this cow, मत्सकाशात् from my proximity, परित्यागम् separation, न अर्हा not proper, आत्मवत: for righteous man, कीर्तिः यथा like fame, शबला Sabala, मह्यम् for me, शाश्वती is permanent.
explanation: O Suppressor of enemies Viswamitra it is not proper to separate this cow from me. The relationship between Sabala and me is permanent like the relationship between a  righteous man and his fame.

shloka_text: अस्यां हव्यं च कव्यं च प्राणयात्रा तथैव  च। आयत्तमग्निहोत्रं च बलिर्होमस्तथैव च।।1.53.13।।
transliteration: asyāṃ havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ ca prāṇayātrā tathaiva  ca| āyattamagnihotraṃ ca balirhomastathaiva ca
translation: हव्यं च Havyam (oblations to be given to gods), कव्यं च Kavyam ( to be given to pitris), तथैव च and, प्राणयात्रा carrying out necessities of life, अग्निहोत्रं च maintenance of the sacred fire and offering oblations, बलि: offerings to spirits of all created beings, तथैव च and also, होम: offerings, अस्याम् in this cow, आयत्तम् are dependant.
explanation: For havyam (oblations to gods) and kavyam (oblations to ancestors), for fulfilling the necessities of life, maintenance of the sacred fire and offering oblations to all spirits of created beings, and for offerings made to the Firegod I depend on this cow.

shloka_text: स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ विद्याश्च विविधा स्तथा। आयत्तमत्र राजर्षे सर्वमेतन्न संशय:।।1.53.14।।
transliteration: svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau vidyāśca vividhā stathā| āyattamatra rājarṣe sarvametanna saṃśaya:
translation: राजर्षे O Royal saint, स्वाहाकारवषट्कारौ Swaha and Vashat, तथा and, विविधा: various branches of, विद्या: learning, एतत् सर्वम् all these things, अत्र in this cow, आयत्तम् are dependant, संशय: न no doubt.
explanation: O Royal saint swaha and vashat and various branches of learning are all dependent on this cow. No doubt about it.

shloka_text: सर्वस्वमेतत्सत्येन मम तुष्टिकरी सदा। कारणैर्बहुभी राजन्न दास्ये शबलां तव।।1.53.15।।
transliteration: sarvasvametatsatyena mama tuṣṭikarī sadā| kāraṇairbahubhī rājanna dāsye śabalāṃ tava
translation: एतत् this one, सत्येन truly, मम my, सर्वस्वम् whole possession, सदा always, तुष्टिकरी causes contentment, राजन् O King,  बहुभि: by various, कारणै: reasons, शबलाम् Sabala, तव to you, न दास्ये will not give.
explanation: This one is truly my whole possession, it always gives me contentment. O King for various reasons, I will not give Sabala to you".

shloka_text: वसिष्ठेनैवमुक्तस्तु विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीत्तत:। संरब्धतरमत्यर्थं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारद:।।1.53.16।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhenaivamuktastu viśvāmitro'bravīttata:| saṃrabdhataramatyarthaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśārada:
translation: वाक्यविशारद: (the king) skilled in conversation, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, वसिष्ठेन through Vasishta, एवम् in this manner, उक्त: spoken, अत्यर्थम् extreme, संरब्धतरम् more excited, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: To there words of Vasishta, Viswamitra who is skilful in conversation reacted with extreme excitement:

shloka_text: हैरण्यकक्ष्याग्रैवेयान् सुवर्णाङ्कुशभूषितान्। ददामि कुञ्जरांस्तेषां सहस्राणि चतुर्दश।।1.53.17।।
transliteration: hairaṇyakakṣyāgraiveyān suvarṇāṅkuśabhūṣitān| dadāmi kuñjarāṃsteṣāṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa
translation: हैरण्यकक्ष्याग्रैवेयान् with gold trappings around the neck and girth (of an elephant), सुवर्णाङ्कुशभूषितान् adorned with (elephant) goads made of gold, कुञ्जरान् elephants, तेषाम् such elephants, चतुर्दशसहस्राणि fourteen thousands, ददामि I shall give.
explanation: "I shall give fourteen thousand elephants with gold trappings around the neck and girth,  and with goads made of gold.

shloka_text: हैरण्यानां रथानां च श्वेताश्वानां चतुर्युजाम्। ददामि ते शतान्यष्टौ किङ्किणीकविभूषितान्।।1.53.18।।
transliteration: hairaṇyānāṃ rathānāṃ ca śvetāśvānāṃ caturyujām| dadāmi te śatānyaṣṭau kiṅkiṇīkavibhūṣitān
translation: श्वेताश्वानाम of white horses, चतुर्युजाम् capable of being yoked with four (horses), हैरण्यानाम् made of gold, रथानाम् chariots, किङ्किणीकविभूषितान् decorated with small tinkling bells, अष्टौ शतान् eight hundred, ते to you, ददामि shall give.
explanation: I shall give you eight hundred chariots made of gold and decorated with small tinkling bells, each chariot yoked with four white horses.

shloka_text: हयानां देशजातानां कुलजानां महौजसाम्। सहस्रमेकं दश च ददामि तव सुव्रत।।1.53.19।।
transliteration: hayānāṃ deśajātānāṃ kulajānāṃ mahaujasām| sahasramekaṃ daśa ca dadāmi tava suvrata
translation: सुव्रत O Maharshi of auspicious vows (religious practices ), देशजातानाम् born in good country, कुलजानाम् born of noble (good) breeds, महौजसाम् mighty, हयानाम् horses, एकं दश च eleven, सहस्रम् thousands, तव to you, ददामि shall give.
explanation: O Maharshi of auspicious vows I shall give you eleven thousand mighty horses of good breed born in good countries.

shloka_text: नानावर्णविभक्तानां वयस्स्थानां तथैव च । ददाम्येकां गवां कोटिं शबला दीयतां मम।।1.53.20।।
transliteration: nānāvarṇavibhaktānāṃ vayassthānāṃ tathaiva ca | dadāmyekāṃ gavāṃ koṭiṃ śabalā dīyatāṃ mama
translation: नानावर्णविभक्तानाम् distinctly separated by colours, तथैव and, वयस्स्थानाम् of youthful, गवाम् cows, एकाम् one, कोटिम् crore, ददामि I shall give, मम for me, शबला Sabala, दीयताम् be given.
explanation: I shall give one crore young cows of various colours. Give me Sabala.

shloka_text: यावदिच्छसि रत्नं वा हिरण्यं वा द्विजोत्तम। तावद्ददामि तत्सर्वं शबला दीयतां मम।।1.53.21।।
transliteration: yāvadicchasi ratnaṃ vā hiraṇyaṃ vā dvijottama| tāvaddadāmi tatsarvaṃ śabalā dīyatāṃ mama
translation: द्विजोत्तम O Best of brahmins, रत्नं वा either jewels, हिरण्यं वा or gold, यावत् as much, इच्छसि you desire, तत्सर्वं all that, तावत् that much, ददामि shall give, शबला Sabala, मम to me, दीयताम् be given.
explanation: O Best of brahmins I shall offer you jewels or gold as much as you desire. I shall give you everything. Give this Sabala to me".

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान् विश्वामित्रेण धीमता। न दास्यामीति शबलां प्राह राजन् कथञ्चन।।1.53.22।।
transliteration: evamuktastu bhagavān viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā| na dāsyāmīti śabalāṃ prāha rājan kathañcana
translation: धीमता by the sagacious, विश्वामित्रेण by Visvamitra, एवम् in this way, उक्त: spoken, भगवान् the adorable one, राजन् O King, कथञ्चन by any means, शबलाम् Sabala, न दास्यामि I shall not give, इति thus, प्राह replied.
explanation: To these words of sagacious Viswamitra the adorable Vasishta replied: "O King I shall not give Sabala."

shloka_text: एतदेव हि मे रत्नमेतदेव हि मे धनम्। एतदेव हि सर्वस्वमेतदेव हि जीवितम्।।1.53.23।।
transliteration: etadeva hi me ratnametadeva hi me dhanam| etadeva hi sarvasvametadeva hi jīvitam
translation: एतदेव this is verily, मे my, रत्नं हि jewel indeed, एतदेव this is verily, मे my, धनम् wealth, एतदेव हि this is verily, सर्वस्वं allinall, एतदेव this is verily, जीवितम् my very life.
explanation: "This is verily my jewel, my wealth my very life. This is allinall for me.

shloka_text: दर्शश्च पूर्णमासश्च यज्ञाश्चैवाप्तदक्षिणा:। एतदेव हि मे राजन् विविधाश्च क्रियास्तथा।।1.53.24।।
transliteration: darśaśca pūrṇamāsaśca yajñāścaivāptadakṣiṇā:| etadeva hi me rājan vividhāśca kriyāstathā
translation: राजन् O King, मे for me, दर्शश्च Darsa sacrifice, पूर्णमासश्च Purnamasa sacrifice, आप्तदक्षिणा: with appropriate gifts, यज्ञाश्च sacrifices, तथा and, विविधा: various, क्रियाश्च rites, एतदेव हि verily is this(cow).
explanation: O King verily this Sabala is useful for my darsa and purnamasa sacrifices, for appropriate gifts and various rites.

shloka_text: अदोमूला: क्रियास्सर्वा मम राजन्न संशय:। बहुना किं प्रलापेन न दास्ये कामदोहिनीम्।।1.53.25।।
transliteration: adomūlā: kriyāssarvā mama rājanna saṃśaya:| bahunā kiṃ pralāpena na dāsye kāmadohinīm
translation: राजन् O King, मम my, सर्वा: all, क्रिया: actions, अदोमूला: are rooted here (in her), संशय: न no doubt, बहुना with many, प्रलापेन useless words, किम् what is the use, कामदोहिनीम्  desire fulfilling cow, न दास्ये I shall not give.
explanation: O King this (cow) is undoubtedly the source of all my actions. Why these useless words? I will never give this wishfulfilling cow". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रिपञ्चाशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fiftythird sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: कामधेनुं वसिष्ठोऽपि यदा न त्यज्यते मुनि:। तदास्य शबलां राम विश्वामित्रोऽन्वकर्षत।।1.54.1।।
transliteration: kāmadhenuṃ vasiṣṭho'pi yadā na tyajyate muni:| tadāsya śabalāṃ rāma viśvāmitro'nvakarṣata
translation: राम O Rama, वसिष्ठ: मुनि: अपि sage Vasishta also, कामधेनुम् wishfulfilling cow, यदा when, न त्यज्यते did not leave, तदा then, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, शबलां Sabala, अन्वकर्षत pulled.
explanation: "O Rama when sage Vasishta did not consent to part with the wishfulfilling cow, Viswamitra dragged Sabala by force.
comments: Viswamitra attempts to take Kamadhenu by force--Kamadhenu creates hordes of warriors -- the army of Viswamitra gets killed.

shloka_text: नीयमाना तु शबला राम राज्ञा महात्मना। दु:खिता चिन्तयामास रुदन्ती शोककर्शिता।।1.54.2।।
transliteration: nīyamānā tu śabalā rāma rājñā mahātmanā| du:khitā cintayāmāsa rudantī śokakarśitā
translation: राम O Rama, महात्मना by the magnanimous, राज्ञा (by) king, नीयमाना being carried away, शबला Sabala, दु:खिता distressed, शोककर्शिता emaciated by sorrow, रुदन्ती weeping, चिन्तयामास reflected.
explanation: O Rama when she was being taken away by the powerful king the distressed Sabala thus reflected choked with sorrow":

shloka_text: परित्यक्ता वसिष्ठेन किमहं सुमहात्मना। याहं राजभटैर्दीना ह्रियेय भृशदु:खिता।।1.54.3।।
transliteration: parityaktā vasiṣṭhena kimahaṃ sumahātmanā| yāhaṃ rājabhaṭairdīnā hriyeya bhṛśadu:khitā
translation: दीना evoking pity, भृश दु:खिता greatly distressed, या अहम् I, राजभटै: by the attendants of king, ह्रियेय carried away, अहम् I, महात्मना magnanimous, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, परित्यक्ता  किम् have been abndoned?.
explanation: "I am being carried away by attendants of the king in this greatly distressed and pitiable condition. Have I been abandoned by the magnanimous Vasishta?

shloka_text: किं मयाऽपकृतं तस्य महर्षेर्भावितात्मन:। यन्मामनागसं भक्तामिष्टां त्यजति धार्मिक:।।1.54.4।।
transliteration: kiṃ mayā'pakṛtaṃ tasya maharṣerbhāvitātmana:| yanmāmanāgasaṃ bhaktāmiṣṭāṃ tyajati dhārmika:
translation: धार्मिक: pious, अनागसम् innocent, भक्ताम् devoted, इष्टाम् beloved, माम् me, यत् त्यजति is forsaking, भावितात्मन: having purified soul, तस्य महर्षे: for that maharshi, मया by me, किम् what, अपकृतम् harm has been done?
explanation: What harm have I done to the pious maharshi, a compassionate soul? Why does he  forsake me, his auspicious one, despite my innocence and devotion"?

shloka_text: इति सा चिन्तयित्वा तु विनिश्श्वस्य पुन:पुन:। निर्धूय तांस्तदा भृत्यान् शतशश्शत्रुसूदन । जगामानिलवेगेन पादमूलं महात्मन:।।1.54.5।।
transliteration: iti sā cintayitvā tu viniśśvasya puna:puna:| nirdhūya tāṃstadā bhṛtyān śataśaśśatrusūdana | jagāmānilavegena pādamūlaṃ mahātmana:
translation: शत्रुसूदन O Destroyer of enemies, Rama, सा she, इति thus, चिन्तयित्वा thinking, पुन: पुन: frequently, विनि:श्वस्य sighing, तदा then, तान् those, शतश: in hundreds, भृत्यान् attendants, निर्धूय shaking, अनिलवेगेन with the speed of wind, महात्मन: illustrious Vasishta's, पादमूलम् towards his feet, जगाम went.
explanation: "O Destroyer of enemies thus thinking and repeatedly sighing, that cow shook off those attendants who were in hundreds and ran towards the feet of the illustrious Vasishta with the speed of the wind.

shloka_text: शबला सा रुदन्ती च क्रोशन्ती चेदमब्रवीत्। वसिष्ठस्याग्रतस्स्थित्वा मेघदुन्दुभिराविणी।।1.54.6।।
transliteration: śabalā sā rudantī ca krośantī cedamabravīt| vasiṣṭhasyāgratassthitvā meghadundubhirāviṇī
translation: सा शबला that Sabala, रुदन्ती च weeping, क्रोशन्ती च moaning, वसिष्ठस्य Vasishta's, अग्रत: in front of, स्थित्वा standing, मेघदुन्दुभिराविणी roaring like the thunder and kettle drum, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Lowing and moaning, standing before Vasishta, roaring like thunder and of kettledrum, Sabala said:

shloka_text: भगवन् किं परित्यक्ता त्वयाऽहं ब्रह्मणस्सुत। यस्माद्राजभृता मां हि नयन्ते त्वत्सकाशत:।।1.54.7।।
transliteration: bhagavan kiṃ parityaktā tvayā'haṃ brahmaṇassuta| yasmādrājabhṛtā māṃ hi nayante tvatsakāśata:
translation: ब्रह्मण: Brahma's, सुत son, भगवन् O Venerable one, अहम् I, त्वया by you, परित्यक्ता किम् abandoned?, यस्मात् for what reason, राजभृता: servants of king, त्वत्सकाशत: from your presence, माम् me, नयन्ते हि carrying me.
explanation: "O Brahma's son O Venerable one you have abandoned me? For what reason the servants of the king are taking me away from you"?

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिरिदं वचनमब्रवीत्। शोकसन्तप्तहृदयां स्वसारमिव दु:खिताम्।।1.54.8।।
transliteration: evamuktastu brahmarṣiridaṃ vacanamabravīt| śokasantaptahṛdayāṃ svasāramiva du:khitām
translation: एवम् in this manner, उक्त: having been spoken by (Sabala), ब्रह्मर्षि: Brahmarshi, शोकसन्तप्तहृदयां (addressing Sabala whose) heart is afflicted with sorrow, दु:खिताम् distressed, स्वसारमिव like to a sister, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Addressed thus, Bramharshi said to Sabala, like to  a sister whose heart is afflicted with sorrow:

shloka_text: न त्वां त्यजामि शबले नापि मेऽपकृतं त्वया। एष त्वां नयते राजा बलोन्मत्तो महाबल:।।1.54.9।।
transliteration: na tvāṃ tyajāmi śabale nāpi me'pakṛtaṃ tvayā| eṣa tvāṃ nayate rājā balonmatto mahābala:
translation: शबले O Sabala, त्वाम् you, न त्यजामि not forsaking, त्वया by you, न अपकृतमपि no harm has been done, महाबल: highly powerful, एष: राजा king, मत्त: from me, बलात् forcibly, त्वाम् you, नयते is carrying.
explanation: "O Sabala I am not forsaking you. You have done me no harm. This highly powerful king is forcibly carrying you away from me.

shloka_text: न हि तुल्यं बलं मह्यं राजा त्वद्य विशेषत:। बली राजा क्षत्रियश्च पृथिव्या: पतिरेव च।।1.54.10।।
transliteration: na hi tulyaṃ balaṃ mahyaṃ rājā tvadya viśeṣata:| balī rājā kṣatriyaśca pṛthivyā: patireva ca
translation: मह्यम् for me, बलम् power, तुल्यम् equal to him, न हि not, अद्य today, विशेषत: especially, राजा तु is king, राजा being king, बली powerful, क्षत्रियश्च also warrior, पृथिव्या: for the earth, पतिरेव च is also the lord.
explanation: I am no match for his strength, especially he is a king. Being king, he is a warrior, powerful and lord of the earth.

shloka_text: इयमक्षौहिणी पूर्णा सवाजिरथसङ्कुला। हस्तिध्वजसमाकीर्णा तेनासौ बलवत्तर:।।1.54.11।।
transliteration: iyamakṣauhiṇī pūrṇā savājirathasaṅkulā| hastidhvajasamākīrṇā tenāsau balavattara:
translation: सवाजिरथसङ्कुला crowded with horses yoked to chariots, हस्तिध्वजसमाकीर्णा surrounded by elephants and banners, इयम् this, अक्षौहिणी Akshauhini, पूर्णा is filled, तेन for that reason, असौ this (king ), बलवत्तर: is mighty.
explanation: He has an entire akshauhini composed of horses, chariots, elephants and banners. Hence he is stonger".

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता वसिष्ठेन प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत्। वचनं वचनज्ञा सा ब्रह्मर्षिममितप्रभम्।।1.54.12।।
transliteration: evamuktā vasiṣṭhena pratyuvāca vinītavat| vacanaṃ vacanajñā sā brahmarṣimamitaprabham
translation: वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, एवम् in this way, उक्ता spoken, वचनज्ञा knowledgeable in words, सा that cow, अमितप्रभम् immeasurable power, ब्रह्मर्षिम् addressing brahmarshi, वचनम् words, विनीतवत् with humility, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: To these words of  brahmarshi Vasishta armed with immeasurable power, Sabala, who knew the use of words, replied with humility:

shloka_text: न बलं क्षत्रियस्याहुर्ब्राह्मणो बलवत्तर:। ब्रह्मन् ब्रह्मबलं दिव्यं क्षत्रात्तु बलवत्तरम्।।1.54.13।।
transliteration: na balaṃ kṣatriyasyāhurbrāhmaṇo balavattara:| brahman brahmabalaṃ divyaṃ kṣatrāttu balavattaram
translation: क्षत्रियस्य the strength of a Kshatriya, बलम् strength, न आहु: do not speak (in high    esteem), ब्राह्मण: Brahmin, बलवत्तर: possesses greater strength, ब्रह्मन् O Best of Brahmins, क्षत्रात् greater than the strength of a Kshatriya, ब्रह्मबलम् the strength of a Brahmin, दिव्यम् is divine, बलवत्तरम् greater.
explanation: "O Best of brahmins it is held that the strength of a kshatriya is no greater than a brahmin's. A brahmin possesses great strength his strength is divine. It is greater than that of a kshatriya.

shloka_text: अप्रमेयबलं तुभ्यं न त्वया बलवत्तर:। विश्वामित्रो महावीर्यस्तेज स्तव दुरासदम्।।1.54.14।।
transliteration: aprameyabalaṃ tubhyaṃ na tvayā balavattara:| viśvāmitro mahāvīryasteja stava durāsadam
translation: तुभ्यम् for you, अप्रमेयबलम् immeasurable power, महावीर्य: highly valourous, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, त्वया more than you, बलवत्तर: न is not great in strength, तव your, तेज: splendour, दुरासदम् cannot be reached.
explanation: Your power is immeasurable. Even though highly valiant, Viswamitra is not greater than you in strength. Your power is unequalled.

shloka_text: नियुङ्क्ष्व मां महाभाग त्वद्ब्रह्मबलसम्भृताम्। तस्य दर्पबलं यत्तन्नाशयामि दुरात्मन:।।1.54.15।।
transliteration: niyuṅkṣva māṃ mahābhāga tvadbrahmabalasambhṛtām| tasya darpabalaṃ yattannāśayāmi durātmana:
translation: महाभाग O Highly fortunate one, त्वद्ब्रह्मबलसम्भृताम् possessed of your brahminic power, माम् me, नियुङ्क्ष्व command, दुरात्मन: of the wickedminded, तस्य his, यत् which, दर्पबलम् insolent power, तत् that one, नाशयामि I will destroy.
explanation: O Highly fortunate one I am possessed of your brahminic power. Command me. I will destroy the insolent and power of that wickedminded one.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तस्तु तया राम वसिष्ठ स्सुमहायशा:। सृजस्वेति तदोवाच बलं परबलार्दनम्।।1.54.16।।
transliteration: ityuktastu tayā rāma vasiṣṭha ssumahāyaśā:| sṛjasveti tadovāca balaṃ parabalārdanam
translation: राम O Rama, तया by her, इति thus, उक्त: spoken, महायशा: highly glorious, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, तदा then, परबलार्दनम् tormenting the power of enemies, बलम् army, सृजस्व create, इति thus, उवाच said.
explanation: O Rama to this, glorious Vasishta replied: "Create an army capable of crushing the enemy power.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुरभिस्साऽसृजत्तदा।।1.54.17।। तस्या हुम्भारवोत्सृष्टा: पप्लवाश्शतशो नृप। नाशयन्ति बलं सर्वं विश्वामित्रस्य पश्यत:।।1.54.18।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā surabhissā'sṛjattadā tasyā humbhāravotsṛṣṭā: paplavāśśataśo nṛpa| nāśayanti balaṃ sarvaṃ viśvāmitrasya paśyata:
translation: तस्य his, तत् वचनम् this word, श्रुत्वा having heard, सा that, सुरभि: Kamadhenu, तदा then, असृजत् created (army), नृप O Rama, तस्या: that Kamadhenu's, हुम्भारवोत्सृष्टा: from the sound of 'Humbha' uttered by her, पप्लवा: paplavas, शतश: in hundreds, विश्वामित्रस्य  Viswamitra, पश्यत: while seeing, सर्वम् entire, बलम् army, नाशयन्ति destroyed.
explanation: Hearing his words Kamadhenu created an army. O Rama her lowing brought into being Paplavas in hundreds who destroyed the entire army of Viswamitra, while he looked on helplessly.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुरभिस्साऽसृजत्तदा।।1.54.17।। तस्या हुम्भारवोत्सृष्टा: पप्लवाश्शतशो नृप। नाशयन्ति बलं सर्वं विश्वामित्रस्य पश्यत:।।1.54.18।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā surabhissā'sṛjattadā tasyā humbhāravotsṛṣṭā: paplavāśśataśo nṛpa| nāśayanti balaṃ sarvaṃ viśvāmitrasya paśyata:
translation: तस्य his, तत् वचनम् this word, श्रुत्वा having heard, सा that, सुरभि: Kamadhenu, तदा then, असृजत् created (army), नृप O Rama, तस्या: that Kamadhenu's, हुम्भारवोत्सृष्टा: from the sound of 'Humbha' uttered by her, पप्लवा: paplavas, शतश: in hundreds, विश्वामित्रस्य  Viswamitra, पश्यत: while seeing, सर्वम् entire, बलम् army, नाशयन्ति destroyed.
explanation: Hearing his words Kamadhenu created an army. O Rama her lowing brought into being Paplavas in hundreds who destroyed the entire army of Viswamitra, while he looked on helplessly.

shloka_text: बलं भग्नं ततो दृष्ट्वा रथेनाक्रम्य कौशिक:। स राजा परमक्रुद्धो रोषविस्फारितेक्षण:। पप्लवान्नाशयामास शस्त्रैरुच्चावचैरपि।।1.54.19।।
transliteration: balaṃ bhagnaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā rathenākramya kauśika:| sa rājā paramakruddho roṣavisphāritekṣaṇa:| paplavānnāśayāmāsa śastrairuccāvacairapi
translation: तत: thereafter, स: राजा that king, कौशिक: Visvamitra, भग्नम् destroyed, बलम् army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमक्रुद्ध: exceedingly enraged, रोषविस्फारितेक्षण: his eyes expanded with anger, रथेन with chariot, आक्रम्य having occupied, उच्चावचै: अपि which were also of various kinds, शस्त्रै: with weapons, पप्लवान् Paplavas, नाशयामास destroyed.
explanation: Thereafter the king (Viswamitra), having seen his army thus routed, flew into a fury. Wideeyed with anger, he sat in his chariot and destoyed the Paplavas with various kinds of weapons.

shloka_text: विश्वामित्रार्दितान् दृष्ट्वा पप्लवाञ्छतशस्तदा। भूय एवासृजत्कोपाच्छकान् यवनमिश्रितान्।।1.54.20।।
transliteration: viśvāmitrārditān dṛṣṭvā paplavāñchataśastadā| bhūya evāsṛjatkopācchakān yavanamiśritān
translation: विश्वामित्रार्दितान् afflicted by Visvamitra, शतश: hundreds of, पप्लवान् Papalavas, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तदा then, कोपात् out of anger, भूय एव again, यवनमिश्रितान् mixed with Yavanas, शकान् Sakas, असृजत् created.
explanation: Having seen hundreds of Paplavas crushed by Viswamitra, once again she created out of anger. Sakas mixed with Yavanas.

shloka_text: तैरासीत् संवृता भूमि श्शकैर्यवनमिश्रितै:। प्रभावद्भिर्महावीर्यैर्हेमकिञ्जल्कसन्निभै:।।1.54.21।।
transliteration: tairāsīt saṃvṛtā bhūmi śśakairyavanamiśritai:| prabhāvadbhirmahāvīryairhemakiñjalkasannibhai:
translation: प्रभावद्भि: by those possessing splendour, महावीर्यै: supreme valour, हेमकिञ्चल्कसन्निभै: resembling golden filaments, यवनमिश्रितै: mixed with Yavanas, शकै: Sakas, भूमि: earth, संवृता आसीत् covered with.
explanation: Sakas mixed with Yavanas, resembling golden filaments possessing brilliance and supreme bravery, covered the earth.

shloka_text: दीर्घासिपट्टिशधरैःमवर्णाम्बरावृतै:। निर्दग्धं तद्बलं सर्वं प्रदीप्तैरिव पावकै:।।1.54.22।।
transliteration: dīrghāsipaṭṭiśadharaiḥmavarṇāmbarāvṛtai:| nirdagdhaṃ tadbalaṃ sarvaṃ pradīptairiva pāvakai:
translation: दीर्घासिपट्टिशधरै: armed with long swords and lances, हेमवर्णाम्बरावृतै: by those clad in yellow apparel (by Sakas and Yavanass), प्रदीप्तै: flaming, पावकैरिव like fire, तत् that, सर्वम् entire, बलम् army, निर्दग्धम् was consumed.
explanation: Sakas and Yavanas, armed with swords and lances, clad in yellow apparel, looking  like flaming fire destroyed the entire army.

shloka_text: ततोऽस्त्राणि महातेजा विश्वामित्रो मुमोच ह। तैस्तैर्यवनकाम्भोजा: पप्लवाश्चाकुलीकृता:।।1.54.23।।
transliteration: tato'strāṇi mahātejā viśvāmitro mumoca ha| taistairyavanakāmbhojā: paplavāścākulīkṛtā:
translation: तत: thereafter, महातेजा: most brilliant, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, अस्त्राणि weapons, मुमोच ह released, तैस्तै: with those weapons, यवनकाम्भोजा: Yavana, Kambhojas, पप्लवाश्च Paplavas, अकुलीकृता: were tormented.
explanation: Thereafter, most brilliant Viswamitra released weapons. With these weapons, the Yavanas, Kambhojas and Paplavas were scattered". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुष्पञ्चाशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fiftyfourth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्तानाकुलान् दृष्ट्वा विश्वामित्रास्त्रमोहितान्। वसिष्ठश्चोदयामास कामधुक् सृज योगत:।।1.55.1।।
transliteration: tatastānākulān dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitrāstramohitān| vasiṣṭhaścodayāmāsa kāmadhuk sṛja yogata:
translation: तत: thereafter, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, विश्वामित्रास्त्रमोहितान् stupefied by weapons of Visvamitra, आकुलान् agitated, तान् them, दृष्ट्वा having seen, कामधुक् O Kamadhenu, योगत: through yogic power, सृज create, चोदयामास thus he directed.
explanation: Thereafter, Vasishta having seen the forces tortured and overpowered by the weapons of Viswamitra said, "O Kamadhenu create additional forces through your yogic power."
comments: Viswamitra's sons and soldiers get destroyed in the clash--Viswamitra performs austerities and acquires divine weapons by pleasing Lord Siva.

shloka_text: तस्याहुम्भारवाज्जाता: काम्भोजा रविसन्निभा:। ऊधसस्त्वथ सञ्जाता: पप्लवाश्शस्त्रपाणय:।।1.55.2।। योनिदेशाच्च यवनाश्शकृद्देशाच्छका स्तथा। रोमकूपेषु च म्लेच्छा हारीतास्सकिरातका:।।1.55.3।।
transliteration: tasyāhumbhāravājjātā: kāmbhojā ravisannibhā:| ūdhasastvatha sañjātā: paplavāśśastrapāṇaya: yonideśācca yavanāśśakṛddeśācchakā stathā| romakūpeṣu ca mlecchā hārītāssakirātakā:
translation: तस्या: her, हुम्भारवात् from the sound of 'Humba", रविसन्निभा: equal to Sun (in brightness), काम्भोजा: Kambhojas, जाता: were born, अथ and, ऊधस: from udder, शस्त्रपाणय: with  weapons in their hands, पप्लवा: Paplavas, सञ्जाता: were born, योनिदेशात् च from womb, यवना: Yavanas, तथा and, शकृद्देशात् from anus, शका: Sakas, रोमकूपेषु from roots of hair , म्लेच्छा: mlecchas, सकिराता: alomg with kiratas, हारीता: Haritas, were born.
explanation: "From her lowing Kambhojas bright like the Sun, from the udder Paplavas, weapons in  hand, from the vagina Yavanas, from the anus Sakas, from the roots of the hair Mlecchas along with Kiratas and Haritas were born.

shloka_text: तस्याहुम्भारवाज्जाता: काम्भोजा रविसन्निभा:। ऊधसस्त्वथ सञ्जाता: पप्लवाश्शस्त्रपाणय:।।1.55.2।। योनिदेशाच्च यवनाश्शकृद्देशाच्छका स्तथा। रोमकूपेषु च म्लेच्छा हारीतास्सकिरातका:।।1.55.3।।
transliteration: tasyāhumbhāravājjātā: kāmbhojā ravisannibhā:| ūdhasastvatha sañjātā: paplavāśśastrapāṇaya: yonideśācca yavanāśśakṛddeśācchakā stathā| romakūpeṣu ca mlecchā hārītāssakirātakā:
translation: तस्या: her, हुम्भारवात् from the sound of 'Humba", रविसन्निभा: equal to Sun (in brightness), काम्भोजा: Kambhojas, जाता: were born, अथ and, ऊधस: from udder, शस्त्रपाणय: with  weapons in their hands, पप्लवा: Paplavas, सञ्जाता: were born, योनिदेशात् च from womb, यवना: Yavanas, तथा and, शकृद्देशात् from anus, शका: Sakas, रोमकूपेषु from roots of hair , म्लेच्छा: mlecchas, सकिराता: alomg with kiratas, हारीता: Haritas, were born.
explanation: "From her lowing Kambhojas bright like the Sun, from the udder Paplavas, weapons in  hand, from the vagina Yavanas, from the anus Sakas, from the roots of the hair Mlecchas along with Kiratas and Haritas were born.

shloka_text: तैस्तैर्निषूदितं सर्वं विश्वामित्रस्य तत्क्षणात्। सपदातिगजं साश्वं सरथं रघुनन्दन।।1.55.4।।
transliteration: taistairniṣūditaṃ sarvaṃ viśvāmitrasya tatkṣaṇāt| sapadātigajaṃ sāśvaṃ sarathaṃ raghunandana
translation: रघुनन्दन O Descendent of Raghu's, तैस्तै: those and those, तत्क्षणात् instantly, विश्वामित्रस्य Visvamitra's, सपदातिगजम् with infantry and elephants, साश्वम् with horses, सरथम् with chariots, सर्वम् entire(army), निषूदितम् has been destroyed.
explanation: O descendant of the Raghus, Viswamitra's army consisting of infantry, elephants, horses, chariots has been entirely destroyed by them instantly.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा निषूदितं सैन्यं वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। विश्वामित्रसुतानां च शतं नानाविधायुधम्।।1.55.5।। अभ्यधावत्सुसङ्कृद्धं वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्। हुङ्कारेणैव तान् सर्वान् ददाह भगवान् ऋषि:।।1.55.6।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā niṣūditaṃ sainyaṃ vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā| viśvāmitrasutānāṃ ca śataṃ nānāvidhāyudham abhyadhāvatsusaṅkṛddhaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ japatāṃ varam| huṅkāreṇaiva tān sarvān dadāha bhagavān ṛṣi:
translation: महात्मना by the magnanimous, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, निषूदितम् destroyed, सैन्यम् army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, विश्वामित्रसुतानाम् sons of Visvamitra, शतम् one hundred, नानाविधायुधम् armed with various kinds of weapons, सुसङ्कृद्धम् extremely furious, जपतां वरम् best among ascetics practising Japa, वसिष्ठम् towards Vasishta, अभ्यधावत् rushed towards him, भगवान् adorable, ऋषि: sage Vasishta, तान् सर्वान् all of them, हुंकारेणैव with 'Humkara" alone, ददाह burnt.
explanation: Having seen the army destroyed by the powerful Vasishta, one hundred sons of Viswamitra became extremely furious and armed with various kinds of weapons rushed towards Vasishta, the best among ascetics. Adorable sage Vasishta, reduced them to ashes with just a 'humkara' (the loud 'hum' sound produced with the mouth)

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा निषूदितं सैन्यं वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। विश्वामित्रसुतानां च शतं नानाविधायुधम्।।1.55.5।। अभ्यधावत्सुसङ्कृद्धं वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्। हुङ्कारेणैव तान् सर्वान् ददाह भगवान् ऋषि:।।1.55.6।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā niṣūditaṃ sainyaṃ vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā| viśvāmitrasutānāṃ ca śataṃ nānāvidhāyudham abhyadhāvatsusaṅkṛddhaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ japatāṃ varam| huṅkāreṇaiva tān sarvān dadāha bhagavān ṛṣi:
translation: महात्मना by the magnanimous, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, निषूदितम् destroyed, सैन्यम् army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, विश्वामित्रसुतानाम् sons of Visvamitra, शतम् one hundred, नानाविधायुधम् armed with various kinds of weapons, सुसङ्कृद्धम् extremely furious, जपतां वरम् best among ascetics practising Japa, वसिष्ठम् towards Vasishta, अभ्यधावत् rushed towards him, भगवान् adorable, ऋषि: sage Vasishta, तान् सर्वान् all of them, हुंकारेणैव with 'Humkara" alone, ददाह burnt.
explanation: Having seen the army destroyed by the powerful Vasishta, one hundred sons of Viswamitra became extremely furious and armed with various kinds of weapons rushed towards Vasishta, the best among ascetics. Adorable sage Vasishta, reduced them to ashes with just a 'humkara' (the loud 'hum' sound produced with the mouth)

shloka_text: ते साश्वरथपादाता वसिष्ठेन महात्मना। भस्मीकृता मुहूर्तेन विश्वामित्रसुता स्तदा।।1.55.7।।
transliteration: te sāśvarathapādātā vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā| bhasmīkṛtā muhūrtena viśvāmitrasutā stadā
translation: तदा then, साश्वरथपादाता: together with horses, chariots and footsoldiers, ते विश्वामित्रसुता: those sons of Visvamitra, महात्मना by the magnanimous, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, भस्मीकृता: were reduced to ashes.
explanation: Then one hundred sons of Viswamitra together with their horses, chariots and foot soldiers were reduced to ashes in a moment by the powerful Vasishta.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा विनाशितान् पुत्रान् बलं च सुमहायशा:। सव्रीडश्चिन्तयाऽविष्टो विश्वामित्रोऽभवत्तदा।।1.55.8।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā vināśitān putrān balaṃ ca sumahāyaśā:| savrīḍaścintayā'viṣṭo viśvāmitro'bhavattadā
translation: तदा then, सुमहायशा: possessing high fame, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, विनाशितान् destroyed, पुत्रान् sons, बलं च army, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सव्रीड: was filled with shame, चिन्तया in thought, आविष्ट: अभवत् pondered over.
explanation: Seeing his sons and army destroyed the illustrious Viswamitra was filled with shame and anxiety.

shloka_text: समुद्र इव निर्वेगो भग्नदंष्ट्र इवोरग:। उपरक्त इवादित्यस्सद्यो निष्प्रभतां गत:।।1.55.9।।
transliteration: samudra iva nirvego bhagnadaṃṣṭra ivoraga:| uparakta ivādityassadyo niṣprabhatāṃ gata:
translation: निर्वेग: without speed (waves), समुद्र: इव like ocean, भग्नदंष्ट्र: bereft of fangs, उरग: इव like snake, उपरक्त: eclipsed by Rahu, आदित्य: इव like Sun, सद्य: suddenly, निष्प्रभताम् devoid of his effulgence, गत: obtained.
explanation: Like the ocean without waves or the snake bereft of fangs or the Sun eclipsed by Rahu, suddenly (Viswamitra) looked cheerless and dull.

shloka_text: हतपुत्रबलो दीनो लूनपक्ष इव द्विज:। हतदर्पो हतोत्साहो निर्वेदं समपद्यत।।1.55.10।।
transliteration: hataputrabalo dīno lūnapakṣa iva dvija:| hatadarpo hatotsāho nirvedaṃ samapadyata
translation: हतपुत्रबल: with sons and army having been killed, लूनपक्ष: with wings cut off, द्विज: इव  like the bird, दीन: wretched, हतदर्प: with vanished pride, हतोत्साह: with shattered confidence, निर्वेदम् despondency, समपद्यत obtained.
explanation: Having lost his sons and the army, like a bird with wings clipped, wretched, with pride vanished and confidence shattered Viswamitra fell into despondency.

shloka_text: स पुत्रमेकं राज्याय पालयेति नियुज्य च। पृथिवीं क्षत्रधर्मेण वनमेवान्वपद्यत।।1.55.11।।
transliteration: sa putramekaṃ rājyāya pālayeti niyujya ca| pṛthivīṃ kṣatradharmeṇa vanamevānvapadyata
translation: स: he, पृथिवीम् the earth, क्षत्रधर्मेण in accordance with the tradition of Kshatriya, पालय  rule, इति thus, एकम् one, पुत्रम् son, राज्याय for the kingdom, नियुज्य having appointed, वनमेव forest, अन्वपद्यत reached.
explanation: Viswamitra, having entrusted one of his remaining sons to rule the kingdom in accordance with the kshatriya tradition reached the forest.

shloka_text: स गत्वा हिमवत्पार्श्वं किन्नरोरगसेवितम्। महादेवप्रसादार्थं तपस्तेपे महातपा:।।1.55.12।।
transliteration: sa gatvā himavatpārśvaṃ kinnaroragasevitam| mahādevaprasādārthaṃ tapastepe mahātapā:
translation: महातपा: mighty ascetic, स: he, किन्नरोरगसेवितम् inhabited by kinnaras and urgas, हिमवत्पार्श्वं on the slopes of Himavat mountain, गत्वा having gone, महादेवप्रसादार्थम् with a view to propitiate lord Mahadeva, तप: austerities, तेपे performed.
explanation: Mighty ascetic Viswamitra, reached the slopes of the Himavat mountain inhabited by kinnaras and uragas (serpents) and performed  austerities in order to propitiate lord Mahadeva.

shloka_text: केनचित्त्वथ कालेन देवेशो वृषभध्वज:। दर्शयामास वरदो विश्वामित्रं महाबलम्।।1.55.13।।
transliteration: kenacittvatha kālena deveśo vṛṣabhadhvaja:| darśayāmāsa varado viśvāmitraṃ mahābalam
translation: अथ thereafter, केनचित्कालेन after some time, देवेश: lord of devatas, वृषभध्वज: with bull as his symbol (banner), वरद: bestower of boons, महाबलम् possessing great strength, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, दर्शयामास showed himself.
explanation: After some time, lord of the gods, bestower of boons, Maheswara with the symbol of the bull on the banner  appeared before mighty Viswamitra.

shloka_text: किमर्थं तप्यसे राजन् ब्रूहि यत्ते विवक्षितम्। वरदोऽस्मि वरो यस्ते काङ्क्षितस्सोऽभिधीयताम्।।1.55.14।।
transliteration: kimarthaṃ tapyase rājan brūhi yatte vivakṣitam| varado'smi varo yaste kāṅkṣitasso'bhidhīyatām
translation: राजन् O King, किमर्थं what for, तप्यसे are you performing penance? ते to you, यत् which, विवक्षितम् intended to be conveyed, (तत् that one), ब्रूहि tell, वरद: अस्मि I am bestower of boons, य: वर: which boon, ते by you, काङ्क्षित: desired, स: that, अभिधीयताम् let it be spoken.
explanation: O King what are you performing the penance for? Tell me what you want? I am bestower of boons. Speak out you desire (said Lord Siva).

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन विश्वामित्रो महातपा:। प्रणिपत्य महादेवमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.55.15।।
transliteration: evamuktastu devena viśvāmitro mahātapā:| praṇipatya mahādevamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: देवेन by that god, एवम् thus, उक्त: spoken, महातपा: performer of mighty austerities, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, महादेवम् to Mahadeva, प्रणिपत्य having prostrated,  इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard this from the god, Viswamitra who performed the great austerities prostrated before Mahadeva and said these words.

shloka_text: यदि तुष्टो महादेव धनुर्वेदो ममानघ। साङ्गोपाङ्गोपनिषदस्सरहस्य: प्रदीयताम्।।1.55.16।।
transliteration: yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva dhanurvedo mamānagha| sāṅgopāṅgopaniṣadassarahasya: pradīyatām
translation: अनघ O Irreproachable one, महादेव Mahadeva, तुष्ट: यदि if pleased, साङ्गोपाङ्गोपनिषद: with angas (branches), upangas (subdivisions), upanishads, सरहस्य: with secrets, धनुर्वेद: Dhanurveda, the science of archery, मम to me, प्रदीयताम् let it be given.
explanation: O Irreproachable one O Mahadeva if you are pleased with me, make me an expert in Dhanurveda, the science of archery with all it secrets, angas (branches), upangas (subdivisions) and Upanishads.

shloka_text: यानि देवेषु चास्त्राणि दानवेषु महर्षिषु। गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षस्सु प्रतिभान्तु ममानघ।।1.55.17।।
transliteration: yāni deveṣu cāstrāṇi dānaveṣu maharṣiṣu| gandharvayakṣarakṣassu pratibhāntu mamānagha
translation: अनघ O Irreproachable one, देवेषु in devatas, दानवेषु in danavas, महर्षिषु in maharshis, गन्धर्वयक्षरक्षस्सु In gandharvas, yakshas, rakashas, यानि अस्त्राणि whatever weapons are known, मम प्रतिभान्तु let them be present in my mind (let them flash in my mind).
explanation: O Irreproachable one whatever weapons are known to devatas, danavas, maharshis, gandharvas, yakshas, rakshasas, be revealed to me.

shloka_text: तव प्रसादाद्भवतु देवदेवममेप्सितम्। एवमस्त्विति देवेशो वाक्यमुक्त्वा गतस्तदा।।1.55.18।।
transliteration: tava prasādādbhavatu devadevamamepsitam| evamastviti deveśo vākyamuktvā gatastadā
translation: देवदेव O Lord of gods, तव by your, प्रसादात् favour, मम my, ईप्सितम् desire, भवतु be fulfilled, एवम् अस्तु "Be it so", इति thus, देवेश: lord of devatas, Mahadeva, (वाक्यं )उक्त्वा having spoken, तदा then, गत: returned (to bis abode).
explanation: O Lord of the gods by your favour let my desire be fulfilled. Lord Mahadeva having said: 'Be it so' vanished.

shloka_text: प्राप्य चास्त्राणि राजर्षिर्विश्वामित्रो महाबल:। दर्पेण महता युक्तो दर्पपूर्णोऽभवत्तदा।।1.55.19।।
transliteration: prāpya cāstrāṇi rājarṣirviśvāmitro mahābala:| darpeṇa mahatā yukto darpapūrṇo'bhavattadā
translation: महाबल: endowed with supreme power, राजर्षि: rajarshi, महता by great, दर्पेण pride, युक्त: endowed with, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, तदा then, अस्त्राणि weapons, प्राप्य having obtained, दर्पपूर्ण: अभवत् filled with insolence.
explanation: Rajarshi Viswamitra endowed with supreme power became very haughty. Having obtained the weapons, his insolence was greatly accentuated.

shloka_text: विवर्धमानो वीर्येण समुद्र इव पर्वणि। हतमेव तदा मेने वसिष्ठमृषिसत्तमम्।।1.55.20।।
transliteration: vivardhamāno vīryeṇa samudra iva parvaṇi| hatameva tadā mene vasiṣṭhamṛṣisattamam
translation: पर्वणि on the day of the full Moon and new Moon, समुद्र इव like sea, वीर्येण with energy, विवर्धमान: growing, ऋषिसत्तमम् foremost of ascetics, वसिष्ठम् Vasishta, तदा then, हतमेव slain only, मेने thought over.
explanation: Like the sea during the full moon, with his increased power (blessed with the invincible strength of the weapons) Viswamitra thought the foremost of ascetics Vasishta was (already) slain. (It shows the height of the king's ignorance and arrogance).

shloka_text: ततो गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं मुमोचास्त्राणि पार्थिव:। यैस्तत्तपोवनं सर्वं निर्दग्धं चास्त्रतेजसा।।1.55.21।।
transliteration: tato gatvā''śramapadaṃ mumocāstrāṇi pārthiva:| yaistattapovanaṃ sarvaṃ nirdagdhaṃ cāstratejasā
translation: तत: there after, पार्थिव: king, आश्रमपदम् towards hermitage (of Vasishta), गत्वा having gone, अस्त्राणि weapons, मुमोच released, यै: by their energy, तत् सर्वम् all that, तपोवनम् forest of ascetics (for carrying austerities ), अस्त्रतेजसा by the power of those weapons, निर्दग्धम् was burnt.
explanation: Thereafter king Viswamitra having proceeded towards the hermitage (of Vasishta) and released the weapons by the energy of which the entire forest of the ascetics was burnt down.

shloka_text: उदीर्यमाणमस्त्रं तद्विश्वामित्रस्य धीमत:। दृष्ट्वा विप्रद्रुतास्सर्वे मुनयश्शतशो दिश:।।1.55.22।।
transliteration: udīryamāṇamastraṃ tadviśvāmitrasya dhīmata:| dṛṣṭvā vipradrutāssarve munayaśśataśo diśa:
translation: धीमत: by the sagacious, विश्वामित्रस्य Visvamitra's, तत् that, उदीर्यमाणम् being roused, अस्त्रम् weapons, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शतश: in hundreds, मुनय: saints, सर्वे all, दिश: in all directions, विप्रद्रुता: fled.
explanation: On seeing the weapons discharged by the intelligent Viswamitra saints in hundreds fled in all directions.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठस्य च ये शिष्यास्तथैव मृगपक्षिण:। विद्रवन्ति भयाद्भीता नानादिग्भ्यस्सहस्रश:।।1.55.23।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasya ca ye śiṣyāstathaiva mṛgapakṣiṇa:| vidravanti bhayādbhītā nānādigbhyassahasraśa:
translation: वसिष्ठस्य Vasishta's, ये those, शिष्या: disciples, तथैव as well as, मृगपक्षिण: animals and birds, भयात् for the reason of fear, भीता: terrified, सहस्रश: in thousands, नानादिग्भ्य: in all directions, विद्रवन्ति fled.
explanation: The disciples of Vasishta as well as animals and birds got terrified by the fear and fled in their thousands in all directions.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठस्याश्रमपदं शून्यमासीन्महात्मन:। मुहूर्तमिव निश्शब्दमासीदिरिणसन्निभम्।।1.55.24।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhasyāśramapadaṃ śūnyamāsīnmahātmana:| muhūrtamiva niśśabdamāsīdiriṇasannibham
translation: महात्मन: of the magnanimous, वसिष्ठस्य Vasishta's, आश्रमपदम् hermitage, शून्यम् आसीत् has become deserted, मुहूर्तमिव in an instant as though, इरिणसन्निभम् like barren field, निश्शब्दम्  आसीत् became silent.
explanation: The greatsoul Vasishta's hermitage became deserted and silent in an instant like a barren field.

shloka_text: वदतो वै वसिष्ठस्य मा भैरिति मुहुर्मुहु:। नाशयाम्यद्य गाधेयं नीहारमिव भास्कर:।।1.55.25।।
transliteration: vadato vai vasiṣṭhasya mā bhairiti muhurmuhu:| nāśayāmyadya gādheyaṃ nīhāramiva bhāskara:
translation: भास्कर: Sun, नीहारमिव like mist, गाधेयम् son of Gadhi, अद्य now, नाशयामि I will destroy, माभै: fear not, इति thus, वसिष्ठस्य Vasishta, मुहुर्मुहु: repeatedly, वदत: while saying (they fled), not withstanding his assurance.
explanation: Even while Vasistha was repeatedly  assuring  the saints saying "Do not fear, I will now destroy Viswamitra, son of Gadhi just as the Sun dispels the morning mist (they fled)".

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा वसिष्ठो जपतां वर:। विश्वामित्रं तदा वाक्यं सरोषमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.55.26।।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahātejā vasiṣṭho japatāṃ vara:| viśvāmitraṃ tadā vākyaṃ saroṣamidamabravīt
translation: महातेजा: highly lustrous, जपतां वर: foremost among those who utter prayers, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तदा then, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, सरोषम् with anger, इदम् this, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: The infuriated Vasishta who was highly brilliant, foremost among those who meditate said to Viswamitra:

shloka_text: आश्रमं चिरसम्वृद्धं यद्विनाशितवानसि। दुराचारोऽसि तन्मूढ तस्मात्त्वं न भविष्यसि।।1.55.27।।
transliteration: āśramaṃ cirasamvṛddhaṃ yadvināśitavānasi| durācāro'si tanmūḍha tasmāttvaṃ na bhaviṣyasi
translation: मूढ O Fool, चिरसम्वृद्धम् developed over long time, आश्रमम् hermitage, यत् for what reason, विनाशितवान् असि you have destroyed, तत् for that reason, दुराचार: असि you are illbehaved, तस्मात् for that reason, त्वम् you, न भविष्यसि will not live.
explanation: "O Fool this hermitage has been developed over a long time. Why did you destroy it?  On account of your wickedness you will not live long."

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा परमक्रुद्धो दण्डमुद्यम्य सत्वर:। विधूममिव कालाग्निं यमदण्डमिवापरम्।।1.55.28।।
transliteration: ityuktvā paramakruddho daṇḍamudyamya satvara:| vidhūmamiva kālāgniṃ yamadaṇḍamivāparam
translation: इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सत्वर: speedily, परमक्रुद्ध: exceedingly furious, विधूमम्  smokeless, कालाग्निमिव like fire at the destruction of the worlds, अपरम् another, यमदण्डमिव like the staff of death, दण्डम् staff, उद्यम्य lifting up.
explanation: Exceedingly furious Vasishta quickly lifted up his staff which looked like the staff of Yama (the od of death), like smokeless fire at the time of destruction of the worlds. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे पञ्चपञ्चाशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the fiftyfifth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन विश्वामित्रो महाबल:। आग्नेयमस्त्रमुत्क्षिप्य तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्।।1.56.1।।
transliteration: evamukto vasiṣṭhena viśvāmitro mahābala:| āgneyamastramutkṣipya tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt
translation: महाबल: mighty, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, एवम् thus, उक्त: having been addressed, आग्नेयम् अस्त्रम् Agneya astra, उत्क्षिप्य after lifting, तिष्ठ तिष्ठ इति 'stay, stay' so, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Thus said Vasishta. Mighty Viswamitra lifted up agneya astra (shaft of fire) and discharging it said, 'stay, stay'.
comments: Vasishta destroys the weapons employed by Viswamitra with his Brahmadanda -- Viswamitra undertakes austerities to acquire brahminhood.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मदण्डं समुत्क्षिप्य कालदण्डमिवाऽपरम्। वसिष्ठो भगवान् क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।1.56.2।।
transliteration: brahmadaṇḍaṃ samutkṣipya kāladaṇḍamivā'param| vasiṣṭho bhagavān krodhādidaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: भगवान् revered, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, परम् another, कालदण्डमिव looking like unto the rod of death, ब्रह्मदण्डम् rod of Brahma, समुत्क्षिप्य having lifted, क्रोधात् in anger, इदम् this, वचनम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Venerable Vasishta, in fury lifted the Brahmadanda which was like another rod of death. And spoke these words:

shloka_text: क्षत्रबन्धो स्थितोस्म्येष यद्बलं तद्विदर्शय। नाशयाम्यद्य ते दर्पं शस्त्रस्य तव गाधिज।।1.56.3।।
transliteration: kṣatrabandho sthitosmyeṣa yadbalaṃ tadvidarśaya| nāśayāmyadya te darpaṃ śastrasya tava gādhija
translation: क्षत्रबन्धो O Wicked kshatriya, एष: स्थित: अस्मि I am standing here, यत् बलम् which strength (you have), तत् that one, विदर्शय show it, गाधिज O Son of Gadhi, अद्य now, ते your, दर्पम् pride, तव your, शस्त्रस्य arms', नाशयामि I will destroy.
explanation: "O wicked kshatriya O son of Gadhi here I stand. Show me your strength and the pride of your arms. I will destroy them now.

shloka_text: क्व च ते क्षत्रियबलं क्व च ब्रह्मबलं महत्। पश्य ब्रह्मबलं दिव्यं मम क्षत्रियपांसन।।1.56.4।।
transliteration: kva ca te kṣatriyabalaṃ kva ca brahmabalaṃ mahat| paśya brahmabalaṃ divyaṃ mama kṣatriyapāṃsana
translation: क्षत्रियपांसन O Meanest among kshatriyas, ते your, क्षत्रियबलम् energy of kshatriya, क्व where, महत् great, ब्रह्मबलम् energy of Brahma, क्व where, मम my, दिव्यम् divine, ब्रह्मबलम् energy of Brahma, पश्य behold.
explanation: O mean kshatriya where does your energy of a kshatriya stand in comparison with the great energy of Brahma? Behold my Brahmabala (Brahman's energy)".

shloka_text: तस्यास्त्रं गाधिपुत्रस्य घोरमाग्नेयमुद्यतम्। ब्रह्मदण्डेन तच्छान्तमग्नेर्वेग इवाम्भसा।।1.56.5।।
transliteration: tasyāstraṃ gādhiputrasya ghoramāgneyamudyatam| brahmadaṇḍena tacchāntamagnervega ivāmbhasā
translation: तस्य गाधिपुत्रस्य that Gadhi's son's, उद्यतम् discharged, तत् that, आग्नेयम् Agneya, अस्त्रम् weapon, अम्भसा by water, अग्ने: fire's, वेग: इव like speed, ब्रह्मदण्डेन by the rod of Brahma, शान्तम् calmed.
explanation: The Brahmadanda (released by Vasishta) put down the dreadful agneya astra released by Gadhi's son just like the force of fire is extinguished by water.

shloka_text: वारुणं चैव रौद्रं च ऐन्द्रं पाशुपतं तथा। ऐषीकं चापि चिक्षेप कुपितो गाधिनन्दन:।।1.56.6।।
transliteration: vāruṇaṃ caiva raudraṃ ca aindraṃ pāśupataṃ tathā| aiṣīkaṃ cāpi cikṣepa kupito gādhinandana:
translation: कुपित: incensed, गाधिनन्दन: son of Gadhi, वारुणं चैव Varuna weapon, रौद्रं च Raudra, ऐन्द्रं च Aindra, तथा and, पाशुपतम् Pasupata, ऐषीकं चापि Aishika, चिक्षेप employed or discharged.
explanation: The incensed son of Gadhi employed varuna, raudra, aindra, pasupata and aishika  weapons.

shloka_text: मानवं मोहनं चैव गान्धर्वं स्वापनं तथा। जृम्भणं मादनं चैव संतापनविलापने।।1.56.7।। शोषणं दारणं चैव वज्रमस्त्रं सुदुर्जयम्। ब्रह्मपाशं कालपाशं वारुणं पाशमेव च।।1.56.8।। पैनाकास्त्रं च दयितं शुष्कार्द्रे अशनी उभे। दण्डास्त्रमथ पैशाचं क्रौञ्चमस्त्रं तथैव च।।1.56.9।। धर्मचक्रं कालचक्रं विष्णुचक्रं तथैव च। वायव्यं मथनं चैव अस्त्रं हयशिरस्तथा।।1.56.10।। शक्तिद्वयं च चिक्षेप कङ्कालं मुसलं तथा। 560 वैद्याधरं महास्त्रं च कालास्त्रमथ दारुणम्।।1.56.11।। त्रिशूलमस्त्रं घोरं च कापालमथ कङ्कणम्। एतान्यस्त्राणि चिक्षेप सर्वाणि रघुनन्दन।।1.56.12।। वसिष्ठे जपतां श्रेष्ठे तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।
transliteration: mānavaṃ mohanaṃ caiva gāndharvaṃ svāpanaṃ tathā| jṛmbhaṇaṃ mādanaṃ caiva saṃtāpanavilāpane śoṣaṇaṃ dāraṇaṃ caiva vajramastraṃ sudurjayam| brahmapāśaṃ kālapāśaṃ vāruṇaṃ pāśameva ca painākāstraṃ ca dayitaṃ śuṣkārdre aśanī ubhe| daṇḍāstramatha paiśācaṃ krauñcamastraṃ tathaiva ca dharmacakraṃ kālacakraṃ viṣṇucakraṃ tathaiva ca| vāyavyaṃ mathanaṃ caiva astraṃ hayaśirastathā śaktidvayaṃ ca cikṣepa kaṅkālaṃ musalaṃ tathā| 560 vaidyādharaṃ mahāstraṃ ca kālāstramatha dāruṇam triśūlamastraṃ ghoraṃ ca kāpālamatha kaṅkaṇam| etānyastrāṇi cikṣepa sarvāṇi raghunandana vasiṣṭhe japatāṃ śreṣṭhe tadadbhutamivābhavat|
translation: रघुनन्दन O Joy of Raghus, Rama, मानवम् manava, मोहनं चैव mohana, गान्धर्वम् gandharva, तथा and, स्वापनम् swapana (inducing sleep), जृम्भणम् Jrimbhana (causing yawning), मादनं चैव weapon causing intoxication, सन्तापनविलापने weapons causing burning and wailing, शोषणम् weapon causing emaciation, दारणं चैव weapon that splits, सुदुर्जयम् difficult to defeat, वज्रम् अस्त्रं च Vajra astra, ब्रह्मपाशम् Brahma astra, कालपाशम् Kala pasa, वारुणं पाशमेव च Varuna pasa, पैनाकास्त्रम् Painaka weapon, दयितम् Daita weapon, शुष्कार्द्रे wet and dry, उभे two, अशनी thunder bolt, अथ and, दण्डास्त्रम् Danda weapon, पैशाचम् Paisacha weapon, तथैव च as also, क्रौञ्चमस्त्रम् Krauncha weapon, धर्मचक्रम् Dharma chakra, कालचक्रम् Kala chakra, तथैव च as also, विष्णुचक्रम् Vishnu Chakra, वायव्यम् pike of Vayu, मथनं चैव mathana, the churning weapon, तथा and, हयशिर: अस्त्रम् Haya sira weapon, कङ्कालम् Kankala, the skeleton weapon, तथा and, मुसलम् musala, the pestle, शक्तिद्वयं च two powers, चिक्षेप employed, वैद्याधरम् Vaidyadhram pertaining to Vidyadharas, महास्त्रं च mahastra, अथ and, दारुणम् fearful, कालास्त्रम् Kala weapon, घोरम् dreadful, त्रिशूलम् अस्त्रम् Trishula weapon, अथ and, कापालम् Kapalaskull, कङ्कणम् ring shaped Kankana, एतानि सर्वाणि all these, अस्त्राणि weapons, जपतां श्रेष्ठे at the best among ascetics, वसिष्ठे on Vasistha, चिक्षेप employed, तत् that, अद्भुतमिव अभवत् became super natural (aweful).
explanation: "O Descendent of Raghu Viswamitra employed weapons like manava, mohana, gandharva, swapana, jrimbhana, madana, santapana, vilapana, shoshana, darana, vajra weapons, Brahma, kala and varuna pasas, the favourite painaka, daita, shushka, ardra vajras, danda, paisacha, krauncha, weapons, dharmachakra, kalachakra, vishnuchakras, vayavya, mathana, hayasira weapons, kanakala, musala powers, vaidyadhara, kalatrishula, kapala, kankana weapons discharged against Vasishta the best of ascetics. All this became aweful.

shloka_text: मानवं मोहनं चैव गान्धर्वं स्वापनं तथा। जृम्भणं मादनं चैव संतापनविलापने।।1.56.7।। शोषणं दारणं चैव वज्रमस्त्रं सुदुर्जयम्। ब्रह्मपाशं कालपाशं वारुणं पाशमेव च।।1.56.8।। पैनाकास्त्रं च दयितं शुष्कार्द्रे अशनी उभे। दण्डास्त्रमथ पैशाचं क्रौञ्चमस्त्रं तथैव च।।1.56.9।। धर्मचक्रं कालचक्रं विष्णुचक्रं तथैव च। वायव्यं मथनं चैव अस्त्रं हयशिरस्तथा।।1.56.10।। शक्तिद्वयं च चिक्षेप कङ्कालं मुसलं तथा। 560 वैद्याधरं महास्त्रं च कालास्त्रमथ दारुणम्।।1.56.11।। त्रिशूलमस्त्रं घोरं च कापालमथ कङ्कणम्। एतान्यस्त्राणि चिक्षेप सर्वाणि रघुनन्दन।।1.56.12।। वसिष्ठे जपतां श्रेष्ठे तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्।

translation: रघुनन्दन O Joy of Raghus, Rama, मानवम् manava, मोहनं चैव mohana, गान्धर्वम् gandharva, तथा and, स्वापनम् swapana (inducing sleep), जृम्भणम् Jrimbhana (causing yawning), मादनं चैव weapon causing intoxication, सन्तापनविलापने weapons causing burning and wailing, शोषणम् weapon causing emaciation, दारणं चैव weapon that splits, सुदुर्जयम् difficult to defeat, वज्रम् अस्त्रं च Vajra astra, ब्रह्मपाशम् Brahma astra, कालपाशम् Kala pasa, वारुणं पाशमेव च Varuna pasa, पैनाकास्त्रम् Painaka weapon, दयितम् Daita weapon, शुष्कार्द्रे wet and dry, उभे two, अशनी thunder bolt, अथ and, दण्डास्त्रम् Danda weapon, पैशाचम् Paisacha weapon, तथैव च as also, क्रौञ्चमस्त्रम् Krauncha weapon, धर्मचक्रम् Dharma chakra, कालचक्रम् Kala chakra, तथैव च as also, विष्णुचक्रम् Vishnu Chakra, वायव्यम् pike of Vayu, मथनं चैव mathana, the churning weapon, तथा and, हयशिर: अस्त्रम् Haya sira weapon, कङ्कालम् Kankala, the skeleton weapon, तथा and, मुसलम् musala, the pestle, शक्तिद्वयं च two powers, चिक्षेप employed, वैद्याधरम् Vaidyadhram pertaining to Vidyadharas, महास्त्रं च mahastra, अथ and, दारुणम् fearful, कालास्त्रम् Kala weapon, घोरम् dreadful, त्रिशूलम् अस्त्रम् Trishula weapon, अथ and, कापालम् Kapalaskull, कङ्कणम् ring shaped Kankana, एतानि सर्वाणि all these, अस्त्राणि weapons, जपतां श्रेष्ठे at the best among ascetics, वसिष्ठे on Vasistha, चिक्षेप employed, तत् that, अद्भुतमिव अभवत् became super natural (aweful).
