translation: नरशार्दूल O Tiger (great) among men, अथ thereafter, महात्मा magnanimous, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, प्रस्थितान् those who had set on their journey, वनवासिन: inhabitants of the forest, तान् सर्वान् all those, ऋषीन् sages, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: O Tiger among men (Rama) thereafter great Viswamitra seeing the departing sages of the forest said:
comments: Indra steals King Ambarisha 's sacrificial horse -- sage Richika's middle son offers himself for sacrifice.

shloka_text: महान्विघ्न: प्रवृत्तोऽयं दक्षिणामास्थितो दिशम्। दिशमन्यां प्रपत्स्यामस्तत्र तप्स्यामहे तप:।।1.61.2।।
transliteration: mahānvighna: pravṛtto'yaṃ dakṣiṇāmāsthito diśam| diśamanyāṃ prapatsyāmastatra tapsyāmahe tapa:
translation: दक्षिणां दिशं In southern quarter, आस्थित: taking hold of, अयम् महान् this great, विघ्न: obstruction, प्रवृत्त: taken place, अन्याम् another, दिशम् region, प्रपत्स्याम: we will take, तत्र there, तप: austerities, तप्स्यामहे we will perform.
explanation: Since this great obstacle has arisen in the southern quarter, we shall proceed to another region and there perform our austerities.

shloka_text: पश्चिमायां विशालायां पुष्करेषु महात्मन:। सुखं तपश्चरिष्याम: परं तद्धि तपोवनम्।।1.61.3।।
transliteration: paścimāyāṃ viśālāyāṃ puṣkareṣu mahātmana:| sukhaṃ tapaścariṣyāma: paraṃ taddhi tapovanam
translation: महात्मन: O Magnanimous ones, विशालायाम् in the vast, पश्चिमायाम् western region, पुष्करेषु in the sacred spot known as Pushkara, सुखम् in peace, तप: austerities, चरिष्याम: we will perform, तत् that, परम् best, तपोवनम् हि forest.
explanation: "O Highsouled sages, there is lake Pushkara in the vast western region. There in the forest fit for austerities we shall practise penance peacefully".

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा: पुष्करेषु महामुनि:। तप उग्रं दुराधर्षं तेपे मूलफलाशन:।।1.61.4।।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahātejā: puṣkareṣu mahāmuni:| tapa ugraṃ durādharṣaṃ tepe mūlaphalāśana:
translation: महातेजा: exceedingly powerful, महामुनि: great muni, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, पुष्करेषु in pushkara land, मूलफलाशन: living of fruits and roots, दुराधर्षम् unsurpassable, उग्रम् intense, तप: austerities, तेपे performed.
explanation: With this the most powerful sage Viswamitra reached Pushkara where living on fruits and roots, he carried out intense, unsurpassable,  austerities.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु अयोध्याधिपतिर्नृप:। अम्बरीष इति ख्यातो यष्टुं समुपचक्रमे।।1.61.5।।
transliteration: etasminneva kāle tu ayodhyādhipatirnṛpa:| ambarīṣa iti khyāto yaṣṭuṃ samupacakrame
translation: एतस्मिन् at that, काले एव time itself, अम्बरीष: इति as Ambarisha, ख्यात: wellknown, अयोध्याधिपति: lord of Ayodhya, नृप: king, यष्टुम् to perform sacrifice, समुपचक्रमे commneced.
explanation: At this time Ambarisha, a wellknown king of Ayodhya, launched preparations for a  sacrifice.

shloka_text: तस्य वै यजमानस्य पशुमिन्द्रो जहार ह। प्रणष्टे तु पशौ विप्रो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।1.61.6।।
transliteration: tasya vai yajamānasya paśumindro jahāra ha| praṇaṣṭe tu paśau vipro rājānamidamabravīt
translation: यजमानस्य the performer's, तस्य पशुम् his (sacrificial) animal, इन्द्र: Indra, जहार ह stolen  away, पशौ when the animal, प्रणष्टे (सति) could not be seen, विप्र: the priest, राजानम् addressing the king, इदम् this word, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: While he was performing the sacrifice Indra stole away the sacrificial animal. The animal could not be traced. Hence the priest said to the king:

shloka_text: पशुरद्य हृतो राजन् प्रणष्टस्तव दुर्नयात् । अरक्षितारं राजानं घ्नन्ति दोषा नरेश्वर ।।1.61.7।।
transliteration: paśuradya hṛto rājan praṇaṣṭastava durnayāt | arakṣitāraṃ rājānaṃ ghnanti doṣā nareśvara
translation: राजन् O King, अद्य now, पशु: animal, हृत: stolen, तव your, दुर्नयात् due to wrong policies,  प्रणष्ट: could not be seen, नरेश्वर O King, अरक्षितारम् him who fails to protect, राजानम् king, दोषा: faults, घ्नन्ति is perished.
explanation: "O King the animal has been stolen away and because of your inability to enforce law, it could not be traced. O Lord of men the king who fails to protect (his dependents) perishes by his own faults.

shloka_text: प्रायश्चित्तं महद्ध्येतन्नरं वा पुरुषर्षभ । आनयस्व पशुं शीघ्रं यावत्कर्म प्रवर्तते।।1.61.8।।
transliteration: prāyaścittaṃ mahaddhyetannaraṃ vā puruṣarṣabha | ānayasva paśuṃ śīghraṃ yāvatkarma pravartate
translation: पुरुषर्षभ O Best of men, एतत् this one, महत् great, प्रायश्चित्तम् expiation, नरं वा either man, पशुम् as beast, शीघ्रम् speedily, आनयस्व bring, कर्म the sacrifice, यावत् प्रवर्तते may be completed.
explanation: "O Best of men you must pay a big price for this. Bring either the beast or a man immediately so that the sacrifice can be completed".

shloka_text: उपाध्यायवचश्श्रुत्वा स राजा पुरुषर्षभ। अन्वियेष महाबुद्धि: पशुं गोभिस्सहस्रश:।।1.61.9।।
transliteration: upādhyāyavacaśśrutvā sa rājā puruṣarṣabha| anviyeṣa mahābuddhi: paśuṃ gobhissahasraśa:
translation: पुरुषर्षभ O Best of men, महाबुद्धि: great intellectual, स: राजा that king, उपाध्यायवच: the words of priest, श्रुत्वा having heard, सहस्रश: in thousands, गोभि: with cows, पशुम् animal, अन्वियेष searched.
explanation: "O Best of men (Rama) hearing the words of the high priest, the highly intellectual king searched for a human victim in exchange for thousands of cows.

shloka_text: देशान् जनपदांस्तां स्तान्नगराणि वनानि च। आश्रमाणि च पुण्यानि मार्गमाणो महीपति: ।।1.61.10।। स पुत्रसहितं तात सभार्यं रघुनन्दन । भृगुतुंदे समासीनमृचीकं सन्ददर्श ह।।1.61.11।।
transliteration: deśān janapadāṃstāṃ stānnagarāṇi vanāni ca| āśramāṇi ca puṇyāni mārgamāṇo mahīpati:  sa putrasahitaṃ tāta sabhāryaṃ raghunandana | bhṛgutuṃde samāsīnamṛcīkaṃ sandadarśa ha
translation: तात O Child, रघुनन्दन delight of the house of Raghu, Rama, स: महीपति: that king, तां स्तान् many, देशान् countries, जनपदान् villages, नगराणि च cities, वनानि च forests, पुण्यानि sacred, आश्रमाणि च hermitages, मार्गमाण: searching, भृगुतुङ्दे on the Bhrigutunda mountain, पुत्रसहितम् along with his sons, सभार्यम् with his wive, समासीनम् seated, ऋचीकम् Richika, a sage, सन्ददर्श ह beheld.
explanation: O Dear Rama, the delight of Raghu clan the king scoured countries, villages, cities, forests, sacred hermitages till he saw sage Richika in the Bhrigutunda mountain sitting with his sons and wie.

shloka_text: देशान् जनपदांस्तां स्तान्नगराणि वनानि च। आश्रमाणि च पुण्यानि मार्गमाणो महीपति: ।।1.61.10।। स पुत्रसहितं तात सभार्यं रघुनन्दन । भृगुतुंदे समासीनमृचीकं सन्ददर्श ह।।1.61.11।।
transliteration: deśān janapadāṃstāṃ stānnagarāṇi vanāni ca| āśramāṇi ca puṇyāni mārgamāṇo mahīpati:  sa putrasahitaṃ tāta sabhāryaṃ raghunandana | bhṛgutuṃde samāsīnamṛcīkaṃ sandadarśa ha
translation: तात O Child, रघुनन्दन delight of the house of Raghu, Rama, स: महीपति: that king, तां स्तान् many, देशान् countries, जनपदान् villages, नगराणि च cities, वनानि च forests, पुण्यानि sacred, आश्रमाणि च hermitages, मार्गमाण: searching, भृगुतुङ्दे on the Bhrigutunda mountain, पुत्रसहितम् along with his sons, सभार्यम् with his wive, समासीनम् seated, ऋचीकम् Richika, a sage, सन्ददर्श ह beheld.
explanation: O Dear Rama, the delight of Raghu clan the king scoured countries, villages, cities, forests, sacred hermitages till he saw sage Richika in the Bhrigutunda mountain sitting with his sons and wie.

shloka_text: तमुवाच महातेजा: प्रणम्याभिप्रसाद्य च। ब्रह्मर्षिं तपसा दीप्तं राजर्षिरमितप्रभ:।।1.61.12।। पृष्ट्वा सर्वत्र कुशलमृचीकं तमिदं वच:।
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejā: praṇamyābhiprasādya ca| brahmarṣiṃ tapasā dīptaṃ rājarṣiramitaprabha: pṛṣṭvā sarvatra kuśalamṛcīkaṃ tamidaṃ vaca:|
translation: महातेजा: most brilliant, अमितप्रभ: extremely resplendent, तपसा with penance, दीप्तम् shining, तम् ब्रह्मर्षिम् that Brahmarshi, प्रणम्य bowing before him, अभिप्रसाद्य च having propitiated him, सर्वत्र in all, कुशलम् welfare, पृष्ट्वा having enquired, तं ऋचीकम्  addressing that sage Richika, इदम् these, वच: words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: The most brilliant king(Ambarisha) bowing to sage Richika, a brahmarshi who looked extremely resplendent with penance, propitiated him, enquired about the welfare of all and finally said":

shloka_text: गवां शतसहस्रेण विक्रीणीषे सुतं यदि।।1.61.13।। पशोरर्थे महाभाग कृतकृत्योऽस्मि भार्गव।
transliteration: gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa vikrīṇīṣe sutaṃ yadi paśorarthe mahābhāga kṛtakṛtyo'smi bhārgava|
translation: महाभाग भार्गव O Fortunate descendent of Bhrigu race, sage Richika, गवाम् cows, शतसहस्रेण hundred thousands, सुतम् your son, पशो: अर्थे as scrificial animal, विक्रीणीषे यदि if sold, कृतकृत्य: अस्मि I have fulfilled my purpose.
explanation: "O Fortunate descendent of the Bhrigu race if your son is sold as a sacrificial animal in exchange for a hundred thousand cows, my purpose will be answered.

shloka_text: सर्वे परिसृता देशा याज्ञीयं न लभे पशुम्।।1.61.14।। दातुमर्हसि मूल्येन सुतमेकमितो मम।4
transliteration: sarve parisṛtā deśā yājñīyaṃ na labhe paśum dātumarhasi mūlyena sutamekamito mama|4
translation: सर्वे all, देशा: countries, परिसृता: roamed about, याज्ञीयम् relating to sacrifice, पशुम् animal, न लभे I could not get, इत: from among them, एकम् one, सुतम् son, मूल्येन for a price, मम for me, दातुम् to give, अर्हसि it behoves of you.
explanation: I have roamed all countries but could not final the sacrificial animal. Should'nt you spare one of your sons for a price"?

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो महातेजा ऋचीकस्त्वब्रवीद्वच:।।1.61.15।। नाहं ज्येष्ठं नरश्रेष्ठ विक्रीणीयां कथञ्चन।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā ṛcīkastvabravīdvaca: nāhaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ naraśreṣṭha vikrīṇīyāṃ kathañcana|
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त: spoken, महातेजाः exceedingly brilliant, ऋचीकस्तु Richika, वच: these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, अहम् I, कथञ्चन in any way, ज्येष्ठम् eldest one, न विक्रीणीयाम् will not sell.
explanation: Thus addressed the exceedingly brilliant Richika said, "O Best among men in no way shall I sell my first born".

shloka_text: ऋचीकस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा तेषां माता महात्मनाम्।।1.61.16।। उवाच नरशार्दूलमम्बरीषं तपस्विनी।
transliteration: ṛcīkasya vacaśśrutvā teṣāṃ mātā mahātmanām uvāca naraśārdūlamambarīṣaṃ tapasvinī|
translation: ऋचीकस्य Richika's, वच: words, श्रुत्वा having listened, महात्मनाम् of illustrious ones, तेषाम् theirs, माता mother, तपस्विनी a woman in misery, नरशार्दूलम् foremost of men, अम्बरीषम् addressing Ambarisha, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Having heard Richika, the miserable mother of great sons, addressed Ambarisha, the foremost of men, saying:

shloka_text: अविक्रेयं सुतं ज्येष्ठं भगवानाह भार्गव:।।1.61.17।। ममापि दयितं विद्धि कनिष्ठं शुनकं नृप। तस्मात्कनीयसं पुत्रं न दास्ये तव पार्थिव ।।1.61.18।।
transliteration: avikreyaṃ sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhagavānāha bhārgava: mamāpi dayitaṃ viddhi kaniṣṭhaṃ śunakaṃ nṛpa| tasmātkanīyasaṃ putraṃ na dāsye tava pārthiva
translation: भगवान् venerable, भार्गव: descendent of Bhrugu, sage Richika, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, सुतम् son, अविक्रेयम् cannot be sold, आह is telling, नृप O King, शुनकम् named Sunaka, कनिष्ठम् 	youngest, मम for me, दयितम् beloved son, विद्धि you may  better know, पार्द्धिव O King, तस्मात् for that reason, कनीयसं पुत्रम् yougest son, तव to you, न दास्ये I will not give.
explanation: Venerable descendant of the Bhrugus (sage Richika) said that the eldest son cannot be sold. "O King the youngest son, Sunaka, is my beloved son. You know, O King for that reason I will not give my yougest son".

shloka_text: अविक्रेयं सुतं ज्येष्ठं भगवानाह भार्गव:।।1.61.17।। ममापि दयितं विद्धि कनिष्ठं शुनकं नृप। तस्मात्कनीयसं पुत्रं न दास्ये तव पार्थिव ।।1.61.18।।
transliteration: avikreyaṃ sutaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhagavānāha bhārgava: mamāpi dayitaṃ viddhi kaniṣṭhaṃ śunakaṃ nṛpa| tasmātkanīyasaṃ putraṃ na dāsye tava pārthiva
translation: भगवान् venerable, भार्गव: descendent of Bhrugu, sage Richika, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, सुतम् son, अविक्रेयम् cannot be sold, आह is telling, नृप O King, शुनकम् named Sunaka, कनिष्ठम् 	youngest, मम for me, दयितम् beloved son, विद्धि you may  better know, पार्द्धिव O King, तस्मात् for that reason, कनीयसं पुत्रम् yougest son, तव to you, न दास्ये I will not give.
explanation: Venerable descendant of the Bhrugus (sage Richika) said that the eldest son cannot be sold. "O King the youngest son, Sunaka, is my beloved son. You know, O King for that reason I will not give my yougest son".

shloka_text: प्रायेण हि नरश्रेष्ठ ज्येष्ठा: पितृषु वल्लभा:। मातृ़णां तु कनीयांसस्तस्माद्रक्षे कनीयसम् ।।1.61.19।।
transliteration: prāyeṇa hi naraśreṣṭha jyeṣṭhā: pitṛṣu vallabhā:| mātṛ़ṇāṃ tu kanīyāṃsastasmādrakṣe kanīyasam
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, प्रायेण generally, ज्येष्ठा: eldest sons, पितृषु for their fathers, वल्लभा: beloved, मातृ़णां तु for mothers, कनीयांस: yougest are beloved, तस्मात् for that reason, कनीयसम् yougest son, रक्षे I shall protect.
explanation: "O Best among men generally, the eldest sons are the favourites of their fathers, the youngest their mothers: For that reason, I shall keep my youngest son.

shloka_text: उक्तवाक्ये मुनौ तस्मिन् मुनिपत्न्यां तथैव च। शुनश्शेफस्स्वयं राम मध्यमो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।1.61.20।।
transliteration: uktavākye munau tasmin munipatnyāṃ tathaiva ca| śunaśśephassvayaṃ rāma madhyamo vākyamabravīt
translation: राम O Rama, तस्मिन् मुनौ: when that sage, उक्तवाक्ये having spoken thus, तथैव च in the same way, मुनिपत्न्याम् by wife of sage, मध्यम: middle son, शुन:शेफ: Sunas sepha, स्वयम् on his own, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: O Rama the sage and his wife having spoken thus, their middle son Sunassepha said on his own:

shloka_text: पिता ज्येष्ठमविक्रेयं माता चाह कनीयसम्। विक्रीतं मध्यमं मन्ये राजन् पुत्रं नयस्व माम्।।1.61.21।।
transliteration: pitā jyeṣṭhamavikreyaṃ mātā cāha kanīyasam| vikrītaṃ madhyamaṃ manye rājan putraṃ nayasva mām
translation: राजन् O King, पिता my father, ज्येष्ठम् eldest son, अविक्रेयम् cannot be sold, आह said, माता च mother, कनीयसम् youngest one, मध्यमं पुत्रम् middle son, विक्रीतम् is sold, मन्ये I consider, माम् me, नयस्व you may take me.
explanation: O King my father says his eldest son cannot be sold, mother says that her  youngest son cannot be spared. From this I think middle son is already sold away. Therefore, take me"

shloka_text: गवां शतसहस्रेण शुनश्शेफं नरेश्वर:। गृहीत्वा परमप्रीतो जगाम रघुनन्दन ।।1.61.22।।
transliteration: gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa śunaśśephaṃ nareśvara:| gṛhītvā paramaprīto jagāma raghunandana
translation: रघुनन्दन O Delighter of Raghus, Rama, नरेश्वरः that king, गवाम् of cows, शतसहस्रेण by  hundred thousands, शुनश्शेफम् Sunassepha, गृहीत्वा having received, परमप्रीत: immensely pleased, जगाम went.
explanation: "O Delight of the Raghus (Rama) having purchased Sunassepha for a hundred thousands of cows the king refurned immensely pleased.

shloka_text: शुनश्शेफं नरश्रेष्ठ गृहीत्वा तु महायशा:। व्यश्राम्यत् पुष्करे राजा मध्याह्ने रघुनन्दन।।1.62.1।।
transliteration: śunaśśephaṃ naraśreṣṭha gṛhītvā tu mahāyaśā:| vyaśrāmyat puṣkare rājā madhyāhne raghunandana
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O Foremost of men, रघुनन्दन O Rama, महायशा: illustrious, राजा king, शुन:शेफम् Sunassepha, गृहीत्वा having taken, मध्याह्ने by noon, पुष्करे in the Pushkara, व्यश्राम्यत् rested.
explanation: O Foremost of men, O Delight of the Raghus (Rama) the illustrious king (Ambarisha) took Sunassepha with him. (On the way) at Pushkara he took some rest at noon.
comments: Viswamitra protects Sunassepha and continues his austerities.

shloka_text: तस्य विश्रममाणस्य शुनश्शेफो महायशा:। पुष्करक्षेत्रमागम्य विश्वामित्रं ददर्श ह।।1.62.2।। तप्यन्तमृषिभिस्सार्धं मातुलं परमातुर:।
transliteration: tasya viśramamāṇasya śunaśśepho mahāyaśā:| puṣkarakṣetramāgamya viśvāmitraṃ dadarśa ha tapyantamṛṣibhissārdhaṃ mātulaṃ paramātura:|
translation: तस्य as he, विश्रममाणस्य was resting, महायशा: highly famous, शुन:शेफ: Sunassepha, परमातुर: greately aggrieved, पुष्करक्षेत्रम् sacred Pushkara, आगम्य having approached, ऋषिभि:सार्धम्  in the company of other sages, तप्यन्तम् performing austerities, मातुलम् maternal uncle,  विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, ददर्श ह beheld.
explanation: While the king was resting at Pushkara, the famous Sunassepha, very much distressed, happened to see his maternal uncle Viswamitra in the company of other sages performing austerities.

shloka_text: विवर्णवदनो दीनस्तृष्णया च श्रमेण च।।1.62.3।। पपाताङ्के मुनेराशु वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह।
transliteration: vivarṇavadano dīnastṛṣṇayā ca śrameṇa ca papātāṅke munerāśu vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha|
translation: तृष्णया with thirst, श्रमेण च and fatigue, विवर्णवदन: with discoloured face, दीन: piteous, आशु immediately, मुने: sage's, अङ्के lap, पपात fell, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke.
explanation: With his face discoloured due to thirst and fatigue, he (Sunassepha) immediately fell into the sage's lap in a pitiable condition and said:

shloka_text: न मेऽस्ति माता न पिता ज्ञातयो बान्धवा: कुत:।।1.62.4।। त्रातुमर्हसि मां सौम्य धर्मेण मुनिपुङ्गव।
transliteration: na me'sti mātā na pitā jñātayo bāndhavā: kuta: trātumarhasi māṃ saumya dharmeṇa munipuṅgava|
translation: सौम्य O Gentle man, मुनिपुङ्गव O Preeminent among ascetics, मे to me, माता mother, नास्ति does no exist, पिता father, न not, ज्ञातय: agnate relations, बान्धवा: relatives, कुत: where?, माम् me, धर्मेण in accordance with righteousness, त्रातुम् to protect, अर्हसि behoves of you.
explanation: "O Noble man O Preeminent among ascetics I have no mother nor father nor friends nor relatives. You should protect me according to dharma.

shloka_text: त्राता त्वं हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां त्वं हि भावन:।।1.62.5।। राजा च कृतकार्यस्स्यादहं दीर्घायुरव्यय:। स्वर्गलोकमुपाश्नीयां तपस्तप्त्वाह्यनुत्तमम्।।1.62.6।।
transliteration: trātā tvaṃ hi muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ hi bhāvana: rājā ca kṛtakāryassyādahaṃ dīrghāyuravyaya:| svargalokamupāśnīyāṃ tapastaptvāhyanuttamam
translation: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Best among ascetics, त्वम् you, सर्वेषाम् to everybody, त्राता हि protector, त्वम् you, भावन: हि promoter of others' welfare, राजा king, कृतकार्य: fulfilling the purpose, स्यात् become, अहम् I, दीर्घायु: one who has long life, अव्यय: imperishable, अनुत्तमम् great, तप: austerities, तप्त्वा having performed, स्वर्गलोकम् heaven, उपाश्नीयाम् I may enjoy.
explanation: O Best among ascetics you are the protecor of everybody. You are promoter of others' welfare. May the king fulfil his purpose. May I live long and become immortal and attain heaven after performing great penance. May I enjoy heaven.

shloka_text: त्राता त्वं हि मुनिश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां त्वं हि भावन:।।1.62.5।। राजा च कृतकार्यस्स्यादहं दीर्घायुरव्यय:। स्वर्गलोकमुपाश्नीयां तपस्तप्त्वाह्यनुत्तमम्।।1.62.6।।
transliteration: trātā tvaṃ hi muniśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ hi bhāvana: rājā ca kṛtakāryassyādahaṃ dīrghāyuravyaya:| svargalokamupāśnīyāṃ tapastaptvāhyanuttamam
translation: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O Best among ascetics, त्वम् you, सर्वेषाम् to everybody, त्राता हि protector, त्वम् you, भावन: हि promoter of others' welfare, राजा king, कृतकार्य: fulfilling the purpose, स्यात् become, अहम् I, दीर्घायु: one who has long life, अव्यय: imperishable, अनुत्तमम् great, तप: austerities, तप्त्वा having performed, स्वर्गलोकम् heaven, उपाश्नीयाम् I may enjoy.
explanation: O Best among ascetics you are the protecor of everybody. You are promoter of others' welfare. May the king fulfil his purpose. May I live long and become immortal and attain heaven after performing great penance. May I enjoy heaven.

shloka_text: त्वं मे नाथो ह्यनाथस्य भव भव्येन चेतसा। पितेव पुत्रं धर्मात्मं स्त्रातुमर्हसि किल्बिषात्।।1.62.7।।
transliteration: tvaṃ me nātho hyanāthasya bhava bhavyena cetasā| piteva putraṃ dharmātmaṃ strātumarhasi kilbiṣāt
translation: अनाथस्य an orphan as i am, मे to me, त्वम् you, भव्येन with auspicious, चेतसा mind, नाथ: lord, भव be, धर्मात्मन् O virtuous one, पिता father, पुत्रमिव like son, किल्बिषात् from sin, त्रातुम् to protect, अर्ह्रसि behoves of you.
explanation: O Virtuous one with a kind heart protect this orphan. Like a father who protects his son, save me from this peril".

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा विश्वामित्रो महातपा:। सान्त्वयित्वा बहुविधं पुत्रानिदमुवाच ह।।1.62.8।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvāmitro mahātapā:| sāntvayitvā bahuvidhaṃ putrānidamuvāca ha
translation: महातपा: mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Viswamitra, तस्य his, तत् बहुविधम् वचनम् those different kinds of words, श्रुत्वा having listened, सान्त्वयित्वा after consoling him, पुत्रान् addressing his sons, इदम् this word, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Having heard Sunassepha, mighty ascetic Viswamitra consoled him in many ways and said to his sons:

shloka_text: यत्कृते पितर: पुत्रान् जनयन्ति शुभार्थिन:। परलोकहितार्थाय तस्य कालोऽयमागत:।।1.62.9।।
transliteration: yatkṛte pitara: putrān janayanti śubhārthina:| paralokahitārthāya tasya kālo'yamāgata:
translation: शुभार्थिन: men desiring auspiciousness, पितर: parents, यत्कृते for whichever reason, परलोकहितार्थाय for your wellbeing in other worlds, पुत्रान् sons, जनयन्ति begetting, तस्य for that, अयम् काल: the proper time, आगत: has come.
explanation: The very time has now come for that purpose for which parents desiring auspiciousness beget sons—namely, for their welfare in the other world.

shloka_text: अयं मुनिसुतो बालो मत्तश्शरणमिच्छति। अस्य जीवितमात्रेण प्रियं कुरुत पुत्रका:।।1.62.10।।
transliteration: ayaṃ munisuto bālo mattaśśaraṇamicchati| asya jīvitamātreṇa priyaṃ kuruta putrakā:
translation: मुनिसुत: son of sage, अयम् this, बाल: young boy, मत्त: from me, शरणम् refuge, इच्छति is  strongly desiring, पुत्रका: O Sons, अस्य for him, जीवितमात्रेण by mere offering of life, प्रियम् dear act, कुरुत you may do.
explanation: O sons of the sage this young boy has sought my protection. O Sons you may grant him his desire by merely offering your life.

shloka_text: सर्वे सुकृतकर्माणस्सर्वे धर्मपरायणा: । पशुभूता नरेन्द्रस्य तृप्तिमग्ने: प्रयच्छत ।।1.62.11।।
transliteration: sarve sukṛtakarmāṇassarve dharmaparāyaṇā: | paśubhūtā narendrasya tṛptimagne: prayacchata
translation: सर्वे all of you, सुकृतकर्माण: have done virtuous deeds, सर्वे all of you, धर्मपरायणा: are engaged in the observance of righteousness, नरेन्द्रस्य for the king, पशुभूता: becoming sacrificial animals, अग्ने for Agni, तृप्तिम् satisfaction, प्रयच्छत give.
explanation: Engaged in the observance of righteousness, all of you have done virtuous deeds. By becoming sacrificial animals for the king, you may satisfy Agni.

shloka_text: नाथवांश्च शुनश्शेफो यज्ञश्चाविघ्नितो भवेत्। देवतास्तर्पिताश्चस्युर्मम चापि कृतं वच:।।1.62.12।।
transliteration: nāthavāṃśca śunaśśepho yajñaścāvighnito bhavet| devatāstarpitāścasyurmama cāpi kṛtaṃ vaca:
translation: शुनशेफ: Sunassepha, नाथवान् च will have a protector, यज्ञश्च sacrifice also, अविघ्नत: without hindrance, भवेत् will become, देवता: devatas, तर्पिता: gratified, स्यु: will become, मम my, वच: च words also, कृतम् will be done.
explanation: Then Sunassepha will be protected. The king's sacrifice will continue without hindrance. The gods will be gratified. My words also will come true".

shloka_text: मुनेस्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा मधुच्छन्दादय स्सुता:। साभिमानं नरश्रेष्ठ सलीलमिदमब्रुवन्।।1.62.13।।
transliteration: munestu vacanaṃ śrutvā madhucchandādaya ssutā:| sābhimānaṃ naraśreṣṭha salīlamidamabruvan
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O Best of men, मधुच्छन्दादय: Madhuchanda and others, सुता: sons, मुने: ascetics's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having listened, साभिमानम् with selfesteem, सलीलम् with ease, इदम् these words, अब्रुवन् spoke.
explanation: "O Best of men (Rama) in response to the words of the sage Madhuchanda and others said thus in a casual way with selfesteem.

shloka_text: कथमात्मसुतान् हित्वा त्रायसेऽन्यसुतं विभो। अकार्यमिव पश्याम श्श्वमांस इव भोजने।।1.62.14।।
transliteration: kathamātmasutān hitvā trāyase'nyasutaṃ vibho| akāryamiva paśyāma śśvamāṃsa iva bhojane
translation: विभो O Lord, आत्मसुतान् ones own sons, हित्वा abandoning, अन्यसुतम् other's son, कथम् how, त्रायसे you rescue, भोजने in partaking, श्वमांस इव like the flesh of dog, अकार्यमिव as if a prohibited act, पश्याम: we find.
explanation: O Lord protecting other's son by abandoning one' own is like partaking the flesh of a dog. We consider it a prohibited act".

shloka_text: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पुत्राणां मुनिपुङ्गव:। क्रोधसंरक्तनयनो व्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे।।1.62.15।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā putrāṇāṃ munipuṅgava:| krodhasaṃraktanayano vyāhartumupacakrame
translation: मुनिपुङ्गव: eminent ascetic, तेषाम् पुत्राणाम् of those sons', तद् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, क्रोधसंरक्तनयन: with eyes reddened with anger, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, उपचक्रमे commenced.
explanation: On hearing the words of his sons Viswamitra, the eminent ascetic, eyes reddened with anger began to speak:

shloka_text: निस्साध्वसमिदं प्रोक्तं धर्मादपि विगर्हितम्। अतिक्रम्य तु मद्वाक्यं दारुणं रोमहर्षणम्।।1.62.16।।
transliteration: nissādhvasamidaṃ proktaṃ dharmādapi vigarhitam| atikramya tu madvākyaṃ dāruṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam
translation: मद्वाक्यम् my words, अतिक्रम्य having trangressed, धर्मादपि even according to morality, विगर्हितम् censurable, दारुणम् dreadful, रोमहर्षणम् causing the hair to stand on end, इदम् these words, निस्साध्वसम् audacious, प्रोक्तम् have been uttered.
explanation: "(You have) not only trangressed my words but also (you are) censurable according to dharma. You have uttered such audacious and dreadrul words causing the hair to stand on end.

shloka_text: श्वमांसभोजिनस्सर्वे वासिष्ठा इव जातिषु। पूर्णं वर्षसहस्रं तु पृथिव्यामनुवत्स्यथ।।1.62.17।।
transliteration: śvamāṃsabhojinassarve vāsiṣṭhā iva jātiṣu| pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pṛthivyāmanuvatsyatha
translation: सर्वे all of you, श्वमांसभोजिन: feeding on the flesh of dog, पूर्णं complete, वर्षसहस्रम् thousand years, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, वासिष्ठा: इव like sons of Vasishta, जातिषु in (Mushtika) race, अनुवत्स्यथ shall dwell.
explanation: All of you shall live on earth for a thousand years, like the sons of Vasishta feeding on the flesh of dogs".

shloka_text: कृत्वा शापसमायुक्तान् पुत्रान् मुनिवरस्तथा। शुनश्शेफमुवाचार्तं कृत्वा रक्षां निरामयम्।।1.62.18।।
transliteration: kṛtvā śāpasamāyuktān putrān munivarastathā| śunaśśephamuvācārtaṃ kṛtvā rakṣāṃ nirāmayam
translation: मुनिवर: best of ascetics, पुत्रान् his sons, शाप समायुक्तान् doomed with curse, कृत्वा having made, तथा then, निरामयम् free from pain, रक्षाम् protection, कृत्वा having made, आर्तम् filled with distress, शुन:शेफम् addressing Sunassepha, (इदम् these words), उवाच spoke.
explanation: Viswamitra the best of ascetics, thus cursed his sons. Sunassepha, (now) was filled with distress. To relieve him of his pain he said:

shloka_text: पवित्रपाशैरासक्तो रक्तमाल्यानुलेपन:। वैष्णवं यूपमासाद्य वाग्भिरग्निमुदाहर ।।1.62.19।।
transliteration: pavitrapāśairāsakto raktamālyānulepana:| vaiṣṇavaṃ yūpamāsādya vāgbhiragnimudāhara
translation: वैष्णवं यूपम् Vaishnava sacrificial post, आसाद्य having reached, पवित्रपाशै: with sacred ropes, आसक्त: having bound with, रक्तमाल्यानुलेपन: bedaubing your body with red sandal paste and adorned with red garlands, वाग्भि: with the hymns, अग्निम् Agni, उदाहर invoke.
explanation: "Bedaubing your person with red sandal paste and adorned with red garlands, you will be bound to a Vaishnava, sacrificial post with sacred ropes. There invoke Agni with these hymns.

shloka_text: इमे तु गाथे द्वे दिव्ये गायेथा मुनिपुत्रक। अम्बरीषस्य यज्ञेऽस्मिंस्तत स्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि।।1.62.20।।
transliteration: ime tu gāthe dve divye gāyethā muniputraka| ambarīṣasya yajñe'smiṃstata ssiddhimavāpsyasi
translation: मुनिपुत्रक: O Son of the sage, अम्बरीषस्य Ambarisha's, अस्मिन् यज्ञे in this sacrifice, इमे द्वे these two, दिव्ये sacred, गाथे verses, गायेथा: chant, तत: there after, सिद्धिम् success, अवाप्स्यसि you will achieve.
explanation: O Son of sage chant thse two sacred mantras in the sacrifice of Ambarisha.There after you will achieve success (long life)".

shloka_text: शुनश्शेफो गृहीत्वा ते द्वे गाथे सुसमाहित:। त्वरया राजसिंहं तमम्बरीषमुवाच ह।।1.62.21।।
transliteration: śunaśśepho gṛhītvā te dve gāthe susamāhita:| tvarayā rājasiṃhaṃ tamambarīṣamuvāca ha
translation: शुनश्शेफ: Sunassepha, सुसमाहित: with concentration of mind, ते द्वे those two, गाथे verses, गृहीत्वा after securing, राजसिंहम् the lion among kings, तम् अम्बरीषम् that Amabarisha, त्वरया quickly, उवाच ह spoke.
explanation: Sunassepha memorized the two verses with concentration of mind and hastened towards Amabarisha, a lion among kings. And said:

shloka_text: राजसिंह महासत्त्व शीघ्रं गच्छावहे सद:। निर्वर्तयस्व राजेन्द्र दीक्षां च समुपाविश।।1.62.22।।
transliteration: rājasiṃha mahāsattva śīghraṃ gacchāvahe sada:| nirvartayasva rājendra dīkṣāṃ ca samupāviśa
translation: महासत्त्व endowed with great strength, राजसिंह lion among kings, सद: sacrificial assembly, शीघ्रम् without dealy, गच्छावहे we shall both go, राजेन्द्र O Indra of monarchs,  निर्वर्तयस्व perform, दीक्षाम् initiatory rites, समुपाविश take up.
explanation: "Endowed with great strength, you are a lion among kings. We shall go to the sacrificial assembly without delay. O Indra among monarchs, take up initiatory rites and  perform the sacrifice".

shloka_text: तद्वाक्यमृषिपुत्रस्य श्रुत्वा हर्षसमुत्सुक: । जगाम नृपति श्शीघ्रं यज्ञवाटमतन्द्रित:।।1.62.23।।
transliteration: tadvākyamṛṣiputrasya śrutvā harṣasamutsuka: | jagāma nṛpati śśīghraṃ yajñavāṭamatandrita:
translation: नृपति: king, ऋषिपुत्रस्य sage's son's, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हर्षसमुत्सुक:   rejoiced with delight, अतन्द्रित: promptly, यज्ञवाटम् sacrificial ground, जगाम went.
explanation: At the words of the sage's son, the king, eager with delight hastened towards the sacrificial ground.

shloka_text: सदस्यानुमते राजा पवित्रकृतलक्षणम्। पशुं रक्ताम्बरं कृत्वा यूपे तं समबन्धयत्।।1.62.24।।
transliteration: sadasyānumate rājā pavitrakṛtalakṣaṇam| paśuṃ raktāmbaraṃ kṛtvā yūpe taṃ samabandhayat
translation: राजा king, सदस्यानुमते with the consent of officiating priests, तम् that Sunassepha,  पवित्रकृतलक्षणम् forming sacred knots of Kusa grass, रक्ताम्बरम् with red apparel, पशुम् as sacrificial animal, कृत्वा having made, यूपे to the sacrificial post, समबन्धयत् tied.
explanation: With the consent of the officiating priests the king invested Sunasepha with the sacred symbols with Kusa grass, dressed him in red apparel and tied him to the sacrificial post as a sacrificial animal.

shloka_text: सबद्धो वाग्भिरग्य्राभिरभितुष्टाव वै सुरौ। इन्द्रमिन्द्रानुजं चैव यथावन्मुनिपुत्रक:।।1.62.25।।
transliteration: sabaddho vāgbhiragyrābhirabhituṣṭāva vai surau| indramindrānujaṃ caiva yathāvanmuniputraka:
translation: बद्ध: having been bound, स: मुनिपुत्रक: the son of sage, इन्द्रम् Indra, इन्द्रानुजं चैव Upendra, सुरौ two devatas, अग्य्राभि: with excellent, वाग्भि: words, यथावत् properly, अभितुष्टाव praised.
explanation: Thus bound, the son of the sage praised the two devatas, Indra and Upendra with moving words.

shloka_text: तत: प्रीत स्सहस्राक्षो रहस्यस्तुतितर्पित:। दीर्घमायुस्तदा प्रादाच्छुनश्शेफाय राघव ।।1.62.26।।
transliteration: tata: prīta ssahasrākṣo rahasyastutitarpita:| dīrghamāyustadā prādācchunaśśephāya rāghava
translation: राघव O Rama, तत: then, रहस्यस्तुतितर्पित: gratified with secret praise, सहस्राक्ष: Indra, प्रीत: pleased, तदा then, शुन:शेफाय for Sunasepha, दीर्घम् long, आयु: life, प्रादात् gave.
explanation: "O Descendant of Raghu (Rama) Indra, gratified with the secret hymn granted Sunassepha long life.

shloka_text: स च राजा नरश्रेष्ठ यज्ञस्य च समाप्तवान्। फलं बहुगुणं राम सहस्राक्षप्रसादजम्।।1.62.27।।
transliteration: sa ca rājā naraśreṣṭha yajñasya ca samāptavān| phalaṃ bahuguṇaṃ rāma sahasrākṣaprasādajam
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O Foremost of men, राम Rama, स: राजा च that king also, सहस्राक्षप्रसादजम् through  the grace of Indra, बहुगुणम् several times, यज्ञस्य   of sacrifice, फलम् fruits, समाप्तवान् obtained.
explanation: O Foremost of men O Rama the king also obtained from the sacrifics innumerable rewards by the grace of Indra several times greater than expected.

shloka_text: विश्वामित्रो ऽपि धर्मात्मा भूयस्तेपे महातपा:। पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ दशवर्षशतानि च।।1.62.28।।
transliteration: viśvāmitro 'pi dharmātmā bhūyastepe mahātapā:| puṣkareṣu naraśreṣṭha daśavarṣaśatāni ca
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O Best among men, धर्मत्मा the righteous, महातपा: mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: अपि Visvamitra also, पुष्करेषु in that sacred spot name Pushkara, दशवर्षशतानि thousand years, भूय: again, तेपे continued his austerities.
explanation: O Best among men the righteous and mighty ascetic Viswamitra also continued his austerities at Pushkara for a thousand years". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtysecond sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु व्रतस्नातं महामुनिम्। अभ्यागच्छन् सुरास्सर्वे तप: फलचिकीर्षव:।।1.63.1।।
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu vratasnātaṃ mahāmunim| abhyāgacchan surāssarve tapa: phalacikīrṣava:
translation: वर्षसहस्रे when thousand years, पूर्णे had been completed, सर्वे all, सुरा: devatas, तप: फलचिकीर्षव: desiring to bestow the fruits of his austerities, व्रतस्नातम् who had taken the ritual bath after completion of the ritual, महामुनिम् mighty ascetic, अभ्यागच्छन् approached.
explanation: All the gods wanted to bestow the fruits of austerties on the mighty ascetic (Viswamitra). They approached him after a thousand years of penace and his final ritual bath.
comments: Viswamitra obtains the title of Maharshi -- Menaka creates impediments to his penance -- Viswamitra performs intense austerities to obtain the rank of Brahmarshi.

shloka_text: अब्रवीत्सुमहातेजा ब्रह्मा सुरुचिरं वच:। ऋषिस्त्वमसि भद्रं ते स्वार्जितै: कर्मभिश्शुभै:।।1.63.2।।
transliteration: abravītsumahātejā brahmā suruciraṃ vaca:| ṛṣistvamasi bhadraṃ te svārjitai: karmabhiśśubhai:
translation: सुमहातेजा: exceedingly effulgent, ब्रह्मा Brahma, सुरुचिरम् attractive, वच: words, अब्रवीत् spoke, त्वम् you, स्वार्जितै: with selfearned, शुभै: कर्मभि: sacred deeds, ऋषि: असि have become Rishi, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you.
explanation: Exceedingly effulgent Brahma spoke to him, "You have become a rishi through the selfearned sacred deeds. Fare you well".

shloka_text: तमेवमुक्त्वा देवेशस्त्रिदिवं पुनरभ्यगात् । विश्वामित्रो महातेजा भूयस्तेपे महत्तप:।।1.63.3।।
transliteration: tamevamuktvā deveśastridivaṃ punarabhyagāt | viśvāmitro mahātejā bhūyastepe mahattapa:
translation: देवेश: lord of devatas, तम् him, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, पुन: again, त्रिदिवम् towards heaven, अभ्यगात् went, महातेजा: a man of mighty effulgence, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, भूय: again, महत् great, तप: austerities, तेपे performed.
explanation: Brahma, the lord of the gods, having said this returned to heaven. The brilliant Viswamitra continues his austerities.

shloka_text: तत: कालेन महता मेनका परमाऽप्सरा:। पुष्करेषु नरश्रेष्ठ स्नातुं समुपचक्रमे।।1.63.4।।
transliteration: tata: kālena mahatā menakā paramā'psarā:| puṣkareṣu naraśreṣṭha snātuṃ samupacakrame
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O foremost of men, तत: thereafter, महता great, कालेन after a great lapse of time, मेनका one named Menaka, परमाप्सरा: freatest among nymphs, पुष्करेषु in the spot at Pushkara, स्नातुम् to bathe, समुपचक्रमे commenced.
explanation: "O Foremost of men after a long lapse of time a chief nymph called Menaka came to bathe at Pushkara.

shloka_text: तां ददर्श महातेजा मेनकां कुशिकात्मज:। रूपेणाप्रतिमां तत्र विद्युतं जलदे यथा।।1.63.5।।
transliteration: tāṃ dadarśa mahātejā menakāṃ kuśikātmaja:| rūpeṇāpratimāṃ tatra vidyutaṃ jalade yathā
translation: महातेजा: highly lustrous, कुशिकात्मज: son of Kusika, Visvamitra, तत्र in that Pushkara, जलदे in the clouds, विद्युतं यथा like lightening, रूपेण in beauty, अप्रतिमाम् incomparable, ताम्  मेनकाम् that Menaka, ददर्श beheld.
explanation: There the most brilliant son of Kusika Viswamitra saw Menaka whose beauty was incomparable. She looked like lightning in the clouds.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा कन्दर्पवशगो मुनिस्तामिदमब्रवीत्। अप्सरस्स्वागतं तेऽस्तु वस चेह ममाश्रमे।।1.63.6।। अनुगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते मदनेन सुमोहितम्।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā kandarpavaśago munistāmidamabravīt| apsarassvāgataṃ te'stu vasa ceha mamāśrame anugṛhṇīṣva bhadraṃ te madanena sumohitam|
translation: दृष्ट्वा having seen, मुनि: sage Visvamitra, कन्दर्पवशग: under the influence of Kandarpa,  Cupid, ताम् her, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, अप्सर: O Apsarasa, ते to you, स्वागतम् अस्तु wecome, मम my, इह here, आश्रमे hermitage, वस च dwell, मदनेन by Manmatha,  सुमोहितम् highly infatuated, अनुगृह्णीष्व favour me, ते भद्रम् safety to you.
explanation: On seeing her (Menaka) Viswamitra came under the influence of the god of love (fell in love with her). He said, O Apsara welcome to my hermitage stay here. I am infatuated with you: Oblige me. Wish you well.

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता सा वरारोहा तत्र वासमथाकरोत्।।1.63.7।। तस्यां वसन्त्यां वर्षाणि पञ्च पञ्च च राघव । विश्वामित्राश्रमे राम सुखेन व्यतिचक्रमु:।।1.63.8।।
transliteration: ityuktā sā varārohā tatra vāsamathākarot tasyāṃ vasantyāṃ varṣāṇi pañca pañca ca rāghava | viśvāmitrāśrame rāma sukhena vyaticakramu:
translation: राघव O Rama, सा वरारोहा that women of exalted breeding, इति thus, उक्ता having been spoken, अथ thereafter, तत्र there, वासम् habitation, अकरोत् made, राम O Rama, तस्याम्  while she, विश्वामित्राश्रमे in the hermitage of Visvamitra, वसन्त्याम् while living, पञ्च पञ्च च ten, वर्षाणि years, सुखेन happily, व्यतिचक्रमु: passed away.
explanation: "O Descendant of Raghu while that woman of an exalted race lived in the hermitage of Viswamitra, ten years rolled by happily".

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता सा वरारोहा तत्र वासमथाकरोत्।।1.63.7।। तस्यां वसन्त्यां वर्षाणि पञ्च पञ्च च राघव । विश्वामित्राश्रमे राम सुखेन व्यतिचक्रमु:।।1.63.8।।
transliteration: ityuktā sā varārohā tatra vāsamathākarot tasyāṃ vasantyāṃ varṣāṇi pañca pañca ca rāghava | viśvāmitrāśrame rāma sukhena vyaticakramu:
translation: राघव O Rama, सा वरारोहा that women of exalted breeding, इति thus, उक्ता having been spoken, अथ thereafter, तत्र there, वासम् habitation, अकरोत् made, राम O Rama, तस्याम्  while she, विश्वामित्राश्रमे in the hermitage of Visvamitra, वसन्त्याम् while living, पञ्च पञ्च च ten, वर्षाणि years, सुखेन happily, व्यतिचक्रमु: passed away.
explanation: "O Descendant of Raghu while that woman of an exalted race lived in the hermitage of Viswamitra, ten years rolled by happily".

shloka_text: अथ काले गते तस्मिन्विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। सव्रीड इव सम्वृत्तश्चिन्ताशोकपरायण:।।1.63.9।।
transliteration: atha kāle gate tasminviśvāmitro mahāmuni:| savrīḍa iva samvṛttaścintāśokaparāyaṇa:
translation: अथ there after, तस्मिन् काले when that period, गते was spent, महामुनि: mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, चिन्ताशोकपरायण: filled with grief and sorrowful thought, सव्रीड इव as though with shame, सम्वृत्त: became.
explanation: As the period passed, Viswamitra the mighty ascetic was filled with grief, anxiety and remorse.

shloka_text: बुद्धिर्मुनेस्समुत्पन्ना सामर्षा रघुनन्दन। सर्वं सुराणां कर्मैतत्तपोपहरणं महत्।।1.63.10।।
transliteration: buddhirmunessamutpannā sāmarṣā raghunandana| sarvaṃ surāṇāṃ karmaitattapopaharaṇaṃ mahat
translation: राघुनन्दन O Rama, मुने: for the ascetic, सामर्षा filled with indignation, बुद्धि: a thought, समुत्पन्ना arose, एतत् सर्वम् all this, महत् great, तपोपहरणम् taking away tapas, सुराणाम् devatas', कर्म deed.
explanation: O Delight of the Raghus (Rama) a sense of indignation filled the mind of the ascetic. 'All this is the conspiracy of the gods to deprive me of my great austerities', he thought.

shloka_text: अहोरात्रापदेशेन गतास्संवत्सरा दश। काममोहाभिभूतस्य विघ्नोऽयं समुपस्थित:।।1.63.11।।
transliteration: ahorātrāpadeśena gatāssaṃvatsarā daśa| kāmamohābhibhūtasya vighno'yaṃ samupasthita:
translation: काममोहाभिभूतस्य for me possessed by lust and delusion, दश संवत्सरा: ten years, अहोरात्रापदेशेन under the pretext of day and night, गता: have passed by, अयम् विघ्न: this hindrance, समुपस्थित: has befallen.
explanation: Night and day deluded by lust I have wasted ten years. A hindrance has been posed (to my tapas).

shloka_text: विनिश्श्वसन्मुनिवर: पश्चात्तापेन दु:खित:। भीतामप्सरसं दृष्ट्वा वेपन्तीं प्राञ्जलिं स्थिताम्।।1.63.12।। मेनकां मधुरैर्वाक्यैर्विसृज्य कुशिकात्मज:। उत्तरं पर्वतं राम विश्वामित्रो जगाम ह।।1.63.13।।
transliteration: viniśśvasanmunivara: paścāttāpena du:khita:| bhītāmapsarasaṃ dṛṣṭvā vepantīṃ prāñjaliṃ sthitām menakāṃ madhurairvākyairvisṛjya kuśikātmaja:| uttaraṃ parvataṃ rāma viśvāmitro jagāma ha
translation: राम O Rama, मुनिवर: best of ascetics, कुशिकात्मज: son of Kusika, विश्वामित्र: Viswamitra, पश्चात्तापेन with repentence, दु:खित: distressed, विनिश्वसन् sighing, भीताम् freightened,  प्राञ्जलिं स्थिताम् standing with folded palms, वेपन्तीम् trembling, अप्सरसम् apsara, मेनकाम् Menaka, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मधुरै: with sweet, वाक्यै: words, विसृज्य after permitting her to leave, उत्तरं पर्वतम् northern mountain, जगाम ह went.
explanation: "O Rama Viswamitra, the best of ascetics sighed with repentance, distressed with grief. On seeing him, the apsara started trembling in fear. She stood before him with folded palms. (But) with sweet words the son of Kushika left her and proceeded towards the northern mountains.

shloka_text: विनिश्श्वसन्मुनिवर: पश्चात्तापेन दु:खित:। भीतामप्सरसं दृष्ट्वा वेपन्तीं प्राञ्जलिं स्थिताम्।।1.63.12।। मेनकां मधुरैर्वाक्यैर्विसृज्य कुशिकात्मज:। उत्तरं पर्वतं राम विश्वामित्रो जगाम ह।।1.63.13।।
transliteration: viniśśvasanmunivara: paścāttāpena du:khita:| bhītāmapsarasaṃ dṛṣṭvā vepantīṃ prāñjaliṃ sthitām menakāṃ madhurairvākyairvisṛjya kuśikātmaja:| uttaraṃ parvataṃ rāma viśvāmitro jagāma ha
translation: राम O Rama, मुनिवर: best of ascetics, कुशिकात्मज: son of Kusika, विश्वामित्र: Viswamitra, पश्चात्तापेन with repentence, दु:खित: distressed, विनिश्वसन् sighing, भीताम् freightened,  प्राञ्जलिं स्थिताम् standing with folded palms, वेपन्तीम् trembling, अप्सरसम् apsara, मेनकाम् Menaka, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मधुरै: with sweet, वाक्यै: words, विसृज्य after permitting her to leave, उत्तरं पर्वतम् northern mountain, जगाम ह went.
explanation: "O Rama Viswamitra, the best of ascetics sighed with repentance, distressed with grief. On seeing him, the apsara started trembling in fear. She stood before him with folded palms. (But) with sweet words the son of Kushika left her and proceeded towards the northern mountains.

shloka_text: स कृत्वा नैष्ठिकीं बुद्धिं जेतुकामो महायशा:। कौशिकीतीरमासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्।।1.63.14।।
transliteration: sa kṛtvā naiṣṭhikīṃ buddhiṃ jetukāmo mahāyaśā:| kauśikītīramāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam
translation: महायशा: highly illustrious, स: he (that Visvamitra), नैष्ठिकीम् life long abstinence and chastity, बुद्धिम् mind, कृत्वा having made, जेतुकाम: with a view to control his senses, कौशिकीतीरम् the banks of the Kausiki river, आसाद्य having reached, सुदारुणम् highly rigid, तप: austerities, तेपे performed.
explanation: Illustrious Viswamitra took a vow of celibacy in order to control his senses. And performed rigid austerities on reaching the bank of river Kausiki.

shloka_text: तस्य वर्षसहस्रं तु घोरं तप उपासत:। उत्तरे पर्वते राम देवतानामभूद्भयम्।।1.63.15।।
transliteration: tasya varṣasahasraṃ tu ghoraṃ tapa upāsata:| uttare parvate rāma devatānāmabhūdbhayam
translation: राम O Rama, तस्य for him, उत्तरे पर्वते on the northern mountains, वर्षसहस्रम् a thousand years, घोरम् fearful, तप: penance, उपासत: while performing, देवतानाम् to devatas, भयम्  अभूत् fear arose.
explanation: O Rama while he was performing rigorous penance for a thousand years on the northern mountains, the gods were gripped with fear. (lest he should exceed them).

shloka_text: आमन्त्रयन् समागम्य सर्वे सर्षिगणा स्सुरा:। महर्षिशब्दं लभतां साध्वयं कुशिकात्मज:।।1.63.16।।
transliteration: āmantrayan samāgamya sarve sarṣigaṇā ssurā:| maharṣiśabdaṃ labhatāṃ sādhvayaṃ kuśikātmaja:
translation: सर्षिगणा: along with hosts of rishis, सर्वे all, सुरा: devatas, समागम्य having met together, अयम् कुशिकात्मज: this Viswamitra, साधु rightly, महर्षिशब्दम् title of Maharshi, लभताम् be obtained, आमन्त्रयन् thought over.
explanation: After consultations the gods and sages decided that this son of Kushika (Viswamitra)  deserved the status of a Maharshi".

shloka_text: देवतानां वच श्शृत्वा सर्वलोकपितामह:। अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं विश्वामित्रं तपोधनम्।।1.63.17।।
transliteration: devatānāṃ vaca śśṛtvā sarvalokapitāmaha:| abravīnmadhuraṃ vākyaṃ viśvāmitraṃ tapodhanam
translation: सर्वलोकपितामह: grandsire of the worlds, Brahma, देवतानाम् devatas, वच: words, श्रुत्वा haivng heard, तपोधनम् great ascetic, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, मधुरम् sweet, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard the gods, the Grandsire of the worlds (Brahma) addressed  Viswamitra whose wealth was his ascetism in these sweet words.

shloka_text: महर्षे स्वागतं वत्स तपसोग्रेण तोषित:। महत्त्वमृषिमुख्यत्वं ददामि तव कौशिक ।।1.63.18।।
transliteration: maharṣe svāgataṃ vatsa tapasogreṇa toṣita:| mahattvamṛṣimukhyatvaṃ dadāmi tava kauśika
translation: महर्षे O Maharshi, वत्स O Child, स्वागतम् welcome, उग्रेण with intense, तपसा austerities, तोषित: I have been pleased, कौशिक O Son of Kusika, Visvamitra, तव your, महत्त्वम् eminenence, ऋषिमुख्यत्वम् preeminence among sages (maharshi hood), ददामि I here by give.
explanation: "O Maharshi O Child welcome Pleased with your intense austerities, O Son of Kushika I confer upon you the eminent rank of a great rishi (maharshi)".

shloka_text: ब्रह्मणस्स वचश्श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकेश्वरस्य ह। न विषण्णो न सन्तुष्टो विश्वामित्रस्तपोधन:।।1.63.19।।
transliteration: brahmaṇassa vacaśśrutvā sarvalokeśvarasya ha| na viṣaṇṇo na santuṣṭo viśvāmitrastapodhana:
translation: तपोधन: the great ascetic, स: विश्वामित्र: afterwards, सर्वलोकेश्वरस्य of the lord of all worlds, ब्रह्मण: Brahma, वच: words, श्रुत्वा having heard, न विषण्ण: not dejected, न सन्तुष्ट: not pleased.
explanation: Having heard the words Brahman, the lord of all the worlds, Viswamitra whose wealth was his asceticism was neither dejected nor delighted.

shloka_text: प्राञ्जलि: प्रणतो भूत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहम्। प्रत्युवाच ततो वाचं विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:।।1.63.20।।
transliteration: prāñjali: praṇato bhūtvā sarvalokapitāmaham| pratyuvāca tato vācaṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuni:
translation: तत: then, महामुनि: mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, प्राञ्जलि: with folded hands, प्रणत:  भूत्वा having bowed, सर्वलोकपितामहम् grandsire of all worlds, वाचम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: Then the mighty ascetic Viswamitra bowed to Brahma, the Grandsire of all the worlds with folded hands and replied:

shloka_text: महर्षिशब्दमतुलं स्वार्जितै: कर्मभिश्शुभै:। यदि मे भगवानाह ततोऽहं विजितेन्द्रिय:।।1.63.21।।
transliteration: maharṣiśabdamatulaṃ svārjitai: karmabhiśśubhai:| yadi me bhagavānāha tato'haṃ vijitendriya:
translation: भगवान् adorable one, स्वार्जितै: earned by me, शुभै: by the auspicious, कर्मभि: deeds, अतुलम् incomparble, महर्षिशब्दम् title of Maharshi, मे to me, आह यदि if it has been told, तत: then, अहम् I, विजितेन्द्रिय: have conquered my senses.
explanation: "O Adorable one, if you have conferred the incomparable title of 'Maharshi' earned by my auspicious deeds, I feel I have conquered the senses."

shloka_text: तमुवाच ततो ब्रह्मा न तावत् त्त्वं जितेन्द्रिय:। यतस्व मुनिशार्दूल इत्युक्त्वा त्रिदिवं गत:।।1.63.22।।
transliteration: tamuvāca tato brahmā na tāvat ttvaṃ jitendriya:| yatasva muniśārdūla ityuktvā tridivaṃ gata:
translation: तत: then, ब्रह्मा Brahma, तम् addressing him, उवाच said, त्त्वम् you, जितेन्द्रियस्तावत् having conquered the senses, न not, मुनिशार्दूल O Best among ascestics, यतस्व strive still, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, त्रिदिवम् towards heaven, गत: went.
explanation: Then Brahma said to him, 'You have not conquered the senses yet. O Tiger among ascetics, strive still.' Having said this he went toward heaven.

shloka_text: विप्रस्थितेषु देवेषु विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्निरालम्बो वायुभक्षस्तपश्चरन्।।1.63.23।।
transliteration: viprasthiteṣu deveṣu viśvāmitro mahāmuni:| ūrdhvabāhurnirālambo vāyubhakṣastapaścaran
translation: देवेषु when devatas, विप्रस्थितेषु सत्सु after having departed, महामुनि: mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, ऊर्ध्वबाहु: with arms raised upwards, निरालम्ब: without support, वायुभक्ष: subsisting on air, तपश्चरन् while performimg.
explanation: After the departure of the gods, mighty ascetic Viswamitra raised his arms up, stood without support, subsisting on air, continuing with his austerities.

shloka_text: घर्मे पञ्चतपा भूत्वा वर्षास्वाकाशसंश्रय:। शिशिरे सलिलस्थायी रात्र्यहानि तपोधन:।।1.63.24।। एवं वर्षसहस्रं हि तपो घोरमुपागमत्।
transliteration: gharme pañcatapā bhūtvā varṣāsvākāśasaṃśraya:| śiśire salilasthāyī rātryahāni tapodhana: evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ hi tapo ghoramupāgamat|
translation: तपोधन: that Visvamitra whose asceticism was his wealth, घर्मे in summer, पञ्चतपा: भूत्वा performing penance amidst five fires, वर्षासु during rainy season, आकाशसंश्रयः taking refuge under the open sky, शिशिरे in the cold season, रात्र्यहानि day and night, सलिलस्थायी immersed in water, एवम् thus, वर्षसहस्रम् for a thousand years, घोरम् rigid, तप: austerities, उपागमत् performed.
explanation: Viswamitra whose wealth was his penance carried on his rigid austerities for a thousand years amidst five fires, in summer, under the open sky in monsoon, and   immersed in ater night and day in winter.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् सन्तप्यमाने तु विश्वामित्रे महामुनौ।।1.63.25।। सम्भ्रमस्सुमहानासीत्सुराणां वासवस्य च।
transliteration: tasmin santapyamāne tu viśvāmitre mahāmunau sambhramassumahānāsītsurāṇāṃ vāsavasya ca|
translation: महामुनौ when the mighty ascestic, तस्मिन् विश्वामित्रे that Visvamitra, सन्तप्यमाने while peforming penance, सुराणाम् for devatas, वासवस्य च for Indra also, सुमहान् greatly, संभ्रम: आसीत् perturbance over took.
explanation: When the mighty asetic Viswamitra was peforming penance, the gods as well as Indra  got deeply perturbed.

shloka_text: रम्भामप्सरसं शक्र स्सह सर्वैर्मरुद्गणै:। उवाचात्महितं वाक्यमहितं कौशिकस्य च।।1.63.26।।
transliteration: rambhāmapsarasaṃ śakra ssaha sarvairmarudgaṇai:| uvācātmahitaṃ vākyamahitaṃ kauśikasya ca
translation: शक्र: Indra, सर्वै: all, मरुद्गणै: सह along with maruts, आत्महितम् promoting his welfare, कौशिकस्य for Kausika, अहितं च against his welfare, वाक्यम् words, रम्भाम् named Rambha, अप्सरसम् celestial nymph, उवाच said.
explanation: Indra along with all the maruts spoke to the celestial nymph Rambha, words that augured well for them and not for kaushika (Viswamitra). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सुरकार्यमिदं रम्भे कर्तव्यं सुमहत्त्वया। लोभनं कौशिकस्येह काममोहसमन्वितम्।।1.64.1।।
transliteration: surakāryamidaṃ rambhe kartavyaṃ sumahattvayā| lobhanaṃ kauśikasyeha kāmamohasamanvitam
translation: रम्भे O Rambha, इह now, कौशिकस्य Kausika's, काममोहसमन्वितम् possessed by lust and passions, लोभनम् enticing, सुमहत् highly great, इदम् this, सुरकार्यम् work of devatas, त्वया by you, कर्तव्यम् fit to be done.
explanation: "O Rambha you must entice Viswamitra by lust and passion. This important work must be done by you in the interest of the gods".
comments: Viswamitra curses Rambha.

shloka_text: तथोक्ता साऽप्सरा राम सहस्राक्षेण धीमता। व्रीडिता प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं प्रत्युवाच सुरेश्वरम्।।1.64.2।।
transliteration: tathoktā sā'psarā rāma sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā| vrīḍitā prāñjalirvākyaṃ pratyuvāca sureśvaram
translation: राम O Rama, धीमता by the sagacious, सहस्राक्षेण by Indra, तथा thus, उक्ता having been spoken, सा अप्सरा: that apsara, व्रीडिता bashfully, प्रञ्जलि: with folded palms in supplication, सुरेश्वरम् leader of gods Indra, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: O Rama, to these words of the sagacious, thousandeyed Lord of the gods (Indra) that apsara with folded hands bashfully replied:

shloka_text: अयं सुरपते घोरो विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। घोरमुत्सृजते क्रोधं मयि देव न संशय:।।1.64.3।। ततो हि मे भयं देव प्रासादं कर्तुमर्हसि।
transliteration: ayaṃ surapate ghoro viśvāmitro mahāmuni:| ghoramutsṛjate krodhaṃ mayi deva na saṃśaya: tato hi me bhayaṃ deva prāsādaṃ kartumarhasi|
translation: सुरपते O Lord of devatas, अयम् महामुनि: this mighty ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, घोर: is a frightful person, देव O Lord, मयि in me, घोरम् fearful, क्रोधम् wrath, उत्सृजते will release, संशय: न no doubt, तत: for that reason, मे my, भयम् fear, देव O lord, प्रसादम् favour, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि behoves of you.
explanation: 'Lord of the devatas this mighty ascetic Viswamitra is a terrible person. He will ceratinly release on his dreadful anger (curse me). O Lord this is my apprehension. You should excuse me'.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तया राम रम्भया भीतया तदा।।1.64.4।। तामुवाच सहस्राक्षो वेपमानां कृताञ्जलिम्।
transliteration: evamuktastayā rāma rambhayā bhītayā tadā tāmuvāca sahasrākṣo vepamānāṃ kṛtāñjalim|
translation: राम O Rama, भीतया with fear, तया रम्भया by that Rambha, तदा then, एवम् thus, उक्त: spoken, सहस्राक्ष: Indra, वेपमानाम् trembling, कृताञ्जलिम् standing with folded palms, ताम् addressing her, उवाच said.
explanation: O Rama having heard Rambha trembling in fear and standing with folded palms, Indra spoke:

shloka_text: माभैषी रम्भे भद्रं ते कुरुष्व मम शासनम्।।1.64.5।। कोकिलो हृदयग्राही माधवे रुचिरद्रुमे। अहं कन्दर्पसहित स्स्थास्यामि तव पार्श्वत:।।1.64.6।।
transliteration: mābhaiṣī rambhe bhadraṃ te kuruṣva mama śāsanam kokilo hṛdayagrāhī mādhave ruciradrume| ahaṃ kandarpasahita ssthāsyāmi tava pārśvata:
translation: रम्भे O Rambha, मा भैषी: have no fear, ते भद्रम् safety to you, मम my, शासनम् order, कुरुष्व carry out, अहम् I, रुचिरद्रुमे with booming trees, माधवे in the season of Spring, हृदयग्राही captivating the heart, कोकिल: cuckoo, कन्दर्पसहित: in the company of Kandarpa, Cupid, तव your, पार्श्वत: side, स्थास्यामि will stay.
explanation: 'O Rambha have no fear. Feel safe. Carry out my order. When the trees look so beautiful in spring I shall in captivating the form of a cuckoo, stay by your side in the company of Kamadeva (Cupid).

shloka_text: माभैषी रम्भे भद्रं ते कुरुष्व मम शासनम्।।1.64.5।। कोकिलो हृदयग्राही माधवे रुचिरद्रुमे। अहं कन्दर्पसहित स्स्थास्यामि तव पार्श्वत:।।1.64.6।।
transliteration: mābhaiṣī rambhe bhadraṃ te kuruṣva mama śāsanam kokilo hṛdayagrāhī mādhave ruciradrume| ahaṃ kandarpasahita ssthāsyāmi tava pārśvata:
translation: रम्भे O Rambha, मा भैषी: have no fear, ते भद्रम् safety to you, मम my, शासनम् order, कुरुष्व carry out, अहम् I, रुचिरद्रुमे with booming trees, माधवे in the season of Spring, हृदयग्राही captivating the heart, कोकिल: cuckoo, कन्दर्पसहित: in the company of Kandarpa, Cupid, तव your, पार्श्वत: side, स्थास्यामि will stay.
explanation: 'O Rambha have no fear. Feel safe. Carry out my order. When the trees look so beautiful in spring I shall in captivating the form of a cuckoo, stay by your side in the company of Kamadeva (Cupid).

shloka_text: त्वं हि रूपं बहुगुणं कृत्वा परमभास्वरम्। तमृषिं कौशिकं रम्भे भेदयस्व तपस्विनम्।।1.64.7।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi rūpaṃ bahuguṇaṃ kṛtvā paramabhāsvaram| tamṛṣiṃ kauśikaṃ rambhe bhedayasva tapasvinam
translation: रम्भे O Rambha, त्वम् you, बहुगुणम् displaying many romantic gestures, परमभास्वरम् highly shining, रूपम् form, कृत्वा having assumed, तपस्विनम् mighty ascestic, तम् ऋषिम् that rishi, कौशिकम् Visvamitra, भेदयस्व break him (from penance).
explanation: O Rambha displaying many (romantic) gestures and assuming a fascinating form, distract the mighty ascetic, Kausika (Viswamitra)'.

shloka_text: सा श्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य कृत्वा रूपमनुत्तमम्। लोभयामास ललिता विश्वामित्रं शुचिस्मिता।।1.64.8।।
transliteration: sā śrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kṛtvā rūpamanuttamam| lobhayāmāsa lalitā viśvāmitraṃ śucismitā
translation: सा she, तस्य his, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having listened, अनुत्तमम् highly excellent, रूपम् form, कृत्वा having asumed, ललिता beautiful, शुचिस्मिता with bright smile, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, लोभयामास allured.
explanation: At these words (of Indra), Rambha, assumed any form of excellent beauty and with a bright smile set out to allure Viswamitra.

shloka_text: कोकिलस्य च शुश्राव वल्गु व्याहरत: स्वनम्। सम्प्रहृष्टेन मनसा तत एनामुदैक्षत।।1.64.9।।
transliteration: kokilasya ca śuśrāva valgu vyāharata: svanam| samprahṛṣṭena manasā tata enāmudaikṣata
translation: वल्गु sweet, charming, व्याहरत: making notes, कोकिलस्य cuckoo's, स्वनम् voice of, शुश्राव heard, तत: afterwards, सम्प्रहृष्टेन with a delighted, मनसा mind, एनाम् her, उदैक्षत beheld.
explanation: Excited by the charming warble of the cuckoo, Viswamitra opened his eyes.

shloka_text: अथ तस्य च शब्देन गीतेनाप्रतिमेन च। दर्शनेन च रम्भाया मुनिस्सन्देहमागत:।।1.64.10।।
transliteration: atha tasya ca śabdena gītenāpratimena ca| darśanena ca rambhāyā munissandehamāgata:
translation: अथ afterwards, तस्य that cuckoo's, शब्देन sounds, अप्रतिमेन incomparable, गीतेन song, रम्भाया: with the Rambha's, दर्शनेन च presence also, मुनि: the ascetic, सन्देहम् doubt,  आगत: arose.
explanation: On hearing the sound of the incomparable song of the cuckoo along with the  sight of Rambha, a doubt arose in the mind of the ascetic.

shloka_text: सहस्राक्षस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय मुनिपुङ्गव:। रम्भां क्रोधसमाविष्ट श्शशाप कुशिकात्मज:।।1.64.11।।
transliteration: sahasrākṣasya tatkarma vijñāya munipuṅgava:| rambhāṃ krodhasamāviṣṭa śśaśāpa kuśikātmaja:
translation: मुनिपुङ्गव: eminent ascetic, कुशिकात्मज: son of Kusika, सहस्राक्षस्य Indra's, तत् that one, कर्म work, विज्ञाय having recognised, क्रोधसमाविष्ट: seized of anger, रम्भाम् Rambha, शशाप cursed.
explanation: Son of Kushika, the eminent ascetic knew it was the work of Indra. Seized with anger, he cursed Rambha:

shloka_text: यन्मां लोभयसे रम्भे कामक्रोधजयैषिणम्। दशवर्षसहस्राणि शैली स्थास्यसि दुर्भगे ।।1.64.12।।
transliteration: yanmāṃ lobhayase rambhe kāmakrodhajayaiṣiṇam| daśavarṣasahasrāṇi śailī sthāsyasi durbhage
translation: दुर्भगे O Unfortunate one, रम्भे Rambha, कामक्रोधजयैषिणम् with a desire to conquer wrath and passion, माम् me, यत् since, लोभयसे seduce me (for that reason), दश वर्षसहस्राणि ten thousand years, शैली as rock, स्थास्यसि shall become.
explanation: 'O luckless Rambha, since you have endeavoured to distract me from my desire to conquer  wrath and passion, you shall turn into a rock and remain so for ten thousand years'.

shloka_text: ब्राह्मण स्सुमहातेजा स्तपोबलसमन्वित:। उद्धरिष्यति रम्भे त्वां मत्क्रोधकलुषीकृताम्।।1.64.13।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇa ssumahātejā stapobalasamanvita:| uddhariṣyati rambhe tvāṃ matkrodhakaluṣīkṛtām
translation: रम्भे O Rambha, सुमहातेजा: highly splendrous, तपोबलसमन्वित: endowed with the power of asceticism, ब्राह्मण: Brahmana, मत्क्रोधकलुषीकृताम् fouled on account of my anger, त्वाम् you, उद्धरिष्यति will liberate.
explanation: 'O Rambha an effulgent brahmin, endowed with the power of asceticism, will liberate you from this state into which you have fallen on account of my anger'.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजा विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:। अशक्नुवन् धारयितुं क्रोधं सन्तापमागत:।।1.64.14।।
transliteration: evamuktvā mahātejā viśvāmitro mahāmuni:| aśaknuvan dhārayituṃ krodhaṃ santāpamāgata:
translation: महातेजा: exceedingly lustrous, महामुनि: great sage, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, क्रोधम् anger, धारयितुम् to contain, अशक्नुवन् unable, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सन्तापम् distress, आगत: experienced.
explanation: The brilliant Viswamitra, the great ascetic, now experienced remorse for his inability to contain anger.

shloka_text: तस्य शापेन महता रम्भा शैली तदाऽभवत्। वचश्शृत्वा च कन्दर्पो महर्षेस्स च निर्गत:।।1.64.15।।
transliteration: tasya śāpena mahatā rambhā śailī tadā'bhavat| vacaśśṛtvā ca kandarpo maharṣessa ca nirgata:
translation: तदा then, तस्य his महता by great, शापेन (because of )curse, रम्भा Rambha, शैली अभवत् became a rock, महर्षे: maharshi's, वच: words, श्रुत्वा having listened, कन्दर्प: Kandarapa, स: च devendra, निर्गत: fled away.
explanation: This mighty curse, of the great saint transformed Rambha into a rock and sent Kamadeva and Indra to their heels.

shloka_text: कोपेन स महातेजास्तपोऽपहरणे कृते। इन्द्रियैरजितै राम न लेभे शान्तिमात्मन:।।1.64.16।।
transliteration: kopena sa mahātejāstapo'paharaṇe kṛte| indriyairajitai rāma na lebhe śāntimātmana:
translation: राम O Rama, महातेजा: highly powerful, स: Visvamitra, कोपेन with anger, तपोपहरणे in deprivation of his ascetic merit, कृते having been made, अजितै: with unconquered,  इन्द्रियै: senses, आत्मन: his own, शान्तिम् peace, न लेभे did not get.
explanation: "O Rama highly powerful Viswamitra was deprived of his ascetic merit due to his anger. He had no peace of mind for his inability to control his senses.

shloka_text: बभूवास्य मनश्चिन्ता तपोऽपहरणे कृते । नैव क्रोधं गमिष्यामि न च वक्ष्ये कथञ्चन।।1.64.17।।
transliteration: babhūvāsya manaścintā tapo'paharaṇe kṛte | naiva krodhaṃ gamiṣyāmi na ca vakṣye kathañcana
translation: तपोपहरणे कृते having been deprived of his ascetic merit, अस्य for him, मनश्चिन्ता बभूव thought arose in his mind, क्रोधम् anger, नैव गमिष्यामि never shall I obtain, कथञ्चन in what  so ever manner, न च वक्ष्ये I shall not speak also.
explanation: Having been deprived of his ascetic merit, he resolved not to lose his temper nor ever breathe a word".

shloka_text: अथवा नोच्छवसिष्यामि संवत्सरशतान्यपि। अहं विशोषयिष्यामि ह्यात्मानं विजितेन्द्रिय:।।1.64.18।।
transliteration: athavā nocchavasiṣyāmi saṃvatsaraśatānyapi| ahaṃ viśoṣayiṣyāmi hyātmānaṃ vijitendriya:
translation: अथवा further, संवत्सरशतान्यपि even for hundreds of years, नोच्छवसिष्यामि I shall not breathe, अहम् I, विजितेन्द्रिय: having conquered my senses, आत्मानम् this body, विशोषयिष्यामि will emaciate.
explanation: "Further, I shall not even inhale for hundreds of years. I shall conquer my senses and dry up this body.

shloka_text: तावद्यावद्धि मे प्राप्तं ब्राह्मण्यं तपसाऽऽर्जितम्। अनुच्छवसन्नभुञ्जान स्तिष्ठेयं शाश्वतीस्समा:।।1.64.19।। न हि मे तप्यमानस्य क्षयं यास्यन्ति मूर्तय:।
transliteration: tāvadyāvaddhi me prāptaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ tapasā''rjitam| anucchavasannabhuñjāna stiṣṭheyaṃ śāśvatīssamā: na hi me tapyamānasya kṣayaṃ yāsyanti mūrtaya:|
translation: मे for me, तपसा by austerities, आर्जितम् earned, ब्राह्मण्यम् brahminhood, यावत् until, प्रप्तम् is obtained, तावत् till then, अनुच्छवसन् suspending my breath, अभुञ्जान: abstaining from  food, शाश्वती: समा: for innumerable years, तिष्ठेयम् I shall stay, तप्यमानसय while performing austerities, मे my, मूर्तय: limbs, क्षयम् deterioration, न यास्यन्ति will not get.
explanation: Until brahminhood is obtained by my austerities, I shall stay without breathing or eating for innumerable years. While performing penance, my limbs shall not undergo deterioration".

shloka_text: एवं वर्षसहस्रस्य दीक्षां स मुनिपुङ्गव:।।1.64.20।। चकाराप्रतिमां लोके प्रतिज्ञां रघुनन्दन।
transliteration: evaṃ varṣasahasrasya dīkṣāṃ sa munipuṅgava: cakārāpratimāṃ loke pratijñāṃ raghunandana|
translation: रघुनन्दन O Rama, स: मुनिपुङ्गव: that eminent ascetic, एवम् in this way, लोके in this world, अप्रतिमाम् unparalleled, वर्षसहस्रस्य दीक्षाम् religious practices for a thousand years,  प्रतिज्ञां vow, चकार made.
explanation: "O Descendant of Raghu in this way that eminent ascetic took an unprecedented vow to practise penance for a thousand years". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे चतुष्षष्टितमस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixtyfourth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथ हैमवतीं राम दिशं त्यक्त्वा महामुनि:। पूर्वां दिशमनुप्राप्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्।।1.65.1।।
transliteration: atha haimavatīṃ rāma diśaṃ tyaktvā mahāmuni:| pūrvāṃ diśamanuprāpya tapastepe sudāruṇam
translation: राम O Rama, अथ thereafter, महामुनि: great ascetic Visvamitra, हैमवतीम् relating to Himavat mountain, दिशम् quarter, त्यक्त्वा abandoning, पूर्वां दिशम् eastern quarter, अनुप्राप्य having reached, सुदारुणम् rigorous, तप: austerities, तेपे performed.
explanation: "O Rama thereafter the great ascetic (Viswamitra), abandoning the north of the Himavat mountain reached the eastern quarter and performed rigorous austerities.
comments: Satananda completes his narration of how Viswamitra attains Brahmarshi status.

shloka_text: मौनं वर्षसहस्रस्य कृत्वा व्रतमनुत्तमम्। चकाराप्रतिमं राम तप: परमदुष्करम्।।1.65.2।।
transliteration: maunaṃ varṣasahasrasya kṛtvā vratamanuttamam| cakārāpratimaṃ rāma tapa: paramaduṣkaram
translation: राम O Rama, वर्षसहस्रस्य for a thousand years, अनुत्तमम् immense, मौनं व्रतं vow of silence, कृत्वा having observed, अप्रतिमम् unprecedented, परमदुष्करम् extremely difficult, तप: austerities, चकार practised.
explanation: Having observed a unique vow of silence for a thousand years, O Rama he practised unprecedented and extremely difficult austerities.

shloka_text: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु काष्ठभूतं महामुनिम्। विघ्नैर्बहुभिराधूतं क्रोधो नान्तर आविशत्।।1.65.3।। स कृत्वा निश्चयं राम तप आतिष्टदव्ययम्।
transliteration: pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu kāṣṭhabhūtaṃ mahāmunim| vighnairbahubhirādhūtaṃ krodho nāntara āviśat sa kṛtvā niścayaṃ rāma tapa ātiṣṭadavyayam|
translation: वर्षसहस्रे when thousand years, पूर्णे were completed, काष्ठभूतम् almost like a piece of wood, महामुनिम् mighty ascetic, बहुभि: several, विघ्नै: with impediments, आधूतम् unshaken, क्रोध: anger, अन्तरे in his mind, न आविशत् did not enter, राम O Rama, स: he, निश्चयम् determination, कृत्वा having made, अव्ययम् immense, तप: austerities, आतिष्ठत् practised.
explanation: After completion of a thousand years the great ascetic became a piece of wood. In spite of many impediments, he was unshaken, anger did not enter into his mind. O Rama with firm determination he practised  austerities.

shloka_text: तस्य वर्षसहस्रस्य व्रते पूर्णे महाव्रत:।।1.65.4।। भोक्तुमारब्धवानन्नं तस्मिन् काले रघूत्तम। इन्द्रो द्विजातिर्भूत्वा तं सिद्धमन्नमयाचत।।1.65.5।।
transliteration: tasya varṣasahasrasya vrate pūrṇe mahāvrata: bhoktumārabdhavānannaṃ tasmin kāle raghūttama| indro dvijātirbhūtvā taṃ siddhamannamayācata
translation: रघूत्तम O Rama, तस्य for him, वर्षसहस्रस्य of a thousand years, व्रते when the vow, पूर्णे had been completed, महाव्रत: one rigidly observing vows, अन्नम् cooked rice, भोक्तुम् to partake,  आरब्धवान् commenced, तस्मिन् काले that moment, इन्द्र: Indra, द्विजाति: भूत्वा assuming the guise of a brahmin, तम् him, सिद्धम् cooked and set ready for consumption, अन्नम् rice, अयाचत asked.
explanation: O Best of Raghus dynasty (Rama) when the thousandyearold vow was over (Viswamitra) the great practitioner of vows began to partake cooked rice. At this moment Indra assumed the guise of a brahmin and asked him for the rice (he was going to eat).

shloka_text: तस्य वर्षसहस्रस्य व्रते पूर्णे महाव्रत:।।1.65.4।। भोक्तुमारब्धवानन्नं तस्मिन् काले रघूत्तम। इन्द्रो द्विजातिर्भूत्वा तं सिद्धमन्नमयाचत।।1.65.5।।
transliteration: tasya varṣasahasrasya vrate pūrṇe mahāvrata: bhoktumārabdhavānannaṃ tasmin kāle raghūttama| indro dvijātirbhūtvā taṃ siddhamannamayācata
translation: रघूत्तम O Rama, तस्य for him, वर्षसहस्रस्य of a thousand years, व्रते when the vow, पूर्णे had been completed, महाव्रत: one rigidly observing vows, अन्नम् cooked rice, भोक्तुम् to partake,  आरब्धवान् commenced, तस्मिन् काले that moment, इन्द्र: Indra, द्विजाति: भूत्वा assuming the guise of a brahmin, तम् him, सिद्धम् cooked and set ready for consumption, अन्नम् rice, अयाचत asked.
explanation: O Best of Raghus dynasty (Rama) when the thousandyearold vow was over (Viswamitra) the great practitioner of vows began to partake cooked rice. At this moment Indra assumed the guise of a brahmin and asked him for the rice (he was going to eat).

shloka_text: तस्मै दत्वा तदा सिद्धं सर्वं विप्राय निश्चित:। निश्शेषितेऽन्ने भगवानभुक्तैव महातपा:।।1.65.6।। न किञ्चिदवदद्विप्रं मौनव्रतमुपस्थित:। अथ वर्षसहस्रं वै नोच्छ्वसन्मुनिपुङ्गव:।।1.65.7।।
transliteration: tasmai datvā tadā siddhaṃ sarvaṃ viprāya niścita:| niśśeṣite'nne bhagavānabhuktaiva mahātapā: na kiñcidavadadvipraṃ maunavratamupasthita:| atha varṣasahasraṃ vai nocchvasanmunipuṅgava:
translation: भगवान् adorable, महातपा: mighty ascetic, मौनव्रतम् vow of silence, उपास्थित: having adopted, निश्चित: firmly determined, तदा then, सिद्धम् kept ready, सर्वम् all that rice, तस्मै  विप्राय for that Brahmin, दत्वा having given, अन्ने when the cooked rice, निश्शेषिते without remainder was consumed, अभुक्तैव without eating food, विप्रम् brahmin, किञ्चित् little, न अवदत् did not utter a word, अथ thereafter, मुनिपुङ्गव: best of ascetics, वर्षसहस्रं thousand years, नोच्छ्वसत् did not breathe.
explanation: This mighty, adorable ascetic having adopted a vow of silence decided to give all the cooked rice to the Brahmin. The brahmin finished all the rice. Viswamitra went without food but did not utter a single word to the brahmin. Thereafter the distinguished ascetic practised austerities for another period of thousand years, his breath suspended.

shloka_text: तस्मै दत्वा तदा सिद्धं सर्वं विप्राय निश्चित:। निश्शेषितेऽन्ने भगवानभुक्तैव महातपा:।।1.65.6।। न किञ्चिदवदद्विप्रं मौनव्रतमुपस्थित:। अथ वर्षसहस्रं वै नोच्छ्वसन्मुनिपुङ्गव:।।1.65.7।।
transliteration: tasmai datvā tadā siddhaṃ sarvaṃ viprāya niścita:| niśśeṣite'nne bhagavānabhuktaiva mahātapā: na kiñcidavadadvipraṃ maunavratamupasthita:| atha varṣasahasraṃ vai nocchvasanmunipuṅgava:
translation: भगवान् adorable, महातपा: mighty ascetic, मौनव्रतम् vow of silence, उपास्थित: having adopted, निश्चित: firmly determined, तदा then, सिद्धम् kept ready, सर्वम् all that rice, तस्मै  विप्राय for that Brahmin, दत्वा having given, अन्ने when the cooked rice, निश्शेषिते without remainder was consumed, अभुक्तैव without eating food, विप्रम् brahmin, किञ्चित् little, न अवदत् did not utter a word, अथ thereafter, मुनिपुङ्गव: best of ascetics, वर्षसहस्रं thousand years, नोच्छ्वसत् did not breathe.
explanation: This mighty, adorable ascetic having adopted a vow of silence decided to give all the cooked rice to the Brahmin. The brahmin finished all the rice. Viswamitra went without food but did not utter a single word to the brahmin. Thereafter the distinguished ascetic practised austerities for another period of thousand years, his breath suspended.

shloka_text: तस्यानुच्छ्वसमानस्य मूर्ध्नि धूमो व्यजायत। त्रैलोक्यं येन सम्भ्रान्तमादीपितमिवाभवत्।।1.65.8।।
transliteration: tasyānucchvasamānasya mūrdhni dhūmo vyajāyata| trailokyaṃ yena sambhrāntamādīpitamivābhavat
translation: अनुच्छ्वसमानस्य while he was suspending his breath, तस्य Visvamitra's, मूर्ध्नि on his head, धूम: smoke, व्यजायत emanated, येन by which, त्रैलोक्यम् three worlds, सम्भ्रान्तम् agitated, आदीपितमिव अभवत् was as thoughset on fire.
explanation: While his breath, was suspended, smoke emanated from his head which frightened the three worlds. It appeared as though they were on fire.

shloka_text: ततो देवास्सगन्धर्वा: पन्नगोरगराक्षसा:। मोहितास्तेजसा तस्य तपसा मन्दरश्मय:।।1.65.9।। कश्मलोपहता स्सर्वे पितामहमथाब्रुवन्।
transliteration: tato devāssagandharvā: pannagoragarākṣasā:| mohitāstejasā tasya tapasā mandaraśmaya: kaśmalopahatā ssarve pitāmahamathābruvan|
translation: तत: thereupon, देवा: devatas, सगन्धर्वा: along with gandharvas, पन्नगोरगरराक्षसा: pannagas, uragas, rakshasas, तस्य his, तेजसा by ascetic energy, मोहिता: bewildered, तपसा by his penance, मन्दरश्मय: with dimmed glory, कश्मलोपहता: afflicted with anguish, अथ thereafter, सर्वे all, पितामहम् addressing grandsire, अब्रुवन् spoke.
explanation: Thereupon devatas along with gandharvas, pannagas, uragas, and rakshasas, stood bewildered by his ascetic energy. Their own glory was dimmed in his lustre". Afflicted with anguish, they spoke to the Grandsire (Brahma):

shloka_text: बहुभि: कारणैर्देव विश्वामित्रो महामुनि:।।1.65.10।। लोभित: क्रोधितश्चैव तपसा चाभिवर्धते।
transliteration: bahubhi: kāraṇairdeva viśvāmitro mahāmuni: lobhita: krodhitaścaiva tapasā cābhivardhate|
translation: देव O Divine lord, महामुनि: great ascetic, विश्वामित्र: Visvamitra, बहुभि: with various, कारणै: by reasons, लोभित: having been lured, क्रोधितश्चैव having been angered, तपसा with his austerities, अभिवर्धते is growing:
explanation: "O Lord the great sage Viswamitra was lured and angered in various ways. But his austerities continued to grow:

shloka_text: न ह्यस्य वृजिनं किञ्चिद्दृश्यते सूक्ष्ममप्यथ।।1.65.11।। न दीयते यदि त्वस्य मनसा यदभीप्सितम्। विनाशयति त्रैलोक्यं तपसा सचराचरम्।।1.65.12।।
transliteration: na hyasya vṛjinaṃ kiñciddṛśyate sūkṣmamapyatha na dīyate yadi tvasya manasā yadabhīpsitam| vināśayati trailokyaṃ tapasā sacarācaram
translation: अथ also, अस्य his, सूक्ष्ममपि even minute, वृजिनम् sin, किञ्चित् a little, न दृश्यते not to be seen, अस्य his, मनसा by mind, यत् which, अभीप्सितम् is desired, न दीयते यदि if not given,  तपसा with his austerities, सचराचरम् moveable and immoveable, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds together, विनाशयति will destroy.
explanation: His penance was flawless. If his wishes were not granted, he will  surely destroy by his austerities the three worlds with all movables and immovables.

shloka_text: न ह्यस्य वृजिनं किञ्चिद्दृश्यते सूक्ष्ममप्यथ।।1.65.11।। न दीयते यदि त्वस्य मनसा यदभीप्सितम्। विनाशयति त्रैलोक्यं तपसा सचराचरम्।।1.65.12।।
transliteration: na hyasya vṛjinaṃ kiñciddṛśyate sūkṣmamapyatha na dīyate yadi tvasya manasā yadabhīpsitam| vināśayati trailokyaṃ tapasā sacarācaram
translation: अथ also, अस्य his, सूक्ष्ममपि even minute, वृजिनम् sin, किञ्चित् a little, न दृश्यते not to be seen, अस्य his, मनसा by mind, यत् which, अभीप्सितम् is desired, न दीयते यदि if not given,  तपसा with his austerities, सचराचरम् moveable and immoveable, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds together, विनाशयति will destroy.
explanation: His penance was flawless. If his wishes were not granted, he will  surely destroy by his austerities the three worlds with all movables and immovables.

shloka_text: व्याकुलाश्च दिशस्सर्वा न च किञ्चित्प्रकाशते। सागरा: क्षुभितास्सर्वे विशीर्यन्ते च पर्वता:।।1.65.13।।
transliteration: vyākulāśca diśassarvā na ca kiñcitprakāśate| sāgarā: kṣubhitāssarve viśīryante ca parvatā:
translation: सर्वा: all, दिश: quarters, व्याकुला: bewildered, किञ्चित् even a little, न प्रकाशते is not shining, सर्वे all, सागरा: seas, क्षुभिता: are agitated, पर्वता: mountains, विशीर्यन्ते are riven.
explanation: There is bewilderment everywhere. It is dark all over. The oceans are disturbed. The mountains have cracked.

shloka_text: प्रकम्पते च पृथिवी वायुर्वाति भृशाकुल:। बृह्मन्न प्रतिजानीमोनास्तिको जायते जन:।।1.65.14।।
transliteration: prakampate ca pṛthivī vāyurvāti bhṛśākula:| bṛhmanna pratijānīmonāstiko jāyate jana:
translation: ब्रह्मन् O Brahma, पृथिवी earth, प्रकम्पते is trembling, वायु: wind, भृशाकुल: is excessively affected, वाति is blowing, न प्रतिजानीम: we do not know what to do, जन: men, नास्तिक: atheist, जायते are becoming.
explanation: O Brahma the earth trembles. The wind blows fiercely. The people have ceased to believe in God. We do not know the way out.

shloka_text: सम्मूढमिव त्रैलोक्यं सम्प्रक्षुभितमानसम्। भास्करो निष्प्रभश्चैव महर्षेस्तस्य तेजसा।।1.65.15।।
transliteration: sammūḍhamiva trailokyaṃ samprakṣubhitamānasam| bhāskaro niṣprabhaścaiva maharṣestasya tejasā
translation: त्रैलोक्यम् three worlds put together, सम्प्रक्षुभितमानसम् with agitated minds, सम्मूढमिव looking as though fainted, तस्य महर्षे: by that maharshi's, तेजसा lustre, भास्करश्च even Sun also, निष्प्रभ: is devoid of brilliance.
explanation: The people of all the three worlds are agitated and confused in mind. The Sun, too, looks pale before the brilliance of the Maharshi.

shloka_text: बुद्धिं न कुरुते यावन्नाशे देव महामुनि:। तावत्प्रसाद्यो भगवा नग्निरूपोमहाद्युति:।।1.65.16।।
transliteration: buddhiṃ na kurute yāvannāśe deva mahāmuni:| tāvatprasādyo bhagavā nagnirūpomahādyuti:
translation: देव O Lord, महामुनि: the mighty ascetic, नाशे in destruction, यावत् until, बुद्धिम् mind, न कुरुते does not make, तावत् till then, अग्निरूप: resembling fire, महाद्युति: highly effulgent, भगवान् venerable, Visvamitra, प्रसाद्य: should be appeased.
explanation: O Lord before this mighty, venerable ascetic, effulgent like fire decides to destroy the three worlds, he should be appeased.

shloka_text: कालाग्निना यथापूर्वं त्रैलोक्यं दह्यतेऽखिलम्। देवराज्यं चिकीर्षेत दीयतामस्य यन्मतम्।।1.65.17।।
transliteration: kālāgninā yathāpūrvaṃ trailokyaṃ dahyate'khilam| devarājyaṃ cikīrṣeta dīyatāmasya yanmatam
translation: अखिलम् entire, त्रैलोक्यम् three worlds, पूर्वम् formerly, कालाग्निना by fire at the dissolution of worlds, यथा in that manner, दह्यते is burnt, देवराज्यम् kingdom of devatas, चिकीर्षेत if he  wants to rule, अस्य for him, यत् which, मतम् likes, दीयताम् be given.
explanation: All the three worlds are burning as though with the fire Pralaya (dissolution). His desire may be granted even if he wants to rule the kingdom of the gods.

shloka_text: ततस्सुरगणास्सर्वे पितामहपुरोगमा:। विश्वामित्रं महात्मानं मधुरं वाक्यमब्रुवन्।।1.65.18।।
transliteration: tatassuragaṇāssarve pitāmahapurogamā:| viśvāmitraṃ mahātmānaṃ madhuraṃ vākyamabruvan
translation: तत: thereafter, पितामहपुरोगमा: with Brahma in the forefront, सर्वे सुरगणा: hosts of devatas,  महात्मानम् magnanimous, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, मधुरम् sweet, वाक्यम् words, अब्रुवन् spoke.
explanation: Thereafter, with Brahma in the forefront, the gods spoke to Viswamitra in pleasing words:

shloka_text: ब्रह्मर्षे स्वागतं तेऽस्तु तपसा स्म सुतोषिता:। ब्राह्मण्यं तपसोग्रेण प्राप्तवानसि कौशिक ।।1.65.19।।
transliteration: brahmarṣe svāgataṃ te'stu tapasā sma sutoṣitā:| brāhmaṇyaṃ tapasogreṇa prāptavānasi kauśika
translation: ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, ते to you, स्वागतम् welcome, तपसा with your austerities, सुतोषिता: स्म: we are immensely pleased, कौशिक O Viswmitra, उग्रेण by intense, तपसा austerities, ब्राह्मण्यम् brahminhood, प्राप्तवान् असि you have attained.
explanation: "Welcome, O Brahmarshi. We are immensely pleased with your austerities. O Kausika you have attained brahminhood by means of your intense penance.

shloka_text: दीर्घमायुश्च ते ब्रह्मन् ददामि समरुद्गण:। स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते गच्छ सौम्य यथासुखम्।।1.65.20।।
transliteration: dīrghamāyuśca te brahman dadāmi samarudgaṇa:| svasti prāpnuhi bhadraṃ te gaccha saumya yathāsukham
translation: ब्रह्मन् O Brahmana, समरुद्गण: I, together with hosts of maruts, ते to you, दीर्घम् long, आयुश्च life, ददामि am giving, स्वस्ति wellbeing, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, प्राप्नुहि you may obtain, सौम्य O Gentle one, यथा सुखम् happily, गच्छ go.
explanation: O Brahmana I along with the maruts grant you long life. May you prosper O Gentle one now you may go happily".

shloka_text: पितामहवचश्शृत्वा सर्वेषां च दिवौकसाम्। कृत्वा प्रणामं मुदितो व्याजहार महामुनि:।।1.65.21।।
transliteration: pitāmahavacaśśṛtvā sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām| kṛtvā praṇāmaṃ mudito vyājahāra mahāmuni:
translation: महामुनि: mighty ascetic, पितामह वच: words of grand sire, सर्वेषाम् all, दिवौकसाम्च words of devatas, श्रुत्वा having heard, मुदित: delighted, प्रणामम् obeisance, कृत्वा having made, व्याजहार spoke.
explanation: Mighty ascetic Viswamitra was delighted to hear the words of the Grandsire and the gods. Bowing to all of them he thus spoke:

shloka_text: ब्राह्मण्यं यदि मे प्राप्तं दीर्घमायुस्तथैव च। ओङ्कारश्च वषट्कारो वेदाश्च वरयन्तु माम्।।1.65.22।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi me prāptaṃ dīrghamāyustathaiva ca| oṅkāraśca vaṣaṭkāro vedāśca varayantu mām
translation: मे for me, ब्राह्मण्यम् brahminhood, प्राप्तम् यदि if acquired, तथैव च and similarly, दीर्घम् long, आयुश्च life, ओङ्कारश्च Omkara, वषट्कारश्च Vashatkara, वेदाश्च vedas, माम् me, वरयन्तु accept.
explanation: "If brahminhood and long life have been acquired by me by your grace, Omkara, Vashatkara and the Vedas shall accept me as Brahmarshi. (I shall acquire the right to interpret the Vedas and to perform sacrifices.)

shloka_text: क्षत्रवेदविदां श्रेष्ठो ब्रह्मवेदविदामपि। ब्रह्मपुत्रो वसिष्ठो मामेवं वदतु देवता:।।1.65.23।। यद्ययं परम: काम: कृतो यान्तु सुरर्षभा:।
transliteration: kṣatravedavidāṃ śreṣṭho brahmavedavidāmapi| brahmaputro vasiṣṭho māmevaṃ vadatu devatā: yadyayaṃ parama: kāma: kṛto yāntu surarṣabhā:|
translation: देवता: O devatas, क्षत्रवेदविदाम् knowledgeable in vedas worthy of kshatriyas like archery, etc, ब्रह्मवेदविदामपि knowledgeable in vedas worthy to brahmins, श्रेष्ठ: eminent, ब्रह्मपुत्र: son of Brahma, वसिष्ठ: Vasishta, माम् me, एवम् thus, वदतु speak, अयम् this, परम: supreme, काम: desire, कृत:यदि if done, सुरर्षभा: best of devatas, यान्तु you can go.
