Even after (intensely) gazing at Rama approaching, the king (Dasaratha) was not satiated.

shloka_text: ﻿अवतार्य सुमन्त्रस्तं राघवं स्यन्दनोत्तमात्।।2.3.30।। पितुस्समीपं गच्छन्तं प्राञ्जलिः पृष्ठतोऽन्वगात्।
transliteration: ﻿avatārya sumantrastaṃ rāghavaṃ syandanottamāt pitussamīpaṃ gacchantaṃ prāñjaliḥ pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt|
translation: ﻿ सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, तम् राघवम् that Rama, स्यन्दनोत्तमात् from that splendid chariot, अवतार्य having assisted him to alight, पितुः to father's, समीपम् proximity, गच्छन्तम् proceeding, प्राञ्जलि: with folded palms, पृष्ठतः behind, अन्वगात् followed.
explanation: ﻿ Sumantra assisted Rama while alighting from that splendid chariot and followed him with folded palms as Rama was proceeding towards his father.

shloka_text: ﻿स तं कैलासशृङ्गाभं प्रासादं नरपुङ्गवः।।2.3.31।। आरुरोह नृपं द्रष्टुं सह सूतेन राघवः।
transliteration: ﻿sa taṃ kailāsaśṛṅgābhaṃ prāsādaṃ narapuṅgavaḥ āruroha nṛpaṃ draṣṭuṃ saha sūtena rāghavaḥ|
translation: ﻿ नरपुङ्गवः best among men, सः that, राघवः Rama, नृपम् the king, द्रष्टुम् to see, सूतेन सह accompanied by charioteer Sumantra, कैलासशृङ्गाभम् as lofty as the peak of Kailasa, तम् प्रासादम् that palace, आरुरोह ascended.
explanation: ﻿ Best among men, Rama accompanied by charioteer Sumantra ascended that palace that was lofty as the peak of Kailasa mountain in order to see the king.

shloka_text: स प्राञ्जलिरभिप्रेत्य प्रणतः पितुरन्तिके।।2.3.32।। नाम स्वं श्रावयन्रामो ववन्दे चरणौ पितुः।
transliteration: sa prāñjalirabhipretya praṇataḥ piturantike nāma svaṃ śrāvayanrāmo vavande caraṇau pituḥ|
translation: सः रामः that Rama, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, अभिप्रेत्य having approached, पितुः father's, अन्तिके in proximity, प्रणतः bowing low, स्वम् his own, नाम name, श्रावयन् pronouncing, पितुः father's, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे touched with reverence.
explanation: Rama, approached his father with folded palms and bowed low near him, pronounced his (own) name and touched his father's feet with reverence.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा प्रणतं पार्श्वे कृताञ्जलिपुटं नृपः।।2.3.33।। गृह्याञ्जलौ समाकृष्य सस्वजे प्रियमात्मजम्।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇataṃ pārśve kṛtāñjalipuṭaṃ nṛpaḥ gṛhyāñjalau samākṛṣya sasvaje priyamātmajam|
translation: नृपः that king, पार्श्वे by his side, प्रणतम् bowed down with reverence, कृताञ्जलिपुटम् with folded hands, प्रियम् beloved, तम् आत्मजम् his son Rama, अञ्जलौ by holding the folded hands, गृह्य clasping, समाकृष्य drawing towards him, सस्वजे embraced.
explanation: Seeing his beloved son Rama who was standing by his side with folded hands in supplication, king Dasaratha, held his folded hands and drew him near and embraced him.

shloka_text: तस्मै चाभ्युदितं दिव्यं मणिकाञ्चनभूषितम्।।2.3.34।। दिदेश राजा रुचिरं रामाय परमासनम्।
transliteration: tasmai cābhyuditaṃ divyaṃ maṇikāñcanabhūṣitam dideśa rājā ruciraṃ rāmāya paramāsanam|
translation: राजा the king (Dasaratha), तस्मै रामाय for that Rama, अभ्युदितम् lofty, दिव्यम् excellent, मणिकाञ्चनभूषितम् decorated with gold and gems, रुचिरम् splendid, वरमासनम् best seat, दिदेश gave.
explanation: The king (Dasaratha) offered Rama a seat on the lofty, glorious throne splendidly  decorated with gold and gems.

shloka_text: तदासनवरं प्राप्य व्यदीपयत राघवः।।2.3.35।। स्वयैव प्रभया मेरुमुदये विमलो रविः।
transliteration: tadāsanavaraṃ prāpya vyadīpayata rāghavaḥ svayaiva prabhayā merumudaye vimalo raviḥ|
translation: राघवः son of the Raghus (Rama), तत् आसनवरम् that lofty seat, प्राप्य having received, उदये in the morning, विमलः translucent, रविः sun, मेरुमिव like Meru (mountain), स्वया of his own, प्रभया with his rays, व्यदीपयत shone.
explanation: The lofty seat Rama occupied was illuminated by him resplenderce like mount Meru in the translucent rays of the morning Sun.

shloka_text: ﻿तेन विभ्राजता तत्र सा सभाऽभिव्यरोचत।।2.3.36।। विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा शारदी द्यौरिवेन्दुना।
transliteration: ﻿tena vibhrājatā tatra sā sabhā'bhivyarocata vimalagrahanakṣatrā śāradī dyaurivendunā|
translation: ﻿ तत्र there, विभ्राजता while illumining, तेन by Rama, सा सभा that assembly, विमलग्रहनक्षत्रा with clear planets and stars, शारदी autumnal, द्यौः sky, इन्दुना इव like moon, अभिव्यरोचत dazzled.
explanation: ﻿ That assembly was illumined by (the presence of) Rama like the Moon dazzling the clear autumnal sky bespangled with sparkling planets and stars.

shloka_text: तं पश्यमानो नृपतिस्तुतोष प्रियमात्मजम्।।2.3.37।। अलङ्कृतमिवात्मानमादर्शतलसंस्थितम्।
transliteration: taṃ paśyamāno nṛpatistutoṣa priyamātmajam alaṅkṛtamivātmānamādarśatalasaṃsthitam|
translation: तम् that, प्रियम् beloved, आत्मजम् son, पश्यमानः beholding, नृपतिः king, अलङ्कृतम् adorned, आदर्शतलसंस्थितम् image reflected in mirror, आत्मानमिव seeing himself, तुतोष experienced delight.
explanation: The king was delighted to see his beloved son as though he saw his own reflection adorning a mirror.

shloka_text: स तं सस्मितमाभाष्य पुत्रं पुत्रवतां वरः।।2.3.38।। उवाचेदं वचो राजा देवेन्द्रमिव काश्यपः।
transliteration: sa taṃ sasmitamābhāṣya putraṃ putravatāṃ varaḥ uvācedaṃ vaco rājā devendramiva kāśyapaḥ|
translation: पुत्रावताम् among those having sons, वरः best, सः राजा that king, तं पुत्रम् that son, सस्मितम् with a smile, आभाष्य having called, काश्यपः Kasyapa, देवेन्द्रमिव like Devendra, इदम् this, वचः words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: The best among fathers, he (Dasaratha) said these words to his son with a smile, like Kasyapa addressing Devendra.

shloka_text: ज्येष्ठायामसि मे पत्न्यां सदृश्यां सदृशस्सुतः।।2.3.39।। उत्पन्नस्त्वं गुणश्रेष्ठो मम रामात्मजः प्रियः।
transliteration: jyeṣṭhāyāmasi me patnyāṃ sadṛśyāṃ sadṛśassutaḥ utpannastvaṃ guṇaśreṣṭho mama rāmātmajaḥ priyaḥ|
translation: राम O Rama, ज्येष्ठायाम् the eldest, सदृश्याम् worthy woman, मे पत्न्याम् to my wife, उत्पन्नः born, सदृशः worthy, सुतः असि are a son, गुणश्रेष्ठः having excellent virtues, त्वम् you, मम to me, प्रियः आत्मजः beloved son.
explanation: A worthy son of my worthy eldest wife, O Rama, your great virtues have endeared you to me.

shloka_text: यतस्त्वया प्रजाश्चेमा स्स्वगुणैरनुरञ्जिताः।।2.3.40।। तस्मात्त्वं पुष्ययोगेन यौवराज्यमवाप्नुहि।
transliteration: yatastvayā prajāścemā ssvaguṇairanurañjitāḥ tasmāttvaṃ puṣyayogena yauvarājyamavāpnuhi|
translation: यतः since, त्वया by you, इमाः these, प्रजाः people, स्वगुणैः with your virtues, अनुरञ्जिताः have been endeared, तस्मात्  therefore, त्वम् you, पुष्ययोगेन when Pushya star is in conjunction with the Moon, यौवराज्यम् office of heirapparent, अवाप्नुहि receive.
explanation: As you have endeared yourself to these subjects with your virtues, you shall assume the office of heirapparent when Pushya star is in conjunction with the Moon.

shloka_text: कामतस्त्वं प्रकृत्यैव विनीतो गुणवानसि।।2.3.41।। गुणवत्यपि तु स्नेहात्पुत्र वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्।
transliteration: kāmatastvaṃ prakṛtyaiva vinīto guṇavānasi guṇavatyapi tu snehātputra vakṣyāmi te hitam|
translation: त्वम् you, कामतः admittedly, प्रकृत्यैव by nature itself, विनीतः gentle one, गुणवान् असि are virtuous, पुत्र O son, गुणवत्यपि तु (in you) even though possessed of virtues, स्नेहात् out of affection, ते you, हितम् good,  वक्ष्यामि I shall speak.
explanation: Admittedly gentle by nature, you are gifted with virtues. O son, even though virtuous,   I shall offer you counsel for your good out of affection for you.

shloka_text: भूयो विनयमास्थाय भव नित्यं जितेन्द्रियः।।2.3.42।। कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि त्यजेथा व्यसनानि च।
transliteration: bhūyo vinayamāsthāya bhava nityaṃ jitendriyaḥ kāmakrodhasamutthāni tyajethā vyasanāni ca|
translation: भूयः still, विनयम् modesty, आस्थाय resorting to, नित्यम् always, जितेन्द्रिय: conquering the senses, भव become, कामक्रोधसमुत्थानि arising out of lust and anger, व्यसनानि च त्यजेथाः you should also abjure violations.
explanation: With humility, always keep your senses under control. Keep off all violations arising out of lust and anger.

shloka_text: परोक्षया वर्तमानो वृत्त्या प्रत्यक्षया तथा।।2.3.43।। अमात्यप्रभृतीस्सर्वाःप्रकृतीश्चानुरञ्जय।
transliteration: parokṣayā vartamāno vṛttyā pratyakṣayā tathā amātyaprabhṛtīssarvāḥprakṛtīścānurañjaya|
translation: परोक्षया indirectly, वृत्त्या with behaviour, तथा also, प्रत्यक्षया with direct behaviour, वर्तमानः conducting, अमात्यप्रभृतीः ministers etc., सर्वाः all, प्रकृतीः people, अनुरञ्जय satisfy.
explanation: With your behaviour keep the ministers and the people satisfied by means direct or indirect.

shloka_text: कोष्ठागारायुधागारैःकृत्वा सन्निचयान्बहून्।।2.3.44।। तुष्टानुरक्तप्रकृतिर्यः पालयति मेदिनीम्। तस्यनन्दन्ति मित्राणि लब्ध्वाऽमृतमिवामराः।।2.3.45।। तस्मात्त्वमपि चात्मानं नियम्यैवं समाचर।
transliteration: koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāraiḥkṛtvā sannicayānbahūn tuṣṭānuraktaprakṛtiryaḥ pālayati medinīm| tasyanandanti mitrāṇi labdhvā'mṛtamivāmarāḥ tasmāttvamapi cātmānaṃ niyamyaivaṃ samācara|
translation: कोष्ठागारायुधागारैः with stocks of foodgrains and arsenals, बहून् many, सन्निचयान्  collections, कृत्वा having made, तुष्टानुरक्त: प्रकृति: keeping the subjects content and loyal, यः who, मेदिनीम् the earth, पालयति rules, तस्य his, मित्राणि friends, अमृतम् nectar, लब्ध्वा having obtained, अमराः इव like devatas, नन्दन्ति obtain pleasure, तस्मात् so, त्वमपि you also, आत्मानम् yourself, एवम् thus, समाचर conduct yourself.
explanation: You shall rule the earth by filling granaries of foodgrains and arsenals and keeping the subjects loyal and contented. The friends of such a person will memain pleased like devatas with nectar. Hence conduct yourself with your mind under control.

shloka_text: कोष्ठागारायुधागारैःकृत्वा सन्निचयान्बहून्।।2.3.44।। तुष्टानुरक्तप्रकृतिर्यः पालयति मेदिनीम्। तस्यनन्दन्ति मित्राणि लब्ध्वाऽमृतमिवामराः।।2.3.45।। तस्मात्त्वमपि चात्मानं नियम्यैवं समाचर।
transliteration: koṣṭhāgārāyudhāgāraiḥkṛtvā sannicayānbahūn tuṣṭānuraktaprakṛtiryaḥ pālayati medinīm| tasyanandanti mitrāṇi labdhvā'mṛtamivāmarāḥ tasmāttvamapi cātmānaṃ niyamyaivaṃ samācara|
translation: कोष्ठागारायुधागारैः with stocks of foodgrains and arsenals, बहून् many, सन्निचयान्  collections, कृत्वा having made, तुष्टानुरक्त: प्रकृति: keeping the subjects content and loyal, यः who, मेदिनीम् the earth, पालयति rules, तस्य his, मित्राणि friends, अमृतम् nectar, लब्ध्वा having obtained, अमराः इव like devatas, नन्दन्ति obtain pleasure, तस्मात् so, त्वमपि you also, आत्मानम् yourself, एवम् thus, समाचर conduct yourself.
explanation: You shall rule the earth by filling granaries of foodgrains and arsenals and keeping the subjects loyal and contented. The friends of such a person will memain pleased like devatas with nectar. Hence conduct yourself with your mind under control.

shloka_text: ﻿तच्छ्रुत्वा सुहृदस्तस्य रामस्य प्रियकारिणः।।2.3.46।। त्वरिताः शीघ्रमभ्येत्य कौसल्यायै न्यवेदयन्।
transliteration: ﻿tacchrutvā suhṛdastasya rāmasya priyakāriṇaḥ tvaritāḥ śīghramabhyetya kausalyāyai nyavedayan|
translation: ﻿ तस्य रामस्य that Rama's, सुहृदः friends, तत् श्रुत्वा hearing that, त्वरिताः in great haste, प्रियकारिणः with the intention of causing pleasure, शीघ्रम् speedily, अभ्येत्य having approached, कौशल्यायै to Kausalya, न्यवेदयन् informed.
explanation: ﻿ Having heard this, Rama's friends quickly reported the matter to Kausalya so that she might be happy.

shloka_text: ﻿सा हिरण्यं च गाश्चैव रत्नानि विविधानि च।।2.3.47।। व्यादिदेश प्रियाख्येभ्यः कौसल्या प्रमदोत्तमा।
transliteration: ﻿sā hiraṇyaṃ ca gāścaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca vyādideśa priyākhyebhyaḥ kausalyā pramadottamā|
translation: ﻿ प्रमदोत्तमा the foremost of women, सा कौशल्या that Kausalya, हिरण्यं च gold, गाः चैव and also cows, विविधानि various kinds of, रत्नानि च gems as well, प्रियाख्येभ्यः (सह) messengers of these good tidings, व्यादिदेश ordered.
explanation: ﻿ The foremost of women, Kausalya ordered gifts of gold, cows and various kinds of gems to be given to the messengers who brought this good tiding.

shloka_text: अथाऽभिवाद्य राजानं रथमारुह्य राघवः।।2.3.48।। ययौ स्वं द्युतिमद्वेश्म जनौघैः प्रतिपूजितः।
transliteration: athā'bhivādya rājānaṃ rathamāruhya rāghavaḥ yayau svaṃ dyutimadveśma janaughaiḥ pratipūjitaḥ|
translation: अथ thereafter, राघवः son of the Raghus (Rama), राजानम् king, अभिवाद्य having paid obeisance, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य ascending, जनौघैः by multitude of men, प्रतिपूजितः worshipped, द्युतिमत् splendid, स्वं वेश्म towards his abode, ययौ went.
explanation: Having paid his obeisance to the king, Rama ascended the chariot amidst the acclaim of multitudes of men and left for his splendid abode.

shloka_text: ते चापि पौरा नृपतेर्वचस्त च्छृत्वा तथा लाभमिवेष्टमाशु। नरेन्द्रमामन्त्र्य गृहाणि गत्वा देवान्समानर्चुरतिप्रहृष्टाः।।2.3.49।।
transliteration: te cāpi paurā nṛpatervacasta cchṛtvā tathā lābhamiveṣṭamāśu| narendramāmantrya gṛhāṇi gatvā devānsamānarcuratiprahṛṣṭāḥ
translation: ते पौराश्चापि those citizens also, तथा such, इष्टम् dear, लाभमिव beneficial, नृपतेः king's, तत् वचः that pronouncement, शृत्वा having heard, नरेन्द्रम् king Dasaratha, आमन्त्र्य having taken leave of, आशु immediately, गृहाणि to their homes, गत्वा having gone, अति प्रहृष्टाः full of joy, देवान् gods, समानर्चुः worshipped.
explanation: On hearing such pronouncement by the king, the citizens also felt they have got something beneficial for themselves. They took leave of the king (Dasaratha) and hastening home,  full of joy, began worshipping their gods. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे तृतीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the third sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: गतेष्वथ नृपो भूयः पौरेषु सह मन्त्रिभिः। मन्त्रयित्वा ततश्चक्रे निश्चयज्ञस्सनिश्चयम्।।2.4.1।। श्व एव पुष्यो भविताश्वोऽभिषेच्यस्तु मे सुतः। रामो राजीवताम्राक्षो यौवराज्य इति प्रभुः।।2.4.2।।
transliteration: gateṣvatha nṛpo bhūyaḥ paureṣu saha mantribhiḥ| mantrayitvā tataścakre niścayajñassaniścayam śva eva puṣyo bhavitāśvo'bhiṣecyastu me sutaḥ| rāmo rājīvatāmrākṣo yauvarājya iti prabhuḥ
translation: अथ thereafter, पौरेषु citizens, गतेषु सत्सु had departed, निश्चयज्ञः knows how to take decisions, प्रभुः Lord, नृपः king, मन्त्रिभि: सह together with counsellors, भूयः again, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, श्वः एव tomorrow itself, पुष्यः Pushya star, भविता is in the ascendance, राजीवताम्राक्षः a man whose eyes resemble red lotus (petals), मे सुतः my son, रामः Rama, श्वः tomorrow, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेच्यः should be  installed, इति thus, निश्चयम् decision, चक्रे made.
explanation: After the citizens departed, the king, an expert in decisionmaking again consulted his counsellors and said, Tomorrow Pushya star is in the ascendence and my son, Rama (handsome) with coppercoloured eyes which resemble red lotus petals will be installed heirapparent.
comments: Dasaratha sends Sumantra to bring Rama again-- briefs him on certain matters and sends him -- Rama visits Kausalya and informs her about the coronation and seeks her blessings.

shloka_text: गतेष्वथ नृपो भूयः पौरेषु सह मन्त्रिभिः। मन्त्रयित्वा ततश्चक्रे निश्चयज्ञस्सनिश्चयम्।।2.4.1।। श्व एव पुष्यो भविताश्वोऽभिषेच्यस्तु मे सुतः। रामो राजीवताम्राक्षो यौवराज्य इति प्रभुः।।2.4.2।।
transliteration: gateṣvatha nṛpo bhūyaḥ paureṣu saha mantribhiḥ| mantrayitvā tataścakre niścayajñassaniścayam śva eva puṣyo bhavitāśvo'bhiṣecyastu me sutaḥ| rāmo rājīvatāmrākṣo yauvarājya iti prabhuḥ
translation: अथ thereafter, पौरेषु citizens, गतेषु सत्सु had departed, निश्चयज्ञः knows how to take decisions, प्रभुः Lord, नृपः king, मन्त्रिभि: सह together with counsellors, भूयः again, मन्त्रयित्वा having consulted, श्वः एव tomorrow itself, पुष्यः Pushya star, भविता is in the ascendance, राजीवताम्राक्षः a man whose eyes resemble red lotus (petals), मे सुतः my son, रामः Rama, श्वः tomorrow, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेच्यः should be  installed, इति thus, निश्चयम् decision, चक्रे made.
explanation: After the citizens departed, the king, an expert in decisionmaking again consulted his counsellors and said, Tomorrow Pushya star is in the ascendence and my son, Rama (handsome) with coppercoloured eyes which resemble red lotus petals will be installed heirapparent.

shloka_text: अथाऽन्तर्गृहमाविश्य राजा दशरथस्तदा। सूतमामन्त्रयामास रामं पुनरिहानय।।2.4.3।।
transliteration: athā'ntargṛhamāviśya rājā daśarathastadā| sūtamāmantrayāmāsa rāmaṃ punarihānaya
translation: अथ thereafter, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, अन्तर्गृहम् inner apartment, आविश्य having entered, तदा then, रामम् Rama, पुनः again, इह here, आनय bring him, सूतम् charioteer  Sumantra, आमन्त्रयामास ordered.
explanation: Therafter king Dasaratha on retiring to his private apartment, ordered Sumantra to bring Rama  once again.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य स तद्वाक्यं सूतः पुनरुपाययौ। रामस्य भवनं शीघ्रं राममानयितुं पुनः।।2.4.4।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya sa tadvākyaṃ sūtaḥ punarupāyayau| rāmasya bhavanaṃ śīghraṃ rāmamānayituṃ punaḥ
translation: सः सूतः the charioteer, तत् वाक्यम् that order, प्रतिगृह्य having received, पुनः again, रामम् Rama, आनयितुम् to fetch, शीघ्रम् speedily, रामस्य Rama's, भवनम् palace, उपाययौ  reached.
explanation: In obedience to the command  of the king charioteer Sumantra set out speedily  to the palace of Rama to fetch him  back once again.

shloka_text: द्वार्स्थैरावेदितं तस्य रामायाऽऽगमनं पुनः। श्रुत्वैव चापि रामस्तं प्राप्तं शङ्कान्वितोऽभवत्।।2.4.5।।
transliteration: dvārsthairāveditaṃ tasya rāmāyā''gamanaṃ punaḥ| śrutvaiva cāpi rāmastaṃ prāptaṃ śaṅkānvito'bhavat
translation: पुनः again, तस्य his, आगमनम् arrival, द्वाः स्धैः by doorkeepers, रामाय to Rama, आवेदितम् was reported, तम् him, प्राप्तम् had arrived, श्रुत्वा एव on listening, रामः Rama, शङ्कान्वितः अभवत् was filled with apprehensions.
explanation: The doorkeepers informed Rama of Sumantra's arrival. As soon as he learnt that Sumantra was back again, Rama was filled with apprehensions.

shloka_text: प्रवेश्य चैनं त्वरितं रामो वचनमब्रवीत्। यदागमनकृत्यं ते भूयस्तद्ब्रूह्यशेषतः।।2.4.6।।
transliteration: praveśya cainaṃ tvaritaṃ rāmo vacanamabravīt| yadāgamanakṛtyaṃ te bhūyastadbrūhyaśeṣataḥ
translation: रामः Rama, एनम् him, त्वरितम् quickly  प्रवेश्य having admitted , वचनम् words अब्रवीत् said, भूयः again, ते your, आगमनकृत्यम् purpose of coming back, यत् whatever is there  तत्  that one, अशेषतः completely, ब्रूहि  tell
explanation: Rama  got Sumantra admitted  and said to him, What is the  purpose of your coming back so quickly ? Tell me whatever is there without holding back.

shloka_text: तमुवाच तत स्सूतो राजा त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति। श्रुत्वा प्रमाणमत्र त्वं गमनायेतराय वा।।2.4.7।।
transliteration: tamuvāca tata ssūto rājā tvāṃ draṣṭumicchati| śrutvā pramāṇamatra tvaṃ gamanāyetarāya vā
translation: ततः thereafter, सूतः charioteer, तम् addressing him, उवाच spoke, राजा king, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति  desires, श्रुत्वा having heard, अत्र in this matter, गमनाय either to go, इतराय वा or otherwise, त्वम् you alone, प्रमाणम् are the authority.
explanation: Then Sumantra replied, 'The king desires to see you. To go or not to go, the decision is yours'.

shloka_text: इति सूतवच श्श्रुत्वा रामोऽथ त्वरयाऽन्वितः। प्रययौ राजभवनं पुनर्द्रष्टुं नरेश्वरम्।।2.4.8।।
transliteration: iti sūtavaca śśrutvā rāmo'tha tvarayā'nvitaḥ| prayayau rājabhavanaṃ punardraṣṭuṃ nareśvaram
translation: इति thus, सूतवचः words of the charioteer, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, अथ afterwards, त्वरया with haste, अन्वितः seized, नरेश्वरम् king, पुनः again, द्रष्टुम् to see, राजभवनम् to royal palace, प्रययौ departed.
explanation: On hearing the words of the charioteer, Rama immediately set out for the royal  palace to see the king again.

shloka_text: तं श्रुत्वा समनुप्राप्तं रामं दशरथो नृपः। प्रवेशयामास गृहं विवक्षुः प्रियमुत्तमम्।।2.4.9।।
transliteration: taṃ śrutvā samanuprāptaṃ rāmaṃ daśaratho nṛpaḥ| praveśayāmāsa gṛhaṃ vivakṣuḥ priyamuttamam
translation: दशरथः नृपः king Dasaratha, तम् रामम् that Rama, समनुप्राप्तम् of his arrival, श्रुत्वा having heard, उत्तमम् exceedingly, प्रियम् pleasing, विवक्षुः to tell, गृहम् palace, प्रवेशयामास got him admitted.
explanation: Having heard of Rama's arrival, king Dasaratha got him admitted into his apartment to tell him something very pleasant.

shloka_text: प्रविशन्नेव च श्रीमान्राघवो भवनं पितुः। ददर्श पितरं दूरात्प्रणिपत्य कृताञ्जलिः।।2.4.10।।
transliteration: praviśanneva ca śrīmānrāghavo bhavanaṃ pituḥ| dadarśa pitaraṃ dūrātpraṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
translation: श्रीमान् glorious, राघवः Rama, पितुः father's, भवनम् palace, प्रविशन्नेव while entering, कृताञ्जलिः folded hands, दूरात् from a distance, पितरम् to his father, प्रणिपत्य bending low in reverence, ददर्श beheld.
explanation: On entering his father's palace, glorious Rama, folded his hands and bent low in reverence from a distance and beheld his father.

shloka_text: प्रणमन्तं समुत्थाप्य तं परिष्वज्य भूमिपः। प्रदिश्य चास्मै रुचिरमासनं पुनरब्रवीत्।।2.4.11।।
transliteration: praṇamantaṃ samutthāpya taṃ pariṣvajya bhūmipaḥ| pradiśya cāsmai ruciramāsanaṃ punarabravīt
translation: भूमिपः protector of the earth (king Dasaratha), प्रणमन्तम् as he (Rama) was bending low, तम् him, समुत्थाप्य lifted up, परिष्वज्य embracing, अस्मै him, रुचिरम् splendid, आसनम् seat, प्रदिश्य च having offered, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: As he (Rama) was bending (with reverence), Dasaratha lifted him up and embraced him. Thereafter, he offered him a splendid seat and said again:

shloka_text: राम वृद्धोऽस्मि दीर्घायुर्भुक्ता भोगा मयेप्सिताः। अन्नवद्भिः क्रतुशतै स्तथेष्टं भूरिदक्षिणैः।।2.4.12।।
transliteration: rāma vṛddho'smi dīrghāyurbhuktā bhogā mayepsitāḥ| annavadbhiḥ kratuśatai statheṣṭaṃ bhūridakṣiṇaiḥ
translation: राम O Rama, दीर्घायुः one with long life, वृद्धः अस्मि I have become old, मया by me, ईप्सिताः desires, भोगाः pleasures, भुक्ताः enjoyed, अन्नवद्भिः cooked rice, भूरिदक्षिणैः abundance of donations, क्रतुशतैः by hundreds of rituals, इष्टम् is performed.
explanation: O Rama after a long life I have grown old. I have enjoyed all the pleasures I desired. I have also performed hundreds of rituals which enjoined distribution of abundant food and gifts.

shloka_text: जातमिष्टमपत्यं मे त्वमद्यानुपमं भुवि। दत्तमिष्टमधीतं च मया पुरुषसत्तम।।2.4.13।।
transliteration: jātamiṣṭamapatyaṃ me tvamadyānupamaṃ bhuvi| dattamiṣṭamadhītaṃ ca mayā puruṣasattama
translation: पुरूषसत्तम the very best of men( Rama), त्वम् you, अद्य now, भुवि on this earth, अनुपमम्  incomparable, इष्टम् to my liking, अपत्यम् as progeny, मे to me, जातम् was born, मया by me, दत्तम् given (performed), इष्टम् rituals (prescribed for kshatriyas), अधीतं च studied (Vedas) also.
explanation: O best of men I have obtained now a progeny of my liking in you and you have no equal on earth. I have given gifts, performed rituals and also studied (the Vedas) .

shloka_text: अनुभूतानि चेष्टानि मया वीर सुखान्यपि। देवर्षिपितृविप्राणामनृणोऽस्मि तथाऽत्मनः।।2.4.14।।
transliteration: anubhūtāni ceṣṭāni mayā vīra sukhānyapi| devarṣipitṛviprāṇāmanṛṇo'smi tathā'tmanaḥ
translation: वीर O mighty one, मया by me, इष्टानि my favouite ones, सुखान्यपि pleasures, अनुभूतानि were experienced, देवर्षिपितृविप्राणाम् with regard to my obligations to gods, sages, my ancestors and brahmins, तथा and also, आत्मनः for me, अनृणः अस्मि I am freed from debt.
explanation: O mighty son I have experienced all the pleasures I longed for. I redeemed my debt to the gods, the sages, my ancestors, brahmins and to myself.

shloka_text: न किञ्चिन्मम कर्तव्यं तवान्यत्राभिषेचनात्। अतो यत्त्वामहं ब्रूयां तन्मे त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि।।2.4.15।।
transliteration: na kiñcinmama kartavyaṃ tavānyatrābhiṣecanāt| ato yattvāmahaṃ brūyāṃ tanme tvaṃ kartumarhasi
translation: तव your, अभिषेचनात् अन्यत्र other than consecration, कर्तव्यम् duty, न किञ्चित् nothing, मम my, अतः for that reason, अहम् I, त्वाम् to you, यत् whatever, ब्रूयाम् I shall tell you, तत् that one, त्वम् you, मे to me, कर्तुम् to perform, अर्हसि it behoves you.
explanation: There is nothing left to be done by me except your consecration Hence you should perform what I  tell you.

shloka_text: अद्य प्रकृतयस्सर्वास्त्वामिच्छन्ति नराधिपम्। अतस्त्वां युवराजानमभिषेक्ष्यामि पुत्रक।।2.4.16।।
transliteration: adya prakṛtayassarvāstvāmicchanti narādhipam| atastvāṃ yuvarājānamabhiṣekṣyāmi putraka
translation: अद्य today, सर्वाः all, प्रकृतयः the subjects, त्वाम् you, नराधिपम् as king, इच्छन्ति wish, पुत्रक my dear son, अतः so, त्वाम् you, युवराजानम् as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I am going to install.
explanation: Today  all the subjects expresed their desire to see you as their king. Therefore, my dear son, I wish to coronate  you heirapparent.

shloka_text: अपि चाद्याऽशुभान्राम स्वप्ने पश्यामि दारुणान्। सनिर्घाता दिवोल्का च पततीह महास्वना।।2.4.17।।
transliteration: api cādyā'śubhānrāma svapne paśyāmi dāruṇān| sanirghātā divolkā ca patatīha mahāsvanā
translation: राम O Rama, अपि च also, अद्य now, स्वप्ने in a dream, दारुणान् frightening, अशुभान् inauspicious events, पश्यामि am seeing, दिवा during day time, सनिर्घाता accompanied by thunders, महास्वना generating great sounds, उल्का meteor, इह here, पतति is falling.
explanation: Moreover Rama, these days I see frightening and ominous events in dreams during day time. I see meteors accompanied by thunders falling, generating great sounds.

shloka_text: अवष्टब्धं च मे राम नक्षत्रं दारुणैर्ग्रहैः। आवेदयन्ति दैवज्ञाः सूर्याङ्गारकराहुभिः।।2.4.18।।
transliteration: avaṣṭabdhaṃ ca me rāma nakṣatraṃ dāruṇairgrahaiḥ| āvedayanti daivajñāḥ sūryāṅgārakarāhubhiḥ
translation: राम O Rama, सूर्याङ्गारकराहुभिः Sun, Mars and Rahu, दारुणैः formidable, ग्रहैः planets, मे my, नक्षत्रम् birth star, अवष्टब्धम् have afflicted, दैवज्ञाः astrologers, आवेदयन्ति are communicating.
explanation: O Rama astrologers also tell me that formidable planets Sun, Mars and Rahu have afflicted my birth star.

shloka_text: प्रायेण हि निमित्तानामीदृशानां समुद्भवे। राजा हि मृत्युमाप्नोति घोरां वाऽऽपदमृच्छति।।2.4.19।।
transliteration: prāyeṇa hi nimittānāmīdṛśānāṃ samudbhave| rājā hi mṛtyumāpnoti ghorāṃ vā''padamṛcchati
translation: ईदृशानाम् when such, निमित्तानाम् of ominous signs, समुद्भवे appear, प्रायेण हि usually, राजा king, मृत्युम् death, आप्नोति meets, घोराम् grave, आपदं वा or calamity, ऋच्छति  faces.
explanation: When such ominous signs appear, usually the king either meets with  death or faces a grave calamity.

shloka_text: तद्यावदेव मे चेतो न विमुह्यति राघव। तावदेवाभिषिञ्चस्व चला हि प्राणिनां मतिः।।2.4.20।।
transliteration: tadyāvadeva me ceto na vimuhyati rāghava| tāvadevābhiṣiñcasva calā hi prāṇināṃ matiḥ
translation: तत् so, राघव son of the Raghus (Rama), मे my, चेतः mind, यावदेव so long as, न विमु३ह्यति is not  deluded, तावदेव till then, अभिषिञ्चस्व be consecrated, प्राणिनाम् men's, मतिः mind, चला हि is unstable indeed.
explanation: Therefore,  before my mind is deluded I wish to see you installed as heirapparent for a man's mind is unstable indeed, O Rama.

shloka_text: अद्य चन्द्रोऽभ्युपगतः पुष्यात्पूर्वं पुनर्वसू। श्वः पुष्ययोगं नियतं वक्ष्यन्ते दैवचिन्तकाः।।2.4.21।।
transliteration: adya candro'bhyupagataḥ puṣyātpūrvaṃ punarvasū| śvaḥ puṣyayogaṃ niyataṃ vakṣyante daivacintakāḥ
translation: अद्य today, चन्द्रः Moon, पुष्यात् than star Pushya, पूर्वम् preceding, पुनर्वसू constellation Punarvasu, अभ्युपगतः entered, श्वः tomorrow, पुष्ययोगम् in conjuction with  Pushya constellation, नियतम् certainly, दैवचिन्तकाः astrologers, वक्ष्यन्ते say
explanation: Today the Moon is in conjunction with the Punarvasu constellation. Tomorrow the  Moon's conjunction with the Pushya constellation is certain and the astrologers say this auspicious time is highly suitable for the purpose of coronation.

shloka_text: ﻿﻿ततः पुष्येऽभिषिञ्चस्व मनस्त्वरयतीव माम्। श्वस्त्वाऽहमभिषेक्ष्यामि यौवराज्ये परन्तप।।2.4.22।।
transliteration: ﻿﻿tataḥ puṣye'bhiṣiñcasva manastvarayatīva mām| śvastvā'hamabhiṣekṣyāmi yauvarājye parantapa
translation: ﻿﻿ ततः therefore, पुष्ये in the Pushya constellation, अभिषिञ्चस्व be coronated , मनः my mind, माम् me, त्वरयतीव looks hastening up, परन्तप O slayer of enemies, अहम् I, श्वः tomorrow, त्वाम् you, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ष्यामि I shall install.
explanation: ﻿﻿ My mind is hastening me saying, 'Coronate Rama in the Pushya constellation itself'. O Slayer of enemies, I shall install you heir apparent tomorrow.

shloka_text: तस्मात्त्वयाऽद्य प्रभृति निशेयं नियतात्मना। सह वध्वोपवस्तव्या दर्भप्रस्तरशायिना।।2.4.23।।
transliteration: tasmāttvayā'dya prabhṛti niśeyaṃ niyatātmanā| saha vadhvopavastavyā darbhaprastaraśāyinā
translation: तस्मात्  therefore, अद्यप्रभृति  from now, इयम् this, निशा night, नियतात्मना with selfrestraint, दर्भप्रस्तरशायिना sleeping on a bed of darbha or kusha grass, त्वया by you, वध्वा सह with daughterinlaw,  Sita, उपवस्तव्या should be spent by undertaking fasting.
explanation: Therefore, you and my daughterinlaw (Sita) should fast tonight and sleep on a bed of darbha or kusha grass with selfrestraint.

shloka_text: सुहृदश्चाप्रमत्तास्त्वां रक्षन्त्वद्य समन्ततः। भवन्ति बहु विघ्नानि कार्याण्येवंविधानि हि।।2.4.24।।
transliteration: suhṛdaścāpramattāstvāṃ rakṣantvadya samantataḥ| bhavanti bahu vighnāni kāryāṇyevaṃvidhāni hi
translation: अद्य today, सुहृदश्च your friends also, समन्ततः on all sides, अप्रमत्ताः vigilantly, त्वाम् you, रक्षन्तु protect, एवं विधानि of this sort, कार्याणि acts, बहुविघ्नानि many impediments, भवन्ति हि will happen, indeed.
explanation: Many impediments befall  acts of this sort indeed. Alert your friends to protect you  from all sides today onwards.

shloka_text: विप्रोषितश्च भरतो यावदेव पुरादितः। तावदेवाभिषेकस्ते प्राप्तकालो मतो मम।।2.4.25।।
transliteration: viproṣitaśca bharato yāvadeva purāditaḥ| tāvadevābhiṣekaste prāptakālo mato mama
translation: भरतः Bharata, इतः पुरात् from this city, यावदेव while, विप्रोषितः away from, तावदेव till that time, ते to you, अभिषेकः consecration, प्राप्तकालः favourable time, मम(मे) my, मतः opinion.
explanation: While Bharata is away from the city, the time is favourable for your installation. This is my opinion.

shloka_text: कामं खलु सतां वृत्ते भ्राता ते भरतस्स्थितः। ज्येष्ठानुवर्ती धर्मात्मा सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः।।2.4.26।।
transliteration: kāmaṃ khalu satāṃ vṛtte bhrātā te bharatassthitaḥ| jyeṣṭhānuvartī dharmātmā sānukrośo jitendriyaḥ
translation: ते your, भ्राता brother, भरतः Bharata, कामम् really, सतां वृत्ते on the path of the virtuous, स्थितः stayed, ज्येष्ठानुवर्ती follows his elder brother, धर्मात्मा righteous, सानुक्रोशः compassionate, जितेन्द्रियः has controlled his senses.
explanation: It is true, your brother Bharata has adhered to the path of the virtuous and has followed his elder brother. No doubt, he is righteous, compassionate and self controlled.

shloka_text: किन्तु चित्तं मनुष्याणामनित्यमिति मे मतिः। सतां च धर्मनित्यानां कृतशोभि च राघव।।2.4.27।।
transliteration: kintu cittaṃ manuṣyāṇāmanityamiti me matiḥ| satāṃ ca dharmanityānāṃ kṛtaśobhi ca rāghava
translation: किन्तु yet, धर्मनित्यानाम् those fixed in righteousness, सतां च virtuous people also, मनुष्याणाम् men's, कृतशोभि made propitious, चित्तम् mind, अनित्यम् इति is fickle, मे my, मतिः my opinion.
explanation: Yet I think even the propitious minds of those who are virtuous and whose thoughts are fixed in righteousness can also become fickle.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त स्सोऽभ्यनुज्ञात श्श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने। व्रजेति रामः पितरमभिवाद्याभ्ययाद्गृहम्।।2.4.28।।
transliteration: ityukta sso'bhyanujñāta śśvobhāvinyabhiṣecane| vrajeti rāmaḥ pitaramabhivādyābhyayādgṛham
translation: श्वः tomorrow, भाविनि that will take place, अभिषेचने about installation ceremony, इति thus, उक्तः spoken of, सः that, रामः Rama, व्रज इति 'you may go', अभ्यनुज्ञातः having been permitted, पितरम् father, अभिवाद्य having paid obeisance, गृहम् to his abode, अभ्ययात् returned.
explanation: Having spoken to Rama about the installation ceremony fixed for the next day, he (Dasaratha) permitted him to leave saying, 'You may go'. Rama paid obeisance to his father and returned to his abode.

shloka_text: प्रविश्य चात्मनो वेश्मराज्ञोद्दिष्टेऽभिषेचने। तत्क्षणेन विनिर्गम्य मातुरन्तपुरं ययौ।।2.4.29।।
transliteration: praviśya cātmano veśmarājñoddiṣṭe'bhiṣecane| tatkṣaṇena vinirgamya māturantapuraṃ yayau
translation: राज्ञा by the king, अभिषेचने with regard to installation, उद्दिष्टे when it was fixed, आत्मनः his own, वेश्म house, प्रविश्य entered in, तत्क्षणेन immediately, विनिर्गम्य having left, मातुः mother's, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, ययौ departed.
explanation: With the installation fixed by the king, Rama went into his residence but left immediately to see his mother in her inner apartment.

shloka_text: तत्र तां प्रवणामेव मातरं क्षौमवासिनीम्। वाग्यतां देवतागारे ददर्शाऽऽयाचतीं श्रियम्।।2.4.30।।
transliteration: tatra tāṃ pravaṇāmeva mātaraṃ kṣaumavāsinīm| vāgyatāṃ devatāgāre dadarśā''yācatīṃ śriyam
translation: तत्र there, देवतागारे in the room (meant for worship) of the gods, प्रवणामेव engrossed in devotion, क्षौमवासिनीम् wearing silk apparels, वाग्यताम् silently, श्रियम् for royal fortune,  आयाचतीम् praying, ताम् मातरम् that mother, ददर्श beheld.
explanation: There he beheld his mother in silk apparel engrossed in silent prayer (to the gods) for his royal fortune in the room meant for the worship of the gods.

shloka_text: प्रागेव चागता तत्र सुमित्रा लक्ष्मण स्तथा। सीता चानायिता श्रुत्वा प्रियं रामाभिषेचनम्।।2.4.31।।
transliteration: prāgeva cāgatā tatra sumitrā lakṣmaṇa stathā| sītā cānāyitā śrutvā priyaṃ rāmābhiṣecanam
translation: प्रियम् welcome tidings, रामाभिषेचनम् of installation of Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रागेव preceding him (Rama), तथा also, सुमित्रा Sumitra, आगता had arrived, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सीता च also Sita, आनायिता had been summoned.
explanation: Hearing the welcome tidings of the installation of her beloved Rama, Sita too, had been brought in. Sumitra and Lakshmana had already arrived there.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् काले हि कौशल्या तस्थावामीलितेक्षणा। सुमित्रयाऽन्वास्यमाना सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च।।2.4.32।।
transliteration: tasmin kāle hi kauśalyā tasthāvāmīlitekṣaṇā| sumitrayā'nvāsyamānā sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca
translation: तस्मिन् काले at that moment, कौशल्या Kausalya, सुमित्रया by Sumitra, सीतया by Sita, लक्ष्मणेन च by Lakshmana, अन्वास्यमाना being accompanied, आमीलितेक्षणा with halfclosed eyes, तस्थौ stood.
explanation: At that moment Kausalya was meditating with her eyes halfclosed. Sumitra, Lakshmana and Sita were attending on her.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा पुष्येण पुत्रस्य यौवराज्याऽभिषेचनम्। प्राणायामेन पुरुषं ध्यायमाना जनार्दनम्।।2.4.33।।
transliteration: śrutvā puṣyeṇa putrasya yauvarājyā'bhiṣecanam| prāṇāyāmena puruṣaṃ dhyāyamānā janārdanam
translation: पुष्येण In Pushya constellation, पुत्रस्य son's, यौवराज्याभिषेचनम् installation as heirapparent, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्राणायामेन by controlling the breath, पुरुषम् supreme god, जनार्दनम् Lord Visnu, ध्यायमाना meditating upon.
explanation: Having heard that installation of her son as heirapparent was planned in Pushya constellation, Kausalya was meditating upon the Supreme Person, Lord Visnu by controlling her breath (Pranayama).

shloka_text: तथा सनियमामेव सोऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च। उवाच वचनं रामो हर्षयंस्तामनिन्दिताम्।।2.4.34।।
transliteration: tathā saniyamāmeva so'bhigamyābhivādya ca| uvāca vacanaṃ rāmo harṣayaṃstāmaninditām
translation: सः रामः that Rama, तथा in that manner, सनियमामेव engaged in prayer, अभिगम्य having approached, अभिवाद्य च having made reverential salutation, ताम् her, हर्षयन् enhancing her joy, अनिन्दितां वचनम् words of praise, उवाच said.
explanation: While she (Kausalya) was in that state of meditation, Rama approached her, offered reverential salutation and said these words of praise enhancing her joy:

shloka_text: सन्दिश्य रामं नृपति श्श्वोभाविन्यभिषेचने। पुरोहितं समाहूय वशिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.5.1।।
transliteration: sandiśya rāmaṃ nṛpati śśvobhāvinyabhiṣecane| purohitaṃ samāhūya vaśiṣṭhamidamabravīt
translation: नृपतिः the king, रामम् Rama, सन्दिश्य having instructed, पुरोहितम् priest, वशिष्ठम् Vasistha, समाहूय summoning, श्वः on the following day, भाविनि about to take place, अभिषेचने with regard to coronation, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: The king having instructed Rama summoned Vasistha, the priest and spoke to him about the coronation that was to take place on the following day
comments: Vasistha advises Rama and Sita to undertake fast preparatory to coronation.

shloka_text: गच्छोपवासं काकुत्स्थं कारयाद्य तपोधन। श्रीयशोराज्यलाभाय वध्वा सह यतव्रतम्।।2.5.2।।
transliteration: gacchopavāsaṃ kākutsthaṃ kārayādya tapodhana| śrīyaśorājyalābhāya vadhvā saha yatavratam
translation: तपोधन O sage whose wealth is asceticism, गच्छ go, अद्य today, यतव्रतम् strictly observing vows, काकुत्स्थम् son of the family of Kakutstha (Rama), श्रीयशोराज्यलाभाय for securing prosperity, fame and kingdom, वध्वा सह along with my daughterinlaw, उपवासम् कारय advise him to undertake fast.
explanation: Could you, O sage, whose wealth is asceticism go to Rama engaged in strict observance of vows and advise him along with Sita, my daughterinlaw to undertake fast for securing prosperity, fame and kingdom.

shloka_text: तथेति च स राजानमुक्त्वा वेदविदां वरः। स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान्ययौ रामनिवेशनम्।।2.5.3।। उपवासयितुं रामं मन्त्रवन्मन्त्रकोविदः। ब्राह्मं रथवरं युक्तमास्थाय सुदृढव्रतः।।2.5.4।।
transliteration: tatheti ca sa rājānamuktvā vedavidāṃ varaḥ| svayaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānyayau rāmaniveśanam upavāsayituṃ rāmaṃ mantravanmantrakovidaḥ| brāhmaṃ rathavaraṃ yuktamāsthāya sudṛḍhavrataḥ
translation: वेदविदाम् of those who know the Vedas, वरः best, मन्त्रकोविदः skilled in mantras, सुदृढव्रतः one who is firm in his vows, भगवान् venerable, सः वसिष्ठः that Vasistha, तथा इति Be it so, राजानाम् king, उक्त्वा having said, युक्तम् harnessed, ब्राह्मम् befitting a brahmin, रथवरम् best of chariots, आस्थाय having mounted, रामम् to Rama, मन्त्रवत् in accompaniment with mantras, उपवासयितुम् to make him fast, स्वयम् personally, रामनिवेशनम् to the abode of Rama, ययौ went.
explanation: Venerabel Vasistha, the best amongst the knowers of the Vedas, skilled in mantras and firm in his vows said to the king, 'Be it so.' Thereafter,  mounted on the best of the chariots befitting a brahmin, with horses harnesed he proceeded personally to the abode of Rama to ask him to undertake a fast in accompaniment with mantras preceding the installation ceremony.

shloka_text: तथेति च स राजानमुक्त्वा वेदविदां वरः। स्वयं वसिष्ठो भगवान्ययौ रामनिवेशनम्।।2.5.3।। उपवासयितुं रामं मन्त्रवन्मन्त्रकोविदः। ब्राह्मं रथवरं युक्तमास्थाय सुदृढव्रतः।।2.5.4।।
transliteration: tatheti ca sa rājānamuktvā vedavidāṃ varaḥ| svayaṃ vasiṣṭho bhagavānyayau rāmaniveśanam upavāsayituṃ rāmaṃ mantravanmantrakovidaḥ| brāhmaṃ rathavaraṃ yuktamāsthāya sudṛḍhavrataḥ
translation: वेदविदाम् of those who know the Vedas, वरः best, मन्त्रकोविदः skilled in mantras, सुदृढव्रतः one who is firm in his vows, भगवान् venerable, सः वसिष्ठः that Vasistha, तथा इति Be it so, राजानाम् king, उक्त्वा having said, युक्तम् harnessed, ब्राह्मम् befitting a brahmin, रथवरम् best of chariots, आस्थाय having mounted, रामम् to Rama, मन्त्रवत् in accompaniment with mantras, उपवासयितुम् to make him fast, स्वयम् personally, रामनिवेशनम् to the abode of Rama, ययौ went.
explanation: Venerabel Vasistha, the best amongst the knowers of the Vedas, skilled in mantras and firm in his vows said to the king, 'Be it so.' Thereafter,  mounted on the best of the chariots befitting a brahmin, with horses harnesed he proceeded personally to the abode of Rama to ask him to undertake a fast in accompaniment with mantras preceding the installation ceremony.

shloka_text: स रामभवनं प्राप्य पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रभम्। तिस्रः कक्ष्या रथेनैव विवेशमुनिसत्तमः।।2.5.5।।
transliteration: sa rāmabhavanaṃ prāpya pāṇḍurābhraghanaprabham| tisraḥ kakṣyā rathenaiva viveśamunisattamaḥ
translation: सः मुनिसत्तमः that foremost of ascetics, पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रभम् shining like a mass of white clouds beaming with brightness, रामभवनम् abode of Rama, प्राप्य having reached, तिस्रः three, कक्ष्याः yards, रथेनैव mounted on the chariot itself, विवेश entered.
explanation: Having crossed the three courtyards in the chariot, that foremost of ascetics (Vasistha) entered Rams's abode, shining like a mass of white clouds.

shloka_text: तमागतमृषिं रामस्त्वरन्निव ससम्भ्रमः। मानयिष्यन्समानार्हं निश्चक्राम निवेशनात्।।2.5.6।।
transliteration: tamāgatamṛṣiṃ rāmastvaranniva sasambhramaḥ| mānayiṣyansamānārhaṃ niścakrāma niveśanāt
translation: सः रामः that Rama, मानार्हम् worthy of honour, आगतम् who arrived pale, तम् ऋषिम् to the sage (Vasistha), मानयिष्यन् to pay respect, त्वरन्निव quickly, ससम्भ्रमः in great excitement, निवेशनात् from his abode, निश्चक्राम came out.
explanation: Seeing the venerable sage(Vasitha) arrive, Rama quickly came out of his abode in great excitement to receive him with honour.

shloka_text: अभ्येत्य त्वरमाणश्च रथाभ्याशं मनीषिणः। ततोऽवतारयामास परिगृह्य रथात्स्वयम्।।2.5.7।।
transliteration: abhyetya tvaramāṇaśca rathābhyāśaṃ manīṣiṇaḥ| tato'vatārayāmāsa parigṛhya rathātsvayam
translation: मनीषिणः sagacious Vasistha's, रथाभ्याशम् near the chariot, त्वरमाणः hastening steps, अभ्येत्य having approached, ततः thereafter, रथात् from the chariot, स्वयम् personally , परिगृह्य holding(his hand), अवतारयामास got him alighted.
explanation: Hastening with rapid strides, Rama approached the chariot of the sagacious Vasistha and personally helped him alight from the chariot.

shloka_text: स चैनं प्रश्रितं दृष्ट्वा सम्भाष्याभिप्रसाद्य च। प्रियार्हं हर्षयन्राममित्युवाच पुरोहितः।।2.5.8।।
transliteration: sa cainaṃ praśritaṃ dṛṣṭvā sambhāṣyābhiprasādya ca| priyārhaṃ harṣayanrāmamityuvāca purohitaḥ
translation: सः पुरोहितः च the family priest also, प्रियार्हम् lovable words, प्रश्रितम् humble, एनम् रामम् to this Rama, दृष्ट्वा having seen, संभाष्य having addressed him, अभिप्रसाद्य च and making him gratified, हर्षयन् causing him delight, इति thus, उवाच said.
explanation: The family priest Vasistha also, having gratified him by enquiring about his welfare, said thus to Rama, who was humble and lovable:

shloka_text: प्रसन्नस्ते पिता राम यौवराज्यमवाप्स्यसि। उपवासं भवानद्य करोतु सह सीतया।।2.5.9।।
transliteration: prasannaste pitā rāma yauvarājyamavāpsyasi| upavāsaṃ bhavānadya karotu saha sītayā
translation: राम O Rama, ते with you, पिता (your) father, प्रसन्नः welldisposed, यौवराज्यम् as  heirapparent, अवाप्स्यसि will obtain, भवान् you, अद्य today, सह सीतया with Sita, उपवासं करोतु undertake fast.
explanation: O Rama, welldisposed towards you, your father will declare you heirapparent. Do undertake fast today, along with Sita.

shloka_text: प्रातस्त्वामभिषेक्ता हि यौवराज्ये नराधिपः। पिता दशरथः प्रीत्या ययातिं नहुषो यथा।।2.5.10।।
transliteration: prātastvāmabhiṣektā hi yauvarājye narādhipaḥ| pitā daśarathaḥ prītyā yayātiṃ nahuṣo yathā
translation: नराधिपः the king, पिता father, दशरथः Dasaratha, प्रातः early in the morning, त्वाम् you, नहुषः Nahusha, ययातिं यथा like Yayati, प्रीत्या with affection, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ता हि will coronate .
explanation: Your father, king Dasaratha, will be pleased to coronate you as heirapparent early tomorrow morning as Nahusa did (to his son) Yayati.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा स तदा राममुपवासं यतव्रतम्। मन्त्रवत्कारयामास वैदेह्या सहितं मुनिः।।2.5.11।।
transliteration: ityuktvā sa tadā rāmamupavāsaṃ yatavratam| mantravatkārayāmāsa vaidehyā sahitaṃ muniḥ
translation: सः मुनिः that ascetic(Vasistha), इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, यतव्रतम् observing vow, वैदेह्या सहितम्  together with Sita, रामम् Rama, तदा then, मन्त्रवत् in accompaniment with sacred hymns, उपवासम् fast, कारयामास made (to undertake).
explanation: The ascetic (Vasistha) having thus spoken to Rama made him undertake fast along with Sita in accompaniment with sacred hymns.

shloka_text: ततो यथावद्रामेण स राज्ञो गुरुरर्चितः। अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य काकुत्स्थं ययौ रामनिवेशनात्।।2.5.12।।
transliteration: tato yathāvadrāmeṇa sa rājño gururarcitaḥ| abhyanujñāpya kākutsthaṃ yayau rāmaniveśanāt
translation: ततः thereafter, राज्ञः king's, गुरुः preceptor, सः he, (Vasistha), रामेण by Rama, यथावत् duly, अर्चितः honoured, काकुत्स्थम् the descendant of Kakutstha (Rama), अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave, रामनिवेशनात् from the abode of Rama, ययौ departed.
explanation: Thereafter, Vasistha, preceptor of the king duly honoured by the descendant of Kakutstha (Rama) left his abode.

shloka_text: सुहृद्भिस्तत्र रामोऽपि सहासीनः प्रियंवदैः। सभाजितो विवेशाऽथ ताननुज्ञाप्य सर्वशः।।2.5.13।।
transliteration: suhṛdbhistatra rāmo'pi sahāsīnaḥ priyaṃvadaiḥ| sabhājito viveśā'tha tānanujñāpya sarvaśaḥ
translation: रामोऽपि Rama also, प्रियंवदैः talking affectionately, सुहृद्भि: सह in the company of friends, तत्र there, आसीनः being seated, अथ thereafter, सभाजितः having been honoured, सर्वशः in all ways, तान् them, अनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave, विवेश entered (his apartment).
explanation: Rama also sat for a while in the company of his sweettongued friends and duly  honoured by them in every way took  leave  of them and entered his apartment.

shloka_text: ﻿हृष्टनारीनरयुतं रामवेश्म तदा बभौ। यथा मत्तद्विजगणं प्रफुल्लनलिनं सरः।।2.5.14।।
transliteration: ﻿hṛṣṭanārīnarayutaṃ rāmaveśma tadā babhau| yathā mattadvijagaṇaṃ praphullanalinaṃ saraḥ
translation: ﻿ तदा then, हृष्टनारीनरयुतम् filled with cheerful men and women, रामवेश्म Rama's residence, मत्तद्विजगणम् multitude of intoxicated birds, प्रफुल्लनलिनम् with fullblown lotuses, सरः यथा like a lake, बभौ was splendid.
explanation: ﻿ The residence of Rama, full of cheerful men and women, looked splendid like a lake with fullblown lotuses flocked by multitudes of intoxicated birds.

shloka_text: स राजभवनप्रख्यात्तस्माद्रामनिवेशानात्। निर्गत्य ददृशे मार्गं वसिष्ठो जनसंवृतम्।।2.5.15।।
transliteration: sa rājabhavanaprakhyāttasmādrāmaniveśānāt| nirgatya dadṛśe mārgaṃ vasiṣṭho janasaṃvṛtam
translation: सः वसिष्ठः that Vasistha, राजभवनप्रख्यात् resembling a royal palace, तस्मात् from that, रामनिवेशनात् abode of Rama, निर्गत्य having emerged, जनसंवृतम् filled with people, मार्गम् highway, ददृशे beheld.
explanation: Vasistha thereafter emerged from the abode of Rama resembling a royal palace and beheld the highways filled with people.

shloka_text: बृन्दबृन्दैरयोध्यायां राजमार्गास्समन्ततः। बभूवुरभिसम्बाधाः कुतूहलजनैर्वृताः।।2.5.16।।
transliteration: bṛndabṛndairayodhyāyāṃ rājamārgāssamantataḥ| babhūvurabhisambādhāḥ kutūhalajanairvṛtāḥ
translation: अयोध्यायाम् in the city of Ayodhya, राजमार्गाः royal highways, समन्ततः on all sides, बृन्दबृन्दैः crowds of, कुतूहलजनैः by curious people, वृताः surrounded, अभिसम्बाधाः बभूवु: were jammed.
explanation: The royal highways in the city of Ayodhya were jammed on all sides with groups of curious people.

shloka_text: जनबृन्दोर्मिसंघर्षहर्षस्वनवतस्तदा। बभूव राजमार्गस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः।।2.5.17।।
transliteration: janabṛndormisaṃgharṣaharṣasvanavatastadā| babhūva rājamārgasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ
translation: तदा then, जनबृन्दोर्मिसंघर्षहर्षस्वनवतः the exultation of the multitudes resembled the roar of the clashing of waves, राजमार्गस्य of the highways, निस्वनः sound, सागरस्येव like that of the roaring sea, बभूव emerged.
explanation: The highways resembled the sea and the exultation of the multitudes, the roar that emanated from the clashing of waves.

shloka_text: सिक्तसम्मृष्टरथ्या हि तदहर्वनमालिनी। आसीदयोध्यानगरी समुच्छ्रितगृहध्वजा।।2.5.18।।
transliteration: siktasammṛṣṭarathyā hi tadaharvanamālinī| āsīdayodhyānagarī samucchritagṛhadhvajā
translation: तदहः on that day, अयोध्यानगरी the city of Ayodhya, सिक्तसम्मृष्टरथ्या हि with thoroughfares sprinkled with water and swept, वनमालिनी surrounded with gardens, समुच्छ्रितगृहध्वजा आसीत् banners raised high on the houses.
explanation: On that day, the thoroughfares of the city of Ayodhya, surrounded with (pleasure) gardens, were sprinkled with water and swept. The flags (on the top) of the houses were raised high.

shloka_text: ﻿तदा ह्ययोध्यानिलयः सस्त्रीबालाबलो जनः। रामाभिषेकमाकाङ्क्षन्नाकाङ्क्षदुदयं रवेः।।2.5.19।।
transliteration: ﻿tadā hyayodhyānilayaḥ sastrībālābalo janaḥ| rāmābhiṣekamākāṅkṣannākāṅkṣadudayaṃ raveḥ
translation: ﻿ तदा then, सस्त्रीबालाबलः with women, children, and weak, old persons, अयोध्यानिलयः living in Ayodhya, जनः people, रामाभिषेकम् coronation of Rama, आकाङ्क्षान् desiring, रवे: उदयम् sunrise, आकाङ्क्षत् eagerly desired.
explanation: ﻿ Then all the people living in Ayodhya including women, children and aged alike wishing to see the coronation of Rama eagerly waited for the sunrise.

shloka_text: ﻿प्रजालङ्कारभूतं च जनस्यानन्दवर्धनम्। उत्सुकोऽभूज्जनो द्रष्टुं तमयोध्यामहोत्सवम्।।2.5.20।।
transliteration: ﻿prajālaṅkārabhūtaṃ ca janasyānandavardhanam| utsuko'bhūjjano draṣṭuṃ tamayodhyāmahotsavam
translation: ﻿ प्रजालङ्कारभूतम् like an ornament for people, जनस्य for men, आनन्दवर्धनम् enhancing joy, तम् अयोध्यामहोत्सवम् that great festival of Ayodhya, द्रष्टुम् to witness, जनः men, उत्सुकः अभूत् became anxious.
explanation: ﻿ People were anxious to witness that great festival of Ayodhya which was to them (precious) like an ornament and a source of immense joy.

shloka_text: एवं तज्जनसम्बाधं राजमार्गं पुरोहितः। व्यूहन्निव जनौघं तं शनै राजकुलं ययौ।।2.5.21।।
transliteration: evaṃ tajjanasambādhaṃ rājamārgaṃ purohitaḥ| vyūhanniva janaughaṃ taṃ śanai rājakulaṃ yayau
translation: पुरोहितः priest (Vasistha), एवम् in this way, जनसम्बाधम् thronged with men, तं राजमार्गम् that highway, तं जनौघम् crowds of men, व्यूहन्निव like dividing (into two tracts), शनैः slowly, राजकुलम् royal palace, ययौ went.
explanation: The priest (Vasistha), beholding the overcrowded highway forced his passage through the crowds of men dividing them into two tracts and slowly entered the royal palace.

shloka_text: सिताभ्रशिखरप्रख्यं प्रासादमधिरुह्य सः। समीयाय नरेन्द्रेण शक्रेणेव बृहस्पतिः।।2.5.22।।
transliteration: sitābhraśikharaprakhyaṃ prāsādamadhiruhya saḥ| samīyāya narendreṇa śakreṇeva bṛhaspatiḥ
translation: सः he, सिताभ्रशिखरप्रख्यम् looking like the peak of a mountain covered with white clouds, प्रासादम् royal palace, अधिरुह्य having ascended, बृहस्पतिः Brihaspati, शक्रेणेव like Indra, नरेन्द्रेण with king, समीयाय met.
explanation: Having ascended the royal palace resembling the peak of a mountain covered with white clouds, Vasistha approached the king like  Brihaspati meeting Indra.

shloka_text: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य हित्वा राजासनं नृपः। पप्रच्छ स च तस्मै तत्कृतमित्यभ्यवेदयत्।।2.5.23।।
transliteration: tamāgatamabhiprekṣya hitvā rājāsanaṃ nṛpaḥ| papraccha sa ca tasmai tatkṛtamityabhyavedayat
translation: नृपः king, आगतम् who had arrived, तम् him, अभिप्रेक्ष्य having seen, राजासनम् the throne, हित्वा after leaving, पप्रच्छ enquired, सः च he also, तत् that, कृतम् performed, इति thus, तस्मै him, अभ्यवेदयत् informed.
explanation: On seeing Vasistha the king descended from the throne and enquired whether he had performed the mission to which the ascetic replied affirmatively.

shloka_text: चैव तदा तुल्यं सहासीनास्सभासदः। आसनेभ्यस्समुत्तस्थुः पूजयन्तः पुरोहितम्।।2.5.24।।
transliteration: caiva tadā tulyaṃ sahāsīnāssabhāsadaḥ| āsanebhyassamuttasthuḥ pūjayantaḥ purohitam
translation: तदा then, सह आसीनाः seated with him, सभासदः courtiers, तेन तुल्यम् एव in the same way as he (Dasaratha) did, पुरोहितम् to the priest, पूजयन्तः to pay obeisance, आसनेभ्यः from their seats, समुत्तस्थुः rose.
explanation: All those present in the assembly with him (the king) also got up from their seats as he (Dasaratha) did and paid their obeisance to Vasistha.

shloka_text: गुरुणा त्वभ्यनुज्ञातो मनुजौघं विसृज्य तम्। विवेशान्तः पुरं राजा सिंहो गिरिगुहामिव।।2.5.25।।
transliteration: guruṇā tvabhyanujñāto manujaughaṃ visṛjya tam| viveśāntaḥ puraṃ rājā siṃho giriguhāmiva
translation: राजा the king, गुरुणा by the preceptor, अभ्यनुज्ञातः having been permitted, तम्  मनुजौघम् that assembly of men, विसृज्य having disposed, सिंहः lion, गिरिगुहामिव like the cave of a mountain, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment, विवेश entered.
explanation: The king then, dully permitted by the preceptor, disposed the assembly of men and stepped into his inner apartment, like a lion entering the cave of a mountain.

shloka_text: तदग्य्रवेषप्रमदाजनाकुलं महेन्द्रवेश्मप्रतिमं निवेशनम्। विदीपयंश्चारु विवेश पार्थिव श्शशीव तारागणसङ्कुलं नभः।।2.5.26।।
transliteration: tadagyraveṣapramadājanākulaṃ mahendraveśmapratimaṃ niveśanam| vidīpayaṃścāru viveśa pārthiva śśaśīva tārāgaṇasaṅkulaṃ nabhaḥ
translation: पार्थिवः the king, अग्य्रवेषप्रमदाजनाकुलम् thronged with excellently attired women, महेन्द्रवेश्मप्रतिमम् equal to the palace of Mahendra, तं निवेशनम् that inner apartment, विदीपयन् illumining, चारु beautiful, तारागणसङ्कुलम् crowded with stars, नभः sky, शशीव like Moon, विवेश entered.
explanation: The king entered the inner apartment thronged with excellently attired women which looked like the palace of Mahendra. He resembled the beautiful Moon that illuminates the sky crowded with stars. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे पञ्चमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: गते पुरोहिते रामः स्नातो नियतमानसः। सह पत्न्या विशालाक्ष्या नारायणमुपागमत्।।2.6.1।।
transliteration: gate purohite rāmaḥ snāto niyatamānasaḥ| saha patnyā viśālākṣyā nārāyaṇamupāgamat
translation: पुरोहिते the family priest, गते (सति) having gone, रामः Rama, स्नातः  bathed, नियतमानसः with  mind under control, विशालाक्ष्या largeeyed (large eyes are marks of beauty), पत्न्या सह with (his) wife, नारायणम् to (lord) Narayana, उपागमत् approached.
explanation: With the family priest (Vasistha) gone, Rama had his bath, and with his mind under control came to Lord Narayana along with his largeeyed consort, Sita. (with an intention to worship him)
comments: Rama and Sita observe the prescribed rites--rejoiced citizens of Ayodhya express their gratitude to the king--people from villages arrive in multitudes.

shloka_text: प्रगृह्य शिरसा पात्रीं हविषो विधिवत्तदा। महते दैवतायाज्यं जुहाव ज्वलितेऽनले।।2.6.2।।
transliteration: pragṛhya śirasā pātrīṃ haviṣo vidhivattadā| mahate daivatāyājyaṃ juhāva jvalite'nale
translation: तदा then, हविषः of havis (clarified butter and other oblations), पात्रीम् a small vessel where in offerings are put, विधिवत् in accordance with ritual practices, शिरसा on the head, प्रगृह्य having held, ज्वलितेनले in flaming (sacred) fire, महते great, दैवताय for great divinity (Visnu), आज्यम् clarified butter, जुहाव offered oblations.
explanation: Then holding the vessel containing havis on his head, he offered the oblations of  clarified butter into the sacred fire for Visnu in accordance with ritual practices.

shloka_text: शेषं च हविषस्तस्य प्राश्याशास्यात्मनः प्रियम्। ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे।।2.6.3।। वाग्यत स्सह वैदेह्या भूत्वा नियतमानसः। श्रीमत्यायतने विष्णो श्शिश्ये नरवरात्मजः।।2.6.4।।
transliteration: śeṣaṃ ca haviṣastasya prāśyāśāsyātmanaḥ priyam| dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svāstīrṇe kuśasaṃstare vāgyata ssaha vaidehyā bhūtvā niyatamānasaḥ| śrīmatyāyatane viṣṇo śśiśye naravarātmajaḥ
translation: नरवरात्मजः son of the king (Rama), आत्मनः of his own, प्रियम् welfare, आशास्य seeking, तस्य हविषः of that havis, शेषं the remainder, प्राश्य च having partaken, देवम्  नारायणम् God Narayana, ध्यायन् meditating upon, वाग्यतः भूत्वा adopting silence, नियतमानसः with restrained mind, विष्णोः Visnu's, श्रीमति (at the) auspicious, आयतने in the temple, स्वास्तीर्णे with wellspread, कुशसंस्तरे in the bed of kusha grass, वैदेह्या सह along with Vaidehi (Sita), शिश्ये slept.
explanation: The son of the king (Rama) partook the remainder of the havis seeking his own welfare. With a restrained mind and a vow of silence, he meditated upon Lord Narayana and slept along with Vaidehi on a wellspread bed of kusha grass in the auspicious temple of lord Visnu.

shloka_text: शेषं च हविषस्तस्य प्राश्याशास्यात्मनः प्रियम्। ध्यायन्नारायणं देवं स्वास्तीर्णे कुशसंस्तरे।।2.6.3।। वाग्यत स्सह वैदेह्या भूत्वा नियतमानसः। श्रीमत्यायतने विष्णो श्शिश्ये नरवरात्मजः।।2.6.4।।
transliteration: śeṣaṃ ca haviṣastasya prāśyāśāsyātmanaḥ priyam| dhyāyannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svāstīrṇe kuśasaṃstare vāgyata ssaha vaidehyā bhūtvā niyatamānasaḥ| śrīmatyāyatane viṣṇo śśiśye naravarātmajaḥ
translation: नरवरात्मजः son of the king (Rama), आत्मनः of his own, प्रियम् welfare, आशास्य seeking, तस्य हविषः of that havis, शेषं the remainder, प्राश्य च having partaken, देवम्  नारायणम् God Narayana, ध्यायन् meditating upon, वाग्यतः भूत्वा adopting silence, नियतमानसः with restrained mind, विष्णोः Visnu's, श्रीमति (at the) auspicious, आयतने in the temple, स्वास्तीर्णे with wellspread, कुशसंस्तरे in the bed of kusha grass, वैदेह्या सह along with Vaidehi (Sita), शिश्ये slept.
explanation: The son of the king (Rama) partook the remainder of the havis seeking his own welfare. With a restrained mind and a vow of silence, he meditated upon Lord Narayana and slept along with Vaidehi on a wellspread bed of kusha grass in the auspicious temple of lord Visnu.

shloka_text: एकयामावशिष्टायां रात्र्यां प्रतिविबुद्ध्य सः। अलङ्कारविधिं कृत्स्नं कारयामास वेश्मनः।।2.6.5।।
transliteration: ekayāmāvaśiṣṭāyāṃ rātryāṃ prativibuddhya saḥ| alaṅkāravidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ kārayāmāsa veśmanaḥ
translation: सः he, रात्र्याम् at night, एकयामावशिष्टायाम् with one yama (measure of time equivalent to four hours) left, प्रतिविबुद्ध्य having awakened, वेश्मनः dwelling's, कृत्स्नम् entire, अलङ्कारविधिम् decoration, कारयामास got it done.
explanation: He got up (Rama) with one yama (three hours) of the night still left, and had his entire  residence decorated.

shloka_text: तत्र श्रृण्वन्सुखा वाच स्सूतमागधवन्दिनाम्। पूर्वां सध्यामुपासीनो जजाप यतमानसः।।2.6.6।।
transliteration: tatra śrṛṇvansukhā vāca ssūtamāgadhavandinām| pūrvāṃ sadhyāmupāsīno jajāpa yatamānasaḥ
translation: तत्र there (in the last watch of the night), सूतमागधवन्दिनाम् of bards and panegyrists, सुखाः pleasant, वाचः words, श्रृण्वन् listening, पूर्वां सन्ध्याम् early morning rites, उपासीनः had attended, यतमानसः with controlled mind, जजाप chanted (Gayatri).
explanation: Then (in the last watch of the night) hearing the pleasant words of bards and panegyrists he attended to early morning rites and intoned Gayatri with a concentrated mind.

shloka_text: तुष्टाव प्रणतश्चैव शिरसा मधुसूदनम्। विमलक्षौमसंवीतो वाचयामास स द्विजान्।।2.6.7।।
transliteration: tuṣṭāva praṇataścaiva śirasā madhusūdanam| vimalakṣaumasaṃvīto vācayāmāsa sa dvijān
translation: शिरसा with head, प्रणत: bowed low, मधुसूदनम् Lord Visnu, तुष्टाव extoled, विमलक्षौमसंवीतः  dressed in spotless silk garments, द्विजान् to brahmins, वाचयामास got the purificatory mantras recited.
explanation: Clad in spotless silk garments, he extoled Lord Madhusudana (Visnu) with his head bowed low. He listened to the purificatory mantras recited by brahmins.

shloka_text: तेषां पुण्याहघोषोऽथ गम्भीरमधुरस्तदा। अयोध्यां पूरयामास तूर्यघोषानुनादितः।।2.6.8।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ puṇyāhaghoṣo'tha gambhīramadhurastadā| ayodhyāṃ pūrayāmāsa tūryaghoṣānunāditaḥ
translation: अथ then, तेषाम् their, गम्भीरमधुरः deep and sweet, पुण्याहघोषः proclamations of 'this is an auspicious day', तूर्यघोषानुनादितः reverberating with the sounds of trumpets, तदा then, अयोध्याम् (the city of) Ayodhya, पूरयामास filled.
explanation: And then the deep and sweet proclamations of 'This is an auspicious day' mingled with the sounds of trumpets reverberated (the city of) Ayodhya.

shloka_text: कृतोपवासं तु तदा वैदेह्या सह राघवम्। अयोध्यानिलयश्श्रुत्वा सर्वः प्रमुदितो जनः।।2.6.9।।
transliteration: kṛtopavāsaṃ tu tadā vaidehyā saha rāghavam| ayodhyānilayaśśrutvā sarvaḥ pramudito janaḥ
translation: तदा then, राघवम् to the scion of the Raghus (Rama), वैदेह्या सह along with the princess of Videha, (Sita), कृतोपवासम् had undertaken the fast, श्रुत्वा having heard, अयोध्यानिलयः  residents of Ayodhya, सर्वः all, जनः men, प्रमुदितः rejoiced.
explanation: The residents of Ayodhya were happy to hear that the scion of the Raghus (Rama) along with princess of Videha (Sita) had undertaken the fast.

shloka_text: ततः पौरजनस्सर्वश्श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम्। प्रभातां रजनीं दृष्ट्वा चक्रे शोभयितुं पुरीम्।।2.6.10।।
transliteration: tataḥ paurajanassarvaśśrutvā rāmābhiṣecanam| prabhātāṃ rajanīṃ dṛṣṭvā cakre śobhayituṃ purīm
translation: ततः afterwards, सर्वः all, पौरजनः citizens, रामाभिषेचनम् consecration of Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, रजनीम् the night, प्रभाताम् brightened into dawn, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पुरीम् the city, शोभयितुम् to decorate, चक्रे made (commenced).
explanation: Having heard about the coronation of Rama, all the citizens began to decorate the city soon after daybreak.

shloka_text: सिताभ्रशिखराभेषु देवतायतनेषु च। चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु चैत्येष्वट्टालकेषु च।।2.6.11।। नानापण्यसमृद्धेषु वणिजामापणेषु च। कुटुम्बिनां समृद्धेषु श्रीमत्सु भवनेषु च।।2.6.12।। सभासु चैव सर्वासु वृक्षेष्वालक्षितेषु च। ध्वजा स्समुच्छ्रिताश्चित्राः पताकाश्चाभवंस्तदा।।2.6.13।।
transliteration: sitābhraśikharābheṣu devatāyataneṣu ca| catuṣpatheṣu rathyāsu caityeṣvaṭṭālakeṣu ca nānāpaṇyasamṛddheṣu vaṇijāmāpaṇeṣu ca| kuṭumbināṃ samṛddheṣu śrīmatsu bhavaneṣu ca sabhāsu caiva sarvāsu vṛkṣeṣvālakṣiteṣu ca| dhvajā ssamucchritāścitrāḥ patākāścābhavaṃstadā
translation: सिताभ्रशिखराभेषु among those bright peaks wreathed by a mass of white clouds, देवतायतनेषु in the temples, चतुष्पथेषु at the crossroads, रथ्यासु on the thoroughfares, चैत्येषु on the tall trees dotting the avenues, अट्टालकेषु च on the towers too, नानापण्यसमृद्धेषु abounding in various kinds of merchandise, वणिजाम् of merchants, आपणेषु च in the stalls also, कुटुम्बिनाम् of householders, समृद्धेषु in prosperous (places), श्रीमत्सु in graceful, भवनेषु च in the houses, सर्वासु in all, सभासु public halls, आलक्षितेषु seen from distances, वृक्षेषु on the trees, तदा then, ध्वजाः banners, चित्राः varying colours, पताकाः च flags, too, समुच्छ्रिचिताः were erected अभवन् became.
explanation: Banners of varying colours and flags were raised on the temples looking resplendent like peaks wreathed by a mass of white clouds, at the crossroads, on the thoroughfares, on the trees standing on avenues, on the towers and stalls of the merchants abounding in various kinds of merchandise, on prosperous and graceful houses of householders, in all public halls and on trees looking tall from a distance.

shloka_text: सिताभ्रशिखराभेषु देवतायतनेषु च। चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु चैत्येष्वट्टालकेषु च।।2.6.11।। नानापण्यसमृद्धेषु वणिजामापणेषु च। कुटुम्बिनां समृद्धेषु श्रीमत्सु भवनेषु च।।2.6.12।। सभासु चैव सर्वासु वृक्षेष्वालक्षितेषु च। ध्वजा स्समुच्छ्रिताश्चित्राः पताकाश्चाभवंस्तदा।।2.6.13।।

explanation: Banners of varying colours and flags were raised on the temples looking resplendent like peaks wreathed by a mass of white clouds, at the crossroads, on the thoroughfares, on the trees standing on avenues, on the towers and stalls of the merchants abounding in various kinds of merchandise, on prosperous and graceful houses of householders, in all public halls and on trees looking tall from a distance.

shloka_text: सिताभ्रशिखराभेषु देवतायतनेषु च। चतुष्पथेषु रथ्यासु चैत्येष्वट्टालकेषु च।।2.6.11।। नानापण्यसमृद्धेषु वणिजामापणेषु च। कुटुम्बिनां समृद्धेषु श्रीमत्सु भवनेषु च।।2.6.12।। सभासु चैव सर्वासु वृक्षेष्वालक्षितेषु च। ध्वजा स्समुच्छ्रिताश्चित्राः पताकाश्चाभवंस्तदा।।2.6.13।।

explanation: Banners of varying colours and flags were raised on the temples looking resplendent like peaks wreathed by a mass of white clouds, at the crossroads, on the thoroughfares, on the trees standing on avenues, on the towers and stalls of the merchants abounding in various kinds of merchandise, on prosperous and graceful houses of householders, in all public halls and on trees looking tall from a distance.

shloka_text: नटनर्तकसङ्घानां गायकानां च गायताम्। मनः कर्णसुखा वाच श्शुशृवुश्च ततस्ततः।।2.6.14।।
transliteration: naṭanartakasaṅghānāṃ gāyakānāṃ ca gāyatām| manaḥ karṇasukhā vāca śśuśṛvuśca tatastataḥ
translation: ततस्ततः here and there, नटनर्तकसङ्घानाम् of troupes of actors and dancers, गायताम् of singers, गायकानां च also of songsters, मनः कर्णसुखाः pleasing to the mind and ears, वाचः words, शुश्रुवुः heard.
explanation: Troupes of actors and dancers entertained the people with songs pleasing to the mind and ears and their utterances were heard here and there.

shloka_text: रामाभिषेकयुक्ताश्च कथाश्चक्रुर्मिथो जनाः। रामाभिषेके सम्प्राप्ते चत्वरेषु गृहेषु च।।2.6.15।।
transliteration: rāmābhiṣekayuktāśca kathāścakrurmitho janāḥ| rāmābhiṣeke samprāpte catvareṣu gṛheṣu ca
translation: रामाभिषेके as the coronation of Rama, संप्राप्ते approached, जना: the people, चत्वरेषु at the public squares, गृहेषु च in the private houses, मिथः with one another, रामाभिषेकयुक्ताः concerning Rama's coronation, कथाः talk, चक्रुः made.
explanation: As the time for Rama's coronation was approaching, men in public squares and in private houses talked with one another about the consecration of Rama.

shloka_text: बाला अपि क्रीडमाना गृहद्वारेषु सङ्घशः। रामाभिषवसंयुक्ताश्चक्रुरेवं मिथः कथाः।।2.6.16।।
transliteration: bālā api krīḍamānā gṛhadvāreṣu saṅghaśaḥ| rāmābhiṣavasaṃyuktāścakrurevaṃ mithaḥ kathāḥ
translation: एवम् thus, गृहद्वारेषु in the doorways, सङ्घशः in groups, क्रीडमानाः playing, बालाः अपि children also, मिथः with each other, रामाभिषवसंयुक्ताः relating to the coronation of Rama, कथाः stories, चक्रुः made.
explanation: Similarly children playing in groups in front of the houses also related to each other  stories regarding the coronation of Rama.

shloka_text: कृतपुष्पोपहारश्च धूपगन्धाधिवासितः। राजमार्गः कृतः श्रीमान्पौरै रामाभिषेचने।।2.6.17।।
transliteration: kṛtapuṣpopahāraśca dhūpagandhādhivāsitaḥ| rājamārgaḥ kṛtaḥ śrīmānpaurai rāmābhiṣecane
translation: रामाभिषेचने on the occasion of Rama's coronation, पौरैः by citizens, राजमार्गः highways, कृतपुष्पोपहारश्च strewn with flowers , धूपगन्धाधिवासितः fragrant with incense, श्रीमान् glorious, कृतः made.
explanation: On the occasion of Rama's coronation the highway, strewn with flowers and rendered fragrant with the burning of incense by the citizens looked glorious.

shloka_text: प्रकाशकरणार्थं च निशागमनशङ्कया। दीपवृक्षां स्तथा चक्रुरनु रथ्यासु सर्वशः।।2.6.18।।
transliteration: prakāśakaraṇārthaṃ ca niśāgamanaśaṅkayā| dīpavṛkṣāṃ stathā cakruranu rathyāsu sarvaśaḥ
translation: तथा so also, अनु connected with if, निशागमनशङ्कया lest night should fall, प्रकाशकरणार्थम् to light it up, रथ्यासु in the streets, सर्वशः all over, दीपवृक्षान् lamps in the shape of trees, चक्रुः improvised.
explanation: In the same way lest night should fall (by the time the installation ceremony was completed), the streets were provided with lamps in the shape of trees to light them up.

shloka_text: अलङ्कारं पुरस्यैवं कृत्वा तत्पुरवासिनः। आकाङ्क्षमाणा रामस्य यौवराज्याभिषेचनम्।।2.6.19।। समेत्य सङ्घशस्सर्वे चत्वरेषु सभासु च। कथयन्तो मिथस्तत्र प्रशशंसुर्जनाधिपम्।।2.6.20।।
transliteration: alaṅkāraṃ purasyaivaṃ kṛtvā tatpuravāsinaḥ| ākāṅkṣamāṇā rāmasya yauvarājyābhiṣecanam sametya saṅghaśassarve catvareṣu sabhāsu ca| kathayanto mithastatra praśaśaṃsurjanādhipam
translation: तत्पुरवासिनः inhabitants of the city, सर्वे all of them, एवम् thus, पुरस्य city's, अलङ्कारम् decoration, कृत्वा having made, रामस्य Rama's, यौवराज्याभिषेचनम् coronation as heirapparent, आकाङ्क्षमाणाः eagerly desiring, चत्वरेषु at the public squares, सभासु च in the assembly halls, सङ्घशः in groups, समेत्य having assembled, तत्र there, मिथः mutually, कथयन्तः conversing, जनाधिपम् to the lord of men (Dasaratha), प्रशशंसुः praised.
explanation: Thus the residents of Ayodhya decorated the city and eagerly waited for Rama's cornonation as heirapparent. Gathered in groups at public squares and in the assembly halls they conversed among themselves about the event, praising Dasaratha, the lord among men.

shloka_text: अलङ्कारं पुरस्यैवं कृत्वा तत्पुरवासिनः। आकाङ्क्षमाणा रामस्य यौवराज्याभिषेचनम्।।2.6.19।। समेत्य सङ्घशस्सर्वे चत्वरेषु सभासु च। कथयन्तो मिथस्तत्र प्रशशंसुर्जनाधिपम्।।2.6.20।।
transliteration: alaṅkāraṃ purasyaivaṃ kṛtvā tatpuravāsinaḥ| ākāṅkṣamāṇā rāmasya yauvarājyābhiṣecanam sametya saṅghaśassarve catvareṣu sabhāsu ca| kathayanto mithastatra praśaśaṃsurjanādhipam
translation: तत्पुरवासिनः inhabitants of the city, सर्वे all of them, एवम् thus, पुरस्य city's, अलङ्कारम् decoration, कृत्वा having made, रामस्य Rama's, यौवराज्याभिषेचनम् coronation as heirapparent, आकाङ्क्षमाणाः eagerly desiring, चत्वरेषु at the public squares, सभासु च in the assembly halls, सङ्घशः in groups, समेत्य having assembled, तत्र there, मिथः mutually, कथयन्तः conversing, जनाधिपम् to the lord of men (Dasaratha), प्रशशंसुः praised.
explanation: Thus the residents of Ayodhya decorated the city and eagerly waited for Rama's cornonation as heirapparent. Gathered in groups at public squares and in the assembly halls they conversed among themselves about the event, praising Dasaratha, the lord among men.

shloka_text: अहो महात्मा राजाऽयमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः। ज्ञात्वा यो वृद्धमात्मानं रामं राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति।।2.6.21।।
transliteration: aho mahātmā rājā'yamikṣvākukulanandanaḥ| jñātvā yo vṛddhamātmānaṃ rāmaṃ rājye'bhiṣekṣyati
translation: यः that king, आत्मानम् himself, वृद्धम्  aged, ज्ञात्वा having realised, रामम् to Rama, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषेक्ष्यति is going to install, अयम् this, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः causing delight to the Ikshvaku race, राजा king , महात्मा highsouled, अहो oh.
explanation: Oh having realised that he himself has grown old the highsouled king Dasaratha the veritable delight to the Ikshvaku race,  is going to coronate Rama in the kingdom.

shloka_text: सर्वेप्यनुगृहीता स्मो यन्नो रामो महीपतिः। चिराय भविता गोप्ता दृष्टलोकपरावरः।।2.6.22।।
transliteration: sarvepyanugṛhītā smo yanno rāmo mahīpatiḥ| cirāya bhavitā goptā dṛṣṭalokaparāvaraḥ
translation: यत् indeed, दृष्टलोकपरावरः who has seen the world's high and low, रामः Rama, महीपतिः as king, चिराय for a long time, नः for us, गोप्ता protector, भविता shall become, सर्वेऽपि all of us, अनुगृहीताः स्म are favoured.
explanation: All of us are fortunate indeed that Rama who knows the world's high and low shall be our king, protector for a long time.

shloka_text: अनुद्धतमनाः विद्वान्धर्मात्मा भ्रातृवत्सलः। यथा च भ्रातृषु स्निग्धस्तथाऽस्मास्वपि राघवः।।2.6.23।।
transliteration: anuddhatamanāḥ vidvāndharmātmā bhrātṛvatsalaḥ| yathā ca bhrātṛṣu snigdhastathā'smāsvapi rāghavaḥ
translation: अनुद्धतमनाः one who is not arrogant, विद्वान् learned, धर्मात्मा a pious soul, भ्रातृवत्सलः  affectionate towards his brothers, राघवः scion of the Raghus (Rama), भ्रातृषु in brothers, यथा like, स्निग्धः friendly, अस्मास्वपि even in us, तथा in that manner.
explanation: This scion of the Raghus (Rama) is free from arrogance, is learned, righteous and affectionate towards his brothers as much as towards us.

shloka_text: चिरं जीवतु धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथोऽनघः। यत्प्रसादोनभिषिक्तं तु रामं द्रक्ष्यामहे वयम्।।2.6.24।।
transliteration: ciraṃ jīvatu dharmātmā rājā daśaratho'naghaḥ| yatprasādonabhiṣiktaṃ tu rāmaṃ drakṣyāmahe vayam
translation: यत्प्रसादेन by whose grace, अभिषिक्तम् having been coronated, रामम् of Rama, द्रक्ष्यामहे we are beholding, धर्मात्मा virtuous, अनघः sinless, दशरथः राजा king Dasaratha, चिरम् for long, जीवतु let live.
explanation: May the virtuous and sinless king Dasaratha live long by whose grace we are beholding (going to behold) Rama's coronation.

shloka_text: एवंविधं कथयतां पौराणां शुश्रुवु स्तदा। दिग्भ्योपि श्रुतवृत्तान्ता: प्राप्ता जानपदा जनाः।।2.6.25।।
transliteration: evaṃvidhaṃ kathayatāṃ paurāṇāṃ śuśruvu stadā| digbhyopi śrutavṛttāntā: prāptā jānapadā janāḥ
translation: श्रुतवृत्तान्ताः having heard the story, दिग्भ्यः अपि from all quarters also, प्राप्ताः had arrived, जानपदाः जनाः village folk, तदा then, एवं विधम् in this manner, पौराणाम् of citizens, कथयताम् while conversing, शुश्रुवुः heard.
explanation: Having heard about the coronation of Rama, villagers arrived from all directions and listened to the citizens conversing in this manner.

shloka_text: ते तु दिग्भ्यः पुरीं प्राप्ता द्रष्टुं रामाभिषेचनम्। रामस्य पूरयामासुः पुरीं जानपदा जनाः।।2.6.26।।
transliteration: te tu digbhyaḥ purīṃ prāptā draṣṭuṃ rāmābhiṣecanam| rāmasya pūrayāmāsuḥ purīṃ jānapadā janāḥ
translation: रामाभिषेचनम् coronation of Rama, द्रष्टुम् to behold, दिग्भ्यः from different directions, पुरम् the city, प्राप्ताः have arrived, ते those, जानपदाः villagers, जनाः men, रामस्य Rama's, पुरीम् city, पूरयामासुः filled.
explanation: The city was filled with villagers coming from different directions to behold Rama's coronation.

shloka_text: जनौघैस्तैर्विसर्पद्भिः शुश्रुवे तत्र निस्वनः। पर्वसूदीर्णवेगस्य सागरस्येव निस्वनः।।2.6.27।।
transliteration: janaughaistairvisarpadbhiḥ śuśruve tatra nisvanaḥ| parvasūdīrṇavegasya sāgarasyeva nisvanaḥ
translation: विसर्पद्भि: by those moving to and fro, तैः जनौघैः by those multitudes of men, तत्र there, निस्वनः noise, पर्वसु on the full and new moon days, उदीर्णवेगस्य with violent speed, सागरस्य of the ocean, निस्वनः इव like the sound, शुश्रुवे was heard.
explanation: The multitudes of men moving to and fro gave rise to a noise like the roar of the ocean enhanced by the violent speed (of the wind) on the full and new moon days.

shloka_text: ततस्तदिन्द्रक्षयसन्निभं पुरं दिदृक्षुभिर्जानपदैरुपागतैः। समन्तत स्सस्वनमाकुलं बभौ समुद्रयादोभिरिवार्णवोदकम्।।2.6.28।।
transliteration: tatastadindrakṣayasannibhaṃ puraṃ didṛkṣubhirjānapadairupāgataiḥ| samantata ssasvanamākulaṃ babhau samudrayādobhirivārṇavodakam
translation: दिदृक्षुभिः wishing to see, उपागतैः arrived, जानपदैः villagers, समन्ततः every side, आकुलम् crowded, सस्वनम् with sounds, इन्द्रक्षयसन्निभम् resembling the abode of Indra, तत् that, पुरम् city, समुद्रयादोभिः with aquatic animals, अर्णवोदकम् इव like water of the ocean, बभौ shone.
explanation: The city (of Ayodhya), resembling the abode of Indra, (Amaravati) crowded with villagers from all over wishing to witness it (the coronation of Rama), grew noisy and sparkled like the water of the ocean teeming with aquatic animals. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ज्ञातिदासी यतो जाता कैकेय्यास्तु सहोषिता। प्रासादं चन्द्रसङ्काशमारुरोह यदृच्छया।।2.7.1।।
transliteration: jñātidāsī yato jātā kaikeyyāstu sahoṣitā| prāsādaṃ candrasaṅkāśamāruroha yadṛcchayā
translation: यत: जाता from the time of her birth, कैकेय्या सह along with Kaikeyi, ऊषिता living, ज्ञातिदासी family servant, यदृच्छया casually, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् resembling the Moon, प्रासादम् palace, आरुरोह ascended.
explanation: The family maid (Manthara) of Kaikeyi who had been living with her since her (Kaikeyi's) birth casually ascended the palace gleaming white like the Moon.
comments: Manthara informs Kaikeyi about the installation of Rama--happy over the news Kaikeyi gifts away her ornaments.

shloka_text: सिक्तराजपथां कृत्स्नां प्रकीर्णकुसुमोत्कराम्। अयोध्यां मन्थरा तस्मात्प्रासादादन्ववैक्षत।।2.7.2।।
transliteration: siktarājapathāṃ kṛtsnāṃ prakīrṇakusumotkarām| ayodhyāṃ mantharā tasmātprāsādādanvavaikṣata
translation: मन्थरा Manthara, सिक्तराजपथाम् highway sprinkled with water, प्रकीर्णकुसुमोत्कराम् strewn with a lot of flowers, कृत्स्नाम् whole, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, तस्मात् from that, प्रासादात् palace, अन्ववैक्षत beheld.
explanation: Manthara beheld from that palace the whole of Ayodhya with its highways sprinkled with water and strewn with a lot of flowers.

shloka_text: पताकाभिर्वरार्हाभिर्ध्वजैश्च समलङ्कृताम्। वृतां छन्दपथैश्चापि शिरस्स्नातजनैर्वृताम्।।2.7.3।। माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्च द्विजेन्द्रैरभिनादिताम्। शुक्लदेवगृहद्वारां सर्ववादित्रनिस्वनाम्।।2.7.4।। सम्प्रहृष्टजनाकीर्णां ब्रह्मघोषाभिनादिताम्। प्रहृष्टवरहस्त्यश्वां सम्प्रणर्दितगोवृषाम्।।2.7.5।। प्रहृष्टमुदितैः पौरैरुच्छ्रितध्वजमालिनीम्। अयोध्यां मन्थरा दृष्ट्वा परं विस्मयमागता।।2.7.6।।
transliteration: patākābhirvarārhābhirdhvajaiśca samalaṅkṛtām| vṛtāṃ chandapathaiścāpi śirassnātajanairvṛtām mālyamodakahastaiśca dvijendrairabhināditām| śukladevagṛhadvārāṃ sarvavāditranisvanām samprahṛṣṭajanākīrṇāṃ brahmaghoṣābhināditām| prahṛṣṭavarahastyaśvāṃ sampraṇarditagovṛṣām prahṛṣṭamuditaiḥ paurairucchritadhvajamālinīm| ayodhyāṃ mantharā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāgatā
translation: मन्थरा Manthara, तस्मात् प्रासादात् from that palace, वरार्हाभि: by costly, पताकाभि: with banners, ध्वजैश्च with flags, समलङ्कृताम् welldecorated, छन्दपथै: च अपि labyrinthine thoroughfares also, वृताम् enveloped by, शिरस्स्नातजनै: with men who had, वृताम् surrounded by, माल्यमोदकहस्तै: holding garlands and sweetmeats in their hands, द्विजेन्द्रै: with the best of brahmins, अभिनादिताम् reverberating, शुक्ल देवगृहद्वाराम् with temples with white doors, सर्ववादित्रनिस्वनाम् with sounds from every kind of musical instrument, सम्प्रहृष्टजनाकीर्णाम् filled with joyful crowds, ब्रह्मघोषाभिनादिताम् echoed  with the chanting of the Vedas, प्रहृष्टवरहस्त्यश्वाम् with the best boisterous horses and elephants, सम्प्रणर्दितगोवृषाम् with the lowing and bellowing of cows and bulls, प्रहृष्टमुदितै: with great joy, पौरै: by the citizens, उच्छ्रितध्वजमालिनीम् encircled by elevated pennants, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, विस्मयमागता was astonished.
explanation: The city of Ayodhya was decorated with costly banners and pennants. The labyrinthine roads were crowded with people who had (finished) their headbath and were wandering at will. The temples with their doors painted white were reverberating with the chanting from the Vedas by the best of brahmins holding garlands and sweetmeats in their hands and with sounds of   all kinds of musical instruments. The city was filled with spirited horses and elephants. The bulls were bellowing and the cows were lowing. The citizens with great joy raised the penants encircling the city of Ayodhya. All this left Manthara astonished.

The city was filled with spirited horses and elephants. The bulls were bellowing and the cows were lowing. The citizens with great joy raised the penants encircling the city of Ayodhya. All this left Manthara astonished.

shloka_text: पताकाभिर्वरार्हाभिर्ध्वजैश्च समलङ्कृताम्। वृतां छन्दपथैश्चापि शिरस्स्नातजनैर्वृताम्।।2.7.3।। माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्च द्विजेन्द्रैरभिनादिताम्। शुक्लदेवगृहद्वारां सर्ववादित्रनिस्वनाम्।।2.7.4।। सम्प्रहृष्टजनाकीर्णां ब्रह्मघोषाभिनादिताम्। प्रहृष्टवरहस्त्यश्वां सम्प्रणर्दितगोवृषाम्।।2.7.5।। प्रहृष्टमुदितैः पौरैरुच्छ्रितध्वजमालिनीम्। अयोध्यां मन्थरा दृष्ट्वा परं विस्मयमागता।।2.7.6।।
transliteration: patākābhirvarārhābhirdhvajaiśca samalaṅkṛtām| vṛtāṃ chandapathaiścāpi śirassnātajanairvṛtām mālyamodakahastaiśca dvijendrairabhināditām| śukladevagṛhadvārāṃ sarvavāditranisvanām samprahṛṣṭajanākīrṇāṃ brahmaghoṣābhināditām| prahṛṣṭavarahastyaśvāṃ sampraṇarditagovṛṣām prahṛṣṭamuditaiḥ paurairucchritadhvajamālinīm| ayodhyāṃ mantharā dṛṣṭvā paraṃ vismayamāgatā
translation: मन्थरा Manthara, तस्मात् प्रासादात् from that palace, वरार्हाभि: by costly, पताकाभि: with banners, ध्वजैश्च with flags, समलङ्कृताम् welldecorated, छन्दपथै: च अपि labyrinthine thoroughfares also, वृताम् enveloped by, शिरस्स्नातजनै: with men who had, वृताम् surrounded by, माल्यमोदकहस्तै: holding garlands and sweetmeats in their hands, द्विजेन्द्रै: with the best of brahmins, अभिनादिताम् reverberating, शुक्ल देवगृहद्वाराम् with temples with white doors, सर्ववादित्रनिस्वनाम् with sounds from every kind of musical instrument, सम्प्रहृष्टजनाकीर्णाम् filled with joyful crowds, ब्रह्मघोषाभिनादिताम् echoed  with the chanting of the Vedas, प्रहृष्टवरहस्त्यश्वाम् with the best boisterous horses and elephants, सम्प्रणर्दितगोवृषाम् with the lowing and bellowing of cows and bulls, प्रहृष्टमुदितै: with great joy, पौरै: by the citizens, उच्छ्रितध्वजमालिनीम् encircled by elevated pennants, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, विस्मयमागता was astonished.
explanation: The city of Ayodhya was decorated with costly banners and pennants. The labyrinthine roads were crowded with people who had (finished) their headbath and were wandering at will. The temples with their doors painted white were reverberating with the chanting from the Vedas by the best of brahmins holding garlands and sweetmeats in their hands and with sounds of   all kinds of musical instruments. The city was filled with spirited horses and elephants. The bulls were bellowing and the cows were lowing. The citizens with great joy raised the penants encircling the city of Ayodhya. All this left Manthara astonished.

shloka_text: प्रहर्षोत्फुल्लनयनां पाण्डुरक्षौमवासिनीम्। अविदूरे स्थितां दृष्ट्वा धात्रीं पप्रच्छ मन्थरा।।2.7.7।।
transliteration: praharṣotphullanayanāṃ pāṇḍurakṣaumavāsinīm| avidūre sthitāṃ dṛṣṭvā dhātrīṃ papraccha mantharā
