shloka_text: इह वा मां मृतां कुब्जे नृपायावेदयिष्यसि। वनं तु राघवे प्राप्ते भरतः प्राप्स्यति क्षितिम्।।2.9.58।।
transliteration: iha vā māṃ mṛtāṃ kubje nṛpāyāvedayiṣyasi| vanaṃ tu rāghave prāpte bharataḥ prāpsyati kṣitim
translation: कुब्जे O hunchback, राघवे to the scion of the Raghus (Rama), वनं तु to the forest, प्राप्ते having gone, भरत: Bharata, क्षितिम् earth, प्राप्स्यति secures, वा or, इह here, माम् me, मृताम् as if dead, नृपाय for  king Dasaratha, आवेदयिष्यसि you will inform.
explanation: O hunchback, tell the king, either Bharata shall secure the kingdom on Rama's departure to the forest or else I will die here.

shloka_text: न सुवर्णेन मे ह्यर्थो न रत्नैर्न च भूषणैः। एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते।।2.9.59।।
transliteration: na suvarṇena me hyartho na ratnairna ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ| eṣa me jīvitasyānto rāmo yadyabhiṣicyate
translation: सुवर्णेन by gold, मे to me, अर्थ: aspiration, न not, रत्नै: with gems, न not, भूषणै: च with ornaments also, न not, राम: Rama, अभिषिच्यते यदि if installed, एष: this (will be), मे my, जीवितस्य life's, अन्त: end.
explanation: I do not aspire for gold, nor gems nor ornaments. If Rama is installed, that will be the end of my life.

shloka_text: अथो पुनस्तां महिषीं महीक्षितो वचोभिरत्यर्थमहापराक्रमैः। उवाच कुब्जा भरतस्य मातरं हितं वचो राममुपेत्य चाहितम्।।2.9.60।।
transliteration: atho punastāṃ mahiṣīṃ mahīkṣito vacobhiratyarthamahāparākramaiḥ| uvāca kubjā bharatasya mātaraṃ hitaṃ vaco rāmamupetya cāhitam
translation: अथो again, कुब्जा that hunchback, अत्यर्थमहापराक्रमै: with extremely powerful  (sharp), वचोभि: with words, महीक्षित: king's, महिषीम् wife, ताम् that, भरतस्य मातरम् addressing Bharata's mother, हितम् beneficial to her, रामम् उपेत्य relating to Rama, अहितम् harmful, वच: words, पुन: again, उवाच said.
explanation: Addressing queen Kaikeyi, the mother of Bharata, with extremely powerful words, that hunchback again made these utterances beneficial to Bharata and detrimental to Rama:

shloka_text: प्रपत्स्यते राज्यमिदं हि राघवो यदि ध्रुवं त्वं ससुता च तप्स्यसे। अतो हि कल्याणि यतस्व तत्तथा यथा सुतस्ते भरतोऽभिषेक्ष्यते।।2.9.61।।
transliteration: prapatsyate rājyamidaṃ hi rāghavo yadi dhruvaṃ tvaṃ sasutā ca tapsyase| ato hi kalyāṇi yatasva tattathā yathā sutaste bharato'bhiṣekṣyate
translation: राघव: descendant of the Raghus (Rama), इदम् हि this indeed, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रपत्स्यते यदि if secures, ससुता along with son, त्वम् you, तप्स्यसे you will suffer, ध्रुवम् this is true, कल्याणि auspicious one, अत: for that reason, ते सुत: your son, भरत: Bharata, यथा in a manner in which, अभिषेक्ष्यते will be installed, तत् that act, तथा in that way, यतस्व strive for.
explanation: It is true that if Rama secures this kingdom, you along with your son are bound to suffer. O auspicious one, hence act in a way your son Bharata will be installed.

shloka_text: तथाऽतिविद्धा महिषी तु कुब्जया समाहता वागिषुभिर्मुहुर्मुहुः। निधायहस्तौ हृदयेऽतिविस्मिता शशंस कुब्जां कुपिता पुनः पुनः।।2.9.62।।
transliteration: tathā'tividdhā mahiṣī tu kubjayā samāhatā vāgiṣubhirmuhurmuhuḥ| nidhāyahastau hṛdaye'tivismitā śaśaṃsa kubjāṃ kupitā punaḥ punaḥ
translation: कुब्जया by that hunchback, मुहुर्मुहु: repeatedly, वागिषुभि: by arrowsharp words, तथा in that manner, समाहता struck down, अतिविद्धा hard hit, महिषी queen, कुपिता inflamed, अतिविस्मिता amazed, हस्तौ her hands, हृदये on the chest, निधाय laying, पुन: पुन: again and again, कुब्जाम् to that hunchback, शशंस praised.
explanation: Repeatedly struck down by that hunchback's arrowsharp words greatly grieved queen Kaikeyi was inflamed against the king. Laying her hands on the chest again and again and expressing her amazement, she praised that hunchback.

shloka_text: यमस्य वा मां विषयं गतामितो निशाम्य कुब्जे प्रतिवेदयिष्यसि। वनं गते वा सुचिराय राघवे समृद्धकामो भरतो भविष्यति।।2.9.63।।
transliteration: yamasya vā māṃ viṣayaṃ gatāmito niśāmya kubje prativedayiṣyasi| vanaṃ gate vā sucirāya rāghave samṛddhakāmo bharato bhaviṣyati
translation: कुब्जे O hunchback, निशाम्य having seen, माम् me, इत: from here, यमस्य Yama's, विषयम् region, गताम् had gone, प्रतिवेदयिष्यसि वा or else inform the king, राघवे of Rama, वनम् to the forest, गते had gone, भरत: Bharata, समृद्धकाम: having attained the objective, भविष्यति वा or would be done.
explanation: Tell the king that he will see either the fulfilment of Bharata's desire after Rama is banished into the forest for a long period or me gone to Yama's abode.

shloka_text: अहं हि नैवास्तरणानि न स्रजो न चन्दनं नाञ्जनपानभोजनम्। न किञ्चिदिच्छामि न चेह जीवितं न चेदितो गच्छति राघवो वनम्।।2.9.64।।
transliteration: ahaṃ hi naivāstaraṇāni na srajo na candanaṃ nāñjanapānabhojanam| na kiñcidicchāmi na ceha jīvitaṃ na cedito gacchati rāghavo vanam
translation: राघव: son of the Raghus (Rama), इत: from here, वनम् to forest, न गच्छति चेत् if does not go, अहम् myself, आस्तरणानि couch, न इच्छामि do not desire, स्रज: न nor garlands, चन्दनम् न nor sandalpaste, अञ्जनपानभोजनम् न nor collyrium, food, water, न किञ्चित् nothing, इह here, जीवितं च not even life, न do not desire.
explanation: If Rama does not go from here to the forest, I want neither a bed nor garlands nor sandalpaste nor unguents nor food nor water nor even life.

shloka_text: अथैतदुक्त्वा वचनं सुदारुणं निधाय सर्वाभरणानि भामिनी। असंवृतामास्तरणेन मेदिनीं तदाऽधिशिश्ये पतितेव किन्नरी।।2.9.65।।
transliteration: athaitaduktvā vacanaṃ sudāruṇaṃ nidhāya sarvābharaṇāni bhāminī| asaṃvṛtāmāstaraṇena medinīṃ tadā'dhiśiśye patiteva kinnarī
translation: भामिनी that beautiful one (Kaikeyi), सुदारुणम् dreadful, एतत् वचनम् this word, उक्त्वा having said, अथ after that, सर्वाभरणानि all ornaments, निधाय having removed, पतिता fallen, किन्नरी इव like a 'kinnar', तदा then, आस्तरणेन by a carpet, असंवृताम् uncovered, मेदिनीम् the earth, अधिशिश्ये lay down.
explanation: Saying these ruthless words, that lovely Kaikeyi cast off all her ornaments like a fallen  'kinnara' woman, and lay down on the floor with the carpet removed.

shloka_text: उदीर्णसंरम्भतमोवृतानना तथाऽवमुक्तोत्तममाल्यभूषणा। नरेन्द्रपत्नी विमना बभूव सा तमोवृता द्यौरिव मग्नतारका।।2.9.66।।
transliteration: udīrṇasaṃrambhatamovṛtānanā tathā'vamuktottamamālyabhūṣaṇā| narendrapatnī vimanā babhūva sā tamovṛtā dyauriva magnatārakā
translation: तथा thus, उदीर्णसंरम्भतमोवृतानना her face enveloped in the darkness of violent anger, अवमुक्तोत्तममाल्यभूषणा all valuable ornaments having been stripped off, विमना: mind restless, नरेन्द्रपत्नी king's wife, सा that Kaikeyi, तमोवृता filled with darkness, मग्नतारकाः bereft of stars, द्यौरिव like sky, बभूव became.
explanation: Thus queen Kaikeyi's face enveloped by the darkness of violent anger and her body stripped of all valuable ornaments, she lay restless, looking like the dark sky without stars. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends of the ninth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: विदर्शिता यदा देवी कुब्जया पापया भृशम्। तदा शेते स्म सा भूमौ दिग्धविद्धेव किन्नरी।।2.10.1।।
transliteration: vidarśitā yadā devī kubjayā pāpayā bhṛśam| tadā śete sma sā bhūmau digdhaviddheva kinnarī
translation: सा देवी that queen (Kaikeyi), भृशम् exceedingly, पापया sinful one, कुब्जया by hunchback (Manthara), यदा when, विदर्शिता perversely advised, तदा then, दिग्धविद्धेव as if struck by a poisonous arrow, किन्नरीव like a 'kinnari', भूमौ on the floor, शेते स्म lay down.
explanation: Perversely advised by the extremely sinful hunchback the queen (Kaikeyi) lay down on the ground like a kinnari struck as though by a poisonous arrow.
comments: King Dasaratha enters the palace of Kaikeyi who is in the chamber of wrath--tries to pacify her in different ways.

shloka_text: निश्चित्य मनसा कृत्यं सा सम्यगिति भामिनी। मन्थरायै शनैस्सर्वमाचचक्षे विचक्षणा।।2.10.2।।
transliteration: niścitya manasā kṛtyaṃ sā samyagiti bhāminī| mantharāyai śanaissarvamācacakṣe vicakṣaṇā
translation: विचक्षणा intelligent, सा भामिनी that beautiful lady, इति thus, सम्यक् correctly, मनसा in her mind, कृत्यम् the strategy, निश्चित्य having decided, सर्वम् everything, शनै: slowly, मन्थरायै to Manthara, आचचक्षे told.
explanation: The intelligent, beautiful lady (Kaikeyi), having correctly decided the strategy in her mind, slowly unfolded everything to Manthara.

shloka_text: सा दीना निश्चयं कृत्वा मन्थरावाक्यमोहिता। नागकन्येव निश्वस्य दीर्घमुष्णं च भामिनी।।2.10.3।। मुहूर्तं चिन्तयामास मार्गमात्मसुखावहम्।
transliteration: sā dīnā niścayaṃ kṛtvā mantharāvākyamohitā| nāgakanyeva niśvasya dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca bhāminī muhūrtaṃ cintayāmāsa mārgamātmasukhāvaham|
translation: सा भामिनी that beautiful lady (Kaikeyi), मन्थरावाक्यमोहिता impressed by Manthara's words, दीना wretch, निश्चयं कृत्वा having decided, नागकन्येव like a female serpent, दीर्घम्  deeply, उष्णं च also hot, निश्वस्य having sighed, मुहूर्तम् for a while, आत्मसुखावहम् bringing  happiness to herself, मार्गम् means, चिन्तयामास thought of.
explanation: That beautiful wretch (Kaikeyi) impressed by the words of Manthara heaved deep, hot sighs like a female serpent and  thought for a while about the means of bringing happiness to herself.

shloka_text: सा सुहृच्चार्थकामा च तं निशम्य सुनिश्चयम्।।2.10.4।। बभूव परमप्रीता सिध्दिं प्राप्येव मन्थरा।
transliteration: sā suhṛccārthakāmā ca taṃ niśamya suniścayam babhūva paramaprītā sidhdiṃ prāpyeva mantharā|
translation: सुहृच्च also a friend, अर्थकामा च desiring to fulfil the resolve, सा मन्थरा that Manthara, तम् that, सुनिश्चयम् firm determination, निशम्य having heard, सिद्धिम् acomplishment of the objective, प्राप्येव as if, परमप्रीता highly pleased, बभूव became.
explanation: Manthara, Kaikeyi's friend, too, driven by a strong desire to fulfil her resolve was highly pleased and on hearing the firm determination of Kaikeyi, felt as if the accomplishment of the objective was at hand.

shloka_text: अथ सा रुषिता देवी सम्यक्कृत्वा विनिश्चयम्।।2.10.5।। संविवेशाबला भूमौ निवेश्य भृकुटीं मुखे।
transliteration: atha sā ruṣitā devī samyakkṛtvā viniścayam saṃviveśābalā bhūmau niveśya bhṛkuṭīṃ mukhe|
translation: अथ then, देवी queen, सा अबला that woman,रुषिता soiled, सम्यक् completely, विनिश्चयम् firm decision, कृत्वा having taken, मुखे on the face, भृकुटीम् frown, निवेश्य having placed, भूमौ on the floor, संविवेश lay down.
explanation: Then Kaikeyi finally took a firm decision. With a soiled body and a frowning face she lay down on the floor.

shloka_text: ततश्चित्राणि माल्यानि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च।।2.10.6।। अपविद्धानि कैकेय्या तानि भूमिं प्रपेदिरे।
transliteration: tataścitrāṇi mālyāni divyānyābharaṇāni ca apaviddhāni kaikeyyā tāni bhūmiṃ prapedire|
translation: तत: after that, तानि those, चित्राणि of different colours, माल्यानि garlands, दिव्यानि divine (costly), आभरणानि च also the ornaments, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, अपविद्धानि thrown off, भूमिम् to the ground, प्रपेदिरे resorted.
explanation: Thereafter Kaikeyi flung away her multicoloured garlands along with her costly ornaments on to the ground.

shloka_text: तया तान्यपविद्धानि माल्यान्याभरणानि च।।2.10.7।। अशोभयन्त वसुधां नक्षत्राणि यथा नभः।
transliteration: tayā tānyapaviddhāni mālyānyābharaṇāni ca aśobhayanta vasudhāṃ nakṣatrāṇi yathā nabhaḥ|
translation: तया by her, अपविद्धानि thrown away, तानि माल्यानि all those garlands, आभरणानि च and the ornaments also, नक्षत्राणि stars, नभ: the sky, यथा like, वसुधाम् the ground, अशोभयन्त adorned.
explanation: All the garlands and ornaments she scattered adorned the floor like the stars (illumining) the sky.

shloka_text: क्रोधागारे निपतिता सा बभौ मलिनाम्बरा।।2.10.8।। एकवेणीं दृढं बद्वा गतसत्त्वेव किन्नरी।
transliteration: krodhāgāre nipatitā sā babhau malināmbarā ekaveṇīṃ dṛḍhaṃ badvā gatasattveva kinnarī|
translation: एकवेणीम् into a single braid, दृढम् tightly, बद्वा having fastened, क्रोधागारे in the chamber of wrath, निपतिता had fallen down, मलिनाम्बरा wearing soiled clothes, सा she, गतसत्त्वा in a lifeless state, किन्नरी इव like kinnari, बभौ shone.
explanation: Tightly fastening her hair into a single braid and wearing soiled clothes, she lay down in the chamber of wrath in a lifeless state like a kinnari.

shloka_text: आज्ञाप्य च महाराजो राघवस्याभिषेचनम्।।2.10.9।। उपस्थानमनुज्ञाप्य प्रविवेश निवेशनम्।
transliteration: ājñāpya ca mahārājo rāghavasyābhiṣecanam upasthānamanujñāpya praviveśa niveśanam|
translation: महाराज: तु as regards the king, राघवस्य Rama's, अभिषेचनम् installation ceremony, आज्ञाप्य having issued orders, उपस्थानम् very close associates, अनुज्ञाप्य having taken leave, निवेशनम् the palace, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: The king issued orders for Rama's installation ceremony, and taking leave of his close associates entered the palace.                        .

shloka_text: अद्य रामाभिषेको वै प्रसिद्ध इति जज्ञिवान्।।2.10.10।। प्रियार्हां प्रियमाख्यातुं विवेशान्तःपुरं वशी।
transliteration: adya rāmābhiṣeko vai prasiddha iti jajñivān priyārhāṃ priyamākhyātuṃ viveśāntaḥpuraṃ vaśī|
translation: वशी one who has subdued the senses, अद्य today, रामाभिषेक: Rama's installation, प्रसिद्ध: इति is known to everybody, जज्ञिवान् having come to know, प्रियार्हाम् to me who deserves to hear such pleasant news (to Kaikeyi), प्रियम् pleasant news, आख्यातुम् to communicate, अन्त: पुरम् the inner apartment, विवेश entered.
explanation: Aware of the fact that Rama's installation ceremony was known to everybody by then he who had subdued his senses entered the inner apartment to convey it to one worthy of such pleasant news.

shloka_text: स कैकेय्या गृहं श्रेष्ठं प्रविवेश महायशाः।।2.10.11।। पाण्डुराभ्रमिवाकाशं राहुयुक्तं निशाकरः।
transliteration: sa kaikeyyā gṛhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ pāṇḍurābhramivākāśaṃ rāhuyuktaṃ niśākaraḥ|
translation: महायशा: renowned, स: he, निशाकर: moon, पाण्डुराभ्रम् with pale clouds, राहुयुक्तम्  accompanied by Rahu, आकाशमिव like the sky, श्रेष्ठम् excellent, कैकेय्या: गृहम् Kaikeyi's abode, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: The illustrious king entered the excellent abode of Kaikeyi like the Moon entering the mouth of Rahu in a sky overcast with pale clouds.

shloka_text: शुकबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टं क्रौञ्चहंसरुतायुतम्।।2.10.12।। वादित्ररवसङ्घुष्टं कुब्जा वामनिकायुतम्। लतागृहैश्चित्रगृहैश्चम्पकाशोकशोभितैः।।2.10.13।। दान्तराजतसौवर्णवेदिकाभि स्समायुतम्। नित्यपुष्पफलैर्वृक्षैर्वापीभिश्चोपशोभितम्।।2.10.14।। दान्तरजतसौवर्णैस्संवृतं परमासनैः। विविधैरन्नपानैश्च भक्ष्यैश्च विविधैरपि।।2.10.15।। उपपन्नं महार्हैश्च भूषितैस्त्रिदिवोपमम्। तत्प्रविश्य महाराजस्स्वमन्तः पुरमृद्धिमत्।।2.10.16।। न ददर्श प्रियां राजा कैकेयीं शयनोत्तमे।
transliteration: śukabarhiṇasaṅghuṣṭaṃ krauñcahaṃsarutāyutam vāditraravasaṅghuṣṭaṃ kubjā vāmanikāyutam| latāgṛhaiścitragṛhaiścampakāśokaśobhitaiḥ dāntarājatasauvarṇavedikābhi ssamāyutam| nityapuṣpaphalairvṛkṣairvāpībhiścopaśobhitam dāntarajatasauvarṇaissaṃvṛtaṃ paramāsanaiḥ| vividhairannapānaiśca bhakṣyaiśca vividhairapi upapannaṃ mahārhaiśca bhūṣitaistridivopamam| tatpraviśya mahārājassvamantaḥ puramṛddhimat na dadarśa priyāṃ rājā kaikeyīṃ śayanottame|
translation: शुकबर्हिणसङ्घुष्टम् filled with parrots and peacocks, क्रौञ्चहंसरुतायुतम् full of cries of kraunchas and swans, वादित्ररवसङ्घुष्टम् echoing with the sounds of musical instruments, कुब्जा वामनिकायुतम् with hunchbacks and dwarfs (attendants moving here and there), चम्पकाशोकशोभितै: shining with champaka and ashoka trees, लतागृहै: by bowers surrounded with creepers, चित्रगृहै: च with picturegalleries, दान्तराजतसौवर्णवेदिकाभि: diases decorated with  ivory, gold and silver, समायुतम् filled with, नित्यपुष्पफलै: bearing flowers and fruits in all seasons, वृक्षै: (adorned) with trees, वापीभि: च with large pools, उपशोभितम् adorned, परमासनै: with excellent seats, विविधै: various kinds of, अन्नपानै: च  with food and drinks, भक्ष्यै: च eatables also, उपपन्नम् endowed with, भूषितै: decorations, महार्है: expensive, त्रिदिवोपमम् resembling heaven, पुरम़ृद्धिमत् prosperous abode, तत् that, स्वम् his own, अन्त: पुरम्  inner apartment, प्रविश्य having entered, महाराज: great king, राजा king (Dasaratha), शयनोत्तमे on  the best bed, प्रियाम् beloved, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, न ददर्श did not see.
explanation: The maharaja entered the inner apartment of Kaikeyi's prosperous abode filled with parrots and peacocks, reverberating with cries of kraunchas and swans and sounds of musical instruments attended with hunchbacks and dwarfs decorated with champak and ashoka trees, bowers surrounded with creepers, picturegalleries, altars and sofas embellished with ivory, gold and silver. It was shining with pools and trees bearing flowers and fruits in all seasons. Various kinds of food, drinks and eatables were kept ready. With excellent decorations that abode of Kaikeyi resembled heaven. (But) the king did not see his beloved Kaikeyi in her best bed.

shloka_text: कामबलसंयुक्तो रत्यर्थं मनुजाधिपः।।2.10.17।। अपश्यन्दयितां भार्यां पप्रच्छ विषसाद च।
transliteration: kāmabalasaṃyukto ratyarthaṃ manujādhipaḥ apaśyandayitāṃ bhāryāṃ papraccha viṣasāda ca|
translation: कामबलसंयुक्त: charged with passion, स: मनुजाधिप: the king, रत्यर्थम् seeking carnal pleasure, दयिताम् beloved, भार्याम् wife, अपश्यन् not seeing, विषसाद dejected, पप्रच्छ च also enquired.
explanation: Charged with passion and seeking carnal pleasure, the king became dejected when he did not see his beloved wife. He enquired about her.

shloka_text: न हि तस्य पुरा देवी तां वेलामत्यवर्तत।।2.10.18।। न च राजा गृहं शून्यं प्रविवेश कदाचन।
transliteration: na hi tasya purā devī tāṃ velāmatyavartata na ca rājā gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ praviveśa kadācana|
translation: पुरा previously, देवी queen (Kaikeyi), तस्य his, तां वेलाम् time, न अत्यवर्तत हि did not transgress, राजा king, कदाचन never, शून्यम् empty, गृहम् apartment, न प्रविवेश च did not enter.
explanation: Never before had queen Kaikeyi missed his time of arrival. Nor had the king ever entered her empty apartment.

shloka_text: ततो गृहगतो राजा कैकेयीं पर्यपृच्छत।।2.10.19।। यथा पूर्वमविज्ञाय स्वार्थलिप्सुमपण्डिताम्।
transliteration: tato gṛhagato rājā kaikeyīṃ paryapṛcchata yathā pūrvamavijñāya svārthalipsumapaṇḍitām|
translation: तत: then, गृहगत: having reached the apartment, राजा king, अपण्डिताम् foolish lady, कैकेयीम् about Kaikeyi, स्वार्थलिप्सुम् seeking selfish interest, अविज्ञाय without realising, यथापूर्वम् as usual, पर्यपृच्छत enquired.
explanation: Having entered her apartment, the king, unaware of that foolish Kaikeyi's selfish design enquired her whereabouts as usual.

shloka_text: प्रतीहारी त्वथोवाच सन्त्रस्ता सुकृताञ्जलिः।।2.10.20।। देव देवी भृशं कृद्धा क्रोधागारमभिदृता।
transliteration: pratīhārī tvathovāca santrastā sukṛtāñjaliḥ deva devī bhṛśaṃ kṛddhā krodhāgāramabhidṛtā|
translation: अथ thereafter, सन्त्रस्ता frightened, प्रतीहरी doorkeeper, कृताञ्जलि: with folded palms, उवाच said, देव O monarch देवी queen, भृशम् कृद्वा mighty angry, क्रोधागारम् towards the chamber of wrath, अभिदृता swiftly went.
explanation: Thereafter, the frightened doorkeeper with folded palms said O monarch the queen in a hot mood has rushed into the chamber of wrath.

shloka_text: प्रतीहार्या वचश्शृत्वा राजा परमदुर्मनाः।।2.10.21।। विषसाद पुनर्भूयो लुलितव्याकुलेन्द्रियः।।
transliteration: pratīhāryā vacaśśṛtvā rājā paramadurmanāḥ viṣasāda punarbhūyo lulitavyākulendriyaḥ||
translation: परमदुर्मना: deeply melancholic, राजा king, प्रतीहार्या door keeper's, वच: words, शृत्वा having heard, लुलितव्याकुलेन्द्रिय: with his senses agitated and unstable, पुन: again, भूय: still more, विषसाद grieved.
explanation: Hearing the words of the doorkeeper, the melancholic king grieved all the more with his senses agitated and unstable.

shloka_text: तत्र तां पतितां भूमौ शयानामतथोचिताम्।।2.10.22।। प्रतप्त इव दुःखेन सोऽपश्यज्जगतीपतिः।
transliteration: tatra tāṃ patitāṃ bhūmau śayānāmatathocitām pratapta iva duḥkhena so'paśyajjagatīpatiḥ|
translation: जगतीपति: lord of the earth, स: he, तत्र there (in that chamber of wrath), पतिताम् fallen down, भूमौ on the floor, शयानाम् lying down, अतथोचिताम् unbecoming manner, ताम् her, अपश्यत् saw,  दु:खेन with grief, प्रतप्त: इव as if consumed.
explanation: The lord of the earth (Dasaratha) saw her (Kaikeyi) lying down on the floor of the chamber of wrath in an unbecoming manner and felt as if consumed by grief.

shloka_text: स वृद्धस्तरुणीं भार्यां प्राणेभ्योपि गरीयसीम्।।2.10.23।। अपापः पापसङ्कल्पां ददर्श धरणीतले। लतामिव विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां देवतामिव।।2.10.24।। किन्नरीमिव निर्धूतां च्युतामप्सरसं यथा। मायामिव परिभ्रष्टां हरिणीमिव संयताम्।।2.10.25।।
transliteration: sa vṛddhastaruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ prāṇebhyopi garīyasīm apāpaḥ pāpasaṅkalpāṃ dadarśa dharaṇītale| latāmiva viniṣkṛttāṃ patitāṃ devatāmiva kinnarīmiva nirdhūtāṃ cyutāmapsarasaṃ yathā| māyāmiva paribhraṣṭāṃ hariṇīmiva saṃyatām
translation: वृद्ध: aged, अपाप: guileless, स: he, तरुणीम् youthful lady, प्राणेभ्योऽपि more than his life, गरीयसीम् dearer, पापसङ्कल्पाम् a lady of sinful intentions, विनिष्कृत्ताम् severed, लतामिव like a creeper, पतिताम् fallen down, देवतामिव like a goddess, निर्धूताम् thrown down on earth, किन्नरीमिव like a 'kinnari', च्युताम् slipped (from heaven), अप्सरसं यथा like apsarasas, परिभ्रष्टाम् fallen down, मायामिव like illusion, संयताम् tied down, हरिणीमिव like a female deer, भार्याम् to wife, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful  intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.

shloka_text: स वृद्धस्तरुणीं भार्यां प्राणेभ्योपि गरीयसीम्।।2.10.23।। अपापः पापसङ्कल्पां ददर्श धरणीतले। लतामिव विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां देवतामिव।।2.10.24।। किन्नरीमिव निर्धूतां च्युतामप्सरसं यथा। मायामिव परिभ्रष्टां हरिणीमिव संयताम्।।2.10.25।।
transliteration: sa vṛddhastaruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ prāṇebhyopi garīyasīm apāpaḥ pāpasaṅkalpāṃ dadarśa dharaṇītale| latāmiva viniṣkṛttāṃ patitāṃ devatāmiva kinnarīmiva nirdhūtāṃ cyutāmapsarasaṃ yathā| māyāmiva paribhraṣṭāṃ hariṇīmiva saṃyatām
translation: वृद्ध: aged, अपाप: guileless, स: he, तरुणीम् youthful lady, प्राणेभ्योऽपि more than his life, गरीयसीम् dearer, पापसङ्कल्पाम् a lady of sinful intentions, विनिष्कृत्ताम् severed, लतामिव like a creeper, पतिताम् fallen down, देवतामिव like a goddess, निर्धूताम् thrown down on earth, किन्नरीमिव like a 'kinnari', च्युताम् slipped (from heaven), अप्सरसं यथा like apsarasas, परिभ्रष्टाम् fallen down, मायामिव like illusion, संयताम् tied down, हरिणीमिव like a female deer, भार्याम् to wife, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful  intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.

shloka_text: स वृद्धस्तरुणीं भार्यां प्राणेभ्योपि गरीयसीम्।।2.10.23।। अपापः पापसङ्कल्पां ददर्श धरणीतले। लतामिव विनिष्कृत्तां पतितां देवतामिव।।2.10.24।। किन्नरीमिव निर्धूतां च्युतामप्सरसं यथा। मायामिव परिभ्रष्टां हरिणीमिव संयताम्।।2.10.25।।
transliteration: sa vṛddhastaruṇīṃ bhāryāṃ prāṇebhyopi garīyasīm apāpaḥ pāpasaṅkalpāṃ dadarśa dharaṇītale| latāmiva viniṣkṛttāṃ patitāṃ devatāmiva kinnarīmiva nirdhūtāṃ cyutāmapsarasaṃ yathā| māyāmiva paribhraṣṭāṃ hariṇīmiva saṃyatām
translation: वृद्ध: aged, अपाप: guileless, स: he, तरुणीम् youthful lady, प्राणेभ्योऽपि more than his life, गरीयसीम् dearer, पापसङ्कल्पाम् a lady of sinful intentions, विनिष्कृत्ताम् severed, लतामिव like a creeper, पतिताम् fallen down, देवतामिव like a goddess, निर्धूताम् thrown down on earth, किन्नरीमिव like a 'kinnari', च्युताम् slipped (from heaven), अप्सरसं यथा like apsarasas, परिभ्रष्टाम् fallen down, मायामिव like illusion, संयताम् tied down, हरिणीमिव like a female deer, भार्याम् to wife, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The guileless, old king beheld his youthful wife who was dearer to him than his own life, filled with deceitful  intentions. She looked like a severed creeper, like a goddess fallen down, like a 'Kinnari' thrown down on earth, like an 'apsarasa' slipped from heaven, like an illusion torn, like a female deer tied down.

shloka_text: करेणुमिव दिग्धेन विद्धां मृगयुना वने। महागज इवारण्ये स्नेहात्परिममर्श ताम्।।2.10.26।।
transliteration: kareṇumiva digdhena viddhāṃ mṛgayunā vane| mahāgaja ivāraṇye snehātparimamarśa tām
translation: वने in the forest, दिग्धेन by a poisoned arrow, विद्धाम् struck down, करेणुमिव like a sheelephant, ताम् her, अरण्ये in the forest, महागज: इव like a mighty elephant, स्नेहात् lovingly, परिममर्श caressed.
explanation: Like a mighty sheelephant caressing her cow wounded with a poisoned arrow in the forest, he caressed her lovingly.

shloka_text: परिमृश्य च पाणिभ्यामभिसन्त्रस्तचेतनः। कामी कमलपत्राक्षीमुवाच वनितामिदम्।।2.10.27।।
transliteration: parimṛśya ca pāṇibhyāmabhisantrastacetanaḥ| kāmī kamalapatrākṣīmuvāca vanitāmidam
translation: कामी passionate, अभिसन्त्रस्तचेतन: mind extremely terrified, कमलपत्राक्षीम् to one with eyes resembling lotuspetals, वनिताम् that woman, पाणिभ्याम् with both hands, परिमृश्य after caressing, इदम् this word, उवाच said.
explanation: With a mind extremely terrified yet passionate, he caressed his lotuseyed wife with his hands, and said:

shloka_text: न तेऽहमभिजानामि क्रोधमात्मनि संश्रितम्। देवि केनाभिशप्ताऽसि केन वाऽसि विमानिता।।2.10.28।। यदिदं मम दुःखाय शेषे कल्याणि पांसुषु।
transliteration: na te'hamabhijānāmi krodhamātmani saṃśritam| devi kenābhiśaptā'si kena vā'si vimānitā yadidaṃ mama duḥkhāya śeṣe kalyāṇi pāṃsuṣu|
translation: देवि O queen आत्मनि in me, संश्रितम् taken refuge in (you), ते your, क्रोधम् about anger, अहम् I, न अभिजानामि am not able to know, केन by whom, अभिशप्ता असि are you cursed, केन वा or by whom, विमानिता असि are you disrespected, कल्याणि O auspicious one, पांसुषु in the dust, यत् शेषे since you lie, इदम् this, मम my, दु:खाय is the source of my sorrow.
explanation: O auspicious queen, I do not know whether your anger is directed at me. I do not know the cause of your anger. By whom have you been offended or disrespected? Why are you lying in the dust? This is causing me great sorrow.

shloka_text: भूमौ शेषे किमर्थं त्वं मयि कल्याणचेतसि।।2.10.29।। भूतोपहतचित्तेव मम चित्तप्रमाथिनी।
transliteration: bhūmau śeṣe kimarthaṃ tvaṃ mayi kalyāṇacetasi bhūtopahatacitteva mama cittapramāthinī|
translation: मयि in me, कल्याणचेतसि in a mind favourably disposed, त्वम् you, भूतोपहतचित्तेव like one possessed by evil spirits, मम my, चित्तप्रमाथिनी afflicting my mind, किमर्थम् why, भूमौ on the floor, शेषे are you lying down?
explanation: While I am here favourably disposed towards you, why are you lying down on the floor like one possessed by an evil spirit? Why are you afflicting my mind?

shloka_text: सन्ति मे कुशला वैद्यास्त्वभितुष्टाश्च सर्वशः।।2.10.30।। सुखितां त्वां करिष्यन्ति व्याधिमाचक्ष्व भामिनी।
transliteration: santi me kuśalā vaidyāstvabhituṣṭāśca sarvaśaḥ sukhitāṃ tvāṃ kariṣyanti vyādhimācakṣva bhāminī|
translation: भामिनि O lovely one कुशला: experts, सर्वश: in every way, अभितुष्टा: च completely satisfied too, मे my, वैद्या: सन्ति physicians are available, त्वाम् you, सुखिताम् करिष्यन्ति will restore your health, व्याधिम् ailment, आचक्ष्व you may tell.
explanation: O lovely one there are, to my best satisfaction, expert physicians in all branches (of medical science). They will restore your health. Tell me your ailment.

shloka_text: कस्य वा ते प्रियं कार्यं केन वा विप्रियं कृतम्।।2.10.31।। कः प्रियं लभतामद्य को वा सुमहदप्रियम्।
transliteration: kasya vā te priyaṃ kāryaṃ kena vā vipriyaṃ kṛtam kaḥ priyaṃ labhatāmadya ko vā sumahadapriyam|
translation: कस्य वा to whom, प्रियम् favour, ते by you, कार्यम् is to be done, केन वा by whom, विप्रियम् displeasure, कृतम् was done, क: who, अद्य now, प्रियम् favour, लभताम् let him obtain, को वा who, सुमहत् exceedingly great, अप्रियम् displeasure (shall obtain).
explanation: On whom do you wish to bestow favour? Who has caused you displeasure? To whom should I grant favour now? To whom should I cause great displeasure?

shloka_text: मा रोदीर्मा च कार्षीस्त्वं देवि संपरिशोषणम्।।2.10.32।। अवध्यो वध्यतां को वा को वा वध्यो विमुच्यताम्। दरिद्रः को भवत्वाढ्यो द्रव्यवान्वाऽप्यकिञ्चनः।।2.10.33।।
transliteration: mā rodīrmā ca kārṣīstvaṃ devi saṃpariśoṣaṇam avadhyo vadhyatāṃ ko vā ko vā vadhyo vimucyatām| daridraḥ ko bhavatvāḍhyo dravyavānvā'pyakiñcanaḥ
translation: देवि O queen मा रोदी: do not weep, त्वम् you, संपरिशोषणम् emaciation of body, मा च कार्षी: do not cause, अवध्य: who should not be slain, को वा or who, वध्यताम् shall be slain, वध्य: worthy of being slain, को वा or who, विमुच्यताम् shall be released, दरिद्र: is poor, को वा or who, आढ्य: should be made rich, भवतु shall become, द्रव्यवान्वापि whosoever is wealthy, अकिञ्चन: shall be rendered poor.
explanation: O queen shed no tears. Drain not your health. Ask me, and I shall slay one who should not be slain or release one who should be slain. I shall make a poor man rich and a wealthy man poor. (Tell me who are such people).

shloka_text: मा रोदीर्मा च कार्षीस्त्वं देवि संपरिशोषणम्।।2.10.32।। अवध्यो वध्यतां को वा को वा वध्यो विमुच्यताम्। दरिद्रः को भवत्वाढ्यो द्रव्यवान्वाऽप्यकिञ्चनः।।2.10.33।।
transliteration: mā rodīrmā ca kārṣīstvaṃ devi saṃpariśoṣaṇam avadhyo vadhyatāṃ ko vā ko vā vadhyo vimucyatām| daridraḥ ko bhavatvāḍhyo dravyavānvā'pyakiñcanaḥ
translation: देवि O queen मा रोदी: do not weep, त्वम् you, संपरिशोषणम् emaciation of body, मा च कार्षी: do not cause, अवध्य: who should not be slain, को वा or who, वध्यताम् shall be slain, वध्य: worthy of being slain, को वा or who, विमुच्यताम् shall be released, दरिद्र: is poor, को वा or who, आढ्य: should be made rich, भवतु shall become, द्रव्यवान्वापि whosoever is wealthy, अकिञ्चन: shall be rendered poor.
explanation: O queen shed no tears. Drain not your health. Ask me, and I shall slay one who should not be slain or release one who should be slain. I shall make a poor man rich and a wealthy man poor. (Tell me who are such people).

shloka_text: अहं चैव मदीयाश्च सर्वे तव वशानुगाः। न ते किञ्चिदभिप्रायं व्याहन्तुमहमुत्सहे।।2.10.34।।
transliteration: ahaṃ caiva madīyāśca sarve tava vaśānugāḥ| na te kiñcidabhiprāyaṃ vyāhantumahamutsahe
translation: अहं चैव I am also, मदीया: my relatives, सर्वे च all people, तव your, वशानुगा: under control, ते your, अभिप्रायम् opinion, किञ्चित् a little, व्याहन्तुम् to spoil, अहम् I, न उत्सहे will not make efforts.
explanation: My kins and I are under your control. I will make no effort to go even a little  against your wishes.

shloka_text: आत्मनो जीवितेनापि ब्रूहि यन्मनसेच्छसि। बलमात्मनि जानन्ती न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि।।2.10.35।। करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे।
transliteration: ātmano jīvitenāpi brūhi yanmanasecchasi| balamātmani jānantī na māṃ śaṅkitumarhasi kariṣyāmi tava prītiṃ sukṛtenāpi te śape|
translation: अत्मन: my own, जीवितेनापि with life even, यत् whatever, मनसा with mind, इच्छसि wish, ब्रूहि tell, आत्मनि in your own self, बलम् strength, जानन्ती you know yourself, माम् me, शङ्कितुम् to doubt, न अर्हसि it does not behove you, सुकृतेनापि on my acquired merits, ते to you, शपे I swear, तव your, प्रीतिम् pleasure, करिष्यामि I will do.
explanation: If you want to do anything even if it means sacrificing my life, I shall do it. Since you know my strength, it does not behove you to doubt me. I swear on my  merits. I will do whatever pleases you.

shloka_text: यावदावर्तते चक्रं तावती मे वसुन्धरा।।2.10.36।। प्राचीनास्सिन्धुसौवीरा स्सौराष्ट्रा दक्षिणापथाः। वङ्गाङ्गमगधाः मत्स्याः समृद्धा काशिकोसलाः।।2.10.37।।
transliteration: yāvadāvartate cakraṃ tāvatī me vasundharā prācīnāssindhusauvīrā ssaurāṣṭrā dakṣiṇāpathāḥ| vaṅgāṅgamagadhāḥ matsyāḥ samṛddhā kāśikosalāḥ
translation: चक्रम् wheel of the chariot, यावत् till (such places), आवर्तते rotates, मे वसुन्धरा my land, तावती (is extended) up to that, प्राचीना: eastern regions, सिन्धुसौवीरा: SindhuSauvira areas, सौराष्ट्रा: Saurashtra, दक्षिणापथा: southern regions, वङ्गाङ्गमगधा: Banga, Anga, Magadha states, मत्स्या: Mathsya kingdom, काशिकोसला: Kasi and Kosala, समृद्धा: prosperous places.
explanation: My authority on the land is extended till such places the wheel of any chariot rotates such as the regions in the east, SindhuSauvira areas, Saurashtra, Southern regions, Banga, Anga, Magadha states, Matsya kingdom and KasiKosala countries which are prosperous places.

shloka_text: यावदावर्तते चक्रं तावती मे वसुन्धरा।।2.10.36।। प्राचीनास्सिन्धुसौवीरा स्सौराष्ट्रा दक्षिणापथाः। वङ्गाङ्गमगधाः मत्स्याः समृद्धा काशिकोसलाः।।2.10.37।।
transliteration: yāvadāvartate cakraṃ tāvatī me vasundharā prācīnāssindhusauvīrā ssaurāṣṭrā dakṣiṇāpathāḥ| vaṅgāṅgamagadhāḥ matsyāḥ samṛddhā kāśikosalāḥ
translation: चक्रम् wheel of the chariot, यावत् till (such places), आवर्तते rotates, मे वसुन्धरा my land, तावती (is extended) up to that, प्राचीना: eastern regions, सिन्धुसौवीरा: SindhuSauvira areas, सौराष्ट्रा: Saurashtra, दक्षिणापथा: southern regions, वङ्गाङ्गमगधा: Banga, Anga, Magadha states, मत्स्या: Mathsya kingdom, काशिकोसला: Kasi and Kosala, समृद्धा: prosperous places.
explanation: My authority on the land is extended till such places the wheel of any chariot rotates such as the regions in the east, SindhuSauvira areas, Saurashtra, Southern regions, Banga, Anga, Magadha states, Matsya kingdom and KasiKosala countries which are prosperous places.

shloka_text: तत्र जातं बहु द्रव्यं धनधान्यमजाविकम्। ततो वृणीष्व कैकेयि यद्यत्त्वं मनसेच्छसि।।2.10.38।।
transliteration: tatra jātaṃ bahu dravyaṃ dhanadhānyamajāvikam| tato vṛṇīṣva kaikeyi yadyattvaṃ manasecchasi
translation: तत्र there, धनधान्यम् wealth and food grains, अजाविकम् sheep and goats, बहु many, द्रव्यम् things, जातम् is produced, कैकेयि Kaikeyi, तत: from those, यद्यत् whichever, त्वम् you, मनसा  in mind, इच्छसि wish, वणीष्व ask.
explanation: There wealth and foodgrains, sheep and goats and many things are produced. O Kaikeyi, ask whichever of these you wish.

shloka_text: किमायासेन ते भीरु उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ शोभने। तत्त्वं मे ब्रूहि कैकेयि यतस्ते भयमागतम्।।2.10.39।। तत्ते व्यपनयिष्यामि नीहारमिव रश्मिवान्।
transliteration: kimāyāsena te bhīru uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha śobhane| tattvaṃ me brūhi kaikeyi yataste bhayamāgatam tatte vyapanayiṣyāmi nīhāramiva raśmivān|
translation: भीरु O lady, ते to you, आयासेन with exertion, किम् what is the use? शोभने O charming one, उत्तिष्ठ उत्तिष्ठ arise, arise, कैकेयि O Kaikeyi ते to you, यत: from whom, भयम् fear, आगतम् has come, तत् that, त्वम् you, मे me, ब्रूहि tell, ते your, तत् the cause for that fear, रश्मिवान् Sun, नीहारमिव like morning mist, व्यपनयिष्यामि I will dispel.
explanation: O lady why do you exert yourself? Arise, arise. O charming Kaikeyi, tell me the cause of your fear. I will dispel it just as the Sun dispels morning mists.

shloka_text: तथोक्ता सा समाश्वस्ता वक्तुकामा तदप्रियम्।।2.10.40।। परिपीडयितुं भूयो भर्तारमुपचक्रमे।
transliteration: tathoktā sā samāśvastā vaktukāmā tadapriyam paripīḍayituṃ bhūyo bhartāramupacakrame|
translation: तथा thus, उक्ता spoken to, सा she, समाश्वस्ता breathing a sigh of relief, तत् that, अप्रियम् unpleasant thing, वक्तुकामा intending to tell, भर्तारम् to her husband, भूयः still more,     परिपीडयितुम् for tormenting, उपचक्रमे started.
explanation: Thus spoken to, she (Kaikeyi) breathed a sigh of relief. Intending to tell him the unpleasant thing (which was in her mind), she began tormenting her husband all the more. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends  the tenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तं मन्मथशरैर्विद्धमं कामवेगवशानुगम्। उवाच पृथिवीपालं कैकेयी दारुणं वचः।।2.11.1।।
transliteration: taṃ manmathaśarairviddhamaṃ kāmavegavaśānugam| uvāca pṛthivīpālaṃ kaikeyī dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ
translation: कैकेयी Kaikeyi, मन्मथशरैः with the darts of Kamadeva, विद्धम् struck, कामवेगवशानुगम् overtaken by passion, तं पृथिवीपालम् to the ruler of earth (Dasaratha), दारुणम् dreadful, वचः words, उवाच said.
explanation: To the ruler of the earth (the king), struck by the darts of Kamadeva and overtaken by passion Kaikeyi spoke (these) dreadful words.
comments: Kaikeyi reminds king Dasaratha about the boons--seeks consecration of Bharata as princeregent and exile of Rama to the forest.

shloka_text: नास्मि विप्रकृतादेव केनचिन्नावमानिता। अभिप्रायस्तु मे कश्चित्तमिच्छामि त्वया कृतम्।।2.11.2।।
transliteration: nāsmi viprakṛtādeva kenacinnāvamānitā| abhiprāyastu me kaścittamicchāmi tvayā kṛtam
translation: देव O king, केनचित् by any one, विप्रकृता offended, नास्मि I am not, न अवमानिता nor disregarded, तु but, मे my, कश्चित् certain, अभिप्रायः purpose, तम् that one, त्वया by you, कृतं इच्छामि you should fulfil.
explanation: O king I have neither been offended nor disregarded by any one, but I have a purpose which you should fulfil.

shloka_text: प्रतिज्ञां प्रतिजानीष्व यदि त्वं कर्तुमिच्छसि। अथ तद्व्याहरिष्यामि यदभिप्रार्थितं मया।।2.11.3।।
transliteration: pratijñāṃ pratijānīṣva yadi tvaṃ kartumicchasi| atha tadvyāhariṣyāmi yadabhiprārthitaṃ mayā
translation: त्वम् you, कर्तुम् to accomplish, इच्छसि यदि if you are inclined, प्रतिज्ञां प्रतिजानीष्व promise to fulfil, अथ thereafter, मया by me, यत् whatever, अभिप्रार्थितम् sought for, तत् that one, व्याहरिष्यामि I will tell you.
explanation: If you are inclined to accomplish my desire, then promise me that you will fulfil them. Thereafter I shall reveal it to you.

shloka_text: तामुवाच महातेजाः कैकेयीमीषदुत्स्मितः। कामी हस्तेन संगृह्य मूर्धजेषु शुचिस्मिताम्।।2.11.4।।
transliteration: tāmuvāca mahātejāḥ kaikeyīmīṣadutsmitaḥ| kāmī hastena saṃgṛhya mūrdhajeṣu śucismitām
translation: महातेजाः mighty, कामी steeped in passion, ईषत् a little, उत्स्मितः with a visible smile, शुचिस्मिताम् with a pure (bright) smile, तां कैकेयीम् to that Kaikeyi, मूर्धजेषु  her hair, हस्तेन with hand, संगृह्य holding (gently), उवाच said.
explanation: The mighty king steeped in passion gently held Kaikeyi's hair in his hands  and with a clear, bright smile said:

shloka_text: आवलिप्ते न जानासि त्वत्तः प्रियतरो मम। मनुजो मनुजव्याघ्राद्रामादन्यो न विद्यते।।2.11.5।।
transliteration: āvalipte na jānāsi tvattaḥ priyataro mama| manujo manujavyāghrādrāmādanyo na vidyate
translation: आवलिप्ते  woman swollen with pride, न जानासि do you not know?, मम to me, त्वत्तः more than you, प्रियतरः dearer, मनुजव्याघ्रात् other than the tiger (best) among men, रामात् than Rama, अन्यः other, मनुजः man, न विद्यते does not exist.
explanation: O proud lady, don't you know there exists for me no woman dearer than you and      no man other than Rama who is the best among men.

shloka_text: तेनाजय्येन मुख्येन राघवेण महात्मना। शपे ते जीवनार्हेण ब्रूहि यन्मनसेच्छासि।।2.11.6।।
transliteration: tenājayyena mukhyena rāghaveṇa mahātmanā| śape te jīvanārheṇa brūhi yanmanasecchāsi
translation: अजय्येन invincible one, मुख्येन chief (among men), जीवनार्हेण by one worthy to live, महात्मना broadminded, तेन राघवेण by that scion among the Raghus (Rama), शपे swear, मनसा in mind, यत् which, इच्छसि (you) wish, ब्रूहि tell.
explanation: I swear in the name of the scion of the Raghu dynasty, the invincible, broadminded Rama, the best among men worthy of long life. Tell me what you have in mind.

shloka_text: यं मुहूर्तमपश्यंस्तु न जीवेयमहं ध्रुवम्। तेन रामेण कैकेयि शपे ते वचनक्रियाम्।।2.11.7।।
transliteration: yaṃ muhūrtamapaśyaṃstu na jīveyamahaṃ dhruvam| tena rāmeṇa kaikeyi śape te vacanakriyām
translation: कैकेयि Kaikeyi, यम् whom, अपश्यन् without seeing, अहम् I, मुहूर्तम् even for a moment, ध्रुवम्  this is certain, न जीवेयम् cannot live, तेन रामेण by such Rama, ते your, वचनक्रियाम् in accordance with your wish, शपे I swear.
explanation: O Kaikeyi, in the name of Rama without seeing whom I, for sure, cannot live a momment, I swear I will fulfil your desire.

shloka_text: आत्मना वात्मजैश्चान्यैर्वृणेयं मनुजर्षभम्। तेन रामेण कैकेयि शपे ते वचनक्रियाम्।।2.11.8।।
transliteration: ātmanā vātmajaiścānyairvṛṇeyaṃ manujarṣabham| tena rāmeṇa kaikeyi śape te vacanakriyām
translation: कैकेयि Kaikeyi, आत्मना वा by myself, अन्यैः by others, आत्मजैश्च my sons, यम् whom,  मनुजर्षभम् best among men, वृणे I choose, तेन रामेण by that Rama, ते your, वचनक्रियाम्  to fulfil your wish, शपे swear.
explanation: O Kaikeyi I wish the best among men Rama well.Even at the expense of my life or the lives of the rest of my sons I swear in his name I shall fulfil your wish.

shloka_text: भद्रे हृदयमप्येतदनुमृशोद्धरस्व मे। एतत्समीक्ष्य कैकेयि ब्रूहि यत्साधु मन्यसे।।2.11.9।।
transliteration: bhadre hṛdayamapyetadanumṛśoddharasva me| etatsamīkṣya kaikeyi brūhi yatsādhu manyase
translation: भद्रे O gentle lady मे my, एतत् this, हृदयम् heart, अनुमृश्य having touched, उद्धरस्व save, कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, एतत् this, समीक्ष्य after considering, यत् which, साधु as good, मन्यसे you may consider, ब्रूहि you may tell.
explanation: O gentle lady my heart is sinking. Touch my heart and deliver me from distress. O Kaikeyi considering all this, tell me what you think is good.

shloka_text: बलमात्मनि जानन्ती न मां शङ्कितुमर्हसि। करिष्यामि तव प्रीतिं सुकृतेनापि ते शपे।।2.11.10।।
transliteration: balamātmani jānantī na māṃ śaṅkitumarhasi| kariṣyāmi tava prītiṃ sukṛtenāpi te śape
translation: आत्मनि  in yourself, बलम् power, जानन्ती you know fully, माम् me, शङ्कितुम् to doubt, न अर्हसि it does not behove you, सुकृतेनापि on my merits, ते to you, शपे I swear, तव your, प्रीतिम् pleasure, करिष्ये I shall do.
explanation: You know fully the authority you wield over me. Therefore, it does not behove you to doubt me. I swear on my acquired merits that I shall do whatever pleases you.

shloka_text: सा तदर्थमना देवी तमभिप्रायमागतम्। निर्माध्यस्थ्याच्च हर्षाच्च बभाषे दुर्वचं वचः।।2.11.11।।
transliteration: sā tadarthamanā devī tamabhiprāyamāgatam| nirmādhyasthyācca harṣācca babhāṣe durvacaṃ vacaḥ
translation: तदर्थमनाः  bent upon her interests, देवी queeni, आगतम् her mind has set upon, तम् अभिप्रायम् her wish, निर्माध्यस्थ्यात् with no alternate path, हर्षात् च rejoiced, दुर्वचम् unutterable, वचः words, बभाषे uttered.
explanation: Bent upon her interests, the queen cheered and expressed in unutterable words her premeditated  wish which had no alternative.

shloka_text: तेन वाक्येन संहृष्टा तमभिप्रायमागतम्। व्याजहार महाघोरमभ्यागतमिवान्तकम्।।2.11.12।।
transliteration: tena vākyena saṃhṛṣṭā tamabhiprāyamāgatam| vyājahāra mahāghoramabhyāgatamivāntakam
translation: तेन वाक्येन by those  words, संहृष्टा delighted, अभ्यागतम् suddenly struck, अन्तकमिव like death, महाघोरम् highly dreadful, आगतम् that has come to her mind, तम् अभिप्रायम् her wish, व्याजहार spoke.
explanation: Delighted by the words (of the king), Kaikeyi disclosed him her highly dreadful wish which entered her mind like a sudden visitation of death:

shloka_text: यथा क्रमे शपसि वरं मम ददासि च। तच्छृण्वन्तु त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवास्साग्निपुरोगमाः।।2.11.13।।
transliteration: yathā krame śapasi varaṃ mama dadāsi ca| tacchṛṇvantu trayastriṃśaddevāssāgnipurogamāḥ
translation: साग्निपुरोगमाः with firegod in the forefront, त्रयस्त्रिंशद्देवाः thirtythree (crore) gods, क्रमेण successively, यथा like, शपसि your are swearing, मम my, वरम् boon, ददासि च are giving, तत् that, शृण्वन्तु listen.
explanation: You are repeatedly swearing to grant me boons. Let the thirtythree crore gods headed by  the firegod, listen.

shloka_text: चन्द्रादित्यौ नभश्चैव ग्रहा रात्र्यहनी दिशः। जगच्च पृथिवी चेयं सगन्धर्वा सराक्षसा।।2.11.14।। निशाचराणि भूतानि गृहेषु गृहदेवता। यानि चान्यानि भूतानि जानीयुर्भाषितं तव।।2.11.15।।
transliteration: candrādityau nabhaścaiva grahā rātryahanī diśaḥ| jagacca pṛthivī ceyaṃ sagandharvā sarākṣasā niśācarāṇi bhūtāni gṛheṣu gṛhadevatā| yāni cānyāni bhūtāni jānīyurbhāṣitaṃ tava
translation: चन्द्रादित्यौ Moon and Sun, नभः च एव and the sky also, ग्रहाः the planets, रात्र्यहनी night and day, दिशः the (ten) quarters, जगच्च the world, सगन्धर्वा with all gandharvas, सराक्षसा with all rakshasas, इयम् this, पृथिवी earth, निशाचराणि nightrangers, भूतानि all beings, गृहेषु in the houses, गृहदेवताः family deities, अन्यानि all other, यानि whosoever, भूतानि beings, तव your, भाषितम्  words of promise, जानीयुः let them know.
explanation: Let the Moon and the Sun, the sky, the planets, night and day, the (ten) quarters the world, gandharvas, rakshasas, this earth, the nocturnal spirits all beings, family deities of every house and all other beings listen to your words of promise.

shloka_text: चन्द्रादित्यौ नभश्चैव ग्रहा रात्र्यहनी दिशः। जगच्च पृथिवी चेयं सगन्धर्वा सराक्षसा।।2.11.14।। निशाचराणि भूतानि गृहेषु गृहदेवता। यानि चान्यानि भूतानि जानीयुर्भाषितं तव।।2.11.15।।
transliteration: candrādityau nabhaścaiva grahā rātryahanī diśaḥ| jagacca pṛthivī ceyaṃ sagandharvā sarākṣasā niśācarāṇi bhūtāni gṛheṣu gṛhadevatā| yāni cānyāni bhūtāni jānīyurbhāṣitaṃ tava
translation: चन्द्रादित्यौ Moon and Sun, नभः च एव and the sky also, ग्रहाः the planets, रात्र्यहनी night and day, दिशः the (ten) quarters, जगच्च the world, सगन्धर्वा with all gandharvas, सराक्षसा with all rakshasas, इयम् this, पृथिवी earth, निशाचराणि nightrangers, भूतानि all beings, गृहेषु in the houses, गृहदेवताः family deities, अन्यानि all other, यानि whosoever, भूतानि beings, तव your, भाषितम्  words of promise, जानीयुः let them know.
explanation: Let the Moon and the Sun, the sky, the planets, night and day, the (ten) quarters the world, gandharvas, rakshasas, this earth, the nocturnal spirits all beings, family deities of every house and all other beings listen to your words of promise.

shloka_text: सत्यसन्धो महातेजाः धर्मज्ञः सुसमाहितः। वरं मम ददात्येष तन्मे श्रृण्वन्तु दैवताः।।2.11.16।।
transliteration: satyasandho mahātejāḥ dharmajñaḥ susamāhitaḥ| varaṃ mama dadātyeṣa tanme śrṛṇvantu daivatāḥ
translation: सत्यसन्ध: true to his vows, महातेजाः heroic, धर्मज्ञः knows the ways of righteousness, सुसमाहितः wellcomposed, एषः this (Dasaratha), मम my, वरम् boon, ददाति is giving, दैवताः gods, तत् that one, मे for my sake, शृण्वन्तु hear.
explanation: King Dasaratha who is true to his vows, heroic and knows the ways of righteousness is granting me boons with a wellcomposed mind. Let all the gods  stand witness to this (declared Kaikeyi).

shloka_text: इति देवी महेष्वासं परिगृह्याभिशस्य च। ततः परमुवाचेदं वरदं काममोहितम्।।2.11.17।।
transliteration: iti devī maheṣvāsaṃ parigṛhyābhiśasya ca| tataḥ paramuvācedaṃ varadaṃ kāmamohitam
translation: देवी queen, महेष्वासम् great archer, परिगृह्य having seized, अभिशस्य च having flattered, ततः परम् च afterwards, वरदम् conferer of boons, काममोहितम् infatuated, इदम् this word, उवाच said.
explanation: Clasping the great archer, the infatuated king, conferer of boons and flattering him (to the top of her bent), the queen said:

shloka_text: स्मर राजन् पुरावृत्तं तस्मिन् दैवासुरे रणे। तत्र चाच्यावयच्छत्रुस्तव जीवितमन्तरा।।2.11.18।।
transliteration: smara rājan purāvṛttaṃ tasmin daivāsure raṇe| tatra cācyāvayacchatrustava jīvitamantarā
translation: राजन् O king, पुरा long ago, तस्मिन् that, दैवासुरे between gods and asuras, रणे in the  war, वृत्तम् event, स्मर recollect, तत्र there, शत्रु: च enemy too, तव your, जीवितम् अन्तरा except your life, अच्यावयत् pulled down.
explanation: O king, recall the event that happened long ago in the war between gods and asuras where the enemy destroyed all your forces except your life.

shloka_text: तत्र चापि मया देव यत्त्वं समभिरक्षितः। जाग्रत्या यतमानायास्ततो मे प्राददा वरौ।।2.11.19।।
transliteration: tatra cāpi mayā deva yattvaṃ samabhirakṣitaḥ| jāgratyā yatamānāyāstato me prādadā varau
translation: देव O king तत्र च there too, यत् since, त्वम् you, मया by me, समभिरक्षितः were rescued, ततः for that reason, जाग्रत्याः fully alert, यतमानायाः making efforts to protect you, मे to me,  वरौ two boons, प्राददाः you conferred.
explanation: O king, I rescued you there. Since I was alert to protect you, you granted me two boons.

shloka_text: तौ तु दत्तौ वरौ देव निक्षेपौ मृगयाम्यहम्। तथैव पृथिवीपाल सकाशे सत्यसङ्गर।।2.11.20।।
transliteration: tau tu dattau varau deva nikṣepau mṛgayāmyaham| tathaiva pṛthivīpāla sakāśe satyasaṅgara
translation: पृथिवीपाल O protector of the earth, सत्यसङ्गर  one who is honest in keeping promises, देव O king तव your, सकाशे एव with, निक्षेपौ preserved as deposit (to be given in course of time), तौ those, दत्तौ given, वरौ तु boons, अहम् I, मृगयामि seeking.
explanation: O protector of the earth, O king, honest in keeping promises, I (now) seek those two boons which were reserved as deposits.

shloka_text: तत् प्रतिश्रुत्य धर्मेण न चेद्दास्यसि मे वरम्। अद्यैव हि प्रहास्यामि जीवितं त्वद्विमानिता।।2.11.21।।
transliteration: tat pratiśrutya dharmeṇa na ceddāsyasi me varam| adyaiva hi prahāsyāmi jīvitaṃ tvadvimānitā
translation: तत् that, प्रतिश्रुत्य having vowed, मे my, वरम् boon, धर्मेण rightfully, न दास्यसि चेत् if you do not grant, त्वद्विमानिता disgraced by you, अद्यैव right away, जीवितम् life, प्रहास्यामि हि shall give up.
explanation: The boons you have vowed to give shall rightfully be given to me. If not, disgraced by you I shall give up my life right away.

shloka_text: वाङ्मात्रेण तदा राजा कैकेय्या स्ववशे कृतः। प्रचस्कन्द विनाशाय पाशं मृग इवात्मनः।।2.11.22।।
transliteration: vāṅmātreṇa tadā rājā kaikeyyā svavaśe kṛtaḥ| pracaskanda vināśāya pāśaṃ mṛga ivātmanaḥ
translation: तदा then, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, वाङ्मात्रेण with words only, स्ववशे under the control, कृतः caught, राजा च king also, मृगः इव like a deer, आत्मनः for his own, विनाशाय  for destruction, पाशम् trap, प्रचस्कन्द jumped into.
explanation: The king now came under the control of Kaikeyi by his own words like a deer that jumps into the trap for its own destruction.

shloka_text: ततः परमुवाचेदं वरदं काममोहितम्। वरौ यौ मे त्वया देव तदा दत्तौ महीपते।।2.11.23।। तौ तावदहमद्यैव वक्ष्यामि शृणु मे वचः।
transliteration: tataḥ paramuvācedaṃ varadaṃ kāmamohitam| varau yau me tvayā deva tadā dattau mahīpate tau tāvadahamadyaiva vakṣyāmi śṛṇu me vacaḥ|
translation: ततः परम् thereafter, काममोहितम् overcome by passion, वरदम् conferer of boons, इदम् this word, उवाच said, महीपते O lord of earth, देव my lord, तदा then, मे to me, त्वया by yourself, यौ वरौ those two boons, दत्तौ were given, तौ about them, अद्यैव तावत् right now, वक्ष्यामि I shall speak out , मे वचः my words, शृणु listen.
explanation: Thereafter, she said to the infatuated king who had promised to confer her boons, O lord of the earth, O king, right now I shall speak to you about the two boons granted by you. Listen to my words.

shloka_text: अभिषेकसमारम्भो राघवस्योपकल्पितः।।2.11.24।। अनेनैवाभिषेकेण भरतो मेऽभिषिच्यताम्।
transliteration: abhiṣekasamārambho rāghavasyopakalpitaḥ anenaivābhiṣekeṇa bharato me'bhiṣicyatām|
translation: राघवस्य Rama's, अभिषेकसमारम्भः preparations for consecration, उपकल्पितः have been  made, अनेन अभिषेकेणैव with these materials for installation, मे my, भरतः Bharata, अभिषिच्यताम् shall be crowned.
explanation: Preparations for Rama's consecration have been made. With these very materials for installation, my son Bharata should be consecrated.

shloka_text: यो द्वितीयो वरो देव दत्तः प्रीतेन मे त्वया।।2.11.25।। तदा दैवासुरे युद्धे तस्य कालोऽयमागत।
transliteration: yo dvitīyo varo deva dattaḥ prītena me tvayā tadā daivāsure yuddhe tasya kālo'yamāgata|
translation: तदा then, दैवासुरे युद्धे in the war between gods and asuras, प्रीतेन pleased, त्वया by you, देव Lord मे  to me, यः which, द्वितीय: second, वरः boon, दत्तः was given, तस्य for that, अयम् this, कालः  time, आगतः has come.
explanation: Then in the war between gods and asuras, O lord, pleased with me you have promised a second boon and the time has come to grant it.

shloka_text: नव प़ञ्च च वर्षाणि दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः।।2.11.26।। चीराजिनजटाधारी रामो भवतु तापसः।
transliteration: nava pa़ñca ca varṣāṇi daṇḍakāraṇyamāśritaḥ cīrājinajaṭādhārī rāmo bhavatu tāpasaḥ|
translation: रामः Rama, नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि for fourteen (nine and five) years, दण्डकारण्यम् Dandaka forest, आश्रितः resorted to, चीराजिनजटाधारी clad in tattered (bark) and deer skin and wearing matted locks, तापसः like an ascetic, भवतु shall remain (in the forest.)
explanation: Consigned to the Dandaka forest for fourteen years, clad in bark and deer skin and wearing matted hair, Rama shall live like an ascetic.

shloka_text: भरतो भजतामद्य यौवराज्यमकण्टकम्।।2.11.27।। एष मे परमः कामो दत्तमेव वरं वृणे। अद्य चैव हि पश्येयं प्रयान्तं राघवं वनम्।।2.11.28।।
transliteration: bharato bhajatāmadya yauvarājyamakaṇṭakam eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo dattameva varaṃ vṛṇe| adya caiva hi paśyeyaṃ prayāntaṃ rāghavaṃ vanam
translation: अद्य now, भरतः Bharata, अकण्टकम् without any thorns(rivals), यौवराज्यम् as princeregent, भजताम् let him enjoy, एषः this, मे my, परमः great, कामः desire, दत्तं वरमेव already granted boon, वृणे I am asking for, अद्य चैव now itself, वनम् to the forest, प्रयान्तं departing to the forest, राघवम् to the scion of the Raghus (Rama), पश्येयम् I shall see.
explanation: Let Bharata be princeregent without any rivals. This is my great desire. I am asking for an already granted boon. Let me see Rama's departure to the forest today itself.

shloka_text: भरतो भजतामद्य यौवराज्यमकण्टकम्।।2.11.27।। एष मे परमः कामो दत्तमेव वरं वृणे। अद्य चैव हि पश्येयं प्रयान्तं राघवं वनम्।।2.11.28।।
transliteration: bharato bhajatāmadya yauvarājyamakaṇṭakam eṣa me paramaḥ kāmo dattameva varaṃ vṛṇe| adya caiva hi paśyeyaṃ prayāntaṃ rāghavaṃ vanam
translation: अद्य now, भरतः Bharata, अकण्टकम् without any thorns(rivals), यौवराज्यम् as princeregent, भजताम् let him enjoy, एषः this, मे my, परमः great, कामः desire, दत्तं वरमेव already granted boon, वृणे I am asking for, अद्य चैव now itself, वनम् to the forest, प्रयान्तं departing to the forest, राघवम् to the scion of the Raghus (Rama), पश्येयम् I shall see.
explanation: Let Bharata be princeregent without any rivals. This is my great desire. I am asking for an already granted boon. Let me see Rama's departure to the forest today itself.

shloka_text: स राजराजः भव सत्यसङ्गरः कुलं च शीलं च हि रक्ष जन्म च। परत्रवासे हि वदन्त्यनुत्तमं तपोधनास्सत्यवचो हितं नृणाम्।।2.11.29।।
transliteration: sa rājarājaḥ bhava satyasaṅgaraḥ kulaṃ ca śīlaṃ ca hi rakṣa janma ca| paratravāse hi vadantyanuttamaṃ tapodhanāssatyavaco hitaṃ nṛṇām
translation: राजराजः king of kings, सः you are such, सत्यसङ्गरः भव  be true to your vows, कुलं च your race , शीलं च character, जन्म च birth, रक्ष हि protect, नृणाम् for men, परत्र in the other world, वासे for existence, सत्यवचः merits of truth, अनुत्तमम् no superior, हितम् welfare, तपोधनाः those having ascetism as wealth, sages, वदन्ति हि are saying.
explanation: O king of kings, by being true to your vow, protect your race, character and lineage. Those sages whose ascetism is their wealth maintain that there is no merit superior to truthfulness which can confer man a place in the other world. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततश्शृत्वा महाराजः कैकेय्या दारुणं वचः। चिन्तामभिसमापेदे मुहूर्तं प्रतताप च।।2.12.1।।
transliteration: tataśśṛtvā mahārājaḥ kaikeyyā dāruṇaṃ vacaḥ| cintāmabhisamāpede muhūrtaṃ pratatāpa ca
translation: महाराजः maharaja कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, दारुणम् dreadful, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ततः thereafter, चिन्ताम् grief, अभिसमापेदे got, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, प्रतताप च was extremely distressed.
explanation: After hearing the dreadful words of Kaikeyi, the maharaja (Dasaratha), engulfed in grief, was extremely distressed for a moment.
comments: Lamentations of king Dasaratha.

shloka_text: किन्नु मे यदि वा स्वप्नश्चित्तमोहोऽपि वा मम। अनुभूतोपसर्गो वा मनसो वाप्युपद्रवः।।2.12.2।।
transliteration: kinnu me yadi vā svapnaścittamoho'pi vā mama| anubhūtopasargo vā manaso vāpyupadravaḥ
translation: मे my, स्वप्नः किं नु is this a dream?, यदि वा or, मम my, चित्तमोहोऽपि वा or hallucination of the mind?, अनुभूतोपसर्गो वा or some  foreboding of evil I am going to experience , मनसः mind's, उपद्रवः वा or a malady.
explanation: ' Is this a dream? Or a hallucination of the mind? Or some foreboding evil I am going to experience or a malady of my mind'? (wondered Dasaratha)

shloka_text: इति सञ्चिन्त्य तद्राजा नाध्यगच्छत्तदासुखम्। प्रतिलभ्य चिरात्संज्ञां कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः।।2.12.3।। व्यथितो विक्लबश्चैव व्याघ्रीं दृष्ट्वा यथा मृगः। असंवृतायामासीनो जगत्यां दीर्घमुच्छवसन्।।2.12.4।। मण्डले पन्नगो रुद्धो मन्त्रैरिव महाविषः। अहो धिगिति सामर्षो वाचमुक्त्वा नराधिपः।।2.12.5।। मोहमापेदिवान्भूय श्शोकोपहतचेतनः।
transliteration: iti sañcintya tadrājā nādhyagacchattadāsukham| pratilabhya cirātsaṃjñāṃ kaikeyīvākyatāḍitaḥ vyathito viklabaścaiva vyāghrīṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgaḥ| asaṃvṛtāyāmāsīno jagatyāṃ dīrghamucchavasan maṇḍale pannago ruddho mantrairiva mahāviṣaḥ| aho dhigiti sāmarṣo vācamuktvā narādhipaḥ mohamāpedivānbhūya śśokopahatacetanaḥ|
translation: राजा king, इति thus, तत् about that , सञ्चित्य having thought over, तदा then, सुखम् comfort, नाध्यगच्छत् did not get, कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः  struck by the words of Kaikeyi, नराधिपः king, चिरात् after a long time, संज्ञाम् senses, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, व्याघ्रीम् a  tigress, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मृगः यथा like a deer, व्यथितः distressed, विक्लबः च एव startled, असंवृतायाम् uncovered, जगत्याम् on the ground, आसीनः having sat down, मण्डले in a circle, मन्त्रै: by  incantations, रुद्धः confined, महाविषः highly venomous, पन्नगः इव like a serpent, दीर्घम् intense, उच्छवसन् heaving, सामर्षः with indignation, आहो धिक् what a pity, इति thus, वाचम् word, उक्त्वा having spoken, शोकोपहतचेतनः with his senses struck by sorrow, भूयः again, मोहम् loss of consciousness, आपेदिवान् obtained.
explanation: The King absorbed in such thoughts did not get solace. He was startled  and distressed like a deer beholding a tigress. He had long lost the senses struck by the (ruthless) words of Kaikeyi. He sank down upon the bare floor heaving deep sighs like  a venomous serpent lying confined in a circle. 'What a pity' said the king with indignation and with his senses overwhelmed  by sorrow  fell into a stupor again.

shloka_text: इति सञ्चिन्त्य तद्राजा नाध्यगच्छत्तदासुखम्। प्रतिलभ्य चिरात्संज्ञां कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः।।2.12.3।। व्यथितो विक्लबश्चैव व्याघ्रीं दृष्ट्वा यथा मृगः। असंवृतायामासीनो जगत्यां दीर्घमुच्छवसन्।।2.12.4।। मण्डले पन्नगो रुद्धो मन्त्रैरिव महाविषः। अहो धिगिति सामर्षो वाचमुक्त्वा नराधिपः।।2.12.5।। मोहमापेदिवान्भूय श्शोकोपहतचेतनः।
transliteration: iti sañcintya tadrājā nādhyagacchattadāsukham| pratilabhya cirātsaṃjñāṃ kaikeyīvākyatāḍitaḥ vyathito viklabaścaiva vyāghrīṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgaḥ| asaṃvṛtāyāmāsīno jagatyāṃ dīrghamucchavasan maṇḍale pannago ruddho mantrairiva mahāviṣaḥ| aho dhigiti sāmarṣo vācamuktvā narādhipaḥ mohamāpedivānbhūya śśokopahatacetanaḥ|
translation: राजा king, इति thus, तत् about that , सञ्चित्य having thought over, तदा then, सुखम् comfort, नाध्यगच्छत् did not get, कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः  struck by the words of Kaikeyi, नराधिपः king, चिरात् after a long time, संज्ञाम् senses, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, व्याघ्रीम् a  tigress, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मृगः यथा like a deer, व्यथितः distressed, विक्लबः च एव startled, असंवृतायाम् uncovered, जगत्याम् on the ground, आसीनः having sat down, मण्डले in a circle, मन्त्रै: by  incantations, रुद्धः confined, महाविषः highly venomous, पन्नगः इव like a serpent, दीर्घम् intense, उच्छवसन् heaving, सामर्षः with indignation, आहो धिक् what a pity, इति thus, वाचम् word, उक्त्वा having spoken, शोकोपहतचेतनः with his senses struck by sorrow, भूयः again, मोहम् loss of consciousness, आपेदिवान् obtained.
explanation: The King absorbed in such thoughts did not get solace. He was startled  and distressed like a deer beholding a tigress. He had long lost the senses struck by the (ruthless) words of Kaikeyi. He sank down upon the bare floor heaving deep sighs like  a venomous serpent lying confined in a circle. 'What a pity' said the king with indignation and with his senses overwhelmed  by sorrow  fell into a stupor again.

shloka_text: इति सञ्चिन्त्य तद्राजा नाध्यगच्छत्तदासुखम्। प्रतिलभ्य चिरात्संज्ञां कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः।।2.12.3।। व्यथितो विक्लबश्चैव व्याघ्रीं दृष्ट्वा यथा मृगः। असंवृतायामासीनो जगत्यां दीर्घमुच्छवसन्।।2.12.4।। मण्डले पन्नगो रुद्धो मन्त्रैरिव महाविषः। अहो धिगिति सामर्षो वाचमुक्त्वा नराधिपः।।2.12.5।। मोहमापेदिवान्भूय श्शोकोपहतचेतनः।
transliteration: iti sañcintya tadrājā nādhyagacchattadāsukham| pratilabhya cirātsaṃjñāṃ kaikeyīvākyatāḍitaḥ vyathito viklabaścaiva vyāghrīṃ dṛṣṭvā yathā mṛgaḥ| asaṃvṛtāyāmāsīno jagatyāṃ dīrghamucchavasan maṇḍale pannago ruddho mantrairiva mahāviṣaḥ| aho dhigiti sāmarṣo vācamuktvā narādhipaḥ mohamāpedivānbhūya śśokopahatacetanaḥ|
translation: राजा king, इति thus, तत् about that , सञ्चित्य having thought over, तदा then, सुखम् comfort, नाध्यगच्छत् did not get, कैकेयीवाक्यताडितः  struck by the words of Kaikeyi, नराधिपः king, चिरात् after a long time, संज्ञाम् senses, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, व्याघ्रीम् a  tigress, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मृगः यथा like a deer, व्यथितः distressed, विक्लबः च एव startled, असंवृतायाम् uncovered, जगत्याम् on the ground, आसीनः having sat down, मण्डले in a circle, मन्त्रै: by  incantations, रुद्धः confined, महाविषः highly venomous, पन्नगः इव like a serpent, दीर्घम् intense, उच्छवसन् heaving, सामर्षः with indignation, आहो धिक् what a pity, इति thus, वाचम् word, उक्त्वा having spoken, शोकोपहतचेतनः with his senses struck by sorrow, भूयः again, मोहम् loss of consciousness, आपेदिवान् obtained.
explanation: The King absorbed in such thoughts did not get solace. He was startled  and distressed like a deer beholding a tigress. He had long lost the senses struck by the (ruthless) words of Kaikeyi. He sank down upon the bare floor heaving deep sighs like  a venomous serpent lying confined in a circle. 'What a pity' said the king with indignation and with his senses overwhelmed  by sorrow  fell into a stupor again.

shloka_text: चिरेण तु नृप स्संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य सुदुःखितः।।2.12.6।। कैकेयीमब्रवीत्क्रुद्धःप्रदहन्निव चक्षुषा।
transliteration: cireṇa tu nṛpa ssaṃjñāṃ pratilabhya suduḥkhitaḥ kaikeyīmabravītkruddhaḥpradahanniva cakṣuṣā|
translation: नृपः  the king, चिरेण after a long time, संज्ञाम् consciousness, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, सुदुःखितः  distressed, क्रुद्धः angry, चक्षुषा with eyes, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, प्रदहन्निव as if burning, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Regaining his consciousness after a long time, the king in deep grief and with eyes as though burning in anger looked at  Kaikeyi  and said:

shloka_text: नृशंसे दुष्टचारित्रे कुलस्यास्य विनाशिनि।।2.12.7।। किं कृतं तव रामेण पापं पापे मयापि वा।
transliteration: nṛśaṃse duṣṭacāritre kulasyāsya vināśini kiṃ kṛtaṃ tava rāmeṇa pāpaṃ pāpe mayāpi vā|
translation: नृशंसे O cruel woman, दुष्टचारित्रे  of wicked character, अस्य कुलस्य of this family, विनाशिनि destroyer, पापे sinful woman, रामेण by Rama, मयापि वा or by me, तव your, किं पापं कृतम् what harm has been done?
explanation: O woman of cruel and sinful nature, you are bent on destroying this family. What harm has been done to you  by Rama or by me?

shloka_text: यदा ते जननीतुल्यां वृत्तिं वहति राघव: ।।2.12.8।। तस्यैव त्वमनर्थाय किंनिमित्तमिहोद्यता ।
transliteration: yadā te jananītulyāṃ vṛttiṃ vahati rāghava:  tasyaiva tvamanarthāya kiṃnimittamihodyatā |
translation: राघवः Rama, यदा when  ते in relation to you, जननीतुल्याम् like his own mother, वृत्तिम् conduct, वहति was carrying out, तस्यैव to such a person, अनर्थाय for injustice, त्वम् you, किं निमित्तम् for what purpose, इह here, उद्यता are you attempting?
explanation: Then Rama was conducting himself in relation to you as his own mother, for what purpose are you seeking injustice to such a person?

shloka_text: त्वं मयाऽऽत्मविनाशार्थं भवनं स्वं प्रवेशिता।।2.12.9।। अविज्ञानान्नृपसुता व्याली तीक्ष्णविषा यथा।
transliteration: tvaṃ mayā''tmavināśārthaṃ bhavanaṃ svaṃ praveśitā avijñānānnṛpasutā vyālī tīkṣṇaviṣā yathā|
translation: त्वम् you, नृपसुता king's daughter, मया by me, तीक्ष्णविषा  venomous, व्याली यथा like a female serpent, अविज्ञानात् by ignorance, स्वं भवनम् my home, आत्म विनाशार्थम् for  selfdestruction, प्रवेशिता  ushered in.
explanation: In my ignorance I brought home for my selfdestruction a king's daughter who was like a venomous female serpent.

shloka_text: जीवलोको यदा सर्वो रामस्याह गुणस्तवम्।।2.12.10।। अपराधं किमुद्दिश्य त्यक्ष्यामीष्टमहं सुतम्।
transliteration: jīvaloko yadā sarvo rāmasyāha guṇastavam aparādhaṃ kimuddiśya tyakṣyāmīṣṭamahaṃ sutam|
translation: यदा when, सर्वः all, जीवलोकः living beings of the world, रामस्य Rama's, गुणस्तवम् extoling  virtues, आह is telling, (then), कम् what, अपराधम् crime, उद्धिश्य showing, अहम् I, इष्टं सुतम् beloved son, त्यक्ष्यामि I shall abandon.
explanation: When all living beings of this world are extoling the virtues of Rama, for what crime should I abandon my beloved son?

shloka_text: कौसल्यां वा सुमित्रां वा त्यजेयमपि वा श्रियम्।।2.12.11।। जीवितं वाऽत्मनो रामं न त्वेव पितृवत्सलम्।
transliteration: kausalyāṃ vā sumitrāṃ vā tyajeyamapi vā śriyam jīvitaṃ vā'tmano rāmaṃ na tveva pitṛvatsalam|
translation: कौशल्यां वा even Kausalya, सुमित्रां वा or even Sumitra, श्रियमपि वा wealth, आत्मनः my own , जीवितं वा life also, त्यजेयम् shall give up, पितृवत्सलम् who is devoted to  his father, रामं तु Rama, न will not leave.
explanation: I shall give up Kausalya or Sumitra or all my wealth or even my own life but I cannot leave Rama who is devoted to his father.

shloka_text: परा भवति मे प्रीतिर्दृष्ट्वा तनयमग्रजम्।।2.12.12।। अपश्यतस्तु मे रामं नष्टा भवति चेतना।
transliteration: parā bhavati me prītirdṛṣṭvā tanayamagrajam apaśyatastu me rāmaṃ naṣṭā bhavati cetanā|
translation: अग्रजम् firstborn, तनयम् son, दृष्ट्वा having seen, मे my, परा supreme, प्रीतिः भवति will be my delight, रामम् Rama, अपश्यतस्तु but if I do not see him, मे my, चेतना life, नष्टा भवति is destroyed.
explanation: When I see my firstborn , I experience supreme delight. But if I do not see him, my life loses its meaning.

shloka_text: तिष्ठेल्लोको विना सूर्यं शस्यं वा सलिलं विना।।2.12.13।। न तु रामं विना देहे तिष्ठेत्तु मम जीवितम्।
transliteration: tiṣṭhelloko vinā sūryaṃ śasyaṃ vā salilaṃ vinā na tu rāmaṃ vinā dehe tiṣṭhettu mama jīvitam|
translation: लोकः world, सूर्यं विना without the Sun, तिष्ठेत् can exist, सस्यम् crops, सलिलं विना वा without water, तु but, रामं विना without Rama, मम देहे my body, जीवितम् life, न तिष्ठेत् shall not exist.
explanation: This world can exist without the Sun or crops (can be grown) without water but without Rama, life would not exist in my body.

shloka_text: तदलं त्यज्यतामेष निश्चयः पापनिश्चये।।2.12.14।। अपि ते चरणै मूर्ध्ना स्पृशाम्येष प्रसीद मे।
transliteration: tadalaṃ tyajyatāmeṣa niścayaḥ pāpaniścaye api te caraṇai mūrdhnā spṛśāmyeṣa prasīda me|
translation: पापनिश्चये O lady of evil intentions, तत् for that reason, अलम् enough, एषः such, निश्चयः intention, त्यज्यताम्  give up, एषः here I, ते चरणौ your feet, मूर्ध्ना with my head, स्पृशाम्यपि will touch, मे my (to me), प्रसीद you may be pleased.
explanation: O lady of evil intentions, enough of this. Give up your resolve. Here I touch your feet with my head. Be pleased with me.

shloka_text: किमिदं चिन्तितं पापे त्वया परमदारुणम्।।2.12.15।। अथ जिज्ञाससे मां त्वं भरतस्य प्रियाप्रिये। अस्तु यत्तत्त्वया पूर्वं व्याहृतं राघवं प्रति।।2.12.16।। स मे ज्येष्ठस्सुत श्रीमान्धर्मज्येष्ठ इतीव मे। तत्त्वया प्रियवादिन्या सेवार्थं कथितं भवेत्।।2.12.17।।
transliteration: kimidaṃ cintitaṃ pāpe tvayā paramadāruṇam atha jijñāsase māṃ tvaṃ bharatasya priyāpriye| astu yattattvayā pūrvaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ rāghavaṃ prati sa me jyeṣṭhassuta śrīmāndharmajyeṣṭha itīva me| tattvayā priyavādinyā sevārthaṃ kathitaṃ bhavet
translation: पापे O sinful one, त्वया by you, परमदारुणम्  most  dreadful, इदम् this, किम् why, चिन्तितम् thought, अथ or, त्वम् you, माम् me, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रियाप्रिये about likes or dislikes, जिज्ञाससे enquire, अस्तु let it be so, त्वया by you, राघवं प्रति speaking of Rama, श्रीमान् noble, सः that Rama, मे my, धर्मज्येष्ठः foremost in  discharging his duties, सुतः son, इतीव like this, पूर्वम् earlier, तत् that , यत् what words, व्याहृतम् uttered, तत् those, प्रियवादिन्या by a woman speaking sweet words, त्वया by you, सेवार्थम् only to serve(please) me, कथितं भवेत् could have been said.
explanation: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know  my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his  duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.

shloka_text: किमिदं चिन्तितं पापे त्वया परमदारुणम्।।2.12.15।। अथ जिज्ञाससे मां त्वं भरतस्य प्रियाप्रिये। अस्तु यत्तत्त्वया पूर्वं व्याहृतं राघवं प्रति।।2.12.16।। स मे ज्येष्ठस्सुत श्रीमान्धर्मज्येष्ठ इतीव मे। तत्त्वया प्रियवादिन्या सेवार्थं कथितं भवेत्।।2.12.17।।
transliteration: kimidaṃ cintitaṃ pāpe tvayā paramadāruṇam atha jijñāsase māṃ tvaṃ bharatasya priyāpriye| astu yattattvayā pūrvaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ rāghavaṃ prati sa me jyeṣṭhassuta śrīmāndharmajyeṣṭha itīva me| tattvayā priyavādinyā sevārthaṃ kathitaṃ bhavet
translation: पापे O sinful one, त्वया by you, परमदारुणम्  most  dreadful, इदम् this, किम् why, चिन्तितम् thought, अथ or, त्वम् you, माम् me, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रियाप्रिये about likes or dislikes, जिज्ञाससे enquire, अस्तु let it be so, त्वया by you, राघवं प्रति speaking of Rama, श्रीमान् noble, सः that Rama, मे my, धर्मज्येष्ठः foremost in  discharging his duties, सुतः son, इतीव like this, पूर्वम् earlier, तत् that , यत् what words, व्याहृतम् uttered, तत् those, प्रियवादिन्या by a woman speaking sweet words, त्वया by you, सेवार्थम् only to serve(please) me, कथितं भवेत् could have been said.
explanation: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know  my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his  duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.

shloka_text: किमिदं चिन्तितं पापे त्वया परमदारुणम्।।2.12.15।। अथ जिज्ञाससे मां त्वं भरतस्य प्रियाप्रिये। अस्तु यत्तत्त्वया पूर्वं व्याहृतं राघवं प्रति।।2.12.16।। स मे ज्येष्ठस्सुत श्रीमान्धर्मज्येष्ठ इतीव मे। तत्त्वया प्रियवादिन्या सेवार्थं कथितं भवेत्।।2.12.17।।
transliteration: kimidaṃ cintitaṃ pāpe tvayā paramadāruṇam atha jijñāsase māṃ tvaṃ bharatasya priyāpriye| astu yattattvayā pūrvaṃ vyāhṛtaṃ rāghavaṃ prati sa me jyeṣṭhassuta śrīmāndharmajyeṣṭha itīva me| tattvayā priyavādinyā sevārthaṃ kathitaṃ bhavet
translation: पापे O sinful one, त्वया by you, परमदारुणम्  most  dreadful, इदम् this, किम् why, चिन्तितम् thought, अथ or, त्वम् you, माम् me, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रियाप्रिये about likes or dislikes, जिज्ञाससे enquire, अस्तु let it be so, त्वया by you, राघवं प्रति speaking of Rama, श्रीमान् noble, सः that Rama, मे my, धर्मज्येष्ठः foremost in  discharging his duties, सुतः son, इतीव like this, पूर्वम् earlier, तत् that , यत् what words, व्याहृतम् uttered, तत् those, प्रियवादिन्या by a woman speaking sweet words, त्वया by you, सेवार्थम् only to serve(please) me, कथितं भवेत् could have been said.
explanation: O sinful one why have you got this most dreadful thought? Do you want to know  my likes or dislikes about Bharata? Let them be so.But speaking of Rama earlier, you used to say, 'Rama is my eldest son. He is noble and foremost in discharging his  duties.' Such sweet words could not have been said only to please me.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा शोकसन्तप्ता सन्तापयसि मां भृशम्। आविष्टाऽसि गृहं शून्यं सा त्वं परवशं गता।।2.12.18।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā śokasantaptā santāpayasi māṃ bhṛśam| āviṣṭā'si gṛhaṃ śūnyaṃ sā tvaṃ paravaśaṃ gatā
translation: तत् further, सा त्वम् you are such, परवशंगता under the influence of others, श्रुत्वा  hearing their words, शोकसन्तप्ता tormented with sorrow, शून्यं गृहम् empty chamber of wrath, आविष्टा असि you have entered, माम् me, भृशम् greatly, सन्तापयसि causing me great pain.
explanation: Further you are tormented with sorrow under the influence of others' insinuations. You are causing me great pain by entering the empty chamber of wrath.

shloka_text: इक्ष्वाकूणां कुले देवि सम्प्राप्तस्सुमहानयम्। अनयो नयसम्पन्ने यत्र ते विकृता मतिः।।2.12.19।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule devi samprāptassumahānayam| anayo nayasampanne yatra te vikṛtā matiḥ
translation: नयसम्पन्ने endowed with a moral sense, देवि O queen, यत्र wherever, ते your, मतिः mind, विकृता changed, इक्ष्वाकुणां कुले in the  Ikshvaku race, सुमहान् very great, अयम् this, अनयः immorality, सम्प्राप्तः has befallen.
explanation: O queen, till now you had a moral sense. With your mind debased (now), a very great immorality has infected the  Ikshvaku race.

shloka_text: नहि किञ्चिदयुक्तं वा विप्रियं वा पुरा मम। अकरोस्त्वं विशालाक्षि तेन न श्रद्दधाम्यहम्।।2.12.20।।
transliteration: nahi kiñcidayuktaṃ vā vipriyaṃ vā purā mama| akarostvaṃ viśālākṣi tena na śraddadhāmyaham
translation: विशालाक्षि O largeeyed lady, पुरा in the past, मम to me, किञ्चित् even little, अयुक्तं वा improper, विप्रियं वा or unpalatable, त्वम् you, न अकरोः did not render, तेन for that reason, अहम् I  न श्रद्दधामि do not believe.
explanation: O largeeyed lady, you have never done anything improper or unpalatable towards me in the past. Therefore I do not  believe your words.

shloka_text: ननु ते राघवस्तुल्यो भरतेन महात्मना। बहुशो हि सुबाले त्वं कथाः कथयसे मम।।2.12.21।।
transliteration: nanu te rāghavastulyo bharatena mahātmanā| bahuśo hi subāle tvaṃ kathāḥ kathayase mama
translation: ते to you, राघवः Raghava, महात्मना highsouled, भरतेन with Bharata, तुल्यः ननु is equal indeed, सुबाले O childish one, त्वम् you, बहुशः several times, मम to me, कथाः कथयसे (मम) हि used to tell (me).
explanation: O childish one, you used to tell me several times that Rama is as dear to you as the highsouled Bharata.

shloka_text: तस्य धर्मात्मनो देवि वनवासं यशस्विनः। कथं रोचयसे भीरु नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च।।2.12.22।।
transliteration: tasya dharmātmano devi vanavāsaṃ yaśasvinaḥ| kathaṃ rocayase bhīru nava varṣāṇi pañca ca
translation: भीरु O lady, देवि O queen, धर्मात्मनः of that righteous one, यशस्विनः illustrious, तस्य his, नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि fourteen years, वनवासम् to dwell in the forest, कथम् how, रोचयसे  wish?
explanation: O lady how do you wish this righteous and illustrious Rama to dwell in the forest for fourteen years?

shloka_text: अत्यन्तसुकुमारस्य तस्य धर्मे धृतात्मनः। कथं रोचयसे वासमरण्ये भृशदारुणे।।2.12.23।।
transliteration: atyantasukumārasya tasya dharme dhṛtātmanaḥ| kathaṃ rocayase vāsamaraṇye bhṛśadāruṇe
translation: अत्यन्तसुकुमारस्य exceedingly tender one, धर्मे in virtues, धृतात्मनः firmminded one, तस्य his  (Rama's), भृशदारुणे very dreadful, अरण्ये in the forest, वासम् to dwell, कथम् why, रोचयसे  you like?
explanation: Why do you want Rama who is so tender and a firm follower of dharma to dwell in the highly dreadful forest?

shloka_text: रोचयस्यभिरामस्य रामस्य शुभलोचने। तव शुश्रूषमाणस्य किमर्थं विप्रवासनम्।।2.12.24।।
transliteration: rocayasyabhirāmasya rāmasya śubhalocane| tava śuśrūṣamāṇasya kimarthaṃ vipravāsanam
translation: शुभलोचने O woman of beautiful eyes, तव to you, शुश्रूषमाणस्य desirous of serving,    अभिरामस्य charming, रामस्य Rama's, विप्रवासनम् exile to a distant place, किमर्थम् why,   रोचयसि do you desire?
explanation: O woman with attractive eyes, why do you want Rama who is so charming and serving you to be exiled to a distant place?

shloka_text: रामो हि भरताद्भूयस्तव शुश्रूषते सदा। विशेषं त्वयि तस्मात्तु भरतस्य न लक्षये।।2.12.25।।
transliteration: rāmo hi bharatādbhūyastava śuśrūṣate sadā| viśeṣaṃ tvayi tasmāttu bharatasya na lakṣaye
translation: रामः Rama, भरतात् more than Bharata, भूयः still more, सदा always, तव to you, शुश्रूषते is doing service, तस्मात्तु for that reason also, त्वयि in you, भरतस्य Bharata's, विशेषम् speciality, न लक्षये I do not see.
explanation: Rama is doing greater service to you than Bharata. Therefore, I do not find any reason for you to have a special love for Bharata.

shloka_text: शुश्रूषां गौरवं चैव प्रमाणं वचनक्रियाम्। कस्ते भूयस्तरं कुर्यादन्यत्र मनुजर्षभात्।।2.12.26।। बहूनां स्त्रीसहस्राणां बहूनां चोपजीविनाम्।
transliteration: śuśrūṣāṃ gauravaṃ caiva pramāṇaṃ vacanakriyām| kaste bhūyastaraṃ kuryādanyatra manujarṣabhāt bahūnāṃ strīsahasrāṇāṃ bahūnāṃ copajīvinām|
translation: बहूनाम् many, स्त्रीसहस्राणाम् thousands of women, बहूनाम् many, उपजीविनाम् attendants, अन्यत्र मनुजर्षभात् other than Rama who is the best among men, कः who, ते to you, भूयस्तरम् great, शुश्रूषाम् service, गौरवम् honour, प्रमाणं चैव trusting your words as true, वचनक्रियाम् carrying out your orders, कुर्यात् will do?
explanation: There are many thousands of women and attendants (in the inner apartment), but who will do greater service and honour you more than Rama, the best among men in the execution of your orders.

shloka_text: परिवादोऽपवादो वा राघवे नोपपद्यते।।2.12.27।। सान्त्वयन्सर्वभूतानि राम श्शुद्धेन चेतसा। गृह्णाति मनुजव्याघ्र प्रियैर्विषयवासिनः।।2.12.28।।
transliteration: parivādo'pavādo vā rāghave nopapadyate sāntvayansarvabhūtāni rāma śśuddhena cetasā| gṛhṇāti manujavyāghra priyairviṣayavāsinaḥ
translation: राघवे in the matter of Rama, परिवादः word of blame, अपवादो वा or word of reproach, नोपपद्यते does not aply to him, मनुजव्याघ्रः a tiger among men, रामः Rama, शुद्धेन with pure, चेतसा heart, सर्वभूतानि all beings, सान्त्वयन् while appeasing, विषयवासिनः inhabitants of the country, प्रियैः by doing acts dear to them, गृह्णाति attracts them.
explanation: The best among men, Rama has won the trust of the inhabitants of the country by securing their affection with a pure heart and by doing acts dear to them. Therefore, neither a word of blame nor reproach applies to this scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama).

shloka_text: परिवादोऽपवादो वा राघवे नोपपद्यते।।2.12.27।। सान्त्वयन्सर्वभूतानि राम श्शुद्धेन चेतसा। गृह्णाति मनुजव्याघ्र प्रियैर्विषयवासिनः।।2.12.28।।
transliteration: parivādo'pavādo vā rāghave nopapadyate sāntvayansarvabhūtāni rāma śśuddhena cetasā| gṛhṇāti manujavyāghra priyairviṣayavāsinaḥ
translation: राघवे in the matter of Rama, परिवादः word of blame, अपवादो वा or word of reproach, नोपपद्यते does not aply to him, मनुजव्याघ्रः a tiger among men, रामः Rama, शुद्धेन with pure, चेतसा heart, सर्वभूतानि all beings, सान्त्वयन् while appeasing, विषयवासिनः inhabitants of the country, प्रियैः by doing acts dear to them, गृह्णाति attracts them.
explanation: The best among men, Rama has won the trust of the inhabitants of the country by securing their affection with a pure heart and by doing acts dear to them. Therefore, neither a word of blame nor reproach applies to this scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama).

shloka_text: सत्येन लोकान् जयति दीनान् दानेन राघवः। गुरूञ्छुश्रूषया वीरो धनुषा युधि शात्रवान्।।2.12.29।।
transliteration: satyena lokān jayati dīnān dānena rāghavaḥ| gurūñchuśrūṣayā vīro dhanuṣā yudhi śātravān
translation: वीरः hero, राघवः Rama, सत्येन by truth, लोकान् the people, दानेन by charity, दीनान् the poor, जयति wins over, शुश्रूषया by his service, गुरून् his preceptors, युधि in battle, धनुषा by the power of his bow, शात्रवान् enemies, जयति conquers.
explanation: Rama is a hero who wins over the people by his truthfulness, the poor by charity, the preceptors by his service and the enemies in the battle by the power of  his bow.

shloka_text: सत्यं दानं तपस्त्यागो मित्रता शौचमार्जवम्। विद्या च गुरुशुश्रूषा ध्रुवाण्येतानि राघवे।।2.12.30।।
transliteration: satyaṃ dānaṃ tapastyāgo mitratā śaucamārjavam| vidyā ca guruśuśrūṣā dhruvāṇyetāni rāghave
translation: सत्यम् truth, दानम् munificence, तपः asceticism, त्यागः renunciation, शौचम् purity, आर्जवम् uprightness, विद्या च also learning, गुरुशुश्रूषा service to his superiors, एतानि all these, राघवे in Rama, ध्रुवाणि are firmly fixed.
explanation: Truth, munificence, asceticism, renunciation, purity, uprightness, learning and service to his superiors all those (virtues) are firmly planted in this descendant of the Raghus.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्नार्जवसम्पन्ने देवि देवोपमे कथम्। पापमाशंससे रामे महर्षिसमतेजसि।।2.12.31।।
transliteration: tasminnārjavasampanne devi devopame katham| pāpamāśaṃsase rāme maharṣisamatejasi
translation: देवि O Devi आर्जवसम्पन्ने one endowed with uprightness, देवोपमे resembling gods, महर्षिसमतेजसि equal to great ascetics in lustre, तस्मिन् रामे in that Rama, कथम् how, पापम् harm, आशंससे wish.
