explanation: Hence tell me, O Devi Whatever be the desire of the king: I promise I shall carry out, Rama does not say two things (does not go back on his word).

shloka_text: तमार्जवसमायुक्तमनार्या सत्यवादिनम्। उवाच रामं कैकेयी वचनं भृशदारुणम्।।2.18.31।।
transliteration: tamārjavasamāyuktamanāryā satyavādinam| uvāca rāmaṃ kaikeyī vacanaṃ bhṛśadāruṇam
translation: अनार्या ignoble, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, आर्जवसमायुक्तं devoted to rectitude of conduct, सत्यवादिनम्  truthful, तं रामम् addressing that Rama, भृशदारुणम् extremely cruel, वचनम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: To Rama who was devoted to truth and to rectitude of conduct the ignobale Kaikeyi said:

shloka_text: पुरा दैवासुरे युद्धे पित्रा ते मम राघव। रक्षितेन वरौ दत्तौ सशल्येन महारणे।।2.18.32।।
transliteration: purā daivāsure yuddhe pitrā te mama rāghava| rakṣitena varau dattau saśalyena mahāraṇe
translation: राघव O (Rama) descendant of Raghu, पुरा in the past, दैवासुरे युद्धे in the war between gods and demons, महारणे great war, सशल्येन wounded by shafts, रक्षितेन protected (by me), ते पित्रा by your father, मम to me, वरौ two boons, दत्तौ granted.
explanation: O descendant of Raghu in the great war between gods and demons in the past your father had granted me two boons for protecting him when he was wounded by a shaft.

shloka_text: तत्र मे याचितो राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम्। गमनं दण्डकारण्ये तव चाद्यैव राघव।।2.18.33।।
transliteration: tatra me yācito rājā bharatasyābhiṣecanam| gamanaṃ daṇḍakāraṇye tava cādyaiva rāghava
translation: राघव (Rama) scion of the Raghus, तत्र there (so), राजा the king, भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् consecration, अद्यैव today itself,  दण्डकारण्ये to Dandaka forest, तव your, गमनम् departure, याचितः has been asked.
explanation: O scion of the Raghus, hence I have asked the king for consecration of Bharata and your departure to Dandaka forest today itself.

shloka_text: यदि सत्यप्रतिज्ञं त्वं पितरं कर्तुमिच्छसि। आत्मानं च नरश्रेष्ठ मम वाक्यमिदं शृणु।।2.18.34।।
transliteration: yadi satyapratijñaṃ tvaṃ pitaraṃ kartumicchasi| ātmānaṃ ca naraśreṣṭha mama vākyamidaṃ śṛṇu
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, त्वम् you, पितरम् your father, आत्मानं च yourself as well, सत्यप्रतिज्ञम् truthful to promise, कर्तुम् to make, इच्छसि यदि if you want, मम my, इदं वाक्यम् these words, शृणु listen.
explanation: O the best of men if you want to be true to the word given by you and your father, listen to what I say.

shloka_text: सन्निदेशे पितुस्तिष्ठ यथा तेन प्रतिश्रुतम्। त्वयाऽरण्यं प्रवेष्टव्यं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च।।2.18.35।।
transliteration: sannideśe pitustiṣṭha yathā tena pratiśrutam| tvayā'raṇyaṃ praveṣṭavyaṃ nava varṣāṇi pañca ca
translation: पितु: father's, सन्निदेशे by the command, तिष्ठ abide by, तेन by him, यथा in this way, प्रतिश्रुतम् promised, त्वया by you, नव पंच च nine and five (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, अरण्यम् forest, प्रवेष्टव्यम् enter (and stay).
explanation: Abide by your father's command. As promised by him go to the forest for fourteen years.

shloka_text: भरतस्त्वभिषिच्येत यदेतदभिषेचनम्। त्वदर्थे विहितं राज्ञा तेन सर्वेण राघव।।2.18.36।।
transliteration: bharatastvabhiṣicyeta yadetadabhiṣecanam| tvadarthe vihitaṃ rājñā tena sarveṇa rāghava
translation: राघव O son of the Raghu dynasty (Rama), राज्ञा by the king, त्वदर्थे for your sake, यत् which, एतत् this, अभिषेचनम् installation, विहितम् has been arranged, तेन सर्वेण with all these (preparations), भरतः Bharata, अभिषिच्येत shall be consecrated.
explanation: Bharata shall be consecrated, O descendant of the Raghu dynasty with all these preparations made by the king to install you.

shloka_text: सप्त सप्त च वर्षाणि दण्डकारण्यमाश्रितः। अभिषेकमिमं त्यक्त्वा जटाजिनधरो वस।।2.18.37।।
transliteration: sapta sapta ca varṣāṇi daṇḍakāraṇyamāśritaḥ| abhiṣekamimaṃ tyaktvā jaṭājinadharo vasa
translation: इमम् अभिषेकम् this consecration, त्यक्त्वा having forsaken, जटाजिनधर: with matted hair and deerskin, दण्डकारण्यम् आश्रितः taking refuge in Dandaka forest, सप्त सप्त च वर्षाणि seven and seven (fourteen) years, वस live.
explanation: Forsake this consecration, wear matted locks and deerskin and take refuge in Dandaka forest for fourteen years.

shloka_text: भरतः कोसलपुरे प्रशास्तु वसुधामिमाम्। नानारत्न समाकीर्णां सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम्।।2.18.38।।
transliteration: bharataḥ kosalapure praśāstu vasudhāmimām| nānāratna samākīrṇāṃ savājirathakuñjarām
translation: भरतः Bharata, कोशलपुरे in Ayodhya, the capital of Kosala country, नानारत्न समाकीर्णाम् abounding in different kinds of gems, सवाजिरथकुञ्जराम् with horses, chariots and elephants, इमां वसुधाम् this earth, प्रशास्तु let (him) rule.
explanation: Let Bharata live in Ayodhya, the capital of Kosala and rule this kingdom rich in gems of different kinds in horses, chariots and elephants.

shloka_text: एतेन त्वां नरेन्द्रोऽयं कारुण्येन समाप्लुतः। शोकसंक्लिष्ट वदनो न शक्नोति निरीक्षितुम्।।2.18.39।।
transliteration: etena tvāṃ narendro'yaṃ kāruṇyena samāplutaḥ| śokasaṃkliṣṭa vadano na śaknoti nirīkṣitum
translation: एतेन  therefore, अयं नरेन्द्रः this king, कारुण्येन on account of compassion, समाप्लुतः was overwhelmed, शोकसंक्लिष्ट वदनः with a face fortured by tears, त्वाम् you, निरीक्षितुम् to see, न शक्नोति not able.
explanation: This is why the king with his face tortured by tears and (his heart) overwhelmed with compassion for you, is unable to look at you.

shloka_text: एतत्कुरु नरेन्द्रस्य वचनं रघुनन्दन। सत्येन महता राम तारयस्व नरेश्वरम्।।2.18.40।।
transliteration: etatkuru narendrasya vacanaṃ raghunandana| satyena mahatā rāma tārayasva nareśvaram
translation: रघुनन्दन  O Joy of the Raghus, O son of the Raghu race, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, एतत् वचनम् this word of promise, कुरु carry out, राम Rama, महता सत्येन with your great truthfulness, नरेश्वरम् the king, तारयस्व save.
explanation: O Joy of the Raghus, O son of the Raghu race, carry out the word of promise given by the king and save him by helping him keep the truth which is great.

shloka_text: इतीव तस्यां परुषं वदन्त्यां न चैव रामः प्रविवेश शोकम्। प्रविव्यथे चापि महानुभावो राजा तु पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः।।2.18.41।।
transliteration: itīva tasyāṃ paruṣaṃ vadantyāṃ na caiva rāmaḥ praviveśa śokam| pravivyathe cāpi mahānubhāvo rājā tu putravyasanābhitaptaḥ
translation: इतीव in this way, तस्याम् she (Kaikeyi), परुषम् harsh words, वदन्त्याम् was speaking, रामः Rama, शोकम् sorrow, नचैव प्रविदेश did not enter, महानुभावः dignified, राजा तु king, पुत्रव्यसनाभितप्तः afflicted with the son's calamity, प्रविव्यथे was greatly pained.
explanation: Even though she was speaking harsh words, Rama did not come to grief. But the magnanimous king was greatly afflicted to see the calamity on his son. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the oly Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तदप्रियममित्रघ्नो वचनं मरणोपमम्। श्रुत्वा न विव्यथे रामः कैकेयीं चेदमब्रवीत्।।2.19.1।।
transliteration: tadapriyamamitraghno vacanaṃ maraṇopamam| śrutvā na vivyathe rāmaḥ kaikeyīṃ cedamabravīt
translation: अमित्रघ्नः destroyer of enemies, रामः Rama, अप्रियम् unpleasant, मरणोपमम् like death, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, न विव्यथे was not pained, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The destroyer of enemies (Rama) did not feel distressed to hear these words painful like death. To Kaikeyi he said:
comments: Rama hears from Kaikeyi about the boons promised by Dasarathaconsents to leave for the forest goes to meet Kausalya.

shloka_text: एवमस्तु गमिष्यामि वनं वस्तुमहं त्वितः। जटाजिनधरो राज्ञः प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन्।।2.19.2।।
transliteration: evamastu gamiṣyāmi vanaṃ vastumahaṃ tvitaḥ| jaṭājinadharo rājñaḥ pratijñāmanupālayan
translation: एवम् अस्तु be it so अहम् I, राज्ञः king's, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, अनुपालयन् while obeying, जटाजिनधरः wearing matted locks and deer skin , इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, वस्तुम् to live, गमिष्यामि shall go.
explanation: Be it so I shall go from here to the forest and live there with matted hair and deerskin to keep the promise of the king.

shloka_text: इदं तु ज्ञातुमिच्छामि किमर्थं मां महीपतिः। नाभिनन्दति दुर्धर्षो यथापूर्वमरिन्दमः।।2.19.3।।
transliteration: idaṃ tu jñātumicchāmi kimarthaṃ māṃ mahīpatiḥ| nābhinandati durdharṣo yathāpūrvamarindamaḥ
translation: दुर्धर्षः unassailable, अरिन्दमः subduer of enemies, महीपतिः lord of the earth (king Dasaratha), यथापूर्वम् as usual, माम् me, किमर्थम् why, नाभिनन्दति does not greet, इदं तु this nevertheless, ज्ञातुम् to know, इच्छामि (I) wish.
explanation: Nevertheless I would like to know why king Dasaratha, an unassailable subduer of enemies does not greet me as usual.

shloka_text: मन्युर्न च त्वया कार्यो देवि ब्रूमि तवाग्रतः। यास्यामि भव सुप्रीता वनं चीरजटाधरः।।2.19.4।।
transliteration: manyurna ca tvayā kāryo devi brūmi tavāgrataḥ| yāsyāmi bhava suprītā vanaṃ cīrajaṭādharaḥ
translation: देवि O Devi त्वया by you, मन्युः indignation, न कार्यः should not be expressed, तव your, अग्रतः in front of, ब्रूमि am telling, चीरजटाधरः wearing tattered clothes (bark robes) and with matted locks, वनम् to the forest, यास्यामि shall go, सुप्रीता भव rejoice.
explanation: O Devi you should not grieve. I declare in your presence that I shall go to the forest wearing tattered clothes (bark) and matted locks. Rejoice (to hear this).

shloka_text: हितेन गुरुणा पित्रा कृतज्ञेन नृपेण च। नियुज्यमानो विस्रब्धः किं न कुर्यामहं प्रियम्।।2.19.5।।
transliteration: hitena guruṇā pitrā kṛtajñena nṛpeṇa ca| niyujyamāno visrabdhaḥ kiṃ na kuryāmahaṃ priyam
translation: हितेन seeking wellbeing, गुरुणा by guru, कृतज्ञेन grateful person, नृपेण च also the king, पित्रा by father, नियुज्यमानः having been ordered, अहम् I, विस्रब्ध without hesitation, प्रियम् what pleases (him), न कुर्यां किम् shall I not do?
explanation: Ordered by my father who is my wellwisher, my guru, one with a sense of gratidude and, above all a king, shall I not, without hesitation do what pleases him?

shloka_text: अलीकं मानसं त्वेकं हृदयं दहतीव मे। स्वयं यन्नाह मां राजा भरतस्याभिषेचनम्।।2.19.6।।
transliteration: alīkaṃ mānasaṃ tvekaṃ hṛdayaṃ dahatīva me| svayaṃ yannāha māṃ rājā bharatasyābhiṣecanam
translation: भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् consecration, राजा king, स्वयम् himself, माम् to me, यत् नाह which he did not tell, एकम् that one, मानसम् in my mind, अलीकम् one which hurts, मे my , हृदयम् heart, दहतीव as if burning.
explanation: One thing which hurts me is that the king himself did not tell me about Bharata's consecration. That alone is burning my heart.

shloka_text: अहं हि सीतां राज्यं च प्राणानिष्टान्धनानि च। हृष्टो भ्रात्रे स्वयं दद्यां भरतायाप्रचोदितः।।2.19.7।।
transliteration: ahaṃ hi sītāṃ rājyaṃ ca prāṇāniṣṭāndhanāni ca| hṛṣṭo bhrātre svayaṃ dadyāṃ bharatāyāpracoditaḥ
translation: अहम् I, अप्रचोदितः unurged, हृष्टः pleased, भ्रात्रे to my  brother, भरताय for Bharata, सीताम् Sita, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राणान् life, इष्टान् most coveted, धनानि च wealth also, स्वयम् myself, दद्याम् shall give.
explanation: Unurged, I would have gladly given to Bharata the kingdom, wealth, my most coveted life, and even Sita.

shloka_text: किं पुनर्मनुजेन्द्रेण स्वयं पित्रा प्रचोदितः। तव च प्रियकामार्थं प्रतिज्ञामनुपालयन्।।2.19.8।।
transliteration: kiṃ punarmanujendreṇa svayaṃ pitrā pracoditaḥ| tava ca priyakāmārthaṃ pratijñāmanupālayan
translation: पित्रा by father, मनुजेन्द्रेण by the king, स्वयम् on his own, प्रचोदितः having been ordered, तव your, प्रियकामार्थम् for the sake of (your) pleasure, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, अनुपालयन् to keep up, किं पुन: needless to say.
explanation: In order to keep the promise I shall do everything to fulfil your desire. Needless to say that my father has ordered this.

shloka_text: तदाश्वासय हीमं त्वं किन्विदं यन्महीपतिः। वसुधासक्तनयनो मन्दमश्रूणि मुञ्चति।।2.19.9।।
transliteration: tadāśvāsaya hīmaṃ tvaṃ kinvidaṃ yanmahīpatiḥ| vasudhāsaktanayano mandamaśrūṇi muñcati
translation: तत् further, त्वम् you, इमम् him, आश्वासय console, महीपतिः king, वसुधासक्तनयनः with eyes fixed upon the ground, मन्दम् slowly, अश्रूणि tears, मुञ्चति इति यत् is shedding, इदं this, किं नु why indeed?
explanation: Please console him. Why is it that the king with his eyes fixed upon the ground is shedding tears drop by drop?

shloka_text: गच्छन्तु चैवानयितुं दूताश्श्रीघ्रजवैर्हयैः। भरतं मातुलकुलादद्यैव नृपशासनात्।।2.19.10।।
transliteration: gacchantu caivānayituṃ dūtāśśrīghrajavairhayaiḥ| bharataṃ mātulakulādadyaiva nṛpaśāsanāt
translation: नृपशासनात् by the king's order, मातुलकुलात् from his maternal uncle's house, भरतम् Bharata, आनयितुम् to bring back, दूताः messengers, शीघ्रजवैः speedy, हयैः horses, अद्यैव (today itself) right now, गच्छन्तु let go.
explanation: With the king's orders let messengers go right away on swift horses to fetch Bharata from his maternal uncle's house.

shloka_text: दण्डकारण्यमेषोऽहमितो गच्छामि सत्वरः। अविचार्य पितुर्वाक्यं समा वस्तुं चतुर्दश।।2.19.11।।
transliteration: daṇḍakāraṇyameṣo'hamito gacchāmi satvaraḥ| avicārya piturvākyaṃ samā vastuṃ caturdaśa
translation: एषः अहम् as for me, पितुः father's, वाक्यम् word, अविचार्य without deliberating, सत्वरः at once, चतुर्दश fourteen, समाः years, वस्तुम् to live, इतः from here, दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka  forest, गच्छामि will go.
explanation: As for me, without deliberating on the propriety of my father's orders, I shall go from here at once to Dandaka forest to live (there) for fourteen years.

shloka_text: सा हृष्टा तस्य तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा रामस्य कैकयी। प्रस्थानं श्रद्धधाना हि त्वरयामास राघवम्।।2.19.12।।
transliteration: sā hṛṣṭā tasya tadvākyaṃ śrutvā rāmasya kaikayī| prasthānaṃ śraddhadhānā hi tvarayāmāsa rāghavam
translation: सा कैकयी that Kaikeyi, तस्य रामस्य such Rama's, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हृष्टा happy, प्रस्थानम् departure, श्रद्धधाना believing,  राघवम् to Rama, त्वरयामास hastened (him).
explanation: Kaikeyi, happy to hear the words of the son of the Raghus as she was convinced that his departure (to the forest) was certain, hastened him (to set out).

shloka_text: एवं भवतु यास्यन्ति दूता श्शीघ्रजवैर्हयैः। भरतं मातुलकुलादुपावर्तयितुं नराः।।2.19.13।।
transliteration: evaṃ bhavatu yāsyanti dūtā śśīghrajavairhayaiḥ| bharataṃ mātulakulādupāvartayituṃ narāḥ
translation: एवं भवतु let it happen, मातुलकुलात् from maternal uncle's house, भरतम् to Bharata, उपावर्तयितुम् to bring him back, दूताः messengers, नराः men, शीघ्रजवैः swiftfooted, हयैः by horses, यास्यन्ति will go.
explanation: Let it be so. Messengers shall go at once on swift horses to bring Bharata from his maternal uncle's house.

shloka_text: तव त्वहं क्षमं मन्ये नोत्सुकस्य विलम्बनम्। राम तस्मादित श्शीघ्रं वनं त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि।।2.19.14।।
transliteration: tava tvahaṃ kṣamaṃ manye notsukasya vilambanam| rāma tasmādita śśīghraṃ vanaṃ tvaṃ gantumarhasi
translation: तु but, उत्सुकस्य eager (to go to the forest), तव your, विलंबनम् delay, क्षमम् appropriate,  अहम् I, न मन्ये do not think, राम Rama, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, इतः from here, शीघ्रम् immediately, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to go, अर्हसि behoves you.
explanation: Since you are eager (to go to the forest), I do not think it is proper to delay. O Rama therefore it behoves you to proceed immediately from here to the forest.

shloka_text: व्रीडान्वित स्स्वयं यच्च नृपस्त्वां नाभिभाषते। नैतत्किञ्चिन्नरश्रेष्ठ मन्युरेषोऽपनीयताम्।।2.19.15।।
transliteration: vrīḍānvita ssvayaṃ yacca nṛpastvāṃ nābhibhāṣate| naitatkiñcinnaraśreṣṭha manyureṣo'panīyatām
translation: नरश्रेष्ठ best among men, Rama, व्रीडान्वित: being ashamed, नृपः king, स्वयम् himself, त्वाम्  you, यत् since, नाभिभाषते does not speak, एतत् this one, न किञ्चित् is nothing, एषः this, मन्युः distress, अपनीयताम् you may dispel.
explanation: Out of shame the king is unable to speak to you. There is nothing other than this. O Rama, the best of men, dispel this distress (of mind).

shloka_text: यावत्त्वं न वनं यातः पुरादस्मादभित्वरन्। पिता तावन्न ते राम स्नास्यते भोक्ष्यतेऽपि वा।।2.19.16।।
transliteration: yāvattvaṃ na vanaṃ yātaḥ purādasmādabhitvaran| pitā tāvanna te rāma snāsyate bhokṣyate'pi vā
translation: राम Rama, त्वम् you, अभित्वरन् hastening up, अस्मात् this, पुरात् from this city, यावत् as long as, वनम् to the forest, न यातः do not go, तावत् till then, ते your, पिता father, स्नास्यते will neither bathe, न भोक्ष्यतेपि वा nor will eat.
explanation: O Rama, as long as you do not hasten to leave this city for the forest, your father will neither bathe nor eat.

shloka_text: धिक्कष्टमिति निःश्वस्य राजा शोकपरिप्लुतः। मूर्छितो न्यपतत्तस्मिन्पर्यङ्के हेमभूषिते।।2.19.17।।
transliteration: dhikkaṣṭamiti niḥśvasya rājā śokapariplutaḥ| mūrchito nyapatattasminparyaṅke hemabhūṣite
translation: राजा king, धिक् fie, कष्टम् what a calamity, इति thus, निःश्वस्य sighing, शोकपरिप्लुतः overwhelmed with sorrow, मूर्छितः having fainted, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, तस्मिन् पर्यङ्के on that couch, न्यपतत् fell down.
explanation: 'Fie, what a calamity' sighing thus, the king, overwhelmed with sorrow, fainted and fell back on the golden couch.

shloka_text: रामोऽप्युत्थाप्य राजानं कैकेय्याभिप्रचोदितः। कशयेवाहतो वाजी वनं गन्तुं कृतत्वरः।।2.19.18।।
transliteration: rāmo'pyutthāpya rājānaṃ kaikeyyābhipracoditaḥ| kaśayevāhato vājī vanaṃ gantuṃ kṛtatvaraḥ
translation: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, अभिप्रचोदितः urged, रामोऽपि Rama also, राजानम् the king, उत्थाप्य having lifted, कशया by a whip आहतः flogged, वाजीव like a horse, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to depart, कृतत्वरः hastened
explanation: Rama lifted up the king and, urged by Kaikeyi, hastened to depart for the forest like a horse flogged by a whip.

shloka_text: तदप्रियमनार्याया वचनं दारुणोदयम्। श्रुत्वा गतव्यथो रामः कैकेयीं वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.19.19।।
transliteration: tadapriyamanāryāyā vacanaṃ dāruṇodayam| śrutvā gatavyatho rāmaḥ kaikeyīṃ vākyamabravīt
translation: रामः Rama, अनार्यायाः of that ignoble (lady), दारुणोदयम् of dreadful consequence, अप्रियम् unpleasant, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा having heard, गतव्यथः bereft of pain, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Rama listened to the dreadful, cruel words of the ignoble woman but, without feeling any sorrow, said to Kaikeyi, these words:

shloka_text: नाहमर्थपरो देवि लोकमावस्तुमुत्सहे। विद्धिमामृषिभिस्तुल्यं केवलं धर्ममास्थितम्।।2.19.20।।
transliteration: nāhamarthaparo devi lokamāvastumutsahe| viddhimāmṛṣibhistulyaṃ kevalaṃ dharmamāsthitam
translation: देवि O Devi, अहम् I, अर्थपरः interested in wealth, न not, लोकम् this world, आवस्तुम् to live, उत्सहे am striving, केवलम् only, धर्मम् righteousness, आस्थितम् devoted to, माम् me, ऋषिभिः with ascetics, तुल्यम् similar, विद्धि know.
explanation: O Devi, I have no desire to live in this world for the sake of wealth. Know me as one with the sages who are devoted only to righteousness.

shloka_text: यदत्र भवतः किञ्चिच्छक्यं कर्तुं प्रियं मया। प्राणानपि परित्यज्य सर्वथा कृतमेव तत्।।2.19.21।।
transliteration: yadatra bhavataḥ kiñcicchakyaṃ kartuṃ priyaṃ mayā| prāṇānapi parityajya sarvathā kṛtameva tat
translation: मया by me, अत्र भवतः to the venerable (father), किञ्चित् even a little, यत् प्रियम् which pleases him, कर्तुम् to do, शक्यम् is possible, तत् that one, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्यापि even by giving up, सर्वथा in every way, कृतमेव it is done.
explanation: If I am able to do anything which pleases my venerable father, it shall be done in every possible manner, may be even at the cost of my life.

shloka_text: न ह्यतो धर्मचरणं किञ्चिदस्ति महत्तरम्। यथा पितरिशुश्रूषा तस्य वा वचनक्रिया।।2.19.22।।
transliteration: na hyato dharmacaraṇaṃ kiñcidasti mahattaram| yathā pitariśuśrūṣā tasya vā vacanakriyā
translation: पितरि in respect of one's father, शुश्रूषा service, तस्य his, वचनक्रिया वा or carrying out orders, यथा as, अतः than that, महत्तरं greater, धर्मचरणम् observing righteousness, किञ्चित् anything, नास्ति हि is not there.
explanation: There is no greater observance of righteousness than doing service to one's father or carrying out his orders.

shloka_text: अनुक्तोऽप्यत्रभवता भवत्या वचनादहम्। वने वत्स्यामि विजने वर्षाणीह चतुर्दश।।2.19.23।।
transliteration: anukto'pyatrabhavatā bhavatyā vacanādaham| vane vatsyāmi vijane varṣāṇīha caturdaśa
translation: अहम् I, अत्र भवता by this venerable (father), अनुक्तोपि even without being told, भवत्याः your, वचनात् by your word, इह now, चतुर्दश वर्षाणि fourteen years, विजने solitary, वने in the forest, वत्स्यामि will live.
explanation: Though this has not been said by my respectable father himself, I shall live in the forlorn forest for fourteen years in accordance with your word.

shloka_text: न नूनं मयि कैकयि किञ्चिदाशंससे गुणम्। यद्राजानमवोचस्त्वं ममेश्वरतरा सती।।2.19.24।।
transliteration: na nūnaṃ mayi kaikayi kiñcidāśaṃsase guṇam| yadrājānamavocastvaṃ mameśvaratarā satī
translation: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, त्वम् you, मम in my affair, ईश्वरतरा सती even though capable of exercising greater authority, राजानम् to the king, यत् अवोचः for which you pleaded, मयि in me, किञ्चित् even a little, गुणम् virtue, न आशंससे do not expect, नूनम् this is certain.
explanation: Since in my case you have exercised more authority (than my father) and pleaded with the king, it follows, you, for sure, do not see any virtue in me, O Kaikeyi (Or else, you should not have asked for Bharata's kingship).

shloka_text: यावन्मातरमाप्नच्छे सीतां चानुनयाम्यहम्। ततोऽद्यैव गमिष्यामि दण्डकानां महद्वनम्।।2.19.25।।
transliteration: yāvanmātaramāpnacche sītāṃ cānunayāmyaham| tato'dyaiva gamiṣyāmi daṇḍakānāṃ mahadvanam
translation: मातरम् my mother, यावत् आप्नच्छे until I take leave, सीतां च Sita also, अहम् I, अनुनयामि  console, ततः after that, अद्यैव today itself, महत् great (wild), दण्डकानां वनम् Dandaka forest, गमिष्यामि I shall go.
explanation: After taking leave of my mother and consoling Sita, today itself I shall go to that wild  Dandaka forest.

shloka_text: भरतः पालयेद्राज्यं शुश्रूषेच्च पितुर्यथा। तथा भवत्या कर्तव्यं स हि धर्म स्सनातनः।।2.19.26।।
transliteration: bharataḥ pālayedrājyaṃ śuśrūṣecca pituryathā| tathā bhavatyā kartavyaṃ sa hi dharma ssanātanaḥ
translation: भरतः Bharata,  यथा so that, राज्यम् the kingdom, पालयेत् rules, पितुः for father, शुश्रूषेच्च serves, तथा thus, भवत्या by you, कर्तव्यम् it should be done, सः that, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः हि duty indeed.
explanation: It is your bounden duty to see that Bharata rules the kingdom and serves father.

shloka_text: स रामस्य वचश्श्रृत्वा भृशं दुःखहतः पिता। शोकादशक्नुवन्वकतुं प्ररुरोद महास्वनम्।।2.19.27।।
transliteration: sa rāmasya vacaśśrṛtvā bhṛśaṃ duḥkhahataḥ pitā| śokādaśaknuvanvakatuṃ praruroda mahāsvanam
translation: रामस्य Rama's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, पिता father, सः that (Dasaratha), भृशम् greatly, दुःखहतः hit with grief, शोकात् out of sorrow, वक्तुम् to speak, अशक्नुवन् was not able, महास्वनम् with a loud voice, प्ररुरोद cried.
explanation: Father (Dasaratha), too tormented with grief to speak cried out loudly on hearing the words of Rama.

shloka_text: वन्दित्वा चरणौ रामो विसंज्ञस्य पितुस्तथा। कैकेय्याश्चाप्यनार्यायाः निष्पपात महाद्युतिः।।2.19.28।।
transliteration: vanditvā caraṇau rāmo visaṃjñasya pitustathā| kaikeyyāścāpyanāryāyāḥ niṣpapāta mahādyutiḥ
translation: महाद्युतिः effulgent, रामः Rama, विसंज्ञस्य who had fallen into a swoon, पितुः father's, चरणौ feet, तथा and, अनार्यायाः of the ignoble, कैकेय्याश्चापि those of Kaikeyi, वन्दित्वा bowing down with respect, निष्पपात set out.
explanation: Effulgent Rama  bowed at the feet of his father who had fallen into a swoon. He bowed at the feet of the ignoble Kaikeyi and set out.

shloka_text: स रामः पितरं कृत्वा कैकेयीं च प्रदक्षिणम्। निष्क्रम्यान्तःपुरात्तस्मात्स्वं ददर्श सुहृज्जनम्।।2.19.29।।
transliteration: sa rāmaḥ pitaraṃ kṛtvā kaikeyīṃ ca pradakṣiṇam| niṣkramyāntaḥpurāttasmātsvaṃ dadarśa suhṛjjanam
translation: सः रामः that Rama, पितरम् father, कैकेयीं च also, Kaikeyi, प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा having made circumambulation, तस्मात् from that, अन्तःपुरात् from that harem, निष्क्रम्य after stepping out, स्वम् own, सुहृज्जनम् friends, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hardly had Rama withdrawn from the harem after circumambulating his father and Kaikeyi when he saw his friends .

shloka_text: तं बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्षः पृष्ठतोऽनुजगाम ह। लक्ष्मणः परमक्कृध्दः स्सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः।।2.19.30।।
transliteration: taṃ bāṣpaparipūrṇākṣaḥ pṛṣṭhato'nujagāma ha| lakṣmaṇaḥ paramakkṛdhdaḥ ssumitrānandavardhanaḥ
translation: सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of the delight of Sumitra, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, परमक्कृद्धः furious, बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्षः with eyes full of tears, तम् him, पृष्ठतः behind, अनुजगाम ह followed.
explanation: Lakshmana, the enhancer of Sumitra's delight, with his eyes brimming with tears, followed him in a rage.

shloka_text: अभिषेचनिकं भाण्डं कृत्वा रामः प्रदक्षिणम्। शनैर्जगाम सापेक्षो दृष्टिं तत्राविचालयन्।।2.19.31।।
transliteration: abhiṣecanikaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ kṛtvā rāmaḥ pradakṣiṇam| śanairjagāma sāpekṣo dṛṣṭiṃ tatrāvicālayan
translation: रामः Rama, अभिषेचनिकम् pertaining to consecration, भाण्डम् vessels, प्रदक्षिणम् कृत्वा having  circumambulated, सापेक्षः with attention, तत्र there, दृष्टिम् glance, अविचालयन् without moving, शनैः slowly, जगाम moved away.
explanation: Rama circumambulated the vessels meant for the consecration ceremony and steadily glancing at them with attention slowly moved away.

shloka_text: न चास्य महतीं लक्ष्मीं राज्यनाशोऽपकर्षति। लोककान्तस्य कान्तत्वाच्छीतरश्मेरिव क्षपा।।2.19.32।।
transliteration: na cāsya mahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ rājyanāśo'pakarṣati| lokakāntasya kāntatvācchītaraśmeriva kṣapā
translation: कान्तत्वात् because of his loveliness, लोककान्तस्य of the beloved of the people, अस्य his, महतीम् great, लक्ष्मीम् splendour, शीतरश्मेः of coolrayed (of Moon), क्षपा इव like night, राज्यनाशः loss of kingdom, न अपकर्षति did not diminish.
explanation: Rama was the beloved of the people. Loss of kingdom did not diminish his splendour just like night cannot diminish the splendour of the coolrayed Moon.

shloka_text: न वनं गन्तुकामस्य त्यजतश्च वसुन्धराम्। सर्वलोकातिगस्येव लक्ष्यते चित्तविक्रिया।।2.19.33।।
transliteration: na vanaṃ gantukāmasya tyajataśca vasundharām| sarvalokātigasyeva lakṣyate cittavikriyā
translation: वनम् to the forest, गन्तुकामस्य having determined to go, वसुन्धराम् the earth, त्यजतश्च renouncing, सर्वलोकातिगस्येव who is beyond all worldly affairs, चित्तविक्रिया change of mind, नलक्ष्यते could not to be seen.
explanation: Rama was determined to renounce the kingdom and go to the forest. So none could see any change in his mind. (For) he was one beyond all worldly affairs.

shloka_text: प्रतिषिध्य शुभं छत्रं व्यजने च स्वलङ्कृते। विसर्जयित्वा स्वजनं रथं पौरांस्तथा जनान्।।2.19.34।। धारयन् मनसा दुःखमिन्द्रियाणि निगृह्य च। प्रविवेशात्मवान्वेश्म मातुरप्रियशंसिवान्।2.19.35।।
transliteration: pratiṣidhya śubhaṃ chatraṃ vyajane ca svalaṅkṛte| visarjayitvā svajanaṃ rathaṃ paurāṃstathā janān dhārayan manasā duḥkhamindriyāṇi nigṛhya ca| praviveśātmavānveśma māturapriyaśaṃsivān|2.19.35||
translation: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् umbrella, स्वलङ्कृते welldecorated, व्यजने च also two fans, प्रतिषिध्य preventing, स्वजनम् (his) own kinsmen, रथम् chariot, तथा and, पौरान् citydwellers, जनान् people, विसर्जयित्वा sending forth, मनसा with mind, दुःखम् sorrow, धारयन् holding, इन्द्रियाणि senses, निगृह्य च having controlled, अप्रियशंसिवान् with a view to communicate the unpleasant news, मातुः mother's, वेश्म residence, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: Selfpossessed Rama held back his sorrow within his mind, abandoned the auspicious umbrella, welldecorated fans and chariot, sent away kinsmen, citydwellers and others and entered his mother's residence to break the unpleasant news.

shloka_text: प्रतिषिध्य शुभं छत्रं व्यजने च स्वलङ्कृते। विसर्जयित्वा स्वजनं रथं पौरांस्तथा जनान्।।2.19.34।। धारयन् मनसा दुःखमिन्द्रियाणि निगृह्य च। प्रविवेशात्मवान्वेश्म मातुरप्रियशंसिवान्।2.19.35।।
transliteration: pratiṣidhya śubhaṃ chatraṃ vyajane ca svalaṅkṛte| visarjayitvā svajanaṃ rathaṃ paurāṃstathā janān dhārayan manasā duḥkhamindriyāṇi nigṛhya ca| praviveśātmavānveśma māturapriyaśaṃsivān|2.19.35||
translation: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् umbrella, स्वलङ्कृते welldecorated, व्यजने च also two fans, प्रतिषिध्य preventing, स्वजनम् (his) own kinsmen, रथम् chariot, तथा and, पौरान् citydwellers, जनान् people, विसर्जयित्वा sending forth, मनसा with mind, दुःखम् sorrow, धारयन् holding, इन्द्रियाणि senses, निगृह्य च having controlled, अप्रियशंसिवान् with a view to communicate the unpleasant news, मातुः mother's, वेश्म residence, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: Selfpossessed Rama held back his sorrow within his mind, abandoned the auspicious umbrella, welldecorated fans and chariot, sent away kinsmen, citydwellers and others and entered his mother's residence to break the unpleasant news.

shloka_text: सर्वोह्यभिजनश्श्रीमान् श्रीमतस्सत्यवादिनः। नालक्षयत रामस्य किञ्चिदाकारमानने।।2.19.36।।
transliteration: sarvohyabhijanaśśrīmān śrīmatassatyavādinaḥ| nālakṣayata rāmasya kiñcidākāramānane
translation: श्रीमान् glorious, सर्वः all, अभिजनः people around him, श्रीमतः of the dignified, सत्यवादिनः of the truthful, रामस्य Rama's, आनने in the countenance, किंचित् even a little, आकारम् change, नालक्षयत did not see.
explanation: All the glorious people around him did not observe any change in the countenance of that dignified and truthful Rama.

shloka_text: उचितं च महाबाहुर्नजहौहर्षमात्मनः। शारद स्समुदीर्णांशुश्चन्द्रस्तेज इवात्मजम्।।2.19.37।।
transliteration: ucitaṃ ca mahābāhurnajahauharṣamātmanaḥ| śārada ssamudīrṇāṃśuścandrasteja ivātmajam
translation: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, समुदीर्णांशुः with profuse radiance, शारदः autumnal, चन्द्र: the Moon, आत्मजम् his own, तेज इव like brightness, आत्मनः his own, उचितम् fitting, हर्षम् cheer, न जहौ did not leave.
explanation: The mightyarmed (Rama) did not leave his habitual cheerfulness like the autumnal Moon his own brightness.

shloka_text: वाचा मधुरया रामस्सर्वं सम्मानयञ्जनम्। मातुस्समीपं धीरात्मा प्रविवेश महायशाः।।2.19.38।।
transliteration: vācā madhurayā rāmassarvaṃ sammānayañjanam| mātussamīpaṃ dhīrātmā praviveśa mahāyaśāḥ
translation: धीरात्मा firmminded, महायशाः illustrious, रामः Rama, मधुरया वाचा in sweet words, जनम् people, सम्मानयन् honouring, मातुः mother's, समीपम् presence, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: Firmminded and illustrious Rama treated all people with sweet words and approached his mother.

shloka_text: तं गुणैस्समतां प्राप्तो भ्राता विपुलविक्रमः। सौमित्रिरनुवव्राज धारयन्दुःखमात्मजम्।।2.19.39।।
transliteration: taṃ guṇaissamatāṃ prāpto bhrātā vipulavikramaḥ| saumitriranuvavrāja dhārayanduḥkhamātmajam
translation: गुणैः in virtues, समतां equality, प्राप्तः obtained, विपुलविक्रमः with great power, भ्राता brother, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, आत्मजम् born in his mind, दुःखम् sorrow, धारयन् controlling, तम् him, अनुवव्राज followed.
explanation: Mighty Lakshmana as virtuous as his brother held the sorrow in his mind and followed him.

shloka_text: प्रविश्य वेश्मातिभृशं मुदाऽन्वितं समीक्ष्य तां चार्थविपत्तिमागताम्। न चैव रामोऽत्रजगामविक्रियां सुहृज्जनस्यात्मविपत्तिशङ्कया।।2.19.40।।
transliteration: praviśya veśmātibhṛśaṃ mudā'nvitaṃ samīkṣya tāṃ cārthavipattimāgatām| na caiva rāmo'trajagāmavikriyāṃ suhṛjjanasyātmavipattiśaṅkayā
translation: रामः Rama, अतिभृशम् very great, मुदा rejoicing, अन्वितम् filled with, प्रविश्य having entered, वेश्म palace, आगताम् arrived, ताम he, अर्थविपत्तिम् obstruction to the objective, समीक्ष्य having seen, अत्र there, सुहृज्जनस्य for his friends, आत्मविपत्तिशङ्कया with the fear that they will be distressed, विक्रियाम् change, न चैव जगाम did not obtain.
explanation: Rama entered  the palace which was full of great rejoicing. He did not disclose the obstruction that had come on the way of achieving his objective for fear of causing distress to his friends. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तु पुरुषव्याघ्रे निष्क्रामति कृताञ्जलौ। आर्तशब्दो महान् जज्ञे स्त्रीणामन्तःपुरे तदा।।2.20.1।।
transliteration: tasmiṃstu puruṣavyāghre niṣkrāmati kṛtāñjalau| ārtaśabdo mahān jajñe strīṇāmantaḥpure tadā
translation: तदा then, पुरुषव्याघ्रे tiger among men, तस्मिन् that Rama, कृताज्ञलौ with folded palms, निष्क्रामति while (he was) leaving, अन्तःपुरे in the inner apartment, स्त्रीणाम् women's, महान् great, आर्तशब्दः cries of distress, जज्ञे arose.
explanation: When the tiger among men (Rama) was coming out with folded palms, there arose a huge cry of distress among the ladies of the harem:
comments: Rama enters to the inner apartment of his mother Kausalya--informs her of his exile to the forest--lamentations of Kausalya.

shloka_text: कृत्येष्वचोदितः पित्रा सर्वस्यान्तःपुरस्य च। गतिर्यश्शरणं चापि स रामोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति।।2.20.2।।
transliteration: kṛtyeṣvacoditaḥ pitrā sarvasyāntaḥpurasya ca| gatiryaśśaraṇaṃ cāpi sa rāmo'dya pravatsyati
translation: यः who (Rama), पित्रा by father, कृत्येषु in his duty, अचोदितः without being urged, सर्वस्य entire, अन्तः पुरस्य for the inner apartment, गतिः refuge, शरणं च (आसीत्) was protector, सः रामः that Rama, अद्य now, प्रवत्स्यति is now going on exile.
explanation: Rama was the refuge and protector of all the inmates lot of the inner apartment although it was not his duty nor was he forced by his father to safeguard them. That Rama is now going on exile.

shloka_text: कौशल्यायां यथा युक्तो जनन्यां वर्तते सदा। तथैव वर्ततेऽस्मासु जन्मप्रभृति राघवः।।2.20.3।।
transliteration: kauśalyāyāṃ yathā yukto jananyāṃ vartate sadā| tathaiva vartate'smāsu janmaprabhṛti rāghavaḥ
translation: जन्मप्रभृति right from birth, राघवः Rama, जनन्याम् with regard to his mother, कौशल्यायाम् in Kausalya, सदा always, युक्तः devoted, यथा how, वर्तते is conducting himself, अस्मासु in all of us, तथैव in the same way, वर्तते is conducting.
explanation: Rama conducted himself towards us in the same way as he did towards his mother Kausalya right from the begining.

shloka_text: न क्रुध्यत्यभिशप्तोऽपि क्रोधनीयानि वर्जयन्। क्रुद्धान्प्रसादयन्सर्वान् स इतोऽद्य प्रवत्स्यति।।2.20.4।।
transliteration: na krudhyatyabhiśapto'pi krodhanīyāni varjayan| kruddhānprasādayansarvān sa ito'dya pravatsyati
translation: क्रोधनीयानि deeds that cause anger, वर्जयन् avoiding, क्रुद्धान् सर्वान् all cholerictempered persons, प्रसादयन् pacifying them, अभिशप्तोऽपि even cursed, न क्रुध्यति does not get angry, सः such Rama, अद्य today, इतः from here, प्रवत्स्यति is going on exile.
explanation: Rama who used to avoid deeds that caused anger, pacified those who were angry with him, and never lost his cool even when cursed, that Rama is going on exile today.

shloka_text: अबुद्धिर्बत नो राजा जीवलोकं चरत्ययम्। यो गतिं सर्वभूतानां परित्यजति राघवम्।।.2.20.5।।
transliteration: abuddhirbata no rājā jīvalokaṃ caratyayam| yo gatiṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ parityajati rāghavam||.2.20.5||
translation: बत alas यः who (Dasaratha), सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, गतिम् who is the refuge, राघवम् to the son of the Raghus (Rama), परित्यजति is abandoning, अयम् this, नः राजा our king, अबुद्धि: devoid of intellect, जीवलोकम् in the world of living beings, चरति moving.
explanation: Alas our king who has lost his brain, who has ordered the banishment of Rama, the refuge of all living beings, (on the other hand) is moving about in the world.

shloka_text: इति सर्वा महिष्यस्ता विवत्सा इव धेनवः। पतिमाचुक्रुशुश्चैव सस्वरं चापि चुक्रुशुः।।2.20.6।।
transliteration: iti sarvā mahiṣyastā vivatsā iva dhenavaḥ| patimācukruśuścaiva sasvaraṃ cāpi cukruśuḥ
translation: इति thus, सर्वाः all, ताः महिष्यः the king's wives, विवत्साः calfless, धेनवः इव like cows, सस्वरम् loudly, चुक्रुशुः च अपि cried and also, पतिम् husband, अचुक्रुशुश्च एव blamed also.
explanation: Thus all the queens like calfless cows cried loudly blaming their husband.

shloka_text: स हि चान्तःपुरे घोरमार्तशब्दं महीपतिः। पुत्रशोकाभिसन्तप्तः श्रुत्वा व्यालीयताऽसने।।2.20.7।।
transliteration: sa hi cāntaḥpure ghoramārtaśabdaṃ mahīpatiḥ| putraśokābhisantaptaḥ śrutvā vyālīyatā'sane
translation: सः महीपतिः that lord of the earth (king), अन्तःपुरे in the harem, घोरम् painful, आर्तशब्दम् cries of distress, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुत्र शोकाभिसन्तप्तः tormented with grief on account of his son, आसने in his seat, व्यालीयत sank down.
explanation: Tormented with grief on account of his son, the king sank in his seat on hearing the cries of distress from the inner apartment

shloka_text: रामस्तु भृशमायस्तो निश्श्वसन्निव कुञ्जरः। जगाम सहितो भ्रात्रा मातुरन्तःपुरं वशी।।2.20.8।।
transliteration: rāmastu bhṛśamāyasto niśśvasanniva kuñjaraḥ| jagāma sahito bhrātrā māturantaḥpuraṃ vaśī
translation: वशी having selfcontrol, रामस्तु Rama however, भृशम् highly, आयस्तः troubled, कुञ्जरः इव like an elephant, निःश्वसन् heaving sighs, भ्रात्रा brother, सहितः together with, मातुः mother's, अन्तःपुरम् towards inner apartment, जगाम went.
explanation: Deeply pained yet selfpossessed Rama, heaving sighs like an elephant went towards the inner apartment of his mother along with his brother.

shloka_text: सोऽपश्यत्पुरुषं तत्र वृद्धं परमपूजितम्। उपविष्टं गृहद्वारि तिष्ठतश्चापरान्बहून्।।2.20.9।।
transliteration: so'paśyatpuruṣaṃ tatra vṛddhaṃ paramapūjitam| upaviṣṭaṃ gṛhadvāri tiṣṭhataścāparānbahūn
translation: सः he, तत्र there, गृहद्वारि at the entrance of the residence, उपविष्टम् seated, परमपूजितम् highly venerable, वृद्धं पुरुषम् aged man, तिष्ठतः standing, बहून् many, अपरांश्च others, अपश्यत् beheld.
explanation: Rama beheld a highly venerable elderly man seated at the entrance of the residence and many others standing (nearby).

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वैव तु तदा रामं ते सर्वे सहसोत्थिताः। जयेन जयतां श्रेष्ठं वर्धयन्ति स्म राघवम्।।2.20.10।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaiva tu tadā rāmaṃ te sarve sahasotthitāḥ| jayena jayatāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ vardhayanti sma rāghavam
translation: तदा then, रामम् Rama, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, ते सर्वे all of them, सहसा immediately, उत्थिताः stood up, जयताम् among victors, श्रेष्ठम् best, राघवम् to the scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama), जयेन with victory, वर्धयन्ति स्म caused prosperity.
explanation: On seeing Rama, all the eminent among the victors got up immediately and greeted him, saying, 'Victory to you'.

shloka_text: प्रविश्य प्रथमां कक्ष्यां द्वितीयायां ददर्श सः। ब्राह्मणान्वेदसम्पन्नान्वृद्धान्राज्ञाऽभिसत्कृतान्।।2.20.11।।
transliteration: praviśya prathamāṃ kakṣyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ dadarśa saḥ| brāhmaṇānvedasampannānvṛddhānrājñā'bhisatkṛtān
translation: सः he (Rama), प्रथमां कक्ष्याम् first courtyard, प्रविश्य having entered, द्वितीयायाम् in the second courtyard, वेदसम्पन्नान् learned in the Vedas, राज्ञा by the king, अभिसत्कृतान् wellhonoured, वृद्धान् aged, ब्राह्मणान् brahmins, ददर्श saw.
explanation: With the first courtyard crossed, Rama saw in the second aged brahmins versed in the Vedas, and duly honoured by the king.

shloka_text: प्रणम्य रामस्तान्विप्रांस्तृतीयायां ददर्श सः। स्त्रियो वृद्धास्तथा बाला द्वाररक्षणतत्पराः।।2.20.12।।
transliteration: praṇamya rāmastānviprāṃstṛtīyāyāṃ dadarśa saḥ| striyo vṛddhāstathā bālā dvārarakṣaṇatatparāḥ
translation: सः राम that Rama, तान् विप्रान् those brahmins, प्रणम्य having paid obeisance, तृतीयायाम् in the third courtyard, द्वाररक्षणतत्पराः vigilantly guarding the door, स्त्रियः women, वृद्धा: the old, तथा as also, बालाः young children, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Rama wished the brahmins and saw old men, women and children vigilantly guarding the door in the third courtyard.

shloka_text: वर्धयित्वा प्रहृष्टास्ताः प्रविश्य च गृहं स्त्रियः। न्यवेदयन्त त्वरिता राममातुः प्रियं तदा।।2.20.13।।
transliteration: vardhayitvā prahṛṣṭāstāḥ praviśya ca gṛhaṃ striyaḥ| nyavedayanta tvaritā rāmamātuḥ priyaṃ tadā
translation: तदा then, ताः those, स्त्रियः women, प्रहृष्टाः were very pleased, वर्धयित्वा greeting him with   words wishing prosperity, त्वरिताः in great haste, गृहम् in the apartment, प्रविश्य having entered, राममातुः Rama's mother, (Kausalya), प्रियम् pleasant (tidings), न्यवेदयन्त informed.
explanation: Wellpleased, the women then greeted him wishing prosperity. They hurried into the abode of Kausalya and gave her the happy news (of Rama's arrival).

shloka_text: कौशल्यापि तदा देवी रात्रिं स्थित्वा समाहिता। प्रभाते त्वकरोत्पूजां विष्णोः पुत्रहितैषिणी।।2.20.14।।
transliteration: kauśalyāpi tadā devī rātriṃ sthitvā samāhitā| prabhāte tvakarotpūjāṃ viṣṇoḥ putrahitaiṣiṇī
translation: तदा then, कौशल्या Kausalya, रात्रिम् night, समाहिता with composed mind, स्थित्वा remaining (in meditation), प्रभाते in the early morning, पुत्रहितैषिणी to secure her son's welfare, विष्णोः Visnu's, पूजाम् worship, अकरोत् performed.
explanation: Having spent the night with a composed mind (abosorbed in meditation), Kausalya was worshipping lord Visnu in the early morning to secure her son's welfare.

shloka_text: सा क्षौमवसना हृष्टा नित्यं व्रतपरायणा। अग्निं जुहोति स्म तदा मन्त्रवत्कृतमङ्गला।।2.20.15।।
transliteration: sā kṣaumavasanā hṛṣṭā nityaṃ vrataparāyaṇā| agniṃ juhoti sma tadā mantravatkṛtamaṅgalā
translation: नित्यम् always, व्रतपरायणा devoted to performing vows, सा she, क्षौमवसना clad in silk cloth, हृष्टा in delight, कृतमङ्गला having performed the rituals of auspiciousness, मन्त्रवत् in accordance with mantras, अग्निं fire, जुहोति स्म offered oblations.
explanation: Always engaged in the observance of vows, Kausalya (then) clad in silk cloth was performing rituals of auspiciousness, offering oblations to the firegod in accordance with mantras (Vedic hymns).

shloka_text: प्रविश्य च तदा रामो मातुरन्त:पुरं शुभम्। ददर्श मातरं तत्र हावयन्तीं हुताशनम्।।2.20.16।।
transliteration: praviśya ca tadā rāmo māturanta:puraṃ śubham| dadarśa mātaraṃ tatra hāvayantīṃ hutāśanam
translation: तदा then, रामः Rama, शुभम् auspicious, मातु: अन्तःपुरम् inner apartment of his mother, प्रविश्य having entered, तत्र there, हुताशनम् to Agni, हावयन्तीम् exhorting the priests to offer sacrificial oblations, मातरम् to mother, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Rama entered the auspicious inner apartment of his mother and saw her exhorting the priests to offer sacrificial oblations to Agni (firegod).

shloka_text: देवकार्यनिमित्तं च तत्रापश्यत्समुद्यतम्। दध्यक्षतं घृतं चैव मोदकान्हविषस्तथा।।2.20.17।। लाजान्माल्यानि शुक्लानि पायसं कृसरं तथा। समिध: पूर्णकुम्भांश्च ददर्श रघुनन्दनः।।2.20.18।।
transliteration: devakāryanimittaṃ ca tatrāpaśyatsamudyatam| dadhyakṣataṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva modakānhaviṣastathā lājānmālyāni śuklāni pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ tathā| samidha: pūrṇakumbhāṃśca dadarśa raghunandanaḥ
translation: रघुनन्दनः scion of the Raghus or delight of the Raghu race (Rama), तत्र there, देवकार्यनिमित्तम् on account of religious acts, समुद्यतम् (things) kept ready, अपश्यत् saw, दध्यक्षतम् curd, grains of rice (smeared with turmeric), घृतं चैव also clarified butter, मोदकान् sweetmeats, तथा as also, हविषः oblations, लाजान् parched grain, शुक्लानि white, माल्यानि garlands of flowers, पायसम् porridge, कृसरम् sesame seeds mixed with cooked rice, समिधः sacrirficial faggots, पूर्णकुम्भान् vessels filled with water, ददर्श saw.
explanation: There Rama saw  curd, grains of rice, clarified butter, sweetmeats, oblations, parched grain, white garlands, porridge of cooked rice mixed with sesame seeds, sacrirficial faggots, vessels filled with water, etc. kept ready for religious rites.

shloka_text: देवकार्यनिमित्तं च तत्रापश्यत्समुद्यतम्। दध्यक्षतं घृतं चैव मोदकान्हविषस्तथा।।2.20.17।। लाजान्माल्यानि शुक्लानि पायसं कृसरं तथा। समिध: पूर्णकुम्भांश्च ददर्श रघुनन्दनः।।2.20.18।।
transliteration: devakāryanimittaṃ ca tatrāpaśyatsamudyatam| dadhyakṣataṃ ghṛtaṃ caiva modakānhaviṣastathā lājānmālyāni śuklāni pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ tathā| samidha: pūrṇakumbhāṃśca dadarśa raghunandanaḥ
translation: रघुनन्दनः scion of the Raghus or delight of the Raghu race (Rama), तत्र there, देवकार्यनिमित्तम् on account of religious acts, समुद्यतम् (things) kept ready, अपश्यत् saw, दध्यक्षतम् curd, grains of rice (smeared with turmeric), घृतं चैव also clarified butter, मोदकान् sweetmeats, तथा as also, हविषः oblations, लाजान् parched grain, शुक्लानि white, माल्यानि garlands of flowers, पायसम् porridge, कृसरम् sesame seeds mixed with cooked rice, समिधः sacrirficial faggots, पूर्णकुम्भान् vessels filled with water, ददर्श saw.
explanation: There Rama saw  curd, grains of rice, clarified butter, sweetmeats, oblations, parched grain, white garlands, porridge of cooked rice mixed with sesame seeds, sacrirficial faggots, vessels filled with water, etc. kept ready for religious rites.

shloka_text: तां शुक्लक्षौमसंवीतां व्रतयोगेन कर्शिताम्। तर्पयन्तीं ददर्शाद्भिर्देवतां देववर्णिनीम्।।2.20.19।।
transliteration: tāṃ śuklakṣaumasaṃvītāṃ vratayogena karśitām| tarpayantīṃ dadarśādbhirdevatāṃ devavarṇinīm
translation: शुक्लक्षौमसंवीताम् wearing white silk, व्रतयोगेन due to observance of vows, कर्शिताम् emaciated, देववर्णिनीम् having divine complexion, अद्भिः with water, देवताम् to deities, तर्पयन्तीम् engaged in propitiating, ताम् her (Kausalya), ददर्श beheld.
explanation: Kausalya, emaciated due to observance of vows and clad in white silk looked like a celestial being. She was engaged in offering libations to the deities.

shloka_text: सा चिरस्यात्मजं दृष्ट्वा मातृनन्दनमागतम्। अभिचक्राम संहृष्टा किशोरं बडबा यथा।।2.20.20।।
transliteration: sā cirasyātmajaṃ dṛṣṭvā mātṛnandanamāgatam| abhicakrāma saṃhṛṣṭā kiśoraṃ baḍabā yathā
translation: सा she, चिरस्य after a long time, आगतम् arrived, मातृनन्दनम् delight to mother, आत्मजम् her son, दृष्ट्वा having seen, संहृष्टा in great delight, बडबा mare, किशोरं यथा like its offspring, अभिचक्राम went towards him.
explanation: Seeing her son who had come after a long time and who is a source of joy to his mother, Kausalya approached him with great delight like a mare to her young calf.

shloka_text: स मातरमभिक्रान्तामुपसंगृह्य राघवः। परिष्वक्तश्च बाहुभ्यामुपाघ्रातश्च मूर्धनि।।2.20.21।।
transliteration: sa mātaramabhikrāntāmupasaṃgṛhya rāghavaḥ| pariṣvaktaśca bāhubhyāmupāghrātaśca mūrdhani
translation: सः राघवः that scion of the Raghus (Rama), अभिक्रान्ताम् who had come to him, मातरम् mother, उपसंगृह्य with respectful salutations, बाहुभ्याम् with both arms, परिष्वक्तः was embraced, मूर्धनि on his forehead, उपाघ्रातश्च was kissed.
explanation: The scion of the Raghus saw his mother coming and bowed her. She held him in both her arms and kissed his forehead.

shloka_text: तमुवाच दुराधर्षं राघवं सुतमात्मनः। कौशल्या पुत्रवात्सल्यादिदं प्रियहितं वचः।।2.20.22।।
transliteration: tamuvāca durādharṣaṃ rāghavaṃ sutamātmanaḥ| kauśalyā putravātsalyādidaṃ priyahitaṃ vacaḥ
translation: कौशल्या Kausalya, दुराधर्षम् invincible, आत्मनः her own, सुतम् son, तं राघवम् that Rama, पुत्रवात्सल्यात् out of filial affection, प्रियहितम् pleasant and beneficial, इदम् these, वचः words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Out of love for her son, the invincible scion of the Raghu dynasty, Kausalya spoke with gentle and pleasant words:

shloka_text: वृद्धानां धर्मशीलानां राजर्षीणां महात्मनाम्। प्राप्नुह्यायुश्च कीर्तिं च धर्मं चोपहितं कुले।।2.20.23।।
transliteration: vṛddhānāṃ dharmaśīlānāṃ rājarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām| prāpnuhyāyuśca kīrtiṃ ca dharmaṃ copahitaṃ kule
translation: वृद्धानाम् of the aged, धर्मशीलानाम् of the virtuous, महात्मनाम् great, राजर्षीणाम् of the rajarsis, आयुश्च long life, कीर्तिं च fame, कुले in the race, उपहितम् maintained over a long time, धर्मं च righteousness, प्राप्नु हि you may attain.
explanation: May you attain long life and fame like those of the aged, virtuous and great rajarsis  who upheld the righteousness in the race.

shloka_text: सत्यप्रतिज्ञं पितरं राजानं पश्य राघव। अद्यैव हि त्वां धर्मात्मा यौवराज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यति।।2.20.24।।
transliteration: satyapratijñaṃ pitaraṃ rājānaṃ paśya rāghava| adyaiva hi tvāṃ dharmātmā yauvarājye'bhiṣekṣyati
translation: राघव scion of the Raghu dynasty (Rama), सत्यप्रतिज्ञम् true to his promise, पितरम् your father, राजानम् king, पश्य see, धर्मात्मा righteous one, त्वाम् you, अद्यैव today, यौवराज्ये as heirapparent, अभिषेक्ष्यति will coronate you.
explanation: O scion of the Raghu race see the king, your righteous and truthful father, who will consecrate you as princeregent today itself.

shloka_text: दत्तमासनमालभ्य भोजनेन निमन्त्रितः। मातरं राघवः किञ्चिद्व्रीडात्प्रसार्याञ्जलिमब्रवीत्।।2.20.25।।
transliteration: dattamāsanamālabhya bhojanena nimantritaḥ| mātaraṃ rāghavaḥ kiñcidvrīḍātprasāryāñjalimabravīt
translation: भोजनेन with food, निमन्त्रितः a man invited, राघवः Rama, दत्तम् provided, आसनम् seat, आलभ्य having touched, व्रोडात् out of shame, किञ्चित् a little, अञ्जलिम् with folded hands, प्रसार्य having stretched, मातरम् to mother, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Invited (by Kausalya) to partake the food, Rama out of abashment only touched the seat provided to him and having stretched his folded palms spoke to his mother.

shloka_text: स स्वभावविनीतश्च गौरवाच्च तदा नतः। प्रस्थितो दण्डकारण्यमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे।।2.20.26।।
transliteration: sa svabhāvavinītaśca gauravācca tadā nataḥ| prasthito daṇḍakāraṇyamāpraṣṭumupacakrame
translation: स्वभावविनीतश्च by nature modest, तदा then, गौरवात् out of reverence (for his mother), नतः च humble also, सः he, दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka forest, प्रस्थितः for his departure, अप्रष्टुम् to seek her permission, उपचक्रमे commenced.
explanation: Modest by nature, Rama with respectful humility began seeking her permission for his departure to Dandaka forest:

shloka_text: देवि नूनं न जानीषे महद्भयमुपस्थितम्। इदं तव च दुःखाय वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणस्य च।।2.20.27।।
transliteration: devi nūnaṃ na jānīṣe mahadbhayamupasthitam| idaṃ tava ca duḥkhāya vaidehyā lakṣmaṇasya ca
translation: देवि O Devi, नूनम् certainly, उपस्थितम् has befallen, महत् great, भयम् misfortune, न जानीषे you do not know, इदम् this one, तव च to you, वैदेह्याः of Sita, लक्ष्मणस्य च of Lakshmana also, दुःखाय for distress.
explanation: O mother surely you do not know that a great misfortune has befallen, causing distress to you, Sita and Lakshmana, too.

shloka_text: गमिष्ये दण्डकारण्यं किमनेनासनेन मे। विष्टरासनयोग्यो हि कालोऽयं मामुपस्थितः।।2.20.28।।
transliteration: gamiṣye daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ kimanenāsanena me| viṣṭarāsanayogyo hi kālo'yaṃ māmupasthitaḥ
translation: दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka forest, गमिष्ये setting forth, मे for me, अनेन आसनेन with this seat, किम् what is the purpose, विष्टरासनयोग्यः worthy of a mat made of kusa grass, अयम् this, कालः time, मम for me, उपस्थितः has come.
explanation: I am setting forth to Dandaka forest.  What is this seat for? A time has come for me when I am fit for a seat of kusa grass.

shloka_text: चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने। मधुमूलफलैर्जीवन्हित्वा मुनिवदामिषम्।।2.20.29।।
transliteration: caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane| madhumūlaphalairjīvanhitvā munivadāmiṣam
translation: अमिषम् all meat, हित्वा abstaining, मुनिवत् like a hermit, मधुमूलफलैः honey, fruits and roots, जीवन् while living on, चतुर्दश fourteen, वर्षाणि years, विजने in a solitary, वने in the forest, वत्स्यामि am to dwell.
explanation: Abstaining from eating meat like hermits and living on honey, fruits and roots, I am to live in the solitary forest for fourteen years.

shloka_text: भरताय महाराजो यौवराज्यं प्रयच्छति। मां पुनर्दण्डकारण्ये विवासयति तापसम्।।2.20.30।।
transliteration: bharatāya mahārājo yauvarājyaṃ prayacchati| māṃ punardaṇḍakāraṇye vivāsayati tāpasam
translation: महाराजः great king, भरताय to Bharata, यौवराज्यम् status of heirapparent, प्रयच्छति is conferring, मां पुनः for me again, तापसम् like an ascetic, दण्डकारण्ये in Dandaka forest, विवासयति  sending in exile.
explanation: The great king is conferring the status of heirapparent on Bharata while he is banishing me to Dandaka forest to live like an ascetic.

shloka_text: स षट्चाष्टौ च वर्षाणि वत्स्यामि विजने वने। आसेवमानो वन्यानि फलमूलैश्च वर्तयन्।।2.20.31।।
transliteration: sa ṣaṭcāṣṭau ca varṣāṇi vatsyāmi vijane vane| āsevamāno vanyāni phalamūlaiśca vartayan
translation: सः that (I am), वन्यानि forest products, आसेवमानः eating, फलमूलैः fruits and roots, वर्तयन् while living, षट्चाष्टौ च six and eight (fourteen), वर्षाणि years, विजने वने in the desolate forest, वत्स्यामि shall dwell.
explanation: Living on things available in the forest, on fruits and roots, I am to dwell in the uninhabited jungle for fourteen years.

shloka_text: सा निकृत्तेव सालस्य यष्टिः परशुना वने। पपात सहसा देवी देवतेव दिवश्च्युता।।2.20.32।।
transliteration: sā nikṛtteva sālasya yaṣṭiḥ paraśunā vane| papāta sahasā devī devateva divaścyutā
translation: सा देवी that Kausalya, परशुना with an axe, वने in the forest, निकृत्ता severed, सालस्य sal tree's, यष्टिः इव like a stick (branch), दिवः from heaven, च्युता fallen down, देवतेव like a celestial, सहसा suddenly, पपात fell down.
explanation: All on a sidden Kausalya fell down on the ground like the branch of a sal tree in the forest severed by an axe, like a goddess dropped from heaven.

shloka_text: तामदुःखोचितां दृष्ट्वा पतितां कदलीमिव। रामस्तूत्थापयामास मातरं गतचेतसम्।।2.20.33।।
transliteration: tāmaduḥkhocitāṃ dṛṣṭvā patitāṃ kadalīmiva| rāmastūtthāpayāmāsa mātaraṃ gatacetasam
translation: अदुःखोचिताम् who does not deserve sorrow, पतिताम् fallen on the ground, कदलीमिव like a plantain tree, गतचेतसम् deprived of her senses, तां मातरम् to that mother, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रामः Rama, उत्थापयामास lifted her up.
explanation: Seeing his mother who had done nothing to deserve (this) suffering and who had fallen down like a plantain tree, deprived of her senses, Rama raised her up (from the ground).

shloka_text: उपावृत्त्योत्थितां दीनां बडबामिव वाहिताम्। पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीं विममर्श च पाणिना।।2.20.34।।
transliteration: upāvṛttyotthitāṃ dīnāṃ baḍabāmiva vāhitām| pāṃsukuṇṭhitasarvāṅgīṃ vimamarśa ca pāṇinā
translation: उपावृत्त्य rolled on the ground, उत्थिताम् arisen, वाहिताम् for drawing (heavy burden), बडबामिव like a mare, दीनाम् miserable, पांसुकुण्ठितसर्वाङ्गीम् all her body covered with dust, पाणिना  with the hand, विममर्श caressed (wiped away).
explanation: Rama gently wiped away the dust that had covered her body as Kausalya stood miserable, like a mare who stands up after having rolled on the ground while pulling the load.

shloka_text: सा राघवमुपासीनमसुखार्ता सुखोचिता। उवाच पुरुषव्याघ्रमुपशृण्वति लक्ष्मणे।।2.20.35।।
transliteration: sā rāghavamupāsīnamasukhārtā sukhocitā| uvāca puruṣavyāghramupaśṛṇvati lakṣmaṇe
translation: असुखार्ता struck by lack of happiness, सुखोचिता deserving happiness, सा she Kausalya, लक्ष्मणे in Lakshmana, उपशृण्वति while listening, उपासीनम् sitting nearby, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् to the tiger (the best) among men, राघवम् to Rama, उवाच said.
explanation: Kausalya who deserved happiness yet was struck down by (this) distress spoke to Rama, the tiger among men who was sitting nearby, while Lakshmana was listening.

shloka_text: यदि पुत्र न जायेथा मम शोकाय राघव। न स्म दुःखमतो भूयः पश्येयमहमप्रजाः।।2.20.36।।
transliteration: yadi putra na jāyethā mama śokāya rāghava| na sma duḥkhamato bhūyaḥ paśyeyamahamaprajāḥ
translation: पुत्र O my son, राघव Rama, मम to me, शोकाय to cause sorrow, न जायेथाः यदि if you were not born, अहम् I, अप्रजाः without progeny, अतः more than this, भूयः greater, दुःखम् sorrow, न स्म पश्येयम् would not have seen.
explanation: O my son, if you were not born to me, I, even as a woman without  progeny, would not have experienced grief, more intense than this.

shloka_text: एक एव हि वन्ध्याया श्शोको भवति मानसः। अप्रजाऽस्मीति सन्तापो न ह्यन्यः पुत्र विद्यते।।2.20.37।।
transliteration: eka eva hi vandhyāyā śśoko bhavati mānasaḥ| aprajā'smīti santāpo na hyanyaḥ putra vidyate
translation: पुत्र O my son, वन्ध्यायाः for a barren woman, अप्रजाः issueless, अस्मि I am, इति thus, मानसः in mind, एकः one, शोकः affliction, भवति हि surely happens, अन्यः any other, सन्तापः sorrow, न विद्यते हि does not exist.
explanation: O my son a barren woman has only one mental agony that she has no progeny.  Except that she does not have any other sorrow.

shloka_text: न दृष्टपूर्वं कल्याणं सुखं वा पतिपौरुषे। अपि पुत्रे ऽपि पश्येयमिति रामाऽस्थितं मया।।2.20.38।।
transliteration: na dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ kalyāṇaṃ sukhaṃ vā patipauruṣe| api putre 'pi paśyeyamiti rāmā'sthitaṃ mayā
translation: राम O Rama, पतिपौरुषे when my husband was exercising authority, कल्याणम् auspicious moment, सुखं वा or pleasure, न दृष्टपूर्वम् was not seen earlier, पुत्रेऽपि in son, पश्येयम् can I see, इति thus, मया by me, आस्थितम् life is sustained.
explanation: I did not have the fortune, O Rama, to enjoy any auspicious moment or pleasure earlier when my husband was in authority. I exist with the hope that I will have it when my son assumes authority.

shloka_text: सा बहून्यमनोज्ञानि वाक्यानि हृदयच्छिदाम्। अहं श्रोष्ये सपत्नीनामवराणां वरा सती।।2.20.39।।
transliteration: sā bahūnyamanojñāni vākyāni hṛdayacchidām| ahaṃ śroṣye sapatnīnāmavarāṇāṃ varā satī
translation: सा अहम् such am I वरा सती being the eldest (of the queens), अवराणाम् by the younger ones, हृदयच्छिदाम् heartbreaking, सपत्नीनाम् cowives, अमनोज्ञानि unpleasant, बहूनि many, वाक्यानि words, श्रोष्ये will have to listen.
explanation: I, being the eldest (of the queens) will have to listen to many heartbreaking and unpleasant words from my fellowwives who are younger to me.

shloka_text: अतो दुःखतरं किं नु प्रमदानां भविष्यति। मम शोको विलापश्च यादृशोऽयमनन्तकः।।2.20.40।।
transliteration: ato duḥkhataraṃ kiṃ nu pramadānāṃ bhaviṣyati| mama śoko vilāpaśca yādṛśo'yamanantakaḥ
translation: मम to me, अनन्तकः unending, यादृश: शोकः such sorrow, विलापश्च lamentation, अतः now, प्रमदानाम् for women, दुःखतरम् more distress, किं नु भविष्यति  what else can be there?
explanation: There cannnot be greater distress for any woman than such unending grief and lamentation (which I am now experiencing).

shloka_text: त्वयि सन्निहितेऽप्येवमहमासं निराकृता। किं पुनः प्रोषिते तात ध्रुवं मरणमेव मे।।2.20.41।।
transliteration: tvayi sannihite'pyevamahamāsaṃ nirākṛtā| kiṃ punaḥ proṣite tāta dhruvaṃ maraṇameva me
translation: तात O child, त्वयि you, सन्निहितेऽपि even when you are nearby, अहम् I, एवम् in this way, निराकृता आसम् I am rejected, प्रोषिते when you are banished, किं पुनः what to say again, मे  for me, मरणम् death, ध्रुवम् is certain.
explanation: O child even when you are nearby I am neglected like this. What to say when you are banished. Death is certain to me.

shloka_text: अत्यन्तनिगृहीतास्मि भर्तुर्नित्यमतन्त्रिता। परिवारेण कैकेय्या स्समा वाप्यथवाऽवरा।।2.20.42।।
transliteration: atyantanigṛhītāsmi bharturnityamatantritā| parivāreṇa kaikeyyā ssamā vāpyathavā'varā
translation: कैकेय्याः of Kaikeyi's, परिवारेण attendants, समा वा equal to, अथवा or, अवरा inferior, अतन्त्रिता  without independence, नित्यम् always, भर्तुः by husband, अत्यन्तनिगृहीता अस्मि am greatly repressed.
explanation: Treating me as an equal or inferior to the attendants of Kaikeyi and making me always dependent, my husband has greatly suppressed me.

shloka_text: योऽहि मां सेवते कश्चिदथवाप्यनुवर्तते। कैकेय्याः पुत्रमन्वीक्ष्य स्वश्चि जनो नाभिभाषते।।2.20.43।।
transliteration: yo'hi māṃ sevate kaścidathavāpyanuvartate| kaikeyyāḥ putramanvīkṣya svaści jano nābhibhāṣate
translation: यः whoever, कश्चित् any one, माम् me, सेवते serving, अथवा or, अनुवर्तते following me, सः जनः such person, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, पुत्रम् son, अन्वीक्ष्य having seen, नाभिभाषते हि will not talk to me.
explanation: Any one who serves me or follows me will not talk to me after seeing Bharata (installed as heirapparent).

shloka_text: नित्यक्रोधतया तस्याः कथं नु खरवादितत्। कैकेय्या वदनं द्रष्टुं पुत्र शक्ष्यामि दुर्गता।।2.20.44।।
transliteration: nityakrodhatayā tasyāḥ kathaṃ nu kharavāditat| kaikeyyā vadanaṃ draṣṭuṃ putra śakṣyāmi durgatā
translation: पुत्र O son, दुर्गता fallen into a bad state, नित्यक्रोधतया due to being always in temper, खरवादि speaking harsh words, तस्याः कैकेय्याः that Kaikeyi's, तत्वदनम् that face, द्रष्टुम् to look at, कथं नु how, शक्ष्यामि will be able?
explanation: Fallen into an unfortunate state how can I look at Kaikeyi's face who is always harsh and in temper?

shloka_text: दश सप्त च वर्षाणि जातस्य तव राघव अतितानि प्रकाङ्क्षन्त्या मया दुःखपरिक्षयम्।।2.20.45।।
transliteration: daśa sapta ca varṣāṇi jātasya tava rāghava atitāni prakāṅkṣantyā mayā duḥkhaparikṣayam
translation: राघव Rama, तव जातस्य after you were (re) born (after your investiture with the sacred thread regarded as second birth), दश सप्त च ten and seven (seventeen), वर्षाणि years, दुःखपरिक्षयम् end of my sorrows, प्रकाङ्क्षन्त्या longing, मया by me, अतितानि have been spent.
explanation: O Rama, I have spent the last seventeen years after your birth with the expectaion that my sorrows would come to an end.

shloka_text: तदक्षयं महद्दुःखं नोत्सहे सहितुं चिरम्। विप्रकारं सपत्नीनामेवं जीर्णाऽपि राघव।।2.20.46।।
transliteration: tadakṣayaṃ mahadduḥkhaṃ notsahe sahituṃ ciram| viprakāraṃ sapatnīnāmevaṃ jīrṇā'pi rāghava
translation: राघव Rama, तत् for that reason, एवम् like this, जीर्णापि grown old, अक्षयम् unending, महत् great, दुःखम् sorrow, सपत्नीनाम् of my cowives, विप्रकारम् insult, चिरम् for long time, सहितुम् to tolerate, नोत्सहे do not desire.
explanation: Therefore, O Rama, I cannot at this old age endure this great, endless sorrow and the insults from cowives for long.

shloka_text: अपश्यन्ती तव मुखं परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम्। कृपणा वर्तयिष्यामि कथं कृपणजीविकाम्।।2.20.47।।
transliteration: apaśyantī tava mukhaṃ paripūrṇaśaśiprabham| kṛpaṇā vartayiṣyāmi kathaṃ kṛpaṇajīvikām
translation: कृपणा wretched I am, तव your, परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम् as bright as the full Moon, मुखम् face, अपश्यन्ती without beholding, कृपणजीविकाम् pitiable means of existence, कथम् how, वर्तयिष्यामि will live.
explanation: Without beholding your face that is as bright as the full Moon, how can this wretched woman live this pitiable life?

shloka_text: उपवासैश्च योगैश्च बहुभिश्च परिश्रमैः। दुःखं संवर्धितो मोघं त्वं हि दुर्गतया मया।।2.20.48।।
transliteration: upavāsaiśca yogaiśca bahubhiśca pariśramaiḥ| duḥkhaṃ saṃvardhito moghaṃ tvaṃ hi durgatayā mayā
translation: त्वम् you, दुर्गतया मया by me so unfortunate, उपवासैश्च through fasts, योगैश्च through meditation, बहुभिः many, परिश्रमैश्च with efforts, दुःखम् with difficulty, मोघम् in vain, संवर्धितः have been brought up.
explanation: Through meditation, through fasts and with a great deal of efforts you have been brought up by this luckless (mother). But alas this is all in vain.

shloka_text: स्थिरं तु हृदयं मन्ये ममेदं यन्न दीर्यते। प्रावृषीव महानद्या स्पृष्टं कूलं नवाम्भसा।।2.20.49।।
transliteration: sthiraṃ tu hṛdayaṃ manye mamedaṃ yanna dīryate| prāvṛṣīva mahānadyā spṛṣṭaṃ kūlaṃ navāmbhasā
translation: प्रावृषि in rainy season, नवाम्भसा with fresh water, स्पृष्टम् contacted, महानद्याः mighty river's, कूलम् इव like bank, मम my, इदम् this, हृदयम् heart, यत् for which reason, न दीर्यते does not break, स्थिरम् firm (hard), मन्ये am thinking.
explanation: I think my heart must be very firm (hard) like the bark of a great river which, touched by (a flood of) fresh water in the rainy season does not disintegrate.

shloka_text: ममैव नूनं मरणं न विद्यते न चावकाऽशोस्ति यमक्षयेऽमम। यदन्तकोऽद्यैव न मां जिहीर्षति। प्रसह्य सिंहो रुदतीं मृगीमिव।।2.20.50।।
transliteration: mamaiva nūnaṃ maraṇaṃ na vidyate na cāvakā'śosti yamakṣaye'mama| yadantako'dyaiva na māṃ jihīrṣati| prasahya siṃho rudatīṃ mṛgīmiva
translation: सिंहः lion, रुदतीम् crying, मृगीमिव like a female deer, माम् myself, अन्तकः Yama, (the god of death), प्रसह्य forcibly, अद्यैव now itself, यत् since, न जिहीर्षति is not willing to carry, मम to me, नूनम् certainly, मरणम् death, न विद्यते does not befall, मम for me, यमक्षये in the abode of (the god of death), Yama, अवकाशः opportunity, नास्ति not there.
explanation: There is no room for me in the abode of Yama (the god of death). If he does not carry me off forcibly like a lion carrying away a crying female deer, certainly there is no death for me.

shloka_text: स्थिरं हि नूनं हृदयं ममायसं न भिद्यते यद्भुवि नावदीर्यते। अनेन दुःखेन च देहमर्पितं ध्रुवं ह्यकाले मरणं न विद्यते।।2.20.51।।
transliteration: sthiraṃ hi nūnaṃ hṛdayaṃ mamāyasaṃ na bhidyate yadbhuvi nāvadīryate| anena duḥkhena ca dehamarpitaṃ dhruvaṃ hyakāle maraṇaṃ na vidyate
translation: नूनम् assuredly, मम my, स्थिरम् still (hard), हृदयम् heart, आयसम् is made of iron, यत् since, न भिद्यते is not breaking, भुवि on this earth, नावदीर्यते does not disintegrate, अनेन this, दुःखेन due to sorrow, देहम् body, अर्पितम् surrendered (pervaded), अकाले untimely, मरणम् death, न विद्यते may not be possible, ध्रुवम् this is certain.
explanation: Surely my still (hard) heart is made of iron. It neither bursts nor breaks down on the ground. Pervaded by grief, there is no untimely death for this my body, too.

shloka_text: इदं हि दुःखं यदनर्थकानि मे व्रतानि दानानि च संयमाश्च हि। तपश्च तप्तं यदपत्यकारणा त्सुनिष्फलं बीजमिवोप्तमूषरे।।2.20.52।।
transliteration: idaṃ hi duḥkhaṃ yadanarthakāni me vratāni dānāni ca saṃyamāśca hi| tapaśca taptaṃ yadapatyakāraṇā tsuniṣphalaṃ bījamivoptamūṣare
translation: मे my, व्रतानि mortifications, दानानि च charitable gifts, संयमाश्च selfrestraint, अनर्थकानीति यत् are all meaningless, इदम् this, दुःखम् regret, अपत्यकारणात् for the sake of progeny, तप्तम् practised, यत् which, तपः asceticism, ऊषरे in a barren land, उप्तम् sown, बीजम् इव like a seed, सुनिष्फलम् was fruitless.
explanation: My regret is that all my mortifications, gifts of charity and penances are of no avail. Even the asceticism which I practised for the sake of progeny was fruitless like a seed sown in a barren land.

shloka_text: यदि ह्यकाले मरणं स्वयेच्छया लभेत कश्चिद्गुरुदुःखकर्शितः। गताहमद्यैव परेतसंसदं विना त्वया धेनुरिवात्मजेन वै।।2.20.53।।
transliteration: yadi hyakāle maraṇaṃ svayecchayā labheta kaścidguruduḥkhakarśitaḥ| gatāhamadyaiva paretasaṃsadaṃ vinā tvayā dhenurivātmajena vai
translation: कश्चित् any one, गुरुदुःखकर्शितः tormented with deep grief, स्वया of one's own, इच्छया by free will, अकाले untimely, मरणम् death, लभेत यदि if he gets, अहम् I, अद्यैव now itself, आत्मजेन विना without offspring, धेनुरिव like a cow, त्वया विना without you, परेतसंसदम् to the assembly of Yama, गता would have reached.
explanation: If any one, tormented with great sorrow, could willingly commit suicide I would have gone the way to the assembly of Yama (the lord of death) right away as without you I will be now like a cow without a calf.

shloka_text: अथापि किं जीवितमद्य मे वृथा त्वया विना चन्द्रनिभाननप्रभ। अनुव्रजिष्यामि वनं त्वयैव गौ स्सुदुर्बला वत्समिवानुकाङ्क्षया।।2.20.54।।
transliteration: athāpi kiṃ jīvitamadya me vṛthā tvayā vinā candranibhānanaprabha| anuvrajiṣyāmi vanaṃ tvayaiva gau ssudurbalā vatsamivānukāṅkṣayā
translation: अथापि even then, चन्द्रनिभाननप्रभ one having a countenance resembling the splendour of the full Moon, त्वया विना without you, मे my, जीवितम् life, अद्य today, किम् what use, वृथा fruitless, सुदुर्बला  enfeebled, गौः cow, वत्सम् इव like a calf, अनुकाङ्क्षया in its affection, त्वयैव with you alone, अद्य now, वनम् to the forest, अनुव्रजिष्यामि shall follow.
explanation: What is the use of this life now? What is life without you whose countenance glows like the full Moon? Like a cow emaciated by its search for the calf, I will follow you into the forest.

shloka_text: भृशमसुखममर्षिता तदा बहु विललाप समीक्ष्य राघवम्। व्यसनमुपनिशम्य सा मह त्सुतमिव बद्धमवेक्ष्य किन्नरी।।2.20.55।।
transliteration: bhṛśamasukhamamarṣitā tadā bahu vilalāpa samīkṣya rāghavam| vyasanamupaniśamya sā maha tsutamiva baddhamavekṣya kinnarī
translation: सा that (Kausalya), राघवम् Rama, समीक्ष्य having seen, महत् great, व्यसनम् misfortune, उपनिशम्य having heard, बद्धम् is made captive, सुतम् son, अवेक्ष्य looking on, किन्नरीव like a kinnari, तदा then, असुखम् unhappy, अमर्षिता wrathful, भृशम् extremely, बहु much, विललाप lamented.
explanation: Kausalya, filled with anger due to extreme sorrow reflected over her misfortune, and burst into harrowing tears, looking at Rama, like a kinnari looking at her grownup son taken captive. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentieth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तथा तु विलपन्तीं तां कौसल्यां राममातरम्। उवाच लक्ष्मणो दीनस्तत्कालसदृशं वचः।।2.21.1।।
transliteration: tathā tu vilapantīṃ tāṃ kausalyāṃ rāmamātaram| uvāca lakṣmaṇo dīnastatkālasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दीनः miserable, तथा thus, विलपन्तीम् lamenting, राममातरम् Rama's mother, तां कौशल्याम् to that Kausalya, तत्कालसदृशम् befitting to the occasion, वचः words, उवाच said.
explanation: While Rama's mother, Kausalya was lamenting, miserable Lakshmana said to her these words appropriate to the occasion:
comments: Angry Lakshmana urges Rama to assume authority over the kingdom forcibly--Rama convinces Kausalya and Lakshmana to allow him to obey the command of his father.

shloka_text: न रोचते ममाप्येतदार्ये यद्राघवो वनम्। त्यक्त्वा राज्यश्रियं गच्छेत् स्त्रिया वाक्यवशं गतः।।2.21.2।।
transliteration: na rocate mamāpyetadārye yadrāghavo vanam| tyaktvā rājyaśriyaṃ gacchet striyā vākyavaśaṃ gataḥ
translation: आर्ये O venerable one, राघवः Rama, स्त्रियाः a woman's, वाक्यवशं गतः yielding to the words, राज्यश्रियम् the welfare of the kingdom, त्यक्त्वा renouncing, वनम् to the forest, गच्छेत् (इति) यत् should go , एतत् all this, ममापि to me also, न रोचते is not pleasing.
explanation: O venerable one, I do not like that Rama should go to the forest yielding to the words of a woman and renouncing the welfare of the kingdom.

shloka_text: विपरीतश्च वृद्धश्च विषयैश्च प्रधर्षितः। नृपः किमिव न ब्रूयाच्चोद्यमानस्समन्मथः।।2.21.3।।
transliteration: viparītaśca vṛddhaśca viṣayaiśca pradharṣitaḥ| nṛpaḥ kimiva na brūyāccodyamānassamanmathaḥ
translation: विपरीतश्च man of perverse nature, वृद्धश्च aged also, विषयैः by carnal pleasures, प्रधर्षितः च  struck, समन्मथः ruled by passion, नृपः king, चोद्यमानः incited by (Kaikeyi), किमिव whatever words, न ब्रूयात् not speak.
explanation: The king  has a perverse nature. He is aged. He is overpowered by passions. He is under the spell of carnal pleasures and is incited (by Kaikeyi). Such a man can speak anything.

shloka_text: नास्यापराधं पश्यामि नापि दोषं तथाविधम्। येन निर्वास्यते राष्ट्राद्वनवासाय राघवः।।2.21.4।।
transliteration: nāsyāparādhaṃ paśyāmi nāpi doṣaṃ tathāvidham| yena nirvāsyate rāṣṭrādvanavāsāya rāghavaḥ
translation: राघवः Rama, येन for which, राष्ट्रात् from the kingdom, वनवासाय to dwell in the forest, निर्वास्यते is  banished, तथाविधम् such, अस्य his, अपराधं offence, न पश्यामि do not see, दोषम् अपि fault also, न not.
explanation: I do not see any fault in Rama nor any offence committed by him for which he is exiled from the kingdom.

shloka_text: न तं पश्याम्यहं लोके परोक्षमपि यो नरः। स्वमित्रोऽपि निरस्तोऽपि योऽस्य दोषमुदाहरेत्।।2.21.5।।
transliteration: na taṃ paśyāmyahaṃ loke parokṣamapi yo naraḥ| svamitro'pi nirasto'pi yo'sya doṣamudāharet
translation: स्वमित्रोऽपि even an adversary, निरस्तोऽपि or the defeated, यः नरः any man, परोक्षमपि in his absence also, अस्य his, दोषम् fault, उदाहरेत् can cite, तम् him, अहम् I, लोके in this  world, न पश्यामि do not find.
explanation: I do not find anybody in this world, even an adversary or one defeated, who finds fault with him even in his absence.

shloka_text: देवकल्पमृजुं दान्तं रिपूणामपि वत्सलम्। अवेक्षमाणः को धर्मं त्यजेत्पुत्रमकारणात्।।2.21.6।।
transliteration: devakalpamṛjuṃ dāntaṃ ripūṇāmapi vatsalam| avekṣamāṇaḥ ko dharmaṃ tyajetputramakāraṇāt
translation: धर्मम् righteousness, अवेक्षमाणः without caring, कः who, देवकल्पम् equal to god, ऋजुम्  upright, दान्तम् with subdued passions, रिपूणामपि even for his enemies, वत्सलम् a loved man, पुत्रम् son, अकारणात् without any cause, त्यजेत् will abandon.
explanation: With no cause nor concern for righteousness, will any one abandon his son who is nearly equal to god, upright, selfrestrained and loved even by his enemies ?

shloka_text: तदिदं वचनं राज्ञःपुनर्बाल्यमुपेयुषः। पुत्रः को हृदये कुर्याद्राजवृत्तमनुस्मरन्।।2.21.7।।
transliteration: tadidaṃ vacanaṃ rājñaḥpunarbālyamupeyuṣaḥ| putraḥ ko hṛdaye kuryādrājavṛttamanusmaran
translation: राजवृत्तम् leading the life of a king, अनुस्मरन् remembering, कः पुत्रः which son, पुनः again, बाल्यम् childhood, उपेयुषः regained, राज्ञः king's, तत् इदं वचनम् that such words, हृदये in the heart, कुर्यात् will accept?
explanation: Will any son with the ideals of a king in mind accept such words of this king who has entered his chilhood again ?

shloka_text: यावदेव न जानाति कश्चिदर्थमिमं नरः। तावदेव मया सार्धमात्मस्थं कुरु शासनम्।।2.21.8।।
transliteration: yāvadeva na jānāti kaścidarthamimaṃ naraḥ| tāvadeva mayā sārdhamātmasthaṃ kuru śāsanam
translation: कश्चित् any one, नरः man, इमम् अर्थम् this information, यावदेव until, न जानाति does not come to know, तावदेव before that period, मया साधे with my assistance, शासनम् authority (over the kingdom ), आत्मस्थम् under your control, कुरु do (assume).
explanation: Before this news is known to any one bring the kingdom under your control with my assistance.

shloka_text: मया पार्श्वे सधनुषा तव गुप्तस्य राघव। क स्समर्थोऽधिकं कर्तुं कृतान्तस्येव तिष्ठतः।।2.21.9।।
transliteration: mayā pārśve sadhanuṣā tava guptasya rāghava| ka ssamartho'dhikaṃ kartuṃ kṛtāntasyeva tiṣṭhataḥ
translation: राघव O Rama, पार्श्वे by your side, स धनुषा with bow, मया by me, गुप्तस्य protected, कृतान्तस्येव like Yama, (god of death), तिष्ठतः (yourself) standing, अधिकम् excess, कर्तुं to challenge, कः who, समर्थः is able?
explanation: O Rama who can commit excesses on you, when you stand like  Yama, god of death, protected by me with my bow?

shloka_text: निर्मनुष्यामिमां कृत्स्नामयोध्यां मनुजर्षभ। करिष्यामि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्यदि स्थास्यति विप्रिये।।2.21.10।।
transliteration: nirmanuṣyāmimāṃ kṛtsnāmayodhyāṃ manujarṣabha| kariṣyāmi śaraistīkṣṇairyadi sthāsyati vipriye
translation: मनुजर्षभ O best among men, विप्रिये against you, स्थास्यति यदि if any one stands up, इमाम् this, कृत्स्नाम् entire, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, शरैः arrows, निर्मनुष्याम्  depopulate, करिष्यामि I shall do.
explanation: O best of men, if the whole of Ayodhya stands against you I shall depopulate it with my sharp arrows.

shloka_text: भरतस्याथ पक्ष्यो वा यो वाऽस्य हितमिच्छति। सर्वानेतान्वधिष्यामि मृदुर्हि परिभूयते।।2.21.11।।
transliteration: bharatasyātha pakṣyo vā yo vā'sya hitamicchati| sarvānetānvadhiṣyāmi mṛdurhi paribhūyate
translation: अथ even so, भरतस्य Bharata's, पक्ष्यो वा or any supporter, यो वा or any one, अस्य his, हितम्  welfare, इच्छति seeking, एतान् सर्वान् all those, वधिष्यामि I shall slay, मृदुः a soft (person), परिभूयते हि is treated with disgrace indeed.
explanation: I shall slay all of them who support Bharata and those who seek his prosperity. A gentleman is treated with disgrace indeed.

shloka_text: प्रोत्साहितोऽयं कैकेय्या स दुष्टो यदि नः पिता। अमित्रभूतो निस्सङ्गं वध्यतां बध्यतामपि।।2.21.12।।
transliteration: protsāhito'yaṃ kaikeyyā sa duṣṭo yadi naḥ pitā| amitrabhūto nissaṅgaṃ vadhyatāṃ badhyatāmapi
translation: कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, प्रोत्साहितः instigated, सः that, दुष्टः vicious, नः पिता our father, अमित्रभूतः यदि becomes enemy, निस्सङ्गं without caring for any relationship, अयम् I will, बध्यताम् shall be imprisoned, वध्यतामपि also shall be slain.
explanation: Even if our father instigated by Kaikeyi becomes our enemy, he shall be imprisoned or even slain regardless of our relationship with him.

shloka_text: गुरोरप्यवलिप्तस्य कार्याकार्यमजानतः। उत्पथं प्रतिपन्नस्य कार्यं भवति शासनम्।।2.21.13।।
transliteration: gurorapyavaliptasya kāryākāryamajānataḥ| utpathaṃ pratipannasya kāryaṃ bhavati śāsanam
translation: अवलिप्तस्य filled with haughtiness, कार्याकार्यम् acts good and bad, अजानतः  of one who does not know, उत्पथम् unrighteous path, प्रतिपन्नस्य of one who has resorted to, गुरोरपि even of a preceptor, शासनम् discipline, कार्यम् duty, भवति becomes.
explanation: Even a preceptor who follows the unrighteous path and is filled with haughtiness and does not know how to discriminate between good and bad, deserves to be disciplined (punished).

shloka_text: बलमेष किमाश्रित्य हेतुं वापुरुषर्षभ। दातुमिच्छति कैकेय्यै राज्यं स्थितमिदं तव।।2.21.14।।
transliteration: balameṣa kimāśritya hetuṃ vāpuruṣarṣabha| dātumicchati kaikeyyai rājyaṃ sthitamidaṃ tava
translation: पुरुषर्षभ O best of men, तव your, स्थितम् belongings, इदम् this, राज्यम् kingdom, एषः he, किम् what, बलम् power, हेतुं वा or reason, आश्रित्य resorting to, कैकेय्यै to Kaikeyi, दातुम् to confer, इच्छति wishes.
explanation: O best of men, under what authority or reason this king wants to confer on Kaikeyi the kingdom  that rightfully belongs to you?

shloka_text: त्वया चैव मया चैव कृत्वा वैरमनुत्तमम्। काऽस्य शक्तिश्श्रियं दातुं भरतायारिशासन।।2.21.15।।
transliteration: tvayā caiva mayā caiva kṛtvā vairamanuttamam| kā'sya śaktiśśriyaṃ dātuṃ bharatāyāriśāsana
translation: अरिशासन O chastiser of foes, त्वया चैव with you, मया चैव with me, अनुत्तमम् undesirable, वैरम् hostility, कृत्वा having created, अस्य for him, भरताय to Bharata, श्रियम् kingdom, दातुम् to bestow, का शक्तिः what strength he has?
explanation: What authority, O Rama, chastiser of foes, this king has to bestow the kingdom upon Bharata by entering into undesirable hostility towards you and me?

shloka_text: अनुरक्तोऽस्मि भावेन भ्रातरं देवि तत्त्वतः। सत्येन धनुषा चैव दत्तेनेष्टेन ते शपे।।2.21.16।।
transliteration: anurakto'smi bhāvena bhrātaraṃ devi tattvataḥ| satyena dhanuṣā caiva datteneṣṭena te śape
translation: देवि mother, तत्त्वत: truly, भावेन from the bottom of my heart, भ्रातरम् my brother, अनुरक्तः अस्मि I am loyal, सत्येन truthfully, धनुषा चैव with bow also, दत्तेन on charity, इष्टेन on sacrifice, ते to you, शपे I swear.
explanation: O mother, (Lakshmana now tells Kausalya) I am truly loyal to my brother from the bottom of my heart. I swear this by my bow, on my merits earned through charity, by my truthfulness and by the good deeds I have done.

shloka_text: दीप्तमग्निमरण्यं वा यदि रामः प्रवेक्ष्यति। प्रविष्टं तत्र मां देवि त्वं पूर्वमवधारय।।2.21.17।।
transliteration: dīptamagnimaraṇyaṃ vā yadi rāmaḥ pravekṣyati| praviṣṭaṃ tatra māṃ devi tvaṃ pūrvamavadhāraya
translation: देवि O mother, रामः Rama, दीप्तम् blazing, अग्निम् fire, अरण्यं वा or to the forest, प्रवेक्ष्यति यदि if  he enters, पूर्वम् prior, माम् me, तत्र there, प्रविष्टम् one who entered, त्वम् you, अवधारय know.
explanation: O mother rest assured should Rama enter a blazing fire or a forest I must have already entered it.

shloka_text: हरामि वीर्याद्दुःखं ते तम स्सूर्य इवोदितः। देवी पश्यतु मे वीर्यं राघवश्चैव पश्यतु।।2.21.18।।
transliteration: harāmi vīryādduḥkhaṃ te tama ssūrya ivoditaḥ| devī paśyatu me vīryaṃ rāghavaścaiva paśyatu
translation: उदितः arisen, सूर्यः Sun, तम इव like darkness, वीर्यात् with my valour, ते दुःखम् your sorrow, हरामि shall take away, देवी mother, मे वीर्यम् my valour, पश्यतु one shall see, राघवश्चैव Rama also, पश्यतु shall see.
explanation: Like the rising Sun dispelling darkness, I shall eliminate your sorrow. O mother Let Rama see my valour. You, too.

shloka_text: एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य महात्मनः। उवाच रामं कौशल्या रुदन्ती शोकलालसा।।2.21.19।।
transliteration: etattu vacanaṃ śrutvā lakṣmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ| uvāca rāmaṃ kauśalyā rudantī śokalālasā
translation: महात्मनः of the magnanimous, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, एतत् वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, कौशल्या Kausalya, रुदन्ती weeping, शोकलालसा depressed with sorrow, रामम्   to Rama, उवाच said.
explanation: Having heard the words of the magnanimous Lakshmana, Kausalya, depressed and weeping, said to Rama:

shloka_text: भ्रातुस्ते वदतः पुत्र लक्ष्मणस्य श्रुतं त्वया। यदत्रानन्तरं कार्यं कुरुष्व यदि रोचते।।2.21.20।।
transliteration: bhrātuste vadataḥ putra lakṣmaṇasya śrutaṃ tvayā| yadatrānantaraṃ kāryaṃ kuruṣva yadi rocate
translation: पुत्र O son, ते your, भ्रातुः brother's, लक्ष्मणस्य of Lakshmana, वदतः saying, त्वया by you, श्रुतम्  has been heard, रोचते यदि if it pleases (you), अत्र in this matter, अनन्तरम् later, यत् what, कार्यम् is to be done, कुरूष्व you may do it.
explanation: O my son you have heard what your brother Lakshmana said and if it pleases you, do later what is to be done.

shloka_text: न चाधर्म्यं वच श्रुत्वा सपत्न्या मम भाषितम्। विहाय शोकसन्तप्तां गन्तुमर्हसि मामितः।।2.21.21।।
transliteration: na cādharmyaṃ vaca śrutvā sapatnyā mama bhāṣitam| vihāya śokasantaptāṃ gantumarhasi māmitaḥ
