translation: मम my, सपत्न्या by (my) cowife (Kaikeyi), भाषितम् spoken, अधर्म्यम् unrighteous, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकसन्तप्ताम् stricken with grief, माम् me, विहाय leaving, इतः from here, गन्तुम् to go, नार्हसि does not behove you.
explanation: By heeding the unrighteous words of my cowife (Kaikeyi) it does not behove you to leave me griefstricken and go away from here.

shloka_text: धर्मज्ञ यदि धर्मिष्ठो धर्मं चरितुमिच्छसि। शुश्रूष मामिहस्थस्त्वं चर धर्ममनुत्तमम्।।2.21.22।।
transliteration: dharmajña yadi dharmiṣṭho dharmaṃ caritumicchasi| śuśrūṣa māmihasthastvaṃ cara dharmamanuttamam
translation: धर्मज्ञ O knower of duties, धर्मिष्ठः pious, धर्मम् righteousness, चरितुम् to follow, इच्छसि यदि if you wish, त्वम् you, इहस्थः by staying here, माम् me, शुश्रूष serve, अनुत्तमम् best, धर्मम् of virutes, चर follow.
explanation: You are righteous. You know your duty. If you wish to follow the path of righteousness, stay here, serve me and follow the best of dharma.

shloka_text: शुश्रूषुर्जननीं पुत्र स्वगृहे नियतो वसन्। परेण तपसा युक्तः काश्यपस्त्रिदिवं गतः।।2.21.23।।
transliteration: śuśrūṣurjananīṃ putra svagṛhe niyato vasan| pareṇa tapasā yuktaḥ kāśyapastridivaṃ gataḥ
translation: पुत्र O son, काश्यपः Kasyapa, जननीम् his mother, शुश्रूषुः by serving, नियतः with selfdiscipline, स्वगृहे in his own home, वसन् while dwelling, परेण with the highest, तपसा with penance, युक्तः engaged in, त्रिदिवम् heaven, गतः went.
explanation: O son Kasyapa who led a life of selfdiscipline and served his mother at home, attained heaven credited with (the merit of) the highest penance.

shloka_text: यथैव राजा पूज्यस्ते गौरवेण तथाऽस्म्यहम्। त्वां नाहमनुजानामि न गन्तव्यमितो वनम्।।2.21.24।।
transliteration: yathaiva rājā pūjyaste gauraveṇa tathā'smyaham| tvāṃ nāhamanujānāmi na gantavyamito vanam
translation: राजा king, गौरवेण out of reverence, ते to you, यथैव how, पूज्यः is worthy of homage, अहम् I, तथा हि in the same manner, अहम् I, त्वाम् to you, नानुजानामि will not permit, इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, न गन्तव्यम् shall not go.
explanation: Just as the king is worthy of your respectful homage, so am I. I will not permit you to go from here to the forest.

shloka_text: त्वद्वियोगान्न मे कार्यं जीवितेन सुखेन वा। त्वया सह मम श्रेयस्तृणानामपि भक्षणम्।।2.21.25।।
transliteration: tvadviyogānna me kāryaṃ jīvitena sukhena vā| tvayā saha mama śreyastṛṇānāmapi bhakṣaṇam
translation: त्वद्वियोगात् by being separated from you, मे for me, जीवितेन with life, सुखेन वा or with happiness, कार्यम् any purpose, न not, त्वया सह along with you, मम to me, तृणानाम् of grass, भक्षणम् अपि feeding also, श्रेयः is preferable.
explanation: Separated from you, I have no use of this life or happiness. I prefer to live with you even if it means eating grass.

shloka_text: यदि त्वं यास्यसि वनं त्यक्त्वा मां शोकलालसाम्। अहं प्रायमिहासिष्ये न हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्।।2.21.26।।
transliteration: yadi tvaṃ yāsyasi vanaṃ tyaktvā māṃ śokalālasām| ahaṃ prāyamihāsiṣye na hi śakṣyāmi jīvitum
translation: शोकलालसाम् overtaken by sorrow, माम् me, त्यक्त्वा after leaving, त्वम् you, वनम् to the forest, यास्यसि यदि if you depart, अहम् I, इह here, प्रायम् असिष्ये I shall seek death by fasting, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यामि हि I am not able.
explanation: If you depart for the forest leaving me griefstricken I cannot live. Here I shall seek death by fasting.

shloka_text: ततस्त्वं प्राप्स्यसे पुत्र निरयं लोकविश्रुतम्। ब्रह्महत्यामिवाधर्मात्समुद्र स्सरितां पतिः।।2.21.27।।
transliteration: tatastvaṃ prāpsyase putra nirayaṃ lokaviśrutam| brahmahatyāmivādharmātsamudra ssaritāṃ patiḥ
translation: ततः after that, पुत्र O son, त्वम् you, सरितां पतिः lord of all rivers, समुद्रः ocean, अधर्मात्  through unrighteous conduct, ब्रह्महत्यामिव like slaying a brahmin, लोकविश्रुतम् renowned  in the world, निरयम् hell, प्राप्स्यसे will attain.
explanation: O son you will then fall into hell. As wellknown in the world, the ocean, the lord of rivers, incurred the guilt of slaying a brahmin through unrighteous conduct.

shloka_text: विलपन्तीं तथा दीनां कौसल्यां जननीं ततः। उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा वचनं धर्मसंहितम्।।2.21.28।।
transliteration: vilapantīṃ tathā dīnāṃ kausalyāṃ jananīṃ tataḥ| uvāca rāmo dharmātmā vacanaṃ dharmasaṃhitam
translation: ततः thereafter, धर्मात्मा virtuous, रामः Rama, दीनाम् miserable lady, तथा in that way, विलपन्तीम् lamenting, जननीम् to his mother, कौशल्याम् to Kausalya, धर्मसंहितम् consistent with righteousness, वचनम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: Thereafter, virtuous Rama addressed these words consistent with righteousness to his miserable mother Kausalya who was thus lamenting:

shloka_text: नास्ति शक्तिः पितुर्वाक्यं समतिक्रमितुं मम। प्रसादये त्वां शिरसा गन्तुमिच्छाम्यहं वनम्।।2.21.29।।
transliteration: nāsti śaktiḥ piturvākyaṃ samatikramituṃ mama| prasādaye tvāṃ śirasā gantumicchāmyahaṃ vanam
translation: पितुः father's, वाक्यम् words (order), समतिक्रमितुम् to transgress, मम for me, शक्तिः power, नास्ति is not there, अहम् I, शिरसा bowing my head, प्रसादये I am propitiating, वनम् to forest, गन्तुम् to depart, इच्छामि wishing.
explanation: I do not have the power to transgress the orders of my father. Bowing my head I beseech you,  allow me to go to the forest.

shloka_text: ऋषिणा च पितुर्वाक्यं कुर्वता व्रतचारिणा। गौर्हता जानता धर्मं कण्डुनाऽपि विपश्चिता।।2.21.30।।
transliteration: ṛṣiṇā ca piturvākyaṃ kurvatā vratacāriṇā| gaurhatā jānatā dharmaṃ kaṇḍunā'pi vipaścitā
translation: ऋषिणा by the sage, व्रतचारिणा by a man observing the vows, धर्मम् righteousness, जानता by the knower, विपश्चिता by a learned man, अपि even, कण्डुना by Kandu, पितुः father's, वाक्यम् command, कुर्वता carrying out, गौ: cow, हता slew.
explanation: Learned sage Kandu who knew what is righteousness and a strict observant of vows, slew a cow for carrying out the command of his father.

shloka_text: अस्माकं च कुले पूर्वं सगरस्याज्ञया पितुः। खनद्भिस्सागरैर्भूमिमवाप्तस्सुमहान्वधः।।2.21.31।।
transliteration: asmākaṃ ca kule pūrvaṃ sagarasyājñayā pituḥ| khanadbhissāgarairbhūmimavāptassumahānvadhaḥ
translation: पूर्वम् earlier, अस्माकम् in our, कुले च race, पितुः of father, सगरस्य Sagara's, आज्ञया by command, भूमिम् earth, खनद्भि: by those excavating, सागरैः by the sons of Sagara, सुमहान् very great (fearful), वधः slaughter, आवाप्तः was met with.
explanation: Earlier the sons of Sagara, born in our family, while excavating the earth by the order of their father met a terrible death.

shloka_text: जामद्ग्न्येन रामेण रेणुका जननी स्वयम्। कृत्ता परशुनाऽरण्ये पितुर्वचनकारिणा।।2.21.32।।
transliteration: jāmadgnyena rāmeṇa reṇukā jananī svayam| kṛttā paraśunā'raṇye piturvacanakāriṇā
translation: पितुः father's, वचनकारिणा in obedience to the words, जामदग्न्येन by the son of Jamadagni, रामेण by Parasurama, जननी his mother, रेणुका Renuka, स्वयम् himself, अरण्ये in the forest, परशुना by an axe, कृत्ता was severed.
explanation: Parasurama, son of Jamadagni himself in obedience to the words of his father, decapitated his mother Renuka in the forest with an axe.

shloka_text: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्देवि देवसमैः कृतम्। पितुर्वचनमक्लीबं करिष्यामि पितुर्हितम्।।2.21.33।।
transliteration: etairanyaiśca bahubhirdevi devasamaiḥ kṛtam| piturvacanamaklībaṃ kariṣyāmi piturhitam
translation: देवि O Devi, एतैः by these, देवसमैः by godlike people, बहुभिः many, अन्यैश्च by others also, पितुः father's, वचनम् words, अक्लीबम् fruitful, कृतम् was made, पितुः father's, हितम् wish, करिष्यामि I will do.
explanation: All of them including many other godlike persons, O Mother fulfilled the words of their father. I shall also make my father's wish come true.

shloka_text: न खल्वेतन्मयैकेन क्रियते पितृशासनम्। एतैरपि कृतं देवि ये मया तव कीर्तिताः।।2.21.34।।
transliteration: na khalvetanmayaikena kriyate pitṛśāsanam| etairapi kṛtaṃ devi ye mayā tava kīrtitāḥ
translation: देवि O Devi, मया by me, एकेन by me alone, एतत् this, पितृशासनम् father's command, न क्रियते has not been obeyed, मया by me, ये all those, तव to you, कीर्तिताः have been mentioned, एतैरपि even by them, कृतम् it has been done.
explanation: I am not O Devi the only one obeying my father's command. All I have mentioned to you did.

shloka_text: नाहं धर्ममपूर्वं ते प्रतिकूलं प्रवर्तये। पूर्वैरयमभिप्रेतो गतो मार्गोऽनुगम्यते।।2.21.35।।
transliteration: nāhaṃ dharmamapūrvaṃ te pratikūlaṃ pravartaye| pūrvairayamabhipreto gato mārgo'nugamyate
translation: अहम् I, प्रतिकूलम् contrary to the old practice, अपूर्वम् anything new, धर्मम् practice, ते to you, न प्रवर्तये I am not advancing, पूर्वैः by ancestors, अभिप्रेतः acceptable, गतः followed by them, अयम् this, मार्गः path, अनुगम्यते is being followed.
explanation: I am not advancing anything new, contrary to the existing practice. I am only following the trodden path of our ancestors.

shloka_text: तदेतत्तु मया कार्यं क्रियते भुवि नान्यथा। पितुर्हि वचनं कुर्वन्न कश्चिन्नाम हीयते।।2.21.36।।
transliteration: tadetattu mayā kāryaṃ kriyate bhuvi nānyathā| piturhi vacanaṃ kurvanna kaścinnāma hīyate
translation: भुवि in this world, कार्यम् duty, तत् एतत् that this(compliance with the command), मया by me, अन्यथा in any other manner, न क्रियते will not be done, पितुः father's, वचनम् orders, कुर्वन् while carrying out, कश्चित् any one, न हीयते नाम will not perish.
explanation: I will not do as duty anything contrary to what is done by others in this world. No one who obeys the commands of his father falls off the path of righteousness.

shloka_text: तामेवमुक्त्वा जननीं लक्ष्मणं पुनरब्रवीत्। वाक्यं वाक्यविदां श्रेष्ठश्श्रेष्ठस्सर्वधनुष्मताम्।।2.21.37।।
transliteration: tāmevamuktvā jananīṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ punarabravīt| vākyaṃ vākyavidāṃ śreṣṭhaśśreṣṭhassarvadhanuṣmatām
translation: वाक्यविदाम् of the knowers of speech, श्रेष्ठः best man, सर्वधनुष्मताम् among all archers,  श्रेष्ठः best man, तां जननीम् his mother, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, पुनः again, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: One who is the best among the knowers of speech and best of all archers, Rama spoke to his mother in this manner and then said to Lakshmana:

shloka_text: तव लक्ष्मण जानामि मयि स्नेहमनुत्तमम्। विक्रमं चैव सत्त्वं च तेजश्च सुदुरासदम्।।2.21.38।।
transliteration: tava lakṣmaṇa jānāmi mayi snehamanuttamam| vikramaṃ caiva sattvaṃ ca tejaśca sudurāsadam
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, तव your, मयि in me, अनुत्तमम् exceedingly great, स्नेहम् affection, विक्रमं चैव also valour, सत्त्वं च also strength, सुदुरासदम् unassailable, तेजश्च energy, जानामि I know.
explanation: I know, O Lakshmana, your profound affection for me. I also know your valour,  strength and unassailable energy.

shloka_text: मम मातुर्महद्दुःखमतुलं शुभलक्षण। अभिप्रायमविज्ञाय सत्यस्य च शमस्य च।।2.21.39।।
transliteration: mama māturmahadduḥkhamatulaṃ śubhalakṣaṇa| abhiprāyamavijñāya satyasya ca śamasya ca
translation: शुभलक्षण O one of auspicious qualities (Lakshmana), सत्यस्य च of truth, शमस्य च of selfrestraint, अभिप्रायम् the meaning, अविज्ञाय without realising, मम मातुः my mother's, अतुलम् incomparable, महत् दुःखम् great grief.
explanation: O Lakshamana of auspicious qualities, since my mother is not aware of the significance of truth and selfrestraint, she is overcome with grief, great and incomparable.

shloka_text: धर्मो हि परमो लोके धर्मे सत्यं प्रतिष्ठितम्। धर्मसंश्रितमेतच्च पितुर्वचनमुत्तमम्।।2.21.40।।
transliteration: dharmo hi paramo loke dharme satyaṃ pratiṣṭhitam| dharmasaṃśritametacca piturvacanamuttamam
translation: धर्मः righteousness, लोके in this world, परमो हि is supreme, धर्मे in righteousness, सत्यम् truth, प्रतिष्ठितम् is established, एतत् this, उत्तमम् excellent, पितुः father's, वचनं च words, धर्मसंश्रितम् is supported by righteousness.
explanation: Righteousness alone is supreme in this world and truth is established in righteousness. This excellent command of our father is supported by righteousness.

shloka_text: संश्रुत्य च पितुर्वाक्यं मातुर्वा ब्राह्मणस्य वा। न कर्तव्यं वृथा वीर धर्ममाश्रित्य तिष्ठता।।2.21.41।।
transliteration: saṃśrutya ca piturvākyaṃ māturvā brāhmaṇasya vā| na kartavyaṃ vṛthā vīra dharmamāśritya tiṣṭhatā
translation: वीर O hero, पितुः of father, मातुर्वा or of mother, ब्राह्मणस्य वा or of brahmins, संश्रुत्य having promised, धर्मम् righteouness, आश्रित्य having taken recourse, तिष्ठता by one who abides in, वाक्यम् words, वृथा in vain, न कर्तव्यम् is not to be done.
explanation: Any one, O hero, who has taken recourse to righteousness should not  allow the promise made to his father,  mother or a brahmin to go in vain.

shloka_text: सोऽहं न शक्ष्यामि पितुर्नियोगमतिवर्तितुम्। पितुर्हिवचनाद्वीर कैकेय्याऽहं प्रचोदितः।।2.21.42।।
transliteration: so'haṃ na śakṣyāmi piturniyogamativartitum| piturhivacanādvīra kaikeyyā'haṃ pracoditaḥ
translation: वीर O warrior, सः अहम् such me, पितुः father's, नियोगम् command, अतिवर्तितुम् to transgress, न शक्ष्यामि I am not competent, पितुः father's, वचनात् from the words, अहम् I, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, प्रचोदितः हि urged.
explanation: O hero I cannot transgress the command of my father since at his instance only Kaikeyi urged me (to go to the forest).

shloka_text: तदेतां विसृजानार्यां क्षत्रधर्माश्रितां मतिम्। धर्ममाश्रय मा तैक्ष्ण्यं मद्बुद्धिरनुगम्यताम्।।2.21.43।।
transliteration: tadetāṃ visṛjānāryāṃ kṣatradharmāśritāṃ matim| dharmamāśraya mā taikṣṇyaṃ madbuddhiranugamyatām
translation: तत् for that reason, अनार्याम् ignoble, क्षत्रधर्माश्रिताम् resorting to the duty of a kshatriya, मतिम् intellect, विसृज you may give up, धर्मम् righteousness, आश्रय adopt, तैक्ष्ण्यम् violence, मा do not follow, मद्बुद्धिः my thought, अनुगम्यताम् be followed.
explanation: Therefore, leave this ignoble thought, resort to the duty of a kshatriya, take the righteous path. Do not adopt violence. Follow my decision.

shloka_text: तमेवमुत्त्वा सौहार्दाद्भ्रातरं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः। उवाच भूयः कौसल्यां प्राञ्जलिश्शिरसानतः।।2.21.44।।
transliteration: tamevamuttvā sauhārdādbhrātaraṃ lakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ| uvāca bhūyaḥ kausalyāṃ prāñjaliśśirasānataḥ
translation: लक्ष्मणाग्रजः elder brother of Lakshmana, Rama, तम् that, भ्रातरम् his brother, सौहार्दात् affectionately, एवम् in this way, उत्त्वा having spoken, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, शिरसा with head, नतः down, भूयः again, कौशल्याम् to Kausalya, उवाच said.
explanation: Speaking affectionately to his brother Lakshmana, Rama with folded hands and head bowed  again addressed Kausalya:

shloka_text: अनुमन्यस्व मां देवि गमिष्यन्तमितो वनम्। शापिताऽसि मम प्राणैः कुरु स्वस्त्ययनानि मे।।2.21.45।।
transliteration: anumanyasva māṃ devi gamiṣyantamito vanam| śāpitā'si mama prāṇaiḥ kuru svastyayanāni me
translation: देवि O Devi, इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, गमिष्यन्तम् one who has decided to go, अनुमन्यस्व you may permit, मम me, प्राणैः with life, शापिता असि you are sworn, मे to me, स्वस्त्ययनानि all ceremonial means of securing prosperity, कुरु perform.
explanation: I have decided, O mother to go to the forest from here. Grant me the permission to do so. I swear on my life. Perform all the ceremonies for securing prosperity for me.

shloka_text: तीर्णप्रतिज्ञश्च वनात्पुनरेष्याम्यहं पुरीम्। ययातिरिव राजर्षिःपुरा हित्वा पुनर्दिवम्।।2.21.46।।
transliteration: tīrṇapratijñaśca vanātpunareṣyāmyahaṃ purīm| yayātiriva rājarṣiḥpurā hitvā punardivam
translation: पुरा in the past, ययातिः Yayati, राजर्षिः rajarshi, दिवम् heaven, हित्वा having left,  पुनः again, दिवम् इव like heaven, अहम् I, तीर्ण प्रतिज्ञः having fulfilled my vow, वनात् from the forest, पुनः again, पुरीम् to the city (of Ayodhya), एष्यामि shall return.
explanation: Like rajarshi Yayati of yore who lost heaven and rejained it, I shall return from the forest to the city (of Ayodhya) after the vow is fulfilled.

shloka_text: शोकस्सन्धार्यतां मात र्हृदये साधु मा शुचः। वनवासादिहैष्यामि पुनः कृत्वा पितुर्वचः।।2.21.47।।
transliteration: śokassandhāryatāṃ māta rhṛdaye sādhu mā śucaḥ| vanavāsādihaiṣyāmi punaḥ kṛtvā piturvacaḥ
translation: मात O mother, शोकः sorrow, हृदये in the heart, साधु prudently, सन्धार्यताम् be subdued, मा शुचः do not grieve, पितुः father's, वचः words, कृत्वा having fulfilled, वनवासात् from exile, पुनः again, इह here, एष्यामि will come back.
explanation: Do not grieve, O mother Be prudent enough to subdue your sorrow in your heart. Having fulfilled father's words, I shall come back from my sojourn in the forest.

shloka_text: त्वया मया च वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन सुमित्रया। पितुर्नियोगे स्थातव्यमेष धर्मस्सनातनः।।2.21.48।।
transliteration: tvayā mayā ca vaidehyā lakṣmaṇena sumitrayā| piturniyoge sthātavyameṣa dharmassanātanaḥ
translation: त्वया by you, मया च by me, वैदेह्या by Sita, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, सुमित्रया by Sumitra, पितुः  father's, नियोगे by the orders, स्थातव्यम् we shall abide, एषः this alone, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः law.
explanation: You, Sita, Lakshmana, Sumitra and I -- all of us shall abide by the words of my father. This indeed is eternal law.

shloka_text: अम्ब संहृत्य सम्भारान् दुःखं हृदि निगृह्य च। वनवासकृता बुद्धिर्मम धर्म्याऽनु वर्त्यताम्।।2.21.49।।
transliteration: amba saṃhṛtya sambhārān duḥkhaṃ hṛdi nigṛhya ca| vanavāsakṛtā buddhirmama dharmyā'nu vartyatām
translation: अम्ब O mother, सम्भारान् articles (for consecration), संहृत्य after withdrawing, दुःखम् sorrow, हृदि in the heart, निगृह्य च also after subduing, वनवासकृता relating to my dwelling in the forest, धर्म्या conforming to duty, मम बुद्धि: my thinking, अनुवर्त्यताम् follow.
explanation: O mother in withdrawing the articles (for consecration) and also in subduing the sorrow in your heart approve of my plan to dwell in the forest.

shloka_text: एतद्वचस्तस्य निशम्य माता सुधर्म्यमव्यग्रमविक्लबं च। मृतेव संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य देवी समीक्ष्य रामं पुनरित्युवाच।।2.21.50।।
transliteration: etadvacastasya niśamya mātā sudharmyamavyagramaviklabaṃ ca| mṛteva saṃjñāṃ pratilabhya devī samīkṣya rāmaṃ punarityuvāca
translation: माता mother, देवी Devi (Kausalya), तस्य that Rama's, सुधर्म्यम् conforming to virtue, अव्यग्रम् unruffled, अविक्लबं च also without getting distressed, एतत् all this, वचः words, निशम्य having heard, मृतेव like a dead person, संज्ञाम् consciousness, प्रतिलभ्य having regained, रामम् Rama, समीक्ष्य having looked at intently, पुनः again, इति thus, उवाच said.
explanation: Having heard these words so unruffled and tranquil which conformed to  righteousness, mother (Kausalya), like a dead person regaining consciousness spoke to Rama again:

shloka_text: यथैव ते पुत्र पिता तथाऽहं गुरु स्स्वधर्मेण सुहृत्तया च। न त्वाऽनुजानामि न मां विहाय सुदुःखितामर्हसि गन्तुमेवम्।।2.21.51।।
transliteration: yathaiva te putra pitā tathā'haṃ guru ssvadharmeṇa suhṛttayā ca| na tvā'nujānāmi na māṃ vihāya suduḥkhitāmarhasi gantumevam
translation: पुत्र O my son, स्वधर्मेण by virtue of one's own duty, सुहृत्तया च out of affection, ते your, पिता father, यथैव as he is to you, तथा like that, अहम् I, गुरुः preceptor, त्वा you, न अनुजानामि do not permit, सुदुःखिताम् highly distressed, माम् me, विहाय leaving, एवम् in this manner, गन्तुम् to go, नार्हसि does not behove you.
explanation: By virtue of my own duty and affection towards you, O my son I am as much your preceptor as your father is. I will not grant you permission. You should not go, leaving me deeply distressed.

shloka_text: किं जीवितेनेह विना त्वया मे लोकेन वा किं स्वधयाऽमृतेन। श्रेयो मुहूर्तं तव सन्निधानं ममेह कृत्स्नादपि जीवलोकात्।।2.21.52।।
transliteration: kiṃ jīviteneha vinā tvayā me lokena vā kiṃ svadhayā'mṛtena| śreyo muhūrtaṃ tava sannidhānaṃ mameha kṛtsnādapi jīvalokāt
translation: त्वया विना without you, मे to me, इह here, जीवितेन with life, किम् what is the purpose, लोकेन with the other world, स्वधया with the oblations (offered to manes), अमृतेन वा or with nectar or immortality available to the gods, किम् what use, मम for me, इह here, कृत्स्नात् entire, जीवलोकात् अपि even more than the world of human beings, मुहूर्तम् even for a moment, तव your, सन्निधानम् presence, श्रेयः more desirable.
explanation: What is the purpose of my life in this world without you? What purpose do I have with  the other world or with the oblations (offered to manes) or with nectar (availble to the gods). I would prefer one moment in your company to the whole world of living beings (without you).

shloka_text: नरैरिवोल्काभिरपोह्यमानो महागजोऽध्वानमनुप्रविष्टः। भूयः प्रजज्वाल विलापमेवं निशम्य रामः करुणं जनन्याः।।2.21.53।।
transliteration: narairivolkābhirapohyamāno mahāgajo'dhvānamanupraviṣṭaḥ| bhūyaḥ prajajvāla vilāpamevaṃ niśamya rāmaḥ karuṇaṃ jananyāḥ
translation: रामः Rama, एवम् in this way, करुणम् pitiful, जनन्याः mother's, विलापम् lamentation, निशम्य having heard, नरैः by men, उल्काभिः by meteors (fireworks), अपोह्यमानः being prevented, अध्वानम् the way, अनुप्रविष्टः entered, महागजः इव like a mighty elephant, भूयः still more, प्रजज्वाल was burning (within).
explanation: At the (inconsolable) lamentations of his mother, Rama was in flames (within) like a mighty elephant prevented from entering the highway by men with fireworks.

shloka_text: स मातरं चैव विसंज्ञकल्पा मार्तं च सौमित्रिमभिप्रतप्तम्। धर्मे स्थितो धर्म्यमुवाच वाक्यं यथा स एवार्हति तत्र वक्तुम्।।2.21.54।।
transliteration: sa mātaraṃ caiva visaṃjñakalpā mārtaṃ ca saumitrimabhiprataptam| dharme sthito dharmyamuvāca vākyaṃ yathā sa evārhati tatra vaktum
translation: धर्मे in righteousness, स्थितः abiding, सः that Rama, विसंज्ञकल्पाम् like one who has fallen into a swoon, मातरं चैव to his mother also, अभिप्रतप्तम् tormented with suffering, सौमित्रिम् to Lakshmana, तत्र at that time, यथा in such a way, वक्तुम् to speak, स एव he alone, अर्हति is competent (in that way), धर्म्यम् endowed with  righteousness, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: Rama, centred on righteousness, again addressed his mother who had almost  fainted and Lakshmana who was deeply distressed. As his words were consistent with righteousness, he alone was competent to speak that way.

shloka_text: अहं हि ते लक्ष्मण नित्यमेव जानामि भक्तिं च पराक्रमं च। मम त्वभिप्रायमसन्निरीक्ष्य मात्रा सहाभ्यर्दसि मां सुदुःखम्।।2.21.55।।
transliteration: ahaṃ hi te lakṣmaṇa nityameva jānāmi bhaktiṃ ca parākramaṃ ca| mama tvabhiprāyamasannirīkṣya mātrā sahābhyardasi māṃ suduḥkham
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अहम् I, नित्यमेव always, ते your, भक्तिं च also devotion, पराक्रमं च valour too, जानामि know, तु but, मम my, अभिप्रायम् intention, असन्निरीक्ष्य without probing, मात्रा सह along with my mother, माम् me, सुदुःखम् severe pain, अभ्यर्दसि you are tormenting.
explanation: I know your devotion (to me) and your valour, O Lakshmana But now, without understanding my intention you are causing me and mother severe pain and torment.

shloka_text: धर्मार्थकामाः खलु तात लोके समीक्षिता धर्मफलोदयेषु। ते तत्र सर्वे स्युरसंशयं मे भार्येव वश्याऽभिमता सुपुत्रा।।2.21.56।।
transliteration: dharmārthakāmāḥ khalu tāta loke samīkṣitā dharmaphalodayeṣu| te tatra sarve syurasaṃśayaṃ me bhāryeva vaśyā'bhimatā suputrā
translation: तात O dear one, लोके in this world, धर्मफलोदयेषु obtaining the fruits of righteousness, धर्मार्थकामाः righteousness, wealth and objects of desire, समीक्षिताः are considered, वश्या obedient, अभिमता beloved, सुपुत्रा having good sons, भार्येव like a wife, तत्र in that  (righteousness), ते सर्वे all these (dharma, artha and kama), स्युः will remain, मे to me, असंशयम् there is no doubt.
explanation: Dharma,artha and kama, O my dear are adjudged in this world according to the fruits of righteous action. All these three are doubtless there (in my decision to go to the forest), like obedience in a wife and love for the mother in good sons.

shloka_text: यस्मिंस्तु सर्वे स्युरसन्निविष्टा धर्मो यत स्स्यात्तदुपक्रमेत। द्वेष्यो भवत्यर्थपरो हि लोके कामात्मता खल्वपि न प्रशस्ता।।2.21.57।।
transliteration: yasmiṃstu sarve syurasanniviṣṭā dharmo yata ssyāttadupakrameta| dveṣyo bhavatyarthaparo hi loke kāmātmatā khalvapi na praśastā
translation: यस्मिन् in whichever man, सर्वे all these (three), असन्निविष्टाः स्युः are not combined, यतः by which, धर्मः righteousness, स्यात् is present, तत् that one, उपक्रमेत should be performed, लोके in the world, अर्थपरः a seeker of wealth, द्वेष्यः is abhorred, भवति हि happens, कामात्मतापि subjecting to fulfilment of desires also, न प्रशस्ता खलु is not  admired (by the wise).
explanation: If actions which combine these three (dharma, artha and kama), cannot be performed (which is likely), resort to righteousness. (For) one who seeks wealth is abhorred and one who seeks fulfilment of desires does not attract admiration in this world.

shloka_text: गुरुश्च राजा च पिता च वृद्धः क्रोधात्प्रहर्षाद्यदि वाऽपि कामात्। यद्व्यादिशेत्कार्यमवेक्ष्य धर्मं कस्तन्न कुर्यादनृशंसवृत्तिः।2.21.58।।
transliteration: guruśca rājā ca pitā ca vṛddhaḥ krodhātpraharṣādyadi vā'pi kāmāt| yadvyādiśetkāryamavekṣya dharmaṃ kastanna kuryādanṛśaṃsavṛttiḥ|2.21.58||
translation: गुरुश्च the precepter, राजा च the king also, वृद्धः च an old man, पिता च also father, क्रोधात् due to anger, प्रहर्षात् due to joy, यदि वा or, कामात् अपि even due to passion, यत् such, कार्यम् act, व्यादिशेत् commands, तत् that one, धर्मम् as rightful duty, अवेक्ष्य having seen, अनृशंसवृत्तिः no tendency to cruelty, कः who, न कुर्यात् will not do.
explanation: Whatever a preceptor, an old man, a king and a father commands whether it is out of anger or pleasure or passion must be carried out as dharma. Who will not do it unless he is heartless?

shloka_text: स वै न शक्नोमि पितुः प्रतिज्ञा मिमामकर्तुं सकलां यथावत्। स ह्यावयोस्तात गुरुर्नियोगे देव्याश्च भर्ता स गति स्सधर्मः।।2.21.59।।
transliteration: sa vai na śaknomi pituḥ pratijñā mimāmakartuṃ sakalāṃ yathāvat| sa hyāvayostāta gururniyoge devyāśca bhartā sa gati ssadharmaḥ
translation: सः that kind of me, पितुः father's, सकलाम् completely, इमां प्रतिज्ञाम् this promise, यथावत् as it is, अकर्तुम् not to execute, न शक्नोमि वै for sooth I am not competent, तात O my dear, सः he, नियोगे in command, आवयोः for both of us, गुरुः हि is preceptor, देव्याश्च of mother also, सः he,  भर्ता husband, सः he, गतिः is refuge, धर्मः virtue.
explanation: It is impossible for me not to execute the promise completely, O my dear, he (Dasaratha) is our preceptor and, therefore, fit to command us. Even for  mother Kausalya, he is her husband, her refuge and her dharma.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्पुनर्जीवति धर्मराजे विशेषतस्स्वे पथि वर्तमाने। देवी मया सार्धमितोऽपगच्छेत् कथं स्विदन्या विधवेव नारी।।2.21.60।।
transliteration: tasminpunarjīvati dharmarāje viśeṣatassve pathi vartamāne| devī mayā sārdhamito'pagacchet kathaṃ svidanyā vidhaveva nārī
translation: धर्मराजे when the king of righteousness, तस्मिन् himself, जीवति while he is living, विशेषतः specially, स्वे his own, पथि in the path, वर्तमाने while he is moving, देवी mother Kausalya, अन्या other, विधवा नारीव like a widow, मया सार्धम् along with me, कथं स्वित्  how, इतः from here, अपगच्छेत् shall come away.
explanation: While the righteous king is living, more importantly treading the righteous path, how can mother Kausalya, like an ordinary widow, accompany me leaving this city?

shloka_text: सा माऽनुमन्यस्व वनं व्रजन्तं कुरुष्व न स्स्वस्त्ययनानि देवि। यथा समाप्ते पुनराव्रजेयं यथा हि सत्येन पुनर्ययातिः।।2.21.61।।
transliteration: sā mā'numanyasva vanaṃ vrajantaṃ kuruṣva na ssvastyayanāni devi| yathā samāpte punarāvrajeyaṃ yathā hi satyena punaryayātiḥ
translation: देवि O mother, सा such you, वनम् to the forest, व्रजन्तम् departing, मा me, अनुमन्यस्व allow, सत्येन by the strength of truth, ययातिः Yayati, यथा just like, पुनः again, समाप्ते after completion of the term, यथा as, पुनः again, अव्रजेयम् I shall come back, स्वस्त्ययनानि ceremonies causing prosperity, कुरुष्व you may perform.
explanation: Grant me permission O mother, to depart for the forest. Bless me and perform ceremonies for my wellbeing so that I shall return (to the city) after completion (of my exile) like Yayati (who came back to heaven) with the strength of truth.

shloka_text: यशो ह्यहं केवलराज्यकारणा न्न पृष्ठतः कर्तुमलं महोदयम्। अदीर्घकाले न तु देवि जीविते वृणेऽवरामद्य महीमधर्मतः।।2.21.62।।
transliteration: yaśo hyahaṃ kevalarājyakāraṇā nna pṛṣṭhataḥ kartumalaṃ mahodayam| adīrghakāle na tu devi jīvite vṛṇe'varāmadya mahīmadharmataḥ
translation: केवलराज्यकारणात् only for the sake of the kingdom, अहम् I, महोदयम् great, यशः glory, पृष्ठतः कर्तुम् to push it back, न अलम् must not, देवि O Mother, अदीर्घकाले in a short duration, जीविते in life, अद्य now, अवराम् insignificant, महीम् earth, अधर्मतः unrighteously, न वृणे will not choose.
explanation: I will not forsake this great glory (of fulfilling my father's promise) for the sake of the kingdom. In this transient existence O mother, I do not wish to acquire this insignificant earth unrighteously.

shloka_text: प्रसादयन्नरवृषभ स्समातरं पराक्रमाज्जिगमिषुरेव दण्डकान्। अथानुजं भृशमनुशास्य दर्शनं चकार तां हृदि जननीं प्रदक्षिणम्।।2.21.63।।
transliteration: prasādayannaravṛṣabha ssamātaraṃ parākramājjigamiṣureva daṇḍakān| athānujaṃ bhṛśamanuśāsya darśanaṃ cakāra tāṃ hṛdi jananīṃ pradakṣiṇam
translation: सः that, नरवृषभः excellent among men, पराक्रमात् courageously, दण्डकान् to Dandaka forest, जिगमिषुरेव wishes to go to, मातरम् to mother, प्रसादयन् while pacifying, अथ thereafter, अनुजम् to brother, भृशम् exceedingly, दर्शनम् good intention, अनुशास्य ह having disciplined (instructed), हृदि in his heart, तां जननीम् his mother, प्रदक्षिणं चकार circumambulated.
explanation: Rama, the best among men, thus pacified his mother insisting on his desire to depart for Dandaka forest with courage. And elaborately instructed his brother about his good intentions after which he circumambulated his mother with all his heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyfirst sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथ तं व्यथया दीनं सविशेषममर्षितम्। श्वसन्तमिव नागेन्द्रं रोषविस्फारितेक्षणम्।।2.22.1।। आसाद्य रामस्सौमित्रिं सुहृदं भ्रातरं प्रियम्। उवाचेदं स धैर्येण धारयन्सत्त्वमात्मवान्।।2.22.2।।
transliteration: atha taṃ vyathayā dīnaṃ saviśeṣamamarṣitam| śvasantamiva nāgendraṃ roṣavisphāritekṣaṇam āsādya rāmassaumitriṃ suhṛdaṃ bhrātaraṃ priyam| uvācedaṃ sa dhairyeṇa dhārayansattvamātmavān
translation: अथ thereafter, आत्मवान् selfpossessed, सः रामः that Rama, धैर्येण with fortitude, सत्त्वम् composure, धारयन् holding, व्यथया with mental agony, दीनम् miserable, सविशेषम्   especially, अमर्षितम् indignant, नागेन्द्रमिव like a king cobra, श्वसन्तम् hissing, रोषविस्फारितेक्षणम्  eyes widened with wrath, सुहृदम् to the intimate, प्रियं भ्रातरम् beloved brother, सौमित्रिम् to Lakshmana, आसाद्य having approached, इदम् these words, उवाच said.
explanation: The selfpossessed Rama held his composure and approached his beloved, intimate brother Lakshmana who was (looking) miserable with his mental agony. To him, who was hissing like a king cobra, he said:
comments: Rama convinces Lakshmana that destiny is allpowerful--cancels all arrangements for his consecration ceremony.

shloka_text: अथ तं व्यथया दीनं सविशेषममर्षितम्। श्वसन्तमिव नागेन्द्रं रोषविस्फारितेक्षणम्।।2.22.1।। आसाद्य रामस्सौमित्रिं सुहृदं भ्रातरं प्रियम्। उवाचेदं स धैर्येण धारयन्सत्त्वमात्मवान्।।2.22.2।।
transliteration: atha taṃ vyathayā dīnaṃ saviśeṣamamarṣitam| śvasantamiva nāgendraṃ roṣavisphāritekṣaṇam āsādya rāmassaumitriṃ suhṛdaṃ bhrātaraṃ priyam| uvācedaṃ sa dhairyeṇa dhārayansattvamātmavān
translation: अथ thereafter, आत्मवान् selfpossessed, सः रामः that Rama, धैर्येण with fortitude, सत्त्वम् composure, धारयन् holding, व्यथया with mental agony, दीनम् miserable, सविशेषम्   especially, अमर्षितम् indignant, नागेन्द्रमिव like a king cobra, श्वसन्तम् hissing, रोषविस्फारितेक्षणम्  eyes widened with wrath, सुहृदम् to the intimate, प्रियं भ्रातरम् beloved brother, सौमित्रिम् to Lakshmana, आसाद्य having approached, इदम् these words, उवाच said.
explanation: The selfpossessed Rama held his composure and approached his beloved, intimate brother Lakshmana who was (looking) miserable with his mental agony. To him, who was hissing like a king cobra, he said:

shloka_text: निगृह्य रोषं शोकं च धैर्यमाश्रित्य केवलम्। अवमानं निरस्येमं गृहीत्वा हर्षमुत्तमम्।।2.22.3।। उपक्लृप्तं हि यत्किञ्चिदभिषेकार्थमद्य मे सर्वं विसर्जय क्षिप्रं कुरु कार्यं निरत्ययम्।।2.22.4।।
transliteration: nigṛhya roṣaṃ śokaṃ ca dhairyamāśritya kevalam| avamānaṃ nirasyemaṃ gṛhītvā harṣamuttamam upaklṛptaṃ hi yatkiñcidabhiṣekārthamadya me sarvaṃ visarjaya kṣipraṃ kuru kāryaṃ niratyayam
translation: रोषम् anger, शोकं च also sorrow, निगृह्य after restraining, केवलम् only, धैर्यम् fortitude, आश्रित्य resorting to, इमम् this, अवमानम् insult, निरस्य after discarding, उत्तमम् great, हर्षम् happiness, गृहीत्वा after securing, अद्य today, मे my, अभिषेकार्थम् for the purpose of consecration, यत्किञ्चित् whatever, उपक्लुप्तम् is arranged, सर्वम् all that, विसर्जय you may discard, क्षिप्रम् quickly, निरत्ययम् safe, कार्यम् act, कुरु perform.
explanation: Restrain your anger and sorrow. Dismiss this humiliation (from the mind). Achieve great happiness through fortitude. Remove whatever preparations have been made for the purpose of (my) consecration today, and act quickly so that there is no obstacle.

shloka_text: निगृह्य रोषं शोकं च धैर्यमाश्रित्य केवलम्। अवमानं निरस्येमं गृहीत्वा हर्षमुत्तमम्।।2.22.3।। उपक्लृप्तं हि यत्किञ्चिदभिषेकार्थमद्य मे सर्वं विसर्जय क्षिप्रं कुरु कार्यं निरत्ययम्।।2.22.4।।
transliteration: nigṛhya roṣaṃ śokaṃ ca dhairyamāśritya kevalam| avamānaṃ nirasyemaṃ gṛhītvā harṣamuttamam upaklṛptaṃ hi yatkiñcidabhiṣekārthamadya me sarvaṃ visarjaya kṣipraṃ kuru kāryaṃ niratyayam
translation: रोषम् anger, शोकं च also sorrow, निगृह्य after restraining, केवलम् only, धैर्यम् fortitude, आश्रित्य resorting to, इमम् this, अवमानम् insult, निरस्य after discarding, उत्तमम् great, हर्षम् happiness, गृहीत्वा after securing, अद्य today, मे my, अभिषेकार्थम् for the purpose of consecration, यत्किञ्चित् whatever, उपक्लुप्तम् is arranged, सर्वम् all that, विसर्जय you may discard, क्षिप्रम् quickly, निरत्ययम् safe, कार्यम् act, कुरु perform.
explanation: Restrain your anger and sorrow. Dismiss this humiliation (from the mind). Achieve great happiness through fortitude. Remove whatever preparations have been made for the purpose of (my) consecration today, and act quickly so that there is no obstacle.

shloka_text: सौमित्रे योऽभिषेकार्थे मम सम्भार सम्भ्रमः। अभिषेकनिवृत्त्यर्थे सोऽस्तु संभारसम्भ्रमः।।2.22.5।।
transliteration: saumitre yo'bhiṣekārthe mama sambhāra sambhramaḥ| abhiṣekanivṛttyarthe so'stu saṃbhārasambhramaḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana मम my, अभिषेकार्थे for (my) consecration, यः which, संभारसम्भ्रमः  perseverance with which preparations have been made, सः that, अभिषेकनिवृत्यर्थे for cessation of those arrangements, अस्तु let there be.
explanation: O Lakshmana the same enthusiasm with which preparations for my consecration were made be shown for the cessation of those arrangements.

shloka_text: यस्या मदभिषेकार्थे मानसं परितप्यते। माता मे सा यथा न स्यात्सविशङ्का तथा कुरु।।2.22.6।।
transliteration: yasyā madabhiṣekārthe mānasaṃ paritapyate| mātā me sā yathā na syātsaviśaṅkā tathā kuru
translation: मदभिषेकार्थे in the matter of my consecration, यस्याः whose, मानसम् (heart), परितप्यते ached, सा मे माता that my mother (Kaikeyi), सविशङ्का with doubt, यथा how, न स्यात् will not entertain, तथा accordingly, कुरु act.
explanation: Act in such a way that our mother (Kaikeyi), whose heart ached due to my consecration should not entertain any doubt.

shloka_text: तस्याश्शङ्कामयं दुःखं मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे। मनसि प्रतिसंजातं सौमित्रेऽहमुपेक्षितुम्।।2.22.7।।
transliteration: tasyāśśaṅkāmayaṃ duḥkhaṃ muhūrtamapi notsahe| manasi pratisaṃjātaṃ saumitre'hamupekṣitum
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, अहम् I, तस्याः her, मनसि in mind, प्रतिसंजातम् arisen, शङ्कामयम्  apprehensive, दुःखम् sorrow, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, उपेक्षितुम् to neglect, नोत्सहे I am not inclined.
explanation: Even for a moment, O Lakshmana I am not inclined to ignore her sorrow caused by the apprehension in her mind (about the possibility of Rama's coronation).

shloka_text: न बुद्धिपूर्वं नाबुद्धं स्मरामीह कदाचन। मातृ़णां वा पितुर्वाऽहं कृतमल्पं च विप्रियम्।।2.22.8।।
transliteration: na buddhipūrvaṃ nābuddhaṃ smarāmīha kadācana| mātṛ़ṇāṃ vā piturvā'haṃ kṛtamalpaṃ ca vipriyam
translation: अहम् I, मातृणां of mothers, पितुर्वा or of father, इह here, कदाचन at any time, बुद्धिपूर्वम् intentional, कृतम् done, अल्पम् little, विप्रियं च displeasure, न स्मरामि I do not remember, अबुद्धम् anything done for want of understanding, न not.
explanation: I do not remember to have done anything any time with a motive or without understanding which might have caused even a little displeasure to father or mothers.

shloka_text: सत्यस्सत्याभिसन्धश्च नित्यं सत्यपराक्रमः। परलोकभयाद्भीतो निर्भयोऽस्तु पिता मम।।2.22.9।।
transliteration: satyassatyābhisandhaśca nityaṃ satyaparākramaḥ| paralokabhayādbhīto nirbhayo'stu pitā mama
translation: सत्यः one who is truthful, सत्यपराक्रमः truly valiant, परलोकभयात् for fear of the other world, भीतः frightened, मम पिता my father, नित्यम् always, सत्याभिसन्धः a man striving for truth, निर्भयः fearless, अस्तु let him be.
explanation: Let my father who is always truthful, who is really valiant, who is always striving for truth and who is afraid of the next world, be fearless.

shloka_text: तस्याऽपि हि भवेदस्मिन्कर्मण्यप्रतिसंहृते। सत्यं नेति मनस्तापस्तस्य तापस्तपेच्च माम्।।2.22.10।।
transliteration: tasyā'pi hi bhavedasminkarmaṇyapratisaṃhṛte| satyaṃ neti manastāpastasya tāpastapecca mām
translation: अस्मिन् कर्मणि if this act (my consecration), अप्रतिसंहृते if not withdrawn, तस्यापि for him also, सत्यं न his word has not come true, इति thus, मनस्तापः mental agony, भवेत् he will experience, तस्य his, तापः pain, माम् me, तपेच्च will torment.
explanation: If the preparations for the consecration are not withdrawn, my father will suffer mental agony for the fear that his word has not come true and his agony will torment me.

shloka_text: अभिषेकविधानं तु तस्मात्संहृत्य लक्ष्मण। अन्वगेवाहमिच्छामि वनं गन्तुमितःपुनः।।2.22.11।।
transliteration: abhiṣekavidhānaṃ tu tasmātsaṃhṛtya lakṣmaṇa| anvagevāhamicchāmi vanaṃ gantumitaḥpunaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, तस्मात् therefore, अभिषेकविधानम् this arrangement for consecration, संहृत्य after withdrawing, अहम् I, अन्वगेव afterwards, इतः from here, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to go, इच्छामि I am desiring.
explanation: Therefore, O Lakshmana I want the arrangement for coronation withdrawn before I proceed to the forest from here itself.

shloka_text: मम प्रव्राजनादद्य कृतकृत्या नृपात्मजा। सुतं भरतमव्यग्रमभिषेचयिता ततः।।2.22.12।।
transliteration: mama pravrājanādadya kṛtakṛtyā nṛpātmajā| sutaṃ bharatamavyagramabhiṣecayitā tataḥ
translation: नृपात्मजा king's daughter (Kaikeyi), अद्य now, मम my, प्रव्राजनात् departure, कृतकृत्या having accomplished her purpose, ततः afterwards, अव्यग्रम् without any distraction, सुतम् son, भरतम् Bharata, अभिषेचयिता will coronate.
explanation: Immediately after my departure to the forest, the king's (Kekaya's) daughter having accomplished her objective, will enthrone Bharata without any distraction.

shloka_text: मयि चीराजिनधरे जटामण्डलधारिणि। गतेऽरण्यं च कैकेय्या भविष्यति मनस्सुखम्।।2.22.13।।
transliteration: mayi cīrājinadhare jaṭāmaṇḍaladhāriṇi| gate'raṇyaṃ ca kaikeyyā bhaviṣyati manassukham
translation: मयि I, चीराजिनधरे wearing tattered clothes (bark) and antelope skin, जटामण्डलधारिणि wearing a crown of matted hair, अरण्यम् to the forest, गते when I leave, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi, मनस्सुखम् peace of mind, भविष्यति will attain.
explanation: Kaikeyi will attain peace of mind only after my departure to the forest in tattered clothes, an antelope skin and a crown of matted locks.

shloka_text: बुद्धिः प्रणीता येनेयं मनश्च सुसमाहितम्। तं तु नार्हामि संक्लेष्टुं प्रव्रजिष्यामि मा चिरम्।।2.22.14।।
transliteration: buddhiḥ praṇītā yeneyaṃ manaśca susamāhitam| taṃ tu nārhāmi saṃkleṣṭuṃ pravrajiṣyāmi mā ciram
translation: येन since, इयम् this, बुद्धि: intellect, प्रणीता is advanced, मनश्च mind also, सुसमाहितम् is wellcomposed, तम् him, संक्लेष्टुम् to inflict pain, नार्हामि I do not deserve, प्रव्रजिष्यामि I shall depart, चिरम् delay, मा not.
explanation: With wellcomposed mind this decision has been taken. I do not like to inflict pain (on Dasaratha or Kaikeyi). I shall, therefore, depart to the forest without delay.

shloka_text: कृतान्तस्त्वेव सौमित्रे द्रष्टव्यो मत्प्रवासने। राज्यस्य च वितीर्णस्य पुनरेव निवर्तने।।2.22.15।।
transliteration: kṛtāntastveva saumitre draṣṭavyo matpravāsane| rājyasya ca vitīrṇasya punareva nivartane
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, मत्प्रवासने in my exile, वितीर्णस्य of the awarded, राज्यस्य  kingdom, पुनरेव again, निवर्तने च in revocation, कृतान्तस्त्वेव destiny (as cause), द्रष्टव्यः  should be seen.
explanation: If the award of the kingdom to me is revoked, O Lakshmana, and if I am banished in this manner, see, it is destiny.

shloka_text: कैकेय्याः प्रतिपत्तिर्हि कथं स्यान्मम पीडने। यदि भावो न दैवोऽयं कृतान्तविहितो भवेत्।।2.22.16।।
transliteration: kaikeyyāḥ pratipattirhi kathaṃ syānmama pīḍane| yadi bhāvo na daivo'yaṃ kṛtāntavihito bhavet
translation: अयम् this, भावः thought, (तस्याः for her), कृतान्तविहितः is caused by destiny, दैवः misfortune, न भवेत् यदि if it were not to be so, कैकेय्याः for Kaikeyi, मम my, पीडने in inflicting pain, प्रतिपत्तिः determination, कथम् how, स्यात् will ever take place.
explanation: If this thought and my misfortune were not caused in Kaikeyi by destiny, how could she muster such determination to inflict pain on me?

shloka_text: जानासि हि यथा सौम्य न मातृषु ममान्तरम्। भूतपूर्वं विशेषो वा तस्या मयि सुतेऽपि वा।।2.22.17।।
transliteration: jānāsi hi yathā saumya na mātṛṣu mamāntaram| bhūtapūrvaṃ viśeṣo vā tasyā mayi sute'pi vā
translation: सौम्य O gentle (Lakshmana), मातृषु amongst my mothers, मम to me, यथा how, अन्तरम्  feeling of distinction, न भूतपूर्वम् was never in the past, तस्याः for her, मयि in me, सुते पि वा or in her son Bharata, विशेषः difference, जानासि you know.
explanation: You know, O gentle Lakshmana that never in the past had I any feeling of  distinction amongst my mothers. And Kaikeyi never differentiated between me and her son.

shloka_text: सोऽभिषेकनिवृत्त्यर्थैप्रवासार्थैश्च दुर्वचैः। उग्रैर्वाक्यैरहं तस्या नान्यद्दैवात्समर्थये।।2.22.18।।
transliteration: so'bhiṣekanivṛttyarthaipravāsārthaiśca durvacaiḥ| ugrairvākyairahaṃ tasyā nānyaddaivātsamarthaye
translation: सः अहम् such me, अभिषेकनिवृर्त्त्थैः to prevent my consecration, प्रवासार्थैश्च for my banishment also, दुर्वचैः by the harsh words, उग्रैः cruel, तस्याः her, वाक्यैः with words, दैवात् other than destiny, अन्यत् any other, न समर्थये I will not propose.
explanation: I do not find any reason other than destiny for the cruel and brutal words spoken by Kaikeyi with the objective of preventing my coronation and exiling me.

shloka_text: कथं प्रकृतिसम्पन्ना राजपुत्री तथागुणा। ब्रूयात्सा प्राकृतेव स्त्री मत्पीडां भर्तृसन्निधौ।।2.22.19।।
transliteration: kathaṃ prakṛtisampannā rājaputrī tathāguṇā| brūyātsā prākṛteva strī matpīḍāṃ bhartṛsannidhau
translation: प्रकृतिसम्पन्ना noble natured, तथागुणा having such virtues, राजपुत्री princess, सा she, प्राकृता ordianry, स्त्री इव like a woman, भर्तृ सन्निधौ in the presence of her husband, मत्पीडाम् words causing me pain, कथम् how, ब्रूयात् will say.
explanation: If destiny is not the cause behind this, how could Kaikeyi who is gifted with virtues and a noble nature speak such painful words to me before her husband, like an ordinary woman?

shloka_text: यदचिन्त्यन्तु तद्दैवं भूतेष्वपि न विहन्यते। व्यक्तं मयि च तस्यां च पतितो हि विपर्ययः।।2.22.20।।
transliteration: yadacintyantu taddaivaṃ bhūteṣvapi na vihanyate| vyaktaṃ mayi ca tasyāṃ ca patito hi viparyayaḥ
translation: अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, यत् such, दैवम् destiny, तत् that one, भूतेष्वपि in all beings, न (वि)हन्यते cannot be averted, मयि च in me also, तस्यां च in her as well, विपर्ययः adversity, पतितः हि had fallen indeed, व्यक्तम् this is evident.
explanation: Inconceivable is the power of destiny. Its impact on all beings cannot be averted. That  an adversity has befallen me and Kaikeyi is (therefore) evident.

shloka_text: कश्चिद्दैवेन सौमित्रे योद्धुमुत्सहते पुमान्। यस्य न ग्रहणं किञ्चित्कर्मणोऽन्यत्र दृश्यते।।2.22.21।।
transliteration: kaściddaivena saumitre yoddhumutsahate pumān| yasya na grahaṇaṃ kiñcitkarmaṇo'nyatra dṛśyate
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, पुमान् (कः) which man, दैवेन with destiny, योद्धुम् to fight, उत्सहते can attempt, यस्य destiny's, ग्रहणम् grip, कर्मणः by following it course, अन्यत्र any other, किञ्चित् nothing, न दृश्यते cannot be seen.
explanation: O Lakshmana which mortal has the power to fight with destiny the grip of which can be comprehended  by following its course only through its effect and nowhere else.

shloka_text: सुखदुःखे भयक्रोधौ लाभालाभौ भवाभवौ। यच्च किञ्चित्तथाभूतं ननु दैवस्य कर्म तत्।।2.22.22।।
transliteration: sukhaduḥkhe bhayakrodhau lābhālābhau bhavābhavau| yacca kiñcittathābhūtaṃ nanu daivasya karma tat
translation: सुखदुःखे happiness or misery, भयक्रोधौ fear or anger, लाभालाभौ gain or loss, भवाभवौ birth or death, तथाभूतम् that happens, यच्च किञ्चित् whatever is there, तत् that, दैवस्य destiny's, कर्म ननु is surely its act.
explanation: Happiness or misery, fear or anger, gain or loss, birth or death, and all such things  are surely the acts of destiny.

shloka_text: ऋषयोऽप्युग्रतपसो दैवेनाभिप्रपीडिताः। उत्सृज्य नियमांस्तीव्रान्भ्रश्यन्ते काममन्युभिः।।2.22.23।।
transliteration: ṛṣayo'pyugratapaso daivenābhiprapīḍitāḥ| utsṛjya niyamāṃstīvrānbhraśyante kāmamanyubhiḥ
translation: उग्रतपसः practising severe austerities, ऋषयोऽपि rishis also, दैवेन by destiny, अभिप्रपीडिताः tormented, तीव्रान् severe, नियमान् observances, उत्सृज्य setting aside, काममन्युभिः with anger and passion, भ्रश्यन्ते are fallen.
explanation: Even rishis with severe austerities are tormented by destiny and are swerved from  their observances because of anger and passion.

shloka_text: असङ्कल्पितमेवेह यदकस्मात्प्रवर्तते। निवर्त्यारम्भमारब्धं ननु दैवस्य कर्म तत्।।2.22.24।।
transliteration: asaṅkalpitameveha yadakasmātpravartate| nivartyārambhamārabdhaṃ nanu daivasya karma tat
translation: इह here, आरब्धम् undertaken, आरम्भम् initiation, निवर्त्य having stopped, असङ्कल्पितम् एव unanticipated, अकस्मात् suddenly, यत् such hindrance, प्रवर्तते takes place, तत् that one, दैवस्य destiny's, कर्म ननु is the result of action.
explanation: Any unanticipated and sudden hindrance to the action undertaken shall be deemed to be the act of destiny.

shloka_text: एतया तत्त्वया बुद्ध्या संस्तभ्यात्मानमात्मना। व्याहतेऽप्यभिषेके मे परितापो न विद्यते।।2.22.25।।
transliteration: etayā tattvayā buddhyā saṃstabhyātmānamātmanā| vyāhate'pyabhiṣeke me paritāpo na vidyate
translation: अभिषेके when my consecration, व्याहतेऽपि even though prevented, तत्त्वया in principle, एतया बुद्ध्या with the intellect, आत्मानम् my mind, आत्मना by myself, संस्तभ्य after controlling, मे my, परितापः sorrow, न विद्यते not there.
explanation: Even though my consecration was thwarted, there is no feeling of sadness in me. In fact I controlled my mind by my intellect.

shloka_text: तस्मादपरितापस्संस्त्वमप्यनुविधाय माम्। प्रतिसंहारय क्षिप्रमाभिषेचनिकीं क्रियाम्।।2.22.26।।
transliteration: tasmādaparitāpassaṃstvamapyanuvidhāya mām| pratisaṃhāraya kṣipramābhiṣecanikīṃ kriyām
translation: तस्मात् therefore, त्वमपि you also, माम् me, अनुविधाय having followed, अपरितापः bereft of grief, क्षिप्रम् immediately, अभिषेचनिकीम् relating to coronation, क्रियाम् acts, प्रतिसंहारय withdraw.
explanation: Therefore, be free from grief like me and revoke all the arrangements made for the consecration ceremony immediately.

shloka_text: एभिरेव घटै स्सर्वैरभिषेचनसम्भृतैः। मम लक्ष्मण तापस्ये व्रतस्नानं भविष्यति।।2.22.27।।
transliteration: ebhireva ghaṭai ssarvairabhiṣecanasambhṛtaiḥ| mama lakṣmaṇa tāpasye vratasnānaṃ bhaviṣyati
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अभिषेचनसम्भृतैः brought for the consecration, एभिः by these, सर्वैः by all, घटैरेव with pots of water, मम my, तापस्ये fit for practising penance, व्रतस्नानम् bathing before the commencement of a vow, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: With these very pots (of holy water) brought for the purpose of consecration, O Lakshmana I shall take bath at the time of taking vow for practising penance.

shloka_text: अथवा किं ममैतेन राजद्रव्यमयेन तु। उद्धृतं मे स्वयं तोयं व्रतादेशं करिष्यति।।2.22.28।।
transliteration: athavā kiṃ mamaitena rājadravyamayena tu| uddhṛtaṃ me svayaṃ toyaṃ vratādeśaṃ kariṣyati
translation: अथवा otherwise, राजद्रव्यमयेन with the royal property, एतेन with this, मम for me, किम् what is the use, स्वयम् myself, उद्धृतम् drawn, तोयम् water, मे for me, व्रतादेशम् direction for observance of vows, करिष्यति will be made.
explanation: Or else, for me what is the use of these pots of holy water which are the king's property? The water drawn with my own hands will be made use of for my religious bath.

shloka_text: मा च लक्ष्मण सन्तापं कार्षीर्लक्ष्म्या विपर्यये। राज्यं वा वनवासो वा वनवासो महोदयः।।2.22.29।।
transliteration: mā ca lakṣmaṇa santāpaṃ kārṣīrlakṣmyā viparyaye| rājyaṃ vā vanavāso vā vanavāso mahodayaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, लक्ष्म्याः of kingdom, विपर्यये due  to its loss, सन्तापम् sorrow, मा कार्षीः do not experience, राज्यं वा either kingdom, वनवासो वा or exile, वनवासः dwelling in the forest, महोदयः is glorious.
explanation: Do not grieve, O Lakshmana, over the loss of the kingdom. Living in exile is more glorious than running the kingdom.

shloka_text: न लक्ष्मणास्मिन्खलु कर्मविघ्ने माता यवीयस्यतिशङ्कनीया। दैवाभिपन्ना हि वदत्यनिष्टं जानासि दैवं च तथा प्रभावम्।।2.22.30।।
transliteration: na lakṣmaṇāsminkhalu karmavighne mātā yavīyasyatiśaṅkanīyā| daivābhipannā hi vadatyaniṣṭaṃ jānāsi daivaṃ ca tathā prabhāvam
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana अस्मिन् in this matter, कर्मविघ्ने obstruction to my coronation, यवीयसी माता younger mother, न अतिशङ्कनीया खलु should not by apprehensive, दैवाभिपन्ना overpowered by destiny, अनिष्टम् unpleasant (words), वदति हि is speaking, दैवं च for destiny, तथा प्रभावम् has such influence, जानासि you know.
explanation: O Lakshmana our younger mother (Kaikeyi) cannot be blamed for her obstruction to my coronation. Overpowered by destiny, she is speaking such unpleasant words. This you know is the impact of destiny. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of  the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: इति ब्रुवति रामे तु लक्ष्मणोऽधश्शिरा मुहुः। श्रृत्वा मध्यं जगामेव मनसा दुःखहर्षयोः।।2.23.1।।
transliteration: iti bruvati rāme tu lakṣmaṇo'dhaśśirā muhuḥ| śrṛtvā madhyaṃ jagāmeva manasā duḥkhaharṣayoḥ
translation: रामे when Rama, इति like this, ब्रुवति was speaking, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अधश्शिरा: with his head down, मनसा in his mind, मुहुः repeatedly, दुःखहर्षयो: in grief and joy, मध्यम् midway, जगामेव as if entered.
explanation: While Rama was speaking thus, Lakshmana listened to him with his head down, experiencing both grief and joy.
comments: Lakshmana speaks of his valour-- condemns destiny as feeble and powerless-- urges Rama to  get consecrated--  Rama resolves to obey his father's command.

shloka_text: तदा तु बध्द्वा भ्रुकुटीं भ्रुवोर्मध्ये नरर्षभः। निशश्वास महासर्पो बिलस्थ इव रोषितः।।2.23.2।।
transliteration: tadā tu badhdvā bhrukuṭīṃ bhruvormadhye nararṣabhaḥ| niśaśvāsa mahāsarpo bilastha iva roṣitaḥ
translation: नरर्षभः best  among men (Lakshmana), तदा तु then, भ्रुवो: brows, मध्ये in between, भ्रुकुटीम्   a frown, बध्द्वा having knitted, बिलस्थः in its hole, रोषितः seized with anger, महासर्पः great serpent, इव like, निशश्वास hissed.
explanation: Lakshmana, frowning between his eyebrows, hissed like a great serpent seized with anger in its hole.

shloka_text: तस्य दुष्प्रतिवीक्षं तद्भ्रुकुटीसहितं तदा। बभौ क्रुद्धस्य सिंहस्य मुखस्य सदृशं मुखम्।।2.23.3।।
transliteration: tasya duṣprativīkṣaṃ tadbhrukuṭīsahitaṃ tadā| babhau kruddhasya siṃhasya mukhasya sadṛśaṃ mukham
translation: तदा then, दुष्प्रतिवीक्षम् frightening to look at, भ्रुकुटी सहितम् with frown, तत् that, तस्य his, मुखम् face, क्रुद्धस्य of angry ones, सिंहस्य of a lion, सदृशम् similar, बभौ shone.
explanation: With his frown, his face looked frightening like the face of a lion provoked.

shloka_text: अग्रहस्तं विधुन्वंस्तु हस्ती हस्तमिवात्मनः। तिर्यगूर्ध्वं शरीरे च पातयित्वा शिरोधराम्।।2.23.4।। अग्राक्ष्णा वीक्षमाणस्तु तिर्यग्भ्रातरमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: agrahastaṃ vidhunvaṃstu hastī hastamivātmanaḥ| tiryagūrdhvaṃ śarīre ca pātayitvā śirodharām agrākṣṇā vīkṣamāṇastu tiryagbhrātaramabravīt|
translation: हस्ती elephant, आत्मनः its own, हस्तम् इव like its trunk, अग्रहस्तम् forearm, विधुन्वन् shaking, शिरोधराम् neck, शरीरे in the body, तिर्यक् horizontally, ऊर्ध्वंच upward, पातयित्वा casting, अग्राक्ष्णा with pointed look, भ्रातरम् to brother, तिर्यक् obliquely, वीक्षमाणः looking, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Shaking his forearm like an elephant raising its trunk, moving his neck horizontally and vertically and casting a pointed and oblique look at his brother, Lakshmana said:

shloka_text: अस्थाने सम्भ्रमो यस्य जातो वै सुमहानयम्।।2.23.5।। धर्मदोष प्रसङ्गेन लोकस्यानतिशङ्कया। कथंह्येतदसम्भ्रान्तस्त्वद्विधो वक्तुमर्हति।।2.23.6।। यथा दैवमशौडीरं शौण्डीर क्षत्रियर्षभ।
transliteration: asthāne sambhramo yasya jāto vai sumahānayam dharmadoṣa prasaṅgena lokasyānatiśaṅkayā| kathaṃhyetadasambhrāntastvadvidho vaktumarhati yathā daivamaśauḍīraṃ śauṇḍīra kṣatriyarṣabha|
translation: शौण्डीर क्षत्रियर्षभ great among brave kshatriyas, यस्य whose, धर्मदोषप्रसङ्गेन (your) stand that harm will be done to  righteousness, लोकस्य of the world, अनतिशङ्कया apprehending verdict in favour of exile, अस्थाने at improper time, अयम् this, सुमहान् great, सम्भ्रमः haste, जातः वै was born, त्वद्विधः men such as you are, असम्भ्रान्तः without apprehension, अशौण्डीरम् devoid of strength, दैवम् destiny, यथा as, एतत् all this, कथम् how, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हति is fit for you.
explanation: O Rama, the greatest among the brave kshatriyas you say this because of your fear that (by disobeying father's command) harm will be done to righteousness. This great haste is unwarranted for there is the least apprehension about people's verdict (in favour of exile). How do you, of all persons, speak about destiny as allpowerful in these circumstances when it is powerless?

shloka_text: अस्थाने सम्भ्रमो यस्य जातो वै सुमहानयम्।।2.23.5।। धर्मदोष प्रसङ्गेन लोकस्यानतिशङ्कया। कथंह्येतदसम्भ्रान्तस्त्वद्विधो वक्तुमर्हति।।2.23.6।। यथा दैवमशौडीरं शौण्डीर क्षत्रियर्षभ।
transliteration: asthāne sambhramo yasya jāto vai sumahānayam dharmadoṣa prasaṅgena lokasyānatiśaṅkayā| kathaṃhyetadasambhrāntastvadvidho vaktumarhati yathā daivamaśauḍīraṃ śauṇḍīra kṣatriyarṣabha|
translation: शौण्डीर क्षत्रियर्षभ great among brave kshatriyas, यस्य whose, धर्मदोषप्रसङ्गेन (your) stand that harm will be done to  righteousness, लोकस्य of the world, अनतिशङ्कया apprehending verdict in favour of exile, अस्थाने at improper time, अयम् this, सुमहान् great, सम्भ्रमः haste, जातः वै was born, त्वद्विधः men such as you are, असम्भ्रान्तः without apprehension, अशौण्डीरम् devoid of strength, दैवम् destiny, यथा as, एतत् all this, कथम् how, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हति is fit for you.
explanation: O Rama, the greatest among the brave kshatriyas you say this because of your fear that (by disobeying father's command) harm will be done to righteousness. This great haste is unwarranted for there is the least apprehension about people's verdict (in favour of exile). How do you, of all persons, speak about destiny as allpowerful in these circumstances when it is powerless?

shloka_text: किन्नाम कृपणं दैवमशक्तमभिशंससि।।2.23.7।। पापयोस्ते कथं नाम तयोश्शङ्का न विद्यते।
transliteration: kinnāma kṛpaṇaṃ daivamaśaktamabhiśaṃsasi pāpayoste kathaṃ nāma tayośśaṅkā na vidyate|
translation: कृपणम् pitiable, अशक्तम् powerless, दैवम् destiny, किम् नाम what for, अभिशंससि you are extoling, पापयोः of two vicious people, तयोः of both of them, ते to you, शङ्का apprehension, कथं नाम how, न विद्यते does not arise.
explanation: Why do you extol this pitiable and powerless destiny? Why don't you doubt those two vicious persons (Dasaratha and Kaikeyi)?

shloka_text: सन्ति धर्मोपधा श्लक्ष्णाः धर्मात्मन्किं न बुध्यसे।।2.23.8।। तयोस्सुचरितं स्वार्थं शाठ्यात्परिजिहीर्षतोः।
transliteration: santi dharmopadhā ślakṣṇāḥ dharmātmankiṃ na budhyase tayossucaritaṃ svārthaṃ śāṭhyātparijihīrṣatoḥ|
translation: धर्मात्मन् O virtuous one, शाठ्यात् perfidiously, स्वार्थम् for selfish ends, सुचरितम् of good conduct, परिजिहीर्षतोः for both of them repudiating, तयोः of both of them, श्लक्ष्णाः soft ones, धर्मोपधा acts of deception in the guise of righteousness, सन्ति exist, किं why, न बुध्यसे do you not know.
explanation: Why don't you realise, O virtuous one that there are soft means of creating hindrances in their plan without trangressing dharma. You know dharma. Why don't you understand that their acts of deception wear the guise of dharma?

shloka_text: यदि नैवं व्यवसितं स्याद्धि प्रागेव राघव।।2.23.9।। तयोः प्रागेव दत्तश्च स्याद्वरः प्रकृतश्च सः।
transliteration: yadi naivaṃ vyavasitaṃ syāddhi prāgeva rāghava tayoḥ prāgeva dattaśca syādvaraḥ prakṛtaśca saḥ|
translation: राघव O Rama, प्रागेव even before, तयोः their own, व्यवसितम् decision, एवम् in this way, न स्याद्धि if it was not like that, प्रकृतः by nature, सः that, वरः boon, प्रागेव दत्तः स्यात् would have been given long before.
explanation: If both of them had not decided before, O Rama the boon granted to Kaikeyi naturally would have been fulfilled long ago.

shloka_text: लोकविद्विष्टमारब्धं त्वदन्यस्याभिषेचनम्। नोत्सहे सहितुं वीर तत्र मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि।।2.23.10।।
transliteration: lokavidviṣṭamārabdhaṃ tvadanyasyābhiṣecanam| notsahe sahituṃ vīra tatra me kṣantumarhasi
translation: वीर O valiant one, लोकविद्विष्टम् universally detested, आरब्धम् commenced, त्वदन्यस्य any one other than you, अभिषेचनम् consecration, सहितुम् to tolerate, नोत्सहे I do not desire, तत्र in this matter, मे to me, क्षन्तुम् pardon, अर्हसि it behoves you.
explanation: The consecration of any one other than you, O valiant one is universally detested. I do not want to tolerate (this act). You should pardon me in this matter.

shloka_text: येनेय मागता द्वैधं तव बुद्धिर्महामते। स हि धर्मो मम द्वेष्यः प्रसङ्गाद्यस्य मुह्यसि।।2.23.11।।
transliteration: yeneya māgatā dvaidhaṃ tava buddhirmahāmate| sa hi dharmo mama dveṣyaḥ prasaṅgādyasya muhyasi
translation: महामते O nobleminded one, येन by which, तव your, (इदम् this), बुद्धि: intellect, द्वैधम् dilemma, आगता attained, यस्य whose, प्रसङ्गात् concern, मुह्यसि you are deluded, सः धर्मः that righteousness, मम to me, द्वेष्यः deserve to be hated.
explanation: O noble minded one I hate this righteousness which has deluded your intellect and created this dilemma about this issue.

shloka_text: कथं त्वं कर्मणा शक्तः कैकेयीवशवर्तिनः। करिष्यसि पितुर्वाक्यमधर्मिष्ठं विगर्हितम्।।2.23.12।।
transliteration: kathaṃ tvaṃ karmaṇā śaktaḥ kaikeyīvaśavartinaḥ| kariṣyasi piturvākyamadharmiṣṭhaṃ vigarhitam
translation: कर्मणा by your act, शक्तः being powerful, त्वम् you, कैकेयीवशवर्तिनः who is under the influence of Kaikeyi, पितुः father's, अधर्मिष्ठम् unjustifiable, विगर्हितम् contemptible, वाक्यम् words, कथम् how, करिष्यसि can you carry out?
explanation: When you are able to counter (this move), why do you want to execute the unjustifiable and contemptible words of the king who is under the spell of Kaikeyi?

shloka_text: यद्ययं किल्बिषाद्भेदः कृतोऽप्येवं न गृह्यते। जायते तत्र मे दुःखं धर्मसङ्गश्च गर्हितः।।2.23.13।।
transliteration: yadyayaṃ kilbiṣādbhedaḥ kṛto'pyevaṃ na gṛhyate| jāyate tatra me duḥkhaṃ dharmasaṅgaśca garhitaḥ
translation: अयम् this, भेदः treachery, किल्बिषात् out of guilty mind, कृतोऽपि even done, एवम् in this way, न गृह्यते यदि is not taken in its right sense, तत्र in that matter, मे to me, दुःखम् grief, जायते is arising, धर्मसङ्गश्च attachment to virtue, गर्हितः is censurable.
explanation: I am grieved that even though this plot has been hatched by a treacherous mind, you are not taking it in the right perspective. Censurable is adherence to virtue.

shloka_text: मनसाऽपि कथं कामं कुर्यास्त्वं कामवृत्तयोः। तयोस्त्वहितयोर्नित्यं शत्र्वोः पित्रभिधानयोः।।2.23.14।।
transliteration: manasā'pi kathaṃ kāmaṃ kuryāstvaṃ kāmavṛttayoḥ| tayostvahitayornityaṃ śatrvoḥ pitrabhidhānayoḥ
translation: कामवृत्तयोः of both steeped in passion, नित्यम् always, अहितयोः of both hostile, पित्रभिधानयोः known as parents, शत्र्वोः enemies, कामम् passion, त्वम् you, मनसा अपि even in mind, कथम् how, कुर्याः will you carry out?
explanation: As both of them are steeped in passion, they never thought of your wellbeing. How will you fulfil the wishes of these enemies miscalled parents?

shloka_text: यद्यपि प्रतिपत्तिस्ते दैवी चापि तयोर्मतम्। तथाप्युपेक्षणीयं ते न मे तदपि रोचते।।2.23.15।।
transliteration: yadyapi pratipattiste daivī cāpi tayormatam| tathāpyupekṣaṇīyaṃ te na me tadapi rocate
translation: तयोः of both of them, प्रतिपत्ति: dictates, दैवी च is the decree of destiny, ते your, मतं यद्यपि even if it is your opinion, तथापि even then, तदपि that one also, ते to you, उपेक्षणीयम् should be ignored, न रोचते it does not please me.
explanation: It might be your opinion that their dictate is the decree of destiny. Even then, it does not satisfy me. It (destiny) should be ignored.

shloka_text: विक्लबो वीर्यहीनो यस्स दैवमनुवर्तते। वीरास्सम्भावितात्मानो न दैवं पर्युपासते।।2.23.16।।
transliteration: viklabo vīryahīno yassa daivamanuvartate| vīrāssambhāvitātmāno na daivaṃ paryupāsate
translation: यः who, विक्लबः timid, वीर्यहीनः weak, सः that one, दैवम् the destiny, अनुवर्तते follows, सम्भावितात्मानः respected souls, वीराः the valiant, दैवम् destiny, न पर्युपासते do not depend upon.
explanation: Those who are timid and cowardly alone depend on destiny.The valiant with of selfrespect will not accept it.

shloka_text: दैवं पुरुषकारेण यः समर्थः प्रबाधितुम्। न दैवेन विपन्नार्थः पुरुषस्सोऽवसीदति।।2.23.17।।
transliteration: daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa yaḥ samarthaḥ prabādhitum| na daivena vipannārthaḥ puruṣasso'vasīdati
translation: यः पुरुषः such a  man, पुरुषकारेण with human effort, दैवम् destiny, प्रबाधितुम् to strike,  समर्थः is capable, सः he, दैवेन by destiny, विपन्नार्थः with defeated objectives, न अवसीदति will not grieve.
explanation: In the case of one capable of striking destiny with human efforts it cannot defeat his objective and bring him despondency.

shloka_text: द्रक्ष्यन्ति त्वद्य दैवस्य पौरुषं पुरुषस्य च। दैवमानुषयोरद्य व्यक्ता व्यक्तिर्भविष्यति।।2.23.18।।
transliteration: drakṣyanti tvadya daivasya pauruṣaṃ puruṣasya ca| daivamānuṣayoradya vyaktā vyaktirbhaviṣyati
translation: अद्य today, दैवस्य destiny's, पुरुषस्य च also man's, पौरुषम् power, द्रक्ष्यन्ति will see, अद्य today, दैवमानुषयोः of destiny and man, व्यक्तिः difference, व्यक्ता will manifest, भविष्यति will become.
explanation: Today all will witness the power of destiny and the power of man. The difference between man and destiny will be manifested today.

shloka_text: अद्य मत्पौरुषहतं दैवं द्रक्ष्यन्ति वै जनाः। यद्दैवादाहतं तेऽद्य दृष्टं राज्याभिषेचनम्।।2.23.19।।
transliteration: adya matpauruṣahataṃ daivaṃ drakṣyanti vai janāḥ| yaddaivādāhataṃ te'dya dṛṣṭaṃ rājyābhiṣecanam
translation: अद्य today, ते your, राज्याभिषेचनम् installation as heirapparent, यद्दैवात् by which divinity, आहतम् as prevented, दृष्टम् has been seen, दैवम् destiny, अद्य today, जनाः people, मत्पौरुषहतम् defeated by my valour, द्रक्ष्यन्ति वै shall witness.
explanation: Today people will see destiny defeated by my valour just as they saw your consecration defeated (obstructed) by destiny.

shloka_text: अत्यङ्कुशमिवोद्दामं गजं मदबलोद्धतम्। प्रधावितमहं दैवं पौरुषेण निवर्तये।।2.23.20।।
transliteration: atyaṅkuśamivoddāmaṃ gajaṃ madabaloddhatam| pradhāvitamahaṃ daivaṃ pauruṣeṇa nivartaye
translation: अहम् I, अत्यङ्कुशम् unmanageable by the goad, उद्दामम् unrestrained, मदबलोद्धतम् uncontrollable through the strongth of nut, प्रधावितम् running away, गजम् इव like an elephant, दैवम् destiny, पौरुषेण with valour, निवर्तये I will turn back.
explanation: I will make destiny, the elephant, running wild on the strength of the rut, unmanageable (even) by the goad, turn back with my valour.

shloka_text: लोकपालास्समस्ता स्ते नाद्य रामाभिषेचनम्। न च कृत्स्नास्त्रयो लोका विहन्युः किं पुनः पिता।।2.23.21।।
transliteration: lokapālāssamastā ste nādya rāmābhiṣecanam| na ca kṛtsnāstrayo lokā vihanyuḥ kiṃ punaḥ pitā
translation: अद्य today, ते those, समस्ताः all, लोकपालाः guardians of the quarters, रामाभिषेचनम् consecration of Rama, न विहन्युः cannot obstruct, कृत्स्नाः all, त्रयः लोकाः च the three worlds, न cannot, पिता father, किं पुनः needless to say again.
explanation: All the guardians of the quarters and all the three worlds united cannot prevent the consecration of Rama today, what to speak of our father (king Dasaratha).

shloka_text: यैर्निवासस्तवारण्ये मिथो राजन्समर्थितः। अरण्ये ते निवत्स्यन्ति चतुर्दश समास्तथा।।2.23.22।।
transliteration: yairnivāsastavāraṇye mitho rājansamarthitaḥ| araṇye te nivatsyanti caturdaśa samāstathā
translation: राजन् O king, यैः by whom, अरण्ये in the forest, तव your, निवासः live, मिथः mutual, समर्थितः support, ते they, तथा in the same way, चतुर्दश समाः fourteen years, अरण्ये in the forest, निवत्स्यन्ति they shall reside.
explanation: O king those who, with mutual support banished you to the forest, will themselves  dwell in the forest for fourteen years.

shloka_text: अहं तदाशां छेत्स्यामि पितुस्तस्याश्च या तव। अभिषेकविघातेन पुत्रराज्याय वर्तते।।2.23.23।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tadāśāṃ chetsyāmi pitustasyāśca yā tava| abhiṣekavighātena putrarājyāya vartate
translation: तत् for that reason, अहम् I, पितुः father's, या Kaikeyi, तव your, अभिषेकविघातेन by obstructing your consecration, पुत्रराज्याय the kingdom for her son, वर्तते is intending, तस्याश्च her, आशाम् desire, छेत्स्यामि I will break asunder.
explanation: Therefore, I shall frustrate the desire of father and of  Kaikeyi who plans the kingdom for her son by obstructing your consecration.

shloka_text: मद्बलेन विरुद्धाय न स्याद्दैवबलं तथा। प्रभविष्यति दुःखाय यथोग्रं पौरुषं मम।।2.23.24।।
transliteration: madbalena viruddhāya na syāddaivabalaṃ tathā| prabhaviṣyati duḥkhāya yathograṃ pauruṣaṃ mama
translation: मद्बलेन with my valour, विरुद्धाय any one who opposes, उग्रम् terrible, मम पौरुषम् my valour, यथा how, दुःखाय for sorrow, प्रभविष्यति will result, तथा like that, दैव बलम् the power  of destiny, न स्यात् may not be.
explanation: Any one who opposes my terrible valour will come to grief. The power of destiny will not cause that much sorrow as my valour will.

shloka_text: ऊर्ध्वं वर्षसहस्रान्ते प्रजापाल्यमनन्तरम्। आर्यपुत्राः करिष्यन्ति वनवासं गते त्वयि।।2.23.25।।
transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ varṣasahasrānte prajāpālyamanantaram| āryaputrāḥ kariṣyanti vanavāsaṃ gate tvayi
translation: प्रजापाल्यमनन्तरं afte ruling the subjects, वर्ष सहस्रान्ते after a thousand years, त्वयि you, वनवासं गते after you have withdrawn to the forest, आर्यपुत्राः your sons, करिष्यन्ति will rule them.
explanation: When after ruling the subjects for a thousand years you withdraw into the forest (for yativrata) your sons will rule them.

shloka_text: पूर्वं राजर्षिवृत्त्या हि वनवासो विधीयते। प्रजा निक्षिप्य पुत्रेषु पुत्रवत्परिपालने।।2.23.26।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃ rājarṣivṛttyā hi vanavāso vidhīyate| prajā nikṣipya putreṣu putravatparipālane
translation: पुत्रेषु in sons, प्रजाः subjects, पुत्रवत् like sons, परिपालने in ruling, निक्षिप्य after entrusting, वनवासः retiring into the forest, पूर्वं राजर्षिवृत्त्या as rajarsis did in ancient times, विधीयते हि is established.
explanation: Leaving their sons to look after the subjects as their own children, the rajarsis in  ancient times used to retire into the forest as per practice.

shloka_text: स चेद्राजन्यनेकाग्रे राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया। नैवमिच्छसि धर्मात्मन् राज्यं राम त्वमात्मनि।।2.23.27।। प्रतिजाने च ते वीर माऽभूवं वीरलोकभाक्। राज्यं च तव रक्षेयमहं वेलेव सागरम्।।2.23.28।।
transliteration: sa cedrājanyanekāgre rājyavibhramaśaṅkayā| naivamicchasi dharmātman rājyaṃ rāma tvamātmani pratijāne ca te vīra mā'bhūvaṃ vīralokabhāk| rājyaṃ ca tava rakṣeyamahaṃ veleva sāgaram
translation: धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, राम Rama, राजनि when the king, अनेकाग्रे in many directions (and unable to decide), राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया with apprehension that disturbances  in the kingdom will arise, सः त्वम् such you, एवम् in this way, राज्यम् kingdom, आत्मनि to you, न इच्छसि चेत् if it is not desired, ते to you, प्रतिजाने च I am swearing, वीर O valient one, वीरलोकभाक् attaining the afterworld of heroes, माऽभूवम् let it not be my fate, अहम् I, वेला shore, सागरम् इव like ocean, तव your, राज्यम् kingdom, रक्षेयम् I will protect.
explanation: O righteous one, if you apprehend chaos in the kingdom for want of wholehearted support from the (feudatory) kings then, O my valiant brother, I swear to you, I will protect your kingdom like the shore protecting the ocean. Or else, I shall never attain the afterworld of heroes.

shloka_text: स चेद्राजन्यनेकाग्रे राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया। नैवमिच्छसि धर्मात्मन् राज्यं राम त्वमात्मनि।।2.23.27।। प्रतिजाने च ते वीर माऽभूवं वीरलोकभाक्। राज्यं च तव रक्षेयमहं वेलेव सागरम्।।2.23.28।।
transliteration: sa cedrājanyanekāgre rājyavibhramaśaṅkayā| naivamicchasi dharmātman rājyaṃ rāma tvamātmani pratijāne ca te vīra mā'bhūvaṃ vīralokabhāk| rājyaṃ ca tava rakṣeyamahaṃ veleva sāgaram
translation: धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, राम Rama, राजनि when the king, अनेकाग्रे in many directions (and unable to decide), राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया with apprehension that disturbances  in the kingdom will arise, सः त्वम् such you, एवम् in this way, राज्यम् kingdom, आत्मनि to you, न इच्छसि चेत् if it is not desired, ते to you, प्रतिजाने च I am swearing, वीर O valient one, वीरलोकभाक् attaining the afterworld of heroes, माऽभूवम् let it not be my fate, अहम् I, वेला shore, सागरम् इव like ocean, तव your, राज्यम् kingdom, रक्षेयम् I will protect.
explanation: O righteous one, if you apprehend chaos in the kingdom for want of wholehearted support from the (feudatory) kings then, O my valiant brother, I swear to you, I will protect your kingdom like the shore protecting the ocean. Or else, I shall never attain the afterworld of heroes.

shloka_text: मङ्गलैरभिषिञ्चस्व तत्र त्वं व्यापृतो भव। अहमेको महीपालानलं वारयितुं बलात्।।2.23.29।।
transliteration: maṅgalairabhiṣiñcasva tatra tvaṃ vyāpṛto bhava| ahameko mahīpālānalaṃ vārayituṃ balāt
translation: त्वम् you, मङ्गलैः with auspicious materials, अभिषिञ्चस्व you may continue the consecration ceremony, तत्र in this matter, व्यापृतः getting engaged in, भव become, अहम् I, एकः singlehanded, बलात् by my valour, महीपालान् the kings, वारयितुम् to prevent, अलम् am competent.
explanation: The consecration may be performed with these auspicious materials. I am alone capable of facing these kings with my valour.

shloka_text: न शोभार्थाविमौ बाहू न धनुर्भूषणाय मे। नाऽसिराबन्धनार्थाय न शरास्तम्भहेतवः।।2.23.30।। अमित्रदमनार्थं मे सर्वमेतच्चतुष्टयम्।
transliteration: na śobhārthāvimau bāhū na dhanurbhūṣaṇāya me| nā'sirābandhanārthāya na śarāstambhahetavaḥ amitradamanārthaṃ me sarvametaccatuṣṭayam|
translation: इमौ this, मे बाहू my two arms, शोभार्थौ for purposes of enhancing beauty, न not, धनुः bow, भूषणाय for decorating, न not, असिः sword, आबन्धनार्थाय for fastening on my waist, न not, शराः arrows, स्तम्भहेतवः remain fixed, न not, मे my, सर्वम् all this, एतत् this, चतुष्टयम् four weapons, अमित्रदमनार्थम् only for subduing enemies.
explanation: These my arms are not intended to enhance the beauty (of my body). This bow is not for decoration. The sword is not for the sake of strapping my waist. The arrows are not meant to be fixed to my quiver. All these four are meant for taming my enemies.

shloka_text: न चाहं कामयेऽत्यर्थं यस्स्याच्छत्रुर्मतो मम।।2.23.31।। असिना तीक्ष्णधारेण विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा। प्रगृहीतेन वै शत्रुं वज्रिणं वा न कल्पये।।2.23.32।।
transliteration: na cāhaṃ kāmaye'tyarthaṃ yassyācchatrurmato mama asinā tīkṣṇadhāreṇa vidyuccalitavarcasā| pragṛhītena vai śatruṃ vajriṇaṃ vā na kalpaye
translation: अहम् I, यः who, मम my, शत्रुः as enemy, मतः स्यात् is considered, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, न कामये I do not desire (to endure), तीक्ष्णधारेण with a sharpedged, विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा with the  lustre of flashing lightning, प्रगृहीतेन by holding, असिना with sword, शत्रुम् to the enemy, वज्रिणं वा or Indra, (bearer of thunder), न कल्पये will not spare.
explanation: Any one who turns my enemy will not be allowed to remain alive. Holding my sharpedged sword, lustrous as a flash of lightning, I shall  exterminate my enemy even if it were Indra, the bearer of thunder.

shloka_text: न चाहं कामयेऽत्यर्थं यस्स्याच्छत्रुर्मतो मम।।2.23.31।। असिना तीक्ष्णधारेण विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा। प्रगृहीतेन वै शत्रुं वज्रिणं वा न कल्पये।।2.23.32।।
transliteration: na cāhaṃ kāmaye'tyarthaṃ yassyācchatrurmato mama asinā tīkṣṇadhāreṇa vidyuccalitavarcasā| pragṛhītena vai śatruṃ vajriṇaṃ vā na kalpaye
translation: अहम् I, यः who, मम my, शत्रुः as enemy, मतः स्यात् is considered, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, न कामये I do not desire (to endure), तीक्ष्णधारेण with a sharpedged, विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा with the  lustre of flashing lightning, प्रगृहीतेन by holding, असिना with sword, शत्रुम् to the enemy, वज्रिणं वा or Indra, (bearer of thunder), न कल्पये will not spare.
explanation: Any one who turns my enemy will not be allowed to remain alive. Holding my sharpedged sword, lustrous as a flash of lightning, I shall  exterminate my enemy even if it were Indra, the bearer of thunder.

shloka_text: खड्गनिष्पेषनिष्पिष्टैर्गहना दुश्चरा च मे। हस्त्यश्वनरहस्तोरुशिरोभिर्भविता मही।।2.23.33।।
transliteration: khaḍganiṣpeṣaniṣpiṣṭairgahanā duścarā ca me| hastyaśvanarahastoruśirobhirbhavitā mahī
translation: मे my, खड्गनिष्पेषनिष्पिष्टैः by those hacked off with the sword, हस्त्यश्वनरहस्तोरुशिरोभिः with trunks of elephants, horses, hands, thighs and heads of warriors, मही the earth, गहना impenetrable, दुश्चरा impassable, भविता shall become.
explanation: This entire earth will become impenetrable and impassable, scattered with the trunks, thighs and heads of elephants, horses and warriors hacked off with my sword.

shloka_text: खड्गधाराहता मेऽद्य दीप्यमाना इवाद्रयः। पतिष्यन्ति द्विपा भूमौ मेघा इव सविद्युतः।।2.23.34।।
transliteration: khaḍgadhārāhatā me'dya dīpyamānā ivādrayaḥ| patiṣyanti dvipā bhūmau meghā iva savidyutaḥ
translation: अद्य now, (हया: horses), मे my, खङ्गधाराहताः struck by the blows of my sword, दीप्यमानाः burning, अद्रय इव like mountains, सविद्युतः with lightning, मेघा इव like clouds, भूमौ on the earth, पतिष्यन्ति will fall down.
explanation: The elephants, struck by the blows of my sword, will fall on earth like mountains engulfed in flames and like clouds with lightning.

shloka_text: बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणे प्रगृहीतशरासने। कथं पुरुषमानी स्यात्पुरुषाणां मयि स्थिते।।2.23.35।।
transliteration: baddhagodhāṅgulitrāṇe pragṛhītaśarāsane| kathaṃ puruṣamānī syātpuruṣāṇāṃ mayi sthite
translation: मयि when I, बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणे while donning the godha (a leather fence fastened round the left arm to prevent injury from the bowstring) and fingerprotector (a contrivance like a thimble used by archers to protect the thumb or finger from being injured by bowstring), प्रगृहीतशरासने while holding the bow, स्थिते while I stand, पुरुषाणाम् among men, पुरुषमानी one who considers himself manly, कथम् how, स्यात् will it be.
explanation: When I stand before men (enemies) wearing godha and fingerprotector, holding the bow ready, who amongst men will boast of his manliness?

shloka_text: बहुभिश्चैकमत्यस्यन्नेकेन च बहून्जनान्। विनियोक्ष्याम्यहं बाणान्नृवाजिगजमर्मसु।।2.23.36।।
transliteration: bahubhiścaikamatyasyannekena ca bahūnjanān| viniyokṣyāmyahaṃ bāṇānnṛvājigajamarmasu
translation: अहम् I, बहुभिः with many (arrows), एकम् only one, अत्यस्यन् striking and throwing, एकेन with one arrow, बहून् जनान् (striking) many men, बाणान् arrows, नृवाजिगजमर्मसु at the vitals of men, horses and elephants, विनियोक्ष्यामि I will aim at.
explanation: Striking each of my foes with many arrows and many with one arrow, I shall aim them at the vitals of men, horses and elephants.

shloka_text: अद्य मेऽस्त्रप्रभावस्य प्रभावः प्रभविष्यति। राज्ञश्चाप्रभुतां कर्तुं प्रभुत्वं तव च प्रभोः।।2.23.37।।
transliteration: adya me'straprabhāvasya prabhāvaḥ prabhaviṣyati| rājñaścāprabhutāṃ kartuṃ prabhutvaṃ tava ca prabhoḥ
translation: प्रभो O Lord, अद्य today, मे my, अस्त्रप्रभावस्य of glorious weapons, प्रभावः strength, राज्ञः of the king (Dasaratha), अप्रभुताम् having no power over the kingdom, तव your, प्रभुत्वं च  supremacy over the kingdom, कर्तुम् to make, प्रभविष्यति is competent.
explanation: O Lord today you shall see the power of my glorious weapons in depriving the king (Dasaratha) of his authority and establishing your supremacy over the kingdom.

shloka_text: अद्य चन्दनसारस्य केयूरामोक्षणस्य च। वसूनां च विमोक्षस्य सुहृदां पालनस्य च।।2.23.38।। अनुरूपाविमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः। अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य कर्तृ़णां ते निवारणे।।2.23.39।।
transliteration: adya candanasārasya keyūrāmokṣaṇasya ca| vasūnāṃ ca vimokṣasya suhṛdāṃ pālanasya ca anurūpāvimau bāhū rāma karma kariṣyataḥ| abhiṣecanavighnasya kartṛ़ṇāṃ te nivāraṇe
translation: राम O Rama , अद्य today, चन्दन सारस्य of sandalwood cream, केयूरामोक्षणस्य of wearing armlets, वसूनाम् of wealth, विमोक्षस्य for distributing, सुहृदाम् friends, पालनस्य for protection, अनुरूपौ worthy, इमौ these (hands), ते your, अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य obstruction to your consecration, कर्तृ़णाम् those who are causing, निवारणे in preventing, कर्म act, करिष्यतः will take up.
explanation: These arms, O Rama which are fit for sandalwood cream, for wearing armlets, for distributing wealth and for protecting friends, will perform the worthy act of subduing those who are creating obstruction to your consecration.

shloka_text: अद्य चन्दनसारस्य केयूरामोक्षणस्य च। वसूनां च विमोक्षस्य सुहृदां पालनस्य च।।2.23.38।। अनुरूपाविमौ बाहू राम कर्म करिष्यतः। अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य कर्तृ़णां ते निवारणे।।2.23.39।।
transliteration: adya candanasārasya keyūrāmokṣaṇasya ca| vasūnāṃ ca vimokṣasya suhṛdāṃ pālanasya ca anurūpāvimau bāhū rāma karma kariṣyataḥ| abhiṣecanavighnasya kartṛ़ṇāṃ te nivāraṇe
translation: राम O Rama , अद्य today, चन्दन सारस्य of sandalwood cream, केयूरामोक्षणस्य of wearing armlets, वसूनाम् of wealth, विमोक्षस्य for distributing, सुहृदाम् friends, पालनस्य for protection, अनुरूपौ worthy, इमौ these (hands), ते your, अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य obstruction to your consecration, कर्तृ़णाम् those who are causing, निवारणे in preventing, कर्म act, करिष्यतः will take up.
explanation: These arms, O Rama which are fit for sandalwood cream, for wearing armlets, for distributing wealth and for protecting friends, will perform the worthy act of subduing those who are creating obstruction to your consecration.

shloka_text: ब्रवीहि कोऽद्यैव मया वियुज्यताम् तवा सुहृत्प्राणयशस्सुहृज्जनैः। यथा तवेयं वसुधा वशे भवे त्तथैव मां शाधि तवास्मि किङ्करः।।2.23.40।।
transliteration: bravīhi ko'dyaiva mayā viyujyatām tavā suhṛtprāṇayaśassuhṛjjanaiḥ| yathā taveyaṃ vasudhā vaśe bhave ttathaiva māṃ śādhi tavāsmi kiṅkaraḥ
translation: तव your, असुहृत् enemy, कः who, अद्यैव now itself, मया by me, प्राणयशस्सुहृज्जनैः with life, fame and friends, वियुज्यताम् shall be separated, ब्रवीहि you may tell me, इयम् this, वसुधा earth, यथा how, तव your, वशे under control, भवेत् shall come under, तथैव in the way, माम् me, शाधि you may command, तव your, किङ्करः servant, अस्मि I am.
explanation: Tell me your enemy who should be deprived of his life, fame and friends. Command me as to how this earth shall come under your control. Now itself I shall do that. I am your servant.

shloka_text: तं समीक्ष्य त्ववहितं पितुर्निर्देश पालने। कौशल्या बाष्पसंरुद्धा वचो धर्मिष्ठमब्रवीत्।।2.24.1।।
transliteration: taṃ samīkṣya tvavahitaṃ piturnirdeśa pālane| kauśalyā bāṣpasaṃruddhā vaco dharmiṣṭhamabravīt
translation: तम् him, पितुः father's, निर्देशपालने in carrying out the command, अवहितम्  determined, समीक्ष्य having perceived, कौशल्या Kausalya, बाष्पसंरुध्दा with choked tears, धर्मिष्ठम् pious, वचः words, अब्रवीत् said.
