translation: शेषाः the rest of them, या मम मातरः my mothers, ते to you also, नित्यम् always, वन्दितव्याः should be respected, मम my, मातरः mothers, स्नेहप्रणय सम्भोगैः with love, affection and service, समाः हि are equal.
explanation: In terms of love, affection and service, the rest of my mothers are all equal. Therefore, you must pay them due respect regularly.

shloka_text: भ्रातृपुत्रसमौ चापि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः। त्वया भरतशत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम।।2.26.33।।
transliteration: bhrātṛputrasamau cāpi draṣṭavyau ca viśeṣataḥ| tvayā bharataśatrughnau prāṇaiḥ priyatarau mama
translation: मम to me, प्राणैः  more than life , प्रियतरौ dearer, भरतशत्रुघ्नौ Bharata and Satrughna, विशेषतः specially, त्वया by you, भ्रातृपुत्रसमौ as your brother and your sons, द्रष्टव्यौ च are to be looked after.
explanation: What is more important is that you should look on Bharata as your brother and Satrughna as your son. They are dearer to me than my life.

shloka_text: विप्रियं न च कर्तव्यं भरतस्य कदाचन। स हि राजा प्रभुश्चैव देशस्य च कुलस्य च।।2.26.34।।
transliteration: vipriyaṃ na ca kartavyaṃ bharatasya kadācana| sa hi rājā prabhuścaiva deśasya ca kulasya ca
translation: कदाचन at any time, भरतस्य of Bharata, विप्रियम् disagreeable, न कर्तव्यम् should not be done, सः he, देशस्य च of the country, कुलस्य च of the family also, राजा king, प्रभुश्चैव  also the lord.
explanation: Now Bharata is the king of the country and head of the family. Therefore, you should never do anything disagreeable to him.

shloka_text: आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैश्चोपसेविताः। राजान स्सम्प्रसीदन्ति कुप्यन्तिच विपर्यये।।2.26.35।।
transliteration: ārādhitā hi śīlena prayatnaiścopasevitāḥ| rājāna ssamprasīdanti kupyantica viparyaye
translation: राजान: kings, शीलेन with good conduct, आराधिताः are gratified, प्रयत्नैः with endeavours, उपसेविताः having been served, सम्प्रसीदन्ति are satisfied, विपर्यये in contrary to that, कुप्यन्तिच are also enraged.
explanation: Kings are gratified if they are served with zeal and good conduct. If the contrary happens, they get provoked.

shloka_text: औरसानपि पुत्रान्हि त्यजन्त्यहितकारिणः। समर्थान्सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति जनानपि नराधिपाः।।2.26.36।।
transliteration: aurasānapi putrānhi tyajantyahitakāriṇaḥ| samarthānsampragṛhṇanti janānapi narādhipāḥ
translation: नराधिपाः kings, अहितकारिणः harmful men, औरसान् पुत्रानपि even their own sons, त्यजन्ति will abandon, समर्थान् capable men, जनानपि even other people, सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति accept.
explanation: Kings abandon (even) their own sons if they are harmful and receive capable people even if they are strangers.

shloka_text: सा त्वं वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञस्समनुवर्तिनी। भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा।।2.26.37।।
transliteration: sā tvaṃ vaseha kalyāṇi rājñassamanuvartinī| bharatasya ratā dharme satyavrataparāyaṇā
translation: कल्याणि O auspicious one, सा त्वम् so you, राज्ञः of the king, भरतस्य of  Bharata, समनुवर्तिनी an obedient lady, धर्मे in righteousness, रता absorbed one, सत्यव्रत परायणा following the truth and the vows, इह वस live here.
explanation: O auspicious one live here by being obedient to king Bharata. Absorbed in righteousness, follow truth and (religious) vows.

shloka_text: अहं गमिष्यामि महावनं प्रिये त्वया हि वस्तव्यमिहैव भामिनि। यथा व्यलीकं कुरुषे न कस्य चि त्तथा त्वया कार्यमिदं वचो मम।।2.26.38।।
transliteration: ahaṃ gamiṣyāmi mahāvanaṃ priye tvayā hi vastavyamihaiva bhāmini| yathā vyalīkaṃ kuruṣe na kasya ci ttathā tvayā kāryamidaṃ vaco mama
translation: प्रिये O beloved one, भामिनि beauty (Sita), अहम् I, महावनम् to the great forest, गमिष्यामि I am going, त्वया by you, इहैव here itself, कस्यचित् to any one, यथा in any way, व्यलीकम् harm, न कुरुषे would not do, तथा in that way, वस्तव्यम् you shall live here, मम my, इदं वचः these words, कार्यम् should be done.
explanation: O my beloved Sita I am going to the wild forest. Stay here and never cause displeasure to any one in any way. Could you carry out these words of mine? इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षड्विंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentysixth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही प्रियार्हा प्रियवादिनी। प्रणयादेव संक्रुद्धा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.27.1।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu vaidehī priyārhā priyavādinī| praṇayādeva saṃkruddhā bhartāramidamabravīt
translation: प्रियवादिनी speaking pleasant words, प्रियार्हा deserving affection, वैदेही Sita, एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, प्रणयादेव out of love, संक्रुद्धा mighty angry, भर्तारम् to her husband, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: When the sweettongued daughter of Videha (Sita) who deserved affection, heard this she was very angry out of her love (for Rama). She said these wordsto her husband (in reply):
comments: Sita prays Rama to take her along with him to the forest.

shloka_text: किमिदं भाषसे राम वाक्यं लघुतया ध्रुवम्। त्वया यदपहास्यं मे श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मज।।2.27.2।।
transliteration: kimidaṃ bhāṣase rāma vākyaṃ laghutayā dhruvam| tvayā yadapahāsyaṃ me śrutvā naravarātmaja
translation: नरवरात्मज O Prince, राम Rama, यत् since, लघुतया lightly, त्वया by you, ध्रुवम् certainly, अपहास्यम् fit to be ridiculed, श्रुत्वा having heard, मे to me (by me also), इदम् these, किं वाक्यम् what words, भाषसे are speaking.
explanation: O Rama why are you speaking so lightly? O prince if you hear these very same words (spoken to you), you will ridicule me.

shloka_text: आर्यपुत्र पिता माता भ्राता पुत्रस्तथा स्नुषा। स्वानि पुण्यानि भुञ्जानाः स्वं स्वं भाग्यमुपासते।।2.27.3।।
transliteration: āryaputra pitā mātā bhrātā putrastathā snuṣā| svāni puṇyāni bhuñjānāḥ svaṃ svaṃ bhāgyamupāsate
translation: आर्यपुत्र O son of a noble monarch, पिता father, माता mother, भ्राता brother, पुत्रः son, तथा also, स्नुषा daughterinlaw, स्वानि their own, पुण्यानि merits, भुञ्जानाः while enjoying, स्वं स्वम् due to each of them, भाग्यम् destiny, उपासते are receiving.
explanation: O son of a noble monarch father, mother, brother, son or daughterinlaw   (everybody) experiences the merit (of their past deeds) and receives what is due from destiny.

shloka_text: भर्तुर्भाग्यं तु भार्यैका प्राप्नोति पुरुषर्षभ। अतश्चैवाहमादिष्टा वने वस्तव्यमित्यपि।।2.27.4।।
transliteration: bharturbhāgyaṃ tu bhāryaikā prāpnoti puruṣarṣabha| ataścaivāhamādiṣṭā vane vastavyamityapi
translation: पुरुषर्षभ O best of men, (Rama), भर्तुर्भाग्यं the destiny of husband, एका only, भार्या wife, प्राप्नोति receives, अतश्च therefore, अहमपि I also, वने in the forest, वस्तव्यमिति should dwell, अदिष्टा एव ordered.
explanation: A wife alone, O best of men shares the destiny of her husband. I am also therefore, ordered to dwell in the forest. ( a command to you is a command to me).

shloka_text: न पिता नात्मजो नात्मा न माता न सखीजनः। इह प्रेत्य च नारीणां पतिरेको गतिस्सदा।।2.27.5।।
transliteration: na pitā nātmajo nātmā na mātā na sakhījanaḥ| iha pretya ca nārīṇāṃ patireko gatissadā
translation: पिता father, न not, आत्मजः son, न not, आत्मा own self, न not, माता mother, न not, सखीजनः friends, न not, नारीणाम् for women, इह here, प्रेत्य च in the next world also, सदा always, एकः alone, पतिः husband, गतिः is the ultimate refuge.
explanation: It is not her father or mother, nor her son or herself, nor her friends but her husband alone gives a woman the permanent refuge in this or in the next world.

shloka_text: यदि त्वं प्रस्थितो दुर्गं वनमद्यैव राघव। अग्रतस्ते गमिष्यामि मृद्नन्ती कुशकण्टकान्।।2.27.6।।
transliteration: yadi tvaṃ prasthito durgaṃ vanamadyaiva rāghava| agrataste gamiṣyāmi mṛdnantī kuśakaṇṭakān
translation: राघव son of the Raghus (Rama), अद्यैव now itself, त्वम् you, दुर्गम् impenetrable, वनम् forest, प्रस्थितः यदि if you set out, कुशकण्टकान् on thorns and on Kusa grass, मृद्नन्ती crushing, ते अग्रतः in front of you, गमिष्यामि I shall go.
explanation: O son of the Raghus if you set out for the impenetrable forest now itself, I shall also go, walking ahead of you and crushing the thorns and (spiky) kusa grass (rendering the path  comfortable for you to walk).

shloka_text: ईर्ष्यारोषौ बहिष्कृत्य भुक्तशेषमिवोदकम्। नय मां वीर विस्रब्धः पापं मयि न विद्यते।।2.27.7।।
transliteration: īrṣyāroṣau bahiṣkṛtya bhuktaśeṣamivodakam| naya māṃ vīra visrabdhaḥ pāpaṃ mayi na vidyate
translation: वीर O Valiant one, ईर्ष्यारोषौ anger and jealousy, भुक्तशेषम् leftover after drinking, उदकम् इव like water, बहिष्कृत्य dismissing, विस्रब्ध: without hesitation, माम् me, नय take me, मयि in me, पापम् fault, न विद्यते does not exist.
explanation: Do take me with you, O valiant one without hesitation. Dismiss all anger and envy (from your mind) like the leftover water after drinking (anger because she disobeys and envy because she, too, like Rama, is willing to brave the hazards of forest life). There is no fault on my part.

shloka_text: प्रासादाग्रैर्विमानैर्वा वैहायसगतेन वा। सर्वावस्थागता भर्तुः पादच्छाया विशिष्यते।।2.27.8।।
transliteration: prāsādāgrairvimānairvā vaihāyasagatena vā| sarvāvasthāgatā bhartuḥ pādacchāyā viśiṣyate
translation: प्रासादाग्रैः on top of mansions, विमानैर्वा or in lovely palaces, वैहायसगतेन वा moving in air, सर्वावस्थागता in all stages of  life, भर्तुः husband's, पादच्छाया shelter at his feet, विशिष्यते is preferable.
explanation: Every woman, everywhere be it on the top of mansions or in lovely palaces or flying in the sky should take shelter at his (her husband's) feet (or follow his footsteps).

shloka_text: अनुशिष्टाऽस्मि मात्रा च पित्रा च विविधाश्रयम्। नाऽस्मि सम्प्रति वक्तव्या वर्तितव्यं यथा मया।।2.27.9।।
transliteration: anuśiṣṭā'smi mātrā ca pitrā ca vividhāśrayam| nā'smi samprati vaktavyā vartitavyaṃ yathā mayā
translation: मात्रा च by mother, पित्रा च by father, विविधाश्रयम् with regard to diverse duties,  अनुशिष्टाअस्मि I have been instructed, मया by myself, यथा in such a way, वर्तितव्यम् to abide, संप्रति now, वक्तव्या नास्मि need not be told to me.
explanation: I have been so instructed by my parents about diverse duties in all stages of life that I need not be told anything (about my duties) now.

shloka_text: अहं दुर्गं गमिष्यामि वनं पुरुषवर्जितम्। नानामृगगणाकीर्णं शार्दूलवृकसेवितम्।।2.27.10।।
transliteration: ahaṃ durgaṃ gamiṣyāmi vanaṃ puruṣavarjitam| nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇaṃ śārdūlavṛkasevitam
translation: अहम् I, दुर्गम् impassable, पुरुषवर्जितम् uninhabited by men, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् teeming with various kinds of animals, शार्दूलवृकसेवितम् inhabited by tigers and wolves, वनम् forest, गमिष्यामि I shall go.
explanation: I will also go to the forest, which is impassable, uninhabited, teeming with various kinds of animals and infested with tigers and wolves.

shloka_text: सुखं वने निवत्स्यामि यथैव भवने पितुः। अचिन्तयन्ती त्रीन्लोकांश्च्चिन्तयन्ती पतिव्रतम्।।2.27.11।।
transliteration: sukhaṃ vane nivatsyāmi yathaiva bhavane pituḥ| acintayantī trīnlokāṃśccintayantī pativratam
translation: त्रीन् लोकान् the three worlds, अचिन्तयन्ती without thinking, पतिव्रतम् duties to the husband, चिन्तयन्ती while thinking, वने in the forest, पितुः father's, भवने in the palace, यथैव the same way, सुखम् happily, निवत्स्यामि I shall dwell.
explanation: Free from any anxiety about the three worlds, my only concern will be my duties towards my husband. I shall dwell as happily in the forest as I did in my father's abode.

shloka_text: शुश्रूषमाणा ते नित्यं नियता ब्रह्मचारिणी। सह रंस्ये त्वया वीर वनेषु मधुगन्धिषु।।2.27.12।।
transliteration: śuśrūṣamāṇā te nityaṃ niyatā brahmacāriṇī| saha raṃsye tvayā vīra vaneṣu madhugandhiṣu
translation: वीर O hero , नित्यम् always, ते to you, शुश्रूषमाणा doing service, नियता self possessed, ब्रह्मचारिणी observing vow of celibacy, मधुगन्धिषु honeyscented, वनेषु in forests, त्वया सह with you, रंस्ये I shall sport.
explanation: I shall wander with you, O heroic Rama in the honeyscented forest remaining selfpossessed, always doing  your service, and observing the vow of celibacy.

shloka_text: त्वं हि शक्तो वने कर्तुं राम सम्परिपालनम्। अन्यस्यापि जनस्येह किं पुनर्मम मानद।।2.27.13।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi śakto vane kartuṃ rāma samparipālanam| anyasyāpi janasyeha kiṃ punarmama mānada
translation: मानद O bestower of honour, राम Rama, त्वम् you, इह here, वने in the forest, अन्यस्य of others, जनस्य man's, सम्परिपालनमपि protection also, कर्तुम् to do, शक्त: हि is capable, मम about my protection, किं पुनः why again say?
explanation: O respector of individuals when you are capable of protecting other people in the forest, what of me?

shloka_text: सह त्वया गमिष्यामि वनमद्य न संशयः। नाहं शक्या महाभाग निवर्तयितुमुद्यता।।2.27.14।।
transliteration: saha tvayā gamiṣyāmi vanamadya na saṃśayaḥ| nāhaṃ śakyā mahābhāga nivartayitumudyatā
translation: अद्य today, त्वया सह along with you, वनम् to the forest, गमिष्यामि shall go, संशयः न no doubt about it, महाभाग O distinguished one, उद्यता resolved, अहम् I, निवर्तयितुम् to restrain, न शक्या not able.
explanation: There is no doudt that I shall go with you to the forest today. O distinguished one I cannot be restrained from this resolve.

shloka_text: फलमूलाशना नित्यं भविष्यामि न संशयः। न ते दुःखं करिष्यामि निवसन्ती सह त्वया।।2.27.15।।
transliteration: phalamūlāśanā nityaṃ bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ| na te duḥkhaṃ kariṣyāmi nivasantī saha tvayā
translation: नित्यम् always, फलमूलाशना living on fruits and roots, भविष्यामि I will become, संशयः  न no doubt, त्वया सह with you, निवसन्ती while living, ते to you, दुःखम् hardship, न करिष्यामि  will not do.
explanation: Do not doubt that I shall not be able to live on fruits and roots or that I will create difficulty for you while living with you.

shloka_text: इच्छामि सरितश्शैलान्पल्वलानि वनानि च। द्रष्टुं सर्वत्र निर्भीता त्वया नाथेन धीमता।।2.27.16।।
transliteration: icchāmi saritaśśailānpalvalāni vanāni ca| draṣṭuṃ sarvatra nirbhītā tvayā nāthena dhīmatā
translation: धीमता with the sagacious, नाथेन by my lord, त्वया along with you, सर्वत्र everywhere, निर्भीता  without fear, सरितः rivers, शैलान् mountains, पल्वलानि lakes and, वनानि च and the forests, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I wish.
explanation: Living with you sans fear, O my sagacious husband, I wish to see the rivers, mountains, lakes and forests here and there.

shloka_text: हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः पद्मिनीस्साधुपुष्पिताः। इच्छेयं सुखिनी द्रष्टुं त्वया वीरेण सङ्गता।।2.27.17।।
transliteration: haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇāḥ padminīssādhupuṣpitāḥ| iccheyaṃ sukhinī draṣṭuṃ tvayā vīreṇa saṅgatā
translation: वीरेण by a warrior (like you), त्वया with you, सङ्गता in company of, सुखिनी happy, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः abounding in swans and ducks, साधु पुष्पिताः fully bloomed, पद्मिनी: lotus ponds, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छेयम् I wish.
explanation: I wish to enjoy the lotus lakes in full bloom, abounding in swans and ducks in the company of a brave husband like you.

shloka_text: अभिषेकं करिष्यामि तासु नित्यं यतव्रता। सह त्वया विशालाक्ष रंस्ये परमनन्दिनी ।।2.27.18।।
transliteration: abhiṣekaṃ kariṣyāmi tāsu nityaṃ yatavratā| saha tvayā viśālākṣa raṃsye paramanandinī
translation: विशालाक्ष O largeeyed one, यतव्रता observing such vows, नित्यम् daily, तासु in those lotus ponds, अभिषेकम् bathing, करिष्यामि will take, परमनन्दिनी attaining great happiness, त्वया सह along with you, रंस्ये I will sport.
explanation: Observing such vows and bathing daily in the lotus lakes, I shall be very much happy to sport with you, O largeeyed one

shloka_text: एवं वर्षसहस्राणां शतं वाऽहं त्वया सह। व्यतिक्रमं न वेत्स्यामि स्वर्गोऽपि न हि मे मतः।।2.27.19।।
transliteration: evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ vā'haṃ tvayā saha| vyatikramaṃ na vetsyāmi svargo'pi na hi me mataḥ
translation: एवम् in this way, अहम् I, त्वया सह with you, वर्षसहस्राणाम्  a thousand years, शतं वापि or even a hundred thousand years (of living with you), व्यतिक्रमम् bassing of time, न वेत्स्यामि   I shall not feel, मे to me, स्वर्ग: अपि even heaven, न मतः हि is not desirable.
explanation: Thus living in your company for a thousand years or even  a hundred thousand years, I shall not feel the passing of time. I shall not desire even heaven.

shloka_text: स्वर्गेऽपि च विना वासो भविता यदि राघव। त्वया मम नरव्याघ्र नाहं तमपि रोचये।।2.27.20।।
transliteration: svarge'pi ca vinā vāso bhavitā yadi rāghava| tvayā mama naravyāghra nāhaṃ tamapi rocaye
translation: नरव्याघ्र O best of men, राघव Rama, त्वया विना without you, मम to me, स्वर्गेऽपि even in heaven, वासः living, भविता यदि if it were to happen, अहम् I, तमपि that one also, न रोचये I do not like.
explanation: O Raghava, tiger among men, if I were given heaven to live in without you, even that I shall not covet.

shloka_text: अहं गमिष्यामि वनं सुदुर्गमं मृगायुतं वानरवारणैर्युतम्। वने निवत्स्यामि यथा पितुर्गृहे तवैव पादावुपगृह्य संयता।।2.27.21।।
transliteration: ahaṃ gamiṣyāmi vanaṃ sudurgamaṃ mṛgāyutaṃ vānaravāraṇairyutam| vane nivatsyāmi yathā piturgṛhe tavaiva pādāvupagṛhya saṃyatā
translation: अहम् I, सुदुर्गमम् highly impenetrable, मृगायुतम् full of animals, वानरवारणैः with monkeys and elephants, वनम् to the forest, गमिष्यामि shall go, तव your, पादावेव feet alone, उपगृह्य taking refuge, संयता restraining myself, वने in the forest, पितुः father's, गृहे यथा like in his house, निवत्स्यामि I shall reside.
explanation: I shall go (along with you) to the highly impenetrable forest infested with animals like monkeys and elephants. I shall live in the forest in (full) discipline as in my father's abode, taking shelter at your feet.

shloka_text: अनन्यभावामनुरक्तचेतसं त्वया वियुक्तां मरणायनिश्चिताम्। नयस्व मां साधु कुरुष्व याचनाम् न ते मयाऽतो गुरुता भविष्यति।।2.27.22।।
transliteration: ananyabhāvāmanuraktacetasaṃ tvayā viyuktāṃ maraṇāyaniścitām| nayasva māṃ sādhu kuruṣva yācanām na te mayā'to gurutā bhaviṣyati
translation: अनन्यभावाम् without any other thought, अनुरक्तचेतसम् with heart deeply attached, त्वया by you, वियुक्ताम् separated (from you), मरणाय for death, निश्चिताम् resolved, माम् me, नयस्व take, याचनाम् my prayer, साधु be welldisposed, कुरुष्व do, अतः for that, ते for you, मया by me, गुरुता burden, न भविष्यति will not be.
explanation: Since I have no thought other than you and my heart is (irretrievably) attached to you I have resolved to die if separated from you. Pray, be favourably disposed to take me. I shall not be a burden to you.

shloka_text: तथा ब्रुवाणामपि धर्मवत्सलो न च स्म सीतां नृवरो निनीषति। उवाच चैनां बहु सन्निवर्तने वने निवासस्य च दुःखितां प्रति।।2.27.23।।
transliteration: tathā bruvāṇāmapi dharmavatsalo na ca sma sītāṃ nṛvaro ninīṣati| uvāca caināṃ bahu sannivartane vane nivāsasya ca duḥkhitāṃ prati
translation: धर्मवत्सलः devoted to righteousness, नृवरः best of men, तथा that way, ब्रूवाणामपि though speaking, सीताम् tp Sita, न निनीषति स्म was unwilling to take, सन्निवर्तने  to dissuade her, एनाम् to her, वने in the forest, निवासस्य of stay, दुःखितां प्रति to the grieved, बहु in many ways, उवाच च said.
explanation: Although Sita was thus appealing, Rama, devoted to righteousness, was (still) unwilling to take her. In order to dissuade her, he began to describe to the mournful Sita the many hardships of forest life. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyseventh sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स एवं ब्रुवतीं सीतां धर्मज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः। न नेतुं कुरुते बुद्धिं वने दुःखानि चिन्तयन्।।2.28.1।।
transliteration: sa evaṃ bruvatīṃ sītāṃ dharmajño dharmavatsalaḥ| na netuṃ kurute buddhiṃ vane duḥkhāni cintayan
translation: धर्मज्ञः knower of righteousness, धर्मवत्सलः devoted to righteousness, सः he, एवम् thus, ब्रुवतीम् speaking, सीताम् to Sita, नेतुम् to take, बुद्धिम् decision, वने in the forest, दुःखानि difficulties, चिन्तयन् while reflecting so, न कुरुते did not make.
explanation: Rama, who knew his duties and was devoted to righteousness, reflected on the difficulties of forest (life) and did not agree to take Sita even though she was pleading the way she did.
comments: Rama relates to Sita the hardships of forest life-- dissuades her from accompanying him to the forest.

shloka_text: सान्त्वयित्वा पुनस्तां तु बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम्। निवर्तनार्थे धर्मात्मा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।।2.28.2।।
transliteration: sāntvayitvā punastāṃ tu bāṣpadūṣitalocanām| nivartanārthe dharmātmā vākyametaduvāca ha
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous, बाष्पदूषितलोचनाम् whose eyes were blurred with tears, ताम् her, सान्त्वयित्वा having consoled, निवर्तनार्थे to dissuade, पुनः again, एतत् this, वाक्यम् word, उवाच ह said.
explanation: Righteous Rama consoled Sita whose eyes were blurred with tears, and in order to dissuade her (from going to the forest) said again:

shloka_text: सीते महाकुलीनाऽसि धर्मे च निरता सदा। इहाऽचर स्वधर्मं त्वं मे यथा मनसस्सुखम्।।2.28.3।।
transliteration: sīte mahākulīnā'si dharme ca niratā sadā| ihā'cara svadharmaṃ tvaṃ me yathā manasassukham
translation: सीते O Sita, महाकुलीना born in a noble race, सदा always, धर्मे to duty ,निरता असि you are devoted, इह here, यथा as, मे मनसः to my mind, सुखम् brings happiness, त्वम् you, स्वधर्मम् your duty, आचर practise.
explanation: Born in a noble race, O Sita, you are always devoted to duty. Follow your duty, here. It will make me happy.

shloka_text: सीते यथा त्वां वक्ष्यामि तथा कार्यं त्वयाऽबले। वने हि बहवो दोषा वदतस्तान्निबोध मे।।2.28.4।।
transliteration: sīte yathā tvāṃ vakṣyāmi tathā kāryaṃ tvayā'bale| vane hi bahavo doṣā vadatastānnibodha me
translation: अबले O frail one, सीते O Sita, त्वाम् you, यथा as, वक्ष्यामि I shall tell you, तथा like that, त्वया by you, कार्यम् should be done, वने in the forest, बहवः many, दोषाः हि hardships are there indeed, वदतः being told, मे by me, तान् about them, निबोध pray attention.
explanation: Do as I tell you, O delicate Sita. There are, indeed, many hardships in the forest. I shall tell you all about them. Listen to me.

shloka_text: सीते विमुच्यतामेषा वनवासकृता मतिः। बहुदोषं हि कान्तारं वनमित्यभिधीयते।।2.28.5।।
transliteration: sīte vimucyatāmeṣā vanavāsakṛtā matiḥ| bahudoṣaṃ hi kāntāraṃ vanamityabhidhīyate
translation: सीते O Sita, वनवासकृता to live in the forest, एषा this, मति: mind, विमुच्यताम् give up, कान्तारम् a dreary forest, वनम् forest, बहुदोषं (बहुदोषयुतं) has many hardships, अभिधीयते हि is being said.
explanation: Give up the desire to live in the forest, O Sita Living in the dreary jungle, it is said, has many hardships.

shloka_text: हितबुद्ध्या खलु वचो मयैतदभिधीयते। सदा सुखं न जानामि दुःखमेव सदा वनम्।।2.28.6।।
transliteration: hitabuddhyā khalu vaco mayaitadabhidhīyate| sadā sukhaṃ na jānāmi duḥkhameva sadā vanam
translation: मया by me, एतत् वचः these words, हितबुद्ध्या with prudence, अभिधीयते हि is being said, वनम् forest, सदा always, सुखम् as happy, न जानामि I do not know, सदा always, दुःखमेव grief only.
explanation: I am saying all this in your interest. The forest is a haven of hardships. I know of no happiness in the forest.

shloka_text: गिरिनिर्झरसम्भूता गिरिकन्दर वासिनाम्। सिंहानां निनदा दुःखा श्श्रोतुं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.7।।
transliteration: girinirjharasambhūtā girikandara vāsinām| siṃhānāṃ ninadā duḥkhā śśrotuṃ duḥkhamato vanam
translation: गिरिनिर्झरसम्भूताः arising from the falling waters from mountains, निनदाः sounds, गिरिकन्दर वासिनाम् living in the mountain caves, सिंहानाम् of lions, श्रोतुम् to hear, दुःखाः fearful, अतः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखम् source of  pain, दुःखमतो painful.
explanation: It is frightening to hear the sounds of  waterfalls and the roar of lions living in the mountain caves. Therefore forest life is painful (fearful).

shloka_text: क्रीडमानाश्च विस्रब्धा मत्ता श्शून्ये महामृगाः। दृष्ट्वा समभिवर्तन्ते सीते दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.8।।
transliteration: krīḍamānāśca visrabdhā mattā śśūnye mahāmṛgāḥ| dṛṣṭvā samabhivartante sīte duḥkhamato vanam
translation: विस्रब्धाः fearless, मत्ताः wild, शून्ये in a deserted place, क्रीडमानाः while sporting, महामृगाः great animals, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, समभिवर्तन्ते attack, सीते Sita, अतः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखम् is a source of danger.
explanation: Big, wild animals, moving about freely and sporting in the deserted forest, attack on seeing a human. Thus forest is full of danger.

shloka_text: सग्राहा स्सरितश्चैव पङ्कवत्यस्सु दुस्तराः। मत्तैरपि गजैर्नित्यमतो दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.9।।
transliteration: sagrāhā ssaritaścaiva paṅkavatyassu dustarāḥ| mattairapi gajairnityamato duḥkhataraṃ vanam
translation: सग्राहाः with crocodiles, पङ्कवत्यः च filled with mud, सरितश्चैव rivers also, मत्तै: intoxicated, गजैरपि by elephants also, दुस्तराः difficult to cross, अतः therefore, वनम् the forest, नित्यम् always, दुःखतरम् more dangerous.
explanation: The rivers, infested with crocodiles and filled with mud are difficult to cross even for elephants in rut. Hence forest life is always extremely dangerous.

shloka_text: लताकण्टकसङ्कीर्णाः कृकवाकूपनादिताः। निरपाश्च सुदुर्गाश्च मार्गा दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.10।।
transliteration: latākaṇṭakasaṅkīrṇāḥ kṛkavākūpanāditāḥ| nirapāśca sudurgāśca mārgā duḥkhamato vanam
translation: मार्गाः the paths, लताकण्टकसङ्कीर्णाः full of thorny creepers, कृकवाकूपनादिताः echoing with the noise of wild fowls, निरपाः with no water, सुदुर्गाः च are  extremely difficult to traverse, अतः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखम् is a difficult place.
explanation: . The paths full of thorny creepers, echoing with the noise of wild fowls, and with no water (to drink) are difficult to tread. So forest is a source of suffering.

shloka_text: सुप्यते पर्णशय्यासु स्वयं भग्नासु भूतले। रात्रिषु श्रमखिन्नेन तस्माद्दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.11।।
transliteration: supyate parṇaśayyāsu svayaṃ bhagnāsu bhūtale| rātriṣu śramakhinnena tasmādduḥkhataraṃ vanam
translation: स्वयम् on their own, भग्नासु broken (fallen), पर्णशय्यासु bed of leaves, भूतले on the ground, श्रमखिन्नेन exhausted with struggles, रात्रिषु at night, सुप्यते will have to sleep, तस्मात्  therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is extremely painful.
explanation: Exhausted with struggles one has to sleep at night on a bed of leaves fallen on their own on the ground. Therefore, forest life is extremely painful.

shloka_text: अहोरात्रं च सन्तोषः कर्तव्यो नियतात्मना। फलैर्वृक्षावपतितै स्सीते दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.12।।
transliteration: ahorātraṃ ca santoṣaḥ kartavyo niyatātmanā| phalairvṛkṣāvapatitai ssīte duḥkhamato vanam
translation: सीते O Sita, अहोरात्रम् night and day, नियतात्मना with senses under control, वृक्षावपतितैः fallen down the trees, फलैः with fruits, सन्तोषः satisfaction, कर्तव्यः to be derived, अतः therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखम् is full of suffering.
explanation: With the senses under control night and day, O Sita, one must be satisfied with the fruits fallen from trees. Therefore, forest life is full of suffering.

shloka_text: उपवासश्च कर्तव्यो यथा प्राणेन मैथिलि। जटाभारश्च कर्तव्यो वल्कलाम्बरधारिणा।।2.28.13।।
transliteration: upavāsaśca kartavyo yathā prāṇena maithili| jaṭābhāraśca kartavyo valkalāmbaradhāriṇā
translation: मैथिलि O Daughter of Mithila, यथाप्राणेन according to one's ability, उपवासश्च fasting also, कर्तव्यः has to be undertaken, वल्कलाम्बरधारिणा wearing robes of bark, जटाभारश्च also burden of matted hair, कर्तव्यः has to be borne.
explanation: One has to wear robes of bark and matted hair and take to fasting as long as one can, O daughter of Mithila

shloka_text: देवतानां पित्रूणां कर्तव्यं विधिपूर्वकम्। प्राप्तानामतिथीनां च नित्यशः प्रतिपूजनम्।।2.28.14।।
transliteration: devatānāṃ pitrūṇāṃ kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam| prāptānāmatithīnāṃ ca nityaśaḥ pratipūjanam
translation: देवतानाम् of devatas, पित्रूणां च also of ancestors, प्राप्तानाम् of those arrived, अतिथीनां च of guests also, विधिपूर्वकम् duly, नित्यशः always, प्रतिपूजनम् worship, कर्तव्यम् needs to be done.
explanation: One has to worship gods and ancestors according to tradition and extend hospitality to guests, (who arrive unexpectedly).

shloka_text: कार्यस्त्रिरभिषेकश्च काले काले च नित्यशः। चरता नियमेनैव तस्माद्धुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.15।।
transliteration: kāryastrirabhiṣekaśca kāle kāle ca nityaśaḥ| caratā niyamenaiva tasmāddhuḥkhataraṃ vanam
translation: नियमेनैव as per rule, चरता while wandering (like an ascetic), नित्यशः always, काले काले at prescribed hours, त्रिः three times, अभिषेकः bathing, कार्यः will have to be done, तस्मात् therefore, वनम् life in the forest, दुःखतरम् is extremely difficult.
explanation: One has to wander about all the while (like an ascetic) as per the customs and take ablutions three times a day at prescribed hours. Hence life in the forest is extremely hard.

shloka_text: उपहारश्च कर्तव्यः कुसुमै स्स्वयमाहृतैः। आर्षेण विधिना वेद्यां बाले दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.16।।
transliteration: upahāraśca kartavyaḥ kusumai ssvayamāhṛtaiḥ| ārṣeṇa vidhinā vedyāṃ bāle duḥkhamato vanam
translation: बाले O innocent one, स्वयम् on your own, आहृतैः has been brought, कुसुमैः with flowers, आर्षेण विधिना as per the injunction of the Vedas, वेद्याम् on the altar, उपहारश्च offering, कर्तव्यः needs to be made, अतः therefore, वनम् living in the forest, दुःखम् is difficult.
explanation: Flowers collected with one's own hands, O innocent one, should be offered on the altar as per injunction of the Vedas. Therefore (life in the) forest is difficult.

shloka_text: यथालब्धेन कर्तव्यः सन्तोषस्तेन मैथिलि। यताहारैर्वनचरै र्नित्यं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.17।।
transliteration: yathālabdhena kartavyaḥ santoṣastena maithili| yatāhārairvanacarai rnityaṃ duḥkhamato vanam
translation: मैथिलि O daughter of Mithila, वनचरैः by wanderers in the forest, यताहारैः with limited food, यथालब्धेन  whatever is available, तेन with that alone, सन्तोषः satisfaction, कर्तव्यः should be derived, अतः for that reason, वनम् forest life, दुःखम् is difficult.
explanation: The wanderers in the jungle, O daughter of Mithila, have to be satisfied daily with whatever little food is available. So forest (life) is a hard life.

shloka_text: अतीव वातास्तिमिरं बुभुक्षा चात्र नित्यशः। भयानि च महान्त्यत्र ततो दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.18।।
transliteration: atīva vātāstimiraṃ bubhukṣā cātra nityaśaḥ| bhayāni ca mahāntyatra tato duḥkhataraṃ vanam
translation: अत्र there (in the forest), वाताः wind, तिमिरम् darkness, अतीव is extreme, नित्यशः always, बुभुक्षा hunger, महान्ति great, भयानि च fears also, ततः therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is extremely difficult.
explanation: There is extreme wind and darkness, hunger and fear. Therefore forest (life) is difficult.

shloka_text: सरीसृपाश्च बहवो बहुरूपाश्च भामिनि। चरन्ति पृथिवीं दर्पात्ततो दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.19।।
transliteration: sarīsṛpāśca bahavo bahurūpāśca bhāmini| caranti pṛthivīṃ darpāttato duḥkhataraṃ vanam
translation: भामिनि O Beautiful lady, बहुरूपाः च of various forms too, बहवः many, सरीसृपाः च reptiles also, दर्पात् fiercely, पृथिवीम् on the ground, चरन्ति move about, ततः therefore, वनम् to live in the forest, दुःखतरं is extremely dangerous.
explanation: There are various forms of fierce reptiles fearlessly crawling on the ground. So (living in the) forest is extremely dangerous.

shloka_text: नदी निलयना स्सर्पा नदीकुटिलगामिनः। तिषठ्न्त्यावृत्य पन्थानं ततो दुःखतरं वनम्।।.2.28.20।।
transliteration: nadī nilayanā ssarpā nadīkuṭilagāminaḥ| tiṣaṭhntyāvṛtya panthānaṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ vanam||.2.28.20||
translation: नदी निलयनाः live in rivers, नदीकुटिलगामिनः meandering like rivers, सर्पाः serpents, पन्थानम् the path, आवृत्य having obstructed, तिष्ठन्ति stay, ततः therefore, वनम् life in the forest, दुःखतरम् is full of sufferings.
explanation: The serpents that live in and move like meandering rivers always obstruct  the paths. Therefore, living in the forest is tremendously difficult.

shloka_text: पतङ्गा वृश्चिकाः कीटा दंशाश्च मशकै स्सह। बाधन्ते नित्यमबले सर्वं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.21।।
transliteration: pataṅgā vṛścikāḥ kīṭā daṃśāśca maśakai ssaha| bādhante nityamabale sarvaṃ duḥkhamato vanam
translation: पतङ्गा: birds, वृश्चिकाः scorpions, कीटाः insects, मशकैः सह with mosquitoes, दंशाश्च gnats, नित्यम् always, सर्वम् everyone, बाधन्ते trouble,  अतः therefore, वनम् the life in forest, दुःखम् is a source of suffering.
explanation: Birds, scorpions, insects, gnats and mosquitoes always create trouble. Therefore, life in the forest is all suffering.

shloka_text: द्रुमाः कण्टकिनश्चैव कुशा: काशाश्च भामिनि। वने व्याकुलशाखाग्रास्तेन दुःखतरं वनम्।।2.28.22।।
transliteration: drumāḥ kaṇṭakinaścaiva kuśā: kāśāśca bhāmini| vane vyākulaśākhāgrāstena duḥkhataraṃ vanam
translation: भामिनि O lovely Sita, वने in the forest, द्रुमाः trees, कुशा काशाः च kusa grass and reeds,  कण्टकिनश्चैव thorny ones, व्याकुलशाखाग्राः with tops of branches interlaced with each other, तेन therefore, वनम् forest life, दुःखतरम् is full of difficulties.
explanation: O lovely Sita there are thorny trees with branches on the top interlaced with one another. There are kusa grass and reeds. So forest life is very hard.

shloka_text: कायक्लेशाश्च बहवो भयानि विविधानि च। अरण्यवासे वसतो दुःखमेव ततो वनम्।।2.28.23।।
transliteration: kāyakleśāśca bahavo bhayāni vividhāni ca| araṇyavāse vasato duḥkhameva tato vanam
translation: अरण्यवासे living in the forest, वसतः while living, बहवः many, कायक्लेशाः physical afflictions, विविधानि various, भयानि च fears, ततः therefore, वनम् forest, दुःखमेव is full of difficulties only.
explanation: There are various physical afflictions and fears for one who lives in the forest. Therefore, forest brings suffering.

shloka_text: क्रोधलोभौ विमोक्तव्यौ कर्तव्या तपसे मतिः। न भेतव्यं च भेतव्ये नित्यं दुःखमतो वनम्।।2.28.24।।
transliteration: krodhalobhau vimoktavyau kartavyā tapase matiḥ| na bhetavyaṃ ca bhetavye nityaṃ duḥkhamato vanam
translation: क्रोधलोभौ anger and greed, विमोक्तव्यौ should be given up, तपसे in asceticism, मतिः mind, कर्तव्या must be fixed, भेतव्ये even in alarming situations, न भेतव्यम् one should not be afraid, अतः therefore, वनम् life in the forest, नित्यम् always, दुःखम् full of misery.
explanation: Anger and greed have to be given up, with the mind preoccupied with ascetic practices. One should not be afraid of fearful situations. Hence forest (life) always very hard.

shloka_text: तदलं ते वनं गत्वा क्षमं न हि वनं तव। विमृशन्निह पश्यामि बहुदोषतरं वनम्।।2.28.25।।
transliteration: tadalaṃ te vanaṃ gatvā kṣamaṃ na hi vanaṃ tava| vimṛśanniha paśyāmi bahudoṣataraṃ vanam
translation: तत् for that reason, ते to you, वनम् to the forest, गत्वा going, अलम् is not desirable, तव for you, वनम् forest life, क्षमम् न हि is not fit, इह now, विमृशन् while reconsidering, वनम् forest life, बहुदोषतरम् is full of great dangers, पश्यामि I see.
explanation: Thus forest life is not suitable for you. On reconsideration, I see that there are many dangers in forest life.

shloka_text: वनन्तु नेतुं न कृता मतिस्तदा बभूव रामेण यदा महात्मना। न तस्य सीता वचनं चकार त त्ततोऽब्रवीद्राममिदं सुदुःखिता।।2.28.26।।
transliteration: vanantu netuṃ na kṛtā matistadā babhūva rāmeṇa yadā mahātmanā| na tasya sītā vacanaṃ cakāra ta ttato'bravīdrāmamidaṃ suduḥkhitā
translation: महात्मना by the great, रामेण by Rama, यदा when, वनम् to the forest, नेतुम् to take, मतिः mind (decision), कृता has been made, न बभूव did not happen, तदा then, सीता Sita, तस्य his, तत्  that, वचनं words, न चकार did not follow, ततः threafter, सुदुःखिता deeply grieved, रामम् to Rama, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: When the great Rama decided not to take her along with him to the forest, Sita, deeply grieved said these words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टाविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyeighth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of  the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्वा सीता रामस्य दुःखिता। प्रसक्ताश्रुमुखी मन्दमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.29.1।।
transliteration: etattu vacanaṃ śrutvā sītā rāmasya duḥkhitā| prasaktāśrumukhī mandamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: सीता Sita, रामस्य Rama's, एतत् these, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, दुःखिता sad, प्रसक्ताश्रुमुखी with tears flowing incessantly from her face, मन्दम् in a faint  voice, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard the words of Rama, thus spoke Sita in a faint voice in sadness, with tears flowing incessantly from her eyes:
comments: Sita insists on going with Rama

shloka_text: ये त्वया कीर्तिता दोषा वने वस्तव्यतां प्रति। गुणानित्येव तान्विद्धि तव स्नेहपुरस्कृतान्।।2.29.2।।
transliteration: ye tvayā kīrtitā doṣā vane vastavyatāṃ prati| guṇānityeva tānviddhi tava snehapuraskṛtān
translation: वने in the forest, वस्तव्यतां प्रति about dwelling in the forest, त्वया by you, ये those, दोषाः difficulties, कीर्तिताः described, तव your, स्नेहपुरस्कृतान् accompanied by your affection, तान् them, गुणानित्येव as virtues only, विद्धि understand.
explanation: Understand that the difficulties of forest life described by you will be turned into advantages if they are accompanied by your affection.

shloka_text: मृगा स्सिंहा गजाश्चैव शार्दूला श्शरभास्तथा। पक्षिण स्सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः।।2.29.3।। अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव। रूपं दृष्ट्वाऽपसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति।।2.29.4।।
transliteration: mṛgā ssiṃhā gajāścaiva śārdūlā śśarabhāstathā| pakṣiṇa ssṛmarāścaiva ye cānye vanacāriṇaḥ adṛṣṭapūrvarūpatvātsarve te tava rāghava| rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā'pasarpeyurbhaye sarve hi bibhyati
translation: राघव Rama, मृगाः antelopes, सिंहाः lions, गजाश्चैव elephants also, शार्दूला: tigers, तथा also, शरभाः sarabhas (a fabulous deer said to have eight legs), पक्षिणः birds, सृमराश्चैव srimaras (a kind of deer), अन्ये other, ये all, वनचारिणः wild beasts wandering in the forest, ते सर्वे all those, तव your, अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात् which had not been seen by you before, रूपम् your appearance, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing alone, अपसर्पेयुः will flee away, भये when fear arises, सर्वे all, बिभ्यति हि are afraid of.
explanation: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, who will not be afraid of seeing an object of fear?.

shloka_text: मृगा स्सिंहा गजाश्चैव शार्दूला श्शरभास्तथा। पक्षिण स्सृमराश्चैव ये चान्ये वनचारिणः।।2.29.3।। अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात्सर्वे ते तव राघव। रूपं दृष्ट्वाऽपसर्पेयुर्भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति।।2.29.4।।
transliteration: mṛgā ssiṃhā gajāścaiva śārdūlā śśarabhāstathā| pakṣiṇa ssṛmarāścaiva ye cānye vanacāriṇaḥ adṛṣṭapūrvarūpatvātsarve te tava rāghava| rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā'pasarpeyurbhaye sarve hi bibhyati
translation: राघव Rama, मृगाः antelopes, सिंहाः lions, गजाश्चैव elephants also, शार्दूला: tigers, तथा also, शरभाः sarabhas (a fabulous deer said to have eight legs), पक्षिणः birds, सृमराश्चैव srimaras (a kind of deer), अन्ये other, ये all, वनचारिणः wild beasts wandering in the forest, ते सर्वे all those, तव your, अदृष्टपूर्वरूपत्वात् which had not been seen by you before, रूपम् your appearance, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing alone, अपसर्पेयुः will flee away, भये when fear arises, सर्वे all, बिभ्यति हि are afraid of.
explanation: O scion of the Raghu race antelopes, lions, elephants, tigers, sarabhas, birds, srimaras and other wild beasts wandering in the forest have not seen your beauty before. Now on seeing you, they will flee away. In fact, who will not be afraid of seeing an object of fear?.

shloka_text: त्वया च सह गन्तव्यं मया गुरुजनाज्ञया। त्वद्वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यमिह जीवितम्।।2.29.5।।
transliteration: tvayā ca saha gantavyaṃ mayā gurujanājñayā| tvadviyogena me rāma tyaktavyamiha jīvitam
translation: गुरुजनाज्ञया with the command of elders, त्वया सह along with you, मया च गन्तव्यम् I should follow, राम Rama, त्वद्वियोगेन if separated from you, मे my, जीवितम् life, इह here, त्यक्तव्यम् will have to be given up.
explanation: In accordance with the command of the elders, I must accompany you to the forest. If I am separated from you, I will give up my life here itself.

shloka_text: न हि मां त्वत्समीपस्थामपि शक्नोतिराघव। सुराणामीश्वर श्शक्रः प्रधर्षयितुमोजसा।।2.29.6।।
transliteration: na hi māṃ tvatsamīpasthāmapi śaknotirāghava| surāṇāmīśvara śśakraḥ pradharṣayitumojasā
translation: राघव O Rama, त्वत्समीवस्थाम् in your company, माम् me, सुराणाम् for gods, ईश्वरः lord, शक्र:  अपि even Indra, ओजसा with his might, प्रधर्षयितुम् to injure, न शक्नोति will not be able
explanation: If I am  in your company, O Rama even the lord of the gods, Indra with all his might will not be able to hurt me.

shloka_text: पतिहीना तु या नारी न सा शक्ष्यति जीवितुम्। काममेवं विधं राम त्वया मम निदर्शितम्।।2.29.7।।
transliteration: patihīnā tu yā nārī na sā śakṣyati jīvitum| kāmamevaṃ vidhaṃ rāma tvayā mama nidarśitam
translation: या नारी a woman, पतिहीना without her husband, सा she, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यति cannot live, राम Rama, त्वया by you, कामम् greatly, एवं विधम् in this manner, मम to me, निदर्शितम्  has been illustrated.
explanation: Your salutary instruction to me, O Rama, is 'A woman cannot live without her husband'. This truth is greatly applicable to me.

shloka_text: अथ चापि महाप्राज्ञ ब्राह्मणानां मया श्रुतम्। पुरा पितृगृहे सत्यं वस्तव्यं किल मे वने।।2.29.8।।
transliteration: atha cāpi mahāprājña brāhmaṇānāṃ mayā śrutam| purā pitṛgṛhe satyaṃ vastavyaṃ kila me vane
translation: महाप्राज्ञ O Sagacious one, अथ चापि moreover, पुरा formerly, पितृगृहे at my father's  house, मया by me, ब्राह्माणानाम् brahmins' (word), श्रुतम् has been heard, मे about me, सत्यम् in sooth, वने in the forest, वस्तव्यं किल to dwell certainly.
explanation: O highly sagacious Rama  I had also heard in my father's house long ago, from brahmins prophesing that some day I shall have certainly to dwell in the forest.

shloka_text: लक्षणिभ्यो द्विजातिभ्य श्शृत्वाऽहं वचनं पुरा। वनवासकृतोत्साहा नित्यमेव महाबल।।2.29.9।।
transliteration: lakṣaṇibhyo dvijātibhya śśṛtvā'haṃ vacanaṃ purā| vanavāsakṛtotsāhā nityameva mahābala
translation: महाबल O mighty one, अहम् I, पुरा long ago, लक्षणिभ्यः from palmist, द्विजातिभ्यः from brahmins, वचनम् words, शृत्वा having heard, नित्यमेव always, वनवासकृतोत्साहा I have become eager to dwell in the forest.
explanation: O mighty hero ever since I heard the prophesies from the brahmin palmists I am yearning to dwell in the forest.

shloka_text: आदेशो वनवासस्य प्राप्तव्य स्स मया किल। सा त्वया सह तत्राहं यास्यामि प्रिय नान्यथा।।2.29.10।।
transliteration: ādeśo vanavāsasya prāptavya ssa mayā kila| sā tvayā saha tatrāhaṃ yāsyāmi priya nānyathā
translation: प्रिय O beloved Rama, मया by me, वनवासस्य to dwell in the forest, सः आदेशः such orders, प्राप्तव्यः किल certainly needs to be obtained, सा अहम् such I am, त्वया सह along with you, तत्र there, यास्यामि I shall accompany, अन्यथा न not otherwise.
explanation: Therefore, O my beloved I must certainly obtain such a command to dwell in the forest. I must accompany you to the forest and it cannot be otherwise.

shloka_text: कृतादेशा भविष्यामि गमिष्यामि सह त्वया। कालश्चायं समुत्पन्न स्सत्यवाग्भवतु द्विजः।।2.29.11।।
transliteration: kṛtādeśā bhaviṣyāmi gamiṣyāmi saha tvayā| kālaścāyaṃ samutpanna ssatyavāgbhavatu dvijaḥ
translation: कृतादेशा carrying out the orders, भविष्यामि I shall become, त्वया सह along with you, गमिष्यामि shall go, अयम् this, कालश्च time, समुत्पन्नः has come, द्विज: brahmin, सत्यवाक् true to his words, भवतु let him be.
explanation: I will go with you, true to the prediction of the brahmin. That time has come and let his prediction come to pass.

shloka_text: वनवासेऽभिजानामि दुःखानि बहुथा किल। प्राप्यन्ते नियतं वीर पुरुषैरकृतात्मभिः।।2.29.12।।
transliteration: vanavāse'bhijānāmi duḥkhāni bahuthā kila| prāpyante niyataṃ vīra puruṣairakṛtātmabhiḥ
translation: वीर O valiant one, वनवासे while residing in the forest, दुःखानि hardships, बहुथा किल  certainly of every kind, अभिजानामि I am aware, अकृतात्मभिः by those whose senses are not under their control, पुरुषैः by men, नियतम् definitely, प्राप्यन्ते will be experienced.
explanation: I am aware, O valiant one, that there are hardships of every  kind in forest life. But they befall those whose senses are not under their  control.

shloka_text: कन्यया च पितुर्गेहे वनवास श्शृतो मया। भिक्षिण्या स्साधुवृत्ताया मम मातुरिहाग्रतः।।2.29.13।।
transliteration: kanyayā ca piturgehe vanavāsa śśṛto mayā| bhikṣiṇyā ssādhuvṛttāyā mama māturihāgrataḥ
translation: पितुः father's, गेहे in the house, कन्यया when I was young, मया by me, मम मातुः my mother's, अग्रतः in the presence, साधुवृत्तायाः a saint, भिक्षिण्या a female mendicant, इह  in this world, वनवासः forest life, श्रुतः heard.
explanation: When I was young in my father's house, a holy female mendicant foretold in the presence of my mother that I would dwell in the forest (in this life).

shloka_text: प्रसादितश्च वै पूर्वं त्वं मे बहुतिथं प्रभो। गमनं वनवासस्य काङ्क्षितं हि सह त्वया।।2.29.14।।
transliteration: prasāditaśca vai pūrvaṃ tvaṃ me bahutithaṃ prabho| gamanaṃ vanavāsasya kāṅkṣitaṃ hi saha tvayā
translation: प्रभो O Lord, पूर्वम् in the past, त्वम् you, बहुतिथम् for a long time, मे for me, प्रसादितश्च वै  favoured, त्वया सह along with you, वनवासस्य गमनम् to go to the forest, काङ्क्षितं हि is wished for.
explanation: Pleased with my long entreaties in the past  to dwell with you in the forest, O lord, you had granted my desire.

shloka_text: कृतक्षणाऽहं भद्रं ते गमनं प्रति राघव। वनवासस्य शूरस्य चर्या हि मम रोचते।।2.29.15।।
transliteration: kṛtakṣaṇā'haṃ bhadraṃ te gamanaṃ prati rāghava| vanavāsasya śūrasya caryā hi mama rocate
translation: राघव Rama, ते to you, वनवासस्य of forest life, गमनं प्रति about departure, अहम् I, कृतक्षणा counting time, ते भद्रम् prosperity to you, शूरस्य of a valiant one,  चर्या movement, मम to me, रोचते हि is pleasing.
explanation: Since then I have been counting time for this forest life. It pleases me to follow my valiant hero as he lives in the forest. Rama, prosperity to you

shloka_text: शुद्धात्मन्प्रेमभावाध्दि भविष्यामि विकल्मषा। भर्तारमनुगच्छन्ती भर्ता हि मम दैवतम्।।2.29.16।।
transliteration: śuddhātmanpremabhāvādhdi bhaviṣyāmi vikalmaṣā| bhartāramanugacchantī bhartā hi mama daivatam
translation: शुद्धात्मन् O purehearted one, प्रेमभावात् with feeling of love, भर्तारम् husband, अनुगच्छन्ती following, विकल्मषा sinless, भविष्यामि I shall become, भर्ता husband, मम to me, दैवतं हि is a god.
explanation: O my purehearted one by following my husband with love I shall become sinless, because my husband is my god.

shloka_text: प्रेत्यभावे हि कल्याण स्सङ्गमो मे सह त्वया। श्रुतिर्हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानां यशस्विनाम्।।2.29.17।। इहलोके च पितृभिर्या स्त्री यस्य महामते। अद्भिर्दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्यभावेऽपि तस्य सा।।2.29.18।।
transliteration: pretyabhāve hi kalyāṇa ssaṅgamo me saha tvayā| śrutirhi śrūyate puṇyā brāhmaṇānāṃ yaśasvinām ihaloke ca pitṛbhiryā strī yasya mahāmate| adbhirdattā svadharmeṇa pretyabhāve'pi tasya sā
translation: प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, त्वया सह with you, मे to me, कल्याणः auspiciousness, सङ्गमः union, यशस्विनाम् by the famous, ब्राह्मणानाम् brahmins', पुण्या pious, श्रुतिः statement from the Vedas, श्रूयते is heard, महामते O highminded one, या स्त्री that woman, इह लोके in this world, पितृभिः by parents, यस्य to whom, स्वधर्मेण in accordance with one's own tradition, अद्भि: with waters, दत्ता is given, प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, सा she, तस्य belongs to him.
explanation: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.

shloka_text: प्रेत्यभावे हि कल्याण स्सङ्गमो मे सह त्वया। श्रुतिर्हि श्रूयते पुण्या ब्राह्मणानां यशस्विनाम्।।2.29.17।। इहलोके च पितृभिर्या स्त्री यस्य महामते। अद्भिर्दत्ता स्वधर्मेण प्रेत्यभावेऽपि तस्य सा।।2.29.18।।
transliteration: pretyabhāve hi kalyāṇa ssaṅgamo me saha tvayā| śrutirhi śrūyate puṇyā brāhmaṇānāṃ yaśasvinām ihaloke ca pitṛbhiryā strī yasya mahāmate| adbhirdattā svadharmeṇa pretyabhāve'pi tasya sā
translation: प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, त्वया सह with you, मे to me, कल्याणः auspiciousness, सङ्गमः union, यशस्विनाम् by the famous, ब्राह्मणानाम् brahmins', पुण्या pious, श्रुतिः statement from the Vedas, श्रूयते is heard, महामते O highminded one, या स्त्री that woman, इह लोके in this world, पितृभिः by parents, यस्य to whom, स्वधर्मेण in accordance with one's own tradition, अद्भि: with waters, दत्ता is given, प्रेत्यभावेऽपि even after death, सा she, तस्य belongs to him.
explanation: My union with you, O highminded one, is auspicious even beyond death. A woman, given away by her parents in accordance with traditional offerings of water belongs to him even after death and lives with him. This is a statement from the Vedas quoted by famous brahmins.

shloka_text: एवमस्मात्स्वकां नारीं सुवृत्तां हि पतिव्रताम्। नाभिरोचयसे नेतुं त्वं मां केनेह हेतुना।।2.29.19।।
transliteration: evamasmātsvakāṃ nārīṃ suvṛttāṃ hi pativratām| nābhirocayase netuṃ tvaṃ māṃ keneha hetunā
translation: त्वम् you, केन हेतुना for what reason, इह now, एवम् this way, सुवृत्ताम् a woman of good conduct, पतिव्रताम् faithful and loyal wife, स्वकां नारीम् your own woman, माम् me, अस्मात्  from this place, नेतुम् to take, नाभिरोचयसे you are not willing.
explanation: Why don't you want to take to the forest your own wife who is loyal and devoted, and is of good conduct.

shloka_text: भक्तां पतिव्रतां दीनां मां समां सुखदुःखयोः। नेतुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ समान सुखदुःखिनीम्।।2.29.20।।
transliteration: bhaktāṃ pativratāṃ dīnāṃ māṃ samāṃ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ| netumarhasi kākutstha samāna sukhaduḥkhinīm
translation: काकुत्थ्स O descendant of Kakutstha, भक्ताम् devotee, पतिव्रताम् faithful to the husband, दीनां distressed, सुखदुःखयोः in happines and sorrow, समाम् having equal disposition, समान सुख दुःखिनीम् equally share your prosperity and adversity, माम् me, नेतुम् अर्हसि should take.
explanation: O Rama, I am faithful and devoted to you. I have equal disposition to happiness and sorrow. I equally share your prosperity and adversity. Therefore, you should  take your wife (to the forest). In this time of distress.

shloka_text: ययदि मां दुःखितामेवं वनं नेतुं न चेच्छसि। विषमग्निं जलं वाऽहमास्थास्ये मृत्युकारणात्।।2.29.21।।
transliteration: yayadi māṃ duḥkhitāmevaṃ vanaṃ netuṃ na cecchasi| viṣamagniṃ jalaṃ vā'hamāsthāsye mṛtyukāraṇāt
translation: एवम् in this, दुःखिताम् distressed, माम् me, वनम् to the forest, नेतुम् to take, न च इच्छसि यदि if you do not wish, मृत्युकारणात् to seek death, विषम् poison, अग्निम् fire, जलं वा or water, आस्थास्ये I shall take refuge.
explanation: If you do not wish to take your wife in this time of distress to the forest I shall die by consuming poison or throwing myself into fire or drowning in water.

shloka_text: एवं बहुविधं तं सा याचते गमनं प्रति। नानुमेने महाबाहुस्तां नेतुं विजनं वनम्।।2.29.22।।
transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ taṃ sā yācate gamanaṃ prati| nānumene mahābāhustāṃ netuṃ vijanaṃ vanam
translation: एवम् in this way, सा she, गमनं प्रति about her departure, बहुविधम् in several ways, तम् him, याचते requested, महाबाहुः mightyarmed Rama, ताम् her, विजनम् desolate, वनम् forest, नेतुम्  to take, नानुमेने did not consent.
explanation: Despite Sita's  pleadings with him in various ways the mightyarmed Rama would not consent to take her to the desolate forest.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता तु सा चिन्तां मैथिली समुपागता। स्नापयन्तीव गामुष्णैरश्रुभिर्नयनच्युतैः।।2.29.23।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu sā cintāṃ maithilī samupāgatā| snāpayantīva gāmuṣṇairaśrubhirnayanacyutaiḥ
translation: एवम् in this way, उक्ता spoken, सा मैथिली that daughter from Mithila, नयनच्युतैः fallen from her eyes, उष्णैः by warm, अश्रुभिः tears, गाम् the ground, स्नापयन्तीव as if drenching, चिन्ताम् grief, समुपागता obtained.
explanation: Thus spoken to (prevented), Sita was filled with grief and cried, drenching the ground with warm tears that fell from her eyes.

shloka_text: चिन्तयन्तीं तथा तां तु निवर्तयितुमात्मवान्। ताम्रोष्ठीं स तदा सीतां काकुत्स्थो बह्वसान्त्वयत्।।2.29.24।।
transliteration: cintayantīṃ tathā tāṃ tu nivartayitumātmavān| tāmroṣṭhīṃ sa tadā sītāṃ kākutstho bahvasāntvayat
translation: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, सः काकुत्स्थ: that scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, तथा that way, चिन्तयन्तीम् grieving, ताम्रोष्ठीम् to the lady with copperred lips, तां सीताम् to that Sita, तदा then, निवर्तयितम् to dissuade her (from going to the forest), बहु many ways, असान्त्वयत् consoled.
explanation: That selfpossessed scion of the Kakutstha dynasty consoled the copperredlipped Sita in several ways to dissuade her (from going to the forest). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyninth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सान्त्व्यमाना तु रामेण मैथिली जनकात्मजा। वनवासनिमित्ताय भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.30.1।।
transliteration: sāntvyamānā tu rāmeṇa maithilī janakātmajā| vanavāsanimittāya bhartāramidamabravīt
translation: वनवासनिमित्ताय for stay in forest, रामेण by Rama, सान्त्व्यमाना consoled, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, मैथिली Maithili, भर्तारम्   to husband, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: In response to Rama's consolation with regard to her stay in the forest, the daughter of Janaka, Maithili (Sita) said:
comments: Rama consents to take Sita to the forest--instructs her to distribute their precious possessions on the eve of their departure

shloka_text: सा तमुत्तमसंविग्ना सीता विपुलवक्षसम्। प्रणयाच्चाभिमानाच्च परिचिक्षेप राघवम्।।2.30.2।।
transliteration: sā tamuttamasaṃvignā sītā vipulavakṣasam| praṇayāccābhimānācca paricikṣepa rāghavam
translation: उत्तमसंविग्ना agitated for  a supreme cause, सा सीता that Sita, विपुल वक्षसम् man of broadchested, राघवम् scion of the Raghu dynasty, प्रणयात् out of love, अभिमानाच्च injured selfrespect, परिचिक्षेप blamed.
explanation: Sita agitated over a supreme cause upbraided the broadchested scion of the Raghu race out of love and injured selfrespect.

shloka_text: किं त्वाऽमन्यत वैदेहः पिता मे मिथिलाधिपः। राम जामातरं प्राप्य स्त्रियं पुरुषविग्रहम्।।2.30.3।।
transliteration: kiṃ tvā'manyata vaidehaḥ pitā me mithilādhipaḥ| rāma jāmātaraṃ prāpya striyaṃ puruṣavigraham
translation: राम O Rama, पुरुषविग्रहम् in the form of a man, स्त्रियम् a woman, त्वा you, जामातरम् as  soninlaw, प्राप्य having obtained, मिथिलाधिपः king of Mithila, वैदेहः lord of Videha, मे पिता my father, किम् what, अमन्यत thought of.
explanation: O Rama while accepting you as soninlaw did my father, king of Mithila and lord of Videha ever think that you are a woman in the guise of a man?

shloka_text: अनृतं बत लोकोऽयमज्ञानाद्यदि वक्ष्यति। तेजो नास्ति परं रामे तपतीव दिवाकरे।।2.30.4।।
transliteration: anṛtaṃ bata loko'yamajñānādyadi vakṣyati| tejo nāsti paraṃ rāme tapatīva divākare
translation: तपति in a blazing, दिवाकरे इव like in the Sun, रामे in Rama, परम् great, तेजः splendour, नास्ति is not  to be found, अयं लोकः this world, अज्ञानात् out of ignorance, वक्ष्यति यदि if they say so, then that one, अनृतम् is a falsehood, बत alas
explanation: Alas that will be a falschood if people out of ignorance say that there is no supreme splendour in Rama like the shining Sun.

shloka_text: किं हि कृत्वा विषण्णस्त्वं कुतो वा भयमस्ति ते। यत्परित्यक्तुकामस्त्वं मामनन्यपरायणाम्।।2.30.5।।
transliteration: kiṃ hi kṛtvā viṣaṇṇastvaṃ kuto vā bhayamasti te| yatparityaktukāmastvaṃ māmananyaparāyaṇām
translation: त्वम् you, अनन्यपरायणाम् with none else as her refuge, माम् me, परित्यक्तुकामः (इति) यत् that you want to desert, त्वम् you, किं हि कृत्वा for what reason, विषण्णः depressed,  ते to you, कुतः वा from where, भयम् fear, अस्ति exists.
explanation: What may be the cause for your fear and depression behind your desire to desert one who is so exclusively devoted to you?

shloka_text: द्युमत्सेनसुतं वीर सत्यवन्तमनुव्रताम्। सावित्रीमिव मां विद्धि त्वमात्मवशवर्तिनीम्।।2.30.6।।
transliteration: dyumatsenasutaṃ vīra satyavantamanuvratām| sāvitrīmiva māṃ viddhi tvamātmavaśavartinīm
translation: वीर O valiant one, माम् me, द्युमत्सेन सुतम् son of Dyumatsena, सत्यवन्तम् Satyavanta, अनुव्रताम् faithfully following, सावित्रीमिव like Savitri, आत्मवशवर्तिनीम् remaining under your subordination, विद्धि know.
explanation: Know, O valiant one, that by remaining subordinate to you, I am as faithful to you as Savitri was to her husband, Satyavanta, son of Dyumatsena.

shloka_text: न त्वहं मनसाऽप्यन्यं द्रष्टाऽस्मि त्वदृतेऽनघ। त्वया राघव गच्छेयं यथाऽन्या कुलपांसिनी।।2.30.7।।
transliteration: na tvahaṃ manasā'pyanyaṃ draṣṭā'smi tvadṛte'nagha| tvayā rāghava gaccheyaṃ yathā'nyā kulapāṃsinī
translation: अनघ O sinless one, राघव Rama, कुलपांसनी a woman who bring disgrace to the family, अन्या यथा like any other ordinary woman, अहम् I, त्वदृते except you, अन्यम् other one, मनसापि even in mind, न द्रष्टास्मि not see, त्वया with you, गच्चेयम् I shall go to the forest.
explanation: O sinless son of the Raghus I am not like other women who bring disgreace to the family. I have not looked at any one except you, even with my mind's eye. I will go (to the forest) along with you.

shloka_text: स्वयं तु भार्यां कौमारीं चिरमध्युषितां सतीम्। शैलूष इव मां राम परेभ्यो दातुमिच्छसि।।2.30.8।।
transliteration: svayaṃ tu bhāryāṃ kaumārīṃ ciramadhyuṣitāṃ satīm| śailūṣa iva māṃ rāma parebhyo dātumicchasi
translation: राम O Rama कौमारीम् young, चिरम् for a long time, अध्युषिताम् living with you, सतीम् chaste, भार्याम् wife, माम् me, शैलूषः इव like an actor, स्वयम् on your own accord, परेभ्यः to others, दातुम् to give, इच्छसि wish.
explanation: I have been living with you for a long time, O Rama I am young and chaste. Why do you, like an actor, wish to hand me over to others.

shloka_text: यस्य पथ्यं च रामाऽत्थ यस्य चार्थेऽवरुध्यसे। त्वं तस्य भव वश्यश्च विधेयश्च सदाऽनघ।।2.30.9।।
transliteration: yasya pathyaṃ ca rāmā'ttha yasya cārthe'varudhyase| tvaṃ tasya bhava vaśyaśca vidheyaśca sadā'nagha
translation: अनघ O sinless, राम O Rama यस्य whose, पथ्यम् welfare, आत्थ are speaking, यस्य च अर्थे on account of whom, अवरुध्यसे you are preventing me, त्वम् you, तस्य for him, सदा always, वश्यः च subservient, विधेयः च also obedient, भव shall be.
explanation: You, O sinless Rama, may become subservient and obedient to them about whose wellfare you are speaking of and on account of whom you are preventing me to go (along with you).

shloka_text: स मामनादाय वनं न त्वं प्रस्थातुमर्हसि। तपो वा यदि वाऽरण्यं स्वर्गो वा स्यात्सह मे त्वया।।2.30.10।।
transliteration: sa māmanādāya vanaṃ na tvaṃ prasthātumarhasi| tapo vā yadi vā'raṇyaṃ svargo vā syātsaha me tvayā
translation: सः त्वम् such as you, माम् me, अनादाय without taking me, वनम् to the forest, प्रस्थातुम् to set forth, नार्हसि it does not behove you, तपो वा either for penance, यदि वा or, अरण्यम् to forest, स्वर्गो वा or to heaven, मे me, त्वया सह स्यात् to be with you.
explanation: You should not depart for the forest without taking me. Be it for penance or for the forest or for heaven, I wish to be with you.

shloka_text: न च मे भविता तत्र कश्चित्पथि परिश्रमः। पृष्ठतस्तव गच्छन्त्या विहारशयनेष्विव।।2.30.11।।
transliteration: na ca me bhavitā tatra kaścitpathi pariśramaḥ| pṛṣṭhatastava gacchantyā vihāraśayaneṣviva
translation: तव your, पृष्ठतः behind, गच्छन्त्याः going, मे to me, तत्र there, पथि on the way, विहारशयनेष्विव on a pleasure stroll or in a (luxurious) couch, कश्चित् even a little, परिश्रमः strain, न भविता will not be.
explanation: While following you, I will feel no fatigue there on the way as if I am going on a pleasurestroll or in a comfortable couch.

shloka_text: कुशकाशशरेषीका ये च कण्टकिनो द्रुमाः। तूलाजिनसमस्पर्शा मार्गे मम सह त्वया।।2.30.12।।
transliteration: kuśakāśaśareṣīkā ye ca kaṇṭakino drumāḥ| tūlājinasamasparśā mārge mama saha tvayā
translation: त्वया सह along with you, मार्गे on the way, कुशकाशशरेषीकाः Kusha, white reeds, Sara and  Ishika grasses, कण्टकिनः thorny, ये द्रुमाः च other trees, तूलाजिन समस्पर्शाः shall feel like the touch of cotton and the skin of a black antelope.
explanation: The white reeds, the kusha, the sara and the ishika grasses and thorny trees on the way will feel as soft as cotton or as the skin of a black antelope.

shloka_text: महावातसमुद्धूतं यन्मामपकरिष्यति। रजो रमण तन्मन्ये परार्थ्यमिव चन्दनम्।।2.30.13।।
transliteration: mahāvātasamuddhūtaṃ yanmāmapakariṣyati| rajo ramaṇa tanmanye parārthyamiva candanam
translation: रमण O Charming one महावातसमुद्धूतम् raised by the stormy wind, यत् which, रजः dust, माम् me, अपकरिष्यति will harm, तत् that one, परार्थ्यम् most excellent, चन्दनम् इव like sandal powder, मन्ये shall consider.
explanation: I shall regard, O charming Rama, the harmful dust raised by the stormy wind and settled on me as the most excellent sandal powder.

shloka_text: शाद्वलेषु यथा शिश्ये वनान्ते वनगोचर। कुथास्तरणतल्पेषु किं स्यात्सुखतरं ततः।।2.30.14।।
transliteration: śādvaleṣu yathā śiśye vanānte vanagocara| kuthāstaraṇatalpeṣu kiṃ syātsukhataraṃ tataḥ
translation: वनगोचर Rover of the forest, वनान्ते on the outskirts of the forest,  शाद्वलेषु on the meadows (of tender green grass), यथा as, शिश्ये I will lie down, ततः more than that, कुथास्तरणतल्पेषु in the couch spread with carpets, सुखतरम् more comfortable, स्यात्किम् what shall be?
explanation: O rover of the forest I will feel happier when I sleep on the meadows (of tender green grass) on the outskirts of the forest than when I sleep on the couch spread with carpets.

shloka_text: पत्रं मूलं फलं यत्त्वमल्पं वा यदि वा बहु। दास्यसि स्वयमाहृत्य तन्मेऽमृतरसोपमम्।।2.30.15।।
transliteration: patraṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ yattvamalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu| dāsyasi svayamāhṛtya tanme'mṛtarasopamam
translation: त्वम् you, यत् whichever, पत्रम् leaf, मूलम् root, फलम् fruit, अल्पं वा even a little, यदि वा or,  बहु much, स्वयम् on your own, आहृत्य having collected, दास्यसि you will give me, तत् that one, मे to me, अमृतरसोपमम् like nectar, (भवेत् shall become).
explanation: Whatever leaves or roots or fruits you collect with your own hands for me little or much, they will be nectar to me.

shloka_text: न मातुर्न पितुस्तत्र स्मरिष्यामि न वेश्मनः। आर्तवान्युपभुञ्जाना पुष्पाणि च फलानि च।।2.30.16।।
transliteration: na māturna pitustatra smariṣyāmi na veśmanaḥ| ārtavānyupabhuñjānā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
translation: तत्र there, आर्तवानि seasonal, पुष्पाणि flowers, फलानि च also fruits, उपभुञ्जाना while enjoying, मातुः mother, न स्मरिष्यामि will not remember, पितुः न not about father, वेश्मनः  about home, न will not.
explanation: Enjoying the seasonal flowers and fruits in the forest, I will not remember my mother or father or home.

shloka_text: न च तत्र ततः किञ्चिद्द्रष्टुमर्हसि विप्रियम्। मत्कृते न च ते शोको न भविष्यामि दुर्भरा।।2.30.17।।
transliteration: na ca tatra tataḥ kiñciddraṣṭumarhasi vipriyam| matkṛte na ca te śoko na bhaviṣyāmi durbharā
translation: ततः for that reason, तत्र there, किञ्चित् even a little, विप्रियम् unpleasant, द्रष्टुम् to see, नार्हसि does not behove you, मत्कृते on my account, ते to you, शोकः sorrow, न will not come, दुर्भरा burden, न भविष्यामि I will not be.
explanation: Therefore, you should not anticipate any problem from me in the forest. Neither shall I be burdensome to you nor shall I make you experience any sorrow on my account.

shloka_text: य स्त्वया सह स स्वर्गो निरयो यस्त्वया विना। इति जानन्परां प्रीतिं गच्छ राम मया सह।।2.30.18।।
transliteration: ya stvayā saha sa svargo nirayo yastvayā vinā| iti jānanparāṃ prītiṃ gaccha rāma mayā saha
translation: त्वया सह in your company, यः that  which is obtained, सः that alone, स्वर्गः is heaven, त्वया विना without you, निरयः is hell, इति thus, जानन् while being aware, राम Rama, मया सह along with me, पराम् great, प्रीतिम् pleasure, गच्छ obtain.
explanation: Wherever I be with you is heaven and without, hell. O Rama, recognise this truth, and derive great pleasure in my company.

shloka_text: अथ मामेवमव्यग्रां वनं नैव नयिष्यति। विषमद्यैव पास्यामि मा विशं द्विषतां गमम्।।2.30.19।।
transliteration: atha māmevamavyagrāṃ vanaṃ naiva nayiṣyati| viṣamadyaiva pāsyāmi mā viśaṃ dviṣatāṃ gamam
translation: अथ otherwise, एवम् in this way, अव्यग्राम् with unhesitant disposition, माम् me, वनम् to the forest, नैव नयिष्यति यदि if you do not at all take, अद्यैव rightaway, विषम् poison, पास्यामि will drink, द्विषताम् enemies', वशम् in the company of, मा गमम् not go.
explanation: If you do not take me to the forest without the least hesitation I shall consume poison right now, but not live under the control of enemies (at Ayodhya).

shloka_text: पश्चादपि हि दुःखेन मम नैवास्ति जीवितम्। उज्झितायास्त्वया नाथ तदैव मरणं वरम्।।2.30.20।।
transliteration: paścādapi hi duḥkhena mama naivāsti jīvitam| ujjhitāyāstvayā nātha tadaiva maraṇaṃ varam
translation: नाथ O Lord, त्वया by you, उज्झितायाः of an abandoned lady, मम to me, पश्चादपि even afterwards, दुःखेन through grief, जीवितम् life, नैवास्ति will not be there, तदैव than abandonment, मरणम् death, वरम् is better.
explanation: If forsaken, O Lord I shall not live a life of sorrow. Instant death is better (than abandoned existence).

shloka_text: इमं हि सहितुं शोकं मुहूर्तमपि नोत्सहे। किं पुनर्दशवर्षाणि त्रीणि चैकं च दुःखिता।।2.30.21।।
transliteration: imaṃ hi sahituṃ śokaṃ muhūrtamapi notsahe| kiṃ punardaśavarṣāṇi trīṇi caikaṃ ca duḥkhitā
translation: इमम् this, शोकम् grief, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, सहितुम् to endure, नोत्सहे will not agree, दश ten, त्रीणि three, एकं च one, वर्षाणि years, दुःखिता a grieving woman, किं पुनः what to say again?
explanation: I cannot bear this grief even for a moment, what to speak of fourteen (ten and three and one) years of grieving.

shloka_text: इति सा शोकसन्तप्ता विलप्य करुणं बहु। चुक्रोश पतिमायस्ता भृशमालिङ्ग्य सस्वरम्।।2.30.22।।
transliteration: iti sā śokasantaptā vilapya karuṇaṃ bahu| cukrośa patimāyastā bhṛśamāliṅgya sasvaram
translation: सा that Sita, शोकसन्तप्ता tormented with grief, आयस्ता exhausted, इति thus, करुणम्  piteously, बहु profusely, विलप्य lamenting, पतिम् husband, आलिङ्ग्य embracing, सस्वरम् with loud voice, भृशम् tightly, चुक्रोश cried.
explanation: Tormented with grief, Sita piteously and profusely lamented, and then exhausted,  embraced her husband  tightly and cried bitterly.

shloka_text: सा विद्धा बहुभिर्वाक्यैर्दिग्धैरिव गजाङ्गना। चिरसन्नियतं बाष्पं मुमोचाग्निमिवारणिः।।2.30.23।।
transliteration: sā viddhā bahubhirvākyairdigdhairiva gajāṅganā| cirasanniyataṃ bāṣpaṃ mumocāgnimivāraṇiḥ
translation: दिग्धै: arrows smeared with poison, गजाङ्गना इव like a cowelephant, सा she, बहुभिः many, वाक्यैः with words, विद्धा was pierled, चिरसन्नियतम् longsuppressed, बाष्पम् tears, आरणिः अग्निमिव like fire produced by arani (a firekindling stick), मुमोच released.
explanation: Pierced by so many words (of objection from  Rama), Sita felt like a cowelephant penetrated by poisonsmeared arrrows. And shed her longsuppressed tears like arani (a firekindling stick) kindling fire.

shloka_text: तस्या स्फटिकसङ्काशं वारि सन्तापसम्भवम्। नेत्राभ्यां परिसुस्राव पङ्कजाभ्यामिवोदकम्।।2.30.24।।
transliteration: tasyā sphaṭikasaṅkāśaṃ vāri santāpasambhavam| netrābhyāṃ parisusrāva paṅkajābhyāmivodakam
translation: तस्याः her, नेत्राभ्याम् from the eyes, सन्तापसम्भवम् arising out of distress, स्फटिक सङ्काशम्  like crystal, वारि water, पङ्कजाभ्याम् from two lotuses, उदकमिव like water, परिसुस्राव flowed.
explanation: Crystallike tears arising out of distress flowed from her eyes like water trickling from two lotuses.

shloka_text: तच्चैवामलचन्द्राभं मुखमायतलोचनम्। पर्यशुष्यत बाष्पेण जलोद्धृतमिवाम्बुजम्।।2.30.25।।
transliteration: taccaivāmalacandrābhaṃ mukhamāyatalocanam| paryaśuṣyata bāṣpeṇa jaloddhṛtamivāmbujam
translation: अमलचन्द्राभम् possessing the brightness of the stainless Moon, आयतलोचनम् having large eyes, तत् that, मुखंचैव from the face, जलोद्धृतम् plucked from water, अम्बुजमिव like a lotus, बाष्पेण with tears, पर्यशुष्यत withered.
explanation: Her face with large eyes assumed the brightness of an immaculate Moon and withered with tears like a lotus plucked out of water.

shloka_text: तां परिष्वज्य बाहुभ्यां विसंज्ञामिव दुःखिताम्। उवाच वचनं रामः परिविश्वासयंस्तदा।।2.30.26।।
transliteration: tāṃ pariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ visaṃjñāmiva duḥkhitām| uvāca vacanaṃ rāmaḥ pariviśvāsayaṃstadā
translation: तदा then, रामः Rama, दुःखिताम् in grief, विसंज्ञामिव as if fainted, ताम् her, बाहुभ्याम् with arms,  परिष्वज्य having embraced, परिविश्वासयन् creating her confidence, वचनम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: With his arms Rama embraced Sita who had almost fainted in grief. And in order to create confidence in her he said these words:

shloka_text: न देवि तव दुःखेन स्वर्गमप्यभिरोचये। न हि मेऽस्ति भयं किञ्चित्स्वयम्भोरिव सर्वतः।।2.30.27।।
transliteration: na devi tava duḥkhena svargamapyabhirocaye| na hi me'sti bhayaṃ kiñcitsvayambhoriva sarvataḥ
translation: देवि O Devi, तव your, दुःखेन with grief, स्वर्गमपि even heaven, न अभिरोचये I do not desire, मे to me, स्वयम्भोरिव like selfcreated Brahma, सर्वतः from everything, किञ्चित् even a little, भयम् fear, नास्ति हि is not there.
explanation: When you are in grief O Devi I do not desire even heaven. Like the selfcreated Brahma, I have no fear for any one.

shloka_text: तव सर्वमभिप्रायमविज्ञाय शुभानने। वासं न रोचयेऽरण्ये शक्तिमानपि रक्षणे।।2.30.28।।
transliteration: tava sarvamabhiprāyamavijñāya śubhānane| vāsaṃ na rocaye'raṇye śaktimānapi rakṣaṇe
translation: शुभानने O one possessing auspicious countenance, रक्षणे in protecting you, शक्तिमानपि even though powerful, तव your, सर्वम् fully, अभिप्रायम् intention, अविज्ञाय without  knowing, अरण्ये in the forest, वासम् your residing, न रोचये do not like.
explanation: O Sita of auspicious countenance even though I am capable of protecting you I did not like your stay in the forest as I did not know your intentions.

shloka_text: यत्सृष्टाऽसि मया सार्धं वनवासाय मैथिलि। न विहातुं मया शक्या कीर्तिरात्मवता यथा।।2.30.29।।
transliteration: yatsṛṣṭā'si mayā sārdhaṃ vanavāsāya maithili| na vihātuṃ mayā śakyā kīrtirātmavatā yathā
translation: मैथिलि O daughter of Mithila (Sita), यत् since, मयासार्धम् along with me, वनवासाय for living in the forest, सृष्टासि created, आत्मवता by selfrespecting, कीर्तिर्यथा like reputation, मया by me, विहातुम् to abandon, न शक्या is not possible.
explanation: Since you, O daughter of Mithila, were born to go along with me to the forest, I cannot abandon you just as a selfrespecting man cannot forsake his reputation.

shloka_text: धर्मस्तु गजनासोरु सद्भिराचरितः पुरा। तं चाहमनुवर्तेऽद्य यथा सूर्यं सुवर्चला।।2.30.30।।
transliteration: dharmastu gajanāsoru sadbhirācaritaḥ purā| taṃ cāhamanuvarte'dya yathā sūryaṃ suvarcalā
translation: गजनासोरु O Lady with thighs like the trunk of an elephant, धर्मः righteousness, पुरा formerly, सद्भिः by virtuous men, आचरितः is practised, सुवर्चला wife of Sun (Suvarchala), सूर्यं यथा like Sun, तम् that righteousness, अहम् I, अद्य now, अनुवर्ते shall follow.
explanation: O one  with (shapely) thighs like the trunk of an elephant follow only the path of righteousness practised earlier by the virtuous as Suvarchala follows the Sun.

shloka_text: न खल्वहं न गच्छेयं वनं जनकनन्दिनि। वचनं तन्नयति मां पितु स्सत्योपबृंहितम्।।2.30.31।।
transliteration: na khalvahaṃ na gaccheyaṃ vanaṃ janakanandini| vacanaṃ tannayati māṃ pitu ssatyopabṛṃhitam
translation: जनकनन्दिनि O daughter of Janaka, अहम् I, वनम् to the forest, न खलु न गच्छेयम् it is not that I shall not go, पितुः father's, सत्योपबृंहितम् nourished by truth, तत् वचनं that word, माम् me, नयति is leading.
explanation: Not that I shall not go to the forest (go I must). My father's word nourished by truth is leading me there, O daughter of Janaka

shloka_text: एष धर्मस्तु सुश्रोणि पितुर्मातुश्च वश्यता। अतश्च तं व्यतिक्रम्य नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे।।2.30.32।।
transliteration: eṣa dharmastu suśroṇi piturmātuśca vaśyatā| ataśca taṃ vyatikramya nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe
translation: सुश्रोणि O one with beautiful posteriors, पितुः of father, मातुश्च of mother, वश्यता in obedience, एषः this one, धर्मस्तु is a righteous act, अतश्च for that reason, तम् that (word of truth), व्यतिक्रम्य disobeying, अहम् I, जीवितुम् to live, न उत्सहे do not wish.
explanation: Obedience to parents is a righteous act. Therefore, O one with fair hips I cannot live and disobey the word of truth.

shloka_text: अस्वाधीनं कथं दैवं प्रकारैरभिराध्यते। स्वाधीनं समतिक्रम्य मातरं पितरं गुरुम्।।2.30.33।।
transliteration: asvādhīnaṃ kathaṃ daivaṃ prakārairabhirādhyate| svādhīnaṃ samatikramya mātaraṃ pitaraṃ gurum
translation: स्वाधीनम् within our reach, मातरम् mother, पितरम् father, गुरुम् preceptor, समतिक्रम्य over stepping, अस्वाधीनम् beyond reach, दैवम् God, प्रकारैः in various ways, कथम् how, अभिराध्यते is worshipped?
explanation: Mother, father and preceptor are present before us. By overstepping them, how can we, in various ways, worship God who is beyond reach (not visible)?

shloka_text: यत्त्रयं तत्त्रयो लोकाः पवित्रं तत्समं भुवि। नान्यदस्ति शुभापाङ्गे तेनेदमभिराध्यते।।2.30.34।।
transliteration: yattrayaṃ tattrayo lokāḥ pavitraṃ tatsamaṃ bhuvi| nānyadasti śubhāpāṅge tenedamabhirādhyate
translation: शुभापाङ्गे O one having lovely side glances, यत्र which, त्रयम् all the three (father, mother and preceptor), तत्र that, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, तत्समम् equal to those three, पवित्रम् अन्यत् any other holy thing, लोके in the world, नास्ति none, तेन therefore, इदम् this, अभिराध्यते is worshipped.
explanation: Where these three(mother,father and preceptor) equal to the three worlds are, O one with loverly sideglances, there is none in this world as holy. Therefore, they are to be worshipped.

shloka_text: न सत्यं दानमानौ वा न यज्ञाश्चाप्तदक्षिणाः। तथा बलकरा स्सीते यथा सेवा पितुर्हिता।।2.30.35।।
transliteration: na satyaṃ dānamānau vā na yajñāścāptadakṣiṇāḥ| tathā balakarā ssīte yathā sevā piturhitā
translation: सीते O Sita, पितुः of father, सेवा service, यथा as, हिता salutary, तथा so,  सत्यम् truth, न not, दानमानौ charity, honour, न not, आप्तदक्षिणाः gifts for the revered ones, यज्ञाःच sacrifices, बलकराः न not strengthening.
explanation: Truth or munificence or homage or distribution of gifts to the revered ones or sacrifices, O Sita, are  not considered as efficacious as service to father.

shloka_text: स्वर्गो धनं वा धान्यं वा विद्याः पुत्रास्सुखानि च। गुरुवृत्त्यनुरोधेन न किञ्चिदपि दुर्लभम्।।2.30.36।।
transliteration: svargo dhanaṃ vā dhānyaṃ vā vidyāḥ putrāssukhāni ca| guruvṛttyanurodhena na kiñcidapi durlabham
translation: गुरुवृत्त्यनुरोधेन fulfilling father's desire, स्वर्गः is heaven, धनं वा or wealth, धान्यं वा or  foodgrains, विद्याः learning, पुत्राः sons, सुखानि च comforts, किञ्चिदपि anything, दुर्लभम् difficult to obtain, न not.
explanation: By fulfilling father's wish, nothing is difficult to achieve, whether it is heaven, or wealth, or foodgrains, or learning, or sons or other comforts.

shloka_text: देवगन्धर्वगोलोकान्ब्रह्मलोकां स्तथाऽपरान्। प्राप्नुवन्ति महात्मानो मातापितृपरायणाः।।2.30.37।।
transliteration: devagandharvagolokānbrahmalokāṃ stathā'parān| prāpnuvanti mahātmāno mātāpitṛparāyaṇāḥ
translation: मातापितृपरायणाः people devoted to the service of parents, महात्मानः great men, देवगन्धर्वगोलोकान् the world of the gods, gandharvas, and the cows or Visnu, ब्रह्मलोकम्  the world of Brahma, तथा and, अपरान् other worlds, प्राप्नुवन्ति will attain.
explanation: Great men who are devoted to the service of their parents attain the world of the gods, of gandharvas, of cows, of Visnu, of Brahma and other worlds.

shloka_text: स मां पिता यथा शास्ति सत्यधर्मपथे स्थितः। तथा वर्तितुमिच्छामि स हि धर्मस्सनातनः।।2.30.38।।
transliteration: sa māṃ pitā yathā śāsti satyadharmapathe sthitaḥ| tathā vartitumicchāmi sa hi dharmassanātanaḥ
translation: सत्यधर्मपथे On the path of truth and dharma, स्थितः firmly fixed, सः पिता such father, माम्   me, यथा as, शास्ति commands, तथा accordingly, वर्तितुम् to abide by, इच्छामि wish सः that one, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः हि is truth indeed.
explanation: My father who follows the path of truth and dharma whatever be his commands, I wish to obey. He is, indeed, dharma eternal.

shloka_text: मम सन्ना मतिस्सीते त्वां नेतुं दण्डकावनम्। वसिष्यामीति सा त्वं मामनुयातुं सुनिश्चिता।।2.30.39।।
transliteration: mama sannā matissīte tvāṃ netuṃ daṇḍakāvanam| vasiṣyāmīti sā tvaṃ māmanuyātuṃ suniścitā
translation: सीते O Sita, त्वाम् you, दण्डकावनम् to Dandaka forest, नेतुम् to take you, मम my, मतिः mind, सन्ना is determined, सा त्वम् such you, वसिष्यामि I can live in the forest, इति like that, माम् me, अनुयातुम् to follow, सुनिश्चिता firmly determined.
explanation: O Sita, my discretion fails me in deciding whether to take you to Dandaka forest or not. You are, however, firmly determined to follow me, saying, you can live in the forest.

shloka_text: सा हि सृष्टाऽनवद्याङ्गि वनाय मदिरेक्षणे। अनुगच्छस्व मां भीरु सहधर्मचरी भव।।2.30.40।।
transliteration: sā hi sṛṣṭā'navadyāṅgi vanāya madirekṣaṇe| anugacchasva māṃ bhīru sahadharmacarī bhava
translation: मदिरेक्षणे O one with fascinating eyes, अनवद्याङ्गि exquisitely beautiful, सा you, वनाय to the forest, सृष्टा you have been created, भीरु O gentle lady, माम् me, अनुगच्छस्व follow me, सहधर्मचरी carrying out together duties, भव become,
explanation: O one with fascinating eyes and exquisite beauty you were born to live in the forest. O gentle lady, assist me in carrying out my duties.

shloka_text: सर्वथा सदृशं सीते मम स्वस्य कुलस्य च। व्यवसायमनुक्रान्ता कान्ते त्वमतिशोभनम्।।2.30.41।।
transliteration: sarvathā sadṛśaṃ sīte mama svasya kulasya ca| vyavasāyamanukrāntā kānte tvamatiśobhanam
translation: कान्ते O my lovely beloved, सीते Sita, त्वम् you, मम for me, स्वस्य your own, कुलस्य च of the family, सर्वथा in all ways, सदृशम् befitting, अतिशोभनम् highly dignified, व्यवसायम् resolution,  अनुक्रान्ता done in due order.
explanation: You, O my lovely beloved Sita, have taken in the right time a highly dignified decision befitting in all ways your family, myself and yourself.

shloka_text: आरभस्व शुभश्रोणि वनवासक्षमाः क्रियाः। नेदानीं त्वदृते सीते स्वर्गोऽपि मम रोचते।।2.30.42।।
transliteration: ārabhasva śubhaśroṇi vanavāsakṣamāḥ kriyāḥ| nedānīṃ tvadṛte sīte svargo'pi mama rocate
translation: शुभश्रोणि O One with beautiful buttocks Sita, वनवासक्षमाः suitable for residing in the forest, क्रियाः those acts, इदानीम् now, आरभस्व commence, सीते O Sita, त्वदृते without you, मम to me, स्वर्गोपि even heaven, न रोचते does not please.
explanation: O Sita, begin right now all preparations necessary for residing in the forest. O one, with beautiful buttocks, without you even the very heaven does not please me.

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च रत्नानि भिक्षुकेभ्यश्च भोजनम्। देहि चाशंसमानेभ्य स्सन्त्वरस्व च मा चिरम्।।2.30.43।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇebhyaśca ratnāni bhikṣukebhyaśca bhojanam| dehi cāśaṃsamānebhya ssantvarasva ca mā ciram
translation: आशंसमानेभ्यः for the needy, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, रत्नानि च jewels, भिक्षुकेभ्यः to mendicants, भोजनं च food also, देहि you may bestow, सन्त्वरस्व च hasten, मा चिरम् do not delay.
explanation: Give away your jewels to brahmins who need them and food to religious mendicants. Hurry up Do not delay.

shloka_text: भूषणानि महार्हाणि वरवस्त्राणि यानि च। रमणीयाश्च ये केचित्क्रीडार्थाश्चाप्युपस्कराः।।2.30.44।। शयनीयानि यानानि मम चान्यानि यानि च। देहि स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य ब्राह्मणानामनन्तरम्।।2.30.45।।
transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi varavastrāṇi yāni ca| ramaṇīyāśca ye kecitkrīḍārthāścāpyupaskarāḥ śayanīyāni yānāni mama cānyāni yāni ca| dehi svabhṛtyavargasya brāhmaṇānāmanantaram
translation: महार्हाणि highly valuable, यानि all, भूषणानि ornaments, वरवस्त्राणि excellent clothing, रमणीयाः charming, ये केचित् whichever, क्रीडार्थाः meant for sport, उपस्कराः articles, मम my, शयनीयानि couches, यानानि chariots, अन्यानि other, यानि च all things, स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य to your attendants, देहि give, अनन्तरम् after that, ब्राह्मणानाम् to brahmins.
explanation: Distribute among your attendants highly valuable ornaments and excellent clothing, charming articles meant for (court) sport, my couches, chariots and all other things. Offer the rest to brahmins.

shloka_text: भूषणानि महार्हाणि वरवस्त्राणि यानि च। रमणीयाश्च ये केचित्क्रीडार्थाश्चाप्युपस्कराः।।2.30.44।। शयनीयानि यानानि मम चान्यानि यानि च। देहि स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य ब्राह्मणानामनन्तरम्।।2.30.45।।
transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni mahārhāṇi varavastrāṇi yāni ca| ramaṇīyāśca ye kecitkrīḍārthāścāpyupaskarāḥ śayanīyāni yānāni mama cānyāni yāni ca| dehi svabhṛtyavargasya brāhmaṇānāmanantaram
