translation: महार्हाणि highly valuable, यानि all, भूषणानि ornaments, वरवस्त्राणि excellent clothing, रमणीयाः charming, ये केचित् whichever, क्रीडार्थाः meant for sport, उपस्कराः articles, मम my, शयनीयानि couches, यानानि chariots, अन्यानि other, यानि च all things, स्वभृत्यवर्गस्य to your attendants, देहि give, अनन्तरम् after that, ब्राह्मणानाम् to brahmins.
explanation: Distribute among your attendants highly valuable ornaments and excellent clothing, charming articles meant for (court) sport, my couches, chariots and all other things. Offer the rest to brahmins.

shloka_text: अनुकूलं तु सा भर्तुर्ज्ञात्वा गमनमात्मनः। क्षिप्रं प्रमुदिता देवी दातुमेवोपचक्रमे।।2.30.46।।
transliteration: anukūlaṃ tu sā bharturjñātvā gamanamātmanaḥ| kṣipraṃ pramuditā devī dātumevopacakrame
translation: सा देवी Devi, आत्मनः her own, गमनम् departure, भर्तुः with her husband, अनुकूलम् is favourable, ज्ञात्वा having come to know, प्रमुदिता happy, क्षिप्रम् quickly, दातुमेव to gift away, उपचक्रमे began.
explanation: Having come to know that her departure to the forest is acceptable to her husband, Sita, highly delighted, quickly got ready to give away (things).

shloka_text: एवं शृत्वा तु संवादं लक्ष्मणः पूर्वमागतः। बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः शोकं सोढुमशक्नुवन्।।2.31.1।। स भ्रातुश्चरणौ गाढं निपीड्य रघुनन्दनः। सीतामुवाचातियशां राघवं च महाव्रतम्।।2.31.2।।
transliteration: evaṃ śṛtvā tu saṃvādaṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ| bāṣpaparyākulamukhaḥ śokaṃ soḍhumaśaknuvan sa bhrātuścaraṇau gāḍhaṃ nipīḍya raghunandanaḥ| sītāmuvācātiyaśāṃ rāghavaṃ ca mahāvratam
translation: पूर्वम् previously, आगतः had come, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, एवम् in this way, संवादम् conversation, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकम् sorrow, सोढुम् to endure, अशक्नुवन् being unable, बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः (बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः) with his eyes filled with tears, सः that, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu race, Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother's, चरणौ feet, गाढम् tightly, निपीड्य pressing, महाव्रतम् of great resolve, राघवं च to Rama, अतियशाम् illustrious, सीताम् Sita, उवाच said.
explanation: Lakshmana who had already reached there heard the conversation (between Sita and Rama). His eyes brimming with tears, he was unable to bear the grief. He held the feet of his brother tightly and said to the illustrious Sita and Rama of great resolve:
comments: Lakshmana gets ready to accompany Rama takes leave of his friends and collects divine weapons from preceptor Vasistha--Rama asks Lakshmana to  distribute his wealth among brahmins.

shloka_text: एवं शृत्वा तु संवादं लक्ष्मणः पूर्वमागतः। बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः शोकं सोढुमशक्नुवन्।।2.31.1।। स भ्रातुश्चरणौ गाढं निपीड्य रघुनन्दनः। सीतामुवाचातियशां राघवं च महाव्रतम्।।2.31.2।।
transliteration: evaṃ śṛtvā tu saṃvādaṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ| bāṣpaparyākulamukhaḥ śokaṃ soḍhumaśaknuvan sa bhrātuścaraṇau gāḍhaṃ nipīḍya raghunandanaḥ| sītāmuvācātiyaśāṃ rāghavaṃ ca mahāvratam
translation: पूर्वम् previously, आगतः had come, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, एवम् in this way, संवादम् conversation, श्रुत्वा having heard, शोकम् sorrow, सोढुम् to endure, अशक्नुवन् being unable, बाष्पपर्याकुलमुखः (बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः) with his eyes filled with tears, सः that, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu race, Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother's, चरणौ feet, गाढम् tightly, निपीड्य pressing, महाव्रतम् of great resolve, राघवं च to Rama, अतियशाम् illustrious, सीताम् Sita, उवाच said.
explanation: Lakshmana who had already reached there heard the conversation (between Sita and Rama). His eyes brimming with tears, he was unable to bear the grief. He held the feet of his brother tightly and said to the illustrious Sita and Rama of great resolve:

shloka_text: यदि गन्तुं कृताबुद्धिर्वनं मृगगजायुतम्। अहं त्वानुगमिष्यामि वनमग्रे धनुर्धरः।।2.31.3।।
transliteration: yadi gantuṃ kṛtābuddhirvanaṃ mṛgagajāyutam| ahaṃ tvānugamiṣyāmi vanamagre dhanurdharaḥ
translation: मृगगजायुतम् abounding in deer and elephants, वनम् to the forest, गन्तुम् to go, बुद्धि: decision, कृता यदि if made, अहम् I, अग्रे in front, धनुर्धरः one holding a bow, त्वा you, वनम् to the forest, अनुगमिष्यामि I shall follow.
explanation: If you have decided to go to the forest where deer and elephants abound, I shall also accompany you by walking before you, holding the bow.

shloka_text: मया समेतोऽरण्यानि बहूनि विचरिष्यसि। पक्षिभिर्मृगयूथैश्च संघुष्टानि समन्ततः।।2.31.4।।
transliteration: mayā sameto'raṇyāni bahūni vicariṣyasi| pakṣibhirmṛgayūthaiśca saṃghuṣṭāni samantataḥ
translation: समन्ततः from all sides, पक्षिभिः with birds, मृगयूथैः च with herds of animals, संघुष्टानि echoing with the sounds of, बहूनि many, अरण्यानि forests, मया by me, समेतः accompanied by, विचरिष्यसि you will roam.
explanation: Accompanied by me, you will roam the forests echoing with the cries of birds and sounds of herds of animals.

shloka_text: न देवलोकाक्रमणं नामरत्वमहं वृणे। ऐश्वर्यं वापि लोकानां कामये न त्वया विना।।2.31.5।।
transliteration: na devalokākramaṇaṃ nāmaratvamahaṃ vṛṇe| aiśvaryaṃ vāpi lokānāṃ kāmaye na tvayā vinā
translation: अहम् I, त्वया विना without you, देवलोकाक्रमणम् the seizure of the world of devatas, न वृणे do not wish to choose, अमरत्वम् immortality, न not, लोकानाम् of the worlds, ऐश्वर्यं वापि sovereignty, न कामये do not desire.
explanation: Without you, I do not want victory over the gods or sovereignty over the worlds or even immortality.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवाणस्सौमित्रिर्वनवासाय निश्चितः। रामेण बहुभिस्सान्त्वैर्निषिध्दः पुनरब्रवीत्।।2.31.6।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇassaumitrirvanavāsāya niścitaḥ| rāmeṇa bahubhissāntvairniṣidhdaḥ punarabravīt
translation: वनवासाय to dwell in the forest, निश्चितः having decided, एवम् in this way, ब्रुवाणः speaking, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, रामेण by Rama, बहुभिः with many, सान्त्वैः with the words of consolation, निषिद्धः dissuaded, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: When Rama tried to dissuade Lakshmana with many words of consolation Lakshmana who was determined to go to the forest said again:

shloka_text: अनुज्ञातश्च भवता पूर्वमेव यदस्म्यहम्। किमिदानीं पुनरिदं क्रियते मन्निवारणम्।।2.31.7।।
transliteration: anujñātaśca bhavatā pūrvameva yadasmyaham| kimidānīṃ punaridaṃ kriyate mannivāraṇam
translation: अहम् I, भवता by you, पूर्वमेव even earlier, अनुज्ञातः  was permitted, अस्मि यत् I have been, इदानीम्  now, पुनः again, इदम् this, (मत्)निवारणम् prevention (of me), किम् why, क्रियते is being done?
explanation: You have granted permission to me earlier.Why are you now preventing me?

shloka_text: यदर्थं प्रतिषेधो मे क्रियते गन्तुमिच्छतः। एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं संशयो हि ममानघ।।2.31.8।।
transliteration: yadarthaṃ pratiṣedho me kriyate gantumicchataḥ| etadicchāmi vijñātuṃ saṃśayo hi mamānagha
translation: अनघ O sinless one, गन्तुम् to go, इच्छतः desiring, मे my, प्रतिषेधः restriction, यदर्थम् for what reason, क्रियते is being done, एतत् all this, विज्ञातुम् to  know, इच्छामि desiring, मम to me, संशयः हि I have a doubt.
explanation: I wish to know, O sinless one, the reason why you are dissuading me, when I am willing to go with you. This creates a doubt in my mind.

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रामो लक्ष्मणमग्रतः। स्थितं प्राग्गामिनं वीरं याचमानं कृताञ्जलिम्।।2.31.9।।
transliteration: tato'bravīnmahātejā rāmo lakṣmaṇamagrataḥ| sthitaṃ prāggāminaṃ vīraṃ yācamānaṃ kṛtāñjalim
translation: ततः after that, महातेजाः brilliant, रामः Rama, अग्रतः in front of him, स्थितम् standing, प्राग्गामिनम् ready to walk ahead of, वीरम् heroic one, याचमानम् imploring, कृताञ्जलिम् with folded palms, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Addressing the heroic Lakshmana in front of him imploring with folded hands to take him to the forest so that he may walk ahead (and guard them), the effulgent Rama said:

shloka_text: स्निग्धो धर्मरतो वीरस्सततं सत्पथे स्थितः। प्रियः प्राणसमो वश्यो भ्राता चापि सखा च मे।।2.31.10।।
transliteration: snigdho dharmarato vīrassatataṃ satpathe sthitaḥ| priyaḥ prāṇasamo vaśyo bhrātā cāpi sakhā ca me
translation: स्निग्धः affectionate, धर्मरतः engaged in righteous activites, वीरः valiant, सततम् always, सत्पथे on the path of virtue, स्थितः abiding, मे to me, प्राणसमः like my own life, प्रियः dear, वश्यः obedient, भ्राता चापि brother also, सखा च friend.
explanation: You are affectionate, you are devoted to dharma. You are valiant. You always walk the path of virtue. You are dear to me like my own life. You are not only an obedient brother but also a friend.

shloka_text: मयाऽद्य सह सौमित्रे त्वयि गच्छति तद्वनम्। को भरिष्यति कौसल्यां सुमित्रां वा यशस्विनीम्।।2.31.11।।
transliteration: mayā'dya saha saumitre tvayi gacchati tadvanam| ko bhariṣyati kausalyāṃ sumitrāṃ vā yaśasvinīm
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, त्वयि if you, अद्य today, मया सह along with me, तत् वनम् to the forest, गच्छति go, कौशल्याम् to Kausalya, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, सुमित्रां च Sumitra, कः who, भरिष्यति will take care?
explanation: O Lakshmana, if you also accompany me to the forest, who will take care of mother Kausalya and the illustrious Sumitra?

shloka_text: अभिवर्षति कामैर्यः पर्जन्यः पृथिवीमिव। स कामपाशपर्यस्तो महातेजा महीपतिः।।2.31.12।।
transliteration: abhivarṣati kāmairyaḥ parjanyaḥ pṛthivīmiva| sa kāmapāśaparyasto mahātejā mahīpatiḥ
translation: महातेजाः mighty one, यः that, महीपतिः lord of the earth, पृथिवीम् the earth, पर्जन्यः इव like Parjanya (Indra), कामैः favours (desires), अभिवर्षति showers, सः he, कामपाशपर्यस्तः he is bound by cords of passion.
explanation: Dasaratha, the mighty king like Parjanya (the raingod), lord of the earth used to shower favours on earth. But now he is bound by the noose of passion.

shloka_text: सा हि राज्यमिदं प्राप्य नृपस्याश्वपते स्सुता। दुःखितानां सपत्नीनां न करिष्यति शोभनम्।।2.31.13।।
transliteration: sā hi rājyamidaṃ prāpya nṛpasyāśvapate ssutā| duḥkhitānāṃ sapatnīnāṃ na kariṣyati śobhanam
translation: नृपस्य king, अश्वपतेः Aswapati's, सुता daughter, सा that (Kaikeyi), इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, प्राप्य having obtained, दुःखितानाम् afflicted ladies, सपत्नीनाम् of her cowives, शोभनम् welfare, न करिष्यति हि will not extend.
explanation: Once the daughter of king Aswapati (Kaikeyi) gains control over the kingdom, she will do nothing to help her afflicted cowives (Kausalya and Sumitra).

shloka_text: न स्मरिष्यति कौसल्यां सुमित्रां च सुदुःखिताम्। भरतो राज्यमासाद्य कैकेय्यां पर्यवस्थितः।।2.31.14।।
transliteration: na smariṣyati kausalyāṃ sumitrāṃ ca suduḥkhitām| bharato rājyamāsādya kaikeyyāṃ paryavasthitaḥ
translation: भरतः Bharata, राज्यम् kingdom, आसाद्य having obtained, कैकेय्याम् in Kaikeyi, पर्यवस्थितः repose confidence, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, सुदुःखिताम् grieved, सुमित्रां च also Sumitra, न स्मरिष्यति will not remember.
explanation: When Bharata secures the kingdom, his confidence reposed in Kaikeyi he will not bother about the miserable Kausalya and Sumitra.

shloka_text: तामार्यां स्वयमेवेह राजानुग्रहणेन वा। सौमित्रे भर कौशल्यामुक्तमर्थमिमं चर।।2.31.15।।
transliteration: tāmāryāṃ svayameveha rājānugrahaṇena vā| saumitre bhara kauśalyāmuktamarthamimaṃ cara
translation: सौमित्रे स्वयमेव by yourself, राजानुग्रहणेन वा or by seeking the favour of king, इह stay here, आर्याम् venerable, तां कौशल्याम् that Kausalya, भर maintain, इमम् this, उक्तम्  what is told, अर्थम् objective, चर accomplish.
explanation: Either by yourself or by seeking the favour of the king, O son of Sumitra, lend support to venerable  Kausalya. This is the objective you must accomplish.

shloka_text: एवं मम च ते भक्तिर्भविष्यति सुदर्शिता। धर्मज्ञ गुरुपूजायां धर्मश्चाप्यतुलो महान्।।2.31.16।।
transliteration: evaṃ mama ca te bhaktirbhaviṣyati sudarśitā| dharmajña gurupūjāyāṃ dharmaścāpyatulo mahān
translation: धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma (duty), एवम् in this way, मम in me, ते your, भक्तिः devotion, सुदर्शिता is welldemonstrated, भविष्यति will become, गुरुपूजायाम् in worshipping  the elders, अतुलः unequalled, महान् great, धर्मश्च is virtue also.
explanation: If you do this, your devotion to me will be amply demonstrated. Service to the elders, O dutiful one, is a virtue, great and unequalled.

shloka_text: एवं कुरुष्व सौमित्रे मत्कृते रघुनन्दन। अस्माभिर्विप्रहीणाया मातुर्नो न भवेत्सुखम्।।2.31.17।।
transliteration: evaṃ kuruṣva saumitre matkṛte raghunandana| asmābhirviprahīṇāyā māturno na bhavetsukham
translation: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghu race, सौमित्रे O Son of Sumitra, मत्कृते for my sake, एवम् like this, कुरुष्व you may act, अस्माभिः by us, विप्रहीणायाः lady deprived of, नः our, मातुः for mother, सुखम् happiness, न भवेत् will not be.
explanation: O delight of the Raghu race, do this for my sake, since deprived of us, there will be no happiness for our mother, O son of Sumitra

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मण श्श्लक्ष्णया गिरा। प्रत्युवाच तदा रामं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम्।।2.31.18।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇa śślakṣṇayā girā| pratyuvāca tadā rāmaṃ vākyajño vākyakovidam
translation: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in this way, उक्तः addressed, वाक्यज्ञः eloquent, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तदा then, वाक्यकोविदम् proficient in the use of words, रामम् Rama, श्लक्ष्णया in gentle voice, गिरा in words, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: Thus addressed by Rama who was an adept in the use of words, eloquent Lakshmana gently replied:

shloka_text: तवैव तेजसा वीर भरतः पूजयिष्यति। कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च प्रयतो नात्र संशयः।।2.31.19।।
transliteration: tavaiva tejasā vīra bharataḥ pūjayiṣyati| kausalyāṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca prayato nātra saṃśayaḥ
translation: वीर O heroic one, भरतः Bharata, तव your, तेजसैव with your power, प्रयतः in humble manner, कौसल्यां च Kausalya and, सुमित्रा च also Sumitra, पूजयिष्यति he will honour, अत्र here, संशयः doubt, न not.
explanation: Aware of your power O valiant one, Bharata will undoubtedly pay respect to Kausalya and Sumitra with all humility.

shloka_text: कौशल्या बिभृयादार्या सहस्रमपि मद्विधान्। यस्यास्सहस्रं ग्रामाणां सम्प्राप्त मुपजीवनम्।।2.31.20।।
transliteration: kauśalyā bibhṛyādāryā sahasramapi madvidhān| yasyāssahasraṃ grāmāṇāṃ samprāpta mupajīvanam
translation: यस्याः for (Kausalya), उपजीवनम् sustenance, ग्रामाणाम् of villages, सहस्रम् one thousand, सम्प्राप्तम् has been obtained, आर्या noble lady, कौशल्या Kausalya, मद्विधान् men like me, सहस्रमपि even one thousand, बिभृयात् she can support.
explanation: Noble Kausalya has under her charge a thousand villages for her sustenance. She can support a thousand men like me.

shloka_text: तदात्मभरणे चैव मम मातुस्तथैव च। पर्याप्ता मद्विधानां च भरणाय यशस्विनी।।2.31.21।।
transliteration: tadātmabharaṇe caiva mama mātustathaiva ca| paryāptā madvidhānāṃ ca bharaṇāya yaśasvinī
translation: तत् for that, यशस्विनी illustrious Kausalya, आत्मभरणे चैव to support herself, तथैव च also, मम मातुः my mother's, मद्विधानां च of men like me, भरणाय च to support, पर्याप्ता is competent.
explanation: Illustrious Kausalya is competent enough to support herself, my mother and men  like me.

shloka_text: कुरुष्व मामनुचरं वैधर्म्यं नेह विद्यते। कृतार्थोऽहं भविष्यामि तव चार्थः प्रकल्पते।।2.31.22।।
transliteration: kuruṣva māmanucaraṃ vaidharmyaṃ neha vidyate| kṛtārtho'haṃ bhaviṣyāmi tava cārthaḥ prakalpate
translation: माम् me, अनुचरम् as your follower, कुरुष्व make (take) me, इह in this, वैधर्म्यम् breach of virtue, न विद्यते is not considered, अहम् I, कृतार्थः accomplish my purpose, भविष्यामि I will become, तव your, अर्थः च object also, प्रकल्पते will be fulfilled.
explanation: Make me your follower. There is no breach of virtue in this. I will have my purpose accomplished. Your object also will be fulfilled.

shloka_text: धनुरादाय सशरं खनित्रपिटकाधरः। अग्रतस्ते गमिष्यामि पन्थानमनुदर्शयन्।।2.31.23।।
transliteration: dhanurādāya saśaraṃ khanitrapiṭakādharaḥ| agrataste gamiṣyāmi panthānamanudarśayan
translation: सशरम् (stringed) with arrows, धनुः bow, आदाय holding, खनित्रपिटकाधरः holding a basket and a crowbar, ते your, अग्रतः in front of, पन्थानम् the way, अनुदर्शयन् indicating, गमिष्यामि I shall go.
explanation: Holding the bow and arrows and carrying a crowbar and a basket, I shall go in front of you leading the way.

shloka_text: आहरिष्यामि ते नित्यं मूलानि च फलानि च। वन्यानि यानि चान्यानि स्वाहाराणि तपस्विनाम्।।2.31.24।।
transliteration: āhariṣyāmi te nityaṃ mūlāni ca phalāni ca| vanyāni yāni cānyāni svāhārāṇi tapasvinām
translation: मूलानि roots, फलानि च fruits also, तपस्विनाम् for ascetics, स्वाहाराणि eatables, वन्यानि available in the forest, यानि those, अन्यानि च other products, नित्यम् daily, ते to you, आहरिष्यामि shall collect.
explanation: I shall daily collect roots, fruits and other forest products fit for ascetics.

shloka_text: भवांस्तु सह वैदेह्या गिरिसानुषु रंस्यते। अहं सर्वं करिष्यामि जाग्रत स्स्वपतश्च ते।।2.31.25।।
transliteration: bhavāṃstu saha vaidehyā girisānuṣu raṃsyate| ahaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyāmi jāgrata ssvapataśca te
translation: भवांस्तु you, वैदेह्या सह with Sita, गिरिसानुषु on mountain slopes, रंस्यते you will go sporting, ते you, जाग्रतः while you are awake, स्ववतश्च while you are asleep, अहम् I,सर्वम् all tasks, करिष्यामि I will do.
explanation: When you go about for pleasure on mountain slopes along with Sita, I shall do everything for you, whether you are awake or asleep.

shloka_text: रामस्त्वनेन वाक्येन सुप्रीतः प्रत्युवाच तम्। व्रजापृच्छस्व सौमित्रे सर्वमेव सुहृज्जनम्।।2.31.26।।
transliteration: rāmastvanena vākyena suprītaḥ pratyuvāca tam| vrajāpṛcchasva saumitre sarvameva suhṛjjanam
translation: रामस्तु Rama also, अनेन वाक्येन with these words, सुप्रीतः immensely pleased man, तम् to him, प्रत्युवाच replied, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, व्रज go forth, सर्वमेव all, सुहृज्जनम् friends, आपृच्छस्व ask leave of them.
explanation: Pleased with his words Rama said, O Lakshmana go and take leave of all your friends.

shloka_text: ये च राज्ञो ददौ दिव्ये महात्मा वरुण स्स्वयम्। जनकस्य महायज्ञे धनुषी रौद्रदर्शने।।2.31.27।। अभेद्यकवचे दिव्ये तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ। आदित्यविमलौ चोभौ खड्गौ हेमपरिष्कृतौ।।2.31.28।। सत्कृत्य निहितं सर्वमेतदाचार्यसद्मनि। सर्वमायुधमादाय क्षिप्रमाव्रज लक्ष्मण।।2.31.29।।
transliteration: ye ca rājño dadau divye mahātmā varuṇa ssvayam| janakasya mahāyajñe dhanuṣī raudradarśane abhedyakavace divye tūṇī cākṣayasāyakau| ādityavimalau cobhau khaḍgau hemapariṣkṛtau satkṛtya nihitaṃ sarvametadācāryasadmani| sarvamāyudhamādāya kṣipramāvraja lakṣmaṇa
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, महात्मा highsouled, वरुणः Varuna, स्वयम् himself, राज्ञः of the king, जनकस्य Janaka's, महायज्ञे in the great sacrifice, दिव्ये divine, रौद्रदर्शने awesome, ये those, धनुषी bows, दिव्ये divine, अभेद्यकवचे impenetrable armour, अक्षयसायकौ two sets of inexhaustible arrows, तूणी च two quivers, हेमपरिष्कृतौ plated with gold, आदित्यविमलौ as bright as the sun, उभौ both, खड्गौ swords, ददौ gave, एतत् that, सर्वम् everything, सत्कृत्य after having worshipped, आचार्य सद्मनि in the house of the preceptor (sage Vasistha), निहितम् is deposited, सर्वम् all, आयुधम् weaponry, आदाय after collecting , क्षिप्रं swiftly, आव्रज come forth.
explanation: O Lakshmana in the great sacrifice performed by the highsouled Janaka, Varuna himself gave him two aweinspiring celestial bows, two impenetrable divine armours, two quivers with inexhaustible arrows, two swords plated with gold and as bright as the sun. All these weapons are deposited in the house of our preceptor (sage Vasistha) where they are being worshipped. Go and bring them swiftly.

shloka_text: ये च राज्ञो ददौ दिव्ये महात्मा वरुण स्स्वयम्। जनकस्य महायज्ञे धनुषी रौद्रदर्शने।।2.31.27।। अभेद्यकवचे दिव्ये तूणी चाक्षयसायकौ। आदित्यविमलौ चोभौ खड्गौ हेमपरिष्कृतौ।।2.31.28।। सत्कृत्य निहितं सर्वमेतदाचार्यसद्मनि। सर्वमायुधमादाय क्षिप्रमाव्रज लक्ष्मण।।2.31.29।।

explanation: O Lakshmana in the great sacrifice performed by the highsouled Janaka, Varuna himself gave him two aweinspiring celestial bows, two impenetrable divine armours, two quivers with inexhaustible arrows, two swords plated with gold and as bright as the sun. All these weapons are deposited in the house of our preceptor (sage Vasistha) where they are being worshipped. Go and bring them swiftly.

explanation: O Lakshmana in the great sacrifice performed by the highsouled Janaka, Varuna himself gave him two aweinspiring celestial bows, two impenetrable divine armours, two quivers with inexhaustible arrows, two swords plated with gold and as bright as the sun. All these weapons are deposited in the house of our preceptor (sage Vasistha) where they are being worshipped. Go and bring them swiftly.

shloka_text: स सुहृज्जनमामन्त्र्यवनवासाय निश्चितः। इक्ष्वाकुगुरुमागम्य जग्राहायुधमुत्तमम्।।2.31.30।।
transliteration: sa suhṛjjanamāmantryavanavāsāya niścitaḥ| ikṣvākugurumāgamya jagrāhāyudhamuttamam
translation: वनवासाय to live in the forest, निश्चित: one who was determined, सः Lakshmana, सुहृज्जनम् friends, आमन्त्र्य taking leave of, इक्ष्वाकुगुरुम् preceptor of the Ikshvakus, Vasistha, आगम्य having reached, उत्तमम् powerful, आयुधम् weapons, जग्राह received.
explanation: Lakshmana, who was resolved to go to the forest, took leave of his friends, and collected from the house of Vasistha, preceptor of the Ikshvaku race, the powerful weapons deposited with him.

shloka_text: तद्धिव्यं राजशार्दूल सत्कृतं माल्यभूषितम्। रामाय दर्शयामास सौमित्रिस्सर्वमायुधम्।।2.31.31।।
transliteration: taddhivyaṃ rājaśārdūla satkṛtaṃ mālyabhūṣitam| rāmāya darśayāmāsa saumitrissarvamāyudham
translation: राजशार्दूलः tiger among princes, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, दिव्यम् divine, सत्कृतम् sanctified, माल्यभूषितम् decorated with garlands, सर्वम् all, तत् आयुधम् those weapons, रामाय to Rama, दर्शयामास showed.
explanation: Lakshmana, tiger among princes, brought all those divine weapons sanctified and  decorated with garlands and showed them to Rama.

shloka_text: तमुवाचात्मवान् रामः प्रीत्या लक्ष्मणमागतम्। काले त्वमागत सौम्य काङ्क्षिते मम लक्ष्मण।।2.31.32।।
transliteration: tamuvācātmavān rāmaḥ prītyā lakṣmaṇamāgatam| kāle tvamāgata saumya kāṅkṣite mama lakṣmaṇa
translation: आत्मवान् selfpossessed, रामः Rama, आगतम् having arrived, तं लक्ष्मणम् to that Lakshmana, प्रीत्या affectionately, उवाच said, सौम्य O handsome, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, त्वम् you, मम to me, काङ्क्षिते काले at the desired moment, आगतः have come.
explanation: O handsome Lakshmana, you have come at the expected time, said the selfpossessed Rama affectionately when he saw him arrive.

shloka_text: अहं प्रदातुमिच्छामि यदिदं मामकं धनम्। ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तपस्विभ्यस्त्वया सह परन्तप।।2.31.33।।
transliteration: ahaṃ pradātumicchāmi yadidaṃ māmakaṃ dhanam| brāhmaṇebhyastapasvibhyastvayā saha parantapa
translation: परन्तप O tormentor of enemies, अहम् I, त्वया सह with you, यत् all that, इदम् this, मामकम् my belonging, धनम् wealth, तपस्विभ्यः to ascetics, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, प्रदातुम् to give away, इच्छामि I wish.
explanation: Let us give away, O tormentor of enemies (Lakshmana) my belogings to the ascetic brahmins.

shloka_text: वसन्तीह दृढं भक्त्या गुरुषु द्विजसत्तमाः। तेषामपि च मे भूयस्सर्वेषाञ्चोपजीविनाम्।।2.31.34।।
transliteration: vasantīha dṛḍhaṃ bhaktyā guruṣu dvijasattamāḥ| teṣāmapi ca me bhūyassarveṣāñcopajīvinām
translation: इह here, गुरुषु among teachers, दृढम् deep, भक्त्या with devotion, द्विजसत्तमाः best of  brahmins, वसन्ति are living, तेषामपि च for them, भूयः also, सर्वेषाम् for all, मे my, उपजीविनां च to my dependents.
explanation: Here live the best of brahmins who are deeply devoted to their teachers along with those who are dependent on me for their livelihood.

shloka_text: वशिष्ठपुत्रं तु सुयज्ञमार्यं त्वमानयाशु प्रवरं द्विजानाम्। अभिप्रयास्यामि वनं समस्ता नभ्यर्च्य शिष्टानपरान् द्विजातीन्।।2.31.35।।
transliteration: vaśiṣṭhaputraṃ tu suyajñamāryaṃ tvamānayāśu pravaraṃ dvijānām| abhiprayāsyāmi vanaṃ samastā nabhyarcya śiṣṭānaparān dvijātīn
translation: त्वम् you, द्विजानाम् among the brahmins, प्रवरम् best, वशिष्ठपुत्रम् son of Vasistha, आर्यम्  venerable, सुयज्ञम् Suyajna, आशु swiftly, आनय bring, शिष्टान् distinguished, अपरान् other, समस्तान् all, द्विजातीन् brahmins, अभ्यर्च्य having paid homage, वनम् to the forest, अभिप्रयास्यामि I shall go.
explanation: Fetch Suyajna, son of Vasistha, best among the brahmins along with all other distinguished brahmins to whom I will pay my homage and leave for the forest. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfirst sarga of Ayodhyakanda of  the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततश्शासन माज्ञाय भ्रातु श्शुभतरं प्रियम्। गत्वा स प्रविवेशाशु सुयज्ञस्य निवेशनम्।।2.32.1।।
transliteration: tataśśāsana mājñāya bhrātu śśubhataraṃ priyam| gatvā sa praviveśāśu suyajñasya niveśanam
translation: ततः thereafter, सः he, भ्रातुः brother's, शुभतरम् very much auspicious, प्रियम् pleasing, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having understood, आशु immediately, गत्वा having gone, सुयज्ञस्य Suyajna's, निवेशनम् house, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: Lakshmana having understood the very auspicious and welcome order (of Rama)  immediately  proceeded to the house of Suyajna.
comments: Rama honours Suyajna with valuable gifts--distributes his wealth to dependents, brahmins and to sageTrijata.

shloka_text: तं विप्रमग्न्यगारस्थं वन्दित्वा लक्ष्मणोऽब्रवीत्। सखेऽभ्यागच्छ पश्य त्वं वेश्म दुष्करकारिणः।।2.32.2।।
transliteration: taṃ vipramagnyagārasthaṃ vanditvā lakṣmaṇo'bravīt| sakhe'bhyāgaccha paśya tvaṃ veśma duṣkarakāriṇaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अग्न्यगारस्थम् staying in the firesanctuary, तं विप्रम् that brahmin, वन्दित्वा after saluting, अब्रवीत् said, सखे O friend, अभ्यागच्छ come, त्वम् you, दुष्करकारिणः  accomplisher of all difficult tasks , वेश्म palace of Rama, पश्य behold.
explanation: Lakshmana paid homage to him who was in the firesanctuary, and said O friend, come and see the palace of Rama who is the accomplisher of all difficult tasks.

shloka_text: ततस्सन्ध्यामुपास्याशु गत्वा सौमित्रिणा सह। जुष्टं तत्प्राविशल्लक्ष्म्या रम्यं रामनिवेशनम्।।2.32.3।।
transliteration: tatassandhyāmupāsyāśu gatvā saumitriṇā saha| juṣṭaṃ tatprāviśallakṣmyā ramyaṃ rāmaniveśanam
translation: ततः thereafter, सन्ध्याम् the twilight prayers, उपास्य having performed, सौमित्रिणा सह along with Lakshmana, आशु swiftly, गत्वा went, लक्ष्म्या with prosperity, जुष्टम् endowed with, रम्यम् beautiful, तत् that, रामनिवेशनम् Rama's palace, प्राविशत् he entered.
explanation: After performing the twilight prayers, Suyajna along with Lakshmana went straight away and entered the beautiful and prosperous palace of Rama.

shloka_text: तमागतं वेदविदं प्राञ्जलिस्सीतया सह। सुयज्ञमभिचक्राम राघवोऽग्निमिवार्चितम्।।2.32.4।।
transliteration: tamāgataṃ vedavidaṃ prāñjalissītayā saha| suyajñamabhicakrāma rāghavo'gnimivārcitam
translation: राघवः Rama, प्राञ्जलिः folded hands, आगतम् who has come, वेदविदम् versed in Vedas, तं सुयज्ञम् that Suyajna, अर्चितम् worshipped, अग्निम् इव like fire, सीतया सह with Sita, अभिचक्राम circumambulated.
explanation: On the arrival of sage Suyajna wellversed in the Vedas, both Rama and Sita offered obeisance to him as to firegod and circumambulated him.

shloka_text: जातरूपमयैर्मुख्यैरङ्गदैः कुण्डलैः शुभैः। सहेमसूत्रैर्मणिभिः केयूरैर्वलयैरपि।।2.32.5।। अन्यैश्च रत्नैर्बहुभिः काकुत्स्थः प्रत्यपूजयत्। सुयज्ञं स तदोवाच रामस्सीता प्रचोदितः।।2.32.6।।
transliteration: jātarūpamayairmukhyairaṅgadaiḥ kuṇḍalaiḥ śubhaiḥ| sahemasūtrairmaṇibhiḥ keyūrairvalayairapi anyaiśca ratnairbahubhiḥ kākutsthaḥ pratyapūjayat| suyajñaṃ sa tadovāca rāmassītā pracoditaḥ
translation: काकुत्स्थ: scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, जातरूपमयैः by golden, मुख्यैः with excellent, अङ्गदैः anklets, शुभैः auspicious, कुण्डलैः with earrings, सहेमसूत्रैः with golden strings, मणिभिः gems, केयूरैः bracelets, वलयैरपि armlets also, अन्यैः others, बहुभिः many, रत्नैश्च jewels, सुयज्ञम् to Suyajna, प्रत्यपूजयत् worshipped, तदा then, सः रामः that Rama, सीताप्रचोदितः urged by Sita, उवाच said.
explanation: Rama, scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, worshipped Suyajna with a collection of golden ornaments such as earrings, anklets, armlets, bracelets and many other ornaments of precious stones. Then urged by Sita, Rama said to him:

shloka_text: जातरूपमयैर्मुख्यैरङ्गदैः कुण्डलैः शुभैः। सहेमसूत्रैर्मणिभिः केयूरैर्वलयैरपि।।2.32.5।। अन्यैश्च रत्नैर्बहुभिः काकुत्स्थः प्रत्यपूजयत्। सुयज्ञं स तदोवाच रामस्सीता प्रचोदितः।।2.32.6।।
transliteration: jātarūpamayairmukhyairaṅgadaiḥ kuṇḍalaiḥ śubhaiḥ| sahemasūtrairmaṇibhiḥ keyūrairvalayairapi anyaiśca ratnairbahubhiḥ kākutsthaḥ pratyapūjayat| suyajñaṃ sa tadovāca rāmassītā pracoditaḥ
translation: काकुत्स्थ: scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, जातरूपमयैः by golden, मुख्यैः with excellent, अङ्गदैः anklets, शुभैः auspicious, कुण्डलैः with earrings, सहेमसूत्रैः with golden strings, मणिभिः gems, केयूरैः bracelets, वलयैरपि armlets also, अन्यैः others, बहुभिः many, रत्नैश्च jewels, सुयज्ञम् to Suyajna, प्रत्यपूजयत् worshipped, तदा then, सः रामः that Rama, सीताप्रचोदितः urged by Sita, उवाच said.
explanation: Rama, scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, worshipped Suyajna with a collection of golden ornaments such as earrings, anklets, armlets, bracelets and many other ornaments of precious stones. Then urged by Sita, Rama said to him:

shloka_text: हारं च हेमसूत्रं च भार्यायै सौम्य हारय। रशनां चाधुना सीता दातुमिच्छति ते सखे।।2.32.7।।
transliteration: hāraṃ ca hemasūtraṃ ca bhāryāyai saumya hāraya| raśanāṃ cādhunā sītā dātumicchati te sakhe
translation: सौम्य O handsome, सखे friend, सीता Sita, अधुना at this time, हारं च necklace also, हेमसूत्रं च golden chain, रशनां च also girdle, ते to you, दातुम् to give,  इच्छति wishes, भार्यायै to your wife, हारय take them.
explanation: O handsome friend now Sita intends to give away to your wife her necklace, her golden chain and girdle. Could you accept them?

shloka_text: अङ्गदानि विचित्राणि केयूराणि शुभानि च। प्रयच्छति सखे तुभ्यं भार्यायै गच्छती वनम्।।2.32.8।।
transliteration: aṅgadāni vicitrāṇi keyūrāṇi śubhāni ca| prayacchati sakhe tubhyaṃ bhāryāyai gacchatī vanam
translation: सखे O friend, वनम् to the forest, गच्छती departing Sita, भार्यायैः to your wife, अङ्गदानि anklets, विचित्राणि wonderful, शुभानि auspicious, केयुराणि च bracelets, तुभ्यम् to you, प्रयच्छति is offering.
explanation: Sita is departing for the forest and offers your wife her armlets, wonderful and elegant  bracelets.

shloka_text: पर्यङ्कमग्य्रास्तरणं नानारत्नविभूषितम्। तमपीच्छति वैदेही प्रतिष्ठापयितुं त्वयि।।2.32.9।।
transliteration: paryaṅkamagyrāstaraṇaṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitam| tamapīcchati vaidehī pratiṣṭhāpayituṃ tvayi
translation: वैदेही Sita, अग्य्रास्तरणम् exquisite bed cover, नानारत्नविभूषितम् encrusted with various gems, तं पर्यङ्कम् that couch, अपि also, त्वयि in you, प्रतिष्ठापयितुम् to place (in your house), इच्छति wishes.
explanation: Sita also wishes to give away a couch with an exquisite cover, encrusted with a variety of precious stones.

shloka_text: नाग श्शत्रुञ्जयो नाम मातुलोऽयं ददौ मम। तं ते गजसहस्रेण ददामि द्विजसत्तम।।2.32.10।।
transliteration: nāga śśatruñjayo nāma mātulo'yaṃ dadau mama| taṃ te gajasahasreṇa dadāmi dvijasattama
translation: द्विजसत्तम O best among brahmins, अयम् this one, शत्रुञ्जयो नाम by name Satrunjaya, नागः an elephant, मातुलः my maternal uncle, मम to me, ददौ gave, तम् to that (elephant), गजसहस्रेण along with a thousand elephants, ते to you, ददामि I am giving.
explanation: I am gifting you, O best among brahmins a thousand elephants including Satrunjaya an elephant my maternal uncle had given me.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तस्स हि रामेण सुयज्ञः प्रतिगृहृयतत्। रामलक्ष्मणसीतानां प्रयुयोजाशिष श्शुभाः।।2.32.11।।
transliteration: ityuktassa hi rāmeṇa suyajñaḥ pratigṛhṛyatat| rāmalakṣmaṇasītānāṃ prayuyojāśiṣa śśubhāḥ
translation: रामेण by Rama, इति thus, उक्तः spoken, सः सुयज्ञः that Suyajna, तत् that, प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, रामलक्ष्मणसीतानाम् to Rama, Lakshmana and Sita, शुभाः auspicious, आशिषः blessings, प्रयुयोज bestowed.
explanation: Thus addressed by Rama, Suyajna accepted the gifts and conferred auspicious blessings on Rama, Lakshmana and Sita.

shloka_text: अथ भ्रातरमव्यग्रं प्रियं रामः प्रियंवदः। सौमित्रिं तमुवाचेदं ब्रह्मेव त्रिदशेश्वरम्।।2.32.12।।
transliteration: atha bhrātaramavyagraṃ priyaṃ rāmaḥ priyaṃvadaḥ| saumitriṃ tamuvācedaṃ brahmeva tridaśeśvaram
translation: अथ thereafter, प्रियंवद: sweettongued, रामः Rama, प्रियम् to his beloved, भ्रातरम् to his brother, तं सौमित्रिम् to Lakshmana, ब्रह्मा creator, त्रिदशेश्वरम् इव like lord of heaven, Indra, अव्यग्रम् without haste, इदम् this word, उवाच said.
explanation: Sweettongued Rama calmly said to his brother (Lakshmana) like Brahma addressing Indra:

shloka_text: अगस्त्यं कौशिकं चैव तावुभौ ब्राह्मणोत्तमौ। अर्चयाहूय सौमित्रे रत्नैस्सस्यमिवाम्बुभिः।।2.32.13।।
transliteration: agastyaṃ kauśikaṃ caiva tāvubhau brāhmaṇottamau| arcayāhūya saumitre ratnaissasyamivāmbubhiḥ
translation: सौमित्रे Lakshmana, अगस्त्यम् sage Agasthya, कौशिकं चैव to sage Kausika, उभौ both, तौ ब्राह्मणोत्तमौ two eminent brahmins, आहूय having invited, रत्नैः gems, सस्यं crops, अम्बुभिः इव like rain waters, अर्चय worship.
explanation: O Lakshmana invite Agastya and Kausika, the two celebrated brahmins, and bestow on them with reverence plenty of precious gems like showers of rain on standing crops.

shloka_text: तर्पयस्व महाबाहो गोसहस्रैश्च मानद। सुवर्णै रजतैश्चैव मणिभिश्च महाधनैः।।2.32.14।।
transliteration: tarpayasva mahābāho gosahasraiśca mānada| suvarṇai rajataiścaiva maṇibhiśca mahādhanaiḥ
translation: महाबाहो O mightyarmed Lakshmana, मानद O bestower of honour, गोसहस्रैश्च with  a thousand cows, सुवर्णैः gold, रजतैश्चैव and also silver, महाधनैः great wealth, मणिभिश्च with gems also, तर्पयस्व you satisfy them.
explanation: Satisfy them, O highlyarmed Lakshmana, O bestower of honour with a thousand cows, gold, silver and with the great wealth of gems.

shloka_text: कौसल्यां च य आशीर्भिर्भक्तः पर्युपतिष्ठति। आचार्यस्तैत्तिरीयाणामभिरूपश्च वेदवित्।।2.32.15।। तस्य यानं च दासीश्च सौमित्रे सम्प्रदापय। कौशेयानि च वस्त्राणि यावत्तुष्यति स द्विजः।।2.32.16।।
transliteration: kausalyāṃ ca ya āśīrbhirbhaktaḥ paryupatiṣṭhati| ācāryastaittirīyāṇāmabhirūpaśca vedavit tasya yānaṃ ca dāsīśca saumitre sampradāpaya| kauśeyāni ca vastrāṇi yāvattuṣyati sa dvijaḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, तैत्तिरीयाणाम् of the Taittiriya branch of the Vedas, आचार्यः learned preceptor, अभिरूपश्च agreeable man, वेदवित् versed in the Vedas, यः who, भक्तः devotee, आशीर्भिः with blessings, कौशल्याम् of  Kausalya, पर्युपतिष्ठति attends on her, तस्य to him, सः द्विजः that brahmin, यावत् till such time, तुष्यति is fully satisfied, यानं च chariots, दासीश्च  maidservants, कौशेयानि वस्त्राणि च silk clothes also, संप्रदापय arrange to give away.
explanation: O Lakshmana, give away chariots, maidservants, silk clothes to learned brahmins of Taittiriya branch and wellversed in the Vedas, to agreeable and faithful brahmins attending on Kausalya with their blessings till they are fully satisfied.

shloka_text: कौसल्यां च य आशीर्भिर्भक्तः पर्युपतिष्ठति। आचार्यस्तैत्तिरीयाणामभिरूपश्च वेदवित्।।2.32.15।। तस्य यानं च दासीश्च सौमित्रे सम्प्रदापय। कौशेयानि च वस्त्राणि यावत्तुष्यति स द्विजः।।2.32.16।।
transliteration: kausalyāṃ ca ya āśīrbhirbhaktaḥ paryupatiṣṭhati| ācāryastaittirīyāṇāmabhirūpaśca vedavit tasya yānaṃ ca dāsīśca saumitre sampradāpaya| kauśeyāni ca vastrāṇi yāvattuṣyati sa dvijaḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, तैत्तिरीयाणाम् of the Taittiriya branch of the Vedas, आचार्यः learned preceptor, अभिरूपश्च agreeable man, वेदवित् versed in the Vedas, यः who, भक्तः devotee, आशीर्भिः with blessings, कौशल्याम् of  Kausalya, पर्युपतिष्ठति attends on her, तस्य to him, सः द्विजः that brahmin, यावत् till such time, तुष्यति is fully satisfied, यानं च chariots, दासीश्च  maidservants, कौशेयानि वस्त्राणि च silk clothes also, संप्रदापय arrange to give away.
explanation: O Lakshmana, give away chariots, maidservants, silk clothes to learned brahmins of Taittiriya branch and wellversed in the Vedas, to agreeable and faithful brahmins attending on Kausalya with their blessings till they are fully satisfied.

shloka_text: सूतश्चित्ररथश्चार्य सचिवस्सुचिरोषितः। तोषयैनं महार्हैश्च रत्नैर्वस्त्रैर्धनैस्तथा।।2.32.17।। पशुकाभिश्च सर्वाभिर्गवां दशशतेन च।
transliteration: sūtaścitrarathaścārya sacivassuciroṣitaḥ| toṣayainaṃ mahārhaiśca ratnairvastrairdhanaistathā paśukābhiśca sarvābhirgavāṃ daśaśatena ca|
translation: आर्यसचिवः noble counsellor (of our father), चित्ररथः Chitraratha, सूतः charioteer, सुचिरोषितः lived with us for many years, एनम् him, महार्है: with invaluable, रत्नैश्च with jewels, वस्त्रै: clothes, तथा similarly, धनैः with wealth,सर्वाभिः with all ,पशुकाभिः च with young female calves, गवाम् cows, दशशतेन च by (a thousand) ten hundreds, तोषय you may gratify him.
explanation: Noble counsellor (of our father) and charioteer Chitraratha has been in our service for many years. Gratify him with invaluable jewels, clothes, wealth, with young female calves and a thousand cows.

shloka_text: ये चेमे कठकालापा बहवो दण्डमाणवाः।।2.32.18।। नित्यस्वाध्यायशीलत्वान्नान्यत्कुर्वन्ति किञ्चन। अलसा स्वादुकामाश्च महतां चापि सम्मताः।।2.32.19।। तेषामशीतियानानि रत्नपूर्णानि दापय। शालिवाहसहस्रं च द्वे शते भद्रकां स्तथा।।2.32.20।। व्यञ्जनार्थं च सौमित्रे गोसहस्रमुपाकुरु।
transliteration: ye ceme kaṭhakālāpā bahavo daṇḍamāṇavāḥ nityasvādhyāyaśīlatvānnānyatkurvanti kiñcana| alasā svādukāmāśca mahatāṃ cāpi sammatāḥ teṣāmaśītiyānāni ratnapūrṇāni dāpaya| śālivāhasahasraṃ ca dve śate bhadrakāṃ stathā vyañjanārthaṃ ca saumitre gosahasramupākuru|
translation: कठकालापाः men versed in Katha and Kalapa portions of the Vedas, ये which, इमे these, बहवः many, दण्डमाणवाः brahmacharis holding a staff (as authority given to an ascetic), नित्यस्वाध्यायशीलत्वात् engaged daily in the study of Vedas, अन्यत् other, किञ्चन any work, न कुर्वन्ति not doing, अलसाः inactive people, स्वादुकामाश्च fond of delicious food, महतां चापि even for great people, सम्मताः are highly respected, तेषाम् for them, रत्नपूर्णानि filled with gems, अशीतियानानि eighty carts, शालिवाहसहस्रं च a thousand bulls capable of carrying corn, द्वे शते two hundred, भद्रकान् bulls, दापय arrange to give away, सौमित्रे O Lakshmana व्यञ्जनार्थम् for preparing food (with milk products), गोसहस्रम् a thousand cows, उपाकुरु arrange to give away.
explanation: O Lakshmana many brahmacharis with a staff (as a mark of religious authority) wellversed in Katha and Kalapa portions of the Vedas engaged daily in the study of the Vedas and nothing else. Not active otherwise, they are fond of delicious food and are respected even by great people. Give them eighty carts filled with gems, a thousand bulls capable of carrying paddy, and two hundred oxen capable of  ploughing land and a thousand cows for preparing food (with milk products).

Not active otherwise, they are fond of delicious food and are respected even by great people. Give them eighty carts filled with gems, a thousand bulls capable of carrying paddy, and two hundred oxen capable of  ploughing land and a thousand cows for preparing food (with milk products).

shloka_text: मेखलीनां महासङ्घः कौसल्यां समुपस्थितः।।2.32.21।। तेषां सहस्रं सौमित्रे प्रत्येकं सम्प्रदापय।
transliteration: mekhalīnāṃ mahāsaṅghaḥ kausalyāṃ samupasthitaḥ teṣāṃ sahasraṃ saumitre pratyekaṃ sampradāpaya|
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana मेखलीनाम् of brahmacharis (who wear a triple girdle worn by the first three castes), महासङ्घः in large numbers, कौशल्याम् of Kausalya, समुपस्थितः depending on, तेषाम् to them, प्रत्येकम् for each of them, सहस्रम् thousand (cows), सम्प्रदापय  gift away.
explanation: Give each of the large number of brahmacharis wearing girdles and working under Kausalya a thousand (cows or gold coins), O Lakshmana

shloka_text: अम्बा यथा च सा नन्देत्कौसल्या मम दक्षिणाम्।।2.32.22।। तथा द्विजातीस्ता न्सर्वान् लक्ष्मणार्चय सर्वशः।
transliteration: ambā yathā ca sā nandetkausalyā mama dakṣiṇām tathā dvijātīstā nsarvān lakṣmaṇārcaya sarvaśaḥ|
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अम्बा mother, सा कौशल्या Kausalya, मम my, दक्षिणाम् respectful offerings, यथा in whichever way, नन्देत् that pleases, तथा in that way, तान् those, सर्वान् all, द्विजातीन् brahmins, सर्वशः in all ways, अर्चय you may honour.
explanation: You should, O Lakshmana treat all those brahmins in such a way that my mother shall be pleased on seeing my respectful offerings.

shloka_text: तत स्सपुरुषव्याघ्रस्तद्धनं लक्ष्मणः स्वयम्।।2.32.23।। यथोक्तं ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणांमददाद्धनदो यथा।
transliteration: tata ssapuruṣavyāghrastaddhanaṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ svayam yathoktaṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃmadadāddhanado yathā|
translation: ततः thereupon, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men (best of men), सः लक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, धनदो यथा like Kubera, bestower of wealth, तत् धनम् that wealth, यथोक्तम् as told (by Rama), स्वयम् personally, ब्राह्मणेन्द्राणाम् to the Indras among brahmins (best brahmins), अददात् gave.
explanation: Thereupon Lakshmana, a tiger among men, personally distributed like Kubera, gifts of riches to all those Indras among brahmins (best of brahmins) in accordance with the instructions of Rama.

shloka_text: अथाऽब्रवीद्बाष्पकलांस्तिष्ठतश्चोपजीविनः।।2.32.24।। सम्प्रदायबहुद्रव्यमेकैकस्योपजीवनम्।
transliteration: athā'bravīdbāṣpakalāṃstiṣṭhataścopajīvinaḥ sampradāyabahudravyamekaikasyopajīvanam|
translation: अथ thereafter, बाष्पकलान् men with their throats choked with tears, तिष्ठतः remaining, उपजीविनः dependents, एकैकस्य for each one of them, बहु abundance of, द्रव्यम् wealth, उपजीवनम् as subsistence, सम्प्रदाय having bestowed, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Rama then bestowed abundant wealth on each of the dependents as they stood with their throats choked with tears, saying:

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्य च यद्वेश्म गृहं च यदिदं मम।।2.32.25।। अशून्यं कार्यमेकैकं यावदागमनं मम।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇasya ca yadveśma gṛhaṃ ca yadidaṃ mama aśūnyaṃ kāryamekaikaṃ yāvadāgamanaṃ mama|
translation: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, यत् which, वेश्म palace, मम my, इदम् this, यत् which, गृहं च palace also, एकैकम् each one, मम my, यावदागमनम् till I return, अशून्यम् without being unattended, कार्यम् fit to be done.
explanation: Till I come back, guard each of the palaces of Lakshmana and mine and ensure that they are not left unattended.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा दुःखितं सर्वं जनं तमुपजीविनम्।।2.32.26।। उवाचेदं धनाध्यक्षं धनमानीयतामिति।
transliteration: ityuktvā duḥkhitaṃ sarvaṃ janaṃ tamupajīvinam uvācedaṃ dhanādhyakṣaṃ dhanamānīyatāmiti|
translation: दुःखितम् filled with grief, उपजीविनम् dependents, सर्वम् all, तं जनम् to that group, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, धनम् treasure, आनीयताम् bring, इति thus, इदम् this word, धनाध्यक्षम् to treasury officer, उवाच said.
explanation: Having spoken thus to all dependents who were overcome with grief, Rama ordered the  treasury officer to bring the entire treasure.

shloka_text: ततोऽस्य धनमाजह्रुस्सर्वमेवोपजीविनः।।2.32.27।। स राशिस्सुमहांस्तत्र दर्शनीयो ह्यदृश्यत।
transliteration: tato'sya dhanamājahrussarvamevopajīvinaḥ sa rāśissumahāṃstatra darśanīyo hyadṛśyata|
translation: ततः after that, उपजीविनः dependents, अस्य Rama's, सर्वमेव entire, धनम् wealth, आजह्रुः brought, तत्र there, सुमहान् extremely great, सः राशिः that heap of wealth, दर्शनीयः pleasing to see, अदृश्यत beheld.
explanation: When all the dependents fetched the entire wealth of Rama, they were pleased to see the great heap of wealth.

shloka_text: ततस्सपुरुषव्याघ्र स्तद्धनं सहलक्ष्मणः।।2.32.28।। द्विजेभ्यो बालवृद्धेभ्यः कृपणेभ्योऽह्यदापयत्।
transliteration: tatassapuruṣavyāghra staddhanaṃ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ dvijebhyo bālavṛddhebhyaḥ kṛpaṇebhyo'hyadāpayat|
translation: ततः then, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men (best of men), सः that Rama, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, तत् धनम् that wealth, द्विजेभ्यः to brahmins, बालवृद्धेभ्यः to the young and old, कृपणेभ्यः to the poor, अदापयत् got it distributed.
explanation: Rama, best among men, got the entire wealth distributed among indigent brahmins, and young and old alike with the help of Lakshmana.

shloka_text: तत्रासीत्पिङ्गलो गार्ग्यस्त्रिजटो नाम वै द्विजः।।2.32.29।। क्षतवृत्तिर्वने नित्यं फालकुद्दाललाङ्गली।
transliteration: tatrāsītpiṅgalo gārgyastrijaṭo nāma vai dvijaḥ kṣatavṛttirvane nityaṃ phālakuddālalāṅgalī|
translation: तत्र there, नित्यम् always, फालकुद्दाललाङ्गली with an ironspade and a plough, वने in the forest, क्षतवृत्ति: digging the earth as profession, पिङ्गलः a man of reddishbrown colour, गार्ग्यः descendant of sage Gargya, त्रिजटो नाम by name Trijata, द्विजः brahmin, आसीत् lived.
explanation: A brahmin by name, Trijata, a descendant of sage Garga and of reddishbrown colour used to live in that region earning his livelihood in the forest by digging the earth with an ironspade and a plough.

shloka_text: तं वृद्धं तरुणी भार्या बालानादाय दारकान्।।2.32.30।। अब्रवीद्बाह्मणं वाक्यं दारिद्र्येणाभिपीडिता।
transliteration: taṃ vṛddhaṃ taruṇī bhāryā bālānādāya dārakān abravīdbāhmaṇaṃ vākyaṃ dāridryeṇābhipīḍitā|
translation: तरुणी young, भार्या wife, दारिद्र्येण due to poverty, अभिपीडिता highly distressed, बालान् young, दारकान् sons, आदाय after presenting, वृद्धम् aged, तं ब्राह्मणम् to that brahmin, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: His young wife, highly distressed due to poverty, keeping her young sons before her said to the aged brahmin:

shloka_text: अपास्य फालं कुद्दालं कुरुष्व वचनं मम।।2.32.31।। रामं दर्शय धर्मज्ञं यदि किञ्चिदवाप्स्यसि।
transliteration: apāsya phālaṃ kuddālaṃ kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama rāmaṃ darśaya dharmajñaṃ yadi kiñcidavāpsyasi|
translation: फालम् iron, कुद्दालम् spade, अपास्य throwing away, मम my, वचनम् words, कुरुष्व implement, धर्मज्ञम् knower of  righteousness, रामम् to Rama, दर्शय you may present yourself, किञ्चित् something, अवाप्स्यसि यदि if at all you may obtain.
explanation: Listen to me throw away this ironspade. Go and see the righteous Rama.You may obtain something.

shloka_text: स भार्यावचनं श्रुत्वा शाटीमाच्छाद्य दुश्छदाम्।।2.32.32।। स प्रातिष्ठत पन्थानं यत्र रामनिवेशनम्।
transliteration: sa bhāryāvacanaṃ śrutvā śāṭīmācchādya duśchadām sa prātiṣṭhata panthānaṃ yatra rāmaniveśanam|
translation: सः that Trijata, भार्यावचनम् wife's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, दुःश्छदाम् tattered clothes, शाटीम् upper garment, आच्छाद्य having wrapped, रामनिवेशनम् Rama's palace, यत्र where it is located, पन्थानम् about the path, प्रातिष्ठत he set forth.
explanation: At the words of his wife, Trijata took the path to Rama's palace, having wrapped  himself with a torn upper garment .

shloka_text: भृग्वङ्गिरसमं दीप्त्या त्रिजटं जनसंसदि।।2.32.33।। आपञ्चमायाः कक्ष्यायाः नैनं कश्चिदवारयत्।
transliteration: bhṛgvaṅgirasamaṃ dīptyā trijaṭaṃ janasaṃsadi āpañcamāyāḥ kakṣyāyāḥ nainaṃ kaścidavārayat|
translation: जनसंसदि in the crowd, दीप्त्या in lustre, भृग्वङ्गिरसमम् like Bhrugu and Angirasa, एनम् this, त्रिजटम् Trijata, आपञ्चमायाः कक्ष्यायाः up to the fifth courtyard, कश्चित् any one, न अवारयत् did not stop him.
explanation: No one in the crowd stopped Tirjata until he reached the fifth courtyard as he looked like Bhrigu and Angirasa in brilliance.

shloka_text: स राजपुत्रमासाद्य त्रिजटो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.32.34।। निर्धनो बहुपुत्रोऽस्मि राजपुत्र महायशः। उञ्छवृत्तिर्वने नित्यं प्रत्यवेक्षस्व मामिति।।2.32.35।।
transliteration: sa rājaputramāsādya trijaṭo vākyamabravīt nirdhano bahuputro'smi rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ| uñchavṛttirvane nityaṃ pratyavekṣasva māmiti
translation: सः त्रिजटः that Trijata, राजपुत्रम् prince Rama, आसाद्य having approached, वाक्यम् these  words, अब्रवीत् uttered, महायशः O illustrious one, राजपुत्र O Prince, निर्धनः I am a destitute, बहुपुत्रः father of many children, नित्यम् daily, वने in the forest, उञ्छवृत्ति: अस्मि living on collecting the leftover grain of the field, माम् me, प्रत्यवेक्षस्व look at, इति thus.
explanation: Trijata approached Rama and said O illustrious prince I am a destitute and have many children. I am  living in the forest by collecting leftover grains. Look at me.

shloka_text: स राजपुत्रमासाद्य त्रिजटो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.32.34।। निर्धनो बहुपुत्रोऽस्मि राजपुत्र महायशः। उञ्छवृत्तिर्वने नित्यं प्रत्यवेक्षस्व मामिति।।2.32.35।।
transliteration: sa rājaputramāsādya trijaṭo vākyamabravīt nirdhano bahuputro'smi rājaputra mahāyaśaḥ| uñchavṛttirvane nityaṃ pratyavekṣasva māmiti
translation: सः त्रिजटः that Trijata, राजपुत्रम् prince Rama, आसाद्य having approached, वाक्यम् these  words, अब्रवीत् uttered, महायशः O illustrious one, राजपुत्र O Prince, निर्धनः I am a destitute, बहुपुत्रः father of many children, नित्यम् daily, वने in the forest, उञ्छवृत्ति: अस्मि living on collecting the leftover grain of the field, माम् me, प्रत्यवेक्षस्व look at, इति thus.
explanation: Trijata approached Rama and said O illustrious prince I am a destitute and have many children. I am  living in the forest by collecting leftover grains. Look at me.

shloka_text: तमुवाच ततो राम: परिहास समन्वितम्। गवां सहस्रमप्येकं न नु विश्राणितं मया।।2.32.36।। परिक्षिपसि दण्डेन यावत्तावदवाप्स्यसि।
transliteration: tamuvāca tato rāma: parihāsa samanvitam| gavāṃ sahasramapyekaṃ na nu viśrāṇitaṃ mayā parikṣipasi daṇḍena yāvattāvadavāpsyasi|
translation: ततः then, रामः Rama, परिहाससमन्वितम् jokingly, तम् him, उवाच said, मया by me, एकम् one, गवां सहस्रमपि thousand cows, न च विश्राणितम् not yet given away, दण्डेन with staff, यावत् as far as, परिक्षिपसि you will hurl, तावत् till such place, अवाप्स्यसि you will obtain.
explanation: Rama jokingly replied to him, I have not yet gifted one thousand cows. Throw your staff and the cows on the space your staff covers will be yours.

shloka_text: स शाटीं त्वरितः कट्यां सम्भ्रान्तः परिवेष्ट्य ताम्।।2.32.37।। आविद्ध्य दण्डं चिक्षेप सर्वप्राणेन वेगितः।
transliteration: sa śāṭīṃ tvaritaḥ kaṭyāṃ sambhrāntaḥ pariveṣṭya tām āviddhya daṇḍaṃ cikṣepa sarvaprāṇena vegitaḥ|
translation: सः Trijata, सम्भ्रान्तः bewildered, त्वरितः swiftly, तां शाटीम् his upper garment, कट्याम् on his waist, परिवेष्ट्य after throwing round, दण्डम् staff, आविद्ध्य after setting the direction, वेगितः swiftly, सर्वप्राणेन with all his might, चिक्षेप hurled.
explanation: Bewildered Trijata swiftly tightened up his upper garment around his waist, set the direction for his staff and hurled it with all his might.

shloka_text: स तीर्त्वा सरयूपारं दण्डस्तस्य कराच्च्युतः।।2.32.38।। गोव्रजे बहुसाहस्रे पपातोक्षणसन्निधौ।
transliteration: sa tīrtvā sarayūpāraṃ daṇḍastasya karāccyutaḥ govraje bahusāhasre papātokṣaṇasannidhau|
translation: तस्य his, करात् from the hand, च्युतः released, सः दण्डः that staff, सरयूपारम् the bank of  Sarayu river, तीर्त्वा having crossed, बहुसाहस्रे in very many thousands, गोव्रजे in the midst of  multitude of cows, उक्षणसन्निधौ near a bull, पपात fell.
explanation: The staff he hurled crossed the bank of the river Sarayu and fell near a bull in the midst of a thousands cows.

shloka_text: तं परिष्वज्य धर्मात्मा आतस्मात्सरयूतटात्।।2.32.39।। आनयामास ता गोपै स्त्रिजटायाश्रमं प्रति।
transliteration: taṃ pariṣvajya dharmātmā ātasmātsarayūtaṭāt ānayāmāsa tā gopai strijaṭāyāśramaṃ prati|
translation: धर्मात्मा virtuous , तम् him, परिष्वज्य having embraced, तस्मात् that, आसरयूतटात् up to the bank of Sarayu river, ताः those cows, गोपैः by herdsmen, त्रिजटाय Trijata's, आश्रमं प्रति towards the hermitage, आनयामास brought them.
explanation: The virtuous Rama embraced Trijata, and despatched all the cattle extending up to the bank of Sarayu to his hermitage.

shloka_text: उवाच स ततो रामस्तं गार्ग्यमभिसान्त्वयन्। मन्युर्न खलु कर्तव्यः परिहासो ह्ययं मम।।2.32.40।।
transliteration: uvāca sa tato rāmastaṃ gārgyamabhisāntvayan| manyurna khalu kartavyaḥ parihāso hyayaṃ mama
translation: ततः afterwards, रामः Rama, तं गार्ग्यम् that Gargya, अभिसान्त्वयन् consoling (him), उवाच said, मन्युः anger, न खलु कर्तव्यः should not be made, अयम् this, मम my, परिहासः a joke.
explanation: Afterwards Rama sought to placate Trijata, that descendant of Ganga, saying: This was a joke. Do not be angry.

shloka_text: इदं हि तेजस्तव यद्दुरत्ययं तदेव जिज्ञासितुमिच्छता मया। इमं भवानर्थमभि प्रचोदितो वृणीष्व किं चेदपरं व्यवस्यति।।2.32.41।।
transliteration: idaṃ hi tejastava yadduratyayaṃ tadeva jijñāsitumicchatā mayā| imaṃ bhavānarthamabhi pracodito vṛṇīṣva kiṃ cedaparaṃ vyavasyati
translation: तव your, दुरत्ययम् unsurpassable, यत् which, तेजः power, तत् that, जिज्ञासितुम् to ascertain, इच्छता एव indeed desiring, मया by me, भवान् you, इमम् this, अर्थम् act, अभिप्रचोदितः incited, अपरम् other, किम् any other, व्यवस्यति चेत् if sought, वृणीष्व you may ask for.
explanation: Your power is unsurpassable and to ascertain this, I incited you to do this act. If there is anything else, ask for it.

shloka_text: ब्रवीमि सत्येन नतेऽस्ति यन्त्रणा धनं हि यद्यन्मम विप्रकारणात्। भवत्सु सम्यक्प्रतिपादनेन त न्मयार्जितं प्रीतियशस्करं भवेत्।।2.32.42।।
transliteration: bravīmi satyena nate'sti yantraṇā dhanaṃ hi yadyanmama viprakāraṇāt| bhavatsu samyakpratipādanena ta nmayārjitaṃ prītiyaśaskaraṃ bhavet
translation: सत्येन truly, ब्रवीमि I speak, ते to you, यन्त्रणा restraint (to seek this much only), नास्ति is not there, मम my, यद्यत् whichever, धनम् wealth, विप्रकारणात् हि indeed for  brahmins only, मया by me, र्जितम् earned, तत् that, भवत्सु in you, सम्यक् correctly,  प्रतिपादनेन by offering, प्रीतियशस्करम् भवेत् gives me pleasure and renown.
explanation: Truly speaking, there is no limit to seeking wealth. My wealth is specifically meant for brahmins. By distributing all the wealth earned by me, I get pleasure and renown.

shloka_text: तत स्सभार्य स्त्रिजटो महामुनि र्गवामनीकं प्रतिगृह्य मोदितः। यशोबलप्रीतिसुखोपबृंहणी स्तदाशिष: प्रत्यवदन्महात्मनः।।2.32.43।।
transliteration: tata ssabhārya strijaṭo mahāmuni rgavāmanīkaṃ pratigṛhya moditaḥ| yaśobalaprītisukhopabṛṃhaṇī stadāśiṣa: pratyavadanmahātmanaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, सभार्यः along with his wife, महामुनिः great sage, त्रिजटः Trijata, गवाम् cows, अनीकम् multitude, प्रतिगृह्य having accepted, मोदितः delighted, तदा then, महात्मनः magnanimous (Rama), यशोबलप्रीतिसुखोपबृंहणीः enhancing glory, power, pleasure and prosperity, आशिषः blessings, प्रत्यवदत् gave in reply.
explanation: Thereafter that great sage Trijata along with his wife, immensely happy to receive multitudes of cows, pronounced blessings on the magnanimous Rama for glory, power, pleasure and prosperity.

shloka_text: स चापि रामः प्रतिपूर्णमानसो महद्धनं धर्मबलैरुपार्जितम्। नियोजयामास सुहृज्जनेऽचिरा द्यथार्हसम्मानवचः प्रचोदितः।।2.32.44।।
transliteration: sa cāpi rāmaḥ pratipūrṇamānaso mahaddhanaṃ dharmabalairupārjitam| niyojayāmāsa suhṛjjane'cirā dyathārhasammānavacaḥ pracoditaḥ
translation: सः that, राम: चापि Rama also, प्रतिपूर्णमानसः with completely satisfied mind, धर्मबलैः through dharma, उपार्जितम् earned, महत् धनम् vast wealth, अचिरात् without delay, यथार्हसम्मानवचः प्रचोदितः prompted by the deserving words of acclaim, सुहृज्जने among his friends, नियोजयामास offered.
explanation: Prompted by the deserving words of acclaim from his friends, Rama distributed with joy and without delay the entire wealth earned by him through dharma.

shloka_text: द्विज स्सुहृद्भृत्यजनोऽथवा तदा दरिद्रभिक्षाचरणश्च योऽभवत्। न तत्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तर्पितो यथार्हसम्मानन दान सम्भ्रमैः।।2.32.46।।
transliteration: dvija ssuhṛdbhṛtyajano'thavā tadā daridrabhikṣācaraṇaśca yo'bhavat| na tatra kaścinna babhūva tarpito yathārhasammānana dāna sambhramaiḥ
translation: तत्र there, तदा then, यः such, द्विज: a brahmin, सुहृत् friend, अथवा or, भृत्यजनः servant, दरिद्र भिक्षाचरणश्च poor or beggar, कश्चित् any one, यथार्हसम्माननदानसम्भ्रमैः with the befitting honour or with charity, न तर्पितः not satisfied, न बभूव there was none.
explanation: Thus there was none among those brahmins, attendants, poor people, and beggars, who was not satisfied with the honour (received) or with the charity. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे द्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysecond sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: दत्त्वा तु सह वैदेह्या ब्राह्मणेभ्यो धनं बहु। जग्मतुः पितरं द्रष्टुं सीतया सह राघवौ।।2.33.1।।
transliteration: dattvā tu saha vaidehyā brāhmaṇebhyo dhanaṃ bahu| jagmatuḥ pitaraṃ draṣṭuṃ sītayā saha rāghavau
translation: राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, वैदेह्या सह along with Sita, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः to brahmins, बहु plenty, धनम् wealth, दत्वा having given (in charity), पितरम् to father, द्रष्टुम् to see, सीतया सह along with Sita, जग्मतुः both of them set out.
explanation: After giving away plenty of wealth to brahmins in charity, Rama and Lakshmana along with Sita set out to see their father, king Dasaratha.
comments: Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana goes to the residence of Kaikeyi--hears comments on the way.

shloka_text: ततो गृहीते दुष्प्रेक्षे त्वशोभेतां तदायुधे। मालादामभिराबद्धे सीतया समलङ्कृते।।2.33.2।।
transliteration: tato gṛhīte duṣprekṣe tvaśobhetāṃ tadāyudhe| mālādāmabhirābaddhe sītayā samalaṅkṛte
translation: ततः then, दुष्प्रेक्षे dazzling, गृहीते held, सीतया by Sita, मालादामभिः with garlands, अबद्धे bound, समलङ्कृते decorated, तदायुथे pair of weapons of Rama and Lakshmana, अशोभेताम् shone.
explanation: The pair of dazzling weapons held (by Rama and Lakshmana) looked splendid decorated with flower garlands by Sita.

shloka_text: ततः प्रासादहर्म्याणि विमानशिखराणि च। अधिरुह्य जनश्श्रीमानुदासीनो व्यलोकयत्।।2.33.3।।
transliteration: tataḥ prāsādaharmyāṇi vimānaśikharāṇi ca| adhiruhya janaśśrīmānudāsīno vyalokayat
translation: ततः then, श्रीमान् prosperous, जनः people, प्रासादहर्म्याणि palaces and mansions, विमानशिखराणि च terraces of sevenstoried buildings, अधिरुह्य having climbed, उदासीनः sad, व्यलोकयत् looked.
explanation: The rich climbed their palaces and mansions, terraces of sevenstoried buildings and watched them sadly.

shloka_text: न हि रथ्याः स्म शक्यन्ते गन्तुं बहुजनाकुलाः। आरुह्य तस्मात्प्रासादान् दीनाः पश्यन्ति राघवम्।।2.33.4।।
transliteration: na hi rathyāḥ sma śakyante gantuṃ bahujanākulāḥ| āruhya tasmātprāsādān dīnāḥ paśyanti rāghavam
translation: बहुजनाकुलाः thronged with multitudes of citizens, रथ्याः streets, गन्तुम् to walk, न शक्यन्ते स्म हि indeed were unable, तस्मात् for that reason, दीनाः miserable,  प्रासादन् the palace, आरुह्य having ascended, राघवम् Rama, पश्यन्ति were looking.
explanation: The streets were so thronged with multitudes of citizens that they were impassable. Therefore, people felt miserable and ascended their mansions and gazed at Rama.

shloka_text: पदातिं वर्जितच्छत्रं रामं दृष्ट्वा जनास्तदा। ऊचुर्बहुविधा वाच श्शोकोपहतचेतसः।।2.33.5।।
transliteration: padātiṃ varjitacchatraṃ rāmaṃ dṛṣṭvā janāstadā| ūcurbahuvidhā vāca śśokopahatacetasaḥ
translation: तदा then, जनाः people, पदातिम् pedestrian, वर्जितच्छत्रम् without the (royal) umbrella, रामम् to Rama, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शोकोपहतचेतसः griefstricken, बहुविधाः in many ways, वाचः words, ऊचुः uttered.
explanation: Seeing Rama walking without the royal umbrella, people were very much shocked. They expressed their reaction in so many words:

shloka_text: यं यान्तमनुयाति स्म चतुरङ्गबलं महत्। तमेकं सीतया सार्धमनुयाति स्म लक्ष्मणः।।2.33.6।।
transliteration: yaṃ yāntamanuyāti sma caturaṅgabalaṃ mahat| tamekaṃ sītayā sārdhamanuyāti sma lakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: यान्तम् while going, यम् whom, महत् powerful, चतुरङ्गबलम् army of four divisions, अनुयाति स्म used to follow, तम् such, एकम् alone, सीतया सार्धम् along with Sita, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अनुयाति स्म followed.
explanation: Whenever Rama went out, powerful army of four divisions used to follow him. Today he is walking alone followed by Lakshmana and Sita.

shloka_text: ऐश्वर्यस्य रसज्ञः सन् कामिनां चैव कामदः। नेच्छत्येवानृतं कर्तुं पितरं धर्मगौरवात्।।2.33.7।।
transliteration: aiśvaryasya rasajñaḥ san kāmināṃ caiva kāmadaḥ| necchatyevānṛtaṃ kartuṃ pitaraṃ dharmagauravāt
translation: ऐश्वर्यस्य of affluence, रसज्ञः सन् while enjoying, कामिनाम् for those who have desires, कामदः चैव fulfiller of desires (Rama), धर्मगौरवात्  out of veneration for righteousness, पितरं to father, अनृतम् false, कर्तुम् to make, नेच्छत्येव does not wish.
explanation: Rama who enjoyed the comforts of affluence gratifies those who have desires. Out of veneration for righteousness, he does not want to prove his father false (to his promise).

shloka_text: या न शक्या पुरा द्रष्टुं भूतैराकाशगैरपि। तामद्य सीतां पश्यन्ति राजमार्गगता जनाः।।2.33.8।।
transliteration: yā na śakyā purā draṣṭuṃ bhūtairākāśagairapi| tāmadya sītāṃ paśyanti rājamārgagatā janāḥ
translation: पुरा earlier, या Sita, आकाशगैः by those wandering in the sky (birds), भूतैरपि creatures, द्रष्टुम् to see, न शक्या not possible, तां सीताम् to that Sita, अद्य now, राजमार्गगताः those walking on the highway, जनाः passersby, पश्यन्ति are beholding.
explanation: It was not possible even for the creatures wandering in the sky (birds) to have a glimpse of Sita before. Now passersby walking the highway can behold her.

shloka_text: अङ्गरागोचितां सीतां रक्तचन्दनसेविनीम्। वर्षमुष्णं च शीतं च नेष्यन्त्याशु विवर्णताम्।।2.33.9।।
transliteration: aṅgarāgocitāṃ sītāṃ raktacandanasevinīm| varṣamuṣṇaṃ ca śītaṃ ca neṣyantyāśu vivarṇatām
translation: अङ्गरागोचिताम् used to fragrant unguents, रक्तचन्दन सेविनीम् smeared with red sandalpaste, सीताम् Sita, वर्षम् rain, उष्णं च heat, शीतं च cold, आशु quickly, विवर्णताम्  discoloured, नेष्यन्ति will render.
explanation: Sita who used to apply fragrant unguents and smear the body with redsandal cream will now be exposed to the rain, the heat and the cold which will quickly discolour her body.

shloka_text: अद्य नूनं दशरथस्सत्त्वमाविश्य भाषते। न हि राजा प्रियं पुत्रं विवासयितुमर्हति।।2.33.10।।
transliteration: adya nūnaṃ daśarathassattvamāviśya bhāṣate| na hi rājā priyaṃ putraṃ vivāsayitumarhati
translation: अद्य today, नूनम् surely, दशरथः Dasaratha, सत्त्वम् by evil spirit, आविश्य after being  possessed by, भाषते is speaking, राजा king, प्रियम् beloved, पुत्रम् son, विवासयितुम् to banish, न अर्हति हि is not fit enough.
explanation: Surely king Dasaratha possessed of an evil spirit spoke the way he did today. Otherwise, should a king banish his beloved son?

shloka_text: निर्गुणस्यापि पुत्रस्य कथं स्याद्विप्रवासनम्। किं पुनर्यस्य लोकोऽयं जितो वृत्तेन केवलम्।।2.33.11।।
transliteration: nirguṇasyāpi putrasya kathaṃ syādvipravāsanam| kiṃ punaryasya loko'yaṃ jito vṛttena kevalam
translation: निर्गुणस्यापि even one bereft of virtues, पुत्रस्य of a son, विप्रवासनम् banishment, कथम् how, स्यात् can it be, यस्य whose, वृत्तेन केवलम् by good conduct alone, अयं लोकः this world, जितः conquered, किं पुनः why to say again?
explanation: Even a son who is bereft of virtues cannot be banished, what to say about Rama, who by good conduct alone has conquered the world.

shloka_text: अनृशंस्यमनुक्रोशः श्रुतं शीलं दमश्शमः। राघवं शोभयन्त्येते षड्गुणाः पुरुषोत्तमम्।।2.33.12।।
transliteration: anṛśaṃsyamanukrośaḥ śrutaṃ śīlaṃ damaśśamaḥ| rāghavaṃ śobhayantyete ṣaḍguṇāḥ puruṣottamam
translation: आनृशंस्यम् harmlessness, अनुक्रोशः compassion, श्रुतम् learning, शीलम् good conduct, दमः restraint of senses, शमः self control, एते all these, षट् six, गुणाः qualities, पुरुषोत्तमम् greatest among men, राघवम् Rama, शोभयन्ति adorn.
explanation: Harmlessness, compassion, learning, good conduct, restraint of senses and selfcontrol, all these six qualities adorn Rama, the greatest among men.

shloka_text: तस्मात्तस्योपघातेन प्रजाः परमपीडिताः। औदकानीव सत्त्वानि ग्रीष्मे सलिलसङ्क्षयात्।।2.33.13।।
transliteration: tasmāttasyopaghātena prajāḥ paramapīḍitāḥ| audakānīva sattvāni grīṣme salilasaṅkṣayāt
translation: तस्मात् for that reason, तस्य Rama's, उपघातेन by hurting, ग्रीष्मे in summer, सलिलसङ्क्षयात्  due to drying up of water, औदकानि aquatic, सत्त्वानीव like creatures, प्रजाः people, परमपीडिताः were highly tormented.
explanation: Therefore, people are deeply pained to see Rama afflicted. They look like aquatic creatures in summer when the water dries up.

shloka_text: पीडया पीडितं सर्वं जगदस्य जगत्पतेः। मूलस्येवोपघातेन वृक्षः पुष्पफलोपगः।।2.33.14।।
transliteration: pīḍayā pīḍitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadasya jagatpateḥ| mūlasyevopaghātena vṛkṣaḥ puṣpaphalopagaḥ
translation: जगत्पतेः of the ruler of the earth, अस्य this Rama's, पीडया on account of his suffering, सर्वम् entire, जगत् earth, मूलस्य at the root, उपघातेन by destruction, पुष्पफलोपगः bearing flowers and fruits, वृक्षः इव like a tree, पीडितम् is distressed.
explanation: Just as severed at the root, an entire tree along with its fruits and flowers is destroyed, similarly the whole world gets afflicted when Rama, the ruler of the world, comes to harm.

shloka_text: मूलं ह्येष मनुष्याणां धर्मसारो महाद्युतिः। पुष्पं फलं च पत्रं च शाखाश्चास्येतरे जनाः।।2.33.15।।
transliteration: mūlaṃ hyeṣa manuṣyāṇāṃ dharmasāro mahādyutiḥ| puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca patraṃ ca śākhāścāsyetare janāḥ
translation: धर्मसारः the essence of dharma, महाद्युतिः effulgent, एषः this Rama, मनुष्याणाम् of humanity, मूलं हि is root indeed, इतरे other, जनाः people, अस्य Rama's (like the trunk of a tree), पुष्पम् flower, फलं च fruit as well, पत्रं च leaf also, शाखाश्च branches.
explanation: Effulgent Rama personifies the essence of dharma. He is the root of  (the tree of) humanity. The other people are connected with this tree like flowers, fruit, leaves and branches.

shloka_text: ते लक्ष्मण इव क्षिप्रं सपत्न्य स्सहबान्धवाः। गच्छन्तमनुगच्छामो येन गच्छति राघवः।।2.33.16।।
transliteration: te lakṣmaṇa iva kṣipraṃ sapatnya ssahabāndhavāḥ| gacchantamanugacchāmo yena gacchati rāghavaḥ
translation: ते such men as we are, सपत्न्यः with (our) wives, सहबान्धवाः together with (our) relations, राघवः Rama, येन on which (way), गच्छति is going, गच्छन्तम् departing, लक्ष्मण इव like Lakshmana, क्षिप्रम् without delay, अनुगच्छामः we will follow.
explanation: Let all of us without delay along with our wives and relations follow Rama, like Lakshmana, wherever he goes.

shloka_text: उद्यानानि परित्यज्य क्षेत्राणि च गृहाणि च। एकदुःखसुखा राममनुगच्छाम धार्मिकम्।।2.33.17।।
transliteration: udyānāni parityajya kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca| ekaduḥkhasukhā rāmamanugacchāma dhārmikam
translation: उद्यानानि gardens, क्षेत्राणि fields, गृहाणि च houses also, परित्यज्य deserting, एक दुःखसुखाः experiencing the same joy and sorrow (as Rama), धार्मिकम् virtuous, रामम् Rama, अनुगच्छामः shall follow.
explanation: Deserting our gardens, fields and houses and experiencing the same joy and sorrow of the virtuous Rama, we shall follow him.

shloka_text: समुद्धृतनिधानानि परिध्वस्ताजिराणि च। उपात्त धनधान्यानि हृतसाराणि सर्वशः।।2.33.18।। रजसाभ्यवकीर्णानि परित्यक्तानि दैवतैः। मूषकैःपरिधावद्भिरुद्बिलैरावृतानि च।।2.33.19।। अपेतोदकधूमानि हीनसम्मार्जनानि च। प्रणष्टबलिकर्मेज्यामन्त्रहोमजपानि च।।2.33.20।। दुष्कालेनेव भग्नानि भिन्नभाजनवन्ति च। अस्मात्त्यक्तानि वेश्मानि कैकेयी प्रतिपद्यताम्।।2.33.21।।
transliteration: samuddhṛtanidhānāni paridhvastājirāṇi ca| upātta dhanadhānyāni hṛtasārāṇi sarvaśaḥ rajasābhyavakīrṇāni parityaktāni daivataiḥ| mūṣakaiḥparidhāvadbhirudbilairāvṛtāni ca apetodakadhūmāni hīnasammārjanāni ca| praṇaṣṭabalikarmejyāmantrahomajapāni ca duṣkāleneva bhagnāni bhinnabhājanavanti ca| asmāttyaktāni veśmāni kaikeyī pratipadyatām
translation: समुद्धृतनिधानानि with treasures unearthed, परिध्वस्ताजिराणि च and ruined courtyards, उपात्त धनधान्यानि with wealth and foodgrains removed, सर्वशः wholly, हृतसाराणि deprived of wealth, रजसा with dust, अभ्यवकीर्णानि spread, दैवतैः by gods, परित्यक्तानि abandoned, उद्बिलैः emerging out of burrows, परिथावद्भि: by those running quickly around, मूषकैः by rats, आवृतानि च filled with, अपेतोदकधूमानि (houses) without water and without (emitting)  smoke, हीनसम्मार्जनानि च also unswept, प्रणष्टबलिकर्मेज्यामन्त्रहोमजपानि च  absence of offerings, sacrifices, recitation of sacred hymns, libations, and invocations, दुष्कालेन famine, भग्नानि इव like dilapidated, भिन्नभाजनवन्ति च places with broken utensils, अस्मत्त्यक्तानि deserted by us, वेश्मानि homes, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, प्रतिपद्यताम् let her own.
explanation: Let Kaikeyi take possession of our deserted and dilapidated homes with ruined courtyards which seem as though struck by calamities. They are drained of wealth and foodgrains, covered with dust and abandoned by the gods. There is no water or smoke (from kitchen). They are infested with rats. They stand unswept. There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.

There foodgrains lie around ratholes, and broken earthenwares lie scattered. There are no offerings, no sacrifices, no recitation of sacred hymns, no libations and no invocations.
