translation: सौम्य O handsome one, एतत् this, ऐणेयम् venison, श्रपयस्व cook, वयम् we, शालाम् hut, यक्ष्यामहे will worship, अयम् this, दिवस: day, अयम् this, मुहूर्त:अपि this moment also, ध्रुवश्च is fixed, त्वर hasten.
explanation: Cook this venison, O handsome one We will offer it to the presiding deity of this hut. Hasten, the day and time are fixed (for the rites)

shloka_text: स लक्ष्मणः कृष्णमृगं मेध्यं हत्वा प्रतापवान्। अथ चिक्षेप सौमित्रिस्समिद्धे जातवेदसि।।2.56.26।।
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇaḥ kṛṣṇamṛgaṃ medhyaṃ hatvā pratāpavān| atha cikṣepa saumitrissamiddhe jātavedasi
translation: अथ then, सौमित्रि: son of Sumitra, प्रतापवान् powerful, स: लक्ष्मण: that Lakshmana, मेथ्यम् fit for offering pure, कृष्णमृगम् black antelope, हत्वा having killed, समिद्धे in a wellkindled, जातवेदसि fire, चिक्षेप offered.
explanation: Then the powerful son of Sumitra killed a black antelope fit for offering, and offered it to the wellkindled fire.

shloka_text: तन्तु पक्वं परिज्ञाय निष्टप्तं छिन्नशोणितम्। लक्ष्मण: पुरुषव्याघ्रमथ राघवमब्रवीत्।।2.56.27।।
transliteration: tantu pakvaṃ parijñāya niṣṭaptaṃ chinnaśoṇitam| lakṣmaṇa: puruṣavyāghramatha rāghavamabravīt
translation: लक्ष्मण: Lakshmana, निष्टप्तम् roasted well, छिन्नशोणितम् with blood drained out, तम् that, पक्वम्  cooked, परिज्ञाय having found, अथ then, पुरुषव्याघ्रम् tiger (best) among men, राघवम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: With the blood drained out of the venison, Lakshmana roasted it and cooked it well, and then said to Rama, the tiger (best) among men.

shloka_text: अयं सर्व: समस्ताग्ङ: श्रृत: कृष्णमृगो मया। देवतां देवसङ्काश यजस्व कुशलो ह्यसि।।2.56.28।।
transliteration: ayaṃ sarva: samastāgṅa: śrṛta: kṛṣṇamṛgo mayā| devatāṃ devasaṅkāśa yajasva kuśalo hyasi
translation: समस्ताङ्ग: with all the limbs, अयम् this, कृष्णमृग: black antelope, सर्व: completely, मया by me, श्रुत: is wellcooked, देवसङ्काश like a god, देवता: devatas, यजस्व offer with sacrifice, कुशल: असि हि you are proficient.
explanation: This black antelope with all its limbs is wellcooked. O divine sire, you may make the offering to Vastu devata in which you are proficient.

shloka_text: राम: स्नात्वा तु नियतो गुणवान् जप्यकोविदः। सङ्ग्रहेणाकरोत् स्रवार्न मन्त्रान् सत्रावसानिकान्।।2.56.29।।
transliteration: rāma: snātvā tu niyato guṇavān japyakovidaḥ| saṅgraheṇākarot sravārna mantrān satrāvasānikān
translation: गुणवान् virtuous,जप्यकोविद: expert in reciting appropriate mantras, राम: Rama, स्नात्वा having bathed, नियत: with his senses restrained, सत्रावसानिकान् rites performed at the end of the ritual, सर्वान् all that, मन्त्रान् mantras, सङ्ग्रहेण briefly, अकरोत् performed (intoned).
explanation: Virtuous Rama, who was an expert in the recitation of mantras, took his bath and his mind controlled, intoned briefly all the mantras appropriate to the completion of the ritual.

shloka_text: इष्ट्वा देवगणान्सर्वान्विवेशाऽवसथं शुचिः। बभूव च मनोह्लादो रामस्यामिततेजसः।।2.56.30।।
transliteration: iṣṭvā devagaṇānsarvānviveśā'vasathaṃ śuciḥ| babhūva ca manohlādo rāmasyāmitatejasaḥ
translation: सर्वान् all, देवगणान् gods, इष्ट्वा having worshipped by offering, शुचिः becoming pure, अवसथम् the leafhut, विवेश entered, अमिततेजस: immeasurable lustre, रामस्य to Rama, मनोह्लादः cheer of mind, बभूव च caused.
explanation: Sanctified with the worship of all the gods, Rama of immeasurable lustre felt a great happiness on entering the hut.

shloka_text: वैश्वदेवबलिं कृत्वा रौद्रं वैष्णव मेव च। वास्तुसंशमनीयानि मङ्गलानि प्रवर्तयन्।।2.56.31।। जपं च न्यायत कृत्वा स्नात्वा नद्यां यथाविधि। पापसंशमनं राम श्चकार बलिमुत्तमम्।।2.56.32।।
transliteration: vaiśvadevabaliṃ kṛtvā raudraṃ vaiṣṇava meva ca| vāstusaṃśamanīyāni maṅgalāni pravartayan japaṃ ca nyāyata kṛtvā snātvā nadyāṃ yathāvidhi| pāpasaṃśamanaṃ rāma ścakāra balimuttamam
translation: राम: Rama, वैश्वदेवबलिम् oblations to Visvadevas (the entire pantheon of gods), रौद्रम् to Rudra, वैष्णवमेव च to Visnu, कृत्वा having offered, वास्तुसंशमनीयानि propitiation of the household deity (Vastu devata), मङ्गलानि auspices, प्रवर्तयन्  doing, न्यायत: according to precept, जपं च कृत्वा muttering the silent prayers, नद्याम् in the river, यथाविधि duly, स्नात्वा after bathing, पापसंशमनम् for the expiation of sins, उत्तमं बलिम् final oblation, चकार made.
explanation: Rama, offered oblations to Visvadevas, Rudra and Visnu,  performed the auspices for the appeasement of the household deity. And having muttered japa silently in conformity with tradition, he took his ablution in the river as enjoined (by the sastras) and offered his final oblations for the expiation of his sins.

shloka_text: वैश्वदेवबलिं कृत्वा रौद्रं वैष्णव मेव च। वास्तुसंशमनीयानि मङ्गलानि प्रवर्तयन्।।2.56.31।। जपं च न्यायत कृत्वा स्नात्वा नद्यां यथाविधि। पापसंशमनं राम श्चकार बलिमुत्तमम्।।2.56.32।।
transliteration: vaiśvadevabaliṃ kṛtvā raudraṃ vaiṣṇava meva ca| vāstusaṃśamanīyāni maṅgalāni pravartayan japaṃ ca nyāyata kṛtvā snātvā nadyāṃ yathāvidhi| pāpasaṃśamanaṃ rāma ścakāra balimuttamam
translation: राम: Rama, वैश्वदेवबलिम् oblations to Visvadevas (the entire pantheon of gods), रौद्रम् to Rudra, वैष्णवमेव च to Visnu, कृत्वा having offered, वास्तुसंशमनीयानि propitiation of the household deity (Vastu devata), मङ्गलानि auspices, प्रवर्तयन्  doing, न्यायत: according to precept, जपं च कृत्वा muttering the silent prayers, नद्याम् in the river, यथाविधि duly, स्नात्वा after bathing, पापसंशमनम् for the expiation of sins, उत्तमं बलिम् final oblation, चकार made.
explanation: Rama, offered oblations to Visvadevas, Rudra and Visnu,  performed the auspices for the appeasement of the household deity. And having muttered japa silently in conformity with tradition, he took his ablution in the river as enjoined (by the sastras) and offered his final oblations for the expiation of his sins.

shloka_text: वेदिस्थलविधानानि चैत्यान्यायतनानि च। आश्रमस्यानुरूपाणि स्थापयामास राघवः।।2.56.33।।
transliteration: vedisthalavidhānāni caityānyāyatanāni ca| āśramasyānurūpāṇi sthāpayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
translation: राघव: the scion of the Raghus (Rama), आश्रमस्य of the hermitage, अनुरूपाणि befitting, वेदिस्थलविधानानि making of altars, चैत्यानि places of worship, आयतनानि च sacred places for fire, स्थापयामास established.
explanation: Rama, son of the Raghus, made altars in all the quarters, places of worship and sacred spots for fire befitting a hermitage.

shloka_text: वन्यैर्माल्यैः फलैर्मूलैः पक्वैर्मांसैर्यथाविधि। अद्भिर्जपैश्च वेदोक्तैर्दर्भैश्च ससमित्कुशैः।।2.56.34।। तौ तर्पयित्वा भूतानि राघवौ सह सीतया। तदा विविशतु श्शालां सुशुभां शुभलक्षणौ।।2.56.35।।
transliteration: vanyairmālyaiḥ phalairmūlaiḥ pakvairmāṃsairyathāvidhi| adbhirjapaiśca vedoktairdarbhaiśca sasamitkuśaiḥ tau tarpayitvā bhūtāni rāghavau saha sītayā| tadā viviśatu śśālāṃ suśubhāṃ śubhalakṣaṇau
translation: शुभलक्षणौ bestowed with auspicious qualities, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, सह सीतया accompanied by Sita, वन्यै: माल्यै: with garlands of forest flowers, फलै: with fruits, मूलै: with roots, पक्वै: with wellcooked, मांसै: with venison, अद्भिः with water, वेदोक्तै: as expounded in the Vedas, जपैश्च with muttering of prayers, दर्भैश्च with darbha grass,    सुसमित्कुशै: with faggots and kusa grass, भूतानि all beings, तर्पयित्वा after propitiating, तदा then, शुभाम् auspicious, शालाम् hut, विविशतुः entered.
explanation: Bestowed with auspicious qualities, Rama and Lakshmana along with Sita propitiated those celestial beings with garlands of forest flowers, fruits and roots, wellcooked venison, water, muttering of prayers as expounded in the Vedas, faggots and kusa grass and entered that auspicious hermitage.

shloka_text: तां वृक्षपर्णच्छदनां मनोज्ञां यथाप्रदेशं सुकृतां निवाताम्। वासाय सर्वे विविशुस्समेतास्सभां यथा देवगणास्सुधर्माम्।।2.56.36।।
transliteration: tāṃ vṛkṣaparṇacchadanāṃ manojñāṃ yathāpradeśaṃ sukṛtāṃ nivātām| vāsāya sarve viviśussametāssabhāṃ yathā devagaṇāssudharmām
translation: वृक्षपर्णच्छदनाम् covered with the leaves of trees, मनोज्ञाम् charming, यथाप्रदेशम् built on a suitable site, सुकृताम् wellbuilt, निवाताम् protected against storm, ताम् that hut, सर्वे all, समेता together, वासाय for purposes of living, देवगणाः gods, सुधर्माम् Sudharma, सभां यथा like the court, विविशु: entered.
explanation: Just like the gods enter the court of Sudharma, they all stepped into the hut to dwell there. The hut was charming wellbuilt on a suitable site and protected against storm.

shloka_text: अनेकनानामृगपक्षिसङ्कुले विचित्रपत्रस्तबकैर्द्रुमैर्युते। वनोत्तमे व्यालमृगानुनादिते तदा विजह्रु स्सुसुखं जितेन्द्रियाः।।2.56.37।।
transliteration: anekanānāmṛgapakṣisaṅkule vicitrapatrastabakairdrumairyute| vanottame vyālamṛgānunādite tadā vijahru ssusukhaṃ jitendriyāḥ
translation: तदा then, जितेन्द्रियाः who had conquered the senses, अनेकनानामृगपक्षिसङ्कुले filled with  many varieties of animals and birds, विचित्रपुष्पस्तबकै: with bunches of bright flowers, द्रुमै with trees, युते full of, व्यालमृगानुनादिते echoing with the sounds of wild animals, वनोत्तमे in that splendid forest, सुसुखम् very happily, विजह्रु: wandered.
explanation: Then they with their senses conquered, enjoyed perfect happiness in that splendid forest teeming with many varieties of animals and birds, with trees full of brilliant clusters of flowers and echoing with the sounds of wild animals.

shloka_text: सुरम्यमासाद्य तु चित्रकूटं नदीं च तां माल्यवतीं सुतीर्थाम्। ननन्द हृष्टो मृगपक्षिजुष्टां जहौ च दुखं पुरविप्रवासात्।।2.35.38।।
transliteration: suramyamāsādya tu citrakūṭaṃ nadīṃ ca tāṃ mālyavatīṃ sutīrthām| nananda hṛṣṭo mṛgapakṣijuṣṭāṃ jahau ca dukhaṃ puravipravāsāt
translation: सुरम्यम् marvellous, चित्रकूटम् mount Chitrakuta, आसाद्य having reached, सुतीर्थाम् with excellent holy places, मृगपक्षिजुष्टाम् full of animals and birds, ताम् that, माल्यवतीं नदीं च that Malyavati river, हृष्ट: filled with delight, ननन्द rejoiced, पुरविप्रवासात् banishment from the city, दुखम् sorrow, जहौ च left.
explanation: Having reached the marvellous mount Chitrakuta and river Malyavati with excellent holy places and full of animals and birds, Rama shed the sorrow of his banishment from the city (of Ayodhya) and rejoiced with a gladdened heart. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे षट्पञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysixth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of  the  holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: कथयित्वा सुदुःखार्तस्सुमन्त्रेण चिरं सह। रामे दक्षिणकूलस्थे जगाम स्वगृहं गुहः।।2.57.1।।
transliteration: kathayitvā suduḥkhārtassumantreṇa ciraṃ saha| rāme dakṣiṇakūlasthe jagāma svagṛhaṃ guhaḥ
translation: रामे Rama, दक्षिणकूलस्थे had reached the southern bank (of the river), गुह: Guha, सुमन्त्रेण सह with Sumantra, चिरम् for a long while, कथयित्वा after talking, सुदुःखार्तः tormented with anguish, स्वगृहम् his home, जगाम reached.
explanation: Until Rama reached the southern bank, Guha kept talking with Sumantra for long and returned home with great sorrow.
comments: Sumantra returns to Ayodhya and reports to king Dasaratha -- Dasaratha and Kausalya fall into a swoon on hearing about Rama in exile.

shloka_text: भरद्वाजाभिगमनं प्रयागे च सहाऽसनम्। आगिरेर्गमनं तेषां तत्रस्थैरुपलक्षितम्।।2.57.2।।
transliteration: bharadvājābhigamanaṃ prayāge ca sahā'sanam| āgirergamanaṃ teṣāṃ tatrasthairupalakṣitam
translation: तेषाम् their, भरद्वाजाभिगमनम् arrival at the hermitage of Bharadwaja, प्रयागे at Prayaga, सहाऽसनम् stay with him, आगिरेः till that Chitrakuta mountain, गमनम् journey, तत्रस्थैः by the men waiting there, उपलक्षितम् has been observed.
explanation: Positioned there, they could mark their arrival at Bharadwaja's at Prayaga, their stay (nighthalt) and their onward journey to Chitrakuta mountain.

shloka_text: अनुज्ञातस्सुमन्त्रोऽथ योजयित्वा हयोत्तमान्। अयोध्यामेव नगरीं प्रययौ गाढदुर्मनाः।।2.57.3।।
transliteration: anujñātassumantro'tha yojayitvā hayottamān| ayodhyāmeva nagarīṃ prayayau gāḍhadurmanāḥ
translation: अथ after this, अनुज्ञातः having been permitted by Rama to leave, सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, हयोत्तमान् best of horses, योजयित्वा harnessing, गाढदुर्मनाः with a heavy heart, अयोध्यां नगरीमेव to the city of Ayodhya, प्रययौ set out.
explanation: Permitted by Rama to leave, Sumantra harnessed the best of horses and set out for the city of Ayodhya with a heavy heart.

shloka_text: स वनानि सुगन्धीनि सरितश्च सरांसि च। पश्यन्नतिययौ शीघ्रं ग्रामाणि नगराणि च।।2.57.4।।
transliteration: sa vanāni sugandhīni saritaśca sarāṃsi ca| paśyannatiyayau śīghraṃ grāmāṇi nagarāṇi ca
translation: सः that, सुगन्धीनि fragrant, वनानि forests, सरितः च rivers as well, सरांसि च lakes also, ग्रामाणि villages, नगराणि च towns also, पश्यन् seeing, शीघ्रम् swiftly, अतिययौ passed through them.
explanation: Beholding the fragrancefilled forests, rivers, lakes, villages and  towns on the way, Sumantra quickly crossed them.

shloka_text: तत स्सायाह्न समये तृतीयेऽहनि सारथिः। अयोध्यां समनुप्राप्य निरानन्दां ददर्श ह।।2.57.5।।
transliteration: tata ssāyāhna samaye tṛtīye'hani sārathiḥ| ayodhyāṃ samanuprāpya nirānandāṃ dadarśa ha
translation: सारथिः charioteer, तृतीये on the third, अहनि day, सायाह्न समये at dusk, निरानन्दाम् cheerless, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, समनुप्राप्य having reached, ददर्श ह saw.
explanation: The charioteer reached Ayodhya on the third day at dusk and found the city cheerless.

shloka_text: स शून्यामिव निश्शब्दां दृष्ट्वा परमदुर्मनाः। सुमन्त्रश्चिन्तयामास शोकवेगसमाहतः।।2.57.6।।
transliteration: sa śūnyāmiva niśśabdāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramadurmanāḥ| sumantraścintayāmāsa śokavegasamāhataḥ
translation: सः सुमन्त्रः that Sumantra, निश्शब्दाम् silent, शून्यामिव almost empty, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परमदुर्मनाः deeply dejected, शोकवेगसमाहतः afflicted with gushing tears, चिन्तयामास reflected.
explanation: Beholding the silent city, almost empty, the deeply depressed Sumantra, afflicted with gushing tears reflected:

shloka_text: कच्चिन्न सगजा साऽश्वा सजना सजनाधिपा। रामसन्तापदुःखेन दग्धा शोकाग्निना पुरी।।2.57.7।।
transliteration: kaccinna sagajā sā'śvā sajanā sajanādhipā| rāmasantāpaduḥkhena dagdhā śokāgninā purī
translation: सगजाः with elephants, साऽश्वाः with horses, सजनाः with its people, सजनाधिपा with the king, पुरी city, रामसन्तापदुःखेन in the sorrow caused by Rama's suffering, शोकाग्निना by the fire of sorrow, दग्धा burnt.
explanation: Has the city along with its elephants, horses, people and its king perished in the fire of grief for Rama?

shloka_text: इति चिन्तापरस्सूतो वाजिभिश्शीघ्रपातिभिः। नगरद्वारमासाद्य त्वरितः प्रविवेश ह।।2.57.8।।
transliteration: iti cintāparassūto vājibhiśśīghrapātibhiḥ| nagaradvāramāsādya tvaritaḥ praviveśa ha
translation: इति in this way, चिन्तापरः absorbed in this thought, सूतः the charioteer, शीघ्रपातिभिः by the swiftrunning, वाजिभिः horses, नगरद्वारम् entrance to the city, आसाद्य having arrived, त्वरितः quickly, प्रविवेश ह entered.
explanation: Absorbed in these thoughts, the charioteer came to the citygate, carried by the swiftfooted horses, and quickly entered the city.

shloka_text: सुमन्त्रमभियान्तं तं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः। क्व राम इति पृच्छन्तस्सूतमभ्यद्रवन्नराः।।2.57.9।।
transliteration: sumantramabhiyāntaṃ taṃ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ| kva rāma iti pṛcchantassūtamabhyadravannarāḥ
translation: अथ thereafter, अभियान्तम् moving towards, तम् that, सूतम् charioteer, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, रामः Rama, क्व where?, इति thus, पृच्छन्तः enquiring, नराः people, शतशः in hundreds, सहस्रशः in thousands, अभ्यद्रवन् poured towards him.
explanation: Meanwhile as the charioteer was moving towards the city, hundreds and thousands of men came pouring towards him enquiring, 'Where is Rama?'

shloka_text: तेषां शशंस गङ्गायामहमापृच्छ्य राघवम्। अनुज्ञातो निवृत्तोऽस्मि धार्मिकेण महात्माना।।2.57.10।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ śaśaṃsa gaṅgāyāmahamāpṛcchya rāghavam| anujñāto nivṛtto'smi dhārmikeṇa mahātmānā
translation: अहम् I, गङ्गायाम् river Ganga, राघवम् Rama, आपृच्छ्य having taken leave, धार्मिकेण by the  righteous, महात्मना great (Rama), अनुज्ञातः having been permitted, निवृत्तः अस्मि I have returned, तेषाम् to them, शशंस said.
explanation: I took leave of the great, righteous Rama on the bank of the Ganga and have returned with his permission. (replied Sumantra).

shloka_text: ते तीर्णा इति विज्ञाय बाष्पपूर्णमुखा जनाः। अहो धिगिति निश्श्वस्य हा रामेति च चुक्रुशुः।।2.57.11।।
transliteration: te tīrṇā iti vijñāya bāṣpapūrṇamukhā janāḥ| aho dhigiti niśśvasya hā rāmeti ca cukruśuḥ
translation: ते they, तीर्णाः इति crossed the river, thus, विज्ञाय having come to know, जनाः people, बाष्पपूर्णमुखाः faces filled with tears, अहो Oh, धिक् O fie upon us, इति thus, निश्श्वस्य sighing, हा राम इति saying 'Alas Rama', चुक्रुशुः च cried aloud.
explanation: Hearing that they had (the trio) crossed the river Ganga, the people, with their faces filled with tears sighed and saying 'Fie upon us Alas, Rama' cried out aloud.

shloka_text: शुश्राव च वचस्तेषां बृन्दं बृन्दं च तिष्ठताम्। हतास्म खलु ये नेह पश्याम इति राघवम्।।2.57.12।।
transliteration: śuśrāva ca vacasteṣāṃ bṛndaṃ bṛndaṃ ca tiṣṭhatām| hatāsma khalu ye neha paśyāma iti rāghavam
translation: ये all of us, इह here, राघवम् Rama, न पश्यामः unable to see, हताः स्म खलु indeed we are  lost (deprived), इति thus saying, बृन्दम् बृन्दम् in groups, तिष्ठताम् standing, तेषाम् their, वचः words, शुश्राव च also heard.
explanation: He saw them gathering in groups, saying, Henceforth we will not be able to see Rama and without him, we are lost indeed.

shloka_text: दानयज्ञविवाहेषु समाजेषु महत्सु च। न द्रक्ष्यामः पुन र्जातु धार्मिकं राममन्तरा।।2.57.13।।
transliteration: dānayajñavivāheṣu samājeṣu mahatsu ca| na drakṣyāmaḥ puna rjātu dhārmikaṃ rāmamantarā
translation: दानयज्ञविवाहेषु in acts of charity, sacrifices and weddings, महत्सु in great, समाजेषु च  assemblies also, अन्तरा in their midst, धार्मिकम् righteous, रामम् Rama, पुनः again, जातु ever, न द्रक्ष्यामः will not see.
explanation: No longer will we see Rama at sacrifices, weddings, great assemblies and at places of charitable activity.

shloka_text: किं समर्थं जनस्यास्य किं प्रियं किं सुखावहम्। इति रामेण नगरं पितृवत्परिपालितम्।।2.57.14।।
transliteration: kiṃ samarthaṃ janasyāsya kiṃ priyaṃ kiṃ sukhāvaham| iti rāmeṇa nagaraṃ pitṛvatparipālitam
translation: अस्य जनस्य to these people, किम् what, समर्थम् is meaningful, किम् what, प्रियम् pleases, किम् what, सुखावहम् brings happiness, इति in this way, रामेण by Rama, नगरम् this city of Ayodhya, पितृवत् like father, परिपालितम् looked after.
explanation: Rama looked after his people like a father always thinking what was good for them, dear to them and comfortable to them.

shloka_text: वातायनगतानां च स्त्रीणामन्वन्तरापणम्। रामशोकाभितप्तानां शुश्राव परिदेवनम्।।2.57.15।।
transliteration: vātāyanagatānāṃ ca strīṇāmanvantarāpaṇam| rāmaśokābhitaptānāṃ śuśrāva paridevanam
translation: वातायनगतानाम् looking through the windows, स्त्रीणाम् women's, अन्वन्तरापणम् in the stalls, रामशोकाभितप्तानाम् burning with sorrow due to Rama's exile, परिदेवनम् bewailings, शुश्राव heard.
explanation: (He) heard wailings of women looking through the window and of the people in marketplaces burning with sorrow over Rama's exile.

shloka_text: स राजमार्गमध्येन सुमन्त्रः पिहिताननः। यत्र राजा दशरथस्तदेवोपययौ गृहम्।।2.57.16।।
transliteration: sa rājamārgamadhyena sumantraḥ pihitānanaḥ| yatra rājā daśarathastadevopayayau gṛham
translation: सः सुमन्त्रः that Sumantra, पिहिताननः with his face muffled, राजमार्गमध्येन along the highway, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, यत्र where, तत् that, गृहम् house, उपययौ reached straight.
explanation: Sumantra with his face muffled, drove along the highway straight to the palace of king Dasaratha.

shloka_text: सोऽवतीर्य रथाच्छीघ्रं राजवेश्म प्रविश्य च। कक्ष्या स्सप्ताभिचक्राम महाजनसमाकुलाः।।2.57.17।।
transliteration: so'vatīrya rathācchīghraṃ rājaveśma praviśya ca| kakṣyā ssaptābhicakrāma mahājanasamākulāḥ
translation: सः that, रथात् from the chariot, अवतीर्य alighting, शीघ्रम् quickly, राजवेश्म king's palace, प्रविश्य च having entered, महाजनसमाकुलाः overcrowded with people, सप्त seven, कक्ष्याः courtyards, अभिक्राम crossed.
explanation: Quickly alighting from the chariot, he entered  the king's palace and crossed the seven courtyards overcrowded with people.

shloka_text: हर्म्यै र्विमानैः प्रासादैरवेक्ष्याथ समागतम्। हाहाकारकृता नार्यो रामदर्शनकर्शिताः।।2.57.18।।
transliteration: harmyai rvimānaiḥ prāsādairavekṣyātha samāgatam| hāhākārakṛtā nāryo rāmadarśanakarśitāḥ
translation: अथ thereafter, नार्यः women, हर्म्यैः from mansions, विमानैः from sevenstoried buildings, प्रासादैः from royal palaces, समागतम् arrived, आवेक्ष्य having seen, रामदर्शन कर्शिताः sad at not seeing Rama, हाहाकारकृताः cried out 'Alas, Alas'.
explanation: Women from mansions, sevenstoried buildings and from royal palaces, sighted him and pained at not seeing Rama cried out 'Alas, Alas'.

shloka_text: आयतैर्विमलैर्नेत्रैरश्रुवेगपरिप्लुतैः। अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तेऽव्यक्तमार्ततराः स्त्रियः।।2.57.19।।
transliteration: āyatairvimalairnetrairaśruvegapariplutaiḥ| anyonyamabhivīkṣante'vyaktamārtatarāḥ striyaḥ
translation: स्त्रियः women, आर्ततराः in greater anguish,आयतैः large,विमलैःclean, अश्रुवेगपरिप्लुतैः flooded with the force of tears, नेत्रैः with eyes, अव्यक्तम् silently  अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिवीक्षन्ते were looking.
explanation: The women in great anguish stood silently looking at one another, their large eyes flooded with overflowing tears.

shloka_text: ततो दशरथस्त्रीणां प्रासादेभ्य स्तत स्ततः। रामशोकाभितप्तानां मन्दं शुश्राव जल्पितम्।।2.57.20।।
transliteration: tato daśarathastrīṇāṃ prāsādebhya stata stataḥ| rāmaśokābhitaptānāṃ mandaṃ śuśrāva jalpitam
translation: ततः then, ततस्ततः here and there, प्रासाद्येभ्यः from palaces, रामशोकाभितप्तानाम् afflicted with sorrow due to Rama's exile, दशरथस्त्रीणाम् of the wives of Dasaratha, मन्दम् जल्पितम् whispers, शुश्राव heard.
explanation: From different spots in the palace, Sumantra heard the sobs and whispers of Dasaratha's wives who were tormented with the sorrow of Rama's exile.

shloka_text: सह रामेण निर्यातो विना राम मिहागतः। सूतः किन्नाम कौसल्यां शोचन्तीं प्रतिवक्ष्यति।।2.57.21।।
transliteration: saha rāmeṇa niryāto vinā rāma mihāgataḥ| sūtaḥ kinnāma kausalyāṃ śocantīṃ prativakṣyati
translation: रामेण सह with Rama, निर्यातः went out, विना रामम् without Rama, इह here, आगतः returned, सूतः charioteer, शोचन्तीम् worrying, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, किं नाम what can, प्रतिवक्ष्यति will he say?
explanation: The charioteer left with Rama and returned without him. What can he say to the wailing Kausalya?

shloka_text: यथा च मन्ये दुर्जीवमेवं न सुकरं ध्रुवम्। आच्छिद्य पुत्रे निर्याते कौसल्या यत्र जीवति।।2.57.22।।
transliteration: yathā ca manye durjīvamevaṃ na sukaraṃ dhruvam| ācchidya putre niryāte kausalyā yatra jīvati
translation: पुत्रे when the son, आच्छिद्य severing all connections, निर्याते had set out, कौसल्या Kausalya, यथा in whichever way, यत्र जीवति wherever surviving still, दुर्जीवम् it is difficult to live, मन्ये I consider, एवम् like this, सुकरम् easily, न not, ध्रुवम् certain.
explanation: I think it is indeed difficult for Kausalya to live wherever and whichever way she tries as she has been separated from her son. (the queens said).

shloka_text: सत्यरूपं तु तद्वाक्यं राज्ञ: स्त्रीणां निशामयन्। प्रदीप्तमिव शोकेन विवेश सहसा गृहम्।।2.57.23।।
transliteration: satyarūpaṃ tu tadvākyaṃ rājña: strīṇāṃ niśāmayan| pradīptamiva śokena viveśa sahasā gṛham
translation: राज्ञ: king's, स्त्रीणाम् wives, सत्यरूपम् truth embodied, तत् वाक्यम् that word, निशामयन्  listening, सहसा immediately, शोकेन with grief, प्रदीप्तमिव as if burning, गृहम् house, विवेश entered.
explanation: Listening to the correct words of the king's wives, he immediately entered the palace as if in flames (of grief).

shloka_text: स प्रविश्याष्टमीं कक्ष्यां राजानं दीनमातुरम्। पुत्रशोकपरिम्लानमपश्यत्पाण्डुरे गृहे।।2.57.24।।
transliteration: sa praviśyāṣṭamīṃ kakṣyāṃ rājānaṃ dīnamāturam| putraśokaparimlānamapaśyatpāṇḍure gṛhe
translation: सः he (Sumantra), अष्टमीम् eighth, कक्ष्याम् courtyard, प्रविश्य having entered, पाण्डुरे in pale white, गृहे chamber, दीनम् desolate, आतुरम् anguished, पुत्रशोकपरिम्लानम् withered by sorrow over his son, राजानम् king, अपश्यत् saw.
explanation: On entering the eighth courtyard, he saw in a pale white chamber king Dasaratha desolate, anguished and withered with the sorrow of separation from his son.

shloka_text: अभिगम्य तमासीनं नरेन्द्रे मभिवाद्य च। सुमन्त्रो रामवचनं यथोक्तं प्रत्यवेदयत्।।2.57.25।।
transliteration: abhigamya tamāsīnaṃ narendre mabhivādya ca| sumantro rāmavacanaṃ yathoktaṃ pratyavedayat
translation: सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, असीनम् seated, नरेन्द्रम् king, अभिगम्य having approached, अभिवाद्य paying  obeisance, रामवचनम् Rama's words, यदोक्तम् verbatim, प्रत्यवेदयत् conveyed.
explanation: Sumantra approached the king who was seated, paid obeisance to him and conveyed Rama's words verbatim.

shloka_text: स तूष्णीमेव तच्छ्रुत्वा राजा विभ्रान्तचेतनः। मूर्छितो न्यपतद्भूमौ रामशोकाभिपीडितः।।2.57.26।।
transliteration: sa tūṣṇīmeva tacchrutvā rājā vibhrāntacetanaḥ| mūrchito nyapatadbhūmau rāmaśokābhipīḍitaḥ
translation: सः that, राजा king, तूष्णीमेव silently, तत् those words, श्रुत्वा having listened, विभ्रान्तचेतनः  with a bewildered mind, रामशोकाभिपीडितः tormented by the grief due to Rama's absence, मूर्छितः with senses lost, भूमौ on the ground, न्यपतत् fell.
explanation: The king silently listened to Rama's message. Bewildered and tormented by the grief of Rama's absence, he fell down on the ground in a swoon.

shloka_text: ततोऽन्तःपुरमाविद्धं मूर्छिते पृथिवीपतौ। उद्धृत्य बाहू चुक्रोश नृपतौ पतितेक्षितौ।।2.57.27।।
transliteration: tato'ntaḥpuramāviddhaṃ mūrchite pṛthivīpatau| uddhṛtya bāhū cukrośa nṛpatau patitekṣitau
translation: ततः then, पृथिवीपतौ when lord of the earth (the king), मूर्छिते had fallen unconscious, अन्तःपुरम्  inner apartment, आविद्धम् broken down, नृपतौ king, क्षितौ on the ground, पतिते had fallen, बाहू arms, उद्धृत्य having raised, चुक्रोश cried loudly.
explanation: The moment the lord of the earth fell down on the ground unconscious, the women in the inner apartment burst into tears, raising their arms.

shloka_text: सुमित्रया तु सहिता कौसल्या पतितं पतिम्। उत्थापयामास तदा वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्।।2.57.28।।
transliteration: sumitrayā tu sahitā kausalyā patitaṃ patim| utthāpayāmāsa tadā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
translation: तदा then, सुमित्रया सहिता together with Sumitra, कौशल्या Kausalya, पतितम् fallen on the ground, पतिम् husband, उत्थापयामास lifted him up, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Having seen her husband collapsed on the ground, Kausalya assisted by Sumitra lifted him up and said to him thus:

shloka_text: इमं तस्य महाभाग दूतं दुष्करकारिणः। वनवासादनुप्राप्तं कस्मान्न प्रतिभाषसे।।2.57.29।।
transliteration: imaṃ tasya mahābhāga dūtaṃ duṣkarakāriṇaḥ| vanavāsādanuprāptaṃ kasmānna pratibhāṣase
translation: महाभाग O distinguished one, वनवासात् from the forest, अनुप्राप्तम् returned, दुष्करकारिणः one who had accomplished arduous tasks, तस्य Rama's, इमम् this, दूतम् messenger, कस्मात् why, न प्रतिभाषसे are not talking.
explanation: O distinguished king, why are you not enquiring from the messenger about him  (Rama) who is capable of performing arduous tasks?

shloka_text: अद्यैवमनयं कृत्वा व्यपत्रपसि राघव। उत्तिष्ठ सुकृतं तेस्तु शोके नस्या त्सहायता।।2.57.30।।
transliteration: adyaivamanayaṃ kṛtvā vyapatrapasi rāghava| uttiṣṭha sukṛtaṃ testu śoke nasyā tsahāyatā
translation: राघव O descendant of the Raghus, अनयम् injustice, कृत्वा having done, अद्य now, एवम् in this way, व्यपत्रपसि are feeling ashamed, उत्तिष्ठ rise, ते to you, सुकृतम् the merit (of having fullfilled your word), अस्तु obtained, शोके in this sorrow, सहायता help, न स्यात् will not get.
explanation: O descendant of the Raghus are you ashamed of having done an injustice? Arise. you may be a blessed one (for fulfilling your promise). If you grieve, none will help you.

shloka_text: देव यस्या भयाद्रामं नानुपृच्छसि सारथिम्। नेह तिष्ठिति कैकेयी विस्रब्धं प्रतिभाष्यताम्।।2.57.31।।
transliteration: deva yasyā bhayādrāmaṃ nānupṛcchasi sārathim| neha tiṣṭhiti kaikeyī visrabdhaṃ pratibhāṣyatām
translation: देव O king, यस्याः by whose, भयात् from fear, सारथिम् charioteer, रामम् about Rama, नानुपृच्छसि you are not enquiring, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, इह now, न तिष्ठति not here, विस्रब्धम् without fear, प्रतिभाष्यताम् you may speak.
explanation: Kaikeyi for fear of whom you dare not ask the charioteer about Rama, O king is not here. You may speak to him without fear.

shloka_text: सा तथोक्त्वा महाराजं कौसल्या शोकलालसा। धरण्यां निपपाताऽशु बाष्पविप्लुतभाषिणी।।2.57.32।।
transliteration: sā tathoktvā mahārājaṃ kausalyā śokalālasā| dharaṇyāṃ nipapātā'śu bāṣpaviplutabhāṣiṇī
translation: बाष्पविप्लुतभाषिणी speaking with a voice choked with tears, शोकलालसा absorbed in grief, सा कौशल्या that Kausalya, महाराजम् to the maharaja, तथा that way, उक्त्वा having said, आशु suddenly, धरण्याम् on the ground, निपपात fell down.
explanation: Absorbed in grief, Kausalya spoke to the maharaja in a voice choked with tears and then collapsed on the floor.

shloka_text: एवं विलपतीं दृष्ट्वा कौसल्यां पतितां भुवि। पतिं चावेक्ष्य ता स्सर्वा सुस्वरं रुरुदुः स्त्रियः।।2.57.33।।
transliteration: evaṃ vilapatīṃ dṛṣṭvā kausalyāṃ patitāṃ bhuvi| patiṃ cāvekṣya tā ssarvā susvaraṃ ruruduḥ striyaḥ
translation: सर्वाः all, ताः स्त्रियः those women, एवम् thus, विलपतीम् lamenting, भुवि पतिताम्  fallen on the ground, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पतिं च also their husband, अवेक्ष्य having seen, सुस्वरम् in chorus, रुरुदुः wailed loudlly.
explanation: All those women saw weeping Kausalya as well as their husband fallen on the ground and wailed loudly in a chorus.

shloka_text: तत स्तमन्तःपुरनादमुत्थितं समीक्ष्य वृद्धा स्तरुणाश्च मानवाः। स्त्रियश्च सर्वा रुरुदु स्समन्ततः पुरं तदासीत्पुनरेव सङ्कुलम्।।2.57.34।।
transliteration: tata stamantaḥpuranādamutthitaṃ samīkṣya vṛddhā staruṇāśca mānavāḥ| striyaśca sarvā rurudu ssamantataḥ puraṃ tadāsītpunareva saṅkulam
translation: ततः thereafter, उत्थितम् rising, तम् that, अन्तःपुरनादम् sound from the inner apartment, समीक्षय having seen, वृद्धा: old, तरुणाश्च young, मानवाः people, सर्वाः all, स्त्रीयश्च also women, समन्ततः all around, रुरुदुः lamented, तदा then, पुरम् city, पुनरेव again, सङ्कुलम् आसीत् was filled (with people).
explanation: Having heard the sound emanating from the inner apartment, people, old, young and women, of the city lamented. The city was crowded again. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyseventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: प्रत्याश्वस्तो यदा राजा मोहात्प्रत्यागतं पुनः। अथाऽजुहाव तं सूतं रामवृत्तान्तकारणात्।।2.58.1।।
transliteration: pratyāśvasto yadā rājā mohātpratyāgataṃ punaḥ| athā'juhāva taṃ sūtaṃ rāmavṛttāntakāraṇāt
translation: अथ thereafter, राजा king, यदा when, प्रत्याश्वस्तः consoled, मोहात् from loss of consciousness, पुनः again, प्रत्यागतम् having regained his senses, रामवृत्तान्त कारणात् due to the news about Rama, तं सूतम् that charioteer, आजुहाव called for him.
explanation: When the king regained his consciousness and was consoled, he summoned the   charioteer to hear news about Rama.
comments: Sumantra conveys the message of Rama to the wailing king and Kausalya.

shloka_text: अथ सूतो महाराजं कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः। राममेवानुशोचन्तं दुःखशोकसमन्वितम्।।2.58.2।। वृद्धं परमसन्तप्तं नवग्रहमिव द्विपम्। विनिश्वसन्तं ध्यायन्तमस्वस्थ मिव कुङञरम्।।2.58.3।।
transliteration: atha sūto mahārājaṃ kṛtāñjalirupasthitaḥ| rāmamevānuśocantaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitam vṛddhaṃ paramasantaptaṃ navagrahamiva dvipam| viniśvasantaṃ dhyāyantamasvastha miva kuṅañaram
translation: अथ then, सूतः the charioteer, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, राममेव Rama alone, अनुशोचन्तम् thinking of Rama, दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् by grief and sorrow, वृद्धम्  aged, परमसन्तप्तम् deeply afflicted, नवग्रहम् newlycaptured, द्विपमिव like an elephant, विनिःश्वसन्तम् heaving deep sighs, अस्वस्थम् indisposed, कुञ्जरमिव like an elephant, ध्यायन्तम् brooding, महाराजम् king, उपस्थितः approached.
explanation: Then the charioteer with folded palms approached the king who, deeply afflicted with grief and pain, was brooding over Rama alone. Aged Dasaratha was heaving deep sighs like a newlycaptured, indisposed elephant.

shloka_text: अथ सूतो महाराजं कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थितः। राममेवानुशोचन्तं दुःखशोकसमन्वितम्।।2.58.2।। वृद्धं परमसन्तप्तं नवग्रहमिव द्विपम्। विनिश्वसन्तं ध्यायन्तमस्वस्थ मिव कुङञरम्।।2.58.3।।
transliteration: atha sūto mahārājaṃ kṛtāñjalirupasthitaḥ| rāmamevānuśocantaṃ duḥkhaśokasamanvitam vṛddhaṃ paramasantaptaṃ navagrahamiva dvipam| viniśvasantaṃ dhyāyantamasvastha miva kuṅañaram
translation: अथ then, सूतः the charioteer, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, राममेव Rama alone, अनुशोचन्तम् thinking of Rama, दुःखशोकसमन्वितम् by grief and sorrow, वृद्धम्  aged, परमसन्तप्तम् deeply afflicted, नवग्रहम् newlycaptured, द्विपमिव like an elephant, विनिःश्वसन्तम् heaving deep sighs, अस्वस्थम् indisposed, कुञ्जरमिव like an elephant, ध्यायन्तम् brooding, महाराजम् king, उपस्थितः approached.
explanation: Then the charioteer with folded palms approached the king who, deeply afflicted with grief and pain, was brooding over Rama alone. Aged Dasaratha was heaving deep sighs like a newlycaptured, indisposed elephant.

shloka_text: राजा तु रजसा सूतं ध्वस्ताङ्गं समुपस्थितम्। अश्रुपूर्णमुखं दीनमुवाच परमार्तवत्।।2.58.4।।
transliteration: rājā tu rajasā sūtaṃ dhvastāṅgaṃ samupasthitam| aśrupūrṇamukhaṃ dīnamuvāca paramārtavat
translation: राजा king, रजसा with dust, ध्वस्ताङ्गम् covered all over, अश्रुपूर्णमुखम् face bathed in tears, दीनम् dejected, समुपस्थितम् standing nearby,  सूतम् charioteer, परमार्तवत् filled with extreme grief, उवाच said.
explanation: Seeing the dejected charioteer standing before him, the desolate king covered all over with dust and his face bathed in tears, said to him in extreme grief:

shloka_text: क्वनु वत्स्यति धर्मात्मा वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितः। सोऽत्यन्तसुखित स्सूत किमशिष्यति राघवः।।2.58.5।।
transliteration: kvanu vatsyati dharmātmā vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ| so'tyantasukhita ssūta kimaśiṣyati rāghavaḥ
translation: सूत the charioteer, धर्मात्मा righteous (Rama), वृक्षमूलम् foot of the tree, उपाश्रितः having taken refuge, क्वनु where, वत्स्यति will he live?, अत्यन्त सुखितः enjoyed supreme luxury, स: राघवः that Rama, किम् what?, अशिष्यति will he eat?
explanation: O charioteer Rama is rightous and he is acustoomed to all sorts of comfort. Taking refuge at the foot of a tree how shall he live and what shall he eat?

shloka_text: दुःखस्यानुचितो दुःखं सुमन्त्र शयनोचितः। भूमिपालात्मजो भूमौ शेते कथमनाथवत्।।2.58.6।।
transliteration: duḥkhasyānucito duḥkhaṃ sumantra śayanocitaḥ| bhūmipālātmajo bhūmau śete kathamanāthavat
translation: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, दुःखस्य to sorrow, अनुचितः not deserving, शयनोचितः accustomed to comfortable couches, भूमिपालात्मजः son of the guardian of the earth (prince Rama),  अनाथवत् like an orphan, भूमौ on the ground, दुःखम् sadly, कथम् how?, शेते can lie down?
explanation: How can the son of the guardian of the earth who is accustomed to a comfortable bed and not to undeserved suffering lie down on the ground like an orphan, O Sumantra

shloka_text: यं यान्तमनुयान्ति स्म पदातिरथकुञ्जराः। स वत्स्यति कथं रामो विजनं वन माश्रितः।।2.58.7।।
transliteration: yaṃ yāntamanuyānti sma padātirathakuñjarāḥ| sa vatsyati kathaṃ rāmo vijanaṃ vana māśritaḥ
translation: यान्तम् when he went out, यम् whom, पदातिरथकुञ्जरा: footsoldiers, chariots and elephants, अनुयान्ति स्म followed, सः that, रामः Rama, विजनम् desolate, वनम् forest, आश्रितः having taken shelter, कथम् how, वत्स्यति can live.
explanation: Wherever Rama went, elephants, chariots and footsoldiers followed him. How can he (now) live in the desolate forest where he has taken refuge?

shloka_text: व्यालैर्मृगैराचरितं कृष्णसर्पनिषेवितम्। कथं कुमारौ वैदेह्या सार्धं वन मुपस्थितौ।।2.58.8।।
transliteration: vyālairmṛgairācaritaṃ kṛṣṇasarpaniṣevitam| kathaṃ kumārau vaidehyā sārdhaṃ vana mupasthitau
translation: कुमारौ the two youths (Rama and Lakshmana), वैदेह्या सार्धम् with Vaidehi also, व्यालैः by wicked wild elephants, मृगैः animals, आचरितम् ranging about, कृष्णसर्पनिषेवितम् abounding in black cobras, वनम् forest, कथम् how, उपस्थितौ exist.
explanation: How can the two young men along with Vaidehi live in the forest infested with black cobras and wicked, wild animals?

shloka_text: सुकुमार्या तपस्विन्या सुमन्त्र सह सीतया। राजपुत्रौ कथं पादैरवरुह्य रथाद्गतौ।।2.58.9।।
transliteration: sukumāryā tapasvinyā sumantra saha sītayā| rājaputrau kathaṃ pādairavaruhya rathādgatau
translation: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, राजपुत्रौ king's sons, सुकुमार्या along with delicate, तपस्विन्या by the pitiable, सीतया सह with Sita, रथात् from the chariot, पादैः on foot, अवरुह्य  alighting, कथम् how, गतौ did they go.
explanation: O Sumantra how did those two princes along with pitiable, delicate Sita, alight from the chariot, and enter the forest on foot?

shloka_text: सिद्धार्थः खलु सूत त्वं येन दृष्टौ ममाऽत्मजौ। वनान्तं प्रविशन्तौ तावश्विनाविवमन्दरम्।।2.58.10।।
transliteration: siddhārthaḥ khalu sūta tvaṃ yena dṛṣṭau mamā'tmajau| vanāntaṃ praviśantau tāvaśvināvivamandaram
translation: सूत O charioteer, येन by you, अश्विनौ Aswinis, मन्दरम् इव like Mandara mountain, वनान्तम् on the outskirts of the forest, प्रविशन्तौ entering, मम my, आत्मजौ sons, दृष्टौ have been seen, त्वम् you, सिद्धार्थः खलु are blessed indeed.
explanation: You are blessed indeed, O charioteer to have seen my sons entering the outskirts of the forest like Aswinis stepping into the region of the Mandara mountain.

shloka_text: किमुवाच वचो रामः किमुवाच च लक्ष्मणः। सुमन्त्र वनमासाद्य किमुवाच च मैथिली।।2.58.11।।
transliteration: kimuvāca vaco rāmaḥ kimuvāca ca lakṣmaṇaḥ| sumantra vanamāsādya kimuvāca ca maithilī
translation: सुमन्त्र Sumantra, वनम् forest, आसाद्य on reaching, रामः Rama, किम् what?, वचः words, उवाच did speak, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, किम् what, उवाच did say, मैथिली च and Sita, किम् what, उवाच did say.
explanation: Upon reaching the forest, O Sumantra what did Rama, Lakshmana and Sita say?

shloka_text: आसितं शयितं भुक्तं सूत रामस्य कीर्तय। जीविष्यामहमेतेन ययातिरिव साधुषु।।2.58.12।।
transliteration: āsitaṃ śayitaṃ bhuktaṃ sūta rāmasya kīrtaya| jīviṣyāmahametena yayātiriva sādhuṣu
translation: सूत charioteer, रामस्य Rama's, आसितम् seat, शयितम् bed, भुक्तम् food, कीर्तय describe, अहम् I, ययातिः Yayati, साधुषु इव as in the company of saints, एतेन with this, जीविष्यामि shall live.
explanation: Tell me, O charioteer where Rama sat, where he slept, what (food) he ate. Only your words will enable me to live like Yayati among saints.

shloka_text: इति सूतो नरेन्द्रेण बोधित स्सज्जमानया। उवाच वाचा राजानं स बाष्पपरिबद्धया।।2.58.13।।
transliteration: iti sūto narendreṇa bodhita ssajjamānayā| uvāca vācā rājānaṃ sa bāṣpaparibaddhayā
translation: नरेन्द्रेण by the king, Dasaratha, इति in this way, बोधितः questioned, सः सूतः that charioteer, बाष्पपरिबद्धया with voice choked with tears, सज्जमानया faltering with grief, वाचा  with words, राजानम् to the king, उवाच said.
explanation: Thus questioned by the king the charioteer, his voice choked with tears and words faltering in grief, addressed the king:

shloka_text: अब्रवीन्मां महाराज धर्ममेवानुपालयन्। अञ्जलिं राघवः कृत्वा शिरसाऽभिप्रणम्य च।।2.58.14।।
transliteration: abravīnmāṃ mahārāja dharmamevānupālayan| añjaliṃ rāghavaḥ kṛtvā śirasā'bhipraṇamya ca
translation: महाराज O great king, राघवः the descendant of the Raghu race (Rama), धर्ममेव righteousness also, अनुपालयन् guarding, अञ्जलिम् with folded hands, कृत्वा having set, शिरसा bowing his head, अभिप्रणम्य च offering  salutations, माम् to me, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: With palms folded and head bowed, O great king Rama offered his salutations to you in confirmity with righteousness and said to me:

shloka_text: सूत मद्वचनात्तस्य तातस्य विदितात्मनः। शिरसा वन्दनीयस्य वन्द्यौ पादौ महात्मनः।।2.58.15।।
transliteration: sūta madvacanāttasya tātasya viditātmanaḥ| śirasā vandanīyasya vandyau pādau mahātmanaḥ
translation: सूत O charioteer, मद्वचनात् as my words, विदितात्मनः knower of the self, महात्मनः illustrious, वन्दनीयस्य worthy of salutations, तस्य that, तातस्य father's, पादौ feet, शिरसा head, वन्द्यौ are worthy of salutations.
explanation: 'Convey on my behalf, O charioteer to my illustrious father who is known for his selfknowledge, and is worthy of homage, that I am saluting his feet with my head bowed.

shloka_text: सर्वमन्तःपुरं वाच्यं सूत मद्वचनात्त्वया। आरोग्यमविशेषेण यथार्हं चाभिवादनम्।।2.58.16।।
transliteration: sarvamantaḥpuraṃ vācyaṃ sūta madvacanāttvayā| ārogyamaviśeṣeṇa yathārhaṃ cābhivādanam
translation: सूत O charioteer, त्वया by you, मद्वचनात् at my words, सर्वम् entire, अन्तःपुरम् inmates of the inner apartment, अविशेषेण without distinction, आरोग्यम् wellbeing, यथार्हम् befitting their status, अभिवादनं च salutations, वाच्यम् fit to be conveyed.
explanation: 'On my behalf convey, O charioteer, without any distinction, my salutations to all the women befitting their status and tell them I was enquiring about their wellbeing.

shloka_text: माता च मम कौसल्या कुशलं चाभिवादनम्। अप्रमादं च वक्तव्या ब्रूयाश्चैनामिदं वचः।।2.58.17।।
transliteration: mātā ca mama kausalyā kuśalaṃ cābhivādanam| apramādaṃ ca vaktavyā brūyāścaināmidaṃ vacaḥ
translation: मम my, माता mother, कौसल्या Kausalya, कुशलम् welfare, अभिवादनं च salutations, अप्रमादं च  alertness, वक्तव्या is worthy of conveying, इदम् this, वचश्च word, ब्रूयाः tell.
explanation: 'Convey my mother carefully my saluations and my wellbeing and tell her:

shloka_text: धर्मनित्या यथाकालमग्न्यगारपरा भव। देवि देवस्य पादौ च देववत्परिपालय।।2.58.18।।
transliteration: dharmanityā yathākālamagnyagāraparā bhava| devi devasya pādau ca devavatparipālaya
translation: देवि O mother, धर्मनित्या adhering to the righteous path, यथाकालम् in time, अग्न्यगारपरा भव perform the rituals in the chamber of sacrificial fire, देवस्य (your) lord's (king Dasaratha's), पादौ च feet also, देववत् like a god, परिपालय serve.
explanation: 'O mother, adhering to the righteous path and performing in time the rituals in the chamber of sacrificial fire, offer your services at the feet of king Dasaratha as if he were a god.

shloka_text: अभिमानं च मानं च त्यक्त्वा वर्तस्व मातृषु। अनु राजानमार्यां च कैकेयीमम्ब कारय।।2.58.19।।
transliteration: abhimānaṃ ca mānaṃ ca tyaktvā vartasva mātṛṣu| anu rājānamāryāṃ ca kaikeyīmamba kāraya
translation: अभिमानं च egoism, मानं च pride, मातृषु towards mothers, वर्तस्व conduct yourself, अम्ब O mother, आर्याम् venerable, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, राजानम् अनु welldisposed towards the king, कारय mould her.
explanation: 'O mother, conduct yourself with other mothers without pride and egoism. Ensure that venerable Kaikeyi remains welldisposed towards the king.

shloka_text: कुमारे भरते वृत्तिर्वर्तितव्या च राजवत्। अर्थज्येष्ठा हि राजानो राजधर्ममनुस्मर।।2.58.20।।
transliteration: kumāre bharate vṛttirvartitavyā ca rājavat| arthajyeṣṭhā hi rājāno rājadharmamanusmara
translation: कुमारे young, भरते towards Bharata, राजवत् like a king, वृत्ति: conduct, वर्तितव्या to be followed, राजानः kings, अर्थज्येष्ठाः हि senior by virtue of their royalty, राजधर्मम् prerogative of kings, अनुस्मर remember.
explanation: 'Behave towards young Bharata as to a king. Irrespective of age, a king is a king. (Hence should be honoured). You should keep this rajadharma (royal prerogative) in mind.

shloka_text: भरतः कुशलं वाच्यो वाच्यो मद्वचनेन च। सर्वास्वेव यथान्यायं वृत्तिं वर्तस्व मातृषु।।2.58.21।।
transliteration: bharataḥ kuśalaṃ vācyo vācyo madvacanena ca| sarvāsveva yathānyāyaṃ vṛttiṃ vartasva mātṛṣu
translation: भरतः Bharata, कुशलम् welfare, वाच्यः deserves to be told, मद्वचनेन by my word, वाच्यः च  is to be told, सर्वासु among all, मातृषु mothers, यथान्यायम् rightly, वृत्तिम् behaviour, वर्तस्व follow.
explanation: 'Tell Bharata of my welfare and tell him on my behalf that he should honour all our mothers equally.

shloka_text: वक्तव्यश्च महाबाहुरिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः। पितरं यौवराज्यस्थो राज्यस्थमनुपालय।।2.58.22।।
transliteration: vaktavyaśca mahābāhurikṣvākukulanandanaḥ| pitaraṃ yauvarājyastho rājyasthamanupālaya
translation: इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनः delight of the race of Ikshvaku, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, वक्तव्यश्च deserves be told this way, यौवराज्यस्थः crowned as prince regent, राज्यस्थम् being in the kingdom, पितरम् father, अनुपालय rule the kingdom (by being obedient to him).
explanation: The mighty-armed delight of the Ikshvaku race should be told this: installed as prince regent, rule the kingdom in obedience to your father.

shloka_text: अतिक्रान्तवया राजा मास्मैनं व्यवरोरुधः। कुमार राज्ये जीव त्वं तस्यैवाज्ञाप्रवर्तनात्।।2.58.23।।
transliteration: atikrāntavayā rājā māsmainaṃ vyavarorudhaḥ| kumāra rājye jīva tvaṃ tasyaivājñāpravartanāt
translation: राजा king Dasaratha, अतिक्रान्तवयाः is advanced in age, एनम् him, मा स्म व्यवरोरुधः do not restrict him, त्वम् you, तस्यैव that king's, आज्ञाप्रवर्तनात् carrying out the commands, कुमारराज्ये as prince regent, जीव live.
explanation: 'The king is advanced in age. Do not restrict him in any manner. Carry out his orders as prince regent, and live happily'.

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्चापि मां भूयो भृशमश्रूणि वर्तयन्। मातेव मम माता ते द्रष्टव्या पुत्रगर्धिनी।।2.58.24।।
transliteration: abravīccāpi māṃ bhūyo bhṛśamaśrūṇi vartayan| māteva mama mātā te draṣṭavyā putragardhinī
translation: भृशम् excessively, अश्रूणि tears, वर्तयन् shedding, माम् addressing me, भूयः more, अब्रवीच्चापि uttered, पुत्रगर्धिनी covetous of her son, मम माता my mother, ते  by you, मातेव as your mother, द्रष्टव्या worthy of being looked after.
explanation: Shedding profuse tears, Rama continued, 'Look after my mother who is covetous of her son as your own mother'.

shloka_text: इत्येवं मां महराज ब्रुवन्नेव महायशाः। रामो राजीवताम्राक्षो भृशमश्रूण्यवर्तयत्।।2.58.25।।
transliteration: ityevaṃ māṃ maharāja bruvanneva mahāyaśāḥ| rāmo rājīvatāmrākṣo bhṛśamaśrūṇyavartayat
translation: महाराज O king, महायशाः renowned, राजीवताम्राक्षः with red lotuslike eyes, रामः Rama, माम् to me, इत्येवम् thus, ब्रुवन्नेव while saying, भृशम् copious,  अश्रूणि tears, अवर्तयत् shed.
explanation: While saying this the red lotuslike eyes of illustrious Rama streamed with tears, O maharaja

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्तु सुसङ्कृद्धो निश्श्वसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। केनायमपराधेन राजपुत्रो विवासितः।।2.58.26।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇastu susaṅkṛddho niśśvasanvākyamabravīt| kenāyamaparādhena rājaputro vivāsitaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मणस्तु Lakshmana, सुसङ्कृद्धः mighty angry, निश्श्वसन् sighing, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, अयम् this, राजपुत्रः king's son, केन by what, अपराधेन offence, विवासितः has been banished?
explanation: But Lakshmana, seething with anger and sighing said, 'For what offence has this king's son  been banished'?

shloka_text: राज्ञा तु खलु कैकेय्या लघुत्वाश्रित्य शासनम्। कृतं कार्यमकार्यं वा वयं येनाभिपीडिताः।।2.58.27।।
transliteration: rājñā tu khalu kaikeyyā laghutvāśritya śāsanam| kṛtaṃ kāryamakāryaṃ vā vayaṃ yenābhipīḍitāḥ
translation: राज्ञा तु by the king also, कैकेय्याः of Kaikeyi, लघु trash, शासनम् command, आश्रित्य having taken refuge, अकार्यम् a forbidden act, कार्यं वा or a worthy act, कृतम् has been done, येन by which, वयम् we, अभिपीडिताः have been made to suffer.
explanation: 'The king, too, submitting to the trash command of Kaikeyi has perpetrated an act, just or unjust (he knows better), for which we are made to suffer so much.

shloka_text: यदि प्रव्राजितो रामो लोभकारणकारितम्। वरदाननिमित्तं वा सर्वथा दुष्कृतं कृतम्।।2.58.28।।
transliteration: yadi pravrājito rāmo lobhakāraṇakāritam| varadānanimittaṃ vā sarvathā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam
translation: रामः Rama, लोभकारणकारितम् out of greed (for the kingdom), वरदाननिमित्तं वा or on account of the boons bestowed, प्रव्राजितः यदि if banished, सर्वथा by all means, दुष्कृतम् wicked act, कृतम् has been done.
explanation: 'Whether it was out of greed (for the kingdom) or for (the execution of) the boon bestowed, this act of banishment is by all means wicked'.

shloka_text: इदं तावद्यथाकाममीश्वरस्य कृते कृतम्। रामस्य तु परित्यागे न हेतु मुपलक्षये।।2.58.29।।
transliteration: idaṃ tāvadyathākāmamīśvarasya kṛte kṛtam| rāmasya tu parityāge na hetu mupalakṣaye
translation: इदं तावत् this one, ईश्वरस्य कृते for (fear of) God, यथाकामम् this act, कृतम् done, रामस्य Rama's, परित्यागे in abandonment, हेतुम् reason, न उपलक्षये I do not see.
explanation: 'Or he might have thought he is the overlord and can do as he likes. (Or, he might have done this for fear of God) Otherwise, I do not see any reason for the abandonment of Rama'.

shloka_text: असमीक्षय समारब्धं विरुद्धं बुध्दिलाघवात्। जनयिष्यति सङ्क्रोशं राघवस्य विवासनम्।।2.58.30।।
transliteration: asamīkṣaya samārabdhaṃ viruddhaṃ budhdilāghavāt| janayiṣyati saṅkrośaṃ rāghavasya vivāsanam
translation: बुद्धिलाघवात् out of lack of intelligence, असमीक्ष्य without (proper) consideration, समारब्धम् commenced, विरुद्धम् contrary (to justice), राघवस्य Rama's, विवासनम् banishment, सङ्क्रोशम् bewailment, जनयिष्यति will produce.
explanation: 'Unjustly, foolishly and without (proper) consideration Rama has been banished. This will (definitely) cause sorrow'.

shloka_text: अहं तावन्महाराजे पितृत्वं नोपलक्ष्ये। भ्राता भर्ता च बन्धुश्च पिता च मम राघवः।।2.58.31।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tāvanmahārāje pitṛtvaṃ nopalakṣye| bhrātā bhartā ca bandhuśca pitā ca mama rāghavaḥ
translation: अहम् I, महाराजे in that great king, पितृत्वम् fatherhood, नोपलक्ष्ये I do not see, मम to me, राघवः Rama alone, भ्राता च brother, भर्ताच also protector, बन्धुश्च friend, पिता father.
explanation: 'I do not regard the great king as my father. Rama alone is my brother, protector, friend and father.

shloka_text: सर्वर्लोकप्रियं त्यक्त्वा सर्वलोकहिते रतम्। सर्वलोकोऽनुरज्येत कथं त्वाऽनेनकर्मणा।।2.58.32।।
transliteration: sarvarlokapriyaṃ tyaktvā sarvalokahite ratam| sarvaloko'nurajyeta kathaṃ tvā'nenakarmaṇā
translation: सर्वलोकप्रियम् beloved to all, सर्वलोकहिते in the welfare of all, रतम् devoted, त्यक्त्वा after deserting, अनेन कर्मणा with this act, त्वा towards you, सर्वलोकः entire world, कथम् how, अनुरज्येत will be pleased?
explanation: 'How can anyone in this world be pleased with you for deserting Rama, the beloved of all, and ever devoted to their welfare?

shloka_text: सर्वप्रजाभिरामं हि रामं प्रव्राज्य धार्मिकम्। सर्वलोकं विरुध्येमं कथं राजा भविष्यसि।।2.58.33।।
transliteration: sarvaprajābhirāmaṃ hi rāmaṃ pravrājya dhārmikam| sarvalokaṃ virudhyemaṃ kathaṃ rājā bhaviṣyasi
translation: सर्वप्रजाभिरामम् Delight of all subjects, धार्मिकम् righteous, रामम् to Rama, प्रव्राज्य having used banishment, इमम् this, सर्वलोकम् entire world, विरुध्य antagonizing, राजा king, कथम् how, भविष्यसि will continue to rule?
explanation: 'Having banished the righteous Rama, the delight of all subjects and, thereby, antagonizing the entire world, how can you claim to be their king?'

shloka_text: जानकी तु महाराज निश्श्वसन्ती मनस्विनी। भूतोपहतचित्तेव विष्ठिता विस्मृता स्मिता।।2.58.34।।
transliteration: jānakī tu mahārāja niśśvasantī manasvinī| bhūtopahatacitteva viṣṭhitā vismṛtā smitā
translation: महाराज O great king, मनस्विनी sensitive lady, जानकी तु Janaki, निश्श्वसन्ती heaving sighs, भूतोपहतचित्तेव like one possessed, विस्मृता स्मिता like one unconcerned with the surroundings and yet smiling, विष्ठिता stood stupefied.
explanation: O great king as for that sensitive Janaki, she stood sighing, stupefied and oblivious (of the past), yet smiling as though her mind was possessed by an evil spirit.

shloka_text: अदृष्टपूर्वव्यसना राज्यपुत्री यशस्विनी। तेन दुःखेन रुदती नैव मां किञ्चिदब्रवीत्।।2.58.35।।
transliteration: adṛṣṭapūrvavyasanā rājyaputrī yaśasvinī| tena duḥkhena rudatī naiva māṃ kiñcidabravīt
translation: अदृष्टपूर्वव्यसना who had never experienced adversity, यशस्विनी celebrated, राजपुत्री that princess, तेन that, दुःखेन with sorrow, रुदती weeping, माम् to me, किञ्चित् even a little, नैव  अब्रवीत् did not at all say.
explanation: That glorious princess Sita who had never experienced any adversity earlier, weeping with sorrow, could not even speak to me anything.

shloka_text: उद्वीक्षमाणा भर्तारं मुखेन परिशुष्यता। मुमोच सहसा बाष्पं मां प्रयान्तमुदीक्ष्य सा।।2.58.36।।
transliteration: udvīkṣamāṇā bhartāraṃ mukhena pariśuṣyatā| mumoca sahasā bāṣpaṃ māṃ prayāntamudīkṣya sā
translation: सा she, प्रयान्तम् moving, माम् me, उदीक्ष्य having seen, परिशुष्यता with driedup, मुखेन face, भर्तारम् husband, उद्वीक्षमाणा beholding, सहसा suddenly, बाष्पम् tears, मुमोच shed.
explanation: When she saw me leaving, she looked at her husband with a dry (pale) face and suddenly burst into tears.

shloka_text: तथैव रामोऽश्रुमुखः कृताञ्जलिः स्थितोऽभवल्लक्ष्मणबाहुपालितः। तथैव सीता रुदती तपस्विनी निरीक्षते राजरथं तथैव माम्।।2.58.37।।
transliteration: tathaiva rāmo'śrumukhaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ sthito'bhavallakṣmaṇabāhupālitaḥ| tathaiva sītā rudatī tapasvinī nirīkṣate rājarathaṃ tathaiva mām
translation: तथैव thus, रामः Rama, अश्रुमुखः with his face filled with tears, कृताञ्जलिः with folded hands, लक्ष्मणबाहुपालितः supported by the arms of Lakshmana, स्थितः अभवत् stood, तपस्विनी pitiable, सीता Sita, रुदती weeping, राजरथम् king's chariot, माम् me, निरीक्षते kept gazing.
explanation: Supported by Lakshmana's arms, Rama stood, his face streaming with tears and palms folded, while the wretched Sita, glaring at me and the royal chariot, weeping. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: इति ब्रुवन्तं तं सूतं सुमन्त्रं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्। ब्रूहि शेषं पुनरिति राजा वचनमब्रवीत्।।2.59.1।।
transliteration: iti bruvantaṃ taṃ sūtaṃ sumantraṃ mantrisattamam| brūhi śeṣaṃ punariti rājā vacanamabravīt
translation: राजा king, इति thus, ब्रुवन्तम् while speaking, सूतम् charioteer, मन्त्रिसत्तमम् best of  ministers, तं सुमन्त्रम् that Sumantra, शेषम् the rest, पुनः again, ब्रूहि tell, इति thus, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Listening to the charioteer, the best of ministers (Sumantra), the king asked him to tell the rest.
comments: Sumantra describes the shadow of sorrow over Ayodhya -- withering plants and flowers, driedup ponds, immobile animals -- Dasaratha pines for Rama.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सुमन्त्रो बाष्पविक्लबः। कथयामास भूयोऽपि रामसन्देशविस्तरम्।।2.59.2।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sumantro bāṣpaviklabaḥ| kathayāmāsa bhūyo'pi rāmasandeśavistaram
translation: सुमन्त्रः Sumantra, तस्य his, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, बाष्पविक्लबः overcome with tears, रामसन्देशविस्तरम् details of Rama's message, भूयोऽपि once again, कथयामास narrated.
explanation: Having heard him, Sumantra, overcome with tears, related further details of Rama's message.

shloka_text: जटाः कृत्वा महाराज चीरवल्कलधारिणौ। गङ्गामुत्तीर्य तौ वीरौ प्रयागाभिमुखौ गतौ।।2.59.3।।
transliteration: jaṭāḥ kṛtvā mahārāja cīravalkaladhāriṇau| gaṅgāmuttīrya tau vīrau prayāgābhimukhau gatau
translation: महाराज O king, चीरवल्कलधारिणौ wearing the bark robes, तौ वीरौ those heroes, जटाः matted hair, कृत्वा having made, गङ्गाम् the river Ganga, उत्तीर्य having crossed, प्रयागाभिमुखौ towards Prayaga, गतौ went.
explanation: O King the heroes in bark robes and with matted hair crossed the Ganga and proceeded towards Prayaga.

shloka_text: अग्रतो लक्ष्मणो यातः पालयन्रघुनन्दनम्। तांस्तथा गच्छतो दृष्ट्वा निवृत्तोऽस्म्यवशस्तदा।।2.59.4।।
transliteration: agrato lakṣmaṇo yātaḥ pālayanraghunandanam| tāṃstathā gacchato dṛṣṭvā nivṛtto'smyavaśastadā
translation: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रघुनन्दनम् Rama, पालयन् protecting, अग्रतः ahead of him, यातः had gone, तथा that way, गच्छतः going, तान् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तदा then, अवशः helplessly, निवृत्तः अस्मि returned.
explanation: Lakshmana walked ahead guarding Rama, the delight of the Raghus. While I returned helplessly seeing them go.

shloka_text: ममत्वश्वा निवृत्तस्य न प्रावर्तन्त वर्त्मनि। उष्णमश्रु प्रमुञ्चन्तो रामे सम्प्रस्थिते वनम्।।2.59.5।।
transliteration: mamatvaśvā nivṛttasya na prāvartanta vartmani| uṣṇamaśru pramuñcanto rāme samprasthite vanam
translation: रामे Rama, वनम् for the forest, सम्प्रस्थिते when setting out, निवृत्तस्य when I returned, मम my, अश्वा: तु as for horses, उष्णम् hot, अश्रुप्रमुञ्चन्तः shedding tears, वर्त्मनि on the path, न प्रावर्तन्त did not proceed.
explanation: When Rama set out for the forest, and I turned back, my horses shedding hot tears were reluctant to walk the path.

shloka_text: उभाभ्यां राजपुत्राभ्यामथ कृत्वाहमञ्जलिम्। प्रस्थितो रथमास्थाय तद्दुःखमपि धारयन्।।2.59.6।।
transliteration: ubhābhyāṃ rājaputrābhyāmatha kṛtvāhamañjalim| prasthito rathamāsthāya tadduḥkhamapi dhārayan
translation: अथ thereafter, अहम् I, उभाभ्याम् to both, राजपुत्राभ्याम् princess, अञ्जलिम् folded palms, कृत्वा having made, तत् that, दुःखम् अपि grief, धारयन् controlling, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय ascending, प्रस्थितः set out.
explanation: Thereafter, controlling my grief and paying obeisance to both the princes with folded palms, I ascended the chariot and returned.

shloka_text: गुहेन सार्धं तत्रैव स्थितोऽस्मि दिवसान्बहून्। आशया यदि मां रामः पुन श्शब्दापयेदिति।।2.59.7।।
transliteration: guhena sārdhaṃ tatraiva sthito'smi divasānbahūn| āśayā yadi māṃ rāmaḥ puna śśabdāpayediti
translation: रामः Rama, पुनः again, माम् me, शब्दापयेत् यदि if calls me, इति thus, आशया with hope, तत्रैव there itself, गुहेन सार्धम् with Guha, बहून् many (three), दिवसान् अस्मि I waited.
explanation: There along with Guha I waited for (three) days that Rama might call me back.

shloka_text: विषये ते महाराज रामव्यसनकर्शिताः। अपि वृक्षाः परिम्लानास्सपुष्पाङ्कुरकोरकाः।।2.59.8।।
transliteration: viṣaye te mahārāja rāmavyasanakarśitāḥ| api vṛkṣāḥ parimlānāssapuṣpāṅkurakorakāḥ
translation: महाराज O great king, ते विषये throughout your empire, वृक्षाः अपि even trees, सपुष्पाङ्कुरकोरकाः with flowers, buds and shoots, रामव्यसनकर्शिताः oppressed on account of the calamity on Rama, परिम्लानाः withered.
explanation: O great king even trees with their flowers, buds and shoots throughout your empire have withered because of the calamity on Rama.

shloka_text: उपतप्तोदका नद्यः पल्वलानि सरांसि च। परिशुष्कपलाशानि वनान्युपवनानि च।।2.59.9।।
transliteration: upataptodakā nadyaḥ palvalāni sarāṃsi ca| pariśuṣkapalāśāni vanānyupavanāni ca
translation: नद्यः rivers, उपतप्तोदकाः with heated waters, पल्वलानि ponds, सरांसि च lakes, वनानि forests, उपवनानि च gardens, परिशुष्कपलाशानि have their foliage shrivelled.
explanation: Water in rivers, ponds and lakes has heated up while all the foliage in the forests and gardens have shrivelled.

shloka_text: न च सर्पन्ति सत्त्वानि व्यासा न प्रचरन्ति च। रामशोकाभिभूतं तन्निष्कूजमभवद्वनम्।।2.59.10।।
transliteration: na ca sarpanti sattvāni vyāsā na pracaranti ca| rāmaśokābhibhūtaṃ tanniṣkūjamabhavadvanam
translation: सत्त्वानि living beings, न च सर्पन्ति are not moving, व्यालाः च wild animals also, नप्रचरन्ति not ranging, तत् वनम् that forest, रामशोकाभिभूतम् overpowered by grief on account of Rama, निष्कूजम् silent, अभवत् became.
explanation: No living being move about and even wild animals roam no more. Overwhelmed with grief on account of Rama a great silence pervades the forest.

shloka_text: लीनपुष्करपत्राश्च नरेन्द्र कलुषोदकाः। सन्तप्तपद्माः पद्मिन्यो लीनमीनविहङ्गमाः।।2.59.11।।
transliteration: līnapuṣkarapatrāśca narendra kaluṣodakāḥ| santaptapadmāḥ padminyo līnamīnavihaṅgamāḥ
translation: नरेन्द्र O king, पद्मिन्यः lotus lakes, लीनपुष्करपत्राः च with the shrivelled blue lotus leaves submerged in water, कलुषोदकाः with waters turbid, सन्तप्तपद्माः withered lotuses, लीनमीनविहङ्गमाः devoid of fishes and birds.
explanation: The water in the lotus lakes, O king, has become turbid. The blue lotuses have withered and their shrivelled petals are submerged in water. The fishes and aquatic birds are hidden under waters.

shloka_text: जलजानि च पुष्पाणि माल्यानि स्थलजानि च। नाद्य भान्त्यल्पगन्धीनि फलानि च यथापुरम्।।2.59.12।।
transliteration: jalajāni ca puṣpāṇi mālyāni sthalajāni ca| nādya bhāntyalpagandhīni phalāni ca yathāpuram
translation: जलजानि born in water, पुष्पाणि flowers, स्थलजानि born on the land, माल्यानि garlands of flowers, फलानि च fruits, अद्य now, अल्पगन्धीनि with scant fragrance, यथापुरम् as before, न भान्ति do not shine.
explanation: Bunches of flowers grown in water and on land, as well as fruits with their scant fragrance do not shine as before.

shloka_text: अत्रोद्यानानि शून्यानि प्रलीनविहगनि च। न चाभिरामा नारामान्पश्यामि मनुजर्षभ।।2.59.13।।
transliteration: atrodyānāni śūnyāni pralīnavihagani ca| na cābhirāmā nārāmānpaśyāmi manujarṣabha
translation: अत्र there, उद्यानानि gardens, शून्यानि are deserted, प्रलीनविहगानि च with birds vanished (into the depth of woods), मनुजर्षभ O (best) among men, आरामान् parks, अभिरामन् as beautiful, न पश्यामि I do not see.
explanation: Pleasuregardens are all deserted as the birds have vanished. O best of men, as such they do not look beautiful.

shloka_text: प्रविशन्तमयोध्यां मां न कश्चिदभिनन्दति। नरा राममपश्यन्तो निश्श्वसन्ति मुहुर्मुहुः।।2.59.14।।
transliteration: praviśantamayodhyāṃ māṃ na kaścidabhinandati| narā rāmamapaśyanto niśśvasanti muhurmuhuḥ
translation: अयोध्यायाम् Ayodhya, प्रविशन्तम् entering, कश्चित् any one, न अभिनन्दति is not greeting, नराः people, रामम् Rama, अपश्यन्तः without beholding, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, निश्श्वसन्ति are heaving sighs.
explanation: None greeted me when I entered Ayodhya, People heaved sighs repeatedly when they did not see Rama.

shloka_text: देव राजरथं दृष्ट्वा विना राममिहागतम्। दुःखादश्रुमुखस्सर्वो राजमार्गगतो जनः।।2.59.15।।
transliteration: deva rājarathaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinā rāmamihāgatam| duḥkhādaśrumukhassarvo rājamārgagato janaḥ
translation: देव O lord, विना रामम् without Rama, इह here, आगतम् arrived, राजरथम् royal chariot, दृष्ट्वा having seen, राजमार्गगतः thronged the highway, सर्वः all, जनः people, दुःखात् due to agony, अश्रुमुखः with tears on their faces.
explanation: Beholding the royal chariot arrive without Rama, all were on the highway shedding tears of anguish.

shloka_text: हर्म्यैर्विमानैः प्रासादैरवेक्ष्यरथमागतम्। हाहाकारकृतानार्यो रामादर्शनकर्शिताः।।2.59.16।।
transliteration: harmyairvimānaiḥ prāsādairavekṣyarathamāgatam| hāhākārakṛtānāryo rāmādarśanakarśitāḥ
translation: नार्य: women, हर्म्यै: from mansions, विमानैः from sevenstoried buildings, प्रासादैः from royal palaces, आगतम् arrived, रथम् chariot, अवेक्ष्य having seen, रामादर्शनकर्शिताः afflicted by the absence of Rama, हाहाकारकृताः cried 'Alas, Alas'.
explanation: When the women from mansions, sevenstoried buildings and from royal palaces saw the chariot without Rama, they, overwhelmed with sorrow, cried, 'Alas, Alas'.

shloka_text: आयतैर्विमलैर्नेत्रैरश्रुवेगपरिप्लुतैः। अन्योन्यमभिवीक्षन्तेऽव्यक्तमार्ततराः स्त्रियः।।2.59.17।।
transliteration: āyatairvimalairnetrairaśruvegapariplutaiḥ| anyonyamabhivīkṣante'vyaktamārtatarāḥ striyaḥ
translation: स्त्रियः women, आर्ततराः in deep anguish, आयतैः with large, विमलैः bright, अश्रुवेगपरिप्लुतैः flooded with gushing tears, नेत्रै: with their eyes, अव्यक्तम् silently, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिवीक्षन्ते are looking at.
explanation: The women, with their large, bright eyes flooded with gushing tears looked in silence at one another in deep anguish.

shloka_text: नामित्राणां न मित्राणामुदासीनजनस्य च। अहमार्ततया किञ्चिद्विशेषमुपलक्षये।।2.59.18।।
transliteration: nāmitrāṇāṃ na mitrāṇāmudāsīnajanasya ca| ahamārtatayā kiñcidviśeṣamupalakṣaye
translation: अहम् I, आर्ततया in great agony, अमित्राणाम् among those who are not friends, किञ्चित् even a little, विशेषम् diference, न उपलक्षये could not see, मित्राणाम् among friends, उदासीनजनस्य of people indifferent, न could not see.
explanation: I did not see any difference in the degree of anguish among friends, those who are not friends and and those who are indifferent. (The degree of agony was same in all).

shloka_text: अप्रहृष्टमनुष्या च दीननागतुरङ्गमा। आर्तस्वरपरिम्लाना विनिश्श्वसितनिस्स्वना।।2.59.19।। निरानन्दा महाराज रामप्रव्राजनातुरा। कौसल्या पुत्रहीनेव अयोध्या प्रतिभाति मा।।2.59.20।।
transliteration: aprahṛṣṭamanuṣyā ca dīnanāgaturaṅgamā| ārtasvaraparimlānā viniśśvasitanissvanā nirānandā mahārāja rāmapravrājanāturā| kausalyā putrahīneva ayodhyā pratibhāti mā
translation: महाराज O great king, अप्रहृष्टमनुष्या च people cheerless, दीननागतुरङ्गमा spiritless elephants and horses, आर्तस्वरपरिम्लाना with agonised voices and pale faces, विनिश्वसित निस्स्वना with deep sighs, निरानन्दा depressed, रामप्रव्राजनातुरा distressed due to Rama's exile, पुत्रहीना deprived of her son, कौसल्या इव like Kausalya, मा प्रतिभाति appears to me.
explanation: O maharaja, Ayodhya is filled with cheerless people with deep sighs, agonised voices and pale faces depressed and distressed due to Rama's exile. (Even) elephants and horses look spiritless. For me it (the city) resembles (dejected) Kausalya deprived of her son.

shloka_text: अप्रहृष्टमनुष्या च दीननागतुरङ्गमा। आर्तस्वरपरिम्लाना विनिश्श्वसितनिस्स्वना।।2.59.19।। निरानन्दा महाराज रामप्रव्राजनातुरा। कौसल्या पुत्रहीनेव अयोध्या प्रतिभाति मा।।2.59.20।।
transliteration: aprahṛṣṭamanuṣyā ca dīnanāgaturaṅgamā| ārtasvaraparimlānā viniśśvasitanissvanā nirānandā mahārāja rāmapravrājanāturā| kausalyā putrahīneva ayodhyā pratibhāti mā
translation: महाराज O great king, अप्रहृष्टमनुष्या च people cheerless, दीननागतुरङ्गमा spiritless elephants and horses, आर्तस्वरपरिम्लाना with agonised voices and pale faces, विनिश्वसित निस्स्वना with deep sighs, निरानन्दा depressed, रामप्रव्राजनातुरा distressed due to Rama's exile, पुत्रहीना deprived of her son, कौसल्या इव like Kausalya, मा प्रतिभाति appears to me.
explanation: O maharaja, Ayodhya is filled with cheerless people with deep sighs, agonised voices and pale faces depressed and distressed due to Rama's exile. (Even) elephants and horses look spiritless. For me it (the city) resembles (dejected) Kausalya deprived of her son.

shloka_text: सूतस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा वाचा परमदीनया। बाष्पोपहतया राजा तं सूतमिदमब्रवीत्।।2.59.21।।
transliteration: sūtasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vācā paramadīnayā| bāṣpopahatayā rājā taṃ sūtamidamabravīt
translation: राजा king, सूतस्य charioteer's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, परमदीनया deeply dejected, बाष्पोपहतया choked with tears, वाचा with a voice, तं सूतम् to the charioteer, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: At these words of the charioteer, the king in deep distress replied with a voice choked with tears:

shloka_text: कैकेय्या विनियुक्तेन पापाभिजनभावया। मया न मन्त्रकुशलैर्वृद्धैस्सह समर्थितम्।।2.59.22।।
transliteration: kaikeyyā viniyuktena pāpābhijanabhāvayā| mayā na mantrakuśalairvṛddhaissaha samarthitam
translation: पापाभिजनभावया by one who has wicked relations and sinful intention, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, विनियुक्तेन having been incited, मया by me, मन्त्रकुशलैः with men skilled in giving advice, वृद्धै: सह with seniors, न समर्थितम् was not consulted.
explanation: Incited by Kaikeyi of sinful relations and sinful motive, I did not consult expert, elderly counsellers.

shloka_text: न सुहृद्भिर्नचामात्यैर्मन्त्रयित्वा न नैगमैः। मयायमर्थस्सम्मोहात् स्त्रीहेतो स्सहसा कृतः।।2.59.23।।
transliteration: na suhṛdbhirnacāmātyairmantrayitvā na naigamaiḥ| mayāyamarthassammohāt strīheto ssahasā kṛtaḥ
translation: सुहृद्भि: with friends, अमात्यैः with ministers, नैगमैः च with men of prudence, न मन्त्रयित्वा without consulting, मया by me, अयम् this, अर्थः act, स्त्रीहेतो: for the sake of a woman, सहसा in great haste, कृतः committed.
explanation: For the sake of a woman, this act was committed in great haste, without consulting friends or ministers or men of prudence.

shloka_text: भवितव्यतया नूनमिदं वा व्यसनं महत्। कुलस्यास्य विनाशाय प्राप्तं सूत यदृच्छया।।2.59.24।।
transliteration: bhavitavyatayā nūnamidaṃ vā vyasanaṃ mahat| kulasyāsya vināśāya prāptaṃ sūta yadṛcchayā
translation: सूत O charioteer, वा otherwise, इदम् this, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, भवितव्यतया because it was destined to happen this way, अस्य this, कुलस्य race's, विनाशाय for destruction, यदृच्छया wilfully, प्राप्तम् has befallen, नूनम् surely.
explanation: Surely it is destiny and this calamity has befallen for the wilful destruction of the (entire) race, O charioteer

shloka_text: सूत यद्यस्ति ते किञ्चिन्मया तु सुकृतं कृतम्। त्वं प्रापयाऽऽशु मां रामं प्राणास्सन्त्वरयन्तिमाम्।।2.59.25।।
transliteration: sūta yadyasti te kiñcinmayā tu sukṛtaṃ kṛtam| tvaṃ prāpayā''śu māṃ rāmaṃ prāṇāssantvarayantimām
translation: सूत O Charioteer, मया by me, ते to you, किंचित् even a little, सुकृतम् favour, कृतम् अस्ति यदि  if it has been rendered, त्वम् you, आशु quickly, माम् me, रामम् to Rama, प्रापय take, प्राणाः life, माम् me, संत्वरयन्ति are hastening me up.
explanation: O Charioteer, if ever I have rendered you any favour, quickly  take me to Rama. My life is hastening me (fast running out).

shloka_text: यद्यद्यापि ममैवाज्ञा निवर्तयतु राघवम्। न शक्ष्यामि विना रामं मुहूर्तमपि जीवितुम्।।2.59.26।।
transliteration: yadyadyāpi mamaivājñā nivartayatu rāghavam| na śakṣyāmi vinā rāmaṃ muhūrtamapi jīvitum
translation: अद्यापि even now, मम my, आज्ञैव by command, राघवम् Rama, निवर्तयतु be brought back, रामं विना without Rama, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यामि am not able.
explanation: If my command prevails today, Rama may be brought back. Without Rama I cannot live for a moment even.

shloka_text: अथवाऽपि महाबाहुर्गतो दूरं भविष्यति। मामेव रथमारोप्य शीघ्रं रामाय दर्शय।।2.58.27।।
transliteration: athavā'pi mahābāhurgato dūraṃ bhaviṣyati| māmeva rathamāropya śīghraṃ rāmāya darśaya
translation: अथवा or otherwise also, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, दूरम् far away, गतः भविष्यति must have gone, मामेव me alone, रथम् on the chariot, आरोप्य placing, शीघ्रम् quickly, रामाय to Rama, दर्शय show.
explanation: Otherwise if (you think) the mightyarmed (Rama) has gone too far then quickly put me in the chariot, and show me Rama (Carry me to him).

shloka_text: वृत्तदंष्ट्रो महेष्वासः क्वासौ लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः। यदि जीवामि साध्वेनं पश्येयं सीतया सह।।2.59.28।।
transliteration: vṛttadaṃṣṭro maheṣvāsaḥ kvāsau lakṣmaṇapūrvajaḥ| yadi jīvāmi sādhvenaṃ paśyeyaṃ sītayā saha
translation: वृत्तदंष्ट्रः one with wellshaped teeth, महेष्वासः a great archer, असौ that, लक्ष्मणपूर्वजः elder brother of Lakshmana, Rama, क्व where is he?, एनम् him, सीतया सह along with Sita, साधु well, पश्येयं यदि if I can see him, जीवामि I can live.
explanation: Where is that Rama, elder brother to Lakshmana who has wellshaped teeth and wields a mighty bow? If I can see him along with Sita I will survive.

shloka_text: लोहिताक्षं महाबाहुमामुक्तमणिकुण्डलम्। रामं यदि न पश्येयं गमिष्यामि यमक्षयम्।।2.59.29।।
transliteration: lohitākṣaṃ mahābāhumāmuktamaṇikuṇḍalam| rāmaṃ yadi na paśyeyaṃ gamiṣyāmi yamakṣayam
translation: लोहिताक्षम् one with redcoloured eyes, महाबाहुम् mightyarmed, आमुक्तमणिकुण्डलम् wearing earrings bedecked with gems, रामम् Rama, न पश्येयं यदि if I cannot see him, यमक्षयम् kingdom of Yama, lord of death, गमिष्यामि I will go.
explanation: If I cannot see Rama of redcoloured eyes, the mightyarmed one and wearing earrings bedecked with precious stones I shall surely go to the abode of Yama, the god of death.

shloka_text: अतो नु किं दुःखतरं सोऽहमिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनम्। इमामवस्थामापन्नो नेह पश्यामि राघवम्।।2.59.30।।
transliteration: ato nu kiṃ duḥkhataraṃ so'hamikṣvākunandanam| imāmavasthāmāpanno neha paśyāmi rāghavam
translation: इमाम् this, अवस्थाम् condition, आपन्नः having reached, सः अहम् such me, इक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम्  Delight of the Ikshvakus, राघवम् Rama, इह now, न पश्यामि see not, अतः than this, दुःखतरम् greater sorrow,  किं नु what more.
explanation: What else can be of greater sorrow to me who having reached this state, am still unable to see Rama?

shloka_text: हा राम रामानुज हा हा वैदेहि तपस्विनि। न मां जानीत दुःखेन म्रियमाणतमनाथवत्।।2.59.31।।
transliteration: hā rāma rāmānuja hā hā vaidehi tapasvini| na māṃ jānīta duḥkhena mriyamāṇatamanāthavat
translation: हा राम Ah Rama, हा रामानुज Ah Lakshmana, तपस्विनि the unfortunate, हा वैदेहि Ah Vaidehi,  माम् me, दुःखेन due to grief, अनाथवत् like an orphan, म्रियमाणम् dying, न जानीत you do not know.
explanation: Ah Rama, Ah Lakshmana, Ah unfortunate Vaidehi, you do not know that I am dying  like an orphan because of my grief.

shloka_text: स तेन राजा दुःखेन भृशमर्पितचेतनः। अवगाढस्सुदुष्पारं शोकसागरमब्रवीत्।।2.59.32।।
transliteration: sa tena rājā duḥkhena bhṛśamarpitacetanaḥ| avagāḍhassuduṣpāraṃ śokasāgaramabravīt
translation: तेन दुःखेन by that sorrow, भृशम् extremely, अर्पित चेतनः with enfeebled mind,  सः राजा that king, सुदुष्पारम् difficult to cross, शोकसागरम् sea of sorrow, अवगाढः immersed, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The king whose mind was extremely enfeebled due to grief and who was immersed in a sea of tears which he was unable to cross continued:

shloka_text: रामशोकमहाभोगस्सीताविरहपारगः। श्वसितोर्मि महावर्तो बाष्पफेनजालाविलः।।2.59.33।। बाहुविक्षेपमीनौघो विक्रन्दित महास्वनः। प्रकीर्णकेशशैवालः कैकेयीबडबामुखः।।2.59.34।। ममाश्रुवेगप्रभवः कुब्जावाक्यमहाग्रहः। वरवेलो नृशंसाया रामप्रव्राजनायतः।।2.59.35।। यस्मिन्बत निमग्नोऽहं कौसल्ये राघवं विना। दुस्तरो जीवता देवि मयाऽयं शोकसागरः।।2.59.36।।
transliteration: rāmaśokamahābhogassītāvirahapāragaḥ| śvasitormi mahāvarto bāṣpaphenajālāvilaḥ bāhuvikṣepamīnaugho vikrandita mahāsvanaḥ| prakīrṇakeśaśaivālaḥ kaikeyībaḍabāmukhaḥ mamāśruvegaprabhavaḥ kubjāvākyamahāgrahaḥ| varavelo nṛśaṃsāyā rāmapravrājanāyataḥ yasminbata nimagno'haṃ kausalye rāghavaṃ vinā| dustaro jīvatā devi mayā'yaṃ śokasāgaraḥ
translation: देवि O queen, कौशल्ये Kausalya, अहम् I, यस्मिन् in which, निमग्नः immersed, (असौ this, शोकसागरः ocean of sorrow), रामशोकमहाभोगः sorrow due to Rama's separation as its breadth, सीताविरहपारगः Sita's separation as its other shore, श्वसितोर्मिमहावर्तः sighs as its turbulent waves and whirlpools, बाष्पफेनजलाविलः tears as its foam and turbid waters, बाहुविक्षेपमीनौघः waving of the arms as fishes, विक्रन्दितमहास्वनः cries of agony as its roar, प्रकीर्णकेशशैवालः dishevelled hair as its moss, कैकेयीबडबामुखः Kaikeyi as mouth of Badaba mythical seamare, मम to me, अश्रुवेगप्रभवः source of copious tears, कुब्जावाक्यमहाग्रहः the words of hunchback (Manthara) as monstrous crocodiles, नृशंसायाः cruel, वरवेल boons as shores, रामप्रव्राजनायतः exile of Rama as its expanse, अयम् this, शोकसागरः sea of sorrow, राघवं विना without Rama, मया by me, जीवता with my life, दुस्तरः difficult to cross, बत on what a pity
explanation: O queen Kausalya, I am completely immersed in this ocean of sorrow. The misfortune due to Rama's separation is its breadth. Sita's separation is the other end of the shore. Sighs are its turbulent waves and whirlpools. Tears are its foam and turbid waters. Waving of arms is its fishes. Cries of agony are its roars. My dishevelled hair is its moss. Kaikeyi is the mouth of Badaba. My copious tears are its source. Words of the hunchback (Manthara) are the monstrous crocodiles. The cruel boons to Kaikeyi are its shores. Without Rama I cannot cross  this sea of sorrow alive. Ah, what a pity

Without Rama I cannot cross  this sea of sorrow alive. Ah, what a pity

shloka_text: अशोभनं योऽहमिहाद्य राघवं दिदृक्षमाणो न लभे सलक्ष्मणम्। इतीव राजा विलपन्महायशाः पपात तूर्णं शयने समूर्छितः।।2.59.37।।
transliteration: aśobhanaṃ yo'hamihādya rāghavaṃ didṛkṣamāṇo na labhe salakṣmaṇam| itīva rājā vilapanmahāyaśāḥ papāta tūrṇaṃ śayane samūrchitaḥ
translation: यः he who, अहम् I, अद्य now, दिदृक्षमाणः wishing to see, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshamana, राघवम् Rama, इह here, न लभे unable to get them, अशोभनम् inauspicious, इतीव in this way, महायशाः of great reknown, सः राजा that king, विलपन् lamenting, मूर्छितः lying unconcsious, तूर्णम् immediately, शयने on the bed, पपात fell.
explanation: Though I wish I cannot see Rama together with Lakshmana. Indeed this is very unfortunate. Lamenting thus, king Dasaratha of great reknown fell on the bed, unconscious.

shloka_text: इति विलपति पार्थिवे प्रणष्टे करुणतरं द्विगुणं च रामहेतोः। वचनमनुनिशम्य तस्य देवी भयमगमत्पुनरेव राममाता।।2.59.38।।
transliteration: iti vilapati pārthive praṇaṣṭe karuṇataraṃ dviguṇaṃ ca rāmahetoḥ| vacanamanuniśamya tasya devī bhayamagamatpunareva rāmamātā
translation: पार्थिवे king, रामहेतोः for the sake of Rama, करुणतरम् in greater grief, द्विगुणं च doubly, विलपति lamenting, प्रणष्टे losing senses, राममाता Rama's mother, देवी queen Kausalya, तस्य वचनम् his words, अनुनिशम्य having heard, पुनरेव once again, भयम् fear, अगमत् seized.
explanation: Wailing, Dasaratha fell unconscious. He was doubly grieved due to his yearning for Rama. Rama's mother was seized with fear hearing those lamentations. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends  the fiftyninth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततो भूतोपसृष्टेव वेपमाना पुनः पुनः। धरण्यां गतसत्त्वेव कौसल्या सूतमब्रवीत्।।2.60.1।।
transliteration: tato bhūtopasṛṣṭeva vepamānā punaḥ punaḥ| dharaṇyāṃ gatasattveva kausalyā sūtamabravīt
translation: ततः thereafter, कौशल्या Kausalya, भूतोपसृष्टेव as if possessed by an evil spirit, वेपमाना trembling, गतसत्त्वेव like one who has his senses lost, पुनः पुनः again and again, धरण्याम् on the floor, सूतम् to the  charioteer (Sumantra), अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Thereafter Kausalya, trembling as if possessed by an evil spirit and rolling on the floor like one who her senses now and again, said to the charioteer (Sumantra):
comments: Sumantra consoles Kausalya.

shloka_text: नय मां यत्र काकुत्स्थस्सीता यत्र च लक्ष्मणः। तान्विना क्षणमप्यत्र जीवितुं नोत्सहेह्यहम्।।2.60.2।।
transliteration: naya māṃ yatra kākutsthassītā yatra ca lakṣmaṇaḥ| tānvinā kṣaṇamapyatra jīvituṃ notsahehyaham
translation: काकुत्स्थः Rama, सीता च Sita, यत्र wherever, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, यत्र wherever, तत्र there, माम् to me, नय take, तान् विना without them, अत्र here,  क्षणमपि even for a moment, जीवितुम्  to live, अहम् I, न उत्सहे do not wish.
explanation: Take me where Rama, Sita and Lakshmana are. I do not wish to live even for a moment without them.

shloka_text: निवर्तय रथं शीघ्रं दण्डकान्नय मामपि। अथ तान्नानुगच्छामि गमिष्यामि यमक्षयम्।।2.60.3।।
transliteration: nivartaya rathaṃ śīghraṃ daṇḍakānnaya māmapi| atha tānnānugacchāmi gamiṣyāmi yamakṣayam
translation: रथम् chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, निवर्तय turn back, मामपि me also, दण्डकान् to Dandaka, नय  take, अथ if, तान् them, नानु गच्छामि if I do not follow, यमक्षयम् to the world of Yama, गमिष्यामि shall go.
explanation: 'Turn back your chariot immediately and take me to the Dandaka forest. If I do not follow them, I shall enter the world of Yama'.

shloka_text: बाष्पवेगोपहतया स वाचा सज्जमानया। इदमाश्वासयन्देवीं सूतः प्राञ्जलिरब्रवीत्।।2.60.4।।
transliteration: bāṣpavegopahatayā sa vācā sajjamānayā| idamāśvāsayandevīṃ sūtaḥ prāñjalirabravīt
translation: सः सूतः that charioteer, बाष्पवेगोपहतया prevented by fastflowing tears, सज्जमानया faltering, वाचा with words, देवीम् to Kausalya, आश्वसयन् consoling, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: With folded hands and faltering words choked by his fastflowing tears the charioteer tried to console Kausalya:

shloka_text: त्यज शोकं च मोहं च सम्भ्रमं दुःखजं तथा। व्यवधूय च सन्तापं वने वत्स्यति राघवः।।2.60.5।।
transliteration: tyaja śokaṃ ca mohaṃ ca sambhramaṃ duḥkhajaṃ tathā| vyavadhūya ca santāpaṃ vane vatsyati rāghavaḥ
translation: शोकम् grief, मोहम् delusion, तथा also, दुःखजम् arising out of sorrow, सम्भ्रमं च despair, त्यज abandon, राघवः Rama, सन्तापम् difficulties, व्यवधूय after brushig aside, वने in the forest, वत्स्यति is going to live.
explanation: Abandon your tears, delusion and despair arising out of sorrow. Rama is going to live in the forest, brushing aside all agony.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणश्चापि रामस्य पादौ परिचरन्वने। आराधयति धर्मज्ञः परलोकं जितेन्द्रियः।।2.60.6।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaścāpi rāmasya pādau paricaranvane| ārādhayati dharmajñaḥ paralokaṃ jitendriyaḥ
translation: धर्मज्ञ: knower of duty, लक्ष्मणश्चापि also Lakshmana, वने in the forest, जितेन्द्रियः one whose senses are controlled, रामस्य to Rama' s, पादौ feet, परिचरन् serving at, परलोकम् the other world, आराधयति is accomplishing.
explanation: Selfcontrolled Lakshmana, aware of his duty, serves Rama in the forest. By this he is securing his next world.
