explanation: ﻿ Being avaricious, you are, I think, unaware of my devotion to Rama. This great calamity has been brought about by you for (your greed for) the kingdom.

shloka_text: अहं हि पुरुषव्याघ्रावपश्यन्रामलक्ष्मणौ। केन शक्तिप्रभावेन राज्यं रक्षितुमुत्सहे।।2.73.14।।
transliteration: ahaṃ hi puruṣavyāghrāvapaśyanrāmalakṣmaṇau| kena śaktiprabhāvena rājyaṃ rakṣitumutsahe
translation: अहम् I, पुरुषव्याघ्रौ two tigers among men, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, अपश्यन् without beholding them, केन with what, शक्तिप्रभावेन by the mighty power, राज्यम् kingdom, रक्षितुम् to protect, उत्सहे will be competent?
explanation: When Rama and Lakshmana, the best of men stay away from me, by virtue of what mighty power am I competent to protect this kingdom?

shloka_text: तं हि नित्यं महाराजो बलवन्तं महाबलः। उपाश्रितोऽभूद्धर्मात्मा मेरुर्मेरुवनं यथा।।2.73.15।।
transliteration: taṃ hi nityaṃ mahārājo balavantaṃ mahābalaḥ| upāśrito'bhūddharmātmā merurmeruvanaṃ yathā
translation: महाबलः  mighty, धर्मात्मा righteous one, महाराजः great king, नित्यम् always, बलवन्तम् all powerful, तम् Rama, मेरुः mount Meru, मेरुवनं यथा just as the forest surrounding Meru, उपाश्रितः अभूत् हि used to rely upon.
explanation: The mighty and righteous maharaja used to rely upon the powerful Rama just as mount Meru depends on the forest surrounding it for its protection.

shloka_text: सोऽहं कथमिमं भारं महाधुर्यसमुद्धृतम्। दम्योधुरमिवाऽऽसाद्य वहेयं केनचौजसा।। 2.73.16।।
transliteration: so'haṃ kathamimaṃ bhāraṃ mahādhuryasamuddhṛtam| damyodhuramivā''sādya vaheyaṃ kenacaujasā
translation: सः अहम् such as me, इमं भारम् this burden, आसाद्य having taken, महाधुर्यसमुद्धृतम् carried by a great bull fit to be yoked, धुरम् the weight, दम्यः इव like an young bullock requiring training, केन by what, ओजसा strength, वहेयम् I shall bear?
explanation: Like a young untrained bullock that cannot carry the weight fit for a great bull, with what strength can I bear this burden?

shloka_text: अथवा मे भवेच्छक्तिर्योगैर्बुद्धिबलेन वा। सकामां न करिष्यामि त्वामहं पुत्रगर्धिनीम्।।2.73.17।।
transliteration: athavā me bhavecchaktiryogairbuddhibalena vā| sakāmāṃ na kariṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ putragardhinīm
translation: अथवा or, योगैः by employing the four expedients (conciliation, bribery, sowing dissenssions and punishment), बुद्धिबलेन वा or with the strength of intellect, मे to me, शक्तिः भवेत् I might get strength, अहम् I, पुत्रगर्धिनीम् covetous of son, त्वाम् you, सकामाम्  having fulfilled your ambition, न करिष्यामि will not do.
explanation: If I gather the strength (to carry the burden) either by employing the four expedients (available to a king against an enemy) or by the power of intellect, I will not allow you, covetous of your son, to fulfil your ambition.

shloka_text: न मे विकाङ्क्षा जायेत त्यक्तुं त्वां पापनिश्चयाम्। यदि रामस्य नावेक्षा त्वयि स्यान्मातृवत्सदा।।2.73.18।।
transliteration: na me vikāṅkṣā jāyeta tyaktuṃ tvāṃ pāpaniścayām| yadi rāmasya nāvekṣā tvayi syānmātṛvatsadā
translation: त्वयि towards you, रामस्य of Rama, सदा always, मातृवत् just like his mother, अवेक्षा न स्याद्यदि if it were not so, पापनिश्चयाम् having sinful conviction, त्वाम् you, त्यक्तुम् to renounce, मे to me, विकाङ्क्षा disinclination, न जायेत will not cause.
explanation: Had Rama not treated you as his own mother I would not have the slightest hesitation to renounce you, a lady of sinful disposition.

shloka_text: उत्पन्नातु कथं बुद्धिस्तवेयं पापदर्शिनि। साधुचारित्रविभ्रष्टे पूर्वेषां नो विगर्हिता।।2.73.19।।
transliteration: utpannātu kathaṃ buddhistaveyaṃ pāpadarśini| sādhucāritravibhraṣṭe pūrveṣāṃ no vigarhitā
translation: पापदर्शिनि O sinful woman, साधुचरित्रविभ्रष्टे one fallen from virtuous conduct, नः our, पूर्वेषाम् for our ancestors, विगर्हिता reproachable, इयं बुद्धि: this thought, तव to you, कथम् how, उत्पन्ना originated.
explanation: O woman of sinful thoughts fallen from virtuous conduct, how did you entertain this thought reproachable to our ancestors?

shloka_text: अस्मिन्कुले हि पूर्वेषां ज्येष्ठो राज्येऽभिषिच्यते। अपरे भ्रातरस्तस्मिन्प्रवर्तन्ते समाहिताः।।2.73.20।।
transliteration: asminkule hi pūrveṣāṃ jyeṣṭho rājye'bhiṣicyate| apare bhrātarastasminpravartante samāhitāḥ
translation: अस्मिन् in this, कुले race, पूर्वेषाम् of our ancestors, ज्येष्ठः the eldest one, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषिच्यते हि is indeed installed, अपरे the rest of them, भ्रातरः brothers, तस्मिन् in the eldest, समाहिताः concentrate their attention, प्रवर्तन्ते conduct themselves.
explanation: In our race only the eldest son is installed in the kingdom and the other brothers behave with utmost respect towards him.

shloka_text: न हि मन्ये नृशंसे त्वं राजधर्ममवेक्षसे। गतिं वा न विजानासि राजवृत्तस्य शाश्वतीम्।।2.73.21।।
transliteration: na hi manye nṛśaṃse tvaṃ rājadharmamavekṣase| gatiṃ vā na vijānāsi rājavṛttasya śāśvatīm
translation: नृशंसे O cruel lady, त्वम् you, राजधर्मम् royal tradition, न अवेक्षसे are not looking at, वा  or, राजवृत्तस्य royal tradition's, शाश्वतीम् everlasting, गतिम् consequences, न विजानासि are ignorant, मन्ये I suppose.
explanation: O cruel one I suppose neither have you any respect for the royal tradition nor are you aware of the everlasting benefit that ensues in following the royal traditon.

shloka_text: ﻿सततं राजवृत्ते हि ज्येष्ठो राज्येऽभिषिच्यते। राज्ञामेतत्समं तत्स्यादिक्ष्वाकूणां विशेषतः।।2.73.22।।
transliteration: ﻿satataṃ rājavṛtte hi jyeṣṭho rājye'bhiṣicyate| rājñāmetatsamaṃ tatsyādikṣvākūṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ
translation: ﻿ राजवृत्ते in royal custom, सततम् always, ज्येष्ठः the eldest son, राज्ये in the kingdom, अभिषिच्यते is consecrated, एतत् this, राज्ञाम् to all kings, समम् is the same, तत् that, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् for Ikshvakus, विशेषतः स्यात् especially it applies.
explanation: ﻿ According to the established law of royalty, the eldest son is invariably crowned in the kingdom. This is true of all kings. This is a special tradition of the kings of the Ikshvaku race.

shloka_text: तेषां धर्मैकरक्षाणां कुलचारित्रशोभिनाम्। अद्य चारित्रशौण्डीर्यं त्वां प्राप्य विनिवर्तितम्।।2.73.23।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ dharmaikarakṣāṇāṃ kulacāritraśobhinām| adya cāritraśauṇḍīryaṃ tvāṃ prāpya vinivartitam
translation: धर्मैकरक्षाणाम् with righteousness as their sole protection, कुलचारित्रशोभिनाम् befitting the  ancestral traditions of the noble race, तेषाम् those (Ikshvaku kings)', चारित्रशौण्डीर्यम् pride about their tradition, अद्य now, त्वाम् you, प्राप्य after admitting, विनिवर्तितम् has been topsyturvied.
explanation: As for the Ikshvaku kings, righteousness is their sole protection. They follow the ancestral traditions befitting the noble race. This tradition has been topsyturvied by admitting you into the family.

shloka_text: तवापि सुमहाभागा जनेन्द्राः कुलपूर्वगाः। बुद्धेर्मोहः कथमयं सम्भूतस्त्वयि गर्हितः।।2.73.24।।
transliteration: tavāpi sumahābhāgā janendrāḥ kulapūrvagāḥ| buddhermohaḥ kathamayaṃ sambhūtastvayi garhitaḥ
translation: तव your, कुलपूर्वगाः ancestors of your family, जनेन्द्राः अपि kings also, सुमहाभागाः were highly distinguished, गर्हितः censured, अयम् this, बुद्धेः mind's, मोहः delusion, त्वयि in you, कथम् how, सम्भूतः originated.
explanation: Even the kings in your ancestral family were highly distinguished men. How did this condemnable deflection originate in your mind?

shloka_text: न तु कामं करिष्यामि तवाऽहं पापनिश्चये। त्वया व्यसनमारब्धं जीवितान्तकरं मम।।2.73.25।।
transliteration: na tu kāmaṃ kariṣyāmi tavā'haṃ pāpaniścaye| tvayā vyasanamārabdhaṃ jīvitāntakaraṃ mama
translation: पापनिश्चये O woman of sinful convictions, अहं तु I on my part, तव your, कामम्  cherished desire, न करिष्यामि will not fulfil, त्वया by you, मम my, जीवितान्तकरम् bringing an end to my existence, व्यसनम् distressing deed, आरब्धम् has commenced.
explanation: O woman of sinful disposition, I on my part will not fulfil your cherished desire. You have started a distressing deed to bring an end to my existence.

shloka_text: एषत्विदानीमेवाहमप्रियार्थं तवानघम्। निवर्तयिष्यामि वनाद्भ्रातरं स्वजनप्रियम्।।2.73.26।।
transliteration: eṣatvidānīmevāhamapriyārthaṃ tavānagham| nivartayiṣyāmi vanādbhrātaraṃ svajanapriyam
translation: एषः अहं तु as for me, इदानीम् now itself, तव your, अप्रियार्थम् for the sake of causing displeasure, अनघम् faultless, स्वजनप्रियम् the beloved of his people, भ्रातरम् my brother, वनात् from the forest, निवर्तयिष्यामि will make him turn back.
explanation: To cause a great discomfiture for you, right now I shall bring back my faultless brother, the beloved of his people, from the forest.

shloka_text: निवर्तयित्वा रामं च तस्याहं दीप्ततेजसः। दासभूतो भविष्यामि सुस्थिरेणान्तरात्मना।।2.73.27।।
transliteration: nivartayitvā rāmaṃ ca tasyāhaṃ dīptatejasaḥ| dāsabhūto bhaviṣyāmi susthireṇāntarātmanā
translation: रामम् Rama, निवर्तयित्वा after bringing back, सुस्थिरेण with a steady, अन्तरात्मना and heart, दीप्ततेजसः with radiating lustre, तस्य to him, दासभूतः like a servant, भविष्यामि I shall become.
explanation: With the effulgent Rama brought back, I shall serve him with a  steadfast mind.

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्त्वा भरतो महात्मा प्रियेतरैर्वाक्यगणैस्तुदंस्ताम्। शोकातुरश्चापि ननाद भूयः सिंहो यथा पर्वतगह्वरस्थः।।2.73.28।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvā bharato mahātmā priyetarairvākyagaṇaistudaṃstām| śokāturaścāpi nanāda bhūyaḥ siṃho yathā parvatagahvarasthaḥ
translation: महात्मा highsouled, भरतः Bharata, इत्येवम् in this manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, प्रियेतरैः unpleasant, वाक्यगणैः with words, ताम् her, तुदन् afflicting, शोकातुरः overwhelmed with grief, पर्वतगह्वरस्थः inside a mountaincave, सिंहो यथा like a lion, भूयश्चापि once again, ननाद cried out loudly.
explanation: Having inflicted on his mother these unpleasant words in this manner, the highsouled Bharata, overwhelmed with grief, roared again like a lion in a mountaincave. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे त्रिसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventythird sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तां तथा गर्हयित्वा तु मातरं भरतस्तदा। रोषेण महताऽविष्टः पुनरेवाब्रवीद्वचः।।2.74.1।।
transliteration: tāṃ tathā garhayitvā tu mātaraṃ bharatastadā| roṣeṇa mahatā'viṣṭaḥ punarevābravīdvacaḥ
translation: तदा then, भरतः Bharata, मातरम् mother, ताम् her, तथा in that manner, गर्हयित्वा having reproached, महता with great, रोषेण wrath, आविष्टः was overtaken, पुनरेव once again, वचः words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Overtaken by great wrath, Bharata reproached his mother and then said to her again:
comments: Bharata reproaches his mother -- decides to restore the glory of Ayodhya -- vows to get back Rama

shloka_text: राज्याद्भ्रंशस्व कैकेयि नृशंसे दुष्टचारिणि। परित्यक्ता च धर्मेण मा मृतं रुदती भव।।2.74.2।।
transliteration: rājyādbhraṃśasva kaikeyi nṛśaṃse duṣṭacāriṇi| parityaktā ca dharmeṇa mā mṛtaṃ rudatī bhava
translation: नृशंसे O cruel one, दुष्टचारिणि of wicked conduct, कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, राज्यात् from the  kingdom, भ्रंशस्व may be deprived, धर्मेण by righteousness, परित्यक्ता abandoned, मृतम्  having died, मा about me, रुदती भव keep weepng.
explanation: O cruel Kaikeyi of wicked conduct, you may be deprived of the kingdom. Abandoned by righteousness, you shall be weeping for me after my death.

shloka_text: किन्नु तेऽदूषयद्राजा रामो वा भृशधार्मिकः। ययोर्मृत्युर्विवासश्च त्वत्कृते तुल्यमागतौ।।2.74.3।।
transliteration: kinnu te'dūṣayadrājā rāmo vā bhṛśadhārmikaḥ| yayormṛtyurvivāsaśca tvatkṛte tulyamāgatau
translation: ययोः to both of whom, त्वत्कृते on your account, तुल्यम् similar, मृत्युः death, विवासश्च exile, आगतौ have come, राजा the king, भृशधार्मिकः highly virtuous, रामो वा or Rama, ते to you, किन्नु what possible, अदूषयत् reviled?
explanation: Death for the king and exile for Rama, similar fate for both, have befallen on your account. What possible harm, either the king or the highly virtuous Rama has done to you?

shloka_text: भ्रूणहत्यामसि प्राप्ता कुलस्यास्य विनाशनात्। कैकेयि नरकं गच्छ मा च भर्तु स्सलोकताम्।।2.74.4।।
transliteration: bhrūṇahatyāmasi prāptā kulasyāsya vināśanāt| kaikeyi narakaṃ gaccha mā ca bhartu ssalokatām
translation: अस्य कुलस्य of  this race, विनाशनात् by destruction, भ्रूणहत्याम् the sin of killing an unborn, प्राप्ता असि you have earned, कैकेयि Kaikeyi, नरकम् to hell, गच्छ go, भर्तुः to husband, सलोकताम् similar world, मा च not attain.
explanation: O Kaikeyi by destroying this race you have earned the demerit of killing an embryo and shall enter hell. You shall never attain the same state of living, in the  afterworld of your husband.

shloka_text: यत्त्वया हीदृशं पापं कृतं घोरेण कर्मणा। सर्वलोकप्रियं हित्वा ममाप्यापादितं भयम्।।2.74.5।।
transliteration: yattvayā hīdṛśaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ ghoreṇa karmaṇā| sarvalokapriyaṃ hitvā mamāpyāpāditaṃ bhayam
translation: त्वया by you, घोरेण by a horrible, कर्मणा deed, यत् what ever reason, ईदृशम् such, पापम् sin, कृतम् has been committed, (for that reason), सर्वलोकप्रियम् beloved of all worlds, हित्वा renouncing, ममापि for me too, भयम् fear, आपादितम् has overtaken me.
explanation: That by doing this horrible deed you have committed a great sin of renouncing Rama, the beloved of all worlds. Therefore I am overtaken by fear.

shloka_text: त्वत्कृते मे पिता वृत्तो रामश्चारण्यमाश्रितः। अयशो जीवलोके च त्वयाऽहं प्रतिपादितः।।2.74.6।।
transliteration: tvatkṛte me pitā vṛtto rāmaścāraṇyamāśritaḥ| ayaśo jīvaloke ca tvayā'haṃ pratipāditaḥ
translation: त्वत्कृते for your sake, मे पिता my father, वृत्तः died, रामश्च Rama also, अरण्यम् to the forest, आश्रितः  taken refuge, त्वया by you, अहम् I, जीवलोके in this world of living beings, अयशः च ignominy, प्रतिपादितः obtained.
explanation: You have caused my father's death and Rama's exile. As for me, I have obtained ignominy in this world.

shloka_text: मातृरूपे ममामित्रे नृशंसे राज्यकामुके। न तेऽह मभिभाष्योऽस्मि दुर्वृत्ते पतिघातिनि।।2.74.7।।
transliteration: mātṛrūpe mamāmitre nṛśaṃse rājyakāmuke| na te'ha mabhibhāṣyo'smi durvṛtte patighātini
translation: मम my, मातृरूपे mother in appearance, अमित्रे enemy, नृशंसे O cruel woman, राज्यकामुके O woman having lust for kingdom, दुर्वृत्ते of vicious character, पतिघातिनि murderess (of husband), अहम् I, ते to you, अभिभाष्यः नास्मि I shall not be speaking to you.
explanation: O cruel woman, O woman of vicious character you are an enemy assuming a mother's form, lustful for kingdom. You are a murderess (of your husband) and I shall never speak to you.

shloka_text: कौसल्या च सुमित्रा च याश्चान्या मम मातरः। दुःखेन महताऽविष्टास्त्वां प्राप्य कुलदूषिणीम्।।2.74.8।।
transliteration: kausalyā ca sumitrā ca yāścānyā mama mātaraḥ| duḥkhena mahatā'viṣṭāstvāṃ prāpya kuladūṣiṇīm
translation: कुलदूषिणीम् one who vitiated the race, त्वाम् you, प्राप्य having obtained, कौशल्या Kausalya, सुमित्रा च Sumitra  also, मम my, याः अन्याः all the other, मातरः mothers, महता great, दुःखेन sorrow, आविष्टाः are overwhelmed.
explanation: As you have vitiated the race, my mothers Kausalya and Sumitra are overwhelmed with great sorrow.

shloka_text: ﻿न त्वमश्वपतेः कन्या धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। राक्षसी तत्र जाताऽसि कुलप्रध्वंसिनी पितुः।।2.74.9।। यत्त्वया धार्मिको रामो नित्यं सत्यपरायणः। वनं प्रस्थापितो दुःखात्पिता च त्रिदिवं गतः।।2.74.10।।
transliteration: ﻿na tvamaśvapateḥ kanyā dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ| rākṣasī tatra jātā'si kulapradhvaṃsinī pituḥ yattvayā dhārmiko rāmo nityaṃ satyaparāyaṇaḥ| vanaṃ prasthāpito duḥkhātpitā ca tridivaṃ gataḥ
translation: ﻿ यत् since, त्वया by you, धार्मिकः the virtuous, नित्यम् constantly, सत्यपरायणः ever devoted to truth, रामः Rama, वनम् to the forest, प्रस्थापितः has been sent away, पिता च father, दुःखात् due to grief, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, गतः had gone, त्वम् you, धर्मराजस्य of the righteous king, धीमतः of the sagacious one, अश्वपतेः king Aswapati's, कन्या daughter, न not, तत्र in that race, जाता born, पितुः father's, कुलप्रध्वंसिनी destroying the race, राक्षसी असि you are a demoness.
explanation: ﻿ As you sent virtuous Rama, ever devoted to truth, into the forest, my father died out of grief (due to separation from his son). Therefore, you are not the true daughter of the righteous and sagacious king Aswapati but a demoness born there to destroy your father's race.

shloka_text: ﻿न त्वमश्वपतेः कन्या धर्मराजस्य धीमतः। राक्षसी तत्र जाताऽसि कुलप्रध्वंसिनी पितुः।।2.74.9।। यत्त्वया धार्मिको रामो नित्यं सत्यपरायणः। वनं प्रस्थापितो दुःखात्पिता च त्रिदिवं गतः।।2.74.10।।
transliteration: ﻿na tvamaśvapateḥ kanyā dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ| rākṣasī tatra jātā'si kulapradhvaṃsinī pituḥ yattvayā dhārmiko rāmo nityaṃ satyaparāyaṇaḥ| vanaṃ prasthāpito duḥkhātpitā ca tridivaṃ gataḥ
translation: ﻿ यत् since, त्वया by you, धार्मिकः the virtuous, नित्यम् constantly, सत्यपरायणः ever devoted to truth, रामः Rama, वनम् to the forest, प्रस्थापितः has been sent away, पिता च father, दुःखात् due to grief, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, गतः had gone, त्वम् you, धर्मराजस्य of the righteous king, धीमतः of the sagacious one, अश्वपतेः king Aswapati's, कन्या daughter, न not, तत्र in that race, जाता born, पितुः father's, कुलप्रध्वंसिनी destroying the race, राक्षसी असि you are a demoness.
explanation: ﻿ As you sent virtuous Rama, ever devoted to truth, into the forest, my father died out of grief (due to separation from his son). Therefore, you are not the true daughter of the righteous and sagacious king Aswapati but a demoness born there to destroy your father's race.

shloka_text: यत्प्रधानाऽसि तत्पापं मयि पित्रा विनाकृते। भ्रातृभ्यां च परित्यक्ते सर्वलोकस्य चाप्रिये।।2.74.11।।
transliteration: yatpradhānā'si tatpāpaṃ mayi pitrā vinākṛte| bhrātṛbhyāṃ ca parityakte sarvalokasya cāpriye
translation: यत्प्रधाना असि committing the sin with a sole objective, तत् that, पापम् sin, पित्रा विना separated from father, कृते made, भ्रातृभ्याम् by the brothers, परित्यक्ते abandoned, सर्वलोकस्य for the whole world, अप्रिये च not a dear one, मयि fallen on me.
explanation: The sin you have committed with a particular objective has affected me and (as a result) I am left without my father. I am abandoned by my brothers. I am hated by every one in this entire world.

shloka_text: कौसल्यां धर्मसंयुक्तां वियुक्तां पापनिश्चये। कृत्वा कं प्राप्स्यसे त्वद्य लोकं निरयगामिनि।।2.74.12।।
transliteration: kausalyāṃ dharmasaṃyuktāṃ viyuktāṃ pāpaniścaye| kṛtvā kaṃ prāpsyase tvadya lokaṃ nirayagāmini
translation: पापनिश्चये O woman of sinful convictions, निरयगामिनि O one who would attain hell, धर्मसंयुक्ताम् endowed with righteous conduct, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, वियुक्ताम् separated from her son, कृत्वा having committed, अद्य now, कं लोसकम् what afterworld, प्राप्स्यसे will attain.
explanation: O woman of sinful convictions you will go to hell. You have separated righteous Kausalya from her son. For having committed such a sin, what afterworld awaits you  (is not known)?

shloka_text: किं नावबुध्यसे क्रूरे नियतं बन्धुसंश्रयम्। ज्येष्ठं पितृसमं रामं कौसल्यायाऽत्मसम्भवम्।।2.74.13।।
transliteration: kiṃ nāvabudhyase krūre niyataṃ bandhusaṃśrayam| jyeṣṭhaṃ pitṛsamaṃ rāmaṃ kausalyāyā'tmasambhavam
translation: क्रूरे O cruel one, कौशल्यायाः Kausalya's, आत्मसम्भवम् born of her very self, रामम् Rama, नियतम् selfrestrained, बन्धुसंश्रयम् refuge for relations, ज्येष्ठम् eldest, पितृसमम् the equal of his father, किं नावबुध्यसे why do you not realise?
explanation: O cruel one why do you not realise that Rama, born of Kausalya, is the eldest son and equal to my father? He is selfrestrained and a refuge to his kith and kin.

shloka_text: अङगप्रत्यङगजः पुत्रो हृदयाच्चापि जायते। तस्मात्प्रियतमो मातुः प्रिया एव तु बान्धवाः।।2.74.14।।
transliteration: aṅagapratyaṅagajaḥ putro hṛdayāccāpi jāyate| tasmātpriyatamo mātuḥ priyā eva tu bāndhavāḥ
translation: पुत्र: son, अङ्गप्रत्यङ्गजः born from every limb big or small, हृदयाच्चापि from the heart too, जायते is born, तस्मात् therefore, मातुः for a mother, प्रियतमः most beloved one, बान्धवाः relatives, प्रिया एव तु are loving ones only.
explanation: A son born from every limb, big or small, and from the heart is the most beloved of all for his mother while the other relatives are only loving ones.

shloka_text: अन्यदा किल धर्मज्ञा सुरभि स्सुरसम्मता। वहमानौ ददर्शोर्व्यां पुत्रौ विगतचेतसौ।।2.74.15।।
transliteration: anyadā kila dharmajñā surabhi ssurasammatā| vahamānau dadarśorvyāṃ putrau vigatacetasau
translation: अन्यदा at some other time, धर्मज्ञा conversant with righteous ways, सुरसम्मता highly respected by the gods, सुरभिः Surabhi (the divine cow), उर्व्याम् on the earth, वहमानौ carrying the burden (drawing the plough), विगतचेतसौ  senses lost, पुत्रौ sons, ददर्श किल beheld, as they say.
explanation: It is said that once upon a time Surabhi, the divine cow, highly respected by the gods and conversant with righteous ways, beheld her two sons who fainted due to fatigue while carrying the burden of the ploughs.

shloka_text: तावर्धदिवसे श्रान्तौ दृष्ट्वा पुत्रौ महीतले। रुरोद पुत्रशोकेन बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा।।2.74.16।।
transliteration: tāvardhadivase śrāntau dṛṣṭvā putrau mahītale| ruroda putraśokena bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā
translation: महीतले on the earth, अर्धदिवसे at midday, श्रान्तौ tired, पुत्रौ sons, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पुत्रशोकेन by the grief for her son, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा eyes filled with tears, रुरोद wailed.
explanation: On seeing her two sons lying on earth exhausted, she wailed in distress for them with her eyes filled with tears.

shloka_text: अधस्ताद्व्रजतस्तस्याः सुरराज्ञो महात्मनः। बिन्दवः पतिता गात्रे सूक्ष्मा स्सुरभिगन्धिनः।।2.74.17।।
transliteration: adhastādvrajatastasyāḥ surarājño mahātmanaḥ| bindavaḥ patitā gātre sūkṣmā ssurabhigandhinaḥ
translation: तस्याः her (Kamadhenu's), सूक्ष्माः fine, सुरभिगन्धिनः fragrant, बिन्दवः tear drops, अधस्तात् down below, व्रजतः proceeding, महात्मनः great, सुरराज्ञः of the king of the gods, गात्रे on the body, पतिताः fell.
explanation: The fine drops of her fragnant tears trickled down the body of the great king of the gods (Indra).

shloka_text: ﻿इन्द्रोऽप्यश्रुनिपातं तं स्वगात्रे पुण्यगन्धिनम्। सुरभिं मन्यते दृष्ट्वा भूयसीं तां सुरेश्वरः।।2.74.18।।
transliteration: ﻿indro'pyaśrunipātaṃ taṃ svagātre puṇyagandhinam| surabhiṃ manyate dṛṣṭvā bhūyasīṃ tāṃ sureśvaraḥ
translation: ﻿ सुरेश्वरः lord of the gods, इन्द्रोऽपि Indra, स्वगात्रे on his body, पुण्यगन्धिनम् of holy fragrance, तम् that, अश्रुपातम् flow of tears, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, ताम् her, भूयसीम् venerated, सुरभिम् as Kamadhenu, मन्यते thought
explanation: ﻿ When Indra, lord of the gods, saw those tears of holy fragrance fallen on his body he understood that the tears were shed by the venerated Kamadhenu.

shloka_text: निरीक्षमाण श्शक्रस्तां ददर्श सुरभिं स्थिताम्। आकाशे विष्ठितां दीनां रुदन्तीं भृशदुःखिताम्।।2.74.19।।
transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇa śśakrastāṃ dadarśa surabhiṃ sthitām| ākāśe viṣṭhitāṃ dīnāṃ rudantīṃ bhṛśaduḥkhitām
translation: शक्रः Indra, आकाशे in the sky, निरीक्षमाणः looking up, स्थिताम् stationed, विष्ठिताम् distressed, दीनाम् miserable, रुदन्तीम् wailing, भृशदुःखिताम् in intense pain, तां सुरभिम् to that Surabhi,  ददर्श beheld.
explanation: While looking around Indra beheld Kamadhenu in intense pain stationed in the sky,   looking distressed and miserable, and wailing.

shloka_text: तां दृष्ट्वा शोकसन्तप्तां वज्रपाणिर्यशस्विनीम्। इन्द्रः प्राञ्जलिरुद्विग्न स्सुरराजोऽब्रवीद्वचः।।2.74.20।।
transliteration: tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śokasantaptāṃ vajrapāṇiryaśasvinīm| indraḥ prāñjalirudvigna ssurarājo'bravīdvacaḥ
translation: वज्रपाणिः wielder of thunderbolt, सुरराजः king of the gods, इन्द्रः Indra, शोकसन्तप्ताम्  consumed with grief, यशस्विनीम् renowned, ताम् that kamadhenu, दृष्ट्वा having seen, उद्विग्नः alarmed, प्राञ्जलिः with palms joined in reverence, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The king of the gods, Indra, wielder of thunderbolt, saw the renowned Kamadhenu consumed with grief. Alarmed, he said to her with palms joined in reverence:

shloka_text: भयं कच्छिन्न चास्मासु कुतश्चिद्विद्यते महत्। कुतोनिमत्तश्शोकस्ते ब्रूहि सर्वहितैषिणि।।2.74.21।।
transliteration: bhayaṃ kacchinna cāsmāsu kutaścidvidyate mahat| kutonimattaśśokaste brūhi sarvahitaiṣiṇi
translation: सर्वहितैषिणि O wellwisher of all, अस्मासु for us, कुतश्चित् from any quarter, महत् great, भयम् fear, न विद्यते कच्छित् does not exist, ते your, शोकः sorrow, कुतोनिमित्तः for what  reason, ब्रूहि  speak.
explanation: 'O holy cow fear not. You wish the welfare of all, Has any great calamity befallen us from any quarter? I hope not. What is the reason for your sorrow? Tell me'.

shloka_text: ﻿एवमुक्ता तु सुरभि स्सुरराजेन धीमता। प्रत्युवाच ततो धीरा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदा।।2.74.22।।
transliteration: ﻿evamuktā tu surabhi ssurarājena dhīmatā| pratyuvāca tato dhīrā vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradā
translation: ﻿ धीमता by the sagacious, सुरराजेन by Indra, king of the gods, एवम् this way, उक्ता having been uttered, धीरा calm, सुरभिः Surabhi, ततः then, वाक्य विशारदा proficient in speech, वाक्यम् these words, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: ﻿ On hearing the sagacious Indra, king of the gods, Kamadhenu, proficient in speech, calmly replied:

shloka_text: शान्तं पापं न वः किञ्चित्कुतश्चिदमराधिपः। अहं मग्नौ तु शोचामि स्वपुत्रौ विषमे स्थितौ।।2.74.23।। एतौ दृष्ट्वा कृशौ दीनौ सूर्यरश्मिप्रतापितौ। बाध्यमानौ बलीवर्धौ कर्षकेण सुराधिप।।2.74.24।।
transliteration: śāntaṃ pāpaṃ na vaḥ kiñcitkutaścidamarādhipaḥ| ahaṃ magnau tu śocāmi svaputrau viṣame sthitau etau dṛṣṭvā kṛśau dīnau sūryaraśmipratāpitau| bādhyamānau balīvardhau karṣakeṇa surādhipa
translation: अमराधिपः O lord of the immortals (Indra), पापम् शान्तम् god forbid, वः for you, कुतश्चित् from any quarter, किञ्चित् any calamity, न not, सुराधिप O lord of the gods, अहम् I, विषमे in trouble, स्थितौ entangled, सूर्यरश्मिप्रतापितौ scorched by the rays of the Sun, कृशौ emaciated, कर्षकेण by a ploughman, बाध्यमानौ beaten, मग्नौ immersed in grief, स्वपुत्रौ my own sons, एतौ these, बलीवर्धौ pair of bulls, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दीनौ miserable, शोचामि weeping.
explanation: 'God forbid, O Indra, lord of the Immortals no calamity has befallen you from any quarter. Only I am in trouble. I am weeping for these pair of bulls, my own sons who are in difficulty. When I see them scorched by the rays of the Sun, miserable, emaciated and weeping, beaten by a ploughman, I am immersed in grief'.

shloka_text: शान्तं पापं न वः किञ्चित्कुतश्चिदमराधिपः। अहं मग्नौ तु शोचामि स्वपुत्रौ विषमे स्थितौ।।2.74.23।। एतौ दृष्ट्वा कृशौ दीनौ सूर्यरश्मिप्रतापितौ। बाध्यमानौ बलीवर्धौ कर्षकेण सुराधिप।।2.74.24।।
transliteration: śāntaṃ pāpaṃ na vaḥ kiñcitkutaścidamarādhipaḥ| ahaṃ magnau tu śocāmi svaputrau viṣame sthitau etau dṛṣṭvā kṛśau dīnau sūryaraśmipratāpitau| bādhyamānau balīvardhau karṣakeṇa surādhipa
translation: अमराधिपः O lord of the immortals (Indra), पापम् शान्तम् god forbid, वः for you, कुतश्चित् from any quarter, किञ्चित् any calamity, न not, सुराधिप O lord of the gods, अहम् I, विषमे in trouble, स्थितौ entangled, सूर्यरश्मिप्रतापितौ scorched by the rays of the Sun, कृशौ emaciated, कर्षकेण by a ploughman, बाध्यमानौ beaten, मग्नौ immersed in grief, स्वपुत्रौ my own sons, एतौ these, बलीवर्धौ pair of bulls, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दीनौ miserable, शोचामि weeping.
explanation: 'God forbid, O Indra, lord of the Immortals no calamity has befallen you from any quarter. Only I am in trouble. I am weeping for these pair of bulls, my own sons who are in difficulty. When I see them scorched by the rays of the Sun, miserable, emaciated and weeping, beaten by a ploughman, I am immersed in grief'.

shloka_text: ममकायात्प्रसूतौ हि दुःखितौ भारपीडितौ। यौ दृष्ट्वा परितप्येऽहं नास्ति पुत्रसमः प्रियः।।2.74.25।।
transliteration: mamakāyātprasūtau hi duḥkhitau bhārapīḍitau| yau dṛṣṭvā paritapye'haṃ nāsti putrasamaḥ priyaḥ
translation: अहम् I, भारपीडितौ oppressed by the burden, दुःखितौ anguished, यौ them both, दृष्ट्वा  having seen, परितप्ये excessively grieving, मम my, कायात् from the body, प्रसूतौ हि were born, पुत्रसमः equal to a son, प्रियः a beloved, नास्ति no one is there.
explanation: 'These bulls were born from my body and they are oppressed by the burden. Having seen their anguish, I am extremely grieved. There is none so dear as a son'.

shloka_text: यस्याः पुत्रसहस्रैस्तु कृत्स्नं व्याप्तमिदं जगत्। तां दृष्ट्वा रुदतीं शक्रो न सुतान्मन्यते परम्।।2.74.26।।
transliteration: yasyāḥ putrasahasraistu kṛtsnaṃ vyāptamidaṃ jagat| tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rudatīṃ śakro na sutānmanyate param
translation: यस्याः whose, पुत्रसहस्रैः by a thousand sons, इदं जगत् this world, व्याप्तम् are spread over, ताम् to her (Kamadhenu), रुदतीम् weeping, दृष्ट्वा having seen, शक्रः Indra, सुतात् more than a son, परम् great one, न not, मन्यते considers.
explanation: The wishfulfilling cow (Kamadhenu) had innumerable sons spread all over the world. When Indra saw that Kamadhenu too was weeping for her sons, he concluded 'there is no one greater than a son'.

shloka_text: ﻿सदाऽप्रतिमवृत्तायाः लोकधारणकाम्यया। श्रीमत्या गुणनित्याया स्स्वभावपरिचेष्टया।।2.74.27।। यस्याः पुत्रसहस्राणि साऽपि शोचति कामधुक्। किं पुनर्या विना रामं कौसल्या वर्तयिष्यति।।2.74.28।।
transliteration: ﻿sadā'pratimavṛttāyāḥ lokadhāraṇakāmyayā| śrīmatyā guṇanityāyā ssvabhāvapariceṣṭayā yasyāḥ putrasahasrāṇi sā'pi śocati kāmadhuk| kiṃ punaryā vinā rāmaṃ kausalyā vartayiṣyati
translation: ﻿ लोकधारणकाम्यया with a desire to nourish the worlds, सदा always, अप्रतिमवृत्तायाः of unequalled conduct, श्रीमत्याः endowed with prosperity, स्वभावपरिचेष्टया in accordance with her nature, गुणनित्यायाः by her virtues, यस्याः such ones, पुत्रसहस्राणि a thousand sons, सा that, कामधुक् अपि Kamadhenu also, शोचति is weeping, या कौशल्या that Kausalya, रामं विना bereft of Rama, वर्तयिष्यति will she be her normal self again?, किं पुनः why again.
explanation: ﻿ Wishing always to nourish the worlds Kamadhenu conducts herself with an unequalled character. In accordance with her nature, she has imbibed in herself eminent virtues. She is endowed with all prosperity. In spite of her thousand sons, she is weeping thus for her two bulls, what can one say of Kausalya separated from her only son Will she be her normal self again?'

shloka_text: ﻿सदाऽप्रतिमवृत्तायाः लोकधारणकाम्यया। श्रीमत्या गुणनित्याया स्स्वभावपरिचेष्टया।।2.74.27।। यस्याः पुत्रसहस्राणि साऽपि शोचति कामधुक्। किं पुनर्या विना रामं कौसल्या वर्तयिष्यति।।2.74.28।।
transliteration: ﻿sadā'pratimavṛttāyāḥ lokadhāraṇakāmyayā| śrīmatyā guṇanityāyā ssvabhāvapariceṣṭayā yasyāḥ putrasahasrāṇi sā'pi śocati kāmadhuk| kiṃ punaryā vinā rāmaṃ kausalyā vartayiṣyati
translation: ﻿ लोकधारणकाम्यया with a desire to nourish the worlds, सदा always, अप्रतिमवृत्तायाः of unequalled conduct, श्रीमत्याः endowed with prosperity, स्वभावपरिचेष्टया in accordance with her nature, गुणनित्यायाः by her virtues, यस्याः such ones, पुत्रसहस्राणि a thousand sons, सा that, कामधुक् अपि Kamadhenu also, शोचति is weeping, या कौशल्या that Kausalya, रामं विना bereft of Rama, वर्तयिष्यति will she be her normal self again?, किं पुनः why again.
explanation: ﻿ Wishing always to nourish the worlds Kamadhenu conducts herself with an unequalled character. In accordance with her nature, she has imbibed in herself eminent virtues. She is endowed with all prosperity. In spite of her thousand sons, she is weeping thus for her two bulls, what can one say of Kausalya separated from her only son Will she be her normal self again?'

shloka_text: एकपुत्रा च साध्वी च विवत्सेयं त्वया कृता। तस्मात्त्वं सततं दुःखं प्रेत्य चेह च लप्स्यसे।।2.74.29।।
transliteration: ekaputrā ca sādhvī ca vivatseyaṃ tvayā kṛtā| tasmāttvaṃ satataṃ duḥkhaṃ pretya ceha ca lapsyase
translation: एकपुत्रा च blessed with an only son, साध्वी च pious woman, इयम् this lady, त्वया by you, विवत्सा childless, कृता has been rendered, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, प्रेत्य च even after death, इह च in this world also, सततम् always, दुःखम् grief, लप्स्यसे you shall experience.
explanation: This pious lady is blessed with only one son and (now) has been rendered childless by you. Therefore, you shall experience grief in this world and hereafter.

shloka_text: अहं ह्यपचितिं भ्रातुः पितुश्च सकलामिमाम्। वर्धनं यशसश्चापि करिष्यामि न संशयः।।2.74.30।।
transliteration: ahaṃ hyapacitiṃ bhrātuḥ pituśca sakalāmimām| vardhanaṃ yaśasaścāpi kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
translation: अहम् I, भ्रातुः for my brother, पितुश्च for father, इमाम् this, सकलाम् complete, अपचितिम्   atonement for improper conduct, यशसः of fame, वर्धनम् enhancement, करिष्यामि will do, संशयः doubt, न not.
explanation: As for me, I shall do whatever is necessary for the atonement of the improper conduct shown towards my father and brother and for enhancement of my fame. There is no doubt  about it.

shloka_text: ﻿अनाययित्वा तनयं कौसल्याया महाबलम्। स्वयमेव प्रवेक्ष्यामि वनं मुनिनिषेवितम्।।2.74.31।।
transliteration: ﻿anāyayitvā tanayaṃ kausalyāyā mahābalam| svayameva pravekṣyāmi vanaṃ muniniṣevitam
translation: ﻿ महाबलम् highly powerful, कौशल्यायाः तनयम् Kausalya's son, अनाययित्वा if I do not bring back, स्वयमेव myself, मुनिनिषेवितम् frequented by the ascetics, वनम् lonely forest, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I shall enter.
explanation: ﻿ If I fail to bring back the mighty son of Kausalya, I shall enter the forest frequented by ascetics.

shloka_text: न ह्यहं पापसङ्कल्पे पापे पापं त्वया कृतम्। शक्तो धारयितुं पौरैरश्रुकण्ठै र्निरीक्षितः।।2.74.32।।
transliteration: na hyahaṃ pāpasaṅkalpe pāpe pāpaṃ tvayā kṛtam| śakto dhārayituṃ paurairaśrukaṇṭhai rnirīkṣitaḥ
translation: पापे O vicious one, पापसङ्कल्पे O evilintentioned one, अहम् I, अश्रुकण्ठैः by those whose throats are choked with tears, पौरैः by the citizens (of Ayodhya), निरीक्षितः am watched, त्वया by you, कृतम् has been committed, पापम् sin, धारयितुम् to endure, न शक्तः हि I am not capable.
explanation: O vicious one, O evilintentioned one being watched by the citizens with their throats choked with tears of grief, I cannot endure the burden of the sin committed by you.

shloka_text: सा त्वमग्निं प्रविश वा स्वयं वा दण्डकान्विश। रज्जुं बधान वा कण्ठे न हि तेऽन्यत्परायणम्।।2.74.33।।
transliteration: sā tvamagniṃ praviśa vā svayaṃ vā daṇḍakānviśa| rajjuṃ badhāna vā kaṇṭhe na hi te'nyatparāyaṇam
translation: सा त्वम् such a person like you, अग्निं वा either the fire, प्रविश enter, दण्डकान्वा or Dandaka forest, स्वयम् yourself, विश enter वा or, कण्ठे round the throat, रज्जुम् rope, बधान fasten, ते to you, अन्यत् any other, परायणम् recourse, न हि is not there.
explanation: Jump into the fire or go to Dandaka forest or hang yourself. There is no other recourse for you.

shloka_text: अहमप्यवनीं प्राप्ते रामे सत्यपराक्रमे। कृतकृत्यो भविष्यामि विप्रवासितकल्मषः।।2.74.34।।
transliteration: ahamapyavanīṃ prāpte rāme satyaparākrame| kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi vipravāsitakalmaṣaḥ
translation: सत्यपराक्रमे having truth as his prowess, रामे Rama, अवनीम् this earth (kingdom), प्राप्ते will obtain, अहमपि I also, विप्रवासितकल्मषः free from all blemishes, कृतकृत्यः shall have my desire  accomplished, भविष्यामि shall become.
explanation: When Rama who has truth as his prowess accepts the kingdom, I shall have accomplished my purpose at last and I shall be free from all blemishes.

shloka_text: इति नाग इवारण्ये तोमराङ्कुशचोदितः। पपात भुवि सङ्कृद्धो निश्श्वसन्निव पन्नगः।।2.74.35।।
transliteration: iti nāga ivāraṇye tomarāṅkuśacoditaḥ| papāta bhuvi saṅkṛddho niśśvasanniva pannagaḥ
translation: इति in this way, अरण्ये in the forest, तोमराङ्कुशचोदितः driven by prods and goads (sharp instruments), नागः इव like an elephant, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, पन्नगः इव like a serpent, निःश्वसन् hissing, भुवि on the ground, पपात fell down.
explanation: In this way like an elephant driven by prods and goads in the forest, highly enraged Bharata hissing like a serpent dropped down on the ground.

shloka_text: संरक्तनेत्र श्शिथिलाम्भरस्तदा विधूतसर्वाभरणः परन्तपः। बभूव भूमौ पतितो नृपात्मजश्शचीपतेः केतुरिवोत्सवक्षये।।2.74.36।।
transliteration: saṃraktanetra śśithilāmbharastadā vidhūtasarvābharaṇaḥ parantapaḥ| babhūva bhūmau patito nṛpātmajaśśacīpateḥ keturivotsavakṣaye
translation: तदा then, संरक्तनेत्रः with bloodshot eyes, शिथिलाम्भरः with his raiment in disarray, विधूतसर्वाभरणः with his ornaments tossed about, भूमौ on the ground, पतितः fallen, परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, नृपात्मजः king's son, उत्सवक्षये at the close of the festival, शचीपतेः of the husband of Sachi (Indra's), केतुरिव बभूव like a banner remained.
explanation: Prince Bharata, the scorcher of enemies, with bloodshot eyes, raiment in disarray, ornaments tossed about lay fallen on the ground like the banner of Indra (husband of Sachi) at the close of the festival of flaghoisting. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfourth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: दीर्घकालात्समुत्थाय संज्ञां लब्ध्वा च वीर्यवान्। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां दीनामुद्वीक्ष्य मातरम्।।2.75.1।। सोऽमात्यमध्ये भरतो जननीमभ्यकुत्सयत्।
transliteration: dīrghakālātsamutthāya saṃjñāṃ labdhvā ca vīryavān| netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṃ dīnāmudvīkṣya mātaram so'mātyamadhye bharato jananīmabhyakutsayat|
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, सः भरतः that Bharata, दीर्घकालात् after a long time, समुत्थाय risen up, संज्ञाम् senses, लब्ध्वा च having regained, अश्रुपूर्णाभ्याम् filled with tears, नेत्राभ्याम् with eyes, दीनाम् unfortunate, मातरम् mother, उद्वीक्ष्य having looked up, अमात्यमध्ये in the midst of counsellors, जननीम् mother, अभ्यकुत्सयत् condemned.
explanation: On regaining his senses after a long time, the valiant Bharata looked at his unfortunate mother whose eyes were filled with tears, and condemned her amidst the counsellors.
comments: Bharata and Satrughna meet griefstricken Kausalya -- Kausalya reproaches Bharata harshly -- Bharata appeases Kausalya and curses himself -- Kausalya gets convinced of Bharata's conviction.

shloka_text: राज्यं न कामये जातु मन्त्रये नापि मातरम्।।2.75.2।। अभिषेकं न जानामि योऽभूद्राज्ञा समीक्षितः। विप्रकृष्टेह्यहं देशे शत्रुघ्नसहितोऽवसम्।।2.75.3।।
transliteration: rājyaṃ na kāmaye jātu mantraye nāpi mātaram abhiṣekaṃ na jānāmi yo'bhūdrājñā samīkṣitaḥ| viprakṛṣṭehyahaṃ deśe śatrughnasahito'vasam
translation: जातु at any time, राज्यम् kingdom, न कामये I do not wish, मातरम् अपि even (with) mother, न मन्त्रये consulted, यः the consecration, राज्ञा by king, समीक्षितः अभूत् has been supervised, अभिषेकम् consecration, न जानामि am not aware, अहम् I, शत्रुघ्नसहितः with Satrughna, विप्रकृष्टे in a distant, देशे country, अवसम् हि stayed.
explanation: Neither did I ever desire the kingdom nor did I ever consult my mother in this regard and I am not even aware of the consecration that was planned by the king for I was away in a distant country with Satrughna.

shloka_text: राज्यं न कामये जातु मन्त्रये नापि मातरम्।।2.75.2।। अभिषेकं न जानामि योऽभूद्राज्ञा समीक्षितः। विप्रकृष्टेह्यहं देशे शत्रुघ्नसहितोऽवसम्।।2.75.3।।
transliteration: rājyaṃ na kāmaye jātu mantraye nāpi mātaram abhiṣekaṃ na jānāmi yo'bhūdrājñā samīkṣitaḥ| viprakṛṣṭehyahaṃ deśe śatrughnasahito'vasam
translation: जातु at any time, राज्यम् kingdom, न कामये I do not wish, मातरम् अपि even (with) mother, न मन्त्रये consulted, यः the consecration, राज्ञा by king, समीक्षितः अभूत् has been supervised, अभिषेकम् consecration, न जानामि am not aware, अहम् I, शत्रुघ्नसहितः with Satrughna, विप्रकृष्टे in a distant, देशे country, अवसम् हि stayed.
explanation: Neither did I ever desire the kingdom nor did I ever consult my mother in this regard and I am not even aware of the consecration that was planned by the king for I was away in a distant country with Satrughna.

shloka_text: वनवासं न जानामि रामस्याहं महात्मनः। विवासनं वा सौमित्रे स्सीतायाश्च यथाऽभवत्।।2.75.4।।
transliteration: vanavāsaṃ na jānāmi rāmasyāhaṃ mahātmanaḥ| vivāsanaṃ vā saumitre ssītāyāśca yathā'bhavat
translation: अहम् I, महात्मनः of great, रामस्य Rama's, वनवासम् banishment, न जानामि do not know, सौमित्रेः Lakshmana's, सीतायाश्च Sita's, विवासनम् exile, यथा अभवत् how it happened.
explanation: I knew nothing of the banishment of great Rama nor did I know how Lakshmana or Sita had gone on exile.

shloka_text: तथैव क्रोशतस्तस्य भरतस्य महात्मनः। कौसल्या शब्दमाज्ञाय सुमित्रामिदमब्रवीत्।।2.75.5।।
transliteration: tathaiva krośatastasya bharatasya mahātmanaḥ| kausalyā śabdamājñāya sumitrāmidamabravīt
translation: तथैव in that way, क्रोशतः wailing, महात्मनः of the magnanimous, भरतस्य Bharata's, शब्दम् sound, आज्ञाय having recognised, कौशल्या Kausalya, सुमित्राम् addressing Sumitra, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: As magnanimous Bharata was wailing, Kausalya recognised his voice and said to Sumitra:

shloka_text: आगतः क्रूरकार्यायाः कैकेय्या भरतस्सुतः। तमहं द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भरतं दीर्घदर्शिनम्।।2.75.6।।
transliteration: āgataḥ krūrakāryāyāḥ kaikeyyā bharatassutaḥ| tamahaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi bharataṃ dīrghadarśinam
translation: क्रूरकार्यायाः of a woman of cruel deeds, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, सुतः son, भरतः Bharata, आगतः has come, दीर्घदर्शिनम् farsighted, तं भरतम् that Bharata, अहम् I, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I am wishing
explanation: Bharata, the farsighted son of Kaikeyi of cruel deeds has come and I wish to see him.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा सुमित्रां सा विवर्णा मलिना कृशा। प्रतस्थे भरतो यत्र वेपमाना विचेतना।।2.75.7।।
transliteration: evamuktvā sumitrāṃ sā vivarṇā malinā kṛśā| pratasthe bharato yatra vepamānā vicetanā
translation: विवर्णा turned pallid, मलिना sullied, कृशा emaciated, सा that Kausalya, सुमित्राम् to Sumitra, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having uttered, वेपमाना trembling, विचेतना almost lifeless, भरतः Bharata, यत्र wherever, प्रतस्थे set out.
explanation: Having said so to Sumitra, Kausalya trembling and almost lifeless, emaciated, sullied and turned pallid set out for the place where Bharat was.

shloka_text: स तु रामानुजश्चापि शत्रुघ्नसहितस्तदा। प्रतस्थे भरतो यत्र कौसल्याया निवेशनम्।।2.75.8।।
transliteration: sa tu rāmānujaścāpi śatrughnasahitastadā| pratasthe bharato yatra kausalyāyā niveśanam
translation: तदा then, रामानुजः younger brother of Rama, सः भरतः तु Bharata on his part, शत्रुघ्नसहितः accompanied by Satrughna, कौशल्यायाः to Kausalya's, निवेशनम् residence, यत्र wherever, प्रतस्थे proceeded.
explanation: But at the same time Bharata, the younger brother of Rama accompanied by Satrughna  proceeded to the place where Kausalya resided.

shloka_text: तत श्शत्रुघ्नभरतौ कौसल्यां प्रेक्ष्य दुःखितौ। पर्यष्वजेतां दुःखार्तां पतितां नष्टचेतसाम्।।2.75.9।। रुदन्तौ रुदतीं दुःखात्समेत्यार्यां मनस्स्विनीम्।
transliteration: tata śśatrughnabharatau kausalyāṃ prekṣya duḥkhitau| paryaṣvajetāṃ duḥkhārtāṃ patitāṃ naṣṭacetasām rudantau rudatīṃ duḥkhātsametyāryāṃ manassvinīm|
translation: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नभरतौ Satrughna and Bharata, दुःखार्ताम् griefstricken, नष्टचेतसाम् semi conscious, रुदतीम् weeping, आर्याम् venerable, मनस्स्विनीम् noblehearted, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, दुःखितौ overcome with sorrow, रुदन्तौ agonised, दुःखात् with great sorrow, समेत्य having approached, पर्यष्वजेताम् hugged.
explanation: Then agonised Bharata and Satrughna, beholding that venerable, noblehearted, griefstricken, weeping Kausalya who was  almost semiconscious overcome with grief, approached her with great sorrow and hugged her.

shloka_text: भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं कौसल्या भृशदुःखिता।।2.75.10।। इदं ते राज्यकामस्य राज्यं प्राप्तमकण्टकम्। संप्राप्तं बत कैकेय्या शशीघ्रं क्रूरेण कर्मणा।।2.75.11।।
transliteration: bharataṃ pratyuvācedaṃ kausalyā bhṛśaduḥkhitā idaṃ te rājyakāmasya rājyaṃ prāptamakaṇṭakam| saṃprāptaṃ bata kaikeyyā śaśīghraṃ krūreṇa karmaṇā
translation: भृशदुःखिता deeply afflicted, कौशल्या Kausalya, भरतं प्रति looking at Bharata, इदम् these words, उवाच said, राज्यकामस्य of one desirous of the kingdom, ते to you, इदम् this, अकण्टकम् without obstacles, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्तम् has been acquired, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, क्रूरेण by crooked, कर्मणा with act, शीघ्रम् quickly, सम्प्राप्तम् secured, बत alas.
explanation: Looking at Bharata, the deeply afflicted Kausalya said, The kingdom which you had desired has been acquired without any obstacle. Alas Kaikeyi had quickly secured it for you  through her crooked act.

shloka_text: भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं कौसल्या भृशदुःखिता।।2.75.10।। इदं ते राज्यकामस्य राज्यं प्राप्तमकण्टकम्। संप्राप्तं बत कैकेय्या शशीघ्रं क्रूरेण कर्मणा।।2.75.11।।
transliteration: bharataṃ pratyuvācedaṃ kausalyā bhṛśaduḥkhitā idaṃ te rājyakāmasya rājyaṃ prāptamakaṇṭakam| saṃprāptaṃ bata kaikeyyā śaśīghraṃ krūreṇa karmaṇā
translation: भृशदुःखिता deeply afflicted, कौशल्या Kausalya, भरतं प्रति looking at Bharata, इदम् these words, उवाच said, राज्यकामस्य of one desirous of the kingdom, ते to you, इदम् this, अकण्टकम् without obstacles, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्तम् has been acquired, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi's, क्रूरेण by crooked, कर्मणा with act, शीघ्रम् quickly, सम्प्राप्तम् secured, बत alas.
explanation: Looking at Bharata, the deeply afflicted Kausalya said, The kingdom which you had desired has been acquired without any obstacle. Alas Kaikeyi had quickly secured it for you  through her crooked act.

shloka_text: प्रस्थाप्य चीरवसनं पुत्रं मे वनवासिनम्। कैकेयी कं गुणं तत्र पश्यति क्रूरदर्शिनी।।2.75.12।।
transliteration: prasthāpya cīravasanaṃ putraṃ me vanavāsinam| kaikeyī kaṃ guṇaṃ tatra paśyati krūradarśinī
translation: क्रूरदर्शिनी one of cruel thoughts, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, मे my, पुत्रम् son, चीरवसनम् clad in bark robes, वनवासिनम् a forestdweller, प्रस्थाप्य having sent, तत्र there, कम् what, गुणम्  advantage, पश्यति sees?
explanation: What advantage did cruel Kaikeyi visualize in sending away my son to dwell in the forest  wearing robes of bark?

shloka_text: क्षिप्रं मामपि कैकेयी प्रस्थापयितुमर्हति। हिरण्यनाभो यत्रास्ते सुतो मे सुमहायशाः।।2.75.13।।
transliteration: kṣipraṃ māmapi kaikeyī prasthāpayitumarhati| hiraṇyanābho yatrāste suto me sumahāyaśāḥ
translation: सुमहायशाः illustrious, हिरण्यनाभः goldennavalled one, मे सुतः my son, यत्र whereever, आस्ते stays, मामपि me also, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, क्षिप्रम् without delay, प्रस्थापयितुम् to send me, अर्हति behoves her.
explanation: Kaikeyi should send me also without any delay to that place where my illustrious Rama with golden navel dwells.

shloka_text: अथवा स्वयमेवाहं सुमित्रानुचरा सुखम्। अग्निहोत्रं पुरस्कृत्य प्रस्थास्ये यत्र राघवः।।2.75.14।।
transliteration: athavā svayamevāhaṃ sumitrānucarā sukham| agnihotraṃ puraskṛtya prasthāsye yatra rāghavaḥ
translation: अथवा or else, अहम् I, स्वयमेव on my own, सुमित्रानुचरा with Sumitra as companion,  अग्निहोत्रम् with sacred fire, पुरस्कृत्य holding in front of me, राघवः Rama, यत्र where, सुखम् happily, प्रस्थास्ये shall set out.
explanation: Or else I, accompanied by Sumitra, shall go happily on my own holding the sacred fire in front to that place where Rama dwells.

shloka_text: कामं वा स्वयमेवाद्य तत्र मां नेतुमर्हसि। यत्रासौ पुरुषव्याघ्रः पुत्रो मे तप्यते तपः।।2.75.15।।
transliteration: kāmaṃ vā svayamevādya tatra māṃ netumarhasi| yatrāsau puruṣavyāghraḥ putro me tapyate tapaḥ
translation: वा or, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men, मे पुत्रो my son, असौ this Rama, यत्र where, तपः the austerities, तप्यते performing, तत्र there, स्वयमेव yourself, अद्य now, माम् me, कामम् certainly indeed, नेतुम् to take, अर्हसि behoves you.
explanation: Or, you should now take me personally to that place where, my son Rama, the best among men, is performing austerities.

shloka_text: इदं हि तव विस्तीर्णं धनधान्यसमाचितम्। हस्त्वश्वरथसम्पूर्णं राज्यं निर्यातितं तया।।2.75.16।।
transliteration: idaṃ hi tava vistīrṇaṃ dhanadhānyasamācitam| hastvaśvarathasampūrṇaṃ rājyaṃ niryātitaṃ tayā
translation: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पूर्णम् abounding in elephants, horses and chariots, धनधान्यसमाचितम् with abundace of wealth and grain, विस्तीर्णम् vast, इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, तया by her, तव to you, निर्यातितं हि has been delivered.
explanation: This vast kingdom, with all its abundance of wealth and grain, elephants, horses and chariots has been delivered to you by her.

shloka_text: इत्यादिबहुभिर्वाक्यैः क्रूरैः सम्भर्त्सितोऽनघः। विव्यथे भरतस्तीव्रं व्रणे तुद्येव सूचिना।।2.75.17।।
transliteration: ityādibahubhirvākyaiḥ krūraiḥ sambhartsito'naghaḥ| vivyathe bharatastīvraṃ vraṇe tudyeva sūcinā
translation: इत्यादि like this, बहुभिः by many, क्रूरैः harsh, वाक्यैः with words, सूचिना with needle, व्रणे in the wound, तुद्येव as if by piercing, सम्भर्त्सितः reproached, अनघः sinless, भरतः Bharata, तीव्रम् intensely, विव्यथे was afflicted.
explanation: Thus reproached by many a harsh word, like needle pricking a wound, the sinless Bharata was intensely pained.

shloka_text: पपात चरणौ तस्यास्तदा सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः। विलप्य बहुधाऽसंज्ञो लब्धसंज्ञस्ततः स्थितः।।2.75.18।।
transliteration: papāta caraṇau tasyāstadā sambhrāntacetanaḥ| vilapya bahudhā'saṃjño labdhasaṃjñastataḥ sthitaḥ
translation: तदा then, सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः with senses reeling, तस्याः her, चरणौ feet, पपात fell, बहुधा repeatedly, विलप्य lamenting, असंज्ञः unconscious, ततः then, लब्धसंज्ञः on regaining the senses, स्थितः stood.
explanation: (Having heard these words), his senses reeling, he became unconscious, lamented profusaly and fell at her feet. And on regaining his senses, he stood motionless.

shloka_text: एवं विलपमानां तां भरतः प्राञ्जलिस्तदा। कौसल्यां प्रत्युवाचेदं शोकैर्बहुभिरावृताम्।।2.75.19।।
transliteration: evaṃ vilapamānāṃ tāṃ bharataḥ prāñjalistadā| kausalyāṃ pratyuvācedaṃ śokairbahubhirāvṛtām
translation: तदा then, भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलिः his palms joined in reverence, एवम् in that manner, विलपमानाम् lamenting, बहुभिः intense, शोकैः with sorrow, आवृताम् overwhelmed with, तां कौशल्याम् that Kausalya, इदम् these words, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: As Kausalya was lamenting in this manner, overwhelmed with deep grief, Bharata, his palms joined in reverence, replied her in these words:

shloka_text: आर्ये कस्मादजानन्तं गर्हसे मामकिल्बिषम्। विपुलां च मम प्रीतिं स्थिरां जानासि राघवे।।2.75.20।।
transliteration: ārye kasmādajānantaṃ garhase māmakilbiṣam| vipulāṃ ca mama prītiṃ sthirāṃ jānāsi rāghave
translation: आर्ये O noble lady, आजानन्तम् unaware, अकिल्बिषम् guiltless, माम् me, कस्मात् for what reason, गर्हसे upbraiding, राघवे in Rama, मम my, विपुलाम् profound, स्थिराम् steadfast, प्रीतिम् affection, जानासि you know.
explanation: O noble lady unaware (of what had happened), I am guiltless. Why do you upbraid me? You know well my profound, steadfast affection for Raghava (Rama).

shloka_text: कृता शास्त्रानुगा बुद्धिर्माभूत्तस्य कदाचन। सत्यसन्ध स्सतां श्रेष्ठो यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.21।।
transliteration: kṛtā śāstrānugā buddhirmābhūttasya kadācana| satyasandha ssatāṃ śreṣṭho yasyā'ryo'numate gataḥ
translation: सत्यसन्धः bound to truth, सताम् श्रेष्ठः best among virtuous men, आर्यः noble (Rama), यस्य whose अनुमते with sanction, गतः banished, तस्य his, बुद्धिः thought, कदाचन at any time, शास्त्रानुगा adhered to the scriptures, कृता steadfast, मा भूत् let it not happen.
explanation: Did not the one who counselled the banishment of my noble brother who is steadfast and bound by truth and virtue, ever adhered to scriptures? (or) My noble brother (Rama), the best among the virtuous, bound to truth, is banished. Let not such thought occur at any time to one who steadfastly adheres to scriptures

shloka_text: प्रेष्यं पापीयसां यातु सूर्यञ्च प्रतिमेहतु। हन्तु पादेन गां सुप्तां यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.22।।
transliteration: preṣyaṃ pāpīyasāṃ yātu sūryañca pratimehatu| hantu pādena gāṃ suptāṃ yasyā'ryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः noble one (Rama), यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, पापीयसाम् the most sinful of men, प्रेष्यम् servitude, यातु shall obtain, सूर्यं च प्रति facing the Sun, मेहतु pass urine, सुप्ताम् sleeping, गाम् cow, पादेन by foot, हन्तु kick.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, Rama be cursed with the sin of undergoing servitude in the hands of most sinful of men, the sin of passing urine facing the Sun and of kicking a sleeping cow.

shloka_text: कारयित्वा महत्कर्म भर्ता भृत्यमनर्थकम्। अधर्मो योऽस्य सोऽस्यास्तु यस्याऽर्योऽनुमतेगतः।।2.75.23।।
transliteration: kārayitvā mahatkarma bhartā bhṛtyamanarthakam| adharmo yo'sya so'syāstu yasyā'ryo'numategataḥ
translation: आर्यः noble one, यस्य whose, अनुमते counsel, गतः was exiled, अस्य that man, यः भर्ता the master, भृत्यम् his servant, अनर्थकम् without remuneration, महत् difficult, कर्म work, कारयित्वा having got done, अस्य to that man, यः अधर्मः acquire the unrighteousness, सः that must, अस्तु be it in that way.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the demerit of unrighteousness in the same way as a master who gets a difficult work done by a servant without remuneration.

shloka_text: परिपालयमानस्य राज्ञो भूतानि पुयत्रवत्। ततस्नु दुह्यतां पापं यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.24।।
transliteration: paripālayamānasya rājño bhūtāni puyatravat| tatasnu duhyatāṃ pāpaṃ yasyā'ryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः was exiled, for him राज्ञः by the king, भूतानि his subjects, पुत्रवत् like his own children, परिपालयमानस्य is ruling, ततः father indeed, द्रुह्यताम् who are treacherously acting, पापम् sin, तत् shall happen.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a man  acting treacherously against a king who rules like a father and protects his subjects like his own children, acquires.

shloka_text: बलिषड्भागमुद्धृत्य नृपस्यारक्षतः प्रजाः। अधर्मो योऽस्य सोऽस्यास्तु यस्यार्थोऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.25।।
transliteration: baliṣaḍbhāgamuddhṛtya nṛpasyārakṣataḥ prajāḥ| adharmo yo'sya so'syāstu yasyārtho'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, अस्य for him, बलिषड्भागम् sixth portion of their revenue as tax, उद्धृत्य having received, नृपस्य of the king, प्रजाः the people, अरक्षतः while not protecting, अस्य for him, अधर्मः that unrighteousness, स: that one, अस्तु so be it.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire unrighteousness in the same way as a king who, having received one sixth of the income as tax from people does not protect them

shloka_text: संश्रुत्य च तपस्विभ्यस्सत्रे वै यज्ञदक्षिणाम्। तां विप्रलपतां पापं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.26।।
transliteration: saṃśrutya ca tapasvibhyassatre vai yajñadakṣiṇām| tāṃ vipralapatāṃ pāpaṃ yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, तपस्विभ्यः for ascetics, सत्रे at sacrifice, यज्ञदक्षिणाम् the offerings at a sacrifice, संश्रुत्य having promised, ताम् that one, विप्रलवताम् those who deny them later, पापम् acquire sin.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person acquires for having promised the ascetics the required offering at a sacrifice and later denies them

shloka_text: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधे युद्धे शस्त्रसमाकुले। मा स्म कार्षीत्सतां धर्मं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.27।।
transliteration: hastyaśvarathasambādhe yuddhe śastrasamākule| mā sma kārṣītsatāṃ dharmaṃ yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधे abundantly provided with elephants, horses and chariots, शस्त्रसमाकुले filled with weapons, युद्धे in a battle, सताम् virtuous men's, धर्मम् righteous, मा स्म कार्षीत् shall not do.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the demerit in the same way as a person, who having gone to the battleground abundantly provided with elephants, horses, chariots and weapons fails to discharge the duty (of a fighter)

shloka_text: उपदिष्टं सुसूक्ष्मार्थं शास्त्रं यत्नेन धीमता। स नाशयतु दुष्टात्मा यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.28।।
transliteration: upadiṣṭaṃ susūkṣmārthaṃ śāstraṃ yatnena dhīmatā| sa nāśayatu duṣṭātmā yasyā'ryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one (Rama), यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that man, दुष्टात्मा evilhearted one, धीमता by a sagacious preceptor, यत्नेन carefully, उपदिष्टम् imparted, सुसूक्ष्मार्थम् having  subtle meaning, शास्त्रम् scriptures, नाशयत may destroy.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire demerit in the same way as an evilhearted person who forever destroys the subtle meaning of the scriptures imparted carefully by a sagacious preceptor

shloka_text: मा च तं व्यूढबाह्वंसं चन्द्रार्कसमतेजसम्। द्राक्षीद्राज्यस्थमासीनं यस्यार्योऽनुमतेगतः।।2.75.29।।
transliteration: mā ca taṃ vyūḍhabāhvaṃsaṃ candrārkasamatejasam| drākṣīdrājyasthamāsīnaṃ yasyāryo'numategataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one (Rama), यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, व्यूढबाह्वंसम्  longarmed and broadshoulderd one, चन्द्रार्कसमतेजसम् resembling Sun and Moon in radiance, राज्यस्थम् on the throne, आसीनम् seated, तम् that Rama, मा च द्राक्षीत् never behold him.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be highly unfortunate like me in not being able to behold that longarmed and broadshoulderd one seated on the throne and resembling both the Sun and the Moon in radiance

shloka_text: पायसं कृसरं छागं वृथा सोऽश्नातु निर्घृणः। गुरूंश्चाप्यवजानातु यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.30।।
transliteration: pāyasaṃ kṛsaraṃ chāgaṃ vṛthā so'śnātu nirghṛṇaḥ| gurūṃścāpyavajānātu yasyā'ryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः was exiled, निर्घृणः pitiless, सः that person, पायसम् sweet milkrice, कृसरम् sesamerice, छागम् goat's flesh, वृथा without purpose (without offering to the gods), अश्नातु may partake, गुरून् preceptors, अवजानातु च may be disrespected.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the demerit in the same way as a person, who partakes the sweet milkrice, sesamerice and goat's flesh without purpose (without invoking and offering it to the gods) and disrespects the teachers

shloka_text: गाश्च स्पृशतु पादेन गुरून्परिवदेत्स्वयम्। मित्रे द्रुह्येत सोऽत्यन्तं यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.31।।
transliteration: gāśca spṛśatu pādena gurūnparivadetsvayam| mitre druhyeta so'tyantaṃ yasyā'ryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः was exiled, सः that  person, पादेन with foot, गाः cows, स्पृशतु may touch (kick), स्वयम् himself, गुरून् elders, परिवदेत्  may be abused, मित्रे friend, अत्यन्तम् greately, द्रुह्येत causes offence.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person who kicks the cows abuses elders and causes great offence to his friends

shloka_text: विश्वासात्कथितं किञ्चित्परिवादं मिथः क्वचित्। विवृणोतु स दुष्टात्मा यस्याऽर्योऽमते गतः।।2.75.32।।
transliteration: viśvāsātkathitaṃ kiñcitparivādaṃ mithaḥ kvacit| vivṛṇotu sa duṣṭātmā yasyā'ryo'mate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः दुष्टात्मा that wickedminded man, क्वचित् at some place, मिथः secretly, विश्वासात् in confidence, कथितम् told, किञ्चित् little, परिवादम् words of abuse, विवृणोतु may divulge.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, acquire the sin in the same way as a wickedminded person, who divulges the words of abuse secretly confided in him by his friends.

shloka_text: अकर्ता ह्यकृतज्ञश्च त्यक्ताचाऽत्मा निरपत्रपः। लोके भवतु विद्विष्टो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.33।।
transliteration: akartā hyakṛtajñaśca tyaktācā'tmā nirapatrapaḥ| loke bhavatu vidviṣṭo yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः was exiled, अकर्ता one who never helps, अकृतज्ञः च an ungrateful one, त्यक्तात्मा one who deserted his life, निरपत्रप: shameless one, लोके in this world, विद्विष्टो भवतु worthy to be hated.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be hated universally as one who never helps any one, who is ungrateful, shameless and as one who has committed the sin of suicide

shloka_text: पुत्रैर्दारैश्च भृत्यैश्च स्वगृहे परिवारितः। स एको मृष्टमश्नातु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.34।।
transliteration: putrairdāraiśca bhṛtyaiśca svagṛhe parivāritaḥ| sa eko mṛṣṭamaśnātu yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that man, स्वगृहे in his own house, पुत्रैर्दारैश्च by wife and children, भृत्यैश्च by servants, परिवारितः surrounded, एकः alone, मृष्टम् delicacies, अश्नातु will partake.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother  acquire the sin in the same way as one who, although surrounded by wife, children and servants, eats the delicacies all alone without sharing acquires.

shloka_text: अप्राप्य सदृशान् दाराननपत्यः प्रमीयताम्। अनवाप्य क्रियां धर्म्यां यस्याऽर्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.35।।
transliteration: aprāpya sadṛśān dārānanapatyaḥ pramīyatām| anavāpya kriyāṃ dharmyāṃ yasyā'ryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that man, सदृशान् worthy, दारान् wife, अप्राप्य without getting, अनपत्यः without begetting offspring, धर्म्याम् religious, क्रियाम् deeds, अनवाप्य without performing, प्रमीयताम् let him die.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother die without winning a worthy wife and without begetting offspring and without performing religious deeds

shloka_text: माऽत्मनस्सन्ततिं द्राक्षीत्स्वेषु दारेषु दुःखितः। आयुस्समग्रमप्राप्य यऽस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.36।।
transliteration: mā'tmanassantatiṃ drākṣītsveṣu dāreṣu duḥkhitaḥ| āyussamagramaprāpya ya'syāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that man,  समग्रम् entire, आयुः life, अप्राप्य begetting, दुःखितः anguished, स्वेषु relating to him, दारेषु in wife, आत्मनः his own, सन्ततिम् children, मा द्राक्षीत् will not see.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother live an entire life of anguish without begetting children through his wife or without seeing his own children

shloka_text: राजस्त्रीबालवृद्धानां वधे यत्पापमुच्यते। भृत्यत्यागे च यत्पापं तत्पापं प्रतिपद्यताम्।।2.75.37।।
transliteration: rājastrībālavṛddhānāṃ vadhe yatpāpamucyate| bhṛtyatyāge ca yatpāpaṃ tatpāpaṃ pratipadyatām
translation: राजस्त्रीबालवृद्धानाम् of the king, woman, children and the aged, वधे kills, यत् पापम् whatever sin, उच्यते is mentioned in scriptures, भृत्यत्यागे च desertion of the dependents as well, यत् पापम् whatever sin, तत् (पापं) such (sin), प्रतिपद्यताम् be obtained.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin as one acquires for murdering a king, a woman, children and the aged and deserting dependents

shloka_text: लाक्षया मधुमांसेन लोहेन च विषेण च। सदैव बिभृयाद्भृत्यान्यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.38।।
transliteration: lākṣayā madhumāṃsena lohena ca viṣeṇa ca| sadaiva bibhṛyādbhṛtyānyasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that man, सदैव always, भृत्यान् dependant wife and children, लाक्षया in lac, मधु मांसेन in wine and meat, लोहेन in metal, विषेण च and in poison, बिभृयात् supports.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin as one who supports his wife and children by trafficking in lac, wine, meat and metal and poison acquires

shloka_text: सङ्ग्रमे समुपोढे स्म शत्रुपक्षभयङ्करे। पलायामानो वध्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.39।।
transliteration: saṅgrame samupoḍhe sma śatrupakṣabhayaṅkare| palāyāmāno vadhyeta yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that man, शत्रुपक्षभयङ्करे सङ्ग्रमे in war, समुपोढे when at its peak, पलायमानः feeling, वध्येत be slain.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin like a warrior, dreadful to the enemy side who will be slain while fleeing from the war at its peak

shloka_text: कपालपाणिः पृथिवीमटतां चीरसंवृतः। भिक्षमाणो यथोन्मत्तो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.40।।
transliteration: kapālapāṇiḥ pṛthivīmaṭatāṃ cīrasaṃvṛtaḥ| bhikṣamāṇo yathonmatto yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that man, कपालपाणिः with a human skull in hand, चीरसंवृतः covered by rags, भिक्षमाणः begging for alms, उन्मत्तो यथा like a insane man, पृथिवीम् on this earth, अटताम् may wander.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, wander this earth, begging alms, holding a human skull like an insane man dressed in rags

shloka_text: मद्ये प्रसक्तो भवतु स्त्रीष्वक्षेषु च नित्यशः। कामक्रोधाभिभूतस्तु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.41।।
transliteration: madye prasakto bhavatu strīṣvakṣeṣu ca nityaśaḥ| kāmakrodhābhibhūtastu yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that man, नित्यशः always, मद्ये in wine, स्त्रीषु in women, अक्षेषु च in dice for gambling, प्रसक्तः addicted, कामक्रोधाभिभूतः भवतु shall be prevailed over by passion and anger.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be always addicted to wine, women and gambling and be swayed by desire and anger

shloka_text: मास्म धर्मे मनो भूयादधर्मं स निषेवताम्। अपात्रवर्षी भवतु यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.42।।
transliteration: māsma dharme mano bhūyādadharmaṃ sa niṣevatām| apātravarṣī bhavatu yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, अस्य his, मनः mind, धर्मे in virtue, मा भूयात् shall not stay, सः he, अधर्मे in unrighteousness, निषेवताम् will practise, अपात्रवर्षी भवतु shall confer charity on the unworthy.
explanation: May the mind of that man who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother not be established in virtue May he practise unrighteousness and confer charity on the unworthy

shloka_text: सञ्चितान्यस्य वित्तनि विविधानि सहस्रशः। दस्युभिर्विप्रलुप्यन्तां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.43।।
transliteration: sañcitānyasya vittani vividhāni sahasraśaḥ| dasyubhirvipralupyantāṃ yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, अस्य for that man's, सहस्रशः in thousands, सञ्चितानि accumulated, विविधानि वित्तानि various, possessions of wealth, दस्युभिः by thieves, विप्रलुप्यन्ताम् be snatched away.
explanation: May that man's accumulated extensive posssessions of various kinds of wealth be  snatched away by thieves in thousands of ways if he had counselled the exile of my esteemed brother

shloka_text: उभे सन्ध्ये शयानस्य यत्पापं परिकल्प्यते। तच्चपापं भवेत्तस्य यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.44।।
transliteration: ubhe sandhye śayānasya yatpāpaṃ parikalpyate| taccapāpaṃ bhavettasya yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, तस्य  for that man, उभे सन्ध्ये at the twilight hour of dawn and dusk, शयानस्य sleeping, यत् पापम् the extent of sin, परिकल्प्यते is fixed, तत् पापम् that sin, भवेत् shall be.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the extent of demerit fixed for a person, who sleeps at the hour of twilight of dawn and dusk

shloka_text: यदग्निदायके पापं यत्पापं गुरतल्पगे। मित्रद्रोहे च यत्पापं तत्पापं प्रतिपद्यताम्।।2.75.45।।
transliteration: yadagnidāyake pāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ guratalpage| mitradrohe ca yatpāpaṃ tatpāpaṃ pratipadyatām
translation: अग्निदायके one who sets fire to human settlements, यत् पापम् sin of such act, गुरुतल्पगे violation of the preceptor's bed, यत् पापम् sin of such act, मित्रद्रोहे betraying a friend, यत् पापम् sin of such act, तत् पापम् sin of that act, प्रतिपद्यताम् be obtained.
explanation: May that one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person who sets fire to human settlements, violates the preceptors's bed and betrays his friend

shloka_text: देवतानां पित्रूणां च मातापित्रोस्तथैव च। मा स्म कार्षीत्स शुश्रूषां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.46।।
transliteration: devatānāṃ pitrūṇāṃ ca mātāpitrostathaiva ca| mā sma kārṣītsa śuśrūṣāṃ yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that man, देवतानाम् for gods, पित्रूणाम् to ancestors, तथा च in the same way, मातापित्रोः for parents, शुश्रूषाम् serve, मा स्म कार्षीत् shall not do.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother, acquire the sin in the same way as a person who fails to show obedience to the gods and the ancestors and to serve his parents

shloka_text: सतां लोकात्सतां कीर्त्या स्सञ्जुष्टात्कर्मणस्तथा। भ्रश्यतु क्षिप्रमद्यैव यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.47।।
transliteration: satāṃ lokātsatāṃ kīrtyā ssañjuṣṭātkarmaṇastathā| bhraśyatu kṣipramadyaiva yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that person,  अद्यैव now, क्षिप्रम् this very moment, सताम् virtuous men's, लोकात् from the world, सताम्  virtuous men's, कीर्त्याः from renown, तथा and, सञ्जुष्टात् approved by virtuous men, कर्मणः from actions, भ्रश्यतु be expelled.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be expelled  this very moment from the world approved by virtuous men, from their renown and from their (noble) actions

shloka_text: अपास्य मातृशुश्रूषामनर्थे सोऽवतिष्ठताम्। दीर्घबाहुर्महावक्षा: यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.48।।
transliteration: apāsya mātṛśuśrūṣāmanarthe so'vatiṣṭhatām| dīrghabāhurmahāvakṣā: yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: दीर्घबाहुः longarmed, महावक्षाः broadchested, आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that person, मातृशुश्रूषाम् ministration to mother, अपास्य abdicating, अनर्थे without purpose, अवतिष्ठताम् shall remain.
explanation: The one who counselled the exile of my noble, longarmed and broadchested brother be banished like the one who commited the sin of leaving the ministration to his mother and engaging himself in purposeless acts

shloka_text: बहुपुत्रो दरिद्रश्च ज्वररोगसमन्वितः। स भूयात्सतत क्लेशी यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.49।।
transliteration: bahuputro daridraśca jvararogasamanvitaḥ| sa bhūyātsatata kleśī yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that person, बहुपुत्रः possessing many sons, दरिद्रः impoverished, ज्वररोगसमन्वितः suffering  from fever and disease, सततं क्लेशी भूयात् be always miserble.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother be always miserable with many sons, poverty and fever and disease

shloka_text: आशामाशंसमानानां दीनानामूर्ध्वचक्षुषाम्। अर्थिनां वितथां कुर्याद्यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.50।।
transliteration: āśāmāśaṃsamānānāṃ dīnānāmūrdhvacakṣuṣām| arthināṃ vitathāṃ kuryādyasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः was exiled, that person, आशंसमानानाम् seeking, दीनानाम् pitiable ones, ऊर्ध्वचक्षुसाम् of those raising their eyes in hope towards donors, अर्थिनाम् mendicants', आशाम् hope, वितथाम् futile, कुर्यात् may make.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person disappoints who miserable mendicants seeking alms and looking up to him for help

shloka_text: मायया रमतां नित्यं परुषः पिशुनोऽशुचिः। राज्ञो भीतस्त्वधर्मात्मा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.51।।
transliteration: māyayā ramatāṃ nityaṃ paruṣaḥ piśuno'śuciḥ| rājño bhītastvadharmātmā yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that person, परुषः abusive, पिशुनः niggardly, अशुचिः impure, अधर्मात्मा unrighteous, नित्यम् always, राज्ञः  from the king, भीतः afraid of, मायया by deceit, रमताम् will entertain his life.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a person, who is abusive, niggardly, impure, unrighteous and always afraid of being caught by the king, and lives by cheating others, acquires

shloka_text: ऋतुस्नातां सतीं भार्यामृतुकालानुरोधिनीम्। अतिवर्तेत दुष्टात्मा यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.52।।
transliteration: ṛtusnātāṃ satīṃ bhāryāmṛtukālānurodhinīm| ativarteta duṣṭātmā yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that person, दुष्टात्मा wickedminded, ऋतुकालानुरोधिनीम् observing the menstrual period unfavourable for conception, ऋतुस्नाताम् a woman who bathed after menstruation,सतीम् chaste woman, भार्याम् wife, अतिवर्तेत may neglect.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way as a wickedminded person who neglects his chaste wife observing the menstrual period unfavourable for conception and had bathed after menstruation  acquires

shloka_text: सधर्मदारान्परित्यज्य परदारान्निषेवताम्। त्यक्तधर्मरतिर्मूढो यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.53।।
transliteration: sadharmadārānparityajya paradārānniṣevatām| tyaktadharmaratirmūḍho yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, that person मूढः foolish one, त्यक्तधर्मरतिः abandoned righteous conduct, धर्मदारान् rightfully married wife, परित्यज्य having forsaken, परदारान् other's wife, निषेवताम् may resort.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a foolish person who abandons righteous conduct and  forsakes his rightfully married wife and resorts to other man's wife acquires

shloka_text: विप्रलुप्तप्रजातस्य दुष्कृतं ब्राह्मणस्य यत्। तदेव प्रतिपद्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.54।।
transliteration: vipraluptaprajātasya duṣkṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasya yat| tadeva pratipadyeta yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled,  विप्रलुप्तप्रजातस्य lacking in children, ब्राह्मणस्य to brahmin, यत् दुष्कृतम् that demerit, तदेव   the same, प्रतिपद्यताम् shall obtain.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the same sin like that of a lowbred brahmin who commits an irreversible sin acquires

shloka_text: पानीयदूषके पापं तथैव विषदायके। यत्तदेकस्स लभतां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.55।।
transliteration: pānīyadūṣake pāpaṃ tathaiva viṣadāyake| yattadekassa labhatāṃ yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, सः that person, एकः only alone, पानीयदूषके in the case of a man who pollutes drinking water, तथैव similarly, विषदायके administers poison to others, यत् पापम् such sin, लभताम् will obtain.
explanation: May the sin of polluting drinking water and administering poison to others be put together and be incurred by the man who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणायोद्यतां पूजां विहन्तु कलुषेन्द्रियः। बालवत्सां च गां दोग्धु यस्यार्यो ऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.56।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇāyodyatāṃ pūjāṃ vihantu kaluṣendriyaḥ| bālavatsāṃ ca gāṃ dogdhu yasyāryo 'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, (सः that person), कलुषेन्द्रियः with befouled senses, ब्राह्मणाय to a brahmin, उद्यताम् kept ready, पूजाम्  offerings of worship, विहन्तु may disturb, बालवत्साम् having a young calf, गाम् cow, दोग्धु may milk.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person with befouled senses disturbs the offerings of worship kept ready for a brahmin and milks the cow having a young calf acquires.

shloka_text: तुर्ष्णार्तं सति पानीये विप्रलम्भेन योजयेत्। लभेत तस्य यत्पापं यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.57।।
transliteration: turṣṇārtaṃ sati pānīye vipralambhena yojayet| labheta tasya yatpāpaṃ yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, (सः that person), पानीये water, सति existing, तृष्णार्तम् thirsty one, विप्रलम्भेन by deceipt, योजयेत् arranges, तस्य to him, यत् पापम् whatever sin, लभेत will result.
explanation: May the one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person who in possession of water does not give it to one suffering from thirst acquires it

shloka_text: भक्त्या विवदमानेषु मार्गमाश्रित्य पश्यतः। तस्य पापेन युज्येत यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः।।2.75.58।।
transliteration: bhaktyā vivadamāneṣu mārgamāśritya paśyataḥ| tasya pāpena yujyeta yasyāryo'numate gataḥ
translation: आर्यः esteemed one, यस्य whose, अनुमते with sanction, गतः exiled, भक्त्या by loyalty (to two religious factions), विवदमानेषु while disputing, मार्गम् one line of argument, आश्रित्य taking shelter, पश्यतः seeing, तस्य to him, पापेन by such sin, युज्येत will apply.
explanation: May that one who counselled the exile of my esteemed brother acquire the sin in the same way a person acquires while giving onesided judgement between divided religious disputants

shloka_text: विहीनां पतिपुत्राभ्यां कौसल्यां पार्थिवात्मजः। एवमाश्वासयन्नेव दुःखार्तो निपपात ह।।2.75.59।।
transliteration: vihīnāṃ patiputrābhyāṃ kausalyāṃ pārthivātmajaḥ| evamāśvāsayanneva duḥkhārto nipapāta ha
translation: पार्थिवात्मजः king's son, Bharata, पतिपुत्राभ्याम् of husband and son, विहीनाम् deprived of, कौशल्याम् Kausalya, एवम् in this way, आश्वासयन्नेव while appeasing, दुःखार्तः filled with grief, निपपात ह fell down at her feet.
explanation: While thus appeasing Kausalya deprived of her husband and son, Bharata, filled with grief, fell down at her feet.

shloka_text: तथा तु शपथैः कष्टै श्शपमानमचेतनम्। भरतं शोकसन्तप्तं कौसल्या वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।2.75.60।।
transliteration: tathā tu śapathaiḥ kaṣṭai śśapamānamacetanam| bharataṃ śokasantaptaṃ kausalyā vākyamabravīt
translation: तथा in this manner, कष्टैः by painful, शपथैः on oaths, शपमानम् swearing, अचेतनम् lying unconscious, शोकसन्तप्तम् consumed with grief, भरतम् Bharata, कौशल्या Kausalya, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Kausalya said these words to Bharata who fell unconscious, consumed with grief, while swearing on painful oaths.

shloka_text: मम दुःखमिदं पुत्र भूयस्समुपजायते। शपथै श्शपमानो हि प्राणानुपरुणत्सि मे।।2.75.61।।
transliteration: mama duḥkhamidaṃ putra bhūyassamupajāyate| śapathai śśapamāno hi prāṇānuparuṇatsi me
translation: पुत्र son, मम to me, इदं दुःखम् this suffering, भूयः still more, समुपजायते is growing, शपथैः by oaths, शपमानः swearing, मे my, प्राणान् life, उपरुणत्सि हि you are obstructing (choking).
explanation: O son by swearing on oaths, you are choking the very breath of my life and my suffering has grown still more.

shloka_text: दिष्ट्या न चलितो धर्मादात्मा ते सहलक्ष्मणः। वत्स सत्यप्रतिज्ञो ते सतां लोकमवाप्स्यसि।।2.75.62।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā na calito dharmādātmā te sahalakṣmaṇaḥ| vatsa satyapratijño te satāṃ lokamavāpsyasi
translation: वत्स O dear child, दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते your, आत्मा mind, धर्मात् form righteousness, न चलितः unswerved, सत्यप्रतिज्ञः truthful to promise, सहलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, सताम् virtuous men's, लोकम् world, अवाप्स्यसि you shall attain.
explanation: O dear child, fortunately your mind is unswerved from righteousness. You being truthful to your promise shall attain the world of virtuous men along with Lakshmana.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा चाङ्कमानीय भरतं भ्रातृवत्सलम्। परिष्वज्य महाबाहुं रुरोद भृशदुःखिता।।2.75.63।।
transliteration: ityuktvā cāṅkamānīya bharataṃ bhrātṛvatsalam| pariṣvajya mahābāhuṃ ruroda bhṛśaduḥkhitā
translation: भ्रातृवत्सलम् a man affectionate towards his brothr, भरतम् addressing Bharata, इति thus , उक्त्वा having said, अङ्कम् on her lap, आनीय drawing into, महाबाहुम् mightyarmed one, परिष्वज्य  hugged, भृशदुःखिता with extreme grief, रुरोद cried out.
explanation: After having addressed Bharata, who was affectionate towards his brother that way, Kausalya  drew the mightyarmed one onto her lap and hugged him and cried out with extreme grief.

shloka_text: एवं विलपमानस्य दुःखार्तस्य महात्मनः। मोहाच्च शोकसम्रोधाद्बभूव लुलितं मनः।।2.75.64।।
transliteration: evaṃ vilapamānasya duḥkhārtasya mahātmanaḥ| mohācca śokasamrodhādbabhūva lulitaṃ manaḥ
translation: एवम् in this way, विलपमानस्य while lamenting, दुःखार्तस्य afflicted by sorrow, महात्मनः great Bharata's, मनः mind, मोहाच्च due to swooning, शोकसम्रोधात् due to being besieged by grief, लुलितम् बभूव became unsteady.
explanation: Afflicted by sorrow and lamenting thus, great Bharata's mind became unsteady owing to swooning and  besieged by grief.

shloka_text: तमेवं शोकसन्तप्तं भरतं कैकयी सुतम्। उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठो वसिष्ठ श्श्रेष्ठवागृषिः।।2.76.1।।
transliteration: tamevaṃ śokasantaptaṃ bharataṃ kaikayī sutam| uvāca vadatāṃ śreṣṭho vasiṣṭha śśreṣṭhavāgṛṣiḥ
