explanation: If like a man who appears noble, though ignoble, clean, though unclean or dishonest, auspicious, though inauspicious, a man of character, though depraved, I forsake auspicious ways for unrighteousness, abandon pious acts and scriptural practices and indulge, under the cloak of dharma, in acts of wickedness by causing harm and confusion to the world, will any sensible man with a sense of discrimination between should and should not hold me in high esteem?

shloka_text: कस्य दास्याम्यहं वृत्तं केन वा स्वर्गमाप्नुयाम्। आनया वर्तमानो हि वृत्त्या हीनप्रतिज्ञया।।2.109.8।।
transliteration: kasya dāsyāmyahaṃ vṛttaṃ kena vā svargamāpnuyām| ānayā vartamāno hi vṛttyā hīnapratijñayā
translation: अहम् I, हीनप्रतिज्ञया by breaking the vow, अनया with this, वृत्त्या practice, वर्तमानः presently, कस्य to whom, वृत्तम् virtuous conduct, दास्यामि can I give, केन वा to whom, स्वर्गम् heaven, आप्नुयाम् can I attain.
explanation: How can I advise others for a virtuous conduct or how can I attain heaven if I break the vow which I follow at present.

shloka_text: कामवृत्तस्त्वयं लोकः कृत्स्न स्समुपवर्तते। यद्वृत्ता स्सन्ति राजानस्तद्वृत्ता स्सन्ति हि प्रजाः।।2.109.9।।
transliteration: kāmavṛttastvayaṃ lokaḥ kṛtsna ssamupavartate| yadvṛttā ssanti rājānastadvṛttā ssanti hi prajāḥ
translation: अयम् this, कृत्स्नः entire, लोकः a world, कामवृत्तः do whatever they wish, समुपवर्तते behaving, राजानः kings, यद्वृत्ताः सन्ति whatever be their conduct, प्रजाः the subjects, तद्वृत्ताः सन्ति हि they are sure to emulate the same conduct.
explanation: The entire world conducts itself as per its own sweet will. Therefore the subjects will follow the same path as their kings.

shloka_text: सत्यमेवानृशंसं च राजवृत्तं सनातनम्। तस्मात्सत्यात्मकं राज्यं सत्ये लोकः प्रतिष्ठितः।।2.109.10।।
transliteration: satyamevānṛśaṃsaṃ ca rājavṛttaṃ sanātanam| tasmātsatyātmakaṃ rājyaṃ satye lokaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
translation: सनातनम् eternal, राजवृत्तम् royal ways, सत्यमेव is a manifestation of truth, अनृशंसं च nonviolent, तस्मात् therefore, राज्यम् kingdom, सत्यात्मकम् of the character of truth, लोकः this world, सत्ये on truth, प्रतिष्ठितः is established.
explanation: Truth and nonviolence are the perpetual principles of kings. Therefore, a kingdom is based on truth. This world is firmly established in truth.

shloka_text: ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च सत्यमेव हि मेनिरे। सत्यवादी हि लोकेऽस्मिन्परमं गच्छति क्षयम्।।2.109.11।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaścaiva devāśca satyameva hi menire| satyavādī hi loke'sminparamaṃ gacchati kṣayam
translation: ऋषयश्चैव sages, देवाश्च the gods or, सत्यमेव the truth only, मेनिरे considered (supreme virtue), सत्यवादी truthful, अस्मिन् लोके in this world, परमम् highest, क्षयम् state, गच्छति  attains, हि indeed.
explanation: Sages and gods all accept truth (as the supreme virtue). A truthful man of this world, attains the highest state (abode).

shloka_text: उद्विजन्ते यथा सर्पान्नरादनृतवादिनः। धर्म स्सत्यं परो लोके मूलं स्वर्गस्य चोच्यते।।2.109.12।।
transliteration: udvijante yathā sarpānnarādanṛtavādinaḥ| dharma ssatyaṃ paro loke mūlaṃ svargasya cocyate
translation: अनृतवादिनः from one speaking untruth, नरात् from man, सर्पात् यथा like from a serpent, उद्विजन्ते are agitated, लोके in this world, सत्यम् truth, परः greatest, धर्मः virtue, स्वर्गस्य to heaven, मूलं च is the very root, उच्यते is said to be.
explanation: People are frightened at the sight of a man speaking untruth as though they have seen a serpent. Truth in this world is the greatest virtue and is said to be the very foundation of heaven.

shloka_text: सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्यं पद्माश्रिता सदा। सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम्।।2.109.13।।
transliteration: satyameveśvaro loke satyaṃ padmāśritā sadā| satyamūlāni sarvāṇi satyānnāsti paraṃ padam
translation: लोके in this world, सत्यमेव truth only, ईश्वरः is God, पद्मा godess of wealth, सदा always, सत्यम् in truth, आश्रिता seeks refuge, सर्वाणि all beings, सत्यमूलानि truth as basis, सत्यात् more than truth, परम् supreme ,पदम् higher state, नास्ति there is nothing.
explanation: Truth is God. The goddess of wealth always takes refuge in truth. Truth is the root of everything. It is supreme and there is nothing above it.

shloka_text: दत्तमिष्टं हुतं चैव तप्तानि च तपांसि च। वेदा स्सत्यप्रतिष्ठाना स्तस्मात्सत्यपरो भवेत्।।2.109.14।।
transliteration: dattamiṣṭaṃ hutaṃ caiva taptāni ca tapāṃsi ca| vedā ssatyapratiṣṭhānā stasmātsatyaparo bhavet
translation: दत्तम् charity, इष्टं च sacrifice, हुतं चैव libation, तप्तानि mortifications, तपांसि च asceticism, वेदाः the Vedas, सत्यप्रतिष्ठानाः have truth as the foundation, तस्मात् therefore, सत्यपरः भवेत् one should adhere to truth.
explanation: Charity, sacrifice, libations, mortifications, asceticism and the Vedas have truth as their foundation. Therefore, every one should be an adherent of truth.

shloka_text: एकः पालयते लोकमेकः पालयते कुलम्। मज्जत्येको हि निरय एक स्स्वर्गे महीयते।।2.109.15।।
transliteration: ekaḥ pālayate lokamekaḥ pālayate kulam| majjatyeko hi niraya eka ssvarge mahīyate
translation: एकः one, लोकम् this world, पालयते protects, एकः one, कुलम् family, पालयते protects, एकः one, निरये into the hell, मज्जति plunges, एकः one, स्वर्गे in heaven, महीयते is honoured.
explanation: One protects the world. Another runs his family. One plunges into hell. Another is honoured in heaven. (These are the fruits of truth and untruth).

shloka_text: सोऽहं पितुर्नियोगं तु किमर्थं नानुपालये। सत्यप्रतिश्रव स्सत्यं सत्येन समयीकृतः।।2.109.16।।
transliteration: so'haṃ piturniyogaṃ tu kimarthaṃ nānupālaye| satyapratiśrava ssatyaṃ satyena samayīkṛtaḥ
translation: सत्यप्रतिश्रवः true to promise, सः अहम् that I, सत्येन by truth, समयीकृतः bound by, पितुः father's, सत्यम् vow, नियोगम् command, किमर्थम् why, नानुपालये will not I obey.
explanation: I am always true to any promise. I am bound by truth. Why shouId I (now) disobey  my father's command (to keep his promise)?

shloka_text: नैव लोभान्न मोहाद्वा न ह्यज्ञानात्तमोऽन्वितः। सेतुं सत्यस्य भेत्स्यामि गुरो स्सत्यप्रतिश्रवः।।2.109.17।।
transliteration: naiva lobhānna mohādvā na hyajñānāttamo'nvitaḥ| setuṃ satyasya bhetsyāmi guro ssatyapratiśravaḥ
translation: सत्यप्रतिश्रवः true to one's, गुरोः father's, सत्यस्य of truth, सेतुम् bridge, लोभात् out of  greed, नैव भेत्स्यामि will not break, मोहाद्वा or out of delusion, न not, तमोऽन्वितः due to ignorance (illusion), अज्ञानात् out of ignorance, न not.
explanation: I am always true to my promise. I will not break the bridge of truth of my father out of either greed or delusion or ignorance or illusion.

shloka_text: असत्यसन्धस्य सतश्चलस्यास्थिरचेतसः। नैव देवा न पितरः प्रतीच्छन्तीति नः श्रुतम्।।2.109.18।।
transliteration: asatyasandhasya sataścalasyāsthiracetasaḥ| naiva devā na pitaraḥ pratīcchantīti naḥ śrutam
translation: असत्यसन्धस्य सतः one who is inclined to untruth, चलस्य of a fickle man, अस्थिरचेतसः of an unsteady mind, देवाः gods, न प्रतीच्छन्ति will not accept, पितरः ancestors, इति thus, नः for us, श्रुतम् heard.
explanation: We have heard that the offerings of a man inclined to untruth, of an unstable and unsteady mind are accepted neither by the gods nor by the ancestors.

shloka_text: प्रत्यगात्ममिमं धर्मं सत्यं पश्याम्यहं स्वयम्। भार स्सत्पुरुषाचीर्णस्तदर्थमभिमन्यते।।2.109.19।।
transliteration: pratyagātmamimaṃ dharmaṃ satyaṃ paśyāmyahaṃ svayam| bhāra ssatpuruṣācīrṇastadarthamabhimanyate
translation: अहम् I, स्वयम् personally, इमम् this, सत्यं धर्मम् righteousness in the form of truth, प्रत्यगात्मम् as supreme self, पश्यामि I perceive (consider), तदर्थम् hence, सत्पुरुषाचीर्णः practised by the virtuous, भारः this burden (of exile into the forest), अभिमन्यते I consider.
explanation: I personally regard this righteousness practised by the virtuous as an evident form of truth, as the supreme self. Therefore, this burden (difficult task of living as an exile) is gratifying to me.

shloka_text: क्षात्रं धर्ममहंत्यक्ष्ये ह्यधर्मं धर्मसंहितम्। क्षुद्रैर्नृशंसैर्लुब्धैश्च सेवितं पापकर्मभिः।।2.109.20।।
transliteration: kṣātraṃ dharmamahaṃtyakṣye hyadharmaṃ dharmasaṃhitam| kṣudrairnṛśaṃsairlubdhaiśca sevitaṃ pāpakarmabhiḥ
translation: क्षुद्रैः by the mean, नृशंसैः by the cruel, लुब्धै: by the greedy, पापकर्मभिः by men of evil deeds, सेवितम् pursued, धर्मसंहितम् conforming to righteousness, अधर्मम् unrighteousness, क्षात्रं धर्मम् kshatriya code of condut, अहम् I, त्यक्षे renounce.
explanation: I renounce the socalled kshatriya code of conduct followed by the mean the cruel, the greedy and by men of evil deeds which is unrighteousness under the cloak of  righteousness.

shloka_text: कायेन कुरुते पापं मनसा सम्प्रधार्य तत्। अनृतं जिह्वया चाह त्रिविधं कर्मपातकम्।।2.109.21।।
transliteration: kāyena kurute pāpaṃ manasā sampradhārya tat| anṛtaṃ jihvayā cāha trividhaṃ karmapātakam
translation: मनसा by mind, सम्प्रधार्य having conceived, कायेन by the body, पापम् sin (evil deed), कुरुते is committed, जिह्वया with tongue, अनृतं च falsehood, आह is spoken, पातकं कर्म sinful action, त्रिविधम् is in these three ways.
explanation: At first a man conceives an evil idea in his mind, then executes it through evil deed with his body and tells a lie through his tongue. Thus sinful action is three dimensional (mental, physical and vocal).

shloka_text: भूमिः कीर्तिर्यशो लक्ष्मीः पुरुषं प्रार्थयन्ति हि। सत्यं समनुवर्तने सत्यमेव भजेत तत:।।2.109.22।।
transliteration: bhūmiḥ kīrtiryaśo lakṣmīḥ puruṣaṃ prārthayanti hi| satyaṃ samanuvartane satyameva bhajeta tata:
translation: भूमिः land, कीर्ति: fame, यशः renown, लक्ष्मीः wealth, पुरुषम् to a man, प्रार्थयन्ति हि desire to, स्वर्गस्थं च one who is in heaven, अनुपश्यन्ति will look at, ततः from, सत्यमेव truth only, भजेत take recourse to.
explanation: Land (kingdom) glory, and wealth pursue a man, they long for him even if he is in heaven. Therefore, every one must take recourse to truth alone.

shloka_text: श्रेष्ठं ह्यनार्यमेव स्याद्यद्भवानवधार्य माम्। आह युक्ति करैर्वाक्यैरिदं भद्रं कुरुष्व ह।।2.109.23।।
transliteration: śreṣṭhaṃ hyanāryameva syādyadbhavānavadhārya mām| āha yukti karairvākyairidaṃ bhadraṃ kuruṣva ha
translation: भवान् you, श्रेष्ठम् as excellent, अवधार्य decided, भद्रम् auspicious, इदम् this course, कुरुष्व pursue, युक्ति करैः cleverlyworded, वाक्यैः with statements, माम् to me, यत् that, आह said (thought), अनार्यमेव is ignoble, स्यात् will be.
explanation: The course you thought excellent and 'this auspicious act' you urged me in a cleverlyworded statement to perform is ignoble indeed.

shloka_text: कथं ह्यहं प्रतिज्ञाय वनवासमिमं गुरॊ:। भरतस्य करिष्यामि वचो हित्वा गुरोर्वचः।।2.109.24।।
transliteration: kathaṃ hyahaṃ pratijñāya vanavāsamimaṃ gurò:| bharatasya kariṣyāmi vaco hitvā gurorvacaḥ
translation: अहम् I, इमं वनवासम् this dwelling in the forest, गुरौ to father, प्रतिज्ञाय having sworn, गुरोः father's, वचः words, हित्वा disregarding, भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, कथम् how, करिष्यामि shall I do?
explanation: Having sworn before my father that I would live in the forest, how can I act upon Bharata's request in disregard to my father's words?

shloka_text: स्थिरा मया प्रतिज्ञाता प्रतिज्ञा गुरुसन्निधौ। प्रहृष्यमाणा सा देवी कैकेयी चाभवत्तदा।।2.109.25।।
transliteration: sthirā mayā pratijñātā pratijñā gurusannidhau| prahṛṣyamāṇā sā devī kaikeyī cābhavattadā
translation: मया by me, गुरुसन्निधौ in the presence of my father, स्थिरा firm, प्रतिज्ञा vow, प्रतिज्ञाता is sworn, तदा then, सा that, देवी कैकेयी च Devi Kaikeyi, प्रहृष्यमाणा अभवत् became immensely delighted.
explanation: I had taken a firm vow in the presence of my father (about my stay in the forest). And then Devi Kaikeyi was immensely delighted.

shloka_text: वनवासं वसन्नेव शुचिर्नियतभोजनः। मूलपुष्पफलैः पुण्यैः पित्रून् देवांश्च तर्पयन्।।2.109.26।। सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गोऽहं लोकयात्रां प्रवर्तये। अकुह श्श्रद्धधानस्सन्कार्याकार्यविचक्षणः।।2.109.27।।
transliteration: vanavāsaṃ vasanneva śucirniyatabhojanaḥ| mūlapuṣpaphalaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pitrūn devāṃśca tarpayan santuṣṭapañcavargo'haṃ lokayātrāṃ pravartaye| akuha śśraddhadhānassankāryākāryavicakṣaṇaḥ
translation: अहम् I, शुचिः purified, नियतभोजनः with regulated food, पुण्यैः by holy, मूलैः with roots, पुष्पैः with flowers, फलैः with fruits, पित्रून् to ancestors, देवांश्च to gods, तर्पयन् satisfying through libation, सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गः with five senses contented, अकुहः honest, श्रद्धधानस्सन् with faith, कार्याकार्यविचक्षणः discriminating ought to be done and what not to, what is right and what is wrong, एवम् in this way, वनवासम् forest life, वसन् living, लोकयात्राम् the term of life, प्रवर्तये shall spend.
explanation: I shall spend the term of my forest life with faith and holiness and purity of mind and with regulated food and with ancestors and gods satisfied with offerings of roots, flowers and fruits, with my five senses contented and with a mind that discriminates between what ought to be done and what ought not to be done.

shloka_text: वनवासं वसन्नेवं शुचिर्नियतभोजनः। मूलैः पुष्पैः फलैः पुण्यैः पित्रून् देवांश्च तर्पयन्।।2.109.26।। सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गोऽहं लोकयात्रां प्रवर्तये। अकुह श्श्रद्धधानस्सन्कार्याकार्यविचक्षणः।।2.109.27।।
transliteration: vanavāsaṃ vasannevaṃ śucirniyatabhojanaḥ| mūlaiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaiḥ puṇyaiḥ pitrūn devāṃśca tarpayan santuṣṭapañcavargo'haṃ lokayātrāṃ pravartaye| akuha śśraddhadhānassankāryākāryavicakṣaṇaḥ
translation: अहम् I, शुचिः purified, नियतभोजनः with regulated food, पुण्यैः by holy, मूलैः with roots, पुष्पैः with flowers, फलैः with fruits, पित्रून् to ancestors, देवांश्च to gods, तर्पयन् satisfying through libation, सन्तुष्टपञ्चवर्गः with five senses contented, अकुहः honest, श्रद्धधानस्सन् with faith, कार्याकार्यविचक्षणः discriminating ought to be done and what not to, what is right and what is wrong, एवम् in this way, वनवासम् forest life, वसन् living, लोकयात्राम् the term of life, प्रवर्तये shall spend.
explanation: I shall spend the term of my forest life with faith and holiness and purity of mind and with regulated food and with ancestors and gods satisfied with offerings of roots, flowers and fruits, with my five senses contented and with a mind that discriminates between what ought to be done and what ought not to be done.

shloka_text: कर्मभूमिमां प्राप्य कर्तव्यं कर्म यच्छुभम्। अग्निर्वायुश्च सोमश्च कर्मणां फलभागिनः।।2.109.28।।
transliteration: karmabhūmimāṃ prāpya kartavyaṃ karma yacchubham| agnirvāyuśca somaśca karmaṇāṃ phalabhāginaḥ
translation: इमाम् this, कर्मभूमिम् the land of (religious) actions, प्राप्य having reached, यत् whichever, शुभम् is auspicious, कर्म deed, कर्तव्यम् should be performed, अग्नि: Agni, वायुश्च Vayu, सोमश्च Soma, कर्मणाम् (religious) rites, फलभागिनः have obtained a share of the fruits.
explanation: Having reached this land of (religious) actions, one should perform auspicious rites. As fruit of their actions, Agni, Vayu and Soma have obtained their status.

shloka_text: शतं क्रतूनामाहृत्य देवराट् त्रिदिवं गतः। तपांस्युग्राणि चास्थाय दिवं याता महर्षयः।।2.109.29।।
transliteration: śataṃ kratūnāmāhṛtya devarāṭ tridivaṃ gataḥ| tapāṃsyugrāṇi cāsthāya divaṃ yātā maharṣayaḥ
translation: देवराट् king of the gods (Indra), क्रतूनाम् sacrifices, शतम् hundred, अहृत्य having performed, त्रिदिवम् to heaven, गतः went, महर्षयः great sages, उग्राणि intenese, तपांसि mortifications, आस्थाय after resorting to, दिवम् heaven, याताः attained.
explanation: After performing a hundred sacrifices, king of the gods (Indra) obtained (dominion over) heaven. Great sages attained heaven after resorting to intense mortifications.

shloka_text: अमृष्यमाणः पुनरुग्रतेजाः निशम्य तं नास्तिकवाक्यहेतुम्। अथाब्रवीत्तं नृपतेस्तनूजो विगर्हमाणो वचनानि तस्य।।2.109.30।।
transliteration: amṛṣyamāṇaḥ punarugratejāḥ niśamya taṃ nāstikavākyahetum| athābravīttaṃ nṛpatestanūjo vigarhamāṇo vacanāni tasya
translation: अथ then after, उग्रतेजाः a man of fierce energy, नृपतेः king, तनूजः son, तम् that, नास्तिक  वाक्य हेतुम् reasons articulated in atheistic words, निशम्य having heard, अमृष्यमाणः unable to endure, तस्य his, वचनानि words, विगर्हमाणः disdaining, तम् him, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The highly energetic prince, Rama, could not tolerate these atheistic arguments of Jabali for which he had to utter these words full of disdain:

shloka_text: सत्यं च धर्मं च पराक्रमं च भूतानुकम्पां प्रियवादितां च। द्विजातिदेवातिधिपूजनं च पन्थानमाहुस्त्रिदिवस्य सन्तः।।2.109.31।।
transliteration: satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca parākramaṃ ca bhūtānukampāṃ priyavāditāṃ ca| dvijātidevātidhipūjanaṃ ca panthānamāhustridivasya santaḥ
translation: सत्यं च truthfulness, धर्मं च righteousness, पराक्रमं च valour, भूतानुकम्पाम् compassion for all beings, प्रियवादितां च speaking pleasing words, द्विजातिदेवातिथिपूजनं च offering homage to gods, brahmins and guests, त्रिदिवस्य of heaven, पन्थानम् is the path, सन्तः virtuous people, आहुः say.
explanation: The virtuous maintain that truthfulness, righteousness, valour, compassion towards all beings, speaking pleasing words, paying homage to gods, brahmins and guests -- all these are  paths to heaven.

shloka_text: तेनैवमाज्ञाय यथावदर्थमेकोदयं सम्प्रतिपद्य विप्राः। धर्मं चरन्त स्सकलं यथावत्काङ्क्षन्ति लोकागममप्रमत्ताः।।2.109.32।।
transliteration: tenaivamājñāya yathāvadarthamekodayaṃ sampratipadya viprāḥ| dharmaṃ caranta ssakalaṃ yathāvatkāṅkṣanti lokāgamamapramattāḥ
translation: तेन therefore, विप्राः brahmins, अर्थम् meaning, यथावत् rightly, आज्ञाय having understood, एकोदयम् the goal, सम्प्रतिपद्य having reached, सकलम् entire, धर्मम् righteousness, यथावत् duly, अप्रमत्ताः with utmost care, चरन्तः practising, लोकागमम् attainment of higher positions, काङ्क्षन्ति  desire.
explanation: Therefore, brahmins who have rightly understood the meaning of righteousness and adopt, with unmost care, the righteous ways as laid down in the scriptures seek attainment of higher positions.

shloka_text: निन्दाम्यहं कर्म कृतं पितुस्तद्यस्त्वामगृह्णाद्विषमस्थबुद्धिम्। बुद्ध्याऽनयैवंविधया चरन्तं सुनास्तिकं धर्मपथादपेतम्।।2.109.33।।
transliteration: nindāmyahaṃ karma kṛtaṃ pitustadyastvāmagṛhṇādviṣamasthabuddhim| buddhyā'nayaivaṃvidhayā carantaṃ sunāstikaṃ dharmapathādapetam
translation: यः who, विषमस्थबुद्धिम् (following the dishonest path with) perilous intelligence, एवं विधया such, बुद्ध्या with mind, चरन्तम् following, सुनास्तिकम् a great atheist, धर्मपथात् from the path of rightousness, आपेतम् dislodged, त्वाम् you, अगृह्णात् had taken, पितुः father, तत् that, कृतम् done, कर्म act, अहम् I, निन्दामि blame.
explanation: You are a great atheist, you have fallen from the path of righteousness. You are guided by an intellect which is extremely peridous. I, therefore, disapprove of my father's decision in inducting a man like you (into the council of ministers).

shloka_text: यथा हि चोर: स‌ तथा हि बुद्धस्तथागतं नास्तिकमत्र विद्धि। तस्माद्धि य: श‌ङ्क्यतमः प्रजानाम् न नास्तिकेनाभिमुखो बुध: स्यात्।।2.109.34।।
transliteration: yathā hi cora: sa‌ tathā hi buddhastathāgataṃ nāstikamatra viddhi| tasmāddhi ya: śa‌ṅkyatamaḥ prajānām na nāstikenābhimukho budha: syāt
translation: चोरः thief, यथा हि as he is, सः that, बुद्धः Buddha, a wise man, तथा हि is like that, तथागतम् Tathagata, having arrived, अत्र here, नास्तिकम् as an atheist, विद्धि know, तस्मात् hence, यः that one, प्रजानाम् for people, शङ्क्यतमः to be highly distrusted, बुधः learned man, नास्तिकेन with atheist, अभिमुखः come in contact, न स्यात् should not .
explanation: Just as a thief, so is the Buddha (a wise men). Know that the Tathagatas are atheists. They are men most distrusted among the people. A learned man should avoid atheists. (Note: Verses 31 to 39 appear to be interpolations, It is anachronistic to talk about Buddha in Tretayuga.)

shloka_text: त्वत्तो जनाः पूर्वतरे  द्विजाच्श्र शुभानि कर्माणि बहूनि चक्रुः। जित्वा सदेमं च परं च लोकं तस्माव्दिजा स्व‌स्ति हुतं कृतं च।।2.109.35।।
transliteration: tvatto janāḥ pūrvatare  dvijācśra śubhāni karmāṇi bahūni cakruḥ| jitvā sademaṃ ca paraṃ ca lokaṃ tasmāvdijā sva‌sti hutaṃ kṛtaṃ ca
translation: त्वत्तः to you, पूर्वतरे in preceding generations, वराश्च superior, जनाः men, शुभानि auspicious, बहूनि many, कर्माणि acts, चक्रुः performed, सदा always, इमं च this world, परं च the other world, जित्वा had conquered, तस्मात् therefore, द्विजाः twiceborn (brahmins), स्वस्ति of welfare, कृतम् (religious) acts, हुतं च also libations.
explanation: Men superior to you in preceding generations had conquered this world and the other world by always performing many auspicious acts. Twiceborn brahmins perform religious acts and offer libations for the welfare of the world.

shloka_text: धर्मे रता: स‌त्पुरुषै: स‌मेतास्तेजस्विनो दानगुणप्रधानाः। अहिंसका वीतमलाश्च लोके भवन्ति पूज्या मुनयः प्रधानाः।।2.109.36।।
transliteration: dharme ratā: sa‌tpuruṣai: sa‌metāstejasvino dānaguṇapradhānāḥ| ahiṃsakā vītamalāśca loke bhavanti pūjyā munayaḥ pradhānāḥ
translation: धर्मे in righteousness, रताः are engaged, सत्पुरुषैः with men of virtue, समेताः are associated, तेजस्विनः of radiant, दानगुण प्रधानाः charity as their chief virtue, अहिंसकाः eschewing violence, वीतमलाः purged of their sins, प्रधानाः supreme, मुनयः ascetics, लोके in this world, पूज्याः भवन्ति are truly worthy of reverence.
explanation: Those supreme ascetics who are radiant, devoted to righteousness and associated with men of virtue, with charity as their chief virtue, eschewing violence and purged of their impurities are truly worthy of reverence in this world.

shloka_text: इति ब्रुवन्तं वचनं सरोषं रामं महात्मानमदीनसत्त्वम्। उवाच पथ्यं पुनरास्तिकं च सत्यं वच: सानुनयं च विप्रः।।2.109.37।।
transliteration: iti bruvantaṃ vacanaṃ saroṣaṃ rāmaṃ mahātmānamadīnasattvam| uvāca pathyaṃ punarāstikaṃ ca satyaṃ vaca: sānunayaṃ ca vipraḥ
translation: इति thus, सरोषम् wrathful, वचनम् words, ब्रुवन्तम् speaking, महा त्मानम् magnanimous, अदीनसत्त्वम् with fearless intellect, रामम् Rama, विप्रः that brahmin, पथ्यम् beneficial, आस्तिकम् full of faith, सत्यम् of truth, वचः in words, पुनः again, सानुनयम् humbly, उवाच said.
explanation: Having heard the wrathful words of the magnanimous Rama of fearless intellect, that brahmin (Jabali) thus humbly replied in palatable, truthful words full of faith (in god).

shloka_text: न नास्तिकानां वचनं ब्रवीम्यहं न नास्तिकोऽहं न च नास्ति किञ्चन। समीक्ष्य कालं पुनरास्तिकोऽभवं भवेय काले पुनरेव नास्तिकः।।2.109.38।।
transliteration: na nāstikānāṃ vacanaṃ bravīmyahaṃ na nāstiko'haṃ na ca nāsti kiñcana| samīkṣya kālaṃ punarāstiko'bhavaṃ bhaveya kāle punareva nāstikaḥ
translation: अहम् I, नास्तिकानाम् atheists', वचनम् the language, न ब्रवीमि I do not speak, अहम् I, नास्तिकः an atheist, न not, किञ्चन in the least, न च नास्ति it is not that it (the other world) does not exist, कालम् time, समीक्ष्य seeing (in keeping with), पुनः again, आस्तिकः अभवम् I become  believer, काले on other occasion, पुनरेव again, नास्तिकः भवेय I shall become a nonbeliever.
explanation: I do not speak the language of atheists. I am not an atheist. I do not say that the next world does not exist. In keeping with time (occasion) I shall speak the language of a believer or a nonbeliever.

shloka_text: न चापि कालोऽय मुपागतश्शनैर्यथा मया नास्तिकवागुदीरिता। निवर्तनार्थं तव राम कारणात् प्रसादनार्थं च मयैतदीरितम्।।2.109.39।।
transliteration: na cāpi kālo'ya mupāgataśśanairyathā mayā nāstikavāgudīritā| nivartanārthaṃ tava rāma kāraṇāt prasādanārthaṃ ca mayaitadīritam
translation: राम O Rama, सः that, अयं कालः चापि appropriate time, शनैः slowly, उपागतः has come, मया by me, यथा as, नास्तिक वाक् words of an atheist, उदीरिता have been uttered, निवर्तनार्थम् to make you return, प्रसादनार्थं च to please you too, तव कारणात् for you, मया by me, एतत् all this, ईरितम् declared told.
explanation: O Rama, since the appropriate time has slowly come, I have uttered this. In order to persuade you to return and to propitiate you I have said these words. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे नवोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the one hundredninth sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: क्रुद्धमाज्ञाय रामं तु वसिष्ठः प्रत्युवाच ह। जाबालिरपि जानीते लोकस्यास्य गतागतिम्।।2.110.1।।
transliteration: kruddhamājñāya rāmaṃ tu vasiṣṭhaḥ pratyuvāca ha| jābālirapi jānīte lokasyāsya gatāgatim
translation: रामम् Rama, क्रुद्धम् as wrathful, आज्ञाय having perceived, वसिष्ठः Vasistha, प्रत्युवाच ह intercedes, जाबालिरपि Jabali also, अस्य लोकस्य to this world, गतागतिम् exits and entrances, जानीते is aware.
explanation: Seeing Rama angry Vasistha intercedes, saying that Jabali is wellaware of the exits and entrances of humans on earth.
comments: Vasistha explains about Brahman and about upholding of values by the Ikshvaku family -- persuades Rama the eldest son to rightfully occupy the throne.

shloka_text: निवर्तयितुकामस्तु त्वामेतद्वाक्यमब्रवीत्। इमां लोकसमुत्पत्तिं लोकनाथ निबोध मे।।2.110.2।।
transliteration: nivartayitukāmastu tvāmetadvākyamabravīt| imāṃ lokasamutpattiṃ lokanātha nibodha me
translation: त्वाम् to you, निवर्तयितुकामश्तु only with the intention to make you return, एतत् all this, वाक्यम् statement, उक्तवान् had spoken, लोकनाथ O lord of the worlds, इमाम् this, लोकसमुत्पत्तिम् origin of the world, मे to (from) me, निबोध get yourself acquainted.
explanation: O lord of the worlds, Jabali had spoken all this only with the intention to make you return (to Ayodhya). Listen I shall (now) relate to you the origin of the world.

shloka_text: सर्वं सलिलमेवासीत्पृथिवी यत्र निर्मिता। तत: स‌मभवद्ब्रह्मा स्वयम्भूर्दैवतै: स‌ह।।2.110.3।।
transliteration: sarvaṃ salilamevāsītpṛthivī yatra nirmitā| tata: sa‌mabhavadbrahmā svayambhūrdaivatai: sa‌ha
translation: सर्वम् all, सलिलम् एव आसीत् all this was water, यत्र where, पृथिवी the earth, निर्मिता was formed, ततः thereafter, स्वयंभूः the selfexistent, ब्रह्मा Brahma, दैवतैस्सह along with the gods, समभवत् came into existence.
explanation: At the beginning, all this was water from which the earth was created. Thereafter, the selfexistent Brahma along with the gods came into existence.

shloka_text: स वराहस्ततो भूत्वा प्रोज्जहार वसुन्धराम्। असृजच्च जगत्सर्वं सह पुत्रैः कृतात्मभिः।।2.110.4।।
transliteration: sa varāhastato bhūtvā projjahāra vasundharām| asṛjacca jagatsarvaṃ saha putraiḥ kṛtātmabhiḥ
translation: ततः then, सः he, वराहः in the form of a boar, भूत्वा becoming, वसुन्धराम् this earth, प्रोज्जहार uplifted, कृतात्मभिः by purified souls, पुत्रैः सह with sons, जगत् the world, असृजच्छ created.
explanation: Then he assumed the form of a boar and uplifted the earth and created this world   with his progeny of purified souls.

shloka_text: आकाशप्रभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्ययः। तस्मान्मरीचि: संज‌ज्ञे मरीचेः कश्यप: सुतः।।2.110.5।।
transliteration: ākāśaprabhavo brahmā śāśvato nitya avyayaḥ| tasmānmarīci: saṃja‌jñe marīceḥ kaśyapa: sutaḥ
translation: शाश्वतः eternal, नित्यः changeless, अव्ययः imperishable, ब्रह्मा Brahma, आकाशप्रभवः arose from space (as his birthplace), तस्मात् from him, मरीचिः Marichi, सञ्जज्ञे was born, कश्यपः Kasyapa, मरीचेः Marichi's, सुतः son.
explanation: Eternal, changeless and imperishable Brahma arose from space and to him was born Marichi and to Marichi, Kasyapa.

shloka_text: विवस्वान्काश्यपात् जज्ञे मनुर्वैवस्वत: स्वयम्। स तु प्रजापतिः पूर्वमिक्ष्वाकुस्तु मनो: सुतः।।2.110.6।।
transliteration: vivasvānkāśyapāt jajñe manurvaivasvata: svayam| sa tu prajāpatiḥ pūrvamikṣvākustu mano: sutaḥ
translation: काश्यपात् from Kasyapa, विवस्वान् Vivaswat (Sun), जज्ञे was born, मनुः Manu, वैवस्वतः Vivaswat's, सुतः son, स तु as for him, पूर्वम् first, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, इक्ष्वाकुः Ikshvaku, मनोः Manu's, सुतः son.
explanation: Kasyapa begot Vivaswat (the Sun) and Vivaswat, Manu. This Manu was the first Prajapati to him whom was born Ikshvaku.

shloka_text: यस्येयं प्रथमं दत्ता समृद्धा मनुना मही। तमिक्ष्वाकुमयोध्यायां राजानं विद्धि पूर्वकम्।।2.110.7।।
transliteration: yasyeyaṃ prathamaṃ dattā samṛddhā manunā mahī| tamikṣvākumayodhyāyāṃ rājānaṃ viddhi pūrvakam
translation: यस्य to whom, प्रथमम् originally, समृद्धा prosperous, मही earth, मनुना by Manu, दत्ता was bestowed, तम् that, इक्ष्वाकुम् Ikshvaku, अयोध्यायाम् of Ayodhya, पूर्वकम् first, राजानम् king, विद्धि please know.
explanation: Manu had orginally bestowed the most prosperous earth on Ikshvaku and you know  Ikshvaku was the first king of Ayodhya.

shloka_text: इक्ष्वाकोस्तु सुत  श्रीमान्कुक्षिरेवेति विश्रुतः। कुक्षेरथात्मजो वीरो विकुक्षिरुदपद्यत।।2.110.8।।
transliteration: ikṣvākostu suta  śrīmānkukṣireveti viśrutaḥ| kukṣerathātmajo vīro vikukṣirudapadyata
translation: इक्ष्वाकोः Ikshaku's, सुतः son, श्रीमान् illustrious, कुक्षिरेवेति as Kukshi, विश्रुतः wellknown, अथ thereafter, कुक्षेः Kukshi's, आत्मजः son, वीरः heroic, विकुक्षिः Vikukshi, उदपद्यत was born.
explanation: Ikshvaku had an illustrious son, wellknown as Kukshi and to Kukshi was born the heroic Vikukshi.

shloka_text: विकुक्षेस्तु महातेजा बाणः पुत्र प्रतापवान्। बाणस्य तु महाबाहुरनरण्यो महात‌पा:।।2.110.9।।
transliteration: vikukṣestu mahātejā bāṇaḥ putra pratāpavān| bāṇasya tu mahābāhuranaraṇyo mahāta‌pā:
translation: विकुक्षेः Vikukshi's, महातेजाः highly energetic, प्रतापवान् powerful, बाणः Bana, पुत्र: son, बाणस्य to Bana, महाबाहुः mighty armed, महायशाः of great renown, अनरण्यः Anaranya was born.
explanation: The son of Vikukshi was highly energetic and powerful Bana and to him was born the mightyarmed Anaranya of great renown.

shloka_text: नानावृष्टिर्बभूवास्मिन्नदुर्भिक्षं सतां वरे। अनरण्ये महाराजे तस्करो नापि कश्चन।।2.110.10।।
transliteration: nānāvṛṣṭirbabhūvāsminnadurbhikṣaṃ satāṃ vare| anaraṇye mahārāje taskaro nāpi kaścana
translation: सताम् among the virtuous, वरे the best, अस्मिन् in this, अनरण्ये in Anaranya, महाराजे when he was king, अनावृष्टिः drought, न बभूव did not take place, दुर्भिक्षम् famine, न not, तस्करः thieves, कश्चन none, न not.
explanation: When Anaranya, the best of the virtuous, was ruling the kingdom, there was no drought, no famine and not even a thief (in his kingdom).

shloka_text: अनरण्यान्महाबाहुः पृथु राजा बभूव ह। तस्मात्पृथोमेहाराजस्त्रिशङ्कुरुदपद्यत।।2.110.11।। स सत्यवचनाद् वीर: स‌शरीरो दिवं गतः।
transliteration: anaraṇyānmahābāhuḥ pṛthu rājā babhūva ha| tasmātpṛthomehārājastriśaṅkurudapadyata sa satyavacanād vīra: sa‌śarīro divaṃ gataḥ|
translation: अनरण्यात् of Anaranya, महाबाहुः mightyarmed, पृथुः Prithu, राजा king, बभूव ह was born, तस्मात् पृथोः from that Prithu, त्रिशङ्कुः Trishanku, महाराजः great king, उदपद्यत was born, सः वीरः that heroic man, सत्यवचनात् on account of his truthfulness, सशरीरः with his physical body, दिवम् heaven, गतः ascended.
explanation: Mightyarmed king Prithu was the son of Anaranya and Prithu was father of the great king Trishanku. That heroic Trishanku, on account of his truthfulness ascended the heaven with his physical body.

shloka_text: त्रिशङ्कोरभवत्सूनुर्दुन्धुमारो महायशाः।।2.110.12।। दुन्धुमारान्महातेजा युवनाश्वो व्यजायत।
transliteration: triśaṅkorabhavatsūnurdundhumāro mahāyaśāḥ dundhumārānmahātejā yuvanāśvo vyajāyata|
translation: त्रिशङ्कोः to Trishanku, महायशाः of illustrious, दुन्धुमारः Dundhumara, सूनुः as son, अभवत् became, दुन्धुमारात् from Dundhumara, महातेजाः exceedingly powerful, युवनाश्वः Yuvanaswa, व्यजायत was born.
explanation: Trishanku's son was illustrious Dundhumara, father of the exceedingly powerful Yuvanaswa.

shloka_text: युवनाश्वसुत श्श्रीमान्मान्धाता समपद्यत।।2.110.13।। मान्धातुस्त महातेजा: सुसन्धिरुदपद्यत। सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन्धिः प्रसेनजित्।।2.110.14।। यशस्वी ध्रुवसन्धेस्तु भरतो रिपुसूदनः।
transliteration: yuvanāśvasuta śśrīmānmāndhātā samapadyata māndhātusta mahātejā: susandhirudapadyata| susandherapi putrau dvau dhruvasandhiḥ prasenajit yaśasvī dhruvasandhestu bharato ripusūdanaḥ|
translation: श्रीमान् majestic, मान्धाता Mandhata, युवनाश्वसुतः as Yuvanasva's son, समपद्यत was born, मन्धातुः to Mandhat, महातेजाः mighty, सुसन्धि Susandhi, उदपध्यत was born, सुसंधेरपि and to Susandhi, ध्रुवसंधिः Dhruvasandhi, प्रसेनजित् Prasenjit, द्वौ two, पुत्रौ sons, यशस्वी renowned, रिपुसूदनः slayer of enemies, भरतः Bharata ध्रुवसन्धेः born to Dhruvasandhi.
explanation: Majestic Mandhata was Yuvanasva's son and father of mighty Susandhi. Sudsandhi had two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenjit. Renowned Bharata, slayer of enemies, was the son of Dhruvasandhi.

shloka_text: युवनाश्वसुत श्श्रीमान्मान्धाता समपद्यत।।2.110.13।। मान्धातुस्त महातेजा स्सुसन्धिरुदपद्यत। सुसन्धेरपि पुत्रौ द्वौ ध्रुवसन्धिः प्रसेनजित्।।2.110.14।। यशस्वी ध्रुवसन्धेस्तु भरतो रिपुसूदनः।
transliteration: yuvanāśvasuta śśrīmānmāndhātā samapadyata māndhātusta mahātejā ssusandhirudapadyata| susandherapi putrau dvau dhruvasandhiḥ prasenajit yaśasvī dhruvasandhestu bharato ripusūdanaḥ|
translation: श्रीमान् majestic, मान्धाता Mandhata, युवनाश्वसुतः as Yuvanasva's son, समपद्यत was born, मन्धातुः to Mandhat, महातेजाः mighty, सुसन्धि Susandhi, उदपध्यत was born, सुसंधेरपि and to Susandhi, ध्रुवसंधिः Dhruvasandhi, प्रसेनजित् Prasenjit, द्वौ two, पुत्रौ sons, यशस्वी  renowned, रिपुसूदनः slayer of enemies, भरतः Bharata  ध्रुवसन्धेः born to Dhruvasandhi.
explanation: Majestic Mandhata was Yuvanasva's son and father of mighty Susandhi. Sudsandhi had two sons Dhruvasandhi and Prasenjit. Renowned Bharata, slayer of enemies, was the son of Dhruvasandhi.

shloka_text: भरतात्तु महाबाहोरसितो नाम जायत।।2.110.15।। यस्यैते प्रतिराजान उदपद्यन्त शत्रवः। हैहयास्तालजङ्घाश्च शूराश्च शशिबिन्दवः।।2.110.16।।
transliteration: bharatāttu mahābāhorasito nāma jāyata yasyaite pratirājāna udapadyanta śatravaḥ| haihayāstālajaṅghāśca śūrāśca śaśibindavaḥ
translation: महाबाहोः of the mightyarmed, भरतात् Bharata, असितो नाम named Asita, (अ)जायत was born, यस्य to him, हैहयाः Haihayas, तालजङ्घाश्च Talajanghas, शूराः indomitable, शशिबिन्दवश्च Sasibindus also, प्रतिराजानः rival kings, शत्रवः as enemies, उदपद्यन्त rose up.
explanation: Mightyarmed Bharata had a son named Asita against whom the Haihayas, Talajanghas and the indomitable Sasibindus, the rival kings rose as enenmies.

shloka_text: भरतात्तु महाबाहोरसितो नाम जायत।।2.110.15।। यस्यैते प्रतिराजान उदपद्यन्त शत्रवः। हैहयास्तालजङ्घाश्च शूराश्च शशिबिन्दवः।।2.110.16।।
transliteration: bharatāttu mahābāhorasito nāma jāyata yasyaite pratirājāna udapadyanta śatravaḥ| haihayāstālajaṅghāśca śūrāśca śaśibindavaḥ
translation: महाबाहोः of the mightyarmed, भरतात् Bharata, असितो नाम named Asita, (अ)जायत was born, यस्य to him, हैहयाः Haihayas, तालजङ्घाश्च Talajanghas, शूराः indomitable, शशिबिन्दवश्च Sasibindus also, प्रतिराजानः rival kings, शत्रवः as enemies, उदपद्यन्त rose up.
explanation: Mightyarmed Bharata had a son named Asita against whom the Haihayas, Talajanghas and the indomitable Sasibindus, the rival kings rose as enenmies.

shloka_text: तांस्तु सर्वान्प्रतिव्यूह्य युद्धे राजा प्रवासितः। स च शैलवरे रम्ये बभूवाभिरतो मुनिः।।2.110.17।।
transliteration: tāṃstu sarvānprativyūhya yuddhe rājā pravāsitaḥ| sa ca śailavare ramye babhūvābhirato muniḥ
translation: राजा the king, युद्धे in battle, तान् सर्वान् all of them, प्रतिव्यूह्य having engaged, प्रवासितः driven into exile, सः he, रम्ये in a delightful, शैलवरे on a tall mountain, अभिरतः contented, मुनिः sage, बभूव became.
explanation: Although king Asita engaged all of them in a battle, he was (defeated and) driven into exile. He retired to a delightful, tall mountain and lived a life of contentment of a sage.

shloka_text: द्वे चास्य भार्ये गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुरिति श्रुतिः। एका गर्भविनाशाय सपत्न्यै गरलं ददौ।।2.110.18।।
transliteration: dve cāsya bhārye garbhiṇyau babhūvaturiti śrutiḥ| ekā garbhavināśāya sapatnyai garalaṃ dadau
translation: अस्य his, द्वे भार्ये two wives, गर्भिण्यौ बभूवतुः became pregnant, इति like this, श्रुतिः it is said, एका one, गर्भविनाशाय to destroy the embryo, सपत्नयै to her cowife, गरलम् poison, ददौ gave.
explanation: Both his wives became pregnant. It is said that one of them gave the other poison (with the motive) to destroy the embryo.

shloka_text: भार्गवश्च्यवनो नाम हिमवन्तमुपाश्रितः। तमृषिं समुपागम्य कालिन्दी त्वभ्यवादयत्।।2.110.19।। स तामभ्यवदद्विप्रो वरेप्सुं पुत्रजन्मनि।
transliteration: bhārgavaścyavano nāma himavantamupāśritaḥ| tamṛṣiṃ samupāgamya kālindī tvabhyavādayat sa tāmabhyavadadvipro varepsuṃ putrajanmani|
translation: भार्गवः descendant of Bhrigu, च्यवनो नाम Chyavana by name, हिमवन्तम् Himavat mountain, उपाश्रितः had taken shelter, कालिन्दी Kalindi, तं ऋषिम् that rishi, समुपागम्य having approached, अभ्यवादयत् paid obeisance, सः विप्रः that brahmin, पुत्रजन्मनि for the birth of a son, वरेप्सुम् craving for a boon, ताम्  to her, अभ्यवदत् said.
explanation: A descendant of Bhrigu named Chyavana dwelt upon the Himavat mountain; Kalindi approached that sage and paid obeisance, and the brahmin spoke to her who craved a boon for the birth of a son.

shloka_text: पुत्रस्ते भविता देवि महात्मा लोकविश्रुतः।।2.110.20।। धार्मिकश्च सुशीलश्च वंशकर्ताऽरिसूदनः।
transliteration: putraste bhavitā devi mahātmā lokaviśrutaḥ dhārmikaśca suśīlaśca vaṃśakartā'risūdanaḥ|
translation: देवि O queen, ते to you, महात्मा magnanimous, लोक विश्रुतः renowned in the world, धार्मिकश्च virtuous, सुशीलश्च of good conduct, वंशकर्ता perpetuator of the race, अरिसूदनः destroyer of enemies, पुत्र a son, भविता will be born.
explanation: O queen, you will beget a son who will be magnanimous, virtuous, renowned in the world. He will be the perpetuator of the race and destroyer of enemies.

shloka_text: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं हृष्टा मुनिंतमनुमान्य च।।2.110.21।। पद्मपत्रसमानाक्षं पद्मगर्भसमप्रभम्। तत: सा गृहमागम्य देवी पुत्रं व्यजायत।।2.110.22।।
transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ hṛṣṭā muniṃtamanumānya ca padmapatrasamānākṣaṃ padmagarbhasamaprabham| tata: sā gṛhamāgamya devī putraṃ vyajāyata
translation: सा देवी that queen, हृष्टा delighted, तं मुनिम् to that sage, प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, कृत्वा having made, अनुमान्य च taking leave of him, ततः then, गृहम् to home, आगम्य having returned, पद्मपत्रसमानाक्षम् with eyes like lotus petals, पद्मगर्भसमप्रभम् resplendent like Brahma, पुत्रम् son, व्यजायत gave birth.
explanation: The queen was happy. She circumambulated the sage, took leave of him and came back home. Thereafter, she gave birth to a son who had eyes like lotus petals and who looked resplendent like Brahma.

shloka_text: कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणं हृष्टा मुनिंतमनुमान्य च।।2.110.21।। पद्मपत्रसमानाक्षं पद्मगर्भसमप्रभम्। तत: सा गृहमागम्य देवी पुत्रं व्यजायत।।2.110.22।।
transliteration: kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ hṛṣṭā muniṃtamanumānya ca padmapatrasamānākṣaṃ padmagarbhasamaprabham| tata: sā gṛhamāgamya devī putraṃ vyajāyata
translation: सा देवी that queen, हृष्टा delighted, तं मुनिम् to that sage, प्रदक्षिणं circumambulation, कृत्वा having made, अनुमान्य च taking leave of him, ततः then, गृहम् to home, आगम्य having returned, पद्मपत्रसमानाक्षम् with eyes like lotus petals, पद्मगर्भसमप्रभम् resplendent like Brahma, पुत्रम् son, व्यजायत gave birth.
explanation: The queen was happy. She circumambulated the sage, took leave of him and came back home. Thereafter, she gave birth to a son who had eyes like lotus petals and who looked resplendent like Brahma.

shloka_text: सपत्न्या तु गरस्तस्यै दत्तो गर्भजिघांसया। गरेण सह तेनैव जात स्स सगरोऽभवत्।।2.110.23।।
transliteration: sapatnyā tu garastasyai datto garbhajighāṃsayā| gareṇa saha tenaiva jāta ssa sagaro'bhavat
translation: सपत्नया by her cowife, गर्भजिघांसया with a motive to destroy the embryo, तस्यै to her, गरः poison, दत्तः given, तेन for that reason, गरेण सहैव with poison, जातः born, सः he, सगरः Sagara, अभवत् became.
explanation: With a motive to destroy the embryo her cowife had poisoned her. That child was born with gara or poison for which he was called  Sagara.

shloka_text: स राजा सगरो नाम य: स‌मुद्रमखानयत्। इष्ट्वा पर्वणि वेगेन त्रासयन इमाः प्रजाः।।2.110.24।
transliteration: sa rājā sagaro nāma ya: sa‌mudramakhānayat| iṣṭvā parvaṇi vegena trāsayana imāḥ prajāḥ||2.110.24|
translation: सः he, सगरो नाम राजा a king, Sagara by name, यः who, इष्ट्वा having performed a sacrifice, पर्वणि on a fullmoon day, वेगेन swiftly, इमाः प्रजाः these men, त्रासयन्तम् frightening, समुद्रम् the ocean, अखानयत् excavated.
explanation: The king Sagara performed a sacrifice on the fullmoon day. And swiftly dug the ocean that frightened the people.

shloka_text: असमञ्जस्तु पुत्रोऽभूत्सगरस्येति न श्श्रुतम्। जीवन्नेव स पित्रा तु निरस्तः पापकर्मकृत्।।2.110.25।।
transliteration: asamañjastu putro'bhūtsagarasyeti na śśrutam| jīvanneva sa pitrā tu nirastaḥ pāpakarmakṛt
translation: असमञ्जः Asamanja, सगरस्य Sagara's, पुत्रः son, अभूत् became, इति thus, नः for us, श्रुतम् heard, पापकर्मकृत् one who indulged in sinful deeds, सः he, जीवन्नेव while he was living in the kingdom, पित्रा by father, निरस्तः banished.
explanation: We have heard that a son, Asamanja by name, was born to Sagara. For his sinful deeds he was banished by his father while he was still alive.

shloka_text: अंशुमानिति पुत्रोऽभूदसमञ्जस्य वीर्यवान्। दिलीपोंशुमतः पुत्रो दिलीपस्य भगीरथः।।2.110.26।।
transliteration: aṃśumāniti putro'bhūdasamañjasya vīryavān| dilīpoṃśumataḥ putro dilīpasya bhagīrathaḥ
translation: असमञ्जस्य Asamanja's, वीर्यवान् valiant, अंशुमानिति Anshuman by name, पुत्रः son, अभूत् was born, दिलीपः Dilipa, अंशुमतः Ansuman's, पुत्रः son, भगीरथः Bhagiratha, दिलीपस्य was son of Dilipa.
explanation: Valiant Anshuman was the son of Asamanja and the father of Dilipa. Dilipa's son was Bhagiratha.

shloka_text: भगीरथात्ककुत्स्थस्तु काकुत्स्था येन विश्रुताः। ककुत्स्थस्य च पुत्रोऽभूद्रघुर्येन च राघवाः।।2.110.27।।
transliteration: bhagīrathātkakutsthastu kākutsthā yena viśrutāḥ| kakutsthasya ca putro'bhūdraghuryena ca rāghavāḥ
translation: भगीरथात् from Bhagiratha, ककुत्स्थ: Kakutstha, येन by whom, काकुत्स्थाः as Kakutsthas, विश्रुताः are celebrated, ककुत्स्थस्य च to Kakutstha, रघुः Raghu, पुत्रः son, अभूत् was born, येन  by whom, राघवाः Raghavas
explanation: To Bhagiratha was born Kakutstha, by whom your race is wellknown. A son Raghu was born to Kakutstha and hence all of you are known as Raghavas.

shloka_text: रघोस्तु पुत्रस्तेजस्वी प्रवृद्धः पुरुषादकः। कल्माषपाद स्सौदास इत्येवं प्रथितो भुवि।।2.110.28।।
transliteration: raghostu putrastejasvī pravṛddhaḥ puruṣādakaḥ| kalmāṣapāda ssaudāsa ityevaṃ prathito bhuvi
translation: रघोः Raghu, तेजस्वी illustrious, पुत्रः son, प्रवृद्धः has grown, पुरुषादकः Purushadaka, कल्माषपादः Kalmasapada, सौदासः Sowdasa, इत्येवम् like these, भुवि in this world, प्रथितः became famous.
explanation: The illustrious son of Raghu became famous in the world under the names of  Kalmasapada and Sowdasa. The curse of a sage turned him a devourer of men for some years.

shloka_text: कल्माषपादपुत्रोऽभूच्छङ्खणस्त्विति विश्रुतः। यस्तु तद्वीर्यमासाद्य सहसैन्यो व्यनीनशत्।।2.110.29।।
transliteration: kalmāṣapādaputro'bhūcchaṅkhaṇastviti viśrutaḥ| yastu tadvīryamāsādya sahasainyo vyanīnaśat
translation: शङ्खणः Shankhana, इति thus, विश्रुतः is famous, कल्माषपादपुत्रः as son of Kalmashapada, अभूत् became, यः whoever, तद्वीर्यम् with that prowess, आसाद्य having been target acquired, सहसैन्यः with his army, व्यनीनशत् was destroyed.
explanation: Shankhana was the famous son of Kalmashapada. Whoever challenged his prowess was routed  with his entire army.

shloka_text: शङ्खणस्य च पुत्रोऽभूच्छूर श्रीमान्सुदर्शनः। सुदर्शनस्याग्निवर्णः अग्निवर्णस्य शीघ्रगः।।2.110.30।। शीघ्रगस्य मरुः पुत्रो मरोः पुत्रः प्रशुश्रुवः। प्रशुश्रुवस्य पुत्रोभूदम्बरीषो महाद्युतिः।।2.110.31।। अम्बरीषस्य पुत्रोभून्नहुषः सत्यविक्रमः। नहुषस्य च नाभागः पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः।।2.110.32।। अजश्च सुव्रतश्चैव नाभागस्य सुतावुभौ। अजस्यैव च धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्सुतः।।2.110.33।।
transliteration: śaṅkhaṇasya ca putro'bhūcchūra śrīmānsudarśanaḥ| sudarśanasyāgnivarṇaḥ agnivarṇasya śīghragaḥ śīghragasya maruḥ putro maroḥ putraḥ praśuśruvaḥ| praśuśruvasya putrobhūdambarīṣo mahādyutiḥ ambarīṣasya putrobhūnnahuṣaḥ satyavikramaḥ| nahuṣasya ca nābhāgaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ajaśca suvrataścaiva nābhāgasya sutāvubhau| ajasyaiva ca dharmātmā rājā daśarathassutaḥ
translation: शङ्खणस्य to Shankhana, श्रीमान् glorious, सुदर्शनः Sudarshana, पुत्रः was his son, सुदर्शनस्य to Sudarshana, अग्निवर्णः Agnivarna, अग्निवर्णस्य to Agnivarna, शीघ्रगः Shighraga, शीघ्रगस्य to Shighraga, पुत्रः son, मरुः Maru, मरोः to Maru, पुत्रः son, प्रशुश्रुवः Prashushruva, प्रशुश्रुवस्य to Prashushruva, महाद्युतिः splendid, अम्बरीषः Ambarisha पुत्रः son, अभूत् was born, अम्बरीषस्य to Ambarisha, सत्यविक्रम: a man of real prowess, नहुषः Nahusha, पुत्रः son, अभूत् was born, नहुषस्य to Nahusha, परमधार्मिकः supremely righteous, नाभागः Nabhaga, पुत्रः son, नाभागस्य to Nabhaga, अजश्च Aja, सुव्रतश्चैव and Suvrata, उभौ two, सुतौ sons, धर्मात्मा rigtheous, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, अजस्यैव to Aja, सुतः son.
explanation: The son of Shankhana was the glorious Sudarshana, father of Agnivarna. Shighraga was the son of Agnivarna whose son was Maru. Maru's son was Prashushruva and to Prashushruva was born splendid Ambarisha. Nahusha of indisputable prowess was the son of Ambarisha whose son was the supremely righteous Nabhaga. Nabhaga had two sons, Aja and Suvrata and Aja's son was the righteous king Dasaratha.

shloka_text: तस्य ज्येष्ठोऽसि दायादो राम इत्यभिविश्रुतः। तद्गृहाण स्वकं राज्यमवेक्षस्व जनं नृप।।2.110.34।।
transliteration: tasya jyeṣṭho'si dāyādo rāma ityabhiviśrutaḥ| tadgṛhāṇa svakaṃ rājyamavekṣasva janaṃ nṛpa
translation: राम इति as Rama, अभिविश्रुतः known far and wide, तस्य that king's, दायादः an heir, ज्येष्ठः असि are the eldest son, नृपः O king, तत् for that reason, स्वकम् is your own, राज्यम् kingdom, गृहाण accept, जनम् the people, अवेक्षस्व look after.
explanation: Being the eldest son of king Dasaratha and widely  known as Rama you happen to be the  heir apparent. Hence, O king, accept the kingdom and look after the people.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठस्तु तदा राममुक्त्वा राजपुरोहितः। अब्रवीद्धर्मसंयुक्तं पुनरेवापरं वचः।।2.111.1।।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhastu tadā rāmamuktvā rājapurohitaḥ| abravīddharmasaṃyuktaṃ punarevāparaṃ vacaḥ
translation: राजपुरोहितः  royal priest, वसिष्टस्तु Vasistha on his part, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, उक्त्वा  spoke further, पुनरेव again, धर्मसंयुक्तम् on righteousness, अपरं वचः some otherword, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Vasistha, the family priest, continued to speak to Rama on righteousness.
comments: Vasistha explains the value of conforming to righteousness -- pleads with Rama to grant the wishes of Bharata and respect  his request -- Rama declines.

shloka_text: पुरुषस्येह जातस्य भवन्ति गुरवस्त्रयः। आचार्यश्चैव काकुत्स्थ पिता माता च राघव।।2.111.2।।
transliteration: puruṣasyeha jātasya bhavanti guravastrayaḥ| ācāryaścaiva kākutstha pitā mātā ca rāghava
translation: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, राघव Rama, जातस्य of one who is born, पुरुषस्य for a person, आचार्यश्चैव the preceptor, पिता the father, माता च the mother, त्रयः three, गुरवः भवन्ति   become gurus.
explanation: Every man born has three preceptors. They are his teacher, father and mother.

shloka_text: पिता ह्येवं जनयति पुरुषं पुरुषर्षभ। प्रज्ञां ददाति चाचार्यस्तस्मात्स गुरुरुच्यते।।2.111.3।।
transliteration: pitā hyevaṃ janayati puruṣaṃ puruṣarṣabha| prajñāṃ dadāti cācāryastasmātsa gururucyate
translation: पुरुषर्षभ O best of men, एवं पुरुषम् in such a way a man, पिता father, जनयति हि begets, आचार्यः teacher, प्रज्ञाम् wisdom, ददाति gives, तस्मात् therefore, सः that (teacher), गुरुः     become guru, उच्यते is called.
explanation: O best of men, the father brings forth a son. The teacher imparts him wisdom. Therefore, the teacher is considered superior.

shloka_text: सोऽहं ते पितुराचार्यस्तव चैव परन्तप। मम त्वं वचनं कुर्वन्नातिवर्तेस्सतां गतिम्।।2.111.4।।
transliteration: so'haṃ te piturācāryastava caiva parantapa| mama tvaṃ vacanaṃ kurvannātivartessatāṃ gatim
translation: सः अहम् that I, ते पितुः of your father, तव चैव and also your, आचार्यः preceptor, परन्तप O destroyer of foes, त्वम् you, मम my, वचनम् order, कुर्वन् carrying out, सताम् of virtuous men's, गतिम् path, नातिवर्तेः you will not transgress.
explanation: I was preceptor to your father and also to you. O destroyer of foes, by following my words, you will not transgress the path of the virtuous.

shloka_text: इमा हि ते परिषद श्श्रेणयश्च द्विजास्तथा। एषु तात चरन्धर्मं नातिवर्ते: स‌तां गतिम्।।2.111.5।।
transliteration: imā hi te pariṣada śśreṇayaśca dvijāstathā| eṣu tāta carandharmaṃ nātivarte: sa‌tāṃ gatim
translation: तात my child, इमाः these, परिषदः assembly of men, श्रेणयश्च guilds of merchants and others, तथा also, द्विजाः the twiceborn, ते हि are yours, एषु towards them, धर्मम् duty, चरन् while practising, सताम् of the virtuous, गतिम् path, नातिवर्तेः you will never swerve.
explanation: All these learned men, guilds of merchants and the twiceborn (brahmins) of this assembly are your men. By fulfilling your duty towards them, you will never swerve from the path of the virtuous.

shloka_text: वृद्धाया धर्मशीलाया मातुर्नार्हस्यवर्तितुम्। अस्या हि वचनं कुर्वन्नातिवर्तेस्सतां गतिम्।।2.111.6।।
transliteration: vṛddhāyā dharmaśīlāyā māturnārhasyavartitum| asyā hi vacanaṃ kurvannātivartessatāṃ gatim
translation: वृद्धायाः of an aged woman, धर्मशीलायाः of a righteousminded woman, मातुः of the mother, अवर्तितुम् not to attend her, नार्हसि is not proper, अस्याः her, वचनम् words, कुर्वन् obeying, सताम् of the virtuous, गतिम् path, नातिवर्तेः you will not deviate.
explanation: Here is your aged and righteous mother. It does not behove you to deny your service to her. By obeying her, you will never deviate from the path of the virtuous.

shloka_text: भरतस्य वचः कुर्वन्याचमानस्य राघव। आत्मानं नातिवर्तेस्त्वं सत्यधर्मपराक्रम।।2.111.7।।
transliteration: bharatasya vacaḥ kurvanyācamānasya rāghava| ātmānaṃ nātivartestvaṃ satyadharmaparākrama
translation: सत्यधर्मपराक्रम one whose strength comes from truth and righteousness, राघव Rama, त्वम् you, याचमानस्य of the supplicant, भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, कुर्वन् by following, आत्मानम् call of your soul, नातिवर्तेः will not ignore.
explanation: O scion of the Raghus whose strength springs from truth and righteousness, if you accede to the prayers of Bharata, you will not ignore the call of your soul.

shloka_text: एवं मधुरमुक्तस्सन् गुरुणा राघवस्स्वयम्। प्रत्युवाच समासीनं वसिष्ठं पुरुषर्षभः।।2.111.8।।
transliteration: evaṃ madhuramuktassan guruṇā rāghavassvayam| pratyuvāca samāsīnaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
translation: पुरुषर्षभः the best of men, राघवः Rama, गुरुणा by the preceptor, स्वयम् personally, एवम् in that way, मधुरम् with sweet words, उक्तस्सन् by having been addressed, समासीनम् who was sitting beside, वसिष्ठम्  to Vasistha, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: When Rama, the best of men, was advised personally by Vasistha, the preceptor, with sweet words, he replied to him who was sitting beside him:

shloka_text: यन्मातापितरौ वृत्तं तनये कुरुत: स‌दा। न सुप्रतिकरं तत् तु मात्रा पित्रा च यत्कृतम्।।2.111.9।। यथाशक्ति प्रदानेन स्वापनोच्छादनेन च। नित्यं च प्रियवादेन तथा संवर्धनेन च।।2.111.10।।
transliteration: yanmātāpitarau vṛttaṃ tanaye kuruta: sa‌dā| na supratikaraṃ tat tu mātrā pitrā ca yatkṛtam yathāśakti pradānena svāpanocchādanena ca| nityaṃ ca priyavādena tathā saṃvardhanena ca
translation: मातापितरौ parents, तनये in relation to son, सदा always, यत् what, वृत्तम् course of action, कुरुतः perform, यथाशक्तिप्रदानेन by conferring benefits according to their resources, स्वापनोच्छादनेन च by lulling him to sleep, clothing him, नित्यं च always, प्रियवादेन with affectionate words, तथा similarly, संवर्धनेन च bringing him up, मात्रा by mother, पित्रा च and by father, यत् what, कृतम् was done, तत्तु all that, न सुप्रतिकरम् cannot easily be repaid.
explanation: The course of action the parents always adopt in respect of their son, the benefits they confer on him according to their resources, the way they lull him to sleep and clothe him, the affectionate words they always speak to him and the way they bring him up all these cannot be repaid.

shloka_text: यन्मातापितरौ वृत्तं तनये कुरुतस्सदा। न सुप्रतिकरं तत्तु मात्रा पित्रा च यत्कृतम्।।2.111.9।। यथाशक्तिप्रदानेन स्वापनोच्छादनेन च। नित्यं च प्रियवादेन तथा संवर्धनेन च।।2.111.10।।
transliteration: yanmātāpitarau vṛttaṃ tanaye kurutassadā| na supratikaraṃ tattu mātrā pitrā ca yatkṛtam yathāśaktipradānena svāpanocchādanena ca| nityaṃ ca priyavādena tathā saṃvardhanena ca
translation: मातापितरौ parents, तनये in relation to son, सदा always, यत् what, वृत्तम् course of action, कुरुतः perform, यथाशक्तिप्रदानेन by conferring benefits according to their resources, स्वापनोच्छादनेन च by lulling him to sleep, clothing him, नित्यं च always, प्रियवादेन with affectionate words, तथा similarly, संवर्धनेन च bringing him up, मात्रा by mother, पित्रा च and by father, यत् what, कृतम् was done, तत्तु all that, न सुप्रतिकरम् cannot easily be repaid.
explanation: The course of action the parents always adopt in respect of their son, the benefits they confer on him according to their resources, the way they lull him to sleep and clothe him, the affectionate words they always speak to him and the way they bring him up all these cannot be repaid.

shloka_text: स हि राजा जनयिता पिता दशरथो मम। आज्ञातं यन्मया तस्य न तन्मिथ्या भविष्यति।।2.111.11।।
transliteration: sa hi rājā janayitā pitā daśaratho mama| ājñātaṃ yanmayā tasya na tanmithyā bhaviṣyati
translation: मम my, पिता father, सः that, राजा दशरथः king Dasaratha, जनयिता हि he begot me, मया by me, तस्य to him, यत् whatever, आज्ञातं was promised, तत् that one, मिथ्या false, न भविष्यति shall not become.
explanation: King Dasaratha is my father who begot me. The promise I made him shall not prove false.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण भरतः प्रत्यनन्तरम्। उवाच परमोदारस्सूतं परमदुर्मनाः।।2.111.12।।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa bharataḥ pratyanantaram| uvāca paramodārassūtaṃ paramadurmanāḥ
translation: परमोदारः a man of great generosity, भरतः Bharata, रामेण by Rama, एवम् in this way, उक्तः having been addressed, परमदुर्मनाः with extremely distressed mind, प्रत्यनन्तरं who was  nearby, सूतम् to the charioteer, उवाच said.
explanation: Having been addressed by Rama in this way, Bharata of great generosity, in extreme distress, addressing the charioteer who was standing nearby said:

shloka_text: इह मे स्थण्डिले शीघ्रं कुशानास्तर सारथे। आर्यं प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यामि यावन्मे न प्रसीदति।।2.111.13।।
transliteration: iha me sthaṇḍile śīghraṃ kuśānāstara sārathe| āryaṃ pratyupavekṣyāmi yāvanme na prasīdati
translation: सारथे O charioteer, मे to me, इह here, स्थण्डिले on the bare ground, शीघ्रम् quickly, कुशान् kusa grass, आस्तर spread, यावत् till such time, मे to me, न प्रसीदति does not show his grace, आर्यम् esteemed brother Rama, प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यामि shall lie down here waiting for him.
explanation: O charioteer, quickly spread kusa grass on the bare ground. Until my esteemed brother shows his grace, I shall lie down here -- waiting.

shloka_text: अनाहारो निरालोको धनहीनो यथा द्विजः। शेष्ये पुरस्ताच्छालाया यावन्न प्रतियास्यति।।2.111.14।।
transliteration: anāhāro nirāloko dhanahīno yathā dvijaḥ| śeṣye purastācchālāyā yāvanna pratiyāsyati
translation: धनहीन: poor, द्विजः यथा like a brahmin, अनाहारः starve, निरालोकः  without seeing the light (of the day), शालायाः of the hut, पुरस्तात् in front of, यावत् till such time, न प्रतियास्यति does not return, शेष्ये I shall lie down.
explanation: Like a poor brahmin, starving, my face muffled, I shall lie down in front of the hut until he agrees to return.

shloka_text: स तु राममवेक्षन्तं सुमन्त्रं पेक्ष्य दुर्मनाः। कुशोत्तरमुपस्थाप्य भूमावेवाऽस्तरत्स्वयम्।।2.111.15।।
transliteration: sa tu rāmamavekṣantaṃ sumantraṃ pekṣya durmanāḥ| kuśottaramupasthāpya bhūmāvevā'staratsvayam
translation: दुर्मनाः of troubled mind, स तु that Bharata, रामम् at Rama, अवेक्षन्तम् glancing at, सुमन्त्रम् Sumantra, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, स्वयमेव himself, कुशोत्तरम् of kusa grass, उपस्थाप्य having brought, भूमौ on the ground, आस्तरत् spread.
explanation: Bharata was mentally disturbed saw Sumantra waiting for Rama's order. Then he himself brought a heap of kusa grass and spread it on the ground.

shloka_text: तमुवाच महातेजा रामो राजर्षिसत्तमः। किं मां भरत कुर्वाणं तात प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसि।।2.111.16।।
transliteration: tamuvāca mahātejā rāmo rājarṣisattamaḥ| kiṃ māṃ bharata kurvāṇaṃ tāta pratyupavekṣyasi
translation: महातेजाः highly powerful, राजर्षिसत्तमः the foremost of royal sages, रामः Rama, तम् to him (Bharata), उवाच said, तातः O dear one, भरत Bharata, किं कुर्वाणम् what have I done, माम्  before me, प्रत्युपवेक्ष्यसि preventing me by lying down?
explanation: Rama, the foremost of royal sages and highly powerful said, 'Dear Bharata, what wrong have I done that you should prevent me by lying down in front of me?'

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणो ह्येकपार्श्वेन नरान्रोद्धुमिहार्हति। न तु मूर्धाभिषिक्तानां विधिः प्रत्युपवेशने।।2.111.17।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇo hyekapārśvena narānroddhumihārhati| na tu mūrdhābhiṣiktānāṃ vidhiḥ pratyupaveśane
translation: ब्राह्मणः brahmin, एकपार्श्वेन (lying down) on one side, नरान् to men, इह in this world, रोद्धुम् to prevent, अर्हति हि is competent, मूर्धाभिषिक्तानां तु for one who is anointed king, प्रत्युपवेशने  to sit in protest, विधिः न there is no tradition.
explanation: A brahmin alone is competent in this world to prevent a person by lying down on one side (in front of him). One who is anointed king is not permitted by (scriptural) tradition to squat in protest.

shloka_text: उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल हित्वैतद्दारुणं व्रतम्। पुरवर्यामितः क्षिप्रमयोध्यां याहि राघव।।2.111.18।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla hitvaitaddāruṇaṃ vratam| puravaryāmitaḥ kṣipramayodhyāṃ yāhi rāghava
translation: नरशार्दूल O best of men, राघव Bharata, एतत् all this, दारुणम् formidable, व्रतम् resolve, हित्वा give up, उत्तिष्ठ arise, इतः from here, क्षिप्रम् quickly, पुरवर्याम् to the best of cities, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, याहि you may return.
explanation: O Bharata, O tiger among men, O scion of the Raghu race give up this formidable vow. Arise and quickly return to Ayodhya, the best of cities.

shloka_text: आसीनस्त्वेव भरतः पौरजानपदं जनम्। उवाच सर्वतः प्रेक्ष्य किमार्यं नानुशासथ।।2.111.19।।
transliteration: āsīnastveva bharataḥ paurajānapadaṃ janam| uvāca sarvataḥ prekṣya kimāryaṃ nānuśāsatha
translation: भरतः Bharata, आसीनस्त्वेव while remaining seated, पौरजानपदम् men inhabiting towns and villages, जनम् men, सर्वतः on all sides, प्रेक्ष्य looking, आर्यम् esteemed brother, किम् why, नानुशासथ don't you all persuade, उवाच said.
explanation: While remaining seated, Bharata looking all around at the inhabitants from towns and villages, questioned them 'why don't you all persuade my esteemed brother to return'.

shloka_text: ते तदोचुर्महात्मानं पौरजानपदा जनाः। काकुत्स्थमभिजानीमः सम्यग् वदति राघवः।।2.111.20।।
transliteration: te tadocurmahātmānaṃ paurajānapadā janāḥ| kākutsthamabhijānīmaḥ samyag vadati rāghavaḥ
translation: पौरजानपदाः inhabiting in towns and villages, ते जनाः those people, महात्मानम्  magnanimous, तम् to Bharata, ऊचुः uttered, काकुत्स्थम् about Kakustha (Rama), अभिजानीयः we know very well, राघवः Rama, सम्यक् properly, वदति  says.
explanation: Those inhabitants from towns and villages replied to the magnanimous Bharata 'we  know the scion of the Kakutha dynasty, Rama, very well. What he has said is proper'.

shloka_text: एषोऽपि हि महाभागः पितुर्वचसि तिष्ठति। अत एव न शक्ताः स्मो व्यावर्तयितुमञ्जसा।।2.111.21।।
transliteration: eṣo'pi hi mahābhāgaḥ piturvacasi tiṣṭhati| ata eva na śaktāḥ smo vyāvartayitumañjasā
translation: एषः this, महाभागः highly distinguished Rama, पितुः father's, वचसि word, तिष्ठति हि is fixed, अत एव that is why, अञ्जसा quickly, व्यावर्तयितुम् to make him return, शक्ताः capable, न स्मः not.
explanation: Highly distinguished Rama is firmly fixed on the command of his father. That is why we are incapable of making him return quickly.

shloka_text: तेषामाज्ञाय वचनं रामो वचनमब्रवीत्। एवं निबोध वचनं सुहृदां धर्मचक्षुषाम्।।2.111.22।।
transliteration: teṣāmājñāya vacanaṃ rāmo vacanamabravīt| evaṃ nibodha vacanaṃ suhṛdāṃ dharmacakṣuṣām
translation: रामः Rama, तेषाम् their, वचनम् words, आज्ञाय having understood, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said, धर्मचक्षुषाम् through righteous vision, सुहृदाम् friends, एवम् in this way, वचनम् words, निबोध  understand.
explanation: Having understood their words, Rama said to him, 'Listen to the words of our friends who have a righteous vision.'

shloka_text: एतच्चैवोभयं श्रुत्वा सम्यक्सम्पश्य राघव। उत्तिष्ठ त्वं महाबाहो मां च स्पृश तथोदकम्।।2.111.23।।
transliteration: etaccaivobhayaṃ śrutvā samyaksampaśya rāghava| uttiṣṭha tvaṃ mahābāho māṃ ca spṛśa tathodakam
translation: महाबाहो O mightyarmed one, राघव Bharata, एतत् all this, उभयं चैव both, श्रुत्वा having heard, सम्यक् carefully, सम्पश्य having thought over, त्वम् you, उत्तिष्ठ arise, मां च me, तथा as also, उदकम् water, स्पृश touch.
explanation: O mightyarmed son of the Raghus, you have heard both (them and me). Carefully think over. Arise. Touch me and sip water.

shloka_text: अथोत्थाय जलंस्पृष्ट्वा भरतो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। श्रुण्वन्तु मे परिषदो मन्त्रिण श्श्रेणयस्तथा।।2.111.24।।
transliteration: athotthāya jalaṃspṛṣṭvā bharato vākyamabravīt| śruṇvantu me pariṣado mantriṇa śśreṇayastathā
translation: अथ then, भरतः Bharata, उत्थाय having stood up, जलम् water, स्पृष्ट्वा having touched, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, परिषदः O men of the assembly, मन्त्रिणः O counsellors, तथा also, श्रेणयः O guildsmen, मे me, श्रुण्वन्तु listen.
explanation: Then Bharata stood up and performed achamana (sipping of water) and said 'let the assembly of  learned men, counsellors and guildsmen hear me'.

shloka_text: न याचे पितरं राज्यं नानुशासामि मातरम्। आर्यं परमधर्मज्ञं नानुजानामि राघवम्।।2.111.25।।
transliteration: na yāce pitaraṃ rājyaṃ nānuśāsāmi mātaram| āryaṃ paramadharmajñaṃ nānujānāmi rāghavam
translation: पितरम् my father, राज्यम् kingdom, न याचे did not ask, मातरम् mother, नानुशासामि did not urge, परमधर्मज्ञम् supremely knowleldgeable in ways of righteousness, आर्यम् esteemed, राघवम् Rama, नानुजानामि I did not consent.
explanation: I never asked my father to confer the kingdom on me. I never urged my mother to seek the kingdom for me. I never supported the exile of my esteemed brother Rama, who is supreme in the knowleldge of righteousness.

shloka_text: यदित्ववश्यं वस्तव्यं कर्तव्यं च पितुर्वचः। अहमेव निवत्स्यामि चतुर्दश समा वने।।2.111.26।।
transliteration: yaditvavaśyaṃ vastavyaṃ kartavyaṃ ca piturvacaḥ| ahameva nivatsyāmi caturdaśa samā vane
translation: अवश्यम् absolutely, वस्तव्यं यदि if it is essential to live in the forest, पितुः father's, वचः words, कर्तव्यं च must be done, अहमेव I myself, चतुर्दश समाः fourteen years, वने in the forest, निवत्स्यामि I will reside.
explanation: If it is absolutely essential to live in the forest in accordance with the command of my father, I myself  shall also dwell in the forest for fourteen years.

shloka_text: धर्मात्मा तस्य तथ्येन भ्रातुर्वाक्येन विस्मितः। उवाच राम स्सम्प्रेक्ष्य पौरजानपदं जनम्।।2.111.27।।
transliteration: dharmātmā tasya tathyena bhrāturvākyena vismitaḥ| uvāca rāma ssamprekṣya paurajānapadaṃ janam
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous, रामः Rama, तस्य his, भ्रातुः brother's, तथ्येन genuine, वाक्येन with words, विस्मितः was astonished, पौरजानपदम् inhabiting the towns and villages, जनम् people, सम्प्रेक्ष seeing, उवाच said.
explanation: On hearing the genuine sentiments of his brother, righteous Rama was astonished. He said to the inhabitants from towns and villages:

shloka_text: विक्रीतमाहितं क्रीतं यत्पित्रा जीवता मम। न तल्लोपयितुं शक्यं मया वा भरतेन वा।।2.111.28।।
transliteration: vikrītamāhitaṃ krītaṃ yatpitrā jīvatā mama| na tallopayituṃ śakyaṃ mayā vā bharatena vā
translation: मम my, जीवता while living, पित्रा by father, यत् what, विक्रीतम् was sold, आहितम् pledged, क्रीतम् bought, तत् that, लोपयितुं to annul, मया वा by me or, भरतेन वा or Bharata, न शक्यम् not possible.
explanation: Neither Bharata nor I can in any way annul anything which was sold, pledged or bought by my father during his lifetime.

shloka_text: उपधिर्न मया कार्यो वनवासे जुगुप्सितः। युक्तमुक्तं च कैकेय्या पित्रा मे सुकृतं कृतम्।।2.111.29।।
transliteration: upadhirna mayā kāryo vanavāse jugupsitaḥ| yuktamuktaṃ ca kaikeyyā pitrā me sukṛtaṃ kṛtam
translation: मया by me, वनवासे in the matter of living in the forest, जुगुप्सितः reprehensible, उपधिः placing a substitute, न कार्यः shall not be done, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, युक्तम् rightly, उक्तम् spoken, मे पित्रा by my father, सुकृतम् good deed, कृतम् has been done.
explanation: As far as living in the forest is concerned it is reprehensible to keep a subsitute for me and it shall not be done. Kaikeyi has acted rightfully and my father has taken the proper decision.

shloka_text: जानामि भरतं क्षान्तं गुरुसत्कारकारिणम्। सर्वमेवात्र कल्याणं सत्यसन्धे महात्मनि।।2.111.30।।
transliteration: jānāmi bharataṃ kṣāntaṃ gurusatkārakāriṇam| sarvamevātra kalyāṇaṃ satyasandhe mahātmani
translation: भरतम् Bharata, क्षान्तम् a man of forbearance, गुरुसत्कारकारिणम् honours elders, जानामि I know, सत्यसन्धे true to his word, महात्मनि great, अत्र for him, सर्वमेव everything, कल्याणम् will be auspicious.
explanation: I know Bharata as a man of forbearance and one who honours elders. Everything will turn out well for this great soul wedded to truth.

shloka_text: अनेन धर्मशीलेन वनात्प्रत्यागतः पुनः। भ्रात्रा सह भविष्यामि पृथिव्याः पतिरुत्तमः।।2.111.31।।
transliteration: anena dharmaśīlena vanātpratyāgataḥ punaḥ| bhrātrā saha bhaviṣyāmi pṛthivyāḥ patiruttamaḥ
translation: वनात् from the forest, पुनः again, प्रत्यागतः when returned, धर्मशीलेन of virtuous conduct, अनेन भ्रात्रा सह along with this brother, पृथिव्याः of the earth, उत्तमः supreme, पतिः lord, भविष्यामि I shall become.
explanation: On returning from the forest, I shall become the supreme lord of this earth along with this virtuous brother.

shloka_text: वृतो हि राजा कैकेय्या मया तद्वचनं कृतम्। अनृतान्मोचयानेन पितरं तं महीपतिम्।।2.111.32।।
transliteration: vṛto hi rājā kaikeyyā mayā tadvacanaṃ kṛtam| anṛtānmocayānena pitaraṃ taṃ mahīpatim
translation: राजा the king (Dasaratha), कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, वृतो हि has been solicited, मया by me, तद्वचनं those words, कृतम् are followed, अनेन for that reason, महीपतिम् the lord of the earth, तं पितरम् that father, अनृतात् from falsehood, मोचय you may release.
explanation: The king (Dasaratha) was solicited by Kaikeyi and I shall abide. Therefore, you also release the lord of the earth, our father from the charge of falsehood. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकादशोत्तरशततमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the hundredeleventh sarga in Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तमप्रतिमतेजोभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां रोमहर्षणम्। विस्मिता: स‌ङ्गमं प्रेक्ष्य समवेता महर्षयः।।2.112.1।।
transliteration: tamapratimatejobhyāṃ bhrātṛbhyāṃ romaharṣaṇam| vismitā: sa‌ṅgamaṃ prekṣya samavetā maharṣayaḥ
translation: समवेताः those who had assembled, महर्षयः the great sages, अप्रतिमतेजोभ्यां of both men of unparalleled brilliance, भ्रातृभ्याम् of brothers (Rama and Bharata), तम् that, रोमहर्षणम् thrilled, सङ्गमम् their meeting, प्रेक्ष्य witnessing, विस्मिताः were amazed.
explanation: The great sages assembled there were amazed at witnessing the meeting of the two brothers (Rama and Bharata) of umparalleled briliance.
comments: Sages praise Rama and Bharata for their virtues -- Bharata proclaims to stay outside Ayodhya and rule under the security of Rama's sandals.

shloka_text: अन्तर्हिता मुनिगणास्सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। तौ भ्रातरौ महात्मानौ काकुत्स्थौ प्रशशंसिरे।।2.112.2।।
transliteration: antarhitā munigaṇāssiddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ| tau bhrātarau mahātmānau kākutsthau praśaśaṃsire
translation: अन्तर्हिताः remaining invisible, मुनिगणाः hosts of sages, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षय: devarshis,  महात्मानौ magnanimous, भ्रातरौ brothers, तौ those two, काकुत्स्थौ Kakutsthas, प्रशशंसिरे lauded.
explanation: The hosts of sages, siddhas and devarshis watching invisible the two Kakutstha  brothers extoled them.

shloka_text: स धन्यो यस्य पुत्रौ द्वौ धर्मज्ञौ धर्मविक्रमौ। श्रुत्वा वयं हि सम्भाषामुभयोस्स्पृहयामहे।।2.112.3।।
transliteration: sa dhanyo yasya putrau dvau dharmajñau dharmavikramau| śrutvā vayaṃ hi sambhāṣāmubhayosspṛhayāmahe
translation: धर्मज्ञौ practioners of righteousness, धर्मविक्रमौ whose strength is righteousness, द्वौ both, यस्य whose, पुत्रौ two sons, सः he (Dasaratha), धन्यः is fortunate, वयम् we, संभाषाम् their conversation, श्रुत्वा having heard, उभयोः in respect of both of them, स्पृहयामहे हि we are attached.
explanation: On hearing their dialogue we are deeply drawn towards them, these two sons of king Dasaratha who was fortunate to have these practioners of righteousness and whose strength is dharma.

shloka_text: ततस्त्वृषिगणाः क्षिप्रं दशग्रीववधैषिणः। भरतं राजशार्दूलमित्यूचु: स‌ङ्गता वचः।।2.112.4।।
transliteration: tatastvṛṣigaṇāḥ kṣipraṃ daśagrīvavadhaiṣiṇaḥ| bharataṃ rājaśārdūlamityūcu: sa‌ṅgatā vacaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, क्षिप्रम् quickly, दशग्रीववधैषिणः men desiring the destruction of tenheaded Ravana, ऋषिगणाः hosts of rishis, राजशार्दूलम् best of kings, भरतम् Bharata, इति thus, वचः words, ऊचुः uttered.
explanation: Thereafter hosts of rishis desiring the speedy destruction of tenheaded Ravana said these words to Bharata, the best of kings.

shloka_text: कुले जात महाप्राज्ञ महावृत्त महायशः। ग्राह्यं रामस्य वाक्यं ते पितरं यद्यवेक्षसे।।2.112.5।।
transliteration: kule jāta mahāprājña mahāvṛtta mahāyaśaḥ| grāhyaṃ rāmasya vākyaṃ te pitaraṃ yadyavekṣase
translation: कुले जात O born in an illustrious race, महाप्राज्ञ O highly sagacious one, महावृत्त of virtuous conduct, महायशः O man of great renown, ते your, पितरम् father, अवेक्षसे यदि if you look at your father, रामस्य Rama's, वाक्यम् words, ग्राह्यम् have to be accepted.
explanation: O Bharata, born in an illustrious race, highly sagacious and a man of virtuous conduct and great renown, accept Rama's proposal if you have any regard for your father.

shloka_text: सदाऽनृणमिमं रामं वयमिच्छामहे पितुः। आनृणत्वाच्च कैकेय्या: स्वर्गम् दशरथो गतः।।2.112.6।।
transliteration: sadā'nṛṇamimaṃ rāmaṃ vayamicchāmahe pituḥ| ānṛṇatvācca kaikeyyā: svargam daśaratho gataḥ
translation: वयम् we, इमं रामम् this Rama, सदा always, पितुः as regards his father, अनृणम् free from debt, इच्छामहे we desire, दशरथः Dasaratha, कैकेय्याः to Kaikeyi, अनृणत्वाच्च by discharging his obligation, स्वर्गम् heaven, गतः ascended.
explanation: We always desire that Rama should discharge his debt to his father. Dasaratha, who by redeeming himself of his obligation to Kaikeyi, had ascended heaven.

shloka_text: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं गन्धर्वा: स‌महर्षयः। राजर्षयश्चैव तदा सर्वे स्वां स्वां गतिं गताः।।2.112.7।।
transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ gandharvā: sa‌maharṣayaḥ| rājarṣayaścaiva tadā sarve svāṃ svāṃ gatiṃ gatāḥ
translation: तदा then, समहर्षयः with great rishis, गन्धर्वाः gandharvas, राजर्षयश्चैव and royal sages, एतावत् upto this extent, वचनम् word, उक्त्वा having spoken, सर्वे all, स्वां स्वाम् to their respective, गतिम् abode, गताः went.
explanation: Then the great rishis, gandharvas and royal sages having said this, returned to their respective abodes.

shloka_text: ह्लादितस्तेन वाक्येन शुभेन शुभदर्शनः। राम स्संहृष्टवदनस्तानृषीनभ्यपूजयत्।।2.112.8।।
transliteration: hlāditastena vākyena śubhena śubhadarśanaḥ| rāma ssaṃhṛṣṭavadanastānṛṣīnabhyapūjayat
translation: शुभदर्शनः of auspicious appearance, रामः Rama, शुभेन by the auspicious, तेन वाक्येन by that statement, ह्लादितः was gladdened, संहृष्टवदनः with delightful countenance, तान् ऋषीन् those rishis, अभ्यपूजयत् paid homage.
explanation: Of pleasing appearance, Rama, gladdened by the auspicious statements (of the sages),  paid them homage with a cheerful countenance.

shloka_text: त्रस्तगात्रस्तु भरतस्स वाचा सज्जमानया। कृताञ्जलिरिदं वाक्यं राघवं पुनरब्रवीत्।।2.112.9।।
transliteration: trastagātrastu bharatassa vācā sajjamānayā| kṛtāñjaliridaṃ vākyaṃ rāghavaṃ punarabravīt
translation: सः भरतत्तु as for Bharata, त्रस्तगात्रः limbs trembling, कृताञ्जलिः with palms folded (in reverence), सज्जमानया got ready, वाचा words, पुनः again, राघवम् to Rama, इदं वाक्यम् these word, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Before Bharata, with his limbs trembling and with palms folded (in reverence) was   ready to depart, he said to Rama:

shloka_text: राजधर्ममनुप्रेक्ष्य कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम्। कर्तुमर्हसि काकुत्स्थ मम मातुश्च याचनाम्।।2.112.10।।
transliteration: rājadharmamanuprekṣya kuladharmānusantatim| kartumarhasi kākutstha mama mātuśca yācanām
translation: काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, राजधर्मम् code of kings, कुलधर्मानुसन्ततिम् to abide by the traditional code of our family, अनुप्रेक्ष्य having considered, मम my, मातुश्च also mother's, याचनाम् supplication, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि behoves you.
explanation: O Rama, keeping in view the code of kings and tradition of our family, it behoves you to consider my supplication and that of my mother.

shloka_text: रक्षितुं सुमहद्राज्यमहमेकस्तु नोत्सहे। पौरजानपदांश्चापि रक्तान्रञ्जयितुं तथा।।2.112.11।।
transliteration: rakṣituṃ sumahadrājyamahamekastu notsahe| paurajānapadāṃścāpi raktānrañjayituṃ tathā
translation: अहम् I, एकस्तु am alone, सुमहत् this vast, राज्यम् kingdom, रक्षितुम् to protect, रक्तान् loyal पौरजानपदान् inhabitants of the town and villages, रञ्जयितुम् to please, नोत्सहे I do not venture.
explanation: I do not venture to protect this kingdom all by myself and keep the inhabitants of the towns and villages who are loyal to you pleased.

shloka_text: ज्ञातयश्च हि योधाश्च मित्राणि सुहृदश्च नः। त्वामेव प्रतिवीक्षन्ते पर्जन्यमिव कर्षकाः।।2.112.12।।
transliteration: jñātayaśca hi yodhāśca mitrāṇi suhṛdaśca naḥ| tvāmeva prativīkṣante parjanyamiva karṣakāḥ
translation: नः our, ज्ञातयश्च relatives, योधाश्च warriors, मित्राणि friends, सुहृदश्च wellwishers, त्वामेव you alone, कर्षकाः farmers, पर्जन्यमिव like rainbearing cloud, प्रतिवीक्षन्ते are longing.
explanation: All our relatives, warriors, friends and wellwishers long to see you like farmers yearn for the raincloud.

shloka_text: इदं राज्यं महाप्राज्ञ स्थापय प्रतिपद्य हि। शक्तिमानसि काकुत्स्थ लोकस्य परिपालने।।2.112.13।।
transliteration: idaṃ rājyaṃ mahāprājña sthāpaya pratipadya hi| śaktimānasi kākutstha lokasya paripālane
translation: महाप्राज्ञ O sagacious one, इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, प्रतिपद्य after accepting, स्थापय establish, काकुत्स्थ Kakutstha, लोकस्य this world's, परिपालने in governance, शक्तिमान् असि  you are powerful.
explanation: O sagacious Rama, accept this kingdom and ensure its stability. You are powerful enough to govern this world. So accept this kingdom and restore its stability.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा न्यपतद्भ्रातुः पादयोर्भरतस्तदा। भृशं सम्प्रार्थयामास राममेव प्रियंवदः।।2.112.14।।
transliteration: ityuktvā nyapatadbhrātuḥ pādayorbharatastadā| bhṛśaṃ samprārthayāmāsa rāmameva priyaṃvadaḥ
translation: भरतः Bharata, तदा then, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, भ्रातुः brother's, पादयोः at the feet, न्यपतत् fell, प्रियंवदः one who speaks sweetly, Bharata, रामम् एव Rama alone, भृशम्  profusely, सम्प्रार्थयामास entreated him.
explanation: Having said this, Bharata, fell at the feet of his brother, and speaking sweetly, he profusely  entreated  Rama.

shloka_text: तमङ्के भरतं कृत्वा रामो वचनमब्रवीत्। श्यामं नलिनपत्राक्षं मत्तहंसस्वरं स्वयम्।।2.112.15।।
transliteration: tamaṅke bharataṃ kṛtvā rāmo vacanamabravīt| śyāmaṃ nalinapatrākṣaṃ mattahaṃsasvaraṃ svayam
translation: रामः Rama, श्यामम् dark complexioned, नलिनपत्राक्षम् man with eyes like lotus petals, मत्तहंस स्वरम् voice of  an amorous swan, तं भरतम् to that Bharata, स्वयम् personally, अङ्के into his lap, कृत्वा drawing, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Rama took his in his arms Bharata who had a darkblue complexion, whose eyes were like petals of lotus and whose voice was the voice of an amorous swan.

shloka_text: आगता त्वामियं बुद्धिस्स्वजा वैनयिकी च या। भृशमुत्सहसे तात रक्षितुं पृथिवीमपि।।2.112.16।।
transliteration: āgatā tvāmiyaṃ buddhissvajā vainayikī ca yā| bhṛśamutsahase tāta rakṣituṃ pṛthivīmapi
translation: तातः O child, स्वजा innate, वैनयिकी च though training (received from a preceptor), या बुद्धि: such wisdom, त्वाम् you, आगता reached, पृथिवीम् to the earth, रक्षितुम् अपि even to protect, भृशम् perfectly, उत्सहसे you are capable.
explanation: O child, this wisdom of yours is both inborn and imbibed through training. With this, you are perfectly capable of protecting the earth.

shloka_text: अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च बुद्धिमद्भिश्च मन्त्रिभिः। सर्वकार्याणि सम्मन्त्र्य सुमहन्त्यपि कारय।।2.112.17।।
transliteration: amātyaiśca suhṛdbhiśca buddhimadbhiśca mantribhiḥ| sarvakāryāṇi sammantrya sumahantyapi kāraya
translation: अमात्यैश्च with ministers, सुहृद्भिश्च with friends, बुद्धिमद्भि: with the prudent, मन्त्रिभिश्च   with the counsellors, सम्मन्त्र्य consulting, सुमहन्त्यपि however great they might appear, सर्वकार्याणि all endeavours, कारय you may get them done.
explanation: After due consultation with ministers, friends, counsellors and prudent persons,   accomplish all tasks, however formidable they may appear.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मीश्चन्द्रादपेयाद्वा हिमवान्वा हिमं त्यजेत्। अतीयात्सागरो वेलां न प्रतिज्ञामहं पितुः।।2.112.18।।
transliteration: lakṣmīścandrādapeyādvā himavānvā himaṃ tyajet| atīyātsāgaro velāṃ na pratijñāmahaṃ pituḥ
translation: चन्द्रात् from the Moon, लक्ष्मीः splendour, अपेयाद्वा might withdraw, हिमवान् Himavat mountain, हिमम् snow, त्यजेद्वा might abandon, सागरः ocean, वेलाम् its shores, अतीयात् might overstep, अहम् I, पितुः to father, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, न shall not forsake.
explanation: The Moon might lose its splendour, snow might abandon the Himavat mountain, the ocean might overstep its shores, but I shall not forsake the promise made to my father.

shloka_text: कामाद्वा तात लोभाद्वा मात्रातुभ्यमिदं कृतम्। न तन्मनसि कर्तव्यं वर्तितव्यं च मातृवत्।।2.112.19।।
transliteration: kāmādvā tāta lobhādvā mātrātubhyamidaṃ kṛtam| na tanmanasi kartavyaṃ vartitavyaṃ ca mātṛvat
translation: तात child, कामाद्वा either out of affection, लोभाद्वा or out of covetousness, मात्रा by your  mother, तुभ्यम् for your sake, इदम् this, कृतम् was done, तत् that, मनसि in your mind, न कर्तव्यम् should not be taken seriously, मातृवत् as to one's own mother, वर्तिव्यम् you should conduct.
explanation: Dear brother, whether out of affection or greed, your mother has done this for your sake. It should not agitate your mind. You should conduct yourself as one should towards one's mother.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवाणं भरतः कौसल्यासुतमब्रवीत्। तेजसाऽऽदित्यसङ्काशं प्रतिपच्चन्द्रदर्शनम्।।2.112.20।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ bharataḥ kausalyāsutamabravīt| tejasā''dityasaṅkāśaṃ pratipaccandradarśanam
translation: भरतः Bharata, एवम् in this way, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, तेजसा in brilliance, आदित्यसङ्काशम्  resembling  the Sun, प्रतिपच्चन्द्रदर्शनम् appearance like the new Moon, कौसल्यासुतम् to the son of Kausalya, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: On hearing this, Bharata replied to the son of  Kausalya who looked like the Sun or the new Moon in brilliance:

shloka_text: आधिरोहाऽर्य पादाभ्यां पादुके हेमभूषिते। एतेहि सर्वलोकस्य योगक्षेमं विधास्यतः।।2.112.21।।
transliteration: ādhirohā'rya pādābhyāṃ pāduke hemabhūṣite| etehi sarvalokasya yogakṣemaṃ vidhāsyataḥ
translation: आर्य O noble one, हेमभूषिते decorated with gold, पादुके sandals, पादाभ्याम् from your feet, अधिरोह get into, एते these, सर्वलोकस्य of the entire world, योगक्षेमम् safety, विधास्यतः हि are going to secure.
explanation: O noble one, place your feet on these sandals decorated with gold. They will secure the prosperity and safety of the entire world.

shloka_text: सोऽधिरुह्य नरव्याघ्रः पादुके ह्यवरुह्य च। प्रायच्छत्सुमहातेजा भरताय महात्मने।।2.112.22।।
transliteration: so'dhiruhya naravyāghraḥ pāduke hyavaruhya ca| prāyacchatsumahātejā bharatāya mahātmane
translation: नरव्याघ्रः the best of men, सुमहातेजाः of great brilliance, सः that Rama, पादुके sandals, अधिरुह्य putting on, अवरुह्य च putting off, महात्मने to the magnanimous, भरताय to Bharata, प्रायच्छत् gave.
explanation: Rama, the best of men, one with great brilliance, put on and then put off the sandals  and presented them to the magnanimous Bharata.

shloka_text: स पादुके सम्प्रणम्य रामं वचनमब्रवीत् चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि जटाचीरधरो ह्याहम्।।2.112.23।। फलमूलाशनो वीर भवेयं रघुनन्दन। तवाऽगमनमाकाङ्क्षान्वसन्वै नगराद्बहिः।।2.112.24।। तव पादुकयोर्न्यस्तराज्यतन्त्रः परन्तप।
