It was a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (by frequent visits of demons). It was difficult to locate a water source.  And it resounded with the chirping of various birds and insects (crickets).

shloka_text: नानामृगगणाकीर्णमृक्षशार्दूल सेवितम्। ध्वस्तवृक्षलतागुल्मं दुर्दर्शसलिलाशयम्।।3.2.2।। निष्कूजनानाशकुनिझिल्लिकागणनादितम्। लक्ष्मणानुगतो रामो वनमध्यं ददर्श ह।।3.2.3।।
transliteration: nānāmṛgagaṇākīrṇamṛkṣaśārdūla sevitam| dhvastavṛkṣalatāgulmaṃ durdarśasalilāśayam niṣkūjanānāśakunijhillikāgaṇanāditam| lakṣmaṇānugato rāmo vanamadhyaṃ dadarśa ha
translation: लक्ष्मणानुगतः followed by Lakshmana, रामः Rama, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with different kinds of animals, ऋक्षशार्दूलसेवितम् inhabited by bears and tigers, ध्वस्तवृक्षलतागुल्मम् a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (due to frequent visit by demons), दुर्दश difficult to see, सलिलाशयम् waterreservoirs like wells, निष्कूजनानाशकुनि with the twitter of various birds, झिल्लिकागणनादितम् resounding with the chirping of crickets. वनमध्यम् midst of the forest, ददर्श ह witnessed.
explanation: With Lakshmana following, Rama went through the forest, filled with herds of animals and inhabited by bears and tigers. It was a place where trees, creepers and bushes were crushed (by frequent visits of demons). It was difficult to locate a water source.  And it resounded with the chirping of various birds and insects (crickets).

shloka_text: सीतया सह काकुत्स्थस्तस्मिनघोरमृगायुते। ददर्श गिरिशृङ्गाभं पुरुषादं महास्वनम्।।3.2.4।।
transliteration: sītayā saha kākutsthastasminaghoramṛgāyute| dadarśa giriśṛṅgābhaṃ puruṣādaṃ mahāsvanam
translation: सीतया सह along with Sita, काकुत्स्थः Rama of the Kakutstha family, घोरमृगायुते infested with dreadful animals, तस्मिन् in that place, गिरिशृङ्गाभम् comparable to the peak of a mountain, महास्वनम्  heavy sound, पुरुषादम् a cannibal, ददर्श saw.
explanation: While Rama along with Sita was wandering in the forest infested with  dreadful animals, he saw a roaring cannibal resembling the peak of a mountain.

shloka_text: गम्भीराक्षं महावक्त्रं विकटं विषमोदरम्। बीभत्सं विषमं दीर्घं विकृतं घोरदर्शनम्।।3.2.5।।
transliteration: gambhīrākṣaṃ mahāvaktraṃ vikaṭaṃ viṣamodaram| bībhatsaṃ viṣamaṃ dīrghaṃ vikṛtaṃ ghoradarśanam
translation: गम्भीराक्षम् deepeyed, महावक्त्रम् with a large face, विकटम् of dreadful appearance, विषमोदरम् with a huge belly, बीभत्सम् loathsome, विषमम् crude, दीर्घम् tall, विकृतम् ugly, घोरदर्शनम् of frightful appearance.
explanation: He was of dreadful appearance with deep eyes, a huge face and a big belly. He looked tall, ugly and frightening.

shloka_text: वसानं चर्म वैयाघ्रं वसार्द्रं रुधिरोक्षितम्। त्रासनं सर्वभूतानां व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्।।3.2.6।।
transliteration: vasānaṃ carma vaiyāghraṃ vasārdraṃ rudhirokṣitam| trāsanaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ vyāditāsyamivāntakam
translation: वैयाघ्रम् tiger's, चर्म skin, वसानम्  wore, वसार्द्रम्  wet with marrow, रुधिरोक्षितम् drenched with  blood, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, त्रासनम् causing terror, व्यादितास्यम् with wide open mouth, अन्तकम् इव like the god of death.
explanation: Wearing a tigerskin, he resembled the god of death. With a wide, open mouth, wet with marrow and drenched with blood, he struck terror into  all beings.

shloka_text: त्रीन्सिम्हान्श्चतुरो व्याघ्रान्द्वौ वृकौ पृषतान्दश। सविषाणं वसादिग्धं गजस्य च शिरो महत्। अवसज्यायसे शूले विनदन्तं महास्वनम्।।3.2.7।।
transliteration: trīnsimhānścaturo vyāghrāndvau vṛkau pṛṣatāndaśa| saviṣāṇaṃ vasādigdhaṃ gajasya ca śiro mahat| avasajyāyase śūle vinadantaṃ mahāsvanam
translation: त्रीन् three, सिंहान् lions, चतुरः four, व्याघ्रान् tigers, द्वौ two, वृकौ wolves, दश ten, पृषतान् deer, सविषाणम् along with the tusk of an elephant, वसादिग्धम् wet with the fat of flesh, महत् great, गजस्य शिरः elephant's head, आयसे on an iron, शूले spoke, अवसज्य having pierced, महास्वनम् shouting loudly, विनदन्तम् while he  produced.
explanation: Roaring loudly, he carried an iron spit in which were pierced three lions, four tigers, two wolves, ten deer  and the huge head of an elephant with its tusks smeared with the fat of flesh.

shloka_text: स रामं लक्ष्मणं चैव सीतां दृष्ट्वा च मैथिलीम्। अभ्यधावत्सुसङ्कृद्धः प्रजाः काल इवान्तकः।।3.2.8।।
transliteration: sa rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva sītāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca maithilīm| abhyadhāvatsusaṅkṛddhaḥ prajāḥ kāla ivāntakaḥ
translation: सः that, रामम् Rama, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, मैथिलीम् princess of Mithila, सीतां च and to Sita, दृष्ट्वा seeing सुसङ्कृद्धः he was with anger, अन्तकः god of death, कालः Yama, प्रजाः इव like the people, अभ्यधावत् ran towards.
explanation: Looking extremely furious, he ran towards Rama, Lakshmana and Sita like the god of death rushes towards the (dying) people.

shloka_text: स कृत्वा भैरवं नादं चालयन्निव मेदिनीम्। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीमपक्रम्य ततोऽब्रवीत्।।3.2.9।।
transliteration: sa kṛtvā bhairavaṃ nādaṃ cālayanniva medinīm| aṅkenādāya vaidehīmapakramya tato'bravīt
translation: ततः then, सः that demon, मेदिनीम् earth, चालयन्निव as if shaking, भैरवम् dreadful, नादम् sound, कृत्वा after producing, वैदेहीम् Sita, अङ्केन in his lap, आदाय taking, अपक्रम्य after moving aside, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Making a dreadful sound, as if shaking the earth, he took Sita on his lap, stepped aside and said:

shloka_text: युवां जटाचीरधरौ सभार्यौ क्षीणजीवितौ। प्रविष्टौ दण्डकारण्यं शरचापासिधारिणौ।।3.2.10।।
transliteration: yuvāṃ jaṭācīradharau sabhāryau kṣīṇajīvitau| praviṣṭau daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ śaracāpāsidhāriṇau
translation: जटाचीरधरौ both of you clad in bark and with matted hair, क्षीणजीवितौ both with shortened life, युवाम् both of you, सभार्यौ with your wife, शरचापासिधारिणौ holding bows, arrows and swords, दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandaka forest, प्रविष्टौ  entered into.
explanation: You both clad in bark and wearing matted hair, holding bows, arrows and swords have entered into the Dandaka forest with your wife. Your life has been cut short indeed৷৷

shloka_text: कथं तापसयोर्वां च वासः प्रमदया सह। अधर्मचारिणौ पापौ कौ युवां मुनिदूषकौ।।3.2.11।।
transliteration: kathaṃ tāpasayorvāṃ ca vāsaḥ pramadayā saha| adharmacāriṇau pāpau kau yuvāṃ munidūṣakau
translation: तापसयोः you wear attire of ascetics, वाम् you both, वासः stay, कथम् how is it possible, अधर्मचरिणौ both unrighteous people, मुनिदूषकौ both distorting ascetic discipline, पापौ sinners, युवाम् both , कौ who are you?
explanation: How is it that you both, dressed in the robes of ascetics, live  with a woman? Leading an unrighteous and sinful life, who are you who have brought disgrace to the ascetic discipline ?

shloka_text: अहं वनमिदं दुर्गं विराधो नाम राक्षसः। चरामि सायुधो नित्यमृषिमांसानि भक्षयन्।।3.2.12।।
transliteration: ahaṃ vanamidaṃ durgaṃ virādho nāma rākṣasaḥ| carāmi sāyudho nityamṛṣimāṃsāni bhakṣayan
translation: अहम् I, विराधो नाम Viradha by name, राक्षसः demon, सायुधः ready with arms, नित्यम् always, ऋषिमांसानि flesh of ascetics, भक्षयन् while eating, दुर्गम्  dense, इदम् here, वनम् forest, चरामि I wander.
explanation: I am a demon named Viradha. I move in this dense forest with my weapons eating the flesh of the sages.

shloka_text: इयं नारी वरारोहा मम भार्या भविष्यति। युवयोः पापयोश्चाहं पास्यामि रुधिरं मृधे।।3.2.13।।
transliteration: iyaṃ nārī varārohā mama bhāryā bhaviṣyati| yuvayoḥ pāpayoścāhaṃ pāsyāmi rudhiraṃ mṛdhe
translation: वरारोहा a beautiful woman (with fine hips), इयं नारी this woman, मम my, भार्या wife, भविष्यति will be, अहम् I, मृधे in the fight, पापयोः of both of you sinners, युवयोः of you both, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यामि I shall drink.
explanation: This  woman of fine hips shall be my wife. You sinners I shall drink  the blood of both of you in the fight.

shloka_text: तस्यैवं ब्रुवतो दुष्टं विराधस्य दुरात्मनः। श्रुत्वा सगर्वितं वाक्यं सम्भ्रान्ता जनकात्मजा।।3.2.14।।
transliteration: tasyaivaṃ bruvato duṣṭaṃ virādhasya durātmanaḥ| śrutvā sagarvitaṃ vākyaṃ sambhrāntā janakātmajā
translation: एवम् in that way, ब्रुवतः while he spoke, दुरात्मनः of that wicked, तस्य विराधस्य that Viradha's, सगर्वितम् boastful, जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, दुष्टम् cruel, वाक्यम् statements, श्रुत्वा after hearing, सम्भ्रान्ता  bewildered out of fear.
explanation: Sita, daughter of Janaka was bewildered out of fear when she heard the cruel  and boastful words of that wicked Viradha.

shloka_text: सीता प्रवेपतोद्वेगात् प्रावाते कदली यथा।।3.2.15।। तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः सीतां विराधाङ्कगतां शुभाम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं मुखेन परिशुष्यता।।3.2.16।।
transliteration: sītā pravepatodvegāt prāvāte kadalī yathā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ sītāṃ virādhāṅkagatāṃ śubhām| abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ vākyaṃ mukhena pariśuṣyatā
translation: सीता Sita, उद्वेगात् due to anxiety, प्रवाते in strong wind, कदली यथा like a plantain tree, प्रवेपिता was shaken, राघवः Rama, विराधाङ्कगताम् in the lap of Viradha, शुभाम् Sita, the auspicious, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, परिशुष्यता with a parched(pale), मुखेन with face, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Seeing the auspicious Sita in the lap of Viradha shaken out of anxiety, like a plantain tree in a strong wind, Rama with his throat parched said to Lakshmana:

shloka_text: सीता प्रवेपतोद्वेगात् प्रावाते कदली यथा।।3.2.15।। तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः सीतां विराधाङ्कगतां शुभाम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं मुखेन परिशुष्यता।।3.2.16।।
transliteration: sītā pravepatodvegāt prāvāte kadalī yathā tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ sītāṃ virādhāṅkagatāṃ śubhām| abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ vākyaṃ mukhena pariśuṣyatā
translation: सीता Sita, उद्वेगात् due to anxiety, प्रवाते in strong wind, कदली यथा like a plantain tree, प्रवेपिता was shaken, राघवः Rama, विराधाङ्कगताम् in the lap of Viradha, शुभाम् Sita, the auspicious, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, परिशुष्यता with a parched(pale), मुखेन with face, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Seeing the auspicious Sita in the lap of Viradha shaken out of anxiety, like a plantain tree in a strong wind, Rama with his throat parched said to Lakshmana:

shloka_text: पश्य सौम्य नरेन्द्रस्य जनकस्यात्मसम्भवाम्। मम भार्यां शुभाचारां विराधाङ्के प्रवेशिताम्।।3.2.17।। अत्यन्तसुखसंमव़ृद्धां राजपुत्रीं यशस्विनीम्।
transliteration: paśya saumya narendrasya janakasyātmasambhavām| mama bhāryāṃ śubhācārāṃ virādhāṅke praveśitām atyantasukhasaṃmava़ṛddhāṃ rājaputrīṃ yaśasvinīm|
translation: सौम्य O gentle one, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, जनकस्य Janaka's, आत्मसम्भवाम् daughter, born of his own self, मम भार्याम् my wife, शुभाचाराम् of good conduct, अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धाम् brought up in utmost comfort, यशस्विनीम् an illustrious one, विराधाङ्के  in the lap of Viradha, प्रवेशिताम् entered, राजपुत्रीम्  princess, पश्य  see.
explanation: Gentle Lakshmana, see the illustrious daughter ofJanaka, a lady of good conduct,  brought up in utmost comfort caught in the lap of Viradha

shloka_text: यदभिप्रेतमस्मासु प्रियं वरवृतं च यत्।।3.2.18।। कैकेय्यास्तु सुसंवृत्तं क्षिप्रमद्यैव लक्ष्मण।
transliteration: yadabhipretamasmāsu priyaṃ varavṛtaṃ ca yat kaikeyyāstu susaṃvṛttaṃ kṣipramadyaiva lakṣmaṇa|
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अस्मासु for us, यत् whatever, अभिप्रेतम् desired, यत् that, वरवृतं च  those boons desired, कैकेय्याः by Kaikeyi's, प्रियम् joy, अद्यैव to day itself, क्षिप्रम् now itself, सुसंवृतम् attained well.
explanation: O Lakshmana whatever Kaikeyi desired through her boons has now come true so soon.

shloka_text: या न तुष्यति राज्येन पुत्रार्थे दीर्घदर्शिनी।।3.2.19।। ययाहं सर्वभूतानां प्रियः प्रस्थापितो वनम्। अद्येदानीं सकामा सा या माता मध्यमा मम।।3.2.20।।
transliteration: yā na tuṣyati rājyena putrārthe dīrghadarśinī yayāhaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ priyaḥ prasthāpito vanam| adyedānīṃ sakāmā sā yā mātā madhyamā mama
translation: दीर्घदर्शिनी farsighted lady, या such a lady as she is, पुत्रार्थे for her son, राज्येन with kingdom, न तुष्यति not being contended, यया by whomsoever, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, प्रियः dear, अहम् I, वनम् forest, प्रस्थापितः is sent, या whoever, मम my, मध्यमा माता middle mother, सा she, अद्य today, सकामा has her desire fulfilled.
explanation: Kaikeyi, my middle mother is farsighted indeed  Not content with the kingdom alone see sent me, beloved of all  beings, away to the forest. Let her cherished desire be fulfilled.

shloka_text: या न तुष्यति राज्येन पुत्रार्थे दीर्घदर्शिनी।।3.2.19।। ययाहं सर्वभूतानां प्रियः प्रस्थापितो वनम्। अद्येदानीं सकामा सा या माता मध्यमा मम।।3.2.20।।
transliteration: yā na tuṣyati rājyena putrārthe dīrghadarśinī yayāhaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ priyaḥ prasthāpito vanam| adyedānīṃ sakāmā sā yā mātā madhyamā mama
translation: दीर्घदर्शिनी farsighted lady, या such a lady as she is, पुत्रार्थे for her son, राज्येन with kingdom, न तुष्यति not being contended, यया by whomsoever, सर्वभूतानाम् of all beings, प्रियः dear, अहम् I, वनम् forest, प्रस्थापितः is sent, या whoever, मम my, मध्यमा माता middle mother, सा she, अद्य today, सकामा has her desire fulfilled.
explanation: Kaikeyi, my middle mother is farsighted indeed  Not content with the kingdom alone see sent me, beloved of all  beings, away to the forest. Let her cherished desire be fulfilled.

shloka_text: परस्पर्शात्तु वैदेह्याः न दुःखतरमस्तिमे। पितुर्विनाशात्सौमित्रे  स्वराज्यहरणात्तथा।।3.2.21।।
transliteration: parasparśāttu vaidehyāḥ na duḥkhataramastime| piturvināśātsaumitre  svarājyaharaṇāttathā
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, वैदेह्याः Sita's, परस्पर्शात् the touch of a man other man, पितुः father's, विनाशात् more than demise, तथा in the same way, स्वराज्यहरणात् more than the the loss of my kingdom, मे to me, दुःखतरम् more painful, नास्ति is not.
explanation: O Lakshmana nothing is more sorrowful to me than the touch of Vaidehi by another. It is more painful to me than the death of my father or loss of my kingdom.

shloka_text: इति ब्रुवति काकुत्स्थे बाष्पशोकपरिप्लुते। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धो रुद्धो नाग इव श्वसन्।।3.2.22।।
transliteration: iti bruvati kākutsthe bāṣpaśokapariplute| abravīllakṣmaṇaḥ kruddho ruddho nāga iva śvasan
translation: काकुत्स्थे when Rama of the Kakutstha family, इति this way, ब्रुवति while he spoke, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, बाष्पशोकपरिप्लुते full of tears of sorrow, क्रुद्धः angry, रुद्धः tied up, नागः इव like a serpent, श्वसन् hissing, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: As Rama was thus full of tears of sorrow, Lakshmana sighed heavily in anger like a hissing serpant in confinement. And said:

shloka_text: अनाथ इव भूतानां नाथस्त्वं वासवोपमः। मया प्रेष्येण काकुत्स्थ किमर्थं परितप्यसे।।3.2.23।।
transliteration: anātha iva bhūtānāṃ nāthastvaṃ vāsavopamaḥ| mayā preṣyeṇa kākutstha kimarthaṃ paritapyase
translation: काकुत्स्थ O Rama, भूतानाम् of all beings, नाथः lord, वासवोपमः comparable to Indra, त्वम् you, अनाथः an orphan, इव like, प्रेष्येण by a servant (at your service), मया by myself, किमर्थम् for what reason, परितप्यसे feeling sad.
explanation: O Rama, you are, like Indra, lord of all beings. What makes you feel sad like an orphan when I am at your service like a servant?

shloka_text: शरेण निहतस्याद्य मया क्रुद्धेन रक्षसः। विराधस्य गतासोर्हि मही पास्यति शोणितम्।।3.2.24।।
transliteration: śareṇa nihatasyādya mayā kruddhena rakṣasaḥ| virādhasya gatāsorhi mahī pāsyati śoṇitam
translation: क्रुद्धेन by an angry one, मया by me, अद्य now, शरेण by the arrow, निहतस्य killed, गतासोः of one who loses life, रक्षसः of this demon, विराधस्य Viradha's, शोणितम् blood, मही the earth, पास्यति will drink.
explanation: The earth will drink the blood of Viradha with his life gone, slain by my angry arrow.

shloka_text: राज्यकामे मम क्रोधो भरते यो बभूव ह। तं विराधे प्रमोक्ष्यामि वज्री वज्रमिवाचले।।3.2.25।।
transliteration: rājyakāme mama krodho bharate yo babhūva ha| taṃ virādhe pramokṣyāmi vajrī vajramivācale
translation: राज्यकामे  one who was desirous of kingdom, भरते on Bharata, मम my, यः whatever, क्रोध: anger, बभूव ह was felt, तम् that, वज्री Indra, वज्रम् thunderbolt, अचले इव at a mountain, विराधे on Viradha, प्रमोक्ष्यामि I will release.
explanation: Like Indra who hits the mountain with his thunderbolt, I shall release on Viradha the anger I felt against Bharata for his passion for the kingdom.

shloka_text: मम भुजबलवेगवेगितः पततु शरोऽस्य महान्महोरसि। व्यपनयतु तनोश्च जीवितं पततु ततस्समहीं विघूर्णितः।।3.2.26।।
transliteration: mama bhujabalavegavegitaḥ patatu śaro'sya mahānmahorasi| vyapanayatu tanośca jīvitaṃ patatu tatassamahīṃ vighūrṇitaḥ
translation: मम my, भुजबलवेगवेगितः by the strength of my arms, महान् great, शरः arrow, अस्य his, महोरसि in high speed, पततु may fall, तनोः from the body, जीवितम् life, व्यपनयतु separate, ततः then, विघूर्णितः  reeling round and round, महीम् earth, पततु may fall down.
explanation: Spurred by the speed of my strong arms, my arrow will fall on his broad chest and separate his life from his body. Then his body reeling round and round will fall on the ground. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्वितीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the second sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणश्श्रीमान्विराधे प्रहसन्निव। कोभवान्वनमभ्येत्य चरिष्यसि यथासुखम्।।3.3.1।।
transliteration: ityuktvā lakṣmaṇaśśrīmānvirādhe prahasanniva| kobhavānvanamabhyetya cariṣyasi yathāsukham
translation: इति उकत्वा having said so, लक्ष्मण श्रीमान्  graceful Lakshmana, प्रहसन्निव  with a smile, विराधे at Viradha, कः भवान् who are you? वनमभ्येत्य having come to the forest, यथासुखम् at will, चरिष्यसि you are roaming about.
explanation: Graceful Lakshmana asked  Viradha  with a smile, Who are you wandering in the forest at will ?.
comments: The story of Viradha

shloka_text: अथोवाच पुनर्वाक्यं विराधः पूरयन्वनम्। पृच्छतो मम हि ब्रूतं कौ युवां क्व गमिष्यथः।।3.3.2.।।
transliteration: athovāca punarvākyaṃ virādhaḥ pūrayanvanam| pṛcchato mama hi brūtaṃ kau yuvāṃ kva gamiṣyathaḥ||3.3.2.||
translation: अथ then, विराथः Viradha, वनम् forest, पूरयन् filling with echoes, पुनः again, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said, पृच्छतः asked, मम me, ब्रूतम् whereabouts, युवाम् you both, कौ who are you, क्व where, गमिष्यथः going.
explanation: Then Viradha with his voice filling the forest said, Instead of asking about me you both should speak out who  you are and where you are going

shloka_text: तमुवाच ततो रामो राक्षसं ज्वलिताननम्। पृच्छन्तं सुमहातेजा इक्ष्वाकुकुलमात्मनः।।3.3.3।।
transliteration: tamuvāca tato rāmo rākṣasaṃ jvalitānanam| pṛcchantaṃ sumahātejā ikṣvākukulamātmanaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, सुमहातेजाः highly effulgent, रामः Rama, पृच्छन्तम् when asked, ज्वलिताननम् burning countenance, तं राक्षसम् to that demon, आत्मनः his, इक्ष्वाकुकुलम् Ikshvaku family, उवाच described.
explanation: Questioned by the demon, who bore a burning countenance, the highly effulgent Rama introduced his Ikshvaku family:

shloka_text: क्षत्रियौ वृत्तसम्पन्नौ विद्धि नौ वनगोचरौ। त्वां तु वेदितुमिच्छावः कस्त्वं चरसि दण्डकान्।।3.3.4।।
transliteration: kṣatriyau vṛttasampannau viddhi nau vanagocarau| tvāṃ tu veditumicchāvaḥ kastvaṃ carasi daṇḍakān
translation: नौ both of us, वृत्तसम्पन्नौ endowed with good lineage, वनगोचरौ both moving in the forest, क्षत्रियौ two kshatriyas, विद्धि know, त्वां तु about you, वेदितुम् wish to know, इच्छावः we both wish, दण्डकान् in the Dandaka forest, चरसि you are going about, त्वम् you, कः tell.
explanation: Know us to be both kshatriyas, endowed with a good lineage and yet moving in the forest. We both wish to know, who you are and why you are going about in Dandaka forest?

shloka_text: तमुवाच विराधस्तु रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। हन्त वक्ष्यामि ते राजन्निबोध मम राघव।।3.3.5।।
transliteration: tamuvāca virādhastu rāmaṃ satyaparākramam| hanta vakṣyāmi te rājannibodha mama rāghava
translation: विराधस्तु Viradha also, सत्यपराक्रमम् one with truth as his prowess, तं रामम् to that Rama, उवाच said, हन्त O, राजन् to king, राघव Rama, ते to you, वक्ष्यामि I will tell, मम myself, निबोध  know.
explanation: Then Viradha said to Rama whose truth was his strength, I will tell you who I am. O, listen:

shloka_text: पुत्रः किल जयस्याहं माता मम शतह्रदा। विराध इति मामाहुः पृथिव्यां सर्वराक्षसाः।।3.3.6।।
transliteration: putraḥ kila jayasyāhaṃ mātā mama śatahradā| virādha iti māmāhuḥ pṛthivyāṃ sarvarākṣasāḥ
translation: अहम् I am, जयस्य Jaya's, पुत्रः son, किल indeed, शतह्रदा Satahrada, मम my, माता mother,  पृथिव्याम् on this earth, सर्वराक्षसाः all the demons, माम् me, विराधः Viradha इति so, आहुः call me.
explanation: I am indeed son to Jaya. My mother is Satahrada. Verily all the demons on this earth call me Viradha.

shloka_text: तपसा चाभिसम्प्राप्ता ब्रह्मणो हि प्रसादजा। शस्त्रेणावध्यता लोकेऽच्छेद्याभेद्यत्वमेव च।।3.3.7।।
transliteration: tapasā cābhisamprāptā brahmaṇo hi prasādajā| śastreṇāvadhyatā loke'cchedyābhedyatvameva ca
translation: तपसा through penance, ब्रह्मणः from Brahma, प्रसादजा bestowed by his pleasure, लोके in this world, शस्त्रेण with any weapon, अवध्यता not to be killed, अभिसम्प्राप्ता has been acquired, अच्छेद्याभेद्यत्वमेव च  not to be cut or broken by any.
explanation: By the grace of Lord Brahma I was bestowed with this prowess through my penance. In this world none can kill me with a weapon nor split nor cut me to pieces.

shloka_text: उत्सृज्य प्रमदामेनामनपेक्षौ यथागतम्। त्वरमाणौ पलायेथां न वां जीवितमाददे।। 3.3.8।।
transliteration: utsṛjya pramadāmenāmanapekṣau yathāgatam| tvaramāṇau palāyethāṃ na vāṃ jīvitamādade
translation: एनाम् this lady, प्रमदाम् woman, उत्सृज्य on giving up, अनपेक्षौ without claiming her, त्वरमाणौ quickly, यथागतम् to the place where you came from, पलायेथाम् both of you may run, वाम् to you both, जीवितम् life, न आददे I will not take away.
explanation: Therefore, leave this lady and run away to the place you came from. I will not take away your life .

shloka_text: तं रामः प्रत्युवाचेदं कोपसंरक्तलोचनः। राक्षसं विकृताकारं विराधं पापचेतसम्।।3.3.9।।
transliteration: taṃ rāmaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanaḥ| rākṣasaṃ vikṛtākāraṃ virādhaṃ pāpacetasam
translation: रामः Rama, कोपसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes reddened due to anger, विकृताकारम् with deformed appearance, पापचेतसम् with sinful intentions, तम् him, विराधं राक्षसम् to demon Viradha, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: With eyes reddened with anger Rama replied to the sinful, deformed Viradha:

shloka_text: क्षुद्र धिक्त्वां तु हीनार्थं मृत्युमन्वेषसे ध्रुवम्। रणे प्राप्स्यसे सन्तिष्ठ न मे जीवन् गमिष्यासि।।3.3.10।।
transliteration: kṣudra dhiktvāṃ tu hīnārthaṃ mṛtyumanveṣase dhruvam| raṇe prāpsyase santiṣṭha na me jīvan gamiṣyāsi
translation: क्षुद्र O vile creature, हीनार्थम् mean, त्वाम् you, धिक् fie upon, ध्रुवम् surely, मृत्युम् death, अन्वेषसे you are seeking, सन्तिष्ठ stay, रणे in war, प्राप्स्यसे you will attain, जीवन् while being alive, मे me, न गमिष्यासि you will not go.
explanation: O vile, mean creature  surely you are seeking death. Wait, you will meet it in the fight.

shloka_text: ततः सज्यं धनुः कृत्वा रामस्सुनिशिताञ्छरान्। सुशीघ्रमभिसन्धाय राक्षसं निजघान ह।।3.3.11।।
transliteration: tataḥ sajyaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā rāmassuniśitāñcharān| suśīghramabhisandhāya rākṣasaṃ nijaghāna ha
translation: ततः then, रामः Rama, धनुः bow, सज्यम् strung, कृत्वा after setting, सुनिशितान् sharp, शरान् arrows, सुशीघ्रम् quickly, अभिसन्धाय after aiming, राक्षसम् rakshasa, निजघान hit,  ह indeed.
explanation: Then Rama strung his bow immediately, shot the sharp arrows at Viradha and hit him verily.

shloka_text: धनुषा ज्यागुणवता सप्त बाणान्मुमोच ह। रुक्मपुङ्खान्महावेगान्सुपर्णानिलतुल्यगान्।।3.3.12।।
transliteration: dhanuṣā jyāguṇavatā sapta bāṇānmumoca ha| rukmapuṅkhānmahāvegānsuparṇānilatulyagān
translation: धनुषा bow, ज्यागुणवता string tied, महावेगान् swift ones, सुपर्णानिलतुल्यगान् in speed comparable to Garuda and the windgod, रुक्मपुङ्खान् with bright feathers, सप्त बाणान् seven arrows, मुमोच ह verily released.
explanation: From his bow  strung tight,  Rama shot seven swift, goldenfeathered arrows comparable to Garuda  and the Windgod in speed.

shloka_text: ते शरीरं विराधस्य भित्त्वाबर्हिणवाससः। निपेतुश्शोणितादिग्धा धरण्यां पावकोपमाः।।3.3.13।।
transliteration: te śarīraṃ virādhasya bhittvābarhiṇavāsasaḥ| nipetuśśoṇitādigdhā dharaṇyāṃ pāvakopamāḥ
translation: पावकोपमाः looking like fire, ते they, बर्हिणवाससः arrows tied with peacock feathers, विराधस्य Viradha's, शरीरम् body, भित्त्वा after piercing, शोणितादिग्धाः drenched in blood, धरण्याम् on the ground, निपेतुः fell.
explanation: The arrows tied with peacockfeathers, looking like fire, pierced the body of Viradha which, drenched in blood, fell on the ground.

shloka_text: स विद्धो न्यस्य वैदेहीं शूलमुद्यम्य राक्षसः। अभ्यद्रवत्सुसङ्कृद्धस्तदा रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.3.14।।
transliteration: sa viddho nyasya vaidehīṃ śūlamudyamya rākṣasaḥ| abhyadravatsusaṅkṛddhastadā rāmaṃ salakṣmaṇam
translation: विद्धः Pierced, सः he, राक्षसः that rakshasa, तदा then, वैदेहीम् Sita, न्यस्य  left her, शूलम् a spear, उद्यम्य after lifting, सुसङ्कृद्धः with intense anger, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, रामम् towards Rama, अभ्यद्रवत् ran towards.
explanation: Hit  by Rama and Lakshmana, the enraged  demon left Vaidehi, lifted a sharp spear   and ran towards them.

shloka_text: स विनद्य महानादं शूलं शक्रध्वजोपमम्। प्रगृह्याशोभत तदा व्यात्तानन इवान्तकः।।3.3.15।।
transliteration: sa vinadya mahānādaṃ śūlaṃ śakradhvajopamam| pragṛhyāśobhata tadā vyāttānana ivāntakaḥ
translation: तदा then, सः that, महानादम् loud noise, विनद्य producing, शक्रध्वजोपमम् like Indra's banner, शूलम् spike, प्रगृह्य taking, व्यात्ताननः with wide open mouth, अन्तकः god of death, इव like, अशोभत shone.
explanation: The demon who produced a great noise with his wide open mouth resembled the god of death. He lifted a sharp spike that looked like Indra's banner.

shloka_text: अथ तौ भ्रातरौ दीप्तं शरवर्षं ववर्षतुः। विराधे राक्षसे तस्मिन् कालान्तकयमोपमे।।3.3.16।।
transliteration: atha tau bhrātarau dīptaṃ śaravarṣaṃ vavarṣatuḥ| virādhe rākṣase tasmin kālāntakayamopame
translation: अथ and then, तौ both, भ्रातरौ brothers, कालान्तकयमोपमे looking like Yama, the god of death, तस्मिन् at him, राक्षसे  at that  demon, विराधे on Viradha, दीप्तम् bright, शरवर्षम् rain of arrows, ववर्षतुः showered.
explanation: And then both the brothers showered bright arrows on the demon Viradha who looked like Yama, the god of death.

shloka_text: स प्रहस्य महारौद्रः स्थित्वाजृम्भत राक्षसः। जृम्भमाणस्य ते बाणाः कायान्निष्पेतुराशुगाः।।3.3.17।।
transliteration: sa prahasya mahāraudraḥ sthitvājṛmbhata rākṣasaḥ| jṛmbhamāṇasya te bāṇāḥ kāyānniṣpeturāśugāḥ
translation: महारौद्रः extremely frightening, सः राक्षस: that rakshasa, प्रहस्य after laughing, स्थित्वा  stood there, अजृम्भत yawned, जृम्भमाणस्य as he was yawning, कायात् from the body, आशुगाः swiftmoving, ते बाणाः those arrows, निष्पेतुः fell down.
explanation: The demon who was extremely frightening stood there, laughing and yawning.  As he yawned, all the swiftlyflying arrows fell out of his body.

shloka_text: स्पर्शात्तु वरदानेन प्राणान्सम्रोध्य राक्षसः। विराधः शूलमुद्यम्य राघवावभ्यधावत।।3.3.18।।
transliteration: sparśāttu varadānena prāṇānsamrodhya rākṣasaḥ| virādhaḥ śūlamudyamya rāghavāvabhyadhāvata
translation: राक्षसः demon, विराधः Viradha, वरदानेन by virtue of a boon, स्पर्शात् तु by touch as well, प्राणान् (Prana, Apana, Vyana, Udana, and Samana) vital breath, संरोध्य  controlled, शूलम्  spike, उद्यम्य on taking out, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, अभ्यधावत ran after.
explanation: By virtue of a boon Viradha, the demon, controlled the vital breath of his body by a mere touch and, raising the spike, ran towards the two Raghava princes.

shloka_text: तच्छूलं वज्रसङ्काशं गगने ज्वलनोपमम्। द्वाभ्यां शराभ्यां चिच्छेद रामः शस्त्रभृतांवरः।।3.3.19।।
transliteration: tacchūlaṃ vajrasaṅkāśaṃ gagane jvalanopamam| dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ ciccheda rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃvaraḥ
translation: शस्त्रभृताम् among the wielders of bows, वरः best, रामः Rama, ज्वलनोपमम् like burning fire, वज्रसङ्काशम् resembling thunderbolt, तत् that, शूलम्  spike, द्वाभ्याम् with two, शराभ्याम् arrows, गगने in the sky, चिच्छेद broke asunder.
explanation: With two arrows, Rama, the best among wielders of weapons, broke down the spike in the sky burning like fire, and resembling the  thunderbolt of Indra.

shloka_text: तद्रामविशिखच्छिन्नं शूलं तस्यकराद्भुवि। पपाताशनिना छिन्नं मेरोरिव शिलातलम्।।3.3.20।।
transliteration: tadrāmaviśikhacchinnaṃ śūlaṃ tasyakarādbhuvi| papātāśaninā chinnaṃ meroriva śilātalam
translation: रामविशिखैः by Rama's arrow, छिन्नम् broken, तत् शूलम् spike, भुवि on the ground, अपतत् fell, अशनिना by the thunder, छिन्नम् broken into pieces, मेरोः of mount Meru, शिलातलम् इव like a slab, पपात fell down.
explanation: The spike, broken down by Rama's arrow, fell like a slab of mount Meru splintered by Indra's thunder.

shloka_text: तौ खड्गौ क्षिप्रमुद्यम्य कृष्णसर्पोपमौशुभौ। तूर्णमापेततुस्तस्य तदा प्रहरतां बलात्।।3.3.21।।
transliteration: tau khaḍgau kṣipramudyamya kṛṣṇasarpopamauśubhau| tūrṇamāpetatustasya tadā praharatāṃ balāt
translation: तदा then, तौ both, उद्यतौ coming on, कृष्णसर्पोपमौ both looking like black serpents, शुभौ auspicious, ख़ड्गौ the two swords, क्षिप्रम् quickly, उद्यम्य raising, तूर्णम् at once, तस्य at him, आपेततुः fell upon, बलात् strongly, प्रहरताम् struck  तस्य him.
explanation: Then both Rama and Lakshmana quickly raised their swords which looked like black serpents and at once fell upon the demon who was going to strike with great force.

shloka_text: स वध्यमानः सुभृशं भुजाभ्यां परिरभ्यतौ। अप्रकम्प्यौ नरव्याघ्रौ रौद्रः प्रस्थातुमैच्छत।।3.3.22।।
transliteration: sa vadhyamānaḥ subhṛśaṃ bhujābhyāṃ parirabhyatau| aprakampyau naravyāghrau raudraḥ prasthātumaicchata
translation: वध्यमानः being struck, रौद्रः angry one, सः he, अप्रकम्प्यौ the unshakeable two, नरव्याघ्रौ two tigerlike men, तौ both, भुजाभ्याम् with his arms, सुभृशम् tightly, परिगृह्य holding, प्रस्थातुम् to set out, ऐच्छत intended.
explanation: Struck down, the angry demon tightly caught hold of both of them under his arms and wanted to set out, carrying Rama and Lakshmana, the two unshakeable tigers among men.

shloka_text: तस्याभिप्रायमाज्ञाय रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्। वहत्वयमलं तावत्पथाऽनेन तु राक्षसः।।3.3.23।।
transliteration: tasyābhiprāyamājñāya rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt| vahatvayamalaṃ tāvatpathā'nena tu rākṣasaḥ
translation: तस्य his, अभिप्रायम् intention, आज्ञाय having understood, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said, अयं राक्षसः this demon, अनेन पथा by this path, अलम् no need to prohibit, वहतु तावत् let him carry us.
explanation: Rama understood the intention of the demon and said to Lakshmana, Let him go his way, no need to stop him.

shloka_text: यथा चेच्छति सौमित्रे तथा वहतु राक्षसः। अयमेव हि नः पन्था येन याति निशाचरः।।3.3.24।।
transliteration: yathā cecchati saumitre tathā vahatu rākṣasaḥ| ayameva hi naḥ panthā yena yāti niśācaraḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, राक्षसः the demon, यथा as, इच्छति wishes to go, तथा like that, वहतु let him carry, निशाचरः nightstalker येन by which ever, याति moves, अयमेव this alone, सः such, पन्थाः हि direction only.
explanation: O Lakshmana, let the nightstalker go the way he wishes. That is, in fact, our path.

shloka_text: स तु स्वबलवीर्येण समुत्क्षिप्य निशाचरः। बालाविव स्कन्धगतौ चकारातिबलोद्धतः।।3.3.25।।
transliteration: sa tu svabalavīryeṇa samutkṣipya niśācaraḥ| bālāviva skandhagatau cakārātibaloddhataḥ
translation: अतिबलोद्धतः one puffed with great strength, सः that Viradha, निशाचरः तु rakshasa on his part, स्वबलवीर्येण by his own strength, समुत्क्षिप्य after lifting, बालाविव like two children, स्कन्धगतौ on both his shoulders, चकार made.
explanation: Puffed up with his own great strength, Viradha lifted them and placed them on his shoulders as though they were two children.

shloka_text: तावारोप्य ततः स्कन्धं राघवौ रजनीचरः। विराधो विनदन्घोरं जगामाभिमुखो वनम्।।3.3.26।।
transliteration: tāvāropya tataḥ skandhaṃ rāghavau rajanīcaraḥ| virādho vinadanghoraṃ jagāmābhimukho vanam
translation: ततः then, रजनीचरः the nightstalker, विराधः Viradha, तौ both राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, स्कन्धम् on the shoulders, आरोप्य keeping, घोरम् dreadfuly, विनदन् while screaming, वनम् अभिमुखः towards the forest, जगाम proceeded.
explanation: Then the nightstalker proceeded towards the forest, carrying both the scions of the Raghu race on his shouldersroaring.

shloka_text: ह्रियमाणौ तु तौ दृष्ट्वा वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ। उच्चैस्स्वरेण चुक्रोश प्रगृह्य सुमहाजाभुजौ।।3.4.1।।
transliteration: hriyamāṇau tu tau dṛṣṭvā vaidehī rāmalakṣmaṇau| uccaissvareṇa cukrośa pragṛhya sumahājābhujau
translation: वैदेही Sita, प्रगृह्य  holding, ह्रियमाणौ the two being abducted, सुमहाभुजौ two huge arms, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, उच्चै स्वरेण at the top of her voice, चुक्रोश shouted.
explanation: Seeing those two mightyarmed Rama and Lakshmana being carried away by Viradha, Sita started crying loudly:
comments: Rama and Lakshmana kill Viradha -- Viradha narrates his story and ascends to heaven.

shloka_text: एष दाशरथी रामः सत्यवान् शीलवान् शुचिः। रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण ह्रियते सहलक्ष्मणः।।3.4.2।।
transliteration: eṣa dāśarathī rāmaḥ satyavān śīlavān śuciḥ| rakṣasā raudrarūpeṇa hriyate sahalakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: सत्यवान् truthful , शीलवान् of good conduct, शुचिः pure, एषः this person, दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, सहलक्ष्मणः  with Lakshmana, रौद्ररूपेण dreadful in appearance, रक्षसा by The demon, ह्रियते is whisked away.
explanation: This son of Dasaratha, Rama—truthful, of good conduct and pure—is being carried off along with Lakshmana by a demon of dreadful form.

shloka_text: मामृका भक्षयिष्यन्ति शार्दूलाद्वीपिनस्तथा। मां हरोत्सृज काकुत्स्थौ नमस्ते राक्षसोत्तम।।3.4.3।।
transliteration: māmṛkā bhakṣayiṣyanti śārdūlādvīpinastathā| māṃ harotsṛja kākutsthau namaste rākṣasottama
translation: माम् me, ऋका wild bears, तथा in the same way, शार्दूलाद्वीपिनः tigers and panthers, भक्षयिष्यन्ति will eat me, राक्षसोत्तम O best of demons, माम् me, हर take away, काकुत्स्थौ Rama and Lakshmana, उत्सृज spare them, ते to you, नमः I salute.
explanation: The wild bears, tigers and panthers will eat me up here. O best among demons, pray take me and leave both the Kakutsthas.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वैदेह्या रामलक्ष्मणौ। वेगं प्रचक्रतुर्वीरौ वधे तस्य दुरात्मनः।।3.4.4।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā vaidehyā rāmalakṣmaṇau| vegaṃ pracakraturvīrau vadhe tasya durātmanaḥ
translation: वीरौ heroic, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, तस्याः वैदेह्याः that Sita's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, दुरात्मनः of the wicked one, तस्य his, वधे to kill, वेगम् haste, प्रचक्रतुः began.
explanation: On hearing those words of  Sita, both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana hastened to kill the wicked Viradha.

shloka_text: तस्य रौद्रस्य सौमित्रिः सव्यं बाहुं बभञ्ज ह। रामस्तु दक्षिणं बाहुं तरसा तस्य रक्षसः।।3.4.5।।
transliteration: tasya raudrasya saumitriḥ savyaṃ bāhuṃ babhañja ha| rāmastu dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ tarasā tasya rakṣasaḥ
translation: सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, रौद्रस्य of that dreadful demon तस्य his, सव्यं बाहुम् left shoulder, बभञ्ज ह broke down, रामः Rama, तु too, तस्य रक्षसः that demon's, दक्षिणम् right, बाहुम् shoulder, तरसा quickly.
explanation: Lakshmana quickly broke the left and Rama the right shoulder of that dreadful demon.

shloka_text: स भग्नबाहुस्सविग्नो निपपाताशु राक्षसः। धरण्यां मेघसङ्काशो वज्रभिन्न इवाचलः।।3.4.6।।
transliteration: sa bhagnabāhussavigno nipapātāśu rākṣasaḥ| dharaṇyāṃ meghasaṅkāśo vajrabhinna ivācalaḥ
translation: भग्नबाहुः broken shoulders, मेघ सङ्काशः resembling cloud, सः he, संविग्नः anxious, राक्षसः demon, निपपातः fell down, वज्रभिन्नः split by a thunderbolt, अचलः इव like a mountain, आशु fell at once, धरण्याम् on the ground.
explanation: With both shoulders broken, the demon, looking like a cloud (huge and dark) fell at once on the ground like a mountain split by a thunderbolt.

shloka_text: मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिः पद्भिः सूदयन्तौ तु राक्षसम्। उद्यम्योद्यम्य चाप्येनं स्थण्डिले निष्पिपेषतुः।।3.4.7।।
transliteration: muṣṭibhirjānubhiḥ padbhiḥ sūdayantau tu rākṣasam| udyamyodyamya cāpyenaṃ sthaṇḍile niṣpipeṣatuḥ
translation: राक्षसम् to the demon, मुष्टिभिः with fists, जानुभिः with knees, पद्भि: with feet, सूदयन्तौ striking, एनम् him, उद्यम्योद्यम्य by lifting him again and again, स्थण्डिले on the bare ground, निष्पिपेषतुः pulverized .
explanation: Striking the demon with fists, knees and feet, both of them smit him  on the bare ground and pulverized him.

shloka_text: स विद्धो बहुभिर्बाणैः खङ्गाभ्यां च परिक्षतः। निष्पिष्टो बहुधा भूमौ न ममार स राक्षसः।।3.4.8।।
transliteration: sa viddho bahubhirbāṇaiḥ khaṅgābhyāṃ ca parikṣataḥ| niṣpiṣṭo bahudhā bhūmau na mamāra sa rākṣasaḥ
translation: बहुभिः by many, बाणैः by arrows, विद्धः pierced, खङ्गाभ्याम् with two swords, परिक्षतः  wounded, बहुधा in many ways, भूमौ on the ground, निष्पिष्टः pulverized, सः राक्षसः that demon, न ममार was not killed.
explanation: Although pierced by arrows, and wounded by the two swords, and pulverized on the ground, the demon did not die.

shloka_text: तं प्रेक्ष्य रामः सुभृशमवध्यमचलोपमम्। भयेष्वभयदश्श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.4.9।।
transliteration: taṃ prekṣya rāmaḥ subhṛśamavadhyamacalopamam| bhayeṣvabhayadaśśrīmānidaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: भयेषु from fear, अभयदः guaranter of safety, (who promises deliverance from fear), श्रीमान् illustrious, रामः Rama, अचलोपमम् mountainlike, तम् him, सुभृशम् very much, अवध्यम् could not be killed, प्रेक्ष्य after seeing, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Seeing the mountainlike Viradha not dying though seriously wounded, illustrious Rama, guaranter of safety from fear said to Lakshmana:

shloka_text: तपसा पुरुषव्याघ्र राक्षसोऽयं न शक्यते। शस्त्रेण युधि निर्जेतुं राक्षसं निखनावहे।।3.4.10।।
transliteration: tapasā puruṣavyāghra rākṣaso'yaṃ na śakyate| śastreṇa yudhi nirjetuṃ rākṣasaṃ nikhanāvahe
translation: पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, तपसा by penance, अयं राक्षसः this demon, युधि in war, शस्त्रेण by weapons, निर्जेतुम् to conquer, न शक्यते is not possible, राक्षसम् this demon, निखनावहे shall bury him.
explanation: O Lakshmana, best among men, this demon by virtue of his penance cannot be killed with any weapon in war. Therefore, let us bury him.

shloka_text: कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्वभ्रं खन्यतां रौद्रवर्चसः।।3.4.11।।
transliteration: kuñjarasyeva raudrasya rākṣasasyāsya lakṣmaṇa| vane'smin sumahacchvabhraṃ khanyatāṃ raudravarcasaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, रौद्रस्य of the dreadful one, अस्य रक्षसः of this demon, कुञ्जरस्येव like an elephant, रौद्रवर्चसः one who emits a fearful glow, अस्मिन् in this, वने forest, सुमहत् very great, श्वभ्रम् a pit, खन्यताम् dig.
explanation: Dig a deep pit to bury this demon, dreadful like an elephant and emitting a fearful glow.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामः प्रदरः खन्यतामिति। तस्थौ विराधमाक्रम्य कण्ठे पादेन वीर्यवान्।।3.4.12।।
transliteration: ityuktvā lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmaḥ pradaraḥ khanyatāmiti| tasthau virādhamākramya kaṇṭhe pādena vīryavān
translation: वीर्यवान् courageous one, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इति thus, प्रदरः crevice, खन्यताम् may be dug up, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, विराधम् Viradha, पादेन with his foot, कण्ठे on his neck, आक्रम्य holding firmly there, तस्थौ stood.
explanation: Courageous Rama standing there put his foot firmly on the neck of Viradha and said to Lakshmana,' Dig up a crevice'.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं राक्षसः प्रश्रितं वचः। इदं प्रोवाच काकुत्थ्सं विराधः पुरुषर्षभम्।।3.4.13।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghaveṇoktaṃ rākṣasaḥ praśritaṃ vacaḥ| idaṃ provāca kākutthsaṃ virādhaḥ puruṣarṣabham
translation: राक्षसः the demon, विराधः Viradha, राघवेण by Rama, उक्तम् instructed, तत् that, श्रुत्वा on hearing, पुरुषर्षभम् best among men, काकुत्थ्सम् to Lakshmana, इदम् thus, प्रश्रितम् humble, वचः words, प्रोवाच uttered.
explanation: When the demon Viradha heard Rama saying so, he said these humble words to the scion of the Kakutsthas and the best of men :

shloka_text: हतोऽस्मि पुरुषव्याघ्र शक्रतुल्यबलेन वै। मया तु पूर्वं त्वं मोहान्न ज्ञातः पुरुषर्षभ।।3.4.14।।
transliteration: hato'smi puruṣavyāghra śakratulyabalena vai| mayā tu pūrvaṃ tvaṃ mohānna jñātaḥ puruṣarṣabha
translation: पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, शक्रतुल्यबलेन equal to Indra in prowess, हतः अस्मि I am killed, पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, मया by me, मोहात् due to delusion, त्वम् you, पूर्वम् earlier, न ज्ञातः was not realised.
explanation: You have killed me, O Rama, a tiger among men. You are equal to Indra in prowess. O best of men, out of delusion I could not recognise you earlier.

shloka_text: कौसल्यासुप्रजा राम तातस्त्वं विदितो मया। वैदेही च महाभागा लक्ष्मणश्च महायशाः।।3.4.15।।
transliteration: kausalyāsuprajā rāma tātastvaṃ vidito mayā| vaidehī ca mahābhāgā lakṣmaṇaśca mahāyaśāḥ
translation: तात O dear one, त्वम् you, कौसल्यासुप्रजाः the good son of Kausalya, रामः Rama, विदितः are known now, महाभागा a great lady, वैदेही च Sita too, महायशाः a man of great fame, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana too.
explanation: O dear Rama, I know now you are the blessed son of Kausalya, Sita is a noble lady and a glorious soul.

shloka_text: अभिशापादहं घोरां प्रविष्टो राक्षसीं तनुम्। तुम्बुरुर्नाम गन्धर्वः शप्तो वैश्रवणेन ह।।3.4.16।।
transliteration: abhiśāpādahaṃ ghorāṃ praviṣṭo rākṣasīṃ tanum| tumbururnāma gandharvaḥ śapto vaiśravaṇena ha
translation: अहम् I, अभिशापात् by a curse, घोराम् this terrible, राक्षसीम् demoniac, तनुम् body, प्रविष्टः I  have entered, वैश्रवणेन by Kubera, शप्तः I am cursed, तुम्बुरुः नाम by name Tumburu, गन्धर्वः celestial musician.
explanation: I am Tumburu by name,  a celestial singer of the gandharva clan. Cursed by Kubera, I got this dreadful body of a demon.

shloka_text: प्रसाद्यमानश्च मया सोऽब्रवीन्मां महायशाः। यदा दाशरथी रामस्त्वां वधिष्यति संयुगे। तदा प्रकृतिमापन्नो भवान्स्वर्गं गमिष्यति।।3.4.17।।
transliteration: prasādyamānaśca mayā so'bravīnmāṃ mahāyaśāḥ| yadā dāśarathī rāmastvāṃ vadhiṣyati saṃyuge| tadā prakṛtimāpanno bhavānsvargaṃ gamiṣyati
translation: मया by me, प्रसाद्यमानः while being appeased, महायशा: illustrious, सः he, माम् me, अब्रवीत् said, दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, यदा when, त्वाम् you, संयुगे at war, वधिष्यति will kill, तदा then, प्रकृतिम् your original form, आपन्नः you will get back, भवान् you, स्वर्गम् to heaven, गमिष्यति you will go.
explanation: When I appealed to him, that lord of great fame (Kubera) said that I would get back my original form and ascend to heaven when Rama, son of Dasaratha, would kill me in a duel.

shloka_text: अनुपस्थीयमानो मां स क्रुद्धो व्याजहार ह। इति वैश्रवणो राजा रम्भासक्तमुवाच ह।।3.4.18।।
transliteration: anupasthīyamāno māṃ sa kruddho vyājahāra ha| iti vaiśravaṇo rājā rambhāsaktamuvāca ha
translation: सः that, अनुपस्थीयमानः not being attended to, क्रुद्धः angry, माम् me, व्याजहार said, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Kubera, रम्भासक्तम्  passionately attached to Rambha, इति like this, उवाच ह cursed.
explanation: When king Kubera saw me absent (from duty) as I was infatuated with Rambha, he got angry and cursed me.

shloka_text: तव प्रसादान्मुक्तोऽहमिहशापात्सुदारुणात्। भुवनं स्वं गमिष्यामि स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु परन्तप।।3.4.19।।
transliteration: tava prasādānmukto'hamihaśāpātsudāruṇāt| bhuvanaṃ svaṃ gamiṣyāmi svasti vo'stu parantapa
translation: तव your, प्रसादात् by grace blessing, सुदारुणात् from the dreadful form, अभिशापात् from the  curse, परन्तप scorcher of enemies अहम् I, मुक्तः am relieved, स्वम् my own, भुवनम् abode, गमिष्यामि I will go, वः to you both, स्वस्ति wish you well, अस्तु may be.
explanation: O scorcher of enemies by your grace I am rid of the curse. Delivered from my dreadful form, I will now go to my world. May both of you fare well.

shloka_text: इतो वसति धर्मात्मा शरभङ्गः प्रतापवान्।।3.4.20।। अध्यर्धयोजने तात महर्षिस्सूर्यसन्निभः। तं क्षिप्रमधिगच्छ त्वं स ते श्रेयोऽभिधास्यति।।3.4.21।।
transliteration: ito vasati dharmātmā śarabhaṅgaḥ pratāpavān adhyardhayojane tāta maharṣissūryasannibhaḥ| taṃ kṣipramadhigaccha tvaṃ sa te śreyo'bhidhāsyati
translation: तात O dear, इतः from here, अध्यर्धयोजने one and half yojanas away, (a yojana  about 8 miles) धर्मात्मा a righteous self, प्रतापवान् of great power, सूर्यसन्निभः comparable to the Sun, शरभङ्गः Sarabhanga, महर्षिः sage, वसति lives, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् quickly, तम् him, अधिगच्छ  approach, सः he, ते to you, श्रेयः welfare, अभिधास्यति bestow on you.
explanation: O dear, there lives Sarabhanga, a righteous sage, comparable to the Sun, at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here. Go to him at once. He will bless you with your wellbeing.

shloka_text: इतो वसति धर्मात्मा शरभङ्गः प्रतापवान्।।3.4.20।। अध्यर्धयोजने तात महर्षिस्सूर्यसन्निभः। तं क्षिप्रमधिगच्छ त्वं स ते श्रेयोऽभिधास्यति।।3.4.21।।
transliteration: ito vasati dharmātmā śarabhaṅgaḥ pratāpavān adhyardhayojane tāta maharṣissūryasannibhaḥ| taṃ kṣipramadhigaccha tvaṃ sa te śreyo'bhidhāsyati
translation: तात O dear, इतः from here, अध्यर्धयोजने one and half yojanas away, (a yojana  about 8 miles) धर्मात्मा a righteous self, प्रतापवान् of great power, सूर्यसन्निभः comparable to the Sun, शरभङ्गः Sarabhanga, महर्षिः sage, वसति lives, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् quickly, तम् him, अधिगच्छ  approach, सः he, ते to you, श्रेयः welfare, अभिधास्यति bestow on you.
explanation: O dear, there lives Sarabhanga, a righteous sage, comparable to the Sun, at a distance of one and a half yojanas from here. Go to him at once. He will bless you with your wellbeing.

shloka_text: अवटे चापि मां राम प्रक्षिप्य कुशली व्रज। रक्षसां गतसत्त्वानामेष धर्मस्ससनातनः। अवटे ये निधीयन्ते तेषां लोकास्सनातनाः।।3.4.22।।
transliteration: avaṭe cāpi māṃ rāma prakṣipya kuśalī vraja| rakṣasāṃ gatasattvānāmeṣa dharmassasanātanaḥ| avaṭe ye nidhīyante teṣāṃ lokāssanātanāḥ
translation: राम Rama, माम् me, अवटे in the pit, प्रक्षिप्य on burying, कुशली proper, व्रज you may go, गतसत्त्वाम्  who are dead, रक्षसाम् of the demons, एषः this one, सनातनः eternal, धर्मः justice, ये those, अवटे विनिक्षिप्यन्ते buried in a pit, तेषाम् to them, सनातनाः eternal, लोकाः in other worlds (heaven)
explanation: Bury me in the pit, O Rama, and proceed happily. This is a great tradition for the dead demons. Those who are buried in the pit attain heaven.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु काकुत्थ्सं विराधश्शरपीडितः। बभूव स्वर्गसम्प्राप्तो न्यस्तदेहो महाबलः।।3.4.23।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu kākutthsaṃ virādhaśśarapīḍitaḥ| babhūva svargasamprāpto nyastadeho mahābalaḥ
translation: महाबलः mighty strong, विराधः Viradha, काकुत्थ्सम् to the scion of the Kakutstha race, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, शरपीडितः hit by the arrows, न्यस्तदेहः casting his body, स्वर्गसम्प्राप्तः बभूव attained heaven.
explanation: Having said so to Rama, the mighty  Viradha, hit by the arrows left his body and attained heaven.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं व्यादिदेश ह। कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण।।3.4.24।। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्वभ्रं खन्यतां रौदकर्मणः। इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामः प्रदरः खन्यतामिति। तस्थौ विराधमाक्रम्य कण्ठे पादेन वीर्यवान्।।3.4.25।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghavo vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ vyādideśa ha| kuñjarasyeva raudrasya rākṣasasyāsya lakṣmaṇa vane'smin sumahacchvabhraṃ khanyatāṃ raudakarmaṇaḥ| ityuktvā lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmaḥ pradaraḥ khanyatāmiti| tasthau virādhamākramya kaṇṭhe pādena vīryavān
translation: राघवः Rama, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा heard, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, व्यादिदेश ordered, अस्यराक्षसस्य for this demon, रौद्रस्य of the dreadful, कुञ्जरस्येव like an elephant वनेऽस्मिन् in this forest, रौद्रकर्मणः of dreadful acts, सुमहत् wide, श्वभ्रः pit, खन्यताम् dig, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, प्रदरः a pit, खन्यताम् dig, इति in this way, वीर्यवान् valiant, पादेन by his foot, कण्ठे on the neck, विराधम् to Viradha, आक्रम्य occupying, तस्थौ stood firmly.
explanation: When Rama heard those words, he said, O Lakshmana dig for this elephantlike demon of dreadful acts, a big pit. Having said so the mighty Rama stood firmly stamping the neck of Viradha with his foot.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं व्यादिदेश ह। कुञ्जरस्येव रौद्रस्य राक्षसस्यास्य लक्ष्मण।।3.4.24।। वनेऽस्मिन् सुमहच्छ्वभ्रं खन्यतां रौदकर्मणः। इत्युक्त्वा लक्ष्मणं रामः प्रदरः खन्यतामिति। तस्थौ विराधमाक्रम्य कण्ठे पादेन वीर्यवान्।।3.4.25।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā rāghavo vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ vyādideśa ha| kuñjarasyeva raudrasya rākṣasasyāsya lakṣmaṇa vane'smin sumahacchvabhraṃ khanyatāṃ raudakarmaṇaḥ| ityuktvā lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmaḥ pradaraḥ khanyatāmiti| tasthau virādhamākramya kaṇṭhe pādena vīryavān
translation: राघवः Rama, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा heard, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, व्यादिदेश ordered, अस्यराक्षसस्य for this demon, रौद्रस्य of the dreadful, कुञ्जरस्येव like an elephant वनेऽस्मिन् in this forest, रौद्रकर्मणः of dreadful acts, सुमहत् wide, श्वभ्रः pit, खन्यताम् dig, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, प्रदरः a pit, खन्यताम् dig, इति in this way, वीर्यवान् valiant, पादेन by his foot, कण्ठे on the neck, विराधम् to Viradha, आक्रम्य occupying, तस्थौ stood firmly.
explanation: When Rama heard those words, he said, O Lakshmana dig for this elephantlike demon of dreadful acts, a big pit. Having said so the mighty Rama stood firmly stamping the neck of Viradha with his foot.

shloka_text: ततः खनित्रमादाय लक्ष्मणश्श्वभ्रमुत्तमम्। अखनत्पार्श्वतस्तस्य विराधस्य महात्मनः।।3.4.26।।
transliteration: tataḥ khanitramādāya lakṣmaṇaśśvabhramuttamam| akhanatpārśvatastasya virādhasya mahātmanaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, खनित्रम् spade, आदाय fetched, महात्मनः of the great soul, तस्यविराधस्य that Viradha's, पार्श्वत: by his side, उत्तमम् sufficiently big, श्वभ्रम् pit, अखनत् dug.
explanation: Then Lakshmana fetched a spade and dug a sufficiently big pit by the side of the great soul Viradha.

shloka_text: तं मुक्तकण्ठंनिक्षिप्य शङ्कुकर्णं महास्वनम्। विराधं प्राक्षिपच्छ्वभ्रे नदन्तं भैरवस्वनम्।।3.4.27।।
transliteration: taṃ muktakaṇṭhaṃnikṣipya śaṅkukarṇaṃ mahāsvanam| virādhaṃ prākṣipacchvabhre nadantaṃ bhairavasvanam
translation: मुक्तकण्ठनिक्षिप्य released pressure on the neck, महास्वनम् with loud voice, शङ्कुकर्णम्   of pointed ears as an iron peg, भैरवस्वनम् fearful sound नदन्तम् making, तं विराधम् that Viradha, श्वभ्रे in the pit, प्राक्षिपत् dropped.
explanation: Rama took his foot off Viradha's neck and dropped his body with pointed ears into the pit while Viradha was groaning fearfully৷৷

shloka_text: तमाहवे दारुणमाशुविक्रमौ स्थिरावुभौ संयति रामलक्ष्मणौ। मुदान्वितौ चिक्षिपतुर्भयावहं नदन्तमुत्क्षिप्य बिले तु राक्षसम्।।3.4.28।।
transliteration: tamāhave dāruṇamāśuvikramau sthirāvubhau saṃyati rāmalakṣmaṇau| mudānvitau cikṣipaturbhayāvahaṃ nadantamutkṣipya bile tu rākṣasam
translation: आशुविक्रमौ both warriors of quick and brave action, संयति in this battle, स्थिरौ stable, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, उभौ both, मुदा joy, अन्वितौ both endowed, आहवे in the war, दारुणम् dreadful, भयावहम् frightening, नदन्तम् was roaring तं राक्षसम् that demon, बलेन forcefully, उत्क्षिप्य  lifted, चिक्षिपतुः both of them  threw him down .
explanation: Rama and Lakshmana, stable and firm, brave and quick, together lifted the body of Viradha who was fierce in battle and roaring and forcibly threw it into the pit with joy.

shloka_text: अवध्यतां प्रेक्ष्य महासुरस्य तौ शितेन शस्त्रेण तदा नरर्षभौ। समर्थ्य चात्यर्थविशारदावुभौ बिले विराधस्य वधं प्रचक्रतुः।।3.4.29।।
transliteration: avadhyatāṃ prekṣya mahāsurasya tau śitena śastreṇa tadā nararṣabhau| samarthya cātyarthaviśāradāvubhau bile virādhasya vadhaṃ pracakratuḥ
translation: तदा then, नरर्षभौ both bulls among men, अत्यर्थविशारदौ very efficient, तौ उभौ both of them, शितेन with sharp, शस्त्रेण weapons, महासुरस्य of that mighty demon, तस्य विराधस्य of that Viradha, अवध्यताम् not to be killed in any other way, प्रेक्ष्य having seen, समर्थ्य after reflecting over the issue, बिले in hole, वधं killed, प्रचक्रतुः both undertook.
explanation: The two princes, bulls among men, who were adept in archery saw that the great demon could not be killed by any other means. They reflected over the issue  and undertook the task of killing him with sharp weapons and buried him in a pit.

shloka_text: स्वयं विराधेन हि मृत्युरात्मनः प्रसह्य रामेण यथार्थमीप्सितः। निवेदितः काननचारिणा स्वयं न मे वधः शस्त्रकृतो भवेदिति।।3.4.30।।
transliteration: svayaṃ virādhena hi mṛtyurātmanaḥ prasahya rāmeṇa yathārthamīpsitaḥ| niveditaḥ kānanacāriṇā svayaṃ na me vadhaḥ śastrakṛto bhavediti
translation: विराधेन by Viradha, स्वयम् himself, आत्मनः for him, मृत्युः death, यथार्थम् truly, प्रसह्य forcibly, रामेण by Rama, ईप्सितः wished to, काननचारिणा one by the forestranger, मे  for me, शस्त्र कृतः by the weapons, वधः kill, न भवेत् not possible for you, इति thus, स्वयम् he himself, निवेदितः was revealed.
explanation: Rama deliberately wanted to kill Viradha with weapons. Viradha the forestranger himself revealed that it was not possible to kill him with weapons and asked Rama to bury him in a pit.

shloka_text: तदेव रामेण निशम्य भाषितं कृता मतिस्तस्य बिलप्रवेशने। बिलं च रामेणातिबलेन रक्षसा प्रवेश्यमानेन वनं विनादितम्।।3.4.31।।
transliteration: tadeva rāmeṇa niśamya bhāṣitaṃ kṛtā matistasya bilapraveśane| bilaṃ ca rāmeṇātibalena rakṣasā praveśyamānena vanaṃ vināditam
translation: तत् then, भाषितमेव words spoken, निशम्य hearing, रामेण by Rama, तस्य his, बिलप्रवेशने putting him in the pit, मतिः mind, कृता determined, बिलम् pit, प्रवेश्यमानेन while placing, अतिबलेन  mighty, रामेण by Rama, रक्षसा  by the demons, वनम् forest, विनादितम् echoed.
explanation: While Rama, who had made up his mind after hearing him, was putting the mighty demon in the pit, the forest rang with his roar.

shloka_text: प्रहृष्टरूपाविव रामलक्ष्मणौ विराधमुर्व्या प्रदरे निहत्य तौ। ननन्दतुर्वीतभयौ महावने शिलाभिरन्तर्दधतुश्च राक्षसम्।।3.4.32।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭarūpāviva rāmalakṣmaṇau virādhamurvyā pradare nihatya tau| nanandaturvītabhayau mahāvane śilābhirantardadhatuśca rākṣasam
translation: प्रहृष्टरूपाविव both joyful, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, तं विराधम् that Viradha, उर्व्याः earth's, प्रदरे in the crevice, निहत्य after killing, वीतभयौ both fearlessly, महावने in the great forest, ननन्दतुः both rejoiced, राक्षसम् to the demon, शिलाभिः with rocks, अन्तर्दधतुश्च  covered him.
explanation: Rama and Lakshmana were happy to consign Viradha's body to the pit after killing him. They filled the pit with rocks in the great forest without fear.

shloka_text: हत्वा तु तं भीमबलं विराधं राक्षसं वने। ततस्सीतां परिष्वज्य समाश्वास्य च वीर्यवान्।।3.5.1।। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं रामो भ्रातरं दीप्ततेजसम्।
transliteration: hatvā tu taṃ bhīmabalaṃ virādhaṃ rākṣasaṃ vane| tatassītāṃ pariṣvajya samāśvāsya ca vīryavān abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo bhrātaraṃ dīptatejasam|
translation: वीर्यवान् heroic, रामः Rama, भीमबलम् of terrific strength, राक्षसम् demon, तं विराधम् that Viradha, वने in the forest, हत्वा on killing, ततः thereafter, सीताम् Sita, परिष्वज्य embraced, समाश्वास्य च connsoled, दीप्ततेजसम् glowing like fire, भ्रातरम्  brother,  अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: On killing Viradha, the demon of terrific strength, heroic Rama embraced Sita, consoled her and said to his brother Lakshmana, glowing like fire:
comments: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana meet sage Sarabhanga -- Rama enquires about Devendra's visit -- Sarabhanga advises Rama to go to the hermitage of  Sutikshna -- with the desire to go to the world of the Brahman, Sarabhanga enters the fire.

shloka_text: कष्टं वनमिदं दुर्गं न च स्म वनगोचराः।।3.5.2।। अभिगच्छामहे शीघ्रं शरभङ्गं तपोधनम्।
transliteration: kaṣṭaṃ vanamidaṃ durgaṃ na ca sma vanagocarāḥ abhigacchāmahe śīghraṃ śarabhaṅgaṃ tapodhanam|
translation: इदम् this, दुर्गम् wild, वनम् forest, कष्टम् is difficult, वनगोचराः uracquainted, न च स्मः we are not, शीघ्रम् quickly, तपोधनम् to the sage, शरभङ्गम् Sarabhanga, अभिगच्छामहे we shall go.
explanation: This wild forest with which we have not been acquainted earlier is difficult  to pass. (Hence) let us proceed quickly to sage Sarabhanga.

shloka_text: आश्रमं शरभङ्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह।।3.5.3।। तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्।।3.5.4।।
transliteration: āśramaṃ śarabhaṅgasya rāghavo'bhijagāma ha tasya devaprabhāvasya tapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ| samīpe śarabhaṅgasya dadarśa mahadadbhutam
translation: राघवः Rama, शरभङ्गस्य Sarabhanga's, आश्रमम् hermitage, अभिजगाम ह reached, देवप्रभावस्य of divine grace, तपसा by penance, भावितात्मनः had realised his self, तस्य शरभङ्गस्य that Sarabhanga's, समीपे  nearby, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful phenomenon, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

shloka_text: आश्रमं शरभङ्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह।।3.5.3।। तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्।।3.5.4।।
transliteration: āśramaṃ śarabhaṅgasya rāghavo'bhijagāma ha tasya devaprabhāvasya tapasā bhāvitātmanaḥ| samīpe śarabhaṅgasya dadarśa mahadadbhutam
translation: राघवः Rama, शरभङ्गस्य Sarabhanga's, आश्रमम् hermitage, अभिजगाम ह reached, देवप्रभावस्य of divine grace, तपसा by penance, भावितात्मनः had realised his self, तस्य शरभङ्गस्य that Sarabhanga's, समीपे  nearby, महत् great, अद्भुतम् wonderful phenomenon, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

shloka_text: विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम्। अवरुह्यरथोत्सङ्गादाकाशे विबुधानुगम।।3.5.5।। असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्। सुप्रभाभरणं देवं विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्।।3.5.6।। तद्विधैरेव बहुभिः पूज्यमानं महात्मभिः।
transliteration: vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā sūryavaiśvānaropamam| avaruhyarathotsaṅgādākāśe vibudhānugama asaṃspṛśantaṃ vasudhāṃ dadarśa vibudheśvaram| suprabhābharaṇaṃ devaṃ virajo'mbaradhāriṇam tadvidhaireva bahubhiḥ pūjyamānaṃ mahātmabhiḥ|
translation: वपुषा with his body, विभ्राजमानम् shining, सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम् like the Sun or the fire, रथोत्सङ्गात् from the the lap of the chariot, अवरुह्य descending, आकाशे in the sky, विबुधानुगम followed by the gods, विबुधेस्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), वसुधाम् earth, असंस्पृशन्तं without touching, सुप्रभाभरणम् adorned with shining ornaments, विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम् wearing pure white clothes (that never got soiled), तद्विधैरेव like him, बहुभिः many, महात्मभिः by great souls, पूज्यमानम्  worshipped, देवम् deity, विबुदेश्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), ददर्श witnessed.
explanation: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

shloka_text: विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम्। अवरुह्यरथोत्सङ्गादाकाशे विबुधानुगम।।3.5.5।। असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्। सुप्रभाभरणं देवं विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्।।3.5.6।। तद्विधैरेव बहुभिः पूज्यमानं महात्मभिः।
transliteration: vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā sūryavaiśvānaropamam| avaruhyarathotsaṅgādākāśe vibudhānugama asaṃspṛśantaṃ vasudhāṃ dadarśa vibudheśvaram| suprabhābharaṇaṃ devaṃ virajo'mbaradhāriṇam tadvidhaireva bahubhiḥ pūjyamānaṃ mahātmabhiḥ|
translation: वपुषा with his body, विभ्राजमानम् shining, सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम् like the Sun or the fire, रथोत्सङ्गात् from the the lap of the chariot, अवरुह्य descending, आकाशे in the sky, विबुधानुगम followed by the gods, विबुधेस्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), वसुधाम् earth, असंस्पृशन्तं without touching, सुप्रभाभरणम् adorned with shining ornaments, विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम् wearing pure white clothes (that never got soiled), तद्विधैरेव like him, बहुभिः many, महात्मभिः by great souls, पूज्यमानम्  worshipped, देवम् deity, विबुदेश्वरम् lord of the gods (Indra), ददर्श witnessed.
explanation: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

shloka_text: हरिभिर्वाजिभिर्युक्तमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.7।। ददर्शादूरतस्तस्य तरुणादित्यसन्निभम्। पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यं चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम्।।3.5.8।।
transliteration: haribhirvājibhiryuktamantarikṣagataṃ ratham dadarśādūratastasya taruṇādityasannibham| pāṇḍurābhraghanaprakhyaṃ candramaṇḍalasannibham
translation: तस्य from that place, अदूरतः not far from, हरितैः by tawnycoloured, वाजिभिः by horses, युक्तम् yoked with, तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् shining like the rising sun, पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यम् comparable to a palewhite cloud, चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम् shining like the lunar orb, अन्तरिक्षगतम् found in the sky, रथम् chariot, ददर्श witnessed.
explanation: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

shloka_text: हरिभिर्वाजिभिर्युक्तमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.7।। ददर्शादूरतस्तस्य तरुणादित्यसन्निभम्। पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यं चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम्।।3.5.8।।
transliteration: haribhirvājibhiryuktamantarikṣagataṃ ratham dadarśādūratastasya taruṇādityasannibham| pāṇḍurābhraghanaprakhyaṃ candramaṇḍalasannibham
translation: तस्य from that place, अदूरतः not far from, हरितैः by tawnycoloured, वाजिभिः by horses, युक्तम् yoked with, तरुणादित्यसन्निभम् shining like the rising sun, पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यम् comparable to a palewhite cloud, चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम् shining like the lunar orb, अन्तरिक्षगतम् found in the sky, रथम् chariot, ददर्श witnessed.
explanation: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

shloka_text: अपश्यद्विमलं छत्रं चित्रमाल्योपशोभितम्। चामरव्यजने चाग्र्ये रुक्मदण्डे महाधने।।3.5.9।। गृहीते वरनारीभ्यां धूयमाने च मूर्धनि।
transliteration: apaśyadvimalaṃ chatraṃ citramālyopaśobhitam| cāmaravyajane cāgrye rukmadaṇḍe mahādhane gṛhīte varanārībhyāṃ dhūyamāne ca mūrdhani|
translation: विमलम् pure white, चित्रमाल्योपशोभितम् decked with variegated flower garlands, छत्रम् umbrella, अग्य्रे  in the forefront, रुक्मदण्डे golden staff, महाधने very costly, वरनारीभ्याम् by two excellent women, गृहीते held, मूर्धनि near the head, धूयमाने fanning, चामरव्यजने  'Chamara' made of yak's tail, अपश्यत् saw.
explanation: Rama saw a pure white umbrella with a highly expensive golden staff, decorated with variegated flower garlands.While near his (Indra's) head stood a pair of exquisite ladies with fans made of yak's tail.

shloka_text: गन्धर्वामरसिद्धाश्च बहवः परमर्षयः।।3.5.10।। अन्तरिक्षगतं देवं वाग्भिरग्य्राभिरीडिरे।
transliteration: gandharvāmarasiddhāśca bahavaḥ paramarṣayaḥ antarikṣagataṃ devaṃ vāgbhiragyrābhirīḍire|
translation: गन्धर्वामरसिद्धाश्च celestial musicians, gods and siddhas, बहवः many, परमर्षयः great sages, अन्तरिक्षगतम् stationed in the sky, देवम् deity, अग्य्राभिः by choicest, वाग्भि: with words, ईडिरे praised.
explanation: Many celestial singers of heaven, gods, great sages and siddhas sang with the choicest words the glory of this god stationed in the sky.

shloka_text: सह सम्भाषमाणे तु शरभङ्गेन वासवे।।3.5.11।। दृष्ट्वा शतक्रतुं तत्र रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: saha sambhāṣamāṇe tu śarabhaṅgena vāsave dṛṣṭvā śatakratuṃ tatra rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt|
translation: वासवे Indra, शरभङ्गेन with Sarabhanga, सह सम्भाषमाणे was conversing with, तत्र there, शतक्रतुम् Indra, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, रामः Rama, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: While Indra was conversing with Sarabhanga, Rama saw him and said to Lakshmana.

shloka_text: रामोऽथ रथमुद्दिश्य लक्ष्मणायप्रदर्शयन्।।3.5.12।। अर्चिष्मन्तं श्रिया जुष्टमद्भुतं पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.13।।
transliteration: rāmo'tha rathamuddiśya lakṣmaṇāyapradarśayan arciṣmantaṃ śriyā juṣṭamadbhutaṃ paśya lakṣmaṇa| pratapantamivādityamantarikṣagataṃ ratham
translation: अथ then, रामः Rama, रथम् chariot, उद्दिश्य pointing at, अद्भुतम् wonderful one, भ्रातुः brother, प्रदर्शयन् while showing, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अर्चिष्मन्तम् effulgent, श्रिया with grace, जुष्टम् endowed with, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रतपन्तम् shining, आदित्यमिव like the Sun, अन्तरिक्षगतम् in the sky, रथम् chariot, पश्य see,
explanation: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

shloka_text: रामोऽथ रथमुद्दिश्य लक्ष्मणायप्रदर्शयन्।।3.5.12।। अर्चिष्मन्तं श्रिया जुष्टमद्भुतं पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.13।।
transliteration: rāmo'tha rathamuddiśya lakṣmaṇāyapradarśayan arciṣmantaṃ śriyā juṣṭamadbhutaṃ paśya lakṣmaṇa| pratapantamivādityamantarikṣagataṃ ratham
translation: अथ then, रामः Rama, रथम् chariot, उद्दिश्य pointing at, अद्भुतम् wonderful one, भ्रातुः brother, प्रदर्शयन् while showing, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अर्चिष्मन्तम् effulgent, श्रिया with grace, जुष्टम् endowed with, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रतपन्तम् shining, आदित्यमिव like the Sun, अन्तरिक्षगतम् in the sky, रथम् chariot, पश्य see,
explanation: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

shloka_text: ये हयाः पुरुहूतस्य पुरा शक्रस्य नश्श्रुताः। अन्तरिक्षगता दिव्यास्त इमे हरयो ध्रुवम्।।3.5.14।।
transliteration: ye hayāḥ puruhūtasya purā śakrasya naśśrutāḥ| antarikṣagatā divyāsta ime harayo dhruvam
translation: पुरुहूतस्य of Indra who is often invoked, शक्रस्य of Indra, ये those, हयाः horses, नः for us, पुरा earlier, श्रुताः heard, ते those, हरयः horses, अन्तरिक्षगताः stationed in the sky, दिव्याः wonderful, इमे we, ध्रुवम् surely.
explanation: The horses of Indra, who is often invoked (during sacrificial rituals) and about whom  we have heard earlier, are now stationed in the sky.

shloka_text: इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः। शोणांशुवसनास्सर्वे व्याध्रा इव दुरासदाः।।3.5.16।। उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसन्निभाः। रूपं बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्।।3.5.17।।
transliteration: ime ca puruṣavyāghrā ye tiṣṭhntyabhito ratham| śataṃ śataṃ kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ khaṅgapāṇayaḥ vistīrṇavipuloraskāḥ parighāyatabāhavaḥ| śoṇāṃśuvasanāssarve vyādhrā iva durāsadāḥ urodeśeṣu sarveṣāṃ hārā jvalanasannibhāḥ| rūpaṃ bibhrati saumitre pañcaviṃśativārṣikam
translation: सौमित्रे O Lakshmana, पुरुषव्याघ्राः finest among men, दिशम् अभितः in each direction, ये those, शतं शतम् in hundreds , कुण्डलिनः wearing earrings, खङ्गपाणयः holding swords in their hands, विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः broadchested, परिघायतबाहवः with iron beamlike strong arms, शोणांशुवसनाः clad in red clothes, युवानः youth, इमे सर्वे all of them, व्याघ्रा इव like tigers, दुरासदाः difficult to overpower, सर्वेषाम् all of them, उरोदेशेषु in their chest, ज्वलनसन्निभाः flaming like fire, हाराः necklaces, पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम् of twentyfive years of age, रूपम् appearance, बिभ्रति appear.
explanation: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.
