explanation: The place covered with banana plants and coconut trees  as well as blossoming sal and tamala trees was looking extremely beautiful.

shloka_text: नागैस्सुपर्णैर्गन्धैर्वैः किन्नरैश्च सहस्रशः। अजैर्वैखानसैर्माषैर्वालखिल्यैर्मरीचिपैः।।3.35.14।। अत्यन्तनियताहारैश्शोभितं परमर्षिभिः। जितकामैश्च सिद्धैश्च चारणैरुपशोभितम्।।3.35.15।।
transliteration: nāgaissuparṇairgandhairvaiḥ kinnaraiśca sahasraśaḥ| ajairvaikhānasairmāṣairvālakhilyairmarīcipaiḥ atyantaniyatāhāraiśśobhitaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ| jitakāmaiśca siddhaiśca cāraṇairupaśobhitam
translation: नागैः with nagas, सुपर्णैः with garudas, गन्धर्वैः gandharvas, सहस्रशः in thousands, किन्नरैश्च with kinneras, आजैः by ajas, वैखानसैः by vaikhanasas, माषैः by mashas, मरीचिपैः by mareechipas, वालखिल्यैः by valakhilyas, अत्यन्तनियताहारैः by those who are highly disciplined in food, परमर्षिभिः by great sages, शोभितम् looked charming, जितकामैः by  those with perfect control over desires, सिद्धैश्च by the spiritually accomplished, चारणैः by charanas, उपशोभितम् delightful.
explanation: The place looked charming with nagas, garudas, gandharvas, kinneras in their thousands and with the descendants of ajas, vaikhanasas, valakhilyas and with those who drink the rays of Sun and Moon for survival, with  sages who were highly disciplined in the intake of food,  spiritually accomplished  and selfcontrolled hermits and charanas.

shloka_text: नागैस्सुपर्णैर्गन्धैर्वैः किन्नरैश्च सहस्रशः। अजैर्वैखानसैर्माषैर्वालखिल्यैर्मरीचिपैः।।3.35.14।। अत्यन्तनियताहारैश्शोभितं परमर्षिभिः। जितकामैश्च सिद्धैश्च चारणैरुपशोभितम्।।3.35.15।।
transliteration: nāgaissuparṇairgandhairvaiḥ kinnaraiśca sahasraśaḥ| ajairvaikhānasairmāṣairvālakhilyairmarīcipaiḥ atyantaniyatāhāraiśśobhitaṃ paramarṣibhiḥ| jitakāmaiśca siddhaiśca cāraṇairupaśobhitam
translation: नागैः with nagas, सुपर्णैः with garudas, गन्धर्वैः gandharvas, सहस्रशः in thousands, किन्नरैश्च with kinneras, आजैः by ajas, वैखानसैः by vaikhanasas, माषैः by mashas, मरीचिपैः by mareechipas, वालखिल्यैः by valakhilyas, अत्यन्तनियताहारैः by those who are highly disciplined in food, परमर्षिभिः by great sages, शोभितम् looked charming, जितकामैः by  those with perfect control over desires, सिद्धैश्च by the spiritually accomplished, चारणैः by charanas, उपशोभितम् delightful.
explanation: The place looked charming with nagas, garudas, gandharvas, kinneras in their thousands and with the descendants of ajas, vaikhanasas, valakhilyas and with those who drink the rays of Sun and Moon for survival, with  sages who were highly disciplined in the intake of food,  spiritually accomplished  and selfcontrolled hermits and charanas.

shloka_text: दिव्याभरणमाल्याभिर्दिव्यरूपाभिरावृतम्। क्रीडारतिविधिज्ञाभिरप्सरोभिस्सहस्रशः।।3.35.16।।
transliteration: divyābharaṇamālyābhirdivyarūpābhirāvṛtam| krīḍāratividhijñābhirapsarobhissahasraśaḥ
translation: दिव्याभरणमाल्याभिः  bedecked with fine ornaments and garlands, दिव्यरूपाभिः  paragons of beauty, क्रीडारतिविधिज्ञाभिः ladies acquainted with various lovesports, सहस्रशः  thousands, अप्सरोभि: apsaras, आवृतम् full of.
explanation: (The place was) full of apsaras  in their thousands and paragons of beauty adorned with divine ornaments and garlands, and experts in lovesports.

shloka_text: सेवितं देवपन्तीभिश्श्रीमतीभिश्श्रियाऽऽवृतम्। देवदानवसङ्घैश्च चरितं त्वमृताशिभिः।।3.35.17।।
transliteration: sevitaṃ devapantībhiśśrīmatībhiśśriyā''vṛtam| devadānavasaṅghaiśca caritaṃ tvamṛtāśibhiḥ
translation: श्रीमतीभिः prosperous (deities), देवपत्नीभिः goddesses, सेवितम्  inhabited, श्रिया resort , वृतम् endowed, अमृतार्थिभिः gods who sought nectar, देवदानवसङ्घैश्च by hosts of gods and demons, चरितम् wandered about.
explanation: It was chosen by prosperous wives of gods as a reosrt. Hosts of gods and demons were wandering, there in the hope of tasting nectar.

shloka_text: हंसक्रौञ्चप्लवाकीर्णं सारसैस्सम्प्रणादितम्। वैढूर्यप्रस्तरं रम्यं स्निग्धं सागरतेजसा।।3.35.18।।
transliteration: haṃsakrauñcaplavākīrṇaṃ sārasaissampraṇāditam| vaiḍhūryaprastaraṃ ramyaṃ snigdhaṃ sāgaratejasā
translation: हंसक्रौञ्चप्लवाकीर्णम् full of flocks of swans and kraunchas and small floats, सारसैः by sarasa birds, सम्प्रणादितम् filled with sound, वैढूर्यप्रस्तरम् having a stretch of vaidurya stones, रम्यम् delightful, सागरतेजसा by the radiance of the sea, स्निग्धम् shining.
explanation: (It was ) full of small floats, flocks of swans, kraunchas, sarasas cackling in the ponds, with great joy. It had stretches of vaidurya stones on the shore and shone with the radiance of the sea

shloka_text: पाण्डुराणि विशालानि दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च। तूर्यगीताभिजुष्टानि विमानानि समन्ततः।।3.35.19।। तपसा जितलोकानां कामगान्यभिसम्पतन्। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव ददर्श धनदानुजः।।3.35.20।।
transliteration: pāṇḍurāṇi viśālāni divyamālyayutāni ca| tūryagītābhijuṣṭāni vimānāni samantataḥ tapasā jitalokānāṃ kāmagānyabhisampatan| gandharvāpsarasaścaiva dadarśa dhanadānujaḥ
translation: अभिसम्पतन् spleding along, धनदानुजः younger brother of Kubera, तपसा with penance, जितलोकानाम्  who has conquered all the worlds, पाण्डुराणि by pale ones, विशालानि large ones, दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च with divine flower garlands, तूर्यगीताभिजुष्टानि ringing with divine strains of music, कामगानि fly where one desires, विमानानि aerial chariots, समन्ततः on all sides, गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव by gandharvas and apsaras also, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Speeding along, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw palewhite, spacious aerial chariots on all sides controlled by those who had conquered the higher worlds by their penances. These chariots, decked with heavenly garlands, and ringing with divine music could fly where one desired. He saw gandharvas and apsaras as well.

shloka_text: पाण्डुराणि विशालानि दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च। तूर्यगीताभिजुष्टानि विमानानि समन्ततः।।3.35.19।। तपसा जितलोकानां कामगान्यभिसम्पतन्। गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव ददर्श धनदानुजः।।3.35.20।।
transliteration: pāṇḍurāṇi viśālāni divyamālyayutāni ca| tūryagītābhijuṣṭāni vimānāni samantataḥ tapasā jitalokānāṃ kāmagānyabhisampatan| gandharvāpsarasaścaiva dadarśa dhanadānujaḥ
translation: अभिसम्पतन् spleding along, धनदानुजः younger brother of Kubera, तपसा with penance, जितलोकानाम्  who has conquered all the worlds, पाण्डुराणि by pale ones, विशालानि large ones, दिव्यमाल्ययुतानि च with divine flower garlands, तूर्यगीताभिजुष्टानि ringing with divine strains of music, कामगानि fly where one desires, विमानानि aerial chariots, समन्ततः on all sides, गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्चैव by gandharvas and apsaras also, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Speeding along, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw palewhite, spacious aerial chariots on all sides controlled by those who had conquered the higher worlds by their penances. These chariots, decked with heavenly garlands, and ringing with divine music could fly where one desired. He saw gandharvas and apsaras as well.

shloka_text: निर्यासरसमूलानां चन्दनानां सहस्रशः। वनानि पश्यन्सौम्यानि घ्राणतृप्तिकराणि च।।3.35.21।।
transliteration: niryāsarasamūlānāṃ candanānāṃ sahasraśaḥ| vanāni paśyansaumyāni ghrāṇatṛptikarāṇi ca
translation: निर्यासरसमूलानाम्  tree trunks with resins (emitting juices), चन्दनानाम् of sandalwood trees, सौम्यानि delighting, घ्राणतृप्तिकराणि satisfying to smell, च and, सहस्रशः by thousands, वनानि trees, पश्यन् seeing,
explanation: He saw thousands of tree trunks with finesmelling resins and sandalwood trees.

shloka_text: अगरूणां च मुख्यानां वनान्युपवनानि च। तक्कोलानां च जात्यानां फलानां च सुगन्धिनाम्।।3.35.22।।
transliteration: agarūṇāṃ ca mukhyānāṃ vanānyupavanāni ca| takkolānāṃ ca jātyānāṃ phalānāṃ ca sugandhinām
translation: मुख्यानाम् of the prominent ones, अगुरूणाम् aguru trees, वनानि forests, उपवनानि च pleasuregroves, तक्कोलानाम् of takkola fruits, फलानाम् of fruits, सुगन्धिनाम् of the fragrant ones, जात्यानाम् nutmegs,
explanation: (He saw) very fine aguru trees in the forest as well as pleasuregroves of takkola fruits, fragrant  trees of a fine variety and fragrant nutmegs.

shloka_text: पुष्पाणि च तमालस्य गुल्मानि मरिचस्य च। मुक्तानां च समूहानि शुष्यमाणानि तीरतः।।3.35.23।।
transliteration: puṣpāṇi ca tamālasya gulmāni maricasya ca| muktānāṃ ca samūhāni śuṣyamāṇāni tīrataḥ
translation: तमालस्य tamala trees, पुष्पाणि flowers in bloom, मरिचस्य of pepper, गुल्मानि shrubs, तीरतः on the shore, शुष्यमाणानि drying, मुक्तानाम् pearls, समूहानि च hoards,
explanation: (He saw) tamala flowers in bloom, pepper shrubs in clusters and hoards of pearls kept for drying on the shores.

shloka_text: शङ्खानां प्रसरं चैव प्रवालनिचयं तथा। काञ्चनानि च शैलानि राजतानि च सर्वशः।।3.35.24।।
transliteration: śaṅkhānāṃ prasaraṃ caiva pravālanicayaṃ tathā| kāñcanāni ca śailāni rājatāni ca sarvaśaḥ
translation: शङ्खानाम् conches, प्रसरं चैव stretch also, तथा likewise, प्रवालनिचयम् heaps of corals, सर्वशः all over, काञ्चनानि gold, राजतानि च and silver, शैलानि mounds,
explanation: He saw stretches of conches, heaps of corals and mounds of gold and silver too.

shloka_text: प्रस्रवाणि मनोज्ञानि प्रसन्नानि ह्रदानि च। धनधान्योपपन्नानि स्त्रीरत्नैश्शोभितानि च।।3.35.25।। हस्त्यश्वरथगाढानि नगराण्यवलोकयन्।
transliteration: prasravāṇi manojñāni prasannāni hradāni ca| dhanadhānyopapannāni strīratnaiśśobhitāni ca hastyaśvarathagāḍhāni nagarāṇyavalokayan|
translation: मनोज्ञानि fascinating , प्रस्रवाणि waterfalls, प्रसन्नानि pleasing, ह्रदानि च ponds, धनधान्योपपन्नानि endowed with wealth and grains in abundance, स्त्रीरत्नैः best of women, शोभितानि  splendid looking, हस्त्यश्वरथगाढानि elephants with, horses and chariots, नगराणि cities, अवलोकयन् went on seeing.
explanation: He went watching fascinating waterfalls, pleasing ponds, cities filled with wealth and grain, looking splendid with beautiful women and full of elephants, horses and chariots.

shloka_text: तं समं सर्वतस्निग्धं मृदुसंस्पर्शमारुतम्। अनूपं सिन्धुराजस्य ददर्श त्रिदिवोपमम्।।3.35.26।।
transliteration: taṃ samaṃ sarvatasnigdhaṃ mṛdusaṃsparśamārutam| anūpaṃ sindhurājasya dadarśa tridivopamam
translation: सर्वतः all over, समम् levelled, स्निग्धम् beautiful, मृदुसंस्पर्शमारुतम् the breeze gentle to touch, त्रिदिवोपमम् comparable to heaven, सिन्धुराजस्य of the sea, तम् अनूपम् backwaters, ददर्श saw.
explanation: It was a veritable heaven with the plain land flooded with the backwaters of the sea and gentle breeze blowing.

shloka_text: तत्रापश्यत्स मेघाभं न्यग्रोधमृषिभिर्वृतम्।।3.35.27।। समन्ताद्यस्य ताश्शाखाश्शतयोजनमायताः।
transliteration: tatrāpaśyatsa meghābhaṃ nyagrodhamṛṣibhirvṛtam samantādyasya tāśśākhāśśatayojanamāyatāḥ|
translation: तत्र there, सः he, यस्य whose, शाखा branches, शतयोजनम् one hundred yojanas, आयताः spread, मेघाभम् looking like a cloud, ऋषिभिः वृतम् occupied by sages, न्यग्रोधम् banyan tree, अपश्यत् saw.
explanation: He saw a banyan tree with its branches spread on all sides measuring a hundred yojanas, looking like a cloud and providing shelter to the sages.

shloka_text: यस्य हस्तिनमादाय महाकायं च कच्छपम्।।3.35.28।। भक्षार्थं गरुडश्शाखामाजगाम महाबलः।
transliteration: yasya hastinamādāya mahākāyaṃ ca kacchapam bhakṣārthaṃ garuḍaśśākhāmājagāma mahābalaḥ|
translation: महाबलः very strong, गरुडः Garuda, भक्षार्थम् for food, हस्तिनम् elephant, महाकायम् of huge body, कच्छपं च and tortoise, आदाय after getting, यस्य whose, शाखाम् branch, आजगाम came to,
explanation: In the past, the mighty Garuda brought an elephant and a huge tortoise and sat on a branch of this tree to feed on them.

shloka_text: तस्य तां सहसा शाखां भारेण पतगोत्तमः।।3.35.29।। सुपर्णः पर्णबहुलां बभञ्ज च महाबलः।
transliteration: tasya tāṃ sahasā śākhāṃ bhāreṇa patagottamaḥ suparṇaḥ parṇabahulāṃ babhañja ca mahābalaḥ|
translation: पतगोत्तमः the best of birds, महाबलः very strong, सुपर्णः Suparna (Garuda), तस्य his, तां शाखाम् that  branch, भारेण with weight, सहसा at once, बभञ्ज broke, पर्णबहुलां full of leaves.
explanation: Due to the weight of this best of birds, the mighty Garuda, the leafy branch at once broke down.

shloka_text: तत्र वैखानसा माषा वालखिल्या मरीचिपाः।।3.35.30।। अजा बभूवुर्धूम्राश्च सङ्गताः परमर्षयः।
transliteration: tatra vaikhānasā māṣā vālakhilyā marīcipāḥ ajā babhūvurdhūmrāśca saṅgatāḥ paramarṣayaḥ|
translation: वैखानसा: vaikhanasas, माषाः mashas, मरीचिपाः marichipas, वालखिल्याः valakhilyas, अजाः ajas,धूम्राश्च dhumras, परमर्षयश्च great seers,तत्र there, सङ्गताः gathered,बभूवुः  were.
explanation: Gathered together under the great tree were great sages like vaikhanasas, mashas, marichipas, valakhilyas, ajas and dhumras.

shloka_text: तेषां दयार्थं गरुडस्तां शाखां शतयोजनाम्।।3.35.31।। जगामादाय वेगेन तौ चोभौ गजकच्छपौ।
transliteration: teṣāṃ dayārthaṃ garuḍastāṃ śākhāṃ śatayojanām jagāmādāya vegena tau cobhau gajakacchapau|
translation: गरुडः Garuda, तेषाम् their, दयार्थम् out of compassion, शतयोजनाम् extending to a hundred yojanas, तां शाखाम् that branch, तौ उभौ both, गजकच्छपौ elephant and the tortoise, आदाय taking, वेगेन with speed, जगाम went.
explanation: Out of compassion for the (endangered) seers Garuda carried away that hundredyojanalong branch along with the elephant and the tortoise with great speed.

shloka_text: एकपादेन धर्मात्मा भक्षयित्वा तदामिषम्।।3.35.32।। निषादविषयं हत्वा शाखया पतगोत्तमः। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे मोक्षयित्वा महामुनीन्।।3.35.33।।
transliteration: ekapādena dharmātmā bhakṣayitvā tadāmiṣam niṣādaviṣayaṃ hatvā śākhayā patagottamaḥ| praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe mokṣayitvā mahāmunīn
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous self, पतगोत्तमः the best among birds (Garuda), तत् that, आमिषम् meat, एकपादेन (standing) on one foot, भक्षयित्वा eating, शाखया with the branch, निषादविषयम्  settlement  of nightwalkers, हत्वा destroying, महामुनीन् great seers, मोक्षयित्वा delivering, अतुलम् great, प्रहर्षम् happiness, लेभे felt.
explanation: Righteous Garuda, the best among the birds, stood on one foot and ate the flesh (of elephant and tortoise) and  with the branch of the tree, destroyed the settlement of the demons. Over the destruction of the demons and deliverance of the great seers he felt immeasurable happiness.

shloka_text: एकपादेन धर्मात्मा भक्षयित्वा तदामिषम्।।3.35.32।। निषादविषयं हत्वा शाखया पतगोत्तमः। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे मोक्षयित्वा महामुनीन्।।3.35.33।।
transliteration: ekapādena dharmātmā bhakṣayitvā tadāmiṣam niṣādaviṣayaṃ hatvā śākhayā patagottamaḥ| praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe mokṣayitvā mahāmunīn
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous self, पतगोत्तमः the best among birds (Garuda), तत् that, आमिषम् meat, एकपादेन (standing) on one foot, भक्षयित्वा eating, शाखया with the branch, निषादविषयम्  settlement  of nightwalkers, हत्वा destroying, महामुनीन् great seers, मोक्षयित्वा delivering, अतुलम् great, प्रहर्षम् happiness, लेभे felt.
explanation: Righteous Garuda, the best among the birds, stood on one foot and ate the flesh (of elephant and tortoise) and  with the branch of the tree, destroyed the settlement of the demons. Over the destruction of the demons and deliverance of the great seers he felt immeasurable happiness.

shloka_text: स तेनैव प्रहर्षेण द्विगुणीकृतविक्रमः। अमृतानयनार्थं वै चकार मतिमान्मतिम्।।3.35.34।।
transliteration: sa tenaiva praharṣeṇa dviguṇīkṛtavikramaḥ| amṛtānayanārthaṃ vai cakāra matimānmatim
translation: मतिमान् wise, सः he (Garuda), तेनैव प्रहर्षेण out of that joy, द्विगुणीकृतविक्रमः with redoubled vigour, अमृतानयनार्थम् to obtain nectar, मतिम् चकार made up his mind.
explanation: Quite happy, his energy redoubled, wise Garuda made up his mind to obtain nectar.

shloka_text: अयोजालानि निर्मथ्य भित्वा रत्नमयं गृहम्। महेन्द्रभवनाद्गुप्तमाजहारामृतं ततः।।3.35.35।।
transliteration: ayojālāni nirmathya bhitvā ratnamayaṃ gṛham| mahendrabhavanādguptamājahārāmṛtaṃ tataḥ
translation: अयोजालानि grills of windows, निर्मथ्य twisting and twirling, रत्नमयम् गृहम् house made of gems, भित्वा breaking, ततः from there, महेन्द्रभवनात् from the palace of Indra, गुप्तम् secretly, अमृतम् nectar, आजहार carried away.
explanation: Twisting and twirling the grills of the window, he broke open the room made of gems and quietly carried away the nectar from Indra's mansion.

shloka_text: तं महर्षिगणैर्जुष्टं सुपर्णकृतलक्षणम्। नाम्ना सुभद्रं न्यग्रोधं ददर्श धनदानुजः।।3.35.36।।
transliteration: taṃ maharṣigaṇairjuṣṭaṃ suparṇakṛtalakṣaṇam| nāmnā subhadraṃ nyagrodhaṃ dadarśa dhanadānujaḥ
translation: धनदानुजः younger brother of Kubera, महर्षिगणैः by groups of seers, जुष्टम् favoured resort, सुपर्णकृतलक्षणम् marked with breaking of the branch by Garuda, नाम्ना by name, सुभद्रम् Subhadra, तं न्यग्रोधम् that banyan tree, ददर्श beheld.
explanation: Ravana, the younger brother of Kubera, beheld that banyan tree called Subhadram ,which was a favoured resort of the sages bearing the ensignia of Garuda.

shloka_text: तं तु गत्वा परं पारं समुद्रस्य नदीपतेः। ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते रम्ये पुण्ये वनान्तरे।।3.35.37।।
transliteration: taṃ tu gatvā paraṃ pāraṃ samudrasya nadīpateḥ| dadarśāśramamekānte ramye puṇye vanāntare
translation: नदीपतेः of lord of rivers(ocean), समुद्रस्य of the sea, तम् that, परं पारम् गत्वा going over to the other side, रम्ये in a beautiful, पुण्ये in a sacred, वनान्तरे in the middle of the forest, एकान्ते in a secluded place, आश्रमम् hermitage, ददर्श beheld.
explanation: Ravana crossed over to the other side of the sea, the lord of rivers, and beheld a hermitage in a beautiful, secluded, sacred  place in the middle of the forest.

shloka_text: तत्र कृष्णाजिनधरं जटावल्कलधारिणम्। ददर्श नियताहारं मारीचं नाम राक्षसाम्।।3.35.38।।
transliteration: tatra kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ jaṭāvalkaladhāriṇam| dadarśa niyatāhāraṃ mārīcaṃ nāma rākṣasām
translation: तत्र there,कृष्णाजिनधरम् clad in deerskin, जटावल्कलधारिणम् with matted hair and bark  cloth, नियताहारम् living on regulated food, मारीचं नाम  named Maricha, राक्षसम् a demon, ददर्श saw.
explanation: There he saw a demon Maricha, by name, clad in dark deerskin and bark ,with matted hair and living on restricted food.

shloka_text: स रावणस्समागम्य विधिवत्तेन रक्षसा। मारीचेनार्चितो राजा सर्वकामैरमानुषैः।।3.35.39।।
transliteration: sa rāvaṇassamāgamya vidhivattena rakṣasā| mārīcenārcito rājā sarvakāmairamānuṣaiḥ
translation: राजा king, सः रावणः Ravana, समागम्य reaching there, रक्षसा by the demon, तेन मारीचेन to Maricha, अमानुषैः superhuman, सर्वकामैः by fulfilling all desires, विधिवत् as per tradition, अर्चितः made worshipful offering.
explanation: When king Ravana reached there, Maricha received him  in accordance with tradition  and made worshipful offering to the king, fulfilling all his superhuman desires.

shloka_text: तं स्वयं पूजयित्वा तु भोजनेनोदकेन च। अर्थोपहितया वाचा मारीचो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.35.40।।
transliteration: taṃ svayaṃ pūjayitvā tu bhojanenodakena ca| arthopahitayā vācā mārīco vākyamabravīt
translation: मारीचः Maricha, तम् to him, भोजनेन food, उदकेन च water, स्वयम् himself, पूजयित्वा after offering, अर्थोपहितया meaningful, वाचा words, वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Maricha extended his hospitality with appropriate food and water and said with meaningful words:

shloka_text: कच्चित्सुकुशलं राजन्लङ्कायां राक्षसेश्वर। केनार्थेन पुनस्त्वं वै तूर्णमेवमिहागतः।।3.35.41।।
transliteration: kaccitsukuśalaṃ rājanlaṅkāyāṃ rākṣaseśvara| kenārthena punastvaṃ vai tūrṇamevamihāgataḥ
translation: राक्षसेश्वर O lord of demons, राजन् O king, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, सुकुशलं कच्चित् I hope every thing is well, त्वम् you, केन अर्थेन to what purpose, तूर्णम् so soon, एवम् like this, पुनः again, इह here, आगतः came?
explanation: O king  O lord of the demons  hope all is well in Lanka. What brings you here again so soon ?

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो महातेजा मारीचेन स रावणः। ततः पश्चादिदं वाक्यमब्रवीद्वाक्यकोविदः।।3.35.42।।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā mārīcena sa rāvaṇaḥ| tataḥ paścādidaṃ vākyamabravīdvākyakovidaḥ
translation: मारीचेन by Maricha, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken, महातेजाः effulgent, वाक्यकोविदः a skilled speaker, सः रावणः that Ravana, ततः पश्चात् later, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Thus addressed by Maricha, the effulgent, eloquent Ravana replied with these words: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: मारीच श्रूयातां तात वचनं मम भाषतः। आर्तोऽस्मि मम चार्तस्य भवान्हि परमा गतिः।।3.36.1।।
transliteration: mārīca śrūyātāṃ tāta vacanaṃ mama bhāṣataḥ| ārto'smi mama cārtasya bhavānhi paramā gatiḥ
translation: तात O child, मारीच Maricha, भाषतः as I speak, मम my, वचनम् words, श्रूयताम् hear, आर्तः distressed, अस्मि I am, आर्तस्य of the distressed, मम my, भवान् you, परमा ultimate, गतिः हि  refuge.
explanation: O dear Maricha hear my words. I am distressed and you are my ultimate refuge.
comments: Ravana tells the story of Janasthana-- urges Maricha to help him in abducting Sita-- Maricha dissuades Ravana and describes the virtues of Rama.

shloka_text: जानीषे त्वं जनस्थाने यथा भ्राता खरो मम। दूषणश्च महाबाहु स्वसा शूर्पणखा च मे।।3.36.2।। त्रिशिराश्च महातेजा राक्षसः पिशिताशनः। अन्ये च बहवश्शूरा लब्धलक्षा निशाचराः।।3.36.3।। वसत्नि मन्नियोगेन नित्यवासं च राक्षसाः। बाधमाना महारण्ये मुनीन्वै धर्मचारिणः।।3.36.4।।
transliteration: jānīṣe tvaṃ janasthāne yathā bhrātā kharo mama| dūṣaṇaśca mahābāhu svasā śūrpaṇakhā ca me triśirāśca mahātejā rākṣasaḥ piśitāśanaḥ| anye ca bahavaśśūrā labdhalakṣā niśācarāḥ vasatni manniyogena nityavāsaṃ ca rākṣasāḥ| bādhamānā mahāraṇye munīnvai dharmacāriṇaḥ
translation: मम my, भ्राता brother, खरः Khara, महाबाहुः of mighty arms, दूषणश्च and Dusana, मे my, स्वसा sister, शूर्पणखा च Surpanakha too, महातेजाः brilliant, पिशिताशनः flesh eater, राक्षसः demon, त्रिशिराश्च and Trisira, शूराः brave, लब्धलक्षाः unfailing in their targets, अन्ये बहवः many other, निशाचराः राक्षसाः nightwalker demons, मन्नियोगेन at my behest, महारण्ये in the great forest, धर्मचारिणः followers of righteous path, मुनीन् seers, बाधमानाः harassing, जनस्थाने at Janasthana, यथा likewise, नित्यवासं वसन्ति always living there, त्वम् you, जानीषे know.
explanation: You know that my brothers, Khara and Dusana, the strongarmed heroes, my sister Surpanakha and  the mighty cannibal Trisira, and many other heroic demons successful in hitting their targets are bonafide residents. They have been harassing the followers of righteous path (the sages) at my behest.

shloka_text: जानीषे त्वं जनस्थाने यथा भ्राता खरो मम। दूषणश्च महाबाहु स्वसा शूर्पणखा च मे।।3.36.2।। त्रिशिराश्च महातेजा राक्षसः पिशिताशनः। अन्ये च बहवश्शूरा लब्धलक्षा निशाचराः।।3.36.3।। वसत्नि मन्नियोगेन नित्यवासं च राक्षसाः। बाधमाना महारण्ये मुनीन्वै धर्मचारिणः।।3.36.4।।
transliteration: jānīṣe tvaṃ janasthāne yathā bhrātā kharo mama| dūṣaṇaśca mahābāhu svasā śūrpaṇakhā ca me triśirāśca mahātejā rākṣasaḥ piśitāśanaḥ| anye ca bahavaśśūrā labdhalakṣā niśācarāḥ vasatni manniyogena nityavāsaṃ ca rākṣasāḥ| bādhamānā mahāraṇye munīnvai dharmacāriṇaḥ
translation: मम my, भ्राता brother, खरः Khara, महाबाहुः of mighty arms, दूषणश्च and Dusana, मे my, स्वसा sister, शूर्पणखा च Surpanakha too, महातेजाः brilliant, पिशिताशनः flesh eater, राक्षसः demon, त्रिशिराश्च and Trisira, शूराः brave, लब्धलक्षाः unfailing in their targets, अन्ये बहवः many other, निशाचराः राक्षसाः nightwalker demons, मन्नियोगेन at my behest, महारण्ये in the great forest, धर्मचारिणः followers of righteous path, मुनीन् seers, बाधमानाः harassing, जनस्थाने at Janasthana, यथा likewise, नित्यवासं वसन्ति always living there, त्वम् you, जानीषे know.
explanation: You know that my brothers, Khara and Dusana, the strongarmed heroes, my sister Surpanakha and  the mighty cannibal Trisira, and many other heroic demons successful in hitting their targets are bonafide residents. They have been harassing the followers of righteous path (the sages) at my behest.

shloka_text: जानीषे त्वं जनस्थाने यथा भ्राता खरो मम। दूषणश्च महाबाहु स्वसा शूर्पणखा च मे।।3.36.2।। त्रिशिराश्च महातेजा राक्षसः पिशिताशनः। अन्ये च बहवश्शूरा लब्धलक्षा निशाचराः।।3.36.3।। वसत्नि मन्नियोगेन नित्यवासं च राक्षसाः। बाधमाना महारण्ये मुनीन्वै धर्मचारिणः।।3.36.4।।
transliteration: jānīṣe tvaṃ janasthāne yathā bhrātā kharo mama| dūṣaṇaśca mahābāhu svasā śūrpaṇakhā ca me triśirāśca mahātejā rākṣasaḥ piśitāśanaḥ| anye ca bahavaśśūrā labdhalakṣā niśācarāḥ vasatni manniyogena nityavāsaṃ ca rākṣasāḥ| bādhamānā mahāraṇye munīnvai dharmacāriṇaḥ
translation: मम my, भ्राता brother, खरः Khara, महाबाहुः of mighty arms, दूषणश्च and Dusana, मे my, स्वसा sister, शूर्पणखा च Surpanakha too, महातेजाः brilliant, पिशिताशनः flesh eater, राक्षसः demon, त्रिशिराश्च and Trisira, शूराः brave, लब्धलक्षाः unfailing in their targets, अन्ये बहवः many other, निशाचराः राक्षसाः nightwalker demons, मन्नियोगेन at my behest, महारण्ये in the great forest, धर्मचारिणः followers of righteous path, मुनीन् seers, बाधमानाः harassing, जनस्थाने at Janasthana, यथा likewise, नित्यवासं वसन्ति always living there, त्वम् you, जानीषे know.
explanation: You know that my brothers, Khara and Dusana, the strongarmed heroes, my sister Surpanakha and  the mighty cannibal Trisira, and many other heroic demons successful in hitting their targets are bonafide residents. They have been harassing the followers of righteous path (the sages) at my behest.

shloka_text: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसां भीमकर्मणाम्। शूराणां लब्धलक्षाणां खरचित्तानुवर्तिनाम्।।3.36.5।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāṃ bhīmakarmaṇām| śūrāṇāṃ labdhalakṣāṇāṃ kharacittānuvartinām
translation: भीमकर्मणाम् of terrible deeds, शूराणाम् of heroes, लब्धलक्षाणाम् skilled in hitting the targets, खरचित्तानुवर्तिनाम्  acting according to the will of Khara, रक्षसाम् of demons, चतुर्दश सहस्राणि fourteen thousand.
explanation: These fourteen thousand heroes, perpetrators of terrible deeds, skilled in hitting the targets had been acting according to the direction of Khara.

shloka_text: ते त्विदानीं जनस्थाने वसमाना महाबलाः। सङ्गताः परमायत्ता रामेण सह संयुगे।।3.36.6।। नानाप्रहरणोपेताः खरप्रमुखराक्षसाः।
transliteration: te tvidānīṃ janasthāne vasamānā mahābalāḥ| saṅgatāḥ paramāyattā rāmeṇa saha saṃyuge nānāpraharaṇopetāḥ kharapramukharākṣasāḥ|
translation: जनस्थाने at Janasthana, वसमानाः living permanently, महाबलाः very strong, ते they, खरप्रमुखराक्षसाः demons led by Khara, इदानीम् now, परमायत्ताः with all support, नानाप्रहरणोपेताः wielding different kinds of weapons, संयुगे in war, रामेण सह with Rama, सङ्गताः have fought.
explanation: These mighty demons, living in Janasthana, eqipped with different kinds of weapons, supported and led by Khara, met Rama in an encounter.

shloka_text: तेन सञ्जातरोषेण रामेण रणमूर्धनि। अनुक्त्वा परुषं किञ्चिच्छरैर्व्यापारितं धनुः।।3.36.7।।
transliteration: tena sañjātaroṣeṇa rāmeṇa raṇamūrdhani| anuktvā paruṣaṃ kiñciccharairvyāpāritaṃ dhanuḥ
translation: सञ्जातरोषेण  even though wrathful, तेन रामेण by that  Rama, रणमूर्धनि on the battle front, परुषम् harsh , किञ्चित् a little, अनुक्त्वा not uttered, धनुः bow, शरैः arrows, व्यापारितम् shot.
explanation: With his wrath generated, Rama, without even speaking anything, used his bow and the arrows.

shloka_text: चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसामुग्रतेजसाम्। निहतानि शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मानुषेण पदातिना।।3.36.8।।
transliteration: caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasāmugratejasām| nihatāni śaraistīkṣṇairmānuṣeṇa padātinā
translation: पदातिना  fighting on foot, मानुषेण by a human being, उग्रतेजसाम् of ferocious, रक्षसाम् of demons, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousand, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, शरैः arrows, निहतानि are killed.
explanation: Being a human being who fought on foot, he killed fourteen thousand ferocious demons with his sharp arrows.

shloka_text: खरश्च निहतस्सङ्ख्ये दूषणश्च निपातितः। हतश्च त्रिशिराश्चापि निर्भया दण्डकाः कृताः।।3.36.9।।
transliteration: kharaśca nihatassaṅkhye dūṣaṇaśca nipātitaḥ| hataśca triśirāścāpi nirbhayā daṇḍakāḥ kṛtāḥ
translation: सङ्ख्ये in the war, खरश्च Khara also, निहतः killed, दूषणश्च Dusana also, निपातितः is ruined, त्रिशिराश्चापि even Trisira, हतः got destroyed, दण्डकाः forest of Dandaka, निर्भयाः safe and fearless, कृताः are rendered.
explanation: Khara, Dusana and Trisira were killed in war.The residents of Dandaka forest are rendered safe and fearless.

shloka_text: पित्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन सभार्यः क्षीणजीवितः। स हन्ता तस्य सैन्यस्य रामः क्षत्रियपांसनः।।3.36.10।।
transliteration: pitrā nirastaḥ kruddhena sabhāryaḥ kṣīṇajīvitaḥ| sa hantā tasya sainyasya rāmaḥ kṣatriyapāṃsanaḥ
translation: क्रुद्धेन by an angry one, पित्रा by father, सभार्यः with his wife, निरस्तः sent away, क्षीणजीवितः of a short life span, क्षत्रियपांसनः a calumny to kshatriyas, सः रामः that Rama, तस्य सैन्यस्य of the  army of demons, हन्ता killer.
explanation: Rama, a victim of his father's anger, banished into the forest with his wife, a shortlived mortal and a calumny on the kshatriyas has killed the army of demons.

shloka_text: दुश्शीलः कर्कशस्तीक्ष्णो मूर्खो लुब्धोऽजितेन्द्रियः।।3.36.11।। त्यक्तधर्मो ह्यधर्मात्मा भूतानामहिते रतः।
transliteration: duśśīlaḥ karkaśastīkṣṇo mūrkho lubdho'jitendriyaḥ tyaktadharmo hyadharmātmā bhūtānāmahite rataḥ|
translation: दुश्शीलः of bad conduct, कर्कशः harsh, तीक्ष्णः sharp one, मूर्खः stupid, लुब्धः avaricious, अजितेन्द्रियः slave to senses, त्यक्तधर्मः immoral, अधर्मात्मा unrighteous, भूतानाम् for others, अहिते in harming, रतः engaged,
explanation: He is a man of bad conduct, harsh, sharptonged, stupid, miserly and a slave to his senses. He is immoral and unrighteous, one who is busy harming others.

shloka_text: येन वैरं विनाऽरण्ये सत्वमाश्रित्य केवलम्।।3.36.12।। कर्णनासापहरणाद्भगिनी मे विरूपिता। तस्यभार्यां जनस्थानात्सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम्।3.36.13।। आनयिष्यामि विक्रम्य सहायस्तत्र मे भव।
transliteration: yena vairaṃ vinā'raṇye satvamāśritya kevalam karṇanāsāpaharaṇādbhaginī me virūpitā| tasyabhāryāṃ janasthānātsītāṃ surasutopamām|3.36.13|| ānayiṣyāmi vikramya sahāyastatra me bhava|
translation: येन by whom, वैरं विना without enmity, केवलम् only, सत्वम् strength, आश्रित्य depending, कर्णनासापहरणात् cut off nose and ears, मे भगिनी my sister, विरूपिता disfigured, तस्य his, भार्याम् wife, सुरसुतोपमाम् like the daughter of god, सीताम् Sita, विक्रम्य with my valour, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, आनयिष्यामि will bring, तत्र in that, मे to me, सहायः accomplice, भव you be,
explanation: With no enmity whatsoever, merely because he has strength, he cut off the nose and ears of my sister and mutilated her. His wife Sita  is like the daughter of heaven. I would like to abduct her with force from Janasthana for which you should be my accomplice.

shloka_text: येन वैरं विनाऽरण्ये सत्वमाश्रित्य केवलम्।।3.36.12।। कर्णनासापहरणाद्भगिनी मे विरूपिता। तस्यभार्यां जनस्थानात्सीतां सुरसुतोपमाम्।3.36.13।। आनयिष्यामि विक्रम्य सहायस्तत्र मे भव।
transliteration: yena vairaṃ vinā'raṇye satvamāśritya kevalam karṇanāsāpaharaṇādbhaginī me virūpitā| tasyabhāryāṃ janasthānātsītāṃ surasutopamām|3.36.13|| ānayiṣyāmi vikramya sahāyastatra me bhava|
translation: येन by whom, वैरं विना without enmity, केवलम् only, सत्वम् strength, आश्रित्य depending, कर्णनासापहरणात् cut off nose and ears, मे भगिनी my sister, विरूपिता disfigured, तस्य his, भार्याम् wife, सुरसुतोपमाम् like the daughter of god, सीताम् Sita, विक्रम्य with my valour, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, आनयिष्यामि will bring, तत्र in that, मे to me, सहायः accomplice, भव you be,
explanation: With no enmity whatsoever, merely because he has strength, he cut off the nose and ears of my sister and mutilated her. His wife Sita  is like the daughter of heaven. I would like to abduct her with force from Janasthana for which you should be my accomplice.

shloka_text: त्वया ह्यहं सहायेन पार्श्वस्थेन महाबल।।3.36.14।। भ्रातृभिश्च सुरान्युद्धे समग्रान्नाभिचिन्तये। तत्सहायो भव त्वं मे समर्थो ह्यसि राक्षस।।3.36.15।।
transliteration: tvayā hyahaṃ sahāyena pārśvasthena mahābala bhrātṛbhiśca surānyuddhe samagrānnābhicintaye| tatsahāyo bhava tvaṃ me samartho hyasi rākṣasa
translation: महाबल of great  strength, सहायेन come for help, पार्श्वस्थेन at my side, त्वया by you, भ्रातृभिश्च by brothers also, युद्धे in war, समग्रान् together, सुरान् gods, नाभिचिन्तये I do not care, राक्षस demon, तत् therefore, त्वम् you, मे to me, सहायः accomplice, भव be, समर्थः capable, असि हि you are,
explanation: You are mighty. I do not care to fight even the gods when you and my brothers are by my side. Therefore, O demon, be my accomplice. (I know) you are capable of that.

shloka_text: त्वया ह्यहं सहायेन पार्श्वस्थेन महाबल।।3.36.14।। भ्रातृभिश्च सुरान्युद्धे समग्रान्नाभिचिन्तये। तत्सहायो भव त्वं मे समर्थो ह्यसि राक्षस।।3.36.15।।
transliteration: tvayā hyahaṃ sahāyena pārśvasthena mahābala bhrātṛbhiśca surānyuddhe samagrānnābhicintaye| tatsahāyo bhava tvaṃ me samartho hyasi rākṣasa
translation: महाबल of great  strength, सहायेन come for help, पार्श्वस्थेन at my side, त्वया by you, भ्रातृभिश्च by brothers also, युद्धे in war, समग्रान् together, सुरान् gods, नाभिचिन्तये I do not care, राक्षस demon, तत् therefore, त्वम् you, मे to me, सहायः accomplice, भव be, समर्थः capable, असि हि you are,
explanation: You are mighty. I do not care to fight even the gods when you and my brothers are by my side. Therefore, O demon, be my accomplice. (I know) you are capable of that.

shloka_text: वीर्ये युद्धे च दर्पे च न ह्यस्ति सदृशस्तव। उपायज्ञो महान्शूरस्सर्वमायाविशारदः।।3.36.16।।
transliteration: vīrye yuddhe ca darpe ca na hyasti sadṛśastava| upāyajño mahānśūrassarvamāyāviśāradaḥ
translation: वीर्ये in valour, युद्धे च in war, दर्पे च in conceit, तव your, सदृशः equal, नास्ति हि none, उपायज्ञः you know all methods, महान् great, शूरः brave, सर्वमायाविशारदः an expert in all deceitful arts.
explanation: In valour,  in war and in conceit there is no one equal to you. You know all means (of success). You are great. You are brave. You are an expert in all deceitful arts.

shloka_text: एतदर्थमहं प्राप्तस्त्वत्समीपं निशाचर। शृणु तत्कर्म साहाय्ये यत्कार्यं वचनान्मम।।3.36.17।।
transliteration: etadarthamahaṃ prāptastvatsamīpaṃ niśācara| śṛṇu tatkarma sāhāyye yatkāryaṃ vacanānmama
translation: निशाचर demon, एतदर्थम् for this purpose, अहं I, त्वत्समीपम् to you, प्राप्तः I came, मम my, वचनात् words, साहाय्ये become a helper, यत् whatever, कार्यम् work, तत् this, कर्म task, शृणु  listen.
explanation: I have come to you for this purpose seeking your help. Listen to  my words on what you should do:

shloka_text: सौवर्णस्त्वं मृगो भूत्वा चित्रो रजतबिन्दुभिः। आश्रमे तस्य रामस्य सीतायाः प्रमुखे चर।।3.36.18।।
transliteration: sauvarṇastvaṃ mṛgo bhūtvā citro rajatabindubhiḥ| āśrame tasya rāmasya sītāyāḥ pramukhe cara
translation: त्वम् you, रजतबिन्दुभिः dappled with silver dots, चित्रः wonderful, सौवर्णः golden, मृगः deer, भूत्वा  become, तस्य रामस्य that Rama's, आश्रमे in hermitage, सीतायाः of Sita, प्रमुखे in front, चर move.
explanation: Be a wonderful golden deer dappled with silver dots and roam in front of Sita in Rama's hermitage.

shloka_text: त्वां तु निस्संशयं सीता दृष्ट्वा तु मृगरूपिणम्। गृह्यतामिति भर्तारं लक्ष्मणं चाभिधास्यति।।3.36.19।।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu nissaṃśayaṃ sītā dṛṣṭvā tu mṛgarūpiṇam| gṛhyatāmiti bhartāraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ cābhidhāsyati
translation: सीता Sita, मृगरूपिणम् in the form of a deer, त्वाम् to you, दृष्ट्वा seeing, गृह्यताम् catch it, इति thus, भर्तारम् her husband, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, निस्संशयम् without any doubt, अभिधास्यति will tell.
explanation: Seeing you in the form of a deer, Sita will undoubtedly ask her husband and Lakshmana to capture you.

shloka_text: ततस्तयोरपाये तु शून्ये सीतां यथासुखम्। निराबाधो हरिष्यामि राहुश्चन्द्रप्रभामिव।।3.36.20।।
transliteration: tatastayorapāye tu śūnye sītāṃ yathāsukham| nirābādho hariṣyāmi rāhuścandraprabhāmiva
translation: ततः then, तयोः both (Rama and Lakshmana), अपाये तु in their absence, शून्ये in an isolated place, यथासुखम् with ease, निराबाधः without any impediment, सीताम् Sita, राहुः Rahu, चन्द्रप्रभामिव like the lustre of the Moon, हरिष्यामि I will abduct.
explanation: Then during their absence it will be easy for me to abduct Sita in an isolated place without obstruction, like Rahu eclipsing the light of the moon.

shloka_text: ततः पश्चात्सुखं रामे भार्याहरणकर्शिते। विस्रब्धः प्रहरिष्यामि कृतार्थेनान्तरात्मना।।3.36.21।।
transliteration: tataḥ paścātsukhaṃ rāme bhāryāharaṇakarśite| visrabdhaḥ prahariṣyāmi kṛtārthenāntarātmanā
translation: ततः पश्चात् thereafter, भार्याहरणकर्शिते afflicted due to his wife's abduction, रामे  Rama, कृतार्थेन successfully, अन्तरात्मना inwardly, सुखम् happily, विस्रब्धः freely, प्रहरिष्यामि I can strike him.
explanation: Thereafter, when Rama with his soul afflicted due to his wife's abduction. I can freely, happily, successfully strike him down.

shloka_text: तस्य रामकथां श्रुत्वा मारीचस्य महात्मनः। शुष्कं समभवद्वक्त्रं परितप्ता बभूव ह।।3.36.22।।
transliteration: tasya rāmakathāṃ śrutvā mārīcasya mahātmanaḥ| śuṣkaṃ samabhavadvaktraṃ paritaptā babhūva ha
translation: रामकथाम् mention of Rama's name, श्रुत्वा after hearing, महात्मनः of the great soul, तस्य मारीचस्य that Maricha's, वक्त्रम् mouth, शुष्कम् got dried, समभवत् became, परितप्त:was worried, बभूव हि became.
explanation: At the mention of Rama's name, great Maricha's mouth dried up and he became concerned.

shloka_text: ओष्ठौ परिलिहञ्चुष्कौ नेत्रैरनिमिषैरिव। मृतभूत इवार्तस्तु रावणं समुदैक्षत।।3.36.23।।
transliteration: oṣṭhau parilihañcuṣkau netrairanimiṣairiva| mṛtabhūta ivārtastu rāvaṇaṃ samudaikṣata
translation: शुष्कौ both dried, ओष्ठौ lips, परिलिहन् while licking, अनिमिषैरिव as though without winking, नेत्रैः eyes, मृतभूत इव like a dead person, आर्तस्तु distressed one, रावणम् Ravana, समुदैक्षत looked at Ravana.
explanation: Licking his dried up lips, as though his eyes stopped winking like those of the dead, Maricha stared at Ravana, distressed.

shloka_text: स रावणं त्रस्तविषण्णचेता महावने रामपराक्रमज्ञः। कृताञ्जलिस्तत्वमुवाच वाक्यं हितं च तस्मै हितमात्मनश्च।।3.36.24।।
transliteration: sa rāvaṇaṃ trastaviṣaṇṇacetā mahāvane rāmaparākramajñaḥ| kṛtāñjalistatvamuvāca vākyaṃ hitaṃ ca tasmai hitamātmanaśca
translation: महावने in the great forest, रामपराक्रमज्ञः one who knows Rama's valour, सः Maricha, त्रस्तविषण्णचेताः mind depressed and frightened, कृताञ्जलिः with folded palms, तस्मै to Ravana, हितम् for his wellbeing, आत्मनश्च of himself too, हितम् salutary, तत्वम् truth, वाक्यम् words, रावणम् to Ravana, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Maricha who knows of Rama's valour was frightened and depressed at heart. He revealed to Ravana with folded hands some facts for mutual benefit. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षट् त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तच्छृत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः। प्रत्युवाच महाप्राज्ञो मारीचो राक्षसेश्वरम्।।3.37.1।।
transliteration: tacchṛtvā rākṣasendrasya vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ| pratyuvāca mahāprājño mārīco rākṣaseśvaram
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रस्य  lord of the demons (Ravana), तत् वाक्यम् the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, वाक्यविशारदः eloquent speaker, मारीचः Maricha, राक्षसेश्वरम् to Ravana, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: Having heard the words of Ravana, lord of the demons, wise Maricha who was also an eloquent speaker replied:
comments: Maricha describes the qualities of Rama and Sita to Ravana --advises Ravana to give up the idea of abduction of Sita.

shloka_text: सुलभाः पुरुषा राजन्सततं प्रियवादिनः। अप्रियस्य तु पथ्यस्य वक्ता श्रोता च दुर्लभः।।3.37.2।।
transliteration: sulabhāḥ puruṣā rājansatataṃ priyavādinaḥ| apriyasya tu pathyasya vaktā śrotā ca durlabhaḥ
translation: राजन् O king, प्रियवादिनः sweettongued, पुरुषाः men, सततम् always, सुलभाः easy to find, अप्रियस्य unpleasant to hear, तु but, पथ्यस्य salutary, वक्ता speaker, श्रोता च audience, दुर्लभः is difficult to find.
explanation: O king, it is always easy to find men who speak pleasing words, but it is difficult to get a speaker and a listener who use words unpleasant (to the ears) but beneficial (in life).

shloka_text: न नूनं बुध्यसे रामं महावीर्यं गुणोन्नतम्। अयुक्तचारश्चपलो महेन्द्रवरुणोपमम्।।3.37.3।।
transliteration: na nūnaṃ budhyase rāmaṃ mahāvīryaṃ guṇonnatam| ayuktacāraścapalo mahendravaruṇopamam
translation: अयुक्तचारः a man who does not employ a spy, चपलः  fickleminded, महावीर्यम्  very brave, गुणोन्नतम्  of good qualities, महेन्द्र वरुणोपमम् comparable to Indra and Varuna, रामम् Rama, नूनम् surely, न बुध्यसे not able to know.
explanation: You  are fickleminded.  You have employed no spy ( who could have told you the truth about Rama's character). Rama is very brave and virtuous comparable to Indra and Varuna. Surely you are not able to know what Rama is.

shloka_text: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्तात सर्वेषां भुवि रक्षसाम्। अपि रामो नासङ्क्रुद्धः कुर्याल्लोकमराक्षसम्।।3.37.4।।
transliteration: api svasti bhavettāta sarveṣāṃ bhuvi rakṣasām| api rāmo nāsaṅkruddhaḥ kuryāllokamarākṣasam
translation: तात O dear, भुवि in the world, सर्वेषाम् of all, रक्षसाम् of demons, स्वस्ति safe, अपिभवेत् may be I wish, रामः Rama, न सङ्क्रुद्धः gets angry, लोकम् world, अराक्षसम् without rakshasa, अपि न कुर्यात् will he not do?.
explanation: O dear may there be good to all the demons in the world. If Rama gets enraged, he will make this world demonless.

shloka_text: अपि ते जीवितान्ताय नोत्पन्ना जनकात्मजा। अपि सीतानिमित्तं च न भवेद्व्यसनं मम।।3.37.5।।
transliteration: api te jīvitāntāya notpannā janakātmajā| api sītānimittaṃ ca na bhavedvyasanaṃ mama
translation: जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, ते to you, जीवितान्ताय to destroy your life, अपि नोत्पन्ना not born I hope, सीतानिमित्तम् on account of Sita, मम myself, व्यसनम् disaster, अपि न भवेत् hope it will not happen.
explanation: Hope the daughter of Janaka is not born to put an end to your life. Hope I will not face any disaster on account of Sita.

shloka_text: अपि त्वामीश्वरं प्राप्य कामवृत्तं निरङ्कुशम्। न विनश्येत्पुरी लङ्का त्वया सह सराक्षसा।।3.37.6।।
transliteration: api tvāmīśvaraṃ prāpya kāmavṛttaṃ niraṅkuśam| na vinaśyetpurī laṅkā tvayā saha sarākṣasā
translation: कामवृत्तम् a slave to sensual pleasures, निरङ्कुशम् a dictator, त्वाम् you, ईश्वरम् lord, प्राप्य  after getting, सराक्षसा along with demons, पुरी लङ्का city of Lanka, त्वया सह along with you, न विनश्येदपि may it not be destroyed,
explanation: I hope the city of Lanka along with the (entire) race of demons will not be destroyed, with a dictator like you who is a slave to sensual pleasure.

shloka_text: त्वद्विधः कामवृत्तो हि दुश्शीलः पापमन्त्रितः। आत्मानं स्वजनं राष्ट्रं स राजा हन्ति दुर्मतिः।।3.37.7।।
transliteration: tvadvidhaḥ kāmavṛtto hi duśśīlaḥ pāpamantritaḥ| ātmānaṃ svajanaṃ rāṣṭraṃ sa rājā hanti durmatiḥ
translation: कामवृत्तः passionate, दुश्शीलः a person of bad character, पापमन्त्रितः advised in evil ways, दुर्मतिः of wicked mind, त्वद्विधः one like you, सः राजा that king, आत्मानम् himself, स्वजनम् his own people, राष्ट्रम् country, हन्ति हि will ruin.
explanation: A king  who is a slave to passion, who is of bad conduct, of wicked thoughts, advised in evil ways destroys himself, his kith and kin and the entire kingdom.

shloka_text: न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो नामर्यादः कथञ्चन। न लुब्धो न च दुश्शीलो न च क्षत्रियपांसनः।।3.37.8।। न च धर्मगुणैर्हीनः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः। न तीक्ष्णो न च भूतानां सर्वेषामहिते रतः।।3.37.9।।
transliteration: na ca pitrā parityakto nāmaryādaḥ kathañcana| na lubdho na ca duśśīlo na ca kṣatriyapāṃsanaḥ na ca dharmaguṇairhīnaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ| na tīkṣṇo na ca bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāmahite rataḥ
translation: कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः delight of Kausalya (Rama), पित्रा by father, न च परित्यक्तः not at all forsaken, कथञ्चन to do so, अमर्यादः nor crossed the limits of dharma, न not, लुब्धः miserly, न not, दुश्शीलः of bad conduct, न च and not, तीक्ष्ण sharptongued, क्षत्रियपांसनः च calumny to kshatriyas, न not, धर्मगुणैः in righteousness, हीनः not lacking, न not, तीक्ष्णः cruel, न not, सर्वेषाम् for all, भूतानाम् of beings, अहिते in doing harm, रतः is involved,
explanation: Rama, the delight of Kausalya, has not forsaken by his father. He has never crossed the limits of dharma. He is not miserly. He has no  bad conduct. He is not a slur on the kshatriyas. He does not lack in righteousness. He is not cruel nor is he engaged in doing harm to others.

shloka_text: न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो नामर्यादः कथञ्चन। न लुब्धो न च दुश्शीलो न च क्षत्रियपांसनः।।3.37.8।। न च धर्मगुणैर्हीनः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः। न तीक्ष्णो न च भूतानां सर्वेषामहिते रतः।।3.37.9।।
transliteration: na ca pitrā parityakto nāmaryādaḥ kathañcana| na lubdho na ca duśśīlo na ca kṣatriyapāṃsanaḥ na ca dharmaguṇairhīnaḥ kausalyānandavardhanaḥ| na tīkṣṇo na ca bhūtānāṃ sarveṣāmahite rataḥ
translation: कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः delight of Kausalya (Rama), पित्रा by father, न च परित्यक्तः not at all forsaken, कथञ्चन to do so, अमर्यादः nor crossed the limits of dharma, न not, लुब्धः miserly, न not, दुश्शीलः of bad conduct, न च and not, तीक्ष्ण sharptongued, क्षत्रियपांसनः च calumny to kshatriyas, न not, धर्मगुणैः in righteousness, हीनः not lacking, न not, तीक्ष्णः cruel, न not, सर्वेषाम् for all, भूतानाम् of beings, अहिते in doing harm, रतः is involved,
explanation: Rama, the delight of Kausalya, has not forsaken by his father. He has never crossed the limits of dharma. He is not miserly. He has no  bad conduct. He is not a slur on the kshatriyas. He does not lack in righteousness. He is not cruel nor is he engaged in doing harm to others.

shloka_text: वञ्चितं पितरं दृष्ट्वा कैकेय्या सत्यवादिनम्। करिष्यामीति धर्मात्मा तात प्रव्रजितो वनम्।।3.37.10।।
transliteration: vañcitaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā kaikeyyā satyavādinam| kariṣyāmīti dharmātmā tāta pravrajito vanam
translation: तात dear, सत्यवादिनम् always speaks the truth, पितरम् father, कैकेय्या by Kaikeyi, वञ्चितम् deceived, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, धर्मात्मा righteous man, करिष्यामि इति saying I will do it, वनम् forest, प्रव्रजितः came.
explanation: O dear, seeing that his truthful father was going to be deceived by Kaikeyi, righteous Rama himself offered to fulfil the promise of his father and came away to the forest.

shloka_text: कैकेय्याः प्रियकामार्थं पितुर्दशरथस्य च। हित्वा राज्यं च भोगांश्च प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्।।3.37.11।।
transliteration: kaikeyyāḥ priyakāmārthaṃ piturdaśarathasya ca| hitvā rājyaṃ ca bhogāṃśca praviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam
translation: कैकेय्याः of Kaikeyi, पितुः father's दशरथस्य च and Dasaratha's, प्रियकामार्थम् to satisfy their desire, राज्यम् kingdom, भोगांश्च pleasures, हित्वा after leaving, दण्डकावनम् Dandaka forest प्रविष्टः he entered.
explanation: To satisfy the desire of Kaikeyi and to fulfil his father's word he came to Dandaka forest,  leaving the kingdom and all royal pleasures, behind.

shloka_text: न रामः कर्कशस्तात नाविद्वान्नाजितेन्द्रियः। अनृतं दुश्श्रुतं चैव नैव त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि।।3.37.12।।
transliteration: na rāmaḥ karkaśastāta nāvidvānnājitendriyaḥ| anṛtaṃ duśśrutaṃ caiva naiva tvaṃ vaktumarhasi
translation: तात O dear, रामः Rama, कर्कशः hardhearted, न not, अविद्वान् not learned, न not, अजितेन्द्रियः not that he has no control over the senses, न not, त्वम् you, अनृतम् false, दुश्श्रुतं चैव illinformed, वक्तुम् to speak, नार्हसि not proper.
explanation: O my dear, Rama is not harsh nor ignorant. It is not that he has no control over the senses. It is not proper  for you to say what is false. You are illinformed.

shloka_text: रामो विग्रहवान् धर्मस्साधुस्सत्यपराक्रमः। राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य देवानां मघवानिव।।3.37.13।।
transliteration: rāmo vigrahavān dharmassādhussatyaparākramaḥ| rājā sarvasya lokasya devānāṃ maghavāniva
translation: रामः Rama, विग्रहवान् a personification of, धर्मः  dharma, साधुः pious , सत्यपराक्रमः one whose strength is truth, देवानाम् for gods, मघवानिव like Indra, सर्वस्य for all, लोकस्य worlds, राजा king.
explanation: Rama is dharma incarnate. He is pious. His strength is truth. He is king of all the worlds like Indra to the gods.

shloka_text: कथं त्वं तस्य वैदेहीं रक्षितां स्वेन तेजसा। इच्छसि प्रसभं हर्तुं प्रभामिव विवस्वतः।।3.37.14।।
transliteration: kathaṃ tvaṃ tasya vaidehīṃ rakṣitāṃ svena tejasā| icchasi prasabhaṃ hartuṃ prabhāmiva vivasvataḥ
translation: त्वम् you, तस्य his, स्वेन own, तेजसा strength of character, रक्षिताम् will be protected, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, विवस्वतः Sun's, प्रभामिव like the radiance, प्रसभम् forcibly, हर्तुम् to take, कथम् how, इच्छसि you wish.
explanation: Sita is protected by the strength of her character. How do you desire to carry her away forcibly (from Rama) ? Can any one separate the radiance of the Sun from the Sun itself ?

shloka_text: शरार्चिषमाधृष्यं चापखङ्गेन्धनं रणे। रामाग्निं सहसा दीप्तं न प्रवेष्टुं त्वमर्हसि।।3.37.15।।
transliteration: śarārciṣamādhṛṣyaṃ cāpakhaṅgendhanaṃ raṇe| rāmāgniṃ sahasā dīptaṃ na praveṣṭuṃ tvamarhasi
translation: शरार्चिषम् arrows are flames, अनाधृष्यम् cannot be overpowered, चापखड्गेन्धनम् bow and  sword as fuel, रणे in war, दीप्तम् blazing, रामाग्निम् fire of Rama, सहसा at once, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, त्वम् you, न अर्हसि should not.
explanation: You should not enter into the unquenchable fire that is  Rama,  the fire that has the  arrows (of Rama) as its flames and his sword and bow as fuel.

shloka_text: धनुर्व्यादितदीप्तास्यं शरार्चिषममर्षणम्। चापबाणधरं तीक्ष्णं शत्रुसैन्यप्रहारिणम्।।3.37.16।। राज्यं सुखं च सन्त्यज्य जीवितं चेष्टमात्मनः। नात्यासादयितुं तात रामान्तकमिहार्हसि।।3.37.17।।
transliteration: dhanurvyāditadīptāsyaṃ śarārciṣamamarṣaṇam| cāpabāṇadharaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ śatrusainyaprahāriṇam rājyaṃ sukhaṃ ca santyajya jīvitaṃ ceṣṭamātmanaḥ| nātyāsādayituṃ tāta rāmāntakamihārhasi
translation: तात O dear, धनुर्व्यादितदीप्तास्यम् his bow is an open burning mouth, शरार्चिषम् flaming arrows as fire, अमर्षणम् anger, चापबाणधरम् wielder of bow and arrows, तीक्ष्णम्  sharp, शत्रुसैन्यप्रहारिणम् one who can strike the enemy's army, रामान्तकम् Rama like Yama himself, आत्मनः your own, इष्टम् dear, राज्यम् kingdom, सुखं च and happiness, जीवितं च life, सन्त्यज्य after abandoning, इह here, आत्यासादयितुम् to enter, न not, अर्हसि should.
explanation: You should not give up happiness,your dear life and kingdom and come to Rama who is a variable god of death. His bow is  like on open burning mouth, and his flaming arrows are like fire. He is all anger. He is wielder of bow and arrows. He can strike the enemy army (alone).

shloka_text: धनुर्व्यादितदीप्तास्यं शरार्चिषममर्षणम्। चापबाणधरं तीक्ष्णं शत्रुसैन्यप्रहारिणम्।।3.37.16।। राज्यं सुखं च सन्त्यज्य जीवितं चेष्टमात्मनः। नात्यासादयितुं तात रामान्तकमिहार्हसि।।3.37.17।।
transliteration: dhanurvyāditadīptāsyaṃ śarārciṣamamarṣaṇam| cāpabāṇadharaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ śatrusainyaprahāriṇam rājyaṃ sukhaṃ ca santyajya jīvitaṃ ceṣṭamātmanaḥ| nātyāsādayituṃ tāta rāmāntakamihārhasi
translation: तात O dear, धनुर्व्यादितदीप्तास्यम् his bow is an open burning mouth, शरार्चिषम् flaming arrows as fire, अमर्षणम् anger, चापबाणधरम् wielder of bow and arrows, तीक्ष्णम्  sharp, शत्रुसैन्यप्रहारिणम् one who can strike the enemy's army, रामान्तकम् Rama like Yama himself, आत्मनः your own, इष्टम् dear, राज्यम् kingdom, सुखं च and happiness, जीवितं च life, सन्त्यज्य after abandoning, इह here, आत्यासादयितुम् to enter, न not, अर्हसि should.
explanation: You should not give up happiness,your dear life and kingdom and come to Rama who is a variable god of death. His bow is  like on open burning mouth, and his flaming arrows are like fire. He is all anger. He is wielder of bow and arrows. He can strike the enemy army (alone).

shloka_text: अप्रमेयं हि तत्तेजो यस्य सा जनकात्मजा। न त्वं समर्थस्तां हर्तुं रामचापाश्रयं वने।।3.37.18।।
transliteration: aprameyaṃ hi tattejo yasya sā janakātmajā| na tvaṃ samarthastāṃ hartuṃ rāmacāpāśrayaṃ vane
translation: सा she, जनकात्मजा Sita, daughter of Janaka, यस्य whose, तत् that, अप्रमेयम् immeasurable, तेजः हि is the power, वने in the forest, रामचापाश्रयम् under the refuge of Rama's bow, ताम् herself, हर्तुम् to abduct, त्वम् you, समर्थः competent, न not.
explanation: Immeasurable indeed is the power of Rama to whom Sita, daughter of Janaka belongs. You are not competent to kidnap her, for she is under the refuge of Rama's bow in the forest.

shloka_text: तस्य सा नरसिंहस्य सिंहोरस्कस्य भामिनी। प्राणेभ्योऽपि प्रियतरा भार्या नित्यमनुव्रता।।3.37.19।।
transliteration: tasya sā narasiṃhasya siṃhoraskasya bhāminī| prāṇebhyo'pi priyatarā bhāryā nityamanuvratā
translation: सा भामिनी effulgent lady, सिंहोरस्कस्य of a lion's chest, तस्य his, नरसिंहस्य of a lion in the form of man, प्राणेभ्योपि more than his life, प्रियतरा dearer, भार्या wife, नित्यम् always, अनुव्रता loyal to him.
explanation: Beautiful Sita happens to be the wife of Rama who is like a lion among men. Rama has a broad chest like that of a lion. He loves Sita who is ever loyal to him, more than his life.

shloka_text: न सा धर्षयितुं शक्या मैथिल्योजस्विनः प्रिया। दीप्तस्येव हुताशस्य शिखा सीता सुमध्यमा।।3.37.20।।
transliteration: na sā dharṣayituṃ śakyā maithilyojasvinaḥ priyā| dīptasyeva hutāśasya śikhā sītā sumadhyamā
translation: मैथिली Maithili, ओजस्विनः of the mighty, प्रिया darling, सुमध्यमा slender waist, सा सीता that Sita, दीप्तस्य of burning, हुताशस्य fire's, शिखा इव like a leaping flame, धर्षयितुम् to touch her, न शक्या not possible.
explanation: Sita is the darling of mighty Rama. With her slender waist, she is like the leaping flames of blazing fire and it is not possible  for you to touch her.

shloka_text: किमुद्यममिमं व्यर्थं कृत्वा ते राक्षसाधिप। दृष्टश्चेत्वं रणे तेन तदन्तं तव जीवितम्।।3.37.21।।
transliteration: kimudyamamimaṃ vyarthaṃ kṛtvā te rākṣasādhipa| dṛṣṭaścetvaṃ raṇe tena tadantaṃ tava jīvitam
translation: राक्षसाधिप chief of the demons, व्यर्थम् futile, इमम् this, उद्यमम् attempt, कृत्वा doing, ते you, किम् why, त्वम् you, रणे in war, तेन by him, दृष्टः seen, चेत् if, तव your, जीवितम् life, तदन्तम् that is the end.
explanation: O chief of the demons, why do you make this futile attempt ? The moment you are seen by Rama in war will be the last of your life.

shloka_text: जीवितं च सुखं चैव राज्यं चैव सुदुर्लभम्। यदीच्छसि चिरं भोक्तुं मा कृथा रामविप्रियम्।।3.37.22।।
transliteration: jīvitaṃ ca sukhaṃ caiva rājyaṃ caiva sudurlabham| yadīcchasi ciraṃ bhoktuṃ mā kṛthā rāmavipriyam
translation: जीवितं च life and, सुखं चैव also happiness, सुदुर्लभम् not easily attainable, राज्यं चैव even kingdom, चिरम् for long, भोक्तुम् to enjoy, इच्छसि यदि if you desire to, रामविप्रियम् displeasure to Rama, मा कृथाः do not incur.
explanation: If you want to enjoy your life, happiness and even the kingdom which is not easily attainable for long, do not incur the displeasure of Rama.

shloka_text: स सर्वैस्सचिवैस्सार्धं विभीषणपुरोगमैः। मन्त्रयित्वा तु धर्मिष्ठैः कृत्वा निश्चयमात्मनः।।3.37.23।। दोषाणां च गुणानां च सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्। आत्मनश्च बलं ज्ञात्वा राघवस्य च तत्वतः।।3.37.24।। हिताहितं विनिश्चित्य क्षमं त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि।
transliteration: sa sarvaissacivaissārdhaṃ vibhīṣaṇapurogamaiḥ| mantrayitvā tu dharmiṣṭhaiḥ kṛtvā niścayamātmanaḥ doṣāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca sampradhārya balābalam| ātmanaśca balaṃ jñātvā rāghavasya ca tatvataḥ hitāhitaṃ viniścitya kṣamaṃ tvaṃ kartumarhasi|
translation: सः त्वम्  you, धर्मिष्ठैः followers of righteous path, विभीषणपुरोगमैः by prominent people like Vibhisana, सर्वैः by all, सचिवैः सार्धम् with all ministers, मन्त्रयित्वा after discussing, आत्मनः yourself, निश्चयम् decision, कृत्वा  take, दोषाणां च of demerits, गुणानां च of merits, बलाबलम् strength and weakness, सम्प्रधार्य assessing, आत्मनश्च your own, राघवस्य च Rama's, बलम् strength, तत्वतः in fact, ज्ञात्वा  knowing, हिताहितम् welfare and otherwise, विनिश्चित्य after deciding, क्षमम् propriety, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि should.
explanation: After consulting all your ministers and the righteous persons led by Vibhisana, you may take a decision. Assess the real strength and weakness, merits and demerits  of your own and of Rama. Decide what is good or bad for you and then take steps you deem proper.

shloka_text: स सर्वैस्सचिवैस्सार्धं विभीषणपुरोगमैः। मन्त्रयित्वा तु धर्मिष्ठैः कृत्वा निश्चयमात्मनः।।3.37.23।। दोषाणां च गुणानां च सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्। आत्मनश्च बलं ज्ञात्वा राघवस्य च तत्वतः।।3.37.24।। हिताहितं विनिश्चित्य क्षमं त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि।
transliteration: sa sarvaissacivaissārdhaṃ vibhīṣaṇapurogamaiḥ| mantrayitvā tu dharmiṣṭhaiḥ kṛtvā niścayamātmanaḥ doṣāṇāṃ ca guṇānāṃ ca sampradhārya balābalam| ātmanaśca balaṃ jñātvā rāghavasya ca tatvataḥ hitāhitaṃ viniścitya kṣamaṃ tvaṃ kartumarhasi|
translation: सः त्वम्  you, धर्मिष्ठैः followers of righteous path, विभीषणपुरोगमैः by prominent people like Vibhisana, सर्वैः by all, सचिवैः सार्धम् with all ministers, मन्त्रयित्वा after discussing, आत्मनः yourself, निश्चयम् decision, कृत्वा  take, दोषाणां च of demerits, गुणानां च of merits, बलाबलम् strength and weakness, सम्प्रधार्य assessing, आत्मनश्च your own, राघवस्य च Rama's, बलम् strength, तत्वतः in fact, ज्ञात्वा  knowing, हिताहितम् welfare and otherwise, विनिश्चित्य after deciding, क्षमम् propriety, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि should.
explanation: After consulting all your ministers and the righteous persons led by Vibhisana, you may take a decision. Assess the real strength and weakness, merits and demerits  of your own and of Rama. Decide what is good or bad for you and then take steps you deem proper.

shloka_text: अहं तु मन्ये तव न क्षमं रणे समागमं कोसलराजसूनुना। इदं हि भूयश्श़ृणु वाक्यमुत्तमं क्षमं च युक्तं च निशाचरेश्वर।।3.37.25।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tu manye tava na kṣamaṃ raṇe samāgamaṃ kosalarājasūnunā| idaṃ hi bhūyaśśa़ṛṇu vākyamuttamaṃ kṣamaṃ ca yuktaṃ ca niśācareśvara
translation: निशाचरेश्वर Ravana, अहं तु on my part, तव your, रणे in war, कोसलराजसूनुना by Rama son of the king of Kosala, समागमम् meet, क्षमम् good, न मन्ये not consider, उत्तमम् best, क्षमम् capable, युक्तं च and proper, इदं वाक्यम् these words, भूयः further, शृणु you may listen.
explanation: O Ravana  I think it is not good on your part to confront the prince of Kosala in a war. Listen to my words and consider what is good for you. इत्यार्षे श्री मद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyseventh sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: कदाचिदप्यहं वीर्यात्पर्यटन्पृथिवीमिमाम्। बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयन्पर्वतोपमः।।3.38.1।। नीलजीमूतसङ्काशस्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः। भयं लोकस्य जनयन्किरीटी परिघायुधः।।3.38.2।। व्यचरं दण्डकारण्ये ऋषिमांसानि भक्षयन्।
transliteration: kadācidapyahaṃ vīryātparyaṭanpṛthivīmimām| balaṃ nāgasahasrasya dhārayanparvatopamaḥ nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśastaptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ| bhayaṃ lokasya janayankirīṭī parighāyudhaḥ vyacaraṃ daṇḍakāraṇye ṛṣimāṃsāni bhakṣayan|
translation: कदाचित् at one time, अहमपि I also, वीर्यात् out of prowess, इमाम् this, पृथिवीम् earth, पर्यटन् while wandering, नागसहस्रस्य thousands of elephants, बलम् strength, धारयन् while possesed, पर्वतोपमः like a mountain, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशः looked like a dark cloud, तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः bright gold earrings, किरीटी crown, परिघायुधः spear, लोकस्य among people, भयम् fear, जनयन्  creating, ऋषिमांसानि flesh of ascetics, भक्षयन् eating, दण्डकारण्ये in Dandaka forest, व्यचरम् I was moving about.
explanation: Once I was roaming the earth, like a mountain possessing the  strength of a thousand elephants, like a dark cloud, wearing bright gold earrings and crown,holding a spear in hand, terrorising the people. I was wandering in Dandaka forest feeding on the flesh of ascetics.
comments: Maricha's narration of his experience of Rama's strength--explains to Ravana the consequences of waging a war with Rama.

shloka_text: कदाचिदप्यहं वीर्यात्पर्यटन्पृथिवीमिमाम्। बलं नागसहस्रस्य धारयन्पर्वतोपमः।।3.38.1।। नीलजीमूतसङ्काशस्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः। भयं लोकस्य जनयन्किरीटी परिघायुधः।।3.38.2।। व्यचरं दण्डकारण्ये ऋषिमांसानि भक्षयन्।
transliteration: kadācidapyahaṃ vīryātparyaṭanpṛthivīmimām| balaṃ nāgasahasrasya dhārayanparvatopamaḥ nīlajīmūtasaṅkāśastaptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ| bhayaṃ lokasya janayankirīṭī parighāyudhaḥ vyacaraṃ daṇḍakāraṇye ṛṣimāṃsāni bhakṣayan|
translation: कदाचित् at one time, अहमपि I also, वीर्यात् out of prowess, इमाम् this, पृथिवीम् earth, पर्यटन् while wandering, नागसहस्रस्य thousands of elephants, बलम् strength, धारयन् while possesed, पर्वतोपमः like a mountain, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशः looked like a dark cloud, तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः bright gold earrings, किरीटी crown, परिघायुधः spear, लोकस्य among people, भयम् fear, जनयन्  creating, ऋषिमांसानि flesh of ascetics, भक्षयन् eating, दण्डकारण्ये in Dandaka forest, व्यचरम् I was moving about.
explanation: Once I was roaming the earth, like a mountain possessing the  strength of a thousand elephants, like a dark cloud, wearing bright gold earrings and crown,holding a spear in hand, terrorising the people. I was wandering in Dandaka forest feeding on the flesh of ascetics.
comments: Maricha's narration of his experience of Rama's strength--explains to Ravana the consequences of waging a war with Rama.

shloka_text: विश्वामित्रोऽथ धर्मात्मा मद्वित्रस्तो महामुनिः।।3.38.3।। स्वयं गत्वा दशरथं नरेन्द्रमिदमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: viśvāmitro'tha dharmātmā madvitrasto mahāmuniḥ svayaṃ gatvā daśarathaṃ narendramidamabravīt|
translation: अथ hence, धर्मात्मा righteous, विश्वामित्रः Visvamitra, महामुनिः great sage, मद्वित्रस्तः afraid of me, स्वयम् he himself, नरेन्द्रम् king, दशरथम् Dasaratha, गत्वा went  इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Hence the great sage, righteous Visvamitra afraid of me, went to king Dasaratha  and said:

shloka_text: अद्य रक्षतु मां रामः पर्वकाले समाहितः।।3.38.4।। मारीचान्मे भयं घोरं समुत्पन्नं नरेश्वर।
transliteration: adya rakṣatu māṃ rāmaḥ parvakāle samāhitaḥ mārīcānme bhayaṃ ghoraṃ samutpannaṃ nareśvara|
translation: नरेश्वर king, मारीचात् from Maricha, मे myself, घोरं (महत्) very, भयम् fear, समुत्पन्नम् has been created, अद्य now, रामः Rama, समाहितः composed, पर्वकाले while doing sacrifice at the time of lunar conjunctions on full moon and new moon days, माम् रक्षतु protect me.
explanation: 'O king Maricha has created in me a great fear. Spare the self possessed Rama to protect me while I do the sacrifice.'

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्तो धर्मात्मा राजा दशरथस्तदा।।3.38.5।। प्रत्युवाच महाभागं विश्वामित्रं महामुनिम्।
transliteration: ityevamukto dharmātmā rājā daśarathastadā pratyuvāca mahābhāgaṃ viśvāmitraṃ mahāmunim|
translation: इत्येवम्  thus, उक्तः  spoken, धर्मात्मा righteous, राजा king, दशरथः Dasaratha, तदा then, महाभागम् the glorious, महामुनिम् the great sage, विश्वामित्रम् Visvamitra, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: When the great, venerable sage Visvamitra said so, the righteous king Dasaratha replied:

shloka_text: बालो द्वादशवर्षोऽयमकृतास्त्रश्च राघवः।।3.38.6।। कामं तु मम यत्सैन्यं मया सह गमिष्यति।
transliteration: bālo dvādaśavarṣo'yamakṛtāstraśca rāghavaḥ kāmaṃ tu mama yatsainyaṃ mayā saha gamiṣyati|
translation: अयम् this lad, राघवः Rama, बालः young one, द्वादशवर्षे: twelve years old, अकृतास्त्रश्च not experienced in the use of weapons, मम mine, यत् that, सैन्यम् army, कामम् surely, मया सह along with me, गमिष्यति will come,
explanation: 'My son Rama is only twelve. He is not experienced in the use of weapons. I shall accompany you with my army.

shloka_text: बलेन चतुरङ्गेण स्वयमेत्य निशाचरान्।।3.38.7।। वधिष्यामि मुनिश्रेष्ठ शत्रूंस्ते मनसेप्सितान्।
transliteration: balena caturaṅgeṇa svayametya niśācarān vadhiṣyāmi muniśreṣṭha śatrūṃste manasepsitān|
translation: मुनिश्रेष्ठ O distinguished sage, चतुरङ्गेन with four divisions (elephants, horses, cavalry and infantry)of the army, बलेन with army, स्वयम् I myself, एत्य after coming, ते your, शत्रून् enemies, मनसा in your mind, ईप्सितान् desired ones, निशाचरान् nightwalkers, वधिष्यामि I will slay.
explanation: 'O distinguished sage with the four divisions of my army I will slay the enemies you want me to.'

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्तस्समुनी राजानमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.38.8।। रामान्नान्यद्बलं लोके पर्याप्तं तस्य रक्षसः।
transliteration: ityevamuktassamunī rājānamidamabravīt rāmānnānyadbalaṃ loke paryāptaṃ tasya rakṣasaḥ|
translation: इत्येवम् in that way, उक्त addressed, सः मुनिः that sage, राजानम् to the king, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, रामात् excepting Rama, अन्यत् other, बलम् strength, तस्य रक्षसः for that demon, लोके in this world, न पर्याप्तम् not enough.
explanation: When  the king thus responded to the sage,  he told him that none other than Rama in this world is a match for that demon.

shloka_text: देवतानामपि भवान् समरेष्वभिपालकः।।3.38.9।। आसीत्तव कृतं कर्म त्रिलोके विदितं नृप।
transliteration: devatānāmapi bhavān samareṣvabhipālakaḥ āsīttava kṛtaṃ karma triloke viditaṃ nṛpa|
translation: नृप O king, भवान् you, समरेषु in wars, देवतानामपि even to gods, अभिपालकः a guardian, कृतम् help, तव your, कर्म deed, त्रिलोके in the three worlds, विदितम् well known, आसीत् was.
explanation: 'O king, you have protected even gods in wars and have been a guardian. Your deeds are very wellknown in the three worlds.

shloka_text: काममस्तु महत्सैन्यं तिष्ठत्विह परन्तप।।3.38.10।। बालोऽप्येष महातेजास्समर्थस्तस्य निग्रहे। गमिष्ये राममादाय स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु परन्तप।।3.38.11।।
transliteration: kāmamastu mahatsainyaṃ tiṣṭhatviha parantapa bālo'pyeṣa mahātejāssamarthastasya nigrahe| gamiṣye rāmamādāya svasti te'stu parantapa
translation: परन्तप O scourge of the foes, महत् great, सैन्यम् army, अस्तु कामम् so you wish, इह here, तिष्ठतु let it stay, महातेजाः glorious one, एषः he, बालोऽपि even if he is a boy, तस्य his, निग्रहे in suppressing, समर्थः capable, परन्तप subduer of enemy, रामम् Rama, आदाय after taking, गमिष्ये I will go, ते to you, स्वस्ति auspicious, अस्तु be.
explanation: 'O scourge of foes as you wish, let your great army wait here. Even though Rama is young he is glorious, and capable of subduing the enemy. I will take him. Be blessed.'

shloka_text: काममस्तु महत्सैन्यं तिष्ठत्विह परन्तप।।3.38.10।। बालोऽप्येष महातेजास्समर्थस्तस्य निग्रहे। गमिष्ये राममादाय स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु परन्तप।।3.38.11।।
transliteration: kāmamastu mahatsainyaṃ tiṣṭhatviha parantapa bālo'pyeṣa mahātejāssamarthastasya nigrahe| gamiṣye rāmamādāya svasti te'stu parantapa
translation: परन्तप O scourge of the foes, महत् great, सैन्यम् army, अस्तु कामम् so you wish, इह here, तिष्ठतु let it stay, महातेजाः glorious one, एषः he, बालोऽपि even if he is a boy, तस्य his, निग्रहे in suppressing, समर्थः capable, परन्तप subduer of enemy, रामम् Rama, आदाय after taking, गमिष्ये I will go, ते to you, स्वस्ति auspicious, अस्तु be.
explanation: 'O scourge of foes as you wish, let your great army wait here. Even though Rama is young he is glorious, and capable of subduing the enemy. I will take him. Be blessed.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु स मुनिस्तमादाय नृपात्मजम्। जगाम परमप्रीतो विश्वामित्रस्स्वमाश्रमम्।।3.38.12।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu sa munistamādāya nṛpātmajam| jagāma paramaprīto viśvāmitrassvamāśramam
translation: सः that, विश्वामित्रः मुनिः sage Visvamitra, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, परमप्रीतः very happily, तम् him, नृपात्मजम् prince Rama, आदाय after taking, स्वम् his, आश्रमम् hermitage, जगाम went.
explanation: Sage Visvamitra saying so took the son of the king and went back very happily to his hermitage.

shloka_text: तं तदा दण्डकारण्ये यज्ञमुद्दिश्य दीक्षितम्। बभूवोपस्थितो रामश्चित्रं विष्फारयन्धनुः।।3.38.13।।
transliteration: taṃ tadā daṇḍakāraṇye yajñamuddiśya dīkṣitam| babhūvopasthito rāmaścitraṃ viṣphārayandhanuḥ
translation: तदा then, रामः Rama, दण्डकारण्ये in Dandaka forest, यज्ञम् Yagna, उद्दिश्य for the purpose, दीक्षितम् settled in rigorous religious discipline(vow), तम् him, उपस्थितः standing by, चित्रम् wonderful, धनुः bow, विष्फारयन् while stretching, बभूव became.
explanation: Then Rama was initiated for the protection of sacrifices and stood on guard, stretching his wonderful bow.

shloka_text: अजातव्यञ्जनश्रीमान्पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः। एकवस्त्रधरो धन्वी शिखी कनकमालया।।3.38.14।। शोभयन् दण्डकारण्यं दीप्तेन स्वेन तेजसा। अदृश्यत ततो रामो बालचन्द्र इवोदितः।।3.38.15।।
transliteration: ajātavyañjanaśrīmānpadmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ| ekavastradharo dhanvī śikhī kanakamālayā śobhayan daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ dīptena svena tejasā| adṛśyata tato rāmo bālacandra ivoditaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, अजातव्यञ्जनः with beards ungrown, श्रीमान् handsome, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः having eyes like lotus petals, एकवस्त्रधरः clad in a single garment, धन्वी  wielding bow, शिखी wearing a knot of hair on the head, कनकमालया with a gold chain, दीप्तेन luminous, स्वेन  by his, तेजसा by lustre, दण्डकारण्यम् Dandaka forest, शोभयन्  beautifying,  रामः Rama, उदितः just risen, बालचन्द्र इव like young Moon, अदृश्यत looked.
explanation: Thereafter, handsome Rama, with eyes like lotus petals, beards ungrown, clad in a single garment with knotted hair on the head, wielding a bow, with a chain of gold, luminous with his own lustre enhanced the glory of Dandaka forest by looking like the young moon just risen.

shloka_text: अजातव्यञ्जनश्रीमान्पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः। एकवस्त्रधरो धन्वी शिखी कनकमालया।।3.38.14।। शोभयन् दण्डकारण्यं दीप्तेन स्वेन तेजसा। अदृश्यत ततो रामो बालचन्द्र इवोदितः।।3.38.15।।
transliteration: ajātavyañjanaśrīmānpadmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ| ekavastradharo dhanvī śikhī kanakamālayā śobhayan daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ dīptena svena tejasā| adṛśyata tato rāmo bālacandra ivoditaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, अजातव्यञ्जनः with beards ungrown, श्रीमान् handsome, पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः having eyes like lotus petals, एकवस्त्रधरः clad in a single garment, धन्वी  wielding bow, शिखी wearing a knot of hair on the head, कनकमालया with a gold chain, दीप्तेन luminous, स्वेन  by his, तेजसा by lustre, दण्डकारण्यम् Dandaka forest, शोभयन्  beautifying,  रामः Rama, उदितः just risen, बालचन्द्र इव like young Moon, अदृश्यत looked.
explanation: Thereafter, handsome Rama, with eyes like lotus petals, beards ungrown, clad in a single garment with knotted hair on the head, wielding a bow, with a chain of gold, luminous with his own lustre enhanced the glory of Dandaka forest by looking like the young moon just risen.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं मेघसङ्काशस्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः। बली दत्तवरोदर्पादाजगाम तदाश्रमम्।।3.38.16।।
transliteration: tato'haṃ meghasaṅkāśastaptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ| balī dattavarodarpādājagāma tadāśramam
translation: ततः then, मेघसङ्काशः looking like a dark hued cloud, तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः wearing bright golden earrings, बली a strong man, दत्तवरः bestowed with boons, अहम् I, दर्पात् with pride, तदाश्रमम् the hermitage, आजगाम arrived.
explanation: Then looking like a dark cloud, wearing bright golden earrings, proud of power bestowed on me with boons, I arrived at the hermitage.

shloka_text: तेन दृष्टः प्रविष्टोऽहं सहसैवोद्यतायुधः। मां तु दृष्ट्वा धनुस्सज्यमसम्भ्रान्तश्चकार सः।।3.38.17।।
transliteration: tena dṛṣṭaḥ praviṣṭo'haṃ sahasaivodyatāyudhaḥ| māṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dhanussajyamasambhrāntaścakāra saḥ
translation: उद्यतायुधः  with raised weapons, प्रविष्टः entered, अहम् I, सहसैव at once, तेन by him, Rama, दृष्टः seen, सः he, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, असम्भ्रान्तः unperturbed, धनुः bow, सज्यम् stringing, चकार did.
explanation: I entered at once and lifted my weapons. Rama saw me and unperturbed, started stringing his bow.

shloka_text: अवजानन्नहं मोहाद्बालोऽयमिति राघवम्। विश्वामित्रस्य तां वेदिमभ्यधावं कृतत्वरः।।3.38.18।।
transliteration: avajānannahaṃ mohādbālo'yamiti rāghavam| viśvāmitrasya tāṃ vedimabhyadhāvaṃ kṛtatvaraḥ
translation: अहम् I, मोहात् due to delusion, अयम् this, बालः young boy, इति in this way, राघवम् Rama, अवजानन् underestimating, कृतत्वरः making sounds, विश्वामित्रस्य Visvamitra's, ताम् that, वेदिम् sacrificial altar, अभ्यधावम् ran towards the same.
explanation: Out of my delusion I underestimated the young boy, and screaming, ran towards Visvamitra's sacrificial altar.

shloka_text: तेन मुक्तस्ततो बाणः शितश्शत्रुनिबर्हणः। तेनाहं त्वाहतः क्षिप्तस्समुद्रे शतयोजने।।3.38.19।।
transliteration: tena muktastato bāṇaḥ śitaśśatrunibarhaṇaḥ| tenāhaṃ tvāhataḥ kṣiptassamudre śatayojane
translation: ततः then, तेन by him, शत्रुनिबर्हणः a subduer of enemy, शितः sharp, बाणः arrow, मुक्तः unleashed, अहम् on me, तेन with that, आहतः struck, शतयोजने one hundred yojanas away, समुद्रे into the sea, आक्षिप्त: I was thrown.
explanation: Then Rama released a sharp arrow that could kill the enemy. It struck me and threw me at a distance of hundred yojanas into the sea.

shloka_text: नेच्छता तात मां हन्तुं तदा वीरेण रक्षितः। रामस्य शरवेगेन निरस्तोऽहमचेतनः।।3.38.20।।
transliteration: necchatā tāta māṃ hantuṃ tadā vīreṇa rakṣitaḥ| rāmasya śaravegena nirasto'hamacetanaḥ
translation: तात O dear, तदा then, माम् me, हन्तुम् to kill, नेच्छता by not intending, वीरेण रक्षितः protected by the hero, रामस्य Rama's, शरवेगेन by the speed of his dart, अचेतनः lost conciousness, अहम् I, निरस्तः thrown away.
explanation: O dear being thrown away by the speed of his dart I lost my consciousness. I was protected by Rama who did not want to kill me.

shloka_text: पातितोऽहं तदा तेन गम्भीरे सागराम्भसि। प्राप्य संज्ञां चिरात्तात लङ्कां प्रतिगतः पुरीम्।।3.38.21।।
transliteration: pātito'haṃ tadā tena gambhīre sāgarāmbhasi| prāpya saṃjñāṃ cirāttāta laṅkāṃ pratigataḥ purīm
translation: तात O dear, तदा then, अहम् I, गम्भीरे in deep, सागराम्भसि in sea water, पातितः was thrown, चिरात् after a long time, संज्ञाम् consciousess, प्राप्य after attaining, लङ्कां पुरीम् city of Lanka, प्रतिगतः went towards.
explanation: O dear I was thrown into the deep sea and after a long time regained consciousness and  returned to the city of Lanka.

shloka_text: एवमस्मि तदा मुक्तस्सहायास्तु निपातिताः। अकृतास्त्रेण बालेन रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा।।3.38.22।।
transliteration: evamasmi tadā muktassahāyāstu nipātitāḥ| akṛtāstreṇa bālena rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā
translation: तदा then, अकृतास्त्रेण who had not mastered archery, बालेन by the young boy, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा by one who acomplishes any task with ease, रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, मुक्तः अस्मि I was spared, सहायास्तु others who accompanied me, निपातिताः were destroyed.
explanation: That way I was spared by the young boy who was not versed in archery and who could still accomplish the task with ease.Those who accompanied me were destroyed.

shloka_text: तन्मया वार्यमाणस्त्वं यदि रामेण विग्रहम्। करिष्यस्यापदं घोरां क्षिप्रं प्राप्स्यसि रावण।।3.38.23।।
transliteration: tanmayā vāryamāṇastvaṃ yadi rāmeṇa vigraham| kariṣyasyāpadaṃ ghorāṃ kṣipraṃ prāpsyasi rāvaṇa
translation: रावण Ravana, तत् that, मया by me, वार्यमाणः while being prevented, त्वम् you, रामेण with Rama, विग्रहम् conflict, करिष्यसि यदि if you wage, क्षिप्रम् very soon, घोराम् dreadful, आपदम् calamity, प्राप्स्यसि you will face.
explanation: If you pick up conflict with Rama even while being warned by me you will soon face a dreadful calamity.

shloka_text: क्रीडारतिविधिज्ञानां समाजोत्सवशालिनाम्। रक्षसां चैव सन्तापमनर्थं चाहरिष्यसि।।3.38.24।।
transliteration: krīḍāratividhijñānāṃ samājotsavaśālinām| rakṣasāṃ caiva santāpamanarthaṃ cāhariṣyasi
translation: क्रीडारतिविधिज्ञानाम् of those who know lovesport, समाजोत्सवशालिनाम् of those who celebrate community festivals, रक्षसां चैव of demons too, सन्तापम् grief, अनर्थं च disaster, आहरिष्यसि you will bring.
explanation: You will bring grief and disaster into the lives of demons who are sporting in love and who are in the habit of celebrating community festivals with joy.

shloka_text: हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधां नानारत्नविभूषिताम्। द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं पुरीं लङ्कां विनष्टां मैथिलीकृते।।3.38.25।।
transliteration: harmyaprāsādasambādhāṃ nānāratnavibhūṣitām| drakṣyasi tvaṃ purīṃ laṅkāṃ vinaṣṭāṃ maithilīkṛte
translation: हर्म्यप्रासादसम्बाधाम्  with magnificent royal mansions, नानारत्नविभूषिताम् embellisted with various gems, लङ्कां पुरीम् city of Lanka, त्वम् you, मैथिलीकृते for the sake of Sita, विनष्टाम् ruined, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: You will see the city of Lanka dotted with magnificent royal mansions embellished  with different kinds of gems ruined for the sake of Sita.

shloka_text: अकुर्वन्तोऽपि पापानि शुचयः पापसंश्रयात्। परपापैर्विनश्यन्ति मत्स्या नागह्रदे यथा।।3.38.26।।
transliteration: akurvanto'pi pāpāni śucayaḥ pāpasaṃśrayāt| parapāpairvinaśyanti matsyā nāgahrade yathā
translation: पापानि sins, अकुर्वन्तोऽपि even without committing, शुचयः pure men, पापसंश्रयात् by contact with sinners, नागह्रदे in a pool of serpents, मत्स्याः यथा like the fish, परपापैः sins committed by others, विनश्यन्ति will be destroyed.
explanation: Even without committing any sin those pure souls because they keep company with sinners will be destroyed for the sins of others just like fishes in a pool of serpents.

shloka_text: दिव्यचन्दनदिग्धाङ्गान्दिव्याभरणभूषितान्। द्रक्ष्यस्यभिहतान्भूमौ तव दोषात्तु राक्षसान्।।3.38.27।।
transliteration: divyacandanadigdhāṅgāndivyābharaṇabhūṣitān| drakṣyasyabhihatānbhūmau tava doṣāttu rākṣasān
translation: दिव्यचन्दनदिग्धाङ्गान् with limbs smeared with sandal paste and unguents, दिव्याभरणभूषितान् adorned with excellent ornaments, राक्षसान् demons, तव दोषात् for your mistakes, भूमौ on this earth, अभिहतान् killed, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: You will see the demons who smear their limbs with sandal paste and unguents, who are adorned with excellent ornaments slain and laid on the ground for your mistakes.

shloka_text: हृतदारान् सदारांश्च दश विद्रवतो दिशः। हतशेषानशरणान्द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं निशाचरान्।।3.38.28।।
transliteration: hṛtadārān sadārāṃśca daśa vidravato diśaḥ| hataśeṣānaśaraṇāndrakṣyasi tvaṃ niśācarān
translation: हतशेषान् the surviving, निशाचरान् demons, हृतदारान् with their wives abducted, सदारांश्च those with wives, अशरणान् with none to take care of them, दश दिशः in ten directions, विद्रवतः while running, त्वम् you, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: You will see the rest of the demons with their wives gone or fleeing in all directions helplessly with none to take care of them.

shloka_text: शरजालपरिक्षिप्तामग्निज्वालासमावृताम्। प्रदग्धभवनां लङ्कां द्रक्ष्यसि त्वं न संशयः।।3.38.29।।
transliteration: śarajālaparikṣiptāmagnijvālāsamāvṛtām| pradagdhabhavanāṃ laṅkāṃ drakṣyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
translation: शरजालपरिक्षिप्ताम् scattered arrows, अग्निज्वालासमावृताम् surrounded by flames of fire, प्रदग्धभवनाम् with buildings on fire, लङ्काम् Lanka, त्वम् you, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see, संशयः doubt, न not.
explanation: You will undoubtedly see Lanka filled with arrows, surrounded by flames of fire and its buildings on fire.

shloka_text: परदाराभिमर्शात्तु नान्यत्पापतरं महत्। प्रमदानां सहस्रं च तव राजन्परिग्रहः।।3.38.30।।
transliteration: paradārābhimarśāttu nānyatpāpataraṃ mahat| pramadānāṃ sahasraṃ ca tava rājanparigrahaḥ
translation: परदाराभिमर्शात्  violating the chastity of others' wives, पापतरम् a greater  sin, महत् highly, अन्यत् other thing, न not, राजन् O king, प्रमदानाम् women  सहस्रम् thousand, तव your, परिग्रहःwhom you married,
explanation: O king there is no sin greater than violating the chastity of others wives, when you have married a thousand lovely women.

shloka_text: भव स्वदारनिरतस्वकुलं रक्ष राक्षस। मानमृद्धिं च राज्यं च जीवितं चेष्टमात्मनः।।3.38.31।।
transliteration: bhava svadāraniratasvakulaṃ rakṣa rākṣasa| mānamṛddhiṃ ca rājyaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ceṣṭamātmanaḥ
translation: राक्षस O demon, स्वदारनिरतः enjoy your own wives, भव be, स्वकुलम् your race, रक्ष you protect, मानम् prestige, ऋद्धिं च prosperity also, राज्यं च kingdom too, आत्मनः your, इष्टम्  dear, जीवितं च and your life.
explanation: Enjoy with your wives. Protect your race, prestige, kingdom, prosperity and your own dear life.

shloka_text: कलत्राणि च सौम्यानि मित्रवर्गं तथैव च। यदीच्छसि चिरं भोक्तं मा कृथा रामविप्रियम्।।3.38.32।।
transliteration: kalatrāṇi ca saumyāni mitravargaṃ tathaiva ca| yadīcchasi ciraṃ bhoktaṃ mā kṛthā rāmavipriyam
translation: सौम्यानि beautiful ones, कलत्राणि wives, तथैव च similarly, मित्रवर्गम् friends, चिरम् for a long time, भोक्तुम् to enjoy, इच्छसि यदि wish to, राम विप्रियम् offence to Rama, मा कृथाः do not do.
explanation: If you wish to enjoy your beautiful wives and your good friends for long, do not create enmity with Rama.

shloka_text: निवार्यमाणस्सुहृदा मया भृशं प्रसह्य सीतां यदि धर्षयिष्यसि। गमिष्यसि क्षीणबलस्सबान्धवो यमक्षयं रामशरात्तजीवितः।।3.38.33।।
transliteration: nivāryamāṇassuhṛdā mayā bhṛśaṃ prasahya sītāṃ yadi dharṣayiṣyasi| gamiṣyasi kṣīṇabalassabāndhavo yamakṣayaṃ rāmaśarāttajīvitaḥ
translation: सुहृदा by a friend, मया by myself, भृशम् profusely, निवार्यमाणः prevented, सीताम् Sita, प्रसह्य forcibly, धर्षयिष्यसि यदि if you violate Sita, क्षीणबलः with reduced strength, सबान्धवः along with your kin, रामशरात्तजीवितः your life taken away by Rama's arrows, यमक्षयम् abode of Yama , गमिष्यसि you will go.
