translation: चारुस्मिते lady  with an elegant smile, चारुदति lady of lovely teeth, चारुनेत्रे beautiful eyes, विलासिनि lovely lady, कान्ते attractive lady, नदी river, अम्भसा with water, कूलमिव like a river bank, मे my, मनः mind, हरसि  capturing, करान्तमितमध्या  slender waist could be compassed with fist, सुकेशी of beautiful hair, संहतस्तनी breasts rubbing agaist each other, असि you are.
explanation: O lady with an elegant smile, beautiful teeth, lovely  eyes you are enticing.Your slender waist can be compassed by my fist.Your hair is beautiful and your large breasts are rubbing against each other.You are capturing my mind  just as the flow of water in a river  touches its banks.

shloka_text: नैव देवी न गन्धर्वी न यक्षी न च किन्नरी। नैवंरूपा मया नारी दृष्टपूर्वा महीतले।।3.46.22।।
transliteration: naiva devī na gandharvī na yakṣī na ca kinnarī| naivaṃrūpā mayā nārī dṛṣṭapūrvā mahītale
translation: मया by  me, महीतले on this earth, एवं रूपा such a beauty, नारी lady, न दृष्टपूर्वा not seen earlier, देवी O goddess, नैव neither, गन्धर्वी gandharva woman, न not even, यक्षी yakshi, न not, किन्नरी kinnera woman.
explanation: O beautiful lady I have not seen such a beauty earlier either among goddesses or among gandharavis, or yakshis or even among kinneris.

shloka_text: रूपमग्र्यं च लोकेषु सौकुमार्यं वयश्चते। इह वासश्च कान्तारे चित्तमुन्मादयन्ति मे।।3.46.23।।
transliteration: rūpamagryaṃ ca lokeṣu saukumāryaṃ vayaścate| iha vāsaśca kāntāre cittamunmādayanti me
translation: लोकेषु in the world, अग्र्यम् the best, ते your, रूपम् beauty, सौकुमार्यम् tenderness, वयश्च youth, इह here, कान्तारे in this forlorn forest, वासश्च living, मे my, चित्तम् heart, उन्मादयन्ति are maddening.
explanation: You are the most beautiful among women in the world. With all your tenderness and youth you are living in this forlorn forest. This maddens my heart.

shloka_text: सा प्रतिक्राम भद्रं ते नैवं वस्तुमिहार्हसि। राक्षसानामयं वासो घोराणां कामरूपिणाम्।।3.46.24।।
transliteration: sā pratikrāma bhadraṃ te naivaṃ vastumihārhasi| rākṣasānāmayaṃ vāso ghorāṇāṃ kāmarūpiṇām
translation: सा such a lady, प्रतिक्राम move out, ते of yours, भद्रम् safety, इह here, एवम् in this way, वस्तुम् to reside, न अर्हसि not proper, अयम् this is, घोराणाम् horrible, कामरूपिणाम् who can change their form at will, राक्षसानाम् of demons, वासः dwelling place.
explanation: It is not safe for a lady like you to reside here. Move out at once. This is only fit for the dwelling of horrible demons who can change their form at will.

shloka_text: प्रासादाग्राणि रम्याणि नगरोपवनानि च। सम्पन्नानि सुगन्धीनि युक्तान्याचरितुं त्वया।।3.46.25।।
transliteration: prāsādāgrāṇi ramyāṇi nagaropavanāni ca| sampannāni sugandhīni yuktānyācarituṃ tvayā
translation: प्रासादाग्राणि terraces of palaces, रम्याणि beautiful, सम्पन्नानि luxurious, सुगन्धीनि fragrant, नगरोपवनानि च city gardens, त्वया yourself, आचरितुम् to stroll, युक्तानि deserve.
explanation: You deserve to stroll in the terraces of palaces, in beautiful, luxurious and fragrant city gardens.

shloka_text: वरं माल्यं वरं भोज्यं वरं वस्त्रं च शोभने। भर्तारं च वरं मन्ये त्वद्युक्तमसितेक्षणे।।3.46.26।।
transliteration: varaṃ mālyaṃ varaṃ bhojyaṃ varaṃ vastraṃ ca śobhane| bhartāraṃ ca varaṃ manye tvadyuktamasitekṣaṇe
translation: असितेक्षणे  black eyed lady, शोभने O beauty, वरम् best of, माल्यम् garlands, वरम् best of, भोज्यम् food, वरम् best of, वस्त्रम् clothes, वरम् choicest, भर्तारं च and husband, त्वद्युक्तम् suitable for you, मन्ये I think.
explanation: O beautiful, blackeyed lady, I think you deserve the best of garlands, best of food, and clothes and a suitable husband.

shloka_text: का त्वं भवसि रुद्राणां मरुतां वा वरानने। वसूनां वा वरावोहे देवता प्रतिभासि मे।।3.46.27।।
transliteration: kā tvaṃ bhavasi rudrāṇāṃ marutāṃ vā varānane| vasūnāṃ vā varāvohe devatā pratibhāsi me
translation: वरानने O beautiful lady, वरारोहे O with beautiful buttocks lady, त्वम् you, का भवसि who are you, रुद्राणाम् among Rudras, मरुतां वा or Maruta's, वसूनां वा or Vasus, मे to me, देवता goddess, प्रतिभासि you appear.
explanation: O best of women O lady with beautiful buttocks  can you be one  of the Rudras or Maruts or Vasus? To me, you appear like a goddess.

shloka_text: नेह गच्छन्ति गन्धर्वा न देवा न च किन्नराः। राक्षसानामयं वासः कथं नु त्वमिहागता।।3.46.28।।
transliteration: neha gacchanti gandharvā na devā na ca kinnarāḥ| rākṣasānāmayaṃ vāsaḥ kathaṃ nu tvamihāgatā
translation: इह here, गन्धर्वाः gandharva, न गच्छन्ति do not go this way, देवाः gods, न not, किन्नराः च and kinnara, न not, अयम् this is, राक्षसानाम् for demons, वासः dwelling place, त्वम् you, कथम् how, इह here, आगता came?
explanation: Neither gandharvas, nor kinnaras, nor gods move here. This is only a dwelling place for the demons. How did you come here ?

shloka_text: इह शाखामृगास्सिंहा द्वीपिव्याघ्रमृगास्तथा। ऋक्षास्तरक्षवः कङ्काः कथं तेभ्यो न बिभ्यसि।।3.46.29।।
transliteration: iha śākhāmṛgāssiṃhā dvīpivyāghramṛgāstathā| ṛkṣāstarakṣavaḥ kaṅkāḥ kathaṃ tebhyo na bibhyasi
translation: इह here, शाखामृगाः monkeys, सिंहाः lions, द्वीपिव्याघ्रमृगाः panthers, tigers and other wild animals, तथा so also, ऋक्षाः bears, तरक्षवः hyenas, कङ्काः Kanka birds, तेभ्यः by them, कथम् how is it, न बिभ्यसि you are not frightened.
explanation: There are monkeys, lions, panthers, tigers, hyenas, bears, kanka birds and other wild animals here. How is it that you are not afraid of them?

shloka_text: मदान्वितानां घोराणां कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम्। कथमेका महारण्ये न बिभेषि वरानने।।3.46.30।।
transliteration: madānvitānāṃ ghorāṇāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ tarasvinām| kathamekā mahāraṇye na bibheṣi varānane
translation: वरानने beautiful lady, महारण्ये in dense woods, मदान्वितानाम्  in rut, घोराणाम् fierce, तरस्विनाम् swift and powerful, कुञ्जराणाम् of elephants, एका alone, कथम् how, न बिभेषि are you not scared of them?
explanation: O Charming lady how is it that although alone you are not afraid of the dreadful, swift, powerful wild animals like elephants in rut ?

shloka_text: कासि कस्य कुतश्चित्त्वं किं निमित्तं च दण्डकान्। एका चरसि कल्याणि घोरान्राक्षससेवितान्।।3.46.31।।
transliteration: kāsi kasya kutaścittvaṃ kiṃ nimittaṃ ca daṇḍakān| ekā carasi kalyāṇi ghorānrākṣasasevitān
translation: कल्याणि O auspicious lady, त्वम् you, का असि who are you, कस्य to whose, कुतश्चित् where did you come from ?, राक्षससेवितान् inhabited by demons, घोरान् terrible, दण्डकान् Dandaka, एका alone, किं निमित्तम् for what reason, चरसि you roam.
explanation: Who are you, O auspicious lady ? Who are your people? Why are you here? From where have you come? For what reason are you going about alone in this fierce Dandaka tract, inhabited by demons?

shloka_text: इति प्रशस्ता वैदेही रावणेन दुरात्मना। द्विजातिवेशेण हि तं दृष्ट्वा रावणमागतम्।।3.46.32।। सर्वैरतिथिसत्कारैः पूजयामास मैथिली।
transliteration: iti praśastā vaidehī rāvaṇena durātmanā| dvijātiveśeṇa hi taṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇamāgatam sarvairatithisatkāraiḥ pūjayāmāsa maithilī|
translation: दुरात्मना by the villain, रावणेन by Ravana, इति thus, प्रशस्ता praised, मैथिली Maithili, वैदेही princess of Videha, द्विजातिवेशेण in the guise of a brahmin, आगतम् come, तं रावणम् that Ravana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, सर्वैः with all, अतिथिसत्कारैः  with hospitality, पूजयामास  honoured him.
explanation: Seeing Ravana, a villain in the guise of a brahmin praising her, Sita, the princess of Videha, honoured him with all hospitality.

shloka_text: उपनीयासनं पूर्वं पाद्येनाभिनिमन्त्र्य च।।3.46.33।। अब्रवीत्सिद्धमित्येव तदा तं सौम्यदर्शनम्।
transliteration: upanīyāsanaṃ pūrvaṃ pādyenābhinimantrya ca abravītsiddhamityeva tadā taṃ saumyadarśanam|
translation: तदा then, पूर्वम् first, आसनम् seat, उपनीय brought, पाद्येन water for his feet, अभिनिमन्त्र्य  च and inviting (for food), सौम्यदर्शनम् lovelylooking, तम् to him, सिद्धम् food ready, इत्येव  in this way, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: She offered the handsome guest a seat first and then water for washing his feet with, and then invited him for food.

shloka_text: द्विजातिवेषेण समीक्ष्य मैथिली समागतं पात्रकुसुम्भधारिणम्। अशक्यमुद्वेष्टुमपायदर्शनम् न्यमन्त्रयद्ब्राह्मणवत्तदाङ्गना।।3.46.34।।
transliteration: dvijātiveṣeṇa samīkṣya maithilī samāgataṃ pātrakusumbhadhāriṇam| aśakyamudveṣṭumapāyadarśanam nyamantrayadbrāhmaṇavattadāṅganā
translation: तदा then, मैथिली Maithili, अङ्गना lady, द्विजातिवेशेण in the guise of a brahmin, समागतम् having come, पात्रकुसुम्भधारिणम् holding a bottlegourd as a begging bowl, उद्वेष्टुम् to hate, अशक्यम् not possible, अपायदर्शनम् dangerous intention, ब्राह्मणवत् brahmin, न्यमन्त्रयत् she invited.
explanation: Sita, being a lady, was unable to doubt him since he came in the guise of a brahmin, holding a bottlegourd and a begging bowl. Without knowing his illintention she invited him in, mistaking him for a brahmin.

shloka_text: इयं बृसी ब्राह्मण काममास्यतामिदं च पाद्यं प्रतिगृह्यतामिति। इदं च सिद्धं वनजातमुत्तमं त्वदर्थमव्यग्रमिहोपभुज्यताम्।।3.46.35।।
transliteration: iyaṃ bṛsī brāhmaṇa kāmamāsyatāmidaṃ ca pādyaṃ pratigṛhyatāmiti| idaṃ ca siddhaṃ vanajātamuttamaṃ tvadarthamavyagramihopabhujyatām
translation: ब्राह्मण O brahmin, इयम् this is, बृसी the seat of an ascetic, कामम् freely, आस्यताम् be seated, इदम् this is, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, प्रतिगृह्यताम् please take, इति these, इदम् this is, उत्तमम् best, वनजातम् available in the forest, त्वदर्थम् for you, सिद्धम् kept ready, इह here, अव्यग्रम् without hesitation, उपभुज्यताम् please eat.
explanation: O brahmin, here is the seat for you. Feel free to sit. Here is water to wash your feet with. This is the best of food for you collected from the forest. Please partake this without hesitation.

shloka_text: निमन्त्र्यमाणः प्रतिपूर्णभाषिणीं नरेन्द्रपत्नीं प्रसमीक्ष्य मैथिलीम्। प्रसह्य तस्याहरणे धृतं मनः समर्पयत्स्वात्मवधाय रावणः।।3.46.36।।
transliteration: nimantryamāṇaḥ pratipūrṇabhāṣiṇīṃ narendrapatnīṃ prasamīkṣya maithilīm| prasahya tasyāharaṇe dhṛtaṃ manaḥ samarpayatsvātmavadhāya rāvaṇaḥ
translation: निमन्त्र्यमाणः as he was being invited, रावणः Ravana, प्रतिपूर्णभाषिणीम् softspoken, नरेन्द्रपत्नीम् wife of the king, मैथिलीम् Maithili, प्रसमीक्ष्य looking at her, स्वात्मवधाय for his own destruction, प्रसह्य forcibly, तस्याः her, हरणे to abduct, मनः set his mind, धृतम् intent upon, समर्पयत् presented.
explanation: Ravana was observing the princess from Mithila, wife of a king inviting him  and speaking to him in cordial manner. Looking at her, he resolved to  abduct her forcibly, inviting his own death.

shloka_text: ततः सुवेषं मृगयागतं पतिं प्रतीक्षमाणा सहलक्ष्मणं तदा। विवीक्षमाणा हरितं ददर्श तन्महद्वनं नैव तु रामलक्ष्णौ।।3.46.37।।
transliteration: tataḥ suveṣaṃ mṛgayāgataṃ patiṃ pratīkṣamāṇā sahalakṣmaṇaṃ tadā| vivīkṣamāṇā haritaṃ dadarśa tanmahadvanaṃ naiva tu rāmalakṣṇau
translation: ततः then, सुवेषम् that beautiful form of Rama, मृगयागतम् gone to hunt the deer, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, पतिम् husband, प्रतीक्षमाणा while waited, तदा then, विवीक्षमाणा  while she looked with eagerness, हरितम् green, तत् that, महत् dense, वनम् forest, ददर्श saw, रामलक्ष्मणौ तु for Rama and Lakshmana, नैव not seen.
explanation: Sita looked out for the beautiful figure of Rama who had gone to hunt the deer along with Lakshmana. Waiting eagerly for her husband, she only saw the vast stretch of green forest  but not Rama and Lakshmana. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षट्चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortysixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: रावणेन तु वैदेही तदा पृष्टा जिहीर्षता। परिव्राजकरूपेण शशंसात्मानमात्मना।।3.47.1।।
transliteration: rāvaṇena tu vaidehī tadā pṛṣṭā jihīrṣatā| parivrājakarūpeṇa śaśaṃsātmānamātmanā
translation: तदा then, जिहीर्षुणा of crooked intention of abducting, परिव्राजकरूपेण in the guise of a mendicant, रावणेन by Ravana, पृष्टा was asked, वैदेही Vaidehi, आत्मानम् about her, आत्मना herself, शशंस told.
explanation: Then Ravana in the guise of a mendicant with crooked intention to abduct her, asked Vaidehi to tell him about herself.
comments: Ravana asks Sita to seek his hand -- Sita's refusal.

shloka_text: ब्राह्मणश्चातिथिश्चायमनुक्तो हि शपेत माम्। इति ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु सीता वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.47.2।।
transliteration: brāhmaṇaścātithiścāyamanukto hi śapeta mām| iti dhyātvā muhūrtaṃ tu sītā vacanamabravīt
translation: ब्राह्मणश्च a brahmin, अतिथिश्च also a guest, अयम् this man, अनुक्तः unanswered, माम् me, शपेत हि may curse, इति thus, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, ध्यात्वा thought, सीता Sita, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: 'He is a brahmin and also a guest. If unanswered he may curse me'. Thinking this Sita thought for a moment and said:

shloka_text: दुहिता जनकस्याहं मैथिलस्य महात्मनः। सीता नाम्नास्मि भद्रं ते रामभार्या द्विजोत्तम।।3.47.3।।
transliteration: duhitā janakasyāhaṃ maithilasya mahātmanaḥ| sītā nāmnāsmi bhadraṃ te rāmabhāryā dvijottama
translation: द्विजोत्तम O best of brahmin, अहम् I am, मैथिलस्य of the king of Maithila, महात्मनः of the great king, जनकस्य Janaka's, दुहिता daughter, नाम्ना by name, सीता अस्मि Sita, रामभार्या wife of Rama, ते to you, भद्रम् be pleased.
explanation: O best of brahmins be pleased to know I am Sita by name, daughter of the great Janaka, king of Mithila and wife of Rama.

shloka_text: उषित्वा द्वादश समा इक्ष्वाकुणां निवेशने। भुञ्जाना मानुषान्भोगान्सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी।।3.47.4।।
transliteration: uṣitvā dvādaśa samā ikṣvākuṇāṃ niveśane| bhuñjānā mānuṣānbhogānsarvakāmasamṛddhinī
translation: द्वादश twelve, समाः years, इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of the Ikshvaku family, निवेशने in the house, उषित्वा  lived, मानुषान् of mortals, भोगान् pleasures, भुञ्जाना enjoying, सर्वकामसमृद्धिनी all my desires fulfilled.
explanation: I lived in the house of the Ikshvakus for twelve years and enjoyed all kinds of pleasures meant for mortals.

shloka_text: ततस्त्रयोदशे वर्षे राजामन्त्रयत प्रभुः। अभिषेचयितुं रामं समेतो राजमन्त्रिभिः।।3.47.5।।
transliteration: tatastrayodaśe varṣe rājāmantrayata prabhuḥ| abhiṣecayituṃ rāmaṃ sameto rājamantribhiḥ
translation: ततः then, प्रभुः राजा king and lord, त्रयोदशे वर्षे in the thirteenth year, राजमन्त्रिभिः   kings and ministers, समेतः together, रामम् for Rama, अभिषेचयितुम् to consecrate, अमन्त्रयत  consulted.
explanation: In the thirteenth year, the king and lord Dasaratha consulted other kings and ministers to consecrate Rama.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्सम्भ्रियमाणे तु राघवस्याभिषेचने। कैकेयी नाम भर्तारमार्या सा याचते वरम्।।3.47.6।।
transliteration: tasminsambhriyamāṇe tu rāghavasyābhiṣecane| kaikeyī nāma bhartāramāryā sā yācate varam
translation: राघवस्य Rama's, तस्मिन् in that, अभिषेचने consecration, सम्भ्रियमाणे  arrangements were being made, कैकेयी नाम Kaikeyi by name, सा she, भर्तारम् her husband, आर्या lady, वरम् boon, याचते sought.
explanation: Arrangements for consecration were on when queen Kaikeyi sought a boon from the king.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य तु कैकेयी श्वशुरं सुकृतेन मे। मम प्रव्राजनं भर्तुर्भरतस्याभिषेचनम्।।3.47.7।। द्वावयाचत भर्तारं सत्यसन्धं नृपोत्तमम्।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tu kaikeyī śvaśuraṃ sukṛtena me| mama pravrājanaṃ bharturbharatasyābhiṣecanam dvāvayācata bhartāraṃ satyasandhaṃ nṛpottamam|
translation: कैकेयी Kaikeyi, मे श्वशुरम् my fatherinlaw, सुकृतेन by good luck, प्रतिगृह्य  extracted a  promise ( married for a consideration), सत्यसन्धम् truthful, नृपोत्तमम् best of kings, भर्तारम् husband's, मम भर्तुः of my husband, प्रव्राजनम् banishment, भरतस्य Bharata's, अभिषेचनम् consecration, द्वौ two (boons), अयाचत asked.
explanation: For the fulfilment of the promise made to Kaikeyi earlier by my truthful fatherin law, who, to my good luck, was the best of kings, she asked for two boons. One was banishment of my husband and second, consecration of Bharata.

shloka_text: नाद्य भोक्ष्ये न च स्वप्स्ये न पास्येच कथञ्चन।।3.47.8।। एष मे जीवितस्यान्तो रामो यद्यभिषिच्यते।
transliteration: nādya bhokṣye na ca svapsye na pāsyeca kathañcana eṣa me jīvitasyānto rāmo yadyabhiṣicyate|
translation: अद्य today, रामः Rama, यदिअभिषिच्यते if consecrated, न भोक्ष्ये I will not eat, न च स्वप्स्ये I will not sleep, कथञ्चन in any way, नपास्ये च I will not drink, एषः this is, मे my, जीवितस्य life's, अन्तः an end.
explanation: 'I shall not eat, or sleep or even drink if Rama is consecrated and I shall put an end to my life itself' (said Kaikeyi).

shloka_text: इति ब्रुवाणां कैकेयीं श्वशुरो मे स मानदः।।3.47.9।। अयाचतार्थैरन्वर्थैर्न च याञ्चां चकार सा।
transliteration: iti bruvāṇāṃ kaikeyīṃ śvaśuro me sa mānadaḥ ayācatārthairanvarthairna ca yāñcāṃ cakāra sā|
translation: इति thus, ब्रुवाणाम् while speaking, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, मानदः respectable, सः he, मे my, श्वशुरः fatherinlaw, अन्वर्थैः अर्थैः riches, अयाचत requested, सा she, याञ्चाम् soliciting, न च चकार not agreed.
explanation: The king, my fatherinlaw, who respected her offered riches. Which she did not accept.

shloka_text: मम भर्तामहातेजा वयसा पञ्चविंशकः।।3.47.10।। अष्टादश हि वर्षाणि मम जन्मनि गण्यते।
transliteration: mama bhartāmahātejā vayasā pañcaviṃśakaḥ aṣṭādaśa hi varṣāṇi mama janmani gaṇyate|
translation: महातेजाः very bold, मम भर्ता my husband, वयसा by age, पञ्चविंशकः twenty five, मम mine, जन्मनि completed after birth, अष्टादश eighteen, वर्षाणि years, गण्यते is counted.
explanation: My husband who was very bold was twentyfive years and I had completed eighteen years since my birth.

shloka_text: रामेति प्रथितो लोके गुणवान्सत्यवान्शुचिः।।3.47.11।। विशालाक्षो महाबाहुस्सर्वभूतहिते रतः।
transliteration: rāmeti prathito loke guṇavānsatyavānśuciḥ viśālākṣo mahābāhussarvabhūtahite rataḥ|
translation: रामेति known as Rama, लोके in the world, प्रथितः famous, गुणवान् virtuous, सत्यवान् truthful, शुचिः pure, विशालाक्षः  large eyed, महाबाहुः  largearmed, सर्वभूतहिते in the wellbeing of all, रतः engaged.
explanation: My husband known in the world as Rama is largeeyed, longarmed, virtuous, truthful, pure and is always engaged in the welfare of all beings.

shloka_text: कामार्तस्तु महातेजाः पिता दशरथस्स्वयम्।।3.47.12।। कैकेय्याः प्रियकामार्थं तं रामं नाभ्यषेचयत्।
transliteration: kāmārtastu mahātejāḥ pitā daśarathassvayam kaikeyyāḥ priyakāmārthaṃ taṃ rāmaṃ nābhyaṣecayat|
translation: कामार्तः overcome by love, महातेजाः brilliant, पिता father, दशरथः Dasaratha, स्वयम् himself, कैकेय्याः Kaikeyi, प्रियकामार्थम् to please her, तं रामम् Rama, नाभ्यषेचयत् not consecrated.
explanation: The brilliant king, Dasaratha, father of Rama, overcome by passion,  did not consecrate Rama in order to please Kaikeyi.

shloka_text: अभिषेकाय तु पितुस्समीपं राममागतम्।।3.47.13।। कैकेयी मम भर्तारमित्युवाच धृतं वचः।
transliteration: abhiṣekāya tu pitussamīpaṃ rāmamāgatam kaikeyī mama bhartāramityuvāca dhṛtaṃ vacaḥ|
translation: अभिषेकाय for consecration, तु but, समीपम् near, आगतम् reached, मम भर्तारम् to my husband, रामम् Rama, इति धृतम् in unhesitating  वचः words, उवाच said.
explanation: When my husband Rama approached his father for the consecration she said these unhesitating words:

shloka_text: तव पित्रा समाज्ञप्तं ममेदं शृणु राघव।।3.47.14।। भरताय प्रदातव्यमिदं राज्यमकण्टकम्।
transliteration: tava pitrā samājñaptaṃ mamedaṃ śṛṇu rāghava bharatāya pradātavyamidaṃ rājyamakaṇṭakam|
translation: राघव O Rama, तव your, पित्रा by father, समाज्ञप्तम् is ordered, इदम् this way, शृणु listen, अकण्टकम् without any obstacles, इदं राज्यम् this kingdom, भरताय to Bharata, प्रदातव्यम् should be bestowed.
explanation: 'O Rama, listen, your father has ordered that this kingdom be bestowed on Bharata without any obstacles.

shloka_text: त्वया हि खलु वस्तव्यं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च।।3.47.15।। वने प्रव्रज काकुत्स्थ पितरं मोचयानृतान्।
transliteration: tvayā hi khalu vastavyaṃ nava varṣāṇi pañca ca vane pravraja kākutstha pitaraṃ mocayānṛtān|
translation: काकुत्स्थ Rama of the Kakutstha dynasty, त्वया by you, नव पञ्च च वर्षाणि fourteen years, वने in the forest, वस्तव्यम् खलु you should live indeed, प्रव्रज  proceed in exile, पितरम् to father, अनृतात् from falsehood, मोचय save him.
explanation: 'O Rama of the Kakutstha dynasty, you should live in the forest for fourteen years and save your father from falsehood'.

shloka_text: तथेत्युक्त्वा च तां रामः कैकेयीमकुतोभयः।।3.47.16।। चकार तद्वचस्तस्या मम भर्ता दृढव्रतः।
transliteration: tathetyuktvā ca tāṃ rāmaḥ kaikeyīmakutobhayaḥ cakāra tadvacastasyā mama bhartā dṛḍhavrataḥ|
translation: अकुतोभयः a fearless man, दृढव्रतः of firm resolution, मम भर्ता my husband, रामः Rama, तथेति be it so, ताम् her, कैकेयीम् to Kaikeyi, उक्त्वा said, तस्याः her, तत् those, वचः words, चकार executed.
explanation: My husband Rama, a man of fearlessness and firm resolution, said to Kaikeyi 'Be it so' and carried out her words.

shloka_text: दद्यान्न प्रतिगृह्णीयात्सत्यं ब्रूयान्न चानृतम्।।3.47.17।। एतद्ब्राह्मण रामस्य ध्रृवं व्रतमनुत्तमम्।
transliteration: dadyānna pratigṛhṇīyātsatyaṃ brūyānna cānṛtam etadbrāhmaṇa rāmasya dhrṛvaṃ vratamanuttamam|
translation: दद्यात् giver, न प्रतिगृह्णीयात् not receive, सत्यम् truth, ब्रूयात् utter, अनृतम् other than truth, न च not utter, ब्राह्मण brahmin, एतत् this is, रामस्य Rama's, धृवम् resolve, अनुत्तमम् very great, व्रतम् vow.
explanation: O brahmin this is his firm resolve and his great vow: 'One should give and never take one should speak the truth and nothing but he truth.'

shloka_text: तस्य भ्राता तु द्वैमात्रो लक्ष्मणो नाम वीर्यवान्।।3.47.18।। रामस्य पुरुषव्याघ्रस्सहायस्समरेरिहा।
transliteration: tasya bhrātā tu dvaimātro lakṣmaṇo nāma vīryavān rāmasya puruṣavyāghrassahāyassamarerihā|
translation: तस्य रामस्य such Rama's, द्वैमात्रः भ्राता second mother's son, half brother, वीर्यवान् strong, पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men, अरिहा slayer of enemies, लक्ष्मणो नाम by name Lakshmana, समरे in battle, सहाय: companion.
explanation: Son to the second mother of Rama, his mighty halfbrother, by name, Lakshmana, a tiger among men and a  slayer of enemies in battle is a companion to him.

shloka_text: स भ्राता लक्ष्मणो नाम धर्मचारी दृढव्रतः।।3.47.19।। अन्वगच्छद्दनुष्पाणिः प्रव्रजन्तं मया सह।
transliteration: sa bhrātā lakṣmaṇo nāma dharmacārī dṛḍhavrataḥ anvagacchaddanuṣpāṇiḥ pravrajantaṃ mayā saha|
translation: धर्मचारी righteous, दृढव्रतः steadfast, लक्ष्मणो नाम Lakshmana by name, सः भ्राता his brother, धनुष्पाणिः wielder of bow, मया सह along with me, प्रव्रजन्तम् as he was being exiled, अन्वगच्छत् came along.
explanation: Lakshmana, his brother, is righteous and steadfast. Bow in hand, he followed Rama along with me, into exile.

shloka_text: जटी तापसरूपेण मया सह सहानुजः।।3.47.20।। प्रविष्टो दण्डकारण्यं धर्मनित्यो जितेन्द्रियः।
transliteration: jaṭī tāpasarūpeṇa mayā saha sahānujaḥ praviṣṭo daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ dharmanityo jitendriyaḥ|
translation: धर्मनित्यः ever righteous, जितेन्द्रियः selfcontrolled, जटी with matted locks, मया सह along with me, सहानुजः with his brother, दण्डकारण्यम् Dandaka forest, प्रविष्टः entered.
explanation: Rama who is ever righteous and selfcontrolled entered the Dandaka forest with matted locks, his brother and me.

shloka_text: ते वयं प्रच्युता राज्यात्कैकेय्यास्तु कृते त्रयः।।3.47.21।। विचरामो द्विजश्रेष्ठ वनं गम्भीरमोजसा।
transliteration: te vayaṃ pracyutā rājyātkaikeyyāstu kṛte trayaḥ vicarāmo dvijaśreṣṭha vanaṃ gambhīramojasā|
translation: द्विजश्रेष्ठ O best among brahmins, ते those of us, वयम् we, त्रयः three of us, कैकेय्याः कृते on account of Kaikeyi, राज्यात् from kingdom, प्रच्युताः dislodged, ओजसा  with valour, गम्भीरम् deep, वनम् forest, विचरामः wandering.
explanation: O best of brahmins three of us have been wandering with courage in the deep forest, dislodged from  the kingdom on account of  Kaikeyi.

shloka_text: समाश्वस मुहूर्तं तु शक्यं वस्तुमिह त्वया।।3.47.22।। आगमिष्यति मे भर्ता वन्यमादाय पुष्कलम्। रुरून्गोधा न्वराहांश्च हत्वाऽदायाऽमिषान्बहून्।।3.47.23।।
transliteration: samāśvasa muhūrtaṃ tu śakyaṃ vastumiha tvayā āgamiṣyati me bhartā vanyamādāya puṣkalam| rurūngodhā nvarāhāṃśca hatvā'dāyā'miṣānbahūn
translation: मुहूर्तम् for a while, समाश्वस take rest, त्वया by you, इह here, वस्तुम् to stay, शक्यम् it is possible, मे भर्ता my husband, रुरून् deer, गोधाः alligators, वराहांश्च boars, हत्वा after killing, बहून् many of them, आमिषान् varieties of meat, आदाय would fetch, पुष्कलम् in plenty, वन्यम् from the forest, आदाय getting, आगमिष्यति will come.
explanation: Rest here awhile. My husband will return with plenty of meat of many kinds from the forest, killing deer, alligators and wild boars.

shloka_text: समाश्वस मुहूर्तं तु शक्यं वस्तुमिह त्वया।।3.47.22।। आगमिष्यति मे भर्ता वन्यमादाय पुष्कलम्। रुरून्गोधा न्वराहांश्च हत्वाऽदायाऽमिषान्बहून्।।3.47.23।।
transliteration: samāśvasa muhūrtaṃ tu śakyaṃ vastumiha tvayā āgamiṣyati me bhartā vanyamādāya puṣkalam| rurūngodhā nvarāhāṃśca hatvā'dāyā'miṣānbahūn
translation: मुहूर्तम् for a while, समाश्वस take rest, त्वया by you, इह here, वस्तुम् to stay, शक्यम् it is possible, मे भर्ता my husband, रुरून् deer, गोधाः alligators, वराहांश्च boars, हत्वा after killing, बहून् many of them, आमिषान् varieties of meat, आदाय would fetch, पुष्कलम् in plenty, वन्यम् from the forest, आदाय getting, आगमिष्यति will come.
explanation: Rest here awhile. My husband will return with plenty of meat of many kinds from the forest, killing deer, alligators and wild boars.

shloka_text: स त्वं नाम च गोत्रञ्च कुलं चाचक्ष्व तत्त्वतः। एकश्च दण्डकारण्ये किमर्थं चरसि द्विज।।3.47.24।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ nāma ca gotrañca kulaṃ cācakṣva tattvataḥ| ekaśca daṇḍakāraṇye kimarthaṃ carasi dvija
translation: द्विज O brahmin, सः such as you, त्वम् you, नाम च name and, गोत्रञ्च gotram, कुलं च race, तत्त्वतः truly, आचक्ष्व tell me, एकः च alone, दण्डकारण्ये in Dandaka forest, किमर्थम् for what purpose, चरसि going about.
explanation: O brahmin, tell me your name, your gotra and your pedigree. And the purpose for which you are going about all alone in this Dandaka forest

shloka_text: एवं बृवन्त्यां सीतायां रामपत्न्यां महाबलः। प्रत्युवाचोत्तरं तीव्रं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।।3.47.25।।
transliteration: evaṃ bṛvantyāṃ sītāyāṃ rāmapatnyāṃ mahābalaḥ| pratyuvācottaraṃ tīvraṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
translation: रामपत्न्याम् when Rama's wife, सीतायाम् Sita, एवम् in that way, ब्रुवन्त्याम् speaking, महाबलः   powerful, राक्षसाधिपः king of demons, रावणः Ravana, तीव्रम् sharp, उत्तरम् reply, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: To these words of Sita, Rama's wife, Ravana, the powerful king of demons, replied  sharp:

shloka_text: येन वित्रासिता लोकास्सदेवासुरपन्नगाः। अहं तु रावणो नाम सीते रक्षोगणेश्वरः।।3.47.26।।
transliteration: yena vitrāsitā lokāssadevāsurapannagāḥ| ahaṃ tu rāvaṇo nāma sīte rakṣogaṇeśvaraḥ
translation: सीते O Sita, अहम् I am, येन by whom, सदेवासुरपन्नगाः asuras and pannagas along with gods, लोकाः worlds, वित्रासिताः are frightened, रक्षोगणेश्वरः lord of demons, रावणो नाम Ravana by name.
explanation: O Sita I am called Ravana, the lord of demons by whom all the worlds of demons, snakes and gods are frightened.

shloka_text: त्वां तु काञ्चनवर्णाभां दृष्ट्वा कौशेयवासिनीम्। रतिं स्वकेषु दारेषु नाधिगच्छाम्यनिन्दिते।।3.47.27।।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu kāñcanavarṇābhāṃ dṛṣṭvā kauśeyavāsinīm| ratiṃ svakeṣu dāreṣu nādhigacchāmyanindite
translation: अनिन्दिते O flawless lady, काञ्चनवर्णाभाम् of golden complexion, कौशेयवासिनीम् clad in silk, त्वाम् you, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, स्वकेषु my own, दारेषु wives, रतिम् love, नाधिगच्छामि do not feel.
explanation: O flawless beauty of golden complexion seeing you clad in silk, I am not inclined to show any interest in my own wives.

shloka_text: बह्वीनामुत्तमस्त्रीणामाहृतानामितस्ततः। सर्वासामेव भद्रं ते ममाग्रमहिषी भव।।3.47.28।।
transliteration: bahvīnāmuttamastrīṇāmāhṛtānāmitastataḥ| sarvāsāmeva bhadraṃ te mamāgramahiṣī bhava
translation: इतस्तत: from various places, आहृतानाम् won over, बह्वीनाम् of many women, सर्वासामेव of all of them, उत्तमस्त्रीणाम् of the best of women, मम myself, अग्रमहिषी chief queen, भव be, ते भद्रम् be blessed.
explanation: You will be the chief queen among the best of women I have won in wars. Be blessed.

shloka_text: लङ्कानाम समुद्रस्य मम मध्ये महापुरी। सागरेण परिक्षिस्ता निविष्टा नगमूर्धनि।।3.47.29।।
transliteration: laṅkānāma samudrasya mama madhye mahāpurī| sāgareṇa parikṣistā niviṣṭā nagamūrdhani
translation: लङ्का नाम by name Lanka, मम my, महापुरी great city, समुद्रस्य of the sea, मध्ये in the  middle, सागरेण by sea, परिक्षिप्ता surrounded, नगमूर्धनि on the peak of a mountain, निविष्टा it is situated.
explanation: My great city  called Lanka is on the peak of a mountain surrounded by, and in the middle of, the sea.

shloka_text: तत्र सीते मया सार्धं वनेषु विहरिष्यसि। न चास्यारण्यवासस्य स्पृहयिष्यसि भामिनि।।3.47.30।।
transliteration: tatra sīte mayā sārdhaṃ vaneṣu vihariṣyasi| na cāsyāraṇyavāsasya spṛhayiṣyasi bhāmini
translation: सीते O Sita, तत्र there, मया सार्धम् with me, वनेषु in the gardens, विहरिष्यसि can stroll with pleasure, भामिनि O beautiful woman, अस्य of this, अरण्यस्य वासस्य living in the forest, न च स्पृहयिष्यसि will not like.
explanation: O Sita, you can stroll with me in my pleasuregardens. O  beautiful lady, you will not like living in the forest (thereafter).

shloka_text: पञ्च दास्यस्सहस्राणि सर्वाभरणभूषिताः। सीते परिचरिष्यन्ति भार्या भवसि मे यदि।।3.47.31।।
transliteration: pañca dāsyassahasrāṇi sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ| sīte paricariṣyanti bhāryā bhavasi me yadi
translation: सीते Sita, मे my, भार्या wife, भवसि यदि if you become so, सर्वाभरणभूषिताः adorned with all kinds of ornaments, सहस्राणि thousands, पञ्च five, दास्यः female attendants, परिचरिष्यन्ति they will serve you.
explanation: O Sita  if you become my wife, five thousand female attendants adorned with all ornaments will attend on you.

shloka_text: रावणेनैवमुक्ता तु कुपिता जनकात्मजा। प्रत्युवाचानवद्याङ्गी तमनादृत्य राक्षसम्।।3.47.32।।
transliteration: rāvaṇenaivamuktā tu kupitā janakātmajā| pratyuvācānavadyāṅgī tamanādṛtya rākṣasam
translation: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् like that, उक्ता having been told, अनवद्याङ्गी a lady of blemishless limbs, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter(Janaki), कुपिता in rage, तम् that, राक्षसम् demon, अनादृत्य without caring, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: Thus addressed by Ravana, Janaki, a lady of blemishless limbs, got enraged and replied without caring for the demon:

shloka_text: महागिरिमिवाकम्प्यं महेन्द्रसदृशं पतिम्। महोदधिमिवाक्षोभ्यमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.33।।
transliteration: mahāgirimivākampyaṃ mahendrasadṛśaṃ patim| mahodadhimivākṣobhyamahaṃ rāmamanuvratā
translation: महागिरिमिव like a huge mountain, अकम्प्यम् unshakeable, महेन्द्रसदृशम् equal to great Indra, महोदधिमिव like a mighty sea, अक्षोभ्यम् imperturbable, पतिम् husband, रामम् Rama, अहम् I, अनुव्रता faithful follower.
explanation: I am devoted to Rama, my husband, who is unshakeable like a huge mountain, is comparable to lord Indra and is imperturbable like the mighty ocean.

shloka_text: सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नं न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डलम्। सत्यसन्धं महाभागमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.34।।
transliteration: sarvalakṣaṇasampannaṃ nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalam| satyasandhaṃ mahābhāgamahaṃ rāmamanuvratā
translation: अहम् I am, सर्वलक्षणसम्पन्नम् endowed with all excellences, न्यग्रोधपरिमण्डलम् a refuge like a spreading banyan tree, सत्यसन्धम् devoted to truth, महाभागम् venerable, रामम् Rama, अनुव्रता a loyal wife.
explanation: I am the loyal wife of venerable Rama who is endowed with all excellences, a refuge to all like  a spreading banyan tree, and a votary of truth.

shloka_text: महाबाहुं महोरस्कं सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम्। नृसिंहं सिंहसङ्काशमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.35।।
transliteration: mahābāhuṃ mahoraskaṃ siṃhavikrāntagāminam| nṛsiṃhaṃ siṃhasaṅkāśamahaṃ rāmamanuvratā
translation: अहम् I am, महाबाहुम् longarmed hero, महोरस्कम् broadchested, सिंहविक्रान्तगामिनम् takes strides like an advancing lion, नृसिंहम् like a lion among men, सिंहसङ्काशम् invincible  like lion, रामम् Rama, अनुव्रता faithful wife.
explanation: I am the faithful wife of the longarmed, broadchested  Rama,  a lion among men. His gait is the gait of an advancing, invincible lion.

shloka_text: पूर्णचन्द्राननं रामं राजवत्सं जितेन्द्रियम्। पृथुकीर्तिं महात्मानमहं राममनुव्रता।।3.47.36।।
transliteration: pūrṇacandrānanaṃ rāmaṃ rājavatsaṃ jitendriyam| pṛthukīrtiṃ mahātmānamahaṃ rāmamanuvratā
translation: अहम् I am, पुर्णचन्द्राननम् face like the full Moon, राजवत्सम् son of a king, जितेन्द्रियम्  who has conquered his senses, पृथुकीर्तिम् whose fame is widespread, महात्मानम् great self, रामम् Rama, अनुव्रता devoted wife.
explanation: I am the devoted wife of great Rama, whose face is like a fullmoon, who is the son of a king, who has conquered his senses and whose fame is widespread (on earth).

shloka_text: त्वं पुनर्जम्बुकस्सिंहीं मामिच्छसि सुदुर्लभाम्। नाहं शक्या त्वया स्प्रष्टुमादित्यस्य प्रभा यथा।।3.47.37।।
transliteration: tvaṃ punarjambukassiṃhīṃ māmicchasi sudurlabhām| nāhaṃ śakyā tvayā spraṣṭumādityasya prabhā yathā
translation: जम्बुकः jackal, त्वं पुनः you are, सुदुर्लभाम् most difficult to have, सिंहीम् a lioness, माम् me, इच्छसि you are desiring, आदित्यस्य like the Sun's, प्रभा यथा radiance, अहम् I am, त्वया by you, स्प्रष्टुम् even to touch, न शक्या not possible.
explanation: You are a jackal, and you want a lioness like me who is difficult to win. I am like the Sun's radiance whom you cannot even touch.

shloka_text: पादपान्काञ्चनान्नूनं बहून्पश्यसि मन्दभाक्। राघपस्य प्रियां भार्यां यस्त्वमिच्छसि रावण।।3.47.38।।
transliteration: pādapānkāñcanānnūnaṃ bahūnpaśyasi mandabhāk| rāghapasya priyāṃ bhāryāṃ yastvamicchasi rāvaṇa
translation: रावण O Ravana, यः one who, त्वम् you, राघवस्य Rama's, प्रियाम् dear, भार्याम् wife, इच्छसि you want, मन्दभाक् unfortunate, नूनम् certainly, काञ्चनान् golden, पादपान् trees, पश्यसि you will see.
explanation: O luckless Ravana  you want the beloved wife of Rama.You will, for sure, see golden trees. (which those close to death do).

shloka_text: क्षुधितस्य हि सिंहस्य मृगशत्रोस्तरस्विनः। आशीविषस्य मुखाद्दंष्ट्रामादातुमिच्छसि।।3.47.39।।
transliteration: kṣudhitasya hi siṃhasya mṛgaśatrostarasvinaḥ| āśīviṣasya mukhāddaṃṣṭrāmādātumicchasi
translation: मृगशत्रोः enemy of the deer, तरस्विनः of the powerful, क्षुधितस्य of a hungry, सिंहस्य lion's, आशीविषस्य of a poisonous snake, मुखात् from the mouth, दंष्ट्राम् teeth, आदातुम् to seize, इच्छसि intending.
explanation: You are seeking to pull the teeth from  the mouth of a hungry and powerful lion who is considered the enemy of the deer(which you are). You intend to pull the fang of a poisonous snake.

shloka_text: मन्दरं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं पाणिना हर्तुमिच्छसि। कालकूटं विषं पीत्वा स्वस्तिमान्गन्तुमिच्छसि।।3.47.40।।
transliteration: mandaraṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ pāṇinā hartumicchasi| kālakūṭaṃ viṣaṃ pītvā svastimāngantumicchasi
translation: पर्वतश्रेष्ठम् greatest of the mountains, मन्दरम् Mandara, पाणिना with a hand, हर्तुम् to carry, इच्छसि want, कालकूटं विषम् deadly poison (produced from the churning of the ocean), पीत्वा after drinking, स्वस्तिमान् safely, गन्तुम् to go, इच्छसि wishing.
explanation: You are trying to carry the greatest of mountains, the Mandara, with one hand. You are wishing to go safe after drinking deadly poison (produced from the churning of the ocean).

shloka_text: अक्षि सूच्या प्रमृजसि जिह्वया लेक्षि च क्षुरम्। राघवस्य प्रियां भार्यां योऽधिगन्तुं त्वमिच्छसि।।3.47.41।।
transliteration: akṣi sūcyā pramṛjasi jihvayā lekṣi ca kṣuram| rāghavasya priyāṃ bhāryāṃ yo'dhigantuṃ tvamicchasi
translation: यः he who, त्वम् you, राघवस्य प्रियाम् dear to Rama, भार्याम् wife, अधिगन्तुम् violate, इच्छसि desiring to, सूच्या by needle, अक्षि eyes, प्रमृजसि rubbing, जिह्वया by your tongue, क्षुरम् razor, लेक्षि licking.
explanation: You wish to violate the loving wife of Rama. You are rubbing your eyes with a needle and licking the razor with your tongue.

shloka_text: अवसज्य शिलां कण्ठे समुद्रं तर्तुमिच्छसि। सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ चोभौ पाणिभ्यां हर्तुमिच्छसि।।3.47.42।। यो रामस्य प्रियां भार्यां प्रधर्षयितुमिच्छसि।
transliteration: avasajya śilāṃ kaṇṭhe samudraṃ tartumicchasi| sūryācandramasau cobhau pāṇibhyāṃ hartumicchasi yo rāmasya priyāṃ bhāryāṃ pradharṣayitumicchasi|
translation: यः he who, रामस्य Rama's, प्रियाम् very dear, भार्याम् wife, प्रधर्षयितुम् assault, इच्छसि desiring, कण्ठे in the neck, शिलाम् stone, अवसज्य after girding round the neck, समुद्रम् sea, तर्तुम् cross, इच्छसि desiring, सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ Sun and Moon, उभौ both, पाणिभ्याम् with both hands, हर्तुम् to carry, इच्छसि desiring,
explanation: You want to assault Rama's dear wife. It is like girding a stone round the neck and trying to cross the sea.It is like intending to take the Sun and the Moon with both your hands.

shloka_text: अग्निं प्रज्वलितं दृष्ट्वा वस्त्रेणाहर्तुमिच्छसि।।3.47.43।। काल्याणवृत्तां रामस्य यो भार्यांहर्तुमिच्छसि।
transliteration: agniṃ prajvalitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vastreṇāhartumicchasi kālyāṇavṛttāṃ rāmasya yo bhāryāṃhartumicchasi|
translation: यः one who, रामस्य Rama's, कल्याणवृत्ताम् a woman of virtuous conduct, भार्याम् wife, हर्तुम् to seize, इच्छसि you intend to, प्रज्वलितम् blazing, अग्निम् fire, दृष्ट्वा after seeing that, वस्त्रेण by cloth, आहर्तुम् to hold, इच्छसि desiring.
explanation: You intend to assaut the wife of Rama, who is a lady of virtuous conduct. You wish to hold blazing fire in your cloth.

shloka_text: अयोमुखानां शूलानामग्रे चरितुमिच्छसि।।3.47.44।। रामस्य सदृशीं भार्यां योऽधिगन्तुं त्वमिच्छसि।
transliteration: ayomukhānāṃ śūlānāmagre caritumicchasi rāmasya sadṛśīṃ bhāryāṃ yo'dhigantuṃ tvamicchasi|
translation: यः one who, त्वम् you, रामस्य Rama's, सदृशीम् his another worthy form, भार्याम् wife, अधिगन्तुम् to acquire, इच्छसि wish, अयोमुखानाम् sharp ironheaded, शूलानाम् spears, अग्रे on the top, चरितुम् to walk on, इच्छसि want.
explanation: You want to acquire Rama's worthy wife. You wish to walk on sharp ironheaded spear.

shloka_text: यदन्तरं सिंहशृगालयोर्वने यदन्तरं स्यन्दिनिका समुद्रयोः। सुराग्र्य सौवीरकयोर्यदन्तरं तदन्तरं वै तव राघवस्य च।।3.47.45।।
transliteration: yadantaraṃ siṃhaśṛgālayorvane yadantaraṃ syandinikā samudrayoḥ| surāgrya sauvīrakayoryadantaraṃ tadantaraṃ vai tava rāghavasya ca
translation: वने in the forest, सिंहशृगालयोः between a lion and a jackal, यत् whatever, अन्तरम् difference, स्यन्दिनिकासमुद्रयोः between a ditch and a sea, यत् that, अन्तरम् difference, सुराग्र्य सौवीरकयोः best of wines and sour gruel, यत् whatever, अन्तरम् difference, तव your, राघवस्य च and Rama, तत् there, अन्तरम् difference.
explanation: The difference between you and Rama is the difference between a jackal and a lion in the forest, between a ditch and the sea, and between sour gruel and the best of wines.

shloka_text: यदन्तरं काञ्चनसीसलोहयोर्यदन्तरं चन्दनवारिपङ्कयोः। यदन्तरं हस्तिबिडालयोर्वने तदन्तरं दाशरथेस्तवैव च।।3.47.46।।
transliteration: yadantaraṃ kāñcanasīsalohayoryadantaraṃ candanavāripaṅkayoḥ| yadantaraṃ hastibiḍālayorvane tadantaraṃ dāśarathestavaiva ca
translation: काञ्चनसीसलोहयोः between gold and lead, यत् whatever, अन्तरम् difference, चन्दनवारिपङ्कयोः between sandal and slime, यत् whatever, अन्तरम् difference, हस्तिबिडालयोर्वने between the elephant and the cat in the forest, दाशरथेः of Dasaratha's son, तवैव च and yours, तत् that, अन्तरम् difference.
explanation: The difference between you and Rama is the difference  between gold and lead, sandal and slime, an elephant and a cat of the forest.

shloka_text: यदन्तरं वायसवैनतेययोर्यदन्तरं मद्गुमयूरयोरपि। यदन्तरं सारसगृध्रयोर्वने तदन्तरं दाशरथेस्तवैव च।।3.47.47।।
transliteration: yadantaraṃ vāyasavainateyayoryadantaraṃ madgumayūrayorapi| yadantaraṃ sārasagṛdhrayorvane tadantaraṃ dāśarathestavaiva ca
translation: वायसवैनतेययोः between a crow and and Garuda, यत् whatever, अन्तरम् difference, मद्गुमयूरयोरपि beween a watercrane and a peacock, यत् whatever, अन्तरम् difference, वने in the forest, सारसगृध्रयोः between a vulture and a swan, यत् that amount, अन्तरम् difference, दाशरथेः Dasaratha's son, तवैव च and you, तत् that, अन्तरम् difference.
explanation: The difference between you and Dasaratha's son is the difference between a crow and Garuda, a watercrane and a peacock, a vulture and a swan in the forest.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्सहस्राक्षसमप्रभावे रामे स्थिते कार्मुकबाणपाणौ। हृतापि तेहं न जरां गमिष्ये वज्रं यथा मक्षिकयावगीर्णम्।।3.47.48।।
transliteration: tasminsahasrākṣasamaprabhāve rāme sthite kārmukabāṇapāṇau| hṛtāpi tehaṃ na jarāṃ gamiṣye vajraṃ yathā makṣikayāvagīrṇam
translation: हृतापि even if I am abducted, अहम् I, सहस्राक्षसमप्रभावे a man equal in prowess to the thousandeyed Indra, कार्मुक बाणपाणौ armed with bow and arrows, तस्मिन् when he, रामे while Rama, स्थिते when he stands, मक्षिकया by fly, अवगीर्णम् gulped (presuming it to be a grain of  rice), वज्रं यथा like a diamond, ते to you, जरां न गमिष्ये will not be withered.
explanation: So long Rama, equal in prowess to the thousandeyed Indra stands with bow and arrows in hand, I will not, although abducted, wither away like a diamond gulped by an insect (fly).

shloka_text: इतीव तद्वाक्यमदुष्टभावा सुदुष्टमुक्त्वा रजनीचरं तम्। गात्रप्रकम्पाद्व्यथिता बभूव वातोद्धता सा कदलीव तन्वी।।3.47.49।।
transliteration: itīva tadvākyamaduṣṭabhāvā suduṣṭamuktvā rajanīcaraṃ tam| gātraprakampādvyathitā babhūva vātoddhatā sā kadalīva tanvī
translation: अदुष्टभावा pure in thought, तन्वी slim, सा that, सुदुष्टम् forcefully, तं रजनीचरम् nightwalker, तत् that, वाक्यम् words, इति thus, उक्त्वा said, गात्रप्रकम्पात् due to trembling of the body, वातोद्धता shaken by violent wind, कदलीव banana, व्यथिता distressed, बभूव became.
explanation: Having said thus to the wicked nightwalker Ravana, Sita, pure in thought remained  distressed.Her slender body started trembling like a banana plant becomes shaken by a violent wind.

shloka_text: तां वेपमानामुपलक्ष्य सीतां स रावणो मृत्युसमप्रभावः। कुलं बलं नाम च कर्म चात्मनः समाचचक्षे भयकारणार्थम्।।3.47.50।।
transliteration: tāṃ vepamānāmupalakṣya sītāṃ sa rāvaṇo mṛtyusamaprabhāvaḥ| kulaṃ balaṃ nāma ca karma cātmanaḥ samācacakṣe bhayakāraṇārtham
translation: मृत्युसमप्रभावः powerful like death, सः that, रावणः Ravana, वेपमानाम् trembling, ताम् she, उपलक्ष्य beholding, भयकारणार्थम् to create more fear, आत्मनः of himself, कुलम् clan, बलं च and strength, कर्म च deeds, समाचचक्षे gave an account of.
explanation: Beholding Sita who was trembling, Ravana, powerful like death, started telling about himself, his clan, his strength and his deeds to instil more fear in her. इत्तयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyseventh sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवं बृवन्त्यां सीतायां संरब्दः परुषं वचः। ललाटे भृकुटीं कृत्वा रावणः प्रत्युवाच ह।।3.48.1।।
transliteration: evaṃ bṛvantyāṃ sītāyāṃ saṃrabdaḥ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ| lalāṭe bhṛkuṭīṃ kṛtvā rāvaṇaḥ pratyuvāca ha
translation: सीतायाम् when Sita, एवम् in that way, बृवन्त्याम् as she spoke, रावणः Ravana, संरब्धः roused to anger, ललाटे forehead, भृकुटीम् knitted eyebrows, कृत्वा doing, परुषम् harsh, वचः words, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: Addressed thus by Sita, Ravana, his anger roused, knitted his eyebrows with a frown on his forehead and replied to her harshly:
comments: Ravana takes on his true form -- speaks of his glory -- Sita abuses Ravana in harsh words.

shloka_text: भ्राता वैश्रवणस्याहं सापत्न्यो वरवर्णिनि। रावणो नाम भद्रं ते दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान्।।3.48.2।।
transliteration: bhrātā vaiśravaṇasyāhaṃ sāpatnyo varavarṇini| rāvaṇo nāma bhadraṃ te daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān
translation: वरवर्णिनि most beautiful woman, अहम् I, वैश्रवणस्य of Kubera's, सापत्न्यः stepmother's son, भ्राता brother, दशग्रीवः ten headed, प्रतापवान् powerful, रावणो नाम called Ravana, ते to you, भद्रम् be pleased.
explanation: O paragon of beauty  I am the halfbrother of Kubera, born of his stepmother. I am known as the tenheaded, powerful Ravana. Be blessed

shloka_text: यस्य देवास्सगन्धर्वाः पिशाचपतगोरगाः। विद्रवन्ति भयाद्भीता मृत्योरिव सदा प्रजाः।।3.48.3।।
transliteration: yasya devāssagandharvāḥ piśācapatagoragāḥ| vidravanti bhayādbhītā mṛtyoriva sadā prajāḥ
translation: प्रजाः people, मृत्योरिव like death, यस्य whose, भयात् out of fear, भीताः scared of, सगन्धर्वाः including gandharvas, देवाः gods, पिशाचपतगोरगा: evil spirits, birds and serpents, विद्रवन्ति run away.
explanation: Just as people get scared of death, all (creatures) including gandharvas, gods, evil spirits, birds and snakes run away from me.

shloka_text: येन वैश्रवणो राजा द्वैमात्रः कारणान्तरे। द्वन्द्वमासादितः क्रोधाद्रणे विक्रम्य निर्जितः।।3.48.4।।
transliteration: yena vaiśravaṇo rājā dvaimātraḥ kāraṇāntare| dvandvamāsāditaḥ krodhādraṇe vikramya nirjitaḥ
translation: येन by whom, कारणान्तरे for some other reason, क्रोधात् in anger, द्वन्द्वम् duel, आसादितः took place, द्वैमात्रः stepmother, वैश्रवणः राजा king Vaisravana, रणे in war, विक्रम्य with my prowess, निर्जितः was defeated.
explanation: For some reason or other a duel took place between me and king Kubera. With my prowess, I defeated him in the duel.

shloka_text: यद्भयार्तः परित्यज्य स्वमधिष्ठानमृद्धिमत्। कैलासं पर्वतश्रेष्ठमध्यास्ते नरवाहनः।।3.48.5।।
transliteration: yadbhayārtaḥ parityajya svamadhiṣṭhānamṛddhimat| kailāsaṃ parvataśreṣṭhamadhyāste naravāhanaḥ
translation: नरवाहनः Kubera (having a human being as his carrier), यद्भयार्तः due to fear of whom, ऋद्धिमत् prosperous, स्वम् his own, अधिष्ठानम् place of residence, परित्यज्य giving up, पर्वतश्रेष्ठम् mighty mountain, कैलासम् Kailasa, अध्यास्ते  residing.
explanation: Out of fear for me, Kubera is residing on the mighty mount Kailasa, leaving his own earlier prosperous place of residence.

shloka_text: यस्य तत्पुष्पकं नाम विमानं कामगं शुभम्। वीर्यादेवार्जितं भद्रे येन यामि विहायसम्।।3.48.6।।
transliteration: yasya tatpuṣpakaṃ nāma vimānaṃ kāmagaṃ śubham| vīryādevārjitaṃ bhadre yena yāmi vihāyasam
translation: भद्रे O noble lady, यस्य whose, तत् that, पुष्पकं नाम by name Pushpaka, कामगम् goes where one desires, शुभम् auspicious, विमानम् chariot, वीर्यादेव by valour alone, आर्जितम् gained over, येन in which, विहायसम् sky, यामि I move about.
explanation: O noble lady  with my valour I gained over from Kubera the aerial chariot 'Pushpaka', which can go wherever one desires and in which I move about in the sky.

shloka_text: मम सञ्जातरोषस्य मुखं दृष्ट्वैव मैथिलि। विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्तास्सुराश्शक्रपुरोगमाः।।3.48.7।।
transliteration: mama sañjātaroṣasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvaiva maithili| vidravanti paritrastāssurāśśakrapurogamāḥ
translation: मैथिलि O Maithili, सञ्जातरोषस्य when I get angry, मम my, मुखम् face, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing alone, परित्रस्ताः frightened , शक्रपुरोगमाः led by Indra, सुराः gods, विद्रवन्ति run away.
explanation: O Princess from Mithila, seeing my angry face  even gods led by Indra take to their heels in fear.

shloka_text: यत्र तिष्ठाम्यहं तत्र मारुतो वाति शङ्कितः। तीव्रांशुश्शिशिरांशुश्च भयात्सम्पद्यते रविः।।3.48.8।।
transliteration: yatra tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ tatra māruto vāti śaṅkitaḥ| tīvrāṃśuśśiśirāṃśuśca bhayātsampadyate raviḥ
translation: अहम् I am, यत्र wherever, तिष्ठामि stay, तत्र there, मारुतः the Windgod, शङ्कितः hesitantly, वाति blows, तीव्रांशुः the Sun with scorching rays, रविः च even Sun, भयात् in fear, शिशिरांशुः Moon of cool radiance, सम्पद्यते discharges duties.
explanation: Wherever I am, the Windgod blows with hesitation. So are the Sun and the Moon afraid of me. Afraid of me the Sun duly discharges his duties.

shloka_text: निष्कम्पपत्रास्तरवो नद्यश्च स्तिमितोदकाः। भवन्ति यत्र यत्राहं तिष्ठामि विचरामि च।।3.48.9।।
transliteration: niṣkampapatrāstaravo nadyaśca stimitodakāḥ| bhavanti yatra yatrāhaṃ tiṣṭhāmi vicarāmi ca
translation: अहम् I am, यत्र यत्र wherever, तिष्ठामि stay, विचरामि move about, उदकाः water, निष्कम्पपत्राः  with their leaves, तरवः trees, नद्यश्च the rivers also, स्तिमितोदकाः have still waters, भवन्ति   remain.
explanation: Wherever I stay or move about, the leaves of trees do not shake, and the waters in rivers remain still.

shloka_text: मम पारे समुद्रस्य लङ्का नाम पुरी शुभा। सम्पूर्णा राक्षसैर्घोरैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती।।3.48.10।।
transliteration: mama pāre samudrasya laṅkā nāma purī śubhā| sampūrṇā rākṣasairghorairyathendrasyāmarāvatī
translation: घोरैः by the terrific, राक्षसैः by demons, सम्पूर्णा filled with, लङ्का नाम known as Lanka, शुभा auspicious, इंद्रस्य Indra's, अमरावतीव like Amaravati, मम my, पुरी city, समुद्रस्य on these, पारे shore.
explanation: My city known as Lanka, teeming with terrific demons, is on the other side of the sea. It is  beautiful like the city of Indra's Amaravati.

shloka_text: प्राकारेण परिक्षिप्ता पाण्डुरेण विराजता। हेमकक्ष्या पुरी रम्या वैढूर्यमयतोरणा।।3.48.11।।
transliteration: prākāreṇa parikṣiptā pāṇḍureṇa virājatā| hemakakṣyā purī ramyā vaiḍhūryamayatoraṇā
translation: रम्या beautiful, पाण्डुरेण pale white, विराजता  shining , प्राकारेण by a ramparts, परिक्षिप्ता surrounded, हेमकक्ष्या interiors built of gold, वैढूर्यमयतोरणा entrance gates encrusted with vaidurya (cat's eye).
explanation: The beautiful city of Lanka  shines with its pale white ramparts and golden interiors. The entrance gates are encrusted with vaidurya (cat'seye).

shloka_text: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधा तूर्यनादविनादिता। सर्वकालफलैर्वृक्षैस्सङ्कुलोद्द्यानशोभिता।।3.48.12।।
transliteration: hastyaśvarathasambādhā tūryanādavināditā| sarvakālaphalairvṛkṣaissaṅkuloddyānaśobhitā
translation: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधा crowded with elephants, horses, and chariots, तूर्यनादविनादिता resounding with trumpets, सर्वकालफलैः yielding fruits in all seasons, वृक्षैः by  trees, सङ्कुलोद्यानशोभिता looks splendid with delightful pleasuregardens.
explanation: It is crowded with elephants, horses and chariots. It resounds with the music of trumpets. The trees in the delightful pleasuregardens yield fruits in all seasons.

shloka_text: तत्र त्वं वसती सीते राजपुत्रि मया सह। न स्मरिष्यसि नारीणां मानुषीणां मनस्विनि।।3.48.13।।
transliteration: tatra tvaṃ vasatī sīte rājaputri mayā saha| na smariṣyasi nārīṇāṃ mānuṣīṇāṃ manasvini
translation: राजपुत्रि princess, मनस्विनि highminded, सीते Sita, तत्र there, मया सह along with me, वसती  while residing, मानुषीणाम् of human beings, नारीणाम् of women, न स्मरिष्यसि you will not think of.
explanation: O highminded princess, O Sita while living with me, you will not even think of other women.

shloka_text: भुञ्जाना मानुषान्भोगान्दिव्यांश्च वरवर्णिनि। न स्मरिष्यसि रामस्य मानुषस्य गतायुषः।।3.48.14।।
transliteration: bhuñjānā mānuṣānbhogāndivyāṃśca varavarṇini| na smariṣyasi rāmasya mānuṣasya gatāyuṣaḥ
translation: वरवर्णिनि blessed lady of excellant complexion, मानुषान् mortals, भोगान् pleasures, दिव्यांश्च  wonderful as well as divine, भुञ्जाना enjoying, मानुषस्य mortals, गतायुषः of a short lifespan, रामस्य Rama's, न स्मरिष्यिसि not think of.
explanation: O blessed lady of fine complexion, while enjoying both human and heavenly  pleasures with me there, you will not remember Rama who is a mortal of short lifespan.

shloka_text: स्थापयित्वा प्रियं पुत्रं राज्ञा दशरथेन यः। मन्दवीर्यस्सुतो ज्येष्ठस्ततः प्रस्थापितो वनम्।।3.48.15।।
transliteration: sthāpayitvā priyaṃ putraṃ rājñā daśarathena yaḥ| mandavīryassuto jyeṣṭhastataḥ prasthāpito vanam
translation: राज्ञा by the king, दशरथेन Dasaratha's, प्रियम् dear, पुत्रम्  son (Bharata), स्थापयित्वा consecrating, ततः then, मन्दवीर्यः weakling, ज्येष्ठः सुतः eldest son, यः one who is, वनम् forest, प्रस्थापितः sent away.
explanation: Considering the eldest son a weakling, king Dasaratha has sent him away to the forest so that he could consecrate his dear son(Bharata).

shloka_text: तेन किं भ्रष्टराज्येन रामेण गतचेतसा। करिष्यसि विशालाक्षि तापसेन तपस्विना।।3.48.16।।
transliteration: tena kiṃ bhraṣṭarājyena rāmeṇa gatacetasā| kariṣyasi viśālākṣi tāpasena tapasvinā
translation: विशालाक्षि O largeeyed, भ्रष्टराज्येन  dislodged from the kingdom, गतचेतसा lost the capacity to think, तापसेन ascetic, तपस्विना by a pitiable man, तेन रामेण such Rama, किं करिष्यसि what can he do (for you) ?
explanation: O largeeyed Sita dislodged from the kingdom, Rama has lost his capacity to think. He is doing penance, assuming an ascetic role. What can he do (for you)?

shloka_text: सर्वराक्षसभर्तारं कामात्स्वयमिहागतम्। न मन्मथशराविष्टं प्रत्याख्यातुं त्वमर्हसि।।3.48.17।।
transliteration: sarvarākṣasabhartāraṃ kāmātsvayamihāgatam| na manmathaśarāviṣṭaṃ pratyākhyātuṃ tvamarhasi
translation: कामात् owing to passion, स्वयम् I myself, इह here, आगतम् came, मन्मथशराविष्टम्   overcome by the arrows of the god of love, सर्वराक्षसभर्तारम् lord of all demons, त्वम्  you, प्रत्याख्यातुम् to reject, न अर्हसि not proper.
explanation: I am lord of all the demons. You should not reject me I am here (only because I am) overcome by the arrows of the god of love.

shloka_text: प्रत्याख्याय हि मां भीरु परितापं गमिष्यसि। चरणेनाभिहत्येव पुरूरवसमूर्वशी।।3.48.18।।
transliteration: pratyākhyāya hi māṃ bhīru paritāpaṃ gamiṣyasi| caraṇenābhihatyeva purūravasamūrvaśī
translation: भीरु O timid lady, माम् me, प्रत्याख्याय after you reject, पुरूरवसम् Pururava, चरणेन by the feet, अभिहत्य kicking, ऊर्वशीव like Urvasi, परितापम् regret, गमिष्यसि will you experience later.
explanation: O timid lady if you reject me, you will regret like Urvasi who kicked Pururava and regretted later.

shloka_text: अङ्गुल्या न समो रामो मम युद्धे स मानुषः। तव भाग्येन सम्प्राप्तं भजस्व वरवर्णिनि।।3.48.19।।
transliteration: aṅgulyā na samo rāmo mama yuddhe sa mānuṣaḥ| tava bhāgyena samprāptaṃ bhajasva varavarṇini
translation: वरवर्णिनि O lady of fine complexion, मानुषः a mere mortal, सः रामः that Rama, युद्धे in war, मम for me, अङ्गुल्या with my finger, समः equal, न not, तव your, भाग्येन by your luck, सम्प्राप्तम्  have I come, भजस्व take refuge.
explanation: O lady of fine complexion, Rama is a (mere) mortal. In war he is no match (even) for my finger. It is your good fortune that you have got me here. Take refuge in me.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही क्रुद्धा संरक्तलोचना। अब्रवीत्परुषं वाक्यं रहिते राक्षसाधिपम्।।3.48.20।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu vaidehī kruddhā saṃraktalocanā| abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ rahite rākṣasādhipam
translation: एवम् that way, उक्ता told, वैदेही Vaidehi, क्रुद्धा enraged, संरक्तलोचना eyes turned red, रहिते in that solitary place, राक्षसाधिपम् chief of the demons, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत्  said.
explanation: Thus addressed, Sita was enraged and her eyes turned red. She replied in harsh words to the chief of the demons in that solitary place:.

shloka_text: कथं वैश्रवणं देवं सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम्। भ्रातरं व्यपदिश्य त्वमशुभं कर्तुमिच्छसि।।3.48.21।।
transliteration: kathaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ devaṃ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtam| bhrātaraṃ vyapadiśya tvamaśubhaṃ kartumicchasi
translation: सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम् worshipped by all beings, देवम् god, वैश्रवणम्  Kubera, भ्रातरम् brother, व्यपदिश्य addressing him, त्वम् you, अशुभम् inauspicious deed, कर्तुम् to do, कथम् how come, इच्छसि you desire.
explanation: Why do you wish to do something inauspicious by calling Lord Kubera who is worshipped by all beings your brother ?

shloka_text: अवश्यं विनशिष्यन्ति सर्वे रावण राक्षसाः। येषां त्वं कर्कशो राजा दुर्बुद्धिरजितेन्द्रियः।।3.48.22।।
transliteration: avaśyaṃ vinaśiṣyanti sarve rāvaṇa rākṣasāḥ| yeṣāṃ tvaṃ karkaśo rājā durbuddhirajitendriyaḥ
translation: रावण O Ravana, कर्कशः cruel, दुर्बुद्धि: evilminded, अजितेन्द्रियः having no control over the senses, त्वम्  you, येषाम् of whom, राजा king, सर्वे all of them, राक्षसाः demons, अवश्यम् certainly, विनशिष्यन्ति will be destroyed.
explanation: O Ravana ,you are cruel and evilminded. You have no control over your senses. (And yet) you are the ruler of your breed. Surely they are going to be destroyed.

shloka_text: अपहृत्य शचीं भार्यां शक्यमिन्द्रस्य जीवितुम्। न च रामस्य भार्यां मामपनीयास्ति जीवितम्।।3.48.23।।
transliteration: apahṛtya śacīṃ bhāryāṃ śakyamindrasya jīvitum| na ca rāmasya bhāryāṃ māmapanīyāsti jīvitam
translation: इन्द्रस्य Indra's, भार्याम् wife, शची Sachi, अपहृत्य after abducting, जीवितुम् to live, शक्यम् may be possible, रामस्य Rama's, भार्याम् wife, माम् me, अपनीय after carrying away, जीवितम् life, नास्ति not there.
explanation: It may be possible (for some one) to live after abducting Indra's wife, Sachi, but it is not possible for any one to live after kidnapping the wife of Rama.

shloka_text: जीवेच्चिरं वज्रधरस्य हस्ताच्छचीं प्रधृष्याप्रतिरूपरूपाम्। न मादृशीं राक्षस दूशयित्वा पीतामृतस्यापि तवास्ति मोक्षः।।3.48.24।।
transliteration: jīvecciraṃ vajradharasya hastācchacīṃ pradhṛṣyāpratirūparūpām| na mādṛśīṃ rākṣasa dūśayitvā pītāmṛtasyāpi tavāsti mokṣaḥ
translation: राक्षस demon, अप्रातिरूपरूपाम् most beautiful lady, शचीम् Sachi, वज्रधरस्य wielder of the thunderbolt, Indra's, हस्ताम् from the hands, प्रधृष्य after snatching, चिरम् long, जीवेत्  may live, मादृशीम् one like me, दूषयित्वा after assualting, पीतामृतस्यापि even after drinking  nectar, तव your, मोक्षः release from death, न not possible.
explanation: O demon, you may live long after forcibly snatching the most beautiful Sachi, from the hands of Indra, the wielder of the thunderbolt, but after abusing a woman like me, you will not be released from death even if you drink nectar. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyeighty sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवाम्। हस्ते हस्तं समाहत्य चकार सुमहद्वपुः।।3.49.1।।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavām| haste hastaṃ samāhatya cakāra sumahadvapuḥ
translation: प्रतापवाम् powerful, दशग्रीवः tenheaded Ravana, सीतायाः Sita's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हस्ते by the palm, हस्तम् palm, समाहत्य  striking, सुमहत् very great, वपुः body, चकार  assumed.
explanation: On hearing the Sita's words, the powerful Ravana struck his palms one over the other and assumed a huge form (original figure).
comments: Ravana carries away Sita in his chariot-- she screams and wails aloud -- implores the animals, trees, mountains and rivers to tell Rama about her.

shloka_text: स मैथिलीं पुनर्वाक्यं बभाषे च ततो भृशम्। नोन्मत्तया श्रुतौ मन्ये मम वीर्यपराक्रमौ।।3.49.2।।
transliteration: sa maithilīṃ punarvākyaṃ babhāṣe ca tato bhṛśam| nonmattayā śrutau manye mama vīryaparākramau
translation: सः Ravana, मैथिलीम् Maithili, पुनः again, वाक्यम् these words, भृशम् very much, बभाषे said, उन्मत्तया by madness, मम my, वीर्यपराक्रमौ strength and valour, न श्रुतौ not heard, मन्ये I suppose.
explanation: Ravana again said to that princess from Mithila, I suppose you are too insane to disregard my strength and valour.

shloka_text: उद्वहेयं भुजाभ्यां तु मेदिनीमम्बरे स्थितः। आपिबेयं समुद्रं च हन्यां मृत्युं रणे स्थितः।।3.49.3।।
transliteration: udvaheyaṃ bhujābhyāṃ tu medinīmambare sthitaḥ| āpibeyaṃ samudraṃ ca hanyāṃ mṛtyuṃ raṇe sthitaḥ
translation: अम्बरे in the sky, स्थितः standing, भुजाभ्याम् with my arms, मेदिनीम् the earth, उद्वहेयम् lift, समुद्रं च and oceans, आपिबेयम् can drink away, रणे in war, स्थितः standing, मृत्युम् for death, हन्याम् can cause death.
explanation: Standing in the sky, I can  lift the earth with my arms.  I can drink the oceans. I can kill even the god of death in a combat.

shloka_text: अर्कं ऱुन्ध्यां शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विभिन्द्या हि महीतलम्। कामरूपिणमुन्मत्ते पश्य मां कामदं पतिम्।।3.49.4।।
transliteration: arkaṃ ṟundhyāṃ śaraistīkṣṇairvibhindyā hi mahītalam| kāmarūpiṇamunmatte paśya māṃ kāmadaṃ patim
translation: अर्कम् Sun, ऱुन्ध्याम् can obstruct, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, शरैः arrows, महीतलम् earth, विभिन्द्याम् I can shatter, उन्मत्ते O mad woman, कामदम् who can fulfil desires, पतिम् husband, कामरूपिणम् who can assume any form at will, माम् me, पश्य see.
explanation: I can obstruct the Sun and shatter the earth with my sharp arrows. O mad woman I am a husband who can fulfil your desires, and can assume any form at my own free will. Look at me.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तवतस्तस्य सूर्यकल्पे शिखिप्रभे। क्रुद्धस्य हरिपर्यन्ते रक्ते नेत्रे बभूवतुः।।3.49.5।।
transliteration: evamuktavatastasya sūryakalpe śikhiprabhe| kruddhasya hariparyante rakte netre babhūvatuḥ
translation: एवम् in that manner, उक्तवतः as he spoke, क्रुद्धस्य  full of anger, तस्य his, सूर्यकल्पे almost like the Sun, शिखिप्रभे  radiance of flaming fire, हरिपर्यन्ते ambercoloured at the corners, नेत्रे eyes, रक्ते red, बभुवतुः became.
explanation: As Ravana exploded in anger, his ambercoloured eyes turned red like the radiance of the flaming fire, and almost as bright as the Sun.

shloka_text: सद्यस्सौम्यं परित्यज्य भिक्षुरूपं स रावणः। स्वं रूपं कालरूपाभं भेजे वैश्रवणानुजः।।3.49.6।।
transliteration: sadyassaumyaṃ parityajya bhikṣurūpaṃ sa rāvaṇaḥ| svaṃ rūpaṃ kālarūpābhaṃ bheje vaiśravaṇānujaḥ
translation: वैश्रवणानुजः younger brother of Kubera, सद्यः instantly, सौम्यम् gentle, भिक्षुरूपम् form of a  mendicant, परित्यज्य shed, स्वम् his, कालरूपाभम् the form of the god of death, रूपम् figure, भेजे assumed.
explanation: Ravana, brother of Kubera, shed the gentle figure of a mendicant and assumed the form of the god of death.

shloka_text: संरक्तनयनश्श्रीमांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः। क्रोधेन महताविष्टो नीलजीमूतसन्निभः।।3.49.7।। दशास्यः कार्मुकी बाणी बभूव क्षणदाचरः।
transliteration: saṃraktanayanaśśrīmāṃstaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaḥ| krodhena mahatāviṣṭo nīlajīmūtasannibhaḥ daśāsyaḥ kārmukī bāṇī babhūva kṣaṇadācaraḥ|
translation: महता with intense, क्रोधेन with anger, आविष्टः overcome, संरक्तनयनः with reddened eyes, श्रीमान् shining, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः  glittering golden ornaments, नीलजीमूतसन्निभः looking like a dark cloud, दशास्यः the tenfaced Ravana, कार्मुकी with bow, बाणी with arrows, क्षणदाचरः nightranger, बभूव became.
explanation: Overcome by intense anger, Ravana's eyes reddened. The nightranger, stood armed with bow and arrows and shining with glittering gold ornaments, appeared like a black cloud.

shloka_text: स परिव्राजकच्छद्म महाकायो विहाय तत्।।3.49.8।। प्रतिपद्य स्वकं रूपं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। संरक्तनयनः क्रोधाज्जीमूतनिचयप्रभः।।3.49.9।। रक्ताम्बरधरस्तस्थौ स्त्रीरत्नं प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम्।
transliteration: sa parivrājakacchadma mahākāyo vihāya tat pratipadya svakaṃ rūpaṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ| saṃraktanayanaḥ krodhājjīmūtanicayaprabhaḥ raktāmbaradharastasthau strīratnaṃ prekṣya maithilīm|
translation: राक्षसाधिपः chief of the demons, सः रावणः that Ravana, तत् that, परिव्राजकच्छद्म figure of a mendicant, विहाय shedding, स्वकम् his real, रूपम् form, प्रतिपद्य assuming, क्रोधात् in anger, संरक्त नयनः red eyes, जीमूतनिचयप्रभः radiating like layers of clouds, रक्ताम्बरधरः wearing red garments, स्त्रीरत्नम् gem of a woman, मैथिलीम् to Sita, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, तस्थौ stood in front.
explanation: Ravana, chief of the demons, shed the mendicant's form and assumed his real self. Clad in red garments, his eyes turned red in anger. Looking like layers of clouds, he stood in front of Sita, a gem among women.

shloka_text: स परिव्राजकच्छद्म महाकायो विहाय तत्।।3.49.8।। प्रतिपद्य स्वकं रूपं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। संरक्तनयनः क्रोधाज्जीमूतनिचयप्रभः।।3.49.9।। रक्ताम्बरधरस्तस्थौ स्त्रीरत्नं प्रेक्ष्य मैथिलीम्।
transliteration: sa parivrājakacchadma mahākāyo vihāya tat pratipadya svakaṃ rūpaṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ| saṃraktanayanaḥ krodhājjīmūtanicayaprabhaḥ raktāmbaradharastasthau strīratnaṃ prekṣya maithilīm|
translation: राक्षसाधिपः chief of the demons, सः रावणः that Ravana, तत् that, परिव्राजकच्छद्म figure of a mendicant, विहाय shedding, स्वकम् his real, रूपम् form, प्रतिपद्य assuming, क्रोधात् in anger, संरक्त नयनः red eyes, जीमूतनिचयप्रभः radiating like layers of clouds, रक्ताम्बरधरः wearing red garments, स्त्रीरत्नम् gem of a woman, मैथिलीम् to Sita, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, तस्थौ stood in front.
explanation: Ravana, chief of the demons, shed the mendicant's form and assumed his real self. Clad in red garments, his eyes turned red in anger. Looking like layers of clouds, he stood in front of Sita, a gem among women.

shloka_text: स तामसितकेशान्तां भास्करस्य प्रभामिव।।3.49.10।। वसनाभरणोपेतां मैथिलीं रावणोऽब्रवीत्।
transliteration: sa tāmasitakeśāntāṃ bhāskarasya prabhāmiva vasanābharaṇopetāṃ maithilīṃ rāvaṇo'bravīt|
translation: सः that, रावणः Ravana, असितकेशान्ताम् a lady with shining black hair, भास्करस्य the Sun's, प्रभामिव like the radiance, वसनाभरणोपेताम् robed in the best of clothes and ornaments, मैथिलीम् to SIta, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Ravana said to the princess from Mithila, whose black hair was shining, who was luminous like the Sun and was clad in the best of clothes and ornaments.

shloka_text: त्रिषु लोकेषु विख्यातं यदि भर्तारमिच्छसि।।3.49.11।। मामाश्रय वरारोहे तवाहं सदृशः पतिः।
transliteration: triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ yadi bhartāramicchasi māmāśraya varārohe tavāhaṃ sadṛśaḥ patiḥ|
translation: वरारोहे O beautiful lady, त्रिषुलोकेषु in the three worlds, विख्यातम् famous, भर्तारम् husband, इच्छसि you desire, यदि so, माम् me, आश्रय take refuge in, अहम् I, तव your, सदृशः fit, पतिः husband.
explanation: O beautiful lady  if you desire a husband who is famous in the three worlds, take refuge in me. I am fit to be your husband.

shloka_text: मां भजस्व चिराय त्वमहं श्लाघ्यः प्रियस्तव।।3.49.12।। नैव चाहं क्वचिद्भद्रे करिष्ये तव विप्रियम्। त्यज्यतां मानुषे भावो मयि भावः प्रणीयताम्।।3.49.13।।
transliteration: māṃ bhajasva cirāya tvamahaṃ ślāghyaḥ priyastava naiva cāhaṃ kvacidbhadre kariṣye tava vipriyam| tyajyatāṃ mānuṣe bhāvo mayi bhāvaḥ praṇīyatām
translation: भद्रे O auspicious lady, चिराय for long, माम् me, भजस्व accept, अहम् I am, तव your, श्लाघ्यः praiseworthy, प्रियः (पतिः) husband, अहम् I am, क्वचित् at any time, तव your, विप्रियम् unpleasantness, न करिष्ये चwill not cause, मानुषे mortal , भावः your attachment, त्यज्यताम्  abandon, मयि in me, भावः inclination, प्रणीयताम् diverted.
explanation: I am your praiseworthy husband. I will not cause any unpleasantness to you at any time. Abandon on your inclination towards, a (mere) mortal. Divert your love to me.

shloka_text: मां भजस्व चिराय त्वमहं श्लाघ्यः प्रियस्तव।।3.49.12।। नैव चाहं क्वचिद्भद्रे करिष्ये तव विप्रियम्। त्यज्यतां मानुषे भावो मयि भावः प्रणीयताम्।।3.49.13।।
transliteration: māṃ bhajasva cirāya tvamahaṃ ślāghyaḥ priyastava naiva cāhaṃ kvacidbhadre kariṣye tava vipriyam| tyajyatāṃ mānuṣe bhāvo mayi bhāvaḥ praṇīyatām
translation: भद्रे O auspicious lady, चिराय for long, माम् me, भजस्व accept, अहम् I am, तव your, श्लाघ्यः praiseworthy, प्रियः (पतिः) husband, अहम् I am, क्वचित् at any time, तव your, विप्रियम् unpleasantness, न करिष्ये चwill not cause, मानुषे mortal , भावः your attachment, त्यज्यताम्  abandon, मयि in me, भावः inclination, प्रणीयताम् diverted.
explanation: I am your praiseworthy husband. I will not cause any unpleasantness to you at any time. Abandon on your inclination towards, a (mere) mortal. Divert your love to me.

shloka_text: राज्याच्च्युतमसिद्धार्थं रामं परिमितायुषम्। कैर्गुणैरनुरक्तासि मूढे पण्डितमानिनि।।3.49.14।। यः स्त्रिया वचनाद्राज्यं विहाय ससुहृज्जनम्। अस्मिन्व्यालानुचरिते वने वसति दुर्मतिः।।3.49.15।।
transliteration: rājyāccyutamasiddhārthaṃ rāmaṃ parimitāyuṣam| kairguṇairanuraktāsi mūḍhe paṇḍitamānini yaḥ striyā vacanādrājyaṃ vihāya sasuhṛjjanam| asminvyālānucarite vane vasati durmatiḥ
translation: मुढे O stupid woman, पण्डितमानिनि you think you are wise, दुर्मतिः wicked, यः he, स्त्रियाः woman's, वचनात् word, ससुहृज्जनम् including friends, राज्यम् kingdom, विहाय after leaving, व्यालानुचरिते  haunted by wild animals, अस्मिन् in this, वने in the forest, चरति moves, राज्यात् from the kingdom, च्युतम् banished, असिद्धार्थम् who has not accomplished any objective, परिमितायुषम् of limited life, रामम् Rama, कैः by what, गुणैः virtues, अनुरक्ता a attached, असि are you.
explanation: O stupid woman you think you are very wise. What is there in Rama so that you are attached to him ? He has left the kingdom and his kith and kin due to the words of a woman. He has not accomplished anything (in life). He has a limited life span and now lives in this forest haunted by wild animals.

shloka_text: राज्याच्च्युतमसिद्धार्थं रामं परिमितायुषम्। कैर्गुणैरनुरक्तासि मूढे पण्डितमानिनि।।3.49.14।। यः स्त्रिया वचनाद्राज्यं विहाय ससुहृज्जनम्। अस्मिन्व्यालानुचरिते वने वसति दुर्मतिः।।3.49.15।।
transliteration: rājyāccyutamasiddhārthaṃ rāmaṃ parimitāyuṣam| kairguṇairanuraktāsi mūḍhe paṇḍitamānini yaḥ striyā vacanādrājyaṃ vihāya sasuhṛjjanam| asminvyālānucarite vane vasati durmatiḥ
translation: मुढे O stupid woman, पण्डितमानिनि you think you are wise, दुर्मतिः wicked, यः he, स्त्रियाः woman's, वचनात् word, ससुहृज्जनम् including friends, राज्यम् kingdom, विहाय after leaving, व्यालानुचरिते  haunted by wild animals, अस्मिन् in this, वने in the forest, चरति moves, राज्यात् from the kingdom, च्युतम् banished, असिद्धार्थम् who has not accomplished any objective, परिमितायुषम् of limited life, रामम् Rama, कैः by what, गुणैः virtues, अनुरक्ता a attached, असि are you.
explanation: O stupid woman you think you are very wise. What is there in Rama so that you are attached to him ? He has left the kingdom and his kith and kin due to the words of a woman. He has not accomplished anything (in life). He has a limited life span and now lives in this forest haunted by wild animals.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा मैथिलीं वाक्यं प्रियार्हां प्रियवादिनीम्। अभिगम्य सुदुष्टात्मा राक्षसः काममोहितः।।3.49.16।। जग्राह रावणस्सीतां बुधः खे रोहिणीमिव।
transliteration: ityuktvā maithilīṃ vākyaṃ priyārhāṃ priyavādinīm| abhigamya suduṣṭātmā rākṣasaḥ kāmamohitaḥ jagrāha rāvaṇassītāṃ budhaḥ khe rohiṇīmiva|
translation: सुदुष्टात्मा evilminded, काममोहितः infatuated, राक्षसः demon, रावणः Ravana, प्रियार्हाम् worthy of pity, प्रियवादिनीम् speaks pleasing words, मैथिलीम् Maithili, इति thus, उक्त्वा said, अभिगम्य going towards, खे बुधः Mercury in the sky, रोहिणीमिव like Rohini, सीताम् Sita, जग्राह caught hold of.
explanation: Just as Budha (planet Mercury) catches Rohini (a cluster of five stars) in the sky, the evilminded, infatuated Ravana advanced towards the pitiable, pleasing Sita and caught hold of her.

shloka_text: वामेन सीतां पद्माक्षीं मूर्धजेषु करेण सः।।3.49.17।। ऊर्वोस्तु दक्षिणेनैव परिजग्राह पाणिना।
transliteration: vāmena sītāṃ padmākṣīṃ mūrdhajeṣu kareṇa saḥ ūrvostu dakṣiṇenaiva parijagrāha pāṇinā|
translation: सः that Ravana, पद्माक्षीम् lotuseyed, सीताम् Sita, वामेन करेण with his left hand, मूर्धजेषु  holding her hair, दक्षिणेन पाणिना with right hand, ऊर्वोः under her thighs, प्रतिजग्राह held her.
explanation: Ravana seized with his left hand the lotuseyed Sita by the hair and lifted her by the thighs with his right hand.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा मृत्युसङ्काशं तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रं महाभुजम्।।3.49.18।। प्राद्रवन्गिरिसङ्काशं भयार्ता वनदेवताः।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyusaṅkāśaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraṃ mahābhujam prādravangirisaṅkāśaṃ bhayārtā vanadevatāḥ|
translation: मृत्युसङ्काशम् like the god of death, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रम् with sharp teeth, महाभुजम् mightyarmed, गिरिसङ्काशम्  like a mountain, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, वनदेवताः deities of the forest, भयार्ताः out of fear, प्राद्रवन् fled.
explanation: The sylvan deities fled out of fear on seeing the dreadful appearance of Ravana who had sharp teeth and mighty arms. He looked like a mountain, a veritable god of death.

shloka_text: स च मायामयो दिव्यः खरयुक्तः खरस्वनः।।3.49.19।। प्रत्यदृश्यत हेमाङ्गो रावणस्य महारथः।
transliteration: sa ca māyāmayo divyaḥ kharayuktaḥ kharasvanaḥ pratyadṛśyata hemāṅgo rāvaṇasya mahārathaḥ|
translation: मायामयः illusive form, दिव्यः divine, खरयुक्तः harnessed by donkeys, खरस्वनः brayins of  asses, हेमाङ्गः goldenlimbed, रावणस्य Ravana's, सः महारथः that great chariot, प्रत्यदृश्यत apeared.
explanation: There arrived the great  golden chariot of Ravana, illusive and wonderful, harnessed with donkeys and braying like donkeys.

shloka_text: ततस्तां परुषैर्वाक्यैर्भर्त्सयन्स महास्वनः।।3.49.20।। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं रथमारोपयत्तदा।
transliteration: tatastāṃ paruṣairvākyairbhartsayansa mahāsvanaḥ aṅkenādāya vaidehīṃ rathamāropayattadā|
translation: तदा then, महास्वनः Ravana in a loud voice, सः he, तां वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, परुषैः with harsh, वाक्यैः words, भर्त्सयन् reproaching, अङ्केन on his lap, आदाय on lifting, रथम् chariot, आरोपयत् placed.
explanation: Reproaching the princess from Videha loudly and harshly, Ravana took her on his lap and put her on the chariot.

shloka_text: सा गृहीता विचुक्रोश रावणेन यशस्स्विनी।।3.49.21।। रामेति सीता दुःखार्ता रामं दूरगतंवने।
transliteration: sā gṛhītā vicukrośa rāvaṇena yaśassvinī rāmeti sītā duḥkhārtā rāmaṃ dūragataṃvane|
translation: रावणेन by Ravana, गृहीता seized, यशस्स्विनी illustrious, सा सीता that Sita, दुःखार्ता helpless in grief, वने in the forset, दूरगतम् who was far away, रामम् Rama, राम इति saying, Alas Rama, विचुक्रोश screamed aloud.
explanation: Seized by Ravana, illustrious Sita screamed aloud Alas, Rama. for one who was far away in the forest.

shloka_text: तामकामां स कामार्तः पन्नगेन्द्रवधूमिव।।3.49.22।। विवेष्टमानामादाय उत्पपाताथ रावणः।
transliteration: tāmakāmāṃ sa kāmārtaḥ pannagendravadhūmiva viveṣṭamānāmādāya utpapātātha rāvaṇaḥ|
translation: अथ then, कामार्तः passionate, सः that, रावणः Ravana, अकामाम् not willing, पन्नगेन्द्रवधूमिव like a serpent queen, विवेष्टमानाम् writhing hard, ताम् her, आदाय seized,उत्पपात flew up.
explanation: Passionate Ravana took hold of Sita who was not willing and was writhing in pain. He seized her  like (an eagle carrying away) a serpent queen and flew up.

shloka_text: ततस्सा राक्षसेन्द्रेण ह्रियमाणा विहायसा।।3.49.23।। भृशं चुक्रोश मत्तेव भ्रान्तचित्ता यथाऽऽतुरा।
transliteration: tatassā rākṣasendreṇa hriyamāṇā vihāyasā bhṛśaṃ cukrośa matteva bhrāntacittā yathā''turā|
translation: ततः then, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the king of demons, विहायसा through the sky, ह्रियमाणा being carried off, सा that Sita, मत्तेव like a mad woman, भ्रान्तचित्ता with a bewildered mind, आतुरा anxious, यथा like, भृशम् चुक्रोश screamed a lot in agony.
explanation: While Sita was being carried off in the sky by the king of demons,   she screamed a lot in agony and anxiety like a mad woman in a bewildered state:

shloka_text: हा लक्ष्मण महाबाहो गुरुचित्तप्रसादक।।3.49.24।। ह्रियमाणां न जानीषे रक्षसा माममर्षिणा।
transliteration: hā lakṣmaṇa mahābāho gurucittaprasādaka hriyamāṇāṃ na jānīṣe rakṣasā māmamarṣiṇā|
translation: महाबाहो O longarmed Lakshmana, गुरुचित्तप्रसादक  who entertains the brother's mind, हा लक्ष्मण Alas, Lakshmana, अमर्षिणा by this angry, रक्षसा demon, माम् me, ह्रियमाणाम् being carried away, न जानीषे you do not know.
explanation: Alas, O longarmed Lakshmana, you who used to entertain your brother do not know that I am being carried away by this ruthless demon.

shloka_text: जीवितं सुखमर्थांश्च धर्महेतोः परित्यजन्।।3.49.25।। ह्रियमाणामधर्मेण मां राघव न पश्यसि।
transliteration: jīvitaṃ sukhamarthāṃśca dharmahetoḥ parityajan hriyamāṇāmadharmeṇa māṃ rāghava na paśyasi|
translation: जीवितम् life, सुखम् comfort, अर्थांश्च treasure, धर्महेतोः for the sake of righteousness, परित्यजन् giving up, राघव O Rama, अधर्मेण by unrighteous, ह्रियमाणाम्   carried off, माम् me, न पश्यसि do you not see.
explanation: O Rama, you have given up your life, pleasure and treasure for the sake of righteousness. Do you not see me carried off by an unrighteous fellow ?

shloka_text: ननु नामाविनीतानां विनेतासि परन्तप।।3.49.26।। कथमेवंविधं पापं न त्वं शासि हि रावणम्।
transliteration: nanu nāmāvinītānāṃ vinetāsi parantapa kathamevaṃvidhaṃ pāpaṃ na tvaṃ śāsi hi rāvaṇam|
translation: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, अविनीतानाम् of the haughty, विनेता a chastiser, असि ननु as such, एवंविधम् such, पापम् sinner, रावणम् Ravana, कथम् how is it, हि indeed, शासि you are not punishing?
explanation: O scorcher of enemies you are the chastiser of the haughty. Why do you not punish such a sinner like Ravana.

shloka_text: ननु सद्योऽविनीतस्य दृश्यते कर्मणःफलम्।।3.49.27।। कालोऽप्यङ्गीभवत्यत्र सस्यानामिव पक्तये।
transliteration: nanu sadyo'vinītasya dṛśyate karmaṇaḥphalam kālo'pyaṅgībhavatyatra sasyānāmiva paktaye|
translation: अविनीतस्य arrogant, कर्मणः action, फलम् result, सद्यः right now, न दृश्यते नु not seen, सस्यानाम् crop, पक्तये इव ripening, अत्र in the same way, कालोऽपि it takes time also, अङ्गीभवति serves as a supporting factor.
explanation: The effect of arrogant action cannot be seen right away. Just as the crop yields results only after ripening, in the same way it takes time. Time acts as a supporting factor.

shloka_text: त्वं कर्म कृतवानेतत्कालोपहतचेतनः।।3.49.28।। जीवितान्तकरं घोरं रामाद्व्यसनमाप्नुहि।
transliteration: tvaṃ karma kṛtavānetatkālopahatacetanaḥ jīvitāntakaraṃ ghoraṃ rāmādvyasanamāpnuhi|
translation: त्वम् you, कालोपहतचेतनः time has taken a toll of your senses, एतत् this, कर्म action, कृतवान् have done, रामात् from Rama, जीवितान्तकरम् leading towards the end of your life, घोरम् dreadful, व्यसनम् sorrow, आप्नुहि will befall.
explanation: Time has taken a toll of your senses. This has made you do what you have done. A great calamity is awaiting you in the hands of Rama. It will end your life.

shloka_text: हन्तेदानीं सकामास्तु कैकेयी सह बान्धवैः।।3.49.29।। ह्रिये यद्धर्मकामस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनः।
transliteration: hantedānīṃ sakāmāstu kaikeyī saha bāndhavaiḥ hriye yaddharmakāmasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinaḥ|
translation: धर्मकामस्य of one who wants to discharge righteous duties, यशस्विनः of the glorious, धर्मपत्नी lawful wife, यत् such, ह्रिये being carried away, इदानीम् now, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, बान्धवैः सह along with her relations, सकामा her desires, अस्तु may be fulfilled, हन्त alas.
explanation: Alas, the lawful wife of the glorious and righteous Rama is being abducted now. Let Kaikeyi along with her relations be happy with her desire fulfilled.

shloka_text: आमन्त्रये जनस्थाने कर्णिकारान्सुपुष्पितान्।।3.49.30।। क्षिप्रं रामाय शंसध्वं सीतां हरति रावणः।
transliteration: āmantraye janasthāne karṇikārānsupuṣpitān kṣipraṃ rāmāya śaṃsadhvaṃ sītāṃ harati rāvaṇaḥ|
translation: जनस्थाने in Janasthana, सुपुष्पितान् blossomed, कर्णिकारान् karnikara trees, आमन्त्रये pray, रावणः Ravana, सीताम् Sita, हरति is abducting, क्षिप्रम् at once, रामाय to Rama, शंसध्वम् tell him.
explanation: O karnikar trees in full bloom in Janasthana, tell Rama quickly that Ravana is kidnapping Sita.

shloka_text: माल्यवन्तं शिखरिणं वन्दे प्रस्रवणं गिरिम्।।3.49.31।। क्षिप्रं रामाय शंस त्वं सीतां हरति रावणः।
transliteration: mālyavantaṃ śikhariṇaṃ vande prasravaṇaṃ girim kṣipraṃ rāmāya śaṃsa tvaṃ sītāṃ harati rāvaṇaḥ|
translation: माल्यवन्तम् Malyavan, शिखरिणम्  mountain, प्रस्रवणं गिरिम् mount Prasravana, वन्दे I salute, रावणः Ravana, सीताम् Sita, हरति abducting, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् at once, रामाय to Rama, शंस tell.
explanation: I salute to Malyavan and  Prasravana mountains. Tell Rama at once that Ravana is carrying away Sita.

shloka_text: हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णां वन्दे गोदावरीं नदीम्।।3.49.32।। क्षिप्रं रामाय शंस त्वं सीतां हरति रावणः।
transliteration: haṃsakāraṇḍavākīrṇāṃ vande godāvarīṃ nadīm kṣipraṃ rāmāya śaṃsa tvaṃ sītāṃ harati rāvaṇaḥ|
translation: हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णां filled with swans and cranes, गोदावरीं नदीम् river Godavari, वन्दे my salutations to you, रावणः Ravana, सीताम् Sita, हरति is carrying away, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् immediately, रामाय Rama, शंस tell.
explanation: O river Godavari abounding in swans and cranes, my salutations to you  Tell Rama immediately that Ravana is taking away Sita.

shloka_text: दैवतानि च यान्यस्मिन्वने विविधपादपे।।3.49.33।। नमस्करोम्यहं तेभ्योभर्तुश्शंसत मां हृताम्।
transliteration: daivatāni ca yānyasminvane vividhapādape namaskaromyahaṃ tebhyobhartuśśaṃsata māṃ hṛtām|
translation: विविधपादपे various trees, अस्मिन् वने in this forest, यानि those, दैवतानि deities, (सन्ति residing here), तेभ्यः to them, अहम् I, नमस्करोमि I offer salutations, माम् me, हृताम् taken away, भर्तुः to my husband, शंसत Tell.
explanation: I offer my salutations to different deities residing in this forest abounding in trees of many kinds. Tell my husband about me that I am being whisked away.

shloka_text: यानि कानि चिदप्यत्र सत्त्वानि निवसन्त्युत।।3.49.34।। सर्वाणि शरणं यामि मृगपक्षिगणानपि।
transliteration: yāni kāni cidapyatra sattvāni nivasantyuta sarvāṇi śaraṇaṃ yāmi mṛgapakṣigaṇānapi|
translation: अत्र here, यानि कानि चित् all the animals of the forest, सत्त्वानि living beings, निवसन्ति are  residing, सर्वाणि all, मृगपक्षिगणानपि including herds of animals and birds, शरणम् I seek refuge, यामि I seek.
explanation: I seek refuge in all those living beings as well as herds of animals and birds in the forest.

shloka_text: ह्रियमाणां प्रियां भर्तुः प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम्।।3.49.35।। विवशाऽपहृता सीता रावणेनेति शंसत।
transliteration: hriyamāṇāṃ priyāṃ bhartuḥ prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasīm vivaśā'pahṛtā sītā rāvaṇeneti śaṃsata|
