translation: प्राणेभ्योऽपि more than his life, गरीयसीम्  valuable lady, ह्रियमाणाम्  carried away, प्रियाम् beloved, विवशा helpless lady, सीता Sita, रावणेन by Ravana, अपहृता इति is abducted like this, भर्तुः to my husband, शंसत tell.
explanation: Tell Rama that his dear wife Sita whom he loves more than his life is abducted helplessly.

shloka_text: विदित्वा मां महाबाहुरमुत्रापि महाबलः।।3.49.36।। आनेष्यति पराक्रम्य वैवस्वतहृतामपि।
transliteration: viditvā māṃ mahābāhuramutrāpi mahābalaḥ āneṣyati parākramya vaivasvatahṛtāmapi|
translation: महाबलः mighty, महाबाहुः longarmed, वैवस्वतहृतामपि even if abducted by Vaivasvata, lord of death, माम् me, अमुत्रापि from there also, विदित्वा knowing, पराक्रम्य by his valour, आनेष्यति can get back.
explanation: If he knows that I am abducted by Yama, the god of death, that mighty, longarmed hero will save me even from there by virtue of his valour.

shloka_text: सा तदा करुणा वाचो विलपन्ती सुदुःखिता।।3.49.37।। वनस्पतिगतं गृध्रं ददर्शाऽयतलोचना।
transliteration: sā tadā karuṇā vāco vilapantī suduḥkhitā vanaspatigataṃ gṛdhraṃ dadarśā'yatalocanā|
translation: तदा then, करुणाः piteously, वाचः words, विलपन्ती pleading crying, आयतलोचना large eyed, सा that lady, सुदुःखिता very sadly, वनस्पतिगतम् seated on the tree, गृध्रम् vulture, ददर्श saw.
explanation: When the griefstricken, largeeyed Sita was lamenting piteously, she saw the vulture (Jatayu) seated on a tree.

shloka_text: सा तमुद्वीक्ष्य सुश्रोणी रावणस्य वशं गता।3.49.38।। समाक्रन्दद्भयपरा दुःखोपहतया गिरा।
transliteration: sā tamudvīkṣya suśroṇī rāvaṇasya vaśaṃ gatā|3.49.38|| samākrandadbhayaparā duḥkhopahatayā girā|
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, वशम् grip, गता gone, सुश्रोणी heavyhipped Sita, भयपरा frightened, सा she, तम् him, उद्वीक्ष्य seeing him, दुःखोपहतया shaken up by sorrow, गिरा with words, समाक्रन्दत् screamed.
explanation: The heavyhipped Sita felt frightened in the grip of Ravana. When she saw Jatayu she screamed, shaken by sorrow:

shloka_text: जटायो पश्य मामद्य ह्रियमाणामनाथवत्।।3.49.39।। अनेन राक्षसेन्द्रेण करुणं पापकर्मणा।
transliteration: jaṭāyo paśya māmadya hriyamāṇāmanāthavat anena rākṣasendreṇa karuṇaṃ pāpakarmaṇā|
translation: जटायो O Jatayu, अद्य now, अनेन by this one, पापकर्मणा by sinful deeds, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the king of demons, अनाथवत् like an orphan, करुणम् in a desparate way, ह्रियमाणाम् being carried away, माम् me, पश्य see.
explanation: O Jatayu, see me now being carried away by the sinful king of demons in this pitiable condition as though I am an orphan.

shloka_text: नैष वारयितुं शक्यस्तव क्रूरो निशाचरः।।3.49.40।। सत्त्वाञ्जितकाशी च सायुधश्चैव दुर्मतिः।
transliteration: naiṣa vārayituṃ śakyastava krūro niśācaraḥ sattvāñjitakāśī ca sāyudhaścaiva durmatiḥ|
translation: क्रूरः cruel, सत्त्वान् strong, जितकाशी victorious, सायुधश्चैव wielding weapons, दुर्मतिः evilminded, एषः this, निशाचरः nightranger, तव you, वारयितुम् to prevent, न शक्यः not possible.
explanation: This nightranger is equipped with weapons. Cruel, strong and evilminded, he has won wars. You cannot stop him.

shloka_text: रामाय तु यथातत्त्वं जटायो हरणं मम।।3.49.41।। लक्ष्मणाय च तत्सर्वमाख्यातव्यमशेषतः।
transliteration: rāmāya tu yathātattvaṃ jaṭāyo haraṇaṃ mama lakṣmaṇāya ca tatsarvamākhyātavyamaśeṣataḥ|
translation: जटायोः Jatayu, मम my, हरणम् abduction, यथातत्त्वम् exact fact, तत् सर्वम् everything, अशेषतः without any omission, रामाय to Rama, लक्ष्मणाय च and Lakshmana, आख्यातव्यम् please narrate.
explanation: O Jatayu narrate to Rama and Lakshmana the exact facts of my abduction and all the details without any omission. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyninth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तं शब्दमवसुप्तस्तु जटायुरथ शुश्रुवे। निरीक्ष्य रावणं क्षिप्रं वैदेहीं च ददर्श सः।।3.50.1।।
transliteration: taṃ śabdamavasuptastu jaṭāyuratha śuśruve| nirīkṣya rāvaṇaṃ kṣipraṃ vaidehīṃ ca dadarśa saḥ
translation: अवसुप्तः reposing, जटायुः Jatayu, तं शब्दम् that sound, शुश्रुवे heard, अथ and, सः he, क्षिप्रम् at once, निरीक्ष्य observed, रावणम् Ravana, वैदेहीं च and Vaidehi, ददर्श saw.
explanation: While reposing, Jatayu heard the cry and at once looked up and saw Ravana and Vaidehi.
comments: Jatayu sees Ravana carrying Sita-- pleads with Ravana to return Sita-- Ravana pays no heed  Jatayu fights with Ravana.

shloka_text: ततः पर्वतकूटाभस्तीक्ष्णतुण्डः खगोत्तमः। वनस्पतिगतश्श्रीमान्व्याजहार शुभां गिरम्।।3.50.2।।
transliteration: tataḥ parvatakūṭābhastīkṣṇatuṇḍaḥ khagottamaḥ| vanaspatigataśśrīmānvyājahāra śubhāṃ giram
translation: ततः then, पर्वतकूटाभः looking like a part of the mountain, तीक्ष्णतुण्डः sharpbeaked, श्रीमान् glorious, वनस्पतिगतः from the top of the tree, खगोत्तमः best among birds, शुभाम् auspicious, गिरम् words, व्याजहार uttered.
explanation: Glorious Jatayu, the best among the birds, looked like the peak of a mountain. His beak was sharp. His words were auspious. He spoke from the top of the tree:

shloka_text: दशग्रीव स्थितो धर्मे पुराणे सत्यसंश्रयः। जटायुर्नाम नाम्नाहं गृध्रराजो महाबलः।।3.50.3।।
transliteration: daśagrīva sthito dharme purāṇe satyasaṃśrayaḥ| jaṭāyurnāma nāmnāhaṃ gṛdhrarājo mahābalaḥ
translation: दशग्रीव tenheaded Ravana, अहम् I, पुराणे धर्मे in eternal dharma, स्थितः adhering to dharma, सत्यसंश्रयः  who abides in truth, महाबलः mighty, गृध्रराजः king of vultures, नाम्ना by name, जटायुर्नाम Jatayu.
explanation: O tenheaded Ravana, I am Jatayu, king of vultures. I am mighty. An eternal follower, of dharma, I am an adherent to truth.

shloka_text: राजा सर्वस्य लोकस्य महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः। लोकानां च हिते युक्तो रामो दशरथात्मजः।।3.50.4।।
transliteration: rājā sarvasya lokasya mahendravaruṇopamaḥ| lokānāṃ ca hite yukto rāmo daśarathātmajaḥ
translation: दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, रामः Rama, सर्वस्य of the entire, लोकस्य world, राजा king, महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः equal to Indra and Varuna, लोकानाम् in the world, हिते in the wellbeing, युक्तः engaged.
explanation: Rama, Dasaratha's son, is the king of the entire world. He is equal to Indra and Varuna. He is ever engaged in the welfare of the entire world.

shloka_text: तस्यैषा लोकनाथस्य धर्मपत्नी यशस्विनी। सीता नाम वरारोहा यां त्वं हर्तुमिहेच्छसि।।3.50.5।।
transliteration: tasyaiṣā lokanāthasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinī| sītā nāma varārohā yāṃ tvaṃ hartumihecchasi
translation: याम् whom, त्वम् you, इह from here, हर्तुम् to take away, इच्छसि are desiring, एषा she is, सीता नाम Sita by name, वरारोहा a beautiful lady, यशस्विनी illustrious, लोकनाथस्य of the lord of the world, तस्य his, धर्मपत्नी wife.
explanation: The lady you want to abduct from here is the famous Sita, the lawful wife of Rama, the lord of the world.

shloka_text: कथं राजास्थितो धर्मे परदारान्परामृशेत्। रक्षणीया विशेषेण राजदारा महाबल।।3.50.6।।
transliteration: kathaṃ rājāsthito dharme paradārānparāmṛśet| rakṣaṇīyā viśeṣeṇa rājadārā mahābala
translation: धर्मे in righteousness, स्थितः adheres, राजा king, परदारान् another's wife, कथम् how, परामृशेत् can any one violate, महाबल powerful, राजदाराः king's wife, विशेषेण specially, रक्षणीयाः should be protected.
explanation: How can a king who adheres to righteousness outrage another's wife ? O powerful one, a king's wife in particular should be protected.

shloka_text: निवर्तय मतिं नीचां परदाराभिमर्शनात्। न तत्समाचरेद्धीरो यत्परोऽस्य विगर्हयेत्।।3.50.7।। यथात्मनस्तथान्येषां दारा रक्ष्या विपश्चिता।
transliteration: nivartaya matiṃ nīcāṃ paradārābhimarśanāt| na tatsamācareddhīro yatparo'sya vigarhayet yathātmanastathānyeṣāṃ dārā rakṣyā vipaścitā|
translation: नीचाम् mean, मतिम् in mind, परदाराभिमर्शनात् thought of touching another's wife, निवर्तय refrain yourself, परः others, अस्य his, यत् such deeds, विगर्हयेत् if he reproaches, तत् that, धीरः learned, न समाचरेत् should not adopt, विपश्चिता by the wise man, आत्मनः his own, यथा likewise, तथा in the same way, अन्येषाम् another's, दाराः wife, रक्ष्याः be protected.
explanation: Refrain yourself from the vile thought of violating other's wives. Wise men do not adopt what is censured by others. Just like one's own, the wise should protect other's wives.

shloka_text: धर्ममर्थं वा कामं वा शिष्टाश्शास्त्रेष्वनागतम्।।3.50.8।। व्यवस्यन्त्यनु राजानं धर्मं पौलस्त्यनन्दन।
transliteration: dharmamarthaṃ vā kāmaṃ vā śiṣṭāśśāstreṣvanāgatam vyavasyantyanu rājānaṃ dharmaṃ paulastyanandana|
translation: पौलस्त्यनन्दन O son of Paulastya, शिष्टाः learned, शास्त्रेषु sastras, अनागतम् unknown, अर्थं वा wish for material, यदि वा even if, कामम् pleasures, धर्मम् righteousness, राजानम् अनु kings follow, व्यवस्यन्ति prescribe.
explanation: O son of Paulastya learned men determine the path of dharma artha and kama,  following a king's conduct even if  they are not declared in sastras.

shloka_text: राजा धर्मस्य कामस्य द्रव्याणां चोत्तमो निधिः।।3.50.9।। धर्मश्शुभं वा पापं वा राजमूलं प्रवर्तते।
transliteration: rājā dharmasya kāmasya dravyāṇāṃ cottamo nidhiḥ dharmaśśubhaṃ vā pāpaṃ vā rājamūlaṃ pravartate|
translation: धर्मस्य of righteousness, कामस्य of pleasures, द्रव्याणां च and for material wealth, राजा king, उत्तमः best, निधिः repository, धर्मः righteousness, शुभंवा good or, पापं वा or bad, राजमूलम् king is at the root, प्रवर्तते is practised.
explanation: A king is the best repository of rigteousness, material wealth and pleasures. The king is the root of dharma, virtue and sin.

shloka_text: पापस्वभावश्चपलः कथं त्वं रक्षसां वर।।3.50.10।। ऐश्वर्यमभिसम्प्राप्तो विमानमिव दुष्कृतिः।
transliteration: pāpasvabhāvaścapalaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ rakṣasāṃ vara aiśvaryamabhisamprāpto vimānamiva duṣkṛtiḥ|
translation: रक्षसाम् of demons, वर best one, पापस्वभावः of sinful nature, चपलः fickleminded, त्वम् you are, दुष्कृतिः who does forbidden acts, विमानमिव like this celestial chariot, ऐश्वर्यम् wealth, कथम् how, अभिसम्प्राप्तः did you get?
explanation: O best of demons  by nature you are sinful, and fickleminded. You do all forbidden acts. Otherwise,how could you get this wealth, like the celestial chariot?

shloka_text: कामं स्वभावो यो यस्य न शक्यः परिमार्जितुम्।।3.50.11।। न हि दुष्टात्मनामार्यमावसत्यालये चिरम्।
transliteration: kāmaṃ svabhāvo yo yasya na śakyaḥ parimārjitum na hi duṣṭātmanāmāryamāvasatyālaye ciram|
translation: यः whatever, यस्य  his, स्वभावः nature, परिमार्जितुम् to erase, कामम् indeed, न शक्यः not possible, दुष्टात्मनाम् evilminded people, आलये in the house, चिरम् for long time, आर्यम् prosperity, न आवसति हि will not be.
explanation: Indeed, it is not possible to erase the nature of any one, whatever it be. Prosperity does not rest for long in the house of the evilminded.

shloka_text: विषये वा पुरे वा ते यदा रामो महाबलः।।3.50.12।। नापराध्यति धर्मात्मा कथं तस्यापराध्यसि।
transliteration: viṣaye vā pure vā te yadā rāmo mahābalaḥ nāparādhyati dharmātmā kathaṃ tasyāparādhyasi|
translation: महाबलः powerful, धर्मात्मा righteous self, रामः Rama, यदा since, ते to you, विषये वा in your kingdom, पुरे वा or in the city, नापराध्यति has not offended, तस्य his, कथम् how, अपराध्यसि do you offend.
explanation: Powerful and righteous Rama has not offended you, your kingdom or your city. Why do you offend him?

shloka_text: यदि शूर्पणखाहेतोर्जनस्थानगतः खरः।।3.50.13।। अतिवृत्तो हतः पूर्वं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। अत्र ब्रूहि यथातत्त्वं को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः।।3.50.14।। यस्य त्वं लोकनाथस्य भार्यां हृत्वा गमिष्यसि।
transliteration: yadi śūrpaṇakhāhetorjanasthānagataḥ kharaḥ ativṛtto hataḥ pūrvaṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā| atra brūhi yathātattvaṃ ko rāmasya vyatikramaḥ yasya tvaṃ lokanāthasya bhāryāṃ hṛtvā gamiṣyasi|
translation: शूर्पणखाहेतोः on account of Surpanakha, जनस्थानगतः staying in Janasthana, खरः Khara, अतिवृत्तः trespassed, आक्लिष्टकर्मणा by one who does something without much effort, रामेण Rama, पूर्वम् earlier, हतः यदि if killed, अत्र here, लोकनाथस्य lord of the world (Rama), यस्य whose, भार्याम् wife, त्वम् you, हृत्वा गमिष्यसि (हरिष्यसि) taking away, रामस्य Rama's, व्यतिक्रमः transgression of dharma, कः what, यथातत्त्वम् truly, ब्रूहि tell.
explanation: On account of Surpanakha, Khara trespassed into Janasthana and got killed by Rama, without much effort. Tell me truly, what transgression (of dharma) did he commit for which you are stealing away the wife of Rama who is the lord of this world?.

shloka_text: यदि शूर्पणखाहेतोर्जनस्थानगतः खरः।।3.50.13।। अतिवृत्तो हतः पूर्वं रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा। अत्र ब्रूहि यथातत्त्वं को रामस्य व्यतिक्रमः।।3.50.14।। यस्य त्वं लोकनाथस्य भार्यां हृत्वा गमिष्यसि।
transliteration: yadi śūrpaṇakhāhetorjanasthānagataḥ kharaḥ ativṛtto hataḥ pūrvaṃ rāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā| atra brūhi yathātattvaṃ ko rāmasya vyatikramaḥ yasya tvaṃ lokanāthasya bhāryāṃ hṛtvā gamiṣyasi|
translation: शूर्पणखाहेतोः on account of Surpanakha, जनस्थानगतः staying in Janasthana, खरः Khara, अतिवृत्तः trespassed, आक्लिष्टकर्मणा by one who does something without much effort, रामेण Rama, पूर्वम् earlier, हतः यदि if killed, अत्र here, लोकनाथस्य lord of the world (Rama), यस्य whose, भार्याम् wife, त्वम् you, हृत्वा गमिष्यसि (हरिष्यसि) taking away, रामस्य Rama's, व्यतिक्रमः transgression of dharma, कः what, यथातत्त्वम् truly, ब्रूहि tell.
explanation: On account of Surpanakha, Khara trespassed into Janasthana and got killed by Rama, without much effort. Tell me truly, what transgression (of dharma) did he commit for which you are stealing away the wife of Rama who is the lord of this world?.

shloka_text: क्षिप्रं विसृज वैदेहीं मा त्वा घोरेण चक्षुषा।।3.50.15।। दहेद्दहनभूतेन वृत्रमिन्द्राशनिर्यथा।
transliteration: kṣipraṃ visṛja vaidehīṃ mā tvā ghoreṇa cakṣuṣā daheddahanabhūtena vṛtramindrāśaniryathā|
translation: क्षिप्रम् at once, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, विसृज leave, त्वा you, इन्द्राशनिः Indra's thunderbolt, वृत्रं यथा like Vritra, दहनभूतेन with fury, घोरेण with fierce, चक्षुषा with looks, मा दहेत् may not burn.
explanation: Leave Vaidehi at once lest with her fierce looks you should be burnt down like demon Vrtra by the thunderbolt of Indra.

shloka_text: सर्पमाशीविषं बद्ध्वा वस्त्रान्ते नावबुध्यसे।।3.50.16।। ग्रीवायां प्रतिसक्तं च कालपाशं न पश्यसि।
transliteration: sarpamāśīviṣaṃ baddhvā vastrānte nāvabudhyase grīvāyāṃ pratisaktaṃ ca kālapāśaṃ na paśyasi|
translation: आशीविषम् venomous, सर्पम् serpent, वस्रान्ते with the skirt of your cloth, बद्ध्वा binding, नावबुध्यसे not understand, ग्रीवायाम् to the neck, प्रतिसक्तम् fastened tightly, कालपाशम् noose of death, न पश्यसि do not see.
explanation: You are not aware that you are tying a venomous snake with the skirt of your cloth. worn by you. You are not able to see the noose of death tightened around your neck.

shloka_text: स भारस्सौम्य भर्तव्यो यो नरं नावसादयेत्।।3.50.17।। तदन्नमपि भोक्तव्यं जीर्यते यदनामयम्।
transliteration: sa bhārassaumya bhartavyo yo naraṃ nāvasādayet tadannamapi bhoktavyaṃ jīryate yadanāmayam|
translation: सौम्य O gentle one, यः that which, नरम् man, नावसादयेत् does not fatigue, सः such, भारः weight, भर्तव्यः should be carried, यत् which, अनामयम् free from any disease, जीर्यते is digested, तत् that only, अन्नम् food, भोक्तव्यम् should be eaten, अपि even.
explanation: O gentle Ravana one should carry that much of weight which does not tire him. One should eat only that wholesome food which can be easily digested.

shloka_text: यत्कृत्वा न भवेद्धर्मो न कीर्तिर्न यशो भुवि।।3.50.18।। शरीरस्य भवेत्खेदः कस्तत्कर्म समाचरेत्।
transliteration: yatkṛtvā na bhaveddharmo na kīrtirna yaśo bhuvi śarīrasya bhavetkhedaḥ kastatkarma samācaret|
translation: यत् by what, कृत्वा doing, धर्मः duty, न भवेत् does not beget, भुवि world, कीर्तिः fame, न nor, यशः glory, न nor, शरीरस्य to the body, खेदः exhaustion, भवेत् brings, तत् that, कर्म deed, कः who, समाचरेत् will practise?
explanation: Who will do such a deed which cannot beget dharma, fame or glory in the world? Who will do such deeds that bring only exhaustion to the body?

shloka_text: षष्टिर्वर्षसहस्राणि मम जातस्य रावण।।3.50.19।। पितृपैतामहं राज्यं यथावदनुतिष्ठतः।
transliteration: ṣaṣṭirvarṣasahasrāṇi mama jātasya rāvaṇa pitṛpaitāmahaṃ rājyaṃ yathāvadanutiṣṭhataḥ|
translation: रावण Ravana, पितृपैतामहम् hereditary, राज्यम् kingdom, यथावत् justly, अनुतिष्टतः while ruling, जातस्य since birth, मम me, षष्टिः sixty, वर्षसहस्राणि thosand years are completed.
explanation: Sixty thousand years ago I was born, O Ravana  Since then I have ruled justly my hereditary kingdom.

shloka_text: वृद्धोऽहं त्वं युवा धन्वी सशरः कवची रथी।।3.50.20।। तथाप्यादाय वैदेहीं कुशली न गमिष्यसि।
transliteration: vṛddho'haṃ tvaṃ yuvā dhanvī saśaraḥ kavacī rathī tathāpyādāya vaidehīṃ kuśalī na gamiṣyasi|
translation: अहम् I am, वृद्धः old, त्वम् you, युवा young, धन्वी wielding bow, सशरः and arrows, कवची shield, रथी riding on the chariot, तथापि even then, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, आदाय carrying, कुशली safely, न गमिष्यसि will not go.
explanation: I am old, you are young, wielding a bow and arrows, with shield to protect and chariot to ride. Even then I will not let you go safe with Vaidehi kidnapped.

shloka_text: न शक्तस्त्वं बलाद्धर्तुं वैदेहीं मम पश्यतः।।3.50.21।। हेतुभिर्न्यायसंसिद्धैद्धृवां वेदश्रुतीमिव।
transliteration: na śaktastvaṃ balāddhartuṃ vaidehīṃ mama paśyataḥ hetubhirnyāyasaṃsiddhaiddhṛvāṃ vedaśrutīmiva|
translation: मम पश्यतः within my very sight, त्वम् you, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, न्यायसंसिद्धैः by those bound by logic, हेतुभिः by reason, ध्रुवाम् everlasting, वेदश्रुतीमिव like revelations of the Vedas, बलात् by force, हर्तुम् abduct, न शक्तः not possible for you.
explanation: You cannot carry Vaidehi by force within my very sight just as the everlasting revelations of the Vedas cannot be robbed by mere logic of reason.

shloka_text: युद्ध्यस्व यदि शूरोऽसि मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ रावण।।3.50.22।। शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथापूर्वं खरस्तथा।
transliteration: yuddhyasva yadi śūro'si muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha rāvaṇa śayiṣyase hato bhūmau yathāpūrvaṃ kharastathā|
translation: रावण O Ravana, शूरः असि यदि if you are a hero, युद्ध्यस्व do fight with me, मुहूर्तम् तिष्ठ stay awhile, पूर्वम् earlier, खरः Khara, यथा as he was, तथा likewise, हतः slayed, भूमौ on the earth, शयिष्यसे will sleep.
explanation: O Ravana, if you are brave, fight with me. In a moment, you will be killed like Khara and lie down on the ground.

shloka_text: असकृत्संयुगे येन निहता दैत्यदानवाः।।3.50.23।। नचिराच्चीरवासास्त्वां रामो युधि वधिष्यति।
transliteration: asakṛtsaṃyuge yena nihatā daityadānavāḥ nacirāccīravāsāstvāṃ rāmo yudhi vadhiṣyati|
translation: येन by whom, असकृत् many times, संयुगे in war, दैत्यदानवाः demons, निहताः were slain, त्वाम् you, नचिरात् soon, चीरवासाः clad in bark robes, रामः Rama, युधि in war, वधिष्यति will slay৷৷
explanation: Clad in bark garments, Rama, who has often slain demons in the past will soon kill you in war.

shloka_text: किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं गतौदूरं नृपात्मजौ।।3.50.24।। क्षिप्रं त्वं नश्यसे नीच तयोर्भीतो न संशयः।
transliteration: kiṃ nu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ gataudūraṃ nṛpātmajau kṣipraṃ tvaṃ naśyase nīca tayorbhīto na saṃśayaḥ|
translation: मया by me, किं नु what else, कर्तुम् to do, शक्यम् am able, नृपात्मजौ the two princes, दूरम् far away, गतौ have gone, नीच mean fellow, तयोः both of them, भीतः fearing, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् at once, नश्यसे will be destroyed, संशयः doubt, न not.
explanation: What can I do? O mean fellow the two princes have gone far away.You will soon be destroyed out of fear for them. There is no doubt.

shloka_text: न हि मे जीवमानस्य नयिष्यसि शुभामिमाम्।।3.50.25।। सीतां कमलपत्राक्षीं रामस्य महिषीं प्रियाम्।
transliteration: na hi me jīvamānasya nayiṣyasi śubhāmimām sītāṃ kamalapatrākṣīṃ rāmasya mahiṣīṃ priyām|
translation: मे myself, जीवमानस्य while I am alive, शुभाम् auspicious, कमलपत्राक्षीम् lotuseyed lady, रामस्य प्रियाम् Rama's dear, महिषीम् consort, इमाम् this lady, सीताम् Sita, न नयिष्यसि will not take.
explanation: I will not let you take away the auspicious, lotuseyed Sita, the dear consort of Rama as long as I am alive.

shloka_text: अवश्यं तु मया कार्यं प्रियं तस्य महात्मनः।।3.50.26।। जीवितेनापि रामस्य तथा दशरथस्य च।
transliteration: avaśyaṃ tu mayā kāryaṃ priyaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ jīvitenāpi rāmasya tathā daśarathasya ca|
translation: महात्मनः great soul, तस्य his, रामस्य Rama's, तथा so, दशरथस्य च and Dasaratha's, मया my, अवश्यम् certainly, जीवितेनापि even giving up my life, प्रियम् dear, कार्यम् task.
explanation: I should do this important work of those great souls, Rama and Dasaratha, even if it claims my life.

shloka_text: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ दशग्रीव मुहूर्तं पश्य रावण।।3.50.27।। युद्धातिथ्यं प्रदास्यामि यथाप्राणं निशाचर। वृन्तादिव फलं त्वां तु पातयेयं रथोत्तमात्।।3.50.28।।
transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha daśagrīva muhūrtaṃ paśya rāvaṇa yuddhātithyaṃ pradāsyāmi yathāprāṇaṃ niśācara| vṛntādiva phalaṃ tvāṃ tu pātayeyaṃ rathottamāt
translation: दशग्रीव tenheaded, मुहूर्तम् for a short while, तिष्ठ तिष्ठ stay, stay, रावण Ravana, पश्य look, निशाचर nightwalker, यथाप्राणम् as long as I am alive, युद्धातिथ्यम् hospitality of war , प्रदास्यामि will accord, वृन्तात् from the stalk, फलमिव like a ripe fruit is dropped down, त्वाम् you, रथोत्तमात् from the best of the chariots, पातयेयम् will pull you down.
explanation: O ten headed Ravana stay, stay for a while. O demon  as long as I am alive I will treat you with the hospitality of war. You will be pulled down from this best of the chariots like a ripe fruit drops from the stalk. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftieth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तस्य यथान्यायं रावणस्य जटायुषा। क्रुद्धस्याग्निनिभास्सर्वा रेजुर्विंशतिदृष्टयः।।3.51.1।।
transliteration: ityuktasya yathānyāyaṃ rāvaṇasya jaṭāyuṣā| kruddhasyāgninibhāssarvā rejurviṃśatidṛṣṭayaḥ
translation: जटायुषा by Jatayu, यथान्यायम् justly, इति in this manner, उक्तस्य  told, क्रुद्धस्य of the enraged, रावणस्य Ravana's, सर्वाः all, विंशतिदृष्टयः twenty eyes, अग्निनिभाः like fire, रेजुः glowed.
explanation: Ravana's twenty eyes glowed like fire in anger after Jatayu thus rightly said.
comments: Jatayu fights Ravana -- wounded Ravana clips Jatayu's wings and carries away Sita.

shloka_text: संरक्तनयनः कोपात्तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः। राक्षसेन्द्रोऽभिदुद्राव पतगेन्द्रममर्षणः।।3.51.2।।
transliteration: saṃraktanayanaḥ kopāttaptakāñcanakuṇḍalaḥ| rākṣasendro'bhidudrāva patagendramamarṣaṇaḥ
translation: तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः bright gold earrings, अमर्षणः intolerant, राक्षसेन्द्रः king of demons, कोपात् in anger, संरक्तनयनः eyes turned red, पतगेन्द्रम् to lord of birds (Jatayu), अभिदुद्राव leaped.
explanation: As the bright gold earrings of the intolerant king of demons glittered, his eyes turned red in rage and he pounced upon Jatayu, the lord of birds.

shloka_text: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुल स्तयोस्तस्मिन्महावने। बभूव वातोद्धतयोर्मेघयोर्गगने यथा।।3.51.3।।
transliteration: sa samprahārastumula stayostasminmahāvane| babhūva vātoddhatayormeghayorgagane yathā
translation: तस्मिन् in that, महावने in the huge forest, तयोः between them, तुमुलः tumultuous, सः सम्प्रहारः fight, गगने in the sky, वातोद्धतयोः stormy wind that arose, मेघयोर्यथा like two flakes of clouds, बभूव appeared.
explanation: The clash between them was tumultuous and it appeared like the clash of two pieces of clouds in the sky raised by stormy winds.

shloka_text: तद्बभूवाद्भुतं युद्धं गृध्रराक्षसयोस्तदा। सपक्षयोर्माल्यवतोर्महापर्वतयोरिव।।3.51.4।।
transliteration: tadbabhūvādbhutaṃ yuddhaṃ gṛdhrarākṣasayostadā| sapakṣayormālyavatormahāparvatayoriva
translation: तदा then, (तयोः of both of them), गृध्रराक्षसयोः vulture and demon, तत् that, अद्भुतम् wonderful, युद्धम् war, सपक्षयोः of the winged ones, माल्यवतोः of Malyavan range, महापर्वतयोरिव between two huge mountains, बभूव took place.
explanation: The duel between Ravana and Jatayu looked as though it was a fight between two huge winged mountains of Malyavan range.

shloka_text: ततो नालीकनाराचैस्तीक्ष्णाग्रैश्च विकर्णिभिः। अभ्यवर्षन्महाघोरैर्गृध्रराजं महाबलः।।3.51.5।।
transliteration: tato nālīkanārācaistīkṣṇāgraiśca vikarṇibhiḥ| abhyavarṣanmahāghorairgṛdhrarājaṃ mahābalaḥ
translation: ततः then,महाबलः mighty, तीक्ष्णाग्रैः with sharp tips, महाघोरैः dreadful, नालीकनाराचैः by spears and shafts, विकर्णिभिः a weapon named Vikarni, गृध्रराजम्  king of vultures, अभ्यवर्षत् rained.
explanation: Then the mighty Ravana rained sharp, dreadful shafts, spears and Vikarnis at Jatayu,  king of vultures.

shloka_text: स तानि शरजालानि गृध्रः पत्त्ररथेश्वरः। जटायुः प्रतिजग्राह रावणास्त्राणि संयुगे।।3.51.6।।
transliteration: sa tāni śarajālāni gṛdhraḥ pattraratheśvaraḥ| jaṭāyuḥ pratijagrāha rāvaṇāstrāṇi saṃyuge
translation: पत्ररथेश्वरः lord of birds, गृध्रः vulture, जटायुः Jatayu, संयुगे in encounter, तानि those, शरजालानि all the arrows, रावणास्त्राणि Ravana's weapons, प्रतिजग्राह endured.
explanation: Jatayu, lord of the birds, faced the arrows and other weapons showered  by Ravana.

shloka_text: तस्य तीक्ष्णनखाभ्यां तु चरणाभ्यां महाबलः। चकार बहुधा गात्रे व्रणान्पतगसत्तमः।।3.51.7।।
transliteration: tasya tīkṣṇanakhābhyāṃ tu caraṇābhyāṃ mahābalaḥ| cakāra bahudhā gātre vraṇānpatagasattamaḥ
translation: महाबलः very strong, पतगसत्तमः virtuous vulture, तीक्ष्णनखाभ्याम् with sharp claws, चरणाभ्याम् with both feet, तस्य his, गात्रे on the limbs, बहुधा many ways, व्रणान् wounds, चकार pierced.
explanation: The mighty, virtuous vulture with his sharp claws wounded many parts of the body of Ravana.

shloka_text: अथ क्रोधाद्धशग्रीवो जग्राह दश मार्गणान्। मृत्युदण्डनिभान्घोरान्छत्रुमर्दनकाङ्क्षया।।3.51.8।।
transliteration: atha krodhāddhaśagrīvo jagrāha daśa mārgaṇān| mṛtyudaṇḍanibhānghorānchatrumardanakāṅkṣayā
translation: अथ at that time, दशग्रीवः the tenheaded Ravana, क्रोधात् enraged, शत्रुमर्दनकाङ्क्षया with a desire to crush the enemy, मृत्युदण्डनिभान् like the staff of death, घोरान् fierce, दश मार्गणान् ten darts, जग्राह unleashed.
explanation: Ravana in a rage took ten dreadful darts (looking) like the staff of death with a desire to crush the enemy.

shloka_text: स तैर्बाणैर्महावीर्यः पूर्णमुक्तैरजिह्मगैः। बिभेद निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्गृध्रं घोरैश्शिलीमुखैः।।3.51.9।।
transliteration: sa tairbāṇairmahāvīryaḥ pūrṇamuktairajihmagaiḥ| bibheda niśitaistīkṣṇairgṛdhraṃ ghoraiśśilīmukhaiḥ
translation: महावीर्यः mighty, सः he, पूर्णमुक्तै: fully released, अजिह्मगैः going straight, निशितैः whetted, तीक्ष्णै with sharp, घोरैः dreadful, शिलीमुखैः with arrows, तैः those, बाणैः arrows, गृध्रम् at the vulture, बिभेद pierced.
explanation: The mighty Ravana fully released his dreadful, sharp arrows that went straight and pierced the vulture.

shloka_text: स राक्षसरथे पश्यन्जानकीं बाष्पलोचनाम्। अचिन्तयित्वा तान्बाणान्राक्षसं समभिद्रवत्।।3.51.10।।
transliteration: sa rākṣasarathe paśyanjānakīṃ bāṣpalocanām| acintayitvā tānbāṇānrākṣasaṃ samabhidravat
translation: सः that, राक्षसरथे on the demon's chariot, बाष्पलोचनाम् eyes filled with tears, जानकीम् Sita, daughter of Janaka, पश्यन् observing, तान् those, बाणान् arrows, अचिन्तयित्वा without minding, राक्षसम् to the demon, समभिद्रवत् attacked again.
explanation: Seeing Sita, daughter of Janaka, on the demon's chariot with eyes full of tears, Jatayu without minding the arrows renewed his attack.

shloka_text: ततोऽस्य सशरं चापं मुक्तामणिविभूषितम्। चरणाभ्यां महातेजा बभञ्ज पतगेश्वरः।।3.51.11।।
transliteration: tato'sya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ muktāmaṇivibhūṣitam| caraṇābhyāṃ mahātejā babhañja patageśvaraḥ
translation: ततः then, महातेजाः glorious, पतगेश्वरः lord of birds, अस्य his, मुक्तामणिविभूषितम् encrusted with pearls and gems, सशरम् along with that arrow, चापम् bow, चरणाभ्याम् with his feet, बभञ्ज broke.
explanation: The glorious lord of birds crushed with his feet the bow and arrow of Ravana with pearls and gems encrusted.

shloka_text: ततोऽन्यद्धनुरादाय रावणः क्रोधमूर्छितः। ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।।3.51.12।।
transliteration: tato'nyaddhanurādāya rāvaṇaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ| vavarṣa śaravarṣāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
translation: ततः then, रावणः Ravana, क्रोधमूर्छितः overcome with anger, अन्यत् other, धनुः bow, आदाय after taking, शतशः hundreds of, अथ and, सहस्रशः in thousands, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, ववर्ष rained.
explanation: Overcome with anger, Ravana took another bow and rained (on him) hundreds and thousands of arrows.

shloka_text: शरैरावारितस्तस्य संयुगे पतगेश्वरः। कुलायमुपसम्प्राप्तः पक्षीव प्रबभौ तदा।।3.51.13।।
transliteration: śarairāvāritastasya saṃyuge patageśvaraḥ| kulāyamupasamprāptaḥ pakṣīva prababhau tadā
translation: तदा then, संयुगे in the encounter, तस्य his, शरैः  arrows, आवारितः surrounded, पतगेश्वरः Jatayu, कुलायम् nest of the bird, उपसम्प्राप्तः returned, पक्षीव resemled the bird, प्रबभौ shone.
explanation: Jatayu, shot with arrows on all sides in the combat, shone like the bird that returned to its nest.

shloka_text: स तानि शरवर्षाणि पक्षाभ्यां च विधूयच। चरणाभ्यां महातेजा बभञ्जास्य महद्धनुः।।3.51.14।।
transliteration: sa tāni śaravarṣāṇi pakṣābhyāṃ ca vidhūyaca| caraṇābhyāṃ mahātejā babhañjāsya mahaddhanuḥ
translation: महातेजाः powerful, सः Jatayu, तानि those, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, पक्षाभ्याम् by the wings, विधूय च on scattering, अस्य his, महत् great, धनुः bow, चरणाभ्याम् with claws, बभञ्ज broke.
explanation: Powerful Jatayu scattered the shower of arrows with his wings and broke down the great bow with his claws.

shloka_text: तच्चाग्निसदृशं दीप्तं रावणस्य शरावरम्। पक्षाभ्यां स महावीर्यो व्याधुनोत्पतगेश्वरः।।3.51.15।।
transliteration: taccāgnisadṛśaṃ dīptaṃ rāvaṇasya śarāvaram| pakṣābhyāṃ sa mahāvīryo vyādhunotpatageśvaraḥ
translation: महावीर्यः mighty, सः Jatayu, पतगेश्वरः lord of the birds, रावणस्य Ravana's, अग्निसदृशम् burning like fire, दीप्तम् glowing, तत् that, शरावरम् armour, पक्षाभ्याम् with the wings, व्याधुनोत् tore asunder.
explanation: Mighty Jatayu, lord of the birds, shattered with his wings the armour of Ravana that was glowing like fire.

shloka_text: काञ्चनोरश्छदान्दिव्यान्पिशाचवदनान्खरान्। तांश्चास्य जवसम्पन्नाञ्जघान समरे बली।।3.51.16।।
transliteration: kāñcanoraśchadāndivyānpiśācavadanānkharān| tāṃścāsya javasampannāñjaghāna samare balī
translation: बली powerful, काञ्चनोरश्छदान् golden shield, दिव्यान् splendid, पिशाचवदनान् devil's face, जवसम्पन्नान् endowed with great speed, तान् those, खरान् च asses, समरे in the combat, जघान killed.
explanation: Powerful Jatayu killed in the combat, the splendid, swiftmoving, devilfaced asses with  golden shields yoked to the chariot.

shloka_text: वरं त्रिवेणुसम्पन्नं कामगं पावकार्चिषम्। मणिहेमविचित्राङ्गं बभञ्ज च महारथम्।।3.51.17।।
transliteration: varaṃ triveṇusampannaṃ kāmagaṃ pāvakārciṣam| maṇihemavicitrāṅgaṃ babhañja ca mahāratham
translation: वरम् excellent, त्रिवेणुसम्पन्नम् endowed with three bamboo reeds, कामगम् go wherever one desired, पावकार्चिषम् glowing like fire, मणिहेमविचित्राङ्गम् glittering with gold and gems, महारथम् great chariot, बभञ्ज broke.
explanation: Then he(Jatayu) broke down the great chariot(of Ravana) glowing like fire, glittering with gold and gems, made of three bamboo reeds, and capable of flying wherever the rider willed.

shloka_text: पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतीकाशं छत्रं च व्यजनैस्सह। पातयामास वेगेन ग्राहिभी राक्षसैस्सह।।3.51.18।।
transliteration: pūrṇacandrapratīkāśaṃ chatraṃ ca vyajanaissaha| pātayāmāsa vegena grāhibhī rākṣasaissaha
translation: पूर्णचन्द्रप्रतीकाशम् shining like the full moon, छत्रं च parasol also, व्यजनैः सह with  the fans, ग्राहिभिः with those holding them, राक्षसैः सह along with the demons, वेगेन violently, पातयामास pulled down.
explanation: Jatayu violently pulled down the parasol shining like the full moon and the fans of the chariot along with the demons holding them.

shloka_text: सारथेश्चास्य वेगेन तुण्डेनैव महच्छिरः। पुनर्व्यपाहरच्छ्रीमान्पक्षिराजो महाबलः।।3.51.19।।
transliteration: sāratheścāsya vegena tuṇḍenaiva mahacchiraḥ| punarvyapāharacchrīmānpakṣirājo mahābalaḥ
translation: पुनः again, महाबलः powerful, श्रीमान् glorious, पक्षिराजः king of the birds, अस्य his, सारथेः charioteer, महत् huge, शिरः head, वेगेन तुण्डेनैव violently with the beak, व्यपाहरत् shattered.
explanation: Again the glorious, powerful king of birds swiftly shattered the huge head of the charioteer with his beak.

shloka_text: स भग्नधन्वा विरथो हताश्वो हतसारथिः। अङ्केनादाय वैदेहीं पपात भुवि रावणः।।3.51.20।।
transliteration: sa bhagnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ| aṅkenādāya vaidehīṃ papāta bhuvi rāvaṇaḥ
translation: भग्नधन्वा with the bow broken, विरथः chariot destroyed, हताश्वः asses (drawing the chariot) dead, हतसारथिः charioteer killed, सः रावणः that Ravana, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अङ्केन on his lap, आदाय held, भुवि on to the ground, पपात fell.
explanation: With the bow broken, the chariot destroyed, asses (drawing the chariot) and the charioteer dead,  Ravana fell down on the ground holding Vaidehi on his lap.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा निपतितं भूमौ रावणं भग्नवाहनम्। साधुसाध्विति भूतानि गृध्रराजमपूजयन्।।3.51.21।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā nipatitaṃ bhūmau rāvaṇaṃ bhagnavāhanam| sādhusādhviti bhūtāni gṛdhrarājamapūjayan
translation: भग्नवाहनम् with the broken chariot, भूमौ on the ground, निपतितम् fallen down, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, साधु साधु इति staying well done, well done, भूतानि all beings, गृध्रराजम् king of the birds, अपूजयन् honoured.
explanation: Seeing Ravana fallen on the ground with his broken chariot, all beings honoured the king of the birds, saying, Well done Well done

shloka_text: परिश्रान्तं तु तं दृष्टवा जरया पक्षियूथपम्। उत्पपात पुनर्हृष्टो मैथिलीं गृह्य रावणः।।3.51.22।।
transliteration: pariśrāntaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭavā jarayā pakṣiyūthapam| utpapāta punarhṛṣṭo maithilīṃ gṛhya rāvaṇaḥ
translation: पक्षियूथपम् the lord of the flocks of birds (Jatayu), तम् him, जरया with old age, परिश्रान्तम् exhausted (after a long fight), दृष्ट्वा seeing, रावणः Ravana, हृष्टः glad, मैथिलीम् Maithili, गृह्य took, पुनः again, उत्पपात flew into the sky.
explanation: Seeing the lord of the flocks of birds exhausted due to age still fighting, Ravana felt glad. He flew back into the sky taking Sita, princess of Mithila, with him.

shloka_text: तं प्रहृष्टं निधायाङ्के गच्छन्तं जनकात्मजाम्। गृध्रराजस्समुत्पत्य समभिद्रुत्य रावणम्।।3.51.23।। समावार्य महातेजा जटायुरिदमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: taṃ prahṛṣṭaṃ nidhāyāṅke gacchantaṃ janakātmajām| gṛdhrarājassamutpatya samabhidrutya rāvaṇam samāvārya mahātejā jaṭāyuridamabravīt|
translation: गृध्रराजः king of the vultures, महातेजाः mighty, जटायुः Jatayu, समुत्पत्य flew up.प्रहृष्टम् happy, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter ( Sita), अङ्के on the lap, निथाय placed, गच्छन्तम् while going, तं रावणम् to that Ravana, समभिद्रुत्य chased, समावार्य obstructing, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Seeing Sita, Janaka's daughter, happily carried away into the sky by Ravana on his lap. Jatayu, the mighty king of vultures chased him, and obstructing his path said :

shloka_text: वज्रसंस्पर्शबाणस्य भार्यां रामस्य रावण।।3.51.24।। अल्पबुद्धे हरस्येनां वधाय खलु रक्षसाम्।
transliteration: vajrasaṃsparśabāṇasya bhāryāṃ rāmasya rāvaṇa alpabuddhe harasyenāṃ vadhāya khalu rakṣasām|
translation: अल्पबुद्धे foolish, रावण Ravana, वज्रसंस्पर्शबाणस्य whose arows can hit like a thunderbolt, रामस्य Rama's, भार्याम् wife, एनाम् this lady, रक्षसाम् of demons, वधाय for destruction, हरसि  kidnapping.
explanation: Foolish Ravana, you are kidnapping this lady, wife of Rama, whose arrows can hit like a thunderbolt. This will lead to the destruction of all demons.

shloka_text: समित्रबन्धुस्सामात्यस्सबलस्सपरिच्छदः।।3.51.25।। विषपानं पिबस्येतत्पिपासित इवोदकम्।
transliteration: samitrabandhussāmātyassabalassaparicchadaḥ viṣapānaṃ pibasyetatpipāsita ivodakam|
translation: मित्रबन्धुः along with kith and kin, सामात्यः with ministers, सबलः with army, सपरिच्छदः with all your allies, पिपासितः thirsty man, उदकमिव like water, एतत् this, विषपानम् poison, पिबसि you  are drinking.
explanation: You are drinking poison along with all your friends, relatives, ministers, the army and  your allies. like a thirsty man drinks water.

shloka_text: अनुबन्धमजानन्तः कर्मणामविचक्षणाः।।3.51.26।। शीघ्रमेव विनश्यन्ति यथा त्वं विनशिष्यसि।
transliteration: anubandhamajānantaḥ karmaṇāmavicakṣaṇāḥ śīghrameva vinaśyanti yathā tvaṃ vinaśiṣyasi|
translation: कर्मणाम् of the deeds, अनुबन्धम् consequences, अजानन्तः not knowing, अविचक्षणाः unwise, यथा similarly, श्रीघ्रमेव soon, विनश्यन्ति get destroyed, त्वम् you, विनशिष्यसि will be destroyed.
explanation: Fools who do not know the consequences of their action perish soon. Similarly you are going to die soon.

shloka_text: बद्धस्त्वं कालपाशेन क्व गतस्तस्य मोक्ष्यसे।।3.51.27।। वधाय बडिशं गृह्य सामिषं जलजो यथा।
transliteration: baddhastvaṃ kālapāśena kva gatastasya mokṣyase vadhāya baḍiśaṃ gṛhya sāmiṣaṃ jalajo yathā|
translation: त्वम् you, कालपाशेन by the noose of death, वधाय to die, बद्धः are bound, सामिषम् with a bait, बडिशम् fishhook, गृह्य having taken, जलजः fish, यथा so also, तस्य its, क्व गतः where can it go, मोक्ष्यसे will you get out.
explanation: You are bound by the noose of death like a fish holding on to the bait of the fishing hook. Where can you go now?

shloka_text: न हि जातु दुराधर्षौ काकुत्स्थौ तव रावण।।3.51.28।। धर्षणं चाश्रमस्यास्य क्षमिष्येते तु राघवौ।
transliteration: na hi jātu durādharṣau kākutsthau tava rāvaṇa dharṣaṇaṃ cāśramasyāsya kṣamiṣyete tu rāghavau|
translation: रावण Ravana, दुराधर्षौ both invincible, काकुत्स्थौ both Kakutsthas, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, तव your, अस्य आश्रमस्य their hermitage, धर्षणम् assault, जातु surely, न क्षमिष्येते not forgive.
explanation: O Ravana  know that Rama and Lakshmana, the Kakutsthas, are invincible. They will not forgive the asssault you have made on their hermitage.

shloka_text: यथा त्वया कृतं कर्म भीरुणा लोकगर्हितम्।।3.51.29।। तस्कराचरितो मार्गो नैव वीरनिषेवितः।
transliteration: yathā tvayā kṛtaṃ karma bhīruṇā lokagarhitam taskarācarito mārgo naiva vīraniṣevitaḥ|
translation: भीरुणा by a timid, त्वया you are, यथा like this, लोकगर्हितम् condemned by the whole world, कर्म  act, कृतम् is done, तस्कराचरितः adopted by thieves, मार्गः this path, वीरनिषेवितः followed by heroes, नैव not at all.
explanation: Your cowardly action will be condemned by the whole world. The path you have chosen is the path of a thief and not of a hero.

shloka_text: युध्यस्व यदि शूरोऽसि मुहूर्तं तिष्ठरावण।।3.51.30।। शयिष्यसे हतो भूमौ यथा भ्राता खरस्तथा।
transliteration: yudhyasva yadi śūro'si muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭharāvaṇa śayiṣyase hato bhūmau yathā bhrātā kharastathā|
translation: रावण Ravana, यदि if you, शूरोऽसि are courageous, युध्यस्व may fight, मुहूर्तं for a moment, तिष्ठ stay, भ्राता brother, खर: Khara, तथा likewise, शयिष्यसे all down, यथा as, भूमौ on the ground, हत: killed.
explanation: O Ravana if you are courageous, tarry awhile and fight with me. Like your brother Khara, you will lie on the ground dead.

shloka_text: परेतकाले पुरुषो यत्कर्म प्रतिपद्यते।।3.51.31।। विनाशायात्मनोऽधर्म्यं प्रतिपन्नोऽसि कर्म तत्।
transliteration: paretakāle puruṣo yatkarma pratipadyate vināśāyātmano'dharmyaṃ pratipanno'si karma tat|
translation: पुरुषः man, परेतकाले at the time of death, यत् whatever, कर्म actions, प्रतिपद्यते does, अधर्म्यम् unrighteous, तत् such, कर्म action, आत्मनः yourself, विनाशाय for destruction, प्रतिपन्नः  undertaken, असि you are.
explanation: You have resorted to unrighteous action like a dying man. This will spell your destruction.

shloka_text: पापानुबन्धो वै यस्य कर्मणः कर्मको नु तत्।।3.51.32।। कुर्वीत लोकाधिपतिस्स्वयंभूर्भगवानपि।
transliteration: pāpānubandho vai yasya karmaṇaḥ karmako nu tat kurvīta lokādhipatissvayaṃbhūrbhagavānapi|
translation: यस्य by whomsoever, कर्मणः action, पापानुबन्धः resulting in sin, तत् such, कर्म action, लोकाधिपतिः lord of the world, भगवान् स्वयंभूरपि selfborn lord (Brahma) too, कः who, कुर्वीत may do, नु indeed, तत् that.
explanation: If the consequences of an action be sin, who will do it ? Even the selfborn lord of the world may not.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा शुभं वाक्यं जटायुस्तस्य रक्षसः।।3.51.33।। निपपात भृशं पृष्ठे दशग्रीवस्य वीर्यवान्।
transliteration: evamuktvā śubhaṃ vākyaṃ jaṭāyustasya rakṣasaḥ nipapāta bhṛśaṃ pṛṣṭhe daśagrīvasya vīryavān|
translation: वीर्यवान् brave,जटायुः Jatayu, एवम् in that manner, शुभम् auspicious (cautious), वाक्यम् words, उक्त्वा having  said, रक्षसः of that demon, तस्य रावणस्य पृष्ठे at Ravana's back, भृशम् repeatedly, निपपात dashed.
explanation: Brave Jatayu having thus said these cautious words to the demon dashed against his back again and again.

shloka_text: तं गृहीत्वा नखैस्तीक्ष्णैर्विददार समन्ततः।।3.51.34।। अधिरूढो गजारोहो यथा स्याद्दुष्टवारणम्।
transliteration: taṃ gṛhītvā nakhaistīkṣṇairvidadāra samantataḥ adhirūḍho gajāroho yathā syādduṣṭavāraṇam|
translation: (ततः thereafter), तं गृहीत्वा seizing him, अधिरूढः ascended, गजारोहः riding on an elephant, दुष्टवारणम् unruly elephant, यथा so also, स्यात् he, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, नखैः claws, समन्ततः all over, विददार pierced.
explanation: Thereafter, seizing Ravana, Jatayu ascended on his back and pierced his body all over with his sharp claws just as a rider goads an unruly elephant.

shloka_text: विददार नखैरस्य तुण्डं पृष्ठे समर्पयन्।।3.51.35।। केशांश्चोत्पाटयामास नखपक्षमुखायुधः।
transliteration: vidadāra nakhairasya tuṇḍaṃ pṛṣṭhe samarpayan keśāṃścotpāṭayāmāsa nakhapakṣamukhāyudhaḥ|
translation: अस्य his, पृष्ठे back, तुण्डम् beak, समर्पयन् pressing, नखैः claws, विददार pierced, नखपक्षमुखायुधः a warrior with claws, wings and beak as the only weapons, केशांश्च hair too, उत्पाटयामास pulled out.
explanation: Jatayu who had  his claws, wings and beak as the only weapons  pierced and pricked  Ravana all over with his nails by pressing his beak on his back and pulled out his hair.

shloka_text: स तथा गृध्रराजेन क्लिश्यमानो मुहुर्मुहुः।।3.51.36।। अमर्षस्फुरितोष्ठस्सन्प्राकम्पत च रावणः।
transliteration: sa tathā gṛdhrarājena kliśyamāno muhurmuhuḥ amarṣasphuritoṣṭhassanprākampata ca rāvaṇaḥ|
translation: गृध्रराजेन by the king of vultures, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तथा in that manner, क्लिश्यमानः being tormented, सः रावणः he, Ravana, अमर्षफुरितोष्ठः सन् with his lips quivering with anger, प्राकम्पत was shaken.
explanation: Thus tormented again and again by the king of vultures, Ravana shook with anger, his lips quivering.

shloka_text: स परिष्वज्य च वैदेहीं वामेनाङ्केन रावणः।।3.51.37।। तलेनाभिजघानाशु जटायुं क्रोधमुर्छीतः।
transliteration: sa pariṣvajya ca vaidehīṃ vāmenāṅkena rāvaṇaḥ talenābhijaghānāśu jaṭāyuṃ krodhamurchītaḥ|
translation: रावणः Ravana, क्रोधमूर्छितः losing senses with rage, वामेन अङ्केन left arm, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, परिष्वज्य holding firmly, आशु quickly, जटायुम् to Jatayu, तलेन palm, अभिजघान hit him.
explanation: Losing his senses, with rage, Ravana held Vaidehi (Sita) with his left arm and hit Jatayu with his palm.

shloka_text: जटायुस्तमभिक्रम्य तुण्डेनास्य खगाधिपः।।3.51.38।। वामबाहून्दश तदा व्यपाहरदरिन्दमः।
transliteration: jaṭāyustamabhikramya tuṇḍenāsya khagādhipaḥ vāmabāhūndaśa tadā vyapāharadarindamaḥ|
translation: तदा then, खगाधिपः lord of the birds, अरिन्दमः  subduer of enemies, जटायुः Jatayu, तम् him, अभिक्रम्य  occupied, तुण्डेन by his beak, अस्य Ravana's, दश ten, वामबाहून् left arms, व्यपाहरत् cut off.
explanation: Then Jatayu, lord of the birds, subduer of enemies, overpowered Ravana and dismembered his ten left arms with his beak.

shloka_text: सञ्छिन्नबाहोस्सद्यैव बाहवस्सहसाभवन्।।3.51.39।। विषज्वालावलीयुक्ता वल्मीकादिव पन्नगाः।
transliteration: sañchinnabāhossadyaiva bāhavassahasābhavan viṣajvālāvalīyuktā valmīkādiva pannagāḥ|
translation: सञ्छिन्नबाहोः whose arms were cut off, बाहवः arms, सद्यैव instantly from them, वल्मीकात् from an anthill, विषज्वालाः poisonous flames, वलीयुक्ताः emitting, पन्नगाः इव like serpants, सहसा all of a sudden, अभवन् came out.
explanation: As the left arms were cut off, there came out from them all the ten arms instantaneously like serpents emitting poisonous flames from anthills

shloka_text: ततः क्रोधाद्दशग्रीवस्सीतामुत्सृज्य रावणः।।3.51.40।। मुष्टिभ्यां चरणाभ्यां च गृध्रराजमपोथयत्।
transliteration: tataḥ krodhāddaśagrīvassītāmutsṛjya rāvaṇaḥ muṣṭibhyāṃ caraṇābhyāṃ ca gṛdhrarājamapothayat|
translation: ततः then, दशग्रीवः tenheaded, रावणः Ravana, सीताम् Sita, उत्सृज्य left, मुष्टिभ्याम् with his fists, चरणाभ्यां च and feet, गृध्रराजम् Jatayu, क्रोधात् with anger, अपोथयत् attacked.
explanation: Then the tenheaded Ravana left Sita and attacked Jatayu with his fists and feet out of anger.

shloka_text: ततो मुहूर्तं सङ्ग्रामो बभूवातुल्यवीर्ययोः।।3.51.41।। राक्षसानां च मुख्यस्य पक्षिणां प्रवरस्य च।
transliteration: tato muhūrtaṃ saṅgrāmo babhūvātulyavīryayoḥ rākṣasānāṃ ca mukhyasya pakṣiṇāṃ pravarasya ca|
translation: ततः then, अतुलवीर्ययो: of unequal valour, राक्षसानां मुख्यस्य of the chief of the demons, पक्षिणां प्रवरस्य king of the birds, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, सङ्ग्रामः fight, बभूव took place.
explanation: Between the warriors of unequal valour, Ravana and Jatayu, the chief of the demons and the foremost of the birds, the fight took place for a moment.

shloka_text: तस्य व्यायच्छमानस्य रामस्यार्थे स रावणः।।3.51.42।। पक्षौ पार्श्वौ च पादौ च खड्गमुद्धृत्य सोऽच्छिनत्।
transliteration: tasya vyāyacchamānasya rāmasyārthe sa rāvaṇaḥ pakṣau pārśvau ca pādau ca khaḍgamuddhṛtya so'cchinat|
translation: सः that, रावणः Ravana, खडगम् sword, उद्यम्य after lifting, रामस्य Rama's, अर्थे for the sake of, व्यायच्छमानस्य of one who was fighting relentlessly, तस्य his, पक्षौ two wings, पार्श्वौ च  both sides, पादौ च feet, अच्छिनत् cut off.
explanation: Ravana lifted his sword and cut off both the wings and feet of Jatayu who was fighting relentlessly (for Rama's sake).

shloka_text: स च्छिन्नपक्षस्सहसा रक्षसा रौद्रकर्मणा।।3.51.43।। निपपात हतो गृद्रो धरण्यामल्पजीवितः।
transliteration: sa cchinnapakṣassahasā rakṣasā raudrakarmaṇā nipapāta hato gṛdro dharaṇyāmalpajīvitaḥ|
translation: रौद्रकर्मणा one who performs terrible deeds, रक्षसा by the demon, छिन्नपक्षः clipped wings, सः that, गृध्रः vulture, हतः hurt, अल्पजीवितः with very little life left, धरण्याम् on the ground, सहसा immediately, निपपात fell.
explanation: (Seriously) wounded and almost dead,the vulture fell down on the ground all at once, when his wings were chipped by the demon of terrible deeds.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ क्षतजार्द्रं जटायुषम्।।3.51.44।। अभ्यधावत वैदेही स्वबन्धुमिव दुःखिता।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā patitaṃ bhūmau kṣatajārdraṃ jaṭāyuṣam abhyadhāvata vaidehī svabandhumiva duḥkhitā|
translation: वैदेही Sita, princess of Videha, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen down, क्षतजार्द्रम् drenched in blood , तं जटायुषम् that Jatayu, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, दुःखिता grieved, स्वबन्धुमिव as if he was her relative, अभ्यधावत ran towards him.
explanation: Sita, princess of Videha, saw the wounded Jatayu fallen on the ground drenched in blood. Grieving, she ran towards him as if he was her relative.

shloka_text: तं नीलजीमूतनिकाशकल्पं सुपाण्डुरोरस्कमुदारवीर्यम्। ददर्श लङ्काधिपतिः पृथिव्यां जटायुषं शान्तमिवाग्निदावम्।।3.51.45।।
transliteration: taṃ nīlajīmūtanikāśakalpaṃ supāṇḍuroraskamudāravīryam| dadarśa laṅkādhipatiḥ pṛthivyāṃ jaṭāyuṣaṃ śāntamivāgnidāvam
translation: लङ्काधिपतिः lord of Lanka, नीलजीमूतनिकाशकायम् of colour like the dark bluish cloud, सुपाण्डुरोरस्कम् of fair chest, उदारवीर्यम् bold, शान्तम् made calm, अग्निदावमिव like the forest fire, तं जटायुषम् that Jatayu, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Lord of Lanka saw that very bold Jatayu of dark blue colour of the cloud, fair chest, fallen on the ground, looking like the forest fire that had been put out.

shloka_text: ततस्तु तं पत्ररथं महीतले निपातितं रावणवेगमर्दितम्। पुनः परिश्वज्य शशिप्रभानना रुरोद सीता जनकात्मजातदा।।3.51.46।।
transliteration: tatastu taṃ patrarathaṃ mahītale nipātitaṃ rāvaṇavegamarditam| punaḥ pariśvajya śaśiprabhānanā ruroda sītā janakātmajātadā
translation: ततः then, शशिप्रभानना with her face like the radiant moon, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, सीता Sita, तां him, रावणवेगमर्थितम् crushed by Ravana's onslaught, महीतले on the ground, निपातितम् fallen, तं पत्ररथम् that bird who rides on wings, पुनः again, परिष्वज्य took hold of him, रुरोद wept.
explanation: Sita, daughter of Janaka, whose face was radiant like the Moon once again embraced  Jatayu, the winged warrior, fallen on the ground, crushed by Ravana's onslaught and wept. इतयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfirst sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सा तु ताराधिपमुखी रावणेन समीक्ष्य तम्। गृध्रराजं विनिहतं विललाप सुदुःखिता।।3.52.1।।
transliteration: sā tu tārādhipamukhī rāvaṇena samīkṣya tam| gṛdhrarājaṃ vinihataṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitā
translation: ताराधिपमुखी  with Moonlike face, सा तु that Sita, रावणेन by Ravana, विनिहतम् struck down, तं गृध्रराजम् king of the birds, समीक्ष्य  seeing, सुदुःखिता very  much agonised, विललाप wept.
explanation: Sita,whose face was like the lord of the stars (Moon), saw Jatayu, king of birds, struck down by Ravana, and lamented in extreme grif :
comments: Ravana carries away  Sita-- Sita calls out for Rama and Lakshmana again and again.

shloka_text: निमित्तं लक्षणज्ञानं शकुनिस्वरदर्शनम्। अवश्यं सुखदुःखेषु नराणां प्रतिदृश्यते।।3.52.2।।
transliteration: nimittaṃ lakṣaṇajñānaṃ śakunisvaradarśanam| avaśyaṃ sukhaduḥkheṣu narāṇāṃ pratidṛśyate
translation: लक्षणज्ञानम् prognostication, शकुनिस्वरदर्शनम् sounds of ominous birds, नराणाम् for people, सुखदुःखेषु in joy and sorrow, अवश्यम् certainly, निमित्तम् indications, प्रतिदृश्यते are perceived.
explanation: People, for sure, foresee weal and woe in life from auspicious symptoms and ominous sounds.

shloka_text: नूनं राम न जानासि महद्व्यसनमात्मनः। धावन्ति नूनं काकुत्स्थं मदर्थं मृगपक्षिणः।।3.52.3।।
transliteration: nūnaṃ rāma na jānāsi mahadvyasanamātmanaḥ| dhāvanti nūnaṃ kākutsthaṃ madarthaṃ mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ
translation: राम Rama, आत्मनः your, महत् great, व्यसनम् disaster, न जानासि not aware, नूनम् surely, मदर्थम् for my sake, मृगपक्षिणः animals and birds, काकुत्स्थम् towards Kakutstha, धावन्ति running to tell you, नूनम् surely.
explanation: O Rama you are, indeed, unaware of the great disaster that has befallen you. All the animals and birds are running for my sake to tell you about me, O scion  of the Kakutsthas.

shloka_text: अयं हि पापचारेण मां त्रातुमभिसङ्गतः। शेते विनिहतो भूमौ ममाभाग्याद्विहंगमः।।3.52.4।।
transliteration: ayaṃ hi pāpacāreṇa māṃ trātumabhisaṅgataḥ| śete vinihato bhūmau mamābhāgyādvihaṃgamaḥ
translation: माम् me, त्रातुम् to rescue, अभिसङ्गतः has come forward, अयम् his, विहङ्गमः bird, मम for me, अभाग्यात् due to bad luck, पापचारेण by the sinner, विनिहतः is hit down, भूमौ on the ground, शेते lies down.
explanation: 'This bird that came forward to save me is hit by the sinner(Ravana) and lies down on the ground, as ill luck would have it.

shloka_text: त्राहि मामद्य काकुत्स्थ लक्ष्मणेति वराङ्गना। सुसन्त्रस्ता समाक्रन्दच्छृण्वतां तु यथान्तिके।।3.52.5।।
transliteration: trāhi māmadya kākutstha lakṣmaṇeti varāṅganā| susantrastā samākrandacchṛṇvatāṃ tu yathāntike
translation: वराङ्गना beautiful lady, सुसन्त्रस्ता terribly frightened, काकुत्स्थ O Rama, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, अद्य and now, माम् me, त्राहि save, इति thus, अन्तिके close by, शृण्वतां यथा as if listening to her, समाक्रन्दत् cried bitterly.
explanation: Terribly frightened, the beautiful lady (Sita) cried bitterly, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana, save me', as if they were close by and were listening to her.

shloka_text: तां क्लिष्टमाल्याभरणां विलपन्तीमनाथवत्। अभ्यधावत् वैदेहीं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।।3.52.6।।
transliteration: tāṃ kliṣṭamālyābharaṇāṃ vilapantīmanāthavat| abhyadhāvat vaidehīṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
translation: क्लिष्टमाल्याभरणाम् lady whose garlands were crushed and jewels let loose, अनाथवत् like orphan, विलपन्तीम् weeping lady, तां वैदेहीम् that Vaidehi, राक्षसाधिपः demon king, रावणः Ravana, अभ्यधावत ran towards.
explanation: Ravana, king of the demons, ran towards Sita who was weeping like an orphan with her garlands and ornaments crushed.

shloka_text: तां लतामिव वेष्टन्तीमालिङ्गन्तीं महाद्रुमान्। मुञ्च मुञ्चेति बहुशः प्रवदन्राक्षसाधिपः।।3.52.7।। क्रोशन्तीं राम रामेति रामेण रहितां वने। जीवितान्ताय केशेषु जग्राहान्तकसन्निभः।।3.52.8।।
transliteration: tāṃ latāmiva veṣṭantīmāliṅgantīṃ mahādrumān| muñca muñceti bahuśaḥ pravadanrākṣasādhipaḥ krośantīṃ rāma rāmeti rāmeṇa rahitāṃ vane| jīvitāntāya keśeṣu jagrāhāntakasannibhaḥ
translation: अन्तकसन्निभः like Yama, lord of death, राक्षसाधिपः lord of the demons, लतामिव like a creeper, महाद्रुमान् huge trees, वेष्टन्तीम् coiled  आलिङ्गन्तीम् embracing, वने in the forest, रामेण by Rama, रहिताम् separated from, राम रामेति saying 'Rama, Rama', क्रोशन्तीम् lamenting, ताम् her, मुञ्च मुञ्च इति leave it, leave it, बहुशः several times, प्रवदन् uttering, जीवितान्ताय to bring an end to his life, केशेषु by her hair, जग्राह caught hold.
explanation: Separated from Rama in the forest, Sita hugged huge trees, running round and round like a creeper coiled, crying loudly, 'Rama, O Rama' . The king of the demons, like Yama, caught hold of her hair only to invite his death, all the time saying, Leave it, Leave it  (Leave the tree).

shloka_text: तां लतामिव वेष्टन्तीमालिङ्गन्तीं महाद्रुमान्। मुञ्च मुञ्चेति बहुशः प्रवदन्राक्षसाधिपः।।3.52.7।। क्रोशन्तीं राम रामेति रामेण रहितां वने। जीवितान्ताय केशेषु जग्राहान्तकसन्निभः।।3.52.8।।
transliteration: tāṃ latāmiva veṣṭantīmāliṅgantīṃ mahādrumān| muñca muñceti bahuśaḥ pravadanrākṣasādhipaḥ krośantīṃ rāma rāmeti rāmeṇa rahitāṃ vane| jīvitāntāya keśeṣu jagrāhāntakasannibhaḥ
translation: अन्तकसन्निभः like Yama, lord of death, राक्षसाधिपः lord of the demons, लतामिव like a creeper, महाद्रुमान् huge trees, वेष्टन्तीम् coiled  आलिङ्गन्तीम् embracing, वने in the forest, रामेण by Rama, रहिताम् separated from, राम रामेति saying 'Rama, Rama', क्रोशन्तीम् lamenting, ताम् her, मुञ्च मुञ्च इति leave it, leave it, बहुशः several times, प्रवदन् uttering, जीवितान्ताय to bring an end to his life, केशेषु by her hair, जग्राह caught hold.
explanation: Separated from Rama in the forest, Sita hugged huge trees, running round and round like a creeper coiled, crying loudly, 'Rama, O Rama' . The king of the demons, like Yama, caught hold of her hair only to invite his death, all the time saying, Leave it, Leave it  (Leave the tree).

shloka_text: प्रधर्षितायां सीतायां बभूव सचराचरम्। जगत्सर्वममर्यादं तमसान्धेन संवृतम्।।3.52.9।। न वाति मारुतस्तत्र निष्प्रभोऽभूद्दिवाकरः।
transliteration: pradharṣitāyāṃ sītāyāṃ babhūva sacarācaram| jagatsarvamamaryādaṃ tamasāndhena saṃvṛtam na vāti mārutastatra niṣprabho'bhūddivākaraḥ|
translation: सीतायाम् when Sita, प्रधर्षितायाम् was assaulted, सचराचरम् with all beings animate and inanimate, सर्वम् all, जगत् world, अमर्यादम् crossed all moral law, अन्धेन तमसा  by pitch darkness, संवृतम्  enveloped, बभूव became, तत्र then, मारुतः wind, न वाति did not blow, दिवाकरः the Sun, निष्प्रभः lustreless, अभूत् became.
explanation: While Sita was being assaulted, the earth with the animate and the inanimate crossed all limits of moral law and became enveloped in blinding darkness. The wind  ceased to blow and the Sun, to shine.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा सीतां परामृष्टां दीनां दिव्येन चक्षुषा।।3.52.10।। कृतं कार्यमिति श्रीमान्व्याजहार पितामहः।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ parāmṛṣṭāṃ dīnāṃ divyena cakṣuṣā kṛtaṃ kāryamiti śrīmānvyājahāra pitāmahaḥ|
translation: श्रीमान् glorious, पितामहः grandfather( Brahma), दीनाम् a desperate woman, सीताम् Sita, परामृष्टाम् assaulted by the enemy, दिव्येन divine, चक्षुषा eyes, दृष्ट्वा saw, कार्यम् the task, कृतम् is accomplished, इति thus, व्याजहार said.
explanation: Brahma, the glorious Grandfather, saw with his divine eyes, Sita in a desperate state caught by the enemy and said, 'The task is accomplished.

shloka_text: प्रहृष्टा व्यथिताश्चासन्सर्वे ते परमर्षयः।।3.52.11।। दृष्ट्वा सीतां परामृष्टां दण्डकारण्यवासिनः। रावणस्य विनाशं च प्राप्तं बुद्ध्वा यदृच्छया।।3.52.12।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭā vyathitāścāsansarve te paramarṣayaḥ dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ parāmṛṣṭāṃ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ| rāvaṇasya vināśaṃ ca prāptaṃ buddhvā yadṛcchayā
translation: दण्डकारण्यवासिनः residents of Dandaka forest, सर्वे all, ते those, परमर्षयः great seers, सीताम् Sita, परामृष्टाम्  abducted, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, यदृच्छया that which happened naturally, रावणस्य Ravana's, विनाशं च destruction, प्राप्तम् has come, बुद्ध्वा knowing, प्रहृष्टाः happy, व्यथिताश्च distressed, आसन् became.
explanation: All the great seers residing in Dandaka forest felt both happy and sad, happy because the destruction of Ravana is at hand and sad because Sita was in distress.

shloka_text: प्रहृष्टा व्यथिताश्चासन्सर्वे ते परमर्षयः।।3.52.11।। दृष्ट्वा सीतां परामृष्टां दण्डकारण्यवासिनः। रावणस्य विनाशं च प्राप्तं बुद्ध्वा यदृच्छया।।3.52.12।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭā vyathitāścāsansarve te paramarṣayaḥ dṛṣṭvā sītāṃ parāmṛṣṭāṃ daṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ| rāvaṇasya vināśaṃ ca prāptaṃ buddhvā yadṛcchayā
translation: दण्डकारण्यवासिनः residents of Dandaka forest, सर्वे all, ते those, परमर्षयः great seers, सीताम् Sita, परामृष्टाम्  abducted, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, यदृच्छया that which happened naturally, रावणस्य Ravana's, विनाशं च destruction, प्राप्तम् has come, बुद्ध्वा knowing, प्रहृष्टाः happy, व्यथिताश्च distressed, आसन् became.
explanation: All the great seers residing in Dandaka forest felt both happy and sad, happy because the destruction of Ravana is at hand and sad because Sita was in distress.

shloka_text: स तु तां राम रामेति रुदन्तीं लक्ष्मणेति च। जगामादाय चाकाशं रावणो राक्षसाधिपः।।3.52.13।।
transliteration: sa tu tāṃ rāma rāmeti rudantīṃ lakṣmaṇeti ca| jagāmādāya cākāśaṃ rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ
translation: राक्षसाधिपः lord of the demons, सः रावणः that Ravana, राम रामेति saying, Rama, O Rama, लक्ष्मणेति च O Lakshmana, रुदन्तीम् crying, ताम् her, आदाय taking her, आकाशम् into the  sky, जगाम went.
explanation: While Sita was crying, 'O Rama, O Lakshmana', Ravana, lord of the demons, carried her back into the sky.

shloka_text: तप्ताभरणजुष्टाङ्गी पीतकौशेयवासिनी। रराजराजपुत्री तुविद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा।।3.52.14।।
transliteration: taptābharaṇajuṣṭāṅgī pītakauśeyavāsinī| rarājarājaputrī tuvidyutsaudāminī yathā
translation: तप्ताभरणजुष्टाङ्गी lady wearing on her limbs pure gold ornaments, पीतकौशेयवासिनी lady clad in yelow silk, राजपुत्री princess, विद्युत् सौदामिनी यथा like lightning, रराज shone.
explanation: SIta who had put on pure gold ornaments on her body and who was clad in yellow silk  shone like lightning.

shloka_text: उद्धूतेन च वस्त्रेण तस्याः पीतेन रावणः। अधिकं परिबभ्राज गिरिर्दीप्त इवाग्निना।।3.52.15।।
transliteration: uddhūtena ca vastreṇa tasyāḥ pītena rāvaṇaḥ| adhikaṃ paribabhrāja girirdīpta ivāgninā
translation: तस्याः her, उद्धूतेन blown, पीतेन yellow, वस्त्रेण clothes, रावणः Ravana, अग्निना with fire, दीप्तः glowing, गिरिरिव like a mountain अधिकम् more, परिबभ्राज shone.
explanation: Ravana was shining all the more with(her) yellow clothes blowing in the air, and looked like a mountain shining with fire burning around.

shloka_text: तस्याः परमकल्याण्यास्ताम्राणि सुरभीणि च। पद्मपत्राणि वैदेह्या अभ्यकीर्यन्त रावणम्।।3.52.16।।
transliteration: tasyāḥ paramakalyāṇyāstāmrāṇi surabhīṇi ca| padmapatrāṇi vaidehyā abhyakīryanta rāvaṇam
translation: परमकल्याण्याः of the most auspicious, तस्याः her, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, ताम्राणि copper  coloured, सुरभीणि fragrant, पद्मपत्राणि lotus petals, रावणम् Ravana, अभ्यकीर्यन्त were showered on him.
explanation: The red lotus petals worn by the most auspicious Sita, princess of Videha, were showered on Ravana.

shloka_text: तस्याः कौशेयमुद्धूतमाकाशे कनकप्रभम्। बभौ चादित्यरागेण ताम्रमभ्रमिवातपे।।3.52.17।।
transliteration: tasyāḥ kauśeyamuddhūtamākāśe kanakaprabham| babhau cādityarāgeṇa tāmramabhramivātape
translation: तस्याः her, आकाशे in the sky, उद्धूतम् blown by the wind, कनकप्रभम् goldenhued, कौशेयम् silken robes, आतपे exposed to the evening Sun , आदित्यरागेण by the Sun's redness, ताम्रम् red, अभ्रमिव cloudlike, बभौ appeared.
explanation: As the goldencoloured garment worn by Sita blew in the wind, it looked like a coppercoloured cloud illumined by the evening Sun in the sky.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तत्सुनसं वक्त्रमाकाशे रावणाङ्कगम्। न रराज विना रामं विनालमिव पङ्कजम्।।3.52.18।।
transliteration: tasyāstatsunasaṃ vaktramākāśe rāvaṇāṅkagam| na rarāja vinā rāmaṃ vinālamiva paṅkajam
translation: आकाशे in the sky, रावणाङ्कगम् in the lap of Ravana, सुनसम् with a beautiful nose, तस्याः वक्त्रम् her face, रामं विना without Rama, विनालम् without stalk, पङ्कजम् इव like lotus, न रराज did not shine.
explanation: Sita's face with her beautiful nose on Ravana's lap and not on Rama's, shone no more like a lotus without its stalk.

shloka_text: बभूव जलदं नीलं भित्त्वा चन्द्र इवोदितः। सुललाटं सुकेशान्तं पद्मगर्भाभमव्रणम्।।3.52.19।। शुक्लैस्सुविमलैर्दन्तै प्रभावद्भिरलङ्कृतम्। तस्यास्तद्विमलं वक्त्रमाकाशे रावणाङ्कगम्।।3.52.20।। रुदितं व्यपमृष्टास्रं चन्द्रवत्प्रियदर्शनम्। सुनासं चारुताम्रोष्ठमाकाशे हाटकप्रभम्।।3.52.21।।
transliteration: babhūva jaladaṃ nīlaṃ bhittvā candra ivoditaḥ| sulalāṭaṃ sukeśāntaṃ padmagarbhābhamavraṇam śuklaissuvimalairdantai prabhāvadbhiralaṅkṛtam| tasyāstadvimalaṃ vaktramākāśe rāvaṇāṅkagam ruditaṃ vyapamṛṣṭāsraṃ candravatpriyadarśanam| sunāsaṃ cārutāmroṣṭhamākāśe hāṭakaprabham
translation: सुललाटम् a fine forehead, सुकेशान्तम् beautiful hair, पद्मगर्भाभम्  the glow of the inner side of a fully blossomed lotus, अव्रणम् whose face had no marks, शुक्लैः white, सुविमलैः  clean, प्रभावद्भि: shining, दन्तैः teeth, अलङ्कृतम् decorated, रुदितम् as she wept, व्यपमृष्टास्रम् wiped her tears, सुनासम् of nice nose, चारुताम्रोष्ठम् with lovely red lips, आकाशे in the sky, हाटकप्रभम् having golden glow, रावणाङ्कगम् held by Ravana, तस्याः her, तत् that, विमलम् pure, वक्त्रम् face, नीलम् dark blue, जलदम् rain cloud, भित्त्वा breaking through, उदितः risen, चन्द्र इव like Moon, बभूव appeared.
explanation: Sita's face looked beautiful with her smooth forehead, shining hair and spotless complexion like the inside of a lotus, with clean, white, shining teeth, a nice nose and lovely red lips. She was continuously weeping and wiping her tears. Her face which was pleasing like the Moon on the lap of Ravana appeared as though the Moon was rising through dark clouds.

shloka_text: बभूव जलदं नीलं भित्त्वा चन्द्र इवोदितः। सुललाटं सुकेशान्तं पद्मगर्भाभमव्रणम्।।3.52.19।। शुक्लैस्सुविमलैर्दन्तै प्रभावद्भिरलङ्कृतम्। तस्यास्तद्विमलं वक्त्रमाकाशे रावणाङ्कगम्।।3.52.20।। रुदितं व्यपमृष्टास्रं चन्द्रवत्प्रियदर्शनम्। सुनासं चारुताम्रोष्ठमाकाशे हाटकप्रभम्।।3.52.21।।

translation: सुललाटम् a fine forehead, सुकेशान्तम् beautiful hair, पद्मगर्भाभम्  the glow of the inner side of a fully blossomed lotus, अव्रणम् whose face had no marks, शुक्लैः white, सुविमलैः  clean, प्रभावद्भि: shining, दन्तैः teeth, अलङ्कृतम् decorated, रुदितम् as she wept, व्यपमृष्टास्रम् wiped her tears, सुनासम् of nice nose, चारुताम्रोष्ठम् with lovely red lips, आकाशे in the sky, हाटकप्रभम् having golden glow, रावणाङ्कगम् held by Ravana, तस्याः her, तत् that, विमलम् pure, वक्त्रम् face, नीलम् dark blue, जलदम् rain cloud, भित्त्वा breaking through, उदितः risen, चन्द्र इव like Moon, बभूव appeared.
explanation: Sita's face looked beautiful with her smooth forehead, shining hair and spotless complexion like the inside of a lotus, with clean, white, shining teeth, a nice nose and lovely red lips. She was continuously weeping and wiping her tears. Her face which was pleasing like the Moon on the lap of Ravana appeared as though the Moon was rising through dark clouds.
