explanation: The goldtipped arrows released from his bowstring will shatter your body like the waves erode the banks of river Ganga.

shloka_text: असुरैर्वा सुरैर्वा त्वं यद्यवध्योऽसि रावण। उत्पाद्य सुमहद्वैरं जीवंस्तस्य न मोक्ष्यसे।।3.56.8।।
transliteration: asurairvā surairvā tvaṃ yadyavadhyo'si rāvaṇa| utpādya sumahadvairaṃ jīvaṃstasya na mokṣyase
translation: रावण O Ravana, त्वम् you, असुरैर्वा by demons, सुरैर्वा or by gods, अवध्यः are not to be killed, असि यदि even if, सुमहत् great, वैरम् enmity, उत्पाद्य after creating, जीवन् with life, तस्य his, न मोक्ष्यसे you will not be released.
explanation: O Ravana, even if you stand invulnerable to gods and demons, you will not come out alive in the combat with Rama with whom you have earned great enmity.

shloka_text: स ते जीवितशेषस्य राघवोऽन्तकरो बली। पशोर्यूपगतस्येव जीवितं तव दुर्लभम्।।3.56.9।।
transliteration: sa te jīvitaśeṣasya rāghavo'ntakaro balī| paśoryūpagatasyeva jīvitaṃ tava durlabham
translation: बली powerful, सः राघवः  Rama, ते your, जीवितशेषस्य of the little life left, अन्तकरः destroyer of life, यूपगतस्य  tied to the sacrificial post, पशोरिव like a beast ready for sacrifice, तव your, जीवितम् life, दुर्लभम् difficult to survive.
explanation: Powerful Rama will put an end to whatever little life you are left with. Just as a beast tied to a sacrificial post, you will not  survive.

shloka_text: यदि पश्येत्स रामस्त्वां रोषदीप्तेन चक्षुषा। रक्षस्त्वमद्य निर्धग्धो गच्छेस्सद्यः पराभवम्।।3.56.10।।
transliteration: yadi paśyetsa rāmastvāṃ roṣadīptena cakṣuṣā| rakṣastvamadya nirdhagdho gacchessadyaḥ parābhavam
translation: रक्षः O demon, सः रामः that Rama, रोषदीप्तेन burning with anger, चक्षुषा with eyes, त्वाम् you, पश्येत् if he sees, अद्य now, सद्यः instantly, त्वम् you, निर्धग्धः totally burnt, पराभवम् गच्छेः you will be destroyed.
explanation: O demon, you will be completely consumed if Rama looks at you with eyes burning in anger.

shloka_text: यश्चन्द्रं नभसो भूमौ पातयेन्नाशयेत वा। सागरं शोषयेद्वापि स सीतां मोचयेदिह।।3.56.11।।
transliteration: yaścandraṃ nabhaso bhūmau pātayennāśayeta vā| sāgaraṃ śoṣayedvāpi sa sītāṃ mocayediha
translation: यः he who, चन्द्रम् Moon, नभसः from the sky, भूमौ on the earth, पातयेत् can bring down, वा or even, नाशयेत destroy, सागरम् sea, शोषयेद्वापि will make it dry, सः he, इह here, सीताम् Sita, मोचयेत् will liberate
explanation: He who can bring down the Moon to the earth from the sky or even dash it down, he who can drain the sea dry will definitely release me from here.

shloka_text: गतायुस्त्वं गतश्रीको गतसत्त्व गतेन्द्रियः। लङ्का वैधव्यसंयुक्ता त्वत्कृतेन भविष्यति।।3.56.12।।
transliteration: gatāyustvaṃ gataśrīko gatasattva gatendriyaḥ| laṅkā vaidhavyasaṃyuktā tvatkṛtena bhaviṣyati
translation: त्वम् you, गतायुः life is gone, गतश्रीकः deprived of your fortune, गतसत्त्व your strength sapped, गतेन्द्रियः your senses dissipated, त्वत्कृतेन  by  your action, लङ्का Lanka, वैधव्यसंयुक्ता भविष्यति attain widowhood.
explanation: Your life is coming to an end. Your fortunes will wane, your strength will be sapped. Your senses will be dissipated. By your deeds Lanka will attain widowhood.

shloka_text: न ते पापमिदं कर्म शुखोदर्कं भविष्यति। याऽहं नीता विनाभावं पतिपार्श्वात्त्वया वने।।3.56.13।।
transliteration: na te pāpamidaṃ karma śukhodarkaṃ bhaviṣyati| yā'haṃ nītā vinābhāvaṃ patipārśvāttvayā vane
translation: ते you, इदम् this, कर्म deed, शुखोदर्कम् will result in happiness, न भविष्यति will not be, या which, अहम् I, त्वया by you, वने in the forest, पतिपार्श्वात् from my husband, विनाभावम् without any feeling, नीता I am brought.
explanation: This evil deed(of abduction) will not yield happy results.You have brought me from my husband from the forest without any forethought.

shloka_text: स हि दैवतसंयुक्तो मम भर्ता महाद्युतिः। निर्भयो वीर्यमाश्रित्य शून्ये वसति दण्डके।।3.56.14।।
transliteration: sa hi daivatasaṃyukto mama bhartā mahādyutiḥ| nirbhayo vīryamāśritya śūnye vasati daṇḍake
translation: महाद्युतिः effulgent, मम my, भर्ता husband, सः he, वीर्यम् valour, आश्रित्य resorting to, निर्भयः a fearless, दैवतसंयुक्तः supported by divine power, शून्ये in a desolate, दण्डके in Dandaka, वसति is dwelling.
explanation: My effulgent, valiant husband armed with divine power resides fearlessly in the desolate Dandaka.

shloka_text: स ते दर्पं बलं वीर्यमुत्सेकं च तथाविधम्। अपनेष्यति गात्रेभ्यश्शरवर्षेण संयुगे।।3.56.15।।
transliteration: sa te darpaṃ balaṃ vīryamutsekaṃ ca tathāvidham| apaneṣyati gātrebhyaśśaravarṣeṇa saṃyuge
translation: सः he, संयुगे in combat, शरवर्षेण with showers of arrows, ते your, गात्रेभ्यः from limbs, दर्पम् pride, बलम् power, वीर्यम् heroism, तथाविधम् as such, उत्सेकं च haughtiness, अपनेष्यति will remove.
explanation: He will remove your pride, your power, your valour and haughtiness from your limbs with a shower of arrows in the fight.

shloka_text: यदा विनाशो भूतानां दृश्यते कालचोदितः। तदा कार्ये प्रमाद्यन्ति नराः कालवशं गताः।।3.56.16।।
transliteration: yadā vināśo bhūtānāṃ dṛśyate kālacoditaḥ| tadā kārye pramādyanti narāḥ kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ
translation: भूतानाम् for the living beings, यदा whenever, कालचोदितः prompted by time (death), विनाशः destruction, दृश्यते is seen, तदा then, नराः men, कालवशम् overcome by time, गताः become, कार्ये deeds, प्रमाद्यन्ति commit blunders.
explanation: When destruction draws near, people being prompted by time start commiting blunders in their deeds.

shloka_text: मां प्रधृष्य स ते कालः प्राप्तोऽयं राक्षसाधम। आत्मनो राक्षसानां च वधायान्तःपुरस्य च।।3.56.17।।
transliteration: māṃ pradhṛṣya sa te kālaḥ prāpto'yaṃ rākṣasādhama| ātmano rākṣasānāṃ ca vadhāyāntaḥpurasya ca
translation: राक्षसाधम O vilest of demons, माम् me, प्रधृष्य having assaulted, आत्मनः your, राक्षसानां च of all  demons, अन्तःपुरस्य च and of women of the harem, वधाय for destruction, सः कालः that time, ते to you, प्राप्तः has come near.
explanation: You vilest of demons, since you have assaulted me, the time of your death and destruction of all demons and of all women in the harem has drawn near.

shloka_text: न शक्या यज्ञमध्यस्था वेदी सृग्भाण्डमण्डिता। द्विजातिमन्त्रपूता च चण्डालेनावमर्दितुम्।।3.56.18।।
transliteration: na śakyā yajñamadhyasthā vedī sṛgbhāṇḍamaṇḍitā| dvijātimantrapūtā ca caṇḍālenāvamarditum
translation: यज्ञमध्यस्था in the midst of the sacrificial ceremony, सुग्भाण्डमण्डिता decorated with ladles  and other vessels, द्विजातिमन्त्रपूता च sanctified by brahmins uttering sacred Vedic hymns, वेदी altar, चण्डालेन by a man of low caste, अवमर्दितुम् to violate, न शक्या is not possible.
explanation: The sacrificial altar adorned with ladles and vessels and sanctified by the sacred mantras recited by brahmins cannot be defiled by a chandala (man of lowest caste).

shloka_text: तथाऽहं धर्मनित्यस्य धर्मपत्नी पतिव्रता। त्वया स्पृष्टुं न शक्यास्मि राक्षसाधम पापिना।।3.56.19।।
transliteration: tathā'haṃ dharmanityasya dharmapatnī pativratā| tvayā spṛṣṭuṃ na śakyāsmi rākṣasādhama pāpinā
translation: राक्षसाधम lowly demon, तथा similarly, धर्मनित्यस्य of the ever righteous, धर्मपत्नी rigteous wife, पतिव्रता chaste woman, अहम् I am, पापिना sinner, त्वया you, स्पृष्टुम् to touch, शक्या possible, नास्मि not.
explanation: O lowly demon  similarly I am a chaste woman and wife of the ever righteous Rama who cannot be defiled by a sinner like you.

shloka_text: क्रीडन्ती राजहंसेन पद्मषण्डेषु नित्यदा। हंसी सा तृणषण्डस्थं कथं पश्येत मद्गुकम्।।3.56.20।।
transliteration: krīḍantī rājahaṃsena padmaṣaṇḍeṣu nityadā| haṃsī sā tṛṇaṣaṇḍasthaṃ kathaṃ paśyeta madgukam
translation: पद्मषण्डेषु lotus ponds, नित्यदा always, राजहंसेन with royal swan, क्रीडन्ती sporting, सा हंसी for that female swan, तृणषण्डस्थम् resting on grass land, मद्गुकम् watercrow, कथम् how can, पश्येत will see.
explanation: How can a female swan ever sporting in lotusponds in the company of a royal swan look at the watercrow resting on a grassy land?

shloka_text: इदं शरीरं निस्संज्ञं बन्ध वा खातयस्व वा। नेदं शरीरं रक्षयं मे जीवितं वापि राक्षस।।3.56.21।। न तु शक्ष्याम्युपक्रोशं पृथिव्यां दातुमात्मनः।
transliteration: idaṃ śarīraṃ nissaṃjñaṃ bandha vā khātayasva vā| nedaṃ śarīraṃ rakṣayaṃ me jīvitaṃ vāpi rākṣasa na tu śakṣyāmyupakrośaṃ pṛthivyāṃ dātumātmanaḥ|
translation: राक्षस demon, निस्संज्ञम् unconscious, इदम् this, शरीरम् body, बन्ध वा bind it on, वा खातयस्व or bury, मे to me, इदम् this, शरीरम् body, जीवितं वा even life, रक्षयम् to protect, न not, तु but, पृथिव्याम् on earth, आत्मन: of myself, उपक्रोशम् ignominy, दातुम् to give, न शक्ष्यामि not possible.
explanation: O demon  this body has (now) no consciousness. You may bind it or bury it. I do not think that this body or even this life need to be protected. But at no cost can I make this an object of censure on earth (must not be branded an unchaste woman).

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही क्रोधात्सुपरुषं वचः।।3.56.22।। रावणं मैथिली तत्र पुनर्नोवाच किञ्चन।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu vaidehī krodhātsuparuṣaṃ vacaḥ rāvaṇaṃ maithilī tatra punarnovāca kiñcana|
translation: वैदेही Sita (Vaidehi), मैथिली princess from Mithila, क्रोधात् in anger, रावणम् Ravana, एवम् in that way, सुपरुषम् very harsh, वचः words, उक्त्वा having uttered, तत्र there, पुनः again, किञ्चन not, नोवाच speak.
explanation: Having uttered these very harsh words out of anger, the daughter of Videha, the princess from Mithila spoke no more.

shloka_text: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा परुषं रोमहर्षणम्।।3.56.23।। प्रत्युवाच ततस्सीतां भयसन्दर्शनं वचः।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā paruṣaṃ romaharṣaṇam pratyuvāca tatassītāṃ bhayasandarśanaṃ vacaḥ|
translation: सीतायाः Sita's such, परुषम् harsh, रोमहर्षणम् horripilating, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, ततः then, सीताम् Sita, भयसन्दर्शनम् creating fear, वचः words, प्रत्युवाच  replied.
explanation: Having heard such harsh, horripilating words from Sita, Ravana replied in a way designed to create fear in her:

shloka_text: शृणु मैथिलि मद्वाक्यं मासान्द्वादश भामिनि।।3.56.24।। कालेनानेन नाभ्येषि यदि मां चारुहासिनि। ततस्त्वां प्रातराशार्थं सूदाश्छेत्स्यन्ति लेशशः।।3.56.25।।
transliteration: śṛṇu maithili madvākyaṃ māsāndvādaśa bhāmini kālenānena nābhyeṣi yadi māṃ cāruhāsini| tatastvāṃ prātarāśārthaṃ sūdāśchetsyanti leśaśaḥ
translation: मैथिलि Princess from Mithila, भामिनि lovely one, मद्वाक्यम् my statement, शृणु listen, द्वादश twelve, मासान् months, चारुहासिनि a lady with sweet smile, अनेन otherwise, कालेन in course of time, माम् me, नाभ्येषि यदि if you do not accept my hand, ततः thereupon, सूदाः cooks, त्वाम् you, प्रातराशार्थे for breakfast, लेशशः in small bits, छेत्स्यन्ति will cut you.
explanation: O comely princess from Mithila, O lady with a sweet smile listen to my words. If you do not accept my hand in the course of twelve months, the cooks will cut you off into small bits for the (my) breakfast.

shloka_text: शृणु मैथिलि मद्वाक्यं मासान्द्वादश भामिनि।।3.56.24।। कालेनानेन नाभ्येषि यदि मां चारुहासिनि। ततस्त्वां प्रातराशार्थं सूदाश्छेत्स्यन्ति लेशशः।।3.56.25।।
transliteration: śṛṇu maithili madvākyaṃ māsāndvādaśa bhāmini kālenānena nābhyeṣi yadi māṃ cāruhāsini| tatastvāṃ prātarāśārthaṃ sūdāśchetsyanti leśaśaḥ
translation: मैथिलि Princess from Mithila, भामिनि lovely one, मद्वाक्यम् my statement, शृणु listen, द्वादश twelve, मासान् months, चारुहासिनि a lady with sweet smile, अनेन otherwise, कालेन in course of time, माम् me, नाभ्येषि यदि if you do not accept my hand, ततः thereupon, सूदाः cooks, त्वाम् you, प्रातराशार्थे for breakfast, लेशशः in small bits, छेत्स्यन्ति will cut you.
explanation: O comely princess from Mithila, O lady with a sweet smile listen to my words. If you do not accept my hand in the course of twelve months, the cooks will cut you off into small bits for the (my) breakfast.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा परुषं वाक्यं रावणश्शत्रुरावणः। राक्षसीश्च ततः क्रुद्ध इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.56.26।।
transliteration: ityuktvā paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ rāvaṇaśśatrurāvaṇaḥ| rākṣasīśca tataḥ kruddha idaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: शत्रुरावणः who makes enemies wail, रावणः Ravana, इति these, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, उक्त्वा having said, ततः then, क्रुद्धः enraged, राक्षसीः demoness, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Enraged Ravana, who used to make enemies wail, turned to the demonesses and said these words.

shloka_text: शीघ्रमेव हि राक्षस्यो विकृता घोरदर्शनाः। दर्पमस्या विनेष्यध्वं मांसशोणितभोजनाः।।3.56.27।।
transliteration: śīghrameva hi rākṣasyo vikṛtā ghoradarśanāḥ| darpamasyā vineṣyadhvaṃ māṃsaśoṇitabhojanāḥ
translation: विकृताः loathsome, घोरदर्शनाः fearful, मांसशोणितभोजनाः flesheaters and bloodsulkers, राक्षस्यः demonesses, शीघ्रमेव at once, अस्याः her, दर्पम् pride, विनेष्यध्वम् humble.
explanation: Addressing the flesheating, blooddrinking, loathsome and fearful demonesses Ravana said, Humble her pride at once.

shloka_text: वचनादेव तास्तस्य सुघोरा राक्षसीगणाः। कृतप्राञ्जलयो भूत्वा मैथिलीं पर्यवारयन्।।3.56.28।।
transliteration: vacanādeva tāstasya sughorā rākṣasīgaṇāḥ| kṛtaprāñjalayo bhūtvā maithilīṃ paryavārayan
translation: सुघोराः very dreadful one, ताः they, राक्षसीगणाः demonesses, तस्य his, वचनादेव soon after he said, कृत प्राञ्जलयः (offered obeisance) with folded hands, भूत्वा being, मैथिलीम् पर्यवारयन् surrounded Sita.
explanation: No sooner had Ravana said it than the dreadful demonesses offered obeisance to him with folded hands and surrounded Sita.

shloka_text: स ताः प्रोवाच राजा तु रावणो घोरदर्शनः। प्रचाल्य चरणोत्कर्षैर्दारयन्निव मेदिनीम्।।3.56.29।।
transliteration: sa tāḥ provāca rājā tu rāvaṇo ghoradarśanaḥ| pracālya caraṇotkarṣairdārayanniva medinīm
translation: घोरदर्शनः of terrific form, राजा king, सः रावणः that Ravana, चरणोत्कर्षैः stamping his feet, मेदिनीम् on the ground, प्रचाल्य after shaking, दारयन्निव as if tearing the ground, ताः to them, प्रोवाच said.
explanation: Stamping his feet and shaking the ground as if tearing the earth, Ravana said to those fiercelooking demonesses:

shloka_text: अशोकवनिकामध्ये मैथिली नीयतामियम्। तत्रेयं रक्ष्यतां गूढं युष्माभिः परिवारिता।।3.56.30।।
transliteration: aśokavanikāmadhye maithilī nīyatāmiyam| tatreyaṃ rakṣyatāṃ gūḍhaṃ yuṣmābhiḥ parivāritā
translation: इयं मैथिली this Maithili (sita), अशोकवनिकामध्ये in the middle of Asoka grove, नीयताम् take, तत्र there, इयम् she, युष्माभिः by you, परिवारिता surrounded by, गूढम् secretly, रक्ष्यताम् protect.
explanation: Let this Sita be led into the Asoka grove. There sit round her and protect her in secret (her presence there should not be made public).

shloka_text: तत्रैनां तर्जनैर्घोरैः पुनस्सान्त्वैश्च मैथिलीम्। आनयध्वं वशं सर्वा वन्यां गजवधूमिव।।3.56.31।।
transliteration: tatraināṃ tarjanairghoraiḥ punassāntvaiśca maithilīm| ānayadhvaṃ vaśaṃ sarvā vanyāṃ gajavadhūmiva
translation: तत्र there, सर्वाः all, एनां मैथिलीम् this Sita, घोरैः terrrific, तर्जनैः threatening, पुनः again, सान्त्वश्च by gently coaxing, वन्याम् wild, गजवधूमिव like a female elephant, वशम् under control, आनयध्वम् being her.
explanation: There you all bring her under control through forcing and cajoling as one would do to tame a wild sheelephant.

shloka_text: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टा राक्षस्यो रावणेन ताः। अशोकवनिकां जग्मुर्मैथिलीं परिगृह्य तु।।3.56.32।। सर्वकालफलैर्वृक्षैर्नानापुष्पफलैर्वृताम्। सर्वकालमदैश्चापि द्विजैस्समुपसेविताम्।।3.56.33।।
transliteration: iti pratisamādiṣṭā rākṣasyo rāvaṇena tāḥ| aśokavanikāṃ jagmurmaithilīṃ parigṛhya tu sarvakālaphalairvṛkṣairnānāpuṣpaphalairvṛtām| sarvakālamadaiścāpi dvijaissamupasevitām
translation: रावणेन Ravana, इति like that, प्रतिसमादिष्टाः instructed, ताः those, राक्षस्यः demonesses, मैथिलीम् to Sita, परिगृह्य  took, सर्वकालफलैः with fruits of all seasons, नानापुष्पफलैः with different kinds of flowers and fruits, वृक्षैः with trees, वृताम् surrounded, सर्वकालमदैः cheerful in all seaons, द्विजैः birds, समुपसेविताम् served by, अशोकवनिकाम् to the Asoka grove, जग्मुः went.
explanation: Thus instructed by Ravana, the demonesses took Sita into the Asoka grove, which was full of perenmal fruits and flowers of different kinds, where trees yielded fruits of all seasons and birds were always cheerful.

shloka_text: इति प्रतिसमादिष्टा राक्षस्यो रावणेन ताः। अशोकवनिकां जग्मुर्मैथिलीं परिगृह्य तु।।3.56.32।। सर्वकालफलैर्वृक्षैर्नानापुष्पफलैर्वृताम्। सर्वकालमदैश्चापि द्विजैस्समुपसेविताम्।।3.56.33।।
transliteration: iti pratisamādiṣṭā rākṣasyo rāvaṇena tāḥ| aśokavanikāṃ jagmurmaithilīṃ parigṛhya tu sarvakālaphalairvṛkṣairnānāpuṣpaphalairvṛtām| sarvakālamadaiścāpi dvijaissamupasevitām
translation: रावणेन Ravana, इति like that, प्रतिसमादिष्टाः instructed, ताः those, राक्षस्यः demonesses, मैथिलीम् to Sita, परिगृह्य  took, सर्वकालफलैः with fruits of all seasons, नानापुष्पफलैः with different kinds of flowers and fruits, वृक्षैः with trees, वृताम् surrounded, सर्वकालमदैः cheerful in all seaons, द्विजैः birds, समुपसेविताम् served by, अशोकवनिकाम् to the Asoka grove, जग्मुः went.
explanation: Thus instructed by Ravana, the demonesses took Sita into the Asoka grove, which was full of perenmal fruits and flowers of different kinds, where trees yielded fruits of all seasons and birds were always cheerful.

shloka_text: सा तु शोकपरीताङ्गी मैथिली जनकात्मजा। राक्षसीवशमापन्ना व्याघ्रीणां हरिणी यथा।।3.56.34।।
transliteration: sā tu śokaparītāṅgī maithilī janakātmajā| rākṣasīvaśamāpannā vyāghrīṇāṃ hariṇī yathā
translation: शोकपरीताङ्गी engulfed in grief, जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, सा मैथिली that Sita, हरिणी doe, व्याघ्रीणां यथा as among tigresses, राक्षसीवशम् under the control of the demonesses, आपन्ना was placed.
explanation: Sita, daughter of Janaka, engulfed in grief found herself like a doe under the control of tigresses.

shloka_text: शोकेन महता ग्रस्ता मैथिली जनकात्मजा। न शर्म लभते भीरुः पाशबद्धा मृगी यथा।।3.56.35।।
transliteration: śokena mahatā grastā maithilī janakātmajā| na śarma labhate bhīruḥ pāśabaddhā mṛgī yathā
translation: महता by great, शोकेन by grief, ग्रस्ता immersed, भीरुः helpless lady, जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, मैथिली Sita, पाशबद्धा ensnared, मृगी यथा like a female, शर्म peace, न लभते not had.
explanation: Sita, daughter of Janaka, immersed in deep grief knew no peace just like a doe caught in a snare.

shloka_text: न विन्दते तत्र तु शर्म मैथिली विरूपनेत्राभिरतीव तर्जिता। पतिं स्मरन्ती दयितं च देवतं विचेतनाऽभूद्भयशोकपीडिता।।3.56.36।।
transliteration: na vindate tatra tu śarma maithilī virūpanetrābhiratīva tarjitā| patiṃ smarantī dayitaṃ ca devataṃ vicetanā'bhūdbhayaśokapīḍitā
translation: विरूपनेत्राभिः by women of deformed eyes, अतीव excessively, तर्जिता threatened, मैथिली Sita,  तत्र there, शर्म peace, न विन्दते not had, दयितम् beloved, पतिम् husband, देवतं च desired deity, स्मरन्ती while remembering, भयशोकपीडिता tortured by fear and grief, विचेतना lost conciousness, अभूत् became.
explanation: Sita had no peace as she was threatened excessively by those women of deformed  looks. Remembering her beloved husband who was also her god, and overtaken by fear and grief , she fell unconscious. इतयार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftysixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: राक्षसं मृगरूपेण चरन्तं कामरूपिणम्। निहत्य रामो मारीचं तूर्णं पथि न्यवर्तत।।3.57.1।।
transliteration: rākṣasaṃ mṛgarūpeṇa carantaṃ kāmarūpiṇam| nihatya rāmo mārīcaṃ tūrṇaṃ pathi nyavartata
translation: रामः Rama, मृगरूपेण in the form of a deer, चरन्तम् moving, कामरूपिणम् assuming a form at will, राक्षसम् to the demon, मारीचम् Maricha, निहत्य slaying, तूर्णम् swiftly, पथि  on the path, न्यवर्तत returned.
explanation: Rama killed Maricha, the demon assuming the form of the deer as per his will and swiftly took the return path.
comments: Rama returns after killing Maricha-- sees bad omens on the way-- sees sad face of Lakshmana midway--blames Lakshmana for leaving Sita alone-- doubts Sita's safety-- experiences bad omens again.

shloka_text: तस्य सन्त्वरमाणस्य द्रष्टुकामस्य मैथिलीम्। क्रूरस्वनोऽथ गोमायुर्विननादास्य पृष्ठतः।।3.57.2।।
transliteration: tasya santvaramāṇasya draṣṭukāmasya maithilīm| krūrasvano'tha gomāyurvinanādāsya pṛṣṭhataḥ
translation: मैथिलीम् Maithili (Sita), द्रष्टुकामस्य desiring to see, तस्य his, सन्त्वरमाणस्य hastening, अथ at that time, क्रूरस्वनः ghastly sound, गोमायुः jackal, अस्य his, पृष्ठतः from behind, विननाद screamed.
explanation: While Rama was hasting to see Sita, he heard from behind the ghastly howl of a jackal.

shloka_text: स तस्य स्वरमाज्ञाय दारुणं रोमहर्षणम्। चिन्तयामास गोमायोस्स्वरेण परिशङ्कितः।।3.57.3।।
transliteration: sa tasya svaramājñāya dāruṇaṃ romaharṣaṇam| cintayāmāsa gomāyossvareṇa pariśaṅkitaḥ
translation: सः he, तस्य गोमायोः the jackal's, दारुणम् dreadful, रोमहर्षणम् horripilating, स्वरम् tone, आज्ञाय recognising, स्वरेण voice, परिशङ्कितः doubting it, चिन्तयामास started worrying.
explanation: Rama knew it was the horrible, horripilating cry of a jackal which made him apprehensive . It made him think.

shloka_text: अशुभं बत मन्येऽहं गोमायुर्वाश्यते यथा। स्वस्ति स्यादपि वैदेह्या राक्षसैर्भक्षणं विना।।3.57.4।।
transliteration: aśubhaṃ bata manye'haṃ gomāyurvāśyate yathā| svasti syādapi vaidehyā rākṣasairbhakṣaṇaṃ vinā
translation: बत alas, गोमायुः jackal, यथा as, वाश्यते howling, अहम् I, अशुभम् inauspicious, मन्ये thinking, राक्षसैः by demons, भक्षणं विना without being eaten up, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, स्वस्ति wellbeing, स्यादपि may be.
explanation: 'The way the jackal is howling appears ominous. May Sita be safe without being eaten up by demons

shloka_text: मारीचेन तु विज्ञाय स्वरमालम्ब्य मामकम्। विक्रुष्टं मृगरूपेण लक्ष्मणश्शृणुयाद्यदि।।3.57.5।। स सौमित्रिस्स्वरं श्रुत्वा तां च हित्वाच मैथिलीम्। तयेह प्रहितः क्षिप्रं मत्सकाशमिहैष्यति।।3.57.6।।
transliteration: mārīcena tu vijñāya svaramālambya māmakam| vikruṣṭaṃ mṛgarūpeṇa lakṣmaṇaśśṛṇuyādyadi sa saumitrissvaraṃ śrutvā tāṃ ca hitvāca maithilīm| tayeha prahitaḥ kṣipraṃ matsakāśamihaiṣyati
translation: मृगरूपेण in the form of a deer, मारीचेन by Maricha, विज्ञाय having known, मामकम् my , स्वरम् voice, आलम्ब्य imitating, विक्रुष्टम् cried out, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शृणुयाद्यदि if he listens, सः सौमित्रिः that Saumitri, स्वरम् voice, श्रुत्वा after hearing, तां मैथिलीम् to Sita, हित्वा च leaving her, तया by her, इह here, प्रहितः sent, क्षिप्रम् at once, इह here, मत्सकाशम् for me, एष्यति he will come,
explanation: 'If  Lakshmana listens to Maricha imitating my voice in the form of a deer, he, sent by Sita will come for me at once, leaving her behind.

shloka_text: मारीचेन तु विज्ञाय स्वरमालम्ब्य मामकम्। विक्रुष्टं मृगरूपेण लक्ष्मणश्शृणुयाद्यदि।।3.57.5।। स सौमित्रिस्स्वरं श्रुत्वा तां च हित्वाच मैथिलीम्। तयेह प्रहितः क्षिप्रं मत्सकाशमिहैष्यति।।3.57.6।।
transliteration: mārīcena tu vijñāya svaramālambya māmakam| vikruṣṭaṃ mṛgarūpeṇa lakṣmaṇaśśṛṇuyādyadi sa saumitrissvaraṃ śrutvā tāṃ ca hitvāca maithilīm| tayeha prahitaḥ kṣipraṃ matsakāśamihaiṣyati
translation: मृगरूपेण in the form of a deer, मारीचेन by Maricha, विज्ञाय having known, मामकम् my , स्वरम् voice, आलम्ब्य imitating, विक्रुष्टम् cried out, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शृणुयाद्यदि if he listens, सः सौमित्रिः that Saumitri, स्वरम् voice, श्रुत्वा after hearing, तां मैथिलीम् to Sita, हित्वा च leaving her, तया by her, इह here, प्रहितः sent, क्षिप्रम् at once, इह here, मत्सकाशम् for me, एष्यति he will come,
explanation: 'If  Lakshmana listens to Maricha imitating my voice in the form of a deer, he, sent by Sita will come for me at once, leaving her behind.

shloka_text: राक्षसैस्सहितैर्नूनं सीताया ईप्सितो वधः। काञ्चनश्च मृगो भूत्वा व्यपनीयाश्रमात्तु माम्।।3.57.7।। दूरं नीत्वा तु मारीचो राक्षसोऽभूच्छरा हतः। हा लक्ष्मण हतोऽस्मीति यद्वाक्यं व्याजहार ह।।3.57.8।।
transliteration: rākṣasaissahitairnūnaṃ sītāyā īpsito vadhaḥ| kāñcanaśca mṛgo bhūtvā vyapanīyāśramāttu mām dūraṃ nītvā tu mārīco rākṣaso'bhūccharā hataḥ| hā lakṣmaṇa hato'smīti yadvākyaṃ vyājahāra ha
translation: यत् that, मारीचः Maricha, काञ्चनः मृगः golden deer, भूत्वा having become, माम् me, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, व्यपनीय dragging away, दूरम् far off, नीत्वा after taking, शराहतः hit by my arrows, राक्षसः demon, अभूत् he became, हा लक्ष्मण Alas, Lakshmana, हतः अस्मि I am killed, इति these, वाक्यम् words, व्याजहार he said, सहितैः accompanying, राक्षसैः by demons, सीतायाः Sita's, वधः slaughter, ईप्सितः desired, नूनम् surely.
explanation: 'Hence the murder of Sita must have been jointly planned by the demons. Maricha who had assumed the form of a golden deer, took me away from the hermitage to a faroff place where, killed by my arrows, he turned a demon uttering the words, Alas, Lakshmana, I am killed.

shloka_text: राक्षसैस्सहितैर्नूनं सीताया ईप्सितो वधः। काञ्चनश्च मृगो भूत्वा व्यपनीयाश्रमात्तु माम्।।3.57.7।। दूरं नीत्वा तु मारीचो राक्षसोऽभूच्छरा हतः। हा लक्ष्मण हतोऽस्मीति यद्वाक्यं व्याजहार ह।।3.57.8।।
transliteration: rākṣasaissahitairnūnaṃ sītāyā īpsito vadhaḥ| kāñcanaśca mṛgo bhūtvā vyapanīyāśramāttu mām dūraṃ nītvā tu mārīco rākṣaso'bhūccharā hataḥ| hā lakṣmaṇa hato'smīti yadvākyaṃ vyājahāra ha
translation: यत् that, मारीचः Maricha, काञ्चनः मृगः golden deer, भूत्वा having become, माम् me, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, व्यपनीय dragging away, दूरम् far off, नीत्वा after taking, शराहतः hit by my arrows, राक्षसः demon, अभूत् he became, हा लक्ष्मण Alas, Lakshmana, हतः अस्मि I am killed, इति these, वाक्यम् words, व्याजहार he said, सहितैः accompanying, राक्षसैः by demons, सीतायाः Sita's, वधः slaughter, ईप्सितः desired, नूनम् surely.
explanation: 'Hence the murder of Sita must have been jointly planned by the demons. Maricha who had assumed the form of a golden deer, took me away from the hermitage to a faroff place where, killed by my arrows, he turned a demon uttering the words, Alas, Lakshmana, I am killed.

shloka_text: अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्ताभ्यां रहिताभ्यां महावने। जनस्थाननिमित्तं हि कृतवैरोऽस्मि राक्षसैः।।3.57.9।। निमित्तानि च घोराणि दृश्यन्तेऽद्य बहूनि च।
transliteration: api svasti bhavettābhyāṃ rahitābhyāṃ mahāvane| janasthānanimittaṃ hi kṛtavairo'smi rākṣasaiḥ nimittāni ca ghorāṇi dṛśyante'dya bahūni ca|
translation: महावने in the dense forest, रहिताभ्याम् staying, ताभ्याम् those two, स्वस्ति safe, अपि भवेत् will be, जनस्थान निमित्तम् on account of Janasthana, राक्षसैः with demons, कृतवैरः have earned enmity, अस्मि हि because of me, अद्य now, घोराणि dreadful, बहूनि many, निमित्तानि च  portents, दृश्यन्ते are seen.
explanation: 'On account of living in this dense forest in Janasthana I have earned enmity with the demons. Will Lakshmana and Sita be safe without my protection? I see many terrible portents.'

shloka_text: इत्येवं चिन्तयन्रामश्श्रुत्वा गोमायुनिस्स्वनम्।।3.57.10।। आत्मनश्चापनयनान्मृगरूपेण रक्षसा। आजगाम जनस्थानं राघवः परिशङ्कितः।।3.57.11।।
transliteration: ityevaṃ cintayanrāmaśśrutvā gomāyunissvanam ātmanaścāpanayanānmṛgarūpeṇa rakṣasā| ājagāma janasthānaṃ rāghavaḥ pariśaṅkitaḥ
translation: राघवः Rama, गोमायुनिस्स्वनम् the jackal's howl, श्रुत्वा on hearing, इत्येवम् like this, चिन्तयन् worried, मृगरूपेण in the form of a deer, रक्षसा by the demon, आत्मनः his, अपनयनात् due to being drawn away, परिशङ्कितः  terrified, जनस्थानम् Janasthana, आजगाम came.
explanation: On hearing the jackal's howl, Rama began thinking how the demon in the form of a deer drew him away. Thus in the midst of apprehensions he reached Janasthana.

shloka_text: इत्येवं चिन्तयन्रामश्श्रुत्वा गोमायुनिस्स्वनम्।।3.57.10।। आत्मनश्चापनयनान्मृगरूपेण रक्षसा। आजगाम जनस्थानं राघवः परिशङ्कितः।।3.57.11।।
transliteration: ityevaṃ cintayanrāmaśśrutvā gomāyunissvanam ātmanaścāpanayanānmṛgarūpeṇa rakṣasā| ājagāma janasthānaṃ rāghavaḥ pariśaṅkitaḥ
translation: राघवः Rama, गोमायुनिस्स्वनम् the jackal's howl, श्रुत्वा on hearing, इत्येवम् like this, चिन्तयन् worried, मृगरूपेण in the form of a deer, रक्षसा by the demon, आत्मनः his, अपनयनात् due to being drawn away, परिशङ्कितः  terrified, जनस्थानम् Janasthana, आजगाम came.
explanation: On hearing the jackal's howl, Rama began thinking how the demon in the form of a deer drew him away. Thus in the midst of apprehensions he reached Janasthana.

shloka_text: तं दीनमनसो दीनमासेदुर्मृगपक्षिणः। सव्यं कृत्वा महात्मानं घोरांश्च ससृजुस्स्वरान्।।3.57.12।।
transliteration: taṃ dīnamanaso dīnamāsedurmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ| savyaṃ kṛtvā mahātmānaṃ ghorāṃśca sasṛjussvarān
translation: दीनमनसः dejected at heart, मृगपक्षिणः animals and birds, दीनम् piteous, महात्मानम् great soul, तम् him, सव्यम् कृत्वा keeping him to the left, आसेदुः remained, घोरान् horrifying, स्वरान् sounds, ससृजुश्च released.
explanation: Dejected at heart, the birds and animals piteously kept the great soul (Rama) to the left and produced a dreadful cacophony.

shloka_text: तानि दृष्ट्वा निमित्तानि महाघोराणि राघवः। न्यवर्तताथ त्वरितो जवेनाश्रममात्मनः।।3.57.13।।
transliteration: tāni dṛṣṭvā nimittāni mahāghorāṇi rāghavaḥ| nyavartatātha tvarito javenāśramamātmanaḥ
translation: राघवः Rama, महाघोराणि very dreadful, तानि निमित्तानि such omens, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, अथ then, त्वरितः hastened, जवेन with speed, आत्मनः his, आश्रमम् hermitage, न्यवर्तत returned.
explanation: On seeing such dreadfu omens at that time, Rama hurried back to his hermitage.

shloka_text: सीतां स तु वरारोहां लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। आजगाम जनस्थानं चिन्तयन्नेव राघवः।।3.57.14।।
transliteration: sītāṃ sa tu varārohāṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam| ājagāma janasthānaṃ cintayanneva rāghavaḥ
translation: सः राघवः that Rama, वरारोहाम् charming, सीताम् Sita, महाबलम्  mighty, लक्ष्मणं च Lakshmana, चिन्तयन्नेव thinking of them, जनस्थानम् Janasthana, आजगाम arrived.
explanation: Rama arrived at Janasthana thinking (of the safety) of charming Sita and mighty Lakshmana.

shloka_text: ततो लक्ष्मणमायान्तं ददर्श विगतप्रभम्। ततोऽविदूरे रामेण समीयाय स लक्ष्मणः।।3.57.15।। विषण्णस्सुविषण्णेन दुःखितो दुःखभागिना।
transliteration: tato lakṣmaṇamāyāntaṃ dadarśa vigataprabham| tato'vidūre rāmeṇa samīyāya sa lakṣmaṇaḥ viṣaṇṇassuviṣaṇṇena duḥkhito duḥkhabhāginā|
translation: ततः thereafter, आयान्तम् while coming, विगतप्रभम् dull, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, ददर्श saw, ततः then, विषण्णः a despondent one, दुःखितः one in grief, सः लक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, सुविषण्णेन with a despondent one, दुःखभागिना immersed in sorrow, रामेण Rama, अविदूरे not very far, समीयाय went near.
explanation: He then saw Lakshmana coming towards him with a cheerless face. When the sad, depressed Lakshmana came near, he saw Rama (equally) despondent and griefstricken.

shloka_text: सञ्जगर्हेऽथ तं भ्राता ज्येष्ठो लक्ष्मणमागतम्।।3.57.16।। विहाय सीतां विजने वने राक्षससेविते।
transliteration: sañjagarhe'tha taṃ bhrātā jyeṣṭho lakṣmaṇamāgatam vihāya sītāṃ vijane vane rākṣasasevite|
translation: अथ at that time, ज्येष्ठः भ्राता elder brother Rama, राक्षससेविते in a place infested with demons, विजने in a desolate, वने forest, सीताम् Sita, विहाय leaving, आगतम् one who came, तं लक्ष्मणम् to that Lakshmana, सञ्जगर्हे rebuked.
explanation: In this situation Rama the elder brother rebuked Lakshmana for having left Sita behind in a desolate forest infested with demons.

shloka_text: गृहीत्वा च करं सव्यं लक्ष्मणं रघुनन्दनः।।3.57.17।। उवाच मधुरोदर्कमिदं परुषमार्तिमत्।
transliteration: gṛhītvā ca karaṃ savyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ raghunandanaḥ uvāca madhurodarkamidaṃ paruṣamārtimat|
translation: रघुनन्दनः a delight of the Raghu dynasty, आर्तिमत् piteously, सव्यं करम् left hand, गृहीत्वा on taking hold, मधुरोदर्कम् sweet as ever, परुषम् harsh, इदम् this, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, उवाच said.
explanation: Rama, the delight of the Raghus, took hold of Lakshmana's left hand, and in sadness said these sweet harsh words :

shloka_text: अहो लक्ष्मण गर्ह्यं ते कृतं यस्त्वं विहाय ताम्।।3.57.18।। सीतामिहाऽगतस्सौम्य कच्चित्स्वस्ति भवेदिह।
transliteration: aho lakṣmaṇa garhyaṃ te kṛtaṃ yastvaṃ vihāya tām sītāmihā'gatassaumya kaccitsvasti bhavediha|
translation: सौम्य O gentle one, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, यः who, त्वम् you, ताम् her, सीताम् Sita, विहाय leaving, इह here, आगतः came, ते to you, गर्ह्यम् blameworthy, कृतम् done, इह here, स्वस्ति safe, भवेत् कच्चित् will she be safe, अहो Alas.
explanation: O gentle Lakshmana you are to blame for coming here, leaving Sita behind. Alas will she be safe now?

shloka_text: न मेऽस्ति संशयो वीर सर्वथा जनकात्मजा।।3.57.19।। विनष्टा भक्षिता वापि राक्षसैर्वनचारिभिः। अशुभान्येव भूयिष्ठं यथा प्रादुर्भवन्ति मे।।3.57.20।।
transliteration: na me'sti saṃśayo vīra sarvathā janakātmajā vinaṣṭā bhakṣitā vāpi rākṣasairvanacāribhiḥ| aśubhānyeva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yathā prādurbhavanti me
translation: वीर O great hero, मे to me, भूयिष्ठम् many, अशुभान्येव inauspicious omens only, यथा similarly, प्रादुर्भवन्ति got manifested, जनकात्मजा Sita, सर्वथा by all means, विनष्टा she is lost, वनचारिभिः by forsetrangers, राक्षसैः demons, भक्षिता वापि must have been eaten up, मे for me, संशयः doubt, नास्ति is not.
explanation: O heroic Lakshmana I see many inauspicious omens. I think Sita might have been lost or eaten away by the demons of the forest. There is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: न मेऽस्ति संशयो वीर सर्वथा जनकात्मजा।।3.57.19।। विनष्टा भक्षिता वापि राक्षसैर्वनचारिभिः। अशुभान्येव भूयिष्ठं यथा प्रादुर्भवन्ति मे।।3.57.20।।
transliteration: na me'sti saṃśayo vīra sarvathā janakātmajā vinaṣṭā bhakṣitā vāpi rākṣasairvanacāribhiḥ| aśubhānyeva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yathā prādurbhavanti me
translation: वीर O great hero, मे to me, भूयिष्ठम् many, अशुभान्येव inauspicious omens only, यथा similarly, प्रादुर्भवन्ति got manifested, जनकात्मजा Sita, सर्वथा by all means, विनष्टा she is lost, वनचारिभिः by forsetrangers, राक्षसैः demons, भक्षिता वापि must have been eaten up, मे for me, संशयः doubt, नास्ति is not.
explanation: O heroic Lakshmana I see many inauspicious omens. I think Sita might have been lost or eaten away by the demons of the forest. There is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: अपि लक्ष्मण सीतायास्सामग्र्यं प्राप्नुयावहे। जीवन्त्याः पुरुषव्याघ्र सुताया जनकस्य वै।।3.57.21।।
transliteration: api lakṣmaṇa sītāyāssāmagryaṃ prāpnuyāvahe| jīvantyāḥ puruṣavyāghra sutāyā janakasya vai
translation: पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, जीवन्त्या: of the living, जनकस्य सुतायाः of the daughter of Janaka, सीतायाः Sita's, सामग्र्यम् total well being, अपि प्राप्नुयावहे will we be able to get her back.
explanation: O Lakshmana, a tiger among men, will we be able to see the daughter of Janaka, living in a state of total wellbeing? Will we be able to get her back ?

shloka_text: यथा वै मृगसङ्घाश्च गोमायुश्चैव भैरवम्। वाश्यन्ते शकुनाश्चापि प्रदीप्तामभितो दिशम्।।3.57.22।। अपि स्वस्ति भवेत्तस्या राजपुत्र्या महाबल।
transliteration: yathā vai mṛgasaṅghāśca gomāyuścaiva bhairavam| vāśyante śakunāścāpi pradīptāmabhito diśam api svasti bhavettasyā rājaputryā mahābala|
translation: महाबल mighty, मृगसङ्घाश्च herds of beasts, गोमायुश्च jackal also, शकुनाश्चापि birds too, प्रदीप्ताम् shining bright, दिशम् direction, अभितः towards, यथा as, भैरवम् in frightful manner, वाश्यन्ते howling, राजपुत्र्याः of the princess, तस्याः of that  Sita, स्वस्ति अपि भवेत् may her be well.
explanation: O  mighty Lakshmana  from the way the beasts, jackals and birds too have turned in the bright direction of the Sun, crying in a frightful manner, can we hope princess Sita is safe ?

shloka_text: इदं हि रक्षो मृगसन्निकाशं प्रलोभ्य मां दूरमनुप्रयान्तम्। हतं कथञ्चिन्महता श्रमेण स राक्षसोऽभून्म्रियमाण एव।।3.57.23।।
transliteration: idaṃ hi rakṣo mṛgasannikāśaṃ pralobhya māṃ dūramanuprayāntam| hataṃ kathañcinmahatā śrameṇa sa rākṣaso'bhūnmriyamāṇa eva
translation: मृगसन्निकाशम् appearing like a deer, इदं रक्षः this demon, अनुप्रयान्तम् who followed, माम् me, दूरम् far, प्रलोभ्य alluring, महता with great, श्रमेण with effort, कथञ्चित् somehow, हतम् killed, सः he, म्रियमाणः while on the verge of death, एव too, राक्षसः demon, अभूत् turned.
explanation: Appearing in the guise of a deer, this demon allured me to a great distance. With much effort he was somehow killed. but he assumed his demoniac form while dying.

shloka_text: मनश्च मे दीनमिहाप्रहृष्टं चक्षुश्च सव्यं कुरुते विकारम्। असंशयं लक्ष्मण नास्ति सीता हृता मृता वा पथि वर्तते वा।।3.57.24।।
transliteration: manaśca me dīnamihāprahṛṣṭaṃ cakṣuśca savyaṃ kurute vikāram| asaṃśayaṃ lakṣmaṇa nāsti sītā hṛtā mṛtā vā pathi vartate vā
translation: इह here, दीनम् depressed, मे मनश्च my heart, अप्रहृष्टम् sorrowful, सव्यं चक्षुश्च left eye, विकारम् throbbing, कुरुते doing, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, असंशयम् no doubt, सीता Sita, नास्ति is not alive, हृता either abducted, मृता वा or died, पथि on the way, वर्तते वा lies.
explanation: With my heart dejected and depressed, my left eye throbbing, O Lakshmana, I have no doubt that Sita is either abducted or dead or abandoned on the way. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyseventh sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं दीनं शून्ये दशरथात्मजः। पर्यपृच्छत धर्मात्मा वैदेहीमागतं विना।।3.58.1।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaṃ dīnaṃ śūnye daśarathātmajaḥ| paryapṛcchata dharmātmā vaidehīmāgataṃ vinā
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous self, सः दशरथात्मजः that son of Dasaratha, शून्ये downcast, वैदेहीं विना without Vaidehi, आगतम् who came, दीनम् depressed, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा seeing, पर्यपृच्छत questioned.
explanation: Rama, son of Dasaratha, the righteous self, saw Lakshmana downcast and dejected. Seeing him  without Sita, Rama enquired:
comments: Rama wails -- doubts Sita's existenceblames Lakshmana -- looks out for Sita around the cottage.

shloka_text: प्रस्थितं दण्डकारण्यं या मामनुजगाम ह। क्व सा लक्ष्मण वैदेही यां हित्वा त्वमिहागतः।।3.58.2।।
transliteration: prasthitaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ yā māmanujagāma ha| kva sā lakṣmaṇa vaidehī yāṃ hitvā tvamihāgataḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmna, दण्डकारण्यम् to Dandakaranyam, प्रस्थितम् entered, माम् me, या who,   अनुजगाम ह followed, याम् whom, हित्वा having left, त्वम् you, इह here, आगतः came, सा वैदेही that Vaidehi, क्व where is she?
explanation: Where is that princess from Videha who accompanied me when I entered Dandaka forest ? Why have you come here leaving her behind ?

shloka_text: राज्यभ्रष्टस्य दीनस्य दण्डकान्परिधावतः। क्व सा दुःखसहाया मे वैदेही तनुमध्यमा।।3.58.3।।
transliteration: rājyabhraṣṭasya dīnasya daṇḍakānparidhāvataḥ| kva sā duḥkhasahāyā me vaidehī tanumadhyamā
translation: राज्यभ्रष्टस्य forsaking the kingdom, दण्डकान् Dandaka, परिधावतः running about, दीनस्य of a dejected, मे mine, दुःखसहाया a sharer of my sorrow, तनुमध्यमा lady of slender waist, सा वैदेही that Vaidehi, क्व where is she?
explanation: Where is that princess from Videha, a sharer of my sorrows, Sita of slender waist who followed this hapless prince disloged from the kingdom into the Dandaka forest?

shloka_text: यां विना नोत्सहे वीर मुहूर्तमपि जीवितुम्। क्व सा प्राणसहाया मे सीता सुरसुतोपमा।।3.58.4।।
transliteration: yāṃ vinā notsahe vīra muhūrtamapi jīvitum| kva sā prāṇasahāyā me sītā surasutopamā
translation: वीर O Warrior, यां विना without whom, मुहूर्तमपि even for a moment, जीवितुम् to live, नोत्सहे I have no interest, सा she, सुरसुतोपमा who resembles the daughter of a god, मे my, प्राणसहाया sustainer of my life, सीता Sita, क्व Where is she?
explanation: O warrior Lakshmana where is that Sita without whom I have no interest to live for a moment, who was like the daughter of a god and a sustainer of my life?

shloka_text: पतित्वममराणां वा पृथिव्याश्चापि लक्ष्मण। तां विना तपनीयाभां नेच्छेयं जनकात्मजाम्।।3.58.5।।
transliteration: patitvamamarāṇāṃ vā pṛthivyāścāpi lakṣmaṇa| tāṃ vinā tapanīyābhāṃ neccheyaṃ janakātmajām
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, तपनीयाभाम् goldenhued lady, ताम् she, जनकात्मजां विना without Janaka's daughter, अमराणाम् of gods, पतित्वम् lordship, पृथिव्याश्च of the earth, नेच्छेयम् do not desire.
explanation: O Lakshmana I desire no lordship of the gods  or of the entire earth without that daughter of Janaka, that lady of golden complexion.

shloka_text: कच्चिज्जीवति वैदेहि प्राणैः प्रियतरा मम। कच्चित्प्रव्राजनं सौम्य न मे मिथ्या भविष्यति।।3.58.6।।
transliteration: kaccijjīvati vaidehi prāṇaiḥ priyatarā mama| kaccitpravrājanaṃ saumya na me mithyā bhaviṣyati
translation: सौम्य O gentle, मम my, प्राणैः than life, प्रियतरा dearer, वैदेही Vaidehi, जीवति कच्चित् will she be alive, मे my, प्रव्राजनम् banishment from kingdom, मिथ्या prove to be false, न भविष्यति कच्चित् shall not become.
explanation: O gentle Lakshmana I wonder if Vaidehi, who is dearer to me than my life is still alive I hope my banishment from the kingdom is not going to prove false.

shloka_text: सीतानिमित्तं सौमित्रे मृते मयि गते त्वयि। कच्चित्सकामा सुखिता कैकेयी सा भविष्यति।।3.58.7।।
transliteration: sītānimittaṃ saumitre mṛte mayi gate tvayi| kaccitsakāmā sukhitā kaikeyī sā bhaviṣyati
translation: सौमित्रे Saumitri, सीतानिमित्तम् on account of Sita, मयि when I will be, मृते dead, त्वयि when you, गते will be gone, सा कैकेयी that Kaikeyi, सकामा with her desire fulfilled, सुखिता a happy soul, भविष्यति कच्चित् will be indeed.
explanation: O Saumitri when I am dead on account of Sita, and you are back, Kaikeyi with her desire fulfilled will be happy, indeed.

shloka_text: सपुत्रराज्यां सिद्धार्थां मृतपुत्रा तपस्विनी। उपस्थास्यतिकौसल्या कच्चित्सौम्य न केकयीम्।।3.58.8।।
transliteration: saputrarājyāṃ siddhārthāṃ mṛtaputrā tapasvinī| upasthāsyatikausalyā kaccitsaumya na kekayīm
translation: सौम्य O handsome one, मृतपुत्रा  with her son dead, तपस्विनी a lady of renunciation, कौसल्या Kausalya, सपुत्रराज्याम् who enjoys the company of a son and power of the throne, सिद्धार्थाम् accomplished her desire, कैकयीम् Kaikeyi, न उपस्थास्यति कच्चित् cease to serve indeed.
explanation: O handsome one  I wonder if that lady of renunciation, Kausalya with her son dead, will have to serve Kaikeyi whose desire would be fulfilled, and who will enjoy the power of the throne in the company of her son

shloka_text: यदि जीवति वैदेही गमिष्याम्याश्रमं पुनः। सुवृत्ता यदि वृत्ता प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यामि लक्ष्मण।।3.58.9।।
transliteration: yadi jīvati vaidehī gamiṣyāmyāśramaṃ punaḥ| suvṛttā yadi vṛttā prāṇāṃstyakṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, वैदेही Vaidehi, जीवति यदि if she is living only, पुनः again, आश्रमम् to the cottage, गमिष्यामि will go, यदि वा or else, सुवृत्ता virtuous, वृत्ता dead, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्यामि I will give up.
explanation: O Lakshmana, only if Vaidehi is alive will I enter the cottage again or else I will give up my life if that virtuous lady is no more.

shloka_text: यदि मामाश्रमगतं वैदेही नाभिभाषते। पुनः प्रहसिता सीता विनशिष्यामि लक्ष्मण।।3.58.10।।
transliteration: yadi māmāśramagataṃ vaidehī nābhibhāṣate| punaḥ prahasitā sītā vinaśiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇa
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, आश्रमगतम् when I return to the cottage, माम् me, वैदेही Vaidehi, सीता Sita, प्रहसिता with her sweet smile, पुनः again, नाभिभाषते यदि if she does not speak to me, विनशिष्यामि I will die.
explanation: I will die if Sita, princess from Videha, is not there to speak to me with her sweet smile when I return to the cottage, O Lakshmana

shloka_text: ब्रूहि लक्ष्मण वैदेही यदि जीवति वा न वा। त्वयि प्रमत्ते रक्षोभिर्भक्षिता वा तपस्विनी।।3.58.11।।
transliteration: brūhi lakṣmaṇa vaidehī yadi jīvati vā na vā| tvayi pramatte rakṣobhirbhakṣitā vā tapasvinī
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वैदेही Vaidehi, जीवति वा alive or, न वा not, त्वयि you, प्रमत्ते were not alert, तपस्विनी lady of renunciation, रक्षोभिः by the demons, भक्षिता वा have they eaten, ब्रूहि tell me.
explanation: Tell me, O Lakshmana   if Sita is alive or not, whether she was eaten up by demons when you were off your guard.

shloka_text: सुकुमारी च बाला च नित्यं चादुःखदर्शिनी। मद्वियोगेन वैदेही व्यक्तं शोचति दुर्मनाः।।3.58.12।।
transliteration: sukumārī ca bālā ca nityaṃ cāduḥkhadarśinī| madviyogena vaidehī vyaktaṃ śocati durmanāḥ
translation: सुकुमारी च a delicate, बाला च young also, नित्यम् always, अदुःखदर्शिनी never experienced sorrow, वैदेही Vaidehi, दुर्मनाः troubled mind, मद्वियोगेन by separation from me, शोचति thinking of, व्यक्तम् it is true.
explanation: Vaidehi is delicate, young and she has never faced any sorrow.She will be certainly disheartened due to separation from me.

shloka_text: सर्वदा रक्षसा तेन जिह्मेन सुदुरात्मना। वदता लक्ष्मणेत्युच्चैस्तवापि जनितं भयम्।।3.58.13।।
transliteration: sarvadā rakṣasā tena jihmena sudurātmanā| vadatā lakṣmaṇetyuccaistavāpi janitaṃ bhayam
translation: जिह्मेन by the wicked, सुदुरात्मना by the evilminded, लक्ष्मण इति saying Lakshmana thus, उच्चैः loudly, वदता calling out, तेन by him, रक्षसा demon, सर्वथा by all means, तवापि for you also, भयम् fear, जनितम् is created.
explanation: The evilminded, wicked demon calling out loudly 'O Lakshmana' must have by all means instilled fear in your mind.

shloka_text: श्रुतस्तु शङ्के वैदेह्या स स्वरस्सदृशो मम। त्रस्तया प्रेषितस्त्वं च द्रष्टुं मां शीघ्रमागतः।।3.58.14।।
transliteration: śrutastu śaṅke vaidehyā sa svarassadṛśo mama| trastayā preṣitastvaṃ ca draṣṭuṃ māṃ śīghramāgataḥ
translation: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, मम of me, सदृशः similar, सः that, स्वरः voice, श्रुतः was heard, शङ्के       I doubt, त्रस्तया by a frightened lady, प्रेषितः sent, त्वं च you too, माम् me, द्रष्टुम् to see, शीघ्रम् quickly, आगतः came.
explanation: I am afraid, Vaidehi, frightened by hearing the voice which was like mine sent you to see me, and you came all at once.

shloka_text: सर्वथा तु कृतं कष्टं सीतामुत्सृजता वने। प्रतिकर्तुं नृशंसानां रक्षसां दत्तमन्तरं।।3.58.15।।
transliteration: sarvathā tu kṛtaṃ kaṣṭaṃ sītāmutsṛjatā vane| pratikartuṃ nṛśaṃsānāṃ rakṣasāṃ dattamantaraṃ
translation: सीताम् Sita, वने in the forest, उत्सृजता leaving alone, सर्वथा by all means, कष्टम् difficult, कृतम् done, प्रतिकर्तुम् to take revenge, नृशंसानाम् of the cruel, रक्षसाम् of demons, अन्तरम् chance, दत्तम् is given.
explanation: You have definitely done a great mistake by leaving Sita alone in the forest. This has given a chance to the cruel demons to wreak revenge.

shloka_text: दुःखिताः खरघातेन राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः। तैस्सीता निहता घोरैर्भविष्यति न संशयः।3.58.16।।
transliteration: duḥkhitāḥ kharaghātena rākṣasāḥ piśitāśanāḥ| taissītā nihatā ghorairbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|3.58.16||
translation: पिशिताशनाः flesheaters, राक्षसाः demons, खरघातेन by the death of Khara, दुःखिताः are aggrieved, घोरैः dreadful, तैः by them, सीता Sita, निहता killed, भविष्यति may be, संशयः doubt, न no.
explanation: The dreadful, carnivorous demons aggrieved over my murder of Khara must have undoubtedly killed Sita.

shloka_text: अहोऽस्मिन् व्यसने मग्नस्सर्वथा शत्रुसूदन। किं न्विदानीं करिष्यामि शङ्के प्राप्तव्यमीदृशम्।।3.58.17।।
transliteration: aho'smin vyasane magnassarvathā śatrusūdana| kiṃ nvidānīṃ kariṣyāmi śaṅke prāptavyamīdṛśam
translation: शत्रुसूदन O destroyer of enemies, सर्वथा in all respects, अस्मिन् in this, व्यसने in sorrow, मग्नः I am drowned, इदानीम् at this time, किं नु करिष्यामि what can I do?, ईदृशम् such, प्राप्तव्यम् destined, शङ्के I fear, अहो alas
explanation: O destroyer of enemies  I am completely drowned in sorrow. What can I do at this moment. Alas, I am destined to suffer.

shloka_text: इति सीतां वरारोहां चिन्तयन्नेव राघवः। आजगाम जनस्थानं त्वरया सह लक्ष्मणः।।3.58.18।।
transliteration: iti sītāṃ varārohāṃ cintayanneva rāghavaḥ| ājagāma janasthānaṃ tvarayā saha lakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: राघवः Raghava, इति thus, वरारोहाम् beautiful, सीताम् Sita, चिन्तयन्नेव while brooding over only, सह लक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, त्वरया quickly, जनस्थानम्  Janasthanam, आजगाम he went.
explanation: While thus brooding over the beautiful Sita, the scion of the Raghus along with Lakshmana hurried towards Janasthana.

shloka_text: विगर्हमाणोऽनुजमार्तरूपं क्षुधा श्रमाच्चैव पिपासया च। विनिश्श्वसन् शुष्कमुखो विवर्णः प्रतिश्रयं प्राप्य समीक्ष्य शून्यम्।।3.58.19।। स्वमाश्रमं सम्प्रविगाह्य वीरो विहारदेशाननुसृत्य कांश्चित्। एतत्तदित्येव निवासभूमौ प्रहृष्टरोमा व्यथितो बभूव।।3.58.20।।
transliteration: vigarhamāṇo'nujamārtarūpaṃ kṣudhā śramāccaiva pipāsayā ca| viniśśvasan śuṣkamukho vivarṇaḥ pratiśrayaṃ prāpya samīkṣya śūnyam svamāśramaṃ sampravigāhya vīro vihāradeśānanusṛtya kāṃścit| etattadityeva nivāsabhūmau prahṛṣṭaromā vyathito babhūva
translation: वीरः hero, आर्तरूपम् dejected, अनुजम् brother, विगर्हमाणः  blaming him, क्षुधा hunger, श्रमाच्चैव due to exhaustion, पिपासया and thirsty, विनिःश्वसन् sighing deeply, शुष्कमुखः face dried up, विवर्णः turned pale, प्रतिश्रयम् restingplace, प्राप्य reaching, शून्यम् empty, समीक्ष्य seeing, स्वम् his, आश्रमम् hermitage, सम्प्रविगाह्य searching thoroughly, कांश्चित् some of the places, विहारदेशान् places where she was moving about, अनुसृत्य after following her, निवासभूमौ in the dwelling place, एतत् all that, तदेव इति this itself, प्रहृष्टरोमा with horripilation, व्यथितः pained, बभूव became.
explanation: Thus blaming his dejected brother, the valiant Rama entered the hermitage, sighing deeply, his face pale and his throat dried up with hunger, exhaustion and thirst. Reaching his dwellingplace, he found it empty. He thoroughly searched the hermitage and the places where she used to move about on the premises. And 'so it has happened', he sadly said to himself, his hair raised on end. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथाश्रमादुपावृत्तमन्तरा रघुनन्दनः। परिपप्रच्छ सौमित्रिं रामो दुःखार्दितं पुनः।।3.59.1।।
transliteration: athāśramādupāvṛttamantarā raghunandanaḥ| paripapraccha saumitriṃ rāmo duḥkhārditaṃ punaḥ
translation: अथ and then, रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghus, रामः Rama, दुःखार्दितम् afflicted, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, उपावृत्तम् returned, सौमित्रिम् Lakshmana, अन्तरा in the midst, पुनः again, परिपप्रच्छ questioned.
explanation: Rama, the delight of the Raghus, once again questioned Lakshmana who had come out of the hermitage, deeply hurt:
comments: Rama enquires Lakshmana the reason for leaving Sita alone-- Lakshmana tells him about Sita goading him to leave immediately.

shloka_text: तमुवाच किमर्थं त्वमागतोऽपास्य मैथिलीम्। यदा सा तव विश्वासाद्वने विरहिता मया।।3.59.2।।
transliteration: tamuvāca kimarthaṃ tvamāgato'pāsya maithilīm| yadā sā tava viśvāsādvane virahitā mayā
translation: तम् him, उवाच had said, तव your, विश्वासात् with the confidence, मया myself, सा she, वने  in the forest, यदा as such, विरहिता left, मैथिलीम् Maithili, किमर्थम् for what reason, उपास्य having left her, त्वम् you, आगतः came.
explanation: Why did you come, leaving the princess from Mithila alone in the forest when I had left her under your trust ?

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वैवाभ्यागतं त्वां मे मैथिलीं त्यज्य लक्ष्मण। शङ्कमानं महत्पापं यत्सत्यं व्यथितं मनः।।3.59.3।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvaivābhyāgataṃ tvāṃ me maithilīṃ tyajya lakṣmaṇa| śaṅkamānaṃ mahatpāpaṃ yatsatyaṃ vyathitaṃ manaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, मैथिलीम् Maithili, त्यज्य left, अभ्यागतम् your coming, त्वाम् your, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, मनः in my mind, महत् great, पापम् evil, शङ्कमानम् doubted, व्यथितम् (इति) यत् I was pained, सत्यम् it was true.
explanation: When I saw you, O Lakshmana, coming without Sita, my mind was oppressed with evil thought which have come true.

shloka_text: स्फुरते नयनं सव्यं बाहुश्च हृदयं च मे। दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मण दूरे त्वां सीताविरहितं पथि।।3.59.4।।
transliteration: sphurate nayanaṃ savyaṃ bāhuśca hṛdayaṃ ca me| dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇa dūre tvāṃ sītāvirahitaṃ pathi
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सीताविरहितम् without Sita, त्वाम् you, दूरे at a distance, पथि on the way, दृष्ट्वा seeing, मे mine, सव्यम् left, नयनम् eye, बाहुश्च shoulder, स्फुरते throbbing, मे my, हृदयं च heart too.
explanation: O Lakshmana, as I saw you from a distance without Sita, my left eye, my shoulder and my heart throbbed.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तन्तु सौमित्रिर्लक्ष्मणश्शुभलक्षणः। भूयो दुःखसमाविष्टो दुःखितं राममब्रवीत्।।3.59.5।।
transliteration: evamuktantu saumitrirlakṣmaṇaśśubhalakṣaṇaḥ| bhūyo duḥkhasamāviṣṭo duḥkhitaṃ rāmamabravīt
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been spoken, सौमित्रिः Lakshmana, शुभलक्षणः endowed with good  traits, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भूयः again, दुःखसमाविष्टः drowned in greater sorrow, दुःखितम् sorrowful, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Thus addressed, virtuous Lakshmana, overwhelmed with sorrow replied to the grief stricken Rama:

shloka_text: न स्वयं कामकारेण तां त्यक्त्वाहमिहागतः। प्रचोदित स्तयैवोग्रैस्त्वत्सकाशमिहागतः।।3.59.6।।
transliteration: na svayaṃ kāmakāreṇa tāṃ tyaktvāhamihāgataḥ| pracodita stayaivograistvatsakāśamihāgataḥ
translation: अहम् I, ताम् her, स्वयम् on my own, त्यक्त्वा after leaving, कामकारेण by my own desire, इह here, न आगतः not come, तयैव by herself, उग्रैः with angry words, प्रचोदितः provoked, इह here, त्वत्सकाशम् to you, आगतः I came.
explanation: I did not leave her on my own nor have I  come here of my own accord. I came to you, provoked by her angry  words.

shloka_text: आर्येणेव पराक्रुष्टं हासीते लक्ष्मणेति च। परित्राहीति यद्वाक्यं मैथिल्यास्तच्छ्रुतिं गतम्।।3.59.7।।
transliteration: āryeṇeva parākruṣṭaṃ hāsīte lakṣmaṇeti ca| paritrāhīti yadvākyaṃ maithilyāstacchrutiṃ gatam
translation: हा सीते Alas, Sita, हा लक्ष्मण Alas, Lakshmana, इति च these words, परित्राहि इति save  me, यत् such, आर्येणेव as if your noble self, पराक्रुष्टम् loudly, तत् then, मैथिल्याः Maithili's, श्रुतिम् to her ears, गतम् reached.
explanation: Uttered loudly, 'Alas Sita, Alas, Lakshmana, save me', as if these were the words of your noble self, reached Sita's ears.

shloka_text: सा तमार्तस्वरं श्रुत्वा तव स्नेहेन मैथिली। गच्छ गच्छेति मामाह रुदन्ती भयविह्वला।।3.59.8।।
transliteration: sā tamārtasvaraṃ śrutvā tava snehena maithilī| gaccha gaccheti māmāha rudantī bhayavihvalā
translation: सा मैथिली that Maithili, तम् that, आर्तस्वरम् cry of pain, श्रुत्वा hearing, रुदन्ती crying, तव स्नेहेन  because of her love for you, भयविह्वला wild with fear, गच्छ गच्छ इति go, go, माम् to me said, आह pleaded.
explanation: The princess from Mithila heard this cry of pain and, wild with fear, urged me out of her love for you to go.

shloka_text: प्रचोद्यमानेन मया गच्छेति बहुशस्तया। प्रत्युक्ता मैथिली वाक्यमिदं त्वत्प्रत्ययान्वितम्।3.59.9।।
transliteration: pracodyamānena mayā gaccheti bahuśastayā| pratyuktā maithilī vākyamidaṃ tvatpratyayānvitam|3.59.9||
translation: गच्छ इति saying go, तया Sita, बहुशः many ways, प्रचोद्यमानेन while being provoked, मया by me, मैथिली Maithili, त्वत्प्रत्ययान्वितम्  cofidence in her, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युक्ता replied.
explanation: When I was repeated asked to go, I said this in order to instil confidence in the princess from Mithila :

shloka_text: न तत्पश्याम्यहं रक्षो यदस्य भयमावहेत्। निर्वृता भव नास्त्येतत्केनाप्येवमुदाहृतम्।।3.59.10।।
transliteration: na tatpaśyāmyahaṃ rakṣo yadasya bhayamāvahet| nirvṛtā bhava nāstyetatkenāpyevamudāhṛtam
translation: अस्य his, यत् Rama, भयम् fear, आवहेत् who can cause, तत् such, रक्षः demon, अहम् I, न पश्यामि I do not see, निर्वृता give up fear, भव your, एतत् this, नास्ति does not exist, केनापि by some one, एवम् in that way, उदाहृतम् is uttered.
explanation: 'No one  can cause fear in Rama. I do not see any demon who can hold a threat to him. Give up fear. Some one might have said it.

shloka_text: विगर्हितं च नीचं च कथमार्योऽभिधास्यति। त्राहीति वचनं सीते यस्त्रायेत्रिदशानपि।।3.59.11।।
transliteration: vigarhitaṃ ca nīcaṃ ca kathamāryo'bhidhāsyati| trāhīti vacanaṃ sīte yastrāyetridaśānapi
translation: सीते O Sita, यः he, त्रिदशानपि even gods, त्रायेत् he may save, आर्यः capable one, विगर्हितम् demeaning, नीचं च lowly, त्राहि इति saying 'save me', वचनम् words, कथम् how, अभिधास्यति will speak out?
explanation: 'How can Rama who is capable of saving even gods speak such unworthy, demeaning words, 'Save me, O Sita'

shloka_text: किं निमित्तं तु केनापि भ्रातुरालम्ब्य मे स्वरम्। राक्षसेनेरितं वाक्यं त्राहि त्राहीति शोभने।।3.59.12।।
transliteration: kiṃ nimittaṃ tu kenāpi bhrāturālambya me svaram| rākṣaseneritaṃ vākyaṃ trāhi trāhīti śobhane
translation: शोभने O fair lady, किं निमित्तं तु for some reason, केनापि राक्षसेन by some demon, मे भ्रातुः my brother's, स्वरम् voice, आलम्ब्य adapting, त्राहि त्राहि इति 'save me, save me', वाक्यम् these words, ईरितम् is said.
explanation: O fair lady, for some reason some demon  has uttered these words 'Save me, save me' adapting my brother's voice.

shloka_text: विस्वरं व्याहृतं वाक्यं लक्ष्मण त्राहि मामिति। न भवत्या व्यथा कार्या कुनारीजनसेविता।।3.59.13।।
transliteration: visvaraṃ vyāhṛtaṃ vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇa trāhi māmiti| na bhavatyā vyathā kāryā kunārījanasevitā
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, माम् me, त्राहि save me, इति thus, विस्वरम् in an altered voice, वाक्यम्  these words, व्याहृतम् uttered, भवत्या yourself, कुनारीजनसेविता like an ordinary lowborn woman, व्यथा pain, न कार्या not to be taken.
explanation: 'Lakshmana, save me' are the words uttered in an altered tone. Like an ordinary, lowborn woman you are not to feel concerned for this.

shloka_text: अलं वैक्लब्यमालम्ब्य स्वस्था भव निरुत्सुका। न सोऽस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु पुमान्वै राघवं रणे।।3.59.14।। जातो वा जायमानो वा संयुगे यः पराजयेत्। न जय्यो राघवो युद्धे देवैश्शक्रपुरोगमैः।।3.59.15।।
transliteration: alaṃ vaiklabyamālambya svasthā bhava nirutsukā| na so'sti triṣu lokeṣu pumānvai rāghavaṃ raṇe jāto vā jāyamāno vā saṃyuge yaḥ parājayet| na jayyo rāghavo yuddhe devaiśśakrapurogamaiḥ
translation: वैक्लब्यम् bewilderment, आलम्ब्य resorting to, अलम् no need, निरुत्सुका frustrated, स्वस्था भव you should be calm, यः whoever, संयुगेरणे in an encounter, राघवम् Rama, पराजयेत् defeat, सः he, पुमान् a man, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, जातो वा is born in the past, जायमानो वा or going to be born, नास्ति is not there, राघवः Rama, शक्रपुरोगमैः by those led by Indra, देवैः by gods, युद्धे in war, न जय्यः cannot be conquered.
explanation: 'You should not feel agitated or dispirited. Be composed. There is no one either born or going to be born in the three worlds who can defeat Rama in war. He cannot be conquered in a battle even by gods led by indra.'

shloka_text: अलं वैक्लब्यमालम्ब्य स्वस्था भव निरुत्सुका। न सोऽस्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु पुमान्वै राघवं रणे।।3.59.14।। जातो वा जायमानो वा संयुगे यः पराजयेत्। न जय्यो राघवो युद्धे देवैश्शक्रपुरोगमैः।।3.59.15।।
transliteration: alaṃ vaiklabyamālambya svasthā bhava nirutsukā| na so'sti triṣu lokeṣu pumānvai rāghavaṃ raṇe jāto vā jāyamāno vā saṃyuge yaḥ parājayet| na jayyo rāghavo yuddhe devaiśśakrapurogamaiḥ
translation: वैक्लब्यम् bewilderment, आलम्ब्य resorting to, अलम् no need, निरुत्सुका frustrated, स्वस्था भव you should be calm, यः whoever, संयुगेरणे in an encounter, राघवम् Rama, पराजयेत् defeat, सः he, पुमान् a man, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, जातो वा is born in the past, जायमानो वा or going to be born, नास्ति is not there, राघवः Rama, शक्रपुरोगमैः by those led by Indra, देवैः by gods, युद्धे in war, न जय्यः cannot be conquered.
explanation: 'You should not feel agitated or dispirited. Be composed. There is no one either born or going to be born in the three worlds who can defeat Rama in war. He cannot be conquered in a battle even by gods led by indra.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही परिमोहितचेतना। उवाचाश्रूणि मुञ्चन्ती दारुणं मामिदं वचः।।3.59.16।।
transliteration: evamuktā tu vaidehī parimohitacetanā| uvācāśrūṇi muñcantī dāruṇaṃ māmidaṃ vacaḥ
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्ता  consoled, वैदेही Vaidehi, परिमोहितचेतना of deluded intellect, अश्रूणि tears, मुञ्चन्ती shedding, माम् me, दारुणं harsh, इदं वचः these words, उवाच said.
explanation: Deluded by her senses, Vaidehi said these words, shedding tears when I  tried to console  her:

shloka_text: भावो मयि तवात्यर्थं पाप एव निवेशितः। विनष्टे भ्रातरि प्राप्तुं न च त्वं मामवाप्स्यसि।।3.59.17।।
transliteration: bhāvo mayi tavātyarthaṃ pāpa eva niveśitaḥ| vinaṣṭe bhrātari prāptuṃ na ca tvaṃ māmavāpsyasi
translation: भ्रातरि brother, विनष्टे is deceased, प्राप्तुम् to get, मयि me, अत्यर्थम् extremely, पापः भाव एव sinful thought only, तव you, निवेशितः is set, त्वम् you, माम् me, न च अवाप्स्यसि will not be able to gain.
explanation: 'You have an extremely sinful intention of getting me  when your brother is dead. But you will not be able to gain me.

shloka_text: सङ्केताद्भरतेन त्वं रामं समनुगच्छसि। क्रोशन्तं हि यथात्यर्थं नैवमभ्यवपद्यसे।।3.59.18।।
transliteration: saṅketādbharatena tvaṃ rāmaṃ samanugacchasi| krośantaṃ hi yathātyarthaṃ naivamabhyavapadyase
translation: अत्यर्थम् intensely, क्रोशन्तम्  shouting for help, यथा as, एवम् in this, नाभ्यवपद्यसे  are not going, त्वम् you, भरतेन by Bharata, सङ्केतात् instruction, रामम् Rama,समनुगच्छसि followed.
explanation: 'Since you are not reaching out to Rama who is helplessly crying for his rescue, you must have followed Rama, instructed by Bharata (to do him harm)'৷৷

shloka_text: रिपुः प्रच्छन्नचारी त्वं मदर्थमनुगच्छसि। राघवस्यान्तरप्रेप्सुस्तथैनं नाभिपद्यसे।।3.59.19।।
transliteration: ripuḥ pracchannacārī tvaṃ madarthamanugacchasi| rāghavasyāntaraprepsustathainaṃ nābhipadyase
translation: प्रच्छन्नचारी in disguise, रिपुः enemy, त्वम् you, राघवस्य Rama's, अन्तरप्रेप्सुः waiting for an opportunity, मदर्थम् for my sake, अनुगच्छसि are following, तथा like this, एनम् him, नाभिपद्यसे not going now.
explanation: 'You are an enemy moving in disguise with an interest in me. You are waiting for an opportunity to set aside Rama. That is why you are not rushing to him.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो हि वैदेह्या संरब्धो रक्तलोचनः। क्रोधात्प्रस्फुरमाणोष्ठ आश्रमादभिनिर्गतः।।3.59.20।।
transliteration: evamukto hi vaidehyā saṃrabdho raktalocanaḥ| krodhātprasphuramāṇoṣṭha āśramādabhinirgataḥ
translation: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, संरब्धः an agitated person, क्रोधात् in anger, रक्तलोचनः with reddened eye, स्फुरमाणोष्ठः quivering lips, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, अभिनिर्गतः came out.
explanation: At these words from the princess of Videha, I came out of the hermitage in an agitated mood with my eyes turned red and lips quivering in anger.

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं रामस्सन्तापमोहितः। अब्रवीद्दुष्कृतं सौम्य तां विना यत्त्वमागतः।।3.59.21।।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ saumitriṃ rāmassantāpamohitaḥ| abravīdduṣkṛtaṃ saumya tāṃ vinā yattvamāgataḥ
translation: एवम् in that way, ब्रुवाणम् as he was telling, सौमित्रिम् Lakshmana, सन्तापमोहितः overtaken by grief, रामः Rama, अब्रवीत् said, सौम्य noble, यत् since, त्वम् you, तां विना without her, आगतः came, दुष्कृतम् a wrong act, कृतम् is done.
explanation: To Lakshmana thus reporting, Rama, overcome with grief, said,(Even then) O noble brother your coming here, leaving her behind, is a wrong step taken.

shloka_text: जानन्नपि समर्थं मां रक्षसां विनिवारणे। अनेन क्रोधवाक्येन मैथिल्या निस्सृतो भवान्।।3.59.22।।
transliteration: jānannapi samarthaṃ māṃ rakṣasāṃ vinivāraṇe| anena krodhavākyena maithilyā nissṛto bhavān
translation: माम् me, रक्षसाम् of demons, विनिवारणे in warding off, समर्थम् capable, जानन्नपि even knowing , भवान् yourself, मैथिल्याः Maithili's, अनेन by this, क्रोधवाक्येन angry words, निस्सृतः came out.
explanation: You have come out of the hermitage provoked by Maithili's angry words, even though you are aware that I am capable of warding off the demons.

shloka_text: न हि ते परितुष्यामि त्यक्त्वा यद्यासि मैथिलीम्। क्रुद्धायाः परुषं श्रुत्वा तां विहाय त्वमागतः।।3.59.23।।
transliteration: na hi te parituṣyāmi tyaktvā yadyāsi maithilīm| kruddhāyāḥ paruṣaṃ śrutvā tāṃ vihāya tvamāgataḥ
translation: मैथिलीम् Maithili, त्यक्त्वा left, यद्यासि that you came, ते with you, न परितुष्यामि not pleased, त्वम् you, क्रुद्धायाः angry, परुषम् harsh, श्रुत्वा  listening, ताम् her, विहाय  deserting, इह here, आगतः came.
explanation: I am not happy with you as you have come here deserting Sita on the plea that she was angry and spoke harsh words.

shloka_text: सर्वथा त्वविनीतं ते सीतया यत्प्रचोदितः। क्रोधस्य वशमापन्नो नाकरोश्शासनं मम।।3.59.24।।
transliteration: sarvathā tvavinītaṃ te sītayā yatpracoditaḥ| krodhasya vaśamāpanno nākarośśāsanaṃ mama
translation: सीतया by Sita, प्रचोदितः you are urged, क्रोधस्य by anger's, वशम् grip, आपन्नः came, मम my, शासनम् orders, नाकरोः (इति) यत् not respected, सर्वथा by all means, ते your, अविनीतम् act of disobedience.
explanation: Provoked by the words of Sita spoken in anger you came without respecting my orders. It is definitely an act of disobedience.

shloka_text: असौ हि राक्षसश्शेते शरेणाभिहतो मया। मृगरूपेण येनाहमाश्रमादपवाहितः।।3.59.25।।
transliteration: asau hi rākṣasaśśete śareṇābhihato mayā| mṛgarūpeṇa yenāhamāśramādapavāhitaḥ
translation: मृगरूपेण in the guise of a deer, येन by whom, अहम् I, आश्रमात् from the hermitage, अपवाहितः was taken away, असौ राक्षसः this demon, मया by me, शरेण with an arrow, अभिहतः he is killed, शेते lies.
explanation: This demon who misled me in the guise of a deer and took me away from the hermitage, lies dead, killed by my arrow.

shloka_text: विकृष्य चापं परिधाय सायकं सलीलबाणेन च ताडितो मया। मार्गीं तनुं त्यज्य स विक्लबस्वरो बभूव केयूरधरस्सराक्षसः।।3.59.26।।
transliteration: vikṛṣya cāpaṃ paridhāya sāyakaṃ salīlabāṇena ca tāḍito mayā| mārgīṃ tanuṃ tyajya sa viklabasvaro babhūva keyūradharassarākṣasaḥ
translation: मया by me, चापम् bow, विकृष्य bending, सायकम् an arrow, परिधाय after fixing, सलीलबाणेन arrow released with ease, ताडितः beaten , सः he, मार्गीम्  a deer, तनुम् body, त्यज्य having, सविक्लबस्वर: painful voice, केयूरधरः with a bracelet, राक्षसः demon, बभूव lay down.
explanation: Bending the bow I fixed the arrow and released it at ease. Hit by that arrow he gave up his guise of the deer and assuming the form of a demon with a bracelet on his arm fell down groaning.

shloka_text: शराहतेनैव तदार्तया गिरा स्वरं समालम्ब्य सुदूरसुश्रवम्। उदाहृतं तद्वचनं सुदारुणं त्वमागतो येन विहाय मैथिलीम्।।3.59.27।।
transliteration: śarāhatenaiva tadārtayā girā svaraṃ samālambya sudūrasuśravam| udāhṛtaṃ tadvacanaṃ sudāruṇaṃ tvamāgato yena vihāya maithilīm
translation: तदा then, शराहतेनैव as soon as he was hit by the arrow, आर्तया in distress, गिरा with a voice, सुदूरसुश्रवम्  even heard from a distance, स्वरम् voice, समालम्ब्य adapting, सुदारुणम् very dreadful, तत् that, वचनम् words, उदाहृतम्  uttered, येन by which, त्वम् you, मैथिलीम् Maithili, विहाय after deserting, इह here, आगतः came.
explanation: Hit by the arrow, the demon imitating my voice cried out in desperation which could be clearly audible even from a distance. On hearing the dreadful words you deserted Sita and came here. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: भृशमाव्रजमानस्य तस्याधो वामलोचनम्। प्रास्फुरच्चास्खलद्रामो वेपथुश्चाप्य जायत।।3.60.1।।
transliteration: bhṛśamāvrajamānasya tasyādho vāmalocanam| prāsphuraccāskhaladrāmo vepathuścāpya jāyata
translation: आव्रजमानस्य Rama was moving about, तस्य his, वामलोचनम् left eye, अधः underneath, भृशम् excessively, प्रास्फुरत् throbbed, रामः Rama, प्रास्खलच्च stumbled, अस्य his, वेपथुश्च shivering, जायत was produced.
explanation: As  Rama was returning( to the hermitage), his left eye throbbed repeatedly  and he stumbled and his body trembled.
comments: Rama's sorrow -- goes from tree to tree enquiring about Sita -- Rama and Lakshmana go in search of Sita.

shloka_text: उपालक्ष्य निमित्तानि सोऽशुभानि मुहुर्मुहुः। अपि क्षेमं नु सीताया इति वै व्याजहार च।।3.60.2।।
transliteration: upālakṣya nimittāni so'śubhāni muhurmuhuḥ| api kṣemaṃ nu sītāyā iti vai vyājahāra ca
translation: सः he, अशुभानि inauspicious, निमित्तानि omens, उपालक्ष्य  having marked, सीतायाः of Sita, क्षेमम् अपि नु doubting the welfare, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, व्याजहार च said also.
explanation: As inauspicious omens appeared again and again, doubting if all is well with Sita, he said to himself, Can Sita be safe?

shloka_text: त्वरमाणो जगामाथ सीतादर्शनलालसः। शून्यमावसथं दृष्ट्वा बभूवोद्विग्नमानसः।।3.60.3।।
transliteration: tvaramāṇo jagāmātha sītādarśanalālasaḥ| śūnyamāvasathaṃ dṛṣṭvā babhūvodvignamānasaḥ
translation: अथ then, त्वरमाणः hastening , सीता दर्शनलालसः eager to see, जगाम went, शून्यम् empty, आवसथम् hermitage, दृष्ट्वा saw, उद्विग्नमानसः with an anxious mind, बभूव became.
explanation: Anxious to see Sita, he hastened to the hermitage and finding it empty, became restless.

shloka_text: उद्भ्रमन्निव वेगेन विक्षिपन्रघुनन्दनः। तत्र तत्रोटजस्थानमभिवीक्षय समन्ततः।।3.60.4।। ददर्श पर्णशालां च रहितां सीतया तदा। श्रिया विरहितां ध्वस्तां हेमन्ते पद्मिनीमिव।।3.60.5।।
transliteration: udbhramanniva vegena vikṣipanraghunandanaḥ| tatra tatroṭajasthānamabhivīkṣaya samantataḥ dadarśa parṇaśālāṃ ca rahitāṃ sītayā tadā| śriyā virahitāṃ dhvastāṃ hemante padminīmiva
translation: रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu race, वेगेन quickly, उद्भ्रमन्निव turning round and round, विक्षिपन्  throwing his hands, तत्र तत्र  here and there, उटजस्थानम् place of hermitage, समन्ततः all round, अभिवीक्ष्य scaninng, तदा then, सीतया by Sita, रहिताम् devoid of, हेमन्ते in winter season, ध्वस्ताम् destroyed, पद्मिनीमिव like the lotus pond, श्रिया with beauty, विरहिताम् without, पर्णशालाम् cottage, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, hurtled in, turning round, throwing his hands to and fro, casting his looks all around the cottage where she used to move. The cottage, devoid of Sita looked like a lotuspond, the beauty of its lotuses destroyed by winter.

shloka_text: उद्भ्रमन्निव वेगेन विक्षिपन्रघुनन्दनः। तत्र तत्रोटजस्थानमभिवीक्षय समन्ततः।।3.60.4।। ददर्श पर्णशालां च रहितां सीतया तदा। श्रिया विरहितां ध्वस्तां हेमन्ते पद्मिनीमिव।।3.60.5।।
transliteration: udbhramanniva vegena vikṣipanraghunandanaḥ| tatra tatroṭajasthānamabhivīkṣaya samantataḥ dadarśa parṇaśālāṃ ca rahitāṃ sītayā tadā| śriyā virahitāṃ dhvastāṃ hemante padminīmiva
translation: रघुनन्दनः delight of the Raghu race, वेगेन quickly, उद्भ्रमन्निव turning round and round, विक्षिपन्  throwing his hands, तत्र तत्र  here and there, उटजस्थानम् place of hermitage, समन्ततः all round, अभिवीक्ष्य scaninng, तदा then, सीतया by Sita, रहिताम् devoid of, हेमन्ते in winter season, ध्वस्ताम् destroyed, पद्मिनीमिव like the lotus pond, श्रिया with beauty, विरहिताम् without, पर्णशालाम् cottage, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, hurtled in, turning round, throwing his hands to and fro, casting his looks all around the cottage where she used to move. The cottage, devoid of Sita looked like a lotuspond, the beauty of its lotuses destroyed by winter.

shloka_text: रुदन्तमिव वृक्षैश्च म्लानपुष्पमृगद्विजम्। श्रिया विहीनं विध्वस्तं सन्त्यक्तवनदेवतम्।।3.60.6।। विप्रकीर्णाजिनकुशं विप्रविद्धब्रुसीकटम्। दृष्ट्वा शून्यं निजस्थानं विललाप पुनः पुनः।।3.60.7।।
transliteration: rudantamiva vṛkṣaiśca mlānapuṣpamṛgadvijam| śriyā vihīnaṃ vidhvastaṃ santyaktavanadevatam viprakīrṇājinakuśaṃ vipraviddhabrusīkaṭam| dṛṣṭvā śūnyaṃ nijasthānaṃ vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ
translation: वृक्षैः by the trees, रुदन्तमिव as if crying, म्लानपुष्पमृगद्विजम्  flowers withered and animals and birds turned pale, श्रिया the beauty, विहीनम् devoid of, विध्वस्तम् destroyed, संत्यक्तवनदेवतम् sylvan deities left, विप्रकीर्णाजिनकुशम् with deerskin and kusa grass scattered, विप्रविद्धब्रुसीकटम् with grass cushions and straw mat thrown pellmell, शून्यम् desolate, निजस्थानम् own place, दृष्ट्वा seeing, पुनः पुनः again and again, विललाप wept.
explanation: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left.  The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn here and there, the grass cushions and straw mats lay scattered. Seeing his cottage so desolate Rama wept again and again.

shloka_text: रुदन्तमिव वृक्षैश्च म्लानपुष्पमृगद्विजम्। श्रिया विहीनं विध्वस्तं सन्त्यक्तवनदेवतम्।।3.60.6।। विप्रकीर्णाजिनकुशं विप्रविद्धब्रुसीकटम्। दृष्ट्वा शून्यं निजस्थानं विललाप पुनः पुनः।।3.60.7।।
transliteration: rudantamiva vṛkṣaiśca mlānapuṣpamṛgadvijam| śriyā vihīnaṃ vidhvastaṃ santyaktavanadevatam viprakīrṇājinakuśaṃ vipraviddhabrusīkaṭam| dṛṣṭvā śūnyaṃ nijasthānaṃ vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ
translation: वृक्षैः by the trees, रुदन्तमिव as if crying, म्लानपुष्पमृगद्विजम्  flowers withered and animals and birds turned pale, श्रिया the beauty, विहीनम् devoid of, विध्वस्तम् destroyed, संत्यक्तवनदेवतम् sylvan deities left, विप्रकीर्णाजिनकुशम् with deerskin and kusa grass scattered, विप्रविद्धब्रुसीकटम् with grass cushions and straw mat thrown pellmell, शून्यम् desolate, निजस्थानम् own place, दृष्ट्वा seeing, पुनः पुनः again and again, विललाप wept.
explanation: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left.  The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn here and there, the grass cushions and straw mats lay scattered. Seeing his cottage so desolate Rama wept again and again.

shloka_text: हृता मृता वा नष्टा वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति। निलीनाप्यथवा भीरुरथवा वनमाश्रिता।।3.60.8।।
transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā naṣṭā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati| nilīnāpyathavā bhīrurathavā vanamāśritā
translation: भिरुः timid, हृता abducted, मृता वा or dead, नष्टा वा or ruined, भक्षिता वा or eaten up, भविष्यति may be, अथवा or else, निलीना hiding, अथवा or else, वनम् forest, आश्रिता taken shelter,
explanation: 'Timid Sita might have been abducted or dead or crushed or eaten up by demons. Or, she may be hiding for protection in the forest'

shloka_text: गता विचेतुं पुष्पाणि फलान्यपि च वा पुनः। अथवा पद्मिनीं याता जलार्थं वा नदीं गता।।3.60.9।।
transliteration: gatā vicetuṃ puṣpāṇi phalānyapi ca vā punaḥ| athavā padminīṃ yātā jalārthaṃ vā nadīṃ gatā
translation: अपिवा or else, पुष्पाणि flowers, फलानि च and fruits, विचेतुम् to pluck, गता gone, अथवा or may be, पद्मिनीम् to a lotus pond, याता to get, जलार्थम्  to get water, नदीम् river, गता gone.
explanation: 'Maybe she has gone to pluck flowers or fruits. Or to the lotuspond or river to  fetch water.'

shloka_text: यत्नान्मृगयमाणस्तु नाससाद वने प्रियाम्। शोकरक्तेक्षणश्शोकादुन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते।।3.60.10।।
transliteration: yatnānmṛgayamāṇastu nāsasāda vane priyām| śokaraktekṣaṇaśśokādunmatta iva lakṣyate
translation: यत्नात् by effort, मृगयमाणः तु while searching, वने in the forest, प्रियाम् darling, नाससाद could not see, शोकरक्तेक्षणः eyes turned red with tears, शोकात् owing to grief, उन्मत्त इव like a mad person, लक्ष्यते he appeared.
explanation: He ransacked the forest, yet did not find his beloved. He  appeared like a mad man, his eyes turned red with tears of sorrow.

shloka_text: वृक्षाद्वृक्षं प्रधावन्सगिरेश्चाद्रिं नदान्नदीम्। बभूव विलपन्रामश्शोकार्णवपरिप्लुतः।।3.60.11।।
transliteration: vṛkṣādvṛkṣaṃ pradhāvansagireścādriṃ nadānnadīm| babhūva vilapanrāmaśśokārṇavapariplutaḥ
translation: रामः Rama, वृक्षात् from tree, वृक्षम् to another tree, गिरेः mountain, अद्रिम् to another mountain, नदात् from one river, नदीम् to another river, प्रधावन् while running, विलपन्  while weeping, शोकार्णवपरिप्लुतः immersed in a sea of sorrow, बभूव remained.
explanation: Running from tree to tree, hill to hill, and river to river and weeping, Rama was immersed in a sea of sorrow.

shloka_text: अपि काचित्त्वया दृष्टा सा कदम्बप्रिया प्रिया। कदम्ब यदि जानीषे शंस सीतां शुभाननाम्।।3.60.12।।
transliteration: api kācittvayā dṛṣṭā sā kadambapriyā priyā| kadamba yadi jānīṣe śaṃsa sītāṃ śubhānanām
translation: कदम्ब O Kadamba, कदम्बप्रिया O lover of kadamba flowers, प्रिया my beloved, सा she, काचित् some lady, त्वया by you, अपि दृष्टा is seen, जानीषे यदि if you know, शुभाननाम्  fair face, सीताम् Sita, शंस tell.
explanation: O Kadamba tree, tell me if you have seen my beloved with a fair face and with love for kadamba flowers.

shloka_text: स्निग्धपल्लवसङ्काशा पीतकौशेयवासिनी। शंसस्व यदि वा दृष्टा बिल्व बिल्वोपमस्तनी।।3.60.13।।
transliteration: snigdhapallavasaṅkāśā pītakauśeyavāsinī| śaṃsasva yadi vā dṛṣṭā bilva bilvopamastanī
translation: बिल्व O Bilva, स्निग्धपल्लवसङ्काशा lovely like tender leaf, पीतकौशेयवासिनी dressed in yellow silk, बिल्वोपमस्तनी lady whose breasts are round (like Bilva fruit), यदि वा दृष्टा if you have seen her, शंसस्व let me know.
explanation: O Bilva tree, tell me if you have seen a lady delicate like your tender leaf, dressed in yellow silk, a lady whose breasts are round like Bilva fruits.

shloka_text: अथवाऽर्जुन शंस त्वं प्रियां तामर्जुनप्रियाम्। जनकस्य सुता भीरुर्यदि जीवति वा न वा।।3.60.14।।
transliteration: athavā'rjuna śaṃsa tvaṃ priyāṃ tāmarjunapriyām| janakasya sutā bhīruryadi jīvati vā na vā
translation: अथवा or else, अर्जुन O Arjuna tree, त्वम् you, अर्जुनप्रियाम् lover of Arjuna tree, तां प्रियाम् that beloved of mine, शंस tell me if you know, भीरुः a timid lady, जनकस्य सुता daughter of Janaka, यदि जीवति वा is she living, न वा or not.
explanation: O Arjuna tree, tell me if you know a timid lady, daughter of Janaka and my beloved, fond of Arjuna tree. Is the living or not ?

shloka_text: ककुभः ककुभोरूं तां व्यक्तं जानाति मैथिलीम्। यथा पल्लवपुष्पाढ्यो भाति ह्येष वनस्पतिः।।3.60.15।।
transliteration: kakubhaḥ kakubhorūṃ tāṃ vyaktaṃ jānāti maithilīm| yathā pallavapuṣpāḍhyo bhāti hyeṣa vanaspatiḥ
translation: वनस्पतिः the tree, पल्लवपुष्पाढ्यः rich with tender leaves and flowers, यथा as, भाति appears, ककुभः kakubha, ककुभोरूम् lady with beautiful thighs, ताम् her, मैथिलीम् Maithili's, व्यक्तम् clearly, जानाति the tree knows.
explanation: This Kakubha tree rich with tender leaves and flowers (perhaps)knows Maithili whose thighs are beautiful like the trunk of the Kakubha tree.

shloka_text: भ्रमरैरुपगीतश्च यथा द्रुमवरो ह्ययम्। एष व्यक्तं विजानाति तिलकस्तिलकप्रियाम्।।3.60.16।।
transliteration: bhramarairupagītaśca yathā drumavaro hyayam| eṣa vyaktaṃ vijānāti tilakastilakapriyām
translation: द्रुमवरः best of trees, अयम् this, तिलकः Tilaka, यथा as, भ्रमरैः with bees, उपगीतः is sung, एषः he that, तिलकप्रियाम् a lover of mark on the forehead, व्यक्तम् it is sure, विजानाति knows?
explanation: This great Tilaka tree round which bees bumble surely knows the lady who loves to put tilaka marks on the forehead.

shloka_text: अशोक शोकापनुद शोकोपहतचेतसम्। त्वन्नामानं कुरु क्षिप्रं प्रियासन्दर्शनेन माम्।।3.60.17।।
transliteration: aśoka śokāpanuda śokopahatacetasam| tvannāmānaṃ kuru kṣipraṃ priyāsandarśanena mām
translation: शोकापनुद O dispeller of sorrow, अशोक O Ashoka tree, प्रियासन्दर्शनेन by showing me my darling, शोकोपहतचेतसम् with a griefstricken heart , माम् to me, क्षिप्रम् quickly, त्वन्नामानम् let me be called by your name, कुरु do it.
explanation: O Ashoka tree, dispeller of sorrow, by quickly showing me my darling make me ashoka (free from sorrow) as I am griefstricken at heart.

shloka_text: यदि ताल त्वया दृष्टा पक्वतालफलस्तनी। कथयस्व वरारोहां कारुण्यं यदि ते मयि।।3.60.18।।
transliteration: yadi tāla tvayā dṛṣṭā pakvatālaphalastanī| kathayasva varārohāṃ kāruṇyaṃ yadi te mayi
translation: ताल Palmyra tree, पक्वतालफलस्तनी one who has breasts like ripened palmyra fruit, त्वया by you, दृष्टा यदि if seen, ते you, मयि my, कारुण्यं यदि kind to me, वरारोहाम् Sita, कथयस्व tell me.
explanation: O Palmyra tree be kind to me and tell me if you have seen my beautiful beloved who has breasts like ripe palmyra fruit?

shloka_text: यदि दृष्टा त्वया सीता जम्बु जम्बूफलोपमा। प्रियां यदि विजानीषे निःशङ्कं कथयस्व मे।।3.60.19।।
transliteration: yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā sītā jambu jambūphalopamā| priyāṃ yadi vijānīṣe niḥśaṅkaṃ kathayasva me
translation: जम्बु O Jambu tree, त्वया by you, सीता Sita, यदि दृष्टा if seen, जम्बूफलोपमा a lady whose body is shining lovely like gold, प्रियाम् the beloved one, (वि)जानीषे यदि know of her, मे to me, निःशङ्कम् without hesitation, कथयस्व tell me.
explanation: O Jambu tree, do not hesitate to tell me if you know Sita whose body shines lovely like gold.

shloka_text: अहो त्वं कर्णिकाराद्य सुपुष्पैश्शोभसे भृशम्। कर्णिकारप्रिया साध्वी शंस दृष्टा प्रिया यदि।।3.60.20।।
transliteration: aho tvaṃ karṇikārādya supuṣpaiśśobhase bhṛśam| karṇikārapriyā sādhvī śaṃsa dṛṣṭā priyā yadi
translation: कर्णिकाराः O Karnikara tree, त्वम् you, अद्य now, सुपुष्पैः with flowers in full doom, भृशम् शोभसे shine, अहो Oh, कर्णिकारप्रिया lover of Karnikara, साध्वी chaste woman, प्रिया beloved, दृष्टा यदि seen her, शंस tell.
explanation: O Karnikara tree with flowers in full bloom, tell me if you have seen my faithful beloved who is fond of karnikara flowers.

shloka_text: चूतनीपमहासालान्पनसान्कुरवान्धवान्। दाडिमाननसान्गत्वा दृष्ट्वा रामो महायशाः।।3.60.21।। मल्लिका माधवीश्चैव चम्पकान्केतकीस्तथा। पृच्छन्रामो वने भान्तः उन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते।।3.60.22।।
