translation: महातेजाः of great brilliance, सत्त्ववान् a powerful one, शीलवान् a man of good conduct, शुचिः pure, लक्ष्मणस्तु Lakshmna too, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, दीप्ततेजसम् glowing in splendour, भ्रातरम् his brother, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Lakshmana of great brilliance and power, of good conduct and pure character spoke to his highly effulgent brother with folded hands:

shloka_text: स्पन्दते च दृढं बाहुरुद्विग्नमिव मे मनः। प्रायशश्चाप्यनिष्टानि निमित्तान्युपलक्षये।।3.69.21।।
transliteration: spandate ca dṛḍhaṃ bāhurudvignamiva me manaḥ| prāyaśaścāpyaniṣṭāni nimittānyupalakṣaye
translation: मे my, बाहुः arm, दृढम् strongly, स्पन्दते is throbbing, मनः mind, उद्विग्नमिव is as if agitated, प्रायशः probably, अनिष्टानि undesirable ones, निमित्तानि omens, उपलक्षये I am observing.
explanation: My arm is throbbing heavily. My mind is agitated. The omens I see foretell some undesirable events.

shloka_text: तस्मात्सज्जीभवार्य त्वं कुरुष्व वचनं हितम्। ममैव हि निमित्तानि सद्यश्शंसन्ति सम्भ्रमम्।।3.69.22।।
transliteration: tasmātsajjībhavārya tvaṃ kuruṣva vacanaṃ hitam| mamaiva hi nimittāni sadyaśśaṃsanti sambhramam
translation: आर्य O noble one, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, सज्जीभव be ready, हितम् good, वचनम् words, कुरुष्व you may act upon, निमित्तानि omens, सद्यः presently, सम्भ्रमम् fear, मम I am, शंसन्ति इव हि as though they are forecasting.
explanation: O noble brother be alert. Heed my words of good advice. The bad omens I see presage perils.

shloka_text: एष वञ्चुलको नाम पक्षी परमदारुणः। आवयोर्विजयं युद्धे शंसन्निव विनर्दति।।3.69.23।।
transliteration: eṣa vañculako nāma pakṣī paramadāruṇaḥ| āvayorvijayaṃ yuddhe śaṃsanniva vinardati
translation: परमदारुणः extremely dreadful, वञ्चुलको नाम  by name Vanchulaka, एषः पक्षी this bird, युद्धे in strife, आवयोः both of us, विजयम् triumph, शंसन्निव as though telling, विनर्दति cries loudly.
explanation: This vanchulaka bird's loud and dreadful screams suggest our triumph in war.

shloka_text: तयोरन्वेषतोरेवं सर्वं तद्वनमोजसा। संजज्ञे विपुलः शब्दो प्रभञ्जन्निव तद्वनम्।।3.69.24।।
transliteration: tayoranveṣatorevaṃ sarvaṃ tadvanamojasā| saṃjajñe vipulaḥ śabdo prabhañjanniva tadvanam
translation: तयोः both, एवम् in that manner, ओजसा with strength, सर्वम् all over, तत् वनम् that forest, अन्वेषतोः while both were searching, तत् वनम् that forest, प्रभञ्जन्निव as if shattering, विपुलः very big, शब्दः sound, संजज्ञे broke out.
explanation: As both the brothers with great prowess were searching for Sita all over, a huge sound exploded as if shattering the forest.

shloka_text: संवेष्टितमिवात्यर्थं गगनं मातरिश्वना। वनस्य तस्य शब्दोऽभूद्दिवमापूरयन्निव।।3.69.25।।
transliteration: saṃveṣṭitamivātyarthaṃ gaganaṃ mātariśvanā| vanasya tasya śabdo'bhūddivamāpūrayanniva
translation: गगनम् sky, अत्यर्थम् very much, मातरिश्वना by fierce wind, संवेष्टितमिव was as if covered, तस्य of that, वनस्य of the forest, शब्दः sound, दिवम् sky, आपूरयन्निव was filling, अभूत् rose.
explanation: It appeared as though a fierce wind rose from the forest and filled the sky.

shloka_text: तं शब्दं काङ्क्षमाणस्तु रामः कक्षे सहानुजः। ददर्श सुमहाकायं राक्षसं विपुलोदरम्।।3.69.26।।
transliteration: taṃ śabdaṃ kāṅkṣamāṇastu rāmaḥ kakṣe sahānujaḥ| dadarśa sumahākāyaṃ rākṣasaṃ vipulodaram
translation: तं शब्दम् that sound, काङ्क्षमाणः a man looking for it, सहानुजः along with his brother, रामः Rama, कक्षे on the side, सुमहाकायम् one with a huge body, विपुलोदरम् and a big belly, राक्षसम् demon, ददर्श saw.
explanation: While looking for the sound, Rama with his brother saw a demon with a huge body and a big belly.

shloka_text: आसेदतुस्ततस्तत्र तावुभौ प्रमुखे स्थितम्। विवृद्धमशिरोग्रीवं कबन्धमुदरे मुखम्।।3.69.27।।
transliteration: āsedatustatastatra tāvubhau pramukhe sthitam| vivṛddhamaśirogrīvaṃ kabandhamudare mukham
translation: ततः then, तौ उभौ both of them, तत्र there, प्रमुखे in front, स्थितम् stood, विवृद्धम् very well grown, अशिरोग्रीवम् without head and neck, उदरे मुखम् with his face in the stomach, कबन्धम् trunk, आसेदतुः reached.
explanation: Then both the brothers saw a very tall figure with a trunk that stood facing them. He had neither neck nor head. His face was in the stomach.

shloka_text: रोमभिर्निचितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्महागिरिमिवोछ्रितम्। नीलमेघनिभं रौद्रं मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम्।।3.69.28।।
transliteration: romabhirnicitaistīkṣṇairmahāgirimivochritam| nīlameghanibhaṃ raudraṃ meghastanitanisvanam
translation: निचितैः by those spread all over the body, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp bristles, रोमभिः hair, उच्छ्रिचतम् mammoth figure, महागिरिमिव like a big mountain, नीलमेघनिभम् resembling a dark cloud, रौद्रम् a fierce one, मेघस्तनितनिस्वनम् voice like the thunder of the cloud.
explanation: With sharp bristled hair all over the body, he was a mammoth figure who looked like a mountain  resembling a dark cloud with his voice like the thunder.

shloka_text: अग्निज्वालानिकाशेन ललाटस्थेन दीप्यता। महापक्ष्मेण पिङ्गेन विपुलेनायतेन च।।3.69.29।। एकेनोरसि घोरेण नयनेनाशुदर्शिना। महादंष्ट्रोपपन्नं तल्लेलिहानं महामुखम्।।3.69.30।।
transliteration: agnijvālānikāśena lalāṭasthena dīpyatā| mahāpakṣmeṇa piṅgena vipulenāyatena ca ekenorasi ghoreṇa nayanenāśudarśinā| mahādaṃṣṭropapannaṃ tallelihānaṃ mahāmukham
translation: अग्निज्वालानिकाशेन resembling the flaming fire, ललाटस्थेन on the forehead, दीप्यता by the glowing, महापक्ष्मेण with huge eyelashes, पिङ्गेन with reddishbrown colour, विपुलेन huge, आयतेन च stretched , आशुदर्शिना with instant vision, घोरेण terrific one, उरसि on the chest, एकेन one, नयनेन eye, महादंष्ट्रोपपन्नम् having massive fangs, लेलिहानम् while licking his lips, महामुखम् his huge mouth, तम् him
explanation: He had a single eye that was reddishbrown in colour resembling flaming fire. It was fixed in the chest. His eyelashes glowed. He had instant vision with massive fangs in his huge mouth. He was licking his lips.

shloka_text: अग्निज्वालानिकाशेन ललाटस्थेन दीप्यता। महापक्ष्मेण पिङ्गेन विपुलेनायतेन च।।3.69.29।। एकेनोरसि घोरेण नयनेनाशुदर्शिना। महादंष्ट्रोपपन्नं तल्लेलिहानं महामुखम्।।3.69.30।।
transliteration: agnijvālānikāśena lalāṭasthena dīpyatā| mahāpakṣmeṇa piṅgena vipulenāyatena ca ekenorasi ghoreṇa nayanenāśudarśinā| mahādaṃṣṭropapannaṃ tallelihānaṃ mahāmukham
translation: अग्निज्वालानिकाशेन resembling the flaming fire, ललाटस्थेन on the forehead, दीप्यता by the glowing, महापक्ष्मेण with huge eyelashes, पिङ्गेन with reddishbrown colour, विपुलेन huge, आयतेन च stretched , आशुदर्शिना with instant vision, घोरेण terrific one, उरसि on the chest, एकेन one, नयनेन eye, महादंष्ट्रोपपन्नम् having massive fangs, लेलिहानम् while licking his lips, महामुखम् his huge mouth, तम् him
explanation: He had a single eye that was reddishbrown in colour resembling flaming fire. It was fixed in the chest. His eyelashes glowed. He had instant vision with massive fangs in his huge mouth. He was licking his lips.

shloka_text: भक्षयन्तं महाघोरानृक्षसिंहमृगद्विपान्। घोरौ भुजौ विकुर्वाणमुभौ योजनमायतौ।।3.69.31।।
transliteration: bhakṣayantaṃ mahāghorānṛkṣasiṃhamṛgadvipān| ghorau bhujau vikurvāṇamubhau yojanamāyatau
translation: महाघोरान् terrific, ऋक्षसिंहमृगद्विपान् bears, lions, deer and elephants, भक्षयन्तम् while eating, योजनम् a Yojana (eight miles), आयतौ long ones, घोरौ both frightening, उभौ both, भूजौ two arms, विकुर्वाणम् as he was stretching.
explanation: The terrific demon kept eating bears, lions, deer and elephants, catching with both his arms stretching up to one yojana.

shloka_text: कराभ्यां विविधान्गृह्यऋक्षान्पक्षिगणान्मृगान्। आकर्षन्तं विकर्षन्तमनेकान्मृगयूथपान्।।3.69.32।। स्थितमावृत्य पन्थानं तयोर्भ्रात्रोः प्रपन्नयोः।
transliteration: karābhyāṃ vividhāngṛhyaṛkṣānpakṣigaṇānmṛgān| ākarṣantaṃ vikarṣantamanekānmṛgayūthapān sthitamāvṛtya panthānaṃ tayorbhrātroḥ prapannayoḥ|
translation: ऋक्षान् bears, विविधान् various, पक्षिगणान् birds, मृगान् deer, अनेकान् many, मृगयूथपान् herds of deer, कराभ्याम्  by both his hands, गृह्य taking, आकर्षन्तम् seizing, विकर्षन्तम् throwing  away, प्रपन्नयोः reached there, तयोः both the, भ्रात्रोः of brothers, पन्थानम् path, आवृत्य after blocking, स्थितम् stood.
explanation: He stood rooted there, catching bears, flocks of birds and deer with both his hands stretching up to one yojana, pulling and pushing them. (Now) he obstructed the path of the two brothers.

shloka_text: अथ तौ समभिक्रम्य क्रोशमात्रे ददर्शतुः।।3.69.33।। महान्तं दारुणं भीमं कबन्धं भुजसंवृम्। कबन्धमिव संस्थानादतिघोरप्रदर्शनम्।।3.69.34।।
transliteration: atha tau samabhikramya krośamātre dadarśatuḥ mahāntaṃ dāruṇaṃ bhīmaṃ kabandhaṃ bhujasaṃvṛm| kabandhamiva saṃsthānādatighorapradarśanam
translation: अथ then, तौ both, समभिक्रम्य after covering, क्रोशमात्रे at a distance of one krosa (2 miles), महान्तम् mighty, दारुणम् cruel, भीमम् frightening, भुजसंवृतम् his arms encircling, संस्थानात् from his form, कबन्धमिव like a trunk, घोरप्रदर्शनम् putting is a monstrous appearance, कबन्धम् one demon, Kabandha, ददर्शतुः they both saw.
explanation: Then the brothers after covering one krosa (2 miles) saw a cruel, fierce, mighty monster named Kabandha looking like a trunk. He had a dreadful appearance and his arms encircled the area.

shloka_text: अथ तौ समभिक्रम्य क्रोशमात्रे ददर्शतुः।।3.69.33।। महान्तं दारुणं भीमं कबन्धं भुजसंवृम्। कबन्धमिव संस्थानादतिघोरप्रदर्शनम्।।3.69.34।।
transliteration: atha tau samabhikramya krośamātre dadarśatuḥ mahāntaṃ dāruṇaṃ bhīmaṃ kabandhaṃ bhujasaṃvṛm| kabandhamiva saṃsthānādatighorapradarśanam
translation: अथ then, तौ both, समभिक्रम्य after covering, क्रोशमात्रे at a distance of one krosa (2 miles), महान्तम् mighty, दारुणम् cruel, भीमम् frightening, भुजसंवृतम् his arms encircling, संस्थानात् from his form, कबन्धमिव like a trunk, घोरप्रदर्शनम् putting is a monstrous appearance, कबन्धम् one demon, Kabandha, ददर्शतुः they both saw.
explanation: Then the brothers after covering one krosa (2 miles) saw a cruel, fierce, mighty monster named Kabandha looking like a trunk. He had a dreadful appearance and his arms encircled the area.

shloka_text: स महाबाहुरत्यर्थं प्रसार्य विपुलौ भुजौ। जग्राह सहितावेव राघवौ पीडयन्बलात्।।3.69.35।।
transliteration: sa mahābāhuratyarthaṃ prasārya vipulau bhujau| jagrāha sahitāveva rāghavau pīḍayanbalāt
translation: महाबाहुः long armed one, सः he, विपुलौ very big, भुजौ both arms, अत्यर्थम् greatly, प्रसार्य  spreading, सहितावेव राघवौ brothers together, बलात् with strength, पीडयन्  pressing, जग्राह held.
explanation: The longarmed demon spread his hands and caught hold of Rama and Lakshmana together by pressing them with all his force.

shloka_text: खड्गिनौ दृढधन्वानौ तिग्मतेजोवपुर्धरौ। भ्रातरौ विवशं प्राप्तौ कृष्यमाणौ महाबलौ।।3.69.36।।
transliteration: khaḍginau dṛḍhadhanvānau tigmatejovapurdharau| bhrātarau vivaśaṃ prāptau kṛṣyamāṇau mahābalau
translation: खड्गिनौ  wielders of swords, दृढधन्वानौ  with strong bows, तिग्मतेजोवपुर्धरौ  with bodies of fiery splendour, महाबलौ mighty, भ्रातरौ both brothers, कृष्यमाणौ both being seized, विवशम् प्राप्तौ both became helpless.
explanation: The two mighty brothers who wielded swords and strong bows and whose bodies were of fiery splendour became helpless, seized by the hands of Kabandha.

shloka_text: तत्र धैर्येण शूरस्तु राघवो नैव विव्यथे। बाल्यादनाश्रयत्वाच्च लक्ष्मणस्त्वतिविव्यथे।।3.69.37।। उवाच स विषण्णस्सन्राघवं राघवानुजः।
transliteration: tatra dhairyeṇa śūrastu rāghavo naiva vivyathe| bālyādanāśrayatvācca lakṣmaṇastvativivyathe uvāca sa viṣaṇṇassanrāghavaṃ rāghavānujaḥ|
translation: तत्र there, शूरः heroic, राघवः Raghava, धैर्येण with courage, नैव विव्यथे not pained, लक्ष्मणस्तु but Lakshmana, बाल्यात् being younger, आनाश्रयत्वाच्च not having much courage, अतिविव्यथे very worried, सः that, राघवानुजः brother of Rama, विषण्णस्सन् depressed, राघवम् to Rama, उवाच said,
explanation: Of the two heroes, Rama being courageous was not worried but Lakshmana being younger and not having as much courage, was very much concerned and depressed. He said to Rama:

shloka_text: पश्य मां वीर विवशं राक्षसस्य वशं गतम्।।3.69.38।। मयैकेन विनिर्युक्तः परिमुञ्चस्व राघव।
transliteration: paśya māṃ vīra vivaśaṃ rākṣasasya vaśaṃ gatam mayaikena viniryuktaḥ parimuñcasva rāghava|
translation: वीर heroic Rama, विवशम् helpless, राक्षसस्य वशम् under the control of the demon, गतम् gone, माम् me, पश्य see, राघव Rama, एकेन by one alone, मया by me, विनिर्युक्तः offering me, परिमुञ्चस्व set yourself free.
explanation: O heroic Rama see how helpless I am under the control of the demon. Set yourself free, leaving me alone and using me as an offering.

shloka_text: मां हि भूतबलिं दत्वा पलायस्व यथासुखम्।।3.69.39।। अधिगन्तासि वैदेहीमचिरेणेति मे मतिः।
transliteration: māṃ hi bhūtabaliṃ datvā palāyasva yathāsukham adhigantāsi vaidehīmacireṇeti me matiḥ|
translation: माम् me, भूतबलिम् as an offering, दत्वा after giving, यथासुखम् happily, पलायस्व you may run away, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अचिरेण soon, अधिगन्तासि will attain her, इति this is, मे my, मतिः opinion.
explanation: Giving me to this monstor as an offering, you may run away happily. I think you will soon obtain Vaidehi.

shloka_text: प्रतिलभ्य च काकुत्स्थ पितृपैतामहीं महीम्।।3.69.40।। तत्र मां राम राज्यस्थस्स्मर्तुमर्हसि सर्वदा।
transliteration: pratilabhya ca kākutstha pitṛpaitāmahīṃ mahīm tatra māṃ rāma rājyasthassmartumarhasi sarvadā|
translation: काकुत्थ्स O scion of Kakutstha dynasty, राम Rama, पितृपैतामहीम् heriditary reign, महीम् land, प्रतिलभ्य च on getting, तत्र there, राज्यस्थः as one ruling the country, सर्वदा always, माम् me, स्मर्तुम् remember, अर्हसि should.
explanation: O scion of the Kakutstha dynasty, on getting the hereditary kingdom and ruling over it you should always remember me.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्तस्तु रामस्सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्।।3.69.41।। मा स्म त्रासं कृथा वीर न हि त्वादृग्विषीदति।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇenaivamuktastu rāmassaumitrimabravīt mā sma trāsaṃ kṛthā vīra na hi tvādṛgviṣīdati|
translation: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been said, रामः Rama, सौमित्रिम् to Soumitri, अब्रवीत् said, वीर heroic Lakshmana, त्रासम् fear, मा स्म कृथाः do not entertain, त्वादृक् a hero like you, न विषीदति हि  should not get desperate.
explanation: O  valiant Lakshmana, a hero like you should not get desparate. said Rama to Saumitri when he was thus entreated by Lakshmana.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे क्रूरो भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.69.42।। पप्रच्छ घननिर्घोषः कबन्धो दानवोत्तमः।
transliteration: etasminnantare krūro bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau papraccha ghananirghoṣaḥ kabandho dānavottamaḥ|
translation: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in the meanwhile, क्रूरः cruel one, दानवोत्तमः foremost of the demons, कबन्धः Kabandha, घननिर्घोषः rumbling like thunder, भ्रातरौ to the brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, पप्रच्छ questioned.
explanation: In the meanwhile the foremost of the demons, Kabandha, rumbling like thunder questioned the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana:

shloka_text: कौ युवां वृषभस्कन्धौ महाखड्गधनुर्धरौ।।3.69.43।। घोरं देशमिमं प्राप्तौ मम भक्षावुपस्थितौ।
transliteration: kau yuvāṃ vṛṣabhaskandhau mahākhaḍgadhanurdharau ghoraṃ deśamimaṃ prāptau mama bhakṣāvupasthitau|
translation: वृषभस्कन्धौ whose shoulders are comparable to a bull, महाखड्गधनुर्धरौ both holding great sword and bow, घोरम् dreadful, इमं देशम् this place, प्राप्तौ reached here, युवाम् you both, कौ who are you, मम for me, भक्षौ both, उपस्थितौ have reached.
explanation: Who are you with bulllike shoulders, wielding big swords, bows and arrows? By coming to this place you have become my food.

shloka_text: वदतं कार्यमिह वां किमर्थं चागतौ युवाम्।।3.69.44।। इमं देशमनुप्राप्तौ क्षुधार्तस्येह तिष्ठतः।
transliteration: vadataṃ kāryamiha vāṃ kimarthaṃ cāgatau yuvām imaṃ deśamanuprāptau kṣudhārtasyeha tiṣṭhataḥ|
translation: इह here, वाम् to you both, कार्यम् work, वदतम् speak, युवाम् both, किमर्थम् for what purpose?, आगतौ have come, क्षुधार्तस्य for the hungry, इह here, तिष्ठतः while staying here, इमम् this, देशम् place, अनुप्राप्तौ came at the right time.
explanation: For what purpose have you come? What work have you here ? You have come at the right time as my food, since I am hungry.

shloka_text: सबाणचापखड्गौ च तीक्ष्णशृङ्गाविवर्षभौ।।3.69.45।। ममास्यमनुसम्प्राप्तौ दुर्लभं जीवितं पुनः।
transliteration: sabāṇacāpakhaḍgau ca tīkṣṇaśṛṅgāvivarṣabhau mamāsyamanusamprāptau durlabhaṃ jīvitaṃ punaḥ|
translation: सबाणचापखड्गौ holding bows and arrows and swords, तीक्ष्णशृङ्गौ two sharp horns, ऋषभौ इव like bulls, मम my, आस्यम् mouth, अनुसम्प्राप्तौ you both have reached, पुनः again, जीवितम् lives, दुर्लभम् impossible.
explanation: Holding bows, arrows and swords, looking like bulls with pointed horns you have entered my mouth. It is impossible for you to live any more.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा कबन्धस्य दुरात्मनः।।3.69.46।। उवाच लक्ष्मणं रामो मुखेन परिशुष्यता।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kabandhasya durātmanaḥ uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ rāmo mukhena pariśuṣyatā|
translation: दुरात्मनः of the evilminded, तस्य कबन्धस्य that Kabandha's, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा on hearing, रामः Rama, परिशुष्यता by dried up, मुखेन by mouth, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmna, अब्रवीत् said:
explanation: On hearing the words of the evilminded Kabandha, Rama said to Lakshmana with dried up mouth:

shloka_text: कृच्छ्रात् कृच्छ्रतरं प्राप्य दारुणं सत्यविक्रमः।।3.69.47।। व्यसनं जीवितान्ताय प्राप्तमप्राप्य तां प्रियाम्।
transliteration: kṛcchrāt kṛcchrataraṃ prāpya dāruṇaṃ satyavikramaḥ vyasanaṃ jīvitāntāya prāptamaprāpya tāṃ priyām|
translation: सत्यविक्रम  one whose valour is truth, कृच्छ्रात् from one calamity, कृच्छ्रतरम् to a greater calamity, प्राप्य having reached, प्रियाम् beloved, ताम् her, अप्राप्य having lost, जीवितान्ताय for ending life, दारुणम् unbearable, व्यसनम् crisis, प्राप्तम् experienced.
explanation: O Lakshmana, your valour is truth.We have gone through from one calamity to a greater one without finding the beloved Sita. Now we have landed into a terrible crisis which will put an end to our own life.

shloka_text: कालस्य सुमहद्वीर्यं सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मण।।3.69.48।। त्वां च मां च नरव्याघ्र व्यसनैः पश्य मोहितौ।
transliteration: kālasya sumahadvīryaṃ sarvabhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa tvāṃ ca māṃ ca naravyāghra vyasanaiḥ paśya mohitau|
translation: नरव्याघ्र tiger among men, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सर्वभूतेषु for all beings, कालस्य of the time, वीर्यम् power, सुमहत् great, व्यसनैः by calamity, मोहितौ afflicted, त्वां च yourself, मां me, च and, पश्य see.
explanation: O tiger among men see how powerful the might of time is for all beings Just see  yourself and myself afflicted wth this great calamity.

shloka_text: नातिभारोस्ति कालस्य सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मण।।3.69.49।। शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च कृतास्त्राश्च रणाजिरे। कालाभिपन्नास्सीदन्ति यथा वालुकसेतवः।।3.69.50।।
transliteration: nātibhārosti kālasya sarvabhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa śūrāśca balavantaśca kṛtāstrāśca raṇājire| kālābhipannāssīdanti yathā vālukasetavaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, कालस्य of the time, सर्वभूतेषु over all creatures, अतिभारः great weight, नास्ति not there, शूराश्च brave people, बलवन्तश्च or strong men, रणाजिरे कृतास्त्राश्च those who know the use of arms in the war, कालाभिपन्नाः by the force of time, वालुकसेतवः यथा like barriers built with sand, सीदतन्ति make way.
explanation: O Lakshmana look at the power of time over all creatures There is nothing too heavy for time. Even those who know the use of arms in war, or are brave or strong enough, cannot  withstand the force of time like the barriers built with sand.

shloka_text: नातिभारोस्ति कालस्य सर्वभूतेषु लक्ष्मण।।3.69.49।। शूराश्च बलवन्तश्च कृतास्त्राश्च रणाजिरे। कालाभिपन्नास्सीदन्ति यथा वालुकसेतवः।।3.69.50।।
transliteration: nātibhārosti kālasya sarvabhūteṣu lakṣmaṇa śūrāśca balavantaśca kṛtāstrāśca raṇājire| kālābhipannāssīdanti yathā vālukasetavaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, कालस्य of the time, सर्वभूतेषु over all creatures, अतिभारः great weight, नास्ति not there, शूराश्च brave people, बलवन्तश्च or strong men, रणाजिरे कृतास्त्राश्च those who know the use of arms in the war, कालाभिपन्नाः by the force of time, वालुकसेतवः यथा like barriers built with sand, सीदतन्ति make way.
explanation: O Lakshmana look at the power of time over all creatures There is nothing too heavy for time. Even those who know the use of arms in war, or are brave or strong enough, cannot  withstand the force of time like the barriers built with sand.

shloka_text: इति ब्रुवाणो दृढसत्यविक्रमो महायशा दाशरथिः प्रतापवान्। अवेक्ष्य सौमित्रिमुदग्रपौरुषं स्थिरां तदा स्वां मतिमात्मनाऽकरोत्।।3.69.51।।
transliteration: iti bruvāṇo dṛḍhasatyavikramo mahāyaśā dāśarathiḥ pratāpavān| avekṣya saumitrimudagrapauruṣaṃ sthirāṃ tadā svāṃ matimātmanā'karot
translation: दृढसत्यविक्रमः Firm in the strength of truth, महायशाः illustrious, प्रतापवान्  powerful, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son (Rama), इति thus, ब्रुवाणः spoke, उदग्रपौरुषम् of mighty manliness, सौमित्रिम् Saumitri, अवेक्ष्य on seeing, तदा then, स्वाम् his own, स्थिराम् determined, मतिम् mind, आत्मना himself, अकरोत् fixed.
explanation: Firm in the strength of truth, famous and powerful Rama, son of Dasaratha,  determined to act with a steadfast mind, spoke to Lakshmana of mighty manliness on seeing him. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyninth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तौ तु तत्र स्थितौ दृष्ट्वा भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। बाहुपाशपरिक्षिप्तौ कबन्धो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.70.1।।
transliteration: tau tu tatra sthitau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau| bāhupāśaparikṣiptau kabandho vākyamabravīt
translation: बाहुपाशपरिक्षिप्तौ bound by the shackles of his arms, तत्र स्थितौ both stood there, भ्रातरौ brothers, तौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, कबन्धः Kabandha, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Kabandha saw the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, stand there bound by the shackles of his arms and said:
comments: Rama and Lakshmana sever the arms of Kabandha-- reveal their identity to him-- Kabandha welcomes Rama and Lakshmana-- his lamentation.

shloka_text: तिष्ठतः किं नु मां दृष्ट्वा क्षुधार्तं क्षत्रियर्षभौ। आहारार्थं तु सन्दिष्टौ दैवेन गतचेतसौ।।3.70.2।।
transliteration: tiṣṭhataḥ kiṃ nu māṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣudhārtaṃ kṣatriyarṣabhau| āhārārthaṃ tu sandiṣṭau daivena gatacetasau
translation: क्षत्रियर्षभौ two bulls among the kshatriyas, क्षुधार्तम् suffering from hunger, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, किं नु why do you, तिष्ठतः both stand here, गतचेतसौ with the senses lost, दैवेन by god, आहारार्थम् for my food, सन्दिष्टौ  are sent.
explanation: O bulls among the kshatriyas You are sent by destiny as food to appease my hunger. Seeing me hungry, why do you stand there with your senses switched off ?

shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं प्राप्तकालं हितं तदा। उवाचाऽर्तिं समापन्नो विक्रमे कृतलक्षणः।।3.70.3।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇo vākyaṃ prāptakālaṃ hitaṃ tadā| uvācā'rtiṃ samāpanno vikrame kṛtalakṣaṇaḥ
translation: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, तदा then, आर्तिम् suffering, समापन्नः he underwent, विक्रमे  to exhibit courage, कृतलक्षणः he has resorted to, प्राप्तकालम् appropriate time, हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: Having heard this, Lakshmana, who was greatly suffering gathered courage at appropriate time and said these salutary words:

shloka_text: त्वां च मां च पुरा तूर्णमादत्ते राक्षसाधमः। तस्मादसिभ्यामस्याशु बाहू छिन्दावहै गुरू।।3.70.4।।
transliteration: tvāṃ ca māṃ ca purā tūrṇamādatte rākṣasādhamaḥ| tasmādasibhyāmasyāśu bāhū chindāvahai gurū
translation: राक्षसाधमः this vile demon, तूर्णम् quickly, त्वां च your, मां च and me, पुरा आदत्ते before he gulps, तस्मात् therefore, अस्य his, गुरू long, बाहू shoulders, असिभ्याम् by our swords, छिन्दावहै cut off.
explanation: Before this vile demon gulps you and me let us cut off his long arms with our swords.

shloka_text: भीषणोऽयं महाकायो राक्षसो भुजविक्रमः। लोकं ह्यतिजितं कृत्वा ह्यावां हन्तुमिहेच्छति।।3.70.5।।
transliteration: bhīṣaṇo'yaṃ mahākāyo rākṣaso bhujavikramaḥ| lokaṃ hyatijitaṃ kṛtvā hyāvāṃ hantumihecchati
translation: भीषणः horrible, महाकायः huge, भुजविक्रमः having the strength of his arms, राक्षसः demon, लोकम् world, अतिजितम्  having conquered, कृत्वा after doing so, इह here, आवाम् us, हन्तुम् to kill, इच्छति intends.
explanation: This huge, horrible demon with the strength of his arms has conquered the world, and now intends to kill us here.

shloka_text: निश्चेष्टानां वधो राजन्कुत्सितो जगतीपतेः। क्रतुमध्योपनीतानां पशूनामिव राघव।।3.70.6।।
transliteration: niśceṣṭānāṃ vadho rājankutsito jagatīpateḥ| kratumadhyopanītānāṃ paśūnāmiva rāghava
translation: राजन् king, राघव of the Raghu race, निश्चेष्टानाम् of harmless creatures, वधः killing, क्रतुमध्योपनीतानाम् brought in the midst of a sacrifice, पशूनामिव like animals, जगतीपतेः lord of the world, कुत्सितः censurable.
explanation: O prince of the Raghu race  just as the animal brought in the midst of a sacrifice should not be killed, so also for a king to kill any harmless creature is despicable.

shloka_text: एतत्सञ्जल्पितं श्रुत्वा तयोः क्रुद्धस्तु राक्षसः। विदार्याऽस्यं तदा रौद्रस्तौ भक्षयितुमारभत्।।3.70.7।।
transliteration: etatsañjalpitaṃ śrutvā tayoḥ kruddhastu rākṣasaḥ| vidāryā'syaṃ tadā raudrastau bhakṣayitumārabhat
translation: क्रूरः cruel, रौद्रः ferocious, राक्षसस्तु the demon, तदा then, तयोः them, सञ्जल्पितम् conversing, श्रुत्वा having heard, आस्यम् mouth, विदार्य widely opening, तौ them, भक्षयितुम् to eat, आरभत् made an effort.
explanation: The cruel, ferocious demon heard them talk. He opened his mouth and attempted to eat both of them.

shloka_text: ततस्तौ देशकालज्ञौ खड्गाभ्यामेव राघवौ। अच्छिन्दतां सुसंविग्नौ बाहू तस्यांसदेशतः।।3.70.8।।
transliteration: tatastau deśakālajñau khaḍgābhyāmeva rāghavau| acchindatāṃ susaṃvignau bāhū tasyāṃsadeśataḥ
translation: ततः then, सुसंविग्नौ became agitated, देशकालज्ञौ knowers of time and space, तौ those two, राघवौ Raghavas, खड्गाभ्याम् with their swords, तस्य his, बाहू two arms, अंसदेशतः from  the shoulders, अच्छिन्दताम् cut off.
explanation: Then the agitated brothers, aware of time and space, quickly pulled out their swords and cut off both his arms from the shoulders.

shloka_text: दक्षिणो दक्षिणं बाहुमसक्तमसिना ततः। चिच्छेद रामो वेगेन सव्यं वीरस्तु लक्ष्मणः।।3.70.9।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇo dakṣiṇaṃ bāhumasaktamasinā tataḥ| ciccheda rāmo vegena savyaṃ vīrastu lakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: ततः then, दक्षिणः  standing on the right, रामः Rama, असक्तम् severed, वेगेन quickly, दक्षिणं बाहुम् right arm, असिना with a sword, चिच्छेद cut off, वीरः hero, लक्ष्मणस्तु Lakshmana, सव्यम् left arm.
explanation: While standing on the right, Rama cut off his right arm and the brave Lakshmana cut off the left.

shloka_text: स पपात महाबाहुश्छिन्नबाहुर्महास्वनः। खं च गां च दिशश्चैव नादयञ्जलदो यथा।।3.70.10।।
transliteration: sa papāta mahābāhuśchinnabāhurmahāsvanaḥ| khaṃ ca gāṃ ca diśaścaiva nādayañjalado yathā
translation: महाबाहुः with strong arms, सः that, छिन्नबाहुः with his arms severed, महास्वनः roaring, जलदः यथा like a stormy cloud, खं च sky, गां च earth, दिशश्चैव quarters, नादयन् while resounding, पपात he fell down.
explanation: The strongarmed demon, his arms severed, rumbling like a raincloud filling the sky, the earth and the quarters, fell down.

shloka_text: स निकृत्तौ भुजौ दृष्ट्वा शोणितौघपरिप्लुतः। दीनः पप्रच्छ तौ वीरौ कौ युवामिति दानवः।।3.70.11।।
transliteration: sa nikṛttau bhujau dṛṣṭvā śoṇitaughapariplutaḥ| dīnaḥ papraccha tau vīrau kau yuvāmiti dānavaḥ
translation: सः that, दानवः demon, निकृत्तौ with amputated, भूजौ arms, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, शोणितौघपरिप्लुतः drenched in the flood of blood, दीनः a pathetic one, युवाम् you both, कौ who are you, इति thus, तौ वीरौ those two heroes, पप्रच्छ asked.
explanation: The demon with his arms amputated, drenched in a pool of blood  looked pathetic and asked them, Who are you?

shloka_text: इति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य लक्ष्मणश्शुभलक्षणः। शशंस राघवं तस्य कबन्धस्य महात्मनः।।3.70.12।।
transliteration: iti tasya bruvāṇasya lakṣmaṇaśśubhalakṣaṇaḥ| śaśaṃsa rāghavaṃ tasya kabandhasya mahātmanaḥ
translation: तस्य his, इति thus, ब्रुवाणस्य when he was speaking, शुभलक्षणः a man of auspicious traits, सः लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, महात्मनः of the great self, कबन्धस्य of Kabandha, राघवम् Raghava, शशंस revealed.
explanation: Imbued with auspicious signs, Lakshmana revealed the identity of Rama to great Kabandha.

shloka_text: अयमिक्ष्वाकुदायादो रामो नाम जनैश्श्रुतः। अस्यैवावरजं विद्दि भ्रातरं मां च लक्ष्मणम्।।3.70.13।।
transliteration: ayamikṣvākudāyādo rāmo nāma janaiśśrutaḥ| asyaivāvarajaṃ viddi bhrātaraṃ māṃ ca lakṣmaṇam
translation: अयम् he, रामो नाम by name Rama, जनैः by people, श्रुतः famous, इक्ष्वाकुदायादः an heir of the Ikshvaku family, माम् me, अस्य his, अवरजं भ्रातरम् as his younger brother, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, विद्दि you may know me,
explanation: Here is Rama, an heir of the Ikshvaku family, known to the people and I am his younger brother Lakshmana for your information.

shloka_text: अस्य देवप्रभावस्य वसतो विजने वने। रक्षसाऽपहृता पत्नी यामिच्छन्ताविहागतौ।।3.70.14।।
transliteration: asya devaprabhāvasya vasato vijane vane| rakṣasā'pahṛtā patnī yāmicchantāvihāgatau
translation: विजने desolate, वने in the forest, वसतः living, देवप्रभावस्य as powerful as a god, अस्य his, पत्नी wife, रक्षसा by a demon, अपहृता is carried off, याम् whom, इच्छन्तौ both wishing, इह here, आगतौ came.
explanation: He is equal to a god in prowess. While living in this desolate forest his wife has been carried off by a demon. We both came here searching for her.

shloka_text: त्वं तु को वा किमर्थं वा कबन्धसदृशो वने। आस्येनोरसि दीप्तेन भग्नजङ्घो विचेष्टसे।।3.70.15।।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu ko vā kimarthaṃ vā kabandhasadṛśo vane| āsyenorasi dīptena bhagnajaṅgho viceṣṭase
translation: त्वं तु you, कः वा who are you, कबन्धसदृशः appearing like a trunk, उरसि in the chest, दीप्तेन by a glittering, आस्येन with a mouth, भग्नजङ्घः with calf muscles broken, वने in the forest, किमर्थं वा for what purpose, विचेष्टसे you are rolling down?
explanation: Who are you with only the trunk of the body, and a glittering mouth in the chest with your calf muscles broken rolling down in the forest?

shloka_text: एवमुक्तः कबन्धस्तु लक्ष्मणेनोत्तरं वचः। उवाच परमप्रीत स्तदिन्द्रवचनं स्मरन्।।3.70.16।।
transliteration: evamuktaḥ kabandhastu lakṣmaṇenottaraṃ vacaḥ| uvāca paramaprīta stadindravacanaṃ smaran
translation: लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been told, कबन्धस्तु the Kabandha, तत् that, इन्द्रवचनम् Indra's words, स्मरन् remembering, परमप्रीतः very pleased, उत्तरम् reply, वचः words, उवाच said.
explanation: While hearing Lakshmana, Kabandha, reminded of Indra's words, replied to him in great joy :

shloka_text: स्वागतं वां नरव्याघ्रौ दिष्ट्या पश्यामि चाप्यहम्। दिष्ट्या चेमौ निकृत्तौ मे युवाभ्यां बाहुबन्धनौ।।3.70.17।।
transliteration: svāgataṃ vāṃ naravyāghrau diṣṭyā paśyāmi cāpyaham| diṣṭyā cemau nikṛttau me yuvābhyāṃ bāhubandhanau
translation: नरव्याघ्रौ two tigers among men, वाम् to you, स्वागतम् welcome, अहम् I, दिष्ट्या luckily, पश्यामि I see, दिष्ट्या by my luck, युवाभ्याम् by both of you, मे my, इमौ these, बाहुबन्धनौ that arms which bound you, निकृत्तौ are cut off.
explanation: O tigers among men you are welcome. It is my good luck that I am able to see you. It is my good luck also that the arms that bound you have been amputated.

shloka_text: विरूपं यच्च मे रूपं प्राप्तं ह्यविनयाद्यथा। तन्मे शृणु नरव्याघ्र तत्त्वतश्शंसतस्तव।।3.70.18।।
transliteration: virūpaṃ yacca me rūpaṃ prāptaṃ hyavinayādyathā| tanme śṛṇu naravyāghra tattvataśśaṃsatastava
translation: नरव्याघ्र O best among men (Rama), मे my, विरूपम् deformity, यत् such, रूपम् form, यथा as, अविनयात् due to haughtiness, प्राप्तम् is obtained, तव to your, तत्त्वतः exactly, शंसतः as I narrate, मे from me, शृणु you may listen.
explanation: O best among men hear how I have been deformed due to my haughtiness. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventieth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: पुरा राम महाबाहो महाबलपराक्रम। रूपमासीन्ममा चिन्त्यं त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्।।3.71.1।। यथा सोमस्य शक्रस्य सूर्यस्य च यथा वपुः।
transliteration: purā rāma mahābāho mahābalaparākrama| rūpamāsīnmamā cintyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam yathā somasya śakrasya sūryasya ca yathā vapuḥ|
translation: महाबाहो longarmed, महाबलपराक्रम strong and powerful, राम O Rama, पुरा in the past, सोमस्य the Moon's, शक्रस्य Indra's, यथा as, सूर्यस्य च the Sun's, वपुः body, यथा like that, मम my,रूपम् form, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, त्रिषु लोकेषु in the three worlds, विश्रुतम् renowned, आसीत् it was.
explanation: O longarmed, mighty and powerful Rama in the past I was handsome like the Moon or Indra or the Sun inconceivable to all the three worlds.
comments: Kabandha narrates his story-- promises to help Rama in finding Sita-- attains his true form after his cremation.

shloka_text: सोऽहं रूपमिदं कृत्वा लोकवित्रासनं महत्।।3.71.2।। ऋषीन्वनगतान्राम त्रासयामि ततस्ततः।
transliteration: so'haṃ rūpamidaṃ kṛtvā lokavitrāsanaṃ mahat ṛṣīnvanagatānrāma trāsayāmi tatastataḥ|
translation: राम Rama, सः that, अहम् I, लोकवित्रासनम् a great terror in the world, महत् great, इदं रूपम् this form, कृत्वा after creating, ततस्ततः eventually, वनगतान् those men in the forests, ऋषीन् seers, त्रासयामि used to terrorise.
explanation: With my appearance, I was a great nuisance to the world and used to terrorise the sages living in the forest.

shloka_text: ततस्स्थूलशिरा नाम महर्षिः कोपितो मया।।3.71.3।। सञ्चिन्वन्विविधं वन्यं रूपेणानेन धर्षितः।
transliteration: tatassthūlaśirā nāma maharṣiḥ kopito mayā sañcinvanvividhaṃ vanyaṃ rūpeṇānena dharṣitaḥ|
translation: ततः then, विविधम् different, वन्यम् forest material, सञ्चिन्वन् while collecting, स्थूलशिराः नाम by name Sthulasira, महर्षिः seer, अनेन by this, रूपेण form, धर्षितः was assaulted, मया by me, कोपितः was enraged.
explanation: With my appearance I invited the wrath of Sthulasira who I assaulted among the many seers, while he was collecting food in the forest.

shloka_text: तेनाहमुक्तः प्रेक्ष्यैवं घोरशापाभिधायिना।।3.71.4।। एतदेव नृशंसं ते रूपमस्तु विगर्हितम्।
transliteration: tenāhamuktaḥ prekṣyaivaṃ ghoraśāpābhidhāyinā etadeva nṛśaṃsaṃ te rūpamastu vigarhitam|
translation: प्रेक्ष्य seeing me, घोरशापाभिधायिना  pronounced a dreadful curse, तेन by him, अहम् I, एवम् in that way, उक्तः said, ते you, नृशंसम् mean, विगर्हितम् dispising, एतत् this, रूपमेव form only, अस्तु it may be.
explanation: Seeing me he pronounced a dreadful curse on me saying, 'You will get a cruel, despicable form.'

shloka_text: स मया याचितः क्रुद्धश्शापस्योन्तो भवेदिति।।3.71.5।। अभिशापकृतस्येति तेनेदं भाषितं वचः।
transliteration: sa mayā yācitaḥ kruddhaśśāpasyonto bhavediti abhiśāpakṛtasyeti tenedaṃ bhāṣitaṃ vacaḥ|
translation: क्रुद्धः angry, सः he, अभिशापकृतस्य pronounced on, शापस्य curse's, अन्तः end of it, भवेत् may be, इति thus, मया by me, प्रार्थितः begged, तेन by him, इदम् this, वचः words, भाषितम् spoke.
explanation: When I sought to know how the curse angrily pronounced on me would come to an end, he said:

shloka_text: यदा छित्त्वा भुजौ रामस्त्वां दहेद्विजने वने।।3.71.6।। तदा त्वं प्राप्स्यसे रूपं स्वमेव विपुलं शुभम्।
transliteration: yadā chittvā bhujau rāmastvāṃ dahedvijane vane tadā tvaṃ prāpsyase rūpaṃ svameva vipulaṃ śubham|
translation: रामः Rama, भुजौ two arms, छित्त्वा cutting, त्वाम् you, यदा when, विजने in a desolate, वने in forest, दहेत् cremate, तदा then, स्वमेव your own, विपुलम् शुभम् greatly auspicious, रूपम् form, प्राप्स्यसे you will obtain.
explanation: 'When Rama gets your arms in a desolate forest amputated and your body cremated, you would get back your gloriously auspicious form.'

shloka_text: श्रिया विराजितं पुत्रं दनोस्त्वं विद्धि लक्ष्मण।।3.71.7।। इन्द्रकोपादिदं रूपं प्राप्तमेवं रणाजिरे।
transliteration: śriyā virājitaṃ putraṃ danostvaṃ viddhi lakṣmaṇa indrakopādidaṃ rūpaṃ prāptamevaṃ raṇājire|
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, दनोः Danu's family, श्रिया by prosperity, विराजितम् shining, पुत्रम् son, त्वम् you, विद्धि know, इन्द्रकोपात् by the wrath of Indra, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, एवम् this, इदं रूपम् this form, प्राप्तम् is obtained.
explanation: O Lakshmana know that I was the prosperous son of demon Danu. By the wrath of Indra in the battlefeild I obtained this form.

shloka_text: अहं हि तपसोग्रेण पितामहमतोषयम्।।3.71.8।। दीर्घमायुस्स मे प्रादात्ततो मां विभ्रमोऽस्पृशत्।
transliteration: ahaṃ hi tapasogreṇa pitāmahamatoṣayam dīrghamāyussa me prādāttato māṃ vibhramo'spṛśat|
translation: अहम् I, उग्रेण by intense, तपसा by penance, पितामहम् the creator Brahma, आतोषयम् I made him happy, सः he, मे my, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, प्रादात् graced, ततः then, माम् me, विभ्रमः confusion, अस्पृशत्  overtook me.
explanation: I pleased the creator Brahma with great penance. He blessed me with long life. Then this pride and confusion overtook me.

shloka_text: दीर्घमायुर्मया प्राप्तं किं मे शक्रः करिष्यति।।3.71.9।। इत्येवं बुद्धिमास्थाय रणे शक्रमधर्षयम्।
transliteration: dīrghamāyurmayā prāptaṃ kiṃ me śakraḥ kariṣyati ityevaṃ buddhimāsthāya raṇe śakramadharṣayam|
translation: मया by me, दीर्घम् long, आयुः life, प्राप्तम् has been attained, शक्रः Indra, मे to me, किं करिष्यति  what can he do, इत्येवम् in that manner, बुद्धिम् in mind, आस्थाय considering, रणे in battle, शक्रम् Indra, अधर्षयम् I attacked .
explanation: Having been blessed with long life and thinking, what can Indra do to me?, I attacked him.

shloka_text: तस्य बाहुप्रयुक्तेन वज्रेण शतपर्वणा।।3.71.10।। सक्थिनी चैव मूर्धा च शरीरे सम्प्रवेशितम्।
transliteration: tasya bāhuprayuktena vajreṇa śataparvaṇā sakthinī caiva mūrdhā ca śarīre sampraveśitam|
translation: तस्य his, बाहुप्रयुक्तेन deployed  from his arm, शतपर्वणा by a weapon of hundred nodes, वज्रेण with the thunderbolt, सक्थिनी चैव both my lower limbs, मूर्धा च head also, शरीरे into the body, सम्प्रवेशितम् entered.
explanation: The thunderbolt having a hundred nodes deployed by Indra pierced my thighs and my head.

shloka_text: स मया याच्यमानस्सन्नानयद्यमसादनम्।।3.71.11।। पितामहवचस्सत्यं तदस्त्विति ममाब्रवीत्।
transliteration: sa mayā yācyamānassannānayadyamasādanam pitāmahavacassatyaṃ tadastviti mamābravīt|
translation: सः he, मया by me, याच्यमानः सन् being begged of him, यमसादनम् to the abode of Yama, न आनयत् did not take me, तत् that, पितामहवचः word of the creator, सत्यम् true, अस्तु इति should become true, मम to me, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Entreated, he did not send me to the abode of Yama ( lord of death) and said, 'Let the words of the creator be true' .

shloka_text: अनाहारः कथं शक्तो भग्नसक्थिशिरोमुखः।।3.71.12।। वज्रेणाभिहतः कालं सुदीर्घमपि जीवितुम्।
transliteration: anāhāraḥ kathaṃ śakto bhagnasakthiśiromukhaḥ vajreṇābhihataḥ kālaṃ sudīrghamapi jīvitum|
translation: वज्रेण by the thunderbolt, अभिहतः struck by, भग्नसक्थिशिरोमुखः with thigh bones, head and face broken, अनाहारः starving, सुदीर्घं कालम् for a long time, जीवितुमपि to live, कथम् somehow, शक्तः was possible.
explanation: Hit by the thunderbolt, my thighbones, head and face were broken. Somehow I could manage to live for a long time without food.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु मे शक्रो बाहू योजनमायतौ।।3.71.13।। प्रादादास्यं च मे कुक्षौ तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रमकल्पयत्।
transliteration: evamuktastu me śakro bāhū yojanamāyatau prādādāsyaṃ ca me kukṣau tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭramakalpayat|
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been entreated, शक्रः Indra, मे to me, योजनम् one yojana, आयतौ long, बाहू two arms, प्रादात् he gave, मे to me, कुक्षौ in the stomach, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रम् with sharp teeth, आस्यं च mouth also, अकल्पयत् created.
explanation: Having been entreated, Indra created in me two long arms extending upto a yojana and set my mouth with sharp teeth in the stomach.

shloka_text: सोऽहं भुजाभ्यां दीर्घाभ्यां संकृष्यास्मिन्वने चरान्।।3.71.14।। सिंहव्दिपमृगव्याघ्रान् भक्षयामि समन्ततः।
transliteration: so'haṃ bhujābhyāṃ dīrghābhyāṃ saṃkṛṣyāsminvane carān siṃhavdipamṛgavyāghrān bhakṣayāmi samantataḥ|
translation: सः अहम् with that I, अस्मिन् in this, वने in the forest, दीर्घाभ्याम् with long, भुजाभ्याम् with arms, अस्मिन् in this, वने in the forest, समन्ततः all over, चरान् moving creatures, सिंहव्दिपमृगव्याघ्रान् lions, tigers, elephants and deer, संकृष्य after pulling, भक्षयामि I eat.
explanation: Stretching the long arms in the forest, I dragged creatures like lions, tigers, elephants and deer moving in the forest and ate them.

shloka_text: स तु मामब्रवीदिन्द्रो यदा रामस्सलक्ष्मणः।।3.71.15।। छेत्स्यते समरे बाहू तदा स्वर्गं गमिष्यसि।
transliteration: sa tu māmabravīdindro yadā rāmassalakṣmaṇaḥ chetsyate samare bāhū tadā svargaṃ gamiṣyasi|
translation: सः that, इन्द्रः तु Indra too, माम् to me, अब्रवीत् said, यदा when, सलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, रामः Rama, समरे in the fight, बाहू छेत्स्यते cuts off the arms, तदा then, स्वर्गम् heaven, गमिष्यसि you will go.
explanation: Indra too had said, 'When Rama along with Lakshmana cuts off your arms in a fight,  you would reach heaven.'

shloka_text: अनेन वपुषा राम वनेऽस्मिन्राजसत्तम।।3.71.16।। यद्यत्पश्यामि सर्वस्य ग्रहणं साधु रोचये।
transliteration: anena vapuṣā rāma vane'sminrājasattama yadyatpaśyāmi sarvasya grahaṇaṃ sādhu rocaye|
translation: राजसत्तम best of kings, राम Rama, अस्मिन् वने in this forest, अनेन वपुषा with this body, यद्यत् whatever, पश्यामि I see, सर्वस्य of all, ग्रहणम् catch, साधु proper, रोचये I like.
explanation: O Rama, the best of kings I thought it was only proper in this forest and with this body to catch whatever creature I saw.

shloka_text: अवश्यं ग्रहणं रामो मन्येऽहं समुपैष्यति।।3.71.17।। इमां बुद्धिं पुरस्कृत्य देहन्यासकृतश्रमः।
transliteration: avaśyaṃ grahaṇaṃ rāmo manye'haṃ samupaiṣyati imāṃ buddhiṃ puraskṛtya dehanyāsakṛtaśramaḥ|
translation: रामः Rama, अवश्यम् certainly, ग्रहणम् into the hold, समुपैष्यति will come, अहम् I, मन्ये  thinking, इमाम् this, बुद्धिम् thought, पुरस्कृत्य depending on, देहन्यासकृतश्रमः I am struggling to preserve my body.
explanation: O Rama, I was struggling to preserve my body all the time thinking that some day you would certainly come into my arms.

shloka_text: स त्वं रामोऽसि भद्रं ते नाहमन्येन राघव।।3.71.18।। शक्यो हन्तुं यथातत्त्वमेवमुक्तं महर्षिणा।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ rāmo'si bhadraṃ te nāhamanyena rāghava śakyo hantuṃ yathātattvamevamuktaṃ maharṣiṇā|
translation: राघव Rama, त्वम् you, सः रामः that Rama, असि you are, ते भद्रम् be blessed, महर्षिणा by the seer, तत्त्वम् truly, एवम् in that way, यथा as, उक्तम् stated, अहम् I, अन्येन by others, हन्तुम् be attacked, शक्यः possible, न not.
explanation: You are that Rama. Be blessed. As stated by the seer I cannot be really killed by any one except you.

shloka_text: अहं हि मतिसाचिव्यं करिष्यामि नरर्षभ।।3.71.19।। मित्रं चैवोपदेक्ष्यामि युवाभ्यां संस्कृतोऽग्निना।
transliteration: ahaṃ hi matisācivyaṃ kariṣyāmi nararṣabha mitraṃ caivopadekṣyāmi yuvābhyāṃ saṃskṛto'gninā|
translation: नरर्षभ O best of men, अहम् I, अग्निना by fire, संस्कृतः purified man, युवाभ्याम् by you both, मतिसाचिव्यम् help you with my wisdom, करिष्यामि I will do, मित्रं चैव as a friend also, उपदेक्ष्यामि I will advise you.
explanation: O best among men I will help you with my wisdom and give you friendly advice when I am purified by you both through cremation on the funeral pyre.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु धर्मात्मा दनुना तेन राघवः।।3.71.20।। इदं जगाद वचनं लक्ष्मणस्योपशृण्वतः।
transliteration: evamuktastu dharmātmā danunā tena rāghavaḥ idaṃ jagāda vacanaṃ lakṣmaṇasyopaśṛṇvataḥ|
translation: तेन by him, दनुना by Danu, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been told, धर्मात्मा righteous, राघवः Rama, लक्ष्मणस्य to Lakshmana, उपशृण्वतः listening, इदम् these, वचनम् words, जगाद spoke.
explanation: Rigteous Rama spoke the following words in response to the story of Danu within Lakshmana's earshot:

shloka_text: रावणेन हृता भार्या मम सीता यशस्स्विनी।।3.71.21।। निष्क्रान्तस्य जनस्थानात्सहभ्रात्रा यथासुखम्।
transliteration: rāvaṇena hṛtā bhāryā mama sītā yaśassvinī niṣkrāntasya janasthānātsahabhrātrā yathāsukham|
translation: जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, सह भ्रात्रा along with my brother, निष्क्रान्तस्य when I had gone out, मम my, भार्या wife, यशस्स्विनी famed lady, सीता Sita, रावणेन by Ravana, यथासुखम्  happily, हृता carried off.
explanation: My illlustrious wife Sita was carried away by Ravana comfortably when I was away from Janasthana along with my brother.

shloka_text: नाममात्रं तु जानामि न रूपं तस्य रक्षसः।।3.71.22।। निवासं वा प्रभावं वा वयं तस्य न विद्महे।
transliteration: nāmamātraṃ tu jānāmi na rūpaṃ tasya rakṣasaḥ nivāsaṃ vā prabhāvaṃ vā vayaṃ tasya na vidmahe|
translation: तस्य his, नाममात्रम् only the name, जानामि I know, रूपम् form, न do not know, तस्य his, निवासं वा residence not known, प्रभावं वा or his power, वयम् we, न विद्महे we do not know.
explanation: I only know his name. We do not know how he looks, where he lives and what influence he has.

shloka_text: शोकार्तानामनाथानामेवं विपरिधावताम्।।3.71.23।। कारुण्यं सदृशं कर्तुमुपकारे च वर्तताम्।
transliteration: śokārtānāmanāthānāmevaṃ viparidhāvatām kāruṇyaṃ sadṛśaṃ kartumupakāre ca vartatām|
translation: शोकार्तानाम् striken by sorrow, अनाथानाम् of orphans, एवम् that way, विपरिधावताम् of those running all over, उपकारे help, वर्ततां च do to others, कारुण्यम् kindness, कर्तुम् do show, सदृशम् worthy of your compasssion.
explanation: Creatures like you may help those who, like orphans, run here and there, stricken with sorrow.

shloka_text: काष्ठान्यादाय शुष्काणि काले भग्नानि कुञ्जरैः।।3.71.24।। धक्ष्यामस्त्वां वयं वीर श्वभ्रे महति कल्पिते।
transliteration: kāṣṭhānyādāya śuṣkāṇi kāle bhagnāni kuñjaraiḥ dhakṣyāmastvāṃ vayaṃ vīra śvabhre mahati kalpite|
translation: वीर hero, काले in the proper season, कुञ्जरैः by elephants, भग्नानि broken, शुष्काणि dried, काष्ठानि logs of wood, आदाय after getting, कल्पिते in a place set, महति in a large one, श्वभ्रे in a pit, त्वाम् you, धक्ष्यामः we will cremate you.
explanation: O hero we will cremate you in a huge pit to be prepared for this occasion, collecting dry logs of wood broken by elephants.

shloka_text: स त्वं सीतां समाचक्ष्व येन वा यत्र वा हृता।।3.71.25।। कुरु कल्याणमत्यर्थं यदि जानासि तत्त्वतः।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ sītāṃ samācakṣva yena vā yatra vā hṛtā kuru kalyāṇamatyarthaṃ yadi jānāsi tattvataḥ|
translation: सः he, त्वम् you, तत्त्वतः truly, जानासि यदि if you know, सीताम् about Sita, येन वा by whom, यत्र वा of wherever, हृता carried, समाचक्ष्व tell me, अत्यर्थम् very much, कल्याणम् wellbeing, कुरु you may do.
explanation: If you really know where SIta has been kidnapped and by whom, tell me. You will be doing a great service.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वाक्यं दनुरनुत्तमम्।।3.71.26।। प्रोवाच कुशलो वक्तुं वक्तारमपि राघवम्।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa vākyaṃ danuranuttamam provāca kuśalo vaktuṃ vaktāramapi rāghavam|
translation: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः  having been asked, वक्तुम् telling, कुशलः one who can speak well, दनुः Danu, वक्तारम् addressing one who can speak, राघवम् to Rama, अनुत्तमम् best, वाक्यम् word, प्रोवाच spoke.
explanation: Danu who was proficient in speech spoke with chosen words to Rama who was a great speaker himself:

shloka_text: दिव्यमस्ति न मे ज्ञानं नाभिजानामि मैथिलीम्।।3.71.27।। यस्तां ज्ञास्यति तं वक्ष्ये दग्धस्स्वं रूपमास्थितः।
transliteration: divyamasti na me jñānaṃ nābhijānāmi maithilīm yastāṃ jñāsyati taṃ vakṣye dagdhassvaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ|
translation: मे to me, दिव्यम् divine, ज्ञानम् wisdom, नास्ति I do not have, मैथिलीम् Maithili, नाभिजानामि I do not know, दग्धः burnt one, स्वं रूम् my original form, आस्थितः getting, ताम् her, यः whoever, ज्ञास्यति know of her, तम् him, वक्ष्ये I will reveal.
explanation: I do not have divine wisdom (now). Nor do I know Sita. When you cremate me, I shall assume my original form and will tell you the name of the person who knows it.

shloka_text: अदग्धस्य तु विज्ञातुं शक्तिरस्ति न मे प्रभो।।3.71.28।। राक्षसं तं महावीर्यं सीता येन हृता तव।
transliteration: adagdhasya tu vijñātuṃ śaktirasti na me prabho rākṣasaṃ taṃ mahāvīryaṃ sītā yena hṛtā tava|
translation: प्रभो O lord, येन by whom, तव your, सीता Sita, हृता is taken away, तम् him, महावीर्यम् very powerful, राक्षसम् rakshasa, विज्ञातुम् to know, अदग्धस्य without being burnt, मे to me, शक्तिः ability, नास्ति is not there.
explanation: O lord before I am cremated, I do not have the ability to know  about that powerful demon by whom Sita has been abducted.

shloka_text: विज्ञानं हि मम भ्रष्टं शापदोषेण राघव।।3.71.29।। स्वकृतेन मया प्राप्तं रूपं लोकविगर्हितम्।
transliteration: vijñānaṃ hi mama bhraṣṭaṃ śāpadoṣeṇa rāghava svakṛtena mayā prāptaṃ rūpaṃ lokavigarhitam|
translation: राघव Rama, शापदोषेण due to the curse, मम my, विज्ञानम् wisdom, भ्रष्टं हि is indeed lost, मया by me, स्वकृतेन by my own deed, लोकविगर्हितम् a form despised by the world, रूपम् this form, प्राप्तम् is attained.
explanation: O Rama due to the curse I have lost my wisdom. By my own deed, I have attained this form despicable to the world.

shloka_text: किं तु यावन्न यात्यस्तं सविता श्रान्तवाहनः।।3.71.30।। तावन्मामवटे क्षिप्त्वा दह राम यथाविधि।
transliteration: kiṃ tu yāvanna yātyastaṃ savitā śrāntavāhanaḥ tāvanmāmavaṭe kṣiptvā daha rāma yathāvidhi|
translation: राम Rama, किं तु but, सविता Sun, श्रान्तवाहनः with his vehicle (horses) tired, अस्तम् (याति) setting, यावत् before, तावत् by then, माम् me, अवटे in a pit, क्षिप्त्वा dropping, यथाविधि in accordance with tradition, दह you may cremate.
explanation: Before the Sun  disappears with his tired horses drop me into a pit and cremate me in accordance with tradition, O Rama

shloka_text: दग्धस्त्वयाहमवटे न्यायेन रघुनन्धन।।3.71.31।। वक्ष्यामि तमहं वीर यस्तं ज्ञास्यति राक्षसम्।
transliteration: dagdhastvayāhamavaṭe nyāyena raghunandhana vakṣyāmi tamahaṃ vīra yastaṃ jñāsyati rākṣasam|
translation: वीर O hero, रघुनन्धन O delight of the Raghus, अहम् I, त्वया by you, न्यायेन as per custom, अवटे in a pit, दग्धः cremated, यः whoever, तं राक्षसम् to that demon, ज्ञास्यति knows, तम् about him, वक्ष्यामि I will let you know.
explanation: O heroic Rama, delight of the Raghus, if you drop me in a pit and cremate me as per custom, I will tell you about him who knows the demon.

shloka_text: तेन सख्यं च कर्तव्यं न्याय्यवृत्तेन राघव।।3.71.32।। कल्पयिष्यति ते प्रीतस्साहाय्यं लघुविक्रमः।
transliteration: tena sakhyaṃ ca kartavyaṃ nyāyyavṛttena rāghava kalpayiṣyati te prītassāhāyyaṃ laghuvikramaḥ|
translation: राघव Rama, न्याय्यवृत्तेन rightfully conducting, तेन with him, सख्यं च friendship, कर्तव्यम् you should establish, लघुविक्रमः a warrior of swift action, प्रीतः a pleased one, ते to you, साहाय्यम् help, कल्पयिष्यति he will do.
explanation: O Rama you should establish friendship with him in a just manner. That hero of swift action will help you when he is pleased.

shloka_text: न हि तस्यास्त्यविज्ञातं त्रिषु लेकेषु राघव।।3.71.33।। सर्वान्परिसृतो लोकान्पुरासौ कारणान्तरे।
transliteration: na hi tasyāstyavijñātaṃ triṣu lekeṣu rāghava sarvānparisṛto lokānpurāsau kāraṇāntare|
translation: राघव Rama, त्रिषु in the three, लोकेषु worlds, तस्य for him, अविज्ञातम् unknown to him, नास्ति is not there, हि do, असौ he, पुरा in the past, कारणान्तरे for a different cause, सर्वान् all, लोकान् worlds, परिसृतः has roamed about.
explanation: O Rama, there is nothing that he does not know in the three worlds. In the past for a different reason he roamed all the (three) worlds. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे एकसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfirst sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तौतु तौ वीरौ कबन्धेन नरेश्वरौ। गिरिप्रदरमासाद्य पावकं विससर्जतुः।।3.72.1।।
transliteration: evamuktautu tau vīrau kabandhena nareśvarau| giripradaramāsādya pāvakaṃ visasarjatuḥ
translation: कबन्धेन by Kabandha, एवम् in that manner, उक्तौ having been advised, नरेश्वरौ two kings, तौ वीरौ the two heroes, गिरिप्रदरम्  mountain cave, आसाद्य reached, पावकम् fire, विससर्जतुः lighted.
explanation: Thus said by Kabandha, the two lords of men, the heroes reached a cave in the mountain and lighted the fire.
comments: Cremation of Kabandha-- his reappearance in the sky-- tells Rama to make friendship with Sugriva.

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणस्तु महोल्काभिर्ज्वलिताभिस्समन्ततः। चितामादीपयामास सा प्रजज्वाल सर्वतः।।3.72.2।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇastu maholkābhirjvalitābhissamantataḥ| citāmādīpayāmāsa sā prajajvāla sarvataḥ
translation: लक्ष्मणस्तु Lakshmana himself, ज्वलिताभिः with burning, महोल्काभिः with big meteorlike logs, समन्ततः all round, चिताम् pyre, आदीपयामास set fire, सर्वतः on all sides, प्रजज्वाल lighted.
explanation: Lakshmana lit the pyre with big meteorlike logs on all sides and it burned.

shloka_text: तच्छरीरं कबन्धस्य घृतपिण्डोपमं महत्। मेदसा पच्यमानस्य मन्दं दहति पावकः।।3.72.3।।
transliteration: taccharīraṃ kabandhasya ghṛtapiṇḍopamaṃ mahat| medasā pacyamānasya mandaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ
translation: मेदसा with flesh, पच्यमानस्य as the corpse was burning, कबन्धस्य Kabandha's, महत् great, घृतपिण्डोपमम् like a huge ball of ghee, तत् that, शरीरम्  body, पावकः the fire, मन्दम् slowly, दहति burnt.
explanation: As the flesh of Kabandha's body decomposed, if burnt slowly in the fire although it was like a huge mass of fat.

shloka_text: स विधूय चितामाशु विधूमोऽग्निरिवोत्थितः। अरजे वाससी बिभ्रन्मालां दिव्यां महाबलः।।3.72.4।।
transliteration: sa vidhūya citāmāśu vidhūmo'gnirivotthitaḥ| araje vāsasī bibhranmālāṃ divyāṃ mahābalaḥ
translation: महाबलः very strong , सः he, अरजे clean, वाससी pair of clothes, दिव्याम् divine, मालाम् garland, बिभ्रत् wearing, चिताम् from the pyre, विधूय  shaking, आशु immediately, विधूमः smokeless, अग्निरिव like fire, उत्थितः he rose up.
explanation: Mighty Kabandha shook himself off the funeral pyre and rose like smokeless fire, wearing a pair of clean clothes and a divine garland.

shloka_text: ततश्चिताया वेगेन भास्वरो विमलाम्बरः। उत्पपाताशु संहृष्टस्सर्वप्रत्यङ्गभूषणः।।3.72.5।।
transliteration: tataścitāyā vegena bhāsvaro vimalāmbaraḥ| utpapātāśu saṃhṛṣṭassarvapratyaṅgabhūṣaṇaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, भास्वरः shining brightly, विमलाम्बरः wearing clean clothes, संहृष्टः happily, सर्वप्रत्यङ्गभूषणः limbs adorned with ornaments, आशु instantaneously, वेगेन speedily, चितायाः from the pyre, उत्पपात came out.
explanation: Thereafter shining brightly in pure clothes and wearing ornaments all over the body, Kabandha hurtled out happily and instantaneously from the pyre.

shloka_text: विमाने भास्वरे तिष्ठन्हंसयुक्ते यशस्करे। प्रभया च महातेजा दिशो दश विराजयन्।।3.72.6।। सोऽन्तरिक्षगतो रामं कबन्धो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। शृणु राघव तत्त्वेन यथा सीतामवाप्स्यसि।।3.72.7।।
transliteration: vimāne bhāsvare tiṣṭhanhaṃsayukte yaśaskare| prabhayā ca mahātejā diśo daśa virājayan so'ntarikṣagato rāmaṃ kabandho vākyamabravīt| śṛṇu rāghava tattvena yathā sītāmavāpsyasi
translation: सः कबन्धः he, Kabandha, अन्तरिक्षगतः reached the sky, हंसयुक्ते harnessed by swans, यशस्करे famous, भास्वरे shining, विमाने in an aerial chariot, तिष्ठन् seated, महातेजाः a brilliant one, प्रभया with glow, दश दिशः all the ten directions, विराजयन् illumining, रामम् Rama, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, राघव Raghava, सीताम् Sita, यथा as, अवाप्स्यसि you will be getting her, तत्त्वेन truly, शृणु listen.
explanation: The effulgent Kabandha rose into the sky on a famous aerial chariot harnessed to swans. Seated on it, he illuminated all ten directions and spoke from the sky,'O Raghava I will truly tell you how you will get Sita, listen to me'.

shloka_text: विमाने भास्वरे तिष्ठन्हंसयुक्ते यशस्करे। प्रभया च महातेजा दिशो दश विराजयन्।।3.72.6।। सोऽन्तरिक्षगतो रामं कबन्धो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। शृणु राघव तत्त्वेन यथा सीतामवाप्स्यसि।।3.72.7।।
transliteration: vimāne bhāsvare tiṣṭhanhaṃsayukte yaśaskare| prabhayā ca mahātejā diśo daśa virājayan so'ntarikṣagato rāmaṃ kabandho vākyamabravīt| śṛṇu rāghava tattvena yathā sītāmavāpsyasi
translation: सः कबन्धः he, Kabandha, अन्तरिक्षगतः reached the sky, हंसयुक्ते harnessed by swans, यशस्करे famous, भास्वरे shining, विमाने in an aerial chariot, तिष्ठन् seated, महातेजाः a brilliant one, प्रभया with glow, दश दिशः all the ten directions, विराजयन् illumining, रामम् Rama, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, राघव Raghava, सीताम् Sita, यथा as, अवाप्स्यसि you will be getting her, तत्त्वेन truly, शृणु listen.
explanation: The effulgent Kabandha rose into the sky on a famous aerial chariot harnessed to swans. Seated on it, he illuminated all ten directions and spoke from the sky,'O Raghava I will truly tell you how you will get Sita, listen to me'.

shloka_text: राम षड्युक्तयो लोके याभिस्सर्वं विमृश्यते। परिमृष्टो दशान्तेन दशाभागेन सेव्यते।।3.72.8।।
transliteration: rāma ṣaḍyuktayo loke yābhissarvaṃ vimṛśyate| parimṛṣṭo daśāntena daśābhāgena sevyate
translation: राम Rama, याभिः by those, सर्वम् all, विमृश्यते is tested, षट् युक्तयः six expedients, लोके in the world, दशान्तेन when one crosses that period, परिमृष्टः a man's test, दशाभागेन met with bad luck, सेव्यते he will be served.
explanation: O Rama there are six expedients (peace,war,marching,neutrality, alliance, making peace with one and waging war with another, for attaining your goal in the world. Only the unlucky can help the unfortunate.

shloka_text: दशाभागगतो हीनस्त्वं हि राम सलक्ष्मणः। यत्कृते व्यसनं प्राप्तं त्वया दारप्रधर्षणम्।।।3.72.9।।
transliteration: daśābhāgagato hīnastvaṃ hi rāma salakṣmaṇaḥ| yatkṛte vyasanaṃ prāptaṃ tvayā dārapradharṣaṇam|
translation: राम Rama, सलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, त्वम् you, दशाभागगतः going through a part of such bad period, हीनः low ebb, यत्कृते by that , त्वया by you, दारप्रधर्षणम् abduction of wife, व्यसनम् sorrow, प्राप्तम् obtained.
explanation: Along with Lakshmna you are passing through a bad period on account of which your wife has been kidnapped and you, lying low, are experiencing great grief, O Rama

shloka_text: तदवश्यं त्वया कार्यस्ससुहृत्सुहृदां वर। अकृत्वा हि न ते सिद्धिमहं पश्यामि चिन्तयन्।।3.72.10।।
transliteration: tadavaśyaṃ tvayā kāryassasuhṛtsuhṛdāṃ vara| akṛtvā hi na te siddhimahaṃ paśyāmi cintayan
translation: सुहृदाम् of friends, वर best one, तत् so, सः that, त्वया by you, अवश्यम् certainly, सुहृत् friend, कार्यः should be done, अकृत्वा without doing so, ते to you, सिद्धिम् achievement, अहम् I, चिन्तयन् while I think over, न पश्यामि I do not see.
explanation: O Rama, the best of friends  you should certainly make friendship with him. As I think over the matter, I do not see any success if you do not adopt this method.

shloka_text: श्रूयतां राम वक्ष्यामि सुग्रीवो नाम वानरः। भ्रात्रा निरस्तः क्रुद्धेन वालिना शक्रसूनुना।।3.72.11।।
transliteration: śrūyatāṃ rāma vakṣyāmi sugrīvo nāma vānaraḥ| bhrātrā nirastaḥ kruddhena vālinā śakrasūnunā
translation: राम Rama, वक्ष्यामि l tell you, श्रूयताम् listen , शक्रसूनुना by Indra's son, भ्रात्रा by his brother, क्रुद्धेन in a fit of anger, वालिना by Vali, निरस्तः banished from the kingdom, सुग्रीवो नाम named Sugriva, वानरः monkey.
explanation: O Rama, listen. I shall tell you. A monkey named Sugriva has been banished from the kingdom in a fit of anger by his brother Vali, the son of Indra.

shloka_text: ऋश्यमूके गिरिवरे पम्पापर्यन्तशोभिते। निवसत्यात्मवान्वीरश्चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः।।3.72.12।।
transliteration: ṛśyamūke girivare pampāparyantaśobhite| nivasatyātmavānvīraścaturbhissaha vānaraiḥ
translation: आत्मवान् he is a man of great selfrespect, वीरः a hero, पम्पापर्यन्तशोभिते extending up to lake Pampa, ऋश्यमूके on Rishyamuka, गिरिवरे the best of the mountain, चतुर्भिः with four, वानरैः सह along with monkeys, निवसति residing.
explanation: A hero of great selfrespect, he lives with four monkeys on a beautiful mountain Rishyamuka extending up to lake Pampa.

shloka_text: वानरेन्द्रो महावीर्यस्तेजोवानमितप्रभः। सत्यसन्धो विनीतश्च धृतिमान्मतिमान्महान्।।3.72.13।।
transliteration: vānarendro mahāvīryastejovānamitaprabhaḥ| satyasandho vinītaśca dhṛtimānmatimānmahān
translation: वानरेन्द्रः king of monkeys, महावीर्यः endowed with great strength, तेजोवान् full of valour, अमितप्रभः of limitless lustre, सत्यसन्धः truthful, विनीतः humble, धृतिमान् patient, मतिमान् intelligent, महान् great.
explanation: This king of monkeys is energetic with great strength and limitless lustre. He is humble and truthful, valiant, patient and intelligent. He is great.

shloka_text: दक्षः प्रगल्भो द्युतिमान्महाबलपराक्रमः। भ्रात्रा विवासितो राम राज्यहेतोर्महाबलः।।3.72.14।।
transliteration: dakṣaḥ pragalbho dyutimānmahābalaparākramaḥ| bhrātrā vivāsito rāma rājyahetormahābalaḥ
translation: राम Rama, दक्षः efficient, प्रगल्भः eloquent, द्युतिमान् brilliant, महाबलपराक्रमः mighty and brave, महाबलः very strong, राज्यहेतोः for the sake of kingdom, भ्रात्रा by brother, विवासितः is banished.
explanation: He is efficient, eloquent, brilliant. He is mighty and strong. (But) he is banished by his brother from the kingdom, O Rama

shloka_text: स ते सहायो मित्रं च सीतायाः परिमार्गणे। भविष्यति हिते राम मा च शोके मनः कृथाः।।3.72.15।।
transliteration: sa te sahāyo mitraṃ ca sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇe| bhaviṣyati hite rāma mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
translation: राम O Rama, सः he, ते your, मित्रम् friend, सीतायाः Sita's, परिमार्गणे in searching, सहायः  helpful, हिते in the welfare, भविष्यति he will be, शोके in sorrow, मनः your mind, मा कृथाः not indulge.
explanation: O Rama he will help you as a benevolent friend in searching out Sita. Do not indulge in sorrow.

shloka_text: भवितव्यं हि यच्चापि न तच्छक्यमिहान्यथा। कर्तुमिक्ष्वाकुशार्दूल कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः।।3.72.16।।
transliteration: bhavitavyaṃ hi yaccāpi na tacchakyamihānyathā| kartumikṣvākuśārdūla kālo hi duratikramaḥ
translation: इक्ष्वाकुशार्दूल best of the Ikshvaku dynasty, यच्चापि whatever, भवितव्यम् has to happen, तत् that, अन्यथा otherwise, कर्तुम् to do, न शक्यम् is not possible, कालः time, दुरतिक्रमः हि cannot be transgressed.
explanation: O best of the Ikshvaku race whatever is due to happen cannot be otherwise.  It is not possible to transgress time (fate).

shloka_text: गच्छ श्रीघ्रमितो राम सुग्रीवं तं महाबलम्। वयस्यं तं कुरु क्षिप्रमितो गत्वाऽद्य राघव।।3.72.17।। अद्रोहाय समागम्य दीप्यमाने विभावसौ।
transliteration: gaccha śrīghramito rāma sugrīvaṃ taṃ mahābalam| vayasyaṃ taṃ kuru kṣipramito gatvā'dya rāghava adrohāya samāgamya dīpyamāne vibhāvasau|
translation: राम Rama, इतः thus, श्रीघ्रम् swiftly, महाबलम् mighty, तं सुग्रीवम् to that Sugriva, गच्छ reach, राघव Rama, अद्य today, इतः from here, क्षिप्रम् quickly, गत्वा having gone, अद्रोहाय make alliance without any malice, विभावसौ  the fire, दीप्यमाने  is burning, तम् with him, वयस्यम् friend, कुरु you do.
explanation: O Rama, immediately proceed today from here to mighty Sugriva. Having reached him, make him your friend without malice in the presence of burning fire.

shloka_text: स च ते नावमन्तव्यस्सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः।।3.72.18।। कृतज्ञः कामरूपी च सहायार्थी च वीर्यवान्।
transliteration: sa ca te nāvamantavyassugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ kṛtajñaḥ kāmarūpī ca sahāyārthī ca vīryavān|
translation: वानराधिपः (अपि सन्) king of the monkeys, सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, ते by you, नावमन्तव्यः not to be insulted, कृतज्ञः a grateful one, कामरूपी च he can take any form at will, सहायार्थी च he seeks your help, वीर्यवान् strong.
explanation: Thinking that Sugriva is only a vanara king, he should not be disrespected. He has a sense of gratitude. He can take any form at will. He is in need of your help although he is very strong.

shloka_text: शक्तौह्यद्य युवां कर्तुं कार्यं तस्य चिकीर्षितम्।।3.72.19।। कृतार्थो वाऽकृतार्थो वा कृत्यं तव करिष्यति।
transliteration: śaktauhyadya yuvāṃ kartuṃ kāryaṃ tasya cikīrṣitam kṛtārtho vā'kṛtārtho vā kṛtyaṃ tava kariṣyati|
translation: युवाम् you both, अद्य now, तस्य his, चिकीर्षितम् desired, कार्यम् his work, कर्तुम् to do, शक्तौ हि you both have the ability, कृतार्थो वा whether his work is done, अकृतार्थो वा or not done, तव your, कृत्यम् work, करिष्यति he will do.
explanation: You are both young and able to do the work he wants. Whether his work is done or not, he will fulfil your task.

shloka_text: स ऋक्षरजसः पुत्रः पम्पामटति शङ्कितः।।.3.72.20।। भास्करस्यौरसः पुत्रो वालिना कृतकिल्बिषः।
transliteration: sa ṛkṣarajasaḥ putraḥ pampāmaṭati śaṅkitaḥ||.3.72.20|| bhāskarasyaurasaḥ putro vālinā kṛtakilbiṣaḥ|
translation: ऋक्षरजसः Riksharaja's, पुत्रः son, भास्करस्य Sungod's, औरसःपुत्रः lawful son, सः he, वालिना Valin, कृतकिल्बिषः developing enmity, शङ्कितः apprehending danger, पम्पाम् on the banks of Pampa, अटति roaming.
explanation: Born of Riksharaja, he is the offspring of the Sungod. He has developed enmity with Vali, and is roaming about the banks of Pampa, suspecting danger from Vali.

shloka_text: सन्निधायायुधं क्षिप्रमृष्यमूकालयं कपिम्।।3.72.21।। कुरु राघव सत्येन वयस्यं वनचारिणम्।
transliteration: sannidhāyāyudhaṃ kṣipramṛṣyamūkālayaṃ kapim kuru rāghava satyena vayasyaṃ vanacāriṇam|
translation: राघव Rama, आयुधम् weapon, सन्निधाय after keeping ready, वनचारिणम् a wanderer in the forest, ऋष्यमूकालयम् dwelling on Rishyamuka, कपिम् monkey, सत्येन truthfully, क्षिप्रम् at once, वयस्यम् friend, कुरु make.
explanation: O Rama, with your weapons kept ready, go to Sugriva, king of the monkeys, a resident of Rishyamuka. He is wandering in the forest. Establish friendship with him.

shloka_text: स हि स्थानानि सर्वाणि कार्त्स्न्येन कपिकुञ्जरः।।3.72.22।। नरमांसाशिनां लोके नैपुण्यादधिगच्छति।
transliteration: sa hi sthānāni sarvāṇi kārtsnyena kapikuñjaraḥ naramāṃsāśināṃ loke naipuṇyādadhigacchati|
translation: कपिकुञ्जरः foremost of monkeys, सः he, लोके in the world, नरमांसाशिनाम् of cannibals, सर्वाणि all, स्थानानि dwellings, कार्त्स्न्येन entirely, नैपुण्यात् with tact, अधिगच्छति हि will find and reach.
explanation: He is the foremost of the monkeys. He knows well by his wisdom all the dwellingplaces of the carnivorous demons in the world.

shloka_text: न तस्याविदितं लोकेकिञ्चिदस्ति हि राघव।।3.72.23।। यावत्सूर्यः प्रतपति सहस्रांशुररिन्दम।
transliteration: na tasyāviditaṃ lokekiñcidasti hi rāghava yāvatsūryaḥ pratapati sahasrāṃśurarindama|
translation: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, राघव Rama, सहस्रांशुः the god of a thousand rays, सूर्यः Sun, यावत् so far, प्रतपति radiates, लोके in the world, तस्य his, अविदितम् unknown, किञ्चित् hardly anything, नास्ति हि is not.
explanation: There is nothing unknown to Sugriva in this world as far as the Sun shines, O subduer of enemies

shloka_text: स नदीर्विपुलान्शैलान् गिरिदुर्गाणि कन्दरान्।।3.72.24।। अन्वीक्ष्य वानरैस्सार्धं पत्नीं तेऽधिगमिष्यति।
transliteration: sa nadīrvipulānśailān giridurgāṇi kandarān anvīkṣya vānaraissārdhaṃ patnīṃ te'dhigamiṣyati|
translation: सः he, वानरैः सार्धम् along with monkeys, नदीः rivers, विपुलान् big, शैलान् mountains, गिरिदुर्गाणि mountain caves, कन्दरान् caverns, अन्वीक्ष्य searching, ते your, पत्नीम् consort, अधिगमिष्यति will find out.
explanation: Along with his monkeys, he will search all rivers, mountains and caves and will find out your consort.

shloka_text: वानरांश्च महाकायान्प्रेषयिष्यति राघव।।3.72.25।। दिशो विचेतुं तां सीतां त्वद्वियोगेन शोचतीम्। स ज्ञास्यति वरारोहां निर्मलां रावणालये।।3.72.26।।
transliteration: vānarāṃśca mahākāyānpreṣayiṣyati rāghava diśo vicetuṃ tāṃ sītāṃ tvadviyogena śocatīm| sa jñāsyati varārohāṃ nirmalāṃ rāvaṇālaye
translation: राघव Rama, त्वद्वियोगेन by separation from you, शोचतीम् brooding, तां सीताम् that Sita, विचेतुम् to search, महाकायान् gigantic, वानरांश्च monkeys, दिशः in all directions, प्रेषयिष्यति he will send, सः he, रावणालये in Ravana's home, निर्मलाम् chaste, वरारोहाम् beautiful, ज्ञास्यति will find out.
explanation: Sugriva will find out the lady of purity and chastity brooding over you in separation in the abode of Ravana. He can send gigantic monkeys in different directions in order to search for her.

shloka_text: वानरांश्च महाकायान्प्रेषयिष्यति राघव।।3.72.25।। दिशो विचेतुं तां सीतां त्वद्वियोगेन शोचतीम्। स ज्ञास्यति वरारोहां निर्मलां रावणालये।।3.72.26।।
transliteration: vānarāṃśca mahākāyānpreṣayiṣyati rāghava diśo vicetuṃ tāṃ sītāṃ tvadviyogena śocatīm| sa jñāsyati varārohāṃ nirmalāṃ rāvaṇālaye
translation: राघव Rama, त्वद्वियोगेन by separation from you, शोचतीम् brooding, तां सीताम् that Sita, विचेतुम् to search, महाकायान् gigantic, वानरांश्च monkeys, दिशः in all directions, प्रेषयिष्यति he will send, सः he, रावणालये in Ravana's home, निर्मलाम् chaste, वरारोहाम् beautiful, ज्ञास्यति will find out.
explanation: Sugriva will find out the lady of purity and chastity brooding over you in separation in the abode of Ravana. He can send gigantic monkeys in different directions in order to search for her.

shloka_text: स मेरुशृङ्गाग्रगतामनिन्दितां प्रविश्य पातालतलेऽपि वा श्रिताम्। प्लवङ्गमानां प्रवरस्तव प्रियां निहत्य रक्षांसि पुनः प्रदास्यति।।3.72.27।।
transliteration: sa meruśṛṅgāgragatāmaninditāṃ praviśya pātālatale'pi vā śritām| plavaṅgamānāṃ pravarastava priyāṃ nihatya rakṣāṃsi punaḥ pradāsyati
translation: प्लवङ्गमानाम् of monkeys, प्रवरः the best one, सः he, अनिन्दिताम् a blameless, तव प्रियाम् your dear consort, मेरुशृङ्गाग्रगता even if on top of mount Meru, पातालतले or in the nether world, श्रितां वापि or gone there also, प्रविश्य after reaching, रक्षांसि demons, निहत्य  killing, पुनः again, प्रदास्यति he will restore to you.
explanation: Sugriva, king of the monkeys, will reach the demons  and restore you that blameless, beloved consort of yours, even if she is there on top of mount Meru or in the deep underworld. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventysecond sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: निदर्शयित्वा रामाय सीतायाः प्रतिपादने। वाक्यमन्वर्थमर्थज्ञः कबन्धः पुनरब्रवीत्।।3.73.1।।
transliteration: nidarśayitvā rāmāya sītāyāḥ pratipādane| vākyamanvarthamarthajñaḥ kabandhaḥ punarabravīt
translation: अर्थज्ञः one who knows the meaning, कबन्धः Kabandha, सीतायाः Sita's, प्रतिपादने finding means to restore, (नि)दर्शयित्वा having shown, अन्वर्थम् meaningful, वाक्यम् words, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having shown Rama the means to find Sita, Kabandha spoke again these significant words:
comments: Kabandha gives Rama the direction to Rishyamuka--  disappears, bidding farewell to Rama and Lakshmanadescription of nature  at Pampa

shloka_text: एष राम शिवः पन्था यत्रैते पुष्पिता द्रुमाः। प्रतीचीं दिशमाश्रित्य प्रकाशन्ते मनोरमाः।।3.73.2।। जम्बूप्रियालपनसप्लक्षन्यग्रोधतिन्धुकाः। अश्वत्थाः कर्णिकाराश्च चूताश्चान्ये च पादापाः।।3.73.3।। धन्वना नागवृक्षाश्च तिलका नक्तमालकाः। नीलाशोकाः कदम्बाश्च करवीराश्च पुष्पिताः।।3.73.4।। अग्निमुख्या अशोकाश्च सुरक्ताः पारिभद्रकाः।
transliteration: eṣa rāma śivaḥ panthā yatraite puṣpitā drumāḥ| pratīcīṃ diśamāśritya prakāśante manoramāḥ jambūpriyālapanasaplakṣanyagrodhatindhukāḥ| aśvatthāḥ karṇikārāśca cūtāścānye ca pādāpāḥ dhanvanā nāgavṛkṣāśca tilakā naktamālakāḥ| nīlāśokāḥ kadambāśca karavīrāśca puṣpitāḥ agnimukhyā aśokāśca suraktāḥ pāribhadrakāḥ|
translation: राम Rama, यत्र whereever, प्रतीचीम् westward, दिशम् direction, अश्रित्य taking, मनोरमाः delightful, पुष्पिताः flowering, द्रुमाः trees, जम्बूप्रियालपनसप्लक्षन्यग्रोधतिन्दुकाः jambu trees , priyala trees, jackfruit trees, holy banyan trees and trees with red flowers, अश्वत्थाः holy fig trees, कर्णिकाराश्च karnikara trees, चूताश्च mango trees, अन्ये च and other, पादपाः trees, धन्वनाः dryland trees, नागवृक्षाश्च different kinds of thorny trees, तिलकाः tilaka trees, नक्तमालकाः trees that bloom at night, नीलाशोकाः ashoka trees of blue flowers, कदम्बाश्च पुष्पिताः kadamba trees in bloom, करवीराश्च karavira, अग्निमुख्याः agnimukhya, अशोकाश्च ashoka, सुरक्ताः red trees, पारिभद्रकाः paribhadrakas, प्रकाशन्ते are shining, एषः that is, शिवः auspicious, पन्थाः route.
explanation: O Rama the delightful path going westward is auspicious for you. It is shining with trees in bloom. There are jambu (rose apple) trees, priyala trees, jackfruit trees, banyan trees, plaksha trees (a tree from which milky latex oozes out), tinduka trees, holy fig trees, karnikaras (of red and white flowers), mango trees and other trees like dryland, thorny trees, tilaka trees, trees that bloom at night, agnimukhya and asoka trees of blue flowers, kadamba trees, karavira trees, red ashoka trees, and paribhadraka trees.

shloka_text: एष राम शिवः पन्था यत्रैते पुष्पिता द्रुमाः। प्रतीचीं दिशमाश्रित्य प्रकाशन्ते मनोरमाः।।3.73.2।। जम्बूप्रियालपनसप्लक्षन्यग्रोधतिन्धुकाः। अश्वत्थाः कर्णिकाराश्च चूताश्चान्ये च पादापाः।।3.73.3।। धन्वना नागवृक्षाश्च तिलका नक्तमालकाः। नीलाशोकाः कदम्बाश्च करवीराश्च पुष्पिताः।।3.73.4।। अग्निमुख्या अशोकाश्च सुरक्ताः पारिभद्रकाः।
transliteration: eṣa rāma śivaḥ panthā yatraite puṣpitā drumāḥ| pratīcīṃ diśamāśritya prakāśante manoramāḥ jambūpriyālapanasaplakṣanyagrodhatindhukāḥ| aśvatthāḥ karṇikārāśca cūtāścānye ca pādāpāḥ dhanvanā nāgavṛkṣāśca tilakā naktamālakāḥ| nīlāśokāḥ kadambāśca karavīrāśca puṣpitāḥ agnimukhyā aśokāśca suraktāḥ pāribhadrakāḥ|
translation: राम Rama, यत्र whereever, प्रतीचीम् westward, दिशम् direction, अश्रित्य taking, मनोरमाः delightful, पुष्पिताः flowering, द्रुमाः trees, जम्बूप्रियालपनसप्लक्षन्यग्रोधतिन्दुकाः jambu trees , priyala trees, jackfruit trees, holy banyan trees and trees with red flowers, अश्वत्थाः holy fig trees, कर्णिकाराश्च karnikara trees, चूताश्च mango trees, अन्ये च and other, पादपाः trees, धन्वनाः dryland trees, नागवृक्षाश्च different kinds of thorny trees, तिलकाः tilaka trees, नक्तमालकाः trees that bloom at night, नीलाशोकाः ashoka trees of blue flowers, कदम्बाश्च पुष्पिताः kadamba trees in bloom, करवीराश्च karavira, अग्निमुख्याः agnimukhya, अशोकाश्च ashoka, सुरक्ताः red trees, पारिभद्रकाः paribhadrakas, प्रकाशन्ते are shining, एषः that is, शिवः auspicious, पन्थाः route.
explanation: O Rama the delightful path going westward is auspicious for you. It is shining with trees in bloom. There are jambu (rose apple) trees, priyala trees, jackfruit trees, banyan trees, plaksha trees (a tree from which milky latex oozes out), tinduka trees, holy fig trees, karnikaras (of red and white flowers), mango trees and other trees like dryland, thorny trees, tilaka trees, trees that bloom at night, agnimukhya and asoka trees of blue flowers, kadamba trees, karavira trees, red ashoka trees, and paribhadraka trees.

shloka_text: एष राम शिवः पन्था यत्रैते पुष्पिता द्रुमाः। प्रतीचीं दिशमाश्रित्य प्रकाशन्ते मनोरमाः।।3.73.2।। जम्बूप्रियालपनसप्लक्षन्यग्रोधतिन्धुकाः। अश्वत्थाः कर्णिकाराश्च चूताश्चान्ये च पादापाः।।3.73.3।। धन्वना नागवृक्षाश्च तिलका नक्तमालकाः। नीलाशोकाः कदम्बाश्च करवीराश्च पुष्पिताः।।3.73.4।। अग्निमुख्या अशोकाश्च सुरक्ताः पारिभद्रकाः।
transliteration: eṣa rāma śivaḥ panthā yatraite puṣpitā drumāḥ| pratīcīṃ diśamāśritya prakāśante manoramāḥ jambūpriyālapanasaplakṣanyagrodhatindhukāḥ| aśvatthāḥ karṇikārāśca cūtāścānye ca pādāpāḥ dhanvanā nāgavṛkṣāśca tilakā naktamālakāḥ| nīlāśokāḥ kadambāśca karavīrāśca puṣpitāḥ agnimukhyā aśokāśca suraktāḥ pāribhadrakāḥ|
translation: राम Rama, यत्र whereever, प्रतीचीम् westward, दिशम् direction, अश्रित्य taking, मनोरमाः delightful, पुष्पिताः flowering, द्रुमाः trees, जम्बूप्रियालपनसप्लक्षन्यग्रोधतिन्दुकाः jambu trees , priyala trees, jackfruit trees, holy banyan trees and trees with red flowers, अश्वत्थाः holy fig trees, कर्णिकाराश्च karnikara trees, चूताश्च mango trees, अन्ये च and other, पादपाः trees, धन्वनाः dryland trees, नागवृक्षाश्च different kinds of thorny trees, तिलकाः tilaka trees, नक्तमालकाः trees that bloom at night, नीलाशोकाः ashoka trees of blue flowers, कदम्बाश्च पुष्पिताः kadamba trees in bloom, करवीराश्च karavira, अग्निमुख्याः agnimukhya, अशोकाश्च ashoka, सुरक्ताः red trees, पारिभद्रकाः paribhadrakas, प्रकाशन्ते are shining, एषः that is, शिवः auspicious, पन्थाः route.
explanation: O Rama the delightful path going westward is auspicious for you. It is shining with trees in bloom. There are jambu (rose apple) trees, priyala trees, jackfruit trees, banyan trees, plaksha trees (a tree from which milky latex oozes out), tinduka trees, holy fig trees, karnikaras (of red and white flowers), mango trees and other trees like dryland, thorny trees, tilaka trees, trees that bloom at night, agnimukhya and asoka trees of blue flowers, kadamba trees, karavira trees, red ashoka trees, and paribhadraka trees.

shloka_text: तानारुह्याथवा भूमौ पातयित्वा च तान्बलात्।।3.73.5।। फलान्यमृतकल्पानि भक्षयन्तौ गमिष्यथः।
transliteration: tānāruhyāthavā bhūmau pātayitvā ca tānbalāt phalānyamṛtakalpāni bhakṣayantau gamiṣyathaḥ|
translation: तान् those trees, आरुह्य climbing, अथवा or else, बलात् with your strength, तान् them, पातयित्वा pulling them down, अमृत कल्पानि nectarlike, फलानि fruits, भक्षयन्तौ while eating, गमिष्यथः go ahead.
explanation: Climbing those trees or else pulling them down with your strength, both of you eat the nectarlike sweet fruits and proceed ahead.

shloka_text: तदतिक्रम्य काकुत्स्थ वनं पुष्पितपादपम्।।3.73.6।। नन्दनप्रतिमं चान्यत्कुरवो ह्युत्तरा इव।
transliteration: tadatikramya kākutstha vanaṃ puṣpitapādapam nandanapratimaṃ cānyatkuravo hyuttarā iva|
translation: काकुत्स्थ Kakustha, पुष्पितपादपम् trees with flowers in bloom, तत् that, वनम् forest, अतिक्रम्य after crossing, नन्दनप्रतिमम् resembling Nandana gardens, उत्तराः कुरवः इव like the north Kuru state, अन्यत् another pleasuregarden.
explanation: O scion of the Kakutstha race  proceeding further you will find another forest of the North Kuru state with trees in bloom resembling the pleasuregardens of Nandana.

shloka_text: सर्वकालफला यत्र पादपास्तु मधुस्रवाः।।3.73.7।। सर्वे च ऋतवस्तत्र वने चैत्ररथे यथा।
transliteration: sarvakālaphalā yatra pādapāstu madhusravāḥ sarve ca ṛtavastatra vane caitrarathe yathā|
translation: यत्र there, सर्वकालफलाः fruits of all seasons, पादपाः trees, मधुस्रवाः drip honey, तत्र वने in that garden, सर्वे all, ऋतवः seasons, चैत्ररथे यथा like the Chaitraratha.
explanation: The trees in that garden with fruits of all seasons drip honey. Like the Chaitraratha garden (of Kubera), it bears fruits of all seasons.

shloka_text: फलभारानतास्तत्र महाविटपधारिणः।।3.73.8।। शोभन्ते सर्वतस्तत्र मेघपर्वतसन्निभाः।
transliteration: phalabhārānatāstatra mahāviṭapadhāriṇaḥ śobhante sarvatastatra meghaparvatasannibhāḥ|
translation: तत्र there, फलभारानताः borne down by the weight of fruits, मेघपर्वतसन्निभाः like mountains and clouds, महाविटपधारिणः trees with huge branches, शोभन्ते look delightful.
explanation: The trees with huge branches bent down with fruits look like mountains or clouds.

shloka_text: तानारुह्याथवा भूमौ पातयित्वा यथासुखम्।।3.73.9।। फलान्यमृतकल्पानि लक्ष्मणस्ते प्रदास्यति।
transliteration: tānāruhyāthavā bhūmau pātayitvā yathāsukham phalānyamṛtakalpāni lakṣmaṇaste pradāsyati|
translation: लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तान् those, आरुह्य  climbing, अथवा or else, यथासुखम् as you like, पातयित्वा pull down, अमृतकल्पानि nectarlike, फलानि fruits, ते to you, प्रदास्यति  he can give you.
explanation: Lakshmana will get you the nectarlike fruits either by climbing the trees or by pulling them down.

shloka_text: चङ्क्रमन्तौ वरान्देशान्शैलाच्छैलं वनाद्वनम्।।3.73.10।। ततः पुष्करिणीं वीरौ पम्पां नाम गमिष्यथः।
transliteration: caṅkramantau varāndeśānśailācchailaṃ vanādvanam tataḥ puṣkariṇīṃ vīrau pampāṃ nāma gamiṣyathaḥ|
translation: वीरौ two brave men, वरान् great, देशान् places, शैलात् from one hill, शैलम् to another hill, वनात् from one forest, वनम् to another, चङ्क्रमन्तौ while going, ततः then, पम्पां नाम named Pampa, पुष्करिणीम् tank, गमिष्यथः you will both reach.
explanation: O brave men, pass from hill to hill, forest to forest in great countries until you reach a lake named Pampa.

shloka_text: अशर्करामविभ्रंशां समतीर्थामशैवलाम्।।3.73.11।। राम सञ्जातवालूकां कमलोत्पलशालिनीम्।
transliteration: aśarkarāmavibhraṃśāṃ samatīrthāmaśaivalām rāma sañjātavālūkāṃ kamalotpalaśālinīm|
translation: राम Rama, अशर्कराम् without stones or pebbles, अविभ्रंशाम् or slipping, समतीर्थाम् level slopes, अशैवलाम् without moss, सञ्जातवालूकाम् smooth beds of sand on the banks, कमलोत्पलशालिनीम् full of lotuses lilies.
explanation: The slopes of Pampa are without stones or pebbles, O Rama   They are not slippery slopes. They are without moss. The water is neither deep nor shallow. It has smooth beds of sand on the banks and it is full of lotuses and lilies.

shloka_text: तत्र हंसाः प्लवाः क्रौञ्चाः कुरराश्चैव राघव।।3.73.12।। वल्गुस्वना विकूजन्ति पम्पासलिलगोचराः।
transliteration: tatra haṃsāḥ plavāḥ krauñcāḥ kurarāścaiva rāghava valgusvanā vikūjanti pampāsalilagocarāḥ|
