translation: राघव O son of the Raghus, तत्र there, पम्पासलिलगोचराः moving in the waters of Pampa, हंसाः swans, प्लवाः ducks, क्रौञ्चाः Krauncha birds, कुरराश्चैव and curlews, वल्गुस्वनाः cackling, विकूजन्ति cooing.
explanation: Moving in the waters of Pampa you will see swans, ducks, krauncha birds and curlews cackling and cooing, O Son of the Raghus.

shloka_text: नोद्विजन्ते नरान्दृष्ट्वा वधस्याकोविदाश्शुभाः।।3.73.13।। घृतपिण्डोपमान् स्थूलांस्तान्द्विजान्भक्षयिष्यथः।
transliteration: nodvijante narāndṛṣṭvā vadhasyākovidāśśubhāḥ ghṛtapiṇḍopamān sthūlāṃstāndvijānbhakṣayiṣyathaḥ|
translation: वधस्य to be killed, अकोविदाः not knowing, शुभाः auspicious, नरान् human beings, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, नोद्विजन्ते do not get scared, घृतपिण्डोपमान् like balls of ghee, स्थूलान् fat, तान् them, द्विजान् killing, भक्षयिष्यथः can eat.
explanation: Not knowing that they may be killed, the innocent creatures will not be scared of human beings. Both of you can kill and eat the fat birds comparable to balls of ghee.

shloka_text: रोहितान्वक्रतुण्डांश्च नडमीनांश्च राघव।।3.73.14।। पम्पायामिषुभिर्मत्स्यांस्तत्र राम वरान्हतान्। निस्त्वक्पक्षानयस्तप्तानकृशानेककण्टकान्।।3.73.15।। तव भक्त्या समायुक्तो लक्ष्मणस्सम्प्रदास्यति।
transliteration: rohitānvakratuṇḍāṃśca naḍamīnāṃśca rāghava pampāyāmiṣubhirmatsyāṃstatra rāma varānhatān| nistvakpakṣānayastaptānakṛśānekakaṇṭakān tava bhaktyā samāyukto lakṣmaṇassampradāsyati|
translation: राघव scion of the Raghu dynasty, राम Rama, तत्र there, पम्पायाम् in Pampa, इषुभिः charging with arrows, हतान् killed, वरान् choicest, निस्त्वक्पक्षान् without scales and fins, अयस्तप्तान् baked on skewers made of iron, अकृशानेककण्टकान् fat ones with a single bone, मत्स्यान् fish, रोहितान् rohita fish, वक्रतुण्डांश्च crookedmouth fish, नडमीनांश्च huge fish, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भक्त्या with devotion, समायुक्तः is endowed, तव you, सम्प्रदास्यति will be able to give.
explanation: O Rama, scion of the Raghu dynasty  there at Pampa, by shooting an arrow at the choicest  fishes with a single bone, prawns and big fishes, crookedfaced fishes, fishes without scales and fins, baked on iron skewers and cooked will be offered to you by faithful Lakshmana.

shloka_text: रोहितान्वक्रतुण्डांश्च नडमीनांश्च राघव।।3.73.14।। पम्पायामिषुभिर्मत्स्यांस्तत्र राम वरान्हतान्। निस्त्वक्पक्षानयस्तप्तानकृशानेककण्टकान्।।3.73.15।। तव भक्त्या समायुक्तो लक्ष्मणस्सम्प्रदास्यति।
transliteration: rohitānvakratuṇḍāṃśca naḍamīnāṃśca rāghava pampāyāmiṣubhirmatsyāṃstatra rāma varānhatān| nistvakpakṣānayastaptānakṛśānekakaṇṭakān tava bhaktyā samāyukto lakṣmaṇassampradāsyati|
translation: राघव scion of the Raghu dynasty, राम Rama, तत्र there, पम्पायाम् in Pampa, इषुभिः charging with arrows, हतान् killed, वरान् choicest, निस्त्वक्पक्षान् without scales and fins, अयस्तप्तान् baked on skewers made of iron, अकृशानेककण्टकान् fat ones with a single bone, मत्स्यान् fish, रोहितान् rohita fish, वक्रतुण्डांश्च crookedmouth fish, नडमीनांश्च huge fish, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, भक्त्या with devotion, समायुक्तः is endowed, तव you, सम्प्रदास्यति will be able to give.
explanation: O Rama, scion of the Raghu dynasty  there at Pampa, by shooting an arrow at the choicest  fishes with a single bone, prawns and big fishes, crookedfaced fishes, fishes without scales and fins, baked on iron skewers and cooked will be offered to you by faithful Lakshmana.

shloka_text: भृशते खादतो मत्स्यान्पम्पायाः पुष्पसञ्चये।।3.73.16।। पद्मगन्धि शिवं वारि सुखशीतमनामयम्। उद्धृत्य सतताक्लिष्टं रौप्यस्फाटिकसन्निभम्।।3.73.17।। असौ पुष्करपर्णेन लक्ष्मणः पाययिष्यति।
transliteration: bhṛśate khādato matsyānpampāyāḥ puṣpasañcaye padmagandhi śivaṃ vāri sukhaśītamanāmayam| uddhṛtya satatākliṣṭaṃ raupyasphāṭikasannibham asau puṣkaraparṇena lakṣmaṇaḥ pāyayiṣyati|
translation: भृशम् very delightedly, मत्स्यान् fish, खादतः while eating, ते to you, पुष्पसञ्चये in a place full of flowers, पद्मगन्धि scent of lotuses, शिवम् beneficent, सुखशीतम् cool, अनामयम् healthy, सतताक्लिष्टम् always clear, रौप्यस्फाटिकसन्निभम् resembling silver and crystal, वारि water, असौ लक्ष्मणः this Lakshmana, पुष्करपर्णेन in lotus leaf, पाययिष्यति will offer you.
explanation: While you delightedly eat the fishes, Lakshmana will fetch you water in a lotus leaf from the Pampa to drink. The waters of Pampa full of lotuses carry their scent, It  is enjoyable, cool, healthy and clear, resembling silver and crystal.

shloka_text: भृशते खादतो मत्स्यान्पम्पायाः पुष्पसञ्चये।।3.73.16।। पद्मगन्धि शिवं वारि सुखशीतमनामयम्। उद्धृत्य सतताक्लिष्टं रौप्यस्फाटिकसन्निभम्।।3.73.17।। असौ पुष्करपर्णेन लक्ष्मणः पाययिष्यति।
transliteration: bhṛśate khādato matsyānpampāyāḥ puṣpasañcaye padmagandhi śivaṃ vāri sukhaśītamanāmayam| uddhṛtya satatākliṣṭaṃ raupyasphāṭikasannibham asau puṣkaraparṇena lakṣmaṇaḥ pāyayiṣyati|
translation: भृशम् very delightedly, मत्स्यान् fish, खादतः while eating, ते to you, पुष्पसञ्चये in a place full of flowers, पद्मगन्धि scent of lotuses, शिवम् beneficent, सुखशीतम् cool, अनामयम् healthy, सतताक्लिष्टम् always clear, रौप्यस्फाटिकसन्निभम् resembling silver and crystal, वारि water, असौ लक्ष्मणः this Lakshmana, पुष्करपर्णेन in lotus leaf, पाययिष्यति will offer you.
explanation: While you delightedly eat the fishes, Lakshmana will fetch you water in a lotus leaf from the Pampa to drink. The waters of Pampa full of lotuses carry their scent, It  is enjoyable, cool, healthy and clear, resembling silver and crystal.

shloka_text: स्थूलान्गिरिगुहाशय्यान्वराहान्वनचारिणः।।3.73.18।। अपां लोभादुपावृत्तान्वृषभानिव नर्दतः। रूपावनितांश्च पम्पायांद्रक्ष्यसि त्वं नरोत्तम।।3.73.19।।
transliteration: sthūlāngiriguhāśayyānvarāhānvanacāriṇaḥ apāṃ lobhādupāvṛttānvṛṣabhāniva nardataḥ| rūpāvanitāṃśca pampāyāṃdrakṣyasi tvaṃ narottama
translation: नरोत्तम O best of men, स्थूलान् huge, गिरिगुहाशय्यान् resting in the mountain caves, वनचारिणः  forestrangers, अपाम् of waters, लोभात्  desire , उपावृत्तान् approaching, वृषभानिव like bulls, नर्दतः roaring, रूपावनितान् delightful appearance, वराहान् boars, पम्पायाम् at Pampa, त्वम् you, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: O best of men you will see huge boars of delightful appearance that roar like bulls resting in mountain caves, roaming in the forest and coming to Pampa for its water.

shloka_text: स्थूलान्गिरिगुहाशय्यान्वराहान्वनचारिणः।।3.73.18।। अपां लोभादुपावृत्तान्वृषभानिव नर्दतः। रूपावनितांश्च पम्पायांद्रक्ष्यसि त्वं नरोत्तम।।3.73.19।।
transliteration: sthūlāngiriguhāśayyānvarāhānvanacāriṇaḥ apāṃ lobhādupāvṛttānvṛṣabhāniva nardataḥ| rūpāvanitāṃśca pampāyāṃdrakṣyasi tvaṃ narottama
translation: नरोत्तम O best of men, स्थूलान् huge, गिरिगुहाशय्यान् resting in the mountain caves, वनचारिणः  forestrangers, अपाम् of waters, लोभात्  desire , उपावृत्तान् approaching, वृषभानिव like bulls, नर्दतः roaring, रूपावनितान् delightful appearance, वराहान् boars, पम्पायाम् at Pampa, त्वम् you, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: O best of men you will see huge boars of delightful appearance that roar like bulls resting in mountain caves, roaming in the forest and coming to Pampa for its water.

shloka_text: सायाह्ने विचरन्राम विटपीन्माल्यधारिणः। शीतोदकं च पम्पाया दृष्ट्वा शोकं विहास्यसि।।3.73.20।।
transliteration: sāyāhne vicaranrāma viṭapīnmālyadhāriṇaḥ| śītodakaṃ ca pampāyā dṛṣṭvā śokaṃ vihāsyasi
translation: राम Rama, सायाह्ने in the evening, विचरन् while strolling, माल्यधारिणः laden with blossoms, विटपीन् trees, पम्पायाः at Pampa, शीतोदकं च cool waters also, दृष्ट्वा seeing, शोकम्  grief, विहास्यसि you will shake off.
explanation: When you stroll in the evening, you will see the trees laden with blossoms and lake Pampa full of cool water. You will forget your grief.

shloka_text: सुमनोभिश्चितांस्तत्र तिलकान्नक्तमालकान्। उत्पलानि च फुल्लानि पङ्कजानि च राघव।।3.73.21।।
transliteration: sumanobhiścitāṃstatra tilakānnaktamālakān| utpalāni ca phullāni paṅkajāni ca rāghava
translation: राघव Son of the Raghus, तत्र there, सुमनोभिः with flowers, चितान् full of, तिलकान् tilaka trees, नक्तमालकान् night jasmine, फुल्लानि blossoming, उत्पलानि च water lilies, पङ्कजानि च otuses.
explanation: O son of the Raghus  there you will see tilaka trees, night jasmines full of flowers. You will also see blossoming water lilies and lotuses in Pampa.

shloka_text: न तानि कश्चिन्माल्यानि तत्रारोपयिता नरः। न च वै म्लानतां यान्ति न च शीर्यन्ति राघव।।3.73.22।।
transliteration: na tāni kaścinmālyāni tatrāropayitā naraḥ| na ca vai mlānatāṃ yānti na ca śīryanti rāghava
translation: राघव Rama, तत्र there, तानि माल्यानि those garlands, आरोपयिता wearing, नरः man, कश्चित्  any one, न not, म्लानताम् whithering, न यान्ति not become, न च शीर्यन्ति they do not wilt,
explanation: There is no one to wear those flowers. Those garlands do not wilt or wither O Rama

shloka_text: मतङ्गशिष्यास्तत्राऽसन्नृषयस्सुसमाहिताः। तेषां भाराभितप्तानां वन्यमाहरतां गुरोः।।3.73.23।। ये प्रपेतुर्महीं तूर्णं शरीरात्स्वेदबिन्दवः। तानि जातानि माल्यानि मुनीनां तपसा तदा।।3.73.24।। स्वेदबिन्दुसमुत्थानि न विनश्यन्ति राघव।
transliteration: mataṅgaśiṣyāstatrā'sannṛṣayassusamāhitāḥ| teṣāṃ bhārābhitaptānāṃ vanyamāharatāṃ guroḥ ye prapeturmahīṃ tūrṇaṃ śarīrātsvedabindavaḥ| tāni jātāni mālyāni munīnāṃ tapasā tadā svedabindusamutthāni na vinaśyanti rāghava|
translation: तत्र there, सुसमाहिताः  in a calm state, मतङ्गशिष्याः seer Matanga's disciples, ऋषयः seers, आसन् they were, गुरोः of the preceptor, वन्यम् forest products, आहरताम् fetched, भाराभितप्तानाम् tired under the burden, तेषाम् from their, शरीरात् from the body, ये those, स्वेदबिन्दवः drops of sweat, तूर्णम् readily, महीम् on the earth, (प्र)पेतुः had fallen, तानि those, तदा then, मुनीनाम् of the sages, तपसा with penance, माल्यानि flowers, जातानि grown, राघव Rama, स्वेदबिन्दुसमुत्थानि sprung from the drops of sweat, न विनश्यन्ति not perish.
explanation: While drops of sweat from the bodies of sage Matanga's disciples fell on earth under the heavy load of forest products they carried for their preceptor, they remained in a calm state. Those drops of sweat turned into flowers and those flowers do not wither due to the power of penance of the sages.

shloka_text: मतङ्गशिष्यास्तत्राऽसन्नृषयस्सुसमाहिताः। तेषां भाराभितप्तानां वन्यमाहरतां गुरोः।।3.73.23।। ये प्रपेतुर्महीं तूर्णं शरीरात्स्वेदबिन्दवः। तानि जातानि माल्यानि मुनीनां तपसा तदा।।3.73.24।। स्वेदबिन्दुसमुत्थानि न विनश्यन्ति राघव।
transliteration: mataṅgaśiṣyāstatrā'sannṛṣayassusamāhitāḥ| teṣāṃ bhārābhitaptānāṃ vanyamāharatāṃ guroḥ ye prapeturmahīṃ tūrṇaṃ śarīrātsvedabindavaḥ| tāni jātāni mālyāni munīnāṃ tapasā tadā svedabindusamutthāni na vinaśyanti rāghava|
translation: तत्र there, सुसमाहिताः  in a calm state, मतङ्गशिष्याः seer Matanga's disciples, ऋषयः seers, आसन् they were, गुरोः of the preceptor, वन्यम् forest products, आहरताम् fetched, भाराभितप्तानाम् tired under the burden, तेषाम् from their, शरीरात् from the body, ये those, स्वेदबिन्दवः drops of sweat, तूर्णम् readily, महीम् on the earth, (प्र)पेतुः had fallen, तानि those, तदा then, मुनीनाम् of the sages, तपसा with penance, माल्यानि flowers, जातानि grown, राघव Rama, स्वेदबिन्दुसमुत्थानि sprung from the drops of sweat, न विनश्यन्ति not perish.
explanation: While drops of sweat from the bodies of sage Matanga's disciples fell on earth under the heavy load of forest products they carried for their preceptor, they remained in a calm state. Those drops of sweat turned into flowers and those flowers do not wither due to the power of penance of the sages.

shloka_text: तेषां गतानामद्यापि दृश्यते परिचारिणी।।3.73.25।। श्रमणी शबरी नाम काकुत्स्थ चिरजीविनी।
transliteration: teṣāṃ gatānāmadyāpi dṛśyate paricāriṇī śramaṇī śabarī nāma kākutstha cirajīvinī|
translation: काकुत्थ्स Kakutstha, तेषाम् for them, गतानाम् who had gone, परिचारिणी their attendant, चिरजीविनी living for long years, शबरीनाम named Sabari, श्रमणी ascetic, अद्यापि even now, दृश्यते is seen.
explanation: O Kakutstha  even now their attendant, named Sabari, an old ascetic is there even though they have left long ago.

shloka_text: त्वां तु धर्मे स्थिता नित्यं सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम्।।3.73.26।। दृष्ट्वा देवोपमं राम स्वर्गलोकं गमिष्यति।
transliteration: tvāṃ tu dharme sthitā nityaṃ sarvabhūtanamaskṛtam dṛṣṭvā devopamaṃ rāma svargalokaṃ gamiṣyati|
translation: राम Rama, नित्यम् always, धर्मे in rigteous ways, स्थिता remaining, सर्वभूतनमस्कृतम् revered by all beings, देवोपमम् godlike, त्वाम् you, दृष्ट्वा seeing, स्वर्गलोकम् heaven, गमिष्यति will go.
explanation: O Rama, she is established in righteousness, and you are godlike, and revered by all beings. When she sees you, she will attain heaven.

shloka_text: ततस्तद्राम पम्पायास्तीरमासाद्य पश्चिमम्।।3.73.27।। आश्रमस्थानमतुलं गुह्यं काकुत्स्थ पश्यसि।
transliteration: tatastadrāma pampāyāstīramāsādya paścimam āśramasthānamatulaṃ guhyaṃ kākutstha paśyasi|
translation: काकुत्स्थ Kakutstha, राम Rama, ततः thereafter, पम्पायाः Pampa's, तत् that, पश्चिमं तीरम् western bank, आसाद्य reaching, अतुलम् incomparable, गुह्यम् concealed, आश्रमस्थानम् site of hermitage, पश्यसि you will see.
explanation: O Rama of the Kakutstha family, you will see on reaching the western bank of Pampa an incomparable site of hermitage concealed in a remote place.

shloka_text: न तत्राक्रमितुं नागाश्शक्नुवन्ति तमाश्रमम्।।3.73.28।। विविधास्तत्र वै नागा वने तस्मिंश्च पर्वते। ऋषेस्तत्र मतङ्गस्य विधानात्तच्च काननम्।।3.73.29।।
transliteration: na tatrākramituṃ nāgāśśaknuvanti tamāśramam vividhāstatra vai nāgā vane tasmiṃśca parvate| ṛṣestatra mataṅgasya vidhānāttacca kānanam
translation: तत्र There, नागा: elephants, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, आक्रमितुम् to attack, न शक्नुवन्ति not able, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वते in the mountain, वने forest, विविधाः many, नागाः elephants, तत् that, काननम् the forest, तस्य his, मतङ्गस्य ऋषेः seer Matanga's, विधानात् due to his command.
explanation: The elephants of the forest and on the mountains do not attack the hermitage forbidden by sage Matanga.

shloka_text: न तत्राक्रमितुं नागाश्शक्नुवन्ति तमाश्रमम्।।3.73.28।। विविधास्तत्र वै नागा वने तस्मिंश्च पर्वते। ऋषेस्तत्र मतङ्गस्य विधानात्तच्च काननम्।।3.73.29।।
transliteration: na tatrākramituṃ nāgāśśaknuvanti tamāśramam vividhāstatra vai nāgā vane tasmiṃśca parvate| ṛṣestatra mataṅgasya vidhānāttacca kānanam
translation: तत्र There, नागा: elephants, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitage, आक्रमितुम् to attack, न शक्नुवन्ति not able, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वते in the mountain, वने forest, विविधाः many, नागाः elephants, तत् that, काननम् the forest, तस्य his, मतङ्गस्य ऋषेः seer Matanga's, विधानात् due to his command.
explanation: The elephants of the forest and on the mountains do not attack the hermitage forbidden by sage Matanga.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्नन्दनसङ्काशे देवारण्योपमे वने। नानाविहगसङ्कीर्णे रंस्यसे राम निर्वृतः।।3.73.30।।
transliteration: tasminnandanasaṅkāśe devāraṇyopame vane| nānāvihagasaṅkīrṇe raṃsyase rāma nirvṛtaḥ
translation: राम Rama, नन्दनसङ्काशे like Nandana gardens, देवारण्योपमे comparable to the garden of the gods, नानाविहगसङ्कीर्णे full of several kinds of birds, तस्मिन् वने in that forest, निवृतः giving up your grief, रंस्यसे you will enjoy.
explanation: O Rama, you will enjoy your stay in that forest which is like Nandana garden, the garden of the gods, full of various birds.

shloka_text: ऋष्यमूकश्च पम्पायाः पुरस्तात्पुष्पितद्रुमः। सुदुःखारोहणो नाम शिशुनागाभिरक्षितः।।3.73.31।। उदारो ब्रह्मणा चैव पूर्वकाले विनिर्मितः।
transliteration: ṛṣyamūkaśca pampāyāḥ purastātpuṣpitadrumaḥ| suduḥkhārohaṇo nāma śiśunāgābhirakṣitaḥ udāro brahmaṇā caiva pūrvakāle vinirmitaḥ|
translation: पम्पायाः Pampa's, पुरस्तात् before, पुष्पितद्रुमः trees with flowers in bloom, सुदुःखारोहणः quite difficult to climb, शिशुनागाभिरक्षितः protected by young elephants, उदारः exalted, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, ऋष्यमूकश्च Rishyamuka, पूर्वकाले in the past, विनिर्मितः is created.
explanation: Mount Rishyamuka situated on the bank of Pampa has trees filled with blossoms. It is difficult to climb and is protected by young elephants.This lofty mountain was created by Brahma in olden days.

shloka_text: शयानः पुरुषो राम तस्य शैलस्य मूर्धनि।।3.73.32।। यत्स्वप्ने लभते वित्तं तत्प्रबुद्धोऽधिगच्छति।
transliteration: śayānaḥ puruṣo rāma tasya śailasya mūrdhani yatsvapne labhate vittaṃ tatprabuddho'dhigacchati|
translation: राम Rama, तस्य of that, शैलस्य mountain's, मूर्धनि on top, शयानः while sleeping there, पुरुषः any man, स्वप्ने in a dream, यत् whatever, वित्तम् wealth, लभते obtains, तत् that, प्रबुद्धः on waking up, अधिगच्छति will get.
explanation: Whatever wealth one dreams of in sleep on top of that mountain he will get on waking up, O Rama

shloka_text: नत्वेनं विषमाचार पापकर्माऽधिरोहति।।3.73.33।। यस्तु तं विषमाचारः पापकर्माऽधिरोहति। तत्रैव प्रहऱन्त्येनं सुप्तमादाय राक्षसाः।।3.73.34।।
transliteration: natvenaṃ viṣamācāra pāpakarmā'dhirohati yastu taṃ viṣamācāraḥ pāpakarmā'dhirohati| tatraiva prahaṟantyenaṃ suptamādāya rākṣasāḥ
translation: विषमाचारः a place of uneven terrain for movement, पापकर्मा sinner, एवम् so also, न अधिरोहति cannot ascend, विषमाचारः evil doer, पापकर्मा sinner, यः whoever, तम् him, अधिरोहति ascends, सुप्तम् when asleep, तम् him, आदाय taking, राक्षसाः demons, तत्रैव there itself, प्रहरन्ति strike at him.
explanation: If an evildoer or a sinner ascends the (Rishyamuka) mountain, he, in his sleep, will be thrown down with asleep by the demons from there itself. A sinner does not climb this mountain of uneven terrain.

shloka_text: नत्वेनं विषमाचार पापकर्माऽधिरोहति।।3.73.33।। यस्तु तं विषमाचारः पापकर्माऽधिरोहति। तत्रैव प्रहऱन्त्येनं सुप्तमादाय राक्षसाः।।3.73.34।।
transliteration: natvenaṃ viṣamācāra pāpakarmā'dhirohati yastu taṃ viṣamācāraḥ pāpakarmā'dhirohati| tatraiva prahaṟantyenaṃ suptamādāya rākṣasāḥ
translation: विषमाचारः a place of uneven terrain for movement, पापकर्मा sinner, एवम् so also, न अधिरोहति cannot ascend, विषमाचारः evil doer, पापकर्मा sinner, यः whoever, तम् him, अधिरोहति ascends, सुप्तम् when asleep, तम् him, आदाय taking, राक्षसाः demons, तत्रैव there itself, प्रहरन्ति strike at him.
explanation: If an evildoer or a sinner ascends the (Rishyamuka) mountain, he, in his sleep, will be thrown down with asleep by the demons from there itself. A sinner does not climb this mountain of uneven terrain.

shloka_text: तत्रापि शिशुनागानामाक्रन्धश्श्रूयते महान्। क्रीडतां राम पम्पायां मतङ्गारण्यवासिनाम्।।3.73.35।।
transliteration: tatrāpi śiśunāgānāmākrandhaśśrūyate mahān| krīḍatāṃ rāma pampāyāṃ mataṅgāraṇyavāsinām
translation: राम Rama, तत्रापि there also, पम्पायाम् at Pampa, क्रीडताम् sporting, मतङ्गारण्यवासिनाम् for those inhabiting sage Matanga's forest, शिशुनागानाम् for baby elphants, महान् great, आक्रन्द: roaring sound, श्रूयते will be heard.
explanation: O Rama, the trumpeting of the young playful elephants inhabiting sage Matanga's forest can be heard at Pampa.

shloka_text: सिक्ता रुधिरधाराभिस्संहृत्य परमद्विपाः। प्रचरन्ति पृथक्कीर्णा मेघवर्णास्तरस्विनः।।3.73.36।।
transliteration: siktā rudhiradhārābhissaṃhṛtya paramadvipāḥ| pracaranti pṛthakkīrṇā meghavarṇāstarasvinaḥ
translation: मेघवर्णाः like dark rainclouds, तरस्विनः swift, परमद्विपाः great elephants, संहृत्य drawn together, रुधिरधाराभिः streams of ichor(red in colour) flowing from their body, सिक्ताः are drenched, पृथक् separated, कीर्णाः scattered, प्रचरन्ति they wander.
explanation: The great, nimble elphants, dark like clouds, drenched with the flow of ichor come together and then separate and scatter.

shloka_text: ते तत्र पीत्वा पानीयं विमलं शीतमव्ययम्। निर्वृतास्संविगाहन्ते वनानि वनगोचराः।।3.73.37।।
transliteration: te tatra pītvā pānīyaṃ vimalaṃ śītamavyayam| nirvṛtāssaṃvigāhante vanāni vanagocarāḥ
translation: वनगोचराः wandering in the forest, ते they, विमलम् pure, शीतम् cool, अव्ययम् plenty, पानीयम् water, पीत्वा drinking, निर्वृताः contented, वनानि in the forest, (सं)विगाहन्ते plunge into.
explanation: The wandering elephants of the forest drink plentiful water, pure and cool, from Pampa and contented, plunge into the forest.

shloka_text: ऋक्षांश्च द्वीपिनश्चैव नीलकोमलकप्रभान्। रुरूनपेतापजयान् दृष्ट्वा शोकं जयिष्यसि।।3.73.38।।
transliteration: ṛkṣāṃśca dvīpinaścaiva nīlakomalakaprabhān| rurūnapetāpajayān dṛṣṭvā śokaṃ jayiṣyasi
translation: ऋक्षांश्च bears and, द्वीपिनश्चैव tigers, नीलकोमलकप्रभान् shining like sapphire, अपेतापजयान् that which have not met with defeat, रुरून् antelopes,दृष्ट्वा on seeing, शोकम् grief, जयिष्यसि will get over.
explanation: When you see, shining like sapphires, the bears, tigers, antelopes who know no defeat, you will get over your grief.

shloka_text: राम तस्य तु शैलस्य महती शोभते गुहा। शिलापिधाना काकुत्स्थ दुःखं चास्याः प्रवेशनम्।।3.73.39।।
transliteration: rāma tasya tu śailasya mahatī śobhate guhā| śilāpidhānā kākutstha duḥkhaṃ cāsyāḥ praveśanam
translation: काकुत्स्थ राम Rama of the Kakutstha family, तस्य शैलस्य of that mountain, शिलापिधाना covered with a slab, महती huge, गुहा cave, शोभते looks beautiful, अस्याः that cave's, प्रवेशनम्  entry, दुःखम् difficult.
explanation: O son of the Kakutstha family, there is a beautiful cave in that mountain covered with a slab of stone. It is difficult to enter.

shloka_text: तस्या गुहायाः प्राग्द्वारे महान्शीतोदको ह्रदः। फलमूलान्वितो रम्यो नानामृगसमावृतः।।3.73.40।।
transliteration: tasyā guhāyāḥ prāgdvāre mahānśītodako hradaḥ| phalamūlānvito ramyo nānāmṛgasamāvṛtaḥ
translation: तस्याः of that, गुहायाः cave's, प्राग्द्वारे at the eastern entrance, शीतोदकः one with cool water, फलमूलान्वीतः filled with fruits and roots, रम्यः delightful, नानामृगसमावृतः surrounded by different kinds of animals, महान् great, ह्रदः lake.
explanation: At the eastern entrance of the cave there is a cool watertank. On its bank teeming with various animals are delightful fruits and roots.

shloka_text: तस्यां वसति सुग्रीवश्चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः। कदाचिच्छिखरे तस्य पर्वतस्यावतिष्ठते।।3.73.41।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ vasati sugrīvaścaturbhissaha vānaraiḥ| kadācicchikhare tasya parvatasyāvatiṣṭhate
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, चतुर्भिः with four, वानरैः सह along with monkeys, तस्याम् in that cave, वसति  dwells, कदाचित् at times, तस्य पर्वतस्य the mountain's, शिखरे top, अवतिष्ठते stays.
explanation: Sugriva dwells in that cave with four other monkeys. At times he sits on the top of the mountain.

shloka_text: कबन्धस्त्वनुशास्यैवं तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। स्रग्वी भास्करवर्णाभः खे व्यरोचत वीर्यवान्।।3.73.42।।
transliteration: kabandhastvanuśāsyaivaṃ tāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau| sragvī bhāskaravarṇābhaḥ khe vyarocata vīryavān
translation: वीर्यवान् courageous, स्रग्वी wearing a flower garland, कबन्धस्तु Kabandha, तौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, उभौ both, एवम् in that way, अनुशास्य telling them, खे भास्करवर्णाभः like the colour of the Sun, व्यरोचत shone brightly.
explanation: Having instructed both Rama and Lakshmana, courageous Kabandha, wearing a flowergarland, shone brightly like the Sun in the sky.

shloka_text: तं तु खस्थं महाभागं कबन्धं रामलक्ष्मणौ। प्रस्थितौ त्वं व्रजस्वेति वाक्यमूचतुरन्तिके।।3.73.43।।
transliteration: taṃ tu khasthaṃ mahābhāgaṃ kabandhaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau| prasthitau tvaṃ vrajasveti vākyamūcaturantike
translation: प्रस्थितौ both set forth, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ both Rama and Lakshmana, अन्तिके gone near, खस्थम् he who stood in the sky, महाभागम् glorious, तं कबन्धम् that Kabandha, त्वम् you, व्रजस्व can go, इति thus, वाक्यम् words said, ऊचतुः both spoke.
explanation: Both Rama and Lakshmana, ready to depart, went near the glorious Kabandha waiting in the sky and said, You may go now.

shloka_text: गम्यतां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थमिति तावब्रवीत्स च। सुप्रीतौ तावनुज्ञाप्य कबन्धः प्रस्थितस्तदा।।3.73.44।।
transliteration: gamyatāṃ kāryasiddhyarthamiti tāvabravītsa ca| suprītau tāvanujñāpya kabandhaḥ prasthitastadā
translation: तदा then, प्रस्थितः set to go, सः कबन्धश्च that Kabandha, सुप्रीतौ both of them very pleased, तौ both, अनुज्ञाप्य took leave, कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थम् to accomplish the task, गम्यताम् you may depart, तौ both, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Then Kabandha said to the brothers satisfied, You may go now to accomplish your task. Then he took leave.

shloka_text: स तत्कबन्धः प्रतिपद्य रूपं वृतश्श्रिया भास्करतुल्यदेहः। निदर्शयन्राममवेक्ष्य खस्थः सख्यं कुरुष्वेति तदाभ्युवाच।।3.73.45।।
transliteration: sa tatkabandhaḥ pratipadya rūpaṃ vṛtaśśriyā bhāskaratulyadehaḥ| nidarśayanrāmamavekṣya khasthaḥ sakhyaṃ kuruṣveti tadābhyuvāca
translation: सः कबन्धः that Kabandha, तत् then, रूपम् his true form, प्रतिपद्य after attaining, श्रिया with radiance, वृतः surrounded, भास्करतुल्य देहः his body shining like the Sun, खस्थः from the sky, रामम् Rama, अवेक्ष्य seeing, निदर्शयन् while showing at, सख्यम् friendship, कुरुष्व  make, इति this, तदा then, उवाच said.
explanation: Kabandha assumed his true form, his body shining like the radiance of the Sun. He stood in the sky showing his form and looking at Rama, said, Make friendship with Sugriva. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे त्रिसप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventythird sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तौ कबन्धेन तं मार्गं पम्पाया दर्शितं वने। प्रतस्थतुर्दिशं गृह्य प्रतीचीं नृवरात्मजौ।।3.74.1।।
transliteration: tau kabandhena taṃ mārgaṃ pampāyā darśitaṃ vane| pratasthaturdiśaṃ gṛhya pratīcīṃ nṛvarātmajau
translation: तौ both, नृवरात्मजौ the two princes, वने in the forest, प्रतीचीं दिशम् western direction showed by, गृह्य took, कबन्धेन by Kabandha, दर्शितं shown by, तम् him, पम्पायाः Pampa's, मार्गम् way, प्रतस्थतुः both set out.
explanation: The two princes set forth in the western direction towards Pampa shown by Kabandha.
comments: Rama and Lakshmana visit  the hermitage of Sabari-- Sabari's hospitalitythey go round the forest and hermitage of sage Matanga-- Sabari casts her body into the fire and ascends to heaven.

shloka_text: तौ शैलेष्वाचितानेकान् क्षौद्रकल्पफलान्द्रुमान्। वीक्षन्तौ जग्मतुर्ध्रष्टुं सुग्रीवं रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.74.2।।
transliteration: tau śaileṣvācitānekān kṣaudrakalpaphalāndrumān| vīkṣantau jagmaturdhraṣṭuṃ sugrīvaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau
translation: तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, शैलेषु in the mountain, आचितान् loaded with, क्षौद्रकल्पफलान् honey like fruits, द्रुमान् trees, वीक्षन्तौ seeing, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, द्रष्टुम् to see, जग्मतुः both went.
explanation: Observing the trees loaded with honeysweet fruits on the mountain, Rama and Lakshmana   went to see Sugriva.

shloka_text: कृत्वा च शैलपृष्ठे तु तौ वासं रामलक्ष्मणौ। पम्पायाः पश्चिमं तीरं राघवावुपतस्थतुः।।3.74.3।।
transliteration: kṛtvā ca śailapṛṣṭhe tu tau vāsaṃ rāmalakṣmaṇau| pampāyāḥ paścimaṃ tīraṃ rāghavāvupatasthatuḥ
translation: राघवौ Rama, तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ both Rama and Lakshmana, शैलपृष्ठे on the slope of the mountain, वासम् stay, कृत्वा made, पम्पायाः Pampa's, पश्चिमं तीरम् western bank, उपतस्थतुः started on that path.
explanation: Rama and Lakshmana halted on the slope of the mountain and then departed for the western bank of Pampa.

shloka_text: तौ पुष्करिण्याः पम्पायास्तीरमासाद्य पश्चिमम्। अपश्यतां ततस्तत्र शबर्या रम्यमाश्रमम्।।3.74.4।।
transliteration: tau puṣkariṇyāḥ pampāyāstīramāsādya paścimam| apaśyatāṃ tatastatra śabaryā ramyamāśramam
translation: ततः then, तौ both, पम्पायाः Pampa, पुष्करिण्याः of the tank, पश्चिमम् western, तीरम्  bank, आसाद्य reached, तत्र there, शबर्याः of Sabari, रम्यम् delightful, आश्रमम् hermitage, अपश्यताम् observed.
explanation: Both reached the west bank of lake Pampa and saw the delightful hermitage of Sabari.

shloka_text: तौ तमाश्रममासाद्य द्रुमैर्बहुभीरावृतम्। सुरम्यमभिवीक्षन्तौ शबरीमभ्युपेयतुः।।3.74.5।।
transliteration: tau tamāśramamāsādya drumairbahubhīrāvṛtam| suramyamabhivīkṣantau śabarīmabhyupeyatuḥ
translation: तौ they both, तम् that, आश्रमम् hermitge, आसाद्य after reaching, बहुभिः with many, द्रुमैः with many trees, आवृतम् surrounded, सुरम्यम् very beautiful, अभिवीक्षन्तौ both looking at, शबरीम् Sabari's, अभ्युपेयतुः went towards.
explanation: Both reached the beautiful hermitage full of many kinds of trees. There they saw Sabari, and went towards her.

shloka_text: तौ च दृष्ट्वा तदा सिद्धा समुत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः। रामस्य पादौ जग्राह लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः।।3.74.6।।
transliteration: tau ca dṛṣṭvā tadā siddhā samutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ| rāmasya pādau jagrāha lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ
translation: तदा then, सिद्धा an accomplished ascetic, तौ both, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, कृताञ्जलिः joined palms and offered obeisance, समुत्थाय having got up, रामस्य Rama's, धीमतः sagacious, लक्ष्मणस्य च and Lakshmana's, पादौ feet, जग्राह held.
explanation: On seeing them both, Sabari, an accomplished ascetic, got up with folded hands and touched the feet of the sagacious Rama and Lakshmana.

shloka_text: पाद्यमाचमनीयं च सर्वं प्रादाद्यथाविधि। तामुवाच ततो रामश्श्रमणीं संशितव्रताम्।।3.74.7।।
transliteration: pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca sarvaṃ prādādyathāvidhi| tāmuvāca tato rāmaśśramaṇīṃ saṃśitavratām
translation: पाद्यम् water to wash feet, आचमनीयं च and water to sip, सर्वम् all, यथाविधि as per tradition, प्रादात् she offered, ततः then, संशितव्रताम्  doing penance, ताम् of yours, श्रमणीम् austere woman, रामः Rama, उवाच said:
explanation: She offered them water to wash their feet and water to sip as per tradition. Then Rama spoke to Sabari who used to perform austere penance:

shloka_text: कच्चित्ते निर्जिता विघ्नाः कच्चित्ते वर्धते तपः। कच्चित्ते नियतः क्रोध आहारश्च तपोधने।।3.74.8।।
transliteration: kaccitte nirjitā vighnāḥ kaccitte vardhate tapaḥ| kaccitte niyataḥ krodha āhāraśca tapodhane
translation: तपोधने  endowed with the wealth of penance(the ascetic), ते your, विघ्नाः obstacles, निर्जिताः कच्चित् hope you have overcome, ते your, तपः penance, वर्धते कच्चित्  progressing indeed, ते your, क्रोधः anger, आहारश्च desire for food, नियतः कच्चित् is controlled indeed?
explanation: O ascetic   hope you have overcome your obstacles to penance, you have controlled your anger and your desire for food. Is your austerity in progress.

shloka_text: कच्चित्ते नियमाः प्राप्ताः कच्चित्ते मनसः सुखम्। कच्चित्ते गुरुशुश्रूषा सफला चारुभाषिणि।।3.74.9।।
transliteration: kaccitte niyamāḥ prāptāḥ kaccitte manasaḥ sukham| kaccitte guruśuśrūṣā saphalā cārubhāṣiṇi
translation: चारुभाषिणि sweettongued, ते you, नियमाः selfcontrol, प्राप्ताः कच्चित् have you attained , ते your, मनसः mind, सुखं कच्चित् attained peace, ते your, गुरुशुश्रूषा serving the preceptor, सफला कच्चित् has yielded results?
explanation: O Sweettongued Sabari, have you achieved selfcontrol? Has your mind attained peace ? Have your services to the preceptor yielded results?

shloka_text: रामेण तापसी पृष्टा सा सिद्धा सिद्धसम्मता। शशंस शबरी वृद्धा रामाय प्रत्युपस्थिता।।3.74.10।।
transliteration: rāmeṇa tāpasī pṛṣṭā sā siddhā siddhasammatā| śaśaṃsa śabarī vṛddhā rāmāya pratyupasthitā
translation: रामेण by Rama, पृष्टा enquired, सिद्धा an accomplished ascetic, सिद्धसम्मता a lady adored and accepted by siddhas, तापसी ascetic, वृद्धा old woman, सा शबरी that Sabari, प्रत्युपस्थिता standing in front, रामाय to Rama, शशंस she spoke.
explanation: When Rama asked Sabari who was an old, accomplished ascetic adored by siddhas, she stood in front and replied :

shloka_text: अद्य प्राप्ता तपस्सिद्धिस्तव संदर्शनान्मया। अद्य मे सफलं तप्तं गुरवश्च सुपूजिताः।।3.74.11।।
transliteration: adya prāptā tapassiddhistava saṃdarśanānmayā| adya me saphalaṃ taptaṃ guravaśca supūjitāḥ
translation: अद्य now, तव your, संदर्शनात् by seeing you, मया by me, तपस्सिद्धि: fulfilment of my penance, प्राप्ता is attained, अद्य now, मे my, तप्तम् penance, सफलम् successful, गुरवश्च preceptors, सुपूजिता: have been honoured.
explanation: On seeing you now my penance has attained fulfilment, my services to my preceptors have borne fruit.

shloka_text: अद्य मे सफलं जन्म स्वर्गश्चैव भविष्यति। त्वयि देववरे राम पूजिते पुरुषर्षभ।।3.74.12।।
transliteration: adya me saphalaṃ janma svargaścaiva bhaviṣyati| tvayi devavare rāma pūjite puruṣarṣabha
translation: पुरुषर्षभ best  of men, देववरे best among  gods, त्वयि when you, पूजिते worshipped, अद्य now, मे my, जन्म birth, सफलम् fruitful, स्वर्गश्चैव even heaven, भविष्यति is certain.
explanation: O best of men, O highest of the gods my birth has become fruitful today with your worship, (you have made) even attainment of heaven quite certain.

shloka_text: चक्षुषा तव सौम्येन पूतास्मि रघुनन्दन। गमिष्याम्यक्षयान्लोकांस्त्वत्प्रसादादरिन्दम।।3.74.13।।
transliteration: cakṣuṣā tava saumyena pūtāsmi raghunandana| gamiṣyāmyakṣayānlokāṃstvatprasādādarindama
translation: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, तव your, सौम्येन by your handsome, चक्षुषा looks, पूता  sanctified, अस्मि I am, अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, त्वत्प्रसादात् by your grace, अक्षयान् imperishable, लोकान् worlds, गमिष्यामि I will reach.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, your handsome look has sanctified me, O subduer of enemies, by your grace I will reach the inmperishable worlds.

shloka_text: चित्रकूटं त्वयि प्राप्ते विमानैरतुलप्रभैः। इतस्ते दिवमारूढा यानहं पर्यचारिषम्।।3.74.14।।
transliteration: citrakūṭaṃ tvayi prāpte vimānairatulaprabhaiḥ| itaste divamārūḍhā yānahaṃ paryacāriṣam
translation: अहम् I, यान् those men, पर्यचारिषम् I have served, ते they, त्वयि when you, चित्रकूटम् Chitrakutam, प्राप्ते arrived, अतुलप्रभैः with incomparable radiance, विमानैः with aerial chariots, इतः from here, दिवम् to heaven, आरूढाः I will reach.
explanation: The men I served have ascended heaven on aerial chariots of incomparable radiance the moment you touched Chitrakuta.

shloka_text: तैश्चाहमुक्ता धर्मज्ञैर्महाभागैर्महर्षिभिः। आगमिष्यति ते रामस्सुपुण्यमिममाश्रमम्।।3.74.15।। स ते प्रतिग्रहीतव्यस्सौमित्रिसहितोतिथिः। तं च दृष्ट्वा वरान्लोकानक्षयांस्त्वं गमिष्यसि।।3.74.16।।
transliteration: taiścāhamuktā dharmajñairmahābhāgairmaharṣibhiḥ| āgamiṣyati te rāmassupuṇyamimamāśramam sa te pratigrahītavyassaumitrisahitotithiḥ| taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā varānlokānakṣayāṃstvaṃ gamiṣyasi
translation: धर्मज्ञैः by knowers of rigteousness, महाभागैः by the honourable, तैः महर्षिभिः by those great seers, अहम् I, उक्ता have been told, रामः Rama, ते your, सुपुण्यम् very sacred, इमम् आश्रमम् this hermitage, अगमिष्यति will come, सौमित्रिसहितः along with Saumitri, सः he, ते for you, अतिथिः guest, प्रतिग्रहीतव्यः receive with due reverence, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, त्वम् you, वरान् great, अक्षयान् inexhaustible, लोकान् worlds, गमिष्यसि you will go,
explanation: Those great honourable sages who knew the ways of dharma said: 'Rama would visit this sacred hermitage along with Lakshmana. He would be your guest. Receive him with due honour. And you would attain the great, inexhaustible worlds when you see him.'

shloka_text: तैश्चाहमुक्ता धर्मज्ञैर्महाभागैर्महर्षिभिः। आगमिष्यति ते रामस्सुपुण्यमिममाश्रमम्।।3.74.15।। स ते प्रतिग्रहीतव्यस्सौमित्रिसहितोतिथिः। तं च दृष्ट्वा वरान्लोकानक्षयांस्त्वं गमिष्यसि।।3.74.16।।
transliteration: taiścāhamuktā dharmajñairmahābhāgairmaharṣibhiḥ| āgamiṣyati te rāmassupuṇyamimamāśramam sa te pratigrahītavyassaumitrisahitotithiḥ| taṃ ca dṛṣṭvā varānlokānakṣayāṃstvaṃ gamiṣyasi
translation: धर्मज्ञैः by knowers of rigteousness, महाभागैः by the honourable, तैः महर्षिभिः by those great seers, अहम् I, उक्ता have been told, रामः Rama, ते your, सुपुण्यम् very sacred, इमम् आश्रमम् this hermitage, अगमिष्यति will come, सौमित्रिसहितः along with Saumitri, सः he, ते for you, अतिथिः guest, प्रतिग्रहीतव्यः receive with due reverence, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, त्वम् you, वरान् great, अक्षयान् inexhaustible, लोकान् worlds, गमिष्यसि you will go,
explanation: Those great honourable sages who knew the ways of dharma said: 'Rama would visit this sacred hermitage along with Lakshmana. He would be your guest. Receive him with due honour. And you would attain the great, inexhaustible worlds when you see him.'

shloka_text: मया तु विविधं वन्यं सञ्चितं पुरुषर्षभ। तवार्थे पुरुषव्याघ्र पम्पायास्तीरसम्भवम्।।3.74.17।।
transliteration: mayā tu vividhaṃ vanyaṃ sañcitaṃ puruṣarṣabha| tavārthe puruṣavyāghra pampāyāstīrasambhavam
translation: पुरुषव्याघ्र O best among men, (रघुनन्दन delight of the Raghus), मया by me, तव अर्थे for your sake, पम्पायाः Pampa's, तीरसम्भवम् grown on the bank, विविधम् many kinds, वन्यम्   forestfood, सञ्चितम् collected.
explanation: O best among men I have collected and kept for your sake different kinds of forestfood grown on the bank of Pampa.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्स धर्मात्मा शबर्या शबरीमिदम्। राघवः प्राह विज्ञाने तां नित्यमबहिष्कृताम्।।3.74.18।।
transliteration: evamuktassa dharmātmā śabaryā śabarīmidam| rāghavaḥ prāha vijñāne tāṃ nityamabahiṣkṛtām
translation: शबर्या by Sabari, एवम् in that way, उक्तः addressed, धर्मात्मा righteous, सः राघवः that Rama, नित्यम् always, विज्ञाने in knowledge, अबहिष्क्रताम् not kept away, तां शबरीम् that Sabari, प्राह he said.
explanation: Entreated by her in that manner, the righteous Rama spoke to Sabari who was established in true knowledge:

shloka_text: दनोस्सकाशात्तत्त्वेन प्रभावं ते महात्मनः। श्रुतं प्रत्यक्षमिच्छामि सन्द्रष्टुं यदि मन्यसे।।3.74.19।।
transliteration: danossakāśāttattvena prabhāvaṃ te mahātmanaḥ| śrutaṃ pratyakṣamicchāmi sandraṣṭuṃ yadi manyase
translation: महात्मनः by the great self, दनोः सकाशात् from Danu, श्रुतम् heard, ते your, प्रभावम् power, मन्यसे यदि if you think so, प्रत्यक्षम् directly, (सं)द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I desire.
explanation: I have heard from great Danu about your power. If you agree, I would like to see this power in person.

shloka_text: एतत्तु वचनं श्रुत्ता रामवक्त्राद्विनिस्सृतम्। शबरी दर्शयामास तावुभौ तद्वनं महत्।।3.74.20।।
transliteration: etattu vacanaṃ śruttā rāmavaktrādvinissṛtam| śabarī darśayāmāsa tāvubhau tadvanaṃ mahat
translation: शबरी Sabari, रामवक्त्रात् from Rama's mouth, विनिस्सृतम् released, एतत् this, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा on hearing, तौ उभौ both of them, महत् great, तत् that, वनम् garden, दर्शयामास started showing.
explanation: At these words from the mouth of Rama, Sabari took them both round the great garden.

shloka_text: पश्य मेघघनप्रख्यं मृगपक्षिसमाकुलम्। मतङ्गवनमित्येव विश्रुतं रघुनन्दन।।।3.74.21।।
transliteration: paśya meghaghanaprakhyaṃ mṛgapakṣisamākulam| mataṅgavanamityeva viśrutaṃ raghunandana|
translation: रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, मेघघनप्रख्यम् looking like the dense cloud, मृगपक्षिसमाकुलम् filled with animals and birds, मतङ्गवनमित्येव known as Matanga garden, विश्रुतम् popular, पश्य see.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus see this garden looking like the dense cloud. Full of animals and birds, it is popularly known as Matanga garden.

shloka_text: इह ते भावितात्मानो गुरवो मे महावने। जुहवाञ्चक्रिरे तीर्थं मन्त्रवन्मन्त्रपूजितम्।।3.74.22।।
transliteration: iha te bhāvitātmāno guravo me mahāvane| juhavāñcakrire tīrthaṃ mantravanmantrapūjitam
translation: महावने in this great garden, भावितात्मानः who perceived the supreme spirit, ते they, मे गुरुवः my preceptors, इह here, मन्त्रवत् by the power of mantras, मन्त्रपूजितम् invoked by mantras, तीर्थम् waters, जुहवाञ्चक्रिरे  performed  sacrifice.
explanation: My precepters, who had perceived the Supreme Spirit made sacrificial offerings in this great garden, invoked gods through the power of mantras. They brought water and offered oblations to the sacrificial fire.

shloka_text: इयं प्रत्यक्थ्सली वेदिर्यत्र ते मे सुसत्कृताः। पुष्पोपहारं कुर्वन्ति श्रमादुद्वेपिभिः करैः।।3.74.23।।
transliteration: iyaṃ pratyakthsalī vediryatra te me susatkṛtāḥ| puṣpopahāraṃ kurvanti śramādudvepibhiḥ karaiḥ
translation: मे my, सुसत्कृताः revered ones, ते they, यत्र where, श्रमात्  exhausted, उद्वेपिभिः करैः did with trembling hands, पुष्पोवहारम् offering flowers for worship, कुर्वन्ति make, प्रत्यक्थ्सली वेदिः altar knows as Pratyaksthali, इयम् this is.
explanation: This is the altar named Pratyaksthali where the saints aged and exhausted( by performing chandrayana) whom I worshipped made offerings of flowers with trembling hands.

shloka_text: तेषां तपःप्रभावेण पश्याद्यापि रघूद्वह। द्योतयन्ति दिशस्सर्वाश्श्रिया वेद्योऽतुलप्रभाः।।3.74.24।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ tapaḥprabhāveṇa paśyādyāpi raghūdvaha| dyotayanti diśassarvāśśriyā vedyo'tulaprabhāḥ
translation: रघूद्वह O Rama, तेषाम् their, तपःप्रभावेण by the power of their penance, अतुलप्रभाः matchless brilliance, वेद्यः altars, श्रिया with glow, अद्यापि even today, सर्वाः all, दिशः directions, द्योतयन्ति filling with light, पश्य see.
explanation: O Rama see, even now they illuminate the sacrificial altars with the power of their penance. They shed light in all directions with a matchless brilliance.

shloka_text: अशक्नुवद्भिस्तैर्गन्तुमुपवासश्रमालसैः। चिन्तितेऽभ्यागतान्पश्य सहितान्सप्तसागरान्।।3.74.25।।
transliteration: aśaknuvadbhistairgantumupavāsaśramālasaiḥ| cintite'bhyāgatānpaśya sahitānsaptasāgarān
translation: उपवासश्रमालसैः weariness due to fasting, गन्तुम् to move about, अशक्नुवद्भिः having no energy, तैः by them, चिन्तिते by mere thought, अभ्यागतान् came towards, सहितान् all together, सप्तसागरान् all the seven seas, पश्य see.
explanation: Look at the seven seas, which have reached here at their mere thought as they could not reach them due to fatigue from fasting.

shloka_text: कृताभिषेकैस्तैर्न्यस्ता वल्कलाः पादपेष्विह। अद्यापि नावशुष्यन्ति प्रदेशे रघुनन्दन।।3.74.26।।
transliteration: kṛtābhiṣekaistairnyastā valkalāḥ pādapeṣviha| adyāpi nāvaśuṣyanti pradeśe raghunandana
translation: रघुनन्दन delight of the Raghus, इह here, कृताभिषेकैः  after bathing, तै: by them, प्रदेशे place, पादपेषु on the trees, न्यस्ताः laid to dry, वल्कलाः bark clothes, अद्यापि even now, न अवशुष्यन्ति do not get dry still.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus  look at the bark robes spread on the trees to dry after their bathing which are still wet.

shloka_text: देवकार्याणि कुर्वद्भिर्यानीमानि कृतानि वै। पुष्पैःकुवलयैस्सार्धं म्लानत्वं नोपयान्तिवै।।3.74.27।।
transliteration: devakāryāṇi kurvadbhiryānīmāni kṛtāni vai| puṣpaiḥkuvalayaissārdhaṃ mlānatvaṃ nopayāntivai
translation: देवकार्याणि for the worship of gods, कुर्वद्भि: they offered, कुवलयैःसार्धम् along with lotuses  and others, पुष्पैः with flowers, यानि all those, कृतानि arranged, इमानि all these, म्लानत्वम् wilted, नोपयान्ति वै do not attain.
explanation: The flowers including lotuses offered by the sages while worshipping gods have not yet wilted.

shloka_text: कृत्स्नं वनमिदं दृष्टं श्रोतव्यं च श्रुतं त्वया। तदिच्छाम्यभ्यनुज्ञाता त्यक्तुमेतत्कलेबरम्।।3.74.28।।
transliteration: kṛtsnaṃ vanamidaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ śrotavyaṃ ca śrutaṃ tvayā| tadicchāmyabhyanujñātā tyaktumetatkalebaram
translation: त्वया by you, कृत्स्नम् entirely, इदं वनम् this garden, दृष्टम् is seen, श्रोतव्यम् to be heard, श्रुतं च it is heard, तत् that, अभ्यनुज्ञाता with your permission, एतत् this, कलेबरम् body, त्यक्तुम् to give up, इच्छामि I desire to.
explanation: You have seen the entire garden and have listened what is to be heard. With your permission I would like to give up this body.

shloka_text: तेषामिच्छाम्यहं गन्तुं समीपं भावितात्मनाम्। मुनीनामाश्रमो येषामहं च परिचारिणी।।3.74.29।।
transliteration: teṣāmicchāmyahaṃ gantuṃ samīpaṃ bhāvitātmanām| munīnāmāśramo yeṣāmahaṃ ca paricāriṇī
translation: आश्रमः hermitage, येषां मुनीनाम् of  those seers (to whom this hermitage belongs), अहं च I, परिचारिणी I am a servant, भावितात्मनाम् realisers of supreme spirit, तेषाम् their, समीपम् near, गन्तुम् to go, इच्छामि I desire.
explanation: I wish to reach those realisers of the Supreme Spirit whom I served and to whom this hermitage belonged.

shloka_text: धर्मिष्ठं तु वचश्श्रुत्वा राघवस्सहलक्ष्मणः। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे आश्चर्यमिति तत्त्वतः।।3.74.30।।
transliteration: dharmiṣṭhaṃ tu vacaśśrutvā rāghavassahalakṣmaṇaḥ| praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe āścaryamiti tattvataḥ
translation: सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, राघवः Rama, धर्मिष्ठम् dedicated to dharma, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तत्त्वतः truly, आश्चर्यम् wonderful, इति thus, अतुलम् incomparable, प्रहर्षम् happiness, लेभे attained.
explanation: Rama and Lakshmana on hearing the pious words of Savari joyfully exclaimed, This is really wonderful.

shloka_text: तामुवाच ततो रामश्श्रमणीं संशितव्रताम्। अर्चितोऽहं त्वया भक्त्या गच्छकामं यथासुखम्।।3.74.31।।
transliteration: tāmuvāca tato rāmaśśramaṇīṃ saṃśitavratām| arcito'haṃ tvayā bhaktyā gacchakāmaṃ yathāsukham
translation: ततः then, रामः Rama,संशितव्रताम् determined in her vow, श्रमणीम् female ascetic, उवाच said, अहम् I, त्वया by you, भक्त्या devotion, अर्चितः worshipped, कामम् verily indeed, यथासुखम् with pleasure, गच्छ you may go.
explanation: Looking at Sabari who was steadfast in her vow, Rama said, O ascetic, you have worshipped me with devotion. You may go wherever you like (to the world you desire)

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता जटिला वृद्धा चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरा। तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते शबरी देहं जीर्णं जिहासती।।3.74.32।। अनुज्ञाता तु रामेण हुत्वात्मानं हुताशने। ज्वलत्पावकसङ्काशा स्वर्गमेव जगाम सा।।3.74.33।।
transliteration: ityuktā jaṭilā vṛddhā cīrakṛṣṇājināmbarā| tasminmuhūrte śabarī dehaṃ jīrṇaṃ jihāsatī anujñātā tu rāmeṇa hutvātmānaṃ hutāśane| jvalatpāvakasaṅkāśā svargameva jagāma sā
translation: इति this, उक्ता was said, जटिला a woman of matted locks, वृद्धा old, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरा woman wearing tattered bark clothes and deer skin, शबरी Sabari, जीर्णम् emaciated, देहम् body, तस्मिन् मूहूर्ते at that moment, जिहासती desiring to give up, रामेण by Rama, अनुज्ञाता permitted, आत्मानम् herself, हुताशने in fire, हुत्वा after offering, ज्वलत्पावकसङ्काशा body glittering like fire, स्वर्गमेव to heaven, जगाम went.
explanation: With matted locks, tattered bark clothes and deer skin, Sabari consigned her old and emaciated body to the fire at that moment, with the permission of Rama and ascended to heaven, her body glowing like fire.

shloka_text: इत्युक्ता जटिला वृद्धा चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरा। तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते शबरी देहं जीर्णं जिहासती।।3.74.32।। अनुज्ञाता तु रामेण हुत्वात्मानं हुताशने। ज्वलत्पावकसङ्काशा स्वर्गमेव जगाम सा।।3.74.33।।
transliteration: ityuktā jaṭilā vṛddhā cīrakṛṣṇājināmbarā| tasminmuhūrte śabarī dehaṃ jīrṇaṃ jihāsatī anujñātā tu rāmeṇa hutvātmānaṃ hutāśane| jvalatpāvakasaṅkāśā svargameva jagāma sā
translation: इति this, उक्ता was said, जटिला a woman of matted locks, वृद्धा old, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरा woman wearing tattered bark clothes and deer skin, शबरी Sabari, जीर्णम् emaciated, देहम् body, तस्मिन् मूहूर्ते at that moment, जिहासती desiring to give up, रामेण by Rama, अनुज्ञाता permitted, आत्मानम् herself, हुताशने in fire, हुत्वा after offering, ज्वलत्पावकसङ्काशा body glittering like fire, स्वर्गमेव to heaven, जगाम went.
explanation: With matted locks, tattered bark clothes and deer skin, Sabari consigned her old and emaciated body to the fire at that moment, with the permission of Rama and ascended to heaven, her body glowing like fire.

shloka_text: दिव्याभरणसंयुक्ता दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपना। दिव्याम्बरधरा तत्र बभूव प्रियदर्शना।।3.74.34।। विराजयन्ती तं देशं विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा।
transliteration: divyābharaṇasaṃyuktā divyamālyānulepanā| divyāmbaradharā tatra babhūva priyadarśanā virājayantī taṃ deśaṃ vidyutsaudāminī yathā|
translation: दिव्याभरणसंयुक्ता adorned with wonderful ornaments, दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपना wearing beautiful garlands and anointed with fragrant unguents, दिव्याम्बरधरा robed in most wonderful clothes, विद्युत् सौदामनी यथा like a streak of lightning, तं देशम् that place, विराजयन्ती illuminating, तत्र there, प्रियदर्शना pleasing appearance, बभूव appeared.
explanation: Adorned with wonderful ornaments and beautiful garlands, anointed with fragrant unguents, robed in most beautiful clothes, she appeared like a streak of lightning, her body shining bright and her face contented.

shloka_text: यत्र ते सुकृतात्मानो विहरन्ति महर्षयः।।3.74.35।। तत्पुण्यं शबरी स्थानं जगामात्मसमाधिना।
transliteration: yatra te sukṛtātmāno viharanti maharṣayaḥ tatpuṇyaṃ śabarī sthānaṃ jagāmātmasamādhinā|
translation: शबरी Sabari, आत्मसमाधिना her meditation, सुकृतात्मानः who did good deeds, ते महर्षयः the great sages, यत्र where, विहरन्ति  moved, तत् that, पुण्यम् sacred, स्थानम् holy place, जगाम went.
explanation: By virtue of her selfmeditation, Sabari went to that sacred world where the holy sages lived because of their good deeds. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfourth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: दिवं तु तस्यां यातायां शबर्यां स्वेन तेजसा। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा चिन्तयामास राघवः।।3.75.1।।
transliteration: divaṃ tu tasyāṃ yātāyāṃ śabaryāṃ svena tejasā| lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā cintayāmāsa rāghavaḥ
translation: तस्याम् when she, शबर्याम् Sabari, स्वेन तेजसा by her own brilliance, दिवम् heavens, यातायाम् on departing, राघवः Rama, भ्रात्रा with his brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह with Lakshmana, चिन्तयामास contemplated.
explanation: When Sabari departed for heaven with her brilliance, Rama  contemplated (about the power of sages)with Lakshmana.
comments: Rama and Lakshmana reach Pampa-- admire the beautiful nature on the banks of Pampa.

shloka_text: स चिन्तयित्वा धर्मात्मा प्रभावं तं महात्मनाम्। हितकारिणमेकाग्रं लक्ष्मणं राघवोऽब्रवीत्।।3.75.2।।
transliteration: sa cintayitvā dharmātmā prabhāvaṃ taṃ mahātmanām| hitakāriṇamekāgraṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ rāghavo'bravīt
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous, सः राघवः Rama, महात्मनाम् of great sages, प्रभावम् power, चिन्तयित्वा  on thinking over, हितकारिणम् his wellwisher, एकाग्रम् with singleminded devotion, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Thinking about the power of the great sages, righteous Rama said to Lakshmana,  his wellwisher with singleminded devotion:

shloka_text: दृष्टोऽयमाश्रमस्सौम्य बह्वाश्चर्यो महात्मनाम्। विश्वस्तमृगशार्दूलो नानाविहगसेवितः।।3.75.3।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭo'yamāśramassaumya bahvāścaryo mahātmanām| viśvastamṛgaśārdūlo nānāvihagasevitaḥ
translation: सौम्य O handsome one  महात्मनाम् of the great sages, बह्वाश्चर्यः very wonderful, विश्वस्तमृगशार्दूलः deer and tigers live together with implicit faith, नानाविहगसेवितः where birds of all kinds dwell, अयम् आश्रमः this hermitage, दृष्टः seen.
explanation: O handsome one, we have seen this highly wonderful hermitage, where deer and tigers dwell together with mutual confidence, where birds of all kinds inhabit.

shloka_text: सप्तानां च समुद्राणामेषु तीर्थेषु लक्ष्मण। उपस्पृष्टं च विधिवत्पितरश्चापि तर्पिताः।।3.75.4।।
transliteration: saptānāṃ ca samudrāṇāmeṣu tīrtheṣu lakṣmaṇa| upaspṛṣṭaṃ ca vidhivatpitaraścāpi tarpitāḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सप्तानाम् of seven, समुद्राणाम् of seas, एषु तीर्थेषु in these waters, उपस्पृष्टम् having bathed, पितरश्चापि oblations to forefathers, विधिवत् in accordance with tradition, तर्पिताः have been invoked with offering.
explanation: O Lakshmana, having bathed in the waters of the seven seas (by taking ritualistic bath in these waters) the manes are offered oblations in accordance with tradition.

shloka_text: प्रणष्टमशुभं तत्तत्कल्याणं समुपस्थितम्। तेन तत्त्वेन हृष्टं मे मनो लक्ष्मण सम्प्रति।।3.75.5।। हृदये हि नरव्याघ्र शुभमाविर्भविष्यति।
transliteration: praṇaṣṭamaśubhaṃ tattatkalyāṇaṃ samupasthitam| tena tattvena hṛṣṭaṃ me mano lakṣmaṇa samprati hṛdaye hi naravyāghra śubhamāvirbhaviṣyati|
translation: अशुभम् inauspicious time, प्रणष्टम् is got rid of, तत्तत् respectively, कल्याणम् auspicious tidings, समुपस्थितम् have reached, लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, तेन therefore, तत्त्वेन truly, सम्प्रति presently, मनः mind, हृष्टम् happy, नरव्याघ्र O best among men, हृदये at heart, शुभम्  good fortune, आविर्भविष्यति हि will appear now.
explanation: We have got rid of inauspicious time and good days have come. Therefore, I feel truly happy. Good fortune will appear (now), O Lakshmana, O tiger among men

shloka_text: तदागच्छ गमिष्यामि पम्पां तां प्रियदर्शनाम्।।3.75.6।। ऋष्यमूको गिरिर्यत्र नातिदूरे प्रकाशते। यस्मिन्वसति धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवोंऽशुमतस्सुतः।।3.75.7।। नित्यं वालिभयात्त्रस्तश्चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः।
transliteration: tadāgaccha gamiṣyāmi pampāṃ tāṃ priyadarśanām ṛṣyamūko giriryatra nātidūre prakāśate| yasminvasati dharmātmā sugrīvoṃ'śumatassutaḥ nityaṃ vālibhayāttrastaścaturbhissaha vānaraiḥ|
translation: तत् therefore, धर्मात्मा the righteous soul, अंशुमतः सुतः son of the Sun, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, नित्यम् ever, वालिभयात् by the fear of Vali, चतुर्भिः with four, वानरैः सह along with monkeys, यस्मिन् in which, वसति stay, ऋष्यमूक: Rishyamuka, यत्र there, नातिदूरे not very far away, प्रकाशते  shines, ताम् that, प्रियदर्शनाम् pleasing to look at, पम्पाम् Pampa, गमिष्यामि I will go, आगच्छ you may come along.
explanation: Come, let us go to Pampa, which is pleasing to look at. Sugriva, the rigteous self, the son of the Sun has been staying for fear of Vali at the shining Rishyamuka, not far from here.

shloka_text: तदागच्छ गमिष्यामि पम्पां तां प्रियदर्शनाम्।।3.75.6।। ऋष्यमूको गिरिर्यत्र नातिदूरे प्रकाशते। यस्मिन्वसति धर्मात्मा सुग्रीवोंऽशुमतस्सुतः।।3.75.7।। नित्यं वालिभयात्त्रस्तश्चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः।
transliteration: tadāgaccha gamiṣyāmi pampāṃ tāṃ priyadarśanām ṛṣyamūko giriryatra nātidūre prakāśate| yasminvasati dharmātmā sugrīvoṃ'śumatassutaḥ nityaṃ vālibhayāttrastaścaturbhissaha vānaraiḥ|
translation: तत् therefore, धर्मात्मा the righteous soul, अंशुमतः सुतः son of the Sun, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, नित्यम् ever, वालिभयात् by the fear of Vali, चतुर्भिः with four, वानरैः सह along with monkeys, यस्मिन् in which, वसति stay, ऋष्यमूक: Rishyamuka, यत्र there, नातिदूरे not very far away, प्रकाशते  shines, ताम् that, प्रियदर्शनाम् pleasing to look at, पम्पाम् Pampa, गमिष्यामि I will go, आगच्छ you may come along.
explanation: Come, let us go to Pampa, which is pleasing to look at. Sugriva, the rigteous self, the son of the Sun has been staying for fear of Vali at the shining Rishyamuka, not far from here.

shloka_text: अभित्वरे च तं द्रष्टुं सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम्।।3.75.8।। तदधीनं हि मे सौम्य सीतायाः परिमार्गणम्।
transliteration: abhitvare ca taṃ draṣṭuṃ sugrīvaṃ vānararṣabham tadadhīnaṃ hi me saumya sītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam|
translation: सौम्य O handsome one, वानरर्षभम् mighty among the monkeys, तं सुग्रीवम् that Sugriva, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभित्वरे च I am in haste, सीतायाः of Sita, परिमार्गणम् searching, तदधीनम् depends on him.
explanation: I am hastening to see that noble Sugriva the mighty monkey, as the search for Sita depends on him, O handsome one

shloka_text: एवं ब्रुवाणं तं धीरं रामं सौमित्रिरब्रवीत्।।3.75.9।। गच्छावस्त्वरितं तत्र ममापि त्वरते मनः।
transliteration: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ taṃ dhīraṃ rāmaṃ saumitrirabravīt gacchāvastvaritaṃ tatra mamāpi tvarate manaḥ|
translation: एवम् in that way, ब्रुवाणम् as he spoke, धीरम् stableminded one, तं रामम् to that Rama, सौमित्रिः Soumitri, अब्रवीत् said, मम my, मनः आपि mind also, त्वरते hurrying, त्वरितम् quickly, तत्र there, गच्छावः we both will go.
explanation: To the words of Rama who was of stable mind, Lakshmana replied : My mind too is hastening me. Let us get there quickly.

shloka_text: आश्रमात्तु तत स्तस्मान्निष्क्रम्य स विशाम्पतिः।।3.75.10।। आजगाम ततः पम्पां लक्ष्मणेन सह प्रभुः।
transliteration: āśramāttu tata stasmānniṣkramya sa viśāmpatiḥ ājagāma tataḥ pampāṃ lakṣmaṇena saha prabhuḥ|
translation: ततः then, विशाम्पतिः lord of men, सः he, प्रभुः lord, तस्मात् from that, आश्रमात् from that hermitage, निष्क्रम्य on departing , ततः then, लक्ष्मणेन सह with Lakshmana, पम्पाम् to Pampa, आजगाम went.
explanation: Then Rama the lord of men along with Lakshmana departed from the hermitage and went to Pampa.

shloka_text: स ददर्श ततः पुण्यामुदारजनसेविताम्।।3.75.11।। नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णां पम्पां पानीयवाहिनीम्। पद्मैस्सौगन्धिकैस्ताम्रां शुक्लां कुमुदमण्डलैः।।3.75.12।। नीलां कुवलयोद्घाटैर्बहुवर्णां कुथामिव।
transliteration: sa dadarśa tataḥ puṇyāmudārajanasevitām nānādrumalatākīrṇāṃ pampāṃ pānīyavāhinīm| padmaissaugandhikaistāmrāṃ śuklāṃ kumudamaṇḍalaiḥ nīlāṃ kuvalayodghāṭairbahuvarṇāṃ kuthāmiva|
translation: ततः then, सः he, पुण्याम् that sacred, उदारजनसेविताम् the place where exalted seers lived, नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णाम्  abounding in different kinds of trees and creepers, पानीयवाहिनीम् with flow of waters, सौगन्धिकैः sweetscented, पद्मैः lotuses, ताम्राम् red, कुमुदमण्डलैः with clusters of lilies, शुक्लाम् white, कुवलयोद्घाटैः with blue waterlilies, नीलाम् blue lotuses, बहुवर्णाम् with variegated colours, कुथामिव like a carpet, पम्पाम् Pampa lake, ददर्श saw.
explanation: He saw the sacred lake Pampa whose sweet flow of water was used by great seers. It abounded in trees and creepers. Its surface was red with lotuses at one place, white with clusters of lilies at another and with blue lotuses at other places. As such, it looked like a carpet with variegated colours.

shloka_text: स ददर्श ततः पुण्यामुदारजनसेविताम्।।3.75.11।। नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णां पम्पां पानीयवाहिनीम्। पद्मैस्सौगन्धिकैस्ताम्रां शुक्लां कुमुदमण्डलैः।।3.75.12।। नीलां कुवलयोद्घाटैर्बहुवर्णां कुथामिव।
transliteration: sa dadarśa tataḥ puṇyāmudārajanasevitām nānādrumalatākīrṇāṃ pampāṃ pānīyavāhinīm| padmaissaugandhikaistāmrāṃ śuklāṃ kumudamaṇḍalaiḥ nīlāṃ kuvalayodghāṭairbahuvarṇāṃ kuthāmiva|
translation: ततः then, सः he, पुण्याम् that sacred, उदारजनसेविताम् the place where exalted seers lived, नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णाम्  abounding in different kinds of trees and creepers, पानीयवाहिनीम् with flow of waters, सौगन्धिकैः sweetscented, पद्मैः lotuses, ताम्राम् red, कुमुदमण्डलैः with clusters of lilies, शुक्लाम् white, कुवलयोद्घाटैः with blue waterlilies, नीलाम् blue lotuses, बहुवर्णाम् with variegated colours, कुथामिव like a carpet, पम्पाम् Pampa lake, ददर्श saw.
explanation: He saw the sacred lake Pampa whose sweet flow of water was used by great seers. It abounded in trees and creepers. Its surface was red with lotuses at one place, white with clusters of lilies at another and with blue lotuses at other places. As such, it looked like a carpet with variegated colours.

shloka_text: स तामासाद्य वै रामो दूरादुदकवाहिनीम्।।3.75.13।। मतङ्गसरसं नाम ह्रदं समवगाहत।
transliteration: sa tāmāsādya vai rāmo dūrādudakavāhinīm mataṅgasarasaṃ nāma hradaṃ samavagāhata|
translation: सः रामः Rama, उदकवाहिनीम् lake, ताम् that one, दूरात् from  a distance, आसाद्य reached, मतङ्गसरसं नाम a place called Matanga lake, ह्रदम् pond,समवगाहत bathed.
explanation: Rama reached the Matanga lake which he could see from  a distance and bathed in it.

shloka_text: अरविन्दोत्पलवतीं पद्मसौगन्धिकायुताम्।।3.75.14।। पुष्पिताम्रवणोपेतां बर्हिणोद्घुष्टनादिताम्। तिलकैर्बीजपूरैश्च धवैश्शुक्लद्रुमैस्तथा।।3.75.15।। पुष्पितैः करवीरैश्च पुन्नागैश्च सुपुष्पितैः। मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च भाण्डीरैर्निचुलैस्तथा।।3.75.16।। अशोकैस्सप्तपर्णैश्च केतकैरतिमुक्तकैः। अन्यैश्च विविधैर्वृक्षैः प्रमदामिव भूषिताम्।।3.75.17।। समीक्षमाणौ पुषपाढ्यं सर्वतो विपुलद्रुमम्। कोयष्टिकैश्चार्जुनकैश्शतपत्रैश्च कीरकैः।।3.75.18।। एतैश्चान्यैश्च विहगैर्नादितं तु वनं महत्। ततो जग्मतुरव्यग्रौ राघवौ सुसमाहितौ।।3.75.19।। तद्वनं चैव सरसः पश्यन्तै शकुनैर्युतम्।
transliteration: aravindotpalavatīṃ padmasaugandhikāyutām puṣpitāmravaṇopetāṃ barhiṇodghuṣṭanāditām| tilakairbījapūraiśca dhavaiśśukladrumaistathā puṣpitaiḥ karavīraiśca punnāgaiśca supuṣpitaiḥ| mālatīkundagulmaiśca bhāṇḍīrairniculaistathā aśokaissaptaparṇaiśca ketakairatimuktakaiḥ| anyaiśca vividhairvṛkṣaiḥ pramadāmiva bhūṣitām samīkṣamāṇau puṣapāḍhyaṃ sarvato vipuladrumam| koyaṣṭikaiścārjunakaiśśatapatraiśca kīrakaiḥ etaiścānyaiśca vihagairnāditaṃ tu vanaṃ mahat| tato jagmaturavyagrau rāghavau susamāhitau tadvanaṃ caiva sarasaḥ paśyantai śakunairyutam|
translation: ततः thereafter, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, अरविन्दोत्पलवतीम् having lilies and lotuses, पद्मसौगन्धिकायुताम् filled with fragrance of lotuses, पुष्पिताम्रवणोपेताम् with blossoming mango trees, बर्हिणोद्घुष्टनादिताम् resounding with the shrill by of peacocks, तिलकैः with tilaka trees, बीजपूरैश्च trees with fruits full of seeds, धवैः dhava trees, तथा so also, शुक्लद्रुमैः white trees, पुष्पितैः in bloom, करवीरैश्च with karaviras, सुपुष्पितैः loaded with flowers, पुन्नागैश्च with punnaga trees, मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च with clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, भाण्डीरैः with fig trees, तथा so also, निचुलैः with reeds, अशोकैः with asoka, अतिमुक्तकैः with atimukta shrubs, अन्यैः and other, विविधैः several, वृक्षैश्च trees, भूषिताम् adorned, प्रमदामिव like a woman, सर्वतः all over, समीक्षमाणौ glancing at them, पुष्पाढ्यम् with abundance of flowers, विपुलद्रुमम् having great trees, कोयष्टिकैश्च with koyashtikas, अर्जुनकैः arjuna trees, शतपत्रैः peacocks, कीरकैः  parrots, एतैः all those, अन्यैः others, विहगैश्च with birds, नादितम् full of sounds, महत् great, शकुनैः with birds, युतम् with, वनम् forest, पश्यन्तौ seeing, अव्यग्रौ both unruffled, सुसमाहितौ both composed, सरसः tank, तत् that, वनम् forest, जग्मतुः both went.
explanation: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.

transliteration: aravindotpalavatīṃ padmasaugandhikāyutām puṣpitāmravaṇopetāṃ barhiṇodghuṣṭanāditām| tilakairbījapūraiśca dhavaiśśukladrumaistathā puṣpitaiḥ karavīraiśca punnāgaiśca supuṣpitaiḥ| mālatīkundagulmaiśca bhāṇḍīrairniculaistathā aśokaissaptaparṇaiśca ketakairatimuktakaiḥ| anyaiśca vividhairvṛkṣaiḥ pramadāmiva bhūṣitām samīkṣamāṇau puṣapāḍhyaṃ sarvato vipuladrumam| koyaṣṭikaiścārjunakaiśśatapatraiśca kīrakaiḥ etaiścānyaiśca vihagairnāditaṃ tu vanaṃ mahat| tato jagmaturavyagrau rāghavau susamāhitau tadvanaṃ caiva sarasaḥ paśyantai śakunairyutam|
translation: ततः thereafter, राघवौ Rama and Lakshmana, अरविन्दोत्पलवतीम् having lilies and lotuses, पद्मसौगन्धिकायुताम् filled with fragrance of lotuses, पुष्पिताम्रवणोपेताम् with blossoming mango trees, बर्हिणोद्घुष्टनादिताम् resounding with the shrill by of peacocks, तिलकैः with tilaka trees, बीजपूरैश्च trees with fruits full of seeds, धवैः dhava trees, तथा so also, शुक्लद्रुमैः white trees, पुष्पितैः in bloom, करवीरैश्च with karaviras, सुपुष्पितैः loaded with flowers, पुन्नागैश्च with punnaga trees, मालतीकुन्दगुल्मैश्च with clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, भाण्डीरैः with fig trees, तथा so also, निचुलैः with reeds, अशोकैः with asoka, अतिमुक्तकैः with atimukta shrubs, अन्यैः and other, विविधैः several, वृक्षैश्च trees, भूषिताम् adorned, प्रमदामिव like a woman, सर्वतः all over, समीक्षमाणौ glancing at them, पुष्पाढ्यम् with abundance of flowers, विपुलद्रुमम् having great trees, कोयष्टिकैश्च with koyashtikas, अर्जुनकैः arjuna trees, शतपत्रैः peacocks, कीरकैः  parrots, एतैः all those, अन्यैः others, विहगैश्च with birds, नादितम् full of sounds, महत् great, शकुनैः with birds, युतम् with, वनम् forest, पश्यन्तौ seeing, अव्यग्रौ both unruffled, सुसमाहितौ both composed, सरसः tank, तत् that, वनम् forest, जग्मतुः both went.
explanation: Lake Pampa was filled with red lotuses and their fragrance.The bank was lined with blossoming mango trees and trees of several kinds like tilaka trees with fruits full of seeds like citron, dhava trees, white trees in bloom, karavira trees loaded with flowers, punnaga trees, clusters of jasmine and kunda shrubs, fig trees, so also reeds, ashoka trees, atimuktaka creepors and several other trees looking like women adorned all over. Rama and Lakshmana passed by, glancing at them. There were other trees full of flowers, huge trees, koyashtika trees with reed. Different kinds of birds such as peacocks, parrots, dwelling in the forest were screaming aloud. Looking at all these in that forest Rama and Lakshmana passed by undisturbed with a composed mind.

shloka_text: स ददर्श ततः पम्पां शीतवारिनिधिं शुभाम्।।3.75.20।। तिलकाशोकपुन्नागवकुलोद्दालकाशिनीम्।
transliteration: sa dadarśa tataḥ pampāṃ śītavārinidhiṃ śubhām tilakāśokapunnāgavakuloddālakāśinīm|
translation: ततः then, सः Rama, शीतवारिनिधिम् a bed of cool waters, शुभाम् auspicious one, तिलकाशोकपुन्नाग with tilaka, asoka, punnaga trees, वकुलोद्दालकाशिनीम् groves shining with vakula, uddala trees, पम्पाम् Pampa, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Rama saw lake Pampa with cool waters and the groves on the bank filled with tilaka, ashoka, punnaga, bakula and uddala trees.

shloka_text: स रामो विविधान्वृक्षान्सरांसि विविधानि च।।3.75.21।। पश्यन्कामाभिसन्तप्तो जगाम परमं ह्रदम्।
transliteration: sa rāmo vividhānvṛkṣānsarāṃsi vividhāni ca paśyankāmābhisantapto jagāma paramaṃ hradam|
translation: सः that, रामः Rama, विविधान् several, वृक्षान् trees, विविधानि different, सरांसि tanks, पश्यन् seeing, कामाभिसन्तप्तः lovestriken, परमम् great, ह्रदम् lake, जगाम went.
explanation: On seeing different kinds of trees and tanks, the lovestriken Rama visited that great lake.

shloka_text: पुष्पितोपवनोपेतां सालचम्पकशोभिताम्।।3.75.22।। षट्पदौघसमाविष्टां श्रीमतीमतुलप्रभाम्। स्फटिकोपमतोयाढ्यां श्लक्ष्णवालुकसन्तताम्।।3.75.23।। स तां दृष्ट्वा पुनः पम्पां पद्मसौगन्घिकैर्युताम्। इत्युवाच तदा वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं सत्यविक्रमः।।3.75.24।।
transliteration: puṣpitopavanopetāṃ sālacampakaśobhitām ṣaṭpadaughasamāviṣṭāṃ śrīmatīmatulaprabhām| sphaṭikopamatoyāḍhyāṃ ślakṣṇavālukasantatām sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ pampāṃ padmasauganghikairyutām| ityuvāca tadā vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ satyavikramaḥ
translation: सत्यविक्रमः whose strength was truth, सः Rama, पुष्पितोपवनोपेताम् with pleasuregardens in full bloom, सालचम्पकशोभिताम् beautiful with sal and champak trees, षट्पदौघसमाविष्टाम् filled with honeybees, श्रीमतीम् lovely one, अतुलप्रभाम् full of incomparable brilliance, स्फटिकोपमतोयाढ्याम्  with crystalclear water, श्लक्ष्णवालुकसन्तताम्  soft sands that gleamed, पद्मसौगन्धिकैः with fragrant lotuses, युताम् filled, ताम् that, पुनः again, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तदा then, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इति thus, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom  filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.

shloka_text: पुष्पितोपवनोपेतां सालचम्पकशोभिताम्।।3.75.22।। षट्पदौघसमाविष्टां श्रीमतीमतुलप्रभाम्। स्फटिकोपमतोयाढ्यां श्लक्ष्णवालुकसन्तताम्।।3.75.23।। स तां दृष्ट्वा पुनः पम्पां पद्मसौगन्घिकैर्युताम्। इत्युवाच तदा वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं सत्यविक्रमः।।3.75.24।।
transliteration: puṣpitopavanopetāṃ sālacampakaśobhitām ṣaṭpadaughasamāviṣṭāṃ śrīmatīmatulaprabhām| sphaṭikopamatoyāḍhyāṃ ślakṣṇavālukasantatām sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ pampāṃ padmasauganghikairyutām| ityuvāca tadā vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ satyavikramaḥ
translation: सत्यविक्रमः whose strength was truth, सः Rama, पुष्पितोपवनोपेताम् with pleasuregardens in full bloom, सालचम्पकशोभिताम् beautiful with sal and champak trees, षट्पदौघसमाविष्टाम् filled with honeybees, श्रीमतीम् lovely one, अतुलप्रभाम् full of incomparable brilliance, स्फटिकोपमतोयाढ्याम्  with crystalclear water, श्लक्ष्णवालुकसन्तताम्  soft sands that gleamed, पद्मसौगन्धिकैः with fragrant lotuses, युताम् filled, ताम् that, पुनः again, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तदा then, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इति thus, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom  filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.

shloka_text: पुष्पितोपवनोपेतां सालचम्पकशोभिताम्।।3.75.22।। षट्पदौघसमाविष्टां श्रीमतीमतुलप्रभाम्। स्फटिकोपमतोयाढ्यां श्लक्ष्णवालुकसन्तताम्।।3.75.23।। स तां दृष्ट्वा पुनः पम्पां पद्मसौगन्घिकैर्युताम्। इत्युवाच तदा वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं सत्यविक्रमः।।3.75.24।।
transliteration: puṣpitopavanopetāṃ sālacampakaśobhitām ṣaṭpadaughasamāviṣṭāṃ śrīmatīmatulaprabhām| sphaṭikopamatoyāḍhyāṃ ślakṣṇavālukasantatām sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ pampāṃ padmasauganghikairyutām| ityuvāca tadā vākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ satyavikramaḥ
translation: सत्यविक्रमः whose strength was truth, सः Rama, पुष्पितोपवनोपेताम् with pleasuregardens in full bloom, सालचम्पकशोभिताम् beautiful with sal and champak trees, षट्पदौघसमाविष्टाम् filled with honeybees, श्रीमतीम् lovely one, अतुलप्रभाम् full of incomparable brilliance, स्फटिकोपमतोयाढ्याम्  with crystalclear water, श्लक्ष्णवालुकसन्तताम्  soft sands that gleamed, पद्मसौगन्धिकैः with fragrant lotuses, युताम् filled, ताम् that, पुनः again, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तदा then, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इति thus, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.
explanation: There were lovely pleasuregardens in full bloom  filled with sal and champk trees. Honeybees on flowers looked lovely and bright. The waters were crystalclear and fragrant with lotuses.The soft sands on the banks of Pampa gleamed. Rama saw them again and again and described them to Lakshmana.

shloka_text: अस्यास्तीरे तु पूर्वोक्तः पर्वतो धातुमण्डितः। ऋष्यमूक इति ख्यातः पुण्यः पुष्पितपादपः।।3.75.25।।
transliteration: asyāstīre tu pūrvoktaḥ parvato dhātumaṇḍitaḥ| ṛṣyamūka iti khyātaḥ puṇyaḥ puṣpitapādapaḥ
translation: पूर्वोक्तः referred  earlier, धातुमण्डितः adorned with minerals, पुण्यः sacred, पुष्पितपादपः having trees with flowers in bloom, ऋष्यमूकः इति Rishyamuka by name, ख्यातः famous, पर्वतः mountain, अस्याः its, तीरे on the bank.
explanation: The famous mount, sacred Rishyamuka is situated on the bank of Pampa full of blossoming trees.

shloka_text: हरेः ऋक्षरजोनाम्नः पुत्रस्तस्य महात्मनः। अध्यास्ते तं महावीर्यस्सुग्रीव इति विश्रुतः।।3.75.26।।
transliteration: hareḥ ṛkṣarajonāmnaḥ putrastasya mahātmanaḥ| adhyāste taṃ mahāvīryassugrīva iti viśrutaḥ
translation: ऋक्षरजोनाम्नः of Riksharaja by name, महात्मनः of the great soul, तस्य his, हरेः Sun's, पुत्रः son, महावीर्यः mighty, सुग्रीवः इति known as Sugriva, विश्रुतः very wellknown, तम् him, अध्यास्ते is residing.
explanation: The mighty son of Riksharaja, the great soul, the Sun whose son was the wellknown Sugriva, resides on this mountain.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवमभिगच्छ त्वं वानरेन्द्रं नरर्षभ। इत्युवाच पुनर्वाक्यं लक्ष्मणं सत्यविक्रमम्।।3.75.27।।
transliteration: sugrīvamabhigaccha tvaṃ vānarendraṃ nararṣabha| ityuvāca punarvākyaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ satyavikramam
translation: नरर्षभ best among men, त्वम् you, वानरेन्द्रम् to the lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, अभिगच्छ approach, पुनः again, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इति this, उवाच said.
explanation: Rama said to Lakshmana, the best of men, who had truth as his strength, Go to Sugriva, lord of the monkeys.

shloka_text: राज्यभ्रष्टेन दीनेन तस्यामासक्तचेतसा। कथं मया विना शक्यं सीतां लक्ष्मण जीवितुम्।।3.75.28।।
transliteration: rājyabhraṣṭena dīnena tasyāmāsaktacetasā| kathaṃ mayā vinā śakyaṃ sītāṃ lakṣmaṇa jīvitum
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, राज्यभ्रष्टेन by one dislodged from the kingdom, दीनेन by a pathetic one, तस्याम् in her, आसक्तचेतसा attached to her, मया by me, सीतां विना without Sita, जीवितुम् to live, कथम् how, शक्यम् is it possible?
explanation: O Lakshmana, deprived of the kingdom I have become a destitute. With my heart attached to Sita how can I live without her ?

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्त्वा मदनाभिपीडितः स लक्ष्मणं वाक्यमनन्यचेतसम्। विवेश पम्पां नलिनीं मनोरमां रघूत्तमश्शोकविषादयन्त्रितः।।3.75.29।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvā madanābhipīḍitaḥ sa lakṣmaṇaṃ vākyamananyacetasam| viveśa pampāṃ nalinīṃ manoramāṃ raghūttamaśśokaviṣādayantritaḥ
translation: मदनाभिपीडितः oppressed by love, सः रघूत्तमः that best of the Raghus, अनन्यचेतसम् without fixing his heart anywhere else, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इत्येवम् in this way, वाक्यम् words, उक्त्वा having said, शोकविषाद tears of sorrow, यन्त्रितः afflicted, मनोरमाम् delightful, पम्पां नलिनीं a lotus tank, Pampa, विवेश entered.
explanation: Having said these words to Lakshmana who was listening to him with undivided attention, Rama, the best of the Raghus, oppressed by love and afflicted by tears of grief entered Pampa, the delightful lotuslake.

shloka_text: ततो महद्वर्त्म सुदूरसङ्क्रमं क्रमेण गत्वा प्रविलोकयन्वनम्। ददर्श पम्पां शुभदर्शकाननामनेकनानाविधपक्षिजालकाम्।।3.75.30।।
transliteration: tato mahadvartma sudūrasaṅkramaṃ krameṇa gatvā pravilokayanvanam| dadarśa pampāṃ śubhadarśakānanāmanekanānāvidhapakṣijālakām
translation: ततः then, सुदूरसङ्क्रमम् extending to a distance, महत् great, वर्त्म path, क्रमेण gradually, गत्वा after going, वनम् forest, प्रविलोकयन् while observing, शुभदर्शकाननाम् surrounded by  beautiful forests, अनेकनानाविधपक्षिजालकाम् many varieties of birds, पम्पाम् Pampa, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Thereafter, going slowly to a distance, Rama and Lakshmana saw Pampa surrounded by beautiful forests full of many varieties of birds. इत्यार्ष श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततिमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventyfifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स तां पुष्करिणीं गत्वा पद्मोत्पलझषाकुलाम्। रामस्सौमित्रि सहितो विललापाकुलेन्द्रियः।।4.1.1।।
transliteration: sa tāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ gatvā padmotpalajhaṣākulām| rāmassaumitri sahito vilalāpākulendriyaḥ
translation: सौमित्रिसहितः together with Saumitri, सः that, रामः Rama, पद्मोत्पलझषाकुलाम् filled with lotuses, lilies and fishes, पुष्करिणीम् to the lake, गत्वा arrived, आकुलेन्द्रियः one (Rama) who is with afflicted senses, विललाप lamented.
explanation: Arriving with Laksmana at the lake filled with lotuses, lilies and fishes, Rama, his senses oppressed, burst into tears.
comments: Description of the enchanting environs of Pampa -- dejected Rama laments -- Lakshmana urges Rama to pick up courage -- Rama and Lakshmana proceed towards Rishyamuka -- Sugriva sees Rama and Lakshmana and gets alarmed

shloka_text: तस्य दृष्ट्वैव तां हर्षादिन्द्रियाणि चकम्पिरे। स कामवशमापन्नस्सौमित्रिमिदमब्रवीत्।।4.1.2।।
transliteration: tasya dṛṣṭvaiva tāṃ harṣādindriyāṇi cakampire| sa kāmavaśamāpannassaumitrimidamabravīt
translation: तस्य there, ताम् that, दृष्ट्वैव on sighting, हर्षात् out of joy, इन्द्रियाणि senses, चकम्पिरे shook, सः he, कामवश obsessed with love for Sita, आपन्नः gone, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, इदम् this, in the following manner,  अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: He was glad to see it but sad at the thought of Sita. His passion stirred, his senses shaken, he said this to Saumitri:

shloka_text: सौमित्रे शोभते पम्पा वैदूर्यविमलोदका। फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवती शोभिता विविधैर्द्रुमैः।।4.1.3।।
transliteration: saumitre śobhate pampā vaidūryavimalodakā| phullapadmotpalavatī śobhitā vividhairdrumaiḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Saumitri,वै2दू2र्यविमलोदका water clear as Vaidurya, फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवती with lilies and lotuses in bloom, विविधैः with varieties of, द्रुमैः trees, शोभिता adorned with, पम्पा Pampa lake, शोभते  looks beautiful
explanation: 'O Saumitri Pampa looks beautiful with its water clear as vaidurya, its lilies and lotuses in full bloom and its trees in all their variety.

shloka_text: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पायाः काननं शुभदर्शनम्। यत्र राजन्ति शैला वा द्रुमास्सशिखरा इव।।4.1.4।।
transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyāḥ kānanaṃ śubhadarśanam| yatra rājanti śailā vā drumāssaśikharā iva
translation: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, पम्पायाः of Pampa, शुभदर्शनम् pleasant (view) to the eyes, काननम् forest, पश्य look see, यत्र where, द्रुमाः trees, सशिखराः with high branches, शैलाः mountains इव like, राजन्ति glitter (appear splendid)
explanation: 'O Saumitri look at the pleasant forest around Pampa where trees stand splendid like mountainpeaks.

shloka_text: मां तु शोकाभिसन्तप्तं माधवः पीडयन्ति वै। भरतस्य च दुःखेन वैदेह्या हरणेन च।।4.1.5।।
transliteration: māṃ tu śokābhisantaptaṃ mādhavaḥ pīḍayanti vai| bharatasya ca duḥkhena vaidehyā haraṇena ca
translation: भरतस्य दुःखेन Bharata's sorrow, वैदेह्या हरणेन Vaidehi's abduction, शोकाभिसन्तप्तम् tormented with sorrow, मां तु me  indeed, माधवः spring, पीडयन्ति is tormenting.
explanation: Already saddened due to the abduction of Sita and plight of Bharata, I am tormented by Spring.

shloka_text: शोकार्तस्यापि मे पम्पा शोभते चित्रकानना। व्यवकीर्णा बहुविधैः पुष्पैश्शीतोदका शिवा।।4.1.6।।
transliteration: śokārtasyāpi me pampā śobhate citrakānanā| vyavakīrṇā bahuvidhaiḥ puṣpaiśśītodakā śivā
translation: चित्रकानना by the wonderful forest, बहुविधैः many kinds, पुष्पैः flowers, व्यवकीर्णाः scattered with, शीतोदकाः cool water, शिवा auspicious, पम्पा Pampa, शोकार्तस्यापि though stricken with grief, मे to me, शोभते delightful
explanation: Though stricken with grief, I feel so delighted to see the auspicious Pampa with its wonderful forest and cool water scattered with flowers.

shloka_text: नलिनैरपि सञ्छन्ना ह्यत्यर्थशुभदर्शना। सर्पव्यालानुचरिता मृगद्विजसमाकुला।।4.1.7।।
transliteration: nalinairapi sañchannā hyatyarthaśubhadarśanā| sarpavyālānucaritā mṛgadvijasamākulā
translation: नलिनैः with lotuses, हिः सञ्छन्नाः indeed covered with, अत्यर्थ शुभदर्शना extremely beautiful सर्पव्यालानुचरिता with vicious serpents moving about, मृगद्विजसमाकुला abounding in beasts and birds
explanation: Abounding in lotuses, birds and beasts and vicious serpents moving about, it looks splendid indeed.

shloka_text: अधिकं प्रविभात्येतन्नीलपीतं तु शाद्वलम्। द्रुमाणां विविधैः पुष्पैः परिस्तोमैरिवार्पितम्।।4.1.8।।
transliteration: adhikaṃ pravibhātyetannīlapītaṃ tu śādvalam| drumāṇāṃ vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristomairivārpitam
translation: द्रुमाणाम् of the trees, विविधैः पुष्पैः with variety of flowers, परिस्तोमैरिव like a carpet, अर्पितम् spread, एतत् this, नीलपीतम् bluishyellow, शाद्वलम् grass, अधिकम् very much, प्रविभाति shines brightly.
explanation: The bluishyellow grass, dotted with different kinds of flowers fallen from the trees shines like a carpet spread.

shloka_text: पुष्पभारसमृद्धानि शिखराणि समन्ततः। लताभिः पुष्पिताग्राभिरुपगूढानि सर्वशः।।4.1.9।।
transliteration: puṣpabhārasamṛddhāni śikharāṇi samantataḥ| latābhiḥ puṣpitāgrābhirupagūḍhāni sarvaśaḥ
translation: समन्ततः all over, पुष्पभारसमृद्धानि trees abundantly loaded with flowers, शिखराणि treetops, पुष्पिताग्राभिः with flowers in bloom, लताभिः by creepers, सर्वशः everywhere, उपगूढानि  entwined  covered
explanation: Entwined with flowering creepers the treetops are covered all over with rich loads of flowers.

shloka_text: सुखानिलोऽयं सौमित्रे कालः प्रचुरमन्मथः। गन्धवान्सुरभिर्मासो जातपुष्पफलद्रुमः।।4.1.10।।
transliteration: sukhānilo'yaṃ saumitre kālaḥ pracuramanmathaḥ| gandhavānsurabhirmāso jātapuṣpaphaladrumaḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, सुखानिलः gentle breeze, अयं कालः at this time, प्रचुरमन्मथः ecstatic, जातपुष्पफलद्रुमः trees filled with flowers and fruits, सुरभिर्मासः Spring Season (Chaitra, the first Month of Indian calendar), गन्धवान् fragrant
explanation: 'O Saumitri it is the season of spring. The trees are laden with fruits and fragrant flowers. Ecstatic blows the gentle freeze.

shloka_text: पश्य रूपाणि सौमित्रे वनानां पुष्पशालिनाम्। सृजतां पुष्पवर्षाणि तोयं तोयमुचामिव।।4.1.11।।
transliteration: paśya rūpāṇi saumitre vanānāṃ puṣpaśālinām| sṛjatāṃ puṣpavarṣāṇi toyaṃ toyamucāmiva
translation: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, पुष्पवर्षाणि showers of flowers, सृजताम् sending forth, पुष्पशालिनाम् वनानाम् of flowering trees, तोयं water, तोयमुचामिव like waterbearing clouds, रूपाणि scenery (forms), पश्य look
explanation: 'Look at the flowering trees sending showers of flowers like water dropping from the clouds, O Saumitri

shloka_text: प्रस्तरेषु च रम्येषु विविधाः काननद्रुमाः। वायुवेगप्रचलिताः पुष्पैरवकिरन्ति गाम्।।4.1.12।।
transliteration: prastareṣu ca ramyeṣu vividhāḥ kānanadrumāḥ| vāyuvegapracalitāḥ puṣpairavakiranti gām
translation: रम्येषु on beautiful, प्रस्तरेषु on the rockyland, विविधाः different kinds of, काननद्रुमाः forest trees, वायुवेगप्रचलिताः shaken by the force of wind, पुष्पैः with flowers, गाम् the earth, अवकिरन्ति spreading all over
explanation: Various forest trees shaken by the force of the wind scatter flowers on the beautiful rocky surface of earth.

shloka_text: पतितैः पतमानैश्च पादपस्थैश्च मारुतः। कुसुमैः पश्य सौमित्रे क्रीडन्निव समन्ततः।।4.1.13।।
transliteration: patitaiḥ patamānaiśca pādapasthaiśca mārutaḥ| kusumaiḥ paśya saumitre krīḍanniva samantataḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, पतितैः fallen down, पादपस्थैश्च found on the trees, पतमानै: about to drop, कुसुमैः with flowers, मारुतः wind, समन्ततः all over, क्रीडन्निव as if playing, पश्य see
explanation: O Saumitri! look, the breeze appears to be playing with the flowers; that are fallen and that are still on the trees.

shloka_text: विक्षिपन्विविधाश्शाखा नगानां कुसुमोत्कचाः। मारुतश्चलितस्थानैष्षट्पदैरनुगीयते।।4.1.14।।
