shloka_text: तमद्य वालिनं पश्य तीक्ष्णैराशीविषोपमैः4.5.29।। शरैर्विनिहतं भूमौ विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम्।
transliteration: tamadya vālinaṃ paśya tīkṣṇairāśīviṣopamaiḥ4.5.29|| śarairvinihataṃ bhūmau vikīrṇamiva parvatam|
translation: अद्य now, आशीविषोपमैः comparable to serpents, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, विनिहतम् killed, भूमौ on the ground, प्रकीर्णम् will fall shattered, पर्वतमिव like a mountain, वालिनम् Vali, पश्य see.
explanation: 'With these sharp, serpentlike arrows Vali will be killed. He will fall down on the ground like a mountain shattered.You will see it now'.

shloka_text: स तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्यात्मनो हितम्4.5.30।। सुग्रीवः परमप्रीतस्सुमहद्वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: sa tu tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāghavasyātmano hitam4.5.30|| sugrīvaḥ paramaprītassumahadvākyamabravīt|
translation: सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, आत्मनः for himself, हितम् welfare, राघवस्य Rama's, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, परमप्रीतः very much pleased, सुमहान् very great, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Sugriva, very much pleased with the words of Rama, spoke highly (of him).

shloka_text: तव प्रसादेन नृसिंह राघव प्रियां च राज्यं च समाप्नुयामहम्। तथा कुरु त्वं नरदेव वैरिणं यथा निहंस्यद्य रिपुंममाग्रजम्4.5.31।।
transliteration: tava prasādena nṛsiṃha rāghava priyāṃ ca rājyaṃ ca samāpnuyāmaham| tathā kuru tvaṃ naradeva vairiṇaṃ yathā nihaṃsyadya ripuṃmamāgrajam4.5.31||
translation: नृसिंह lion among men, तव your, प्रसादेन by your grace, अहम् I am, प्रियां च wife and, राज्यं च kingdom, समाप्नुयाम् will attain, नरदेव king, सः he, पुनः again, यथा as, निहंस्यद्य will destroy, तथा thus, त्वम् you, वैरिणम् enemy, मम अग्रजम् my elder brother, कुरु do.
explanation: 'O Rama, by your grace I will get my wife and kingdom back. O king accomplish this so that I can destroy my, elder brother, my enemy, O lion among men

shloka_text: सीता कपीन्द्रक्षणदाचराणां राजीवहेमज्वलनोपमानि। सुग्रीवरामप्रणयप्रसङ्गे वामानि नेत्राणि समं स्फुरन्ति4.5.32।।
transliteration: sītā kapīndrakṣaṇadācarāṇāṃ rājīvahemajvalanopamāni| sugrīvarāmapraṇayaprasaṅge vāmāni netrāṇi samaṃ sphuranti4.5.32||
translation: सुग्रीवरामप्रणयप्रसङ्गे while Sugriva and Rama were making a friendly alliance, सीताकपीन्द्रक्षणदाचराणाम् Sita's, Vali's and also Ravana's, राजीवहेमज्वलनोपमानि lotuslike and blazing like gold, वामानिनेत्राणि left eyes, समम् equally, स्फुरन्ति throbbed.
explanation: While Sugriva was making a friendly alliance with Rama, Sita's left eye, like lotus, Vali's left eye glittering like gold and Ravana's left eye blazing (like fire) twitched at the same time for a moment (Twitching of left eye is considered auspicious to a woman and ominous to a man). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे पञ्चमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: पुनरेवाब्रवीत्प्रीतो राघवं रघुनन्दनम्। अयमाख्याति मे राम सचिवो मन्त्रिसत्तमः4.6.1।। हनुमान्यन्निमित्तं त्वं निर्जनं वनमागतः। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वसतश्च वने तव4.6.2।। रक्षसाऽपहृता भार्या मैथिली जनकात्मजा। त्वया वियुक्ता रुदती लक्ष्मणेन च धीमता4.6.3।। अन्तरप्रेप्सुना तेन हत्वा गृध्रं जटायुषम्4.6.4।।
transliteration: punarevābravītprīto rāghavaṃ raghunandanam| ayamākhyāti me rāma sacivo mantrisattamaḥ4.6.1|| hanumānyannimittaṃ tvaṃ nirjanaṃ vanamāgataḥ| lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vasataśca vane tava4.6.2|| rakṣasā'pahṛtā bhāryā maithilī janakātmajā| tvayā viyuktā rudatī lakṣmaṇena ca dhīmatā4.6.3|| antaraprepsunā tena hatvā gṛdhraṃ jaṭāyuṣam4.6.4||
translation: प्रीतः pleased, रघुनन्दनम् delight of the Raghu dynasty, राघवम् to Rama, पुनरेव again, अब्रवीत् said, राम Rama, त्वम् you, भ्रात्रा your brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana यन्निमित्तं the reason, निर्जनम् desolate, वनम् forest, आगतः has come, मे my, सचिव: counsellor, मन्त्रिसत्तमः jewel among ministers, अयम् this, हनुमान् Hanuman, आख्याति has told, वने in the forest, वसतः residing, तव your, भार्या wife, त्वया by you, धीमता a wise person, लक्ष्मणेन च and by Lakshmana, वियुक्ता alone, रुदती crying, जनकात्मजा daughter of Janaka, मैथिली Maithili, रक्षसा by the demon, अपहृता was carried off, अन्तरप्रेप्सुना seeking a chance, तेन by him, जटायुषम् Jatayu, गृध्रम् vulture, हत्वा having killed
explanation: Sugriva was pleased to say to Rama, delight of the Raghu race once again, 'O Rama, Hanuman, jewel among Ministers, has told me the cause of your coming to this desolate forest. While you were residing in the forest, a demon who was looking for an opportunity carried off your wife, the princess from Mithila, daughter of Janaka, finding her alone. While she was crying (piteously) he killed Jatayu. (the vulture who pretested).
comments: Sugriva speaks about the abduction of Sita by Ravana -- shows to Rama the veil and ornament dropped down by Sita -- Rama eager to killl Ravana, seeks further details of the enemy from Sugriva

shloka_text: भार्यावियोगजं दुःखं न चिरात्त्वं विमोक्ष्यसे। अहं तामानयिष्यामि नष्टां वेदश्रुतीमिव।।4.6.5।।
transliteration: bhāryāviyogajaṃ duḥkhaṃ na cirāttvaṃ vimokṣyase| ahaṃ tāmānayiṣyāmi naṣṭāṃ vedaśrutīmiva
translation: त्वम् you, न चिरात् very soon, भार्यावियोगजम्  due to separation from wife, दुःखम् grief, विमोक्ष्यसे will be relieved, नष्टाम् lost, वेदश्रुतीमिव like the Vedas, ताम् her, आनयिष्यामि I will get her
explanation: 'Very soon you will be relieved of the grief caused by the separation from your wife. Just as Visnu retrieved the Vedas (carried away by the demons, Madhu and Kaitabha) I will deliver her to you.

shloka_text: रसातले वा वर्तन्तीं वर्तन्ती वा नभस्थले अहमानीय दास्यामि तव भार्यामरिन्दम।।।4.6.6।।
transliteration: rasātale vā vartantīṃ vartantī vā nabhasthale ahamānīya dāsyāmi tava bhāryāmarindama|
translation: अरिन्दम subduer of enemies, रसातले in the underworld, वर्तन्तीम् staying, वा or, नभस्तले in the sky, वर्तन्तीम् staying, वा or, तव भार्याम् your wife, आनीया after restoring, (अहं) दास्यामि (I) will give you
explanation: 'O subduer of enemies I will restore her to you even if she is kept in the bowels of the earth or in the vaults of heaven.

shloka_text: इदं तथ्यं मम वचस्त्वमवेहि च राघव। न शक्या सा जरयितुं सेन्द्रैरपि स्सुरासुरैः4.6.7।। तव भार्या महाबाहो भक्ष्यं विषकृतं यथा। त्यज शोकं महाबाहो तां कान्तामानयामि ते4.6.8।।
transliteration: idaṃ tathyaṃ mama vacastvamavehi ca rāghava| na śakyā sā jarayituṃ sendrairapi ssurāsuraiḥ4.6.7|| tava bhāryā mahābāho bhakṣyaṃ viṣakṛtaṃ yathā| tyaja śokaṃ mahābāho tāṃ kāntāmānayāmi te4.6.8||
translation: राघव Rama, मम my, इदम् these, वच: तथ्यम् words will come true, त्वम् you, अवेहि may know, महाबाहो O longarmed one, तव your, भार्या consort, सा she, विषकृतम् mixed with poison, भक्ष्यं यथा like the food, सेन्द्रैः inclusive of Indra, सुरासुरैरपि by  gods or demons, जरयितुम् to absorb, न शक्या not possible, महाबाहो O longarmed, शोकम् grief, त्यज give up, ते to you, कान्ताम्  lady, ताम् her, आनयामि I will get
explanation: 'O longarmed Rama, take these words of mine as true. Your consort cannot be absorbed with impunity even by the denizens of heaven including Indra or the ogres on earth any more than food cooked with poison.Give up grief.

shloka_text: इदं तथ्यं मम वचस्त्वमवेहि च राघव। न शक्या सा जरयितुं सेन्द्रैरपि स्सुरासुरैः4.6.7।। तव भार्या महाबाहो भक्ष्यं विषकृतं यथा। त्यज शोकं महाबाहो तां कान्तामानयामि ते4.6.8।।
transliteration: idaṃ tathyaṃ mama vacastvamavehi ca rāghava| na śakyā sā jarayituṃ sendrairapi ssurāsuraiḥ4.6.7|| tava bhāryā mahābāho bhakṣyaṃ viṣakṛtaṃ yathā| tyaja śokaṃ mahābāho tāṃ kāntāmānayāmi te4.6.8||
translation: राघव Rama, मम my, इदम् these, वच: तथ्यम् words will come true, त्वम् you, अवेहि may know, महाबाहो O longarmed one, तव your, भार्या consort, सा she, विषकृतम् mixed with poison, भक्ष्यं यथा like the food, सेन्द्रैः inclusive of Indra, सुरासुरैरपि by  gods or demons, जरयितुम् to absorb, न शक्या not possible, महाबाहो O longarmed, शोकम् grief, त्यज give up, ते to you, कान्ताम्  lady, ताम् her, आनयामि I will get
explanation: 'O longarmed Rama, take these words of mine as true. Your consort cannot be absorbed with impunity even by the denizens of heaven including Indra or the ogres on earth any more than food cooked with poison.Give up grief.

shloka_text: अनुमानात्तु जानामि मैथिली सा न संशयः। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रक्षसा क्रूरकर्मणा4.6.9।। क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च विस्वरम्। स्फुरन्ती रावणस्याङ्के पन्नगेन्द्रवधूर्यथा4.6.10।।
transliteration: anumānāttu jānāmi maithilī sā na saṃśayaḥ| hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rakṣasā krūrakarmaṇā4.6.9|| krośantī rāma rāmeti lakṣmaṇeti ca visvaram| sphurantī rāvaṇasyāṅke pannagendravadhūryathā4.6.10||
translation: क्रूरकर्मणा of terrible deeds, रक्षसा by the demon, ह्रियमाणा being carried away, राम रामेति saying Rama, Rama, लक्ष्मणेति also Lakshmana, विस्वरम् husky voice, क्रोशन्ती (विलपन्ती)  crying, पन्नगेन्द्रवधूर्यथा like the queen of serpents, रावणस्य Ravana's, अङ्के on the lap, स्फुरन्ती while she was wriggling, मया by myself, दृष्टा was seen, सा she, मैथिली Maithili, अनुमानात् no doubt, जानामि I know, संशयः doubt, न not
explanation: 'Yes, I remember. I had observed a lady being carried away by a wicked demon. She was crying loudly 'Oh, Rama Oh Rama Oh Lakshmana' in a husky voice. It was Maithili. She was wriggling on the lap of Ravana like a female serpent.

shloka_text: अनुमानात्तु जानामि मैथिली सा न संशयः। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रक्षसा क्रूरकर्मणा4.6.9।। क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च विस्वरम्। स्फुरन्ती रावणस्याङ्के पन्नगेन्द्रवधूर्यथा4.6.10।।
transliteration: anumānāttu jānāmi maithilī sā na saṃśayaḥ| hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rakṣasā krūrakarmaṇā4.6.9|| krośantī rāma rāmeti lakṣmaṇeti ca visvaram| sphurantī rāvaṇasyāṅke pannagendravadhūryathā4.6.10||
translation: क्रूरकर्मणा of terrible deeds, रक्षसा by the demon, ह्रियमाणा being carried away, राम रामेति saying Rama, Rama, लक्ष्मणेति also Lakshmana, विस्वरम् husky voice, क्रोशन्ती (विलपन्ती)  crying, पन्नगेन्द्रवधूर्यथा like the queen of serpents, रावणस्य Ravana's, अङ्के on the lap, स्फुरन्ती while she was wriggling, मया by myself, दृष्टा was seen, सा she, मैथिली Maithili, अनुमानात् no doubt, जानामि I know, संशयः doubt, न not
explanation: 'Yes, I remember. I had observed a lady being carried away by a wicked demon. She was crying loudly 'Oh, Rama Oh Rama Oh Lakshmana' in a husky voice. It was Maithili. She was wriggling on the lap of Ravana like a female serpent.

shloka_text: आत्मना पञ्चमं मां हि दृष्ट्वा शैलतटे स्थितम्। उत्तरीयं तया त्यक्तं शुभान्याभरणानि च4.6.11।।
transliteration: ātmanā pañcamaṃ māṃ hi dṛṣṭvā śailataṭe sthitam| uttarīyaṃ tayā tyaktaṃ śubhānyābharaṇāni ca4.6.11||
translation: शैलतटे on the mountain, स्थितम् seated, आत्मना by myself, पञ्चमम् a fifth one, माम् me, दृष्टवा after seeing, तया by her, उत्तरीयम् veil, त्यक्तम् is dropped, शुभानि auspicious, आभरणानि च ornaments also
explanation: 'Seeing me as the fifth member seated on a mountain  she dropped down the auspicious ornaments (bundled) in her veil

shloka_text: तान्यस्माभिगृहीतानि निहितानि च राघव। आनयिष्याम्यहं तानि प्रत्यभिज्ञातुमर्हसि4.6.12।।
transliteration: tānyasmābhigṛhītāni nihitāni ca rāghava| ānayiṣyāmyahaṃ tāni pratyabhijñātumarhasi4.6.12||
translation: राघव Rama, तानि those, अस्माभिः by us, गृहीतानि collected, निहितानि च and kept safely, अहम् I, तानि them, आनयिष्यामि will get, प्रत्यभिज्ञातुम् recognise them, अर्हसि you ought to
explanation: 'Rama, we have kept  them safely. I will fetch them so that you should be able to identify them.'

shloka_text: तमब्रवीत्ततो रामस्सुग्रीवं प्रियवादिनम्। आनयस्व सखे शीघ्रं किमर्थं प्रविलम्बसे4.6.13।।
transliteration: tamabravīttato rāmassugrīvaṃ priyavādinam| ānayasva sakhe śīghraṃ kimarthaṃ pravilambase4.6.13||
translation: ततः then, रामः Rama, प्रियवादिनम् a man of pleasant word, तं सुग्रीवम् that Sugriva, अब्रवीत् said, सखे O friend, शीघ्रम् quickly, आनयस्व you may get, किमर्थम् why do you, प्रविलम्बसे delay
explanation: Rama then said to Sugriva, one who used pleasing words, 'O my friend why delay? Get them here immediately'.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवश्शैलस्य गहनां गुहाम्। प्रविवेश ततशशीघ्रं राघवप्रियकाम्यया4.6.14।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvaśśailasya gahanāṃ guhām| praviveśa tataśaśīghraṃ rāghavapriyakāmyayā4.6.14||
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having asked, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, ततः then, राघवप्रियकाम्यया to make Rama happy, शैलस्य mountain's, गहनाम् deep, गुहाम् cave, शीघ्रम् at once, प्रविवेश entered
explanation: On hearing this, Sugriva at once entered into the deep cave of the mountain (to get the ornaments and veil) in order to please Rama.

shloka_text: उत्तरीयं गृहीत्वा तु शुभान्याभरणानि च। इदं पश्येति रामाय दर्शयामास वानरः4.6.15।।
transliteration: uttarīyaṃ gṛhītvā tu śubhānyābharaṇāni ca| idaṃ paśyeti rāmāya darśayāmāsa vānaraḥ4.6.15||
translation: (सः) वानरः that monkey, उत्तरीयम् veil, तानि those, आभरणानि च and ornaments, गृहीत्वा after taking, इदम् this, पश्य see, इति thus, रामाय to Rama, दर्शयामास showed
explanation: That monkey brought out the veil and auspicios ornaments, showed them to Rama and said, 'Please, see.'

shloka_text: ततो गृहीत्वा वासस्तु श्शुभान्याभरणानि च। अभवद्बाष्पसंरुद्धो नीहारेणेव चन्द्रमाः4.6.16।।
transliteration: tato gṛhītvā vāsastu śśubhānyābharaṇāni ca| abhavadbāṣpasaṃruddho nīhāreṇeva candramāḥ4.6.16||
translation: ततः thereafter, वासः raiment, शुभानि auspicious, आभरणानि च ornaments, गृहीत्वा holding, नीहारेण with dew, चन्द्रमाः इव like the Moon, बाष्पसंरुद्धः filled with tears, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Holding the raiment  as well as the ornaments,  Rama's  eyes were filled with tears.He appeared like the Moon covered with dews.

shloka_text: सीतास्नेहप्रवृत्तेन स तु बाष्पेण दूषितः। हा प्रियेति रुदन्धैर्यमुत्सृज्य न्यपतत्क्षितौ4.6.17।।
transliteration: sītāsnehapravṛttena sa tu bāṣpeṇa dūṣitaḥ| hā priyeti rudandhairyamutsṛjya nyapatatkṣitau4.6.17||
translation: सः he, तु too, सीतास्नेहप्रवृत्तेन  on account of his deep love for Sita, बाष्पेण with tears, दूषितः affllicted, धैर्यम् patience, उत्सृज्य  failed to maintain, हा प्रियेति Oh darling, रुदन्  crying, क्षितौ on the ground, न्यपतत् fell
explanation: On account of his deep attachment for Sita, he shed profuse tears. Unable to maintain his natural composure, he sank down to the ground, saying 'O my darling Sita' and cried inconsolably

shloka_text: हृदि कृत्वा तु बहुशस्तमलङ्कारमुत्तमम्। निशश्वास भृशं सर्पो बिलस्थ इव रोषितः।।4.6.18।।
transliteration: hṛdi kṛtvā tu bahuśastamalaṅkāramuttamam| niśaśvāsa bhṛśaṃ sarpo bilastha iva roṣitaḥ
translation: सः he, उत्तमम् excellent, तम् अलङ्कारम् her ornaments, बहुशः again and again, हृदि on his chest, कृत्वा held, रोषितः in anger (sorrow), बिलस्थः in the hole, सर्पः इव like a snake, भृशम् intensely, निशश्वास sighed
explanation: Pressing the excellent ornaments to his bosom again and again Rama hissed like a cobra provoked in its anthill.

shloka_text: अविच्छिन्नाश्रुवेगस्तु सौमित्रिं वीक्ष्य पार्श्वतः। परिदेवयितुं दीनं रामस्समुपचक्रमे4.6.19।।
transliteration: avicchinnāśruvegastu saumitriṃ vīkṣya pārśvataḥ| paridevayituṃ dīnaṃ rāmassamupacakrame4.6.19||
translation: रामः Rama, अविच्छिन्नाश्रुवेगः tears streamed incessantly, पार्श्वतः by his side, सौमित्रिम् at Saumitri, विक्ष्य  looking, दीनम् piteously, परिदेवयितुम् to wail, समुपचक्रमे started
explanation: Rama began to wail piteously while tears streamed down his eyes incessantly. He looked at Saumitri standing by his side and said:

shloka_text: पश्य लक्ष्मण वैदेह्या सन्त्यक्तं ह्रियमाणया। उत्तरीयमिदं भूमौ शरीराद्भूषणानि च4.6.20।।
transliteration: paśya lakṣmaṇa vaidehyā santyaktaṃ hriyamāṇayā| uttarīyamidaṃ bhūmau śarīrādbhūṣaṇāni ca4.6.20||
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, ह्रियमाणया while being abducted, वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, शरीरात् from her body, भूमौ on the ground, सन्त्यक्तम् thrown down, इदम् these, उत्तरीयम् veil, भूषणानि च and ornaments, पश्य see
explanation: 'O Lakshmana, behold the veil and the ornaments dropped on the ground by Vaidehi while she was being abducted.

shloka_text: शाद्वलिन्यां ध्रुवं भूमौ सीतया ह्रियमाणया। उत्सृष्टं भूषणमिदं तथारूपं हि दृश्यते4.6.21।।
transliteration: śādvalinyāṃ dhruvaṃ bhūmau sītayā hriyamāṇayā| utsṛṣṭaṃ bhūṣaṇamidaṃ tathārūpaṃ hi dṛśyate4.6.21||
translation: ह्रियमाणया while being carried away, सीतया by Sita, इदम् these, भूषणम् ornaments, शाद्वलिन्याम् on the grassy land, भूमौ on the ground, उत्सृष्टम् dropped down, ध्रुवम् surely, तथारूपम् as before, दृश्यते हि It appears like that
explanation: 'Sita, for sure, dropped these ornaments on the grassy ground. They are in good shape (without any damage).

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। नाहं जानामि केयूरे नाहं जानामि कुण्डले4.6.22।। नूपुरे त्वभिजानामि नित्यं पादाभिवन्दनात्।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇo vākyamabravīt| nāhaṃ jānāmi keyūre nāhaṃ jānāmi kuṇḍale4.6.22|| nūpure tvabhijānāmi nityaṃ pādābhivandanāt|
translation: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having addressed, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, अहम् I am, केयूरे armlets, न जानामि I do not know, कुण्डले earrings, न not, नित्यम् daily, पादाभिवन्दनात् by bowing at her feet, नूपुरे तु only the anklets, अभिजानामि I recognise
explanation: Thus addressed by Rama, Lakshmana replied, 'I recognise neither the armlets nor the earrings. I only recognise the anklets as I used to bow at her feet daily.'

shloka_text: ततस्तु राघवो वाक्यं सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्4.6.23।। ब्रूहि सुग्रीव कं देशं ह्रियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया। रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण मम प्राणैः प्रिया प्रिया4.6.24।।
transliteration: tatastu rāghavo vākyaṃ sugrīvamidamabravīt4.6.23|| brūhi sugrīva kaṃ deśaṃ hriyantī lakṣitā tvayā| rakṣasā raudrarūpeṇa mama prāṇaiḥ priyā priyā4.6.24||
translation: ततः then, राघवः Rama, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, सुग्रीव O Sugriva, मम my, प्राणैः life, प्रिया प्रिया dear one, रौद्ररूपेण by the fiercelooking one, रक्षसा by the demon, कम् which,देशम् place, ह्रियन्ती taken, त्वया by you, लक्षिता is seen, ब्रूहि tell me
explanation: Then Rama said to Sugriva,.'Tell me, O Sugriva, to which region that fiercelooking demon has carried away my Sita, who is dearer than my life.

shloka_text: ततस्तु राघवो वाक्यं सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्4.6.23।। ब्रूहि सुग्रीव कं देशं ह्रियन्ती लक्षिता त्वया। रक्षसा रौद्ररूपेण मम प्राणैः प्रिया प्रिया4.6.24।।
transliteration: tatastu rāghavo vākyaṃ sugrīvamidamabravīt4.6.23|| brūhi sugrīva kaṃ deśaṃ hriyantī lakṣitā tvayā| rakṣasā raudrarūpeṇa mama prāṇaiḥ priyā priyā4.6.24||
translation: ततः then, राघवः Rama, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, सुग्रीव O Sugriva, मम my, प्राणैः life, प्रिया प्रिया dear one, रौद्ररूपेण by the fiercelooking one, रक्षसा by the demon, कम् which,देशम् place, ह्रियन्ती taken, त्वया by you, लक्षिता is seen, ब्रूहि tell me
explanation: Then Rama said to Sugriva,.'Tell me, O Sugriva, to which region that fiercelooking demon has carried away my Sita, who is dearer than my life.

shloka_text: क्व वा वसति तद्रक्षो महद्व्यसनदं मम। यन्निमित्तमहं सर्वान्नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसान्4.6.25।।
transliteration: kva vā vasati tadrakṣo mahadvyasanadaṃ mama| yannimittamahaṃ sarvānnāśayiṣyāmi rākṣasān4.6.25||
translation: अहम् I am, यन्निमित्तम् on whose account, सर्वान् all, राक्षसान् demons, नाशयिष्यामि I will exterminate, तत् that, मम my, व्यसनदम् brought agony to me, महत् रक्षः huge demon, क्व वा where does, वसति he lives?
explanation: 'Let me know where dwells that huge  ogre who has caused this agony to me. I will exterminate all the demons

shloka_text: हरता मैथिलीं येन मां च रोषयता भृशम्। आत्मनो जीवितान्ताय मृत्युद्वारमपावृतम्4.6.26।।
transliteration: haratā maithilīṃ yena māṃ ca roṣayatā bhṛśam| ātmano jīvitāntāya mṛtyudvāramapāvṛtam4.6.26||
translation: मैथिलीम् Maithili, हरता being kidnapped, माम् me, रोषयता च by causing anger, येन by whom, भृशम् profusly, आत्मनः to his self, जीवितान्ताय for his death, मृत्युद्वारम् door of death, अपावृतम् opened
explanation: 'By abducting Maithili he has stirred my fierce anger and has opened the door of his death.

shloka_text: मम दयिततरा हृता वनान्ता द्रजनिचरेण विमथ्य येन सा। कथय मम रिपुं तमद्य वै प्लवगपते यमसादनं नयामि4.6.27।।
transliteration: mama dayitatarā hṛtā vanāntā drajanicareṇa vimathya yena sā| kathaya mama ripuṃ tamadya vai plavagapate yamasādanaṃ nayāmi4.6.27||
translation: प्लवगपते O lord of monkeys, येन by whom, रजनिचरेण by the mightrangers, मम my, दयिततरा most beloved, सा she, विमथ्य troubled her, वनान्तात् from the forest, हृता stolen, मम my, रिपुम् enemy, तम् him, कथय अद्य tell me now, यमसदनम् abode of lord of death, नयामि carry him
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys tell me the whereabouts of that nightranger who has carried off my darling from the heart of the forest and has harassed her. I will send him now to the abode of Death. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः Thus ends the sixth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana,  the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो रामेणार्तेन वानरः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं सबाष्पं बाष्पगद्गदः।।4.7.1।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvo rāmeṇārtena vānaraḥ| abravītprāñjalirvākyaṃ sabāṣpaṃ bāṣpagadgadaḥ
translation: आर्तेन  by the distressed, रामेण by Rama, एवम् that way, उक्तः spoke, वानरः monkey, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, बाष्पगद्गदः voice choked, सबाष्पम् with sears, वाक्यम्  words, अब्रवीत् said
explanation: On hearing the words of Rama in deep distress, the monkey replied to him with folded hands, his throat choked with tears:
comments: Sugriva promises to kill Ravana and bring Sita back -- he consoles Rama -- Rama promises to kill Vali.

shloka_text: न जाने निलयं तस्य सर्वथा पापरक्षसः। सामर्थ्यं विक्रमं वापि दौष्कुलेयस्य वा कुलम्4.7.2।।
transliteration: na jāne nilayaṃ tasya sarvathā pāparakṣasaḥ| sāmarthyaṃ vikramaṃ vāpi dauṣkuleyasya vā kulam4.7.2||
translation: दौष्कुलेयस्य born in despicable clan, तस्य his, पापरक्षसः of the sinful demon, निलयम् residence, सामर्थ्यम् capacity, विक्रमं वापि or his valour, कुलं वा or even the clan, सर्वथा all that, न जाने not known to me
explanation: 'I do not have any knowledge of this sinful demon's dwelling , his capability, his valour or his clan or his despicable lineage.

shloka_text: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि त्यज शोकमरिन्दम। करिष्यामि तथा यत्नं यथा प्राप्स्यसि मैथिलीम्4.7.3।।
transliteration: satyaṃ te pratijānāmi tyaja śokamarindama| kariṣyāmi tathā yatnaṃ yathā prāpsyasi maithilīm4.7.3||
translation: अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, सत्यम् truth, प्रतिजानामि I promise you, शोकम् sorrow, त्यज give up, मैथिलीम् Maithili, यथा as, प्राप्स्यसि will obtain, तथा that way, यत्नम् effort, करिष्यामि I will make
explanation: 'O subduer of enemies, give up sorrow. I promise I will make necessary effort so that you will obtain the princess from Mithila.

shloka_text: रावणं सगणं हत्वा परितोष्यात्मपौरुषम्। तथाऽस्मि कर्ता न चिराद्यथा प्रीतो भविष्यसि4.7.4।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṃ sagaṇaṃ hatvā paritoṣyātmapauruṣam| tathā'smi kartā na cirādyathā prīto bhaviṣyasi4.7.4||
translation: सगणम् including clan, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा after killing, आत्मपौरुषम् my prowess, परितोष्य satisfy, यथा as, प्रीतः pleased, भविष्यसि you will be, तथा that way, न चिरात् very soon, कर्तास्मि I will do
explanation: 'With all my capability I will kill Ravana and his clan. Thus I will be able to satisfy you soon with my efforts.

shloka_text: अलं वैक्लब्यमालम्ब्य धैर्यमात्मगतं स्मर। त्वद्विधानां न सदृशमीदृशं बुद्धिलाघवम्।।4.7.5।।
transliteration: alaṃ vaiklabyamālambya dhairyamātmagataṃ smara| tvadvidhānāṃ na sadṛśamīdṛśaṃ buddhilāghavam
translation: वैक्लब्यम् despair, आलम्ब्य resorting to, अलम् it is enough, आत्मगतम् your natural disposition, धैर्यम् patience, स्मर pick up, त्वद्विधानाम् for men like you, ईदृशम् such, बुद्धिलाघवम् frivolous thought, न सदृशम् is not worthy
explanation: 'Give up despair. It is enough. Be patient. Maintain your natural disposition.It is unworthy of men like you to entertain such frivolus thoughts?

shloka_text: मयाऽपि व्यसनं प्राप्तं भार्याविरहजं महत्। नाहमेवं हि शोचामि न च धैर्यं परित्यजे4.7.6।।
transliteration: mayā'pi vyasanaṃ prāptaṃ bhāryāvirahajaṃ mahat| nāhamevaṃ hi śocāmi na ca dhairyaṃ parityaje4.7.6||
translation: मयापि I am also, भार्याविरहजम् due to separation from my wife, महत् great, व्यसनम् sorrow, प्राप्तम् shared, अहम् I am, एवम् in that way, न not शोचामि I am not brooding, धैर्यं च patience also, न परित्यजे  not given up
explanation: 'Separated from my wife, I, too, am afflicted with deep grief. But I do not brood, I do not lose patience.

shloka_text: नाहं तामनुशोचामि प्राकृतो वानरोऽपि सन्। महात्मा च विनीतश्च किं पुनर्धृतिमान्भवान्4.7.7।।
transliteration: nāhaṃ tāmanuśocāmi prākṛto vānaro'pi san| mahātmā ca vinītaśca kiṃ punardhṛtimānbhavān4.7.7||
translation: अहम् I am, प्राकृतः ordinary, वानरोऽपि सन् although a monkey, ताम् her (wife), न अनुशोचामि I do not brood, महात्मा च you are highsouled, विनीतश्च  humble, धृतिमान् endowed with patience, भवान् you, किं पुनः why (grieve) again.
explanation: 'I am an ordinary monkey born. Even then, I do not brood over my wife. You are highsouled, humble and patient. Why do you grieve?

shloka_text: बाष्पमापतितं धैर्यान्निग्रहीतुं त्वमर्हसि। मर्यादां सत्त्वयुक्तानां धृतिं नोत्स्रष्टुमर्हसि4.7.8।।
transliteration: bāṣpamāpatitaṃ dhairyānnigrahītuṃ tvamarhasi| maryādāṃ sattvayuktānāṃ dhṛtiṃ notsraṣṭumarhasi4.7.8||
translation: त्वम् you, आपतितम् streaming down, बाष्पम् tears, धैर्यात् with patience, निग्रहीतुम् to  restrain,  अर्हसि you ought to, सत्त्वयुक्तानाम् men endowed with equilibrium, मर्यादाम् mark, धृतिम् steadfastness, उत्स्रष्टुम् to deviate from, नार्हसि ought  not
explanation: 'Restrain the flow of your tears. Be  patient. Men (like you) endowed with  equilibrium and dignity and patience ought not to leave their composure.

shloka_text: व्यसने वाऽर्थकृच्छ्रे वा भये वा जीवितान्तके। विमृशन्वै स्वया बुद्ध्या धृतिमान्नावसीदति4.7.9।।
transliteration: vyasane vā'rthakṛcchre vā bhaye vā jīvitāntake| vimṛśanvai svayā buddhyā dhṛtimānnāvasīdati4.7.9||
translation: व्यसने वा in grief or, अर्थकृच्छ्रे वा or even over loss of wealth, जीवितान्तके at the hour of death, भये वा or in fear?, धृतिमान् one who is patient, स्वया बुद्ध्या by his own wisdom, विमृशन्  leaving, नावसीदति will not despair
explanation: 'In times of grief or loss of wealth or at the hour of death, one who is patient does not abandon his wisdom, he does not despair.

shloka_text: बालिशस्तु नरो नित्यं वैक्लब्यं योऽनुवर्तते। स मज्जत्यवशश्शोके भाराक्रान्तेव नौर्जले4.7.10।।
transliteration: bāliśastu naro nityaṃ vaiklabyaṃ yo'nuvartate| sa majjatyavaśaśśoke bhārākrānteva naurjale4.7.10||
translation: यः नरः which man, बालिशः foolish, नित्यम् always, वैक्लब्यम् despair, अनुवर्तते gives in for, सः he, अवशं he loses selfcontrol, भाराक्रान्ता burdened, नौः boat, जले इव as in the water, शोके in grief, मज्जति gets sunk
explanation: A man who is unwise and distraught only gets sunk in grief like a heavily loaded boat (sinks) in water.

shloka_text: एषोऽञ्जलिर्मया बद्धः प्रणयात्त्वां प्रसादये। पौरुषं श्रय शोकस्य नान्तरं दातुमर्हसि4.7.11।।
transliteration: eṣo'ñjalirmayā baddhaḥ praṇayāttvāṃ prasādaye| pauruṣaṃ śraya śokasya nāntaraṃ dātumarhasi4.7.11||
translation: मया by me, एषः this, अञ्जलिः folded palms, बद्धः is held, प्रणयात् out of friendship, त्वाम् you, प्रसादये be pleased, पौरुषम् manliness, श्रय you may take resort to, शोकस्य sorrow's, अन्तरम् a chance, दातुम् to give in, नार्हसि you ought not.
explanation: 'I implore you with folded palms on account of our friendship to show manliness. You should not give in to grief.

shloka_text: ये शोकमनुवर्तन्ते न तेषां विद्यते सुखम्। तेजश्च क्षीयते तेषां न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि4.7.12।।
transliteration: ye śokamanuvartante na teṣāṃ vidyate sukham| tejaśca kṣīyate teṣāṃ na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi4.7.12||
translation: ये those, शोकम् grief, अनुवर्तन्ते whoever give way, तेषाम् for them, सुखम् pleasure, न विद्यते is not there, तेषाम् for them, तेजश्च brilliance, क्षीयते is reduced, त्वम् you, शोचितुम् to grieve, नार्हसि ought not
explanation: 'There is no happiness for those who give way to sorrow. Their brilliance is dimmed. Therefore, you ought not grieve.

shloka_text: शोकेनाभिप्रपन्नस्य जीविते चापि संशयः। स शोकं त्यज राजेन्द्र धैर्यमाश्रय केवलम्4.7.13।।
transliteration: śokenābhiprapannasya jīvite cāpi saṃśayaḥ| sa śokaṃ tyaja rājendra dhairyamāśraya kevalam4.7.13||
translation: शोकेन by grief, अभिप्रपन्नस्य who is overpowered, जीविते चापि even in life, संशयः doubt, राजेन्द्र O king, सः he, शोकम् sorrow, त्यज give up, केवलम् only, धैर्यम् patience, आश्रय seek shelter
explanation: 'Even the chances of survival are doubtful for a man who is overpowered by sorrow. Give up sorrow and have patience, O king

shloka_text: हितं वयस्यभावेन ब्रूमि नोपदिशामि ते। वयस्यतां पूजयन्मे न त्वं शोचितुमर्हसि4.7.14।।
transliteration: hitaṃ vayasyabhāvena brūmi nopadiśāmi te| vayasyatāṃ pūjayanme na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi4.7.14||
translation: वयस्यतां friendly concern, पूजयन्मे offering you, हितम् ब्रूमि I am speaking, ते to you, नोपदिशामि I do not advise, मे my, वयस्यताम् friendship, पूजयन् honouring, त्वम् you, शोचितुम् to grieve, न अर्हसि you ought not to
explanation: 'Out of friendly concern I offer my opinion in your interest. I am not competent to advise you. Respecting my friendship, you should never yield to grief.'

shloka_text: मधुरं सान्त्वित स्तेन सुग्रीवेण स राघवः। मुखमश्रुपरिक्लिन्नं वस्त्रान्तेन प्रमार्जयत्4.7.15।।
transliteration: madhuraṃ sāntvita stena sugrīveṇa sa rāghavaḥ| mukhamaśrupariklinnaṃ vastrāntena pramārjayat4.7.15||
translation: तेन सुग्रीवेण by  Sugriva, मधुरम् sweet, सान्त्वितः comforted, सः राघवः that Rama, अश्रुपरिक्लिन्नम् wet with tears, मुखम् face, वस्त्रान्तेन with the hem of his upper cloth, प्रमार्जयत् wiped
explanation: Consoled by the sweet words of Sugriva, Rama wiped his face filled with tears by the hem of his upper cloth.

shloka_text: प्रकृतिस्थस्तु काकुत्स्थस्सुग्रीववचनात्प्रभुः। सम्परिष्वज्य सुग्रीवमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्4.7.16।।
transliteration: prakṛtisthastu kākutsthassugrīvavacanātprabhuḥ| sampariṣvajya sugrīvamidaṃ vacanamabravīt4.7.16||
translation: प्रभुः Lord , काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, सुग्रीववचनात् by the words of Sugriva, प्रकृतिस्थः he became composed, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, सम्परिष्वज्य after embracing, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् he spoke
explanation: When lord Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race was comforted by these words of Sugriva, he came to his senses, and clasping him said:

shloka_text: कर्तव्यं यद्वयस्येन स्निग्धेन च हितेन च। अनुरूपं च युक्तं च कृतं सुग्रीव तत्त्वया4.7.17।।
transliteration: kartavyaṃ yadvayasyena snigdhena ca hitena ca| anurūpaṃ ca yuktaṃ ca kṛtaṃ sugrīva tattvayā4.7.17||
translation: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, स्निग्धेन by a loving, हितेन च and by a wellwisher, वयस्येन by a friend, यत् whatever, कर्तव्यं duty, अनुरूपं suitable, युक्तम् proper, तत् that, त्वया by you, कृतम् done
explanation: 'O Sugriva you have done what a friend should have done in a befitting manner with your sweet words and good wishes.

shloka_text: एष च प्रकृतिस्थोऽहमनुनीतस्त्वया सखे। दुर्लभो हीदृशो बन्धुरस्मिन्काले विशेषतः4.7.18।।
transliteration: eṣa ca prakṛtistho'hamanunītastvayā sakhe| durlabho hīdṛśo bandhurasminkāle viśeṣataḥ4.7.18||
translation: सखे O friend, त्वया by you, अनुनीतः counselled by you, एषः अहम् that way I am, प्रकृतिस्थः come back to the senses, ईदृशः such, बन्धुः friend, दुर्लभः हि is difficult to find, अस्मिन् काले this time, विशेषतः specially
explanation: 'O friend you have guided me back to my senses thus. It is difficult to find a friend like you specially at this time.

shloka_text: किं तु यत्नस्त्वया कार्यो मैथिल्याः परिमार्गणे। राक्षसस्य च रौद्रस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः4.7.19।।
transliteration: kiṃ tu yatnastvayā kāryo maithilyāḥ parimārgaṇe| rākṣasasya ca raudrasya rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ4.7.19||
translation: किं तु but, त्वया by you, मैथिल्याः Maithili's, दुरात्मनः of the evilminded, राक्षसस्य demon's, रौद्रस्य of the fierce, रावणस्य Ravana's, परिमार्गणे in tracing, यत्नः effort, कार्यः do
explanation: 'Indeed, you must make effort to trace the princess from Mithila and the evilminded, fierce  demon Ravana.

shloka_text: मया च यदनुष्ठेयं विस्रब्धेन तदुच्यताम्। वर्षास्विव च सुक्षेत्रे सर्वं सम्पद्यते तव4.7.20।।
transliteration: mayā ca yadanuṣṭheyaṃ visrabdhena taducyatām| varṣāsviva ca sukṣetre sarvaṃ sampadyate tava4.7.20||
translation: मया by me, यत् that, अनुष्ठेयम् to be done, तत् that, विस्रब्धेन without any hesitation, उच्यताम् it may be, तव your, सर्वम् everything, वर्षासु in the rainy season, सुक्षेत्रे इव in a fertile land, सम्पद्यते it will produce good results.
explanation: 'Now tell me about my duty without any hesitation. I assure you that your desire will be fulfilled, just as seeds sown in a fertile land with timely rains bear fruit.

shloka_text: मया च यदिदं वाक्यमभिमानात्समीरितम्। तत्त्वया हरिशार्दूल तत्त्वमित्युपधार्यताम्4.7.21।।
transliteration: mayā ca yadidaṃ vākyamabhimānātsamīritam| tattvayā hariśārdūla tattvamityupadhāryatām4.7.21||
translation: हरिशार्दूल O tiger among monkeys, मया by me too, अभिमानात् out of injured honour, यत् those words, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, समीरितुम् have been uttered, तत् that, त्वया by you, तत्त्वम् इति appropriately, उपधार्यताम् it may be treated so
explanation: 'O tiger amongst monkeys accept my words uttered out of injured honour in their true sense.

shloka_text: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन। एतत्ते प्रतिजानामि सत्येनैव च ते शपाम्यहमं।।4.7.22।।
transliteration: anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me na ca vakṣye kadācana| etatte pratijānāmi satyenaiva ca te śapāmyahamaṃ
translation: मे by me, अनृतम् lies, न उक्तपूर्वम् never said earlier, कदाचन at any time, न वक्ष्ये च I will not tell also, एतत् this, ते to you, प्रतिजानामि I promise, अहम् I am, सत्येनैव by truth alone, च and, ते शपामि I swear
explanation: 'I have never uttered a false word earlier nor will I do it in future. This is my promise. I swear by truth alone.'

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवो वानरैस्सचिवैस्सह। राघवस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञातं विशेषतः4.7.23।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭassugrīvo vānaraissacivaissaha| rāghavasya vacaśśrutvā pratijñātaṃ viśeṣataḥ4.7.23||
translation: ततः then, सचिवैः with his counsellers, वानरैः सह with monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विशेषतः specially, प्रतिज्ञातम् his own promise, प्रहृष्टः felt glad
explanation: Sugriva and his counsellors felt glad on hearing Rama's words, particularly  the assurance given by him.

shloka_text: एवमेकान्तसम्पृक्तौ ततस्तौ नरवानरौ। उभावन्योन्यसदृशं सुखं दुःखमभाषताम्4.7.24।।
transliteration: evamekāntasampṛktau tatastau naravānarau| ubhāvanyonyasadṛśaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhamabhāṣatām4.7.24||
translation: ततः then, एवम् that way, एकान्तसम्पृक्तौ meeting in private, तौ both, नरवानरौ a man and a monkey (Rama and Sugriva), उभौ both, अन्योन्यसदृशम् in a mutually befitting manner, सुखदुःखम् joy and sorrow, अभाषताम् spoke to each other
explanation: Man and monkey then met privately and shared the weal and woe of one another.

shloka_text: महानुभावस्य वचो निशम्य हरिर्नृपाणामृषभस्य तस्य। कृतं स मेने हरिवीरमुख्य स्तदा स्वकार्यं हृदयेन विद्वान्4.7.25।।
transliteration: mahānubhāvasya vaco niśamya harirnṛpāṇāmṛṣabhasya tasya| kṛtaṃ sa mene harivīramukhya stadā svakāryaṃ hṛdayena vidvān4.7.25||
translation: विद्वान् wise man, सः he, हरिवीरमुख्यः chief of monkeys, हरिः monkey, महानुभावस्य of the magnanimous, तस्य his, नृपाणाम् of kings, रुषभस्य of the bull among men, वचः words, निशम्य after listening, तदा then, कार्यम् task, कृतम् achieved, हृदयेन at heart, मेने he thought
explanation: Wise Sugriva, chief of monkeys, heard the words of the magnanimous Rama, a bull among men. He felt glad at heart thinking that his task has been achieved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by the sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: परितुष्टस्तु सुग्रीवस्तेन वाक्येन वानरः। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो राममिदं वचनमब्रवीत्4.8.1।।
transliteration: parituṣṭastu sugrīvastena vākyena vānaraḥ| lakṣmaṇasyāgrato rāmamidaṃ vacanamabravīt4.8.1||
translation: वानरः monkey, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तेन वाक्येन by the words, परितुष्टः very pleased, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अग्रतः in front, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् he spoke.
explanation: Sugriva, the monkey was very pleased with Rama's words and said to him in front of Lakshmana:
comments: Sugriva feels happy about his friendship with Rama -- solicits Vali's death -- relates to Rama about Vali's hostile attitude and his enmity with him.

shloka_text: सर्वथाऽहमनुग्राह्यो देवतानां न संशयः। उपपन्न गुणोपेतस्सखा यस्य भवान्मम4.8.2।।
transliteration: sarvathā'hamanugrāhyo devatānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ| upapanna guṇopetassakhā yasya bhavānmama4.8.2||
translation: उपपन्नः come, गुणोपेतः endowed with all virtues, भवान् yourself, यस्य मम you to me, सखा friend, अहम् I am, सर्वथा in all respects, देवतानाम्  of gods, अनुग्राह्यः worthy of favour, संशयः doubt, न no.
explanation: 'Since one like you endowed with all virtues has become my friend I am (now) worthy of grace of the gods in all respects. There is no doubt.

shloka_text: शक्यं खलु भवेद्राम सहायेन त्वयाऽनघ। सुरराज्यमपि प्राप्तुं स्वराज्यं किं पनः प्रभो 4.8.3।।
transliteration: śakyaṃ khalu bhavedrāma sahāyena tvayā'nagha| surarājyamapi prāptuṃ svarājyaṃ kiṃ panaḥ prabho 4.8.3||
translation: अनघ sinless, प्रभो O Lord, राम Rama, त्वया by you, सहायेन with help, सुरराज्यमपि even the kingdom of the gods, प्राप्तुम् to attain, शक्यम् possible, स्वराज्यम् my own kingdom, किं पुनः what to speak
explanation: 'O Rama, my sinless Lord, it is possible to attain even the kingdom of the gods with your help, what  to speak of my own kingdom?

shloka_text: सोऽहं सभाज्यो बन्धूनां सुहृदां चैव राघव। यस्याग्निसाक्षिकं मित्रं लब्धं राघववंशजम्4.8.4।।
transliteration: so'haṃ sabhājyo bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāṃ caiva rāghava| yasyāgnisākṣikaṃ mitraṃ labdhaṃ rāghavavaṃśajam4.8.4||
translation: राघव Rama, यस्य whose, राघववंशजम् born in Raghava dynasty, मित्रम् friend, अग्निसाक्षिकम्  fire as witness, लब्धम् got, सः अहम् that I, बन्धूनाम्  among relatives, सुहृदां चैव also among friends, सभाज्यः became equally honourable.
explanation: 'O Rama, since you, born in Raghava dynasty, have become my friend with fire as witness, I have become equally honourable among my relatives and friends.

shloka_text: अहमप्यनुरूपस्ते वयस्यो ज्ञास्यसे शनैः। न तु वक्तुं समर्थोऽहं स्वयमात्मगतान्गुणान्4.8.5।।
transliteration: ahamapyanurūpaste vayasyo jñāsyase śanaiḥ| na tu vaktuṃ samartho'haṃ svayamātmagatānguṇān4.8.5||
translation: अहमपि I am also, ते to you, अनुरूपः worthy, वयस्यः friend, शनैः slowly, ज्ञास्यसे you will know, अहम् I am, इमान् those, आत्मगुणान् my own qualities, स्वयम् myself, वक्तुम् to speak of, समर्थः proper, न not
explanation: 'You will come to know slowly that I am also a friend worthy of you.It is not proper for me to speak of my qualities( flatter myself).

shloka_text: महात्मनां तु भूयिष्ठं त्वद्विधानां कृतात्मनाम्। निश्चला भवति प्रीतिर्धैर्यमात्मवतामिव4.8.6।।
transliteration: mahātmanāṃ tu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ tvadvidhānāṃ kṛtātmanām| niścalā bhavati prītirdhairyamātmavatāmiva4.8.6||
translation: आत्मवताम् wellcomposed, कृतात्मनाम्  selfcontrolled, त्वद्विधानाम् of men like you, महात्मनाम् of the exalted souls, प्रीतिः affection, भूयिष्ठम् exceedingly, निश्चला stable, भवति will be, धैर्यम् patience.
explanation: 'The affection of exalted souls is exceedingly stable like the patience of  selfcontrolled and wellcomposed men like you.

shloka_text: रजतं वा सुवर्णं वा वस्त्राण्याभरणानि च। अविभक्तानि साधूनामवगच्छन्ति साधवः4.8.7।।
transliteration: rajataṃ vā suvarṇaṃ vā vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca| avibhaktāni sādhūnāmavagacchanti sādhavaḥ4.8.7||
translation: साधूनाम्  good friends, रजतं वा silver or, सुवर्णं वा gold, वस्त्राणि clothes, आभरणानि च and ornaments, अविभक्तानि not divisible, साधवः men who go in one's way, अवगच्छन्ति will consider.
explanation: 'Good friends consider(valuables such as) silver or gold, clothes or ornaments of worldly wealth indivisible.

shloka_text: आढ्यो वापि दरिद्रो वा दुःखितस्सुखितोऽपि वा। निर्दोषो वा सदोषो वा वयस्यः परमा गतिः4.8.8।।
transliteration: āḍhyo vāpi daridro vā duḥkhitassukhito'pi vā| nirdoṣo vā sadoṣo vā vayasyaḥ paramā gatiḥ4.8.8||
translation: आढ्यो वापि whether a rich man, दरिद्रो वा or poor, दुःखितः or sad one, सुखितोऽपि वा or a happy man, निर्दोषो flawless one, सदोषः guilty, वयस्यः a friend, परमा ultimate, गतिः refuge.
explanation: 'Whether rich or poor, afflicted or happy, flawless or guilty, a friend is the ultimate refuge to a friend.

shloka_text: धनत्यागस्सुखत्यागो देहत्यागोऽपि वा पुनः। वयस्यार्थे प्रवर्तन्ते स्नेहं दृष्टवा तथाविधम्4.8.9।।
transliteration: dhanatyāgassukhatyāgo dehatyāgo'pi vā punaḥ| vayasyārthe pravartante snehaṃ dṛṣṭavā tathāvidham4.8.9||
translation: स्नेहम् friendship, तथाविधम् that kind, दृष्ट्वा after finding, वयस्यार्थे for the sake of a friend, धनत्यागः to sacrifice wealth, सुखत्यागः to sacrifice happiness, देहत्यागोऽपि वा or sacrifice even life, प्रवर्तन्ते undertake
explanation: 'One will not hesitate to sacrifice wealth or happiness or even life for the sake of a friend like you.'

shloka_text: तत्तथेत्यब्रवीद्रामस्सुग्रीवं प्रियवादिनम्। लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतो लक्ष्म्या वासवस्येव धीमतः4.8.10।।
transliteration: tattathetyabravīdrāmassugrīvaṃ priyavādinam| lakṣmaṇasyāgrato lakṣmyā vāsavasyeva dhīmataḥ4.8.10||
translation: रामः Rama, वासवस्य इव like Indra, धीमतः wise, लक्ष्म्या by signs, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अग्रतः in the presence of, प्रियवादिनम् pleasant speaker, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, तत् that, तथा it is true, इति thus, अब्रवीत् he spoke.
explanation: As wise Lakshmana, brilliant like Indra stood witness, Rama said, 'it is true as you say' to Sugriva who spoke pleasing words.

shloka_text: ततो रामं स्थितं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। सुग्रीवस्सर्वतश्चक्षुर्वने लोलमपातयत्4.8.11।।
transliteration: tato rāmaṃ sthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam| sugrīvassarvataścakṣurvane lolamapātayat4.8.11||
translation: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, स्थितम् standing, रामम् Rama, महाबलम् strong, लक्ष्मणं च Lakshmana also, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, लोलम् moving unsteadily, चक्षुः his eyes, वने in the forest, सर्वतः all sides, अपातयत् cast.
explanation: With mighty Rama and Lakshmana standing by, Sugriva cast his eyes eagerly all round the forest.

shloka_text: स ददर्श ततस्सालमविदूरे हरीश्वरः। सुपुष्पमीषत्पत्राढ्यं भ्रमरैरुपशोभितम्4.8.12।।
transliteration: sa dadarśa tatassālamavidūre harīśvaraḥ| supuṣpamīṣatpatrāḍhyaṃ bhramarairupaśobhitam4.8.12||
translation: ततः then, सः हरीश्वरः chief of monkeys, अविदूरे not very far, सुपुष्पम् having flowers, ईषत्पत्राढ्यम् with a few leaves, भ्रमरैः by bees, उपशोभितम् looking graceful, सालम् sala tree, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Then the chief of monkeys saw a sala tree looking lovely with tender leaves and flowers graced by bees.

shloka_text: तस्यैकां पर्णबहुलां भङ्क्त्वा शाखां सुपुष्पिताम्। सालस्यास्तीर्य सुग्रीवो निषसाद सराघवः4.8.13।।
transliteration: tasyaikāṃ parṇabahulāṃ bhaṅktvā śākhāṃ supuṣpitām| sālasyāstīrya sugrīvo niṣasāda sarāghavaḥ4.8.13||
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तस्य its, पर्णबहुलाम्  with plenty of leaves, सुशोभिताम् beautifully  blossomed, एकां शाखाम् one branch, भङ्क्त्वा broke, रामस्य for Rama, आस्तीर्य spread, स राघवः with Rama, निषसाद sat.
explanation: Sugriva cut a branch of the beautifully blossomed sala tree with plenty of leaves,   spread it (on the ground) and squatted along with Rama.

shloka_text: तावासीनौ ततो दृष्ट्वा हनूमानपि लक्ष्मणम्। सालशाखां समुत्पाट्य विनीतमुपवेशयत्4.8.14।।
transliteration: tāvāsīnau tato dṛṣṭvā hanūmānapi lakṣmaṇam| sālaśākhāṃ samutpāṭya vinītamupaveśayat4.8.14||
translation: ततः thereafter, हनूमानपि Hanuman also, आसीनौ seated, तौ both Rama and Sugriva, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, सालशाखाम् a branch of sala tree, समुत्पाट्य  broke, विनीतम् obedient, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, उपवेशयत् made him sit.
explanation: Thereafter Hanuman also broke a branch of the sala tree and seated Lakshmana on it.

shloka_text: सुखोपविष्टं रामं तु प्रसन्नमुदधिं यथा। फलपुष्पसमाकीर्णे तस्मिन् गिरिवरोत्तमे4.8.15।। ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवश्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा। उवाच प्रणयाद्रामं हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम्4.8.16।।
transliteration: sukhopaviṣṭaṃ rāmaṃ tu prasannamudadhiṃ yathā| phalapuṣpasamākīrṇe tasmin girivarottame4.8.15|| tataḥ prahṛṣṭassugrīvaślakṣṇaṃ madhurayā girā| uvāca praṇayādrāmaṃ harṣavyākulitākṣaram4.8.16||
translation: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, फलपुष्पमाकीर्णे in a place filled with flowers and fruits, तस्मिन् in that, गिरिवरोत्तमे on the best of mountains, सुखोपविष्टम् seated comfortably, प्रसन्नम् peaceful, उदधिं यथा like an ocean, रामम् Rama, श्लक्ष्णम् softly, मधुरया sweetly, गिरा words, हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम् mixing up words due to extreme joy and excitement, प्रणयात् out of love, उवाच said.
explanation: Now Rama, seated comfortably on the best of mountains overgrown with trees full of flowers and fruits, appeared tranguil like an ocean. Extremely delighted and excited, Sugriva spoke to Rama words that got mixed up with softness and sweetness out of love:

shloka_text: सुखोपविष्टं रामं तु प्रसन्नमुदधिं यथा। फलपुष्पसमाकीर्णे तस्मिन् गिरिवरोत्तमे4.8.15।। ततः प्रहृष्टस्सुग्रीवश्लक्ष्णं मधुरया गिरा। उवाच प्रणयाद्रामं हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम्4.8.16।।
transliteration: sukhopaviṣṭaṃ rāmaṃ tu prasannamudadhiṃ yathā| phalapuṣpasamākīrṇe tasmin girivarottame4.8.15|| tataḥ prahṛṣṭassugrīvaślakṣṇaṃ madhurayā girā| uvāca praṇayādrāmaṃ harṣavyākulitākṣaram4.8.16||
translation: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, फलपुष्पमाकीर्णे in a place filled with flowers and fruits, तस्मिन् in that, गिरिवरोत्तमे on the best of mountains, सुखोपविष्टम् seated comfortably, प्रसन्नम् peaceful, उदधिं यथा like an ocean, रामम् Rama, श्लक्ष्णम् softly, मधुरया sweetly, गिरा words, हर्षव्याकुलिताक्षरम् mixing up words due to extreme joy and excitement, प्रणयात् out of love, उवाच said.
explanation: Now Rama, seated comfortably on the best of mountains overgrown with trees full of flowers and fruits, appeared tranguil like an ocean. Extremely delighted and excited, Sugriva spoke to Rama words that got mixed up with softness and sweetness out of love:

shloka_text: अहं विनिकृतो भ्रात्रा चराम्येष भयार्दितः। ऋष्यमूकं गिरिवरं हृतभार्यस्सुदुःखितः4.8.17।।
transliteration: ahaṃ vinikṛto bhrātrā carāmyeṣa bhayārditaḥ| ṛṣyamūkaṃ girivaraṃ hṛtabhāryassuduḥkhitaḥ4.8.17||
translation: भ्रात्रा  brother, विनिकृतः offended, एषः here I am, अहम् I, भयार्दितः frightened, हृतभार्यः wife stolen, सुदुःखितः very sad, गिरिवरम् great mountain, ऋश्यमूकम् Rishyamuka, चरामि I am roaming .
explanation: 'I am sadly roaming here in the great Rishyamuka mountain, my wife stolen, offended by my brother and frightened.

shloka_text: सोऽहं त्रस्तो भये मग्नो वसाम्युद्भ्रान्तचेतनः। वालिना निकृतो भ्रात्रा कृतवैरश्च राघव4.8.18।।
transliteration: so'haṃ trasto bhaye magno vasāmyudbhrāntacetanaḥ| vālinā nikṛto bhrātrā kṛtavairaśca rāghava4.8.18||
translation: राघव Rama, भ्रात्रा brother, वालिना by Vali, निकृतः deceived, कृतवैरश्च developed enmity, सः अहम् that I am, त्रस्तः terrified, सम्भ्रान्तचेतनः utterly confused, वने in the forest, भये with fear, मग्नः stricken.
explanation: 'O Rama my brother is my enemy. Deceived and threatened by him, I live in the forest stricken with fear and utterly confused.

shloka_text: वालिनो मे भयार्तस्य सर्वलोकाभयङ्कर। ममापि त्वमनाथस्य प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि4.8.19।।
transliteration: vālino me bhayārtasya sarvalokābhayaṅkara| mamāpi tvamanāthasya prasādaṃ kartumarhasi4.8.19||
translation: सर्वलोकाभयङ्कर O warrior who can threaten people of all worlds, मे to me, वालिनः from Vali, भयार्तस्य of one scared and helpless, अनाथस्य of an orphan, ममापि for me, त्वम् you, प्रसादम् grace, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि ought to.
explanation: 'O great warrior who can frighten all the worlds scared of Vali, I feel  helpless like an orphan to whom you ought to extend your grace.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु तेजस्वी धर्मज्ञो धर्मवत्सलः। प्रत्युवाच स काकुत्स्थस्सुग्रीवं प्रहसन्निव4.8.20।।
transliteration: evamuktastu tejasvī dharmajño dharmavatsalaḥ| pratyuvāca sa kākutsthassugrīvaṃ prahasanniva4.8.20||
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, तेजस्वी glorious, धर्मज्ञः knower of duty , धर्मवत्सलः a lover of dharma, सः काकुत्स्थः that Kakustha, प्रहसन्निव gentle smile on his face, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, प्रत्युवाच replied
explanation: Thus spoken to, the glorious Rama, lover of righteousness who knew his duty, replied to Sugriva with a smile on his face:

shloka_text: उपकारफलं मित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम्। अद्यैव तं हनिष्यामि तव भार्यापहारिणम्4.8.21।।
transliteration: upakāraphalaṃ mitramapakāro'rilakṣaṇam| adyaiva taṃ haniṣyāmi tava bhāryāpahāriṇam4.8.21||
translation: मित्रम्ज्ञ a friend, उपकारफलम् carries the fruit of help, अपकारः harm, अरिलक्षणम् an enemy's characteristic feature, तव your, भार्यापहारिणम् wrested your wife, तम् him, अद्यैव this very day, वधिष्यामि I will kill.
explanation: 'While a friend is known for his help, an enemy is known for his offensiveness. I will this very day kill the one who wrested your wife.

shloka_text: इमे हि मे महावेगा पत्रिणस्तिग्मतेजसः। कार्तिकेयवनोद्भूताश्शरा हेमविभूषिताः4.8.22।। कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः। सुपर्वाणस्सुतीक्ष्णाग्रास्सरोषा भुजगा इव4.8.23।।
transliteration: ime hi me mahāvegā patriṇastigmatejasaḥ| kārtikeyavanodbhūtāśśarā hemavibhūṣitāḥ4.8.22|| kaṅkapatraparicchannā mahendrāśanisannibhāḥ| suparvāṇassutīkṣṇāgrāssaroṣā bhujagā iva4.8.23||
translation: महावेगाः of high speed, मे my, पत्रिणः winged ones, इमे these , शराःarrows, तिग्मतेजसः glowing like fierce fire, कार्तिकेयवनोद्भताः born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds, हेमविभूषिताः decked with gold, कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्नाः covered with kanka feathers, महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः  comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt, सुपर्वाणः those with smooth joints, सुतीक्ष्णाग्राः  with very sharp and pointed tips, सरोषाः angry, भुजगाः serpents, इव like.
explanation: 'Here are my highspeed, winged arrows glowing like fierce fire, born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds.They are smooth and welljointed, decked with gold, comparable in strength to great Indra's thunderbolt, very sharp with pointed tips looking like angry serpents.

shloka_text: इमे हि मे महावेगा पत्रिणस्तिग्मतेजसः। कार्तिकेयवनोद्भूताश्शरा हेमविभूषिताः4.8.22।। कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्ना महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः। सुपर्वाणस्सुतीक्ष्णाग्रास्सरोषा भुजगा इव4.8.23।।
transliteration: ime hi me mahāvegā patriṇastigmatejasaḥ| kārtikeyavanodbhūtāśśarā hemavibhūṣitāḥ4.8.22|| kaṅkapatraparicchannā mahendrāśanisannibhāḥ| suparvāṇassutīkṣṇāgrāssaroṣā bhujagā iva4.8.23||
translation: महावेगाः of high speed, मे my, पत्रिणः winged ones, इमे these , शराःarrows, तिग्मतेजसः glowing like fierce fire, कार्तिकेयवनोद्भताः born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds, हेमविभूषिताः decked with gold, कङ्कपत्रपरिच्छन्नाः covered with kanka feathers, महेन्द्राशनिसन्निभाः  comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt, सुपर्वाणः those with smooth joints, सुतीक्ष्णाग्राः  with very sharp and pointed tips, सरोषाः angry, भुजगाः serpents, इव like.
explanation: 'Here are my highspeed, winged arrows glowing like fierce fire, born out of Kartikeya's bed of reeds.They are smooth and welljointed, decked with gold, comparable in strength to great Indra's thunderbolt, very sharp with pointed tips looking like angry serpents.

shloka_text: भ्रातृसंज्ञममित्रं ते वालिनं कृतकिल्बिषम्। शरैर्विनिहतं पश्य विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम्4.8.24।।
transliteration: bhrātṛsaṃjñamamitraṃ te vālinaṃ kṛtakilbiṣam| śarairvinihataṃ paśya vikīrṇamiva parvatam4.8.24||
translation: ते your, वालिनम् at Vali, कृतकिल्बिषम् doer of wrong deeds, वालिसंज्ञम् calls Vali's brother, अमित्रम् enemy, शरैः by arrows, विनिहतम् being killed, विकीर्णम् shattered, पर्वतम् इव crushed like a mountain, पश्य you may see.
explanation: 'Vali who calls himself your brother is your enemy and a doer of wrong deeds. You will see him crushed, like a mountain shattered, by my arrows.'

shloka_text: राघवस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवो वाहिनीपतिः। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे साधु साध्विति चाब्रवीत्4.8.25।।
transliteration: rāghavasya vacaśśrutvā sugrīvo vāhinīpatiḥ| praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe sādhu sādhviti cābravīt4.8.25||
translation: वाहिनीपतिः chief of the army (of monkeys), सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राघवस्य Rama's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अतुलम् immeasurable, प्रहर्षम् happiness, लेभे attained, साधु साधु इति good good thus, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: On hearing Rama's words, Sugriva, chief of the army of monkeys experienced immeasurable happiness and exclaimed, 'you're great, you're great.'

shloka_text: राम शोकाभिभूतोऽहं शोकार्तानां भवान्गतिः। वयस्य इति कृत्वा हि त्वय्यहं परिदेवये4.8.26।।
transliteration: rāma śokābhibhūto'haṃ śokārtānāṃ bhavāngatiḥ| vayasya iti kṛtvā hi tvayyahaṃ paridevaye4.8.26||
translation: राम  Rama, अहम् I am, शोकाभिभूतः overcome with sorrow, शोकार्तानाम् for those in sorrow, भवान् you are, गतिः refuge, वयस्यः friend, इति कृत्वा treating you like this, अहम् I am, त्वयि to you, परिदेवये express.
explanation: 'Rama I am overwhelmed with sorrow. You are the refuge of the distressed. As you are a friend I ventilate all my grief to you.

shloka_text: त्वं हि पाणिप्रदानेन वयस्यो मेऽग्निसाक्षिकम्। कृतः प्राणैर्बहुमतस्सत्येनापि शपामि ते4.8.27।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi pāṇipradānena vayasyo me'gnisākṣikam| kṛtaḥ prāṇairbahumatassatyenāpi śapāmi te4.8.27||
translation: त्वम् you, पाणिप्रदानेन by offering your hand in friendship, अग्निसाक्षिकम् with fire as witness, कृतः did, प्राणैः more than life, बहुमतः very great, मे वयस्यः हि being my friend, अहम् I am, सत्येन truly, शपामि  vow, ते to you.
explanation: 'I value your hand of friendship extended to me, with fire as witness more than my very life. I, on my own, offer my pledge of friendship.

shloka_text: वयस्य इति कृत्वा च विस्रब्धः प्रवदाम्यहम्। दुःखमन्तर्गतं यन्मे मनो हरति नित्यशः4.8.28।।
transliteration: vayasya iti kṛtvā ca visrabdhaḥ pravadāmyaham| duḥkhamantargataṃ yanme mano harati nityaśaḥ4.8.28||
translation: वयस्यः इति कृत्वा च also considering you as a friend, अहम् I am, विस्रब्धः  relaxed , प्रवदामि I am speaking, मे अन्तर्गतम् my feelings, दुःखम् sorrow, नित्यशः always, मनः mind, हरति is tormenting me.
explanation: Considering you a friend, I speak frankly of the sorrow hidden within me that constantly torments my mind.

shloka_text: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं बाष्पदूषितलोचनः। बाष्पोपहतया वाचा नोच्चैश्शक्नोति भाषितुम्4.8.29।।
transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ bāṣpadūṣitalocanaḥ| bāṣpopahatayā vācā noccaiśśaknoti bhāṣitum4.8.29||
translation: एतावत् till that, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा spoken, बाष्पदूषितलोचनः vision blurred by tears, बाष्पदूषितया choked with tears, वाचा with words, उच्चैः loudly, भाषितुम् to speak further, न शक्नोति was not able to do.
explanation: His vision blurred, words choked with tears he was unable to speak further.

shloka_text: बाष्पवेगं तु सहसा नदीवेगमिवागतम्। धारयामास धैर्येण सुग्रीवो रामसन्निधौ4.8.30।।
transliteration: bāṣpavegaṃ tu sahasā nadīvegamivāgatam| dhārayāmāsa dhairyeṇa sugrīvo rāmasannidhau4.8.30||
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामसन्निधौ in front of Rama, नदीवेगमिव like a rushing river, सहसा instantaneously, आगतम् flowing, बाष्पवेगम् fast flowing tears, धैर्येण with patience, धारयामास checked
explanation: Quickly Sugriva controlled his tears streaming fast like the rushing river, with patience, Rama seated in front.

shloka_text: सन्निगृह्य तु तं बाष्पं प्रमृज्य नयने शुभे। विनिश्श्वस्य च तेजस्वी राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.8.31।।
transliteration: sannigṛhya tu taṃ bāṣpaṃ pramṛjya nayane śubhe| viniśśvasya ca tejasvī rāghavaṃ vākyamabravīt4.8.31||
translation: तेजस्वी  brilliant, सः he, तं बाष्पम् his tears, निगृह्य  controlled, शुभे auspicious, नयने eyes, प्रमृज्य wiped, विनिःश्वस्य took deep breath, राघवम् to Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said
explanation: Effulgent Sugriva controlled his tears, wiped his bright eyes, took deep breath and said to Rama:

shloka_text: पुराऽहं वालिना राम राज्यात्स्वादवरोपितः। परुषाणि च संश्राव्य निर्धूतोऽस्मि बलीयसा4.8.32।।
transliteration: purā'haṃ vālinā rāma rājyātsvādavaropitaḥ| paruṣāṇi ca saṃśrāvya nirdhūto'smi balīyasā4.8.32||
translation: राम O Rama, पुरा in the past, अहम् I, बलीयसा powerful, वालिना by Vali, स्वात् from my  own, राज्यात् from the kingdom, अवरोपितः was uprooted, परुषाणि harsh (words), संश्राव्य making me listen, निर्धूतः thrown out, अस्मि I am.
explanation: 'O Rama I was subjected to the harsh words of powerful Vali in the past when he uprooted me from  the kingdom and threw me out.

shloka_text: हृता भार्या च मे तेन प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी। सुहृदश्च मदीया ये संयता बन्धनेषु ते4.8.33।।
transliteration: hṛtā bhāryā ca me tena prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī| suhṛdaśca madīyā ye saṃyatā bandhaneṣu te4.8.33||
translation: तेन by him, प्राणेभ्योऽपि than my own life, गरीयसी dearer, मे भार्या my wife, हृता robbed, मदीयाः my, ये whoever, सुहृदः friends, ते they, बन्धनेषु under arrest, संयताः imprisoned.
explanation: 'I was robbed of my wife who is dearer than my own life. All my friends were rounded up and imprisoned.

shloka_text: यत्नवांश्च सुदुष्टात्मा मद्विनाशाय राघव। बहुशस्तत्प्रयुक्ताश्च वानरा निहता मया4.8.34।।
transliteration: yatnavāṃśca suduṣṭātmā madvināśāya rāghava| bahuśastatprayuktāśca vānarā nihatā mayā4.8.34||
translation: राघव O Rama, दुष्टात्मा evilminded, सः he was, मद्विनाशाय to kill me, यत्नवांश्च made effort, बहुशः in many ways, तत्प्रयुक्ताः  sent by him, वानराः monkeys, मया by myself, निहताः were killed.
explanation: 'O Rama this evilminded one made several attempts to kill me. The monkeys he sent to kill me were themselves killed.

shloka_text: शङ्कया त्वेतया चेह दृष्ट्वा त्वामपि राघव। नोपसर्पाम्यहं भीतो भये सर्वे हि बिभ्यति4.8.35।।
transliteration: śaṅkayā tvetayā ceha dṛṣṭvā tvāmapi rāghava| nopasarpāmyahaṃ bhīto bhaye sarve hi bibhyati4.8.35||
translation: राघव Rama, अहं च I also, एतया by that, शङ्कया with doubt, त्वाम् अपि you also, इह here, दृष्ट्वा seeing, भीतः scared, नोपसर्पामि I did not come near, भये out of fear, सर्वे all, बिभ्यति हि one is scared.
explanation: 'It is because of suspicion that I did not approach you. Every one is scared when there is ample reason to fear.

shloka_text: केवलं हि सहाया मे हनुमत्प्रमुखास्त्विमे। अतोऽहं धारयाम्यद्य प्राणान् कृच्छ्रगतोऽपि सन्4.8.36।।
transliteration: kevalaṃ hi sahāyā me hanumatpramukhāstvime| ato'haṃ dhārayāmyadya prāṇān kṛcchragato'pi san4.8.36||
translation: केवलम् only, इमे these, हनुमत्प्रमुखाः Hanuman and other chiefs, मे to me, सहायाः helpful ones, अतः therefore, अहम् I, कृच्छ्रगतोऽपि सन् in spite of all difficulties, अद्य now, प्राणान् life, धारयामि I am surviving.
explanation: 'Only Hanuman and other chiefs are helping me. Therefore, I am surviving in spite of all difficulties.

shloka_text: एते हि कपयस्स्निग्धा मां रक्षन्ति समन्ततः। सह गच्छन्ति गन्तव्ये नित्यं तिष्ठन्ति च स्थिते4.8.37।।
transliteration: ete hi kapayassnigdhā māṃ rakṣanti samantataḥ| saha gacchanti gantavye nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti ca sthite4.8.37||
translation: स्निग्धाः affectionate, एते these, कपयः monkeys, माम् me, समन्ततः on all sides, रक्षन्ति protecting, गन्तव्ये  have to go, सह with any one, गच्छन्ति they go, स्थितौ stay when I stay, तिष्ठन्ति च stop.
explanation: 'These monkeys out of love for me keep me protected from all sides. They go out with me when it is necessary and stay back whenever I stop (in order to guard me).

shloka_text: सङ्क्षेपस्त्वेष मे राम किमुक्त्वा विस्तरं हि ते। स मे ज्येष्ठो रिपुर्भ्राता वाली विश्रुतपौरुषः4.8.38।।
transliteration: saṅkṣepastveṣa me rāma kimuktvā vistaraṃ hi te| sa me jyeṣṭho ripurbhrātā vālī viśrutapauruṣaḥ4.8.38||
translation: राम O Rama, एषः this, मे my, सङ्क्षेपः in brief, ते to you, विस्तरम् in detail, उक्त्वा telling, किम् why, मे my, भ्राता brother, विश्रुतपौरुषः a man of wellknown prowess, सः वाली that Vali, रिपुः enemy.
explanation: 'O Rama I tell you (my story) briefly. It is not necessary to go into details. My elder brother Vali, who is known for his prowess, is my enemy.

shloka_text: तद्विनाशाद्धि मे दुःखं प्रणष्टं स्यादनन्तरम्। सुखं मे जीवितं चैव तद्विनाशनिबन्धनम्4.8.39।।
transliteration: tadvināśāddhi me duḥkhaṃ praṇaṣṭaṃ syādanantaram| sukhaṃ me jīvitaṃ caiva tadvināśanibandhanam4.8.39||
translation: तद्विनाशाद्धि only after he is killed, अनन्तरम् thereafter, मे my, दुःखम् sorrow, प्रणष्टम् can vanish, स्यात् will be, मे my, सुखम् happiness, जीवितं चैव and life also, तद्विनाशनिबन्धनम् is subject to his destruction.
explanation: 'My sorrow will go only with his death. My happiness and my life are also subject to his destruction.

shloka_text: एष मे राम शोकान्तश्शोकार्तेन निवेदितः। दुःखितस्सुखितो वापि सख्युर्नित्यं सखा गतिः4.8.40।।
transliteration: eṣa me rāma śokāntaśśokārtena niveditaḥ| duḥkhitassukhito vāpi sakhyurnityaṃ sakhā gatiḥ4.8.40||
translation: राम Rama, शोकार्तेन out of sorrow, मे my, एषः this, शोकान्तः end the sorrow, निवेदितः  explained to you, सख्युः for a friend, दुःखितः unhappy, सुखितो वापि or happy, सखा a friend, गतिः is the only refuge.
explanation: 'This what I had to tell you out of sorrow. This is how my sorrow will end. In joy and in sorrow your friend is your refuge.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वैतद्वचनं रामस्सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्। किं निमित्तमभूद्वैरं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः4.8.41।।
transliteration: śrutvaitadvacanaṃ rāmassugrīvamidamabravīt| kiṃ nimittamabhūdvairaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ4.8.41||
translation: रामः Rama, एतत् these, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् he spoke, किं निमित्तम् for what reason, वैरम् enmity, अभूत् was caused, तत्त्वतः truly, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि I wish
explanation: After hearing  Sugriva, Rama said 'I wish to know the actual cause of this enmity.

shloka_text: सुखं हि कारणं श्रुत्वा वैरस्य तव वानर। अनन्तरं विधास्यामि सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलम्4.8.42।।
transliteration: sukhaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ śrutvā vairasya tava vānara| anantaraṃ vidhāsyāmi sampradhārya balābalam4.8.42||
translation: वानर O monkey, तव your, वैरस्य enmity's, कारणम् cause, श्रुत्वा after hearing, बलाबलम् strength or weakness, सम्प्रधार्य after measuring, आनन्तर्यात् thereafter, सुखम् विधास्यामि I will take action to make you happy.
explanation: 'On hearing the cause of your enmity and considering your strength and weakness, I will take steps to make you happy.

shloka_text: बलवान् हि ममामर्षश्श्रुत्वा त्वामवमानितम्। वर्तते हृदयोत्कम्पी प्रावृड्वेग इवाम्भसः4.8.43।।
transliteration: balavān hi mamāmarṣaśśrutvā tvāmavamānitam| vartate hṛdayotkampī prāvṛḍvega ivāmbhasaḥ4.8.43||
translation: त्वाम् your, अवमानितम् insulted, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मम my, हृदयोत्कम्पी heart is agitated, बलवान् strong, आमर्षः restless, अम्भसः rain water, प्रापृड्वेग इव  enraged , वर्तते feels
explanation: 'On hearing about your humiliation I feel highly agitated at heart. I feel very much angry and restless like the water in rainy season.

shloka_text: हृष्टः कथय विस्रब्धो यावदारोप्यते धनुः। सृष्टश्च हि मया बाणो निरस्तश्च रिपुस्तव4.8.44।।
transliteration: hṛṣṭaḥ kathaya visrabdho yāvadāropyate dhanuḥ| sṛṣṭaśca hi mayā bāṇo nirastaśca ripustava4.8.44||
translation: मया by me, धनुः bow, यावत् until, आरोप्यते is strung, बाणः arrow, सृष्टश्च on the release, तव your, रिपुः enemy, निरस्तश्च will be destroyed, हृष्टः happily, विस्रब्धः freely, कथय speak.
explanation: 'Tell me freely and cheerfully before I string the bow. Your enemy will be destroyed as soon as I release my arrow.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवः काकुत्स्थेन महात्मना। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे चतुर्भिस्सह वानरैः4.8.45।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvaḥ kākutsthena mahātmanā| praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe caturbhissaha vānaraiḥ4.8.45||
translation: महात्मना by the great, काकुत्स्थेन by Rama, एवम् that way, उक्तः having been told, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, चतुर्भिः with all the four, वानरैः सह with monkeys, अतुलम् immeasurable, प्रहर्षम् joy, लेभे felt.
explanation: When the great Rama said this, Sugriva with all the four monkeys felt immeasurably glad.

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टवदनस्सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणाग्रजे। वैरस्य कारणं तत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे4.8.46।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭavadanassugrīvo lakṣmaṇāgraje| vairasya kāraṇaṃ tattvamākhyātumupacakrame4.8.46||
translation: ततः then, प्रहृष्टवदनः  smiling face, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वैरस्य on account of enmity, कारणम् cause, तत्त्वम् facts, लक्ष्मणाग्रजे to the elder brother of Lakshmana, आख्यातुम् to tell, उपचक्रमे started.
explanation: With a smile on his face, Sugriva started narrating to Lakshmana's elder brother the facts about the cause of his enmity (with Vali). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः Thus ends the eighth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: वाली नाम मम भ्राता ज्येष्ठश्शत्रुनिषूदनः। पितुर्बहुमतो नित्यं ममापि च तथा पुरा4.9.1।।
transliteration: vālī nāma mama bhrātā jyeṣṭhaśśatruniṣūdanaḥ| piturbahumato nityaṃ mamāpi ca tathā purā4.9.1||
translation: शत्रुनिषूदनः an exterminater of enemies, वाली नाम called Vali , मम my, ज्येष्ठः भ्राता elder brother, नित्यम् always, पितुः father, बहुमतः very highly regarded, पुरा earlier, मम चापि even me also, तथा that way.
explanation: 'My elder brother called Vali, capable of exterminating enemies was always highly regarded by my father and me.
comments: Episode of Vali's fight with Mayavi -- installation of Sugriva as king of Kishkinda -- return of Vali to Kishkinda.

shloka_text: पितर्युपरतेऽस्माकं ज्येष्ठोऽयमिति मन्त्रिभिः। कपीनामीश्वरो राज्ये कृतः परमसम्मतः4.9.2।।
transliteration: pitaryuparate'smākaṃ jyeṣṭho'yamiti mantribhiḥ| kapīnāmīśvaro rājye kṛtaḥ paramasammataḥ4.9.2||
translation: तस्मिन् he, पितरि my father, उपरते demise, अयम् this, ज्येष्ठः इति being  elder, राज्ये in the kingdom, परमसम्मतः with the acceptance of all, कपीनाम् ईश्वरः king of monkeys, मन्त्रिभिः including ministers, कृतः made.
explanation: On the death of our father, the ministers, holding him the elder, installed this one as the highly esteemed king of the monkeys.

shloka_text: राज्यं प्रशासतस्तस्य पितृपैतामहं महत्। अहं सर्वेषु कालेषु प्रणतः प्रेष्यवत् स्थितः4.9.3।।
transliteration: rājyaṃ praśāsatastasya pitṛpaitāmahaṃ mahat| ahaṃ sarveṣu kāleṣu praṇataḥ preṣyavat sthitaḥ4.9.3||
translation: अहम् I, महत् great, पितृपैतामहम् inherited from ancestors, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रशासतः while he was ruling, तस्य his, सर्वेषु कालेषु at all times, प्रेष्यवत् like a servant, प्रणतः an obedient one, स्थितः remained.
explanation: 'I served him obediently like a servant while he ruled over the great  ancestral kingdom inherited by him.

shloka_text: मायावी नाम तेजस्वी पूर्वजो दुन्दुभेः सुतः। तेन तस्य महद्वैरं स्त्रीकृतं विश्श्रुतं पुरा4.9.4।।
transliteration: māyāvī nāma tejasvī pūrvajo dundubheḥ sutaḥ| tena tasya mahadvairaṃ strīkṛtaṃ viśśrutaṃ purā4.9.4||
translation: दुन्दभेः Dundubhi's, पूर्वजः elder, सुतः son, मायावी Mayavi, तेजस्वी a  mighty one, पुरा in the past, तस्य विश्श्रुतं wellknown about him, तेन by him, स्त्रीकृतम् for the sake of a woman, महत् bitter, वैरम् enmity.
explanation: 'Dundubhi's eldest son Mayabi was a mighty demon. He developed bitter enmity with Vali for the sake of a woman.

shloka_text: स तु सुप्तजने रात्रौ किष्किन्धाद्वारमागतः। नर्दति स्म सुसंरब्धो वालिनं चाह्वयद्रणे4.9.5।।
transliteration: sa tu suptajane rātrau kiṣkindhādvāramāgataḥ| nardati sma susaṃrabdho vālinaṃ cāhvayadraṇe4.9.5||
translation: रात्रौ at night, जने people, सुप्ते were asleep, सः he, किष्किन्धाद्वारम् entrance of Kishkindha, आगतः came, सुसंरब्धः an agitated one, नर्दति स्म bellowing, वालिनम् Vali, रणे for war, आह्वयत् challenging.
explanation: 'One midnight when all were asleep, he (Mayabi) came to the entrance of Kishkinda screaming angrily and bellowing at Vali, challenging him to a duel.

shloka_text: प्रसुप्तस्तु मम भ्राता नर्दितं भैरवस्वनम्। श्रुत्वा न ममृषे वाली निष्पपात जवात्तदा4.9.6।।
transliteration: prasuptastu mama bhrātā narditaṃ bhairavasvanam| śrutvā na mamṛṣe vālī niṣpapāta javāttadā4.9.6||
translation: तदा  then, प्रसुप्त was sleeping, मम भ्राता my brother, वाली Vali, नर्दतः shouting, भैरवस्वनम् frightful sound, श्रुत्वा after hearing, न ममृषे  did not tolerate, जवात् hastily, निष्पपात jumped out.
explanation: ' My brother Vali, who was asleep could not tolerate the frightful sound and jumped out of bed hastily.

shloka_text: स तु वै निस्सृतः क्रोधात्तं हन्तुमसुरोत्तमम्। वार्यमाणस्तत स्त्रीभिर्मया च प्रणतात्मना4.9.7।।
transliteration: sa tu vai nissṛtaḥ krodhāttaṃ hantumasurottamam| vāryamāṇastata strībhirmayā ca praṇatātmanā4.9.7||
translation: ततः then, सः he, स्त्रीभिः by women, प्रणतात्मना by an obedient one, मया च and by me too, निवार्यमाणः  was prevented, तम् him, असुरोत्तमम् powerful demon, हन्तुम् to kill, क्रोधात् angrily, निःसृतः came out.
explanation: 'Enraged, he came out to kill the powerful demon even though I with the womenfolk (of the harem) tried to prevent him.

shloka_text: स तु निर्धूय ताः सर्वा निर्जगाम महाबलः। ततोऽहमपि सौहार्दान्निस्सृतो वालिना सह4.9.8।।
transliteration: sa tu nirdhūya tāḥ sarvā nirjagāma mahābalaḥ| tato'hamapi sauhārdānnissṛto vālinā saha4.9.8||
translation: महाबलः powerful, स तु he too, ताः सर्वाः all the women, निर्धूय pushing aside, निर्जगाम went, ततः then, अहमपि I too, सौहार्दात् out of love, वालिना सह accompanied Vali, निःसृतः came out (to support him).
explanation: 'That mighty warrior(Vali) came out, pushing aside all the womenfolk. I too followed  him due to my affection towards him.

shloka_text: स तु मे भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा मां च दूरादवस्थितम्। असुरो जातसन्त्रासः प्रदुद्राव ततो भृशम्4.9.9।।
transliteration: sa tu me bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ ca dūrādavasthitam| asuro jātasantrāsaḥ pradudrāva tato bhṛśam4.9.9||
translation: सः he, असुरः तु demon also, मे भ्रातरम् my brother, दूरात् from a distance, अवस्थितम् took my stand, मां च and us, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, तदा then, भृशम् very much, जातसन्त्रासः felt scared, प्रदुद्राव ran
explanation: 'On seeing my brother and me from a distance, the demon took to his heels scared.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् द्रवति सन्त्रस्ते ह्यावां द्रुततरं गतौ। प्रकाशश्च कृतो मार्गश्चन्द्रेणोद्गच्छता तदा4.9.10।।
transliteration: tasmin dravati santraste hyāvāṃ drutataraṃ gatau| prakāśaśca kṛto mārgaścandreṇodgacchatā tadā4.9.10||
translation: सन्त्रस्ते when frightened, तस्मिन् him, द्रवति while running, आवाम् we also, द्रुततरम् faster, गतौ both went, तदा then, उद्गच्छता while rising, चन्द्रेण by the Moon, मार्गः the path, प्रकाशश्च was welllit, कृतः made.
explanation: 'Frightened, he ran. We too chased him running faster. As the Moon was rising the path was welllit.

shloka_text: स तृणैरावृतं दुर्गं धरण्या विवरं महत्। प्रविवेशासुरो वेगादावामासाद्य विष्ठितौ4.9.11।।
transliteration: sa tṛṇairāvṛtaṃ durgaṃ dharaṇyā vivaraṃ mahat| praviveśāsuro vegādāvāmāsādya viṣṭhitau4.9.11||
translation: सः असुरः that demon, धरण्याः on earth, दुर्गम् difficult passage, तृणैः by heaps of grass, आवृतम् covered, महत् great, विवरम् a hole, प्रविवेश entered, आवाम् both of us, आसाद्य reaching, विष्ठितौ we took position
explanation: 'The demon entered into a hole (cave) covered with a heap of grass, difficult, therefore, of access. Both of us reached there and took position.

shloka_text: तं प्रविष्टं रिपुं दृष्ट्वा बिलं रोषवशं गतः। मामुवाच तदा वाली वचनं क्षुभितेन्द्रियः4.9.12।।
transliteration: taṃ praviṣṭaṃ ripuṃ dṛṣṭvā bilaṃ roṣavaśaṃ gataḥ| māmuvāca tadā vālī vacanaṃ kṣubhitendriyaḥ4.9.12||
translation: तदा then, बिलम् hole, प्रविष्टम् entered, तं रिपुम् that enemy, दृष्ट्वा seeing, वाली Vali, रोषवशम् angry, गतः went, क्षुभितेन्द्रियः senses stirred, माम् to me, उवाच said.
explanation: 'Seeing the enemy entering the cave, Vali became wrathful and his senses were terribly disturbed.He said to me:

shloka_text: इह त्वं तिष्ठ सुग्रीव बिलद्वारि समाहितः। यावत्तत्र प्रविश्याहं निहन्मि सहसा रिपुम्4.9.13।।
transliteration: iha tvaṃ tiṣṭha sugrīva biladvāri samāhitaḥ| yāvattatra praviśyāhaṃ nihanmi sahasā ripum4.9.13||
translation: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, अहम् I, तत्र there, प्रविश्य after entering, सहसा at once, रिपुम् the enemy, यावत् निहन्मि till I kill, समाहितः being alert, अद्य now, इह here, बिलद्वारि at the hole, तिष्ठ you wait, त्वम् yourself.
explanation: 'O Sugriva wait here at the entrance of the cave and be on your alert until I enter this hole and kill the enemy'.

shloka_text: मया त्वेतद्वचश्श्रुत्वा याचितस्स परन्तपः। शापयित्वा तु मां पद्भ्यां प्रविवेश बिलं महत्4.9.14।।
transliteration: mayā tvetadvacaśśrutvā yācitassa parantapaḥ| śāpayitvā tu māṃ padbhyāṃ praviveśa bilaṃ mahat4.9.14||
translation: एतत् this, वचः words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मया me, याचितः begged, परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, सः he, माम् me, पद्भ्याम् on his feet, शापयित्वा made me swear, महत् great, बिलम् cave, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: 'On hearing him, I begged the scorcher of enemies (Vali) that I would follow him, but he made me swear on his feet and entered the cave.

shloka_text: तस्य प्रविष्टस्य बिलं साग्रस्संवत्सरो गतः। स्थितस्य मम बिलद्वारि स कालो व्यत्यवर्तत4.9.15।।
transliteration: tasya praviṣṭasya bilaṃ sāgrassaṃvatsaro gataḥ| sthitasya mama biladvāri sa kālo vyatyavartata4.9.15||
translation: बिलम् cave, प्रविष्टस्य  him who entered, तस्य for him, साग्रः well over, संवत्सरज्ञ a year, गतः had passed, बिलद्वारि at the entrance of the cave, स्थितस्य was waiting, सः कालः all that year, व्यत्यवर्तत passed by.
explanation: Well over a year passed for him who had entered the cave, and that whole time passed for me as I waited at its entrance.

shloka_text: अहं तु नष्टं ज्ञात्वा तं स्नेहादागतसम्भ्रमः। भ्रातरं न च पश्यामि पापाशङ्कि च मे मनः4.9.16।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tu naṣṭaṃ jñātvā taṃ snehādāgatasambhramaḥ| bhrātaraṃ na ca paśyāmi pāpāśaṅki ca me manaḥ4.9.16||
translation: अहं तु I also, तम् him, नष्टम् dead, ज्ञात्वा after knowing, स्नेहात् due to love, आगत संभ्रमः became agitated, भ्रातरम् brother, न पश्यामि I have not seen, मे my, मनः mind, पापाशङ्कि च suspected.
explanation: 'Thinking him dead, I became agitated because of my love for him. My mind began to apprehend his death since I had not seen my brother for long.

shloka_text: अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य बिलात्तस्माद्विनिस्सृतम्। सफेनं रुधिरं रक्तमहं दृष्ट्वा सुदुःखितः।।4.9.17।।
transliteration: atha dīrghasya kālasya bilāttasmādvinissṛtam| saphenaṃ rudhiraṃ raktamahaṃ dṛṣṭvā suduḥkhitaḥ
translation: अथ then, दीर्घस्य कालस्य after a long time, तस्मात् from that, बिलात् from the cave, विनिःसृतम् flowing down, सफेनम् along with foam, रुधिरम् blood, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, ततः then, अहम् I, भृशदुःखितः became very sad.
explanation: Then, after a long while, seeing frothy red blood flowing out of that cave, I became deeply grieved.

shloka_text: नर्दतामसुराणां च ध्वनिर्मे श्रोत्रमागतः। निरस्तस्य च सङ्ग्रामे क्रोशतोनिस्स्वनो गुरोः4.9.18।।
transliteration: nardatāmasurāṇāṃ ca dhvanirme śrotramāgataḥ| nirastasya ca saṅgrāme krośatonissvano guroḥ4.9.18||
translation: नर्दताम्  roaring voices, असुराणाम् of the demon, ध्वनिः sound, मे to me, श्रोत्रम् to the ear, आगतः came to, सङ्ग्रामे in war, रतस्त engaged, क्रोशतो वापि or not of a shouting, गुरोः of my brother, निस्स्वनः voice.
explanation: 'I heard the roaring voices of the demons and not the yelling of my brother engaged in the duel.

shloka_text: अहं त्ववगतो बुद्ध्या चिह्नैस्तैर्भ्रातरं हतम्। पिधाय च बिलद्वारं शिलया गिरिमात्रया4.9.19।। शोकार्तश्चोदकं कृत्वा किष्किन्धामागतस्सखे। गूहमानस्य मे तत्त्वं यत्नतो मन्त्रिभिश्श्रुतम्4.9.20।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tvavagato buddhyā cihnaistairbhrātaraṃ hatam| pidhāya ca biladvāraṃ śilayā girimātrayā4.9.19|| śokārtaścodakaṃ kṛtvā kiṣkindhāmāgatassakhe| gūhamānasya me tattvaṃ yatnato mantribhiśśrutam4.9.20||
translation: सखे O friend, अहं तु I also, तैः by those, चिह्नैः by the signs, भ्रातरम् my brother, हतम्  killed, बुद्ध्या with my understanding, अवगतः  came to know, गिरिमात्रया of the size of a mountain, शिलया with a rock, बिलद्वारम् the entrance of the mountain, पिधाय blocking, च and, शोकार्तः immersed in sorrow, उदकं कृत्वा offering oblations, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkindha, आगतः came, मे  me, गूहमानस्य intending to hide the fact, मन्त्रिभिः by the ministers, तत्त्वम् truth, यत्नतः  efforts, श्रुतम् heard.
explanation: 'O friend by those signs I understood that my brother was killed and concluding that way I blocked the entrance of the cave with a rock of the size of a mountain and offered oblations to my brother and came to Kishkinda. I intended to hide the fact of Vali's death. But the ministers came to know the truth with their efforts.

shloka_text: अहं त्ववगतो बुद्ध्या चिह्नैस्तैर्भ्रातरं हतम्। पिधाय च बिलद्वारं शिलया गिरिमात्रया4.9.19।। शोकार्तश्चोदकं कृत्वा किष्किन्धामागतस्सखे। गूहमानस्य मे तत्त्वं यत्नतो मन्त्रिभिश्श्रुतम्4.9.20।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tvavagato buddhyā cihnaistairbhrātaraṃ hatam| pidhāya ca biladvāraṃ śilayā girimātrayā4.9.19|| śokārtaścodakaṃ kṛtvā kiṣkindhāmāgatassakhe| gūhamānasya me tattvaṃ yatnato mantribhiśśrutam4.9.20||
translation: सखे O friend, अहं तु I also, तैः by those, चिह्नैः by the signs, भ्रातरम् my brother, हतम्  killed, बुद्ध्या with my understanding, अवगतः  came to know, गिरिमात्रया of the size of a mountain, शिलया with a rock, बिलद्वारम् the entrance of the mountain, पिधाय blocking, च and, शोकार्तः immersed in sorrow, उदकं कृत्वा offering oblations, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkindha, आगतः came, मे  me, गूहमानस्य intending to hide the fact, मन्त्रिभिः by the ministers, तत्त्वम् truth, यत्नतः  efforts, श्रुतम् heard.
explanation: 'O friend by those signs I understood that my brother was killed and concluding that way I blocked the entrance of the cave with a rock of the size of a mountain and offered oblations to my brother and came to Kishkinda. I intended to hide the fact of Vali's death. But the ministers came to know the truth with their efforts.

shloka_text: ततोऽहं तैस्समागम्य सम्मतैरभिषेचितः। राज्यं प्रशासतस्तस्य न्यायतो मम राघव4.9.21।। आजगाम रिपुं हत्वा वाली तमसुरोत्तमम्।।
transliteration: tato'haṃ taissamāgamya sammatairabhiṣecitaḥ| rājyaṃ praśāsatastasya nyāyato mama rāghava4.9.21|| ājagāma ripuṃ hatvā vālī tamasurottamam||
translation: ततः then, समेतैः by those coming together, तैः by them, समागम्य having assembled, अहम् I, अभिषेचितः I was consecrated, राघव O Rama, तस्य मम to me (in such a condition), राज्यम् kingdom, न्यायतः lawfully, प्रशासतः while I was ruling, सः वानरः that monkey, रिपुम् enemy, दानवम् demon, हत्वा after killing, आजगाम came back.
explanation: 'Then all the ministers assembled together and consecrated me. While I was ruling the kingdom lawfully, Vali, the monkey came back after killing the enemy demon.

shloka_text: अभिषिक्तं तु मां दृष्ट्वा वाली संरक्तलोचनः। मदीयान्मन्त्रिणो बद्ध्वा परुषं वाक्यमब्रवीत्4.9.22।।
transliteration: abhiṣiktaṃ tu māṃ dṛṣṭvā vālī saṃraktalocanaḥ| madīyānmantriṇo baddhvā paruṣaṃ vākyamabravīt4.9.22||
translation: अभिषिक्तम् consecrated, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, कोपात् angrily, संरक्तलोचनः with his eyes turned red, मदीयान् those belonging to me, मन्त्रिणः at the ministers, बद्ध्वा after imprisoning, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: 'Seeing me on the throne, Vali became angry and his eyes turned red. He imprisoned my ministers and spoke to me harshly.

shloka_text: निग्रहेऽपि समर्थस्य तं पापं प्रति राघव। न प्रावर्तत मे बुद्धिर्भ्रातुर्गौरवयन्त्रिता4.9.23।।
transliteration: nigrahe'pi samarthasya taṃ pāpaṃ prati rāghava| na prāvartata me buddhirbhrāturgauravayantritā4.9.23||
translation: राघव Rama, निग्रहे in resistance, अपि also, समर्थस्य of a capable one, मे my, बुद्धि: intellect, भ्रातृगौरवयन्त्रिता controlled by my respect for my brother, तं पापं प्रति towards that sinner, न प्रावर्तत did not advance.
explanation: 'O Rama even though I was capable of restraining the sinner, my intellect did not let me do so out of respect for my brother.

shloka_text: हत्वा शत्रुं स मे भ्राता प्रविवेश पुरं तदा4.9.24।। मानयंस्तं महात्मानं यथावच्चाभ्यवादयम्। उक्ताश्च नाशिषस्तेन सन्तुष्टेनान्तरात्मना4.9.25।।
transliteration: hatvā śatruṃ sa me bhrātā praviveśa puraṃ tadā4.9.24|| mānayaṃstaṃ mahātmānaṃ yathāvaccābhyavādayam| uktāśca nāśiṣastena santuṣṭenāntarātmanā4.9.25||
