transliteration: yadi te matpriyaṃ kāryaṃ yadi cāvaiṣi māṃ hitām| yācyamānaḥ prayatnena sādhu vākyaṃ kuruṣva me4.15.29||
translation: ते to you, मत्प्रियम् a favour to me, कार्यं यदि if it is going to be done, माम् me, हिताम् a good counsel, अवेषि यदि if you treat me so, प्रयत्नेन by the effort, याच्यमानः pray you, मे my, वाक्यम् words, साधु please, कुरुष्व heed.
explanation: 'Pray, do me this favour. Treat me as your wellwisher. Heed my  advice given with care.

shloka_text: प्रसीद पथ्यं शृणु जल्पितं हि मे न रोष मेवानुविधातुमर्हसि। क्षमो हि ते कोसलराजसूनुना न विग्रहश्शक्रसमानतेजसा4.15.30।।
transliteration: prasīda pathyaṃ śṛṇu jalpitaṃ hi me na roṣa mevānuvidhātumarhasi| kṣamo hi te kosalarājasūnunā na vigrahaśśakrasamānatejasā4.15.30||
translation: प्रसीद quieten your mind, मे my, पथ्यम् beneficial, जल्पितं word, शृणु listen, रोषमेव only anger, अनुविधातुम् follow, न अर्हसि you should not, शक्रसमानतेजसा resembling Indra in splendour, कोसलराजसूनुना with the prince of the kingdom of Kosala, ते you, विग्रहः enmity, न क्षमः हि not fit for you.
explanation: 'Do not lose your temper. Quieten your mind. My advice is beneficial to you. You should not  fight with the prince of Kosala who is comparable to Indra in splendour.It is not proper for you.'

shloka_text: तदा हि तारा हितमेव वाक्यं तं वालिनं पथ्यमिदं बभाषे। न रोचते तद्वचनं हि तस्य कालाभिपन्नस्य विनाशकाले4.15.31।।
transliteration: tadā hi tārā hitameva vākyaṃ taṃ vālinaṃ pathyamidaṃ babhāṣe| na rocate tadvacanaṃ hi tasya kālābhipannasya vināśakāle4.15.31||
translation: तदा then, तारा Tara, तं वालिनम् to Vali, हितम् counsel, पथ्यम् beneficial, इदं वाक्यम् these words, बभाषे spoke, कालाभिपन्नस्य influenced by bad time, तस्य his, विनाशकाले at the time of destruction, तत् वचनम् those words, न रोचते not liking.
explanation: Even though Tara gave good counsel to Vali at the hour of destruction, the advice did not find favour with him as he was under the influence of unfavourable time (seized by death). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे पञ्चदशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifteenth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तामेवं ब्रुवतीं तारां ताराधिपनिभाननाम्। वाली निर्भर्त्सयामास वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्4.16.1।।
transliteration: tāmevaṃ bruvatīṃ tārāṃ tārādhipanibhānanām| vālī nirbhartsayāmāsa vacanaṃ cedamabravīt4.16.1||
translation: एवम् thus, ब्रुवतीम्  speaking, ताराधिपनिभाननाम् Moonlike face, तां ताराम् to such a Tara, वाली Vali, निर्भर्त्सयामास reproached, इदम् these, वचनं च words, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: To these words of Tara with her Moonlike face, Vali replied reproachfully:
comments: Tara's counsel to Vali -- fight between Vali and Sugriva -- Rama observes Sugriva's plight in the duel -- shoots an arrow at Vali.

shloka_text: गर्जतोऽस्य च सुसम्भ्रश्च भ्रातुः शत्रोर्विशेषतः। मर्षयिष्याम्यहं केन कारणेन वरानने4.16.2।।
transliteration: garjato'sya ca susambhraśca bhrātuḥ śatrorviśeṣataḥ| marṣayiṣyāmyahaṃ kena kāraṇena varānane4.16.2||
translation: वरानने O lady with a charming face, भ्रातुः brother, विशेषतः especially, शत्रोः enemy, अस्य his, सुसम्रब्धम् excitement, गर्जतः as he roars, केन कारणेन for what reason, मर्षयिष्यामि should I tolerate?
explanation: 'O lady with a charming face why should I tolerate the enemy (Sugriva) who is none other than my own younger brother, especially when he roars excitedly?

shloka_text: अधर्षितानां शूराणां समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम्। धर्षणामर्षणं भीरु मरणादतिरिच्यते4.16.3।।
transliteration: adharṣitānāṃ śūrāṇāṃ samareṣvanivartinām| dharṣaṇāmarṣaṇaṃ bhīru maraṇādatiricyate4.16.3||
translation: भीरु O timid lady, समरेषु in combat, अनिवर्तिनाम् for those who do not turn back, अधर्षितानाम् for the invincible, शूराणाम् for heroes, धर्षणामर्षणम् to endure insult, मरणात् more than death, अतिरिच्यते is worse
explanation: O timid lady to swallow insult (without facing the opponent) is worse than death for indomitable heroes (like me) who know no retreat in a battle.

shloka_text: सोढुं न च समर्थोऽहं युद्धकामस्य संयुगे। सुग्रीवस्य च सम्रम्भं हीनग्रीवस्य गर्जतः4.16.4।।
transliteration: soḍhuṃ na ca samartho'haṃ yuddhakāmasya saṃyuge| sugrīvasya ca samrambhaṃ hīnagrīvasya garjataḥ4.16.4||
translation: अहम् I am, संयुगे in battle, युद्धकामस्य desiring to fight, हीनग्रीवस्य of the weaknecked, गर्जतः  who roars, सुग्रीवस्य of Sugriva, सम्रम्भम् flurry, सोढुम् to tolerate, न समर्थः not right
explanation: 'When the weaknecked Sugriva roars eager to join a duel it is not right on my part to tolerate his arrogance,much less his warcry.

shloka_text: न च कार्यो विषादस्ते राघवं प्रति मत्कृते। धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च कथं पापं करिष्यति4.16.5।।
transliteration: na ca kāryo viṣādaste rāghavaṃ prati matkṛte| dharmajñaśca kṛtajñaśca kathaṃ pāpaṃ kariṣyati4.16.5||
translation: मत्कृते for me, राघवं प्रति with respect to Rama, ते to you, विषादः worry, न कार्यः no need, धर्मज्ञश्च for a knower of dharma, कृतज्ञश्च a grateful person, पापम् sin, कथम् how, करिष्यति will he do
explanation: 'You need not be concerned about me on account of Rama. How can one who knows dharma and who has a sense of gratitude commit sin?

shloka_text: निवर्तस्व सह स्त्रीभिः कथं भूयोऽनुगच्छसि। सौहृदं दर्शितं तारे मयि भक्ति: कृता त्वया4.16.6।।
transliteration: nivartasva saha strībhiḥ kathaṃ bhūyo'nugacchasi| sauhṛdaṃ darśitaṃ tāre mayi bhakti: kṛtā tvayā4.16.6||
translation: स्त्रीभिः सह along with women, निवर्तस्व you may return, भूयः again, कथम् how, अनुगच्छसि following, त्वया by you, सौहृदम् concern, दर्शितं (तावत्) shown by you, मयि to me, भक्तिः devotion, कृता is fixed
explanation: 'Go back with all the women of the harem. Why do you follow me again? Your devotion towards me is evident from the sincere concern expressed by you.

shloka_text: प्रतियोत्स्याम्यहं गत्वा सुग्रीवं जहि सम्भ्रमम्। दर्पमात्रं विनेष्यामि न च प्राणैर्विमोक्ष्यते4.16.7।।
transliteration: pratiyotsyāmyahaṃ gatvā sugrīvaṃ jahi sambhramam| darpamātraṃ vineṣyāmi na ca prāṇairvimokṣyate4.16.7||
translation: अहम् I am, गत्वा after going, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, प्रतियोत्स्यामि will fight accepting his challenge, सम्भ्रमम् anxiety, जहि give up, अस्य his, दर्पमात्रं pride, विनेष्यामि I will subdue, प्राणैः with life, न विमोक्ष्यते not be relieved
explanation: 'I shall accept the challenge and fight with Sugriva. Give up your anxiety. I will destroy  his pride, not his life.

shloka_text: अहं ह्याजौस्थितस्यास्य करिष्यामि यथेप्सितम्। वृक्षैर्मुष्टिप्रहारैश्च पीडितः प्रतियास्यति4.16.8।।
transliteration: ahaṃ hyājausthitasyāsya kariṣyāmi yathepsitam| vṛkṣairmuṣṭiprahāraiśca pīḍitaḥ pratiyāsyati4.16.8||
translation: अहम् I, इति आजौ in the battlefield, स्थितस्य when he stands, अस्य his, यत् whatever, ईप्सितम् desire, करिष्यामि I will do, वृक्षैः by the trees, मुष्टिप्रहारैश्च by hitting with fists, पीडितः hurt, प्रतियास्यति will run back
explanation: 'When he faces me in the battlefield, I will hit him with trees and fists, and he will run back  for life.

shloka_text: न मे गर्वितमायस्तं सहिष्यति दुरात्मवान्। कृतं तारे सहांयत्वं सौहृदं दर्शितं मयि4.16.9।।
transliteration: na me garvitamāyastaṃ sahiṣyati durātmavān| kṛtaṃ tāre sahāṃyatvaṃ sauhṛdaṃ darśitaṃ mayi4.16.9||
translation: दुरात्मवान् an evilminded one, मे my, गर्वितम् pride, अयस्तम्  hard strokes, न सहिष्यति will not tolerate, तारे O Tara, सहायत्वम् helpful attitude, कृतम् to do, मयि for me, सौहृदम्  affection, दर्शितम् you have shown
explanation: 'That evilminded Sugriva cannot bear my mighty, hard blows. Tara you could shower your affection on me and extend help (in passing secret information obtained through Angada)

shloka_text: शापिताऽपि मम प्राणैर्निवर्तस्व जयेन च। अहं जित्वा निवर्तिष्ये तमहं भ्रातरं रणे4.16.10।।
transliteration: śāpitā'pi mama prāṇairnivartasva jayena ca| ahaṃ jitvā nivartiṣye tamahaṃ bhrātaraṃ raṇe4.16.10||
translation: मम my, प्राणैः with life, शापिता अपि even a vow on my life, जयेन  on victory, निवर्तस्व  I will return, अहम् I, रणे in encounter, तं भ्रातरम् that brother, जित्वा after winning, अहम् I, निवर्तिष्ये    will return
explanation: 'I make a vow even on my life and my victory. Pray return with the retinue. I will be back only after winning the encounter with my brother.

shloka_text: तं तु तारा परिष्वज्य वालिनं प्रियवादिनी। चकार रुदती मन्दं दक्षिणा सा प्रदक्षिणम्4.16.11।।
transliteration: taṃ tu tārā pariṣvajya vālinaṃ priyavādinī| cakāra rudatī mandaṃ dakṣiṇā sā pradakṣiṇam4.16.11||
translation: प्रियवादिनी a lady  pleasant in speech, दक्षिणा a compliant, सा तारा that Tara, तं वालिनम् that Vali, परिष्वज्य having embraced, मन्दम् faintly रुदती weeping, प्रदक्षिणम् circumambulated, चकार went
explanation: Pleasing in her words, Tara then embraced Vali and sobbing, circumambulated Vali in compliance (to his advice).

shloka_text: ततः स्वस्त्ययनं कृत्वा मन्त्रविद्विजयैषिणी। अन्तःपुरं सह स्त्रीभिः प्रविष्टा शोकमोहिता4.16.12।।
transliteration: tataḥ svastyayanaṃ kṛtvā mantravidvijayaiṣiṇī| antaḥpuraṃ saha strībhiḥ praviṣṭā śokamohitā4.16.12||
translation: ततः then, मन्त्रवित् a lady wellversed in mantras, विजयैषिणी a lady who wished victory, स्वस्त्ययनम्  hailing, कृत्वा uttering, शोकमोहिता overwhelmed with sorrow, स्त्रीभिः सह along with women, अन्तःपुरम् inner apartments, प्रविष्टा entered
explanation: The wise counsellor, Tara bade him farewell, wishing him victory and then, overwhelmed with sorrow, entered the inner apartment followed by the womenfolk.

shloka_text: प्रविष्टायां तु तारायां सह स्त्रीभिस्स्वमालयम्। नगरान्निर्ययौ क्रुद्धो महासर्प इव श्वसन्4.16.13।।
transliteration: praviṣṭāyāṃ tu tārāyāṃ saha strībhissvamālayam| nagarānniryayau kruddho mahāsarpa iva śvasan4.16.13||
translation: तारायाम् when Tara, स्त्रीभिस्सह along with women, स्वम् her, आलयम् abode, प्रविष्टायाम् after she entered, कुद्दः angry , महासर्प इव like a huge serpent, श्वसन् breathing, नगरात् from the city, निर्ययौ came out.
explanation: After Tara and other women returned to their abode, Vali departed from the city,  hissing  like a huge angry cobra.

shloka_text: स निश्श्वस्य महातेजा वाली परमरोषणः। सर्वतश्चारयन् दृष्टिं शत्रुदर्शनकाङ्क्षया4.16.14।।
transliteration: sa niśśvasya mahātejā vālī paramaroṣaṇaḥ| sarvataścārayan dṛṣṭiṃ śatrudarśanakāṅkṣayā4.16.14||
translation: महातेजा: brilliant, वाली Vali, परमरोषणः very angrily, विश्श्वस्य breathing heavily, शत्रुदर्शनराङ्क्षया with a desire to see the enemy, सर्वतः in all directions, दृष्टिम् sight, चारयन् sending.
explanation: The mighty Vali, breathing heavily, looked around to find where his enemy was.

shloka_text: स ददर्श ततश्श्रीमान् सुग्रीवं हेमपिङ्गलम्। सुसंवीतमवष्टब्धं दीप्यमानमिवानलम्4.16.15।।
transliteration: sa dadarśa tataśśrīmān sugrīvaṃ hemapiṅgalam| susaṃvītamavaṣṭabdhaṃ dīpyamānamivānalam4.16.15||
translation: ततः then, श्रीमान् lustrous, सः he, हेमपिङ्गलम् of red gold complexion, सुसंवीतम् ready to combat, अवष्टब्धम् steady, दीप्यमानम् glowing bright, अनलम् इव like fire, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, ददर्श saw
explanation: There Vali saw Sugriva in lustrous, red gold complexion standing ready for a combat steady like glowing fire.

shloka_text: स तं दृष्ट्वा महावीर्यं सुग्रीवं पर्यवस्थितम्। गाढं परिदधे वासो वाली परमरोषण:4.16.16।।
transliteration: sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāvīryaṃ sugrīvaṃ paryavasthitam| gāḍhaṃ paridadhe vāso vālī paramaroṣaṇa:4.16.16||
translation: परमरोषण: in mighty rage, महावीर्यं great hero, सः वाली Vali, पर्यवस्थितम्  standing firmly तं सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, वासः (upper) cloth, गाढम् tightly, परिदधे tied up
explanation: On seeing the great hero Sugriva standing firmly, the enraged Vali tied his upper cloth (around his loin) tightly.

shloka_text: स वाली गाढसंवीतो मुष्टिमुद्यम्य वीर्यवान्। सुग्रीवमेवाभिमुखो ययौ योद्धुं कृतक्षणः4.16.17।।
transliteration: sa vālī gāḍhasaṃvīto muṣṭimudyamya vīryavān| sugrīvamevābhimukho yayau yoddhuṃ kṛtakṣaṇaḥ4.16.17||
translation: गाढसंवीतः with cloth tied tightly, वीर्यवान् brave, सः वाली Vali, मुष्टिम् fist, उद्यम्य advanced towards, योद्धुम् for combat, कृतक्षणः waiting for the moment impatiently, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अभिमुखः towards, ययौ went
explanation: Vali tied up his cloth tightly, raised his fist and advanced towards Sugriva, ready for the encounter.

shloka_text: श्लिष्टं मुष्टिं समुद्यम्य संरब्धतरमागतः। सुग्रीवोऽपि समुद्दिश्य वालिनं हेममालिनम्4.16.18।।
transliteration: śliṣṭaṃ muṣṭiṃ samudyamya saṃrabdhataramāgataḥ| sugrīvo'pi samuddiśya vālinaṃ hemamālinam4.16.18||
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अपि also, श्लिष्टम् firmly closed, मुष्टिम् fist, समुद्यम्य lifting up, हेममालिम् adorned with gold necklace, वालिनम् Vali, समुद्दिश्य directing towards, संरब्धतरम् more impatiently, आगतः reached
explanation: Sugriva also lifted his fist firmly and advanced more impatiently towards Vali adorned with a golden necklace.

shloka_text: तं वाली क्रोधताम्राक्षस्सुग्रीवं रणपण्डितम्। आपतन्तं महावेगमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्4.16.19।।
transliteration: taṃ vālī krodhatāmrākṣassugrīvaṃ raṇapaṇḍitam| āpatantaṃ mahāvegamidaṃ vacanamabravīt4.16.19||
translation: वाली Vali, क्रोधताम्राक्षः whose eyes red in anger, रणपण्डितम् expert in warfare, महावेगम् of great speed, आपतन्तम् pouncing upon, तं सुग्रीवम् him Sugriva, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: While Sugriva, expert in combat, advanced swiftly to pounce upon (his enemy), Vali whose eyes turned red in anger said:

shloka_text: एष मुष्टिर्मयाबद्धो गाढस्सन्निहिताङ्गुलिः। मया वेगविमुक्तस्ते प्राणानादाय यास्यति4.16.20।।
transliteration: eṣa muṣṭirmayābaddho gāḍhassannihitāṅguliḥ| mayā vegavimuktaste prāṇānādāya yāsyati4.16.20||
translation: सन्निसताङ्गुलिः closely held fingers, गाढः tight, एषः this, बद्धः महान्  clenched and big. मुष्टिः fist, मया by me, वेगविमुक्तः hit with formidable speed, ते your, प्राणान् life, आदाय on taking out, यास्यति will move away
explanation: This big, tightly clenched fist of mine, with its fingers closely held, hurled with great speed, will take away your life.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवः क्रुद्धो वालिनमब्रवीत्। तवैव चा हरन्प्राणान्मुष्टिः पततु मूर्धनि4.16.21।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvaḥ kruddho vālinamabravīt| tavaiva cā haranprāṇānmuṣṭiḥ patatu mūrdhani4.16.21||
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः सुग्रीवः Sugriva having been addressed, क्रुद्धः  angry, वालिनम् Vali, अब्रवीत् said, एषः thus, मुष्टिः fist, तव your, प्राणान् life, हरन्  take, मूर्धनि on your forehead, पततु let it hit
explanation: This infuriated Sugriva who, looking at Vali, said 'This fist of mine will draw your life out, hitting your forehead'.

shloka_text: ताडितस्तेन सङ्कृद्धस्समभिक्रम्य वेगितः। अभवच्छोणितोद्गारी सोत्पीड इव पर्वतः4.16.22।।
transliteration: tāḍitastena saṅkṛddhassamabhikramya vegitaḥ| abhavacchoṇitodgārī sotpīḍa iva parvataḥ4.16.22||
translation: वेगितः speedily, समभिक्रम्य encountered him, तेन by him, ताडितः struck, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, शोणितोद्गारी  rivulets of blood, सोत्पेडः flowing, पर्वतः इव like a mountain, अभवत् appeared
explanation: Struck by Vali, enraged Sugriva encountered Vali more aggresively. His body drenched in blood seemed a mountain with rivulets of blood flowing.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवेण तु निस्सङ्गं सालमुत्पाट्य तेजसा। गात्रेष्वभिहतो वाली वज्रेणेव महागिरिः4.16.23।।
transliteration: sugrīveṇa tu nissaṅgaṃ sālamutpāṭya tejasā| gātreṣvabhihato vālī vajreṇeva mahāgiriḥ4.16.23||
translation: सुग्रीवेण तु by Sugriva also, तेजसा with vigour, निस्सङ्गम् pulled out, सालम् sala tree, उत्पाट्य  uprooted, वज्रेण with the thunderbolt, महागिरिः इव like a huge mountain, गात्रेषु on the body, अभिहतः struck.
explanation: With all his vigour, Sugriva uprooted a sala tree, pulled it out and struck Vali on the body, like a thunderbolt striking a huge mountain.

shloka_text: स तु वाली प्रचलितस्सालताडनविह्वलः। गुरुभारसमाक्रान्तो नौ सार्थ इव सागरे4.16.24।।
transliteration: sa tu vālī pracalitassālatāḍanavihvalaḥ| gurubhārasamākrānto nau sārtha iva sāgare4.16.24||
translation: सालताडनविह्वलः hurt by the blows of the sala tree, सः he, वाली तु Vali also, सागरे in the ocean, गुरुभारसमाक्रान्तः heavily loaded, सार्थ trader's, नौः ship, इव like, प्रचलितः shaken up
explanation: Struck by the blows of the sala tree, Vali also lost his balance like the heavily loaded ship of a trader shaken up in the ocean.

shloka_text: तौ भीमबलविक्रान्तौ सुपर्णसमवेगिनौ। प्रवृद्धौ घोरवपुषौ चन्द्रसूर्याविवाम्बरे। परस्परममित्रघ्नौ च्छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परौ4.16.25।।
transliteration: tau bhīmabalavikrāntau suparṇasamaveginau| pravṛddhau ghoravapuṣau candrasūryāvivāmbare| parasparamamitraghnau cchidrānveṣaṇatatparau4.16.25||
translation: भीमबलविक्रान्तौ of terrific strength, सुपर्णसमवेगिनौ both as fast as Suparna (Garuda), घोरवपुषौ both of fierce appearance, परस्परम् each other, छिद्रान्वेषणतत्परौ both searching the weak points of the other, अमित्रघ्नौ both striking and trying to win over the other, तौ both, अम्बरे in the sky, चन्द्रसूर्याविव like Sun and Moon, प्रवृद्धौ both grew
explanation: Both of them endowed with terrible strength, fierce in appearance, and each seeking the weak points of the other advanced, as fast as Garuda, striking at the enemy. Their fight grew more and more fierce like the fight between Sun and Moon in the sky.

shloka_text: ततोऽवर्धत वाली तु बलवीर्यसमन्वितः। सूर्यपुत्रो महावीर्यस्सुग्रीवः परिहीयते4.16.26।।
transliteration: tato'vardhata vālī tu balavīryasamanvitaḥ| sūryaputro mahāvīryassugrīvaḥ parihīyate4.16.26||
translation: ततः then, बलवीर्यसमन्वितः endowed with strength and valour, वाली Vali, अवर्धत he grew, महावीर्यः mighty, सूर्यपुत्रः Sun's son, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, परिहीयते becomes weak
explanation: In a short while Vali, endowed with great strength, gained the upper hand and Sugriva, son of the Sungod, was losing ground .

shloka_text: वालिना भग्नदर्पस्तु सुग्रीवो मन्दविक्रमः। वालिनं प्रति सामर्षो दर्शयामास लाघवम्4.16.27।।
transliteration: vālinā bhagnadarpastu sugrīvo mandavikramaḥ| vālinaṃ prati sāmarṣo darśayāmāsa lāghavam4.16.27||
translation: वालिना by Vali, भग्नदर्पः pride crushed, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, मन्दविक्रमः diminished in strength, सामर्षः anguished, वालिनं प्रति towards Vali, लाघवम्  shrewdness, दर्शयामास displayed
explanation: With his strength waning and pride crushed, Sugriva, anguished, exhibited shrewdness.

shloka_text: वृक्षैः स्सशाखै स्सशिखैर्वज्रकोटिनिभैर्नखैः4.16.28।। मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिः पद्भिर्बाहुभिश्च पुनः पुनः। तयोर्युद्धमभूद्घोरं वृत्रवासवयोरिव4.16.29।।
transliteration: vṛkṣaiḥ ssaśākhai ssaśikhairvajrakoṭinibhairnakhaiḥ4.16.28|| muṣṭibhirjānubhiḥ padbhirbāhubhiśca punaḥ punaḥ| tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ vṛtravāsavayoriva4.16.29||
translation: तयोः both, वृक्षैः with trees, सशाखैः with branches, शिखरैः with tops, वज्रकोटिनिभैः by those  hard as tips of thunderbolts, नखैः with nails, मुष्टिभिः with fists, पद्भिः with feet, जानुभिः with knees, वृत्रवासवयोरिव like Vritra and Indra, पुनः पुनः again and again, घोरम् terrible, युद्धम् combat, अभूत् became.
explanation: Both like Vritra and Indra fought, hitting each other again and again with trees full of branches and tops, with their hard nails akin to thunderbolts and with their fists, knees, feet, etc.

shloka_text: वृक्षैः स्सशाखै स्सशिखैर्वज्रकोटिनिभैर्नखैः4.16.28।। मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिः पद्भिर्बाहुभिश्च पुनः पुनः। तयोर्युद्धमभूद्घोरं वृत्रवासवयोरिव4.16.29।।
transliteration: vṛkṣaiḥ ssaśākhai ssaśikhairvajrakoṭinibhairnakhaiḥ4.16.28|| muṣṭibhirjānubhiḥ padbhirbāhubhiśca punaḥ punaḥ| tayoryuddhamabhūdghoraṃ vṛtravāsavayoriva4.16.29||
translation: तयोः both, वृक्षैः with trees, सशाखैः with branches, शिखरैः with tops, वज्रकोटिनिभैः by those  hard as tips of thunderbolts, नखैः with nails, मुष्टिभिः with fists, पद्भिः with feet, जानुभिः with knees, वृत्रवासवयोरिव like Vritra and Indra, पुनः पुनः again and again, घोरम् terrible, युद्धम् combat, अभूत् became.
explanation: Both like Vritra and Indra fought, hitting each other again and again with trees full of branches and tops, with their hard nails akin to thunderbolts and with their fists, knees, feet, etc.

shloka_text: तौ शोणिताक्तौ युध्येतां वानरौ वनचारिणौ। मेघाविव महाशब्दै स्तर्जमानौ परस्परम्4.16.30।।
transliteration: tau śoṇitāktau yudhyetāṃ vānarau vanacāriṇau| meghāviva mahāśabdai starjamānau parasparam4.16.30||
translation: वनचारिणौ wanderers of the forest, तौ both of them, वानरौ monkeys, शोणिताक्तौ both with blood stains, परस्परम् at each other, महाशब्दैः producing loud sound, मेघाविव like two clouds, तर्जमानौ pointing at each other, युध्येताम् clashed
explanation: The monkeys, wanderers in the forest, both with blood stains fiercely clashed pointing at each other, roaring with dreadful sounds like two clouds.

shloka_text: हीयमानमथोऽपश्यत्सुग्रीवं वानरेश्वरम्। वीक्षमाणं दिशश्चैव राघवस्स मुहुर्मुहुः4.16.31।।
transliteration: hīyamānamatho'paśyatsugrīvaṃ vānareśvaram| vīkṣamāṇaṃ diśaścaiva rāghavassa muhurmuhuḥ4.16.31||
translation: अथ then, सः राघवः Rama, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, दिशः different directions, वीक्षमाणम्  glancing, वानरेश्वरम् lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवं Sugriva, हीयमानम् waning (in strength), अपश्यत् observed
explanation: Raghava perceived that the monkey king Sugriva whose strength was waning was looking again and again in all directions (seeking help).

shloka_text: ततो रामो महातेजा आर्तं दृष्ट्वा हरीश्वरम्। शरं च वीक्षते वीरो वालिनो वधकारणात् 4.16.32।।
transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā ārtaṃ dṛṣṭvā harīśvaram| śaraṃ ca vīkṣate vīro vālino vadhakāraṇāt 4.16.32||
translation: ततः then, महातेजाः brilliant, वीरः hero, रामः Rama, हरीश्वरम् king of monkeys, आर्तम् distress, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वालिनः Vali's, वधकारणात् in order to kill, शरम् arrow, वीक्षते looked for
explanation: Finding the king of the monkeys in distress, the heroic, brilliant Rama looked for an  arrow in order to kill Vali.

shloka_text: ततो धनुषि सन्धाय शरमाशीविषोपमम्। पुरयामास तच्चापं कालचक्रमिवान्तकः4.16.33।।
transliteration: tato dhanuṣi sandhāya śaramāśīviṣopamam| purayāmāsa taccāpaṃ kālacakramivāntakaḥ4.16.33||
translation: ततः then, आशीविषोपमम् poisonous like a snake, शरम् arrow, धनुषि at the bow, सन्धाय having fixed, अन्तकः lord of death, कालचक्रमिव like the wheel of death, तत् चापम् that bow, पुरयामास stretched at fully.
explanation: Rama then fixed an arrow which resembled a venomous snake, on to his bow looking like the very deathwheel of Yama and stretched it fully.

shloka_text: तस्य ज्यातलघोषेण त्रस्ताः पत्ररथेश्वराः। प्रदुद्रुवुर्मृगाश्चैव युगान्त इव मोहिताः4.16.34।।
transliteration: tasya jyātalaghoṣeṇa trastāḥ patraratheśvarāḥ| pradudruvurmṛgāścaiva yugānta iva mohitāḥ4.16.34||
translation: तस्य his, ज्यातलघोषेण by the twang of the bowstring, त्रस्ताः terrified, पत्ररथेश्वराः winged and feathered birds, मृगाश्चैव like animals, युगान्ते at the time of dissolution, मोहिताः इव as though frightened, प्रदुद्रुवुः ran in all directions.
explanation: As if scared by the twang of the bowstring, winged and feathered birds and animals ran frightened in different directions.

shloka_text: मुक्तस्तु वज्रनिर्घोष: प्रदीप्ताशनिसन्निभः। राघवेण महाबाणो वालिवक्षसि पातितः4.16.35।।
transliteration: muktastu vajranirghoṣa: pradīptāśanisannibhaḥ| rāghaveṇa mahābāṇo vālivakṣasi pātitaḥ4.16.35||
translation: राघवेण by Rama, मुक्तः released, वज्रनिर्घोषः sounding like the thunderbolt, प्रदीप्ताशनिसन्निभः like blazing lightning, महाबाणः mighty arrow, वालिवक्षसि  into the chest of Vali, पातितः pierced
explanation: As Rama shot the mighty arrow, it went like a blazing lightning with a thunderous sound and pierced into the chest of Vali.

shloka_text: ततस्तेन महातेजा वीयौटत्सिक्तः कपीश्वरः। वेगेनाभिहतो वाली निपपात महीतले4.16.36।।
transliteration: tatastena mahātejā vīyauṭatsiktaḥ kapīśvaraḥ| vegenābhihato vālī nipapāta mahītale4.16.36||
translation: ततः then, महातेजाः powerful, वीयौत्सक्तः proud of his strength, कपीश्वरः king of monkeys, वाली Vali, तेन by such, वेगेन with speed, अभिहतः was hit, महीतले on the earth, निपपात fell down
explanation: Then the powerful monkey king Vali, who was proud of his might, fell down on earth, struck by the fast flying arrow.

shloka_text: इन्द्रध्वज इवोद्धूतः पौर्णमास्यां महीतले। आश्वयुक्समये मासि गतश्रीको विचेतनः4.16.37।।
transliteration: indradhvaja ivoddhūtaḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ mahītale| āśvayuksamaye māsi gataśrīko vicetanaḥ4.16.37||
translation: आश्वयुक्समये in the month of Aswayuja, मासि in a month, पौर्णमास्याम् on the full Moon day, महीतले on the earth, उद्धूतः was thrown down, इन्द्रध्वज इव like Indra's staff, वाली Vali, गतश्रीको lost his brilliance, विचेतनः fell unconscious
explanation: Vali fell lustreless on the ground. He was thrown down unconscious like the banner (hoisted in honour) of Indra on the fullmoon day of Aswayuja month.

shloka_text: नरोत्तमः कालयुगान्तकोपमं शरोत्तमं काञ्चनरूप्यभुषितम्। ससर्ज दीप्तं तममित्रमर्दनं सधूममग्निं मुखतो यथा हरः4.16.38।।
transliteration: narottamaḥ kālayugāntakopamaṃ śarottamaṃ kāñcanarūpyabhuṣitam| sasarja dīptaṃ tamamitramardanaṃ sadhūmamagniṃ mukhato yathā haraḥ4.16.38||
translation: नरोत्तमः distinguished among men, कालयुगान्तकोपमम् like the destroyer of the world, काञ्चनरूप्यभाषितम् adorned with gold and silver, दीप्तम् glittering, अमित्रमर्दनम् that which can crush the enemy, तं शरोत्तमम् that best of arrows, हरः  Hara (Rudra), मुखतः from the  mouth, सधूमम् with smoke, अग्निम् इव like fire, ससर्ज released
explanation: The arrow of Rama, distinguished among men, adorned with silver and gold, which could crush the enemy shone like fire and smoke emitted from the mouth of Rudra at the time of dissolution (at the end of the aeon).

shloka_text: ततश्शरेणाभिहतो रामेण रणकर्कशः। पपात सहसा वाली निकृत्त इव पादपः4.17.1।।
transliteration: tataśśareṇābhihato rāmeṇa raṇakarkaśaḥ| papāta sahasā vālī nikṛtta iva pādapaḥ4.17.1||
translation: ततः then, रणकर्कशः  tyrant in war, वाली Vali, रामेण by Rama, शरेण by an arrow, अभिहतः struck, निकृत्तः  felled, पादप: the tree, इव like, सहसा instantaneously, पपात fell down
explanation: A tyrant in war, Vali struck by4.54.24 Rama's arrow, collapsed instantaneously like a tree felled down.
comments: Vali accuses Rama -- calls him deceitful -- reproaches Rama in many ways.

shloka_text: स भूमौ न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः। अपतद्देवराजस्य मुक्तरश्मिरिव ध्वजः4.17.2।।
transliteration: sa bhūmau nyastasarvāṅgastaptakāñcanabhūṣaṇaḥ| apataddevarājasya muktaraśmiriva dhvajaḥ4.17.2||
translation: तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः adorned with shining gold ornaments, सः he, मुक्तरश्मिः with the loosening of ropes, देवराजस्य Indra's, ध्वजः इव like the post, भूमौ on the ground, न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गः all limbs of body touching the ground, पपात fell down
explanation: Adorned with shining gold ornaments,Vali fell down with all his limbs touching the ground like Indra's flag when its ropes are loosened.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ वानराणां गणेश्वरे। नष्टचन्द्रमिव व्योम न व्यराजत भूतलम्4.17.3।।
transliteration: tasminnipatite bhūmau vānarāṇāṃ gaṇeśvare| naṣṭacandramiva vyoma na vyarājata bhūtalam4.17.3||
translation: वानराणाम् of the monkeys, गणेश्वरे lord of the troops, तस्मिन् him, भूमौ निपतिते when (he) fell on the ground, भूतलम् the earth, नष्टचन्द्रमिव like sky devoid of the Moon, व्योम sky, न व्यराजत not shine
explanation: When the lord of the monkey troops fell down, it was as though the earth lost its brightness like the sky loses its brightness devoid of the Moon.

shloka_text: भूमौ निपतितस्यापि तस्य देहं महात्मनः। न श्रीर्जहाति न प्राणा न तेजो न पराक्रमः4.17.4।।
transliteration: bhūmau nipatitasyāpi tasya dehaṃ mahātmanaḥ| na śrīrjahāti na prāṇā na tejo na parākramaḥ4.17.4||
translation: भूमौ on the ground, निपतितस्यापि even though fell down, महात्मनः  highsouled, तस्य it, देहम् body, श्रीः splendour, न जहाति not left, प्राणाः life, न not, तेजः glow, न not, पराक्रमः valour
explanation: Even though the highsouled Vali's body had fallen on the ground, its  splendour, glow, life and valour had not left it.

shloka_text: शक्रदत्ता वरा माला काञ्चनी वज्रभूषिता। दधार हरिमुख्यस्य प्राणांस्तेज्शियं च सा4.17.5।।
transliteration: śakradattā varā mālā kāñcanī vajrabhūṣitā| dadhāra harimukhyasya prāṇāṃstejśiyaṃ ca sā4.17.5||
translation: शक्रदत्ता given by Indra, काञ्चनी golden, वज्रभूषिता decorated with diamonds, वरा most beautiful, माला necklace, हरिमुख्यस्य lord of the monkeys, प्राणान् life, तेज brightness, श्रियं च and splendour, दधार remained
explanation: As the most beautiful golden necklace, studded with diamonds, given by Indra was there on him, the life, brightness and splendour of Vali's body remained.

shloka_text: स तया मालया वीरो हेमया हरियूथपः। सन्ध्यानुगतपर्यन्तः पयोधर इवाभवत्4.17.6।।
transliteration: sa tayā mālayā vīro hemayā hariyūthapaḥ| sandhyānugataparyantaḥ payodhara ivābhavat4.17.6||
translation: वीरः hero, सः हरियूथपः that chief of monkeys, हेमया with golden, तयामालया with that necklace, सन्ध्यानुगतपर्यन्तः hallowed by the glowing twilight, पयोधरः इव like the raincloud, अभवत् appeared
explanation: Vali, the chief hero of the monkeys, with his golden necklace appeared like the raincloud hallowed by the glowing twilight.

shloka_text: तस्य माला च देहश्च मर्मघाती च यश्शरः। त्रिधेव रचिता लक्ष्मीः पतितस्यापि शोभते4.17.7।।
transliteration: tasya mālā ca dehaśca marmaghātī ca yaśśaraḥ| tridheva racitā lakṣmīḥ patitasyāpi śobhate4.17.7||
translation: पतितस्यापि even though he had fallen down, तस्य his, माला च necklace, देहः च body and,मर्मघाती  pierced into the vital parts, यः शरः that arrow, त्रिधा in three ways, रचिता the effect, लक्ष्मीः the effulgence, इव similar , शोभते shining
explanation: Even though he had fallen down, the effulgence of his necklace on his body, and the arrow pierced into his vital parts remained.

shloka_text: तदस्त्रं तस्य वीरस्य स्वर्गमार्गप्रभावनम्। रामबाणासनक्षिप्तमावहत्परमां गतिम्4.17.8।।
transliteration: tadastraṃ tasya vīrasya svargamārgaprabhāvanam| rāmabāṇāsanakṣiptamāvahatparamāṃ gatim4.17.8||
translation: स्वर्गमार्गप्रभावनम् that which paves the way to heaven (for the dead), रामबाणा Rama's arrow, सनक्षिप्तम् released, तत् that, अस्त्रम् weapon, तस्य वीरस्य that hero's, परमां गतिम् supreme destination, आवहत् created
explanation: Rama's arrow released paved the way to heaven which was that hero's supreme destination.

shloka_text: तं तदा पतितं सङ्ख्ये गतार्चिषमिवानलम्। बहुमान्य च तं वीर वीक्षमाणं शनैरिव।4.17.9।। ययातिमिव पुण्यान्ते देवलोकादिहच्युतम्। आदित्यमिव कालेन युगान्ते भुवि पातितम्।4.17.10।। महेन्द्रमिव दुर्धर्षंमुपेन्द्रमिव दुस्सहम्। महेन्द्रपुत्रं पतितं वालिनं हेममालिनम्।।4.17.11।। सिंहोरस्कं महाबाहुं दीप्तास्यं हरिलोचनम्। लक्ष्मणानुगतो रामो ददर्शोपससर्प च।।4.17.12।।
transliteration: taṃ tadā patitaṃ saṅkhye gatārciṣamivānalam| bahumānya ca taṃ vīra vīkṣamāṇaṃ śanairiva|4.17.9|| yayātimiva puṇyānte devalokādihacyutam| ādityamiva kālena yugānte bhuvi pātitam|4.17.10|| mahendramiva durdharṣaṃmupendramiva dussaham| mahendraputraṃ patitaṃ vālinaṃ hemamālinam siṃhoraskaṃ mahābāhuṃ dīptāsyaṃ harilocanam| lakṣmaṇānugato rāmo dadarśopasasarpa ca
translation: सङ्ख्ये in the battle , तदा then, पतितम् fallen, भुवि on the ground, आदित्यमिव like the Sun,  गतार्चिषम् fire without flame, अनलम् इव fire like, पुण्यान्ते after exhaustion of the merits, कालेन by the time, देवलोकात् the abode of gods, इह here, च्युतम् descended down, युगान्ते at the end of aeon (at the end of the world), ययातिमिव like Yayati, महेन्द्रमिव like Indra, दुर्धर्षम् unassailable, उपेन्द्रमिव like Upendra, दुःसहम् intolerable,महेन्द्रपुत्रम् son of Indra, हेममालिनम् adorned with golden necklace, सिंहोरस्कम् lionchested, महाबाहुम् of mighty arms, दीप्तास्यम् with a bright face, हरिलोचनम् tawnyeyed, तं वालिनम् that Vali, लक्ष्मणानुगतो followed by Lakshmna, रामः Rama, पतितम् fallen, ददर्श saw, उपससर्प च approached, शनैरिव slowly, वीक्षमाणम् observing, तं वीरम् that hero, बहुमान्य  admiringly.
explanation: Rama followed by Lakshmana slowly approached the longarmed, lionchested, brightfaced, tawnyeyed Vali, and admiringly observed this unchallengeable son of Indra, unassailable like Indra himself. Adorned with a golden necklace, he had fallen on the ground like fire without flame, like king Yayati descended on the earth from the celestial realm on the exhaustion of his merits, or like the Sun cast down on the earth at the end of the aeon.

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा राघवं वाली लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं परुषं धर्मसंहितम्4.17.13।। त्वं नराधिपतेः पुत्रः प्रथितः प्रियदर्शनः कुलीनस्सत्त्वसम्पन्न स्तेजस्वी चरितव्रतः।।4.17.14।। पराङ्मुखवधं कृत्वा कोऽत्र प्राप्तस्त्वया गुणः। यदहं युद्धसंरब्धश्शरेणोरसि ताडित:4.17.15।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavaṃ vālī lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam| abravītpraśritaṃ vākyaṃ paruṣaṃ dharmasaṃhitam4.17.13|| tvaṃ narādhipateḥ putraḥ prathitaḥ priyadarśanaḥ kulīnassattvasampanna stejasvī caritavrataḥ parāṅmukhavadhaṃ kṛtvā ko'tra prāptastvayā guṇaḥ| yadahaṃ yuddhasaṃrabdhaśśareṇorasi tāḍita:4.17.15||
translation: तं राघवम् to, Rama, महाबलम् powerful, लक्ष्मणं च and to Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वाचा by word, परुषम् pride, धर्मसंहितम् righteous, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, त्वं नराधिपतेः पुत्रैः you are a prince, प्रथितः famous, प्रियदर्शनः handsome, कुलीनस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नः born in  a noble family, तेजस्वी  brilliant, चरितव्रतः follower of good practices, युद्धसंरब्धः while waging war, अहम् I, यत् ताडित गतः hit, पराङ्मुखवधम् killing one who was engaged otherwise ,कृत्वा having done that, अत्र there, कः what, गुणः merit, त्वया by you, प्राप्तः gained
explanation: On seeing powerful Rama and Lakshmana approaching,Vali spoke with pride and rigteousness to Rama, 'You are a prince, born of a noble family, son of a renowned king. You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा राघवं वाली लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं परुषं धर्मसंहितम्4.17.13।। त्वं नराधिपतेः पुत्रः प्रथितः प्रियदर्शनः कुलीनस्सत्त्वसम्पन्न स्तेजस्वी चरितव्रतः।।4.17.14।। पराङ्मुखवधं कृत्वा कोऽत्र प्राप्तस्त्वया गुणः। यदहं युद्धसंरब्धश्शरेणोरसि ताडित:4.17.15।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavaṃ vālī lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam| abravītpraśritaṃ vākyaṃ paruṣaṃ dharmasaṃhitam4.17.13|| tvaṃ narādhipateḥ putraḥ prathitaḥ priyadarśanaḥ kulīnassattvasampanna stejasvī caritavrataḥ parāṅmukhavadhaṃ kṛtvā ko'tra prāptastvayā guṇaḥ| yadahaṃ yuddhasaṃrabdhaśśareṇorasi tāḍita:4.17.15||
translation: तं राघवम् to, Rama, महाबलम् powerful, लक्ष्मणं च and to Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वाचा by word, परुषम् pride, धर्मसंहितम् righteous, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said, त्वं नराधिपतेः पुत्रैः you are a prince, प्रथितः famous, प्रियदर्शनः handsome, कुलीनस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नः born in  a noble family, तेजस्वी  brilliant, चरितव्रतः follower of good practices, युद्धसंरब्धः while waging war, अहम् I, यत् ताडित गतः hit, पराङ्मुखवधम् killing one who was engaged otherwise ,कृत्वा having done that, अत्र there, कः what, गुणः merit, त्वया by you, प्राप्तः gained
explanation: On seeing powerful Rama and Lakshmana approaching,Vali spoke with pride and rigteousness to Rama, 'You are a prince, born of a noble family, son of a renowned king. You are famous, brilliant, handsome and follower of good practices.Having hit me when I was engaged otherwise in an encounter what merit have you gained?'

shloka_text: रामः करुणवेदी च प्रजानां च हिते रतः। सानुक्रोशो जितोत्साहस्समयज्ञो दृढव्रतः।।4.17.16।। इति ते सर्वभूतानि कथयन्ति यशो भुवि।।4.17.17।।
transliteration: rāmaḥ karuṇavedī ca prajānāṃ ca hite rataḥ| sānukrośo jitotsāhassamayajño dṛḍhavrataḥ iti te sarvabhūtāni kathayanti yaśo bhuvi
translation: रामः Rama, करुणवेदी च a kind soul, प्रजानाम् of people,हिते in the wellbeing, रतः engaged,  सानुक्रोशः compassionate, जितोत्साहः enthusiastic, समयज्ञः one who has a sense of time, दृढव्रतः steadfast in vows, इति in this way, ते your, यशः fame, सर्वभूतानि all beings, भुवि the world, कथयन्ति praise you
explanation: All beings proclaim your fame throughout the world, saying: Rama is compassionate, devoted to his people's welfare, kindly, enthusiastic, mindful of the right occasion, and steadfast in his vows.

shloka_text: रामः करुणवेदी च प्रजानां च हिते रतः। सानुक्रोशो जितोत्साहस्समयज्ञो दृढव्रतः।।4.17.16।। इति ते सर्वभूतानि कथयन्ति यशो भुवि।।4.17.17।।
transliteration: rāmaḥ karuṇavedī ca prajānāṃ ca hite rataḥ| sānukrośo jitotsāhassamayajño dṛḍhavrataḥ iti te sarvabhūtāni kathayanti yaśo bhuvi
translation: रामः Rama, करुणवेदी च a kind soul, प्रजानाम् of people,हिते in the wellbeing, रतः engaged,  सानुक्रोशः compassionate, जितोत्साहः enthusiastic, समयज्ञः one who has a sense of time, दृढव्रतः steadfast in vows, इति in this way, ते your, यशः fame, सर्वभूतानि all beings, भुवि the world, कथयन्ति praise you
explanation: All beings proclaim your fame throughout the world, saying: Rama is compassionate, devoted to his people's welfare, kindly, enthusiastic, mindful of the right occasion, and steadfast in his vows.

shloka_text: दमश्शमः क्षमा धर्मो धृतिस्सत्यं पराक्रमः। पार्थिवानां गुणा राजन्दण्डश्चाप्यपराधिषु4.17.18।।
transliteration: damaśśamaḥ kṣamā dharmo dhṛtissatyaṃ parākramaḥ| pārthivānāṃ guṇā rājandaṇḍaścāpyaparādhiṣu4.17.18||
translation: राजन् O king, दमः selfcontrol, शमः control of mind, intellect, memory and ego क्षमा tolerance, धर्मः righteousness, धृतिः forbearance, सत्यम् truthfulness, पराक्रमः valour, अपराधिषु towards the offenders, दण्डश्च punishment, पार्थिवानाम् for king's, गुणाः virtues
explanation: 'O king selfcontrol (of organs of action and sense organs), righteousness, steadfastness, truthfulness, valiance and capacity to punish the offenders are virtues  of a king.

shloka_text: तान्गुणान्सम्प्रधार्याहमग्र्यं चाभिजनं तव। तारया प्रतिषिद्धोऽपि सुग्रीवेण समागतः4.17.19।।
transliteration: tānguṇānsampradhāryāhamagryaṃ cābhijanaṃ tava| tārayā pratiṣiddho'pi sugrīveṇa samāgataḥ4.17.19||
translation: अहम् I am, तान् them, गुणान् virtues, तव your, अग्र्यम् foremost, अभिजनम् noble, सम्प्रधार्य considered, तारया by Tara, प्रतिषिद्धः अपि even though forewarned, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, समागतः came for a combat
explanation: 'Believing that you are a repository of all these virtues are in you, and respecting your noble lineage I engaged in a duel with Sugriva even though I was forewarned (by Tara).

shloka_text: न मामन्येन सम्रब्धं प्रमत्तं योद्धु मर्हसि। इति मे बुद्धिरुत्पन्ना बभूवादर्शने तव4.17.20।।
transliteration: na māmanyena samrabdhaṃ pramattaṃ yoddhu marhasi| iti me buddhirutpannā babhūvādarśane tava4.17.20||
translation: तव your, आदर्शने not seen, अन्येन with others, सम्रब्धम् engaged in combat, प्रमत्तम् engrossed, माम् me, योद्धुम् attacked, नार्हसि not proper on your part, इति thus, मे my, बुद्धि: mind, उत्पन्ना strike, बभूव become
explanation: The conviction arose in my mind that, being unseen by you, you would not strike me while I was off my guard and engaged in combat with another.

shloka_text: न त्वां विनिहतात्मानं धर्मध्वजमधार्मिकम्। जाने पापसमाचारं तृणैः कूपमिवावृतम्4.17.21।।
transliteration: na tvāṃ vinihatātmānaṃ dharmadhvajamadhārmikam| jāne pāpasamācāraṃ tṛṇaiḥ kūpamivāvṛtam4.17.21||
translation: त्वाम् to you, विनिहतात्मानम् who has killed his soul( one who acts against his conscience), धर्मध्वजम् functioning under the banner of (showing off) virtue, अधार्मिकम्  unrighteous, पापसमाचारम् sinful in conduct, तृणैः by grass, आवृतम् covered, कूपम् इव like a well, न जाने I did not know
explanation: 'I did not know that you have killed your soul (by acting against your conscience), that you are sinful in conduct and unrighteous under the show of virtues like a well, its mouth covered with grass.

shloka_text: सतां वेषधरं पापं प्रच्छन्नमिव पावकम्। नाहं त्वामभिजानामि धर्मच्छद्माभिसंवृतम्4.17.22।।
transliteration: satāṃ veṣadharaṃ pāpaṃ pracchannamiva pāvakam| nāhaṃ tvāmabhijānāmi dharmacchadmābhisaṃvṛtam4.17.22||
translation: सताम् of piety, वेषधरम्  covered, पापम् a sinner, प्रच्छनम् a disguised person, पावकम् इव like fire, धर्मच्छद्माभिसंवृतम् with righteousness as a pretext, त्वाम् to you, अहम् I,  न अभिजानामि did not recognise
explanation: 'You are a sinful man covered with the mask of piety thus resembling a hidden fire. I failed to recognise that righteousness is a mere pretext for you.

shloka_text: विषये वा पुरे वा ते यदा पापं करोम्यहम्। न च त्वामवजाने च कस्मात्त्वं हंस्यकिल्बिषम्4.17.23।। फलमूलाशनं नित्यं वानरं वनगोचरम्। मामिहाप्रतियुध्यन्तमन्येन च समागतम्4.17.24।।
transliteration: viṣaye vā pure vā te yadā pāpaṃ karomyaham| na ca tvāmavajāne ca kasmāttvaṃ haṃsyakilbiṣam4.17.23|| phalamūlāśanaṃ nityaṃ vānaraṃ vanagocaram| māmihāpratiyudhyantamanyena ca samāgatam4.17.24||
translation: अहम् I am, यदा when, ते your, विषये वा or in your affairs, पुरे वा or in your city, पापम् sin, न करोमि I did not, त्वाम् to you, न च and not, अवजाने I did  not insult you, अकिल्बिषम् not done any harm to you, नित्यम् always, फलमूलाशनम् living on fruits and roots, वनगोचरम् roaming in the forest, वानरम् monkey, इह here, अप्रतियुध्यन्तम् not come to battle with you, अन्येन others, समागतम् come, माम् me, कस्मात् why, हंसि do you kill
explanation: 'I did no harm to your affairs or to your city. I did not insult you. Why did you choose to kill me, a monkey roaming in the forest and living on fruits and roots? I was not fighting you. Why did you come and strike a person like me?

shloka_text: विषये वा पुरे वा ते यदा पापं करोम्यहम्। न च त्वामवजाने च कस्मात्त्वं हंस्यकिल्बिषम्4.17.23।। फलमूलाशनं नित्यं वानरं वनगोचरम्। मामिहाप्रतियुध्यन्तमन्येन च समागतम्4.17.24।।
transliteration: viṣaye vā pure vā te yadā pāpaṃ karomyaham| na ca tvāmavajāne ca kasmāttvaṃ haṃsyakilbiṣam4.17.23|| phalamūlāśanaṃ nityaṃ vānaraṃ vanagocaram| māmihāpratiyudhyantamanyena ca samāgatam4.17.24||
translation: अहम् I am, यदा when, ते your, विषये वा or in your affairs, पुरे वा or in your city, पापम् sin, न करोमि I did not, त्वाम् to you, न च and not, अवजाने I did  not insult you, अकिल्बिषम् not done any harm to you, नित्यम् always, फलमूलाशनम् living on fruits and roots, वनगोचरम् roaming in the forest, वानरम् monkey, इह here, अप्रतियुध्यन्तम् not come to battle with you, अन्येन others, समागतम् come, माम् me, कस्मात् why, हंसि do you kill
explanation: 'I did no harm to your affairs or to your city. I did not insult you. Why did you choose to kill me, a monkey roaming in the forest and living on fruits and roots? I was not fighting you. Why did you come and strike a person like me?

shloka_text: त्वं नराधिपतेः पुत्रः प्रतीतः प्रियदर्शनः। लिङ्गमप्यस्ति ते राजनन्दृश्यते धर्मसंहितम्4.17.25।।
transliteration: tvaṃ narādhipateḥ putraḥ pratītaḥ priyadarśanaḥ| liṅgamapyasti te rājanandṛśyate dharmasaṃhitam4.17.25||
translation: त्वम् you, प्रियदर्शनः pleasing in appearance, नराधिपतेः पुत्रः son of a king, प्रतीतः famous, राजन् O king, ते to you, धर्मसंहितम् righteous one, लिङ्गमपि  even signs, अस्ति are, दृश्यते found
explanation: 'O prince, you are son to a king, handsome and famous. Even signs of righteousness are discernible in you.

shloka_text: कः क्षत्रियकुले जात्शृतवान्नष्टसंशयः। धर्मलिङ्गप्रतिच्छन्न क्रूरं कर्म समाचरेत्4.17.26।।
transliteration: kaḥ kṣatriyakule jātśṛtavānnaṣṭasaṃśayaḥ| dharmaliṅgapraticchanna krūraṃ karma samācaret4.17.26||
translation: क्षत्रियकुले in a kshatriya family, जातः born, श्रुतवान् one who has read the Vedas, नष्टसंशयः free from doubt, धर्मलिङ्गप्रतिच्छन्नः in the guise of a righteous person, कः who, क्रूरम् cruel, कर्म deed, समाचरेत् will do
explanation: 'Who, born in a kshatriya family, versed in the Vedas and free from doubt will commit such a cruel act under the guise of righteousness?

shloka_text: राम राजकुले जातो धर्मवानिति विश्रुतः।।4.17.27।। अभव्यो भव्यरूपेण किमर्थं परिधावसि।
transliteration: rāma rājakule jāto dharmavāniti viśrutaḥ abhavyo bhavyarūpeṇa kimarthaṃ paridhāvasi|
translation: राजकुले in royal family, जातः born, धर्मवानिति  proficient in dharma, विश्रुतः wellknown, राम Rama, अभव्यः unworthy, भव्यरूपेण attire, किमर्थम् for what reason, परिधावसे running
explanation: 'You are born in a royal family. You are wellknown. You are proficient in dharma. Yet you are unworthy  of your race and robe.

shloka_text: साम दानं क्षमा धर्मस्सत्यं धृतिपराक्रमौ। पार्थिवानां गुणा राजन् दण्डश्चाप्यपराधिषु4.17.28।।
transliteration: sāma dānaṃ kṣamā dharmassatyaṃ dhṛtiparākramau| pārthivānāṃ guṇā rājan daṇḍaścāpyaparādhiṣu4.17.28||
translation: राजन् O king, साम conciliation, दानम् generosity, क्षमा forbearance, धर्मः righteousness, सत्यम् truth, धृतिपराक्रमौ steadfast in valour, अपराधिषु at the offenders, दण्डः punishment, पार्थिवानाम् of the rulers, गुणाः hallmarks
explanation: 'Conciliation, generosity, forbearance, righteousness, truthfulness, steadfastness in valour and punishing offenders are the hallmarks of rulers.

shloka_text: वयं वनचरा राम मृगा मूलफलाशना:। एषा प्रकृतिरस्माकं पुरुषस्त्वं नरेश्वरः4.17.29।।
transliteration: vayaṃ vanacarā rāma mṛgā mūlaphalāśanā:| eṣā prakṛtirasmākaṃ puruṣastvaṃ nareśvaraḥ4.17.29||
translation: राम Rama, वयम् we, मूलफलाशना: live on roots and fruits, वनचराः wanderers in forest, मृगाः animals, एषा this, अस्माकम् our, प्रकृतिः nature, त्वम् you, नरेश्वरः lord of men, पुरुषः a man
explanation: 'O Rama we are mere animals wandering in the forest and living on roots and fruits. This is our nature. (But) you are a lord of men.

shloka_text: भूमिर्हिरण्यं रूप्यं च विग्रहे कारणानि च। अत्र कस्ते वने लोभो मदीयेषु फलेषु वा4.17.30।।
transliteration: bhūmirhiraṇyaṃ rūpyaṃ ca vigrahe kāraṇāni ca| atra kaste vane lobho madīyeṣu phaleṣu vā4.17.30||
translation: विग्रहे in battle, भूमिः land, हिरण्यम् gold, रूप्यं च and silver, कारणानि reasons, तत्र there, ते to you, वने in the forest, मदीयेषु in my belongings, फलेषु in fruits वा or, लोभः greediness, कः what for?
explanation: 'We fight for land or gold or silver. What did you fight me for, for what I have or for the fruits of the forest?

shloka_text: नयश्च विनयश्चोभौ निग्रहानुग्रहावपि4.17.31।। राजवृत्तिरसङ्कीर्णा न नृपाः कामवृत्तयः।
transliteration: nayaśca vinayaścobhau nigrahānugrahāvapi4.17.31|| rājavṛttirasaṅkīrṇā na nṛpāḥ kāmavṛttayaḥ|
translation: नयश्च  submissiveness, विनयश्च  modesty, निग्रहानुग्रहौ  restraint and favour, उभावपि both are, असङ्कीर्णा not to be mixed up, राजवृत्तिः king's functions, नृपाः kings, कामवृत्तयः impulsive, न not excercise
explanation: 'Submissiveness and modesty are the attributes of good rulers and should not be mixed up with benevolence and selfrestraint. Kings ought not to act (as they like) impulsively.

shloka_text: त्वं तु कामप्रधानश्च कोपनश्चानवस्थितः4.17.32।। राजवृत्तेश्च सङ्कीणश्शरासनपरायणः।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu kāmapradhānaśca kopanaścānavasthitaḥ4.17.32|| rājavṛtteśca saṅkīṇaśśarāsanaparāyaṇaḥ|
translation: त्वं तु you also, कामप्रधानश्च fulfilling your own desire is important, कोपनश्च wrathful, अनवस्थितः unstable, राजवृत्तेश्च royal course of conduct, सङ्कीर्णः intermingled, शरासनपरायणः you have  discharged arrows
explanation: 'Fulfilling your own desire is important for you. You are wrathful and unstable with royal course of conduct. Your business is with your bow and arrows.

shloka_text: न तेऽस्त्यपचितिर्धर्मे नार्थे बुद्धिरवस्थिता4.17.33।। इन्द्रियैः कामवृत्तस्सन्कृष्यसे मनुजेश्वर।
transliteration: na te'styapacitirdharme nārthe buddhiravasthitā4.17.33|| indriyaiḥ kāmavṛttassankṛṣyase manujeśvara|
translation: मनुजेश्वरः lord of men, ते to you, धर्मे in righteousness, उपचितिः not have faith, न not, बुद्धि: intellect, अर्थे material wealth, न अवस्थिता not steadfast, कामवृत्तः सन् overcome by delusion, इन्द्रियैः by the senses, कृष्यसे you are drawn
explanation: 'O lord of men you have no faith in righteousness, no steadfastness in the acquisition of wealth. You have no control over the senses. You are overcome by delusion.

shloka_text: हत्वा बाणेन काकुत्स्थ मामिहानपराधिनम्4.17.34।। किं वक्ष्यसि सतां मध्ये कर्म कृत्वा जुगुप्सितम्।
transliteration: hatvā bāṇena kākutstha māmihānaparādhinam4.17.34|| kiṃ vakṣyasi satāṃ madhye karma kṛtvā jugupsitam|
translation: काकुत्स्थ O scion of the Kakutstha race, अनपराधिनम् one who has not done any harm, मा to me, इह here, बाणेन by arrow, हत्वा having killed, जुगुप्सितम् abominable, कर्म deed, कृत्वा after commiting, सताम् to the holy people, मध्ये midst, किम् what, वक्ष्यसि will you answer?
explanation: 'O scion of the Kakutsthas Having killed me here with your arrow even though I have done you no harm, you have perpetrated an abominable act. How will you defend yourself in the midst of holy men after commiting such a sinful act?

shloka_text: राजहा ब्रह्महा गोघ्नश्चोरः प्राणिवधे रतः4.17.35।। नास्तिकः परिवेत्ता च सर्वे निरयगामिनः।
transliteration: rājahā brahmahā goghnaścoraḥ prāṇivadhe rataḥ4.17.35|| nāstikaḥ parivettā ca sarve nirayagāminaḥ|
translation: राजहा killer of a king, ब्रह्महा  killer of brahmin, गोघ्नः  killer of cows, चोर: a thief, प्राणिवधेरत: killer of living beings,नास्तिकः atheist, परिवेत्ता च and one who marries before his elder sibling, सर्वे all, निरयगामिनः will go to hell
explanation: 'One who kills a king, a brahmin or a cow, a thief or one who delights in destruction of life an atheist or one who marries before his elder  they all go to hell.

shloka_text: सूचकश्च कदर्यश्च मित्रघ्नो गुरुतल्पगः4.17.36।। लोकं पापात्मनामेते गच्छन्ते नात्र संशयः।
transliteration: sūcakaśca kadaryaśca mitraghno gurutalpagaḥ4.17.36|| lokaṃ pāpātmanāmete gacchante nātra saṃśayaḥ|
translation: सूचकः च a talebearer, कदर्यः च and a mean fellow, मित्रघ्नः murderer of a friend, गुरुतल्पगः one who shares the bed of the Guru's wife, एते these people, पापात्मनाम् of sinners, लोकम् to the world, गच्छन्ते will go, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no
explanation: A tale-bearer, a miser, a betrayer of friends, and one who defiles his guru's bed—these surely go to the world of sinners, there is no doubt.

shloka_text: अधार्यं चर्म मे सद्भी रोमाण्यस्थि च वर्जितम्। अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि त्वद्विधैर्धर्मचारिभिः4.17.37।।
transliteration: adhāryaṃ carma me sadbhī romāṇyasthi ca varjitam| abhakṣyāṇi ca māṃsāni tvadvidhairdharmacāribhiḥ4.17.37||
translation: मे mine, चर्म skin, अधार्यम् is not fit to be worn, रोमाणि hair, सदभी: by the virtuous, अस्थि च bone also, वर्जितम् is prohibited, त्वद्विधैः by men like you also, धर्मचारिभिः by righteous people, मांसानि flesh, अभक्ष्याणि च is not fit for eating
explanation: 'My skin is not fit to be worn by the virtuous, my hair and bones are also prohibited from any use. My flesh is also not at all fit to be eaten by righteous people like you

shloka_text: पञ्च पञ्च नखा भक्ष्या ब्रह्मक्षत्रेण राघव4.17.38।। शल्यक श्श्वाविधो गोधा शशः कूर्मश्च पञ्चमः।
transliteration: pañca pañca nakhā bhakṣyā brahmakṣatreṇa rāghava4.17.38|| śalyaka śśvāvidho godhā śaśaḥ kūrmaśca pañcamaḥ|
translation: राघव Rama, ब्रह्मक्षत्रेण by brahmin and kshatriya, शल्यकः porcupine, श्वाविधः the hedgehog, गोधा the alligator, शशः the rabbit, कूर्मश्च the turtle, पञ्चमः the five, पञ्चनखाः fivenailed creatures, भक्ष्याः are permitted to be eaten
explanation: 'O Rama brahmins and kshatriyas are permitted to eat only the five nailed animals the porcupine, the hedgehog, the alligator, the rabbit and the tortoise.

shloka_text: चर्म चास्थि च मे राजन् नस्पृशन्ति मनीषिणः4.17.39।। अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि सोऽहं पञ्चनखो हतः।
transliteration: carma cāsthi ca me rājan naspṛśanti manīṣiṇaḥ4.17.39|| abhakṣyāṇi ca māṃsāni so'haṃ pañcanakho hataḥ|
translation: राजन O king, मनीषिणः learned people, मे mine, चर्म च even skin, अस्थीनि bone, न स्पृशन्ति do not touch, मांसानि च and the flesh, अभक्ष्याणि should not be eaten, पञ्चमः five nailed animal, सः अहम् such me, हतः killed
explanation: 'O king the learned do not even touch my skin or bone. They do not eat my flesh. While it is so, you have unnecessarily killed me, a fivenailed animal.

shloka_text: तारया वाक्यमुक्तोऽहं सत्यं सर्वज्ञया हितम्4.17.40।। तदतिक्रम्य मोहेन कालस्य वशमागतः।
transliteration: tārayā vākyamukto'haṃ satyaṃ sarvajñayā hitam4.17.40|| tadatikramya mohena kālasya vaśamāgataḥ|
translation: सर्वज्ञया by the omniscient, तारया by Tara, अहम् I, सत्यम् truth, हितम् wellbeing, वाक्यम् words, उक्तः warned, मोहेन out of ignorance or arrogance, तत् that, अतिक्रम्य overriding, कालस्य  of yama (the lord of death), वशम् fold, आगतः came under
explanation: 'Tara knew everything. Her words were correct. They were meant for my wellbeing. However, due to my ignorance (or arrogance), I did not heed her words and fell under the sway of the lord of death

shloka_text: त्वया नाथेन काकुत्स्थ न सनाथा वसुन्धरा। प्रमदा शीलसम्पन्ना धूर्तेन पतिना यथा4.17.41।।
transliteration: tvayā nāthena kākutstha na sanāthā vasundharā| pramadā śīlasampannā dhūrtena patinā yathā4.17.41||
translation: काकुत्स्थ Kakutstha, वसुन्धरा earth, नाथेन by lord, त्वया by you, शीलसम्पन्ना one endowed with good character, प्रमदा a lady, धूर्तेन by a wicked one, यथा similarly, पतिना by husband, सनाथा a protector, न no
explanation: 'O Kakutstha just as a wife endowed with good character cannot be protected by a wicked husband, you cannot be a protector of this earth.

shloka_text: शठो नैकृतिकः क्षुद्रो मिथ्याप्रश्रितमानसः। कथं दशरथेन त्वं जातः पापो महात्मना4.17.42।।
transliteration: śaṭho naikṛtikaḥ kṣudro mithyāpraśritamānasaḥ| kathaṃ daśarathena tvaṃ jātaḥ pāpo mahātmanā4.17.42||
translation: शठः treacherous, नैकृतिकः dishonest, क्षुद्रः mean, मिथ्याप्रश्रितमानसः guised with false humility, पापः sinner, त्वम् you, महात्मना highsouled, दशरथेन to Dasaratha, कथम् how, जातः were you born?
explanation: 'You are treacherous, dishonest, mean, guised with false humility and a sinner to the core. How were you born to that highsouled Dasaratha?

shloka_text: छिन्नचारित्रकक्ष्येण सतां धर्मातिवर्तिना। त्यक्तधर्माङ्कुशेनाहं निहतो रामहस्तिना4.17.43।।
transliteration: chinnacāritrakakṣyeṇa satāṃ dharmātivartinā| tyaktadharmāṅkuśenāhaṃ nihato rāmahastinā4.17.43||
translation: छिन्नचारित्रकक्ष्येण breaking through the chains of good character, सताम् the sages, धर्मातिवर्तिना trespassing moral code of conduct, त्यक्तधर्माङ्कुशेन discharging sharp arrow of righteousness, रामहस्तिना the elephant called Rama, अहम् I, निहतः killed
explanation: 'Breaking through the chains of good character, trespassing the moral code of conduct of the sages, discharging the sharp arrow of righteousness, the elephantine (arrogant) Rama killed me.

shloka_text: अशुभं चाप्ययुक्तं च सतां चैव विगर्हितम्। वक्ष्यसे चेदृशं कृत्वा सद्भिस्सह समागतः4.17.44।।
transliteration: aśubhaṃ cāpyayuktaṃ ca satāṃ caiva vigarhitam| vakṣyase cedṛśaṃ kṛtvā sadbhissaha samāgataḥ4.17.44||
translation: अशुभम् inauspicious, अयुक्तम् not fit, सताम् to the noble, विगर्हितम् despised, ईदृशम् such, कृत्वा after doing, सद्भिः सह by the noble, समागतः meet with, वक्ष्यसे you say.
explanation: 'You have committed an inauspicious, improper act, despised by the virtuous. What will you speak when you are questioned by noble men for committing such an act?

shloka_text: उदासीनेषु योऽस्मासु विक्रमऽस्ते प्रकाशितः। अपकारिषु ते राजन्नहि पश्यामि विक्रमम्4.17.45।।
transliteration: udāsīneṣu yo'smāsu vikrama'ste prakāśitaḥ| apakāriṣu te rājannahi paśyāmi vikramam4.17.45||
translation: राजन O king, उदासीनेषु to the indifferent people, अस्मासु towards us, यः such, अयम् this, विक्रमः power, प्रकाशितः shown, विक्रमम् such valour, अपकारिषु to the harmful, न पश्यामि do not see
explanation: 'O king you have exhibited your valour against one who has done you no harm. Why have you not shown such valour on those who have offended you?

shloka_text: दृश्यमानस्तु युद्ध्येथा मया यदि नृपात्मज। अद्य वैवस्वतं देवं पश्येस्त्वं निहतो मया4.17.46।।
transliteration: dṛśyamānastu yuddhyethā mayā yadi nṛpātmaja| adya vaivasvataṃ devaṃ paśyestvaṃ nihato mayā4.17.46||
translation: नृपात्मज O prince, यदि if, दृश्यमानः openly, मया by me, युद्ध्येथाः you had fought, मया by me, निहतः killed, अद्य  today, त्वम् you, वैवस्वतं देवम् Vaivasvata, the lord of death, पश्येः you would have seen.
explanation: 'O prince had  you fought me face to face you would have seen Vaivasvata, the lord of death today (you would have been killed by me).

shloka_text: त्वयाऽदृश्येन तु रणे निहतोऽहं दुरासदः। प्रसुप्तः पन्नगेनेव नरः पानवशं गतः4.17.47।।
transliteration: tvayā'dṛśyena tu raṇe nihato'haṃ durāsadaḥ| prasuptaḥ pannageneva naraḥ pānavaśaṃ gataḥ4.17.47||
translation: दुरासदः an unassailable warrior, अहम् I am, रणे in battle, अदृश्येन not seen, त्वया by you, पानवशं गतः in a drunken state, प्रसुप्तः  in deep sleep, नरः man, पन्नगेनेव like by the snake, निहतः killed
explanation: bitten to death by a snake while fast asleep.

shloka_text: मामेव यदि पूर्वं त्वमेतदर्थमचोदयः4.17.48।। मैथिलीमहमेकाह्ना तव चानीतवान्भवेत्। सुग्रीवप्रियकामेन यदहं निहतस्त्वया। कण्ठे बद्ध्वा प्रदद्यां ते निहतं रावणं रणे4.17.49।।
transliteration: māmeva yadi pūrvaṃ tvametadarthamacodayaḥ4.17.48|| maithilīmahamekāhnā tava cānītavānbhavet| sugrīvapriyakāmena yadahaṃ nihatastvayā| kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyāṃ te nihataṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe4.17.49||
translation: सुग्रीवप्रियकामेन to please Sugriva, त्वया by you, अहम् me, यत् since, निहतः killed, त्वम् you, एतदर्थम् on this account, पूर्वम् earlier, मामेव to me only, अचोदयः यदि if you had sought, रावणम् Ravana, रणे in battle, निहतम् killed, कण्ठे by the neck, बद्ध्वा tying, ते you, प्रदद्याम् I would have handed over
explanation: 'Had you sought my help earlier(before you met Sugriva), I would have restored Sita to you within a single day. I have been killed by you to oblige Sugriva. I would have handed over Ravana by the neck after killing him in the battle.

shloka_text: मामेव यदि पूर्वं त्वमेतदर्थमचोदयः4.17.48।। मैथिलीमहमेकाह्ना तव चानीतवान्भवेत्। सुग्रीवप्रियकामेन यदहं निहतस्त्वया। कण्ठे बद्ध्वा प्रदद्यां ते निहतं रावणं रणे4.17.49।।
transliteration: māmeva yadi pūrvaṃ tvametadarthamacodayaḥ4.17.48|| maithilīmahamekāhnā tava cānītavānbhavet| sugrīvapriyakāmena yadahaṃ nihatastvayā| kaṇṭhe baddhvā pradadyāṃ te nihataṃ rāvaṇaṃ raṇe4.17.49||
translation: सुग्रीवप्रियकामेन to please Sugriva, त्वया by you, अहम् me, यत् since, निहतः killed, त्वम् you, एतदर्थम् on this account, पूर्वम् earlier, मामेव to me only, अचोदयः यदि if you had sought, रावणम् Ravana, रणे in battle, निहतम् killed, कण्ठे by the neck, बद्ध्वा tying, ते you, प्रदद्याम् I would have handed over
explanation: 'Had you sought my help earlier(before you met Sugriva), I would have restored Sita to you within a single day. I have been killed by you to oblige Sugriva. I would have handed over Ravana by the neck after killing him in the battle.

shloka_text: न्यस्तां सागरतोये वा पाताले वापि मैथिलीम्। आनयेयं तवादेशाच्छ्वेतामश्वतरीमिव4.17.50।।
transliteration: nyastāṃ sāgaratoye vā pātāle vāpi maithilīm| ānayeyaṃ tavādeśācchvetāmaśvatarīmiva4.17.50||
translation: सागरतोये वा even from the water of the ocean, पातालेऽपि वा or even in the underworld, न्यस्ताम् hidden, मैथिलीम् Sita, तव your, आदेशात् by your order, श्वेताम्  like Sweta, अश्वतरीमिव like Aswatari, अनये यम् I could have brought
explanation: 'Even if she were hidden in the waters of the ocean or in the underworld, I would have brought her by your order like Sweta to Aswatari or Hayagriva. (Hayagriva, an incarnation of Visnu brought Vedas stolen by demons, Madhu and Kaitabha from Patala or the netherworld)

shloka_text: युक्तं यत्प्राप्नुयाद्राज्यं सुग्रीवस्स्वर्गते मयि। अयुक्तं यदधर्मेण त्वयाऽहं निहतो रणे4.17.51।।
transliteration: yuktaṃ yatprāpnuyādrājyaṃ sugrīvassvargate mayi| ayuktaṃ yadadharmeṇa tvayā'haṃ nihato raṇe4.17.51||
translation: मयि in me, स्वर्गते on going to heaven, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्नुयात् इति getting as such, युक्तम् is right, अहम् I, रणे in war, त्वया by your, अधर्मेण by unjustifiable means, निहतः इति यत् this way been killed, अयुक्तम् not proper
explanation: 'Sugriva inheriting the kingdom after my departure to heaven is proper. But your killing me this way in the combat by unjustifiable means is not.

shloka_text: काममेवं विधो लोकः कालेन विनियुज्यते। क्षमं चेद्भवता प्राप्तमुत्तरं साधु चिन्त्यताम्4.17.52।।
transliteration: kāmamevaṃ vidho lokaḥ kālena viniyujyate| kṣamaṃ cedbhavatā prāptamuttaraṃ sādhu cintyatām4.17.52||
translation: लोकः the world, एवं विधः in this way, कामं indeed, कालेन  when time of death comes, विनियुज्यते hiding, क्षमं चेत् is it right, भवता for you, प्राप्तम् achieved, उत्तरम् reply, साधु properly, चिन्त्यताम् think over
explanation: 'Indeed, in the world people meet with death when the time comes. Hiding yourself (from me) you have achieved it. Is it proper for you? You may think over and give your reply.'

shloka_text: इत्युक्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यं धर्मार्थसहितं हितम्। परुषं वालिना रामो निहतेन विचेतसा4.18.1।।
transliteration: ityuktaḥ praśritaṃ vākyaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ hitam| paruṣaṃ vālinā rāmo nihatena vicetasā4.18.1||
translation: रामः Rama, निहतेन struck, विचेतसा confused in mind, वालिना Vali, धर्मार्थसहितम् righteous, हितम् wellmeaning, प्रश्रितम् courteous, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, इति these, उक्तः said.
explanation: To these harsh words though seemingly wellmeaning, courteous and righteous, Vali who had been mortally wounded and confused in mind, Rama replied:
comments: Rama explains to Vali the righteous duties of kings -- justifies his action in killing him -- Vali pleads with Rama to protect Angada

shloka_text: तं निष्प्रभमिवादित्यं मुक्ततोयमिवाम्बुदम्। उक्तवाक्यं हरिश्रेष्ठमुपशान्तमिवानलम्4.18.2।। धर्मार्थगुणसम्पन्नं हरीश्वरमनुत्तमम्। अधिक्षिप्तस्तदा रामः पश्चाद्वालिनमब्रवीत्4.18.3।।
transliteration: taṃ niṣprabhamivādityaṃ muktatoyamivāmbudam| uktavākyaṃ hariśreṣṭhamupaśāntamivānalam4.18.2|| dharmārthaguṇasampannaṃ harīśvaramanuttamam| adhikṣiptastadā rāmaḥ paścādvālinamabravīt4.18.3||
translation: तदा then, अधिक्षिप्तः having been criticised, रामः Rama, निष्प्रभम्  lost his glow, आदित्यम्  Sun, इव like, मुक्ततोयम् raindrained, अम्बुदमिव like the cloud, उपशान्तम् extinguished, अनलम् इव like the fire, हरिश्रेष्ठम् best of monkeys, हरीश्वरम् king of monkeys, अनुत्तमम् excellent, धर्मार्थगुणसम्पन्नम् righteous, उक्तवाक्यम् spoke out, वालिनम् to Vali, पश्चात् later, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: To righteous Vali,the best of the monkeys, the lord of the monkeys, who looked like the Sun shorn of his brilliance or a raindrained cloud or a fire that had been extinguished. Rama, under the scanner, said in reply:

shloka_text: तं निष्प्रभमिवादित्यं मुक्ततोयमिवाम्बुदम्। उक्तवाक्यं हरिश्रेष्ठमुपशान्तमिवानलम्4.18.2।। धर्मार्थगुणसम्पन्नं हरीश्वरमनुत्तमम्। अधिक्षिप्तस्तदा रामः पश्चाद्वालिनमब्रवीत्4.18.3।।
transliteration: taṃ niṣprabhamivādityaṃ muktatoyamivāmbudam| uktavākyaṃ hariśreṣṭhamupaśāntamivānalam4.18.2|| dharmārthaguṇasampannaṃ harīśvaramanuttamam| adhikṣiptastadā rāmaḥ paścādvālinamabravīt4.18.3||
translation: तदा then, अधिक्षिप्तः having been criticised, रामः Rama, निष्प्रभम्  lost his glow, आदित्यम्  Sun, इव like, मुक्ततोयम् raindrained, अम्बुदमिव like the cloud, उपशान्तम् extinguished, अनलम् इव like the fire, हरिश्रेष्ठम् best of monkeys, हरीश्वरम् king of monkeys, अनुत्तमम् excellent, धर्मार्थगुणसम्पन्नम् righteous, उक्तवाक्यम् spoke out, वालिनम् to Vali, पश्चात् later, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: To righteous Vali,the best of the monkeys, the lord of the monkeys, who looked like the Sun shorn of his brilliance or a raindrained cloud or a fire that had been extinguished. Rama, under the scanner, said in reply:

shloka_text: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च समयं चापि लौकिकम्। अविज्ञाय कथं बाल्यान्मामिहाद्य विगर्हसे4.18.4।।
transliteration: dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca samayaṃ cāpi laukikam| avijñāya kathaṃ bālyānmāmihādya vigarhase4.18.4||
translation: धर्मम् righteousness, अर्थं च and wealth, कामं च pleasure also, लौकिकम् worldliness, समयं च at this time, अविज्ञाय not knowing, इह here, अद्य today, बाल्यात् from ignorance, माम् to me, कथम् how , विगर्हसे blame.
explanation: 'Without correct knowledge of dharma, artha, kama and worldly ways, how do you reproach me bitterly now in total ignorance?

shloka_text: अपृष्ट्वा बुद्धिसम्पन्नान्वृद्धानाचार्यसम्मतान्। सौम्य वानरचापल्यात्किं मावक्तुमिहेच्छसि4.18.5।।
transliteration: apṛṣṭvā buddhisampannānvṛddhānācāryasammatān| saumya vānaracāpalyātkiṃ māvaktumihecchasi4.18.5||
translation: बुद्धिसम्पन्नान् endowed with intelligence, आचार्यसम्मतान् which carries the approval of teachers, वृद्धान् elderly, अपृष्ट्वा without consulting, त्वम् you,सौम्य gentle one, माम् me, वानरचापल्यात् from frivolousness of a monkey, इह here, वक्तुम् for talking this way, इच्छसि you wish.
explanation: 'O gentle Vali why do you speak with monkeyish frivolousness, without consulting the elders and teachers endowed with intelligence?

shloka_text: इक्ष्वाकूणामियं भूमिस्सशैलवनकानना। मृगपक्षिमनुष्याणां निग्रहप्रग्रहावपि4.18.6।।
transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāmiyaṃ bhūmissaśailavanakānanā| mṛgapakṣimanuṣyāṇāṃ nigrahapragrahāvapi4.18.6||
translation: सशैलवनकानना including mountains, groves and forests, इयम् this, भूमिः earth, मृगपक्षिमनुष्याणाम् of animals, birds and humans, निग्रहप्रग्रहावपि punishing and rewarding also, इक्ष्वाकूणाम्  bequeathed to Ikshvaku race.
explanation: 'This earth including mountains, groves and forests, animals, birds and humans belongs to the Ikshvaku kings.The right of purnishment and reward also vests with them.

shloka_text: तां पालयति धर्मात्मा भरतस्सत्यवागृजुः। धर्मकामार्थतत्त्वज्ञो निग्रहानुग्रहे रतः4.18.7।।
transliteration: tāṃ pālayati dharmātmā bharatassatyavāgṛjuḥ| dharmakāmārthatattvajño nigrahānugrahe rataḥ4.18.7||
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous, सत्यवाक् truthful , ऋजुः upright one, धर्मकामार्थत्त्वज्ञः knower of  dharma, kama and artha, निग्रहानुग्रहे in punishment and reward, रतः rests, भरतः Bharata, ताम् that earth, पालयति rules
explanation: 'Bharata, righteous, truthful, upright, knower of dharma, artha and kama and dispenser of punishment and rewards, rules this earth.

shloka_text: नयश्च विनयश्चोभौ यस्मिन्सत्यं च सुस्थितम्। विक्रमश्च यथा दृष्टस्स राजा देशकालवित्4.18.8।।
transliteration: nayaśca vinayaścobhau yasminsatyaṃ ca susthitam| vikramaśca yathā dṛṣṭassa rājā deśakālavit4.18.8||
translation: यस्मिन् in whom, नयश्च justice, विनयश्च discipline, उभौ both, सत्यं च and truth, सुस्थितम् firmly established, विक्रमश्च and courage, यथा so, दृष्टः seen, सः he, देशकालवित् time and place for action, राजा king.
explanation: 'Bharata in whom justice and discipline, truth and courage along with the knowledge of time and place for action are firmly rooted is king (of this earth).

shloka_text: तस्य धर्मकृतादेशा वयमन्ये च पार्थिवाः। चरामो वसुधां कृत्स्नां धर्मसन्तानमिच्छवः4.18.9।।
transliteration: tasya dharmakṛtādeśā vayamanye ca pārthivāḥ| carāmo vasudhāṃ kṛtsnāṃ dharmasantānamicchavaḥ4.18.9||
translation: तस्य his, धर्मकृतादेशाः receiving instructions according to dharma, वयम् we, अन्ये others, पार्थिवाश्च and kings, धर्मसन्तानम् for the progress of dharma, इच्छवः desiring, कृत्स्नाम् this whole, वसुधाम् land, चरामः we are going about.
explanation: 'Following his command, in confirmity with dharma we and the other kings also move all over the  entire world desirous of promoting dharma.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्नृपतिशार्दूले भरते धर्मवत्सले। पालयत्यखिलां भूमिं कश्चरेद्धर्मनिग्रहम्4.18.10।।
transliteration: tasminnṛpatiśārdūle bharate dharmavatsale| pālayatyakhilāṃ bhūmiṃ kaścareddharmanigraham4.18.10||
translation: नृपतिशार्दूले when the tiger among kings, धर्मवत्सले lover of dharma, तस्मिन् in him, भरते when Bharata, अखिलाम् entire, भूमिम् earth, पालयति while he is ruling, कः who, धर्मनिग्रहम् can stray from dharma, चरेत् and go?
explanation: 'Who can stray from the path of dharma when the whole world is ruled by Bharata, a tiger among kings, and a lover of dharma?

shloka_text: ते वयं धर्मविभ्रष्टं स्वधर्मे परमे स्थिताः। भरताज्ञां पुरस्कृत्य निगृह्णीमो यथाविधि4.18.11।।
transliteration: te vayaṃ dharmavibhraṣṭaṃ svadharme parame sthitāḥ| bharatājñāṃ puraskṛtya nigṛhṇīmo yathāvidhi4.18.11||
translation: परमे supreme, स्वधर्मे in one's own duty, स्थिताः established, ते वयम् all of us by him, भरताज्ञाम् command of Bharata, पुरस्कृत्य regarding, यथाविधि our duty, धर्मविभ्रष्टम् one who strays from the path of dharma,  निगृह्णीमो will punish.
explanation: 'By the command of Bharata ,all of us are devoted to our duty of upholding dharma and virtue and duly punish those who deviate from the path of dharma.

shloka_text: त्वं तु संक्लिष्टधर्मा च कर्मणा च विगर्हितः। कामतन्त्रप्रधानश्च न स्थितो राजवर्त्मनि4.18.12।।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu saṃkliṣṭadharmā ca karmaṇā ca vigarhitaḥ| kāmatantrapradhānaśca na sthito rājavartmani4.18.12||
translation: त्वं तु you too, संक्लिष्टधर्मा च are violating dharma, कर्मणा by your actions, विगर्हितः despised, कामतन्त्रप्रधानश्च seeking pleasures as primary, राजवर्त्मनि on the right path of kings, न स्थितः did not stay.
explanation: 'You have violated dharma. You stand condemned for your actions. Passion is your priority. You have strayed from the right path of kings.

shloka_text: ज्येष्ठो भ्राता पिता चैव यश्च विद्यां प्रयच्छति। त्रयस्ते पितरो ज्ञेया धर्म्ये च पथि वर्तिनः4.18.13।।
transliteration: jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitā caiva yaśca vidyāṃ prayacchati| trayaste pitaro jñeyā dharmye ca pathi vartinaḥ4.18.13||
translation: धर्म्ये in a righteous, पथि path, वर्तिनः those who conduct, ज्येष्ठो भ्राता elder brother, पिता चैव  even father, यश्च his, विद्याम् knowledge, प्रयच्छति gives, ते त्रयः all the three, पितरः are fathers, ज्ञेयाः should be known.
explanation: The elder brother, the father, and he who imparts knowledge—these three, who conduct themselves on the path of righteousness, are to be known as fathers.

shloka_text: यवीयानात्मनः पुत्रशशिष्यश्चापि गुणोदितः। पुत्रवत्ते त्रयश्चिन्त्या धर्मश्चेदत्रकारणम्4.18.14।।
transliteration: yavīyānātmanaḥ putraśaśiṣyaścāpi guṇoditaḥ| putravatte trayaścintyā dharmaścedatrakāraṇam4.18.14||
translation: यवीयान् younger brother, पुत्रः son, गुणोदितः virtuous, शिष्यश्च a pupil, ते त्रयः these three, आत्मनः one's own, पुत्रवत् like son, चिन्त्याः should be treated, अत्र there, धर्मः dharma (morality), कारणम् judged.
explanation: A younger brother, a son, and a virtuous pupil—these three are to be regarded like one's own son; here righteousness is the deciding consideration.

shloka_text: सूक्ष्मः परमदुरजेयस्सतां धर्मः प्लवङ्गम। हृदिस्थस्सर्वभूतानामात्मा वेद शुभाशुभम्4.18.15।।
transliteration: sūkṣmaḥ paramadurajeyassatāṃ dharmaḥ plavaṅgama| hṛdisthassarvabhūtānāmātmā veda śubhāśubham4.18.15||
translation: प्लवङ्गम O monkey, सताम् for the pious ones, धर्मः dharma, सूक्ष्मः is subtle, परमदुरजेयः  extremely difficult to understand, सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, हृदिस्थः in the heart, आत्मा self, शुभाशुभम् good and bad, वेद knows.
explanation: 'O monkey dharma is very subtle. It is extremely difficult to understand. Installed in the hearts of all living beings the self knows good and evil (soul is the witness of good and evil).

shloka_text: चपलश्चपलैस्सार्धं वानरैरकृतात्मभिः। जात्यन्ध इव जात्यन्धैर्मन्त्रयन् प्रेक्षसे नु किम्4.18.16।।
transliteration: capalaścapalaissārdhaṃ vānarairakṛtātmabhiḥ| jātyandha iva jātyandhairmantrayan prekṣase nu kim4.18.16||
translation: चपलः frivolous one, अकृतात्मभिः by the pettyminded, चपलैः by the fickle ones, वानरैः सार्धम् with the monkeys, जात्यन्धैः इव as if blind by birth, मन्त्रयन् while counselling, प्रेक्षसे नु किम् (why do you look at these issues) for what?
explanation: 'You are fickle by nature. Your consultants are frivolous, pettyminded monkeys. It is like one born blind suppporting another blind by birth. What do you know (about dharma)?

shloka_text: अहं तु व्यक्ततामस्य वचनस्य ब्रवीमि ते। न हि मां केवलं रोषात्त्वं विगर्हितुमर्हसि4.18.17।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tu vyaktatāmasya vacanasya bravīmi te| na hi māṃ kevalaṃ roṣāttvaṃ vigarhitumarhasi4.18.17||
translation: अहम् I, अस्य his, वचनस्य of words, व्यक्तताम् clarify, ते to you, ब्रवीमि I will explain, त्वम् you, केवलम् only, रोषात् with anger, माम् me, विगर्हितुम् blame, नार्हसि हि not proper.
explanation: 'I shall explain to you clearly (the reason for striking you down). It is not proper for you to despise me with mere anger and malice.

shloka_text: तदेतत्कारणं पश्य यदर्थं त्वं मया हतः। भ्रातुर्वर्तसि भार्यायां त्यक्त्वा धर्मं सनातनम्4.18.18।।
transliteration: tadetatkāraṇaṃ paśya yadarthaṃ tvaṃ mayā hataḥ| bhrāturvartasi bhāryāyāṃ tyaktvā dharmaṃ sanātanam4.18.18||
translation: त्वम् you, यदर्थम् reason, मया by me, हतः struck, तत् एतत् all about that, कारणम् reason, पश्य see, सनातनम् having abandoned, धर्मम् law त्यक्त्वा casting, भ्रातुः brother's, भार्यायाम् with wife, वर्तसि live.
explanation: 'Now know the reason why I struck you down. Having abandoned the eternal  law, you are living with your younger brother's wife.

shloka_text: अस्य त्वं धरमाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। रुमायां वर्तसे कामात्स्नुषायां पापकर्मकृत्4.18.19।।
transliteration: asya tvaṃ dharamāṇasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ| rumāyāṃ vartase kāmātsnuṣāyāṃ pāpakarmakṛt4.18.19||
translation: महात्मनः great self, अस्य of this, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, धरमाणस्य when he is alive, पापकर्मकृत् a sinner, कामात् due to lust, स्नुषायाम् in your daughterinlaw, रुमायाम् with Ruma, वर्तसे live.
explanation: 'You are a sinner, since you live with Ruma, who is your virtual daughterinlaw, when the great self Sugriva is alive. (A younger brother is like a son and his wife, a daughterinlaw).

shloka_text: तद्व्यतीतस्य ते धर्मात्कामवृत्तस्य वानर। भ्रातृभार्यावमर्शेऽस्मिन्दण्डोऽयं प्रतिपादितः4.18.20।।
transliteration: tadvyatītasya te dharmātkāmavṛttasya vānara| bhrātṛbhāryāvamarśe'smindaṇḍo'yaṃ pratipāditaḥ4.18.20||
translation: वानर monkey, तत् thus, धर्मात् from morality, व्यतीतस्य trespassing, कामवृत्तस्य for sensual pleasure, ते to you, अस्मिन् भ्रातृभार्यावमर्शे sinning against brother's wife, अयम् this, दण्डः punishment, प्रतिपादितः was justified.
explanation: 'O monkey since you have violated morality by sinning against your brother's wife this punishment is justified.

shloka_text: न हि धर्मविरुद्धस्य लोकवृत्तादपेयुषः। दण्डादन्यत्र पश्यामि निग्रहं हरियूथप4.18.21।
transliteration: na hi dharmaviruddhasya lokavṛttādapeyuṣaḥ| daṇḍādanyatra paśyāmi nigrahaṃ hariyūthapa4.18.21|
translation: हरियूथप O lord of monkeys, धर्मविरुद्धस्य for one who acts against dharma, लोकवृत्तात् from the accepted practice of the world, अपेयुषः for one who swerved, दण्डात् from punishing, अन्यत्र other than this, निग्रहम् preventing, न पश्यामि हि I have not seen.
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys I do not see any other way of controlling a person excepting punishing the one who has acted against dharma and swerved from the accepted code of conduct.

shloka_text: न हि ते मर्षये पापं क्षत्रियोऽहं कुलोद्भवः। औरसीं भगिनीं वापि भार्यां वाप्यनुजस्य यः4.18.22।। प्रचरेत नरः कामात्तस्य दण्डो वधः स्मृतः।
transliteration: na hi te marṣaye pāpaṃ kṣatriyo'haṃ kulodbhavaḥ| aurasīṃ bhaginīṃ vāpi bhāryāṃ vāpyanujasya yaḥ4.18.22|| pracareta naraḥ kāmāttasya daṇḍo vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ|
translation: कुलोद्भव: born in a good family, क्षत्रियः kshatriya, अहम् I am, ते your, पापम् sin, न मर्षये I will not pardon, यः नरः whoever, औरसीम् his own daughter, भगिनीं वापि even sister also, अनुजस्य brother's, भार्यां वापि wife also, कामात् out of lust, प्रचरेत meets, तस्य his, दण्डः punishment, वधः killing, स्मृतः ordained in scriptures.
explanation: 'I am a kshatriya born of a good family. I will not pardon you for your sin. Whosoever transgresses dharma against his own daughter, sister or brother's wife out of lust should be killed according to smriti.

shloka_text: भरतस्तु महीपालो वयं त्वादेशवर्तिनः4.18.23।। त्वं तु धर्मादतिक्रान्तः कथं शक्यं उपेक्षितुम्।
transliteration: bharatastu mahīpālo vayaṃ tvādeśavartinaḥ4.18.23|| tvaṃ tu dharmādatikrāntaḥ kathaṃ śakyaṃ upekṣitum|
translation: भरतः तु Bharata too, महीपालः king, वयं तु we too, आदेशवर्तिनः follow his order, त्वं तु you too, धर्मात् from dharma, अतिक्रान्तः stayed, उपेक्षितुम् to overlook, कथम् how, शक्यम् possible?
explanation: 'Bharata is a king and we follow his command. How can you, who have strayed from dharma, go unpunished?

shloka_text: गुरूर्धर्मव्यतिक्रान्तं प्राज्ञो धर्मेण पालयन्4.18.24।। भरतः कामवृत्तानां निग्रहे पर्यवस्थितः।
transliteration: gurūrdharmavyatikrāntaṃ prājño dharmeṇa pālayan4.18.24|| bharataḥ kāmavṛttānāṃ nigrahe paryavasthitaḥ|
translation: प्राज्ञ: wise man, गुरुः a respectable man, धर्मव्यतिक्रान्तम् one who has trespassed dharma, धर्मेण by dharma, पालयन् while ruling, भरतः Bharata, कामवृत्तानाम्  addicted to sensual pleasures, निग्रहे to punish, पर्यवस्थितः is determined.
explanation: 'Wise Bharata being a respectable king rules by dharma. By the command of Bharata, we are bent upon punishing those who have strayed from dharma  by being addicted to sensual pleasures.

shloka_text: वयं तु भरतादेश विधिं कृत्वा हरीश्वर। त्वद्विधान्भिन्नमर्यादान्नियन्तुपर्यवस्थिताः4.18.25।।
transliteration: vayaṃ tu bharatādeśa vidhiṃ kṛtvā harīśvara| tvadvidhānbhinnamaryādānniyantuparyavasthitāḥ4.18.25||
translation: हरीश्वर lord of monkeys, वयं तु we too, भरतादेशम् by Bharata's command, विधिम् following his command, कृत्वा do, भिन्नमर्यादान् deviated from the bounds of dharma, त्वद्विधान् this way, नियन्तुम् to punish, पर्यवस्थिताः determined.
explanation: 'O Vali we have to follow Bharata's command and are bent upon punishing those wicked people who deviate from the bounds of dharma.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवेण च मे सख्यं लक्ष्मणेन यथा तथा। दारराज्यनिमित्तं च निःश्रेयसि रत स्स मे4.18.26।। प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता तदा वानरसन्निधौ। प्रतिज्ञा च कथं शक्या मद्विधेनानवेक्षितुम्4.18.27।।
transliteration: sugrīveṇa ca me sakhyaṃ lakṣmaṇena yathā tathā| dārarājyanimittaṃ ca niḥśreyasi rata ssa me4.18.26|| pratijñā ca mayā dattā tadā vānarasannidhau| pratijñā ca kathaṃ śakyā madvidhenānavekṣitum4.18.27||
translation: लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, यथा as such, सख्यं friendship, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, दारराज्यनिमित्तं for the sake of wife and kingdom, निःश्रेयसि welfare, रत: engaged, च and, तथा so, मे  mine, तदा then, मया by me, वानरसन्निधौ in the presence of monkeys, प्रतिज्ञा च a pledge, दत्ता made, मद्विधेन a person like me, प्रतिज्ञा promise, अनवेक्षितुम् to disregard, कथम् how,  शक्या possible?
explanation: 'My friendship with Sugriva is as strong as that with Lakshmana. Its motive is the recovery of his wife and sovereignty. I have  promised this to him in the presence of monkeys. How can a pledge remain unhonoured by a person like me? How is it possible?

shloka_text: सुग्रीवेण च मे सख्यं लक्ष्मणेन यथा तथा। दारराज्यनिमित्तं च निःश्रेयसि रत स्स मे4.18.26।। प्रतिज्ञा च मया दत्ता तदा वानरसन्निधौ। प्रतिज्ञा च कथं शक्या मद्विधेनानवेक्षितुम्4.18.27।।
transliteration: sugrīveṇa ca me sakhyaṃ lakṣmaṇena yathā tathā| dārarājyanimittaṃ ca niḥśreyasi rata ssa me4.18.26|| pratijñā ca mayā dattā tadā vānarasannidhau| pratijñā ca kathaṃ śakyā madvidhenānavekṣitum4.18.27||
translation: लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, यथा as such, सख्यं friendship, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, दारराज्यनिमित्तं for the sake of wife and kingdom, निःश्रेयसि welfare, रत: engaged, च and, तथा so, मे  mine, तदा then, मया by me, वानरसन्निधौ in the presence of monkeys, प्रतिज्ञा च a pledge, दत्ता made, मद्विधेन a person like me, प्रतिज्ञा promise, अनवेक्षितुम् to disregard, कथम् how,  शक्या possible?
explanation: 'My friendship with Sugriva is as strong as that with Lakshmana. Its motive is the recovery of his wife and sovereignty. I have  promised this to him in the presence of monkeys. How can a pledge remain unhonoured by a person like me? How is it possible?

shloka_text: तदेभिः कारणैस्सर्वैर्महद्भिर्धर्मसंहितैः4.18.28।। शासनं तप यद्युक्तं तद्भवाननुमन्यताम्।
transliteration: tadebhiḥ kāraṇaissarvairmahadbhirdharmasaṃhitaiḥ4.18.28|| śāsanaṃ tapa yadyuktaṃ tadbhavānanumanyatām|
translation: तत् that, धर्मसंहितैः in consonance with dharma, सर्वैः all, महद्भिः  many big, एभिः by these, कारणैः for these reasons, तव your, यत् which, शासनम् is accorded, युक्तम् is proper, तत् that, भवान् you, अनुमन्यताम् to be accepted
explanation: 'Knowing all these reasons(many violations of dharma), it is proper for you as a king to approve of the punishment accorded to you in consonance with dharma.

shloka_text: सर्वथा धर्म इत्येव द्रष्टव्यस्तव निग्रहः4.18.29।। वयस्यस्योपकर्तव्यं धर्ममेवानुपश्यतः।
transliteration: sarvathā dharma ityeva draṣṭavyastava nigrahaḥ4.18.29|| vayasyasyopakartavyaṃ dharmamevānupaśyataḥ|
translation: तव your, निग्रहः overthrowing, सर्वथा in all respects, धर्मः इत्येव thus justifiable,द्रष्टव्यः it should be viewed, धर्मम् dharma, अनुपश्यत: who follows, वयस्यस्य a friend's, उपकर्तव्यम् एव  should be rendered.
