explanation: 'Punishment given to you should be viewed as a right course of action in all respects. This is the duty of a trustworthy friend who follows dharma.

shloka_text: शक्यं त्वयाऽपि तत्कार्यं धर्ममेवानुपश्यता4.18.30।। श्रूयते मनुना गीतौ श्लोकौ चारित्रवत्सलौ। गृहीतौ धर्मकुशलैस्तत्तथा चरितं हरे4.18.31।।
transliteration: śakyaṃ tvayā'pi tatkāryaṃ dharmamevānupaśyatā4.18.30|| śrūyate manunā gītau ślokau cāritravatsalau| gṛhītau dharmakuśalaistattathā caritaṃ hare4.18.31||
translation: धर्ममेव dharma alone, अनुपश्यता considering, त्ययाऽपि by you also, तत् that, कार्यम् action, शक्यम् possible, मनुना by Manu, चारित्रवत्सलौ those that hold good traditions dear, श्लोकौ two verses, गीतौ have been said, श्रूयते  listen, धर्मकुशलैः by those wellversed in dharma, गृहीतौ have been followed, मया me, तत् that, तथा similar, चरितम् followed.
explanation: 'You should also have acted in that manner considering dharma. Now listen to what Manu said, in two verses that hold good traditions dear which are accepted by men wellversed in dharma. O monkey the action taken by me is in conformity with this.

shloka_text: शक्यं त्वयाऽपि तत्कार्यं धर्ममेवानुपश्यता4.18.30।। श्रूयते मनुना गीतौ श्लोकौ चारित्रवत्सलौ। गृहीतौ धर्मकुशलैस्तत्तथा चरितं हरे4.18.31।।
transliteration: śakyaṃ tvayā'pi tatkāryaṃ dharmamevānupaśyatā4.18.30|| śrūyate manunā gītau ślokau cāritravatsalau| gṛhītau dharmakuśalaistattathā caritaṃ hare4.18.31||
translation: धर्ममेव dharma alone, अनुपश्यता considering, त्ययाऽपि by you also, तत् that, कार्यम् action, शक्यम् possible, मनुना by Manu, चारित्रवत्सलौ those that hold good traditions dear, श्लोकौ two verses, गीतौ have been said, श्रूयते  listen, धर्मकुशलैः by those wellversed in dharma, गृहीतौ have been followed, मया me, तत् that, तथा similar, चरितम् followed.
explanation: 'You should also have acted in that manner considering dharma. Now listen to what Manu said, in two verses that hold good traditions dear which are accepted by men wellversed in dharma. O monkey the action taken by me is in conformity with this.

shloka_text: राजभिर्धृतदण्डास्तु कृत्वा पापानि मानवाः। निर्मलास्स्वर्गमायान्ति सन्तस्सुकृतिनो यथा4.18.32।।
transliteration: rājabhirdhṛtadaṇḍāstu kṛtvā pāpāni mānavāḥ| nirmalāssvargamāyānti santassukṛtino yathā4.18.32||
translation: मानवाः human beings, पापानि sins, कृत्वा having done, राजभिः by kings, धृतदण्डाः those punished, निर्मलाः purified, सुकृतिनः like those men performing good deeds, सन्तः यथा like pious men, स्वर्गम् heaven, आयान्ति will attain.
explanation: 'Men who have perpetrated sins should be subjected to punishment by kings so that they become stainless and attain heaven like pious men who have performed good deeds.

shloka_text: शासनाद्वाऽपिमोक्षाद्वा स्तेनः स्तेयाद्विमुच्यते। राजात्वशासन्पापस्य तदवाप्नोति किल्बिषम्4.18.33।।
transliteration: śāsanādvā'pimokṣādvā stenaḥ steyādvimucyate| rājātvaśāsanpāpasya tadavāpnoti kilbiṣam4.18.33||
translation: स्तेनः a thief, शासनाद्वा either with punishment, अपि or, मोक्षाद्वा relieved, पापात् from that sin, विमुच्यते gets absolved, अशासन् without punishing, राजा तु king also, पापस्य of a sinner, तत् that, किल्बिषम् sin, आप्नोति himself gets afflicted.
explanation: A thief is freed from his theft either by punishment or by being let off; but a king who fails to punish a sinner himself incurs that sin.

shloka_text: आर्येण मम मान्धात्रा व्यसनं घोरमीप्सितम्। श्रमणेन कृते पापे यथा पापं कृतं त्वया4.18.34।।
transliteration: āryeṇa mama māndhātrā vyasanaṃ ghoramīpsitam| śramaṇena kṛte pāpe yathā pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā4.18.34||
translation: मम me, आर्येण by noble, मान्धात्रा by Mandhata, त्वया by you, यथा like that, पापम्  sin, कृतम् was perpetrated, श्रमणेन by Sramana, पापे sin, कृते done, ईप्सितम् inflicted, घोरम् terrible, व्यसनम् punishment.
explanation: 'In the past a similar sin was perpetrated by Sramana, a revered soul (mendicant) and Mandhata, a noble king of my race inflicted terrible punishment on him.

shloka_text: अन्यैरपि कृतं पापं प्रमत्तैर्वसुधाधिपैः। प्रायश्चित्तं च कुर्वन्ति तेन तच्छाम्यते रजः4.18.35।।
transliteration: anyairapi kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ pramattairvasudhādhipaiḥ| prāyaścittaṃ ca kurvanti tena tacchāmyate rajaḥ4.18.35||
translation: अन्यैरपि by others also, कृतम् committed, पापम् vicious deeds, प्रमत्तैः by those not watchful, वसुधाधिपैः by the kings of the earth, प्रायश्चित्तम् atonement, कुर्वन्ति was done, तेन by that, तत् that, रजः taint, शाम्यते is removed.
explanation: 'Vicious deeds have been committed by others when the kings were not watchful. Kings punish such sinners when they are vigilant. Otherwise they have to atone for their negligence.

shloka_text: तदलं परितापेन धर्मतः परिकल्पितः। वधो वानरशार्दूल न वयं स्ववशे स्थिता:।।4.18.36।।
transliteration: tadalaṃ paritāpena dharmataḥ parikalpitaḥ| vadho vānaraśārdūla na vayaṃ svavaśe sthitā:
translation: वानरशार्दूल O tiger among Monkeys, तत् therefore, परितापेन अलम् do not regret, वधः striking, धर्मतः righteously, परिकल्पितः committed, वयम् we are, स्ववशे under our control, न स्थिताः are not.
explanation: 'O tiger among monkeys do not regret. Your death has the sanction of dharma. We are under the control of sastras. We are committed to them. We do not have the freedom to act independently.

shloka_text: शृणु चाप्यपरं भूयः कारणं हरिपुङ्गव। यच्छ्रुत्वा हेतुमद्वीर न मन्युं कर्तुमर्हसि4.18.37।।
transliteration: śṛṇu cāpyaparaṃ bhūyaḥ kāraṇaṃ haripuṅgava| yacchrutvā hetumadvīra na manyuṃ kartumarhasi4.18.37||
translation: वीर O hero, हरिपुङ्गव O best of monkeys, भूयः once again, अपरम् another, कारणम् reason, शृणु listen, यत् that, हेतुम reason, श्रुत्वा on hearing, मन्युम् anger, कर्तुम् to entertain, नार्हसि it is not proper.
explanation: 'O hero O best of monkeys listen to me. I will give you one more reason. On hearing it, I hope you would not be angry with me.

shloka_text: न मे तत्र मनस्तापो न मन्युर्हरिपुङ्गव। वागुराभिश्च पाशैश्च कूटैश्च विविधैर्नराः4.18.38।। प्रतिच्छन्नाश्च दृश्याश्च गृह्णन्ति सुबहून्मृगान्।
transliteration: na me tatra manastāpo na manyurharipuṅgava| vāgurābhiśca pāśaiśca kūṭaiśca vividhairnarāḥ4.18.38|| praticchannāśca dṛśyāśca gṛhṇanti subahūnmṛgān|
translation: हरिपुङ्गव O best of monkeys, तत्र here, मे to me, मनस्तापः mental agony, मन्युः regret, न not, नराः people, वागुराभिश्च with meshnet, पाशैश्च with ropes, विविधैः different, कूटैश्च with tricks, प्रतिच्छन्नाश्च hiding, दृश्याश्च out in the open, सुबहून् many, मृगान् animals, गृह्णन्ति catch.
explanation: 'O best of monkeys I have no mental agony nor do I regret in this case. Hidden from view or out in the open, people catch animals by means of snares or ropes or through other tricks.

shloka_text: प्रधावितान्वा वित्रस्तान्विस्रब्धांश्चापि निष्ठितान्4.18.39।। प्रमत्तानप्रमत्तान्वा नरा मांसार्थिनो भृशम्। विध्यन्ति विमुखांश्चापि न च दोषोऽत्र विद्यते4.18.40।।
transliteration: pradhāvitānvā vitrastānvisrabdhāṃścāpi niṣṭhitān4.18.39|| pramattānapramattānvā narā māṃsārthino bhṛśam| vidhyanti vimukhāṃścāpi na ca doṣo'tra vidyate4.18.40||
translation: मांसार्थिनः seeking flesh for food, नराः men, प्रधावितान् वा or running ones, वित्रस्तान् alarmed ones, विस्रब्धान् unalarmed, निष्ठितान् stable ones, प्रमत्तान् those that are not alert, अप्रमत्तान्वा even alert ones also, विमुखांश्च those which turn away, विध्यन्ति kill, अत्र here, दोषः blemish, न विद्यते not known.
explanation: 'People seeking animal flesh for food kill animals alarmed or unalarmed, animals that run away or animals that stand still. They kill animals whether they are alert or not and no blemish is attached.

shloka_text: प्रधावितान्वा वित्रस्तान्विस्रब्धांश्चापि निष्ठितान्4.18.39।। प्रमत्तानप्रमत्तान्वा नरा मांसार्थिनो भृशम्। विध्यन्ति विमुखांश्चापि न च दोषोऽत्र विद्यते4.18.40।।
transliteration: pradhāvitānvā vitrastānvisrabdhāṃścāpi niṣṭhitān4.18.39|| pramattānapramattānvā narā māṃsārthino bhṛśam| vidhyanti vimukhāṃścāpi na ca doṣo'tra vidyate4.18.40||
translation: मांसार्थिनः seeking flesh for food, नराः men, प्रधावितान् वा or running ones, वित्रस्तान् alarmed ones, विस्रब्धान् unalarmed, निष्ठितान् stable ones, प्रमत्तान् those that are not alert, अप्रमत्तान्वा even alert ones also, विमुखांश्च those which turn away, विध्यन्ति kill, अत्र here, दोषः blemish, न विद्यते not known.
explanation: 'People seeking animal flesh for food kill animals alarmed or unalarmed, animals that run away or animals that stand still. They kill animals whether they are alert or not and no blemish is attached.

shloka_text: यान्ति राजर्षयश्चात्र मृगयां धर्मकोविदाः। तस्मात्त्वं निहतो युद्धे मया बाणेन वानर4.18.41।। अयुध्यन्प्रतियुध्यन्वा यस्माच्छाखामृगो ह्यसि।
transliteration: yānti rājarṣayaścātra mṛgayāṃ dharmakovidāḥ| tasmāttvaṃ nihato yuddhe mayā bāṇena vānara4.18.41|| ayudhyanpratiyudhyanvā yasmācchākhāmṛgo hyasi|
translation: अत्र here, धर्मकोविदाः those wellversed in dharma, राजर्षयः royal saints, मृगयाम् hunting, यान्ति go for, वानर monkey, त्वम् you, अयुध्यन् while not fighting, प्रतियुध्यन् वा or while fighting back, यस्मात् since, शाखामृगः monkey, असि you are, तस्मात् therefore, मया myself, युद्धे in battle, बाणेन by an arrow, निहतः struck down.
explanation: 'O monkey even royal saints wellversed in dharma go for hunting. I struck you down with an arrow whether you were fighting with Sugriva or not, since you are a monkey. (You can be hit whether you are fighting face to face or not).

shloka_text: दुर्लभस्य च धर्मस्य जीवितस्य शुभस्य च4.18.42।। राजानो वानरश्रेष्ठ प्रदातारो न संशयः।
transliteration: durlabhasya ca dharmasya jīvitasya śubhasya ca4.18.42|| rājāno vānaraśreṣṭha pradātāro na saṃśayaḥ|
translation: वानरश्रेष्ठ O best among monkeys राजानः kings, दुर्लभस्य difficult, धर्मस्य righteousness, शुभस्य auspicious, जीवितस्य life, प्रदातारः donors, संशयः doubt, न not.
explanation: 'O best of monkeys kings are donors of dharma, life and auspiciousness to people which is difficult to acquire. There is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: तान्न हिंस्यान्न चाक्रोशेन्नाक्षिपेन्नाप्रियं वदेत्4.18.43।। देवा मानुषरूपेण चरन्त्येते महीतले।
transliteration: tānna hiṃsyānna cākrośennākṣipennāpriyaṃ vadet4.18.43|| devā mānuṣarūpeṇa carantyete mahītale|
translation: तान् them, न हिंस्यात्  insult, न चाक्रोशेत् not to be shouted, न आक्षिपेत् not to be disregarded, अप्रियम् unpleasant, न वदेत् not speak, एते they, देवाः gods, मानुषरूपेण in the form of human beings, महीतले on this earth, चरन्ति move about.
explanation: 'One should not insult kings, nor shout at them, nor disregard them nor speak unpleasant words to them. They are gods in human form moving on this earth.

shloka_text: त्वं तु धर्ममविज्ञाय केवलं रोषमास्थितः4.18.44।। प्रदूषयसि मां धर्मे पितृपैतामहे स्थितम्।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu dharmamavijñāya kevalaṃ roṣamāsthitaḥ4.18.44|| pradūṣayasi māṃ dharme pitṛpaitāmahe sthitam|
translation: त्वं तु you on your part, धर्मम् dharma, अविज्ञाय not knowing, केवलम् only, रोषम् anger, आस्थितः have restored, पितृपैतामहे followed by fathers and grandfathers, धर्मे in dharma, स्थितम् devoted, माम्  me, प्रदूषयसि you are reproaching.
explanation: 'Seized with improper anger, you are reproaching one who is devoted to dharma, without knowing that I follow the code of conduct that has been passed on by my fathers and forefathers.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण वाली प्रव्यथितो भृशम्4.18.45।। न दोषं राघवे दध्यौ धर्मेऽधिगतनिश्चयः।
transliteration: evamuktastu rāmeṇa vālī pravyathito bhṛśam4.18.45|| na doṣaṃ rāghave dadhyau dharme'dhigataniścayaḥ|
translation: रामेण by Rama, एवम् that way, उक्तः addressed, वाली Vali, भृशम् greatly, प्रव्यथितः was pained, धर्मे in dharma, अधिगतनिश्चयः had arrived at a conclusion, राघवे at Rama, दोषम्  fault, एवमुक्तस्तु having said this way, न दध्यौ did not find.
explanation: Vali was very much pained to hear Rama. He became free from confusion regarding dharma and no longer found fault with Rama.

shloka_text: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिर्वानरेश्वरः।।4.18.46।। यत्त्वमात्थ नरश्रेष्ठ तदेवं नात्र संशयः।
transliteration: pratyuvāca tato rāmaṃ prāñjalirvānareśvaraḥ yattvamāttha naraśreṣṭha tadevaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|
translation: ततः then, वानरेश्वरः Vali, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, रामम् to Rama, प्रत्युवाच replied, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, त्वम् you, यत् what ever, आत्थ spoke, तदेवं There is, संशयः doubt, न no, अत्र in this matter.
explanation: Thereafter Vali offered obeisance with folded palms to Rama, saying, 'O best among men whatever you have spoken is undoubtedly true.'

shloka_text: प्रतिवक्तुं प्रकृष्टे हि नापकृष्टस्तु शक्नुयात्4.18.47।। यदयुक्तं मया पूर्वं प्रमादाद्वाक्यमप्रियम्। तत्रापि खलु मे दोषं कर्तुं नार्हसि राघव।
transliteration: prativaktuṃ prakṛṣṭe hi nāpakṛṣṭastu śaknuyāt4.18.47|| yadayuktaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ pramādādvākyamapriyam| tatrāpi khalu me doṣaṃ kartuṃ nārhasi rāghava|
translation: राघव Rama, प्रकृष्टे  a distinguished person, अपकृष्टः an ordinary person, प्रतिवक्तुम् to argue, न शक्नुयात् is not possible, मया by me, पूर्वम् earlier, प्रमादात् due to ignorance, यत् those, अयुक्तम् in appropriate, अप्रियम् unpleasant, वाक्यम् words, (उक्तम्  said), तत्रापि in that, मे my, दोषम् fault, कर्तुम्  hold, नार्हसि you need not be.
explanation: O Rama, an inferior cannot argue against a distinguished person; therefore, if I earlier spoke improper and unpleasant words out of folly, you ought not to hold me at fault for that.

shloka_text: तदयुक्तं मया पूर्वं प्रमादादुक्तमप्रियम् । तत्रापि खलु मे दोषं कर्तुं नार्हसि राघव ।। 4.18.48 ।।
transliteration: tadayuktaṃ mayā pūrvaṃ pramādāduktamapriyam | tatrāpi khalu me doṣaṃ kartuṃ nārhasi rāghava
translation: In Progress
explanation: In Progress

shloka_text: त्वं हि दृष्टार्थतत्त्वज्ञ: प्रजानां च हिते रतः। कार्यकारणसिद्धौ च प्रसन्ना बुद्धिरव्यया4.18.49।।
transliteration: tvaṃ hi dṛṣṭārthatattvajña: prajānāṃ ca hite rataḥ| kāryakāraṇasiddhau ca prasannā buddhiravyayā4.18.49||
translation: त्वम् you, दृष्टार्थतत्त्वज्ञः wise man given to truth and righteousness, प्रजानाम्  people's, हिते   wellbeing, रतश्च remain devoted, अव्यया knowing, बुद्धि: sound intellect, कार्यकारणसिद्धौ know for certain about cause and effect, प्रसन्ना is pleasant.
explanation: 'You are a wise man given to truth and righteousness.You remain devoted to people's wellbeing. As you know for certain about cause and effect your intellect is sound and words pleasant.

shloka_text: मामप्यगतधर्माणं व्यतिक्रान्तपुरस्कृतम्। धर्मसंहितया वाचा धर्मज्ञ परिपालय4.18.50।।
transliteration: māmapyagatadharmāṇaṃ vyatikrāntapuraskṛtam| dharmasaṃhitayā vācā dharmajña paripālaya4.18.50||
translation: धर्मज्ञ knower of dharma, अगतधर्माणं did not follow dharma, अवगतम् in the past, व्यतिक्रान्तपुरस्कृतम्  violated the bounds of dharma in the past, मामपि and me too, धर्मसंहितया in a righteous manner, वाचा word, परिपालय  protect.
explanation: 'O knower of dharma, I did not follow dharma in the past. I have trangressed the bounds of dharma. Say, you have pardoned me, protect me in a righteous manner.

shloka_text: न त्वात्मानमहं शोचे न तारां न च बान्धवान्। यथा पुत्रं गुणज्येष्ठमङ्गदं कनकाङ्गदम् 4.18.51।।
transliteration: na tvātmānamahaṃ śoce na tārāṃ na ca bāndhavān| yathā putraṃ guṇajyeṣṭhamaṅgadaṃ kanakāṅgadam 4.18.51||
translation: गुणज्येष्ठम्  all virtues, कनकाङ्गदम् adorned with golden armlets, पुत्रम् son, अङ्गदम् Angada, यथा as, अहम् I, आत्मानम् for me, न शोचे I do not grieve, ताराम् Tara too, न not, बान्धवानपि even kinsmen, न not.
explanation: 'I neither grieve for myself nor for Tara nor for my kinsmen. But I do for my son Angada adorned with golden armlets. He is embellished with all virtues.

shloka_text: स ममादर्शनाद्दीनो बाल्यात्प्रभृति लालितः। तटाक इव पीताम्बुरुपशोषं गमिष्यति4.18.52।।
transliteration: sa mamādarśanāddīno bālyātprabhṛti lālitaḥ| taṭāka iva pītāmburupaśoṣaṃ gamiṣyati4.18.52||
translation: बाल्यात् from childhood, प्रभृति from that time, लालितः loved, सः him, मम to me, आदर्शदानत्   by not seeing me, दीनः dejected, पीताम्बुः after the water is dried up, तटाकः इव like a tank, उपशोषम् left dried, गमिष्यति will become.
explanation: 'I loved him very much from his childhood. He will grow depressed in my absence. He will become like a pond whose waters have been dried up.

shloka_text: बालश्चाकृतबुद्धिश्च एकपुत्रश्च मे प्रियः। तारेयो राम भवता रक्षणीयो महाबलः4.18.53।।
transliteration: bālaścākṛtabuddhiśca ekaputraśca me priyaḥ| tāreyo rāma bhavatā rakṣaṇīyo mahābalaḥ4.18.53||
translation: राम Rama, बालश्च young boy, आकृतबुद्धिश्च innocent, मे my, प्रियः dear, एकपुत्रश्च only son, महाबलःvery strong, तारेयःTara's son, भवता by you, रक्षणीयः  deserves to be protected.
explanation: 'O Rama he is my only son through Tara and dear to me. He is young,innocent but strong.He  deserves to be protected by you.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवे चाङ्गदे चैव विधत्स्व मतिमुत्तमाम्। त्वं हि शास्ता च गोप्ता च कार्याकार्यविधौ स्थितः4.18.54।।
transliteration: sugrīve cāṅgade caiva vidhatsva matimuttamām| tvaṃ hi śāstā ca goptā ca kāryākāryavidhau sthitaḥ4.18.54||
translation: सुग्रीवे at Sugriva, आङ्गदे चैव and at Angada, उत्तमाम् great, मतिम् in mind, विधत्स्व you may show, कार्याकार्यविधौ with regard to what should and should not be done, स्थितः sure, त्वम् you, गोप्ता च protector and, शास्ता च also punisher.
explanation: 'Shower equal affection from your heart on Sugriva and Angada. You are their protector and punisher also. You know what should and should not be done.

shloka_text: या ते नरपते वृत्तिर्भरते लक्ष्मणे च या। सुग्रीवे चाङ्गदे राजंस्तां त्वमाधातुमिहासि4.18.55।।
transliteration: yā te narapate vṛttirbharate lakṣmaṇe ca yā| sugrīve cāṅgade rājaṃstāṃ tvamādhātumihāsi4.18.55||
translation: नरपते O Lord of men, राजन् king, भरते Bharata, ते your, या वृत्ति: such affection, लक्ष्मणे च and towards Lakshmana, या whatever, ताम् same, सुग्रीवे च Sugriva and, अङ्गदे at Angada, आधातुम् to hold, इह here, अर्हसि you may do.
explanation: 'O lord of men may you have the same kind of affection for Sugriva and Angada as you have for Bharata and Lakshmana.

shloka_text: मद्दोषकृतदोषां तां यथा तारां तपस्विनीम्। सुग्रीवो नावमन्येत तथाऽवस्थातुमर्हसि4.18.56।।
transliteration: maddoṣakṛtadoṣāṃ tāṃ yathā tārāṃ tapasvinīm| sugrīvo nāvamanyeta tathā'vasthātumarhasi4.18.56||
translation: मद्दोषकृतदोषाम् suffered due to my offence, तपस्विनीम् wretch, तां ताराम् that Tara, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, नावमन्येत not think ill of her, तथा that, अवस्थातुम् to maintain, अर्हसि hope
explanation: 'I hope Tara will not be made to suffer because of my offence. Make Sugriva not to run wretched Tara down.

shloka_text: त्वया ह्यनुगृहीतेन राज्यं शक्यमुपासितुम्4.18.57।। त्वद्वशे वर्तमानेन तव चित्तानुवर्तिना। शक्यं दिवं चार्जयितुं वसुधां चापि शासितुम्4.18.58।।
transliteration: tvayā hyanugṛhītena rājyaṃ śakyamupāsitum4.18.57|| tvadvaśe vartamānena tava cittānuvartinā| śakyaṃ divaṃ cārjayituṃ vasudhāṃ cāpi śāsitum4.18.58||
translation: त्वया by you, अनुगृहीतेन by a person favoured, त्वद्वशे under your control, वर्तमानेन by one who moves, तव चित्तानुवर्तिना acts according to your will, राज्यम् kingdom, उपासितुम् to rule, शक्यम् it is possible, दिवम् heaven, आर्जयितुं च to attain, वसुधाम् earth, चापि also, शक्यम् posssible.
explanation: 'It is possible for a person favoured by you to rule the kingdom.It is possible for one who is under your control and acts according to your will to rule the entire world and earn heaven.

shloka_text: त्वया ह्यनुगृहीतेन राज्यं शक्यमुपासितुम्4.18.57।। त्वद्वशे वर्तमानेन तव चित्तानुवर्तिना। शक्यं दिवं चार्जयितुं वसुधां चापि शासितुम्4.18.58।।
transliteration: tvayā hyanugṛhītena rājyaṃ śakyamupāsitum4.18.57|| tvadvaśe vartamānena tava cittānuvartinā| śakyaṃ divaṃ cārjayituṃ vasudhāṃ cāpi śāsitum4.18.58||
translation: त्वया by you, अनुगृहीतेन by a person favoured, त्वद्वशे under your control, वर्तमानेन by one who moves, तव चित्तानुवर्तिना acts according to your will, राज्यम् kingdom, उपासितुम् to rule, शक्यम् it is possible, दिवम् heaven, आर्जयितुं च to attain, वसुधाम् earth, चापि also, शक्यम् posssible.
explanation: 'It is possible for a person favoured by you to rule the kingdom.It is possible for one who is under your control and acts according to your will to rule the entire world and earn heaven.

shloka_text: त्वत्तोऽहं वधमाकाङ्क्षन्वार्यमाणोऽपि तारया। सुग्रीवेण सह भ्रात्रा द्वन्द्वयुद्धमुपागतः4.18.59।। इत्युक्त्वा सन्नतो रामं विरराम हरीश्वरः।
transliteration: tvatto'haṃ vadhamākāṅkṣanvāryamāṇo'pi tārayā| sugrīveṇa saha bhrātrā dvandvayuddhamupāgataḥ4.18.59|| ityuktvā sannato rāmaṃ virarāma harīśvaraḥ|
translation: अहम् I, तारया by Tara, वार्यमाणोऽपि even though prevented, त्वत्तः from you, वधम् death, आकाङ्क्षन्  wishing, भ्रात्रा with brother, सुग्रीवेण सह along with Sugriva, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् duel, उपागतः came, हरीश्वरः lord of monkeys, वानरः monkey, रामम् to Rama, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, विरराम stopped.
explanation: 'Even though I was prevented by Tara, I came for a duel with Sugriva since I wished to die in your hands.' Having spoken thus to Rama, Vali fell silent.

shloka_text: स तमाश्वासयद्रामो वालिनं व्यक्तदर्शनम्4.18.60।। सामसम्पन्नया वाचा धर्मतत्त्वार्थयुक्तया।
transliteration: sa tamāśvāsayadrāmo vālinaṃ vyaktadarśanam4.18.60|| sāmasampannayā vācā dharmatattvārthayuktayā|
translation: सः रामः Rama, व्यक्तदर्शनम् him who saw clearly, तं वालिनम् that Vali, सामसम्पन्नया for peace and tranquillity, धर्मतत्त्वार्थयुक्तया reflecting truth and righteousness, वाचा with words, आश्वासयत् he consoled.
explanation: Now Vali was able to see clearly. Rama consoled him with words of peace and tranquillity, truth and righteousness.

shloka_text: न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्य एतदर्थं प्लवङ्गम4.18.61।। न वयं भवता चिन्त्या नाप्यात्मा हरिसत्तम। वयं भवद्विशेषेण धर्मतः कृतनिश्चयाः4.18.62।।
transliteration: na santāpastvayā kārya etadarthaṃ plavaṅgama4.18.61|| na vayaṃ bhavatā cintyā nāpyātmā harisattama| vayaṃ bhavadviśeṣeṇa dharmataḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ4.18.62||
translation: प्लवङ्गम O monkey, एतदर्थम् on this account, त्वया by you, सन्तापः worry, न कार्यः not to be entertained, हरिसत्तम best of the monkeys, भवता by you, वयम् we, न चिन्त्याः not worry, आत्मापि you too, न not, वयम् we, भवद्विशेषेण for your sin, धर्मतः principles of righteousness, कृतनिश्चयाः came to firm decision.
explanation: 'O best of monkeys, abandon all your anxiety on this score. Bother not about us or about yourself. Whatever has happened, has happened in consonance with dharma.

shloka_text: न सन्तापस्त्वया कार्य एतदर्थं प्लवङ्गम4.18.61।। न वयं भवता चिन्त्या नाप्यात्मा हरिसत्तम। वयं भवद्विशेषेण धर्मतः कृतनिश्चयाः4.18.62।।
transliteration: na santāpastvayā kārya etadarthaṃ plavaṅgama4.18.61|| na vayaṃ bhavatā cintyā nāpyātmā harisattama| vayaṃ bhavadviśeṣeṇa dharmataḥ kṛtaniścayāḥ4.18.62||
translation: प्लवङ्गम O monkey, एतदर्थम् on this account, त्वया by you, सन्तापः worry, न कार्यः not to be entertained, हरिसत्तम best of the monkeys, भवता by you, वयम् we, न चिन्त्याः not worry, आत्मापि you too, न not, वयम् we, भवद्विशेषेण for your sin, धर्मतः principles of righteousness, कृतनिश्चयाः came to firm decision.
explanation: 'O best of monkeys, abandon all your anxiety on this score. Bother not about us or about yourself. Whatever has happened, has happened in consonance with dharma.

shloka_text: दण्ड्ये यः पातयेद्दण्डं दण्ड्यो यश्चापि दण्ड्यते। कार्यकारणसिद्धार्था वुभौ तौ नावसीदतः4.18.63।।
transliteration: daṇḍye yaḥ pātayeddaṇḍaṃ daṇḍyo yaścāpi daṇḍyate| kāryakāraṇasiddhārthā vubhau tau nāvasīdataḥ4.18.63||
translation: यः whoever, दण्ड्ये  deserves to be punished, दण्डम् punishment, पातयेत्  inflicts, यश्चापि and whosoever, दण्ड्यः sinner, दण्ड्यते punished, कार्यकारणसिद्धार्थौ with regard to cause and effect, तौ they, उभौ both, नावसीदतः do not become despondent.
explanation: 'The sinner and the punisher, whoever gives punishment and whoever receives it, are both regulated by the law of cause and effect. So do not despair.

shloka_text: तद्भवान्दण्डसंयोगादस्माद्विगतकल्मषः। गतस्स्वां प्रकृतिं धर्म्यं धर्मदृष्टेन वर्त्मना4.18.64।।
transliteration: tadbhavāndaṇḍasaṃyogādasmādvigatakalmaṣaḥ| gatassvāṃ prakṛtiṃ dharmyaṃ dharmadṛṣṭena vartmanā4.18.64||
translation: तत् such, भवान् you अस्मात् from this, दण्डसंयोगात् due to punishment, विगतकल्मषः got rid of sin, धर्मदृष्टेन from the point of righteousness, वर्त्मना by the path, धर्म्याम् righteous, स्वाम् your, प्रकृतिम् natura spiritual nature, गतः you regained.
explanation: 'You have been purged of your sin through punishment from the point of view of righteousness. You have regained your spiritual nature on the path of dharma.

shloka_text: त्यज शोकं च मोहं च भयं च हृदये स्थितम्। त्वया विधानं हर्यग्र्य न शक्यमतिवर्तितुम्4.18.65।।
transliteration: tyaja śokaṃ ca mohaṃ ca bhayaṃ ca hṛdaye sthitam| tvayā vidhānaṃ haryagrya na śakyamativartitum4.18.65||
translation: हर्यग्र्य O best of vanaras, हृदये at heart, स्थितम् left over, शोकं च sorrow, मोहं च and delusion, भयं च and fear, त्यज abandon, त्वया by your, विधानम् fate, अतिवर्तितुम् trangress, न शक्यम् not possible.
explanation: 'O best of monkeys remove sorrow from your heart, delusion and fear. It is not possible for you to transgress fate.

shloka_text: यथा त्वय्यङ्गदो नित्यं वर्तते वानरेश्वर। तथा वर्तेत सुग्रीवे मयि चापि न संशयः4.18.66।।
transliteration: yathā tvayyaṅgado nityaṃ vartate vānareśvara| tathā varteta sugrīve mayi cāpi na saṃśayaḥ4.18.66||
translation: वानरेश्वर lord of monkeys, अङ्गदः Angada, त्वयि with you, नित्यं always, यथा as, वर्तते conduct, सुग्रीवे in Sugriva, मयि चापि in me too, तथा in the same way, वर्तेत he may conduct, संशयः doubt, न no.
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys Angada will remain with Sugriva and with me as he used to live with you. Rest assured.'

shloka_text: स तस्य वाक्यं मधुरं महात्मन स्समाहितं धर्मपथानुवर्तिनः। निशम्य रामस्य रणावमर्दिनो वचस्सुयुक्तं निजगाद वानरः4.18.67।।
transliteration: sa tasya vākyaṃ madhuraṃ mahātmana ssamāhitaṃ dharmapathānuvartinaḥ| niśamya rāmasya raṇāvamardino vacassuyuktaṃ nijagāda vānaraḥ4.18.67||
translation: सः वानरः that monkey, महात्मनः of the great, धर्मपथानुवर्तिनः of a man following a righteous path, रणावमर्दिनः  a crusher of enemy in war, तस्य रामस्य that Rama's, मधुरम् sweet, समाहितम् wellcomposed, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य after hearing, सुयुक्तम् very fitting, वचः words, निजगाद replied.
explanation: Having listened to the sweet, wellcomposed words of great Rama, a crusher of the enemy in war ,follower of righteous path, Vali replied in appropriate manner:

shloka_text: शराभितप्तेन विचेतसा मया प्रदूषितस्त्वं यदजानता प्रभो। इदं महेन्द्रोपम भीमविक्रम प्रसादितस्त्वं क्षम मे नरेश्वर4.18.68।।
transliteration: śarābhitaptena vicetasā mayā pradūṣitastvaṃ yadajānatā prabho| idaṃ mahendropama bhīmavikrama prasāditastvaṃ kṣama me nareśvara4.18.68||
translation: प्रभो O lord, महेन्द्रोपम् like Indra, भीमविक्रम hero of immense valour, नरेश्वर lord of men, शराभितप्तेन excruciating pain caused by the arrow, विचेतसा loss of consciousness, अजानता without knowing, मया by me, त्वम् you, यत् since, प्रदूषितः blamed very much, मे I, इदम् thus, क्षमस्व  forgive, त्वम् you, प्रसादितः be pleased.
explanation: 'Pray, O mighty prince, hero of immense valour, pardon me for the words of blame I unwittingly hurled at you. I said all that in excruciating pain caused by your mighty arrow and in confusion of what is right and what is wrong.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighteenth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic, composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स वानरमहाराजश्शयानश्शरविक्षतः। प्रत्युक्तो हेतुमद्वाक्यैर्नोत्तरं प्रत्यपद्यत4.19.1।।
transliteration: sa vānaramahārājaśśayānaśśaravikṣataḥ| pratyukto hetumadvākyairnottaraṃ pratyapadyata4.19.1||
translation: शरविक्षतः struck down by arrow, शयानः lying on the ground, सः he (Vali), वानरमहाराजः the  king of monkeys, हेतुमद्वाक्यैः by reasonable words, प्रत्युक्तः offered, उत्तरम् reply, न प्रत्यपद्यत not found.
explanation: The king of monkeys lying on the ground struck by the arrow did not offer to reply after listening to Rama's appropriate answers (to his objections).
comments: Tara arrives -- her lamentations.

shloka_text: अश्मभिः प्रविभिन्नाङ्गः पादपैराहतो भृशम्। रामबाणेन चाक्रान्तो जीवितान्ते मुमोह सः4.19.2।।
transliteration: aśmabhiḥ pravibhinnāṅgaḥ pādapairāhato bhṛśam| rāmabāṇena cākrānto jīvitānte mumoha saḥ4.19.2||
translation: अश्मभिः with stones, प्रविभिन्नाङ्गः limbs battreed, पादपैः with trees, भृशम् very much, आहतः   hit, रामबाणेन च by Rama's arrow, आक्रान्तः  attacked, सः he, जीवितान्ते end of life, मुमोह lost consciousness.
explanation: Severely battered by stones, hit by trees and pierced by Rama's arrow, Vali lost consciousness as the end of his life was nearing.

shloka_text: तं भार्या बाणमोक्षेण रामदत्तेन संयुगे। हतं प्लवगशार्दूलं तारा शुश्राव वालिनम्4.19.3।।
transliteration: taṃ bhāryā bāṇamokṣeṇa rāmadattena saṃyuge| hataṃ plavagaśārdūlaṃ tārā śuśrāva vālinam4.19.3||
translation: प्लवगशार्दूलम् tiger among monkeys, तं वालिनम् by that Vali, संयुगे in the battle, रामदत्तेन hit by Rama, बाणमोक्षेण by the discharge of the arrow, हतम् killed, भार्या wife, तारा Tara, शुश्राव heard.
explanation: Tara, wife of Vali, heard that her husband, tiger among monkeys, was killed in the battle by the arrow discharged by Rama.

shloka_text: सा सपुत्राप्रियं श्रुत्वा वधं भर्तुस्सुदारुणम्। निष्पपात भृशं तस्माद्विविधा गिरिगह्वरात्4.19.4।।
transliteration: sā saputrāpriyaṃ śrutvā vadhaṃ bhartussudāruṇam| niṣpapāta bhṛśaṃ tasmādvividhā girigahvarāt4.19.4||
translation: सपुत्रा along with her son, सा Tara, भर्तुः husband's, सुदारुणम् terrible, अप्रियम् sad, वधम् killing, श्रुत्वा on hearing, भृशम् much, उद्विग्ना anxious, तस्मात् from that, गिरि गह्वरात् from the mountain cave, विविधा many, निष्पपात rushed.
explanation: Hearing the terrible, unhappy news of her husband's death, Tara anxiously rushed along with her son out of the mountain cave.

shloka_text: ये त्वङ्गदपरीवारा वानरा भीमविक्रमाः। ते सकार्मुकमालोक्य रामं त्रस्ताः प्रदुद्रुवुः4.19.5।।
transliteration: ye tvaṅgadaparīvārā vānarā bhīmavikramāḥ| te sakārmukamālokya rāmaṃ trastāḥ pradudruvuḥ4.19.5||
translation: अङ्गदपरीवाराः Angada's bodyguards, ये those, भीमविक्रमा: terribly courageous warriors,  वानराः monkeys, ते to, सकार्मुकम् with bow, रामम् Rama, आलोक्य  seeing, त्रस्ताः   frightened, प्रदुद्रुवु: ran in different directions.
explanation: Alarmed at the sight of Rama holding the bow, the terribly courageous monkeys who followed Angada as his bodyguards ran in different directions.

shloka_text: सा ददर्श ततस्त्रस्तान्हरीनापततो भृशम्। यूथादिव परिभ्रष्टान्मृगान्निहतयूथपान्4.19.6।।
transliteration: sā dadarśa tatastrastānharīnāpatato bhṛśam| yūthādiva paribhraṣṭānmṛgānnihatayūthapān4.19.6||
translation: ततः then, सा she, त्रस्तान् terrorstricken, भृशम् very much, आपततः running, निहतयूथपान् the leader killed, यूथात् from the troop, परिभ्रष्टान् strayed, मृगानिव like the deer, हरीन् monkeys, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Tara saw the terrorstricken monkeys running helterskelter, like the herd of deer whose leader who had strayed had been killed.

shloka_text: तानुवाच समासाद्य दुःखितान्दुखिता सती। रामवित्रासितान्सर्वाननुबद्धानिवेषुभिः4.19.7।।
transliteration: tānuvāca samāsādya duḥkhitāndukhitā satī| rāmavitrāsitānsarvānanubaddhāniveṣubhiḥ4.19.7||
translation: दुःखितान्  sorrowing ones, इषुभिः by the arrows, अनुबद्धानिव as if stricken at the back, रामवित्रासितान् terrified by Rama's arrows, तान् them, समासाद्य after duly approaching them, दुःखिता सती she herself being sorrowful, उवाच said.
explanation: Sorrowful Tara, the wife of Vali, duly approaching the monkeys stricken with grief and running as if chased by the arrows of Rama at their back, said to them:

shloka_text: वानराः राजसिंहस्य यस्य यूयं पुरस्सराः। तं विहाय सुसन्त्रस्ताः कस्माद्द्रवथ दुर्गताः4.19.8।।
transliteration: vānarāḥ rājasiṃhasya yasya yūyaṃ purassarāḥ| taṃ vihāya susantrastāḥ kasmāddravatha durgatāḥ4.19.8||
translation: वानराः O monkeys, यूयम् all of you, यस्य whosoever, राजसिंहस्य of a lion among kings, पुरःसराः walked ahead, तम् him, विहाय left, सुसन्त्रस्ताः extremely frightened, दुर्गताः distressed, कस्मात् why, द्रवथ are you running?
explanation: 'O monkeys deserting the lion among kings,whose servants you are ? What should you  be frightened for ? Why run away in distress?

shloka_text: राज्यहेतोस्स चेद्भ्राता भ्रात्रा रौद्रेण पातितः। रामेण प्रहितैरौद्रैर्मार्गणैर्दूरपातिभिः4.19.9।।
transliteration: rājyahetossa cedbhrātā bhrātrā raudreṇa pātitaḥ| rāmeṇa prahitairaudrairmārgaṇairdūrapātibhiḥ4.19.9||
translation: रौद्रेण terrified, भ्रात्रा by the brother, सः he, Vali, राज्यहेतोः for the sake of kingship, रामेण by Rama, रौद्रात् in anger, प्रहितैः discharged, दूरपातिभिः farreaching, मार्गणैः with arrows, पातितः चेत् if he is struck down.
explanation: 'If the (elder) brother is struck down by his (younger) brother in anger for the sake of kingship using farreaching arrows discharged by Rama, why are you running?'

shloka_text: कपिपत्न्या वचश्श्रुत्वा कपयः कामरूपिणः। प्राप्तकालमविक्लिष्टमूचुर्वचनमङ्गनाम्4.19.10।।
transliteration: kapipatnyā vacaśśrutvā kapayaḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ| prāptakālamavikliṣṭamūcurvacanamaṅganām4.19.10||
translation: कामरूपिणः who change form at their will, कपयः monkeys, कपिपत्न्या: of the wife of Vali, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, प्राप्तकालम् timely, अविक्लिष्टम् clear, वचनम् words, अङ्गनाम् to the lady, ऊचुः spoke.
explanation: On hearing Tara, the wife of Vali, the monkeys who could assume any form at their will replied with clear words appropriate to the occasion:

shloka_text: जीवपुत्रे निवर्तस्व पुत्रं रक्षस्व चाङ्गदम्। अन्तको रामरूपेण हत्वा नयति वालिनम्4.19.11।।
transliteration: jīvaputre nivartasva putraṃ rakṣasva cāṅgadam| antako rāmarūpeṇa hatvā nayati vālinam4.19.11||
translation: जीवपुत्रे O mother of a son who is alive, निवर्तस्व go back, पुत्रम् son, अङ्गदम् Angada, रक्षस्व you may protect, अन्तकः lord of death, रामरूपेण in the form of Rama, वालिनम् Vali, हत्वा having killed, नयति carrying away.
explanation: 'O mother, your son is still alive. Go back and protect your son Angada. Lord of death in the form of Rama has come and killed Vali and is carrying him away.

shloka_text: क्षिप्तान् वृक्षान्समाविध्य विपुलाश्च शिलास्तथा। वाली वज्रसमैर्बाणै रामेण विनिपातितः4.19.12।।
transliteration: kṣiptān vṛkṣānsamāvidhya vipulāśca śilāstathā| vālī vajrasamairbāṇai rāmeṇa vinipātitaḥ4.19.12||
translation: क्षिप्तान् hurled, वृक्षान् trees, तथा so also, विपुलाः huge, शिलाः rocks, वज्रसमैः  like thunderbolt, बाणैः by arrows, समाविध्य after striking, वाली Vali, रामेण by Rama, निपातितः killed.
explanation: 'Rama smashed the trees and stones Vali hurled at him and then struck him down with thunderboltlike arrows.

shloka_text: अभिद्रुतमिदं सर्वं विद्रुतं प्रसृतं बलम्। अस्मिन् प्लवगशार्दूले हते शक्रसमप्रभे4.19.13।।
transliteration: abhidrutamidaṃ sarvaṃ vidrutaṃ prasṛtaṃ balam| asmin plavagaśārdūle hate śakrasamaprabhe4.19.13||
translation: शक्रसमप्रभे equal to Indra in splendour, अस्मिन् his, प्लवगशार्दूले tiger among monkeys, हते  is killed, इदम् this, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, अभिद्रुतम् terrified, विद्रुतम् scattered , प्रसृतम् spread all over.
explanation: 'When Vali who was equal to Indra in strength, a tiger among monkeys, was killed, the army of monkeys got terrified and ran away here and there, scattered in different directions.

shloka_text: रक्ष्यतां नगरद्वारमङ्गदश्चाभिषिच्यताम्। पदस्थं वालिनः पुत्रं भजिष्यन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः4.19.14।।
transliteration: rakṣyatāṃ nagaradvāramaṅgadaścābhiṣicyatām| padasthaṃ vālinaḥ putraṃ bhajiṣyanti plavaṅgamāḥ4.19.14||
translation: नगरद्वारम् the gateway of the city, रक्ष्यताम् may be protected, अङ्गदश्च Angada also, अभिषिच्यताम् be consecrated, पदस्थम् assuming the position of a king, वालिनः पुत्रम् Vali's son, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, भजिष्यन्ति will serve him.
explanation: 'Let the gate of the city be shut and Vali's son be consecrated as king. All the monkeys will serve him when he assumes power.

shloka_text: अथवाऽरुचितं स्थानमिह ते रुचिरानने। आविशन्ति हि दुर्गाणि क्षिप्रमन्यानि वानराः4.19.15।।
transliteration: athavā'rucitaṃ sthānamiha te rucirānane| āviśanti hi durgāṇi kṣipramanyāni vānarāḥ4.19.15||
translation: रुचिरानने a woman with a lovely face, अथवा or else, इह here, ते your, स्थानम् place, अरुचितम् not proper, वानराः monkeys, अद्यैव this very day, क्षिप्रम् at once, अन्यानि other, दुर्गाणि citadels, आविशन्ति हि will occupy.
explanation: 'O lovely Tara, this very day other monkeys will soon occupy our citadels.

shloka_text: अभार्याश्च सभार्याश्च सन्त्यत्र वनचारिणः। लुब्धेभ्यो विप्रयुक्तेभ्यस्तेभ्यो नस्तुमुलं भयम्4.19.16।।
transliteration: abhāryāśca sabhāryāśca santyatra vanacāriṇaḥ| lubdhebhyo viprayuktebhyastebhyo nastumulaṃ bhayam4.19.16||
translation: अभार्याः those who do not have wives, सभार्याश्च those who have wives too, वनचारिणः wanderers of the forest, अत्र there, सन्ति are found, लुब्देभ्यः those who have made others wives their own, विप्रयुक्तेभ्यः separated from their wives, तेभ्यः from them, नः no, स्तुमुलम् great, भयम् fear.
explanation: 'There are monkeys wandering in the forest (sent away by Vali). Some of them have made others' wives their own and some have been separated from their wives. They are a great cause of fear.'

shloka_text: अल्पान्तरगतानां तु श्रुत्वा वचनमङ्गना। आत्मनः प्रतिरूपं सा बभाषे चारुहासिनी4.19.17।।
transliteration: alpāntaragatānāṃ tu śrutvā vacanamaṅganā| ātmanaḥ pratirūpaṃ sā babhāṣe cāruhāsinī4.19.17||
translation: अल्पान्तरगतानाम् of those lowminded monkeys, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, चारुहासिनी a lady with a gentle smile, सा अङ्गना that lady, आत्मनः of herself, प्रतिरूपम् in her own style, बभाषे spoke.
explanation: Hearing the words of the pettyminded monkeys, Tara spoke to them in her own way with a gentle smile:

shloka_text: पुत्रेण मम किं कार्यं राज्येनच किमात्मना। कपिसिंहे महाभागे तस्मिन्भर्तरि नश्यति4.19.18।।
transliteration: putreṇa mama kiṃ kāryaṃ rājyenaca kimātmanā| kapisiṃhe mahābhāge tasminbhartari naśyati4.19.18||
translation: कपिसिंहे  lion among monkeys, महाभागे  glorious, तस्मिन् him, नश्यति सति  he is dying, मम to me, पुत्रेण by my son, किं कार्यम् what use, राज्येन (अपि) च even with the kingdom, आत्मना with my own life, किम् what purpose?
explanation: 'Now that the glorious Vali, a lion among monkeys, my husband is dying, of what purpose is the son, or the kingdom or my own life?

shloka_text: पादमूलं गमिष्यामि तस्यैवाहं महात्मनः। योऽसौ रामप्रयुक्तेन शरेण विनिपातितः4.19.19।।
transliteration: pādamūlaṃ gamiṣyāmi tasyaivāhaṃ mahātmanaḥ| yo'sau rāmaprayuktena śareṇa vinipātitaḥ4.19.19||
translation: यः whosoever, असौ this person, रामप्रयुक्तेन discharged by Rama, शरेण by arrow, विनिपातितः is killed, महात्मनः of the great soul, तस्य his, पादमूलम् एव  soles of his feet, गमिष्यामि I will go.
explanation: 'I will seek the soles of the feet of the great soul who has been killed by the arrow discharged by Rama.'

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा प्रदुद्राव रुदन्ती शोककर्शिता। शिरश्चोरश्च बाहुभ्यां दुःखेन समभिध्नती4.19.20।।
transliteration: evamuktvā pradudrāva rudantī śokakarśitā| śiraścoraśca bāhubhyāṃ duḥkhena samabhidhnatī4.19.20||
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, रुदन्ती while crying, शोककर्शिता grief stricken, दुःखेन sadly, शिरश्च head, उरश्च chest, बाहुभ्याम् with both hands, समभिध्नती beating, प्रदुद्राव hastened.
explanation: So saying, the griefstricken, weeping Tara hastened, sadly beating with both hands her head and her chest.

shloka_text: आव्रजन्ती ददर्शाथ पतिं निपतितं भुवि। हन्तारं दानवेन्द्राणां समरेष्वनिवर्तिनम्4.19.21।।
transliteration: āvrajantī dadarśātha patiṃ nipatitaṃ bhuvi| hantāraṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ samareṣvanivartinam4.19.21||
translation: आव्रजन्ती as she approached, अथ then, दानवेन्द्राणाम् of warriors among demons, हन्तारम्  killed, समरेषु in wars, अनिवर्तिनम् who never retreated, भुवि on the ground, निपतितम् fallen, पतिम् husband, ददर्श saw.
explanation: As she was nearing (the spot) she saw her husband, a great conqueror of monkeys who never retreated  from the battle, mortally hit and fallen on the ground.

shloka_text: क्षेप्तारं पर्वतेन्द्राणां वज्राणामिव वासवम्। महावातसमाविष्टं महामेघौघनिस्स्वनम्4.19.22।।
transliteration: kṣeptāraṃ parvatendrāṇāṃ vajrāṇāmiva vāsavam| mahāvātasamāviṣṭaṃ mahāmeghaughanissvanam4.19.22||
translation: वज्राणाम् the thunderbolts, वासवम् इव like Indra, पर्वतेन्द्राणाम् of huge mountains, क्षेप्तारम् the one who hurls, महावातसमाविष्टम् wind blowing at high velocity, महामेघौघनिस्स्वनम् thundering like huge clouds.
explanation: Vali who used to hurl huge mountains like Indra discharges thunderbolts, who had the speed  of wind of high velocity, who would roar like huge thundering clouds,

shloka_text: क्रतुल्यपराक्रान्तं वृष्टवेवोपरतं घनम्। नर्दन्तं नर्दतां भीमं शूरं शूरेण पातितम्4.19.23।। शार्दूलेनामिषस्यार्थे मृगराजं यथाहतम्।
transliteration: kratulyaparākrāntaṃ vṛṣṭavevoparataṃ ghanam| nardantaṃ nardatāṃ bhīmaṃ śūraṃ śūreṇa pātitam4.19.23|| śārdūlenāmiṣasyārthe mṛgarājaṃ yathāhatam|
translation: शक्रतुल्यपराक्रान्तम् equal to Indra in prowess, वृष्टवा after raining, उपरतम् who stopped, घनम् इव heavy cloud like, नर्दन्तम् thundering, नर्दताम् among those who roared, भीमम् terrific, शूरम् heroic, शूरेण by a hero, पातितम् struck down, आमिषस्यार्थे for the sake of meat, शार्दूलेन by tiger, आहतम् killed, मृगराजं यथा like the lion.
explanation: (Vali) who was equal to Indra in prowess looked like a huge monsoon cloud that had calmed down after pouring all water, a roaring warrior who could frighten others,  struck down by another warrior,  appeared like a lion killed by a tiger for the sake of meat

shloka_text: अर्चितं सर्वलोकस्य सपताकं सवेदिकम्4.19.24।। नागहेतोस्सुपर्णेन चैत्यमुन्मथितं यथा।
transliteration: arcitaṃ sarvalokasya sapatākaṃ savedikam4.19.24|| nāgahetossuparṇena caityamunmathitaṃ yathā|
translation: सर्वलोकस्य by all the worlds, अर्चितम् revered, सपताकम् along with the flag, सवेदिकम् along with the altar, सुपर्णेन by Garuda, नागहेतोः on account of serpent, उन्मथितम् destroyed, चैत्यं यथा like the sacred chaityaa place of worship.
explanation: Vali looked like a chaitya (a tree of worship) having a banner and altar and reverentially  worshipped by the entire world, but destroyed by Garuda on account of a serpent (hidden in it). (Here Rama is Garuda, Sugriva, serpent and Vali a sacred Chaitya)

shloka_text: अवष्टभ्य च तिष्ठन्तं ददर्श धनुरुत्तम्4.19.25।। रामं रामानुजं चैव भर्तुश्चैवानुजं शुभा।
transliteration: avaṣṭabhya ca tiṣṭhantaṃ dadarśa dhanuruttam4.19.25|| rāmaṃ rāmānujaṃ caiva bhartuścaivānujaṃ śubhā|
translation: उत्तमम् best, धनुः bow, अवष्टभ्य leaning on, तिष्ठन्तम् standing firmly, रामम् Rama, रामानुजं चैव and brother of Rama also, भर्तुः husband's, अनुजं brother, शुभा चैव auspicious lady, ददर्श beheld.
explanation: The auspicious lady Tara beheld Rama standing there firmly with his brother and Sugriva, leaning on the best of bows.

shloka_text: तावतीत्य समासाद्य भर्तारं निहतं रणे4.19.26।। समीक्ष्य व्यथिता भूमौ सम्भ्रान्ता निपपात ह।
transliteration: tāvatītya samāsādya bhartāraṃ nihataṃ raṇe4.19.26|| samīkṣya vyathitā bhūmau sambhrāntā nipapāta ha|
translation: तौ both of them (Rama and Lakshmana), अतीत्य  passing, रणे in war, निहतम् killed, भर्तारम् her husband, समासाद्य having reached, समीक्ष्य after seeing, व्यथिता very much pained, सम्भ्रान्ता agitated, भूमौ on the ground, निपपात ह fell down.
explanation: Passing Rama and Lakshmana, she went near her husband killed in the combat. She was full of agony to see him. Deeply agitated in the mind, she fell down on the ground.

shloka_text: सुप्त्वेव पुनरुत्थाय आर्यपुत्रेति शोचती4.19.27।। रुरोद सा पतिं दृष्ट्वा संवीतं मृत्युदामभिः।
transliteration: suptveva punarutthāya āryaputreti śocatī4.19.27|| ruroda sā patiṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃvītaṃ mṛtyudāmabhiḥ|
translation: सा that, सुप्त्वेव as if from sleep, पुनः again, उत्थाय rising up, आर्यपुत्र इति O Aryaputra (husband), शोचती weeping, मृत्युदामभिः with the garland of death, संवीतम् surrounded, पतिम् husband, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, रुरोद lamented.
explanation: Tara got up again, as if she woke up from sleep and addressing her husband garlanded with death, lamented.

shloka_text: तामवेक्ष्य तु सुग्रीवः क्रोशन्तीं कुररीमिव। विषादमगमत्कष्टं दृष्ट्वा चाङ्गदमागतम्4.19.28।।
transliteration: tāmavekṣya tu sugrīvaḥ krośantīṃ kurarīmiva| viṣādamagamatkaṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāṅgadamāgatam4.19.28||
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, कुररीमिव like a female osprey, क्रोशन्तीम् while she was crying, ताम् her, अवेक्ष्य seeing, आगतम् came, आङ्गदं च and Angada also, दृष्ट्वा seeing, कष्टम् pain, विषादम् despair, अगमत् experienced.
explanation: Seeing Tara crying like a female osprey and Angada following her in despair, Sugriva felt pain (at heart). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the nineteenth sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: रामचापविसृष्टेन शरेणान्तकरेण तम्। दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं भूमौ तारा ताराधिपानना4.20.1।। सा समासाद्य भर्तारं पर्यष्वजत भामिनी।
transliteration: rāmacāpavisṛṣṭena śareṇāntakareṇa tam| dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ bhūmau tārā tārādhipānanā4.20.1|| sā samāsādya bhartāraṃ paryaṣvajata bhāminī|
translation: ताराधिपानना moonfaced, भामिनी lovely woman, सा तारा that Tara, रामचापविसृष्टेन by the release of an arrow from Rama's bow, अन्तकरेण by a deathdealing one, शरेण arrow, (वि)निहतम् killed, तम् him, भूमौ on the ground, दृष्ट्वा beholding, समासाद्य went near, पर्यष्वजत embraced.
explanation: Beholding her husband lying on the ground pierced by a deathdealing arrow released by Rama, the lovely moonfaced Tara went and embraced him.
comments: Tara's lamentation over her misfortune.

shloka_text: इषुणाऽभिहतं दृष्ट्वा वालिनं कुञ्जरोपमम्4.20.2।। वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभं शोकसन्तप्तमानसा। तारा तरुमिवोन्मूलं पर्यदेवयदातुरा4.20.3।।
transliteration: iṣuṇā'bhihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vālinaṃ kuñjaropamam4.20.2|| vānarendra mahendrābhaṃ śokasantaptamānasā| tārā tarumivonmūlaṃ paryadevayadāturā4.20.3||
translation: इषुणा by the arrows, अभिहतम् killed, कुञ्जरोपमम् like an elephant, पर्वतेन्द्राभम् splendid as mountain, उन्मूलम् uprooted, तरुम् इव like a tree, वानरेन्द्रम् lord of monkeys, वालिनम् Vali, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तारा Tara, आतुरा restless, शोकसन्तप्तमानसा immersed in grief, पर्यदेवयत् wailed.
explanation: Beholding Vali, the lord of monkeys, who was strong as an elephant, splendid as a mountain, fallen down like an uprooted tree, struck by the arrow, Tara became restless and wailed bitterly:

shloka_text: इषुणाऽभिहतं दृष्ट्वा वालिनं कुञ्जरोपमम्4.20.2।। वानरेन्द्र महेन्द्राभं शोकसन्तप्तमानसा। तारा तरुमिवोन्मूलं पर्यदेवयदातुरा4.20.3।।
transliteration: iṣuṇā'bhihataṃ dṛṣṭvā vālinaṃ kuñjaropamam4.20.2|| vānarendra mahendrābhaṃ śokasantaptamānasā| tārā tarumivonmūlaṃ paryadevayadāturā4.20.3||
translation: इषुणा by the arrows, अभिहतम् killed, कुञ्जरोपमम् like an elephant, पर्वतेन्द्राभम् splendid as mountain, उन्मूलम् uprooted, तरुम् इव like a tree, वानरेन्द्रम् lord of monkeys, वालिनम् Vali, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तारा Tara, आतुरा restless, शोकसन्तप्तमानसा immersed in grief, पर्यदेवयत् wailed.
explanation: Beholding Vali, the lord of monkeys, who was strong as an elephant, splendid as a mountain, fallen down like an uprooted tree, struck by the arrow, Tara became restless and wailed bitterly:

shloka_text: रणे दारुण विक्रान्त प्रवीर प्लवतां वर। किं दीनामपुरोभागामद्य त्वं नाभिभाषसे।।4.20.4।।
transliteration: raṇe dāruṇa vikrānta pravīra plavatāṃ vara| kiṃ dīnāmapurobhāgāmadya tvaṃ nābhibhāṣase
translation: रणे in war, दारुण dreadful, प्रवीर valiant, विक्रान्त a hero who advances, प्लवतां वर lord of monkeys, दीनाम् piteous lady, अपुरोभागाम् ignorant, त्वम् you, अद्य now, किम् why, नाभिभाषसे not replying.
explanation: 'O valiant hero, lord of monkeys you were terrifying in war. Why don't you speak now to me so forlorn and helpless?

shloka_text: उत्तिष्ठ हरिशार्दूल भजस्व शयनोत्तमम्। नैवंविधाश्शेरते हि भूमौ नृपतिसत्तमाः4.20.5।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭha hariśārdūla bhajasva śayanottamam| naivaṃvidhāśśerate hi bhūmau nṛpatisattamāḥ4.20.5||
translation: हरिशार्दूल O tiger among monkeys, उत्तिष्ठ get up, शयनोत्तमम् best of beds, भजस्व resort to, एवंविधाः such people, नृपतिसत्तमाः  best of kings, भूमौ on the ground, न शेरते हि do not lie down.
explanation: 'O tiger among monkeys get up. Come and sleep on the best of beds. Best of kings, you should not lie on the ground.

shloka_text: अतीव खलु ते कान्ता वसुधा वसुधाधिप। गतासुरपि यां गात्रैर्मां विहाय निषेवसे4.20.6।।
transliteration: atīva khalu te kāntā vasudhā vasudhādhipa| gatāsurapi yāṃ gātrairmāṃ vihāya niṣevase4.20.6||
translation: वसुधाधिप lord of the earth, ते to you, वसुधा earth, अतीव very much, कान्ता खलु indeed your loved one, गतासुरपि even after death, माम् me, विहाय abandon, गात्रै: by your limbs, याम् her, निषेवसे you are enjoying.
explanation: 'O lord of the earth I know you loved the earth more than you loved me since you have forsaken me and enjoy her company by hugging her with your limbs, even after death.

shloka_text: व्यक्तमन्या त्वया वीर धर्मत: सम्प्रवर्तिता। किष्किन्धेव पुरी रम्या स्वर्गमार्गे विनिर्मिता4.20.7।।
transliteration: vyaktamanyā tvayā vīra dharmata: sampravartitā| kiṣkindheva purī ramyā svargamārge vinirmitā4.20.7||
translation: वीर O hero, धर्मतः righteously, सम्प्रवर्तिता acknowledged, त्वया by you, अन्या another, किष्किन्धेव kishkindalike, रम्या delightful, पुरी city, स्वर्गमार्गे on your way to heaven, विनिर्मिता is built, स्पष्टम् it is evident.
explanation: 'O my heroic husband, you are the legitimate, righteous king of Kiskinda. You have evidently built another beautiful city Kiskinda on your way to heaven.

shloka_text: यान्यस्माभिस्त्वया सार्धं वनेषु मधुगन्धिषु। विहृतानि त्वया काले तेषामुपरमः कृतः4.20.8।।
transliteration: yānyasmābhistvayā sārdhaṃ vaneṣu madhugandhiṣu| vihṛtāni tvayā kāle teṣāmuparamaḥ kṛtaḥ4.20.8||
translation: त्वया with you, अस्माभि: by us, सार्धम् with us, मधुगन्धिषु sweetscented, वनेषु in the forests, यानि such, विहृतानि pleasure trips, काले at this time, तेषाम् their, उपरमः made to end, त्वया by you, कृतः is made.
explanation: 'Our pleasure trips to sweetscented forests have ended now. You have brought them to a close.

shloka_text: निरानन्दा निराशाऽहं निमग्ना शोकसागरे। त्वयि पञ्चत्वमापन्ने महायूथपयूथपे4.20.9।।
transliteration: nirānandā nirāśā'haṃ nimagnā śokasāgare| tvayi pañcatvamāpanne mahāyūthapayūthape4.20.9||
translation: महायूथपयूथपे the leader of the leaders, त्वयि you only, पञ्चत्वम् heaven, आपन्ने  are dead, अहम् I am, निरानन्दा without pleasure, निराशा with no hope, शोकसागरे in a sea of sorrow, निमग्ना immersed.
explanation: 'You are the leader of leaders. Now that you have attained heaven I am bereft of all joy,   plunged in a sea of grief.

shloka_text: हृदयं सुस्थिरं मह्यं दृष्ट्वा विनिहतं पतिम्। यन्न शोकाभिसन्तप्तं स्फुटतेऽद्य सहस्रधा4.20.10।।
transliteration: hṛdayaṃ susthiraṃ mahyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ patim| yanna śokābhisantaptaṃ sphuṭate'dya sahasradhā4.20.10||
translation: मह्यम् for me, हृदयम् heart, सुस्थिरम् is strong, यत् since, भुवि on the ground, (नि)पतितम् fallen, दृष्ट्वा even seeing, शोकाभिसन्तप्तम् tormented with sorrow, अद्य today, सहस्रधा thousandfold, न स्फुटते not broken into pieces.
explanation: 'I presume my heart is strong, for it has not broken into a thousand pieces, even though I am overwhelmed with grief to see my husband fallen on the ground.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवस्य त्वया भार्या हृता स च विवासितः। यत्तु त्तस्य त्वया व्युष्टिः प्राप्तेयं प्लवगाधिप4.20.11।।
transliteration: sugrīvasya tvayā bhāryā hṛtā sa ca vivāsitaḥ| yattu ttasya tvayā vyuṣṭiḥ prāpteyaṃ plavagādhipa4.20.11||
translation: प्लवगाधिप O king of monkeys, त्वया by you, यत् that, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, भार्या wife, हृता seized, सः च and he is, विवासितः banished, तत् that, त्वया by you, तस्य its, इयम् this, व्युष्टिः as a result, प्राप्ता attained.
explanation: 'O king of monkeys you have banished Sugriva. You have usurped his wife. This is the fruit  of your action.

shloka_text: निश्श्रेयसपरा मोहात्त्वया चाहं विगर्हिता। यैषाऽब्रुवं हितं वाक्यं वानरेन्द्र हितैषिणी4.20.12।।
transliteration: niśśreyasaparā mohāttvayā cāhaṃ vigarhitā| yaiṣā'bruvaṃ hitaṃ vākyaṃ vānarendra hitaiṣiṇī4.20.12||
translation: वानरेन्द्र O lord of monkeys, निःश्रेयसपरा wishing your wellfare, हितैषिणी as a wellwisher, या such, एषा such a lady, हितम् वाक्यम् salutary advice, अब्रुवम् I tendered, अहम् I, त्वया मोहात्  due to delusion, विगर्हिता despised.
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys wishing your wellbeing I tendered salutary advice. But out of delusion you despised them.

shloka_text: रूपयौवनदृप्तानां दक्षिणानां च मानद। नूनमप्सरसामार्य चित्तानि प्रमथिष्यसि4.20.13।।
transliteration: rūpayauvanadṛptānāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ ca mānada| nūnamapsarasāmārya cittāni pramathiṣyasi4.20.13||
translation: मानद O venerable one, रूपयौवनदृप्तानाम् endowed with youth and beauty, दक्षिणानाम् of the kindhearted, अप्सरसाम् of apsarasas, चित्तानि hearts, प्रमथिष्यसि you will churn, नूनम् surely.
explanation: 'O venerable one you will surely churn the minds of the kindhearted celestial nymphs who are endowed with youth and beauty.

shloka_text: कालो निस्संशयो नूनं जीवितान्तकरस्तव। बलाद्येनावपन्नोऽसि सुग्रीवस्यावशो वशम्4.20.14।।
transliteration: kālo nissaṃśayo nūnaṃ jīvitāntakarastava| balādyenāvapanno'si sugrīvasyāvaśo vaśam4.20.14||
translation: निस्संशयः no doubt, कालः inexorable time, तव to you, जीवितान्तकरः ends your life, नूनम् surely, येन since, अवशः an uncontrollable one, बलात् forcibly, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, वशम् under control, अवपन्नः  come into the fold.
explanation: 'No doubt time is inexorable. The time of your death had surely arrived.Now you, whom nobody could control, have come under the sway of Sugriva.

shloka_text: वैधव्यं शोकसन्तापं कृपणं कृपणा सती। अदुःखोपचिता पूर्वं वर्तयिष्याम्यनाथवत्।।4.20.15।।
transliteration: vaidhavyaṃ śokasantāpaṃ kṛpaṇaṃ kṛpaṇā satī| aduḥkhopacitā pūrvaṃ vartayiṣyāmyanāthavat
translation: पूर्वम् earlier, कृपणा सती reduced to pitiable condition, अदुःखोपचिता not experienced grief, अनाथवत् like an orphan, कृपणं in a wretched manner, वैधव्यम् widowhood, शोकसन्तापम् immersed in grief, वर्तयिष्यामि I will remain.
explanation: 'I have not experienced poverty or suffering before. Immersed in grief, like an orphan, now I am reduced to the pitiable condition of a widow.

shloka_text: लालितश्चाङ्गदो वीरस्सुकुमारस्सुखोचितः। वर्त्स्यते कामवस्थां मे पितृव्ये क्रोधमूर्छिते।।4.20.16।।
transliteration: lālitaścāṅgado vīrassukumārassukhocitaḥ| vartsyate kāmavasthāṃ me pitṛvye krodhamūrchite
translation: पितृव्ये  father's brother, क्रोधमूर्छिते is deluded with anger, लालितः a fondled boy, सुकुमारः tender, सुखोचितः who deserves comforts, वीरः a hero, मे अङ्गदः my Angada, काम् what kind, अवस्थाम् state, वर्त्स्यते is going to experience?
explanation: 'To what plight will the tender Angada, who has been tended affectionately and deserves comforts, be reduced when his uncle displays anger?

shloka_text: कुरुष्व पितरं पुत्र सुदृष्टं धर्मवत्सलम्। दुर्लभं दर्शनं वत्स तव तस्य भविष्यति।।4.20.17।।
transliteration: kuruṣva pitaraṃ putra sudṛṣṭaṃ dharmavatsalam| durlabhaṃ darśanaṃ vatsa tava tasya bhaviṣyati
translation: पुत्र O son, धर्मवत्सलम् a lover of dharma, पितरम् father, सुदृष्टम् well seen, कुरुष्व you may do, वत्स dear, तस्य his, दर्शनम् meeting, दुर्लभम् difficult, भविष्यति will become.
explanation: (Turning to Angada Tara said) 'O son, look at your father, a lover of dharma. See him, as it will be difficult to see him later, dear'.

shloka_text: समाश्वासय पुत्रं त्वं सन्देशं सन्दिशस्व मे। मूर्ध्नि चैनं समाघ्राय प्रवासं प्रस्थितो ह्यसि4.20.18।।
transliteration: samāśvāsaya putraṃ tvaṃ sandeśaṃ sandiśasva me| mūrdhni cainaṃ samāghrāya pravāsaṃ prasthito hyasi4.20.18||
translation: त्वम् you, पुत्रम् son, समाश्वासय console him, एनम् him, मूर्ध्नि touching his forehead, समाघ्राय enjoying the sweet smell of his body, च एनं him, सन्देशम्  instructon, सन्दिश्व  consoling him, प्रवासम् on a journey, प्रस्थितः going, असि हि you are.
explanation: 'O lord you have set out on a long journey. Kiss your son on the forehead, enjoy its sweet smell, console him and give him your message.

shloka_text: रामेण हि महत्कर्म कृतं त्वामभिनिघ्नता। आनृण्यं च गतं तस्य सुग्रीवस्य प्रतिश्रवे4.20.19।।
transliteration: rāmeṇa hi mahatkarma kṛtaṃ tvāmabhinighnatā| ānṛṇyaṃ ca gataṃ tasya sugrīvasya pratiśrave4.20.19||
translation: त्वाम् you, अभिनिघ्नता by killing you, रामेण by Rama, महत् great, कर्म deed, कृतं हि accomplished, सुग्रीवस्य for Sugriva, प्रतिश्रवे in fulfilling promise, तस्य his, आनृण्यम् debt, गतं तु is acquitted.
explanation: 'Indeed, Rama has achieved a great feat in fulfilling his promise to Sugriva. He is acquitted of the debt by killing you.

shloka_text: सकामो भव सुग्रीव रुमां त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे। भुङ्क्षव राज्यमनुद्विग्नश्शस्तो भ्राता रिपुस्तव4.20.20।।
transliteration: sakāmo bhava sugrīva rumāṃ tvaṃ pratipatsyase| bhuṅkṣava rājyamanudvignaśśasto bhrātā ripustava4.20.20||
translation: सुग्रीव Sugriva, सकामः be happy, भव be, त्वम् you, रुमाम् Ruma, प्रतिपत्स्यसे returned to her, अनुद्विग्नः without any worry, राज्यम् kingdom, भुङ्क्षव  enjoy, तव your, रिपुः enemy, भ्राता brother, शस्तः is killed.
explanation: '(Now turning to Sugriva she said) O Sugriva your enemy brother has been killed and your desire has been fulfilled.You will get back Ruma and enjoy the kingdom without any obstacles.'

shloka_text: किं मामेवं विलपतीं प्रेम्णा त्वं नाभिभाषसे। इमाः पश्य वरा बह्वीर्भार्यास्ते वानरेश्वर4.20.21।।
transliteration: kiṃ māmevaṃ vilapatīṃ premṇā tvaṃ nābhibhāṣase| imāḥ paśya varā bahvīrbhāryāste vānareśvara4.20.21||
translation: वानरेश्वर lord of monkeys, एवम् in that way, विलपतीम् while I am wailing, प्रेम्णा lovingly, माम् with me, त्वम् you, किम् why, नाभिभाषसे you are not speaking, ते your, बह्वीः many, वराः lovely, भार्याः wives, इमाः these, पश्य you may see.
explanation: '(To Vali she said) O lord of monkeys Why don't you speak to me loving words when I am wailing this way? Here are your excellent wives'

shloka_text: तस्या विलपितं श्रुत्वा वानर्यस्सर्वतश्च ताः। परिगृह्याङ्गदं दीनं दुःखार्ता परिचुक्रुशुः4.20.22।।
transliteration: tasyā vilapitaṃ śrutvā vānaryassarvataśca tāḥ| parigṛhyāṅgadaṃ dīnaṃ duḥkhārtā paricukruśuḥ4.20.22||
translation: सर्वतः all over, ताः those, वानर्यः female monkeys, तस्याः their, विलपितम् wailing, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अङ्गदम् Angada, परिगृह्य taking hold, दीनाः wretched women, दुःखार्ताः filled with sorrow, परिचुक्रुशुः cried bitterly.
explanation: On hearing the wailing of Tara, all the other wives of Vali held the piteous (in their arms) Angada and wailed, overwhelmed with sorrow:

shloka_text: किमङ्गदं साङ्गदवीरबाहो विहाय यास्यद्य चिरप्रवासम्। न युक्तमेवं गुणसन्निकृष्टं विहाय पुत्रं प्रियपुत्र गन्तुम्4.20.23।।
transliteration: kimaṅgadaṃ sāṅgadavīrabāho vihāya yāsyadya cirapravāsam| na yuktamevaṃ guṇasannikṛṣṭaṃ vihāya putraṃ priyaputra gantum4.20.23||
translation: साङ्गदवीरबाहो O hero adorned with armlets, अङ्गदम् Angada, विहाय deserting, चिरप्रवासम् on a long journey, किम् why, प्रयातः असि going, गुणसन्निकृष्टम् with qualities like yours, प्रियपुत्र  your dear son, पुत्रम् son, एवम् this way, न युक्तम् not proper to go.
explanation: 'O hero, adorned with armlets, why have you departed on a long journey, deserting your dear son Angada who possesses similar virtues like you? It is not proper.

shloka_text: किमप्रियं ते प्रिय चारुवेष मया कृतं नाथ सुतेन वा ते। सहाङ्गदां मां प्रविहाय वीर यत्प्रस्थितो दीर्घ मितः प्रवासम्4.20.24।।
transliteration: kimapriyaṃ te priya cāruveṣa mayā kṛtaṃ nātha sutena vā te| sahāṅgadāṃ māṃ pravihāya vīra yatprasthito dīrgha mitaḥ pravāsam4.20.24||
translation: प्रियचारुवेष  robed attractively, वीर esteemed one, नाथ lord, सहाङ्गदाम् with Angada, माम् me, विहाय leaving, इतः  this place, दीर्घम् long distance, प्रवासम् journey, यत् प्रस्थितः since you have begun, मया by me, ते to you, सुतेन वा or by your son, किम् what, अप्रियम् unpleasant, कृतम् done.
explanation: 'O darling, attractively dressed, you are leaving me and Angada and going too far.  What unpleasant deeds we have done (to deserve this).

shloka_text: यद्यप्रियं किञ्चिदसम्प्रधार्य कृतं मया स्यात्तव दीर्घबाहो। क्षमस्व मे तद्धरिवंशनाथ व्रजामि मूर्ध्ना तव वीर पादौ।।4.20.25।।
transliteration: yadyapriyaṃ kiñcidasampradhārya kṛtaṃ mayā syāttava dīrghabāho| kṣamasva me taddharivaṃśanātha vrajāmi mūrdhnā tava vīra pādau
translation: दीर्घबाहो O longarmed one, हरिवंशनाथ chief of monkey clan, वीर warrior, असम्प्रधार्य unknowingly, मया by me, तव to you, अप्रियम् inconsiderately, किञ्चित् even a little, कृतं स्याद्यदि if done, मे mine, तत् that, क्षमस्व  may pardon, मूर्ध्ना by my head, तव your, पादो feet, व्रजामि I reach.
explanation: 'O longarmed chief of the monkey clan O warrior pardon me any wrong done unknowingly, inconsiderately. I touch your feet with my head.'

shloka_text: ततो निपतितां तारां च्युतां तारामिवाम्बरात्। शनैराश्वासयामास हनुमान्हरियूथपः4.21.1।।
transliteration: tato nipatitāṃ tārāṃ cyutāṃ tārāmivāmbarāt| śanairāśvāsayāmāsa hanumānhariyūthapaḥ4.21.1||
translation: ततः then, अम्बरात् from the sky, च्युताम् fallen down, तारामिव like a star, निपतिताम् fallen on the ground, ताराम् Tara, हरियूथपः leader of the monkey clan, हनुमान् Hanuman, शनैः slowly, आश्वासयामास consoled.
explanation: Thereafter Hanuman, leader of the monkey clan, slowly consoled Tara who was (standing before her husband) like a star fallen from the sky.
comments: Hanuman consoles Tara -- requests her to ask Angada to perform the last rites for Vali -- Tara's reply.

shloka_text: गुणदोषकृतं जन्तुस्स्वकर्म फलहेतुकम्। अव्यग्रस्तदवाप्नोति सर्वं प्रेत्य शुभाशुभम्4.21.2।।
transliteration: guṇadoṣakṛtaṃ jantussvakarma phalahetukam| avyagrastadavāpnoti sarvaṃ pretya śubhāśubham4.21.2||
translation: जन्तुः an embodied soul, गुणदोषकृतम् by virtue of their good and bad deeds, फलहेतुकम् the fruits of actions, सर्वम् all, तत् that, शुभाशुभम् whether good and bad, कर्म deed, प्रेत्य after death, अव्यग्रः gradually, आप्नोति attains.
explanation: 'On departing from this mortal world an embodied soul reaps gradually the good and evil fruits of action performed under the notion of virtue or vice with an eye to their good or evil consequences.

shloka_text: शोच्या शोचसि कं शोच्यं दीनं दीनाऽनुकम्पसे। कस्य कोवाऽनुशोच्योऽस्ति देहेऽस्मिन् बुद्बुदोपमे4.21.3।।
transliteration: śocyā śocasi kaṃ śocyaṃ dīnaṃ dīnā'nukampase| kasya kovā'nuśocyo'sti dehe'smin budbudopame4.21.3||
translation: शोच्या worry, शोच्यम् a matter to grieve, कम् whom, शोचसि you are grieving, दीना in a  miserable manner, अनुकम्पसे you show sympathy, अस्मिन् in this, देहे body, बुद्बुदोपमे like a bubble, कः who, कस्य for whom, अनुशोच्यः worthy of worrying, अस्ति now.
explanation: 'For whom do you grieve except for yourself? You are miserable. Who are you sympathising with? Who are you grieving for? When this body itself  is like a bubble, who is worth grieving for?

shloka_text: अङ्गदस्तु कुमारोऽयं द्रष्टव्यो जीवपुत्रया। अयत्यां च विधेयानि समर्थान्यस्य चिन्तय4.21.4।।
transliteration: aṅgadastu kumāro'yaṃ draṣṭavyo jīvaputrayā| ayatyāṃ ca vidheyāni samarthānyasya cintaya4.21.4||
translation: जीवपुत्रया  who has a son surviving, कुमारः prince, अयम् this, अङ्गदः Angada, द्रष्टव्यः should be looked after, आयत्याम् in future, अस्य his, विधेयानि duties, समर्थानि properly, चिन्तय you may think of.
explanation: 'You are mother of a surviving son, Angada. You have to look after him in times to come. Think of the duties to be performed now.

shloka_text: जानास्यनियतामेवं भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। तस्माच्छुभं हि कर्तव्यं पण्डितेनैह लौकिकम्।।4.21.5।।
transliteration: jānāsyaniyatāmevaṃ bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim| tasmācchubhaṃ hi kartavyaṃ paṇḍitenaiha laukikam
translation: भूतानाम् for all beings, आगतिम् transient happenings, अनियताम् एव as it is unstable, जानासि you know, तस्मात् therefore, पण्डितेन by the wise, इह here, लौकिकम् worldly, शुभम् auspicious, कर्तव्यं हि is to be done.
explanation: 'You are aware of the uncertain and transient happenings in the lives of living beings. Therefore, a wise lady should do auspicious work in this world.

shloka_text: यस्मिन्हरिसहस्राणि प्रयुतान्यर्बुदानि च। वर्तयन्ति कृतांशानि सोऽयं दिष्टान्तमागतः4.21.6।।
transliteration: yasminharisahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca| vartayanti kṛtāṃśāni so'yaṃ diṣṭāntamāgataḥ4.21.6||
translation: यस्मिन् in whom, कृतांशानि pinning their hopes, हरिसहस्राणि thousands of monkeys, प्रयुतानि in millions, अर्बुदानि च and tens of millions, वर्तयन्ति sustain, सः he, अयम् this, दिष्टान्तम् to enjoy the fruits of his good deeds, आगतः reached.
explanation: 'Tens of millions of monkeys depended on this hero with their hopes on him. He has reached his ultimate destiny now to enjoy the fruits of his good deeds.

shloka_text: यदयं न्यायदृष्टार्थस्सामदानक्षमापरः। गतो धर्मजितां भूमिं नैनं शोचितुमर्हसि4.21.7।।
transliteration: yadayaṃ nyāyadṛṣṭārthassāmadānakṣamāparaḥ| gato dharmajitāṃ bhūmiṃ nainaṃ śocitumarhasi4.21.7||
translation: न्यायदृष्टार्थः who has right vision, सामदानक्षमापरः adopts the sama(conciliation) dana (charity) and forgiveness (as means of administration), अयम् this hero, यत् such, धर्मजिताम् of those who win righteously, भूमिम् earth, गतः reached, एवम् in that way, शोचितुम् to mourn, नार्हसि not proper.
explanation: 'This hero with a right vision, adopted the means of conciliation, charity and forgiveness (in his administration) and has finally reached a position through righteousness in his death. It is not proper to mourn for him.

shloka_text: सर्वे हि हरिशार्दूलाः पुत्रश्चायं तवाङ्गदः। इदं हर्यृक्षपतिराज्यं च त्वत्सनाथमनिन्दिते4.21.8।।
transliteration: sarve hi hariśārdūlāḥ putraścāyaṃ tavāṅgadaḥ| idaṃ haryṛkṣapatirājyaṃ ca tvatsanāthamanindite4.21.8||
translation: अनिन्दिते O blemishless lady, सर्वे all, हरिशार्दूलाः tigers among monkeys, तव your, पुत्रः son, अयम् this, अङ्गदश्च Angada's, हर्यृक्षपतिराज्यं च and the kingdom of monkeys and bears, त्वत्सनाथम्  under your protection.
explanation: 'O blemishless lady these great monkeys including your son Angada and the entire kingdom of monkeys and bears are under your protection.

shloka_text: ताविमौ शोकसन्तप्तौ शनैः प्रेरय भामिनि। त्वया परिगृहीतोऽयमङ्गदश्शास्तु मेदिनीम्4.21.9।।
transliteration: tāvimau śokasantaptau śanaiḥ preraya bhāmini| tvayā parigṛhīto'yamaṅgadaśśāstu medinīm4.21.9||
translation: भामिनि O fair sex, शोकसन्तप्तौ immersed in grief, तौ इमौ they both, शनैः slowly, प्रेरय you may encourage, त्वया by you, परिगृहीतः protected, अयम् this, अङ्गदः Angada, मेदिनीम् earth, शास्तु he may command.
explanation: 'O fair sex Encourage these two griefstricken heroes (Angada and Sugriva) gently. Let Angada rule this earth under your protection.

shloka_text: सन्ततिश्च यथा दृष्टा कृत्यं यच्चापि साम्प्रतम्। राज्ञस्तत्क्रियतां सर्वमेष कालस्य निश्चयः4.21.10।।
transliteration: santatiśca yathā dṛṣṭā kṛtyaṃ yaccāpi sāmpratam| rājñastatkriyatāṃ sarvameṣa kālasya niścayaḥ4.21.10||
translation: सन्ततिः a son, यथा that way, दृष्टा after seeing, साम्प्रतम् presently, राज्ञः to king Vali, यत् all such thing, कृत्यं चापि and done, तत् that, सर्वम् all, क्रियताम् may be carried out, एषः this, कालस्य at this time, निश्चयः is the decision.
explanation: Let everything be done for the king that has been judged fit; this is the decision befitting the present time.

shloka_text: संस्कार्यो हरिराजश्च अङ्गदश्चाभिषिच्यताम्। सिंहासनगतं पुत्रं पश्यन्ती शान्तिमेष्यसि4.21.11।।
transliteration: saṃskāryo harirājaśca aṅgadaścābhiṣicyatām| siṃhāsanagataṃ putraṃ paśyantī śāntimeṣyasi4.21.11||
translation: हरिराजः king of monkeys, संस्कार्यः all rituals should be performed, अङ्गदश्च by Angada, अभिषिच्यताम् may be consecrated, सिंहासनगतम् seated on the throne, पुत्रम् son, पश्यन्ती while you are looking at him, शान्तिम् peace, एष्यसि you will attain.
explanation: 'Let all the rituals of the king of vanaras be performed. Let Angada be consecrated. You will attain peace of mind to see your son seated on the throne.'

shloka_text: सा तस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता। अब्रवीदुत्तरं तारा हनूमन्तमवस्थितम्4.21.12।।
transliteration: sā tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā bhartṛvyasanapīḍitā| abravīduttaraṃ tārā hanūmantamavasthitam4.21.12||
translation: भर्तृव्यसनपीडिता tormented by the husband's death, सा तारा that Tara, तस्य his, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अवस्थितम् waiting, हनूमन्तम् to Hanumanta, अवस्थितम् who was waiting, उत्तरम् reply, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: On hearing Hanuman's words, Tara, tormented by the death of her husband said to Hanuman who was waiting for her reply:

shloka_text: अङ्गदप्रतिरूपाणां पुत्राणामेकतश्शतम्। हतस्याप्यस्य वीरस्य गात्रसंश्लेषणं वरम्4.21.13।।
transliteration: aṅgadapratirūpāṇāṃ putrāṇāmekataśśatam| hatasyāpyasya vīrasya gātrasaṃśleṣaṇaṃ varam4.21.13||
translation: अङ्गदप्रतिरूपाणाम् of those who may be prototypes of Angada, पुत्राणाम् of sons, शतम् one hundred, एकतः on one side, हतस्यापि even if he is slayed, अस्य his, वीरस्य warrior's, गात्रसंश्लेषणम् embracing the body, वरम् is better.
explanation: 'To embrace even the deadbody of this hero is better than (to embrace) a hundred prototypes of Angada.

shloka_text: न चाहं हरिराजस्य प्रभवाम्यङ्गदस्य वा। पितृव्यस्तस्य सुग्रीवस्सर्वकार्येष्वनन्तरः4.21.14।।
transliteration: na cāhaṃ harirājasya prabhavāmyaṅgadasya vā| pitṛvyastasya sugrīvassarvakāryeṣvanantaraḥ4.21.14||
translation: अहम् I am, हरिराजस्य of the king of monkeys, अङ्गदस्य वा or about Angada, न प्रभवामि not the right, तस्य his, पितृव्यः father's brother, सर्वकार्येषु in all tasks, अनन्तरः herafter.
explanation: I have no authority over the monkey-king's affairs or over Angada; his paternal uncle Sugriva is the one to act in all matters hereafter.

shloka_text: न ह्येषाबुद्धिरास्थेया हनूमन्नङ्गदं प्रति। पिता हि बन्धुः पुत्रस्य न माता हरिसत्तम4.21.15।।
transliteration: na hyeṣābuddhirāstheyā hanūmannaṅgadaṃ prati| pitā hi bandhuḥ putrasya na mātā harisattama4.21.15||
translation: हनुमान् O Hanuman, अङ्गदं प्रति for Angada, एषा that way, बुद्धि: thought, न आस्थेयाः not to be entertained, हरिसत्तम best of monkeys, पुत्रस्य son's, पिता father, बन्धुः relation, माता mother, न none else.
explanation: 'O Hanuman the best of monkeys, you need not think about (the future of) Angada. A father plans for a son and not (even) the mother.

shloka_text: न हि मम हरिराजसंश्रयात् क्षमतरमस्ति परत्र चेह वा। अभिमुखहतवीरसेवितं शयनमिदं मम सेवितुं क्षमम्4.21.16।।
transliteration: na hi mama harirājasaṃśrayāt kṣamataramasti paratra ceha vā| abhimukhahatavīrasevitaṃ śayanamidaṃ mama sevituṃ kṣamam4.21.16||
translation: मम my, इह वा in this world or, परत्र वा or in the next world, हरिराजसंश्रयात् other than joining king of monkeys, क्षमतरम् a safer course, न अस्ति हि is not found, अभिमुखहतवीरसेवितम् used by this slain warrior in front of me, इदं this, शयनम् resting place, सेवितुम् to rest, मम for me, क्षमम् is fitting.
explanation: There is nothing more befitting for me than joining the king of monkeys either here or in the next world. It is proper for me to resort to this resting place (pyre) used by this slain hero in front of me. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकविंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the twentyfirst sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: वीक्षमाणस्तु मन्दासुस्सर्वतो मन्दमुच्छ्वसन्। आदावेव तु सुग्रीवं ददर्शत्वात्मजाग्रतः4.22.1।।
transliteration: vīkṣamāṇastu mandāsussarvato mandamucchvasan| ādāveva tu sugrīvaṃ dadarśatvātmajāgrataḥ4.22.1||
translation: मन्दासुः slowly, मन्दं feebly, उच्छ्वसन्  sighing, सर्वतः all over, वीक्षमाणः तु gazing all round, आदावेव at first instance, अग्रतः front, आत्मजः his own son, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Vali, gazing all around, breathing slowly and sighing feably beheld Sugriva at first instance, Sugriva who was standing in front of his own son.
comments: Vali repents -- asks Sugriva  to take care of Angada and Tara -- hands over his golden necklace to Sugriva -- exhorts Angada.

shloka_text: तं प्राप्तविजयं वाली सुग्रीवं प्लवगेश्वरः। आभाष्य व्यक्तया वाचा सस्नेहमिदमब्रवीत्4.22.2।।
transliteration: taṃ prāptavijayaṃ vālī sugrīvaṃ plavageśvaraḥ| ābhāṣya vyaktayā vācā sasnehamidamabravīt4.22.2||
translation: प्लवगेश्वरः lord of monkeys, वाली Vali, प्राप्तविजयम् had won a victory, तं सुग्रीवम् to that Sugriva, आभाष्य spoke, व्यक्तया addressing, वाचा words, सस्नेहम् with love, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Vali, the lord of monkeys, lovingly said to Sugriva, who had won a victory:

shloka_text: सुग्रीव दोषेण न मां गन्तुमर्हसि किल्बिषात्। कृष्यमाणं भविष्येण बुद्धिमोहेन मां बलात्4.22.3।।
transliteration: sugrīva doṣeṇa na māṃ gantumarhasi kilbiṣāt| kṛṣyamāṇaṃ bhaviṣyeṇa buddhimohena māṃ balāt4.22.3||
translation: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, माम् me, दोषेण by mistake, गन्तुम् exiling, न अर्हसि ought not to, किल्बिषात् due to mistake, भविष्येण in future, बुद्धिमोहेन by deluded, बलात् by force  माम् me, कृष्यमाणम् bound
explanation: 'O Sugriva you ought not to accuse me of exiling you, and wresting your wife. My mind was deluded by the force of fate that controls one's future.

shloka_text: युगपद्विहितं तात न मन्ये सुखमावयोः। सौहार्द भ्रातृयुक्तं हि तदिदं तात नान्यथा4.22.4।।
transliteration: yugapadvihitaṃ tāta na manye sukhamāvayoḥ| sauhārda bhrātṛyuktaṃ hi tadidaṃ tāta nānyathā4.22.4||
translation: तात O dear, आवयोः for both of us, सुखम् happiness, युगपत् at the same time, न मन्ये I also do not believe, भ्रातृयुक्तम् not right for brothers, तत् so, इदम् this, सौहार्दम् friendship between us, न अन्यथा not otherwise, जातम् is created.
explanation: 'O dear I believe that both of us are not destined to enjoy the love and happiness that come together to brothers.

shloka_text: प्रतिपद्य त्वमद्यैव राज्यमेषां वनौकसाम्। मामप्यद्यैव गच्छन्तं विद्धि वैवस्वतक्षयम्4.22.5।।
transliteration: pratipadya tvamadyaiva rājyameṣāṃ vanaukasām| māmapyadyaiva gacchantaṃ viddhi vaivasvatakṣayam4.22.5||
translation: त्वम् you, अद्यैव just now, एषाम् of these, वनौकसाम् forest dwellers, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रतिपद्य accept, मामपि me also, अद्यैव now, वैवस्वतक्षयम् the abode of Vivasvan, lord of the death, गच्छन्तम्  going, विद्धि know.
explanation: Accept this very day the kingdom of these forest-dwellers, and know that I too am departing this day to the abode of Yama, lord of death.

shloka_text: जीवितं च हि राज्यं च श्रियं च विपुलामिमाम्। प्रजहाम्येष वै तूर्णं महच्चागर्हितं यशः4.22.6।।
transliteration: jīvitaṃ ca hi rājyaṃ ca śriyaṃ ca vipulāmimām| prajahāmyeṣa vai tūrṇaṃ mahaccāgarhitaṃ yaśaḥ4.22.6||
translation: एषः अहम् thus I, जीवितं च life also, राज्यं च even kingdom, इमाम् this, विपुलाम् vast, श्रियं च and prosperity, अगर्हितम् untarnished, यशः च and fame, तूर्णम् soon, एषः here I am, प्रजहामि leaving.
explanation: 'I am leaving this world soon, along with this vast kingdom, prosperity and untarnished fame.

shloka_text: अस्यां त्वहमवस्थायां वीर वक्ष्यामि यद्वचः। यद्यप्यसुकरं राजन्कर्तुमेव तदर्हसि4.22.7
transliteration: asyāṃ tvahamavasthāyāṃ vīra vakṣyāmi yadvacaḥ| yadyapyasukaraṃ rājankartumeva tadarhasi4.22.7
translation: वीर O warrior, राजन् O king, अस्यां अवस्थायाम् at this stage, अहम् I, यत् those, वचः words, वक्ष्यामि speaking, असुकरं not easy to do, यद्यपि even though, कर्तुमेव only to carry out, त्वम् you, अर्हसि ought to.
explanation: 'O warrior king you should do whatever I request you at this hour even though it may not be easy.

shloka_text: सुखार्हं सुखसंवृद्धं बालमेनमबालिशम्। बाष्पपूर्णमुखं पश्य भूमौ पतितमङ्गदम्4.22.8।।
transliteration: sukhārhaṃ sukhasaṃvṛddhaṃ bālamenamabāliśam| bāṣpapūrṇamukhaṃ paśya bhūmau patitamaṅgadam4.22.8||
translation: सुखार्हम् who deserves happiness, सुखसंवृद्धम् raised with comfort, बालम् young boy, अबालिशम् youthful, बाष्पपूर्णमुखम् tearful face, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम्  fallen down, अङ्गदम् Angada, पश्य see.
explanation: 'Look at this young Angada fallen on the ground, face flooded with tears. Raised with comfort, he deserves to be kept happy.

shloka_text: मम प्राणैः प्रियतरं पुत्रं पुत्रमिवौरसम्। मया हीनमहीनार्थं पर्वतः परिपालय4.22.9।।
transliteration: mama prāṇaiḥ priyataraṃ putraṃ putramivaurasam| mayā hīnamahīnārthaṃ parvataḥ paripālaya4.22.9||
translation: मम my, प्राणैः more than life, प्रियतरम् dearer to me, मया by me, हीनम् separated, पुत्रम् son, औरसं पुत्रं इव like your own son, सर्वतः in all respects, अहीनार्थम् without being deprived of anything, परिपालय take care of him.
explanation: 'He is dearer to me than my life. Take care of him like your own son. He is separated from me. Take care of him in all respects, so that he is not deprived of anything.

shloka_text: त्वमेवास्य हि दाता च परित्राता च सर्वशः। भयेष्वभयदश्चैव यथाऽहं प्लवगेश्वर।।4.22.10।।
transliteration: tvamevāsya hi dātā ca paritrātā ca sarvaśaḥ| bhayeṣvabhayadaścaiva yathā'haṃ plavageśvara
translation: प्लवगेश्वर O lord of monkeys, अहम् I, यथा as I am, त्वमेव you alone, अस्य his, (पिता father), दाता provider, सर्वशः of everything, परित्राता च and saviour, भयेषु in danger, अभयदश्चैव protector.
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys from now on, you alone will be his father, provider of everything, saviour and protector in danger.

shloka_text: एष तारात्मज श्रीमांस्त्वया तुल्यपराक्रमः। रक्षसां च वधे तेषामग्रतस्ते भविष्यति4.22.11।।
transliteration: eṣa tārātmaja śrīmāṃstvayā tulyaparākramaḥ| rakṣasāṃ ca vadhe teṣāmagrataste bhaviṣyati4.22.11||
translation: श्रीमान् prosperous, त्वया to you, तुल्यपराक्रमः equal in valour, एषः this, तारात्मजः son of Tara, तेषाम् their, रक्षसाम् demons, वधे crush, ते to you, अग्रतः on the forefront, भविष्यति will remain.
explanation: 'This prosperous son of Tara, your equal in valour, will remain with you in the forefront to crush demons.

shloka_text: अनुरूपाणि कर्माणि विक्रम्य बलवान्रणे। करिष्यत्येष तारेयस्तरस्वी तरुणोऽङ्गदः4.22.12।।
transliteration: anurūpāṇi karmāṇi vikramya balavānraṇe| kariṣyatyeṣa tāreyastarasvī taruṇo'ṅgadaḥ4.22.12||
translation: बलवान् strong, तारेयः of Tara's, तरस्वी fast, तरुणः young, एषः अङ्गदः this Angada, रणे in war, विक्रम्य strike, अनुरूपाणि fitting , कर्माणि deeds, करिष्यति will do.
explanation: 'This mighty hero Angada, son of Tara, is young and dynamic. He will strike (the enemy) in a fitting manner in war.

shloka_text: सुषेणदुहिता चेयमर्थसूक्ष्मविमनिश्चये। औत्पातिके च विविधे सर्वतः परिनिष्ठिता4.22.13।।
transliteration: suṣeṇaduhitā ceyamarthasūkṣmavimaniścaye| autpātike ca vividhe sarvataḥ pariniṣṭhitā4.22.13||
translation: सुषेणदुहिता daughter of Sushena, इयं च and she also , अर्थसूक्ष्मविनिश्चये in disecerning subtle matters, विविधे various, औत्पातिके च and in foreseeing events that come up suddenly, सर्वतःall over, परिनिष्ठिता very efficient( in crisis management),
explanation: 'Tara, daughter of Sushena, is wise and efficient in discerning subtle matters and in foreseeing unexpected events.

shloka_text: यदेषा साध्विति ब्रूयात्कार्यं तन्मुक्तसंशयम्। न हि तारामतं किञ्चिदन्यथा परिवर्तते4.22.14।।
transliteration: yadeṣā sādhviti brūyātkāryaṃ tanmuktasaṃśayam| na hi tārāmataṃ kiñcidanyathā parivartate4.22.14||
translation: एषा she, यत् whatever, साधु इति treat it to be right, ब्रूयात् speak, तत् that, मुक्तसंशयम् without any doubt, कार्यम् work, तारामतम् her opinion, किञ्चत् even a little, अन्यथा otherwise, न परिवर्तते हि does not change.
explanation: 'Tara's opinion is never wrong. It does not change. Whatever she speaks is right and should be carried out without any doubt.

shloka_text: राघवस्य च ते कार्यं कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया। स्यादधर्मो ह्यकरणे त्वां च हिंस्याद्विमानितः4.22.15।।
transliteration: rāghavasya ca te kāryaṃ kartavyamaviśaṅkayā| syādadharmo hyakaraṇe tvāṃ ca hiṃsyādvimānitaḥ4.22.15||
translation: राघवस्य Rama's, कार्यं च work also, ते to you, अविशङ्कया without hesitation, कर्तव्यम्   duty, अकरणे not do, अधर्मः unrighteousness, स्यात् हि will be, अमानितः disobeyed, त्वाम् you, हिंस्यात् च will hurt.
explanation: 'You ought to carry out Rama's work without hesitation. If you do not, it will be unrighteous and harmful.

shloka_text: इमां च मालामाधत्स्व दिव्यां सुग्रीव काञ्चनीम्। उदारा श्रीस्थिता ह्यास्यां सम्प्रजह्यान्मृते मयि4.22.16।।
transliteration: imāṃ ca mālāmādhatsva divyāṃ sugrīva kāñcanīm| udārā śrīsthitā hyāsyāṃ samprajahyānmṛte mayi4.22.16||
