shloka_text: तमप्रतिहतं क्रुद्धं प्रविष्टं पुरुषर्षभम्। सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणं दृष्ट्वा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः।।4.34.1।।
transliteration: tamapratihataṃ kruddhaṃ praviṣṭaṃ puruṣarṣabham| sugrīvo lakṣmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā babhūva vyathitendriyaḥ
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अप्रतिहतम् who could not be obstructed, प्रविष्टम्  entered, क्रुद्धम् angry one, पुरुषर्षभम् a bull among men, तं him, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्ट्वा  seeing, व्यथितेन्द्रियः  senses depressed, बभूव became.
explanation: On seeing the angry Lakshmana, a bull among men, who could not be obstructed,  enter in,  Sugriva was disturbed.
comments: Lakshmana meets Sugriva -- reminds him of his promise to Rama.

shloka_text: क्रुद्धं निश्श्वसमानं तं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तं दृष्ट्वा दशरथात्मजम्।।4.34.2।। उत्पपात हरिश्रेष्ठो हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम्। महान्महेन्द्रस्य यथा स्वलङ्कृत इव ध्वजः।।4.34.3।।
transliteration: kruddhaṃ niśśvasamānaṃ taṃ pradīptamiva tejasā| bhrāturvyasanasantaptaṃ dṛṣṭvā daśarathātmajam utpapāta hariśreṣṭho hitvā sauvarṇamāsanam| mahānmahendrasya yathā svalaṅkṛta iva dhvajaḥ
translation: क्रुद्धम् enraged, निश्श्वसमानम्  sighing heavily, तेजसा lustrous, प्रदीप्तमिव as if glowing, भ्रातुः brother's, व्यसनसन्तप्तम् burning with sorrow, तम् him, दशरथात्मजम् son of Dasaratha, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, हरिश्रेष्ठ: best of vanaras, सौवर्णम् golden, आसनम् seat, हित्वा quitting, महेन्द्रस्य Mahendra's, ध्वजः  banner, स्वलङ्कृतः decorated, महान् great, इव like,  उत्पपात jumped up.
explanation: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, son of Dasaratha, sighing heavily, glowing like bright fire burning with the sorrow of Rama, Sugriva jumped out of his seat quitting the decorated golden throne just as Indra's decorated banner is raised up suddenly.

shloka_text: क्रुद्धं निश्श्वसमानं तं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। भ्रातुर्व्यसनसन्तप्तं दृष्ट्वा दशरथात्मजम्।।4.34.2।। उत्पपात हरिश्रेष्ठो हित्वा सौवर्णमासनम्। महान्महेन्द्रस्य यथा स्वलङ्कृत इव ध्वजः।।4.34.3।।
transliteration: kruddhaṃ niśśvasamānaṃ taṃ pradīptamiva tejasā| bhrāturvyasanasantaptaṃ dṛṣṭvā daśarathātmajam utpapāta hariśreṣṭho hitvā sauvarṇamāsanam| mahānmahendrasya yathā svalaṅkṛta iva dhvajaḥ
translation: क्रुद्धम् enraged, निश्श्वसमानम्  sighing heavily, तेजसा lustrous, प्रदीप्तमिव as if glowing, भ्रातुः brother's, व्यसनसन्तप्तम् burning with sorrow, तम् him, दशरथात्मजम् son of Dasaratha, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, हरिश्रेष्ठ: best of vanaras, सौवर्णम् golden, आसनम् seat, हित्वा quitting, महेन्द्रस्य Mahendra's, ध्वजः  banner, स्वलङ्कृतः decorated, महान् great, इव like,  उत्पपात jumped up.
explanation: Seeing enraged Lakshmana, son of Dasaratha, sighing heavily, glowing like bright fire burning with the sorrow of Rama, Sugriva jumped out of his seat quitting the decorated golden throne just as Indra's decorated banner is raised up suddenly.

shloka_text: उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतू रुमाप्रभृतयः स्त्रियः। सुग्रीवं गगने पूर्णचन्द्रं तारागणा इव।।4.34.4।।
transliteration: utpatantamanūtpetū rumāprabhṛtayaḥ striyaḥ| sugrīvaṃ gagane pūrṇacandraṃ tārāgaṇā iva
translation: रुमाप्रभृतयः Ruma and others, स्त्रियः women, उत्पतन्तम्  jumped up, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, गगने in the sky, पूर्णम् full, चन्द्रम् Moon, तारागणा cluster of stars, इव like, अनूत्पेतु: jumped up.
explanation: As soon as Sugriva jumped up ,Ruma and other womenfolk rose to their feet like the clusters of stars around the fullMoon in the sky.

shloka_text: संरक्तनयनः श्रीमान्विचचाल कृताञ्जलिः। बभूवावस्थितस्तत्र कल्पवृक्षो महानिव।।4.34.5।।
transliteration: saṃraktanayanaḥ śrīmānvicacāla kṛtāñjaliḥ| babhūvāvasthitastatra kalpavṛkṣo mahāniva
translation: संरक्तनयनः redeyed, श्रीमान् prosperous, कृताञ्जलिः offered salutations with folded palms, विचचाल was shaken, महान् great, कल्पवृक्षः इव like the Kalpa tree, तत्र there, अवस्थितः stood, बभूव became.
explanation: With eyes red as blood through drunkenness,prosperous Sugriva was shaken like the Kalpa tree.He stood there and offered salutations(to Lakshmana) with folded hands.

shloka_text: रुमाद्वितीयं सुग्रीवं नारीमध्यगतं स्थितम्। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणः क्रुद्धस्सतारं शशिनं यथा।।4.34.6।।
transliteration: rumādvitīyaṃ sugrīvaṃ nārīmadhyagataṃ sthitam| abravīllakṣmaṇaḥ kruddhassatāraṃ śaśinaṃ yathā
translation: सतारम् surrounded by stars, शशिनं यथा like the Moon, रुमाद्वितीयम् along with Ruma, नारीमध्यगतम् surrounded by women, स्थितम् who stood, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, क्रुद्धः infuriated, लक्ष्मणः to Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Looking at Sugriva surrounded by Ruma and other women like the Moon among stars, infuriated Lakshmana said

shloka_text: सत्त्वाभिजनसम्पन्नस्सानुक्रोशो जितेन्द्रियः। कृतज्ञस्सत्यवादी च राजा लोके महीयते।।4.34.7।।
transliteration: sattvābhijanasampannassānukrośo jitendriyaḥ| kṛtajñassatyavādī ca rājā loke mahīyate
translation: सत्त्वाभिजनसम्पन्नः heir of a noble clan, सानुक्रोशः compassionate, जितेन्द्रियः one who has controlled his senses, कृतज्ञः grateful person, सत्यवादी च one who is truthful, राजा king, लोके in the world, महीयते will excel.
explanation: 'Only a king who is an heir to a noble family, compassionate, and selfcontrolled, grateful and truthful excels in the world.

shloka_text: यस्तु राजा स्थितोऽधर्मे मित्राणामुपकारिणाम्। मिथ्या प्रतिज्ञां कुरुते को नृशंसतरस्ततः।।4.34.8।।
transliteration: yastu rājā sthito'dharme mitrāṇāmupakāriṇām| mithyā pratijñāṃ kurute ko nṛśaṃsatarastataḥ
translation: यः whoever, राजा a king, अधर्मे in unrighteous path, स्थितः adopts, उपकारिणाम् to his benefactors, मिथ्या false, प्रतिज्ञाम् promise, कुरुते makes, ततः then, नृशंसतरः more malicious, कः what
explanation: 'Which king can be more malicious than the one who makes false promises and adopts an unrighteous path towards those who helped him?

shloka_text: शतमश्वानृते हन्ति सहस्रं तु गवानृते। आत्मानं स्वजनं हन्ति पुरुषः पुरुषानृते।।4.34.9।।
transliteration: śatamaśvānṛte hanti sahasraṃ tu gavānṛte| ātmānaṃ svajanaṃ hanti puruṣaḥ puruṣānṛte
translation: पुरुषः  man, अश्वानृते tells a lie about a horse, शतम् hundred, हन्ति kills, गवानृते tells a lie about a cow, सहस्रम् thousand, पुरुषानृते a lie about a man, आत्मानम् himself, स्वजनम् his own people, हन्ति kills.
explanation: 'If a man tells a lie about a horse, he commits the sin of killing a hundred horses. If one tells a lie about a cow, he shares the sin of killing a thousand cows. If one tells a lie about a man, it is equal to the sin of killing oneself and his own people.

shloka_text: पूर्वं कृतार्थो मित्राणां न तत्प्रतिकरोति यः। कृतघ्नस्सर्वभूतानां स वध्यः प्लवगेश्वर।।4.34.10।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃ kṛtārtho mitrāṇāṃ na tatpratikaroti yaḥ| kṛtaghnassarvabhūtānāṃ sa vadhyaḥ plavageśvara
translation: प्लगेश्वर O lord of monkeys, पूर्वम् first, कृतार्थः is fulfilled, यः whoever, मित्राणाम् to the friends, तत् that, प्रतिकरोति does not help in turn, कृतघ्नः an ungrateful one, सः he, सर्वभूतानाम् to all beings, वध्यः deserves to be killed.
explanation: 'O lord of monkeys he who, having accomplished his task first with the help of his friend, does not return the help is ungrateful. Such a person deserves to be killed.It applies to all beings.

shloka_text: गीतोऽयं ब्रह्मणा श्लोक स्सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। दृष्ट्वा कृतघ्नं क्रुद्धेन तन्निबोध प्लवङ्गम।।4.34.11।।
transliteration: gīto'yaṃ brahmaṇā śloka ssarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ| dṛṣṭvā kṛtaghnaṃ kruddhena tannibodha plavaṅgama
translation: प्लवङ्गम O lord of the monkeys, कृतघ्नम्  an ungrateful one, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, क्रुद्धेन by an outraged, ब्रह्मणा by a brahmin, सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः revered by all the worlds, अयम् this, श्लोकः verse, गीतः is sung, तत् that, निबोध listen.
explanation: 'O lord of the monkeys here is a verse worthy of appreciation by all the worlds, sung by a brahmin, when he saw an ungrateful person. Listen:

shloka_text: ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चोरे भग्नव्रते तथा। निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भि: कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः।।4.34.12।।
transliteration: brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā| niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhi: kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
translation: ब्रह्मघ्ने one who kills a brahmin, सुरापे च and a drunkard, चोरे by thieves, तथा similarly, भग्नव्रते one who violates sacred vows, सद्भि: pious men, निष्कृतिः expiation, विहिता is provided, कृतघ्ने for an ungrateful one, निष्कृतिः such an atonement, नास्ति not there.
explanation: 'There is expiation for one who kills a brahmin, a drunkard, a thief and a violator of sacred vows. But there is no atonement for an ungrateful man.'

shloka_text: अनार्यस्त्वं कृतघ्नश्च मिथ्यावादी च वानर। पूर्वं कृतार्थो रामस्य न तत्प्रतिकरोषि यत्।।4.34.13।।
transliteration: anāryastvaṃ kṛtaghnaśca mithyāvādī ca vānara| pūrvaṃ kṛtārtho rāmasya na tatpratikaroṣi yat
translation: वानर O monkey, पूर्वम् in the past, कृतार्थः one whose object is achieved, त्वम् you, यत् since, रामस्य Rama's, न प्रतिकरोषि not helped in return, तत् that, अनार्यः ignoble one, कृतघ्नश्च ungrateful, मिथ्यावादी च one who is a liar, ननु you are surely.
explanation: 'O monkey you have already achieved your objective (with the help of Rama) but have not helped Rama in return. You are surely an ignoble and ungrateful liar.

shloka_text: ननु नाम कृतार्थेन त्वया रामस्य वानर। सीताया मार्गणे यत्नः कर्तव्यः कृतमिच्छता।।4.34.14।।
transliteration: nanu nāma kṛtārthena tvayā rāmasya vānara| sītāyā mārgaṇe yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ kṛtamicchatā
translation: वानर monkey, कृतार्थेन by a grateful one, रामस्य Rama's, कृतम् task, इच्छता intending, त्वया by you, सीतायाः Sita's, मार्ग in search, यत्नः attempt, ननु नाम कर्तव्यः it should be taken up indeed.
explanation: 'O monkey, if you are grateful to Rama you should wish to search for Sita. Indeed, you should make efforts to take it up.

shloka_text: स त्वं ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु सक्तो मिथ्याप्रतिश्रवः। न त्वां रामो विजानीते सर्पं मण्डूकराविणम्।।4.34.15।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu sakto mithyāpratiśravaḥ| na tvāṃ rāmo vijānīte sarpaṃ maṇḍūkarāviṇam
translation: मिथ्याप्रतिश्रवः who has made false promises, सः he, त्वम् you, ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु worldy pleasures, सक्तः engaged in, रामः Rama, त्वाम् you, मण्डूकराविणम् croaking like a frog, सर्पम् serpent, न विजानीते did not identify.
explanation: 'You have failed to keep your word. You are engaged in worldly pleasures. Rama did not know that you are a serpent croaking like a frog.

shloka_text: महाभागेन रामेण पापः करुणवेदिना। हरीणां प्रापितो राज्यं त्वं दुरात्मा महात्मना।।4.34.16।।
transliteration: mahābhāgena rāmeṇa pāpaḥ karuṇavedinā| harīṇāṃ prāpito rājyaṃ tvaṃ durātmā mahātmanā
translation: महाभागेन by the illustrious, महात्मना by the great self, करुणवेदिना by the compassionate, रामेण by Rama, पापः sinner, दुरात्मा evilminded, त्वम् you, हरीणाम् monkeys', राज्यम् kingdom, प्रापितः granted.
explanation: 'Rama is illustrious, compassionate and great. He has granted the kingdom to you, to one who is a sinner and an evilminded person.

shloka_text: कृतं चेन्नाभिजानीषे रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः। सद्यस्त्वं निशितैर्भावार्हतो द्रक्ष्यसि वालिनम्।।4.34.17।।
transliteration: kṛtaṃ cennābhijānīṣe rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ| sadyastvaṃ niśitairbhāvārhato drakṣyasi vālinam
translation: त्वम् you, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः of a man who accomplishes a task with ease, रामस्य of Rama, कृतम् help, नाभिजानीषे यदि if you did not recognise, सद्यः presently, निशितैः by sharp ones, बाणैः with arrows, हतः kill, वालिनम् to Vali, द्रक्ष्यसे you may see.
explanation: 'If you do not recognise  the help of Rama who can accomplish any deed with ease, you will be killed with my sharp arrows and meet Vali (in heaven).

shloka_text: न च सङ्कुचितः पन्था येन वाली हतो गतः। समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा वालिपथमन्वगाः।।4.34.18।।
transliteration: na ca saṅkucitaḥ panthā yena vālī hato gataḥ| samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā vālipathamanvagāḥ
translation: सुग्रीव O Sugriva, समये by agreement, तिष्ठ stand by, हतः killed, वाली Vali, येन by whichever path, गतः gone, पन्थाः path, न च सङ्कुचितः is not a narrow one, वालिपथम् the path of Vali, मा अन्वगाः do not follow him.
explanation: 'O Sugriva the path by which Vali went is not closed.I wish you do not follow him. You stand by the promise made.

shloka_text: न नूनमिक्ष्वाकुवरस्य कार्मुक च्युतान् शरान्पश्यसि वज्र सन्निभान्। तत स्सुखं नाम निषेवसे सुखी। न रामकार्यं मनसाऽप्यवेक्षसे।।4.34.19।।
transliteration: na nūnamikṣvākuvarasya kārmuka cyutān śarānpaśyasi vajra sannibhān| tata ssukhaṃ nāma niṣevase sukhī| na rāmakāryaṃ manasā'pyavekṣase
translation: नूनम् surely, इक्ष्वाकुवरस्य of the renowned among the Ikshvaku race, कार्मुक bow, वज्रसन्निभान् comparable to a thunderbolt, च्युतान् released, शरान् arrows, न पश्यसि you do not see, ततः then, सुखी without fear, सुखम् a happy, निषेवसे नाम you are resorting to, मनसापि even in your mind, रामकार्यम् Rama's work, न अवेक्षसे  not thinking.
explanation: 'You have not seen the thunderboltlike arrows released from the bow of Rama, the renowned prince of the Ikshvaku race. Therefore you are resorting to enjoyment without any fear and have not given thought to Rama's work.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे चतुस्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfourth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तथा ब्रुवाणं सौमित्रिं प्रदीप्तमिव तेजसा। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं तारा ताराधिपनिभानना।।4.35.1।।
transliteration: tathā bruvāṇaṃ saumitriṃ pradīptamiva tejasā| abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ tārā tārādhipanibhānanā
translation: तथा that way, ब्रुवाणम् when he spoke, तेजसा with brilliance, प्रदीप्तमिव as if glowing, सौमित्रिम् to Saumitri, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, ताराधिपनिभानना a lady with a Moonlike face, तारा Tara, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: While Lakshmana, the son of Sumitra, was glowing like fire with his brilliance, thus spoke the moonfaced Tara:
comments: Tara consoles Lakshmana -- gives reasons for the delay in action -- Tara's request pacifies Lakshmana -- Sugriva commands the army.

shloka_text: नैवं लक्ष्मण वक्तव्यो नायं परुषमर्हति। हरीणामीश्वरश्श्रोतुं तव वक्त्राद्विशेषतः।।4.35.2।।
transliteration: naivaṃ lakṣmaṇa vaktavyo nāyaṃ paruṣamarhati| harīṇāmīśvaraśśrotuṃ tava vaktrādviśeṣataḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, अयम् this, हरीणामीश्वरः king of vanaras, एवम् in that way, न वक्तव्यः not speak, विशेषतः specially, तव your, वक्त्रात् your words, परुषम् harsh, श्रोतुम् to listen, नार्हति not deserve.
explanation: 'O Lakshmana you, in particular, should not speak to the king of vanaras in that manner. He does not deserve to hear from your mouth words which are harsh.

shloka_text: नैवाकृतज्ञस्सुग्रीवो न शठो नापि दारुणः। नैवानृतकथो वीर न जिह्मश्च कपीश्वरः।।4.35.3।।
transliteration: naivākṛtajñassugrīvo na śaṭho nāpi dāruṇaḥ| naivānṛtakatho vīra na jihmaśca kapīśvaraḥ
translation: वीर O hero, कपीश्वरः king of monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अकृतज्ञः ungrateful, न not, शठः deceitful, न not, अपि even, न not, अनृतकथः one who tells a lie, नैव nor, जिह्मः च and crooked, न not.
explanation: 'O hero Sugriva, king of monkeys, is not ungrateful or deceitful, He is neither crooked nor false.

shloka_text: उपकारं कृतं वीरो नाप्ययं विस्मृतः कपिः। रामेण वीर सुग्रीवो यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे।।4.35.4।।
transliteration: upakāraṃ kṛtaṃ vīro nāpyayaṃ vismṛtaḥ kapiḥ| rāmeṇa vīra sugrīvo yadanyairduṣkaraṃ raṇe
translation: वीर hero, कपिः monkey, अयं सुग्रीवः this Sugriva, रणे in war, यत् such, अन्यै: by others, दुष्करम् difficult, रामेण by Rama, कृतम् has been done, उपकारम् help, न विस्मृतः अपि and not forget.
explanation: 'O hero this warrior Sugriva has not forgotten the help rendered by Rama in combat which was difficult (to win).

shloka_text: रामप्रसादात्कीर्तिञ्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। प्राप्तवानिह सुग्रीवो रुमां मां च परन्तप ।।4.35.5।।
transliteration: rāmaprasādātkīrtiñca kapirājyaṃ ca śāśvatam| prāptavāniha sugrīvo rumāṃ māṃ ca parantapa
translation: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, इह now, रामप्रसादात् by Rama's grace, कीर्तिं च fame and, शाश्वतम् permanent, कपिराज्यं च kingdom of monkeys, रुमाम् Ruma, मां च and me, प्राप्तवान् attained.
explanation: 'O scorcher of enemies it is by Rama's grace that Sugriva has attained fame, the kingdom of monkeys and Ruma and me.

shloka_text: सुदुःखं शयितः पूर्वं प्राप्येदं सुखमुत्तमम्। प्राप्तकालं न जानीते विश्वामित्रो यथा मुनिः।।4.35.6।।
transliteration: suduḥkhaṃ śayitaḥ pūrvaṃ prāpyedaṃ sukhamuttamam| prāptakālaṃ na jānīte viśvāmitro yathā muniḥ
translation: पूर्वम् earlier, सुदुःखं शयितः sleeping unhappily, उत्तमम् best, इदम् this, सुखम् happiness, प्राप्य having obtained, विश्वामित्रः Visvamitra, मुनिः यथा like the sage, प्राप्तकालम् time to attend to his duty, न जानीते I did not know.
explanation: 'Sleep did not come to him in deep distress in the past, and now that great happiness has come, he does not realize that it is time to act (search for Sita). He behaves like sage Viswamitra.

shloka_text: घृताच्यां किल संसक्तो दशवर्षाणि लक्ष्मण। अहोऽमन्यत धर्मात्मा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः।।4.35.7।।
transliteration: ghṛtācyāṃ kila saṃsakto daśavarṣāṇi lakṣmaṇa| aho'manyata dharmātmā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, धर्मात्मा great self, महामुनिः great sage, विश्वामित्रः Visvamitra, दश ten, वर्षाणि years, घृताच्याम् with an apsara Gritachi, संसक्तः in union, अह one day, अमन्यत thought, किल indeed.
explanation: 'O Lakshmana great sage Visvamitra was in union with an apsara Gritachi for ten years and felt it was just one day indeed

shloka_text: स हि प्राप्तं न जानीते कालं कालविदां वरः। विश्वामित्रो महातेजाः किं पुनर्यः पृथग्जनः।।4.35.8।।
transliteration: sa hi prāptaṃ na jānīte kālaṃ kālavidāṃ varaḥ| viśvāmitro mahātejāḥ kiṃ punaryaḥ pṛthagjanaḥ
translation: कालविदाम् वरः a distinguished person among those who know the value of time, महातेजाः brilliant, सः that, विश्वामित्रः Visvamitra, प्राप्त कालम् right time, न जानीते did not know, यः he who, पृथग्जनः ordinary man, किं पुनः what else.
explanation: 'If the brilliant and the most distinguished of those who knew the value of time did not realise the passing of time, what can be said of an ordinary person?

shloka_text: देहधर्मं गतस्यास्य परिश्रान्तस्य लक्ष्मण। अवितृप्तस्य कामेषु कामं क्षन्तुमिहार्हसि।।4.35.9।।
transliteration: dehadharmaṃ gatasyāsya pariśrāntasya lakṣmaṇa| avitṛptasya kāmeṣu kāmaṃ kṣantumihārhasi
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, देहधर्मं गतस्य  attending to physical needs, परिश्रान्तस्य tired person, कामेषु in lust, अवितृप्तस्य finding no satisfaction, अस्य his, कामम् love, इह now, क्षन्तुम् to pardon, अर्हसि should.
explanation: 'O Lakshmana you should pardon him since he is not yet satisfied, though tired, with the struggle for the fulfilment of his sensual pleasures.

shloka_text: न च रोषवशं तात गन्तुमर्हसि लक्ष्मण। निश्चयार्थमविज्ञाय सहसा प्राकृतो यथा।।4.35.10।।
transliteration: na ca roṣavaśaṃ tāta gantumarhasi lakṣmaṇa| niścayārthamavijñāya sahasā prākṛto yathā
translation: तात O dear, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, निश्चयार्थम् true meaning, अविज्ञाय not knowing, प्राकृतो यथा like an ordinary man, सहसा rashly, रोषवशम् being angry, गन्तुम् to be, न अर्हसि is not proper.
explanation: 'O dear Lakshmana not knowing the true intention of Sugriva, it is not proper for you to be rashly angry like an ordinary man.

shloka_text: सत्त्वयुक्ता हि पुरुषास्त्वद्विधाः पुरुषर्षभ। अविमृश्य न रोषस्य सहसा यान्ति वश्यताम्।।4.35.11।।
transliteration: sattvayuktā hi puruṣāstvadvidhāḥ puruṣarṣabha| avimṛśya na roṣasya sahasā yānti vaśyatām
translation: पुरुषर्षभ O bull among men, सत्त्वयुक्ताः people with right vision, त्वद्विधाः people like you, पुरुषाः men, अविमृश्य not thinking rightly, सहसा rashly, रोषस्य of anger, वश्यताम् to become, न यान्ति do not get.
explanation: 'O bull among men men with right vision like you do not become angry instantly without right thinking.

shloka_text: प्रसादये त्वां धर्मज्ञ सुग्रीवार्थे समाहिता। महान्रोषसमुत्पन्न स्संरम्भस्त्यज्यतामयम्।।4.35.12।।
transliteration: prasādaye tvāṃ dharmajña sugrīvārthe samāhitā| mahānroṣasamutpanna ssaṃrambhastyajyatāmayam
translation: धर्मज्ञ knower of righteousness, समाहिता a wellcomposed woman, सुग्रीवार्थे for the sake of Sugriva, त्वाम् you, प्रसादये I appease you, रोषसमुत्पन्नः arising out of this anger, महान् great, अयम् this, संरम्भः agitation, त्यज्यताम् give up.
explanation: 'O Lakshmana, knower of dharma, give up your agitation arising out of great anger. Be composed for the sake of Sugriva.

shloka_text: रुमां मां कपि राज्यं च धनधान्यवसूनि च। रामप्रियार्थं सुग्रीवस्त्यजेदिति मतिर्मम।।4.35.13।।
transliteration: rumāṃ māṃ kapi rājyaṃ ca dhanadhānyavasūni ca| rāmapriyārthaṃ sugrīvastyajediti matirmama
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामप्रियार्थम् for Rama's pleasure, रुमाम् Ruma, मां me, कपिराज्यम् monkey kingdom, धनधान्यवसूनि च wealth, grain and other treasures, त्यजेत् will renounce, इति this is, मम my, मतिः feeling in mind.
explanation: 'I feel Sugriva should (is prepared to) renounce the monkeykingdom, wealth, grains and other treasures and even Ruma and me for the pleasure of Rama.

shloka_text: समानेष्यति सुग्रीव स्सीतया सह राघवम्। शशाङ्कमिव रोहिण्या निहत्वा रावणं रणे।।4.35.14।।
transliteration: samāneṣyati sugrīva ssītayā saha rāghavam| śaśāṅkamiva rohiṇyā nihatvā rāvaṇaṃ raṇe
translation: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रणे in war, हत्वा having killed, रावणं Ravana, शशाङ्कम् the Moon, रोहिण्या इव like with Rohini, राघवम् Rama, सीतया सह with Sita, समानेष्यति will make them meet.
explanation: 'Killing Ravana in war, Sugriva will restore Sita soon to Rama.Rama will join Sita like Moon joins Rohini.

shloka_text: शतकोटिसहस्राणि लङ्कायां किल राक्षसाः। आयुतानि च षट्त्रिंशत्सहस्राणि शतानि च।।4.35.15।।
transliteration: śatakoṭisahasrāṇi laṅkāyāṃ kila rākṣasāḥ| āyutāni ca ṣaṭtriṃśatsahasrāṇi śatāni ca
translation: लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, राक्षसाः demons, शतकोटिसहस्राणि a hundred thousand crores,   षट्त्रिंशत् thirtysix times, आयुतानि च ten thousandmyriads, सहस्राणि thousands, शतानि च  and hundreds.
explanation: 'The number of demons in Lanka is reported to be a hundred thousand crore, three lakh, ninetynine thousand and six hundred. (Note: Indian tradition has numbers up to eighteen digits. One hundred thousand crores is equal to a 'mahapadma' which has thirteen digits. The number described here is 1000000399600.)

shloka_text: अहत्वा तांश्च दुर्धर्षान्राक्षसान्कामरूपिणः। न शक्यो रावणो हन्तुं येन सा मैथिली हृता।।4.35.16।।
transliteration: ahatvā tāṃśca durdharṣānrākṣasānkāmarūpiṇaḥ| na śakyo rāvaṇo hantuṃ yena sā maithilī hṛtā
translation: दुर्धर्षान् unassailable, कामरूपिणः who can assume any form at will, तान् them, राक्षसान् demons, अहत्वा without killing, येन by whomsoever, सा she, मैथिली Maithili, हृता stolen, रावण: Ravana, हन्तुम् to kill, न शक्यः not possible.
explanation: 'It is not possible to kill Ravana who has stolen Sita without killing those unassailable demons who can assume any form at their will.

shloka_text: ते न शक्या रणे हन्तुमसहायेन लक्ष्मण। रावणः क्रूरकर्मा च सुग्रीवेण विशेषतः।।4.35.17।।
transliteration: te na śakyā raṇe hantumasahāyena lakṣmaṇa| rāvaṇaḥ krūrakarmā ca sugrīveṇa viśeṣataḥ
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, ते those, क्रूरकर्मा evildoer, रावणः Ravana, असहायेन without any help, रणे in war, हन्तुम् to kill, न शक्याः not possible, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, विशेषतः specially.
explanation: 'O Lakshmana moreover it is not possible for Sugriva alone to kill the wicked Ravana without the help of the monkeys.

shloka_text: एवमाख्यातवान्वाली स ह्यभिज्ञो हरीश्वरः। आगमस्तु न मे व्यक्तश्श्रवात्तस्माद्ब्रवीम्यहम्।।4.35.18।।
transliteration: evamākhyātavānvālī sa hyabhijño harīśvaraḥ| āgamastu na me vyaktaśśravāttasmādbravīmyaham
translation: वाली Vali, एवम् in that way, आख्यातवान् gave an account, सः that, हरीश्वरः lord of monkeys, अभिज्ञः हि a well informed person, आगमः source, मे to myself, न व्यक्तः not known, तस्मात् therefore, श्रवात् from what is heard, अहम् I, ब्रवीमि I am speaking.
explanation: Vali, the wellinformed lord of the monkeys, has given an account of the demons. The source of the account is not known to me.Therefore I am speaking from what I have heard.

shloka_text: त्वत्सहायनिमित्तं वै प्रेषिता हरिपुङ्गवाः। आनेतुं वानरान्युद्धे सुबहून्हरियूधपान्।।4.35.19।।
transliteration: tvatsahāyanimittaṃ vai preṣitā haripuṅgavāḥ| ānetuṃ vānarānyuddhe subahūnhariyūdhapān
translation: तत् then, युद्धे in war, त्वत् सहायनिमित्तम् for helping you, हरियूधपान् troops of monkeys, सुबहून् in multitudes, वानरान् monkeys, आनेतुम् to bring, हरिपुङ्गवाः leaders of monkeys, प्रेषिताः sent.
explanation: 'Monkey chiefs have been sent to bring multitudes of monkey leaders to help you in the battle.

shloka_text: तांश्च प्रतीक्षमाणोऽयं विक्रान्तात्सुमहाबलान्। राघवस्यार्थसिध्यर्थं न निर्याति हरीश्वरः।।4.35.20।।
transliteration: tāṃśca pratīkṣamāṇo'yaṃ vikrāntātsumahābalān| rāghavasyārthasidhyarthaṃ na niryāti harīśvaraḥ
translation: विक्रान्तां powerful, अयम् this, हरीश्वरः Sugriva, महाबलान् strong, तान् them, राघवस्य for Rama's, अर्थसिध्यर्थम् to accomplish his task, प्रतीक्षमाणः awaiting, न निर्याति not yet started.
explanation: 'Sugriva is awaiting the arrival of the powerful and strong vanaras without whose help he cannot accomplish Rama's task.Therefore he has not yet started (the search).

shloka_text: कृता तु संस्था सौमित्रे सुग्रीवेण पुरा यथा। अद्य तैर्वानरैस्सर्वैरागन्तव्यं महाबलैः।।4.35.21।।
transliteration: kṛtā tu saṃsthā saumitre sugrīveṇa purā yathā| adya tairvānaraissarvairāgantavyaṃ mahābalaiḥ
translation: सौमित्रे O Suamitri, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, पुरा earlier, संस्था promulgated an ordinance, यथा like that, कृता is ordered by, महाबलैः mighty, सर्वैः by all, तैः them, वानरैः by vanaras, अद्य now, आगन्तव्यम् should be reaching.
explanation: 'O Lakshmana since Sugriva has already promulgated an ordinance to all the mighty vanaras, they should be all arriving by now.

shloka_text: ऋक्षकोटिसहस्राणि गोलाङ्गूलशतानि च। अद्य त्वामुपयास्यन्ति जहि कोपमरिन्दम। कोट्योऽनेकास्तु काकुत्स्थ कपीनां दीप्ततेजसाम्।।4.35.22।।
transliteration: ṛkṣakoṭisahasrāṇi golāṅgūlaśatāni ca| adya tvāmupayāsyanti jahi kopamarindama| koṭyo'nekāstu kākutstha kapīnāṃ dīptatejasām
translation: अरिन्दम subduer of enemies, काकुत्स्थ Lakshmana, अद्य now, ऋक्षकोटिसहस्राणि thousands of crores of bears, गोलाङ्गूलशतानि hundreds of golangulas (monkeys with long tails like those of cows), दीप्ततेजसाम्  of fiery spirit, कपीनाम् of monkeys, अनेकाः many, कोट्यः crores, त्वाम् your, उपयास्यन्ति will attend on you, कोपम् anger, जहि give up.
explanation: Give up your anger, O subduer of foes; today, Kakutstha, thousands of crores of bears, hundreds of golangulas, and many crores of fiery-spirited monkeys will come to attend on you.

shloka_text: तव हि मुखमिदं निरीक्ष्य कोपात् क्षतजनिभे नयने निरीक्षमाणाः। हरिवरवनिता न यान्ति शान्तिं प्रथमभयस्य हि शङ्कितास्तु सर्वाः।।4.35.23।।
transliteration: tava hi mukhamidaṃ nirīkṣya kopāt kṣatajanibhe nayane nirīkṣamāṇāḥ| harivaravanitā na yānti śāntiṃ prathamabhayasya hi śaṅkitāstu sarvāḥ
translation: हरिवरवनिताः wives of foremost of monkeys, तव your, इदम् this, मुखम् face, निरीक्ष्य on seeing, कोपात् from anger, क्षतजनिभे resembling blood, नयने eyes, निरीक्षमाणाः looking at the eyes, शान्तिम् peace, न यान्ति not able to, सर्वाः all, प्रथमभयस्य of the earlier fear, शङ्कितास्तु suspecting.
explanation: 'Looking at your angry countenance with bloodred eyes, the wives of  the foremost of monkeys are frightened by the possibility of similar danger of the past (of Vali's death) and do not find peace of mind.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे पञ्चत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyfifth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तस्तारया वाक्यं प्रश्रितं धर्मसंहितम्। मृदुस्वभावस्सौमित्रिः प्रतिजग्राह तद्वचः।।4.36.1।।
transliteration: ityuktastārayā vākyaṃ praśritaṃ dharmasaṃhitam| mṛdusvabhāvassaumitriḥ pratijagrāha tadvacaḥ
translation: इति this, तारया by Tara, प्रश्रितम् courteous, धर्मसंहितम् justifiable, वाक्यम् words, उक्तः having been told, मृदुस्वभावः of gentle nature, सौमित्रिः Saumitri, तत् that, वचः word, प्रतिजग्राह accepted.
explanation: Thus the gentlenatured Saumitri accepted Tara's courteous words sanctioned by dharma.
comments: Lakshmana gets pacified -- Sugriva praises Rama's valour -- Lakshmana tenders apology for his harsh words

shloka_text: तस्मिन्प्रतिगृहीते तु वाक्ये हरिगणेश्वरः। लक्ष्मणात्सुमहत्त्रासं वस्त्रं क्लिन्नमिवात्यजत्।।4.36.2।।
transliteration: tasminpratigṛhīte tu vākye harigaṇeśvaraḥ| lakṣmaṇātsumahattrāsaṃ vastraṃ klinnamivātyajat
translation: तस्मिन् when such, वाक्ये words, प्रतिगृहीते were accepted, हरिगणेश्वरः leader of the vanara clan, लक्ष्मणात् from Lakshmana, सुमहत् great, त्रासम् fear, क्लिन्नम् wet, वस्त्रमिव like a garment, अत्यजत् cast aside.
explanation: Sugriva, king of the vanara clan, cast aside his great fear when Lakshmana accepted the words of Tara just as one discards a wet garment from the body.

shloka_text: ततः कण्ठगतं माल्यं चित्रं बहुगुणं महत्। चिच्छेद विमदश्चासीत्सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः।।4.36.3।।
transliteration: tataḥ kaṇṭhagataṃ mālyaṃ citraṃ bahuguṇaṃ mahat| ciccheda vimadaścāsītsugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ
translation: ततः then, वानरेश्वरः lord of vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, कण्ठगतम् worn on the neck, चित्रम् colourful, बहुगुणम् valuable, महत् great, माल्यम् garland, चिच्छेद tore off, विमदश्च relieved (from drunkenness), आसीत् got free.
explanation: Thereupon Sugriva, relieved from his drunken state tore off the great, colourful valuable garland worn on his neck.

shloka_text: स लक्ष्मणं भीमबलं सर्ववानरसत्तमः। अब्रवीत्प्रश्रितं वाक्यं सुग्रीव स्सम्प्रहर्षयन्।।4.36.4।।
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇaṃ bhīmabalaṃ sarvavānarasattamaḥ| abravītpraśritaṃ vākyaṃ sugrīva ssampraharṣayan
translation: सर्ववानरसत्तमः the noble of all the vanaras, सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, भीमबलम् a man of great prowess, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, सम्प्रहर्षयन् pleasing manner, प्रश्रितम् वाक्यम् these polite words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Sugriva, the noblest of all monkeys, spoke these polite words in a pleasing manner to Lakshmana of terrific strength:

shloka_text: प्रणष्टा श्रीश्च कीर्तिश्च कपिराज्यं च शाश्वतम्। रामप्रसादात्सौमित्रे पुन: प्राप्तमिदं मया।।4.36.5।।
transliteration: praṇaṣṭā śrīśca kīrtiśca kapirājyaṃ ca śāśvatam| rāmaprasādātsaumitre puna: prāptamidaṃ mayā
translation: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, प्रणष्टा lost from me, श्री:च prosperity also, कीर्ति: च and fame, शाश्वतम् permanent, कपिराज्यं च and the kingdom of monkeys, इदम् this, रामप्रसादात् by the grace of Rama, मया by me, पुनः again, प्राप्तम् has been regained.
explanation: 'O Saumitri my prosperity, fame and the permanent sovereignty of vanaras had been lost. It was  regained by the grace of Rama.

shloka_text: कश्शक्तस्तस्य देवस्य ख्यातस्य स्वेन कर्मणा। तादृशं विक्रमं वीर प्रतिकर्तुमरिन्दम।।4.36.6।।
transliteration: kaśśaktastasya devasya khyātasya svena karmaṇā| tādṛśaṃ vikramaṃ vīra pratikartumarindama
translation: अरिन्दम crusher of enemies, स्वेन his own, कर्मणा by deeds, ख्यातस्य of a famed, देवस्य lord's, तस्य his, शक्तः is possible, कः who, प्रतिकर्तुम् ever to repay, तादृशम् such, विक्रमं वीर heroic valour.
explanation: 'O crusher of enemies  how is it possible to repay the famous lord Rama's valour (in killing Vali)?

shloka_text: सीतां प्राप्स्यति धर्मात्मा वधिष्यति च रावणम्। सहायमात्रेण मया राघव स्स्वेन तेजसा।।4.36.7।।
transliteration: sītāṃ prāpsyati dharmātmā vadhiṣyati ca rāvaṇam| sahāyamātreṇa mayā rāghava ssvena tejasā
translation: धर्मात्मा राघवः righteous Rama, सहायमात्रेण only be an assistant, मया by me, स्वेन तेजसा by his own fiery energy, सीताम् Sita, प्राप्स्यति he will get back, रावणम् Ravana,वधिष्यति च he will  kill.
explanation: 'Righteous Rama can merely restore Sita with my assistance. By his own fiery energy he will kill Ravana.

shloka_text: सहायकृत्यं किं तस्य येन सप्त महाद्रुमाः। शैलश्च वसुधा चैव बाणेनैकेन दारिताः।।4.36.8।।
transliteration: sahāyakṛtyaṃ kiṃ tasya yena sapta mahādrumāḥ| śailaśca vasudhā caiva bāṇenaikena dāritāḥ
translation: येन by whomsoever, सप्त seven, महाद्रुमाः huge trees, शैलश्च mountain too, वसुधा चैव and earth also, एकेन by only one, बाणेन with an arrow, दारिताः shattered, तस्य to him, सहायकृत्यम् assistance to be done, किम् what.
explanation: 'Rama shattered seven huge trees, a mountain and earth with a single arrow. What assistance does he need?

shloka_text: धनुर्विष्फारयानस्य यस्य शब्देन लक्ष्मण। सशैला कम्पिता भूमिस्सहायै: किन्नु तस्य वै।।4.36.9।।
transliteration: dhanurviṣphārayānasya yasya śabdena lakṣmaṇa| saśailā kampitā bhūmissahāyai: kinnu tasya vai
translation: लक्ष्मण O Lakshmana, धनुः bow, विष्फारयानस्य  with the twang of his bow, यस्य its, शब्देन by the sound, सशैला: even the mountains, भूमिः earth, कम्पिता was shaken तस्य his, सहायैः assistance, किं why?
explanation: 'O Lakshmana the twang of his bow shook even the mountains and the earth. What assistance does he need?

shloka_text: अनुयात्रां नरेन्द्रस्य करिष्येऽहं नरर्षभ। गच्छतो रावणं हन्तुं वैरिणं सपुरस्सरम्।।4.36.10।।
transliteration: anuyātrāṃ narendrasya kariṣye'haṃ nararṣabha| gacchato rāvaṇaṃ hantuṃ vairiṇaṃ sapurassaram
translation: नरर्षभ O bull among men, सपुरस्सरम् along with his followers, वैरिणम् the enemy, रावणम् Ravana, हन्तुम् to kill, गच्छतः while going, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, अहम् I, अनुयात्राम् following, करिष्ये I shall.
explanation: 'O Lakshmana, bull among men I shall only join him along with others when he leads the army to kill Ravana.

shloka_text: यदि किञ्चिदतिक्रान्तं विश्वासात्प्रणयेन वा। प्रेष्यस्य क्षमितव्यं मे न कश्चिन्नापराध्यति।।4.36.11।।
transliteration: yadi kiñcidatikrāntaṃ viśvāsātpraṇayena vā| preṣyasya kṣamitavyaṃ me na kaścinnāparādhyati
translation: विश्वासात् due to faith, प्रणयेन वा or with love, किञ्चित् even a little, अतिक्रान्तं यदि have exceeded time, प्रेष्यस्य of a servant, मे my, क्षमितव्यम् one should pardon, कश्चित् any one, नापराध्यति इति न is not flawless in the world.
explanation: 'If I have committed even a little transgression in my faith in Rama or affection for him and exceeded the time limit, my mistakes are to be excused as one would pardons a servant. No one is flawless in the world.'

shloka_text: ति तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः। अभवल्लक्ष्मणः प्रीतः प्रेम्णा चैवमुवाच ह।।4.36.12।।
transliteration: ti tasya bruvāṇasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ| abhavallakṣmaṇaḥ prītaḥ premṇā caivamuvāca ha
translation: महात्मनः of the great self, तस्य his, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, इति thus, ब्रुवाणस्य of him while speaking, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रीतः अभवत् was happy, प्रेम्णा with affection, च also, एवम् in this way, उवाच ह spoke.
explanation: Lakshmana who was happy to hear great Sugriva replied affectionately:

shloka_text: सर्वथा हि मम भ्राता सनाथो वानरेश्वर। त्वया नाथेन सुग्रीव प्रश्रितेन विशेषतः।।4.36.13।।
transliteration: sarvathā hi mama bhrātā sanātho vānareśvara| tvayā nāthena sugrīva praśritena viśeṣataḥ
translation: वानरेश्वर O king of monkeys, सुग्रीव Sugriva, नाथेन by a king, विशेषतः specially, प्रश्रितेन by a courteous one, त्वया you, मम my, भ्राता brother, सर्वथा in all ways, सनाथः हि has a guardian.
explanation: 'O Sugriva, king of monkeys when you are extending due courtesy to my brother,he has a guardian in you by all means.

shloka_text: यस्ते प्रभाव स्सुग्रीव यच्च ते शौचमार्जवम्। अर्हस्त्वं कपिराज्यस्य श्रियं भोक्तुमनुत्तमाम्।।4.36.14।।
transliteration: yaste prabhāva ssugrīva yacca te śaucamārjavam| arhastvaṃ kapirājyasya śriyaṃ bhoktumanuttamām
translation: सुग्रीव Sugriva, ते your, यः whatever, प्रभावः power, आर्जवम् straightforward nature, यत्  such, शौचं च purity, त्वम् your, कपिराज्यस्य of vanara kingdom, अनुत्तमाम् excellent, श्रियम् prosperity, भोक्तुम् to enjoy, अर्हः you deserve.
explanation: 'You are powerful and straightforward by nature.You are humble and noble. Therefore, you deserve the high prosperity of the kingdom of the monkeys.

shloka_text: सहायेन तु सुग्रीव त्वया रामः प्रतापवान्। वधिष्यति रणे शत्रूनचिरान्नात्र संशयः।।4.36.15।।
transliteration: sahāyena tu sugrīva tvayā rāmaḥ pratāpavān| vadhiṣyati raṇe śatrūnacirānnātra saṃśayaḥ
translation: सुग्रीव Sugriva, सहायेन with you as associate, त्वया by your, प्रतापवान् valiant hero, रामः Rama, शत्रून्  enemies, रणे in war, अचिरात् shortly, वधिष्यति he will kill, संशयः is doubt, न not, अत्र in this case
explanation: 'O Sugriva with you as associate, valiant hero Rama will kill his enemies in war very soon. There is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: धर्मज्ञस्य कृतज्ञस्य सङ्ग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिनः। उपपन्नं च युक्तं च सुग्रीव तव भाषितम्।।4.36.16।।
transliteration: dharmajñasya kṛtajñasya saṅgrāmeṣvanivartinaḥ| upapannaṃ ca yuktaṃ ca sugrīva tava bhāṣitam
translation: सुग्रीव Sugriva, धर्मज्ञस्य  who is aware of dhrama, कृतज्ञस्य of a grateful one, सङ्ग्रामेषु in battles, अनिवर्तिनः of one who does not retreat, तव your, भाषितम् word, उपपन्नम्  true, युक्तं च is fitting also.
explanation: 'O Sugriva you know dharma.You are grateful and will not turn back from the battle. So your words are true and befitting.

shloka_text: दोषज्ञस्सति सामर्थ्ये कोऽन्यो भाषितुमर्हति। वर्जयित्वा मम ज्येष्ठं त्वां च वानरसत्तम।।4.36.17।।
transliteration: doṣajñassati sāmarthye ko'nyo bhāṣitumarhati| varjayitvā mama jyeṣṭhaṃ tvāṃ ca vānarasattama
translation: वानरसत्तम best of monkeys, मम my, ज्येष्ठम् elder brother, त्वां च and you, वर्जयित्वा with the exception of, अन्यः others, कः who, सामर्थ्ये सति capability, दोषज्ञः knows the faults of others, भाषितुम् to speak, अर्हति will be capable.
explanation: 'O best of monkeys barring you and my elder brother, who else would be capable of speaking this way about themselves even when you are aware of other's faults?

shloka_text: सदृशश्चासि रामस्य विक्रमेण बलेन च। सहायो दैवतैर्दत्तश्चिराय हरिपुङ्गव।।4.36.18।।
transliteration: sadṛśaścāsi rāmasya vikrameṇa balena ca| sahāyo daivatairdattaścirāya haripuṅgava
translation: हरिपुङ्गव Sugriva, दैवतैः by deities, चिराय for a long time, दत्तः given, सहायः as helper, विक्रमेण बलेन च in power and valour, रामस्य with Rama, सदृशः equal, असि you are.
explanation: 'You who are equal to Rama in valour and strength, will continue to be the gift of gods to us for long.

shloka_text: किं तु शीघ्रमितो वीर निष्क्रम त्वं मया सह। सान्त्वयस्व वयस्यं च त्वं भार्याहरणकर्शितम्।।4.36.19।।
transliteration: kiṃ tu śīghramito vīra niṣkrama tvaṃ mayā saha| sāntvayasva vayasyaṃ ca tvaṃ bhāryāharaṇakarśitam
translation: किं तु nevertheless, त्वम् you, मया सह with me, इतः from this place, शीघ्रम् at once, निष्क्रम start, भार्याहरणकर्शितम् a man grieved by the abduction of his wife, वयस्य your friend, सान्त्वयस्व reassure.
explanation: 'Nevertheless I want you to proceed from here with me at once and reassure your friend who is agrieved due to the abduction of his wife.

shloka_text: यच्च शोकाभिभूतस्य श्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्। मया त्वं परुषाण्युक्तस्तच्चत्वं क्षन्तु मर्हसि।।4.36.20।।
transliteration: yacca śokābhibhūtasya śrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam| mayā tvaṃ paruṣāṇyuktastaccatvaṃ kṣantu marhasi
translation: त्वम् You, शोकाभिभूतस्य of a griefstricken man, रामस्य भाषितम् Rama's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मया by me, त्वम् you, परुषाणि harshly, उक्तः इति यत् thus spoken, अर्हसि you will, तच्च that, क्षन्तुम् to forgive.
explanation: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामयणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysix sarga of Kishkindakanda of the Holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना। हनूमन्तं स्थितं पार्श्वे सचिवन्त्विदमब्रवीत्।।4.37.1।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā| hanūmantaṃ sthitaṃ pārśve sacivantvidamabravīt
translation: महात्मना great self, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् in that manner, उक्त having said, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, पार्श्वे by his side, स्थितम् stood, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, इदं this, सचिवं minister,  अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Having heard the great Lakshmana Sugriva said to Hanuman, the minister who stood by his side:
comments: Countless monkeys report to Sugriva

shloka_text: महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च। मन्दरे पाण्डुशिखरे पञ्चशैलेषु ये स्थिताः।।4.37.2।। तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु भ्राजमानेषु सर्वतः। पर्वतेषु समुद्रान्ते पश्चिमायां च ये दिशि।।4.37.3।। आदित्यभवने चैव गिरौ सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे। पद्मातालवनं भीमं संश्रिता हरिपुङ्गवाः।।4.37.4।। अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः कुञ्जरप्रतिमौजसः। अञ्जने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.5।। मनश्शिला गुहावासा वानराः कनकप्रभाः। मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव ये धूम्रगिरिं संश्रिताः।।4.37.6।। तरुणादित्यवर्णाश्च पर्वते ये महारुणे। पिबन्तो मधुमैरेयं भीमवेगाः प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.7।। वनेषु च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिषु महत्सु च। तापसानां च रम्येषु वनान्तेषु समन्ततः।।4.37.8।। तांस्तां स्त्वमानय क्षिप्रं पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्। सामदानादिभि: स्सर्वैराशु प्रेषय वानरान्।।4.37.9।।
transliteration: mahendrahimavadvindhyakailāsaśikhareṣu ca| mandare pāṇḍuśikhare pañcaśaileṣu ye sthitāḥ taruṇādityavarṇeṣu bhrājamāneṣu sarvataḥ| parvateṣu samudrānte paścimāyāṃ ca ye diśi ādityabhavane caiva girau sandhyābhrasannibhe| padmātālavanaṃ bhīmaṃ saṃśritā haripuṅgavāḥ añjanāmbudasaṅkāśāḥ kuñjarapratimaujasaḥ| añjane parvate caiva ye vasanti plavaṅgamāḥ manaśśilā guhāvāsā vānarāḥ kanakaprabhāḥ| merupārśvagatāścaiva ye dhūmragiriṃ saṃśritāḥ taruṇādityavarṇāśca parvate ye mahāruṇe| pibanto madhumaireyaṃ bhīmavegāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ vaneṣu ca suramyeṣu sugandhiṣu mahatsu ca| tāpasānāṃ ca ramyeṣu vanānteṣu samantataḥ tāṃstāṃ stvamānaya kṣipraṃ pṛthivyāṃ sarvavānarān| sāmadānādibhi: ssarvairāśu preṣaya vānarān
translation: महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च on the peaks of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya and Kailasa mountains, पाण्डुशिखरे on the white peak, मन्दरे of Mandara, पञ्चशैलेषु on the five mountains, ये who, स्थिताः ever residing, समुद्रान्ते on the shores of the sea, सर्वत: all over, भ्राजमानेषु on the lustrous, तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु colour of the rising Sun, पर्वतेषु on mountains, पश्चिमायाम् western, दिशि direction, ये those, सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे like the clouds of the setting Sun, आदित्यभवने the mountain where the Sun rises, गिरौ चैव even mountains, भीमं fierce, हरिपुङ्गवाः best of monkeys, पद्म तालवनम् in the garden of Padmatala, संश्रिताः staying, अञ्जने पर्वते on the Anjani mountain, अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः resembling black clouds, कुञ्जरेन्द्रप्रतिमौजसः strong as best elephants, ये प्लवङ्गमाः the monkeys, वसन्ति dwelling, मनश्शिलागुहावासाः  residing at Manassilva (a red pigment of arsenic) mountain caves, कनकप्रभाः shining like gold in complexion, वानराः monkeys, मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव and those who have gone to Mount Meru, ये those, धूम्रगिरिम् at  Dhumra mountain, श्रिताः staying, महारुणे on Maharuna, पर्वते on the mountain, मैरेयं मधु liquor of Maireya, पिबन्तः drinking, भीमवेगाः of terrific speed, ये those, तरुणादित्यवर्णाः of the colour of the rising Sun, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, सुरम्येषु on beautiful spots, सुगन्धिषु of the fragrant, महत्सु on the great, वनेषु च and in the forests, तापसानां च रम्येषु at the delightful hermitages of ascetics, समन्ततः all over, वनान्तेषु allover the forest, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, तां स्तान् respective ones, सर्ववानरान् all the monkeys, सामदानादिभिः using all means (sama and dana), सवै: by all, आशुप्रेषय send for, वानरान् the monkeys, क्षिप्रम् at once, त्वम् you, आनय bring.
explanation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who  resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

shloka_text: महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च। मन्दरे पाण्डुशिखरे पञ्चशैलेषु ये स्थिताः।।4.37.2।। तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु भ्राजमानेषु सर्वतः। पर्वतेषु समुद्रान्ते पश्चिमायां च ये दिशि।।4.37.3।। आदित्यभवने चैव गिरौ सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे। पद्मातालवनं भीमं संश्रिता हरिपुङ्गवाः।।4.37.4।। अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः कुञ्जरप्रतिमौजसः। अञ्जने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.5।। मनश्शिला गुहावासा वानराः कनकप्रभाः। मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव ये धूम्रगिरिं संश्रिताः।।4.37.6।। तरुणादित्यवर्णाश्च पर्वते ये महारुणे। पिबन्तो मधुमैरेयं भीमवेगाः प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.7।। वनेषु च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिषु महत्सु च। तापसानां च रम्येषु वनान्तेषु समन्ततः।।4.37.8।। तांस्तां स्त्वमानय क्षिप्रं पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्। सामदानादिभि: स्सर्वैराशु प्रेषय वानरान्।।4.37.9।।
transliteration: mahendrahimavadvindhyakailāsaśikhareṣu ca| mandare pāṇḍuśikhare pañcaśaileṣu ye sthitāḥ taruṇādityavarṇeṣu bhrājamāneṣu sarvataḥ| parvateṣu samudrānte paścimāyāṃ ca ye diśi ādityabhavane caiva girau sandhyābhrasannibhe| padmātālavanaṃ bhīmaṃ saṃśritā haripuṅgavāḥ añjanāmbudasaṅkāśāḥ kuñjarapratimaujasaḥ| añjane parvate caiva ye vasanti plavaṅgamāḥ manaśśilā guhāvāsā vānarāḥ kanakaprabhāḥ| merupārśvagatāścaiva ye dhūmragiriṃ saṃśritāḥ taruṇādityavarṇāśca parvate ye mahāruṇe| pibanto madhumaireyaṃ bhīmavegāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ vaneṣu ca suramyeṣu sugandhiṣu mahatsu ca| tāpasānāṃ ca ramyeṣu vanānteṣu samantataḥ tāṃstāṃ stvamānaya kṣipraṃ pṛthivyāṃ sarvavānarān| sāmadānādibhi: ssarvairāśu preṣaya vānarān
translation: महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च on the peaks of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya and Kailasa mountains, पाण्डुशिखरे on the white peak, मन्दरे of Mandara, पञ्चशैलेषु on the five mountains, ये who, स्थिताः ever residing, समुद्रान्ते on the shores of the sea, सर्वत: all over, भ्राजमानेषु on the lustrous, तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु colour of the rising Sun, पर्वतेषु on mountains, पश्चिमायाम् western, दिशि direction, ये those, सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे like the clouds of the setting Sun, आदित्यभवने the mountain where the Sun rises, गिरौ चैव even mountains, भीमं fierce, हरिपुङ्गवाः best of monkeys, पद्म तालवनम् in the garden of Padmatala, संश्रिताः staying, अञ्जने पर्वते on the Anjani mountain, अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः resembling black clouds, कुञ्जरेन्द्रप्रतिमौजसः strong as best elephants, ये प्लवङ्गमाः the monkeys, वसन्ति dwelling, मनश्शिलागुहावासाः  residing at Manassilva (a red pigment of arsenic) mountain caves, कनकप्रभाः shining like gold in complexion, वानराः monkeys, मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव and those who have gone to Mount Meru, ये those, धूम्रगिरिम् at  Dhumra mountain, श्रिताः staying, महारुणे on Maharuna, पर्वते on the mountain, मैरेयं मधु liquor of Maireya, पिबन्तः drinking, भीमवेगाः of terrific speed, ये those, तरुणादित्यवर्णाः of the colour of the rising Sun, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, सुरम्येषु on beautiful spots, सुगन्धिषु of the fragrant, महत्सु on the great, वनेषु च and in the forests, तापसानां च रम्येषु at the delightful hermitages of ascetics, समन्ततः all over, वनान्तेषु allover the forest, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, तां स्तान् respective ones, सर्ववानरान् all the monkeys, सामदानादिभिः using all means (sama and dana), सवै: by all, आशुप्रेषय send for, वानरान् the monkeys, क्षिप्रम् at once, त्वम् you, आनय bring.
explanation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who  resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

shloka_text: महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च। मन्दरे पाण्डुशिखरे पञ्चशैलेषु ये स्थिताः।।4.37.2।। तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु भ्राजमानेषु सर्वतः। पर्वतेषु समुद्रान्ते पश्चिमायां च ये दिशि।।4.37.3।। आदित्यभवने चैव गिरौ सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे। पद्मातालवनं भीमं संश्रिता हरिपुङ्गवाः।।4.37.4।। अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः कुञ्जरप्रतिमौजसः। अञ्जने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.5।। मनश्शिला गुहावासा वानराः कनकप्रभाः। मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव ये धूम्रगिरिं संश्रिताः।।4.37.6।। तरुणादित्यवर्णाश्च पर्वते ये महारुणे। पिबन्तो मधुमैरेयं भीमवेगाः प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.7।। वनेषु च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिषु महत्सु च। तापसानां च रम्येषु वनान्तेषु समन्ततः।।4.37.8।। तांस्तां स्त्वमानय क्षिप्रं पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्। सामदानादिभि: स्सर्वैराशु प्रेषय वानरान्।।4.37.9।।

explanation: 'Send for the monkeys residing at the five mountains of Mahendra, Himavan, Vindhya, Kailasa and the whitepeaked mount Mandara those monkeys residing on the western mountains, on the sea shore and on mount Udaya shining like the rising Sun monkeys like dark clouds shining in the twilight Sun those at the fierce Padmatala garden and those at the Anjana mountain who  resemble dark clouds like collyrium and are as strong as elephants those monkeys of golden complexion residing at the red arsenic mountain caves beside mount Meru those on mount Meru and Dhumra who are of bright red colour like the rising Sun drinking liquor Maireya the monkeys of terrific speed at mount Maharuna those staying at the delightful hermitages in the forests, and those living on the ground all must be cajoled and persuaded to report at once.

shloka_text: महेन्द्रहिमवद्विन्ध्यकैलासशिखरेषु च। मन्दरे पाण्डुशिखरे पञ्चशैलेषु ये स्थिताः।।4.37.2।। तरुणादित्यवर्णेषु भ्राजमानेषु सर्वतः। पर्वतेषु समुद्रान्ते पश्चिमायां च ये दिशि।।4.37.3।। आदित्यभवने चैव गिरौ सन्ध्याभ्रसन्निभे। पद्मातालवनं भीमं संश्रिता हरिपुङ्गवाः।।4.37.4।। अञ्जनाम्बुदसङ्काशाः कुञ्जरप्रतिमौजसः। अञ्जने पर्वते चैव ये वसन्ति प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.5।। मनश्शिला गुहावासा वानराः कनकप्रभाः। मेरुपार्श्वगताश्चैव ये धूम्रगिरिं संश्रिताः।।4.37.6।। तरुणादित्यवर्णाश्च पर्वते ये महारुणे। पिबन्तो मधुमैरेयं भीमवेगाः प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.37.7।। वनेषु च सुरम्येषु सुगन्धिषु महत्सु च। तापसानां च रम्येषु वनान्तेषु समन्ततः।।4.37.8।। तांस्तां स्त्वमानय क्षिप्रं पृथिव्यां सर्ववानरान्। सामदानादिभि: स्सर्वैराशु प्रेषय वानरान्।।4.37.9।।
