explanation: While the numerous monkeys, resembling peaks of high mountains were roaring, it resounded through the mountain caves. It was like the sound of the  stormy thunderclouds. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे पञ्चपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyfifth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: उपविष्टास्तु ते सर्वे यस्मिन्प्रायं गिरिस्थले। हरयो गृध्रराजश्च तं देशमुपचक्रमे।।4.56.1।। सम्पातिर्नाम नाम्ना तु चिरञ्जीवी विहङ्गमः। भ्राता जटायुषः श्रीमान्विख्यातबलपौरुषः।।4.56.2।।
transliteration: upaviṣṭāstu te sarve yasminprāyaṃ giristhale| harayo gṛdhrarājaśca taṃ deśamupacakrame sampātirnāma nāmnā tu cirañjīvī vihaṅgamaḥ| bhrātā jaṭāyuṣaḥ śrīmānvikhyātabalapauruṣaḥ
translation: ते they, सर्वे all, हरयः monkeys, यस्मिन् that, गिरिस्थले on the plateau of the mountain, प्रायम् उपविष्टाः seated preparing to die by fasting unto death, तं देशम् that location, गृध्रराजः king of vultures, नाम्ना by name, सम्पातिर्नाम as Sampati, चिरञ्जीवी longlived, जटायुष: Jatayu, भ्राता brother, श्रीमान् prosperous, विख्यातबलपौरुषः widely known for his strength, विहङ्गमः a vulture, उपचक्रमे came there.
explanation: While the monkeys were preparing to fast unto death on the plateau of the mountain, Sampati, the prosperous king of vultures, the longlived elder brother of Jatayu widely known for his strength, appeared there.
comments: Sampati sees Angada and other monkeys -- hears about the death of his brother Jatayu.

shloka_text: उपविष्टास्तु ते सर्वे यस्मिन्प्रायं गिरिस्थले। हरयो गृध्रराजश्च तं देशमुपचक्रमे।।4.56.1।। सम्पातिर्नाम नाम्ना तु चिरञ्जीवी विहङ्गमः। भ्राता जटायुषः श्रीमान्विख्यातबलपौरुषः।।4.56.2।।
transliteration: upaviṣṭāstu te sarve yasminprāyaṃ giristhale| harayo gṛdhrarājaśca taṃ deśamupacakrame sampātirnāma nāmnā tu cirañjīvī vihaṅgamaḥ| bhrātā jaṭāyuṣaḥ śrīmānvikhyātabalapauruṣaḥ
translation: ते they, सर्वे all, हरयः monkeys, यस्मिन् that, गिरिस्थले on the plateau of the mountain, प्रायम् उपविष्टाः seated preparing to die by fasting unto death, तं देशम् that location, गृध्रराजः king of vultures, नाम्ना by name, सम्पातिर्नाम as Sampati, चिरञ्जीवी longlived, जटायुष: Jatayu, भ्राता brother, श्रीमान् prosperous, विख्यातबलपौरुषः widely known for his strength, विहङ्गमः a vulture, उपचक्रमे came there.
explanation: While the monkeys were preparing to fast unto death on the plateau of the mountain, Sampati, the prosperous king of vultures, the longlived elder brother of Jatayu widely known for his strength, appeared there.
comments: Sampati sees Angada and other monkeys -- hears about the death of his brother Jatayu.

shloka_text: कन्दरादभिनिष्क्रम्य स विन्ध्यस्य महागिरेः। उपविष्टान्हरीन्दृष्ट्वा हृष्टात्मा गिरमब्रवीत्।।4.56.3।।
transliteration: kandarādabhiniṣkramya sa vindhyasya mahāgireḥ| upaviṣṭānharīndṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭātmā giramabravīt
translation: सः he, महागिरेः of the great mountain, विन्ध्यस्य Vindhya's, कन्दरात् from the cave, अभिनिष्क्रम्य emerging, उपविष्टान् seated, हरीन् monkeys, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, हृष्टात्मा delighted, गिरम् word, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Coming out of the cave of the great mount Vindhya, Sampati was glad to see the monkeys seated there and said to himself:

shloka_text: विधिः किल नरं लोके विधानेनानुवर्तते। यथाऽयं विहितो भक्ष्यश्चिरान्मह्यमुपागतः।।4.56.4।।
transliteration: vidhiḥ kila naraṃ loke vidhānenānuvartate| yathā'yaṃ vihito bhakṣyaścirānmahyamupāgataḥ
translation: लोके in this world, विधिः destiny, विधानेन in accordance with, नरम् अनुवर्तते किल said to follow, यथा as, चिरात् for long, मह्यम् for me, विहितः fixed, अयम् this, भक्ष्यः eatable, उपागतः has come.
explanation: 'Destiny rules the world of men in accordance with a divine arrangement. Or else, it would not have brought me food after a long time (of fasting)'. (The monkeys are food for Sampati)'

shloka_text: परम्पराणां भक्षिष्ये वानराणां मृतं मृतम्। उवाचेदं वचः पक्षी तान्निरीक्ष्य प्लवङ्गमान्।।4.56.5।।
transliteration: paramparāṇāṃ bhakṣiṣye vānarāṇāṃ mṛtaṃ mṛtam| uvācedaṃ vacaḥ pakṣī tānnirīkṣya plavaṅgamān
translation: वानराणाम् of monkeys, परम्पराणाम् one after the other, मृतं मृतम् as and when they die, भक्षिष्ये I will eat, तान् them, प्लवङ्गमान् monkeys, निरीक्ष्य looking at them, पक्षी the vulture, इदं these, वचः words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Looking at them, the vulture continued, 'I will eat these monkeys one after the other as and when they die'.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भक्ष्यलुब्धस्य पक्षिणः। अङ्गदः परमायस्तो हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्।।4.56.6।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhakṣyalubdhasya pakṣiṇaḥ| aṅgadaḥ paramāyasto hanūmantamathābravīt
translation: भक्ष्यलुब्धस्य of the greedy for food, तस्य पक्षिणः of the vulture, तत् वचनम् that words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अथ then, अङ्गदः Angada, परमायस्तः highly dejected, हनूमन्तम् to Hanumanta, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Hearing the words of the vulture greedily waiting for food, deeply dejected Angada spoke to Hanuman:

shloka_text: पश्य सीतापदेशेन साक्षाद्वैवस्वतो यमः। इमं देशमनुप्राप्तो वानराणां विपत्तये।।4.56.7।।
transliteration: paśya sītāpadeśena sākṣādvaivasvato yamaḥ| imaṃ deśamanuprāpto vānarāṇāṃ vipattaye
translation: सीतापदेशेन in the name of Sita, वैवस्वतः Vaivasvata, यमः Yama, साक्षात् himself in person, वानराणाम् to monkeys, विपत्तये to kill, इमं देशम् this place, अनुप्राप्तः has come, पश्य see.
explanation: 'See, Yama, son of Vaivasvata, has arrived here in person  to destroy the monkeys in the name of Sita. (Sita became the direct agent for causing the destruction of monkeys).

shloka_text: रामस्य न कृतं कार्यं राज्ञो न च वचः कृतम्। हरीणामियमज्ञाता विपत्तिस्सहसागता।।4.56.8।।
transliteration: rāmasya na kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ rājño na ca vacaḥ kṛtam| harīṇāmiyamajñātā vipattissahasāgatā
translation: रामस्य Rama's, कार्यम् task, न कृतम् not carried out, राज्ञ: the king's, वचः words, न च कृतम् not carried out, हरीणाम् for the monkeys, इयम् this, अज्ञाता unknown, विपत्ति: calamity, सहसा suddenly, आगता has set in.
explanation: 'Rama's task has not been performed. Sugriva's order has not been excuted. And (now) suddenly this calamity has overtaken the monkeys unawares.

shloka_text: वैदेह्याः प्रियकामेन कृतं कर्म जटायुषा। गृध्राराजेन यत्तत्र श्रुतं वस्तदशेषतः।।4.56.9।।
transliteration: vaidehyāḥ priyakāmena kṛtaṃ karma jaṭāyuṣā| gṛdhrārājena yattatra śrutaṃ vastadaśeṣataḥ
translation: वैदेह्याः the princess of Videha, प्रियकामेन in order to please her, गृध्रराजेन by the king of vultures, जटायुषा by Jatayu, तत्र there, यत् कर्म whatever task, कृतम् has been accomplished, तत् that, अशेषतः fully, वः for you, श्रुतम् heard.
explanation: 'We have heard in detail about the task accomplished by Jatayu, the king of vultures, in order to please Sita, the princess of Videha.

shloka_text: तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि तिर्यग्योनिगतान्यपि। प्रियं कुर्वन्ति रामस्य त्यक्त्वा प्राणान्यथा वयम्।।4.56.10।।
transliteration: tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni tiryagyonigatānyapi| priyaṃ kurvanti rāmasya tyaktvā prāṇānyathā vayam
translation: तथा that way, तिर्यग्योनिगतान्यपि those born as animals even, सर्वाणि all, भूतानि creatures, प्राणान् life, त्यक्त्वा risking, वयं यथा like us, रामस्य for Rama, प्रियम् please, कुर्वन्ति you will.
explanation: In that way all creatures, even those born as animals, do what is dear to Rama by risking their lives, just as we do.

shloka_text: अन्योऽन्यमुपकुर्वन्ति स्नेहकारुण्ययन्त्रिताः। तेन तस्योपकारार्थं त्यजताऽत्मानमात्मना।।4.56.11।।
transliteration: anyo'nyamupakurvanti snehakāruṇyayantritāḥ| tena tasyopakārārthaṃ tyajatā'tmānamātmanā
translation: स्नेहकारुण्ययन्त्रिताः  bound by  friendship and compassion, अन्योन्यम् mutually, उपकुर्वन्ति  help, तेन by him, तस्य Rama's, उपकारार्थम् for wellbeing, आत्मानम् his life, आत्मना by himself, त्यजत by giving up.
explanation: 'Bound by  friendship and compassion each one helps the other. In fact, Jatayu did this by giving up his life on his own, for the sake of Rama.

shloka_text: प्रियं कृतं हि रामस्य धर्मज्ञेन जटायुषा। राघवार्थे परिश्रान्ता वयं सन्त्यक्तजीविताः।।4.56.12।। कान्ताराणि प्रपन्नाः स्म न च पश्याम मैथिलीम्।
transliteration: priyaṃ kṛtaṃ hi rāmasya dharmajñena jaṭāyuṣā| rāghavārthe pariśrāntā vayaṃ santyaktajīvitāḥ kāntārāṇi prapannāḥ sma na ca paśyāma maithilīm|
translation: धर्मज्ञेन by the righteous, जटायुषा by Jatayu, रामस्य Rama's, प्रियम् wellbeing, कृतं हि is done, वयम् we, राघवार्थे for Rama's sake, परिश्रान्ताः exhausted, सन्त्यक्तजीविताः all of us are giving up life, कान्ताराणि forests, प्रपन्नाः ventured, स्म we, मैथिलीम् Maithili, न च पश्याम we have not seen.
explanation: 'Jatayu, the knower of dharma, has laid down his life for the wellbeing of Rama. We are exhausted in the process of helping Rama. We have lost hope of our lives after entering these forests. Yet we have failed to find the princess from Mithila.

shloka_text: स सुखी गृध्रराजस्तु रावणेन हतो रणे।।4.56.13।। मुक्तश्च सुग्रीवभयाद्गतश्च परमां गतिम्।
transliteration: sa sukhī gṛdhrarājastu rāvaṇena hato raṇe muktaśca sugrīvabhayādgataśca paramāṃ gatim|
translation: रणे in combat, रावणेन by Ravana, हतः was slain, सः he, गृध्रराजस्तु king of vultures, सुखी is happy, सुग्रीवभयात् fear of Sugriva, मुक्तश्च relieved, परमाम् supreme, गतिम् status, गतश्च attained.
explanation: 'The king of vultures was slain by Ravana in a combat. He attained supreme status. He had no fear for Sugriva (as we have).

shloka_text: जटायुषो विनाशेन राज्ञो दशरथस्य च।।4.56.14।। हरणेन च वैदेह्या स्संशयं हरयो गताः।
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣo vināśena rājño daśarathasya ca haraṇena ca vaidehyā ssaṃśayaṃ harayo gatāḥ|
translation: जटायुषः Jatayu's, विनाशेन by the death, राज्ञः king's, दशरथस्य च and Dasaratha's, वैदेह्याः princess from Videha, हरणेन च by abducting, हरयः monkeys, संशयं गताः are caught in doubtful situation.
explanation: 'The survival of monkeys has become doubtful due to the death of Jatayu, death of  king Dasaratha and the abduction of the princess from Videha.

shloka_text: रामलक्ष्मणयोर्वासश्च अरण्ये सह सीतया।।4.56.15।। राघवस्य च बाणेन वालिनश्च तथा वधः। रामकोपादशेषाणां रक्षसानां तथा वधः।।4.56.16।। कैकेय्या वरदानेन इदं च विकृतं कृतम्।
transliteration: rāmalakṣmaṇayorvāsaśca araṇye saha sītayā rāghavasya ca bāṇena vālinaśca tathā vadhaḥ| rāmakopādaśeṣāṇāṃ rakṣasānāṃ tathā vadhaḥ kaikeyyā varadānena idaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ kṛtam|
translation: कैकेय्याः to Kaikeyi, वरदानेन the granting of boons, सीतया सह along with Sita, अरण्ये in the forest, रामलक्ष्मणयोः of Rama and Lakshmana, वासः residence, तथा so also, राघवस्य Rama's, बाणेन with arrow, वालिनः Vali's, वधश्च death, तथा so also, रामकोपात् due to Rama's anger, अशेषाणाम् of the entire lot, रक्षसानाम् demons, वधश्च death, इदम् this, विकृतं च unwanted consequence, कृतम् was done.
explanation: 'The exile of Rama and Lakshmana into the forest along with Sita, so also the death of Vali and of the demons in the hands of Rama due to his anger are all evil consequences of a boon granted to Kaikeyi.'

shloka_text: रामलक्ष्मणयोर्वासश्च अरण्ये सह सीतया।।4.56.15।। राघवस्य च बाणेन वालिनश्च तथा वधः। रामकोपादशेषाणां रक्षसानां तथा वधः।।4.56.16।। कैकेय्या वरदानेन इदं च विकृतं कृतम्।
transliteration: rāmalakṣmaṇayorvāsaśca araṇye saha sītayā rāghavasya ca bāṇena vālinaśca tathā vadhaḥ| rāmakopādaśeṣāṇāṃ rakṣasānāṃ tathā vadhaḥ kaikeyyā varadānena idaṃ ca vikṛtaṃ kṛtam|
translation: कैकेय्याः to Kaikeyi, वरदानेन the granting of boons, सीतया सह along with Sita, अरण्ये in the forest, रामलक्ष्मणयोः of Rama and Lakshmana, वासः residence, तथा so also, राघवस्य Rama's, बाणेन with arrow, वालिनः Vali's, वधश्च death, तथा so also, रामकोपात् due to Rama's anger, अशेषाणाम् of the entire lot, रक्षसानाम् demons, वधश्च death, इदम् this, विकृतं च unwanted consequence, कृतम् was done.
explanation: 'The exile of Rama and Lakshmana into the forest along with Sita, so also the death of Vali and of the demons in the hands of Rama due to his anger are all evil consequences of a boon granted to Kaikeyi.'

shloka_text: तदसुखमनुकीर्तितं वचो भुवि पतितांश्च समीक्ष्य वानरान्। भृशचलितमतिर्महामतिः कृपणमुदाहृतवान् स गृध्रराट्।।4.56.17।।
transliteration: tadasukhamanukīrtitaṃ vaco bhuvi patitāṃśca samīkṣya vānarān| bhṛśacalitamatirmahāmatiḥ kṛpaṇamudāhṛtavān sa gṛdhrarāṭ
translation: अनुकीर्तितम् which was described, असुखम् unhappy , तत् that, वचः words, भुवि on the earth, पतितान् fallen, वानरान् monkeys, समीक्ष्य observing, महामतिः wise, सः he, गृध्राराट् the king of vultures, भृशचलितमतिः shaken up mentally, कृपणम् wretched, उदाहृतवान् narrated.
explanation: The wise king of vultures was shaken up mentally on seeing the monkeys lying on the ground and hearing the unhappy narration of Angada. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आतिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the  fiftysixth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तत्तु श्रुत्वा तथा वाक्यमङ्गदस्य मुखोद्गतम्। अब्रवीद्वचनं गृध्रस्तीक्ष्णतुण्डो महास्वनः।।4.57.1।।
transliteration: tattu śrutvā tathā vākyamaṅgadasya mukhodgatam| abravīdvacanaṃ gṛdhrastīkṣṇatuṇḍo mahāsvanaḥ
translation: तीक्ष्णतुण्डः sharpbeaked, महास्वनः loudvoiced, गृध्रः vulture, तथा like that, अङ्गदस्य of Angada, मुखोद्गतम् came from the mouth, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: On hearing the words that came from Angada's mouth, the sharpbeaked, loudvoiced vulture (Sampati) said:
comments: Angada relates the story of Jatayu's combat with Ravana to Sampati

shloka_text: कोऽयं गिरा घोषयति प्राणैः प्रियतमस्य मे। जटायुषो वधं भ्रातुः कम्पयन्निव मे मनः।।4.57.2।।
transliteration: ko'yaṃ girā ghoṣayati prāṇaiḥ priyatamasya me| jaṭāyuṣo vadhaṃ bhrātuḥ kampayanniva me manaḥ
translation: मे my, प्राणैः with life, प्रियतमस्य dearest, भ्रातुः brother's, जटायुषः Jatayu's, वधम् death, मे my, मनः mind, कम्पयन्निव shaking, गिरा with a word, घोषयति loudly proclaims, अयम् this, कः who is that?
explanation: 'Who is it that was Pronouncing loudly the death of my dearest brother Jatayu? This news has shaken my mind.

shloka_text: कथमासीज्जनस्थाने युद्धं राक्षसगृध्रयोः। नामधेयमिदं भ्रातुश्चिरस्याद्य मया श्रुतम्।।4.57.3।।
transliteration: kathamāsījjanasthāne yuddhaṃ rākṣasagṛdhrayoḥ| nāmadheyamidaṃ bhrātuścirasyādya mayā śrutam
translation: जनस्थाने at Janasthana, राक्षसगृध्रयोः between the demon and the vulture, युद्धम् fight, कथम् how, आसीत् took place, भ्रातुः brother's, इदं नामधेयम् this name, मया by me, अद्य today, चिरस्य श्रुतम् heard after a long time.
explanation: 'I heard my brother's name today after a long time.I wish to know how the demon and the vulture fought at Janasthana.

shloka_text: इच्छेयं गिरिदुर्गाच्च भवद्भिरवतारितुम्। यवीयसो गुणज्ञस्य श्लाघनीयस्य विक्रमैः।।4.57.4।। अतिदीर्घस्य कालस्य परितुष्टोऽस्मि परिकीर्तनात्।
transliteration: iccheyaṃ giridurgācca bhavadbhiravatāritum| yavīyaso guṇajñasya ślāghanīyasya vikramaiḥ atidīrghasya kālasya parituṣṭo'smi parikīrtanāt|
translation: गिरिदुर्गात् from the inaccessible mountain, भवद्भि: by all of you, अवतारितुम् to help to get down, इच्छेयम् I wish, गुणज्ञस्य of the virtuous, विक्रमैः with valour, श्लाघनीयस्य of the praiseworthy, यवीयसः younger brother, अतिदीर्घस्य after a long, कालस्य time, कीर्तनात् by a mention, परितुष्टः अस्मि I am very glad.
explanation: 'I wish to be brought down from this inaccessible mountain peak by all of you. I am glad to have heard from you the name of my younger brother after a long time. He is virtuous, valiant and praiseworthy.

shloka_text: तदिच्छेयमहं श्रोतुं विनाशं वानरर्षभाः।।4.57.5।। भ्रातुर्जटायुषस्तस्य जनस्थाननिवासिनः।
transliteration: tadiccheyamahaṃ śrotuṃ vināśaṃ vānararṣabhāḥ bhrāturjaṭāyuṣastasya janasthānanivāsinaḥ|
translation: वानरर्षभाः O bulls among monkeys, तत् therefore, अहम् I, जनस्थान्निवासिनः of the inhabitant of Janasthana, भ्रातुः brother's, तस्य his, जटायुषः Jatayu's, विनाशम् death, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छेयम् I am desirous.
explanation: 'O bulls among monkeys I desire to hear about the death of my brother Jatayu, who was dwelling at Janasthana.

shloka_text: तस्यैव च मम भ्रातुस्सखा दशरथः कथम्।।4.57.6।। यस्य रामः प्रियः पुत्रो ज्येष्ठो गुरुजनप्रियः।
transliteration: tasyaiva ca mama bhrātussakhā daśarathaḥ katham yasya rāmaḥ priyaḥ putro jyeṣṭho gurujanapriyaḥ|
translation: गुरुजनप्रियः loved by elders, रामः Rama, यस्य whose, प्रियः favourite one, ज्येष्ठः पुत्रः eldest son, मम भ्रातुः my brother's, तस्यैव of him alone, सखा friend, दशरथः Dasaratha, कथम् how.
explanation: 'How did Dasaratha develop friendship with my brother? I hear that Rama who is the favourite firstborn of Dasaratha has endeared himself to all elders.

shloka_text: सूर्यांशुदग्धपक्षत्वान्न शक्नोम्युपसर्पितुम्।।4.57.7।। इच्छेयं पर्वतादस्मादवतर्तु मरिन्दमाः।
transliteration: sūryāṃśudagdhapakṣatvānna śaknomyupasarpitum iccheyaṃ parvatādasmādavatartu marindamāḥ|
translation: अरिन्दमाः O tamers of enemies, सूर्यांशुदग्धपक्षत्वात् due to the burning of my wings by the Sun's rays, उपसर्पितुम् to move forward, न शक्नोमि it is not possible for me, अस्मात् from this, पर्वतात् from the mountain, अवतर्तुम् to get down, इच्छेयम् I want.
explanation: 'O tamers of foes as my wings are burnt down by the Sun's rays it is not possible for me to move forward. I wish you help me to get down from this mountain'.

shloka_text: शोकाद्भ्रष्टस्वरमपि श्रुत्वा ते हरियूथपाः। श्रद्दधुर्नैव तद्वाक्यं कर्मणा तस्य शङ्किताः।।4.57.8।।
transliteration: śokādbhraṣṭasvaramapi śrutvā te hariyūthapāḥ| śraddadhurnaiva tadvākyaṃ karmaṇā tasya śaṅkitāḥ
translation: हरियूथपाः leaders among monkeys, शोकात् owing to grief, भ्रष्टस्वरमपि even if he had his voice had been choked, तद्वाक्यम् his words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, तस्य his, कर्मणा by the intention, शङ्किताः suspicious, नैव श्रद्दधुः they did not believe.
explanation: The leaders among monkeys did not trust his words even though his voice was choked with grief. They suspected his intentions.

shloka_text: ते प्रायमुपविष्टास्तु दृष्ट्वा गृध्रं प्लवङ्गमाः। चक्रुर्बुद्धिं तदा रौद्रां सर्वान्नो भक्षयिष्यति।।4.57.9।।
transliteration: te prāyamupaviṣṭāstu dṛṣṭvā gṛdhraṃ plavaṅgamāḥ| cakrurbuddhiṃ tadā raudrāṃ sarvānno bhakṣayiṣyati
translation: प्रायम् fasting unto death, उपविष्टाः seated, ते प्लवङ्गमाः those monkeys, गृध्रम् vulture, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, तदा then, नः us, सर्वान् all, भक्षयिष्यति he will eat away, रौद्रम् terribly, बुद्धिम् in their minds, चक्रुः  thought .
explanation: On seeing the vulture, the monkeys fasting unto death got a terrible thought in their minds that the vulture might eat them.

shloka_text: सर्वथा प्रायमासीनान्यदि नो भक्षयिष्यति। कृतकृत्या भविष्यामः क्षिप्रं सिद्धिमितो गताः।।4.57.10।।
transliteration: sarvathā prāyamāsīnānyadi no bhakṣayiṣyati| kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyāmaḥ kṣipraṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
translation: प्रायम् आसीनान् welcoming death, नः us, भक्षयिष्यति यदि if he eats us away, इतः from here, क्षिप्रम् soon, सिद्धिम् accomplishment, गताः attained, सर्वथा by all means, कृतकृत्याः we succeed in our objective, भविष्यामः we will be.
explanation: 'Since we wish to die, we will be accomplishing our objective successfully if he eats us soon'.

shloka_text: एतां बुद्धिं ततश्चक्रुस्सर्वे ते वानरर्षभाः। अवतार्य गिरेश्शृङ्गाद्गृध्रमाहाङ्गदस्तदा।।4.57.11।।
transliteration: etāṃ buddhiṃ tataścakrussarve te vānararṣabhāḥ| avatārya gireśśṛṅgādgṛdhramāhāṅgadastadā
translation: ततः then, सर्वे all, ते वानरर्षाभाः those heroic monkeys, एताम् this way, बुद्धिम् thought, चक्रुः they entertained, तदा then, अङ्गदः Angada, गृध्रम् vulture, गिरेः mountain's, शृङ्गात् from the peak, अवतार्य having brought down, आह he said.
explanation: Thus thought the chief among the monkeys. Angada having helped the vulture come down the mountain peak, said:

shloka_text: बभूवर्क्षरजा नाम वानरेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्। ममार्यः पार्थिवः पक्षिन् धार्मिक स्तस्य चात्मजौ।।4.57.12। सुग्रीवश्चैव वाली च पुत्रावोघबलावुभौ। लोकेविश्रुतकर्माभूद्राजा वाली पिता मम।।4.57.13।।
transliteration: babhūvarkṣarajā nāma vānarendraḥ pratāpavān| mamāryaḥ pārthivaḥ pakṣin dhārmika stasya cātmajau||4.57.12| sugrīvaścaiva vālī ca putrāvoghabalāvubhau| lokeviśrutakarmābhūdrājā vālī pitā mama
translation: पक्षिन् O bird, प्रतापवान् powerful, वानरेन्द्रः king of monkeys, मम my, आर्यः revered ancestor, ऋक्षरजा Riksharaja's, नाम named, पार्थिवः a king, बभूव was, ओघबलौ strong like flood water, उभौ both, सुग्रीवश्चैव Sugriva, वाली च and Vali, तस्य his, धार्मिकौ righteous, आत्मजौ पुत्रौ his two sons, मम my, पिता father, वाली Vali, लोके in the world, विश्रुतकर्मा famous by his great deeds, राजा king, अभूत् was.
explanation: 'O powerful bird my revered grandfather Riksharaja was a glorious king of monkeys. He had two sons called Sugriva and Vali.Both were strong like floodwaters. My father Vali was wellknown in this world for his remarkable deeds.

shloka_text: बभूवर्क्षरजा नाम वानरेन्द्रः प्रतापवान्। ममार्यः पार्थिवः पक्षिन् धार्मिक स्तस्य चात्मजौ।।4.57.12। सुग्रीवश्चैव वाली च पुत्रावोघबलावुभौ। लोकेविश्रुतकर्माभूद्राजा वाली पिता मम।।4.57.13।।
transliteration: babhūvarkṣarajā nāma vānarendraḥ pratāpavān| mamāryaḥ pārthivaḥ pakṣin dhārmika stasya cātmajau||4.57.12| sugrīvaścaiva vālī ca putrāvoghabalāvubhau| lokeviśrutakarmābhūdrājā vālī pitā mama
translation: पक्षिन् O bird, प्रतापवान् powerful, वानरेन्द्रः king of monkeys, मम my, आर्यः revered ancestor, ऋक्षरजा Riksharaja's, नाम named, पार्थिवः a king, बभूव was, ओघबलौ strong like flood water, उभौ both, सुग्रीवश्चैव Sugriva, वाली च and Vali, तस्य his, धार्मिकौ righteous, आत्मजौ पुत्रौ his two sons, मम my, पिता father, वाली Vali, लोके in the world, विश्रुतकर्मा famous by his great deeds, राजा king, अभूत् was.
explanation: 'O powerful bird my revered grandfather Riksharaja was a glorious king of monkeys. He had two sons called Sugriva and Vali.Both were strong like floodwaters. My father Vali was wellknown in this world for his remarkable deeds.

shloka_text: राजा कृत्स्नस्य जगत इक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः। रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान्प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्।।4.57.14।। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या चापि भार्यया। पितुर्निदेशनिरतो धर्म्यं पन्थानमाश्रितः।।4.57.15।।
transliteration: rājā kṛtsnasya jagata ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahārathaḥ| rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmānpraviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā cāpi bhāryayā| piturnideśanirato dharmyaṃ panthānamāśritaḥ
translation: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of Ikshvaku race, महारथः great warrior, कृत्स्नस्य of the entire, जगतः world, राजा king, श्रीमान् illustrious, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son, रामः Rama's, पितुः father's, निदेशनिरतः obeying his command, धर्म्यम् righteous, पन्थानम् path, आश्रितः seeking, भ्रात्रा with his brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, भार्यया with his wife, वैदेह्या चापि and with Vaidehi, दण्डकावनम् forest of Dandaka, प्रविष्टः he entered.
explanation: 'The great warrior Rama is the son of Dasaratha, the scion of the Ikshvaku race and the king of the entire world. He entered Dandaka forest along with his brother Lakshmana and consort Vaidehi obeying his father's command following a righteous path.

shloka_text: राजा कृत्स्नस्य जगत इक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः। रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान्प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम्।।4.57.14।। लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वैदेह्या चापि भार्यया। पितुर्निदेशनिरतो धर्म्यं पन्थानमाश्रितः।।4.57.15।।
transliteration: rājā kṛtsnasya jagata ikṣvākūṇāṃ mahārathaḥ| rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmānpraviṣṭo daṇḍakāvanam lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vaidehyā cāpi bhāryayā| piturnideśanirato dharmyaṃ panthānamāśritaḥ
translation: इक्ष्वाकूणाम् of Ikshvaku race, महारथः great warrior, कृत्स्नस्य of the entire, जगतः world, राजा king, श्रीमान् illustrious, दाशरथिः Dasaratha's son, रामः Rama's, पितुः father's, निदेशनिरतः obeying his command, धर्म्यम् righteous, पन्थानम् path, आश्रितः seeking, भ्रात्रा with his brother, लक्ष्मणेन सह along with Lakshmana, भार्यया with his wife, वैदेह्या चापि and with Vaidehi, दण्डकावनम् forest of Dandaka, प्रविष्टः he entered.
explanation: 'The great warrior Rama is the son of Dasaratha, the scion of the Ikshvaku race and the king of the entire world. He entered Dandaka forest along with his brother Lakshmana and consort Vaidehi obeying his father's command following a righteous path.

shloka_text: तस्य भार्या जनस्थानाद्रावणेन हृता बलात्। रामस्य तु पितुर्मित्रं जटायुर्नाम गृध्रराट्।।4.57.16।। ददर्श सीतां वैदेहीं ह्रियमाणां विहायसा।
transliteration: tasya bhāryā janasthānādrāvaṇena hṛtā balāt| rāmasya tu piturmitraṃ jaṭāyurnāma gṛdhrarāṭ dadarśa sītāṃ vaidehīṃ hriyamāṇāṃ vihāyasā|
translation: तस्य his, भार्या wife, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, रावणेन by Ravana, बलात् with force, हृता is abducted, रामस्य Rama's, पितुः father's, मित्रम् friend, जटायुर्नाम called Jatayu, गृध्रराट् king of vultures, विहायसा flying through aerial region, ह्रियमाणाम्  forcibly taken away, वैदेहीम् princess of Videha, सीताम् Sita, ददर्श he saw.
explanation: 'His wife was abducted from Janasthana by Ravana. The king of vultures Jatayu, a friend of Rama's father observed princess of Videha, being forcibly carried away through the aerial region.

shloka_text: रावणं विरथं कृत्वा स्थापयित्वा च मैथिलीम्। परिश्रान्तश्च वृद्धश्च रावणेन हतो रणे।।4.57.17।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṃ virathaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayitvā ca maithilīm| pariśrāntaśca vṛddhaśca rāvaṇena hato raṇe
translation: रावणम् Ravana, विरथम् deprived of the chariot, कृत्वा after defeating, मैथिलीं च and Maithili, स्थापयित्वा putting her at a place, परिश्रान्तश्च exhausted one, वृद्धश्च and old one also, रणे in combat, रावणेन by Ravana, हतः was killed.
explanation: 'Jatayu destroyed Ravana's aerial chariot and put Maithili in a (safe) place. But being old and exhausted, he was killed in a combat by Ravana.

shloka_text: एवं गृध्रो हतस्तेन रावणेन बलीयसा। संस्कृतश्चापि रामेण गतश्च गतिमुत्तमाम्।।4.57.18।।
transliteration: evaṃ gṛdhro hatastena rāvaṇena balīyasā| saṃskṛtaścāpi rāmeṇa gataśca gatimuttamām
translation: गृध्रः vulture, एवम् that way, बलीयसा by a stronger one, तेन रावणेन by that Ravana, हतः slain, रामेण by Rama, संस्कृतश्चासि cremated according to rites, उत्तमां गतिम् supreme abode, गतश्च reached.
explanation: 'Thus the vulture was slain by Ravana who was stronger. Cremated by Rama and his last rites performed, he reached the supreme heavenly abode. (It was the luck of Jatayu, unlike Dasaratha, to be cremated by Rama.)

shloka_text: ततो मम पितृव्येण सुग्रीवेण महात्मना। चकार राघवस्सख्यं सोऽवधीत्पितरं मम।।4.57.19।।
transliteration: tato mama pitṛvyeṇa sugrīveṇa mahātmanā| cakāra rāghavassakhyaṃ so'vadhītpitaraṃ mama
translation: ततः then, राघवः Rama, मम my, पितृव्येण with my father's brother, महात्मना by the great self, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, सख्यम् friendship, चकार made, सः he, Rama, पितरम् my father, अवधीत् killed.
explanation: 'Then Rama made friendship with my father's brother, great self Sugriva and killed my father.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तः करुणं वाक्यं वानरैस्त्यक्तजीवितैः। सबाष्पो वानरान्गृध्रः प्रत्युवाच महास्वनः।।4.58.1।।
transliteration: ityuktaḥ karuṇaṃ vākyaṃ vānaraistyaktajīvitaiḥ| sabāṣpo vānarāngṛdhraḥ pratyuvāca mahāsvanaḥ
translation: त्यक्तजीवितैः who had given up hope of life, वानरैः by monkeys, इति thus, करुणम् pathetic, वाक्यम् words, उक्तः spoken, महास्वनः loudvoiced, गृध्रः vulture, सबाष्पः with tears, वानरान्   the monkeys, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: On hearing the pathetic words from the monkeys who had given up hope of life, the loudvoiced vulture wailing replied:
comments: Samapati narrates his story to the monkeys says he saw Sita being carried off by Ravana to Lanka.

shloka_text: यवीयान्मम भ्राता जटायुर्नाम वानराः। यमाख्यात हतं युद्धे रावणेन बलीयसा।।4.58.2।।
transliteration: yavīyānmama bhrātā jaṭāyurnāma vānarāḥ| yamākhyāta hataṃ yuddhe rāvaṇena balīyasā
translation: वानराः O monkeys, यम् whom, बलीयसा by a strong, रावणेन by Ravana, युद्धे in the combat, हतम् killed, आख्यात you told, जटायुः नाम called Jatayu, सः he is, मम my, यवीयान् younger, भ्राता brother.
explanation: 'O monkeys, the one you said to have been killed by mighty Ravana in a combat was  my younger brother, Jatayu.

shloka_text: वृद्धभावादपक्षत्वाच्छृण्वंस्तदपि मर्षये। न हि मे शक्तिरस्त्यद्य भ्रातुर्वैरविमोक्षणे।।4.58.3।।
transliteration: vṛddhabhāvādapakṣatvācchṛṇvaṃstadapi marṣaye| na hi me śaktirastyadya bhrāturvairavimokṣaṇe
translation: तत् that, श्रुण्वन् अपि even after hearing , वृद्धभावात् due to old age, अपक्षत्वात् since I have no wings, मे to me, अद्य now, भ्रातुः brother's, वैरविमोक्षणे to avenge the death, शक्तिः energy, नास्ति हि I do not have.
explanation: 'Even after I have heard this, I cannot avenge my brother's death as I am old, I have no wings, and I have no energy enough (to fight).

shloka_text: पुरा वृत्रवधे वृत्ते परस्परजयैषिणौ। आदित्यमुपयातौ स्वो ज्वलन्तं रश्मिमालिनम्।।4.58.4।।
transliteration: purā vṛtravadhe vṛtte parasparajayaiṣiṇau| ādityamupayātau svo jvalantaṃ raśmimālinam
translation: पुरा in olden days, वृत्रवधे at the time of the death of Vrutra, वृत्ते परस्पर when Vrutra and Indra, जयैषिणौ wishing to win, ज्वलन्तम् blazing, रश्मिमालिनम् with a garland of beams, आदित्यम् to Sun, उपयातौ both went, स्वः we both.
explanation: 'In olden days, when Indra killed Vrutra we (Jatayu and I) seeking to challenge him reached the Sun blazing with a garland of beams.

shloka_text: आवृत्त्याऽकाशमार्गे तु जवेन स्म गतौ भृशम्। मध्यं प्राप्ते दिनकरे जटायुरवसीदति।।4.58.5।।
transliteration: āvṛttyā'kāśamārge tu javena sma gatau bhṛśam| madhyaṃ prāpte dinakare jaṭāyuravasīdati
translation: आकाशमार्गे in the sky, आवृत्य surrounding, भृशम् violently, जवेन at high speed, गतौ स्म both of us reached, मध्यम् in the midst, प्राप्ते when reached, दिनकरे when the Sun, जटायुः Jatayu's, अवसीदति became weak.
explanation: 'Flying in the sky at a violently high speed, we reached the meridian of the Sun when, unable to bear the heat, Jatayu became weak.

shloka_text: तमहं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा सूर्यरश्मिभिरर्दितम्। पक्षाभ्यां छादयामास स्नेहात्परमविह्वलः।।4.58.6।।
transliteration: tamahaṃ bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sūryaraśmibhirarditam| pakṣābhyāṃ chādayāmāsa snehātparamavihvalaḥ
translation: भ्रातरम् my brother, तम् him, सूर्यरश्मिभिः with Sun's radiance, अर्दितम् tormented, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, परमविह्वल: overwhelmed, अहम् I, स्नेहात् lovingly, पक्षाभ्याम् with both my wings, छादयामास I covered.
explanation: 'Seeing my brother tormented due to the Sun's radiance I was overwhelmed with grief. Out of love I covered him with both my wings.

shloka_text: निर्दग्धपक्षः पतितो विन्ध्येऽहं वानरर्षभाः। अहमस्मिन्वसन्भ्रातुः प्रवृत्तिं नोपलक्षये।।4.58.7।।
transliteration: nirdagdhapakṣaḥ patito vindhye'haṃ vānararṣabhāḥ| ahamasminvasanbhrātuḥ pravṛttiṃ nopalakṣaye
translation: वानरर्षभाः O bulls among monkeys, अहम् I am, निर्दग्धपत्रः with burnt wings, विन्ध्ये on Vindhya, पतितः dropped down, अस्मिन् in this place, वसन् while I lived, अहम् I, भ्रातुः brother's, प्रवृत्तिम् news, नोपलक्षये not known to me.
explanation: 'O bulls among monkeys, consequently my wings were burnt and I dropped down on Vindhya. Here I have been living, knowing not my brother's whereabouts.'

shloka_text: जटायुषस्त्वेवमुक्तो भ्रात्रा सम्पातिना तदा। युवराजो महाप्राज्ञः प्रत्युवाचाङ्गदस्ततः।।4.58.8।।
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣastvevamukto bhrātrā sampātinā tadā| yuvarājo mahāprājñaḥ pratyuvācāṅgadastataḥ
translation: तदा then, जटायुषः Jatayu's, भ्रात्रा by brother, सम्पातिना by Sampathi, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having been told, महाप्राज्ञः highly learned one, युवराजः heir apparent, अङ्गदः Angada, ततः then, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: To these words of Jatayu's brother, Sampati, Angada, the learned heir apparent replied:

shloka_text: जटायुषो यदि भ्राता श्रुतं ते गदितं मया। आख्या हि यदि जानासि निलयं तस्य रक्षसः।।4.58.9।।
transliteration: jaṭāyuṣo yadi bhrātā śrutaṃ te gaditaṃ mayā| ākhyā hi yadi jānāsi nilayaṃ tasya rakṣasaḥ
translation: ते your, गदितम् word, मया by me, श्रुतम् is heard, जटायुषः Jatayu's, भ्राता यदि if you are brother, जानासि यदि if you know, तस्य his, रक्षसः demon's निलयम् residence, आख्याहि tell.
explanation: 'I have heard you. If you are the brother of Jatayu, tell us about the abode of that demon if you know.

shloka_text: अदीर्घदर्शिनं तं वै रावणं राक्षसाधिपम्। अन्तिके यदि वा दूरे यदि जानासि शंस नः।।4.58.10।।
transliteration: adīrghadarśinaṃ taṃ vai rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam| antike yadi vā dūre yadi jānāsi śaṃsa naḥ
translation: अदीर्घदर्शिनम् one who is not farsighted, राक्षसाधिपम् king of demons, तं रावणम् that Ravana, अन्तिके near, दूरे यदि वा far away, जानासि यदि if you know, नः us, शंस tell.
explanation: 'Tell us about Ravana, king of the demons who is unaware of the consequences. If you know his residence, tell us if it is near or far.'

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीन्महातेजा ज्येष्ठो भ्राता जटायुषः। आत्मानुरूपं वचनं वानरान्सम्प्रहर्षयन्।।4.58.11।।
transliteration: tato'bravīnmahātejā jyeṣṭho bhrātā jaṭāyuṣaḥ| ātmānurūpaṃ vacanaṃ vānarānsampraharṣayan
translation: ततः then, जटायुषः Jatayu's, ज्येष्ठः भ्राता elder brother, महातेजाः very  glorious, वानरान् monkeys, अत्मानुरूपम् in a befitting manner, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said, सम्प्रहर्षयन् while pleasing them.
explanation: Then Jatayu's elder brother, the glorious Sampati, said these pleasing, befitting words:

shloka_text: निर्दग्धपक्षो गृध्रोऽहं हीनवीर्य: प्लवङ्गमाः। वाङ्मात्रेण तु रामस्य करिष्ये साह्यमुत्तमम्।।4.58.12।।
transliteration: nirdagdhapakṣo gṛdhro'haṃ hīnavīrya: plavaṅgamāḥ| vāṅmātreṇa tu rāmasya kariṣye sāhyamuttamam
translation: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, निर्दग्धपक्षः my wings are totally burnt, हीनवीर्यः my strength is reduced, गृध्रः vulture, अहम् I, वाङ्मात्रेणा only by my words, रामस्य to Rama, उत्तमम् substantial, साह्यम् help, करिष्ये I will do.
explanation: 'O monkeys I am a vulture. My wings are burnt and my strength is depleted. The only substantial help I can render Rama is through my words.

shloka_text: जानामि वारुणान्लोकान्विष्णोस्त्रै विक्रमानपि। महासुरविमर्दन्वा श्च ह्यमृतस्य च मन्थनम्।।4.58.13।।
transliteration: jānāmi vāruṇānlokānviṣṇostrai vikramānapi| mahāsuravimardanvā śca hyamṛtasya ca manthanam
translation: वारुणान् Varuna's, लोकान् world, त्रैविक्रमान् three strides, विष्णोः Visnu's, लोकान् worlds, महासुरविमर्दान् the fricton between gods and demons, अमृतस्य for the nectar , च मन्थनम् and the churning, जानामि I know, अपि indeed.
explanation: 'I know Varuna's worlds(seas and oceans) and all the three worlds measured by three  strides  by Vamana. Indeed I also know about the friction between the great gods and demons and the churning of the ocean for nectar.

shloka_text: रामस्य यदिदं कार्यं कर्तव्यं प्रथमं मया। जरया च हृतं तेजः प्राणाश्च शिथिला मम।।4.58.14।।
transliteration: rāmasya yadidaṃ kāryaṃ kartavyaṃ prathamaṃ mayā| jarayā ca hṛtaṃ tejaḥ prāṇāśca śithilā mama
translation: रामस्य Rama's, यत् if, इदं कार्यम् this task, मया by me, प्रथमम् first, कर्तव्यम् duty, हृतम् should be done, प्राणाश्च vitality, शिथिलाः reduced, मम my, जरया due to old age, तेज: strength.
explanation: 'Rama's work is my primary duty. (But) my strength is drained by age and I have lost my vitality.

shloka_text: तरुणी रूपसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना।।4.58.15।। क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च भामिनी। भूषणान्यपविध्यन्ती गात्राणि च विधुन्वती।।4.58.16।।
transliteration: taruṇī rūpasampannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā| hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rāvaṇena durātmanā krośantī rāma rāmeti lakṣmaṇeti ca bhāminī| bhūṣaṇānyapavidhyantī gātrāṇi ca vidhunvatī
translation: दुरात्मना by the evilminded, रावणेन by Ravana, ह्रियमाणा being borne away, तरुणी young lady, रूपसम्पन्ना beautiful in appearance, सर्वाभरणभूषिता adorned with all kinds of jewels, रामरामेति calling out 'Rama, Rama', लक्ष्मणेति च and calling out 'Lakshmana', क्रोशन्ती crying aloud, भूषणानि ornaments, अपविध्यन्ती thrown down, गात्राणि limbs,विधून्वती wriggling to get out, भामिनी a dainty lady, मया by me, दृष्टा was seen.
explanation: 'I saw a young lady of beautiful appearance, adorned with all kinds of ornaments  borne away by the evilminded Ravana. That dainty lady was calling out, 'O Rama,  O Lakshmana' and was crying aloud. She was throwing away her ornaments and was wriggling to get out of Ravana's grip.

shloka_text: तरुणी रूपसम्पन्ना सर्वाभरणभूषिता। ह्रियमाणा मया दृष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना।।4.58.15।। क्रोशन्ती राम रामेति लक्ष्मणेति च भामिनी। भूषणान्यपविध्यन्ती गात्राणि च विधुन्वती।।4.58.16।।
transliteration: taruṇī rūpasampannā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā| hriyamāṇā mayā dṛṣṭā rāvaṇena durātmanā krośantī rāma rāmeti lakṣmaṇeti ca bhāminī| bhūṣaṇānyapavidhyantī gātrāṇi ca vidhunvatī
translation: दुरात्मना by the evilminded, रावणेन by Ravana, ह्रियमाणा being borne away, तरुणी young lady, रूपसम्पन्ना beautiful in appearance, सर्वाभरणभूषिता adorned with all kinds of jewels, रामरामेति calling out 'Rama, Rama', लक्ष्मणेति च and calling out 'Lakshmana', क्रोशन्ती crying aloud, भूषणानि ornaments, अपविध्यन्ती thrown down, गात्राणि limbs,विधून्वती wriggling to get out, भामिनी a dainty lady, मया by me, दृष्टा was seen.
explanation: 'I saw a young lady of beautiful appearance, adorned with all kinds of ornaments  borne away by the evilminded Ravana. That dainty lady was calling out, 'O Rama,  O Lakshmana' and was crying aloud. She was throwing away her ornaments and was wriggling to get out of Ravana's grip.

shloka_text: सूर्यप्रभेव शैलाग्रे तस्याः कौशेयमुत्तमम्। असिते राक्षसे भाति यथा वा तटिदम्बुदे।।4.58.17।।
transliteration: sūryaprabheva śailāgre tasyāḥ kauśeyamuttamam| asite rākṣase bhāti yathā vā taṭidambude
translation: असिते in dark, राक्षसे on the demon, तस्याः her, उत्तमम् fine, कौशेयम् silken cloth, शैलाग्रे on the peak of the mountain, सूर्यप्रभेव like the radiance of Sun, अम्बुदे in the dark cloud, यथा like that, वा तटित् यथा like lightning, भाति shining.
explanation: 'Her fine silk garment was shining like the radiance of the Sun on the mountain peak, like lightning against the dark cloud. (That was Ravana).

shloka_text: तां तु सीतामहं मन्ये रामस्य परिकीर्तनात्। श्रूयतां मे कथयतो निलयं तस्य रक्षसः।।4.58.18।।
transliteration: tāṃ tu sītāmahaṃ manye rāmasya parikīrtanāt| śrūyatāṃ me kathayato nilayaṃ tasya rakṣasaḥ
translation: रामस्य Rama's, परिकीर्तनात् was uttering, ताम् her, सीताम् Sita, अहम् I, मन्ये I think, तस्य his, रक्षसः demon's, निलयम् abode, कथयतः described, मे by me, श्रूयताम् you may listen.
explanation: 'Since she was uttering Rama's name I think she is Sita. (Now) I will tell you about the demon's abode. Listen

shloka_text: पुत्रो विश्रवस स्साक्षाद्भ्राता वैश्रवणस्य च। अध्यास्ते नगरीं लङ्कां रावणो नाम राक्षसः।।4.58.19।।
transliteration: putro viśravasa ssākṣādbhrātā vaiśravaṇasya ca| adhyāste nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ rāvaṇo nāma rākṣasaḥ
translation: विश्रवसः Vishravas's, पुत्रः son, साक्षात् real, वैश्रवणस्य Vyshravana's, भ्राता brother, रावणो नाम  called Ravana, राक्षसः rakshasa, लङ्कां नगरीम् city of Lanka, अध्यास्ते resides.
explanation: 'He is Vishrava's son and halfbrother of Vaishravana. His name is Ravana and he resides in the city of Lanka.

shloka_text: इतो द्वीपस्समुद्रस्य सम्पूर्णे शतयोजने। तस्मिन्लङ्कापुरी रम्या निर्मिता विश्वकर्मणा।।4.58.20।।
transliteration: ito dvīpassamudrasya sampūrṇe śatayojane| tasminlaṅkāpurī ramyā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā
translation: इतः from here, सम्पूर्णे when completed, शतयोजने a hundred yojanas, द्वीपः island, तस्मिन् in it, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, निर्मिता built, रम्या beautiful, लङ्कापुरी capital of Lanka.
explanation: 'The beautiful city of Lanka is an island, a hundred yojanas away from here.It was built by Visvakarma.

shloka_text: जाम्बूनदमयैर्द्वारैश्चित्रैः काञ्चनवेदिकैः। प्रासादैर्हेमवर्णैश्च महद्भिः सुसमा कृता।।4.58.21।। प्राकारेणार्कवर्णेन महता च समान्विता।
transliteration: jāmbūnadamayairdvāraiścitraiḥ kāñcanavedikaiḥ| prāsādairhemavarṇaiśca mahadbhiḥ susamā kṛtā prākāreṇārkavarṇena mahatā ca samānvitā|
translation: जाम्बूनदमयैः made of gold, चित्रैः wonderful, द्वारैः doors, काञ्चनवेदिकैः with golden platforms, हेमवर्णैश्च  of golden colour, महद्भिः with a huge, प्रासादैः mansions, सुसमाः uniformly built, आवृता covered, अर्कवर्णेन in the colour of Sun light, महता प्राकारेण with a tall boundary wall, समन्विता endowed.
explanation: 'The city has golden gates, golden platforms, huge, goldencoloured, uniformly built mansions surrounded by a tall boundary wall of the colour of sunlight.

shloka_text: तस्यां वसति वैदेही दीना कौशेयवासिनी।।4.58.22।। रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिस्सुरक्षिता। जनकस्यात्मजां राज्ञस्तत्र द्रक्ष्यथ मैथिलीम्।।4.58.23।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ vasati vaidehī dīnā kauśeyavāsinī rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā rākṣasībhissurakṣitā| janakasyātmajāṃ rājñastatra drakṣyatha maithilīm
translation: दीना dejected, कौशेयवासिनी lady wearing silk garment, वैदेही Vaidehi, तस्याम् in the city, रावणान्तःपुरे in the harem, रुद्धा confined, राक्षसीभिः by demonesses, सुरक्षिता well protected, वसति lives, तस्याम् in that city, राज्ञः the king's, जनकस्य Janaka's, आत्मजाम् daughter, मैथिलीम् Maithili, द्रक्ष्यथ you will see.
explanation: 'You will see in the city of Lanka, the princess from Videha, daughter of Janaka, a picture of dejection, robed in silk, confined in the harem of Ravana, wellprotected by demonesses.

shloka_text: तस्यां वसति वैदेही दीना कौशेयवासिनी।।4.58.22।। रावणान्तःपुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभिस्सुरक्षिता। जनकस्यात्मजां राज्ञस्तत्र द्रक्ष्यथ मैथिलीम्।।4.58.23।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ vasati vaidehī dīnā kauśeyavāsinī rāvaṇāntaḥpure ruddhā rākṣasībhissurakṣitā| janakasyātmajāṃ rājñastatra drakṣyatha maithilīm
translation: दीना dejected, कौशेयवासिनी lady wearing silk garment, वैदेही Vaidehi, तस्याम् in the city, रावणान्तःपुरे in the harem, रुद्धा confined, राक्षसीभिः by demonesses, सुरक्षिता well protected, वसति lives, तस्याम् in that city, राज्ञः the king's, जनकस्य Janaka's, आत्मजाम् daughter, मैथिलीम् Maithili, द्रक्ष्यथ you will see.
explanation: 'You will see in the city of Lanka, the princess from Videha, daughter of Janaka, a picture of dejection, robed in silk, confined in the harem of Ravana, wellprotected by demonesses.

shloka_text: लङ्कायामथ गुप्तायां सागरेण समन्ततः। सम्प्राप्य सागरस्यान्तं सम्पूर्णं शतयोजनम्।।4.58.24।। आसाद्य दक्षिणं तीरं ततो द्रक्ष्यथ रावणम्। तत्रैव त्वरिताः क्षिप्रं विक्रमध्वं प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.58.25।।
transliteration: laṅkāyāmatha guptāyāṃ sāgareṇa samantataḥ| samprāpya sāgarasyāntaṃ sampūrṇaṃ śatayojanam āsādya dakṣiṇaṃ tīraṃ tato drakṣyatha rāvaṇam| tatraiva tvaritāḥ kṣipraṃ vikramadhvaṃ plavaṅgamāḥ
translation: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, सम्पूर्णम् a complete, शतयोजनम् hundred yojanas, सागरस्य of the sea, अन्तम् end, सम्प्राप्य having reached, अथ then, दक्षिणं तीरम् southern coast, आसाद्य on reaching, ततः then, समन्ततः all around, सागरेण by the sea, गुप्तायाम् protected, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, रावणम् Ravana, द्रक्ष्यथ will see, त्वरिताः swiftly, तत्रैव there, क्षिप्रम् at once, विक्रमध्वम् prove your strength.
explanation: 'O monkeys traverse a hundred yojanas across the sea. On reaching the southern coast you will be able to see Ravana's Lanka defended and surrounded by the sea. Now proceed swiftly and prove your strength.

shloka_text: लङ्कायामथ गुप्तायां सागरेण समन्ततः। सम्प्राप्य सागरस्यान्तं सम्पूर्णं शतयोजनम्।।4.58.24।। आसाद्य दक्षिणं तीरं ततो द्रक्ष्यथ रावणम्। तत्रैव त्वरिताः क्षिप्रं विक्रमध्वं प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.58.25।।
transliteration: laṅkāyāmatha guptāyāṃ sāgareṇa samantataḥ| samprāpya sāgarasyāntaṃ sampūrṇaṃ śatayojanam āsādya dakṣiṇaṃ tīraṃ tato drakṣyatha rāvaṇam| tatraiva tvaritāḥ kṣipraṃ vikramadhvaṃ plavaṅgamāḥ
translation: प्लवङ्गमाः O monkeys, सम्पूर्णम् a complete, शतयोजनम् hundred yojanas, सागरस्य of the sea, अन्तम् end, सम्प्राप्य having reached, अथ then, दक्षिणं तीरम् southern coast, आसाद्य on reaching, ततः then, समन्ततः all around, सागरेण by the sea, गुप्तायाम् protected, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, रावणम् Ravana, द्रक्ष्यथ will see, त्वरिताः swiftly, तत्रैव there, क्षिप्रम् at once, विक्रमध्वम् prove your strength.
explanation: 'O monkeys traverse a hundred yojanas across the sea. On reaching the southern coast you will be able to see Ravana's Lanka defended and surrounded by the sea. Now proceed swiftly and prove your strength.

shloka_text: ज्ञानेन खलु पश्यामि दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यागमिष्यथ। आद्यः पन्थाः कुलिङ्गानां ये चान्ये धान्यजीविनः।।4.58.26।। द्वितीयो बलिभोजानां ये च वृक्षफलाशिनः। भासास्तृतीयं गच्छन्ति क्रौञ्चाश्च कुररैस्सह।।4.58.27।। श्येनाश्चतुर्थं गच्छन्ति गृध्रा गच्छन्ति पञ्चमम्।
transliteration: jñānena khalu paśyāmi dṛṣṭvā pratyāgamiṣyatha| ādyaḥ panthāḥ kuliṅgānāṃ ye cānye dhānyajīvinaḥ dvitīyo balibhojānāṃ ye ca vṛkṣaphalāśinaḥ| bhāsāstṛtīyaṃ gacchanti krauñcāśca kuraraissaha śyenāścaturthaṃ gacchanti gṛdhrā gacchanti pañcamam|
translation: ज्ञानेन by intuition, पश्यामि खलु I can see, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रत्यागमिष्यथ you will return, कुलिङ्गानाम् of sparrows, अन्ये and other, धान्यजीविनः living on grain, ये those, आद्यः first, पन्थाः path, बलिभोजानाम् crows living on the offerings of food, वृक्षफलाशनाः eating the fruits of trees, ये those, द्वितीयः second, भासाः cocks, कुररैस्सह along with cranes, क्रौञ्चाश्च and Kraunchas, तृतीयम् third, गच्छन्ति move about, श्येनाः hawks and falcons, चतुर्थम् fourth, गच्छन्ति move about, गृध्राः vultures, पञ्चमम् fifth, गच्छन्ति moving.
explanation: 'By intuition I know you would see Sita and return. On the first plane you will see sparrows and birds which live on grain. On the second, you will see crows living on the food offered to the dead and birds living on the fruits of trees, and then cocks, cranes and kraunchas moving on the third plane, on the fourth, hawks and falcons and on the fifth, vultures.

shloka_text: ज्ञानेन खलु पश्यामि दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यागमिष्यथ। आद्यः पन्थाः कुलिङ्गानां ये चान्ये धान्यजीविनः।।4.58.26।। द्वितीयो बलिभोजानां ये च वृक्षफलाशिनः। भासास्तृतीयं गच्छन्ति क्रौञ्चाश्च कुररैस्सह।।4.58.27।। श्येनाश्चतुर्थं गच्छन्ति गृध्रा गच्छन्ति पञ्चमम्।
transliteration: jñānena khalu paśyāmi dṛṣṭvā pratyāgamiṣyatha| ādyaḥ panthāḥ kuliṅgānāṃ ye cānye dhānyajīvinaḥ dvitīyo balibhojānāṃ ye ca vṛkṣaphalāśinaḥ| bhāsāstṛtīyaṃ gacchanti krauñcāśca kuraraissaha śyenāścaturthaṃ gacchanti gṛdhrā gacchanti pañcamam|
translation: ज्ञानेन by intuition, पश्यामि खलु I can see, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रत्यागमिष्यथ you will return, कुलिङ्गानाम् of sparrows, अन्ये and other, धान्यजीविनः living on grain, ये those, आद्यः first, पन्थाः path, बलिभोजानाम् crows living on the offerings of food, वृक्षफलाशनाः eating the fruits of trees, ये those, द्वितीयः second, भासाः cocks, कुररैस्सह along with cranes, क्रौञ्चाश्च and Kraunchas, तृतीयम् third, गच्छन्ति move about, श्येनाः hawks and falcons, चतुर्थम् fourth, गच्छन्ति move about, गृध्राः vultures, पञ्चमम् fifth, गच्छन्ति moving.
explanation: 'By intuition I know you would see Sita and return. On the first plane you will see sparrows and birds which live on grain. On the second, you will see crows living on the food offered to the dead and birds living on the fruits of trees, and then cocks, cranes and kraunchas moving on the third plane, on the fourth, hawks and falcons and on the fifth, vultures.

shloka_text: बलवीर्योपपन्नानां रूपयौवनशालिनाम्।।4.58.28।। षष्ठस्तु पन्था हंसानां वैनतेयगतिः परा। वैनतेयाच्च नो जन्म सर्वेषां वानरर्षभाः।।4.58.29।।
transliteration: balavīryopapannānāṃ rūpayauvanaśālinām ṣaṣṭhastu panthā haṃsānāṃ vainateyagatiḥ parā| vainateyācca no janma sarveṣāṃ vānararṣabhāḥ
translation: वानरर्षभाः O bulls among monkeys बलवीर्योपपन्नानाम् endowed with strength and vigour, रूपयौवनशालिनाम् with beauty and youth, हंसानाम् of swans, षष्ठः the sixth, पन्थाः path, वैनतेयगतिः the path of Garuda, परा is over that, सर्वेषाम् of all, नः of us, जन्म birth, वैनतेयात् from the son of Vinata (Garuda).
explanation: 'O bulls among monkeys swans blessed with strength, vigour,  beauty and youth move in the sixth region. Beyond, on the seventh plane, you will see the descendants of Garuda.

shloka_text: बलवीर्योपपन्नानां रूपयौवनशालिनाम्।।4.58.28।। षष्ठस्तु पन्था हंसानां वैनतेयगतिः परा। वैनतेयाच्च नो जन्म सर्वेषां वानरर्षभाः।।4.58.29।।
transliteration: balavīryopapannānāṃ rūpayauvanaśālinām ṣaṣṭhastu panthā haṃsānāṃ vainateyagatiḥ parā| vainateyācca no janma sarveṣāṃ vānararṣabhāḥ
translation: वानरर्षभाः O bulls among monkeys बलवीर्योपपन्नानाम् endowed with strength and vigour, रूपयौवनशालिनाम् with beauty and youth, हंसानाम् of swans, षष्ठः the sixth, पन्थाः path, वैनतेयगतिः the path of Garuda, परा is over that, सर्वेषाम् of all, नः of us, जन्म birth, वैनतेयात् from the son of Vinata (Garuda).
explanation: 'O bulls among monkeys swans blessed with strength, vigour,  beauty and youth move in the sixth region. Beyond, on the seventh plane, you will see the descendants of Garuda.

shloka_text: इहस्थोऽहं प्रपश्यामि रावणं जानकीं तथा। अस्माकमपि सौवर्णं दिव्यं चक्षुर्बलं तथा।।4.58.30।।
transliteration: ihastho'haṃ prapaśyāmi rāvaṇaṃ jānakīṃ tathā| asmākamapi sauvarṇaṃ divyaṃ cakṣurbalaṃ tathā
translation: इहस्थः from here, अहम् I am, रावणम् Ravana, तथा so also, जानकीम् Janaki also, प्रपश्यामि I can see, अस्माकमपि for us also, सौवर्णम् golden, दिव्यम् divine, चक्षुः vision, तथा so also, बलम् power.
explanation: 'From here I see Ravana and Janaki. We (vultures) have a divine golden vision and great power.

shloka_text: तस्मादाहारवीर्येण निसर्गेण च वानराः। आयोजनशतात्साग्राद्वयं पश्याम नित्यशः।।4.58.31।।
transliteration: tasmādāhāravīryeṇa nisargeṇa ca vānarāḥ| āyojanaśatātsāgrādvayaṃ paśyāma nityaśaḥ
translation: वानराः O monkeys, तस्मात् therefore, वयम् we, आहारवीर्येण with the strength of our food, निसर्गेण च and by nature, साग्रात् from the edge, आयोजनशतात् up to a hundred yojanas, नित्यशः always, पश्याम we can see.
explanation: 'O monkeys therefore, by the strength of food and by nature we can always see beyond a hundred yojanas from this edge.

shloka_text: अस्माकं विहिता वृत्तिर्निसर्गेण च दूरतः। विहिता पादमूले तु वृत्तिश्चरणयोधिनाम्।।4.58.32।।
transliteration: asmākaṃ vihitā vṛttirnisargeṇa ca dūrataḥ| vihitā pādamūle tu vṛttiścaraṇayodhinām
translation: अस्माकम् for us, वृत्ति: movement, निसर्गेण by nature, दूरतः at a distance, विहिता is fixed (by destiny), चरणयोधिनाम् for those fighting on foot, पादमूले at their feet, वृत्ति: movement, विहिता is fixed.
explanation: 'Our movement and vision naturally extends to distant places. For those fighting on foot, the movement is restricted to the extent of foot movement.

shloka_text: गर्हितं तु कृतं कर्म येन स्म पशिताशिना। प्रतीकार्यं च मे तस्य वैरं भ्रातृकृतं भवेत्।।4.58.33।।
transliteration: garhitaṃ tu kṛtaṃ karma yena sma paśitāśinā| pratīkāryaṃ ca me tasya vairaṃ bhrātṛkṛtaṃ bhavet
translation: येन by whomsoever, गर्हितम् despised, कर्म action, कृतम् done, तस्य पिशिताशिनाः by that flesheater (demon), भ्रातृकृतं due to my brother's, वैरं enmity, च and, प्रतिकार्यम् deserves retaliation, भवेत् it will be.
explanation: The despicable deed was done by that flesh-eating demon, and avenging my brother's enmity falls to me.

shloka_text: उपायो दृश्यतां कश्चिल्लङ्घने लवणाम्भसः। अभिगम्य तु वैदेहीं समृद्धार्था गमिष्यथ।।4.58.34।।
transliteration: upāyo dṛśyatāṃ kaścillaṅghane lavaṇāmbhasaḥ| abhigamya tu vaidehīṃ samṛddhārthā gamiṣyatha
translation: लवणाम्भसः of the salt ocean, लङ्घने in crossing, कश्चित् some, उपायः means, दृश्यताम् you may look for, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अभिगम्य after approaching her, समृद्धार्थाः as accomplished ones, गमिष्यथ you will return.
explanation: 'Look out for some means to cross the salty ocean. You will see Vaidehi, and return, your mission accomplished.

shloka_text: समुद्रं नेतुमिच्छामि भवद्भिर्वरुणालयम्। प्रदास्याम्युदकं भ्रातुस्स्वर्गतस्य महात्मनः।।4.58.35।।
transliteration: samudraṃ netumicchāmi bhavadbhirvaruṇālayam| pradāsyāmyudakaṃ bhrātussvargatasya mahātmanaḥ
translation: भवद्भिः by you, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, समुद्रम् ocean, नेतुम् to lead, इच्छामि I intend, स्वर्गतस्य for him who is in heaven, महात्मनः of the great soul, भ्रातुः to my brother, उदकम्  oblation, प्रदास्यामि I will offer.
explanation: 'Take me to the ocean, the abode of Varuna. I intend to offer oblation to my brother, a great soul who is in heaven.'

shloka_text: ततो नीत्वा तु तं देशं तीरं नदनदीपतेः। निर्दग्धपक्षं सम्पातिं वानरास्सुमहौजसः।।4.58.36।। पुनः प्रत्यानयित्वा च तं देशं पतगेश्वरम्। बभूवुर्वानरा हृष्टाः प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य ते।।4.58.37।।
transliteration: tato nītvā tu taṃ deśaṃ tīraṃ nadanadīpateḥ| nirdagdhapakṣaṃ sampātiṃ vānarāssumahaujasaḥ punaḥ pratyānayitvā ca taṃ deśaṃ patageśvaram| babhūvurvānarā hṛṣṭāḥ pravṛttimupalabhya te
translation: सुमहौजसः mightiest, वानराः monkeys, निर्दग्धपक्षम् whose wings were totally burnt, सम्पातिम् Sampati, ततः then, नदनदीपतेः of lord of rivers, तीरं shore, तं देशम् that place, नीत्वा after taking, पतगेश्वरम् the king of vultures, पुनः again, प्रत्यानयित्वा after bringing him back, वानराः monkeys, प्रवृत्तिम् all the information, उपलभ्य having obtained, हृष्टाः pleased, ते बभूवु they were.
explanation: Th mightiest of monkeys carried Sampati, whose wings were totally burnt, to the sea shore and after he had offered oblations took him back to the same place. Having obtained all information from the king of vultures the monkeys were very happy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे अष्टपञ्चशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyeighth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्तदमृतास्वादं गृध्रराजेन भाषितम्। निशम्य मुदिता हृष्टास्ते वचः प्लवगर्षभाः।।4.59.1।।
transliteration: tatastadamṛtāsvādaṃ gṛdhrarājena bhāṣitam| niśamya muditā hṛṣṭāste vacaḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ
translation: ततः then, अमृतास्वादम् tasting nectar, गृध्रराजेन by the king of vultures, भाषितम् spoken, तत् वचः those words, निशम्य on listening, ते they, प्लवगर्षभाः mighty monkeys, मुदिताः delighted, हृष्टाः pleased.
explanation: The mighty monkeys were delighted to hear the nectarlike words of the king of vultures.
comments: Information brought by Suparshva, Sampati's son.

shloka_text: जाम्बवान् वानरश्रेष्ठस्सह सर्वैः प्लवङ्गमैः। भूतलात्सहसोत्थाय गृध्रराजानमब्रवीत्।।4.59.2।।
transliteration: jāmbavān vānaraśreṣṭhassaha sarvaiḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ| bhūtalātsahasotthāya gṛdhrarājānamabravīt
translation: वानरश्रेष्ठः king of bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वैः by all, प्लवङ्गमैः सह with all monkeys, सहसा at once, भूतलात् from the ground, उत्थाय  got up, गृध्रराजानम् to the king of vultures, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Jambavan the king of bears got up at once from the ground along with the monkeys and spoke to the king of vultures:

shloka_text: क्व सीता केन वा दृष्टा को वा हरति मैथिलीम्। तदाख्यातु भवात्सर्वं गतिर्भव वनौकसाम्।।4.59.3।।
transliteration: kva sītā kena vā dṛṣṭā ko vā harati maithilīm| tadākhyātu bhavātsarvaṃ gatirbhava vanaukasām
translation: सीता Sita, क्व where is she, केन वा by whom, दृष्टा was seen, मैथिलीम् to the princess from Mithila, को वा who did, हरति was carrying, भवान् you, तत् सर्वम् everything about that, आख्यातु tell, वनौकसाम् to the monkeys, गतिः ultimate saviour, भव you are.
explanation: 'Where is Sita now? By whom else was she seen while being carried? Pray, tell us everything. You are the ultimate saviour of monkeys.

shloka_text: को दाशरथि बाणानां वज्रवेगनिपातिनाम्। स्वयं लक्ष्मणमुक्तानां न चिन्तयति विक्रमम्।।4.59.4।।
transliteration: ko dāśarathi bāṇānāṃ vajraveganipātinām| svayaṃ lakṣmaṇamuktānāṃ na cintayati vikramam
translation: वज्रवेगनिपातिनाम् of those falling as swiftly as thunderbolt, दाशरथिबाणानाम् of Rama's arrows, स्वयम् directly, लक्ष्मणमुक्तानाम् released by Lakshmana, विक्रमम् power, कः who, न चिन्तयति is not taking seriously.
explanation: 'Who is not aware of Rama's swift arrows which are like thunderbolt? Who is not able to assess the speed and power of arrows of Lakshmana released directly?'

shloka_text: स हरीन्प्रीतिसंयुक्तान्सीताश्रुतिसमाहितान्। पुनराश्वसयन्प्रीत: इदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।4.59.5।।
transliteration: sa harīnprītisaṃyuktānsītāśrutisamāhitān| punarāśvasayanprīta: idaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: सः Sampati, प्रीतः pleased, प्रीतिसंयुक्तान्  happy, सीताश्रुतिसमाहितान् assembled to hear about Sita, हरीन् monkeys, आश्वासयन् reassuring them, पुनः again, इदं this वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Pleased to see the happiness and eagernes of the monkeys assembled to hear about Sita, Sampati continued in order to reassure them:

shloka_text: श्रूयतामिह वैदेह्या यथा मे हरणं श्रुतम्। येन चापि ममाऽख्यातं यत्र वायतलोचना।।4.59.6।।
transliteration: śrūyatāmiha vaidehyā yathā me haraṇaṃ śrutam| yena cāpi mamā'khyātaṃ yatra vāyatalocanā
translation: वैदेह्या: of the princess from Videha, हरणम् abduction, मे by me, यथा as, श्रुतम् heard, येन च and by whom, मम  to me, आख्यातम् was informed, आयतलोचना largeeyed lady, यत्र च and where, इह now, श्रूयताम् you hear.
explanation: 'Now hear by whom I was informed about the abduction of the largeeyed princess from Videha and where she is at present.

shloka_text: अहमस्मिन्गिरौ दुर्गे बहुयोजनमायते। चिरान्निपतितो वृद्धः क्षीणप्राणपराक्रमः।।4.59.7।।
transliteration: ahamasmingirau durge bahuyojanamāyate| cirānnipatito vṛddhaḥ kṣīṇaprāṇaparākramaḥ
translation: बहुयोजनम् several yojanas, आयते wide, दुर्गे in this inaccessible place, अस्मिन् गिरौ on this mountain, चिरात् for a long time, निपतितः fallen, अहम् I am, वृद्धः old, क्षीणप्राणपराक्रमः with my vitality and prowess depleted.
explanation: 'With my vitality and prowess depleted, I have been staying for a long time on this mountain, extended by several yojanas and inaccessible.

shloka_text: तं मामेवं गतं पुत्रस्सुपार्श्वोनाम नामतः। आहारेण यथाकालं बिभर्ति पततां वरः।।4.59.8।।
transliteration: taṃ māmevaṃ gataṃ putrassupārśvonāma nāmataḥ| āhāreṇa yathākālaṃ bibharti patatāṃ varaḥ
translation: एवं गतम् Reduced to this state, तम् him, माम् me, पतताम् among birds, वरः best among, नामतः named, सुपार्श्वो नाम Suparshva, पुत्रः son, यथाकालम् in time, आहारेण with food, बिभर्ति maintains.
explanation: 'Reduced to this state, I have been maintained by food given in time by my son named Suparshva, best among birds.

shloka_text: तीक्ष्णकामास्तु गन्धर्वास्तीक्ष्णकोपा भुजङ्गमाः। मृगाणां तु भयं तीक्ष्णं ततस्तीक्ष्णक्षुधा वयम्।।4.59.9।।
transliteration: tīkṣṇakāmāstu gandharvāstīkṣṇakopā bhujaṅgamāḥ| mṛgāṇāṃ tu bhayaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ tatastīkṣṇakṣudhā vayam
translation: गन्धर्वाः gandharvas, तीक्ष्णकामाः with intense passion, भुजङ्गमाः serpents, तीक्ष्णकोपाः with violent anger, मृगाणाम् for the deer, भयम् fear, तीक्ष्णम् is intense, ततः then, वयम् we, तीक्ष्णक्षुधा: have intense hunger.
explanation: 'Gandharvas have intense passion. Serpents show violent anger. Deer have great fear. And we vultures have great hunger.

shloka_text: स कदाचित्क्षुधार्तस्य ममाहाराभिकाङ्क्षिणः। गतसूर्येऽहनि प्राप्तो मम पुत्रो ह्यनामिषः।।4.59.10।।
transliteration: sa kadācitkṣudhārtasya mamāhārābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ| gatasūrye'hani prāpto mama putro hyanāmiṣaḥ
translation: कदाचित् once, मम पुत्रः my son, सः he, आहाराभिकाङ्क्षिणः with intense longing for food, मम myself, क्षुधार्तस्य for me so hungry, अहनि day, गतसूर्ये after sun set, अनामिषः without meat, प्राप्तः came.
explanation: 'Once my son came to me without meat after sunset while I was feeling hungry for food.

shloka_text: स मामाहारसंरोधात्पीडितं प्रीतिवर्धनः। अनुमान्य यथातत्त्वमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।4.59.11।।
transliteration: sa māmāhārasaṃrodhātpīḍitaṃ prītivardhanaḥ| anumānya yathātattvamidaṃ vacanamabravīt
translation: आहारसंरोधात् with no food, माम् me, पीडितं I was tormented, सः he, प्रीतिवर्धनः  who makes me happy, अनुमान्य suspected, यथातत्त्वम् what had truly happened, इदं वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: 'I was thinking, tormented with hunger, my son who always keeps me happy told me exactly what had happened:

shloka_text: अहं तात यथाकालमामिषार्थी खमाप्लुतः। महेन्द्रस्य गिरेर्द्वारमावृत्य सुसमास्थितः।।4.59.12।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tāta yathākālamāmiṣārthī khamāplutaḥ| mahendrasya girerdvāramāvṛtya susamāsthitaḥ
translation: तात O father, अहम् I, आमिषार्थी intending to get food, यथाकालम् at the right time, महेन्द्रस्य गिरेः of Mahendra mountain, द्वारम् at the entrance, आवृत्य covering, सुसमास्थितः I was stationed.
explanation: 'O dear father I went to get food at the right time and stood blocking the entrance of mount Mahendra.

shloka_text: तत्र सत्त्वसहस्राणां सागरान्तरचारिणाम्। पन्थानमेकोऽध्यवसं सन्निरोद्धुमवाङ्मुखः।।4.59.13।।
transliteration: tatra sattvasahasrāṇāṃ sāgarāntaracāriṇām| panthānameko'dhyavasaṃ sanniroddhumavāṅmukhaḥ
translation: तत्र there, सागरान्तचारिणाम्  by the inhabitants of the ocean, सत्त्वसहस्राणाम् of thousands of creatures, पन्थानम् path, सन्निरोद्धुम् obstructing the path, एकः I alone, अवाङ्मुखः looking downwards, अध्यवसम् stood.
explanation: 'There I stood alone  looking down, obstructing the path of thousands of creatures inhabiting the ocean.

shloka_text: तत्र कश्चिन्मया दृष्ट स्सूर्योदयसमप्रभाम्। स्त्रियमादाय गच्छन्वै भिन्नाञ्जनचयप्रभः।।4.59.14।।
transliteration: tatra kaścinmayā dṛṣṭa ssūryodayasamaprabhām| striyamādāya gacchanvai bhinnāñjanacayaprabhaḥ
translation: सूर्योदयसमप्रभाम् a lady like the radiance of the rising Sun, स्त्रियम् lady, आदाय carrying, गच्छन् was going, भिन्नाञ्जनचयप्रभः dark and huge like a mass of collyrium, कश्चित् some one, मया by me, तत्र there, दृष्टः was seen.
explanation: 'I saw a person who was dark and huge like a mass of collyrium carrying a lady whose radiance was like the rising Sun.

shloka_text: सोऽहमभ्यवहारार्थी तौ दृष्ट्वा कृतनिश्चयः। तेन साम्ना विनीतेन पन्थानमभियाचितः।।4.59.15।।
transliteration: so'hamabhyavahārārthī tau dṛṣṭvā kṛtaniścayaḥ| tena sāmnā vinītena panthānamabhiyācitaḥ
translation: तौ both, दृष्ट्वा seeing, अभ्यवहारार्थी looking for food, कृतनिश्चयः resolved, विनीतेन politely, तेन by him, साम्ना in a courteous manner, पन्थानम् path, अनुयाचितः requested.
explanation: 'Since I was looking for food I resolved to seize both of them. (But) he asked me in a gentle and courteous manner to make way (since I was blocking the aerial path).

shloka_text: न हि सामोपपन्नानां प्रहर्ता विद्यते क्वचित्। नीचेष्वपि जनः कश्चित्किमङ्ग बत मद्विधः।।4.59.16।।
transliteration: na hi sāmopapannānāṃ prahartā vidyate kvacit| nīceṣvapi janaḥ kaścitkimaṅga bata madvidhaḥ
translation: सामोपपन्नानाम् for polite people, प्रहर्ता who strikes, जनः people, नीचेष्वपि even among the mean, कश्चित् any one, क्वचित् at any place, न हि not do, मद्विधः one like me, किमङ्ग not to say, बत indeed.
explanation: 'Who will strike polite people? Even the mean do not do it anywhere. And what to speak of me.

shloka_text: स यातस्तेजसा व्योम सङ्क्षिपन्निव वेगतः। अथाऽहं खेचरैर्भूतैरभिगम्य सभाजितः।।4.59.17।।
transliteration: sa yātastejasā vyoma saṅkṣipanniva vegataḥ| athā'haṃ khecarairbhūtairabhigamya sabhājitaḥ
translation: सः he, वेगत: hurriedily, तेजसा with splendour, व्योम the sky, सङ्क्षिपन्निव as if he was enveloping, यातः he proceeded, अथ now, अहम् I, खेचरैः by the flying creatures  in the sky, भूतैः by creatures, अभिगम्य approached, सभाजितः respected me
explanation: 'He flew hurriedly with splendour as though he was enveloping the sky (making it small). All the flying creatures in the sky came and greeted me with respect.

shloka_text: दिष्ट्या जीवसि तातेति ह्यब्रुवन्मां महर्षयः। कथञ्चित्सकळत्रोऽसौ गतस्ते स्वस्त्यसंशयम्।।4.59.18।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā jīvasi tāteti hyabruvanmāṃ maharṣayaḥ| kathañcitsakaḻatro'sau gataste svastyasaṃśayam
translation: तात O dear child, दिष्ट्या lucky, जीवसि you are, असौ he, सकलत्रः with a lady, कथञ्चित्  some how, गतः went, ते to you, असंशयम् no doubt, स्वस्ति be it safe, इति thus, महर्षयः the great sages, माम् me, अब्रुवन् saying.
explanation: 'I heard the great sages saying, 'O dear you are lucky to be saved. He has somehow gone from here with that lady (without hurting you). Undoubtedly you are lucky.'

shloka_text: एव मुक्तस्ततोऽहं तैस्सिद्धै: परमशोभनैः। स च मे रावणो राजा रक्षसां प्रतिवेदितः।।4.59.19।। हरन्दाशरथेर्भार्यां रामस्य जनकात्मजाम्। भ्रष्टाभरणकौशेयां शोकवेगपराजिताम्।।4.59.20।। रामलक्ष्मणयोर्नाम क्रोशन्तीं मुक्तमूर्धजाम्।
transliteration: eva muktastato'haṃ taissiddhai: paramaśobhanaiḥ| sa ca me rāvaṇo rājā rakṣasāṃ prativeditaḥ harandāśaratherbhāryāṃ rāmasya janakātmajām| bhraṣṭābharaṇakauśeyāṃ śokavegaparājitām rāmalakṣmaṇayornāma krośantīṃ muktamūrdhajām|
translation: ततः then, अहम् I, परमशोभनैः by the glorious, सिद्धैः by siddhas, एवम् that way, दाशरथेः of the son of Dasaratha, रामस्य Rama's, भार्याम् wife, जनकात्मजाम् daughter of Janaka, भ्रष्टाभरणकौशेयाम् ornaments dropped and silken robe slipping, शोकवेगपराजिताम् overcome with the force of grief, रामलक्ष्मणयोः of Rama and Lakshmana, नाम name, क्रोशन्तीम् while she cried,  मुक्तमूर्धजाम् hair dishevelled, हरन् while abducting, सः he, रक्षासाम् राजा king of demons, रावणः Ravana, प्रतिवेदितः came to be known.
explanation: 'I was greeted by the most illustrious siddhas. I came to know from them that he was Ravana, the king of demons. I was looking at him while he was abducting Janaka's daughter, who was the wife of Dasaratha's Rama. Her ornaments had dropped and silken robes had slipped since she lost hold on herself. She was crying, loudly calling out the names of Rama and Lakshmana, her hair dishevelled.

shloka_text: एव मुक्तस्ततोऽहं तैस्सिद्धै: परमशोभनैः। स च मे रावणो राजा रक्षसां प्रतिवेदितः।।4.59.19।। हरन्दाशरथेर्भार्यां रामस्य जनकात्मजाम्। भ्रष्टाभरणकौशेयां शोकवेगपराजिताम्।।4.59.20।। रामलक्ष्मणयोर्नाम क्रोशन्तीं मुक्तमूर्धजाम्।
transliteration: eva muktastato'haṃ taissiddhai: paramaśobhanaiḥ| sa ca me rāvaṇo rājā rakṣasāṃ prativeditaḥ harandāśaratherbhāryāṃ rāmasya janakātmajām| bhraṣṭābharaṇakauśeyāṃ śokavegaparājitām rāmalakṣmaṇayornāma krośantīṃ muktamūrdhajām|
translation: ततः then, अहम् I, परमशोभनैः by the glorious, सिद्धैः by siddhas, एवम् that way, दाशरथेः of the son of Dasaratha, रामस्य Rama's, भार्याम् wife, जनकात्मजाम् daughter of Janaka, भ्रष्टाभरणकौशेयाम् ornaments dropped and silken robe slipping, शोकवेगपराजिताम् overcome with the force of grief, रामलक्ष्मणयोः of Rama and Lakshmana, नाम name, क्रोशन्तीम् while she cried,  मुक्तमूर्धजाम् hair dishevelled, हरन् while abducting, सः he, रक्षासाम् राजा king of demons, रावणः Ravana, प्रतिवेदितः came to be known.
explanation: 'I was greeted by the most illustrious siddhas. I came to know from them that he was Ravana, the king of demons. I was looking at him while he was abducting Janaka's daughter, who was the wife of Dasaratha's Rama. Her ornaments had dropped and silken robes had slipped since she lost hold on herself. She was crying, loudly calling out the names of Rama and Lakshmana, her hair dishevelled.

shloka_text: एष कालात्ययस्तावदिति कालविदां वरः।।4.59.21।। एतमर्थं समग्रं मे सुपार्श्वः प्रत्यवेदयत्।
transliteration: eṣa kālātyayastāvaditi kālavidāṃ varaḥ etamarthaṃ samagraṃ me supārśvaḥ pratyavedayat|
translation: तात O dear father, एषः this, कालात्ययः cause of delay, इति thus, कालविदां among those  who knew the value of time, वरः best among birds, सुपार्श्वः Suparhsva, एतमर्थम् this account, समग्रम् in detail, मे to me, प्रत्यवेदयत् reported.
explanation: 'O father this is the cause of my delay', said Suparshva, who knew the value of time.                 Thus he gave the entire account to me.

shloka_text: तच्छृत्वाऽपि हि मे बुद्धिर्नासीत्काचित्पराक्रमे।।4.59.22।। अपक्षो हि कथं पक्षी कर्म किञ्चिदुपक्रमे।
transliteration: tacchṛtvā'pi hi me buddhirnāsītkācitparākrame apakṣo hi kathaṃ pakṣī karma kiñcidupakrame|
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वाऽपि even on hearing, मे me, पराक्रमे in advancing (against Ravana), काचित् any such , बुद्धिः thought, नासीत् could not attempt, अपक्षः without wings, पक्षी bird, किञ्चित् कर्म do even a little , कथम् how, उपक्रमे could I start.
explanation: 'Even after hearing this I could not advance (against Ravana). How could I, a vulture without wings, leap even a little?

shloka_text: यत्तु शक्यं मया कर्तुं वाग्बुद्धिगुणवर्तिना।।4.59.23।। श्रूयतां तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि भवतां पौरुषाश्रयम्।
transliteration: yattu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ vāgbuddhiguṇavartinā śrūyatāṃ tatpravakṣyāmi bhavatāṃ pauruṣāśrayam|
translation: वाग्बुद्धिगुणवर्तिना  endowed with the faculty of thinking and speaking, मया by me, यत् such, कर्तुम् to execute, शक्यम् capable, भवताम् to you, पौरुषाश्रयम् with your prowess, तत्र there, वक्ष्यामि I shall tell, श्रूयताम् you may listen.
explanation: 'Being endowed with the faculty of thinking and speech I shall tell you what is possible for you to execute with your prowess. Listen.

shloka_text: वाङ्मतिभ्यां तु सर्वेषां करिष्यामि प्रियं हि वः।।4.59.24।। यद्धि दाशरथेः कार्यं मम तन्नात्र संशयः।
transliteration: vāṅmatibhyāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ kariṣyāmi priyaṃ hi vaḥ yaddhi dāśaratheḥ kāryaṃ mama tannātra saṃśayaḥ|
translation: सर्वेषाम् for all of you, वः to you, वाङ्मतिभ्याम् by word and thought, प्रियम् dear to you, करिष्यामि I will do, यत् हि whatever, दाशरथेः to Dasarathi, कार्यम् is the task, तत् that, मम to me, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न not.
explanation: 'I will please you with my word and thought and do not doubt that Rama's task is dear to me as well.

shloka_text: ते भवन्तो मतिश्रेष्ठा बलवन्तो मनस्विनः।।4.59.25।। प्रेषिताः कपिराजेन देवैरपि दुरासदाः।
transliteration: te bhavanto matiśreṣṭhā balavanto manasvinaḥ preṣitāḥ kapirājena devairapi durāsadāḥ|
translation: ते those of you, मतिश्रेष्ठाः very wise, मनस्विनः sensitive , बलवन्त: strong, देवैरपि even by gods, दुरासदाः unapproachable, भवन्तः you are, कपिराजेन by king of monkeys, प्रेषिताः sent.
explanation: 'Indeed, you monkeys are very wise, strong and sensitive. The king of monkeys has sent you on this mission. You cannot be conquered even by gods.

shloka_text: रामलक्ष्मणबाणाश्च निशिताः कङ्कपत्रिणः।।4.59.26।। त्रयाणामपि लोकानां पर्याप्तास्त्राणनिग्रहे।
transliteration: rāmalakṣmaṇabāṇāśca niśitāḥ kaṅkapatriṇaḥ trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ paryāptāstrāṇanigrahe|
translation: कङ्कपत्रिणः heronfeathered, निशिताः sharp, रामलक्ष्मणबाणाश्च are the arrows of Rama and Lakshmana, त्रयाणाम् all the three, लोकानाम् of worlds, त्राणनिग्रहे to protect or subdue, पर्याप्ताः are enough.
explanation: 'The heronfeathered arrows of Rama and Lakshmana are sharp and strong enough to protect or subdue all the three worlds.

shloka_text: कामं खलु दशग्रीव स्तेजोबलसमन्वितः।।4.59.27।। भवतां तु समर्थानां न किञ्चिदपि दुष्करम्।
transliteration: kāmaṃ khalu daśagrīva stejobalasamanvitaḥ bhavatāṃ tu samarthānāṃ na kiñcidapi duṣkaram|
translation: दशग्रीवः the tenheaded Ravana, तेजोबलसमन्वितः खलु कामम् is mighty, powerful and strong, तु but, समर्थानाम् for the efficient ones, भवताम् for you, दुष्करम् difficult, किञ्चिदपि even a little, न not.
explanation: 'The tenheaded Ravana is mighty, powerful and strong, indeed. But you are efficient and it will not be difficult for you to achieve this task.

shloka_text: तदलं कालसङ्गेन क्रियतां बुद्धिनिश्चयः।।4.59.28।। न हि कर्मसु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः।
transliteration: tadalaṃ kālasaṅgena kriyatāṃ buddhiniścayaḥ na hi karmasu sajjante buddhimanto bhavadvidhāḥ|
translation: तत् then, कालसङ्गेन by complying to the time limit (set by Sugriva), अलम् enough, बुद्धिनिश्चयः resolute, क्रियताम् may be made, भवद्विधाः persons like you, बुद्धिमन्तः wise people, कर्मसु in accepting challenges, न सज्जन्ते हि not lag behind.
explanation: 'Do not bother about the time limit. Resolve to achieve the objective, for wise people  like you should not lag behind in accepting challenges.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततः कृतोदकं स्नातं तं गृध्रं हरियूथपाः। उपविष्टा गिरौ रम्ये परिवार्य समन्ततः।।4.60.1।।
transliteration: tataḥ kṛtodakaṃ snātaṃ taṃ gṛdhraṃ hariyūthapāḥ| upaviṣṭā girau ramye parivārya samantataḥ
translation: ततः then, हरियूथपाः leaders among the monkeys, कृतोदकम् offered libations, स्नातम् bathed, तं गृध्रम् that vulture Sampati, समन्ततः all of them together, परिवार्य surrounding him, रम्ये delightful, गिरौ on mountain, उपविष्टाः sat down.
explanation: Sampati bathed and offered libations to Jatayu. Then all the monkeys sat round him on the beautiful mountain.
comments: Sampati gives his past account.

shloka_text: तमङ्गदमुपासीनं तैस्सर्वैर्हरिभिर्वृतम्। जनितप्रत्ययो हर्षात्सम्पातिः पुनरब्रवीत्।।4.60.2।।
transliteration: tamaṅgadamupāsīnaṃ taissarvairharibhirvṛtam| janitapratyayo harṣātsampātiḥ punarabravīt
translation: तैः by those, सर्वैः by all, हरिभिः by monkeys, वृतम् surrounded, उपासीनम् seated, तम् अङ्गदम् to that Angada, जनितप्रत्ययः gained confidence, सम्पातिः Sampati, हर्षात् out of by, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् addressed.
explanation: Angada sat near Sampati surrounded by all monkeys. Sampati who had gained confidence spoke to Angada  once again joyously.

shloka_text: कृत्वा निश्शब्दमेकाग्रा श्श्रुण्वन्तु हरयो मम। तत्वं सङ्कीर्तयिष्यामि यथा जानामि मैथिलीम्।।4.60.3।।
transliteration: kṛtvā niśśabdamekāgrā śśruṇvantu harayo mama| tatvaṃ saṅkīrtayiṣyāmi yathā jānāmi maithilīm
translation: हरयः O monkeys, मैथिलीम् princess from Mithila, यथा as, जानामि I know, तत्वम् the truth, सङ्कीर्तयिष्यामि I shall describe, निश्शब्दम् कृत्वा remaining silently, एकाग्राः rapt attention, मम to me, श्रुण्वन्तु listen.
explanation: 'O monkeys I shall tell you in detail how I came to know the princess from Mithila. Listen quietly with rapt attention:

shloka_text: अस्य विन्ध्यस्य शिखरे पतितोऽस्मि पुरावने। सूर्यतपपरीताङ्गो निर्दग्धस्सूर्यरश्मिभिः।।4.60.4।।
transliteration: asya vindhyasya śikhare patito'smi purāvane| sūryatapaparītāṅgo nirdagdhassūryaraśmibhiḥ
translation: पुरा years ago, सूर्यरश्मिभिः by Sun's rays, निर्दग्धः scorched, सूर्यतापपरीताङ्गः limbs burnt by the heat of Sun, अस्य of this, विन्ध्यस्य  Vindhya's, शिखरे on the peak, पतितः अस्मि I fell.
explanation: Scorched by the rays of the Sun, I was burnt totally and fell on the peak of this mount Vindhya years ago.

shloka_text: लब्धसंज्ञस्तु षड्रात्राद्विवशो विह्वलन्निव। वीक्षमाणो दिशस्सर्वा नाभिजानामि किञ्चन।।4.60.5।।
transliteration: labdhasaṃjñastu ṣaḍrātrādvivaśo vihvalanniva| vīkṣamāṇo diśassarvā nābhijānāmi kiñcana
translation: षड्रात्रात् after six nights, लब्धसंज्ञः with consciousness restored, विवश  pale, विह्वलन्निव perturbed, सर्वाः all, दिशः quarters, वीक्षमाणः while looking at, किञ्चन even a little, नाभिजानामि I could not recognise anything.
explanation: Regaining consciousness after six nights, pale and bewildered, looking in every direction, I could recognize nothing.

shloka_text: ततस्तु सागरान् शैलान्नदीस्सर्वास्सरांसि च। वनानि च प्रदेशांश्च नीरीक्ष्य मतिरागता।।4.60.6।।
transliteration: tatastu sāgarān śailānnadīssarvāssarāṃsi ca| vanāni ca pradeśāṃśca nīrīkṣya matirāgatā
translation: ततः then, सागरान् the seas, शैलान् mountain, सर्वाः नदीः all rivers, सरांसि च and lakes, वनानि च and forests, प्रदेशांश्च and all locations, नीरीक्ष्य after observing, मतिः mind, आगता realised.
explanation: 'Then I looked at the oceans, the mountains, rivers, lakes, forests and all locations and  my memory returned gradually.

shloka_text: हृष्टपक्षिगणाकीर्णः कन्दरान्तरकूटवान्। दक्षिणस्योदधेस्तीरे विन्ध्योऽयमिति निश्चितः।।4.60.7।।
transliteration: hṛṣṭapakṣigaṇākīrṇaḥ kandarāntarakūṭavān| dakṣiṇasyodadhestīre vindhyo'yamiti niścitaḥ
translation: हृष्टपक्षिगणाकीर्णः inhabited by flocks of  happy birds, कन्दरान्तरकूटवान् filled with caves and mountains, अयम् this, दक्षिणस्य southern side, उदधेः ocean's, तीरे on the shore, विन्ध्य Vindhya, इति this is, निश्चितः for sure.
explanation: 'I came to know then that this place is inhabited by flocks of happy birds and full of many caves and mountain peaks. This is mount Vindhya on the shore of the southern ocean.

shloka_text: आसीच्चात्राश्रमं पुण्यं सुरैरपि सुपूजितम्। ऋषिर्निशाकरो नाम यस्मिन्नुग्रतपाभवत्।।4.60.8।।
transliteration: āsīccātrāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ surairapi supūjitam| ṛṣirniśākaro nāma yasminnugratapābhavat
translation: अत्र there, सुरैरपि even by Gods, सुपूजितम् worshipped with reverence, आश्रमम् hermitage, आसीत् was situated, यस्मिन् in it, निशाकरो नाम called Nisakara, उग्रतपाः performed rigorous penance, ऋषिः sage, अभवत् lived.
explanation: 'There was a hermitage nearby, where a revered sage, who was even worshpped by gods  lived. His name was Nishakara. He did rigorous penance here.

shloka_text: अष्टौ वर्षसहस्राणि तेनास्मिन्नृषिणा विना। वसतो मम धर्मज्ञा स्वर्गते तु निशाकरे।।4.60.9।।
transliteration: aṣṭau varṣasahasrāṇi tenāsminnṛṣiṇā vinā| vasato mama dharmajñā svargate tu niśākare
translation: धर्मज्ञाः O knowers of dharma, निशाकरे when Nishakara, स्वर्गते after he reached the heaven, तेन by him, ऋषिणा विना devoid of sage, अस्मिन् that, वसतः for me while dwelling, मम for me, अष्टौ eight, वर्षसहस्राणि thousand years.
explanation: 'O righteous monkeys after the death of sage Nishakara eight thousand years have passed. And I have been living here.

shloka_text: अवतीर्य तु विन्ध्याग्रात्कृच्छ्रेण विषमाच्छनैः। तीक्ष्णदर्भां वसुमतीं दुःखेन पुनरागतः।।4.60.10।।
transliteration: avatīrya tu vindhyāgrātkṛcchreṇa viṣamācchanaiḥ| tīkṣṇadarbhāṃ vasumatīṃ duḥkhena punarāgataḥ
translation: विषमात् from the craggy rugged place, विन्ध्याग्रात् from the peak of Vindhya mountain, शनैः slowly, कृच्छ्रेण with great difficulty, अवतीर्य having descended, तीक्ष्णदर्भाम् a place with sharp rough darbha grass, वसुमतीम् to the land, दुःखेन with difficulty, पुनः again, आगतः came.
explanation: 'I descended down slowly from the high rugged peak of the Vindhya mountain with great difficulty to the plain land bristling with sharp, harsh darbha grass.

shloka_text: तमृषिं द्रष्टुकामोऽस्मि दुःखेनाभ्यागतो भृशम्। जटायुषा मया चैव बहुशोऽभिगतो हि सः।।4.60.11।।
transliteration: tamṛṣiṃ draṣṭukāmo'smi duḥkhenābhyāgato bhṛśam| jaṭāyuṣā mayā caiva bahuśo'bhigato hi saḥ
translation: भृशम् intense, दुःखेन with utmost difficulty, अभ्यागतः approached, तम् ऋषिम् that sage, द्रष्टुकामः eager to see, अस्मि I am, सः he, जटायुषा with Jatayu, मयाचैव along with me, बहुशः in many ways, अभिगतो हि both visited him.
explanation: 'Eager to see the great sage I reached the place with much difficulty. I and my brother Jatayu had  approached him many a time earlier.

shloka_text: तस्याश्रमपदाभ्याशे ववुर्वातास्सुगन्धिनः। वृक्षो वापुष्पितः कश्चिदफलो वा न विद्यते।।4.60.12।।
transliteration: tasyāśramapadābhyāśe vavurvātāssugandhinaḥ| vṛkṣo vāpuṣpitaḥ kaścidaphalo vā na vidyate
translation: तस्य of that, आश्रमपदाभ्याशे in the vicinity of that hermitage, सुगन्धिनः fragrant, वाताः breeze, ववुः blew, अपुष्पितः without flowers, वृक्षः trees, कश्चित् any one, न विद्यते not seen, अफलो वा without fruits, न not.
explanation: 'In the vicinity of that hermitage there was no tree without flowers or fruits and fragrant was the breeze that blew around.

shloka_text: उपेत्य चाश्रमं पुण्यं वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितः। द्रष्टुकामः प्रतीक्षेऽहं भगवन्तं निशाकरम्।।4.60.13।।
transliteration: upetya cāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛkṣamūlamupāśritaḥ| draṣṭukāmaḥ pratīkṣe'haṃ bhagavantaṃ niśākaram
translation: पुण्यम् sacred, आश्रमम् hermitage, उपेत्य reaching, वृक्षमूलम् under a tree, उपाश्रितः I rested, भगवन्तम् divine sage, निशाकरम् Nishakara, द्रुष्टुकामः desiring to see, प्रतीक्षेऽहम् I awaited.
explanation: 'On reaching the sacred hermitage, I stood and waited under a tree for the audience of the divine sage Nishakara.

shloka_text: अथापश्यमदूरस्थमृषिं ज्वलिततेजसम्। कृताभिषेकं दुर्धर्षमुपावृत्तमुदङ्मुखम्।।4.60.14।।
transliteration: athāpaśyamadūrasthamṛṣiṃ jvalitatejasam| kṛtābhiṣekaṃ durdharṣamupāvṛttamudaṅmukham
translation: अथ then, कृताभिषेकम् after having ritual bath, उपावृत्तम् returned towards, दुर्धर्षम् unassailable, उदङ्मुखम् facing towards north, ज्वलिततेजसम् shining with brilliance (of ascetic power), अदूरस्थम् near by, ऋषिम् sage, अपश्यम् I saw.
explanation: Then nearby I beheld a sage blazing with ascetic splendour, unassailable, facing north, having just bathed and returned.

shloka_text: तमृक्षास्सृमरा व्याघ्रास्सिंहा नागास्सरीसृपाः। परिवार्योपगच्छन्ति धातारं प्राणिनो यथा।।4.60.15।।
transliteration: tamṛkṣāssṛmarā vyāghrāssiṃhā nāgāssarīsṛpāḥ| parivāryopagacchanti dhātāraṃ prāṇino yathā
translation: प्राणिनः living creatures, धातारं यथा like the creator, तम् him, परिवार्य circling around, ऋक्षाः bears, सृमराः deer, व्याघ्राः tigers, सिंहाः lions, नागास्सरीसृपाः elephants and snakes, उपगच्छन्ति were following.
explanation: 'He was followed by bears, deer, tigers, lions, elephants and snakes just as living beings follow their creator.

shloka_text: ततः प्राप्तमृषिं ज्ञात्वा तानि सत्त्वानि वै ययुः। प्रविष्टे राजनि यथा सर्वं सामात्यकं बलम्।।4.60.16।।
transliteration: tataḥ prāptamṛṣiṃ jñātvā tāni sattvāni vai yayuḥ| praviṣṭe rājani yathā sarvaṃ sāmātyakaṃ balam
