translation: राजनि when the king, प्रविष्टे enters, सर्वम् all, सामात्यकम् including the feudatories, बलम्  army, यथा like, ऋषिम् that sage, प्राप्तम् when he came, ज्ञात्वा knowing, ततः then, तानि all those, सत्त्वानि creatures, ययुः went.
explanation: 'Just as the army including feudatories recede, when the king comes, all those creatures repaired to their dens when they knew the arrival of the sage at the hermitage.

shloka_text: ऋषिस्तु दृष्ट्वा मां प्रीतः प्रविष्टश्चाश्रमं पुनः। मुहूर्तमात्रान्निष्क्रम्य ततः कार्यमपृच्छत।।4.60.17।।
transliteration: ṛṣistu dṛṣṭvā māṃ prītaḥ praviṣṭaścāśramaṃ punaḥ| muhūrtamātrānniṣkramya tataḥ kāryamapṛcchata
translation: ऋषिस्तु sage also, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, प्रीतः pleased, आश्रमम् to the hermitage, प्रविष्टः entered, ततः then, मुहूर्तमात्रात् for a moment, पुनः again, निष्क्रम्य after coming out, कार्यम् the task, अपृच्छत enquired.
explanation: The sage who entered the hermitage came out again within a moment on seeing me and enquired about me affectionately:

shloka_text: सौम्य वैकल्यतां दृष्ट्वा रोम्णां ते नावगम्यते। अग्निदग्धाविमौ पक्षौ व्रणाश्चापि शरीरके।।4.60.18।।
transliteration: saumya vaikalyatāṃ dṛṣṭvā romṇāṃ te nāvagamyate| agnidagdhāvimau pakṣau vraṇāścāpi śarīrake
translation: सौम्य O gentle one, ते your, रोम्णाम् of the hair, वैकल्यताम् being devoid of, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, नावगम्यते it is understood, इमौ these two, पक्षौ two wings, अग्निदग्धौ both burnt by fire, व्रणाश्चापि wounded, शरीरके all over the body.
explanation: 'O gentle one seeing your body devoid of hair I can understood that your wings have been burnt and your body bruised.

shloka_text: गृध्रौ द्वौ दृष्टपूर्वौ मे मातरिश्वसमौ जवे। गृध्राणां चैव राजानौ भ्रातरौ कामरूपिणौ।।4.60.19।।
transliteration: gṛdhrau dvau dṛṣṭapūrvau me mātariśvasamau jave| gṛdhrāṇāṃ caiva rājānau bhrātarau kāmarūpiṇau
translation: गृध्राणाम् among vultures, राजानौ you both are kings, जवे in speed, मातरिश्वसमौ equal to wind, कामरूपिणौ both can change to any form at will, भ्रातरौ brothers, द्वौ two, गृध्रौ two vultures, मे for me, दृष्टपूर्वौ seen earlier.
explanation: 'You are the king among vultures equal to wind in speed.I had seen both the brothers earlier and both of you could change your form at will.

shloka_text: ज्येष्ठो हि त्वं तु सम्पाते जटायुरनुजस्तव। मानुषं रूपमास्थाय गृह्णीतां चरणौ मम।।4.60.20।।
transliteration: jyeṣṭho hi tvaṃ tu sampāte jaṭāyuranujastava| mānuṣaṃ rūpamāsthāya gṛhṇītāṃ caraṇau mama
translation: सम्पाते O Sampati, त्वम् you, ज्येष्ठो हि  the elder, जटायु Jatayu, तव your, अनुजः younger brother, मानुषम् human, रूपम् form, आस्थाय assuming, मम my, चरणौ feet, गृह्णीताम् touch my feet.
explanation: O Sampati, you are the elder and Jatayu your younger brother; assume a human form and touch my feet.

shloka_text: किं ते व्याधिसमुत्थानं पक्षयोः पतनं कथम्। दण्डोऽयंच कृतः केन सर्वमाख्याहि पृच्छतः।।4.60.21।।
transliteration: kiṃ te vyādhisamutthānaṃ pakṣayoḥ patanaṃ katham| daṇḍo'yaṃca kṛtaḥ kena sarvamākhyāhi pṛcchataḥ
translation: ते to you, व्याधिसमुत्थानं किम् what disease affected you, पक्षयोः to both your wings, पतनम् dropping down, कथम् how come, केन by whom, अयम् this, दण्डः punishment, कृतः is given, पृच्छतः for the enquiry, सर्वम् all about, आख्याहि you may tell me.
explanation: 'What disease has affected you? Why are your wings dropped down? Who punished you in this way? Tell me.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्तद्दारुणं कर्म दुष्करं सहसात्कृतम्। आचचक्षे मुनेस्सर्वं सूर्यानुगमनं तथा।।4.61.1।।
transliteration: tatastaddāruṇaṃ karma duṣkaraṃ sahasātkṛtam| ācacakṣe munessarvaṃ sūryānugamanaṃ tathā
translation: ततः then, सहसा rashly, कृतम् done, दुष्करम् impetuous, दारुणम् arrogant, तत् कर्म that deed, तदा then, सूर्यानुगमनम् following the Sun, सर्वम् everything, मुनेः to the sage, आचचक्षे I revealed.
explanation: 'Then I revealed everything to the sage,including the arrogant, impetuous action of rashly following the Sun (for challenging Indra).
comments: Sampati's revelation to sage Nishakara about his burnt wings.

shloka_text: भगवन्व्रणयुक्तत्वाल्लज्जया व्याकुलेन्द्रियः। परिश्रान्तो न शक्नोमि वचनं परिभाषितुम्।।4.61.2।।
transliteration: bhagavanvraṇayuktatvāllajjayā vyākulendriyaḥ| pariśrānto na śaknomi vacanaṃ paribhāṣitum
translation: भगवन् O revered sage, व्रणयुक्तत्वात् body being wounded, लज्जया च due to shame, व्याकुलेन्द्रियः with senses disturbed, परिश्रान्तः exhausted, वचनम् these words, परिभाषितुम् to express, न शक्नोमि I am not able to do.
explanation: 'O revered sage I am exhausted and my senses are depressed. I am ashamed of myself. My body is wounded. Therefore I am not able to reply.

shloka_text: अहं चैव जटायुश्च सङ्घर्षाद्धर्पमोहितौ। आकाशं पतितौ वीरौ जिज्ञासन्तौ पराक्रमम्।।4.61.3।।
transliteration: ahaṃ caiva jaṭāyuśca saṅgharṣāddharpamohitau| ākāśaṃ patitau vīrau jijñāsantau parākramam
translation: अहं चैव I also, जटायुश्च Jatayu also, दर्पमोहितौ deluded by pride, पराक्रमम् valour, वीरौ two heroes, जिज्ञासन्तौ with the intention of knowing, सङ्घर्षात् challenging each other, दूरात् from far, आकाशम् sky, पतितौ we flew.
explanation: 'Deluded by pride, I and my brother Jatayu challenging each other to test our relative strength flew  far into the sky.

shloka_text: कैलासशिखरे बद्ध्वा मुनीनामग्रतः पणम्। रविस्स्यादनुयातव्यो यावदस्तं महागिरिम्।।4.61.4।।
transliteration: kailāsaśikhare baddhvā munīnāmagrataḥ paṇam| ravissyādanuyātavyo yāvadastaṃ mahāgirim
translation: कैलासशिखरे on the peak of Kailasa, मुनीनाम् of sages, अग्रतः in their presence, महागिरिम्  great mountain, अस्तं यावत् till the setting, रविः Sun, अनुयातव्यः follow, स्यात् be, पणम् bet, बद्ध्वा made.
explanation: 'Both of us made a bet on the peak of mount Kailasa in the presence of sages to follow the Sungod until he sets on the western mountain.

shloka_text: अथाऽवां युगपत्प्राप्तावपश्याव महीतले। रथचक्रप्रमाणानि नगराणि पृथक्पृथक्।।4.61.5।।
transliteration: athā'vāṃ yugapatprāptāvapaśyāva mahītale| rathacakrapramāṇāni nagarāṇi pṛthakpṛthak
translation: अथ and then, आवाम् both of us, युगपत् simultaneously, प्राप्तौ both reaching, महीतले on the land, रथचक्रप्रमाणानि the size of chariot wheels, नगराणि cities, पृथक् पृथक् one after another, अपश्याव we both saw.
explanation: 'And from there both of us looked at all the cities on the land which seemed like the size of chariot wheels one after the other.

shloka_text: क्वचिद्वादित्रघोषांश्च ब्रह्मघोषांश्च शुश्रुवः। गायन्तीश्चाङ्गना बह्वीः पश्यावो रक्तवाससः।।4.61.6।।
transliteration: kvacidvāditraghoṣāṃśca brahmaghoṣāṃśca śuśruvaḥ| gāyantīścāṅganā bahvīḥ paśyāvo raktavāsasaḥ
translation: क्वचित् at some places, वादित्रघोषांश्च sounds of musical instruments, ब्रह्मघोषांश्च sounds of Vedic chanting, शुश्रुवः we heard, गायन्ती: ladies singing, रक्तवासस: clothed in red  garments, बह्वीः many, अङ्गनाः women, पश्यावः we both saw.
explanation: 'We heard at some places sounds of musical instruments, sounds of Vedic chanting, and many lovely young women dressed in redsinging.

shloka_text: तूर्णमुत्पत्य चाकाशमादित्यपथमाश्रितौ। आवामालोकयावस्तद्वनं शाद्वलसन्निभम्।।4.61.7।।
transliteration: tūrṇamutpatya cākāśamādityapathamāśritau| āvāmālokayāvastadvanaṃ śādvalasannibham
translation: आकाशम् sky, तूर्णम् quickly, उत्पत्य flying, आदित्यपदम् Sun's path, आश्रितौ we reached, आवाम् we both, तत् वनम् that forest, शाद्वलसन्निभम् like a lawn of grass, आलोकयावः we saw.
explanation: 'We flew quickly into the sky and reached the path of the Sun and looked down at the forest which looked like a green lawn.

shloka_text: उपलैरिव सञ्छन्ना दृश्यते भूश्शिलोच्चयैः। आपगाभिश्च संवीता सूत्रैरिव वसुन्धरा।।4.61.8।।
transliteration: upalairiva sañchannā dṛśyate bhūśśiloccayaiḥ| āpagābhiśca saṃvītā sūtrairiva vasundharā
translation: भूः land, शिलोच्चयैः with tall mountains, उपलैः with pebbles, सञ्छन्ना इव as though it is covered, दृश्यते looked, आपगाभिः by rivers, वसुन्धरा land, सूत्रैः with threads, संवीता इव as if entwined.
explanation: 'The earth filled with lofty mountains appeared as if it is covered with pebbles. Surrounded by rivers meandering, it looked as though it was entwined with threads.

shloka_text: हिमवांश्चैव विन्ध्यश्च मेरुश्च सुमहान्नगः। भूतले सम्प्रकाशन्ते नागा इव जलाशये।।4.61.9।।
transliteration: himavāṃścaiva vindhyaśca meruśca sumahānnagaḥ| bhūtale samprakāśante nāgā iva jalāśaye
translation: हिमवांश्चैव even Himalaya , विन्ध्यश्च Vindhya mountain also, सुमहान्नगः towering mountains, मेरुश्च Mount Meru also, भूतले on the surface of the earth, जलाशये in a pond, नागा इव like elephants, सम्प्रकाशन्ते shining.
explanation: 'The mountains of the earth, Himavan and Vindhya and the great Meru looked like huge elephants in a huge pond.

shloka_text: तीव्रस्स्वेदश्च खेदश्च भयं चासीत्तदाऽऽवयोः। समाविशति मोहश्च तमो मूर्छा च दारुणा।।4.61.10।।
transliteration: tīvrassvedaśca khedaśca bhayaṃ cāsīttadā''vayoḥ| samāviśati mohaśca tamo mūrchā ca dāruṇā
translation: तदा then, आवयोः for both of us, तीव्रः intense, स्वेदश्च sweat, खेदश्च pain, भयं च and fear, आसीत् made its appearance, मोहः confusion, दारुणा terrific, मूर्छा च and stupor, समाविशति led to.
explanation: 'Much sweat, pain and fear generated in us while we went on and up. This led to terrific confusion and stupor.

shloka_text: न दिग्विज्ञायते याम्या नाग्नेयी न च वारुणी। युगान्ते नियतो लोको हतो दग्ध इवाग्निना।।4.61.11।।
transliteration: na digvijñāyate yāmyā nāgneyī na ca vāruṇī| yugānte niyato loko hato dagdha ivāgninā
translation: याम्या दिक् southern direction, न च ज्ञायते also was not known, आग्नेयी south east, न or, वारुणी west, न or, लोकः world, युगान्ते at the end of yuga, अग्निना by fire of dissolution, दग्धः burnt, हत इव consumed, नियतः set by an order.
explanation: 'I did not know which the southern direction was or the southeast or the west. It looked as if the world had been consumed by fire and dissolved, as if it was the end of the yuga.

shloka_text: मनश्च मे हतं भूयस्सन्निवर्त्यतु संश्रयम्। यत्नेन महता ह्यस्मिन्पुनस्सन्धाय चक्षुषी।।4.61.12।। यत्नेन महता भूयो भास्करः प्रतिलोकितः। तुल्यः पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन भास्करः प्रतिभाति नौ।।4.61.13।।
transliteration: manaśca me hataṃ bhūyassannivartyatu saṃśrayam| yatnena mahatā hyasminpunassandhāya cakṣuṣī yatnena mahatā bhūyo bhāskaraḥ pratilokitaḥ| tulyaḥ pṛthvīpramāṇena bhāskaraḥ pratibhāti nau
translation: मे my, मनः mind, हतम् disturbed, चक्षुषी eyes, संश्रयम् a resort, प्राप्य became, महता with great, यत्नेन with effort, अस्मिन् in this, मनः mind, चक्षुषी both my eyes, सन्धाय by fixing, भूयः again, महता यत्नेन with great effort, भास्करः Sun, प्रतिलोकितः was seen, भास्करः Sun, पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन with the measurement of earth, तुल्यः equal, नौ to us, प्रतिभाति appeared.
explanation: 'My mind was disturbed and I turned my attention from the object. Once again I focused my attention (on the Sun) and could see the Sungod with great effort. The Sun appeared to us equal in size to earth.

shloka_text: मनश्च मे हतं भूयस्सन्निवर्त्यतु संश्रयम्। यत्नेन महता ह्यस्मिन्पुनस्सन्धाय चक्षुषी।।4.61.12।। यत्नेन महता भूयो भास्करः प्रतिलोकितः। तुल्यः पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन भास्करः प्रतिभाति नौ।।4.61.13।।
transliteration: manaśca me hataṃ bhūyassannivartyatu saṃśrayam| yatnena mahatā hyasminpunassandhāya cakṣuṣī yatnena mahatā bhūyo bhāskaraḥ pratilokitaḥ| tulyaḥ pṛthvīpramāṇena bhāskaraḥ pratibhāti nau
translation: मे my, मनः mind, हतम् disturbed, चक्षुषी eyes, संश्रयम् a resort, प्राप्य became, महता with great, यत्नेन with effort, अस्मिन् in this, मनः mind, चक्षुषी both my eyes, सन्धाय by fixing, भूयः again, महता यत्नेन with great effort, भास्करः Sun, प्रतिलोकितः was seen, भास्करः Sun, पृथ्वीप्रमाणेन with the measurement of earth, तुल्यः equal, नौ to us, प्रतिभाति appeared.
explanation: 'My mind was disturbed and I turned my attention from the object. Once again I focused my attention (on the Sun) and could see the Sungod with great effort. The Sun appeared to us equal in size to earth.

shloka_text: जटायुर्मामनापृच्छ्य निपपात महीं ततः। तं दृष्ट्वा तूर्णमाकाशादात्मानं मुक्तवानहम्।।4.61.14।।
transliteration: jaṭāyurmāmanāpṛcchya nipapāta mahīṃ tataḥ| taṃ dṛṣṭvā tūrṇamākāśādātmānaṃ muktavānaham
translation: जटायुः Jatayu, माम् to me, अनापृच्छ्य without taking leave, महीम् to the earth, निपपात fell down, ततः then, अहम् I, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, तूर्णम् quickly, आत्मानम् myself, आकाशात् from the sky, मुक्तवान् came down.
explanation: 'Without taking leave of me Jatayu descended down to the earth. Seeing that, I also followed him down quickly from the sky.

shloka_text: पक्षाभ्यां च मया गुप्तो जटायुर्न प्रदह्यते। प्रमादात्तत्र निर्दग्धः पतन्वायुपथादहम्।।4.61.15।।
transliteration: pakṣābhyāṃ ca mayā gupto jaṭāyurna pradahyate| pramādāttatra nirdagdhaḥ patanvāyupathādaham
translation: मया by me, पक्षाभ्याम् with wings, गुप्तः protected, जटायुः Jatayu, न प्रदह्यते was not burnt, तत्र there, प्रमादात् miserably, वायुपथात् from the path of the wind, पतन् while falling down, अहम्  I, निर्दग्धः got burnt.
explanation: 'I protected Jatayu with my wings so that he was not burnt. I, however, got burnt miserably and fell down from the aerial region.

shloka_text: आशङ्के तं निपतितं जनस्थाने जटायुषम्। अहं तु पतितो विन्ध्ये दग्धपक्षो जडीकृतः।।4.61.16।।
transliteration: āśaṅke taṃ nipatitaṃ janasthāne jaṭāyuṣam| ahaṃ tu patito vindhye dagdhapakṣo jaḍīkṛtaḥ
translation: तं जटायुषम् that Jatayu, जनस्थाने at Janasthana, निपतितम् fell down, आशङ्के I guess, अहं तु but I, दग्धपक्षः with burnt wings, जडीकृतः devoid of consciousness, विन्ध्ये on Vindhya, पतितः fell.
explanation: 'I thought Jatayu had fallen down somewhere at Janasthana, but I fell on Vindhya, wings burnt, in an unconscious state.

shloka_text: राज्येन हीनो भ्रात्रा च पक्षाभ्यां विक्रमेण च। सर्वथा मर्तुमेवेच्छन्पतिष्ये शिखराद्गीरेः।।4.61.17।।
transliteration: rājyena hīno bhrātrā ca pakṣābhyāṃ vikrameṇa ca| sarvathā martumevecchanpatiṣye śikharādgīreḥ
translation: राज्येन with kingdom, भ्रत्रा च and brother also, पक्षाभ्याम् my wings, विक्रमेण च and my strength, हीनः devoid, सर्वथा by all means, मर्तुमेव to die, इच्छन् while desiring, गिरेः from the mountain, शिखरात् from the peak, पतिष्ये I shall fall down.
explanation: 'Bereft of my kingdom, my brother and my wings, and having lost my strength I desire to fall down from the mountain top and die.' इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfirst sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता मुनिश्रेष्ठ मरुदं दुःखितो भृशं। अथ ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु भगवानिदमब्रवीत्।।4.62.1।।
transliteration: evamuktā muniśreṣṭha marudaṃ duḥkhito bhṛśaṃ| atha dhyātvā muhūrtaṃ tu bhagavānidamabravīt
translation: एवम् thus, उक्ता having spoken, मुनिश्रेष्ठः venerable sage, मरुदं roared, दुःखितो भृशं very sadly, अथ then, ध्यात्वा reflecting, मुर्हूतं for a moment, भगवान् divine sage, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत said.
explanation: 'When thus I spoke to the venerable sage in that manner roaring very painfully the divine sage replied after reflecting silently for a moment:
comments: The sage consoles Sampati -- Nishakara speaks about Rama coming to destroy the demons and their king Ravana.

shloka_text: पक्षौ तु ते प्रपक्षौ च पुनरन्यौभविष्यतः। प्राणाश्च चक्षुषी चैव विक्रमश्च बलं च ते।।4.62.2।।
transliteration: pakṣau tu te prapakṣau ca punaranyaubhaviṣyataḥ| prāṇāśca cakṣuṣī caiva vikramaśca balaṃ ca te
translation: पक्षौ तु wings, ते to you, प्रपक्षौ च and feathers, पुन: again, अन्यौ and other, प्राणाश्च life also, चक्षुषी eyes, चैव also, विक्रमश्च prowess, बलं च and strength, ते to you, भविष्यतः you will attain.
explanation: 'You will get new wings and feathers and also other parts.You will attain vision, life, prowess and strength.

shloka_text: पुराणे सुमहत्कार्यं भविष्यति मया श्रुतं। दृष्टं मे तपसा चैव श्रुत्वा च विदितं मम4.62.3।।
transliteration: purāṇe sumahatkāryaṃ bhaviṣyati mayā śrutaṃ| dṛṣṭaṃ me tapasā caiva śrutvā ca viditaṃ mama4.62.3||
translation: पुराणे in the purana (history), सुमहत् very great, कार्यं task, भविष्यति will happen, मया by you, श्रुतं I heard, दृष्टं seen, मे with my, तपसा by the power of penance, चैव also, श्रुत्वाच I heard, मम me, विदितम् I came to know.
explanation: 'I have foreseen with the power of my penance that a great task will be done by you. I have also heard about it in the Puranas and came to know of it.

shloka_text: राजा दशरथो नाम कश्चिदिक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः। तस्य पुत्रो महातेजा रमोनाम भविष्यति।।4.62.4।।
transliteration: rājā daśaratho nāma kaścidikṣvākunandanaḥ| tasya putro mahātejā ramonāma bhaviṣyati
translation: इक्ष्वाकुनन्दनः delight of the Ikshvaku family, दशरथो Dasaratha, नाम named, राजा king, कश्चित indeed, तस्य his, पुत्रो son, महा highly, तेजाः effulgent, रमो Rama, नाम by name, भविष्यति will beget.
explanation: 'Indeed in the Ikshvaku family there will be a king named Dasaratha. He will beget a brilliant son named Rama.

shloka_text: अरण्यं च सह र्भात्रा लक्ष्मणेनगमिष्यति। अस्मिन्नर्थे नियुक्त स्सन्पित्रा सत्यपराक्रमः।।4.62.5।।
transliteration: araṇyaṃ ca saha rbhātrā lakṣmaṇenagamiṣyati| asminnarthe niyukta ssanpitrā satyaparākramaḥ
translation: अस्मिन्नर्थे on account of, नियुक्तस्सन् assigned by, पित्रा his father, सत्यपराक्रमः strength of truth, सह भ्रात्रा with his brother, लक्ष्मणेन accompanied by Lakshmana, गमिष्यति will proceed, अरण्यं the forest.
explanation: 'On account of the command of his father, Rama armed with the strength of truth will proceed to the forest with his brother Lakshmana.

shloka_text: नैऋतो रावणो नाम तस्य भार्यां हरिष्यति। राक्षसेन्द्रो जनस्थनादवध्य स्सुरदानवैः4.62.6।।
transliteration: naiṛto rāvaṇo nāma tasya bhāryāṃ hariṣyati| rākṣasendro janasthanādavadhya ssuradānavaiḥ4.62.6||
translation: सुरदानवैः by gods and demons, अवध्यः indestructible, राक्षसेन्द्रो king of demons, रावणो by Ravana, नाम named, जनस्थनात् from Janasthana, नैऋतो in the southwest direction, तस्य his, भार्यां wife, हरिष्यति will be abducting.
explanation: 'The king of demons, Ravana who is indestructible even by gods and demons will be abducting his wife from Janastahana.

shloka_text: सा च कामैः प्रलोभ्यन्ती भक्ष्यै:भोज्यैश्च मैथिली। नभोक्ष्यति महाभागा दुःखे मग्ना यशस्विनी।।4.62.7।।
transliteration: sā ca kāmaiḥ pralobhyantī bhakṣyai:bhojyaiśca maithilī| nabhokṣyati mahābhāgā duḥkhe magnā yaśasvinī
translation: महाभागा noble, यशस्विनी famed, दुःखे in sorrow, मग्ना immersed, न भोक्ष्यति will not eat, सा she, च and, कामैः pleasures, प्रलोभ्यन्ती however, भक्ष्यै: eatables, भोज्यैश्च to be enjoyed, मैथिली princess from Mithila.
explanation: 'Immersed in grief, chaste and famed Sita, will not take any food or enjoy pleasures however much she is tempted.

shloka_text: परमान्नंतु वैदेह्या ज्ञात्वा दास्यति वा सः। यदन्नममृतप्रख्यं सुराणामपिदुर्लभम्4.62.8।।
transliteration: paramānnaṃtu vaidehyā jñātvā dāsyati vā saḥ| yadannamamṛtaprakhyaṃ surāṇāmapidurlabham4.62.8||
translation: सुराणाम् of gods, वैदेह्या by Sita, दास्यति avoiding to eat, ज्ञात्वा knowing, वा to, स: he, परमान्नंतु divine food, यदन्नम् as food, अमृतप्रख्यम्  like nectar, अपिदुर्लभं that which is difficult to get.
explanation: 'Knowing that Vaidehi is not eating food(given by Ravana) Indra,the ruler of gods, will offer nectarlike food rare even for gods.

shloka_text: तदन्नं मैथिलीप्राप्य विज्ञायेन्द्रादिदंत्विति। अग्रमुदृत्य रामाय भूतले निर्वपिष्यति।।4.62.9।।
transliteration: tadannaṃ maithilīprāpya vijñāyendrādidaṃtviti| agramudṛtya rāmāya bhūtale nirvapiṣyati
translation: तदन्नं such food, मैथिली princess from Mithila, प्राप्य received, विज्ञाय having understood, अदिदंत्विति this is provided by, इन्द्रात् Indra, अग्रम् large portion, उदृत्य taken out, रामाय for Rama, भूतले on the earth, निर्वपिष्यति offers.
explanation: 'Having understood that it has been provided by Indra, Sita will take out a large portion of it and pour it on the ground (as an offering to Rama) and say 'I offer it to Rama wherever he is on earth'.

shloka_text: यदि जीवति मे भर्ता लक्ष्मणेन सह प्रभुः। देवत्वं गच्छ्तो र्वापि तयो रन्नमिदंत्विति4.62.10।।
transliteration: yadi jīvati me bhartā lakṣmaṇena saha prabhuḥ| devatvaṃ gacchto rvāpi tayo rannamidaṃtviti4.62.10||
translation: मे my, भर्ता husband, लक्ष्मणेन with Lakshmana, सह along with, प्रभुः king, यदि like that, जीवति if living, देवत्वं attained heaven, गच्छतः have gone, वापि or so, तयो: their, अन्नमिदंत्विति let this food be enjoyed by them.
explanation: 'If my husband and Lakshmana are living or else even if they have attained heaven let this food be enjoyed by them', Sita will say.

shloka_text: एष्यन्त्यन्वेषका स्तस्या रामदूताः प्लवांगमाः। आख़्येया राम महीषी त्वया तेभ्यो विहंगम4.62.11।।
transliteration: eṣyantyanveṣakā stasyā rāmadūtāḥ plavāṃgamāḥ| āk͟hyeyā rāma mahīṣī tvayā tebhyo vihaṃgama4.62.11||
translation: रामदूताः Rama's messenger, एष्यन्ति and others that way, अन्वेषका to search, तस्याः for her, प्लवांगमाः monkeys, आख़्येया narrate, रामः Rama, महीषी queen, त्वया your, तेभ्यो to them, विहंगम bird (Sampati).
explanation: 'Rama's messenger and other monkeys will be coming to search for the his queen. O Sampati you should narrate this to them.

shloka_text: सर्वथा हि नगन्तव्यमीदृशः क्व गमिष्यसि। देशकालौ प्रतीक्षस्व पक्षौ त्वं प्रतिपत्स्यसे4.62.12।।
transliteration: sarvathā hi nagantavyamīdṛśaḥ kva gamiṣyasi| deśakālau pratīkṣasva pakṣau tvaṃ pratipatsyase4.62.12||
translation: सर्वथा in all respects, हि indeed, न गन्तव्यम् should not leave, इदृशः remain here, क्व गमिष्यसि where can you go, देशकालौ time and place, प्रतीक्षस्व waiting for, पक्षौ wings, त्वं yours, प्रतिपत्स्यसे will again grow.
explanation: 'It is good for you in all respects to remain here. Where can you go (without wings)? Wait for appropriate time and place. You will recover your wings'.

shloka_text: नोत्सहेयमहंकर्तुमध्यैव त्वां सपक्षकम्। इहस्थ स्त्वं तु लोकानां हितं कार्यं करिष्यसि।।4.62.13।।
transliteration: notsaheyamahaṃkartumadhyaiva tvāṃ sapakṣakam| ihastha stvaṃ tu lokānāṃ hitaṃ kāryaṃ kariṣyasi
translation: नोत्सह not enthusiastic, इयम् for me, अहंकर्तु if I make you get (the wings), मध्यैव remain here, त्वां your, सपक्षकम् your wings, इहस्थ: here itself, त्वं you, तु to you, लोकानां हितां good for the world, कार्यं task, करिष्यसि you will do.
explanation: 'I am not enthusiastic about giving you the wings now. Remain here and carry on the work for the welfare of the world.

shloka_text: त्वयापि खलु तत्कार्यं तयोश्चनृपपुत्रयोः। ब्राह्मणानां सुराणां च मुनीनां वासवस्य च।।4.62.14।।
transliteration: tvayāpi khalu tatkāryaṃ tayoścanṛpaputrayoḥ| brāhmaṇānāṃ surāṇāṃ ca munīnāṃ vāsavasya ca
translation: त्वया your, अपि and, खलु for all, तत् that, कार्यं task, तयो: for both of them, च and, नृपपुत्रयोः princes, ब्राह्मणानां for the brahmins, सुराणां च and gods, मुनीनां for sages, वासवस्यच and those who live here.
explanation: '(Carry on) the work not only for the princes (Rama and Lakshmana) but also for the brahmins, sages, gods and others who live here.

shloka_text: इच्छाम्यहमपिद्रष्टुं भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। नेच्छेचिरं धारयुतुं प्राणां स्त्यक्ष्ये कलेबरं। महर्षि स्त्वब्रवीदेवं दृष्टतत्वार्थदर्शनः।।4.62.15।।
transliteration: icchāmyahamapidraṣṭuṃ bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau| neccheciraṃ dhārayutuṃ prāṇāṃ styakṣye kalebaraṃ| maharṣi stvabravīdevaṃ dṛṣṭatatvārthadarśanaḥ
translation: इच्छाम desirous, अहं अपि I am also, द्रष्टुं to see, भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ brothers Rama and Lakshmana, न not, इच्छा चिरं desire to live long, धारयुतुं to hold on, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्ये will give up, कलेबरं my body, महर्षि: sage, तु your, अब्रवीत् said, एवं this, दृष्टः after seeing, तत्वार्थदर्शनः knower of self.
explanation: 'I also want to see Rama and Lakshmana. But I do not like to hold on to my life for long. Hence I will give up my body'. The knower of self, the sage (Nishakara) said this to Sampati. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे  द्विषष्टितम स्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysecond sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एतैरन्यैश्च बहुभिर्वाक्यैर्वाक्यविशारदः। मां प्रशस्याभ्यनुज्ञाप्य प्रविष्टस्स स्वमालयम्।।4.63.1।।
transliteration: etairanyaiśca bahubhirvākyairvākyaviśāradaḥ| māṃ praśasyābhyanujñāpya praviṣṭassa svamālayam
translation: वाक्यविशारदः skilful in speech, सः he (sage), एतैः by these, अन्यैश्च and others, बहुभिः by many, वाक्यैः with words, माम् me, प्रशस्य having praised, अभ्यनुज्ञाप्य permitted me to leave, स्वम् his own, आलयम् dwelling, प्रविष्टः entered.
explanation: 'The sage who was skilful in speech, having  praised me thus and in many other ways,  permitted me to leave and entered his dwelling.
comments: Sampati gets back his wings -- the monkeys rejoice and proceed southward.

shloka_text: कन्दरात्तु विसर्पित्वा पर्वतस्य शनैश्शनैः। अहं विन्ध्यं समारुह्य भवतः प्रतिपालये।।4.63.2।।
transliteration: kandarāttu visarpitvā parvatasya śanaiśśanaiḥ| ahaṃ vindhyaṃ samāruhya bhavataḥ pratipālaye
translation: अहम् I, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, कन्दरात् from the cave, शनैः शनैः slowly and slowly, विसर्पित्वा having crawled, विन्ध्यम् Vindhya, समारुह्य after climbing, भवतः you, प्रतिपालये I am waiting for your arrival.
explanation: 'Having crawled slowly and slowly from the cave and climbed the Vindhya, I have been awaiting your arrival.

shloka_text: अद्य त्वेतस्य कालस्य साग्रं वर्षशतं गतम्। देशकालप्रतीक्षोऽस्मि हृदि कृत्वा मुनेर्वचः।।4.63.3।।
transliteration: adya tvetasya kālasya sāgraṃ varṣaśataṃ gatam| deśakālapratīkṣo'smi hṛdi kṛtvā munervacaḥ
translation: अद्य now, एतस्य कालस्य of this time, साग्रम् more than, वर्षशतम् one hundred years, गतम् have passed, मुनेः sage's, वचः words, हृदि in heart, कृत्वा by bearing, देशकालप्रतीक्षः waiting for the right time and place, अस्मि I am.
explanation: 'More than a hundred years have passed and all this time I have borne the sage's words in my heart and have waited for the right time and place.

shloka_text: महाप्रस्थानमासाद्य स्वर्गते तु निशाकरे। मां निर्दहति सन्तापो वितर्कैर्बहुभिर्वृतम्।।4.63.4।।
transliteration: mahāprasthānamāsādya svargate tu niśākare| māṃ nirdahati santāpo vitarkairbahubhirvṛtam
translation: निशाकरे when Nishakara, महाप्रस्थानम् the last journey, आसाद्य having launched, स्वर्गते when he reached heaven, बहुभिः by many, वितर्कैः with alternatives, वृतम् filled with, माम् me, सन्तापः sorrow, निर्दहति it is burning.
explanation: 'Nishakara went on his last journey and attained heaven. Since then many sad thoughts have crisscrossed my mind and I am consumed with those thoughts.

shloka_text: उत्थितां मरणे बुद्धिं मुनिवाक्यैर्निवर्तये। बुद्धिर्या तेन मे दत्ता प्राणानां रक्षणाय तु।।4.63.5।। सा मेऽपनयते दुःखं दीप्तेवाग्निशिखा तमः।
transliteration: utthitāṃ maraṇe buddhiṃ munivākyairnivartaye| buddhiryā tena me dattā prāṇānāṃ rakṣaṇāya tu sā me'panayate duḥkhaṃ dīptevāgniśikhā tamaḥ|
translation: मरणे for death, उत्थिम् intending, बुद्धिम् my mind, मुनिवाक्यैः  sage's words, निवर्तये I avert, मे my, प्राणानाम् of life, रक्षणे in protecting, तेन by him, मे my, या such, बुद्धिः thought, दत्ता is given, सा that, दीप्ता glowing, अग्निशिखा like the flames of fire, तमः इव like darkness, मे my, दु:खम् agony, अपनयते take away.
explanation: 'Whenever I intended to die, the words of the sage rang in my mind. The inspiration he gave me to preserve my life removed my agony like the glowing flames of fire that take away darkness.

shloka_text: बुद्ध्यता च मया वीर्यं रावणस्य दुरात्मनः।।4.63.6।। पुत्रस्सन्तर्जितो वाग्भिर्न त्राता मैथिली कथम्।
transliteration: buddhyatā ca mayā vīryaṃ rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ putrassantarjito vāgbhirna trātā maithilī katham|
translation: दुरात्मनः of the evilminded, रावणस्य Ravana's, वीर्यं बुद्ध्यता knowing his valour, मया by me, मैथिली princess from Mithila, कथम् how, न त्राता not protected, वाग्भिः with (harsh) words, पुत्रः son, संतर्जितः goaded.
explanation: 'I goaded my son with harsh words saying, 'Knowing the valour of the evilminded Ravana, why did you not protect her (Sita)'

shloka_text: तस्या विलपितं श्रुत्वा तौ च सीताविनाकृतौ।।4.63.7।। न मे दशरथस्नेहात्पुत्रेणोत्पादितं प्रियम्।
transliteration: tasyā vilapitaṃ śrutvā tau ca sītāvinākṛtau na me daśarathasnehātputreṇotpāditaṃ priyam|
translation: तस्याः her, विलपितम् wailing, श्रुत्वा on hearing also, तौ both (Rama and Lakshmna), सीताविनाकृतौ separated from Sita, मे for me, दशरथस्नेहात् in view of my friendship with Dasaratha, पुत्रेण by my son, प्रियम् pleased, न उत्पादितम् not created.
explanation: 'Even after hearing the wailing of Sita, knowing that both (Rama and Lakshmana) are separated from her and considering my friendship with Dasaratha, I felt displeased with my son (as he did not make an attempt to rescue her)'.

shloka_text: तस्य त्वेवं ब्रुवाणस्य सम्पातेर्वानरैस्सह।।4.63.8।। उत्पेततुस्तदा पक्षौ समक्षं वनचारिणाम्।
transliteration: tasya tvevaṃ bruvāṇasya sampātervānaraissaha utpetatustadā pakṣau samakṣaṃ vanacāriṇām|
translation: तदा then, संहतैः together with, वानरैस्सह with the monkeys, तस्य when he, एवम् in that way, ब्रुवाणस्य while he was speaking, वनचारिणाम् of forestdwellers, समक्षम् in the presence, पक्षौ both wings, उत्पेततुः started appearing.
explanation: Even as he was telling this to the monkeys his wings started appearing in their presence.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा स्वां तनुं पक्षैरुद्गतैररुणच्छदैः।।4.63.9।। प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे वानरांश्चेदमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā svāṃ tanuṃ pakṣairudgatairaruṇacchadaiḥ praharṣamatulaṃ lebhe vānarāṃścedamabravīt|
translation: सः he, अरुणच्छदैः with red feathers, उद्गतैः grown, पक्षैः with wings, स्वाम् his, तनुम् body, दृष्ट्वा seeing, अतुलम् unparalleled, प्रहर्षम् delight, लेभे experienced, वानरान् monkeys, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् च and said.
explanation: He experienced an unparalleled delight seeing wings with red feathers growing on his body, and said to the monkeys:

shloka_text: ऋषेर्निशाकरस्यैव प्रभावादमितात्मन:।।4.63.10।। आदित्यरश्मिनिर्दग्धौ पक्षौ मे पुनरुपस्थितौ।
transliteration: ṛṣerniśākarasyaiva prabhāvādamitātmana: ādityaraśminirdagdhau pakṣau me punarupasthitau|
translation: अमितात्मनः of the most revered soul, ऋषेः sage, निशाकरस्य Nishakara's, प्रभावात् due to his grace, आदित्यरश्मिनिर्दग्धौ those that are burnt by Sun's radiant heat, मे my, पक्षौ both wings, पुनः again, उपस्थितौ have grown.
explanation: 'By the grace of the most revered soul,sage Nishakara, both my wings that were burnt by the Sun's radiance have grown again.

shloka_text: यौवने वर्तमानस्य ममासीद्यः पराक्रमः।।4.63.11।। तमेवाद्यावगच्छामि बलं पौरुषमेव च।
transliteration: yauvane vartamānasya mamāsīdyaḥ parākramaḥ tamevādyāvagacchāmi balaṃ pauruṣameva ca|
translation: यौवने in youth, वर्तमानस्य while I was, मम my, यः that, पराक्रमः valour, आसीत् had been, तमेव the same one, अद्य now, अवगच्छामि I find, बलम् strength, पौरुषमेव even courage, च also.
explanation: 'The valour, strength and even courage that I had in my youth,I am experiencing now.

shloka_text: सर्वथा क्रियतां यत्न स्सीतामधिगमिष्यथ।।4.63.12।। पक्षलाभो ममायं वस्सिद्धिप्रत्ययकारकः।
transliteration: sarvathā kriyatāṃ yatna ssītāmadhigamiṣyatha pakṣalābho mamāyaṃ vassiddhipratyayakārakaḥ|
translation: सर्वथा by all means, यत्नः effort, क्रियताम् may be made, सीताम् Sita, अधिगमिष्यथ you will trace, मम me, अयम् this, पक्षलाभः growing of wings, वः to you, सिद्धिप्रत्ययकारकः is a proof of your success in future.
explanation: By all means make the effort; you will trace Sita, and this growing of my wings is a sign assuring your future success.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा स तान्हरीन् सर्वान्सम्पातिः पतगोत्तमः।।4.63.13।। उत्पपात गिरेश्शृङ्गाज्जिज्ञासुः खगमो गतिम्।
transliteration: ityuktvā sa tānharīn sarvānsampātiḥ patagottamaḥ utpapāta gireśśṛṅgājjijñāsuḥ khagamo gatim|
translation: पतगोत्तमः foremost of birds, सम्पातिः Sampathi, सर्वान् all, सः those, हरीन् monkeys, इति in this way, उक्त्वा having said, खगमः the bird, गतिम् direction, जिज्ञासुः eager to find, गिरेः mountain's, शृङ्गात् from the peak, उत्पपात flew up.
explanation: Sampati, the foremost of the birds thus spoke to the monkeys and flew up from the mountain's peak keen on finding the aerial path.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रतिसंहृष्टमानसाः।।4.63.14।। बभूवुर्हरिशार्दूला विक्रमाभ्युदयोन्मुखाः।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratisaṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ babhūvurhariśārdūlā vikramābhyudayonmukhāḥ|
translation: हरिशार्दूलाः tigers among monkeys, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, प्रतिसंहृष्टमानसाः in turn felt very happy, विक्रमाभ्युदयोन्मुखाः hoping success with their valour, बभूवुः  became.
explanation: The tigers among monkeys felt very happy on hearing the words of Sampati and became sure of their success with their valour.

shloka_text: अथ पवनसमानविक्रमाः प्लवगवराः प्रतिलब्धपौरुषाः। अभिजिदभिमुखा दिशं ययु र्जनकसुतापरिमार्गणोन्मुखाः।।4.63.15।।
transliteration: atha pavanasamānavikramāḥ plavagavarāḥ pratilabdhapauruṣāḥ| abhijidabhimukhā diśaṃ yayu rjanakasutāparimārgaṇonmukhāḥ
translation: अथ now, पवनसमानविक्रमाः as strong as the wind, प्रतिलब्धपौरुषाः regained courage, प्लवगवराः best of the monkeys, अभिजिदभिमुखाः facing Abhijit, जनकसुतापरिमार्गणोन्मुखाः eager to find the daughter of Janaka, दिशम् direction, ययुः went.
explanation: The monkeys as strong as the wind regained courage and went in search of the daughter of Janaka in the direction of Abhijit (constellation known as Abhijit is associated with success). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: आख्याता गृध्रराजेन समुत्प्लुत्य प्लवङ्गमाः। सङ्गताः प्रीतिसंयुक्ता विनेदुर्भीमविक्रमाः।।4.64.1।।
transliteration: ākhyātā gṛdhrarājena samutplutya plavaṅgamāḥ| saṅgatāḥ prītisaṃyuktā vinedurbhīmavikramāḥ
translation: गृध्रराजेन by the king of vultures, आख्याताः directed, भीमविक्रमा terribly courageous, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, संगताः assembled, प्रीतिसंयुक्ताः they were pleased, समुत्प्लुत्य leaped, विनेदुः screaming in joy.
explanation: Hearing the words spoken by the king of vultures, the highly courageous monkeys assembled together and leaped with joyscreaming.
comments: Angada discusses with the monkeys the strategies to cross the ocean.

shloka_text: सम्पातेर्वचनं श्रुत्वा हरयो रावणक्षयम्। हृष्टास्सागरमाजग्मुस्सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।4.64.2।।
transliteration: sampātervacanaṃ śrutvā harayo rāvaṇakṣayam| hṛṣṭāssāgaramājagmussītādarśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
translation: हरयः monkeys, सम्पातेः Sampati's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, हृष्टाः glad, सीतादर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः desiring to see Sita, रावणक्षयम् the abode of Ravana, सागरम् ocean, आजग्मुः reached.
explanation: On hearing the words of Sampati, the monkeys felt glad and, eager to see Sita, reached the ocean, the passage to the abode of Ravana.

shloka_text: अभिक्रम्य तु तं देशं ददृशुर्भीमविक्रमाः। कृत्स्नं लोकस्य महतः प्रतिबिम्बमिव स्थितम्।।4.64.3।।
transliteration: abhikramya tu taṃ deśaṃ dadṛśurbhīmavikramāḥ| kṛtsnaṃ lokasya mahataḥ pratibimbamiva sthitam
translation: भीमविक्रमाः those with frigtening courage, तम् that, देशम् place, अभिक्रम्य having reached, महतः of a great, लोकस्य of the world, कृत्स्नम् vast, प्रतिबिम्बमिव like an image, स्थितम् placed, ददृशुः saw.
explanation: Having reached the ocean, the monkeys, endowed with frightening courage, stood looking at the vast ocean which appeared like an image of the whole world.

shloka_text: दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य समासाद्योत्तरां दिशम्। सन्निवेशं ततश्चक्रुर्हरिवीरा महाबलाः।।4.64.4।।
transliteration: dakṣiṇasya samudrasya samāsādyottarāṃ diśam| sanniveśaṃ tataścakrurharivīrā mahābalāḥ
translation: महाबलाः powerful, हरिवीराः heroic monkeys, समुद्रस्य ocean's, उत्तरां दिशम् northernside, समासाद्य having reached, ततः then, सन्निवेशम् collected at that, चक्रुः held.
explanation: Powerful and heroic monkeys assembled at the northern end of the southern ocean.

shloka_text: सत्त्वैर्महद्भिर्विकृतैः क्रीडद्भिर्विविधैर्जले। व्यात्तास्यैस्सुमहाकायैरूर्मिभिश्च समाकुलम्।।4.64.5।। प्रसुप्तमिव चान्यत्र क्रीडन्तमिव चान्यतः। क्वचित्पर्वतमात्रैश्च जलराशिभिरावृतम्।।4.64.6।। सङ्कुलं दानवेन्द्रैश्च पातालतलवासिभिः। रोमहर्षकरं दृष्ट्वा विषेदु: कपिकुञ्जराः।।4.64.7।।
transliteration: sattvairmahadbhirvikṛtaiḥ krīḍadbhirvividhairjale| vyāttāsyaissumahākāyairūrmibhiśca samākulam prasuptamiva cānyatra krīḍantamiva cānyataḥ| kvacitparvatamātraiśca jalarāśibhirāvṛtam saṅkulaṃ dānavendraiśca pātālatalavāsibhiḥ| romaharṣakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣedu: kapikuñjarāḥ
translation: जले in water, क्रीडद्भिः  sporting in water, महद्भि: great ocean, विकृतैः  of terrifying form, विविधैः several, सत्त्वै: species, व्यात्तास्यैः by grotesque creatures, सुमहाकायैः of massive body, ऊर्मिभिश्च with waves, समाकुलम् filled with, यत्र there, प्रसुप्तमिव as if sleeping, अन्यतः at other places, क्रीडन्तमिव like sporting, क्वचित् and at some places, पर्वतमात्रैः  as high as mountain, जलराशिभिः volumes of water, आवृतम् covered, पातालतलवासिभिः who dwell in the underworld, दानवेन्द्रैश्च also by lords of demons, सङ्कुलम् filled, रोमहर्षकरम् causing horripilation, दृष्ट्वा seeing, कपिकुञ्जराः elephants among monkeys, विषेदुः became worried.
explanation: The ocean was of terrifying form filled with various violent species of grotesque creatures of huge bodies playing in the water. Full of violent tides, it appeared asleep at one place and apparently sporting in another. In some places it was rising as high as a mountain with huge volumes of water. It was as if roaring with the demon chiefs residing in the underworld. The great monkeys were worried seeing the huge ocean which created horripilation in them.

shloka_text: सत्त्वैर्महद्भिर्विकृतैः क्रीडद्भिर्विविधैर्जले। व्यात्तास्यैस्सुमहाकायैरूर्मिभिश्च समाकुलम्।।4.64.5।। प्रसुप्तमिव चान्यत्र क्रीडन्तमिव चान्यतः। क्वचित्पर्वतमात्रैश्च जलराशिभिरावृतम्।।4.64.6।। सङ्कुलं दानवेन्द्रैश्च पातालतलवासिभिः। रोमहर्षकरं दृष्ट्वा विषेदु: कपिकुञ्जराः।।4.64.7।।

translation: जले in water, क्रीडद्भिः  sporting in water, महद्भि: great ocean, विकृतैः  of terrifying form, विविधैः several, सत्त्वै: species, व्यात्तास्यैः by grotesque creatures, सुमहाकायैः of massive body, ऊर्मिभिश्च with waves, समाकुलम् filled with, यत्र there, प्रसुप्तमिव as if sleeping, अन्यतः at other places, क्रीडन्तमिव like sporting, क्वचित् and at some places, पर्वतमात्रैः  as high as mountain, जलराशिभिः volumes of water, आवृतम् covered, पातालतलवासिभिः who dwell in the underworld, दानवेन्द्रैश्च also by lords of demons, सङ्कुलम् filled, रोमहर्षकरम् causing horripilation, दृष्ट्वा seeing, कपिकुञ्जराः elephants among monkeys, विषेदुः became worried.
explanation: The ocean was of terrifying form filled with various violent species of grotesque creatures of huge bodies playing in the water. Full of violent tides, it appeared asleep at one place and apparently sporting in another. In some places it was rising as high as a mountain with huge volumes of water. It was as if roaring with the demon chiefs residing in the underworld. The great monkeys were worried seeing the huge ocean which created horripilation in them.

shloka_text: आकाशमिव दुष्पारं सागरं प्रेक्षय वानराः। विषेदु स्सहसासर्वे कथं कार्यमिति ब्रुवन्।।4.64.8।।
transliteration: ākāśamiva duṣpāraṃ sāgaraṃ prekṣaya vānarāḥ| viṣedu ssahasāsarve kathaṃ kāryamiti bruvan
translation: सहसा at once, सर्वे all, वानराः monkeys, आकाशमिव looking like the sky, दुष्पारम् impossible to cross, सागरम् ocean, प्रेक्षय seeing, विषेदुः worried, कथम् how, कार्यम् the task can be performed, इति thus, ब्रुवन् while saying
explanation: All the monkeys were worried when they suddenly saw the ocean which looked impassable like the sky. They wondered if they can at all accomplish the task (of finding Sita)

shloka_text: विषण्णां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा सागरस्य निरीक्षणात्। आश्वासयामास हरीन्भयार्तान् हरिसत्तमः।।4.64.9।।
transliteration: viṣaṇṇāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā sāgarasya nirīkṣaṇāt| āśvāsayāmāsa harīnbhayārtān harisattamaḥ
translation: हरिसत्तमः Angada, the best of the monkeys, सागरस्य ocean's, निरीक्षणात् gazing at, विषण्णाम्   despondent, वाहिनीम् army, दृष्ट्वा seeing, भयार्तान् frightened, हरीन् monkeys, आश्वासयामास comforted.
explanation: Angada, the best among the monkeys saw the worried army despondent gazing at the ocean, and comforted the frightened troops.

shloka_text: तान्विषादेन महता विषण्णान्वानरर्षभान्। उवाच मतिमान्काले वालिसूनुर्महाबलः।।4.64.10।।
transliteration: tānviṣādena mahatā viṣaṇṇānvānararṣabhān| uvāca matimānkāle vālisūnurmahābalaḥ
translation: मतिमान् wise, महाबलः strong, वालिसूनुः son of Vali, महता great, विषादेन sorrow, विषण्णान् worried, तान् वानरर्षभान् those bulls among monkeys, काले  in time, उवाच said.
explanation: Angada,the strong and wise  son of Vali, spoke thus to the tensed vanaras in the right time:

shloka_text: न विषादे मनः कार्यं विषादो दोषवत्तमः। विषादो हन्ति पुरुषं बालं क्रुद्ध इवोरगः।।4.64.11।।
transliteration: na viṣāde manaḥ kāryaṃ viṣādo doṣavattamaḥ| viṣādo hanti puruṣaṃ bālaṃ kruddha ivoragaḥ
translation: वषादे in despondency, मनः mind, न कार्यम् does not work, विषादः despair, दोषवत्तमाः biggest flaw, क्रुद्धः angry, उरगः serpent, बालम् इव like a child, पुरुषम् man, विषादः despondency, हन्ति destroys.
explanation: 'Do not be despondent. It is the biggest flaw. It destroys a person like an angry serpent killing a young child.

shloka_text: यो विषादं प्रसहते विक्रमे पर्युपस्थिते। तेजसा तस्य हीनस्य पुरुषार्थो न सिध्यति।।4.64.12।।
transliteration: yo viṣādaṃ prasahate vikrame paryupasthite| tejasā tasya hīnasya puruṣārtho na sidhyati
translation: विक्रमे when valiance, समुपस्थिते needs to be exhibited, यः whoever, विषादम् despondency, प्रसहते will succumb, तेजसा with brilliant, हीनस्य of a deprived one, तस्य his, पुरुषार्थः manly pursuit, न सिध्यति will not achieve.
explanation: 'If one succumbs to despondency while he has to exhibit his valour, his brilliance gets diminished and he does not succeed in his manly pursuits'.

shloka_text: तस्यां रात्र्यां व्यतीतायामङ्गदो वानरैस्सह। हरिवृद्धैस्समागम्य पुनर्मन्त्रममन्त्रयत्।।4.64.13।।
transliteration: tasyāṃ rātryāṃ vyatītāyāmaṅgado vānaraissaha| harivṛddhaissamāgamya punarmantramamantrayat
translation: तस्याम् when that, रात्रौ night, व्यतीतायाम् having ended, अङ्गदः Angada, हरिवृद्धैः with old monkeys, वानरैस्सह along with fellowmonkeys, समागम्य joined together, पुनः again, मन्त्रम् counsel, अमन्त्रयत् sought.
explanation: With the night over, Angada joined the older monkeys again and sought their counsel.

shloka_text: सा वानराणां ध्वजिनी परिवार्याङ्गदं बभौ। वासवं परिवार्येव मरुतां वाहिनी स्थिता।।4.64.14।।
transliteration: sā vānarāṇāṃ dhvajinī parivāryāṅgadaṃ babhau| vāsavaṃ parivāryeva marutāṃ vāhinī sthitā
translation: वानराणाम् of the monkeys, सा that, ध्वजिनी army, अङ्गदम् Angada, परिवार्य surrounding, स्थिता stood, वासवम् Indra, परिवार्य surrounding, मरुताम् of Maruts, वाहिनी इव like the army, बभौ appeared.
explanation: The army of monkeys encircled Angada like the army of Maruts surrounding Indra.

shloka_text: कोऽन्यस्तां वानरीं सेनां शक्त:स्तम्भयितुं भवेत्। अन्यत्र वालितनयादन्यत्र च हनूमतः।।4.64.15।।
transliteration: ko'nyastāṃ vānarīṃ senāṃ śakta:stambhayituṃ bhavet| anyatra vālitanayādanyatra ca hanūmataḥ
translation: वालितनयात् अन्यत्र other than Vali's son, हनूमतः Hanumat, अन्यत्र other than, अन्यः another person, कः who, ताम् that, वानरीम् monkey सेनाम् army, स्तम्भयितुम् to suspend, शक्तः can do, भवेत् will be.
explanation: Who else other than the son of Vali and Hanuman can resist and pacify the monkeyarmy?

shloka_text: ततस्तान्हरिवृद्धांश्च तच्च सैन्यमरिन्दमः। अनुमान्याङ्गदश्श्रीमान्वाक्यमर्थवदब्रवीत्।।4.64.16।।
transliteration: tatastānharivṛddhāṃśca tacca sainyamarindamaḥ| anumānyāṅgadaśśrīmānvākyamarthavadabravīt
translation: ततः then, अरिन्दमः subduer of foes, श्रीमान् illustrious, अङ्गदः Angada, तान् those, हरिवृद्धान् elderly monkeys, तत् that, सैन्यं च and the army also, अनुमान्य taking them into confidence, अर्थवत् meaningful, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् expressed.
explanation: Then the illustrious Angada, subduer of foes took the counsel of elderly monkeys and  the army into confidence and thus addressed them all in meaningful words:

shloka_text: क इदानीं महातेजा लङ्घयिष्यति सागरम्। कः करिष्यति सुग्रीवं सत्यसन्धमरिन्दमम्।।4.64.17।।
transliteration: ka idānīṃ mahātejā laṅghayiṣyati sāgaram| kaḥ kariṣyati sugrīvaṃ satyasandhamarindamam
translation: इदानीम् now, महातेजाः brilliant, कः who, सागरम् ocean, लङ्घयिष्यति will cross, कः who, अरिंदमम् subduer of foes, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, सत्यसन्धम् true to his promise, करिष्यति will render.
explanation: 'Now which mighty monkey will cross the ocean? Who will prove Sugriva, subduer of enemies, true to his promise?

shloka_text: को वीरो योजनशतं लङ्घयेत प्लवङ्गमाः। इमांश्च यूथपान् सर्वान्मोक्षयेत्को महाभयात्।।4.64.18।।
transliteration: ko vīro yojanaśataṃ laṅghayeta plavaṅgamāḥ| imāṃśca yūthapān sarvānmokṣayetko mahābhayāt
translation: वीरः hero, कः who, प्लवङ्गमा: O monkeys, योजनशतम् a hundred yojanas, लङ्घयेत can leap, इमान् these, यूथपान् leaders, सर्वान् all, महाभयात् from great fear, मोक्षयेत liberate them.
explanation: 'O monkeys which one can leap a hundred yojanas and liberate the monkey leaders from the great fear of Sugriva?

shloka_text: कस्य प्रभावाद्धारांश्च पुत्रांश्चैव गृहाणि च। इतो निवृत्ताः पश्येम सिद्धार्थास्सुखिनो वयम्।।4.64.19।।
transliteration: kasya prabhāvāddhārāṃśca putrāṃścaiva gṛhāṇi ca| ito nivṛttāḥ paśyema siddhārthāssukhino vayam
translation: वयम् we,कस्य whose, प्रभावात् effort,सिद्धार्थाः emerge successful,सुखिनः happy,इतः from here, निवृत्ताः return,दारांश्च wives,पुत्रांश्चैव and sons, गृहाणि च and homes,पश्येम we will see.
explanation: 'By whose effort can we be successful and return home happily from here to meet wives and sons?

shloka_text: कस्य प्रसादाद्रामं च लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्। अभिगच्छेम संहृष्टास्सुग्रीवं च वनौकसम्।।4.64.20।।
transliteration: kasya prasādādrāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam| abhigacchema saṃhṛṣṭāssugrīvaṃ ca vanaukasam
translation: कस्य whose, प्रसादात् grace, संहृष्टा: happily, रामं च Rama and, महाबलम् mighty, लक्ष्मणं च Lakshmana also, वनौकसम् forester, सुग्रीवं च even Sugriva, अभिगच्छेम can we approach.
explanation: 'By whose grace shall we approach Rama and Lakshmana and even the monkey king Sugriva happily?

shloka_text: यदि कश्चित्समर्थो वस्सागरप्लवने हरिः। स ददा त्विह न शशीघ्रं पुण्यामभयदक्षिणाम्।।4.64.21।।
transliteration: yadi kaścitsamartho vassāgaraplavane hariḥ| sa dadā tviha na śaśīghraṃ puṇyāmabhayadakṣiṇām
translation: वः among you, कश्चित् any one, हरिः vanara, सागरप्लवने in leaping the ocean, समर्थः यदि if he is capable, सः he, इह here, नः to us, शीघ्रम् quickly, पुण्याम् sacred, अभयदक्षिणाम् a gift of assurance, ददातु can he give?
explanation: 'If there is any one among you who is capable of leaping  across the ocean he will be giving all of us the sacred gift of life quickly?'

shloka_text: अङ्गदस्य वच श्शृत्वा न कश्चित् किञ्चिदब्रवीत्। स्तिमिते वा भवत्सर्वा सा तत्र हरिवाहिनी।।4.64.22।।
transliteration: aṅgadasya vaca śśṛtvā na kaścit kiñcidabravīt| stimite vā bhavatsarvā sā tatra harivāhinī
translation: अङ्गदस्य Angada's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, कश्चित् any one, किञ्चित् even a little, न अब्रवीत् did not speak, तत्र there, सर्वा the entire, सा that, हरिवाहिनी army of monkeys स्तिमिते motionless, अभवत् became.
explanation: After hearing Angada, no one spoke a word. The entire army of monkeys became still and motionless.

shloka_text: पुनरेवाङ्गदः प्राह तान्हरीन्हरिसत्तमः। सर्वे बलवतां श्रेष्ठा भवन्तो दृढविक्रमाः।।4.64.23।। व्यपदेश्य कुले जाताः पूजिताश्चाप्यभीक्ष्णशः।
transliteration: punarevāṅgadaḥ prāha tānharīnharisattamaḥ| sarve balavatāṃ śreṣṭhā bhavanto dṛḍhavikramāḥ vyapadeśya kule jātāḥ pūjitāścāpyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ|
translation: हरिसत्तमः best of monkeys, अङ्गदः Angada, तान् हरीन् those monkeys, पुनरेव once again, प्राह addressed, भवन्तः you are, सर्वे all, बलवताम् among strong, श्रेष्ठाः eminent, दृढविक्रमाः mighty, व्यपदेशकुले in a renowned family, जाताः born, अभीक्ष्णशः again and again, पूजिताश्च honoured.
explanation: Angada, the best of the monkeys again addressed them saying, 'you are all mighty, eminent and courageous, born in renowned families and have been honoured again and again(for your actions).

shloka_text: न हि वो गमने सङ्गः कदाचित्कस्यचित्क्वचित्। ब्रुवध्वं यस्य या शक्तिः प्लवने प्लवगर्षभाः।।4.64.24।।
transliteration: na hi vo gamane saṅgaḥ kadācitkasyacitkvacit| bruvadhvaṃ yasya yā śaktiḥ plavane plavagarṣabhāḥ
translation: वः to you, कस्यचित् any one of you, कदाचित् at any time, गमने fly, सङ्गः no obstruction, क्वचित् हि to carry out, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, प्लवने in leaping, यस्य whose, या such, शक्तिः capacity, ब्रुवध्वम्  speak .
explanation: 'None of you at any time have faced any obstruction in doing your deeds. You are efficient  in leaping. O bulls among monkeys now speak out, who among you can fly and how far? इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे चतुष्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfourth sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अथाङ्गदवचश्श्रुत्वा ते सर्वे वानरर्षभाः। स्वं स्वं गतौ समुत्साहमूचुस्तत्र यथाक्रमम्।।4.65.1।। गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्धमादनः। मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चैव सुषेणो जाम्बवां स्तथा।।4.65.2।।
transliteration: athāṅgadavacaśśrutvā te sarve vānararṣabhāḥ| svaṃ svaṃ gatau samutsāhamūcustatra yathākramam gajo gavākṣo gavayaśśarabho gandhamādanaḥ| maindaśca dvividaścaiva suṣeṇo jāmbavāṃ stathā
translation: अथ and then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्चैव even Dvivida, सुषेणः Sushena, तथा so also, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वे all, ते them, वानरर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, यथाक्रमम् following an order, तत्र there, गतौ in turn the scope for, स्वं स्वम् on their own, समुत्साहम् capability (to leap), ऊचुः expressed.
explanation: Thereafter, on hearing Angada, all the leaders among the monkeys, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda, Dvivida, Sushena and Jambavan as well expressed one after  the other their capability for leaping.
comments: Each of the monkey leaders declares the distance they can fly -- Jambavan resolves not to send Angada but send Hanuman instead to cross.

shloka_text: अथाङ्गदवचश्श्रुत्वा ते सर्वे वानरर्षभाः। स्वं स्वं गतौ समुत्साहमूचुस्तत्र यथाक्रमम्।।4.65.1।। गजो गवाक्षो गवयश्शरभो गन्धमादनः। मैन्दश्च द्विविदश्चैव सुषेणो जाम्बवां स्तथा।।4.65.2।।
transliteration: athāṅgadavacaśśrutvā te sarve vānararṣabhāḥ| svaṃ svaṃ gatau samutsāhamūcustatra yathākramam gajo gavākṣo gavayaśśarabho gandhamādanaḥ| maindaśca dvividaścaiva suṣeṇo jāmbavāṃ stathā
translation: अथ and then, अङ्गदवचः Angada's words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्चैव even Dvivida, सुषेणः Sushena, तथा so also, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, सर्वे all, ते them, वानरर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, यथाक्रमम् following an order, तत्र there, गतौ in turn the scope for, स्वं स्वम् on their own, समुत्साहम् capability (to leap), ऊचुः expressed.
explanation: Thereafter, on hearing Angada, all the leaders among the monkeys, Gaja, Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Mainda, Dvivida, Sushena and Jambavan as well expressed one after  the other their capability for leaping.
comments: Each of the monkey leaders declares the distance they can fly -- Jambavan resolves not to send Angada but send Hanuman instead to cross.

shloka_text: आबभाषे गजस्तत्र प्लवेयं दशयोजनम्। गवाक्षो योजननान्याह गमिष्यामीति विंशतिम्।।4.65.3।।
transliteration: ābabhāṣe gajastatra plaveyaṃ daśayojanam| gavākṣo yojananānyāha gamiṣyāmīti viṃśatim
translation: तत्र after that, गजः Gaja, दशयोजनम् ten yojanas, प्लवेयम् I can leap, आबभाषे said, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, विंशतिम् twenty, योजनानि yojanas, गमिष्यामि I can go, इति thus, आह said.
explanation: Gaja said he can leap ten yojanas and Gavaksha said he can go upto twenty yojanas.

shloka_text: गवयो वानरस्तत्र वानरां स्तानुवाच ह। त्रिंशतं तु गमिष्यामि योजनानां प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.65.4।। शरभस्तानुवाचाथ वानरान् वानरर्षभः। चत्वारिंशद्गमिष्यामि योजनानां प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.65.5।। वानरस्तु महातेजा अब्रवीद्गन्धमादनः। योजनानां गमिष्यामि पञ्चाशत्तु न संशयः।।4.65.6।। मैन्दस्तु वानरस्तत्र वानरांस्तानुवाच ह। योजनानां परं षष्टिमहं प्लवितुमुत्सहे।।4.65.7।। ततस्तत्र महातेजा द्विविदः प्रत्यभाषत। गमिष्यामि न सन्देहस्सप्ततिं योजनान्यहम्।।4.65.8।। सुषेणस्तु महातेजा:प्रोक्तवान्हरिसत्तमान्। अशीतिं योजनानां तु प्लवेयं प्लवगेश्वराः।।4.65.9।।
transliteration: gavayo vānarastatra vānarāṃ stānuvāca ha| triṃśataṃ tu gamiṣyāmi yojanānāṃ plavaṅgamāḥ śarabhastānuvācātha vānarān vānararṣabhaḥ| catvāriṃśadgamiṣyāmi yojanānāṃ plavaṅgamāḥ vānarastu mahātejā abravīdgandhamādanaḥ| yojanānāṃ gamiṣyāmi pañcāśattu na saṃśayaḥ maindastu vānarastatra vānarāṃstānuvāca ha| yojanānāṃ paraṃ ṣaṣṭimahaṃ plavitumutsahe tatastatra mahātejā dvividaḥ pratyabhāṣata| gamiṣyāmi na sandehassaptatiṃ yojanānyaham suṣeṇastu mahātejā:proktavānharisattamān| aśītiṃ yojanānāṃ tu plaveyaṃ plavageśvarāḥ
translation: तत्र there, गवयो Gava, वानरः monkeys, तान् वानरान् the monkeys, उवाच ह said like that, प्लवङ्गमाः O leaping monkeys, योजनानाम्  yojanas, त्रिंशतम् thirty, गमिष्यामि I can reach, तत्र there, शरभः Sarabha, वानरर्षभ great monkey, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, योजनानाम् yojanas, चत्वारिंशत् forty, गमिष्यामि can reach, संशयः doubt, न without, महातेजाः bright, गन्धमादनः Ghandamadana, वानरान् monkeys, अब्रवीत् said, योजनानाम् yojanas, पञ्चाशत् fifty, गमिष्यामि I can go, संशयः doubt, न no, तत्र there, मैन्दः Mainda, वानरस्तु to the monkeys, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, अहम् I, योजनानाम् of yojanas, षष्टिं परम् more than sixty, प्लवितुम् to leap, उत्सहे I am enthusiastic, ततः then, महातेजाः highly brilliant, द्विविदः Dvivida, तत्र there, प्रत्यभाषत in turn spoke, अहम् I, सप्तति: seventy, योजनानि yojanas, गमिष्यामि I can go, सन्देहः doubt, न not, महातेजाः brilliant, सत्त्ववान् strong, सुषेणः Sushena, कपिसत्तमः best among the monkeys, अहम् I, पराक्रमे capability, योजनानाम् of yojanas, अशीतिम् eighty, प्लवेयं I can leap.
explanation: Then Gavaya said to the monkeys 'I can leap thirty yojanas Sarabha said 'I can leap forty yojanas' bright Ghandhamadana said 'I can leap as far as fifty yojanas without any doubt' Mainda said 'I can leap more than sixty yojanas' highly brilliant Dvivida said in turn, 'I can no doubt leap seventy yojanas ' brilliant and best of the monkeys Sushena declared 'I can leap across eighty yojanas'.

shloka_text: गवयो वानरस्तत्र वानरां स्तानुवाच ह। त्रिंशतं तु गमिष्यामि योजनानां प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.65.4।। शरभस्तानुवाचाथ वानरान् वानरर्षभः। चत्वारिंशद्गमिष्यामि योजनानां प्लवङ्गमाः।।4.65.5।। वानरस्तु महातेजा अब्रवीद्गन्धमादनः। योजनानां गमिष्यामि पञ्चाशत्तु न संशयः।।4.65.6।। मैन्दस्तु वानरस्तत्र वानरांस्तानुवाच ह। योजनानां परं षष्टिमहं प्लवितुमुत्सहे।।4.65.7।। ततस्तत्र महातेजा द्विविदः प्रत्यभाषत। गमिष्यामि न सन्देहस्सप्ततिं योजनान्यहम्।।4.65.8।। सुषेणस्तु महातेजा:प्रोक्तवान्हरिसत्तमान्। अशीतिं योजनानां तु प्लवेयं प्लवगेश्वराः।।4.65.9।।

translation: तत्र there, गवयो Gava, वानरः monkeys, तान् वानरान् the monkeys, उवाच ह said like that, प्लवङ्गमाः O leaping monkeys, योजनानाम्  yojanas, त्रिंशतम् thirty, गमिष्यामि I can reach, तत्र there, शरभः Sarabha, वानरर्षभ great monkey, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, योजनानाम् yojanas, चत्वारिंशत् forty, गमिष्यामि can reach, संशयः doubt, न without, महातेजाः bright, गन्धमादनः Ghandamadana, वानरान् monkeys, अब्रवीत् said, योजनानाम् yojanas, पञ्चाशत् fifty, गमिष्यामि I can go, संशयः doubt, न no, तत्र there, मैन्दः Mainda, वानरस्तु to the monkeys, तान् वानरान् those monkeys, उवाच ह said, अहम् I, योजनानाम् of yojanas, षष्टिं परम् more than sixty, प्लवितुम् to leap, उत्सहे I am enthusiastic, ततः then, महातेजाः highly brilliant, द्विविदः Dvivida, तत्र there, प्रत्यभाषत in turn spoke, अहम् I, सप्तति: seventy, योजनानि yojanas, गमिष्यामि I can go, सन्देहः doubt, न not, महातेजाः brilliant, सत्त्ववान् strong, सुषेणः Sushena, कपिसत्तमः best among the monkeys, अहम् I, पराक्रमे capability, योजनानाम् of yojanas, अशीतिम् eighty, प्लवेयं I can leap.
explanation: Then Gavaya said to the monkeys 'I can leap thirty yojanas Sarabha said 'I can leap forty yojanas' bright Ghandhamadana said 'I can leap as far as fifty yojanas without any doubt' Mainda said 'I can leap more than sixty yojanas' highly brilliant Dvivida said in turn, 'I can no doubt leap seventy yojanas ' brilliant and best of the monkeys Sushena declared 'I can leap across eighty yojanas'.

shloka_text: तेषां कथयतां तत्र सर्वांस्ताननुमान्य च। ततो वृद्धतमस्तेषां जाम्बवान्प्रत्यभाषत।।4.65.10।।
transliteration: teṣāṃ kathayatāṃ tatra sarvāṃstānanumānya ca| tato vṛddhatamasteṣāṃ jāmbavānpratyabhāṣata
translation: ततः then, तेषाम् among them, वृद्धतमः oldest, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, तेषाम् they, तत्र there, कथयताम् (when they were) saying, तान् सर्वान् all the, अनुमान्य inferred, प्रत्यभाषत replied.
explanation: When the monkeys were talking (of their individual capacity) in that manner about their speed, Jambavan the oldest of the monkeys inferred (their capacity) and said:

shloka_text: पूर्वमस्माकमप्यासीत्कश्चिद्गतिपराक्रमः। ते वयं वयसः पारमनुप्राप्तास्स्म साम्प्रतम्।।4.65.11।।
transliteration: pūrvamasmākamapyāsītkaścidgatiparākramaḥ| te vayaṃ vayasaḥ pāramanuprāptāssma sāmpratam
translation: पूर्वम् earlier, अस्माकमपि even I also, कश्चित् some, गतिपराक्रमः very courageous, आसीत् had , ते वयम् for me, साम्प्रतम् attained, वयसः (old) age, पारम् fag end of life, अनुप्राप्ताः स्म have reached.
explanation: 'Earlier I was also very courageous, but now I have become old and reached the fag end of life.

shloka_text: किन्तु नैवं गते शक्यमिदं कार्यमुपेक्षितुम्। यदर्थं कपिराजश्च रामश्च कृतनिश्चयौ।।4.65.12।।
transliteration: kintu naivaṃ gate śakyamidaṃ kāryamupekṣitum| yadarthaṃ kapirājaśca rāmaśca kṛtaniścayau
translation: किं तु however, एवं गते in this situation, यदर्थम् order, कपिराजश्च monkey king's, रामश्च and Rama's, कृतनिश्चयौ are determined, इदम् this, कार्यम् task, उपेक्षितुम् to neglect, न शक्यम् not possible.
explanation: 'However  in this situation, it is not possible for us to neglect (our task) as it is the order of the monkeyking and Rama who are determined to achieve the objective.

shloka_text: साम्प्रतं कालभेदेन या गतिस्तां निबोधत। नवतिं योजनानां तु गमिष्यामि न संशयः।।4.65.13।।
transliteration: sāmprataṃ kālabhedena yā gatistāṃ nibodhata| navatiṃ yojanānāṃ tu gamiṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
translation: साम्प्रतम् at this age, कालभेदेन due to advancement of age, या that, गतिः movement, ताम् that, निबोधत you know, योजनानाम् of yojanas, नवतिम् ninety,गमिष्यामि I can leap, संशयः doubt, न not.
explanation: Know the extent of my leap as lessened by age: I can spring ninety yojanas, without doubt.

shloka_text: तांश्च सर्वान्हरिश्रेष्ठाञ्जाम्बवान्पुनरब्रवीत्। न खल्वेतावदेवासीद्गमने मे पराक्रमः।।4.65.14।।
transliteration: tāṃśca sarvānhariśreṣṭhāñjāmbavānpunarabravīt| na khalvetāvadevāsīdgamane me parākramaḥ
translation: सर्वान् all, तान् of the monkeys, हरिश्रेष्ठान् distinguished among the monkeys, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, पुनः again, अब्रवीत् said, मे my, गमने in leaping, पराक्रमः valour, एतावदेव only that much, न आसीत् खलु was not.
explanation: Jambavan, the distinguished among the monkeys again said, 'My strength to leap into the sky was not only that much (I was stronger in my youth and could cover longer distances)'

shloka_text: मया महाबलेश्चैव यज्ञे विष्णुस्सनातनः। प्रदक्षिणीकृतः पूर्वं क्रममाणस्त्रिविक्रमम्।।4.65.15।।
transliteration: mayā mahābaleścaiva yajñe viṣṇussanātanaḥ| pradakṣiṇīkṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kramamāṇastrivikramam
translation: मया by myself, पूर्वम् earlier, महाबलेश्चैव of Mahabali, यज्ञे in yagna, क्रममाणः the advancing Lord, विष्णुः Visnu, सनातनः eternal, त्रिविक्रमः Visnu of three strides, प्रदक्षिणीकृतः circumambulated.
explanation: 'In the past, at the time of the wellknown yagna (of king Bali) I was very strong. I circumambulated the eternal Vishnu while he was taking three strides (in his incarnation of Trivikrama Vamana.)

shloka_text: स इदानीमहं वृद्धः प्लवने मन्दविक्रमः। यौवने च तदाऽसीन्मे बलमप्रतिमं परैः।।4.65.16।।
transliteration: sa idānīmahaṃ vṛddhaḥ plavane mandavikramaḥ| yauvane ca tadā'sīnme balamapratimaṃ paraiḥ
translation: इदानीम् now, वृद्धः old, सः अहम् that I am, प्लवने to leap, मन्दविक्रमः my strength is denuded, तदा then, यौवने in youth, मे बलम् my prowess, अप्रतिमम् incomparable, परैः by others, आसीत् it was.
explanation: 'Having grown old I do not have the same courage. In my youth my prowess was incomparable and none could excel me.

shloka_text: सम्प्रत्येतावतीं शक्तिं गमने तर्कयाम्यहम्। नैतावता हि संसिद्धिः कार्यस्यास्य भविष्यति।।4.65.17।।
transliteration: sampratyetāvatīṃ śaktiṃ gamane tarkayāmyaham| naitāvatā hi saṃsiddhiḥ kāryasyāsya bhaviṣyati
translation: सम्प्रति at this time, अहम् I have, शक्तिं capacity, गमने to fly, तर्कयामि I guess, एतावतीं that much, शक्यम् possible, एतावता to this extent, अस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the objective, संसिद्धिः success, न भविष्यति will not be.
explanation: 'I guess that at this time I do not have the capacity to fly to that extent. Achieving the objective is out of question with this much of energy.

shloka_text: अथोत्तरमुदारार्थमब्रवीदङ्गदस्तदा। अनुमान्य तथा प्राज्ञो जाम्बवन्तं महाकपिम्।।4.65.18।।
transliteration: athottaramudārārthamabravīdaṅgadastadā| anumānya tathā prājño jāmbavantaṃ mahākapim
translation: अथ and now, तदा then, प्राज्ञः wise, अङ्गदः Angada, महाकपिम् great monkey, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, अनुमान्य doubting, उदारार्थम् in a gentle manner, उत्तरम् reply, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: 'Then the wise Angada said to great Jambavan, in a gentle manner about his  own strength.

shloka_text: अहमेतद्गमिष्यामि योजनानां शतं महत्। निवर्तने तु मे शक्तिस्स्यान्न वेति न निश्चितम्।।4.65.19।।
transliteration: ahametadgamiṣyāmi yojanānāṃ śataṃ mahat| nivartane tu me śaktissyānna veti na niścitam
translation: अहम् I, महत् great, एतत् this, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतम् hundred, गमिष्यामि I can go, निवर्तने to return, मे my, शक्तिः capacity, स्यात् may be, न वा or not, इति thus, निश्चितम् certainly, न not known.
explanation: 'I can  certainly go to a distance of a hundred yojanas. However, I cannot say whether I will have enough capacity to return?

shloka_text: तमुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठं जाम्बवान्वाक्यकोविदः। ज्ञायते गमने शक्तिस्तव हर्यृक्षसत्तम।।4.65.20।।
transliteration: tamuvāca hariśreṣṭhaṃ jāmbavānvākyakovidaḥ| jñāyate gamane śaktistava haryṛkṣasattama
translation: वाक्यकोविदः skilful at speech, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, तम् him, हरिश्रेष्ठम् best of monkeys, उवाच said, हर्यृक्षसत्तम best among bears and monkeys, गमने I am going to fly, तव your, शक्तिः energy, ज्ञायते is known.
explanation: Jambavan who was skilful in speech spoke to that great Angada, 'O leader among monkeys and bears your energy to cover this distance is wellknown to us'.

shloka_text: कामं शतं सहस्रं वा न ह्येष विधिरुच्यते। योजनानां भवान् शक्तो गन्तुं प्रतिनिवर्तितुम्।।4.65.21।।
transliteration: kāmaṃ śataṃ sahasraṃ vā na hyeṣa vidhirucyate| yojanānāṃ bhavān śakto gantuṃ pratinivartitum
translation: भवान् you, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतं सहस्रं वा even a hundred or a thousand, गन्तुम् to go, प्रतिनिवर्तितुम् but to return, शक्तः कामम् you have the required energy, एषः this, विधिः duty, उच्यते हि not proper.
explanation: 'You can go upto even a hundred thousand yojanas and have the required energy to return also. But it is not proper to send you (because you are the heir apparent).

shloka_text: न हि प्रेषयिता तात स्वामी प्रेष्यः कथञ्चन। भवताऽयं जनस्सर्वः प्रेष्यः प्लवगसत्तम।।4.65.22।।
transliteration: na hi preṣayitā tāta svāmī preṣyaḥ kathañcana| bhavatā'yaṃ janassarvaḥ preṣyaḥ plavagasattama
translation: तात dear , प्रेषयिता who orders, स्वामी lord, कथञ्चन in any way, प्रेष्यः a servant who is sent, न हि indeed, प्लवगसत्तम best of monkeys, सर्वः all, अयं जनः this group, भवता by you, प्रेष्यः to be sent.
explanation: Dear one, one who issues orders is a master and is never himself the one sent; best of monkeys, this whole assembly is yours to dispatch.

shloka_text: भवान्कळत्रमस्माकं स्वामिभावे व्यवस्थितः। स्वामी कळत्रं सैन्यस्य गतिरेषा परन्तप।।4.65.23।।
transliteration: bhavānkaḻatramasmākaṃ svāmibhāve vyavasthitaḥ| svāmī kaḻatraṃ sainyasya gatireṣā parantapa
translation: परन्तप O scorcher of enemies, स्वामिभावे in a state of commander, व्यवस्थितः you are established, भवान् you, अस्माकम् for us, कलत्रम् wife, स्वामी lord, सैन्यस्य army's, कलत्रम् wife, एषा so that, गतिः proper.
explanation: 'O scorcher of enemies, you are established as the commander of the army and it is proper for us to protect you as we protect our wives.

shloka_text: अपि चैतस्य कार्यस्य भवान्मूलमरिन्दम। तस्मात्कळत्रवत्तात प्रतिपाल्यस्सदा भवान्।।4.65.24।।
transliteration: api caitasya kāryasya bhavānmūlamarindama| tasmātkaḻatravattāta pratipālyassadā bhavān
translation: तात O dear, अरिन्दम O subduer of enemies, एतस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the task, भवान् you, मूलम् the root, अपि वै and also, तस्मात् therefore, भवान् you, कलत्रवत् like the wife, सदा always, प्रतिपाल्यः should be taken care of.
explanation: 'O subduer of enemies in acomplishing this task you are the root. O dear therefore you should always be taken care of by us just like the wife looked after.

shloka_text: मूलमर्थस्य संरक्ष्यमेष कार्यविदां नयः। मूले सति हि सिद्ध्यन्ति गुणा फलो पुष्पोदयाः।।4.65.25।।
transliteration: mūlamarthasya saṃrakṣyameṣa kāryavidāṃ nayaḥ| mūle sati hi siddhyanti guṇā phalo puṣpodayāḥ
translation: अर्थस्य the objective, मूलम् root, संरक्ष्यम् should be protected, एषः this कार्यविदाम् of the accomplishers, नयः policy, मूले when root, सति when it is intact, फलो पुष्पोदयाः bearing flowers and fruits, गुणाः qualities, सिद्ध्यन्ति हि will result.
explanation: 'The root of any objective should be protected well. This is the basis of an accomplisher. Only when the roots are intact, the trees have the ability to yield flowers and fruits.

shloka_text: तद्भवानस्य कार्यस्य साधने सत्यविक्रम। बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नो हेतुरत्र परन्तप।।4.65.26।।
transliteration: tadbhavānasya kāryasya sādhane satyavikrama| buddhivikramasampanno heturatra parantapa
translation: सत्यविक्रम truely courageous one, तत् that, भवान् you, अस्य कार्यस्य of this task, साधने in achieving, परन्तप O subduer of enemies, अत्र there, बुद्धिविक्रमसम्पन्नः endowed with wisdom and valour, हेतुः you are the cause.
explanation: 'O warrior of proven valour O subduer of enemies in achieving this objective you are the source, being endowed with valour and wisdom.

shloka_text: गुरुश्च गुरुपुत्रश्च त्वं हि नः कपिसत्तम। भवन्तमाश्रित्य वयं समर्था ह्यर्थसाधने।।4.65.27।।
transliteration: guruśca guruputraśca tvaṃ hi naḥ kapisattama| bhavantamāśritya vayaṃ samarthā hyarthasādhane
translation: कपिसत्तम O best of monkeys, नः for us, गुरुपुत्रः son of our teacher, त्वम् you are, गुरुश्च and also a respectable guide, वयम् we, भवन्तम् you, आश्रित्य under your care, अर्थसाधने in accomplishing our objective, समर्थाः हि are capable also.
explanation: 'O best of monkeys you are the son of my guide (Vali) and respectable. We will be capable of accomplishing the goal only under your protection and guidance.

shloka_text: उक्तवाक्यं महाप्राज्ञं जाम्बवन्तं महाकपिः। प्रत्युवाचोत्तरं वाक्यं वालिसूनुरथाङ्गदः।।4.65.28।।
transliteration: uktavākyaṃ mahāprājñaṃ jāmbavantaṃ mahākapiḥ| pratyuvācottaraṃ vākyaṃ vālisūnurathāṅgadaḥ
translation: अथ now, महाकपिः great monkey, वालिसूनुः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, उक्तवाक्यम् having said that, महाप्राज्ञम् very wise, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavan, उत्तरं वाक्यम् in reply, प्रत्युवाच said.
explanation: Jambavan, the wise monkey having said that, Angada, the great son of Vali, replied:

shloka_text: यदि नाहं गमिष्यामि नान्यो वानरपुङ्गवः। पुनः खल्विदमस्माभिः कार्यं प्रायोपवेशनम्।।4.65.29।।
transliteration: yadi nāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi nānyo vānarapuṅgavaḥ| punaḥ khalvidamasmābhiḥ kāryaṃ prāyopaveśanam
translation: अहम् I am, न गमिष्यामि यदि if I will not go, अन्यः other, वानरपुङ्गवः monkey leader, न not, अस्माभिः by us, पुनः again, इदम् this, प्रायोपवेशनम् fasting to death, कार्यं खलु have to do.
explanation: 'If I do not go and no other monkey leader goes, then we have to resort to fasting unto death once again.

shloka_text: न ह्यकृत्वा हरिपतेस्सन्देशं तस्य धीमतः। तत्रापि गत्वा प्राणानां पश्यामि परिरक्षणम्।।4.65.30।।
transliteration: na hyakṛtvā haripatessandeśaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ| tatrāpi gatvā prāṇānāṃ paśyāmi parirakṣaṇam
translation: धीमतः of the wise, तस्य हरिपतेः of the lord of monkeys, सन्देशम् message, अकृत्वा by not fulfilling, तत्र there, गत्वापि even after going, प्राणानाम् of life, परिरक्षणम् protection, न पश्यामि I do not see.
explanation: 'If I do not fulfil the objective of the wise king of monkeys I cannot save my life even after returning there (Kishkinda).

shloka_text: स हि प्रसादे चात्यर्थं कोपे च हरिरीश्वरः। अतीत्य तस्य सन्देशं विनाशो गमने भवेत्।।4.65.31।।
transliteration: sa hi prasāde cātyarthaṃ kope ca harirīśvaraḥ| atītya tasya sandeśaṃ vināśo gamane bhavet
translation: सः he, हरिः monkey king, प्रसादे च in showering grace, कोपे च and vent anger, अत्यर्थम् highly, ईश्वरः all powerful, तस्य his, सन्देशम् instruction, अतीत्य in not fulfilling the task, गमने in going, विनाशः total destruction, भवेत् will be.
explanation: 'The monkey king has the authority to shower grace or give vent to his anger. If we go without fulfilling the task we will face destruction.

shloka_text: तद्यथा ह्यस्य कार्यस्य न भवत्यन्यथा गतिः। तद्भवानेव दृष्टार्थस्सञ्चिन्तयितु मर्हति।।4.65.32।।
transliteration: tadyathā hyasya kāryasya na bhavatyanyathā gatiḥ| tadbhavāneva dṛṣṭārthassañcintayitu marhati
translation: तत् तथाहि therefore, अस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the task, गतिः advancement, अन्यथा  otherwise, न भवति will not be, तत् that, दृष्टार्थः well aware, भवानेव you alone, सञ्चिन्तयितुम् to think over well, अर्हति you should.
explanation: 'Therefore, think over well so that we do not fail ultimately. You have a vision.You should suggest means by which this mission does not misfire.'

shloka_text: सोऽङ्गदेन तदा वीरः प्रत्युक्तः प्लवगर्षभः। जाम्बवानुत्तरं वाक्यं प्रोवाचेदं ततोऽङ्गदम्।।4.65.33।।
transliteration: so'ṅgadena tadā vīraḥ pratyuktaḥ plavagarṣabhaḥ| jāmbavānuttaraṃ vākyaṃ provācedaṃ tato'ṅgadam
translation: अङ्गदेन by Angada, तदा then, प्रत्युक्तः having been addressed, वीरः hero, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, सः जाम्बवान् that Jambavan, ततः then, अङ्गदम् to Angada, उत्तरम् reply, इदं वाक्यम् in these words, प्रोवाच said.
explanation: On listening to Angada's words, Jambavan, the  bull among monkeys, replied this way:

shloka_text: अस्य ते वीर कार्यस्य न किञ्चित्परिहीयते। एष सञ्चोदयाम्येनं यः कार्यं साधयिष्यति।।4.65.34।।
transliteration: asya te vīra kāryasya na kiñcitparihīyate| eṣa sañcodayāmyenaṃ yaḥ kāryaṃ sādhayiṣyati
translation: वीर O hero, ते your, तस्य कार्यस्य of this task, किञ्चित् even a little, न परिहीयते nothing is balked, एषः here I am, कार्यम् task, यः who, साधयिष्यति who can achieve, सञ्चोदयामि एनम् I will inspire him.
explanation: 'O hero this work will not be balked. I will now inspire one who can achieve this task.'

shloka_text: अनेकशतसाहस्रीं विषण्णां हरिवाहिनीम्। जाम्बवान्समुदीक्ष्यैवं हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्।।4.66.1।।
transliteration: anekaśatasāhasrīṃ viṣaṇṇāṃ harivāhinīm| jāmbavānsamudīkṣyaivaṃ hanūmantamathābravīt
translation: जाम्बवान् Jambavan, विषण्णाम् worried, अनेकशतसाहस्रीम् several hundred thousands, हरिवाहिनीम् army of monkeys, समुदीक्ष्य observed, अथ then, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, एवम् this way, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Then Jambavan observed the worries of several hundred thousands of the monkey army and said to Hanuman:
comments: Description of Hanuman's glory

shloka_text: वीर वानरलोकस्य सर्वशास्त्रविदां वर। तूष्णीमेकान्तमाश्रित्य हनूमन्किं न जल्पसि।।4.66.2।।
transliteration: vīra vānaralokasya sarvaśāstravidāṃ vara| tūṣṇīmekāntamāśritya hanūmankiṃ na jalpasi
translation: वानरलोकस्य in the world of monkeys, वीर hero, सर्वशास्त्रविदाम् among the knowledgeable in all sastras, वर choicest one, हनूमान् Hanuman, तूष्णीम् quietly, एकान्तम् solitude, आश्रित्य remaining, किम् why, न जल्पसि you are not speaking.
explanation: 'O Hanuman you are the choicest one among many scholars wellversed in all sastras. Why do you sit alone? Why do you not speak?

shloka_text: हनूमन्हरिराजस्य सुग्रीवस्य समो ह्यसि। रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि तेजसा च बलेन च।।4.66.3।।
transliteration: hanūmanharirājasya sugrīvasya samo hyasi| rāmalakṣmaṇayoścāpi tejasā ca balena ca
translation: हनूमन् Hanuman, तेजसा च with brilliance, बलेन च and in strength, हरिराजस्य monkey king's, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि with Rama and Lakshmana also, समः equal, असि हि you are.
explanation: 'Hanuman you are equal to the king of monkeys and also Rama and Lakshmana in brilliance and strength.

shloka_text: अरिष्टनेमिनः पुत्रो वैनतेयो महाबलः। गरुत्मानिति विख्यात उत्तमस्सर्वपक्षिणाम्।।4.66.4।।
transliteration: ariṣṭaneminaḥ putro vainateyo mahābalaḥ| garutmāniti vikhyāta uttamassarvapakṣiṇām
translation: अरिष्टनेमिनः Arishtanemi's, पुत्रः son, सर्वपक्षिणाम् among all birds, उत्तमः greatest, वैनतेयः Vainateya's, महाबलः very powerful, गरुत्मान् इति Garuthman as such, विख्यातः very famous.
explanation: 'You are the son of Arishtanemi (sage Kasyapa) and Vinata, and your gurulike (elder brother) is Garuda, the greatest among birds. He is powerful and and famous.

shloka_text: बहुशो हि मया दृष्टः सागरे स महाबलः। भुजङ्गानुद्धरन्पक्षी महावेगो महायशाः।।4.66.5।।
transliteration: bahuśo hi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sāgare sa mahābalaḥ| bhujaṅgānuddharanpakṣī mahāvego mahāyaśāḥ
translation: महाबलः very powerful, महावेगः very swift, महायशाः very famous, सः that, पक्षी bird, सागरे ocean, भुजङ्गान् serpents, उद्धरन् while snatching, मया by me, बहुशः many times, दृष्टः हि is seen.
explanation: 'Garuda is very powerful, swift, and famous. I have seen him snatching serpents from the ocean many times.

shloka_text: पक्षयोर्यद्बलं तस्य तावद्भुजबलं तव। विक्रमश्चापि वेगश्च न ते तेनावहीयते।।4.66.6।।
transliteration: pakṣayoryadbalaṃ tasya tāvadbhujabalaṃ tava| vikramaścāpi vegaśca na te tenāvahīyate
translation: तस्य his, पक्षयोः of the wings, यत् such, बलम् strength, तव your, भुजबलम् the strength of your shoulders, तावत् so much, ते your, विक्रमश्चापि also courage, वेगश्च speed, तेन with him, न अपहीयते no less.
explanation: 'The strength of your shoulders is equal to that of his (Garuda's) wings. Your speed and valour are no less.

shloka_text: बलं बुद्धिश्च तेजश्च सत्त्वं च हरिपुङ्गव। विशिष्टं सर्वभूतेषु किमात्मानं न बुध्यसे।।4.66.7।।
transliteration: balaṃ buddhiśca tejaśca sattvaṃ ca haripuṅgava| viśiṣṭaṃ sarvabhūteṣu kimātmānaṃ na budhyase
translation: हरिपुङ्गव leader of the monkeys, बलम् strength, बुद्धिश्च wisdom, तेजश्च brilliance, सत्त्वम् valour, सर्वभूतेषु of all beings, विशिष्टम् superior, आत्मानम् your self, किम् why, न बुध्यसे do you not know that.
explanation: 'O leader of the monkeys you are superior in strength, wisdom, brilliance and valour to all beings. Why do you not realise your own strength?

shloka_text: अप्सराप्सरसां श्रेष्ठा विख्याता पुञ्जिकस्थला। अञ्जनेति परिख्याता पत्नी केसरिणो हरेः।।4.66.8।।
transliteration: apsarāpsarasāṃ śreṣṭhā vikhyātā puñjikasthalā| añjaneti parikhyātā patnī kesariṇo hareḥ
translation: पुञ्जिकस्थला Punjikasthala, अप्सरसाम् among apsarasas, श्रेष्ठा eminent, विख्याता famous, अञ्जनेति by name Anjana, परिख्याता wellknown as, अप्सरा: apsara, हरेः monkeys, केसरिणः Kesari, पत्नी wife.
explanation: An eminent and famous apsara, foremost among them, named Punjikasthala and well known as Anjana, was the wife of the monkey Kesari.

shloka_text: विख्याता त्रिषु लोकेषु रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि। अभिशापादभूत्तात वानरी कामरूपिणी।।4.66.9।।
transliteration: vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi| abhiśāpādabhūttāta vānarī kāmarūpiṇī
translation: तात dear, रूपेण in appearance, अप्रतिमा peerless, त्रिषु among three, लोकेषु in worlds, विख्याता famous, अभिशापात् by a curse, भुवि on the land, कामरूपिणी lovely one, who can change form at her will, वानरी monkey, अभूत् she was.
explanation: 'O dear she was famous in the three worlds, peerless in beauty and could change form at her free will. She was born of a monkey on this land by dint of a curse.

shloka_text: दुहिता वानरेन्द्रस्य कुञ्जरस्य महात्मनः। मानुषं विग्रहं कृत्वा रूपयौवनशालिनी।।4.66.10।। विचित्रमाल्याभरणा महार्हक्षौमवासिनी। अचरत्पर्वतस्याग्रे प्रावृडम्बुदसन्निभे।।4.66.11।।
transliteration: duhitā vānarendrasya kuñjarasya mahātmanaḥ| mānuṣaṃ vigrahaṃ kṛtvā rūpayauvanaśālinī vicitramālyābharaṇā mahārhakṣaumavāsinī| acaratparvatasyāgre prāvṛḍambudasannibhe
translation: वानरेन्द्रस्य of the king of monkeys, महात्मनः of the great, कुञ्जरस्य Kunjara's, दुहिता  daughter, रूपयौवनशालिनी young and beautiful, मानुषम् human, विग्रहम् form, कृत्वा took, विचित्रमाल्याभरणा decked in wonderful garlands and ornaments, महार्हक्षौमवासिनी wearing rich silk clothes, प्रावृडम्बुदसन्निभे looking like the proud raincloud, पर्वतस्य अग्रे on top of the mountain, अचरत् she was wandering.
explanation: 'She was the daughter of a great king of monkeys called Kunjara. That young and beautiful lady had assumed a lustrous human form decked with wonderful garlands, ornaments and silk clothes and was roving on top of the mountain which appeared like a proud raincloud.

shloka_text: दुहिता वानरेन्द्रस्य कुञ्जरस्य महात्मनः। मानुषं विग्रहं कृत्वा रूपयौवनशालिनी।।4.66.10।। विचित्रमाल्याभरणा महार्हक्षौमवासिनी। अचरत्पर्वतस्याग्रे प्रावृडम्बुदसन्निभे।।4.66.11।।
transliteration: duhitā vānarendrasya kuñjarasya mahātmanaḥ| mānuṣaṃ vigrahaṃ kṛtvā rūpayauvanaśālinī vicitramālyābharaṇā mahārhakṣaumavāsinī| acaratparvatasyāgre prāvṛḍambudasannibhe
translation: वानरेन्द्रस्य of the king of monkeys, महात्मनः of the great, कुञ्जरस्य Kunjara's, दुहिता  daughter, रूपयौवनशालिनी young and beautiful, मानुषम् human, विग्रहम् form, कृत्वा took, विचित्रमाल्याभरणा decked in wonderful garlands and ornaments, महार्हक्षौमवासिनी wearing rich silk clothes, प्रावृडम्बुदसन्निभे looking like the proud raincloud, पर्वतस्य अग्रे on top of the mountain, अचरत् she was wandering.
explanation: 'She was the daughter of a great king of monkeys called Kunjara. That young and beautiful lady had assumed a lustrous human form decked with wonderful garlands, ornaments and silk clothes and was roving on top of the mountain which appeared like a proud raincloud.

shloka_text: तस्या वस्त्रं विशालाक्ष्याः पीतं रक्तदशं शुभम्। स्थितायाः पर्वतस्याग्रे मारुतोऽपहरच्छनैः।।4.66.12।।
transliteration: tasyā vastraṃ viśālākṣyāḥ pītaṃ raktadaśaṃ śubham| sthitāyāḥ parvatasyāgre māruto'paharacchanaiḥ
translation: पर्वतस्य mountain's, अग्रे on top, स्थितायाः stationed, विशालाक्ष्याः of largeeyed lady, तस्याः her, पीतं रक्तदशम् yellow with red border, शुभम् auspicious, वस्त्रम् garment, मारुतः Windgod, शनैः gently, अपाहरत् let it fly away.
explanation: 'While the largeeyed lady was stationed on the mountain top, the Windgod gently let her auspicious yellow garment with red border fly away.

shloka_text: स ददर्श ततस्तस्या वृत्तावूरू सुसंहतौ। स्तनौ च पीनौ सहितौ सुजातं चारु चाननम्।।4.66.13।।
transliteration: sa dadarśa tatastasyā vṛttāvūrū susaṃhatau| stanau ca pīnau sahitau sujātaṃ cāru cānanam
translation: ततः then, सः he, तस्याः her, वृत्तौ curved, सुसंहतौ both wellset, ऊरू both thighs, पीनौ plump, सहितौ together, स्तनौ च two breasts, सुजातम् very beautiful, चारु pleasing, आननं च face, ददर्श saw.
explanation: 'Then he (Windgod) saw her curved, wellset thighs, her beautiful plump breasts and her lovely pleasing face.

shloka_text: तां विशालायतश्रोणीं तनुमध्यां यशस्विनीम्। दृष्टवैव शुभसर्वाङ्गीं पवनः काममोहितः।।4.66.14।।
transliteration: tāṃ viśālāyataśroṇīṃ tanumadhyāṃ yaśasvinīm| dṛṣṭavaiva śubhasarvāṅgīṃ pavanaḥ kāmamohitaḥ
translation: विशालायतश्रोणीम् a lady of broad hips, तनुमध्याम् slender waist, यशस्विनीम् famed one, शुभसर्वाङ्गीम् a lady of beautiful limbs, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वैव on seeing, पवनः Windgod, काममोहितः was infatuated.
explanation: 'On seeing the broad hips, slender waist and beautiful limbs of that famous lady the Windgod was infatuated.
