shloka_text: तस्य चैकतमे देशे सोऽग्य्रमालाविभूषितम्। ददर्श पाण्डुरं छत्रं ताराधिपतिसन्निभम्।।5.10.3।।
transliteration: tasya caikatame deśe so'gyramālāvibhūṣitam| dadarśa pāṇḍuraṃ chatraṃ tārādhipatisannibham
translation: सः that Hanuman, तस्य its, एकतमे in one, देशे spot, अग्य्रमालाविभूषितम् decorated with best of garlands, ताराधिपतिसन्निभम् like the Moon, पाण्डुरम् white, छत्रम् umbrella, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hanuman saw an umbrella in one spot decorated with the best of garlands. The white umbrella looked like the Moon, lord of stars.

shloka_text: जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तं चित्रभानुसमप्रभम्। अशोकमालाविततं ददर्श परमासनम्।।5.10.4।। वालव्यजनहस्ताभिर्वीज्यमानं समन्ततः। गन्धैश्च विविधैर्जुष्टं वरधूपेन धूपितम्।।5.10.5।। परमास्तरणास्तीर्णमाविकाजिनसंवृतम्। दामभिर्वरमाल्यानां समन्तादुपशोभितम्।।5.10.6।।
transliteration: jātarūpaparikṣiptaṃ citrabhānusamaprabham| aśokamālāvitataṃ dadarśa paramāsanam vālavyajanahastābhirvījyamānaṃ samantataḥ| gandhaiśca vividhairjuṣṭaṃ varadhūpena dhūpitam paramāstaraṇāstīrṇamāvikājinasaṃvṛtam| dāmabhirvaramālyānāṃ samantādupaśobhitam
translation: जातरूपपरिक्षिप्तम् made of gold, चित्रभानुसमप्रभम् shining like the Sun, अशोकमालाविततम् decorated with Ashoka flowers, वालव्यजनहस्ताभिः women holding fans made of the hair of chamari deer, समन्ततः all over, वीज्यमानम् he was being, विविधैः several, गन्धैः with fragrants, जुष्टम् full of, वरधूपेन with excellent fragrants, धूपितम्  smoky, परमास्तरणास्तीर्णम् spread with the best of bedspreads, आविकाजिनसंवृतम् covered with soft sheep skin, समन्तात् all over, वरमाल्यानाम् of beautiful garlands, दामभिः by strings, उपशोभितम् delightfullooking, परमासनम् exquisite couch, ददर्श saw.
explanation: He saw an exquisite couch made of gold shining wonderfully like the Sun. It was decorated with ashoka flowers. Women were holding fans of chamari deer. It was upholstered with the best of bedspreads made of soft sheep skin and adorned with beautiful strings of flower garlands. Scented with aromatic smoke, it was refreshed with fragrance which had spread all over the place.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् जीमूतसंकाशं प्रदीप्तोत्तमकुण्डलम्। लोहिताक्षं महाबाहुं महारजतवाससम्।।5.10.7।। लोहितेनानुलिप्ताङ्गं चन्दनेन सुगन्धिना। सन्ध्यारक्तमिवाकाशे तोयदं सतटिद्गणम्।।5.10.8।। वृतमाभरणैर्दिव्यैः सुरूपं कामरूपिणम्। सवृक्षवनगुल्माढ्यं प्रसुप्तमिव मन्दरम्।।5.10.9।। क्रीडित्वोपरतं रात्रौ वराभरणभूषितम्। प्रियं राक्षसकन्यानां राक्षसानां सुखावहम्।।5.10.10।। पीत्वाऽप्युपरतं चापि ददर्श स महाकपिः। भास्वरे शयने वीरं प्रसुप्तं राक्षसाधिपम्।।5.10.11।।

shloka_text: निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागं रावणं वानरर्षभः। आसाद्य परमोद्विग्नस्सोपासर्पत्सुभीतवत्।।5.10.12।।
transliteration: niḥśvasantaṃ yathā nāgaṃ rāvaṇaṃ vānararṣabhaḥ| āsādya paramodvignassopāsarpatsubhītavat
translation: सः वानरर्षभः the bull among the vanaras, नागं यथा like a snake, निःश्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, रावणम् Ravana, आसाद्य having reached, परमोद्विग्नः  very frightened, सुभीतवत् like a person in terrible fear, अपासर्पत् drew  away
explanation: Having reached Ravana, who was breathing (hissing) like a snake, Hanuman was for a moment frightened and drew away from him as if he was put to terrible fear.

shloka_text: अथाऽऽरोहणमासाद्य वेदिकाऽन्तरमाश्रितः। सुप्तं राक्षसशार्दूलं प्रेक्षते स्म महाकपिः।।5.10.13।।
transliteration: athā''rohaṇamāsādya vedikā'ntaramāśritaḥ| suptaṃ rākṣasaśārdūlaṃ prekṣate sma mahākapiḥ
translation: महाकपिः great vanara, अथ then, आरोहणम् stairway, आसाद्य on reaching, वेदिकान्तरम् another altar, आश्रितः approached, सुप्तम् sleeping, राक्षसशार्दूलम् tiger among ogres, प्रेक्षते स्म glanced once again.
explanation: The great vanara ascended the stairway and reached another altar and once again looked at the sleeping Ravana, the tiger among demons.

shloka_text: शुशुभे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य स्वपतः शयनोत्तमम्। गन्धहस्तिनि संविष्टे यथा प्रस्रवणं महत्।।5.10.14।।
transliteration: śuśubhe rākṣasendrasya svapataḥ śayanottamam| gandhahastini saṃviṣṭe yathā prasravaṇaṃ mahat
translation: स्वपतः sleeping, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य lord of rakshasa's, शयनोत्तमम् magnificent couch, गन्धहस्तिनि elephant in rut, संविष्टे is sleeping, महत् great, प्रस्रवणं यथा like Prasravana hill, शुशुभे looked lovely.
explanation: While the lord of demons lay asleep on the magnificent couch, he  looked like the Prasravana hill with its elephant in rut.

shloka_text: काञ्चनाङ्गदसन्नध्दै च ददर्श स महात्मनः। विक्षिप्तौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भुजाविन्द्रध्वजोपमौ।।5.10.15।। ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरापीडनकृतव्रणौ। वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ।।5.10.16।। पीनौ समसुजातांसौ संगतौ बलसंयुतौ। सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठा स्वङ्गुलीतललक्षितौ।।5.10.17।। संहतौ परिघाकारौ वृत्तौ करिकरोपमौ। विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ।।5.10.18।। शशक्षतजकल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना। चन्दनेन परार्ध्येन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलङ्कृतौ।।5.10.19।। उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ। यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ।।5.10.20।।
transliteration: kāñcanāṅgadasannadhdai ca dadarśa sa mahātmanaḥ| vikṣiptau rākṣasendrasya bhujāvindradhvajopamau airāvataviṣāṇāgrairāpīḍanakṛtavraṇau| vajrollikhitapīnāṃsau viṣṇucakraparikṣatau pīnau samasujātāṃsau saṃgatau balasaṃyutau| sulakṣaṇanakhāṅguṣṭhā svaṅgulītalalakṣitau saṃhatau parighākārau vṛttau karikaropamau| vikṣiptau śayane śubhre pañcaśīrṣāvivoragau śaśakṣatajakalpena suśītena sugandhinā| candanena parārdhyena svanuliptau svalaṅkṛtau uttamastrīvimṛditau gandhottamaniṣevitau| yakṣapannagagandharvadevadānavarāviṇau
translation: सः that, महात्मनः the great self, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, काञ्चनाङ्गदनसद्धौ two arms adorned with golden straps, विक्षिप्तौ ल्यिन्ग lying, इन्द्रध्वजोपमौ like the pair of flag staff of Indra, ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैः torn by Iravata, the vehicle of Indra, आपीडनकृतव्रणौ having scars caused by injury, वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ  arms with scars caused by the thunderbolt of Indra, विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ wounded by Visnu's discus, पीनौ fleshy, समसुजातांसौ wellbuilt, fleshy arms, सङ्गतौ tough, बलसंयुतौ strong, सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठौ on shapely thumb nails, स्वङ्गुलीतल लक्षितौ on shapely palms and fingers, संहतौ wellfixed, परिघाकारौ like iron crowbars, वृत्तौ rounded, करिकरोपमौ resembling elephant tusk, शुभ्रे on a clean, शयने couch, विक्षिप्तौ lying, पञ्चशीर्षौ like fivehooded, उरगौ इव like two serpents, शशक्षतजकल्पेन like the colour of the hare's blood, सुशीतेन by cool, सुगन्धिना with fragrant, परार्थ्येन fine, चन्दनेन by sandal paste, स्वनुलिप्तौ be smeared, स्वलङ्कृतौ welldecorated, उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ massaged by the best of women, गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ anointed by best of fragrants, यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ which can make yakshas, pannagas, gandharvas, gods and demons cry in terror, भुजौ arms, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hanuman saw the great Ravana's arms, which were like a pair of Indra's flag staff adorned with golden straps. The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged  by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.

shloka_text: काञ्चनाङ्गदसन्नध्दै च ददर्श स महात्मनः। विक्षिप्तौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य भुजाविन्द्रध्वजोपमौ।।5.10.15।। ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैरापीडनकृतव्रणौ। वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ।।5.10.16।। पीनौ समसुजातांसौ संगतौ बलसंयुतौ। सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठा स्वङ्गुलीतललक्षितौ।।5.10.17।। संहतौ परिघाकारौ वृत्तौ करिकरोपमौ। विक्षिप्तौ शयने शुभ्रे पञ्चशीर्षाविवोरगौ।।5.10.18।। शशक्षतजकल्पेन सुशीतेन सुगन्धिना। चन्दनेन परार्ध्येन स्वनुलिप्तौ स्वलङ्कृतौ।।5.10.19।। उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ। यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ।।5.10.20।।
transliteration: kāñcanāṅgadasannadhdai ca dadarśa sa mahātmanaḥ| vikṣiptau rākṣasendrasya bhujāvindradhvajopamau airāvataviṣāṇāgrairāpīḍanakṛtavraṇau| vajrollikhitapīnāṃsau viṣṇucakraparikṣatau pīnau samasujātāṃsau saṃgatau balasaṃyutau| sulakṣaṇanakhāṅguṣṭhā svaṅgulītalalakṣitau saṃhatau parighākārau vṛttau karikaropamau| vikṣiptau śayane śubhre pañcaśīrṣāvivoragau śaśakṣatajakalpena suśītena sugandhinā| candanena parārdhyena svanuliptau svalaṅkṛtau uttamastrīvimṛditau gandhottamaniṣevitau| yakṣapannagagandharvadevadānavarāviṇau
translation: सः that, महात्मनः the great self, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, काञ्चनाङ्गदनसद्धौ two arms adorned with golden straps, विक्षिप्तौ ल्यिन्ग lying, इन्द्रध्वजोपमौ like the pair of flag staff of Indra, ऐरावतविषाणाग्रैः torn by Iravata, the vehicle of Indra, आपीडनकृतव्रणौ having scars caused by injury, वज्रोल्लिखितपीनांसौ  arms with scars caused by the thunderbolt of Indra, विष्णुचक्रपरिक्षतौ wounded by Visnu's discus, पीनौ fleshy, समसुजातांसौ wellbuilt, fleshy arms, सङ्गतौ tough, बलसंयुतौ strong, सुलक्षणनखाङ्गुष्ठौ on shapely thumb nails, स्वङ्गुलीतल लक्षितौ on shapely palms and fingers, संहतौ wellfixed, परिघाकारौ like iron crowbars, वृत्तौ rounded, करिकरोपमौ resembling elephant tusk, शुभ्रे on a clean, शयने couch, विक्षिप्तौ lying, पञ्चशीर्षौ like fivehooded, उरगौ इव like two serpents, शशक्षतजकल्पेन like the colour of the hare's blood, सुशीतेन by cool, सुगन्धिना with fragrant, परार्थ्येन fine, चन्दनेन by sandal paste, स्वनुलिप्तौ be smeared, स्वलङ्कृतौ welldecorated, उत्तमस्त्रीविमृदितौ massaged by the best of women, गन्धोत्तमनिषेवितौ anointed by best of fragrants, यक्षपन्नगगन्धर्वदेवदानवराविणौ which can make yakshas, pannagas, gandharvas, gods and demons cry in terror, भुजौ arms, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hanuman saw the great Ravana's arms, which were like a pair of Indra's flag staff adorned with golden straps. The arms bore the marks of wounds caused by Airavata, (Indra's elephant), torn by the thunderbolt of Indra in war, and wounded by the discus of Lord Visnu. His strong, fleshy, wellbuilt arms, having auspicious thumbnails, shapely fingers and palms, pressed together, resembled the iron crowbars or beam used for main doors. The arms resembled elephant's trunks, tossed on a clean bed, resembling two fivehooded snakes (fingers like hoods), besmeared with cool, fragrant, red sandalpaste of excellent quality which looked red like the hare's blood. They were well massaged  by the best of women with fine, fragrant sandal paste. They were the arms which could make yakshas, pannagas, gods and demons roar in fear at their sight.

shloka_text: ददर्श स कपिस्तत्र बाहू शयनसंस्थितौ। मन्दरस्यांतरे सुप्तौ महाही रुषिताविव।।5.10.21।।
transliteration: dadarśa sa kapistatra bāhū śayanasaṃsthitau| mandarasyāṃtare suptau mahāhī ruṣitāviva
translation: सः कपिः that vanara, तत्र there, मन्दरस्य mount Mandara's, अन्तरे in the cave, सुप्तौ asleep, रुषितौ angry, महाही इव like two serpents, शयनसंस्थितौ placed on the bed, बाहू two arms, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The vanara, gazed at the arms of Ravana placed on the couch that appeared like two angry snakes asleep in a cave on (the lap) of mount Mandara.

shloka_text: ताभ्यां स परिपूर्णाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां राक्षसेश्वरः। शुशुभेऽचलसङ्काशः शृङ्गाभ्यामिव मन्दरः।।5.10.22।।
transliteration: tābhyāṃ sa paripūrṇābhyāṃ bhujābhyāṃ rākṣaseśvaraḥ| śuśubhe'calasaṅkāśaḥ śṛṅgābhyāmiva mandaraḥ
translation: अचलसङ्काशः (he) appeared like a mountain, सः he, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of demon, परिपूर्णाभ्याम् fully developed, ताभ्याम् with both of them, भुजाभ्याम् with arms, शृङ्गाभ्याम् with two peaks, मन्दरः इव resembled mount Mandara, शुशुभे shone.
explanation: The lord of demons looked splendid like a mountain with his long, fully developed arms. He appeared like Mandara mountain with two lofty peaks.

shloka_text: चूतपुन्नागसुरभिर्वकुलोत्तमसंयुतः। मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः पानगन्धपुरस्कृतः।।5.10.23।। तस्य राक्षससिंहस्य निश्चक्राम महामुखात्। शयानस्य विनिःश्वासः पूरयन्निव तद् गृहम्।।5.10.24।।
transliteration: cūtapunnāgasurabhirvakulottamasaṃyutaḥ| mṛṣṭānnarasasaṃyuktaḥ pānagandhapuraskṛtaḥ tasya rākṣasasiṃhasya niścakrāma mahāmukhāt| śayānasya viniḥśvāsaḥ pūrayanniva tad gṛham
translation: शयानस्य while he was sleeping, तस्य राक्षससिंहस्य of that of lion of demons, महामुखात् from his huge mouth, चूतपुन्नागसुरभिः fragrance of Punnaga and Mango blossoms, वकुलोत्तमसंयुतः and mixed with the fragrance of the best of Bakula flowers, मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः mixed with aroma of rich food, पानगन्धपुरस्सरः and also of the aroma of drinks, विनिःश्वासः breath, तत् that, गृहम् home, पूरयन्निव  pervading as though, निश्चक्राम spread out.
explanation: The breath released from the huge mouth of that lion of demons carried the fragrance of mango and punnaga as well as excellent Bakula flowers. It exuded the aroma of rich and delicious food and different drink. It was as though pervading the whole chamber.

shloka_text: चूतपुन्नागसुरभिर्वकुलोत्तमसंयुतः। मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः पानगन्धपुरस्कृतः।।5.10.23।। तस्य राक्षससिंहस्य निश्चक्राम महामुखात्। शयानस्य विनिःश्वासः पूरयन्निव तद् गृहम्।।5.10.24।।
transliteration: cūtapunnāgasurabhirvakulottamasaṃyutaḥ| mṛṣṭānnarasasaṃyuktaḥ pānagandhapuraskṛtaḥ tasya rākṣasasiṃhasya niścakrāma mahāmukhāt| śayānasya viniḥśvāsaḥ pūrayanniva tad gṛham
translation: शयानस्य while he was sleeping, तस्य राक्षससिंहस्य of that of lion of demons, महामुखात् from his huge mouth, चूतपुन्नागसुरभिः fragrance of Punnaga and Mango blossoms, वकुलोत्तमसंयुतः and mixed with the fragrance of the best of Bakula flowers, मृष्टान्नरससंयुक्तः mixed with aroma of rich food, पानगन्धपुरस्सरः and also of the aroma of drinks, विनिःश्वासः breath, तत् that, गृहम् home, पूरयन्निव  pervading as though, निश्चक्राम spread out.
explanation: The breath released from the huge mouth of that lion of demons carried the fragrance of mango and punnaga as well as excellent Bakula flowers. It exuded the aroma of rich and delicious food and different drink. It was as though pervading the whole chamber.

shloka_text: मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण काञ्चनेन विराजितम्। मकुटेनापवृत्तेन कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम्।।5.10.25।। रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन तथा हारेण शोभिना। पीनायतविशालेन वक्षसाऽभिविराजितम्।।5.10.26।। पाण्डरेणापविद्धेन क्षौमेण क्षतजेक्षणम्। महार्हेण सुसंवीतं पीतेनोत्तमवाससा।।5.10.27।। माषराशिप्रतीकाशं निश्श्वसन्तं भुजङ्गवत्। गाङ्गे महति तोयान्ते प्रसुप्तमिव कुञ्जरम्।।5.10.28।। चतुर्भिः काञ्चनैर्दीपैद्धीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम्। प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गं मेघं विद्युद्गणैरिव।।5.10.29।। पादमूलगताश्चापि ददर्श सुमहात्मनः। पत्नी: स प्रियभार्यस्य तस्य रक्षःपतेर्गृहे।।5.10.30।।
transliteration: muktāmaṇivicitreṇa kāñcanena virājitam| makuṭenāpavṛttena kuṇḍalojvalitānanam raktacandanadigdhena tathā hāreṇa śobhinā| pīnāyataviśālena vakṣasā'bhivirājitam pāṇḍareṇāpaviddhena kṣaumeṇa kṣatajekṣaṇam| mahārheṇa susaṃvītaṃ pītenottamavāsasā māṣarāśipratīkāśaṃ niśśvasantaṃ bhujaṅgavat| gāṅge mahati toyānte prasuptamiva kuñjaram caturbhiḥ kāñcanairdīpaiddhīpyamānacaturdiśam| prakāśīkṛtasarvāṅgaṃ meghaṃ vidyudgaṇairiva pādamūlagatāścāpi dadarśa sumahātmanaḥ| patnī: sa priyabhāryasya tasya rakṣaḥpatergṛhe
translation: सः that, तस्य रक्षःपतेः of Ravana, the lord of demons, गृहे in the palace, मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण studded with pearls and gems, काञ्चनेन by gold, अपवृत्तेन kept aside, मकुटेन by a crown, विराजितम् glittering, कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम् face shining with earrings, रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन smeared with bright red sandal paste, हारेण by a string of pearls, शोभिना shining, पीनायतविशालेन fleshy and broad, वक्षसा on the chest, अभिविराजितम् very splendid, पाण्डरेण white, अपविद्धेन in disarray, क्षौमेण by silken cloth, क्षतजेक्षणम् having bloodred eyes, महार्हेण with an excellent, पीतेन with yellow, उत्तमवाससा with very expensive cloth, सुसंवीतम् covered well,माषराशिप्रतीकाशम् resembling a heap of blackbeans, भुजङ्गवत् like a snake, निःश्वसन्तम् sighing heavily, महति in a large, गाङ्गे on Ganga, तोयान्ते on the edge of water, प्रसुप्तम् sleeping, कुञ्जरम् इव like the elephant, काञ्चनैः golden,चतुर्भिः with four, दीपैः with lamps, दीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम् illumined on all four sides, विद्युद्गणैः by the flashes of lightning, प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गम् all his limbs lit up, प्रियभार्यस्य and his dear wives, सुमहात्मनः that great Ravana, पादमूलगताः seated at the feet, पत्नीश्च wives, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep)  was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely  rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. translation: सः that, तस्य रक्षःपतेः of Ravana, the lord of demons, गृहे in the palace, मुक्तामणिविचित्रेण studded with pearls and gems, काञ्चनेन by gold, अपवृत्तेन kept aside, मकुटेन by a crown, विराजितम् glittering, कुण्डलोज्वलिताननम् face shining with earrings, रक्तचन्दनदिग्धेन smeared with bright red sandal paste, हारेण by a string of pearls, शोभिना shining, पीनायतविशालेन fleshy and broad, वक्षसा on the chest, अभिविराजितम् very splendid, पाण्डरेण white, अपविद्धेन in disarray, क्षौमेण by silken cloth, क्षतजेक्षणम् having bloodred eyes, महार्हेण with an excellent, पीतेन with yellow, उत्तमवाससा with very expensive cloth, सुसंवीतम् covered well,माषराशिप्रतीकाशम् resembling a heap of blackbeans, भुजङ्गवत् like a snake, निःश्वसन्तम् sighing heavily, महति in a large, गाङ्गे on Ganga, तोयान्ते on the edge of water, प्रसुप्तम् sleeping, कुञ्जरम् इव like the elephant, काञ्चनैः golden,चतुर्भिः with four, दीपैः with lamps, दीप्यमानचतुर्दिशम् illumined on all four sides, विद्युद्गणैः by the flashes of lightning, प्रकाशीकृतसर्वाङ्गम् all his limbs lit up, प्रियभार्यस्य and his dear wives, सुमहात्मनः that great Ravana, पादमूलगताः seated at the feet, पत्नीश्च wives, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hanuman saw Ravana, whose face was lit up by his earrings. His shining headgear studded with gold and pearls was set aside. His fleshy, broad chest on which the pearl necklace had slightly receded from its position(as he was asleep)  was shining along with the red sandal paste. He had put on a splendid white silken cloth which had also slipped a little and was covered with exquisitely  rich yellow upper garment. His eyes were bloodred. His body was comparable to a heap of blackbeans. He was sighing heavily like a hissing snake. He appeared like an elephant sleeping on the banks of the great river Ganges. With four golden lamps glowing on four sides of the bed,the four directions were illuminated. All his limbs lit up bright (with the glow of lamps), he looked like a cloud with streaks of lightning. His dear wives were seen resting at his feet in the palace of the lord of demons.

shloka_text: शशिप्रकाशवदनाश्चारुकुण्डलभूषिताः। अम्लानमाल्याभरणा ददर्श हरियूथपः।।5.10.31।।
transliteration: śaśiprakāśavadanāścārukuṇḍalabhūṣitāḥ| amlānamālyābharaṇā dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ
translation: हरियूथपः leader of vanaras, शशिप्रकाशवदनाः women with faces splendid like the Moon, चारुकुण्डलभूषिताः adorned with beautiful earrings, अम्लानमाल्याभरणाः wearing ever fresh garlands of flowers, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hanuman, the leader of vanaras found the wives of Ravana,  whose  faces were bright as the Moon, adorned with beautiful earrings and fresh floral garlands.

shloka_text: नृत्तवादित्रकुशला राक्षसेन्द्रभुजाङ्कगाः। वराभरणधारिण्यो निषण्णा ददृशे हरिः।।5.10.32।।
transliteration: nṛttavāditrakuśalā rākṣasendrabhujāṅkagāḥ| varābharaṇadhāriṇyo niṣaṇṇā dadṛśe hariḥ
translation: हरिः Hanuman, नृत्तवादित्रकुशलाः women proficient in dancing and playing musical instruments, राक्षसेन्द्रभुजाङ्कगाः resting on his arms and lap, वराभरणधारिण्यः wearing fine jewellery,निषण्णाः leaning,ददृशेsaw.
explanation: Hanuman saw  the women there wearing fine jewellery, performing dances, playing musical instruments, and resting on the lap or leaning on the arms of the demon king.

shloka_text: वज्रवैडूर्यगर्भाणि श्रवणान्तेषु योषिताम्। ददर्श तापनीयानि कुण्डलान्यङ्गदानि च।।5.10.33।।
transliteration: vajravaiḍūryagarbhāṇi śravaṇānteṣu yoṣitām| dadarśa tāpanīyāni kuṇḍalānyaṅgadāni ca
translation: योषिताम् of those women there, श्रवणान्तेषु fixed to their ears, वज्रवैडूर्यगर्भाणि encrusted with diamonds and Vaidurya, तापनीयानि shining armlets of gold, कुण्डलानि earrings, अङ्गदानि च and Angadas (bracelets worn on upper arms), ददर्श saw.
explanation: He noticed on the earlobes of the the women gold earrings decked with diamonds and vaidurya. They were wearing shining armlets of gold.

shloka_text: तासां चन्द्रोपमैर्वक्त्रैश्शुभैर्ललितकुण्डलैः। विरराज विमानं तन्नभस्तारागणैरिव।।5.10.34।।
transliteration: tāsāṃ candropamairvaktraiśśubhairlalitakuṇḍalaiḥ| virarāja vimānaṃ tannabhastārāgaṇairiva
translation: ललितकुण्डलैः by lovely earrings, चन्द्रोपमैः Moon like, शुभैः by beautiful, तासाम् their, वक्त्रै: with countenance, तत् विमानम् that exceptional cot, तारागणैः with hosts of stars, नभः इव like the sky, विरराज resplendent.
explanation: There the beautiful moonlike faces of women Illumined by the lovely earrings lay on the cot which looked resplendent like the sky lit up with hosts of stars.

shloka_text: मदव्यायामखिन्नास्ता राक्षसेन्द्रस्य योषितः। तेषु तेष्ववकाशेषु प्रसुप्तास्तनुमध्यमाः।।5.10.35।।
transliteration: madavyāyāmakhinnāstā rākṣasendrasya yoṣitaḥ| teṣu teṣvavakāśeṣu prasuptāstanumadhyamāḥ
translation: मदव्यायामखिन्नाः exhausted by drinking, तनुमध्यमाः women of slender waist, ताः those, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य demon king's, योषितः wives, तेषु तेषु here and there, अवकाशेषु after having dalliance, प्रसुप्ताः slept.
explanation: Exhausted by drinking and indulging in amorous sport, the consorts of Ravana slept here and there with their visible slender waists.

shloka_text: अङ्गहारैस्तथैवान्या कोमलैर्नृत्तशालिनी। विन्यस्तशुभसर्वाङ्गी प्रसुप्ता वरवर्णिनी।।5.10.36।।
transliteration: aṅgahāraistathaivānyā komalairnṛttaśālinī| vinyastaśubhasarvāṅgī prasuptā varavarṇinī
translation: अन्या a certain woman, नृत्तशालिनी a danseuse, वरवर्णिनी of exceedingly beautiful complexion, कोमलैः with delicate, अङ्गहारैः rythmicmovements of dance, तथैव due to her dance habit, विन्यस्तशुभसर्वाङ्गी held her limbs in a dance posture, प्रसुप्ता slept.
explanation: Another woman exceedingly beautiful and a delicate danseuse of beautiful complexion and rhythmic movements held her limbs in a dancing posture (though asleep) due to her habit .

shloka_text: काचिद्वीणां परिष्वज्य प्रसुप्ता सम्प्रकाशते। महानदीप्रकीर्णेव नलिनी पोतमाश्रिता।।5.10.37।।
transliteration: kācidvīṇāṃ pariṣvajya prasuptā samprakāśate| mahānadīprakīrṇeva nalinī potamāśritā
translation: वीणाम् veena, परिष्वज्य hugging, प्रसुप्ता slept, काचित् one (woman), महानदीप्रकीर्णा floating in a large river, पोतम् a boat, आश्रिता holding, नलिनीव like a lotusplant, सम्प्रकाशते  shines.
explanation: Another woman slept hugging her veena. She shone like a lotus plant flung in a large river, clinging on to a boat. (Veena is compared to a boat and the woman to a lotusplant in the ambience of flowing waters of the river. The entire hall had put up such a dynamic view showing hectic life of the inmates).

shloka_text: अन्या कक्षगतेनैव मड्डुकेनासितेक्षणा। प्रसुप्ता भामिनी भाति बालपुत्रेव वत्सला।।5.10.38।।
transliteration: anyā kakṣagatenaiva maḍḍukenāsitekṣaṇā| prasuptā bhāminī bhāti bālaputreva vatsalā
translation: कक्षगतेनैव held on her armpit, मड्डुकेन with Madduka drum, इव like प्रसुप्ता sleeping, अन्याः other, असितेक्षणा darkeyed, वत्सला lovingly, बालपुत्रा held a baby, भामिनीव a beautiful lady, भाति  splendid.
explanation: A woman with dark eyes asleep with a drum placed in her armpit looked like a beautiful mother holding her loving baby (the drum was hung to her arm with a rope).

shloka_text: पटहं चारुसर्वाङ्गी पीड्य शेते शुभस्तनी। चिरस्य रमणं लब्ध्वा परिष्वज्येव भामिनी।।5.10.39।।
transliteration: paṭahaṃ cārusarvāṅgī pīḍya śete śubhastanī| cirasya ramaṇaṃ labdhvā pariṣvajyeva bhāminī
translation: चारुसर्वाङ्गी charming lady, शुभस्तनी of beautiful breasts, भामिनी beauty, चिरस्य a long time, रमणम् pleasure, लब्ध्वा having got, परिष्वज्येव as if hugged, पटहम् a tambourine, पीड्य  held tight, शेते slept.
explanation: Another charming beauty endowed with beautiful breasts lay hugging a tambourine as though a passionate woman lay embracing her lover whom she secured after a long time.

shloka_text: काचिद्वंशं परिष्वज्य सुप्ता कमललोचना। रहः प्रियतमं गृह्य सकामेव च कामिनी।।5.10.40।।
transliteration: kācidvaṃśaṃ pariṣvajya suptā kamalalocanā| rahaḥ priyatamaṃ gṛhya sakāmeva ca kāminī
translation: कमललोचना lotuseyed, काचित् yet another lady, वंशम् lute, परिष्वज्य embracing, रहः in privacy, प्रियतमम् lover, गृह्य holding, सकामा in love, कामिनीव like a lover, सुप्ता slept.
explanation: Yet another lotuseyed lady slept embracing a lute as if a lovelorn woman lay clasping her lover.

shloka_text: विपञ्चीं परिगृह्यान्या नियता नृत्तशालिनी। निद्रावशमनुप्राप्ता सह कान्तेव भामिनी।।5.10.41।।
transliteration: vipañcīṃ parigṛhyānyā niyatā nṛttaśālinī| nidrāvaśamanuprāptā saha kānteva bhāminī
translation: नृत्तशालिनी a lady graceful in dance, अन्या other, विपञ्चीम् sevenstringed lute, परिगृह्य holding, नियता selfpossessed one, सहकान्ता along with her lover, इव like, भामिनीव loved one, निद्रावशम् while sleeping, अनुप्राप्ता overtaken.
explanation: Another selfpossessed lady, graceful in dance, holding a sevenstringed lute  was as though lying asleep with her beloved.

shloka_text: अन्या कनकसङ्काशैर्मृदुपीनैर्मनोरमैः। मृदङ्गं परिपीड्याङ्गैः प्रसुप्ता मत्तलोचना।।5.10.42।।
transliteration: anyā kanakasaṅkāśairmṛdupīnairmanoramaiḥ| mṛdaṅgaṃ paripīḍyāṅgaiḥ prasuptā mattalocanā
translation: मत्तलोचना a lady of drunken eyes, अन्या another, कनकसङ्काशै: of golden complexion, मृदुपीनैः soft bosom, मनोहरैः delightful, अङ्गैः limbs, मृदङ्गम् drum, परिपीड्य holding, प्रसुप्ता slept.
explanation: Another lady with drunken eyes lay fast asleep holding a drum close to her beautiful bosom with her soft limbs. (These images show that these women were singing and dancing till late night and slept exhausted).

shloka_text: भुजपार्श्वान्तरस्थेन कक्षगेन कृशोदरी। पणवेव सहानिन्द्या सुप्ता मदकृतश्रमा।।5.10.43।।
transliteration: bhujapārśvāntarasthena kakṣagena kṛśodarī| paṇaveva sahānindyā suptā madakṛtaśramā
translation: अनिन्द्या flawless, कृशोदरी of slender stomach, मदकृतश्रमा exhausted by drunkenness, भुजपर्श्वान्तरस्थेन pressed to her bosom, कक्षगेन into her armpit, पणवेन सह with tabor, सुप्ता slept
explanation: Another lady of slender belly, who had been exhausted by drunkeness was lying with a tabor pressed to her bosom and inserted in her armpit.

shloka_text: डिण्डिमं परिगृह्यान्या तथैवासक्तडिण्डिमा। प्रसुप्ता तरुणं वत्समुपगूह्येव भामिनी।।5.10.44।।
transliteration: ḍiṇḍimaṃ parigṛhyānyā tathaivāsaktaḍiṇḍimā| prasuptā taruṇaṃ vatsamupagūhyeva bhāminī
translation: आसक्तडिण्डिमा holding a drum, अन्या another one, डिण्डिमम् drum, परिगृह्य having held, तथैव in the same position, तरुणम् young, वत्सम् child, उपगुह्य by holding, इव like  प्रसुप्ता slept, भामिनी lovely lady
explanation: One lovely woman and another held a drum and slept as if they were hugging their young child.

shloka_text: काचिदाडम्बरं नारी भुजसंयोगपीडितम्। कृत्वा कमलपत्राक्षी प्रसुप्ता मदमोहिता।।5.10.45।।
transliteration: kācidāḍambaraṃ nārī bhujasaṃyogapīḍitam| kṛtvā kamalapatrākṣī prasuptā madamohitā
translation: कमलपत्राक्षी eyes like lotus petals, काचित् yet another, नारी woman, आडम्बरम् Adambaram, a musical instrument, भुजसंयोगपीडितम् held tightly in her arms, कृत्वा having made, मदमोहिता deluded with passion, प्रसुप्ता slept.
explanation: Yet another with her eyes like lotus petals deluded with passion tightly held in her arms a musical instrument known as Adambaram and slept.

shloka_text: कलशीमपविध्यान्या प्रसुप्ता भाति भामिनी। वसन्ते पुष्पशबला मालेव परिमार्जिता।।5.10.46।।
transliteration: kalaśīmapavidhyānyā prasuptā bhāti bhāminī| vasante puṣpaśabalā māleva parimārjitā
translation: कलशीम् goblet filled with water, अपविध्य by turning aside, प्रसुप्ता slept, अन्या भामिनी another lovely one, वसन्ते in Spring, परिमार्जिता swept away, पुष्पशबला of variegated flowers, मालेव garland like, भाति appeared.
explanation: Another lovely lady was fast asleep, having turned a goblet of water  aside, yet another lay like a garland of variegated flowers in spring season.

shloka_text: पाणिभ्यां च कुचौ काचित्सुवर्णकलशोपमौ। उपगूह्याबला सुप्ता निद्राबलपराजिता।।5.10.47।।
transliteration: pāṇibhyāṃ ca kucau kācitsuvarṇakalaśopamau| upagūhyābalā suptā nidrābalaparājitā
translation: काचित् yet another, अबला woman, पाणिभ्याम् with both her hands, सुवर्णकलशोपमौ like golden goblets, कुचौ breasts, उपगूह्य pressing, निद्राबलपराजिता overpowered with sleep, सुप्ता slept.
explanation: Overcome with sleep another woman lay pressing with her own hands her golden gobletlike breasts.

shloka_text: अन्या कमलपत्राक्षी पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना। अन्यामालिङ्ग्य सुश्रोणीं प्रसुप्ता मदविह्वला।।5.10.48।।
transliteration: anyā kamalapatrākṣī pūrṇendusadṛśānanā| anyāmāliṅgya suśroṇīṃ prasuptā madavihvalā
translation: कमलपत्राक्षी eyes like lotus petals, पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना face like the fullmoon, अन्या another one, मदविह्वला drowsy with drunkeness, सुश्रोणीम् with beautiful hips, अन्याम् other, आलिङ्ग्य having embraced, प्रसुप्ता slept.
explanation: One woman with eyes like lotus petals and face like the fullmoon embraced another young woman of beautiful hips  and slept tipsy with drink.

shloka_text: आतोद्यानि विचित्राणि परिष्वज्य वरस्त्रियः। निपीड्य च कुचैस्सुप्ता कामिन्यः कामुकानिव।।5.10.49।।
transliteration: ātodyāni vicitrāṇi pariṣvajya varastriyaḥ| nipīḍya ca kucaissuptā kāminyaḥ kāmukāniva
translation: वरस्त्रियः exquisite women, विचित्राणि of many wonderful kinds, आतोद्यानि musical instruments, परिष्वज्य embraced, कामिन्यः passionate women, कामुकानिव as if their loved ones, कुचैः with their bosom, निपीड्य by holding, सुप्ता slept.
explanation: Some charming maidens held wonderful musical instruments pressing against their bosom and slept like passionate women embracing their loved ones.

shloka_text: तासामेकान्तविन्यस्ते शयानां शयने शुभे। ददर्श रूपसम्पन्नामपरां स कपिः स्त्रियम्।।5.10.50।।
transliteration: tāsāmekāntavinyaste śayānāṃ śayane śubhe| dadarśa rūpasampannāmaparāṃ sa kapiḥ striyam
translation: सः कपिः that vanara, तासाम् among them, एकान्तविन्यस्ते lying separately, शुभे excellent, शयने bed, शयानाम् sleeping, रूपसम्पन्नाम् richly endowed with beauty, स्त्रियम् women, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Hanuman saw some maidens lying on separate excellent beds, women richly  endowed with beautysleeping.

shloka_text: मुक्तामणिसमायुक्तैर्भूषणैः सुविभूषिताम्। विभूषयन्तीमिव तत्स्वश्रिया भवनोत्तमम्।।5.10.51।। गौरीं कनकवर्णाभामिष्टामन्तः पुरेश्वरीम्। कपिर्मन्दोदरीं तत्र शयानां चारुरूपिणीम्।।5.10.52।।
transliteration: muktāmaṇisamāyuktairbhūṣaṇaiḥ suvibhūṣitām| vibhūṣayantīmiva tatsvaśriyā bhavanottamam gaurīṃ kanakavarṇābhāmiṣṭāmantaḥ pureśvarīm| kapirmandodarīṃ tatra śayānāṃ cārurūpiṇīm
translation: कपिः vanara, मुक्तामणिसमायुक्तै: with pearls and gems, भूषणैः with ornaments, सुविभूषिताम् well decorated, स्वश्रिया by her radiance, तत् that, भवनोत्तमम् that excellent mansion, विभूषयन्तीमिव as if decorating, गौरीम् woman of golden complexion, कनकवर्णाभाम् of golden complexion, इष्टाम् favourite, अन्तःपुरेश्वरीम् queen of the harem, तत्र there, शयानाम् sleeping, चारुरूपिणीम् very beautiful, मन्दोदरीम् Mandodari.
explanation: Then the vanara saw  a very beautiful woman of golden complexion decked with pearls and gems and with ornaments as if illuminating the excellent mansion with her splendour She was the king's favourite and the chief queen, Mandodari.

shloka_text: मुक्तामणिसमायुक्तैर्भूषणैः सुविभूषिताम्। विभूषयन्तीमिव तत्स्वश्रिया भवनोत्तमम्।।5.10.51।। गौरीं कनकवर्णाभामिष्टामन्तः पुरेश्वरीम्। कपिर्मन्दोदरीं तत्र शयानां चारुरूपिणीम्।।5.10.52।।
transliteration: muktāmaṇisamāyuktairbhūṣaṇaiḥ suvibhūṣitām| vibhūṣayantīmiva tatsvaśriyā bhavanottamam gaurīṃ kanakavarṇābhāmiṣṭāmantaḥ pureśvarīm| kapirmandodarīṃ tatra śayānāṃ cārurūpiṇīm
translation: कपिः vanara, मुक्तामणिसमायुक्तै: with pearls and gems, भूषणैः with ornaments, सुविभूषिताम् well decorated, स्वश्रिया by her radiance, तत् that, भवनोत्तमम् that excellent mansion, विभूषयन्तीमिव as if decorating, गौरीम् woman of golden complexion, कनकवर्णाभाम् of golden complexion, इष्टाम् favourite, अन्तःपुरेश्वरीम् queen of the harem, तत्र there, शयानाम् sleeping, चारुरूपिणीम् very beautiful, मन्दोदरीम् Mandodari.
explanation: Then the vanara saw  a very beautiful woman of golden complexion decked with pearls and gems and with ornaments as if illuminating the excellent mansion with her splendour She was the king's favourite and the chief queen, Mandodari.

shloka_text: स तां दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्भूषितां मारुतात्मजः। तर्कयामास सीतेति रूपयौवनसम्पदा।।5.10.53। हर्षेण महता युक्तो ननन्द हरियूथपः।
transliteration: sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurbhūṣitāṃ mārutātmajaḥ| tarkayāmāsa sīteti rūpayauvanasampadā||5.10.53| harṣeṇa mahatā yukto nananda hariyūthapaḥ|
translation: महाबाहुः with long arms, सः मारुतात्मजः that son of the Windgod, भूषिताम् decorated, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, रूपयौवनसम्पदा by the wealth of her beauty and charm, सीतेति 'this is Sita', तर्कयामास deliberated, हरियूथपः chief of vanara, महता with great, हर्षेण joy, युक्तः endowed, ननन्द rejoiced.
explanation: On seeing her embellished with ornaments, beauty and charm, the long armed son of the Windgod, the chief of the vanaras thought her to be Sita and rejoiced.

shloka_text: आस्फोटयामास चुचुम्ब पुच्छं ननन्द चिक्रीड जगौ जगाम। स्तम्भानरोहन्निपपात भूमौ निदर्शयन् स्वां प्रकृतिं कपीनाम्।।5.10.54।।
transliteration: āsphoṭayāmāsa cucumba pucchaṃ nananda cikrīḍa jagau jagāma| stambhānarohannipapāta bhūmau nidarśayan svāṃ prakṛtiṃ kapīnām
translation: आस्फोटयामास clapped his palms, पुच्छम् tail, चुचुम्ब kissed, ननन्द rejoiced, चिक्रीड played, जगौ sang songs, जगाम went about, स्वाम् himself, कपीनाम् of being monkeys, प्रकृतिम् nature, निदर्शयन् while exhibiting, स्तम्भान् pillars, अरोहन् while climbing up, भूमौ on the land, निपपात jumped down.
explanation: He rejoiced clapping his palms, kissing his tail and jumping up, climbing up the pillars and jumping down on the ground in joy. Thus he exhibited his monkey nature. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: अवधूय च तां बुद्धिं बभूवावस्थितस्तदा। जगाम चापरां चिन्तां सीतां प्रति महाकपिः।।5.11.1।।
transliteration: avadhūya ca tāṃ buddhiṃ babhūvāvasthitastadā| jagāma cāparāṃ cintāṃ sītāṃ prati mahākapiḥ
translation: महाकपिः great vanara, तदा then, ताम् such, बुद्धिम् judgement, अवधूय having rejected, अवस्थितः stood, बभूव remained, सीतां प्रति about Sita, अपराम् again, चिन्ताम् thinking, जगाम started.
explanation: The great vanara, having rejected his judgement, started thinking again.
comments: Hanuman mistakes Mandodari for Sita -- soon dismises his wrong inference -- sees the women of harem lying in disorder -- could not find Sita

shloka_text: न रामेण वियुक्ता सा स्वप्तुमर्हति भामिनी। न भोक्तुं वाप्यलङ्कर्तुं न पानमुपसेवितुम्।।5.11.2।। नान्यं नरमुपस्थातुं सुराणामपि चेश्वरम्। न हि रामसमः कश्चिद्विद्यते त्रिदशेष्वपि।।5.11.3।। अन्येयमिति निश्चित्य पानभूमौ चचार सः।
transliteration: na rāmeṇa viyuktā sā svaptumarhati bhāminī| na bhoktuṃ vāpyalaṅkartuṃ na pānamupasevitum nānyaṃ naramupasthātuṃ surāṇāmapi ceśvaram| na hi rāmasamaḥ kaścidvidyate tridaśeṣvapi anyeyamiti niścitya pānabhūmau cacāra saḥ|
translation: भामिनी lovely lady, रामेण about Rama, वियुक्ता separated, स्वप्तुम् to sleep, न अर्हति will not, भोक्तुम् न not to eat, अलङ्कर्तुम् to decorate, अपि also, न not, पानम् drinking, उपसेवितुम् to serve, सुराणाम् among gods, ईश्वरमपि even the lord, अन्यम् and others, नरम् man, उपस्थातुम् to approach, न not, हि indeed, रामसमः equal to Rama, कश्चित् any one, त्रिदशेष्वपि even among gods, न विद्यते हि not exist, इयम् this lady, अन्या other, इति thus, निश्चित्य having decided, सः he, पानभूमौ at the banquet, चचार strolled.
explanation: 'Lovely Sita, being away from Rama, will not sleep, will not eat or drink or adorn herself. How can she approach any other man even if he is the king of gods for there is none equal to Rama even among gods'. Having thus decided, Hanuman strolled about the banquet hall.

shloka_text: न रामेण वियुक्ता सा स्वप्तुमर्हति भामिनी। न भोक्तुं वाप्यलङ्कर्तुं न पानमुपसेवितुम्।।5.11.2।। नान्यं नरमुपस्थातुं सुराणामपि चेश्वरम्। न हि रामसमः कश्चिद्विद्यते त्रिदशेष्वपि।।5.11.3।। अन्येयमिति निश्चित्य पानभूमौ चचार सः।
transliteration: na rāmeṇa viyuktā sā svaptumarhati bhāminī| na bhoktuṃ vāpyalaṅkartuṃ na pānamupasevitum nānyaṃ naramupasthātuṃ surāṇāmapi ceśvaram| na hi rāmasamaḥ kaścidvidyate tridaśeṣvapi anyeyamiti niścitya pānabhūmau cacāra saḥ|
translation: भामिनी lovely lady, रामेण about Rama, वियुक्ता separated, स्वप्तुम् to sleep, न अर्हति will not, भोक्तुम् न not to eat, अलङ्कर्तुम् to decorate, अपि also, न not, पानम् drinking, उपसेवितुम् to serve, सुराणाम् among gods, ईश्वरमपि even the lord, अन्यम् and others, नरम् man, उपस्थातुम् to approach, न not, हि indeed, रामसमः equal to Rama, कश्चित् any one, त्रिदशेष्वपि even among gods, न विद्यते हि not exist, इयम् this lady, अन्या other, इति thus, निश्चित्य having decided, सः he, पानभूमौ at the banquet, चचार strolled.
explanation: 'Lovely Sita, being away from Rama, will not sleep, will not eat or drink or adorn herself. How can she approach any other man even if he is the king of gods for there is none equal to Rama even among gods'. Having thus decided, Hanuman strolled about the banquet hall.

shloka_text: क्रीडितेनापराः क्लान्ता गीतेन च तथाऽपराः।।5.11.4।। नृत्तेन चापराः क्लान्ताः पानविप्रहतास्तथा।
transliteration: krīḍitenāparāḥ klāntā gītena ca tathā'parāḥ nṛttena cāparāḥ klāntāḥ pānaviprahatāstathā|
translation: पराः other women, क्रीडितेन by sporting, क्लान्ताः fatigued, तथा similarly, अपराः others, गीतेन due to singing, अपराः others, नृत्तेन by dancing, क्लान्ताः tired out, तथा so also, पानविप्रहताः  worn out due to continuous drinking.
explanation: Some women were fatigued after sporting, similarly some were exhausted after singing. Others were tired through dancing and some were worn out by continuous drinking.

shloka_text: मुरजेषु मृदङ्गेषु पीठिकासु च संस्थिताः।।5.11.5।। तथाऽऽस्तरणमुख्येषु संविष्टाश्चापराः स्त्रियः।
transliteration: murajeṣu mṛdaṅgeṣu pīṭhikāsu ca saṃsthitāḥ tathā''staraṇamukhyeṣu saṃviṣṭāścāparāḥ striyaḥ|
translation: मुरजेषु on murajas, मृदङ्गेषु on tabors, पीठिकासु च on hassocks, संस्थिताः resting, अपराः other, स्त्रियः women, आस्तरणमुख्येषु on exquisite beds, संविष्टाः lying.
explanation: Some women reclined on tabors, some on murajas, and some on drums and hassocks while some slept on excellent couches.

shloka_text: अङ्गनानां सहस्रेण भूषितेन विभूषणैः।।5.11.6।। रूपसल्लापशीलेन युक्तगीतार्थभाषिणा। देशकालाभियुक्तेन युक्तवाक्याभिधायिना।।5.11.7।। रताभिरतसंसुप्तं ददर्श हरियूथपः।
transliteration: aṅganānāṃ sahasreṇa bhūṣitena vibhūṣaṇaiḥ rūpasallāpaśīlena yuktagītārthabhāṣiṇā| deśakālābhiyuktena yuktavākyābhidhāyinā ratābhiratasaṃsuptaṃ dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ|
translation: विभूषणैः with ornaments, भूषितेन adorned, रूपसल्लापशीलेन good at arguments, युक्तगीतार्थभाषिणा versed in appreciation, देशकालाभियुक्तेन acquainted with the appropriateness of time and place, युक्तवाक्याभिधायिना good at appropriate expressions, अङ्गनानाम् of women, सहस्रेण thousands, रताभिरतसंसुप्तम् sleeping after long sexual intercourse, हरियूथपः monkey leader, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The monkey leader saw thousands of  beautiful women asleep after long dalliance. Some of them were adorned with ornaments, some were good at arguments and versed in the appreciation of songs, some were aware of the appropriate time and place and some were adept in right expressions.

shloka_text: अङ्गनानां सहस्रेण भूषितेन विभूषणैः।।5.11.6।। रूपसल्लापशीलेन युक्तगीतार्थभाषिणा। देशकालाभियुक्तेन युक्तवाक्याभिधायिना।।5.11.7।। रताभिरतसंसुप्तं ददर्श हरियूथपः।
transliteration: aṅganānāṃ sahasreṇa bhūṣitena vibhūṣaṇaiḥ rūpasallāpaśīlena yuktagītārthabhāṣiṇā| deśakālābhiyuktena yuktavākyābhidhāyinā ratābhiratasaṃsuptaṃ dadarśa hariyūthapaḥ|
translation: विभूषणैः with ornaments, भूषितेन adorned, रूपसल्लापशीलेन good at arguments, युक्तगीतार्थभाषिणा versed in appreciation, देशकालाभियुक्तेन acquainted with the appropriateness of time and place, युक्तवाक्याभिधायिना good at appropriate expressions, अङ्गनानाम् of women, सहस्रेण thousands, रताभिरतसंसुप्तम् sleeping after long sexual intercourse, हरियूथपः monkey leader, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The monkey leader saw thousands of  beautiful women asleep after long dalliance. Some of them were adorned with ornaments, some were good at arguments and versed in the appreciation of songs, some were aware of the appropriate time and place and some were adept in right expressions.

shloka_text: तासां मध्ये महाबाहुः शुशुभे राक्षसेश्वरः।।5.11.8।। गोष्ठे महति मुख्यानां गवां मध्ये यथा वृषः।
transliteration: tāsāṃ madhye mahābāhuḥ śuśubhe rākṣaseśvaraḥ goṣṭhe mahati mukhyānāṃ gavāṃ madhye yathā vṛṣaḥ|
translation: तासाम् their, मध्ये in the midst, महाबाहुः longarmed, राक्षसेश्वरः lord of ogres, महति a big, गोष्ठे in a shed, गवाम् of cows, मध्ये in the midst, वृषः इव like a bull, शुशुभे  shone.
explanation: In the midst of these women the longarmed lord of demons shone like a (majestic) bull in a big cowshed.

shloka_text: स राक्षसेन्द्रः शुशुभे ताभिः परिवृतस्स्वयम्।।5.11.9।। करेणुभिर्यथाऽरण्ये परिकीर्णो महाद्विपः।
transliteration: sa rākṣasendraḥ śuśubhe tābhiḥ parivṛtassvayam kareṇubhiryathā'raṇye parikīrṇo mahādvipaḥ|
translation: ताभिः by those women, परिवृतः surrounded, सः राक्षसेन्द्रः the demon king, स्वयम् himself, महारण्ये in a great forest, करेणुभिः with female elphants, परिकीर्णः scattered, महाद्विपः यथा like a proud elephant, शुशुभे shone.
explanation: Surrounded by the women, the demon king shone like a proud elephant attended by many female elephants scattered in a dense forest.

shloka_text: सर्वकामैरुपेतां च पानभूमिं महात्मनः।।5.11.10।। ददर्श हरिशार्दूलस्तस्य रक्षःपतेर्गृहे।
transliteration: sarvakāmairupetāṃ ca pānabhūmiṃ mahātmanaḥ dadarśa hariśārdūlastasya rakṣaḥpatergṛhe|
translation: हरिशार्दूलः tiger among vanaras, महात्मनः of the great, तस्य his, रक्षःपते: Ravana's, गृहे in the palace, सर्वकामैः with all his, उपेताम् provided, पानभूमिं च drinking place, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The tiger among vanaras saw at the great Ravana's palace a drinking place where everything one desires was provided.

shloka_text: मृगाणां महिषाणां च वराहाणां च भागशः।।5.11.11।। तत्र न्यस्तानि मांसानि पानभूमौ ददर्श सः।
transliteration: mṛgāṇāṃ mahiṣāṇāṃ ca varāhāṇāṃ ca bhāgaśaḥ tatra nyastāni māṃsāni pānabhūmau dadarśa saḥ|
translation: सः he, तत्र there, पानभूमौ at the drinking hall, भागशः in portions, न्यस्तानि placed, मृगाणाम् on the deer, महिषाणां च buffaloes, वराहाणां च pigs, मांसानि meat, ददर्श saw.
explanation: There at the drinking hall the meat of deer, buffaloes and boars portioned and placed.

shloka_text: रौक्मेषु च विशालेषु भाजनेष्वर्धभक्षितान्।।5.11.12।। ददर्श हरिशार्दूलो मयूरान् कुक्कुटांस्तथा।
transliteration: raukmeṣu ca viśāleṣu bhājaneṣvardhabhakṣitān dadarśa hariśārdūlo mayūrān kukkuṭāṃstathā|
translation: हरिशार्दूलः tiger among vanaras, रौक्मेषु in golden, विशालेषु in large ones, भाजनेषु vessels, अर्धभक्षितान् half eaten, मयूरान् peacocks, तथा so also, कुक्कुटान् chicken, ददर्श saw.
explanation: The tiger among vanaras also saw there meat of peacocks and chicken placed in large golden vessels, some half eaten.

shloka_text: वराहवार्ध्राणसकान् दधिसौवर्चलायुतान्।।5.11.13।। शल्यान् मृगमयूरांश्च हनुमानन्ववैक्षत।
transliteration: varāhavārdhrāṇasakān dadhisauvarcalāyutān śalyān mṛgamayūrāṃśca hanumānanvavaikṣata|
translation: दधिसौवर्चलायुतान् marinated with yoghurt and special salt, वराहवार्ध्राणसकान् meat of pigs and jungle fowls, हनुमान् Hanuman, अन्ववैक्षत observed, शल्यान् bones, मृगमयूरांश्च deer and peacocks.
explanation: Hanuman saw the meat of pigs and jungle fowls, deer, peacocks and bones marinated with yoghurt and special kinds of salt.

shloka_text: क्रकरान्विविधान् सिद्धांश्चकोरानर्धभक्षितान्।।5.11.14।। महिषानेकशल्यांश्च छागांश्च कृतनिष्ठितान्। लेह्यानुच्चावचान्पेयान् भोज्यानि विविधानि च।।5.11.15।।
transliteration: krakarānvividhān siddhāṃścakorānardhabhakṣitān mahiṣānekaśalyāṃśca chāgāṃśca kṛtaniṣṭhitān| lehyānuccāvacānpeyān bhojyāni vividhāni ca
translation: विविधान् several types, सिद्धान् cooked, क्रकरान् fowls, अर्धभक्षितान् half eaten, चकोरान् ruddy geese, महिषान् buffaloes, एकशल्यांश्च fishes, छागांश्च goats, उच्चवचान् all sorts of them, लेह्यान् varieties of food that can be licked, पेयान् drinks, विविधानि of many kinds, भोज्यानि eatables.
explanation: He saw several kinds of (nonvegetarian) food like cooked meat of fowls, ruddy geese, buffaloes, goats, fishes as well as food for licking. (Food is of four kinds  1) भक्ष्य which can be chewed 2) भोज्य ordinary solid, semisolid food which can be consumed  3) लेह्य food for licking  4) चोष्य liquid food (which can be sipped)).

shloka_text: क्रकरान्विविधान् सिद्धांश्चकोरानर्धभक्षितान्।।5.11.14।। महिषानेकशल्यांश्च छागांश्च कृतनिष्ठितान्। लेह्यानुच्चावचान्पेयान् भोज्यानि विविधानि च।।5.11.15।।
transliteration: krakarānvividhān siddhāṃścakorānardhabhakṣitān mahiṣānekaśalyāṃśca chāgāṃśca kṛtaniṣṭhitān| lehyānuccāvacānpeyān bhojyāni vividhāni ca
translation: विविधान् several types, सिद्धान् cooked, क्रकरान् fowls, अर्धभक्षितान् half eaten, चकोरान् ruddy geese, महिषान् buffaloes, एकशल्यांश्च fishes, छागांश्च goats, उच्चवचान् all sorts of them, लेह्यान् varieties of food that can be licked, पेयान् drinks, विविधानि of many kinds, भोज्यानि eatables.
explanation: He saw several kinds of (nonvegetarian) food like cooked meat of fowls, ruddy geese, buffaloes, goats, fishes as well as food for licking. (Food is of four kinds  1) भक्ष्य which can be chewed 2) भोज्य ordinary solid, semisolid food which can be consumed  3) लेह्य food for licking  4) चोष्य liquid food (which can be sipped)).

shloka_text: तथाऽऽम्ललवणोत्तंसैर्विविधैरागषाडबैः। हारनूपुरकेयूरैरपविद्धैर्महाधनैः।।5.11.16।। पानभाजनविक्षिप्तैः फलैश्च विविधैरपि। कृतपुष्पोपहारा भूरधिकं पुष्यति श्रियम्।।5.11.17।।
transliteration: tathā''mlalavaṇottaṃsairvividhairāgaṣāḍabaiḥ| hāranūpurakeyūrairapaviddhairmahādhanaiḥ pānabhājanavikṣiptaiḥ phalaiśca vividhairapi| kṛtapuṣpopahārā bhūradhikaṃ puṣyati śriyam
translation: तथा so also, आम्ललवणोत्तंसैः seasoned with sour and salty ingredients, विविधैः with many types, रागषाडबैः with syrups, अपविद्धै: with discarded, महाधनैः with heavy, हारनूपुरकेयूरैः with chains, anklets, shoulder straps, पानभाजनविक्षिप्तै: with those drinks spilt from the glasses, विविधैः with many, फलैश्च fruits, कृतपुष्पोपहारा with the offerings flowers of, भूः the earth, अधिकम् greatly, श्रियम् rich, पुष्यति looked splendid.
explanation: The banquet hall looked splendid with food seasoned with salt and sour ingredients. There was ragashadavas (syrup made with grapes, pomegranates, different juices like half ripe mangoes and seasoned with ginger cardomom, butter etc). Heavy chains, anklets and shouldersstraps were thrown aside. (The people relaxed while eating and drinking and discarded heavy ornaments). Many glasses were found scattered or drinks spilt on the floor after use.Many fruits and flowers were kept.

shloka_text: तथाऽऽम्ललवणोत्तंसैर्विविधैरागषाडबैः। हारनूपुरकेयूरैरपविद्धैर्महाधनैः।।5.11.16।। पानभाजनविक्षिप्तैः फलैश्च विविधैरपि। कृतपुष्पोपहारा भूरधिकं पुष्यति श्रियम्।।5.11.17।।
transliteration: tathā''mlalavaṇottaṃsairvividhairāgaṣāḍabaiḥ| hāranūpurakeyūrairapaviddhairmahādhanaiḥ pānabhājanavikṣiptaiḥ phalaiśca vividhairapi| kṛtapuṣpopahārā bhūradhikaṃ puṣyati śriyam
translation: तथा so also, आम्ललवणोत्तंसैः seasoned with sour and salty ingredients, विविधैः with many types, रागषाडबैः with syrups, अपविद्धै: with discarded, महाधनैः with heavy, हारनूपुरकेयूरैः with chains, anklets, shoulder straps, पानभाजनविक्षिप्तै: with those drinks spilt from the glasses, विविधैः with many, फलैश्च fruits, कृतपुष्पोपहारा with the offerings flowers of, भूः the earth, अधिकम् greatly, श्रियम् rich, पुष्यति looked splendid.
explanation: The banquet hall looked splendid with food seasoned with salt and sour ingredients. There was ragashadavas (syrup made with grapes, pomegranates, different juices like half ripe mangoes and seasoned with ginger cardomom, butter etc). Heavy chains, anklets and shouldersstraps were thrown aside. (The people relaxed while eating and drinking and discarded heavy ornaments). Many glasses were found scattered or drinks spilt on the floor after use.Many fruits and flowers were kept.

shloka_text: तत्र तत्र च विन्यस्तै: सुश्लिष्टैश्शयनासनैः। पानभूमिर्विना वह्निं प्रदीप्तेवोपलक्ष्यते।।5.11.18।।
transliteration: tatra tatra ca vinyastai: suśliṣṭaiśśayanāsanaiḥ| pānabhūmirvinā vahniṃ pradīptevopalakṣyate
translation: पानभूमिः banquet hall, तत्र तत्र here and there, विन्यस्तै: arranged, सुश्लिष्टैः wellarranged, शयनासनैः with beds and seats, विना वह्निम् without fire, प्रदीप्तेव as if glowing, उपलक्ष्यते seemed.
explanation: Good couches and different kinds of seats were wellarranged in the banquet hall. The place appeared as if it was glowing witout fire.

shloka_text: बहुप्रकारैर्विविधैर्वरसंस्कारसंस्कृतैः। मांसैः कुशलसम्पृक्तैः पानभूमिगतैः पृथक्।।5.11.19।।
transliteration: bahuprakārairvividhairvarasaṃskārasaṃskṛtaiḥ| māṃsaiḥ kuśalasampṛktaiḥ pānabhūmigataiḥ pṛthak
translation: बहुप्रकारैः in many ways, विविधैः with many kinds, नरसंस्कारसंस्कृतैः by those seasoneed with many types of ingredients, कुशलसम्पृक्तै: cooked by experts, पृथक् separately, पानभूमिगतैः at the banquet hall, मांसैः with meat.
explanation: In the banquet hall there were many types of meat arranged in a number of ways. They were cooked by experts by seasoning them with choicest ingredients.

shloka_text: दिव्याः प्रसन्ना विविधाः सुराः कृतसुरा अपि। शर्कराऽसवमाध्वीकपुष्पासवफलासवाः।।5.11.20।। वासचूर्णैश्च विविधैर्मृष्टास्तैस्तैः पृथक् पृथक्।
transliteration: divyāḥ prasannā vividhāḥ surāḥ kṛtasurā api| śarkarā'savamādhvīkapuṣpāsavaphalāsavāḥ vāsacūrṇaiśca vividhairmṛṣṭāstaistaiḥ pṛthak pṛthak|
translation: दिव्याः wonderful, प्रसन्नाः pleasing, विविधाः many, सुराः wines, शर्करासवमाध्वीकपुष्पासवफलासवाः sugercanejuices, honey, juices made from flowers and fruits, कृतसुराः अपि even though fermented, तैस्तै: as mentioned earlier, विविधैः with many, वासचूर्णैः with spice powders, पृथक् पृथक् diferent and, मृष्टाः were made delicious.
explanation: There were many types of wonderful and pleasing wine extracted from sugarcane, honey , fruits and flowers. They were good even though fermented and made delicious by seasoning with aromatic spices.

shloka_text: सन्तता शुशुभे भूमिर्माल्यैश्च बहुसंस्थितैः।।5.11.21।। हिरण्मयैश्च विविधैर्भाजनैः स्फाटिकैरपि। जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्यैः करकैरभिसंवृता।।5.11.22।।
transliteration: santatā śuśubhe bhūmirmālyaiśca bahusaṃsthitaiḥ hiraṇmayaiśca vividhairbhājanaiḥ sphāṭikairapi| jāmbūnadamayaiścānyaiḥ karakairabhisaṃvṛtā
translation: बहुसंस्थितैः arranged in varied styles, माल्यैश्च with garlands, संतता strectched, हिरण्मयैः with those made of gold, स्फाटिकैरपि and crystalware, विविधैः several kinds, भाजनैः with vessels, जाम्बूनदमयैः made of pure gold, अन्यैः by others, करकैः with jars, अभिसंवृता spread all over, भूमिः floor, शुशुभे looked  beautiful.
explanation: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.

shloka_text: सन्तता शुशुभे भूमिर्माल्यैश्च बहुसंस्थितैः।।5.11.21।। हिरण्मयैश्च विविधैर्भाजनैः स्फाटिकैरपि। जाम्बूनदमयैश्चान्यैः करकैरभिसंवृता।।5.11.22।।
transliteration: santatā śuśubhe bhūmirmālyaiśca bahusaṃsthitaiḥ hiraṇmayaiśca vividhairbhājanaiḥ sphāṭikairapi| jāmbūnadamayaiścānyaiḥ karakairabhisaṃvṛtā
translation: बहुसंस्थितैः arranged in varied styles, माल्यैश्च with garlands, संतता strectched, हिरण्मयैः with those made of gold, स्फाटिकैरपि and crystalware, विविधैः several kinds, भाजनैः with vessels, जाम्बूनदमयैः made of pure gold, अन्यैः by others, करकैः with jars, अभिसंवृता spread all over, भूमिः floor, शुशुभे looked  beautiful.
explanation: (The banquet hall) appeared beautiful with many kinds of garlands arranged in different locations. Also there were vessels made of pure gold, crystalware and jars spread all over.

shloka_text: राजतेषु च कुम्भेषु जाम्बूनदमयेषु च। पानश्रेष्ठं तदा भूरि कपिस्तत्र ददर्श ह।।5.11.23।।
transliteration: rājateṣu ca kumbheṣu jāmbūnadamayeṣu ca| pānaśreṣṭhaṃ tadā bhūri kapistatra dadarśa ha
translation: कपिः monkey, तदा then, राजतेषु in those made of silver, जाम्बूनदमयेषु च in those made of pure gold, कुम्भेषु in pots, भूरि abundant, पानश्रेष्ठम् best of wines, ददर्श ह saw.
explanation: Hanuman saw the best of wines in large quantities kept in silver and pure gold pots.

shloka_text: ﻿सोऽपश्यच्छातकुम्भानि सीधोर्मणिमयानि च। राजतानि च पूर्णानि भाजनानि महाकपिः।।5.11.24।।
transliteration: ﻿so'paśyacchātakumbhāni sīdhormaṇimayāni ca| rājatāni ca pūrṇāni bhājanāni mahākapiḥ
translation: ﻿ स: महाकपिः that great monkey, शीधोः of wine, शातकुम्भानि made of gold, मणिमयानि च inlaid with gems also, राजतानि च and silver, पूर्णानि filled, भाजनानि vessels, अपश्यत् saw.
explanation: ﻿ The great monkey saw the wine jars made of gold and silver studded with crystals and gems.

shloka_text: क्वचिदल्पावशेषाणि क्वचित्पीतानि सर्वशः। क्वचिन्नैव प्रपीतानि पानानि स ददर्श ह।।5.11.25।।
transliteration: kvacidalpāvaśeṣāṇi kvacitpītāni sarvaśaḥ| kvacinnaiva prapītāni pānāni sa dadarśa ha
translation: स he, क्वचित् in one place, अल्पावशेषाणि left over, क्वचित् at one place, सर्वशः fully, पीतानि drained, क्वचित् yet in another spot, नैव प्रपीतानि not touched even a little, पानानि drinks, ददर्श ह saw.
explanation: He saw wine jars at one place, some fully drained, and at another place not touched at all.

shloka_text: क्वचिद् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् क्वचित्पानानि भागशः। क्वचिदन्नावशेषाणि पश्यन्वै विचचार ह।।5.11.26।।
transliteration: kvacid bhakṣyāṃśca vividhān kvacitpānāni bhāgaśaḥ| kvacidannāvaśeṣāṇi paśyanvai vicacāra ha
translation: क्वचित् in one place, विविधान् many types, भक्ष्यांश्च eatables, क्वचित् in another place, भागशः separated, पानानि drinks, क्वचित् in another places, अन्नावशेषाणि left over food, पश्यन् while looking at, विचचार ह he moved about.
explanation: He moved about looking at different types of eatables and drinks arranged separately along with the left over food.

shloka_text: क्वचित्प्रभिन्नैः करकैः क्वचिदालोलितैर्घटैः। क्वचित्संपृक्तमाल्यानि जलानि च फलानि च।।5.11.27।।
transliteration: kvacitprabhinnaiḥ karakaiḥ kvacidālolitairghaṭaiḥ| kvacitsaṃpṛktamālyāni jalāni ca phalāni ca
translation: क्वचित् in one place, प्रभिन्नैः with broken, करकैः with pots, क्वचित् at other place, आलोलितैः with rolling, घटैः with pots, क्वचित् somewhere else, संपृक्तमाल्यानि strewn and mixed up flower garlands, जलानि च and water, फलानि च and fruits.
explanation: At some places he saw broken pots, at other places rolling pots and elsewhere flower garlands strewn and mixed up with water and fruits.

shloka_text: शयनान्यत्र नारीणां शुभ्राणि बहुधा पुनः। परस्परं समाश्लिष्य काश्चित्सुप्ता वराङ्गनाः।।5.11.28।।
transliteration: śayanānyatra nārīṇāṃ śubhrāṇi bahudhā punaḥ| parasparaṃ samāśliṣya kāścitsuptā varāṅganāḥ
translation: अत्र there, नारीणाम् women's, शयनानि beds, पुनः again, बहुधा severally, शुभ्राणि clean (unused) काश्चित् some, वराङ्गनाः lovely women, परस्परम् each other, समाश्लिष्य having embraced, सुप्ताः slept.
explanation: Hanuman saw many beds some unused and some occupied by lovely women sleeping, embracing one another.

shloka_text: काश्चिच्च वस्त्रमन्यस्यास्स्वपन्त्याः परिधाय च। आहृत्य चाबलाः सुप्ता निद्राबलपराजिताः।।5.11.29।।
transliteration: kāścicca vastramanyasyāssvapantyāḥ paridhāya ca| āhṛtya cābalāḥ suptā nidrābalaparājitāḥ
translation: काश्चित् some, अबलाः women, निद्राबलपराजिताः succumbed to sleep, स्वपन्त्याः of sleeping women, अन्यस्याः others, वस्त्रम् clothes, आहृत्य after pulling, परिधाय covering their bodies with the same, सुप्ताः slept.
explanation: Overcome with sleep some women pulled clothes of other women and covered their bodies with them.

shloka_text: तासामुच्छवासवातेन वस्त्रं माल्यं च गात्रजम्। नात्यर्थं स्पन्दते चित्रं प्राप्य मन्दमिवानिलम्।।5.11.30।।
transliteration: tāsāmucchavāsavātena vastraṃ mālyaṃ ca gātrajam| nātyarthaṃ spandate citraṃ prāpya mandamivānilam
translation: तासाम् their, गात्रजम् on their bodies, वस्त्रम् clothes, माल्यं च and garlands, उच्छवासवातेन by their exhaling, मन्दम् mildly, अनिलम् wind, प्राप्य इव as though caught, नात्यर्थम् by that, चित्रम् it is lovely, स्पन्दते moving.
explanation: The lovely clothes and garlands on the bodies of women were moving mildly by their exhalations as if shaken by the gentle breeze.

shloka_text: चन्दनस्य च शीतस्य शीधोर्मधुरसस्य च। विविधस्य च माल्यस्य धूपस्य विविधस्य च।।5.11.31।। बहुधा मारुतस्तत्र गन्धं विविधमुद्वहन्।
transliteration: candanasya ca śītasya śīdhormadhurasasya ca| vividhasya ca mālyasya dhūpasya vividhasya ca bahudhā mārutastatra gandhaṃ vividhamudvahan|
translation: तत्र there, मारुतः the wind, शीतस्य of cool, चन्दनस्य  of  sandal, शीथोः of the wines, मधुरसस्य च of sweet smelling, विविधस्य of diverse, माल्यस्य and of garlands, विविधस्य of several types, धूपस्य च and of incense, विविधम् several, गन्धम् fragrances, बहुधा in many ways, उद्वहन्  blew.
explanation: With the many scents of cool sandal, of sweetsmelling wines of diverse kinds, as well as flower garlands of several types and of incense burning in that hall, the cool wind blew spreading several fragrances all over.

shloka_text: स्नानानां चन्दनानां च धूपानां चैव मूर्छितः।।5.11.32।। प्रववौ सुरभिर्गन्धो विमाने पुष्पके तदा।
transliteration: snānānāṃ candanānāṃ ca dhūpānāṃ caiva mūrchitaḥ pravavau surabhirgandho vimāne puṣpake tadā|
translation: तदा then, पुष्पके विमाने in the Pushpaka chariot, स्नानानाम् followed by bath, चन्दनानां च of sandals, धूपानां चैव also incense, सुरभिः sweet smelling wines, गन्धः fragrance, मूर्छितः spread, प्रववौ wafted through.
explanation: The wind wafting through the Pushpaka chariot carried the fragrance of the cool sandalpaste used in bath and the sweet smell of wines and thick smoke of fragrance spread further.

shloka_text: श्यामावदातास्तत्रान्याः काश्चित्कृष्णा वराङ्गनाः।।5.11.33।। काश्चित् काञ्चनवर्णाङ्ग्यः प्रमदा राक्षसालये।
transliteration: śyāmāvadātāstatrānyāḥ kāścitkṛṣṇā varāṅganāḥ kāścit kāñcanavarṇāṅgyaḥ pramadā rākṣasālaye|
translation: तत्र there, राक्षसालये in the abode of the ogres, अन्याः others, श्यामावदाताः of glowing dark complexion, काश्चित् some, वराङ्गनाः lovely women, कृष्णाः dark in colour, काश्चित् some, प्रमदाः women, काञ्चनवर्णाङ्ग्यः of golden complexion.
explanation: There in the demons abode were women who were fair, some lovely with dark and others with golden complexion.

shloka_text: तासां निद्रावशत्वाच्च मदनेन विमूर्छितम्।।5.11.34।। पद्मिनीनां प्रसुप्तानां रूपमासीद्यथैव हि।
transliteration: tāsāṃ nidrāvaśatvācca madanena vimūrchitam padminīnāṃ prasuptānāṃ rūpamāsīdyathaiva hi|
translation: निद्रावशत्वाच्च overwhelmed with sleep, मदनेन च and due to dalliance, विमूर्छितम् exhausted, प्रसुप्तानाम् of the sleeping, तासाम् their, रूपम् charm, प्रसुप्तानाम् of the sleeping, पद्मिनीनाम् of lotus creepers, यथैव as, आसीत् was seen.
explanation: Withered due to indulgence in sex they were overcome with sleep. The charm of the women was like the lotus creepers with closed lotuses .

shloka_text: एवं सर्वमशेषेण रावणान्तः पुरं कपिः।।5.11.35।। ददर्श सुमहातेजाः न ददर्श च जानकीम्।
transliteration: evaṃ sarvamaśeṣeṇa rāvaṇāntaḥ puraṃ kapiḥ dadarśa sumahātejāḥ na dadarśa ca jānakīm|
translation: सुमहातेजाः brilliant, कपिः monkey, एवम् in that way, सर्वम् all, रावणान्तःपुरं harem of Ravana, अशेषेण thoroughly, ददर्श searched, जानकीं च Janaki, न ददर्श did not see.
explanation: Brilliant Hanuman ransacked the harem of Ravana but found no Janaki.

shloka_text: निरीक्षमाणश्च तदा ताः स्त्रियः स महाकपिः।।5.11.36।। जगाम महतीं चिन्तां धर्मसाध्वसशङ्कितः।
transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇaśca tadā tāḥ striyaḥ sa mahākapiḥ jagāma mahatīṃ cintāṃ dharmasādhvasaśaṅkitaḥ|
translation: तदा then, स्त्रियः women, निरीक्षमाणः while seeing, सः he, महाकपिः the great monkey, धर्मसाध्वसशङ्कितः thinking that he transgressed the moral code, महतीम् great, चिन्ताम् worry, जगाम experienced.
explanation: The great monkey was very much worried as he thought he had transgressed the moral code by watching the women.

shloka_text: परदारावरोधस्य प्रसुप्तस्य निरीक्षणम्।।5.11.37।। इदं खलु ममात्यर्थं धर्मलोपं करिष्यति।
transliteration: paradārāvarodhasya prasuptasya nirīkṣaṇam idaṃ khalu mamātyarthaṃ dharmalopaṃ kariṣyati|
translation: प्रसुप्तस्य of those sleeping, परदारावरोधस्य of the inner chambers of others' wives, इदम् this, मम on my part, निरीक्षणम् observing them, अत्यर्थम् very much, धर्मलोपम् trangression of moral code, करिष्यति will lead to.
explanation: 'Observing the wives of others in this manner in their inner chambers very much amounts to transgression of moral code  by me'. ( thought he)

shloka_text: न हि मे परदाराणां दृष्टिर्विषयवर्तिनी।।5.11.38।। अयं चात्र मया दृष्टः परदारापरिग्रहः।
transliteration: na hi me paradārāṇāṃ dṛṣṭirviṣayavartinī ayaṃ cātra mayā dṛṣṭaḥ paradārāparigrahaḥ|
translation: मे my, दृष्टिः to view, परदाराणाम् others' wives, विषयवर्तिनी sensual, न हि not indeed, अत्र there, मया by me, अयम् this, परदारापरिग्रहः others' wives, दृष्टश्च were seen.
explanation: 'I did see these wives of another, but not with a sensual mind. I have only seen them but not with foul intention'.

shloka_text: तस्य प्रादुरभूच्चिन्ता पुनरन्या मनस्विनः।।5.11.39।। निश्चितैकान्तचित्तस्य कार्यनिश्चयदर्शिनी।
transliteration: tasya prādurabhūccintā punaranyā manasvinaḥ niścitaikāntacittasya kāryaniścayadarśinī|
translation: मनस्विनः highly sensible, निश्चितैकान्तचित्तस्य struck with a bright idea in a single direction, तस्य his, पुनः again, कार्यनिश्चयदर्शिनी the decision regarding the task ahead, अन्या other, चिन्ता thought, प्रादुरभूत् arose.
explanation: Another  bright idea struck the highly sensible Hanuman, who had a clear vision of the task ahead-- 'I was firm and singleminded in my direction regarding the task ahead' (thought he).

shloka_text: कामं दृष्टा मया सर्वा विश्वस्ता रावणस्त्रियः।।5.11.40।। न हि मे मनसः किञ्चिद्वैकृत्यमुपजायते।
transliteration: kāmaṃ dṛṣṭā mayā sarvā viśvastā rāvaṇastriyaḥ na hi me manasaḥ kiñcidvaikṛtyamupajāyate|
translation: विश्वस्ताः loyal, सर्वाः all, रावणस्त्रियः wives of Ravana, मया by me, कामं दृष्टाः are seen indeed without any foul desire, मे my, मनसः minds, किञ्चित् even a little, वैकृत्यम् passionate feeling, न उपजायते हि indeed not arise.
explanation: 'It is true I saw all the loyal wives of Ravana but without any foul desire. Indeed in my mind no passionate feeling was ever aroused'.

shloka_text: मनो हि हेतुः सर्वेषामिन्द्रियाणां प्रवर्तने।।5.11.41।। शुभाशुभास्ववस्थासु तच्च मे सुव्यवस्थितम्।
transliteration: mano hi hetuḥ sarveṣāmindriyāṇāṃ pravartane śubhāśubhāsvavasthāsu tacca me suvyavasthitam|
translation: शुभाशुभासु for good and bad, अवस्थासु in all stages, सर्वेषाम् for all, इन्द्रियाणाम् of sense organs, प्रवर्तने in reaction, मनः mind, हेतुः is instrumental, मे my, तच्च that also, सुव्यवस्थितम्  is firmly eastablished.
explanation: 'Mind propels the sense organs to do good or bad deeds. (But) my mind is firmly esatablished in righteousness'.

shloka_text: नान्यत्र हि मया शक्या वैदेही परिमार्गितुम्।।5.11.42।। स्त्रियो हि स्त्रीषु दृश्यन्ते सदा सम्परिमार्गणे।
transliteration: nānyatra hi mayā śakyā vaidehī parimārgitum striyo hi strīṣu dṛśyante sadā samparimārgaṇe|
translation: वैदेही Vaidehi, अन्यत्र at other places, परिमार्गितुम् to search, मया by me, न शक्या हि not possible indeed, सदा always, सम्परिमार्गणे during search, स्त्रियः women, स्त्रीषु among women, दृश्यन्ते can be seen.
explanation: 'It is not possible for me to look for Vaidehi elsewhere. During such search operations one always looks for women among women.'

shloka_text: यस्य सत्त्वस्य या योनिस्तस्यां तत्परिमार्ग्यते। न शक्या प्रमदा नष्टा मृगीषु परिमार्गितुम्।।5.11.43।।
transliteration: yasya sattvasya yā yonistasyāṃ tatparimārgyate| na śakyā pramadā naṣṭā mṛgīṣu parimārgitum
translation: यस्य whose, सत्त्वस्य of a being, या whichever, योनिः source, तत् that, तस्याम् in that, परिमार्ग्यते is searched, नष्टा lost, प्रमदा woman, मृगीषु among female deer, परिमार्गितुम् to search, न शक्या not possible.
explanation: 'One has to search a creature among its own species. It is not possible to find a lost woman in the herd of female deer'.

shloka_text: तदिदं मार्गितं तावच्छुद्धेन मनसा मया।।5.11.44।। रावणान्तःपुरं सर्वं दृश्यते न तु जानकी।
transliteration: tadidaṃ mārgitaṃ tāvacchuddhena manasā mayā rāvaṇāntaḥpuraṃ sarvaṃ dṛśyate na tu jānakī|
translation: तत् that, मया by me, शुद्धेन with a pure, मनसा mind, इदम् this, सर्वम् all, रावणान्तःपुरम् Ravana's harem, मार्गितम् searched, जानकी तु but Janaki also, न दृश्यते is not seen.
explanation: 'I searched all over Ravana's harem with a pure mind but I have not seen Janaki'.

shloka_text: देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च नागकन्याश्च वीर्यवान्।।5.11.45।। अवेक्षमाणो हनुमान्नैवापश्यत जानकीम्।
transliteration: devagandharvakanyāśca nāgakanyāśca vīryavān avekṣamāṇo hanumānnaivāpaśyata jānakīm|
translation: देवगन्धर्वकन्याश्च daughters of gods, gandharvas also, नागकन्याश्च and daughters of nagas, अवेक्षमाणः looked, वीर्यवान् valiant, हनुमान् Hanuman, जानकीम् Janaki, नैवापश्यत did not find.
explanation: Even while valiant Hanuman was looking among the daughters of gods, gandharvas and nagas he could not find Janaki.

shloka_text: तामपश्यन्कपिस्तत्र पश्यञ्श्चान्या परस्त्रियः।।5.11.46।। अपक्रम्य तदा वीरः प्रध्यातुमुपचक्रमे।
transliteration: tāmapaśyankapistatra paśyañścānyā parastriyaḥ apakramya tadā vīraḥ pradhyātumupacakrame|
translation: वीरः hero, कपिः vanara, तत्र there, ताम् her, अपश्यन् not able to see, अन्याः others, परस्त्रियः the wives of others, पश्यञ्श्च and while seeing, तदा then, अपक्रम्य having moved aside, प्रध्यातुम् to contemplate, उपचक्रमे started.
explanation: Heroic Hanuman, unable to find Sita among the women, moved aside and started thinking.

shloka_text: स भूयस्तु परं श्रीमान् मारुतिर्यत्नमास्थितः।।5.11.47।। आपानभूमिमुत्सृज्य तद्विचेतुं प्रचक्रमे।
transliteration: sa bhūyastu paraṃ śrīmān mārutiryatnamāsthitaḥ āpānabhūmimutsṛjya tadvicetuṃ pracakrame|
translation: श्रीमान् Illustrious, सः मारुतिः Maruti, भूयः once again, परम् great, यत्नम् effort, आस्थितः made, आपानभूमिम् banquet hall, उत्सृज्य leaving, तत् that, विचेतुम् to search, प्रचक्रमे departed.
explanation: Illustrious Hanuman left the banquet hall to renew his effort in search of Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकादशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स तस्य मध्ये भवनस्य मारुति र्लतागृहांश्चित्रगृहान्निशागृहान्। जगाम सीतां प्रति दर्शनोत्सुको न चैव तां पश्यति चारुदर्शनाम्।।5.12.1।।
transliteration: sa tasya madhye bhavanasya māruti rlatāgṛhāṃścitragṛhānniśāgṛhān| jagāma sītāṃ prati darśanotsuko na caiva tāṃ paśyati cārudarśanām
translation: सः मारुतिः Maruti, तस्य of that, भवनस्य mansion's, मध्ये midst, सीतां प्रति towards Sita, दर्शनोत्सुकः with eagerness to find, लतागृहान् homes of creepers, चित्रगृहान् picture galleries, निशागृहान् dormitories for rest at night, जगाम went, चारुदर्शनाम् beautiful lady, ताम् that Sita, न चैव पश्यति did not find her.
explanation: Anxious to find Sita, Hanuman revisited the bowers of creepers, picture galleries and domitories located in the midst of the mansion, but  did not find that beautiful Sita.
comments: Hanuman makes a thorough search of Ravana's palace for Sita.

shloka_text: स चिन्तयामास ततो महाकपिः प्रियामपश्यन्रघुनन्दनस्य ताम्। ध्रुवं हि सीता म्रियते यथा न मे विचिन्वतो दर्शनमेति मैथिली।।5.12.2।।
transliteration: sa cintayāmāsa tato mahākapiḥ priyāmapaśyanraghunandanasya tām| dhruvaṃ hi sītā mriyate yathā na me vicinvato darśanameti maithilī
translation: ततः then, सः महाकपिः that great monkey, रघुनन्दनस्य Rama's, प्रियाम् beloved, ताम् her, अपश्यन् while being unable to find, चिन्तयामास started thinking, मैथिली Mythili, विचिन्वतः while searching, मे to me, यथा as, दर्शनम् her sight, न उपैति not appears, सीता Sita, ध्रुवम् surely, म्रियते dead.
explanation: The great monkey, unable to find the beloved of Rama thought Sita might not be surviving. So he started thinking, ' I could not see her even though I have searched all over'.

shloka_text: सा राक्षसानां प्रवरेण जानकी स्वशीलसंरक्ष्णतत्परा सती। अनेन नूनं प्रति दुष्टकर्मणा हता भवेदार्यपथे परे स्थिता।।5.12.3।।
transliteration: sā rākṣasānāṃ pravareṇa jānakī svaśīlasaṃrakṣṇatatparā satī| anena nūnaṃ prati duṣṭakarmaṇā hatā bhavedāryapathe pare sthitā
translation: परे best, आर्यपथे on a noble path, स्थिता follower, सा जानकी Janaki,              स्वशीलसंरक्षणतत्परा सती who wishes to protect her chastity, प्रति दुष्टकर्मणा by this evil mind, अनेन by him, राक्षसानां प्रवरेण by the demon king, हता slayed, भवेत् is, नूनम् surely.
explanation: 'Janaki, follower of noble path, anxious to protect her chastity must have been killed by the wicked demon king.

shloka_text: विरूपरूपा विकृता विवर्चसो महानना दीर्घविरूपदर्शनाः। समीक्ष्य सा राक्षसराजयोषितो भयाद्विनष्टा जनकेश्वरात्मजा।।5.12.4।।
transliteration: virūparūpā vikṛtā vivarcaso mahānanā dīrghavirūpadarśanāḥ| samīkṣya sā rākṣasarājayoṣito bhayādvinaṣṭā janakeśvarātmajā
translation: सा that, जनकेश्वरात्मजा daughter of king Janaka, विरूपरूपाः distorted forms, विकृताः ugly, विवर्चसः dull, महाननाः women with huge faces, दीर्घविरूपदर्शनाः tall and deformed, राक्षसराजयोषितः wives of the demon king, समीक्ष्य on looking, भयात् out of fear, विनष्टा died.
explanation: 'The daughter of Janaka might have collapsed out of fear, looking at the distorted faces of ugly, tall and monstrous demon maids of Ravana.

shloka_text: सीतामदृष्ट्वा ह्यनवाप्य पौरुषं विहृत्य कालं सह वानरैश्चिरम्। न मेऽस्ति सुग्रीवसमीपगा गतिः सुतीक्ष्णदण्डो बलवांश्च वानरः।।5.12.5।।
transliteration: sītāmadṛṣṭvā hyanavāpya pauruṣaṃ vihṛtya kālaṃ saha vānaraiściram| na me'sti sugrīvasamīpagā gatiḥ sutīkṣṇadaṇḍo balavāṃśca vānaraḥ
translation: सीताम् Sita, अदृष्ट्वा without seeing, पौरुषम् pride of achievement, अनवाप्य without achieving, वानरैः सह accompanied by vanaras, चिरं कालम् for a long time, विहृत्य having passed time, मे to myself, सुग्रीवसमीपगा to approach Sugriva, गतिः way, नास्ति not possible, वानरः vanara, सुतीक्ष्णदण्डः  will punish severely, बलवांश्च powerful.
explanation: 'I have spent a long time with vanaras. I have not  succeded in my efforts to find Sita. I dare not see Sugriva now without finding Sita and without fulfilling my task. Sugriva will punish me severely. There is no way out.'

shloka_text: दृष्टमन्तःपुरं सर्वं दृष्टा रावणयोषितः। न सीता दृश्यते साध्वीवृथा जातो मम श्रमः।।5.12.6।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭamantaḥpuraṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭā rāvaṇayoṣitaḥ| na sītā dṛśyate sādhvīvṛthā jāto mama śramaḥ
translation: सर्वम् everywhere, अन्तःपुरम् the harem, दृष्टम् seen, रावणयोषितः Ravana's women, दृष्टाः are seen, साध्वी noble lady, सीता Sita, न दृश्यते is not seen, मम my, श्रमः efforts, वृथा wasted, जातः gone.
explanation: 'I have searched all over the harem. Ravana's women have been seen. (Yet) I have not been able to see noble Sita. My efforts have been wasted'.

shloka_text: किं नु मां वानराः सर्वे गतं वक्ष्यन्ति सङ्गताः। गत्वा तत्र त्वया वीर किं कृतं तद्वदस्व नः।।5.12.7।।
transliteration: kiṃ nu māṃ vānarāḥ sarve gataṃ vakṣyanti saṅgatāḥ| gatvā tatra tvayā vīra kiṃ kṛtaṃ tadvadasva naḥ
translation: गतम् when I reach, माम् me, सङ्गताः together, सर्वे all, वानराः vanaras, किं नु what indeed, वक्ष्यन्ति they will speak, वीर O hero, तत्र there, गत्वा after going, त्वया by you, किम् what, कृतम् is done, तत् that, नः for us, वदस्व you will say.
explanation: 'What will the vanaras say when I return? What should I speak when they ask me: O hero, what did you accomplish there?'

shloka_text: अदृष्ट्वा किं प्रवक्ष्यामि तामहं जनकात्मजाम्। ध्रुवं प्रायमुपैष्यन्ति कालस्य व्यतिवर्तने।।5.12.8।।
transliteration: adṛṣṭvā kiṃ pravakṣyāmi tāmahaṃ janakātmajām| dhruvaṃ prāyamupaiṣyanti kālasya vyativartane
translation: ताम् her, जनकात्मजाम् Janaki, अदृष्टवा without seeing, किम् what, प्रवक्ष्यामि l am going to say, कालस्य for a long time, व्यतिवर्तने exceeded time limit, ध्रुवम् surely, प्रायम् उपैष्यन्ति they will sit down and wait until death.
explanation: 'Since the time limit has exceeded and Janaki is not spotted, surely the vanaras would sit and wait unto death. What am I going to say'?

shloka_text: किं वा वक्ष्यति वृद्धश्च जाम्बवानाङ्गदश्च सः। गतं पारं समुद्रस्य वानराश्च समागताः।।5.12.9।।
transliteration: kiṃ vā vakṣyati vṛddhaśca jāmbavānāṅgadaśca saḥ| gataṃ pāraṃ samudrasya vānarāśca samāgatāḥ
translation: समुद्रस्य ocean's, पारम् other shore, गतम् on going, वृद्धः elderly, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, किं वा why or else, वक्ष्यति will say, सः he, अङ्गद: च Angada also, समागताः collecting together, वानराश्च and vanaras.
explanation: 'What will the elderly Jambavan say? What will young prince Angada and other vanaras collected there say when I reach the seashore to meet them'.

shloka_text: अनिर्वेदः श्रियो मूलमनिर्वेदः परं सुखम्। अनिर्वेदो हि सततं सर्वार्थेषु प्रवर्तकः।।5.12.10।।
transliteration: anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlamanirvedaḥ paraṃ sukham| anirvedo hi satataṃ sarvārtheṣu pravartakaḥ
translation: अनिर्वेदः being free from despair, श्रियः prosperity, मूलम् cause, अनिर्वेदः being free from despondency, परम् supreme, सुखम् happiness, अनिर्वेदः being free from despair, सततम् always, सर्वार्थेषु in all objectives, प्रवर्तकः हि will lead the way.
explanation: Wise Hanuman once again declared, 'being free from despair is the root cause of prosperity. Freedom from despondency gives supreme happiness and leads to success'.

shloka_text: करोति सफलं जन्तोः कर्म यत्तत्करोति सः। तस्मादनिर्वेदकृतं यत्नं चेष्टेऽहमुत्तमम्।।5.12.11।। भूयस्तावद्विचेष्यामि देशान्रावणपालितान्।
transliteration: karoti saphalaṃ jantoḥ karma yattatkaroti saḥ| tasmādanirvedakṛtaṃ yatnaṃ ceṣṭe'hamuttamam bhūyastāvadviceṣyāmi deśānrāvaṇapālitān|
translation: यत् that, कर्म action, करोति that he will do, जन्तोः of a living being, तत् that, सफलम् fruitful, सः he, करोति will do, तस्मात् therefore, अहम् I, अनिर्वेदकृतम् without experiencing despair, उत्तमम् best, प्रयत्नम् effort, चेष्टे I act, अदृष्टान् not seen, रावणपालितान् ruled by Ravana, देशान् country, विचेष्यामि तावत् search everywhere.
explanation: 'The action of a living being certainly bears fruit. Therefore, I shall put forth my best effort without feeling despondent. I will once again search everywhere in Lanka ruled  by Ravana'.

shloka_text: आपानशाला विचितास्तथा पुष्पगृहाणि च।।5.12.12।। चित्रशालाश्च विचिता भूयः क्रीडागृहाणि च। निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च विमानानि च सर्वशः।।5.12.13।।
transliteration: āpānaśālā vicitāstathā puṣpagṛhāṇi ca citraśālāśca vicitā bhūyaḥ krīḍāgṛhāṇi ca| niṣkuṭāntararathyāśca vimānāni ca sarvaśaḥ
translation: पानशालाः banquet halls, विचिताः searched, तथा so also, पुष्पगृहाणि च bowers of creepers, चित्रशालाश्च picture galleries, विचिताः searched, भूयः further, क्रीडागृहाणि च and sports galleries, निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च paths through the gardens and mansions, female apartments, विमानानि च of the chariot, सर्वशः everywhere.
explanation: 'I have searched the banquet halls, bowers of creepers, picture galleries and gymnasiums. I have searched everywhere through the paths of gardens and mansions, harems and the Pushpaka chariot also.

shloka_text: आपानशाला विचितास्तथा पुष्पगृहाणि च।।5.12.12।। चित्रशालाश्च विचिता भूयः क्रीडागृहाणि च। निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च विमानानि च सर्वशः।।5.12.13।।
transliteration: āpānaśālā vicitāstathā puṣpagṛhāṇi ca citraśālāśca vicitā bhūyaḥ krīḍāgṛhāṇi ca| niṣkuṭāntararathyāśca vimānāni ca sarvaśaḥ
translation: पानशालाः banquet halls, विचिताः searched, तथा so also, पुष्पगृहाणि च bowers of creepers, चित्रशालाश्च picture galleries, विचिताः searched, भूयः further, क्रीडागृहाणि च and sports galleries, निष्कुटान्तररथ्याश्च paths through the gardens and mansions, female apartments, विमानानि च of the chariot, सर्वशः everywhere.
explanation: 'I have searched the banquet halls, bowers of creepers, picture galleries and gymnasiums. I have searched everywhere through the paths of gardens and mansions, harems and the Pushpaka chariot also.

shloka_text: इति सञ्चिन्त्य भूयोऽपि विचेतुमुपचक्रमे। भूमीगृहांश्चैत्यगृहान् गृहातिगृहकानपि।।5.12.14।।
transliteration: iti sañcintya bhūyo'pi vicetumupacakrame| bhūmīgṛhāṃścaityagṛhān gṛhātigṛhakānapi
translation: इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking over well, भूमीगृहान् underground cells, चैत्यगृहान् temples, गृहातिगृहकानपि homes with many doorways also, भूयोऽपि once again, विचेतुम् to search, उपचक्रमे he started.
explanation: Thinking thus, he started searching once again the basement cells, temples, homes within homes.

shloka_text: उत्पतन्निष्पतंश्चापि तिष्ठन्गच्छन् पुनः पुनः। अपावृण्वंश्च द्वाराणि कवाटान्यवघाटयन्।।5.12.15।। प्रविशन्निष्पतंश्चापि प्रपतन्नुत्पतन्नपि। सर्वमप्यवकाशं स विचचार महाकपिः।।5.12.16।।
transliteration: utpatanniṣpataṃścāpi tiṣṭhangacchan punaḥ punaḥ| apāvṛṇvaṃśca dvārāṇi kavāṭānyavaghāṭayan praviśanniṣpataṃścāpi prapatannutpatannapi| sarvamapyavakāśaṃ sa vicacāra mahākapiḥ
translation: सः महाकपिः that great vanara, पुनः पुनः again and again, उत्पतन् jumping, निष्पतंश्चापि climbing down, तिष्ठन्  standing, गच्छन् going, द्वाराणि entrance, अपावृण्वन् opening, कवाटानि doors, अवघाटयन् crossing, प्रविशन् entering, निष्पतंश्चापि and coming out, प्रपतन् jumping down, उत्पतन्नपि climbing up, सर्वम् अपि and all over, अवकाशम् scope, विचचार searched.
explanation: The great vanara searched all over again and again jumping up and down, stopping for a while and moving, opening and closing doors, by crossing, entering and exiting, jumping up and down. Thus he moved about and searched whereever there was scope to search

shloka_text: उत्पतन्निष्पतंश्चापि तिष्ठन्गच्छन् पुनः पुनः। अपावृण्वंश्च द्वाराणि कवाटान्यवघाटयन्।।5.12.15।। प्रविशन्निष्पतंश्चापि प्रपतन्नुत्पतन्नपि। सर्वमप्यवकाशं स विचचार महाकपिः।।5.12.16।।
transliteration: utpatanniṣpataṃścāpi tiṣṭhangacchan punaḥ punaḥ| apāvṛṇvaṃśca dvārāṇi kavāṭānyavaghāṭayan praviśanniṣpataṃścāpi prapatannutpatannapi| sarvamapyavakāśaṃ sa vicacāra mahākapiḥ
translation: सः महाकपिः that great vanara, पुनः पुनः again and again, उत्पतन् jumping, निष्पतंश्चापि climbing down, तिष्ठन्  standing, गच्छन् going, द्वाराणि entrance, अपावृण्वन् opening, कवाटानि doors, अवघाटयन् crossing, प्रविशन् entering, निष्पतंश्चापि and coming out, प्रपतन् jumping down, उत्पतन्नपि climbing up, सर्वम् अपि and all over, अवकाशम् scope, विचचार searched.
explanation: The great vanara searched all over again and again jumping up and down, stopping for a while and moving, opening and closing doors, by crossing, entering and exiting, jumping up and down. Thus he moved about and searched whereever there was scope to search

shloka_text: चतुरङ्गुलमात्रोऽपि नावकाशः स विद्यते। रावणान्तःपुरे तस्मिन् यं कपिर्न जगाम सः।।5.12.17।।
transliteration: caturaṅgulamātro'pi nāvakāśaḥ sa vidyate| rāvaṇāntaḥpure tasmin yaṃ kapirna jagāma saḥ
translation: तस्मिन् in that, रावणान्तःपुरे in Ravana's inner chambers, सः कपिः monkey, यम् where, न जगाम did not go, सः he, अवकाशः scope, चतुरङ्गुलमात्रोऽपि even four fingers of space, न not विद्यते leaving.
explanation: Even a space of four fingers in the inner chambers of Ravana was not left out in his search for Sita.
