transliteration: anidrassatataṃ rāmassupto'pi ca narottamaḥ| sīteti madhurāṃ vāṇīṃ vyāharanpratibudhyate
translation: रामः Rama, सततम् always, अनिद्रः he does not sleep, नरोत्तमः best of men, सुप्तोऽपि even if he sleeps, सीतेति calling out 'Sita', मधुराम् sweet, वाणीम् voice, व्याहरन् uttering, प्रतिबुध्यते he wakes up.
explanation: "Rama, the best of men never goes to sleep and even if he drops off to sleep he mutters 'Sita, Sita' in a sweet voice in his sleep.

shloka_text: दृष्ट्वा फलं वा पुष्पं वा यद्वाऽन्यत्सुमनोहरम्। बहुशो हा प्रियेत्येवं श्वसंस्त्वामभिभाषते।।5.36.45।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭvā phalaṃ vā puṣpaṃ vā yadvā'nyatsumanoharam| bahuśo hā priyetyevaṃ śvasaṃstvāmabhibhāṣate
translation: फलं वा fruit or, पुष्पं वा or flowers, यद्वा such similar, सुमनोहरम् delightful, अन्यत् any other thing, दृष्ट्वा seeing, श्वसन् while, हा प्रियेत्येवम् alas, darling, त्वाम् you, बहुशः in many, अभिभाषते speaks.
explanation: "Sighing deeply whenever Rama sees a fruit or a flower or any such delightful thing, he remembers you and calls you out again and again, saying, 'alas, my darling '

shloka_text: स देवि नित्यं परितप्यमान स्त्वामेव सीतेत्यभिभाषमाणः। धृतव्रतो राजसुतो महात्मा तवैव लाभाय कृतप्रयत्नः।।5.36.46।।
transliteration: sa devi nityaṃ paritapyamāna stvāmeva sītetyabhibhāṣamāṇaḥ| dhṛtavrato rājasuto mahātmā tavaiva lābhāya kṛtaprayatnaḥ
translation: देवि godlike lady, महात्मा great self, सः Rama, राजसुतः son of a king, नित्यम् always, परितप्यमानः suffering, सीतेति saying Sita, त्वामेव you only, अभिभाषमाणः keeps talking in the air, धृतव्रतः firm in his decision, तव your, लाभाय to secure you only, कृतप्रयत्नः makes efforts.
explanation: "O divine lady prince Rama is ceaselessly suffering. He keeps talking to you in air. The determined Rama is only thinking of your recovery ".

shloka_text: सा रामसङ्कीर्तनवीतशोका रामस्य शोकेन समानशोका। शरन्मुखे साम्बुदशेषचन्द्रा निशेव वैदेहसुता बभूव।।5.36.47।।
transliteration: sā rāmasaṅkīrtanavītaśokā rāmasya śokena samānaśokā| śaranmukhe sāmbudaśeṣacandrā niśeva vaidehasutā babhūva
translation: रामस्य Rama's, शोकेन because of  his sorrow, समानशोका equally sad, रामसङ्कीर्तनवीतशोका devoid of sorrow on hearing about Rama, सा she, वैदेहसुता the daughter of Videha, शरन्मुखे at the advent of autumn, साम्बुदशेषचन्द्रा Moon muffled by clouds, निशेव like the night, बभूव appeared.
explanation: Her sorrow was mitigated by references made by Hanuman about Rama.She felt equally sad when she heard about Rama's agony. The princess from Videha appeared like a night at the advent of autumn, with the Moon looking partly muffled by clouds and partly bright. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सीता तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना। हनूमन्तमुवाचेदं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः।।5.37.1।।
transliteration: sītā tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pūrṇacandranibhānanā| hanūmantamuvācedaṃ dharmārthasahitaṃ vacaḥ
translation: पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना face like the full moon, सीता Sita, तद्वचनम् that word, श्रुत्वा having heard, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, इदम् this, धर्मार्थसहितम् full of righteousness, वचः word, उवाच spoke.
explanation: To the righteous words (about Rama's grief) of Hanuman, Sita with a face like the full moon replied.
comments: Hanuman offers to carry Sita back to RamaSita politely Sita declines -- appeals to Hanuman to get Rama to take her.

shloka_text: अमृतं विषसंसृष्टं त्वया वानर भाषितम्। यच्च नान्यमना रामो यच्च शोकपरायणः ।।5.37.2।।
transliteration: amṛtaṃ viṣasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vānara bhāṣitam| yacca nānyamanā rāmo yacca śokaparāyaṇaḥ
translation: वानर O vanara, रामः Rama, अन्यमनाः न not thinking of others,  इति यत् that way, इति च यत् and this way also (that he is sad), त्वया by you, भाषितम् spoken, विषसंसृष्टम् mixed with poison, अमृतम् nectar.
explanation: "O vanara you have told me that Rama has his mind always fixed on me, not on others and you have also said that he is sad. It is like offering me poison mixed with nectar.

shloka_text: ऐश्वर्ये वा सुविस्तीर्णे व्यसने वा सुदारुणे। रज्ज्वेव पुरुषं बद्ध्वा कृतान्तः परिकर्षति।।5.37.3।।
transliteration: aiśvarye vā suvistīrṇe vyasane vā sudāruṇe| rajjveva puruṣaṃ baddhvā kṛtāntaḥ parikarṣati
translation: कृतान्तः death, पुरुषम् a man, रज्ज्वा with a cord, बद्ध्वा इव like tying, सुविस्त्रीर्णे in the great, ऐश्वर्ये वा in fortune, सुदारुणे deeply sunk, व्यसने वा  in adversity, परिकर्षति will snatch.
explanation: "Death snatches a man tied with a cord, whether he is rolling in luxury or sinking in adversity.

shloka_text: विधिर्नूनमसंहार्यः प्राणिनां प्लवगोत्तम। सौमित्रिं मां च रामं च व्यसनै: पश्य मोहितान्।।5.37.4।।
transliteration: vidhirnūnamasaṃhāryaḥ prāṇināṃ plavagottama| saumitriṃ māṃ ca rāmaṃ ca vyasanai: paśya mohitān
translation: प्लवगोत्तम O best of vanaras, प्राणिनाम् for living beings, नूनम् surely, विधिः destiny, असंहार्यः it cannot be overcome, व्यसनैः with sorrows, मोहितान् afflicted, सौमित्रिम् Saumitri, मां च me too, रामं च Rama also, पश्य you see.
explanation: "O best of vanaras surely it is not possible for living beings to overcome destiny. You see how Sri Rama, Saumitri, and my own self are all   afflicted with grief.

shloka_text: शोकस्यास्य कदा पारं राघवोऽधिगमिष्यति। प्लवमानः परिश्रान्तो हतनौ स्सागरे यथा।।5.37.5।।
transliteration: śokasyāsya kadā pāraṃ rāghavo'dhigamiṣyati| plavamānaḥ pariśrānto hatanau ssāgare yathā
translation: सागरे in the ocean, हतनौः in shipwreck, प्लवमानः while getting drowned, परिश्रान्तः यथा  who has suffered, राघवः Rama, अस्य of this, शोकस्य from grief, पारम् the shore, कदा when, अधिगमिष्यति will he reach.
explanation: "When will Raghava reach the shore of this ocean of grief? He is like a man who has suffered a ship wreck, trying to swim?

shloka_text: राक्षसानां वधं कृत्वा सूदयित्वा च रावणम्। लङ्कामुन्मूलितां कृत्वा कदा द्रक्ष्यति मां पतिः।।5.37.6।।
transliteration: rākṣasānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā sūdayitvā ca rāvaṇam| laṅkāmunmūlitāṃ kṛtvā kadā drakṣyati māṃ patiḥ
translation: पतिः husband, राक्षसानाम् of all the demons, वधम् killing, कृत्वा after doing, रावणं च and Ravana, सूदयित्वा after killing, लङ्काम् Lanka, उन्मूलिताम् uprooting, कृत्वा after doing, माम् कदा when me, द्रक्ष्यति he will see.
explanation: "When will my husband see me after killing the demons including Ravana and uprooting Lanka?

shloka_text: स वाच्यस्संत्वरस्वेति यावदेव न पूर्यते। अयं संवत्सरः कालस्तावद्धि मम जीवितम्।।5.37.7।।
transliteration: sa vācyassaṃtvarasveti yāvadeva na pūryate| ayaṃ saṃvatsaraḥ kālastāvaddhi mama jīvitam
translation: अयम् this, संवत्सरः कालः one year's time, यावदेव until then, न पूर्यते before it is completed, संत्वरस्वेति you may be quick, सः he, वाच्यः he should be informed, मम I, जीवितम् life, तावद्धि till then only.
explanation: "One year's time has been given (by Ravana) to me.  Rama should be informed to be quick in reaching before the completion of the time limit and that I will survive till then only.

shloka_text: वर्तते दशमो मासो द्वौ तु शेषौ प्लवङ्गम। रावणेन नृशंसेन समयो यः कृतो मम।।5.37.8।।
transliteration: vartate daśamo māso dvau tu śeṣau plavaṅgama| rāvaṇena nṛśaṃsena samayo yaḥ kṛto mama
translation: प्लवङ्गम O vanara, नृशंसेन रावणेन by the wicked Ravana, मम to me, यः such, समयः time, कृतः given, दशमः tenth, मासः month, वर्तते is running, द्वौ तु two only, शेषौ remain.
explanation: "O vanara this is the end of the tenth month. Only two more months are left. This is the condition laid by the wicked Ravana in my case.

shloka_text: विभीषणेन च भ्रात्रा मम निर्यातनं प्रति। अनुनीतः प्रयत्नेन न च तत्कुरुते मतिम्।।5.37.9।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇena ca bhrātrā mama niryātanaṃ prati| anunītaḥ prayatnena na ca tatkurute matim
translation: भ्रात्रा by the brother, विभीषणेन by Vibhisana, मम my, निर्यातनं प्रति for my restoration, प्रयत्नेन made efforts, अनुनीतः he was advised gently, तत् such, मतिम् thought, न कुरुते he has not agreed.
explanation: "Vibhisana made efforts to advise Ravana for my restoration. But Ravana has not agreed to that.

shloka_text: मम प्रतिप्रदानं हि रावणस्य न रोचते। रावणं मार्गते संख्ये मृत्युः कालवशं गतम्।।5.37.10।।
transliteration: mama pratipradānaṃ hi rāvaṇasya na rocate| rāvaṇaṃ mārgate saṃkhye mṛtyuḥ kālavaśaṃ gatam
translation: मम my, प्रतिप्रदानम् returning, रावणस्य to Ravana, न रोचते is not liked, कालवशं गतम् fallen into the trap of time, रावणम् Ravana, संख्ये in a battle, मृत्युः death, मार्गते  is searching.
explanation: "Ravana did not like to return me having fallen into the death trap. Death lies in wait for him in battle.

shloka_text: ज्येष्ठा कन्या नला नाम विभीषणसुता कपे। तया ममेदमाख्यातं मात्रा प्रहितया स्वयम्।।5.37.11।।
transliteration: jyeṣṭhā kanyā nalā nāma vibhīṣaṇasutā kape| tayā mamedamākhyātaṃ mātrā prahitayā svayam
translation: कपे O vanara, नला Nala, ज्येष्ठा eldest daughter, विभीषणसुता daughter of Vibhisana, मात्रा प्रहितया sent by her mother, तया by her, स्वयम् personally, इदम् here, मम to me, आख्यातम् reported.
explanation: "O vanara Nala the eldest daughter of Vibhisana sent by her mother came here personally and reported this to me.

shloka_text: असंशयं हरिश्रेष्ठ क्षिप्रं मां प्राप्स्यते पतिः। अन्तरात्मा च मे शुद्धस्तस्मिंश्च बहवो गुणाः।।5.37.12।।
transliteration: asaṃśayaṃ hariśreṣṭha kṣipraṃ māṃ prāpsyate patiḥ| antarātmā ca me śuddhastasmiṃśca bahavo guṇāḥ
translation: हरिश्रेष्ठ O eminent vanara, पतिः my lord, क्षिप्रम् soon, माम् me, असंशयम् no doubt, प्राप्स्यति he will reach, मे my, अन्तरात्मा च inner self also, शुद्धः pure, तस्मिंश्च in that, बहवः many, गुणाः are virtues.
explanation: "O eminent vanara no doubt my lord will soon reach this place. My pure conscience tells me that Rama has many virtues.

shloka_text: उत्साहः पौरुषं सत्त्वमानृशंस्यं कृतज्ञता। विक्रमश्च प्रभावश्च सन्ति वानर राघवे।।5.37.13।।
transliteration: utsāhaḥ pauruṣaṃ sattvamānṛśaṃsyaṃ kṛtajñatā| vikramaśca prabhāvaśca santi vānara rāghave
translation: वानरvanara, राघवे in Rama, उत्साहः perseverance, पौरुषम् manliness, सत्त्वम् prowess, अनृशंस्यम् kindness, कृतज्ञता gratitude, विक्रमश्च competence, प्रभावश्च power, सन्ति endowed.
explanation: "O vanara Rama is endowed with perseverance, manliness, prowess, kindness, gratitude, competence and power.

shloka_text: चतुर्दशसहस्राणि राक्षसानां जघान यः। जनस्थाने विना भ्रात्रा शत्रुः कस्तस्य नोद्विजेत् ।।5.37.14।।
transliteration: caturdaśasahasrāṇi rākṣasānāṃ jaghāna yaḥ| janasthāne vinā bhrātrā śatruḥ kastasya nodvijet
translation: यः whoever, जनस्थाने in Janasthana, विना भ्रात्रा without his brother also, राक्षसानाम् demons, चतुर्दशसहस्राणि fourteen thousand, जघान slew, तस्य his, कः who, शत्रुः enemy, नोद्विजेत् will not tremble.
explanation: "At Janasthana without the help of his brother also he slew fourteen thousand demons. Which enemy will not tremble before him?

shloka_text: न स शक्यस्तुलयितुं व्यसनैः पुरुषर्षभः। अहं तस्य प्रभावज्ञा शक्रस्येव पुलोमजा ।।5.37.15।।
transliteration: na sa śakyastulayituṃ vyasanaiḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ| ahaṃ tasya prabhāvajñā śakrasyeva pulomajā
translation: पुरुषर्षभः bull among men, सः he, व्यसनैः in calamities, तुलयितुम् shaken, न शक्यः not possible, पुलोमजा daughter of Puloma, शक्रस्येव just as Indra, अहम् I, तस्य his, प्रभावज्ञा know his might.
explanation: "O bull among men he will not be shaken by calamities. Just as Sachi, the daughter of Puloma knows Indra's might I know Rama's.

shloka_text: शरजालांशुमान्शूरः कपे रामदिवाकरः। शत्रुरक्षोमयं तोयमुपशोषं नयिष्यति।।5.37.16।।
transliteration: śarajālāṃśumānśūraḥ kape rāmadivākaraḥ| śatrurakṣomayaṃ toyamupaśoṣaṃ nayiṣyati
translation: कपे O monkey, शूरः valiant, रामदिवाकर: Rama the Sun, शरजालांशुमान् with his volley of dazzling arrows, शत्रुरक्षोमयम् enemy forces of the demons, तोयम् water, उपशोषम् will dry up, नयिष्यति will effect.
explanation: "O monkey the valiant Rama is like the Sungod shoofing a dazzling volley of arrows which will dry up the sea of enemy forces."

shloka_text: इति सञ्जल्पमानां तां रामार्थे शोककर्शिताम्। आश्रुसम्पूर्णनयनामुवाच वचनं कपिः।।5.37.17।।
transliteration: iti sañjalpamānāṃ tāṃ rāmārthe śokakarśitām| āśrusampūrṇanayanāmuvāca vacanaṃ kapiḥ
translation: इति thus, सञ्जल्पमानाम् while she was speaking freely, रामार्थे on account of Rama, शोककर्शिताम् emaciated with sorrow, अश्रु सम्पूर्णनयनाम् her eyes filled with tears, ताम् her, कपिः vanara, वचनम् word, उवाच spoke.
explanation: While Sita, tormented with grief on account of Rama was thus speaking, her eyes filled with tears, the monkey said:

shloka_text: श्रुत्वैव तु वचो मह्यं क्षिप्रमेष्यति राघवः। चमूं प्रकर्षन्महतीं हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम्।।5.37.18।।
transliteration: śrutvaiva tu vaco mahyaṃ kṣiprameṣyati rāghavaḥ| camūṃ prakarṣanmahatīṃ haryṛkṣagaṇasaṅkulām
translation: राघवः Rama, श्रुत्वैव तु after hearing this, वचः word, मह्यं by me, क्षिप्रम् soon, ऐष्यति he will reach, चमूं an army, प्रकर्षन् while leading, महतीं huge, हर्यृक्षगणसङ्कुलाम् with an army of vanaras and bears.
explanation: "On hearing me Rama will reach soon with a huge army of vanaras and bears.

shloka_text: अथवा मोचयिष्यामि त्वामद्यैव वरानने। अस्माद्धुःखादुपारोह मम पृष्ठमनिन्दिते।।5.37.19।।
transliteration: athavā mocayiṣyāmi tvāmadyaiva varānane| asmāddhuḥkhādupāroha mama pṛṣṭhamanindite
translation: अथवा or, वरानने O lady with a beautiful face, त्वाम् you, अद्यैव now itself, अस्मात् from this, दुःखात् from grief, मोचयिष्यामि I shall redeem you, अनिन्दिते O blameles one, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, उपारोह you may  ascend.
explanation: "O beautiful lady, if you please, I shall redeem you today itself from grief. You may ride on my back, O blameless lady.

shloka_text: त्वां हि पृष्ठगतां कृत्वा सन्तरिष्यामि सागरम्। शक्तिरस्ति हि मे वोढुं लङ्कामपि सरावणाम् ।।5.37.20।।
transliteration: tvāṃ hi pṛṣṭhagatāṃ kṛtvā santariṣyāmi sāgaram| śaktirasti hi me voḍhuṃ laṅkāmapi sarāvaṇām
translation: त्वाम् you, पृष्ठगताम् placing you on my back, कृत्वा on doing so, सागरम् ocean, सन्तरिष्यामि I can cross over, सरावणाम् along with Ravana, लङ्कामपि even Lanka, वोढुम् to carry, मे to me, शक्ति capacity, अस्ति हि indeed I have.
explanation: "Placing you on my back I shall cross the ocean. Indeed, I have the capacity to carry the entire city of Lanka along with Ravana.

shloka_text: अहं प्रस्रवणस्थाय राघवायाद्य मैथिलि। प्रापयिष्यामि शक्राय हव्यं हुतमिवानलः।।5.37.21।।
transliteration: ahaṃ prasravaṇasthāya rāghavāyādya maithili| prāpayiṣyāmi śakrāya havyaṃ hutamivānalaḥ
translation: मैथिलि O Mythili, अनलः sacred fire, हुतम्  put into fire, हव्यम् oblations, शक्राय by Indra, अहम् I, प्रस्रवणस्थाय to a person staying on Prasravan mountain, राघवाय to Rama, अद्यैव प्रापयिष्यामि I will take you today itself.
explanation: "O Mythili Just as oblations offered to the sacred fire goes to Indra, I shall offer you today to Rama waiting on the Prasravana mountain.

shloka_text: द्रक्ष्यस्यद्वैव वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्। व्यवसायसमायुक्तं विष्णुं दैत्यवधे यथा।।5.37.22।।
transliteration: drakṣyasyadvaiva vaidehi rāghavaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam| vyavasāyasamāyuktaṃ viṣṇuṃ daityavadhe yathā
translation: वैदेहि Vaidehi, दैत्यवधे in the killing of demons, व्यवसायसमायुक्तम् making all out efforts, विष्णुं यथा like Visnu, सहलक्ष्मणम् together with Lakshmana, राघवम् Rama, अद्यैव right now, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: "O Vaidehi you will see Rama and Lakshmana making all out efforts like Lord Visnu to kill the demons.

shloka_text: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहमाश्रमस्थं महाबलम्। पुरन्दरमिवासीनं नागराजस्य मूर्धनि।।5.37.23।।
transliteration: tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhamāśramasthaṃ mahābalam| purandaramivāsīnaṃ nāgarājasya mūrdhani
translation: त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहम् enthused in seeing you, आश्रमस्थम् staying in his asram, महाबलम् mighty, नागराजस्य of the king of elephants Airavatam, मूर्धनि on the back, आसीनम् seated, पुरन्दरमिव like the destroyer of citadels (Indra).
explanation: Mighty Rama staying in asram ill be enthused to see you seated on my back like Lord Purandara (Indra) seated on the back of the lord of elephants (Airavata)

shloka_text: पृष्ठमारोह मे देवि मा विकाङ्क्षस्व शोभने। योगमन्विच्छ रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी।।5.37.24।।
transliteration: pṛṣṭhamāroha me devi mā vikāṅkṣasva śobhane| yogamanviccha rāmeṇa śaśāṅkeneva rohiṇī
translation: देवि O god like lady, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, आरोह climb up, शोभने O beautiful one, मा विकाङ्क्षस्व do not be reluctant, रोहिणी Rohini, शशाङ्केनेव like joining with the Moon, रामेण with Rama, योगम् union, अन्विच्छ you may become.
explanation: "O god like lady climb up my back. Do not be reluctant. Join Rama just as Rohini unites with the Moon, O beautiful one

shloka_text: कथयन्तीव चन्द्रेण सूर्येण च महार्चिषा। मत्पृष्ठमधिरुह्य त्वं तराकाशमहार्णवौ।।5.37.25।।
transliteration: kathayantīva candreṇa sūryeṇa ca mahārciṣā| matpṛṣṭhamadhiruhya tvaṃ tarākāśamahārṇavau
translation: त्वम् you, मत्पृष्ठम् my back, अधिरुह्य after climbing up, चन्द्रेण with the Moon, महार्चिषा  flaming light, सूर्येण with the Sun, कथयन्तीव conversing, आकाशमहार्णवौ sky and ocean, तर cross.
explanation: "Climb on my back and cross the ocean through space in the flaming light, conversing with Moon and Sun.

shloka_text: न हि मे सम्प्रयातस्य त्वामितो नयतोऽङ्गने। अनुगन्तुं गतिं शक्तास्सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः।।5.37.26।।
transliteration: na hi me samprayātasya tvāmito nayato'ṅgane| anugantuṃ gatiṃ śaktāssarve laṅkānivāsinaḥ
translation: अङ्गने O beautiful lady, त्वाम् you, इतः from the place, नयतः while carrying, सम्प्रयातस्य joined together, मे my, गतिम् speed, अनुगन्तुम् to follow me, सर्वे all, लङ्कानिवासिनः the inhabitants of Lanka, न शक्ताः not possible for any one.
explanation: "O beautiful lady it is not possible for all the inhabitants of Lanka together to follow me while I carry you from this place.

shloka_text: यथैवाहमिह प्राप्तस्तथैवाहमसंशयः। यास्यामि पश्य वैदेहि त्वामुद्यम्य विहायसम्।।5.37.27।।
transliteration: yathaivāhamiha prāptastathaivāhamasaṃśayaḥ| yāsyāmi paśya vaidehi tvāmudyamya vihāyasam
translation: वैदेहि Vaidehi, यथैवाहमिह just as I reached here, प्राप्तस्तथैव in the same way I reached, अहम I, त्वामुद्यम्य taking you on my back, यास्यामि will go, विहायसम् across the sky, नसंशयः no doubt, पश्य you may see.
explanation: "O Vaidehi just as I reached here I shall beyond doubt take you on my back in the same way across the sky without any difficulty. See.

shloka_text: मैथिली तु हरिश्रेष्ठाच्छ्रुत्वा वचनमद्भुतम्। हर्षविस्मितसर्वाङ्गी हनुमन्तमथाब्रवीत्।।5.37.28।।
transliteration: maithilī tu hariśreṣṭhācchrutvā vacanamadbhutam| harṣavismitasarvāṅgī hanumantamathābravīt
translation: मैथिली तु Mythili also, हरिश्रेष्ठात् from the best of vanaras, अद्भुतम् wonderful, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा on hearing, हर्षविस्मितसर्वाङ्गी experienced immense joy in every limb of her body, अथ then, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: When Mythili heard the wonderful proposal from Hanuman, the best of vanaras, she experienced immense joy in every limb of her body and said:

shloka_text: हनुमन्दूरमध्वानं कथं मां वोढुमिच्छसि। तदेव खलु ते मन्ये कपित्वं हरियूथप।।5.37.29।।
transliteration: hanumandūramadhvānaṃ kathaṃ māṃ voḍhumicchasi| tadeva khalu te manye kapitvaṃ hariyūthapa
translation: हनुमन् Hanuman, दूरम् distant, अध्वानम् path, माम् me, वोढुम् carry, कथम् how, इच्छसि you intend, हरियूथप O leader of vanaras, ते you, कपित्वम् monkey nature, तदेव खलु indeed that is, मन्ये I think.
explanation: "Hanuman how do you intend to carry me to such a distant place? Indeed, it is your monkey nature, I suppose.

shloka_text: कथं वाल्पशरीरस्त्वं मामितो नेतुमिच्छसि। सकाशं मानवेन्द्रस्य भर्तुर्मे प्लवगर्षभ।।5.37.30।।
transliteration: kathaṃ vālpaśarīrastvaṃ māmito netumicchasi| sakāśaṃ mānavendrasya bharturme plavagarṣabha
translation: प्लवगर्षभ O bull among monkeys, अल्पशरीरः small body, त्वम् you, इतः from here, मे my, भर्तुः to my husband, मानवेन्द्रस्य lord of men, सकाशम् presence of, नेतुम् to carry, कथं वा how is it, इच्छसि you intend.
explanation: "O bull among monkeys you have  such a small body. How can you intend to carry me from here to my husband, the lord of men"?

shloka_text: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। चिन्तयामास लक्ष्मीवान्नवं परिभवं कृतम्।।5.37.31।।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā hanumānmārutātmajaḥ| cintayāmāsa lakṣmīvānnavaṃ paribhavaṃ kṛtam
translation: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, लक्ष्मीवान् illustrious one, हनुमान् Hanuman, सीतायाः Sita's, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा on hearing, नवम् new, परिभवम् कृतम् insult hurled, चिन्तयामास he thought.
explanation: On hearing Sita's new belittling statement about him, Hanuman, the illustrious son of the Windgod reflected:

shloka_text: न मे जानाति सत्त्वं वा प्रभावं वाऽसितेक्षणा। तस्मात्पश्यतु वैदेही यद्रूपं मम कामतः।।5.37.32।।
transliteration: na me jānāti sattvaṃ vā prabhāvaṃ vā'sitekṣaṇā| tasmātpaśyatu vaidehī yadrūpaṃ mama kāmataḥ
translation: असितेक्षणा blackeyed, वैदेही Vaidehi, मे my, सत्त्वं वा strength, प्रभावं वा my power, न जानाति she is not aware, तस्मात् therefore, कामतः freely, मम my, यत् that real, रूपम् form, पश्यतु see.
explanation: 'Blackeyed Sita is not aware of my strength or my power. Therefore let her see the real (huge) form that I can assume at my free will'.

shloka_text: इति सञ्चिन्त्य हनुमांस्तदा प्लवगसत्तमः। दर्शयामास वैदेह्यास्स्वरूपमरिमर्दनः।।5.37.33।।
transliteration: iti sañcintya hanumāṃstadā plavagasattamaḥ| darśayāmāsa vaidehyāssvarūpamarimardanaḥ
translation: प्लवगसत्तमः the noble monkey, अरिमर्दनः crusher of enemies,हनुमान् Hanuman, इति in that way, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking that way, तदा then, स्वरूपम् his real form, वैदेह्याः to Vaidehi, दर्शयामास he revealed.
explanation: Thinking thus, Hanuman, the noble monkey, crusher of enemies, started revealing his real form to Vaidehi.

shloka_text: स तस्मात्पादपाद्धीमानाप्लुत्य प्लवगर्षभः। ततो वर्धितुमारेभे सीताप्रत्ययकारणात्।।5.37.34।।
transliteration: sa tasmātpādapāddhīmānāplutya plavagarṣabhaḥ| tato vardhitumārebhe sītāpratyayakāraṇāt
translation: धीमान् wise, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, सः he, तस्मात् पादपात् from the tree, अप्लुत्य jumping down, ततः from there, सीताप्रत्ययकारणात् in order to instil confidence in Sita, वर्धितुम् to grow in size, आरेभे started.
explanation: The wise bull among monkeys, jumped down from the tree and started growing in size in order to instil confidence in Sita.

shloka_text: मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशो बभौ दीप्तानलप्रभः। अग्रतो व्यवतस्थे च सीताया वानरोत्तमः।।5.37.35।।
transliteration: merumandarasaṅkāśo babhau dīptānalaprabhaḥ| agrato vyavatasthe ca sītāyā vānarottamaḥ
translation: वानरोत्तमः foremost among vanaras, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशः like mount Meru or Mandara, दीप्तानलप्रभः glowing like blazing fire, बभौ appeared, सीतायाः Sita's, अग्रतः in front, व्यवतस्थे च and stood there.
explanation: Hanuman, the foremost of the vanaras resembling mount Meru or Mandara stood there glowing like blazing fire in front of Sita.

shloka_text: हरिः पर्वतसङ्काशस्ताम्रवक्त्रो महाबलः। वज्रदंष्ट्रनखो भीमो वैदेहीमिदमब्रवीत्।।5.37.36।।
transliteration: hariḥ parvatasaṅkāśastāmravaktro mahābalaḥ| vajradaṃṣṭranakho bhīmo vaidehīmidamabravīt
translation: पर्वतसङ्काशः resembling a mountain, ताम्रवक्त्रः one who has a red face, महाबलः very strong, वज्रदंष्ट्रनखः teeth and nails as strong as diamonds, भीम: dreadful, हरिः vanara, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Resembling a mountain in size, with a red face, with teeth and nails strong like  diamond, the vanara in dreadful form said to Vaidehi:

shloka_text: सपर्वतवनोद्देशां साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम्। लङ्कामिमां सनाथां वा नयितुं शक्तिरस्ति मे।।5.37.37।।
transliteration: saparvatavanoddeśāṃ sāṭṭaprākāratoraṇām| laṅkāmimāṃ sanāthāṃ vā nayituṃ śaktirasti me
translation: सपर्वतवनोद्देशाम् filled with mountains and gardens, साट्टप्राकारतोरणाम् forts,  ramparts and gateways, सनाथाम् along with its king, इमाम् this, लङ्कां वा Lanka itself, नयितुम्  carried away, मे my, शक्ति: capacity, अस्ति is there.
explanation: "I have the capacity to carry away this entire Lanka uprooted with its mountains, gardens, forts, ramparts and gateways along with the king.

shloka_text: तदवस्थाप्यतां बुद्धिरलं देवि विकाङ्क्षया। विशोकं कुरु वैदेहि राघवं सहलक्ष्मणम्।।5.37.38।।
transliteration: tadavasthāpyatāṃ buddhiralaṃ devi vikāṅkṣayā| viśokaṃ kuru vaidehi rāghavaṃ sahalakṣmaṇam
translation: देवि queen, तत् so, विकाङ्क्ष्या with unworthy attitude, अलम् enough, बुद्धि: intellect, अवस्थाप्यताम् be stable, वैदेहि Vaidehi, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, राघवम् Rama, विशोकम् rid of sorrow, कुरु do.
explanation: "O queen it is enough. Give up this unworthy attitude. Be stable. O Vaidehi, rid Lakshmana and Rama of grief".

shloka_text: तं दृष्ट्वा भीमसङ्काशमुवाच जनकात्मजा। पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षी मारुतस्यौरसं सुतम्।।5.37.39।।
transliteration: taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmasaṅkāśamuvāca janakātmajā| padmapatraviśālākṣī mārutasyaurasaṃ sutam
translation: पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षी with eyes large like lotus petals, जनकात्मा daughter of Janaka, भीमसङ्काशम् dreadful to viewers, मारुतस्य Maruta's, औरसं सुतम् own son, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, उवाच said.
explanation: Seeing the son of Maruta in dreadful form, the broad lotus petaleyed daughter of Janaka with eyes as large as lotus petals replied :

shloka_text: तव सत्त्वं बलं चैव विजानामि महाकपे। वायोरिव गतिं चैव तेजश्चाग्नेरिवाद्भुतम्।।5.37.40।।
transliteration: tava sattvaṃ balaṃ caiva vijānāmi mahākape| vāyoriva gatiṃ caiva tejaścāgnerivādbhutam
translation: महाकपे O great monkey, तव your, सत्त्वम् strength, बलं चैव and power, वायोरिव like the Windgod's, गतिम् speed, आग्नेरिव like fire's, अद्भुतम् astonishing, तेजश्च splendour, विजानामि I have understood
explanation: "O great monkey I have understood your strength and power. Your speed is like the Windgod's and your power is astonishing and splendid.

shloka_text: प्राकृतोऽन्यः कथं चेमां भूमिमागन्तुमर्हति। उदधेरप्रमेयस्य पारं वानरपुङ्गव।।5.37.41।।
transliteration: prākṛto'nyaḥ kathaṃ cemāṃ bhūmimāgantumarhati| udadheraprameyasya pāraṃ vānarapuṅgava
translation: वानरपुङ्गव O chief of vanaras, प्राकृतः an ordinary one, अन्यः other, अप्रमेयस्य of an immeasurable one, उदधेः ocean's, पारम् far off shore, इमाम् this, भूमिम् this land, आगन्तुम् reach, कथम् how, अर्हति fit.
explanation: "O chief of vanaras how could an ordinary person be capable of reaching this land on far off shore of the immeasurable ocean?

shloka_text: जानामि गमने शक्तिं नयने चापि ते मम। अवश्यं सम्प्रधार्याशु कार्यसिद्धिर्महात्मनः।।5.37.42।।
transliteration: jānāmi gamane śaktiṃ nayane cāpi te mama| avaśyaṃ sampradhāryāśu kāryasiddhirmahātmanaḥ
translation: गमने in making the journey, मम me, नयने in  taking, शक्तिम् power, जानामि I know, महात्मनः of the great soul, कार्यसिददि success of the mission, अवश्यम् surely, आशु immediately, सम्प्रधार्या after planning properly
explanation: "I know you are capable of carrying me on your journey. I am sure about the quick success of your mission which has been carried out after careful planning.

shloka_text: अयुक्तं तु कपिश्रेष्ठ मम गन्तुं त्वयाऽनघ। वायुवेगसवेगस्य वेगो मां मोहयेत्तव।।5.37.43।।
transliteration: ayuktaṃ tu kapiśreṣṭha mama gantuṃ tvayā'nagha| vāyuvegasavegasya vego māṃ mohayettava
translation: अनघ sinless one, कपिश्रेष्ठ foremost monkey, त्वया by you, मम my, गन्तुम् to go with, अयुक्तम् not proper, वायुवेगसवेगस्य of a person with the speed of the wind, तव your, वेगः speed, माम् me, मोहयेत् will render me unconscious.
explanation: "O sinless and foremost monkey going with you is not proper for me. Your windlike speed will render me unconscious.

shloka_text: अहमाकाशमापन्ना ह्युपर्युपरि सागरम्। प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद्भयाद्वेगेव गच्छतः।।5.37.44।।
transliteration: ahamākāśamāpannā hyuparyupari sāgaram| prapateyaṃ hi te pṛṣṭhādbhayādvegeva gacchataḥ
translation: सागरम् उपर्युपरि above the ocean, आकाशम् sky, अहम् I, वेगेन speedily, गच्छतः when you go, ते your, पृष्ठात् from the back, भयात् out of fear, आपन्ना when I reach, प्रपतेयम् I may tumble down.
explanation: "When you fly over the ocean in the sky  speedily I may tumble down from your back by your speed out of fear.

shloka_text: पतिता सागरे चाहं तिमिनक्रझषाकुले। भवेयमाशु विवशा यादसामन्नमुत्तमम्।।5.37.45।।
transliteration: patitā sāgare cāhaṃ timinakrajhaṣākule| bhaveyamāśu vivaśā yādasāmannamuttamam
translation: तिमिनक्रझषाकुले filled with whales, crocodiles and fish, सागरे in the ocean, पतिता fallen in, अहम् I, विवशा helpless, आशु immediately, यादसाम् of aquatic animals, उत्तमम् very good, अन्नम् food, भवेयम् I will be.
explanation: Fallen into the ocean teeming with whales, crocodiles and fish, I should at once become, helpless, excellent food for the aquatic creatures.

shloka_text: न च शक्ष्ये त्वया सार्धं गन्तुं शत्रुविनाशन। कलत्रवति सन्देहस्त्वय्यपि स्यादसंशयः।।5.37.46।।
transliteration: na ca śakṣye tvayā sārdhaṃ gantuṃ śatruvināśana| kalatravati sandehastvayyapi syādasaṃśayaḥ
translation: शत्रुविनाशन O destroyer of foes, त्वया सार्थम् along with you, गन्तुम् to go, न शक्ष्ये च I have no power, कलत्रवति when burdened with a woman, त्वय्यपि with you also, संदेहः doubt, स्यात् may be, असंशयः there is no doubt.
explanation: "O destroyer of foes, it is not possible for me to go with you. Further, when you are burdened with a woman you will also fall into danger (because of me), no doubt.

shloka_text: ह्रियमाणां तु मां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः। अनुगच्छेयुरादिष्टा रावणेन दुरात्मना।।5.37.47।।
transliteration: hriyamāṇāṃ tu māṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ| anugaccheyurādiṣṭā rāvaṇena durātmanā
translation: ह्रियमाणाम् while I am, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, भीमविक्रमाः of fearsome valour, राक्षसाः demons, दुरात्मना by evilminded, रावणेन by Ravana, आदिष्टाः ordered, अनुगच्छेयुः they will pursue
explanation: "When I am seen (while being carried away) by the demons of fearsome valour they will pursue you, ordered by the wicked Ravana.

shloka_text: तैस्त्वं परिवृतश्शूरैश्शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः। भवेस्त्वं संशयं प्राप्तो मया वीर कलत्रवान्।।5.37.48।।
transliteration: taistvaṃ parivṛtaśśūraiśśūlamudgarapāṇibhiḥ| bhavestvaṃ saṃśayaṃ prāpto mayā vīra kalatravān
translation: त्वम् you, शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः by those wielding spears and mace, तैः by them, शूरैः by warriors, परिवृतः surrounded, वीर O hero, मया by me, कलत्रवान् one who has a wife, त्वम् you, संशयम् doubt, प्राप्तः have been, भवेः  you.
explanation: "O heroic monkey as the warriors armed with spears and maces surround you and attack, your life will be in danger, because of me.

shloka_text: सायुधा बहवो व्योम्नि राक्षसास्त्वं निरायुधः। कथं शक्ष्यसि संयातुं मां चैव परिरक्षितुम्।।5.37.49।।
transliteration: sāyudhā bahavo vyomni rākṣasāstvaṃ nirāyudhaḥ| kathaṃ śakṣyasi saṃyātuṃ māṃ caiva parirakṣitum
translation: व्योम्नि in the sky, सायुधाः will be armed with weapons, राक्षसाः demons, बहवः many, त्वम् you, निरायुधः unarmed, संयातुम् to fight, माम् me, परिरक्षितुं च and safeguard, कथम् how, शक्ष्यसि you will be capable?
explanation: "The demons are in large number and they will be armed with weapons. You are unarmed. How can you fight and protect me?

shloka_text: युध्यमानस्य रक्षोभिस्तव तैः क्रूरकर्मभिः। प्रपतेयं हि ते पृष्ठाद्भयार्ता कपिसत्तम।।5.37.50।।
transliteration: yudhyamānasya rakṣobhistava taiḥ krūrakarmabhiḥ| prapateyaṃ hi te pṛṣṭhādbhayārtā kapisattama
translation: कपिसत्तम O noble monkey, तव your, क्रूरकर्मभिः by those of wicked deeds, तैः by them, रक्षोभिः by the demons, युध्यमानस्य for you while engaged in fighting, भयार्ता out of fear, ते your, पृष्ठात् from the back, प्रपतेयं हि I will drop down.
explanation: "O noble monkey while you are engaged in fighting with those demons of wicked deeds, I may drop down out of fear.

shloka_text: अथ रक्षांसि भीमानि महान्ति बलवन्ति च। कथञ्चित्सांपराये त्वां जयेयुः कपिसत्तम।।5.37.51।।
transliteration: atha rakṣāṃsi bhīmāni mahānti balavanti ca| kathañcitsāṃparāye tvāṃ jayeyuḥ kapisattama
translation: कपिसत्तम O noble monkey, अथ then, भीमानि fearsome, महान्ति massive, बलवन्ति च powerful, रक्षांसि demons, सांपराये in the fight, कथञ्चित् in any case, त्वाम् you, जयेयुः win over.
explanation: "O noble monkey the massive, fearsome and powerful demons may defeat you in the fight in any way.

shloka_text: अथवा युध्यमानस्य पतेयं विमुखस्य ते। पतितां च गृहीत्वा मां नयेयुः पापराक्षसाः।।5.37.52।।
transliteration: athavā yudhyamānasya pateyaṃ vimukhasya te| patitāṃ ca gṛhītvā māṃ nayeyuḥ pāparākṣasāḥ
translation: अथवा or else, युध्यमानस्य for you while engaged in the fighting, ते for you, विमुखस्य while you turn your attention other way, पतेयम् I may fall down, पतिताम् when I have fallen down, माम् me, गृहीत्वा taking hold, पापराक्षसाः wretched rakshasas, नयेयुः may take me away.
explanation: "Or else, while you are engaged in fighting and turn your attention the other way I might fall down and the sinful ogres may bear me away.

shloka_text: मां वा हरेयुस्त्वद्धस्ताद्विशसेयुरथापि वा। अव्यवस्थौ हि दृश्येते युद्धे जयपराजयौ।।5.37.53।।
transliteration: māṃ vā hareyustvaddhastādviśaseyurathāpi vā| avyavasthau hi dṛśyete yuddhe jayaparājayau
translation: त्वत् हस्तात् from your hand, माम् me, हरेयुः they may take one away, अथापि वा or rather, विशसेयुः may cut me, युद्धे in the fight, जयपराजयौ success or failure, अव्यवस्थौ not sure, दृश्येते हि they appear.
explanation: "They may snatch me away from your hands or cut me to pieces. Success or defeat is uncertain in a war.

shloka_text: अहं वापि विपद्येयं रक्षोभिरभितर्जिता। त्वत्प्रयत्नो हरिश्रेष्ठ भवेन्निष्फल एव तु।।5.37.54।।
transliteration: ahaṃ vāpi vipadyeyaṃ rakṣobhirabhitarjitā| tvatprayatno hariśreṣṭha bhavenniṣphala eva tu
translation: रक्षोभिः caught by the ogres, अभितर्जिता very much threatened, अहम् I, विपद्येयं वापि or else I may die, हरिश्रेष्ठ best of monkeys, त्वत्प्रयत्नः your effort, निष्फल एव will be wasteful, तु indeed, भवेत् may be.
explanation: "In such a case, caught and intimidated by the demons I may die. Then your efforts will be wasted.

shloka_text: कामं त्वमसि पर्याप्तो निहन्तुं सर्वराक्षसान्। राघवस्य यशो हीयेत्त्वया शस्तैस्तु राक्षसैः।।5.37.55।।
transliteration: kāmaṃ tvamasi paryāpto nihantuṃ sarvarākṣasān| rāghavasya yaśo hīyettvayā śastaistu rākṣasaiḥ
translation: त्वम् you, सर्वराक्षसान् all the ogres, निहन्तुम् to slay, पर्याप्तः अपि कामम् it may be you can do the task, त्वया by you, शस्तै by those killed, राक्षसैः by demons, राघवस्य Rama's, यशः fame, हीयेत् will diminish.
explanation: "It may be that you can kill  all the demons but by such an act the fame of Rama will be diminished. (He cannot give his strength a trial)

shloka_text: अथवाऽदाय रक्षांसि न्यसेयुस्सम्वृते हि माम्। यत्र ते नाभिजानीयुर्हरयो नापि राघवौ।।5.37.56।।
transliteration: athavā'dāya rakṣāṃsi nyaseyussamvṛte hi mām| yatra te nābhijānīyurharayo nāpi rāghavau
translation: अथवा or else, रक्षांसि the ogres, माम् me, आदाय after taking, यत्र where, ते हरयः those of you vanaras, राघवौ अपि and even Rama and Lakshmana, नाभिजानीयुः may not know, संवृते in a secret place, न्यसेयु: they may hide.
explanation: "Or else, the ogres will carry me  and conceal me in a secret place which the vanaras or Rama and Lakshmana may not know.

shloka_text: आरम्भस्तु मदर्थोऽयं ततस्तव निरर्थकः। त्वया हि सह रामस्य महानागमने गुणः।।5.37.57।।
transliteration: ārambhastu madartho'yaṃ tatastava nirarthakaḥ| tvayā hi saha rāmasya mahānāgamane guṇaḥ
translation: ततः then, मदर्थः for my sake, तव your, आरम्भस्तु effort, निरर्थकः futile, त्वया सह along with you, रामस्य Rama, आगमने coming here, महान् great, गुणः merit.
explanation: "All your effort for my sake would be futile. Hence Rama's arrival along with you will be of great benefit.

shloka_text: मयि जीवितमायत्तं राघवस्य महात्मनः। भ्रात्रूणां च महाबाहो तव राजकुलस्य च।।5.37.58।।
transliteration: mayi jīvitamāyattaṃ rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ| bhrātrūṇāṃ ca mahābāho tava rājakulasya ca
translation: महाबाहो strongarmed one, महात्मनः of the great self, राघवस्य Rama's, भ्रात्रूणाम् of his brothers, तव your, राजकुलस्य of the relatives of your king, जीवितम् life, मयि in me, आयत्तम् is dependent.
explanation: "O strongarmed Hanuman your life and the life of the great self Rama, of his brother, and relatives of your king is dependent upon my survival.

shloka_text: तौ निराशौ मदर्थं तु शोकसन्तापकर्शितौ। सह सर्वर्क्षहरिभिस्त्यक्ष्यतः प्राणसङ्ग्रहम्।।5.37.59।।
transliteration: tau nirāśau madarthaṃ tu śokasantāpakarśitau| saha sarvarkṣaharibhistyakṣyataḥ prāṇasaṅgraham
translation: मदर्थम् for my sake, शोकसन्तापकर्शितौ emaciated with sorrow and suffering, तौ they both, निराशौ with no hope of finding me, सर्वर्क्षहरिभिः सह along with all vanaras and bears, प्राणसङ्ग्रहम् the five elements of which life is made, त्यक्ष्यतः will give up.
explanation: "Both Rama and Lakshmana who are emaciated with sorrow and suffering on account of me will give up their lives along with vanaras and bears.

shloka_text: भर्तुर्भक्तिं पुरस्कृत्य रामादन्यस्य वानर। न स्पृशामि शरीरं तु पुंसो वानरपुङ्गव।।5.37.60।।
transliteration: bharturbhaktiṃ puraskṛtya rāmādanyasya vānara| na spṛśāmi śarīraṃ tu puṃso vānarapuṅgava
translation: वानरपुङ्गव O chief of vanaras, वानर vanara, भर्तुः husband's, भक्तिम् devotion, पुरस्कृत्य after cherishing, रामात् from Rama, अन्यस्य other, पुंसः man's, शरीरं तु body, न स्पृशामि I do not touch.
explanation: "O chief of vanaras I cherish my devotion towards Rama alone and not touch the body of any other man.

shloka_text: यदहं गात्रसंस्पर्शं रावणस्य बलाद्गता। अनीशा किं करिष्यामि विनाथा विवशा सती।।5.37.61।।
transliteration: yadahaṃ gātrasaṃsparśaṃ rāvaṇasya balādgatā| anīśā kiṃ kariṣyāmi vināthā vivaśā satī
translation: अहम् I, बलात् by force, रावणस्य Ravana's, गात्रसंस्पर्शम् touch of his body, गता यत् that I had to experience, अनीशा having no control over my self, विवशा सती a helpless woman, विनाथा without my husband, किं करिष्यामि what can I do?
explanation: "I had no control over myself. I was helpless and my husband was not present when I had to bear the touch of Ravana's limbs. What can I do?

shloka_text: यदि रामो दशग्रीवमिह हत्त्वा सबान्धवम्। मामितो गृह्य गच्छेत तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्।।5.37.62।।
transliteration: yadi rāmo daśagrīvamiha hattvā sabāndhavam| māmito gṛhya gaccheta tattasya sadṛśaṃ bhavet
translation: रामः Rama, सबान्धवम् along with his relations, दशग्रीवम् Ravana, इह here, हत्त्वा after killing, माम् me, इतः from here, गृह्य taking, गच्छेत यदि and if he goes, तत् then, तस्य his, सदृशम् proper, भवेत् it will be.
explanation: "It will be proper if Rama comes here, kills Ravana along with all his relations and takes me away.

shloka_text: श्रुता हि दृष्टाश्च मया पराक्रमा महात्मनस्तस्य रणावमर्दिनः। न देवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गराक्षसा भवन्ति रामेण समा हि संयुगे।।5.37.63।।
transliteration: śrutā hi dṛṣṭāśca mayā parākramā mahātmanastasya raṇāvamardinaḥ| na devagandharvabhujaṅgarākṣasā bhavanti rāmeṇa samā hi saṃyuge
translation: रणावमर्दिनः of the crusher of enemies, महात्मनः great self, तस्य his, पराक्रमाः valiant deeds, मया by me, श्रुताः heard, दृष्टाश्च witnessed, संयुगे in war, देवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गराक्षसाः whether gods, gandharvas, nagas or demons, रामेण by Rama, समाः equal, नहि not indeed.
explanation: "I have seen and heard about Rama's conquest of enemies and his valiant deeds in war. Indeed, gods gandharvas, nagas or even demons cannot match him in war.

shloka_text: समीक्ष्य तं संयति चित्रकार्मुकम् महाबलं वासवतुल्यविक्रमम्। सलक्ष्मणं को विषहेत राघवं हुताशनं दीप्तमिवानिलेरितम्।।5.37.64।।
transliteration: samīkṣya taṃ saṃyati citrakārmukam mahābalaṃ vāsavatulyavikramam| salakṣmaṇaṃ ko viṣaheta rāghavaṃ hutāśanaṃ dīptamivānileritam
translation: चित्रकार्मुकम् wielder of a powerful bow, महाबलम् endowed with great strength, वासवतुल्यविक्रमम् equal to Vasava in valour, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, अनिलेरितम् whipped by wind, दीप्तम् blazing, हुताशनमिव like the fire, तं राघवम् him, Rama, सयति in war, समीक्ष्य facing, कः who, विषहेतः can withstand.
explanation: "After seeing Rama who is equal to lord Indra in valour. He is like blazing fire whipped by wind, wielding a wonderful bow, who can withstand the power of strong Rama accompanied by Lakshmana in war?

shloka_text: सलक्ष्मणं राघवमाजिमर्दनं दिशागजं मत्तमिव व्यवस्थितम्। सहेत को वानरमुख्य संयुगे युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमं शरार्चिषम्।।5.37.65।।
transliteration: salakṣmaṇaṃ rāghavamājimardanaṃ diśāgajaṃ mattamiva vyavasthitam| saheta ko vānaramukhya saṃyuge yugāntasūryapratimaṃ śarārciṣam
translation: वानरमुख्य chief of vanaras, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, आजिमर्दनम् crusher of enemies in war, मत्तम् intoxicated, दिशागजमिव like the elephant supporting quarter of the earth, व्यवस्थितम् steady, शरार्चिषम् arrows of rays, युगान्तसूर्यप्रतिमम् resembling the Sun at the at the time of the deluge, राघवम् Rama, संयुगे in a war, कः who, सहेत can withstand.
explanation: "O chief of vanaras who can withstand Rama accompanied by Lakshmana, the conqueror of enemies? His arrows resemble the rays of the Sun at the time of the deluge, steady like the elephants who support the quarters of the earth.

shloka_text: ततस्स कपिशार्दूलस्तेन वाक्येन तोषितः। सीतामुवाच तच्छृत्वा वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः।।5.38.1।।
transliteration: tatassa kapiśārdūlastena vākyena toṣitaḥ| sītāmuvāca tacchṛtvā vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
translation: ततः then, वाक्यविशारदः eloquent in speech, सः कपिशार्दूलः tiger among monkeys, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तेन वाक्येन by those words, तोषितः contented with, सीताम् to Sita, उवाच said.
explanation: Satisfied with the words of Sita, the tiger among monkeys, who was eloquent in speech said:
comments: Hanuman carries the episode of Kakasura and the Chudamani from Sita to Rama as a mark of identification

shloka_text: युक्तरूपं त्वया देवि भाषितं शुभदर्शने। सदृशं स्त्रीस्वभावस्य साध्वीनां विनयस्य च।।5.38.2।।
transliteration: yuktarūpaṃ tvayā devi bhāṣitaṃ śubhadarśane| sadṛśaṃ strīsvabhāvasya sādhvīnāṃ vinayasya ca
translation: शुभदर्शने whose appearance is auspicious, देवि queen, त्वया you, भाषितम् spoken, युक्तरूपम् is in accordance with your nature, स्त्रीस्वभावस्य of feminine nature, साध्वीनाम् of virtuous women, विनयस्य च and of the modesty, सदृशम् appropriate.
explanation: "O queen O lady of auspicious appearance your words are most appropriate to and characteristic of a modest virtuous woman.

shloka_text: स्त्रीत्वं न तु समर्थं हि सागरं व्यतिवर्तितुम्। मामधिष्ठाय विस्तीर्णं शतयोजनमायतम्।।5.38.3।।
transliteration: strītvaṃ na tu samarthaṃ hi sāgaraṃ vyativartitum| māmadhiṣṭhāya vistīrṇaṃ śatayojanamāyatam
translation: माम् me, अधिष्ठाय after climbing up, विस्तीर्णम् vast, शतयोजनम् of hundred yojanas, आयतम् wide, सागरम् the ocean, व्यतिवर्तितुम् to cross, स्त्रीत्वम् for a woman, न समर्थं हि is not possible.
explanation: "It may not be possible for a woman to cross on my back the vast ocean stretching over a hundred yojanas. It is not possible for a woman.

shloka_text: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते। रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संस्पर्शमिति जानकि ।।5.38.4।। एतत्ते सदृशं देवि पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः। का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम्।।5.38.5।।
transliteration: dvitīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ yacca bravīṣi vinayānvite| rāmādanyasya nārhāmi saṃsparśamiti jānaki  etatte sadṛśaṃ devi patnyāstasya mahātmanaḥ| kā hyanyā tvāmṛte devi brūyādvacanamīdṛśam
translation: विनयान्विते O lady with humility etc., जानकि Janaki, रामात् from Rama, अन्यस्य of others, संस्पर्शम् touch, नार्हिमि I do not want, यत् that which, द्वितीयम् second, कारणम् reason, ब्रवीषि you said, एतत् that, तस्य his, महात्मनः of the great soul, पत्न्याः of the wife, ते to you, सदृशम् appropriate, देवि O queen, त्वाम् your, ऋते excepting, अन्या other than, का who else, ईदृशम् such, वचनम् word, ब्रूयात् will speak.
explanation: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?

shloka_text: द्वितीयं कारणं यच्च ब्रवीषि विनयान्विते। रामादन्यस्य नार्हामि संस्पर्शमिति जानकि ।।5.38.4।। एतत्ते सदृशं देवि पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः। का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम्।।5.38.5।।
transliteration: dvitīyaṃ kāraṇaṃ yacca bravīṣi vinayānvite| rāmādanyasya nārhāmi saṃsparśamiti jānaki  etatte sadṛśaṃ devi patnyāstasya mahātmanaḥ| kā hyanyā tvāmṛte devi brūyādvacanamīdṛśam
translation: विनयान्विते O lady with humility etc., जानकि Janaki, रामात् from Rama, अन्यस्य of others, संस्पर्शम् touch, नार्हिमि I do not want, यत् that which, द्वितीयम् second, कारणम् reason, ब्रवीषि you said, एतत् that, तस्य his, महात्मनः of the great soul, पत्न्याः of the wife, ते to you, सदृशम् appropriate, देवि O queen, त्वाम् your, ऋते excepting, अन्या other than, का who else, ईदृशम् such, वचनम् word, ब्रूयात् will speak.
explanation: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?

shloka_text: श्रोष्यते चैव काकुत्स्थ: सर्वं निरवशेषतः। चेष्टितं यत्त्वया देवि भाषितं मम चाग्रतः।।5.38.6।।
transliteration: śroṣyate caiva kākutstha: sarvaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ| ceṣṭitaṃ yattvayā devi bhāṣitaṃ mama cāgrataḥ
translation: काकुत्स्थ: Rama the scion of the Kakutstha family, सर्वं all, देवि queen, त्वया your, यत् what ever, चेष्टितम् is done, मम my, अग्रतः presence, भाषितं च you have spoken, सर्वम् all, निरवशेषतः without omission, श्रोष्यते च will hear.
explanation: "O queen Kakutstha Rama will hear from me fully all that has been said and done by you in my presence without any omission.

shloka_text: कारणैर्बहुभिर्देवि रामप्रियचिकीर्षया। स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा मयैतत्समुदीरितम्।।5.38.7।।
transliteration: kāraṇairbahubhirdevi rāmapriyacikīrṣayā| snehapraskannamanasā mayaitatsamudīritam
translation: देवि O queen, बहुभिः with many, कारणैः with reasons, रामप्रियचिकीर्षया desiring to please Rama, स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा mind is sprinkled with love, मया by me, एतत् this, समुदीरितम् uttered.
explanation: "O queen my heart is drenched with love for Rama and desires to please him for many reasons. Therefore these words have been spoken by me.

shloka_text: लङ्काया दुष्प्रवेशत्वाद्दुस्तरत्वान्महोदधेः। सामर्थ्यादात्मनश्चैव मयैतत्समुदीरितम्।।5.38.8।।
transliteration: laṅkāyā duṣpraveśatvāddustaratvānmahodadheḥ| sāmarthyādātmanaścaiva mayaitatsamudīritam
translation: लङ्कायाः of Lanka, दुष्प्रवेशत्वात् difficult to enter, महोदधेः of the ocean, दुस्तरत्वात् difficult to cross, आत्मनः of my self, सामर्थ्याश्चैव because of my capacity, मया by me, एतत् all this, समुदीरितम् pronounced.
explanation: "Crossing the ocean and entering Lanka are  difficult. But I accomplished it. Hence my proposal.

shloka_text: इच्छामि त्वां समानेतुमद्यैव रघुबन्धुना। गुरुस्नेहेन भक्त्या च नान्यथैतदुदाहृतम्।।5.38.9।।
transliteration: icchāmi tvāṃ samānetumadyaiva raghubandhunā| gurusnehena bhaktyā ca nānyathaitadudāhṛtam
translation: गुरुस्नेहेन out of love for my master, भक्त्या च and devotion, त्वाम् you, रघुबन्धुना with Rama, अद्यैव today itself, समानेतुम् to take, इच्छामि desirous of, एतत् all this, अन्यथा any other, न उदाहृतम् not mentioned otherwise.
explanation: "I offered to take you today itself out of my love and devotion to Rama with a desire to unite you with him and not with any other intention.

shloka_text: यदि नोत्सहसे यातुं मया सार्थमनिन्दिते। अभिज्ञानं प्रयच्छ त्वं जानीयाद्राघवो हि यत्।।5.38.10।।
transliteration: yadi notsahase yātuṃ mayā sārthamanindite| abhijñānaṃ prayaccha tvaṃ jānīyādrāghavo hi yat
translation: अनिन्दिते O blameless lady, मया सार्थम् along with me, यातुम् to go, नोत्सहसे यदि if not desiring, यत् that, राघवः Rama, जानीयात् coming and seeing you, अभिज्ञानम् to let him know, त्वम् you, प्रयच्छ you may give me a token of identity.
explanation: "O blameless lady If you wish not to accompany me you may give me a token of identification to let Rama know about my coming here and seeing you".

shloka_text: एवमुक्ता हनुमता सीता सुरसुतोपमा। उवाच वचनं मन्दं बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम्।।5.38.11।। इदं श्रेष्ठमभिज्ञानं ब्रूयास्त्वं तु मम प्रियम्।
transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā sītā surasutopamā| uvāca vacanaṃ mandaṃ bāṣpapragrathitākṣaram idaṃ śreṣṭhamabhijñānaṃ brūyāstvaṃ tu mama priyam|
translation: हनुमता by Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्ता having been addressed, सुरसुतोपमा resembling a god's daughter, सीता Sita, बाष्पप्रग्रथिताक्षरम् words choked with tears, वचनम् word, मन्दम् in low tone, उवाच said, त्वं तु you also, मम my, प्रियम् dear, श्रेष्ठम् best, इदम् thus, अभिज्ञानम् token of identity, ब्रूयाः said.
explanation: Having heard Hanuman, Sita, a child of god, said these words in a low tone. Choked with tears, 'Carry this token of identity to my dear husband':

shloka_text: शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा।।5.38.12।। तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके। तस्मिन्सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या विदूरतः।।5.38.13।। तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु। विहृत्य सलिले क्लिन्ना ममाङ्के समुपाविशमः।।5.38.14।।
transliteration: śailasya citrakūṭasya pāde pūrvottare purā tāpasāśramavāsinyāḥ prājyamūlaphalodake| tasminsiddhāśrame deśe mandākinyā vidūrataḥ tasyopavanaṣaṇḍeṣu nānāpuṣpasugandhiṣu| vihṛtya salile klinnā mamāṅke samupāviśamaḥ
translation: पुरा earlier, चित्रकूटस्य शैलस्य on the mountain of Chitrakuta, पूर्वोत्तरे in the northeast, पादे on foot, प्राज्यमूलफलोदके with abundant roots fruits and water, तस्मिन् in that, सिद्धाश्रमे Siddhasrama, देशे in a region, मन्दाकिन्याध्यविदूरतः not far from Mandakini river, तस्य of him, नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु many kinds of fragrant flowers, उपवनषण्डेषु in gardens, सलिले in water, विहृत्य  after sporting, क्लिन्नः wet, तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः hermitages of ascetics, मम me, अङ्के the body, समुपाविशः you were seated.
explanation: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.

shloka_text: शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा।।5.38.12।। तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके। तस्मिन्सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या विदूरतः।।5.38.13।। तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु। विहृत्य सलिले क्लिन्ना ममाङ्के समुपाविशमः।।5.38.14।।
transliteration: śailasya citrakūṭasya pāde pūrvottare purā tāpasāśramavāsinyāḥ prājyamūlaphalodake| tasminsiddhāśrame deśe mandākinyā vidūrataḥ tasyopavanaṣaṇḍeṣu nānāpuṣpasugandhiṣu| vihṛtya salile klinnā mamāṅke samupāviśamaḥ
translation: पुरा earlier, चित्रकूटस्य शैलस्य on the mountain of Chitrakuta, पूर्वोत्तरे in the northeast, पादे on foot, प्राज्यमूलफलोदके with abundant roots fruits and water, तस्मिन् in that, सिद्धाश्रमे Siddhasrama, देशे in a region, मन्दाकिन्याध्यविदूरतः not far from Mandakini river, तस्य of him, नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु many kinds of fragrant flowers, उपवनषण्डेषु in gardens, सलिले in water, विहृत्य  after sporting, क्लिन्नः wet, तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः hermitages of ascetics, मम me, अङ्के the body, समुपाविशः you were seated.
explanation: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.

shloka_text: शैलस्य चित्रकूटस्य पादे पूर्वोत्तरे पुरा।।5.38.12।। तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः प्राज्यमूलफलोदके। तस्मिन्सिद्धाश्रमे देशे मन्दाकिन्या विदूरतः।।5.38.13।। तस्योपवनषण्डेषु नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु। विहृत्य सलिले क्लिन्ना ममाङ्के समुपाविशमः।।5.38.14।।
transliteration: śailasya citrakūṭasya pāde pūrvottare purā tāpasāśramavāsinyāḥ prājyamūlaphalodake| tasminsiddhāśrame deśe mandākinyā vidūrataḥ tasyopavanaṣaṇḍeṣu nānāpuṣpasugandhiṣu| vihṛtya salile klinnā mamāṅke samupāviśamaḥ
translation: पुरा earlier, चित्रकूटस्य शैलस्य on the mountain of Chitrakuta, पूर्वोत्तरे in the northeast, पादे on foot, प्राज्यमूलफलोदके with abundant roots fruits and water, तस्मिन् in that, सिद्धाश्रमे Siddhasrama, देशे in a region, मन्दाकिन्याध्यविदूरतः not far from Mandakini river, तस्य of him, नानापुष्पसुगन्धिषु many kinds of fragrant flowers, उपवनषण्डेषु in gardens, सलिले in water, विहृत्य  after sporting, क्लिन्नः wet, तापसाश्रमवासिन्याः hermitages of ascetics, मम me, अङ्के the body, समुपाविशः you were seated.
explanation: 'Long ago we were staying at Siddhasrama. This hermitage was situated to the northeast at the foot of Chitrakuta mountain which was not far from the river Mandakini. It had abundant roots, fruits and water. You sported with me in the gardens which were fragrant with many types of flowers and ponds. You sat down on my lap with wet clothes in the hermitage'.

shloka_text: ततो मांससमायुक्तो वायसः पर्यतुण्डयत्। तमहं लोष्टमुद्यम्य वारयामिस्म वायसम्।।5.38.15।।
transliteration: tato māṃsasamāyukto vāyasaḥ paryatuṇḍayat| tamahaṃ loṣṭamudyamya vārayāmisma vāyasam
translation: ततः then, मांससमायुक्तः it brought meat, वायसः crow, पर्यतुण्डयत् went round with its beak and pecked, अहम् I, लोष्टम् clod of earth, उद्यम्य by lifting, तम् him, वायसम् that crow, वारयामि स्म I presented him.
explanation: 'Then a crow greedy of flesh began to peck my bossom with its beak. I took a clod of earth and warded him off.

shloka_text: दारयन्स च मां काकस्तत्त्रैव परिलीयते। न चाप्युपारमन्मांसाद्भक्षार्थि बलिभोजनः।।5.38.16।।
transliteration: dārayansa ca māṃ kākastattraiva parilīyate| na cāpyupāramanmāṃsādbhakṣārthi balibhojanaḥ
translation: सः काकः that crow, माम् me, दारयन् while pecking, तत्रैव there itself, परिलीयते waited, भक्षार्थि hungry for food, सः he, बलिभोजनः eater of offerings, मांसात् flesh, न उपारमच्चापि was not giving up.
explanation: 'The crow was an eater of offerings, hungry for food began to peck me again and again for flesh.He did not stop.

shloka_text: उत्कर्षन्त्यां च रशनां क्रुद्धायां मयि पक्षिणि। स्रस्यमाने च वसने ततो दृष्टा त्वया ह्यहम्।।5.38.17।।
transliteration: utkarṣantyāṃ ca raśanāṃ kruddhāyāṃ mayi pakṣiṇi| srasyamāne ca vasane tato dṛṣṭā tvayā hyaham
translation: मयि I, पक्षिणि by the crow, क्रुद्धायाम् when I was angry, वसने when the cloth, स्रस्यमाने च was slipping, रशनाम् waist string, उत्कर्षन्त्यां च as I was pulling up, ततः then, त्वया by you, अहम् I, दृष्टा seen.
explanation: 'My upper cloth was slipping. I was trying to pull up my waist string angrily when you saw me.

shloka_text: त्वयाऽपहसिता चाहं क्रुद्धा संलज्जिता तदा। भक्षगृध्नेन काकेन दारिता त्वामुपागता।।5.38.18।।
transliteration: tvayā'pahasitā cāhaṃ kruddhā saṃlajjitā tadā| bhakṣagṛdhnena kākena dāritā tvāmupāgatā
translation: तदा then, क्रुद्धा enraged, अहम् I, त्वया your, अपहसिता made fun of me, संलज्जिता  embarassed, भक्षगृध्नेन by the voracious bird, काकेन by the crow, दारिता torn, त्वाम् you, उपागता  sought.
explanation: 'Then you made fun of me, and I became angry. I was abashed. Torn by the voracious bird I sought your shelter.

shloka_text: आसीनस्य च ते श्रान्ता पुनरुत्सङ्गमाविशम्। क्रुध्यन्ती च प्रहृष्टेन त्वयाऽहं परिसान्त्विता।।5.38.19।।
transliteration: āsīnasya ca te śrāntā punarutsaṅgamāviśam| krudhyantī ca prahṛṣṭena tvayā'haṃ parisāntvitā
translation: श्रान्ता exhausted, आसीनस्य when you sat, ते your, उत्सङ्गम् lap, पुनः again, आविशम् settled again, क्रुध्यन्ती seeing me angry, अहम् I, प्रहृष्टेन happily, त्वया by you, परिसान्त्विता you pacified me.
explanation: 'Exhausted, I sat on your lap again. Seeing my angry face you pacified me. You were happy (to see me draw close).

shloka_text: बाष्पपूर्णमुखी मन्दं चक्षुषी परिमार्जती। लक्षिताऽहं त्वया नाथ वायसेन प्रकोपिता।।5.38.20।।
transliteration: bāṣpapūrṇamukhī mandaṃ cakṣuṣī parimārjatī| lakṣitā'haṃ tvayā nātha vāyasena prakopitā
translation: नाथ O lord, वायसेन by the crow, प्रकोपिता angered, बाष्पपूर्णमुखी face filled with tears, मन्दम् slowly, चक्षुषी eyes, परिमार्जती while wiping, अहम् I was, त्वया you, लक्षिता marked.
explanation: 'O lord when I was angered by the crow and my face was filled with tears, you marked me wiping my eyes.

shloka_text: परिश्रमात्प्रसुप्ता च राघवाङ्केऽप्यहं चिरम्। पर्यायेण प्रसुप्तश्च ममाङ्के भरताग्रजः।।5.38.21।।
transliteration: pariśramātprasuptā ca rāghavāṅke'pyahaṃ ciram| paryāyeṇa prasuptaśca mamāṅke bharatāgrajaḥ
translation: अहमपि I too, परिश्रमात् due to exhaustion, राघवाङ्के on Rama's lap, चिरम् for long time, प्रसुप्ता च I slept, पर्यायेण in turn, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, मम my, अङ्के on the lap, प्रसुप्तः slept.
explanation: 'Totally exhausted I slept on your lap for a long time, and in turn you slept on my lap later.

shloka_text: स तत्र पुनरेवाथ वायसस्समुपागमत्। ततस्सुप्तप्रबुद्धां मां रामस्याङ्कात्समुत्थिताम्।।5.38.22।। वायसस्सहसागम्य विददार स्तनान्तरे। पुनः पुनरथोत्पत्य विददार स मां भृशम्।।5.38.23।।
transliteration: sa tatra punarevātha vāyasassamupāgamat| tatassuptaprabuddhāṃ māṃ rāmasyāṅkātsamutthitām vāyasassahasāgamya vidadāra stanāntare| punaḥ punarathotpatya vidadāra sa māṃ bhṛśam
translation: अथ and then, सः वायसः that crow, पुनरेव again, तत्र there, समुपागमत् came back, ततः then, सः he, वायसः crow, सहसा atonce, आगम्य having come, सुप्तप्रबुद्धाम् awakened from sleep, रामस्य Rama's, अङ्कात् from the lap, समुत्थिताम् risen, माम् myself, स्तनान्तरे between my breasts, विददार clawed, अथ and, पुनः again, उत्पत्य flying, माम् myself, भृशम् repeatedly, विददार clawed down.
explanation: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.

shloka_text: स तत्र पुनरेवाथ वायसस्समुपागमत्। ततस्सुप्तप्रबुद्धां मां रामस्याङ्कात्समुत्थिताम्।।5.38.22।। वायसस्सहसागम्य विददार स्तनान्तरे। पुनः पुनरथोत्पत्य विददार स मां भृशम्।।5.38.23।।
transliteration: sa tatra punarevātha vāyasassamupāgamat| tatassuptaprabuddhāṃ māṃ rāmasyāṅkātsamutthitām vāyasassahasāgamya vidadāra stanāntare| punaḥ punarathotpatya vidadāra sa māṃ bhṛśam
translation: अथ and then, सः वायसः that crow, पुनरेव again, तत्र there, समुपागमत् came back, ततः then, सः he, वायसः crow, सहसा atonce, आगम्य having come, सुप्तप्रबुद्धाम् awakened from sleep, रामस्य Rama's, अङ्कात् from the lap, समुत्थिताम् risen, माम् myself, स्तनान्तरे between my breasts, विददार clawed, अथ and, पुनः again, उत्पत्य flying, माम् myself, भृशम् repeatedly, विददार clawed down.
explanation: 'The crow came back again and clawed me in the space between my breasts even after I woke up after slumber from Rama's lap. Flying, it tore my bosom again and again.

shloka_text: ततस्समुक्षितो रामो मुक्तैश्शोणितबिन्दुभिः। वायसेन ततस्तेन बलवत्क्लिश्यमानया।।5.38.24।। स मया बोधितश्श्रीमान्सुखसुप्तः परन्तपः।
transliteration: tatassamukṣito rāmo muktaiśśoṇitabindubhiḥ| vāyasena tatastena balavatkliśyamānayā sa mayā bodhitaśśrīmānsukhasuptaḥ parantapaḥ|
translation: ततः then, रामः Rama, मुक्तै: dripping, शोणितबिन्दुभिः drops of blood, समुक्षितः seeing, ततः then, तेन वायसेन by that crow, बलवत् forcibly, क्लिश्यमानया tormented, मया by me, श्रीमान् illustrious, परन्तपः scorcher of foes, सुखसुप्तः happily sleeping, सः he, बोधितः he was awakened.
explanation: 'At the touch of the drops of blood dripping from my body, tormented by seeing me distressed with the dripping blood, you were awakened, you who were an illustrious scorcher of foes.

shloka_text: स मां दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्वितुन्नां स्तनयोस्तदा।।5.38.25।। आशीविष इव क्रुद्धश्वसन्वाक्यमभाषत।
transliteration: sa māṃ dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurvitunnāṃ stanayostadā āśīviṣa iva kruddhaśvasanvākyamabhāṣata|
translation: महाबाहुः strong armed, सः Rama, तदा then, स्तनयोः in the breasts, वितुन्नाम् wounded, माम् me, दृष्ट्वा on seeing, क्रुद्धः angered, आशीविष इव like a (hissing) snake, श्वसन् breathing hard, वाक्यम् these words, अभाषत spoke.
explanation: 'O strongarmed Rama, seeing my torn breasts, you became angry like a hissing serpent  and hissing said :

shloka_text: केन ते नागनासोरु विक्षतं वै स्तनान्तरम्।।5.38.26।। कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना।
transliteration: kena te nāganāsoru vikṣataṃ vai stanāntaram kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā|
translation: नागनासोरु lady whose thighs look like elephant's trunk, सीता Sita, स्तनान्तरम् your breasts, केन by whom, विक्षतं वै wounded, सरोषेण with the angry, पञ्चवक्त्रेण fivehooded, भोगिना by the serpent, कः who, क्रीडति sporting.
explanation: 'O Sita with a beautiful lap like an elephant trunk by whom is your bosom wounded? Who is sporting with an angry fivehooded snake?

shloka_text: वीक्षमाणस्ततस्तं वै वायसं समुदैक्षत।।5.38.27।। नखैस्सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम्।
transliteration: vīkṣamāṇastatastaṃ vai vāyasaṃ samudaikṣata nakhaissarudhiraistīkṣṇairmāmevābhimukhaṃ sthitam|
translation: ततः then, वीक्षमाणः while glancing, सरुधिरैः with blood stained, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp ones, नखैः with nails, मामेव me, अभिमुखम् facing me, स्थितम् standing, तं वायसम् that crow, समुदैक्षत वै he saw.
explanation: 'Then looking around, you saw the crow facing me with sharp, bloodstained claws.

shloka_text: पुत्त्रः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः।।5.38.28।। धरान्तरगतश्शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः।
transliteration: puttraḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ dharāntaragataśśīghraṃ pavanasya gatau samaḥ|
translation: पतताम् of the birds, वरः eminent, सः वायसः that crow, शक्रस्य Indra's, पुत्रः किल it is said that he is the son, धरान्तरगतः he covered a long distance, शीघ्रम् in great speed, गतौ in movement, पवनस्य Windgod's, समः matching.
explanation: 'This crow was the best of birds. He was surely Indra's son who had covered a long distance with great speed and his speed was like the Windgod's.

shloka_text: ततस्तस्मिन्महाबाहुः कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः।।5.38.29।। वायसे कृतवान्क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वरः।
transliteration: tatastasminmahābāhuḥ kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ vāyase kṛtavānkrūrāṃ matiṃ matimatāṃ varaḥ|
translation: ततः then, मतिमताम् among the wise, वरः best, महाबाहुः strongarmed, कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः with eye balls rolling in anger, तस्मिन् him, वायसे at the crow, क्रूराम् cruel, मतिम् mind, कृतवान् made up.
explanation: 'Then you, the strongarmed and best among the wise, your eyeballs rolling in fury, made up your mind about the cruel crow.

shloka_text: स दर्भं संस्तराद्गृह्य ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण योजयत्।।5.38.30।। स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखो द्विजम्।
transliteration: sa darbhaṃ saṃstarādgṛhya brāhmeṇāstreṇa yojayat sa dīpta iva kālāgnirjajvālābhimukho dvijam|
translation: सः he, Rama, संस्तरात् from his darbha mat, दर्भम् darbha grass, गृह्य took out, ब्राह्मेण अस्त्रेण invoked the weapon of Brahma into it by reciting the mantra, योजयत् discharged, सः that, दीप्तः blazed, कालाग्निरिव like the fire of death, द्विजम् the bird, अभिमुखः towards, जज्वाल glowed.
explanation: 'Taking out a blade of darbha grass from your mat, you invoked the weapon of Brahma by reciting the mantra. Then you discharged it which blazed like the fire of death and went spearheading towards the crow.

shloka_text: स तं प्रदीप्तं चिक्षेप दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति।।5.38.31।। ततस्तं वायसं दर्भस्सोम्बरेऽनुजगाम ह।
transliteration: sa taṃ pradīptaṃ cikṣepa darbhaṃ taṃ vāyasaṃ prati tatastaṃ vāyasaṃ darbhassombare'nujagāma ha|
translation: सः he, प्रदीप्तम् glowing, तं दर्भम् that darbha, तं वायसं प्रति him, the crow in turn, चिक्षेप threw, ततः then, सः दर्भः that darbha, तं वायसम् that crow, अम्बरे in the sky, अनुजगाम ह followed.
explanation: 'Then you threw the burning darbha grass at the crow and it chased him in the sky.

shloka_text: अनुसृष्टस्तदा काको जगाम विविधां गतिम्।।5.38.32।। लोककाम इमं लोकं सर्वं वै विचचार ह।
transliteration: anusṛṣṭastadā kāko jagāma vividhāṃ gatim lokakāma imaṃ lokaṃ sarvaṃ vai vicacāra ha|
translation: तदा then, काकः that crow, अनुसृष्टः one who was followed, विविधाम् many, गतिम् places, जगाम went, लोककामः the entire universe desiring safety, इमम् this, सर्वम् all, लोकम् worlds, विचचार ह went round.
explanation: 'Then that crow flew to many places seeking asylum all over the universe chased by the blade of grass.

shloka_text: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तस्सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः।।5.38.33।। त्रीन्लोकान्सम्परिक्रम्य तमेव शरणं गतः।
transliteration: sa pitrā ca parityaktassuraiśca samaharṣibhiḥ trīnlokānsamparikramya tameva śaraṇaṃ gataḥ|
translation: सः he, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, सम्परिक्रम्य having gone round, पित्रा च and to his father also, समहर्षिभिः including the sages, सुरैश्च by gods, परित्यक्तः rejected, तमेव him alone, शरणं गतः went seeking refuge.
explanation: 'Then the crow went round all the three worlds, having been rejected by his father Indra, including all the sages and gods. Refused by all he came back to Rama seeking shelter.

shloka_text: स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यश्शरणागतम्।।5.38.34।। वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ: कृपया पर्यपालयत्।
transliteration: sa taṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṇyaśśaraṇāgatam vadhārhamapi kākutstha: kṛpayā paryapālayat|
translation: शरण्यः saviour, सः काकुत्स्थ: that Kakutstha, शरणागतम् one who sought refuge, भूमौ on the ground, निपतितम् fallen on the ground, तम् him, वधार्हमपि even though deserves to be killed, कृपया out of compassion, पर्यपालयत् saved.
explanation: 'Seeing the crow fallen on the ground, O Kakutstha, you who are a saviour of those who seek refuge saved him out of compassion, even though he deserved to be killed.

shloka_text: परिद्यूनं विषण्णं च स तमायान्तमब्रवीत्।।5.38.35।। मोघं कर्तुं न शक्यं तु ब्राह्ममस्त्रं तदुच्यताम्।
transliteration: paridyūnaṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ ca sa tamāyāntamabravīt moghaṃ kartuṃ na śakyaṃ tu brāhmamastraṃ taducyatām|
translation: सः Rama, परिद्यूनम् pained, विषण्णम् despondent, आयान्तम् he reached, तम् him, अब्रवीत् said, ब्राह्मम् अस्त्रम् Brahma weapon, मोघम् in vain, कर्तुम् to do, न शक्यं तु not possible, तत् that, उच्यताम् tell.
explanation: 'Rama, you saw the crow in pain and despondency who returned to you and said that it is not possible to make Brahma's weapon ineffectual.You may tell now. (what should be done.)

shloka_text: हिनस्तु दक्षिणाक्षि त्वच्छर इत्यथ सोऽब्रवीत्।।5.38.36।। ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम्। दत्त्वा स दक्षिणं नेत्रं प्राणेभ्यः परिरक्षितः।।5.38.37।।
transliteration: hinastu dakṣiṇākṣi tvacchara ityatha so'bravīt tatastasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam| dattvā sa dakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ prāṇebhyaḥ parirakṣitaḥ
translation: अथ and then, सः that, त्वच्छरः your arrow, दक्षिणाक्षि right eye, हिनस्तु may be blinded, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, ततः then, सः he, तस्य काकस्य that crow's, दक्षिणम् right, अक्षि eye, हिनस्ति स्म blinded by hitting, सः that, दक्षिणम् right, दत्त्वा having offered, प्राणेभ्यः from life, परिरक्षितः protected.
explanation: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.

shloka_text: हिनस्तु दक्षिणाक्षि त्वच्छर इत्यथ सोऽब्रवीत्।।5.38.36।। ततस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम्। दत्त्वा स दक्षिणं नेत्रं प्राणेभ्यः परिरक्षितः।।5.38.37।।
transliteration: hinastu dakṣiṇākṣi tvacchara ityatha so'bravīt tatastasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam| dattvā sa dakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ prāṇebhyaḥ parirakṣitaḥ
translation: अथ and then, सः that, त्वच्छरः your arrow, दक्षिणाक्षि right eye, हिनस्तु may be blinded, इति thus, अब्रवीत् said, ततः then, सः he, तस्य काकस्य that crow's, दक्षिणम् right, अक्षि eye, हिनस्ति स्म blinded by hitting, सः that, दक्षिणम् right, दत्त्वा having offered, प्राणेभ्यः from life, परिरक्षितः protected.
explanation: 'Then that crow said, 'let my right eye be blinded'. you then hit the right eye of the crow'. Thus the crow offered his right eye and saved himself.

shloka_text: स रामाय नमस्कृत्य राज्ञे दशरथाय च। विसृष्टस्तेन वीरेण प्रतिपेदे स्वमालयम्।।5.38.38।।
transliteration: sa rāmāya namaskṛtya rājñe daśarathāya ca| visṛṣṭastena vīreṇa pratipede svamālayam
translation: सः that crow, रामाय to Rama, राज्ञे to the king, दशरथाय च and to Dasaratha, नमस्कृत्य having offered salutations, तेन by him, वीरेण by the warrior, विसृष्टः permitted to leave, स्वम् his own, आलयम् dwelling, प्रतिपेदे went reached.
explanation: 'That crow offered salutations to you Rama and king Dasaratha, thereafter took permission and went to his own dwelling.

shloka_text: मत्कृते काकमात्रे तु ब्रह्मास्त्रं समुदीरितम्। कस्माद्यो मां हरेत्त्वत्तः क्षमसे तं महीपते।।5.38.39।।
transliteration: matkṛte kākamātre tu brahmāstraṃ samudīritam| kasmādyo māṃ harettvattaḥ kṣamase taṃ mahīpate
translation: महीपते lord of the earth, मत्कृते for the sake of, काकमात्रे on a mere crow, ब्रह्मास्त्रम् weapon of Brahma, समुदीरितम् released, त्वत्तः from you, माम् me, यः he who, अहरत् abducted, तम् him, कस्मात् why, क्षमसे you excuse him.
explanation: '(Addressing Rama as though he was present before her, Sita said) 'O lord of the earth for my sake you released the weapon of Brahma on a crow. What makes you excuse him who has abducted me?

shloka_text: स कुरुष्व महोत्साहः कृपां मयि नरर्षभ। त्वया नाथवती नाथ ह्यनाथा इव दृश्यते।।5.38.40।।
transliteration: sa kuruṣva mahotsāhaḥ kṛpāṃ mayi nararṣabha| tvayā nāthavatī nātha hyanāthā iva dṛśyate
translation: नरर्षभ bull among men, सः Rama, महोत्साहः one with great love, मयि in me, कृपाम् compassion, कुरुष्व bestow, नाथ O lord, त्वया your, नाथवती I have been protected, अनाथा इव like an orphan, दृश्यते  appears.
explanation: 'O bull among men you are so loving to me. I am like an orphan. Be kind to me. She who has found her lord in you stays without a protector.

shloka_text: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्तवत्त्त ऐव मया श्रुतः। जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम्।।5.38.41।। अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात्सागरोपमम्। भर्तारं ससमुद्राया धरण्या वासवोपमम्।।5.38.42।।
transliteration: ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmastavattta aiva mayā śrutaḥ| jānāmi tvāṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahābalam apārapāramakṣobhyaṃ gāmbhīryātsāgaropamam| bhartāraṃ sasamudrāyā dharaṇyā vāsavopamam
translation: अनृशंस्यम् kindness, परः supreme, धर्मः is righteous, मया by me, त्वत्तः एव from you alone,श्रुतः heard, त्वाम् you, महावीर्यम् heroic, महोत्साहम् vigour, महाबलम् mighty, अपारपारम् boundless, अक्षोभ्यम् never to be stirred, गाम्भीर्यात् with depth, सागरोपमम् like the ocean, ससमुद्रायाः inclusive of seas, धरण्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् lord, वासवोपमम् like Vasava, जानामि I know.
explanation: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.

shloka_text: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मस्तवत्त्त ऐव मया श्रुतः। जानामि त्वां महावीर्यं महोत्साहं महाबलम्।।5.38.41।। अपारपारमक्षोभ्यं गाम्भीर्यात्सागरोपमम्। भर्तारं ससमुद्राया धरण्या वासवोपमम्।।5.38.42।।
transliteration: ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmastavattta aiva mayā śrutaḥ| jānāmi tvāṃ mahāvīryaṃ mahotsāhaṃ mahābalam apārapāramakṣobhyaṃ gāmbhīryātsāgaropamam| bhartāraṃ sasamudrāyā dharaṇyā vāsavopamam
translation: अनृशंस्यम् kindness, परः supreme, धर्मः is righteous, मया by me, त्वत्तः एव from you alone,श्रुतः heard, त्वाम् you, महावीर्यम् heroic, महोत्साहम् vigour, महाबलम् mighty, अपारपारम् boundless, अक्षोभ्यम् never to be stirred, गाम्भीर्यात् with depth, सागरोपमम् like the ocean, ससमुद्रायाः inclusive of seas, धरण्याः of the earth, भर्तारम् lord, वासवोपमम् like Vasava, जानामि I know.
explanation: 'O my supreme lord I know you are kind, righteous, valiant, vigroous, mighty. You are boundless, calm and deep like the ocean. You are lord of earth and the seas and compeer of Vasava. I have heard from you that motiveless compassion is the best way to make one righteous.

shloka_text: एवमस्त्रविदां श्रेष्ठस्सत्यवान्बलवानपि। किमर्थमस्त्रं रक्षस्सु न योजयसि राघव।।5.38.43।।
transliteration: evamastravidāṃ śreṣṭhassatyavānbalavānapi| kimarthamastraṃ rakṣassu na yojayasi rāghava
translation: राघव Rama, एवम् in that way, अस्त्रविदाम् among the users of weapons, श्रेष्ठः expert, सत्यवान् truthful, बलवानपि even strong, रक्षस्सु demons, अस्त्रम् weapon, किमर्थम् why, न योजयसि you are not using?
explanation: 'Even though you are an expert in the use of weapons, truthful and strong. (Yet) why are you not using weapons aganst the demons?'

shloka_text: न नागा नाऽपि गन्धर्वा नासुरा न मरुद्गणाः। रामस्य समरे वेगं शक्ताः प्रतिसमाधितुं।।5.38.44।।
transliteration: na nāgā nā'pi gandharvā nāsurā na marudgaṇāḥ| rāmasya samare vegaṃ śaktāḥ pratisamādhituṃ
translation: समरे in war, रामस्य Rama's, वेगम् speed, प्रतिसमाधितुम् to hit back, नागाः serpents, न शक्ताः not able, गन्धर्वा अपि even gandharvas, न not, असुराः demons, न not, मरुद्गणाः marutas, न not.
explanation: (Now Sita turns to Hanuman and says) "In war serpents, gandharvas, demons or Marutas cannot withstand the speed of Rama's arrows and hit back.

shloka_text: तस्य वीर्यवतः कश्चिद्यद्यस्ति मयि सम्भ्रमः। किमर्थं न शरैस्तीक्ष्णै: क्षयं नयति राक्षसान्।।5.38.45।।
transliteration: tasya vīryavataḥ kaścidyadyasti mayi sambhramaḥ| kimarthaṃ na śaraistīkṣṇai: kṣayaṃ nayati rākṣasān
translation: वीर्यवतः hero of great discipline, तस्य his, मयि in me, कश्चित् even a little, सम्भ्रमः hurry, अस्ति यदि if he has, तीक्ष्णैः with sharp, शरैः with arrows, राक्षसान् at the demons, किमर्थम् why, क्षयम् destroy, न नयति not killing.
explanation: "Does Rama have a little anxiety about me? If he has, why does he, a disciplined hero, not  put an end to the demons with his sharp arrows?

shloka_text: भ्रातुरादेशमादाय लक्ष्मणो वा परन्तपः। कस्य हेतोर्न मां वीरः परित्राति महाबलः।।5.38.46।।
transliteration: bhrāturādeśamādāya lakṣmaṇo vā parantapaḥ| kasya hetorna māṃ vīraḥ paritrāti mahābalaḥ
translation: परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, महाबलः mighty, वीरः hero, लक्ष्मणो वा even Lakshmana, भ्रातुः brother, आदेशम् order, आदाय after taking, कस्य हेतोः for what reason, माम् me, न परित्राति not rescue.
explanation: "Or, why does the mighty hero, Lakshmana, who is a scorcher of enemies, not come to my rescue taking the orders from his brother?

shloka_text: यदि तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ। सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः।।5.38.47।।
transliteration: yadi tau puruṣavyāghrau vāyvagnisamatejasau| surāṇāmapi durdharṣau kimarthaṃ māmupekṣataḥ
translation: वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ resembling wind and fire in power, पुरुषव्याघ्रौ two tigers among men, तौ they both, सुराणाम् even the gods, दुर्धर्षौ यदि अपि even though unassailable also, माम् me, किमर्थम् how is it, उपेक्षतः disregarding.
explanation: "Both Rama and Lakshmana are tigers among men who resemble wind and fire in power and have the unassailability of the gods. Wherefore are they disregarding me?.

shloka_text: ममैव दुष्कृतं किञ्चिन्महदस्ति न संशयः। समर्थावपि तौ यन्मां नावेक्षेते परन्तपौ।।5.38.48।।
transliteration: mamaiva duṣkṛtaṃ kiñcinmahadasti na saṃśayaḥ| samarthāvapi tau yanmāṃ nāvekṣete parantapau
translation: ममैव mine alone, महत् atrocious, किञ्चित् some, दुष्कृतम् sin, अस्ति is committed, संशयः doubt, न no, यत् because, समर्थावपि although capable, परन्तपौ both scorchers of enemies, तौ both, माम् me, न आवेक्षेते not deliver.
explanation: "Perhaps I must have committed an atrocious sin. There is no doubt. For although both of them are scorchers of enemies, they deliver me not."

shloka_text: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रुभाषितम्। अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.38.49।।
transliteration: vaidehyā vacanaṃ śrutvā karuṇaṃ sāśrubhāṣitam| athābravīnmahātejā hanumānmārutātmajaḥ
translation: अथ and then, महातेजाः lustrous, मारुतात्मजः Windgod's son, हनुमान् Hanuman, वैदेह्या Vaidehi's, साश्रु with tears, करुणम् piteous, भाषितम् spoken, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Hearing the piteous words of Vaidehi and beholding her eyes filled with tears, the Windgod's son, lustrous Hanuman replied thus:.

shloka_text: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे। रामे दुःखाभिपन्ने च लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते।।5.38.50।।
transliteration: tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena te śape| rāme duḥkhābhipanne ca lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate
translation: देवि Devi, रामः Rama, त्वच्छोकविमुखः he is averse to your misery, सत्येन truly, ते your, शपे I vow, रामे when Rama, दुःखाभिपन्ने immersed in sorrow, लक्ष्मणः च even Lakshmana, परितप्यते wails.
explanation: "O godlike lady Rama is not averse to your misery. On my word this is true. Rama is immersed in sorrow. Even Lakshmana wails.

shloka_text: कथञ्चिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिदेवितुम्। इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानां द्रक्ष्यस्यन्तमनिन्दिते।।5.38.51।।
transliteration: kathañcidbhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ paridevitum| imaṃ muhūrtaṃ duḥkhānāṃ drakṣyasyantamanindite
translation: कथञ्चित् with difficulty, भवती your self, दृष्टा could be found, परिदेवितुम् wailing, कालः time, न not, अनिन्दिते blameless lady, इमम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, दुःखानाम् all sorrrow, अन्तम् end, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: "I could find you with difficulty. This is not the time to wail. O blameless lady take it, your sorrow has come to an end at this moment.

shloka_text: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रौ महाबलौ। त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः।।5.38.52।।
transliteration: tāvubhau puruṣavyāghrau rājaputrau mahābalau| tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhau laṅkāṃ bhasmīkariṣyataḥ
translation: पुरुषव्याघ्रौ two tigers among men, महाबलौ mighty, त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ eager to see you, उभौ both, तौ राजपुत्रौ those two princes, लङ्काम् this Lanka, भस्मीकरिष्यतः will reduce to ashes.
explanation: "Both the mighty brothers, tigers among men, are eager to see you. Both the princes will reduce this Lanka  into ashes.

shloka_text: हत्त्वा च समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम्। राघवस्त्वां विशालाक्षि नेष्यति स्वां पुरीं प्रति।।5.38.53।।
transliteration: hattvā ca samare krūraṃ rāvaṇaṃ sahabāndhavam| rāghavastvāṃ viśālākṣi neṣyati svāṃ purīṃ prati
translation: विशालाक्षि O largeeyed lady, राघवः Rama, समरे in war, सहबान्धवम् along with relatives, क्रूरम् cruel, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा after killing, स्वां पुरीं प्रति towards his city, त्वाम् you, नेष्यति he will be taking you.
explanation: "O largeeyed lady cruel Ravana along with his relatives will be killed by Rama in war and Rama will return to his city with you.

shloka_text: ब्रूहि यद्राघवो वाच्यो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। सुग्रीवो वापि तेजस्वी हरयोऽपि समागताः।।5.38.54।।
transliteration: brūhi yadrāghavo vācyo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ| sugrīvo vāpi tejasvī harayo'pi samāgatāḥ
translation: राघवः Rama, यत् whichever, वाच्यः you may like to convey, महाबलः mighty Rama, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, तेजस्वी brilliant, सुग्रीवो वापि and Sugriva also, समागताः those who collect there, हरयोऽपि even the vanaras, ब्रूहि say.
explanation: "Communicate your message to mighty Rama and Lakshamana, to brilliant Sugriva and even the vanaras who gather there.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तवति तस्मिंस्तु सीता सुरसुतोपमा। उवाच शोकसन्तप्ता हनुमन्तं प्लवङ्गमम्।।5.38.55।।
transliteration: ityuktavati tasmiṃstu sītā surasutopamā| uvāca śokasantaptā hanumantaṃ plavaṅgamam
translation: तस्मिन् when he, इति in that way, उक्तवति when he said, सुरसुतोपमा lady resembling a god's daughter, सीता Sita, शोकसन्तप्ता filled with grief, प्लवङ्गमम् to vanara, हनुमन्तम् Hanuman, उवाच said
explanation: "Hanuman having spoken this way, Sita, resembling a god's daughter, grieving, thus addressed Hanuman:

shloka_text: कौसल्या लोकभर्तारं सुषुवे यं मनस्विनी। तं ममार्थे सुखं पृच्छ शिरसा चाभिवादय।।5.38.56।।
transliteration: kausalyā lokabhartāraṃ suṣuve yaṃ manasvinī| taṃ mamārthe sukhaṃ pṛccha śirasā cābhivādaya
translation: लोकभर्तारम् lord of the world, यम् whom, मनस्विनी sensitive woman, कौसल्या Kausalya, सुषुवे bore, तम् him, मदर्थे on my behalf, सुखम् welfare, पृच्छ you may inquire into, शिरसा by bowing, अभिवादय च offer salutations.
explanation: "Bow to Rama and offer salutations on my behalf. Inquiries concerning his welfare should be addressed to Rama, whom virtuous Kausalya bore as a son.

shloka_text: स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः। ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम्।।5.38.57।। पितरं मातरं चैव सम्मान्याभिप्रसाद्य च। अनुप्रव्रजितो रामं सुमित्रा येन सुप्रजाः।।5.38.58।।
transliteration: srajaśca sarvaratnāni priyā yāśca varāṅganāḥ| aiśvaryaṃ ca viśālāyāṃ pṛthivyāmapi durlabham pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva sammānyābhiprasādya ca| anupravrajito rāmaṃ sumitrā yena suprajāḥ
