translation: येन by whom, सुमित्रा Sumitra, सुप्रजाः has attained the title of blessed mother, स्रजश्च garlands, सर्वरत्नानि all jewels, प्रियाः dear, याः those, वराङ्गनाः best of women, विशालायाम् in the vast, पृथिव्याम् in the whole earth, दुर्लभम् most difficult to attain, ऐश्वर्यं चापि prosperity also, पितरम् father, मातरं चापि even mother, सम्मान्य having respected, अभिप्रसाद्य  pleased by adopting the life of an ascetic, च and, रामम् with Rama, अनुप्रव्रजितः accompanied.
explanation: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.

shloka_text: स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः। ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम्।।5.38.57।। पितरं मातरं चैव सम्मान्याभिप्रसाद्य च। अनुप्रव्रजितो रामं सुमित्रा येन सुप्रजाः।।5.38.58।।
transliteration: srajaśca sarvaratnāni priyā yāśca varāṅganāḥ| aiśvaryaṃ ca viśālāyāṃ pṛthivyāmapi durlabham pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva sammānyābhiprasādya ca| anupravrajito rāmaṃ sumitrā yena suprajāḥ
translation: येन by whom, सुमित्रा Sumitra, सुप्रजाः has attained the title of blessed mother, स्रजश्च garlands, सर्वरत्नानि all jewels, प्रियाः dear, याः those, वराङ्गनाः best of women, विशालायाम् in the vast, पृथिव्याम् in the whole earth, दुर्लभम् most difficult to attain, ऐश्वर्यं चापि prosperity also, पितरम् father, मातरं चापि even mother, सम्मान्य having respected, अभिप्रसाद्य  pleased by adopting the life of an ascetic, च and, रामम् with Rama, अनुप्रव्रजितः accompanied.
explanation: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.

shloka_text: आनुकूल्येन धर्मात्मा त्यक्त्वा सुखमनुत्तमम्। अनुगच्छति काकुत्स्थं भ्रातरं पालयन्वने।।5.38.59।।
transliteration: ānukūlyena dharmātmā tyaktvā sukhamanuttamam| anugacchati kākutsthaṃ bhrātaraṃ pālayanvane
translation: धर्मात्मा righteous self, अनुत्तमम् great, सुखम् pleasures, त्यक्त्वा having given up, भ्रातरम् his brother, काकुत्स्थम् Kakustha Rama, वने to the forest, आनुकूल्येन in his favour, पालयन् while serving, अनुगच्छति followed.
explanation: "Great, righteous Lakshmana had given up his pleasures and followed his brother Rama in his favour into the forest to be able to serve him.

shloka_text: सिंहस्कन्धो महाबाहुर्मनस्वी प्रियदर्शिनः। पितृवद्वर्तते रामे मातृवन्मां समाचरन्।।5.38.60।।
transliteration: siṃhaskandho mahābāhurmanasvī priyadarśinaḥ| pitṛvadvartate rāme mātṛvanmāṃ samācaran
translation: सिंहस्कन्ध: lionshoulders, महाबाहुः strongarmed one, मनस्वी highsouled, प्रियदर्शनः a handsome person, माम् me, मातृवत् like his mother, समाचरन् while treating, रामे with Rama, पितृवत् as his father, वर्तते conducts.
explanation: "Lakshmana, who has lionshoulders and strong arms, who is handsome, who takes Rama as his father and treats me as his own mother.

shloka_text: ह्रियमाणां तदा वीरो न तु मां वेद लक्ष्मणः। वृद्धोपसेवी लक्ष्मीवान् शक्तो न बहुभाषिता।।5.38.61।। राजपुत्रः प्रियः श्रेष्ठः सदृशः श्वशुरस्य मे।
transliteration: hriyamāṇāṃ tadā vīro na tu māṃ veda lakṣmaṇaḥ| vṛddhopasevī lakṣmīvān śakto na bahubhāṣitā rājaputraḥ priyaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sadṛśaḥ śvaśurasya me|
translation: वीरः hero, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तदा then, माम् me, ह्रियमाणाम् while I was borne away, न वेद not know, वृद्धोपसेवी serving elders, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, शक्तः energetic, न बहुभाषिता limited in speech, मे my, श्वशुरस्य of my fatherinlaw, सदृशः resembles, प्रियः dear, श्रेष्ठः foremost, राजपुत्रः prince.
explanation: "Heroic Lakshmana, did not know while I was borne away. He is prosperous, foremost in serving elders. He is energetic and reserved in his speech like my fatherinlaw. He is a prince dear (to his brother).

shloka_text: ममः प्रियतरो नित्यं भ्राता रामस्य लक्ष्मणः।।5.38.62।। नियुक्तो धुरि यस्यां तु तामुद्वहति वीर्यवान्।
transliteration: mamaḥ priyataro nityaṃ bhrātā rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ niyukto dhuri yasyāṃ tu tāmudvahati vīryavān|
translation: रामस्य Rama's, भ्राता brother, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, नित्यम् always, मम to me, प्रियतरः loving, वीर्यवान् heroic, यस्याम् in whichever, धुरि task, नियुक्तः he is entrusted, ताम् such a job, उद्वहति executes.
explanation: "Rama's brother Lakshmana is always dear to me. Heroic Lakshmana will discharge whichever responsibility is entrusted to him.

shloka_text: यं दृष्ट्वा राघवो नैव वृत्तमार्यमनुस्मरेत्।।5.38.63।। स ममार्थाय कुशलं वक्तव्यो वचनान्मम।
transliteration: yaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāghavo naiva vṛttamāryamanusmaret sa mamārthāya kuśalaṃ vaktavyo vacanānmama|
translation: यम् who, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, राघवः Rama, वृत्तम् support, आर्यम् noble, न अनुस्मरेत् not remembering, सः he, मम my, अर्थाय sake, मम on me, वचनात् words, कुशलम् welfare, वक्तव्यः that I have enquired.
explanation: "He is Lakshmana for whose care and support Rama did not miss the noble king Dasaratha (during exile). Convey him my words of enquiry about his wellbeing.

shloka_text: मृदुर्नित्यं शुचिर्दक्षः प्रियो रामस्य लक्ष्मणः।।5.38.64।। यथा हि वानरश्रेष्ठ दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्। त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तमः।।5.38.65।।
transliteration: mṛdurnityaṃ śucirdakṣaḥ priyo rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ yathā hi vānaraśreṣṭha duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet| tvamasminkāryaniryoge pramāṇaṃ harisattamaḥ
translation: वानरश्रेष्ठः excellent vanara, हरिसत्तम: esteemed vanaras, मृदुः gentle, नित्यम् always, शुचिः pure, दक्षः competent, रामस्य Rama's, प्रियः beloved, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, यथा as such, दुःखक्षयकरः who mitigates suffering, भवेत् will be, अस्मिन् in that, कार्यनिर्योगे in a task, त्वम् you, प्रमाणम् authority.
explanation: "Lakshmana is soft, pure, competent and dear to Rama. O great vanara, act in such a manner that Lakshmana can mitigate my suffering. O great monkey, the best of vanaras you are competent in accomplishing this task.

shloka_text: मृदुर्नित्यं शुचिर्दक्षः प्रियो रामस्य लक्ष्मणः।।5.38.64।। यथा हि वानरश्रेष्ठ दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्। त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तमः।।5.38.65।।
transliteration: mṛdurnityaṃ śucirdakṣaḥ priyo rāmasya lakṣmaṇaḥ yathā hi vānaraśreṣṭha duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet| tvamasminkāryaniryoge pramāṇaṃ harisattamaḥ
translation: वानरश्रेष्ठः excellent vanara, हरिसत्तम: esteemed vanaras, मृदुः gentle, नित्यम् always, शुचिः pure, दक्षः competent, रामस्य Rama's, प्रियः beloved, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, यथा as such, दुःखक्षयकरः who mitigates suffering, भवेत् will be, अस्मिन् in that, कार्यनिर्योगे in a task, त्वम् you, प्रमाणम् authority.
explanation: "Lakshmana is soft, pure, competent and dear to Rama. O great vanara, act in such a manner that Lakshmana can mitigate my suffering. O great monkey, the best of vanaras you are competent in accomplishing this task.

shloka_text: राघवस्त्वत्समारम्भान्मयि यत्नपरो भवेत्। इदं ब्रूयाश्च मे नाथं शूरं रामं पुनः पुनः।।5.38.66।।
transliteration: rāghavastvatsamārambhānmayi yatnaparo bhavet| idaṃ brūyāśca me nāthaṃ śūraṃ rāmaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
translation: राघवः Rama, त्वत्समारम्भात् by your efforts alone, मयि regarding me, यत्नपरः one who makes efforts, भवेत् will be, मे my, नाथम् husband, शूरम् powerful hero, रामम् Rama, पुनः पुनः again and again, इदम् this, ब्रूयाः may tell.
explanation: "By your efforts alone my husband will try for my release. You may tell these words to my heroic husband, Rama, again and again.

shloka_text: जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज। ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं सत्येनाहं ब्रवीमि ते।।5.38.67।।
transliteration: jīvitaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṃ daśarathātmaja| ūrdhvaṃ māsānna jīveyaṃ satyenāhaṃ bravīmi te
translation: दशरथात्मज Dasaratha's son, Rama, मासम् a month, जीवितम् life, धारयिष्यामि will hold on to life, मासात् after a month, ऊर्ध्वम् beyond that, न जीवेयम् I will not live, अहम् I, सत्येन on truth, ते to you, ब्रवीमि I am telling.
explanation: "I will hold on to life  only for a month. Beyond, I will not survive. I swear by truth. You may tell this to Rama.

shloka_text: रावणेनोपरुद्धां मां निकृत्य पापकर्मणा। त्रातुमर्हसि वीर त्वं पातालादिव कौशिकीम्।।5.38.68।।
transliteration: rāvaṇenoparuddhāṃ māṃ nikṛtya pāpakarmaṇā| trātumarhasi vīra tvaṃ pātālādiva kauśikīm
translation: वीर hero, पापकर्मणा by the wicked, रावणेन by Ravana, निकृत्य after insulting, उपरुद्धाम् imprisonment, माम् me, त्वम् you, पातालात् from the underworld or Pataala, कौशिकीमिव like Kausik, त्रातुम् rescue me, अर्हसि is proper.
explanation: "O heroic Rama just as Kausik was rescued from the underworld it behoves you to deliver me from imprisonment of wicked Ravana".

shloka_text: ततो वस्त्रगतं मुक्त्वा दिव्यं चूडामणिं शुभम्। प्रदेयो राघवायेति सीता हनुमते ददौ।।5.38.69।।
transliteration: tato vastragataṃ muktvā divyaṃ cūḍāmaṇiṃ śubham| pradeyo rāghavāyeti sītā hanumate dadau
translation: ततः then, सीता Sita, वस्त्रगतम् tied up in clothes, शुभम् auspicious, दिव्यम् exquisite, चूडामणिम् Chudamani, an ornament worn on the head, मुक्त्वा took out, राघवाय to Rama, प्रदेयः to be given, इति thus, हनुमते to Hanuman, ददौ gave.
explanation: Then Sita took out the exquisite and auspicious Chudamani worn on the head, untied from her clothes and gave it to Hanuman to be presented to Rama.

shloka_text: प्रतिगृह्य ततो वीरो मणिरत्नमनुत्तमम्। अङ्गुल्या योजयामास न ह्यस्य प्राभवद्भुजः।।5.38.70।।
transliteration: pratigṛhya tato vīro maṇiratnamanuttamam| aṅgulyā yojayāmāsa na hyasya prābhavadbhujaḥ
translation: ततः then, वीरः hero, अनुत्तमम् very great, मणिरत्नम् jewel, प्रतिगृह्य after taking, अङ्गुल्या on his finger, योजयामास placed अस्य to his, भुजः arm, न प्राभवत् हि was not fitting.
explanation: Then Hanuman, taking the extraordinary jewel and placed it on his finger as it was not fitting to his arm.

shloka_text: मणिरत्नं कपिवरः प्रतिगृह्याभिवाद्य च। सीतां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रणतः पार्व्शतः स्थितः।।5.38.71।।
transliteration: maṇiratnaṃ kapivaraḥ pratigṛhyābhivādya ca| sītāṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā praṇataḥ pārvśataḥ sthitaḥ
translation: कपिवरः best of vanaras, मणिरत्नम् jewel, प्रतिगृह्य after taking, सीताम् from Sita, अभिवाद्य च having saluted, प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा having circumambulated, प्रणतः humbly, पार्श्वतः by the side, स्थितः stood.
explanation: Having recieved the jewel from Sita and circumambulated her, Hanuman offered salutations to  her and stood by her.

shloka_text: हर्षेण महता युक्तः सीतादर्शनजेन सः। हृदयेन गतो रामं शरीरेण तु विष्ठितः।।5.38.72।।
transliteration: harṣeṇa mahatā yuktaḥ sītādarśanajena saḥ| hṛdayena gato rāmaṃ śarīreṇa tu viṣṭhitaḥ
translation: सः he, सीतादर्शनजेन by seeing Sita, महता with a great, हर्षेण joy, युक्तः endowed, हृदयेन his mind, रामम् to Rama, गतः went, शरीरेण तु but body, विष्ठितः stood there.
explanation: Hanuman stood there physically, with great joy gazing at Sita, but mentally he was with Rama.

shloka_text: मणिवरमुपगृह्य तं महार्हं जनकनृपात्मजया धृतं प्रभावात्। गिरिरिव पवनावधूतमुक्तः सुखितमनाः प्रतिसङ्क्रमं प्रपेदे।।5.38.73।।
transliteration: maṇivaramupagṛhya taṃ mahārhaṃ janakanṛpātmajayā dhṛtaṃ prabhāvāt| giririva pavanāvadhūtamuktaḥ sukhitamanāḥ pratisaṅkramaṃ prapede
translation: महार्हम् precious, जनकनृपात्मजया by Janaka's daughter, धृतम् borne, तं मणिवरम् that great jewel, उपगृह्य taking, प्रभावात् by its glow, पवनावधूतमुक्तः shaken by wind and released, गिरिरिव like a mountain, सुखितमनाः pleased, प्रतिसङ्क्रमम् to return, प्रपेदे prepared.
explanation: Having received the most precious jewel from the daughter of Janaka, Hanuman prepared to return like a mountain released from the impact of the wind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टत्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: मणिं दत्त्वा ततः सीता हनूमन्तमथाब्रवीत्। अभिज्ञानमभिज्ञातमेतद्रामस्य तत्त्वतः।।5.39.1।।
transliteration: maṇiṃ dattvā tataḥ sītā hanūmantamathābravīt| abhijñānamabhijñātametadrāmasya tattvataḥ
translation: सीता Sita, मणिं Jewel, दत्त्वा having given, ततः that way, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, अब्रवीत् said, एतत् this, रामस्य to Rama, अभिज्ञात known, तत्त्वतः truly, अभिज्ञानम् signet.
explanation: Sita gave the jewel to Hanuman and said, "This signet ornament is known to Rama very well".
comments: Sita further appeals to Hanuman

shloka_text: मणिं तु दृष्ट्वा रामो वै त्रयाणां संस्मरिष्यति। वीरो जनन्या मम च राज्ञो दशरथस्य च।।5.39.2।।
transliteration: maṇiṃ tu dṛṣṭvā rāmo vai trayāṇāṃ saṃsmariṣyati| vīro jananyā mama ca rājño daśarathasya ca
translation: मणिम् jewel, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, रामः Rama, त्रयाणाम् of three of us, जनन्याः of the mother, मम च me and, राज्ञः king, दशरथस्य च Dasaratha and, संस्मरिष्यति will recall.
explanation: "Seeing this jewel,Rama will recall three of us, my mother, myself and the king Dasaratha" (as this was given by her mother at her marriage.)

shloka_text: स भूयस्त्वं समुत्साहे चोदितो हरिसत्तम। अस्मिन्कार्यसमारम्भे प्रचिन्तय यदुत्तरम्।।5.39.3।।
transliteration: sa bhūyastvaṃ samutsāhe codito harisattama| asminkāryasamārambhe pracintaya yaduttaram
translation: हरिसत्तम great Hanuman, सः such Rama, त्वम् you, भूयः again, समुत्साहचोदितः prompted by enthusiasm, अस्मिन् in this, कार्यसमारम्भे in this effort, यत् that, उत्तरम् now, प्रचिन्तय think over.
explanation: "Great Hanuman you are enthused now. You may think over the future course of action.

shloka_text: त्वमस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे प्रमाणं हरिसत्तम। हनुमन्यत्नमास्थाय दुःखक्षयकरो भव।।5.39.4।। तस्य चिन्तयतो यत्नो दुःखक्षयकरो भवेत्।
transliteration: tvamasminkāryaniryoge pramāṇaṃ harisattama| hanumanyatnamāsthāya duḥkhakṣayakaro bhava tasya cintayato yatno duḥkhakṣayakaro bhavet|
translation: हरिसत्तम O best of monkeys, अस्मिन् in this, कार्यनिर्योगे in carrying out this task, त्वम् you, प्रमाणम् are responsible, हनुमान् Hanuman, यत्नम् initiative, आस्थाय after making, दुःखक्षयकरः reducer of suffering, भव you are, तस्य for him, चिन्तयतः  thinking, यत्नः effort, दुःखक्षयकरः reducer of grief, भवेत् become.
explanation: "O best of monkeys it is your  responsibility to carry out this task. O Hanuman think carefully of that. Take the initiative to reduce my suffering. I am confident that you can do it."

shloka_text: स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः।।5.39.5।। शिरसा वन्ध्य वैदेहीं गमनायोपचक्रमे।
transliteration: sa tatheti pratijñāya mārutirbhīmavikramaḥ śirasā vandhya vaidehīṃ gamanāyopacakrame|
translation: भीमविक्रमः possessed with fierceful valour, सः मारुतिः that Maruti, तथेति so be it, प्रतिज्ञाय promised, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, शिरसा with his head, वन्ध्य having offered salutation, गमनाय to depart, उपचक्रमे started.
explanation: Hanuman possessed with fierce valour said to Vaidehi, 'so be it' and bowed his head, and offered salutations before he departed.

shloka_text: ज्ञात्वा सम्प्रस्थितं देवी वानरं मारुतात्मजम्।।5.39.6।। बाष्पगद्गदया वाचा मैथिली वाक्यमब्रवीत्।
transliteration: jñātvā samprasthitaṃ devī vānaraṃ mārutātmajam bāṣpagadgadayā vācā maithilī vākyamabravīt|
translation: देवी noble lady, मैथिली Mythili, मारुतात्मजम् Maruti's son, वानरम् vanara, सम्प्रस्थितम् who had started, ज्ञात्वा having realised, बाष्पगद्गदया with voice choked with tears, वाचा with speech, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: The noble lady, Sita, having been fully convinced about Hanuman and realising that he is about to start, her voice was choked with tears. She said these words:

shloka_text: कुशलं हनुमन्ब्रूयाः सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।5.39.7।। सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वानरान्। ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम्।।5.39.8।।
transliteration: kuśalaṃ hanumanbrūyāḥ sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau sugrīvaṃ ca sahāmātyaṃ vṛddhān sarvāṃśca vānarān| brūyāstvaṃ vānaraśreṣṭha kuśalaṃ dharmasaṃhitam
translation: वानरश्रेष्ठः O great vanara, हनुमन् O Hanuman, सहितौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate, सहामात्यम् along with his ministers, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, वृद्धान् elders, सर्वान् all, वानरान् vanaras, त्वम् you, धर्मसंहितम् righteous manner, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate
explanation: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare  to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.

shloka_text: कुशलं हनुमन्ब्रूयाः सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।5.39.7।। सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं वृद्धान् सर्वांश्च वानरान्। ब्रूयास्त्वं वानरश्रेष्ठ कुशलं धर्मसंहितम्।।5.39.8।।
transliteration: kuśalaṃ hanumanbrūyāḥ sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau sugrīvaṃ ca sahāmātyaṃ vṛddhān sarvāṃśca vānarān| brūyāstvaṃ vānaraśreṣṭha kuśalaṃ dharmasaṃhitam
translation: वानरश्रेष्ठः O great vanara, हनुमन् O Hanuman, सहितौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate, सहामात्यम् along with his ministers, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, वृद्धान् elders, सर्वान् all, वानरान् vanaras, त्वम् you, धर्मसंहितम् righteous manner, कुशलम् welfare, ब्रूयाः you may communicate
explanation: "O Hanuman the great communicate my welfare  to both Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva, his ministers, elderly vanaras in righteous order.

shloka_text: यथा स च महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः। अस्माद्धुःखाम्बुसंरोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि।।5.39.9।।
transliteration: yathā sa ca mahābāhurmāṃ tārayati rāghavaḥ| asmāddhuḥkhāmbusaṃrodhāttvaṃ samādhātumarhasi
translation: महाबाहुः strongarmed, सः राघवः that Rama, अस्मात् from this, दुःखाम्बुसंरोधात् relieve me from this ocean of grief, यथा that way, तारयति he helps me to cross, त्वम् you, समाधातुम् to pacify, अर्हसि you may.
explanation: "You must pacify the strongarmed Rama in a manner by which he will help me to cross the ocean of grief and rlieve me.

shloka_text: जीवन्तीं मां यथा रामः सम्भावयति कीर्तिमान्। तत्तथा हनुमन्वाच्यं वाचा धर्ममवाप्नुहि।।5.39.10।।
transliteration: jīvantīṃ māṃ yathā rāmaḥ sambhāvayati kīrtimān| tattathā hanumanvācyaṃ vācā dharmamavāpnuhi
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, कीर्तिमान् illustrious one, रामः Rama, माम् me, जीवन्तीम् while I am alove, यथा in such way, सम्भावयति will take me, तत् that, तथा that way, वाच्यम् words, वाचा tell, धर्मम् righteous, अवाप्नुहि you will acquire.
explanation: "Let the illustrious Rama take me alive. Help me with your (persuasive) words and you will acquire merit.

shloka_text: नित्यमुत्साहयुक्ताश्च वाचश्रुत्वा त्वयेरिताः। वर्धिष्यते दाशरथेः पौरुषं मदवाप्तये।।5.39.11।।
transliteration: nityamutsāhayuktāśca vācaśrutvā tvayeritāḥ| vardhiṣyate dāśaratheḥ pauruṣaṃ madavāptaye
translation: त्वया you, ईरिताः spoken, उत्साहयुक्ताः full of determination for action, वाचः words, नित्यम् ever, श्रुत्वा after hearing, मदवाप्तये for acquiring me, दाशरथेः son of Dasaratha, पौरुषम् manliness, वर्धिष्यते will increase.
explanation: "On hearing your ever spirited words his manliness to get me back will be charged.

shloka_text: मत्सन्देशयुता वाचस्त्वत्तश्श्रुत्वा च राघवः। पराक्रमविधिं वीरो विधिवत्संविधास्यति।।5.39.12।।
transliteration: matsandeśayutā vācastvattaśśrutvā ca rāghavaḥ| parākramavidhiṃ vīro vidhivatsaṃvidhāsyati
translation: वीरः hero, राघवः Rama, त्वत्तः from you, मत्सन्देशयुताः with repetition of my message, वाचः words, श्रुत्वा after hearing, विधिवत् arrange duly, पराक्रमविधम् following his valour, संविधास्यति will make efforts.
explanation: After hearing my message repeated from you, the heroic Rama will duly make his display of valour.

shloka_text: सीताया वचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधाय वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.39.13।।
transliteration: sītāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā hanumānmārutātmajaḥ| śirasyañjalimādhāya vākyamuttaramabravīt
translation: मारुतात्मजः son of Maruta, हनुमान् Hanuman, सीतायाः Sita's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा after listening, शिरसि on his head, अञ्जलिम् folded palms, आधाय placed, उत्तरम् replied, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: "Having heard Sita's words, Hanuman, son of Maruta, placed his folded palms over his head in reverence and replied:

shloka_text: क्षिप्रमेष्यति काकुत्स्थो हार्यृक्षप्रवरैर्वृतः। यस्ते युधि विजित्यारीन्शोकं व्यपनयिष्यति।।5.39.14।।
transliteration: kṣiprameṣyati kākutstho hāryṛkṣapravarairvṛtaḥ| yaste yudhi vijityārīnśokaṃ vyapanayiṣyati
translation: काकुत्स्थ: Kakutstha, हर्यृक्षप्रवरैः with vanaras and bears, क्षिप्रम् at once, एष्यति he will hasten, यः he, युधि in war, अरीन् enemies, विजित्य winning over, ते your, शोकम् grief, व्यपनयिष्यति will relieve.
explanation: "Kakutstha Rama, accompanied by vanaras and bears will reach here soon and conquer the enemies in war and relieve your grief.

shloka_text: न हि पश्यामि मर्त्येषु नासुरेषु सुरेषु वा। यस्तस्य क्षिपतो बाणान्स्थातुमुत्सहतेऽग्रतः।।5.39.15।।
transliteration: na hi paśyāmi martyeṣu nāsureṣu sureṣu vā| yastasya kṣipato bāṇānsthātumutsahate'grataḥ
translation: यः when he, बाणान् arrows, क्षिपतः while he releases, तस्य  his, अग्रतः in front, स्थातुम् to stand, उत्सहते will have, मर्त्येषु among humans, नासुरेषु or among demons, सुरेषु वा or among gods, न हि पश्यामि I do not see.
explanation: "I do not see any one among humans or demons or even among gods who can face his arrows when released.

shloka_text: अप्यर्कमपि पर्जन्यमपि वैवस्वतं यमम्। स हि सोढुं रणे शक्तस्तव हेतोर्विशेषतः।।5.39.16।।
transliteration: apyarkamapi parjanyamapi vaivasvataṃ yamam| sa hi soḍhuṃ raṇe śaktastava hetorviśeṣataḥ
translation: सः he, रणे in war, अर्कमपि even the Sun, पर्जन्यमपि or the raingod, वैवस्वतम् son of the Sun, यमम् Yama the lord of death, सोढुम् to hear, शक्तः capable, तव हेतोः for you, विशेषतः specially.
explanation: "Indeed, Rama is capable of conquering even the Sungod, or the raingod or Yama (the son of the Sun) specially for your sake.

shloka_text: स हि सागरपर्यन्तां महीं शासितुमीहति। त्वन्निमित्तो हि रामस्य जयो जनकनन्दिनि।।5.39.17।।
transliteration: sa hi sāgaraparyantāṃ mahīṃ śāsitumīhati| tvannimitto hi rāmasya jayo janakanandini
translation: सः he, सागरपर्यन्ताम् surrounded by the entire ocean, महीम् earth, शासितुम् to rule, अर्हति हि is fit, जनकनन्दिनि O Janaka's delight, रामस्य Rama's, जयः victory, त्वन्निमित्तो हि for your sake only.
explanation: "Rama is fit to rule the entire earth surrounded by the ocean. O delight of Janaka he will succeed in serving your cause."

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सम्यक्सत्यं सुभाषितम्। जानकी बहुमेनेऽथ वचनं चेदमब्रवीत्।।5.39.18।।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā samyaksatyaṃ subhāṣitam| jānakī bahumene'tha vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
translation: जानकी Janaki, तस्य his, सत्यम् truth, सम्यक् proper, सुभाषितम् good words, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, बहुमेने held in great esteem, अथ then, इदम् thus, वचनं च and the word, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: On hearing the truthful, proper, pleasing words by Hanuman whom she held in great esteem, Sita said this:

shloka_text: ततस्तं प्रस्थितं सीता वीक्षमाणा पुनः पुनः। भर्तृस्नेहान्वितं वाक्यं सौहार्दादनुमानयत्।।5.39.19।।
transliteration: tatastaṃ prasthitaṃ sītā vīkṣamāṇā punaḥ punaḥ| bhartṛsnehānvitaṃ vākyaṃ sauhārdādanumānayat
translation: ततः then, सीता Sita, प्रस्थितम् ready to start, तम् him, पुनः पुनः again and again, वीक्षमाणा looking at, भर्तृस्नेहान्वितम् conveying her love to Rama, वाक्यम् word, सौहार्दात् goodhearted, अनुमानयत् she made him understand.
explanation: Sita again and again looked at Hanuman who was about to start. She made him understand her words conveying her love for Rama.

shloka_text: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम। कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विश्रान्तःश्वो गमिष्यसि।।5.39.20।।
transliteration: yadi vā manyase vīra vasaikāhamarindama| kasmiṃścitsaṃvṛte deśe viśrāntaḥśvo gamiṣyasi
translation: अरिन्दम O destroyer of enemies, वीर hero, मन्यसे यदि if you  think so, कस्मिंश्चित् some where, संवृते in a closed space, देशे in location, एकाहम् for one day, वस you may stay, विश्रान्तः rest, श्वः tomorrow, गमिष्यसि you may go.
explanation: "O destroyer of enemies if you think of halting for a day you may do so in a solitary location and leave tomorrow.

shloka_text: मम चेदल्पभाग्याया सान्निध्यात्तव वानर। अस्य शोकस्य महतो मुहूर्तं मोक्षणं भवेत्।।5.39.21।।
transliteration: mama cedalpabhāgyāyā sānnidhyāttava vānara| asya śokasya mahato muhūrtaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ bhavet
translation: वानर vanara, तव your, सान्निध्यात् by the presence, अल्पभाग्यायाः of an unfortunate woman, मम to me, महतः great, अस्य शोकस्य from the suffering, मुहूर्तम् for a short while, मोक्षणम् relief, भवेत् चेत् will be.
explanation: "Your presence will relieve me of my suffering, if you stay here for a while.

shloka_text: गते हि हरिशार्दूल पुनरागमनाय तु। प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः।।5.39.22।।
transliteration: gate hi hariśārdūla punarāgamanāya tu| prāṇānāmapi sandeho mama syānnātra saṃśayaḥ
translation: हरिशार्दूल O tiger among vanaras, पुनरागमनाय for your visit once again, गते when you go, मम for me, प्राणानामपि and for my life, सन्देहः doubt, स्यात् will be, अत्र here, सन्देहः doubt, न no.
explanation: "O tiger among vanaras if you leave this place to come again, my life will be uncertain, (if your coming is uncertain). There is no doubt about it.

shloka_text: तवादर्शनजः शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत्। दुःखाद्धुःखपरामृष्टां दीपयन्निव वानर।।5.39.23।।
transliteration: tavādarśanajaḥ śoko bhūyo māṃ paritāpayet| duḥkhāddhuḥkhaparāmṛṣṭāṃ dīpayanniva vānara
translation: वानर vanara, दुःखात् agonised, दुःखपरामृष्टाम् agony increased further, माम् me, तव your, अदर्शनजः not seeing you, शोकः sorrow, दीपयन्निव as if inflamming my agony, भूयः again, परितापयेत् it will trouble me.
explanation: "My agony would be increased further by not seeing you. It would be inflamming my agony and I would be even more pained.

shloka_text: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः। सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वरः।।5.39.24।।
transliteration: ayaṃ ca vīra sandehastiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ| sumahāṃstvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu harīśvaraḥ
translation: वीर hero, हरीश्वर chief of vanaras, त्वत्सहायेषु your helpless, हर्यृक्षेषु among vanaras and bears, अयम् this, सुमहान् great, सन्देहः doubtful, मम अग्रतः in front of me, तिष्ठतीव dwells in my mind.
explanation: "O heroic chief of vanaras I am doubtful as to whether vanaras and bears can extend help?

shloka_text: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम्। तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ।।5.39.25।।
transliteration: kathaṃ nu khalu duṣpāraṃ tariṣyanti mahodadhim| tāni haryṛkṣasainyāni tau vā naravarātmajau
translation: तानि those, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि army of vanaras and bears, तौ they both, Rama and Lakshmana, नरवरात्मजौ princes, दुष्पारम् difficult to cross, महोदधिम्  ocean, कथं नु how indeed, तरिष्यन्ति they can cross.
explanation: "How can the army of vanaras and bears, for that matter, princes Rama and Lakshmana negotiate the ocean, which is difficult to cross?

shloka_text: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने। शक्तिस्स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा।।5.39.26।।
transliteration: trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṃ sāgarasyāsya laṅghane| śaktissyādvainateyasya tava vā mārutasya vā
translation: अस्य of this, सागरस्य ocean's, लङ्घने to leap, वैनतेयस्य वा for Bainateya (Garuda) or, तव वा or you, मारुतस्य or Windgod वा or, त्रयाणाम् for these three, भूतानाम् living beings, शक्तिः energy, स्यात् have.
explanation: "It is only three beings who have the capacity to leap over this ocean. Garuda, or you or the Windgod.

shloka_text: तदस्मिन्कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे। किं पश्यसि समाधानं त्वं हि कार्यविदां वरः।।5.39.27।।
transliteration: tadasminkāryaniryoge vīraivaṃ duratikrame| kiṃ paśyasi samādhānaṃ tvaṃ hi kāryavidāṃ varaḥ
translation: वीर hero, तत् such, एवम् in that way, दुरतिक्रमे in a very difficult task, अस्मिन् in this, कार्यनिर्योगे the task, किम् what, समाधानम् means, पश्यसि you foresee, त्वम् you, कार्यविदाम् among those who are capable, वरः हि foremost.
explanation: "What means do you, being the foremost hero among the three who are capable performing this difficult task, foresee?

shloka_text: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने। पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते फलोदयः।।5.39.28।।
transliteration: kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane| paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste phalodayaḥ
translation: परवीरघ्न slayer of enemy heroes, अस्य कार्यस्य this task, परिसाधने to accomplish, त्वम् you, एक एव alone are, पर्याप्तः कामम् are competent, ते to you, फलोदयः fruit, यशस्यः of the accomplishment.
explanation: "O slayer of enemy heroes if you alone can accomplish this task the fame of doing this will be yours.

shloka_text: बलैस्समग्रैर्यदि मां रावणं जित्य संयुगे। विजयी स्वपुरं यायात्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्।।5.39.29।।
transliteration: balaissamagrairyadi māṃ rāvaṇaṃ jitya saṃyuge| vijayī svapuraṃ yāyāttattasya sadṛśaṃ bhavet
translation: संयुगे in war, समग्रैः with  the entire, बलैः with army, रावणम् Ravana, जित्य after winning, माम् me, विजयी victorious , स्वपुरम् his own city, यायात् यदि if he can reach, तत् that, तस्य his, सदृशम् worthy of him, भवेत् will be.
explanation: "It would be worthy of Rama if he with his entire army emerges victorious over Ravana in a battle and takes me to his city.

shloka_text: शरैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः। मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थः तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्।।5.39.30।।
transliteration: śaraistu saṅkulāṃ kṛtvā laṅkāṃ parabalārdanaḥ| māṃ nayedyadi kākutsthaḥ tattasya sadṛśaṃ bhavet
translation: परबलार्दनः slayer of enemy army, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, लङ्काम् Lanka, शरैः with arrows, सङ्कुलाम् an agitated place, कृत्वा does, माम् me, नयेद्यदि if he takes, तत् that, तस्य his action, सदृशम् agreeable, भवेत् will be.
explanation: "If Kakutstha (Rama), slayer of the enemy army fills the entire Lanka with his arrows and takes me, then his action will be worthy of him.

shloka_text: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः। भवेदाहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय।।5.39.31।।
transliteration: tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṃ mahātmanaḥ| bhavedāhavaśūrasya tathā tvamupapādaya
translation: तत् that, महात्मनः of the great self, आहवशूरस्य of the hero in war, तस्य his, अनुरूपम् worthy of him, विक्रान्तम् victorious, यथा in such a way, भवेत् will be, तथा in that way, त्वम् you, उपपादय you may make arrangement.
explanation: "You may make arrangement in such a manner that, that great self, the hero in war makes his victorious march which is worthy of him."

shloka_text: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम्। निशम्य हनुमान्शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.39.32।।
transliteration: tadarthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ praśritaṃ hetusaṃhitam| niśamya hanumānśeṣaṃ vākyamuttaramabravīt
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अर्थोपहितम् meaningful, प्रश्रितम् courteous, हेतुसंहितम् logical, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य having heard, शेषम् the rest, वाक्यम् word, अब्रवीत् said, उत्तरं in reply.
explanation: Having heard the meaningful, courteous and logical words of Sita, Hanuman replied:

shloka_text: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः। सुग्रीवस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः।।5.39.33।।
transliteration: devi haryṛkṣasainyānāmīśvaraḥ plavatāṃ varaḥ| sugrīvassattvasampannastavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ
translation: देवि Devi, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानाम् of the army of vanaras and bears, ईश्वरः lord, प्लवतां वरः foremost among monkeys, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with satvaguna, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तव अर्धे for your sake, कृतनिश्चयः detemined to accomplish.
explanation: "O Devi the lord of monkeys, Sugriva heads the army of vanaras and bears. He is richly endowed with satvaguna and is determined to accomplish your cause and free you from sorrow.

shloka_text: स वानरसहस्राणां कोटीभिरभिसंवृतः। क्षिप्रमेष्यति वैदेहि राक्षसानां निबर्हणः।।5.39.34।।
transliteration: sa vānarasahasrāṇāṃ koṭībhirabhisaṃvṛtaḥ| kṣiprameṣyati vaidehi rākṣasānāṃ nibarhaṇaḥ
translation: वैदेहि Vaidehi, सः he, the Sugriva, वानरसहस्राणाम् of thousands of vanaras, कोटीभिः with crores of them, अभिसंवृतः is surrounded, राक्षसानाम् of all the ogres, निबर्हणः will destroy, क्षिप्रम् swiftly, एष्यति he will reach.
explanation: "O Vaidehi Sugriva will reach this place with thousands of crores of vanaras very soon and would kill all the ogres.

shloka_text: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नास्सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। मनस्सङ्कल्पसम्पाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः।।5.39.35।।
transliteration: tasya vikramasampannāssattvavanto mahābalāḥ| manassaṅkalpasampātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ
translation: विक्रमसम्पन्नाः powerful, सत्त्ववन्तः virtuous, महाबलाः mighty, मनस्सङ्कल्पसम्पाताः who can leap with the speed of mind, हरयः vanaras, तस्य his, निदेशे at his command, स्थिताः awaiting.
explanation: "Valiant, virtuous and powerful vanaras who can leap with the speed of mind are awaiting orders (of Sugriva).

shloka_text: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक्सज्जते गतिः। न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः।।5.39.36।।
transliteration: yeṣāṃ nopari nādhastānna tiryaksajjate gatiḥ| na ca karmasu sīdanti mahatsvamitatejasaḥ
translation: येषाम् for those monkeys, गतिः movement, उपरि upward, न सज्जते  do not get impeded, अधस्तात्  downward, न not, तिर्यक्  horizontally, न not, अमिततेजसः very brilliant ones, महत्सु any kind, कर्मसु of task, न सीदन्ति do not care
explanation: "Their course cannot be impeded either upward, or downward or right or left. They  are indeed very brilliant and would never fail in any task.

shloka_text: असकृत्तैर्महोत्साहैस्ससागरधराधरा। प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः।।5.39.37।।
transliteration: asakṛttairmahotsāhaissasāgaradharādharā| pradakṣiṇīkṛtā bhūmirvāyumārgānusāribhiḥ
translation: महोत्साहैः by the enthusiastic, वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः following aerial path, तैः by them, असकृत् repeatedly, ससागरधराधरा with the oceans and mountains, भूमिः earth, प्रदक्षिणीकृता has been circumambulated.
explanation: "They have often circumambulated the earth including its oceans and mountains through the aerial path with great enthusiasm.

shloka_text: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः। मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ।।5.39.38।।
transliteration: madviśiṣṭāśca tulyāśca santi tatra vanaukasaḥ| mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścinnāsti sugrīvasannidhau
translation: तत्र there, मद्विशिष्टाश्च more powerful than me, तुल्याश्च those equal to me, वनौकसः vanaras who move in the forest, सन्ति are, मत्तः to me, प्रत्यवरः inferior, कश्चित् not even one, सुग्रीवसन्निधौ under Sugriva, नास्ति not there.
explanation: "The vanaras under Sugriva who move in the forest are more powerful than me or equal to me. None is inferior to me.

shloka_text: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः। न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेष्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः।।5.39.39।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tāvadiha prāptaḥ kiṃ punaste mahābalāḥ| na hi prakṛṣṭāḥ preṣyante preṣyante hītare janāḥ
translation: अहं तावत् I have, इह here, अनुप्राप्तः reached, महाबलाः very powerful, ते to you, किं पुनः why not others, प्रकृष्टाः the best ones, न प्रेष्यन्ते हि will not be sent, इतरे others, जनाः ordinary ones, प्रेष्यन्ते हि will be sent.
explanation: "If I have managed to come here, why not the other powerful ones? The superior leaders are not sent (as messengers). Only ordinary ones like me are.

shloka_text: तदलं परितापेन देवि शोको व्यपैतु ते। एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः।।5.39.40।।
transliteration: tadalaṃ paritāpena devi śoko vyapaitu te| ekotpātena te laṅkāmeṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ
translation: देवि noble lady, तत् therefore, परितापेन with lamentation, अलम् enough, ते your, शोकः agony, व्यपैतु may be given up, ते those, हरियूथपाः monkey troops, एकोत्पातेन in one stride, लङ्काम् to Lanka, एष्यन्ति will reach.
explanation: "O noble lady therefore, give up your agony. Enough of your lamentation. The monkey troops will reach this place in one stride.

shloka_text: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ। त्वत्सकाशं महासत्त्वौ नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः।।5.39.41।।
transliteration: mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāvivoditau| tvatsakāśaṃ mahāsattvau nṛsiṃhāvāgamiṣyataḥ
translation: महासत्त्वौ both great men, नृसिंहौ both lions among men, तौ च and both, मम my, पृष्ठगतौ on my back, उदितौ just risen, चन्द्रसूर्याविव like Sun and Moon, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, आगमिष्यतः will come.
explanation: "Both the valiant Rama and Lakshmana, lions among men, looking brilliant like Sun and Moon will come to you riding on my back.

shloka_text: ततो वीरौ नरवरौ सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कां सायकैर्विधमिष्यतः।।5.39.42।।
transliteration: tato vīrau naravarau sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau| āgamya nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ sāyakairvidhamiṣyataḥ
translation: ततः then, वीरौ two heroes, नरवरौ both the princes, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, सहितौ together, आगम्य on coming, लङ्कां नगरीम् to the city of Lanka, सायकैः with their arrows, विधमिष्यतः will blow away.
explanation: "Both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana will come and blow up the city of Lanka with their unfailing arrows.

shloka_text: सगणं रावणं हत्त्वा राघवो रघुनन्दनः। त्वामादाय वरारोहे स्वपुरीं प्रतियास्यति।।5.39.43।।
transliteration: sagaṇaṃ rāvaṇaṃ hattvā rāghavo raghunandanaḥ| tvāmādāya varārohe svapurīṃ pratiyāsyati
translation: वरारोहे O beautiful lady, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghu race, राघवः Rama, सगणम् along with his kins, रावणम् Ravana, हत्त्वा on killing, त्वाम् you, आदाय after taking you, स्वपुरीम् their city, प्रतियास्यति would go back.
explanation: "O beautiful lady Raghava, the delight of the Raghu race would kill Ravana and his kins and return with you to his city৷৷

shloka_text: तदाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते भव त्वं कालकाङ्क्षिणी। नचिराद्द्रक्ष्यसे रामं प्रज्वलन्तमिवानलम्।।5.39.44।।
transliteration: tadāśvasihi bhadraṃ te bhava tvaṃ kālakāṅkṣiṇī| nacirāddrakṣyase rāmaṃ prajvalantamivānalam
translation: तत् therefore, आश्वसिहि rest assured, ते भद्रम् let it be auspicious to you, त्वम् you, कालकाङ्क्षिणी count your time, भव be, प्रज्वलन्तम् burning, अनलम् इव like the fire, रामम् Rama, नचिरात् shortly, द्रक्ष्यसे would see.
explanation: "Therefore, count the days and rest assured. Let it be auspicious to you. You will shortly see Rama burning like fire.

shloka_text: निहते राक्षसेन्द्रेऽस्मिन्सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे। त्वं समेष्वसि रामेण शशाङ्केनेव रोहिणी।।5.39.45।।
transliteration: nihate rākṣasendre'sminsaputrāmātyabāndhave| tvaṃ sameṣvasi rāmeṇa śaśāṅkeneva rohiṇī
translation: सपुत्रामात्यबान्धवे along with his sons, ministers and relatives, अस्मिन् when, राक्षसेन्द्रे the king of demons, निहते killed, त्वम् you, रोहिणी Rohini, शशाङ्केनेव like the Moon, रामेण with Rama, समेष्यसि you will reunite.
explanation: "When Ravana is slain, with his sons, ministers and kith and kin, you will reunite with Rama as Rohini unites with the Moon.

shloka_text: क्षिप्रं त्वं देवि शोकस्य पारं यास्यसि मैथिलि। रावणं चैव रामेण निहतं द्रक्ष्यसेऽचिरात्।।5.39.46।।
transliteration: kṣipraṃ tvaṃ devi śokasya pāraṃ yāsyasi maithili| rāvaṇaṃ caiva rāmeṇa nihataṃ drakṣyase'cirāt
translation: देवि queen, मैथिलि Mythili, त्वम् you, क्षिप्रम् soon, शोकस्य grief, पारम् to the other shore, यास्यसि will go, अचिरात् very shortly, रामेण by Rama, रावणम् Ravana, निहतं slain, द्रक्ष्यसे चैव you will see.
explanation: "O queen Mythili you come to the end of your sorrow and will soon see Ravana killed by Rama".

shloka_text: एवमाश्वास्य वैदेहीं हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। गमनाय मतिं कृत्वा वैदेहीं पुनरब्रवीत्।।5.39.47।।
transliteration: evamāśvāsya vaidehīṃ hanumānmārutātmajaḥ| gamanāya matiṃ kṛtvā vaidehīṃ punarabravīt
translation: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, एवम् in that manner, आश्वास्य having consoled, गमनाय to depart, मतिम् thought, कृत्वा after resolving, पुनः again, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Having thus consoled Vaidehi, Hanuman, son of the Windgod resolved to depart. Once again he spoke to Vadehi:

shloka_text: तमरिघ्नं कृतात्मानं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्। लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपागतम्।।5.39.48।।
transliteration: tamarighnaṃ kṛtātmānaṃ kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāghavam| lakṣmaṇaṃ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṃ laṅkādvāramupāgatam
translation: लङ्काद्वारम् at the entrance of Lanka, उपागतम् reached, अरिघ्नम् slayer of foes, कृतात्मानम् an accomplished man, तं राघवम् that Rama, धनुष्पाणिम् wielder of bow, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, क्षिप्रम् very soon, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: "Very soon you would see the slayer of foes, who is an accomplished wielder of the bow (Rama) along with Lakshmana at the entrance of Lanka.

shloka_text: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान्वीरान्सिम्हशार्दूलविक्रमान्। वानरान्वारणेन्द्राभान्क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि सङ्गतान्।।5.39.49।।
transliteration: nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhānvīrānsimhaśārdūlavikramān| vānarānvāraṇendrābhānkṣipraṃ drakṣyasi saṅgatān
translation: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् whose nails and teeth are their weapons, वीरान् heroes, सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान् resembling lion and tiger in valour, वारणेन्द्राभान् who resemble wellbred elephants, सङ्गतान् reach, वानरान् vanaras, क्षिप्रम् soon, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see.
explanation: "You will soon see heroic vanaras whose weapons are their teeth, who are like lion and tiger in their valour. They are (mighty) like wellbred elephants.

shloka_text: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु। नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामार्ये यूधान्यनेकशः।।5.39.50।।
transliteration: śailāmbudanikāśānāṃ laṅkāmalayasānuṣu| nardatāṃ kapimukhyānāmārye yūdhānyanekaśaḥ
translation: आर्ये respectable lady, शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानाम् whose body is like clouds on mountain, नर्दताम् of the roaring, कपिमुख्यानाम् of the chiefs of vanaras, अनेकशः  in many ways, यूधानि troops, लङ्कामलयसानुषु on the  mountain of Lanka.
explanation: "O respectable lady you would see many troops of vanara chiefs who resemble clouds hovering on the mountain peaks of Lankaroaring.

shloka_text: स तु मर्मणि घोरेण ताडितो मन्मथेषुणा। न शर्म लभते रामस्सिंहार्धित इव द्विपः।।5.39.51।।
transliteration: sa tu marmaṇi ghoreṇa tāḍito manmatheṣuṇā| na śarma labhate rāmassiṃhārdhita iva dvipaḥ
translation: सः रामः that Rama, घोरेण by the dreadful, मन्मथेषुणा arrows of god of love, मर्मणि pierced into vitals, ताडितः hit, सिंहार्दितः hit by a lion, द्विपः इव like an elephant, न शर्म लभते is not happy
explanation: "Rama is tormented by the dreadful arrows of the god of love pierced into vitals, like an elephant hit by a lion. He has no happiness in life.

shloka_text: मा रुदो देवि शोकेन माभूत्ते मनसोऽप्रियम्। शचीव पत्या शक्रेण भर्त्रा नाथवती ह्यसि।।5.39.52।।
transliteration: mā rudo devi śokena mābhūtte manaso'priyam| śacīva patyā śakreṇa bhartrā nāthavatī hyasi
translation: देवि devi, शोकेन with sorrow, मा रुदः do not cry, ते your, मनसः in mind, अप्रियम् unpleasant, माभूत् no thought be entertained, पत्या with a husband शक्रेण to Indra, शचीव like Sachi, भर्त्रा by your husband, नाथवती you have a great husband, असि हि you are.
explanation: "O devi weep no more.Entertain no unpleasant thoughts.You have a great husband, just as Sachi has her lord Indra.

shloka_text: रामाद्विशिष्टः कोऽन्योऽस्ति कश्चित्सौमित्रिणा समः। अग्निमारुतकल्पौ तौ भ्रातरौ तव संश्रयौ।।5.39.53।।
transliteration: rāmādviśiṣṭaḥ ko'nyo'sti kaścitsaumitriṇā samaḥ| agnimārutakalpau tau bhrātarau tava saṃśrayau
translation: रामात् than Rama, विशिष्टः more distinguished, अन्यः others, कः who is there, अस्ति is, सौमित्रिणा to Lakshmana, समः equal, कश्चित् who is there, अग्निमारुतकल्पौ equal to fire and wind, तौ भ्रातरौ both brothers, तव your, संश्रयौ they are your refuge.
explanation: "Who is superior to Rama? Who is equal to Lakshmana? Both the brothers are like Fire and Wind. They are your refuge.

shloka_text: नास्मिंश्चिरं वत्स्यसि देवि देशे रक्षोगणैरध्युषितेऽतिरौद्रे। न ते चिरादामगमनं प्रियस्य क्षमस्व मत्सङ्गमकालमात्रम्।।5.39.54।।
transliteration: nāsmiṃściraṃ vatsyasi devi deśe rakṣogaṇairadhyuṣite'tiraudre| na te cirādāmagamanaṃ priyasya kṣamasva matsaṅgamakālamātram
translation: देवि noble lady, रक्षोगणैः by the hosts of ogres, अध्युषिते in a stronghold, अतिरौद्रे in a dreadful place, अस्मिन् देशे country, चिरम् not very long, न वत्स्यसि will not stay, ते प्रियस्य with your beloved, आगमनम् coming, न चिरात् not very long, मत्सङ्गमकालमात्रम् for this period, क्षमस्व pardon me.
explanation: "O noble lady You will not stay longer in this country, which is a strong hold of hosts of demons and a dreadful place It will not be very long before you unite with your beloved. Pray, have  patience till then. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य वायुसूनोर्महात्मनः। उवाचात्महितं वाक्यं सीता सुरसुतोपमा।।5.40.1।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya vāyusūnormahātmanaḥ| uvācātmahitaṃ vākyaṃ sītā surasutopamā
translation: महात्मनः great soul, तस्य his, वायुसूनोः son of the Windgod, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सुरसुतोपमा like the daughter of gods, सीता Sita, आत्महितम् for her benefit, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Sita who was like the daughter of the gods heard the son of the Windgod for her benefit and replied:
comments: Sita permits Hanuman to depart

shloka_text: त्वां दृष्ट्वा प्रियवक्तारं सम्प्रहृष्यामि वानरः। अर्धसञ्जातसस्येव वृष्टिं प्राप्य वसुन्धरा।।5.40.2।।
transliteration: tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā priyavaktāraṃ samprahṛṣyāmi vānaraḥ| ardhasañjātasasyeva vṛṣṭiṃ prāpya vasundharā
translation: वानर vanara, प्रियवक्तारम् who has been speaking pleasing words, त्वाम् you दृष्ट्वा after seeing, अर्धसञ्जातसस्या as half grown, वसुन्धरा earth, वृष्टिम् rain, प्राप्येव as if begotten, सम्प्रहृष्यामि I feel happy.
explanation: "O vanara just as the earth feels happy when the half grown crops receive rain, I feel happy after seeing you. You have been speaking pleasing words

shloka_text: यथा तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं गात्रैश्शोकाभिकर्शितैः। संस्पृशेयं सकामाहं तथा कुरु दयां मयि।।5.40.3।।
transliteration: yathā taṃ puruṣavyāghraṃ gātraiśśokābhikarśitaiḥ| saṃspṛśeyaṃ sakāmāhaṃ tathā kuru dayāṃ mayi
translation: सकामम् a passionate lady, अहम् I, शोकाभिकर्शितैः emaciated with suffering, गात्रैः with limbs, तं पुरुषव्याघ्रम् him that tiger among men, यथा as, संस्पृशेयम् I may touch, तथा in that way, मयि in me, दयाम् kindness, कुरु do.
explanation: "Be kind to me and act in such a manner that I may embrace my lord passionately with my body emaciated with grief.

shloka_text: अभिज्ञानं च रामस्य दद्या हरिगणोत्तम। क्षिप्तामिषीकां काकस्य कोपादेकाक्षिशातनीम्।।5.40.4।।
transliteration: abhijñānaṃ ca rāmasya dadyā harigaṇottama| kṣiptāmiṣīkāṃ kākasya kopādekākṣiśātanīm
translation: हरिगणोत्तम best leader of the vanaras, कोपात् with anger, क्षिप्ताम् released, काकस्य crow's, एकाक्षिशातनीम् blinding one eye, इषीकाम् by a blade of grass, रामस्य to Rama, अभिज्ञानम् as a token, दद्याः give.
explanation: "O best leader of vanaras remind Rama about the incident of the release of a blade of grass in anger blinding one of the eyes of the crow narrated to you.

shloka_text: मनश्शिलायास्तिलको गण्डपार्श्वे निवेशितः। त्वया प्रणष्टे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि।।5.40.5।।
transliteration: manaśśilāyāstilako gaṇḍapārśve niveśitaḥ| tvayā praṇaṣṭe tilake taṃ kila smartumarhasi
translation: तिलके when tilaka mark, प्रणष्टे got erased, त्वया by you, मनश्शिलायाः with a grind stone, तिलकः tilaka (mark on forehead), गण्डपार्श्वे stone near by, निवेशितः किल painted indeed, तम् that tilaka, स्मर्तुम् to remember, अर्हसि you will.
explanation: '(Further remind him), 'When my tilaka mark was erased, you painted tilaka with a stone (manassita pigment) nearby. O Rama you should remember that (incident).

shloka_text: स वीर्यवान्कथं सीतां हृतां समनुमन्यसे। वसन्तीं रक्षसां मध्ये महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः।।5.40.6।।
transliteration: sa vīryavānkathaṃ sītāṃ hṛtāṃ samanumanyase| vasantīṃ rakṣasāṃ madhye mahendravaruṇopamaḥ
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, महेन्द्रवरुणोपमः comparable to Varuna and Indra, सः Rama, हृताम् seized, रक्षसाम् of rakshasas, मध्ये in the midst of, वसन्तीम् dwelling, सीताम् Sita, कथम् how, समनुमन्यसे he will agree.
explanation: 'Rama you are like Indra and Varuna in valiance. How are you tolerating Sita seized, dwelling among the demons?

shloka_text: एष चूडामणिर्दिव्यो मया सुपरिरक्षितः। एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्यामि व्यसने त्वामिवानघ।।5.40.7।।
transliteration: eṣa cūḍāmaṇirdivyo mayā suparirakṣitaḥ| etaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣyāmi vyasane tvāmivānagha
translation: अनघ sinless, दिव्यः wonderful, एषः this, चूडामणिः Chudamani, मया of mine, सुपरिरक्षितः carefully safe guared, व्यसने in distress, एतम् this one, दृष्ट्वा seeing, त्वामिव like you here, प्रहृष्यामि look at it.
explanation: "O sinless Rama this wonderful Chudamani of mine has been carefully safeguarded. Seeing this is like seeing you when I am in distress.

shloka_text: एष निर्यातितश्श्रीमान्मया ते वारिसम्भवः। अतः परं न शक्ष्यामि जीवितुं शोकलालसा।।5.40.8।।
transliteration: eṣa niryātitaśśrīmānmayā te vārisambhavaḥ| ataḥ paraṃ na śakṣyāmi jīvituṃ śokalālasā
translation: श्रीमान् glorious one, वारिसम्भवः born of the sea, एषः this, ते to you, निर्यातितः is returned, शोकलालसा engrossed in grief, अतः परम् beyond this, जीवितुम् to live, न शक्ष्यामि it is not possible for me.
explanation: "I am sending you this (Chudamani) born of the sea. O glorious Rama and now engrossed in grief it is not possible for me to live.

shloka_text: असह्यानि च दुःखानि वाचश्च हृदयच्छिदः। राक्षसीनां सुघोराणां त्वत्कृते मर्षयाम्यहम्।।5.40.9।।
transliteration: asahyāni ca duḥkhāni vācaśca hṛdayacchidaḥ| rākṣasīnāṃ sughorāṇāṃ tvatkṛte marṣayāmyaham
translation: अहम् I, असह्यानि unbearable, दुःखानि grief, सुघोराणाम् of dreadful ones, राक्षसीनाम् of ogresses, हृदयच्छिदः piercing my heart, वाचश्च utterings, त्वत्कृते your sake, मर्षयामि I am enduring.
explanation: "I am tolerating this unbearable grief, and the words of the dreadful ogresses piercing my heart. Only for you.

shloka_text: धारयिष्यामि मासं तु जीवितं शत्रुसूदन। ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीविष्ये त्वया हीना नृपात्मज।।5.40.10।।
transliteration: dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṃ tu jīvitaṃ śatrusūdana| ūrdhvaṃ māsānna jīviṣye tvayā hīnā nṛpātmaja
translation: शत्रुसूदन O subduer of enemies, नृपात्मज O prince, मासं तु for one month only, जीवितम् life, धारयिष्यामि will survive, त्वया you, हीना separated, मासात् for one month only, ऊर्ध्वम् beyond that, न जीविष्ये will not live.
explanation: "O subduer of enemies O prince I will hold on to life only for a month. I will not survive beyond a month in your absence.

shloka_text: घोरो राक्षसराजोऽयं दृष्टिश्च न सुखा मयि। त्वां च श्रुत्वा विपद्यन्तं न जीवेयमहं क्षणम्।।5.40.11।।
transliteration: ghoro rākṣasarājo'yaṃ dṛṣṭiśca na sukhā mayi| tvāṃ ca śrutvā vipadyantaṃ na jīveyamahaṃ kṣaṇam
translation: अयम् this, राक्षसराजः demon king, घोरः fearsome, मयि at me, दृष्टिः look, सुखा moral, न no, त्वाम् you, विपद्यन्तम् facing calamities, श्रुत्वा hearing, अहम् I, क्षणम् even a moment, न जीवेयम् I will not survive.
explanation: "The demon king is frightful. He looks at me with immoral (lusty) eyes. I do not wish to live even for a moment after hearing about the adversities (you have faced)."

shloka_text: वैदेह्या वचनं श्रुत्वा करुणं साश्रु भाषितम्। अथाब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः।।5.40.12।।
transliteration: vaidehyā vacanaṃ śrutvā karuṇaṃ sāśru bhāṣitam| athābravīnmahātejā hanumānmārutātmajaḥ
translation: अथ then, महातेजाः a brilliant one, मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, हनुमान् Hanuman, साश्रु weeping, भाषितम् words spoken, करुणम् piteously, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Hearing the words of Sita who was weeping piteously, brilliant Hanuman said this:

shloka_text: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन ते शपे। रामे दुःखाभिभूते तु लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते।।5.40.13।।
transliteration: tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena te śape| rāme duḥkhābhibhūte tu lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate
translation: देवि O irreproachable lady, रामः Rama, त्वच्छोकविमुखः out of grief he is not showing any  interest in life, सत्येन truly, ते to you, शपे I promise, रामे when Rama, दुःखाभिभूते he is in grief, लक्ष्मणः च even Lakshmana, परितप्यते is immersed in sorrow.
explanation: "O irreproachable lady I swear by you that Rama has grown averse to everything out of grief of separation from you. When Rama is in grief even Lakshmana gets immersed in sorrow.

shloka_text: कथञ्चिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम्। इमं मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि।।5.40.14।।
transliteration: kathañcidbhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ pariśocitum| imaṃ muhūrtaṃ duḥkhānāmantaṃ drakṣyasi bhāmini
translation: कथञ्चित् somehow, भवती you, दृष्टा seen, परिशोचितम् to worry, कालः time, न not, भामिनि a beautiful lady, इमम् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, दुःखानाम् for grief, अन्तम् end, द्रक्ष्यसि you can see.
explanation: "O beautiful lady somehow I could meet you. This is not the time to worry about. You will see the end of suffering at this very moment.

shloka_text: तावुभौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ राजपुत्रावरिन्दमौ। त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ लङ्कां भस्मीकरिष्यतः।।5.40.15।।
transliteration: tāvubhau puruṣavyāghrau rājaputrāvarindamau| tvaddarśanakṛtotsāhau laṅkāṃ bhasmīkariṣyataḥ
translation: पुरुषव्याघ्रौ tigers among men, अरिन्दमौ crusher of enemies, त्वद्दर्शनकृतोत्साहौ very determined to see you, उभौ both, तौ राजपुत्रौ both the princes, लङ्काम् Lanka, भस्मीकरिष्यतः will reduce to ashes.
explanation: "Both the princes are tigers among men and crushers of enemies. They are determined to see you, and will reduce Lanka to ashes.

shloka_text: हत्त्वा च समरे क्रूरं रावणं सहबान्धवम्। राघवौ त्वां विशालाक्षि स्वां पुरीं प्रापयिष्यतः।।5.40.16।।
transliteration: hattvā ca samare krūraṃ rāvaṇaṃ sahabāndhavam| rāghavau tvāṃ viśālākṣi svāṃ purīṃ prāpayiṣyataḥ
translation: विशालाक्षि largeeyed one, राघवः Rama, समरे in war, सहबान्धवम् along with relatives, क्रूरम् vile, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा after killing, स्वां पुरीं प्रति to his own city, त्वाम् you, प्रापयिष्यतः will take you back.
explanation: "O largeeyed lady Killing in war the vile Ravana, the demon king and all his relatives, Rama would take you back to his own city৷৷

shloka_text: यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते। प्रीतिसञ्जननं तस्य भूयस्त्वं दातुमर्हसि।।5.40.17।।
transliteration: yattu rāmo vijānīyādabhijñānamanindite| prītisañjananaṃ tasya bhūyastvaṃ dātumarhasi
translation: अनिन्दिते blameless lady, रामः Rama, यत् that which, अभिज्ञानम् knows, विजानीयात् to identify you, तस्य your, प्रीतिसञ्जननम् that which makes him more happy, भूयः one more, त्वम् you, दातुम् may give, अर्हसि is proper.
explanation: "O unimpeachable lady give one more identification which would make him more happy".

shloka_text: साब्रवीद्दत्तमेवेति मयाभिज्ञानमुत्तमम्। एतदेव हि रामस्य दृष्ट्वा मत्केशभूषणम्।।5.40.18।। श्रद्धेयं हनुमन्वाक्यं तव वीर भविष्यति।
transliteration: sābravīddattameveti mayābhijñānamuttamam| etadeva hi rāmasya dṛṣṭvā matkeśabhūṣaṇam śraddheyaṃ hanumanvākyaṃ tava vīra bhaviṣyati|
translation: मया mine, उत्तमम् best, अभिज्ञानम् identification, दत्तमेव already given, इति this, सा she, अब्रवीत् said, वीर hero, हनुमान् Hanuman, एतत् all this, मत्केशभूषणम् my jewel for the hair, दृष्ट्वा seeing, तव his, वाक्यम् words, रामस्य Rama's, श्रद्धेयम् what you tell, भविष्यति will believe.
explanation: "I have already given the best identification. When you hand this jewel used on my hair to him,  he will believe what you tell him".

shloka_text: स तं मणिवरं गृह्य श्रीमान्प्लवगसत्तमः।।5.40.19।। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवीं गमनायोपचक्रमे।
transliteration: sa taṃ maṇivaraṃ gṛhya śrīmānplavagasattamaḥ praṇamya śirasā devīṃ gamanāyopacakrame|
translation: श्रीमान् illustrious one, सः he, प्लवगसत्तमः best of vanaras, मणिवरम् best jewel, गृह्य holding, देवीम् to Sita, शिरसा by his head, प्रणम्य prostrated, गमनाय to depart, उपचक्रमे started.
explanation: The illustrious vanara held the ornament, prostrated to Sita and prepared to depart.

shloka_text: तमुत्पातकृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य हरिपुङ्गवम्।।5.40.20।। वर्धमानं महावेगमुवाच जनकात्मजा। अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा।।5.40.21।।
transliteration: tamutpātakṛtotsāhamavekṣya haripuṅgavam vardhamānaṃ mahāvegamuvāca janakātmajā| aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpagadgadayā girā
translation: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, उत्पातकृतोत्साहम् risen up eager to leap, वर्धमानम् enlarging, महावेगम् very swiftly, तं हरिपुङ्गवम् him the chief of vanaras, आवेक्ष्य looking at him, अश्रुपूर्णमुखी her face filled with tears, दीना pitiably, बाष्पगद्गदया throat choked with tears, गिरा with these words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Seeing Hanuman eager to leap, enlarging his body quickly, she appeared pitiable with her face filled with tears and throat choked.

shloka_text: तमुत्पातकृतोत्साहमवेक्ष्य हरिपुङ्गवम्।।5.40.20।। वर्धमानं महावेगमुवाच जनकात्मजा। अश्रुपूर्णमुखी दीना बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा।।5.40.21।।
transliteration: tamutpātakṛtotsāhamavekṣya haripuṅgavam vardhamānaṃ mahāvegamuvāca janakātmajā| aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā bāṣpagadgadayā girā
translation: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, उत्पातकृतोत्साहम् risen up eager to leap, वर्धमानम् enlarging, महावेगम् very swiftly, तं हरिपुङ्गवम् him the chief of vanaras, आवेक्ष्य looking at him, अश्रुपूर्णमुखी her face filled with tears, दीना pitiably, बाष्पगद्गदया throat choked with tears, गिरा with these words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: Seeing Hanuman eager to leap, enlarging his body quickly, she appeared pitiable with her face filled with tears and throat choked.

shloka_text: हनुमन्सिंहसङ्काशौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। सुग्रीवं च सहामात्यं सर्वान् ब्रूयाह्यनामयम्।।5.40.22।।
transliteration: hanumansiṃhasaṅkāśau bhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau| sugrīvaṃ ca sahāmātyaṃ sarvān brūyāhyanāmayam
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, भ्रातरौ brothers, सिंहसङ्काशौ both comparable to lion, रामलक्ष्मणौ to Rama and Lakshmana, सहामात्यम् along with ministers, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, सर्वान् to all, अनामयम् wellbeing, ब्रूयाः convey.
explanation: "O Hanuman to the lionlike brothers Rama and Lakshmana, to Sugriva  including his ministers and to every one convey my good wishes.

shloka_text: यथा च स महाबाहुर्मां तारयति राघवः। अस्माद्दु:खाम्बुसम्रोधात्त्वं समाधातुमर्हसि।।5.40.23।।
transliteration: yathā ca sa mahābāhurmāṃ tārayati rāghavaḥ| asmāddu:khāmbusamrodhāttvaṃ samādhātumarhasi
translation: महाबाहुः mightyarmed, सः राघवः that Rama, अस्मात् from this, दुःखाम्बुसंशेधात् from this ocean of sorrow, यथा in such a way, तारयति will help to cross, त्वम् you, समाधातुम् to make efforts, अर्हसि it is proper.
explanation: "You should make efforts in such a manner that the mightyarmed Rama will help me in crossing the cean of sorrow.

shloka_text: इमं च तीव्रं मम शोकवेगं रक्षोभिरेभिः परिभर्त्सनं च। ब्रूयास्तु रामस्य गतस्समीपम् शिवश्च तेऽध्वाऽस्तु हरिप्रवीर।।5.40.24।।
transliteration: imaṃ ca tīvraṃ mama śokavegaṃ rakṣobhirebhiḥ paribhartsanaṃ ca| brūyāstu rāmasya gatassamīpam śivaśca te'dhvā'stu haripravīra
translation: हरिप्रवीर foremost vanara, रामस्य to Rama, समीपम् near, गतः after going, मम my, इमम् this, तीव्रम् intense, शोकवेगम् of grief, एभिः by these, रक्षोभिः by the rakshasas, परिभर्त्सनं च threats also, ब्रूयाः you nararte, ते to you, अध्वा journey, शिवः happy, अस्तु let it be.
explanation: "Foremost vanara tell Rama about my intense grief as well as the threats of the demons. May your journey be happy.

shloka_text: स राजपुत्र्य्राप्रतिवेदितार्थः कपिः कृतार्थः परिहृष्टचेताः। अल्पावशेषं प्रसमीक्ष्य कार्यं दिशं ह्युदीचीं मनसा जगाम।।5.40.25।।
transliteration: sa rājaputryrāprativeditārthaḥ kapiḥ kṛtārthaḥ parihṛṣṭacetāḥ| alpāvaśeṣaṃ prasamīkṣya kāryaṃ diśaṃ hyudīcīṃ manasā jagāma
translation: सः that, कपिः vanara, राजपुत्र्या by the princess, प्रतिवेदितार्थः understood the message, कृतार्थः accomplished, परिहृष्टचेताः delighted at heart, कार्यम् task, अल्पावशेषम् a small left over, प्रसमीक्ष्य after considering, उदीचीम् north, दिशम् direction, मनसा mentally, जगम reached.
explanation: Hanuman understood the message of princess Sita and felt delighted at heart at his accomplishment. Considering the small task yet to be accomplished he reached the northern shore mentally (He thought of Rama who waited in Kishkinda which is in the northern direction). इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे चत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: स च वाग्भिः प्रशस्ताभिर्गमिष्यन्पूजितस्तया। तस्माद्देशादपक्रम्य चिन्तयामास वानरः।।5.41.1।।
transliteration: sa ca vāgbhiḥ praśastābhirgamiṣyanpūjitastayā| tasmāddeśādapakramya cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ
translation: गमिष्यन् to depart, सः वानरः that vanara, तया by her, प्रशस्ताभिः with choicest, वाग्भिः with words, पूजितः honoured, तस्मात् from that, देशात् from location, अपक्रम्य moved, चिन्तयामास started thinking.
explanation: Having been honoured and praised by Sita's words, Hanuman prepared to depart from Sita's presence.
comments: Hanuman decides to meet Ravana and measure his strength

shloka_text: अल्पशेषमिदं कार्यं दृष्टेयमसितेक्षणा। त्रीनुपायानतिक्रम्य चतुर्थ: इह विद्यते।।5.41.2।।
transliteration: alpaśeṣamidaṃ kāryaṃ dṛṣṭeyamasitekṣaṇā| trīnupāyānatikramya caturtha: iha vidyate
translation: इदं कार्यम् this work, अल्पशेषम् little more remains, इयम् this, असितेक्षणा blackeyed lady, दृष्टा seen, त्रीन् three expedientsnegotiation, presentation and, dissension (Sama, Dana, Bheda), उपायान् strategies, अतिक्रम्य crossing, इह here, चतुर्थ fourth (expedient) punishment (Danda), विद्यते remains.
explanation: This task is all but finished now that this dark-eyed lady has been found; having passed over the first three expedients, here the fourth—punishment—remains.

shloka_text: न साम रक्षस्सु गुणाय कल्पते न दानमर्थोपचितेषु युज्यते। न भेदसाध्या बलदर्पिता जनाः पराक्रमस्त्वेव ममेह रोचते।।5.41.3।।
transliteration: na sāma rakṣassu guṇāya kalpate na dānamarthopaciteṣu yujyate| na bhedasādhyā baladarpitā janāḥ parākramastveva mameha rocate
translation: रक्षस्सु with demons, साम negotiation, गुणाय for any merit, न कल्पते does not lead, अर्थोपचितेषु being wealthy, दानम् gifts, न युज्यते not proper, बलदर्पिताः proud of their strength, जनाः people, भेदसाध्याः will not yield by sowing seeds of dissension, न not, इह here, मम my, पराक्रमस्त्वेव only by valour, रोचते  pleases me.
explanation: 'With demons, negotiation is of no use. They are wealthy, they need no gifts. Proud of their stregth, the demons will not yield to dissension. I think only by using power it can be done.

shloka_text: न चास्य कार्यस्य पराक्रमादृते विनिश्चयः कश्चिदिहोपपद्यते। हतप्रवीरा हि रणे हि राक्षसाः कथञ्चिदीयुर्यदिहाद्य मार्दवम्।।5.41.4।।
transliteration: na cāsya kāryasya parākramādṛte viniścayaḥ kaścidihopapadyate| hatapravīrā hi raṇe hi rākṣasāḥ kathañcidīyuryadihādya mārdavam
translation: इह here, अस्य of this, कार्यस्य of the task, पराक्रमात् ऋते other than power, विनिश्चयः a decision, कश्चित् even one, इह here, न उपपद्यते not hold good, यत् that, रणे in fight, हतप्रवीराः slay a few heroes, राक्षसाः ogres, अद्य to day, इह here, कथञ्चित् somehow, मार्दवम् soften, ईयुः will yield.
explanation: 'Other than power, there is no way to accomplish the task of ascertaining their strength. If I slay a few strong ogres somehow they may soften a little and yield.

shloka_text: कार्ये कर्मणि निर्दिष्टे यो बहून्यपि साधयेत्। पूर्वकार्याविरोधेन स कार्यं कर्तुमर्हति।।5.41.5।।
transliteration: kārye karmaṇi nirdiṣṭe yo bahūnyapi sādhayet| pūrvakāryāvirodhena sa kāryaṃ kartumarhati
translation: कार्ये in a work to be accomplished, कर्मणि in a work, निर्दिष्टे when the work is entrusted, यः he who, पूर्वकार्याविरोधेन without affecting the earlier work, बहून्यपि many, साधयेत् will achieve, सः he, कार्यम् task, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हति is fit.
explanation: 'He, who can perform tasks in addition to the objective accomplished without affecting it, is really worthy.

shloka_text: न ह्येकस्साधको हेतुस्स्वल्पस्यापीह कर्मणः। यो ह्यर्थं बहुधा वेद स समर्थोऽर्थसाधने।।5.41.6।।
transliteration: na hyekassādhako hetussvalpasyāpīha karmaṇaḥ| yo hyarthaṃ bahudhā veda sa samartho'rthasādhane
translation: इह here, स्वल्पस्य of a trivial task, अपि also, कर्मणः of the task, साधकः effective, हेतुः cause, एकः one, न हि is not, यः he who, अर्थम् as an object, बहुधा in many ways (means of doing), वेद knows, सः he, अर्थसाधने in achieving the task, समर्थः capable.
explanation: 'There are ways more than one even to perform a small work. And the capable know it.

shloka_text: इहैव तावत्कृतनिश्चयो ह्यहं यदि व्रजेयं प्लवगेश्वरालयम्। परात्मसम्मर्दविशेषतत्त्ववित्ततः कृतं स्यान्मम भर्तृशासनम्।।5.41.7।।
transliteration: ihaiva tāvatkṛtaniścayo hyahaṃ yadi vrajeyaṃ plavageśvarālayam| parātmasammardaviśeṣatattvavittataḥ kṛtaṃ syānmama bhartṛśāsanam
translation: अहम् I, इहैव here itself, तावत् therefore, परात्मसम्मर्दविशेषतत्त्ववित् by understanding the difference between the strength of enemy forces and our strength in war, प्लवगेश्वरालयम् abode of vanaras, व्रजेयं यदि if I go, ततः then, मम my, भर्तृशासनम् the orders of my lord, कृतम् executed, स्यात् well.
explanation: 'If I ascertain the difference in the strength of enemies and vanaras in war here itself and return to Kishkinda, the abode of vanaras, then I would have executed the orders of my lord properly.

shloka_text: कथं नु खल्वद्य भवेत्सुखागतं प्रसह्य युद्धं मम राक्षसैः सह। तथैव खल्वात्मबलं च सारवत्सम्मानयेन्मां च रणे दशाननः।।5.41.8।।
transliteration: kathaṃ nu khalvadya bhavetsukhāgataṃ prasahya yuddhaṃ mama rākṣasaiḥ saha| tathaiva khalvātmabalaṃ ca sāravatsammānayenmāṃ ca raṇe daśānanaḥ
translation: अद्य today, मम for me, राक्षसैः सह with ogres, प्रसह्य enduring, युद्धम् war, कथं नु how to, सुखागतम् happy coming, भवेत् may be, तथैव in that way, आत्मबलं च our strength, सारवत् substantial, सः he, दशाननः च tenheaded Ravana's, माम् me, रणे in fight, मानयेत्  measure.
explanation: 'How can I have enduring war with the ogres today? How will my visit to this place end in happy return? Only in a combat this tenheaded Ravana will guage his strength and mine

shloka_text: ततस्समासाद्य रणे दशाननं समन्त्रिवर्गं सबलप्रयायिनम्। हृदि स्थितं तस्य मतं बलं च वै सुखेन मत्त्वाऽहमितः पुनर्व्रजे।।5.41.9।।
transliteration: tatassamāsādya raṇe daśānanaṃ samantrivargaṃ sabalaprayāyinam| hṛdi sthitaṃ tasya mataṃ balaṃ ca vai sukhena mattvā'hamitaḥ punarvraje
translation: ततः thereafter, समन्त्रिवर्गम् along with the ministers, सबलप्रयायिनम् and army chiefs marching forward, दशाननम् tenheaded Ravana, रणे in war, समासाद्य after finding out, तस्य his, हृदि in his mind, स्थितम् established, मतम् feeling, बलं च वै strength, मत्त्वा knowing, अहम् I, इतः from here, सुखेन happily, पुनः again, व्रजे can go.
explanation: 'I can return happily only after I gauge the tenheaded Ravana's army in war, his strength, his companions including the ministers and his mind.

shloka_text: इदमस्य नृशंसस्य नन्दनोपममुत्तमम्। वनं नेत्रमनःकान्तं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.10।।
transliteration: idamasya nṛśaṃsasya nandanopamamuttamam| vanaṃ netramanaḥkāntaṃ nānādrumalatāyutam
translation: नृशंसस्य wicked Ravana's, अस्य his, इदम् this (Ashoka garden), नेत्रमनःकान्तम् feast to the eyes and mind, नानाद्रुमलतायुतम् filled with different kinds of trees and creepers, उत्तमम् excellent, वनम् garden, नन्दनोपमम् like the Nandana garden of Indra.
explanation: 'This Ashoka garden of Ravana filled with different kinds of trees and creepers is a feast to the eyes and mind. It is an excellent garden like the Nandana  garden of Indra.

shloka_text: इदं विध्वंसयिष्यामि शुष्कं वनमिवानलः। अस्मिन्भग्ने ततः कोपं करिष्यति दशाननः।।5.41.11।।
transliteration: idaṃ vidhvaṃsayiṣyāmi śuṣkaṃ vanamivānalaḥ| asminbhagne tataḥ kopaṃ kariṣyati daśānanaḥ
translation: शुष्कम् dried up, वनम् forest, अनलः इव like fire, इदम् this, विध्वंसयिष्यामि will destroy, अस्मिन् when this, भग्ने devastate, ततः then, दशाननः Ravana, कोपम्  anger, करिष्यति will exhibit.
explanation: 'I will devastate this garden, just as fire destroys a dried up forest. This will enrage Ravana.

shloka_text: ततो महत्साश्वमहारथद्विपं बलं समादेक्ष्यति राक्षसाधिपः। त्रिशूलकालायसपट्टिसायुधं ततो महद्युद्धमिदं भविष्यति।।5.41.12।।
transliteration: tato mahatsāśvamahārathadvipaṃ balaṃ samādekṣyati rākṣasādhipaḥ| triśūlakālāyasapaṭṭisāyudhaṃ tato mahadyuddhamidaṃ bhaviṣyati
translation: ततः then, राक्षसाधिपः king of ogres, साश्वमहारथद्विपम् with horses, chariots and elephants, महत् great, त्रिशूलकालायसपट्टिसायुधम् armed with tridents, black iron spears, बलम् army, समादेक्ष्यति will order, ततः then, इदम् this, महत् great, युद्धम् war, भविष्यति will take place.
explanation: 'Then the demon king will order the horses, chariots and elephants and army equipped with tridents and spears to march against me. A great war will take place.

shloka_text: अहं तु तैः संयति चण्डविक्रमै स्समेत्य रक्षोभिरसह्य विक्रमः। निहत्य तद्रावणचोदितं बलं सुखं गमिष्यामि कपीश्वरालयम्।।5.41.13।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tu taiḥ saṃyati caṇḍavikramai ssametya rakṣobhirasahya vikramaḥ| nihatya tadrāvaṇacoditaṃ balaṃ sukhaṃ gamiṣyāmi kapīśvarālayam
translation: अहं तु I on my part, चण्डविक्रमैः with those endowed with fierce strength, तैः with them, रक्षोभिः by demons, संयति in fight, समेत्य colliding, असह्यविक्रमः irresistible valour, रावणचोदितम् sent by Ravana, तत् that, बलम् army, निहत्य after destroying, सुखम् happily, कपीश्वरालयम् to the abode of vanaras, गमिष्यामि I will go.
explanation: 'I will fight with the ogres sent by Ravana, endowed with fierce strength and irresistible valour. After destroying their army I will go to the abode of vanaras happily'.

shloka_text: ततो मारुतवत्कृद्धो मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः। ऊरुवेगेन महता द्रुमान्क्षेप्तुमथारभत्।।5.41.14।।
transliteration: tato mārutavatkṛddho mārutirbhīmavikramaḥ| ūruvegena mahatā drumānkṣeptumathārabhat
translation: ततः then, भीमविक्रमः a vanara of fierce valour, मारुतिः Maruti, क्रुद्धः furious one, अथ and then, महता with great, ऊरुवेगेन with speed sprung from his thighs, मारुतवत् like the Windgod, द्रुमान् trees, क्षेप्तुम् to uproot, आरभत् started.
explanation: Furious Maruti endowed with fierce valour started uprooting the trees with the speed sprung from his thighs like the Windgod.

shloka_text: ततस्तु हनुमान्वीरो बभञ्ज प्रमदावनम्। मत्तद्विजसमाघुष्टं नानाद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.15।।
transliteration: tatastu hanumānvīro babhañja pramadāvanam| mattadvijasamāghuṣṭaṃ nānādrumalatāyutam
translation: ततः then, वीरः hero, हनुमान् Hanuman, मत्तद्विजसमाघुष्टम् filled with intoxicated birds, नानाद्रुमलतायुतम् with variety of trees and vines, प्रमदावनम् garden grown for women folk, बभञ्ज felled.
explanation: Then Hanuman felled a variety of trees and vines inhabited by intoxicated birds in the beautiful garden meant for womenfolk.

shloka_text: तद्वनं मथितैर्वृक्षैर्भिन्नैश्च सलिलाशयैः। चूर्णितैः पर्वताग्रैश्च बभूवाप्रियदर्शनम्।।5.41.16।।
transliteration: tadvanaṃ mathitairvṛkṣairbhinnaiśca salilāśayaiḥ| cūrṇitaiḥ parvatāgraiśca babhūvāpriyadarśanam
translation: तत् वनम् that garden, मथितैः with destroyed, वृक्षैः trees, भिन्नैः with breached, सलिलाशयैः ponds, चूर्णितैः powdered, पर्वताग्रैश्च mountain peaks, अप्रियदर्शनम् unpleasant appearance, बभूव remained.
explanation: That garden looked ugly with uprooted trees, breached ponds and powdered mountain peaks.

shloka_text: नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः प्रभिन्नैस्सलिलाशयैः। ताम्रैः किसलयैः क्लान्तै: क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.17।। न बभौ तद्वनं तत्र दावानलहतं यथा। व्याकुलावरणा रेजुर्विह्वला इव ता लताः।।5.41.18।।
transliteration: nānāśakuntavirutaiḥ prabhinnaissalilāśayaiḥ| tāmraiḥ kisalayaiḥ klāntai: klāntadrumalatāyutam na babhau tadvanaṃ tatra dāvānalahataṃ yathā| vyākulāvaraṇā rejurvihvalā iva tā latāḥ
translation: कलान्तद्रुमलतायुतम् with wilted vines and trees, तत् वनम् that garden, नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः with birds shrieking with different kinds of sounds, प्रभिन्नैः with smashed, सलिलाशयैः with ponds of water, क्लान्तै: withered, ताम्रैः with red ones only, किसलयैः with tender shoots, दावानलहतंरणाः like burntin forest fire, ताः लताः those climbers, विह्वलाः इव like women with their robes disarrayed, रेजुः trembling in fear.
explanation: Vines and trees wilted, birds shrieking, the embankments of ponds destroyed, its tender coppery red shoots withered, the garden looked as though it is burnt by forest fire and the climbers looked like women shivering in fear with their robes disarrayed.

shloka_text: नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः प्रभिन्नैस्सलिलाशयैः। ताम्रैः किसलयैः क्लान्तै: क्लान्तद्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.41.17।। न बभौ तद्वनं तत्र दावानलहतं यथा। व्याकुलावरणा रेजुर्विह्वला इव ता लताः।।5.41.18।।
transliteration: nānāśakuntavirutaiḥ prabhinnaissalilāśayaiḥ| tāmraiḥ kisalayaiḥ klāntai: klāntadrumalatāyutam na babhau tadvanaṃ tatra dāvānalahataṃ yathā| vyākulāvaraṇā rejurvihvalā iva tā latāḥ
translation: कलान्तद्रुमलतायुतम् with wilted vines and trees, तत् वनम् that garden, नानाशकुन्तविरुतैः with birds shrieking with different kinds of sounds, प्रभिन्नैः with smashed, सलिलाशयैः with ponds of water, क्लान्तै: withered, ताम्रैः with red ones only, किसलयैः with tender shoots, दावानलहतंरणाः like burntin forest fire, ताः लताः those climbers, विह्वलाः इव like women with their robes disarrayed, रेजुः trembling in fear.
explanation: Vines and trees wilted, birds shrieking, the embankments of ponds destroyed, its tender coppery red shoots withered, the garden looked as though it is burnt by forest fire and the climbers looked like women shivering in fear with their robes disarrayed.

shloka_text: लतागृहैश्चित्रगृहैश्च नाशितैर्महोरगैर्व्यालमृगैश्च निर्धुतैः। शिलागृहैरुन्मथितैस्तथा गृहैः प्रणष्टरूपं तदभून्महद्वनम्।।5.41.19।।
transliteration: latāgṛhaiścitragṛhaiśca nāśitairmahoragairvyālamṛgaiśca nirdhutaiḥ| śilāgṛhairunmathitaistathā gṛhaiḥ praṇaṣṭarūpaṃ tadabhūnmahadvanam
translation: महत् great, तत् वनम् that garden, नाशितैः ruined, लतागृहैः arbours, चित्रगृहैः picture galleries, निर्धुतैः destroyed, महोरगैः huge serpents, व्यालमृगैश्च and even with wild animals, तथा in the same manner, उन्मथितैः scattered, शिलागृहैः stone houses, गृहैः with houses, प्रणष्टरूपम् disfigured, अभूत् became.
explanation: The great garden lay disfigured, with the arbours and the picture galleries ruined, huge serpents and wild animals scattered, with stone houses and sheds destroyed.

shloka_text: सा विह्वलाऽशोकलताप्रताना वनस्थली शोकलताप्रताना। जाता दशास्यप्रमदावनस्य कपेर्बलाद्धि प्रमदावनस्य।।5.41.20।।
transliteration: sā vihvalā'śokalatāpratānā vanasthalī śokalatāpratānā| jātā daśāsyapramadāvanasya kaperbalāddhi pramadāvanasya
translation: दशास्यप्रमदावनस्य of that pleasure garden of the tenheaded Ravana, प्रमदावनस्य कपेः with the strength of the monkey who had set out to protect a lady (Sita), सा वनस्थली that garden, बलात् by force, विह्वला destroyed, शोकलताप्रताना was spreading out creepers of sorrow, जाता appeared.
explanation: The pleasuregarden of Ravana appeared as though it was spreading the creepers of sorrow, since it was totally destroyed by the monkey who had set out to protect a woman. प्रमदावनस्य  of the pleasure garden, प्रमदाअवनस्य of the hero who came to protect a lady.

shloka_text: स तस्य कृत्वार्थपतेर्महाकपिर्महद्व्यलीकं मनसो महात्मनः। युयुत्सुरेको बहुभिर्महाबलैश्शिया ज्वलंस्तोरणमास्थितः कपिः।।5.41.21।।
transliteration: sa tasya kṛtvārthapatermahākapirmahadvyalīkaṃ manaso mahātmanaḥ| yuyutsureko bahubhirmahābalaiśśiyā jvalaṃstoraṇamāsthitaḥ kapiḥ
translation: सः महाकपिः that great vanara, महात्मनः of the great self, तस्य his, अर्थपतेः of the lord of wealth, मनसः in mind, महत् great, व्यलीकम् unpleasantness, कृत्वा having caused, महाबलैः mighty, बहुभिः many, एकः singlehanded, युयुत्सुः ready to fight, श्रिया blazing, ज्वलन् glowing, तोरणम् exit doorway, आस्थितः stood.
explanation: The great vanara having perpetrated mischief, rousing anger in the mind of the great lord of wealth, stood at the exit doorway ready to combat singlehanded with many warriors in that  mighty army blazing in glory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fortyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततः पक्षिनिनादेन वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन च। बभूवुस्त्राससम्भ्रान्तास्सर्वे लङ्कानिवासिनः।।5.42.1।।
transliteration: tataḥ pakṣininādena vṛkṣabhaṅgasvanena ca| babhūvustrāsasambhrāntāssarve laṅkānivāsinaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, पक्षिनिनादेन by the sounds of birds, वृक्षभङ्गस्वनेन by the cracking sound of trees, सर्वे all, लङ्कानिवासिनः the residents of Lanka, त्राससम्भ्रान्ताः were panicked, बभूवुः became.
explanation: The residents of Lanka panicked at the shrieking sounds of birds and cracking sounds of trees.
comments: Hanuman ruins Ashoka garden -- kills eighty thousand kinkaras

shloka_text: विद्रुताश्च भयत्रस्ता विनेदुर्मृगपक्षिणः। रक्षसां च निमित्तानि क्रूराणि प्रतिपेदिरे।।5.42.2।।
transliteration: vidrutāśca bhayatrastā vinedurmṛgapakṣiṇaḥ| rakṣasāṃ ca nimittāni krūrāṇi pratipedire
translation: मृगपक्षिणः beasts and birds, विद्रुता: ran and flown away, भयत्रस्ताः became scared, विनेदुः screeching in all directions, रक्षसां च for the ogres, क्रूराणि fierce, निमित्तानि portents, प्रतिपेदिरे appeared.
explanation: The frightened beasts and birds ran and flew, screeching in all directions. Fierce portents appeared to the demons.

shloka_text: ततो गतायां निद्रायां राक्षस्यो विकृताननाः। तद्वनं ददृशुर्भग्नं तं च वीरं महाकपिम्।।5.42.3।।
transliteration: tato gatāyāṃ nidrāyāṃ rākṣasyo vikṛtānanāḥ| tadvanaṃ dadṛśurbhagnaṃ taṃ ca vīraṃ mahākapim
translation: ततः then, विकृताननाः women of hideous faces, राक्षस्यः ogressses, निद्रायाम् in sleep, गतायाम् was awakened, भग्नम् devastated, तत् that, वनम् garden, वीरम् hero, तं महाकपिं च that great vanara, ददृशुः saw.
explanation: Hideouslooking ogresses, awakened from sleep, saw the garden devastated by the heroic Vanara.

shloka_text: स ता दृष्ट्वा महाबाहुर्महासत्त्वो महाबलः। चकार सुमहद्रूपं राक्षसीनां भयावहम्।।5.42.4।।
transliteration: sa tā dṛṣṭvā mahābāhurmahāsattvo mahābalaḥ| cakāra sumahadrūpaṃ rākṣasīnāṃ bhayāvaham
translation: महाबाहुः strong armed one, महासत्त्वः a great hero, महाबलः mighty, सः he, Hanuman, ताः the women, दृष्ट्वा seeing, राक्षसीनाम् for the ogresses, भयावहम् to create fear, सुमहत् very huge, रूपम् form, चकार assumed.
explanation: When the powerful, mighty and strongarmed Hanuman saw the ogresses he assumed a very huge form in order to strike terror in them.

shloka_text: ततस्तं गिरिसङ्काशमतिकायं महाबलम्। राक्षस्यो वानरं दृष्ट्वा पप्रच्छुर्जनकात्मजाम्।।5.42.5।।
transliteration: tatastaṃ girisaṅkāśamatikāyaṃ mahābalam| rākṣasyo vānaraṃ dṛṣṭvā papracchurjanakātmajām
translation: ततः then, गिरिसङ्काशम् looking like a mountain, अतिकायम् of huge body, महाबलम्  mighty, तं वानरम् that vanara, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, राक्षस्यः ogresses, जनकात्मजाम् Janaki, पप्रच्छुः questioned.
explanation: Then, seeing the huge body of the mighty vanara resembling a mountain the ogresses questioned Janaki about him.

shloka_text: कोऽयं कस्य कुतो वायं किं निमित्तमिहागतः। कथं त्वया सहानेन संवादः कृत इत्युत।।5.42.6।।
transliteration: ko'yaṃ kasya kuto vāyaṃ kiṃ nimittamihāgataḥ| kathaṃ tvayā sahānena saṃvādaḥ kṛta ityuta
translation: अयम् this person, कः who, कस्य whose, अयम् he, कुतः from where, किं निमित्तम् for what purpose, इह here, आगतः he has come, उत or, अनेन by him, त्वया सह with you, संवादः talk, कृतः  made.
explanation: "Who is he? By whom has he been sent? From where and why did he come here? What dialogue  did you have with him?

shloka_text: आचक्ष्व नो विशालाक्षि मा भूत्ते सुभगे भयम्। संवादमसितापाङ्गे त्वया किं कृतवानयम्।।5.42.7।।
transliteration: ācakṣva no viśālākṣi mā bhūtte subhage bhayam| saṃvādamasitāpāṅge tvayā kiṃ kṛtavānayam
translation: विशालाक्षि largeeyed lady, नः to us, आचक्ष्व O you may tell, सुभगे O auspicious one, ते to you, भयम् fear, मा भूत् let there be none, असितापाङ्गे O lady with dark sideglances, अयम् this, त्वया with you, किम् what, संवादम् dialogue, कृतवान् he had.
explanation: "O lovely, largeeyed lady O auspicious one have no fear. What conversation did he have with you? Tell us".

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीन्महासाध्वी सीता सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी। रक्षसां भीमरूपाणां विज्ञाने मम का गतिः।।5.42.8।।
transliteration: athābravīnmahāsādhvī sītā sarvāṅgasundarī| rakṣasāṃ bhīmarūpāṇāṃ vijñāne mama kā gatiḥ
translation: अथ then, महासाध्वी a chaste lady, सर्वाङ्गसुन्दरी a lady of beautiful limbs, सीता Sita, तदा then, अब्रवीत् said, भीमरूपाणाम् of fierce form, रक्षसाम् of ogresses, विज्ञाने in knowing, गतिः direction, मम to me, का what?
explanation: Chaste and beautiful Sita said, "How do I know about the ogresses who assume many fierce forms?"

shloka_text: यूयमेवाभिजानीत योऽयं यद्वा करिष्यति। अहिरेव ह्यहेः पादान्विजानाति न संशयः।।5.42.9।।
transliteration: yūyamevābhijānīta yo'yaṃ yadvā kariṣyati| ahireva hyaheḥ pādānvijānāti na saṃśayaḥ
translation: अयम् this, यः whoever, यद्वा what, करिष्यति he is about, यूयमेव you alone, अभिजानीत you may find out, अहेः of a serpent, पादान् feet, अहिरेव a serpent alone, विजानाति  knows, संशयः doubt, न no.
