explanation: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

shloka_text: सा मया राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभिर्दृष्टा हि प्रमदावने।।5.59.30।। एकवेणीधरा दीना भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा। अधश्शय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे।।5.59.31।। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया।
transliteration: sā mayā rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ| rākṣasībhirvirūpābhirdṛṣṭā hi pramadāvane ekaveṇīdharā dīnā bhartṛcintāparāyaṇā| adhaśśayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himāgame rāvaṇādvinivṛttārthā martavyakṛtaniścayā|
translation: विरूपाभिः uglylooking, राक्षसीभिः ogresses, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तर्ज्यमाना threatened, एकवेणीधरा with a single braid, दीना pathetic, भर्तृचिन्तापरायणा thinking of her husband all the time, अधः now, शय्या lying on floor, हिमागमे in winter season, पद्मिनिव like the lotus, विवर्णाङ्गी devoid of lustre, रावणात् by Ravana, विनिवृत्तार्था turned away, मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया decided to die, सा that she, मया by me, राक्षसीमध्ये in the midst of ogresses, प्रमदावने in the pleasure garden, दृष्टा saw her.
explanation: "I saw Sita often threatened by uglylooking ogresses. Wearing a single braid, she looked pathetic, thinking always about her husband, lying on the bare ground. She was like a lustreless lotus in winter. Spurning the advances by Ravana, she is rather determined to commit suicide.

shloka_text: कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता।।5.59.32।। ततः संभाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता।।5.59.33।।
transliteration: kathañcinmṛgaśābākṣī viśvāsamupapāditā tataḥ saṃbhāṣitā caiva sarvamarthaṃ ca darśitā| rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca śrutvā prītimupāgatā
translation: मृगशाबाक्षी fawneyed woman, कथञ्चित् little, विश्वासम् confidence, उपपादिता pacified, ततः then, संभाषिता चैव after conversing only, सर्वम् everything, अर्थं च with difficulty, दर्शिता presented, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा after hearing, प्रीतिम् happy, उपागता became.
explanation: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.

shloka_text: कथञ्चिन्मृगशाबाक्षी विश्वासमुपपादिता।।5.59.32।। ततः संभाषिता चैव सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता।।5.59.33।।
transliteration: kathañcinmṛgaśābākṣī viśvāsamupapāditā tataḥ saṃbhāṣitā caiva sarvamarthaṃ ca darśitā| rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca śrutvā prītimupāgatā
translation: मृगशाबाक्षी fawneyed woman, कथञ्चित् little, विश्वासम् confidence, उपपादिता pacified, ततः then, संभाषिता चैव after conversing only, सर्वम् everything, अर्थं च with difficulty, दर्शिता presented, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा after hearing, प्रीतिम् happy, उपागता became.
explanation: "I created a little confidence in the fawneyed lady by pacifying her and explaining her with great difficulty the alliance of Rama and Sugriva on hearing which she became happy.

shloka_text: नियतस्समुदाचारो भक्तिर्भर्तरि चोत्तमा। यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं सा महात्मा कृतागसम्।।5.59.34।।
transliteration: niyatassamudācāro bhaktirbhartari cottamā| yanna hanti daśagrīvaṃ sā mahātmā kṛtāgasam
translation: महात्मा great soul, सा that, कृतागसम् has done harm, दशग्रीवं to Ravana,न हन्ति not killed, इति यत् this being so, नियत: of good conduct, समुदाचारः chaste, भर्तरि towards husband, उत्तमा high, भक्तिः devotion
explanation: "Ravana is a great soul because, even though he has done harm to her, he is not killed. This is because Sita being a chaste woman of good conduct and deep devotion towards her husband (she refrained from killing Ravana as she wanted her husband to do that.)

shloka_text: निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति। सा प्रकृत्यैव तन्वङ्गी तद्वियोगाच्च कर्शिता।।5.59.35।। प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य विद्येव तनुमतां गता।
transliteration: nimittamātraṃ rāmastu vadhe tasya bhaviṣyati| sā prakṛtyaiva tanvaṅgī tadviyogācca karśitā pratipatpāṭhaśīlasya vidyeva tanumatāṃ gatā|
translation: रामस्तु Rama also, तस्य his, वधे killing, निमित्तमात्रं instrumental, भविष्यति will be, प्रकृत्यैव naturally, तन्वङ्गी thin body, तद्वियोगात् by the separation from her husband, कर्शिता च and also emaciated, सा she, प्रतिपत्पाठशीलस्य just as a student on the new Moon day, विद्येव shrunken, तनुमताम्  slender in body, गता has become.
explanation: "To Rama, killing Ravana is easy (since Ravana's power of penance has already declined by his abduction of Sita). Separated from her husband she is naturally emaciated. She has become slender just like a student on the new Moon day (on the first day of study).

shloka_text: एवमास्ते महाभागा सीता शोकपरायणा।।5.59.36।। यदत्र प्रतिकर्तव्यं तत्सर्वमुपपाद्यताम्।
transliteration: evamāste mahābhāgā sītā śokaparāyaṇā yadatra pratikartavyaṃ tatsarvamupapādyatām|
translation: महाभागा noble lady, सीता Sita, अस्ते being, एवम् in this way, शोकपरायणा absorbed in grief, अत्र there, यत् that, प्रतिकर्तव्यम् what is to be done, तत् that, सर्वम् all, उपपाद्यताम् you may do.
explanation: "Noble Sita is absorbed in grief. Let us do all that has to be done now." इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the fiftyninth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा वालिसूनुरभाषत। अयुक्तं तु विना देवीं दृष्टवद्भिश्च वानराः।।5.60.1।। समीपं गन्तुमस्माभी राघवस्य महात्मनः।
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vālisūnurabhāṣata| ayuktaṃ tu vinā devīṃ dṛṣṭavadbhiśca vānarāḥ samīpaṃ gantumasmābhī rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ|
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, वालिसूनुः Vali's son, अभाषत said this, वानराः O vanaras, दृष्टवद्भिः even after seeing, अस्माभिः her, देवीं विना without Sita, महात्मनः great soul, राघवस्य to Rama, समीपम् near, गन्तुम् going, अयुक्तं तु not appropriate.
explanation: After hearing Hanuman,  Vali's son said" O vanaras (Hanuman) having seen Sita it is not proper on our part to go without Sita to the great soul Rama.
comments: Jambavan says it is advisable to follow Rama's instruction.

shloka_text: दृष्टा देवी न चानीता इति तत्र निवेदनम्।।5.60.2।। अयुक्तमिव पश्यामि भवद्भिः ख्यातविक्रमैः।
transliteration: dṛṣṭā devī na cānītā iti tatra nivedanam ayuktamiva paśyāmi bhavadbhiḥ khyātavikramaiḥ|
translation: ख्यातविक्रमैः known for valour, भवद्भिः you too, देवी godlike lady, दृष्टा seeing, न आनीता च not brought her, इति this, तत्र there, निवेदनम् tell, अयुक्तमिव not proper, पश्यामि I think.
explanation: "O vanaras, you are known for your valour. I think, to tell Rama that we have seen Sita but not brought her is not proper".

shloka_text: न हि नः प्लवने कश्चिन्नापि कश्चित्पराक्रमे।।5.60.3।। तुल्य स्सामरदैत्येषु लोकेषु हरिसत्तमाः।
transliteration: na hi naḥ plavane kaścinnāpi kaścitparākrame tulya ssāmaradaityeṣu lokeṣu harisattamāḥ|
translation: हरिसत्तमाः noble vanaras, सामरदैत्येषु gods or demons, लोकेषु in the world, प्लवने in leaping, नः none, तुल्यः match, कश्चित् even few, न हि not indeed, पराक्रमेऽपि even in valour, कश्चित् are there, न no one.
explanation: "O noble vanaras Indeed either among gods or among demons there is none who can match the vanaras in leaping and exhibiting valour.

shloka_text: तेष्वेवं हतवीरेषु राक्षसेषु हनूमता।।5.60.4।। किमन्यदत्र कर्तव्यं गृहीत्वा याम जानकीम्।
transliteration: teṣvevaṃ hatavīreṣu rākṣaseṣu hanūmatā kimanyadatra kartavyaṃ gṛhītvā yāma jānakīm|
translation: तेषु hence, राक्षसेषु  among demons, हनूमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, हतवीरेषु dead heroes, अत्र there, किम् what, अन्यत् other, कर्तव्यम् action, जानकीम् Janaki, गृहीत्वा get, याम here.
explanation: "Hence, having killed the heroes among ogres what other task has Hanuman to do? Let us get Sita.

shloka_text: तमेवं कृतसङ्कल्पं जाम्बवान् हरिसत्तमः।।5.60.5।। उवाच परमप्रीतो वाक्यमर्थवदर्थवित्।
transliteration: tamevaṃ kṛtasaṅkalpaṃ jāmbavān harisattamaḥ uvāca paramaprīto vākyamarthavadarthavit|
translation: अर्थवित् knower of ways of execution of tasks, हरिसत्तमः noble vanara, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, परमप्रीतः very pleased, एवम् in that way, कृतसंकल्पम् determined, तम् him, अर्थवत् commnading way, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: "Jambavan, the noble vanara, skilled in the execution of tasks thus commanded in a determined manner:

shloka_text: न तावदेषा मतिरक्षमा नो यथा भवान् पश्यति राजपुत्र। यथा तु रामस्य मतिर्निविष्टा तथा भवान् पश्यतु कार्यसिद्धिम्।।5.60.6।।
transliteration: na tāvadeṣā matirakṣamā no yathā bhavān paśyati rājaputra| yathā tu rāmasya matirniviṣṭā tathā bhavān paśyatu kāryasiddhim
translation: राजपुत्र O prince, भवान् you, यथा this way, पश्यति thought of, एषा also, मतिः to my mind, नः none, अक्षमा acceptable, न तावत् we are capable, तु you, रामस्य Rama's, मतिः mind, यथा this way, निविष्टा should act, तथा that way, भवान् you, कार्यसिद्धिम् to accomplish the work, पश्यतु do it.
explanation: "O prince what you think is  acceptable to us also. Even though we are capable of achieving, knowing what is in Rama's mind, we should act only according to his command to accomplish the task. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramyana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततो जाम्बवतो वाक्यमगृह्णन्त वनौकसः। अङ्गदप्रमुखा वीरा हनुमांश्च महाकपिः।।5.61.1।।
transliteration: tato jāmbavato vākyamagṛhṇanta vanaukasaḥ| aṅgadapramukhā vīrā hanumāṃśca mahākapiḥ
translation: ततः then, अङ्गदप्रमुखाः Angada and other leaders, वीराः heroes, वनौकसः wanderers of the forest, vanaras, महाकपिः great monkey, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, जाम्बवतः Jambavan's, वाक्यम् these words, अगृह्णन्त agreed upon.
explanation: In the midst of all the leaders of the monkeys including Angada, Hanuman accepted Jambavan's advice.
comments: Monkey leaders enter Madhuvan on the outskirts of Kishkinda and destroy it in their drunkenness.

shloka_text: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपरस्पराः। महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः।।5.61.2।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः।।5.61.3।। सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः।।5.61.4।। राघवे चार्थनिर्ववृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः सर्वेसिद्धिभिरुन्नता।।5.61.5।। प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्स्विनः।।5.61.6।।
transliteration: prītimantastataḥ sarve vāyuputraparasparāḥ| mahendrādriṃ parityajya pupluvuḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ merumandarasaṅkāśā mattā iva mahāgajāḥ| chādayanta ivākāśaṃ mahākāyā mahābalāḥ sabhājyamānaṃ bhūtaistamātmavantaṃ mahābalam| hanūmantaṃ mahāvegaṃ vahanta iva dṛṣṭibhiḥ rāghave cārthanirvavṛttiṃ kartuṃ ca paramaṃ yaśaḥ| samādhāya samṛddhārthāḥ sarvesiddhibhirunnatā priyākhyānonmukhāḥ sarve sarve yuddhābhinandinaḥ| sarve rāmapratīkāre niścitārthā manassvinaḥ
translation: ततः then, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशाः resembling Meru mountain, मत्ताः in rut, गजाः इव like elephants, आकाशम् sky, छादयन्तः इव as though covering the sky, महाकायाः of huge body, महाबलाः mighty, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among leaping monkeys, सर्वे all, महेन्द्राद्रिम् from the summit of Mahendra mountain, परित्यज्य left, प्रीतिमन्तः very happily, वायुपुत्रपुरस्सराः led by the son of the Windgod, भूतैः all creatures, सभाज्यमानम् praised by, आत्मवन्तम् selfconfident, महाबलम् mighty, महावेगम् swift, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टिभिः seeing, वहन्तः इव like seeing without blinking, राघवे Rama's, अर्थनिर्ववृततिम् remaining in state of offering, परमम् supreme, यशः fame, कर्तुम् to do, समाधाय concentrating, समृद्धार्थाः better than others, कर्मसिद्धिभिः  accomplished ones, उन्नताः eager, पुप्लुवुः jumping vanaras, सर्वे all, प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः pleasantly talking among themselves, सर्वे all, युद्धाभिनन्दिनः anxious to wage a war, मनस्स्विनः determined, सर्वे all, रामप्रतीकारे to please, निश्चितार्थाः determined.
explanation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

shloka_text: प्रीतिमन्तस्ततः सर्वे वायुपुत्रपरस्पराः। महेन्द्राद्रिं परित्यज्य पुप्लुवुः प्लवगर्षभाः।।5.61.2।। मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशा मत्ता इव महागजाः। छादयन्त इवाकाशं महाकाया महाबलाः।।5.61.3।। सभाज्यमानं भूतैस्तमात्मवन्तं महाबलम्। हनूमन्तं महावेगं वहन्त इव दृष्टिभिः।।5.61.4।। राघवे चार्थनिर्ववृत्तिं कर्तुं च परमं यशः। समाधाय समृद्धार्थाः सर्वेसिद्धिभिरुन्नता।।5.61.5।। प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः सर्वे सर्वे युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। सर्वे रामप्रतीकारे निश्चितार्था मनस्स्विनः।।5.61.6।।
transliteration: prītimantastataḥ sarve vāyuputraparasparāḥ| mahendrādriṃ parityajya pupluvuḥ plavagarṣabhāḥ merumandarasaṅkāśā mattā iva mahāgajāḥ| chādayanta ivākāśaṃ mahākāyā mahābalāḥ sabhājyamānaṃ bhūtaistamātmavantaṃ mahābalam| hanūmantaṃ mahāvegaṃ vahanta iva dṛṣṭibhiḥ rāghave cārthanirvavṛttiṃ kartuṃ ca paramaṃ yaśaḥ| samādhāya samṛddhārthāḥ sarvesiddhibhirunnatā priyākhyānonmukhāḥ sarve sarve yuddhābhinandinaḥ| sarve rāmapratīkāre niścitārthā manassvinaḥ
translation: ततः then, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशाः resembling Meru mountain, मत्ताः in rut, गजाः इव like elephants, आकाशम् sky, छादयन्तः इव as though covering the sky, महाकायाः of huge body, महाबलाः mighty, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among leaping monkeys, सर्वे all, महेन्द्राद्रिम् from the summit of Mahendra mountain, परित्यज्य left, प्रीतिमन्तः very happily, वायुपुत्रपुरस्सराः led by the son of the Windgod, भूतैः all creatures, सभाज्यमानम् praised by, आत्मवन्तम् selfconfident, महाबलम् mighty, महावेगम् swift, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टिभिः seeing, वहन्तः इव like seeing without blinking, राघवे Rama's, अर्थनिर्ववृततिम् remaining in state of offering, परमम् supreme, यशः fame, कर्तुम् to do, समाधाय concentrating, समृद्धार्थाः better than others, कर्मसिद्धिभिः  accomplished ones, उन्नताः eager, पुप्लुवुः jumping vanaras, सर्वे all, प्रियाख्यानोन्मुखाः pleasantly talking among themselves, सर्वे all, युद्धाभिनन्दिनः anxious to wage a war, मनस्स्विनः determined, सर्वे all, रामप्रतीकारे to please, निश्चितार्थाः determined.
explanation: Thereafter led by Hanuman, all the vanaras left Mahendra mountain and marched very happily. The vanaras were strong and huge like elephants and resembled mountain Meru. Moreover when they leaped up they seemed to cover the sky (so it was difficult to tell their numbers). Since Hanuman had accomplished the task, the vanaras were praising his strength, his swiftness and courage. They were looking at Hanuman without blinking their eyes, and seemed as though they were carrying him by their eyes. They were determined in their minds to please Rama. Remaining in a state of offering themselves, some of them more accomplished than others, collected together eager to wage war and talking pleasantly among themselves having resolved to assist Rama.

shloka_text: प्लवमानाः खमाप्लुत्य ततस्ते काननौकसः। नन्दनोपमयासेदुर्वनं द्रुमलतायुतम्।।5.61.7।।
transliteration: plavamānāḥ khamāplutya tataste kānanaukasaḥ| nandanopamayāsedurvanaṃ drumalatāyutam
translation: ततः then, ते they, काननौकसः forestdwellers, monkeys, खम् sky, आफ्लुत्य rising up, प्लवमानाः started leaping, द्रुमलतायुतम् filled with trees and creepers, नन्दनोपमम् like the garden of Indra, वनम् garden, आसेदुः entered.
explanation: "The monkeys leaped into the sky and entered the garden that resembled the garden of Indra filled with trees and creepers.

shloka_text: यत्तन्मधुवनं नाम सुग्रीवस्याभिरक्षितम्। अधृष्यं सर्वभूतानां सर्वभूतमनोहरम्।।5.61.8।।
transliteration: yattanmadhuvanaṃ nāma sugrīvasyābhirakṣitam| adhṛṣyaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvabhūtamanoharam
translation: अभिरक्षितम् wellprotected, सर्वभूतानाम् all creatures, अधृष्यम् difficult to access, सर्वभूतमनोहरम् enchanting to all beings, यत् that, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, मधुवनं नाम Madhuvanam, तत् that.
explanation: The Madhuvanam of Sugriva was wellprotected  and was difficult to access for the vanaras. It was enchating to all beings.

shloka_text: यद्रक्षति महावीर्य स्सदा दधिमुखः कपिः। मातुलः कपिमुख्यस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः।।5.61.9।।
transliteration: yadrakṣati mahāvīrya ssadā dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ| mātulaḥ kapimukhyasya sugrīvasya mahātmanaḥ
translation: महात्मनः great, कपिमुख्यस्य foremost of monkeys, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, मातुलः maternal uncle, महावीर्यः of great valour, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, कपिः monkey, यत् that which, सदा always, रक्षति protected.
explanation: Dadhimukha, the foremost of all monkeys, of great valour and the maternal uncle of Sugriva was the caretaker of  the garden.

shloka_text: ते तद्वनमुपागम्य बभूवुः परमोत्कटाः। वानरा वानरेन्द्रस्य मनः कान्ततमं महत्।।5.61.10।।
transliteration: te tadvanamupāgamya babhūvuḥ paramotkaṭāḥ| vānarā vānarendrasya manaḥ kāntatamaṃ mahat
translation: ते those, वानराः vanaras, वानरेन्द्रस्य Vanara king's, मनःकान्ततमम् delighting to all, महत् extensive, तत् that, वनम् garden, उपागम्य on reaching, परमोत्कटाः highly rejoiced, बभूवुः became.
explanation: On reaching the vanara king's extensive, delightful garden all the vanaras highly rejoiced.

shloka_text: ततस्ते वानरा हृष्टा दृष्टवा मधुवनं महत्। कुमारमभ्ययाचन्त मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः।।5.61.11।।
transliteration: tataste vānarā hṛṣṭā dṛṣṭavā madhuvanaṃ mahat| kumāramabhyayācanta madhūni madhupiṅgalāḥ
translation: ततः then, मधुपिङ्गलाः honeycoloured monkeys, ते वानराः those vanaras, महत् large, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, दृष्ट्वा seeing, हृष्टाः happy, कुमारम् young Angada, मधूनि honey, अभ्ययाचन्त sought permission.
explanation: The honeycoloured monkeys felt happy on seeing the Madhuvanam and sought Angada's permission to drink honey.

shloka_text: ततः कुमारस्तान् वृद्धान् जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् कपीन्। अनुमान्य ददौ तेषां विसर्गं मधुभिक्षणे।।5.61.12।।
transliteration: tataḥ kumārastān vṛddhān jāmbavatpramukhān kapīn| anumānya dadau teṣāṃ visargaṃ madhubhikṣaṇe
translation: ततः then, कुमारः young Angada, वृद्धान् old, तान् him, जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् chief of monkeys Jambavan, कपीन् monkey, अनुमान्य permitting, तेषाम् them, मधुभक्षणे to drink honey, निसर्गम् leave, ददौ gave.
explanation: Young Angada asked old Jambavan's permission for the vanaras to drink honey and Jambavan permitted them.

shloka_text: ततश्चानुमता स्सर्वे सम्प्रहृष्टा वनौकसः। मुदिताः प्रेरिताश्चापि प्रनृत्यन्तोऽभवंस्तदा।।5.61.13।।
transliteration: tataścānumatā ssarve samprahṛṣṭā vanaukasaḥ| muditāḥ preritāścāpi pranṛtyanto'bhavaṃstadā
translation: ततः then, सर्वे all, वनौकसः forestdwellers, monkeys, अनुमताः having been permitted, सम्प्रहृष्टाः very happily, तदा then, प्रेरिताः motivated, मुदिताः rejoiced, प्रनृत्यन्तः started dancing, अभवन् they.
explanation: Permitted thus to drink honey the forestdwelling monkeys were motivated. They rejoiced very happily and started dancing.

shloka_text: गायन्ति केचित्प्रणमन्ति केचिन्नृत्यन्ति केचित्प्रहसन्ति केचित्। पतन्ति केचिद्विचरन्ति केचित्ल्पवन्ति केचित्प्रलपन्ति केचित्।।5.61.14।।
transliteration: gāyanti kecitpraṇamanti kecinnṛtyanti kecitprahasanti kecit| patanti kecidvicaranti kecitlpavanti kecitpralapanti kecit
translation: केचित् some, गायन्ति sang, केचित् some, प्रणमन्ति prostrated, केचित् few, नृत्यन्ति danced, केचित् some, प्रहसन्ति laughed, केचित् while others, पतन्ति fell down, केचित् some, विचरन्ति roamed, केचित् few, प्लवन्ति jumped up, केचित् some, प्रलपन्ति jumped up.
explanation: Some sang, some prostrated on the ground, some danced, while some laughed, some jumped from the tree, some roamed about and some jumped up and down.

shloka_text: परस्परं केचिदुपाश्रयन्ते परस्परं केचिदुपाक्रमन्ते। परस्परं केचिदुपब्रुवन्ते परस्परं केचिदुपारमन्ते।।5.61.15।।
transliteration: parasparaṃ kecidupāśrayante parasparaṃ kecidupākramante| parasparaṃ kecidupabruvante parasparaṃ kecidupāramante
translation: केचित् some, परस्परम् to one another, उपाश्रयन्ते comforted, केचित् some, परस्परम् one another, उपाक्रमन्ते held, केचित् some, परस्परम् one another, उपब्रुवन्ते exchanged secrets, केचित् some, परस्परम् to one another, उपारमन्ते entertained.
explanation: While some supported one another, some held each other, some exchanged secrets with one another, some entertained one another.

shloka_text: द्रुमाद्द्रुमं केचिदभिद्रवन्ते क्षितौ नगाग्रान्निपतन्ति केचित्। महीतलात्केचिदुदीर्णवेगा महाद्रुमाग्राण्यभिसम्पतन्ति।।5.61.16।।
transliteration: drumāddrumaṃ kecidabhidravante kṣitau nagāgrānnipatanti kecit| mahītalātkecidudīrṇavegā mahādrumāgrāṇyabhisampatanti
translation: केचित् some, द्रुमात् from tree, द्रुमम् to another tree, अभिद्रवन्ते ran, केचित् some, नगाग्रात् from the top of tree jumped down, क्षितौ broken, निपतन्ति fell down, केचित् some, उदीर्णवेगाः very swift ones, महातलात् from the huge trees, महाद्रुमाग्राणि from the top of trees, अभिसम्पतन्ति fell down.
explanation: While some ran from one tree to another, some jumped down from broken branches, and some swiftfooted ones fell down from the top of trees.

shloka_text: गायन्तमन्यः प्रहसन्नुपैति हसन्तमन्यः प्ररुदन्नुपैति। रुदन्तमन्यः प्रणुदन्नुपैति नुदन्तमन्यः प्रणदन्नुपैति।।5.61.17।।
transliteration: gāyantamanyaḥ prahasannupaiti hasantamanyaḥ prarudannupaiti| rudantamanyaḥ praṇudannupaiti nudantamanyaḥ praṇadannupaiti
translation: गायन्तम् singing, अन्यः others, प्रहनम् laughing, उपैति on who fell, हसन्तम् laughing, अन्यः others, प्ररुदन् went roaring aloud, उपैति fell, रुदन्तम् roaring, अन्यः others, प्रणुदन् pushing, उपैति fell on others, नुदन्तम् encouraged to do some thing, अन्यः others, प्रणदन् shouting, उपैति fell over.
explanation: While one was singing, others approached him laughing while some were laughing others fell on them laughing excessively. While some were roaring, others went pushing them down. While some were encouraged to do something others shouted at them.

shloka_text: समाकुलं तत्कपिसैन्यमासीन्मधुप्रसानोत्कटसत्त्वचेष्टम्। न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव मत्तो न चात्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तृप्तः।।5.61.18।।
transliteration: samākulaṃ tatkapisainyamāsīnmadhuprasānotkaṭasattvaceṣṭam| na cātra kaścinna babhūva matto na cātra kaścinna babhūva tṛptaḥ
translation: मधुप्रसानोत्कटसत्त्वचेष्टम् lost control due to drinking honeywine, तत् that, कपिसैन्यम् army of monkeys, समाकुलम् collected together, आसीत् quietly seated, अत्र there, कश्चित् not even one, मत्तः intoxicated, न बभूव not there, इति न not only this, अत्र there, कश्चित् none, तृप्तः satisfied, न बभूव इति न not there like that.
explanation: The army of monkeys had lost control over their bodies due to drinking of honeywine. Not even one was quietly seated there. Not even one was not intoxicated. Not only that, none were satisfied.

shloka_text: ततो वनं तत्परिभक्ष्यमाणं द्रुमांश्च विध्वंसितपत्रपुष्पान्। समीक्ष्य कोपाद्धधिवक्रनामा निवारयामास कपिः कपींस्तान्।।5.61.19।।
transliteration: tato vanaṃ tatparibhakṣyamāṇaṃ drumāṃśca vidhvaṃsitapatrapuṣpān| samīkṣya kopāddhadhivakranāmā nivārayāmāsa kapiḥ kapīṃstān
translation: ततः that, दधिवक्त्रनामा named Dadhimukha, कपिः monkey, परिभक्ष्यमाणम् drank all the honeywine, तत् that, वनम् garden, विध्वंसितपत्रपुष्पान् leaves, flowers, द्रुमांश्च and trees, समीक्ष्य seeing, कोपात् in anger, तान् कपीन् the monkeys, निवारयामास asked them to stop and get out.
explanation: Beholding the destruction wrought by the vanaras to the garden, trees, leaves and flowers, and having drunk all the honey, Dadhimukha angrily asked them to stop and get out.

shloka_text: स तैः प्रवृद्धैः परिभर्त्स्यमानो वनस्य गोप्ता हरिवीरवृद्धः। चकार भूयो मतिमुग्रतेजा वनस्य रक्षां प्रति वानरेभ्यः।।5.61.20।।
transliteration: sa taiḥ pravṛddhaiḥ paribhartsyamāno vanasya goptā harivīravṛddhaḥ| cakāra bhūyo matimugratejā vanasya rakṣāṃ prati vānarebhyaḥ
translation: प्रवृद्धैः by the elderly, तैः by both, परिभर्त्स्यमानः reprimanded, वनस्य garden's, गोप्ता  caretaker, हरिवीरवृद्धः old monkey leader, उग्रतेजाः powerful one, वानरेभ्यः by vanaras, वनस्य garden's, रक्षांप्रति to protect, भूयः again, मतिम् in his mind, चकार thought over.
explanation: The elderly Dadhimukha who was the powerful protector of the garden reprimanded them and devised yet again a plan to protect it.

shloka_text: उवाच कांश्चित्परुषाणि धृष्टमसक्तमन्यांश्च तलैर्जघान। समेत्य कैश्चित्कलहं चकार तथैव साम्नोपजगाम कांश्चित्।।5.61.21।।
transliteration: uvāca kāṃścitparuṣāṇi dhṛṣṭamasaktamanyāṃśca talairjaghāna| sametya kaiścitkalahaṃ cakāra tathaiva sāmnopajagāma kāṃścit
translation: कांश्चित् to some, परुषाणि in harsh words, उवाच spoken, अन्यांश्च to others, असक्तम् not to say, तलैः with the palm of the hand, धृष्टम् slapped, जघान hind part, समेत्य with good words, कैश्चित् with some, कलहम् quarrel, चकार made, तथैव in the same way, कांश्चित् some, साम्ना approached, उपजगाम in a conciliatory manner.
explanation: He spoke harshly to some, to others he asked not to talk, some he slapped on the hind part with the palm of his hand. To some he spoke pleasantly and with some he quarrelled. And to others he spoke in a conciliatory manner.

shloka_text: स तैर्मदात्संपरिवार्य वाक्यैर्भलाच्छ तेन प्रतिवार्यमाणैः। प्रधर्षितस्त्यक्तभयै स्समेत्य प्रकृष्यते चाप्यनवेक्ष्य दोषम्।।5.61.22।।
transliteration: sa tairmadātsaṃparivārya vākyairbhalāccha tena prativāryamāṇaiḥ| pradharṣitastyaktabhayai ssametya prakṛṣyate cāpyanavekṣya doṣam
translation: तैर्मदात् in their drunkenness, अप्रतिवार्यवाक्यैः speaking in abusive language, तेन by them, बलात् by their strength, प्रतिवार्यमाणैः retaliated, त्यक्तभयैः devoid of fear, तैः those, प्रधर्षितः roared, सः that, दोषं च mistakes only, अनवेक्ष्य not seeing, सम्ये held, प्रकृष्यते च pulled.
explanation: In their drunkenness they were using abusive language and with their strength they retaliated without fear. They invaded without considering their mistakes. They caught hold of Dadhimukha and pulled him.

shloka_text: नखैस्तुदन्तो दशनैर्दशन्त स्तलैश्च पादैश्च समापयन्तः। मदात्कपिं तं कपय स्समग्रा महावनं निर्विषयं च चक्रुः।।5.61.23।।
transliteration: nakhaistudanto daśanairdaśanta stalaiśca pādaiśca samāpayantaḥ| madātkapiṃ taṃ kapaya ssamagrā mahāvanaṃ nirviṣayaṃ ca cakruḥ
translation: समग्राः all of them together, कपयः that monkey, मदात् in their drunkenness, नखैः with nails, तुदन्तः scratched, दशनैः with teeth, दशन्तः bitten, तलैश्च with palms, पादैश्च legs, तं कपिम् the monkeys, समापयन्तः getting together, महावनम् great garden, निर्विषयम् completely, चक्रुः looted.
explanation: In their drunkenness some monkeys scratched Dadhimukha violently with their nails, some bit him with their teeth and others slapped and kicked him with their palms and legs.Getting together they looted the garden completely. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे एकषष्टितम स्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfirst sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तानुवाच हरिश्रेष्ठो हनुमान्वानरर्षभः। अव्यग्रमनसो यूयं मधु सेवत वानराः।।5.62.1।। अहमावारयिष्यामि युष्माकं परिपन्थिनः।
transliteration: tānuvāca hariśreṣṭho hanumānvānararṣabhaḥ| avyagramanaso yūyaṃ madhu sevata vānarāḥ ahamāvārayiṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ paripanthinaḥ|
translation: हरिश्रेष्ठः foremost of the monkeys, वानरर्षभः bull among vanaras, हनुमान् Hanuman, तान् them, उवाच spoke, वानराः vanaras, यूयम् looking at, अव्यग्रमनसः devoid of any fear in your mind, मधु honey, सेवत take, अहम् I, युष्माकम् those, परिपन्थिनः who object to your action, अवायिष्यामि will prevent.
explanation: Hanuman, the foremost of the monkeys, bull among vanaras said, 'Enjoy the honey devoid of any fear. I shall prevent those who object to your action'.
comments: Guards of Madhuvanam headed by Dadhimukha move to report to Sugriva.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं हरीणां प्रवरोऽङ्गदः।।5.62.2।। प्रत्युवाच प्रसन्नात्मा पिबन्तु हरयो मधु।
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyaṃ harīṇāṃ pravaro'ṅgadaḥ pratyuvāca prasannātmā pibantu harayo madhu|
translation: हनुमतः Hanuman, वाक्यम् these words, श्रुत्वा hearing, हरीणाम् to the monkeys, प्रवरः distinguished, अङ्गदः Angada, प्रसन्नात्मा very pleased, प्रत्युवाच replied, हरयः vanaras, पिबन्तु you may drink.
explanation: Pleased with Hanuman's words, the distinguished Angada permitted the monkeys to drink.

shloka_text: अवश्यं कृतकार्यस्य वाक्यं हनुमतो मया।।5.62.3।। अकार्यमपि कर्तव्यं किमङ्ग पुनरीदृशम्।
transliteration: avaśyaṃ kṛtakāryasya vākyaṃ hanumato mayā akāryamapi kartavyaṃ kimaṅga punarīdṛśam|
translation: कृतकार्यस्य one who has accomplished the task, हनुमतः Hanuman, वाक्यम् these words, अकार्यमपि tells not to do, मया by me, अवश्यम् surely, कर्तव्यम् what is to be done, ईदृशं पुनः when he has spoken again, किमङ्ग what to say?
explanation: Even if Hanuman, the achiever, forbids me to do something, I will do it. And now when he has permitted you, why hesitate ?

shloka_text: अङ्गदस्य मुखाच्छ्रुत्वावचनं वानरर्षभाः।।5.62.4।। साधुसाध्विति संहृष्टा वानराः प्रत्यपूजयन्।
transliteration: aṅgadasya mukhācchrutvāvacanaṃ vānararṣabhāḥ sādhusādhviti saṃhṛṣṭā vānarāḥ pratyapūjayan|
translation: वानरर्षभाः bulls among vanaras, वानराः vanaras, अङ्गदस्य Angada's, मुखात् from the mouth, वचः spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, संहृष्टाः very happy, साधु साध्विति good words, प्रत्यपूजयन् praised.
explanation: Having heard the words that came from Angada's mouth, the bulls among vanaras praised him for his generous approval.

shloka_text: पूजयित्वाङ्गदं सर्वे वानरा वानरर्षभम्।।5.62.5।। जग्मुर्मधुवनं यत्र नदीवेग इव द्रुमम्।
transliteration: pūjayitvāṅgadaṃ sarve vānarā vānararṣabham jagmurmadhuvanaṃ yatra nadīvega iva drumam|
translation: सर्वे all, वानरा vanaras, वानरर्षभम् to bull among vanaras, अङ्गदम् to Angada, पूजयित्वा having praised, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, यत्र there, नदीवेगः fast flowing river, द्रुमम् इव like tree, जग्मुः went.
explanation: The vanaras praised Angada, the bull among vanaras and went to Madhuvanam swiftly like a fastflowing river going to uproot a tree.

shloka_text: ते प्रविष्टा मधुवनं पालानाक्रम्य वीर्यतः।।5.62.6।। अतिसर्गाच्च पटवो दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम्। पपुस्सर्वे मधु तदा रसवत्फलमाददुः।।5.62.7।।
transliteration: te praviṣṭā madhuvanaṃ pālānākramya vīryataḥ atisargācca paṭavo dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca maithilīm| papussarve madhu tadā rasavatphalamādaduḥ
translation: मैथिलीम् Mythili, दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रुत्वा heard, अतिसर्गाच्च overjoyed with success, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टाः entered, पालान् guards, वीर्यतः violently, आक्रम्य attacked, तदा then, मधु Madhu, पपुः drank, रसवत् tasty, फलम् fruits, आददु: ate.
explanation: Overjoyed at the news of Mythili, being seen, the vanaras entered Madhuvanam and attacked the guards violently, drank the honey and ate the tasty fruits.

shloka_text: ते प्रविष्टा मधुवनं पालानाक्रम्य वीर्यतः।।5.62.6।। अतिसर्गाच्च पटवो दृष्ट्वा श्रुत्वा च मैथिलीम्। पपुस्सर्वे मधु तदा रसवत्फलमाददुः।।5.62.7।।
transliteration: te praviṣṭā madhuvanaṃ pālānākramya vīryataḥ atisargācca paṭavo dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca maithilīm| papussarve madhu tadā rasavatphalamādaduḥ
translation: मैथिलीम् Mythili, दृष्ट्वा having seen, श्रुत्वा heard, अतिसर्गाच्च overjoyed with success, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टाः entered, पालान् guards, वीर्यतः violently, आक्रम्य attacked, तदा then, मधु Madhu, पपुः drank, रसवत् tasty, फलम् fruits, आददु: ate.
explanation: Overjoyed at the news of Mythili, being seen, the vanaras entered Madhuvanam and attacked the guards violently, drank the honey and ate the tasty fruits.

shloka_text: उत्पत्य च ततस्सर्वे वनपालान् समागतान्। ताडयन्ति स्म शतश स्सक्तान्मधुवने तदा।।5.62.8।।
transliteration: utpatya ca tatassarve vanapālān samāgatān| tāḍayanti sma śataśa ssaktānmadhuvane tadā
translation: तदा then, सर्वे all, मधुवने in Madhuvanam, शतशः in many ways, सक्तान् vanaras, समागतान् came together, वनपालान् guards protecting the garden, उत्पत्य risen up, ततः then, ताडयन्ति स्म struck.
explanation: All the vanaras collected together, entered the Madhuvanam and attacked in many ways the guards protecting  the  garden.

shloka_text: मधूनि द्रोणमात्राणि बाहुभिः परिगृह्य ते। पिबन्ति सहिता स्सर्वे निघ्नन्ति स्म तथापरे।।5.62.9।।
transliteration: madhūni droṇamātrāṇi bāhubhiḥ parigṛhya te| pibanti sahitā ssarve nighnanti sma tathāpare
translation: ते सर्वे all of them, बाहुभिः many, द्रोणमात्राणि of huge size (large containers made of leather, a drona is a measure of two litres), मधूनि honey, परिगृह्य took hold of, सहिताः together, पिबन्ति  drinking, अपरे others, निघ्नन्ति स्म were preventing.
explanation: All of them now gathered at one place and drank honey from large containers. Others were busy preventing the guards.

shloka_text: केचित्पीत्वा प्रविध्यन्ति मधूनि मधुपिङ्गलाः। मधूच्छिष्टेन केचिच्च जग्मुरन्योन्यमुत्कटाः।।5.62.10।।
transliteration: kecitpītvā pravidhyanti madhūni madhupiṅgalāḥ| madhūcchiṣṭena kecicca jagmuranyonyamutkaṭāḥ
translation: मधुपिङ्गलाः honeycoloured, केचित् some, मधूनि honey, पीत्वा were drinking, प्रविध्यन्ति throwing, केचिच्च some, मधूच्छिष्ठेन chunks of honey combs, उत्कटाः intoxicated, अन्योन्यम् with each other, जग्मुः went about.
explanation: The honeycoloured monkeys drank honey. Some threw large chunks of honey combs after drinking and some went about intoxicated.

shloka_text: अपरे वृक्षमूले तु शाखां गृह्य व्यवस्थिताः। अत्यर्थं च मदग्लानाः पर्णान्यास्तीर्य शेरते।।5.62.11।।
transliteration: apare vṛkṣamūle tu śākhāṃ gṛhya vyavasthitāḥ| atyarthaṃ ca madaglānāḥ parṇānyāstīrya śerate
translation: अपरे some others, शाखाम् branches of trees, गृह्य taking, वृक्षमूले at the root of trees, व्यवस्थिताः stayed, अत्यर्थम् on account of drinking, मदग्लानाः sweet drinks, पर्णानि leaves, आस्तीर्य spreading, शेरते lay down.
explanation: Some took branches of trees and rested at the root of trees. Some totally languid lay down spreading leaves due to drinking of sweet drinks.

shloka_text: उन्मत्तभूताः प्लवगा मधुमत्ताश्च हृष्टवत्। क्षिपन्ति च तथान्योन्यं स्खलन्ति च तथाऽपरे।।5.62.12।।
transliteration: unmattabhūtāḥ plavagā madhumattāśca hṛṣṭavat| kṣipanti ca tathānyonyaṃ skhalanti ca tathā'pare
translation: मधुमत्ताः by drinking of honey, प्लवगाः vanaras, उन्मत्तभूताः like mad people, हृष्टवत् joyfully, अन्योन्यम् each other, क्षिपन्ति pushing each other, अपरे others, स्खलन्ति च were shaking unsteady.
explanation: Intoxicated with drink, some behaved like mad people, some pushed others senselessly and some were unsteady and shaky.

shloka_text: केचित् क्ष्वेलां प्रकुर्वन्ति केचित् कूजन्ति हृष्टवत्। हरयोमधुना मत्ताः केचित्सुप्ता महीतले।।5.62.13।।
transliteration: kecit kṣvelāṃ prakurvanti kecit kūjanti hṛṣṭavat| harayomadhunā mattāḥ kecitsuptā mahītale
translation: केचित् some, क्ष्वेलाम् प्रकुर्वन्ति roared, केचित् some, हृष्टवत् happy, कूजन्ति cooing like the birds, मधुना by the drinking of honey, मत्ताः drowsy, केचित् हरयः some vanaras, महीतले on the ground, सुप्ताः slept.
explanation: Some roared, some warbled happily, some felt drowsy, drinking honey and some dropped off to sleep on the ground.

shloka_text: कृत्वा केचिद्धसन्त्यन्ये केचित्कुर्वन्ति चेतरत्। कृत्वा केचिद्वदन्त्यन्ये केचिद्बुध्यन्ति चेतरत्।।5.62.14।।
transliteration: kṛtvā keciddhasantyanye kecitkurvanti cetarat| kṛtvā kecidvadantyanye kecidbudhyanti cetarat
translation: केचित् some, कृत्वा having done, हसन्ति laughing, अन्ये others, केचित् some, इतरत् different, कुर्वन्ति doing, केचित् some, कृत्वा having done, वदन्ति were telling others, अन्ये others, केचित् some, इतरत् something else, बुध्यन्ति thought of doing.
explanation: Some made others laugh, some provoked others and some thought of doing something else having got over the intoxication.

shloka_text: येऽप्यत्र मधुपाला स्स्युः प्रेष्या दधिमुखस्य तु। तेऽपि तैर्वानरैर्भीमैः प्रतिषिद्धा दिशो गताः।।5.62.15।।
transliteration: ye'pyatra madhupālā ssyuḥ preṣyā dadhimukhasya tu| te'pi tairvānarairbhīmaiḥ pratiṣiddhā diśo gatāḥ
translation: अत्र there, दधिमुखस्य Dadhimukha's, प्रेष्याः engaged, मधुपालाः guards of Madhuvanam, ये those, स्युः to cover, तेऽपि were also, भीमैः fierce, वानरैः vanaras, प्रतिषिद्धाः driven away, दिशः in all directions, गताः went.
explanation: All the guards engaged in protecting the garden were driven away in all directions by the fierce vanaras.

shloka_text: जानुभिस्तु प्रकृष्टाश्च देवमार्गं प्रदर्शिताः। अब्रुवन् परमोद्विग्ना गत्वा दधिमुखं वचः।।5.62.16।।
transliteration: jānubhistu prakṛṣṭāśca devamārgaṃ pradarśitāḥ| abruvan paramodvignā gatvā dadhimukhaṃ vacaḥ
translation: जानुभिः knees, प्रकृष्टाः drawn forth, देवमार्गम् towards the path of gods, प्रदर्शिताः exhibiting, परमोद्विग्नाः greatly disturbed, दधिमुखम् to Dadhimukha, गत्वा having gone, वचः these words, अब्रुवन् said.
explanation: Some were dragged on their knees and tossed up. Some monkeys exhibited their private parts, showing indecent behaviour. Dadhimukha, highly disturbed at this, said:

shloka_text: हनूमता दत्तवरैर्हतं मधुवनं बलात्। वयं च जानुभिः कृष्टा देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः।।5.62.17।।
transliteration: hanūmatā dattavarairhataṃ madhuvanaṃ balāt| vayaṃ ca jānubhiḥ kṛṣṭā devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ
translation: हनूमता Hanuman, दत्तवरैर्हतं by whom they were permitted, वयं च and us, मधुवनं Madhuvanam, जानुभिः knees, बलात् forcefully, कृष्टा holding, देवमार्गं च  dragged to the private parts, दर्शिताः and showed.
explanation: Permitted by Hanuman (to enter Madhuvanam and drink), they dragged one another forcefully tossed up  on their knees showing their private parts.

shloka_text: ततो दधिमुख: क्रुद्धो वनपस्तत्र वानरः। हतं मधुवनं श्रुत्वा सान्त्वयामास तान् हरीन्।।5.62.18।।
transliteration: tato dadhimukha: kruddho vanapastatra vānaraḥ| hataṃ madhuvanaṃ śrutvā sāntvayāmāsa tān harīn
translation: ततः then, तत्र there, वनपः guardian of the garden, दधिमुख: Dadhimukha, वानर: vanara, क्रुद्धः furious, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, हतम् destoyed, श्रुत्वा having heard, हरीन् vanaras, सान्त्वयामास with soothing words.
explanation: Then Dadhimukha, the guardian of the garden became furious on the vanaras. Having heard from the guards that the garden was destroyed, he said soothing words to them.

shloka_text: इहागच्छत गच्छामो वानरान् बलदर्पितान्। बलेन वारयिष्यामो मधु भक्षयतो वयम्।।5.62.19।।
transliteration: ihāgacchata gacchāmo vānarān baladarpitān| balena vārayiṣyāmo madhu bhakṣayato vayam
translation: इह here, आगच्चत come, गच्चामः will go, वयम् we, बलदर्पितान् proud of their power, मधु Madhu, भक्षयतः consume honey, वानरान् vanaras, बलेन forcibly, वारयिष्यामः will prevent them.
explanation: "Come, we will all go there to Madhuvanam and prevent forcibly the vanaras who have consumed honey proud of their power.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं वचनं वानरर्षभाः। पुनर्वीरा मधुवनं तेनैव सहसा ययुः।।5.62.20।।
transliteration: śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṃ vacanaṃ vānararṣabhāḥ| punarvīrā madhuvanaṃ tenaiva sahasā yayuḥ
translation: वीराः heroes, वानरर्षभाः bull among vanaras, दधिमुखस्य Dadhimukha's, इदम् this kind of, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, सहसा quickly, तेनैव along with him, पुनः again, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, ययुः went.
explanation: "The heroes, bulls among vanaras, heard Dadhimukha and quickly entered Madhuvanam along with him.

shloka_text: मध्ये चैषां दधिमुखः प्रगृह्य तरसा तरुम्। समभ्यधावद्वेगेन ते च सर्वे प्लवङ्गमाः।।5.62.21।।
transliteration: madhye caiṣāṃ dadhimukhaḥ pragṛhya tarasā tarum| samabhyadhāvadvegena te ca sarve plavaṅgamāḥ
translation: एषाम् their, मध्ये way, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, तरसा energetic, तरुम् tree, प्रगृह्य taking up, वेगेन swiftly, समभ्यधावत् following, ते they, सर्वे all, प्लवङ्गमाः च the leaping vanaras.
explanation: On the way, the energetic Dadhimukha took up a tree and ran to the leaping vanaras swiftly with guards following him.

shloka_text: ते शिलाः पादपांश्चापि पर्वतांश्चापि वानराः। गृहीत्वाऽऽभ्यगमन् क्रुद्धा यत्र ते कपिकुञ्जराः।।5.62.22।।
transliteration: te śilāḥ pādapāṃścāpi parvatāṃścāpi vānarāḥ| gṛhītvā''bhyagaman kruddhā yatra te kapikuñjarāḥ
translation: ते वानराः those vanaras, क्रुद्धाः furious, शिलाः rocks, पादपांश्चापि also trees, पर्वतांश्चापि even mountains, गृहीत्वा took up, ते they, कपिकुञ्जराः elephant of monkeys, यत्र there, अभ्यगमन् went.
explanation: The furious vanara guards lifted rocks, trees and even mountains and went behind Dadhimukha the elephant among the vanaras.

shloka_text: ते स्वामिवचनं वीरा हृदयेष्ववसज्य तत्। त्वरया ह्यभ्यधावन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः।।5.62.23।।
transliteration: te svāmivacanaṃ vīrā hṛdayeṣvavasajya tat| tvarayā hyabhyadhāvanta sālatālaśilāyudhāḥ
translation: वीराः heroic, ते they, तत् that, स्वामिवचनम् leader's words, हृदयेषु in their heart, अवसज्य rushed, सालतालशिलायुधाः Sala, Tala trees as weapons, त्वरया at once, अभ्यधावन्त ran.
explanation: The heroic vanaras held Sala and Tala trees and rushed at once keeping their leader's words in mind.

shloka_text: वृक्षस्थांश्च तलस्थांश्च वानरान् बलदर्पितान्। अभ्यक्रामंस्ततो वीराः पालास्तत्र सहस्रशः।।5.62.24।।
transliteration: vṛkṣasthāṃśca talasthāṃśca vānarān baladarpitān| abhyakrāmaṃstato vīrāḥ pālāstatra sahasraśaḥ
translation: ततः then, वीराः heroic, पालाः guards, सहस्रशः in thousands, वृक्षस्थांश्च on the trees, तलस्थांश्च under the trees, बलदर्पितान् proud of their power, वानरान् vanaras, अभ्यक्रामन् attacked.
explanation: Then the heroic guards in their thousands fell on the vanaras proud of their power on and under the tala trees.

shloka_text: अथ दृष्ट्वा दधिमुखं क्रुद्धं वानरपुङ्गवाः। अभ्यधावन्त वेगेन हनुमत्प्रमुखास्तदा।।5.62.25।।
transliteration: atha dṛṣṭvā dadhimukhaṃ kruddhaṃ vānarapuṅgavāḥ| abhyadhāvanta vegena hanumatpramukhāstadā
translation: अथ and then, हनुमत्प्रमुखाः leader Hanuman, वानरपुङ्गवाः foremost of vanaras, तदा then, दधिमुखम् Dadhimukha's, क्रुद्धम् fury, दृष्ट्वा having seen, वेगेन swiftly, अभ्यधावन्त went there.
explanation: Having seen the fury of Dadhimukha, Hanuman the leader of the vanaras went to him swiftly.

shloka_text: तं सवृक्षं महाबाहुमापतन्तं महाबलम्। आर्यकं प्राहरत्तत्र बाहुभ्यां कुपितोऽङ्गदः।।5.62.26।।
transliteration: taṃ savṛkṣaṃ mahābāhumāpatantaṃ mahābalam| āryakaṃ prāharattatra bāhubhyāṃ kupito'ṅgadaḥ
translation: कुपितः angry, अङ्गदः Angada, सवृक्षम् with trees, महाबाहुम् strongarmed, महाबलम् powerful, आपतन्तम् coming, तम् him, आर्यकम् तत्र there, बाहुभ्याम् with both hands, प्राहरत् clasped tightly.
explanation: Seeing the revered, powerful and strongarmed Dadhimukha rushing to him, the angry Angada caught him with both hands tightly.

shloka_text: मदान्धश्च न वेदैनमार्यकोऽयं ममेति सः। अथैनं निष्पिपेषाशु वेगवद्वसुधातले।।5.62.27।।
transliteration: madāndhaśca na vedainamāryako'yaṃ mameti saḥ| athainaṃ niṣpipeṣāśu vegavadvasudhātale
translation: सः he, मदान्धश्च blinded by arrogance, अयम् this, मम my, आर्यकः revered, इति this, एनम् therefore, न वेद not understnding that (I am his granduncle), अथ now, एनम् therefore, वसुधातले on the floor, वेगवत् forcibly, आशु him, निष्पिपेष pushed.
explanation: "Blinded by arrogance, the prince pushed him (Dadhimukha) on the floor forcibly,  forgetting that he was his revered granduncle.

shloka_text: स भग्नबाहूरुभुजो विह्वलश्शोणितोक्षितः। मुमोह सहसा वीरो मुहूर्तं कपिकुञ्जरः।।5.62.28।।
transliteration: sa bhagnabāhūrubhujo vihvalaśśoṇitokṣitaḥ| mumoha sahasā vīro muhūrtaṃ kapikuñjaraḥ
translation: भग्नबाहूरुभुजः with shoulders and arms broken, विह्वलः battered, शोणितोक्षितः body drenched in blood, सः he, Dadhimukha, वीरः a hero, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among monkeys, सहसा at once, मुहूर्तम् in a moment, मुमोह lost conciousness.
explanation: The heroic Dadhimukha, an elephant among monkeys, with his shoulders and arms broken, and body drenched in blood lost his consciousness instantly.

shloka_text: स समाश्वस्य सहसा सङ्कृद्धो राजमातुलः। वानरान्वारयामास दण्डेन मधुमोहितान्।।5.62.29।।
transliteration: sa samāśvasya sahasā saṅkṛddho rājamātulaḥ| vānarānvārayāmāsa daṇḍena madhumohitān
translation: राजमातुलः maternal uncle of the king, सः he, सहसा at once, समाश्वस्य coming out of unconscious state, सङ्कृद्धः furious, मधुमोहितान् deluded by drinking, वानरान् vanaras, दण्डेन with a stick, वारयामास chased.
explanation: At once Dadhimukha, the maternal uncle of the king became conscious and chased with a stick the intoxicated vanaras.

shloka_text: स कथञ्चिद्विमुक्तस्स्तैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभः। उवाचैकान्तमाश्रित्य भृत्यान् स्वान् समुपागतान्।।5.62.30।।
transliteration: sa kathañcidvimuktasstairvānarairvānararṣabhaḥ| uvācaikāntamāśritya bhṛtyān svān samupāgatān
translation: तैः they, वानरैः vanaras, कथञ्चित् with great difficulty, विमुक्तः escaped, सः he, Dadhimukha, वानरर्षभः bull among monkeys, एकान्तम् secluded, आश्रित्य reached, समुपागतान् returned, स्वान् them, भृत्यान् servants, उवाच said.
explanation: Escaping from the vanaras with great difficulty, Dadhimukha,  a bull among monkeys, repaired to a secluded place and said to his servants:

shloka_text: एते तिष्ठन्तु गच्छामो भर्ता नो यत्र वानरः। सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः सह रामेण तिष्ठति।।5.62.31।।
transliteration: ete tiṣṭhantu gacchāmo bhartā no yatra vānaraḥ| sugrīvo vipulagrīvaḥ saha rāmeṇa tiṣṭhati
translation: एते let them, तिष्ठन्तु stay, नः our, भर्ता king, वानरः vanaras, विपुलग्रीवः one with broad neck, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र there, रामेण सह with Rama, तिष्ठति will be staying, गच्चामः let us go.
explanation: "Let them stay here. Our broadnecked king Sugriva will be there with Rama. Let us go to him.

shloka_text: सर्वं चैवाङ्गदे दोषं श्रावयिष्यामि पार्थिवे। अमर्षी वचनं श्रुत्वा घातयिष्यति वानरान्।।5.62.32।।
transliteration: sarvaṃ caivāṅgade doṣaṃ śrāvayiṣyāmi pārthive| amarṣī vacanaṃ śrutvā ghātayiṣyati vānarān
translation: अङ्गदे Angada, सर्वम् all, दोषम् mistakes, पार्थिवे to the king, श्रावयिष्यामि will let him know, वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, अमर्षि very furious, वानरान् vanaras, घातयिष्यति will put an end.
explanation: I will make all of Angada's faults known to the king; hearing it, the furious one will have the monkeys put to death.

shloka_text: इष्टं मधुवनं ह्येतत्पार्थिवस्य महात्मनः। पितृपैतामहं दिव्यं देवैरपि दुरासदम्।।5.62.33।।
transliteration: iṣṭaṃ madhuvanaṃ hyetatpārthivasya mahātmanaḥ| pitṛpaitāmahaṃ divyaṃ devairapi durāsadam
translation: पितृपैतामहम् from grandfather and father, दिव्यम् wonderful, देवैरपि even for devatas, दुरासदम् forbidden, एतत् this, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, महात्मनः great self, पार्थिवस्य to the king, इष्टं हि very dear.
explanation: 'Madhuvan has come down to us from our forefather's time. Dear to the king, its entry is prohibited even to the gods.

shloka_text: स वानरानिमान् सर्वान् मधुलुब्धान् गतायुषः। घातयिष्यति दण्डेन सुग्रीवस्ससुहृज्जनान्।।5.62.34।।
transliteration: sa vānarānimān sarvān madhulubdhān gatāyuṣaḥ| ghātayiṣyati daṇḍena sugrīvassasuhṛjjanān
translation: सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, मधुलुब्धान् those greedy for honey, गतायुषः doomed, ससुहृज्जनान् their friends, इमान् these, सर्वान् all, वानरान् vanaras, दण्डेन with a stick, घातयिष्यति will be beaten.
explanation: 'Sugriva will chase all the vanaras and their friends greedy for honey. They will be punished with a stick. They are doomed'.

shloka_text: वध्या ह्येते दुरात्मानो नृपाज्ञापरिभाविनः। अमर्षप्रभवो रोषस्सफलो नो भविष्यति।।5.62.35।।
transliteration: vadhyā hyete durātmāno nṛpājñāparibhāvinaḥ| amarṣaprabhavo roṣassaphalo no bhaviṣyati
translation: नृपाज्ञापरिभाविनः who have disobeyed the king's order, एते they, दुरात्मनः evilminded, वध्याः हि indeed deserve to be killed, अमर्षप्रभवः forbearance king, नः रोषः our fury, सफलः will result in success, भविष्यति will be.
explanation: 'Indeed those evilminded ones who have disobeyed the king's order deserve to be killed.That way our fury and forbearance will result in success'.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा दधिमुखो वनपालान्महाबलः। जगाम सहसोत्पत्य वनपालैस्समन्वितः।।5.62.36।।
transliteration: evamuktvā dadhimukho vanapālānmahābalaḥ| jagāma sahasotpatya vanapālaissamanvitaḥ
translation: महाबलः very powerful, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, वनसालान् garden protectors, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सहसा at once, वनपालैः garden guards, समन्वितः along with them, उत्पत्य rising to the sky, जगाम went.
explanation: Powerful Dadhimukha having said that to the guardians of the garden rose up to the sky and went off with them.

shloka_text: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण स हि प्राप्तो वनालयः। सहस्रांशुसुतो धीमान् सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः।।5.62.37।।
transliteration: nimeṣāntaramātreṇa sa hi prāpto vanālayaḥ| sahasrāṃśusuto dhīmān sugrīvo yatra vānaraḥ
translation: सः he, वनालयः forestdweller, सहस्रांशुसुतः to the son of Sungod, धीमान् wise, सुग्रीवः वानरः to the vanara Sugriva, यत्र there, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in a moment's time, प्राप्तः reached.
explanation: In a moment, Dadhimukha reached the place where wise Sugriva, the son of Sungod was there

shloka_text: रामं च लक्ष्मणं चैव दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवमेव च। समप्रतिष्ठां जगतीमाकाशान्निपपात ह।।5.62.38।।
transliteration: rāmaṃ ca lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva dṛṣṭvā sugrīvameva ca| samapratiṣṭhāṃ jagatīmākāśānnipapāta ha
translation: रामं च Rama, लक्ष्मणं चैव and also Lakshmana, सुग्रीवमेव च and also Sugriva, दृष्ट्वा seeing, आकाशात् from the sky, समप्रतिष्ठाम् even, जगतीम् ground, निपपात landed.
explanation: Seeing Rama, Lakshmana and also Sugriva from the sky he landed on an even ground.

shloka_text: सन्निपत्य महावीर्यस्सर्वैस्तै: परिवारितः। हरिर्दधिमुखः पालैः पालानां परमेश्वरः।।5.62.39।। स दीनवदनो भूत्वा कृत्वा शिरसि चाञ्जलिम्। सुग्रीवस्य शुभौ मूर्ध्ना चरणौ पत्यपीडयत्।।5.62.40।।
transliteration: sannipatya mahāvīryassarvaistai: parivāritaḥ| harirdadhimukhaḥ pālaiḥ pālānāṃ parameśvaraḥ sa dīnavadano bhūtvā kṛtvā śirasi cāñjalim| sugrīvasya śubhau mūrdhnā caraṇau patyapīḍayat
translation: सर्वैः all, तैः पालैः those guards, परिवारितः the servants, पालानाम् king, परमेश्वरः lord, हरिः of monkeys, महावीर्यः great hero, सः दधिमुखः that Dadhimukha, दीनवदनः with a painful expression on the face, शिरसि head bowed down, अञ्जलिम् salutations with folded hands, कृत्वा having offered, सन्निपत्य surrounded by, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva, शुभे auspicious, चरणौ feet, मूर्ध्ना touching with his forehead, पत्यपीडयत् painful obeisance.
explanation: Dadhimukha, a great hero and king of the guards protecting Madhuvanam surrounded by his servants, with a sad expression on his face offered painful obeisance with folded hands bowing down his forehead at the feet of Sugriva. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysecond sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततो मूर्ध्ना निपतितं वानरं वानरर्षभः। दृष्ट्वैवोद्विग्नहृदयो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।।5.63.1।।
transliteration: tato mūrdhnā nipatitaṃ vānaraṃ vānararṣabhaḥ| dṛṣṭvaivodvignahṛdayo vākyametaduvāca ha
translation: ततः then, वानरर्षभः bull among vanaras, मूर्ध्ना forehead, निपतितम् prostrated, वानरम् vanara, Dadhimukha, दृष्ट्वैव as soon as he saw, उद्विग्नहृदयः anxious at heart, एतत् these, वाक्यम् words, उवाच ह spoke.
explanation: Feeling anxious on seeing Dadhimukha touching his feet with his forehead, Sugriva, the bull among vanaras said:
comments: Sugriva tells Dadhimukha not to worry about the destruction of Madhuvanam. He asked him to send Hanuman, Angada and others

shloka_text: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ कस्मात्त्वं पादयोः पतितो मम। अभयं ते भवेद्वीर सर्वमेवाभिधीयताम्।।5.63.2।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha kasmāttvaṃ pādayoḥ patito mama| abhayaṃ te bhavedvīra sarvamevābhidhīyatām
translation: वीर hero, उत्तिष्ठ उत्तिष्ठ get up, get up, त्वम् you, कस्मात् why, मम my, पादयोः feet, पतितः fallen, ते to you, अभयम् give you protection, भवेत् you be, सर्वमेव from all, अभिधीयताम् you may tell.
explanation: "O heroic Dadhimukha, get up. Tell me why you have fallen at my feet. I give you protection from all.

shloka_text: स तु विश्वासितस्तेन सुग्रीवेण महात्मना। उत्थाय सुमहाप्राज्ञो वाक्यं दधिमुखोऽब्रवीत्।।5.63.3।।
transliteration: sa tu viśvāsitastena sugrīveṇa mahātmanā| utthāya sumahāprājño vākyaṃ dadhimukho'bravīt
translation: महात्मना great self, तेन सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, विश्वासितः given assurance, सुमहाप्राज्ञः very wise, सः दधिमुखः that Dadhimukha, उत्थाय got up, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: When great Sugriva gave assurance to wise Dadhimukha, he got up and said:

shloka_text: नैवर्क्षरजसा राजन्न त्वया नापि वालिना। वनं निसृष्टपूर्वं हि भक्षितं तच्च वानरैः।।5.63.4।।
transliteration: naivarkṣarajasā rājanna tvayā nāpi vālinā| vanaṃ nisṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hi bhakṣitaṃ tacca vānaraiḥ
translation: राजन् O king, वनम्  garden, ऋक्षरजसा in Riksharaja's time, नैव निसृष्टपूर्वं हि or even before, त्वया your time, न not, वालिनापि even at the time of Vali, न not, तच्च accessible to go, वानरैः vanaras, भक्षितम् finished eating.
explanation: "O king in your time or even before, during the time of Vali, that (Madhuvanam) was forbidden for entry. Now it has been laid waste by the trespassing vanaras.

shloka_text: एभिः प्रधर्षिताश्चैव वानरा वनरक्षिभिः। मधून्यचिन्तयित्वेमान् भक्षयन्ति पिबन्ति च।।5.63.5।।
transliteration: ebhiḥ pradharṣitāścaiva vānarā vanarakṣibhiḥ| madhūnyacintayitvemān bhakṣayanti pibanti ca
translation: एभिः they also, वनरक्षिभिः garden guards, प्रधर्षिताश्चैव even though resisted, वानराः vanaras, इमान् them, अचिन्तयित्वा not cared for, मधूनि honey, भक्षयन्ति finished eating, पिबन्ति च and drinking.
explanation: "Even though the garden guards forcibly tried to prevent them they did not care and have devoured all the honey.

shloka_text: शिष्टमत्रापविध्यन्ति भक्षयन्ति तथापरे। निवार्यमाणास्ते सर्वे भ्रुवो वै दर्शयन्ति हि।।5.63.6।।
transliteration: śiṣṭamatrāpavidhyanti bhakṣayanti tathāpare| nivāryamāṇāste sarve bhruvo vai darśayanti hi
translation: शिष्टम् left over, अत्र there, अपविध्यन्ति thrown off, तथा similarly, अपरे others, भक्षयन्ति eating, ते सर्वे all, निवार्यमाणाः when we prevented, भ्रुवः eyebrows, दर्शयन्ति च raising to show (a sign of arrogance)
explanation: "Some have thrown off the leftovers, when others were prevented from drinking off the honey, they raised their eyebrows (to show their grouch).

shloka_text: इमे हि संरब्धतरास्तथा तैस्सम्प्रधर्षिताः। वारयन्तो वनात्तस्मात्क्रुद्धैर्वानरपुङ्गवैः।।5.63.7।।
transliteration: ime hi saṃrabdhatarāstathā taissampradharṣitāḥ| vārayanto vanāttasmātkruddhairvānarapuṅgavaiḥ
translation: संरब्दतराः when enraged guards, तथा that way, तस्मात् from that, वनात् garden, वारयन्तः vanaras, इमे to go, क्रुद्धैः angry, तैः they, वानरपुङ्गवैः vanara leaders, सम्प्रधर्षिताः ill treated them.
explanation: "When the guards asked the vanaras to leave the garden the enraged vanaras misbehaved with them.

shloka_text: ततस्तैर्बहुभिर्वीरैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभ। संरक्तनयनैः क्रोधाद्धरयः प्रविचालिताः।।5.63.8।।
transliteration: tatastairbahubhirvīrairvānarairvānararṣabha| saṃraktanayanaiḥ krodhāddharayaḥ pravicālitāḥ
translation: वानरर्षभ bull among vanaras, ततः then, क्रोधात् in fury, संरक्तनयनैः redeyed, वीरैः heroes, बहुभिः many, तैः them, वानरैः vanara guards, हरयः monkeys, प्रविचालिताः chased.
explanation: "O Sugriva the vanara guards were chased away by the many heroic monkeys, angry and redeyed.

shloka_text: पाणिभिर्निहताः केचित्केचिज्जानुभिराहताः। प्रकृष्टाश्च यथाकामं देवमार्गं च दर्शिताः।।5.63.9।।
transliteration: pāṇibhirnihatāḥ kecitkecijjānubhirāhatāḥ| prakṛṣṭāśca yathākāmaṃ devamārgaṃ ca darśitāḥ
translation: केचित् some, पाणिभिः with the hands, निहताः struck, केचित् some, जानुभिः on the knees, आहताः beaten, यथाकामम् as they liked, प्रकृष्टाः dragged, देवमार्गम् private parts, दर्शिताः च showed.
explanation: "Some were struck with hands, some beaten on their knees and were dragged as they liked and showed up their private parts.

shloka_text: एवमेते हताश्शूरास्त्वयि तिष्ठति भर्तरि। कृत्स्नं मधुवनं चैव प्रकामं तैः प्रभक्ष्यते।।5.63.10।।
transliteration: evamete hatāśśūrāstvayi tiṣṭhati bhartari| kṛtsnaṃ madhuvanaṃ caiva prakāmaṃ taiḥ prabhakṣyate
translation: त्वयि you, भर्तरि when you are the king, तिष्ठति staying, एते these, शूराः heroes, एवम् in that way, हताः striking, तैः they, कृत्स्नम् on the earth, मधुवनं चैव Madhuvanam aslo, प्रकामम् at their will, प्रभक्ष्यते eating so.
explanation: These heroes struck that way devoured the Madhuvanam on the earth at their will and devoured the honey even when you are there as king.

shloka_text: एवं विज्ञाप्यमानं तं सुग्रीवं वानरर्षभम्। अपृच्छत्तं महाप्राज्ञो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा।।5.63.11।।
transliteration: evaṃ vijñāpyamānaṃ taṃ sugrīvaṃ vānararṣabham| apṛcchattaṃ mahāprājño lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
translation: एवम् in that way, विज्ञाप्यमानम् having appealed, वानरर्षभम् bulls among vanaras, तं सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, परवीरहा killer of enemies, महाप्राज्ञः very learned, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अपृच्छत् enquired.
explanation: While Dadhimukha appealed thus to wise Sugriva, Lakshmana the killer of enemies happened to see them and enquired:

shloka_text: किमयं वानरो राजन् वनपः प्रत्युपस्थितः। कं चार्थमभिनिर्दिश्य दुःखितो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।5.63.12।।
transliteration: kimayaṃ vānaro rājan vanapaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ| kaṃ cārthamabhinirdiśya duḥkhito vākyamabravīt
translation: राजन् O king, वनप: protector of the garden, अयं वानरः this vanara, किम् why, प्रत्युपस्थितः came here?, दुःखितः sad, कम् why, अर्थम् for what, अभिनिर्दिश्य what is he telling, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: "O king why has this protector of the garden come here? Why is he sad? What is he narrating, asked Lakshmana.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु सुग्रीवो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना। लक्ष्मणं प्रत्युवाचेदं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः।।5.63.13।।
transliteration: evamuktastu sugrīvo lakṣmaṇena mahātmanā| lakṣmaṇaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
translation: महात्मना great prince, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, वाक्यविशारदः proficient in speech, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, प्रत्युवाच replied.
explanation: Great prince Lakshmana thus said, Sugriva the proficient speaker replied:

shloka_text: आर्य लक्ष्मण सम्प्राह वीरो दधिमुखः कपिः। अङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वीरैर्भक्षितं मधु वानरैः।।5.63.14।। विचित्य दक्षिणामाशामागतैर्हरिपुङ्गवैः।
transliteration: ārya lakṣmaṇa samprāha vīro dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ| aṅgadapramukhairvīrairbhakṣitaṃ madhu vānaraiḥ vicitya dakṣiṇāmāśāmāgatairharipuṅgavaiḥ|
translation: आर्य O venerable one, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वीरः hero, कपिः monkey, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, सम्प्राह to search, दक्षिणाम् southern, आशाम् hope, विचित्य having searched, आगतैः have come, हरिपुङ्गवैः monkey leaders, वीरैः heroic ones, अङ्गदप्रमुखैः Angada and others, वानरैः vanaras, मधु honey, भक्षितम् eaten.
explanation: 'O venerable Lakshmana Dadhimukha as complaining that the fruits and honey have been consumed by the vanara heroes, Angada and others who have come after their search for Sita in the southern direction.

shloka_text: नैषामकृत्यानामीदृशस्स्यादुपक्रमः।।5.63.15।। आगतैश्च प्रमथितं यथा मधुवनं हि तैः। धर्षितं च वनं कृत्स्नमुपयुक्तं च वानरैः।।5.63.16।।
transliteration: naiṣāmakṛtyānāmīdṛśassyādupakramaḥ āgataiśca pramathitaṃ yathā madhuvanaṃ hi taiḥ| dharṣitaṃ ca vanaṃ kṛtsnamupayuktaṃ ca vānaraiḥ
translation: आगतैः having come, तैः those, वानरैः vanaras, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, यथा that way, प्रमथितम् entered, कृत्स्नम् whole, वनम् garden, धर्षितम् broken, उपयुक्तं च right, एषाम् they that way, अकृतकृत्यानाम् if they had not accomplished their purpose, ईदृशः this way, उपक्रमः indulged, न स्यात् not done.
explanation: "Those vanaras having entered Madhuvanam and broken the trees are quite right. Had they not accomplished their purpose they would not have indulged themselves that way.

shloka_text: नैषामकृत्यानामीदृशस्स्यादुपक्रमः।।5.63.15।। आगतैश्च प्रमथितं यथा मधुवनं हि तैः। धर्षितं च वनं कृत्स्नमुपयुक्तं च वानरैः।।5.63.16।।
transliteration: naiṣāmakṛtyānāmīdṛśassyādupakramaḥ āgataiśca pramathitaṃ yathā madhuvanaṃ hi taiḥ| dharṣitaṃ ca vanaṃ kṛtsnamupayuktaṃ ca vānaraiḥ
translation: आगतैः having come, तैः those, वानरैः vanaras, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, यथा that way, प्रमथितम् entered, कृत्स्नम् whole, वनम् garden, धर्षितम् broken, उपयुक्तं च right, एषाम् they that way, अकृतकृत्यानाम् if they had not accomplished their purpose, ईदृशः this way, उपक्रमः indulged, न स्यात् not done.
explanation: "Those vanaras having entered Madhuvanam and broken the trees are quite right. Had they not accomplished their purpose they would not have indulged themselves that way.

shloka_text: वनं यदाऽभिपन्नास्ते साधितं कर्म वानरैः। दृष्टा देवी न सन्देहो न चान्येन हनूमता।।5.63.17।।
transliteration: vanaṃ yadā'bhipannāste sādhitaṃ karma vānaraiḥ| dṛṣṭā devī na sandeho na cānyena hanūmatā
translation: ते they, यदा like that, वनम् garden, अभिपन्नाः entered, वानरैं कर्म their duty, साधितम् had done, देवी queen, दृष्टा saw, सन्देहः doubt, न no, अन्येन others, न not, हनुमता Hanuman.
explanation: "If they have trespassed into the garden that way, they might have done their duty. No doubt, Hanuman alone among them might have seen Sita.

shloka_text: न ह्यन्यस्साधने हेतुः कर्मणोऽस्य हनूमतः। कार्यसिद्धिर्मतिश्चैव तस्मिन्वानरपुङ्गवे।।5.63.18।। व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च श्रुतं चापि प्रतिष्ठितम्।
transliteration: na hyanyassādhane hetuḥ karmaṇo'sya hanūmataḥ| kāryasiddhirmatiścaiva tasminvānarapuṅgave vyavasāyaśca vīryaṃ ca śrutaṃ cāpi pratiṣṭhitam|
translation: अस्य कर्मणः that duty, साधने capacity, हनूमतः Hanuman, अन्यः others, हेतुः the reason being, न हि not indeed, कार्यसिद्धि: capacity to accomplish, मतिश्चैव even wisdom, व्यवसायश्च even strenuous effort, वीर्यं च and virility, श्रुतं चापि enthusiasm, तस्मिन् for him, वानरपुङ्गवे to only the foremost of the monkys, प्रतिष्ठितम् are wellestablished.
explanation: "Hanuman alone has the ability to do it, the reason being he has the capacity the wisdom, streneous effort, virility and enthusiasm to accomplish it. These attributes are wellestablished in him.

shloka_text: जाम्बवान्यत्र नेता स्यादङ्गदश्च महाबलः।।5.63.19।। हनुमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिरन्यथा।
transliteration: jāmbavānyatra netā syādaṅgadaśca mahābalaḥ hanumāṃścāpyadhiṣṭhātā na tasya gatiranyathā|
translation: यत्र where, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, नेता is the leader, स्यात् remains, महाबलः strong, अङ्गदश्च Angada also, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, अधिष्ठाता directing, तस्य that, गतिः will be done, अन्यथा otherwise, न not.
explanation: Where Jambavan, Angada and Hanuman are leaders directing the task of the army it must have been accomplished.

shloka_text: अङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वीरैर्हतं मधुवनं किल।।5.63.20।। वारयन्तश्च सहितास्तदा जानुभिराहताः।
transliteration: aṅgadapramukhairvīrairhataṃ madhuvanaṃ kila vārayantaśca sahitāstadā jānubhirāhatāḥ|
translation: अङ्गदप्रमुखैः Angada and other leaders, वीरैः heroes, मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, हतं किल destroyed the garden, सहिताः along with others, वारयन्तः च when they were obstructed, तदा then, जानुभिः knees, आहताः beaten.
explanation: Angada and the other heroes have indeed laid waste Madhuvana, and when we together tried to stop them, we were beaten back with their knees.

shloka_text: एतदर्थमयं प्राप्तो वक्तुं मधुरवागिह।।5.63.21।। नाम्ना दधिमुखो नाम हरिः प्रख्यातविक्रमः।
transliteration: etadarthamayaṃ prāpto vaktuṃ madhuravāgiha nāmnā dadhimukho nāma hariḥ prakhyātavikramaḥ|
translation: नाम्ना named, दधिमुखो नाम Dadhimukha, प्रख्यातविक्रमः known for his valour, हरिः monkey, एतदर्थम् on account of it, वक्तुम् to tell, मधुरवाक् sweet tongued, इह here, प्राप्तः came.
explanation: "Here is Dadhimukha, a vanara, known for his valour and sweet tongue. He came here this incident to tell.

shloka_text: दृष्टा सीता महाबाहो सौमित्रे पश्य तत्त्वतः।।5.63.22।। अभिगम्य तथा सर्वे पिबन्ति मधु वानराः।
transliteration: dṛṣṭā sītā mahābāho saumitre paśya tattvataḥ abhigamya tathā sarve pibanti madhu vānarāḥ|
translation: महाबाहो strongarmed, सौमित्रे O Saumitri, सीता Sita, दृष्टा would have seen, तत्त्वतः truly, पश्य seen, तथा so, वानराः vanaras, सर्वे all, अभिगम्य having arrived, मधु honey, पिबन्ति drank.
explanation: "O strongarmed Saumitri the Vanaras must have seen Sita. Or else, they would not have arrived to drink honey.

shloka_text: न चाप्यदृष्ट्वा वैदेहीं विश्रुताः पुरुषर्षभ।।5.63.23।। वनं दत्तवरं दिव्यं धर्षयेयुर्वनौकसः।
transliteration: na cāpyadṛṣṭvā vaidehīṃ viśrutāḥ puruṣarṣabha vanaṃ dattavaraṃ divyaṃ dharṣayeyurvanaukasaḥ|
translation: पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, विश्रुताः renowned, वनौकसः forestdwellers, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अदृष्ट्वा not seen, दत्तवरम् that which was given as boon, दिव्यम् wonderful, वनम् garden, न धर्षयेयुः entered.
explanation: "If the renowned vanaras had not seen Vaidehi, they would not have entered the wonderful garden granted as boon (by Brahma).

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणस्सह राघवः।।5.63.24।। श्रुत्वा कर्णसुखां वाणीं सुग्रीववदनाच्च्युताम्। प्राहृष्यत भृशं रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः।।5.63.25।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭo dharmātmā lakṣmaṇassaha rāghavaḥ śrutvā karṇasukhāṃ vāṇīṃ sugrīvavadanāccyutām| prāhṛṣyata bhṛśaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ
translation: ततः then, सह राघवः also Rama, धर्मात्मा righteous, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रहृष्टः very cheerful rejoiced, सुग्रीववदनात् Sugriva's mouth, च्युताम् delivered, कर्णसुखाम् pleasing to the ears, वाणीम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, प्राहृष्यत felt happy, महाबलः mighty strong, लक्ष्मणश्च even Lakshmana, भृशम् very, प्राहृष्यत happy.
explanation: "Then righteous Rama and Lakshmana rejoiced to hear the words of Sugriva, which were pleasing to the ears.

shloka_text: ततः प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा लक्ष्मणस्सह राघवः।।5.63.24।। श्रुत्वा कर्णसुखां वाणीं सुग्रीववदनाच्च्युताम्। प्राहृष्यत भृशं रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः।।5.63.25।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahṛṣṭo dharmātmā lakṣmaṇassaha rāghavaḥ śrutvā karṇasukhāṃ vāṇīṃ sugrīvavadanāccyutām| prāhṛṣyata bhṛśaṃ rāmo lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ
translation: ततः then, सह राघवः also Rama, धर्मात्मा righteous, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्रहृष्टः very cheerful rejoiced, सुग्रीववदनात् Sugriva's mouth, च्युताम् delivered, कर्णसुखाम् pleasing to the ears, वाणीम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, प्राहृष्यत felt happy, महाबलः mighty strong, लक्ष्मणश्च even Lakshmana, भृशम् very, प्राहृष्यत happy.
explanation: "Then righteous Rama and Lakshmana rejoiced to hear the words of Sugriva, which were pleasing to the ears.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं सुग्रीवस्सम्प्रहृष्य च। वनपालं पुनर्वाक्यं सुग्रीवः प्रत्यभाषत।।5.63.26।।
transliteration: śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṃ sugrīvassamprahṛṣya ca| vanapālaṃ punarvākyaṃ sugrīvaḥ pratyabhāṣata
translation: सुग्रीवः one with beautiful neck, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, दधिमुखस्य Dadhimukha's, इदम् thus, श्रुत्वा having heard, सम्प्रहृष्य च very glad, पुनः again, वनपालम् protector of the garden, वाक्यम् these words, प्रत्यभाषत replied.
explanation: Beautifulnecked Sugriva heard Dadhimukha, the protector of the garden, felt very glad and replied:

shloka_text: प्रीतोऽस्मि सोऽहं यद्भुक्तं वनं तैः कृतकर्मभिः। मर्षितं मर्षणीयं च चेष्टितं कृतकर्मणाम्।।5.63.27।।
transliteration: prīto'smi so'haṃ yadbhuktaṃ vanaṃ taiḥ kṛtakarmabhiḥ| marṣitaṃ marṣaṇīyaṃ ca ceṣṭitaṃ kṛtakarmaṇām
translation: कृतकर्मभिः having performed the duty, तैः they, वनम् garden, यत् भुक्तम् for drinking that honey, सः अहम् I, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased, कृतकर्मणाम् having accomplished the task, मर्षणीयम् are to be excused, चेष्टितम् their behaviour, मर्षितम् excused.
explanation: "They went to the garden to drink only after having performed their duty. I am glad about it. Since they have accomplished the purpose, they are to be excused for their behaviour. I have pardoned them.

shloka_text: इच्छामि शीघ्रं हनुमत्प्रधानान् शाखामृगांस्तान् मृगराजदर्पान्। द्रष्टुं कृतार्थान् सह राघवाभ्यां श्रोतुं च सीताधिगमे प्रयत्नम्।।5.63.28।।
transliteration: icchāmi śīghraṃ hanumatpradhānān śākhāmṛgāṃstān mṛgarājadarpān| draṣṭuṃ kṛtārthān saha rāghavābhyāṃ śrotuṃ ca sītādhigame prayatnam
translation: हनुमत्प्रधानान् led by Hanuman, मृगराजदर्पान् with the majesty of the lion, कृतार्थान् acomplished ones, तान् them, शाखामृगान् vanaras (who live on trees), राघवाभ्यां सह Rama and others, द्रष्टुम् to see, सीताधिगमेन to see Sita, प्रयत्नम् endeavour, श्रोतुं च to hear, इच्छामि desiring.
explanation: I long to see those triumphant monkeys led by Hanuman, proud as the king of beasts, together with Rama and Lakshmana, and to hear of their effort in finding Sita.

shloka_text: प्रीतिस्फीताक्षौ सम्प्रहृष्टौ कुमारौ दृष्ट्वा सिद्धार्थौ वानराणां च राजा। अङ्गैः संहृष्टैः कर्मसिद्धिं विदित्वा बाह्वोरासन्नां सोऽतिमात्रं ननन्द।।5.63.29।।
transliteration: prītisphītākṣau samprahṛṣṭau kumārau dṛṣṭvā siddhārthau vānarāṇāṃ ca rājā| aṅgaiḥ saṃhṛṣṭaiḥ karmasiddhiṃ viditvā bāhvorāsannāṃ so'timātraṃ nananda
translation: सः he (Sugriva), वानराणां राजा king of vanaras, प्रीतिस्फीताक्षौ eyes filled with joy, सम्प्रहृष्टौ very happy, सिद्धार्धौ accomplished, कुमारौ young, दृष्ट्वा seeing, संहृष्टैः very glad, अङ्गैः limbs of the body, कर्मसिद्धिम् task has been accomplished, बाह्वोः shoulders, आसन्नाम् time has come, विदित्वा recognising, अतिमात्रम् highly, ननन्द delighted.
explanation: "Beholding young Rama and Lakshmana extremely delighted, their eyes filled with joy out of fulfilment of the purpose, Sugriva who was also highly delighted felt an auspicious thrill on his limbs and knew that good time had come. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtythird sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु हृष्टो दधिमुखः कपिः। राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं चाभ्यवादयत्।।5.64.1।।
transliteration: sugrīveṇaivamuktastu hṛṣṭo dadhimukhaḥ kapiḥ| rāghavaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ caiva sugrīvaṃ cābhyavādayat
translation: सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, कपिः monkey, दधिमुखः Dadhimukha, हृष्टः pleased, राघवम् Rama, लक्ष्मणं चैव and also Lakshmana, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, अभ्यवादयत् offered salutations.
explanation: Pleased with Sugriva's command (to send forth Angada and Hanuman) Dadhimukha offered salutations to Sugriva, Rama  and Lakshmana.
comments: Hanuman and Angada along with others approach Sugriva -- Hanuman tells Rama about the discovery of Sita.

shloka_text: स प्रणम्य च सुग्रीवं राघवौ च महाबलौ। वानरैः सहितः शूरैर्दिवमेवोत्पपात ह।।5.64.2।।
transliteration: sa praṇamya ca sugrīvaṃ rāghavau ca mahābalau| vānaraiḥ sahitaḥ śūrairdivamevotpapāta ha
translation: सः he, Dadhimukha, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, महाबलौ mighty strong, राघवौ च Rama, प्रणम्य offering obeisance, शूरैः heroes, वानरैः vanaras, सहितः followed by, दिवमेव to the sky, उत्पपात rose up.
explanation: Dadhimukha offered his obeisance to Sugriva and the mighty Rama and Lakshmana  and rose up to the sky followed by the vanaras.

shloka_text: स यथैवाऽगतः पूर्वं तथैव त्वरितं गतः। निपत्य गगनाद्भूमौतद्वनं प्रविवेश ह।।5.64.3।। स प्रविष्टो मधुवनं ददर्श हरियूथपान्। विमदानुत्थितान्सर्वान् मेहमानान्मधूदकम्।।5.64.4।।
transliteration: sa yathaivā'gataḥ pūrvaṃ tathaiva tvaritaṃ gataḥ| nipatya gaganādbhūmautadvanaṃ praviveśa ha sa praviṣṭo madhuvanaṃ dadarśa hariyūthapān| vimadānutthitānsarvān mehamānānmadhūdakam
translation: मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टः entered, सः he, विमदान् intoxication, मदूदकम् honey and water, मेहमानान् voiding urine, सर्वान् all, हरियूथपान् troops of vanaras, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).

shloka_text: स यथैवाऽगतः पूर्वं तथैव त्वरितं गतः। निपत्य गगनाद्भूमौतद्वनं प्रविवेश ह।।5.64.3।। स प्रविष्टो मधुवनं ददर्श हरियूथपान्। विमदानुत्थितान्सर्वान् मेहमानान्मधूदकम्।।5.64.4।।
transliteration: sa yathaivā'gataḥ pūrvaṃ tathaiva tvaritaṃ gataḥ| nipatya gaganādbhūmautadvanaṃ praviveśa ha sa praviṣṭo madhuvanaṃ dadarśa hariyūthapān| vimadānutthitānsarvān mehamānānmadhūdakam
translation: मधुवनम् Madhuvanam, प्रविष्टः entered, सः he, विमदान् intoxication, मदूदकम् honey and water, मेहमानान् voiding urine, सर्वान् all, हरियूथपान् troops of vanaras, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Descending into Madhuvanam, Dadhimukha saw all the monkey troops free from intoxication (of honeywine).

shloka_text: स तानुपागमद्वीरो बद्ध्वा करपुटाञ्जलिम्। उवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णमिदं हृष्टवदङ्गदम्।।5.64.5।।
transliteration: sa tānupāgamadvīro baddhvā karapuṭāñjalim| uvāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇamidaṃ hṛṣṭavadaṅgadam
translation: वीरः hero, सः he, करपुटाञ्जलिम् cupping his palms reverentially, बद्ध्वा holding, तान् him, उपागमत् returned, हृष्टवत् with joy, अङ्गदम् Angada, श्लक्ष्णम् conciliatory, इदं वचनम् these words, उवाच spoken.
explanation: Heroic Dadhimukha went to Angada, holding his cupped palms reverentially and spoke these conciliatory words with joy:

shloka_text: सौम्य रोषो न कर्तव्यो यदेतत्परिवारितम्। अज्ञानाद्रक्षिभिः क्रोधाद्भवन्तः प्रतिषेधिताः।।5.64.6।।
transliteration: saumya roṣo na kartavyo yadetatparivāritam| ajñānādrakṣibhiḥ krodhādbhavantaḥ pratiṣedhitāḥ
translation: सौम्य prince of mild disposition, एतत् all this, यत् परिवारितम् that your companions, रोषः harsh, न कर्तव्यः not react, भवन्तः you, रक्षिभिः even the guards, अज्ञानात् out of ignorance, क्रोधात् fury, प्रतिषेधिताः have obstructed you.
explanation: "O handsome one, do not react harshly at these guards who have obstructed your companions out of ignorance and fury.

shloka_text: युवराजस्त्वमीशश्च वनस्यास्य महाबल। मौर्ख्यात्पूर्वं कृतो दोषस्तं भवान् क्षन्तुमर्हति।।5.64.7।।
transliteration: yuvarājastvamīśaśca vanasyāsya mahābala| maurkhyātpūrvaṃ kṛto doṣastaṃ bhavān kṣantumarhati
translation: महाबल mighty, त्वम् you, युवराजः heir apparent, अस्य वनस्य at this garden, ईशश्च king also, पूर्वम् earlier, मौर्ख्यात् out of foolishness, दोषः mistake, कृतः did, तम् to you, भवान् you, क्षन्तुम् be at peace, अर्हति is proper.
explanation: "O mighty Angada you are heir apparent and also king. Out of foolishness I obstructed you. You ought to pardon me this mistake.

shloka_text: आख्यातं हि मया गत्वा पितृव्यस्य तवानघ। इहोपयातं सर्वेषामेतेषां वनचारिणाम्।।5.64.8।।
transliteration: ākhyātaṃ hi mayā gatvā pitṛvyasya tavānagha| ihopayātaṃ sarveṣāmeteṣāṃ vanacāriṇām
translation: अनघ blameless, मया I, गत्वा gone, तव your, पितृव्यस्य elder brother of your father, सर्वेषाम् all, एतेषाम् your people, वनचारिणाम् forestdwellers, इह here, उपयातम् your arrival, आख्यातं हि indeed told.
explanation: "O blameless prince I have already told your father's elder brother and all the forestdwellers about your arrival here.

shloka_text: स त्वदागमनं श्रुत्वा सहैभिर्हरियूथपैः। प्रहृष्टो न तु रुष्टोऽसौ वनं श्रुत्वा प्रधर्षितम्।।5.64.9।।
transliteration: sa tvadāgamanaṃ śrutvā sahaibhirhariyūthapaiḥ| prahṛṣṭo na tu ruṣṭo'sau vanaṃ śrutvā pradharṣitam
translation: सः he, एभिः these, सह with, त्वदागमनम् your arrival, श्रुत्वा hearing, प्रहृष्टः very glad, तु you, वनम् garden, प्रधर्षितम् destroying, श्रुत्वा having heard, असौ he was, न रुष्टः not angry.
explanation: "He was not angry at your destruction of the garden. On the other hand, he was very glad to hear about your arrival.

shloka_text: प्रहृष्टो मां पितृव्यस्ते सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः। शीघ्रं प्रेषय सर्वांस्तानिति होवाच पार्थिवः।।5.64.10।।
transliteration: prahṛṣṭo māṃ pitṛvyaste sugrīvo vānareśvaraḥ| śīghraṃ preṣaya sarvāṃstāniti hovāca pārthivaḥ
translation: ते पितृव्यः your father's brother, वानरेश्वरः lord of vanaras, पार्थिवः king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्रहृष्टः happily, तान् सर्वान् all of them, शीघ्रम् quickly, प्रेषय send, इति this, माम् to me, उवाच ह said indeed.
explanation: "Your father's brother, Sugriva, the lord of vanaras felt very glad and indeed asked me to send you quickly."

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा दधिमुखस्येदं वचनं श्लक्ष्णमङ्गदः। अब्रवीत्तान् हरिश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः।।5.64.11।।
transliteration: śrutvā dadhimukhasyedaṃ vacanaṃ ślakṣṇamaṅgadaḥ| abravīttān hariśreṣṭho vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ
translation: दधिमुखस्य to Dadhumukha, इदम् this, श्लक्ष्णम् very good, वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हरिश्रेष्ठः monkey leader, वाक्यविशारदः eloquent in speech, अङ्गदः Angada, तान् to them, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: At these good words from Dadhimukha, Angada, the monkey leader, an eloquent speaker said this:.

shloka_text: शङ्के श्रुतोऽयं वृत्तान्तो रामेण हरियूथपाः। तत्क्षमं नेह नः स्थातुं कृते कार्ये परन्तपाः।।5.64.12।।
transliteration: śaṅke śruto'yaṃ vṛttānto rāmeṇa hariyūthapāḥ| tatkṣamaṃ neha naḥ sthātuṃ kṛte kārye parantapāḥ
translation: परन्तपाः scorcher of enemies, हरियूथपाः leader of monkeys, अयं वृत्तान्तः about this here, रामेण by Rama, श्रुतः having heard, शङ्के I presume, तत् that, कार्ये task, कृते having done, इह here, स्थातुम् to be here, नः for us, न क्षमम् not proper.
explanation: "O scorcher of enemies I presume Rama has already heard the news of our arrival on accomplishment of the task. Hence it is not proper for us to tarry here.

shloka_text: पीत्वा मधु यथाकामं विश्रान्ता वनचारिणः। किं शेषं गमनं तत्र सुग्रीवो यत्र मे गुरुः।।5.64.13।।
transliteration: pītvā madhu yathākāmaṃ viśrāntā vanacāriṇaḥ| kiṃ śeṣaṃ gamanaṃ tatra sugrīvo yatra me guruḥ
translation: वनचारिणः forestrangers, vanaras, यथाकामम् as they desire, मधु honey, पीत्वा having drunk, विश्रान्ताः rested, किम् what, शेषम् is left, मे my, गुरुः king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र where, तत्र there, गमनम् have to go.
explanation: "The vanaras of the forest have taken rest after drinking as much honey as they desired. What is left here to do? We have to go wherever Sugriva is."

shloka_text: सर्वे यथा मां वक्ष्यन्ति समेत्य हरियूथपाः। तथास्मि कर्ता कर्तव्ये भवद्भिः परवानहम्।।5.64.14।।
transliteration: sarve yathā māṃ vakṣyanti sametya hariyūthapāḥ| tathāsmi kartā kartavye bhavadbhiḥ paravānaham
translation: सर्वे all, हरियूथपाः monkey troops, समेत्य assembled together, माम् me, यथा like that, वक्ष्यन्ति would tell, यथा in that way, कर्ता we are to do, अस्मि we, कर्तव्ये in our duty, अहम् I am, भवद्भिः as you say, परवान् have to do.
explanation: Angada said to the vanara troops assembled, "Tell me what we have to do. I shall act as you wish.

shloka_text: नाज्ञापयितुमीशोऽहं युवराजोऽस्मि यद्यपि। अयुक्तं कृतकर्माणो यूयं धर्षयितुं मया।।5.64.15।।
transliteration: nājñāpayitumīśo'haṃ yuvarājo'smi yadyapi| ayuktaṃ kṛtakarmāṇo yūyaṃ dharṣayituṃ mayā
translation: अहम् I am, युवराजः heir apparent, अस्मि यद्यपि even though I am, आज्ञापयितुम् to order you, न ईशः not lord, कृतकर्माणः accomplished dones, यूयम् troops, मया by me, धर्षयितुम् ordering, अयुक्तम् not proper.
explanation: "Even though I am heir apparent, it is not proper for me to order you.You have accomplished the purpose and to command you is not befitting on my part."

shloka_text: ब्रुवतश्चाङ्गदस्यैवं श्रुत्वा वचनमव्ययम्। प्रहृष्टमनसो वाक्यमिदमूचुर्वनौकसः।।5.64.16।।
transliteration: bruvataścāṅgadasyaivaṃ śrutvā vacanamavyayam| prahṛṣṭamanaso vākyamidamūcurvanaukasaḥ
translation: एवम् in that way, ब्रुवतः when said, अङ्गदस्य by Angada, अव्ययम् priceless, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वनौकसः forest dwellers, प्रहृष्टमनः glad at heart, इदम् these, ऊचुः said.
explanation: On hearing Angada's valuable words said in that way, the vanaras repled:

shloka_text: एवं वक्ष्यति को राजन् प्रभुस्सन्वानरर्षभ। ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तो हि सर्वोऽहमिति मन्यते।।5.64.17।।
transliteration: evaṃ vakṣyati ko rājan prabhussanvānararṣabha| aiśvaryamadamatto hi sarvo'hamiti manyate
translation: वानरर्षभ bull among vanaras, राजन् O king, प्रभुः सन् who is lord, कः who, एवम् in that way, वक्ष्यति said so, सर्वः all others, ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तः arrogant on account of prosperity, अहम् I, इति thus, मन्यते हि think .
explanation: "O king O bull among monkeys we think you are an exception to those to whom prosperity brings arrogance.

shloka_text: तव चेदं सुसदृशं वाक्यं नान्यस्य कस्यचित्। सन्नतिर्हि तवाख्याति भविष्यच्छुभयोग्यताम्।।5.64.18।।
transliteration: tava cedaṃ susadṛśaṃ vākyaṃ nānyasya kasyacit| sannatirhi tavākhyāti bhaviṣyacchubhayogyatām
translation: इदं वाक्यम् these words, तव च you alone would have said, सुसदृशम् your humility, अन्यस्य in others, कस्यचित्  you only, न not, तव your, सन्नतिः humble, भविष्यच्छुभयोग्यताम् fit for a bright future, आख्याति speaks of.
explanation: "You alone could speak such words. Your humility speaks of your fitness for a  bright future.

shloka_text: सर्वे वयमपि प्राप्तास्तत्र गन्तुं कृतक्षणाः। स यत्र हरिवीराणां सुग्रीवः पतिरव्ययः।।5.64.19।।
