transliteration: sarve vayamapi prāptāstatra gantuṃ kṛtakṣaṇāḥ| sa yatra harivīrāṇāṃ sugrīvaḥ patiravyayaḥ
translation: प्राप्ताः come here, वयम् us, सर्वेऽपि all of us, हरिवीराणाम् vanara heroes, पतिः lord, अव्ययः one who is immortal, सः सुग्रीवः that Sugriva, यत्र to him, तत्र there, गन्तुम् to go, कृतक्षणाः ready at any moment.
explanation: All of us have come here, ready to set out at any moment for wherever Sugriva, the immortal lord of the vanara heroes, may be.

shloka_text: त्वया ह्यनुक्तैर्हरिभिर्नैव शक्यं पदात्पदम्। क्वचिद्गन्तुं हरिश्रेष्ठ ब्रूमः सत्यमिदं तु ते।।5.64.20।।
transliteration: tvayā hyanuktairharibhirnaiva śakyaṃ padātpadam| kvacidgantuṃ hariśreṣṭha brūmaḥ satyamidaṃ tu te
translation: हरिश्रेष्ठ best of the vanaras, Angada, त्वया your, अनुक्तै: order, हरिभिः vanaras, पदात् on foot, पदम् one step, क्वचित् not even, गन्तुम् to go, न शक्यम् not possible, सत्यम् it is true, इदम् this, ते to you, ब्रूमः appealed.
explanation: "O Angada the best of vanaras without your command none will find it possible to put forward even a single step."

shloka_text: एवं तु वदतां तेषामङ्गदः प्रत्युवाच ह। बाढं गच्छाम इत्युक्त्वा खमुत्पेतुर्महाबलाः।।5.64.21।।
transliteration: evaṃ tu vadatāṃ teṣāmaṅgadaḥ pratyuvāca ha| bāḍhaṃ gacchāma ityuktvā khamutpeturmahābalāḥ
translation: तेषाम् those vanaras, एवम् that way, वदताम् spoken, अङ्गदः Angada, बाढम् very good, गच्छाम let us go, प्रत्युवाच ह replied, इति thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, महाबलाः powerful vanaras, खम् to the sky, उत्पेतुः rose up.
explanation: Thus addressed by all the vanaras, Angada said 'Well, let us go'. Then the powerful vanaras rose up the sky.

shloka_text: उत्पतन्तमनूत्पेतु स्सर्वे ते हरियूथपाः। कृत्वाकाशं निराकाशं यन्त्रोत्क्षिप्ता इवाचलाः।।5.64.22।।
transliteration: utpatantamanūtpetu ssarve te hariyūthapāḥ| kṛtvākāśaṃ nirākāśaṃ yantrotkṣiptā ivācalāḥ
translation: सर्वे all, ते हरियूथपाः vanara troops, यन्त्रोत्क्षिप्ताः  stones shattered by machines, अचलाः mountain, इव like, आकाशम् sky, निराकाशम् as if there is no sky, कृत्वा did, उत्पतन्तम् rising up, अनूत्पेतुः sprang up.
explanation: All the vanara troops sprang up into the air as though there was no sky, like stones shattered by machines from the  mountains rise up.

shloka_text: तेऽम्बरं सहसोत्पत्य वेगवन्तः प्लवङ्गमाः। विनदन्तो महानादं घना वातेरिता यथा।।5.64.23।।
transliteration: te'mbaraṃ sahasotpatya vegavantaḥ plavaṅgamāḥ| vinadanto mahānādaṃ ghanā vāteritā yathā
translation: वेगवन्तः swift, ते प्लवङ्गमाः those monkeys, महानादम् roared aloud, विनदन्तः noise, वातेरिताः driven by the Wind, घनाः यथा like heavy clouds, सहसा at once, अम्बरम् to the sky, उत्पत्य went up.
explanation: The swift monkeys roared aloud as though they went up the sky like thundering clouds driven by  the wind.

shloka_text: अङ्गदे ह्यननुप्राप्ते सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः। उवाच शोकोपहतं रामं कमललोचनम्।।5.64.24।।
transliteration: aṅgade hyananuprāpte sugrīvo vānarādhipaḥ| uvāca śokopahataṃ rāmaṃ kamalalocanam
translation: अङ्गदे Angada, अननुप्राप्ते before he came, वानराधिपः lord of the vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, शोकोपहतम् stricken with grief, कमललोचनम् lotus eyed, रामम् Rama, उवाच said.
explanation: Seeing the griefstricken, lotuseyed Rama, the lord of the vanaras Sugriva said this before the arrival of Angada:

shloka_text: समाश्वसिहि भद्रं ते दृष्टा देवी न संशयः। नागन्तुमिह शक्यं तैरतीते समये हि नः।।5.64.25।।
transliteration: samāśvasihi bhadraṃ te dṛṣṭā devī na saṃśayaḥ| nāgantumiha śakyaṃ tairatīte samaye hi naḥ
translation: समाश्वसिहि trust me, ते to you, भद्रम् auspicious, देवी queen, दृष्टा have seen, संशयः doubt, न not, नः us, समये time, अतीते exceeded, तैः they, इह here, आगन्तुम् to come, न शक्यम् not possible.
explanation: "Trust me, Rama. Be blessed. The vanaras have seen the divine lady. There is no doubt. It is not possible for them to come here after exceeding the time limit  (in their search for Sita).

shloka_text: न मत्सकाशमागच्छेत्कृत्ये हि विनिपातिते। युवराजो महाबाहुः प्लवतां प्रवरोऽङ्गदः।।5.64.26।।
transliteration: na matsakāśamāgacchetkṛtye hi vinipātite| yuvarājo mahābāhuḥ plavatāṃ pravaro'ṅgadaḥ
translation: युवराजः heir apparent, महाबाहुः strongarmed one, प्लवताम् leaping, प्रवरः endowed with good virtues, अङ्गदः Angada, कृत्ये mission, विनिपातिते has failed, मत्सकाशम् near me, नागच्छेत् will not come.
explanation: "My heir apparent, the strongarmed Angada, and the best of the monkeys is endowed with virtues. He would not come near me if his mission had failed.

shloka_text: यद्यप्यकृतकृत्यानामीदृश स्स्यादुपक्रमः। भवेत्स दीनवदनो भ्रान्तविप्लुतमानसः।।5.64.27।।
transliteration: yadyapyakṛtakṛtyānāmīdṛśa ssyādupakramaḥ| bhavetsa dīnavadano bhrāntaviplutamānasaḥ
translation: अकृतकृत्यानाम् in case they have not accomplished, उपक्रमः return, ईदृशः this way, यद्यपि स्यात् acted that way, सः he, दीनवदनः pathetic face, भ्रान्त विप्लुतमानसः perplexed and unsteady in mind, भवेत् would be.
explanation: "In case the vanaras have returned without accomplishing the task, Angada would have assumed a pathetic face, perplexed and unsteady in mind.

shloka_text: पितृपैतामहं चैतत्पूर्वकैरभिरक्षितम्। न मे मधुवनं हन्यादहृष्टः प्लवगेश्वरः।।5.64.28।। कौसल्यासुप्रजा राम समाश्वसिहि सुव्रत।
transliteration: pitṛpaitāmahaṃ caitatpūrvakairabhirakṣitam| na me madhuvanaṃ hanyādahṛṣṭaḥ plavageśvaraḥ kausalyāsuprajā rāma samāśvasihi suvrata|
translation: प्लवगेश्वरः lord of monkeys, अहृष्टः not been happy, पितृपैतामहम् father and grandfather's time, पूर्वकैः ancestors, अभिरक्षितम् protected, मे मधुवनम् my Madhuvanam, न हन्यात् not destroy, कौसल्यासुप्रजाः Kausalya's son, सुव्रत one who pracitces good traditions, राम Rama, समाश्वसिहि trust me.
explanation: "If Angada, lord of the vanaras had not been happy, he would not have destroyed the Madhuvanam of my father's and my grandfather's time. O Rama, follower of righteous practices, Kausalya has an excellent son in you. Trust me.

shloka_text: दृष्टा देवी न सन्देहो न चान्येन हनूमता।।5.64.29।। न ह्यन्यः कर्मणो हेतुस्साधनेऽस्य हनूमतः।
transliteration: dṛṣṭā devī na sandeho na cānyena hanūmatā na hyanyaḥ karmaṇo hetussādhane'sya hanūmataḥ|
translation: कर्मणो this task, हेतुस्साधनेऽस्य the reason for accomplishing, देवी Sita, दृष्टा saw, सन्देहः doubt, न  not, अन्येन not others, न not, हनुमता Hanuman.
explanation: "Hanuman is the one who has accomplished this task. Who else can? No doubt, he has seen Sita.

shloka_text: हनूमति हि सिद्धिश्च मतिश्च मतिसत्तमः।।5.64.30।। व्यवसायश्च वीर्यं च सूर्ये तेज इव ध्रुवम्।
transliteration: hanūmati hi siddhiśca matiśca matisattamaḥ vyavasāyaśca vīryaṃ ca sūrye teja iva dhruvam|
translation: मतिसत्तम best one among the wise, हनूमति Hanuman, सूर्ये Sun, तेजः इव like the luminosity, सिद्धिश्च capacity to succeed, मतिश्च intelligence, व्यवसायश्च effort, वीर्यं च and even courage, ध्रुवम् steadfast.
explanation: "O Rama, the best among the wise just like the luminosity that abides in the Sun, capacity to succeed, energy, intelligence, even courage and steadfastness reside in Hanuman.

shloka_text: जाम्बवान्यत्र नेता स्यादङ्गदश्च बलेश्वरः। हनुमांश्चाप्यधिष्ठाता न तस्य गतिरन्यथा।।5.64.31।।
transliteration: jāmbavānyatra netā syādaṅgadaśca baleśvaraḥ| hanumāṃścāpyadhiṣṭhātā na tasya gatiranyathā
translation: यत्र there, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, नेता leader, स्यात् remains, महाबलः commander of army अङ्गदश्च and Angada, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, अधिष्ठाता the guiding force, तस्य that, गतिः end result, अन्यथा otherwise, न not be.
explanation: "Where Jambavan is the leader, Angada the commander of the army and Hanuman the guiding force, the end result will not be otherwise.

shloka_text: मा भूश्चिन्तासमायुक्तस्सम्प्रत्यमितविक्रमः।।5.64.32।। ततः किलकिलाशब्दं शुश्रावासन्नमम्बरे। हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानां नार्धतां काननौकसाम्।।5.64.33।। किष्किन्धामुपयातानां सिद्धिं कथयतामिव।
transliteration: mā bhūścintāsamāyuktassampratyamitavikramaḥ tataḥ kilakilāśabdaṃ śuśrāvāsannamambare| hanumatkarmadṛptānāṃ nārdhatāṃ kānanaukasām kiṣkindhāmupayātānāṃ siddhiṃ kathayatāmiva|
translation: अमितविक्रमः extremely valiant, सम्प्रति at this time, चिन्तासमायुक्तः anxious, मा भूः do not, ततः at that time, हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानाम् in the pride of Hanuman's success, नार्धताम् roaring, सिद्धिम् successfully completed the work, कथयतामिव talking, किष्किन्धाम् in Kishkinda, उपयातानाम् have reached, काननौकसाम् forestdwellers, vanaras, अम्बरे in the sky, आसन्नम् have arrived, किलकिलाशब्दम् chatterings, शुश्राव was heard.
explanation: "You are extremely valiant and it is unbecoming of you to be anxious at this time Rama. Just then chatterings of the monkeys were heard from the sky as they roared in pride talking of Hanuman's achievement. Having successfully completed the errand, they have arrived at Kishkinda.

shloka_text: मा भूश्चिन्तासमायुक्तस्सम्प्रत्यमितविक्रमः।।5.64.32।। ततः किलकिलाशब्दं शुश्रावासन्नमम्बरे। हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानां नार्धतां काननौकसाम्।।5.64.33।। किष्किन्धामुपयातानां सिद्धिं कथयतामिव।
transliteration: mā bhūścintāsamāyuktassampratyamitavikramaḥ tataḥ kilakilāśabdaṃ śuśrāvāsannamambare| hanumatkarmadṛptānāṃ nārdhatāṃ kānanaukasām kiṣkindhāmupayātānāṃ siddhiṃ kathayatāmiva|
translation: अमितविक्रमः extremely valiant, सम्प्रति at this time, चिन्तासमायुक्तः anxious, मा भूः do not, ततः at that time, हनुमत्कर्मदृप्तानाम् in the pride of Hanuman's success, नार्धताम् roaring, सिद्धिम् successfully completed the work, कथयतामिव talking, किष्किन्धाम् in Kishkinda, उपयातानाम् have reached, काननौकसाम् forestdwellers, vanaras, अम्बरे in the sky, आसन्नम् have arrived, किलकिलाशब्दम् chatterings, शुश्राव was heard.
explanation: "You are extremely valiant and it is unbecoming of you to be anxious at this time Rama. Just then chatterings of the monkeys were heard from the sky as they roared in pride talking of Hanuman's achievement. Having successfully completed the errand, they have arrived at Kishkinda.

shloka_text: ततश्श्रुत्वा निनादं तं कपीनां कपिसत्तमः।।5.64.34।। आयताञ्चितलाङ्गूलस्सोऽभवद्धृष्टमानसः।
transliteration: tataśśrutvā ninādaṃ taṃ kapīnāṃ kapisattamaḥ āyatāñcitalāṅgūlasso'bhavaddhṛṣṭamānasaḥ|
translation: ततः then, सः कपिसत्तमः that great monkey, Sugriva, कपीनाम् of the monkeys, तं निनादम् that roar, श्रुत्वा having heard, आयताञ्चितलाङ्गूलः lifting and shaking the long tail, हृष्टमानसः extremely happy, अभवत् remained.
explanation: The great Sugriva heard the roar of the monkeys and was extremely happy. He kept raising and shaking his long tail in joy.

shloka_text: आजग्मुस्तेऽपि हरयो रामदर्शनकांक्षिणः।।5.64.35।। अङ्गदं पुरतः कृत्वा हनूमन्तं च वानरम्।
transliteration: ājagmuste'pi harayo rāmadarśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ aṅgadaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā hanūmantaṃ ca vānaram|
translation: ते हरयः those joyful monkeys, कपिः monkeys, अङ्गदम् Angada, वानरम् vanaras, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, पुरतः in front, कृत्वा having, रामदर्शनकांक्षिणः eager to have a look at Rama, आजग्मुः reached.
explanation: The joyful monkeys with Angada and Hanuman leading them descended with eagerness to have a close look at Rama.

shloka_text: तेऽङ्गदप्रमुखा वीराः प्रहृष्ठाश्च मुदान्विताः।।5.64.36।। निपेतुर्हरिराजस्य समीपे राघवस्य च।
transliteration: te'ṅgadapramukhā vīrāḥ prahṛṣṭhāśca mudānvitāḥ nipeturharirājasya samīpe rāghavasya ca|
translation: अङ्गदप्रमुखाः Angada, the chief of the army of monkeys, ते वीराः the heroes, प्रहृष्टाश्च very joyfully, मुदा exuberant, अन्विताः descended, हरिराजस्य to the king of monkeys, राघवस्य च and Rama, समीपे near, निपेतुः landed.
explanation: Angada the chief along with the heroic monkeys very joyfully and exuberantly descended close to Sugriva, the king of monkeys and Rama.

shloka_text: हनुमांश्च महाबाहुः प्रणम्य शिरसा ततः।।5.64.37।। नियतामक्षतां देवीं राघवाय न्यवेदयत्।
transliteration: hanumāṃśca mahābāhuḥ praṇamya śirasā tataḥ niyatāmakṣatāṃ devīṃ rāghavāya nyavedayat|
translation: ततः then, महाबाहुः strongarmed, हनुमान् Hanuman, शिरसा with head bowed down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, देवीम् divine lady, नियताम् with her constant devotion, अक्षताम् sound in body, राघवाय to Rama, न्यवेदयत् reported.
explanation: Then the strongarmed Hanuman with his head bowed down offered salutations and reported, 'Divine lady Sita with her constant devotion to Sri Rama is sound in body'.

shloka_text: दृष्टा देवीति हनुमद्वदनादमृतोपमम्।।5.64.38।। आकर्ण्य वचनं रामो हर्षमाप सलक्ष्मणः।
transliteration: dṛṣṭā devīti hanumadvadanādamṛtopamam ākarṇya vacanaṃ rāmo harṣamāpa salakṣmaṇaḥ|
translation: सलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामः Rama, हनुमद्वदनात् only Hanuman, अमृतोपमम् sweet at nectar, देवी दृष्टा इति Sita was seen, these, वचनम् words, आकर्ण्य hearing, हर्षम् delighted, आप remained.
explanation: On hearing the nectarlike words from Hanuman that Sita was found, Rama and Lakshmana were delighted.

shloka_text: निश्चितार्थं ततस्तस्मिन् सुग्रीवं पवनात्मजे।।5.64.39।। लक्ष्मणः प्रीतिमान् प्रीतं बहुमानादवैक्षत।
transliteration: niścitārthaṃ tatastasmin sugrīvaṃ pavanātmaje lakṣmaṇaḥ prītimān prītaṃ bahumānādavaikṣata|
translation: ततः then, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तस्मिन् पवनात्मजे that son of the Windgod, निश्चितार्थम् surely, प्रीतम् very affectionately, सुग्रीवम् and Sugriva, बहुमानात् respectfully, अवैक्षत glanced.
explanation: Sugriva and Lakshmana glanced at Hanuman respectfully with affection thinking surely Hanuman alone has succeeded.

shloka_text: ततः प्रस्रवणं शैलं ते गत्वा चित्रकाननम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्।।5.65.1।। युवराजं पुरस्कृत्य सुग्रीवमभिवाद्य च। प्रवृत्तिमथ सीतायाः प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमुः।।5.65.2।।
transliteration: tataḥ prasravaṇaṃ śailaṃ te gatvā citrakānanam| praṇamya śirasā rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam yuvarājaṃ puraskṛtya sugrīvamabhivādya ca| pravṛttimatha sītāyāḥ pravaktumupacakramuḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, ते they, चित्रकाननम् wonderful forest of Chitra, प्रस्रवणम् शैलम् to Prasravana mount, युवराजम् heir apparent, पुरस्कृत्य placing in front with respect, गत्वा having arrived, रामम् to Rama, महाबलम् mighty, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, शिरसा bowed down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, अभिवाद्य च offered obeisance, अथ and then, सीतायाः  regarding Sita's, प्रवृत्तिम् state, प्रवक्तुम् to tell, उपचक्रमुः began.
explanation: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.
comments: Hanuman apprises Sri Rama of Sita's presence under the Simsupa tree surrounded by demonesses and presents the Chudamani to Rama in the presence of Sugriva.

shloka_text: ततः प्रस्रवणं शैलं ते गत्वा चित्रकाननम्। प्रणम्य शिरसा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम्।।5.65.1।। युवराजं पुरस्कृत्य सुग्रीवमभिवाद्य च। प्रवृत्तिमथ सीतायाः प्रवक्तुमुपचक्रमुः।।5.65.2।।
transliteration: tataḥ prasravaṇaṃ śailaṃ te gatvā citrakānanam| praṇamya śirasā rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca mahābalam yuvarājaṃ puraskṛtya sugrīvamabhivādya ca| pravṛttimatha sītāyāḥ pravaktumupacakramuḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, ते they, चित्रकाननम् wonderful forest of Chitra, प्रस्रवणम् शैलम् to Prasravana mount, युवराजम् heir apparent, पुरस्कृत्य placing in front with respect, गत्वा having arrived, रामम् to Rama, महाबलम् mighty, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, शिरसा bowed down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, अभिवाद्य च offered obeisance, अथ and then, सीतायाः  regarding Sita's, प्रवृत्तिम् state, प्रवक्तुम् to tell, उपचक्रमुः began.
explanation: Thereafter the vanaras arrived at the Prasrvana mount, with wonderful forests and bowed down to Sri Rama and mighty Lakshaman and Sugriva placing their leader, heir apparent in front. Then they began telling the story of Sita and her state.
comments: Hanuman apprises Sri Rama of Sita's presence under the Simsupa tree surrounded by demonesses and presents the Chudamani to Rama in the presence of Sugriva.

shloka_text: रावणान्तः पुरे रोधं राक्षसीभिश्च तर्जनम्। रामे समनुरागं च यश्चायं समयः कृतः।।5.65.3।। एतदाख्यान्ति ते सर्वे हरयो रामसन्निधौ।
transliteration: rāvaṇāntaḥ pure rodhaṃ rākṣasībhiśca tarjanam| rāme samanurāgaṃ ca yaścāyaṃ samayaḥ kṛtaḥ etadākhyānti te sarve harayo rāmasannidhau|
translation: सर्वे all, ते हरयः those vanaras, रावणान्तः पुरे in the chambers of Ravana, रोधम् detention, राक्षसीभिः ogresses, तर्जनं च threatening, रामे to Rama, समनुरागं च her devotion, यः that which, अयम् thus, समयः time limit, कृतः set, एतत् all that, रामसन्निधौ in Rama's presence, आख्यान्ति told.
explanation: The monkeys in Rama's presence narrated all about Sita's detention in Ravana's Ashoka garden, the ogresses threatening her and the time limit fixed by Ravana (for her survival).

shloka_text: वैदेहीमक्षतां श्रुत्वा रामस्तूत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.65.4।। क्व सीता वर्तते देवी कथं च मयि वर्तते। एतन्मे सर्वमाख्यात वैदेहीं प्रति वानराः।।5.65.5।।
transliteration: vaidehīmakṣatāṃ śrutvā rāmastūttaramabravīt kva sītā vartate devī kathaṃ ca mayi vartate| etanme sarvamākhyāta vaidehīṃ prati vānarāḥ
translation: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अक्षताम् not harmed, श्रुत्वा hearing, रामस्तु Rama too, उत्तरम् responded, अब्रवीत् asked, देवी divine lady, सीता Sita, क्व tell me, वर्तते she is, मयि to me, कथम् how, वर्तते is she, वानराः vanara, वैदेहीं प्रति her disposition towards, एतत् all that, सर्वम् every thing, मे to me, आख्यात asked.
explanation: Hearing of Sita alive and not harmed, Rama asked the vanaras, 'How is Sita? How is she disposed to me? Tell me everything'.

shloka_text: वैदेहीमक्षतां श्रुत्वा रामस्तूत्तरमब्रवीत्।।5.65.4।। क्व सीता वर्तते देवी कथं च मयि वर्तते। एतन्मे सर्वमाख्यात वैदेहीं प्रति वानराः।।5.65.5।।
transliteration: vaidehīmakṣatāṃ śrutvā rāmastūttaramabravīt kva sītā vartate devī kathaṃ ca mayi vartate| etanme sarvamākhyāta vaidehīṃ prati vānarāḥ
translation: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, अक्षताम् not harmed, श्रुत्वा hearing, रामस्तु Rama too, उत्तरम् responded, अब्रवीत् asked, देवी divine lady, सीता Sita, क्व tell me, वर्तते she is, मयि to me, कथम् how, वर्तते is she, वानराः vanara, वैदेहीं प्रति her disposition towards, एतत् all that, सर्वम् every thing, मे to me, आख्यात asked.
explanation: Hearing of Sita alive and not harmed, Rama asked the vanaras, 'How is Sita? How is she disposed to me? Tell me everything'.

shloka_text: रामस्य गदितं श्रुत्वा हरयो रामसन्निधौ। चोदयन्ति हनूमन्तं सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम्।।5.65.6।।
transliteration: rāmasya gaditaṃ śrutvā harayo rāmasannidhau| codayanti hanūmantaṃ sītāvṛttāntakovidam
translation: हरयः vanaras,रामस्य Rama's, गदितम् words spoken, श्रुत्वा hearing, सीतावृत्तान्तकोविदम् who was aware of Sita's position, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, रामसन्निधौ in the presence of Rama, चोदयन्ति requested to tell.
explanation: On hearing the words from Rama, the vanaras requested Hanuman who was aware of  Sita's position to tell Rama all about her.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तेषां हनुमान्मारुतात्मजः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देव्यै सीतायै तां दिशं प्रति।।5.65.7।। उवाच वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञस्सीताया दर्शनं यथा।
transliteration: śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ hanumānmārutātmajaḥ| praṇamya śirasā devyai sītāyai tāṃ diśaṃ prati uvāca vākyaṃ vākyajñassītāyā darśanaṃ yathā|
translation: मारुतात्मजः son of the Windgod, वाक्यज्ञः wise in speech, हनुमान् Hanuman, तेषाम् their, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, देव्यै to the divine lady, सीतायै Sita, तां दिशं प्रति to the direction in which she was located, शिरसा with head down, प्रणम्य offered salutations, सीतायाः about Sita's, दर्शनम् finding, यथा these, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: The son of the Wind god, Hanuman who was wise in speech heard the words of Rama, offered salutations to Sita in the direction in which she was located and narrated the story about her discovery.

shloka_text: समुद्रं लङ्घयित्वाहं शतयोजनमायतम्।।5.65.8।। अगच्छं जानकीं सीतां मार्गमाणो दिदृक्षया।
transliteration: samudraṃ laṅghayitvāhaṃ śatayojanamāyatam agacchaṃ jānakīṃ sītāṃ mārgamāṇo didṛkṣayā|
translation: अहम् I, शतयोजनम् a hundred yojanas, आयतम् wide, समुद्रम् ocean, लङ्घयित्वा having crossed, जानकीम् Janaki,सीताम् Sita, मार्गमाणः searching, दिदृक्षया with the intention of seeing, आगच्छम् reached.
explanation: "Having crossed the sea consisting of a hundred yojanas in quest of Vaidehi, I found her.

shloka_text: तत्र लङ्केति नगरी रावणस्य दुरात्मनः।।5.65.9।। दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य तीरे वसति दक्षिणे।
transliteration: tatra laṅketi nagarī rāvaṇasya durātmanaḥ dakṣiṇasya samudrasya tīre vasati dakṣiṇe|
translation: तत्र there, दक्षिणस्य समुद्रस्य on the southern side of the sea, दक्षिणे तीरे of the southern shore, दुरात्मनः evilminded, रावणस्य Ravana's, लङ्केति in Lanka, नगरी city, वसति there is.
explanation: "On the southern shore of the ocean is situated the city of Lanka , ruled by the evilminded Ravana.

shloka_text: तत्र दृष्टा मया सीता रावणान्तः पुरे सती।।5.65.10।। सन्न्यस्य त्वयि जीवन्ती रामा राम मनोरथम्।
transliteration: tatra dṛṣṭā mayā sītā rāvaṇāntaḥ pure satī sannyasya tvayi jīvantī rāmā rāma manoratham|
translation: रामा Rama, तत्र there, रावणान्तः पुरे in the inner palace of Ravana, सती your wife, त्वयि your, मनोरथम्  her hopes, सन्न्यस्य giving up desires, जीवन्ती living, राम lovely, सीता Sita, मया by me, दृष्टा seen.
explanation: "There in the inner palace of Ravana, I saw your lovely wife Sita, with all her hopes pinned on you, giving up all other desires.

shloka_text: दृष्टा मे राक्षसीमध्ये तर्ज्यमाना मुहुर्मुहुः।।5.65.11।। राक्षसीभिर्विरूपाभी रक्षिता प्रमदावने।
transliteration: dṛṣṭā me rākṣasīmadhye tarjyamānā muhurmuhuḥ rākṣasībhirvirūpābhī rakṣitā pramadāvane|
translation: प्रमदावने in that beautiful garden, विरूपाभिः hideous, राक्षसीभिः rakshasas, रक्षिता guarded, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तर्ज्यमाना threatening, मे I, राक्षसीमध्ये in the midst of ogresses, दृष्टा saw.
explanation: "I found her in the beautiful garden guarded by hideous ogresses threatening her again and again৷৷

shloka_text: दुःख मासाद्यते देवी तथाऽदुःखोचिता सती।।5.65.12।। रावणान्तः पुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभि स्सुरक्षिता। एकवेणीधरा दीना त्वयि चिन्तापरायणा।।5.65.13।। अधःशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया।।5.65.14।। देवी कथञ्चित्काकुत्स्थ त्वन्मना मार्गिता मया।
transliteration: duḥkha māsādyate devī tathā'duḥkhocitā satī rāvaṇāntaḥ pure ruddhā rākṣasībhi ssurakṣitā| ekaveṇīdharā dīnā tvayi cintāparāyaṇā adhaḥśayyā vivarṇāṅgī padminīva himāgame| rāvaṇādvinivṛttārthā martavyakṛtaniścayā devī kathañcitkākutstha tvanmanā mārgitā mayā|
translation: तथा in that way, दुःखोचिता mind filled with grief, देवी divine lady, दुःखम्  grief, आपद्यते not deserve to experience, रावणान्तःपुरे  in the inner palace of Ravana, रुद्धा  detained, राक्षसीभि by ogresses, स्सुरक्षिता guarded by, एकवेणीधरा wearing a single braid( a mark of desolation),दीना pathetic, त्वयि your,सती wife,चिन्तापरायणा absorbed in your thought, अध: शय्या now lying on bare ground, हिमागमे in winter season, पद्मिनीव like the lotus, विवर्णाङ्गी  limbs turned pale, रावणात् by Ravana, विनिवृत्तार्था averse to Ravana, मर्तव्यकृन्तिश्चया determined to die, काकुत्स्थ Rama alone, त्वन्मनाः in her mind, देवी Sita, कथञ्चित्  somehow, मार्गिता found.
explanation: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic,  and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.

shloka_text: दुःख मासाद्यते देवी तथाऽदुःखोचिता सती।।5.65.12।। रावणान्तः पुरे रुद्धा राक्षसीभि स्सुरक्षिता। एकवेणीधरा दीना त्वयि चिन्तापरायणा।।5.65.13।। अधःशय्या विवर्णाङ्गी पद्मिनीव हिमागमे। रावणाद्विनिवृत्तार्था मर्तव्यकृतनिश्चया।।5.65.14।। देवी कथञ्चित्काकुत्स्थ त्वन्मना मार्गिता मया।

explanation: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic,  and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.

explanation: "Sita, who did not deserve and yet was full of grief was detained by Ravana in his inner palace, guarded by ogresses. She had single braid (a sign of desolation), was pathetic,  and totally absorbed in your thought. She was lying on bare ground with her limbs turned pale, like lotus in winter. She was averse to Ravana and was determined to commit suicide. She has only Rama in her mind. Somehow I found her.

shloka_text: इक्ष्वाकुवंशविख्यातिं शनैः कीर्तयतानघ।।5.65.15।। सा मया नरशार्दूल विश्वासमुपपादिता।
transliteration: ikṣvākuvaṃśavikhyātiṃ śanaiḥ kīrtayatānagha sā mayā naraśārdūla viśvāsamupapāditā|
translation: अनघ sinless one, नरशार्दूल tiger among men, इक्ष्वाकुवंशविख्यातिम् all about the glory of Ikshvaku race, शनैः slowly, कीर्तयता praised, मया by me, सा she, विश्वासम् confidence, उपपादिता to inspire.
explanation: "O sinless one O tiger among men To inspire confidence in her I praised the glory of your Ikshvaku dynasty.

shloka_text: तत स्सम्भाषिता देवी सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता।।5.65.16।। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता। नियत स्समुदाचारो भक्तिश्चास्यास्तथा त्वयि।।5.65.17।।
transliteration: tata ssambhāṣitā devī sarvamarthaṃ ca darśitā rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca śrutvā prītimupāgatā| niyata ssamudācāro bhaktiścāsyāstathā tvayi
translation: ततः then, देवी divine lady, सम्भाषिता talked, सर्वम् all,अर्थम् all facts,दर्शिता presented to her, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा on hearing, प्रीतिम् affectionately, उपागता became, अस्याः her, समुदाचारः virtuous, नियतः fixed, तथा so also, त्वयि towards, भक्तिश्च and devotion.
explanation: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.

shloka_text: तत स्सम्भाषिता देवी सर्वमर्थं च दर्शिता।।5.65.16।। रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च श्रुत्वा प्रीतिमुपागता। नियत स्समुदाचारो भक्तिश्चास्यास्तथा त्वयि।।5.65.17।।
transliteration: tata ssambhāṣitā devī sarvamarthaṃ ca darśitā rāmasugrīvasakhyaṃ ca śrutvā prītimupāgatā| niyata ssamudācāro bhaktiścāsyāstathā tvayi
translation: ततः then, देवी divine lady, सम्भाषिता talked, सर्वम् all,अर्थम् all facts,दर्शिता presented to her, रामसुग्रीवसख्यं च about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva, श्रुत्वा on hearing, प्रीतिम् affectionately, उपागता became, अस्याः her, समुदाचारः virtuous, नियतः fixed, तथा so also, त्वयि towards, भक्तिश्च and devotion.
explanation: "When the divine lady talked to me, I presented all the facts about the alliance of Rama and Sugriva. On hearing me, virtuous Sita, whose devotion is fixed on you became delighted.

shloka_text: एवं मया महाभागा दृष्टा जनकनन्दिनी। उग्रेण तपसा युक्ता त्वद्भक्त्या पुरुषर्षभ।।5.65.18।।
transliteration: evaṃ mayā mahābhāgā dṛṣṭā janakanandinī| ugreṇa tapasā yuktā tvadbhaktyā puruṣarṣabha
translation: पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, उग्रेण formidable, तपसा austerity, त्वद्भक्त्या devotion to you, युक्ता filled with, महाभागा prosperous, जनकनन्दिनी delight of Janaka, मया by me, एवम् that way, दृष्टा seen.
explanation: "O bull among men I saw Janaki,the delight of Janaka, a formidable lady filled with devotion to you and richly endowed with austerity.

shloka_text: अभिज्ञानं च मे दत्तं यथा वृत्तं तवान्तिके। चित्रकूटे महाप्राज्ञ वायसं प्रति राघव।।5.65.19।।
transliteration: abhijñānaṃ ca me dattaṃ yathā vṛttaṃ tavāntike| citrakūṭe mahāprājña vāyasaṃ prati rāghava
translation: महाप्राज्ञ very wise, चित्रकूटे in Chitrakuta, तव your, अन्तिके provided me, वायसं प्रति with an anecdote of a crow, यथा so also, वृत्तम् told, अभिज्ञानम् as an identification for you, मे to me, दत्तम् presented.
explanation: "O wise one, with your ring given her, she told me an anecdote of a crow that took place at Chitrakuta.

shloka_text: विज्ञाप्यश्च नरव्याघ्रो रामो वायुसुत त्वया। अखिलेनेह यद्धृष्टमिति मामाह जानकी।।5.65.20।।
transliteration: vijñāpyaśca naravyāghro rāmo vāyusuta tvayā| akhileneha yaddhṛṣṭamiti māmāha jānakī
translation: वायुसुत son of the Windgod, नरव्याघ्रः tiger among men, रामः Rama, त्वया your, इह here, यत् that which, दृष्टम् seen, अखिलेन should tell, विज्ञाप्यः should let him know, इति thus, जानकी Janaki, माम् me, आह told.
explanation: (She said)'O son of the Windgod you should let Rama, the tiger among men know all that you have seen here.

shloka_text: अयं चास्मै प्रदातव्यो यत्नात्सुपरिरक्षितः। ब्रुवता वचनान्येवं सुग्रीवस्योपशृण्वतः।।5.65.21।।
transliteration: ayaṃ cāsmai pradātavyo yatnātsuparirakṣitaḥ| bruvatā vacanānyevaṃ sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ
translation: सुग्रीवस्य while Sugriva, उपशृण्वतः within hearing of, एवम् that way, वचनानि these words, ब्रुवता that I said, यत्नात् the efforts, सुपरिरक्षितः kept with great care, अयं च and I, अस्मै this, प्रदातव्यः be presented.
explanation: 'Within hearing of Sugriva, tell him about your efforts. Present this(signet) to Rama carefully preserved by me.

shloka_text: एष चूडामणिश्श्रीमान् मया सुपरिरक्षितः। मनश्शिलायास्तिलको गण्डपार्श्वे निवेशितः।।5.65.22।। त्वया प्रणष्ठे तिलके तं किल स्मर्तुमर्हसि।
transliteration: eṣa cūḍāmaṇiśśrīmān mayā suparirakṣitaḥ| manaśśilāyāstilako gaṇḍapārśve niveśitaḥ tvayā praṇaṣṭhe tilake taṃ kila smartumarhasi|
translation: श्रीमान् prosperous, एषः this, चूडामणिः Chudamani, मया by me, सुपरिरक्षितः very carefully preserved, तिलके red mark on the forehead, प्रणष्ठे when it was, त्वया by you, मनश्शिलायाः with the stone pigment, तिलकः mark on the forehead, गण्डपार्श्वे on my forehead, निवेशितः किल decorated indeed, तम् स्मर्तुम् remind him, अर्हसि is proper.
explanation: 'This auspicious (jewel) Chudamani has been preserved by me very carefully. Remind him of the decorative red mark he painted with a stone pigment on my forehead, indeed, it is proper to remind him of this.

shloka_text: एष निर्यातितश्श्रीमान्मया ते वारि सम्भवः। एतं दृष्ट्वा प्रहृष्यामि व्यसने त्वामिवानघ।।5.65.23।।
transliteration: eṣa niryātitaśśrīmānmayā te vāri sambhavaḥ| etaṃ dṛṣṭvā prahṛṣyāmi vyasane tvāmivānagha
translation: अनघ sinless one, दिव्यः wonderful, एषः this, निर्यातितः sent to you, श्रीमान् prosperous one, वारिसम्भवः born in the ocean, व्यसने in sorrow, एतम् this (Chudamani), मया I, दृष्टवा gazing, त्वामिव you only, प्रहृष्यामि was feeling happy.
explanation: 'O sinless one tell Rama that this auspicious Chudamani born in the ocean is sent to him and I was gazing at it as if it was him (Rama) and feeling happy.

shloka_text: जीवितं धारयिष्यामि मासं दशरथात्मज।।5.65.24।। ऊर्ध्वं मासान्न जीवेयं रक्षसां वशमागता।
transliteration: jīvitaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi māsaṃ daśarathātmaja ūrdhvaṃ māsānna jīveyaṃ rakṣasāṃ vaśamāgatā|
translation: दशरथात्मज Dasaratha's son, मासम् one month, जीवितम् living, धारयिष्यामि will hold on to, रक्षसाम् these demons, वशम् captivated by, आगता completion, मासात् after a month, ऊर्ध्वम् more than, न जीवेयम् will not live.
explanation: 'O Son of Dasaratha I will hold on to life for a month. Captured by the demons, I will not live for more than a month'.

shloka_text: इति मामब्रवीत्सीता कृशाङ्गी धर्मचारिणी।।5.65.25।। रावणान्तः पुरे रुद्धा मृगीवोत्फुल्ललोचना।
transliteration: iti māmabravītsītā kṛśāṅgī dharmacāriṇī rāvaṇāntaḥ pure ruddhā mṛgīvotphullalocanā|
translation: कृशाङ्गी enfeebled lady, धर्मचारिणी following righteous ways, रावणान्तःपुरे in the inner palace of Ravana, रुद्धा detained मृगीव like a doe, उत्फुल्ललोचना eyes wide open in fear, सीता Sita, माम् to me, इति this, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: "With her limbs emaciated through austerities detained in Ravana's inner palace, eyes wide open in fear, Sita said this to me:

shloka_text: एतदेव मयाख्यातं सर्वं राघव यद्यथा।।5.65.26।। सर्वथा सागरजले संतारः प्रविधीयताम्।
transliteration: etadeva mayākhyātaṃ sarvaṃ rāghava yadyathā sarvathā sāgarajale saṃtāraḥ pravidhīyatām|
translation: राघव Rama, यत् that which, यथा like that, एतत् happened, सर्वमेव every thing, मया by me, ख्यातम् has been said, सर्वथा ever, सागरजले water of the ocean, सन्तारः means to cross the ocean, प्रविधीयताम् pay attention to.
explanation: "O Rama I have spoken everything that has happened. We have to pay attention to the means of crossing the ocean."

shloka_text: तौ जाताश्वासौ राजपुत्रौ विदित्वा तच्चाभिज्ञानं राघवाय प्रदाय। देव्या चाख्यातं सर्वमेवानुपूर्व्याद्वाचा सम्पूर्णं वायुपुत्त्र श्शशंस।।5.65.27।।
transliteration: tau jātāśvāsau rājaputrau viditvā taccābhijñānaṃ rāghavāya pradāya| devyā cākhyātaṃ sarvamevānupūrvyādvācā sampūrṇaṃ vāyuputtra śśaśaṃsa
translation: वायुपुत्रः son of the Windgod, तौ राजपुत्त्रौ the two princes Rama and Lakshmana, जाताश्वासौ sighing in relief, विदित्वा knowing, तत् that, अभिज्ञानम् identification, राघवाय to Rama, प्रदाय communicated, देव्या by Sita, आख्यातम् having spoken, सर्वमेव everything, सम्पूर्णम् completely, आनुपूर्व्यात् in an orderly manner, वाचा spoken, शशंस  Hanuman.
explanation: Coming to know that the two princes were sighing in relief, Hanuman presented the token of identification given by Sita to Rama, after having communicated in full the messsage of Sita in an orderly manner. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyfifth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो हनुमता रामो दशरथात्मज:। तं मणिं हृदये कृत्वा प्ररुरोद सलक्ष्मणः।।5.66.1।।
transliteration: evamukto hanumatā rāmo daśarathātmaja:| taṃ maṇiṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā praruroda salakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: हनुमता Hanuman, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः spoken, सलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, दशरथात्मजः son of Dasaratha, रामः Rama, तं मणिम् that ornament, हृदये to the bosom, कृत्वा held, प्ररुरोद wept.
explanation: Thus addressed by Hanuman, Rama held the token (Chudamani) against his bosom and wept with Lakshmana.
comments: Sri Rama wails piteously after seeing the token chudamani.

shloka_text: तं तु दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं राघव श्शोककर्शितः। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यां सुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत्।।5.66.2।।
transliteration: taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ rāghava śśokakarśitaḥ| netrābhyāmaśrupūrṇābhyāṃ sugrīvamidamabravīt
translation: तं मणिश्रेष्ठम् the precious jewel, दृष्ट्वा seeing, राघवः Rama, शोककर्शितः overcome with sorrow, अश्रुपूर्णाभ्याम् filled with tears, नेत्राभ्याम् both eyes, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Seeing the precious jewel, Rama's eyes were filled with tears. Overwhelmed with grief, he spoke to Sugriva.

shloka_text: यथैव धेनु स्स्रवति स्नेहाद्वत्सस्य वत्सला। तथा ममापि हृदयं मणिरत्नस्य दर्शनात्।।5.66.3।।
transliteration: yathaiva dhenu ssravati snehādvatsasya vatsalā| tathā mamāpi hṛdayaṃ maṇiratnasya darśanāt
translation: वत्सला fond of its calf, धेनुः cow, वत्सस्य at the sight of calf, स्नेहात् out of love, यथैव in the same way, स्रवति distils milk from its teats, मम हृदयमपि my heart also, मणिरत्नस्य at this excellent jewel, दर्शनात् on seeing, तथा  so does.
explanation: "Just as a cow fond of its calf begins to distil milk from its teats at the sight of the calf, so does my heart melt at the sight of this excellent jewel.

shloka_text: मणिरत्नमिदं दत्तं वैदेह्याश्श्वशुरेण मे। वधूकाले यथाबद्धमधिकं मूर्ध्नि शोभते।।5.66.4।।
transliteration: maṇiratnamidaṃ dattaṃ vaidehyāśśvaśureṇa me| vadhūkāle yathābaddhamadhikaṃ mūrdhni śobhate
translation: वधूकाले at the time of marriage, मूर्ध्नि to the head, आबद्धम् tied, यथा so, शोभते charming, इदम् this, मणिरत्नम् gem of ornament, मे श्वशुरेण my fatherinlaw, वैदेह्याः to Vaidehi, दत्तम् presented.
explanation: "At the time of marriage, this jewel was presented by my father-in-law. Vaidehi wore it on her forehead and it looked charming.

shloka_text: अयं हि जलसम्भूतो मणिस्सज्जनपूजितः। यज्ञे परमतुष्टेन दत्तश्शक्रेण धीमता।।5.66.5।।
transliteration: ayaṃ hi jalasambhūto maṇissajjanapūjitaḥ| yajñe paramatuṣṭena dattaśśakreṇa dhīmatā
translation: जलसम्भूतः found in water, सज्जनपूजितः worshipped by elders of the family, अयं मणिः this jewel यज्ञे in sacrificial ceremony, परमतुष्टेन great joy, धीमता wise one, शक्रेण by Indra, दत्तः given.
explanation: "This was found in water and was bestowed by Indra out of great joy on Janaka who had performed a grand sacrificial ceremony. So it was worshipped by elders of the family.

shloka_text: इमं दृष्ट्वा मणिश्रेष्ठं यथा तातस्य दर्शनम्। अद्यास्म्यवगतस्सौम्य वैदेहस्य तथा विभोः।।5.66.6।।
transliteration: imaṃ dṛṣṭvā maṇiśreṣṭhaṃ yathā tātasya darśanam| adyāsmyavagatassaumya vaidehasya tathā vibhoḥ
translation: सौम्य noble, अद्य now, इमम् this, मणिश्रेष्ठम् gem of jewel, दृष्ट्वा when I see, तातस्य father's, तथा so also, विभोः king, वैदेहस्य of Videha, दर्शनम् seeing, यथा as if, अवगतः get.
explanation: "O noble Sugriva now when I see this excellent jewel, I get direct sight of my father and king of Videha (in the same way as I obtained the sight of Sita).

shloka_text: अयं हि शोभते तस्याः प्रियाया मूर्ध्नि मे मणिः। अस्याद्य दर्शने नाहं प्राप्तां तामिव चिन्तये।।5.66.7।।
transliteration: ayaṃ hi śobhate tasyāḥ priyāyā mūrdhni me maṇiḥ| asyādya darśane nāhaṃ prāptāṃ tāmiva cintaye
translation: अयं मणिः this gem, मे प्रियायाः my beloved, मूर्ध्नि head, शोभते हि indeed shone, अद्य now, अस्य its, दर्शनेन mere look, ताम् her, प्राप्तामिव as if I am seeing, चिन्तये I think.
explanation: "This jewel was shining on the head of my beloved. Now its mere look makes me feel that I am seeing her.

shloka_text: किमाह सीता वैदेही ब्रूहि सौम्य पुनः पुनः। पिपासुमिव तोयेन सिञ्चन्ती वाक्यवारिणा।।5.66.8।।
transliteration: kimāha sītā vaidehī brūhi saumya punaḥ punaḥ| pipāsumiva toyena siñcantī vākyavāriṇā
translation: सौम्य O handsome (Hanuman), पिपासुम् for a thirsty one, तोयेन इव like water, वाक्यवारिणा in lifegiving water of words, सिञ्चन्ती sprinkle, वैदेही Vaidehi, सीता Sita, किम् what else, पुनः पुनः again and again, आह to speak, ब्रूहि asked.
explanation: "O handsome Hanuman Sita is like water for a thirsty person. Tell me again and again what Sita said to you. Sprinkle on me (lifegiving) water of her words in the form of message.

shloka_text: इतस्तु किं दुःखतरं यदिमं वारिसम्भवम्। मणिं पश्यामि सौमित्रे वैदेहीमागतां विना।।5.66.9।।
transliteration: itastu kiṃ duḥkhataraṃ yadimaṃ vārisambhavam| maṇiṃ paśyāmi saumitre vaidehīmāgatāṃ vinā
translation: सौमित्रे O Saumitri, वारिसम्भवम् found in water, इमं मणिम् this jewel, वैदेहीम् of Vaidehi, आगतां विना without her, यत् पश्यामि seeing this, इतः here, दुःखतरम् cause more sorrow, किम् what?
explanation: "O Saumitri I see this jewel born (formed) under water but not her. What can be more sorrowful to me?

shloka_text: चिरं जीवति वैदेही यदि मासं धरिष्यति। क्षणं सौम्य न जीवेयं विना तामसितेक्षणाम्।।5.66.10।।
transliteration: ciraṃ jīvati vaidehī yadi māsaṃ dhariṣyati| kṣaṇaṃ saumya na jīveyaṃ vinā tāmasitekṣaṇām
translation: सौम्य O dear!, वैदेही Vaidehi, मासम् one month, धरिष्यति यदि if she lives, चिरम् for long, जीवति living, सौम्य O dear, ताम् her, असितेक्षणां विना without the (enchanting) black-eyed, क्षणम् for a moment, न जीवेयम् I cannot live
explanation: (Addressing Hanuman again) "O dear, if she can live for a month it is living for long. I would not live for a moment without the black-eyed Vaidehi.

shloka_text: नय मामपि तं देशं यत्र दृष्टा मम प्रिया। न तिष्ठेयं क्षणमपि प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च।।5.66.11।।
transliteration: naya māmapi taṃ deśaṃ yatra dṛṣṭā mama priyā| na tiṣṭheyaṃ kṣaṇamapi pravṛttimupalabhya ca
translation: मम my, प्रिया beloved, यत्र दृष्टा where you saw, मामपि me too, तं देशम् that place, नय take me, प्रवृत्तिम् where she is, उपलभ्य च and knowing, क्षणमपि even a moment, न तिष्ठेयम् not stay here.
explanation: "Take me to the place you saw my beloved. Knowing where she is I cannot stay here even for a moment.

shloka_text: कथं सा मम सुश्रोणी भीरुभीरु स्सती सदा। भयावहानां घोराणां मध्ये तिष्ठति रक्षसाम्।।5.66.12।।
transliteration: kathaṃ sā mama suśroṇī bhīrubhīru ssatī sadā| bhayāvahānāṃ ghorāṇāṃ madhye tiṣṭhati rakṣasām
translation: सदा always, भीरुभीरुः सती very timid, मम सुश्रोणी my fairhipped beloved, भयावहानाम् fearsome forms, घोराणाम् dreadful ones, रक्षसाम् demons, मध्ये midst, कथम् how, तिष्ठति does she remain.
explanation: "She is always very timid. How can my fairhipped beloved remain in the midst of dreadful and fearsome demons?

shloka_text: शारद स्तिमिरोन्मुक्तो नूनं चन्द्रं इवांबुधैः। आवृतं वदनं तस्या न विराजति राक्षसैः।।5.66.13।।
transliteration: śārada stimironmukto nūnaṃ candraṃ ivāṃbudhaiḥ| āvṛtaṃ vadanaṃ tasyā na virājati rākṣasaiḥ
translation: तिमिरोन्मुक्तः bereft of brightness, अम्बुदैः by rainclouds, चन्द्रः इव like the Moon, राक्षसैः by demons, आवृतम् surrounded by, तस्याः her, वदनम् countenance, न विराजति not shine, नूनम् surely.
explanation: "Her face resembling the autumnal Moon bereft of its stain, though covered with rainclouds does not shine so bright.

shloka_text: किमाह सीता हनुमंस्तत्त्वतः कथयाद्य मे। एतेन खलु जीविष्ये भेषजेनातुरो यथा।।5.66.14।।
transliteration: kimāha sītā hanumaṃstattvataḥ kathayādya me| etena khalu jīviṣye bheṣajenāturo yathā
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, सीता Sita, किम् what, आह to go, अद्य now, तत्त्वतः truly, मे I am, कथय told by her, आतुरः eager, भेषजेन यथा just as medicine does, एतेन that alone, जीविष्ये खलु indeed, keep me alive.
explanation: "O Hanuman Tell me now truly what has been told by her. I am eager to know. Indeed, it will keep me alive just as medicne does. (I shall survive on the strength of her message)

shloka_text: मधुरा मधुरालापा किमाह मम भामिनी। मद्विहीना वरारोहा हनुमन् कथयस्व मे।।5.66.15।।
transliteration: madhurā madhurālāpā kimāha mama bhāminī| madvihīnā varārohā hanuman kathayasva me
translation: मधुरा lovely one, मधुरालापा one who speaks sweetly, वरारोहा fairhipped one, मद्विहीना separated from me, मम भामिनी my beloved, किम् what, आह did she say, मे to me, कथयस्व you may narrate.
explanation: That lovely Sita who speaks sweetly, that fairhipped beautiful one who has been separated from me, my beloved, what did she say? Please narrate. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे षट्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtysixth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान् राघवेण महात्मना। सीताया भाषितं सर्वं न्यवेदयत राघवे।।5.67.1।।
transliteration: evamuktastu hanumān rāghaveṇa mahātmanā| sītāyā bhāṣitaṃ sarvaṃ nyavedayata rāghave
translation: महात्मना great soul, राघवेण to Rama, एवम् that way, उक्तः spoken, हनुमान् Hanuman, सीतायाः Sita's, भाषितम् said, सर्वम् everything, राघवे to Rama, न्यवेदयत related.
explanation: Thus asked by Sri Rama, Hanuman repeated everything spoken by Sita to Rama.
comments: Hanuman once again narrates to Rama, Sita's condition.

shloka_text: इदमुक्तवती देवी जानकी पुरुषर्षभ। पूर्व वृत्तमभिज्ञानं चित्रकूटे यथातथम्।।5.67.2।।
transliteration: idamuktavatī devī jānakī puruṣarṣabha| pūrva vṛttamabhijñānaṃ citrakūṭe yathātatham
translation: पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, देवी queen, जानकी Janaki, चित्रकूटे at Chitrakuta, पूर्ववृत्तम् incident of the past, अभिज्ञानम् as an identification, यथातथम् as it is, इदम् this, उक्तवती she said.
explanation: "O bull among men queen Janaki related to me as a token of identification an incident  that had taken place at Chitrakuta in the past.

shloka_text: सुखसुप्ता त्वया सार्धं जानकी पूर्वमुत्थिता। वायस स्सहसोत्पत्य विददार स्तनान्तरे।।5.67.3।।
transliteration: sukhasuptā tvayā sārdhaṃ jānakī pūrvamutthitā| vāyasa ssahasotpatya vidadāra stanāntare
translation: त्वया सार्धम् along with you, सुखसुप्ता lying down happily, जानकी Janaki, पूर्वम् earlier, उत्थिता woke up, वायसः a crow, सहसा swiftly, उत्पत्य got up, स्तनान्तरे on her breast, विददार scratched.
explanation: "When she was lying on your lap happily she awoke early and a crow came swiftly and scratched on her breast.

shloka_text: पर्यायेण च सुप्तस्त्वं देव्यङ्के भरताग्रज। पुनश्च किल पक्षी स देव्या जनयति व्यथाम्।।5.67.4।।
transliteration: paryāyeṇa ca suptastvaṃ devyaṅke bharatāgraja| punaśca kila pakṣī sa devyā janayati vyathām
translation: भरताग्रज elder brother of Bharata, त्वम् you, पर्यायेण woke up, देव्यङ्के on her lap, सुप्तः slept, सः पक्षी that crow, पुनश्च again, देव्याः Sita's, व्यथाम् hurting, जनयति किल started hurting.
explanation: "O Bharata's brother, when Sita awoke from sleep you slept on her lap. The same crow again hurt her.

shloka_text: पुनः पुनरुपागम्य विददार भृशं किल। ततस्त्वं बोधितस्तस्याश्शोणितेन समुक्षितः।।5.67.5।।
transliteration: punaḥ punarupāgamya vidadāra bhṛśaṃ kila| tatastvaṃ bodhitastasyāśśoṇitena samukṣitaḥ
translation: पुनः पुनः again and again, उपागम्य coming over her, भृशम् violently, विददार किल started scratching, ततः then, त्वम् you, तस्याः her, शोणितेन by blood, समुक्षितः wet by shedding, बोधितः किल woke you up.
explanation: Again and again the crow came to her and scratched her. She woke you up as you were getting wet with blood shed from her body.

shloka_text: वायसेन च तेनैव सततं बाध्यमानया। बोधितः किल देव्या त्वं सुखसुप्तः परन्तप।।5.67.6।।
transliteration: vāyasena ca tenaiva satataṃ bādhyamānayā| bodhitaḥ kila devyā tvaṃ sukhasuptaḥ parantapa
translation: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, तेन by that, वायसेनैव by the crow, सततम् repeatedly, बाध्यमानया pained, देव्या by the divine lady, सुखसुप्तः sleeping happily, त्वम् you, बोधितः किल woke you up and informed you.
explanation: "O scorcher of enemies pained by the crow hurting her repeatedly, while you were sleeping happily, she woke you up and informed you about it.

shloka_text: तां तु दृष्ट्वा महाबाहो दारितां च स्तनान्तरे। आशीविष इव क्रुद्धो निश्वसन्नभ्यभाषथाः।।5.67.7।।
transliteration: tāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mahābāho dāritāṃ ca stanāntare| āśīviṣa iva kruddho niśvasannabhyabhāṣathāḥ
translation: महाबाहो one with strong arms, स्तनान्तरे from the breasts, दारिताम् flowing, ताम् her, दृष्ट्वा seeing, क्रुद्धः furious, आशीविष इव like a serpent, निश्वसन् sighing, अभ्यभाषथाः you said this.
explanation: "Seeing the blood flowing from her breasts you became furious like a hissing serpent and said:

shloka_text: नखाग्रैः केन ते भीरु दारितं तु स्तनान्तरम्। कः क्रीडति सरोषेण पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना।।5.67.8।।
transliteration: nakhāgraiḥ kena te bhīru dāritaṃ tu stanāntaram| kaḥ krīḍati saroṣeṇa pañcavaktreṇa bhoginā
translation: भीरु timid, ते you, स्तनान्तरम् from the breasts, केन who, नखाग्रैः with the tip of the nails, दारितम् scratched, सरोषेण furious, पञ्चवक्त्रेण भोगिना fivehooded serpent, कः who, क्रीडति sported.
explanation: "You are of timid nature. Who has scratched your breasts with the tip of the nail? Who is sporting with an enraged fivehooded serpent"?

shloka_text: निरीक्षमाणस्सहसा वायसं समवैक्षथाः। नखै स्सरुधिरैस्तीक्ष्णैस्तामेवाभिमुखं स्थितम्।।5.67.9।।
transliteration: nirīkṣamāṇassahasā vāyasaṃ samavaikṣathāḥ| nakhai ssarudhiraistīkṣṇaistāmevābhimukhaṃ sthitam
translation: निरीक्षमाणः seeing all over, सरुधिरैः with blood, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, नखैः nails, तामेव of her, अभिमुखम् in front of, स्थितम् stood, वायसम् crow, सहसा at once, समवैक्षथाः glanced.
explanation: 'Seeing all over, at once I glanced at the crow that stood in front of her with sharp bloodstained nails'.

shloka_text: सुतः किल स शक्रस्य वायसः पततां वरः। धरान्तरचरश्शीघ्रं पवनस्य गतौ समः।।5.67.10।।
transliteration: sutaḥ kila sa śakrasya vāyasaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ| dharāntaracaraśśīghraṃ pavanasya gatau samaḥ
translation: पतताम् among birds, वरः foremost, सः वायसः that crow, शक्रस्य Indra's, पुत्रः son, किल moving about, धरान्तरगतः all over the earth, शीघ्रम् swiftly, गतौ flying, पवनस्य windgod's speed, समः equal.
explanation: 'That crow, the foremost of the birds was the son of Indra moving about all over the earth swiftly. His speed matched the Windgod's.

shloka_text: ततस्तस्मिन्महाबाहो कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः। वायसे त्वं कृथाः क्रूरां मतिं मतिमतां वर।।5.67.11।।
transliteration: tatastasminmahābāho kopasaṃvartitekṣaṇaḥ| vāyase tvaṃ kṛthāḥ krūrāṃ matiṃ matimatāṃ vara
translation: महाबाहो longarmed one, मतिमताम् very wise one, वर reverred, त्वम् you, कोपसंवर्तितेक्षणः anguished, ततः then, तस्मिन् its, वायसे the crow's, क्रूराम् cruel, मतिम् in your mind, कृथाः decision took.
explanation: 'O longarmed, wise and revered Rama, then in anguish you took a cruel decision'.

shloka_text: स दर्भं संस्तराद्गृह्य ब्रह्मास्त्रेण ह्ययोजयः। स दीप्त इव कालाग्निर्जज्वालाभिमुखः खगम्।।5.67.12।।
transliteration: sa darbhaṃ saṃstarādgṛhya brahmāstreṇa hyayojayaḥ| sa dīpta iva kālāgnirjajvālābhimukhaḥ khagam
translation: सः he, संस्तरात् from your mat, दर्भम् a blade of grass, गृह्य took out, ब्राह्मेण अस्त्रेण by the mantra of the weapon of Brahma, योजयत् chanted, सः he, दीप्तः blazed, कालाग्निरिव like the fire of the demon's day, द्विजम् bird, अभिमुखः towards the direction, जज्वाल hurled.
explanation: 'You took out a blade of grass from your mat and chanted the mantra to invoke the weapon of Brahma (Brahmastra) and hurled it on the crow. It blazed like the fire of the doom's day.

shloka_text: क्षिप्तवांस्त्वं प्रदीप्तं हि दर्भं तं वायसं प्रति। ततस्तु वायसं दीप्तस्स दर्भोऽनुजगाम ह।।5.67.13।।
transliteration: kṣiptavāṃstvaṃ pradīptaṃ hi darbhaṃ taṃ vāyasaṃ prati| tatastu vāyasaṃ dīptassa darbho'nujagāma ha
translation: त्वम् yourself, प्रदीप्तम् blazing, तं दर्भम् that blade of grass, वायसं प्रति over the crow, क्षिप्तवान् burning, ततः then, सः दर्भः that blade of grass, दीप्तः glowing like fire, वायसम् to the crow, अनुजगाम ह chased.
explanation: 'You hurled the blazing blade of grass on to the crow. That burning blade of grass chased the crow.

shloka_text: स पित्रा च परित्यक्तस्सुरैश्च समहर्षिभिः। त्रीन् लोकान् सम्परिक्रम्य त्रातारं नाधिगच्छति।।5.67.14।।
transliteration: sa pitrā ca parityaktassuraiśca samaharṣibhiḥ| trīn lokān samparikramya trātāraṃ nādhigacchati
translation: सः he, पित्रा च by the father, समहर्षिभिः even the great sages, सुरैश्च and gods, परित्यक्तः abandoned, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, सम्परिक्रम्य went round also, त्रातारम् saviour, नाधिगच्छति was not found.
explanation: 'He was abandoned by his father, even by great sages and gods. Then he went round the three worlds but could not find a saviour.

shloka_text: पुनरेवागतस्त्रस्तस्त्वत्सकाशमरिंदम। स तं निपतितं भूमौ शरण्यश्शरणागतम्।।5.67.15।। वधार्हमपि काकुत्स्थ कृपया पर्यपालयः।
transliteration: punarevāgatastrastastvatsakāśamariṃdama| sa taṃ nipatitaṃ bhūmau śaraṇyaśśaraṇāgatam vadhārhamapi kākutstha kṛpayā paryapālayaḥ|
translation: अरिन्दम destroyer of enemies, त्रस्तः trembling, पुनरेव again, त्वत्सकाशम् that crow, आगतः came back, शरण्यः for protection, सः काकुत्स्थ: to Rama, शरणागतम् seeking protection, भूमौ on earth, निपतितम् fell down, तम् him, वाधर्हमपि that which deserved to be slayed, कृपया in compassion, पर्यपालय: saved.
explanation: 'O destroyer of enemies the crow came back again to you trembling seeking protection from you and fell on the ground. Even though it deserved to be slayed, you saved him out of compassion.

shloka_text: मोघमस्त्रं न शक्यं तु कर्तुमित्येव राघव।।5.67.16।। भवांस्तस्याक्षि काकस्य हिनस्ति स्म स दक्षिणम्।
transliteration: moghamastraṃ na śakyaṃ tu kartumityeva rāghava bhavāṃstasyākṣi kākasya hinasti sma sa dakṣiṇam|
translation: राघव Rama, अस्त्रम् weapon, मोघम् divine one, कर्तुम् to withdraw, न शक्यम् not possible, इत्येव therefore, भवान् you, तस्य काकस्य that crow, दक्षिणम् अक्षि right eye, हिनस्ति स्म struck.
explanation: 'O Rama since a divine weapon cannot be withdrawn, it did strike his right eye'.

shloka_text: अथाहमुत्तरं देव्या पुनरुक्त स्ससम्भ्रमम्। तव स्नेहान्नरव्याघ्र सौहार्दादनुमान्य वै।।5.68.1।।
transliteration: athāhamuttaraṃ devyā punarukta ssasambhramam| tava snehānnaravyāghra sauhārdādanumānya vai
translation: नरव्याघ्र tiger among men, अथ and then, अहम् I, देव्या to Sita, तव your, स्नेहात् love, सौहार्दात् having affection, अनुमान्य confident, पुनः again, उत्तरम् addressed, ससम्भ्रमम् hurrying up, उक्तः said.
explanation: "O tiger among men In view of her regards for me and and her love for you she was confident and once again addressed me:
comments: Hanuman describes to Rama the manner in which he warded off Sita's doubts regarding monkeys' crossing the ocean and rescuing her.

shloka_text: एवं बहुविधं वाच्यो रामो दाशरथिस्त्वया। यथा मामाप्नुयाच्छीघ्रं हत्वा रावणमाहवे।।5.68.2।।
transliteration: evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ vācyo rāmo dāśarathistvayā| yathā māmāpnuyācchīghraṃ hatvā rāvaṇamāhave
translation: दाशरथिः Dasaratha's, रामः Rama, आहवे in battle, रावणम् Ravana, शीघ्रम् quickly, हत्वा slaying, माम् me, यथा so that, आप्नुयात् he will get me, तथा so that, एवम् in that way, बहुविधम् in many ways, वाच्यः you may appeal.
explanation: 'You may appeal to Rama, the son of Dasaratha in many ways, that he should come quickly and slay Ravana in the battle and get me back.

shloka_text: यदि वा मन्यसे वीर वसैकाहमरिन्दम। कस्मिंश्चित्संवृते देशे विक्रान्तश्श्वो गमिष्यसि।।5.68.3।।
transliteration: yadi vā manyase vīra vasaikāhamarindama| kasmiṃścitsaṃvṛte deśe vikrāntaśśvo gamiṣyasi
translation: अरिन्दम crusher of enemies, वीर brave, मन्यसे यदि I wish, कस्मिंश्चित् for a while, संवृते around, देशे this place, एकाहम् in a secluded place, वस stay, विश्रान्तः after resting, श्वः tomorrow, गमिष्यसि (you) may leave.
explanation: 'O crusher of enemies O brave Hanuman I wish you rest for a while in a secluded place around here and leave tomorrow .

shloka_text: मम चाप्यल्पभाग्यायास्सान्निध्यात्तव वीर्यवन्। अस्य शोकविपाकस्य मुहूर्तं स्याद्विमोक्षणम्।।5.68.4।।
transliteration: mama cāpyalpabhāgyāyāssānnidhyāttava vīryavan| asya śokavipākasya muhūrtaṃ syādvimokṣaṇam
translation: वीर्यवन् valiant (Hanuman), तव your, सान्निध्यात् by your presence, अल्पभाग्यायाः less fortunate one, मम to me, अस्य your, शोकपाकस्य from sorrow, मुहूर्तम् for a while, विमोक्षणम्  relieved, स्यात् will be.
explanation: 'O valiant (Hanuman) by your presence here, the less fortunate me, will be relieved of sorrow for a while.

shloka_text: गते हि त्वयि विक्रान्ते पुनरागमनाय वै। प्राणानामपि सन्देहो मम स्यान्नात्र संशयः।।5.68.5।।
transliteration: gate hi tvayi vikrānte punarāgamanāya vai| prāṇānāmapi sandeho mama syānnātra saṃśayaḥ
translation: विक्रान्ते courageous, त्वयि your, हरिशार्दूल tiger among monkeys, पुनरागमनाय by your return, गते gone, मम me, प्राणानामपि even my life, सन्देहः doubt, स्यात् will be, अत्र that, संदेहः doubt, न no.
explanation: 'O courageous tiger among monkeys when you depart (abruptly) I doubt if I would be alive by your return.

shloka_text: तवादर्शनजश्शोको भूयो मां परितापयेत्। दुःखाद्दुःखपराभूतां दुर्गतां दुःखभागिनीम्।।5.68.6।।
transliteration: tavādarśanajaśśoko bhūyo māṃ paritāpayet| duḥkhādduḥkhaparābhūtāṃ durgatāṃ duḥkhabhāginīm
translation: दुःखात् afflicted by sorrow, दुःखभागिनीम् unfortunate one, दुर्गताम् tormented, माम् me, तव your, अदर्शनजः not seeing you, शोकः grief, भूयः will be, परितापयेत् will be lamenting further.
explanation: I am an unfortunate one, afflicted by sorrow and tormented (by demons). If I am not able to see you I will be lamenting in grief.

shloka_text: अयं च वीर सन्देहस्तिष्ठतीव ममाग्रतः। सुमहांस्त्वत्सहायेषु हर्यृक्षेषु हरीश्वर।।5.68.7।।
transliteration: ayaṃ ca vīra sandehastiṣṭhatīva mamāgrataḥ| sumahāṃstvatsahāyeṣu haryṛkṣeṣu harīśvara
translation: वीर brave, हरीश्वर vanara, त्वत्सहायेषु your helpers, हर्यृक्षेषु the vanaras and bears, अयम् this, सुमहान्  highly, सन्देहः doubt, मम अग्रतः I have, तिष्ठतीव will cross this ocean.
explanation: 'O brave vanaras I have great doubts about your assistants the vanaras and bears, crossing the ocean.

shloka_text: कथं नु खलु दुष्पारं तरिष्यन्ति महोदधिम्। तानि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि तौ वा नरवरात्मजौ।।5.68.8।।
transliteration: kathaṃ nu khalu duṣpāraṃ tariṣyanti mahodadhim| tāni haryṛkṣasainyāni tau vā naravarātmajau
translation: तानि those, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानि the army of vanaras and bears, तौ both, नरवरात्मजौ princes Rama and Lakshmana, दुष्पारम् impassable, महोदधिम् great ocean, कथं नु how will, तरिष्यन्ति be able to cross.
explanation: 'How will the vanaras and bears cross this great, impassable ocean? How will the princes Rama and Lakshmna be able to cross it?

shloka_text: त्रयाणामेव भूतानां सागरस्यास्य लङ्घने। शक्तिस्स्याद्वैनतेयस्य तव वा मारुतस्य वा।।5.68.9।।
transliteration: trayāṇāmeva bhūtānāṃ sāgarasyāsya laṅghane| śaktissyādvainateyasya tava vā mārutasya vā
translation: अस्य that, सागरस्य ocean, लङ्घने to cross, वैनतेयस्य वा to Garuda, तव वा or you, मारुतस्य वा or wind god, त्रयाणाम् three of you, भूतानाम् among all beings, शक्तिः the capacity, स्यात् have.
explanation: 'Only three among all beings, Garuda, the Windgod and you have the capacity to cross the ocean.

shloka_text: तदस्मिन् कार्यनिर्योगे वीरैवं दुरतिक्रमे। किं पश्यसि समाधानं ब्रूहि कार्यविदां वरः।।5.68.10।।
transliteration: tadasmin kāryaniryoge vīraivaṃ duratikrame| kiṃ paśyasi samādhānaṃ brūhi kāryavidāṃ varaḥ
translation: वीर hero, तत् that, एवम् in that way, दुरतिक्रमे who knows to succeed, अस्मि I, कार्यनिर्योगे  difficult to accomplish, किम् what, समाधानम् expedient, पश्यसि are you perceiving, ब्रूहि tell me, कार्यविदाम् to accomplish the task, वर हि foremost indeed.
explanation: 'O heroic Hanuman you know how to succeed. But I wish to know what expedient you have to accomplish which is difficult by all means. O foremost vanara, please tell me .

shloka_text: काममस्य त्वमेवैकः कार्यस्य परिसाधने। पर्याप्तः परवीरघ्न यशस्यस्ते बलोदयः।।5.68.11।।
transliteration: kāmamasya tvamevaikaḥ kāryasya parisādhane| paryāptaḥ paravīraghna yaśasyaste balodayaḥ
translation: परवीरघ्न slayer of enemy heroes, अस्य कार्यस्य in this task, परिसाधने ability to succeed, त्वम् for you, एक एव single handed, पर्याप्तः कामम् to accomplish the desired object, ते to you, फलोदयः having succeed, यशस्यः you will be renowned.
explanation: 'O Slayer of enemy heroes you have the ability to accomplsh this task singlehanded. By succeeding in accomplishing the objective you will become renowned (and not Rama).

shloka_text: बलै स्समग्रैर्यदि मां हत्वा रावणमाहवे। विजयी स्वां पुरीं रामो नयेत्तत्स्याद्यशस्करम्।।5.68.12।।
transliteration: balai ssamagrairyadi māṃ hatvā rāvaṇamāhave| vijayī svāṃ purīṃ rāmo nayettatsyādyaśaskaram
translation: रामः Rama, रावणम् Ravana's, समग्रैः entire, बलैः with army, आहवे in battle, हत्वा slaying, विजयी becoming victorious, स्वाम् his, पुरीम् city, माम् me, नयेद्यदि will take, तत् that, यशस्करम् glorious, स्यात् will be.
explanation: 'When Rama slays Ravana and his entire army and takes me to his city after becoming victorious it will add glory to him.

shloka_text: यथाऽहं तस्य वीरस्य वनादुपधिना हृता। रक्षसा तद्भयादेव तथा नार्हति राघवः।।5.68.13।।
transliteration: yathā'haṃ tasya vīrasya vanādupadhinā hṛtā| rakṣasā tadbhayādeva tathā nārhati rāghavaḥ
translation: अहम् I am, रक्षसा by the demon, वीरस्य valiant one, उपधिना cheat, यथा like, हृता abducted, तथा that way, तद्भयादेव out of fear of, राघवः Rama, नार्हति not right.
explanation: 'Tell valiant Rama not to take me back the way Ravana, the demon abducted me out of fear. Which is not right.

shloka_text: बलैस्तु सङ्कुलां कृत्वा लङ्कां परबलार्दनः। मां नयेद्यदि काकुत्स्थस्तत्तस्य सदृशं भवेत्।।5.68.14।।
transliteration: balaistu saṅkulāṃ kṛtvā laṅkāṃ parabalārdanaḥ| māṃ nayedyadi kākutsthastattasya sadṛśaṃ bhavet
translation: परबलार्धनः one who is a slayer of the enemy army, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha, लङ्काम् Lanka, शरैः with arrows, सङ्कुलाम् filling, कृत्वा does, माम् me, नयेद्यदि takes, तत् that, तस्य to him, सदृशम् pleasing to look, भवेत् will be.
explanation: 'If Rama, the slayer of the enemy army, could fill Lanka with his arrows and take me that will be a good sight for him to see.

shloka_text: तद्यथा तस्य विक्रान्तमनुरूपं महात्मनः। भवेदाहवशूरस्य तथा त्वमुपपादय।।5.68.15।।
transliteration: tadyathā tasya vikrāntamanurūpaṃ mahātmanaḥ| bhavedāhavaśūrasya tathā tvamupapādaya
translation: तत् that, महात्मनः great soul, आहवशूरस्य  exalted hero, तस्य his, अनुरूपम् according to his might, विक्रान्तम् exhibiting, यथा that way, भवेत् will be, तथा like, त्वम् you, उपपादय make arrangement.
explanation: 'You may make arrangement in such a way that the exalted hero Rama exhibits his might according to his stature'.

shloka_text: तदर्थोपहितं वाक्यं प्रश्रितं हेतुसंहितम्। निशम्याहं तत श्शेषं वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रुवम्।।5.68.16।।
transliteration: tadarthopahitaṃ vākyaṃ praśritaṃ hetusaṃhitam| niśamyāhaṃ tata śśeṣaṃ vākyamuttaramabruvam
translation: अहम् I am, अर्थोपहितम् meaningful, प्रश्रितं courteous, हेतुसंहितम् reasonable, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य hearing, ततः then, शेषम् rest, उत्तरम् reply, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवम् said.
explanation: "Hearing the meaningful, courteous and reasonable words of Sita, I replied :

shloka_text: देवि हर्यृक्षसैन्यानामीश्वरः प्लवतां वरः। सुग्रीवस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्तवार्थे कृतनिश्चयः।।5.68.17।।
transliteration: devi haryṛkṣasainyānāmīśvaraḥ plavatāṃ varaḥ| sugrīvassattvasampannastavārthe kṛtaniścayaḥ
translation: देवि O queen, हर्यृक्षसैन्यानाम् army of bears and vanaras, ईश्वरः lord, प्लवतां वरः foremost among leaping beings, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with strength, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तव अर्धे your task, कृतनिश्चयः resolved.
explanation: 'O queen The lord of the army of bears and vanaras who is the foremost among the monkeys is endowed with enough strength and has resolved to rescue you.

shloka_text: तस्य विक्रमसम्पन्नास्सत्त्ववन्तो महाबलाः। मन स्सङ्कल्पसम्पाता निदेशे हरयः स्थिताः।।5.68.18।।
transliteration: tasya vikramasampannāssattvavanto mahābalāḥ| mana ssaṅkalpasampātā nideśe harayaḥ sthitāḥ
translation: विक्रमसम्पन्नाः mighty, सत्त्ववन्तः powerful, महाबलाः tough, मनः सङ्कल्पसम्पाताः having the speed of thought, हरयः monkeys, तस्य his, निदेशे under his command, स्थिताः remain.
explanation: 'Mighty, powerful and tough monkeys who have the speed of thought are under the command of Sugriva.

shloka_text: येषां नोपरि नाधस्तान्न तिर्यक्सज्जते गतिः। न च कर्मसु सीदन्ति महत्स्वमिततेजसः।।5.68.19।।
transliteration: yeṣāṃ nopari nādhastānna tiryaksajjate gatiḥ| na ca karmasu sīdanti mahatsvamitatejasaḥ
translation: येषाम् all of them, गतिः can go, उपरि in the sky, न सज्जते not obstructed, अधस्तात् in the underworld, न not, तिर्यक् obliquely, न not, अमिततेजसः very brilliant, महत्सु very great, कर्मसु task also, न सीदन्ति without any difficulty.
explanation: 'All of them can go upward in the sky, downward into the underworld or obliquely in any direction without obstruction. They are brilliant enough to do any great task without any difficulty.

shloka_text: असकृत्तैर्महाभागैर्वानरैर्बलदर्पितैः। प्रदक्षिणीकृता भूमिर्वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः।।5.68.20।।
transliteration: asakṛttairmahābhāgairvānarairbaladarpitaiḥ| pradakṣiṇīkṛtā bhūmirvāyumārgānusāribhiḥ
translation: महाभागैः great lady, बलदर्पितैः by extraordinary might, वायुमार्गानुसारिभिः flying with the wind, तैः they, वानरैः vanaras, भूमिः earth, प्रदक्षिणीकृता have circumambulated.
explanation: 'O great lady the mighty vanaras of extraordinary strength can fly with the wind and have  even circumambulated the earth.

shloka_text: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः। मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसन्निधौ।।5.68.21।।
transliteration: madviśiṣṭāśca tulyāśca santi tatra vanaukasaḥ| mattaḥ pratyavaraḥ kaścinnāsti sugrīvasannidhau
translation: तत्र there, मद्विशिष्टाश्च greater than, तुल्याश्च equals, वनौकसः monkeys, सन्ति are there, मत्तः compared to me, प्रत्यवरः less valiant, कश्चित् none, सुग्रीवसन्निधौ in front of Sugriva, नास्ति not there.
explanation: 'There are monkeys who are more powerful than me or equal to me. None are less strong than me or Sugriva.

shloka_text: अहं तावदिह प्राप्तः किं पुनस्ते महाबलाः। न हि प्रकृष्टाः प्रेत्यन्ते प्रेष्यन्ते हीतरे जनाः।।5.68.22।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tāvadiha prāptaḥ kiṃ punaste mahābalāḥ| na hi prakṛṣṭāḥ pretyante preṣyante hītare janāḥ
translation: अहं तावत् therefore I, इह here, अनुप्राप्तः have come, महाबलाः highly powerful ones, ते they, किं पुनः why to say again, प्रकृष्टाः superior, न प्रेत्यन्ते हि indeed do not send, इतरे others, जनाः people, प्रेष्यन्ते हि will send.
explanation: 'When I could come here, what to speak of the mightier monkeys?, People do not send the superior ones on errand, but send only the juniors.

shloka_text: तदलं परितापेन देवि मन्युर्व्यपैतु ते। एकोत्पातेन ते लङ्कामेष्यन्ति हरियूथपाः।।5.68.23।।
transliteration: tadalaṃ paritāpena devi manyurvyapaitu te| ekotpātena te laṅkāmeṣyanti hariyūthapāḥ
translation: देवि O noble lady, तत् that, परितापेन lamentation, अलम् enough, ते your, शोकः sorrow, व्यपैतु will fill this place, ते they, हरियूथपाः vanara army, एकोत्पातेन in one jump, लङ्काम् Lanka, एष्यन्ति will fly to reach.
explanation: 'O noble lady give up your lamentation. Enough of sorrowing. The vanara army will fly and reach this place at one leap and fill it.

shloka_text: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ। त्वत्सकाशं महाभागे नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः।।5.68.24।।
transliteration: mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāvivoditau| tvatsakāśaṃ mahābhāge nṛsiṃhāvāgamiṣyataḥ
translation: महाभागे O noble lady, नृसिंहौ lions among men, तौ च they both, मम my, पृष्ठगतौ on back, उदितौ ascend, चन्द्रसूर्याविव like Sun and Moon, त्वत्सकाशम् newly risen, आगमिष्यतः will reach here.
explanation: 'O noble lady the lions among men, Rama and Lakshmana who resemble Sun and Moon will ascend on my back and reach here.

shloka_text: अरिघ्नं सिंहसङ्काशं क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्। लक्ष्मणं च धनुष्पाणिं लङ्काद्वारमुपस्थितम्।।5.68.25।।
transliteration: arighnaṃ siṃhasaṅkāśaṃ kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāghavam| lakṣmaṇaṃ ca dhanuṣpāṇiṃ laṅkādvāramupasthitam
translation: लङ्काद्वारम् at the entrance of Lanka, उपस्थितम् standing, अरिघ्नम् slayer of enemies, सिंहसङ्काशम् like a lion, तं राघवम् that Rama, धनुष्पाणिम् wielding bow in hand, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, क्षिप्रम् very soon, द्रक्ष्यसि will see.
explanation: 'You will see the lionlike Rama, a slayer of enemies and Lakshmana wielding bow in hand standing at the entrance of Lanka very soon.

shloka_text: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान्। वानरान्वारणोन्द्राभान् क्षिप्रं द्रक्षसि सङ्गतान्।।5.68.26।। शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु। नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामचिराच्छ्रोष्यसि स्वनम्।।5.68.27।।
transliteration: nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhān vīrān siṃhaśārdūlavikramān| vānarānvāraṇondrābhān kṣipraṃ drakṣasi saṅgatān śailāmbudanikāśānāṃ laṅkāmalayasānuṣu| nardatāṃ kapimukhyānāmacirācchroṣyasi svanam
translation: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानाम् like rainclouds on the mountain, लङ्कामलयसानुषु Lanka's mountain Malaya, नर्दताम् roaring like lion, कपिमुख्यानाम् generals of monkey army, स्वनम् sounds, अचारत् making, श्रोष्यसि will hear.
explanation: 'You will hear before long the shouts of generals of the vanaras who resemble rainclouds on the mountain roaring like lions from the Malaya mountain of Lanka.

shloka_text: नखदंष्ट्रायुधान् वीरान् सिंहशार्दूलविक्रमान्। वानरान्वारणोन्द्राभान् क्षिप्रं द्रक्षसि सङ्गतान्।।5.68.26।। शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानां लङ्कामलयसानुषु। नर्दतां कपिमुख्यानामचिराच्छ्रोष्यसि स्वनम्।।5.68.27।।
transliteration: nakhadaṃṣṭrāyudhān vīrān siṃhaśārdūlavikramān| vānarānvāraṇondrābhān kṣipraṃ drakṣasi saṅgatān śailāmbudanikāśānāṃ laṅkāmalayasānuṣu| nardatāṃ kapimukhyānāmacirācchroṣyasi svanam
translation: शैलाम्बुदनिकाशानाम् like rainclouds on the mountain, लङ्कामलयसानुषु Lanka's mountain Malaya, नर्दताम् roaring like lion, कपिमुख्यानाम् generals of monkey army, स्वनम् sounds, अचारत् making, श्रोष्यसि will hear.
explanation: 'You will hear before long the shouts of generals of the vanaras who resemble rainclouds on the mountain roaring like lions from the Malaya mountain of Lanka.

shloka_text: निवृत्तवनवासं च त्वया सार्धमरिन्दमम्। अभिषिक्तमयोध्यायां क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्।।5.68.28।।
transliteration: nivṛttavanavāsaṃ ca tvayā sārdhamarindamam| abhiṣiktamayodhyāyāṃ kṣipraṃ drakṣyasi rāghavam
translation: निवृत्तवनवासम् completing the exile in the forest, अरिन्दमम् slayer of enemies, अयोध्यायाम् in Ayodhya, त्वया सार्धम् along with you, अभिषिक्तम् crowned, राघवम् Rama, क्षिप्रम् soon, द्रक्ष्यसि will see.
explanation: 'You will soon see Rama, the slayer of enemies crowned as king of Ayodhya with you, having duly completed the term of  exile in the forest'.

shloka_text: ततो मया वाग्भिरदीनभाषिणा शिवाभिरिष्टाभिरभिप्रसादिता। जगाम शान्तिं मम मैथिलात्मजा तवापि शोकेन तदाभिपीडिता।।5.68.29।।
transliteration: tato mayā vāgbhiradīnabhāṣiṇā śivābhiriṣṭābhirabhiprasāditā| jagāma śāntiṃ mama maithilātmajā tavāpi śokena tadābhipīḍitā
translation: ततः then, तव your, शोकेनापि also in grief, तदा then, अभिपीडिता much grief, मैथिलात्मजा princess of Mithila, अदीनभाषिणा soothing words, मया of me, शिवाभिः auspicious also, इष्टाभिः welcome, मम my, वाग्भि: words, अभिप्रसादिता having spoken, शान्तिम् quiet, जगाम became.
explanation: Sita though afflicted heard from me that you were also in excessive grief on account of separation from her and from my soothing, auspicious and welcome words, she derived comfort and remained quiet. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे अष्टषष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtyeighth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं यथावदभिभाषितम् । रामः प्रीतिसमायुक्तो वाक्यमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ।।6.1.1।।
transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyaṃ yathāvadabhibhāṣitam | rāmaḥ prītisamāyukto vākyamuttaramabravīt
translation: रामः Rama, यथावत्:  in that manner, अभिभाषितम् : spoken , हनुमतः by Hanuman, वाक्यम्: words,श्रुत्वा: having heard, प्रीतिसमायुक्तः filled with love, उत्तरम: replied, वाक्यम्: words, अब्रवीत्: said
explanation: Having heard Hanuman's words, full of love, Rama replied.
comments: Hearing Hanuman's report, Rama praises him and embraces.

shloka_text: कृतं हनुमता कार्यं सुमहद्भुवि दुर्लभम् । मनसापि यदन्येन न शक्यं धरणीतले ।।6.1.2।।
transliteration: kṛtaṃ hanumatā kāryaṃ sumahadbhuvi durlabham | manasāpi yadanyena na śakyaṃ dharaṇītale
translation: हनुमता: Hanuman, यत्: such , धरणीतले: on this earth, अन्येन:  by any one, मनसापि:  even to think, नशक्यम्: not possible, सुमहत्: mighty, भुवि: world, दुर्लभम्: difficult, कार्यम्: task, कृतम्: has performed.
explanation: "Hanuman You have performed a mighty task indeed, which is difficult even to think of in this world and not possible for any one else on this earth."

shloka_text: न हि तं परिपश्यामि यस्तरेत महार्णवम् । अन्यत्र गरुडाद्वायोरन्यत्र च हनूमतः ।।6.1.3।।
transliteration: na hi taṃ paripaśyāmi yastareta mahārṇavam | anyatra garuḍādvāyoranyatra ca hanūmataḥ
translation: गरुडात्: by Garuda( the vehicle of Visnu ), वायोः by windgod, अन्यत्र:  anyone other than, हनूमतः by Hanuman, अन्यत्र:  none other than, यः this, महार्णवम्: great ocean, तरेत:  can  cross, हि: indeed, परिपश्यामि: not seen
explanation: "None else than Garuda or Vayu have I seen to have crossed this great ocean crossed by you, Hanuman."

shloka_text: देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । अप्रधृष्यां पुरीं लङ्कां रावणेन सुरक्षिताम् । प्रवष्ट स्सत्त्वमाश्रित्यश्वसन्को नाम निष्क्रमेत् ।।6.1.4।।
transliteration: devadānavayakṣāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām | apradhṛṣyāṃ purīṃ laṅkāṃ rāvaṇena surakṣitām | pravaṣṭa ssattvamāśrityaśvasanko nāma niṣkramet
translation: देवदानवयक्षाणाम्: for devas, danavas, yakshas, गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम्गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् gandharvas ,uragas , rakshasas, अप्रधृष्याम्: unimaginable to  cross, रावणेन: by Ravana, सुरक्षिताम्: highly protected, पुरीम्: city, सत्त्वम्: strength, आश्रित्य:  resorted, प्रविष्टः enter, को नाम: who indeed, श्वसन्: life, निष्क्रमेत्: can return
explanation: "Indeed, who has the strength to return alive after entering that city highly protected by Ravana. It is unimaginable even for devas, danavas, yakshas, gandharvas, uragas and rakshasas to cross."

shloka_text: को विशेत्सुदुराधर्षां राक्षसैश्च सुरक्षिताम् । यो वीर्यबलसम्पन्नो न समस्याद्धनूमतः ।।6.1.5।।
transliteration: ko viśetsudurādharṣāṃ rākṣasaiśca surakṣitām | yo vīryabalasampanno na samasyāddhanūmataḥ
translation: यः  he who , वीर्यबलसम्पन्नः abounding in valour and strength, हनूमतः Hanuman, नस्यात्: not possible , कः which सुदुराधर्षाम्: inaccessible, राक्षसैः by rakshasas, सुरक्षिताम्: highly protected, विशेत्: to enter
explanation: "Except for Hanuman, who is abounding in valour and strength, it is not possible for others to enter the inaccessible Lanka highly protected by rakshasas."

shloka_text: भृत्यकार्यं हनुमता सुग्रीवस्य कृतंमहत् । स्वयं विधाय स्वबलं सदृशं विक्रमस्य च ।।6.1.6।।
transliteration: bhṛtyakāryaṃ hanumatā sugrīvasya kṛtaṃmahat | svayaṃ vidhāya svabalaṃ sadṛśaṃ vikramasya ca
translation: हनुमता: Hanuman, विक्रमस्य: by his valour, सदृशम्:  mighty form, स्वबलम्: own strength, विधाय: what ought to be done,  सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, महत्: great, भृत्यकार्यम्: task assigned, कृतम्: carried out
explanation: "Hanuman, with his mighty form and valour not only carried out a great task assigned by Sugriva but also what had to be done as duty."

shloka_text: यो हि भृत्यो नियुक्तस्सन्भर्त्रा कर्मणि दुष्करे । कुर्यात्तदनुरागेण तमाहुः पुरुषोत्तमम् ।।6.1.7।।
transliteration: yo hi bhṛtyo niyuktassanbhartrā karmaṇi duṣkare | kuryāttadanurāgeṇa tamāhuḥ puruṣottamam
translation: यः he who, भृत्यः servant, दुष्करे: formidable, कर्मणि: task, भर्त्रा: master, नियुक्तः entrusted by, सन्: bestow, तत्: that, अनुरागेण: with love, कुर्यात्: does, तम्: him, पुरुषोत्तमम्: the best among men, आहुः is said to be
explanation: "He, who carries out  a formidable task entrusted to him by the master, with love is  said to be the best among men."

shloka_text: नियुक्तोय: परं कार्यं न कुर्यान्नृपतेः प्रियम् । भृत्योऽभृत्यस्समर्थोऽपि तमाहुर्मध्यमं नरम् ।।6.1.8।।
transliteration: niyuktoya: paraṃ kāryaṃ na kuryānnṛpateḥ priyam | bhṛtyo'bhṛtyassamartho'pi tamāhurmadhyamaṃ naram
translation: यः he, भृत्यः is a servant, समर्थ: efficient, अभृत्य: not a servant, नियुक्तः told, नृपते: by king, प्रियम्:  dear, कार्यम्: work, परम्: other, नकुर्यात्: does not do, तम्: him, नरम्: mediocre, अहु: said to be
explanation: An efficient servant does not only do what is asked but also does the work dear to the king. One who does not do so is said to be mediocre.

shloka_text: नियुक्तो नृपतेः  कार्यं न कुर्याद्यस्समाहितः । भृत्यो युक्तस्समर्थश्च तमाहुः पुरुषाधमम् ।।6.1.9।।
transliteration: niyukto nṛpateḥ  kāryaṃ na kuryādyassamāhitaḥ | bhṛtyo yuktassamarthaśca tamāhuḥ puruṣādhamam
translation: नियुक्तः one who is entrusted, यः he , भृत्यः servant, युक्तः capable, समर्थश्च:  who is efficient, नृपतेः by the king, कार्यम्: work, समाहितः who has agreed, कुर्यात्: not do the work , तम्: him, पुरुषाधमम्: lowly person, अहुः said  to be
explanation: "If one who is capable and efficient has been entrusted with a task by a king and fails to do the work agreed to, is said to be a lowly person."

shloka_text: तन्नियोगे नियुक्तेन कृतं कृत्यं हनूमता । न चात्मा लघुतां नीतस्सुग्रीवश्चापि तोषितः ।।6.1.10।।
transliteration: tanniyoge niyuktena kṛtaṃ kṛtyaṃ hanūmatā | na cātmā laghutāṃ nītassugrīvaścāpi toṣitaḥ
translation: तत्: that, नियोगे:  assigned, नियुक्तेन:  which is favourable, हनूमता: Hanuman, कृत्यम्: had to be done, कृतम्:  having accomplished, आत्मा: on his own, लघुताम् :difficulty, न: not, नीतः  carried out  सुग्रीवश्चापि: even to Sugriva, तोषितः made happy
explanation: "Having done the task assigned to him, Hanuman carried out what had to be done and accomplished without difficulty. This made Sugriva also happy."

shloka_text: अहं च रघुवंशश्च लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः । वैदेह्या दर्शनेनाद्य धर्मतः परिरक्षिताः ।।6.1.11।।
transliteration: ahaṃ ca raghuvaṃśaśca lakṣmaṇaśca mahābalaḥ | vaidehyā darśanenādya dharmataḥ parirakṣitāḥ
translation: वैदेह्या: Vaidehi's, दर्शनेन: by seeing, अद्य: now, अहं च: I am also, रघुवंशश्च: those of Raghu dynasty, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणश्च: Lakshmana's, धर्मतः rightfully, परिरक्षिताः  protected.
explanation: "On Hanuman finding Vaidehi, I and, mighty Lakshmana and the whole of Raghu dynasty are now rightfully protected."

shloka_text: इदं तु मम दीनस्य मनो भूयः प्रकर्षति । यदिहास्य प्रियाख्यातुर्न कुर्मि सदृशं प्रियम् ।।6.1.12।।
transliteration: idaṃ tu mama dīnasya mano bhūyaḥ prakarṣati | yadihāsya priyākhyāturna kurmi sadṛśaṃ priyam
translation: तु: on the other hand, प्रियाख्यातुः  who has spoken pleasing words, अस्य: to him, सदृशम्:  to see, प्रियम्: pleasing, यत् न कुर्मि:  not able to do to such person, इदम्: this, दीनस्य: piteous, मम: me, मनः mind भूयः further, प्रकर्षति: causing exceedingly
explanation: "On the other hand, it is a pity that I am not able to please such a person who has spoken pleasing words. Further this causes grief to me."

shloka_text: एष सर्वस्वभूते परिष्वङ्गो हनूमतः । मया कालमिमं प्राप्य दत्तस्तस्य महात्मनः ।।6.1.13।।
transliteration: eṣa sarvasvabhūte pariṣvaṅgo hanūmataḥ | mayā kālamimaṃ prāpya dattastasya mahātmanaḥ
translation: मया: me, इमम्: such, कालम्: time, प्राप्य: attained, महात्मनः great person, तस्य: to him, हनूमतः Hanuman, सर्वस्वभूतः everything, एषः परिष्वङ्गः this  embrace, मे दत्तः that I give
explanation: "To such a great one who attained success at this time, everything can be given. I give my embrace."

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा प्रीतिहृष्टाङ्गो रामस्तं परिषस्वजे । हनूमन्तं कृतात्मानं कृतकार्यमुपागतम् ।।6.1.14।।
transliteration: ityuktvā prītihṛṣṭāṅgo rāmastaṃ pariṣasvaje | hanūmantaṃ kṛtātmānaṃ kṛtakāryamupāgatam
translation: रामः Rama, इति: thus, उक्त्वा: having said, प्रीतिहृष्टाङ्गः  experiencing the joy of love all over the body, कृतात्मानम्: one who has accomplished, कृतकार्यम्: his duty, उपागतम्: returned back, तं हनूमन्तम्:  to him, Hanuman, परिषस्वजे: embraced.
explanation: Having said so, Rama experienced the joy of love all over his body and embraced Hanuman who returned successful.

shloka_text: ध्यात्वा पुनरुवाचेदं वचनं रघुनन्दनः । हरीणामीश्वरस्यापि सुग्रीवस्योपशृण्वतः ।।6.1.15।।
transliteration: dhyātvā punaruvācedaṃ vacanaṃ raghunandanaḥ | harīṇāmīśvarasyāpi sugrīvasyopaśṛṇvataḥ
translation: रघुनन्दनः Rama the delight of Raghu dynasty, ध्यात्वा: thought over , हरीणाम्: of monkeys, ईश्वरस्य: lord, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, उपशृण्वतः while listening, पुनः again, इदं वचनम्: these words, उवाच: spoke
explanation: Rama, the delight of Raghu dynasty thought over and said while Sugriva, the lord of monkeys was still listening.

shloka_text: सर्वथा सुकृतं तावत्सीतायाः परिमार्गणम् । सागरं तु समासाद्य पुनर्नष्टं मनो मम ।।6.1.16।।
transliteration: sarvathā sukṛtaṃ tāvatsītāyāḥ parimārgaṇam | sāgaraṃ tu samāsādya punarnaṣṭaṃ mano mama
translation: सीतायाः Sita's, परिमार्गणम्: in searching, सर्वथा: by all means, सुकृतम्: good work, तु: but( on the contrary), सागरम्: ocean, समासाद्य : having succeeded, मम मनः my mind, पुनः again, नष्टम्: fear
explanation: "By all means good work was done in searching for Sita. On the contrary, having succeeded, my mind is once again agitated when I think of (crossing) the ocean."

shloka_text: कथं नाम समुद्रस्य दुष्पारस्य महाम्भसः । हरयो दक्षिणं पारं गमिष्यन्ति समागताः ।।6.1.17।।
transliteration: kathaṃ nāma samudrasya duṣpārasya mahāmbhasaḥ | harayo dakṣiṇaṃ pāraṃ gamiṣyanti samāgatāḥ
translation: समागताः come together, हरय: monkeys, दुष्पारस्य: difficult to cross, महाम्भसः vast ocean, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, दक्षिणम्: southern, पारम्: shore, कथम्: how can, गमिष्यन्ति: be able to cross
explanation: "How will all the monkeys together be able to cross to the southern shore of the vast ocean? It is difficult to cross."

shloka_text: यद्यप्येष तु वृत्तान्तो वैदेह्या गदितो मम । समुद्रपारगमने हरीणां किमिहोत्तरम् ।।6.1.18।।
transliteration: yadyapyeṣa tu vṛttānto vaidehyā gadito mama | samudrapāragamane harīṇāṃ kimihottaram
translation: वैदेह्या: to Vaidehi, एषः all this , वृत्तान्तः matter, मम:  by me , गदितो:  told, यद्यपि: even though, हरीणाम्:  the monkeys, समुद्रपारगमने : to cross the ocean, उत्तरम्: enquired, किम्: what
explanation: "This has been told to me by Vaidehi. How will the monkeys cross the ocean(enquired Vaidehi)."

shloka_text: इत्युक्तवा शोकसम्भ्रान्तो राम श्शत्रुनिबर्हणः । हनूमन्तं महाबाहुस्ततो ध्यानमुपागमत् ।।6.1.19।।
transliteration: ityuktavā śokasambhrānto rāma śśatrunibarhaṇaḥ | hanūmantaṃ mahābāhustato dhyānamupāgamat
translation: शत्रुनिबर्हणः destroyer of enemy, महाबाहुः  mighty armed, रामः Rama , हनूमन्तम्: at Hanuman, इति: thus, उक्त्वा: said, शोकसंभ्रान्तः agitated with sorrow, ध्यानम्: reflected, उपागमत्: approaching
