shloka_text: क्षत्रियैर्बहुभिर्वीरैःशक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः । आसीद्वसुमतीपूर्णामहद्भिरिवपादपैः ।।6.7.18।।
transliteration: kṣatriyairbahubhirvīraiḥśakratulyaparākramaiḥ | āsīdvasumatīpūrṇāmahadbhirivapādapaiḥ
translation: क्षत्रियैर्: warriors, आसीद: was, बहुभि: many, र्वीरैः strong, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः with courage equal to Indra, आसीद्: was, वसुमती: Earth, पूर्णा: fully, महद्भिरिव: like great, पादपैः trees
explanation: "The earth was fully filled with Kshatriya heroes of great prowess, equal to Indra in war who stood like trees on earth."

shloka_text: तेषांवीर्यगुणोत्साहैर्नसमोराघवोरणे । प्रसह्यतेत्वयाराजन्हताःसमरदुर्जयाः ।।6.7.19।।
transliteration: teṣāṃvīryaguṇotsāhairnasamorāghavoraṇe | prasahyatetvayārājanhatāḥsamaradurjayāḥ
translation: तेषाम्: to them, वीर्यगुणोत्साहै: valour, excellence and energy, न: not, समो: equal, राघवो: Raghava, प्रसह्य: were overpowered, त्वया: by you, राजन्: King, हता: Killed, समरदुर्जयाः who were difficult to be overpowered.
explanation: "Raghava is not equal to them in valour, excellence and energy. Those warriors who were difficult to overcome by battle were overpowered and killed by you."

shloka_text: तिष्ठवाकिंमहाराजश्रमे णतववानरान् । अयमेकोमहाबाहुरिन्द्रजित्क्षपयिष्यति ।।6.7.20।।
transliteration: tiṣṭhavākiṃmahārājaśrame ṇatavavānarān | ayamekomahābāhurindrajitkṣapayiṣyati
translation: तिष्ठ: you stay, किम्: why, महाराज: Oh great king तव: your, श्रमेण: by exertion, वानरान्: the monkeys, अयम्: this, एको: alone, महाबाहु: strong armed, इन्द्रजित्: Indrajith (Elder son of Ravana) क्षपयिष्यति: can destroy.
explanation: "Oh great king, you stay here calmly. Why exert yourself? This strong armed Indrajith alone can destroy those Vanaras."

shloka_text: अनेनहिमहाराजमहेश्वरमनुत्तमम् । इष्ट्वायज्ञंवरोलब्धोलोकेपरमदुर्लभः ।।6.7.21।।
transliteration: anenahimahārājamaheśvaramanuttamam | iṣṭvāyajñaṃvarolabdholokeparamadurlabhaḥ
translation: अनेन: by him, महाराज: great king, महेश्वर: Lord Maheshwara (Siva), अनुत्तमम्: supreme इष्ट्वायज्ञं: performing sacrifice, लब्धो: obtained, लोके: in the world, परमदुर्लभः very difficult, वरो: boon.
explanation: "Oh Great King By performing supreme sacrifices, Indrajith obtained boons from Lord Maheswara, which are very difficult to get."

shloka_text: शक्तितोमरमीनंचविनिकीर्णान्त्रशैवलम् । गजकछपसम्बाधमश्वमण्डूकसंकुलम् ।।6.7.22।। रुद्रादित्यमहाग्राहंमरुद्वसुमहोरगम् । रथश्वगजतोयौघंपदातिपुलिनंमहत् ।।6.7.23।। अनेनहिसमासाद्यदेवानांबलसागरम् । गृहीतोदैवतपतिर्लङ्कांचापिप्रवेशितः ।।6.7.24।।
transliteration: śaktitomaramīnaṃcavinikīrṇāntraśaivalam | gajakachapasambādhamaśvamaṇḍūkasaṃkulam  rudrādityamahāgrāhaṃmarudvasumahoragam | rathaśvagajatoyaughaṃpadātipulinaṃmahat  anenahisamāsādyadevānāṃbalasāgaram | gṛhītodaivatapatirlaṅkāṃcāpipraveśitaḥ
translation: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.
explanation: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.

explanation: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.

shloka_text: शक्तितोमरमीनंचविनिकीर्णान्त्रशैवलम् । गजकछपसम्बाधमश्वमण्डूकसंकुलम् ।।6.7.22।। रुद्रादित्यमहाग्राहंमरुद्वसुमहोरगम् । रथश्वगजतोयौघंपदातिपुलिनंमहत् ।।6.7.23।। अनेनहिसमासाद्यदेवानांबलसागरम् । गृहीतोदैवतपतिर्लङ्कांचापिप्रवेशितः ।।6.7.24।।
transliteration: śaktitomaramīnaṃcavinikīrṇāntraśaivalam | gajakachapasambādhamaśvamaṇḍūkasaṃkulam  rudrādityamahāgrāhaṃmarudvasumahoragam | rathaśvagajatoyaughaṃpadātipulinaṃmahat  anenahisamāsādyadevānāṃbalasāgaram | gṛhītodaivatapatirlaṅkāṃcāpipraveśitaḥ
translation: शक्ति: a powerful weapon like spear, तोमर: javelin, मीनंच: and fish, विनिकीर्णान्त्र: throwing entrails, शैवलम्: mossa water plant, गज: elephants, कछप: tortoises सम्बाध: connected, अश्व: horses, मण्डूक: frogs, संकुलम्: filled with, रुद्रा: Rudras, आदित्य: Adityas, महाग्राहं: huge alligator, मरुद्व: Marudas, सुमहोरगम्: huge serpents, रथश्व: Chariots tied to horses, गज: elephants, तोयौघं: volume of water, पदाति: footsoldiers, पुलिनं: sand beaches, महत्: large, अनेनहि: by him, समासाद्य: encountered, देवानां: of Devas, बलसागरम्: great ocean of army, गृहीतो: captured, दैवतपति: Lord of Devas (Indra), लङ्काच: in Lanka, प्रवेशितः entered.
explanation: Encountering with this army the ocean-like host of the gods—with spears and javelins for fish, scattered entrails for moss, elephants and tortoises, horses and frogs, Rudras and Adityas for huge crocodiles, Maruts and Vasus for great serpents, chariots, horses and elephants for its flood of water, and foot-soldiers for its sandbanks—he captured the lord of the gods, Indra, and brought him into Lanka.

shloka_text: पितामहनियोगाच्चमुक्तःशम्बरवृत्रहा । गतस्त्रिविष्टपम्राजन्सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ।।6.7.25।।
transliteration: pitāmahaniyogāccamuktaḥśambaravṛtrahā | gatastriviṣṭapamrājansarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ
translation: राजन्: king पितामहनियोगाच्च: ordered by creator Brahma, मुक्तः liberated, शम्बरवृत्रहा: the destroyer of Sambara and Vrtra (Indra): सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः adored by all Devas. गतस्त्रिविष्ट: returned to heaven.
explanation: "Liberated by the command of creator Brahma, Indra the destroyer of Sambara and Vrtra entered heaven was adorned and greeted by all Devas."

shloka_text: ततोनीलाम्बुदनिभ: प्रहस्तोनामराक्षसः । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंशूरस्सेनापतिस्तदा ।।6.8.1।।
transliteration: tatonīlāmbudanibha: prahastonāmarākṣasaḥ | abravītprāñjalirvākyaṃśūrassenāpatistadā
translation: ततः then, शूरः hero, सेनापतिः chief of army, नीलाम्बुदनिभ: one whose body is like dark cloud, प्रहस्तोनाम: called Prahastha, राक्षसः Rakshasa, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, वाक्यम् these words. अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then a Rakshasa whose body was like a dark cloud, called Prahastha, the heroic chief of the army, spoke these words with folded palms.
comments: Prahastha and others assure Ravana that they will kill Rama and others.

shloka_text: देवदानवगन्धर्वाःपिशाचपतगोरगाः । नत्वांधर्षयितुंशक्याःकिंपुनर्वानरारणे ।।6.8.2।।
transliteration: devadānavagandharvāḥpiśācapatagoragāḥ | natvāṃdharṣayituṃśakyāḥkiṃpunarvānarāraṇe
translation: देवदानवगन्धर्वाः Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, पिशाचपतगोरगाः Devils, birds and even serpents, सर्वे: all, रणे: in war, धर्षयितुम् to face you, नशक्याः not possible, वानरा: Vanaras, किंपुनः What to say.
explanation: "Even Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Devils, birds, and serpents, cannot face you in war. What to say of Vanaras?"

shloka_text: सर्वेप्रमत्ताविश्वस्तावञ्चितास्स्महनूमता । नहिमेजीवतोगच्छेज्जीवन् सवनगोचरः ।।6.8.3।।
transliteration: sarvepramattāviśvastāvañcitāssmahanūmatā | nahimejīvatogacchejjīvan savanagocaraḥ
translation: अप्रमत्ता: inattentive, विश्वस्ताः confident, सर्वे: all of us, हनूमता: Hanuman, वञ्चिताःस्म: cheated us, मे: when I, जीवतः living, सः he, वनगोचरः wanderer of woods, जीवन् with life, नगच्छेत् हि: will not go.
explanation: All of us were inattentive and confident (of our ability) while Hanuman cheated us. When I am alive how will the wanderer of woods (Hanuman) go with life?

shloka_text: सर्वांसागरपर्यन्तांसशैलवनकाननाम् । करोम्यवानरांभूमिमाज्ञापयतुमांभवान् ।।6.8.4।।
transliteration: sarvāṃsāgaraparyantāṃsaśailavanakānanām | karomyavānarāṃbhūmimājñāpayatumāṃbhavān
translation: सागरपर्यन्ताम् all over the ocean, सशैलवनकाननाम् in the mountains and forests, सर्वाम् entire, भूमिम् the earth, अवानराम् rid of Vanaras, करोमि: will do, भवान् your, माम् me, आज्ञापयतु: if you order
explanation: "I will make all the oceans, mountains, forests or even the entire earth rid of Vanaras if you order me."

shloka_text: रक्षांचैवविधास्यामिवानराद्रजनीचर । नागमिष्यतितेदुःखंकिञ्चिदात्मापराधजम् ।।6.8.5।।
transliteration: rakṣāṃcaivavidhāsyāmivānarādrajanīcara | nāgamiṣyatiteduḥkhaṃkiñcidātmāparādhajam
translation: रजनीचर: O night ranger (Ravana), वानरात् by these Vanaras, रक्षांचैव: will protect, विधास्यामि: I will arrange, ते: by you, आत्मापराधजम् your own wrong action, दुःखम् grief, किञ्चित् even a little, नागमिष्यति: not undergo
explanation: "O night ranger (Ravana) I will arrange the protection (of this Lanka) from these Vanaras. For your own wrong action (of abducting Sita) you cannot undergo suffering."

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्चसुसङ्कृद्धोदुर्मुखोनामराक्षसः । इदंनक्षमणीयंहिसर्वेषांनःप्रधर्षणम् ।।6.8.6।।
transliteration: abravīccasusaṅkṛddhodurmukhonāmarākṣasaḥ | idaṃnakṣamaṇīyaṃhisarveṣāṃnaḥpradharṣaṇam
translation: दुर्मुखोनाम: called Durmukha, राक्षसः Rakshasa, सुसङ्कृद्ध: feeling very angry, च: and, अब्रवीत् said, नः nay, सर्वेषाम् for all of us, इदम् this, प्रधर्षणम् shame, नक्षमणीयंहि: not deserve to be excused.
explanation: Feeling very angry, a Rakshasa called Durmukha said, "He who has caused shame for all of us does not deserve to be excused."

shloka_text: अयंपरिभवोभूयःपुरस्यान्तःपुरस्यच । श्रीमतोराक्षसेन्द्रस्यवानरेणप्रधर्षणम् ।।6.8.7।।
transliteration: ayaṃparibhavobhūyaḥpurasyāntaḥpurasyaca | śrīmatorākṣasendrasyavānareṇapradharṣaṇam
translation: पुरस्य: to Lanka, अन्तःपुरस्यच: and to the royal residence, अयम् this, परिभवः despising, श्रीमतः one who is prosperous, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य: to the Lord of Rakshasas, वानरेण: by Vanara, प्रधर्षणम् assaulting, भूयः Furthermore.
explanation: "Furthermore, this assault by a Vanara on Lanka, to the royal residence, and to the prosperous Lord of Rakshasas is despising."

shloka_text: अस्मिन् मुहूर्तेगत्वैकोनिवर्तिष्यामिवानरान् । प्रविष्टान् सागरंभीममम्बरंवारसातलम् ।।6.8.8।।
transliteration: asmin muhūrtegatvaikonivartiṣyāmivānarān | praviṣṭān sāgaraṃbhīmamambaraṃvārasātalam
translation: अस्मिन् this, मुहूर्ते: very minute, एकः alone, गत्व: going, सागरम् ocean, भीमम् terrific, रसातलम् the underworld, अम्बरंवा: or the upper world, प्रविष्टान् entering, वानरान् the monkey, निवर्तिष्यामि: I will put an end.
explanation: At this very minute I will go alone into the terrific ocean, to the underworld or the upper world and on entering put an end to the monkey.

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीत्सुसङ्कृद्धोवज्रदंष्ट्रोमहाबलः । प्रगृह्यपरिघंघोरंमांसशोणितरूषितम् ।।6.8.9।।
transliteration: tato'bravītsusaṅkṛddhovajradaṃṣṭromahābalaḥ | pragṛhyaparighaṃghoraṃmāṃsaśoṇitarūṣitam
translation: ततः then, महाबल: mighty, वज्रदंष्ट्रः one who has diamond like strong teeth, सुसङ्कृद्ध: highly enraged, मांसशोणितरूषितम् stained with flesh and blood, घोरम् dreadful, परिघम् iron bludgeon, प्रगृह्य: clasping, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then a mighty strong one who was endowed with diamond like teeth highly enraged, clasping a dreadful iron bludgeon stained with flesh and blood spoke.

shloka_text: किंवोहनुमताकार्यंकृपणेनतपस्विना । रामेतिष्ठतिदुर्धर्षेससुग्रीवेऽपिसलक्ष्मणे ।।6.8.10।।
transliteration: kiṃvohanumatākāryaṃkṛpaṇenatapasvinā | rāmetiṣṭhatidurdharṣesasugrīve'pisalakṣmaṇe
translation: दुर्धर्षे: one who is unassailable, रामे: while Rama, सलक्ष्मणे: along with Lakshmana, ससुग्रीवेऽपि: and also Sugriva, तिष्ठति: is there, कृपणेन: pitiable तपस्विना: helpless, हनुमता: with Hanuman, व: for us, कार्यम् work, किम् what.
explanation: "While unassailable Rama is there, along with Lakshmana and Sugriva, what have we to do with miserable, pitiable and helpless Hanuman?"

shloka_text: अद्यरामंससुग्रीवंपरिघेणसलक्ष्मणम् । आगमिष्यामिहत्वैकोविक्षोभ्यहरिवाहिनीम् ।।6.8.11।।
transliteration: adyarāmaṃsasugrīvaṃparigheṇasalakṣmaṇam | āgamiṣyāmihatvaikovikṣobhyaharivāhinīm
translation: अद्य: now, एकः alone, परिघेण: by the iron crow bar, ससुग्रीववम् that Sugriva, सलक्ष्मणम् and that Lakshmana, रामम् and Rama also, हत्वा: killing, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, विक्षोभ्य: after shattering, आगमिष्यामि: would return.
explanation: "Now I would go alone and with the iron crowbar, kill Sugriva Lakshmana and Rama and return after shattering the Vanara troops."

shloka_text: इदंममापरंवाक्यंशृणुराजन् यदीच्छसि । उपायकुशलोह्येवजयेच्छत्रूनतन्द्रितः ।।6.8.12।।
transliteration: idaṃmamāparaṃvākyaṃśṛṇurājan yadīcchasi | upāyakuśalohyevajayecchatrūnatandritaḥ
translation: राजन् O king, यदिइच्छसि: if you like, मम: my, अपरम् another, इदंवाक्यम् this statement, शृणु: you listen, उपायकुशलःएव: only one who is cunning, अतन्द्रितः one who is vigilant, शत्रून् enemy, जयेत् हि: would win.
explanation: "O King If you like, listen to my other statement: One who is cunning and is vigilant would win over an enemy."

shloka_text: कामरूपधराश्शूरास्सुभीमाभीमदर्शनाः । राक्षसावैसहस्राणिराक्षसाधिपनिश्चिताः ।।6.8.13।। काकुत्स्थमुपसङ्गम्यबिभ्रतोमानुषंवपुः । सर्वेह्यसम्भ्रमाभूत्वाब्रुवन्तुरघुसत्तमम् ।।6.8.14।।
transliteration: kāmarūpadharāśśūrāssubhīmābhīmadarśanāḥ | rākṣasāvaisahasrāṇirākṣasādhipaniścitāḥ  kākutsthamupasaṅgamyabibhratomānuṣaṃvapuḥ | sarvehyasambhramābhūtvābruvanturaghusattamam
translation: राक्षसाधिप: Lord of Rakshasas, कामरूपधराः one who is capable of assuming any form at free will, शूराः hero, सुभीमाः very fearful, भीमदर्शनाः of frightful appearance, सहस्राणि: thousands of, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, निश्चिताः determined, मानुषम् human, वपुः body, बिभ्रतः wearing, काकुत्स्थम् of Kakutstha dynasty, उपसङ्गम्य: going near, सर्वे: all, असम्भ्रमाः without any agitation, रघुसत्तमम् the foremost of Raghu dynasty, ब्रुवन्तु: should tell.
explanation: "O Lord of Rakshasas Thousands of fearful Rakshasas capable of assuming any form at free will, heroic ones of frightful appearance should tell Rama the foremost of Raghus, quietly going near him in human form."

shloka_text: कामरूपधराश्शूरास्सुभीमाभीमदर्शनाः । राक्षसावैसहस्राणिराक्षसाधिपनिश्चिताः ।।6.8.13।। काकुत्स्थमुपसङ्गम्यबिभ्रतोमानुषंवपुः । सर्वेह्यसम्भ्रमाभूत्वाब्रुवन्तुरघुसत्तमम् ।।6.8.14।।
transliteration: kāmarūpadharāśśūrāssubhīmābhīmadarśanāḥ | rākṣasāvaisahasrāṇirākṣasādhipaniścitāḥ  kākutsthamupasaṅgamyabibhratomānuṣaṃvapuḥ | sarvehyasambhramābhūtvābruvanturaghusattamam
translation: राक्षसाधिप: Lord of Rakshasas, कामरूपधराः one who is capable of assuming any form at free will, शूराः hero, सुभीमाः very fearful, भीमदर्शनाः of frightful appearance, सहस्राणि: thousands of, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, निश्चिताः determined, मानुषम् human, वपुः body, बिभ्रतः wearing, काकुत्स्थम् of Kakutstha dynasty, उपसङ्गम्य: going near, सर्वे: all, असम्भ्रमाः without any agitation, रघुसत्तमम् the foremost of Raghu dynasty, ब्रुवन्तु: should tell.
explanation: "O Lord of Rakshasas Thousands of fearful Rakshasas capable of assuming any form at free will, heroic ones of frightful appearance should tell Rama the foremost of Raghus, quietly going near him in human form."

shloka_text: प्रेषिताभरतेनैवभ्रात्रातवयवीयसा । सहिसेनांसमुत्थाप्यक्षिप्रमेवोपयास्यति ।।6.8.15।।
transliteration: preṣitābharatenaivabhrātrātavayavīyasā | sahisenāṃsamutthāpyakṣipramevopayāsyati
translation: तव: your, यवीयसा: younger, भ्रात्रा: brother, भरतेनैव: by Bharata, प्रेषिताः sent by, सः he, सेनाम् army, समुत्थाप्य: taking, क्षिप्रमेव: very soon, उपस्थास्यति: is coming.
explanation: "'We have been sent by your younger brother Bharata and he is coming here very soon with the army."

shloka_text: ततोवयमितस्तूर्णंशूलशक्तिगदाधराः । चापबाणासिहस्ताश्चत्वरितास्तत्रयामहे ।।6.8.16।।
transliteration: tatovayamitastūrṇaṃśūlaśaktigadādharāḥ | cāpabāṇāsihastāścatvaritāstatrayāmahe
translation: ततः then, वयम् we, शूलशक्तिगदाधराः tridents, javelins and maces, चापबाणासि: swords and arrows, हस्ताश्च: wielding, इतः from here, तूर्णम् soon, तत्र: there, त्वरिताः quickly, यामहे: will go.
explanation: "Then from here we will go there wielding tridents, javelins, maces, swords and arrows."

shloka_text: आकाशेगणशस्थ्सित्वाहत्वातांहरिवाहिनीम् । अश्मशस्त्रमहावृष्ट्याप्रापयामयमक्षयम् ।।6.8.17।।
transliteration: ākāśegaṇaśasthsitvāhatvātāṃharivāhinīm | aśmaśastramahāvṛṣṭyāprāpayāmayamakṣayam
translation: आकाशे: from the sky, गणशः in groups, स्थित्वा: staying there, ताम् those, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, अश्मशस्त्रमहावृष्ट्या: astras, sastras, boulders, हत्वा: killing, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama, प्रापयाम: will send
explanation: Staying in the sky in groups, we will rain astras, sastras and boulders on the Vanara troops and on killing them, we shall send them to the abode of God of death.

shloka_text: एवंचेदुपसर्पेतामनयंरामलक्ष्मणौ । अवश्यमपनीतेनजहतामेवजीवितम् ।।6.8.18।।
transliteration: evaṃcedupasarpetāmanayaṃrāmalakṣmaṇau | avaśyamapanītenajahatāmevajīvitam
translation: रामलक्ष्मणौ: Rama and Lakshmana, एवम् that way, अनयम् distressed, उपसर्पेतांयदि: they will succumb, अवश्यमेव: certainly, अपनीतेन: cunning ways, जीवितम्: life, जहतामेव: giving up.
explanation: "When Rama and Lakshmana are distressed that way, they would certainly succumb to our cunning ways and give up life."

shloka_text: कौम्भकर्णिस्ततोवीरोनिकुम्भोनामवीर्यवान् । अब्रवीत्परमक्रुद्धोरावणंलोकरावणम् ।।6.8.19।।
transliteration: kaumbhakarṇistatovīronikumbhonāmavīryavān | abravītparamakruddhorāvaṇaṃlokarāvaṇam
translation: ततः thereafter, कौम्भकर्णिः Son of Kumbhakarna, वीरः hero, वीर्यवान् valiant, निकुम्भोनाम: called Nikumbha, परमक्रुद्ध: highly enraged, लोकरावणम् one who makes the world cry, रावणम् Ravana, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Thereafter the enraged heroic and valiant son of Kumbhakarna called Nikumbha said to Ravana, who made the world cry.

shloka_text: सर्वेभवन्तस्तिष्ठन्तुमहाराजेनसङ्गताः । अहमेकोहनिष्यामिराघवंसहलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.8.20।। सुग्रीवञ्चहनूमन्तंसर्वांनेवचवानरान् ।
transliteration: sarvebhavantastiṣṭhantumahārājenasaṅgatāḥ | ahamekohaniṣyāmirāghavaṃsahalakṣmaṇam  sugrīvañcahanūmantaṃsarvāṃnevacavānarān |
translation: भवन्तः of you, सर्वे: all, महाराजेन: King's, सङ्गताः along with, तिष्ठन्तु: stay here, अहम् I, एकः alone, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, राघवम् that Rama, सहानूमन्तम् and with Hanuman, सुग्रीवंच: Sugriva also, सर्वानेव: everyone, वानरान्: those Vanaras, च also, हनिष्यामि will kill.
explanation: "Let all of you stay here along with the king. Going alone I will kill Rama along with Lakshmana, and Hanuman also Sugriva and all of the Vanaras."

shloka_text: ततोवज्रहनुर्नामराक्षसःपर्वतोपमः ।।6.8.21।। क्रुद्ध: परिलिहन्सृक्कांजिह्वयावाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: tatovajrahanurnāmarākṣasaḥparvatopamaḥ  kruddha: parilihansṛkkāṃjihvayāvākyamabravīt |
translation: ततः then, पर्वतोपमः one of mountain like form, वज्रहनुर्नाम Vajrahanu, राक्षसः Rakshasa, क्रुद्ध: angry, जिह्वया: with tongue, सृक्काम् lips, परिलिहन् licking, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Then a Rakshasa called Vajrahanu, mountain like in form, enraged, licking lips with his tongue said these words.

shloka_text: स्वैरंकुर्वन्तुकर्माणिभवन्तोविगतज्वराः ।।6.8.22।। एकोऽहंभक्षयिष्यामितांसर्वांहरियूथपान् । स्वस्थाःक्रीडन्तुनिश्चिन्ताःपिबन्तुमधुवारुणीम् ।।6.8.23।।
transliteration: svairaṃkurvantukarmāṇibhavantovigatajvarāḥ  eko'haṃbhakṣayiṣyāmitāṃsarvāṃhariyūthapān | svasthāḥkrīḍantuniścintāḥpibantumadhuvāruṇīm
translation: भवन्तः all of you, विगतज्वराः giving up fear, स्वैरम् freely, कर्माणि: duties कुर्वन्तु: doing, स्वस्थाः moving happily, क्रीडन्तु: sporting, निश्चिन्ताः without any anxiety, वारुणंमधु: sweet wine, पिबन्तु: drinking, अहम् I, एकः single handed, ताम् them, सर्वाम् all, हरियूथपान् Vanara army, भक्षयिष्यामि: will consume.
explanation: All of you giving up fear, do your duties freely move happily sporting and drinking sweet wine. Single handed, I will consume all the Vanara army.

shloka_text: स्वैरंकुर्वन्तुकर्माणिभवन्तोविगतज्वराः ।।6.8.22।। एकोऽहंभक्षयिष्यामितांसर्वांहरियूथपान् । स्वस्थाःक्रीडन्तुनिश्चिन्ताःपिबन्तुमधुवारुणीम् ।।6.8.23।।

shloka_text: अहमेकोवधिष्यामिसुग्रीवंसहलक्ष्मणम् । साङ्गदंचहनूमन्तंरामंचरणकुञ्जरम् ।।6.8.24।।
transliteration: ahamekovadhiṣyāmisugrīvaṃsahalakṣmaṇam | sāṅgadaṃcahanūmantaṃrāmaṃcaraṇakuñjaram
translation: अहम् I, एकः alone, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवम् and Sugriva, साङ्गदम् that Angada, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, रणकुञ्जरम् army, रामम् च: and Rama, वधिष्यामि: will kill.
explanation: "I alone will kill that Rama with Lakshmana, Sugriva, that Angada, Hanuman and the Vanara army." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततोनिकुम्भोरभसस्सूर्यशत्रुर्महाबलः । सुप्तघ्नोयज्ञहारक्षोमहापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।।6.9.1।। अग्निकेतुश्चदुर्धर्षोरश्मिकेतुश्चराक्षस: । इन्द्रजिच्चमहातेजाबलवान्रावणात्मजः ।।6.9.2।। प्रहस्तोऽथविरूपाक्षोवज्रदंष्ट्रोमहाबलः । धूम्राक्षश्चातिकायश्चदुर्मुखश्चैवराक्षसः ।।6.9.3।। परिघान्पट्टिशान्प्रासान्शक्तिशूलपरश्वधान् । चापानिचसबाणानिखङ्गांश्चविपुलान्शितान् ।।6.9.4।। प्रगृह्यपरमक्रुद्धास्समुत्पत्यचराक्षसाः । अब्रुवन्रावणंसर्वेप्रदीप्ताइवतेजसा ।।6.9.5।।
transliteration: tatonikumbhorabhasassūryaśatrurmahābalaḥ | suptaghnoyajñahārakṣomahāpārśvamahodarau  agniketuścadurdharṣoraśmiketuścarākṣasa: | indrajiccamahātejābalavānrāvaṇātmajaḥ  prahasto'thavirūpākṣovajradaṃṣṭromahābalaḥ | dhūmrākṣaścātikāyaścadurmukhaścaivarākṣasaḥ  parighānpaṭṭiśānprāsānśaktiśūlaparaśvadhān | cāpānicasabāṇānikhaṅgāṃścavipulānśitān  pragṛhyaparamakruddhāssamutpatyacarākṣasāḥ | abruvanrāvaṇaṃsarvepradīptāivatejasā
translation: ततः then, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, रभसः Rshaba, महाबलः mighty strong, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, सुप्तघ्नः Supthagna, यज्ञहरक्षो: Yagna raksha, महापार्शो: Mahaparsva, महोदरौ: Mahodara, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च: Agnikethu, रश्मिकेतुश्च: Rasmikethu, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, ततः Further, बलवन् powerful, रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, महाबलः powerful, इन्द्रजिच्च: and Indrajith, प्रहस्तोऽथ: Prahastha, विरूपाक्षो: Virupaksha, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraaksha, अथ: and also, दुर्मुखश्चैव: Durmukha also, राक्षसः Rakshasas, पट्टिशान् iron bars, शूलान् tridents, प्रासान् battle axes, शक्ति: power, परश्वथान् and axes, सुबाणानि: good arrows, चापानि: bows, विपुलान्शितान् very sharp, खङ्गांश्च: swords, प्रगृह्य: wielding, परमक्रुद्धा: highly enraged, तेजसा: bright, प्रदीप्ताः glowing like fire, व: those, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, समुत्पत्य: rising up, रावणम् at Ravana, अब्रुवन् said.
explanation: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.
comments: Vibheeshana begins to advise the Rakshasas and Ravana.

transliteration: tatonikumbhorabhasassūryaśatrurmahābalaḥ | suptaghnoyajñahārakṣomahāpārśvamahodarau  agniketuścadurdharṣoraśmiketuścarākṣasa: | indrajiccamahātejābalavānrāvaṇātmajaḥ  prahasto'thavirūpākṣovajradaṃṣṭromahābalaḥ | dhūmrākṣaścātikāyaścadurmukhaścaivarākṣasaḥ  parighānpaṭṭiśānprāsānśaktiśūlaparaśvadhān | cāpānicasabāṇānikhaṅgāṃścavipulānśitān  pragṛhyaparamakruddhāssamutpatyacarākṣasāḥ | abruvanrāvaṇaṃsarvepradīptāivatejasā
translation: ततः then, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, रभसः Rshaba, महाबलः mighty strong, सूर्यशत्रुः Suryasatru, सुप्तघ्नः Supthagna, यज्ञहरक्षो: Yagna raksha, महापार्शो: Mahaparsva, महोदरौ: Mahodara, दुर्धर्षः Durdarsha, अग्निकेतुश्च: Agnikethu, रश्मिकेतुश्च: Rasmikethu, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, ततः Further, बलवन् powerful, रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, महाबलः powerful, इन्द्रजिच्च: and Indrajith, प्रहस्तोऽथ: Prahastha, विरूपाक्षो: Virupaksha, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraaksha, अथ: and also, दुर्मुखश्चैव: Durmukha also, राक्षसः Rakshasas, पट्टिशान् iron bars, शूलान् tridents, प्रासान् battle axes, शक्ति: power, परश्वथान् and axes, सुबाणानि: good arrows, चापानि: bows, विपुलान्शितान् very sharp, खङ्गांश्च: swords, प्रगृह्य: wielding, परमक्रुद्धा: highly enraged, तेजसा: bright, प्रदीप्ताः glowing like fire, व: those, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, समुत्पत्य: rising up, रावणम् at Ravana, अब्रुवन् said.
explanation: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.
comments: Vibheeshana begins to advise the Rakshasas and Ravana.

explanation: Then Nikumbha, Rshabha, mighty Suryasatru, Supthagna, Yagnaha raksha, Mahaparva, Mahodaro, Durdarsha, Agnikethu, Rasmikethu Rakshasas, Further Ravana's own son powerful Indrajith, Virupaksha and Prahasta, and mighty Rakshasas Vajradamshtra, Dumraaksha and also Durmukha of huge body holding iron bars, tridents, battle axes, bows and sharp arrows, very sharp swords, got up, highly enraged and all Rakshasas glowing like fire addressed Ravana.
comments: Vibheeshana begins to advise the Rakshasas and Ravana.

shloka_text: अद्यरामंवधिष्यामस्सुग्रीवंसचलक्ष्मणम् । कृपणंचहनूमन्तंलङ्कायेनप्रधर्षिता ।।6.9.6।।
transliteration: adyarāmaṃvadhiṣyāmassugrīvaṃsacalakṣmaṇam | kṛpaṇaṃcahanūmantaṃlaṅkāyenapradharṣitā
translation: रामम् Rama, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवंच: and Sugriva, येन: on which account, लङ्का: Lanka, प्रधर्षिता: was attacked, कृपणम् vile, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, अद्य: now, वधिष्यामः will kill.
explanation: "Right now, we will kill Rama along with Lakshmana, Sugriva and vile Hanuman, on whose account Lanka was attacked."

shloka_text: तान्गृहीतायुधान् सर्वान्वारयित्वाविभीषणः । अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंपुनःप्रत्युपवेश्यतान् ।।6.9.7।।
transliteration: tāngṛhītāyudhān sarvānvārayitvāvibhīṣaṇaḥ | abravītprāñjalirvākyaṃpunaḥpratyupaveśyatān
translation: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, गृहीतायुधान् wielding arms, तान् सर्वान् all those, वारयित्वा: stopping, तान् those, प्रत्युपवेश्य: and making them sit, प्राञ्जलिः with folded palms, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् addressed.
explanation: With folded hands, Vibheeshana made all the (Rakshasas) wielding arms to stop and sit and addressed these words to Ravana.

shloka_text: अप्युपायैस्त्रिभिस्तातयोऽर्थःप्राप्तुंनशक्यते । तस्यविक्रमकालांस्तान्युक्तानाहुर्मनीषिणः ।।6.9.8।।
transliteration: apyupāyaistribhistātayo'rthaḥprāptuṃnaśakyate | tasyavikramakālāṃstānyuktānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
translation: तात: father, यः one who takes, अर्थः I ask, त्रिभिः of the three (Sama, Dana and Bheda), उपायैरपि: means also, प्राप्तम् attained, नशक्यते: not possible, तस्य: his, विक्रमकालान् heroic deed, युक्तान् diligently, मनीषिणः intelligent, आहुः yes.
explanation: "Dear father, intelligent people say that an act which cannot be accomplished by the three means (Sama  Conciliation, Dana  Gift, Bheda  Sowing dissension), should only be accomplished diligently by one's heroic deed. Therefore, we should think of war only after the above three means are employed."

shloka_text: प्रमत्तेष्यभियुक्तेषुदैवेनप्रहतेषुच । विक्रमास्तातसिध्यन्तिपरीक्ष्यविधिनाकृताः ।।6.9.9।।
transliteration: pramatteṣyabhiyukteṣudaivenaprahateṣuca | vikramāstātasidhyantiparīkṣyavidhinākṛtāḥ
translation: तात: father, प्रमत्तेषु: at those who are not alert, अभियुक्तेषु: at those who are attacked, दैवेन: by fate, प्रहतेषुच: those who are struck, परीक्ष्य: examine, विधिना: according to prescribed method, कृताः one who performed deeds, विक्रमाः of heroic valour, सिध्यन्ति: will succeed.
explanation: "O Dear at those who are not alert, who are attacked by the enemy, and who are struck by fate, if you examine diligently according to prescribed method and perform deeds of heroic valour you will succeed."

shloka_text: अप्रमत्तंकथंतंतुविजिगीषुंबलेस्थितम् । जितरोषंदुराधर्षतंप्रधर्षयितुमिच्छथ ।।6.9.10।।
transliteration: apramattaṃkathaṃtaṃtuvijigīṣuṃbalesthitam | jitaroṣaṃdurādharṣataṃpradharṣayitumicchatha
translation: अप्रमत्तम् very attentive, विजिगीषुम् bent on victory, बले: mighty, स्थितम् steadfast, जितरोषम् subdued anger, दुराधर्षम् unassailable, तम् him, कथम् how, प्रधर्षयितुम् to overpower, इच्छथ: desire.
explanation: "How do you wish to overpower, him who is very attentive, bent on victory, mighty, steadfast, has subdued anger and unassailable?"

shloka_text: समुद्रंलङ्घयित्वातुघोरंनदनदीपतिम् । गतिंहनूमतोलोकेकोविद्यात्तर्कयेतवा ।।6.9.11।।
transliteration: samudraṃlaṅghayitvātughoraṃnadanadīpatim | gatiṃhanūmatolokekovidyāttarkayetavā
translation: नदनदीपतिम् Lord of streams and rivers, घोरम् terrific, समुद्रम् ocean, लङ्घयित्वा: crossed over, हनुमतः Hanuman, गतिम् arrived at, लोके: in the world, कः who can ever, विद्यात् can know, तर्कयेतवा: or think of.
explanation: "Hanuman has crossed over the ocean, a Lord of streams and rivers and arrived. Who can ever know or think of such a task in this world?"

shloka_text: बलान्यपरिमेयानिवीर्याणिचनिशाचराः । परेषांसहसाऽवज्ञानकर्तव्याकथञ्चन ।।6.9.12।।
transliteration: balānyaparimeyānivīryāṇicaniśācarāḥ | pareṣāṃsahasā'vajñānakartavyākathañcana
translation: निशाचराः night ranger, परेषाम् enemy's, बलानि: strength, वीर्याणिच: and valour, अपरिमेयानि: inestimable, कथञ्चन: to relate, सहसा: rashly, अवज्ञा: to disregard, नकर्तव्या: not do.
explanation: "Enemy's strength and valour is inestimable to relate. Do not disregard rashly, O Night ranger"

shloka_text: किंचराक्षसराजस्यरामेणापकृतंपुरा । आजहारजनस्थानाद्यस्यभार्यांयशस्विनः ।।6.9.13।।
transliteration: kiṃcarākṣasarājasyarāmeṇāpakṛtaṃpurā | ājahārajanasthānādyasyabhāryāṃyaśasvinaḥ
translation: यशस्विनः glorious, यस्य: his, भार्याम् wife, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, आजहार: abducted, रामेण: Rama's, पुरा: earlier, राक्षसराजस्य: to the Rakshasa king, किम् why, अपकृतम् offence.
explanation: "What offence did Rama do earlier to the Rakshasa king that he abducted the glorious wife of Rama from Janasthana?"

shloka_text: खरोयद्यतिवृत्तस्तुरामेणनिहतोरणे । अवश्यंप्राणिनांप्राणारक्षितव्यायथाबलम् ।।6.9.14।।
transliteration: kharoyadyativṛttasturāmeṇanihatoraṇe | avaśyaṃprāṇināṃprāṇārakṣitavyāyathābalam
translation: अतिवृत्तः acted beyond his limit, खरः Khara, रणे: in war, रामेण: by Rama, हतःयदि has been killed also, प्राणिना: by living beings, यथाबलम् their own strength, प्राणाः life, अवश्यम् certainly, रक्षितव्याः will have to protect.
explanation: "(It is true) Khara was killed by Rama in war as he acted beyond his limit. Certainly, living beings will have to protect their life with their own strength."

shloka_text: एतन्निमित्तंवैदेहीभयंनस्सुमहद्भवेत् । आहृतासापरित्याज्याकलहार्थेकृतेनकिम् ।।6.9.15।।
transliteration: etannimittaṃvaidehībhayaṃnassumahadbhavet | āhṛtāsāparityājyākalahārthekṛtenakim
translation: एतन्निमित्तम् on account of this reason, नः to us, सुमहत् great, वैदेहीभयम् fear from Vaidehi, भवेत् will have, आहृता: brought, सा: that, परित्याज्या: given away, कलहार्थे: cause of strife, कृतेन: by doing so, किम् why.
explanation: "On account of this, we have a great fear of Vaidehi. She, who was brought here, is to be given away. What is the use of doing anything, which may be the cause of strife?"

shloka_text: नतुक्षमंवीर्यवतातेनधर्मानुवर्तिना । वैरंनिरर्थकंकर्तुंदीयतामस्यमैथिली ।।6.9.16।।
transliteration: natukṣamaṃvīryavatātenadharmānuvartinā | vairaṃnirarthakaṃkartuṃdīyatāmasyamaithilī
translation: वीर्यवता: valorous one, धर्मानुवर्तिना: follower of dharma, तेन: his, निरर्थकम् useless, वैरम् enmity, कर्तुम् to have, नतुक्षमम् not good for us, मैथिली: Mythili, अस्य: to him, दीयताम् give away.
explanation: "To have enmity with a valorous one, a follower of dharma, is useless and not good for us. Give away Mythili to him (Rama)."

shloka_text: यावन्नसगजांसाश्वांबहुरत्नसमाकुलाम् । पुरींदारयतेबाणैर्दीयतामस्यमैथिली ।।6.9.17।।
transliteration: yāvannasagajāṃsāśvāṃbahuratnasamākulām | purīṃdārayatebāṇairdīyatāmasyamaithilī
translation: सगजाम् with elephants, साश्वम् horses, बहुरत्नसमाकुलाम् filled with many gems, पुरीम् city, बाणैः arrows, यावत् all over, नदारयते: before tearing, अस्य: his, मैथिली: Mythili, दीयताम् will give.
explanation: "Before Rama comes with elephants and horses and tears with his arrows, this Lanka filled with abundance of gems, give away Mythili."

shloka_text: यावत्सुघोरामहतीदुर्धर्षाहरिवाहिनी । नावस्कन्दतिनोलङ्कांतावत्सीताप्रदीयताम् ।।6.9.18।।
transliteration: yāvatsughorāmahatīdurdharṣāharivāhinī | nāvaskandatinolaṅkāṃtāvatsītāpradīyatām
translation: सुघोरा: highly dreadful, दुर्धर्षा: formidable, महती: huge, हरिवाहिनी: Vanara troops, यावत् total, नः lest, लङ्काम् Lanka, नावस्कन्दति: surrounds, तावत् before doing anything, सीता: Sita, प्रदीयताम् give away.
explanation: "Lest the highly dreadful, formidable and huge Vanara troops surround all over Lanka. Give away Sita."

shloka_text: विनश्येद्धिपुरीलङ्काशूरास्सर्वेचराक्षसाः । रामस्यदयितापत्नीनस्वयंनयदिदीयते ।।6.9.19।।
transliteration: vinaśyeddhipurīlaṅkāśūrāssarvecarākṣasāḥ | rāmasyadayitāpatnīnasvayaṃnayadidīyate
translation: रामस्य: Rama's, दयिता: dear, स्वयम् his own, पत्नी: wife, नदीयतेयदि: if not given, चलङ्कापुरी: and this Lanka, विनश्येत् हि: will be destroyed, सर्वे: all, राक्षसाश्च: Rakshasas also.
explanation: "If Rama's dear wife is not given, this Lanka will be destroyed and also all Rakshasas."

shloka_text: प्रसादयेत्वांबन्धुत्वात्कुरुष्यवचनंमम । हितंतथ्यमहंब्रूमिदीयतामस्यमैथिली ।।6.9.20।।
transliteration: prasādayetvāṃbandhutvātkuruṣyavacanaṃmama | hitaṃtathyamahaṃbrūmidīyatāmasyamaithilī
translation: बन्धुत्वात् relation, त्वाम् your, प्रसादये: requesting you, मम: my, वचनम् words, कुरुष्य: do as I say, अहम् I, हितम् welfare, तथ्यंतु: for your, ब्रूमि: telling, अस्य: his, मैथिली: Mythili, दीयताम् give away.
explanation: "I am requesting you because you are my relation (brother). Do as I said, as I am telling you for your welfare. Give away Sita."

shloka_text: पुराशरत्सूर्यमरीचिसन्निभान्नवाग्रपुङ्खान् सुदृढान्नृपात्मजः । सृजत्यमोघान्विशिखान्वधायतेप्रदीयतांदशरधायमैथिली ।।6.9.21।।
transliteration: purāśaratsūryamarīcisannibhānnavāgrapuṅkhān sudṛḍhānnṛpātmajaḥ | sṛjatyamoghānviśikhānvadhāyatepradīyatāṃdaśaradhāyamaithilī
translation: नृपात्मजः son of emperor, शरत्सूर्यमरीचिसन्निभान् shining like the autumnal Sun, नवाग्रपुङ्खान् provided with fresh heads and shafts, सुदृढान् solid, आमोघान् unfailing, विशिखान् arrows, ते for your, वधाय: killing, पुरा: before, सृजति: sends forth, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: son of Dasaratha, प्रदीयताम् you may restore.
explanation: "You may restore Rama's Mythili, before the emperor Dasaratha's son sends forth solid unfailing arrows shining like autumnal Sun provided with fresh heads and shafts for killing you."

shloka_text: त्वजस्वकोपंसुखधर्मनाशनंभजस्वधर्मंरतिकीर्तिवर्धनम् । प्रसीदजीवेमसपुत्रबान्धवाःप्रदीयतांदाशरथायमैथिली ।।6.9.22।।
transliteration: tvajasvakopaṃsukhadharmanāśanaṃbhajasvadharmaṃratikīrtivardhanam | prasīdajīvemasaputrabāndhavāḥpradīyatāṃdāśarathāyamaithilī
translation: सुखधर्मनाशनम् happiness will destroy virtues, कोपम् anger, आशु: that, त्यज: give up, रतिकीर्तिवर्धनम् pleasures that enhance fame, धर्मम् righteousness, भजस्व: seek, प्रसीद: pacified, सपुत्रबान्धवाः with sons and relatives, जीवेम: live, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: Dasaratha's son Rama's, प्रदीयताम् restore.
explanation: "Give up that happiness and anger which destroys virtues. Seek pleasures that enhance fame. Be pacified. Live happily with sons and relatives restoring Mythili to Rama, the son of Dasaratha."

shloka_text: विभीषणवच्शुत्वारावणोराक्षसेश्वराः । विसर्जयित्वातान्सर्वान्प्रविवेशस्वकंगृहम् ।।6.9.23।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavacśutvārāvaṇorākṣaseśvarāḥ | visarjayitvātānsarvānpraviveśasvakaṃgṛham
translation: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, तान् those, सर्वान् everything, विसर्जयित्वा: sending away स्वकम् he too, गृहम् home, प्रविवेश: entered.
explanation: Having heard everything that was told by Vibheeshana, the Lord of Rakshasas sent away all and entered his palace. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेनवमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततःप्रत्युषसिप्राप्तेप्राप्तधर्मार्थनिश्चयः । राक्षसाधिपतेर्वेश्मभीमकर्माविभीषणः ।।6.10.1।।
transliteration: tataḥpratyuṣasiprāpteprāptadharmārthaniścayaḥ | rākṣasādhipaterveśmabhīmakarmāvibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, प्राप्तधर्मार्थनिश्चयः determined to relate about righteous and material gains, भीमकर्मा: of fierce task, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युषसि: when morning Sun, प्राप्ते: rose, राक्षसाधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, वेश्म: residence.
explanation: Thereafter, determined to relate about righteous and material gains, Vibheeshana of fierce tasks got up early in the morning when the Sun rose and set himself to go to the residence of Lord of Rakshasas.
comments: Vibheeshana once again goes to Ravana and appeals to him stating about the evil portents.

shloka_text: शैलाग्रचयसङ्काशंशैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । सुविभक्तमहाकक्षंमहाजनपरिग्रहम् ।।6.10.2।।
transliteration: śailāgracayasaṅkāśaṃśailaśṛṅgamivonnatam | suvibhaktamahākakṣaṃmahājanaparigraham
translation: शैलाग्रचयसङ्काशं: like a lofty mountain top with many peaks, शैलशृङ्गमिव: like a summit of a mountain, उन्नतम् supreme, सुविभक्तमहाकक्षम् divided into many spacious sections, महाजनपरिग्रहम् surrounded by many people.
explanation: Like a lofty mountain top, and like a summit of a mountain, Ravana's palace was a supreme one, divided into many spacious sections and surrounded by many people.

shloka_text: मतिमद्भिर्महामात्रैरनुरक्तैरधिष्ठितम् । राक्षसैराप्तपर्याप्तैस्सर्वतःपरिरक्षितम् ।।6.10.3।।
transliteration: matimadbhirmahāmātrairanuraktairadhiṣṭhitam | rākṣasairāptaparyāptaissarvataḥparirakṣitam
translation: मतिमद्भि: wise ones, अनुरक्तै: devoted to their Lord, महामात्रैः great ministers, अधिष्ठितम् commanded by, आप्तपर्याप्तै: competent and trustworthy, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, सर्वतः everywhere, परिरक्षितम् well protected.
explanation: The palace was inhabited by wise ones, and devoted to their Lord and ministers,commanded by trustworthy and competent Rakshasas spread everywhere and well protected.

shloka_text: मत्तमातङ्गनिश्श्वासैर्व्याकुलीकृतमारुतम् । शङ्खघोषमहाघोषंतूर्यनादानुनादितम् ।।6.10.4।।
transliteration: mattamātaṅganiśśvāsairvyākulīkṛtamārutam | śaṅkhaghoṣamahāghoṣaṃtūryanādānunāditam
translation: मत्तमातङ्गनिश्श्वासैः elephants in rut breathing heavily, व्याकुलीकृतमरुतम् filled by tempestuous wind, शङ्खघोषमहाघोषम् echoed by the sound of blowing conchs of the early morning, तूर्यनादानुनादितम् filled with the sounds of drums and trumpets.
explanation: It was filled with elephants in rut breathing heavily, which was like a tempestuous wind around, that echoed by the blowing of conchs of the early morning and filled with the sounds of drums and trumpets.

shloka_text: प्रमदाजनसम्बाधंप्रजल्पितमहापथम् । तप्तकाञ्चननिर्यूहंभूषणोत्तमभूषितम् ।।6.10.5।।
transliteration: pramadājanasambādhaṃprajalpitamahāpatham | taptakāñcananiryūhaṃbhūṣaṇottamabhūṣitam
translation: प्रमदाजनसम्बाधम् filled with women, प्रजल्पितमहापथम् royal path filled with the prattling sounds of gossiping, तप्तकाञ्चननिर्यूहम् shining golden passages, भूषणोत्तमभूषितम् decorated with the best of ornaments.
explanation: (It was) The royal path was filled with women, with prattling sounds of gossiping. It had shining golden passages and decorated with the best of ornaments.

shloka_text: गन्धर्वाणामिवाऽवासमालयंमरुतामिव । रत्नसञ्चयसम्बाधंभवनंभोगिनामिव ।।6.10.6।।
transliteration: gandharvāṇāmivā'vāsamālayaṃmarutāmiva | ratnasañcayasambādhaṃbhavanaṃbhogināmiva
translation: गन्धर्वाणाम् of Gandharvas, आवासम् इव: like the abode, मरुतामिव: of the wind god, आलयम् abode, रत्नसञ्चयसम्बाधम् abounding in the collection of precious gems, भोगिनाम् indulging in enjoyment like Nagas, भवनम् इव: like mansion.
explanation: (It was) like the abode of Gandharvas (the celestial musicians), like an abode of wind god, abounding in collection of precious gems, like the mansion of Nagas indulging  in enjoyment.

shloka_text: तंमहाभ्रमिवाऽदित्यस्तेजोविस्तृतरश्मिमान् । अग्रजस्यालयंवीरःप्रविवेशमहाद्युतिः ।।6.10.7।।
transliteration: taṃmahābhramivā'dityastejovistṛtaraśmimān | agrajasyālayaṃvīraḥpraviveśamahādyutiḥ
translation: महाद्युतिः one of exceptional splendour, वीरः heroic, तेजो: brilliant विस्तृतरश्मिमान् one whose radiance was spread widely, आदित्यः Sun, महाभ्रमिव: highly lustrous, अग्रजस्य: brother's, तम् आलयम् that abode, प्रविवेश: entered.
explanation: Heroic (Vibheeshana) of exceptional splendour, whose brilliance spread widely like the radiance of the highly lustrous Sun entered his brother's abode.

shloka_text: पुण्यान्पुण्याहघोषांश्चवेदविद्भिरुदाहृतान् । शुश्रावसुमहातेजाभ्रातुर्विजयसंश्रितान् ।।6.10.8।।
transliteration: puṇyānpuṇyāhaghoṣāṃścavedavidbhirudāhṛtān | śuśrāvasumahātejābhrāturvijayasaṃśritān
translation: सुमहातेजाः highly effulgent, भ्रातुः for brother, विजयसंश्रितान् desiring propitious day, वेदविद्भि: who are learned in the Vedas, उदाहृतान् uttering, पुण्यान् sacred, पुण्याहघोषान् sounds of sacred mantras, शुश्रावच: heard.
explanation: Highly effulgent (Vibheeshana) heard sounds of recitation of sacred mantras from Vedas uttered by learned ones desiring a propitious day for his brother.

shloka_text: पूजितान् दधिपात्रैश्चसर्पिर्भिस्सुमनोक्षतैः । मन्त्रवेदविदोविप्रान्ददर्शसमहाबलः ।।6.10.9।।
transliteration: pūjitān dadhipātraiścasarpirbhissumanokṣataiḥ | mantravedavidoviprāndadarśasamahābalaḥ
translation: महाबलः mighty, सः he, दधिपात्रैश्च: pots of curd, सर्पिर्भिः clarified butter, सुमनोक्षतैः with yellow rice, पूजितान् worshipped by, मन्त्रवेदविदः learned in vedas and mantras, विप्रान् by brahmins, ददर्श: saw.
explanation: Mighty Vibheeshana saw there, brahmins learned in vedas and mantras, who worshipped with yellow rice, curd, clarified butter and flowers.

shloka_text: सपूज्यमानोरक्षोभिद्दीप्यमानस्स्वतेजसा । आसनस्थंमहाबाहुर्ववन्देधनदानुजम् ।।6.10.10।।
transliteration: sapūjyamānorakṣobhiddīpyamānassvatejasā | āsanasthaṃmahābāhurvavandedhanadānujam
translation: रक्षोभिः by Rakshasas, पूज्यमानः one who is revered, महाबाहुः one with broad shoulders, सः that Ravana, स्वतेजसा: self brilliance, दीप्यमानम् shining, आसनस्थम् seated on his chair, धनदानुजम् brother of Kubera, ववन्दे: greeted with folded palms.
explanation: Vibheeshana, of broad shoulders, who is revered by Rakshasas was shining in his own splendour. He greeted with folded palms, the brother of Kubera (Ravana) seated on his chair.

shloka_text: सराजदृष्टिसम्पन्नमासनंहेमभूषितम् । जगामसमुदाचारंप्रयुज्याचारकोविदः ।।6.10.11।।
transliteration: sarājadṛṣṭisampannamāsanaṃhemabhūṣitam | jagāmasamudācāraṃprayujyācārakovidaḥ
translation: आचारकोविदः learned in traditions, सः that Vibheeshana, समुदाचारम् wellversed in the code of conduct, प्रयुज्यराजदृष्टिसम्पन्नम् blessed by the glance of the king, हेमभूषितम् decorated with gold, आसनम् seat, जगाम: reached.
explanation: Vibheeshana who was learned in traditions and wellversed with code of conduct reached a seat decorated with gold blessed by the glance of the king Ravana.

shloka_text: सरावणंमहात्मानंविजनेमन्त्रिसन्निधौ । उवाचहितमत्यर्थंवचनंहेतुनिश्चितम् ।।6.10.12।।
transliteration: sarāvaṇaṃmahātmānaṃvijanemantrisannidhau | uvācahitamatyarthaṃvacanaṃhetuniścitam
translation: सः he, Vibheeshana, विजने: when none were there, मन्त्रिसन्निधौ: in the presence of ministers, महात्मानम् distinguished one, रावणम् at Ravana, हेतुनिश्चितम् wishing the welfare decidedly, अत्यर्थम् meaningful, हितम् advice, वचनम् words, उवाच: spoke.
explanation: When none other than ministers were present, Vibheeshana spoke these meaningful words to the distinguished Ravana, decidedly wishing for welfare.

shloka_text: प्रसाद्यभ्रातरंजेष्ठंसान्त्वेनोपस्थितक्रमः । देशकालार्थसंवादिदृष्टलोकपरावरः ।।6.10.13।।
transliteration: prasādyabhrātaraṃjeṣṭhaṃsāntvenopasthitakramaḥ | deśakālārthasaṃvādidṛṣṭalokaparāvaraḥ
translation: दृष्टलोकपरावरः one who knew good and bad of the world, सान्त्वेन: in appeasing way, ज्येष्ठंभ्रातरं: to elder brother, प्रसाद्य: propitiated, उपस्थितक्रमः observing the customary traditions, देशकालार्थसंवादि: one who knows the time and place of advice.
explanation: Vibheeshana who knew the good and bad of the world and knew to advice in consonance with place and time said to his elder brother in an appeasing manner, propitiating him observing the customary tradition.

shloka_text: यदाप्रभृतिवैदेहीसम्प्रास्तेमांपुरींतव । तदाप्रभृतिदृश्यन्तेनिमित्तान्यशुभानिनः ।।6.10.14।।
transliteration: yadāprabhṛtivaidehīsamprāstemāṃpurīṃtava | tadāprabhṛtidṛśyantenimittānyaśubhāninaḥ
translation: इमांपुरीं: this city, वैदेही: Vaidehi, यदाप्रभृतिइह: since she has come here, सम्प्राप्ता: observed, तदाप्रभृति: such signs are observed, नः by us, अशुभानि: inauspicious, निमित्तानि: happenings, दृश्यन्ते: are seen.
explanation: "Since Vaidehi has come to this city, inauspicious happenings are seen by us."

shloka_text: सस्फुलिङ्गस्सधूमार्चिस्सधूमकलुषोदयः । मन्त्रसङ्घहुतोऽप्यग्निर्नसम्यगभिवर्थते ।।6.10.15।।
transliteration: sasphuliṅgassadhūmārcissadhūmakaluṣodayaḥ | mantrasaṅghahuto'pyagnirnasamyagabhivarthate
translation: मन्त्रसङ्घहुतःअपि: even the fire sacrifices, अग्निः fire, सस्फुलिङ्गः with fire particles, सधूमार्चिः with smoke, सधूमकलुषोदयः mixed with smoke, सम्यक् well, नाभिवर्धते: not burning with brilliance.
explanation: "Even from the fire of fire sacrifices, fire particles polluted with smoke are rising and the fire is not burning with brilliance."

shloka_text: अग्निष्ठेष्वग्निशलासुतथाब्रह्मस्थालीषुच । सरीसृपाणिदृश्यन्तेहन्येषुचपिपीलिकाः ।।6.10.16।।
transliteration: agniṣṭheṣvagniśalāsutathābrahmasthālīṣuca | sarīsṛpāṇidṛśyantehanyeṣucapipīlikāḥ
translation: अग्निष्ठेषु: in cooking fire, अग्निशालासु: in places of fire sacrifice, तथा: so also, ब्रह्मस्थलीषुच: at places where offerings are made into fire, सरीसृपाणि: serpents, दृश्यन्ते: are seen, हव्येषु: in the Havis, पिपीलिकाः ants are seen.
explanation: "In the cooking fire, in places of fire sacrifice, so also at places where offerings are made into fire, serpents are seen. Ants are seen in the Havis."

shloka_text: गवांसयांसिस्कन्नानिविमदावीरकुञ्जराः । दीनमश्वाःप्रहेषन्तेनचग्रासाभिनन्दिनः ।।6.10.17।।
transliteration: gavāṃsayāṃsiskannānivimadāvīrakuñjarāḥ | dīnamaśvāḥpraheṣantenacagrāsābhinandinaḥ
translation: गवाम् of cows, पयांसि: udder, स्कन्नानि: dried up, वीरकुञ्जराः proud elephants, विमदामः lost their ichor, अश्वाः horses, दीनम् pa the tic, प्रहेषन्ते: neighing, ग्रासाभिनन्दिनः interested in fodder, नच: even not.
explanation: "The udder of cows is dried up, the proud elephants have lost their ichor, the horses are pathetic and neighing. They are not even interested in fodder."

shloka_text: खरोष्ट्राश्वतराराजभनभिन्नरोमास्स्रवन्तिच । नस्वभावेऽवतिष्ठन्तिविधानैरपिचिन्तिताः ।।6.10.18।।
transliteration: kharoṣṭrāśvatarārājabhanabhinnaromāssravantica | nasvabhāve'vatiṣṭhantividhānairapicintitāḥ
translation: राजन् O king, खरोष्ट्रातराः donkeys and camels, भिन्नरोमाः shed their body hair, स्रवन्तिच: crying, विधानैः different kinds, चिन्तिताःअपि: even though treated for, स्वभावे: natural form, नअवतिष्ठन्ति: not getting to be normal.
explanation: "O King the donkeys and camels have shed their body hair and are crying. Even though they are treated for it in different ways they are not getting to be in normal natural form."

shloka_text: वायसाःसङ्घशःक्रूराव्याहरन्तिसमन्ततः । समवेताश्चदृश्यन्तेविमानाग्रेषुसङ्घशः ।।6.10.19।।
transliteration: vāyasāḥsaṅghaśaḥkrūrāvyāharantisamantataḥ | samavetāścadṛśyantevimānāgreṣusaṅghaśaḥ
translation: क्रूराः wild, वायसाः crows, सङ्घश: in flocks, समन्ततः all over, व्याहरन्ति: sounding harsh, विमानाग्रेषु: on the top of aerial chariot, सङ्घशः gathered, समवेताः in groups, दृश्यन्ते: are seen.
explanation: Wild crows are seen in flocks all over the top of aerial chariot sounding harsh gathered in groups.

shloka_text: गृध्राश्चपरिलीयन्तेपुरीमुपरिपिण्डिताः । उपपन्नाश्चस्नध्येद्वेव्याहऱ्नत्यशिवंशिवाः ।।6.10.20।।
transliteration: gṛdhrāścaparilīyantepurīmuparipiṇḍitāḥ | upapannāścasnadhyedvevyāhaṟnatyaśivaṃśivāḥ
translation: गृध्राश्च: even eagles, पुरीमुपरि: over the houses of the capital, पिण्डिताः collected, परिलीयन्ते: repeatedly standing, शिवाः auspicious, द्वेसन्ध्ये: in both morning and evening twilight time, उपपन्नाः coming together, अशिवम् inauspicious, व्याहरन्ति: sounding.
explanation: "Even the eagles are collecting together and standing over the houses of the capital repeatedly in both the auspicious times of morning and evening and making inauspicious sounds."

shloka_text: क्रव्यादानांमृगाणांचपुरीद्वारेषुसङ्घशः । श्रूयन्तेविपुलाघोषास्सविस्फूर्जितनिस्स्वनाः ।।6.10.21।।
transliteration: kravyādānāṃmṛgāṇāṃcapurīdvāreṣusaṅghaśaḥ | śrūyantevipulāghoṣāssavisphūrjitanissvanāḥ
translation: पुरिद्वारेषु: at the entrance of capital, सङ्घशः collected, क्रव्यादानाम् carnivorous, मृगाणाम् animals, सविस्फूर्जिन्तिस्स्वनाः like thunderous sounds, विपुलाः loud, घोषाः noise, श्रूयन्ते: heard.
explanation: At the entrance of the capital are heard thunderous sounds of carnivorous animals collected together sounding like thunder.

shloka_text: तदेवंप्रस्तुतेकार्येप्रायश्चित्तमिदंक्षमम् । रोचतेयदिवैदेहीराघवायप्रदीयताम् ।।6.10.22।।
transliteration: tadevaṃprastutekāryeprāyaścittamidaṃkṣamam | rocateyadivaidehīrāghavāyapradīyatām
translation: यदि: such being, तत् that, एवम् in that way, प्रस्तुते: commenced, कार्ये: task (of burning Lanka), इदम् this is, क्षमम् appropriate, प्रायश्चित्तम् atonement, रोचते: I have thought, वैदेही: Vaidehi, राघवाय: to Rama, प्रदीयताम् restore.
explanation: "Therefore, the task (of burning Lanka) has commenced. I have thought of this appropriate atonement. Restore Vaidehi to Rama."

shloka_text: इदंचयदिवामोहाल्लोभाद्वाव्याहृतंमया । तत्रापिचमहाराज नदोषंकर्तुमर्हसि ।।6.10.23।।
transliteration: idaṃcayadivāmohāllobhādvāvyāhṛtaṃmayā | tatrāpicamahārāja nadoṣaṃkartumarhasi
translation: महाराज: O great king, इदम् this is, मयामोहाद्वा: by my delusion, लोभाद्वा: or greed, व्याहृतंयदि: telling like that, तत्रापि: you ought, दोषम् fault, कर्तुम् finding, नार्हसि: you may know.
explanation: "O great king You may know that I am not telling like this out of my delusion or greed. You ought not to find fault with me."

shloka_text: अयंहिदोषस्सर्वस्यजनस्यास्योपलक्ष्यते । रक्षसांराक्षसीनांचपुरस्यान्तःपुरस्यच ।।6.10.24।।
transliteration: ayaṃhidoṣassarvasyajanasyāsyopalakṣyate | rakṣasāṃrākṣasīnāṃcapurasyāntaḥpurasyaca
translation: आयम् This, दोषः offence, रक्षसाम् for all Rakshasas, राक्षसीनांच: for Rakshasa women also, पुरस्य: of the capital, अन्तःपुरस्यच: even those in the harem, अस्य: there, सर्वस्य: to all, जनस्य: common people, उपलक्ष्यतेहि: are aware of.
explanation: All of us, the Rakshasas and Rakshasa women of the capital, even those in the harem, and all the common people are aware of this offence.

shloka_text: श्रावणेचास्यमन्त्रस्यनिवृत्तास्सर्वमन्त्रिणः । अवश्यंचमयावाच्यंयद्दृष्टमपिवाश्रुतम् ।।6.10.25।। सम्विधाययथान्यायंतद्भवान् कर्तुमर्हति ।
transliteration: śrāvaṇecāsyamantrasyanivṛttāssarvamantriṇaḥ | avaśyaṃcamayāvācyaṃyaddṛṣṭamapivāśrutam  samvidhāyayathānyāyaṃtadbhavān kartumarhati |
translation: अस्य: your, मन्त्रस्य: ministers', श्रावणे: in order to make you hear, सर्वमन्त्रिणः all ministers, निवृत्ताः abstained from, यत् that which, दृष्टम् is seen, अपिवा: and also, श्रुतम् that which is heard, मया: my, अवश्यम् necessarily, वाच्यम् these words, तत् that, भवान् to you, यथान्यायम् that which is justifiable, सम्विधाय: determining the propriety, कर्तुम् I submit, अर्हति: is proper for me.
explanation: All your ministers have abstained from telling you out of fear of you. I must necessarily tell you (as brother) this which is seen and heard. You may determine that which is justifiable by determining the propriety. It is proper for me to submit to you.

shloka_text: इतिस्ममन्त्रिणांमध्येभ्राताभ्रातरमूचिवान् । रावणंराक्षसांश्रेष्ठंपथ्यमेतद्विभीषणः ।।6.11.26।।
transliteration: itismamantriṇāṃmadhyebhrātābhrātaramūcivān | rāvaṇaṃrākṣasāṃśreṣṭhaṃpathyametadvibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: भ्राता: brother, विभीषण: Vibheeshana, स्ममन्त्रिणाम् in the presence of his ministers, भ्रातरम् brother, राक्षसां: among Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठम् eminent, रावणम् to Ravana, इति: thus, पथ्यम् beneficial, एतत् all this, ऊचिवान् tendered advice.
explanation: Brother Vibheeshana thus tendered advice to Ravana, the eminent king of Rakshasas in the presence of his ministers.

shloka_text: हितंमहार्थंमृदुहेतुसंहितंव्यतीतकालायतिसम्प्रतिक्षमम् । निशम्यतद्वाक्यमुपस्थितज्वरःप्रसङ्गवानुत्तरमेतदब्रवीत् ।।6.10.27।।
transliteration: hitaṃmahārthaṃmṛduhetusaṃhitaṃvyatītakālāyatisampratikṣamam | niśamyatadvākyamupasthitajvaraḥprasaṅgavānuttarametadabravīt
translation: प्रसङ्गवान् words of counsel, हितम् welfare, महार्थम् very meaningful, मृदु: gentle, हेतुसंहितम् that which was full of benefit, व्यतीतकालायतिसम्प्रतिक्षमम् that which is beneficial for the past, present and future also, तत् such, वाक्यम् statement, निशम्य: foregoing, उपस्थितज्वरः seized with anger, एतत् this manner, उत्तरम् replied, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Foregoing the beneficial, meaningful, and gentle words of counsel of significance in the past, present and future also (given by Vibheeshana), Ravana seized with anger replied in this manner.

shloka_text: भयंनपश्यामिकुतश्चिदप्यहंनराघवःप्राप्स्यतिजातुमैथिलीम् । सुरैस्सहेन्द्रैरपिसङ्गरेकथंममाग्रतस्स्थास्यतिलक्ष्मणाग्रजः ।।6.10.28।।
transliteration: bhayaṃnapaśyāmikutaścidapyahaṃnarāghavaḥprāpsyatijātumaithilīm | suraissahendrairapisaṅgarekathaṃmamāgratassthāsyatilakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ
translation: अहम् I am, कुतश्चिदपि: of anyone, भयम् fear, नपश्यामि: do not perceive, राघवः Rama, जातु: at any time, मैथिलीम् Mythili, नप्राप्स्यति: will not get, सहेन्द्रेः with Indra, सुरैरपि: with Suras, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, सङ्गरे: in battle, मम: with me, अग्रज: elder brother, कथम् how can, स्थास्यति: withstand.
explanation: "I do not perceive fear from anyone. Rama will not be able to get Mythili at any time. How can the elder brother of Lakshmana withstand me even if Indra and Devatas come (to his help) in battle"

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्त्वासुरसैन्यनाशनोमहाबलस्संयतिचण्डविक्रमः । दशाननोभ्रातरमाप्तवादिनंविसर्जयामासतदाविभीषणम् ।।6.10.29।।
transliteration: ityevamuktvāsurasainyanāśanomahābalassaṃyaticaṇḍavikramaḥ | daśānanobhrātaramāptavādinaṃvisarjayāmāsatadāvibhīṣaṇam
translation: सुरसैन्यनाशनः one who is a destroyer of Devatas army, महाबलः mighty, संयति in war, चण्डविक्रमः of formidable valour, दशाननः tenheaded, इत्येवम् in this way, उक्त्वा: having spoken, आप्तवादिनम् one who gave good advice, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, तदा: then, विसर्जयामास: sent him away.
explanation: Then mighty tenheaded Ravana of formidable valour, a destroyer of Devatas' army in war, sent away Vibheeshana who had spoken words of good advice in that manner. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेवामलीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेदशमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the tenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सबभूवकृशोराजामैथिलीकाममोहितः । असन्मानाच्चसुहृदांपापंपापेनकर्मणा ।।6.11.1।।
transliteration: sababhūvakṛśorājāmaithilīkāmamohitaḥ | asanmānāccasuhṛdāṃpāpaṃpāpenakarmaṇā
translation: मैथिलीकाममोहितः infatuated with passion towards Mythili, सः that, पापं: sinner, राजा: king, सुहृदाम् those who were dear to him, असन्मानाच्च: disregarded, पापेन: on account of sinful, कर्मणा: actions, कृशः weak, बभूव: became.
explanation: Infatuated with passion towards Mythili, disregarded by his dear ones on account of sinful actions, sinner Ravana became weak.
comments: Ravana enters the royal assembly followed by Vibheeshana, Prahastha and others and holds consultations with his ministers.

shloka_text: अतीतसमयेकालेतस्मिन्वैयुधिरावणः । अमात्यैश्चसुहृद्भिश्चप्राप्तकालममन्यत ।।6.11.2।।
transliteration: atītasamayekāletasminvaiyudhirāvaṇaḥ | amātyaiścasuhṛdbhiścaprāptakālamamanyata
translation: रावणः Ravana, तस्मिन् on account of, अतीतसमये: elapsed, काले: time, अमात्यैश्च: with ministers, सुहृद्भिश्च: with his friends, युधि: about war, प्राप्तकालम् right time, अमन्यत: considered for consultation.
explanation: Because of the lapse of time, Ravana considered it imminent to consult with his ministers and friends about war.

shloka_text: सहेमजालविततंमणिविद्रुमभूषितम् । उपगम्यविनीताश्वमारुरोहमहारथम् ।।6.11.3।।
transliteration: sahemajālavitataṃmaṇividrumabhūṣitam | upagamyavinītāśvamārurohamahāratham
translation: सः he (Ravana), हेमजालविततम् overlaid with golden latticework, मणिविद्रुमभूषितम् decked with gems and corals, विनीताश्वम् trained horses,महारथम् magnificent chariot, उपगम्य: having reached, आरुरोह: ascended.
explanation: Ravana, having reached, ascended the magnificent chariot that was overlaid with golden latticework, decked with gems and corals, and yoked to trained horses.

shloka_text: तमास्थायरथश्रेष्ठंमहामेघसमस्वनम् । प्रययौरक्षसांश्रेष्ठोदशग्रीवस्सभांप्रति ।।6.11.4।।
transliteration: tamāsthāyarathaśreṣṭhaṃmahāmeghasamasvanam | prayayaurakṣasāṃśreṣṭhodaśagrīvassabhāṃprati
translation: रक्षसाम् of Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठः eminent, दशग्रीवः tenheaded Ravana, महामेघसमस्वनम् making sound like the roaring noise of a huge cloud, तम् him, रथश्रेष्ठम् best chariot, आस्थाय: climbed up, सभांप्रति: to assembly, प्रययौ: went.
explanation: The tenheaded Ravana, eminent one among Rakshasas climbed up that best of chariots that was making noise like the roaring sound of a huge cloud and went to assembly.

shloka_text: असिचर्मधरायोधास्सर्वायुधधरास्ततः । राक्षसाराक्षसेन्द्रस्यपुरस्तात्सम्प्रतस्थिरे ।।6.11.5।।
transliteration: asicarmadharāyodhāssarvāyudhadharāstataḥ | rākṣasārākṣasendrasyapurastātsampratasthire
translation: ततः then, असिचर्मधराः wielding swords and all kinds of weapons, योधाः soldiers, सर्वायुधधराः different kinds of weapons, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य: Lord of Rakshasas, पुरस्तात् in front, सम्प्रतस्थिरे: stood at that time.
explanation: Then soldiers wielding swords and different kinds of weapons stood in front of the Lord of Rakshasas.

shloka_text: नानाविकृतवेषाश्चनानाभूषणभूषिताः । पार्श्वतस्पृष्ठतश्चैनंपरिवार्यययुस्तत:।। 6.11.6।।
transliteration: nānāvikṛtaveṣāścanānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ | pārśvataspṛṣṭhataścainaṃparivāryayayustata:
translation: नानाविकृतवेषाश्च: adorned in different kinds of uncouth attire, नानाभरणभूषिताः wearing different kinds of ornaments, तत: thereafter, एनम् by his, पार्श्वतः sides, पष्ठतश्चैव: and also back, परिवार्य: surrounding, ययुः went.
explanation: Further (Rakshasas) adorned in different kinds of uncouth attire, wearing different kinds of ornaments went by his side and also at the back.

shloka_text: रथैश्चातिरथाश्शीघ्रंमत्तैश्चवरवारणैः । अनूत्पेतुर्दशग्रीवमाक्रीडद्भिश्चवाजिभिः ।।6.11.7।।
transliteration: rathaiścātirathāśśīghraṃmattaiścavaravāraṇaiḥ | anūtpeturdaśagrīvamākrīḍadbhiścavājibhiḥ
translation: अतिरथाः great charioteers, रथैः chariots, मत्तै: proud elephants, वरवारणैः excellent, आक्रीडद्भिः sporting, वाजिभिश्च: and horses also, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded Ravana, शीघ्रम् swiftly, अनूत्पेतुः followed.
explanation: (Some Rakshasa) Charioteers riding on chariots, some on proud elephants and some on horses sporting away followed the tenheaded Ravana.

shloka_text: गदापरिघहस्ताश्चशक्तितोमरपाणयः । परश्वथधराश्चान्येतथाऽन्येशूलपाणयः ।।6.11.8।।
transliteration: gadāparighahastāścaśaktitomarapāṇayaḥ | paraśvathadharāścānyetathā'nyeśūlapāṇayaḥ
translation: गदापरिघहस्ताश्च: maces and iron bars in their hands, शक्तितोमरपाणयः holding strong iron clubs in hand, परश्वथधराः holding battle axes, अन्ये: others शूलपाणयः with tridents in their hands, अन्येच: and other.
explanation: Some holding maces and iron bars, some holding strong iron clubs in hand, and some others holding battle axes, tridents and other weapons went.

shloka_text: ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणांसञ्जज्ञेनिस्स्वनोमहान् । तुमुलश्शङ्खशब्दश्चसभांगच्छतिरावणे ।।6.11.9।।
transliteration: tatastūryasahasrāṇāṃsañjajñenissvanomahān | tumulaśśaṅkhaśabdaścasabhāṃgacchatirāvaṇe
translation: ततः then, रावणे: as Ravana, सभाम् to the assembly, गच्छति: as he entered, तूर्यसहस्राणाम् thousands of band instruments, महान् high, निस्स्वनः sounded, तुमुलः tumultuous noise, शङ्खशब्दश्च: sounds of conchs, सञ्जज्ञे: broke forth.
explanation: Then as Ravana entered the assembly thousands of band instruments sounded aloud. Conchs broke forth producing tumultuous noise.

shloka_text: सनेमिघोषेणमहान्सहसाऽभिनिनादयन् । राजमार्गंश्रियाजुष्टंप्रतिपेदेमहारथः ।।6.11.10।।
transliteration: sanemighoṣeṇamahānsahasā'bhininādayan | rājamārgaṃśriyājuṣṭaṃpratipedemahārathaḥ
translation: महान् great, सः he, महारथः great chariot, नेमिघोषेण: rattling sound of chariot, अभिनिनादयन् echoed in all directions, श्रिया: bright, जुष्टम् pleasing, राजमार्गम् royal path, सहसा: all at once, प्रतिपेदे: entered.
explanation: As the rattling sounds of the great chariot echoed in all directions, he entered the bright pleasing royal path all at once.

shloka_text: विमलंचातपत्राणांप्रगृहीतमशोभत । पाण्डुरंराक्षसेन्द्रस्यपूर्णस्ताराधिपोयथा ।।6.11.11।।
transliteration: vimalaṃcātapatrāṇāṃpragṛhītamaśobhata | pāṇḍuraṃrākṣasendrasyapūrṇastārādhipoyathā
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रस्य: Lord of Rakshasa's, विमलम् pure, पाण्डुरम् white canopy, प्रगृहीतम् taking hold, आतपत्राणाम् spread like lines, पूर्णः full, ताराथिपो: like the Lord of stars (moon), यथा: like that, अशोभत: was shining.
explanation: The pure white canopy of Ravana held by the Rakshasas spread like lines shone like the Lord of stars (the full moon).

shloka_text: हेममञ्जरिगर्भेचशुद्धस्फटिकविग्रहे । चामरव्यजनेतस्यरेजतुस्सव्यदक्षिणे ।।6.11.12।।
transliteration: hemamañjarigarbhecaśuddhasphaṭikavigrahe | cāmaravyajanetasyarejatussavyadakṣiṇe
translation: हेममञ्जरिगर्भे: with golden bouquet in the middle, शुद्धस्फटिकविग्रहे: pure crystal like handles, चामरव्यजने: a pair of fans, तस्य: its, सव्यदक्षिणे: on left and right side, रेजतुः glowed.
explanation: A pair of fans with pure crystal like handles with a golden bouquet in the middle glowed.

shloka_text: तेकृताञ्जलयस्सर्वेरथस्थंपृथिवीस्थिताः । राक्षसाराक्षसश्रेष्ठंशिरोभिस्तंववन्दिरे ।।6.11.13।।
transliteration: tekṛtāñjalayassarverathasthaṃpṛthivīsthitāḥ | rākṣasārākṣasaśreṣṭhaṃśirobhistaṃvavandire
translation: पृथिवीस्थिताः standing on the ground, सर्वे: all, सतेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, कृताञ्जलयः with folded palms, रथस्थम् seated in the chariot, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् foremost of Rakshasas, तम् him, शिरोभिस्तं: bowing their heads, ववन्दिरे: offered salutations.
explanation: Standing on the ground, all the Rakshasas bowing their heads down and with folded palms offered their salutations to the foremost of the Rakshasas seated in the chariot.

shloka_text: राक्षसैस्त्सूयमानस्सञ्जयाशीर्भिररिन्दमः । आससादमहातेजास्सभांविरचितांतदा ।।6.11.14।।
transliteration: rākṣasaistsūyamānassañjayāśīrbhirarindamaḥ | āsasādamahātejāssabhāṃviracitāṃtadā
translation: तदा: then, अरिन्दमः conqueror of foes, महातेजाः exceptionally splendid, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, जयाशीर्भि: victory to you, prosperity to you', स्तूयमानः having praised, विरचिताम् well built, सभाम् royal court, आससाद: reached.
explanation: Then as the conqueror of foes, an exceptionally splendid one, Ravana was praised by the Rakshasas saying, "Victory to you, Prosperity to you", Ravana entered the wellbuilt royal court.

shloka_text: सुवर्णरजतास्तीर्णांविशुद्धस्फटिकान्तराम् । विराजमानोवपुषारुक्मपट्टोत्तरच्छदाम् ।।6.11.15।। तांपिशाचशतै: षङ्भिरभिगुप्तांसदाप्रभाम् । प्रविवेशमहातेजास्सुकृतांविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.11.16।।
transliteration: suvarṇarajatāstīrṇāṃviśuddhasphaṭikāntarām | virājamānovapuṣārukmapaṭṭottaracchadām  tāṃpiśācaśatai: ṣaṅbhirabhiguptāṃsadāprabhām | praviveśamahātejāssukṛtāṃviśvakarmaṇā
translation: वपुषा: whose body was embodied with, विराजमानः glowing, महातेजा: exceptionally splendid, सुवर्णरजतास्तीर्णाम् pillars made of gold and silver, विशुद्धस्फटिकान्तराम् inside of which is pure like crystal, रुक्मपट्टोत्तरच्छदाम् carpeted with shining bright golden silk, षडिभः six, पिशाचशतैः hundred devils, अभिगुस्ताम् very beautiful, सदाप्रभाम् ever shining, विश्वकर्मणा: by Vishwakarma, सुकृताम् wellconstructed, ताम् that, प्रविवेश: entered.
explanation: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.

shloka_text: सुवर्णरजतास्तीर्णांविशुद्धस्फटिकान्तराम् । विराजमानोवपुषारुक्मपट्टोत्तरच्छदाम् ।।6.11.15।। तांपिशाचशतै: षङ्भिरभिगुप्तांसदाप्रभाम् । प्रविवेशमहातेजास्सुकृतांविश्वकर्मणा ।।6.11.16।।
transliteration: suvarṇarajatāstīrṇāṃviśuddhasphaṭikāntarām | virājamānovapuṣārukmapaṭṭottaracchadām  tāṃpiśācaśatai: ṣaṅbhirabhiguptāṃsadāprabhām | praviveśamahātejāssukṛtāṃviśvakarmaṇā
translation: वपुषा: whose body was embodied with, विराजमानः glowing, महातेजा: exceptionally splendid, सुवर्णरजतास्तीर्णाम् pillars made of gold and silver, विशुद्धस्फटिकान्तराम् inside of which is pure like crystal, रुक्मपट्टोत्तरच्छदाम् carpeted with shining bright golden silk, षडिभः six, पिशाचशतैः hundred devils, अभिगुस्ताम् very beautiful, सदाप्रभाम् ever shining, विश्वकर्मणा: by Vishwakarma, सुकृताम् wellconstructed, ताम् that, प्रविवेश: entered.
explanation: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.

shloka_text: तस्यांसवैडूर्यमयंप्रियकाजिनसम्वृतम् । महत्सोपाश्रयंभेजेरावणःपरमासनम् ।।6.11.17।।
transliteration: tasyāṃsavaiḍūryamayaṃpriyakājinasamvṛtam | mahatsopāśrayaṃbhejerāvaṇaḥparamāsanam
translation: सः he, रावणः Ravana, तस्याम् his, वैडूर्यमयम् encrusted with Vaidurya gems,प्रियकाजिनसम्वृतम् covered with deer skin, सोपाश्रयम् which had a pillow, महत् huge, परमासनम् excellent seat, भेजे: sat.
explanation: Ravana sat on a huge excellent seat encrusted with Vydurya gems and covered with deer skin and which had a pillow.

shloka_text: तत: शशासेश्वरवद्दूतान्लघुपराक्रमान् । समानयतमेक्षिप्रमिहैतान्राक्षसानिति ।। कृत्यमस्तिमहज्जानेकर्तव्यमितिशत्रुभिः ।।6.11.18।।
transliteration: tata: śaśāseśvaravaddūtānlaghuparākramān | samānayatamekṣipramihaitānrākṣasāniti || kṛtyamastimahajjānekartavyamitiśatrubhiḥ
translation: ततः then, लघुपराक्रमान् quick footed, दूतान् messengers, ईश्वरवत् like Lord, महत् great, कृत्याम् task, अस्ति: for us, शत्रुभिः against enemies, कर्तव्यम् इति: this has to be performed, जाने: you may know, एतान् that way, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, क्षिप्रम् at once, मे: to me, इह: here, समानयत: with you, इति: thus, शशास: commanded.
explanation: Then that Lord like Ravana said "We have to do a great task against the enemies now. It has to be performed." He commanded quick footed messengers to get the Rakshasas to him at once.

shloka_text: राक्षसास्तद्वचश्श्रुत्वालङ्कायांपरिचक्रमुः ।।6.11.19।। अनुगेहमवस्थायविहारशयनेषुच । उद्यानेषुचरक्षांसिचोदयन्तोह्यभीतवत् ।।6.11.20।।
transliteration: rākṣasāstadvacaśśrutvālaṅkāyāṃparicakramuḥ  anugehamavasthāyavihāraśayaneṣuca | udyāneṣucarakṣāṃsicodayantohyabhītavat
translation: राक्षसाः those Rakshasas, तद्वचः that which was spoken, श्रुत्वा: having heard, विहारशयनेषु: places of recreation and bedrooms, उद्यानेषुच: also into recreational gardens, अवस्थाय: residing, रक्षांसि: Rakshasas, चोदयन्तः directing, अभीतवत् without fear, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, अनुगेहम् every house, परिचक्रमुः went round.
explanation: Those Rakshasas having heard the words spoken by Ravana went to places of recreation, bedrooms and gardens and went round without fear into every house directing the Rakshasas.

shloka_text: राक्षसास्तद्वचश्श्रुत्वालङ्कायांपरिचक्रमुः ।।6.11.19।। अनुगेहमवस्थायविहारशयनेषुच । उद्यानेषुचरक्षांसिचोदयन्तोह्यभीतवत् ।।6.11.20।।
transliteration: rākṣasāstadvacaśśrutvālaṅkāyāṃparicakramuḥ  anugehamavasthāyavihāraśayaneṣuca | udyāneṣucarakṣāṃsicodayantohyabhītavat
translation: राक्षसाः those Rakshasas, तद्वचः that which was spoken, श्रुत्वा: having heard, विहारशयनेषु: places of recreation and bedrooms, उद्यानेषुच: also into recreational gardens, अवस्थाय: residing, रक्षांसि: Rakshasas, चोदयन्तः directing, अभीतवत् without fear, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, अनुगेहम् every house, परिचक्रमुः went round.
explanation: Those Rakshasas having heard the words spoken by Ravana went to places of recreation, bedrooms and gardens and went round without fear into every house directing the Rakshasas.

shloka_text: तेरथान् रुचिरानेकेदृप्तानेकेपृथग्घयान् । नागानेकेऽधिरुरुहुर्जग्मुश्चैकेपदातयः ।।6.11.21।।
transliteration: terathān rucirānekedṛptānekepṛthagghayān | nāgāneke'dhiruruhurjagmuścaikepadātayaḥ
translation: ते: of these, एके: some, रुचिरान् on exquisite, रथान् chariots, एके: some, दृप्तान् proud, दृढान् sturdy, हयान् on horses, एके: some, नागान् elephants, अधिरुरुहुः ascended, एके: some, पदातयः on foot.
explanation: Of those (Rakshasas) some went on exquisite chariots, some on proud sturdy horses some ascended elephants and some by foot.

shloka_text: सापुरीपरमाकीर्णारथकुञ्जरवाजिभिः । सम्पतद्भिर्विरुरुचेगरुत्मद्भिरिवाम्बरम् ।।6.11.22।।
transliteration: sāpurīparamākīrṇārathakuñjaravājibhiḥ | sampatadbhirvirurucegarutmadbhirivāmbaram
translation: सम्पतद्भिः that prosperous capital, रथकुञ्जरवाजिभिः chariots elephants and horses, परमाकीर्णा: in groups, सापुरी: that capital, गरुत्मद्भिः filled with birds, अम्बरमिव: like the sky, विरुरुचे: was shining.
explanation: With chariots, elephants and horses advancing in groups the prosperous capital was shining resembling the flocks of birds in the sky.

shloka_text: तेवाहनाव्यवस्थाप्ययानानिविविधानिच । सभांपद्भिःप्रविविशुस्सिंहागिरिगुहामिव ।।6.11.23।।
transliteration: tevāhanāvyavasthāpyayānānivividhānica | sabhāṃpadbhiḥpraviviśussiṃhāgiriguhāmiva
translation: ते: those, वाहनानि: vehicles, विविधानि: of several kinds, यानानिच: at the entrance and, अवस्थाप्य: parking, सिंहाः lions, गिरिगुहामिव: like a cave of a mountain, सभाम् royal court, पद्भिः on foot, प्रविविशुः entered.
explanation: Parking those vehicles of several kinds at the entrance they entered the royal court by foot like the lions entering the cave of a mountain.

shloka_text: राज्ञःपादौगृहीत्वातुराज्ञातेप्रतिपूजिताः । पीठेष्वन्येबृसीष्वन्येभूमौकेचिदुपाविशन् ।।6.11.24।।
transliteration: rājñaḥpādaugṛhītvāturājñātepratipūjitāḥ | pīṭheṣvanyebṛsīṣvanyebhūmaukecidupāviśan
translation: ते: they राज्ञः king's, पादौ: feet, गृहीत्वा: clasping, राज्ञा: to king, प्रतिपूजिताः offering salutations, अन्येय: some, पीठेषु: on golden seats, अन्ये: some, बृसीषु: on kusa grass mats, केचित् while some, भूमौ: on the floor, उपाविशन् took seat.
explanation: They held the feet of the king and on offering salutations to the king took their seat. While some took golden seats, some sat on a kusa grass mat, and some took a se at on the floor.

shloka_text: तेसमेत्यसभायांवैराक्षसाराजशासनात् । यथार्हमुपतस्थुस्तेरावणंराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.11.25।।
transliteration: tesametyasabhāyāṃvairākṣasārājaśāsanāt | yathārhamupatasthusterāvaṇaṃrākṣasādhipam
translation: तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, राजशासनात् by the king's command, सभायाम् in the royal court, समेत्य: settled in appropriate seats, ते: they, राक्षसाधिपम् leaders of Rakshasas, रावणम् at Ravana, यथार्हम् close by, उपतस्थुः sat.
explanation: Those Rakshasas (who arrived) at the royal court settled down in appropriate seats on the king's command. The leaders of Rakshasas s at close by Ravana.

shloka_text: मन्त्रिणश्चयथामुख्यानिश्चयार्थेषुपण्डिताः । अमात्याश्चगुणोपेतास्सर्वज्ञाबुद्धिदर्शनाः ।।6.11.26।। समीयुस्तत्रशतशशूराश्चबहवस्तदा । सभायांहेमवर्णायांसर्वार्थस्यसुखायवै ।।6.11.27।।
transliteration: mantriṇaścayathāmukhyāniścayārtheṣupaṇḍitāḥ | amātyāścaguṇopetāssarvajñābuddhidarśanāḥ  samīyustatraśataśaśūrāścabahavastadā | sabhāyāṃhemavarṇāyāṃsarvārthasyasukhāyavai
translation: निश्चयार्थे: in deciding matters, पण्डिताः learned, मन्त्रिणश्च: and also ministers, गुणोपेताः virtuous, सर्वज्ञाः knowledgeable, बुद्धिदर्शनाः who can visualise things with their intellect, अमात्याश्च: army men, तथा: likewise, शतशः in hundreds, बहवः many, शूराः heroes, तत्र: there, हेमवर्णायाम् shining with golden colour, सभायाम् in the royal assembly, सर्वार्थस्य: to deliberate on all matters, सुखायवै: for a happy conclusion, यथामुख्याः important people, समीयुः collected.
explanation: Those who were learned in decision making, ministers, virtuous and knowledgeable ones, those who can visualise things with their intellect, army men, like wise many heroes and important people collected at the royal assembly shining in golden colour to deliberate on matters for a happy conclusion.

shloka_text: मन्त्रिणश्चयथामुख्यानिश्चयार्थेषुपण्डिताः । अमात्याश्चगुणोपेतास्सर्वज्ञाबुद्धिदर्शनाः ।।6.11.26।। समीयुस्तत्रशतशशूराश्चबहवस्तदा । सभायांहेमवर्णायांसर्वार्थस्यसुखायवै ।।6.11.27।।
transliteration: mantriṇaścayathāmukhyāniścayārtheṣupaṇḍitāḥ | amātyāścaguṇopetāssarvajñābuddhidarśanāḥ  samīyustatraśataśaśūrāścabahavastadā | sabhāyāṃhemavarṇāyāṃsarvārthasyasukhāyavai
translation: निश्चयार्थे: in deciding matters, पण्डिताः learned, मन्त्रिणश्च: and also ministers, गुणोपेताः virtuous, सर्वज्ञाः knowledgeable, बुद्धिदर्शनाः who can visualise things with their intellect, अमात्याश्च: army men, तथा: likewise, शतशः in hundreds, बहवः many, शूराः heroes, तत्र: there, हेमवर्णायाम् shining with golden colour, सभायाम् in the royal assembly, सर्वार्थस्य: to deliberate on all matters, सुखायवै: for a happy conclusion, यथामुख्याः important people, समीयुः collected.
explanation: Those who were learned in decision making, ministers, virtuous and knowledgeable ones, those who can visualise things with their intellect, army men, like wise many heroes and important people collected at the royal assembly shining in golden colour to deliberate on matters for a happy conclusion.

shloka_text: ततोमहात्माविपुलंसुयुग्यंरथम्वरंहेमविचित्रिताङ्गम् । शुभंसमास्थायययौयशस्वीविभीषणस्संसदमग्रजस्य ।।6.11.28।।
transliteration: tatomahātmāvipulaṃsuyugyaṃrathamvaraṃhemavicitritāṅgam | śubhaṃsamāsthāyayayauyaśasvīvibhīṣaṇassaṃsadamagrajasya
translation: ततः thereafter, महात्मा: great, यशस्वी: illustrious, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, विपुलम् broad, सुयुग्यं: yoked with good horses, हेमविचित्रिताङ्गम् decked with gold, शुभम् auspicious, वरम् choicest, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय: having ascended, अग्रजस्य: of the elder brother, संसदम् assembly, ययौ: went.
explanation: Thereafter illustrious and great Vibheeshana having ascended auspicious and choicest chariot decked with gold and yoked to good horses went to the assembly of his elder brother.

shloka_text: सपूर्वजायावरजश्शशंसनामाथपश्चाश्चरणौववन्दे । शुकःप्रहस्तश्चतथैवतेभ्योददौयथार्हंपृथगासनानि ।।6.11.29।।
transliteration: sapūrvajāyāvarajaśśaśaṃsanāmāthapaścāścaraṇauvavande | śukaḥprahastaścatathaivatebhyodadauyathārhaṃpṛthagāsanāni
translation: अथ: and then, सः that Vibheeshana, अवरजः younger brother, पूर्वजाय: elder brother's, नाम: name, श्शशंस: repeated, पश्चात् after that, चरणौ: to the feet, ववन्दे: offered salutations, शुकः Suka, प्रहस्तश्च: Prahastha also, तथैव: likewise, तेभ्यः both, यथार्हम् in accordance with their position, असनानि: seats, पृथक् different, ददौ: offered.
explanation: There after Vibheeshana the younger brother, repeated his name (by way of courtesy ). A fter that he offered salutations to his elder brother's feet. B oth Sukha and Prahastha likewise followed Vibheeshana and took their seats offered according to their position.

shloka_text: सुवर्णनानामणिभूषणानांसुवाससांसंसदिराक्षसानाम् । तेषांपरार्घ्यागुरुचन्दनानांस्रजाश्चगन्धाःप्रववुस्समन्तात् ।।6.11.30।।
transliteration: suvarṇanānāmaṇibhūṣaṇānāṃsuvāsasāṃsaṃsadirākṣasānām | teṣāṃparārghyāgurucandanānāṃsrajāścagandhāḥpravavussamantāt
translation: संसदि: in that court, सुवर्णनानामणिभूषणानाम् decorated with different kinds of golden and gem colours, सुवाससाम् beautiful clothes, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasa's, परार्घ्यागुरुचन्दनानाम् best of fragrances like incense and sandal paste, स्रजाश्च: floral garlands, गन्धा: fragrance of sandal, समन्तात् everywhere, प्रववुः spread all round.
explanation: In that royal court decorated with different kinds of golden and gem colours, the Rakshasas attired in beautiful clothes with their body smeared with fragrance of incense and sandal paste and wearing floral garland s whose fragrance had spread all over.

shloka_text: नचुक्रुशुर्नानृतमाहकश्चित्सभापदोनापिजजल्पुरुच्चैः । संसिद्धार्थास्सर्वएवोग्रवीर्याभर्तुस्सर्वेददृशुश्चाननंते ।।6.11.31।।
transliteration: nacukruśurnānṛtamāhakaścitsabhāpadonāpijajalpuruccaiḥ | saṃsiddhārthāssarvaevogravīryābhartussarvedadṛśuścānanaṃte
translation: सभासदः those who assembled, नचुक्रुशुः not make noise, कश्चित् even a little,अनृतम् untruth, नाह: not, उच्चैः uttered, नजजल्पुः not speak, अपिसर्वेसंसिद्धार्धा: and all were fully accomplished, उग्रवीर्याः very heroic, तेसर्वे: all of them, भर्तुः Lord, आननम् face, ददृशुः looked at.
explanation: Those who assembled at the royal court neither made a little noise, nor uttered untruth, nor spoke. All of them were fully accomplished, very heroic and looked at their Lord's face.

shloka_text: सरावणश्शस्त्रभृतांमनस्विनांमहाबलानांसमितौमनस्वी । तस्यांसभायांप्रभयाचकाशेमध्येवसूनामिववज्रहस्तेः ।।6.11.32।।
transliteration: sarāvaṇaśśastrabhṛtāṃmanasvināṃmahābalānāṃsamitaumanasvī | tasyāṃsabhāyāṃprabhayācakāśemadhyevasūnāmivavajrahasteḥ
translation: तस्याम् in that सभायाम्: assembly, मनस्वी: heroic, सरावणः that Ravana, शस्त्रभृताम् those who held arms, मनस्विनां: heroes, महाबलानाम् of great prowess, समितौ: in battle, वसूनाम् among Vasus (gods ), मध्ये: in the midst, वज्रहस्तः Indra who holds a diamond bolt, इव: like, प्रभया: with glow, चकाशे: shone.
explanation: In that assembly, amid those heroes of great prowess, who held arms, Ravana glowed like Indra, who wields a diamond bolt in battle among the Vasus. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकादशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the eleventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सतांपरिषदंकृत्स्नांसमीक्ष्यसमितिञ्जयः । प्रचोदयामासतदाप्रहस्तंवाहिनीपतिम् ।।6.12.1।।
transliteration: satāṃpariṣadaṃkṛtsnāṃsamīkṣyasamitiñjayaḥ | pracodayāmāsatadāprahastaṃvāhinīpatim
translation: तदा: then, समितिञ्जयः one who is victorious in wars, सः he, कृत्स्नाम् vast, तांपरिषदम् that assembly, दृष्टवा: on seeing, तदा: then, वाहिनीपतिम् chief of the army, प्रहस्तम् to Prahastha, प्रचोदयामास: ordered.
explanation: Then Ravana who is victorious in wars, looking at the vast assembly (of Rakshasas) ordered Prahastha, the chief of the army.
comments: Ravana asks Prahastha to decide for the safety of Lanka and also inform Kumbhakarna of the situation.

shloka_text: सेनापतेयथातेस्युःकृतविद्याश्चतुर्विधाः । योधानगररक्षायांतथाव्यादेष्टुमर्हसि ।।6.12.2।।
transliteration: senāpateyathātesyuḥkṛtavidyāścaturvidhāḥ | yodhānagararakṣāyāṃtathāvyādeṣṭumarhasi
translation: सेनापते: O chief of the army चतुर्विधाः warriors of four divisions of army, कृतविद्याः those who are well versed in the knowledge of all kinds of wars, ते: you, योधाः war, नगररक्षायाम् to safeguarding the city, यथा: likewise, स्युः you entrust, तथा: so also, व्यादेष्टुम् you order to be more alert, अर्हसि: you ought.
