explanation: "O Chief of the army You order those who are well versed in the knowledge of all kinds of war and entrust those warriors of four divisions of the army to safeguard the city. Likewise, you ought to order them to be more alert."

shloka_text: सप्रहस्तःप्रणीतात्माचिकीर्षन् राजशासनम् । विनिक्षिपद्बलंसर्वंबहिरन्तश्चमन्दिरे ।।6.12.3।।
transliteration: saprahastaḥpraṇītātmācikīrṣan rājaśāsanam | vinikṣipadbalaṃsarvaṃbahirantaścamandire
translation: प्रणीतात्मा: celebrated, सःप्रहस्तः that Prahastha, राजशासनम् by king's order, चिकीर्षन् desiring to do, मन्दिरे: city, बहिः outside, अन्तश्च: inside, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, विनिक्षिपत् assigned.
explanation: Celebrated Prahastha desiring to carry out the king's order assigned the army inside and outside the city.

shloka_text: ततोविनिक्षिप्यबलंसर्वनगरगुप्तये । प्रहस्तःप्रमुखेराज्ञोनिषसादजगादच ।।6.12.4।।
transliteration: tatovinikṣipyabalaṃsarvanagaraguptaye | prahastaḥpramukherājñoniṣasādajagādaca
translation: ततः thereafter, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, नगरगुप्तये: for guarding the city, विनिक्षिप्य: having assigned, राज्ञः of the king, प्रमुखे: in front, निषसाद: sat down, जगादच: and appealed.
explanation: There after Prahastha, having assigned the army for guarding the city, sat down in front of the king, and appealed.

shloka_text: विहितंबहिरन्तश्चबलंबलवतस्तव । कुरुष्याविमनाःक्षिप्रंयदभिप्रेतमस्तुते ।।6.12.5।।
transliteration: vihitaṃbahirantaścabalaṃbalavatastava | kuruṣyāvimanāḥkṣipraṃyadabhipretamastute
translation: बलवतः one who is powerful, तव: your, बलम् strength, बहिः outside, अन्तश्च: and inside, विहितम् kept, अविमनाः with undistracted mind, ते: to you, यत् that which, अभिप्रेतम् you intend to do, अस्तु: you will, क्षिप्रम् at once, कुरुष्व: you may tell.
explanation: "You are a powerful one. Your army has been posted outside as well as inside. You may tell me at once without any distraction what you intend to do."

shloka_text: प्रहस्तस्यवचश्श्रुत्वाराजाराज्यहितैषिणः । सुखेप्सुस्सुहृदांमध्येव्याजहारसरावणः ।।6.12.6।।
transliteration: prahastasyavacaśśrutvārājārājyahitaiṣiṇaḥ | sukhepsussuhṛdāṃmadhyevyājahārasarāvaṇaḥ
translation: राजा: king, सः that, रावणः Ravana, राज्यहितैषिणः keen on doing good to the kingdom, प्रहस्तस्य: Prahastha's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, सुखेप्सुः desiring happiness, सुहृदाम् dear ones, मध्ये: in the midst, व्याजहार: said this.
explanation: Ravana who was keen on doing good to the kingdom desiring happiness and having heard Prahastha's word, said this in the midst of his dear ones.

shloka_text: प्रियाप्रियेसुखंदुःखंलाभालाभेहिताहिते । धर्मकामार्थकृच्छ्रेषुयूयमर्हथवेदितुम् ।।6.12.7।।
transliteration: priyāpriyesukhaṃduḥkhaṃlābhālābhehitāhite | dharmakāmārthakṛcchreṣuyūyamarhathaveditum
translation: यूयम् you all, धर्मकामार्थकृच्छ्रेषु: among dharma (righteous code of conduct), artha (material wealth) and kama (desire), प्रियाप्रिये: that which is desirable and undesirable, सुखम् happiness, दुःखम् sorrow, लाभालाभे: gain and loss, हिताहिते: good and bad, वेदितुम् to know, अर्हथ: you are capable.
explanation: "When there is doubt about dharma, artha and kama, you are capable of deciphering between desirable and undesirable, happiness and sorrow, gain and loss."

shloka_text: सर्वकृत्यानियुष्माभिस्समारब्धानिसर्वथा । मन्त्रकर्मनियुक्तानिनजातुविफलानिमे ।।6.12.8।।
transliteration: sarvakṛtyāniyuṣmābhissamārabdhānisarvathā | mantrakarmaniyuktāninajātuviphalānime
translation: सर्वथा: always, युष्माभिः all of you, समारब्धानि: started, मन्त्रकर्मनियुक्तानि: that which has been well thought out and decided, मे: by me, सर्वकृत्यानि: actions carried out, जातु: that I know, नविफलानि: never futile.
explanation: "The actions carried out by me are always after it is well thought out and decided by all of you. I know that those actions have not failed."

shloka_text: ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रैर्मरुद्भिरिववासवः । भवद्भिरहमत्यर्थंवृतश्रियमवाप्नुयाम् ।।6.12.9।।
transliteration: sasomagrahanakṣatrairmarudbhirivavāsavaḥ | bhavadbhirahamatyarthaṃvṛtaśriyamavāpnuyām
translation: ससोमग्रहनक्षत्रैः ruling over the moon, sun and stars, मरुद्भि: even gods, वासवःइव: just as Indra भवद्भिः with you also, वृतः accompanied, अहम् I, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, श्रियम् at once, अवाप्नुयाम् attain fortune.
explanation: "Just as Indra who rules over the moon, sun, stars, and gods attains fortune, accompanied by you I will attain fortune exceedingly at once."

shloka_text: अहंतुखलुसर्वान्वस्समर्थयितुमुद्यतः । कुम्भकर्णस्यतुस्वप्नान्नेममर्थमचोदयम् ।।6.12.10।।
transliteration: ahaṃtukhalusarvānvassamarthayitumudyataḥ | kumbhakarṇasyatusvapnānnemamarthamacodayam
translation: अहम् I, वः earlier, सर्वान् all, खलु: indeed, समर्थयितुम् right, उद्यतः told you, कुम्भकर्णस्यतु: to Kumbhakarna, स्वप्नात् was sleeping, मम् I, इमम् this, अर्थं: matter, नअचोदयम् not informed.
explanation: "Indeed, rightly I told all of you earlier. Since Kumbhakarna was sleeping I had not informed him about this matter."

shloka_text: अयंहिसुप्तःषण्मासान्कुम्भकर्णोमहाबलः । सर्वशस्त्रभृतांमुख्यस्सइदानींसमुत्थितः ।।6.12.11।।
transliteration: ayaṃhisuptaḥṣaṇmāsānkumbhakarṇomahābalaḥ | sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃmukhyassaidānīṃsamutthitaḥ
translation: सर्वशस्त्रभृताम् among the wielders of weapons, मुख्यः foremost, अयम् this, महाबलः very strong, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, षट् मासान् six months, सुप्तःहि: was sleeping, सः he, इदानीम् here, समुत्थितः has arrived now.
explanation: "Kumbhakarna, the foremost among the wielders of weapons, is very strong. He was sleeping these six months and has arrived now."

shloka_text: इयंचदण्डकारण्याद्रामस्यमहिषीमया । रक्षोभिश्चरितोद्देशादानीताजनकात्मजा ।।6.12.12।।
transliteration: iyaṃcadaṇḍakāraṇyādrāmasyamahiṣīmayā | rakṣobhiścaritoddeśādānītājanakātmajā
translation: रामस्य: Rama's, मया: by me, महिषी: consort, इयम् this, जनकात्मजा: Sita, रक्षोभिः Rakshasas, चरितोद्देशात् wandering place, दण्डकारण्यात् from Dandakaranya, आनीता: brought.
explanation: "This Sita, the consort of Rama was brought from D and akaranya, a place where rakshasas wander."

shloka_text: सामेवशय्यामारोढुमिच्छत्यलसगामिनी । त्रिषुलोकेषुचान्यामेनसीतासदृशीमता ।।6.12.13।।
transliteration: sāmevaśayyāmāroḍhumicchatyalasagāminī | triṣulokeṣucānyāmenasītāsadṛśīmatā
translation: अलसगामिनी: one whose pace of walk is modest, सा: she, मे: my, शय्याम् bed, आरोढुम् to lay her feet (to love), नइच्छति: not like, त्रिषु: in the three, लोकेषु: in the world, अन्या: others, सीतासदृशी: one who has the looks like Sita, मे: to me, नमता: not think.
explanation: "Sita who walks modestly did not like to enter into my bed (love me ) however much I prayed. I do not think there is anyone who looks like her in the three worlds."

shloka_text: तनुमध्यापृथुश्रोणीशरदिन्दुनिभानना । हेमबिम्बनिभासौम्यामायेवमयनिर्मिता ।।6.12.14।।
transliteration: tanumadhyāpṛthuśroṇīśaradindunibhānanā | hemabimbanibhāsaumyāmāyevamayanirmitā
translation: तनुमध्या: one of slender waist, पृथुश्रोणी: plump hips, शरदिन्दुनिभानना: of autumnal full moon like face, हेमबिम्बनिभा: like golden image, सौम्या: gentle lady, मयनिर्मिता: constructed by Maya (Rakshasa), मायेव: like a magical one.
explanation: "She is a woman of slender waist, plump hips, whose face is like an autumnal full moon. She is gentle and like a golden image. She is like a magical one constructed by Maya."

shloka_text: सुलोहिततलौश्लक्ष् णौचरणौसुप्रतिष्ठितौ । दृष्ट्वाताम्रनखौतस्यादीप्यतेमेशरीरजः ।।6.12.15।।
transliteration: sulohitatalauślakṣ ṇaucaraṇausupratiṣṭhitau | dṛṣṭvātāmranakhautasyādīpyatemeśarīrajaḥ
translation: सुलोहिततलौ: red coloured soles of feet, श्लक्ष् णौ: smooth, सुप्रतिष्ठितौ: evenly shaped, ताम्रनखौ: pinkish nails, तस्याः of her, चरणौ: feet, दृष्ट्वा: on beholding, मे: my, शरीरजः born in me, दीप्यते: kindled.
explanation: "Beholding her smooth red soles and evenly shaped pinkish nails of feet, love is kindled in me."

shloka_text: हुताग्निरर्चिस्सङ्काशामेनांसौरीमिवप्रभाम् । उन्नसंविमलंवल्गुविपुलांचारुलोचनम् ।।6.12.16।। पश्यंस्तदवशस्तस्याःकामस्यवशमेयिवान् ।
transliteration: hutāgnirarcissaṅkāśāmenāṃsaurīmivaprabhām | unnasaṃvimalaṃvalguvipulāṃcārulocanam  paśyaṃstadavaśastasyāḥkāmasyavaśameyivān |
translation: हुताग्निरर्चिः like the sacrificial fire, सङ्काशाम् like the radiance, सौरीम् of Sun, प्रभामिव: like the glow, एनाम् her, उन्नसम् prominent nose, विपुलम् large, वल्गु: attractive, चारुलोचनम् beautiful eyes, तस्याः of her, तत् those, पश्यन् seeing, अवशः surely, कामस्य: by love, वशम् overtaken, एयिवान् slave to her.
explanation: "On beholding the sacrificial firelike face of Sita glowing like the radiance of the Sun, seeing her prominent nose, her large attractive countenance with beautiful eyes surely, I am overtaken by love and have become a slave to her."

shloka_text: क्रोधहर्षसमानेनदुर्वर्णकरणेनच ।।6.12.17।। शोकसन्तापनित्येनकामेनकलुषीकृतः ।
transliteration: krodhaharṣasamānenadurvarṇakaraṇenaca  śokasantāpanityenakāmenakaluṣīkṛtaḥ |
translation: क्रोधहर्षसमानेन: is equal in anger and happiness, दुर्वर्णकरणेनच: makes one pale, शोकसन्तापनित्येन: either in grief or agony, कामेन: by passion, कलुषीकृतः disturbed.
explanation: "I have been disturbed by passion, which is equal in anger or happiness and makes one pale in grief or agony."

shloka_text: सातुसंवत्सरंकालंमामयाचतभामिनी ।।6.12.18।। प्रतीक्षमाणाभर्तारंराममायतलोचना । तन्मयाचारुनेत्रायःप्रतिज्ञातंवचश्शुभम् ।।6.12.19।। श्रान्तोऽहंसततंकामाद्यातोहयइवाध्वनि ।
transliteration: sātusaṃvatsaraṃkālaṃmāmayācatabhāminī  pratīkṣamāṇābhartāraṃrāmamāyatalocanā | tanmayācārunetrāyaḥpratijñātaṃvacaśśubham  śrānto'haṃsatataṃkāmādyātohayaivādhvani |
translation: भर्तारम् husband, रामम् Rama, प्रतीक्षमाणा: expecting to come, आयतलोचना: broadeyed Sita, सा: that, भामिनी: beautiful woman, माम् me, संवत्सरंकालम् one year time, आयाचत: had requested, मया: by me, चारुनेत्रायाः lady with beautiful eyes, शुभम् auspicious, तत् that, वचः word, प्रतिज्ञातम् promised in turn, सततम् ever, अध्वनि: feel exhausted, यातः one that has marched, हयःइव: like the horse, अहम् I, कामात् on account of passion, श्रान्त: tired.
explanation: "Broadeyed Sita requested me one year time expecting her husband Rama to come (this is a false statement made by Ravana here) and I promised in turn to Sita of beautiful eyes. Just like an exhausted horse that marched I am tired on account of my passion."

shloka_text: सातुसंवत्सरंकालंमामयाचतभामिनी ।।6.12.18।। प्रतीक्षमाणाभर्तारंराममायतलोचना । तन्मयाचारुनेत्रायःप्रतिज्ञातंवचश्शुभम् ।।6.12.19।। श्रान्तोऽहंसततंकामाद्यातोहयइवाध्वनि ।
transliteration: sātusaṃvatsaraṃkālaṃmāmayācatabhāminī  pratīkṣamāṇābhartāraṃrāmamāyatalocanā | tanmayācārunetrāyaḥpratijñātaṃvacaśśubham  śrānto'haṃsatataṃkāmādyātohayaivādhvani |
translation: भर्तारम् husband, रामम् Rama, प्रतीक्षमाणा: expecting to come, आयतलोचना: broadeyed Sita, सा: that, भामिनी: beautiful woman, माम् me, संवत्सरंकालम् one year time, आयाचत: had requested, मया: by me, चारुनेत्रायाः lady with beautiful eyes, शुभम् auspicious, तत् that, वचः word, प्रतिज्ञातम् promised in turn, सततम् ever, अध्वनि: feel exhausted, यातः one that has marched, हयःइव: like the horse, अहम् I, कामात् on account of passion, श्रान्त: tired.
explanation: "Broadeyed Sita requested me one year time expecting her husband Rama to come (this is a false statement made by Ravana here) and I promised in turn to Sita of beautiful eyes. Just like an exhausted horse that marched I am tired on account of my passion."

shloka_text: कथंसागरमक्षोभ्यंतरिष्यन्तिवनौकसः ।।6.12.20।। बहुसत्त्वसमाकीर्णंतौवादशरथात्मजौ ।
transliteration: kathaṃsāgaramakṣobhyaṃtariṣyantivanaukasaḥ  bahusattvasamākīrṇaṃtauvādaśarathātmajau |
translation: अक्षोभ्यम् unassailable, बहुसत्त्वसमाकीर्णम् inhabited by many crocodiles, सागरम् the ocean, वनौकसः Vanaras, तौ: both the, दशरथात्मजौवा: even the sons of Dasaratha, कथम् how, तरिष्यन्ति: will they cross.
explanation: "How will the Vanaras and even both the sons of Dasaratha be able to cross the unassailable ocean inhabited by huge crocodiles?"

shloka_text: अथवाकपिनैकेनकृतंनःकदनंमहत् ।।6.12.21।। दुर् ज्ञेयाःकार्यगतयोब्रूतयस्ययथामति ।
transliteration: athavākapinaikenakṛtaṃnaḥkadanaṃmahat  dur jñeyāḥkāryagatayobrūtayasyayathāmati |
translation: अथवा: Even so, एकेन: singly, कपिना: monkey, नः let us think, महत् great, कदनम् most difficult, कृतम् after having done, कार्यगतयः did and went, दुर् ज्ञेयाः is difficult to ascertain, यस्य: his, यथामति: whatever you feel, ब्रूत: you may tell.
explanation: "Even so, a huge destruction was done to us, by a single monkey. The consequences of their acts are unpredictable. Tell me what is there in your mind, according to your own understanding."

shloka_text: मानुष्यान्नोभयंनास्तितथापितुविमृश्यताम् ।।6.12.22।। तदादेवासुरेयुद्धेयुष्माभिस्सहितोऽजयम् । तेमेभवन्तश्चतथासुग्रीवप्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.12.23।। परेपारेसमुद्रस्यपुरस्कृत्यनृपात्मजौ । सीतायाःपदवींप्राप्यसम्प्राप्तौवरुणालयाम् ।।6.12.24।।
transliteration: mānuṣyānnobhayaṃnāstitathāpituvimṛśyatām  tadādevāsureyuddheyuṣmābhissahito'jayam | temebhavantaścatathāsugrīvapramukhānharīn  parepāresamudrasyapuraskṛtyanṛpātmajau | sītāyāḥpadavīṃprāpyasamprāptauvaruṇālayām
translation: मानुषात् of human beings, नः to me, भयम् fear, नास्ति: not there, तथापि: in the same way, विमृश्यताम् let it be deliberated, तदा: then, देवासुरेयुद्धे: in the battle of Devas and asuras, युष्माभिः you also, सहितः along with, अजयम् victory, मे: to me, ते: by you, भवन्तश्च: as it is all of you, तथा: be like that, नृपात्मजौ: sons of King (Rama and Lakshmana), सीतायाः Sita's, पदवीम् a way out, प्राप्या: gain, सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् Sugriva and other leaders, हरीन् Vanaras, पुरस्कृत्य: placed in front, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, परे: shore, पारे: collected, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, the ocean, सम्प्राप्तौ: arrived.
explanation: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

shloka_text: मानुष्यान्नोभयंनास्तितथापितुविमृश्यताम् ।।6.12.22।। तदादेवासुरेयुद्धेयुष्माभिस्सहितोऽजयम् । तेमेभवन्तश्चतथासुग्रीवप्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.12.23।। परेपारेसमुद्रस्यपुरस्कृत्यनृपात्मजौ । सीतायाःपदवींप्राप्यसम्प्राप्तौवरुणालयाम् ।।6.12.24।।
transliteration: mānuṣyānnobhayaṃnāstitathāpituvimṛśyatām  tadādevāsureyuddheyuṣmābhissahito'jayam | temebhavantaścatathāsugrīvapramukhānharīn  parepāresamudrasyapuraskṛtyanṛpātmajau | sītāyāḥpadavīṃprāpyasamprāptauvaruṇālayām
translation: मानुषात् of human beings, नः to me, भयम् fear, नास्ति: not there, तथापि: in the same way, विमृश्यताम् let it be deliberated, तदा: then, देवासुरेयुद्धे: in the battle of Devas and asuras, युष्माभिः you also, सहितः along with, अजयम् victory, मे: to me, ते: by you, भवन्तश्च: as it is all of you, तथा: be like that, नृपात्मजौ: sons of King (Rama and Lakshmana), सीतायाः Sita's, पदवीम् a way out, प्राप्या: gain, सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् Sugriva and other leaders, हरीन् Vanaras, पुरस्कृत्य: placed in front, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, परे: shore, पारे: collected, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, the ocean, सम्प्राप्तौ: arrived.
explanation: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

shloka_text: मानुष्यान्नोभयंनास्तितथापितुविमृश्यताम् ।।6.12.22।। तदादेवासुरेयुद्धेयुष्माभिस्सहितोऽजयम् । तेमेभवन्तश्चतथासुग्रीवप्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.12.23।। परेपारेसमुद्रस्यपुरस्कृत्यनृपात्मजौ । सीतायाःपदवींप्राप्यसम्प्राप्तौवरुणालयाम् ।।6.12.24।।
transliteration: mānuṣyānnobhayaṃnāstitathāpituvimṛśyatām  tadādevāsureyuddheyuṣmābhissahito'jayam | temebhavantaścatathāsugrīvapramukhānharīn  parepāresamudrasyapuraskṛtyanṛpātmajau | sītāyāḥpadavīṃprāpyasamprāptauvaruṇālayām
translation: मानुषात् of human beings, नः to me, भयम् fear, नास्ति: not there, तथापि: in the same way, विमृश्यताम् let it be deliberated, तदा: then, देवासुरेयुद्धे: in the battle of Devas and asuras, युष्माभिः you also, सहितः along with, अजयम् victory, मे: to me, ते: by you, भवन्तश्च: as it is all of you, तथा: be like that, नृपात्मजौ: sons of King (Rama and Lakshmana), सीतायाः Sita's, पदवीम् a way out, प्राप्या: gain, सुग्रीवप्रमुखान् Sugriva and other leaders, हरीन् Vanaras, पुरस्कृत्य: placed in front, समुद्रस्य: ocean's, परे: shore, पारे: collected, वरुणालयम् abode of Varuna, the ocean, सम्प्राप्तौ: arrived.
explanation: "There is no fear of human beings for me. I won the war between Devas and asuras along with you. As it is, all of you are there. There at the shore of the ocean Rama and Lakshmana have collected with Sugriva and other leaders placing Vanaras in front to get back Sita. You may suggest a way out to gain."

shloka_text: अदेयाचयथासीतावध्यौदशरथात्मजौ । भवद्भिर्मन्त्र्यतांमन्त्रस्सुनीतंचाभिधीयताम् ।।6.12.25।।
transliteration: adeyācayathāsītāvadhyaudaśarathātmajau | bhavadbhirmantryatāṃmantrassunītaṃcābhidhīyatām
translation: यथा: that way, सीता: Sita, आदेया: without giving, दशरथात्मजौ: Dasaratha's sons,वध्यौच: to kill, भवद्भिः you may also, मन्त्रः suggestion, मन्त्र्यताम् thinking over, सुनीतम् good scheme, अभिधीयतांच: and suggest me.
explanation: "You may also think over and suggest to me a plan to kill Rama and Lakshmana without giving Sita."

shloka_text: नहिशक्तिंप्रपश्यामिजगत्यन्यस्यकस्यचित् । सागरंवानरैस्तीर्वानिश्चयेनजयोमम ।।6.12.26।।
transliteration: nahiśaktiṃprapaśyāmijagatyanyasyakasyacit | sāgaraṃvānaraistīrvāniścayenajayomama
translation: वानरैः Vanaras, सागरम् ocean, तीर्त्वा: to cross, अन्यस्य: no one, कस्यचित् as such, शक्तिम् capacity, नप्रपश्यामि: I do not find in any one, मम: to me, जयः will be victorious, निश्चयेन: surely.
explanation: "No one can cross the ocean with Vanaras (help). As such I do not find anyone has the capacity. I am certain of victory."

shloka_text: तस्यकामपरीतस्यनिशम्यपरिदेवितम् । कुम्भकर्णःप्रचुक्रोधवचनंचेदमब्रवीत् ।।6.12.27।।
transliteration: tasyakāmaparītasyaniśamyaparidevitam | kumbhakarṇaḥpracukrodhavacanaṃcedamabravīt
translation: कामपरीतस्य: seized with passion, तस्य: his, परिदेवितम् lamentation, निशम्य: hearing, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रचुक्रोध: enraged, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् च: uttered.
explanation: On hearing the lamentation of Ravana seized with passion, enraged Kumbhakarna uttered these words.

shloka_text: यदातुरामस्यसलक्ष्मणस्यप्रसह्यसीताखलुसाइहाऽहृता । सकृत्समीक्ष्यैवसुनिश्चितंतदाभजेतचित्तंयमुनेवयामुनम् ।।6.12.28।।
transliteration: yadāturāmasyasalakṣmaṇasyaprasahyasītākhalusāihā'hṛtā | sakṛtsamīkṣyaivasuniścitaṃtadābhajetacittaṃyamunevayāmunam
translation: सलक्ष्मणस्य: accompanied by Lakshmana, रामस्य: Rama's, सीता: Sita, प्रसह्य: by force, यदा: at that time, इह: here, अहृता: brought, तदा: then, सकृत् formerly, समीक्ष्यैव: should have discussed, चित्तम् mind, यमुना: Yamuna, यामुनमिव: like it fills Yamuna mountain, सुनिश्चितम् decided, भजेत: would be.
explanation: "If you had at that time, that is before bringing Sita by force, which was accompanied by Rama and Lakshmana, discussed, and thought of, then you would be sure in your mind like the Yamuna River filling the Yamuna (mountain )."

shloka_text: सर्वमेतन्महाराजकृतमप्रतिमंतव । विधीयेतसहास्माभिरादावेवास्यकर्मणः ।।6.12.29।।
transliteration: sarvametanmahārājakṛtamapratimaṃtava | vidhīyetasahāsmābhirādāvevāsyakarmaṇaḥ
translation: महाराज: great king, अस्य: about, कर्मण: the action, आदावेव: earlier, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, कृतम् done, तव: your, अस्माभिःसह: along with us, विधीयेतयदि: if you had, अप्रतिमम् it would have been very good.
explanation: "Great king If you had discussed with us about all this action earlier, it would have been very good."

shloka_text: न्यायेनराजकार्याणियःकरोतिदशानन: । नससन्तप्यतेपश्चान्निश्चितार्थमतिर्नृपः ।।6.12.30।।
transliteration: nyāyenarājakāryāṇiyaḥkarotidaśānana: | nasasantapyatepaścānniścitārthamatirnṛpaḥ
translation: दशानन: Ravana, यः whosoever, नृपः is the king, न्यायेन: justifiably, निश्चितार्थमतिः having sense of determination, राजकार्याणि: princely duties, करोति: does, सः he, पश्चात् later, नसन्तप्यते: will not regret.
explanation: "O Ravana Whoever is the king, having a sense of determination, thinks justifiably and carries out princely duties will not regret."

shloka_text: अनुपायेनकर्माणिविपरीतानियानिच । क्रियमाणानिदुष्यन्तिहवींष्यप्रयतेष्विव ।।6.12.31।।
transliteration: anupāyenakarmāṇiviparītāniyānica | kriyamāṇāniduṣyantihavīṃṣyaprayateṣviva
translation: अनुपायेन: without proper plan, क्रियमाणानि: tasks carried out, विपरीतानि: contrary to the principle, कर्माणि: tasks, अप्रयते: not auspicious, हवींषीव: like anything fit for oblation, दुष्यन्ति: spoilt.
explanation: "Tasks carried out without proper plan and contrary to the right principles are spoilt like inauspicious oblations offered into sacrificial fire."

shloka_text: यःपश्चात्पूर्वकार्याणिकर्माण्यभिचिकीर्षति । पूर्वंचापरकार्याणिनसवेदनयानयौ ।।6.12.32।।
transliteration: yaḥpaścātpūrvakāryāṇikarmāṇyabhicikīrṣati | pūrvaṃcāparakāryāṇinasavedanayānayau
translation: यः whoever, पूर्वकार्याणि: that which has to be performed earlier, कर्माणि: acts, पश्चात् afterwards, अपरकार्याणि: that which has to be done later, पूर्वंच: does earlier, चिकीर्षतिसः seeks to perform, नयानयौ: right and wrong, नवेद: does not know.
explanation: "He who seeks to perform earlier what has to be done later and does later what have to be done earlier is not a knower of right and wrong."

shloka_text: चपलस्यतुकृत्येषुप्रसमीक्ष्याधिकंबलम् । क्षिप्रमन्येप्रपद्यन्तेक्रौञ्चस्यखमिवद्विजाः ।।6.12.33।।
transliteration: capalasyatukṛtyeṣuprasamīkṣyādhikaṃbalam | kṣipramanyeprapadyantekrauñcasyakhamivadvijāḥ
translation: अधिकम् superior, बलम् strength, प्रसमीक्ष्य: without thinking, कृत्येषु: one who acts, चपलस्य: a hasty one, क्षिप्रम् at once, क्रौञ्चस्य: Krauncha's, खम् digs, द्विजाःइव: like the swans, प्रपद्यन्ते: penetrates and goes.
explanation: A hasty one who acts without thinking of the superior strength (of enemy) gets out at once like the swan penetrates into the crevice of Krauncha (mountain).

shloka_text: त्वयेदंमहादारब्धंकार्यमप्रतिचिन्तितम् । दिष्ट्यात्वांनावधीद्रामोविषमिश्रमिवामिषम् ।।6.12.34।।
transliteration: tvayedaṃmahādārabdhaṃkāryamapraticintitam | diṣṭyātvāṃnāvadhīdrāmoviṣamiśramivāmiṣam
translation: त्वया: by you, अप्रतिचिन्तितम् without thinking, इदम् thus, महत् great, कार्यम् action, आरब्धम् beginning, विषमिश्रम् mixed with poison, अमिषम् इव: like the flesh, रामः Rama, त्वाम् you, दिष्ट्या: fortunately, नावधीत् not killed.
explanation: "Without prior thought this great act has been done by you. Rama has not killed you, fortunately like poison mixed flesh would kill."

shloka_text: तस्मात्त्वयासमारब्धंकर्मह्यप्रतिमंपरैः । अहंसमीकरिष्यामिहत्वाशत्रूंस्तवानघ ।।6.12.35।।
transliteration: tasmāttvayāsamārabdhaṃkarmahyapratimaṃparaiḥ | ahaṃsamīkariṣyāmihatvāśatrūṃstavānagha
translation: आनघ: sinless one, तस्मात् therefore, त्वया: by you, परैः other than me, समारब्दम् undertaking, अप्रतिमम् which is not possible, कर्म: act अहम् I, तव: your, शत्रून् enemy, हत्वा: killing, समीकरिष्यामि: accomplish your goal.
explanation: "O Sinless Ravana Therefore, that which you have done is not possible for none other than me. I will kill your enemy and accomplish your goal for you."

shloka_text: अहमुत्सादयिष्यामिशत्रूंस्तवनिशाचर । यदिशक्रविवस्वन्तौयदिपावकमारुतौ ।।6.12.36।। तावहंयोधयिष्यामिकुबेरवरुणावपि ।
transliteration: ahamutsādayiṣyāmiśatrūṃstavaniśācara | yadiśakravivasvantauyadipāvakamārutau  tāvahaṃyodhayiṣyāmikuberavaruṇāvapi |
translation: निशाचर: Rakshasa, अहम् I, तव: your, शत्रून् enemy, उत्सादयिष्यामि: will ruin them, शक्रविवस्वन्तौ: even Indra and Sun,, पावकमारुतौ: fire and wind god, कुबेरवरुणावपि: even if Kubera and Varuna, तौ: both, अहम् I, योधयिष्यामि: will fight in war.
explanation: "O Rakshasa I will ruin the enemy. I will fight with both of them (Rama and Lakshmana) even if they are Indra and sun, fire god and wind god or Kubera and Varuna."

shloka_text: गिरिमात्रशरीरस्यमहापरिघयोधिनः । नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्यबिभीयाद्वैपुरन्दरः ।।6.12.37।।
transliteration: girimātraśarīrasyamahāparighayodhinaḥ | nardatastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrasyabibhīyādvaipurandaraḥ
translation: गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य: one with mountain like body, महापरिघयोधिनः holding huge iron bar, तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य: with sharp teeth, नर्दतः roaring like a lion, पुरन्दरः Indra, बिभीयात् वै: will run out of fear.
explanation: "If I go with a mountain like body and sharp teeth, holding a huge iron bar roaring like a lion, even Indra will run away out of fear."

shloka_text: पुनर्मांसद्वितीयेनशरेणनिहनिष्यति । ततोऽहंतस्यपास्यामिरुधिरंकाममाश्वस ।।6.12.38।।
transliteration: punarmāṃsadvitīyenaśareṇanihaniṣyati | tato'haṃtasyapāsyāmirudhiraṃkāmamāśvasa
translation: सः he, द्वितीयेन: second, शरेण: arrow, माम् on me, पुनः again, निहनिष्यति: by the time he releases ततः immediately, तस्य: his, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यामि: will drink, कामम् stay quiet, आश्वस: confidently.
explanation: "By the time he releases a second arrow again, I will immediately drink his blood. Stay quiet with confidence."

shloka_text: वधेनवैदाशरथेस्सुखावहंजयंतवाहर्तुमहंयतिष्ये । हत्वाचरामंसहलक्ष्मणेनखादामिसर्वान्हरियूथमुख्यान् ।।6.12.39।।
transliteration: vadhenavaidāśarathessukhāvahaṃjayaṃtavāhartumahaṃyatiṣye | hatvācarāmaṃsahalakṣmaṇenakhādāmisarvānhariyūthamukhyān
translation: दाशरथेः Dasaratha's son, वधेन: by killing, तव: your, सुखावहम् I will make you happy, जयम् victorious, आहर्तुम् will do, अहम् I, यतिष्ये: attempt, लक्ष्मणेनसह: with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama also, हत्वा: on killing, सर्वान् all, हरियूथमुख्यान् Vanara leaders, खादामि: will consume.
explanation: "By killing Rama, I will try to make you happy and victorious. On killing Rama and Lakshmana like that I will consume the Vanara leaders."

shloka_text: रमस्वकामम् पिबचाग्य्रवारुणींकुरष्वकार्याणिहितानिविज्वरः । मयातुरामेगमितेयमक्षयंचिरायसीतावशगाभविष्यति ।।6.12.40।।
transliteration: ramasvakāmam pibacāgyravāruṇīṃkuraṣvakāryāṇihitānivijvaraḥ | mayāturāmegamiteyamakṣayaṃcirāyasītāvaśagābhaviṣyati
translation: कामम् freely, रमस्व: sport, अग्य्रवारुणीम् best of wines, पिब: drinking, विज्वरः free from fear, हितानि: that which you like, कार्याणि: action, कुरष्व: you may do, रामे: Rama, मया: by me, यमक्षयं: to the god of death, गमिते: on reaching, सीता: Sita,चिराय: for a long time, वशगा: under your control, भविष्यति: will be.
explanation: "You be free from fear, sporting and drinking the best of wines and doing actions that you like. Rama will be sent to the abode of the god of death. On reaching their Sita will be under your control for long." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्वादशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of twelfth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: रावणंक्रुद्धमाज्ञायमहापार्श्वोमहाबलः । मुहूर्तमनुसञ्चिन्त्यप्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.13.1।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṃkruddhamājñāyamahāpārśvomahābalaḥ | muhūrtamanusañcintyaprāñjalirvākyamabravīt
translation: रावणम् Ravana, कृद्धम् became angry, आज्ञाय: having realized, महाबलः one of extraordinary strength, महापार्श्वः Mahaparsva, मुहूर्तम् for a short time, अनुसञ्चिन्त्य: thinking of pleasing, प्राञ्जलिः greeting with folded palms, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having realized that Ravana has become angry, Mahaparsva of extraordinary strength, thinking of pleasing him for a while greeting him with folded palms, spoke.
comments: Mahaparsva advises Ravana to force Sita, and Ravana expresses his inability to do so because of the curse pronounced by Brahma.

shloka_text: यःखल्वपिवनंप्राप्यमृगव्यालनिषेवितम् । नपिबेन्मधुसम्प्राप्यसनरोबालिशोभवेत् ।।6.13.2।।
transliteration: yaḥkhalvapivanaṃprāpyamṛgavyālaniṣevitam | napibenmadhusamprāpyasanarobāliśobhavet
translation: यः whoever, नरः human being, मृगव्यालनिषेवितम् inhabited by wild animals and snakes, वनम् forest, प्राप्य: reached, मधु: for honey, सम्प्राप्य: that which has been obtained, नपिबेत् not drink, सः he, ध्रुवम् surely, बालिशः childish.
explanation: "Having reached a forest inhabited by wild animals and snakes for honey, whoever does not drink the honey obtained is surely a childish one."

shloka_text: ईश्वरस्येश्वरःकोऽस्तितवशत्रुनिबर्हण: । रमस्वसहवैदेह्याशत्रूनाक्रम्यमूर्धसु ।।6.13.3।।
transliteration: īśvarasyeśvaraḥko'stitavaśatrunibarhaṇa: | ramasvasahavaidehyāśatrūnākramyamūrdhasu
translation: शत्रुनिबर्हण: destroyer of foes, ईश्वरस्य: to Lord, ईश्वरः Lord, कः who, अस्ति: so be it, शत्रून् enemy, मूर्धसु: on the head, आक्रम्य: setting your feet, वैदेह्या: Vaidehi, सह: with, रमस्व: you may sport.
explanation: "O Destroyer of foes Who is there to question Lord since you are Lord? Setting your foot on the head of enemy you may sport with Sita."

shloka_text: बलात्कुक्कुटवृत्तेनप्रवर्तस्वमहाबल: । आक्रम्याक्रम्यसीतांवैतांभुङ् क्ष्वचरमस्वच ।।6.13.4।।
transliteration: balātkukkuṭavṛttenapravartasvamahābala: | ākramyākramyasītāṃvaitāṃbhuṅ kṣvacaramasvaca
translation: महाबल: of great strength, बलात् forcibly, कुक्कुटवृत्तेन: like the cock again and again, प्रवर्तस्व: using force, तांसीताम् on that Sita, आक्रम्य: taking hold, भुङ् क्ष्व: enjoy, रमस्वच: and revel.
explanation: "(O Ravana) of great strength Take hold of Sita forcibly like the cock, enjoy and revel with her."

shloka_text: लब्धकामस्यतेपश्चादागमिष्यतियद्भयम् । प्राप्तमप्राप्तकालंवासर्वंप्रतिसहिष्यति ।।6.13.5।।
transliteration: labdhakāmasyatepaścādāgamiṣyatiyadbhayam | prāptamaprāptakālaṃvāsarvaṃpratisahiṣyati
translation: लब्दकामस्य: after fulfilling your desire, ते to you, पश्चात् in case, यद्भयम् fear of her, आगमिष्यतिप्राप्तम् let it come, अप्राप्तकालम् that which is yet to come, सर्वम् everything, प्रतिसहिष्यति: you will be able to face.
explanation: "When you have fulfilled your desire, why fear? Let it happen. Let that which is yet to come, happen. You will be able to face."

shloka_text: कुम्भकर्णस्सहास्माभिरिन्द्रजिच्चमहाबलः । प्रतिषेधयितुंशक्तौसवज्रमपिवज्रिणम् ।।6.13.6।।
transliteration: kumbhakarṇassahāsmābhirindrajiccamahābalaḥ | pratiṣedhayituṃśaktausavajramapivajriṇam
translation: अस्माभिस्सह: along with us, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलः one of extraordinary strength, इन्द्रजित् च: even Indrajith, सवज्रम् wielder of thunder bolt, Indra, वज्रिणम् thunderbolt, अपि: also, प्रतिषेधयितुम् to ward off, शक्तौ: have the power.
explanation: "Kumbhakarna accompanied by Indrajith of extraordinary strength have the power to ward off even if Indra, armed with thunderbolt comes."

shloka_text: उपप्रदानंसान्त्वंवाभेदंवाकुशलैःकृतम् । समतिक्रम्यदण्डेनसिद्धिमर्थेषुरोचये ।।6.13.7।।
transliteration: upapradānaṃsāntvaṃvābhedaṃvākuśalaiḥkṛtam | samatikramyadaṇḍenasiddhimartheṣurocaye
translation: कुशलैः wise people, कृतम् done, उपप्रदानम् charity, सान्त्वंवा: Sama (conciliation) or, भेदंवा: or by bedha (dissension), समतिक्रम्य: leaving these, अर्थेषु: means, दण्डेन: by d and a (force ), सिद्धिम् success, रोचये: attained.
explanation: "Leaving aside charity, conciliation or even by showing dissension, the three means resorted to by the wise people, you will attain success by force."

shloka_text: इहप्राप्तान्वयंसर्वान् शत्रूंस्तवमहाबल: । वशेशस्त्रप्रतापेनकरिष्यामोनसंशयः ।।6.13.8।।
transliteration: ihaprāptānvayaṃsarvān śatrūṃstavamahābala: | vaśeśastrapratāpenakariṣyāmonasaṃśayaḥ
translation: महाबल: powerful one, वयम् we, इह: here, प्राप्तान् on arriving, तम: him, सर्वान् all, शत्रून् enemies, शस्त्रप्रतापेन: by the strength of arms, वशे: bring under your control, करिष्यामः will do, संशयः doubt, न: not.
explanation: "O Ravana of extraordinary strength We will bring all your enemies under control on their arrival here. There is no doubt."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तदाराजामहापार्श्वेनरावणः । तस्यसम्पूजयन्वाक्यमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.13.9।।
transliteration: evamuktastadārājāmahāpārśvenarāvaṇaḥ | tasyasampūjayanvākyamidaṃvacanamabravīt
translation: तदा: then, महापार्श्वेन: by Mahaparsva, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, राजा: king, रावणः Ravana, तस्य: his, वाक्यम् statement, सम्पूजयन् feeling happy, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas feeling happy about the statement of Mahaparsva, spoke these words.

shloka_text: महापार्श्वनिबोधत्वंरहस्यंकिञ्चिदात्मन: । चिरवृत्तंतदाख्यास्येयदवाप्तंपुरामया ।।6.13.10।।
transliteration: mahāpārśvanibodhatvaṃrahasyaṃkiñcidātmana: | ciravṛttaṃtadākhyāsyeyadavāptaṃpurāmayā
translation: महापार्श्व: O Mahaparsva, आत्मनः I myself, किञ्चित् certain, रहस्यम् secret, निबोध: listen to, पुरा: earlier, मया: by me, यत् that which, अवाप्तम् happened, चिरवृत्तम् long time ago, तत् that, आख्यास्ये: will tell.
explanation: "O Mahaparsva I have certain secret that happened in the past. It was a long time ago and I shall tell you. Listen to it."

shloka_text: पितामहस्यभवनंगच्छन्तींपुञ्जिकस्थलाम् । चञ्चूर्यमाणामद्राक्षमाकाशेऽग्निशिखामिव ।।6.13.11।।
transliteration: pitāmahasyabhavanaṃgacchantīṃpuñjikasthalām | cañcūryamāṇāmadrākṣamākāśe'gniśikhāmiva
translation: पितामहस्य: Brahma the grandfather, भवनम् abode, गच्छन्तीम् while going, आकाशे: in the sky, चञ्चुर्यमाणाम् concealing herself, अग्निशिखामिव: like the flame of fire, पुञ्जिकस्थलाम् Punjikasthala, अद्राक्षम् saw.
explanation: "While I was going in the sky to the abode of Grandfather Brahma, I saw a celebrated one called Punjikasthala flying concealing herself, glowing like the flame of the fire."

shloka_text: साप्रसह्यमयाभुक्ताकृताविवसनाततः । स्वयम्भूभवनंप्राप्तालोलितानलिनीयथा ।।6.13.12।।
transliteration: sāprasahyamayābhuktākṛtāvivasanātataḥ | svayambhūbhavanaṃprāptālolitānalinīyathā
translation: विवसना: stripped of clothes, कृता: did, सा: to her, मया: by me, प्रसह्य: forcibly, भुक्ता: enjoyed her, ततः then, लोलिता: shaken violently, नलिनीयथा: like the lotus stem, स्वयम्भूभवनम् abode of selfborn Brahma, गता: went.
explanation: "Then her clothes were stripped off by me forcibly and enjoyed her. Then like a violently shaken lotus stem, she went to the abode of Brahma."

shloka_text: तच्चतस्यतदामन्येज्ञातमासीन्महात्मनः । अथसङ्कुपितोदेवोमामिदंवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.13.13।।
transliteration: taccatasyatadāmanyejñātamāsīnmahātmanaḥ | athasaṅkupitodevomāmidaṃvākyamabravīt
translation: तदा: then, तच्च: that incident, महात्मनः high souled, तस्य: it, ज्ञातम् known, आसीत् as it happened, मन्ये: I believe, अथ: and then, सङ्कुपितः highly enraged, देवो: Brahma, मां: to me, इदम् these, वाक्यम् statement, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: "Then the high souled Brahma happened to know about that incident, I believe. Enraged Brahma made this statement to me."

shloka_text: अद्यप्रभृतियामन्याबलान्नारींगमिष्यसि । तदातेशतधामूर्धाफलिष्यतिनसंशयः ।।6.13.14।।
transliteration: adyaprabhṛtiyāmanyābalānnārīṃgamiṣyasi | tadāteśatadhāmūrdhāphaliṣyatinasaṃśayaḥ
translation: अद्यप्रभृति: from today onwards, अन्याम् other, नारीम् women, गमिष्यसि: reach, तदा: then, ते: your, मूर्दा: head, शतधाफलिष्यति: will break into hundred pieces, संशय: doubt, न: no.
explanation: "From today onwards if you desire to resort to a woman forcefully, your head will break into a hundred pieces. There is no doubt."

shloka_text: इत्यहंतस्यशापस्यभीतःप्रसभमेवताम् । नारोहयेबलात्सीतांवैदेहींशयनेशुभे ।।6.13.15।।
transliteration: ityahaṃtasyaśāpasyabhītaḥprasabhamevatām | nārohayebalātsītāṃvaidehīṃśayaneśubhe
translation: इति: thus, तस्य: that, शापस्य: on account of that curse, भीतः frightened, अहम् I, वैदेहीम् to Vaidehi, सीताम् Sita प्रसभमेव: perforce, बलात् by strength, शुभे: lustrous, शयने: bed नारोहये: not able to get.
explanation: "Thus, frightened on account of his curse, I do not perforce to get her to my lustrous bed."

shloka_text: सागरस्येनमेवेगोमारुतस्येवमेगतिः । नैतद्दाशरथिर्वेदह्यासादयतितेनमाम् ।।6.13.16।।
transliteration: sāgarasyenamevegomārutasyevamegatiḥ | naitaddāśarathirvedahyāsādayatitenamām
translation: मे: my, वेगः speed, सागरस्येव: like that of ocean, मे: to me, गतिः movement, मारुतस्येन: like that of wind, एतत् all this, दाशरथिः Rama, son of Dasaratha, नवेद: not know, तेन: therefore, माम् me, आसादयतिहि: coming to attack.
explanation: "My speed is like that of the ocean, my movement is like that of the wind and Dasaratha's son does not know this. Therefore, he is coming to attack me."

shloka_text: कोहिसिंहमिवासीनंसुप्तंगिरिगुहाशये । क्रुद्धंमृत्युमिवाऽसीनंसम्भोधयितुमिच्छति ।।6.13.17।।
transliteration: kohisiṃhamivāsīnaṃsuptaṃgiriguhāśaye | kruddhaṃmṛtyumivā'sīnaṃsambhodhayitumicchati
translation: गिरिगुहाशये: dwelling in the mountain cave, आसीनम् seated, सुप्तम् sleeping, सिंहम् इव: lion like, आसीनम् seated, क्रुद्धम् one who is angry मृत्युम् इव: like waking up death, कोहि: What sort of a person, सम्भोधयितुम् instigating, इच्छति: desiring.
explanation: "He is waking me up like waking up a lion sleeping in the mountain cave. Like waking up death from sleep, he is desiring to instigate me. What sort of a person is he?"

shloka_text: नमत्तोनिशितान्बाणान्द्विजिह्वान्पन्नगानिव । रामःपश्यतिसङ्ग्रामेतेनमामभिगच्छति ।।6.13.18।।
transliteration: namattoniśitānbāṇāndvijihvānpannagāniva | rāmaḥpaśyatisaṅgrāmetenamāmabhigacchati
translation: रामः Rama, मत्तः from me, निशितान् sharp, द्विजिह्वान् of forked flame like fire, पन्नगानिव: like snakes, बाणान् arrows, सङ्ग्रामे: in combat, नपश्यति: not seen, तेन: so, माम् at me, अभिगच्छति: coming towards.
explanation: "Rama has not seen my sharp arrows in comb at that are like the forked flame like the tongues of snakes. So, he is coming towards me."

shloka_text: क्षिप्रंवज्रसमैर्बाणैश्शतथाकार्मुकच्युतैः । राममादीपयिष्यामिउल्काभिरिवकुञ्जरम् ।।6.13.19।।
transliteration: kṣipraṃvajrasamairbāṇaiśśatathākārmukacyutaiḥ | rāmamādīpayiṣyāmiulkābhirivakuñjaram
translation: शतथा: in hundreds, कार्मुकच्युतैः released from my bow, वज्रसमैः like thunderbolt, बाणैः arrows, रामम् at Rama, उल्काभिः meteors, कुञ्जरम् इव: like the elephants, क्षिप्रम् at once, आदीपयिष्यामि: I will blaze up.
explanation: At once with thunderbolts and meteor like arrows released from my bow will blaze up Rama just like fire sticks whirled at elephants.

shloka_text: तच्चास्यबलमादास्येबलेनमहतावृतः । उदितस्सविताकालेनक्षत्राणामिवप्रभाम् ।।6.13.20।।
transliteration: taccāsyabalamādāsyebalenamahatāvṛtaḥ | uditassavitākālenakṣatrāṇāmivaprabhām
translation: महता: huge, बलेन: army, वृतः surrounded by, काले: early, morning उदितः rising, सविता: Sun, नक्षत्राणामिव: like the stars, प्रभाम् with radiance, अस्य: his, तत् that, बलम् army, आदास्ये: split up.
explanation: "Surrounded by a huge army I will split up his army like the morning Sun splits up stars with his radiance."

shloka_text: नवासनेनापिसहस्रचक्षुषायुधाऽस्मिशक्योवरुणेनवापुनः । मयात्वियंबाहुबलेननिर्जितापुरापुरीवैश्रवणेनपालिता ।।6.13.21।।
transliteration: navāsanenāpisahasracakṣuṣāyudhā'smiśakyovaruṇenavāpunaḥ | mayātviyaṃbāhubalenanirjitāpurāpurīvaiśravaṇenapālitā
translation: सहस्रचक्षुषा: thousand eyed one, Indra, वासवेनापि: even Lord of gods, वरुणेनवा: even Lord Varuna, पुनः again, युधा: in combat, नशक्यः not possible आस्मि: to with stand me, पुरा: in the past, वैश्रवणेन: by Kubera, पालिता: ruled, इयंपुरी: this city, मया: by me, बाहुबलेना: huge strength, निर्जिता: won.
explanation: "Even for the thousand eyed Indra or Lord Varuna it is not possible to withstand me in combat. In the past I have won this city ruled by Kubera with huge strength." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रयोदशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the thirteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: निशाचरेन्द्रस्यनिशम्यवाक्यंसकुम्भकर्णस्यचगर्जितानि । विभीषणोराक्षसराजमुख्यमुवाचवाक्यंहितमर्थयुक्तम् ।।6.14.1।।
transliteration: niśācarendrasyaniśamyavākyaṃsakumbhakarṇasyacagarjitāni | vibhīṣaṇorākṣasarājamukhyamuvācavākyaṃhitamarthayuktam
translation: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, निशाचरेन्द्रस्य: the Lord of Rakshasas, वाक्यम् statement, कुम्भकर्णस्य: Kumbhakarna's, गर्जितानि: roaring, निशम्य: looking at, हितम् good, अर्थयुक्तम् meaningful, वाक्यम् statement, राक्षसराजमुख्यम् king of Rakshasas, उवाच: said.
explanation: On hearing the statement of the Lord of Rakshasas and roaring of Kumbhakarna, looking at Ravana the king of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana said these good words appropriate of a noble person.
comments: Vibheeshana advises Ravana to give away Sita to Sri Rama before the Rakshasas are pierced by Rama.

shloka_text: न्तरभोगराशिश्चिन्ताविषस्सुस्मिततीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रः । पञ्चाङ्गुलीपञ्चशिरोऽतिकायस्सीतामहाहिस्तवकेनराजन् ।।6.14.2।।
transliteration: ntarabhogarāśiścintāviṣassusmitatīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraḥ | pañcāṅgulīpañcaśiro'tikāyassītāmahāhistavakenarājan
translation: राजन् O king, बाह्वन्तरभोगराशिः who has the hood at her bosom, चिन्ताविषः poison of grief, सुस्मिततीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रः has sharp fangs behind her gentle smile, पञ्चाङ्गुलीपञ्चशिरोऽतिकायः has her five fingers of the palm like five heads of snake, सीतामहाहिः snake called Sita, केन: why, तववृतः you desired.
explanation: "O king Why have you desired Sita who has snake hood at her bosom, has poison of grief, has sharp fangs behind her gentle smile and has five fingers of her palm as five heads of snake called Sita?"

shloka_text: यावन्नलङ्कांसमभिद्रवन्तिवलीमुखाःपर्वतकूटमात्राः । दष्ट्रायुधाश्चैवनखायुधाश्चप्रदीयतांदाशरथायमैथिली ।।6.14.3।।
transliteration: yāvannalaṅkāṃsamabhidravantivalīmukhāḥparvatakūṭamātrāḥ | daṣṭrāyudhāścaivanakhāyudhāścapradīyatāṃdāśarathāyamaithilī
translation: पर्वतकूटमात्राः of mountain like form, दंष्ट्रायुधाः who have teeth as weapons, नखायुधाश्च: and claws as weapons, वलीमुखाः monkeys, यावत् all of them, लङ्काम् to Lanka, नसमभिद्रवन्ति: before reaching, दाशरथाय: to Rama, मैथिली: Mythili, प्रदीयताम् give away.
explanation: "Before the monkeys of mountain like form whose teeth and claws are like weapons reach Lanka, give away Mythili to Rama."

shloka_text: यावन्नगृह्णन्तिशिरांसिबाणारामेरिताराक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् । वज्रोपमावायुसमानवेगाःप्रदीयतांदाशरथायमैथिली ।।6.14.4।।
transliteration: yāvannagṛhṇantiśirāṃsibāṇārāmeritārākṣasapuṅgavānām | vajropamāvāyusamānavegāḥpradīyatāṃdāśarathāyamaithilī
translation: वज्रोसमाः equal to thunderbolt, वायुसमानवेगाः speed of wind, रामेरिताः released by Rama, बाणाः arrows, राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् leaders of Rakshasas, शिरांसि: heads, यावत् l, नगृह्णन्ति: take away, मैथिली: Mythili, दाशरथाय: to Rama son of Dasaratha, प्रदीयताम् give away.
explanation: "Give away Mythili to Rama before he releases arrows like that of thunder bolt with the speed of wind and take away the heads of the leader."

shloka_text: नकुम्भकर्णेन्द्रजितौचराजंस्तथामहापार्श्वमहोदरौवा । निकुम्भकुम्भौचतथाऽतिकायःस्थातुंनशक्तायुधिराघवस्य ।।6.14.5।।
transliteration: nakumbhakarṇendrajitaucarājaṃstathāmahāpārśvamahodarauvā | nikumbhakumbhaucatathā'tikāyaḥsthātuṃnaśaktāyudhirāghavasya
translation: राजन् O king, कुम्भकर्णेन्द्रजितौ: either Kumbhakarna or Indrajith, तथा: so also, महापार्श्वमहोदरौवा: Mahaparsva, Mahodara or, निकुम्भकुम्भौ: Nikumbha or Kumbha, तथा: so also, अतिकायः Athikaya, युधि: in combat, राघवस्य: at Raghava, स्थातुम् to face, शक्ता: न: not possible.
explanation: "O King It will not be possible for either Kumbhakarna or Indrajith so also for Mahaparsva not even Mahodara, so also for Nikumbha or Kumbha and Athikaya to face Rama in combat."

shloka_text: जीवंस्तुरामस्यनमोक्ष्यसेत्वंगुप्तस्सवित्राप्यथवामरुद्भि: । नवासवस्याङ्कगतोनमृत्योर्नभोनपाताळमनुप्रविष्टः ।।6.14.6।।
transliteration: jīvaṃsturāmasyanamokṣyasetvaṃguptassavitrāpyathavāmarudbhi: | navāsavasyāṅkagatonamṛtyornabhonapātāḻamanupraviṣṭaḥ
translation: त्वम् you, सवित्रा: Sun, अथवा: or else, मरुद्भि: even wind god, गुप्तः guarded, जीवन् with life, रामस्य: Rama's arrows, नमोक्ष्यसे: will not leave, वासवस्य: Indra's, अङ्कगतः sit on lap of, न not, मृत्योः death god, न: not, नभः heaven, पातालम् underworld (under water), अनुप्रविष्टः enter also, न: not.
explanation: "Rama's arrows will not leave you with life even if you are guarded by Sun or wind god, not even if you sit on the lap of Indra or death god or even if you enter the sky or under water."

shloka_text: निशम्यवाक्यंतुविभीषणस्यततःप्रहस्तोवचनंबभाषे । ननोभयंविद्मनदैवतेभ्योनदानवेभ्योऽप्यथवाकुतश्चित् ।।6.14.7।।
transliteration: niśamyavākyaṃtuvibhīṣaṇasyatataḥprahastovacanaṃbabhāṣe | nanobhayaṃvidmanadaivatebhyonadānavebhyo'pyathavākutaścit
translation: विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य: having heard ततः thereafter, प्रहास्तः Prahastha, वचनम् words, बभाषे: told by, नः no, भयम् fear, नविद्म: do not know, दैवतेभ्यः of gods, नअथवा: not even, दानवेभ्यः Rakshasas, कुतश्चित् anyone, न: no.
explanation: After hearing the words said by Vibheeshana, Prahastha spoke these words, we do not know the fear of gods or Rakshasas or anyone.

shloka_text: नयक्षगन्धर्वमहोरगेभ्योभयंनसंख्येपतगोरगेभ्यः । कथंनुरामाद्भविताभयंनोनरेन्द्रपुत्रात्समरेकदाचित् ।।6.14.8।।
transliteration: nayakṣagandharvamahoragebhyobhayaṃnasaṃkhyepatagoragebhyaḥ | kathaṃnurāmādbhavitābhayaṃnonarendraputrātsamarekadācit
translation: यक्षगन्धर्वमहोरगेभ्यः Yakshas, Gandharvas, Nagas, संख्ये: in battle, भयम् fear, न: no, पतगोरगेभ्यः birds and reptiles, न: no, नरेन्द्रपुत्रात् of the king's sons, रामात् from Rama, नः no, कदाचित् even a little, समरे: in war, भयम् fear, कथम् what, भविता: will be?
explanation: "We are not afraid of Yakshas, Gandharvas, or even Nagas. We have no fear of birds or reptiles. What fear can we have of the king's son, Rama?"

shloka_text: प्रहस्तवाक्यंत्वहितंनिशम्यविभीषणोराजहितानुकाङ्क्षी । ततोमहार्थंवचनंबभाषेधर्मार्थकामेषुनिविष्टबुद्धि:।। 6.14.9।।
transliteration: prahastavākyaṃtvahitaṃniśamyavibhīṣaṇorājahitānukāṅkṣī | tatomahārthaṃvacanaṃbabhāṣedharmārthakāmeṣuniviṣṭabuddhi:
translation: ततः then, राजहितानुकाङ्क्षी: desiring king's welfare, धर्मार्थकामेषु: dharma (righteousness) artha (material prosperity) and Kama (sensual desires), निविष्टबुद्धि: thinking deeply and rightly, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अहितम् that which is not good, प्रहस्तवाक्यम् Prahastha's word, निशम्य: hearing, महार्थम् well meaning, वचनम् words, बभाषे: spoke.
explanation: Then Vibheeshana, wishing the welfare of the king, intent upon Dharma, artha and kama, thinking rightly and deeply, spoke these words on hearing Prahastha's words that were not good.

shloka_text: प्रहस्त: राजाचमहोदरश्चत्वंकुम्भकर्णश्चयथाऽर्थजातम् । ब्रवीतरामंप्रतितन्नशक्यंयथागतिस्स्वर्गमधर्मबुद्धेः ।।6.14.10।।
transliteration: prahasta: rājācamahodaraścatvaṃkumbhakarṇaścayathā'rthajātam | bravītarāmaṃpratitannaśakyaṃyathāgatissvargamadharmabuddheḥ
translation: प्रहस्त: Prahastha, राजाच: and king, महोदरश्च: Mahodara also, त्वम् you, कुम्भकर्णश्च: and Kumbhakarna, रामंप्रति: against Rama, अर्थजातम् intend to accomplish, यथा: just as, ब्रवीत: said, तत् that, अधर्मबुद्देः one who is not righteous, स्वर्गम् heaven, गतिः obtained, यथा so also, नशक्यम् not possible.
explanation: "That which you intend to accomplish against Rama is not possible either for you or the king and even for Kumbhakarna and Mahodara, just as heaven is not obtained by the unrighteous people," said Vibheeshana.

shloka_text: वधस्तुरामस्यमयात्वयाचप्रहस्तसर्वैरपिराक्षसैर्वा । कथंभवेदर्थविशारदस्यमहार्णवंतर्तुमिवाप्लवस्य ।।6.14.11।।
transliteration: vadhasturāmasyamayātvayācaprahastasarvairapirākṣasairvā | kathaṃbhavedarthaviśāradasyamahārṇavaṃtartumivāplavasya
translation: हस्त: Prahastha, मया: by me, त्वयाच: and by you, सर्वैः all, राक्षसैर्वा: by Rakshasas also, अर्थविशारदस्य: one who is knowledgeable of everything, रामस्य: Rama's, वधः killing, अप्लवस्य: not swimming, महार्णवम् great ocean, तर्तुम् इव: like crossing, कथम् how, भवेत् will it be possible.
explanation: "Prahastha How can you or me or all Rakshasas kill Rama who is knowledgeable of everything, just as one who is not swimming can cross the great ocean."

shloka_text: धर्मप्रधानस्यमहारथस्यइक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवस्यराज्ञः । पुरोस्यदेवाश्चतथाविधस्यकृत्येषुशक्तस्यभवन्तिमूढा ।।6.14.12।।
transliteration: dharmapradhānasyamahārathasyaikṣvākuvaṃśaprabhavasyarājñaḥ | purosyadevāścatathāvidhasyakṛtyeṣuśaktasyabhavantimūḍhā
translation: धर्मप्रधानस्य: one to whom righteousness alone is foremost, महारथस्य: a great charioteer, इक्ष्वाकुवंशप्रभवस्य: glorious son of Ikshvaku dynasty, कृत्येषु: in action, शक्तस्य: very capable, तथाविधस्य: in such acts राज्ञः by the king, अस्य: its, पुरः earlier, देवाश्च: even gods, मूढा: bewildered, भवन्ति: by you at present.
explanation: "One to whom righteousness is foremost, who is capable of fighting with eleven thousand warriors as charioteer, (like Dasaratha) who is a glorious scion of Ikshvaku dynasty, who is highly capable in war, in front of whom even gods got bewildered earlier. What can be done by you?"

shloka_text: तीक्ष्णानतायत्तवकङ्कपत्रादुरासदाराघवविप्रमुक्ताः । भित्वाशरीरंप्रविशन्तिबाणाःप्रहस्ततेनैवविकत्थसेत्वम् ।।6.14.13।।
transliteration: tīkṣṇānatāyattavakaṅkapatrādurāsadārāghavavipramuktāḥ | bhitvāśarīraṃpraviśantibāṇāḥprahastatenaivavikatthasetvam
translation: प्रहस्त: Prahastha, तीक्ष्णाः sharp, कङ्कपत्राः arrows fixed with feathers of kanka bird, दुरासदाः dangerous ones, राघवविप्रमुक्ताः released by Rama, बाणाः arrows, तवशरीरम् your body, भित्त्वा: tear, प्रविशन्ति: penetrate तावत् therefore, तेनैव: yourself, त्वम् your, विकत्थसे: boasting.
explanation: "Prahastha Sharp arrows of Rama fixed with feathers of Kanka birds are dangerous arrows. They will tear your body and penetrate. What are you boasting yourself?"

shloka_text: भित्त्वानतावत्प्रविशन्तिकायंप्राणान्तिकास्तेऽशनितुल्यवेगाः । शिताश्शराराघवविप्रमुक्ताःप्रहस्ततेनैवविकत्थसेत्वम् ।।6.14.14।।
transliteration: bhittvānatāvatpraviśantikāyaṃprāṇāntikāste'śanitulyavegāḥ | śitāśśarārāghavavipramuktāḥprahastatenaivavikatthasetvam
translation: प्रहस्त: Prahastha, राघवविप्रमुक्ताः released by Rama, प्राणान्तकाः those life threatening, अशनितुल्यवेगाः which have the speed of a meteor, शिताः sharp, शराः arrows, ते: your, कायम् body, भित्त्वा: tearing, नतावत् प्रविशन्ति: will not penetrate, तेनैव: yourself, त्वम् you, विकत्थसे: boasting.
explanation: "Prahastha Before the lifethreatening sharp arrows which have the speed of a meteor released by Rama penetrate and tear your body, why are you boasting yourself?"

shloka_text: नरावणोनातिबलस्त्रिशीर्षोनकुम्भकर्णोऽस्यसुतोनिकुम्भः । नचेन्द्रजिद्दाशरधिंप्रसोढुंत्वंवारणेशक्रसमंसमर्थ:।। 6.14.15।।
transliteration: narāvaṇonātibalastriśīrṣonakumbhakarṇo'syasutonikumbhaḥ | nacendrajiddāśaradhiṃprasoḍhuṃtvaṃvāraṇeśakrasamaṃsamartha:
translation: शक्रसमम् equal to Indra, दाशरथिम् son of Dasaratha, रणे: in war, सोढुम् to oppose, रावणः Ravana, नसमर्थः not capable, अतिबलः exceptionally strong, त्रिशीर्षः Trisirsha, न: not, कुम्भकर्णस्य: Kumbhakarna's, सुतः son, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, न: not, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, न: not possible, त्वंवा: how can you.
explanation: "Either Ravana or exceptionally strong Trisirsha, or even Nikumbha son of Kumbahakarna, or Indrajith are not capable of opposing Rama who is equal to Indra in war. How can you?"

shloka_text: देवान्तकोवापिनरान्तकोवातथातिकायोऽतिरथोमहात्मा । आकम्पनश्चाद्रिसमानसारःस्थातुंनशक्तायुधिराघवस्य ।।6.14.16।।
transliteration: devāntakovāpinarāntakovātathātikāyo'tirathomahātmā | ākampanaścādrisamānasāraḥsthātuṃnaśaktāyudhirāghavasya
translation: देवान्तकोवापि: either Devanthaka, नरान्तकोवा: or Naranthaka, तथाअतिरधः in the same way Athiratha, महात्मा: great soul, अतिकायः Athikaya, अद्रिसमानसारः even if he is of mountain in size, अकम्पनश्च: like Akampana, राघवस्य: with Raghava, युधि: war, स्थातुम् to stand, नशक्ताः not possible.
explanation: "Either by Devanthaka or Naranthaka, in the same way the great soul Athiratha or Akampana, who is of mountainlike size, will not be able to stand against Raghava in war."

shloka_text: अयंचराजाव्यसनाभिभूतोमित्रैरमित्रप्रतिमैर्भवद्भि: । अन्वास्यतेराक्षसनाशनार्थेतीक्ष्णःप्रकृत्याह्यसीक्षयकारी ।।6.14.17।।
transliteration: ayaṃcarājāvyasanābhibhūtomitrairamitrapratimairbhavadbhi: | anvāsyaterākṣasanāśanārthetīkṣṇaḥprakṛtyāhyasīkṣayakārī
translation: व्यसनाभिभूतः one who is a slave to vices, प्रकृत्या: by nature, तीक्ष्णः violent in action, असमीक्षयकारी: one who does without thinking, अयंराजा: this king,अमित्रप्रतिमैः like enemies, मित्रैः friends, भवद्भि: you also, राक्षसनाशनार्थे: for the destruction of Rakshasas, अन्वास्यते: attending. Vices The seven vices are harshness in speech, harshness in punishment, extravagance, drinking, weakness for women, hunting and gambling.
explanation: "This king who is by nature violent and acts without thinking about being an addict to seven vices, is destroying Rakshasas. You are also attending to him calling yourself as friends but like enemies."

shloka_text: अनन्तभोगेनसहस्रमूर्थ्नानागेनभीमेनमहाबलेव । बलात्परिक्षिप्तमिमंभवन्तोराजानमुत्क्षिप्यविमोचयन्तु ।।6.14.18।।
transliteration: anantabhogenasahasramūrthnānāgenabhīmenamahābaleva | balātparikṣiptamimaṃbhavantorājānamutkṣipyavimocayantu
translation: अनन्तभोगेन endowed with extraordinary energy, सहस्रमूर्द्ना with thousand heads, महाबलेन by extremely strong, भीमेन fearsome, नागेन snake, बलात् with strength,परिक्षिप्तम् is entwined with, इमंराजानम् this king, भवन्तः for the present time, उत्क्षिप्य: lift up, विमोचयन्तु relieve.
explanation: "This king is entwined by a fearsome and extremely strong thousand hooded snake endowed with extraordinary energy at present. Lift him up and relieve him."

shloka_text: यावद्धिकेशग्रहणातसुहृद्भि: समेत्यसर्वैःपरिपूर्णकामैः । निगृह्यराजापरिरक्षितव्योभूतैर्यथाभीमबलैर्गृहीतः ।।6.14.19।।
transliteration: yāvaddhikeśagrahaṇātasuhṛdbhi: sametyasarvaiḥparipūrṇakāmaiḥ | nigṛhyarājāparirakṣitavyobhūtairyathābhīmabalairgṛhītaḥ
translation: परिपूर्णकामैः whose wishes have been gratified, सर्वैः all, सुहृद्भि: friends also, समेत्य: joined together राजा: king, भीमबलैः of terrific strength, भूतै: by devils, गृहीतःयथा: just as, केशग्रहणात् यावत् even catching him by hair, निगृह्य: by force, परिरक्षितव्यःहि: will have to be protected.
explanation: "The king will have to be protected by all friends joined together whose wishes have been gratified even by catching him by his hair forcibly just as a man surrounded by a devil of terrific strength is pulled out by his hair."

shloka_text: सुवारिणाराघवसागरेणप्रच्छाद्यमानस्तरसाभवद्भि: । युक्तस्त्वयंतारयितुंसमेत्यकाकुत्स्थपातालमुखेपतन्सः ।।6.14.20।।
transliteration: suvāriṇārāghavasāgareṇapracchādyamānastarasābhavadbhi: | yuktastvayaṃtārayituṃsametyakākutsthapātālamukhepatansaḥ
translation: सुवारिणा: into the pit, राघवसागरेण: ocean called Raghava, तरसा: to be destroyed, प्रच्छाद्यमानः engulfed, काकुत्स्थ: Kakutstha's, पातालमुखे: the underworld, पतन् fall into, अयम् us, भवद्भि: at present, समेत्य: joined together, तारयितुम् will have to make him free, युक्तः proper for you.
explanation: "He is going to fall into the ocean called Rama to be destroyed, engulfed in the pit of the shape of Kakutstha Rama, the underworld. It is proper for all of us to join and make him free."

shloka_text: इदंपुरस्यास्यसराक्षसस्यराज्ञश्चपथ्यंससुहृज्जनस्य । सम्यग्घिवाक्यंस्वमतंब्रवीमिनरेन्द्रपुत्रायददामपत्नीम् ।।6.14.21।।
transliteration: idaṃpurasyāsyasarākṣasasyarājñaścapathyaṃsasuhṛjjanasya | samyagghivākyaṃsvamataṃbravīminarendraputrāyadadāmapatnīm
translation: सराक्षसस्य: for the Rakshasas, अस्य: there, पुरस्य: capital, ससुहृज्जनस्य: for all of you the dear ones, राज्ञश्च: for the king, पथ्यम्: embodying, स्वमतम् my opinion, इदंवाक्यम् these words, सम्यक् good, ब्रवीमिहि: told, नरेन्द्रपुत्राय: king's son, पत्नीम् wife, ददाम: will give.
explanation: "I tell these good words embodying my opinion. Let the king's wife be given away for the good of the Rakshasas, their dear ones, for the capital and the king."

shloka_text: परस्यवीर्यंस्वबलंचबुध्वास्थानंक्षयंचैवतथैववृद्धिम् । तथास्वपक्षेप्यनुमृश्यबुध्वावदेत् क्षमंस्वामिहितंसमन्त्री ।।6.14.22।।
transliteration: parasyavīryaṃsvabalaṃcabudhvāsthānaṃkṣayaṃcaivatathaivavṛddhim | tathāsvapakṣepyanumṛśyabudhvāvadet kṣamaṃsvāmihitaṃsamantrī
translation: परस्य: foes', वीर्यम् valour, स्वबलंच: one's own strength, बुध्वा: ascertaining, तथा: so also, स्वपक्षे: one's own side, स्थानम् status, क्षयंचैव: reduction also, तथैव: one's own, वृद्धिम् growth, बुध्या: knowing, अनुमृश्य: considering, क्षमम् conducive, स्वामिहितम् to the king's welfare, वदेत् tells, सः he, मन्त्री: minister.
explanation: "One who is a minister should advice after ascertaining the strength of the foe and his own strength so also one's own growth (in strength) and fall in strength (of foe) and advice that which is conducive to the king's welfare." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुर्दसस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the fourteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: बृहस्पतेस्तुल्यमतेर्वचस्तन्निशम्ययत्नेनविभीषणस्य । ततोमहात्मावचनंबभाषेतत्रेन्द्रजिन्नैरृतयूथमुख्यः ।।6.15.1।।
transliteration: bṛhaspatestulyamatervacastanniśamyayatnenavibhīṣaṇasya | tatomahātmāvacanaṃbabhāṣetatrendrajinnairṛtayūthamukhyaḥ
translation: बृहस्ततेः like Brhaspathi, तुल्यमतेः highly intelligent, विभीषणस्य: Vibheeshana's, तत् those, वचः words, यत्नेन: with restraint, निशम्य: beholding, ततः there, महात्मा: great soul, नैरृतयोथमुख्यः the leader of Rakshasa army, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, तत्र: there, वचनम् words, बभाषे: spoke.
explanation: Thus spoke Indrajith, the great leader of the Rakshasa army, having heard the words spoken by the highly intelligent Vibheeshana who was equal to Brhaspathi in wisdom.
comments: Indrajith objects Vibheeshana's advice. Vibheeshana replies Indrajith.

shloka_text: किंनामतेतातकनिष्ठवाक्यमनर्थकंचेवेसुबसुभीतवच्च । अस्मिन्कुलेयोऽपिभवेन्नजातस्सोऽपीदृशंनैववदेन्नकुर्यात् ।।6.15.2।।
transliteration: kiṃnāmatetātakaniṣṭhavākyamanarthakaṃcevesubasubhītavacca | asminkuleyo'pibhavennajātasso'pīdṛśaṃnaivavadennakuryāt
translation: कनिष्ठतात: father's younger brother (uncle), किंनाम: What a statement, ते: by you, वाक्यम् words, अनर्थकम् meaningless, सुभीतवच्च: frightened, यः such, अस्मिनकुले: in this race, जातः born, न: not, भवेत् What you said, सोपि: unbecoming, ईदृशम् such words, नैववदेत् will not speak, नकुर्यात् not do.
explanation: "What a meaningless statement you made uncle, being frightened? One who is not born in our race also would not have said such unbecoming words uttered by you (nor do such unbecoming acts)?"

shloka_text: सत्त्वेनवीर्येणपराक्रमेणशौर्येणधैर्येणचतेजसाच । एकःकुलेऽस्मिन्पुरुषोविमुक्तोविभीषणस्तातकनिष्ठएषः ।।6.15.3।।
transliteration: sattvenavīryeṇaparākrameṇaśauryeṇadhairyeṇacatejasāca | ekaḥkule'sminpuruṣovimuktovibhīṣaṇastātakaniṣṭhaeṣaḥ
translation: अस्मिन् in this, कुले: race, एषः that way, तातकनिष्ठ: younger father, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, एकः alone, सत्त्वेन: in strength, वीर्येण: in valour, पराक्रमेण: in prowess, धैर्येण: courage, शौर्येण: heroism, तेजसाच: and boldness, विमुक्ताः devoid of, पुरुषः man.
explanation: "In this race, alone younger father Vibheeshana is devoid of strength, valour, prowess, heroism, courage and boldness."

shloka_text: किंनामतौमानुषराजपुत्रावस्माकमेकेनहिराक्षसेन । सुप्राकृतेनापिरणेनिहन्तुमेतौशक्यौकुतोभीषयसेस्मभीरो ।।6.15.4।।
transliteration: kiṃnāmataumānuṣarājaputrāvasmākamekenahirākṣasena | suprākṛtenāpiraṇenihantumetauśakyaukutobhīṣayasesmabhīro
translation: तौ: those two, मानुषराजपुत्रा: sons of king of men, किंनाम: why do you, एतौ: at them, अस्माकम् from among us, सुप्राकृतेनापि: one who is ordinary, एकेन: alone, राक्षसेन: by Rakshasas, रणे: in war, निहन्तुम् would kill, शक्यौ: possible, भीरो: timid, कुतः doing, भीषयसे: making to fear.
explanation: "Those two sons of the king of men could be killed in war by an ordinary Rakshasa among us single handed. O timid one Why are you scaring us?"

shloka_text: त्रिलोकनाथोननुदेवराजश्शक्रोमयाभूमितलेनिविष्टः । भयार्पिताश्चापिदिशःप्रपन्नास्सर्वेतथादेवगणास्समग्राः ।।6.15.5।।
transliteration: trilokanāthonanudevarājaśśakromayābhūmitaleniviṣṭaḥ | bhayārpitāścāpidiśaḥprapannāssarvetathādevagaṇāssamagrāḥ
translation: तदा: at one time, त्रिलोकनाथः Lord of the three worlds, शक्रः Indra, देवराजः king of gods, तथा: that way, भूमितले: on the ground, निविष्टः cast down, सर्वे: all, देवगणाः Devatas groups, भयार्पिताश्चापि: and scared of, समग्राः entire, दिशः direction, प्रपन्नाः fled.
explanation: "I have cast down on the ground, Indra, the Lord of gods and of three worlds. At one time all the gods in groups fled in all directions scared of me."

shloka_text: ऐरावतोविस्वरमुन्नदन् सनिपातितोभूमितलेमयातु । विकृष्यदन्तौतुमयाप्रसह्यवित्रासितादेवगणास्समग्राः ।।6.15.6।।
transliteration: airāvatovisvaramunnadan sanipātitobhūmitalemayātu | vikṛṣyadantautumayāprasahyavitrāsitādevagaṇāssamagrāḥ
translation: विस्वरम् making noise, उन्नदन् coming towards, सः that, ऐरावतः Airavata elephant, मया: by me, भूमितलेनिपातितः pushed down, प्रसह्य: violently, दन्तौ: tusks, विकृष्य: pulled down, मया: by me, समग्राः entire, देवगणाः group of gods, वित्रासिताः chased them.
explanation: "I pushed down the elephant Airavata coming towards me making noise, pulled down its tusks forcibly and chased the entire group of gods."

shloka_text: सोऽहंसुराणामपिदर्पहन्तादैत्योत्तमानामपिशोकदाता । कथंनरेन्द्रात्मजयोर्नशक्तोमनुष्ययोःप्राकृतयोस्सुवीर्यः ।।6.15.7।।
transliteration: so'haṃsurāṇāmapidarpahantādaityottamānāmapiśokadātā | kathaṃnarendrātmajayornaśaktomanuṣyayoḥprākṛtayossuvīryaḥ
translation: सुराणामपि even Devendra, दर्पहन्ता crushed down the arrogance, दैत्योत्तमानामपि even the leaders of Rakshasas, शोकदाता: will cause grief, सुवीर्यः such a valorous one, सःअहम् that I am, प्राकृतयोः ordinary people, मनुष्ययोः human beings, नरेन्द्रात्मजयोः sons of kings, कथम् how, नशक्तः not possible.
explanation: "I am such a valiant one who crushed the arrogance of even the king of gods, Devendra. I can put even the Rakshasa leaders to grief. How is it not possible for me to do away the sons of kings who are ordinary human beings."

shloka_text: अथेन्द्रकल्पस्यदुरासदस्यमहौजसस्तद्वचनंनिशम्य । ततोमहार्थवचनंबभाषेविभीषणश्शस्त्रभृतांवरिष्ठः ।।6.15.8।।
transliteration: athendrakalpasyadurāsadasyamahaujasastadvacanaṃniśamya | tatomahārthavacanaṃbabhāṣevibhīṣaṇaśśastrabhṛtāṃvariṣṭhaḥ
translation: अथ: and then, इन्द्रकल्पस्य: one who is equal to Indra, दुरासदस्य: dangerous one, महौजसः foremost of the warriors, तत् वचनम् those words, निशम्य: observing, शस्त्रभृताम् among the wielders of weapons, वरिष्ठः great, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ततः that, महार्थम् highly beneficial advice, वचनम् बभाषे: these words spoke.
explanation: Vibheeshana, the best among wielders of weapons, spoke the following words of highly beneficial advice after hearing the words of dangerous Indrajith, the foremost of the warriors.

shloka_text: नतातमन्त्रेतवनिश्चयोऽस्तिबालस्त्वमद्याप्यविपक्वबुद्धि: । तस्मात्त्वयाप्यात्मविनाशनायवचोऽर्धहीनंबहुविप्रलप्तम् ।।6.15.9।।
transliteration: natātamantretavaniścayo'stibālastvamadyāpyavipakvabuddhi: | tasmāttvayāpyātmavināśanāyavaco'rdhahīnaṃbahuvipralaptam
translation: तात: dear, तव: your, मन्त्रे: in decision making, निश्चयः settlement, नास्ति: not having, बालः being a boy, त्वम् you, अद्यापि: even now, अविपक्वबुद्धि: you are not mature, तस्मात् therefore, त्वयापि: by you too, आत्मविनाशनाय: self destructive, अर्थहीनम् devoid of any sense, बहु: all, वचः words, विप्रलप्तम् incoherently.
explanation: "O dear  You have no capacity for decision making. You are young and not mature. Therefore, you are talking incoherently without any sense which is selfdestructive."

shloka_text: पुत्रप्रवादेवतुरावणस्यत्वमिन्द्रजिन्मित्रमुखोऽसिशत्रुः । यस्येदृशंराघवतोविनाशंनिशम्यमोहादनुमन्यसेत्वम् ।।6.15.10।।
transliteration: putrapravādevaturāvaṇasyatvamindrajinmitramukho'siśatruḥ | yasyedṛśaṃrāghavatovināśaṃniśamyamohādanumanyasetvam
translation: इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, राघवतः from Raghava, यस्य: his, ईदृशम् this kind of, विनाशम् destruction, निशम्य: on hearing, मोहात् out of delusion, त्वम् you, अनुमन्यसे: accepting, रावणस्य: Ravana's, पुत्रप्रवादेन: calling yourself son of, मित्रमुखः like friend, शत्रुः foe, असि: you are.
explanation: "Indrajith Though you are calling yourself as the son of Ravana and pretending to be a friend, you are his foe. Even after hearing about the kind of destruction (of Ravana, his kingdom etc.) from Rama, out of delusion you are accepting (with Ravana)."

shloka_text: त्वमेववध्यश्चसुदुर्मतिश्चसचापिवध्योयइहाऽनयत्त्वाम् । बालंदृढंसाहसिकंचयोऽद्यप्रावेशयन्मन्त्रकृतांसमीपम् ।।6.15.11।।
transliteration: tvamevavadhyaścasudurmatiścasacāpivadhyoyaihā'nayattvām | bālaṃdṛḍhaṃsāhasikaṃcayo'dyaprāveśayanmantrakṛtāṃsamīpam
translation: त्वमेव: you yourself, वध्यश्च: deserved to be killed, बालम् young, दृढम् determined, सुसाहसिकं: one who loves to make bold attempt, त्वम् you, यः whoever, इह: here, आनयत् brought you, मन्त्रकृताम् polluting your thought, समीपम् here, अद्य: now, प्रावेशयत् made to enter, सुदुर्मतिः evil minded, सः he च: and.
explanation: "You who are evil minded, deserve to be killed. The one who brought you here is young and loves you to make bold attempts. He is polluting your mind and deserves to be killed."

shloka_text: मूढोऽप्रगल्भोऽविनयोपपन्नस्तीक्षणस्वभावोऽल्पमतिर्दुरात्मा । मूर्खस्त्वमत्यर्थसुदुर्मतिश्चत्वमिन्द्रजिद्बालतयाब्रवीषि ।।6.15.12।।
transliteration: mūḍho'pragalbho'vinayopapannastīkṣaṇasvabhāvo'lpamatirdurātmā | mūrkhastvamatyarthasudurmatiścatvamindrajidbālatayābravīṣi
translation: इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, त्वम् your, मूढः foolish one, अप्रगल्भः one who boasts himself, अविनयोपपन्नः lack obedience, तीक्षणस्वभावः wicked nature, अल्पमतिः of poor intellect, दुरात्मा: cruel, मूर्खः ignorant, अत्यर्थसुदुर्मतिश्च: extremely evil minded, त्वम् you are, बालतया: like a child, ब्रवीषि: spoken.
explanation: "Indrajith You are foolish and boasting yourself. You lack obedience. You are wicked by nature, cruel, poor in intellect, extremely evil minded, ignorant and have spoken like a child."

shloka_text: कोब्रह्मदण्डप्रतिमप्रकाशानर्चिष्मतःकालनिकाशरूपान् । सहेतबाणान्यमदण्डकल्पान्समक्षमुक्तान्युधिराघवेण ।।6.15.13।।
transliteration: kobrahmadaṇḍapratimaprakāśānarciṣmataḥkālanikāśarūpān | sahetabāṇānyamadaṇḍakalpānsamakṣamuktānyudhirāghaveṇa
translation: युधि: in combat, राघवेण: with Raghava, समक्षमुक्तान् released in the presence, ब्रह्मदण्डप्रतिमप्रकाशान् resembling the shaft of Brahma in splendour, अर्चिष्मतः flames of fire, कालनिकाशरूपान् resembling like death, युमदण्डकल्पान् of the form of Lord of death 's shaft, बाणान् arrows, कः who, सहेता: can bear.
explanation: "Who can bear the arrows released by Rama in combat, which resembles the shaft of Brahma in splendour and flames of fire resembling death and equal to the shaft of the Lord of death?"

shloka_text: धनानिरत्नानिसुभूषणानिवासांसिदिव्यानिमणींश्च । चित्रान् सीतांचरामायनिवेद्यदेवींवसेमराजन् निहवीतशोकाः ।।6.15.14।।
transliteration: dhanāniratnānisubhūṣaṇānivāsāṃsidivyānimaṇīṃśca | citrān sītāṃcarāmāyanivedyadevīṃvasemarājan nihavītaśokāḥ
translation: राजन् king, धनानि: wealth, रत्नानि: gems, सुभूषाणानि: good ornaments, दिव्यानि: wonderful, वासांसि: clothes, चित्रान् beautiful, मणींश्च: precious gems, सीतांदेवींच: with celebrated Sita, रामाय: to Rama, निवेद्य: offer, इह: here, वीतशोकाः devoid of sorrow, वसेम: will remain.
explanation: "O King We will offer celebrated Sita to Rama along with wealth, gems, good ornaments, wonderful and beautiful clothes and precious gems and remain here devoid of sorrow." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चदशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the fifteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic of the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सुनिविष्टंहितंवाक्यमुक्तवन्तंविभीषणम् । अब्रवीत्परुषंवाक्यंरावणःकालचोदितः ।।6.16.1।।
transliteration: suniviṣṭaṃhitaṃvākyamuktavantaṃvibhīṣaṇam | abravītparuṣaṃvākyaṃrāvaṇaḥkālacoditaḥ
translation: सुनिविष्टम् with good intention, हितम् favourable, वाक्यम् words, उक्तवन्तम् that were spoken by, विभीषणं: Vibheeshana, रावणः Ravana, कालचोदितः influenced by death, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, आब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: While Vibheeshana advised in Ravana's favour with all good intention, Ravana who was under the influence of death spoke harsh words.
comments: Ravana gets annoyed at Vibheeshana's advice and replies to him in a harsh tone. Vibheeshana departs from Ravana.

shloka_text: वसेत्सहसपत्नेनक्रुद्धेऽनाशीविषेणवा । नतुमित्रप्रवादेनसंवसेच्छत्रुसेविना ।।6.16.2।।
transliteration: vasetsahasapatnenakruddhe'nāśīviṣeṇavā | natumitrapravādenasaṃvasecchatrusevinā
translation: सपत्नेनसह: with known enemy, वसेत् can live with, कृद्धेन: angry, अशीविषेणच: even with venomous serpent, मित्रप्रवादेन: professing to be a friend, शत्रुणासहतु: devoted to enemy, नसंवसेत् cannot stay together.
explanation: "One can live with a known enemy or even with an angry and venomous serpent but cannot stay together with one who professes to be a friend and devoted to an enemy."

shloka_text: जानामिशीलंज्ञातीनांसर्वलोकेषुराक्षस: । हृष्यन्तिव्यसनेष्वेतेज्ञातीनाज्ञातयस्सदा ।।6.16.3।।
transliteration: jānāmiśīlaṃjñātīnāṃsarvalokeṣurākṣasa: | hṛṣyantivyasaneṣvetejñātīnājñātayassadā
translation: राक्षस: O Rakshasa, सर्वलोकेषु: in all the worlds, ज्ञातीनाम् of close relatives, शीलम् behaviour, जानामि: is known to me, एते these, ज्ञातयः relatives, सदा: always, ज्ञातीनाम् of relatives, व्यसनेषु: when in difficulty, हृष्यन्ति: are happy.
explanation: "The behaviour of close relatives in all worlds is known to me. They are happy at the difficulties of relatives."

shloka_text: प्रथानंसाधनंवैद्यंधर्मशीलंचराक्षस: । ज्ञातयोह्यवमन्यन्तेशूरंपरिभवन्तिच ।।6.16.4।।
transliteration: prathānaṃsādhanaṃvaidyaṃdharmaśīlaṃcarākṣasa: | jñātayohyavamanyanteśūraṃparibhavantica
translation: राक्षस: Rakshasa, ज्ञातयः relatives, प्रथानम् chief, साधकम् accomplished वैद्यम्: learned ones, धर्मशीलंच: and one who is virtuous, शूरम् heroic ones, अवमन्यस्तेहि: will disapprove, परिभवन्तिच: will disrespect.
explanation: "O Rakshasa Relatives will insult and disapprove their chief even if he is an accomplished one, a virtuous one or a heroic one and does his duty (as a ruler)."

shloka_text: नित्यमन्योन्यसम्हृष्टाव्यसनेष्वाततायिनः । प्रच्छन्नहृदयाघोराज्ञातयस्तुभयावहाः ।।6.16.5।।
transliteration: nityamanyonyasamhṛṣṭāvyasaneṣvātatāyinaḥ | pracchannahṛdayāghorājñātayastubhayāvahāḥ
translation: व्यसनेषु: in misfortunes, नित्यम् forever, अन्योन्यसम्हृष्टाः rejoice pretending to be friendly, आततायिनः a desperado, प्रच्छन्नहृदयाः a covertly person, घोरा: terrible, ज्ञातियः relatives, भयावहाः create fear.
explanation: "Pretending to be friendly forever the relatives rejoice in them is fortunes of their relatives. They create terrible fear like desperadoes and covertly ones."

shloka_text: श्रूयन्तेहस्तिभिर्गीताश्श्लोकाःपद्मवनेक्वचित् । पाशहस्तान्नरान्द्रुष्टवाशृणुतान्गदतोमम ।।6.16.6।।
transliteration: śrūyantehastibhirgītāśślokāḥpadmavanekvacit | pāśahastānnarāndruṣṭavāśṛṇutāngadatomama
translation: पुरा: in the past, पद्मवने: in the lotus park, पाशहस्तान् one holding the snares, नरान् men in hand, दृष्ट्वा: seeing, हस्तिभिः even elephants, गीताः uttered, श्लोकाः verses, श्रूयन्ते: heard of, गदतः relate, मम: to me, शृणु: listen.
explanation: "In the past elephants in the lotus park, uttered some verses on seeing men holding snares in hand. I will relate those that I heard. You may listen."

shloka_text: नाग्निर्नान्यानिशस्त्राणिननःपाशाभयावहाः । घोरास्स्वार्थप्रयुक्तास्तुज्ञातयोनोभयावहाः ।।6.16.7।।
transliteration: nāgnirnānyāniśastrāṇinanaḥpāśābhayāvahāḥ | ghorāssvārthaprayuktāstujñātayonobhayāvahāḥ
translation: अग्नि: fire, न: no, अन्यानि: others, शस्त्राणि: weapons, न: no, पाशाः noose, भयावहाः fear, न: no, घोराः terrific, स्वार्थप्रयुक्ताः one who is selfish, ज्ञातयः close relatives, नः for us, भयावहाः causing fear.
explanation: "We have no fear of fire or weapons or noose of death. Selfish relatives are causing fear in us."

shloka_text: उपायमेतेवक्ष्यन्तिग्रहणेनात्रसंशयः । कृत्स्नाद्भयाद् ज्ञातिभयंसुकष्टंविदितंचन ।।6.16.8।।
transliteration: upāyametevakṣyantigrahaṇenātrasaṃśayaḥ | kṛtsnādbhayād jñātibhayaṃsukaṣṭaṃviditaṃcana
translation: एते: they, ग्रहणे: to catch, उपायम् means, वक्ष्यन्ति: teach, कृत्स्ना: great, भयात् fear, ज्ञातिभयम् fear of paternal relatives, नः for us, सुकष्टम् very difficult, विदितम् is known.
explanation: "It is known that they (paternal relatives) teach the means to catch us. Out of all fears the fear of close relatives is the great difficulty for us."

shloka_text: विद्यतेगोषुसम्पन्नंविद्यतेब्राह्मणेदमः । विद्यतेस्त्रीषुचापल्यंविद्यतेज्ञातितोभयम् ।।6.16.9।।
transliteration: vidyategoṣusampannaṃvidyatebrāhmaṇedamaḥ | vidyatestrīṣucāpalyaṃvidyatejñātitobhayam
translation: गोषु: in cows, सम्पन्नम् wealth, विद्यते: is present, ज्ञातितः in close relatives, भयम् fear, विद्यते: is seen, स्त्रीषु: in women, चापल्यम् capriciousness, विद्यते: is present, ब्राह्मणे: in brahmins, दमः forbearance, विद्यते: is present.
explanation: "In the cows' wealth is present, in the brahmins forbearance is seen, in the women capriciousness exists but in close relatives fear is present."

shloka_text: ततोनेष्टमिदंसौम्ययदहंलोकसत्कृतः । ऐश्वर्यमभिजातश्चज्ञातीनांमूर्ध्न्यवस्थितः ।।6.16.10।।
transliteration: tatoneṣṭamidaṃsaumyayadahaṃlokasatkṛtaḥ | aiśvaryamabhijātaścajñātīnāṃmūrdhnyavasthitaḥ
translation: सौम्य: gentle, ततः therefore, अहम् I, लोकसत्कृतः worshipped by the people, ऐश्वर्यम् sovereignty, अभिजातःच: born of noble descent, ज्ञातीनाम् of the clan, मूध्नर्य: chief, अवस्थित: attained, इदम् this, नइष्टम् not like.
explanation: "Gentle (Vibheeshana) one Since you belong to the same kinsfolk (as I) you do not like me, who is born of noble descent, attained the position of chief (of clan), is worshipped by the world, and attained sovereignty."

shloka_text: यथापुष्करपत्रेषुपतितास्तोयबिन्दवः । नश्लेषमभिगच्छन्तितथाऽनार्येषुसङ्गतम् ।।6.16.11।।
transliteration: yathāpuṣkarapatreṣupatitāstoyabindavaḥ | naśleṣamabhigacchantitathā'nāryeṣusaṅgatam
translation: पुष्करपत्रेषु: on the lotus leaves, पतिताः fallen, तोयबिन्दवः drops of water, यथा: so also, श्लेषम् adhering to, न: not, अभिगच्छन्ति: however long you spend, अनार्येषु: with unworthy, सङ्गतम् good friendship, तथा: likewise.
explanation: "Just as drops of water that fall on lotus leaves do not adhere to each other, like wise however long you spend with an unworthy (relative) one, good friendship does not take place."

shloka_text: यथामधुकरस्तर्षाद्रसंविन्दन्नविद्यते । तथात्वमपितत्रैवतथानार्येषुसौहृदम् ।।6.16.12।।
transliteration: yathāmadhukarastarṣādrasaṃvindannavidyate | tathātvamapitatraivatathānāryeṣusauhṛdam
translation: यथा: that way, रसम् juice, विन्दन् gaining, मधुकरः honeybees, तर्षात् satisfying, नविद्यते: does not know, त्वमपि: you also, तथा: likewise, तत्रैवअनार्येषु: in the same way with unworthy ones, सौहृदम् making friendship, तथा: that way.
explanation: "Just as honeybees do not have gratitude after drinking (honey) and satisfying, the friendship with an unworthy person like you is of no use."

shloka_text: यथापूर्वंगजस्स्नात्वागृह्यहस्तेनवैरजः । दूषयत्यात्मनोदेहंतथानार्येषुसङ्गतम् ।।6.16.13।।
transliteration: yathāpūrvaṃgajassnātvāgṛhyahastenavairajaḥ | dūṣayatyātmanodehaṃtathānāryeṣusaṅgatam
translation: गजः elephant, पूर्वम् first, स्नात्वा: taking bath, हस्तेन: with its own trunk, रजः dust,गृह्य: taking, आत्मनः own, देहम् body, यथा: in the same way, दूषयति: abuses, तथा: that way, अनार्येषु: unworthy ones, सङ्गतम् association.
explanation: "Just as an elephant takes dust with its trunk and abuses (and spreads on) its own body after taking a bath so also is the association with unworthy ones."

shloka_text: यथाशरदिमेघानांसिञ्चतामपिगर्जताम् । नभवत्यम्बुसंक्लेदस्तथाऽनार्येषुसौहृदम् ।।6.16.14।।
transliteration: yathāśaradimeghānāṃsiñcatāmapigarjatām | nabhavatyambusaṃkledastathā'nāryeṣusauhṛdam
translation: शरदि: in autumn, गर्जतामपि: even the thundering, सिञ्चताम् water poured down, मेघानाम् from the clouds, अम्बुसंक्लेदः dampness created by water, यथा: in the same way, नभवति: not happen, अनार्येषु: unworthy, सौहृदम् affection.
explanation: "Just as the autumn rain poured out from the thundering clouds does not dampen, in the same way unworthy ones do not have affection."

shloka_text: यथामधुकरस्तर्षात्काशपुष्पंपिबन्नपि । रसमत्रनविन्देततथानार्वेषुसौहृदम् ।।6.16.15।।
transliteration: yathāmadhukarastarṣātkāśapuṣpaṃpibannapi | rasamatranavindetatathānārveṣusauhṛdam
translation: मधुकरः honey bees, तर्षात् on satisfying, काशपुष्पम् from the flower, पिबन्नपि: even after drinking, अत्र: stay here, रसम् the nectar, यथा: in the same way, नविन्देत: after getting, अनार्येषु: unworthy one, सौहृदम् friendships, तथा: likewise.
explanation: "Just as honeybees do not stay at the flower after satisfaction with the nectar, in the same way is the friendship with unworthy ones."

shloka_text: अन्यस्त्वेवंविधंब्रूयाद्वाक्यमेतन्निशाचर: । अस्मिन्मुहूर्तेनभवेत्त्वांतुधिक्कुलपांसन ।।6.16.16।।
transliteration: anyastvevaṃvidhaṃbrūyādvākyametanniśācara: | asminmuhūrtenabhavettvāṃtudhikkulapāṃsana
translation: निशाचर: night ranger, अन्यः others, यः whoever, एवंविधम् this kind of, एतत् in this way, वाक्यम् words, ब्रूयात् had spoken, अस्मिन् him, मुहूर्तेनभवेत् will not let him live this moment, कुलपांसनम् to destroy, त्वांतु: you also, धिक् fie.
explanation: "O Night ranger (Vibheeshana) If any other one had spoken such words, I would not let him live this moment and also destroy. Fie upon you."

shloka_text: इत्युक्तःपरुषंवाक्यंन्यायवादीविभीषणः । उत्पपातगदापाणिश्चतुर्भिस्सहराक्षसैः ।।6.6.17।।
transliteration: ityuktaḥparuṣaṃvākyaṃnyāyavādīvibhīṣaṇaḥ | utpapātagadāpāṇiścaturbhissaharākṣasaiḥ
translation: इति: this, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, उक्तः having spoken, न्यायवादी: one who is just in argument, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, गदापाणिः wielding the mace, चतुर्भिः with four, राक्षसैःसह: accompanied by Rakshasas, उत्पपात: rose up.
explanation: Vibheeshana who was just in his argument rose up, wielding mace in hand accompanied by the four Rakshasas, when Ravana had spoken such harsh words to him.

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्चतदावाक्यंजातक्रोधोविभीषणः । अन्तरिक्षगत्शीमान्भ्रातरंराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.16.18।।
transliteration: abravīccatadāvākyaṃjātakrodhovibhīṣaṇaḥ | antarikṣagatśīmānbhrātaraṃrākṣasādhipam
translation: जातक्रोधः enraged, श्रीमान् prosperous, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अन्तरिक्षगतः going into the sky, तदा: then, भ्रातरम् brother, राक्षसाधिपम् Lord of Rakshasas, अब्रवीच्च spoke.
explanation: Great Vibheeshana was enraged. Then going up into the sky spoke these words to his brother, the Lord of Rakshasas.

shloka_text: सत्वंभ्राताऽसिमेराजन्ब्रूहिमांयद्यदिच्छसि । ज्येष्टोमान्यःपितृसमोनचधर्मपथेस्थितः ।।6.16.19।। इदंतुपरुषंवाक्यंनक्षमाम्यग्रजस्यते ।
transliteration: satvaṃbhrātā'simerājanbrūhimāṃyadyadicchasi | jyeṣṭomānyaḥpitṛsamonacadharmapathesthitaḥ  idaṃtuparuṣaṃvākyaṃnakṣamāmyagrajasyate |
translation: राजन् O King, सःत्वम् that you, मे: my, भ्राता: brother, असि: being so, यद्यत् that which, इच्छसि: wish, माम् to me, ब्रूहि: to tell, ज्येष्ठः elder, पितृसमः equal to the father, धर्मपथे: righteous path, नचस्थितः not followed, मान्यः honour, आग्रजस्य: to elder brother, ते: to you, इदम् thus, वाक्यं: words तु: to you नक्षमामि: not pardonable.
explanation: "O King You, being my elder brother, you may tell me What you wish. You are equal to father being elder brother and are to be honoured. But you have not followed the righteous path. The words you spoke are not pardonable."

shloka_text: सुनीतंहितकामेनवाक्यमुक्तंदशानन: । नगृह्णन्त्यकृतात्मानःकालस्यवशमागताः ।।6.16.20।।
transliteration: sunītaṃhitakāmenavākyamuktaṃdaśānana: | nagṛhṇantyakṛtātmānaḥkālasyavaśamāgatāḥ
translation: दशानन: tenheaded one, कालस्य: of death, वशम् under the sway, आगताः fallen, अकृतात्मानः foolish one, हितकामेन: wishing your welfare, उक्तम् spoken, सुनीतम् well prepared, हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, नगृह्णन्ति: not understand.
explanation: "O Tenheaded king Fallen under the sway of death, you are foolish. You do not understand the well prepared good words spoken by me wishing your welfare."

shloka_text: सुलभाःपुरुषराजन् सततंप्रियवादिनः । अप्रियस्यचपथ्यस्यवक्ताश्रोताचदुर्लभः ।।6.16.21।।
transliteration: sulabhāḥpuruṣarājan satataṃpriyavādinaḥ | apriyasyacapathyasyavaktāśrotācadurlabhaḥ
translation: राजन् O king, सततम् always, प्रियवादिनः who speak pleasingly, पुरुषाः men, सुलभाः are easily found, अप्रियस्य: that which is unpleasant, पथ्यस्य: good words, वक्ता: speaker, श्रोताच: listener also, दुर्लभः difficult.
