explanation: "O King Those who speak pleasingly are always easier to find than those who speak unpleasant but good words. Listeners of unpleasant words (though good) are difficult (to find)."

shloka_text: बद्धंकालस्यपाशेनसर्वभूतापहारिणा । ननश्यन्तमुपेक्षेत्वांप्रदीप्तंशरणंयथा ।।6.16.22।।
transliteration: baddhaṃkālasyapāśenasarvabhūtāpahāriṇā | nanaśyantamupekṣetvāṃpradīptaṃśaraṇaṃyathā
translation: सर्वभूतापहारिणा: one who is cause for destruction of all beings, कालस्य: at death, पाशेन: by the noose, बद्दम् bound, नश्यन्तम् getting killed, त्वाम् you, प्रदीप्तम् blazing, शरणंयथा: house, नउपेक्षे: do not ignore.
explanation: "Bound by the noose of death which is the cause of destruction of all beings you are going to be killed just as the burning house if you ignore my advice."

shloka_text: दीप्तपावकसङ्काशैश्शितैःकाञ्चनभूषणैः । नत्वामिच्छाम्यहंद्रष्टुंरामेणनिहतंशरैः ।।6.16.23।।
transliteration: dīptapāvakasaṅkāśaiśśitaiḥkāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ | natvāmicchāmyahaṃdraṣṭuṃrāmeṇanihataṃśaraiḥ
translation: दीप्तपावकसङ्काशैः like burning fire, काञ्जनभूषणैः decorated with gold, शितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, रामेण: by Rama, निहतम् striking to kill, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, नइच्छामि: I do not wish.
explanation: "While the sharp golden arrows of Rama burning like fire strike you, I do not wish to see."

shloka_text: शूराश्चबलवन्तश्चकृतास्त्राश्चरणाजिरे । कालाभिपन्नास्सीदन्तियथावालुकसेतव ।।6.16.24।।
transliteration: śūrāścabalavantaścakṛtāstrāścaraṇājire | kālābhipannāssīdantiyathāvālukasetava
translation: रणाजिरे: in war, शूराः heroic archers, बलवन्तश्च: and mighty, कृतास्त्राश्च: those wielding arrows, नराः humans, कालाभिपन्नाः seized by death, वालुकसेतवयथा: just as the dams of sand, सीदन्ति: will fall.
explanation: "Even the heroic archers and mighty men wielding weapons will fall in war seized by death like the dams of sands."

shloka_text: तन्मर्षयतुयच्चोक्तंगुरुत्वाद्धितमिच्छता ।।6.16.25।। अत्मानंसर्वथारक्षपुरींचेमांसराक्षसाम् । स्वस्तितेऽस्तुगमिष्यामिसुखीभवमयाविना ।।6.16.26।।
transliteration: tanmarṣayatuyaccoktaṃgurutvāddhitamicchatā  atmānaṃsarvathārakṣapurīṃcemāṃsarākṣasām | svastite'stugamiṣyāmisukhībhavamayāvinā
translation: गुरुत्वात् as you are an elderly one, हितम् good advice, इच्छता: wished, यत् such, उक्तम् words spoken, तत् that, मर्षयतु: I may be excused, आत्मानम् yourself, सराक्षसाम् these Rakshasas, इमाम् this, पुरींच: capital city, सर्वथा: all, रक्षते: you protect, स्वस्ति: let you be auspicious, अस्तु: you be, गमिष्यामि: I will depart, मयाविना: without me, सुखीभव: let you be happy.
explanation: "Since you are an elderly one, I desired to tender good advice and spoke these words. I may be excused. You protect all these Rakshasas, this capital city and yourself after I depart. Let you be auspicious and be happy."

shloka_text: तन्मर्षयतुयच्चोक्तंगुरुत्वाद्धितमिच्छता ।।6.16.25।। अत्मानंसर्वथारक्षपुरींचेमांसराक्षसाम् । स्वस्तितेऽस्तुगमिष्यामिसुखीभवमयाविना ।।6.16.26।।
transliteration: tanmarṣayatuyaccoktaṃgurutvāddhitamicchatā  atmānaṃsarvathārakṣapurīṃcemāṃsarākṣasām | svastite'stugamiṣyāmisukhībhavamayāvinā
translation: गुरुत्वात् as you are an elderly one, हितम् good advice, इच्छता: wished, यत् such, उक्तम् words spoken, तत् that, मर्षयतु: I may be excused, आत्मानम् yourself, सराक्षसाम् these Rakshasas, इमाम् this, पुरींच: capital city, सर्वथा: all, रक्षते: you protect, स्वस्ति: let you be auspicious, अस्तु: you be, गमिष्यामि: I will depart, मयाविना: without me, सुखीभव: let you be happy.
explanation: "Since you are an elderly one, I desired to tender good advice and spoke these words. I may be excused. You protect all these Rakshasas, this capital city and yourself after I depart. Let you be auspicious and be happy."

shloka_text: निवार्यमाणस्यमयाहितैषिणानरोचतेतेवचनंनिशाचर: । परीतकालाहिगतायुषोनराहितंनगृह्णन्तिसुहृद्भिरीरितम् ।।6.16.27।।
transliteration: nivāryamāṇasyamayāhitaiṣiṇānarocatetevacanaṃniśācara: | parītakālāhigatāyuṣonarāhitaṃnagṛhṇantisuhṛdbhirīritam
translation: निशाचर: night ranger, हितैषिणा: in your interest, मया: by me, निवार्यमाणस्य: preventing you, ते: to you, वचनम् my words, नरोचते: not palatable, परीतकालाहि: at the time of death, गतायुषः those whose life is over, नराः beings, गतायुषः whose life is over, सुहृद्भि: friends, ईरितम् tendering, हितम् good advice, नगृह्णन्तिहि: will not receive.
explanation: "O King My words (of advice), given in your interest to prevent you, are not palatable to you. Good advice tendered by friends at the time of death will not be received by those beings whose life is over." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषोडशस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the sixteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वापरुषंवाक्यंरावणंरावणानुजः । आजगाममुहूर्तेनयत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ।।6.17.1।।
transliteration: ityuktvāparuṣaṃvākyaṃrāvaṇaṃrāvaṇānujaḥ | ājagāmamuhūrtenayatrarāmassalakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: रावणानुजः Ravana's brother, Vibheeshana, रावणम् to Ravana, इति: thus, परुषम् in harsh, वाक्यम् language, उक्त्वा: said, सलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, रामः Rama, यत्र: there, मुहूर्तेन: in a short while, आजगाम: reached.
explanation: Vibheeshana, having addressed Ravana in harsh language, reached Rama and Lakshmana in a short while.
comments: Vibheeshana goes to seek the help of Rama. Rama holds consultations with his ministers.

shloka_text: तंमेरुशिखराकारंदीप्तामिवशतह्रदाम् । गगनस्थंमहीस्थास्तेददृशुसर्ववानराः ।।6.17.2।।
transliteration: taṃmeruśikharākāraṃdīptāmivaśatahradām | gaganasthaṃmahīsthāstedadṛśusarvavānarāḥ
translation: महीस्थाः on the ground, सर्ववानराः all Vanaras, मेरुशिखराकारम् like the Mount Meru in form, दीप्ताम् shining, शतह्रदाम् इव: like a brilliant lightning, गगनस्थम् in the sky, तम् him, ददृशुः saw.
explanation: All the Vanaras on the ground saw Vibheeshana who was like Mount Meru in form and shining like a brilliant lightning.

shloka_text: येचाप्यनुचरास्तस्य चत्वारो भीमविक्रमा: । तेsपि सर्वायुधोपेता भूषणैश्चापि भूषिता ।।6.17.3।।
transliteration: yecāpyanucarāstasya catvāro bhīmavikramā: | tespi sarvāyudhopetā bhūṣaṇaiścāpi bhūṣitā
translation: येच: these, अनुचरा: companions, तस्य: his, चत्वार: four, भीमविक्रमा: or terrible prowess, ते s पि: they also, सर्वायुधोपेता: with all weapons, भूषणैश्चापि: with ornaments, भूषिता: adorned.
explanation: His four companions of terrific prowess were also there with him. They were wearing all weapons and were adorned with excellent ornaments.

shloka_text: स च मेघाचलप्रख्यो वज्रायुधसमप्रभः । वरायुधधरो वीरो दिव्याभरणभूषितः ।।6.17.4।।
transliteration: sa ca meghācalaprakhyo vajrāyudhasamaprabhaḥ | varāyudhadharo vīro divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ
translation: स च And that Vibheeshana, मेघाचलप्रख्यो resembling a mass of cloud, वज्रायुधसमप्रभः the equal of the God who wields the thunderbolt, वीरो valiant man, वरायुधधरो wearing excellent weapons, दिव्याभरणभूषितः and adorned with wonderful jewels.
explanation: Vibheeshana looked like a mass of cloud, like someone who can cause thunderbolt, possessing excellent weapons and wonderful jewels.

shloka_text: तमात्मपञ्चमंदृष्टवासुग्रीवोवाहिनीपति: । वानरैस्सहदुर्धर्षचिन्तयामासबुद्धिमान् ।।6.17.5।।
transliteration: tamātmapañcamaṃdṛṣṭavāsugrīvovāhinīpati: | vānaraissahadurdharṣacintayāmāsabuddhimān
translation: दुर्धर्षः formidable one, बुद्धिमान् wise one, वाहिनीपति: Lord of the Vanara army, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, आत्मपञ्चमम् the fifth one besides four others, तम् him, दृष्टवा: on seeing, वानरैःसह: along with Vanaras चिन्तयामास: started thinking.
explanation: Wise Sugriva the Lord of the Vanara army, a formidable one along with Vanaras, started thinking on seeing Vibheeshana (the fifth one) besides four others.

shloka_text: चिन्तयित्वामुहूर्तंतुवानरांस्तानुवाचह । हनुमत्प्रमुखान्सर्वानिदंवचनमुत्तमम् ।।6.17.6।।
transliteration: cintayitvāmuhūrtaṃtuvānarāṃstānuvācaha | hanumatpramukhānsarvānidaṃvacanamuttamam
translation: मुहूर्तम् for a while, चिन्तयित्वा: reflecting, हनुमत् प्रमुखान् leader Hanuman, तान् those, सर्वान् all, वानरान् Vanaras, उत्तमम् best, इदम् these, वचनम् words, उवाचह: addressed.
explanation: Reflecting for a while he addressed Hanuman and the other Vanara leaders in this way.

shloka_text: एषसर्वायुधोपेतश्चतुर्भिस्सहराक्षसैः । राक्षसोऽभ्येतिपश्यध्वमस्मान्हन्तुंनसंशयः ।।6.17.7।।
transliteration: eṣasarvāyudhopetaścaturbhissaharākṣasaiḥ | rākṣaso'bhyetipaśyadhvamasmānhantuṃnasaṃśayaḥ
translation: सर्वायुधोपेतः armed with all kinds of weapons, एषःराक्षसः this Rakshasa, चतुर्भिराक्षसैःसह: along with four Rakshasas, अभ्येति: coming near, पश्यध्वम् you may see, अस्मान् us, हन्तुम् to attack, संशयः doubt, नः no.
explanation: Armed with all kinds of weapons this Rakshasa along with four Rakshasas are coming near to attack. You may see. There is no doubt.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवस्यवचश्रुत्वासर्वेतेवानरोत्तमाः । सालानुद्यम्यशैलांश्चइदंवचनमब्रुवन् ।।6.17.8।।
transliteration: sugrīvasyavacaśrutvāsarvetevānarottamāḥ | sālānudyamyaśailāṃścaidaṃvacanamabruvan
translation: सर्वे: all, तेवानरोत्तमाः those Vanara leaders, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, सालान् Sala trees, शैलांश्च: boulders, उद्यम्य: taking up, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रुवन् uttered.
explanation: Having heard Sugriva's words, all the Vanara leaders taking up Sala trees and boulders uttered these words.

shloka_text: शीघ्रंव्यादिशनोराजन्वधायैषांदुरात्मनाम् । निपतन्तुहताश्चैतेधरण्यामल्पतेजसः ।।6.17.9।।
transliteration: śīghraṃvyādiśanorājanvadhāyaiṣāṃdurātmanām | nipatantuhatāścaitedharaṇyāmalpatejasaḥ
translation: राजन् O king दुरात्मनाम् evil minded, एषाम् these, वधाय: to kill, शीघ्रम् quickly, व्यादिश: order, अल्पतेजसा: being short of life, हता: killed, धरण्याम  on the ground, निपतन्तु: will fall down.
explanation: "O King Order us to kill these evil minded ones at once. Being mortals and of short life, on striking, all of them will fall down dead on the ground."

shloka_text: तेषासम्भाषमाणानामन्योन्यंसविभीषणः । उत्तरंतीरमासाद्यखस्थएवव्यतिष्ठत ।।6.17.10।।
transliteration: teṣāsambhāṣamāṇānāmanyonyaṃsavibhīṣaṇaḥ | uttaraṃtīramāsādyakhasthaevavyatiṣṭhata
translation: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, उत्तरम् northern, तीरम् shore, आसाद्य: having reached तेषाम् there, अन्योन्यम् one to the other, सम्भाषमाणानाम् started conversing, खस्थःएव: in the sky, व्यतिष्ठत: stayed.
explanation: As they (Vanaras) started conversing, Vibheeshana, having reached the northern shore, stayed in the sky.

shloka_text: उवाचमहाप्राज्ञस्स्वरेणमहतामहान् । सुग्रीवंतांश्चसम्प्रेक्ष्यसर्वान्वानरयूथपान् ।।6.17.11।।
transliteration: uvācamahāprājñassvareṇamahatāmahān | sugrīvaṃtāṃścasamprekṣyasarvānvānarayūthapān
translation: महाप्राज्ञः very wise, महान् great, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवम् at Sugriva, तांश्च: and those (Vanaras ), सम्प्रेक्ष्य: gazing, सर्वान् all, महता: loud, स्वरेण: tone, उवाच: addressed.
explanation: Great and very wise Vibheeshana, gazing at Sugriva and the Vanaras, addressed them in a loud tone.

shloka_text: रावणोनामदुर्वृत्तोराक्षसोराक्षसेश्वरः । तस्याहमनुजोभ्राताविभीषणइतिश्रुतः ।।6.17.12।।
transliteration: rāvaṇonāmadurvṛttorākṣasorākṣaseśvaraḥ | tasyāhamanujobhrātāvibhīṣaṇaitiśrutaḥ
translation: रावणोनाम: Ravana by name, दुर्वृत्तः of evil conduct, राक्षसेश्वरः king of Rakshasas, राक्षसः Rakshasa, अहम् I, तस्य: his, अनुजःभ्राता: younger brother, विभीषणइति: as Vibheeshana, श्रुतः called.
explanation: "I am called Vibheeshana, the younger brother of Ravana, the king of Rakshasas and of evil conduct."

shloka_text: तेनसीताजनस्थानाद्धृताहत्वाजटायुषम् । रुद्दाचविवशादीनाराक्षसीभिस्सुरक्षिता ।।6.17.13।।
transliteration: tenasītājanasthānāddhṛtāhatvājaṭāyuṣam | ruddācavivaśādīnārākṣasībhissurakṣitā
translation: तेन: by him, जटायुषम् Jatayu, हत्वा: killing, सीता: Sita, जनस्थानात् from Janasthana, हृता: having been carried away, रुद्दा: detained, विवशा: poor, दीना: pitiable, राक्षसीभिः by Rakshasas, सुरक्षिता: protected.
explanation: "Having been carried away from Janasthana by him (Ravana) poor and pitiable Sita is detained and protected by the Rakshasas."

shloka_text: तमहंहेतुभिर्वाक्यैर्विविधैश्चन्यदर्शयम् । साधुनिर्यात्यतांसीतारामायेतिपुनःपुनः ।।6.17.14।।
transliteration: tamahaṃhetubhirvākyairvividhaiścanyadarśayam | sādhuniryātyatāṃsītārāmāyetipunaḥpunaḥ
translation: सीता: Sita, साधु: correct, रामाय: to Rama, निर्यात्यताम् इति: to restore, पुनःपुनः again and again, तम् him, अहम् I, हेतुभिः argued also, विविधैः in several ways, वाक्यैः words, न्यदर्शयम् to explain.
explanation: "I argued with him again and again in several ways to explain him and admonished him saying 'restore Sita to Rama'."

shloka_text: सचनप्रतिजग्राहरावणःकालचोदितः । उच्यमानंहितंवाक्यंविपरीतइवौषधम् ।।6.17.15।।
transliteration: sacanapratijagrāharāvaṇaḥkālacoditaḥ | ucyamānaṃhitaṃvākyaṃviparītaivauṣadham
translation: सःरावणः that Ravana, कालचोदितः impelled by death, उच्यमानम् advice tendered, हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, विपरीतः contrary to, औषधम् इव: like the medicine, नप्रतिजग्राह: would not take.
explanation: "Impelled by death Ravana would not take good words of advice tendered to him just as one who is impelled by death does not take medicine."

shloka_text: सोऽहंपरुषितस्तेनदासवच्चावमानितः । त्यक्त्वापुत्रांश्चदारांश्चराघवंशरणंगतः ।।6.17.16।।
transliteration: so'haṃparuṣitastenadāsavaccāvamānitaḥ | tyaktvāputrāṃścadārāṃścarāghavaṃśaraṇaṃgataḥ
translation: तेन: by him, परुषितः spoken to harshly, दासवत् treated like a slave, अवमानितः having been put to shame, सःअहम् that I, पुत्रांश्चदारांश्च: sons and wife, त्वक्त्वा: giving up, राघवम् of Raghava, शरणंगतः came for protection.
explanation: "Leaving my sons and wife, I have come for protection of Raghava having been put to shame by him (Ravana), spoken to harshly and treated like a slave."

shloka_text: सर्वलोकशरण्यायराघवायमहात्मने । निवेदयतमांक्षिप्रंविभीषणमुपस्थितम् ।।6.17.17।।
transliteration: sarvalokaśaraṇyāyarāghavāyamahātmane | nivedayatamāṃkṣipraṃvibhīṣaṇamupasthitam
translation: महात्मने: O great soul, सर्वलोकशरण्याय: one who is a protector of the whole world, राघवाय: Raghava's, विभीषणं: Vibheeshana, माम् I, उपस्थितम् waiting here, क्षिप्रम् at once, निवेदयत: you may inform.
explanation: At once you may inform Raghava who is a protector of the whole world that I, Vibheeshana, are waiting here.

shloka_text: एतत्तुवचनंश्रुत्वासुग्रीवोलघुविक्रमः । लक्ष्मणस्याग्रतोरामंसम्रब्धमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.17.18।।
transliteration: etattuvacanaṃśrutvāsugrīvolaghuvikramaḥ | lakṣmaṇasyāgratorāmaṃsamrabdhamidamabravīt
translation: लघुविक्रमः highly valiant, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, एतत् all this, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, लक्ष्मणस्य: Lakshmana's, अग्रतः presence, रामम् Rama's, सम्रब्धतरम् eagerly, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoken.
explanation: Highly valiant Sugriva having heard all this (from Vibheeshana) eagerly spoke these words to Rama in the presence of Lakshmana.

shloka_text: रावणस्यानुजोभ्राताविभीषणइतिश्रुतः । चतुर्भिस्सहरक्षोभिर्भवन्तंशरणंगतः ।।6.17.19।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasyānujobhrātāvibhīṣaṇaitiśrutaḥ | caturbhissaharakṣobhirbhavantaṃśaraṇaṃgataḥ
translation: विभीषणःइति: thus Vibheeshana, श्रुतः heard, रावणस्य: Ravana's, अनुजःभ्रातः younger brother, चतुर्भिः all the four, रक्षोभिःसह: along with Rakshasas, भवन्तम्: to you शरणम् protection, गतः sought.
explanation: "Ravana's younger brother, known as Vibheeshana, along with four Rakshasas has come to you seeking protection."

shloka_text: मन्त्रेव्यूहेनयेचारेयुक्तोभवितुमर्हसि । वानराणांचभद्रंतेपरेषांचपरन्तप ।।6.17.20।।
transliteration: mantrevyūhenayecāreyuktobhavitumarhasi | vānarāṇāṃcabhadraṃtepareṣāṃcaparantapa
translation: परन्तप: scorcher of foes, वानराणांच: for Vanaras also, परेषांच: alert, मंत्रे: in deliberations, व्यूहे: in plan, नये: a method, चारे: of spies, युक्तः joined together, भवितुम् What is to be done in future, अर्हसि: let it be ते: to you, भद्रम् safety.
explanation: "O Scorcher of enemies For Vanara's safety and considering to be spies also you should be alert in your deliberations, with a plan and policy in moving together and deciding what is to be done. Let you be safe."

shloka_text: अन्तर्धानगताह्येतेराक्षसाःकामरूपिणः । शूराश्चनिकृतिज्ञाश्चतेषांजातुनविश्वसेत् ।।6.17.21।।
transliteration: antardhānagatāhyeterākṣasāḥkāmarūpiṇaḥ | śūrāścanikṛtijñāścateṣāṃjātunaviśvaset
translation: एतेराक्षसा: these Rakshasas, कामरूपिणः who can change their form at their will, अन्तर्धानगताः who can move about without bein g seen, शूराः heroic, निकृतिज्ञाश्च: who are crafty, तेषाम् them, जातु: know, नविश्वसेत् not to be trusted.
explanation: "Know that these Rakshasas are heroic, crafty and cannot be trusted. They can change their form at will and can move about without being seen."

shloka_text: प्रणिधीराक्षसेन्द्रस्यरावणस्यभवेदयम् । अनुप्रविश्यसोऽस्मासुभेदंकुर्यान्नसंशयः ।।6.17.22।।
transliteration: praṇidhīrākṣasendrasyarāvaṇasyabhavedayam | anupraviśyaso'smāsubhedaṃkuryānnasaṃśayaḥ
translation: अयम् this one, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य: Rakshasa king's, रावणस्य: Ravana's, प्रणिधिः spy, भवेत् may be, सः he, अनुप्रविशय: having found a way to enter, अस्मासु: to our place, भेदम् difference, कूर्यात् to create, संशयः doubt, न: no.
explanation: "This Rakshasa may be a spy who has found entry into our camp to create differences (among us). No doubt about it."

shloka_text: अथवास्वयमेवैषछिद्रमासाद्यबुद्धिमान् । अनुप्रविश्यविश्वस्तेकदाचित्प्रहरेदपि ।।6.17.23।।
transliteration: athavāsvayamevaiṣachidramāsādyabuddhimān | anupraviśyaviśvastekadācitpraharedapi
translation: अथवा: or else, बुद्धिमान् a wise one, एषः in this manner, स्वयमेव: on his own, छिद्रम् weak points, आसाद्य: having reached, अनुप्रविश्य: having found way, विश्वस्ते: if trusted, प्रहरेदपि: strike, कदाचित् perhaps.
explanation: "Or else if he is a wise one and knows our weak points, might have found a way and reached us. He may strike us if he is trusted."

shloka_text: मित्राटवीबलंचैवमौलभृत्यबलंतथा । सर्वमेतद्बलंग्राह्यंवर्जयित्वाद्विषद्बलम् ।।6.17.24।।
transliteration: mitrāṭavībalaṃcaivamaulabhṛtyabalaṃtathā | sarvametadbalaṃgrāhyaṃvarjayitvādviṣadbalam
translation: मित्राटवीबलंचैव: army of friends or army from a jungle, तथा: so also, मौलभृत्यबलम् army brought up by the king for generations, एतत् that way, सर्वम् all, बलम् kinds of army, द्विषद्बलम् army that is obtained by payment, वर्जयित्वा: apart from (enemies), ग्राह्यम् can be accepted.
explanation: Army of friends or army from a jungle, so also an army brought up by a king for generations, army obtained on payment and all kinds of army except for enemies can be accepted.

shloka_text: प्रकृत्याराक्षसेन्द्रस्यभ्राताऽमित्रस्यतेप्रभो: । आगतश्चरिपोस्साक्षात्कथमस्मिन्हिविश्वसेत् ।।6.17.25।।
transliteration: prakṛtyārākṣasendrasyabhrātā'mitrasyateprabho: | āgataścaripossākṣātkathamasminhiviśvaset
translation: प्रभो: O king एषः these, प्रकृत्या by nature, राक्षसोहि: Rakshasas also, अमित्रस्य: enemy's, भ्राता: brother, साक्षात् evidently, रिपोः enemies, आगतः arrived, आस्मिन् himself, कथम् how, विश्वसेत् to trust.
explanation: "O king, by nature they are Rakshasas, and he is brother of the enemy. Evidently, he has arrived by himself. How to trust him?"

shloka_text: रावणेनप्रणिहितंतमवेहिविभीषणम् । तस्याहंनिग्रहंमन्येक्षमंक्षमवतांवर ।।6.17.26।।
transliteration: rāvaṇenapraṇihitaṃtamavehivibhīṣaṇam | tasyāhaṃnigrahaṃmanyekṣamaṃkṣamavatāṃvara
translation: क्षमवताम् one who is forbearing, वर: choicest one, तम् him, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, रावणेन: by Ravana, प्रणितम् sent by, अवेहि: to consider, तस्य: his, निग्रहम् arrest क्षमम् fit, अहम् I, मन्ये: think.
explanation: "O Rama of most forbearing nature Vibheeshana is sent by Ravana. You may consider that he is fit to be arrested, I think."

shloka_text: राक्षसोजिह्मयाबुद्ध्यासंदिष्टोऽयमुपागतः । प्रहर्तुंमाययाच्छन्नोविश्वस्तेत्वयिराघव ।।6.17.27।।
transliteration: rākṣasojihmayābuddhyāsaṃdiṣṭo'yamupāgataḥ | prahartuṃmāyayācchannoviśvastetvayirāghava
translation: राघव: Raghava, अयम्: this, राक्षसः Rakshasa, जिह्मया: with a crooked, बुदद्या: you may know, संदिष्ट: being send, मायया: by deceit, छन्नः under the cover, विश्वस्ते: creating confidence, त्वयि: to you, प्रहर्तुम् to strike you, इह: here, आगतः came.
explanation: "O Raghava You may know that this Rakshasa is being sent here by deceit ever intending to strike you under the cover of creating confidence."

shloka_text: प्रविष्टश्शत्रुसैन्यंहिप्राप्तश्शत्रुरतर्कितः । निहन्यादन्तरंलब्ध्वाउलूकवायसानिव ।।6.17.28।।
transliteration: praviṣṭaśśatrusainyaṃhiprāptaśśatruratarkitaḥ | nihanyādantaraṃlabdhvāulūkavāyasāniva
translation: प्रविष्टहि: just as one who entered, अतर्कितः not to suspect, प्राप्तः one who appeared, शत्रुसैन्यम् enemy's army, शत्रुः enemy, अन्तरम् inside the hole, लब्ध्वा: having got access, उलूकः an owl, वायसानिव: like crows, निहन्यात् after killing.
explanation: "One who entered the enemy's camp and had access to come inside kills the enemies. It is like an owl killing many crows having entered the hole."

shloka_text: वध्यतामेषतीव्रेणदण्डेनसचिवैस्सह । रावणस्यनृशंसस्यभ्राताह्येषविभीषणः ।।6.17.29।।
transliteration: vadhyatāmeṣatīvreṇadaṇḍenasacivaissaha | rāvaṇasyanṛśaṃsasyabhrātāhyeṣavibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: एषः that way, सचिवैः with ministers, तीव्रेण: severe, दण्डेन: by punishment, वध्यताम् will kill, एषःविभीषणः this Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: cruel, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: is Ravana's brother.
explanation: "Let us kill this Vibheeshana by punishment along with his ministers as he is the brother of cruel Ravana (said Sugriva to Rama)."

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वातुतंरामंसम्रब्धोवाहिनीपतिः । वाक्यज्ञोवाक्यकुशलंततोमौनमुपागमत् ।।6.17.30।।
transliteration: evamuktvātutaṃrāmaṃsamrabdhovāhinīpatiḥ | vākyajñovākyakuśalaṃtatomaunamupāgamat
translation: वाहिनीपतिः the chief of the army, वाक्यज्ञः one who knows to speak, सम्रब्ध: well, वाक्यकुशलम् one who was adept in expression, तंरामम् him, to Rama, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा: after having spoken, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.
explanation: The chief of the army (Sugriva) who knew how to speak appropriately having submitted in that manner to Rama who was adept in expression remained silent.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवस्यतुतद्वाक्यंश्रुत्वारामोमहायशाः । समीपस्थानुवाचेदंहनुमत्प्रमुखान्हरीन् ।।6.17.31।।
transliteration: sugrīvasyatutadvākyaṃśrutvārāmomahāyaśāḥ | samīpasthānuvācedaṃhanumatpramukhānharīn
translation: महायशाः of great fame, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, तत् those words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, समीपस्थान् stood close by, हनुमत्प्रमुखान् including the great Hanuman, हरीन् to Vanaras, इदम् thus, उवाच: addressed.
explanation: Rama of great fame having heard the words of Sugriva, addressed the Vanara army including the great Hanuman who stood close by.

shloka_text: यदुक्तंकपिराजेनरावणावरजंप्रति । वाक्यंहेतुमदत्यर्थंचभवद्भिरपितच्छ्रुतम् ।।6.17.32।।
transliteration: yaduktaṃkapirājenarāvaṇāvarajaṃprati | vākyaṃhetumadatyarthaṃcabhavadbhirapitacchrutam
translation: रावणावरजंप्रति: about Ravana's brother, कपिराजेन: by the king of Vanaras, अत्यर्थम् highly reasonable, हेतुमत् words of reason, यत् those, वाक्यम् words, उक्तम् having spoken, भवद्भिरपि: even by you, श्रुतम् has been heard.
explanation: "The highly reasonable words of advice given by the king of Vanaras about Ravana's brother was heard even by you."

shloka_text: सुहृदामर्थकृच्छेषुयुक्तंबुद्धिमतासदा । समर्थेनोपनिर्देष्टुंशाश्वतींभूतिमिच्छता ।।6.17.33।।
transliteration: suhṛdāmarthakṛccheṣuyuktaṃbuddhimatāsadā | samarthenopanirdeṣṭuṃśāśvatīṃbhūtimicchatā
translation: शाश्वतीम् everlasting, भूतिम् welfare, इच्छता: desirable, समर्थेन: capable, बुद्धिमता: wise one, सदा: ever, सुहृदाम् to near and dear ones, अर्थकृच्छ्रेषु: in difficult situation on complex matter, निर्देष्टुम्: to express, युक्तम् is proper.
explanation: "It is always desirable to seek everlasting advice for one's welfare from capable and wise ones by the near and dear ones. It is proper to seek advice on complex matters by one who is in a difficult situation."

shloka_text: इत्येवंपरिपृष्टास्तेस्वंस्वंमतमतन्द्रिताः । सोपचारंतदाराममूचुर्हितचिकीर्षवः ।।6.17.34।।
transliteration: ityevaṃparipṛṣṭāstesvaṃsvaṃmatamatandritāḥ | sopacāraṃtadārāmamūcurhitacikīrṣavaḥ
translation: तदा: then, इत्येवम् in this manner, परिपृष्टाः having told, ते: you, अतन्द्रिताः vigilant, हितचिकीर्षवः beneficial advice, सोपचारम् respectfully an end, स्वंस्वम् one's own, मतम् opinion, राम् Rama, ऊचुः spoke.
explanation: The Vanaras having heard the words spoken by Rama in that way, tendered beneficial advice and their own opinion respectfully, to be vigilant.

shloka_text: अज्ञातंनास्तितेकिंचित्त्रिषुलोकेषुराघव: । आत्मानंसूचयन्राम: पृच्छस्यस्मान् सुहृत्तया ।।6.17.35।।
transliteration: ajñātaṃnāstitekiṃcittriṣulokeṣurāghava: | ātmānaṃsūcayanrāma: pṛcchasyasmān suhṛttayā
translation: राघव: Raghava, त्रिषु: in the three, लोकेषु: worlds, ते: to you, अज्ञातम् that which, किंचित् nothing, नास्ति: is not there, आत्मानम् you yourself, सूचयन् to give our opinion, पृच्छसि: ask, अस्मान: to us, सुह्रत्तया: out of friendship.
explanation: "O Raghava there is nothing unknown to you in the three worlds. You are asking our opinion (giving us the honour) out of friendship."

shloka_text: त्वंहिसत्यव्रतश्शूरोधार्मिकोदृढविक्रमः । परीक्ष्यकारीस्मृतिमान्निसृष्टात्मासुहृत्सुच ।।6.17.36।।
transliteration: tvaṃhisatyavrataśśūrodhārmikodṛḍhavikramaḥ | parīkṣyakārīsmṛtimānnisṛṣṭātmāsuhṛtsuca
translation: त्वम् you, सत्यव्रतः one who follows vows truthfully, शूरः heroic, धार्मिकः one who is righteous, दृढविक्रमः firm in resolve, परीक्ष्यकारी: one who is capable of good judgment, स्मृतिमान् one who has good memory of laws of the past, सुहृत्सु: to your friends, निसृष्टात्माच: and committed in heart.
explanation: "You are a truthful follower of vows, a heroic and righteous one. You are firm in your resolve, capable of good judgment, have a good memory of the past traditions and committed in heart to your friends."

shloka_text: तस्मादेकैकशस्तावद्ब्रुवन्तुसचिवास्तव । हेतुतोमतिसम्पन्नास्समर्थाश्चपुन: पुनः ।।6.17.37।।
transliteration: tasmādekaikaśastāvadbruvantusacivāstava | hetutomatisampannāssamarthāścapuna: punaḥ
translation: तस्मात् for that reason, मतिसम्पन्नाः richly endowed with intelligence, समर्थाश्च: capable also, पुनःपुनः again and again, तवसचिवाः your ministers, एकैकशः one after another, हेतुतः with reason, ब्रुवन्तु: speak out, तावत् like that.
explanation: "On account of that reason, since your ministers are richly endowed with intelligence let them speak out again and again, one after the other in that way."

shloka_text: इत्युक्तेराघवायाऽथमतिमानङ्गदोऽग्रतः । विभीषणपरीक्षार्थमुवाचवचनंहरिः ।।6.17.38।।
transliteration: ityukterāghavāyā'thamatimānaṅgado'grataḥ | vibhīṣaṇaparīkṣārthamuvācavacanaṃhariḥ
translation: इति: so, उक्ते: having said, अथ: then, हरिः Vanara, मतिमान् intelligent, अङ्गदः Angada, राघवाय: to Rama, अग्रतः immediately, विभीषणपरीक्षार्थम् for the sake of judging Vibheeshana, वचनम् these words, उवाच: spoken.
explanation: Having said so, Angada the intelligent Vanara spoke these words immediately to Rama for judging Vibheeshana.

shloka_text: शत्रोस्सकाशात्सम्प्राप्तस्सर्वथाशङ् क्यएवहि । विश्वासयोग्यस्सहसानकर्तव्योविभीषणः ।।6.17.39।।
transliteration: śatrossakāśātsamprāptassarvathāśaṅ kyaevahi | viśvāsayogyassahasānakartavyovibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: शत्रोः enemy, सकाशात् from the camp, सम्प्राप्तः having come, विभीषण: Vibheeshana, सर्वथा: in every way, शङ् क्या: doubtful, एवहि: surely, सहसा: suddenly, विश्वासयोग्यः worthy to be trusted, नकर्तव्यः not to be.
explanation: "Since he has come from the enemy's camp suddenly, surely Vibheeshana is to be suspected in every way. He is not worthy to be trusted."

shloka_text: छादयित्वाऽत्मभावंहिचरन्तिशठबुद्धयः । प्रहरन्तिचरन्ध्रेषुसोऽनर्थस्सुमहान्भवेत् ।।6.17.40।।
transliteration: chādayitvā'tmabhāvaṃhicarantiśaṭhabuddhayaḥ | praharanticarandhreṣuso'narthassumahānbhavet
translation: शठबुद्धयः one with perfidious mind, आत्मभावम् one's own feeling, छादयित्वा: concealing, चरन्तिहि: keep moving about, रन्ध्रेषु: a weak point, प्रहरन्तिच and attack, सः he, महान् great, अनर्थः inestimable mistake, भवेत् will be.
explanation: "One who has a perfidious mind keeps moving about concealing his intention and will attack at weak points, which will be a great inestimable mistake."

shloka_text: अर्थानर्थौविनिश्चित्यव्यवसायंभजेतह । गुणतस्सङ्ग्रहंकुर्याद्दोषतस्तुविसर्जयेत् ।।6.17.41।।
transliteration: arthānarthauviniścityavyavasāyaṃbhajetaha | guṇatassaṅgrahaṃkuryāddoṣatastuvisarjayet
translation: अर्थानर्थौ: advantages and disadvantages, विनिश्चित्य: ascertaining, व्यवसायम् course of action, भजेत: follows, गुणतः by virtue, सङ्ग्रहम् take hold of, कुर्यात् act, दोषतस्तु: if faulty, विसर्जयेत् should give up.
explanation: Ascertaining advantages and disadvantages one should take the right course of action, by acting if it is virtuous and giving up if it is faulty.

shloka_text: यदिदोषोमहांस्तस्मिंस्त्यज्वतामविशङ्कितम् । गुणान्वापिबहून् ज्ञात्वासङ्ग्रहःक्रियतांनृप ।।6.17.42।।
transliteration: yadidoṣomahāṃstasmiṃstyajvatāmaviśaṅkitam | guṇānvāpibahūn jñātvāsaṅgrahaḥkriyatāṃnṛpa
translation: नृप: king, तस्मिन् in him, महान् great, दोषःयदि: if one has bad qualities, अविशङ्कितम् no doubt, त्यज्यताम् to be rejected, बहून् many, गुणान् virtues, ज्ञात्वावापि: knowing them also, सङ्ग्रहः let us take, क्रियताम् we will.
explanation: "If there are great bad qualities (in Vibheeshana) no doubt he has to be rejected. If there are many virtues let us take him knowing them also."

shloka_text: शरभस्त्वथनिश्चित्यसार्थंवचनमब्रवीत् । क्षिप्रमस्मिन्नरव्याघ्र  चारःप्रतिविधीयताम् ।।6.17.43।।
transliteration: śarabhastvathaniścityasārthaṃvacanamabravīt | kṣipramasminnaravyāghra  cāraḥpratividhīyatām
translation: नरव्याघ्र: tiger among men, अथ: and now, शरभस्तु: Sarabha too, निश्चित्य: decided, सार्थम् meaningful, वचनम् अब्रवीत् tendered words, अस्मिन् in this, क्षिप्रम् at once, चारः spy, प्रतिविधीयताम् shall be assigned to cover him.
explanation: "Sarabha has also decided and spoken these meaningful words of advice." O Tiger among men Let a spy be assigned to cover him at once."

shloka_text: प्रणिधायहिचारेणयथावत्सूक्ष्मबुद्धिना । परीक्ष्यचततःकार्योयथान्यायंपरिग्रहः ।।6.17.44।।
transliteration: praṇidhāyahicāreṇayathāvatsūkṣmabuddhinā | parīkṣyacatataḥkāryoyathānyāyaṃparigrahaḥ
translation: प्रणिधाय: employing spies, सूक्ष्मबुद्धिना: who has subtle intellect, चारेण: by a spy, यथावत् in the same way, परीक्ष्यच after examining, ततः thereafter, यथान्यायम् in appropriate manner, परिग्रहः accept, कार्यः action.
explanation: "By employing a spy with subtle intellect to examine Vibheeshana, we can act in an appropriate manner to accept him (Vibheeshana)."

shloka_text: जाम्बवांस्त्वथसम्प्रेक्ष्यशास्त्रबुध्याविचक्षणः । वाक्यंविज्ञापयामासगुणवद्दोषवर्जितम् ।।6.17.45।।
transliteration: jāmbavāṃstvathasamprekṣyaśāstrabudhyāvicakṣaṇaḥ | vākyaṃvijñāpayāmāsaguṇavaddoṣavarjitam
translation: अथ: and then, विचक्षणः one who has sense of discrimination, जाम्बवांस्तु: even Jambavan also, शास्त्रबुध्या: enlightened one, सम्प्रेक्ष्य: considering, गुणवत् full of virtues, दोषवर्जितम् free from flaws, वाक्यम् statement, विज्ञापयामास: made this sub mission.
explanation: Then, enlightened Jambavan who was endowed with sense of discrimination, considering all facts made his submission which was free from flaws.

shloka_text: बद्धवैराच्चपापाच्चराक्षेसेन्द्राद्विभीषणः । अदेशकालेसम्प्राप्तस्सर्वथाशङ् क्यतामयम् ।।6.17.46।।
transliteration: baddhavairāccapāpāccarākṣesendrādvibhīṣaṇaḥ | adeśakālesamprāptassarvathāśaṅ kyatāmayam
translation: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, बद्धवैराच्च: one who has conceived bitter hatred, पापात् sinful one, राक्षसेन्द्रात् towards Rakshasa king, अदेशकाले: without regard for time and place, सम्प्राप्तः having come, आयम् this, सर्वथा: always, शङ् क्यताम् viewed with suspicion.
explanation: "Vibheeshana who has conceived bitter hatred towards the sinful Rakshasa king Ravana came without regard for place and time is always to be viewed with suspicion."

shloka_text: ततोमैन्दस्तुसम्प्रेक्ष्यनयापनयकोविदः । वाक्यंवचनसम्पन्नोबभाषेहेतुमत्तरम् ।।6.17.47।।
transliteration: tatomaindastusamprekṣyanayāpanayakovidaḥ | vākyaṃvacanasampannobabhāṣehetumattaram
translation: ततः then, नयापनयकोविदः prudent in making policy, वचनसम्पन्नः rich in expression, मैन्दस्तु: Mainda, सम्प्रेक्ष्य: considering, हेतुमत्तरम् fully logical, वाक्यम् statement बभाषे: expressed.
explanation: "Mainda, who was prudent in making policy and rich in expression, considering all facts expressed this statement that was fully logical."

shloka_text: वजनंनामतस्यैषरावणस्यविभीषणः । पृच्छयतांमधुरेणायंशनैर्नरपतीश्वर ।।6.17.48।।
transliteration: vajanaṃnāmatasyaiṣarāvaṇasyavibhīṣaṇaḥ | pṛcchayatāṃmadhureṇāyaṃśanairnarapatīśvara
translation: नरपतीश्वर: O king of the mortals, एषः this is, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, तस्य: his, रावणस्य: Ravana's, वचनं: words नाम: indeed, आयम् for long, मधुरेण: gently, शनैः slowly, पृच्छयताम् be interrogated.
explanation: "O king of mortals This is Ravana's brother called Vibheeshana. Let him be slowly and gently interrogated for long."

shloka_text: भावमस्यतुविज्ञायतत्त्वतस्त्वंकरिष्यसि । यदिदुष्टोनदुष्टोवाबुद्धिपूर्वंनरर्षभ ।।6.17.49।।
transliteration: bhāvamasyatuvijñāyatattvatastvaṃkariṣyasi | yadiduṣṭonaduṣṭovābuddhipūrvaṃnararṣabha
translation: नरर्षभ: O best of kings, अस्य: his, भावम् intention, तत्त्वतः truly, विज्ञाय: after ascertaining, दुष्टोयदि: if he is wicked, नदुष्टोवा: or not wicked also, बुद्धिपूर्वम् wisely, त्वम् you, करिष्यसि: act accordingly.
explanation: "O Best of kings After truly ascertaining Vibheeshana's intention whether he is wicked or not, you may act wisely (said Mainda)."

shloka_text: अथसंस्कारसम्पन्नोहनुमान् सचिवोत्तमः । उवाचवचनंश्लक्ष्णमर्थवन्मधुरंलघु ।।6.17.50।।
transliteration: athasaṃskārasampannohanumān sacivottamaḥ | uvācavacanaṃślakṣṇamarthavanmadhuraṃlaghu
translation: अथ: on the other hand, संस्कारसम्पन्नः endowed with rich culture, सचिवोत्तमः best of the ministers, हनुमान् Hanuman, श्लक्ष्णम् soft, अर्थवत् full of meaning, मधुरम् sweet, लघु: brief, वचनम् words, उवाच: spoke.
explanation: On the other hand, Hanuman who was endowed with rich culture spoke these soft, sweet, and meaningful words briefly.

shloka_text: नभवन्तंमतिश्रेष्ठंसमर्थंवदतांवरम् । अतिशाययितुंशक्तोबृहस्पतिरपिब्रुवन् ।।6.17.51।।
transliteration: nabhavantaṃmatiśreṣṭhaṃsamarthaṃvadatāṃvaram | atiśāyayituṃśaktobṛhaspatirapibruvan
translation: बृहस्पतिरपि: even Brihaspati, बृवन् proclaim, मतिश्रेष्ठम् highly intelligent, समर्थम् exceptionally capable, वदताम् in eloquence, वरम् foremost, भवन्तम् you, अतिशाययितुम् excellent, नशक्तः not possible.
explanation: "Even for Brihaspati who is proclaimed to be highly intelligent, it is not possible to surpass you as you are the foremost in capability and eloquence."

shloka_text: नवादान्नपिसङ्घर्षान्नाधिक्यान्नचकामतः । वक्ष्यामिवचनंराजन्यथार्थंरामगौरवात् ।।6.17.52।।
transliteration: navādānnapisaṅgharṣānnādhikyānnacakāmataḥ | vakṣyāmivacanaṃrājanyathārthaṃrāmagauravāt
translation: राजन् O king, राम: Rama, वादात् for the sake of argument, वचनम् words, न: not, सङ्घर्षादपि: for the sake of creating friction, न: nor, आधिक्यात् with sense of superiority, न: nor, कामतःच: or even desire, न: nor, गौरवात् out of respect, यथार्थम् truth, वक्ष्यामि: telling you.
explanation: "O King Rama I am telling this to you truly not for the sake of argument, not for the sake of creating friction, or with a sense of superiority, or desire but out of respect."

shloka_text: अर्थानर्थनिमित्तंहियदुक्तंसचिवैस्तव । तत्रदोषंप्रपश्यामिक्रियानह्युपपद्यते ।।6.17.53।।
transliteration: arthānarthanimittaṃhiyaduktaṃsacivaistava | tatradoṣaṃprapaśyāmikriyānahyupapadyate
translation: तव: your, सचिवैः counsellors, अर्थानर्थनिमित्तम् after judging good or bad qualities, यत् by what, उक्तम् has been said, तत्र: there, दोषम् fault, प्रपश्यामि: I see, क्रिया: action, नउपपद्यतेहि: not arise.
explanation: "Your counsellors have said that after judging good or bad qualities we should accept or reject Vibheeshana. I see a flaw in that statement as such action would not arise."

shloka_text: ऋतेनियोगात्सामर्थ्यमवबोद्धुंनशक्यते । सहसाविनियोगोहिदोषवान्प्रतिभातिमे ।।6.17.54।।
transliteration: ṛteniyogātsāmarthyamavaboddhuṃnaśakyate | sahasāviniyogohidoṣavānpratibhātime
translation: नियोगात् ऋते: only when entrusted with duty, सामर्थ्यम् capability, अवबोद्धुम् will be known, नशक्यते: not possible, सहसा: inconsiderately, विनियोगः appointment to a duty, दोषवान् will be faulty, मे: to me, प्रतिभाति: to understand.
explanation: "When entrusted with duty one's capability will be known. It is not possible to appoint him for duty inconsiderately without understanding (his capacity) as it will be faulty."

shloka_text: चारप्रणिहितंयुक्तंयदुक्तंसचिवैस्तव । अर्थस्यासम्भवात्तत्रकारणंनोपयुज्यते ।।6.17.55।।
transliteration: cārapraṇihitaṃyuktaṃyaduktaṃsacivaistava | arthasyāsambhavāttatrakāraṇaṃnopayujyate
translation: तव: your, सचिवैः counsellors, यत् that way, चारप्रणिहितम् ascertain from the spies whether he is good or not, युक्तम् proper, उक्तम् has said, तत्र: then, अर्थस्य: has no meaning, असम्भवात् not possible to do, कारणम् reason, नोपयुज्यते: no purpose will be served by that.
explanation: "Your counsellors (Sarabha) have said that it is proper to know from the spies to ascertain about him. It has no meaning as it is not possible to do so (as he is near you). It does not serve the purpose."

shloka_text: अदेशकालेसम्प्राप्तइत्ययंयद्विभीषणः । विवक्षातत्रमेऽस्तीयंतांनिबोधयथामति ।।6.17.56।।
transliteration: adeśakālesamprāptaityayaṃyadvibhīṣaṇaḥ | vivakṣātatrame'stīyaṃtāṃnibodhayathāmati
translation: अयंविभीषणः this Vibheeshana, आदेशकाले: without regard for place and time, सम्प्राप्तःइतियत् has come here, तत्र: hence, मे: my, यथामति: according to me, इयंविवक्षा: desire to speak this, अस्ति: will be, ताम् to it, निबोध: be considered.
explanation: "This Vibheeshana has come here without regard for place and time. I desire to speak what I feel in this regard."

shloka_text: सएषदेश: कालश्चभवतीतियथातथा । पुरुषात्पुरुषंप्राप्यतथादोषगुणावपि ।।6.17.57।।
transliteration: saeṣadeśa: kālaścabhavatītiyathātathā | puruṣātpuruṣaṃprāpyatathādoṣaguṇāvapi
translation: एषः this, इह: here, देश: place, कालश्च: and time, तथा: similarly, पुरुषात् you, पुरुषम् superior, प्राप्य: came here, तथा: so also, गुणदोषावपि: even if there are de merits (in him) and merits (in you), यथा: as, तथा: it is, इह: here, भवति: seems to be.
explanation: "It seems proper for him (Vibheeshana) to come here, considering place and time and so also considering that you are superior to him (Ravana) even if there are demerits in him and merits in you."

shloka_text: त्म्यंरावणेदृष्टवाविक्रमंचतथात्वयि । युक्तमागमनंह्यत्रसदृशंतस्यबुद्धितः ।।6.17.58।।
transliteration: tmyaṃrāvaṇedṛṣṭavāvikramaṃcatathātvayi | yuktamāgamanaṃhyatrasadṛśaṃtasyabuddhitaḥ
translation: रवणे: in Ravana, दौरात्म्यम् wickedness, तथा: likewise, त्वयि: in you, विक्रमंच: valiance, दृष्टवा: seen, अत्र: here, आगमनम् has come, युक्तंहि: seems right, तस्य: his, बुद्धितः thinking, सदृशम् suitable.
explanation: "He has thought over and seen wickedness in Ravana, likewise valiance in you has made you come here. He seems to be right and suitable."

shloka_text: अज्ञातरूपैःपुरुषैस्सराजन्पृच्छ् यतामिति । यदुक्तमत्रमेप्रेक्षाकाचिदस्तिसमीक्षिता ।।6.17.59।।
transliteration: ajñātarūpaiḥpuruṣaissarājanpṛcch yatāmiti | yaduktamatrameprekṣākācidastisamīkṣitā
translation: राजन् O king अज्ञातरूपैः people of unknown identity, पुरुषैः by men, सः he (Mainda), पृच्छ् यताम् said to enquire इति: this, यत् that way, उक्तम् said, अत्र: here, समीक्षिता: having reviewed, मे: to me, काचित् a little, प्रेक्षा: view, अस्ति: be it.
explanation: "O king People of unknown identity should enquire about him. (Vibheeshana)" said Mainda. Having reviewed the matter, I have another view. (in the matter)."

shloka_text: पृच्छयमानोविशङ्केतसहसाबुद्धिमान्वचः । तत्रमित्रंप्रदुष्येतमिथ्यापृष्टंसुखागतम् ।।6.17.60।।
transliteration: pṛcchayamānoviśaṅketasahasābuddhimānvacaḥ | tatramitraṃpraduṣyetamithyāpṛṣṭaṃsukhāgatam
translation: सहसा: at once, पृच्छयमानः if enquired, बुद्धिमान् wise one, वचः words, विशङ्केत: will become suspicious, तत्र: there, सुखागतम् come with relief, मित्रम् friend, मिथ्यापृष्टम् प्रदुष्येत: will appear as wicked one.
explanation: "If enquired suddenly, a wise one will also become suspicious of his words. Even a friend who has come there will seem like a wicked one to him."

shloka_text: अशक्यस्सहसाराजन्भावोबोद्धुंपरस्यवै । अन्तस्स्वभावैर्गीतैस्तैर्नैपुण्यंपश्यतांभृशम् ।।6.17.61।।
transliteration: aśakyassahasārājanbhāvoboddhuṃparasyavai | antassvabhāvairgītaistairnaipuṇyaṃpaśyatāṃbhṛśam
translation: राजन् O king अन्तस्स्वभावै: his intention, र्गीतै: tone of words स्तै: his, पश्यताम् to find out, भृशम् excessive, नैपुण्यं: dexterity, परस्य: other's, भावः feelings, सहसा: at once, बोद्धुम् to know, अशक्यम् not possible.
explanation: "O king It is not possible to know the intention (of an enemy) of others at once without excessive dexterity. It is to be known by his tone of words and description."

shloka_text: नत्वस्यब्रुवतोजातुलक्ष्यतेदुष्टभावता । प्रसन्नंवदनंचापितस्मान्मेनास्तिसंशयः ।।6.17.62।।
transliteration: natvasyabruvatojātulakṣyateduṣṭabhāvatā | prasannaṃvadanaṃcāpitasmānmenāstisaṃśayaḥ
translation: ब्रुवतः he is speaking, अस्य: his, दुष्टभावता: malevolence, जातु: known, नलक्ष्यते: does not seem, वदनंचापि: even his countenance, प्रसन्नम् pleasing, तस्मात् therefore, मे: to me, संशयः suspicion, नास्ति: is not there.
explanation: "Even when one is speaking, his malevolence is known. It does not seem so as his countenance is also pleasing. Therefore, I have no doubt (of him)."

shloka_text: अशङ्कितमतिस्स्वस्थोनशठःपरिसर्पति । नचास्यदुष्टावाक्चापितस्मान्नास्तीहसंशयः ।।6.17.63।।
transliteration: aśaṅkitamatissvasthonaśaṭhaḥparisarpati | nacāsyaduṣṭāvākcāpitasmānnāstīhasaṃśayaḥ
translation: शठः one with deceitful feeling, अशङ्कितमतिः without any expression of suspicion, स्वस्थः on his own, नपरिसर्पति: not going about, अस्य: his, वाक् च: even his talk, दुष्टा: looks, नास्ति: not, तस्मात् therefore, मे: to me, संशयः suspicion, नास्ति: not there.
explanation: "One who is with deceitful feeling will not come without an expression of suspicion. He has come on his own and even his talk and looks are not suspicious to me."

shloka_text: आकारश्चाद्यमानोऽपिनशक्योविनिगूहितम् । बलाद्धिविवृणोत्येवभावमन्तर्गतंनृणाम् ।।6.17.64।।
transliteration: ākāraścādyamāno'pinaśakyovinigūhitam | balāddhivivṛṇotyevabhāvamantargataṃnṛṇām
translation: आकारः form, छाद्यमानोऽपि: even if one wishes to hide, एवगूहितुम् kept concealed, नशक्यः not feasible, अन्तर्गतम् inner feeling, नृणाम् of a man's, भावम्: feeling, बलात् perforce, निप्पणोत्येव: cleverly also.
explanation: "Even if one intends to hide in his external form, it is not feasible to keep it concealed. The inner feeling of a man gets revealed even if cleverly hidden."

shloka_text: अथरामःप्रसन्नात्माशृत्वावायुसुतस्यह । प्रत्यभाषतदुर्धषश्रुतवानात्मनिस्थितम् ।।6.18.1।।
transliteration: atharāmaḥprasannātmāśṛtvāvāyusutasyaha | pratyabhāṣatadurdhaṣaśrutavānātmanisthitam
translation: अथ: and then, दुर्धर्षः formidable one, श्रुतवान् one who heard, रामः Rama, वायुसुतस्य: son of wind god's, शृत्वा: having heard, प्रसन्नात्मा: highly pleased at heart, आत्मनि: his own, स्थितम् that which was in his mind, प्रत्यभाषत: started to tell.
explanation: Having heard Hanuman (son of wind god) formidable Rama was highly pleased at heart and started to tell his opinion.
comments: Sri Rama decided to accept friendship with Vibheeshana.

shloka_text: ममापितुविवक्षाऽस्तिकाचित्प्रतिविभीषणम् । श्रोतुमिच्छामितत्सर्वंभवद्भिश्श्रेयसिस्थितैः ।।6.18.2।।
transliteration: mamāpituvivakṣā'stikācitprativibhīṣaṇam | śrotumicchāmitatsarvaṃbhavadbhiśśreyasisthitaiḥ
translation: विभीषणंप्रति: about Vibheeshana, ममापि: even I, काचित् a few words, विवक्षा: desire to speak, आस्ति: is there, श्रेयसि: well wishers, स्थितैः are devoted, भवद्भिः you also, तत् that, श्रोतुम् to hear, इच्छामि: I desire.
explanation: "Even I desire to speak a few words about Vibheeshana. I wish you, who are my well wishers and devoted to me, also hear me."

shloka_text: मित्रभावेनसम्प्राप्तंनत्यजेयंकथञ्चन । दोषोयद्यपितस्यस्यात्सतामेतदगर्हितम् ।।6.18.3।।
transliteration: mitrabhāvenasamprāptaṃnatyajeyaṃkathañcana | doṣoyadyapitasyasyātsatāmetadagarhitam
translation: मित्रभावेन: with friendly feeling, सम्राप्तम् having come here, तस्य: his, दोष: defects, यद्यसि: although, कथञ्चन: however, नत्यजेयम् not reject, एतत् all this, सताम् good people, अगर्हितम् not reprehensible.
explanation: Although he (Vibheeshana) has defects, as he has come here with a friendly feeling, I cannot reject him. Good people are not reprehensible.

shloka_text: सुग्रीस्त्वथतद्वाक्यमाभाष्यचविमृश्यच । ततश्शुभतरंवाक्यमुवाचहरिपुङ्गवः ।।6.18.4।।
transliteration: sugrīstvathatadvākyamābhāṣyacavimṛśyaca | tataśśubhataraṃvākyamuvācaharipuṅgavaḥ
translation: अथ then, हरिपुङ्गवः leader of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तद्वाक्यम् his statement, अभाष्यच and spoken by, विमृश्यच and reflecting upon, ततः thereafter, शुभतरम् favouring, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह said.
explanation: Then Sugriva, the leader of Vanaras reflecting on what was spoken by Rama said these words favouring Rama.

shloka_text: सुदुष्टोवाप्यदुष्टोवाकिमेषरजनीचरः । ईदृशंव्यसनंप्राप्तंभ्रातरंयःपरित्यजेत् ।।6.18.5।। कोनामसभवेत्तस्ययमेषनपरित्यजेत् ।
transliteration: suduṣṭovāpyaduṣṭovākimeṣarajanīcaraḥ | īdṛśaṃvyasanaṃprāptaṃbhrātaraṃyaḥparityajet  konāmasabhavettasyayameṣanaparityajet |
translation: एषः this, रजनीचरः night ranger, सुदुष्टोवा: be a wicked one, अदुष्टोवा: or not a wicked one, किम् what, यः with him, ईदृशम् such a person, व्यसनम् worry, प्राप्तम् has come here, भ्रातरम् when brother, परित्यजेत् had abandoned, तस्यएषः his this, यम् who, नपरित्यजेत् not abandon सः he, कोनाम: who will not, भवेत् do so.
explanation: "Let this Rakshasa (night ranger) be a wicked one or not a wicked one, what have we to worry about such a person? He has come here abandoned by his brother and who will not send away such a person? Who will not do so?"

shloka_text: वानराधिपतेर्वाक्यंश्रुत्वासर्वानुदीक्ष्यच ।।6.18.6।। ईषदुत्स्मयमानस्तुलक्ष्मणंपुण्यलक्षणम् । इतिहोवाचकाकुत्स्थोवाक्यंसत्यपराक्रमः ।।6.18.7।।
transliteration: vānarādhipatervākyaṃśrutvāsarvānudīkṣyaca  īṣadutsmayamānastulakṣmaṇaṃpuṇyalakṣaṇam | itihovācakākutsthovākyaṃsatyaparākramaḥ
translation: सत्यपराक्रमः one of truthful valour, काकुत्स्थ: of Kakuthsa dynasty, वानराधिपतेः of king of Vanaras, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, सर्वान् all, उदीक्ष्यतु: looking at, ईषत् slightly, उत्स्मयमानः throwing up a smile, पुण्यलक्षणम् meritorious characteristics, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, इति: these, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह: spoke.
explanation: On hearing the words of the king of Vanaras, Rama of Kakuthsa dynasty and of truthful valour looked at all and threw a smile slightly at meritorious Lakshmana and spoke these words.

shloka_text: वानराधिपतेर्वाक्यंश्रुत्वासर्वानुदीक्ष्यच ।।6.18.6।। ईषदुत्स्मयमानस्तुलक्ष्मणंपुण्यलक्षणम् । इतिहोवाचकाकुत्स्थोवाक्यंसत्यपराक्रमः ।।6.18.7।।
transliteration: vānarādhipatervākyaṃśrutvāsarvānudīkṣyaca  īṣadutsmayamānastulakṣmaṇaṃpuṇyalakṣaṇam | itihovācakākutsthovākyaṃsatyaparākramaḥ
translation: सत्यपराक्रमः one of truthful valour, काकुत्स्थ: of Kakuthsa dynasty, वानराधिपतेः of king of Vanaras, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, सर्वान् all, उदीक्ष्यतु: looking at, ईषत् slightly, उत्स्मयमानः throwing up a smile, पुण्यलक्षणम् meritorious characteristics, लक्ष्मणम् at Lakshmana, इति: these, वाक्यम् words, उवाचह: spoke.
explanation: On hearing the words of the king of Vanaras, Rama of Kakuthsa dynasty and of truthful valour looked at all and threw a smile slightly at meritorious Lakshmana and spoke these words.

shloka_text: अनधीत्यचशास्त्राणिवृद्धाननुपसेव्यच । नशक्यमीदृशंवक्तुंयदुवाचहरीश्वरः ।।6.18.8।।
transliteration: anadhītyacaśāstrāṇivṛddhānanupasevyaca | naśakyamīdṛśaṃvaktuṃyaduvācaharīśvaraḥ
translation: हरीश्वरः Lord of monkeys, यत् that which, उवाचह: has been said, ईदृशम् in this way, वक्तुम् to speak, शास्त्राणि: sastras, अनधीत्य: without studying, वृद्दान् elders, अनुपसेन्यच: to one who has served, नशक्यम् not possible.
explanation: "That which has been spoken by the Lord of monkeys in this way is not possible for one who has not studied sastras or served the elders."

shloka_text: अस्तिसूक्ष्मतरंकिंचिद्यदत्रप्रतिभातिमे । प्रत्यक्षंलौकिकंचापिविद्यतेसर्वराजसु ।।6.18.9।।
transliteration: astisūkṣmataraṃkiṃcidyadatrapratibhātime | pratyakṣaṃlaukikaṃcāpividyatesarvarājasu
translation: यत् that in this matter, सर्वराजसु: for all kings, प्रत्यक्षम् openly, विद्यते: known, लौकिकंचापि: even from worldly view, सूक्ष्मतरम् in subtle manner, किंचित् a little, अस्ति: is, अत्र: that, मे: to me, प्रतिभाति: strikes.
explanation: "It strikes me that in this regard, as it is openly known for all the kings or at least in a subtle manner from a worldly point of view."

shloka_text: अमित्रास्तत्कुलीनाश्चप्रातिदेश्याश्चकीर्तिताः । व्यसनेषुप्रहर्तारस्तस्मादयमिहागतः ।।6.18.10।।
transliteration: amitrāstatkulīnāścaprātideśyāścakīrtitāḥ | vyasaneṣuprahartārastasmādayamihāgataḥ
translation: तत्कुलीनाश्च: of kings of same clan, प्रातिदेश्याश्च: kings of adjoining countries, अमित्रा: not friendly ones, व्यसनेषु: when in difficulties, प्रहर्तारः keep attacking, कीर्तिताः renowned, तस्मात् on account of this, अयम् he has, इह: here, आगतः come.
explanation: "When in difficulty kings of the same clan of adjoining countries keep attacking the renowned and so they are declared as enemies. It is on account of this cause he (Vibheeshana) has come here."

shloka_text: अपापास्तत्कुलीनाश्चमानयन्तिस्वकान्हितान् । एषप्रायोनरेन्द्राणांशङ्कनीयस्तुशोभनः ।।6.18.11।।
transliteration: apāpāstatkulīnāścamānayantisvakānhitān | eṣaprāyonarendrāṇāṃśaṅkanīyastuśobhanaḥ
translation: अपापाः sinless one, तत्कुलीनाः of the same clan, स्वकान् of their own, हितान् friendly ones, मानयन्ति: respect, प्रायः by and large, नरेन्द्राणाम् of the kings, शोभनः virtuous ones, एषः in this way, शङ्कनीयः do not believe.
explanation: "The sinless ones respect the kings of their clan as friendly ones. But by and large such kings also do not believe the virtuous ones among the kings."

shloka_text: यस्तुदोषस्त्वयाप्रोक्तोह्यादानेऽरिबलस्यच । तत्रतेकीर्तयिष्यामियथाशास्त्रमिदंशृणु ।।6.18.12।।
transliteration: yastudoṣastvayāproktohyādāne'ribalasyaca | tatratekīrtayiṣyāmiyathāśāstramidaṃśṛṇu
translation: अरिबलस्य: regarding the enemy's strength, आदाने: accepting, यः that which, दोषः demerit, त्वया: by you, प्रोक्तः you have spoken, तत्र: there, ते: to you, यथाशास्त्रम् What the scriptures say, कीर्तयिष्यामि: will narrate to you, इदम् this, शृणु: you may listen.
explanation: "I will tell you what the scriptures have said about the demerit in accepting an enemy's strength that you have spoken. You may listen."

shloka_text: नवयंतत्कुलीनाश्चराज्यकाङ् क्षीचराक्षसः । पण्डिताहिभविष्यन्तितस्माद्ग्राह्योविभीषणः ।।6.18.13।।
transliteration: navayaṃtatkulīnāścarājyakāṅ kṣīcarākṣasaḥ | paṇḍitāhibhaviṣyantitasmādgrāhyovibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: वयम् we, तत्कुलीनाःच: their clan, न: not, राक्षसः Rakshasas, राज्यकाङ् क्षीच: and desire for their (Rakshasa) kingdom, पण्डिताः learned, भविष्यन्ति: desires, तस्मात् on account of this cause, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ग्राह्यः can be accepted.
explanation: "We do not belong to their clan. Among Rakshasas there are some learned ones. Vibheeshana has come because of his desire for their (Rakshasa) kingdom, perhaps ?"

shloka_text: अव्यग्राश्चप्रहृष्टाश्चनभविष्यन्तिसङ्गता । प्रणादश्चमहानेषततोऽस्यभयमागतम् ।।6.18.14।। इतिभेदंगमिष्यन्तितस्माग्राह्योविभीषणः ।
transliteration: avyagrāścaprahṛṣṭāścanabhaviṣyantisaṅgatā | praṇādaścamahāneṣatato'syabhayamāgatam  itibhedaṃgamiṣyantitasmāgrāhyovibhīṣaṇaḥ |
translation: अव्यग्राश्च: free from anxiety, प्रहृष्टाश्च: satisfied, सङ्गताः with one another, नभविष्यन्ति: will not be, इति: this, भेदम् difference, गमिष्यन्ति: will have, अतः and that way, अस्य: his (Vibheeshana's), भयम् fear, आगतम् has come, एषः this way, प्रणादश्च: crying for help, महान् loudly, तस्मात् as such, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, ग्राह्यः worthy to accept.
explanation: "Kinsmen will not be satisfied with one another and are not free from anxiety. That way they will not be together. Vibheeshana who has come out of fear in this way crying loudly for help and is worthy to accept."

shloka_text: नसर्वेभ्रातरस्तातभवन्तिभरतोपमाः । मद्विथावापितुःपुत्रास्सुहृदोनाभवद्विथाः ।।6.18.15।।
transliteration: nasarvebhrātarastātabhavantibharatopamāḥ | madvithāvāpituḥputrāssuhṛdonābhavadvithāḥ
translation: तात: dear, सर्वे: all, भ्रातरः brothers, भरतोपमाः like Bharata, नभवन्ति: will not be, पितुः father, मद्विथाः like me, पुत्राः are sons, भवद्विधाः like you, सुहृदोवा: or friends.
explanation: "O dear All brothers cannot be like Bharata, all sons will not be like me, or all friends like you."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तुरामेणसुग्रीवस्सहलक्ष्मणः । उत्थायेदंमहाप्राज्ञःप्रणतोवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।।6.18.16।।
transliteration: evamuktasturāmeṇasugrīvassahalakṣmaṇaḥ | utthāyedaṃmahāprājñaḥpraṇatovākyamabravīt
translation: रामेण: by Rama, एवम् in this way, उक्तः having spoken, महाप्राज्ञः very wise, सहलक्ष्मणः along with Lakshmana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, उत्थाय: got up, प्रणतः saluting, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken.
explanation: When Rama had spoken that way, sagacious Sugriva along with Lakshmana got up and saluted him and spoke these words to Rama.

shloka_text: रावणेनप्रणिहितंतमवेहिविभीषणम् । तस्याहंनिग्रहंमन्येक्षमंक्षमवतांवर ।।6.18.17।।
transliteration: rāvaṇenapraṇihitaṃtamavehivibhīṣaṇam | tasyāhaṃnigrahaṃmanyekṣamaṃkṣamavatāṃvara
translation: क्षमवतांवर: exceptional in excusing, तम् him, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, रावणेन: by Ravana, प्रणिहितम् has been sent, अवेहि: Realize, तस्य: his, निग्रहम् captivate, क्षमम् befitting, मन्ये: I think.
explanation: "Rama, you are exceptional in excusing Vibheeshana. Realize that he has been dispatched here by Ravana. I consider befitting for you to captivate him."

shloka_text: राक्षसोजिह्मयाबुध्यासन्दिष्टोऽयमिहागतः । प्रहर्तुंत्वयिविश्वस्तेप्रच्छन्नोमयिवानघ ।।6.18.18।। लक्ष्मणेवामहाबाहो सवध्यस्सचिवैस्सहा । रावणस्यनृशंसस्यभ्राताह्येषविभीषणः ।। एवमुक्त्वारघुश्रेष्ठंसुग्रीवोवाहिनीपतिः । वाक्यज्ञोवाक्यकुशलंततोमौनमुपागमत् ।।6.18.19।।
transliteration: rākṣasojihmayābudhyāsandiṣṭo'yamihāgataḥ | prahartuṃtvayiviśvastepracchannomayivānagha  lakṣmaṇevāmahābāho savadhyassacivaissahā | rāvaṇasyanṛśaṃsasyabhrātāhyeṣavibhīṣaṇaḥ || evamuktvāraghuśreṣṭhaṃsugrīvovāhinīpatiḥ | vākyajñovākyakuśalaṃtatomaunamupāgamat
translation: अनघ: sinless, महाबाहो: mightyarmed, आयंराक्षसः this Rakshasa, विश्वस्ते: I believe, त्वयि: you, प्रच्छन्नो: covertly, मयि: or me, लक्ष्मणेवा: at Lakshman too, प्रहर्तुम् strike, सन्दिष्टः is been sent, जिह्मया: greedily, बुद्ध्या: on knowing, इह: here, आगतः has come, सः he, सचिवैस्सह: along with his counsellors, बध्यः kill, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: the cruel one, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: Ravana's brother, वाक्यज्ञः adept in expression, वाहिनीपतिः chief of the army, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वाक्यकुशलम् good at speech, रघुश्रेष्ठम् best of Raghu race, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा: having said, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.
explanation: "O sinless mightyarmed Rama I believe that this Rakshasa has been sent to come here covertly to strike at you or me or Lakshmana. On knowing that you are here the cruel Ravana's brother has come greedily along with his counsellors to kill you." Sugriva the chief of the army, who was good at speech and adept in expression, having said to Rama, the best among the Raghu race, remained silent thereafter.

shloka_text: राक्षसोजिह्मयाबुध्यासन्दिष्टोऽयमिहागतः । प्रहर्तुंत्वयिविश्वस्तेप्रच्छन्नोमयिवानघ ।।6.18.18।। लक्ष्मणेवामहाबाहो सवध्यस्सचिवैस्सहा । रावणस्यनृशंसस्यभ्राताह्येषविभीषणः ।। एवमुक्त्वारघुश्रेष्ठंसुग्रीवोवाहिनीपतिः । वाक्यज्ञोवाक्यकुशलंततोमौनमुपागमत् ।।6.18.19।।
transliteration: rākṣasojihmayābudhyāsandiṣṭo'yamihāgataḥ | prahartuṃtvayiviśvastepracchannomayivānagha  lakṣmaṇevāmahābāho savadhyassacivaissahā | rāvaṇasyanṛśaṃsasyabhrātāhyeṣavibhīṣaṇaḥ || evamuktvāraghuśreṣṭhaṃsugrīvovāhinīpatiḥ | vākyajñovākyakuśalaṃtatomaunamupāgamat
translation: अनघ: sinless, महाबाहो: mightyarmed, आयंराक्षसः this Rakshasa, विश्वस्ते: I believe, त्वयि: you, प्रच्छन्नो: covertly, मयि: or me, लक्ष्मणेवा: at Lakshman too, प्रहर्तुम् strike, सन्दिष्टः is been sent, जिह्मया: greedily, बुद्ध्या: on knowing, इह: here, आगतः has come, सः he, सचिवैस्सह: along with his counsellors, बध्यः kill, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, नृशंसस्य: the cruel one, रावणस्यभ्राताहि: Ravana's brother, वाक्यज्ञः adept in expression, वाहिनीपतिः chief of the army, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वाक्यकुशलम् good at speech, रघुश्रेष्ठम् best of Raghu race, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा: having said, ततः then, मौनम् silent, उपागमत् remained.
explanation: "O sinless mightyarmed Rama I believe that this Rakshasa has been sent to come here covertly to strike at you or me or Lakshmana. On knowing that you are here the cruel Ravana's brother has come greedily along with his counsellors to kill you." Sugriva the chief of the army, who was good at speech and adept in expression, having said to Rama, the best among the Raghu race, remained silent thereafter.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवस्यतुतद्वाक्यंरामश्रुत्वाविमृश्यच । ततश्शुभतरंवाक्यमुवाचहरिपुङ्गवम् ।।6.18.20।।
transliteration: sugrīvasyatutadvākyaṃrāmaśrutvāvimṛśyaca | tataśśubhataraṃvākyamuvācaharipuṅgavam
translation: रामः Rama, सुग्रीवस्य: Sugriva's, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, विमृश्यतुततः that which was nobler, हरिपुङ्गवम् leader of the Vanaras, शुभतरम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच: spoken.
explanation: Having heard the words of the leader of Vanaras that were nobler, Rama spoke these auspicious words.

shloka_text: सुदुष्टोवाप्यदुष्टोवाकिमेषरजनीचरः । सूक्ष्ममप्यहितंकर्तुंममाशक्तःकथञ्चन ।।6.18.21।।
transliteration: suduṣṭovāpyaduṣṭovākimeṣarajanīcaraḥ | sūkṣmamapyahitaṃkartuṃmamāśaktaḥkathañcana
translation: एषः this, रजनीचरः night ranger, सुदुष्टोवा: wicked or, अदुष्टोवा: or not wicked, मम: to me, कथञ्चन: What to say, सूक्ष्मम् subtlest, अहितमपि: that which is harmful, कर्तुम् to do, आशक्तः capable.
explanation: "Whether this night ranger is wicked or not wicked, is he capable of doing even subtlest harm to me?"

shloka_text: पिशाचानदानवान् यक्ष I नपृथिव्यांचैवराक्षसान् । अङ्गुल्यग्रेणतान् हन्यामिच्छन् हरिगणेश्वर ।।6.18.22।।
transliteration: piśācānadānavān yakṣa I napṛthivyāṃcaivarākṣasān | aṅgulyagreṇatān hanyāmicchan harigaṇeśvara
translation: हरिगणेश्वर: leader of Vanara troop, इच्छान् if I desire, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, तान् them, पिशाचान् devils, दानवान् Danavas, यक्षान् Yakshas, राक्षसान्चैव: including Rakshasas, अङ्गुल्यग्रेण: with tip of my big finger, हन्याम् can kill.
explanation: "O leader of the Vanara troop If I so desire, I can kill with the tip of my big finger the devils, Danavas, Yakshas and the Rakshasas on this earth."

shloka_text: श्रूयतेहिकपोतेनशत्रुश्शरणमागतः । अर्चितश्चयथान्यायंस्वैश्चमांसैर्निमन्त्रितः ।।6.18.23।।
transliteration: śrūyatehikapotenaśatruśśaraṇamāgataḥ | arcitaścayathānyāyaṃsvaiścamāṃsairnimantritaḥ
translation: कपोतेन: by a dove, शरणम् to seek refuge, आगतः came, शत्रुः enemy, यथान्यायम् according to practice, आर्चितश्च: offered, स्वैः its own, मांसैः flesh, निमन्त्रितश्च: without any jealousy, श्रूयतेहि: have heard.
explanation: "You have heard of the (story of a) dove that offered his own flesh to an enemy who came to seek protection according to tradition (of hospitality)."

shloka_text: सहितंप्रतिजग्राहभार्याहर्तारमागतः । कपोतोवानरश्रेष्ठ: किंपुनर्मद्विधोजनः ।।6.18.24।।
transliteration: sahitaṃpratijagrāhabhāryāhartāramāgataḥ | kapotovānaraśreṣṭha: kiṃpunarmadvidhojanaḥ
translation: वानरश्रेष्ठ: supreme Vanara, सःकपोतः that dove, आगतम् came near, भार्याहर्तारम् carried away its mate, तम् him, प्रतिजग्राहहि: in turn received, मद्विधः like me, जनः a man, किंपुनः What more.
explanation: "O Supreme Vanara When the fowler who had carried away the mate came near the dove it received him and in turn protected him. What more can a man like me do?"

shloka_text: ऋषेःकण्वस्यपुत्रेणकण्डुनापरमर्षिणा । शृणुगाथांपुरागीतांधर्मिष्ठासत्यवादिना ।।6.18.25।।
transliteration: ṛṣeḥkaṇvasyaputreṇakaṇḍunāparamarṣiṇā | śṛṇugāthāṃpurāgītāṃdharmiṣṭhāsatyavādinā
translation: पुरा: in the past, कण्वस्यऋषेः sage Kanva's, पुत्रेण: by the son, सत्यवादिना: truthful one, परमर्षिणा: great sage, कण्डुना: Kandu by name, धर्मिष्ठा: inculcating righteousness, गाथा: used to sing, गीता: verses, शृणु: you may listen.
explanation: "In the past Kanva's son called Kandu, a sage and a truthful one used to sing verses inculcating righteousness. (I shall recite) You may listen."

shloka_text: बद्धाञ्जलिपुटंदीनंयाचन्तंशरणागतम् । नहन्यदानृशंस्यार्थमपिशत्रुंपरन्तप ।।6.18.26।।
transliteration: baddhāñjalipuṭaṃdīnaṃyācantaṃśaraṇāgatam | nahanyadānṛśaṃsyārthamapiśatruṃparantapa
translation: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटम् who greets reverentially with folded hands, दीनम् piteous, याचन्तम् begs, शरणागतम् protection, शत्रुम् अपि even the enemy, अनृशंस्यार्थम् not to be cruel नहन्यात् not to be killed.
explanation: "O scorcher of enemies To one who greets reverentially with folded hands and begs for protection, we should not be cruel, and he is not to be killed."

shloka_text: आर्तोवायदिवादृप्तःपरेषांशरणांगतः । अरिःप्राणान्परित्यज्यरक्षितव्यःकृतात्मना ।।6.18.27।।
transliteration: ārtovāyadivādṛptaḥpareṣāṃśaraṇāṃgataḥ | ariḥprāṇānparityajyarakṣitavyaḥkṛtātmanā
translation: कृतात्माना one's own self, परेषाम् an enemy, शरणम् protection, गतः comes, अरिः enemy, आर्तोवा or one who is struck by suffering, यदिवा whoever he be, दृप्तः arrogant, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्य giving up, रक्षितव्यः should be protected.
explanation: An enemy who comes for protection against another enemy should be protected, even giving up one's own life whoever he may be, even if he is afflicted or arrogant.

shloka_text: सचेद्भयाद्वामोहाद्वाकामाद्वापिनरक्षति । स्वयाशक्त्यायथासत्त्वंतत्पापंलोकगर्हितम् ।।6.18.28।।
transliteration: sacedbhayādvāmohādvākāmādvāpinarakṣati | svayāśaktyāyathāsattvaṃtatpāpaṃlokagarhitam
translation: सः he, भयाद्वा: from fear, मोहाद्वा: from delusion, कामाद्वापि: even from desire, स्वया: his own, शक्त्वा: capacity, यथासत्त्वम् accordingly, नरक्षतिचेत् if he does not protect, तत् that, लोकगर्हितम् censured by the world, पापम् sin.
explanation: "If one does not protect, or give refuge, according to his capacity out of fear, desire (to gain) or delusion, the sin acquired by him will be censured by the world."

shloka_text: विनष्टःपश्यतस्तस्यारक्षिणश्शरणागतः । आदायसुकृतंतस्यसर्वंगच्छेदरक्षित:।। 6.18.29।।
transliteration: vinaṣṭaḥpaśyatastasyārakṣiṇaśśaraṇāgataḥ | ādāyasukṛtaṃtasyasarvaṃgacchedarakṣita:
translation: शरणागतः one who seeks protection, अरक्षितः fails to protect, तस्य: his, रक्षिणः refugee, पश्यतः in the eyes of, विनष्टः ruined, तस्य: his, सर्वम् all, सुकृतम् merit, आदाय: takes, गच्छेत् away.
explanation: "One who fails to protect a refugee who seeks protection from him is ruined in the eyes of the refugee and he takes away all the merit."

shloka_text: एवंदोषोमहानत्रप्रपन्नानामरक्षणे । अस्वर्ग्यंचायशस्यंचबलवीर्यविनाशनम् ।।6.18.30।।
transliteration: evaṃdoṣomahānatraprapannānāmarakṣaṇe | asvargyaṃcāyaśasyaṃcabalavīryavināśanam
translation: प्रपन्नानाम् resorts to, अत्रअरक्षणे: that way fails to protect, एवम् in that way, महान् great, दोषः sin, अस्वर्ग्यम् out of heaven, अयशस्यंच: and infamy, बलवीर्यविनाशनम् strength and virility gets lost.
explanation: "One who resorts to failure in protecting a refugee, will be doing a great sin that way and will be shut out of heaven, be infamy and his strength and virility will be lost."

shloka_text: करिष्यामियथार्थंतुकण्डोर्वचनमुत्तमम् । धर्मिष्ठंचयशस्यंचस्वर्ग्यंस्यात्तुफलोदये ।।6.18.31।।
transliteration: kariṣyāmiyathārthaṃtukaṇḍorvacanamuttamam | dharmiṣṭhaṃcayaśasyaṃcasvargyaṃsyāttuphalodaye
translation: कण्डोः of Kandu, उत्तमम् excellent, वचनम् words, यथार्थम् meaningful, करिष्यामि: has said, धर्मिष्ठम् one who does his rightful duty, यशस्यम् glorious, स्वर्ग्यम् heaven, फलोदयेस्यात् will receive such result (after death).
explanation: "Excellent and meaningful words have been said by sage Kandu (about one who protects a refugee), that is by doing one's righteous duty. He will be not only famous but reach heaven as a result of his action."

shloka_text: सकृदेवप्रपन्नायतवास्मीतिचयाचते । अभयंसर्वभूतेभ्योददाम्येतद्व्रतंमम ।।6.18.32।।
transliteration: sakṛdevaprapannāyatavāsmīticayācate | abhayaṃsarvabhūtebhyodadāmyetadvrataṃmama
translation: सकृदेव: for the sake of one, प्रपन्नाय: one who seeks protection, तव: him, अस्मि: me, इति: this way, याचते: begs, सर्वभूतेभ्यः from all living beings, अभयम् security, ददामि: will provide, एतत् thus, मम: my, व्रतम् vow.
explanation: "I will provide protection from all living beings for the one who seeks protection from me and begs in this way. This is my vow."

shloka_text: अनयैनंहरिश्रेष्ठ: दत्तमस्याभयंमया । विभीषणोवासुग्रीव: यदिवारावणस्स्वयम् ।।6.18.33।।
transliteration: anayainaṃhariśreṣṭha: dattamasyābhayaṃmayā | vibhīṣaṇovāsugrīva: yadivārāvaṇassvayam
translation: हरिश्रेष्ठ: best of Vanaras, सुग्रीव: Sugriva, विभीषणोवा: either Vibheeshana, यदिवा: or any one, स्वयम् by himself, रावणः Ravana, अस्य: his, मया: from me, अभयम् security, दत्तम् will offer, एनम् thus, आनय: one who is unprotected.
explanation: "O best of Vanaras Sugriva Either Vibheeshana or any one by himself and even Ravana who is unprotected thus seeks security from me, I will offer protection."

shloka_text: रामस्यतुवच्शुत्वासुग्रीवःप्लवगेश्वरः । प्रत्यभाषतकाकुत्स्थंसौहार्देनप्रचोदितः ।।6.18.34।।
transliteration: rāmasyatuvacśutvāsugrīvaḥplavageśvaraḥ | pratyabhāṣatakākutsthaṃsauhārdenapracoditaḥ
translation: प्लवगेश्वरः king of (leaping) Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामस्य: Rama's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा: having heard, सौहार्देन: lovingly, प्रचोदितः inciting, काकुत्स्थम् Rama of Kakuthsa race, प्रत्यभाषत: replied.
explanation: Having heard the inciting words spoken by Rama so lovingly, the king of Vanaras replied.

shloka_text: किमत्रचित्रंधर्मज्ञ: लोकनाथ: सुखावहा: । यत्त्वमार्यंप्रभाषेथास्सत्त्ववान् सत्पथेस्थितः ।।6.18.35।।
transliteration: kimatracitraṃdharmajña: lokanātha: sukhāvahā: | yattvamāryaṃprabhāṣethāssattvavān satpathesthitaḥ
translation: धर्मज्ञ: knower of righteous duty, लोकनाथसुखावहा: protector of the world, सत्त्ववान् virtuous one, सत्पथे: upright, स्थितः who stands, त्वम् by you, आर्यम् noble, प्रभाषेथाः that which was spoken, इतियत् thus which, अत्र: here, चित्रम् wonderful, किम् What.
explanation: "What wonderful words have been spoken by you, Rama? You are the knower of righteous duty, protector of the world, a virtuous and upright one."

shloka_text: ममचाप्यन्तरात्मायंशुद्धंवेत्तिविभीषणम् । अनुमानाच्चभावाच्चसर्वतस्सुपरीक्षितः ।।6.18.36।।
transliteration: mamacāpyantarātmāyaṃśuddhaṃvettivibhīṣaṇam | anumānāccabhāvāccasarvatassuparīkṣitaḥ
translation: मम: my, अयम् this, अन्तरात्माच: inner self, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana's, शुद्धम् pure, वेत्ति: known, अनुमानात् च: and with doubt, भावात् feeling, सर्वतः in all respects, सुपरीक्षितः been tested.
explanation: "My inner self is aware that this Vibheeshana is pure. He has been tested in all respects with doubtful feelings."

shloka_text: तस्मात् क्षिप्रंसहास्माभिस्तुल्योभवतराघव: । विभीषणोमहाप्राज्ञस्सखित्वंचाभ्युपैतुनः ।।6.18.37।।
transliteration: tasmāt kṣipraṃsahāsmābhistulyobhavatarāghava: | vibhīṣaṇomahāprājñassakhitvaṃcābhyupaitunaḥ
translation: राघव: Rama, तस्मात् therefore, महाप्राज्ञः highly sagacious one, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, क्षिप्रम् at once, अस्माभिस्सह: along with us, तुल्यः equal term, भवतु: be, नः our, सखित्वंच: friendship, अभ्युपैतु: you enjoy.
explanation: "Rama therefore, let this highly sagacious Vibheeshana be with you like a friend in equal terms and enjoy."

shloka_text: ततस्तुसुग्रीववचोनिशम्यतद्दरीश्वरेणाभिहितंनरेश्वरः । विभीषणेनाशुजगामसङ्गमंपतत्त्रिराजेनयथापुरन्दरः ।।6.18.38।।
transliteration: tatastusugrīvavaconiśamyataddarīśvareṇābhihitaṃnareśvaraḥ | vibhīṣaṇenāśujagāmasaṅgamaṃpatattrirājenayathāpurandaraḥ
translation: ततः then, नरेश्वरः king, तत् there, सुग्रीववचः Sugriva's words, निशम्य: perceiving, पुरन्दरः: like Indra, पतत्त्रिराजेनयथा like with the king of birds, विभीषणेन: with Vibheeshana, अशु: as said, हरीश्वरेण: by Sugriva, अभिहितम् very fitting, सङ्गमम् meeting, जगाम: went.
explanation: Perceiving Sugriva's befitting words, king Rama went to meet Vibheeshana like Indra arranged to meet with the king of birds. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टादशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the eighteenth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: राघवेणाभयेदत्तेसन्नतोरावणानुजः । विभीषणोमहाप्राज्ञोभूमिंसमवलोकयन् ।।6.19.1।।
transliteration: rāghaveṇābhayedattesannatorāvaṇānujaḥ | vibhīṣaṇomahāprājñobhūmiṃsamavalokayan
translation: राघवेण: by Raghava, अभये: promised security, दत्ते: given, रावाणानुजः to Ravana's brother, महाप्राज्ञः wise, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सन्नतः prepared to, भूमिम् ground, समवलोकयन् looked around.
explanation: When wise Vibheeshana, the brother of Ravana was assured of security by Raghava, he looked around the ground and prepared (to descend).
comments: Descending from the sky Vibheeshana seeks refuge with Sri Rama. On enquiry Vibheeshana tells everything about Ravana to Sri Rama.

shloka_text: खात्पपातावनींहृष्टोभक्तेरनुचरैस्सह । सतरामस्यपरमात्मानिपपातविभीषणः ।।6.19.2।।
transliteration: khātpapātāvanīṃhṛṣṭobhakteranucaraissaha | satarāmasyaparamātmānipapātavibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: धर्मात्मा: righteous self, सः that, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, हृष्टः happily, खात् from the sky, भक्तेः devotees, सहा: accompanied by, अवनिम् on to the land, पपातात: descended, रामस्य: towards Rama, निपपात: fell on the feet.
explanation: Righteous Vibheeshana descended from the sky and fell at the feet of Rama accompanied by his devotees happily (considering it to be inappropriate to come with foot down he came straight down with his body).

shloka_text: पादयोश्शरणान्वेषीचतुर्भिस्सहराक्षसैः । अब्रवीच्चतदावाक्यंरामंप्रतिविभीषणः ।।6.19.3।। धर्मयुक्तंचयुक्तंचसाम्प्रतंसम्प्रहर्षणम् ।
transliteration: pādayośśaraṇānveṣīcaturbhissaharākṣasaiḥ | abravīccatadāvākyaṃrāmaṃprativibhīṣaṇaḥ  dharmayuktaṃcayuktaṃcasāmprataṃsampraharṣaṇam |
translation: अथ: thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चतुर्भिः and the four, राक्षसैःसह: along with Rakshasas, पादयोः by foot, शरणान्वेषी: who seeks shelter, निपपात: prostrated falling down, रामंप्रति: in front of Rama, धर्मयुक्तम् duly expressing his duty, युक्तंच: and appropriate, साम्प्रतम् placing confidence in, सम्प्रहर्षणम् showing extreme joy, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीच्च: spoken.
explanation: Thereafter Vibheeshana and the four Rakshasas who sought shelter prostrated lying at the feet of Rama expressing their duty, duly and placing confidence in Rama who spoke these words showing extreme joy.

shloka_text: अनुजोरावणस्याहंतेनचाप्यवमानितः । भवन्तंसर्वभूतानांशरण्यंशरणागतः ।।6.19.4।।
transliteration: anujorāvaṇasyāhaṃtenacāpyavamānitaḥ | bhavantaṃsarvabhūtānāṃśaraṇyaṃśaraṇāgataḥ
translation: अहम् I am, रावणस्य: Ravana's, अनुजः younger brother, तेन: having been, अवमानितश्च: put to shame, सर्वभूतानाम् all beings, शरण्यम् protector, भवन्तम् you are, शरणागतः came to seek protection.
explanation: "I am Ravana's younger brother. Having been put to shame I came to seek protection from you who are the protector of all beings " (Vibheeshana said to Rama)."

shloka_text: परित्यक्तामयालङ्कमित्राणिचधनानिच । भवद्गतंहिमेराज्यंजीवितंचसुखानिच ।।6.19.5।।
transliteration: parityaktāmayālaṅkamitrāṇicadhanānica | bhavadgataṃhimerājyaṃjīvitaṃcasukhānica
translation: मया: my, लङ्का: Lanka, परित्यक्ता: leaving, मित्राणिच: and friends, धनानिच: even wealth, मे: my, राज्यम् kingdom, भवद्गतंहि: at your disposal, जीवितम् life, सुखानिच: for happiness.
explanation: "Leaving Lanka, my friends and my wealth I came to you. Now my life, kingdom and welfare are at your disposal."

shloka_text: तथ्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वारामोवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.19.6।। वचसासान्त्वयित्वैनंलोचनाभ्यांपिबन्निव । आख्याहिममतत्त्वेनराक्षसानांबलाबलम् ।।6.19.7।।
transliteration: tathyatadvacanaṃśrutvārāmovacanamabravīt  vacasāsāntvayitvainaṃlocanābhyāṃpibanniva | ākhyāhimamatattvenarākṣasānāṃbalābalam
translation: रामः Rama, तस्य: that, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, वचसा: word, एनम् that way, सान्त्वयित्वा: soothing him, लोचनाभ्याम् with both eyes, पिबन्निव: as if drinking, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, बलाबलम् strength as well as weakness, मम: to me, तत्त्वेन: truly, आख्याहि: related.
explanation: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."

shloka_text: तथ्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वारामोवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.19.6।। वचसासान्त्वयित्वैनंलोचनाभ्यांपिबन्निव । आख्याहिममतत्त्वेनराक्षसानांबलाबलम् ।।6.19.7।।
transliteration: tathyatadvacanaṃśrutvārāmovacanamabravīt  vacasāsāntvayitvainaṃlocanābhyāṃpibanniva | ākhyāhimamatattvenarākṣasānāṃbalābalam
translation: रामः Rama, तस्य: that, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा: on hearing, वचसा: word, एनम् that way, सान्त्वयित्वा: soothing him, लोचनाभ्याम् with both eyes, पिबन्निव: as if drinking, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoken, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, बलाबलम् strength as well as weakness, मम: to me, तत्त्वेन: truly, आख्याहि: related.
explanation: "On hearing those words (of Vibheeshana) that were soothing to him as if he drank (Vibheeshana's love) with his both eyes, Rama asked Vibheeshana to truly relate the strength as well as weakness of the Rakshasas."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तंतदारक्षोरामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । रावणस्यबलंसर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।।6.19.8।।
transliteration: evamuktaṃtadārakṣorāmeṇākliṣṭakarmaṇā | rāvaṇasyabalaṃsarvamākhyātumupacakrame
translation: तदा: then, अक्लिष्टकिर्मणा: of unwearied action, रामेण: by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तम् having said, रक्षः Rakshasa (Vibheeshana), रावणस्य: Ravana's, सर्वम् all, बलम् strength, आख्यातुम् to speak out, उपचक्रमे: proceeded.
explanation: Then the Rakshasa (Vibheeshana) having heard that Rama of unwearied action would save him proceeded to speak out about the strength of Ravana.

shloka_text: अवध्यस्सर्वभूतानांगन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । राजपुत्रदशग्रीवोवरदानात्स्वयंभुवः ।।6.19.9।।
transliteration: avadhyassarvabhūtānāṃgandharvoragarakṣasām | rājaputradaśagrīvovaradānātsvayaṃbhuvaḥ
translation: राजपुत्र: prince, स्वयंभुवः selfborn Brahma, वरदानात्: by virtue of a boon, दशग्रीवः tenheaded Ravana, गन्धर्वोररक्षसाम् by Gandharvas, serpents or Rakshasas, सर्वभूतानाम् by all beings, अवध्यः not possible to kill.
explanation: "Oh Prince, by virtue of a boon granted by Brahma, the selfborn to the tenheaded Ravana, he cannot be killed by Gandharvas, Rakshasas and by all beings."

shloka_text: रावणानन्तरोभ्राताममज्येष्ठश्चवीर्यवान् । कुम्भकर्णोमहातेजाश्शक्रप्रतिबलोयुधि ।।6.19.10।।
transliteration: rāvaṇānantarobhrātāmamajyeṣṭhaścavīryavān | kumbhakarṇomahātejāśśakrapratibaloyudhi
translation: रावणानन्तरः younger to Ravana, भ्राता: brother, मम: my, ज्येष्ठश्च: elder's, वीर्यवान् highly valiant, महातेजा: of great prowess, कुम्बकर्णः Kumbhakarna, युधि: in war, शक्रप्रतिबलः equal to Indra in strength.
explanation: "My elder brother, the one who is younger to Ravana is a highly valiant one endowed with great prowess. He is Kumbhakarna and equal to Indra in war."

shloka_text: रामसेनापतिस्तस्यप्रहास्तोयदिवाश्रुतः । कैलासेयेनसङ्ग्रामेमणिभद्रःपराजितः ।।6.19.11।।
transliteration: rāmasenāpatistasyaprahāstoyadivāśrutaḥ | kailāseyenasaṅgrāmemaṇibhadraḥparājitaḥ
translation: राम: Rama, येन: on which account, कैलासे: in Kailasa, सङ्ग्रामे: in combat, मणिभद्रः Manibhadra, पराजितः defeated, तस्यसेनापतिः his army chief, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, ते: you, श्रुतःयदि: might have heard.
explanation: "Rama You might have heard of Prahastha who the commander in chief of his (Ravana's) army is by whom Manibhadra (Kubera's Commander of Army) was defeated in a comb at in Kailas (the abode of Siva)."

shloka_text: बद्धगोधाङ्गुळित्रश्चअवध्यकवचोयुधि । धनुरादाययस्तिष्टन्नदृश्योभवतीन्द्रजित् ।।6.19.12।।
transliteration: baddhagodhāṅguḻitraścaavadhyakavacoyudhi | dhanurādāyayastiṣṭannadṛśyobhavatīndrajit
translation: यः he who, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, बुद्धगोधाङ्गुळित्रश्च: possessed with skin of Iguana on his hands, अवध्यकवचः shield which cannot be pierced, धनुः bow, आदाय: wielding, युधि: in combat, तिष्ठन् remains, अदृश्यः unseen, भवति: will be.
explanation: "He (Ravana's eldest son) who is possessed of Iguana skin on his hands (to protect), and with a shield that cannot be pierced and who remains unseen in comb at wielding a bow is Indrajith."

shloka_text: सङ्ग्रामसमयव्यूहेतर्पयित्वाहुताशनम् । अन्तर्धानगतश्शत्रूनिन्द्रजिद् हन्तिराघव:।। 6.19.13।।
transliteration: saṅgrāmasamayavyūhetarpayitvāhutāśanam | antardhānagataśśatrūnindrajid hantirāghava:
translation: राघव: Raghava, शत्रून् at enemies, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, हुताशनम् god of fire, तर्पयित्वा: by satisfying, अन्तर्धानगतः goes unseen, सुमयव्यूहे: when caught by network of foes, सङ्ग्रामसमये: at the time of war, हन्ति: strikes.
explanation: "Raghava Indrajith strikes when caught by a network of foes in war by becoming invisible because of satisfying fire god."

shloka_text: महोदरमहापार्श्वौराक्षसश्चाप्यकम्पनः । अनीकस्थास्तुतस्यैतेलोकपालसमायुधि ।।6.19.14।।
transliteration: mahodaramahāpārśvaurākṣasaścāpyakampanaḥ | anīkasthāstutasyaitelokapālasamāyudhi
translation: महोदरमहापार्श्वौ: Mahodara and Mahaparsva, अकम्पनः Akampana, राक्षसश्च: at Rakshasas, युधि: in war, लोकपालसमाः like the guardians of the world, एते: all these are, तस्य: their, अनीकस्ध: commanders in the army.
explanation: "Mahodara, Mahaparsva, Akampana are Rakshasas who are like the guards of the world. They are the commanders of his (Ravana's) army."

shloka_text: दशकोटिसहस्राणिरक्षसांकामरूपिणाम् । मांसशोणितभक्ष्याणांलङ्कापुरनिवासिनाम् ।।6.19.15।।
transliteration: daśakoṭisahasrāṇirakṣasāṃkāmarūpiṇām | māṃsaśoṇitabhakṣyāṇāṃlaṅkāpuranivāsinām
translation: कामरूपिणाम् who change form at their will, मांसशोणितभक्ष्याणाम् who eat flesh and blood, लङ्कापुरनिवासिनाम् those residing in the city of Lanka, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सहस्राणि: thousands.
explanation: "Thousands of Rakshasas inhabit the city of Lanka living on flesh and blood and changing their form at will."

shloka_text: सतैस्तुसहितोराजालोकपालानयोधयत् । सहदेवैस्तुतेभग्नारावणेनमहात्मना ।।6.19.16।।
transliteration: sataistusahitorājālokapālānayodhayat | sahadevaistutebhagnārāvaṇenamahātmanā
translation: सः that, राजा king, तैः them (Rakshasas), सहितः accompanied by, लोकपालन् rulers of the world, अयोधय् unassailable, देवैःसहा: along with celestial beings, महात्मना: great soul, रावणे: by Ravana, भग्नाः shattered.
explanation: "The unassailable rulers of the world and even celestial beings have been shattered by Ravana accompanied by the Rakshasas."

shloka_text: विभीषणवच: श्रुत्वारामोदृढपराक्रमः । अन्वीक्ष्यमनसासर्वमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।।6.19.17।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇavaca: śrutvārāmodṛḍhaparākramaḥ | anvīkṣyamanasāsarvamidaṃvacanamabravīt
translation: रामः Rama, दृढपराक्रमः one of mighty prowess, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा: hearing, सर्वम् everything, मनसा: in mind, अन्वीक्ष्य: examining, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Rama of mighty prowess having heard everything from Vibheeshana, examining in his mind, spoke.

shloka_text: यानिकर्मापदानानिरावणस्यविभीषण: । अख्यातानिचतत्त्वेनह्यवगच्छामितान्यहम् ।।6.19.18।।
transliteration: yānikarmāpadānānirāvaṇasyavibhīṣaṇa: | akhyātānicatattvenahyavagacchāmitānyaham
translation: विभीषण: Vibheeshana, रावणस्य: Ravana's, यानि: those, कर्मापदानानि: actions followed, अख्यातानि: that which has been spoken, तानि: those, तत्त्वेन: in essence, अहम् अवगच्छामि: is known to me, हि: also.
explanation: "Vibheeshana Those actions resorted to by Ravana which have been spoken by you in essence are known to me."

shloka_text: अहंहत्वादशग्रीवंसप्रहस्तंसबान्धवम् । राजानंत्वांकरिष्यामिसत्यमेतद्ब्रवीमिते ।।6.19.19।।
transliteration: ahaṃhatvādaśagrīvaṃsaprahastaṃsabāndhavam | rājānaṃtvāṃkariṣyāmisatyametadbravīmite
