There are ten crores of heroic and prosperous Vanaras desiring to wage war who are the sons of gods. It is not possible to speak of the remaining ones", said Saardula to Ravana."

shloka_text: पुत्त्रोदशरथस्यैषसिंहसंहनोयुवा । दूषणोनिहतोयेनखरश्चत्रिशिरास्तथा ।।6.30.28।।
transliteration: puttrodaśarathasyaiṣasiṃhasaṃhanoyuvā | dūṣaṇonihatoyenakharaścatriśirāstathā
translation: सिंहसंहनन built like lion in form, एष that, युवा young one, दशरथस्य Dasaratha's, पुत्त्र son, त्रिशिरा Trisira.
explanation: "That young one whose build is like a lion is Dasaratha's son who slayed Dushana, even Khara, like wise Trisira."

shloka_text: नास्तिरामस्यसदृशोविक्रमेभुविकश्चन । विराधोनिहतोयेनकबन्धश्चान्तकोपमः ।।6.30.29।।
transliteration: nāstirāmasyasadṛśovikramebhuvikaścana | virādhonihatoyenakabandhaścāntakopamaḥ
translation: येन by whom, विराध Viradha, निहत was killed, अन्तकोपम one like Lord of death, कबन्धश्च even Kabhanda, रामस्य Rama's, विक्रमे by valour, सदृश equal, कश्चन perhaps, भूवि in this world, नास्ति not.
explanation: "Viradha and even Kabhanda who was like the Lord of death were killed by Rama. Perhaps there is none equal to Rama in valour in this world."

shloka_text: वक्तुंनशक्तोरामस्यनरःकश्चिद्गुणान् क्षितौ । जनस्थानगतायेनयावन्तोराक्षसाहताः ।।6.30.30।।
transliteration: vaktuṃnaśaktorāmasyanaraḥkaścidguṇān kṣitau | janasthānagatāyenayāvantorākṣasāhatāḥ
translation: येन by whom, जनस्थानगता approaching Janasthana, यावन्त all, राक्षसा Rakshasas, हता were killed, रामस्य by Rama, गुणान् virtues, वक्तुम् to speak of, नर human, कश्चित् even, क्षितौ to recount, नशक्त not possible.
explanation: "It is not even possible to recount the virtues of Rama who killed all the Rakshasas approaching Janasthana."

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणश्चात्रधर्मात्मामातङ्गानामिवर्षभः । यस्यबाणपथंप्राप्यनजीवेदपिवासवः ।।6.30.31।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaścātradharmātmāmātaṅgānāmivarṣabhaḥ | yasyabāṇapathaṃprāpyanajīvedapivāsavaḥ
translation: यस्य his, बाणपथम् within the range of arrows, प्राप्य strike, वासवःअपि even Indra, नजीवेत् not be alive, धर्मात्मा righteous, मातङ्गानाम् proud elephant, ऋषभःइव like a bull, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana's, अत्र here.
explanation: "Here is righteous Lakshmana, who is like a bull (foremost) resembling a proud elephant. Even Indra will not be alive with in the range of his arrows when he strikes."

shloka_text: श्वेतोज्योतिर्मुखश्चात्रभास्करस्यात्मसम्भवौ । वरुणस्यचपुत्त्रोऽन्योःहेमकूटःप्लवङ्गमः ।।6.30.32।। विश्वकर्मसुतोवीरोनलःप्लवगसत्तमः । विक्रान्तोबलवानत्रवसुपुत्रस्सदुर्धरः ।।6.30.33।।
transliteration: śvetojyotirmukhaścātrabhāskarasyātmasambhavau | varuṇasyacaputtro'nyoḥhemakūṭaḥplavaṅgamaḥ  viśvakarmasutovīronalaḥplavagasattamaḥ | vikrāntobalavānatravasuputrassadurdharaḥ
translation: भास्करस्य Sun god's, आत्मसम्भवौ sprung from Sun god, श्वेत Swetha, ज्योतिर्मुखश्च Jyothirmukha, वरुणस्य Varuna's, अन्यःपुत्त्र other son, हेमकूट Hemakuta, प्लवङ्गम monkey, विश्वकर्मसुत son of Vishwakarma, वीर heroes, प्लवगसत्तम foremost among the monkeys, नल Nala, विक्रान्त valiant, बलवान् gallant, वसुपुत्र son of Vasu, विक्रान्त valiant, वेगवान् swift in action, वसुपुत्त्र son of Vasu, स he, दुर्धर is Durdhara, अत्र here.
explanation: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."

shloka_text: श्वेतोज्योतिर्मुखश्चात्रभास्करस्यात्मसम्भवौ । वरुणस्यचपुत्त्रोऽन्योःहेमकूटःप्लवङ्गमः ।।6.30.32।। विश्वकर्मसुतोवीरोनलःप्लवगसत्तमः । विक्रान्तोबलवानत्रवसुपुत्रस्सदुर्धरः ।।6.30.33।।
transliteration: śvetojyotirmukhaścātrabhāskarasyātmasambhavau | varuṇasyacaputtro'nyoḥhemakūṭaḥplavaṅgamaḥ  viśvakarmasutovīronalaḥplavagasattamaḥ | vikrāntobalavānatravasuputrassadurdharaḥ
translation: भास्करस्य Sun god's, आत्मसम्भवौ sprung from Sun god, श्वेत Swetha, ज्योतिर्मुखश्च Jyothirmukha, वरुणस्य Varuna's, अन्यःपुत्त्र other son, हेमकूट Hemakuta, प्लवङ्गम monkey, विश्वकर्मसुत son of Vishwakarma, वीर heroes, प्लवगसत्तम foremost among the monkeys, नल Nala, विक्रान्त valiant, बलवान् gallant, वसुपुत्र son of Vasu, विक्रान्त valiant, वेगवान् swift in action, वसुपुत्त्र son of Vasu, स he, दुर्धर is Durdhara, अत्र here.
explanation: "Here are Swetha and Jyothirmukha sons of Sun god Hemakuta another son of Varuna Nala the foremost among the monkey heroes is the valiant son of Vishwakarma and Durdhara of swift action, the son of Vasu."

shloka_text: राक्षसानांवरिष्ठश्चतवभ्रातावीभीषणः । प्रतिगृह्यपुरींलङ्कांराघवस्यहितेरतः ।।6.30.34।।
transliteration: rākṣasānāṃvariṣṭhaścatavabhrātāvībhīṣaṇaḥ | pratigṛhyapurīṃlaṅkāṃrāghavasyahiterataḥ
translation: राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, वरिष्ठश्च jewel, तव your, भ्राता brother, विभीषण Vibheeshana, राघवस्य Raghava's, हिते wellwisher, रत remains, लङ्कापुरीम् city of Lanka, प्रतिगृह्य received.
explanation: "Here is your brother Vibheeshana the jewel among Rakshasas, who remains as a wellwisher of Rama and has received the city of Lanka (to whom Rama has offered Lanka)."

shloka_text: इतिसर्वंसमाख्यातंतवेदंवानरंबलम् । सुवेलेऽधिष्ठितंशैलेशेषकार्येभवान्गतिः ।।6.30.35।।
transliteration: itisarvaṃsamākhyātaṃtavedaṃvānaraṃbalam | suvele'dhiṣṭhitaṃśaileśeṣakāryebhavāngatiḥ
translation: इति this, सुवेलेशैले on Suvela mountain, अधिष्ठितम् stationed, इदम् thus, सर्वम् everything, वानरंबलम् Vanara strength, तवइदं to you this, समाख्यातम् described, शेषकार्ये rest of the task, भवान् your, गति decide.
explanation: "I have described to you everything about the Vanara strength stationed on Suvela mountain. You may decide the rest of the task to be done." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: ततस्तमक्षोभ्यबलंलङ्काधिपतयेचराः । सुवेलेराघवंशैलेनिविष्टंप्रत्यवेदयन् ।।6.31.1।।
transliteration: tatastamakṣobhyabalaṃlaṅkādhipatayecarāḥ | suvelerāghavaṃśaileniviṣṭaṃpratyavedayan
translation: ततः there upon लङ्काअधिपतये to the king of Lanka, चराः the spies, अक्षोभ्यबलम् unshakeable army, तंराघवम् of Raghava, लङ्कायाम् to Lanka, सुवेलेशैलेनिविष्टम् staying at Suvela mountain, प्रत्यवेदयन् described.
explanation: There upon the spies described the unshakeable army of Raghava staying at Suvela mountain, to the king of Lanka.
comments: Rama's army takes position. Ravana seeks advice from his ministers and goes to Sita to threaten her to state that her husband has been killed and places counterfeit head of Rama by Sita's side.

shloka_text: चाराणांरावणश्श्रुत्वाप्राप्तंरामंमहाबलम् । जातोद्वेगोऽभवत्किञ्चित्सचिवानिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.31.2।।
transliteration: cārāṇāṃrāvaṇaśśrutvāprāptaṃrāmaṃmahābalam | jātodvego'bhavatkiñcitsacivānidamabravīt
translation: रावणः Ravana, महाबलम् with mighty force, रामम् Rama, प्राप्तम् has come, चाराणाम् from the spies, श्रुत्वा heard, किञ्चित् a little, जातोद्वेगः got perturbed, सचिवान् ministers, इदम् here, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Having heard from the spies that Rama has come with mighty force, Ravana got perturbed and said to the ministers.

shloka_text: मन्त्रिणश्शीघ्रमायान्तुसर्वेवैसुसमाहिताः । अयंनोमन्त्रकालोहिसम्प्रप्ताइतिराक्षसाः ।।6.31.3।।
transliteration: mantriṇaśśīghramāyāntusarvevaisusamāhitāḥ | ayaṃnomantrakālohisampraptāitirākṣasāḥ
translation: नः for us, अयम् this is, मन्त्रकालः time to think, सम्प्राप्तः has come इति thus, मन्त्रिणः with ministers, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सर्वे all, सुसमाहिताः all of them assembled, शीघ्रम् immediately, अयान्तु let them be called.
explanation: "The time has come for us to call for all the rakshasas and ministers immediately and assemble (said Ravana)."

shloka_text: तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वामन्त्रिणोऽभ्यागमन् द्रुतम् । ततस्समन्त्रयामासराक्षसैस्सचिवैस्सह ।।6.31.4।।
transliteration: tasyatadvacanaṃśrutvāmantriṇo'bhyāgaman drutam | tatassamantrayāmāsarākṣasaissacivaissaha
translation: तस्य his, तत् that, शासनम् order, श्रुत्वा having hard, मन्त्रिणः ministers, द्रुवम् instantly, अभ्यागमन् reached, ततः then, सः he, राक्षसैः to Rakshasa, सचिवैः ministers सह along with, मन्त्रयामास started to think.
explanation: Having been ordered (by Ravana) that way, the ministers along with Rakshasas instantly reached and he started to think with them.

shloka_text: मन्त्रयित्वासदुर्धर्षःक्षमंयत्समनन्तरम् । विसर्जयित्वासचिवान्प्रविवेशस्वमालयम् ।।6.31.5।।
transliteration: mantrayitvāsadurdharṣaḥkṣamaṃyatsamanantaram | visarjayitvāsacivānpraviveśasvamālayam
translation: दुर्दर्षः unassailable, अनन्तरम् after that, यत् that which, क्षमम् proper, तत् that, मन्त्रयित्वा thinking over, सचिवान् minister, विसर्जयित्वा dispensed away, स्वम् his own, आलयम् residence, प्रविवेश entered.
explanation: Thereafter, thinking about what is appropriate to do, unassailable Ravana dispensed his ministers and entered his own residence.

shloka_text: ततोराक्षसमाहूयविद्युज्जिह्वंमहाबलम् । मायाविदंमहामायःप्राविशद्यत्रमैथिली ।।6.31.6।।
transliteration: tatorākṣasamāhūyavidyujjihvaṃmahābalam | māyāvidaṃmahāmāyaḥprāviśadyatramaithilī
translation: ततः then, महामायः extraordinary skills, महाबलम् mighty, मायाविदम् learned in conjuring tricks, विद्युज्जिह्वम् Vidyujihvam, आदाय sent for, मैथिली Mythili, यत्र there, प्राविशत् went.
explanation: Then Ravana of extraordinary skills sent for Vidyujihvam, a learned one in conjuring tricks and went from there to Mythili.

shloka_text: विद्युज्जिह्वंचमायाज्ञमब्रवीद्राक्षसाधिपः । मोहयिष्यावहेसीतांमाययाजनकात्मजाम् ।।6.31.7।।
transliteration: vidyujjihvaṃcamāyājñamabravīdrākṣasādhipaḥ | mohayiṣyāvahesītāṃmāyayājanakātmajām
translation: राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, मायाज्ञाम् one who knows conjuring ricks, विद्युज्जिह्वम् Vidyujihvam, अब्रवीत् च and said, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, सीताम् Sita, मायया by making trick, मोहयिष्यानहे will cheat.
explanation: Rakshasa king Ravana said to Vidyujihvam who knew conjuring tricks, "We will cheat Sita, daughter of Janaka by a trick."

shloka_text: शिरोमायामयंगृह्यराघवस्यनिशाचर: । त्वंमांसमुतिष्ठस्वमहच्चसशरंधनुः ।।6.31.8।।
transliteration: śiromāyāmayaṃgṛhyarāghavasyaniśācara: | tvaṃmāṃsamutiṣṭhasvamahaccasaśaraṃdhanuḥ
translation: निशाचर night ranger, राघवस्य Raghava's, मायामयम् an illusory, शिरः head, सशरम् an arrow, महात् great, धनुःच and bow also, गृह्य seizing, माम् to me, त्वम् you, समुपतिष्ठस्व come and stand.
explanation: "O Night ranger! You make an illusory head of Raghava and come and stand at me holding an arrow with great bow."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्याहविद्युज्जिह्वोनिशाचरः । दर्शयामासतांमायांसुप्रयुक्तांसरावणे ।।6.31.9।। तस्यतुष्टोऽभवद्राजाप्रददौचविभूषणम् ।
transliteration: evamuktastathetyāhavidyujjihvoniśācaraḥ | darśayāmāsatāṃmāyāṃsuprayuktāṃsarāvaṇe  tasyatuṣṭo'bhavadrājāpradadaucavibhūṣaṇam |
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, निशाचरः night ranger, विद्युज्जिह्वः Vidyujihvam, तथेति be it so, आह striking, सुप्रयुक्ताम् dexterously produced, तांमायाम् by the tricker, सः that, रावणे to Ravana, दर्शयामास showed, राजा king, तस्य his, तुष्टः pleased, आभवत् विभूषणम् beautiful ornament, प्रददेच presented.
explanation: When the Rakshasa king had spoken that way to Vidyujihvam, he said, "Be it so." Pleased with the dexterous production of Vidyujihvam, Ravana presented to him a beautiful ornament.

shloka_text: अशोकवनिकायांतुसीतादर्शनलालसः । वैरृतानामधिपतिस्संविवेशमहाबलः ।।6.31.10।।
transliteration: aśokavanikāyāṃtusītādarśanalālasaḥ | vairṛtānāmadhipatissaṃviveśamahābalaḥ
translation: महाबलः mighty strong, नैरृतानाम् अधिपतिः Rakshasa king, सीतादर्शनलालसः eager to have a look at Sita, आशोकवनिकायाम् to the Asoka grove, संविवेश entered.
explanation: Eager to have a look at Sita, the mighty king of Rakshasas entered Asoka grove.

shloka_text: ततोदीनामदैन्यार्हांददर्शधनदानुजः ।।6.31.11।। अधोमुखींशोकपरामुपविष्टांमहीतले । भर्तारमेवध्यायन्तीमशोकवविकांगताम् ।।6.31.12।।
transliteration: tatodīnāmadainyārhāṃdadarśadhanadānujaḥ  adhomukhīṃśokaparāmupaviṣṭāṃmahītale | bhartāramevadhyāyantīmaśokavavikāṃgatām
translation: ततः there upon, धनदानुजः brother of Kubera, दीनाम् sad, अदैन्यार्हाम् who did not deserve that piteous condition, अथोमुखीम् bending down her head, शोकपराम् filled with sorrow, अशोकवनिकाम् in the Asoka grove, गताम् reduced to that state, महीतले on the ground, उपविष्टाम् seated, भर्तारमेव only about her husband, ध्यायन्तीम् contemplating, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Thereafter, the younger brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw sad Sita, who did not deserve that piteous condition, who had been reduced to sorrowful state, seated on the ground in Asoka grove, with her head bent down filled with sorrow contemplating on her husband alone.

shloka_text: ततोदीनामदैन्यार्हांददर्शधनदानुजः ।।6.31.11।। अधोमुखींशोकपरामुपविष्टांमहीतले । भर्तारमेवध्यायन्तीमशोकवविकांगताम् ।।6.31.12।।
transliteration: tatodīnāmadainyārhāṃdadarśadhanadānujaḥ  adhomukhīṃśokaparāmupaviṣṭāṃmahītale | bhartāramevadhyāyantīmaśokavavikāṃgatām
translation: ततः there upon, धनदानुजः brother of Kubera, दीनाम् sad, अदैन्यार्हाम् who did not deserve that piteous condition, अथोमुखीम् bending down her head, शोकपराम् filled with sorrow, अशोकवनिकाम् in the Asoka grove, गताम् reduced to that state, महीतले on the ground, उपविष्टाम् seated, भर्तारमेव only about her husband, ध्यायन्तीम् contemplating, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Thereafter, the younger brother of Kubera (Ravana) saw sad Sita, who did not deserve that piteous condition, who had been reduced to sorrowful state, seated on the ground in Asoka grove, with her head bent down filled with sorrow contemplating on her husband alone.

shloka_text: उपास्यमानांघोराभीराक्षसीभिरितस्ततः । उपसृत्यततस्सीतांप्रहर्षंनामकीर्तयन् ।।6.31.13।। इदंचवचनंधृष्टमुवाचजनकात्मजाम् ।
transliteration: upāsyamānāṃghorābhīrākṣasībhiritastataḥ | upasṛtyatatassītāṃpraharṣaṃnāmakīrtayan  idaṃcavacanaṃdhṛṣṭamuvācajanakātmajām |
translation: ततः then, अरितस्ततः guarded by enemies, घोराभिः dreadful, राक्षसीभिः Rakshasas also, उपास्यमानाम् closely surrounded by, सीताम् while Sita, उपसृत्य went near, प्रहर्षंनाम happy, कीर्तयन् praising, जनकात्मजाम् Sita, daughter of Janaka, धृष्टम् saw, इदंवचनम् these words, उवाच addressed.
explanation: While she was guarded by dreadful Rakshasa women surrounding her closely, Ravana went near her happily and saw her. He addressed Sita praising her.

shloka_text: सान्त्व्यमानामयाभद्रेयमुपाश्रित्यवल्गसे । खरहन्तासतेभर्ताराघवस्समरेहतः ।।6.31.14।।
transliteration: sāntvyamānāmayābhadreyamupāśrityavalgase | kharahantāsatebhartārāghavassamarehataḥ
translation: भद्रे O auspicious one, मया my, सान्त्व्यमाना however much requested, यम् whom, उपाश्रित्य seeking, विमन्यसे you did not care for me, सः that, तेभर्ता your husband, खरहन्ता who slayed Khara, राघवः Raghava, समरे in war, हतः killed.
explanation: "O Auspicious one! However, much I have requested you, you did not care for me seeking your husband. Raghava, who killed Khara, has been killed in war."

shloka_text: छिन्नंतेसर्वतोमूलंदर्पस्तेनिहतोमया । व्यसनेनात्मनस्सीते ममभार्याभविष्यसि ।।6.31.15।।
transliteration: chinnaṃtesarvatomūlaṃdarpastenihatomayā | vyasanenātmanassīte mamabhāryābhaviṣyasi
translation: सीते O Sita, सर्वतः all, मया my me, मूलम् roots, छिन्नम् crushed, दर्पतः vanity, विहतः give up, आत्मनः your own, व्यसनेन by your own self will, मम my, भार्या wife, भविष्यसि will be.
explanation: "O Sita! All your roots have been crushed by me. Give up your vanity. By your own accord, you become my wife."

shloka_text: विसृजेमांमतिंमूढे: किंमृतेनकरिष्यसि । भवस्वभद्रे: भार्याणांसर्वेसामीश्वरीमम ।।6.31.16।।
transliteration: visṛjemāṃmatiṃmūḍhe: kiṃmṛtenakariṣyasi | bhavasvabhadre: bhāryāṇāṃsarvesāmīśvarīmama
translation: मूढे O foolish one!, एताम् these, मतिम् from mind, विसृज give up, मृतेन with a deceased, किंकरिष्यसि What will you do, भद्रे O auspicious one, मम my, सर्वासाम् all, भार्याणम् of all wives, ईश्वरी queen, भव you be.
explanation: "O Foolish one! Give up these thoughts from your mind. What will you do with your deceased husband? O auspicious one! You are the queen of all my wives."

shloka_text: अल्पपुण्ये: निवृत्तार्थे: मूढे: पण्डितमानिनि: । शृणुभर्तृवधंसीते: घोरंवृत्रवधंयथा ।।6.31.17।।
transliteration: alpapuṇye: nivṛttārthe: mūḍhe: paṇḍitamānini: | śṛṇubhartṛvadhaṃsīte: ghoraṃvṛtravadhaṃyathā
translation: अल्पपुण्ये of less merit, निवृत्तार्थे one who has given up all worldly acts, मूढे stupid one, पण्डितमानिनि one who pretends as if she knows everything, सीते O Sita, वृत्रवधंयथा just as the slaying of Vrthasura, घोरम् terrific, भर्तृवधम् husband 's, शृणु hear.
explanation: "O woman of less merit! You are one who has given up all worldly actions. Stupid one! You pretend as if you know everything. O Sita! Hear about your husband 's death like that of Vrthasura."

shloka_text: समायातस्समुद्रान्तंमांहन्तुंकिलराघवः । वानरेन्द्रप्रणीतेनबलेनमहतावृतः ।।6.31.18।।
transliteration: samāyātassamudrāntaṃmāṃhantuṃkilarāghavaḥ | vānarendrapraṇītenabalenamahatāvṛtaḥ
translation: राघवः Raghava, वानरेन्द्रप्रणीतेन led by Vanara king, महता huge, बलेन army force, वृतः surrounded, माम् me, हन्तुम् to kill, समुद्रान्तम् to the shore of the sea, समायातःकिल indeed has collected.
explanation: "Raghava led by the huge army force of the Vanara king has arrived on the seashore."

shloka_text: सन्निविष्टस्समुद्रस्यपीड्यतीरमथोत्तरम् । बलेनमहतारामोव्रजत्यस्तंदिवाकरे ।।6.31.19।।
transliteration: sanniviṣṭassamudrasyapīḍyatīramathottaram | balenamahatārāmovrajatyastaṃdivākare
translation: अथ and then, दिवाकरे when Sun, अस्तम् sets, व्रजतिपति moved towards west, रामः Rama, महता huge, बलेन strength of army, समुद्रस्य ocean's, उत्तरम् northern, तीरम् shore, पीड्य to strike, सन्निविष्टः encamped.
explanation: And when the Sun moved towards the west, Rama encamped on the northern shore of the sea with a huge army to strike.

shloka_text: अथाध्वनिपरिश्रान्तमर्धरात्रेस्थितंबलम् । सुखसुप्तंसमासाद्यचारित्रंप्रथमंचरैः ।।6.31.20।।
transliteration: athādhvanipariśrāntamardharātresthitaṃbalam | sukhasuptaṃsamāsādyacāritraṃprathamaṃcaraiḥ
translation: अथ and then, अध्वनि having walked all the way, परिश्रान्तम् taking rest, अर्धरात्रे midnight, सुखसुप्तम् slept well, स्थितम् stayed, बलम् army, प्रथमम् prime, समासाद्य sending, चरैः spies, चारित्रं all about them.
explanation: After having walked all the way they slept well and when they were sleeping at midnight, we found out all about them by sending prime spies.

shloka_text: तत्प्रहस्तप्रणीतेनबलेनमहतामम । बलमस्यहतंरात्रौयत्ररामस्सलक्ष्मणः ।।6.31.21।।
transliteration: tatprahastapraṇītenabalenamahatāmama | balamasyahataṃrātrauyatrarāmassalakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: सलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, रामः Rama, यत्र where in, प्रहस्तप्रणीतेन led by Prahastha, महता great, ममबलेन by my army, अस्य their, बलम् powerful, रात्रौ in the night, हतम् slayed.
explanation: "There in that camp Lakshmana and Rama are killed by my powerful army led by Prahastha at night."

shloka_text: पट्टसान्परिघांश्चक्रान्दण्डान्महायशान् । बाणजालानिशूलानिभास्वरान्कूटमुद्गरान् ।।6.31.22।। यष्टीश्चतोमरान् शक्तीश्चक्राणिमुसलानिच । उद्यम्योद्यम्यरक्षोभिर्वानरेषुनिपातितां ।।6.31.23।।
transliteration: paṭṭasānparighāṃścakrāndaṇḍānmahāyaśān | bāṇajālāniśūlānibhāsvarānkūṭamudgarān  yaṣṭīścatomarān śaktīścakrāṇimusalānica | udyamyodyamyarakṣobhirvānareṣunipātitāṃ
translation: पट्टशान् spears, परिघान् iron bars, चक्रान् javelins, दण्डान् staffs, महायशान् huge ones, बाणजालानि sparkling maces, शूलानि tridents, भास्वरान् shining, कूटमुद्गरान् iron mallets, यष्टीश्च and clubs, तोमरान् lances, शक्ती strong, मुसलानिच and Musalas, उद्यम्यउद्यम्य lifting again and again, रक्षोभिः Rakshasas, वानरेषु at Vanaras, निपातिताः hurled.
explanation: Again, and again lifting spears, iron bars, javelins, huge staffs, sparkling maces, shining iron mallets and clubs, lances and strong Musalas, the Rakshasas hurled at Vanaras.

shloka_text: पट्टसान्परिघांश्चक्रान्दण्डान्महायशान् । बाणजालानिशूलानिभास्वरान्कूटमुद्गरान् ।।6.31.22।। यष्टीश्चतोमरान् शक्तीश्चक्राणिमुसलानिच । उद्यम्योद्यम्यरक्षोभिर्वानरेषुनिपातितां ।।6.31.23।।
transliteration: paṭṭasānparighāṃścakrāndaṇḍānmahāyaśān | bāṇajālāniśūlānibhāsvarānkūṭamudgarān  yaṣṭīścatomarān śaktīścakrāṇimusalānica | udyamyodyamyarakṣobhirvānareṣunipātitāṃ
translation: पट्टशान् spears, परिघान् iron bars, चक्रान् javelins, दण्डान् staffs, महायशान् huge ones, बाणजालानि sparkling maces, शूलानि tridents, भास्वरान् shining, कूटमुद्गरान् iron mallets, यष्टीश्च and clubs, तोमरान् lances, शक्ती strong, मुसलानिच and Musalas, उद्यम्यउद्यम्य lifting again and again, रक्षोभिः Rakshasas, वानरेषु at Vanaras, निपातिताः hurled.
explanation: Again, and again lifting spears, iron bars, javelins, huge staffs, sparkling maces, shining iron mallets and clubs, lances and strong Musalas, the Rakshasas hurled at Vanaras.

shloka_text: अथसुप्तस्यरामस्यप्रहस्तेनप्रमाथिना । असक्तंकृतहस्तेनशिरश्छिन्नंमहासिना ।।6.31.24।।
transliteration: athasuptasyarāmasyaprahastenapramāthinā | asaktaṃkṛtahastenaśiraśchinnaṃmahāsinā
translation: अथ thereafter, प्रमाथिना one who is capable of striking, कृतहस्तेन skilled, प्रहस्तेन by Prahastha, महासिना big sword, सुप्तस्य sleeping, रमस्य Rama's, शिरः head, असक्तं without any feeling of attachment, छिन्नम् severed.
explanation: "There after the head of Rama, who was sleeping, was severed by Prahastha, skilled at striking, with a big sword without any feeling of attachment."

shloka_text: विभीषणस्समुत्पत्यनिगृहीतोयदृच्छया । दिशःप्रव्राजितस्सर्वैस्सर्लक्ष्मणःप्लवगैस्सहा ।।6.31.25।।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇassamutpatyanigṛhītoyadṛcchayā | diśaḥpravrājitassarvaissarlakṣmaṇaḥplavagaissahā
translation: यदृच्छया by chance, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, समुत्पत्य when rose up, निगृहीतः caught hold, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, प्लवगैःसह along with Vanaras, दिशम् directions, प्रव्राजितः fled.
explanation: "When Vibheeshana rose up he was caught by chance. Lakshmana and Vanaras fled in all directions."

shloka_text: सुग्रीवोग्रीनयासीतेभग्नयाप्लवगाधिपः । निरस्तहनुकश्शेतेहनुमान्राक्षसैर्हतः ।।6.31.26।।
transliteration: sugrīvogrīnayāsītebhagnayāplavagādhipaḥ | nirastahanukaśśetehanumānrākṣasairhataḥ
translation: सीते O Sita!, प्लवगाधिपः Vanara Lord, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भग्नया broken, ग्रीनया neck, हनुमान् Hanuman, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, निरस्तहनुकः chin broken, हतः killed, शेते lies fallen down.
explanation: "O Sita! Vanara Lord Sugriva with his neck broken, Hanuman with chin broken were killed by Rakshasas and are lying down fallen on the ground."

shloka_text: जाम्बवानथजानुभ्यामुत्पतन्निहतोयुधि । पट्टसैर्बहुभिश्छिन्नोनिकृत्तःपादपोयथा ।।6.31.27।।
transliteration: jāmbavānathajānubhyāmutpatannihatoyudhi | paṭṭasairbahubhiśchinnonikṛttaḥpādapoyathā
translation: अथ and, जानुभ्याम् on the knees, उत्पतन् while rising up, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, युधि in combat, निहातः fallen down, बहुभिः many, पट्टसै: iron bars, छिन्नः struck, पादपोयथा like a tree, छिन्नः broken down.
explanation: And while Jambavan was rising on his knees, he was struck by many iron bars in comb at and had fallen down like a tree.

shloka_text: मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौनिहतौवानरर्षभौ ।।6.31.28।। निश्श्वसन्तौरुदन्तौचरुधिरेणसमुक्षितौ । असिनाव्यायतौछिन्नौमध्येह्यरिनिषूदनौ ।।6.31.29।।
transliteration: maindaścadvividaścobhaunihatauvānararṣabhau  niśśvasantaurudantaucarudhireṇasamukṣitau | asināvyāyatauchinnaumadhyehyariniṣūdanau
translation: व्यायतौ of huge body, अरिनिषूदनौ slayers of enemies, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, वानरर्षभौ bulls among Vanaras, निश्शसन्तौ breathing hard, रुदन्तौ roaring, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षितौ bathing, असिना sword, मध्ये in the midst, छिन्नौ cut.
explanation: "Mainda and Dwivida of huge bodies, who are slayers of enemies, the bulls among Vanaras are breathing hard, and bathed in blood roaring, having been cutin the middle of their body."

shloka_text: मैन्दश्चद्विविदश्चोभौनिहतौवानरर्षभौ ।।6.31.28।। निश्श्वसन्तौरुदन्तौचरुधिरेणसमुक्षितौ । असिनाव्यायतौछिन्नौमध्येह्यरिनिषूदनौ ।।6.31.29।।
transliteration: maindaścadvividaścobhaunihatauvānararṣabhau  niśśvasantaurudantaucarudhireṇasamukṣitau | asināvyāyatauchinnaumadhyehyariniṣūdanau
translation: व्यायतौ of huge body, अरिनिषूदनौ slayers of enemies, मैन्दश्च Mainda, द्विविदश्च and Dwivida, उभौ both, वानरर्षभौ bulls among Vanaras, निश्शसन्तौ breathing hard, रुदन्तौ roaring, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षितौ bathing, असिना sword, मध्ये in the midst, छिन्नौ cut.
explanation: "Mainda and Dwivida of huge bodies, who are slayers of enemies, the bulls among Vanaras are breathing hard, and bathed in blood roaring, having been cutin the middle of their body."

shloka_text: अनुतिष्ठतिमेदिन्यांपनसःपनसोयथा ।।6.31.30।। नाराचैर्बहुभिश्चिन्नश्शेतेदर्यांदरीमुखः । कुमुदस्तुमहातेजानिष्कूजन्सायकै: कृतः ।।6.31.31।।
transliteration: anutiṣṭhatimedinyāṃpanasaḥpanasoyathā  nārācairbahubhiścinnaśśetedaryāṃdarīmukhaḥ | kumudastumahātejāniṣkūjansāyakai: kṛtaḥ
translation: पनसोयथा like jackfruit, पनसः Panasa, मेदिन्याम् on the earth, अनुतिष्ठति lying on the ground, दरीमुखः Darimukha, बहुभिः many, नाराचैः arrows, छिन्नः shattered, दर्याम् on the ground, शेते lying down, निष्कूजन् torn off, महातेजाः brilliant, कुमुदस्तु Kumuda too, सायकैः silently, कृतः lying.
explanation: "Panasa is lying down on earth like jackfruit. Darimukha is lying down shattered by many arrows. Brilliant Kumuda too is torn off and silently lying down."

shloka_text: अनुतिष्ठतिमेदिन्यांपनसःपनसोयथा ।।6.31.30।। नाराचैर्बहुभिश्चिन्नश्शेतेदर्यांदरीमुखः । कुमुदस्तुमहातेजानिष्कूजन्सायकै: कृतः ।।6.31.31।।
transliteration: anutiṣṭhatimedinyāṃpanasaḥpanasoyathā  nārācairbahubhiścinnaśśetedaryāṃdarīmukhaḥ | kumudastumahātejāniṣkūjansāyakai: kṛtaḥ
translation: पनसोयथा like jackfruit, पनसः Panasa, मेदिन्याम् on the earth, अनुतिष्ठति lying on the ground, दरीमुखः Darimukha, बहुभिः many, नाराचैः arrows, छिन्नः shattered, दर्याम् on the ground, शेते lying down, निष्कूजन् torn off, महातेजाः brilliant, कुमुदस्तु Kumuda too, सायकैः silently, कृतः lying.
explanation: "Panasa is lying down on earth like jackfruit. Darimukha is lying down shattered by many arrows. Brilliant Kumuda too is torn off and silently lying down."

shloka_text: अङ्गदोबहुभिश्छिन्नश्शरैरासाद्यराक्षसैः । पतितोरुधिरोद्गारीक्षितौनिपतिताङ्गदः ।।6.31.32।।
transliteration: aṅgadobahubhiśchinnaśśarairāsādyarākṣasaiḥ | patitorudhirodgārīkṣitaunipatitāṅgadaḥ
translation: पतितः fallen down, रुधिरोद्गारी throwing up blood, क्षितौ destroyed, निपतिताङ्गदः shoulder straps dropped down, अङ्गदः Angada, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, आसाद्य reaching towards him, बहुभिः many, शरैः arrows, छिन्नः chopped.
explanation: "By the many arrows of Rakshasas reaching towards Angada, he lies down chopped up and destroyed, with his armlets dropped down throwing up blood."

shloka_text: हरयोमथितानागैरथजातैस्तथापरे । शयितामृदिताश्चाश्वैर्यायुवेगैरिवाम्बुदाः ।।6.31.33।।
transliteration: harayomathitānāgairathajātaistathāpare | śayitāmṛditāścāśvairyāyuvegairivāmbudāḥ
translation: तत्र there, शयिता: sleeping ones, अपरे some, हरयः Vanaras, नागैः by elephants, तथा so also, रथजातैः by mass of clouds, वायुवेगैः by the speed of wind, अम्बुदाःइव like the clouds, मृदिताः are dead.
explanation: "There, some of the sleeping Vanaras were crushed by elephants, so also, just as by the speed of wind the clouds are crushed the Vanaras are crushed to death."

shloka_text: प्रहृताश्चपरेत्रस्ताहस्यमानाजघन्यतः । अभिद्रुतास्तुरक्षोभिस्सिंहैरिवमहाद्विपाः ।।6.31.34।।
transliteration: prahṛtāścaparetrastāhasyamānājaghanyataḥ | abhidrutāsturakṣobhissiṃhairivamahādvipāḥ
translation: परे some, जघन्यतः followed behind, हन्यमानाः destroying, सिंहैः lions, महाद्विपा: इव like huge elephants, रक्षोभिः like Rakshasas, अभिद्रुताः severely afflicted, त्रस्ताः frightened, प्रहृताः struck.
explanation: "Some were followed behind as they were speeding like lions and mighty elephants afflicted and frightened, struck by Rakshasas."

shloka_text: सागरेपतिताःकेचित्केचिग्दगनमाश्रिताः । ऋक्षावृक्षानुपारूढावानरींवृत्तिमाश्रिताः ।।6.31.35।।
transliteration: sāgarepatitāḥkecitkecigdaganamāśritāḥ | ṛkṣāvṛkṣānupārūḍhāvānarīṃvṛttimāśritāḥ
translation: केचित् a few, सागरे sea, पतिताः dived in, केचित् some, गगनम् sky, आश्रिताः sought refuge, ऋक्षाः Bears, वानरैः Vanaras, वृत्तिमाश्रिताः resorting to their ways, वृक्षान् trees, उपारूढाः climbed.
explanation: "While a few Vanaras dived into the sea, some took refuge in the sky. Resorting to their natural way the Bears climbed the trees."

shloka_text: सागरस्यचतीरेषुशैलेषुचवनेषुच । पिङ्गलास्तेविरूपाक्षैर्बहुभिर्बहवोहताः ।।6.31.36।।
transliteration: sāgarasyacatīreṣuśaileṣucavaneṣuca | piṅgalāstevirūpākṣairbahubhirbahavohatāḥ
translation: ते they, बहवः many, पिङ्गलाः those with yellowish brown eyes (Vanaras), सागरस्य in the ocean, तीरेषु on the shore, शैलेषुच on mountains, वनेषुच in woods, विरूपाक्षैः with fierce eyes, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, हताः were killed.
explanation: "Many fierceeyed Rakshasas killed several Vanaras on the shore of the ocean, in the mountains and woods."

shloka_text: एवंतवहतोभर्ताससैन्योममसेनया । क्षतजार्द्रंरजोध्वस्तमिदंचस्याहृतंशिरः ।।6.31.37।।
transliteration: evaṃtavahatobhartāsasainyomamasenayā | kṣatajārdraṃrajodhvastamidaṃcasyāhṛtaṃśiraḥ
translation: एवम् in that manner, ससैन्यः the army, तन your, भर्ता husband, सेनया army, हतः were killed, अस्य his, क्षथजार्द्रम् decayed and drenched in blood, रजोध्वस्तम् covered with dust particles, इदम् this, शिरः head, अहृतम् brought.
explanation: "In that way the army of your husband has been killed by Rakshasa army and his decayed head drenched in blood covered with dust has been brought."

shloka_text: ततःपरमदुर्धर्षोरावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । सीतायामुपशन्त्यांराक्षसीमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.31.38।।
transliteration: tataḥparamadurdharṣorāvaṇorākṣaseśvaraḥ | sītāyāmupaśantyāṃrākṣasīmidamabravīt
translation: ततः then, परमदुर्धर्षः highly unassailable, राक्षसेश्वर king of Rakshasas, रावण Ravana, सीतायाम् while Sita, उशृण्वत्याम् to the hearing of, राक्षसीम् Rakshasas, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then Ravana, the highly unassailable king of Rakshasas spoke these words to the hearing of Sita.

shloka_text: राक्षसंक्रूरकर्माणंविद्युज्जिह्वंत्वमानय । येनतद्राघवशिरस्सङ्ग्रामात्स्वयमाहृतम् ।।6.31.39।।
transliteration: rākṣasaṃkrūrakarmāṇaṃvidyujjihvaṃtvamānaya | yenatadrāghavaśirassaṅgrāmātsvayamāhṛtam
translation: येन he who, तत् that, राघवशिरः Rama's head, सङ्ग्रामात् from the battlefield, स्वयम् the one, आहृतम् who brought, क्रूरकर्माणम् one of cruel deeds, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, विद्युज्जिह्वम् Vidyujihvam, त्वमानयः bring along.
explanation: "Bring that Rakshasa, Vidyujihvam of cruel deeds who brought Rama's head from the battlefield."

shloka_text: विद्युज्जिह्वस्ततोगृह्यशिरस्तत्सशरासनम् । प्रणामंशिरसाकृत्वारावणस्याग्रतस्थितः ।।6.31.40।।
transliteration: vidyujjihvastatogṛhyaśirastatsaśarāsanam | praṇāmaṃśirasākṛtvārāvaṇasyāgratasthitaḥ
translation: ततः then, विद्यज्जिह्वः Vidyujihvam, सशरासनम् along with bow, तत् शिरः that head, गृह्य holding, शिरसा by his head, प्रणामम् bowing down in salutation, कृत्वा having done रावणस्य Ravana 's, अग्रतः in front, स्थितः stood.
explanation: Then holding the head along with the bow, Vidyujihvam bowed his head down in salutation and stood in front of Ravana.

shloka_text: तमब्रवीत्ततोराजारावणोराक्षसंस्थितम् । विद्युज्जिह्वंमहाजिह्वंसमीपपरिवर्तिनम् ।।6.31.41।।
transliteration: tamabravīttatorājārāvaṇorākṣasaṃsthitam | vidyujjihvaṃmahājihvaṃsamīpaparivartinam
translation: ततः then, राज king, रावणः Ravana, महाजिह्वाम् one with extended tongue, समीपपरिवर्तिनम् who had come close, स्थितम् stood, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, तंविद्युज्जिह्वं to Vidyujihvam, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Then the king, Ravana spoke to Vidyujihvam, the Rakshasa with extended tongue, who stood close by.

shloka_text: अग्रतःकुरुसीतायाश्शीघ्रंदाशरधेशशिरः । अवस्थांपश्चिमांभर्तुःकृपणासाधुपश्यतु ।।6.31.42।।
transliteration: agrataḥkurusītāyāśśīghraṃdāśaradheśaśiraḥ | avasthāṃpaścimāṃbhartuḥkṛpaṇāsādhupaśyatu
translation: दाशरथेः Dasaratha's son's, शिरः head, शीघ्रम् at once, सीतायाः Sita's, अग्रतः before, कुरु place it, कृपणा piteous woman, भर्तुः to husband, पश्चिमाम् at the end, अवस्थाम् ultimate state, साधु attained, पश्यतु let her see.
explanation: At once place the head of Dasaratha's son before that piteous woman. Let her see the ultimate status attained by her husband at the end (said Ravana).

shloka_text: एवमुक्तंतुतद्रक्षशशिरस्तत्प्रियदर्शनम् । उपनिक्षिप्यसीतायाःक्षिप्रमन्तरधीयत ।।6.31.43।।
transliteration: evamuktaṃtutadrakṣaśaśirastatpriyadarśanam | upanikṣipyasītāyāḥkṣipramantaradhīyata
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्तम् having spoken, तत् रक्षः that Rakshasa, प्रियदर्शनम् pleasing to see, तत् that, शिरः head, सीतायाः to Sita, उपनिक्षिप्य by the side of, क्षीप्रम् immediately, अन्तरधीयत went away.
explanation: Having spoken immediately placed the head of Rama that was pleasing to see, by the side of Sita and went away.

shloka_text: रावणश्चापिचिक्षेपभस्वरंकार्मुकंमहत् । त्रिषुलोकेषुविख्यातंसीतामिदमुवाचह ।।6.31.44।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaścāpicikṣepabhasvaraṃkārmukaṃmahat | triṣulokeṣuvikhyātaṃsītāmidamuvācaha
translation: रावणश्चापि even Ravana, सीता Sita, इदम् thus, उवाचह addressed, त्रिषुलोकेषु in the three worlds, विख्यातम् famous, इति this, भास्वरम् bright, महत् great, कार्मुकम् bow, चिक्षेप casting down.
explanation: Thus addressed Ravana casting down the bright great bow that is famous in the three worlds.

shloka_text: इदंतुतवरामस्यकार्मुकंज्यासमायुतम् । इहप्रहस्तेनानीतंहत्वातंनिशिमानुषम् ।।6.31.45।।
transliteration: idaṃtutavarāmasyakārmukaṃjyāsamāyutam | ihaprahastenānītaṃhatvātaṃniśimānuṣam
translation: इदम् this, तवरामस्य your Rama's, ज्यासमावृतम duly strung, तत् that, कार्मुकम् bow, निशि in the night, तम् him, मानुषम् he human being, हत्वा after killing, इह here, प्रहस्तेन by Prahastha, अनीतम् has brought.
explanation: "Prahastha has brought this bow duly tied with the string after killing human Rama in the night."

shloka_text: सासीतातच्छिरोदृष्टवातच्चकार्मुकमुत्तमम् । सुग्रीवप्रतिसंपर्गमाख्यातंचहनूमता ।।6.32.1।। नयनेमुखवर्णंचभर्तुस्तत्सदृशंमुखम् । केशान् केशान्तदेशंचतंचचूडामणिंशुभम् ।।6.32.2।। एतैस्सर्वेरभिज्ञानैरभिज्ञायसुदुःखिता । निजगर्हेचकैकेयींक्रोशन्तीकुररीयथा ।।6.32.3।।
transliteration: sāsītātacchirodṛṣṭavātaccakārmukamuttamam | sugrīvapratisaṃpargamākhyātaṃcahanūmatā  nayanemukhavarṇaṃcabhartustatsadṛśaṃmukham | keśān keśāntadeśaṃcataṃcacūḍāmaṇiṃśubham  etaissarverabhijñānairabhijñāyasuduḥkhitā | nijagarhecakaikeyīṃkrośantīkurarīyathā
translation: सासीता that Sita, तत् then, शिरः head, उत्तमम् esteemed, तत् that, कार्मुकंच and the bow, हनूमता by Hanuman, आख्यातम् described by, सुग्रीप्रतिसंसर्गम् friendship with Sugriva, नयने the eyes, मुखवर्णंच and complexion of the face, भर्तुः husband 's, पदृशम् the eyes, तत् that, मुखम् face, केसान् the hair, केशान्तदेशंच curls at the end of hair, तम् them, शुभम् auspicious चूडामणिंच and Chudamani, दृष्टवा seeing, एतैः those सर्वैः all, अभिज्ञानैः recognizing, अभिज्ञाय perceiving similarity, सुदुःखिता very sad, कुररीयथा like a deer, क्रोशन्ती crying, कैकेयीम् Kaikeyi, निजगर्हेच abused.
explanation: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.
comments: Sita wails at the sight of Rama's head presented by Ravana to her. Ravana abruptly leaves Ashoka grove.

shloka_text: सासीतातच्छिरोदृष्टवातच्चकार्मुकमुत्तमम् । सुग्रीवप्रतिसंपर्गमाख्यातंचहनूमता ।।6.32.1।। नयनेमुखवर्णंचभर्तुस्तत्सदृशंमुखम् । केशान् केशान्तदेशंचतंचचूडामणिंशुभम् ।।6.32.2।। एतैस्सर्वेरभिज्ञानैरभिज्ञायसुदुःखिता । निजगर्हेचकैकेयींक्रोशन्तीकुररीयथा ।।6.32.3।।
transliteration: sāsītātacchirodṛṣṭavātaccakārmukamuttamam | sugrīvapratisaṃpargamākhyātaṃcahanūmatā  nayanemukhavarṇaṃcabhartustatsadṛśaṃmukham | keśān keśāntadeśaṃcataṃcacūḍāmaṇiṃśubham  etaissarverabhijñānairabhijñāyasuduḥkhitā | nijagarhecakaikeyīṃkrośantīkurarīyathā

explanation: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.
comments: Sita wails at the sight of Rama's head presented by Ravana to her. Ravana abruptly leaves Ashoka grove.

explanation: On seeing the esteemed Rama's head and bow, remembering the description made by Hanuman about the friendship with Sugriva thinking of the eyes, complexion of the face, the hair, and curls of her husband at the end Sita recognized the auspicious Chudamani. Identifying all those marks to be like Rama's she felt very sad and cried like a deer and abused Kaikeyi.
comments: Sita wails at the sight of Rama's head presented by Ravana to her. Ravana abruptly leaves Ashoka grove.

shloka_text: सकामाभवकैकेयीहतोऽयंकुलनन्दनः । कुलमुत्सादितंसर्वंत्वयाकलहशीलया ।।6.32.4।।
transliteration: sakāmābhavakaikeyīhato'yaṃkulanandanaḥ | kulamutsāditaṃsarvaṃtvayākalahaśīlayā
translation: कैकेयि O Kaikeyi, सकामा desire fulfilled, भव of yours, कुलनन्दनः delight of the race, आयम् this, हतः killed, कलहशीलया one who is given to creating quarrel, त्वया by you, सर्वम् all, कुलम् race, उत्सादितम् have ruined.
explanation: "O Kaikeyi! Your desire is fulfilled with the killing of the delight of the race. You, who are given to creating quarrel have ruined the race."

shloka_text: आर्येणकिंतेकैकेयी कृतंरामेणविप्रियम् । यन्मयाचीरवसनस्त्वयाप्रस्थापितोवनम् ।।6.32.5।।
transliteration: āryeṇakiṃtekaikeyī kṛtaṃrāmeṇavipriyam | yanmayācīravasanastvayāprasthāpitovanam
translation: आर्येण to the prince, रामेण to Rama, कैकेयी Kaikeyi, किमं what, विप्रियम् harm, कृतंनु you did, यत् to him, चीरवसनम् bark robes, त्वया by you, मया with me, वनम् forest, प्रस्थापितः cried.
explanation: "Kaikeyi, you have given bark robes to prince Rama and sent him to the forest with me. What harm has he done for you? Thinking of this again and again Sita cried."

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वातुवैदेहीवेपमानातपस्विनी । जगामजगतींबालाछिन्नातुकदळीयथा ।।6.32.6।।
transliteration: evamuktvātuvaidehīvepamānātapasvinī | jagāmajagatīṃbālāchinnātukadaḻīyathā
translation: तपस्विनी miserable one, बाला young, वैदेही Vaidehi, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, वेपमाना trembling, छिन्ना cut off, कदळी banana, जगतीम् on to the ground, जगाम fell down.
explanation: That miserable young, Vaidehi, having said so, fell on the ground trembling like a cut off banana plant.

shloka_text: सामुहूर्तात्समाश्वास्यप्रतिलभ्यचचेतनाम् । तच्छिरस्समुपाघ्रायविललासायतेक्षणा ।।6.32.7।।
transliteration: sāmuhūrtātsamāśvāsyapratilabhyacacetanām | tacchirassamupāghrāyavilalāsāyatekṣaṇā
translation: आयुतेक्षणा broadeyed one, सा she, अथ and then, मुहूर्तात् for a while, समाश्वास्य regaining, चेतनाम् consciousness, परिलभ्य remaining behind, तत् that, शिरः head, समुपाघ्राय sitting close by, विललास lamented.
explanation: Broadeyed Sita, regaining her consciousness after a while, sat close to the head of Rama and lamented.

shloka_text: हाहताऽस्मिमहाबाहो वीरव्रतमनुव्रत । इमांतेपश्चिमावस्थांगताऽस्मिविधवाकृता ।।6.32.8।।
transliteration: hāhatā'smimahābāho vīravratamanuvrata | imāṃtepaścimāvasthāṃgatā'smividhavākṛtā
translation: महाबाहो mightyarmed, वीरव्रतम् heroic vow, अनुव्रत following, हा alas, हतास्मि you are killed, ते you, इमाम् thus, पश्चिमावस्थाम् in the last state of life, गताआस्मि live to see you, विधवा widowed, कृता am done.
explanation: "O mightyarmed one! Alas you are killed while following heroic vow. I live to see you in the last state of your life, widowed. I am done."

shloka_text: प्रथमंमरणंनार्याभर्तुर्वैगुण्यमुच्यते । सुवृत्त: स्साधुवृत्तायास्सम्वृत्तस्त्वंममाग्रतः ।।6.32.9।।
transliteration: prathamaṃmaraṇaṃnāryābharturvaiguṇyamucyate | suvṛtta: ssādhuvṛttāyāssamvṛttastvaṃmamāgrataḥ
translation: सुवृत्तः faithful to one's vows, प्रथमम् in front, भर्तुः husband 's, मरणम् death, नार्याः O noble one, वैगुण्यम् fault, उच्यते is said to be, त्वम् your, साधुवृत्तायाः of good conduct, मम I, अग्रतः in front, सम्वृत्तं virtuous one.
explanation: "O Rama, you are faithful to your vows, a noble one! It is said that because of a woman's faults, the husband will die. It is not even so as you died in front of a virtuous woman of good conduct."

shloka_text: दुःखाद्दुःखंप्रपन्नायामग्नायाश्शोकसागरे । योहिमामुद्यतनिस्त्रातुंसोऽपित्वंविनिपातितः ।।6.32.10।।
transliteration: duḥkhādduḥkhaṃprapannāyāmagnāyāśśokasāgare | yohimāmudyatanistrātuṃso'pitvaṃvinipātitaḥ
translation: दुःखात् in grief, दुःखम् grief, प्रपन्नायाः reaching at, शोकसागरे ocean of sorrow, मग्नायाः filled, यः who, त्वम् you, त्रातु, to save उद्यतः have come, सोऽपि you are also, विनिपातितः are killed.
explanation: "I am in grief and filled with an ocean of sorrow. You who have come to save me and are also killed."

shloka_text: साश्वश्रूर्ममकौसल्यात्वयापुत्रेणराघव: । वत्सेनेवयथाधेनुर्विवत्सावत्सलाकृता ।।6.32.11।।
transliteration: sāśvaśrūrmamakausalyātvayāputreṇarāghava: | vatsenevayathādhenurvivatsāvatsalākṛtā
translation: राघव Raghava, मम my, श्वश्रूः motherinlaw, कौसल्या Kausalya, वत्सला dear धेनुःयथा like a cow, पुत्रेण about son, त्वया likewise, वत्सेने about her dear son, विवत्साकृता is separated.
explanation: "O Raghava! Even my motherinlaw Kausalya is separated from her dear son just as cow is separated from calf."

shloka_text: आद्दिष्टंदीर्घमायुस्तेयैरचिन्त्यपराक्रम । अनृतंवचनंतेषामल्पायुरपिराघव ।।6.32.12।।
transliteration: āddiṣṭaṃdīrghamāyusteyairacintyaparākrama | anṛtaṃvacanaṃteṣāmalpāyurapirāghava
translation: राघव Raghava, अचिन्त्यपराक्रम of incomprehensible valour, ते you, आयुः life, दीर्घम् long, उददिष्टम् predicted by astrologers, राघव Raghava, तेषाम् their, वचनम् word, आनृतम् is falsified, अल्पायुः short life, असि has been.
explanation: "O Raghava of incomprehensible valour! the words predicted by astrologers that your life is long is falsified. Your life has been short."

shloka_text: अथवानश्यतिप्रज्ञाप्राज्ञस्यापिसतस्तव । पचत्येनंयथाकालोभूतानांप्रभवोऽह्ययम् ।।6.32.13।।
transliteration: athavānaśyatiprajñāprājñasyāpisatastava | pacatyenaṃyathākālobhūtānāṃprabhavo'hyayam
translation: अथवा or else, प्राज्ञास्यापिसतः even the learned ones, तन diffused, प्रज्ञा wisdom, नश्यति lost, यथा likewise, भूतानाम् living beings, प्रभवः effect, आयम् this, कालः time, एवम् in that way, पचति caused.
explanation: "Or else, even the wisdom of a learned one is diffused and lost perhaps! the effect of time which is the cause of all living beings has caused this."

shloka_text: अदृष्टंमृत्युमापन्नःकस्मात्त्वंनयशास्त्रवित् । व्यसनानामुपायज्ञःकुशलोह्यसिवर्जने ।।6.32.14।।
transliteration: adṛṣṭaṃmṛtyumāpannaḥkasmāttvaṃnayaśāstravit | vyasanānāmupāyajñaḥkuśalohyasivarjane
translation: नयशास्त्रवित् knower of all sastras, त्वम् you, कस्मात् how did you meet, अदृष्टम् by chance, मृत्युम् death, आपन्नः overtakes you, उपायज्ञः ways of getting out, व्यसनानाम् calamities, वर्जने to ward off, कुशलः capable, असिहि you are also.
explanation: "You are the knower of all sastras, and capable of warding off all calamities. How did death have a chance to meet you and overtake?"

shloka_text: तथात्वंसम्परिष्वज्यरौद्रयाऽतिनृशंसया । काळरात्य्राममाच्छिद्यहृतःकमललोचन:।। 6.32.15।।
transliteration: tathātvaṃsampariṣvajyaraudrayā'tinṛśaṃsayā | kāḻarātyrāmamācchidyahṛtaḥkamalalocana:
translation: कमललोचन lotuseyed one, अतिनृशंसया most horrible, रौद्रया cruel, काळरात्य्रा dark night, तथा likewise, सम्परिष्वज्य after losing contact, मम me, आच्छिद्य cutting off, हृतः killed.
explanation: "O lotuseyed Rama! After you have lost contact with me, the most horrible cruel night has killed you cutting you off from me."

shloka_text: उपशेषेमहाबाहो: मांविहायतपस्विनीम् । प्रियामिवसमालशिष्यपृथिवींपुरुषर्षभ ।।6.32.16।।
transliteration: upaśeṣemahābāho: māṃvihāyatapasvinīm | priyāmivasamālaśiṣyapṛthivīṃpuruṣarṣabha
translation: महाबाहो mightyarmed one, पुरुषर्षभ bull among men, तपस्विनीम् noble one, माम् me, विहाय sky, पृथिवीम् the earth, प्रियामिव like beloved, समालशिष्य embraced, उपशेषे more over sleeping.
explanation: "O mightyarmed one! A bull among men and a noble one, you are embracing the earth as though it is your beloved and sleeping leaving me in the sky."

shloka_text: अर्चितंसततंयत्तद्गन्धमाल्यैर्मयातव । इदंतेमप्रतियंवीरधनुःकाञ्चानभूषणम् ।।6.32.17।।
transliteration: arcitaṃsatataṃyattadgandhamālyairmayātava | idaṃtemapratiyaṃvīradhanuḥkāñcānabhūṣaṇam
translation: वीर hero, इदम this, मया my, तव you, सततम् ever, यत्नात् diligently, गन्धमाल्यैः with sandal and flowers, अर्चितम् worshipped, मप्रतियम् with utmost devotion, काञ्चनभूषणम् decorated with gold, ते your, धनुः bow.
explanation: "O Hero! This bow that was decorated with gold was always worshipped with sandal and flowers diligently by you and me with utmost devotion."

shloka_text: पित्रादशरथेनत्वंश्वशुरेणममानघ: । सर्वैश्चपितृभिस्सार्थंनूनंस्वर्गेसमागतः ।।6.32.18।।
transliteration: pitrādaśarathenatvaṃśvaśureṇamamānagha: | sarvaiścapitṛbhissārthaṃnūnaṃsvargesamāgataḥ
translation: अनघ sinless one, त्वम् by you, मम me, श्वशुरेण with fatherinlaw, पित्रा father, दशरथेन by Dasaratha, सर्वैः all, पितृभि grand fathers स्सार्दम् with all, नूनम् surely, स्वर्गे heaven, समागतः reached.
explanation: "O Sinless one! Surely you have reached heaven where your father, my fatherinlaw Dasaratha and your grandfathers have reached."

shloka_text: दिविनक्षत्रभूतस्त्वंमहात्कर्मकृतप्रियम् । पुण्यंराजर्षिवंशंत्वमात्मनस्समुपेक्षसे ।।6.32.19।।
transliteration: divinakṣatrabhūtastvaṃmahātkarmakṛtapriyam | puṇyaṃrājarṣivaṃśaṃtvamātmanassamupekṣase
translation: दिवि heaven, नक्षत्रभूतम् luminaries of the sky, प्रियम् dear, महत् great, कर्म deed, कृता done, त्वम् you, आत्मनः your own, पुण्यम् merit, राजर्षिवंशम् race of royal sages, समुपेक्षसे will be seeing.
explanation: "In heaven, you will be seeing luminaries of the sky who are dear, who have done great deeds and earned merit and the royal sages of your own race."

shloka_text: किंमांनप्रेक्षसेराजन् किंमांनप्रतिभाषसे । बालांबाल्येनसम्प्राप्तांभार्यांमांसहचारिणीम् ।।6.32.20।।
transliteration: kiṃmāṃnaprekṣaserājan kiṃmāṃnapratibhāṣase | bālāṃbālyenasamprāptāṃbhāryāṃmāṃsahacāriṇīm
translation: राजन् O king!, बाल्येन in young age, बालाम् from a young age, सम्प्राप्ताम् have come to you, सहचारिणीम् companion, भार्याम् our wife also, माम् me, नप्रेक्षसे you do not see, माम् me, किंना why, मांप्रतिभाषसे you are not talking to me.
explanation: "O King! I have come to you while I was young. I am your companion and wife also. Why are you not seeing me? Why are you not talking to me?"

shloka_text: संश्रुतंगृह्णतापाणिंचरिष्यामीतियत्त्वया । स्मरतन्ममकाकुत्स्थनयमामपिदुःखिताम् ।।6.32.21।।
transliteration: saṃśrutaṃgṛhṇatāpāṇiṃcariṣyāmītiyattvayā | smaratanmamakākutsthanayamāmapiduḥkhitām
translation: काकुत्स्थ Kakutstha, पाणिम् hand, गृह्णता while held, त्वया by you, चरिष्यामिइति will be with you, यत् likewise, संश्रुतम् promised, तत् that, स्मरनाम remember, दुःखितम् sad, मामपि me too, नय such a one.
explanation: "O Kakutstha! while you held my hand (at the time of marriage) you promised that you will be with me and likewise promised to take me, a (wretched one) with you to the other world. Remembering that I am sad."

shloka_text: कस्मान्मामपहायत्वंगतोगतिमतांवर । अस्माल्लोकादमुंलोकंत्यक्त्वामामपिदुःखिताम् ।।6.32.22।।
transliteration: kasmānmāmapahāyatvaṃgatogatimatāṃvara | asmāllokādamuṃlokaṃtyaktvāmāmapiduḥkhitām
translation: गतिमताम् jewel among those who have good status, वर O jewel, त्वम् you, माम् me, अपहाय abandoning, कस्मात् why have you, गतः gone, दुखिःताम् I am pained, मामपि I am, त्यक्त्वा deserting, अस्मात् from this, लोकात् world, अमुम् heaven, लोकम् world.
explanation: "O Jewel among those who attained good state! Why have you gone abandoning me dear? To which world have you gone from here? I am pained by your deserting me."

shloka_text: कल्याणैरुचितंयत्तत्परिष्वक्तंमयैवतु । क्रव्यादैस्तच्छरीरंतेमानंविपरिकृष्यते ।।6.32.23।।
transliteration: kalyāṇairucitaṃyattatpariṣvaktaṃmayaivatu | kravyādaistaccharīraṃtemānaṃviparikṛṣyate
translation: कल्याणैः auspicious, रुचितम् decorated, यत्तत् that which, मयैव by me, alone परिष्वक्तम् embracing, तत् that, शरीरम् body, मानम् with great respect, क्रव्यादैः cruel animals, इपरिकृष्यते is dragged.
explanation: "This body which used to be decorated by me with auspicious items, with great respect is dragged by cruel animals."

shloka_text: अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैरिष्टवानाप्तदक्षिणैः । अग्निहोत्रेणसंस्कारंकेनत्वंनतुलप्स्यसे ।।6.32.24।।
transliteration: agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairiṣṭavānāptadakṣiṇaiḥ | agnihotreṇasaṃskāraṃkenatvaṃnatulapsyase
translation: आप्तदक्षिणैः all offerings into fire, अग्निष्टोमादिभिः offerings in sacrificial fire, यज्ञैः sacrifices, इष्टवान् which you deserve, त्वम् you, अग्निङोत्रेण by sacrificial performances of fire, संस्कारम् sanctification, केन why, नतुलप्स्यसे you are not getting.
explanation: "Why are you, who performed all kinds of sacrificial rituals of fire with all offerings deserve sanctification without doing fire sacrifice?"

shloka_text: प्रव्रज्यामुपपन्नानांत्रयाणामेकमागतम् । परिप्रक्ष्यतिकौसल्यालक्ष्मणंशोकलालसा ।।6.32.25।।
transliteration: pravrajyāmupapannānāṃtrayāṇāmekamāgatam | pariprakṣyatikausalyālakṣmaṇaṃśokalālasā
translation: शोकलालसा immersed in grief, कौसल्या Kausalya, प्रव्रज्याम् of the exiled ones, उपपन्नानाम् attended by, त्रयाणाम् of the three, आगतम् returning, एकम् alone, लक्ष्मणम् only Lakshmana, परिप्रेक्ष्यति will see returned.
explanation: "Seeing only Lakshmana returning, of the three exiled, Kausalya will be immersed in grief (will ask)."

shloka_text: सतस्याःपरिपृच्छन्त्यावधंमित्रबलस्यते । तवचाख्यास्यतेनूनंनिशायांराक्षसैर्वधम् ।।6.32.26।।
transliteration: satasyāḥparipṛcchantyāvadhaṃmitrabalasyate | tavacākhyāsyatenūnaṃniśāyāṃrākṣasairvadham
translation: सः she, परिपृच्छन्त्याः when enquired by her, तस्याः you, निशायम् in the night, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, तेमित्रबलस्य by the friend's army, वधम् slayed, तव your, बधंच and army, नूनम् indeed surely.
explanation: "When she questions, he may tell that you and your army were killed by the army of friends at night."

shloka_text: सात्वांसुप्तंहतंश्रुत्वामांचरक्षोगृहंगताम् । हृदयेनविदीर्णेननभविष्यतिराघव ।।6.32.27।।
transliteration: sātvāṃsuptaṃhataṃśrutvāmāṃcarakṣogṛhaṃgatām | hṛdayenavidīrṇenanabhaviṣyatirāghava
translation: राघव Raghava, सा that, त्वाम् your, सुप्तम् while asleep, हतम् killed, माम् me, रक्षोगृहम् in the home of Rakshasas, गताम् taken, श्रुत्वा on hearing अविदीर्णन broken, हृदयेन heart, नभविष्यति will not survive.
explanation: "Raghava! Hearing that you were killed while asleep and I was taken to the home of Rakshasas, Kausalya will not be able to survive with a broken heart."

shloka_text: ममहेतोरनार्यायाह्यनर्हःपार्थिवात्म: । रामस्सागरमुततीर्यसत्त्ववान् गोष्पदेहतः ।।6.32.28।।
transliteration: mamahetoranāryāyāhyanarhaḥpārthivātma: | rāmassāgaramutatīryasattvavān goṣpadehataḥ
translation: अनर्हः undeserving, पार्थिवात्मजः son of emperor, सत्त्ववान् valiant, रामः Rama, अनार्यायाः not noble, मम my, हेतोः on account of, सागरम् ocean, उततीर्य having crossed, गोष्पदे for a footprint of cow, हतः killed.
explanation: "On account of an undeserving one, Rama, the son of the emperor, a valiant one who does not deserve to be killed, after having crossed the ocean is killed by a footprint of a cow(easily)."

shloka_text: अहंदाशरथेनोढामोहात्स्वकुलपांसनी । आर्यपुत्रस्यरामस्यभार्यामृत्युरजायत ।।6.32.29।।
transliteration: ahaṃdāśarathenoḍhāmohātsvakulapāṃsanī | āryaputrasyarāmasyabhāryāmṛtyurajāyata
translation: स्वकुलपांसनी as an obloquy of his race, अहम् I am, दाशरथेन by the son of Dasaratha, मोहत् in ignorance, ऊढा married, आर्यपुत्रस्य son of noble one, रामस्य with Rama, भार्या wife, मृत्युः death, अजायत turned out to be.
explanation: "In ignorance as an obloquy of his race, the noble son of Dasaratha married me. For such Rama's wife turned out to be his death."

shloka_text: नूनमन्यांमयाजातिंवारितंदानमुत्तमम् । याहमद्येहशोचामिभार्यासर्वतिथेरपि ।।6.32.30।।
transliteration: nūnamanyāṃmayājātiṃvāritaṃdānamuttamam | yāhamadyehaśocāmibhāryāsarvatitherapi
translation: सर्वतितेः kind to all, भार्यापि even though wife, या also, अहम् I am, इह here, अध्य now, शोचामि pained, मया by me, अन्याम् other, जातिम् life, उत्तमम् supreme, दानम् charity, वारितम् obstructed, नूनम् surely.
explanation: "Undoubtedly I may have obstructed a supreme offering (such as offering a girl in marriage) in some other (previous) life. So now I am pained even though I am the wife of one who is kind to all."

shloka_text: साधुपातयमांक्षिप्रंरामस्योपरिरावण । समानयपतिंपन्त्याकुरुकल्याणमुत्तमम् ।।6.32.31।।
transliteration: sādhupātayamāṃkṣipraṃrāmasyoparirāvaṇa | samānayapatiṃpantyākurukalyāṇamuttamam
translation: रावण Ravana, क्षिप्रम् quickly, माम् me, रामस्यउपरि on Rama, साधु do, पातय husband, सतिम् wife also, पत्नया with husband, समानय joined with, उत्तमम् highly, कल्याणम् auspicious, करु you may do.
explanation: "O Ravana! You may quickly join me with my husband as it will be highly auspicious for the wife to join the husband."

shloka_text: शिरसामेशिरश्चास्यकायंकायेनयोजय । रावणानुगमिष्यामिगतिंभर्तुर्महात्मनः ।।6.32.32।।
transliteration: śirasāmeśiraścāsyakāyaṃkāyenayojaya | rāvaṇānugamiṣyāmigatiṃbharturmahātmanaḥ
translation: रावण Ravana, मेशिरसा my head, अस्य with his, शिरः head, कायेन body, कायम् with his body, येजय join, महात्मनः great soul, भर्तुः husband, गतिम् way, अनुगमिष्यामि will follow.
explanation: "O Ravana! Join my head with his and my body with his body. I will follow him in the same way."

shloka_text: इतिसदुःखसन्तप्ताविललापायतेक्षणा । भर्तुश्शिरोधनुस्तत्रसमीक्ष्यचपुनःपुनः ।।6.32.33।।
transliteration: itisaduḥkhasantaptāvilalāpāyatekṣaṇā | bhartuśśirodhanustatrasamīkṣyacapunaḥpunaḥ
translation: अयतेक्षणा broad eyed one, भर्तुः husband, शिरः head, धनुश्चैन at the bow, पुनःपुनः again and again, समीक्ष्य gazing, दुःखसन्तप्ता burning in sorrow, सइतिसा she thus, विलालस lamented.
explanation: Burning in sorrow, the broad eyed Sita gazing at the head of her husband and the bow again and again lamented.

shloka_text: एवंलालप्यमानायांसीतायांतत्रराक्षसः । अभिचक्रामभर्तारमनीकस्थःकृताञ्जलिः ।।6.32.34।।
transliteration: evaṃlālapyamānāyāṃsītāyāṃtatrarākṣasaḥ | abhicakrāmabhartāramanīkasthaḥkṛtāñjaliḥ
translation: सीतायां while Sita, एवम् in that way, लालप्यमानायाम् wailing as said before, तत्र there, अनीकस्थः guarding, राक्षसः Rakshasa, कृताञ्जालिः offered salutation, भर्तारम् to the king, अभिचक्राम approached.
explanation: While Sita was wailing in that manner, as said earlier, the Rakshasa guarding her approached the king and offered salutations with both hands.

shloka_text: विजयस्वार्यपुत्रेतिसोऽभिवाद्यप्रसाद्यच । न्यवेदयदनुप्राप्तंप्रहस्तंवाहिनीपतिम् ।।6.32.35।।
transliteration: vijayasvāryaputretiso'bhivādyaprasādyaca | nyavedayadanuprāptaṃprahastaṃvāhinīpatim
translation: सः that Rakshasa, आर्यपुत्र to the king, विजयस्व let you be victorious, इति thus, अभिवाद्य greeted, प्रसाद्यच and reverentially, वाहिनीपतिम् chief of the army, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, अनुप्राप्तम् has arrived, न्यवेदय् announced.
explanation: The Rakshasa (guard) greeted the king saying, "Let you be victorious!" and announced reverentially, "Prahastha, the army chief has arrived."

shloka_text: अमात्यैस्सहितस्सर्वैःप्रहस्तस्समुपस्थितः । तेनदर्शनकामेनवयंप्रस्थापिताःप्रभो ।।6.32.36।।
transliteration: amātyaissahitassarvaiḥprahastassamupasthitaḥ | tenadarśanakāmenavayaṃprasthāpitāḥprabho
translation: प्रभो O Lord, सर्वेः all, अमात्यैः ministers, सहितः accompanied by, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, त्वाम् to you, उपस्थितः waiting, दर्शनकामेन desiring to see you, तेन so, वयम् me, प्रस्थासितः sent.
explanation: "O Lord! Accompanied by all ministers Prahastha is waiting and sends me desiring to see you."

shloka_text: नूनमस्तिमहाराज राजभावात्क्षमान्वितं । किञ्चिदात्ययिकंकार्यंतेषांत्वंदर्शनंकुरु ।।6.32.37।।
transliteration: nūnamastimahārāja rājabhāvātkṣamānvitaṃ | kiñcidātyayikaṃkāryaṃteṣāṃtvaṃdarśanaṃkuru
translation: महाराजा great king, क्षमान्वित endowed with forgiveness, राजभावात् with royalty, किञ्चित् a little, अत्ययिकम् urgent, कार्यम् work, अस्ति is, नूनम् undoubtedly, त्वम् you, तेषाम् them, दर्शनम् see, कुरु to.
explanation: "O great king, endowed with forgiveness and royalty! there is a little urgent work. Undoubtedly, they are waiting to see you please."

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वादशग्रीवोराक्षसप्रतिवेदितम् । अशोकन्विकांत्यक्त्वामन्त्रिणांदर्शनंययौ ।।6.32.38।।
transliteration: etacchrutvādaśagrīvorākṣasaprativeditam | aśokanvikāṃtyaktvāmantriṇāṃdarśanaṃyayau
translation: दशग्रीवः tenheaded Ravana, एतत् all that (was said), राक्षसप्रतिवेदितम् submitted by Rakshasa, श्रुत्वा hearing, अशोकननकाम् from the Asoka grove, त्वक्त्वा left, मन्त्रिणाम् to the ministers, दर्सनम् to see, ययौ went.
explanation: On hearing the submission of the rakshasa, the tenheaded king left the Asoka grove to see the ministers.

shloka_text: सतुसर्वंसमर्थ्यैवमन्त्रिभिःकृत्यमात्मनः । सभांप्रविश्यविदधेविदित्वारामविक्रमम् ।।6.32.39।।
transliteration: satusarvaṃsamarthyaivamantribhiḥkṛtyamātmanaḥ | sabhāṃpraviśyavidadheviditvārāmavikramam
translation: सः that he, मन्त्रिभिः and ministers, आत्मनः himself, सर्वम् all about (Rama's prowess), कृत्यम् the task to be carried out, समर्थ्यैव thinking carefully, सभाम् to the assembly, प्रविश्य entered, रामविक्रमम् Rama's prowess, विदित्वा having known, विदधे to do so.
explanation: Having known all about Rama's prowess, Ravana and ministers entered the assembly to think carefully about the task to be carried out and how to do it.

shloka_text: अन्तर्थानंतुतच्छीर्षंतच्चकार्मुकमुत्तमम् । जगामरावणस्यैवनिर्याणसमनन्तरम् ।।6.32.40।।
transliteration: antarthānaṃtutacchīrṣaṃtaccakārmukamuttamam | jagāmarāvaṇasyaivaniryāṇasamanantaram
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, निर्याणसमनन्तरमेव as soon as he departed, तत् शीर्षम् that head, उत्तमम् excellent, तत् that, कार्मुकंच and the bow, अन्तर्थानम् vanished, जागाम went.
explanation: As soon as Ravana departed, that head and the excellent bow vanished from there.

shloka_text: राक्षसेन्द्रस्तुतैस्सार्धंमन्त्रिभिर्भीमविक्रमैः । समर्थयामासतदारामकार्यविनिश्चयम् ।।6.32.41।।
transliteration: rākṣasendrastutaissārdhaṃmantribhirbhīmavikramaiḥ | samarthayāmāsatadārāmakāryaviniścayam
translation: राक्षसेन्द्रस्तु even king of Rakshasas, भीमविक्रमैः of terrific valour, मन्त्रिभिः and ministers, तदा then, रामकार्यविनिश्चयम् to decide on the course of action to be taken against Rama, समर्थयामास thought over and decided.
explanation: The king of Rakshasas and the ministers of terrific valour then thought about the course of action to be taken against Rama and decided.

shloka_text: अविदूरस्थितान्सर्वान्बलाध्यक्षाहनितैषिणः । अब्रवीत्कालसदृशोरावणोराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.32.42।।
transliteration: avidūrasthitānsarvānbalādhyakṣāhanitaiṣiṇaḥ | abravītkālasadṛśorāvaṇorākṣasādhipaḥ
translation: कालसदृशः resembling god of death, राक्षसादिपः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, अविदूरस्थितान् stood not far from him, हितैषिणः wellwishers, सर्वान् all, बलाध्यक्षान् heads of army force अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: The Rakshasa king who resembled the god of death spoke to the heads of army force and wellwishers who stood close by.

shloka_text: शीघ्रंभेरीनिनादेनस्फुटंकोणाहतेनमे । समानयध्वंसैन्यानिवक्तव्यंचनकारणम् ।।6.32.43।।
transliteration: śīghraṃbherīninādenasphuṭaṃkoṇāhatename | samānayadhvaṃsainyānivaktavyaṃcanakāraṇam
translation: स्फुटम् break forth, कोणाहतेन with powerful drumsticks, भेरिनिनादेनमे by beating the drums, सैन्यानि the army, समानयध्वम् let them be called to assemble, कारणम् reason, नचवक्तव्यम् without telling.
explanation: "Break forth by beating the drums with powerful drumsticks calling the army to assemble without telling the reason."

shloka_text: ततस्तथेतिप्रतिगृह्यतद्वचोबलाधिपास्तेमहदात्मनोबलम् । समानयंश्चैवसमागमंचतेन्यवेदयन्भर्तरियुद्धकाङ्क्षिणि ।।6.32.44।।
transliteration: tatastathetipratigṛhyatadvacobalādhipāstemahadātmanobalam | samānayaṃścaivasamāgamaṃcatenyavedayanbhartariyuddhakāṅkṣiṇi
translation: ततः then, ते those, दूताः attendants, तद्वचः those words, तथाइति so be it, प्रतिगृह्य taking hold, बलाधिपाते the powerful army, महता great, आत्मनो to him, बलंच and the army, समानयान् collected, समागतम् arrived, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणि one who was desirous of war.
explanation: Then the attendants collected the great powerful army saying, 'so be it', to Ravana who was desirous of war. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्दकाण्डेद्वात्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: सीतांतुमोहितांदृष्टवासरमानामराक्षसी । आससादाथवैदेहींप्रियांप्रणयिनींसखी ।।6.33.1।।
transliteration: sītāṃtumohitāṃdṛṣṭavāsaramānāmarākṣasī | āsasādāthavaidehīṃpriyāṃpraṇayinīṃsakhī
translation: अथ then, प्रणयिनीम् dear, सखी friend, सरमानाम Saarana, राक्षसी rakshasa मोहिताम् distraught, सीताम् Sita, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रियाम् friend, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, आससाद approached
explanation: Then seeing Sita in distraught, a Rakshasi by name Saarana who was very dear and friendly with Vaidehi approached her.
comments: Saarana tells Sita that the evidence shown by Ravana is false and that Rama has crossed the ocean and reached Lanka.

shloka_text: मोहितांराक्षसेन्द्रेणसीतांपरमदुःखिताम् । आश्वासयामासतदासरमामृदुभाषिणी ।।6.33.2।।
transliteration: mohitāṃrākṣasendreṇasītāṃparamaduḥkhitām | āśvāsayāmāsatadāsaramāmṛdubhāṣiṇī
translation: तदा then, मृदुभाषिणी of sweet expression, सरमा Saarana, राक्षसेन्द्रेण because of the king of Rakshasa, मोहिताम् put off, परमदुःखिताम् extremely sorrowful, सीताम् Sita, आश्वासयामास comforted.
explanation: Then Saarana of sweet expression, comforted Sita who was put off and was extremely sorrowful because of the Rakshasa king.

shloka_text: साहितत्रकृतामित्रंसीतयारक्ष्यमाणया । रक्षन्तीरावणादिष्टासानुक्रोशादृढव्रता ।।6.33.3।।
transliteration: sāhitatrakṛtāmitraṃsītayārakṣyamāṇayā | rakṣantīrāvaṇādiṣṭāsānukrośādṛḍhavratā
translation: रावणादिष्टा by Ravana's order, रक्षन्ती protected, सानुक्रोशा most compassionate, दृढव्रता determined, सा that, तत्र there, रक्ष्यमाणया protecting, सीतया Sita, मित्रम् friendship, कृताहि was doing (protecting).
explanation: Most compassionate Saarana, determined to protect was friendly with Sita while she was ordered for protecting her by Ravana.

shloka_text: साददर्शसखीसीतांसरमानष्टचेतनाम् । उपावृत्त्योत्थितांध्वस्तांबडबामिवपांसुलाम् ।।6.33.4।।
transliteration: sādadarśasakhīsītāṃsaramānaṣṭacetanām | upāvṛttyotthitāṃdhvastāṃbaḍabāmivapāṃsulām
translation: सखी friend, सा that, सरमा Saarana, नष्टचेतनाम् lost consciousness, पांसुलाम् dirty ground, उपावृत्त्य enveloped, उत्थिताम् female horse, ध्वस्ताम् covered with, बडबामिव like a female horse, सीताम् Sita, ददर्श saw.
explanation: Saarana saw her friend Sita, who had lost consciousness, fully covered by dust by rolling on the dirty ground like a female horse.

shloka_text: तांसमाश्वासयामाससखीस्नेहेनसुव्रता । समाश्वसिहिवैदेही माभूत्तेमवसोव्यथा ।।6.33.5।।
transliteration: tāṃsamāśvāsayāmāsasakhīsnehenasuvratā | samāśvasihivaidehī mābhūttemavasovyathā
translation: सखी friend, वैदेही Vaidehi, सुव्रता noble vows, ताम् her, स्नेहेन in friendly way, समाश्वासयामास consoled, समाश्वसिहि encouraging to recover, ते your, मनसः heart, व्यधा pain, माभूत् not be.
explanation: Saarana consoled Vaidehi of noble vows in a friendly way and encouraged her to recover saying, "Let there be no pain at heart."

shloka_text: उक्तायद्रावणेनत्वंप्रत्युक्तश्चस्वयंत्वया । सखीस्नेहेनतभदीरुमयासर्वंप्रतिश्रुतम् ।।6.33.6।। लीनयागहनेशून्येभयमुत्सृज्यरावणात् । तवहेतोर्विशालाक्षी नहिमेजीवितंप्रियम् ।।6.33.7।।
transliteration: uktāyadrāvaṇenatvaṃpratyuktaścasvayaṃtvayā | sakhīsnehenatabhadīrumayāsarvaṃpratiśrutam  līnayāgahaneśūnyebhayamutsṛjyarāvaṇāt | tavahetorviśālākṣī nahimejīvitaṃpriyam
translation: भीरु one under constant fear (timid), त्वम् you are, रावणेन by Ravana, यत् thus, उक्ता spoken, त्वया to you, स्वयम् yourself, प्रत्युक्तश्च your reply, तत् सर्वम् all that, शून्ये secret, गहने location, लीनया hiding, मया by me, सखीस्नेहेन out of friendship, रावणात् of Ravana, भयम् fear, उत्सृज्य giving up, प्रतिश्रुतम् heard the reply, विशालाक्षि broadeyed, तवहेतोः for your sake, मे me, जीवितम् life, भयम् fear, नहि not being.
explanation: "O Broadeyed friend! You are constantly under fear (timid). Give up fear of Ravana, I have overheard all that you have spoken to Ravana and his reply by hiding in a secret place out of my affection, without caring for my life."

shloka_text: उक्तायद्रावणेनत्वंप्रत्युक्तश्चस्वयंत्वया । सखीस्नेहेनतभदीरुमयासर्वंप्रतिश्रुतम् ।।6.33.6।। लीनयागहनेशून्येभयमुत्सृज्यरावणात् । तवहेतोर्विशालाक्षी नहिमेजीवितंप्रियम् ।।6.33.7।।
transliteration: uktāyadrāvaṇenatvaṃpratyuktaścasvayaṃtvayā | sakhīsnehenatabhadīrumayāsarvaṃpratiśrutam  līnayāgahaneśūnyebhayamutsṛjyarāvaṇāt | tavahetorviśālākṣī nahimejīvitaṃpriyam
translation: भीरु one under constant fear (timid), त्वम् you are, रावणेन by Ravana, यत् thus, उक्ता spoken, त्वया to you, स्वयम् yourself, प्रत्युक्तश्च your reply, तत् सर्वम् all that, शून्ये secret, गहने location, लीनया hiding, मया by me, सखीस्नेहेन out of friendship, रावणात् of Ravana, भयम् fear, उत्सृज्य giving up, प्रतिश्रुतम् heard the reply, विशालाक्षि broadeyed, तवहेतोः for your sake, मे me, जीवितम् life, भयम् fear, नहि not being.
explanation: "O Broadeyed friend! You are constantly under fear (timid). Give up fear of Ravana, I have overheard all that you have spoken to Ravana and his reply by hiding in a secret place out of my affection, without caring for my life."

shloka_text: ससम्भ्रान्तश्चनिष्क्रान्तोयत्कृतेराक्षसाधिपः । तच्चमेविदितंसर्वमभिनिष्क्रम्यमैथिलि:।। 6.33.8।।
transliteration: sasambhrāntaścaniṣkrāntoyatkṛterākṣasādhipaḥ | taccameviditaṃsarvamabhiniṣkramyamaithili:
translation: मैथिलि Mythili, सःराक्षसाधिपः the king of Rakshasas, यत्कृते for what reason, सम्भ्रान्तः agitated, निष्क्रान्तः left, तत्र that, सर्वम् everything, अभिनिष्क्रम्य returned back, मे I, विदितम् know.
explanation: "O Mythili! I know all about why the king of Rakshasas returned back agitated."

shloka_text: नशक्यंसौप्तिकंकर्तुंरामस्यविदितात्मनः । वधश्चपुरुषव्याघ्रेतस्मिन्नैवोपपद्यते ।।6.33.9।।
transliteration: naśakyaṃsauptikaṃkartuṃrāmasyaviditātmanaḥ | vadhaścapuruṣavyāghretasminnaivopapadyate
translation: विदितात्मनः knower of himself, रामस्य Rama's, सौप्तिकम् sleeping, कर्तुम् to do, नशक्यम् not possible, पुरुषव्याघ्रे tiger among men, तस्मिन् his, वधश्च death, नैवउपपद्यते not possible.
explanation: "Rama is a knower of his Self. It is not possible to kill him while he is asleep. Nay death is not possible for he is a tiger among men."

shloka_text: नत्वेववानराहन्तुंशक्याःपादपयोधिपः । सुरादेवर्षभेणेवरामेणहिसुरक्षिताः ।।6.33.10।।
transliteration: natvevavānarāhantuṃśakyāḥpādapayodhipaḥ | surādevarṣabheṇevarāmeṇahisurakṣitāḥ
translation: सुरर्षभेण Lord of Devas, सुराःइव like Devas, रामेण by Rama, सुरक्षिताः protected, पादपयोधिपः warriors who fight wielding trees, वानराः Vanaras, एवम् like that, हन्तुम् to kill, नशक्याः not feasible.
explanation: "Vanaras are fighting with trees and are not capable of being killed. Just as the gods are protected by their Lord Indra, Vanaras are protected by Rama. It is not feasible to kill them."

shloka_text: दीर्घवृत्तभुज्शीमान्महोरस्कःप्रतापवान् । धन्वीसंहननोपेतोधर्मात्माभुविविश्रुतः ।।6.33.11।। विक्रान्तोरक्षितानित्यमात्मनश्चपरस्यच । लक्ष्मणेनसहभ्रात्राकुशलीनयशास्त्रवित् ।।6.33.12।। हन्तापरबलौघनामचिन्त्यबलपौरुषः । नहतोराघवश्रशीमान्सीते: शत्रुनिबर्हणः ।।6.33.13।।
transliteration: dīrghavṛttabhujśīmānmahoraskaḥpratāpavān | dhanvīsaṃhananopetodharmātmābhuviviśrutaḥ  vikrāntorakṣitānityamātmanaścaparasyaca | lakṣmaṇenasahabhrātrākuśalīnayaśāstravit  hantāparabalaughanāmacintyabalapauruṣaḥ | nahatorāghavaśraśīmānsīte: śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
translation: सीते O Sita!, दीर्घवृत्तभुजः who has long rounded shoulders, श्रीमान् majestic, महोरस्कः broad chest, प्रतापवान् endowed with valour, धन्वी wielder of bow, संहननोपेतः surrounded by many, धर्मात्मा righteous, भुवि world, विश्रुतः famous, विक्रान्तः powerful, नित्यम् at all times, आत्मनश्च his own, परस्यच and others, रक्षिता protector, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana also, कुशल: happy, नयशास्त्रवित् knower of sastras of propriety, परबलौघानाम् strength of enemy, हन्ता kill, अचिन्त्यबलपौरुषः of inconceivable courage, श्रीमान् royal, शत्रुनिबर्हणः destroyer of foes, राघवः Raghava, नहतः not killed.
explanation: "O Sita! One who is endowed with long rounded arms and broad chest, a valorous one, a glorious wielder of bow and powerful Rama along with his brother Lakshmana, is always a protector of himself and all surrounding him. He is a knower of sastras of propriety. Raghava is majestic with inconceivable courage and a destroyer of foes. He will not be killed."

shloka_text: दीर्घवृत्तभुज्शीमान्महोरस्कःप्रतापवान् । धन्वीसंहननोपेतोधर्मात्माभुविविश्रुतः ।।6.33.11।। विक्रान्तोरक्षितानित्यमात्मनश्चपरस्यच । लक्ष्मणेनसहभ्रात्राकुशलीनयशास्त्रवित् ।।6.33.12।। हन्तापरबलौघनामचिन्त्यबलपौरुषः । नहतोराघवश्रशीमान्सीते: शत्रुनिबर्हणः ।।6.33.13।।
transliteration: dīrghavṛttabhujśīmānmahoraskaḥpratāpavān | dhanvīsaṃhananopetodharmātmābhuviviśrutaḥ  vikrāntorakṣitānityamātmanaścaparasyaca | lakṣmaṇenasahabhrātrākuśalīnayaśāstravit  hantāparabalaughanāmacintyabalapauruṣaḥ | nahatorāghavaśraśīmānsīte: śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
translation: सीते O Sita!, दीर्घवृत्तभुजः who has long rounded shoulders, श्रीमान् majestic, महोरस्कः broad chest, प्रतापवान् endowed with valour, धन्वी wielder of bow, संहननोपेतः surrounded by many, धर्मात्मा righteous, भुवि world, विश्रुतः famous, विक्रान्तः powerful, नित्यम् at all times, आत्मनश्च his own, परस्यच and others, रक्षिता protector, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana also, कुशल: happy, नयशास्त्रवित् knower of sastras of propriety, परबलौघानाम् strength of enemy, हन्ता kill, अचिन्त्यबलपौरुषः of inconceivable courage, श्रीमान् royal, शत्रुनिबर्हणः destroyer of foes, राघवः Raghava, नहतः not killed.
explanation: "O Sita! One who is endowed with long rounded arms and broad chest, a valorous one, a glorious wielder of bow and powerful Rama along with his brother Lakshmana, is always a protector of himself and all surrounding him. He is a knower of sastras of propriety. Raghava is majestic with inconceivable courage and a destroyer of foes. He will not be killed."

explanation: "O Sita! One who is endowed with long rounded arms and broad chest, a valorous one, a glorious wielder of bow and powerful Rama along with his brother Lakshmana, is always a protector of himself and all surrounding him. He is a knower of sastras of propriety. Raghava is majestic with inconceivable courage and a destroyer of foes. He will not be killed."

shloka_text: अयुक्तबुद्धिकृत्येनसर्वभूतविरोधिना । इहप्रमुक्तारौद्रेणमायामायाविदात्वयि ।।6.33.14।।
transliteration: ayuktabuddhikṛtyenasarvabhūtavirodhinā | ihapramuktāraudreṇamāyāmāyāvidātvayi
translation: अयुक्तबुद्धिकृत्येन by perverse thought, सर्वभूतविरोधिना inimical to all beings, रौद्रेण in anger, मायाविदा a tricker, इह here, त्वयि at you, माया trickcheating, प्रयुक्ता attempted.
explanation: "On account of his perverse thought and being inimical to all beings Ravana a tricker has attempted a trick at you in anger."

shloka_text: शोकस्तेविगतस्सर्वःकल्याणंत्वामुपस्थितम् । ध्रुवंत्वांभजतेलक्ष्मीःप्रियंतेप्रीतिकरंशृणुः ।।6.33.15।।
transliteration: śokastevigatassarvaḥkalyāṇaṃtvāmupasthitam | dhruvaṃtvāṃbhajatelakṣmīḥpriyaṃteprītikaraṃśṛṇuḥ
translation: ते your, शोकः grief, विगतः gone, सर्वकल्याणम् all auspicious, त्वाम् to you, उपस्थितम् awaits, लक्ष्मीः Lakshmi, ध्रुवम् surely, त्वाम् you, भजते attain, ते to you, प्रियम् pleasant, प्रीतिकरं happy, शृणु hear.
explanation: "Your sorrow has gone. All auspiciousness awaits you. Surely you will attain good fortune (Lakshmi). You listen to my happy and pleasant news."

shloka_text: उत्तीर्यसागरंरामस्सहवानरसेनया । सन्निविष्टःसमुद्रस्यतीरमासाद्यदक्षिणम् ।।6.33.16।।
transliteration: uttīryasāgaraṃrāmassahavānarasenayā | sanniviṣṭaḥsamudrasyatīramāsādyadakṣiṇam
translation: रामः Rama, वानरसेनयासह accompanied by Vanara army, सागरम् ocean, उत्तीर्य cross, समुद्रस्य of the ocean, दक्षिणंतीरम् southern shore, आसाद्य reached, सन्निविष्टः staying.
explanation: "Rama accompanied by Vanara army has crossed the ocean and reached the southern shore of the ocean."

shloka_text: दृष्टोमेपरिपूर्णार्थःकाकुत्स्थस्सहलक्ष्मणः । सहितैस्सागरान्तस्थैर्बलैस्तिष्ठतिरक्षितः ।।6.33.17।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭomeparipūrṇārthaḥkākutsthassahalakṣmaṇaḥ | sahitaissāgarāntasthairbalaistiṣṭhatirakṣitaḥ
translation: परिपूर्णार्थः fully accomplished soul, सहलक्ष्मणः accompanied by Lakshmana, काकुत्स्थ Kakuthsa, मे myself, दृष्टः seen, सागरान्तस्थैः sea shore, सहितैः together with, बलैः army, रक्षितः protected, तिष्ठति stationed.
explanation: "Rama, a fully accomplished soul accompanied by Lakshmana together with army stands protected by the army and is stationed on the seashore."

shloka_text: अनेनप्रेषितायेचराक्षसालघुविक्रमाः । राघवस्तीर्णइत्येवप्रवृत्तिस्तैरिहाहृता ।।6.33.18।।
transliteration: anenapreṣitāyecarākṣasālaghuvikramāḥ | rāghavastīrṇaityevapravṛttistairihāhṛtā
translation: अनेन by the king, ये they, लघुविक्रमाः swiftfooted, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, प्रेषिताः sent by, तैः they, राघवः Raghava, इत्येव this news, प्रवृत्तिः of crossing, इह here, आहृता brought.
explanation: "These swift footed Rakshasas sent by the king brought the news of Rama crossing the sea."

shloka_text: सतांश्रुत्वाविशालाक्षी: प्रवृत्तिंराक्षसाधिपः । एषमन्त्रयतेसर्वैस्सचिवैस्सहरावणः ।।6.33.19।।
transliteration: satāṃśrutvāviśālākṣī: pravṛttiṃrākṣasādhipaḥ | eṣamantrayatesarvaissacivaissaharāvaṇaḥ
translation: विशालाक्षी broad eyed, राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, सःएषः all the news, रावणः Ravana, ताम् those, प्रवृत्तिम् What to do, श्रुत्वा hearing, सचिवैःसह with friends, मन्त्रयते with ministers.
explanation: "O Broadeyed Sita! On hearing the news (of Rama crossing) Rakshasa king is holding consultation with ministers about what to do."

shloka_text: इतिब्रुवाणासरमाराक्षसीसीतयासह । सर्वोद्योगेनसैन्यानांशब्दंशुश्रावभैरवम् ।।6.33.20।।
transliteration: itibruvāṇāsaramārākṣasīsītayāsaha | sarvodyogenasainyānāṃśabdaṃśuśrāvabhairavam
translation: इति thus, सीतयासह with Sita, ब्रुवाणा while speaking, राक्षसी rakshasi, सरमा Saarana, सैन्यानाम् by the army, सर्वोद्योगेन all kinds of attempts, भैरवम् frightening, शब्दम् sound, शुश्राव heard.
explanation: While Saarana was speaking to Sita, frightening sounds of the army making all kinds of attempts were heard.

shloka_text: दण्डनिर्घातवादिन्याश्रुत्वाभेर्यामहास्वनम् । उवाचसरमासीतामिदंमधुरभाषिणी ।।6.33.21।।
transliteration: daṇḍanirghātavādinyāśrutvābheryāmahāsvanam | uvācasaramāsītāmidaṃmadhurabhāṣiṇī
translation: मधुरभाषिणी of sweet talk, सरमा Saarana, दण्डनिर्घातवादिन्याः sounds of army maces and rods, भेर्याः drums, महास्वनम् loud sounds, श्रुत्वा hearing, सीताम् to Sita, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke.
explanation: On hearing the loud sounds of army maces, rods, and drums, Saarana looked at Sita and spoke these sweet words.

shloka_text: सन्नाहजननीह्येषाभैरवाभीरु: भेरिका । भेरीनादंचगम्भीरंशृणुतोयदनिःस्वनम् ।।6.33.22।।
transliteration: sannāhajananīhyeṣābhairavābhīru: bherikā | bherīnādaṃcagambhīraṃśṛṇutoyadaniḥsvanam
translation: भीरु timid, भैरवा fear, एषा these, भेरिका of drums, सन्नाहजननीहि to let the army start, तोयदनिःस्वनम् sound of rain clouds, गम्भीरम् very penetrating, भेरीनादंच sound of drums, शृणु listen.
explanation: "O Timid Sita! Listen to the deep penetrating sounds of drums like the rumbling of rain clouds signifying the preparations of the army."

shloka_text: कल्प्यन्तेमत्तमातङ्गायुज्यन्तेरथवाजिन । हृष्यन्तेतुरगारूढाःप्रासहस्तस्सहस्रशः ।।6.33.23।।
transliteration: kalpyantemattamātaṅgāyujyanterathavājina | hṛṣyanteturagārūḍhāḥprāsahastassahasraśaḥ
translation: मत्तमातङ्गाः elephants in rut, कल्प्यन्ते decorating, रथवाजिनः charioteers, युज्यन्ते getting ready for war, सहस्रशः in thousands, प्रासहस्ताः discharging darts from hand s, तुरगारूढाः getting on the horses, हृष्यन्ते happilylaughing loudly.
explanation: "Elephants in rut are being decorated, charioteers are getting ready for war in thousands and discharging darts from hands and laughing loudly."

shloka_text: तत्रतत्रचसन्नद्धास्सपततनिपदातयः । अपूर्यन्तेराजमार्गास्सैन्यैरद्भुतदर्शनैः ।।6.33.24।। वेगवभदिन्नदभदिश्चतोयौघैरिवसागरः ।
transliteration: tatratatracasannaddhāssapatatanipadātayaḥ | apūryanterājamārgāssainyairadbhutadarśanaiḥ  vegavabhadinnadabhadiścatoyaughairivasāgaraḥ |
translation: पदातयः foot soldiers, सन्नद्धाः prepared, तत्रतत्रच here and there, संपततनि collected in groups, अद्भुतदर्शनैः weird appearance, सैन्यैः troops, वेगवभदिः swiftly, नदभदिःच making sounds, तोयौघैः streams of water, सागरःइव like the ocean, राजमार्गाः royal path, अपूर्यन्ते strange.
explanation: "See the weird appearance of footsoldiers collected here and therein groups prepared to go. The royal path is filled with choking sounds of the troops moving fast, like an ocean filled with streams of water. It is strange."

shloka_text: शस्त्राणांचप्रसन्नानांचर्मणांवर्मणांतथा ।।6.33.25।। रथवाजिगजानांचभूषितानांचराक्षसाम् । संभ्रमोराक्षसामेषहृषितानांतरस्विनाम् ।।6.33.26।। प्रभांविसृजतांपश्यनानावर्णांसमुत्थिताम् । वनंनिर्धहतोघर्मेयथारूपंविभावसोः ।।6.33.27।।
transliteration: śastrāṇāṃcaprasannānāṃcarmaṇāṃvarmaṇāṃtathā  rathavājigajānāṃcabhūṣitānāṃcarākṣasām | saṃbhramorākṣasāmeṣahṛṣitānāṃtarasvinām  prabhāṃvisṛjatāṃpaśyanānāvarṇāṃsamutthitām | vanaṃnirdhahatogharmeyathārūpaṃvibhāvasoḥ
translation: घर्मे in summer, वनम् forest, निर्दहतः burning, विभावसोः the glow, रूपंयथा like that, नानावर्णाम् in different colours, समुत्थिताम् , प्रभाम् brightness, विसृजताम् arisen and spread, प्रसन्नानाम् pleasing, शस्त्राणाम् weapons, चर्मणाम् leather shields, तथा like that, वर्मणाम् colourful, राक्षसामेष Rakshasa demons राक्षसेन्रर्दामयायिनाम् Rakshasa king's heroic army, रथवाजिगजानां chariots and elephants horses, भूषितानां ornaments, तरस्विनाम् powerful, रक्षसाम् demons, एषः that manner, सःभ्रमः joyful, पश्य see.
explanation: "Look at the sheen of weapons, the leather shields, spreading forth different pleasing colours, the brightness of which resembles the burning of forest fire arisen and spread in summer. And here are chariots, horses and elephants decked with ornaments following Ravana, as well as the powerful Rakshasa army full of joy."

And here are chariots, horses and elephants decked with ornaments following Ravana, as well as the powerful Rakshasa army full of joy."
