shloka_text: ऋषीणामग्निकल्पानामग्निहोत्रासमुत्थितः ।।6.35.21।। अदत्तेरक्षसांतेजोधूमोव्याप्यदिशोदश ।
transliteration: ṛṣīṇāmagnikalpānāmagnihotrāsamutthitaḥ  adatterakṣasāṃtejodhūmovyāpyadiśodaśa |
translation: अग्निकल्पानाम् poured into fire, ऋषीणाम् by the seers, अग्निहोत्रासमुत्थितः into the sacrificial fires, धूमः smoke, दश all ten, दिशः directions, व्याप्य spread, रक्षसाम् of the Rakshasas, तेजः brilliance, आदत्ते take away.
explanation: "By the spread of smoke in different directions from the sacrificial fires from the oblations offered by the seers the brilliance of the Rakshasas is taken away."

shloka_text: तेषुतेषुचदेशेषुपुण्येष्वेवदृढव्रतैः ।।6.35.22।। चर्यमाणंतपस्तीव्रंसन्तापयतिराक्षसान् ।
transliteration: teṣuteṣucadeśeṣupuṇyeṣvevadṛḍhavrataiḥ  caryamāṇaṃtapastīvraṃsantāpayatirākṣasān |
translation: पुण्येष्वेव at holy places दृढव्रतैः determined firmly, तेषुतेषु those, देशेषु regions चर्यमाणम् performing, तीव्रम् intense, तपः austerities, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, सन्तापयति tormenting.
explanation: "The intense austerities performed by the sages in different regions determined firmly are tormenting the Rakshasas."

shloka_text: देवदानवयक्षेभ्योगृहीतश्चवरस्त्वया ।।6.35.23।। मनुषावानराऋक्षागोलाङ्गूलामहाबलाः । बलवन्तइहागम्यगर्जन्तीदृढविक्रमाः ।।6.35.24।।
transliteration: devadānavayakṣebhyogṛhītaścavarastvayā  manuṣāvānarāṛkṣāgolāṅgūlāmahābalāḥ | balavantaihāgamyagarjantīdṛḍhavikramāḥ
translation: त्वया by you, देवदानवयक्षेभ्यः Devas, Danavas and Yakshas, वरः boons, गृहीतः obtained, बलवन्तः strong, दृढविक्रमाः powerful valour, महाबलाः mighty, मनुष्याः human beings, वानराः Vanaras, ऋक्षाः Bears, गोलाङ्गूलाः monkeys with dark face, इह now, आगम्य come here, गर्जन्ती thundering.
explanation: "You have secured boons of immunity against death at the hand s of strong and mighty and powerful valour, like gods, Danavas, Yakshas and human beings. The Vanaras, Bears and monkeys with dark faces are coming here now thundering."

shloka_text: देवदानवयक्षेभ्योगृहीतश्चवरस्त्वया ।।6.35.23।। मनुषावानराऋक्षागोलाङ्गूलामहाबलाः । बलवन्तइहागम्यगर्जन्तीदृढविक्रमाः ।।6.35.24।।
transliteration: devadānavayakṣebhyogṛhītaścavarastvayā  manuṣāvānarāṛkṣāgolāṅgūlāmahābalāḥ | balavantaihāgamyagarjantīdṛḍhavikramāḥ
translation: त्वया by you, देवदानवयक्षेभ्यः Devas, Danavas and Yakshas, वरः boons, गृहीतः obtained, बलवन्तः strong, दृढविक्रमाः powerful valour, महाबलाः mighty, मनुष्याः human beings, वानराः Vanaras, ऋक्षाः Bears, गोलाङ्गूलाः monkeys with dark face, इह now, आगम्य come here, गर्जन्ती thundering.
explanation: "You have secured boons of immunity against death at the hand s of strong and mighty and powerful valour, like gods, Danavas, Yakshas and human beings. The Vanaras, Bears and monkeys with dark faces are coming here now thundering."

shloka_text: उत्पातान्विविधान्दृष्टवाघोरन्बहुविधांस्तथा । विनाशमनुपश्यामिसर्वेषांरक्षसामहम् ।।6.35.25।।
transliteration: utpātānvividhāndṛṣṭavāghoranbahuvidhāṃstathā | vināśamanupaśyāmisarveṣāṃrakṣasāmaham
translation: विविधान् different, उत्पातान् rising up, तथा like that, बहुविधान् in various ways, घोरान् dreadful, दृष्टवा seeing, अहम् I, सर्वेषाम् all, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, विनाशम् destruction, अनुपश्यामि foresee.
explanation: "Beholding different dreadful ones rising up in various directions, I foresee destruction of all Rakshasas."

shloka_text: खराभिस्न्तिताघोरामेघाःप्रतिभयङ्कराः । शोणितेनाभिवर्षन्तिलङ्कामुष्णेनसर्वतः ।।6.35.26।।
transliteration: kharābhisntitāghorāmeghāḥpratibhayaṅkarāḥ | śoṇitenābhivarṣantilaṅkāmuṣṇenasarvataḥ
translation: खराभिस्न्तिताः emitting hot thunder, घोराः formidable, प्रतिभयङ्कराः very frightening, मेघाः clouds, लङ्काम् Lanka, सर्वतः all over, उष्णेन by the heat, शोणितेन by blood, अभिवर्षन्ति raining.
explanation: "Formidable clouds are emitting hot and most frightening thunder drenched by rain of blood all over Lanka."

shloka_text: रुदतांवाहनानांचप्रपवन्त्यौस्रबिन्दवः । ध्वजाध्वस्ताविवर्णाश्चनप्रभान्तियथापुरम् ।।6.35.27।।
transliteration: rudatāṃvāhanānāṃcaprapavantyausrabindavaḥ | dhvajādhvastāvivarṇāścanaprabhāntiyathāpuram
translation: रुदताम् weeping, वाहनानाम् carrying, अस्रबिन्दवः tear drops, प्रपतन्ति falling, ध्वजाध्वस्ताः horses and elephants, विवर्णाः discoloured by dust, यधापुरम् as before, नप्रभान्ति not shining.
explanation: "With tear drops falling from the eyes of weeping horses and elephants (carrying army) they are discoloured by dust and are not shining like before."

shloka_text: व्याळागोमायवोगृध्रावाश्यन्तिचसुभैरवम् । प्रविश्यलङ्कामनिशंसमवायांश्चकुर्वते ।।6.35.28।।
transliteration: vyāḻāgomāyavogṛdhrāvāśyanticasubhairavam | praviśyalaṅkāmaniśaṃsamavāyāṃścakurvate
translation: व्यालाः wicked, गोमायवः jackals, सुभैरवम् most frightful, वाश्यन्ति vultures, लङ्काम् into Lanka, प्रविश्य entering, मनिशम् deep, समवायन् gather, कुर्वते crying.
explanation: "Wicked jackals and vultures are entering deep into Lanka and gathering. They are crying most frightfully."

shloka_text: काळिकाःपाण्डुरैर्दन्तै: प्रहसन्त्यग्रतःस्थिताः । स्त्रियस्स्वप्नेषुमुष्ण्नत्योगृहाणिप्रतिभाष्यच ।।6.35.29।।
transliteration: kāḻikāḥpāṇḍurairdantai: prahasantyagrataḥsthitāḥ | striyassvapneṣumuṣṇnatyogṛhāṇipratibhāṣyaca
translation: काळिकाः coal black, स्त्रियः women, स्वप्नेषु in dreams, प्रतिभाष्य speaking, गृहाणि omen, मुष्ण्नत्यः plundering, अग्रतः before, स्थिताः standing, पाण्डुरैः yellow, दन्स्सैः teeth, प्रहसन्ति laughing heartily.
explanation: "Women of dark colour like coal with yellow teeth are speaking unpleasant things standing before us in dreams laughing heartily."

shloka_text: गृहाणांबलिकर्माणिश्वानःपर्युपभुञ्जते । खरागोषुप्रजायन्तेमूषकानकुलैस्सह ।।6.35.30।।
transliteration: gṛhāṇāṃbalikarmāṇiśvānaḥparyupabhuñjate | kharāgoṣuprajāyantemūṣakānakulaissaha
translation: गृहाणाम् in the homes, बलिकर्माणि offerings of food made for gods, श्वानः dogs, पर्युभुञ्जते are coming to eat, गोषु cows, खराः donkeys, प्रजायन्ते procreating, नकुलैहिः mongoose, मूषकाः rats सह also.
explanation: "In the houses, food offerings made for gods are eaten by dogs, donkeys are procreating cows and rats of mongoose."

shloka_text: मार्जाराद्वीपिभिस्सार्थंसूकराश्शुनकैस्सह । किन्नराराक्षसैश्चापिसमीयुर्मानुषैस्सह ।।6.35.31।।
transliteration: mārjārādvīpibhissārthaṃsūkarāśśunakaissaha | kinnarārākṣasaiścāpisamīyurmānuṣaissaha
translation: मार्जराः cats, द्वीपिभिः leopards सार्थम् having company, सूकराः pigs, शुनकैःसह dogs also, किन्नराः Kinnera, राक्षसैश्चापि Rakshasas as well, मानुषैःसह including human beings, समेयुः mating.
explanation: "Cats are having the company of (mating) Leopards, pigs are mating with dogs, Kinneras with Rakshasas as well as human beings also."

shloka_text: पाण्डुरारक्तपादाश्चविहङ्गाःकालचोदिताः । राक्षसानांविनाशायकपोताविचरन्तिच ।।6.35.32।।
transliteration: pāṇḍurāraktapādāścavihaṅgāḥkālacoditāḥ | rākṣasānāṃvināśāyakapotāvicarantica
translation: पाण्डुराः white, रक्तपादाश्च redfooted, कपोताः doves, विहगाः birds, कालचोदिताः impelled by time, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, विनाशाय boding destruction, विचरन्ति move about.
explanation: "The white and redfooted doves are moving about impelled by time spirit boding destruction of Rakshasas."

shloka_text: वीचीकूचीतिवाश्य्नत्यश्शारिकावेश्मसुस्थिताः । पतन्तिग्रथिताश्चापिनिर्जिताःकलहैषिणः ।।6.35.33।।
transliteration: vīcīkūcītivāśynatyaśśārikāveśmasusthitāḥ | patantigrathitāścāpinirjitāḥkalahaiṣiṇaḥ
translation: वेश्मसु in the households, स्थिताः living, शारिकाः minas, कलहैषिणः grapple, निर्जिताः dead, वीचीकूचीति delight, वाश्यन्तः inhabiting, ग्रथिताश्चापि bellicose birds, पतन्ति falling down.
explanation: "Minas living in households grappling with bellicose birds in delight are falling down dead."

shloka_text: पक्षिणश्चमृगास्सर्वेप्रत्यादित्यंरुदन्तिच । कराळोविकटोमुण्डःपुरुषःकष्णपिङ्गळः ।।6.35.34।। कालोगृहाणिसर्वेषांकालेकालेऽन्ववेक्षते । एतान्यन्यानिदुष्टानिनिमित्तान्युत्पतन्तिच ।।6.35.35।।
transliteration: pakṣiṇaścamṛgāssarvepratyādityaṃrudantica | karāḻovikaṭomuṇḍaḥpuruṣaḥkaṣṇapiṅgaḻaḥ  kālogṛhāṇisarveṣāṃkālekāle'nvavekṣate | etānyanyāniduṣṭāninimittānyutpatantica
translation: पक्षिणः birds, सर्वे all, मृगाः animals, प्रत्यादित्यम् hostile, रुदन्ति crying, कराळः dreadful, विकटः monstrous, मुण्डः shaven head, परुषः male, कृष्णपिङ्गळः blackish, कालः time, कालेकाले at all times, सर्वेषाम् all, गृहाणि households, अन्ववेक्षते considering, एतानि all this, अन्यानि complete, दुष्टानि sinister निमित्तानि portents, उत्पतन्ति making appearance.
explanation: All birds and animals are making hostile noise. Time is always coming in a dreadful and monstrous blackish form with a shaved head, morning, and evening. Considering all these sinister portents are making an appearance at all households.

shloka_text: पक्षिणश्चमृगास्सर्वेप्रत्यादित्यंरुदन्तिच । कराळोविकटोमुण्डःपुरुषःकष्णपिङ्गळः ।।6.35.34।। कालोगृहाणिसर्वेषांकालेकालेऽन्ववेक्षते । एतान्यन्यानिदुष्टानिनिमित्तान्युत्पतन्तिच ।।6.35.35।।
transliteration: pakṣiṇaścamṛgāssarvepratyādityaṃrudantica | karāḻovikaṭomuṇḍaḥpuruṣaḥkaṣṇapiṅgaḻaḥ  kālogṛhāṇisarveṣāṃkālekāle'nvavekṣate | etānyanyāniduṣṭāninimittānyutpatantica
translation: पक्षिणः birds, सर्वे all, मृगाः animals, प्रत्यादित्यम् hostile, रुदन्ति crying, कराळः dreadful, विकटः monstrous, मुण्डः shaven head, परुषः male, कृष्णपिङ्गळः blackish, कालः time, कालेकाले at all times, सर्वेषाम् all, गृहाणि households, अन्ववेक्षते considering, एतानि all this, अन्यानि complete, दुष्टानि sinister निमित्तानि portents, उत्पतन्ति making appearance.
explanation: All birds and animals are making hostile noise. Time is always coming in a dreadful and monstrous blackish form with a shaved head, morning, and evening. Considering all these sinister portents are making an appearance at all households.

shloka_text: विष्णुंमन्यामहेरामंमानुषंरूपमास्थितम् । नहिमानुषमात्रोऽसौराघवोदृढविक्रमः ।।6.35.36।। येनबद्धःसमुद्रेचसेतुःसपरमाद्भुतः । कुरुष्वनरराजेनसधनिंरामेणरावण ।।6.35.37।। ज्ञात्वावधार्यकर्माणिक्रियतामायतिक्षमम् ।
transliteration: viṣṇuṃmanyāmaherāmaṃmānuṣaṃrūpamāsthitam | nahimānuṣamātro'saurāghavodṛḍhavikramaḥ  yenabaddhaḥsamudrecasetuḥsaparamādbhutaḥ | kuruṣvanararājenasadhaniṃrāmeṇarāvaṇa  jñātvāvadhāryakarmāṇikriyatāmāyatikṣamam |
translation: रामम् Rama, मानुषम् human being, रूपम् form, आस्तितम् assuming, विष्णुम् Vishnu, मन्यामहे Lord, दृढविक्रमः fortitude and prowess, असौ oh, राघवः Raghava, मानुषमात्रः only a human being, नहि not, येन therefore, समुद्रे on the ocean, परमाद्भुतः most amazing, सः he, सेतुः bridge, बद्धः constructing, रावण Ravana, नरराजेन ruler of men, रामेण with Rama, सन्धिम् align, कुरुष्व make, कर्माणि action, ज्ञात्वा know, अवधार्य determine correctly, आयतिक्षमम् after careful thinking, क्रियताम् be done.
explanation: Rama is Lord Vishnu in human form endowed with fortitude and prowess. One who has constructed an amazing bridge on the ocean is not just a human being. O Ravana! Align with the ruler of men, Sri Rama. After careful thinking and determining correctly, do what is good.

shloka_text: विष्णुंमन्यामहेरामंमानुषंरूपमास्थितम् । नहिमानुषमात्रोऽसौराघवोदृढविक्रमः ।।6.35.36।। येनबद्धःसमुद्रेचसेतुःसपरमाद्भुतः । कुरुष्वनरराजेनसधनिंरामेणरावण ।।6.35.37।। ज्ञात्वावधार्यकर्माणिक्रियतामायतिक्षमम् ।
transliteration: viṣṇuṃmanyāmaherāmaṃmānuṣaṃrūpamāsthitam | nahimānuṣamātro'saurāghavodṛḍhavikramaḥ  yenabaddhaḥsamudrecasetuḥsaparamādbhutaḥ | kuruṣvanararājenasadhaniṃrāmeṇarāvaṇa  jñātvāvadhāryakarmāṇikriyatāmāyatikṣamam |
translation: रामम् Rama, मानुषम् human being, रूपम् form, आस्तितम् assuming, विष्णुम् Vishnu, मन्यामहे Lord, दृढविक्रमः fortitude and prowess, असौ oh, राघवः Raghava, मानुषमात्रः only a human being, नहि not, येन therefore, समुद्रे on the ocean, परमाद्भुतः most amazing, सः he, सेतुः bridge, बद्धः constructing, रावण Ravana, नरराजेन ruler of men, रामेण with Rama, सन्धिम् align, कुरुष्व make, कर्माणि action, ज्ञात्वा know, अवधार्य determine correctly, आयतिक्षमम् after careful thinking, क्रियताम् be done.
explanation: Rama is Lord Vishnu in human form endowed with fortitude and prowess. One who has constructed an amazing bridge on the ocean is not just a human being. O Ravana! Align with the ruler of men, Sri Rama. After careful thinking and determining correctly, do what is good.

shloka_text: तत्तुमाल्यवतोवाक्यंहितमुक्तंदशाननः । नमर्षयतिदुष्टात्माकालस्यवशमागतः ।।6.36.1।।
transliteration: tattumālyavatovākyaṃhitamuktaṃdaśānanaḥ | namarṣayatiduṣṭātmākālasyavaśamāgataḥ
translation: दुष्टात्मा evil minded, दशाननः the tenheaded, कालस्य death 's, वशम् fallen under the sway, आगतः come, माल्यवतः Malyavatha, उक्तम् told, तत् that, वाक्यम् words of advice, नमर्षयति not tolerated.
explanation: The tenheaded Ravana, having fallen under the sway of death could not tolerate Malyavatha's words of advice.
comments: Ravana rejects Malyavan's advice, consults ministers and asks Prahastha and others to guard the gates and enters the gynaecium.

shloka_text: नबद् ध्वाभ्रुकुटींवक्त्रेक्रोधस्यवशमागतः । अमर्षात्परिवृत्ताक्षोमाल्यवन्तमथाब्रवीत् ।।6.36.2।।
transliteration: nabad dhvābhrukuṭīṃvaktrekrodhasyavaśamāgataḥ | amarṣātparivṛttākṣomālyavantamathābravīt
translation: सः he, क्रोधस्य by anger, वशम् submitted to, आगतः come under, वक्त्रे in the face, भ्रुकुटिम् eyebrows, बद् ध्वा knitting, अमर्षात् intolerant, परिवृत्ताक्षः rolling his eyes, अथ and then, माल्यवन्तम् to Malyavan, अब्रवीत् said.
explanation: Then Ravana who had come under the influence of anger, knitting the brows of his face rolling his eyes said to Malyavan.

shloka_text: हितबुध्यायदहितंवचःपरुषमुच्यते । परपक्षंप्रनिश्यैवनैतच्च्रोत्रगतंमम ।।6.36.3।।
transliteration: hitabudhyāyadahitaṃvacaḥparuṣamucyate | parapakṣaṃpraniśyaivanaitaccrotragataṃmama
translation: परपक्षम् enemies side, प्रविश्यैव taking, हितबुध्या salutary sense, यत् those, परुषम् harsh, अहितम् not meaning good, वचः words, उच्यते have uttered, एतत् all these, मम to me, श्रोत्रगतम् listen to what was told earlier, न not.
explanation: "Harsh and not wellmeaning words have been uttered by you taking the enemy's side. I will not listen to what you said earlier."

shloka_text: मानुषंकृपणंराममेकंशाखामृगाश्रयम् । समर्थंमन्यसेकेनत्यक्तंपित्रावनालयम् ।।6.36.4।।
transliteration: mānuṣaṃkṛpaṇaṃrāmamekaṃśākhāmṛgāśrayam | samarthaṃmanyasekenatyaktaṃpitrāvanālayam
translation: मानुषम् human, कृपणम् wretched, एकम् alone, शाखामृगाश्रयम् who has the help of herbivorous animals to help, पित्रा by father, त्यक्तम् forsaken, वनालयम् forest as asylum, रामम् Rama, समर्थम् capable, केन by what, मन्यसे reason.
explanation: "For what reason do you say that a wretched human being, alone, forsaken by a father who has taken asylum in the forest, who is taking the help of vanaras is capable?"

shloka_text: रक्षसामीश्वरंमांचदेवानांचभयङ्करम् । हीनंमांमन्यसेकेनह्यहीनंसर्वविक्रमैः ।।6.36.5।।
transliteration: rakṣasāmīśvaraṃmāṃcadevānāṃcabhayaṅkaram | hīnaṃmāṃmanyasekenahyahīnaṃsarvavikramaiḥ
translation: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, ईश्वरम् Lord, देवानांच including Devas, भयङ्करम् fearfulterror, माम् me, सर्वविक्रमैः all kinds of prowess, अहीनम् not deficient, माम् me, हीनम् deficient, केन why, मन्यसे think.
explanation: "The Lord of Rakshasas is a terror to all including the Devas and am endowed with all kinds of prowess and efficiency. Why do you think I am deficient?"

shloka_text: वीरद्वेषेणवाशङ्केपक्षपातेनवारिपोः । त्वयाहंपरुषाण्युक्तःपरप्रोत्साहनेनवा ।।6.36.6।।
transliteration: vīradveṣeṇavāśaṅkepakṣapātenavāripoḥ | tvayāhaṃparuṣāṇyuktaḥparaprotsāhanenavā
translation: वीरद्वेषेण out of hatred to hero, रिपोः enemy, पक्षपातेन out of one sided view, पर others, प्रोत्साहनेनवा by the encouragement of, अहम् I am, त्वया by your, परुषाणि harsh words, उक्तः spoken, शङ्के suspect.
explanation: "I suspect that out of hatred towards me, you are speaking such harsh words to a hero encouraged by the enemy."

shloka_text: प्रभवन्तंपदस्थंहिपरुषंकोऽभिभाषते । पण्डितश्शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञोविनाप्रोत्साहनाद्रिपोः ।।6.36.7।।
transliteration: prabhavantaṃpadasthaṃhiparuṣaṃko'bhibhāṣate | paṇḍitaśśāstratattvajñovināprotsāhanādripoḥ
translation: शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञः learned in the truth of sastras, पण्डितः learned, कः who, विनाप्रोत्साहनाद्रिपोः without instigation, प्रभवन्तम् in power, पदस्थम् address, परुषम् harsh, अभिभाषते will speak.
explanation: "Which person who has learned the truth of sastras will address such harsh words to one in power without instigation?"

shloka_text: आनीयचवनासतीतांपद्महीनामिवश्रियम् । किमर्थंप्रतिदास्यामिराघवस्यभयादहम् ।।6.36.8।।
transliteration: ānīyacavanāsatītāṃpadmahīnāmivaśriyam | kimarthaṃpratidāsyāmirāghavasyabhayādaham
translation: पद्महीनाम् without the lotus, श्रियम् इव like Lakshmi, सीताम् Sita, वनात् from forest, आनीय brought her, अहम् I, राघवस्य Rama's, भयात् fear, किमर्थम् for what, प्रतिदास्यामि will not return.
explanation: "Sita who is like Lakshmi without the lotus has been brought from the forest. Why would I return her for the fear of Rama?"

shloka_text: वृतंवानरकोटीभिस्ससुग्रीवंसलक्ष्मणम् । पश्यकैश्चिदहोभिस्त्वंराघवंनिहतंमया ।।6.36.9।।
transliteration: vṛtaṃvānarakoṭībhissasugrīvaṃsalakṣmaṇam | paśyakaiścidahobhistvaṃrāghavaṃnihataṃmayā
translation: कैश्चित् in short time, अहोभिः praised, मया by me, निहतम् killed वानरकोटिभिः crores of Vanaras, वृतम् surrounding, ससुग्रीवम् Sugriva, सलक्ष्मणम् and that Lakshmana, राघवम् Raghava, पश्य see.
explanation: "Indeed, in a short while crores of Vanaras, Sugriva and also Lakshmana and Raghava will be killed by me. Oh!"

shloka_text: द्वन्द्वेयस्यनतिष्ठन्तिदैवतान्यपिसंयुगे । सकस्माद्रावणोयुद्धेभयमाहारयिष्यति ।।6.36.10।।
transliteration: dvandveyasyanatiṣṭhantidaivatānyapisaṃyuge | sakasmādrāvaṇoyuddhebhayamāhārayiṣyati
translation: दैवतान्यपि even gods, युद्धे in war, यस्य, द्वन्द्वे duel, नतिष्ठन्ति not with stand, सः that he, रावणः Ravana, युद्धे in war, कस्मात् whom, भयम् fear, आहारयिष्यति striking.
explanation: As even gods will not with stand Ravana in war, of whom Ravana will be afraid of in a duel.

shloka_text: द्विधाभज्येयमप्येवंननमेयंतुकस्यचित् । एषमेसहजोदोषस्स्वभावोदुरतिक्रमः ।।6.36.11।।
transliteration: dvidhābhajyeyamapyevaṃnanameyaṃtukasyacit | eṣamesahajodoṣassvabhāvoduratikramaḥ
translation: द्विधा into two, भज्येयमपि resorts to breaks my head, एवम् also, कस्यचित् his mind, ननमेयम् bend myself to any one, एषः in that way, मे I, सहजः natural, दोषः weakness, स्वभावः nature, दुरतिक्रमः to overcome.
explanation: "I would break my head into two also but not bend my head to anyone. It is my weakness. It is hard to overcome nature."

shloka_text: यदितावत्समुद्रेतुसेतुर्बद्धोयदृच्छया । रामेणविस्मयःकोऽत्रयेवमेभयमागतम् ।।6.36.12।।
transliteration: yaditāvatsamudretuseturbaddhoyadṛcchayā | rāmeṇavismayaḥko'trayevamebhayamāgatam
translation: रामेण by Rama, यदृच्छया by chance, समुद्रे on the ocean, सेतुः bridge, बद्धःयदि constructed तावत् by that, अत्र there, येन because of that, मे to me, भयम् fear, आगतम् overtaken, विस्मयः wonder, कः what.
explanation: "Rama has constructed a bridge by chance and because of that you are fearing what wonder is there in it?"

shloka_text: सतुतीर्त्वार्णवंरामस्सहवानरसेनया । प्रतिजानामितेसत्यंनजीवन्प्रतियास्यति ।।6.36.13।।
transliteration: satutīrtvārṇavaṃrāmassahavānarasenayā | pratijānāmitesatyaṃnajīvanpratiyāsyati
translation: सःराघवः that Raghava, वानरसेवयासह along with Vanara army, आर्णवम् sea, तीर्त्वा crossed water, जीवन् with life, नप्रतियाप्यति not going back, ते, सत्यम् true, प्रतिजानामि will not return back.
explanation: "Rama having crossed the sea with his Vanara army will not go back with life. It is true."

shloka_text: एवंब्रुवाणंसंरब्धंरुष्टंविज्ञायरावणम् । व्रीळितोमाल्यवान्वाक्यंनोत्तरंप्रत्यपद्यत ।।6.36.14।।
transliteration: evaṃbruvāṇaṃsaṃrabdhaṃruṣṭaṃvijñāyarāvaṇam | vrīḻitomālyavānvākyaṃnottaraṃpratyapadyata
translation: एवं in that way, संरब्धम् abashed, ब्रुवाणम् speaking, रावणम् to Ravana, रुष्टम् anger, विज्ञाय knowing, माल्यवान् Malyavan, व्रीळितः feeling shy, उत्तरम् reply, वाक्यम् words, नप्रत्यपद्यत not uttered.
explanation: When Ravana was abashed and speaking in that way realizing that he is angry, Malyavan did not reply feeling shy.

shloka_text: जयाशिषाचराजानंवर्धयित्वायथोचितम् । माल्यवानभ्यनुज्ञातोजगामस्वंनिवेशनम् ।।6.36.15।।
transliteration: jayāśiṣācarājānaṃvardhayitvāyathocitam | mālyavānabhyanujñātojagāmasvaṃniveśanam
translation: माल्यवान् Malyavan, राजानम् to the king, जयाशिषाच blessing to succeed यथोचितम् in accordance with tradition, स्वम् his, निवेशनम् house, जगाम went.
explanation: Malyavan offered blessings to the king for success in accordance with tradition left to his house.

shloka_text: रावणस्तुसहामात्योमन्त्रयित्वाविमृश्यच । लङ्कायामतुलांगुप्तिंकारयामासराक्षसः ।।6.36.16।।
transliteration: rāvaṇastusahāmātyomantrayitvāvimṛśyaca | laṅkāyāmatulāṃguptiṃkārayāmāsarākṣasaḥ
translation: राक्षसः Rakshasas, रावणस्तु with Ravana, सहामात्यः with companions, मन्त्रयित्वा with ministers, विमृश्य holding discussions, तदा then, लङ्कायां for Lanka, अतुलां unequalled, गुप्तिम् protection, कारयामास made arrangements.
explanation: Ravana then held discussions with his companions and ministers and made unequalled arrangements for (safety of) Lanka.

shloka_text: व्यादिदेशसपूर्वस्यांप्रहस्तंद्वारिराक्षसम् । दक्षिणस्यांमहावीर्यौमहापार्श्वमहादरौ ।।6.36.17।। पश्चिमायामथोद्वारिपुत्रमिन्द्रजितंतदा । व्यादिदेशमयामायंबहूभीराक्षसैर्भहुभिर्वृतम् ।।6.36.18।।
transliteration: vyādideśasapūrvasyāṃprahastaṃdvārirākṣasam | dakṣiṇasyāṃmahāvīryaumahāpārśvamahādarau  paścimāyāmathodvāriputramindrajitaṃtadā | vyādideśamayāmāyaṃbahūbhīrākṣasairbhahubhirvṛtam
translation: सः he, पूर्वस्यांद्वारि at the eastern gate, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, व्यादिदेश posted, दक्षिणस्याम् at the southern gate, महावीर्यौदि of great prowess, महापर्श्वा Mahaparsva महोदरौ Mahodara, व्यादिदेश posted, अथ and, तदा like that, पश्चिमायांद्वारि at the western gate, महामायाम् Mahamaya, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतम् surrounded by, पुत्रम् son, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajith, व्यादिदेश assigned duty.
explanation: Ravana posted Prahastha surrounded by many Rakshasas at the east gate, and the Rakshasas of great prowess, Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the southern gate, and like that Mahamaya and Indrajith, his own son at the western gate.

shloka_text: व्यादिदेशसपूर्वस्यांप्रहस्तंद्वारिराक्षसम् । दक्षिणस्यांमहावीर्यौमहापार्श्वमहादरौ ।।6.36.17।। पश्चिमायामथोद्वारिपुत्रमिन्द्रजितंतदा । व्यादिदेशमयामायंबहूभीराक्षसैर्भहुभिर्वृतम् ।।6.36.18।।
transliteration: vyādideśasapūrvasyāṃprahastaṃdvārirākṣasam | dakṣiṇasyāṃmahāvīryaumahāpārśvamahādarau  paścimāyāmathodvāriputramindrajitaṃtadā | vyādideśamayāmāyaṃbahūbhīrākṣasairbhahubhirvṛtam
translation: सः he, पूर्वस्यांद्वारि at the eastern gate, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, व्यादिदेश posted, दक्षिणस्याम् at the southern gate, महावीर्यौदि of great prowess, महापर्श्वा Mahaparsva महोदरौ Mahodara, व्यादिदेश posted, अथ and, तदा like that, पश्चिमायांद्वारि at the western gate, महामायाम् Mahamaya, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतम् surrounded by, पुत्रम् son, इन्द्रजितम् Indrajith, व्यादिदेश assigned duty.
explanation: Ravana posted Prahastha surrounded by many Rakshasas at the east gate, and the Rakshasas of great prowess, Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the southern gate, and like that Mahamaya and Indrajith, his own son at the western gate.

shloka_text: उतरस्यांपुरद्वारिव्यादिश्यशुकसारणौ । स्वयंचात्रगमिष्यामिमन्त्रिणस्तानुवाचह ।।6.36.19।।
transliteration: utarasyāṃpuradvārivyādiśyaśukasāraṇau | svayaṃcātragamiṣyāmimantriṇastānuvācaha
translation: उत्तरस्याम् at the north, पुरद्वारि of the city gate, शुकसारणौ Suka and Sarana, व्यादिश्य posted, स्वयम् himself, चअत्र also there, गमिष्यामि reached, तान् his, मन्त्रिणः ministers, उवाच told.
explanation: Ravana posted Suka and Sarana at the north gate of Lanka and himself reached there and told the ministers that he would be there.

shloka_text: राक्षसांतुविरूपाक्षंमहावीर्यपराक्रमम् । मध्यमेऽस्थापयद्गुल्मेबहुभिस्सहराक्षसैः ।।6.36.20।।
transliteration: rākṣasāṃtuvirūpākṣaṃmahāvīryaparākramam | madhyame'sthāpayadgulmebahubhissaharākṣasaiḥ
translation: महावीर्यपराक्रमम् endowed with extraordinary strength, विरूपाक्षम् Virupaksha,राक्षसाम् Rakshasa, बहुभिः and many more, राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, मध्यमे middle, गुल्मे of city, आस्थापयत् placed.
explanation: In the middle of the city, he placed Virupaksha, a Rakshasa endowed with extraordinary strength and many more Rakshasas.

shloka_text: एवंविधानंलङ्कायांकृत्वाराक्षसपुङ्गवः । कृतकृत्यमिवात्मानंमन्यतेकालचोदितः ।।6.36.21।।
transliteration: evaṃvidhānaṃlaṅkāyāṃkṛtvārākṣasapuṅgavaḥ | kṛtakṛtyamivātmānaṃmanyatekālacoditaḥ
translation: राक्षसपुङ्गवः best of Rakshasas, लङ्कायाः in Lanka, एवम् in that way, विधानम् order, कृत्वा having done, कालचोदितः sway of destiny, आत्मानम् his own, कृतकृत्यमिव as if accomplished the task, मन्यते thought.
explanation: The best of Rakshasas under the sway of destiny, having been ordered in that way in Lanka, Ravana felt as though he had accomplished the task.

shloka_text: विसर्जयामासततस्समन्त्रिणोविधानमाज्ञाप्यपुरस्यपुष्कलम् । जयाशिषामन्त्रिगणेनपूजितोविवेशचाऽन्तःपुरमृद्धिमन्महत् ।।6.36.22।।
transliteration: visarjayāmāsatatassamantriṇovidhānamājñāpyapurasyapuṣkalam | jayāśiṣāmantrigaṇenapūjitoviveśacā'ntaḥpuramṛddhimanmahat
translation: सः he, पुरस्य for Lanka, पुष्कलम् adequately, विधानम् arrangements, आज्ञाप्य having ordered, ततः thereafter, मन्त्रिणः with ministers, विसर्जयामास taking leave, मन्त्रिगणेव body of ministers, जयाशिषा uttering benediction for success, पूजितः blessing सः him, बुद्धिमत् with prosperity, महत् great, अन्तःपुरम् inner chambers, विवेश entered.
explanation: There after making arrangements adequately for the protection of Lanka, taking leave of ministers who offered blessings for his prosperity and uttered words of benediction for his success Ravana entered the inner chambers of the palace. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटित्रंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: नरवानरराजौतौसतुवायुसुतःकपिः । जाम्बवानृक्षराजश्चराक्षसश्चविभीषणः ।।6.37.1।। अङ्गदोवालिपुत्रश्चसौमित्रिश्शरभःकपिः । सुषेणस्सहदायादोमैन्दोद्विविदएवच ।।6.37.2।। गजोगवाक्षःकुमुदोनलोऽथपनसस्तथा । अमित्रविषयंप्राप्तास्समवेतास्समर्धयन् ।।6.37.3।।
transliteration: naravānararājautausatuvāyusutaḥkapiḥ | jāmbavānṛkṣarājaścarākṣasaścavibhīṣaṇaḥ  aṅgadovāliputraścasaumitriśśarabhaḥkapiḥ | suṣeṇassahadāyādomaindodvividaevaca  gajogavākṣaḥkumudonalo'thapanasastathā | amitraviṣayaṃprāptāssamavetāssamardhayan
translation: नरवानरराजानौ king of men and monkeys, वायुसुतः son of wind god, सःकपिः that Vanara, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, शरभः Sarabha कपिः monkey, सहदायादः accompanied by kin, सुषेणः Sushena, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदएवच and Dwivida also, गजः Gaja, अथ so also, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, कुमुदः Kumuda, तथा likewise, नलः Nala, अथ and पनसः Panasa, अमित्रविषयम् at the enemy city, प्राप्ताः having reached, समवेताः collected, समर्थयन् thought.
explanation: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.
comments: Vibheeshana reveals to Rama the arrangements made by Ravana to protect Lanka. Sri Rama and Sugriva discuss the plans for success.

shloka_text: नरवानरराजौतौसतुवायुसुतःकपिः । जाम्बवानृक्षराजश्चराक्षसश्चविभीषणः ।।6.37.1।। अङ्गदोवालिपुत्रश्चसौमित्रिश्शरभःकपिः । सुषेणस्सहदायादोमैन्दोद्विविदएवच ।।6.37.2।। गजोगवाक्षःकुमुदोनलोऽथपनसस्तथा । अमित्रविषयंप्राप्तास्समवेतास्समर्धयन् ।।6.37.3।।
transliteration: naravānararājautausatuvāyusutaḥkapiḥ | jāmbavānṛkṣarājaścarākṣasaścavibhīṣaṇaḥ  aṅgadovāliputraścasaumitriśśarabhaḥkapiḥ | suṣeṇassahadāyādomaindodvividaevaca  gajogavākṣaḥkumudonalo'thapanasastathā | amitraviṣayaṃprāptāssamavetāssamardhayan
translation: नरवानरराजानौ king of men and monkeys, वायुसुतः son of wind god, सःकपिः that Vanara, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, शरभः Sarabha कपिः monkey, सहदायादः accompanied by kin, सुषेणः Sushena, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदएवच and Dwivida also, गजः Gaja, अथ so also, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, कुमुदः Kumuda, तथा likewise, नलः Nala, अथ and पनसः Panasa, अमित्रविषयम् at the enemy city, प्राप्ताः having reached, समवेताः collected, समर्थयन् thought.
explanation: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.
comments: Vibheeshana reveals to Rama the arrangements made by Ravana to protect Lanka. Sri Rama and Sugriva discuss the plans for success.

shloka_text: नरवानरराजौतौसतुवायुसुतःकपिः । जाम्बवानृक्षराजश्चराक्षसश्चविभीषणः ।।6.37.1।। अङ्गदोवालिपुत्रश्चसौमित्रिश्शरभःकपिः । सुषेणस्सहदायादोमैन्दोद्विविदएवच ।।6.37.2।। गजोगवाक्षःकुमुदोनलोऽथपनसस्तथा । अमित्रविषयंप्राप्तास्समवेतास्समर्धयन् ।।6.37.3।।
transliteration: naravānararājautausatuvāyusutaḥkapiḥ | jāmbavānṛkṣarājaścarākṣasaścavibhīṣaṇaḥ  aṅgadovāliputraścasaumitriśśarabhaḥkapiḥ | suṣeṇassahadāyādomaindodvividaevaca  gajogavākṣaḥkumudonalo'thapanasastathā | amitraviṣayaṃprāptāssamavetāssamardhayan
translation: नरवानरराजानौ king of men and monkeys, वायुसुतः son of wind god, सःकपिः that Vanara, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, शरभः Sarabha कपिः monkey, सहदायादः accompanied by kin, सुषेणः Sushena, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदएवच and Dwivida also, गजः Gaja, अथ so also, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, कुमुदः Kumuda, तथा likewise, नलः Nala, अथ and पनसः Panasa, अमित्रविषयम् at the enemy city, प्राप्ताः having reached, समवेताः collected, समर्थयन् thought.
explanation: Sugriva the king of men and monkeys, Hanuman the son of wind god, Jambavan the king of Bears, Vibheeshana, Vali's son Angada, Sarabha, accompanied by his kin Sushena, Mainda, Dwivida, Gaja, Gavaksha, Kumuda, the wise Nala and Panasa arrived at the enemy city and collected together thought like this.
comments: Vibheeshana reveals to Rama the arrangements made by Ravana to protect Lanka. Sri Rama and Sugriva discuss the plans for success.

shloka_text: इयंसालक्षयतेलङ्कापुरीरावणपालिता । सासुरोरगगन्धर्वैरमरैरपिदुर्जया ।।6.37.4।।
transliteration: iyaṃsālakṣayatelaṅkāpurīrāvaṇapālitā | sāsuroragagandharvairamarairapidurjayā
translation: रावणपालिता ruled by Ravana, सासुरोरगगन्धर्वैः Devas, demons and Gandharvas, अमरैरपि immortals, दुर्जया not conquerable, सा that, इयम् this, लङ्कापुरी Lanka city, लक्षयते appears.
explanation: "This Lanka city ruled by Ravana is seen. It appears that this city is unconquerable to Devas, demons and Gandharvas also by the immortals."

shloka_text: कार्यसिद्धिंपुरस्कृत्यमन्द्रयध्वंविनिर्णये । नित्यंसन्निहितोह्यत्ररावणोराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.37.5।।
transliteration: kāryasiddhiṃpuraskṛtyamandrayadhvaṃvinirṇaye | nityaṃsannihitohyatrarāvaṇorākṣasādhipaḥ
translation: कार्यसिद्धिम् to achieve success, पुरस्कृत्य preparing, विनिर्णये determining duty, मन्त्रयध्वम् , अत्र there, राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, नित्यम् ever, सन्निहितःहि present here.
explanation: "Rakshasa king Ravana is ever present here. Prepare yourself to achieve success in the mission and determine your duty."

shloka_text: तथातेषुब्रुवाणेषुरावणावरजोऽब्रवीत् । वाक्यमग्राम्यपदवत्पुष्कलार्धंविभीषणः ।।6.37.6।।
transliteration: tathāteṣubruvāṇeṣurāvaṇāvarajo'bravīt | vākyamagrāmyapadavatpuṣkalārdhaṃvibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: तथा like that, तेषु they, ब्रुवाणेषु speaking to one another, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अग्राम्यपदवत् courteous words, पुष्कलार्थम् meaningful, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: While they were speaking like that to one another, Ravana's brother Vibheeshana spoke courteously, words full of meaning.

shloka_text: अनलश्शरभश्चैवसम्पातिःप्रघसस्तथा । गत्वालङ्कांममामात्याःपुरींपुनरिहागताः ।।6.37.7।।
transliteration: analaśśarabhaścaivasampātiḥpraghasastathā | gatvālaṅkāṃmamāmātyāḥpurīṃpunarihāgatāḥ
translation: मम my, अमात्याः ministers, अनलः Anala, शरभश्चैव and Sarabha, सम्पातिः Sampathi, तथा so also, प्रघसः Praghasa, लङ्कांपुरीम् to Lanka city, गत्वा went, पुनः again, इह there, आगताः came
explanation: "My ministers Anala, Sarabha, Sampathi and also Praghasa went to Lanka and saw it and returned."

shloka_text: भूत्वाशकुनयस्सर्वेप्रविष्टाश्चरिपोर्भलम् । विधानंविहितंयच्चतद्धृष्टवासमुपस्थिताः ।।6.37.8।।
transliteration: bhūtvāśakunayassarvepraviṣṭāścariporbhalam | vidhānaṃvihitaṃyaccataddhṛṣṭavāsamupasthitāḥ
translation: सर्वे all, शकुनयः birds, भूत्वा form, रिपोः enemy, बलम् strength, प्रविष्टाः went in deep, यत् , विधानम् arrangements, विहितम् knowing, तत् there, दृष्टवा seeing, समुपस्थिताः turned up.
explanation: All of them assumed the form of birds and went deep into Lanka, saw the enemy strength and arrangements made by the enemy and turned up.

shloka_text: संविधानंयथाहुस्तेरावणस्यदुरात्मनः । राम तद्ब्रुवतस्सर्वंयथात्त्वेनमेशृणु ।।6.37.9।।
transliteration: saṃvidhānaṃyathāhusterāvaṇasyadurātmanaḥ | rāma tadbruvatassarvaṃyathāttvenameśṛṇu
translation: राम Rama, ते to you, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, संविधानम् army is organized, यथा that way, आहुः alas, सर्वम् everything, याथात्त्वेन as it is, ब्रुवतः told, मे to me, शृणु listen.
explanation: "Rama! Alas, they told me everything of the way evil minded Ravana's army is organized as it is. Listen to me."

shloka_text: पूर्वंप्रहस्तस्सबलोद्वारमासाद्यतिष्ठति । दक्षिणंचमहावीर्यौमहापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।।6.37.10।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃprahastassabalodvāramāsādyatiṣṭhati | dakṣiṇaṃcamahāvīryaumahāpārśvamahodarau
translation: प्रबलः powerful, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, पूर्वंद्वारम् at east gate, आसाद्य with army, तिष्ठति remains, महावीर्यौ of great valour, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparsva and Mahodara, दक्षइणंच at south gate
explanation: "Powerful Prahasta stands at east gate with army, Mahaparsva and Mahodara of great valour are at the south gate."

shloka_text: इन्द्रजित्पश्चिमंद्वारंराक्षसैर्भहुभिर्वृतः । पट्टसासिधनुष्मद्भिश्शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः ।।6.37.11।। नानाप्रहरणैश्शूरैरावृतोरावणात्मजः ।
transliteration: indrajitpaścimaṃdvāraṃrākṣasairbhahubhirvṛtaḥ | paṭṭasāsidhanuṣmadbhiśśūlamudgarapāṇibhiḥ  nānāpraharaṇaiśśūrairāvṛtorāvaṇātmajaḥ |
translation: रावणात्मजः Ravana's own son, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, पट्टसासिधनुष्मद्भिः sharp iron words, bows and spears, शोलमुद्गरपाणिभिः arrows and darts, बहुभिः numerous, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, नानाप्रहरणैः many kinds of weapons, शूरैः heroes, आवृतः collected together, पश्चिमंद्वारम् west gate.
explanation: "Ravana's own son, Indrajith stands at the west gate surrounded by numerous Rakshasas collected together wielding sharp swords, bows, spears, arrows and darts and many kinds of weapons."

shloka_text: राक्षसानांसहस्रैस्तुबहुभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः ।।6.37.12।। युक्तःपरमसंविग्नोराक्षर्भहुभिर्वृतः । उत्तरंनगरद्वारंरावणस्स्वयमास्थितः ।।6.37.13।।
transliteration: rākṣasānāṃsahasraistubahubhiśśastrapāṇibhiḥ  yuktaḥparamasaṃvignorākṣarbhahubhirvṛtaḥ | uttaraṃnagaradvāraṃrāvaṇassvayamāsthitaḥ
translation: रावणः Ravana, शस्त्रपाणिभिः wielding weapons, राक्षसानाम् with Rakshasas, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded by, सहस्रैः thousands, युक्तः skilled, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परमसंविग्नः highly agitated, उत्तरम् north, नगरद्वारम् gate of the city, स्वयम् himself, आस्थितः stands.
explanation: "Ravana himself stands at the north gate of Lanka, highly agitated surrounded by many thousands of Rakshasas wielding weapons."

shloka_text: राक्षसानांसहस्रैस्तुबहुभिश्शस्त्रपाणिभिः ।।6.37.12।। युक्तःपरमसंविग्नोराक्षर्भहुभिर्वृतः । उत्तरंनगरद्वारंरावणस्स्वयमास्थितः ।।6.37.13।।
transliteration: rākṣasānāṃsahasraistubahubhiśśastrapāṇibhiḥ  yuktaḥparamasaṃvignorākṣarbhahubhirvṛtaḥ | uttaraṃnagaradvāraṃrāvaṇassvayamāsthitaḥ
translation: रावणः Ravana, शस्त्रपाणिभिः wielding weapons, राक्षसानाम् with Rakshasas, बहुभिः many, वृतः surrounded by, सहस्रैः thousands, युक्तः skilled, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परमसंविग्नः highly agitated, उत्तरम् north, नगरद्वारम् gate of the city, स्वयम् himself, आस्थितः stands.
explanation: "Ravana himself stands at the north gate of Lanka, highly agitated surrounded by many thousands of Rakshasas wielding weapons."

shloka_text: विरूपाक्षस्तुमहताशूलखडगधनुष्मता । बलेनराक्षसैस्सार्थंमध्यमंगुल्ममास्थितः ।।6.37.14।।
transliteration: virūpākṣastumahatāśūlakhaḍagadhanuṣmatā | balenarākṣasaissārthaṃmadhyamaṃgulmamāsthitaḥ
translation: विरूपाक्षस्तु Virupaksha, शूलखडगधनुष्मता with spears, swords and bows, महता mighty, बलेन army, राक्षसैः of Rakshasas, सार्थम् accompanied by, मध्यमंगुल्मम् middle of city, आस्थितः remains.
explanation: "Virupaksha stands in the middle of Lanka wielding spears, swords, bows and arrows accompanied by mighty army."

shloka_text: एतानेवंविधान्गुल्मान् लङ्कायांसमुदीक्ष्यते । मामकामन्त्रिणस्सर्वेपुनशशीघ्रमिहागताः ।।6.37.15।।
transliteration: etānevaṃvidhāngulmān laṅkāyāṃsamudīkṣyate | māmakāmantriṇassarvepunaśaśīghramihāgatāḥ
translation: मामकाः our, सर्वे all, तेमन्त्रिणः the ministers, एवंविधान् in this way, एतान् them, गुल्मान् in the city, लङ्कायाम् of Lanka, समुदीक्ष्य keenly observed, शीघ्रम् immediately, पुनः again, इह here, आगताः reached.
explanation: All our ministers immediately returned back after keenly observing the city of Lanka in this way.

shloka_text: गजानांचसाहस्रंचरथानामयुतंपुरे । हयानामयुतेद्वेचसाग्राकोटीचरक्षसाम् ।।6.37.16।। विक्रान्ताबलवन्तश्चसंयुगेष्वाततायिनः । इष्टाराक्षसराजस्यनित्यमेतेनिशाचराः ।।6.37.17।।
transliteration: gajānāṃcasāhasraṃcarathānāmayutaṃpure | hayānāmayutedvecasāgrākoṭīcarakṣasām  vikrāntābalavantaścasaṃyugeṣvātatāyinaḥ | iṣṭārākṣasarājasyanityameteniśācarāḥ
translation: गजानाम् elephant riders, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, तथा similarly, रथानाम् charioteers, अयुतम् ten thousands, हयानाम् horse riders, द्वे, आयुते twenty thousand, रक्षसाम् foot soldiers, साग्रा more than, कोटिश्च one crore, संयुगेषु in wars, विक्रान्ताः valiant warriors, बलवन्तश्च mighty strong, आततायिनः endeavouring to kill, एते all, निशाचराः night rangers, नित्यम् always, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, इष्टाः dear.
explanation: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."

shloka_text: गजानांचसाहस्रंचरथानामयुतंपुरे । हयानामयुतेद्वेचसाग्राकोटीचरक्षसाम् ।।6.37.16।। विक्रान्ताबलवन्तश्चसंयुगेष्वाततायिनः । इष्टाराक्षसराजस्यनित्यमेतेनिशाचराः ।।6.37.17।।
transliteration: gajānāṃcasāhasraṃcarathānāmayutaṃpure | hayānāmayutedvecasāgrākoṭīcarakṣasām  vikrāntābalavantaścasaṃyugeṣvātatāyinaḥ | iṣṭārākṣasarājasyanityameteniśācarāḥ
translation: गजानाम् elephant riders, दशसाहस्रम् ten thousands, तथा similarly, रथानाम् charioteers, अयुतम् ten thousands, हयानाम् horse riders, द्वे, आयुते twenty thousand, रक्षसाम् foot soldiers, साग्रा more than, कोटिश्च one crore, संयुगेषु in wars, विक्रान्ताः valiant warriors, बलवन्तश्च mighty strong, आततायिनः endeavouring to kill, एते all, निशाचराः night rangers, नित्यम् always, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, इष्टाः dear.
explanation: "Elephant army of ten thousand, similarly ten thousand charioteers, horse riders in twenty thousand, more than a crore foot soldiers, mighty strong and valiant warriors, night ranger's beloved to Ravana, the king of Rakshasas were staying close and serving."

shloka_text: एकैकस्यात्रयुद्धार्थेराक्षसस्यविशाम्पते । परीवारस्सहस्राणांसहस्रमुपतिष्ठते ।।6.37.18।।
transliteration: ekaikasyātrayuddhārtherākṣasasyaviśāmpate | parīvārassahasrāṇāṃsahasramupatiṣṭhate
translation: विशाम्पते Lord of men, अत्र there, एकस्य for one, राक्षसस्य Rakshasa, युद्धार्थे to assist in war, सहस्राणाम् thousands of, सहस्रम् thousands, परीवारः at the service, उपतिष्ठते are staying.
explanation: "O! Lord of men! For the sake of assisting one Rakshasa in war ten lakhs of Rakshasas are staying at his service."

shloka_text: एतांप्रवृत्तिंलङ्कायांमन्त्रिप्रोक्तांविभीषणः । एवमुक्त्वामहाबाहूराक्षसांस्तानदर्शयत् ।।6.37.19।।
transliteration: etāṃpravṛttiṃlaṅkāyāṃmantriproktāṃvibhīṣaṇaḥ | evamuktvāmahābāhūrākṣasāṃstānadarśayat
translation: महाबाहुः mighty armed, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, मन्त्रिप्रोक्तम् told by ministers, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, एताम् all this, प्रवृत्तिम् information, एनम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तान् he, राक्षसान् by Rakshasas, अदर्शयत् revealed.
explanation: Mighty armed Vibheeshana revealed to Rama all the information that was told to him by ministers.

shloka_text: लङ्कायांसचिवैस्सर्वंरामायप्रत्यवेदयत् । रामंकमलपत्राक्षमिदमुत्तरमब्रवीत् ।।6.37.20।। रावणावरजःश्रीमान् रामप्रियचिकीर्षया ।
transliteration: laṅkāyāṃsacivaissarvaṃrāmāyapratyavedayat | rāmaṃkamalapatrākṣamidamuttaramabravīt  rāvaṇāvarajaḥśrīmān rāmapriyacikīrṣayā |
translation: श्रीमान् prosperous, रावणावरजः Ravana's brother, लङ्कायाम् about Lanka, सर्वम् everything, सचिवैः ministers, रामाय to Rama, प्रत्यवेदयत् having submitted, कमलपत्राक्षम् lotus eyed, रामम् Rama, रामप्रियचिकीर्षया intending to please Rama, इदम् this, उत्तरम् reply, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Again, Vibheeshana, the prosperous brother of Ravana, spoke to Rama everything about Lanka made known to him by the ministers. Vibheeshana looking at the lotus petal eyed Rama, intending to please Rama, spoke.

shloka_text: कुबेरंतुयदाराम रावणःप्रत्ययुध्यत ।।6.37.21।। षष्टिश्शतसहस्राणितदानिर्यान्तिरक्षसाः । राक्रमेणवीर्येणतेजसासत्त्वगौरवात् ।।6.37.22।। सदृशाय्येऽत्रदर्पेणरावणस्यदुरात्मनः ।
transliteration: kuberaṃtuyadārāma rāvaṇaḥpratyayudhyata  ṣaṣṭiśśatasahasrāṇitadāniryāntirakṣasāḥ | rākrameṇavīryeṇatejasāsattvagauravāt  sadṛśāyye'tradarpeṇarāvaṇasyadurātmanaḥ |
translation: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.
explanation: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."

shloka_text: कुबेरंतुयदाराम रावणःप्रत्ययुध्यत ।।6.37.21।। षष्टिश्शतसहस्राणितदानिर्यान्तिरक्षसाः । राक्रमेणवीर्येणतेजसासत्त्वगौरवात् ।।6.37.22।। सदृशाय्येऽत्रदर्पेणरावणस्यदुरात्मनः ।
transliteration: kuberaṃtuyadārāma rāvaṇaḥpratyayudhyata  ṣaṣṭiśśatasahasrāṇitadāniryāntirakṣasāḥ | rākrameṇavīryeṇatejasāsattvagauravāt  sadṛśāyye'tradarpeṇarāvaṇasyadurātmanaḥ |
translation: राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, यदा like that, कुबेरम् at Kubera, प्रत्ययुध्यत offensive, तदा then, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, षष्टिः sixty, शतसहस्राणि lakh, निर्यान्ति sallied forth, पराक्रमेण in courage, वीर्येण in valour, तेजसा brilliance, सत्त्वगौरवात् with respect, दर्पेण proud, यत्र there, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana 's, सदृशाः befitting.
explanation: "Rama! Earlier when Ravana launched an offensive battle against Kubera, sixty thousand Rakshasas who were equal to him in valour, brilliance, courage, and with respect sallied forth the proud, the evil minded Ravana."

shloka_text: अत्रमन्युर्नकर्तव्योरोषयेत्वांनभीषये ।।6.37.23।। समर्थोह्यसिवीर्येणसुराणामपिनिग्रहे ।
transliteration: atramanyurnakartavyoroṣayetvāṃnabhīṣaye  samarthohyasivīryeṇasurāṇāmapinigrahe |
translation: अत्र here in this case, मन्युः indignation, नकर्तव्यः as my duty, त्वाम् to you, रोषये not to cause anger, नभीषये not to cause fear, वीर्येण in valour, सुराणाम् Devatas, निग्रहेऽपिमोल can resist, समर्थः capable, असिहि am telling.
explanation: "Here, in this case do not be angry. I am telling out of my duty and not out of indignation or to cause anger or fear in you. You are capable of resisting even Devatas."

shloka_text: तद्भवांश्चतुरङ्गेणबलेनमहातावृतः ।।6.37.24।। व्यूह्येदंवानरानीकंनिर्मथिष्यतिरावणम् ।
transliteration: tadbhavāṃścaturaṅgeṇabalenamahātāvṛtaḥ  vyūhyedaṃvānarānīkaṃnirmathiṣyatirāvaṇam |
translation: तत् and also, भवान् you, इदम् these, वानरानीकम् army of Vanaras, व्यूह्य with, चतुरङ्गेणबलेन four kinds of army force, वृतः surrounded, रावणम् Ravana, निर्मथिष्यति crush.
explanation: "You also have these Vanara armies surrounded by four kinds of army, elephants, chariots, cavalry and foot soldiers."

shloka_text: रावणावरजेवाक्यमेवंब्रुवतिराघवः ।।6.37.25।। शत्रूणांप्रतिघातार्थमिदंवचनमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: rāvaṇāvarajevākyamevaṃbruvatirāghavaḥ  śatrūṇāṃpratighātārthamidaṃvacanamabravīt |
translation: रावणावरजे Ravana's younger brother, इति this way, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवति spoke इति this, राघवः Raghava, शत्रूणाम् enemies, प्रतिघातार्थम् issued orders to attack, इदम् thus, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् had spoken
explanation: When Ravana's younger brother spoke in that way Raghava instructed the army to attack the enemy.

shloka_text: पूर्वद्वारेतुलङ्कायानीलोवानरपुङ्गवः ।।6.37.26।। प्रहस्तप्रतियोद्धास्याद्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ।
transliteration: pūrvadvāretulaṅkāyānīlovānarapuṅgavaḥ  prahastapratiyoddhāsyādvānarairbahubhirvṛtaḥ |
translation: लङ्कायाः at Lanka's, पूर्वद्वारे east gate, वानरपुङ्गवः Vanara leader, नीलः Neela, बहुभिः many more, वानरैः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded, प्रहस्तप्रतियोद्धा to Prahasta give fight, स्यात् with.
explanation: "Let the Vanara leader Neela along with Vanaras stay at the east gate of Lanka and give fight to Prahasta."

shloka_text: अङ्गदोवालिपुत्रस्तुबलेनमहतावृतः ।।6.37.27।। दक्षिणेबाधतांद्वारेमहापार्श्वमहोदरौ ।
transliteration: aṅgadovāliputrastubalenamahatāvṛtaḥ  dakṣiṇebādhatāṃdvāremahāpārśvamahodarau |
translation: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, महता mighty, बलेन powerful, वृतः along with, दक्षिणेद्वारे south gate, महापार्श्वमहोदरौ Mahaparsva and Mahodara, बाधताम् crush.
explanation: "Let Vali's son the mighty and powerful Angada along with army crush Mahaparsva and Mahodara at the south gate."

shloka_text: हनुमान्पश्चिमद्वारंनिपीड्यपवनात्मजः ।।6.37.28।। प्रविशत्वप्रमेयात्माबहुभिःकपिभिर्वृतः ।
transliteration: hanumānpaścimadvāraṃnipīḍyapavanātmajaḥ  praviśatvaprameyātmābahubhiḥkapibhirvṛtaḥ |
translation: पवनात्मजः wind god's son, अप्रमेयात्मा of unimaginable prowess, हनुमान् Hanuman, बहुभिः numerous, कपिभिः Vanaras, वृतः surrounded by, पश्चिमद्वारम् west gate, निपीड्य pressing, प्रविशतु enter.
explanation: "Let Hanuman, the wind god's son of unimaginable prowess, enter the west gate along with numerous Vanaras and press against the enemy."

shloka_text: दैत्यदावनसङ्घानामृषीणांचमहात्मनाम् ।।6.37.29।। विप्रकारप्रियःक्षुद्रोवरदानबलान्वितः । परिक्रमतियःसर्वान्लोकान्सन्तापयन्प्रजाः ।।6.37.30।। तस्याहंराक्षसेन्द्रस्यस्वयमेववधेधृतः । उत्तरंनगरद्वारमहंसौमित्रिणासह ।।6.37.31।। निपीड्याभिप्रवेक्ष्यामिसबलोयत्ररावणः ।
transliteration: daityadāvanasaṅghānāmṛṣīṇāṃcamahātmanām  viprakārapriyaḥkṣudrovaradānabalānvitaḥ | parikramatiyaḥsarvānlokānsantāpayanprajāḥ  tasyāhaṃrākṣasendrasyasvayamevavadhedhṛtaḥ | uttaraṃnagaradvāramahaṃsaumitriṇāsaha  nipīḍyābhipravekṣyāmisabaloyatrarāvaṇaḥ |
translation: दैत्यदानवसङ्घानाम् multitude of Daityas and Danavas, महात्मनाम् great self, ऋषीणांच even sages, विप्रकारप्रियः fond of doing harm, क्षुद्रः wicked, वरदानबलान्वितः armed by the boons received, यः he, प्रजाः people, सन्तापयन् oppressing, सर्वान् all, लोकान् people, परिक्रामिति wandering, तस्य, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa leader, वधे destroy, अहम् I, स्वयमेव myself, धृतः determined, अहम् I, सौमित्रिणासह along with Lakshmana, सबलः along with army, रावणः Ravana, यत्र, उत्तरंनगरद्वारम् north gate, निपीड्य persecuting, अभिप्रवेक्ष्यामि force my entry into.
explanation: "That Ravana who is harming Daityas and Danavas, and great souls following wicked practices and armed by the boons is oppressing all people wandering all over. I, with Lakshmana, have determined to persecute and kill him and force my entry to the north gate."

shloka_text: दैत्यदावनसङ्घानामृषीणांचमहात्मनाम् ।।6.37.29।। विप्रकारप्रियःक्षुद्रोवरदानबलान्वितः । परिक्रमतियःसर्वान्लोकान्सन्तापयन्प्रजाः ।।6.37.30।। तस्याहंराक्षसेन्द्रस्यस्वयमेववधेधृतः । उत्तरंनगरद्वारमहंसौमित्रिणासह ।।6.37.31।। निपीड्याभिप्रवेक्ष्यामिसबलोयत्ररावणः ।

shloka_text: वानरेन्द्रश्चबलवानृक्षराजश्चवीर्यवान् ।।6.37.32।। राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैवगुलोभवतुमध्यम: ।
transliteration: vānarendraścabalavānṛkṣarājaścavīryavān  rākṣasendrānujaścaivagulobhavatumadhyama: |
translation: बलवान् mighty strong, वानरेन्द्रश्च Vanara king, वीर्यवान् valorous, ऋक्षराजश्च Rksharaja, Jambavan, राक्षसेन्द्रानुजश्चैव and Ravana's brother, मध्यम: middle, गुलो of city, भवतु will remain.
explanation: "Mighty strong Sugriva, valorous Jambavan, the ruler of Vanaras and Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana will remain at the middle of Lanka and fight."

shloka_text: नचैवमानुषंरूपंकार्यंहरिभिराहवे ।।6.37.33।। एषाभवतुसंङञान् युद्धेऽस्मिन् वानरेबले ।
transliteration: nacaivamānuṣaṃrūpaṃkāryaṃharibhirāhave  eṣābhavatusaṃṅañān yuddhe'smin vānarebale |
translation: आहवे in battle, हरिभिः monkeys, मानुषं human, रूपम् form, नचैवम् not have, कार्यम् task, अस्मिन् our, युद्धे war, वानरे Vanaras, बले, एषा in that way, संज्ञा sign, भवतु let it be.
explanation: "In the battle like this at present Vanaras should not be in the semblance of humans. Let this be our sign."

shloka_text: वानराएवनश्चिह्नंस्वजनेऽस्मिन् भविष्यति ।।6.37.34।। वयंतुमानुषेणैवसप्तयोत्प्यामहेपरान् । अहमेषममभ्रात्रालक्ष्मणेनमहौजसौ ।।6.37.35।। आत्मनापञ्चमश्चायंसखाममविभीषणः ।
transliteration: vānarāevanaścihnaṃsvajane'smin bhaviṣyati  vayaṃtumānuṣeṇaivasaptayotpyāmaheparān | ahameṣamamabhrātrālakṣmaṇenamahaujasau  ātmanāpañcamaścāyaṃsakhāmamavibhīṣaṇaḥ |
translation: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.
explanation: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."

shloka_text: वानराएवनश्चिह्नंस्वजनेऽस्मिन् भविष्यति ।।6.37.34।। वयंतुमानुषेणैवसप्तयोत्प्यामहेपरान् । अहमेषममभ्रात्रालक्ष्मणेनमहौजसौ ।।6.37.35।। आत्मनापञ्चमश्चायंसखाममविभीषणः ।
transliteration: vānarāevanaścihnaṃsvajane'smin bhaviṣyati  vayaṃtumānuṣeṇaivasaptayotpyāmaheparān | ahameṣamamabhrātrālakṣmaṇenamahaujasau  ātmanāpañcamaścāyaṃsakhāmamavibhīṣaṇaḥ |
translation: अस्मिन् our, स्वजने own people, वानराःएव even Vanaras, नः not, चिह्नम् recognize, भविष्यति should be able to, महौजसौ very chivalrous, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, एषः similarly, अहम् I, आत्मना my own, पञ्चमः five of us, ममसखा our friends, अयम् our, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, वयम् also, सप्तमानुषेणैव seven human forms, परान् enemies, योत्स्यामहे wage war.
explanation: "To know our own people the Vanaras are the sign of recognition Chivalrous Lakshmana, my brother, similarly five of us and our friend Vibheeshana, these seven people alone will wage war in human form."

shloka_text: सरामःकृत्यसिध्यर्थएवमुक्त्वाविभीषणम् ।।6.37.36।। सुवेलारोहणेबुद्धिश्चकारमतिमान्मतिम् । रमणीयतरंदृष्टवासुवेलस्यगिरेस्तटम् ।।6.37.37।।
transliteration: sarāmaḥkṛtyasidhyarthaevamuktvāvibhīṣaṇam  suvelārohaṇebuddhiścakāramatimānmatim | ramaṇīyataraṃdṛṣṭavāsuvelasyagirestaṭam
translation: मतिमान् wise, मतिम् in mind, सःरामः that Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुवेलस्यगिरिः Suvela mountain, रमणीयतरम् beauty, तटम् slopes, दृष्टवा seeing, कृत्यसिध्यर्थम् for accomplishing the task, सुवेलारोहणे climb up, बुद्धिम् thought, चकार and went.
explanation: Wise Rama having spoken like that to Vibheeshana for accomplishing the task, looking at the beauty of Suvela mountain slopes, climbed up and went.

shloka_text: सरामःकृत्यसिध्यर्थएवमुक्त्वाविभीषणम् ।।6.37.36।। सुवेलारोहणेबुद्धिश्चकारमतिमान्मतिम् । रमणीयतरंदृष्टवासुवेलस्यगिरेस्तटम् ।।6.37.37।।
transliteration: sarāmaḥkṛtyasidhyarthaevamuktvāvibhīṣaṇam  suvelārohaṇebuddhiścakāramatimānmatim | ramaṇīyataraṃdṛṣṭavāsuvelasyagirestaṭam
translation: मतिमान् wise, मतिम् in mind, सःरामः that Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सुवेलस्यगिरिः Suvela mountain, रमणीयतरम् beauty, तटम् slopes, दृष्टवा seeing, कृत्यसिध्यर्थम् for accomplishing the task, सुवेलारोहणे climb up, बुद्धिम् thought, चकार and went.
explanation: Wise Rama having spoken like that to Vibheeshana for accomplishing the task, looking at the beauty of Suvela mountain slopes, climbed up and went.

shloka_text: सतुकृत्वासुवेलस्यमतिमारोहणंप्रति । लक्ष्मणानुगतोरामःसुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.38.1।। विभीषणंचधर्मज्ञमनुरक्तंनिशाचरम् । मन्त्रज्ञंचविधिज्ञंचश्लक्क्ष्णयापरयागिरा ।।6.38.2।।
transliteration: satukṛtvāsuvelasyamatimārohaṇaṃprati | lakṣmaṇānugatorāmaḥsugrīvamidamabravīt  vibhīṣaṇaṃcadharmajñamanuraktaṃniśācaram | mantrajñaṃcavidhijñaṃcaślakkṣṇayāparayāgirā
translation: लक्ष्मणानुगतः Lakshmana's wellwisher, सःरामः Rama, सुवेलस्य Suvela's, आरोहणंप्रति climbing, मतिम् in his mind, कृत्वा made up, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, अनुरक्तम् very affectionate, निशाचरम् night ranger, मन्त्रज्ञम् thinkercounsellor, विधिज्ञम् knower of right action, विभीषणंच and Vibheeshana, श्लक्क्ष्णया knower of facts (of Lanka), परया enemy, गिरा respectable, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a respectable enemy.
comments: Sri Rama climbs up to Suvela mountain along with Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana and surveys the city of Lanka from there. The Vanaras roar at the top of their voice and all of them spend the night on top of the Suvela mountain.

shloka_text: सतुकृत्वासुवेलस्यमतिमारोहणंप्रति । लक्ष्मणानुगतोरामःसुग्रीवमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.38.1।। विभीषणंचधर्मज्ञमनुरक्तंनिशाचरम् । मन्त्रज्ञंचविधिज्ञंचश्लक्क्ष्णयापरयागिरा ।।6.38.2।।
transliteration: satukṛtvāsuvelasyamatimārohaṇaṃprati | lakṣmaṇānugatorāmaḥsugrīvamidamabravīt  vibhīṣaṇaṃcadharmajñamanuraktaṃniśācaram | mantrajñaṃcavidhijñaṃcaślakkṣṇayāparayāgirā
translation: लक्ष्मणानुगतः Lakshmana's wellwisher, सःरामः Rama, सुवेलस्य Suvela's, आरोहणंप्रति climbing, मतिम् in his mind, कृत्वा made up, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, अनुरक्तम् very affectionate, निशाचरम् night ranger, मन्त्रज्ञम् thinkercounsellor, विधिज्ञम् knower of right action, विभीषणंच and Vibheeshana, श्लक्क्ष्णया knower of facts (of Lanka), परया enemy, गिरा respectable, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Rama, the well wisher of Lakshmana climbing up the Suvela mountain thought in his mind and thus spoke to Sugriva and the righteous, affectionate Vibheeshana, a counsellor, knower of right action and facts of Lanka, and a respectable enemy.
comments: Sri Rama climbs up to Suvela mountain along with Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana and surveys the city of Lanka from there. The Vanaras roar at the top of their voice and all of them spend the night on top of the Suvela mountain.

shloka_text: सुवेलंसाधुशैलेन्द्रमिमंधातुशतैश्चितम् । अध्यारोहामहेसर्वेवत्स्यामोऽत्रनिशामिमाम् ।।6.38.3।।
transliteration: suvelaṃsādhuśailendramimaṃdhātuśataiścitam | adhyārohāmahesarvevatsyāmo'traniśāmimām
translation: धातुशतैः hundreds of minerals, चितम् captivating, इमम् this, सुवेलंशैलेन्द्रम् Suvela mountain, साधु together, अध्यारोहामहे climb up, सर्वे all, इमाम् this, निशाम् night, अत्र there, वत्स्यामहे shall remain
explanation: "We shall all climb up this Suvela mountain captivating with hundreds of minerals and remain there tonight."

shloka_text: लङ्कांचालोकयिष्यामोनिलयंतस्यरक्षसः । येनमेमरणान्तायहृताभार्यादुरात्मना ।।6.38.4।। येनधर्मोनविज्ञातोनतद्वृत्तंनकुलंतथा । राक्षस्यानीचयाबुद् ध्यायेनतद्गर्हितंकृतम् ।।6.38.5।।
transliteration: laṅkāṃcālokayiṣyāmonilayaṃtasyarakṣasaḥ | yenamemaraṇāntāyahṛtābhāryādurātmanā  yenadharmonavijñātonatadvṛttaṃnakulaṃtathā | rākṣasyānīcayābud dhyāyenatadgarhitaṃkṛtam
translation: दुरात्मना evil minded, येन by whom, मरणान्ताय to end with death, मे I भार्या wife, हृता stolen, येन by whom, धर्मः righteous duty, नविज्ञातः not know, वृत्तम् turned round, न not, तथा similarly, कुलम् race, न not, येन by whom, नीचया lowly, राक्षस्याबुध्या Rakshasa mentality, गर्हितम् immoral, तत् him, कृतम् done, तस्यरक्षसः his Rakshasa, निलयम् abode, लङ्काम् Lanka, आलोकयिष्यामःच and also see.
explanation: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."

shloka_text: लङ्कांचालोकयिष्यामोनिलयंतस्यरक्षसः । येनमेमरणान्तायहृताभार्यादुरात्मना ।।6.38.4।। येनधर्मोनविज्ञातोनतद्वृत्तंनकुलंतथा । राक्षस्यानीचयाबुद् ध्यायेनतद्गर्हितंकृतम् ।।6.38.5।।

translation: दुरात्मना evil minded, येन by whom, मरणान्ताय to end with death, मे I भार्या wife, हृता stolen, येन by whom, धर्मः righteous duty, नविज्ञातः not know, वृत्तम् turned round, न not, तथा similarly, कुलम् race, न not, येन by whom, नीचया lowly, राक्षस्याबुध्या Rakshasa mentality, गर्हितम् immoral, तत् him, कृतम् done, तस्यरक्षसः his Rakshasa, निलयम् abode, लङ्काम् Lanka, आलोकयिष्यामःच and also see.
explanation: "We shall see Lanka the abode of Rakshasa by whom, who is evil minded as he is to face death, has stolen my consort not knowing, who turned away from righteous duty not knowing the race with lowly Rakshasa mentality, who is immoral."

shloka_text: तस्मिन्मेवर्ततेरोषःकीर्तितेराक्षसाधमे । यस्यापराधाननीचस्यवधंद्रक्ष्यामिरक्षसाम् ।।6.38.6।।
transliteration: tasminmevartateroṣaḥkīrtiterākṣasādhame | yasyāparādhānanīcasyavadhaṃdrakṣyāmirakṣasām
translation: नीचस्य mean, यस्य his, अपराधात् mistakes, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधम् terminate, द्रक्ष्यामि perceive, तस्मिन् his, राक्षसाधमे lowly Rakshasa, कीर्तितेसति mention of name, मे my, रोषः wrath, वर्तते aroused.
explanation: "My wrath is aroused by the mention of the name of lowly Rakshasa. Because of his mistakes all Rakshasas are to be exterminated now."

shloka_text: एकोहिकुरुतेपापंकालपाशवशंगतः । नीचेनात्मापचारेणकुलंतेनविनश्यति ।।6.38.7।।
transliteration: ekohikurutepāpaṃkālapāśavaśaṃgataḥ | nīcenātmāpacāreṇakulaṃtenavinaśyati
translation: एकः one alone, कालपाशवशम् fallen into the noose of death, गतः gone, पापम् sin, कुरुतेहि has done also, नीचेन meanly, तेन because of that, आत्मापचारेण because of his own mistake, कुलम् race, विनश्यति will perish.
explanation: "Only one has done that sin and fallen into the noose of death. Because of one Rakshasa's mistake the race will perish."

shloka_text: एवंसम्मन्त्रयन्नेवसक्रोधोरावणंप्रति । रामःसुवेलमासाद्यचित्रसानुमुपारुहत् ।।6.38.8।।
transliteration: evaṃsammantrayannevasakrodhorāvaṇaṃprati | rāmaḥsuvelamāsādyacitrasānumupāruhat
translation: रावणंप्रति about Ravana, सक्रोधः anger, रामः Rama, एवम् in that manner, सम्मन्त्रयन्नेन talking about, चित्रसानुम् captivating slopes, सुवेलम् of Suvela, आसाद्य climbed, उपारुहत् to rest there.
explanation: Talking about Ravana in that manner, Rama climbed the captivating slopes of Suvela to rest there.

shloka_text: पृष्ठतोलक्ष्मणश्चैवमन्वगच्छत्समाहितः । सशरंचापमुद्यम्यसुमहद्विक्रमेरतः ।।6.38.9।। अन्वारोहत्सुग्रीवस्सामात्यस्सविभीषणः ।
transliteration: pṛṣṭhatolakṣmaṇaścaivamanvagacchatsamāhitaḥ | saśaraṃcāpamudyamyasumahadvikramerataḥ  anvārohatsugrīvassāmātyassavibhīṣaṇaḥ |
translation: विक्रमे heroic, रतः showing, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana too, समाहितः reached, सशरम् , सुमहत् great, चापम् bow, उद्यम्य holding, एवम् likewise, पृष्ठतः alert, अन्वगच्छत् followed, सामात्यः his ministers, सविभीषणः and Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तम् and, अन्वारोहत् followed.
explanation: Heroic and alert Lakshmana also holding his great bow, followed. His ministers and Vibheeshana and Sugriva also followed him up.

shloka_text: हनुमानङ्गदोनीलोमैन्दोद्विविदएवच ।।6.38.10।। गजोगवाक्षोगवयश्शरभोगन्धमादनः । पनसःकुमुदश्चैवहरोरम्भश्चयूथपः ।।6.38.11।। जाम्बवांश्चसुषेणश्चऋषभश्चमहामतिः । दुर्मुखश्चमहातेजास्तथाशतवलिःकपिः ।।6.38.12।। एतेचान्येचबहवोवानराशशीघ्रगामिनः । तेवायुवेगप्रवणास्तंगिरिगिरिचारिणः ।।6.38.13।। अध्यारोहन्तशतशस्सुवेलंयत्रराघवः ।
transliteration: hanumānaṅgadonīlomaindodvividaevaca  gajogavākṣogavayaśśarabhogandhamādanaḥ | panasaḥkumudaścaivaharorambhaścayūthapaḥ  jāmbavāṃścasuṣeṇaścaṛṣabhaścamahāmatiḥ | durmukhaścamahātejāstathāśatavaliḥkapiḥ  etecānyecabahavovānarāśaśīghragāminaḥ | tevāyuvegapravaṇāstaṃgirigiricāriṇaḥ  adhyārohantaśataśassuvelaṃyatrarāghavaḥ |
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.

shloka_text: हनुमानङ्गदोनीलोमैन्दोद्विविदएवच ।।6.38.10।। गजोगवाक्षोगवयश्शरभोगन्धमादनः । पनसःकुमुदश्चैवहरोरम्भश्चयूथपः ।।6.38.11।। जाम्बवांश्चसुषेणश्चऋषभश्चमहामतिः । दुर्मुखश्चमहातेजास्तथाशतवलिःकपिः ।।6.38.12।। एतेचान्येचबहवोवानराशशीघ्रगामिनः । तेवायुवेगप्रवणास्तंगिरिगिरिचारिणः ।।6.38.13।। अध्यारोहन्तशतशस्सुवेलंयत्रराघवः ।
transliteration: hanumānaṅgadonīlomaindodvividaevaca  gajogavākṣogavayaśśarabhogandhamādanaḥ | panasaḥkumudaścaivaharorambhaścayūthapaḥ  jāmbavāṃścasuṣeṇaścaṛṣabhaścamahāmatiḥ | durmukhaścamahātejāstathāśatavaliḥkapiḥ  etecānyecabahavovānarāśaśīghragāminaḥ | tevāyuvegapravaṇāstaṃgirigiricāriṇaḥ  adhyārohantaśataśassuvelaṃyatrarāghavaḥ |
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.

shloka_text: हनुमानङ्गदोनीलोमैन्दोद्विविदएवच ।।6.38.10।। गजोगवाक्षोगवयश्शरभोगन्धमादनः । पनसःकुमुदश्चैवहरोरम्भश्चयूथपः ।।6.38.11।। जाम्बवांश्चसुषेणश्चऋषभश्चमहामतिः । दुर्मुखश्चमहातेजास्तथाशतवलिःकपिः ।।6.38.12।। एतेचान्येचबहवोवानराशशीघ्रगामिनः । तेवायुवेगप्रवणास्तंगिरिगिरिचारिणः ।।6.38.13।। अध्यारोहन्तशतशस्सुवेलंयत्रराघवः ।
transliteration: hanumānaṅgadonīlomaindodvividaevaca  gajogavākṣogavayaśśarabhogandhamādanaḥ | panasaḥkumudaścaivaharorambhaścayūthapaḥ  jāmbavāṃścasuṣeṇaścaṛṣabhaścamahāmatiḥ | durmukhaścamahātejāstathāśatavaliḥkapiḥ  etecānyecabahavovānarāśaśīghragāminaḥ | tevāyuvegapravaṇāstaṃgirigiricāriṇaḥ  adhyārohantaśataśassuvelaṃyatrarāghavaḥ |
translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.

translation: हनुमान् Hanuman, अङ्गदः Angada, नीलः Neela, मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविद Dwivida एव so also, गजः Gaja, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, शरभः Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandhamadana, पनसः Panasa, कुमुदश्चैव and Kumuda, हरः Hara, यूथपः heroes, रम्भश्च Rambhu, जाम्बवांश्च Jambhavan, सुषेणश्च Sushena, महामतिः intelligent, ऋषभश्च and Rshabha, महातेजाः highly energetic, दुर्मुखश्च Durmukha, कपिः monkeys, शतवलिः Satavali, एतेच and more, शीघ्रगामिनः swift footed, गिरिचारिणः mountain rangers, वायुवेगप्रवणाः who can move at wind speed, ते all of them, वानराः Vanaras, शतशः in hundreds, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, तम् that, सुवेलंगिरिम् Suvela mountain, अध्यारोहन्त ascended.
explanation: Hanuman, Angada, Neela, Mainda, Dwivida, Gandhamadana, Panasa, Kumuda, Hara. Rambhu, Jambhavan, Sushena, intelligent Rshaba, highly energetic Durmukha and Satavali and similarly swift footed Vanaras, mountain rangers and those who can move at wind speed, all of them in hundreds ascended the Suvela mountain following Rama.

shloka_text: तेत्वदीर्घेणकालेनगिरिमारुह्यसर्वतः ।।6.38.14।। ददृशुशशिखरेतस्यविषक्तामिवखेपुरीम् ।
transliteration: tetvadīrgheṇakālenagirimāruhyasarvataḥ  dadṛśuśaśikharetasyaviṣaktāmivakhepurīm |
translation: तेतु and they, अदीर्घेण short, कालेन time, सर्वतः all, गिरिम् mountain, आरुह्य ascended, तस्य its, शिखरे peak, खे sky, विषक्तामिव like a closely clinging, पुरीम् city, ददृशुः saw.
explanation: All of them in no time ascended the mountain peak and saw the city of Lanka which was as if clinging closely to the sky and hanging.

shloka_text: तांशुभांप्रवरद्वारांप्राकारपरिशोभिताम् ।।6.38.15।। लङ्कांराक्षससम्पूर्णांददृशुर्हरियूथपाः ।
transliteration: tāṃśubhāṃpravaradvārāṃprākārapariśobhitām  laṅkāṃrākṣasasampūrṇāṃdadṛśurhariyūthapāḥ |
translation: हरियूथपाः Vanara heroes, प्रवरद्वाराम् beautiful gateways, प्राकारपरिशोभिताम् captivating boundaries, राक्षससम्पूर्णाम् filled with Rakshasas, शुभाम् auspicious, तांलङ्काम् that Lanka, ददृशुः witnessed.
explanation: The vanara heroes witnessed beautiful gateways, captivating boundaries of auspicious Lanka filled all over with rakshasas.

shloka_text: प्राकारवरसंस्थैश्चतथानीलैश्चराक्षसैः ।।6.38.16।। ददृशुस्तेहरिश्रेष्ठाःप्राकारमपरंकृतम् ।
transliteration: prākāravarasaṃsthaiścatathānīlaiścarākṣasaiḥ  dadṛśustehariśreṣṭhāḥprākāramaparaṃkṛtam |
translation: प्राकारवरसंस्थैः stood like boundary, तथा like that, नीलैश्च dark, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, कृतम् formed, अपरम् another, प्राकारम् boundary, ते they, हरिश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, ददृशुः saw.
explanation: The best of vanaras saw dark coloured rakshasas who stood like another boundary in a row.

shloka_text: तेदृष्टवावानराःसर्वेराक्षसान् युद्धकाङ् क्षिणः ।।6.38.17।। मुमुचुर्विविधान्नादांतत्ररामस्यपश्यतः ।
transliteration: tedṛṣṭavāvānarāḥsarverākṣasān yuddhakāṅ kṣiṇaḥ  mumucurvividhānnādāṃtatrarāmasyapaśyataḥ |
translation: सर्वे all, तेवानराः the Vanaras, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः eager for war, राक्षसान् दृष्टवा seeing the Rakshasas, तस्य them, रामस्य Rama, पश्यतः saw, विविधान् many, नादान् clamours, मुमुचुः stood looking.
explanation: All the vanaras saw the rakshasas eager for war, and as Rama stood looking at them many kinds of clamours were heard.

shloka_text: ततोऽस्तमगमत्पूर्यःसन्ध्ययाप्रतिरञ्जितः ।।6.38.18।। पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीप्ताचक्षपासमभिवर्तते ।
transliteration: tato'stamagamatpūryaḥsandhyayāpratirañjitaḥ  pūrṇacandrapradīptācakṣapāsamabhivartate |
translation: ततः thereafter, सूर्यः sun, सन्ध्यया twilight, प्रतिरञ्जितः reddened, अस्तम् sun set आगमत् had set in, पूर्णचन्द्रप्रदीप्ता full moon shining, क्षपाच dazzling, समभिवर्तते night set in duly.
explanation: Thereafter the Sun had set in, and twilight reddened. Full moon started shining as night had set in.

shloka_text: ततस्सरामोहरिवाहिनीपतिर्विभीषणेनप्रतिनन्द्यसत्कृतः । सलक्ष्मणोयूथपयूथसम्वृतस्सुवेलपृष्ठेन्यवसद्यथासुखम् ।।6.38.19।।
transliteration: tatassarāmoharivāhinīpatirvibhīṣaṇenapratinandyasatkṛtaḥ | salakṣmaṇoyūthapayūthasamvṛtassuvelapṛṣṭhenyavasadyathāsukham
translation: ततः then, सलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सः he, रामः Rama, यूथपयूथसम्वृतः surrounded by Vanara heroes, हरिवाहिनीपतिः leader of ocean of monkey troops, विभीषणेन to Vibheeshana, प्रतिनन्द्य offered prayers, सत्कृतः having, सुवेलपृष्ठे Suvela peak, यथासुखम् happily, न्यवसत् rested.
explanation: Thereafter, Rama, the leader of Vanara troops happily rested on Suvela peak after Vibheeshana and Lakshmana duly offered their prayers. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टात्रिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the thirty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.

shloka_text: तांरात्रिमुषितास्तत्रसुवेलेहरिपुङ्गवाः । लङ्कायांददृशुर्वीरावनान्युपवनानिच ।।6.39.1।।
transliteration: tāṃrātrimuṣitāstatrasuveleharipuṅgavāḥ | laṅkāyāṃdadṛśurvīrāvanānyupavanānica
translation: वीराः heroic, हरिपुङ्गवाः leader of monkeys, तत्र there, सुवेले on the Suvela, ताम् on that, रात्रिम् night, उषिताः kept awake, लङ्कायाम् Lanka, वनानि forests, उपवनानिच and gardens, ददृशः saw.
explanation: The heroic leader of the monkeys kept awake that night on the Suvela and saw forests and gardens there in Lanka.
comments: Sri Rama keeps awake with others and observes the forests, beautiful gardens, parks, and palaces of Lanka from the top of Suvela mountain.

shloka_text: समसौम्यानिरम्याणिविशालान्यायतानिच । दृष्टिरम्याणितेदृष्टवाबभूवुर्जातविस्मयाः ।।6.39.2।।
transliteration: samasaumyāniramyāṇiviśālānyāyatānica | dṛṣṭiramyāṇitedṛṣṭavābabhūvurjātavismayāḥ
translation: ते they, समसौम्यानि even terrain with, रम्याणि beautiful, विशालानि expansive, आयतानिच long and continuous sanctuary, दृष्टिरम्याणि feast to the eyes, दृष्टवा on seeing, जातविस्मयाः lovely to look at, बभूवुः amazed.
explanation: They were amazed to see the even terrain, beautiful and expansive, long, and continuous sanctuary lovely to look at being a feast to the eyes.

shloka_text: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला । तमालवनसञ्छन्नानागमालासमावृता ।।6.39.3।। हिन्तालैरर्जुनैर्नीपैस्सप्तपर्णैश्चपुष्पितैः । तिलकैःकर्णिकारैश्चपाटलैश्चसमन्ततः ।।6.39.4।। शुशुभेपुष्पिताग्रैश्चलतापरिगतैर्द्रुमैः । लङ्काबहुविधैर्दिव्यैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती ।।6.39.5।। विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैरक्तकोमलपल्लवैः । शाद्वलैश्चतथानीपैश्चित्राभिर्वनराजिभिः ।।6.39.6।।
transliteration: campakāśokapunnāgasālatālasamākulā | tamālavanasañchannānāgamālāsamāvṛtā  hintālairarjunairnīpaissaptaparṇaiścapuṣpitaiḥ | tilakaiḥkarṇikāraiścapāṭalaiścasamantataḥ  śuśubhepuṣpitāgraiścalatāparigatairdrumaiḥ | laṅkābahuvidhairdivyairyathendrasyāmarāvatī  vicitrakusumopetairaktakomalapallavaiḥ | śādvalaiścatathānīpaiścitrābhirvanarājibhiḥ
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala trees, तमालवनसञ्छन्ना Tamala forest concealed, नागमालासमावृता surrounded with Nagamala trees, लङ्काम् in Lanka, समन्ततः all over, हिन्तालैः Hintala, अर्जुनैः Arjuna, नीपैः Neepa, सुपुष्पितैः in full bloom, सप्तपर्णैः Saptaparni, तिलकैः Tilaka, कर्णिकारैश्च karnakara, पाटलैः Patala, पुष्पिताग्रैः crests laden with flowers, लतापरिगतद्रुमैः intertwined with creepers, विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैः wonderful variety of flowers, रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः clothed with red tender leaves, दिव्यैः wonderful, बहुविधैः of diverse kind, तथा similarly, नीलैः Neela, शाद्वलैः sadala, चित्राभिः colourful, वनराजिभिः king of forest, इन्द्रस्य Indra's capital, अमरावतीइव like Amaravathi, शुशुभे shining.
explanation: Thickly covered with trees like Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala and Tamala trees concealing the woods, surrounded with Nagamala trees all over  and Hintala, Arjuna and Neepa in full bloom, Saptaparni, Tilaka, Karnakara and Patala trees with crests laden with flowers, intertwined with creepers and wonderful variety of flowers trees with tender red leaves as if clothe d in red, flowers of diverse kind and similarly colourful Neela and Sadala as king of forest, it was shining like Amaravathi, capital of Indra.

shloka_text: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला । तमालवनसञ्छन्नानागमालासमावृता ।।6.39.3।। हिन्तालैरर्जुनैर्नीपैस्सप्तपर्णैश्चपुष्पितैः । तिलकैःकर्णिकारैश्चपाटलैश्चसमन्ततः ।।6.39.4।। शुशुभेपुष्पिताग्रैश्चलतापरिगतैर्द्रुमैः । लङ्काबहुविधैर्दिव्यैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती ।।6.39.5।। विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैरक्तकोमलपल्लवैः । शाद्वलैश्चतथानीपैश्चित्राभिर्वनराजिभिः ।।6.39.6।।
transliteration: campakāśokapunnāgasālatālasamākulā | tamālavanasañchannānāgamālāsamāvṛtā  hintālairarjunairnīpaissaptaparṇaiścapuṣpitaiḥ | tilakaiḥkarṇikāraiścapāṭalaiścasamantataḥ  śuśubhepuṣpitāgraiścalatāparigatairdrumaiḥ | laṅkābahuvidhairdivyairyathendrasyāmarāvatī  vicitrakusumopetairaktakomalapallavaiḥ | śādvalaiścatathānīpaiścitrābhirvanarājibhiḥ
translation: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala trees, तमालवनसञ्छन्ना Tamala forest concealed, नागमालासमावृता surrounded with Nagamala trees, लङ्काम् in Lanka, समन्ततः all over, हिन्तालैः Hintala, अर्जुनैः Arjuna, नीपैः Neepa, सुपुष्पितैः in full bloom, सप्तपर्णैः Saptaparni, तिलकैः Tilaka, कर्णिकारैश्च karnakara, पाटलैः Patala, पुष्पिताग्रैः crests laden with flowers, लतापरिगतद्रुमैः intertwined with creepers, विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैः wonderful variety of flowers, रक्तकोमलपल्लवैः clothed with red tender leaves, दिव्यैः wonderful, बहुविधैः of diverse kind, तथा similarly, नीलैः Neela, शाद्वलैः sadala, चित्राभिः colourful, वनराजिभिः king of forest, इन्द्रस्य Indra's capital, अमरावतीइव like Amaravathi, शुशुभे shining.
explanation: Thickly covered with trees like Champaka, Asoka, Punnaga, Sala, Tala, Samala and Tamala trees concealing the woods, surrounded with Nagamala trees all over  and Hintala, Arjuna and Neepa in full bloom, Saptaparni, Tilaka, Karnakara and Patala trees with crests laden with flowers, intertwined with creepers and wonderful variety of flowers trees with tender red leaves as if clothe d in red, flowers of diverse kind and similarly colourful Neela and Sadala as king of forest, it was shining like Amaravathi, capital of Indra.

shloka_text: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागसालतालसमाकुला । तमालवनसञ्छन्नानागमालासमावृता ।।6.39.3।। हिन्तालैरर्जुनैर्नीपैस्सप्तपर्णैश्चपुष्पितैः । तिलकैःकर्णिकारैश्चपाटलैश्चसमन्ततः ।।6.39.4।। शुशुभेपुष्पिताग्रैश्चलतापरिगतैर्द्रुमैः । लङ्काबहुविधैर्दिव्यैर्यथेन्द्रस्यामरावती ।।6.39.5।। विचित्रकुसुमोपेतैरक्तकोमलपल्लवैः । शाद्वलैश्चतथानीपैश्चित्राभिर्वनराजिभिः ।।6.39.6।।

shloka_text: गन्धाढ्यान्यभिरम्याणिपुष्पाणिचफलानिच । धारयन्त्यगमास्तत्रभूषणानीवमानवाः ।।6.39.7।।
transliteration: gandhāḍhyānyabhiramyāṇipuṣpāṇicaphalānica | dhārayantyagamāstatrabhūṣaṇānīvamānavāḥ
translation: तत्र there, अगमाः having reached, गन्धाढ्यानि bore fragrance, अभिरम्याणि very beautiful, पुष्पाणिच flowers, फलानिच and fruits, मानवाः humans, भूषणानीव ornaments, धारयतनि as though wearing.
explanation: Having reached there where trees bore fragrance, very beautiful flowers and fruits seemed as though humans were wearing ornaments.

shloka_text: तच्चैत्ररथसङ्काशंमनोज्ञंनन्दनोपमम् । वनंसर्वरर्तुकंरम्यंशुशुभेषटपदायुतम् ।।6.39.8।।
transliteration: taccaitrarathasaṅkāśaṃmanojñaṃnandanopamam | vanaṃsarvarartukaṃramyaṃśuśubheṣaṭapadāyutam
translation: चैत्ररथसङ्काशम् with chaitra chariot, मनोज्ञम् delightful to the mind, नन्दनोपमम् like Nandana garden of Indra, सर्वर्तुकम् green in all seasons, षटपदायुतम् filled with bees, तत् that, वनम् garden, शुशुभे very wonderful.
explanation: Appearing like the chaitra chariot of Kubera, Nandana garden of Indra, green in all seasons filled with bees, the garden was a wonderful delight.

shloka_text: नत्यूहकोयष्टिमकैर्नृत्यमानैश्चबर्हिभि । रुतंपरभृतानांचशुश्रुवुर्वन्निर्झरे ।।6.39.9।।
transliteration: natyūhakoyaṣṭimakairnṛtyamānaiścabarhibhi | rutaṃparabhṛtānāṃcaśuśruvurvannirjhare
translation: वन्निर्झरे abounding in cascades, नात्यूहकोयष्टिभकैः gallinules, lapwings, herons, नृत्यमानैः dancing, बर्हिणैः peacocks, परभृतानाम् cuckoos, रुतम् च and singing, शुश्रुवे heard.
explanation: The Vanaras heard the singing of cuckoos, dancing of peacocks, crying of gallinules, lapwings and herons from the gardens abounding in cascades.

shloka_text: नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानिभ्रमराचरितानिच । कोकिलाकुलषण्डानिविहगाभिरुतानिच ।।6.39.10।। भृङ्गराजाभिगीतानिभ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच । कोणालकविघुष्टानिसारसाभिरुतानिच ।।6.39.11।। विविशुस्तेततस्तानिवनान्युपवनानिच । हृष्टाःप्रमुदितावीराहरयःकामरूपिणः ।।6.39.12।।
transliteration: nityamattavihaṅgānibhramarācaritānica | kokilākulaṣaṇḍānivihagābhirutānica  bhṛṅgarājābhigītānibhramaraissevitānica | koṇālakavighuṣṭānisārasābhirutānica  viviśustetatastānivanānyupavanānica | hṛṣṭāḥpramuditāvīrāharayaḥkāmarūpiṇaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, ते they, हृष्टाः joyful, प्रमुदिताः happily, वीराः heroes, कामरूपिणः who can change form at will, हरयः monkeys, नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानि inhabited by birds ever heated with emotion, भ्रमराचरितानिच wandering bees, कोकिराकुलखण्डानि clusters of trees covered with cuckoos, विहङ्गाभिरुतानिच rendered noisy by birds singing, भृङ्गराजाधिगीतानि resounded with the singing of large black bees, भ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच bees clinging, कोणालकविघुष्टानि mingled sound of various birds, सारसाभिरुतानि noise of cries of cranes, तानि all that, वनानि woods, उपवनानिच and gardens, विविशुः entered.
explanation: There after the rejoiced heroic Vanaras who can change their form at will happily entered the woods and gardens inhabited by birds in heat full of emotion, trees covered with cuckoos, and wandering bees, rendered noisy by birds, resounded with the singing of large black bees and bees going around clinging to trees, mingled with sounds of various birds and noise of cries of cranes.

shloka_text: नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानिभ्रमराचरितानिच । कोकिलाकुलषण्डानिविहगाभिरुतानिच ।।6.39.10।। भृङ्गराजाभिगीतानिभ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच । कोणालकविघुष्टानिसारसाभिरुतानिच ।।6.39.11।। विविशुस्तेततस्तानिवनान्युपवनानिच । हृष्टाःप्रमुदितावीराहरयःकामरूपिणः ।।6.39.12।।

translation: ततः thereafter, ते they, हृष्टाः joyful, प्रमुदिताः happily, वीराः heroes, कामरूपिणः who can change form at will, हरयः monkeys, नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानि inhabited by birds ever heated with emotion, भ्रमराचरितानिच wandering bees, कोकिराकुलखण्डानि clusters of trees covered with cuckoos, विहङ्गाभिरुतानिच rendered noisy by birds singing, भृङ्गराजाधिगीतानि resounded with the singing of large black bees, भ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच bees clinging, कोणालकविघुष्टानि mingled sound of various birds, सारसाभिरुतानि noise of cries of cranes, तानि all that, वनानि woods, उपवनानिच and gardens, विविशुः entered.

shloka_text: नित्यमत्तविहङ्गानिभ्रमराचरितानिच । कोकिलाकुलषण्डानिविहगाभिरुतानिच ।।6.39.10।। भृङ्गराजाभिगीतानिभ्रमरैस्सेवितानिच । कोणालकविघुष्टानिसारसाभिरुतानिच ।।6.39.11।। विविशुस्तेततस्तानिवनान्युपवनानिच । हृष्टाःप्रमुदितावीराहरयःकामरूपिणः ।।6.39.12।।
