transliteration: tāmanuvyāharacchaktimāpatantīṃ sa rāghavaḥ | svastyastulakṣmaṇaāyetimoghābhavahatodyamā
translation: सःराघवः that Raghava, आपतन्तीम् coming towards, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, लक्ष्मणाय towards Lakshman, स्वस्ति may he be auspicious, अस्तु be, मोघा well, हतोद्यमा to kill Lakshmana, भव your, इति this, अनुव्याहरत् be ineffective and wasted
explanation: Seeing the javelin coming towards Lakshmana, Raghava said 'May Lakshmana be auspicious. May he be well. May your attempt to kill Lakshmana be ineffective and wasted'.

shloka_text: रावणेनरणेशक्तिःक्रुद्धेनाशीविषोपमाः । मुक्ताशूरस्यभीतस्यलक्ष्मणस्यममज्जसा ।।6.101.34।।
transliteration: rāvaṇenaraṇeśaktiḥkruddhenāśīviṣopamāḥ | muktāśūrasyabhītasyalakṣmaṇasyamamajjasā
translation: क्रुद्धेन in anger, रावणेन by Ravana, रणे in battle, मुक्ता liberated, आशीविषोपमा like poison of venomous serpent, साशक्तिः that javelin, आशुstood, अभीतस्य fearless, लक्ष्मणस्य on Lakshmana, उरसि chest, ममज्ज pierced
explanation: Released by Ravana in anger, that javelin, which was like poison of venomous serpent, pierced into the chest of Lakshmana who stood fearless.

shloka_text: न्यपतत्सामहावेगालक्ष्मणस्यमहोरसि । जिह्वेवोरगराजस्यदीप्यमानामहाद्युतिः ।।6.101.35।।
transliteration: nyapatatsāmahāvegālakṣmaṇasyamahorasi | jihvevoragarājasyadīpyamānāmahādyutiḥ
translation: उरगराजस्य king of serpents, Vasuki, दीप्यमाना glowing, जिह्वेव like tongue, महाद्युतिःflaming, महावेगा at high speed, सा that javelin, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshman's, महोरपि broad chest, न्यपतत् descended on
explanation: Glowing like the tongue of Vasuki, the king of serpents, flaming, त्त्जवेलिन descended at high speed on the chest of Lakshmana.

shloka_text: ततोरावणवेगेनसुदूरमवगाढया । शक्त्याविभिन्नहृदयःपपातभुविलक्ष्मणः ।।6.101.36।।
transliteration: tatorāvaṇavegenasudūramavagāḍhayā | śaktyāvibhinnahṛdayaḥpapātabhuvilakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, रावणवेगेन speedily by Ravana, सुदूरम् very long, अवगाढया plunged into, विभिन्नहृदयः penetrated deep into the heart, लक्ष्मणः Lakshman, भुवि on ground, पपात fell
explanation: Thereafter, Lakshmana fell on the ground, pierced by the javelin, deep into the heart from far with great force by Ravana.

shloka_text: तदवस्थंसमीपस्थोलक्ष्मणंप्रेक्ष्यराघवः । भ्रातृस्नेहान्महातेजाविषण्णहृदयोऽभवत् ।।6.101.37।।
transliteration: tadavasthaṃsamīpastholakṣmaṇaṃprekṣyarāghavaḥ | bhrātṛsnehānmahātejāviṣaṇṇahṛdayo'bhavat
translation: महातेजाः most courageous, समीपस्थः nearby, राघवः Raghava, तदवस्थम् that situation, लक्ष्मणम् of Lakshmana, प्रेक्ष्य watching, भ्रातृस्नेहात् because of brotherly affection, विषण्णहृदयः felt despondent at heart, अभवत् became
explanation: Watching Lakshmana in that situation, most courageous Raghava, out of brotherly affection felt despondent at heart.

shloka_text: स मुहूर्तमिवध्यात्वाबाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः । बभूवसम्रब्धतरोयुगान्तइवपावकः ।।6.101.38।।
transliteration: sa muhūrtamivadhyātvābāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ | babhūvasamrabdhataroyugāntaivapāvakaḥ
translation: सः he, मुहूर्तमिव for a short while, ध्यात्वा as it is, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः eyes filled with tears, युगान्ते at the end of universe, पावकःइव like fire, सम्रब्दतरः as if confused, बभूव stood
explanation: He (Raghava) stood confused for a short while as it was, his eyes filled with tears like fire at the end of the universe.

shloka_text: न विषादस्यकालोऽयमितिसञ्चिन्त्यराघवः । चक्रेसुतुमुलंयुद्धंरावणस्यवधेधृतः ।।6.101.39।। सर्वयत्नेनमहतालक्ष्मणंपरिवीक्ष्य च ।
transliteration: na viṣādasyakālo'yamitisañcintyarāghavaḥ | cakresutumulaṃyuddhaṃrāvaṇasyavadhedhṛtaḥ  sarvayatnenamahatālakṣmaṇaṃparivīkṣya ca |
translation: अयम् this, विषादस्य disconsolate, कालः time, नःnot, इति now, सञ्चिन्त्य realizing, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, परिवीक्ष्य observing, राघवः Raghava, रावणस्य Ravana's, वधे destruction, धृतःdetermined, महता great, सर्वयत्नेन all efforts, सुतुमुलम् fierce struggle, युद्धम् battle, चक्रे started
explanation: Realizing that this is not the time to be disconsolate, observing Lakshmana's efforts, Raghava resolved to destroy Ravana and started a fierce struggle.

shloka_text: सददर्शततोरामःशक्त्याभिन्नंमहाहवे ।।6.101.40।। लक्ष्मणंरुधिरादिग्धंसपन्नगमिवाचलम् ।
transliteration: sadadarśatatorāmaḥśaktyābhinnaṃmahāhave  lakṣmaṇaṃrudhirādigdhaṃsapannagamivācalam |
translation: ततः then, सःरामः that Rama, महाहवे great war, शक्त्या javelin, भिन्नम् pierced, रुधिरादिग्धम् bathed in blood, सपन्नगम् like snake, अचलम् इव like mountain, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, ददर्श beheld
explanation: Rama beheld Lakshmana pierced with javelin in the great war bathed in blood and resembling a mountain with a snake penetrated into it.

shloka_text: तामपिप्रहितांशक्तिंरावणेनबलीयसा ।।6.101.41।। यत्नतस्तेहरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम् । अर्दिताश्चैवबाणौघैस्तेक्षिप्रहस्तेनरक्षसा ।।6.101.42 ।
transliteration: tāmapiprahitāṃśaktiṃrāvaṇenabalīyasā  yatnatastehariśreṣṭhā na śekuravamarditum | arditāścaivabāṇaughaistekṣiprahastenarakṣasā ||6.101.42 |
translation: रक्षसा Rakshasa, क्षिप्रहस्तेन released from his hand, बाणौघैः by the arrows, अर्दिताःचैव pained, ते they, हरिश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, बलीयसा with great strength, रावणेन by Ravana, प्रहिताम् discharged, ताम् them, शक्तिम् javelin, यत्नतःअपि effort also, अवमर्दितुम् to pull out, न शेकुः not feasible
explanation: It was not feasible for the best of Vanaras to pull out the javelin (from Lakshmana's body) discharged with great strength from Ravana's hand, despite great efforts.

shloka_text: तामपिप्रहितांशक्तिंरावणेनबलीयसा ।।6.101.41।। यत्नतस्तेहरिश्रेष्ठा न शेकुरवमर्दितुम् । अर्दिताश्चैवबाणौघैस्तेक्षिप्रहस्तेनरक्षसा ।।6.101.42 ।
transliteration: tāmapiprahitāṃśaktiṃrāvaṇenabalīyasā  yatnatastehariśreṣṭhā na śekuravamarditum | arditāścaivabāṇaughaistekṣiprahastenarakṣasā ||6.101.42 |
translation: रक्षसा Rakshasa, क्षिप्रहस्तेन released from his hand, बाणौघैः by the arrows, अर्दिताःचैव pained, ते they, हरिश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, बलीयसा with great strength, रावणेन by Ravana, प्रहिताम् discharged, ताम् them, शक्तिम् javelin, यत्नतःअपि effort also, अवमर्दितुम् to pull out, न शेकुः not feasible
explanation: It was not feasible for the best of Vanaras to pull out the javelin (from Lakshmana's body) discharged with great strength from Ravana's hand, despite great efforts.

shloka_text: सौमित्रिंसाविनिर्भिद्यप्रविष्टाधरणीतलम् । तांकराभ्यांपरामृश्यरामःशक्तिंभयावहाम् ।।6.101.43।। बभञ्जसमरेक्रुद्धोबलवान्विचकर्ष च ।
transliteration: saumitriṃsāvinirbhidyapraviṣṭādharaṇītalam | tāṃkarābhyāṃparāmṛśyarāmaḥśaktiṃbhayāvahām  babhañjasamarekruddhobalavānvicakarṣa ca |
translation: सा that, सौमित्रि: Saumithri, विनिर्भिद्य piercing through, धरणीतलम् the ground, प्रविष्टा entered, बलवान् mighty, रामः Rama, समरे in battle, क्रुद्धः enraged, भयापहाम् terrific, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, कराभ्याम् with both hands, परामृश्य bending it, विचकर्ष in the course of struggle, बभञ्ज च removed
explanation: It pierced through Lakshmana's body and entered into the earth. Mighty Rama held the terrific javelin with both hands bent it and removed in the course of struggle.

shloka_text: तस्यनिष्कर्षतःशक्तिंरावणेनबलीयसा ।।6.101.44।। शराःसर्वेषुगात्रेषुपातितामर्मभेदिनः ।
transliteration: tasyaniṣkarṣataḥśaktiṃrāvaṇenabalīyasā  śarāḥsarveṣugātreṣupātitāmarmabhedinaḥ |
translation: बलीयसा mighty courageous, रावणेन by Ravana, शक्तिम् javelin, निष्कर्षतः while pulling out, तस्य his, सर्वेषु all over, गात्रेषु the limbs, मर्मभेदिनः private parts also, शराः arrows, पातिताः struck
explanation: While Rama was pulling out the javelin, mighty and courageous Ravana struck him in his private parts and all over the body with arrows.

shloka_text: अचिन्तयित्वातान्बाणान्समालशिष्य च लक्ष्मणम् ।।6.101.45।। अब्रवीच्चहनूमन्तंसुग्रीवं च महाकपिम् ।
transliteration: acintayitvātānbāṇānsamālaśiṣya ca lakṣmaṇam  abravīccahanūmantaṃsugrīvaṃ ca mahākapim |
translation: तान् those, बाणान् arrows, अचिन्तयित्वा not minding, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, समालशिष्य embracing, हनूमन्तम् to Hanumantha, महाकपिम् great Vanara, सुग्रीवंच Sugriva also, अब्रवीच्छ spoke
explanation: Not minding the arrows struck, Rama embraced Lakshmana and spoke to Hanumantha and the great Vanara Sugriva.

shloka_text: क्ष्मणंपरिवार्यैवतिष्ठध्वंवानरोत्तमाः ।।6.101.46।। पराक्रमस्यकालोऽयंसम्प्राप्तोमेचिरेप्सितः । पापात्मायंदशग्रीवोवध्यतांपापनिश्चयः ।।6.101.47।। काङ्क्षितस्स्तोककस्येवघर्मान्तेमेघदर्शनम् ।
transliteration: kṣmaṇaṃparivāryaivatiṣṭhadhvaṃvānarottamāḥ  parākramasyakālo'yaṃsamprāptomecirepsitaḥ | pāpātmāyaṃdaśagrīvovadhyatāṃpāpaniścayaḥ  kāṅkṣitasstokakasyevagharmāntemeghadarśanam |
translation: वानरोत्तमाः O foremost of Vanaras, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, परिवार्यैव surrounding, पापात्मा sinful, पापनिश्चयः of sinful resolve, अयंदशग्रीवः this ten headed, वध्यताम् will put an end, घर्माने rightfully, स्तोककस्य chataka bird, काङ्क्षितम् desire, मेघदर्शनिमव just as clouds appeared, मे for me, चिरेप्सितःfor a long time, अयम् this, पराक्रमस्यकालः time to exhibit valour, सम्प्राप्तः has come अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते in a short while now
explanation: "O foremost of Vanaras! Take care of Lakshmana by surrounding him. Just as clouds appeared before the chataka bird waiting for long, time has come to exhibit my valour which was awaited for long. Now I will destroy the ten headed Ravana of sinful resolve rightfully in a short while from now."

shloka_text: शक्त्याविनिहतंदृष्टवारावणेनबलीयसा । लक्ष्मणंसमरेशूरंरूधिरौघपरिप्लुतम् ।।6.102.1।। स दत्त्वातुमुलंयुद्धंरावणस्यदुरात्मनः । विसृजन्नेवबाणौघान् सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.102.2।।
transliteration: śaktyāvinihataṃdṛṣṭavārāvaṇenabalīyasā | lakṣmaṇaṃsamareśūraṃrūdhiraughapariplutam  sa dattvātumulaṃyuddhaṃrāvaṇasyadurātmanaḥ | visṛjannevabāṇaughān suṣeṇamidamabravīt
translation: बलीयसा exceedingly mighty, रावणेन by Ravana, शक्त्या by the javelin, विनिहतम् struck, समरे in fight, शूरम् heroic, रूधिरौघपरिप्लुतम् soaked in blood, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्टवा seeing, सःhe, दुरात्मनःevil minded, रावणस्य Ravana's, तुमुलम् intense, युद्धम् fight, दत्त्वा given, बाणौघान् arrows, विसृजन्नेव even discharging, सुषेणम् Sushena, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Seeing Lakshmana struck by exceedingly mighty, evil minded Ravana's javelin and soaked in blood Rama giving intense fight by discharging arrows also spoke as follows to Sushena.
comments: Rama laments over Lakshmana's unconscious state. Hanuman is directed by Sushena to Himalayas and get herbs for treating Lakshmana. Hanuman gets the herbs and on inhalation of the herbs Lakshmana recovers.

shloka_text: शक्त्याविनिहतंदृष्टवारावणेनबलीयसा । लक्ष्मणंसमरेशूरंरूधिरौघपरिप्लुतम् ।।6.102.1।। स दत्त्वातुमुलंयुद्धंरावणस्यदुरात्मनः । विसृजन्नेवबाणौघान् सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.102.2।।
transliteration: śaktyāvinihataṃdṛṣṭavārāvaṇenabalīyasā | lakṣmaṇaṃsamareśūraṃrūdhiraughapariplutam  sa dattvātumulaṃyuddhaṃrāvaṇasyadurātmanaḥ | visṛjannevabāṇaughān suṣeṇamidamabravīt
translation: बलीयसा exceedingly mighty, रावणेन by Ravana, शक्त्या by the javelin, विनिहतम् struck, समरे in fight, शूरम् heroic, रूधिरौघपरिप्लुतम् soaked in blood, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्टवा seeing, सःhe, दुरात्मनःevil minded, रावणस्य Ravana's, तुमुलम् intense, युद्धम् fight, दत्त्वा given, बाणौघान् arrows, विसृजन्नेव even discharging, सुषेणम् Sushena, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Seeing Lakshmana struck by exceedingly mighty, evil minded Ravana's javelin and soaked in blood Rama giving intense fight by discharging arrows also spoke as follows to Sushena.
comments: Rama laments over Lakshmana's unconscious state. Hanuman is directed by Sushena to Himalayas and get herbs for treating Lakshmana. Hanuman gets the herbs and on inhalation of the herbs Lakshmana recovers.

shloka_text: एषरावणवीर्येणलक्ष्मणःपतितोभुविः । सर्पवच्चेष्टतेवीरोभूमौशोकमुदिरीयन् ।।6.102.3।।
transliteration: eṣarāvaṇavīryeṇalakṣmaṇaḥpatitobhuviḥ | sarpavacceṣṭatevīrobhūmauśokamudirīyan
translation: रावणवीर्येण prowess of Ravana, भुवि earth, पतितः fallen, एषः like that, वीरः hero, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शोकम् sorrow, उदीरयन् writhing, सर्पवत् like snake, भूमौ on the ground, चेष्टते rolling
explanation: 'Heroic Lakshmana struck by Ravana, fell on the ground and writhing like a snake and rolling made me sad'.

shloka_text: शोणितार्द्रमिमंवीरंप्राणैःप्रियतरंमम । पश्यतोममकाशक्तिर्योद्धुंपर्याकुलात्मनः ।।6.102.4।।
transliteration: śoṇitārdramimaṃvīraṃprāṇaiḥpriyataraṃmama | paśyatomamakāśaktiryoddhuṃparyākulātmanaḥ
translation: मम my, प्राणैः more than life, प्रियतरम् loving, शोणितार्द्रम् soaked in blood, इमम् this way, वीरम् heroic, पश्यतः as I see, पर्याकुलात्मनः mind agitated, मम me, योद्धुम् to fight, शक्तिः energy, का how
explanation: ' As I see Lakshmana, who is more than my life, and loving soaked in blood, my mind is agitated. How can I have the energy to fight?'

shloka_text: अ यं स समरश्लाघीभ्रातामेशुभलक्षणः । यदिपञ्चत्वमापन्नःप्राणैर्मेकिंसुखेनवा ।।6.102.5।।
transliteration: a yaṃ sa samaraślāghībhrātāmeśubhalakṣaṇaḥ | yadipañcatvamāpannaḥprāṇairmekiṃsukhenavā
translation: समरश्लाघी praised for efficiency in war, शुभलक्षणः endowed with auspicious marks, सःhe, अयम् this, मे my, भ्राता brother, पञ्चत्वम् death, आपन्नःयदि if meets, मे my, प्राणैः life, सुखेनवा happiness, किम् What use
explanation: 'Lakshmana, my brother, is praised for his efficiency in war, is endowed with auspicious marks. If he is met with death, what use is my happiness and life for me?'

shloka_text: लज्जतीवहिवीर्यंभ्रश्यतीवकराद्धनुः । सायकाव्यवसीदन्तिदृष्टिर्भाष्पवशंगता ।।6.102.6।।
transliteration: lajjatīvahivīryaṃbhraśyatīvakarāddhanuḥ | sāyakāvyavasīdantidṛṣṭirbhāṣpavaśaṃgatā
translation: वीर्यम् heroism, लज्जतीव shy, धनुः bow, करात् from hand, भ्रश्यतीव slip from, सायकाः arrows, व्यवसीदन्ति dropping, दृष्टिः vision, बाष्पवशम् filled with tears, गताहि gone
explanation: 'My heroism is shy, my bow slips from my hand, arrows are dropping, my vision is blurred with tears with my brother gone.'

shloka_text: अवसीदन्तिगात्राणिस्वप्नयानेनृणामिव । चिन्तामेवर्ततेतीव्रामुमूर्षापि च जायते ।।6.102.7।।
transliteration: avasīdantigātrāṇisvapnayānenṛṇāmiva | cintāmevartatetīvrāmumūrṣāpi ca jāyate
translation: स्वप्नयाने in dream, नृणामिव while walking, गात्राणि limbs, अवसीदन्ति retrieves, मे my, चिन्ता grief, तीव्रा intense, वर्तते growing, मुमूर्षापि च being on the point of death, जायते desire to live is going
explanation: 'Seeing Lakshmana in this state, just as in dream, my limbs are retrieving while walking, being on the point of death intense sorrow is growing and the desire to live is gone.'

shloka_text: भ्रातरंनिहतंदृष्टवारावणेनदुरात्मना । विष्टनन्तंतुदुःखार्तंमर्मण्यभिहतंभृशम् ।।6.102.8।।
transliteration: bhrātaraṃnihataṃdṛṣṭavārāvaṇenadurātmanā | viṣṭanantaṃtuduḥkhārtaṃmarmaṇyabhihataṃbhṛśam
translation: दुरात्मना evil minded, रावणेन by Ravana, निहतम् wounded, विष्टनन्तम् filled with grief, दुःखार्तम् sad, भृशम् breathing heavily, मर्मणि vital parts, अभिहतम् struck, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing
explanation: Seeing the brother struck in vital parts and wounded by the evilminded Ravana, Rama was filled with grief and breathing heavily.

shloka_text: राघवोभ्रातरंदृष्टवाप्रियंप्राणंबहिश्चरम् । दुःखेनमहताविष्टोध्यानशोकपरायणः ।।6.102.9।।
transliteration: rāghavobhrātaraṃdṛṣṭavāpriyaṃprāṇaṃbahiścaram | duḥkhenamahatāviṣṭodhyānaśokaparāyaṇaḥ
translation: राघवो Raghava, भ्रातरं brother, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रियं dear, प्राणंबहिश्चरम् life outside, दुःखेन in grief, महताविष्टो overcome by anxiety, ध्यानशोकपरायणःgave himself to great sorrow lost senses
explanation: Beholding his dear brother, who is his life outside him overcome by anxiety, Rama lost senses and gave himself to great sorrow.

shloka_text: परंविषादमापन्नोविललापाकुलेन्द्रियः । भ्रातरंनिहतंदृष्टवालक्ष्मणंरणपांसुषु ।।6.102.10।।
transliteration: paraṃviṣādamāpannovilalāpākulendriyaḥ | bhrātaraṃnihataṃdṛṣṭavālakṣmaṇaṃraṇapāṃsuṣu
translation: निहतम् wounded, भ्रातरम् brother, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, रणपांसुषु in the battlefield, दृष्टवा seeing, परम् very, विषादम् sad, आपन्नः overtaken, आकुलेन्द्रियःlost control over senses, विललाप grieved
explanation: Seeing the wounded brother Lakshmana in the battlefield, the very sad Rama lost control over his senses and grieved.

shloka_text: विजयोऽपिहिमेशूर न प्रियायोपकल्पते । अचक्षुर्विषयश्चन्द्रःकांप्रीतिंजनयिष्यति ।।6.102.11।।
transliteration: vijayo'pihimeśūra na priyāyopakalpate | acakṣurviṣayaścandraḥkāṃprītiṃjanayiṣyati
translation: शूर hero, विजयोपि if victorious, मे for me, प्रियाय loving, न उपकल्पते not give joy, अचक्षुर्विषयः for one who has lost vision, चन्द्रः moon, काम् desire, प्रीतिम् जनयिष्यति What pleasure will it give
explanation: 'O Hero! Even victory for me will not give joy. What pleasure will one have if he desires to see the moon when he has lost vision?'

shloka_text: किंमेयुद्धेनकिंप्राणैर्युद्धकार्यं न विद्यते । यत्रायंनिहतश्शेतेरणमूर्धनिलक्ष्मणः ।।6.102.12।।
transliteration: kiṃmeyuddhenakiṃprāṇairyuddhakāryaṃ na vidyate | yatrāyaṃnihataśśeteraṇamūrdhanilakṣmaṇaḥ
translation: मे to me, युद्धेन in the battle, किम् what, प्राणैः life, किम् what, अयंलक्ष्मणः this Lakshmana, रणमूर्धनि in the forefront of battle, निहतः struck, यत्र here, शेते lying, युद्धकार्यम् purpose of fighting, न विद्यते not known
explanation: 'What purpose is there to fight in battle or in life with Lakshmana lying in the forefront struck in the battlefield?'

shloka_text: यथैवमांवनंयान्तमनुयातिमहाद्युतिः । अहमप्युपयास्यामितथैवैनंयमक्षयम् ।।6.102.13।।
transliteration: yathaivamāṃvanaṃyāntamanuyātimahādyutiḥ | ahamapyupayāsyāmitathaivainaṃyamakṣayam
translation: महाद्युतिः endowed with splendour, वनम् forest, यान्तम् followed, माम् me, यथैव in the same way, अनुयाति follow, अहमपि I also, तथैव in the same way, एनम्, यमक्षयम् god of death, उपयास्यामि follow him
explanation: 'Lakshmana who is endowed with splendour followed me to the forest. In the same way I will follow him to the god of death.'

shloka_text: इष्टबन्धुजनोनित्यंमां स नित्यमनुव्रतः । इमामवस्थांगमितोराक्षसैःकूटयोधिभिः ।।6.102.14।।
transliteration: iṣṭabandhujanonityaṃmāṃ sa nityamanuvrataḥ | imāmavasthāṃgamitorākṣasaiḥkūṭayodhibhiḥ
translation: इष्टबन्धुजनः loved kin, नित्यम् always, माम् me, अनुव्रतः devoted to me, सः he, कूटयोधिभिः has been led to, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, इमाम् this way, अवस्थाम् situation, गमितः pass by
explanation: 'Lakshmana, who loved the kin and was devoted to me, has been led to pass by the Rakshasas.'

shloka_text: देशेदेशेकलत्राणिदेशेदेशे च बान्दवाः । तंतुदेशं न पश्यामियत्रभ्रातासहोदरः ।।6.102.15।।
transliteration: deśedeśekalatrāṇideśedeśe ca bāndavāḥ | taṃtudeśaṃ na paśyāmiyatrabhrātāsahodaraḥ
translation: देशेदेशे everywhere, कलत्राणि wives, देशेदेशे च everywhere, बान्दवाः relatives, सहोदरः sibling brother, भ्राता brother, यत्र here, तम् him, देशंतु no place, न पश्यामि not found
explanation: 'Wives can be found everywhere, relatives can be found everywhere but biological sibling brothers are not found in any place.'

shloka_text: इत्येवंविलपन्तंतंशोकविह्वलितेद्रनियम् । विवेष्टमानंकरुणमच्छवसन्तंपुनःपुनः ।।6.102.16।। राममाश्वासयनवीरसुषेनोवाक्यमब्रवीत
transliteration: ityevaṃvilapantaṃtaṃśokavihvalitedraniyam | viveṣṭamānaṃkaruṇamacchavasantaṃpunaḥpunaḥ  rāmamāśvāsayanavīrasuṣenovākyamabravīta
translation: इत्येवम् in this manner, विलपन्तम् grieving, शोकविह्वलितेद्रनियम् lost control over senses in grief विवेष्टमानम् lost sense of discrimination, पुनःपुनः again and again, करुणम् pitiable, उच्छवसन्तम् sighing, तम् him, रामRama, वीर hero, सुषेनो Sushena, आस्वसयन consoling, अब्रवीत spoke, वाक्यम words
explanation: Grieving in this manner, lost control over senses, and discrimination, Rama was sighing again and again and was pitiable. Sushena, the hero consoling Rama spoke these words.

shloka_text: किनुराज्येनदुर्धर्षलक्ष्मणेनविनामम । कथंवक्ष्याम्यहंत्वम्बांसुमित्रांपुत्रवत्सलाम् ।।6.102.17।।
transliteration: kinurājyenadurdharṣalakṣmaṇenavināmama | kathaṃvakṣyāmyahaṃtvambāṃsumitrāṃputravatsalām
translation: दुर्धर्षलक्ष्मणेनविना without Lakshmana who is difficult to win, मम me, राज्येन kingdom, किंनु why, पुत्रवत्सलाम् lover of son, अम्बाम् mother, सुमित्राम् to Sumithra, अहम् I, किंनुवक्ष्यामि What can I tell
explanation: 'Without Lakshmana who is difficult to win, what use is kingdom to me? What can I tell mother Sumithra who is the lover of her son?'

shloka_text: न मृथोयंमहाबाहो लक्ष्मणोलक्षमिवर्धन: । न चास्यविक्रतंवक्त्रानापिशस्वासं न निष्प्रभं ।।6.102.18।।
transliteration: na mṛthoyaṃmahābāho lakṣmaṇolakṣamivardhana: | na cāsyavikrataṃvaktrānāpiśasvāsaṃ na niṣprabhaṃ
translation: महाबाहो O broad shouldered, लक्षमिवर्धन: enhancer of prosperity, लक्ष्मणोthis Lakshmana, न मृथो not dead, चास्यविक्रतंnot changed वक्त्रा face नापि also न निष्प्रभंnot lost splendour
explanation: O Broad shouldered Rama! Enhancer of prosperity, Lakshmana is not dead. His face has not changed, and he has not lost splendour.

shloka_text: सुप्रभंसुप्रसन्नं च मुखमस्यनिरीक्ष्यताम् ।।6.102.19।। पद्मपत्रतलौहस्तौसुप्रसन्ने च लोचने ।
transliteration: suprabhaṃsuprasannaṃ ca mukhamasyanirīkṣyatām  padmapatratalauhastausuprasanne ca locane |
translation: सुप्रभम् radiant, सुप्रसन्नं pleasing, अस्य his, मुखम् face, निरीक्ष्यताम् seeing, हस्तौ palms, पद्मपत्रतलौ red lotus like, लोचने च and eyes, सुप्रसन्ने very pleasant
explanation: 'His face is radiant and pleasing to see. His palms are like red lotuses and his eyes are so pleasant'.

shloka_text: ऐ वं न विद्यतेरूपंगतासूनांविशम्पते ।।6.102.20।। माविषादंमृकृथावीरसप्राणोऽयमरिन्दम ।
transliteration: ai vaṃ na vidyaterūpaṃgatāsūnāṃviśampate  māviṣādaṃmṛkṛthāvīrasaprāṇo'yamarindama |
translation: विशम्पते such form, वीर heroes, गतासूनाम् ceased of life, रूपम् form, ईदृशब् marks, न दृश्यते not seen, अरिन्दम tamer of foes, अयम् this, सप्राणः those who are alive, विषादम् grief, माकृथाःI tell you
explanation: "O hero! Those who cease to live will not have such appearance and signs. He who is a tamer of foes is alive. I tell you, do not grieve."

shloka_text: आ ख्यासतितुप्रसुप्तस्यस्रस्तगात्रस्यभूतले ।।6.102.21।। सोच्छवासंहृदयंवीरकम्पमानंमुहुर्मुहुः ।
transliteration: ā khyāsatituprasuptasyasrastagātrasyabhūtale  socchavāsaṃhṛdayaṃvīrakampamānaṃmuhurmuhuḥ |
translation: तु you, प्रसुप्तस्य fallen thus, स्रस्तगात्रस्य from the limbs, सोच्छवासम् lying alive, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, कम्पमानम् throbbing, हृदयम् heart, आख्याति is known
explanation: "From the movement of his limbs and throbbing of his heart again and again it is known that he is alive."

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वामहाप्राज्ञःसुषेणोराघवंवचः ।।6.102.22।। समीपस्थमुवाचेदंहनूमन्तंमहाकपिम् ।
transliteration: evamuktvāmahāprājñaḥsuṣeṇorāghavaṃvacaḥ  samīpasthamuvācedaṃhanūmantaṃmahākapim |
translation: महाप्राज्ञः very wise, सुषेणःSushena, राघवम्to Raghava, एवम् in that manner, वचःwords, उक्त्वा having spoken, समीपस्थम् nearby, महाकपिम् great Vanara, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke
explanation: Very wise Sushena, having spoken like that to Raghava, spoke to the great Vanara, Hanuman nearby.

shloka_text: सौम्य शीघ्रमितोगत्वाशैलमौषधिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.23।। पूर्वंतुकथितोयोऽसौवीर जाम्बवताशुभ: । दक्षिणेशिखरेजातामोषधिमानय ।।6.102.24।। सवर्णकरणींनाम्नासावर्ण्यकरणींतथा । सञ्जीवकरणींवीरसन्धानीं च महौषधीम् ।।6.102.25।। सञ्जीवनार्धंवीरस्यलक्ष्मणस्यमहात्मनः ।
transliteration: saumya śīghramitogatvāśailamauṣadhiparvatam  pūrvaṃtukathitoyo'sauvīra jāmbavatāśubha: | dakṣiṇeśikharejātāmoṣadhimānaya  savarṇakaraṇīṃnāmnāsāvarṇyakaraṇīṃtathā | sañjīvakaraṇīṃvīrasandhānīṃ ca mahauṣadhīm  sañjīvanārdhaṃvīrasyalakṣmaṇasyamahātmanaḥ |
translation: सौम्य gentle, वीर heroic, यःअसौ that which, पूर्वम् earlier, जाम्बवता Jambavantha, तव your, कथितः spoken, औषथिपर्वतम् mountain of herbs, शैलम् peak, इतः now, शीघ्रम् quickly, गत्वाreach, दक्षिणेशिखरे southern peak, जाताम् having gone, नाम्ना by name, सवर्णकरणीम् Sarvakarani, महौषधिम् great herb, तथा so also, सावर्ण्यकरणीम् Savarnakarani, सञ्जीवकरणीम् Sanjeevakarani, सन्धानीं च Sandhanakarani, महौषधीम् great herbs, महात्मनः great soul, वीरस्यhero's, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, सञ्जीवनार्धम् to make him alive, इह here, आनय come
explanation: "O gentle Hanumantha! Going to that mountain of herbs about which Jambavan had earlier spoken to you, get the herbs from the southern peak of that great mountain. To make Lakshmana the great soul alive quickly go and get Savarankarani, Sarvakarani so also Sanjeevakarani and Sandhanakarani and come."

shloka_text: सौम्य शीघ्रमितोगत्वाशैलमौषधिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.23।। पूर्वंतुकथितोयोऽसौवीर जाम्बवताशुभ: । दक्षिणेशिखरेजातामोषधिमानय ।।6.102.24।। सवर्णकरणींनाम्नासावर्ण्यकरणींतथा । सञ्जीवकरणींवीरसन्धानीं च महौषधीम् ।।6.102.25।। सञ्जीवनार्धंवीरस्यलक्ष्मणस्यमहात्मनः ।
transliteration: saumya śīghramitogatvāśailamauṣadhiparvatam  pūrvaṃtukathitoyo'sauvīra jāmbavatāśubha: | dakṣiṇeśikharejātāmoṣadhimānaya  savarṇakaraṇīṃnāmnāsāvarṇyakaraṇīṃtathā | sañjīvakaraṇīṃvīrasandhānīṃ ca mahauṣadhīm  sañjīvanārdhaṃvīrasyalakṣmaṇasyamahātmanaḥ |
translation: सौम्य gentle, वीर heroic, यःअसौ that which, पूर्वम् earlier, जाम्बवता Jambavantha, तव your, कथितः spoken, औषथिपर्वतम् mountain of herbs, शैलम् peak, इतः now, शीघ्रम् quickly, गत्वाreach, दक्षिणेशिखरे southern peak, जाताम् having gone, नाम्ना by name, सवर्णकरणीम् Sarvakarani, महौषधिम् great herb, तथा so also, सावर्ण्यकरणीम् Savarnakarani, सञ्जीवकरणीम् Sanjeevakarani, सन्धानीं च Sandhanakarani, महौषधीम् great herbs, महात्मनः great soul, वीरस्यhero's, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, सञ्जीवनार्धम् to make him alive, इह here, आनय come
explanation: "O gentle Hanumantha! Going to that mountain of herbs about which Jambavan had earlier spoken to you, get the herbs from the southern peak of that great mountain. To make Lakshmana the great soul alive quickly go and get Savarankarani, Sarvakarani so also Sanjeevakarani and Sandhanakarani and come."

shloka_text: सौम्य शीघ्रमितोगत्वाशैलमौषधिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.23।। पूर्वंतुकथितोयोऽसौवीर जाम्बवताशुभ: । दक्षिणेशिखरेजातामोषधिमानय ।।6.102.24।। सवर्णकरणींनाम्नासावर्ण्यकरणींतथा । सञ्जीवकरणींवीरसन्धानीं च महौषधीम् ।।6.102.25।। सञ्जीवनार्धंवीरस्यलक्ष्मणस्यमहात्मनः ।
transliteration: saumya śīghramitogatvāśailamauṣadhiparvatam  pūrvaṃtukathitoyo'sauvīra jāmbavatāśubha: | dakṣiṇeśikharejātāmoṣadhimānaya  savarṇakaraṇīṃnāmnāsāvarṇyakaraṇīṃtathā | sañjīvakaraṇīṃvīrasandhānīṃ ca mahauṣadhīm  sañjīvanārdhaṃvīrasyalakṣmaṇasyamahātmanaḥ |
translation: सौम्य gentle, वीर heroic, यःअसौ that which, पूर्वम् earlier, जाम्बवता Jambavantha, तव your, कथितः spoken, औषथिपर्वतम् mountain of herbs, शैलम् peak, इतः now, शीघ्रम् quickly, गत्वाreach, दक्षिणेशिखरे southern peak, जाताम् having gone, नाम्ना by name, सवर्णकरणीम् Sarvakarani, महौषधिम् great herb, तथा so also, सावर्ण्यकरणीम् Savarnakarani, सञ्जीवकरणीम् Sanjeevakarani, सन्धानीं च Sandhanakarani, महौषधीम् great herbs, महात्मनः great soul, वीरस्यhero's, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, सञ्जीवनार्धम् to make him alive, इह here, आनय come
explanation: "O gentle Hanumantha! Going to that mountain of herbs about which Jambavan had earlier spoken to you, get the herbs from the southern peak of that great mountain. To make Lakshmana the great soul alive quickly go and get Savarankarani, Sarvakarani so also Sanjeevakarani and Sandhanakarani and come."

shloka_text: इत्येवमुक्तोहनुमान्गत्वाचौषथिपर्वतम् ।।6.102.26।। चिन्तामभ्यगमछ्रचीमानजानं स्ता महौषधीः ।
transliteration: ityevamuktohanumāngatvācauṣathiparvatam  cintāmabhyagamachracīmānajānaṃ stā mahauṣadhīḥ |
translation: इत्येवम् in this manner, उक्तः having said, श्रीमान् glorious, हनुमान् Hanuman, औषधिपर्वतम् mountain of herbs, गत्वा having gone, ताः those, महौषदीः great herbs, अजानन् not able to recognize, चिन्ताम् thought over, अभ्यगतम् after having reached
explanation: Sushena having said so, glorious Hanuman set out to the mountain of herbs. Not able to recognise the herbs he thought over.

shloka_text: तस्यबुद्धि: समुत्पन्नामारुतेरमितौजसः ।।6.102.27।। इदमेवगमिष्यामिगृहीत्वाशिखरंगिरेः ।
transliteration: tasyabuddhi: samutpannāmāruteramitaujasaḥ  idamevagamiṣyāmigṛhītvāśikharaṃgireḥ |
translation: अमितौजसः highly brilliant, तस्यमारुतेः that Maruthi, बुद्धि: intellect, समुत्पना sprung, गिरेःon mountain, इदम् thus, शिखरमेव peak, गृहीत्वा seized, गमिष्यामिwill take
explanation: Highly brilliant Hanuman used his intellect and thought to seize the peak of the mountain on which herbs had sprung.

shloka_text: अस्मिंस्तुशिखरेजातामोषधिंतांसुखावहाम् ।।6.102.28।। प्रतर्केणावगच्छामिसुषेणोह्यवमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: asmiṃstuśikharejātāmoṣadhiṃtāṃsukhāvahām  pratarkeṇāvagacchāmisuṣeṇohyavamabravīt |
translation: सुखावहाम् that which does good, ताम् to him, ओषधिम् herb, अस्मिन् in this, शिखरे peak, जाताम् growing, प्रतर्केण reasoning, अवगच्छामि is known, सुषेणः Sushena, एवम् in that way, अब्रवीत् हि has told
explanation: By reasoning it is known that the herb which is good for him is grown in this peak, for Sushena said so.

shloka_text: अगृह्ययदिगच्छामिविशल्यकरणीमहम् ।।6.102.29।। कालात्ययेनदोषःस्याद्वैक्लब्यं च महद्भवेत् ।
transliteration: agṛhyayadigacchāmiviśalyakaraṇīmaham  kālātyayenadoṣaḥsyādvaiklabyaṃ ca mahadbhavet |
translation: अहम् I, विशल्यकरणीम् Visalakarani, अगृह्य taking, गच्छामियदि if I go, कालात्ययेन through passage of time, दोषः mistake, स्यात् again, महत् huge, वैक्लब्यं च perplexity, भवेत् will arise
explanation: 'If I go without taking Visalakarani, through the passage of time huge mistakes will happen and perplexity will arise'.

shloka_text: इतिसञ्चिन्त्यहनूमान्गत्वाक्षिप्रंमहाबलः ।।6.102.30।। आसाद्यपर्वतश्रेष्ठंप्रक्रम्यगिरेश्शिरः । फुल्लनानातरुगणंसमुत्पाट्यमहाबलः ।।6.102.31।। गृहीत्वाहरिशार्दूलोहस्ताभ्यांसमतोलयत् ।
transliteration: itisañcintyahanūmāngatvākṣipraṃmahābalaḥ  āsādyaparvataśreṣṭhaṃprakramyagireśśiraḥ | phullanānātarugaṇaṃsamutpāṭyamahābalaḥ  gṛhītvāhariśārdūlohastābhyāṃsamatolayat |
translation: महाबलः mighty, हरिशार्दूलः tiger among Vanaras, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking, क्षिप्रम् quickly, गत्वाgoing, पर्वतश्रेष्ठम् foremost of the mountains, आसाद्य reached, गिरेः mountain, शिखरं top, हस्ताभ्याम् with both hands, गृहीत्वाseized, त्रिःthrice, प्रकम्प्य shaking, फुल्लनानातरुगणम् with plants, flowers in bloom, समुत्पाट्य uprooted, महाबलः mighty, समतोलयत् balanced
explanation: Hanuman, the mighty among the Vanaras, thinking so quickly reached the foremost of the mountains, seized the mountain with both hands by shaking it thrice, uprooted the plants with flowers in bloom and balanced it with his hands.

shloka_text: इतिसञ्चिन्त्यहनूमान्गत्वाक्षिप्रंमहाबलः ।।6.102.30।। आसाद्यपर्वतश्रेष्ठंप्रक्रम्यगिरेश्शिरः । फुल्लनानातरुगणंसमुत्पाट्यमहाबलः ।।6.102.31।। गृहीत्वाहरिशार्दूलोहस्ताभ्यांसमतोलयत् ।
transliteration: itisañcintyahanūmāngatvākṣipraṃmahābalaḥ  āsādyaparvataśreṣṭhaṃprakramyagireśśiraḥ | phullanānātarugaṇaṃsamutpāṭyamahābalaḥ  gṛhītvāhariśārdūlohastābhyāṃsamatolayat |
translation: महाबलः mighty, हरिशार्दूलः tiger among Vanaras, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य thinking, क्षिप्रम् quickly, गत्वाgoing, पर्वतश्रेष्ठम् foremost of the mountains, आसाद्य reached, गिरेः mountain, शिखरं top, हस्ताभ्याम् with both hands, गृहीत्वाseized, त्रिःthrice, प्रकम्प्य shaking, फुल्लनानातरुगणम् with plants, flowers in bloom, समुत्पाट्य uprooted, महाबलः mighty, समतोलयत् balanced
explanation: Hanuman, the mighty among the Vanaras, thinking so quickly reached the foremost of the mountains, seized the mountain with both hands by shaking it thrice, uprooted the plants with flowers in bloom and balanced it with his hands.

shloka_text: सनीलमिवजीमूतंतोयपूर्णंनभस्तलात् ।।6.102.32।। उत्पपातगृहीत्वातुहनूमान् शिखरंगिरेः ।
transliteration: sanīlamivajīmūtaṃtoyapūrṇaṃnabhastalāt  utpapātagṛhītvātuhanūmān śikharaṃgireḥ |
translation: सःहनूमान् that Hanuman, तोयपूर्णम् filled with water, नीलम् bluish, जीमूतम् इव like the wind, गिरेःशिखरम् mountain peak, गृहीत्वा holding, नभस्तलात् from the earth surface, उत्पपात went into air
explanation: Like a dark cloud filled with water carried by wind, Hanuman held the mountain peak and went in the air from the surface of the earth.

shloka_text: समागम्यमहावेगःसंन्यस्यशिखरंगिरेः ।।6.102.33।। विश्रम्यकिञ्चिद्धनुमान्सुषेणमिदमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: samāgamyamahāvegaḥsaṃnyasyaśikharaṃgireḥ  viśramyakiñciddhanumānsuṣeṇamidamabravīt |
translation: महावेगः at high speed, हनुमान् Hanuman, समागम्य came, गिरेः mountain, शिखरम्peak, संन्यस्यletting it down, किञ्चित् for a while, विश्रम् resting, सुषेणम् to Sushena, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Hanuman came at high speed with the mountain and letting it down and resting for a while spoke as follows.

shloka_text: ओषधीर्नावगच्छामिताअहंहरिपुङ्गव ।।6.102.34।। तदिदंशिखरंकृत्स्नंगिरेस्तस्याहृतंमया ।
transliteration: oṣadhīrnāvagacchāmitāahaṃharipuṅgava  tadidaṃśikharaṃkṛtsnaṃgirestasyāhṛtaṃmayā |
translation: हरिपुङ्गव leader of Vanaras, अहम् I, ताः those, ओषधीःherbs, नावगच्छामि did not know, तस्यitsगिरेः mountain, तत् that, इदम् here, कृत्स्नम् dark, शिखरम् peak, मया by me, आहृतम् brought
explanation: "O leader of the Vanaras! I did not know those herbs. So, the mountain peak was brought here by me."

shloka_text: एवंकथयमानंतुप्रशस्यपवनात्मजम् ।।6.102.35।। सुषेणोवानरश्रेष्ठोजग्राहोत्पाट्यचौषधीः ।
transliteration: evaṃkathayamānaṃtupraśasyapavanātmajam  suṣeṇovānaraśreṣṭhojagrāhotpāṭyacauṣadhīḥ |
translation: एवम् in that manner, कथयमानम् having revealed, पवनात्मजम् by the son of wind god, प्रशस्य applauding, वानरश्रेष्ठः leader of the Vanaras, सुषेणः Sushena, ओषधीः herb, उत्पाट्य uprooted, जग्राह took up
explanation: The son of wind god, having revealed it like that, Sushena the leader of the Vanaras uprooted the herb and took out.

shloka_text: विस्मितास्तुबभूवुस्तेसर्वेवानरपुङ्गवाः ।।6.102.36।। दृष्टवाहनूमतःकर्मसुरैरपिसुदुष्करम् ।
transliteration: vismitāstubabhūvustesarvevānarapuṅgavāḥ  dṛṣṭavāhanūmataḥkarmasurairapisuduṣkaram |
translation: सुरैरपि even for Suras, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, हनूमतः Hanuman, कर्म task, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वे all, ते them, वानरपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, विस्मिताः amazed, बभूवुः were
explanation: It is a difficult task even for Suras. Seeing Hanuman doing it all the Vanara leaders were amazed.

shloka_text: ततःसङ्क्षोदयित्वातामोषधिंवानरोत्तमः ।।6.102.37।। लक्ष्मणस्यददौनस्तस्सुषेणस्सुमहाद्युतिः ।
transliteration: tataḥsaṅkṣodayitvātāmoṣadhiṃvānarottamaḥ  lakṣmaṇasyadadaunastassuṣeṇassumahādyutiḥ |
translation: ततः thereafter, वानरोत्तमः foremost of Vanaras, सुमहाद्युतिः brilliant, सुषेणः Sushena, ताम् them, ओषधिम् herbs, सङ्क्षोदयित्वा crushed, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, नस्तः nose, ददौ dropped
explanation: Thereafter, Sushena the foremost of the Vanaras, a brilliant one crushed the herbs and dropped the extract into Lakshmana's nose.

shloka_text: विशल्यस्ससमाघ्रायलक्ष्मणःपरवीरहा ।।6.102.38।। विशल्योविरुजश्शीघ्रमुदतिष्ठन्महीतलात् ।
transliteration: viśalyassasamāghrāyalakṣmaṇaḥparavīrahā  viśalyovirujaśśīghramudatiṣṭhanmahītalāt |
translation: सशल्यः pained with piercing of that javelin, परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, सः he, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, समाघ्राय inhaling, विशल्यः devoid of javelin, विरुजः rid of pain, महीतलात् from the ground, शीघ्रम् quickly, उदतिष्ठत् got up
explanation: The destroyer of enemies, Lakshmana, who was pained by the javelin stuck in his body, on inhaling the herb, was devoid of javelin and rid of pain. He got up from the ground.

shloka_text: तमुत्थितंतुहरयोभूतलात्प्रेक्ष्यलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.102.39।। साधुसावधितिसुप्रीतालक्ष्मणंप्रत्यपूजयन् ।
transliteration: tamutthitaṃtuharayobhūtalātprekṣyalakṣmaṇam  sādhusāvadhitisuprītālakṣmaṇaṃpratyapūjayan |
translation: हरयः Vanaras, भूतलात् from the surface of the ground, उत्थितम् arisen, तंलक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, दृष्टवा seeing, सुप्रीताः very affectionately, साधुसाधुइति well done well done, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, प्रत्यपूजयन् in turn offered prayers
explanation: Seeing Lakshmana rise up from the surface of the ground, the Vanaras said Well done and offered prayers very affectionately.

shloka_text: एह्येहीत्यब्रवीद्रामोलक्ष्मणंपरवीरहा ।।6.102.40।। सस्वजेस्नेहगाढं च बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः ।
transliteration: ehyehītyabravīdrāmolakṣmaṇaṃparavīrahā  sasvajesnehagāḍhaṃ ca bāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇaḥ |
translation: परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, रामःRama, एहिएहि come, इति thus, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, अब्रवीत् spoke, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणः eyes filled with tears, स्नेहगाढं च overcome with affection, सस्वजेembraced him
explanation: Rama the destroyer of enemies seeing Lakshmana saying, 'come come', eyes filled with tears of joy affectionately embraced him and spoke.

shloka_text: ब्रवीच्छपरिष्वज्यसौमित्रिंराघवस्तदा ।।6.102.41।। दिष्ट्यात्वांवीरपश्यामिमरणात्पुनरागतम् ।
transliteration: bravīcchapariṣvajyasaumitriṃrāghavastadā  diṣṭyātvāṃvīrapaśyāmimaraṇātpunarāgatam |
translation: तदा then, राघवः Raghava, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, परिष्वज्य embracing, अब्रवीच्छ spoke this, वीर hero, दिष्ट्या luckily, मरणात्from death, पुनःagain, आगतम् come, त्वाम् you, पश्यामिI see
explanation: Embracing Saumithri, Rama spoke 'luckily you have recovered from death again and I am able to see you'.

shloka_text: न हिमेजीवितेनार्थस्सीतयाविजयनेवा ।।6.102.42।। कोहिमेवदतेनार्धस्त्वयिपञ्चत्वमागते ।
transliteration: na himejīvitenārthassītayāvijayanevā  kohimevadatenārdhastvayipañcatvamāgate |
translation: त्वयि you, पञ्चत्वम् from the five elements, आगते not come out, मे to me, जीवितेन life, सीतया even Sita, विजयेनवा or victory, अर्थः meaning, न हि not there, मे to me, तेन your, कः what, अर्थः use, वद said
explanation: 'Lakshmana! If you had not come out of death, what use is life to me? What is the use of Sita? What is the meaning of life' said Rama?

shloka_text: इत्येवंवदतस्तस्यराघवस्यमहात्मनः ।।6.102.43।। भिन्नश्शिथिलयावाचालक्ष्मणोवाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: ityevaṃvadatastasyarāghavasyamahātmanaḥ  bhinnaśśithilayāvācālakṣmaṇovākyamabravīt |
translation: महात्मनः great soul, राघवस्य Raghava's, इत्येवम् in this manner, वदतः spoken, भिन्नः broken, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, शिथिलया irresolute, वाचा talk, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: When Raghava had spoken in that manner, Lakshmana spoke, pained by the irresolute talk (of Rama).

shloka_text: तांप्रतिज्ञांप्रतिज्ञायपुरासत्यपराक्रम ।।6.102.44।। लघुःकश्चिदिवासत्त्वोनैवंवक्तुमिहार्हसि ।
transliteration: tāṃpratijñāṃpratijñāyapurāsatyaparākrama  laghuḥkaścidivāsattvonaivaṃvaktumihārhasi |
translation: सत्यपराक्रम of truthful valour, पुरा earlier, तांप्रतिज्ञाम् you having made a vow, प्रतिज्ञाय vow, असत्त्वः weak minded, लघुः lowly, कश्चिदिव spiritless, इह now, ए वम् this way, वक्तुम् speaking, न अर्हसि not appropriate
explanation: "You who are of truthful valour having made a vow, now speaking in this way, like a lowly person is not appropriate."

shloka_text: न हिप्रतिज्ञांकुर्वन्तिवितथांसत्यवादिनः ।।6.102.45।। लक्षणंहिमहत्त्वस्यप्रतिज्ञापरिपालनम् ।
transliteration: na hipratijñāṃkurvantivitathāṃsatyavādinaḥ  lakṣaṇaṃhimahattvasyapratijñāparipālanam |
translation: सत्यवादिनः those who speak truth, प्रतिज्ञाम् vows, वितथाम् futile, न कुर्वन्तिहि never make, प्रतिज्ञापरिपालनम् for fulfilment of vow, महत्त्वस्य greatness, लक्षणंहि mark of vow
explanation: 'Those who speak truth never fail their vows futile for fulfilment of the vows is a mark of greatness for them'.

shloka_text: नैराश्यमुपगन्तुं च नालंतेमत्कृतेऽनघ ।।6.102.46।। वधेनरावणस्याद्यप्रतिज्ञामनुपालय ।
transliteration: nairāśyamupagantuṃ ca nālaṃtematkṛte'nagha  vadhenarāvaṇasyādyapratijñāmanupālaya |
translation: अनघ sinless, मत्कृते on my account, नैराश्यम् to despair, उपगन्तुं च to give up, ते you, नालम्redeem, अद्य now, रावणस्य Ravana's, वधेन destruction, प्रतिज्ञाम् vow, अनुपालय fulfill
explanation: "O Sinless Rama! To be in despair on my account is not fair. Destroy Ravana and redeem your vow."

shloka_text: नजीवन्यास्यतेशत्रुस्तवबाणपथंगतः ।।6.102.47।। नर्दतस्तीक्षणदंष्ट्रस्यसिंहस्येवमहागजः ।
transliteration: najīvanyāsyateśatrustavabāṇapathaṃgataḥ  nardatastīkṣaṇadaṃṣṭrasyasiṃhasyevamahāgajaḥ |
translation: तव your, बाणपथम् victim of your arrow, गतःnot alive, शत्रुःenemy, नर्धतःroaring, तीक्षणदंष्ट्रस्यpossessing sharp teeth, सिंहस्यlion's, महागजःइव like an elephant, जीवन् live, न यास्यते not possible
explanation: " A victim of your arrow can not be alive just as an elephant fallen into the clutch of a roaring lion with sharp teeth is not possible to live."

shloka_text: अहंतुवधमिच्छामिशीघ्रमस्यदुरात्मनः ।।6.102.48।। यावदस्तं न यात्येषकृतकर्मादिवाकरः ।
transliteration: ahaṃtuvadhamicchāmiśīghramasyadurātmanaḥ  yāvadastaṃ na yātyeṣakṛtakarmādivākaraḥ |
translation: एषः, दिवाकरः Sun, कृतकर्मा having completed his day, यावत् before, अस्तम् sets, न यातिbefore departing, अस्य his, दुरात्मनःevil minded, वधम् destruction, शीघ्रम् quickly, अहम् I, इच्छामि wish
explanation: "I wish to see the destruction of this evil minded one quickly before the sun completes the day and sets."

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणेनतुतद्वाक्यमुक्तंश्रुत्वा स राघवः । सन्दधेपरवीरघ्नोधनुरादायवीर्यवान् ।।6.103.1।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇenatutadvākyamuktaṃśrutvā sa rāghavaḥ | sandadheparavīraghnodhanurādāyavīryavān
translation: परवीरघ्नः destroyer of enemies, वीर्यवान् courageous, सःराघवः Raghava, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, उक्तम् spoken, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, धनुः bow, आदाय took up, सन्दधे fixed
explanation: Courageous Raghava, the destroyer of enemies on hearing the words spoken by Lakshmana took up his bow and fixed it.
comments: Indra sends a chariot to Rama who is seen standing on the ground and fighting with Ravana in chariot. Rama ascends the chariot and renews the fight,

shloka_text: रावणायशरानघोरान्विससर्जचमूमुखे । अधान्यंरथमास्थायरावणोराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.103.2।। अभ्यधावतकाकुत्स्थंस्वर्भानुरिवभास्करम् ।
transliteration: rāvaṇāyaśarānaghorānvisasarjacamūmukhe | adhānyaṃrathamāsthāyarāvaṇorākṣasādhipaḥ  abhyadhāvatakākutsthaṃsvarbhānurivabhāskaram |
translation: चमूमुखे forefront of army, रावणाय Ravana's, घोरान् dreadful, शरान् arrows, विससर्ज discharged, अथ and then, राक्षसाधिपः king of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, अन्यम् other, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय ascended, काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, स्वर्भानुः planet to Sun, भास्करम् इव the Sun, अभ्यधावत went towards
explanation: Rama discharged dreadful shafts at Ravana's army in the forefront. Ravana ascended another chariot and went towards Rama, just as the planet Rahu moved towards the Sun.

shloka_text: दशग्रीवोरधस्थस्तुरामंवज्रोपमैश्शरैः ।।6.103.3।। आजघानमहाशैलंधाराभिरिवतोयदः ।
transliteration: daśagrīvoradhasthasturāmaṃvajropamaiśśaraiḥ  ājaghānamahāśailaṃdhārābhirivatoyadaḥ |
translation: रथस्थः from the chariot दशग्रीवःतु ten headed also, रामम् at Rama, वज्रोपमैः like thunderbolt, शरैःshafts, तोयदः rain cloud, धाराभिः showers, महाशैलम् इव on the huge mountain, आजघान struck
explanation: Seated in the chariot, the ten headed Ravana showered thunderbolt like shafts just as rain cloud showers on a huge mountain and struck.

shloka_text: दीप्तपावकसङ्काशैःशरैःकाञ्चनभूषणैः ।।6.103.4।। अभ्यवर्षद्रणरामोदशग्रीवंसमाहितः ।
transliteration: dīptapāvakasaṅkāśaiḥśaraiḥkāñcanabhūṣaṇaiḥ  abhyavarṣadraṇarāmodaśagrīvaṃsamāhitaḥ |
translation: रामःRama, समाहितःsteadily, दीप्तपावकसङ्काशैः shining like glowing fire, काञ्चनभूषणैः covered with gold, शरैःshafts, रणे in battle, दशग्रीवम् Ravana, अभ्यवर्षत् covered
explanation: Sri Rama steadily covered Ravana, the ten headed Rakshasa with shining shafts covered with gold glowing like fire in the battle.

shloka_text: भूमौस्थितस्यरामस्यरथस्थस्य च रक्षसः ।।6.103.5।। न समंयुद्धमित्याहुर्देवगन्धर्वकिन्नराः ।
transliteration: bhūmausthitasyarāmasyarathasthasya ca rakṣasaḥ  na samaṃyuddhamityāhurdevagandharvakinnarāḥ |
translation: भूमौ on the earth, स्थितस्य standing, रामस्य Rama's, रथस्थस्य seated, रक्षसः Rakshasa, युद्धम् doing war, समम् not equal, न not, इति this, देवगन्धर्वकिन्नराः Devas, Gandharvas and Kinneras, आहुः declared
explanation: Rama standing on the earth and Ravana seated on the chariot and waging war is not fair, declared Devas, Gandharvas and Kinneras.

shloka_text: ततोदेववरर्श्रीमान् श्रुत्वातेषांवचोऽमृतम् ।।6.103.6।। आहूयमातलिंशक्रोवचनंचेदमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: tatodevavararśrīmān śrutvāteṣāṃvaco'mṛtam  āhūyamātaliṃśakrovacanaṃcedamabravīt |
translation: ततः then, देववरः foremost of Devas, श्रीमान् glorious, शक्रः Indra, तेषाम् their, वचोमृतम् words of nectar, श्रुत्वा hearing, मातलिम् Matali, आहूय called for, इदम् thus, वचनं च words also, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: The foremost of Devas, the glorious Indra, on hearing their sweet words called his charioteer Matali and spoke as follows.

shloka_text: रथेनममभूमिष्ठंशीघ्रंयाहिरघूत्तमम् ।।6.103.7।। आहूयभूतलंयातःकुरुदेवहितंमहत् ।
transliteration: rathenamamabhūmiṣṭhaṃśīghraṃyāhiraghūttamam  āhūyabhūtalaṃyātaḥkurudevahitaṃmahat |
translation: मम my, रथेन chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, भूमिष्ठम् on the earth, रघूत्तमम् foremost of Raghus, याहि proceed, आहूय calling, भूतलम् on the ground, यातः where, महत् great, देवहितम् words of Devas, कुरु do
explanation: "Proceed quickly in my chariot to the foremost of the Raghus on the earth, where Sri Rama stands and call him to sit in the chariot as per the words of Devas."

shloka_text: इत्युक्तोदेवराजेनमातलिर्देवसारथिः ।।6.103.8।। प्रणम्यशिरसादेवंततोवचनमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: ityuktodevarājenamātalirdevasārathiḥ  praṇamyaśirasādevaṃtatovacanamabravīt |
translation: देवराजेन Lord of Devas, इति thus, उक्तः spoken, देवसारधिः charioteer of Devas, मातलिः Matali, शिरसा obedience, देवम् to Devas, प्रणम्य offering salutations, ततः then, वचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Lord of Devas having spoken that way, the charioteer of Devas offering salutations to Devas in obedience spoke these words.

shloka_text: शीघ्रंयास्यामिदेवेन्द्रसारथ्यं च करोम्यहम् ।।6.103.9।। ततोहयैश्चसम्योज्यहरितैःस्यन्दनोत्तमम् ।
transliteration: śīghraṃyāsyāmidevendrasārathyaṃ ca karomyaham  tatohayaiścasamyojyaharitaiḥsyandanottamam |
translation: देवेन्द्र Devendra, अहम् I, स्यन्दनोत्तमम् Lord of gods, हरितैः green, हयैः horses, सम्योज्य duly, ततः then, शीघ्रम् quickly, यास्यामि to you, सारथ्यं च and charioteer, करोमि will do
explanation: "O Devendra, I will do the duty of charioteer duly to the Lord of gods with green horses proceeding quickly", said the charioteer."

shloka_text: ततःकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गःकिङ्किणीशतभूषितः ।।6.103.10।। तरुणादित्यसङ्काशोवैदूर्यमयकूबरः । सदश्वैःकाञ्चनापीडैर्युक्तश्श्वेतप्रकीर्णकैः ।।6.103.11।। हरिभिःसूर्यसङ्काशैर्हेमजालविभूषितैः । रुक्मवेणुध्वज्श्रीमन्देवराजरथोवरः ।।6.103.12।। देवराजेनन्दिष्टोरथमारुह्यमातलिः । अभ्यवर्ततकाकुत्स्थमवतीर्यत्रिवष्टपात् ।।6.103.13।।
transliteration: tataḥkāñcanacitrāṅgaḥkiṅkiṇīśatabhūṣitaḥ  taruṇādityasaṅkāśovaidūryamayakūbaraḥ | sadaśvaiḥkāñcanāpīḍairyuktaśśvetaprakīrṇakaiḥ  haribhiḥsūryasaṅkāśairhemajālavibhūṣitaiḥ | rukmaveṇudhvajśrīmandevarājarathovaraḥ  devarājenandiṣṭorathamāruhyamātaliḥ | abhyavartatakākutsthamavatīryatrivaṣṭapāt
translation: ततः thereafter, देवराजेन by the Lord of Devas, सन्दिष्टः assigned, मातलिः Matali, काञ्चनचित्राङ्गः body of wheels decked with charming gold, किङ्किणीशतभूषितः fitted with hundreds of bells, तरुणआदित्यसङ्काशः shone like the early morning sun, काञ्चनापीडैः decked with gold on top, श्वेतप्रकीर्णकैः white whisks, हरिभिः green horses also, सूर्यसङ्काशैः shining like the sun, हेमजालविभूषितैः decked with golden net, सदश्वैः the horses, युक्तः fitted, उक्मवरः on golden bamboo like staff, श्रीमान् glorious, वरः foremost, देवराजरथःking of gods, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य mounted, त्रिविष्टपात् descending from heaven, अवतीर्य opposite, काकुत्स्थम् to Kakuthsa, अभ्यवर्तत went towards.
explanation: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. It was decked with charming gold wheels, body fitted with hundreds of gold bells that shone like the early morning sun, decked with gold on top, green horses with white whisks shining like the Sun, decked with golden net, the horses yoked to staff, and the flag fitted on golden bamboo staff. Descending from the chariot, like from heaven, Matali went towards Kakuthsa.

shloka_text: ततःकाञ्चनचित्राङ्गःकिङ्किणीशतभूषितः ।।6.103.10।। तरुणादित्यसङ्काशोवैदूर्यमयकूबरः । सदश्वैःकाञ्चनापीडैर्युक्तश्श्वेतप्रकीर्णकैः ।।6.103.11।। हरिभिःसूर्यसङ्काशैर्हेमजालविभूषितैः । रुक्मवेणुध्वज्श्रीमन्देवराजरथोवरः ।।6.103.12।। देवराजेनन्दिष्टोरथमारुह्यमातलिः । अभ्यवर्ततकाकुत्स्थमवतीर्यत्रिवष्टपात् ।।6.103.13।।
transliteration: tataḥkāñcanacitrāṅgaḥkiṅkiṇīśatabhūṣitaḥ  taruṇādityasaṅkāśovaidūryamayakūbaraḥ | sadaśvaiḥkāñcanāpīḍairyuktaśśvetaprakīrṇakaiḥ  haribhiḥsūryasaṅkāśairhemajālavibhūṣitaiḥ | rukmaveṇudhvajśrīmandevarājarathovaraḥ  devarājenandiṣṭorathamāruhyamātaliḥ | abhyavartatakākutsthamavatīryatrivaṣṭapāt

explanation: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. It was decked with charming gold wheels, body fitted with hundreds of gold bells that shone like the early morning sun, decked with gold on top, green horses with white whisks shining like the Sun, decked with golden net, the horses yoked to staff, and the flag fitted on golden bamboo staff. Descending from the chariot, like from heaven, Matali went towards Kakuthsa.

explanation: Thereafter, Matali brought the glorious chariot of Lord of Devas. shloka_text: अब्रवीच्चतदारामंसप्रतोदोरथेस्थितः । प्राञ्जलिर्मातलिर्वाक्यंसहस्राक्षस्यसारथिः ।।6.103.14।।
transliteration: abravīccatadārāmaṃsapratodorathesthitaḥ | prāñjalirmātalirvākyaṃsahasrākṣasyasārathiḥ
translation: तदा then, सहस्राक्षस्य thousand eyed, सारथिः charioteer, मातलिः Matali, सप्रतोदः holding the whip, रथे from the chariot, स्थितः seated, प्राञ्जलिः offered salutation with both palms, रामम् to Sri Rama, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् च spoke
explanation: Then the thousand eyed charioteer, holding the whip in hand, from the chariot, offered salutations with folded palms to Sri Rama and spoke these words.

shloka_text: सहस्राक्षेणकाकुत्थ्सरथोऽयंविजयायते । दत्तस्तवमहासत्त्वश्रीमन् शत्रुनिबर्हण ।।6.103.15।।
transliteration: sahasrākṣeṇakākutthsaratho'yaṃvijayāyate | dattastavamahāsattvaśrīman śatrunibarhaṇa
translation: महासत्त्व endowed with great prowess, श्रीमन् glorious, शत्रुनिबर्हण destroyer of enemies, काकुत्थ्स Kakuthsa's, अयम् this, रथः chariot, ते to you, विजयाय for victory, सहस्राक्षेण by the thousand eyed, तव to you, दत्तः gifted
explanation: "To you, Kakuthsa, who are endowed with great prowess, destroyer of enemies, this chariot has been sent by Indra for your victory."

shloka_text: इदमैन्द्रंमहच्चापंकवचंचानगिसन्निभम् । शराश्चादित्यसङ्काशाःशक्तिश्चविमलाशिवा ।।6.103.16।।
transliteration: idamaindraṃmahaccāpaṃkavacaṃcānagisannibham | śarāścādityasaṅkāśāḥśaktiścavimalāśivā
translation: ऐन्द्रम् Indra's, इदम् this, महत् mighty, चापम् bow, अनगिसंनिभम् shining like fire, कवचं च armour, आदित्यसङ्काशाः resembling sun, शराश्च shafts, विमला stainless, शिवा auspicious, शक्तिश्च javelin
explanation: "Here is Indra's mighty bow, armour shining like fire, shafts resembling the Sun and stainless auspicious javelin."

shloka_text: आरुह्येमंरथंवीरराक्षसंजहिरावणम् । मयासारथिनाराजन् महेन्द्रइवदानवान् ।।6.103.17।।
transliteration: āruhyemaṃrathaṃvīrarākṣasaṃjahirāvaṇam | mayāsārathinārājan mahendraivadānavān
translation: वीर heroic, राजन् king, सारथिना charioteer, मया me, इमम् this, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य mounting, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, दानवान् इव like he killed demons, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, रावणम् Ravana, जहि attack
explanation: "O heroic king! With me as charioteer, mounting this chariot, kill the Rakshasa Ravana as Mahendra killed the demons."

shloka_text: इत्युक्तःसम्परिक्रम्यरथंतमभिवाद्य च । आरुरोहतदारामोलोकान् लक्ष्मविराजयन् ।।6.103.18।।
transliteration: ityuktaḥsamparikramyarathaṃtamabhivādya ca | ārurohatadārāmolokān lakṣmavirājayan
translation: इति thus, उक्तःspoken, रामःRama, सम्परिक्रम्य going round, तम् him, रथम् chariot, अभिवाद्य च saluting, तदा then, लोकान् world, लक्ष्मsplendour, विराजयन् illumining, आरुरोह ascended
explanation: Speaking like that, Matali went round Sri Rama, and went round the chariot clockwise saluting him. Sri Rama then ascended the chariot, illuminating his splendour to the world.

shloka_text: तद्भभूवाद्भुतंयुद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । रामस्य च महाबाहोरावणस्य च रक्षसः ।।6.103.19।।
transliteration: tadbhabhūvādbhutaṃyuddhaṃtumulaṃromaharṣaṇam | rāmasya ca mahābāhorāvaṇasya ca rakṣasaḥ
translation: महाबाहोः mightyarmed, रामस्य Rama's, रक्षसः Rakshasa, रावणस्य च Ravana's, तुमुलम् severe, रोमहर्षणम् thrilling, अद्भुतम् wonderful, युद्धम् fight, तदा then, बभूव च took place
explanation: Then a wonderful, severe thrilling fight took place between Sri Rama and Ravana.

shloka_text: स गान्धर्वेणगान्धर्वंदैवंदैवेनराघवः । अस्त्रंराक्षसराजस्यजघानपरमास्त्रवित् ।।6.103.20।।
transliteration: sa gāndharveṇagāndharvaṃdaivaṃdaivenarāghavaḥ | astraṃrākṣasarājasyajaghānaparamāstravit
translation: परमास्त्रवित् highly skilled in supreme weapons, सःराघवः that Raghava, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, गान्धर्वम् Gandharvam, अस्त्रम् missile, गान्धर्वेण by Gandharva, दैवम् Deva, दैवेन and god, जघान destroyed
explanation: Raghava who was highly skilled in the use of supreme weapons destroyed that missile presided over by Gandharvas and gods, released by Ravana.

shloka_text: अस्त्रंतुपरमंघोरंराक्षसंराक्षसाधिपः । ससर्जपरमक्रुद्धःपुनरेवनिशाचरः ।।6.103.21।।
transliteration: astraṃtuparamaṃghoraṃrākṣasaṃrākṣasādhipaḥ | sasarjaparamakruddhaḥpunarevaniśācaraḥ
translation: राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, निशाचरः night ranger, परमक्रुद्धः highly furious, परमम् most घोरम् terrific, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अस्त्रम् missile, पुनरेव once again, ससर्ज discharged
explanation: The Rakshasa king, the night ranger, became highly furious and once again discharged the most terrific missile presided over by Rakshasas.

shloka_text: तेरावणधनुर्मुक्ताःशराःकाञ्चनभूषणाः । अभ्यवर्तन्तकाकुत्स्थंसर्पाभूत्वामहाविषाः ।।6.103.22।।
transliteration: terāvaṇadhanurmuktāḥśarāḥkāñcanabhūṣaṇāḥ | abhyavartantakākutsthaṃsarpābhūtvāmahāviṣāḥ
translation: रावणधनुर्मुक्ताः released from Ravana's bow, काञ्चनभूषणाः covered with gold, तेशराः those shafts, महाविषाः highly venomous, सर्पाः serpent, भूत्वा arising, काकुत्स्थम् to Kakuthsa, अभ्यवर्तन्त went near
explanation: The shafts released from Ravana's bow were covered with gold and highly venomous like serpents reached near Kakuthsa.

shloka_text: तेदीप्तवदनादीप्तंसमन्तोज्वलनंमुखैः । राममेवाभ्यवर्तन्तव्यादितास्याभयानकाः ।।6.103.23।।
transliteration: tedīptavadanādīptaṃsamantojvalanaṃmukhaiḥ | rāmamevābhyavartantavyāditāsyābhayānakāḥ
translation: दीप्तवदनाः with flaming mouths, ते those, मुखैः face, दीप्तम् glowing, ज्वलनम् fire, वमन्तः vomiting, व्यादितास्याः striking, भयानकाः frightening, राममेव towards Rama, अभ्यवर्तन्त over to
explanation: Those shafts with wide flaming mouths, vomiting fire, glowing, frightening, and striking went over to Rama.

shloka_text: तैर्वासुकिसमस्पर्शैर्दीप्तभोगैर्महाविषैः । दिशश्चसन्ततास्सर्वाप्रदिशश्चसमावृताः ।।6.103.24।।
transliteration: tairvāsukisamasparśairdīptabhogairmahāviṣaiḥ | diśaścasantatāssarvāpradiśaścasamāvṛtāḥ
translation: वासुकिसमस्पर्शैः like the Vasuki, दीप्तभोगैः flaming coils, महाविषैः huge poison, तैः those, सर्वाः all, दिशश्च quarters, सन्तताः covered, प्रदिशश्च corners, समावृताः enveloped
explanation: Flaming coils like the Vasuki, covering all quarters with poison, enveloped all over.

shloka_text: तान् दृष्टवापन्नगान् रामःसमापततआहवे । अस्त्रंगारुत्मतंघोरंप्रादुश्चक्रेभयावहम् ।।6.103.25।।
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭavāpannagān rāmaḥsamāpatataāhave | astraṃgārutmataṃghoraṃprāduścakrebhayāvaham
translation: रामः Rama, आहवे coming towards, समापततः approaching, तान् पन्नगान् those reptiles, दृष्टवा seeing, घोरम् dreadful, भयावहम् fearful, गारुत्मतम् Garuda, अस्त्रम् missile, प्रादुश्चक्रे discharged
explanation: Seeing the dreadful reptiles approaching, Rama discharged the missile presided over by Garuda.

shloka_text: तेराघवधनुर्मुक्तारुक्मपुङ्खाःशिखिप्रभाः । सुपर्णाःकाञ्चनाभूत्वाविचेरुःसर्पशत्रवः ।।6.103.26।।
transliteration: terāghavadhanurmuktārukmapuṅkhāḥśikhiprabhāḥ | suparṇāḥkāñcanābhūtvāviceruḥsarpaśatravaḥ
translation: राघवधनुर्मुक्ताः discharged from Raghava's bow, रुक्मपुङ्खाःgolden feathered eagles, शिखिप्रभाः shine of the feathers, ते those, सर्पशत्रवः reptiles and snakes, काञ्चनाः golden, सुवर्णाः all, भूत्वा arising, विचेरुःflew
explanation: By the missile discharged by Raghava those reptiles and snakes turned into golden feathered eagles and by the shine of the feathers, the reptiles flew.

shloka_text: तेतान्सर्वान् जघ्नुस्सर्परूपान्महाजवान् । सुपर्णरूपारामस्यविशिखाःकामरूपिणः ।।6.103.27।।
transliteration: tetānsarvān jaghnussarparūpānmahājavān | suparṇarūpārāmasyaviśikhāḥkāmarūpiṇaḥ
translation: रामस्य Rama's, कामरूपिणः which change form as per their will, सुपर्णरूपाः form of eagles, ते they, विशिखाः shafts, महाजवान् great speed, सर्परूपान् snake forms, सर्वान् all, तान् of them, शरान् shafts, जघ्नुः flew
explanation: Those shafts of Rama in the form of eagles which could change their form at will, destroyed the serpent forms and they flew at great speed.

shloka_text: अस्त्रेप्रतिहतेक्रुद्धोरावणोराक्षसाधिपः । अभ्यवर्षत्तदारामंघोराभिःशरवृष्टिभिः ।।6.103.28।।
transliteration: astrepratihatekruddhorāvaṇorākṣasādhipaḥ | abhyavarṣattadārāmaṃghorābhiḥśaravṛṣṭibhiḥ
translation: अस्त्र missiles, प्रतिहते knocked back, क्रुद्धः enraged, राक्षसाधिपः king of Rakshasas, तदा then, घोराभिः terrific, शरवृष्टिभिः shower of shafts, रामम् Rama, अभ्यवर्षत् covered
explanation: King of Rakshasas knocked back, became enraged and covered Rama with a terrific shower of shafts.

shloka_text: ततश्शरसहस्रेणराममक्लिष्टकारिणम् । अर्दयित्वाशरौघेणमातलिम्प्रत्यविध्यत ।।6.103.29।।
transliteration: tataśśarasahasreṇarāmamakliṣṭakāriṇam | ardayitvāśaraugheṇamātalimpratyavidhyata
translation: ततः thereafter, शरसहस्रेण by a thousand shafts, अक्लिष्टकारिणम् of unwearied action, रामम् Rama, अर्दयित्वा pierced, शरौघेण shafts, मातलिम् Matali, प्रत्यविध्यत discharged
explanation: Thereafter having showered a thousand shafts on Rama, of unwearied action, Ravana pierced Matali with shafts.

shloka_text: चिच्छेदकेतुमुद्धिश्यशरेणैकेनरावणः । पातयित्वारथोपस्थेरथात्केतुं च काञ्चनम् ।।6.103.30।। ऐन्द्रानपिजघानाश्वान्शरजालेनरावणः ।
transliteration: cicchedaketumuddhiśyaśareṇaikenarāvaṇaḥ | pātayitvārathopastherathātketuṃ ca kāñcanam  aindrānapijaghānāśvānśarajālenarāvaṇaḥ |
translation: रावणः Ravana, एकेन with one, शरेण arrow, उददिश्य felled, केतुम् staff, चिच्छेद shattered, काञ्चनम् golden, रथात् of the chariot, रथोपस्थे on the flag, पातयित्वा felled down, रावणः Ravana, शरजालेन net of arrows, ऐन्द्रान् Indra's, अश्वान् अपि horses also, जघान struck
explanation: Ravana attacked the flag post of the chariot with one arrow and felled it down. Then he released a network of arrows on Indra's horses and struck them.

shloka_text: तदृष्ट्वासुमहातत्कर्मरावणस्यदुरात्मना: । विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वाचारणादानवैस्सह ।।6.103.31।। राममार्तंतदादृष्टवासिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः । व्यथितावानरेन्द्राश्चबभूवुस्सविभीषणाः ।।6.103.32।। रामचन्द्रमसंदृष्टवाग्रस्तंरावणराहुणा ।
transliteration: tadṛṣṭvāsumahātatkarmarāvaṇasyadurātmanā: | viṣedurdevagandharvācāraṇādānavaissaha  rāmamārtaṃtadādṛṣṭavāsiddhāścaparamarṣayaḥ | vyathitāvānarendrāścababhūvussavibhīṣaṇāḥ  rāmacandramasaṃdṛṣṭavāgrastaṃrāvaṇarāhuṇā |
translation: सुमहा great, तत्कर्म action, तत that, दृष्ट्वा seeing, रावणस्य of Ravana, दुरात्मना: evil minded, तदा then, आर्तम् afflicted, रामम् to Rama, दृष्टवा on seeing, देवगन्धर्वचारणाः Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, दानवैः Danavas, सह also, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षयः foremost rsis, विषेदुः despondent, रावणराहुणा planet Rahu like Ravana, ग्रस्तम् eclipsed, रामचन्द्रमसम् like Sri Rama, दृष्टवा seeing, सविभीषणाः that Vibheeshana, वानरेन्द्राश्च Vanara leaders, व्यथिताः worried, बभूवुः became
explanation: On seeing Sri Rama afflicted by the action of evilminded Ravana, the Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, Danavas also, Siddhas and foremost rishis were despondent. Seeing the moon like Sri Rama eclipsed by planet Rahu in the form of Ravana, the Vanara leaders and Vibheeshana became worried.

shloka_text: तदृष्ट्वासुमहातत्कर्मरावणस्यदुरात्मना: । विषेदुर्देवगन्धर्वाचारणादानवैस्सह ।।6.103.31।। राममार्तंतदादृष्टवासिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः । व्यथितावानरेन्द्राश्चबभूवुस्सविभीषणाः ।।6.103.32।। रामचन्द्रमसंदृष्टवाग्रस्तंरावणराहुणा ।
transliteration: tadṛṣṭvāsumahātatkarmarāvaṇasyadurātmanā: | viṣedurdevagandharvācāraṇādānavaissaha  rāmamārtaṃtadādṛṣṭavāsiddhāścaparamarṣayaḥ | vyathitāvānarendrāścababhūvussavibhīṣaṇāḥ  rāmacandramasaṃdṛṣṭavāgrastaṃrāvaṇarāhuṇā |
translation: सुमहा great, तत्कर्म action, तत that, दृष्ट्वा seeing, रावणस्य of Ravana, दुरात्मना: evil minded, तदा then, आर्तम् afflicted, रामम् to Rama, दृष्टवा on seeing, देवगन्धर्वचारणाः Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, दानवैः Danavas, सह also, सिद्धाश्च siddhas, परमर्षयः foremost rsis, विषेदुः despondent, रावणराहुणा planet Rahu like Ravana, ग्रस्तम् eclipsed, रामचन्द्रमसम् like Sri Rama, दृष्टवा seeing, सविभीषणाः that Vibheeshana, वानरेन्द्राश्च Vanara leaders, व्यथिताः worried, बभूवुः became
explanation: On seeing Sri Rama afflicted by the action of evilminded Ravana, the Devas, Gandharvas, Charanas, Danavas also, Siddhas and foremost rishis were despondent. Seeing the moon like Sri Rama eclipsed by planet Rahu in the form of Ravana, the Vanara leaders and Vibheeshana became worried.

shloka_text: प्राजात्यं च नक्षत्रंरोहिणींकशशिनःप्रियाम् ।।6.103.33।। समाक्रम्यबुधस्तस्थौप्रजानामशुभावहः ।
transliteration: prājātyaṃ ca nakṣatraṃrohiṇīṃkaśaśinaḥpriyām  samākramyabudhastasthauprajānāmaśubhāvahaḥ |
translation: प्राजापत्यम् Prajapathi the Lord of creation, नक्षत्रम् star, शशिनः moon, प्रियाम् comes closer, रोहिणीम् Rohini, बुधः Budha, आक्रम्य takes over, प्रजानाम् people, अशुभावहः spells bad luck, तस्थौ similarly
explanation: When the planet Budha comes closer to the Rohini planet presided over by the Lord of creation, people predict bad luck.

shloka_text: सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिःप्रज्वलन्निवसागरः ।।6.103.34।। उत्पपाततदाक्रुद्धस्स्पृशन्निवदिवाकरम् ।
transliteration: sadhūmaparivṛttormiḥprajvalannivasāgaraḥ  utpapātatadākruddhasspṛśannivadivākaram |
translation: सधूमपरिवृत्तोर्मिः waves covered by mist (Dhumakethu) turning round, प्रज्वलन्निव as though going to touch the radiant sun, सागरः ocean, तदा then, क्रुद्धः enraged, दिवाकरम् sun, स्स्पृशन्निव as though to touch, उत्पपात rose high
explanation: The waves of the ocean were, as if in fury, waves covered with mist turning around as though to touch the radiant sun rose high.

shloka_text: शस्त्रवर्णस्सुपरुषोमन्दरश्मिद्दिवाकरः ।।6.103.35।। अदृश्यतकबन्धाङ्कःसंसक्तोधूमकेतुना ।
transliteration: śastravarṇassuparuṣomandaraśmiddivākaraḥ  adṛśyatakabandhāṅkaḥsaṃsaktodhūmaketunā |
translation: शस्त्रवर्णः like weapon in colour (grey), सुपरुषः devoid of radiance, मन्दरश्मि: dull in radiance, दिवाकरः sun, कबन्धाङ्कः Kabhandaka, धूमकेतुना Dhumakethu, संसक्तः combined with, अदृश्यत seemed
explanation: The Sun seemed without radiance like the colour of weapon (grey), in the form of Kabhanda (headless trunk), combined with Dhumakethu.

shloka_text: कोसलानां च नक्षत्रंव्यक्तमिन्द्राग्निदैवतम् ।।6.103.36।। आक्रम्याङ्गारकस्तस्थौविशाखामपिचाम्बरे ।
transliteration: kosalānāṃ ca nakṣatraṃvyaktamindrāgnidaivatam  ākramyāṅgārakastasthauviśākhāmapicāmbare |
translation: अम्बरे in the sky, अङ्गारकः Angaraka (Mars), ऐन्द्राग्निदैवतम् presided over by Indra and Agni, कोसलानाम् Kosala, नक्षत्रम् star, विशाखाम् Visakha, आक्रम्य united with, तस्थौ stood
explanation: In the sky, the planet Mars too stood in constellation with Visakha star presided over by gods Indra and Agni in heaven, which was propitious for the kosala kings.

shloka_text: दशास्योविंशतिभुजःप्रगृहीतशरासनः ।।6.103.37।। अदृशास्यःदशग्रीवःमैनाकःपर्वतःइव
transliteration: daśāsyoviṃśatibhujaḥpragṛhītaśarāsanaḥ  adṛśāsyaḥdaśagrīvaḥmainākaḥparvataḥiva
translation: दशास्यः ten heads, विंशतिभुजः twenty arms, प्रगृहीतशरासनः seizing hold of bow, दशग्रीवः ten headed, मैनाकःपर्वतः इव like Mynaka mountain, अदृश्यत appeared
explanation: Ravana with ten heads and twenty arms seizing his bow appeared like the Mynaka mountain.

shloka_text: निरस्यमानोरामस्तुदशग्रीवेणरक्षसा ।।6.103.38।। नाशक्नोदभिसन्धातुंसायकान्रणमूर्धनि ।
transliteration: nirasyamānorāmastudaśagrīveṇarakṣasā  nāśaknodabhisandhātuṃsāyakānraṇamūrdhani |
translation: रक्षसा Rakshasa, दशग्रीवेण with ten necks, रणमूर्धनि in the forefront of battle, निरस्यमानःnot had opportunity, रामः for Rama, सायकान् weapons, अभिसन्धातुम् even to fix, नाशक्नोत् not feasible
explanation: While Ravana with ten heads and arms was ready in the forefront of the battle, Sri Rama had no possibility to fix his arrows.

shloka_text: तस्यक्रुद्धस्यवदनंदृष्टवारामस्यधीमतः ।।6.104.1।। सर्वभूतानिवित्रेसुःप्राकम्पत च मेदिनी ।
transliteration: tasyakruddhasyavadanaṃdṛṣṭavārāmasyadhīmataḥ  sarvabhūtānivitresuḥprākampata ca medinī |
translation: क्रुद्धस्य enraged, धीमतः wise, तस्यरामस्य that Rama's, वदनम् countenance, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वभूतानि all beings, वित्रेसुः frightened, मेदिनी च on earth, प्राकम्पत were shaken
explanation: Seeing enraged wise Rama's countenance, all beings on earth were shaken in fear.
comments: Dreadful war takes place between Rama and Ravana. Celestial bodies watch the war from the sky.

shloka_text: सिंहशार्दूलान्शैलस्सञ्चचालचलद्द्रुमः । बभूवचापिक्षुभितःसमुद्रःसरिताम्पतिः ।।6.104.2।।
transliteration: siṃhaśārdūlānśailassañcacālacaladdrumaḥ | babhūvacāpikṣubhitaḥsamudraḥsaritāmpatiḥ
translation: सिंहशार्दूलवान् abode of lions and tigers, चलद्द्रुमः trees shook, शैलः mountains, सञ्चचाल, सरिताम्पतिः king of rivers, समुद्रः च and ocean, अपि also, क्षुभितः agitated, बभूव became
explanation: The mountains that were abode of lions and tigers with trees shook and the ocean, the king of rivers, was seen agitated.

shloka_text: खराश्चखरनिर्घोषागगनेपरुषाघनाः । औत्पातिकानिनर्दन्तस्समन्तात्परिचक्रमुः ।।6.104.3।।
transliteration: kharāścakharanirghoṣāgaganeparuṣāghanāḥ | autpātikāninardantassamantātparicakramuḥ
translation: खराः donkeys, खरनिर्घोषाः emitting harsh sound, परुषाः dreadful, औत्पातिकानि portentous, घनाः clouds, गगने in the sky, समन्तात् all over, परिचक्रमुः went round
explanation: Dreadful and portentous clouds went in circles all over sky looking like donkeys emitting harsh sounds.

shloka_text: रामंदृष्टवासुसङ्क्रुद्धमुत्पातांश्चैवसुदारुणान् । वित्रेसुस्सर्वभूतानिरावणस्याभवद्भयम् ।।6.104.4।।
transliteration: rāmaṃdṛṣṭavāsusaṅkruddhamutpātāṃścaivasudāruṇān | vitresussarvabhūtānirāvaṇasyābhavadbhayam
translation: सुसङ्क्रुद्धम् highly furious, रामम् Rama, सुदारुणान् very dreadful, उत्पातान् च rising up, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वभूतानि all beings, वित्रेसुः frightened, रावणस्य of Ravana, भयम् fear, अभवत् was created
explanation: Rama became highly furious, most dreadful sounds were rising up and all beings were frightened. Ravana was also afraid.

shloka_text: विमानस्थास्तदादेवागन्धर्वाश्चमहोरगाः । ऋषिदावनदैत्याश्चगरुत्मन्तश्चखेचराः ।।6.104.5।। ददृशुस्तेतदायुद्धंलोकसम्वर्तसंस्थितम् । नानाप्रहरणैर्भीमैश्शूरयोस्सम्प्रयुध्यतोः ।।6.104.6।।
transliteration: vimānasthāstadādevāgandharvāścamahoragāḥ | ṛṣidāvanadaityāścagarutmantaścakhecarāḥ  dadṛśustetadāyuddhaṃlokasamvartasaṃsthitam | nānāpraharaṇairbhīmaiśśūrayossamprayudhyatoḥ
translation: तदा then, भीमैः frightening, नानाप्रहरणैः different kinds of weapons, सम्प्रयुथ्यतोः together clashing, शूरयोः arrows, लोकसम्वर्तसंस्थितम् dissolution of the world, युद्धम् war, तदा then, विमानस्थाः from the aerial chariots, देवाः Devas, गन्धर्वाश्च Gandharvas, महोरगाः great Nagas, ऋषिदावनदैत्याश्च sages, devils and giants खेचराः birds, ते they, गरुत्मन्तश्च eagles, ददृशुः watched.
explanation: Then from the aerial chariots, Devas, Gandharvas, great Nagas, sages, devils, giants, birds, and eagles watched the duel war that went on between the heroes clashing with different kinds of frightening weapons like at the dissolution of the world.

shloka_text: विमानस्थास्तदादेवागन्धर्वाश्चमहोरगाः । ऋषिदावनदैत्याश्चगरुत्मन्तश्चखेचराः ।।6.104.5।। ददृशुस्तेतदायुद्धंलोकसम्वर्तसंस्थितम् । नानाप्रहरणैर्भीमैश्शूरयोस्सम्प्रयुध्यतोः ।।6.104.6।।

shloka_text: ऊचुस्सुरासुरास्सर्वेतदाविग्रहमागताः । प्रेक्षमाणामहर्युद्धंवाक्यंभक्त्याप्रहृष्टवत् ।।6.104.7।।
transliteration: ūcussurāsurāssarvetadāvigrahamāgatāḥ | prekṣamāṇāmaharyuddhaṃvākyaṃbhaktyāprahṛṣṭavat
translation: तदा then, महत् great, युद्धम् war, प्रेक्षमाणाः watching, सर्वे all, सुरासुराः Suras and Asuras, विग्रहम् losing control, आगताः overcome, प्रहृष्टवत् happy, भक्त्या with devotion, वाक्यम् these words, ऊचुः spoke
explanation: Then watching the great war, all the Suras, Asuras, lost control and overcome with happiness spoke these words with devotion.

shloka_text: दशग्रीवंजयेत्याहुरसुराःसमवस्थिताः । देवाराममवोचंस्तेत्वंजयेतिपुनःपुनः ।।6.104.8।।
transliteration: daśagrīvaṃjayetyāhurasurāḥsamavasthitāḥ | devārāmamavocaṃstetvaṃjayetipunaḥpunaḥ
translation: समवस्थिताः firmly established, असुराः Asura, दशग्रीवम् Ten headed, जयइति be victorious, आहुः be, ते the, देवाःDevas, त्वम् for their part, जय victory, इति thus, पुनःपुनः again and again, रामम् to Rama, आहुः be
explanation: Firmly established the Asuras uttered 'Victory to the Ten headed Ravana', and Devas for their part pronounced 'Rama be victorious' again and again.

shloka_text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरेक्रोधाद्राघवस्य स रावणः । प्रहर्तुकामोदुष्टात्मास्पृशन् प्रहरणंमहत् ।।6.104.9।। वज्रसारंमहानादंसर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् । शैलशृङ्गनिभैःकूटैश्चित्तदृष्टिभयावहम् ।।6.104.10।। सधूममिवतीक्ष्णाग्रंयुगान्ताग्निचमोपमम् । अतिरौद्रमनासाद्यंकालेनापिदुरासदम् ।।6.104.11।। त्रासनंसर्वभूतानांदारणंभेदनंतथा । प्रदीप्तमिवरोषेणशूलंजग्राहरावणः ।।6.104.12।।
transliteration: etasminnantarekrodhādrāghavasya sa rāvaṇaḥ | prahartukāmoduṣṭātmāspṛśan praharaṇaṃmahat  vajrasāraṃmahānādaṃsarvaśatrunibarhaṇam | śailaśṛṅganibhaiḥkūṭaiścittadṛṣṭibhayāvaham  sadhūmamivatīkṣṇāgraṃyugāntāgnicamopamam | atiraudramanāsādyaṃkālenāpidurāsadam  trāsanaṃsarvabhūtānāṃdāraṇaṃbhedanaṃtathā | pradīptamivaroṣeṇaśūlaṃjagrāharāvaṇaḥ
translation: एतस्मिन् in the meantime, दुष्टात्मा evil self, रावणः Ravana, सः he, रावणः Ravana, क्रोधात् angrily, राघवस्य Raghava's, प्रहर्तुकामः stroking, महत् unassailable, प्रहरणम् weapon, स्पृशन् to attack, वज्रसारम् like the thunderbolt, महानादम् loud noise, सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणम् capable of killing all enemies, शैलशृङ्गनिभैः like mountain peaks, कूटैः spikes, चित्तदृष्टिभयावहम् dreadful to think, सधूममिव like mass of smoke, तीक्ष्णाग्राम् sharp and pointed, युगान्ताग्निचमोपमम् blazing at the dissolution of the universe, अतिरौद्रम् very frightening, अनासाद्यम् difficult to hand le, कालेनापि like god of death, दुरासाद्यम् terror for all, सर्वभूतानाम् for all beings, त्रासनम् frightening, दारणम् tearing, तथा so also, भेदनम splitting, प्रदीप्तम् इव like glowing, शूलम् trident, रोषेण made one cry, जग्राह seized hold of
explanation: In the meantime, the evil self Ravana who is called so, as he makes others cry, in intense anger making loud noise, stroking an unassailable weapon which was like the thunderbolt, capable of killing all enemies, a spike which closely resembled mountain peaks, dreadful even to think, like a mass of smoke, sharp and pointed, blazing like at the dissolution of the universe, very frightening, difficult to hand le, like the god of death, a terror for all beings, frightening, tearing, splitting, glowing like trident seized hold of to attack Rama.
