shloka_text: तच्छूलंपरमक्रुद्धोमध्येजग्राहवीर्यवान् । अनेकैःसमरेश्शूरैराक्षसैःपरिवारितः ।।6.104.13।।
transliteration: tacchūlaṃparamakruddhomadhyejagrāhavīryavān | anekaiḥsamareśśūrairākṣasaiḥparivāritaḥ
translation: समरे in the battlefield, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, शूरैः heroes, अनेकैः many, परिवारितः surrounded by, वीर्यवान् valiant, परमक्रुद्धः enraged, तत् that, शूलम् trident, मध्ये in the middle, जग्राह took up
explanation: In the battlefield surrounded by Rakshasa heroes, enraged valiant Ravana took up the trident holding it in the middle.

shloka_text: समुद्यम्यमहाकायोननादयुधिभैरवम् । संरक्तनयनोरोषात्स्वसैन्यमभिहर्षयन् ।।6.104.14।।
transliteration: samudyamyamahākāyonanādayudhibhairavam | saṃraktanayanoroṣātsvasainyamabhiharṣayan
translation: महाकायः of gigantic body, समुद्यम्य raising the trident, रोषात् in anger, संरक्तनयनः red eyed, स्वसैन्यम् his army, अभिहर्षयन् excessive joy, युधि in war, भैरवम् formidable, ननाद loud noise
explanation: Gigantic Ravana, eyes turned red in anger, raising the trident made formidable noise to make his army extremely joyful in the battlefield.

shloka_text: पृथिवींचान्तरिक्षं च दिशश्चप्रदिशस्तथा । प्राकम्पयत्तदाशब्दोराक्षसेन्द्रस्यदारुणः ।।6.104.15।।
transliteration: pṛthivīṃcāntarikṣaṃ ca diśaścapradiśastathā | prākampayattadāśabdorākṣasendrasyadāruṇaḥ
translation: तदा then, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king's, दारुणः horrible, शब्धः sound, पृथिवीं च earth also, अन्तरिक्षं च even the heavens, दिशश्च quarters, तथा similarly, प्रदिशश्च corners, प्राकम्पयत् trembled
explanation: By the horrible sound made by the Rakshasa king, the earth, even the heavens, similarly the quarters and corners trembled.

shloka_text: अतिनादस्य्यदानेनतेनतस्यदुरात्मनः । सर्वभूतानिवित्रेसुस्सागरश्चप्रचुक्षुभे ।।6.104.16।।
transliteration: atinādasyyadānenatenatasyadurātmanaḥ | sarvabhūtānivitresussāgaraścapracukṣubhe
translation: अतिकायस्य of loud roar, दुरात्मनः evil minded, तस्य his, तेनवादेन by that sound, सर्वभूतानि all living beings, वित्रेसुः feared, सागरश्च even the ocean, प्रचुक्षुभे set to commotion
explanation: By the loud roar of the evilminded Ravana's sound, all living beings feared and even the ocean was set to tremble.

shloka_text: स गृहीत्वामहावीर्यश्शूलंतद्रावणोमहत् । विनद्यसुमहानादंरामंपरुषमब्रवीत् ।।6.104.17।।
transliteration: sa gṛhītvāmahāvīryaśśūlaṃtadrāvaṇomahat | vinadyasumahānādaṃrāmaṃparuṣamabravīt
translation: महावीर्यः extraordinary valour, सःhe, रावणः Ravana, महत् great, तत् शूलम् that trident, गृहीत्वा taking hold of, सुमहानादम् loud tone, विनद्य addressed, रामम् to Rama, परुषम् harshly, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Ravana who was endowed with extraordinary valour, taking hold of the trident, addressed Rama harshly in a loud tone.

shloka_text: शूलोऽयंवज्रसारस्तेरामरोषान्मयोद्यतः । तवभ्रातृसहायस्यसम्यक् प्राणान् हरिष्यति ।।6.104.18।।
transliteration: śūlo'yaṃvajrasārasterāmaroṣānmayodyataḥ | tavabhrātṛsahāyasyasamyak prāṇān hariṣyati
translation: राम Rama!, रोषात् in fury, मया my, उद्यतः taken, वज्रसारः like thunderbolt, अयंशूलः this trident, भ्रातृसहायस्य along with your brother's, तव you, प्राणान् life, सम्यक् help, हरिष्यति will take away life
explanation: "O Rama! This thunderbolt like trident taken up by me now will take away your life along with your brother's."

shloka_text: रक्षसामद्यशूराणांनिहतानांचमूमुखे । त्वांनिहत्यरणश्लाघीकरोमितरसासमम् ।।6.104.19।।
transliteration: rakṣasāmadyaśūrāṇāṃnihatānāṃcamūmukhe | tvāṃnihatyaraṇaślāghīkaromitarasāsamam
translation: रणश्लाघी commend warfare, अद्य today, तरसा quickly, त्वाम् you, निहत्य kill, चमूमुखे in the forefront of army, निहतानाम् those killed, शूराणाम् heroes, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, समम् along with, करोमि will do
explanation: "I, who commend warfare, will quickly kill you today in the forefront of the army and join you with Rakshasa heroes who were killed."

shloka_text: तिष्ठेदानींनिहमनित्वामेषशूलेनराघव । एवमुक्त्वा स चिक्षेपतच्छूलंराक्षसाधिपः ।।6.104.20।।
transliteration: tiṣṭhedānīṃnihamanitvāmeṣaśūlenarāghava | evamuktvā sa cikṣepatacchūlaṃrākṣasādhipaḥ
translation: राघव Raghava, तिष्ठ stay, एषः there, इदानीम् now itself, शूलेन with the trident, त्वाम् you, निहमनि kill, एवम् that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, सः he, राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, तत् that, शूलम् trident, चिक्षेप hurled
explanation: "O Raghava! Stay there. Right now, I will kill you with this trident." Having spoken that way, Ravana hurled the trident.

shloka_text: तद्रावणकरान्मुक्तंविद्युन्मालासमावृतम् । अष्टघण्टंमहानादंवियद्गतमशोभत ।।6.104.21।।
transliteration: tadrāvaṇakarānmuktaṃvidyunmālāsamāvṛtam | aṣṭaghaṇṭaṃmahānādaṃviyadgatamaśobhata
translation: रावणकरात् from Ravana's hand, मुक्तम् discharged, विद्युन्मालासमावृतम् with circle of lightning and glowing covered, अष्टघण्टम् eight bells, महानादम् making loud noise, तत् that, वियद्गतम् the atmosphere, अशोभत shone
explanation: The trident discharged from Ravana's hand, made circles of lightning, and covered the atmosphere with its glow and shine along with eight bells making loud sounds.

shloka_text: तच्छूलंराघवोदृष्टवाज्वलन्तंघोरदर्शनम् । ससर्जविशिखान्रामश्चापमायम्यवीर्यवान् ।।6.104.22।।
transliteration: tacchūlaṃrāghavodṛṣṭavājvalantaṃghoradarśanam | sasarjaviśikhānrāmaścāpamāyamyavīryavān
translation: राघवः Raghava, वीर्यवान् valiant, रामःRama, ज्वलन्तम् glowing, घोरदर्शनम् horrible to look at, तत् that, शूलम् trident, दृष्टवा seeing, चाप् bow, अयम्य taking up, विशिखान् number of arrows, ससर्ज loosed
explanation: Valiant Raghava, seeing the glowing trident that was horrible to look at, loosed a number of arrows at it.

shloka_text: आपतन्तंशरौघेणवारयामासराघवः । उत्पतन्तंयुगान्तानगिंजलौघैरिववासवः ।।6.104.23।।
transliteration: āpatantaṃśaraugheṇavārayāmāsarāghavaḥ | utpatantaṃyugāntānagiṃjalaughairivavāsavaḥ
translation: आपतन्तम् intercepted, राघवः by Raghava, उत्पतन्तम् coming towards, युगान्तानगिम् at the end of universal dissolution, वासवः fire, जलौघैःइव like the flow of water, शरौघेण with his arrows, वारयामास obstructed
explanation: Raghava intercepted the trident, just as the fire was obstructed by the flow of water, at the time of universal dissolution, and obstructed.

shloka_text: निर्ददाह स तान्बाणान्रामकार्मुकनिःसृतान् । रावणस्यमहान् शूलःपतङ्गानिवपावकः ।।6.104.24।।
transliteration: nirdadāha sa tānbāṇānrāmakārmukaniḥsṛtān | rāvaṇasyamahān śūlaḥpataṅgānivapāvakaḥ
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, सः that, महान् great, शूलः trident, रामकार्मुकनिःसृतान् arrows released from Rama's bow, तान् बाणान् those arrows, पावकः fire, पतङ्कानिव like moths, निर्ददाह burnt
explanation: The arrows released from Rama's bow fell on the great trident of Ravana and burnt like moths falling in fire.

shloka_text: तान्दृष्टवाभस्मसाद्भूतान्शूलसम्स्पर्शचूर्णितान् । सायकानन्तरिक्षस्थान् राघवःक्रोधमाहरत् ।।6.104.25।।
transliteration: tāndṛṣṭavābhasmasādbhūtānśūlasamsparśacūrṇitān | sāyakānantarikṣasthān rāghavaḥkrodhamāharat
translation: राघवः Raghava, शूलसम्स्पर्शचूर्णितान् trident touching the arrows and crushed to powder, अन्तरिक्षस्थान् in the sky, भस्मसाद्भूतान् reduced to ashes, तान् those, सायकान् arrows, दृष्टवा seeing, क्रोधम् anger, आहरत् was overcome
explanation: Rama was overcome with fury on seeing his arrows being crushed to powder in the sky on touching the trident and reduced to ashes.

shloka_text: स तांमातलिनानीतांशक्तिंवासवसम्मताम् । जग्राहपरमक्रुद्धोराघवोरघुनन्दनः ।।6.104.26।।
transliteration: sa tāṃmātalinānītāṃśaktiṃvāsavasammatām | jagrāhaparamakruddhorāghavoraghunandanaḥ
translation: रघुनन्दनः enhancer of joy of Raghus, सः he, राघवः Raghava, परमक्रुद्धः very angry, मातलिना Matali, आनीताम् brought by, वासवसम्मताम् built by esteemed Indra, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, जग्राह raised
explanation: Raghava, the enhancer of the joy of Raghus, lifted up the javelin brought by Matali, esteemed by Indra.

shloka_text: सातोलिताबलवताशक्तिर्घण्टाकृतस्वना । नभःप्रज्वालयामासयुगान्तोल्केवसप्रभा ।।6.104.27।।
transliteration: sātolitābalavatāśaktirghaṇṭākṛtasvanā | nabhaḥprajvālayāmāsayugāntolkevasaprabhā
translation: बलवता mighty, तोलिता lifted up, घण्टाकृतस्वना rendered sonorous by bells, साशक्तिः that javelin, सप्रभा its radiance, युगान्तोल्केव at the end of the universe, नभः sky, प्रज्वालयामास lit up sky brightly like meteor
explanation: When mighty Rama lifted up that javelin, it rendered sonorous sounds of bells and lit up the sky like a meteor at the end of the universal dissolution.

shloka_text: साक्षिप्ताराक्षसेन्द्रस्यतस्मिन्कूलेपपात ह । भिन्नःशक्त्यामहान् शूलोनिपपातहतद्युतिः ।।6.104.28।।
transliteration: sākṣiptārākṣasendrasyatasminkūlepapāta ha | bhinnaḥśaktyāmahān śūlonipapātahatadyutiḥ
translation: सा that, क्षिप्ता glowing, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king's, तस्मिन् शूले that trident, निपपात ह fell, महान् great, शूलः trident, शक्त्या with javelin, भिन्नः broken, हतद्युतिः lost its splendour, निपपात fell down
explanation: With the hurling of the javelin by Rama at the great trident of Ravana and on (the javelin) touching the trident, it was broken, lost its splendour and fell down.

shloka_text: निर्भिभेदततोबाणैर्हयानस्यमहाजवान् । रामस्त्रीक्ष्णैर्महावेगैर्भाणवद्भिरजिह्मगैः ।।6.104.29।।
transliteration: nirbhibhedatatobāṇairhayānasyamahājavān | rāmastrīkṣṇairmahāvegairbhāṇavadbhirajihmagaiḥ
translation: ततः then, रामः Rama, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, महावेगैः of great speed, बाणवद्भिः shower of arrows, अजिह्मगैः straight into, बाणैः arrows, महाजनान् multitude, अस्य its, हयान् horses, निर्भिभेद shattered
explanation: Rama then released arrows endowed with great speed, shower of multitude of arrows straight into the horses of Ravana and shattered them.

shloka_text: निर्बिभेदोरपितदारावणंनिशितैश्शरैः । राघवःपरमायत्तोललाटेपत्रतिभिस्त्रिभिः ।।6.104.30।।
transliteration: nirbibhedorapitadārāvaṇaṃniśitaiśśaraiḥ | rāghavaḥparamāyattolalāṭepatratibhistribhiḥ
translation: राघवःRaghava, तदा then, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, रावणम् Ravana's, उरसि chest, निर्बिभेद pierced, परमायत्तः with great effort, त्रिभिः three, पत्रतिभिः sharp, ललाटे forehead
explanation: Raghava pierced into the chest of Ravana sharp arrows and with great effort three sharp arrows on the forehead.

shloka_text: स शरैर्भिन्नसर्वाङ्गोगात्रप्रसृतशोणितः । राक्षसेन्द्रस्समूहस्थःफुल्लाशोकइवाबभौ ।।6.104.31।।
transliteration: sa śarairbhinnasarvāṅgogātraprasṛtaśoṇitaḥ | rākṣasendrassamūhasthaḥphullāśokaivābabhau
translation: शरैः arrows, भिन्नसर्वाङ्गः pierced all over the limbs, गात्रप्रसृतशोणितः blood flowing from limbs, सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, समूहस्थः in the gathering, फुल्लाशोकःइव like Ashoka tree, अबभौ appeared
explanation: Pierced all over the limbs with arrows, blood flowing from the limbs, he (Rakshasa king) appeared like an Ashoka tree in the gathering.

shloka_text: स तेनतुतदाक्रोधात्काकुत्स्थेनार्दितोरणे । रावणस्समरश्लाघिमहाक्रोधामुपागमत् ।।6.105.1।।
transliteration: sa tenatutadākrodhātkākutsthenārditoraṇe | rāvaṇassamaraślāghimahākrodhāmupāgamat
translation: तदा then, तेनकाकुत्स्थेन by Kakuthsa, क्रोधात् in anger, रणे in the war, आर्दितःpained, समरश्लाघि: proud of skill in warfare, सःतुरावणःhe Ravana, महाक्रोधम् very angry, उपागमत् became
explanation: Ravana, who was proud of his skill in warfare, became very angry when he was pained by Kakuthsa's arrows.
comments: Rama accuses Ravana for abducting Sita. Ravana gets confused with the rain of arrows from Rama. Seeing the situation of Ravana his charioteer takes him away from the battlefield.

shloka_text: स दीप्तनयनोरोषाच्चापमायाम्यवीर्यवान् । अभ्यर्दयत्सुसङ्कृद्धोराघवंपरमाहवे ।।6.105.2।। बाणधारसहस्रैस्तैस्सतोयदइवाम्बरात् । राघवंरावणोबाणैस्तटकमिवपूरयन् ।।6.105.3।।
transliteration: sa dīptanayanoroṣāccāpamāyāmyavīryavān | abhyardayatsusaṅkṛddhorāghavaṃparamāhave  bāṇadhārasahasraistaissatoyadaivāmbarāt | rāghavaṃrāvaṇobāṇaistaṭakamivapūrayan
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant one, वीरः hero, सः he, अमर्षात् bearing, दीप्तनयनः flaming eyes, राघवम् Raghava, सुसङ्क्रुद्ध: very angry, रोषात् furiously, चापम् bow, अपयाम्य fixing, अम्बरात् sky, सः he, तोयदःइव like water, तटाकम् इव like tank, बाणधारासहस्रैः thousands of arrows showered, राघवम् Raghava, पूरयन् fill, अभ्यर्दयत् covered
explanation: Valiant hero, Ravana, with his eyes flaming in anger, raising his bow, rained arrows at Sri Rama. He continued to rain thousands of arrows just as rain filled the tank, his arrows covered Raghava.

shloka_text: स दीप्तनयनोरोषाच्चापमायाम्यवीर्यवान् । अभ्यर्दयत्सुसङ्कृद्धोराघवंपरमाहवे ।।6.105.2।। बाणधारसहस्रैस्तैस्सतोयदइवाम्बरात् । राघवंरावणोबाणैस्तटकमिवपूरयन् ।।6.105.3।।
transliteration: sa dīptanayanoroṣāccāpamāyāmyavīryavān | abhyardayatsusaṅkṛddhorāghavaṃparamāhave  bāṇadhārasahasraistaissatoyadaivāmbarāt | rāghavaṃrāvaṇobāṇaistaṭakamivapūrayan
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant one, वीरः hero, सः he, अमर्षात् bearing, दीप्तनयनः flaming eyes, राघवम् Raghava, सुसङ्क्रुद्ध: very angry, रोषात् furiously, चापम् bow, अपयाम्य fixing, अम्बरात् sky, सः he, तोयदःइव like water, तटाकम् इव like tank, बाणधारासहस्रैः thousands of arrows showered, राघवम् Raghava, पूरयन् fill, अभ्यर्दयत् covered
explanation: Valiant hero, Ravana, with his eyes flaming in anger, raising his bow, rained arrows at Sri Rama. He continued to rain thousands of arrows just as rain filled the tank, his arrows covered Raghava.

shloka_text: पूरितःशरजालेनधनुर्मुक्तेनसम्युगे । महागिरिरिवाकम्प्यःकाकुत्स्थो न प्रकम्पते ।।6.105.4।।
transliteration: pūritaḥśarajālenadhanurmuktenasamyuge | mahāgiririvākampyaḥkākutstho na prakampate
translation: सम्युगे in the conflict, धनुर्मुक्तेन released from the bow, शरजालेन network of arrows, पूरितःcovered, काकुस्त्थ: Kakuthsa, अकम्प्यः not shaken, महागिरिरिव like a huge mountain, न प्रकम्पते not agitated
explanation: Sri Rama did not get agitated, and stood like a huge mountain, even though the network of arrows released from the bow of Ravana covered him in the conflict.

shloka_text: स शरैश्शरजालानिवारयन् समरेस्थितः । गभस्तीनिवसूर्यस्यप्रतिजग्राहवीर्यवान् ।।6.105.5।।
transliteration: sa śaraiśśarajālānivārayan samaresthitaḥ | gabhastīnivasūryasyapratijagrāhavīryavān
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, सः he, समरे in war, स्थितः stood, शरैः arrows, शरजालानि streams of arrows, वारयन् intercepting, सूर्यस्य sun's, गभस्तीनिव like rays, प्रतिजग्राह tolerated
explanation: Valiant Sri Rama stood intercepting them when streams of arrows covered him, and tolerated them like the rays of the Sun.

shloka_text: ततश्शरसहस्राणिक्षिप्रहस्तोनिशाचरः । निजघानोरसिक्रुद्धोराघवस्यमहात्मनः ।।6.105.6।।
transliteration: tataśśarasahasrāṇikṣiprahastoniśācaraḥ | nijaghānorasikruddhorāghavasyamahātmanaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, क्षिप्रहस्तः quickhanded, निशाचरः night ranger, क्रुद्धः angry, महात्मनः great soul, राघवस्य Raghava's, उरसि chest, शरसहस्राणि thousands of arrows, निजघान struck
explanation: Thereafter the quickhanded angry night ranger struck into the chest of Raghava thousands of arrows.

shloka_text: स शोणितसमादिग्धस्समरेलक्ष्मणाग्रजः । दृष्टःफुल्लइवारण्येसुमहान् किंशुकद्रुमः ।।6.105.7।।
transliteration: sa śoṇitasamādigdhassamarelakṣmaṇāgrajaḥ | dṛṣṭaḥphullaivāraṇyesumahān kiṃśukadrumaḥ
translation: समरे in the conflict, शोणितसमादिग्धः covered with blood all over, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, अरण्ये in the forest, फुल्लः in bloom, सुमहान् huge, किंशुकद्रुमः Kimsuka tree, दृष्टः looked
explanation: In that conflict Lakshmana's elder brother looked like a huge Kimsuka tree in bloom in the forest body being covered with blood all over.

shloka_text: शराभिघातसम्रब्दःसोऽभिजग्राहसायकान् । काकुत्स्थ: सुमहातेजायुगान्तादित्यतेजसः ।।6.105.8।।
transliteration: śarābhighātasamrabdaḥso'bhijagrāhasāyakān | kākutstha: sumahātejāyugāntādityatejasaḥ
translation: शराभिघातसम्रब्दः angered by the impact of arrows, सुमहातेजाः highly energetic, सःकाकुत्स्थ: that Kakuthsa, युगान्तादित्यतेजसः like the sun blazing at the end of dissolution of the universe, सायकान् shafts, अभिजग्राह took up
explanation: Endowed with extraordinary energy, Kakuthsa, angered by the impact of arrows resembled the Sun at the end of universal dissolution, took up arrows.

shloka_text: ततोऽन्योन्यंसुसम्रब्धौतावुभौरामरावणौ । शरान्धकारेसमरेनोपलक्ष्यतांतदा ।।6.105.9।।
transliteration: tato'nyonyaṃsusamrabdhautāvubhaurāmarāvaṇau | śarāndhakāresamarenopalakṣyatāṃtadā
translation: ततः then, सुसम्रब्धौ speedily releasing arrows, तौ those, उभौ both, रामरावणौ Rama and Ravana, तदा then, शरान्धकारे darkened by the arrows, समरे in the battlefield, अन्योन्यम् one another, नोपलक्ष्यताम् not able to see
explanation: Then with both Rama and Ravana speedily releasing (hail of) arrows on one another, the battlefield was darkened by arrows, and they were not able to see each other.

shloka_text: ततःक्रोधसमाविष्टोरामोदशरथात्मजः । उवाचरावणंवीरःप्रहस्यपरुषंवचः ।।6.105.10।।
transliteration: tataḥkrodhasamāviṣṭorāmodaśarathātmajaḥ | uvācarāvaṇaṃvīraḥprahasyaparuṣaṃvacaḥ
translation: ततः then, दशरथात्मजः Dasharatha's son, वीरः heroic, रामः Rama, क्रोधसमाविष्टः overcome by anger, प्रहस्य laughing, रावणम् at Ravana, परुषम् harsh, वचः words, उवाच spoke
explanation: Then Rama, the heroic son of Dasharatha, overcome by anger, laughing at Ravana, spoke these words.

shloka_text: ममभार्याजनस्थानादज्ञानाद्राक्षसाधम । हृतातेविवशायस्मात्तस्मात्त्वंनासिवीर्यवान् ।।6.105.11।।
transliteration: mamabhāryājanasthānādajñānādrākṣasādhama | hṛtātevivaśāyasmāttasmāttvaṃnāsivīryavān
translation: राक्षसाधम lowly Rakshasa, विवशा helpless, ममभार्या my wife, यस्मात् therefore, अज्ञानात् ignorantly, ते you, हृता abducted, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, वीर्यवन् valiant, नासि not
explanation: "Lowly Rakshasa! My wife was abducted by you ignorantly when she was helpless. Therefore, you are not valiant."

shloka_text: मयाविरहितांदीनांवर्तमानांमहावने । वैदेहींप्रसभंहृत्वाशूरोऽहमितिमन्यसे ।।6.105.12।।
transliteration: mayāvirahitāṃdīnāṃvartamānāṃmahāvane | vaidehīṃprasabhaṃhṛtvāśūro'hamitimanyase
translation: मया from me, विरहिताम् separated, दीनाम् desperate, महावने in the great forest, वर्तमानाम् living, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, प्रसभम् forcibly, हृत्वा abducted, अहम् I, शूरः hero, इति thus, मन्यसे you think
explanation: "Having abducted Vaidehi living in the forest by force, when she was desperate and separated from me, do you think that you are a hero?

shloka_text: स्त्रीषुशूरविनाथासुपरदाराभिमर्शक । कृत्वाकापुरुषंकर्मशूरोऽहमितिमन्यसे ।।6.105.13।।
transliteration: strīṣuśūravināthāsuparadārābhimarśaka | kṛtvākāpuruṣaṃkarmaśūro'hamitimanyase
translation: विनाथासु timid fellow, स्त्रीषु women, शूर hero, परदाराभिमर्शक laying hands on other woman, कापुरुषम् such men, कर्म action, कृत्वा having done, अहम् I, शूरःhero, इति thus, मन्यसे thinking
explanation: "Timid fellow! You having laid hands on another woman think you are a hero? You, who have done such an action, think that you are a hero?"

shloka_text: भिन्नमर्यादनिर्लज्ज चारित्रेष्वनवस्थित । दर्पान्मृत्युमुपादायशूरोऽहमितिमन्यसे ।।6.105.14।।
transliteration: bhinnamaryādanirlajja cāritreṣvanavasthita | darpānmṛtyumupādāyaśūro'hamitimanyase
translation: भिन्नमर्याद transgressed morality, निर्लज्ज shameless, चारित्रे traditional practice, अनवस्थित dissolute, दर्पात् pride, मृत्युम् death, उपादाय seeking, अहम् I, शूरः heroic, इति thus, मन्यसे think
explanation: "O shameless one! You have transgressed morality and traditional practice. You are dissolute and by your pride seeking death. You think that you are a hero!"

shloka_text: शूरेणधनदभ्रात्राबलैःसमुदितेन च । श्लाघनीयंमहत्कर्मयशस्यं च कृतंत्वया ।।6.105.15।।
transliteration: śūreṇadhanadabhrātrābalaiḥsamuditena ca | ślāghanīyaṃmahatkarmayaśasyaṃ ca kṛtaṃtvayā
translation: शूरेण hero, धनदभ्रात्रा brother of Kubera, बलैः rich in might, समुदितेन च and risen up, त्वया by you, श्लाघनीयम् laudable, यशस्यं च attained fame, महत् great, कर्म action, कृतम् performed
explanation: "By laudable great action performed by you (of abducting Sita and your penance) you have attained fame. You are a heroic brother of Kubera, rich in might."

shloka_text: उत्सेकानाभिपन्नस्यगर्हितस्याहितस्य च । कर्मणःप्राप्नुहीदानांतस्याद्यसुमहत्फलम् ।।6.105.16।।
transliteration: utsekānābhipannasyagarhitasyāhitasya ca | karmaṇaḥprāpnuhīdānāṃtasyādyasumahatphalam
translation: उत्सेकेन out of pride, अभिपन्नस्य overpowered, गर्हितस्य vanity, अहितस्य च hurtful, तस्यकर्मणः your action, सुमहत् great, फलम् result, अद्य today, इदानीम् this way, प्राप्नुहि attained
explanation: "You will attain the great result of your hurtful action, overpowered by pride and vanity today."

shloka_text: शूरोऽहमितिचात्मानमवगच्छसिदुर्मते । नैवलज्जास्तितेसीतांचौरवद्वृपकर्षतः ।।6.105.17।।
transliteration: śūro'hamiticātmānamavagacchasidurmate | naivalajjāstitesītāṃcauravadvṛpakarṣataḥ
translation: दुर्मते evil minded, आत्मानम् yourself, अहम् I, शूरःhero, इति thus, अवगच्छसि praise, चौरवत् like a thief, सीताम् Sita, व्यपकर्षतः abducting, ते to you, लज्जा shame, नैवअस्ति not stand
explanation: "O Evil minded fellow! You boast yourself as a hero, while you abducted Sita like a thief. Shame did not stand in your way."

shloka_text: यदिमत्सन्निधौसीताधर्षितास्यात्त्वयाबलात् । भ्रातरंतुखरंपश्येस्तदामत्सायकैर्हतः ।।6.105.18।।
transliteration: yadimatsannidhausītādharṣitāsyāttvayābalāt | bhrātaraṃtukharaṃpaśyestadāmatsāyakairhataḥ
translation: सीता Sita, त्वया by you, मत्सन्निधौ my presence, बलात् forcibly, धर्षिता taken, स्याद्यदि been seen, तदा then, मत्सायकैः by my arrows, हतः killed, भ्रातरम् brother, खरम् Khara, पश्येः seen
explanation: "If Sita had been seen by me forcibly taken by you in my presence, then you would have been killed by my arrows and seen your brother Khara."

shloka_text: दिष्ट्यासिममदुष्टात्मश्चक्षुर्विषयमागतः । अद्यत्वांसायकैस्तीक्ष्णैर्नयामियमसादनम् ।।6.105.19।।
transliteration: diṣṭyāsimamaduṣṭātmaścakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ | adyatvāṃsāyakaistīkṣṇairnayāmiyamasādanam
translation: दुष्टात्मन् selfish, दिष्ट्या seen now, मम by me, चक्षुर्विषयम् in my sight, आगतःअसि have come now, अद्य today, त्वाम् you, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, सायकैः by arrows, यमसादनम् abode of Yama, नयामि reach
explanation: "O selfish Ravana! Today you have come in my sight by good fortune. I shall send you to the abode of Yama with my arrows."

shloka_text: अद्यतेमच्छरैश्चिन्नंशिरोज्वलितकुण्डलम् । क्रव्यादाव्यपकर्षन्तुविकीर्णंरणपांसुषु ।।6.105.20।।
transliteration: adyatemaccharaiścinnaṃśirojvalitakuṇḍalam | kravyādāvyapakarṣantuvikīrṇaṃraṇapāṃsuṣu
translation: अद्य now, मच्छरैः by my shafts, छिन्नम् severed, रणपांसुषु in the battlefield, विकीर्णम् covered with dust, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् shining earrings, तेशिरः your head, क्रन्यादाः carnivorous animals, व्यपकर्षन्तु be dragged
explanation: "Now, let your head severed by my shafts lying in dust in the battlefield with the shining earrings be dragged by the carnivorous animals."

shloka_text: निपत्योरसिगृध्रास्तेक्षितौक्षिप्तस्यरावण । पिबन्तुरुधिरंतर्षाद्बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् ।।6.105.21।।
transliteration: nipatyorasigṛdhrāstekṣitaukṣiptasyarāvaṇa | pibanturudhiraṃtarṣādbāṇaśalyāntarotthitam
translation: रावण Ravana, क्षितौ caused to destroy, क्षिप्तस्य scattered, ते your, उरसि chest, निपत्य fallen, गृध्राः vultures, बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् by the piercing of the heads of my arrows, रुधिरम् blood, पिबन्तु drink
explanation: "Ravana! After your body is caused to destroy and scattered on the ground, let the vultures drink the blood oozing from your chest pierced by the heads of my arrows."

shloka_text: अद्यमद्बाणभिन्नस्यगतासोःपतितस्यते । कर्षन्त्वन्त्राणिपतगागरुत्मन्तइवोरगान् ।।6.105.22।।
transliteration: adyamadbāṇabhinnasyagatāsoḥpatitasyate | karṣantvantrāṇipatagāgarutmantaivoragān
translation: अद्य now, मद्बाणभिन्नस्य by my arrows splitting, गतासोः ceased of life, पतितस्य fallen, ते your, अन्त्राणि intestines, पतगाः birds, गरुत्मन्तः eagles, उरगानिव like snakes, कर्षन्तु dragging
explanation: "Let the birds tear your intestines as eagles would tear off snakes, now when your body is split and fallen, split by my arrows and ceased of life."

shloka_text: इत्येवं स वदन्वीरोरामश्शत्रुनिबर्हणः । राक्षसेन्द्रंसमीपस्थंशरवर्षैरवाकिरत् ।।6.105.23।।
transliteration: ityevaṃ sa vadanvīrorāmaśśatrunibarhaṇaḥ | rākṣasendraṃsamīpasthaṃśaravarṣairavākirat
translation: वीरः hero, शत्रुनिबर्हणः exterminator of enemies, रामः Rama, इत्येवम् in this way, वदन् speaking, समीपस्थम् nearby, राक्षसेन्द्रम् king of Rakshasas, शरवर्षैः rained arrows, अवाकिरत् covered
explanation: Speaking in this way to Ravana who was nearby, Rama the exterminator of enemies rained showers of arrows and covered.

shloka_text: बभूवद्विगुणंवीर्यंबलंहर्षश्चसंयुगे । रामस्यास्त्रबलंचैवशत्रोर्निधनकाङ्क्षिणः ।।6.105.24।।
transliteration: babhūvadviguṇaṃvīryaṃbalaṃharṣaścasaṃyuge | rāmasyāstrabalaṃcaivaśatrornidhanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
translation: संयुगे in battle, शत्रोः enemy, निधनकाङ्क्षिणः desirous of destruction, रामस्य Rama's, वीर्यम् valiance, बलम् strength, हर्षश्च enthusiasm, अस्त्रबलंचैव and strength of missiles, द्विगुणम् doubled, बभूव became
explanation: The strength, valiance, enthusiasm, and the strength of missiles of Rama, who was desirous of the destruction of the enemy, doubled.

shloka_text: प्रादुर्भभूवुरस्त्राणिसर्वाणिविदितात्मनः । प्रहर्षाच्चमहातेजाश्शीघ्रहस्ततरोऽभवत् ।।6.105.25।।
transliteration: prādurbhabhūvurastrāṇisarvāṇividitātmanaḥ | praharṣāccamahātejāśśīghrahastataro'bhavat
translation: विदितात्मनः rich in selfknowledge, सर्वाणि all, अस्त्राणि missiles, प्रादुर्भभूवुः appeared before him, महातेजाः excessive energy, प्रहर्षात् joy, शीघ्रहस्ततरः skillful with hands अभूत् became
explanation: All missiles appeared before Rama because of his richness in selfknowledge. In his excessive energy and joy the prince became more skillful with his hands.

shloka_text: शुभान्येतानिचिह्नानिविज्ञायात्मगतानिसः । भूयएवार्दयद्रामोरावणंराक्षसान्तकृत् ।।6.105.26।।
transliteration: śubhānyetānicihnānivijñāyātmagatānisaḥ | bhūyaevārdayadrāmorāvaṇaṃrākṣasāntakṛt
translation: राक्षसान्तकृत् one who can put an end to Rakshasas, सःरामः that Rama, आत्मगतानि his own past, शुभानि auspicious, एतानि all these, चिह्नानि signs, विज्ञाय knowing, रावणम् Ravana, भूयःएव more vehemently, अर्दयत् strike
explanation: Rama, who can put an end to Rakshasas, knower of his own self having experienced auspicious signs, began to strike at Ravana more vehemently.

shloka_text: हरीणांचाश्मनिकरैश्शरवर्षाच्चराघवात् । हन्यमानोदशग्रीवोविघूर्णहृदयोऽभवत् ।।6.105.27।।
transliteration: harīṇāṃcāśmanikaraiśśaravarṣāccarāghavāt | hanyamānodaśagrīvovighūrṇahṛdayo'bhavat
translation: हरीणाम् Vanaras, अश्मनिकरैः stones from their hands, राघवात् at Raghava, शरवर्षाच्च rain of shafts, हन्यमानः pained, दशग्रीवः ten headed, विघूर्णहृदयः bewildered, अभवत् became
explanation: By the stones thrown by the Vanaras and rain of shafts from Raghava, the ten headed Ravana was pained and was bewildered.

shloka_text: यदा च शस्त्रंनारेभे न चकर्षशरासनम् । नास्यप्रत्यकरोवदीर्यंविक्लबेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.105.28।।
transliteration: yadā ca śastraṃnārebhe na cakarṣaśarāsanam | nāsyapratyakarovadīryaṃviklabenāntarātmanā
translation: यदा like that, शस्त्रम् missiles, नारेभे not started, शरासनम् arrows, न चकर्ष not able to stretch bow, विक्लबेन confused, अन्तरात्मना mentally, अस्य his, वीर्यम् valiance, न प्रत्यकरोत् not oppose
explanation: Being confused mentally, Ravana did not start his arrows, nor stretch his bow, nor was able to use missiles and was not able to oppose Rama's valour.

shloka_text: क्षिप्ताःश्चाशुशरास्तेनशस्त्राणिविविधानि च । मरणार्थायवर्तन्तेमृत्युकालोऽभ्यवर्तत ।।6.105.29।।
transliteration: kṣiptāḥścāśuśarāstenaśastrāṇivividhāni ca | maraṇārthāyavartantemṛtyukālo'bhyavartata
translation: तेन by the, क्षिप्ताः destroyed, शराः arrows, विविधानि several, शस्त्राणि च missiles, मरणार्थाय death as objective, वर्तन्ते unable to act, मृत्युकालः time of death, अभ्यवर्ततunable to do
explanation: Ravana's arrows of several kinds being destroyed, perceiving that his death is objective Rama's missiles, and that the time of death appeared, he was unable to act.

shloka_text: सूतस्तुरथनेतास्यतदवस्थंनिरीक्ष्यतम् । शनैर्युद्धासम्भ्रान्तोरथंतस्यापवाहयत् ।।6.105.30।।
transliteration: sūtasturathanetāsyatadavasthaṃnirīkṣyatam | śanairyuddhāsambhrāntorathaṃtasyāpavāhayat
translation: अस्य his, रथनेता charioteer, सूतस्तु Sutha, तदवस्थम् that condition, तम् him, निरीक्ष्य observing, असम्भ्रान्तः quietly, शनैः slowly, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, युद्धात् from the battlefield, अपवाहयत् withdrew
explanation: Observing his (Ravana's) condition, the charioteer quietly, slowly withdrew his chariot from the battlefield.

shloka_text: सतुमोहात्सुसङ्क्रुद्धःकृतान्तबलचोदितः । क्रोधसंरक्तनयनोरावणंसूतमब्रवीत् ।।6.106.1।।
transliteration: satumohātsusaṅkruddhaḥkṛtāntabalacoditaḥ | krodhasaṃraktanayanorāvaṇaṃsūtamabravīt
translation: मोहात् deluded, सुसङ्क्रुद्धः enraged, कृतान्तबलचोदितः by force of destiny, सःरावणः that Ravana, क्रोधसंरक्तनयनः eyes turned red in anger, सूतम् charioteer, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Enraged out of delusion, by force of destiny, Ravana's eyes turned red in anger and spoke to his charioteer.
comments: Ravana reproaches the charioteer. After satisfying his master the charioteer drives Ravana to the battlefield.

shloka_text: हीनवीर्यमिवाशक्तंपौरुषेणविवर्जितम् । भीरुंलघुमिवासत्त्वंविहीनमिवतेजसा ।।6.106.2।। विमुक्तमिवमायाभिरस्त्रैरिवबहिष्कृतम् । मामवज्ञायदुर्बुद्धेस्वयाबुद्ध्याविचेष्टसे ।।6.106.3।।
transliteration: hīnavīryamivāśaktaṃpauruṣeṇavivarjitam | bhīruṃlaghumivāsattvaṃvihīnamivatejasā  vimuktamivamāyābhirastrairivabahiṣkṛtam | māmavajñāyadurbuddhesvayābuddhyāviceṣṭase
translation: दुर्बुद्धे dull fellow, अशक्तम् not capable, पौरुषेय in manliness, विवर्जितम् powerless, हीनवीर्यमिव deficient in valour, भीरुम् timid, असत्त्वम् incapable, लघुमिव petty, तेजसा energy, विहीनमिव devoid of, मायाभिः not know conjuring tricks, विमुमिव abandoned like, अस्त्रै: weapons, बहिष्कृतम् इव like driven out, माम् me, अवज्ञाय not knowing, स्वया your own way, बुद्ध्या discretion, विचेष्टसे foolishly
explanation: "You dullard! Disdaining me as not capable, lacking manliness, powerless, deficient in valour, timid, incapable, petty, devoid of energy, not knowing conjuring tricks, abandoned weapons, driven out, you act not knowing me in your own way foolishly using your discretion."

shloka_text: हीनवीर्यमिवाशक्तंपौरुषेणविवर्जितम् । भीरुंलघुमिवासत्त्वंविहीनमिवतेजसा ।।6.106.2।। विमुक्तमिवमायाभिरस्त्रैरिवबहिष्कृतम् । मामवज्ञायदुर्बुद्धेस्वयाबुद्ध्याविचेष्टसे ।।6.106.3।।
transliteration: hīnavīryamivāśaktaṃpauruṣeṇavivarjitam | bhīruṃlaghumivāsattvaṃvihīnamivatejasā  vimuktamivamāyābhirastrairivabahiṣkṛtam | māmavajñāyadurbuddhesvayābuddhyāviceṣṭase
translation: दुर्बुद्धे dull fellow, अशक्तम् not capable, पौरुषेय in manliness, विवर्जितम् powerless, हीनवीर्यमिव deficient in valour, भीरुम् timid, असत्त्वम् incapable, लघुमिव petty, तेजसा energy, विहीनमिव devoid of, मायाभिः not know conjuring tricks, विमुमिव abandoned like, अस्त्रै: weapons, बहिष्कृतम् इव like driven out, माम् me, अवज्ञाय not knowing, स्वया your own way, बुद्ध्या discretion, विचेष्टसे foolishly
explanation: "You dullard! Disdaining me as not capable, lacking manliness, powerless, deficient in valour, timid, incapable, petty, devoid of energy, not knowing conjuring tricks, abandoned weapons, driven out, you act not knowing me in your own way foolishly using your discretion."

shloka_text: किमर्थंमामवज्ञायमच्छन्दमनवेक्ष्य च । त्वयाशत्रुसमक्षंमेरथोऽयमपवाहितः ।।6.106.4।।
transliteration: kimarthaṃmāmavajñāyamacchandamanavekṣya ca | tvayāśatrusamakṣaṃmeratho'yamapavāhitaḥ
translation: शत्रुसमक्षं enemy presence, मे my अवज्ञाय, not knowing, मच्छन्दम् my opinion, अनवेक्ष्य च belittling, अयम् I, मेरथः my chariot, किमर्थम् for What reason, अपवाहितः removed by you
explanation: Not knowing my opinion, for what reason have you removed my chariot in the presence of my enemy, belittling me?

shloka_text: त्वयाद्यहिममानार्य चिरकालसमार्जितम् । यशोवीर्यं च तेजश्चप्रत्ययश्चविनाशितः ।।6.106.5।।
transliteration: tvayādyahimamānārya cirakālasamārjitam | yaśovīryaṃ ca tejaścapratyayaścavināśitaḥ
translation: अनार्य evil minded, अद्य today, त्वया by you, मम me, चिरकालसमार्जितम् earned over a long period, यशः fame, वीर्यम् valiance, तेजश्च glory, प्रत्ययश्च bravery, विनशत्रोः has been wiped out
explanation: "O evil minded one! My fame, glory, valiance and bravery earned over a long period has been wiped out by you."

shloka_text: प्रख्यातवीर्यस्यरञ्जनीयस्यविक्रमैः । पश्यतोयुद्धलुब्धोऽहंकृतंकापुरुषस्त्वया ।।6.106.6।।
transliteration: prakhyātavīryasyarañjanīyasyavikramaiḥ | paśyatoyuddhalubdho'haṃkṛtaṃkāpuruṣastvayā
translation: प्रख्यातवीर्यस्य valour is known widely, विक्रमैः bravery, रञ्जनीयस्य one who is to be praised, शत्रोः adversary, पश्यतः as I was looking, त्वया by you, युद्धलुब्दः lover of war, अहम् I, कापुरुषः timid, कृतः did
explanation: "While my adversary's valour is widely known, you brought me back like a timid one, while I love war, while I am to be praised in the presence of my enemy."

shloka_text: यस्त्वंरथमिदंमोहान्नचेद्वहसिदुर्मते । सत्योऽप्रतितर्कोमेपरेणत्वमुपस्कृतः ।।6.106.7।।
transliteration: yastvaṃrathamidaṃmohānnacedvahasidurmate | satyo'pratitarkomepareṇatvamupaskṛtaḥ
translation: दुर्मते evil minded, यःत्वम् you are, इदंरथम् this chariot, मोहात् out of delusion, न वहसिचेत् not willing to drive, अयम् I, प्रतितर्कः perversion, सत्यःtruly, त्वम् you, परेण by the enemy, उपस्कृतःare influenced
explanation: "O Evil minded one! If out of delusion you are not willing to drive, truly you are influenced by the enemy."

shloka_text: न हितद्विद्यतेकर्मसुहृदोहितकाङ्क्षिणः । रिपूणांसदृशंत्वेतद्यतत्त्वयैतदनुष्ठितम् ।।6.106.8।।
transliteration: na hitadvidyatekarmasuhṛdohitakāṅkṣiṇaḥ | ripūṇāṃsadṛśaṃtvetadyatattvayaitadanuṣṭhitam
translation: त्वया by you, यत् that which, एतत् all this, अनुष्ठितम् followed, एतत् this, रिपूणाम् enemy's, सदृशम् not befitting, तत् that, हितकाङ्क्षिणः desiring benefit, सुहृदः with good heart, कर्म action, न विद्यतेहि do not know
explanation: What has been done by you is not befitting, this is What an enemy should have done. Being good at heart you have done What is good for enemy.

shloka_text: निवर्तयरथंशीघ्रंयावन्नापैतिमेरिपुः । यदिवाध्युषितोऽसित्वंस्मर्यतेयदिमेगुणः ।।6.106.9।।
transliteration: nivartayarathaṃśīghraṃyāvannāpaitimeripuḥ | yadivādhyuṣito'sitvaṃsmaryateyadimeguṇaḥ
translation: त्वम् your, अध्युषितः lived with me for long, असियदि if you, मे my, गुणः virtues, यदिस्मर्यते if you remember, मेरिपुः my enemy, यावत् all that, नापैति by the way, शीघ्रम् quickly, रथम् chariot, निवर्तय take back
explanation: "If you remember that you lived long with me and know my virtues, quickly turn back the chariot before my adversary with draws.

shloka_text: एवंपुरुषमुक्तस्तुहितबुद्धिबुद्धिना । अब्रवीद्रावणंसूतोहितंसानुनयंवचः ।।6.106.10।।
transliteration: evaṃpuruṣamuktastuhitabuddhibuddhinā | abravīdrāvaṇaṃsūtohitaṃsānunayaṃvacaḥ
translation: अबुद्धिना insensitive, एवम् in that way, परुषम् harsh, उक्तः spoken, हितबुद्धि: beneficial advice, सूतः charioteer, रावणम् to Ravana, सानुनयम् friendly, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: When the insensitive Ravana spoke harshly in that manner, to the charioteer who was wishing his benefit, he spoke in friendly language to Ravana.

shloka_text: न भीतोऽस्मि न मूढोऽस्मिनोपजप्तोऽस्मिशत्रुभिः । न प्रमत्तो न निःस्नेहोविस्मृता न च सत्क्रिया ।।6.106.11।।
transliteration: na bhīto'smi na mūḍho'sminopajapto'smiśatrubhiḥ | na pramatto na niḥsnehovismṛtā na ca satkriyā
translation: भीतः fearing, नास्मि me not, मूढः foolish, न अस्मि am not, शत्रुभिः enemy also, उपजप्तः won by them, न अस्मि not me, प्रमत्तः negligent, न not, निःस्नेहः friendliness, न not, सत्क्रिया च good deeds also, न not
explanation: "I was not fearing, nor foolish, not won by the enemy, not negligent also, not lacking friendliness and not forgetting good deeds done by you."

shloka_text: मयातुहितकामेवयशश्चपरिरक्षता । स्नेहप्रसन्नमनसाहितमित्यप्रियंकृतम् ।।6.106.12।।
transliteration: mayātuhitakāmevayaśaścaparirakṣatā | snehaprasannamanasāhitamityapriyaṃkṛtam
translation: हितकामेन wishing your welfare, यशश्च fame, परिरक्षता to protect, स्नेहप्रसन्नमनसा with friendly and pleasant feeling, मया by me, हितम् इति that which is good for you, अप्रियम् unpleasant, कृतम् action
explanation: Wishing your welfare, for your fame and to protect you with a friendly and pleasant feeling I did that which is good for you. You are unpleasant about this action.

shloka_text: नास्मिन्नर्थेमहाराज त्वंमांप्रियहितेरतम् । कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्योदोषतोगन्तुमर्हसि ।।6.106.13।।
transliteration: nāsminnarthemahārāja tvaṃmāṃpriyahiteratam | kaścillaghurivānāryodoṣatogantumarhasi
translation: महाराज O king, प्रियहिते with good intention, रतम् remain, माम् me, अस्मिन् I, अर्थे solicit, त्वम् you, कश्चित् indeed, लघुः petty, अनार्यःइव like an unworthy, दोषतः by mistake, गन्तुम् I wish you, न अर्हसि ought not
explanation: "O King! I who wish your welfare ought not to be blamed like an unworthy and pettyminded person by mistake."

shloka_text: श्रूयतांप्रतिदास्यामियन्निमित्तंमयारथः । नदीवेगइवामंभोभिेसंयुगेविनिवर्तितः ।।6.106.14।।
transliteration: śrūyatāṃpratidāsyāmiyannimittaṃmayārathaḥ | nadīvegaivāmaṃbhobhiesaṃyugevinivartitaḥ
translation: इवामंभोभिे into ocean like, नदीवेगःइव like speeding river, संयुगे in war, रथः chariot, यन्निमित्तम् for that reason, विनिवर्तितः taken back, प्रतिदास्यामि will answer you, श्रूयताम् please listen
explanation: "O yes! I will answer you. Please listen. like the river entering the ocean speedily is diverted, I have taken back the chariot from the battle.

shloka_text: श्रमंतवावगच्छामिमहतारणकर्मणा । न हितेवीर्यसौमुख्यंप्रकर्षंवोपधारये ।।6.106.15।।
transliteration: śramaṃtavāvagacchāmimahatāraṇakarmaṇā | na hitevīryasaumukhyaṃprakarṣaṃvopadhāraye
translation: महता great, रणकर्मणा in the task of battle, तव your, श्रमम् strenuous work, अवगच्छामि took cognizance of, ते your, वीर्यसौमुख्यम् valiance, प्रकर्षंवा or superiority, नोपधारये no exhibition
explanation: "Great Ravana! After the strenuous task in the battle, there was no exhibition of your valour, and I did not cognize any superiority in your action."

shloka_text: रथोद्वहनखिन्नाश्चभग्नामेरथवाजिनः । दीनाघर्मपरिश्रान्तागावोवर्षहताइव ।।6.106.16।।
transliteration: rathodvahanakhinnāścabhagnāmerathavājinaḥ | dīnāgharmapariśrāntāgāvovarṣahatāiva
translation: मे my, रथवाजिनः chariot horses, रथोद्वहनखिन्नाः exhausted by dragging, भग्नाः broken, वर्षहताः lashed by rain, गावःइव like cows, घर्मपरिश्रान्ताः worn out with the heat of the sun, दीनाः desperate
explanation: "The horses of my chariot were exhausted by dragging, broken down, worn out by the hot sun, and desperate like cows lashed by rain."

shloka_text: निमित्तानि च भूयिष्ठंयानिप्रादुर्भवन्तिनः । तेषुतेष्वभिपन्नेषुलक्ष्याम्यप्रदक्षिणम् ।।6.106.17।।
transliteration: nimittāni ca bhūyiṣṭhaṃyāniprādurbhavantinaḥ | teṣuteṣvabhipanneṣulakṣyāmyapradakṣiṇam
translation: नः not, यानि those, निमित्तानि portents, भूयिष्ठम् many, प्रादुर्भवन्ति manifesting, अभिपन्नेषु seeing, तेषुतेषु again and again, अप्रदक्षिणम् in the reverse direction, लक्ष्यामि observable
explanation: "Those portents manifesting again and again, that I am seeing, all of them are in the reverse direction (meaning not proptitious)."

shloka_text: देशकालौ च विज्ञेयौलक्षणानीङ्गितानि च । दैन्यंहर्षश्चखेदश्चरथिनश्चबलाबलम् ।।6.106.18।।
transliteration: deśakālau ca vijñeyaulakṣaṇānīṅgitāni ca | dainyaṃharṣaścakhedaścarathinaścabalābalam
translation: बलाबलम् strength and weakness, देशकालौ च in time and place, विज्ञेयौ good and evil, लक्षणानि signs, इङ्गितानि च omens, रथिनः warrior's, दैन्यम् depression, हर्षश्च liveliness, खेदश्च sorrow also
explanation: "Propitious and unpropitious, time and place, good and evil signs and omens, depression and liveliness of the warrior as well as strength and weakness of the one in the chariot must be ascertained."

shloka_text: स्थलनिम्नानिभूमेश्चसमानिविषमाणि च । युद्धकालश्चविज्ञेयःपरस्यान्तरदर्शनम् ।।6.106.19।।
transliteration: sthalanimnānibhūmeścasamāniviṣamāṇi ca | yuddhakālaścavijñeyaḥparasyāntaradarśanam
translation: भूमेः, earth's स्थलनिम्नानि ups and downs, समानि stable, विषमाणि च difficult locations, युद्धकालश्च right time of war, विज्ञेयः should be known, परस्य of the enemy, अन्तरदर्शनम् inner weakness
explanation: "The earths' ups and downs, evenness and ruggedness, difficult locations, the right time and place for war should be known in advance and the inner weakness of the enemy also to be known."

shloka_text: उपयानापयाने च स्थानंप्रत्यपसर्पणम् । सर्वमेतद्रथस्थेनज्ञेयंरथकुटुम्भिना ।।6.106.20।।
transliteration: upayānāpayāne ca sthānaṃpratyapasarpaṇam | sarvametadrathasthenajñeyaṃrathakuṭumbhinā
translation: रथस्थेन by the charioteer, रथकुटुम्भिना to hold or advance, उपयानापयाने च coming near or retreating, स्थानम् in seated, प्रत्यपसर्पणम् to return back, एतत् all this, सर्वम् everything, ज्ञेयम् to be known
explanation: "To hold the chariot or advance, to go near the (enemy) or retreat, to return back or advance, everything should be known to the charioteer."

shloka_text: तवविश्रामहेतोस्तुतथैषांरथवाजिनाम् । रौद्रंवर्जयताखेदंक्षमंकृतमिदंमया ।।6.106.21।।
transliteration: tavaviśrāmahetostutathaiṣāṃrathavājinām | raudraṃvarjayatākhedaṃkṣamaṃkṛtamidaṃmayā
translation: तव your, विश्रामहेतोः reason is to give rest, तथा in that way, एषाम् all these, रथवाजिनाम् horses of the chariot, रौद्रम् terrific feat, खेदम् fatigue, वर्जयता to relieve, मया by me, इदम् in this way, क्षमम् deserve to be excused, कृतम् for the action
explanation: "The reason for retreating in this way is to give you rest and relieve the horses from the terrible feat and fatigue. I deserve to be excused for this action."

shloka_text: स्वेच्छयान मयावीररथोऽयमपवाहितः । भर्तृस्नेहपरीतेनमयेदंयत्कृतंप्रभो ।।6.106.22।।
transliteration: svecchayāna mayāvīraratho'yamapavāhitaḥ | bhartṛsnehaparītenamayedaṃyatkṛtaṃprabho
translation: वीर heroic, प्रभो Lord, अयम् I, रथः chariot, मया by me, स्वेच्छया independently, न अपवाहितः not brought back, मया by me, यत् that, कृतम् action, इदम् thus, भर्तृस्नेहपरीतेन with affection to the master
explanation: "Heroic Lord! I have not brought back this chariot independently (without thinking). I have acted in friendliness to the master (to give rest) not otherwise."

shloka_text: आज्ञापययथातत्त्वंवक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन । तत्करिष्याम्यहंवीरगतानृण्येनचेतसा ।।6.106.23।।
transliteration: ājñāpayayathātattvaṃvakṣyasyariniṣūdana | tatkariṣyāmyahaṃvīragatānṛṇyenacetasā
translation: अरिषूदन, tamer of enemies वीर warrior, आज्ञापय orders, त्वम् your, तत् like that, यथा so also, वक्ष्यसि order, तत् that, अहम् I, गतानृण्येन in accordance with, चेतसा wholeheartedly, करिष्यामि will carry out
explanation: "O Tamer of enemies! Order now and in that way, I shall carry out your order in accordance with you wholeheartedly."

shloka_text: सन्तुष्टस्तेनवाक्येनरावणस्तस्यसारथेः । प्रशस्यैनंबहुविधंयुद्धलुब्धोऽब्रवीदिदम् ।।6.106.24।।
transliteration: santuṣṭastenavākyenarāvaṇastasyasāratheḥ | praśasyainaṃbahuvidhaṃyuddhalubdho'bravīdidam
translation: तस्यसारथेः by that charioteer, तेनवाक्येन by those words, सन्तुष्टः fully satisfied, रावणः Ravana, एनम् in that way, बहुविधम् many ways, प्रशस्य praised, युद्धलुब्दः desiring to wage war, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Ravana was fully satisfied with the words of the charioteer. He praised the charioteer in many ways and spoke like this desiring to wage war.

shloka_text: रथंशीघ्रमिदंसूतराघवाभिमुखंनय । नाहत्वासमरेशत्रून्निवर्तिष्यतिरावणः ।।6.106.25।।
transliteration: rathaṃśīghramidaṃsūtarāghavābhimukhaṃnaya | nāhatvāsamareśatrūnnivartiṣyatirāvaṇaḥ
translation: सूत charioteer इमम् this, रथम् chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, राघवाभिमुखम् towards Raghava, नय as a policy, रावणः Ravana, समरे in battle, शत्रून् enemy, अहत्वा without putting an end, न निवर्तिष्यति never returns back
explanation: "Quickly drive the chariot towards Raghava. As a policy, Ravana would never turn back on the battlefield without putting an end to the enemy."

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वाततस्तुष्टोरावणोराक्षसेश्वरः । ददौतस्यशुभंह्येकंहस्ताभरणमुत्तमम् ।।6.106.26।। श्रुत्वारावणवाक्यानिसारथिस्सन्यवर्तत ।
transliteration: evamuktvātatastuṣṭorāvaṇorākṣaseśvaraḥ | dadautasyaśubhaṃhyekaṃhastābharaṇamuttamam  śrutvārāvaṇavākyānisārathissanyavartata |
translation: तुष्टःराक्षसेश्वरः fully satisfied, रावणः Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, तस्य his, शुभम् auspicious, एकम् one, उत्तमम् excellent, हस्ताभरणम् ornament of the hand ददौ presented, सःसारथिः to the charioteer, रावणवाक्यानि Ravana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, न्यवर्तत turned
explanation: Fully satisfied with Charioteer's words, Ravana bestowed him with an excellent auspicious ornament of the hand. On hearing Ravana's words, the charioteer advanced the chariot.

shloka_text: ततोयुद्धपरिश्रान्तंसमरेचिन्तयास्थितम् । रावणंचाग्रतोदृष्टवायुद्धायसमुपस्थितम् ।।6.107.1।। दैवतैश्चसमागम्यद्रष्टुमभ्यागतोरणम् । उपागम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्योभगवान् ऋषिः ।।6.107.2।।
transliteration: tatoyuddhapariśrāntaṃsamarecintayāsthitam | rāvaṇaṃcāgratodṛṣṭavāyuddhāyasamupasthitam  daivataiścasamāgamyadraṣṭumabhyāgatoraṇam | upāgamyābravīdrāmamagastyobhagavān ṛṣiḥ
translation: ततः then, दैवतैः Devatas, समागम्य collected together, रणम् war, द्रष्टुम् seeing, अभ्यागतः came, भगवान् god, अगस्त्यऋषिः Agastya Risi, युद्धपरिश्रान्तम् duly prepared, युद्धाय for war, समुपस्थितम् come and stood, रावणम् Ravana, अग्रतः before, दृष्टवा seeing, समरे in war, चिन्तया thinking, स्थितम् stood, रामम् Rama, उपगम्य had come, अब्रवीत् spoke as follows
explanation: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.
comments: Sage Agastya arrives and advises Rama to chant 'Aditya Hrdaya' verses in praise of Sun god for success.

shloka_text: ततोयुद्धपरिश्रान्तंसमरेचिन्तयास्थितम् । रावणंचाग्रतोदृष्टवायुद्धायसमुपस्थितम् ।।6.107.1।। दैवतैश्चसमागम्यद्रष्टुमभ्यागतोरणम् । उपागम्याब्रवीद्राममगस्त्योभगवान् ऋषिः ।।6.107.2।।
transliteration: tatoyuddhapariśrāntaṃsamarecintayāsthitam | rāvaṇaṃcāgratodṛṣṭavāyuddhāyasamupasthitam  daivataiścasamāgamyadraṣṭumabhyāgatoraṇam | upāgamyābravīdrāmamagastyobhagavān ṛṣiḥ
translation: ततः then, दैवतैः Devatas, समागम्य collected together, रणम् war, द्रष्टुम् seeing, अभ्यागतः came, भगवान् god, अगस्त्यऋषिः Agastya Risi, युद्धपरिश्रान्तम् duly prepared, युद्धाय for war, समुपस्थितम् come and stood, रावणम् Ravana, अग्रतः before, दृष्टवा seeing, समरे in war, चिन्तया thinking, स्थितम् stood, रामम् Rama, उपगम्य had come, अब्रवीत् spoke as follows
explanation: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.
comments: Sage Agastya arrives and advises Rama to chant 'Aditya Hrdaya' verses in praise of Sun god for success.

shloka_text: राम राम महाबाहो शृणुगुह्यंसनातनम् । येनसर्वानरीस्वत्ससमरेविजयिष्यसे ।।6.107.3।।
transliteration: rāma rāma mahābāho śṛṇuguhyaṃsanātanam | yenasarvānarīsvatsasamarevijayiṣyase
translation: महाबाहो mighty armed, रामराम Rama Rama, सनातनम् eternal, गुह्यम् secret, शृणु hear, वत्स dear, येन because, समरे in war, सर्वान् all, अरीन् enemies, विजयिष्यसे which will enable you to win
explanation: "O mighty armed Sri Rama! Dear, hear this eternal secret (mantra) which will enable you to win all the enemies in war."

shloka_text: आदित्यहृदयंपुण्यंसर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् । जयावहंजपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यंपरमंशिवम् ।।6.107.4।। सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यंसर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम् ।।6.107.5।।
transliteration: ādityahṛdayaṃpuṇyaṃsarvaśatruvināśanam | jayāvahaṃjapennityamakṣayyaṃparamaṃśivam  sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃsarvapāpapraṇāśanam | cintāśokapraśamanamāyurvardhanamuttamam
translation: पुण्यम् sacred, सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् which can destroy all enemies, जयावहम् bring victory, अक्षय्यम् eternal, परमंशिवम् very auspicious, सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यम् supremely blessed for all and prolongs life, सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्root out sins, चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनम् remove anxiety, उत्तमम् excellent, आयुर्वर्थनम् prolongs life, आदित्यहृदयम् Aditya Hridayam, नित्यम् always, जपेत् bring victory
explanation: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.

shloka_text: आदित्यहृदयंपुण्यंसर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् । जयावहंजपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यंपरमंशिवम् ।।6.107.4।। सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यंसर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम् ।।6.107.5।।
transliteration: ādityahṛdayaṃpuṇyaṃsarvaśatruvināśanam | jayāvahaṃjapennityamakṣayyaṃparamaṃśivam  sarvamaṅgalamaṅgalyaṃsarvapāpapraṇāśanam | cintāśokapraśamanamāyurvardhanamuttamam
translation: पुण्यम् sacred, सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् which can destroy all enemies, जयावहम् bring victory, अक्षय्यम् eternal, परमंशिवम् very auspicious, सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यम् supremely blessed for all and prolongs life, सर्वपापप्रणाशनम्root out sins, चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनम् remove anxiety, उत्तमम् excellent, आयुर्वर्थनम् prolongs life, आदित्यहृदयम् Aditya Hridayam, नित्यम् always, जपेत् bring victory
explanation: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.

shloka_text: रस्मीमन्तंसमुद्यन्तंदेवासुरनमस्कृतम् । पूजयस्वविवस्त्वन्तंभास्करंभुवनेश्वरम् ।।6.107.6।।
transliteration: rasmīmantaṃsamudyantaṃdevāsuranamaskṛtam | pūjayasvavivastvantaṃbhāskaraṃbhuvaneśvaram
translation: रस्मीमन्तम् crowned with rays, समुद्यन्तम् rising up at the horizon, देवासुरनमस्कृत्य greeted by gods and demons, विवस्वन्तम् bring light, भास्करम् sun god, भुवनेश्वरम् embodiment of all gods, पूजयस्वworship
explanation: "You worship the Sun God, crowned with rays rising up at the horizon, greeted by all gods and demons, who brings light to all and who is the embodiment of all gods."

shloka_text: सर्वदेवात्मकोह्येषतेजस्वीरस्मीभावनः । एषदेवासुरगणान्लोकान्पातिगभस्तिभिः ।।6.107.7।।
transliteration: sarvadevātmakohyeṣatejasvīrasmībhāvanaḥ | eṣadevāsuragaṇānlokānpātigabhastibhiḥ
translation: एषः he is, सर्वदेवात्मकः self in all, तेजस्वी glorious, रस्मीभावनः by his rays, एषः he in that way, गभस्तिभिः ray of light, देवासुरगणान् for gods and suras, लोकान् for the world, पाति Lord
explanation: "He is the self in all, glorious, he sustains by his rays of light, the gods, suras and the whole world. He is the Lord of all.

shloka_text: एषब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्चशिवःस्कन्धःप्रजापतिः । महेन्द्रोधनदःकालोयमःसोमोह्यपांपतिः ।।6.107.8।।
transliteration: eṣabrahmā ca viṣṇuścaśivaḥskandhaḥprajāpatiḥ | mahendrodhanadaḥkāloyamaḥsomohyapāṃpatiḥ
translation: एषः in the same way, ब्रह्मा च Brahma, the creator, विष्णुश्च Vishnu also, शिवः Siva also, स्कन्धः Skanda, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, महेन्द्र Mahendra, धनदः Kubera, कालः Time spirit, यमः Yama, सोमः Soma, अपांपतिः Varuna
explanation: "In the same way, he is the body of Brahma the creator, he is Vishnu also, Shiva also, S Kanda, Prajapati, Mahendra, Kubera, time spirit, Yama, Soma, and Varuna also.

shloka_text: पितरोवसवस्साध्याअश्विनौमरुतोमनुः । वायुर्वह्निःप्रजाःप्राणऋतुकर्ताप्रभाकरः ।।6.107.9।।
transliteration: pitarovasavassādhyāaśvinaumarutomanuḥ | vāyurvahniḥprajāḥprāṇaṛtukartāprabhākaraḥ
translation: पितरः manes, वसवः Vasava, साध्याः Sadhyas, अश्विनौ Aswinis, मरुतः Marutha, मनुः Manu, वायुः Wind god, वह्निः god of fire, प्रजाः for beings, प्राणः life, ऋतुकर्ता god of seasons, प्रभाकरः Sun god
explanation: "He is the god of manes, Vasava, Sadhayas, Aswins, Marutha, Manu, wind god, fire god, life of all beings and god of all seasons.

shloka_text: आदित्यःसवितासूर्यःखगःपूषागभस्तिमान् । सुवर्णसदृशोभानुर्हिरण्यरेतादिवाकरः ।।6.107.10।।
transliteration: ādityaḥsavitāsūryaḥkhagaḥpūṣāgabhastimān | suvarṇasadṛśobhānurhiraṇyaretādivākaraḥ
translation: आदित्यः Aditya, सविता Savitha, सूर्यः Sun, खगः sky, पूषा sustainer, गभस्तिमान् rays of light, सुवर्णसदृशः of golden effulgence, भानुः Bhanu, हिरण्यरेताः shining with golden rays, दिवाकरः Sun god
explanation: "You are the son of Aditi, the sungod, creator Savitha, the courser in the heavens, the sustainer, the possessor of golden rays, Bhanu, shining with golden rays, the Sun god.

shloka_text: हरिदश्वस्सहस्रार्चिस्सप्तसप्तिर्मरीचिमान् । तिमिरोन्मथनश्शम्भुस्त्वष्टामार्तण्डकोऽंशुमान् ।।6.107.11।।
transliteration: haridaśvassahasrārcissaptasaptirmarīcimān | timironmathanaśśambhustvaṣṭāmārtaṇḍako'ṃśumān
translation: हरिदश्वः possessor of green horses, सहस्रार्चिः of thousand rays, सप्तसप्तिः having horse Sapta, मरीचिमान् destroyer of darkness, तिमिरोन्मथनः mitigator of the suffering of devotees, शम्भु: giver of happiness, त्वष्टा destroyer of all names and forms, मार्तण्डकः the infuser of life in the cosmic egg, अंशुमान् all pervading
explanation: "You are the possessor of seven green horses, having a thousand rays, having horse Sapta, destroyer of darkness, mitigator of the suffering of all devotees, giver of happiness, destroyer of all names and forms, the infuser of life in the cosmic egg and having the allpervading rays.

shloka_text: हिरण्यगर्भश्शिशिरस्तपनोभास्करोरविः । अग्निगर्भोऽदितेःपुत्रःशङ्घश्शिशिरनाशनः ।।6.107.12।।
transliteration: hiraṇyagarbhaśśiśirastapanobhāskaroraviḥ | agnigarbho'diteḥputraḥśaṅghaśśiśiranāśanaḥ
translation: हिरण्यगर्भः having golden cosmic egg in the womb, शिशिरः cool, तपनः purifier, भास्करः ruler of all, रविः bringer of day, अग्निगर्भः Bears dissolution in the womb, अदितेः son of Aditi, पुत्रः son, शङ्खः bliss personified, शिशिरनाशनः destroyer of cold
explanation: "You have the golden cosmic egg in the womb, you are cool, you are the purifier, the ruler of all, bringer of day, who Bears the fire of dissolution in the womb. You are the son of Aditi, blissful personified and destroyer of cold.

shloka_text: व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदीऋग्यजुस्सामपारगः । घनवृष्टिरपांमित्रोविन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः ।।6.107.13।।
transliteration: vyomanāthastamobhedīṛgyajussāmapāragaḥ | ghanavṛṣṭirapāṃmitrovindhyavīthīplavaṅgamaḥ
translation: व्योमनाथः Lord of the sky,, तमोभेदी dispeller of darkness, ऋग्यजुसामपारगः the master of the three Vedas, Rig, Yajur and Sama vedas, घनवृष्टिः sender of rain, अपाम् of water, मित्रः friend, विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः courser of the path of Vindhya swiftly
explanation: "You are the Lord of the sky, dispeller of darkness, the master of the three VedasRig, Yajur and Sama, the sender of rain, the friend of water and the courser of the path of Vindhya swiftly.

shloka_text: आतपीमण्डलेमृत्युःपिङ्गलस्सर्वतापनः । कविर्विश्वोमहातेजारक्तस्सर्वभवोद्भव: ।।6.107.14।।
transliteration: ātapīmaṇḍalemṛtyuḥpiṅgalassarvatāpanaḥ | kavirviśvomahātejāraktassarvabhavodbhava:
translation: आतपी possessor of heat, मण्डले circle of rays, मृत्युः killer of all enemies, पिङ्गलः tawny, सर्वतापनः destroyer of all, कविः creator, विश्वः omniscient, महातेजाः resplendant, रक्तः lover of all devotees, सर्वभवोद्भवः source of all evolutes
explanation: "You are the possessor of heat, adorned with a circle of rays. You are killer of all enemies, tawny destroyer of all, omniscient, lover of all devotees and source of all evolutes.

shloka_text: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपोविश्वभावनः । तेजसामपितेजस्वीद्वादशात्मन्नमोऽस्तुते ।।6.107.15।।
transliteration: nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmadhipoviśvabhāvanaḥ | tejasāmapitejasvīdvādaśātmannamo'stute
translation: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणाम् stars, planets, विश्वभावनः creator of all, तेजसामपि resplendent, तेजस्वी among the splendid, द्वादशात्मन् of twelve faces, ते you, नमः hail, अस्तु to you
explanation: "You are the Lord of all stars and planets. You are the creator of all, resplendent among the splendid, the twelve faces of twelve months. Hail to you.

shloka_text: नमःपूर्वायगिरयेपश्चिमायाद्रयेनमः । ज्योतिर्गणानांपतयेदिनाधिपतयेनमः ।।6.107.16।।
transliteration: namaḥpūrvāyagirayepaścimāyādrayenamaḥ | jyotirgaṇānāṃpatayedinādhipatayenamaḥ
translation: पूर्वायगिरये on the east mountain, नमः hail to you, पश्चिमायअद्रये setting in the west, नमः hail to you, दिनाधिपतयेः Lord of luminaries, नमः hail to you
explanation: "Hail to you, rising on the east mountain, setting in the west. Hail to the Lord of all luminaries.

shloka_text: जयायजयभद्रायहर्यश्वायनमोनमः । नमोनमस्सहस्रांशोआदित्यायनमोनमः ।।6.107.17।।
transliteration: jayāyajayabhadrāyaharyaśvāyanamonamaḥ | namonamassahasrāṃśoādityāyanamonamaḥ
translation: जयाय giver of victory, जयभद्राय joy born of victory, हर्यश्वाय god having green horses, नमःनमः hail to you hail to you, आदित्याय Aditya, नमःनमः namaskar, namaskar
explanation: "Namaskar, Namaskar to the giver of victory, joy born of victory, god having green horses. Hail to you Aditya.

shloka_text: नमउग्रायवीरायसारङ्गायनमोनमः । नमःपद्मप्रबोधायमार्ताण्डायनमोऽस्तुते ।।6.107.18।।
transliteration: namaugrāyavīrāyasāraṅgāyanamonamaḥ | namaḥpadmaprabodhāyamārtāṇḍāyanamo'stute
translation: उग्राय of terrible form, वीराय valiant, नमः hail to you, सारङ्गाय denoted by syllable AUM, नमःनमः namaskar namaskar, पद्मप्रबोधाय awakener of lotus, नमः namaskar, मार्ताण्डाय the fierce one, ते to you, नमः namaskar, अस्तु be
explanation: "Hail to you of terrible form, of valiant one, denoted by the syllable 'AUM'. Namaskar to the awakener of lotuses. Namaskar to the fierce one.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशायसूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे । भास्वतेसर्वभक्षायरौद्रायवपुषेनमः ।।6.107.19।।
transliteration: brahmeśānācyuteśāyasūryāyādityavarcase | bhāsvatesarvabhakṣāyaraudrāyavapuṣenamaḥ
translation: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, सूर्याय Sun god, आदित्यवर्चसे the spiritual light in dwelling, भास्वते in solar orbit, सर्वभक्षाय consumer of all, रौद्रायवपुषे appearing in the form of Rudra, नमः namaskar
explanation: "Namskar to you, the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, to you the Sun god, the spiritual dwelling light in solar orbit, the consumer of all appearing in the form of Rudra.

shloka_text: तमोघ्नायहिमघ्नायशत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने । कृतघ्नघ्नायदेवायज्योतिषांपतयेनमः ।।6.107.20।।
transliteration: tamoghnāyahimaghnāyaśatrughnāyāmitātmane | kṛtaghnaghnāyadevāyajyotiṣāṃpatayenamaḥ
translation: तमोघ्नाय dispeller of darkness, हिमघ्नाय dispeller of cold, शत्रुघ्नाय dispeller of enemies, अमितात्मने whose extent is immeasurable, कृतघ्नघ्नाय destroyer of the ungrateful, देवाय god, ज्योतिषाम् ruler of lights, पतये Lord of all, नमः namaskar
explanation: "You are the dispeller of darkness, dispeller of cold, dispeller of enemies, your extent is immeasurable. You are the destroyer of the ungrateful, the ruler of lights, the Lord of all and namaskar to you.

shloka_text: तप्तचामीकराभायहरयेविश्मकर्मणे । नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नायरुचयेलोकसाक्षिणे।।1.107.21।।
transliteration: taptacāmīkarābhāyaharayeviśmakarmaṇe | namastamobhinighnāyarucayelokasākṣiṇe
translation: तप्तचामीकराभाय possessing lustre of pure gold, हरये dispeller of ignorance,, विश्वकर्मण architect of the universe, तमोभिनिघ्नाय splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, रुचये splendor, लोकसाक्षिणे witnessor of all actions in the world, नमः namaskar
explanation: "Namaskar to one possessing the lustre of pure gold, dispeller of darkness, architect of the universe, splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, witnessor of all actions in the world.

shloka_text: नाशयत्येषवैभूतंतदेवसृजतिप्रभुः । पायत्येषतपत्येषवर्षत्येष गभस्तिभिः ।1.107.22।।
transliteration: nāśayatyeṣavaibhūtaṃtadevasṛjatiprabhuḥ | pāyatyeṣatapatyeṣavarṣatyeṣa gabhastibhiḥ |1.107.22||
translation: प्रभुः Lord, एषःचै being so, भूतम् beings, नाशयति destroys, तदेव this god, सृजति creates, एषः he alone, गभस्तिभिः radiates, पायति thirst, एषः he alone, तपति heats, एषः he alone, वर्षति rains
explanation: "Being a creator and destroyer of the world, this Sun god alone radiates, creates thirst by heat and rains to relieve.

shloka_text: एषसुप्तेषुजागर्तिभूतेषुपरिनिष्ठितः । एषचैवाग्निहोत्रं च फलंचैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम् ।।6.107.23।।
transliteration: eṣasupteṣujāgartibhūteṣupariniṣṭhitaḥ | eṣacaivāgnihotraṃ ca phalaṃcaivāgnihotriṇām
translation: एषः he alone, भूतेषु among beings, सुप्तेषु in sleep, परिनिष्ठितः pervades, जागर्ति awake, एषःचैव he alone, अग्निहोत्रं च is fire sacrifice, अग्निहोत्रिणाम् of fire sacrifice, फलं च fruits
explanation: "He alone pervades the created beings and remains awake in sleep. He alone is the fire sacrifice as well as the fruits obtained from fire sacrifice.

shloka_text: वेदश्चक्रतवश्चैवक्रतूनांफलमेव च । यानिकृत्यानिलोकेषुसर्वेषुपरमप्रभुः ।।6.107.24।।
transliteration: vedaścakratavaścaivakratūnāṃphalameva ca | yānikṛtyānilokeṣusarveṣuparamaprabhuḥ
translation: वेदश्च vedas, क्रतवश्चैव sacrifices, क्रतूनाम् of the sacrifices, फलमेव च results, सर्वेषु all, लोकेषु in the worlds, यानि he alone, कृत्यानि of all actions, परमप्रभुः supreme controller
explanation: "He is all vedas, as well as all the sacrifices as also the fruits of all sacrifices. He is the supreme controller of all actions in all worlds.

shloka_text: एनमापत्सुकृच्छ्रेषुकान्तारेषुभयेषु च । कीर्तयन्पुरुषःकश्चिनावसीदतिराघव ।।6.107.25।।
transliteration: enamāpatsukṛcchreṣukāntāreṣubhayeṣu ca | kīrtayanpuruṣaḥkaścināvasīdatirāghava
translation: राघव Raghava, एनम् any one, आपत्सु in straits, कृच्छ्रेषु in difficulties, कान्तारेषु in the woods, भयेषु in times of fear, कीर्तयन् praise, पुरुषः men, कश्चित् surely, नावसीदति will experience grief
explanation: "O Raghava! Anyone praying to him will surely not experience grief in straits, in difficulties, in the woods and in times of fear.

shloka_text: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रोदेवदेवंजगत्पतिम् । एतत्त्रिगुणितंजप्त्वायुद्धेषुविजयिष्यसि ।।6.107.26।।
transliteration: pūjayasvainamekāgrodevadevaṃjagatpatim | etattriguṇitaṃjaptvāyuddheṣuvijayiṣyasi
translation: जगत्पतिम् Lord of the universe, देवदेवम् Lord of Lords, एनम् him alone, एकाग्रः with concentration, पूजयस्व if you offer prayers, एतत् by that, त्रिगुणितम् three times of the day, जप्त्वा chant, युद्धेषु in war, विजयिष्यसि will attain victory
explanation: "Worship the Lord of the universe, the Lord of Lords. Worship him alone with concentration of mind, three times of the day by chanting his name. You will attain victory in war."

shloka_text: अस्मिन् क्षणेमहाबाहोरावणंत्वंवधिष्यसि । एवमुक्त्वाततोऽगस्त्योजगाम स यथागतम् ।।6.107.27।।
transliteration: asmin kṣaṇemahābāhorāvaṇaṃtvaṃvadhiṣyasi | evamuktvātato'gastyojagāma sa yathāgatam
translation: महाबाहो mighty armed, अस्मिन् your, क्षणे this very moment, थ्वम् you, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्यसि will kill, अगस्त्यः Agastya, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, यथागतम् left in the same way जगाम went
explanation: Agastya having spoken in that way to the mighty armed Rama to worship the Sun God and assuring him that the very moment he will be able to kill Ravana, left in the same way.

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वामहातेजानष्टशोकोऽभवत्तदा । धारयामाससुप्रीतोराघवःप्रयतात्मवान् ।।6.107.28।।
transliteration: etacchrutvāmahātejānaṣṭaśoko'bhavattadā | dhārayāmāsasuprītorāghavaḥprayatātmavān
translation: तदा then, महातेजः extraordinary energy, एतत् being, श्रुत्वा having heard, नष्टशोकः stopped worry, अभवत् became, राघवः Raghava, सुप्रीतः very affectionately, प्रयतात्मवान् greatly delighted, धारयमास remembered and chanted Aditya in his mind
explanation: Then Rama endowed with extra ordinary energy having heard Agastya, was very delighted and stopped worry. He remembered Aditya and chanted in his mind.

shloka_text: आदित्यंप्रेक्ष्यजप्त्वातुपरंहर्षमवाप्तवान् । त्रिराचम्यशुचिर्भूत्वाधनुरादायवीर्यवान् ।।6.107.29।। रावणंप्रेक्ष्यहृष्टात्मायुद्धार्थंसमुपागमत् । सर्वयत्नेनमहतावधेतस्यधृतोऽभवत् ।।6.107.30।।
transliteration: ādityaṃprekṣyajaptvātuparaṃharṣamavāptavān | trirācamyaśucirbhūtvādhanurādāyavīryavān  rāvaṇaṃprekṣyahṛṣṭātmāyuddhārthaṃsamupāgamat | sarvayatnenamahatāvadhetasyadhṛto'bhavat
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, आदित्यम् Aditya, प्रेक्ष्य looking, त्रिः three times, आचम्य sipping water, शुचिः clean, भूत्वा with devotion, जप्त्वा chanted, परम् supreme, हर्षम् delight, अवाप्तवान् getting purified, धनुः bow, आदाय took up, रावणम् Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य fixing his eyes, हृष्टात्मा delighted, युद्धार्थम् for the war, समुपागमत् advanced, महता great, सर्वयत्नेन with allout effort, तस्य his, वधे destruction, धृतः determined, भवत् became
explanation: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.

shloka_text: आदित्यंप्रेक्ष्यजप्त्वातुपरंहर्षमवाप्तवान् । त्रिराचम्यशुचिर्भूत्वाधनुरादायवीर्यवान् ।।6.107.29।। रावणंप्रेक्ष्यहृष्टात्मायुद्धार्थंसमुपागमत् । सर्वयत्नेनमहतावधेतस्यधृतोऽभवत् ।।6.107.30।।

explanation: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.

shloka_text: स रथंसारथिःहृष्टंपरसैन्यप्रधर्षणम् । गन्धर्वनगराकारंसमुच्छ्रितपाताकिनम् ।।6.108.1।। युक्तंपरमसम्पन्नैर्वजिभिर्हेममालिभिः । युद्धोपकरणैःपूर्णंपताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ।।6.108.2।। ग्रसन्तमिवचाकाशंनादयन्तंवसुन्धराम् । प्रणाशंपरनैन्यानांस्वनैन्यस्यप्रहर्षणम् ।।6.108.3।। रावणस्यरथंक्षिप्रंचोदयामाससारथिः ।
transliteration: sa rathaṃsārathiḥhṛṣṭaṃparasainyapradharṣaṇam | gandharvanagarākāraṃsamucchritapātākinam  yuktaṃparamasampannairvajibhirhemamālibhiḥ | yuddhopakaraṇaiḥpūrṇaṃpatākādhvajamālinīm  grasantamivacākāśaṃnādayantaṃvasundharām | praṇāśaṃparanainyānāṃsvanainyasyapraharṣaṇam  rāvaṇasyarathaṃkṣipraṃcodayāmāsasārathiḥ |
translation: सारथिः charioteer, हृष्टः delighted, परसैन्यध्रर्षणम् which can destroy enemy's army, गन्धर्वनगराकारम् like the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, समुच्छ्रितपताकिनम् with rows of excellent flags, परमसम्पन्नैः richly endowed, हेममालिभिः gold chains, वाजिभिः horses, युक्तम् best at work, युद्धोपकरणैः well equipped with implements for war, पूर्णम् round, पताकाध्वजमालिनम् flag posts as if touching आकाशम् the sky, ग्रसन्तमिव as if filling space, वसुन्धराम् earth, नादयन्तम् resounding, परसैन्यानाम् enemy army, प्रणाशम् crushing, स्वसैन्यस्य own army, प्रहर्षणम् happy, रावणस्यरथम् Ravana's chariot, क्षिप्रम् with speed, चोदयामास drove
explanation: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. It had rows of excellent flags, richly endowed, like the best piece of artwork. It was fixed with flag posts in rows touching the sky and filling space. It was yoked to excellent horses adorned with gold chains and equipped with implements for war. The earth was resounding as it was driven as if to crush the enemy's army and its own army was happy.
comments: Ravana beholds evil portents over Lanka and his chariot indicating his fall. Rama alerts Matali to be on guard. Rama and Ravana fight facing each other releasing powerful arrows. Celestial bodies and sages watch the fight eager to see the end of Ravana.

explanation: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. It was yoked to excellent horses adorned with gold chains and equipped with implements for war. The earth was resounding as it was driven as if to crush the enemy's army and its own army was happy.
