It was yoked to excellent horses adorned with gold chains and equipped with implements for war. The earth was resounding as it was driven as if to crush the enemy's army and its own army was happy.
comments: Ravana beholds evil portents over Lanka and his chariot indicating his fall. Rama alerts Matali to be on guard. Rama and Ravana fight facing each other releasing powerful arrows. Celestial bodies and sages watch the fight eager to see the end of Ravana.

shloka_text: समापतन्तंसहसास्वनवन्तंमहाध्वजम् ।।6.108.4।। रथंराक्षसराजस्यनरराजोददर्श ह । कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तंयुक्तंरौद्रेणवर्चसा ।।6.108.5।। दीप्यमानमिवाकाशेविमानंसूर्यवर्चसं । तडित्पताकागहनंदर्शितेन्द्रायुधप्रभम् ।।6.108.6।।
transliteration: samāpatantaṃsahasāsvanavantaṃmahādhvajam  rathaṃrākṣasarājasyanararājodadarśa ha | kṛṣṇavājisamāyuktaṃyuktaṃraudreṇavarcasā  dīpyamānamivākāśevimānaṃsūryavarcasaṃ | taḍitpatākāgahanaṃdarśitendrāyudhaprabham
translation: स्वनवन्तम् bells making sounds, महाध्वजम् huge flag post, कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तम् yoked to dark horses, रौद्रेण enraged, वर्चसा splendor, युक्तम् fixed, आकाशे sky, दीप्यमानम् glowing, विमानमिव like the aerial chariot, सूर्यवर्चसम् bright like sun, तडित्पताकागहनम् shining in the sky, दर्शितेन्द्रायुथप्रभम् displaying its splendor, सहसा with force, आपतन्तम् cloud with water, तम् from, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, रथम् chariot, नरराजः king of humans, ददर्श ह saw
explanation: The chariot bells fixed to the huge flag post were making sounds, yoked to dark horses, and was shining with splendor with rage. It was glowing like a bright sun in the sky displaying its splendor, like the aerial chariot. It looked like a cloud holding water, releasing water of arrows from Rakshasa king's bow. The king of humans saw this chariot.

shloka_text: समापतन्तंसहसास्वनवन्तंमहाध्वजम् ।।6.108.4।। रथंराक्षसराजस्यनरराजोददर्श ह । कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तंयुक्तंरौद्रेणवर्चसा ।।6.108.5।। दीप्यमानमिवाकाशेविमानंसूर्यवर्चसं । तडित्पताकागहनंदर्शितेन्द्रायुधप्रभम् ।।6.108.6।।
transliteration: samāpatantaṃsahasāsvanavantaṃmahādhvajam  rathaṃrākṣasarājasyanararājodadarśa ha | kṛṣṇavājisamāyuktaṃyuktaṃraudreṇavarcasā  dīpyamānamivākāśevimānaṃsūryavarcasaṃ | taḍitpatākāgahanaṃdarśitendrāyudhaprabham
translation: स्वनवन्तम् bells making sounds, महाध्वजम् huge flag post, कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तम् yoked to dark horses, रौद्रेण enraged, वर्चसा splendor, युक्तम् fixed, आकाशे sky, दीप्यमानम् glowing, विमानमिव like the aerial chariot, सूर्यवर्चसम् bright like sun, तडित्पताकागहनम् shining in the sky, दर्शितेन्द्रायुथप्रभम् displaying its splendor, सहसा with force, आपतन्तम् cloud with water, तम् from, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, रथम् chariot, नरराजः king of humans, ददर्श ह saw
explanation: The chariot bells fixed to the huge flag post were making sounds, yoked to dark horses, and was shining with splendor with rage. It was glowing like a bright sun in the sky displaying its splendor, like the aerial chariot. It looked like a cloud holding water, releasing water of arrows from Rakshasa king's bow. The king of humans saw this chariot.

shloka_text: समापतन्तंसहसास्वनवन्तंमहाध्वजम् ।।6.108.4।। रथंराक्षसराजस्यनरराजोददर्श ह । कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तंयुक्तंरौद्रेणवर्चसा ।।6.108.5।। दीप्यमानमिवाकाशेविमानंसूर्यवर्चसं । तडित्पताकागहनंदर्शितेन्द्रायुधप्रभम् ।।6.108.6।।
transliteration: samāpatantaṃsahasāsvanavantaṃmahādhvajam  rathaṃrākṣasarājasyanararājodadarśa ha | kṛṣṇavājisamāyuktaṃyuktaṃraudreṇavarcasā  dīpyamānamivākāśevimānaṃsūryavarcasaṃ | taḍitpatākāgahanaṃdarśitendrāyudhaprabham
translation: स्वनवन्तम् bells making sounds, महाध्वजम् huge flag post, कृष्णवाजिसमायुक्तम् yoked to dark horses, रौद्रेण enraged, वर्चसा splendor, युक्तम् fixed, आकाशे sky, दीप्यमानम् glowing, विमानमिव like the aerial chariot, सूर्यवर्चसम् bright like sun, तडित्पताकागहनम् shining in the sky, दर्शितेन्द्रायुथप्रभम् displaying its splendor, सहसा with force, आपतन्तम् cloud with water, तम् from, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, रथम् chariot, नरराजः king of humans, ददर्श ह saw
explanation: The chariot bells fixed to the huge flag post were making sounds, yoked to dark horses, and was shining with splendor with rage. It was glowing like a bright sun in the sky displaying its splendor, like the aerial chariot. It looked like a cloud holding water, releasing water of arrows from Rakshasa king's bow. The king of humans saw this chariot.

shloka_text: शराधाराविमुञ्चन्तंधारासारमिवाम्बुदम् । तंदृष्टवामेघसङ्काशमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.7।। गिरेर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्यदीर्यतस्सदृशस्वनम् । विस्पारयन्वैवेगेनबालचन्द्रानतंधनुः ।।6.108.8।। उवाचसारथिंरामंसहस्राक्षस्यमातलिम् ।
transliteration: śarādhārāvimuñcantaṃdhārāsāramivāmbudam | taṃdṛṣṭavāmeghasaṅkāśamāpatantaṃrathaṃripoḥ  girervajrābhimṛṣṭasyadīryatassadṛśasvanam | vispārayanvaivegenabālacandrānataṃdhanuḥ  uvācasārathiṃrāmaṃsahasrākṣasyamātalim |
translation: शरधाराः flow of arrows, विमुञ्चन्तम् released from, धारासारमिवा like the flow of water, अम्बुदमिव like rain water cloud, मेघसङ्काशम् from the clouds, वज्राभिमृष्टस्य struck by thunderbolt, दीर्यतः broken, गिरेः mountain, सदृशस्वनम् like sound of mountain, आपतन्तम् cloud, तम् him, रथम् chariot, दृष्टवा seeing, रामः Rama, बालचन्द्रानतम् crescent shaped like the young moon, धनुः bow, वेगेन with speed, विस्फारयन् stretching, सहस्राक्षस्यसारथिम् Indra's charioteer, मातलिम् Matali, उवाच spoke
explanation: The flow of arrows (from Ravana) released from the chariot were seen by Rama like the flow of water from rain clouds. Seeing that, Sri Rama made terrific sounds by stretching his bow to crescent shape, and it was as if a mountain struck by thunderbolt had broken and resounding and seeing Matali, charioteer of Indra, Sri Rama spoke as follows.

shloka_text: शराधाराविमुञ्चन्तंधारासारमिवाम्बुदम् । तंदृष्टवामेघसङ्काशमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.7।। गिरेर्वज्राभिमृष्टस्यदीर्यतस्सदृशस्वनम् । विस्पारयन्वैवेगेनबालचन्द्रानतंधनुः ।।6.108.8।। उवाचसारथिंरामंसहस्राक्षस्यमातलिम् ।
transliteration: śarādhārāvimuñcantaṃdhārāsāramivāmbudam | taṃdṛṣṭavāmeghasaṅkāśamāpatantaṃrathaṃripoḥ  girervajrābhimṛṣṭasyadīryatassadṛśasvanam | vispārayanvaivegenabālacandrānataṃdhanuḥ  uvācasārathiṃrāmaṃsahasrākṣasyamātalim |
translation: शरधाराः flow of arrows, विमुञ्चन्तम् released from, धारासारमिवा like the flow of water, अम्बुदमिव like rain water cloud, मेघसङ्काशम् from the clouds, वज्राभिमृष्टस्य struck by thunderbolt, दीर्यतः broken, गिरेः mountain, सदृशस्वनम् like sound of mountain, आपतन्तम् cloud, तम् him, रथम् chariot, दृष्टवा seeing, रामः Rama, बालचन्द्रानतम् crescent shaped like the young moon, धनुः bow, वेगेन with speed, विस्फारयन् stretching, सहस्राक्षस्यसारथिम् Indra's charioteer, मातलिम् Matali, उवाच spoke
explanation: The flow of arrows (from Ravana) released from the chariot were seen by Rama like the flow of water from rain clouds. Seeing that, Sri Rama made terrific sounds by stretching his bow to crescent shape, and it was as if a mountain struck by thunderbolt had broken and resounding and seeing Matali, charioteer of Indra, Sri Rama spoke as follows.

shloka_text: मातलेपश्यसम्रद्धमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.9।। यथापसव्यंपततावेगेनमहतापुनः । समरेहन्तुमात्मानंतथानेनकृतामतिः ।।6.108.10।।
transliteration: mātalepaśyasamraddhamāpatantaṃrathaṃripoḥ  yathāpasavyaṃpatatāvegenamahatāpunaḥ | samarehantumātmānaṃtathānenakṛtāmatiḥ
translation: मातले Matali, सम्रद्धम् hurrying, आपतन्तम् darting forward, रिपोः enemy, रथम् chariot, पश्य seeing, अपसव्यम् in reverse direction, महता great, वेगेन with speed, पुनः once again, पतता causing a fall, समरे in war, आत्मानम् himself, हन्तुम् to kill, यथा that way, तथानेन like that, मतिः mind, कृता strikes me
explanation: "Matali! the enemy's chariot is darting forward hurriedly. See him coming in the reverse direction with great speed once again. It strikes my mind that he is surely causing his fall."

shloka_text: मातलेपश्यसम्रद्धमापतन्तंरथंरिपोः ।।6.108.9।। यथापसव्यंपततावेगेनमहतापुनः । समरेहन्तुमात्मानंतथानेनकृतामतिः ।।6.108.10।।
transliteration: mātalepaśyasamraddhamāpatantaṃrathaṃripoḥ  yathāpasavyaṃpatatāvegenamahatāpunaḥ | samarehantumātmānaṃtathānenakṛtāmatiḥ
translation: मातले Matali, सम्रद्धम् hurrying, आपतन्तम् darting forward, रिपोः enemy, रथम् chariot, पश्य seeing, अपसव्यम् in reverse direction, महता great, वेगेन with speed, पुनः once again, पतता causing a fall, समरे in war, आत्मानम् himself, हन्तुम् to kill, यथा that way, तथानेन like that, मतिः mind, कृता strikes me
explanation: "Matali! the enemy's chariot is darting forward hurriedly. See him coming in the reverse direction with great speed once again. It strikes my mind that he is surely causing his fall."

shloka_text: तदप्रमादमातिष्ठन्प्रत्युद्गच्छरथंरिपोः । विध्वंसयितुमिच्छामिवायुर्मेघमिवोत्थितम् ।।6.108.11।।
transliteration: tadapramādamātiṣṭhanpratyudgaccharathaṃripoḥ | vidhvaṃsayitumicchāmivāyurmeghamivotthitam
translation: तत् then, अप्रमादम् being alert, अतिष्ठ staying, रिपोः enemy, रथम् chariot, प्रत्युद्गच्छ towards him, वायुः wind, उत्थितम् excessively rising, मेघमिव like cloud, विध्वंसयितुम् destroy him, इ च्छामि wish to
explanation: "Being alert, you drive the chariot towards Ravana, just as wind drives the cloud in the sky, as I wish to destroy him."

shloka_text: अविक्लबमसम्भ्रान्तमव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम् । रमशिसञ्चारनियंप्रचोदयरथंद्रुतम् ।।6.108.12।।
transliteration: aviklabamasambhrāntamavyagrahṛdayekṣaṇam | ramaśisañcāraniyaṃpracodayarathaṃdrutam
translation: अविक्लबम् without confusion, असम्भ्रान्तम् without agitation, अव्यग्रहृदयेक्षणम् with steady heart and vision, रमशिसञ्चारनियतम् movement of reins controlled, रथम् chariot, द्रुतम् determined, प्रचोदय drive swiftly
explanation: "Drive the chariot swiftly without confusion, without any agitation, with steady heart and vision, controlling the movement of reins and determination.

shloka_text: कामं न त्वंसमाधेयःपुरन्दररथोचितः । युयुत्सुरहमेकाग्रःस्मारयेत्वां न शिक्ष्ये ।।6.108.13।।
transliteration: kāmaṃ na tvaṃsamādheyaḥpurandararathocitaḥ | yuyutsurahamekāgraḥsmārayetvāṃ na śikṣye
translation: पुरन्दररथोचितः driver of the chariot of one like Indra, त्वम् you, कामम् desire, न समाधेयः not required to be told, अहम् by me, एकाग्रः single pointed, युयुत्सुः wishing to fight, त्वाम् you, स्मारये remind you, न शिक्ष्ये not instruct
explanation: "You are a driver of great Indra's chariot. You are not required to be told. Wishing to fight with rapt attention, I will remind you now and then not instruct you", said Rama to Matali."

shloka_text: परितुष्टः स रामस्यतेनवाक्येनमातलिः । प्रचोदयामासरथंसुरसारथिरुत्तमः ।।6.108.14।।
transliteration: parituṣṭaḥ sa rāmasyatenavākyenamātaliḥ | pracodayāmāsarathaṃsurasārathiruttamaḥ
translation: उत्तमः best, सुरसारथिः charioteer of Devatas, सः he, मातलिः Matali, रामस्य Rama's, तेनवाक्येन by his words, परितुष्टः highly delighted, रथम् chariot, प्रचोदयामास started driving.
explanation: Matali, the best charioteer of the Devatas, was highly delighted at Rama's words and started driving.

shloka_text: अपसव्यंततःकुर्वन् रावणस्यमहारथम् । चक्रसम्भूतरसारावणंव्यवदूनयन् ।।6.108.15।।
transliteration: apasavyaṃtataḥkurvan rāvaṇasyamahāratham | cakrasambhūtarasārāvaṇaṃvyavadūnayan
translation: ततः then, रावणस्य Ravana's, रथम् chariot, अपसव्यम् turned, कुर्वन् done, चक्रसम्भूतरजसा dust arising out of rolling wheels, रावणम् Ravana, व्यवधूनयन् shaken
explanation: Then Matali made the chariot turn round and by the dust rising from the rolling wheels of the chariot, Ravana was shaken.

shloka_text: ततःक्रुद्धोदशग्रीवस्ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः । रथप्रतिमुखंरामंसायकैरवधूनयत् ।।6.108.16।।
transliteration: tataḥkruddhodaśagrīvastāmravisphāritekṣaṇaḥ | rathapratimukhaṃrāmaṃsāyakairavadhūnayat
translation: ततः then, क्रुद्धःfurious, दशग्रीवः ten headed, ताम्रविस्फारितेक्षणः coppery eyes open widely, रामम् Rama, सायकैः arrows, अवधूनयत् struck
explanation: Then furious Ravana, the ten headed Rakshasa, whose eyes turned coppery in anger, struck Rama with arrows.

shloka_text: धर्षणामर्षितोरामोधैर्यंरोषेणलम्भयन् । जग्राहसुमहावेगमैन्द्रंयुधिशरासनम् ।।6.108.17।।
transliteration: dharṣaṇāmarṣitorāmodhairyaṃroṣeṇalambhayan | jagrāhasumahāvegamaindraṃyudhiśarāsanam
translation: धर्षणामर्षितः provoked by the assault, रामः Rama, सैन्यम् army, रोषेण perturbed, लम्भयन् of extraordinary impulse, युधि bow, सुमहावेगम् at high speed, ऐन्द्रम् Indra's, शरासनम् like sunbeams, जग्राह took up
explanation: Rama who was provoked by the assault and army was perturbed. He took up Indra's bow of extraordinary impulse and of high speed like sunbeams.

shloka_text: शरांश्चसुमहावेगान्सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान् । तदुपोढुंमहद्युद्धमन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः ।।6.108.18।। परस्पराभिमुखयोर्दृप्तयोरिवसिंहयोः ।
transliteration: śarāṃścasumahāvegānsūryaraśmisamaprabhān | tadupoḍhuṃmahadyuddhamanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇoḥ  parasparābhimukhayordṛptayorivasiṃhayoḥ |
translation: सुमहावेगान् of very high speed, सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभान् glowing in radiance like the sun's rays, शरान् च arrows, अन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणोः each one desirous killing the other, तत् then, महत् great, युद्धम् war, परस्पराभिमुखयोः who stood facing each other, दृप्तयोः ensued, सिंहयोरिव like lions, उपोढम् come near
explanation: The arrows endowed with very high speed, glowing in radiance like the sun's radiance, holding the arrows, each one desirous of killing the other stood facing each other, came near, and started fighting like lions in the great war.

shloka_text: ततोदेवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः ।।6.108.19।। समीयुर्द्वैरथंद्रष्टुंरावणक्षयकाङ्क्षिणः ।
transliteration: tatodevāssagandharvāssiddhāścaparamarṣayaḥ  samīyurdvairathaṃdraṣṭuṃrāvaṇakṣayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ |
translation: ततः thereafter, सगन्धर्वाः the Gandharvas, देवाः Devas, सिद्धाश्च Siddhas, परमर्षयः sages, रावणक्षय काङ्क्षिणः longing for destruction of Ravana, ध्वैरथम् duel, द्रष्टुम् witness, समीयुःcame
explanation: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas and sages longing for the end of Ravana came there to witness the duel.

shloka_text: वर्षरुधिरंदेवोरावणस्यरधोपरि ।।6.108.20।। वातामण्डलिनस्त्रीव्राह्यपसव्यंप्रचक्रमुः ।
transliteration: varṣarudhiraṃdevorāvaṇasyaradhopari  vātāmaṇḍalinastrīvrāhyapasavyaṃpracakramuḥ |
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, रथोपरि on the chariot, देवः Devas, रुधिरम् blood, ववर्ष rained, मण्डलिनः in circles, तीव्राः intense, वाताः wind, अपसव्यम् left to right, प्रचक्रमुः blew
explanation: Devas rained blood on Ravana's chariot, wind blew in circles intensely from left to right.

shloka_text: महत् गृध्रकुलंचास्यभ्रममाणंनभस्तले ।।6.108.21।। येनयेनरथोयातितेनतेनप्रधावति
transliteration: mahat gṛdhrakulaṃcāsyabhramamāṇaṃnabhastale  yenayenarathoyātitenatenapradhāvati
translation: सभस्तले in the sky, भ्रममाणम् hovering, महत् huge, गृध्रकुलम् flock of eagles, अस्य on his, रथः chariot, येनयेन whatever path, याति went, तेनतेन there and there, प्रधावति followed
explanation: In the sky, a huge flock of eagles hovering on the chariot of Ravana went following the chariot wherever it went.

shloka_text: सन्ध्ययाचावृतालङ्काजपापुष्पनिकाशया ।।6.108.22।। दृश्यतेसम्प्रदीप्तेवदिवसेऽपिवसुन्धरा ।
transliteration: sandhyayācāvṛtālaṅkājapāpuṣpanikāśayā  dṛśyatesampradīptevadivase'pivasundharā |
translation: लङ्का Lanka, जपापुष्पनिकाशया as though filled with japa flowers, सन्ध्यया like dusk, आवृता enshrouded, वसुन्धरा earth surface, दिवसेऽपि even though day time, सम्प्रदीप्तेव, glowing, दृश्यते seemed
explanation: Lanka seemed glowing in red colour like at dusk, and as though the earth was burning, shrouded with Japa flowers, even though it was daytime.

shloka_text: सनिर्घातामहोल्काश्चसम्प्रपेतुर्महास्वनाः ।।6.108.23।। विषादयंस्तेरक्षांसिरावणस्यतदाहिताः ।
transliteration: sanirghātāmaholkāścasamprapeturmahāsvanāḥ  viṣādayaṃsterakṣāṃsirāvaṇasyatadāhitāḥ |
translation: सनिर्घाताः meteors, महास्वनाः with great sound, महोल्काश्च huge fire, सम्प्रपेतुः dropped, रावणस्य Ravana's, अहिताः end, ते they, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, विषादयन् were sad
explanation: Meteors and huge fire dropped there indicating Ravana's end. Seeing them, Rakshasas were sad.

shloka_text: सनिर्घातामहोल्काश्चसम्प्रपेतुर्महास्वनाः ।।6.108.23।। विषादयंस्तेरक्षांसिरावणस्यतदाहिताः ।
transliteration: sanirghātāmaholkāścasamprapeturmahāsvanāḥ  viṣādayaṃsterakṣāṃsirāvaṇasyatadāhitāḥ |
translation: सनिर्घाताः meteors, महास्वनाः with great sound, महोल्काश्च huge fire, सम्प्रपेतुः dropped, रावणस्य Ravana's, अहिताः end, ते they, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, विषादयन् were sad
explanation: Meteors and huge fire dropped there indicating Ravana's end. Seeing them, Rakshasas were sad.

shloka_text: रावणश्चयतस्तत्रप्रचचालवसुन्धरा ।।6.108.25।। रक्षसां च प्रहरतांगृहीताइवबाहवः ।
transliteration: rāvaṇaścayatastatrapracacālavasundharā  rakṣasāṃ ca praharatāṃgṛhītāivabāhavaḥ |
translation: रावणः Ravana यतः where, तत्र he was, वसुन्धरा earth, प्रचचाल shook, प्रहरताम् moving, रक्षसां च Rakshasas, बाहवः many, गृहीताइव as if clasped
explanation: Wherever Ravana went, the earth shook. Many Rakshasas felt their hands clasped.

shloka_text: ताम्राःपीतास्सिताश्वेताःपतितास्सूर्यरश्मयः ।।6.108.26।। दृश्यन्तेरावणस्याग्रेपर्वतस्येवधातवः ।
transliteration: tāmrāḥpītāssitāśvetāḥpatitāssūryaraśmayaḥ  dṛśyanterāvaṇasyāgreparvatasyevadhātavaḥ |
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, अग्रे front, ताम्राः red, पीताः yellow, सिताश्वेताः white and dark, सूर्यरश्मयः sun rays, पतिताः fallen, पर्वतस्य mountain's, धातवःइव minerals, दृश्यन्ते appeared
explanation: The rays of the Sun fell in front of Ravana, in red, yellow, white, and dark like minerals on the mountain.

shloka_text: गृध्रैरनुगताश्चास्यवमन्त्योज्वलनंमुखैः ।।6.108.27।। प्रणेदुर्मुखमीक्षन्त्यःसम्रद्धमशिवंशिवाः ।
transliteration: gṛdhrairanugatāścāsyavamantyojvalanaṃmukhaiḥ  praṇedurmukhamīkṣantyaḥsamraddhamaśivaṃśivāḥ |
translation: गृध्रैः vultures, अनुगताः followed, शिवाः shejackals, मुखैः mouth, ज्वलनम् burning fire, वमन्त्यः vomitted, अस्य from there, मुखम् mouth, ईक्षन्त्यःindicating, सम्रद्धम् agitated, अशिवम् inauspicious, प्रणेदुः screamed
explanation: The vultures followed by shejackals vomited, burning fire from their mouths indicating inauspiciousness and screamed.

shloka_text: प्रतिकूलंववेवायूरणेपांसून् समुकतिरन् ।।6.108.28।। तस्यराक्षसराजस्यकुर्वन्दृष्टिविलोपनम् ।
transliteration: pratikūlaṃvavevāyūraṇepāṃsūn samukatiran  tasyarākṣasarājasyakurvandṛṣṭivilopanam |
translation: वायुः wind, तस्यराक्षसराजस्य that Rakshasa king's, दृष्टिविलोपनम् clouding the sight, कुर्वन made, रणे in war, पांसून् close by, समुकतिरन् to, प्रतिकूलम् unfavourable, ववौ blew
explanation: The unfavourable wind that blew in war, clouded the sight of Rakshasa king.

shloka_text: निपेतुरिन्द्राशनयस्सैन्येचाप्यसमन्ततः ।।6.108.29।। दुर्विषह्यस्वनाघोरंविनाजलधरोदयम् ।
transliteration: nipeturindrāśanayassainyecāpyasamantataḥ  durviṣahyasvanāghoraṃvinājaladharodayam |
translation: जलधरोदयंविना without clouds, घोरम् terrific, दुर्विषह्यस्वनाः unbearable sound, इन्द्राशनयः thunderbolts of Indra, अस्य on his, सैन्ये army, समन्ततःall over, निपेतुःdropped
explanation: Without clouds, terrific thunderbolts of Indra (rain) dropped on his (Ravana's) army all over causing unbearable sound.

shloka_text: दिशश्चप्रदिशस्सर्वाबभूवुस्तिमिरावृताः ।।6.108.30।। पांसुवर्षेणमहतादुर्दर्शं च नभोऽभवत् ।
transliteration: diśaścapradiśassarvābabhūvustimirāvṛtāḥ  pāṃsuvarṣeṇamahatādurdarśaṃ ca nabho'bhavat |
translation: सर्वाः all, दिशः च directions, प्रदिशश्च intermediate points, तिमिरावृताः enveloped by darkness, बभूवुः remained, नभः sky, महता huge, पांसुवर्षेण shower of dust, दुर्दर्शम् to see, अभवत् obscure
explanation: All directions and intermediate points were enveloped by darkness by the shower of dust and the huge sky was obscure.

shloka_text: कुर्वन्त: कलहंघोरंशारिकास्तद्रथंप्रति ।।6.108.31।। निपेतुश्शतशस्तत्रदारुणादारुणारुताः ।
transliteration: kurvanta: kalahaṃghoraṃśārikāstadrathaṃprati  nipetuśśataśastatradāruṇādāruṇārutāḥ |
translation: दारुणारुताः fighting in terrific way, दारुणाः frightening, शतशः in hundreds, शारिकाः minas, घोरम् dreadful, कलहम् cries, कुर्वन्त: emitting, तत्र there, तद्रथंप्रति on the chariot, निपेतुः fallen
explanation: Hundreds of minas making frightening sounds, fighting in terrific manner emitting dreadful cries had fallen on the chariot there.

shloka_text: जघनेभ्यःस्फुलिङ्गांश्चनेत्रेभ्योऽश्रूणिसन्ततम् ।।6.108.32।। मुमुचुस्तस्यतुरगास्तुल्यमग्नि च वारि च ।
transliteration: jaghanebhyaḥsphuliṅgāṃścanetrebhyo'śrūṇisantatam  mumucustasyaturagāstulyamagni ca vāri ca |
translation: तस्य his, तुरगाः horses, जघनेभ्यः from hips, स्फुलिङ्गान् fire sparks, नेत्रेभ्यः from eyes, अश्रूणिच tears, अग्निं च fire, वारि च water, तुल्यम् equally, सन्ततम् at a time, मुमुचुःlet out
explanation: His (Ravana's) horses were letting out fire sparks from their hips, tears, water, and fire from their eyes at a time, continuously.

shloka_text: एवंप्रकाराबहवस्समुत्पाताभयापहाः ।।6.108.33।। रावणस्यविनाशायदारुणाःसम्प्रजज्ञिरे ।
transliteration: evaṃprakārābahavassamutpātābhayāpahāḥ  rāvaṇasyavināśāyadāruṇāḥsamprajajñire |
translation: एवंप्रकाराः in that manner, बहवः many, भयावहाः frightful, दारुणाः dreadful, समुत्पाताः falling, रावणस्य Ravana's, विनाशाय destruction, सम्प्रजज्ञिरे indicated
explanation: In that manner, many frightful and dreadful objects falling indicated destruction of Ravana.

shloka_text: रामस्यापिनिमित्तानिसौम्यानि च शिवानि च ।।6.108.34।। बभूवुर्जयशंसीनिप्रादुर्भूतानिसर्वशः ।
transliteration: rāmasyāpinimittānisaumyāni ca śivāni ca  babhūvurjayaśaṃsīniprādurbhūtānisarvaśaḥ |
translation: सर्वशःon all sides, प्रादुर्भूतानि displaying beings, सौम्यानि delightful, शिवानि auspicious, रामस्य Rama's, जयशंसीनि signs of victory, निमित्तानि indications, बभूवुः appeared
explanation: On all sides appeared indications of signs of victory for Rama, displaying beings delightful and auspicious.

shloka_text: निमित्तानि च सौम्यानिराघवःस्वजयायवै ।।6.108.35।। दृष्टवापरमसम्हृष्टोहतंमेने च रावणम् ।
transliteration: nimittāni ca saumyānirāghavaḥsvajayāyavai  dṛṣṭavāparamasamhṛṣṭohataṃmene ca rāvaṇam |
translation: राघवःRaghava, स्वजयाय his own victory, सौम्यानि good, निमित्तानि indications, दृष्टवा seeing, परमसम्हृष्टः very delighted रावणम् Ravana, हतम् destroyed, मेने by me
explanation: Sri Rama was very delighted over the appearance of good signs of his own victory and thought 'Ravana is destroyed by me'.

shloka_text: ततःप्रवृत्तंसुक्रूरंरामरावणयोस्तदा । सुमहदद्वैरथंयुद्धंसर्वलोकभयावहम् ।।6.109.1।।
transliteration: tataḥpravṛttaṃsukrūraṃrāmarāvaṇayostadā | sumahadadvairathaṃyuddhaṃsarvalokabhayāvaham
translation: ततः thereupon, तदा then, रामरावणयोः for Rama and Ravana, सुक्रूरम् fierce, सुमहत् great, सर्वलोकभयावहम् fearsome to the whole world, धैरथम् duel, युद्धम् war, प्रवृत्तम् ensued
explanation: Then there ensued a fierce duel between Rama and Ravana that was fearsome to the whole world.
comments: Rama and Ravana continue to fight raining arrows at each other. Rama breaks the flag post of Ravana's chariot.

shloka_text: ततोराक्षससैन्यं च हरीणां च महद्बलम् । प्रगृहीतप्रहरणंनिश्चेष्टंसमवर्तत ।।6.109.2।।
transliteration: tatorākṣasasainyaṃ ca harīṇāṃ ca mahadbalam | pragṛhītapraharaṇaṃniśceṣṭaṃsamavartata
translation: ततः then, राक्षससैन्यं च Rakshasa army, हरीणाम् Vanaras, महत् huge, बलं च army, प्रगृहीतप्रहरणम् holding their weapons readily, निश्चेचष्टम् motionless, समवर्तत stood
explanation: Then, both Rakshasa army and huge Vanara army, stood motionless holding their weapons ready.

shloka_text: सम्प्रयुद्धेतुतौदृष्टवाबलवन्नरराक्षसौ । व्याक्षिप्तहदृयास्सर्वेपरंविस्मयमागताः ।।6.109.3।।
transliteration: samprayuddhetutaudṛṣṭavābalavannararākṣasau | vyākṣiptahadṛyāssarveparaṃvismayamāgatāḥ
translation: सम्प्रयुद्धौ engaged in battle, तौ both, बलवन्नरराक्षसौ mighty human and Rakshasa, दृष्टवा to see, सर्वे all, व्याक्षिप्तहृदयैः distracted in heart, परम् supreme, विस्मयम् wonderment, आगताः experienced
explanation: Then, when the mighty human and the Rakshasa were both engaged in the battle, distracted at heart, all experienced supreme wonderment.

shloka_text: नाप्रहरणैर्व्यग्रैर्भुजैर्विस्मितबुद्धयः । तस्थुःप्रेक्षय च सर्वेतेनाभिजग्मुःपरस्परम् ।।6.109.4।।
transliteration: nāpraharaṇairvyagrairbhujairvismitabuddhayaḥ | tasthuḥprekṣaya ca sarvetenābhijagmuḥparasparam
translation: ते they, सर्वे all, नानाप्रहरणैः different kinds of implements, व्यग्रैः lifted up, भुजैः armed, विस्मितबुद्धयः amazed, प्रेक्षय witnessed, तस्थुः both of them, परस्परम् one another, नाभिजग्मुः did not attack
explanation: All the army on both sides lifted their hands up, holding different kinds of implements, and were amazed looking at them and did not attack one another.

shloka_text: रक्षसांरावणंचापिवानराणां च राघवम् । पश्यतांविस्मिताक्षाणांसैन्यंचित्रमिवाबभौ ।।6.109.5।।
transliteration: rakṣasāṃrāvaṇaṃcāpivānarāṇāṃ ca rāghavam | paśyatāṃvismitākṣāṇāṃsainyaṃcitramivābabhau
translation: रावणम् Ravana, पश्यताम् seeing, विस्मिताक्षाणाम् astonished, रक्षसाम् of Rakshasa, राघवम् Raghava, वानराणां च Vanaras also, सैन्यम् army, चित्रमिव wonderful picture, अबभौ remained as though
explanation: The army of Rakshasas was looking at Ravana and the Vanaras were looking at Raghava with astonishment as though it was a wonderful picture.

shloka_text: तौतुतत्रनिमित्तानिदृष्टवाराघवरावणौ । कृतबुद्धीस्थिरामर्षौयुयुधातेह्यभीतवत् ।।6.109.6।।
transliteration: taututatranimittānidṛṣṭavārāghavarāvaṇau | kṛtabuddhīsthirāmarṣauyuyudhātehyabhītavat
translation: तौ both, रावणौ Ravana, तत्र there, निमित्तानि portents, दृष्टवा on seeing, कृतबुद्धी firm in mind, स्थिरामर्षौ indignation, अभीतवत् fearless, युयुधाते fought
explanation: Both Ravana and Rama, seeing their portents, firmly resolved in mind with indignation, fought fearlessly.

shloka_text: जेतव्यमितिकाकुत्स्थोमर्तव्यमितिरावणः । धृतौस्ववीर्यसर्वस्वंयुद्धेऽदर्शयतांतदा ।।6.109.7।।
transliteration: jetavyamitikākutsthomartavyamitirāvaṇaḥ | dhṛtausvavīryasarvasvaṃyuddhe'darśayatāṃtadā
translation: जेतव्यम् victory, इति thus, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, मर्तव्यम् death, इति this, रावणः Ravana, धृतौ determined, तदा then, युद्धे in battle, स्ववीर्यसर्वस्वम् their total prowess, अदर्शयताम् exhibited
explanation: Kakuthsa Rama, sure of his victory and Ravana thinking surely of his death, exhibited their prowess totally in the battle, with determination.

shloka_text: ततःक्रोधाद्धशग्रीवश्शरान्सन्धायवीर्यवान् । मुमोचध्वजमुद्धिस्यराघवस्यरथेस्थितम् ।।6.109.8।।
transliteration: tataḥkrodhāddhaśagrīvaśśarānsandhāyavīryavān | mumocadhvajamuddhisyarāghavasyarathesthitam
translation: ततः thereafter, वीर्यवान् valiant, दशग्रीवः ten headed, क्रोधात् in anger, शरान् arrows, न्धाय fixing, राघवस्य on Raghava's, ध्वजे flag post, स्थितम् stood, ध्वजम् flag, उद्धिस्य aiming, मुमोच struck
explanation: Thereafter, valiant ten headed Ravana, fixing arrows released them in anger aiming at the flag post of Rama's chariot.

shloka_text: तेशरास्तमनासाद्यपुरन्दररथध्वजम् । रथशक्तिंपरामृश्यनिपेतुर्धरणीतले ।।6.109.9।।
transliteration: teśarāstamanāsādyapurandararathadhvajam | rathaśaktiṃparāmṛśyanipeturdharaṇītale
translation: ते those, शराः arrows, तम् that, पुरन्दररथध्वजम् post of Indra's chariot, अनासाद्य without reaching, रथशक्तिम् the chariot, परामृश्य touching, धरणीतले on earth surface, निपेतुः fell
explanation: Those arrows, without reaching the post on Indra's chariot, touching the chariot fell on ground.

shloka_text: ततोरामोऽपिसङ्क्रुद्धश्चपमाकृष्यवीर्यवान् । कृतप्रतिकृतंकर्तुंमनसस्सम्प्रचक्रमे ।।6.109.10।।
transliteration: tatorāmo'pisaṅkruddhaścapamākṛṣyavīryavān | kṛtapratikṛtaṃkartuṃmanasassampracakrame
translation: ततः then, वीर्यवान् valiant one, रामः Rama, अपि very, सङ्क्रुद्धः angry, चापम् bow, आकृष्य stretching, कृतप्रतिकृतम् return back to Ravana, कर्तुम् to do, मनसा in his mind, सम्प्रचक्रमे started to comply
explanation: Valiant Rama too stretching his bow in anger and thinking of returning back blow to Ravana and started compliance.

shloka_text: रावणध्वजमुद्दिस्यमुमोचनिशितंशरम् । महासर्पमिवासह्यंज्वलन्तंस्वेनतेजसा ।।6.109.11।।
transliteration: rāvaṇadhvajamuddisyamumocaniśitaṃśaram | mahāsarpamivāsahyaṃjvalantaṃsvenatejasā
translation: रावणध्वजम् Ravana's post, उद्दिस्य targeting, महासर्पमिव like great snake, असह्यम् intolerant, स्वेन himself, तेजसा bright, ज्वलन्तम् इव glowing, निशितम् sharp, शरम् arrow, मुमोच released
explanation: Rama, intolerant like a snake, targeting Ravana's post, released a sharp bright glowing arrow.

shloka_text: रामश्चिक्षेपतेजस्वीकेतुमुद्धिश्यसायकम् । जगाम स महींछित्त्वादशग्रीवध्वजंशरः ।।6.109.12।।
transliteration: rāmaścikṣepatejasvīketumuddhiśyasāyakam | jagāma sa mahīṃchittvādaśagrīvadhvajaṃśaraḥ
translation: तेजस्वी glorious, रामःRama, केतुम् flag post, उद्धिश्य aiming at, सायकम् arrow, चिक्षेप loosed, सःशरः that arrow, दशग्रीवध्वजम् Ravana's flag post, छित्त्वा torn, महीम् ground, जगाम went in
explanation: Glorious Rama aiming at the flag post of Ravana, released an arrow that tore the post and went into the ground.

shloka_text: स निकृत्तोऽपतद्भूमौरावणस्यन्दनध्वजः । ध्वजस्योन्मथनंदृष्टवारावणस्समहाबलः ।।6.109.13।। सम्प्रदीप्तोऽभवत्क्रोधादमर्षात्प्रहसन्निव । स रोषवशमापन्नश्शरवर्षंववर्ष ह ।।6.109.14।।
transliteration: sa nikṛtto'patadbhūmaurāvaṇasyandanadhvajaḥ | dhvajasyonmathanaṃdṛṣṭavārāvaṇassamahābalaḥ  sampradīpto'bhavatkrodhādamarṣātprahasanniva | sa roṣavaśamāpannaśśaravarṣaṃvavarṣa ha
translation: सः he, रावणस्यन्दनध्वजः Ravana's flag post, भूमौ ground, अपतत् fell, महाबलः mighty, सःरावणः that Ravana, ध्वजस्य flag's, उन्मधनम् striking, दृष्टवा observing, अमर्षात् intolerant, प्रहसन्निव laughing, क्रोधात् in wrath, सम्प्रदीप्तः burning, अभवत् became, सः he, रोषवशम् out of fury, आपन्नः distressed, शरवर्षम् shower of arrows, ववर्ष ह rained
explanation: Ravana's flag post fell down, struck by Rama. Mighty Ravana, observing his post being struck, became intolerant, and burning in anger, laughing, rained showers of arrows at Rama out of fury.

shloka_text: स निकृत्तोऽपतद्भूमौरावणस्यन्दनध्वजः । ध्वजस्योन्मथनंदृष्टवारावणस्समहाबलः ।।6.109.13।। सम्प्रदीप्तोऽभवत्क्रोधादमर्षात्प्रहसन्निव । स रोषवशमापन्नश्शरवर्षंववर्ष ह ।।6.109.14।।
transliteration: sa nikṛtto'patadbhūmaurāvaṇasyandanadhvajaḥ | dhvajasyonmathanaṃdṛṣṭavārāvaṇassamahābalaḥ  sampradīpto'bhavatkrodhādamarṣātprahasanniva | sa roṣavaśamāpannaśśaravarṣaṃvavarṣa ha
translation: सः he, रावणस्यन्दनध्वजः Ravana's flag post, भूमौ ground, अपतत् fell, महाबलः mighty, सःरावणः that Ravana, ध्वजस्य flag's, उन्मधनम् striking, दृष्टवा observing, अमर्षात् intolerant, प्रहसन्निव laughing, क्रोधात् in wrath, सम्प्रदीप्तः burning, अभवत् became, सः he, रोषवशम् out of fury, आपन्नः distressed, शरवर्षम् shower of arrows, ववर्ष ह rained
explanation: Ravana's flag post fell down, struck by Rama. Mighty Ravana, observing his post being struck, became intolerant, and burning in anger, laughing, rained showers of arrows at Rama out of fury.

shloka_text: रामस्यतुरगान्दीप्तै: शरैर्विव्याथरावणः । तेदिव्याहरयस्तत्रनास्खलन्नापिबभ्रमुः ।।6.109.15।। बभूवुःस्वस्थहृदयाःपद्मनालैरिवाहताः ।
transliteration: rāmasyaturagāndīptai: śarairvivyātharāvaṇaḥ | tedivyāharayastatranāskhalannāpibabhramuḥ  babhūvuḥsvasthahṛdayāḥpadmanālairivāhatāḥ |
translation: रावणः Ravana, दीप्तै: burning, शरैः arrow, रामस्य of Rama, तुरगान् horses, विद्याथ pierced, दिव्याः wonderful, तेतुरगाः those horses, तत्र there, नास्खलन् not staggered, न बभ्रमुः nor reeled, पद्मनारैः lotus stalks, आहताःइव as if not hurt, स्वस्थहृदयाः complacent at heart, बभूवुः remained
explanation: Ravana with his burning arrows pierced Rama's horses. Those horses were wonderful as they did not stagger or reel as if hurt by lotus stalks and remained complacent.

shloka_text: तेषामसम्भ्रमंदृष्टवावाजिनांरावणस्तदा ।।6.109.16।। भूयएवसुसङ्क्रुद्धश्शरवर्षंमुमोच ह ।
transliteration: teṣāmasambhramaṃdṛṣṭavāvājināṃrāvaṇastadā  bhūyaevasusaṅkruddhaśśaravarṣaṃmumoca ha |
translation: तदा then, रावणः Ravana, तेषाम् those, वाजिनाम् horses, असम्भ्रमम् unagitated, दृष्टवा perceiving, भूयः exceedingly, एव just, सुसङ्क्रुद्धः highly enraged, शरवर्षम् shower of arrows, मुमोच ह released
explanation: Ravana perceived that the horses were just unperturbed by his arrows, became enraged and showered arrows excessively.

shloka_text: गदाश्चपरिघांश्चैवचक्राणिमुसलानि च ।।6.109.17।। गिरिशृङ्गाणिवृक्षांश्चतथाशूलपरश्वधान् ।
transliteration: gadāścaparighāṃścaivacakrāṇimusalāni ca  giriśṛṅgāṇivṛkṣāṃścatathāśūlaparaśvadhān |
translation: गदाश्च maces, परिघांश्च iron bars, चक्राणि discuses, मुसलानि च with clubs, गिरिशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, वृक्षान् च and trees, तथा so also, शूलपरश्वधान् tridents and axes.
explanation: Ravana used maces, iron bars, discuses, clubs, mountain peaks, trees and also tridents and axes.

shloka_text: मायाविहितमेतत्तुशस्त्रवर्षमपातयत् ।।6.109.18।। सहस्रशस्तदाबाणानश्रान्तहृदयोद्यमः ।
transliteration: māyāvihitametattuśastravarṣamapātayat  sahasraśastadābāṇānaśrāntahṛdayodyamaḥ |
translation: तदा then, अश्रान्तहृदयोद्यमः unwearied at heart, एतत् all such, मायाविहितम् created by magic, शस्त्रवर्षम् rain of arrows, सहस्रशः thousand, बाणान् arrows, अपातयत् let loose
explanation: Unwearied at heart, Ravana let loose rain of arrows created by magic in thousands.

shloka_text: तुमुलंत्रासजननंभीमंभीमप्रतिस्वनम् ।।6.109.19।। तद्वर्षमभवद्युद्धेनैकशस्त्रमयंमहत् ।
transliteration: tumulaṃtrāsajananaṃbhīmaṃbhīmapratisvanam  tadvarṣamabhavadyuddhenaikaśastramayaṃmahat |
translation: युद्धे in war, तुमुलम् noisy, त्रासजननम् alarming, भीमम् fearful, भीमप्रतिस्वनम् making loud noise, तत् those, नैकशस्त्रमयम् different kinds of weapons, महत् huge, वर्षम् rain, अभवत् descended
explanation: In that war, noisy, alarming, fearful loud noise of weapons of different kinds, in huge numbers, descended.

shloka_text: राघवरथंसमन्ताद्वानरेबले ।।6.109.20।। सायकैरन्तरिक्षं च चकारसुनिरन्तरम् ।
transliteration: rāghavarathaṃsamantādvānarebale  sāyakairantarikṣaṃ ca cakārasunirantaram |
translation: राघवरथम् Raghava's chariot, विमुच्य obstructed by, समन्तात् on all sides, वानरे Vanaras, बले army, सायकैः arrows, अन्तरिक्षम् into the sky, सुनिरन्तरम् on the army, चकार covered
explanation: Obstructed by Raghava's chariot on all sides, the arrows covered the Vanara army and up to the sky.

shloka_text: मुमोच ह दशग्रीवोनिःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.109.21।। व्यायच्छमानंतंदृष्टवासत्वरमरावणंरणे । प्रहसन्निवकाकुत्स्थसन्दधेनिशितान्शरान् ।।6.109.22।। स मुमो च ततोबाणान्शतशोऽथसहस्रशः ।
transliteration: mumoca ha daśagrīvoniḥsaṅgenāntarātmanā  vyāyacchamānaṃtaṃdṛṣṭavāsatvaramarāvaṇaṃraṇe | prahasannivakākutsthasandadheniśitānśarān  sa mumo ca tatobāṇānśataśo'thasahasraśaḥ |
translation: दशग्रीवः tenheaded, निःसङ्गेन released, अन्तरात्मना not thinking anything in his mind, मुमोच च loosed, व्यायच्छमानम् with enthusiasm, सत्वरम quickly, तंरावणम् that Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, प्रहसन्निव laughing, निशितान् pointed, शरान् arrows, सन्दधे fixing, ततः then, सः he, शतशः hundred, सहस्रशः thousands, बाणान् arrows, मुमोच released
explanation: Seeing the ten headed Ravana releasing arrows with enthusiasm, not thinking of anything in his mind, quickly Kakuthsa laughed at them, fixed pointed arrows, and released hundreds and thousands.

shloka_text: मुमोच ह दशग्रीवोनिःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.109.21।। व्यायच्छमानंतंदृष्टवासत्वरमरावणंरणे । प्रहसन्निवकाकुत्स्थसन्दधेनिशितान्शरान् ।।6.109.22।। स मुमो च ततोबाणान्शतशोऽथसहस्रशः ।
transliteration: mumoca ha daśagrīvoniḥsaṅgenāntarātmanā  vyāyacchamānaṃtaṃdṛṣṭavāsatvaramarāvaṇaṃraṇe | prahasannivakākutsthasandadheniśitānśarān  sa mumo ca tatobāṇānśataśo'thasahasraśaḥ |
translation: दशग्रीवः tenheaded, निःसङ्गेन released, अन्तरात्मना not thinking anything in his mind, मुमोच च loosed, व्यायच्छमानम् with enthusiasm, सत्वरम quickly, तंरावणम् that Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, प्रहसन्निव laughing, निशितान् pointed, शरान् arrows, सन्दधे fixing, ततः then, सः he, शतशः hundred, सहस्रशः thousands, बाणान् arrows, मुमोच released
explanation: Seeing the ten headed Ravana releasing arrows with enthusiasm, not thinking of anything in his mind, quickly Kakuthsa laughed at them, fixed pointed arrows, and released hundreds and thousands.

shloka_text: तान् दृष्टवारावणश्चक्रेस्वशरैःखंनिरन्तरम् ।।6.109.23।। ततस्थाभ्यांप्रमुक्तेनशरवर्षेणभास्वता । शरबद्धमिवाभातिद्वितीयंभास्वदम्भरम् ।।6.109.24।।
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭavārāvaṇaścakresvaśaraiḥkhaṃnirantaram  tatasthābhyāṃpramuktenaśaravarṣeṇabhāsvatā | śarabaddhamivābhātidvitīyaṃbhāsvadambharam
translation: रावणः Ravana, तान् them, दृष्टवा seeing, स्वशरैः those arrows, खम् sky, निरन्तरम् upto, चक्रे released, तदा then, ताभ्याम् both of them, प्रमुक्तेन released by, भास्वता resplendent, शरवर्षेण by the rain of arrows, भास्वत् resplendent, अम्भरम् space, शरबद्धम् enveloped network of arrows, द्वितीयम् इव like, अभाति seemed
explanation: Seeing the arrows in the sky released by Rama, even Ravana released arrows up to the sky. With the arrows released by both of them, the space became resplendent and by the network of arrows covering it seemed like another sky.

shloka_text: तान् दृष्टवारावणश्चक्रेस्वशरैःखंनिरन्तरम् ।।6.109.23।। ततस्थाभ्यांप्रमुक्तेनशरवर्षेणभास्वता । शरबद्धमिवाभातिद्वितीयंभास्वदम्भरम् ।।6.109.24।।
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭavārāvaṇaścakresvaśaraiḥkhaṃnirantaram  tatasthābhyāṃpramuktenaśaravarṣeṇabhāsvatā | śarabaddhamivābhātidvitīyaṃbhāsvadambharam
translation: रावणः Ravana, तान् them, दृष्टवा seeing, स्वशरैः those arrows, खम् sky, निरन्तरम् upto, चक्रे released, तदा then, ताभ्याम् both of them, प्रमुक्तेन released by, भास्वता resplendent, शरवर्षेण by the rain of arrows, भास्वत् resplendent, अम्भरम् space, शरबद्धम् enveloped network of arrows, द्वितीयम् इव like, अभाति seemed
explanation: Seeing the arrows in the sky released by Rama, even Ravana released arrows up to the sky. With the arrows released by both of them, the space became resplendent and by the network of arrows covering it seemed like another sky.

shloka_text: नानिमित्तोऽभवद्भाणोनानिर्भेत्ता न निष्फलः । अन्योन्यमभिसम्हत्यनिपेतुर्धरणीतले ।।6.109.25।। तथाविसृजतोर्भाणान् रामरावणयोर्मृथे ।
transliteration: nānimitto'bhavadbhāṇonānirbhettā na niṣphalaḥ | anyonyamabhisamhatyanipeturdharaṇītale  tathāvisṛjatorbhāṇān rāmarāvaṇayormṛthe |
translation: मृथे in vain, रामरावणयोः both Rama's and Ravana's, तथा like that, बाणान् arrows, विसृजतोः let go, अनिमित्तः failed to reach the target, बाणः arrow, न अभवत् not become, अनिर्भेत्ता no arrow failed to complete the target, न not, निष्फलः without result, न not, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिसम्हत्य colliding with each other, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः fell
explanation: The arrows released by both Rama and Ravana were without result. None failed to reach the target. None failed to complete the target. The arrows were colliding with one another and fell on the ground.

shloka_text: प्रायुध्येतामविच्छिन्नमस्यन्तौसव्यदक्षिणम् ।।6.109.26।। चक्रतुश्चशरैर्घोरैर्निरुच्छवासमिवाम्बरम् ।
transliteration: prāyudhyetāmavicchinnamasyantausavyadakṣiṇam  cakratuścaśarairghorairnirucchavāsamivāmbaram |
translation: सव्यदक्षिणम् right and left direction, अविच्छिन्नम् without break, अस्यन्तौ vehemently, प्रायुध्येताम् discharging, घोरैः dreadful, शरैः arrows, अम्बरम् sky, निरुच्छवासमिव without space for breathing, चक्रतुः च released
explanation: Discharging from right and left, the two heroes without break vehemently released dreadful arrows that covered the sky and left no breathing space between them.

shloka_text: रावणस्यहयान्रामोहयान्रामस्यरावणः ।।6.109.27।। जघ्नतुस्तौतदान्योन्यंकृतानुकृतकारिणौ ।
transliteration: rāvaṇasyahayānrāmohayānrāmasyarāvaṇaḥ  jaghnatustautadānyonyaṃkṛtānukṛtakāriṇau |
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, हयान् horses, रामः Rama, रामस्य Rama's, हयान् horses, रावणः Ravana, तौ both, तदा then, अन्योन्यम् one another, कृतानुकृतकारिणौ each other blow to blow, जघ्नतुः struck
explanation: Ravana struck Rama's horses and Rama struck Ravana's horses blow to blow at that time.

shloka_text: एवंतुतौसुसङ्क्रुद्धौचक्रतुर्युद्धमुत्तमम् ।।6.109.28।। मुहूर्तमभवद्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् ।
transliteration: evaṃtutaususaṅkruddhaucakraturyuddhamuttamam  muhūrtamabhavadyuddhaṃtumulaṃromaharṣaṇam |
translation: सुसङ्क्रुद्धौ very furious, तौ both, एवम् in that way, उत्तमम् best, युद्धम् duel, चक्रतुः carried out, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, तुमुलम् fierce, रोमहर्षणम् horipulating, युद्धम् battle, अभवत् took place
explanation: Both became furious in that way and the best duel took place for a moment that was fierce and horipulating.

shloka_text: तौतथायुध्यमानौतुसमरेरामरावणौ । ददृशुस्सर्वभूतानिविस्मितेनान्तरात्मना ।।6.110.1।।
transliteration: tautathāyudhyamānautusamarerāmarāvaṇau | dadṛśussarvabhūtānivismitenāntarātmanā
translation: समरे in war, तथा thus, युध्यमनौ fighting, रामरावणौ Rama and Ravana, सर्वभूतानि all beings, विस्मितेन with astonishment, अन्तरात्मना in mind, ददृशुः observed
explanation: As Rama and Ravana were thus fighting in war, all beings watched with astonishment in mind.
comments: Tumultuous war takes place between Rama and Ravana for seven days and nights both using powerful arrows, maces, and mallets.

shloka_text: अर्धयन्तौतुसमरेतयोस्तौस्यन्दनोत्तमौ । परस्परमभिक्रुद्धौपरस्परमभिद्रुतौ ।।6.110.2।।
transliteration: ardhayantautusamaretayostausyandanottamau | parasparamabhikruddhauparasparamabhidrutau
translation: तयोः both, स्यन्दनोत्तमौ both moving quickly, परस्परम् one another, अर्धयन्तौ seeking to gain, अभिक्रुद्धौ very furious, परस्परम् one another, अभिद्रुतौ persevering
explanation: Both of them were moving quickly seeking to gain one another, very furiously persevering.

shloka_text: परस्परवधेयुक्तौघोररूपौबभूवतुः । मण्डलानि च वीधीश्चगतप्रत्यागतानि च ।।6.110.3।। दर्शयन्तौबहुविधांसूतसामर्थ्यजांगतिम् ।
transliteration: parasparavadheyuktaughorarūpaubabhūvatuḥ | maṇḍalāni ca vīdhīścagatapratyāgatāni ca  darśayantaubahuvidhāṃsūtasāmarthyajāṃgatim |
translation: परस्परवधे striking one another, युक्तौ diligently, मण्डलानि in circles, वीधीश्च feats, गतप्रत्यागतानि forwarding and receding, सूतसामर्थ्यजाम् displaying charioteers skills, बभूवतुः went on
explanation: Both striking one another diligently, going in circles moving forward and backward displaying feats, went on.

shloka_text: अर्धयन्रावणंरामोराघवंचापिरावणः ।।6.110.4।। गतिवेगंसमापन्नौप्रतिवेगप्रवर्तने ।
transliteration: ardhayanrāvaṇaṃrāmorāghavaṃcāpirāvaṇaḥ  gativegaṃsamāpannauprativegapravartane |
translation: रावणम् Ravana, अर्धयन् hurting, रामः Rama, राघवम् Raghava, रावणःचापि hurting Ravana, प्रतिवेगप्रवर्तने quickness in retaliation, गतिवेगम् speed of arrows, समापन्नौ happened
explanation: Ravana hurting Rama and vice versa displaying quickness in retaliation and speed of arrows, the fight happened.

shloka_text: क्षिपतोश्शरजालानितयोस्तौस्यन्दनोत्तमौ ।।6.110.5।। चेरतुस्सम्युगमहीं सासारौ जलदाविव ।
transliteration: kṣipatośśarajālānitayostausyandanottamau  ceratussamyugamahīṃ sāsārau jaladāviva |
translation: शरजालानि network of arrows, क्षिपतोः released, तयोः by both, स्यन्दनोत्तमौ excellent warriors, सासारौ in the battlefield, जलदौइव like water streams, संयुगमहीम् like two clouds, चेरतुः both chariots
explanation: The network of arrows released by both of them from the chariots were like water streams from two clouds in the battlefield

shloka_text: दर्शयित्वातदातौतुगतिंबहुविधांरणे ।।6.110.6।। परस्परस्याभिमुखौपुनरेव च तस्थतुः ।
transliteration: darśayitvātadātautugatiṃbahuvidhāṃraṇe  parasparasyābhimukhaupunareva ca tasthatuḥ |
translation: तदा then, तौ those two, रणे in battlefield, बहुविधाम् many ways, गतिम् movements, दर्शयित्वा having seen, पुनरेव once again, परस्परस्य one another, अभिमुखौ facing each other, तस्थतुः stood
explanation: Then those two, having seen many movements, once again stood facing each other in the battlefield.

shloka_text: धुरंधुरेणरथयोर्वक्त्रंवक्त्रेणवाजिनाम् ।।6.110.7।। पताकाश्चपताकाभिस्समीयुस्स्थितयोस्तदा ।
transliteration: dhuraṃdhureṇarathayorvaktraṃvaktreṇavājinām  patākāścapatākābhissamīyussthitayostadā |
translation: तदा then, स्थितयोः standing, रथयोः chariots, धुरम् axle, धुरेण with axle, वाजिनाम् horses, वक्त्रम् standard, वक्त्रेण with face, पताकाः flags, पताकाभिः च with flag, समीयुः stood together
explanation: The two chariots stood facing each other on the battlefield once more, the axle of one chariot facing the axle of another chariot, the flag of one with another flag, the standard with another standard, the face of one horse with the face of another horse stood and it seemed as though they were together.

shloka_text: रावणस्यततोरामोधनुर्मुस्तैश्शितैश्शरैः ।।6.110.8।। चतुर्भिश्चतुरोदीप्तान्हयान्प्रत्यपसर्पयत् ।
transliteration: rāvaṇasyatatorāmodhanurmustaiśśitaiśśaraiḥ  caturbhiścaturodīptānhayānpratyapasarpayat |
translation: ततः there upon, रामः Rama, धनुर्मुस्तै: stretching the bow, चतुर्भिःfour, शितैःsharp, शरैः arrows, रावणस्य at Ravana, दीप्तान् glowing, चतुरः four, हयान् horses, प्रत्यसर्पयत् drove back
explanation: Thereupon, Rama, stretching the bow, released four sharp glowing arrows at Ravana's four horses and drove them back.

shloka_text: सक्रोधवशमापन्नोहयानामपसर्पणे ।।6.110.9।। मुमोचनिशितान्बाणान्राघवायदशाननः ।
transliteration: sakrodhavaśamāpannohayānāmapasarpaṇe  mumocaniśitānbāṇānrāghavāyadaśānanaḥ |
translation: हयानाम् the horses, अपसर्पणे retreating, क्रोधवशम् prey to anger, आपन्नःafflicted, दशाननःtenheaded one, राघवाय on Raghava, निशितान् pointed, बाणान् arrows, मुमोच released
explanation: Fallen prey to anger for retreating the horses, the ten headed Ravana released pointed arrows on Raghava.

shloka_text: सोतिविद्धोबलवतादशग्रीवेणराघवः ।।6.110.10।। जगाम न विकारं च न चापिव्यथितोऽभवत् ।
transliteration: sotividdhobalavatādaśagrīveṇarāghavaḥ  jagāma na vikāraṃ ca na cāpivyathito'bhavat |
translation: बलवता mighty, दशग्रीवेण Ravana, अतिविद्धः wounded very much, राघवःRaghava, विकारम् agitated, न जगाम nor disquieted, व्यथितः च suffering, न अभवत् not experienced
explanation: Raghava, though wounded by the mighty Ravana's arrows, did notexperience suffering or agitation, nor disquiet.

shloka_text: चिक्षेप च पुनर्भाणान्वज्रपातसमस्वनान् ।।6.110.11।। सारथिंवज्रहस्तस्यसमुद्दिश्यदशाननः ।
transliteration: cikṣepa ca punarbhāṇānvajrapātasamasvanān  sārathiṃvajrahastasyasamuddiśyadaśānanaḥ |
translation: दशाननः Ten headed, वज्रहस्तस्य with thunderbolt like hands, सारथिम् charioteer, उद्दिश्य aimed, पुनःagain, वज्रपातसमस्वनान् equal to thunder, बाणान् arrow, चिक्षेप struck
explanation: The ten headed Ravana with his thunderbolt like hands hurled arrows and struck the charioteer of Rama, making sounds like thunder.

shloka_text: मातलेस्तुमहावेगाश्शरीरेपतिताश्शराः ।।6.110.12।। न सूक्ष्ममपिसम्मोहंव्यथांवाप्रददुर्युधि ।
transliteration: mātalestumahāvegāśśarīrepatitāśśarāḥ  na sūkṣmamapisammohaṃvyathāṃvāpradaduryudhi |
translation: मातलेःMatali, शरीरे body, पतिताः fallen, महावेगाः at great speed, शराः arrows, सुसूक्ष्ममपि even slight, सम्बोहम् perturbance, व्यथांवा or suffering, न प्रददुः not felt
explanation: Even though the arrows fell on Matali's body at great speed, he did not feel perturbed or experience even slight suffering.

shloka_text: तयाधर्षणयाक्रुद्धोमातलेर्नतथात्मनः ।।6.110.13।। चकारशरजालेनराघवोविमुखंरिपुम् ।
transliteration: tayādharṣaṇayākruddhomātalernatathātmanaḥ  cakāraśarajālenarāghavovimukhaṃripum |
translation: राघवः Raghava, मातलेः Matali, तयाधर्षणया like that torment, क्रुद्धः furious, आत्मनः himself, तथा in that way, न not, शरजालेन by the network of arrows, रिपुम् enemy, विमुखम् diverted, चकार made
explanation: Rama was furious for tormenting Matali like that, but not for hurting him and in fury discharged a network of arrows on him (Ravana) and diverted him.

shloka_text: विंशतिंत्रिंशतिंषष्टिंशतशोऽथसहस्रशः ।।6.110.14।। मुमोचराघवोवीरस्सायकान्स्यन्दनेरिपोः ।
transliteration: viṃśatiṃtriṃśatiṃṣaṣṭiṃśataśo'thasahasraśaḥ  mumocarāghavovīrassāyakānsyandaneripoḥ |
translation: वीर hero, राघवःRaghava, रिपोः enemy, स्यन्दने chest, विंशतिम् twenty, त्रिंशतिम् thirty, षष्टिम् sixty, अथ and then, शतशः hundreds, सहस्रशः thousands, सायकान् shafts, मुमोच loosed at him
explanation: Heroic Raghava thereafter, let loose shafts in twenties, thirties, sixties, hundreds, and thousands at Ravana's chest.

shloka_text: रावणोऽपिततःक्रुद्धोरथस्थराक्षसेश्वरः ।।6.110.15।। गदामुसलवर्षेणरामंप्रत्यर्दयद्रणे ।
transliteration: rāvaṇo'pitataḥkruddhorathastharākṣaseśvaraḥ  gadāmusalavarṣeṇarāmaṃpratyardayadraṇe |
translation: ततः then, क्रुद्धः enraged, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणोऽपि Ravana also, रणे in the battle, रामम् Rama, गदामुसलवर्षेण with mace and mallets, प्रत्यर्थयत् in return
explanation: Enraged Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, also in return, retaliated with maces and mallets.

shloka_text: तत्प्रवृतंपुनर्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.16।। गदानांमुसलानां च परिघाणांचनिस्स्वनैः । शराणांपुङ्खवातैश्चक्षुभितास्सप्तसागराः ।।6.110.17।।
transliteration: tatpravṛtaṃpunaryuddhaṃtumulaṃromaharṣaṇam  gadānāṃmusalānāṃ ca parighāṇāṃcanissvanaiḥ | śarāṇāṃpuṅkhavātaiścakṣubhitāssaptasāgarāḥ
translation: तत् then, प्रवृतं ensued, पुनः again, युद्धम् war, तुमुलम् tumultuous, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, गदानाम् with maces, मुसलानां च and mallets, परिघाणां च iron bars, निःस्वनैः by the resound of speed, सप्तसागराः the seven seas, क्षुभिताः agitated
explanation: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.

shloka_text: तत्प्रवृतंपुनर्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.16।। गदानांमुसलानां च परिघाणांचनिस्स्वनैः । शराणांपुङ्खवातैश्चक्षुभितास्सप्तसागराः ।।6.110.17।।
transliteration: tatpravṛtaṃpunaryuddhaṃtumulaṃromaharṣaṇam  gadānāṃmusalānāṃ ca parighāṇāṃcanissvanaiḥ | śarāṇāṃpuṅkhavātaiścakṣubhitāssaptasāgarāḥ
translation: तत् then, प्रवृतं ensued, पुनः again, युद्धम् war, तुमुलम् tumultuous, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, गदानाम् with maces, मुसलानां च and mallets, परिघाणां च iron bars, निःस्वनैः by the resound of speed, सप्तसागराः the seven seas, क्षुभिताः agitated
explanation: Once again ensued a tumultuous war fought with maces, mallets, and iron bars, caused hair to stand and the resound of the speed of weapons caused agitation in the seven seas.

shloka_text: क्षुब्दानांसागराणां च पातालतलवासिनः । व्यथितादानवाःसर्वेपन्नगाश्चसहस्रशः ।।6.110.18।।
transliteration: kṣubdānāṃsāgarāṇāṃ ca pātālatalavāsinaḥ | vyathitādānavāḥsarvepannagāścasahasraśaḥ
translation: क्षुब्दानाम् sounds, सागराणाम् in the seas, पातालतलवासिनः inhabiting the subterranean region, सर्वे all, दानवाःDanavas, सहस्रशःthousands, पन्नगाश्च snakes, व्यथिताः distressed
explanation: By the agitation and sounds in the seas, all the Danavas and snakes in thousands inhabiting the seas got distressed.

shloka_text: चकम्पेमेदिनीकृत्स्नासशैलवनकानना । भास्करोनिष्प्रभश्चासीन्नवनौचापिमारुतः ।।6.110.19।।
transliteration: cakampemedinīkṛtsnāsaśailavanakānanā | bhāskaroniṣprabhaścāsīnnavanaucāpimārutaḥ
translation: सशैलवनकानना with mountains, gardens, forests, कृत्स्ना dark, मेदिनी earth, चकम्पे shook, भास्करश्च even the sun, निष्प्रभः lost radiance, आसीत् not move, मारुतश्चापि even the wind, न ववौ not blow
explanation: The entire globe with its mountains, gardens and forests shook, the Sun lost his radiance, even the wind did not blow.

shloka_text: ततोदेवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्चपरमर्षयः । चिन्तामापेदिरेसर्वेसकिन्नरमहोरगाः ।।6.110.20।।
transliteration: tatodevāssagandharvāssiddhāścaparamarṣayaḥ | cintāmāpediresarvesakinnaramahoragāḥ
translation: ततः then, सगन्धर्वाः the Gandharvas, देवाःDevas, सिद्धाश्च Siddhas, परमर्षयः great sages, सकिन्नरमहोरगाः Kinneras, and huge serpents, सर्वे all, चिन्ताम् anxiety, अपेदिरे became
explanation: Thereafter, the Gandharvas, Devas, Siddhas, great sages, Kinneras and huge serpents all of them became anxious.

shloka_text: स्वस्तिगोब्राह्मणेभ्योऽस्तुलोकास्तिष्ठन्तुशाश्वताः । जयतांराघयसङ्ख्येरावणंराक्षसेश्वरम् ।।6.110.21।। एवंजपन्तोऽपश्यंस्तेदेवास्सर्षिगणास्तदा । रामरावणयोर्युद्धंसुघोरंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.22।।
transliteration: svastigobrāhmaṇebhyo'stulokāstiṣṭhantuśāśvatāḥ | jayatāṃrāghayasaṅkhyerāvaṇaṃrākṣaseśvaram  evaṃjapanto'paśyaṃstedevāssarṣigaṇāstadā | rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃsughoraṃromaharṣaṇam
translation: तदा then, सर्षिगणाः hosts of sages, ते the, देवाः Devas, गोब्राह्मणेभ्यः  cows, brahmanas, स्वस्ति be auspicious, अस्तु be, लोकाः worlds, शाश्वताः ever, तिष्ठन्तु endure, राघवः Raghava, संख्ये large numbers, राक्षसेश्वरम् Rakshasa king, रावणम् Ravana, जयताम् conquer, एवम् in that way, जपन्तः chanted, घोरम् terrific, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् war, अपश्यन् witnessed
explanation: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.

shloka_text: स्वस्तिगोब्राह्मणेभ्योऽस्तुलोकास्तिष्ठन्तुशाश्वताः । जयतांराघयसङ्ख्येरावणंराक्षसेश्वरम् ।।6.110.21।। एवंजपन्तोऽपश्यंस्तेदेवास्सर्षिगणास्तदा । रामरावणयोर्युद्धंसुघोरंरोमहर्षणम् ।।6.110.22।।
transliteration: svastigobrāhmaṇebhyo'stulokāstiṣṭhantuśāśvatāḥ | jayatāṃrāghayasaṅkhyerāvaṇaṃrākṣaseśvaram  evaṃjapanto'paśyaṃstedevāssarṣigaṇāstadā | rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃsughoraṃromaharṣaṇam
translation: तदा then, सर्षिगणाः hosts of sages, ते the, देवाः Devas, गोब्राह्मणेभ्यः  cows, brahmanas, स्वस्ति be auspicious, अस्तु be, लोकाः worlds, शाश्वताः ever, तिष्ठन्तु endure, राघवः Raghava, संख्ये large numbers, राक्षसेश्वरम् Rakshasa king, रावणम् Ravana, जयताम् conquer, एवम् in that way, जपन्तः chanted, घोरम् terrific, रोमहर्षणम् caused hair to stand, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् war, अपश्यन् witnessed
explanation: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.

shloka_text: गन्धर्वाप्सरसांसङ्घादृष्टवायुद्धमनूपमम् । गगनंगगनाकारंसागरस्सागरोपमः ।।6.110.23।। रामरावणयोर्युद्धंरामरावणयोरिव । एवंब्रुवन्तोददृशुस्तद्युद्धंरामरावणम् ।।6.110.24।।
transliteration: gandharvāpsarasāṃsaṅghādṛṣṭavāyuddhamanūpamam | gaganaṃgaganākāraṃsāgarassāgaropamaḥ  rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃrāmarāvaṇayoriva | evaṃbruvantodadṛśustadyuddhaṃrāmarāvaṇam
translation: गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् Gandharvas and Apsaras, सङ्घाः combination, अनूपमम् unimaginable, युद्धम् war, दृष्टवा watching, गगनम् sky, गगनाकारम् sky is its own analogue, सागरःsea, गरोपमः sea is its own compeer, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् fight, रामरावणयोः likened Rama and Ravana's struggle, युद्धम् combat, रामरावणयोरिव both Rama and Ravana, एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवन्तः said, रामरावणम् Rama and Ravana, तत् that, युद्धम् war, ददृशुः looked
explanation: Gandharvas and Apsaras watching the combination of Rama and Ravana fighting an unimaginable war said that sky is its own analogue for sky, sea is its own analogue to sea, in the same way is the struggle between Rama and Ravana is unique like Rama and Ravana's struggle and looked at the combat.

shloka_text: गन्धर्वाप्सरसांसङ्घादृष्टवायुद्धमनूपमम् । गगनंगगनाकारंसागरस्सागरोपमः ।।6.110.23।। रामरावणयोर्युद्धंरामरावणयोरिव । एवंब्रुवन्तोददृशुस्तद्युद्धंरामरावणम् ।।6.110.24।।
transliteration: gandharvāpsarasāṃsaṅghādṛṣṭavāyuddhamanūpamam | gaganaṃgaganākāraṃsāgarassāgaropamaḥ  rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃrāmarāvaṇayoriva | evaṃbruvantodadṛśustadyuddhaṃrāmarāvaṇam
translation: गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् Gandharvas and Apsaras, सङ्घाः combination, अनूपमम् unimaginable, युद्धम् war, दृष्टवा watching, गगनम् sky, गगनाकारम् sky is its own analogue, सागरःsea, गरोपमः sea is its own compeer, रामरावणयोः both Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् fight, रामरावणयोः likened Rama and Ravana's struggle, युद्धम् combat, रामरावणयोरिव both Rama and Ravana, एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवन्तः said, रामरावणम् Rama and Ravana, तत् that, युद्धम् war, ददृशुः looked
explanation: Gandharvas and Apsaras watching the combination of Rama and Ravana fighting an unimaginable war said that sky is its own analogue for sky, sea is its own analogue to sea, in the same way is the struggle between Rama and Ravana is unique like Rama and Ravana's struggle and looked at the combat.

shloka_text: ततःक्रोधान्महाबासूरघूणांकीर्तिवर्धनः । सन्धायधनुषारामश्शरमाशीविषोपमम् ।।6.110.25।। रावणस्यशिरोऽच्छिन्दच्छ्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम् । तछचिरःपतितंभूमौदृष्टंइलोकैस्त्रिभिस्तदा ।।6.110.26।।
transliteration: tataḥkrodhānmahābāsūraghūṇāṃkīrtivardhanaḥ | sandhāyadhanuṣārāmaśśaramāśīviṣopamam  rāvaṇasyaśiro'cchindacchrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam | tachaciraḥpatitaṃbhūmaudṛṣṭaṃilokaistribhistadā
translation: ततः then, महाबहुः mighty armed, रघूणाम् Raghava, कीर्तिवर्धनः enhancer of glory, रामः Rama, क्रोधात् in wrath, धनुषा bow, आशिविषोपमम् like a venomous snake, शरम् arrows, सन्धाय fitting, श्रीम् graced, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् shining earrings, रावणस्यशिरः Ravana's head, अच्छिन्दत् cut off, तदा then, भूमौ on earth surface, पतितम् fallen, तत् that, शिरः head, त्रिभिः three, लोकैः in the world, दृष्टम् witnessed
explanation: Then the mighty armed Raghava, enhancer of glory, in wrath like a venomous snake, fitting the bow with arrows cut off the head of Ravana graced with shining earrings. Then the three worlds witnessed the head cut off and fallen on the earth surface.

shloka_text: ततःक्रोधान्महाबासूरघूणांकीर्तिवर्धनः । सन्धायधनुषारामश्शरमाशीविषोपमम् ।।6.110.25।। रावणस्यशिरोऽच्छिन्दच्छ्रीमज्ज्वलितकुण्डलम् । तछचिरःपतितंभूमौदृष्टंइलोकैस्त्रिभिस्तदा ।।6.110.26।।
transliteration: tataḥkrodhānmahābāsūraghūṇāṃkīrtivardhanaḥ | sandhāyadhanuṣārāmaśśaramāśīviṣopamam  rāvaṇasyaśiro'cchindacchrīmajjvalitakuṇḍalam | tachaciraḥpatitaṃbhūmaudṛṣṭaṃilokaistribhistadā
translation: ततः then, महाबहुः mighty armed, रघूणाम् Raghava, कीर्तिवर्धनः enhancer of glory, रामः Rama, क्रोधात् in wrath, धनुषा bow, आशिविषोपमम् like a venomous snake, शरम् arrows, सन्धाय fitting, श्रीम् graced, ज्वलितकुण्डलम् shining earrings, रावणस्यशिरः Ravana's head, अच्छिन्दत् cut off, तदा then, भूमौ on earth surface, पतितम् fallen, तत् that, शिरः head, त्रिभिः three, लोकैः in the world, दृष्टम् witnessed
explanation: Then the mighty armed Raghava, enhancer of glory, in wrath like a venomous snake, fitting the bow with arrows cut off the head of Ravana graced with shining earrings. Then the three worlds witnessed the head cut off and fallen on the earth surface.

shloka_text: तस्यैवसदृशंचान्यद्रावणस्योत्थितंशिरः । तत्क्षिप्तंक्षिप्रहस्तेनरामेणक्षिप्रकारिणा ।।6.110.27।।
transliteration: tasyaivasadṛśaṃcānyadrāvaṇasyotthitaṃśiraḥ | tatkṣiptaṃkṣiprahastenarāmeṇakṣiprakāriṇā
translation: तस्यैव similar, सदृशम् looking similar, अन्यत् another, रावणस्य Ravana's, शिरः head, उत्थितम् arose, तत् that, क्षिप्रहस्तेन cut off by hand, क्षिप्रकारिणा quick with hand, रामेण by Rama, क्षिप्तम् cut off
explanation: A similar looking head arose on Ravana's head. Rama, endowed with a quick hand, cut off by his hand the other head.

shloka_text: द्वितीयंरावणशिरश्छिन्नंसम्यतिसायकैः । छिन्नमात्रं च तच्चीर्षंपुनरेवप्रदृश्यते ।।6.110.28।।
transliteration: dvitīyaṃrāvaṇaśiraśchinnaṃsamyatisāyakaiḥ | chinnamātraṃ ca taccīrṣaṃpunarevapradṛśyate
translation: सम्यति before that, द्वितीयम् second, रावणशिरः Ravana's head, सायकैः by arrows, छिन्नम् cut off, तत् that, शीर्षम् head, छिन्नमात्रम् as he cut, पुनरेव again, दृश्यते appeared
explanation: Before cutting that second head of Ravana again another head appeared.

shloka_text: तदप्यशनिसङ्काशैश्छिन्नंरामस्यसायकैः । एवमेवशतंछिन्नंशिरसांतुल्यवर्चसाम् ।।6.110.29।।
transliteration: tadapyaśanisaṅkāśaiśchinnaṃrāmasyasāyakaiḥ | evamevaśataṃchinnaṃśirasāṃtulyavarcasām
translation: तदपि in that way, अशनिसङ्काशैः like thunderbolt of Indra, रामसायकैःRama's arrows, छिन्नम् cut off, एवमेव in that place, तुल्यवर्चसाम् equally charming, शिरसाम् head, शतम् hundred, छिन्नम् struck off
explanation: Rama cut off the afore said head with Indra's thunderbolt like arrows. In that way equally charming a hundred heads were struck off.

shloka_text: न चैवरावणस्यान्तोदृश्यतेजीवितक्षये । ततस्सर्वास्त्रविद्वीरःकौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः ।।6.110.30।। मार्गणैर्बहुभिर्युक्तश्चिन्तयामासराघवः ।
transliteration: na caivarāvaṇasyāntodṛśyatejīvitakṣaye | tatassarvāstravidvīraḥkausalyānandavardhanaḥ  mārgaṇairbahubhiryuktaścintayāmāsarāghavaḥ |
translation: रावणस्य Ravana's, जीवितक्षये life not ceased, अन्तः end, न चैवदृश्यते not able to see, ततः then, सर्वास्त्रवित् knower of all knowledge, वीरः valiant, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of Kausalya's joy, बहुभिः many, मार्गणैः ways, युक्तः well versed, राघवःRaghava, चिन्तयामास started thinking
explanation: Rama, knower of all shastras, valiant, enhancer of Kausalya's joy, well versed in the use of weapons, was not able to see the end of Ravana's life. He started thinking.

shloka_text: मारीचोनिहतोयैस्तुखरोयैस्तुसदूषणः ।।6.110.31।। क्रौञ्चावनेविराधस्तुकबन्धोदण्डकेवने । यैस्सालागिरयोभग्नावाली च क्षुभितोऽम्बुधिः ।।6.110.32।। त इमेसायकास्सर्वेयुद्धेप्रात्ययिकामम किनुतत्कारणंयेनरावणेमन्दतेजसः ।।6.110.33।।
transliteration: mārīconihatoyaistukharoyaistusadūṣaṇaḥ  krauñcāvanevirādhastukabandhodaṇḍakevane | yaissālāgirayobhagnāvālī ca kṣubhito'mbudhiḥ  ta imesāyakāssarveyuddheprātyayikāmama kinutatkāraṇaṃyenarāvaṇemandatejasaḥ
translation: यैः by which, मारीचः Maricha, निहतः killed, यैः he, सदूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, क्रौञ्चानने in Krauncha, कबन्धः Kabhanda, दण्डकानने in Dandaka forest, विराधःतु Virada also, यैः by which, सालाःSala, गिरयः mountain, भग्नाः broken, वाली च Vali also, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitation, वाली च and Vali, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitated, ते they, मेसायकाः by my arrows, सर्वे all, मम my, युद्धे war, प्रात्ययिकाः wasted, येन by which, रावणे Ravana, मन्दतेजसः less brilliant, तत् that, कारणम् reason, किंनु What is it
explanation: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'

shloka_text: मारीचोनिहतोयैस्तुखरोयैस्तुसदूषणः ।।6.110.31।। क्रौञ्चावनेविराधस्तुकबन्धोदण्डकेवने । यैस्सालागिरयोभग्नावाली च क्षुभितोऽम्बुधिः ।।6.110.32।। त इमेसायकास्सर्वेयुद्धेप्रात्ययिकामम किनुतत्कारणंयेनरावणेमन्दतेजसः ।।6.110.33।।
