explanation: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'

shloka_text: मारीचोनिहतोयैस्तुखरोयैस्तुसदूषणः ।।6.110.31।। क्रौञ्चावनेविराधस्तुकबन्धोदण्डकेवने । यैस्सालागिरयोभग्नावाली च क्षुभितोऽम्बुधिः ।।6.110.32।। त इमेसायकास्सर्वेयुद्धेप्रात्ययिकामम किनुतत्कारणंयेनरावणेमन्दतेजसः ।।6.110.33।।
transliteration: mārīconihatoyaistukharoyaistusadūṣaṇaḥ  krauñcāvanevirādhastukabandhodaṇḍakevane | yaissālāgirayobhagnāvālī ca kṣubhito'mbudhiḥ  ta imesāyakāssarveyuddheprātyayikāmama kinutatkāraṇaṃyenarāvaṇemandatejasaḥ
translation: यैः by which, मारीचः Maricha, निहतः killed, यैः he, सदूषणः Dushana, खरः Khara, क्रौञ्चानने in Krauncha, कबन्धः Kabhanda, दण्डकानने in Dandaka forest, विराधःतु Virada also, यैः by which, सालाःSala, गिरयः mountain, भग्नाः broken, वाली च Vali also, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitation, वाली च and Vali, अम्बुधिः ocean, क्षुभितः agitated, ते they, मेसायकाः by my arrows, सर्वे all, मम my, युद्धे war, प्रात्ययिकाः wasted, येन by which, रावणे Ravana, मन्दतेजसः less brilliant, तत् that, कारणम् reason, किंनु What is it
explanation: 'Earlier, by my arrows, Maricha was killed, Dushana and Khara were killed, Kabhanda was killed in Krauncha forest, Virada was killed in Dandaka forest. By which arrows Sala trees were cut off, mountain was broken, ocean was agitated, and Vali was killed, are wasted with Ravana, who is less brilliant in war. What is the reason?'

shloka_text: इतिचिन्तापरश्चासीदप्रमत्तश्चसम्युगे । ववर्षशरवर्षाणीराघवोरावणोरसि ।।6.110.34।।
transliteration: iticintāparaścāsīdapramattaścasamyuge | vavarṣaśaravarṣāṇīrāghavorāvaṇorasi
translation: राघवः Raghava, सम्युगे in that duel, इति thus, चिन्तापरः started thinking, अप्रमत्तश्च very alert, आसीत् not move, रावणोरसि Ravana's chest, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, ववर्ष rained
explanation: Even though Raghava was thinking so, yet remaining alert in the duel, rained arrows on Ravana's chest.

shloka_text: रावणोऽपिततःक्रुद्धोरथस्थोराक्षसेश्वरः । गदामुसलवर्षेणरामंप्रत्यर्दयद्रणे ।।6.110.35।।
transliteration: rāvaṇo'pitataḥkruddhorathasthorākṣaseśvaraḥ | gadāmusalavarṣeṇarāmaṃpratyardayadraṇe
translation: वीरः valiant, राघवः Raghava, रिपोः enemy, स्यन्दने in chariot, विंशतिम् seated, त्रिंशतिम् three hundred, षष्टिम् sixties, अथ and, शतशः hundreds, सहस्रशः thousands, सायकान् arrows, मुमोच released
explanation: Valiant enemy of Raghava also seated in the chariot, rained three hundred, sixties, hundreds, and thousands of arrows.

shloka_text: तत्प्रवृत्तंमहद्युद्धंतुमुलंरोमहर्षणम् । अन्तरिक्षे च भूमौ च पुनश्चगिरिमूर्धनि ।।6.110.36।।
transliteration: tatpravṛttaṃmahadyuddhaṃtumulaṃromaharṣaṇam | antarikṣe ca bhūmau ca punaścagirimūrdhani
translation: तुमुलम् fierce, रोमहर्षणम् horipulating, महत् great, तत् that, युद्धम् war, अन्तरिक्षे च even in the sky, भूमौ च also on earth, पुनश्च again, गिरिमूर्धनि on top of mountain, प्रवृत्तम् commenced again
explanation: Great war commenced in the sky, as well as on the earth, and on top of mountain again, which was horipulating,

shloka_text: देवदानवयक्षाणांपिशाचोरगरक्षसाम् । पश्यतांतन्महायुद्धंसप्तरात्रमवर्तत ।।6.110.37।।
transliteration: devadānavayakṣāṇāṃpiśācoragarakṣasām | paśyatāṃtanmahāyuddhaṃsaptarātramavartata
translation: देवदानवयक्षाणाम् Devas, Danavas, Yakshas, पिशाचोरगरक्षसाम् demons, Nagas, and Rakshasas, पश्यताम् watched, तत् that, महायुद्धम् great war, सप्तरात्रम् seven nights and days, अवर्तत continued
explanation: The Devas, Danavas, Yakshasas also the fiends Demon, Nagas and Rakshasas watched the great war that continued for seven days and nights.

shloka_text: नैव रात्रिं न दिवसंमुहूर्तं न च क्षणम् । रामरावणयोर्युद्धंविराममुपगच्छति ।।6.110.38।।
transliteration: naiva rātriṃ na divasaṃmuhūrtaṃ na ca kṣaṇam | rāmarāvaṇayoryuddhaṃvirāmamupagacchati
translation: रामरावणयोः Rama and Ravana, युद्धम् fight, रात्रिम् night, विरामम् ceased, न उपगच्छति started, दिवसम् all day, न not, मुहूर्तम् a moment, न not, क्षणं च not a second, न not
explanation: The fight between Rama and Ravana continued all day and night, without stopping for a moment.

shloka_text: अथसंस्मारयामासमातलिराघवंतदा । अजानन्निवकिंवीरत्वमेनमनुवर्तसे ।।6.111.1।।
transliteration: athasaṃsmārayāmāsamātalirāghavaṃtadā | ajānannivakiṃvīratvamenamanuvartase
translation: अथ and तदा then, मातलिः Matali, राघवम् to Raghava, संस्मारयामास reminded, वीर hero, अजानन्निव as if you don't know, त्वम् you, एनम् in that way, किम् why, अनुवर्तसे are you doing
explanation: Matali reminded Rama in this way," O heroic Rama, why are you doing this way, as if you do not know?"
comments: Rama uses Brahmastra and kills Ravana. The terror of all worlds killed. Charanas and Devas were filled with joy.

shloka_text: विसृजास्मैवधायत्वमस्त्रंपैतामहंप्रभो । विनाशकालःकथितोःयःसुरैःसोऽद्यवर्तते ।।6.111.2।।
transliteration: visṛjāsmaivadhāyatvamastraṃpaitāmahaṃprabho | vināśakālaḥkathitoḥyaḥsuraiḥso'dyavartate
translation: प्रभो king, त्वम् you, वधाय destruction, अस्मै you, पैतामहम् creator Brahma, अस्त्रम् missile, विसृज use, सुरैः Suras, यः they, विनाशकालः for the destruction, कथितः spoken, सः he, अद्य now, वर्तते use
explanation: "O king! As spoken by Suras, the destruction of Ravana has come now. Use the missile of the creator Brahma."

shloka_text: ततःसंस्मारितोरामस्तेनवाक्येनमातलेः । जग्राह स शरंदीप्तंनिःश्वसन्तमिवोरगम् ।।6.111.3।। यंतस्मैप्रथमंप्रादादगस्त्योभगवानृषिः । ब्रह्मदत्तंमहाबाणममोघंयुधिवीर्यवान् ।।6.111.4।।
transliteration: tataḥsaṃsmāritorāmastenavākyenamātaleḥ | jagrāha sa śaraṃdīptaṃniḥśvasantamivoragam  yaṃtasmaiprathamaṃprādādagastyobhagavānṛṣiḥ | brahmadattaṃmahābāṇamamoghaṃyudhivīryavān
translation: ततः then, मातलेः by Matali, तेनवाक्येन by that suggestion, संस्मारितः reminded of, वीर्यवान् valiant, रामः Rama, ब्रह्मदत्तम् bestowed by Brahma, युधि in war, अमोघम् wonderful, यम् that which, महाबाणम् great arrow, प्रथमम् first, भगवान् divine, अगस्त्यः by Agastya, ऋषिःsage, तस्मै that, पादात्, दीप्तम् glowing, निःश्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, उरगम् इव like serpent, शरम् shaft, जग्राह seized hold of
explanation: Suggested and reminded by Matali, valiant Sri Rama seized hold of the wonderful glowing arrow, bestowed by Brahma, and given by the divine to sage Agastya first. Breathing heavily, like a serpent, Rama seized the arrow.

shloka_text: ततःसंस्मारितोरामस्तेनवाक्येनमातलेः । जग्राह स शरंदीप्तंनिःश्वसन्तमिवोरगम् ।।6.111.3।। यंतस्मैप्रथमंप्रादादगस्त्योभगवानृषिः । ब्रह्मदत्तंमहाबाणममोघंयुधिवीर्यवान् ।।6.111.4।।
transliteration: tataḥsaṃsmāritorāmastenavākyenamātaleḥ | jagrāha sa śaraṃdīptaṃniḥśvasantamivoragam  yaṃtasmaiprathamaṃprādādagastyobhagavānṛṣiḥ | brahmadattaṃmahābāṇamamoghaṃyudhivīryavān
translation: ततः then, मातलेः by Matali, तेनवाक्येन by that suggestion, संस्मारितः reminded of, वीर्यवान् valiant, रामः Rama, ब्रह्मदत्तम् bestowed by Brahma, युधि in war, अमोघम् wonderful, यम् that which, महाबाणम् great arrow, प्रथमम् first, भगवान् divine, अगस्त्यः by Agastya, ऋषिःsage, तस्मै that, पादात्, दीप्तम् glowing, निःश्वसन्तम् breathing heavily, उरगम् इव like serpent, शरम् shaft, जग्राह seized hold of
explanation: Suggested and reminded by Matali, valiant Sri Rama seized hold of the wonderful glowing arrow, bestowed by Brahma, and given by the divine to sage Agastya first. Breathing heavily, like a serpent, Rama seized the arrow.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मणानिर्मितंपूर्वमिन्द्रार्थममितौजसा । दत्तंसुरपतेःपूर्वंत्रिलोकजयकाङ्क्षिणः ।।6.111.5।।
transliteration: brahmaṇānirmitaṃpūrvamindrārthamamitaujasā | dattaṃsurapateḥpūrvaṃtrilokajayakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
translation: पूर्वम् earlier, इन्द्रार्थम् for Indra's sake, अमितेजसा very powerful, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, निर्मितम् for the sake, पूर्वम् earlier, त्रिलोकजयकाङ्क्षिणः desirous to gain the three worlds, सुरपतेः king of gods, दत्तम् bestowed
explanation: Earlier, this powerful arrow was created for Indra's sake by Brahma and was bestowed to Indra, the king of gods, who was desirous of conquering the three worlds.

shloka_text: यस्यवाजेषुपवनःफलेपावकभास्करौ । शरीरमाकाशमयंगौरवेमेरुमन्दरौ ।।6.111.6।।
transliteration: yasyavājeṣupavanaḥphalepāvakabhāskarau | śarīramākāśamayaṃgauravemerumandarau
translation: यस्य its, वाजेषु feathers, पवनः presided by wind god, फले head, पावकभास्करौ presided by fire and Sun god, गौरवे energy, मेरुमन्दरौ Meru and Mandara presided over, शरीरम् body, आकाशमयम् like sky
explanation: The wind god presided over its feathers, the fire god and the Sun god presided over its head, its energy was presided over by Meru and Mandara mountains and its weight by the sky.

shloka_text: जाज्वल्यमानंवपुषासुपुङ्खंहेमभूषितम् । तेजसासर्वभूतानांकृतंभास्करवर्चसम् ।।6.111.7।।
transliteration: jājvalyamānaṃvapuṣāsupuṅkhaṃhemabhūṣitam | tejasāsarvabhūtānāṃkṛtaṃbhāskaravarcasam
translation: वपुषा form, जाज्वल्यमानम् shining, सुपुङ्खम् the feathers, हेमभूषितम्decked with gold, सर्वभूतानाम् all beings, तेजसा splendid, कृतम् crafted, भास्करवर्चसम् like the Sun in brilliance
explanation: Its form was shining with feathers, decked with gold, splendid with all elements and brilliant like the sun.

shloka_text: सधूममिवकालानगिंदीप्तमाशीविषोपमम् । नरनागाश्ववृद्धानांभेदनंक्षिप्रकारिणम् ।।6.111.8।।
transliteration: sadhūmamivakālānagiṃdīptamāśīviṣopamam | naranāgāśvavṛddhānāṃbhedanaṃkṣiprakāriṇam
translation: सधूमम् its fire, कालानगिम् इव like the universal dissolution, दीप्तम् burning, अशीविषोपमम् like the venomous serpent, नरनागरश्ववृद्धानाम् hosts of men, elephants, horses of enemies, भेदनम् splitting, क्षिप्रकारिणम् quick in action
explanation: Like fire at the time of dissolution of the universe, burning like venomous serpent, capable of splitting hosts of enemy, men, elephants, and horses and quick in action.

shloka_text: द्वाराणांपरिघाणां च गिरीणांचापिभेदनम् । नानारुधिरदिग्धाङ्गंमेदोदिग्धंसुदारुणम् ।।6.111.9।।
transliteration: dvārāṇāṃparighāṇāṃ ca girīṇāṃcāpibhedanam | nānārudhiradigdhāṅgaṃmedodigdhaṃsudāruṇam
translation: द्वाराणाम् gateways, परिघाणाम् iron bars, गिरीणांचापि even mountains, भेदनम् splitting, नानारुधिरदिग्धाङ्गम् smeared with blood of various Asuras, मेदोदिग्धम् marrow of the brain, सुदारुणम् of dreadful appearance
explanation: Capable of splitting gateways, iron bars, even mountains, smeared with blood and brain marrow of various Asuras, of dreadful appearance.

shloka_text: वज्रसारंमहानादंनानासमितिदारणम् । सर्ववित्रासनंभीमंश्वसन्तमिवपन्नगम् ।।6.111.10।।
transliteration: vajrasāraṃmahānādaṃnānāsamitidāraṇam | sarvavitrāsanaṃbhīmaṃśvasantamivapannagam
translation: वज्रसारम् strong as thunderbolt, महानादम् loud sounding, नानासमितिदारणम् dispersing every deceitful kind of army, सर्ववित्रासनम् frightening all kinds of beings, श्वसन्तम् hissing, पन्नगम् serpent, इव like
explanation: Strong as thunderbolt, loud sounding, dispersing every deceitful kind of army, frightening to all kinds of beings, hissing like a serpent.

shloka_text: कङ्कगृध्रबकानां च गोमायुगणरक्षसाम् । नित्यंभक्षप्रदंयुद्धेयमरूपंभयापहम् ।।6.111.11।।
transliteration: kaṅkagṛdhrabakānāṃ ca gomāyugaṇarakṣasām | nityaṃbhakṣapradaṃyuddheyamarūpaṃbhayāpaham
translation: युद्धे in war, कङ्कगृध्राबकानां च buzzards, vultures, herons कोमायुगणरक्षसाम् jackals and Rakshasas, नित्यम् always, भक्षप्रदम् provider of food, यमरूपम् form of Yama, भयावहम् causing terror
explanation: In war, it provides food for buzzards, vultures, and herons, and also jackals and Rakshasas, causing terror in the form of Yama (God of death).

shloka_text: नन्दनंवानरेन्द्राणांरक्षसामवसादनम् । वाजितंविविधैर्वाजैश्चारुचित्रैर्गरुत्मतः ।।6.111.12।।
transliteration: nandanaṃvānarendrāṇāṃrakṣasāmavasādanam | vājitaṃvividhairvājaiścārucitrairgarutmataḥ
translation: वानरेन्द्राणाम् for Vanara chiefs, नन्दनम् delight, रक्षसाम् for Rakshasas, अवसादनम् causes destruction, गरुत्मतः for eagles, चित्रैः picturesque, विविधैः several, वाजैः for arrows, वाजितम् plumes
explanation: Provides delight for Vanara chiefs, causes destruction of Rakshasas, provides picturesque plumes of eagles to arrows.

shloka_text: तमुत्तमेषुंलोकानामिक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम् । द्विषतांकीर्तिहरणंप्रहर्षकरमात्मनः ।।6.111.13।। अभिम्नत्यततोरामस्तंमहेषुंमहाबलः । वेदप्रोक्तेनविधिनासन्दधेकार्मुकेबली ।।6.111.14।।
transliteration: tamuttameṣuṃlokānāmikṣvākubhayanāśanam | dviṣatāṃkīrtiharaṇaṃpraharṣakaramātmanaḥ  abhimnatyatatorāmastaṃmaheṣuṃmahābalaḥ | vedaproktenavidhināsandadhekārmukebalī
translation: महाबलः mighty, बली strong, रामः Rama, लोकानाम् of the world, उत्तमेषुम् great arrow, इक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम् dispellar of fear for Ikshvaku, द्विषताम् of enemies, कीर्तिहरणम् takes away the glory, आत्मनः own, प्रहर्षणम् delighting, तम् that, महेषुम् great arrow, वेदप्रोक्तेन chanting vedas, विधिना as tradition, अभिम्नत्यर charging with mystic power, कार्मुके bow, सन्दधे fitted
explanation: The great arrow, was a dispeller of fear of enemies to Ikshvaku kings, which takes away the glory of enemies, delighting to oneself, chanting vedas as per tradition, charging with mystic power, mighty strong Rama fitted to the bow.

shloka_text: तमुत्तमेषुंलोकानामिक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम् । द्विषतांकीर्तिहरणंप्रहर्षकरमात्मनः ।।6.111.13।। अभिम्नत्यततोरामस्तंमहेषुंमहाबलः । वेदप्रोक्तेनविधिनासन्दधेकार्मुकेबली ।।6.111.14।।
transliteration: tamuttameṣuṃlokānāmikṣvākubhayanāśanam | dviṣatāṃkīrtiharaṇaṃpraharṣakaramātmanaḥ  abhimnatyatatorāmastaṃmaheṣuṃmahābalaḥ | vedaproktenavidhināsandadhekārmukebalī
translation: महाबलः mighty, बली strong, रामः Rama, लोकानाम् of the world, उत्तमेषुम् great arrow, इक्ष्वाकुभयनाशनम् dispellar of fear for Ikshvaku, द्विषताम् of enemies, कीर्तिहरणम् takes away the glory, आत्मनः own, प्रहर्षणम् delighting, तम् that, महेषुम् great arrow, वेदप्रोक्तेन chanting vedas, विधिना as tradition, अभिम्नत्यर charging with mystic power, कार्मुके bow, सन्दधे fitted
explanation: The great arrow, was a dispeller of fear of enemies to Ikshvaku kings, which takes away the glory of enemies, delighting to oneself, chanting vedas as per tradition, charging with mystic power, mighty strong Rama fitted to the bow.

shloka_text: तस्मिन् सधनीयमानेतुराघवेणशरोत्तमे । सर्वभूतानिसन्त्रेसुश्चचाल च वसुन्धरा ।।6.111.15।।
transliteration: tasmin sadhanīyamāneturāghaveṇaśarottame | sarvabhūtānisantresuścacāla ca vasundharā
translation: राघवेण by Raghava, तस्मिन् his own, शरोत्तमे excellent arrow, सधनीयमाने started fixing, सर्वभूतानि all beings, सन्त्रेषु terrified, वसुन्धरा earth, चचाल shook
explanation: As Raghava started fixing his excellent arrow, all beings got terrified and the earth shook.

shloka_text: स रावणायसङ्रुद्धोभृशमायम्यकार्मुकम् । चिक्षेपपरमायत्तःशरंमर्मविदारणम् ।।6.111.16।।
transliteration: sa rāvaṇāyasaṅruddhobhṛśamāyamyakārmukam | cikṣepaparamāyattaḥśaraṃmarmavidāraṇam
translation: सङ्क्रुद्धः very furious, सः he, कार्मुकम् bow, भृशम् fully, आयम्य stretched, परमायत्तः very well prepared, मर्मविदारणम् capable of tearing into vital parts, शरम् arrow, रावणाय on Ravana, चिक्षेप released
explanation: Rama, provoked by anger, stretched the bow to full length, very well prepared, released the arrow on Ravana, which was capable of tearing into the vital parts.

shloka_text: स वज्रइवदुर्धर्षोवज्रिबाहुविसर्जितः । कृतान्तइवचावार्योन्यपतद्रावणोरसि ।।6.111.17।।
transliteration: sa vajraivadurdharṣovajribāhuvisarjitaḥ | kṛtāntaivacāvāryonyapatadrāvaṇorasi
translation: वज्रिबाहुविसर्जितः released from thunderbolt hurled by the arm of Indra, वज्रःइव like thunderbolt, दुर्धर्षः difficult, कृतान्तःइव capable of bringing to an end, अवार्यः prevent, सः that, रावणोरसि into Ravana's chest, न्यपतत् penetrated
explanation: Like the thunderbolt hurled by the arm of Indra, difficult to obstruct, capable of bringing life to an end, that arrow released by Rama penetrated into Ravana's chest.

shloka_text: स विसृष्टोमहावेगश्शरीरान्तकरश्शरः । चिच्छेदहृदयंतस्यरावणस्यदुरात्मनः ।।6.111.18।।
transliteration: sa visṛṣṭomahāvegaśśarīrāntakaraśśaraḥ | cicchedahṛdayaṃtasyarāvaṇasyadurātmanaḥ
translation: विसृष्टः loosed, महावेगः high velocity शरीरान्तकरः putting an end to the body, सःशरः that arrow, दुरात्मनः evil minded, तस्य his, रावणस्य Ravana's, हृदयम् heart, बिभेद split as under
explanation: Loosed at high velocity, that arrow capable of putting an end to the body, split as under the heart of evilminded Ravana

shloka_text: रुधिराक्तस्सवेगेनशरीरान्तकरःशरः । रावणस्यहरन्प्राणान्विवेशधरणीतलम् ।।6.111.19।।
transliteration: rudhirāktassavegenaśarīrāntakaraḥśaraḥ | rāvaṇasyaharanprāṇānviveśadharaṇītalam
translation: शरीरान्तकरः capable of putting an end to the body, सःशरः that arrow, वेगेन speedily, रावणस्य Ravana's, प्राणान् life, हरन् took out, रुधिराक्तः smeared with blood, धरणीतलम् into the ground, विवेश entered
explanation: That arrow which was capable of putting an end to the body took out Ravana's life and smeared with blood, it entered the earth.

shloka_text: स शरोरावणंहत्वारुधिरार्द्रीकृतच्छविः । कृतकर्मानिभृतवत्स्वतूणींपुनराविशत् ।।6.111.20।।
transliteration: sa śarorāvaṇaṃhatvārudhirārdrīkṛtacchaviḥ | kṛtakarmānibhṛtavatsvatūṇīṃpunarāviśat
translation: सःशरः that arrow, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा on killing, रुधिरार्द्रीकृतच्छविः soaked in blood, कृतकर्मा having accomplished the task, निभृतवत् quietly, स्वतूणीम् its quiver, पुनः again, अविशत् reentered
explanation: That arrow of Rama, on killing Ravana, soaked in blood, having accomplished the task quietly reentered its quiver.

shloka_text: तस्यहस्ताद्धतस्याशुकार्मुकं च ससायकम् । निपपातसहप्राणैर्भ्रश्यमानस्यजीवितात् ।।6.111.21।।
transliteration: tasyahastāddhatasyāśukārmukaṃ ca sasāyakam | nipapātasahaprāṇairbhraśyamānasyajīvitāt
translation: हतस्य killed, जीवितात् life, भ्रश्यमानस्य fallen from, तस्य his, हस्तात् hand, ससायकम् arrow, कार्मुकम् bow, आशु with, प्राणैःसह with life breath, निपपात fell
explanation: Thus, when Ravana was killed and lost his life, the bow and arrow in his hand also fell along with his life breath.

shloka_text: गतासुर्भीमवेगस्तुनैरृतेन्द्रोमहाद्युतिः । पपातस्यन्दनाद्भूमौवृत्रोवज्रहतोयथा ।।6.111.22।।
transliteration: gatāsurbhīmavegastunairṛtendromahādyutiḥ | papātasyandanādbhūmauvṛtrovajrahatoyathā
translation: भीमवेगः terrific speed, महाद्युतिः courageous, नैरृतेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas, गतासुः having gone, वज्रहतः killed by thunderbolt, वृत्रःयथा Vrttra, स्यन्दनात् when struck down, भूमौ on earth, पपात fell
explanation: The king of Rakshasas, who possessed terrific speed and courage, having lost life, fell on earth like Vrttra struck down by thunderbolt.

shloka_text: तंदृष्टवापतितंभूमौहतशेषानिशाचराः । हतनाधाभयत्रस्तास्सर्वतस्सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः ।।6.111.23।।
transliteration: taṃdṛṣṭavāpatitaṃbhūmauhataśeṣāniśācarāḥ | hatanādhābhayatrastāssarvatassampradudruvuḥ
translation: भूमौ on earth surface, पतितम् fallen, तम् that, दृष्टवा seeing, हतशेषाः left after killing, निशाचराः night rangers, हतनाथाः Lord killed, भयत्रस्ताः fearing, सर्वतः all over, सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः ran
explanation: Seeing their Lord killed and fallen on the ground, the leftover night rangers fled all over in fear.

shloka_text: सर्वतश्चाभिपेतुस्तान्वानराद्रुमयोधिनः । दशग्रीववधंदृष्टवावानराजितकाशिनः ।।6.111.24।।
transliteration: sarvataścābhipetustānvānarādrumayodhinaḥ | daśagrīvavadhaṃdṛṣṭavāvānarājitakāśinaḥ
translation: द्रुमयोधिनः holding trees, वानराः Vanaras, तान् they, सर्वतःall sides, अभिपेतुः roaming, दशग्रीववधम् killed ten headed Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, वानराः Vanaras, जितकाशिनः triumphant
explanation: Seeing Ravana killed, the Vanaras holding trees went roaming on all sides, feeling triumphant.

shloka_text: अर्दितावानरैर्भ्रष्टालङ्कामभ्यपतन् भयात् । हताश्रयात्वात्करुणैर्भाष्पप्रस्रवणैर्मुखैः ।।6.111.25।।
transliteration: arditāvānarairbhraṣṭālaṅkāmabhyapatan bhayāt | hatāśrayātvātkaruṇairbhāṣpaprasravaṇairmukhaiḥ
translation: वानरैः by Vanaras, अर्दिताः hurt, भ्रष्टाः lost battle, भयात् out of fear, हताश्रयत्वात् their king being killed, करुणैः piteous, बाष्पप्रस्रवणैः eyes filled with tears, मुखैः face, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभ्यपतन् went towards
explanation: The Rakshasas hurt by the Vanaras, lost battle and their king killed, were piteous and went towards Lanka in fear, eyes filled with tears.

shloka_text: ततोविनेदुःसम्हृष्टावानराःजितकाशिनः । वदन्तोराघवजयंरावणस्य ज तद्वधम् ।।6.111.26।।
transliteration: tatovineduḥsamhṛṣṭāvānarāḥjitakāśinaḥ | vadantorāghavajayaṃrāvaṇasya ja tadvadham
translation: ततः then, जितकाशिनः feeling triumphant, वानराः Vanaras, सम्हृष्टाः highly delighted, राघवजयम् Rama's victory, रावणस्य Ravana's, तद्वधं च death of Ravana, वदन्तः shouted, विनेदुः in joy
explanation: Then the Vanaras, feeling triumphant, got highly excited over Rama's victory and the death of Ravana, and shouted aloud in joy.

shloka_text: अथान्तरिक्षेव्यनदत्सौम्यस्त्रिदशदुन्धुभिः । दिव्यगन्धशहस्तत्रमारुतस्सुसुकोववौ ।।6.111.27।।
transliteration: athāntarikṣevyanadatsaumyastridaśadundhubhiḥ | divyagandhaśahastatramārutassusukovavau
translation: अथ and now, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, सौम्याः gods, त्रिदशदुन्धुभिः thirty drums, व्यनदत् sounded, तत्र there, दिव्यगन्धवहः divine fragrance, सुसुखः pleasant, मारुतः breeze, ववौ blew
explanation: And then thirty drums of gods sounded in the sky. Divine fragrant pleasant breeze blew.

shloka_text: निपपातान्तरिक्षाच्चपुष्पवृष्टिस्तदाभुवि । किरन्तीराघवरथंदुरवापामनोहरा ।।6.111.28।।
transliteration: nipapātāntarikṣāccapuṣpavṛṣṭistadābhuvi | kirantīrāghavarathaṃduravāpāmanoharā
translation: तदा then, अन्तरिक्षात् from the heaven, राघवरथम् on Raghava's chariot, किरन्ती covering, दुरवापा difficult to find out, मनोहरा very pleasing, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, भुवि on earth, निपपात fell
explanation: Then from heaven, a very pleasing shower of flowers, difficult to know from where, fell on Raghava's chariot covering it and dropped on the ground.

shloka_text: राघवस्तवसंयुक्तागगने च विशुश्रुवे । साधुसाध्वितिवागग्य्रादेवतानांमहात्मनाम् ।।6.111.29।।
transliteration: rāghavastavasaṃyuktāgagane ca viśuśruve | sādhusādhvitivāgagyrādevatānāṃmahātmanām
translation: महात्मनाम् great soul, देवतानाम् gods too, साधुसाधुइति well done well done, राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता praised Rama, अग्य्रा the foremost, वाक् words, गगने in the heaven, विशुश्रुवे च heard
explanation: The gods too praised Sri Rama, the great soul saying, 'Well done, Well done', from the heaven, which was distinctly heard.

shloka_text: अविवेशमहान् हर्षोदेवानांचारणैःसह । रावणेनिहतेरौद्रेसर्वलोकभयङ्करे ।।6.111.30।।
transliteration: aviveśamahān harṣodevānāṃcāraṇaiḥsaha | rāvaṇenihateraudresarvalokabhayaṅkare
translation: रौद्रे terror, सर्वलोकभयङ्करे of all worlds, रावणे Ravana, निहते killed, चारणैः Charanas, देवानाम् Devas, महान् great, हर्षः joy, अविवेश filled
explanation: When Ravana, a terror of all worlds was killed, the Charanas and Devas were filled with great joy.

shloka_text: ततःसकामंसुग्रीवमङ्गदं च विभीषणम् । चकारराघवःप्रीतोहत्वाराक्षसपुङ्गवम् ।।6.111.31।।
transliteration: tataḥsakāmaṃsugrīvamaṅgadaṃ ca vibhīṣaṇam | cakārarāghavaḥprītohatvārākṣasapuṅgavam
translation: राघवः Raghava, राक्षसपुङ्गवम् foremost of the Rakshasas, हत्वा killed, प्रीतः pleased, राघवः Raghava, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अङ्गदं च and Angada, विभीषणं च Vibheeshana also, सकामम् their desire fulfilled, चकार made them happy
explanation: The foremost of the Rakshasas killed, Raghava was pleased and having fulfilled the desire of Sugriva, Angada, Vibheeshana, he made them happy.

shloka_text: ततःप्रजग्मुःप्रशमंमरुद्गणादिशःप्रसेदुर्विमलंनभोऽभवत् । महीचकम्पे न च मारुतोववौस्थिरप्रभश्चाप्यभवद्दिवाकरः ।।6.111.32।।
transliteration: tataḥprajagmuḥpraśamaṃmarudgaṇādiśaḥprasedurvimalaṃnabho'bhavat | mahīcakampe na ca mārutovavausthiraprabhaścāpyabhavaddivākaraḥ
translation: ततः then, मरुद्गणाः hosts of gods, प्रशमम् tranquil, प्रजग्मुः attained, दिशः quarters, प्रसेदुः brightened, नभः sky, विमलम् clear, अभवत् became, मही earth, न चकम्पे no longer shook, मारुतः wind, ववौ blew, दिवाकरःचापि even the Sun, स्थिरप्रभः steady radiance, अभवत् became
explanation: Then the host of gods attained tranquil, quarters brightened, sky became clear, earth no longer shook, wind blew and even the Sun became steady and radiant.

shloka_text: ततस्तुसुग्रीवविभीषणाङ्गदाःसुहृद्विशिष्टास्सहलक्ष्मणास्तदा । समेत्यहृष्टाविजयेनराघवंरणेऽभिरामंविधिनाभ्यपूजयन् ।।6.111.33।।
transliteration: tatastusugrīvavibhīṣaṇāṅgadāḥsuhṛdviśiṣṭāssahalakṣmaṇāstadā | sametyahṛṣṭāvijayenarāghavaṃraṇe'bhirāmaṃvidhinābhyapūjayan
translation: ततः then, सुहृद्विशिष्टाः coming together, सहलक्ष्मणाः accompanied by Lakshmana, सुग्रीवविभीषणाङ्गदाः Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada, रणे in the battle, विजयेन by the victory, हृष्टाः happy, अभिरामम् charming, रामम् Rama, समेत्य friends together, तदा then, विधिना as tradition goes, अभ्यपूजयन् offered prayers
explanation: Then all of them (hosts of gods) coming together, accompanied by Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada along with other friends, happy about the victory in the battle offered prayers to charming Sri Rama in accordance with tradition.

shloka_text: भ्रातरंनिहतंदृष्टवाशयानंनिर्जितंरणे । शोकवेगपरीतात्माविललापविभीषणः ।।6.112.1।।
transliteration: bhrātaraṃnihataṃdṛṣṭavāśayānaṃnirjitaṃraṇe | śokavegaparītātmāvilalāpavibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: रणे battlefield, निर्जितम् without life, निहतम् killed, शयानम् lying, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, शोकवेगपरीतात्मा immersed in sorrow, विललाप lamented
explanation: Vibheeshana, seeing his brother killed and lying in the battlefield, lamented immersed in sorrow.
comments: Vibheeshana laments and Sri Rama consoles him and asks him to conduct the obsequies of Ravana.

shloka_text: वीर विक्रान्त विख्यात प्रवीण नयकोविद । महार्हाशयनोपेतकिंशेषेनिहतोभुवि ।।6.112.2।।
transliteration: vīra vikrānta vikhyāta pravīṇa nayakovida | mahārhāśayanopetakiṃśeṣenihatobhuvi
translation: वीर valiant, विक्रान्त powerful, विख्यात renowned, प्रवीण skilled in all fields, नयकोविद in polity, महार्हशयनोपेत accustomed to sumptuous bed, निहतः killed, भुवि on ground, किम् why, शेषे lying
explanation: "O valiant, powerful and renowned king! You who were skilled in all fields and in polity, accustomed to a sumptuous bed, why are you lying on ground?"

shloka_text: विक्षिप्यदीर्घौनिश्चेष्टौभुजावङ्गभूषितौ । मुकुटेनापवृत्तेनभास्कराकारवर्चसा ।।6.112.3।।
transliteration: vikṣipyadīrghauniśceṣṭaubhujāvaṅgabhūṣitau | mukuṭenāpavṛttenabhāskarākāravarcasā
translation: अङ्गदभूषितौ decked with armlets, निश्चेष्टौ motionless, भुजौ arms, विक्षिप्य broken, अपवृत्ने knocked down, भास्करा Sun, कारवर्चसा charming armlets, मुकुटेन with the crown
explanation: "Decked with armlets, motionless are your arms, broken, knocked down with the crown, radiant like the Sun."

shloka_text: दंवीरसम्प्राप्तंयन्मयापूर्वमीरितम् । काममोहपरीतस्ययत्तन्नरुचितंतव ।।6.112.4।।
transliteration: daṃvīrasamprāptaṃyanmayāpūrvamīritam | kāmamohaparītasyayattannarucitaṃtava
translation: वीर hero, मया by me, यत् this, पूर्वम् earlier, ईरितम् predicted, यत् that which, काममोहपरीतस्य overcome by infatuation, तव your, न रुचितम् not find favour, तत् that, इदम् thus, प्राप्तम् true
explanation: "Hero! That which was predicted by me earlier, which did not find your favour due to your infatuation, has come true."

shloka_text: यन्नदर्पात्प्रहस्तोवानेन्द्रजिन्नापरेजनाः । न कुम्बकर्णोऽतिरथोनातिकायोनरान्तकः ।।6.112.5।। न स्वयंत्वममन्येथास्तस्योदर्कोऽयमागतः ।
transliteration: yannadarpātprahastovānendrajinnāparejanāḥ | na kumbakarṇo'tirathonātikāyonarāntakaḥ  na svayaṃtvamamanyethāstasyodarko'yamāgataḥ |
translation: यत् that which, दर्पात् out of pride, प्रहस्तोवा either Prahastha, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, अपरेजनाः other Rakshasas, न nor, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, न nor, अतिरथः exceeding car warrior, अतिकायः Athikaya, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, न nor, स्वयम् you also, त्वम् your, न अमन्येथाः not cared for, तस्य its, अयम् this, उदर्कः consequence, आगतः has come
explanation: "Either Prahastha or Indrajith or other Rakshasas, or even Kumbhakarna, an exceeding car warrior, nor Atikaya or Naranthaka or you also did not care for my counsel. Its consequence has come now."

shloka_text: गतस्सेतुस्सुनीतीनांगतोधर्मस्यविग्रहः ।।6.112.6।। गतस्सत्त्वस्यसङ्क्षेपःप्रस्तावानांगतिर्गता । आदित्यःपतितोभूमौमग्नस्तमसिचन्द्रमाः ।।6.112.7।। चित्रभानुःप्रशान्तार्चिर्व्यवसायोनिरुद्यमः । अस्मिन्निपतितेवीरे भूमौशस्त्रभृतांवरे ।।6.112.8।।
transliteration: gatassetussunītīnāṃgatodharmasyavigrahaḥ  gatassattvasyasaṅkṣepaḥprastāvānāṃgatirgatā | ādityaḥpatitobhūmaumagnastamasicandramāḥ  citrabhānuḥpraśāntārcirvyavasāyonirudyamaḥ | asminnipatitevīre bhūmauśastrabhṛtāṃvare
translation: शस्त्रभृताम् wielders of weapons, वरे choicest, अस्मिन् वीरे this hero, भूमौ on ground, निपतिते fallen down, सुनीतीनाम् prudent, सेतुः boundary, गतः disappeared, धर्मस्य righteousness, विग्रहः form, गतः departed, सत्त्वस्य repository of might, सङ्क्षेपः thrown down, गतः out of sight, प्रस्तावानाम् praise worthy for all, गतिः position, गता lost, आदित्यः Sun, भूमौ on ground, पतितः fallen, चन्द्रमाः moon, तमसि darkness, मग्नः plunged, चित्रभानुः fire, प्रशान्तार्चिः extinct, व्यवसायः enthusiasm, निरुद्यमः wasted
explanation: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."

shloka_text: गतस्सेतुस्सुनीतीनांगतोधर्मस्यविग्रहः ।।6.112.6।। गतस्सत्त्वस्यसङ्क्षेपःप्रस्तावानांगतिर्गता । आदित्यःपतितोभूमौमग्नस्तमसिचन्द्रमाः ।।6.112.7।। चित्रभानुःप्रशान्तार्चिर्व्यवसायोनिरुद्यमः । अस्मिन्निपतितेवीरे भूमौशस्त्रभृतांवरे ।।6.112.8।।

translation: शस्त्रभृताम् wielders of weapons, वरे choicest, अस्मिन् वीरे this hero, भूमौ on ground, निपतिते fallen down, सुनीतीनाम् prudent, सेतुः boundary, गतः disappeared, धर्मस्य righteousness, विग्रहः form, गतः departed, सत्त्वस्य repository of might, सङ्क्षेपः thrown down, गतः out of sight, प्रस्तावानाम् praise worthy for all, गतिः position, गता lost, आदित्यः Sun, भूमौ on ground, पतितः fallen, चन्द्रमाः moon, तमसि darkness, मग्नः plunged, चित्रभानुः fire, प्रशान्तार्चिः extinct, व्यवसायः enthusiasm, निरुद्यमः wasted
explanation: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."

shloka_text: गतस्सेतुस्सुनीतीनांगतोधर्मस्यविग्रहः ।।6.112.6।। गतस्सत्त्वस्यसङ्क्षेपःप्रस्तावानांगतिर्गता । आदित्यःपतितोभूमौमग्नस्तमसिचन्द्रमाः ।।6.112.7।। चित्रभानुःप्रशान्तार्चिर्व्यवसायोनिरुद्यमः । अस्मिन्निपतितेवीरे भूमौशस्त्रभृतांवरे ।।6.112.8।।

explanation: " As this hero, the wielder of weapons has fallen down on ground, the prudent one who was at boundary, disappeared he who was the form of righteousness, departed he who was a repository of might, thrown down and out of sight he, who was praiseworthy for all, lost position. With the hero falling down, it seems the Sun has fallen down, the moon plunged into darkness, fire became extinct, and the enthusiasm of people wasted."

shloka_text: किंशेषमिहलोकस्यगतसत्त्वस्यसम्प्रति । रणेराक्षसशार्दूलेप्रसुप्तइवपांसुषु ।।6.112.9।।
transliteration: kiṃśeṣamihalokasyagatasattvasyasamprati | raṇerākṣasaśārdūleprasuptaivapāṃsuṣu
translation: राक्षसशार्दूले tiger among Rakshasas, रणे in the battlefield, पांसुषु dust, प्रसुप्तेइव fallen like this asleep, सम्प्रति everything, गतसत्त्वस्य strength departed, लोकस्य in the world, इह now, किम् what, शेषम् is left
explanation: "With the tiger among the Rakshasas fallen asleep like this in the dust in the battlefield, strength of the people departed. What is left in this world?"

shloka_text: धृतिप्रवालःप्रसह्याग्य्रपुष्पस्तपोबलश्शौर्यनिबद्धमूलः । रणेमहान्राक्षसराजवृक्षःसम्मर्दितोराघवमारुतेन ।।6.112.10।।
transliteration: dhṛtipravālaḥprasahyāgyrapuṣpastapobalaśśauryanibaddhamūlaḥ | raṇemahānrākṣasarājavṛkṣaḥsammarditorāghavamārutena
translation: धृतिप्रवालः firmness as leaves, प्रसह्याग्य्रपुष्प stubbornness as blossom, तपोबलः austerity, शौर्यनिबद्धमालः valour as strong roots, महान् great, राक्षसराजवृक्षः tree of Rakshasa king, राघवमारुतेन by the tempest of Raghava, रणे in the battlefield, संमर्धितः crushed
explanation: "The great tree in the form of Rakshasa king, with its firmness as leaves, stubbornness as its blossom, austerity as strength, valour as strong roots, was crushed by the tempest of Raghava in the battlefield."

shloka_text: तेजोविषाणःकुलवंशवंशःकोपप्रसादापरगात्रहस्तः । इक्ष्वाकुसिंहावगृहीतदेहःसुप्तःक्षितौरावणगन्धहस्ती ।।6.112.11।।
transliteration: tejoviṣāṇaḥkulavaṃśavaṃśaḥkopaprasādāparagātrahastaḥ | ikṣvākusiṃhāvagṛhītadehaḥsuptaḥkṣitaurāvaṇagandhahastī
translation: तेजोविषाणः prowess as tusks, कुलवंशवंशः the father and grandfather as back of the body, कोपप्रसादपरगात्रहस्तः wrath as lower body and graciousness as proboscis, रावणगन्धहस्ती, Ravana as the elephant in rut, इक्ष्वाकुसिंसावगृहीतदेहः lion in the shape of king of Ikshvaku race, क्षितौ overthrown on the ground, सुप्तः lying asleep
explanation: "Ravana's prowess as tusks, father and grand fathers' race as back of the body, wrath as lower body and graciousness as proboscis, overthrown by a lion in the shape of Ikshvaku race having killed him he is lying asleep thrown down."

shloka_text: पराक्रमोत्साहविजृम्भितार्चिर्निःश्वासधूमस्स्वबलप्रतापः । प्रतापवान्सम्यतिराक्षसाग्निर्विर्वापितोरामपयोधरेण ।।6.112.12।।
transliteration: parākramotsāhavijṛmbhitārcirniḥśvāsadhūmassvabalapratāpaḥ | pratāpavānsamyatirākṣasāgnirvirvāpitorāmapayodhareṇa
translation: पराक्रमोत्साहविजृम्भितार्चिः prowess and exceeding energy as flames, निःश्वासधूमः sighs as smoke, स्वबलप्रतापः own strength as heat, सम्यति in the battlefield, प्रतापवान् endowed with prowess, राक्षसाग्नि: fire of Rakshasa, रामपयोधरेण by the rainy cloud in the shape of Rama, निर्वापितः extinguished
explanation: "The prowess and exceeding energy of Ravana as flames, his sighs as smoke, his own strength as heat, endowed with might, that fire of Rakshasa has been extinguished by the rainy cloud in the shape of Rama in the battlefield."

shloka_text: सिंहरक्षलाङ्गूलककुद्विषाणःपराभिजिद्गन्धनगन्धहस्ती । रक्षोवृषश्चापलकर्णचक्षुःक्षितीश्वरव्याघ्रहतोऽवसन्नः ।।6.112.13।।
transliteration: siṃharakṣalāṅgūlakakudviṣāṇaḥparābhijidgandhanagandhahastī | rakṣovṛṣaścāpalakarṇacakṣuḥkṣitīśvaravyāghrahato'vasannaḥ
translation: सिंहर्क्षलाङ्गूलककुद्विषाणः Rakshasas as tails, humps, and horns, पराभिजित् the conqueror of its enemies, गन्धनगन्धहस्ती in pride like elephant in rut, चापकर्णचक्षुः animality as ears and eyes, रक्षोवृषः the bull in the form of Rakshasa, क्षितीश्वरव्याघ्रहतः tiger in the form of Rama master of the earth, अवसन्नः gone off
explanation: "Rakshasas who followed as tails, humps and horns, Ravana the conquerors of enemies, like elephants in pride, animality as ears and eyes, the bull in the form of Rakshasa Ravana was killed by Rama, the master of earth in the form of tiger."

shloka_text: वदन्तंहेतुमद्वाक्यंपरिदृष्टार्थनिश्चयम् । रामःशोकसमाविष्टमित्युवाचविभीषणम् ।।6.112.14।।
transliteration: vadantaṃhetumadvākyaṃparidṛṣṭārthaniścayam | rāmaḥśokasamāviṣṭamityuvācavibhīṣaṇam
translation: रामः Rama, वदन्तम् countenance, शोकसमाविष्टम् overcome by sorrow, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, हेतुमत् with reason, परिदृष्टार्थनिश्चयम् determined opinion, वाक्यम् words, इति thus, उवाच spoke
explanation: Thus spoke Rama to Vibheeshana, who was overcome with sorrow and speaking with reason, his determined opinion.

shloka_text: नायंविनष्टोनिश्चेष्टस्समरेचण्डविक्रमः । अत्युन्नतमहोत्साहःपतितोऽयमशङ्कितः ।।6.112.15।।
transliteration: nāyaṃvinaṣṭoniśceṣṭassamarecaṇḍavikramaḥ | atyunnatamahotsāhaḥpatito'yamaśaṅkitaḥ
translation: अयम् this, निश्चेष्टः without power, न विनष्टः not destroyed, समरे in war, चण्डविक्रमः of terrible prowess, अयम् this, अत्युन्नतमहोत्साहः extraordinary enthusiasm, अशङ्कितः without any fear, पतितः fallen
explanation: "This Ravana is not destroyed without power in war. He is of terrible prowess, of extraordinary enthusiasm and fought without any fear and fallen."

shloka_text: नैवंविनष्टाःशोच्यन्तेक्षत्रधर्मव्यवस्थिताः । वृधदिमाशंसमानायेनिपतन्तिरणाजिरे ।।6.112.16।।
transliteration: naivaṃvinaṣṭāḥśocyantekṣatradharmavyavasthitāḥ | vṛdhadimāśaṃsamānāyenipatantiraṇājire
translation: ये those who, क्षत्रधर्मव्यवस्थिताः kings who follow duty steadfast, वृधदिम् desiring advancement, अशंसमानाः fearless, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, निपतन्ति fallen, विनष्टाः lost, एवम् in that way, न शोच्यन्ते not to be mourned
explanation: "Those kings who follow duty steadfast, desiring advancement, fearless in the battlefield, who die in that way should not be mourned."

shloka_text: येनसेन्द्रास्त्रयोलोकास्त्रासितायुधिधीमता । तस्मिन्कालसमायुक्ते न कालःपरिशोचितुम् ।।6.112.17।।
transliteration: yenasendrāstrayolokāstrāsitāyudhidhīmatā | tasminkālasamāyukte na kālaḥpariśocitum
translation: धीमता wise, येन being, युधि war, सेन्द्राः Indra, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, त्रासिताः fear, तस्मिन् his, कालसमायुक्ते brought under the sway of time, परिशोचितुम् to grieve, कालः time, न not
explanation: "He who is wise, and the three worlds fear him, including Indra, the Lord of gods, when brought under the sway of death according to timespirit, should not be mourned."

shloka_text: नैकान्तविजयोयुद्धेभूतपूर्वःकदाचन । परैराहन्यतेवीरःपरान्वाहन्तिसंयुगे ।।6.112.18।।
transliteration: naikāntavijayoyuddhebhūtapūrvaḥkadācana | parairāhanyatevīraḥparānvāhantisaṃyuge
translation: कदाचन not only that, युद्धे in war, एकान्तविजयः victorious alone, न भूतपूर्वः now or before, वीरः heroic, संयुगे in war, परैः enemy, हन्यतेवा will kill, परान् by enemy, हन्तिवा be killed
explanation: "Not only that, in war, he will only will be victorious is not true now or before. Hero may kill the enemy or will be killed by the enemy."

shloka_text: इयंहिपूर्वैस्सन्दिष्टागतिःक्षत्रियसम्मता । क्षत्रियोनिहतंसङ्ख्ये न शोच्यइतिनिश्चयः ।।6.112.19।।
transliteration: iyaṃhipūrvaissandiṣṭāgatiḥkṣatriyasammatā | kṣatriyonihataṃsaṅkhye na śocyaitiniścayaḥ
translation: इयम् this, पूर्वैः in the past, सन्दिष्टा in battle, क्षत्रियसम्मता acceptable for ancient kings, गतिः course, सङ्ख्ये action, निहतः killed, क्षत्रियः king, न शोच्यः not mourned, इति this, निश्चयः is true
explanation: "This course has been practised in the past by ancient kings for those killed in war. Warrior killed in war is not to be mourned', is true."

shloka_text: तदेवंनिश्चयंदृष्टवातत्त्वमास्थायविज्वरः । यदिहानन्तरंकार्यंकल्प्यंतदनुचिन्तय ।।6.112.20।।
transliteration: tadevaṃniścayaṃdṛṣṭavātattvamāsthāyavijvaraḥ | yadihānantaraṃkāryaṃkalpyaṃtadanucintaya
translation: तत् that, एवम् in that way, निश्चयम् determined, दृष्टवा seeing, तत्त्वम् in principle, आस्थाय considering, विज्वरः freed from grief, इह here, अनन्तरम् later, यत् that which, कार्यम् action, कल्प्यम् to be done, तत् that, अनुचिन्तय is required
explanation: In principle, in that way, decide the action, freed from grief, considering what action is required."

shloka_text: मुक्तवाक्यंविक्रान्तंराजपुत्रंविभीषणः । उवाचशोकसन्तप्तोभ्रातुर्हितमनन्तरम् ।।6.112.21।।
transliteration: muktavākyaṃvikrāntaṃrājaputraṃvibhīṣaṇaḥ | uvācaśokasantaptobhrāturhitamanantaram
translation: उक्तवाक्यम् having spoken like that, विक्रान्तम् valiant, तंराजपुत्रम् prince, शोकसन्तप्तः immersed in grief, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, अनन्तरम् after that, भ्रातुः brother, हितम् good, उवाच spoke
explanation: Having spoken that way by the valiant prince to Vibheeshana, who was immersed in grief, spoke to Rama for the good of his brother.

shloka_text: योऽयंविमर्देष्वविभग्नपूर्वःसुरैस्समस्थेरपिवासवेन । भवन्तमासाद्यरणेविभग्नोवेलामिवासाद्ययथासमुद्रः ।।6.112.22।।
transliteration: yo'yaṃvimardeṣvavibhagnapūrvaḥsuraissamastherapivāsavena | bhavantamāsādyaraṇevibhagnovelāmivāsādyayathāsamudraḥ
translation: यः he who, अयम् this, विमर्देषु in battle, स्समस्थेरपि combined together in trial of strength, सुरैरपि even gods, वासवेन by Indra, भग्नपूर्वः not defeated, भवन्तम् by you, आसाद्य routed, वेलाम् flow, आसाद्य routed, समुद्रःयथा like the ocean, रणे in war, विभग्नः divides
explanation: "He who has not been defeated in battle by even gods or Indra combined together in a trial of strength has been routed by you like the flow of the ocean divides on reaching the shore."

shloka_text: अनेनदत्तानिवनीपकेषुभुक्ताश्चभोगानिभृताश्चभृत्याः । धनानिमित्रेषुसमर्पितानिवैराण्यमित्रेषुनिपातितानि ।।6.112.23।।
transliteration: anenadattānivanīpakeṣubhuktāścabhogānibhṛtāścabhṛtyāḥ | dhanānimitreṣusamarpitānivairāṇyamitreṣunipātitāni
translation: अनेन many, वनीपकेषु mendicants, दत्तानि bestowed, भोगाश्च gifts, भुक्ताः nurtured, भृत्याः dependants निभृताः filled with, धनानि wealth, मित्रेषु to friends, समर्पितानि given, वैराणि grudges, अमित्रेषु to enemies, निपातितानि destroyed
explanation: "He bestowed gifts to mendicants, nurtured dependents, filled his friends with wealth, and held grudges against enemies and destroyed them."

shloka_text: एषोहिताग्निश्च:महातपाश्चवेदान्तगःकर्मसुचाग्य्रशूरः । एतस्ययत्प्रेतगतस्यकृत्यंतत्कर्तुमिच्छामितवप्रसादात् ।।6.112.24।।
transliteration: eṣohitāgniśca:mahātapāścavedāntagaḥkarmasucāgyraśūraḥ | etasyayatpretagatasyakṛtyaṃtatkartumicchāmitavaprasādāt
translation: एषः he, हिताग्नि: maintained sacred fire, महातपाश्च practised austerities, वेदान्तगः mastered vedas, कर्मसु च even in doing rituals, अग्रशूरः foremost, प्रेतगतस्य departed soul, एतस्य to him, कृत्यम् to do the rituals, तव your, प्रसादात् permission, कर्तुम् will do, इच्छामि I desire
explanation: "He maintained sacrificial fire and practised austerities. He mastered vedas and was even doing rituals. To the foremost brother's departed soul, I desire your permission to do the rituals."

shloka_text: रावणंनिहतंदृष्टवाराघवेणमहात्मना । अन्तःपुराद्विनिष्पेतूराक्षस्यश्शोककर्शिताः ।।6.113.1।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṃnihataṃdṛṣṭavārāghaveṇamahātmanā | antaḥpurādviniṣpetūrākṣasyaśśokakarśitāḥ
translation: महात्मना great soul, राघवेण by Raghava, रावणम् Ravana, निहतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, शोककर्शिताः stricken with grief, अन्तःपुरात् from the gynaeceum, विनिष्पेतुः rushed out
explanation: On seeing Ravana killed by the great soul Raghava, the Rakshasas from the gynaeceum stricken with grief rushed out.
comments: Lamentation of Ravana's consorts on seeing his dead body.

shloka_text: वार्यमाणास्सुबहुशोवेष्टन्त्यःक्षितिपांसुषु । विमुक्तकेश्यश्शोकार्तागावोवत्सहतायथा ।।6.113.2।।
transliteration: vāryamāṇāssubahuśoveṣṭantyaḥkṣitipāṃsuṣu | vimuktakeśyaśśokārtāgāvovatsahatāyathā
translation: सुबहुशो: numerous Rakshasa women, वार्यमाणाः obstructed, क्षितिपांसुषु rolling in dust, वेष्ट्नत्यः encompassing, विमुक्तकेश्यः dishevelled, वत्सहताः young ones lost, गावःयथा like cows, शोकार्ताः crying
explanation: Numerous women, though obstructed, were rolling in dust, with dishevelled hair and crying like cows which had lost their calves.

shloka_text: उत्तरेणविनिष्क्रम्यद्वारेणसहराक्षसैः । प्रविश्यायोधनंघोरंविचिन्वन्त्वोहतंपतिम् ।।6.113.3।। आर्यपुत्रेतिवादिन्योहानाथेति च सर्वशः । परिपेतुःकबन्धाङ्कांमहींशोणितकर्दमाम् ।।6.113.4।।
transliteration: uttareṇaviniṣkramyadvāreṇasaharākṣasaiḥ | praviśyāyodhanaṃghoraṃvicinvantvohataṃpatim  āryaputretivādinyohānātheti ca sarvaśaḥ | paripetuḥkabandhāṅkāṃmahīṃśoṇitakardamām
translation: राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, उत्तरेणद्वारेण northern gate, विनिष्क्रम्य coming out, हतम् killed, पतिम् husbands, विचिन्वन्त्वः crying, घोरम् dreadful, अयोधनम् battlefield, प्रविश्य entered, आर्यपुत्रेति O son, हानाथेति ha husband, वादिन्यः speaking, कबन्धाङ्काम् trunks, शोणितकर्दमाम् soaked in blood and mud, महीम् on ground, सर्वशः all over, परिपेतुःwent about
explanation: The Rakshasa women along with Rakshasas came out of the north gate and entered the battlefield screaming 'O son', 'O husband' and crying, seeing the trunks soaked in blood and mud on the ground and went about all over.

shloka_text: उत्तरेणविनिष्क्रम्यद्वारेणसहराक्षसैः । प्रविश्यायोधनंघोरंविचिन्वन्त्वोहतंपतिम् ।।6.113.3।। आर्यपुत्रेतिवादिन्योहानाथेति च सर्वशः । परिपेतुःकबन्धाङ्कांमहींशोणितकर्दमाम् ।।6.113.4।।
transliteration: uttareṇaviniṣkramyadvāreṇasaharākṣasaiḥ | praviśyāyodhanaṃghoraṃvicinvantvohataṃpatim  āryaputretivādinyohānātheti ca sarvaśaḥ | paripetuḥkabandhāṅkāṃmahīṃśoṇitakardamām
translation: राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, उत्तरेणद्वारेण northern gate, विनिष्क्रम्य coming out, हतम् killed, पतिम् husbands, विचिन्वन्त्वः crying, घोरम् dreadful, अयोधनम् battlefield, प्रविश्य entered, आर्यपुत्रेति O son, हानाथेति ha husband, वादिन्यः speaking, कबन्धाङ्काम् trunks, शोणितकर्दमाम् soaked in blood and mud, महीम् on ground, सर्वशः all over, परिपेतुःwent about
explanation: The Rakshasa women along with Rakshasas came out of the north gate and entered the battlefield screaming 'O son', 'O husband' and crying, seeing the trunks soaked in blood and mud on the ground and went about all over.

shloka_text: ताबाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्योभर्तृशोकपराजिताः । करेण्वइवनर्द्नत्योविनेदुर्हतयूथपाः ।।6.113.5।।
transliteration: tābāṣpaparipūrṇākṣyobhartṛśokaparājitāḥ | kareṇvaivanardnatyovinedurhatayūthapāḥ
translation: बाष्पपरिपूर्णाक्ष्यः eyes filled with tears, भर्तृशोकपरिजाताः on account of grief for their husbands, ताः they, हतयूथपाः leader lost, करेण्वःइव like female elephant, नर्द्नत्यः bellowing, विनेदुः roared
explanation: Bellowing like female elephants that had lost their husbands, the women roared eyes filled with tears on account of grief for their husbands.

shloka_text: ददृशुस्तामहाकायंमहावीर्यंमहाद्युतिम् । रावणंनिहतम्भूमौनीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् ।।6.113.6।।
transliteration: dadṛśustāmahākāyaṃmahāvīryaṃmahādyutim | rāvaṇaṃnihatambhūmaunīlāñjanacayopamam
translation: ताः they, महाकायम् gigantic body, महावीर्यम् extraordinary valour, महाद्युतिम् full of splendor, नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् like heap of dark mountain, निहतम् killed, भूमौ on the ground, ददृशुः looked
explanation: They looked at the gigantic body of Ravana of extraordinary valour, full of splendor, killed and lying like a heap of dark mountain on the ground.

shloka_text: ताःपतिंसहसादृष्टवाशयानंरणपांसुषु । निपेतुस्तस्यगात्रेषुछिन्नावनलताइव ।।6.113.7।।
transliteration: tāḥpatiṃsahasādṛṣṭavāśayānaṃraṇapāṃsuṣu | nipetustasyagātreṣuchinnāvanalatāiva
translation: ताः they, रणपांसुषु in the battlefield, शयानम् lying, पतिम् husband, सहसा precipitately, दृष्टवा seeing, छिन्नाः broken, वनलताइव like creepers in a garden, तस्य his, गात्रेषु limbs, निपेतुः fallen
explanation: In the battlefield they saw their husband lying, and precipitately fell on his limbs like broken creepers in a garden.

shloka_text: बहुमानात्परिष्वज्यकाचिदेवंरुरोद ह । चरणौकाचिदालम्ब्यकाचित्कण्ठेऽवलम्ब्य च ।।6.113.8।।
transliteration: bahumānātpariṣvajyakācidevaṃruroda ha | caraṇaukācidālambyakācitkaṇṭhe'valambya ca
translation: काचित् indeed, बहुमानात् out of great respect, एनम् they, परिष्वज्य embracing, रुरोद ह roared aloud, काचित् some, चरणौ feet, आलम्ब्य holding, काचित् some, कण्ठे neck, अवलम्ब्य च started weeping
explanation: Indeed, out of respect some embraced him and roared aloud, some held his feet and wept, some held his neck and started weeping.

shloka_text: उत्क्षिप्य च भुजौकाचिद्भूमौसुपरिवर्तते । हतस्यवदनंदृष्टवाकाचिन्मोहमुपागमत् ।।6.113.9।।
transliteration: utkṣipya ca bhujaukācidbhūmausuparivartate | hatasyavadanaṃdṛṣṭavākācinmohamupāgamat
translation: काचित् some, भुजौ arms, उत्क्षिप्य throwing herself on ground, भूमौ on ground, सुपरिवर्तते rolled, काचित् some, हतस्य killed, वदनम् face, दृष्टवा seeing, मोहम् in delusion, उपागमत् holding
explanation: Some lifting their arms threw themselves on ground, some rolled, some beholding the dead Ravana's face became deluded.

shloka_text: काचिदङ्केशिरःकृत्वारुरोदमुखमीक्षती । स्नापयन्तीमुखंबाष्पैस्तुषारैरिवपङ्कजम् ।।6.113.10।।
transliteration: kācidaṅkeśiraḥkṛtvārurodamukhamīkṣatī | snāpayantīmukhaṃbāṣpaistuṣārairivapaṅkajam
translation: काचित् some, शिरः head, अङ्के lap, कृत्वा holding, मुखम् face, ईक्षती looking, तुषारैः nature sheds dew, पङ्कजम् इव like from lotus, मुखम् face, बाष्पैः tears, स्नापयन्ती flowed, रुरोद roared
explanation: One held his head on her lap, and one held his face and looking at it shed tears, like nature covers lotus with dew and roared.

shloka_text: एवमार्ताःपतिंदृष्टवारावणंनिहतंभुवि । चुक्रुशुर्भहुधाशोकाद्भूयस्ताःपर्यदेवयन् ।।6.113.11।।
transliteration: evamārtāḥpatiṃdṛṣṭavārāvaṇaṃnihataṃbhuvi | cukruśurbhahudhāśokādbhūyastāḥparyadevayan
translation: भुवि on the ground, निहतम् killed, पतिम् husband, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा beholding, एवम् in that manner, आर्ताः afflicted, ताः they, बहुधा many, चुक्रुशुः again and again, शोकात् in sorrow, भूयः exceedingly, पर्यदेवयन् overcome with grief
explanation: Afflicted on beholding their husband Ravana, killed, and lying on the ground, the Rakshasa women again and again cried exceedingly in many ways overcome with grief.

shloka_text: येनमित्रासितःशक्रोयेनवित्रासितोयमः । येनवैश्रवणोराजापुष्पकेणवियोजितः ।।6.113.12।। गन्धर्वाणामृषीणां च सुराणां च महात्मनाम् । भयंयेनरणेदत्तंसोऽयंशेतेरणेहतः ।।6.113.13।।
transliteration: yenamitrāsitaḥśakroyenavitrāsitoyamaḥ | yenavaiśravaṇorājāpuṣpakeṇaviyojitaḥ  gandharvāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām | bhayaṃyenaraṇedattaṃso'yaṃśeteraṇehataḥ
translation: येन to whom, शक्रः Indra, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, यमः Yama, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Visrava, पुष्पकेण् Pushpaka, वियोजितः used by winning, येन to whom, रणे in war, गन्धर्वाणाम् Gandharvas, ऋषीणां च and ascetics, महात्मनाम् high souled, सुराणां च and Suras, भयम् fear, दत्तम् bestowed, सःअयम् he this, रणे battlefield, सतः lies, शेते asleep
explanation: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."

shloka_text: येनमित्रासितःशक्रोयेनवित्रासितोयमः । येनवैश्रवणोराजापुष्पकेणवियोजितः ।।6.113.12।। गन्धर्वाणामृषीणां च सुराणां च महात्मनाम् । भयंयेनरणेदत्तंसोऽयंशेतेरणेहतः ।।6.113.13।।
transliteration: yenamitrāsitaḥśakroyenavitrāsitoyamaḥ | yenavaiśravaṇorājāpuṣpakeṇaviyojitaḥ  gandharvāṇāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca mahātmanām | bhayaṃyenaraṇedattaṃso'yaṃśeteraṇehataḥ
translation: येन to whom, शक्रः Indra, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, यमः Yama, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Visrava, पुष्पकेण् Pushpaka, वियोजितः used by winning, येन to whom, रणे in war, गन्धर्वाणाम् Gandharvas, ऋषीणां च and ascetics, महात्मनाम् high souled, सुराणां च and Suras, भयम् fear, दत्तम् bestowed, सःअयम् he this, रणे battlefield, सतः lies, शेते asleep
explanation: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."

shloka_text: असुरेभ्यःसुरेभ्योवापन्नगेभ्योऽपिवातथा । भयंयो न विजानातितस्येदंमानुषाद् भयम् ।।6.113.14।।
transliteration: asurebhyaḥsurebhyovāpannagebhyo'pivātathā | bhayaṃyo na vijānātitasyedaṃmānuṣād bhayam
translation: यः he who, असुरेभ्यः from Asuras, सुरेभ्योवा or Suras, तथा so also, पन्नगेभ्योऽपि Uragas also, भयम् fear, न विजानाति not known, तस्य his, मानुषात् by human, इदम् thus, भयम् experienced fear
explanation: "He, who did not know fear from Asuras or Uragas, experienced fear from a mortal."

shloka_text: अवध्योदेवतानांयस्तथादानवराक्षसाम् । हतःसोऽयंरणेशेतेमानुषेणपदातिना ।।6.113.15।।
transliteration: avadhyodevatānāṃyastathādānavarākṣasām | hataḥso'yaṃraṇeśetemānuṣeṇapadātinā
translation: यः he who, देवतानाम् Devatas, तथा so also, दानवरक्षनाम् Danavas, Rakshasas, अवध्यः not be killed, सःअयम् he, पदातिना by walk, मानुषेण by a mortal, रणे in battle, हतः killed, शेते lies asleep
explanation: "He, whom Devatas, Danavas and Rakshasas could not kill, lies asleep, killed by a mortal who came by walk."

shloka_text: यो न शक्यस्सुरैर्हन्तुं न यक्षैर्नासुरैस्तथा । सोऽयंकश्चिदिवासत्त्वोमृत्युंमर्त्येनलम्भितः ।।6.113.16।।
transliteration: yo na śakyassurairhantuṃ na yakṣairnāsuraistathā | so'yaṃkaścidivāsattvomṛtyuṃmartyenalambhitaḥ
translation: यः he who, सुरैः Suras, हन्तुम् to kill, न शक्यः not possible, यक्षै: Yaksha, न not, तथा so also, असुरैः Asuras, न not, सः he, अयम् this, असत्त्वः weak, कश्चिदिव like one devoid of strength, मर्त्येन by death, मृत्युम् death, लम्भितः resting
explanation: "He, who could not be killed by Suras, Asuras or Yakshas, such a hero lies like a weak person devoid of strength, killed by a mortal, is resting."

shloka_text: एवंवदन्त्योरुरुदुस्तस्यतादुःखिताःस्त्रियः । भूयएव च दुःखार्ताविलेपुश्चपुनःपुनः ।।6.113.17।।
transliteration: evaṃvadantyorurudustasyatāduḥkhitāḥstriyaḥ | bhūyaeva ca duḥkhārtāvilepuścapunaḥpunaḥ
translation: तस्य his, दुःखिताः grieving, ताःस्त्रियःएवम् those women in that way, वदन्त्य: roaring, रुरुदुः aloud, भूयःएव च lamented again, दुःखार्ताः afflicted with sorrow, पुनःपुनः again and again, विलेपुः cried
explanation: Those women grieving in that way roared aloud, lamenting again and again cried, afflicted by sorrow.

shloka_text: अशृण्वतातुसुहृदांसततंहितवादिनाम् । मरणायहृतासीताराक्षसाश्चनिपातिताः ।।6.113.18।। एतास्सममिदानींतेवयमात्मा च पातितः ।
transliteration: aśṛṇvatātusuhṛdāṃsatataṃhitavādinām | maraṇāyahṛtāsītārākṣasāścanipātitāḥ  etāssamamidānīṃtevayamātmā ca pātitaḥ |
translation: सततम् always, हितवादिनाम् your welfare, सुहृदाम् dear and good at heart, अश्वण्वता not listened, मरणाय death, सीता Sita, आहृता brought, राक्षसाश्च Rakshasas, निपातिताः struck down, आत्मा च yourself, पातितः destroyed, समम् at a time, ते to you, एताःवयम् all of us, इदानीम् this way
explanation: "You did not listen to the good advice of your dear and good at heart. You brought Sita and destroyed yourself and all of us at a time."

shloka_text: ब्रुवाणोऽपिहितंवाक्यमिष्टोभ्राताविभीषणः ।।6.113.19।। धृष्टंपरुषितोमोहत्त्वयात्मवथकाङ्क्षिणा ।
transliteration: bruvāṇo'pihitaṃvākyamiṣṭobhrātāvibhīṣaṇaḥ  dhṛṣṭaṃparuṣitomohattvayātmavathakāṅkṣiṇā |
translation: हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवाणोऽपि even though told, इष्टःभ्राता dear brother, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, धृष्टम् evidently, आत्मवथकाङ्णा sought your own destruction, त्वया by you, मोहात् in delusion, परुषितः harshly
explanation: "Even though good advice was given by your dear brother Vibheeshana, in your delusion evidently you sought your own destruction."

shloka_text: दिनिर्यातितातेस्वासतीतारामायमैथिली ।।6.113.20।। ननस्स्याद्व्यसनंघोरमिदंमूलहरंमहत् ।
transliteration: diniryātitātesvāsatītārāmāyamaithilī  nanassyādvyasanaṃghoramidaṃmūlaharaṃmahat |
translation: मैतिली Mythili, सीता Sita, ते to you, रामाय Rama's, निर्यातिता returned, यदिस्यात् if so with you, नः not, मूलहरम् destruction of the very root, इदम् this, महत् great, घोरम् terrific, व्यसनम् calamity, न स्यात् not happened
explanation: "If Sita, princess of Mithila had been returned by you, this great destruction of the very root and calamity with you and for us would not have happened."

shloka_text: वृत्तकामोभवेद्भ्रातारामोमित्रकुलंभवेत् ।।6.113.21।। वयंचाध्विवाःसर्वाःसकमा न च शत्रवः ।
transliteration: vṛttakāmobhavedbhrātārāmomitrakulaṃbhavet  vayaṃcādhvivāḥsarvāḥsakamā na ca śatravaḥ |
translation: न्राता brother, वृत्तकामः desire fulfilled, भवेत् would be, रामः Rama, मित्रकुलम् turned to be friend, भवेत् would have been, वयम् our, सर्वाः all, अध्विनाः not widows, शत्रवः च enemy's, सकामाः that desire, न not
explanation: "If your brother's desire had been fulfilled Rama would have turned to be our friend. We would not have been widows. Our enemy's desire would not have been fulfilled."

shloka_text: त्वयापुनर्नृशंशंसेनसीतांसंरुन्धताबलात् ।।6.113.22।। राक्षसावयमात्मा च त्रयंतुल्यंनिपातितम् ।
transliteration: tvayāpunarnṛśaṃśaṃsenasītāṃsaṃrundhatābalāt  rākṣasāvayamātmā ca trayaṃtulyaṃnipātitam |
translation: नृशंसेन with evil intention, सीताम् Sita, बलात् forcibly, संरुन्धता kept under detention, त्वयापुनः again by you, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, वयम् these आत्मा च and you too, त्रयम् three, तुल्यम् together, निपातितम् destroyed
explanation: "With evil intention you kept Sita under detention. These Rakshasas and you and us all the three are together destroyed."

shloka_text: न कामकारःकामंवातवराक्षसपुङ्गव । दैवंचेष्टयतेसर्वंहतंदैवेनहन्यते ।।6.113.23।।
transliteration: na kāmakāraḥkāmaṃvātavarākṣasapuṅgava | daivaṃceṣṭayatesarvaṃhataṃdaivenahanyate
translation: राक्षसपुङ्गवः foremost of Rakshasas, कामम् desire, तव of yours, कामकारः acting to your will, न वा by you, सर्वम् all, दैवम् divine, चेष्टयते makes you do, देवेन by divine, हतम् killed, हन्यते kills
explanation: "O Foremost of Rakshasas! You have acted according to your desire alone is not sufficient as divine will make you do everything. He is killed whom destiny kills."

shloka_text: वानराणांविनाशोऽयंराक्षसानां च तेरणे । तवचैवमहाबाहो दैवयोगादुपागतः ।।6.113.24।।
transliteration: vānarāṇāṃvināśo'yaṃrākṣasānāṃ ca teraṇe | tavacaivamahābāho daivayogādupāgataḥ
translation: महाबाहो mighty armed, रणे in war, वानराणाम् Vanaras, राक्षसानां च Rakshasas also, तव च you too, अयम् this, विनाशः destruction, दैवयोगात् with the divine grace, उपागतः has come
explanation: "O mighty armed Ravana! For Vanaras, Rakshasas and you too, this destruction in this war has come by divine grace."

shloka_text: नैवार्थेन न कामेनविक्रमेण न चाज्ञया । शक्यादैवगतिर्लोकेनिवर्तयितुमुद्यता ।।6.113.25।।
transliteration: naivārthena na kāmenavikrameṇa na cājñayā | śakyādaivagatirlokenivartayitumudyatā
translation: उद्यता to lift up, दैवगतिः divine course, लोके in the world, अर्थेन by wealth, निवर्तयितुम् to stop, न शक्या not possible, कामेन with will, न not, विक्रमेण by prowess, न not, आज्ञया च king's order, न not
explanation: "In the world, to change the divine course of action, it is not possible with wealth, or will or by prowess or king's orders."

shloka_text: तासांविलपमानानांतदाराक्षसयोषिताम् । ज्येष्ठापत्नीप्रियाजीनाभर्तारंसमुदैक्षत ।।6.114.1।।
transliteration: tāsāṃvilapamānānāṃtadārākṣasayoṣitām | jyeṣṭhāpatnīpriyājīnābhartāraṃsamudaikṣata
translation: तदा then, तासाम् of them, राक्षसयोषिताम् Rakshasa's wife, विलपमानानाम् lamenting, प्रिया dear, ज्येष्ठापत्नी first wife, दीना piteously, भर्तारम् husband, समुदैक्षत gazed
explanation: Then from among the wives lamenting, the first wife, dear to Ravana gazed at her husband lamenting piteously.
comments: Mandodari laments over Ravana's death. Requested by Rama, Vibheeshna performs the funeral rites of Ravana.

shloka_text: दशग्रीवंहतंदृष्टवारामेणाचिन्त्यकर्मणा । पतिंमण्डोदरीतत्रकृपणापर्यदेवयत् ।।6.114.2।।
transliteration: daśagrīvaṃhataṃdṛṣṭavārāmeṇācintyakarmaṇā | patiṃmaṇḍodarītatrakṛpaṇāparyadevayat
translation: अचिन्त्यकर्मणा of inconceivable exploits, रामेण by Rama, हतम् killed, पतिम् husband, दशग्रीवम् ten headed Ravana, दृष्टवा looking, मण्डोदरी Mandodari, तत्र there, कृपणा piteously, पर्यदेवयत् lamented there
explanation: Looking at her husband Ravana killed by Rama of inconceivable exploits, Mandodari piteously lamented there.

shloka_text: ननुनाममहाबाहोतववैश्रवणानुज । क्रुद्धस्यप्रमुखेस्थातुंत्रस्यत्यपिपुरन्दरः ।।6.114.3।।
transliteration: nanunāmamahābāhotavavaiśravaṇānuja | kruddhasyapramukhesthātuṃtrasyatyapipurandaraḥ
translation: महाबाहो mighty armed, वैश्रवणानुज brother of Visrava, क्रुद्धस्य in anger, तव your, प्रमुखे chief, स्थातुम् to stand, पुरन्दरःअपि even Purandara, त्रस्यति fears, ननुनाम well known
explanation: "O mighty armed Ravana! O, brother of Visrava! When in anger even Purandara was afraid to stand before you, it is well known."

shloka_text: ऋषयश्चमहान्तोऽपिगन्धर्वाश्चयशस्विनः । ननुनामतवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्चदिशोगताः ।।6.114.4।।
transliteration: ṛṣayaścamahānto'pigandharvāścayaśasvinaḥ | nanunāmatavodvegāccāraṇāścadiśogatāḥ
translation: तव your, उद्वेगात् for fear, महान्तः great, ऋषयः seers, यशस्विनः illustrious, गन्धर्वाश्च Gandharvas also, चारणाः Charanas, दिशः directions, गताः went, ननुनाम is well known
explanation: "For fear of you, even great seers, illustrious Gandharvas, Charanas also went in all directions, is well known."

shloka_text: स त्वंमानुषमात्रेणरामेणयुधिनिर्जितः । न व्यपत्रपसेराजन् किमिदंराक्षसेश्वर ।।6.114.5।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃmānuṣamātreṇarāmeṇayudhinirjitaḥ | na vyapatrapaserājan kimidaṃrākṣaseśvara
translation: राक्षसेश्वर Lord of Rakshasas, राजन् king, सःत्वम् you, मानुषमात्रेण just a mortal, रामेण by Rama, युधि in war, निर्जितः killed, न व्यपत्रपसे not shy about it, इदम् for this, किम् why
explanation: "O Lord of Rakshasas! Just by Rama, a mortal, you have been killed in war. Are you not shy of it?"

shloka_text: कथंत्रैलोक्यमाक्रम्यश्रियावीर्येणचान्वितम् । अविषह्यंजघानत्वांमानुषोवनगोचरः ।।6.114.6।।
transliteration: kathaṃtrailokyamākramyaśriyāvīryeṇacānvitam | aviṣahyaṃjaghānatvāṃmānuṣovanagocaraḥ
translation: त्रैलोक्यम् in the three worlds, आक्रम्य occupying, श्रिया glorious, वीर्येण च by your valour, अन्वितम् irresistible, अविषह्यम् beyond the reach, त्वाम् you, वनगोचरः wanderer in forest, मानुषः human, कथम् how, जघान struck you
explanation: "Winning the three worlds by your valour, you are glorious, irresistible and beyond reach. How did the wanderer in the forest strike you?"

shloka_text: मानुषाणामविषयेचरतःकामरूपिणः । विनाशस्तवरामेणसम्युगेनोपपद्यते ।।6.114.7।।
transliteration: mānuṣāṇāmaviṣayecarataḥkāmarūpiṇaḥ | vināśastavarāmeṇasamyugenopapadyate
translation: मानुषाणाम् among humans, अविषये inaccessible, चरतः live, कामरूपिणः capable of assuming any form at will, तव your, विनाशः destroyed, रामेण by Rama, संयुगे in war, नोपपद्यते is not believable
explanation: "You lived in an inaccessible place and are capable of assuming any form at will. It is not believable how you have been destroyed by Rama."

shloka_text: न चैतत्कर्मरामस्यश्रद्धधामिचमूमुखे । सर्वतस्समुपेतस्यतवतेनाभिमर्षणम् ।।6.114.8।।
transliteration: na caitatkarmarāmasyaśraddhadhāmicamūmukhe | sarvatassamupetasyatavatenābhimarṣaṇam
translation: चमूमुखे army, रामस्य of Rama, एतत् such, कर्म action, न श्रद्धधामि not action, सर्वतः always, समुपेतस्य fully equipped, तव your, तेन therefore, धर्षणम् fight
explanation: "You are always well equipped with the army, so such action (killing you) is not possible for Rama."

shloka_text: यदैव च जनस्थानेराक्षसैर्भहुनिर्ववृतः । खरस्तवहतोभ्रातातदैवासौ न मानुषः ।।6.114.9।।
transliteration: yadaiva ca janasthānerākṣasairbhahunirvavṛtaḥ | kharastavahatobhrātātadaivāsau na mānuṣaḥ
translation: जनस्थाने at Janasthana, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, तवभ्राता your brother, खरः Khara, हतः killed, तदैव in the same manner, असौ you, मानुषः mortal, न not
explanation: " At Janasthana your brother Khara, who was surrounded by many Rakshasas, was killed by a mortal in the same manner."

shloka_text: यदैवनगरींलङ्कांदुष्प्रवेशांसुरैरपि । प्रविष्टोहनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैवव्यथितावयम् ।।6.114.10।।
transliteration: yadaivanagarīṃlaṅkāṃduṣpraveśāṃsurairapi | praviṣṭohanumānvīryāttadaivavyathitāvayam
translation: यदैव by that action, हनुमान् Hanuman, सुरैरपि even Suras, दुष्प्रवेशाम् difficult to enter, लङ्कांनगरीम् Lanka city, वीर्यात् valour, प्रविष्टः increasing, तदैव like that, वयम् knowing this, व्यथिताः worried
explanation: "To Lanka, which is inaccessible to anyone, Hanuman entered by increasing his valour. Knowing this we worried (that Rama may not be mere mortal)."

shloka_text: यदैववानरैर्घोरैर्बद्धस्सेतुर्महार्णवे । तदैवहृदयेनाहंशङ्केरामममानुषम् ।।6.114.11।।
transliteration: yadaivavānarairghorairbaddhasseturmahārṇave | tadaivahṛdayenāhaṃśaṅkerāmamamānuṣam
translation: घोरैः terrific, वानरैः Vanaras, महार्णवे great ocean, यदैव that time, सेतुः bridge, बद्धः constructed, तदैव at that time, अहम् I, रामम् Rama, अमानुषम् other than mortal, हृदयेन in my mind, शङ्के doubted
explanation: "When these terrific Vanaras constructed a bridge over the great ocean, I doubted in my mind at that time itself that Rama is not a mortal."

shloka_text: अथवारामरूपेणकृतान्तस्स्वयमागतः । मायांतवविनाशायविधायाप्रतितर्किताम् ।।6.114.12।।
transliteration: athavārāmarūpeṇakṛtāntassvayamāgataḥ | māyāṃtavavināśāyavidhāyāpratitarkitām
translation: अथवा or else, स्वयम् by himself, कृतान्तः god of death, तव your, विनाशाय for destruction, अप्रतितर्किताम् inconceivable recourse, मायाम् conceit, विधाय right knowledge, रामरूपेण in the form of Rama, आगतः would have come.
explanation: "Or else, the god of death would have come in the form of Rama for your destruction, having right knowledge and taking an inconceivable recourse.

shloka_text: अथवावासवेनत्वंधर्षितोऽपिमहाबल । वासवस्यतुकाशक्तिस्त्वांद्रष्टुमपिसंयुगे ।।6.114.13।।
transliteration: athavāvāsavenatvaṃdharṣito'pimahābala | vāsavasyatukāśaktistvāṃdraṣṭumapisaṃyuge
translation: अथवा or else, महाबल of extraordinary might, त्वम् you, वासवेन by Indra, धर्षितःअसि to overcome also, तु you, वासवस्य by Indra, संयुगे in the battlefield, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुमपि to look at you, काशक्तिः where is the energy
explanation: "Or else O king of extraordinary might! Indra would have come to overthrow you in the form of Rama. Indra has no energy even to look at you in the battlefield."

shloka_text: व्यक्तमेषमहायोगीपरमात्मासनातनः । अनादिमध्यनिधनोमहतंपरमोमहान् ।।6.114.14।। तमसःपरमोधाताशङ्खचक्रगदाधरः । श्रीवत्सवक्षानित्यश्रीरजय्यश्शाश्वतोध्रुवः ।।6.114.15।। मानुषंरूपमास्थायविष्णुस्सत्यपराक्रमः । सर्वैःपरिवृतोदेवैर्वानरत्वमुपागतैः ।।6.114.16।। सर्वलोकेश्वर्श्रीमान्लोकानांहितकाम्यया । सराक्षसरपरीवारंहतवांस्त्वांमहाद्युतिः ।।6.114.17।।
transliteration: vyaktameṣamahāyogīparamātmāsanātanaḥ | anādimadhyanidhanomahataṃparamomahān  tamasaḥparamodhātāśaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ | śrīvatsavakṣānityaśrīrajayyaśśāśvatodhruvaḥ  mānuṣaṃrūpamāsthāyaviṣṇussatyaparākramaḥ | sarvaiḥparivṛtodevairvānaratvamupāgataiḥ  sarvalokeśvarśrīmānlokānāṃhitakāmyayā | sarākṣasaraparīvāraṃhatavāṃstvāṃmahādyutiḥ
translation: व्यक्तम् it is evident, एषः this, महायोगी great yogi, सनातनः eternal, अनादिमध्यनिधनः who has no beginning, middle or end, महतः great, परमः supreme, महान् greater than,   (ignorance), परमः supreme, धाता sustainer, शङ्खचक्रगदाधरः holder of conch, discus, mace, श्रीवत्सवक्षाः Srivatsa symbol on his chest, नित्यश्रीः ever rich, अजय्यः invincible, शाश्वतः everlasting, ध्रुवः steady, परमात्मा supreme soul, सत्यपराक्रमः of truthful valour, सर्वलोकेश्वरः Lord of all worlds, श्रीमान् prosperous, महाद्युतिः mass of brilliance, विष्णुः Lord Vishnu, लोकानाम् for all worlds, हितकाम्यया wellwisher, मानुषम् mortal, रूपम् form, आस्थाय come, वानरत्वम् Vanara form, उपागतैः has come, सर्वैः all, देवैः gods, परिवृतः surrounded by, सराक्षसपरीवारम् along with all Rakshasas, त्वाम् you, हतवान् killed
explanation: "It is evident that this Rama is a great yogi, eternal, who has no beginning, middle or end. He is supreme, greater than great and stands beyond darkness, a sustainer. He holds conch, discus, and mace in hand. He has symbols of Srivatsa on his chest. He is ever rich, invincible, everlasting, steady supreme soul and of truthful valour. He is prosperous, a mass of brilliance, Lord Vishnu and the Lord of all worlds, a wellwisher of all. He has come in mortal form, in the form of Vanaras also, and by all gods. He vanquished you along with Rakshasas is evident."
