shloka_text: प्रविष्टासुसर्वासुराक्षसीषुविभीषणः । रामपार्श्वमुपागम्यतदातिष्ठद्विनीतवत् ।।6.114.124।।
transliteration: praviṣṭāsusarvāsurākṣasīṣuvibhīṣaṇaḥ | rāmapārśvamupāgamyatadātiṣṭhadvinītavat
translation: स्त्रीषु women also, पुरीम् Lanka, प्रविष्टासु on entering, सर्वासु all over, राक्षसीषु Rakshasa women, विभीषणः Vibhishana, तदा then, रामपार्श्वम् towards Rama, उपागम्य came towards, विनीतवत् submissive manner, अतिष्ठत् standing
explanation: After the women entering the city, Vibheeshana came towards Rama and stood in a submissive manner.

shloka_text: रामोऽपिसहसैन्येनससुग्रीवस्सलक्ष्मणः । हर्षंलेभेरिपुंहत्वायथावृत्रंशतक्रतु: ।।6.114.125।।
transliteration: rāmo'pisahasainyenasasugrīvassalakṣmaṇaḥ | harṣaṃlebheripuṃhatvāyathāvṛtraṃśatakratu:
translation: ससुग्रीवः Sugriva, सलक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सैन्येनसह accompanied by the army, रामोऽपि Rama also, रिपुम् enemy, हत्वा killed, वृत्रम् Vrta, हत्वा killed, शतक्रतु: Indra who did a hundred sacrifices, यथा that manner, हर्षम् happy, लेभे experienced
explanation: Enemy killed, Rama also accompanied by Sugriva, Lakshmana, and army experienced joy, like Indra (who performed a hundred sacrifices) after killing Vrta.

shloka_text: तेरावणवधंदृष्टवादेवगन्धर्वदानवाः । जग्मुस्स्वैस्वैर्विमानैस्तेकथयन्तश्शुभाःकथाः ।।6.115.1।।
transliteration: terāvaṇavadhaṃdṛṣṭavādevagandharvadānavāḥ | jagmussvaisvairvimānaistekathayantaśśubhāḥkathāḥ
translation: ते in the meantime, देवगन्धर्वदानवाः Devas, Gandharvas, Danavasरावणवधम् Ravana's destruction, दृष्टवा seeing, ते they, शुभाःauspicious, कथाः story, कथयन्तः speaking to each other, स्वैःस्वैः their, विमानैः aerial cars, जग्मुः went
explanation: In the meantime, Devas, Gandharvas, Danavas speaking to each other an auspicious story of Ravana's destruction went in their respective aerial cars.
comments: Vibheeshana consecrated as king of Lanka. Sri Rama sends a message to Sita through Hanuman.

shloka_text: रावणस्यवधंघोरंराघवस्यपराक्रमम् । सुयुद्धंवानराणां च सुग्रीवस्य च मन्त्रितम् ।।6.115.2।। अनुरागं च वीर्यं च सौमित्रेर्लक्ष्मणस्य च । पतिव्रतात्वंसीतायाहनूमतिपराक्रमम् ।।6.115.3।। कथयन्तोमहाभागाजग्मुर्हष्टायथागतम् ।
transliteration: rāvaṇasyavadhaṃghoraṃrāghavasyaparākramam | suyuddhaṃvānarāṇāṃ ca sugrīvasya ca mantritam  anurāgaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca saumitrerlakṣmaṇasya ca | pativratātvaṃsītāyāhanūmatiparākramam  kathayantomahābhāgājagmurhaṣṭāyathāgatam |
translation: महाभागाः highly respected, रावणस्य Ravana's, घोरम् dreadful, वधम् end, राघवस्य Raghava's, पराक्रमम् prowess, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सुयुद्धम् good fight, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, मन्त्रितम् counsel, सौमित्रेः Saumithri, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अनुरागं च love, वीर्यं च valour, सीतायाःSita's, पतिव्रतात्वम् fidelity of Sita, हनूमतिHanuman's, पराक्रमम् valiance, कथयन्तः speaking, हृष्टाःrejoiced, यथागतम् as they had come from, जग्मुः returned
explanation: Speaking about the highly respected Raghava's prowess, the end of dreadful Ravana, the good fighting of Vanaras, counsel of Sugriva, valour of Hanuman, love of Lakshmana, fidelity of Sita, all rejoiced and returned as they had come.

shloka_text: रावणस्यवधंघोरंराघवस्यपराक्रमम् । सुयुद्धंवानराणां च सुग्रीवस्य च मन्त्रितम् ।।6.115.2।। अनुरागं च वीर्यं च सौमित्रेर्लक्ष्मणस्य च । पतिव्रतात्वंसीतायाहनूमतिपराक्रमम् ।।6.115.3।। कथयन्तोमहाभागाजग्मुर्हष्टायथागतम् ।
transliteration: rāvaṇasyavadhaṃghoraṃrāghavasyaparākramam | suyuddhaṃvānarāṇāṃ ca sugrīvasya ca mantritam  anurāgaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca saumitrerlakṣmaṇasya ca | pativratātvaṃsītāyāhanūmatiparākramam  kathayantomahābhāgājagmurhaṣṭāyathāgatam |
translation: महाभागाः highly respected, रावणस्य Ravana's, घोरम् dreadful, वधम् end, राघवस्य Raghava's, पराक्रमम् prowess, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सुयुद्धम् good fight, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, मन्त्रितम् counsel, सौमित्रेः Saumithri, लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, अनुरागं च love, वीर्यं च valour, सीतायाःSita's, पतिव्रतात्वम् fidelity of Sita, हनूमतिHanuman's, पराक्रमम् valiance, कथयन्तः speaking, हृष्टाःrejoiced, यथागतम् as they had come from, जग्मुः returned
explanation: Speaking about the highly respected Raghava's prowess, the end of dreadful Ravana, the good fighting of Vanaras, counsel of Sugriva, valour of Hanuman, love of Lakshmana, fidelity of Sita, all rejoiced and returned as they had come.

shloka_text: राघवस्तुरथंदिव्यमिन्द्रदत्तंशिखिप्रभम् ।।6.115.4।। अनुज्ञायमहाभागोर्मातलिंप्रत्यपूजयत् ।
transliteration: rāghavasturathaṃdivyamindradattaṃśikhiprabham  anujñāyamahābhāgormātaliṃpratyapūjayat |
translation: महाभागो honourable, राघवस्तु Raghava too, इन्द्रदत्तम् bestowed by Indra, शिखिप्रभम् aerial chariot, दिव्यम् wonderful, रथम् chariot, अनुज्ञाय bidding farewell, मातलिम् Matali, प्रत्यपूजयत् joyously returned
explanation: Bidding farewell to Matali joyously, honourable Raghava returned the aerial chariot bestowed to him by Indra.

shloka_text: राघवेणाभ्यनुज्ञातोमातलिश्शक्रसारथिः ।।6.115.5।। दिव्यंतंरथमास्थायदिवमेवारूरोहसह ।
transliteration: rāghaveṇābhyanujñātomātaliśśakrasārathiḥ  divyaṃtaṃrathamāsthāyadivamevārūrohasaha |
translation: रा: he, राघवेण by Raghava, अभ्यनुज्ञातः with permission, शक्रसारथिः Indra's charioteer, मातलिःMatali, दिव्यम् wonderful, तंरथम् that chariot, आस्थाय taking, दिवमेव heaven, आरुरोह went
explanation: Matali, charioteer of Indra too taking Raghava's permission went to heaven in that wonderful chariot.

shloka_text: तस्मिंस्तुदिवमारूढेसुसारथिसन्तमे ।।6.115.6।। राघवःपरमप्रीतस्सुग्रीवंपरिषस्वजे ।
transliteration: tasmiṃstudivamārūḍhesusārathisantame  rāghavaḥparamaprītassugrīvaṃpariṣasvaje |
translation: तस्मिन् on his, दिवम् heaven, आरूढे ascended, सुसारथि that charioteer, सन्तमे rejoiced, राघवःRaghava, परमप्रीतः very dearly, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, परिषस्वजे embraced
explanation: "On Matali ascending to heaven, Raghava very dearly embraced Sugriva for his help in his victory."

shloka_text: परिष्वज्य च सुग्रीवंलक्ष्मणेनाभिवादितः ।।6.115.7।। पूज्यमानोहरिगणैराजगामबलालयम् ।
transliteration: pariṣvajya ca sugrīvaṃlakṣmaṇenābhivāditaḥ  pūjyamānoharigaṇairājagāmabalālayam |
translation: सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, परिष्वज्य च embracing, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, अभिवादितः initiated by, हरिगणैः Vanara troops, पूज्यमानः worshipped, बलालयम् by the army, आजगाम went
explanation: On embracing Sugriva, greeted by Lakshmana, and worshipped by the army of Vanaras, Rama returned to the camp.

shloka_text: अथोवाच स काकुत्स्थस्समीपपरिवर्तिनम् ।।6.115.8।। सौमित्रिंसत्त्वसम्पन्नंलक्ष्मणंशुभलक्षणम् ।
transliteration: athovāca sa kākutsthassamīpaparivartinam  saumitriṃsattvasampannaṃlakṣmaṇaṃśubhalakṣaṇam |
translation: अथ and then, सःकाकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, समीपपरिवर्तिनम् nearby surrounded, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, सत्त्वसम्पन्नम् rich in prowess, शुभलक्षणम् of auspicious nature, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, उवाच spoke
explanation: And then, Kakuthsa spoke to Saumithri, of auspicious nature and endowed richly with prowess, who stood close by.

shloka_text: भीषणमिमंसौम्य लङ्कायामभिषेचय ।।6.115.9।। अनुरक्तं च भक्तं च तथापूर्वोपकारिणम् ।
transliteration: bhīṣaṇamimaṃsaumya laṅkāyāmabhiṣecaya  anuraktaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca tathāpūrvopakāriṇam |
translation: सौम्य gentle, अनुरक्तम् very friendly, भक्तं च devotion, तथा so also, पूर्वोपकारिणम् done good work in the past, इमम् him, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, अभिषेचय consecrate
explanation: "Gentle Lakshmana! Vibheeshana is friendly to me and devoted. He has done me good work in the past. Consecrate him in Lanka."

shloka_text: एषमेपरमःकामोयदिमंरावणानुजम् ।।6.115.10।। लङ्कायांसौम्य पश्येमभिषिक्तंविभीषणम् ।
transliteration: eṣameparamaḥkāmoyadimaṃrāvaṇānujam  laṅkāyāṃsaumya paśyemabhiṣiktaṃvibhīṣaṇam |
translation: सौम्य gentle, एषः being so, मे to me, परमः very, कामः desire, यत् that, रावणानुजम् Ravana's brother, इमंविभीषणम् this Vibheeshana, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, अभिषिक्तम् consecrate, पश्येयम् wish to see
explanation: "O gentle Lakshmana! I desire to see this Vibheeshana, Ravana's brother, consecrated at Lanka"

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तुसौमित्रीराघवेणमहात्मना ।।6.115.11।। तथेत्युक्त्वासुसम्हृष्टःसौवर्णंघटमाददे ।
transliteration: evamuktastusaumitrīrāghaveṇamahātmanā  tathetyuktvāsusamhṛṣṭaḥsauvarṇaṃghaṭamādade |
translation: महात्मना great self, राघवेण by Raghava, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः spoken, सौमित्रि Saumithri, तथेति same way, सुसम्हृष्टः very happy, सौवर्णम् golden, घटम् vessel, आददे arranged to get
explanation: Great selfRaghava having spoken like that, Saumithri, very happily arranged to get a golden vessel.

shloka_text: तम्घटंवानरेन्द्राणांहस्तेदत्त्वामनोजवान् ।।6.115.12।। व्यादिदेशमहासत्त्व: समुद्रसलिलंतदा ।
transliteration: tamghaṭaṃvānarendrāṇāṃhastedattvāmanojavān  vyādideśamahāsattva: samudrasalilaṃtadā |
translation: महासत्त्व: endowed with mighty prowess, तदा then, तम् that, घटम् vessel, वानरेन्द्राणाम् chief of Vanaras, हस्ते hand, दत्त्वा given, मनोजवान् endowed with speed of mind, समुद्रसलिलम् water from the ocean, व्यादिदेश to get
explanation: Commanded like that, Lakshmana, endowed with mighty prowess placed that vessel in the hands of Vanara chief, who was endowed with the speed of the mind, to get water from the ocean.

shloka_text: अतिशीघ्रंततोगत्वावानरास्तेमनोजवाः ।।6.115.13।। आगतास्तुजलंगृह्यसमुद्राद्वानरोत्तमाः ।
transliteration: atiśīghraṃtatogatvāvānarāstemanojavāḥ  āgatāstujalaṃgṛhyasamudrādvānarottamāḥ |
translation: ततः then, मनोजवाः who has the speed of mind, वानरोत्तमाः foremost of Vanaras, अतिशीघ्रम् all speed, गत्त्वा going, समुद्रात् ocean's, जलम् water, गृह्य taking, आगताः came
explanation: Then the foremost of the Vanaras, endowed with the speed of mind, with all speed went and got water from the ocean.

shloka_text: ततःस्त्वेकंघटंगृह्यसम्स्थाप्यपरमासने ।।6.115.14।। घटेनतेनसौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम् । लङ्कायांरक्षसांमध्येराजानंरामशासनात् ।।6.115.15।। विधिनामन्त्रदृष्टेनसुहृद्गणसमावृतः ।
transliteration: tataḥstvekaṃghaṭaṃgṛhyasamsthāpyaparamāsane  ghaṭenatenasaumitrirabhyaṣiñcadvibhīṣaṇam | laṅkāyāṃrakṣasāṃmadhyerājānaṃrāmaśāsanāt  vidhināmantradṛṣṭenasuhṛdgaṇasamāvṛtaḥ |
translation: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, सुहृद्गणसमावृतः surrounded by hosts of friends and dear, ततः then, एकम् one, घटम् vessel, गृह्य taking, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, परमासने excellent seat, संस्थाप्य making to sit, तेन thereafter, घटेन with the vessel, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, मध्ये midst, मन्त्रदृष्टेन chanting sacred verses, विधिना in accordance with scriptures, रामशासनात् by Rama's command, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, राजानम् kingdom, अभ्यषिञ्चत् consecrated
explanation: Vibheeshana was made to sit on an excellent seat, surrounded by hosts of friends and dear ones. Thereafter, in the midst of Rakshasas chanting sacred verses in accordance with scriptures, Saumithri took a vessel of water and duly consecrated Vibhishana with the water in the vessel as commanded by Rama, in Lanka.

shloka_text: ततःस्त्वेकंघटंगृह्यसम्स्थाप्यपरमासने ।।6.115.14।। घटेनतेनसौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम् । लङ्कायांरक्षसांमध्येराजानंरामशासनात् ।।6.115.15।। विधिनामन्त्रदृष्टेनसुहृद्गणसमावृतः ।
transliteration: tataḥstvekaṃghaṭaṃgṛhyasamsthāpyaparamāsane  ghaṭenatenasaumitrirabhyaṣiñcadvibhīṣaṇam | laṅkāyāṃrakṣasāṃmadhyerājānaṃrāmaśāsanāt  vidhināmantradṛṣṭenasuhṛdgaṇasamāvṛtaḥ |
translation: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, सुहृद्गणसमावृतः surrounded by hosts of friends and dear, ततः then, एकम् one, घटम् vessel, गृह्य taking, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, परमासने excellent seat, संस्थाप्य making to sit, तेन thereafter, घटेन with the vessel, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, मध्ये midst, मन्त्रदृष्टेन chanting sacred verses, विधिना in accordance with scriptures, रामशासनात् by Rama's command, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, राजानम् kingdom, अभ्यषिञ्चत् consecrated
explanation: Vibheeshana was made to sit on an excellent seat, surrounded by hosts of friends and dear ones. Thereafter, in the midst of Rakshasas chanting sacred verses in accordance with scriptures, Saumithri took a vessel of water and duly consecrated Vibhishana with the water in the vessel as commanded by Rama, in Lanka.

shloka_text: अभ्यषिञ्चंस्तदासर्वेराक्षसावानरास्तथा ।।6.115.16।। प्रहर्षमतुलंगत्वातुष्टुवूराममवे ह ।
transliteration: abhyaṣiñcaṃstadāsarverākṣasāvānarāstathā  praharṣamatulaṃgatvātuṣṭuvūrāmamave ha |
translation: तदा then, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, स्तथा like that, वानराः Vanaras, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecrated, अतुलम् extreme, प्रहर्षम् joy, गत्वा went, राममेवहि Rama alone, तुष्टुवुः paid tribute
explanation: Thereafter all the Rakshasas and Vanaras also consecrated with extreme joy and paid tribute to Rama alone.

shloka_text: तस्यामात्याजहृषिरेभक्तायेचास्यराक्षसाः ।।6.115.17।। दृष्टवाभिषिक्तंलङ्कायांराक्षसेन्द्रंविभीषणम् ।
transliteration: tasyāmātyājahṛṣirebhaktāyecāsyarākṣasāḥ  dṛṣṭavābhiṣiktaṃlaṅkāyāṃrākṣasendraṃvibhīṣaṇam |
translation: लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, अभिषिक्तम् consecrated, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा seeing, तस्य his, अमात्याः ministers, अस्य his, भक्ताः devotees, येराक्षसाः this Rakshasa, जहृषिरे felt rejoiced
explanation: Seeing Vibheeshana consecrated and becoming a king of Lanka, all his ministers and devotees felt rejoiced.

shloka_text: राघवःपरमांप्रीतिंजगामसहलक्ष्मणः ।।6.115.18।। स तद्राज्यंमहत्प्राप्यरामदत्तंविभीषणः ।
transliteration: rāghavaḥparamāṃprītiṃjagāmasahalakṣmaṇaḥ  sa tadrājyaṃmahatprāpyarāmadattaṃvibhīṣaṇaḥ |
translation: सहलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, राघवः Raghava, परमाम् extreme, प्रीतिम् felicity, जगाम felt, सः he, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, रामदत्तम् given by Rama, महत् great, तत् that राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्य attained
explanation: Vibheeshana felt extreme felicity for attaining the kingdom given by great Rama with Lakshmana.

shloka_text: प्रकृतयस्सान्त्वयित्वा च ततोराममुपागमत् ।।6.115.19।। दध्यक्षतान्मोदकांश्चलाजास्सुमनसस्तथा । आजह्रुरथसन्तुष्टाःपौरास्तस्मैनिशाचराः ।।6.115.20।।
transliteration: prakṛtayassāntvayitvā ca tatorāmamupāgamat  dadhyakṣatānmodakāṃścalājāssumanasastathā | ājahrurathasantuṣṭāḥpaurāstasmainiśācarāḥ
translation: प्रकृतीः subjects, सान्त्वयित्वा consoling with good words, ततः that, रामम् Rama, उपागमत् came, अथ and then, पौराः people, निशाचराः night ranger, सन्तुष्टाः very happy, दधि curds, अक्षतान् rice mixed with turmeric, मोदकांश्च sweets, लाजाः parched grain, तथा that way, सुमनसः flowers, तस्मै on him, आजह्रुः offered
explanation: Consoling the subjects of the kingdom with good words, Vibheeshana sought Rama's presence. The people were very happy and brought curds, yellow rice grains (rice mixed with turmeric), flowers and sweets and parched grain and offered.

shloka_text: प्रकृतयस्सान्त्वयित्वा च ततोराममुपागमत् ।।6.115.19।। दध्यक्षतान्मोदकांश्चलाजास्सुमनसस्तथा । आजह्रुरथसन्तुष्टाःपौरास्तस्मैनिशाचराः ।।6.115.20।।
transliteration: prakṛtayassāntvayitvā ca tatorāmamupāgamat  dadhyakṣatānmodakāṃścalājāssumanasastathā | ājahrurathasantuṣṭāḥpaurāstasmainiśācarāḥ
translation: प्रकृतीः subjects, सान्त्वयित्वा consoling with good words, ततः that, रामम् Rama, उपागमत् came, अथ and then, पौराः people, निशाचराः night ranger, सन्तुष्टाः very happy, दधि curds, अक्षतान् rice mixed with turmeric, मोदकांश्च sweets, लाजाः parched grain, तथा that way, सुमनसः flowers, तस्मै on him, आजह्रुः offered
explanation: Consoling the subjects of the kingdom with good words, Vibheeshana sought Rama's presence. The people were very happy and brought curds, yellow rice grains (rice mixed with turmeric), flowers and sweets and parched grain and offered.

shloka_text: सःतान् गृहीत्वादुर्धर्षोराघवायन्यवेदयत् ।।6.115.21।। माङ्गल्यंमङ्गलंसर्वंलक्ष्मणाय च वीर्यवान् ।
transliteration: saḥtān gṛhītvādurdharṣorāghavāyanyavedayat  māṅgalyaṃmaṅgalaṃsarvaṃlakṣmaṇāya ca vīryavān |
translation: दुर्धर्षः difficult to encounter, वीर्यवान् valiant, सःhe, तान् him, गृहीत्वा received, सर्वम् all, माङ्गल्यम् benign offerings, मङ्गलम् auspicious, राघवाय to Raghava, लक्ष्मणाय and Lakshmana, न्यवेदयत् presented
explanation: Valiant Vibheeshana, who is difficult to encounter, presented the benign offerings and auspicious ones received by him to Rama and Lakshmana.

shloka_text: कृतकार्यंसमृद्धार्थंदृष्टवारामोविभीषणम् ।।6.115.22।। प्रतिजग्राहतत्सर्वंतस्यैवप्रियकाम्यया ।
transliteration: kṛtakāryaṃsamṛddhārthaṃdṛṣṭavārāmovibhīṣaṇam  pratijagrāhatatsarvaṃtasyaivapriyakāmyayā |
translation: रामः Rama, कृतकार्यम् accomplished, समृद्धार्थम् richly endowed, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा seeing, तस्य his, प्रियकाम्ययाएव to please, तत् those, सर्वम् all, प्रतिजग्राह received in return
explanation: Rama having accomplished the task, thoughtfully pleased did not desire for the offerings, accepted them to please Vibheeshana.

shloka_text: ततःशैलोपमंवीरंप्राञ्जलिंप्रणतंस्थितम् ।।6.115.23।। उवाचेदंवचोरामोहनूमन्तंप्लवङ्गमम् ।
transliteration: tataḥśailopamaṃvīraṃprāñjaliṃpraṇataṃsthitam  uvācedaṃvacorāmohanūmantaṃplavaṅgamam |
translation: ततः then, रामःRama, शैलोपमम् like mountain, वीरम् hero, प्राञ्जलिम् greeting with joined palms, प्रणतम् supplicant mood, स्थितम् stood, प्लवङ्गमम् Vanara, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, इदंवचः these words, उवाच spoke
explanation: Then Rama, seeing a heroic mountain like Hanuman, who stood there in supplicant mood greeting him with joined palms, spoke these words.

shloka_text: अनुज्ञाप्यमहाराजमिमंसौम्य विभीषणम् ।।6.115.24।। प्रविश्यनगरींलङ्कांकौशलंब्रूहिमैथिलीम् ।
transliteration: anujñāpyamahārājamimaṃsaumya vibhīṣaṇam  praviśyanagarīṃlaṅkāṃkauśalaṃbrūhimaithilīm |
translation: सौम्य gentle, महाराजम् great king, इमम् this, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, अनुज्ञाप्य with permission, लङ्कांनगरीम् Lanka city, प्रविश्य entering, मैथिलीम् Mythili, कौशलम् wellbeing, ब्रूहि enquire
explanation: "O Gentle Hanuman! Taking the permission of the great king Vibheeshana, entering the city of Lanka, enquire the wellbeing of Mythili."

shloka_text: वैदेह्यैमांकुशलिनंसुग्रीवं च सलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.115.25।। आचक्ष्ववदतांश्रेष्ठरावणं च हतंरणे ।
transliteration: vaidehyaimāṃkuśalinaṃsugrīvaṃ ca salakṣmaṇam  ācakṣvavadatāṃśreṣṭharāvaṇaṃ ca hataṃraṇe |
translation: वदताम् eloquent, श्रेष्ठ best, माम् me, सलक्ष्मणम् and Lakshmana, सुग्रीवं च and Sugriva, कुशलिनम् are doing well, रावणम् Ravana, रणे in combat, हतम् killed, वैदेह्यै Vaidehi, आचक्ष्व tell her
explanation: "Convey to Vaidehi that me and Lakshman and also Sugriva are doing well, and that Ravana has been killed, O Best among the eloquent."

shloka_text: इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टोहनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । प्रविवेशपुरींलङ्कांपूज्यमानोनिशाचरैः ।।6.116.1।।
transliteration: itipratisamādiṣṭohanūmānmārutātmajaḥ | praviveśapurīṃlaṅkāṃpūjyamānoniśācaraiḥ
translation: इति thus, प्रतिसमादिष्टः commanded, मारुतात्मजः son of Maruti, हनुमान् Hanuman, निशाचरैः night ranger, पूज्यमानः offered prayers, लङ्कांपुरीम् into Lanka, प्रविवेश entered
explanation: Having been commanded, Hanuman offered prayers to Vibheeshana and entered Lanka.
comments: Hanuman communicates the victory of Sri Rama to Sita and the message.

shloka_text: प्रविश्य चपुरींलङ्कांपूज्यमानोनिशाचारै: । ततस्तेनाभ्युनुज्ञातोहनुमान्वृक्षवाटिकाम् ।।6.116.2।। सम्प्रविश्ययथान्यायंसीतायाद्विितोहरिः । ददर्शमृजयाहीनांसातङ्कांरोहिणीमिव ।।6.116.3।। वृक्षमूलेनिरानन्दांराक्षसीभिःपरीवृताम् । निभृतःप्रणतःप्रह्वस्सोऽभिगम्याभिवाद्य च ।।6.116.4।।
transliteration: praviśya capurīṃlaṅkāṃpūjyamānoniśācārai: | tatastenābhyunujñātohanumānvṛkṣavāṭikām  sampraviśyayathānyāyaṃsītāyādviitohariḥ | dadarśamṛjayāhīnāṃsātaṅkāṃrohiṇīmiva  vṛkṣamūlenirānandāṃrākṣasībhiḥparīvṛtām | nibhṛtaḥpraṇataḥprahvasso'bhigamyābhivādya ca
translation: सीतायाः Sita, विदितः knew, हरिः monkey, सः he, हनूमान् Hanuman, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, प्रविश्य entered, निशाचरै: through Rakshasas, पूज्यमान: offered prayers, ततः then, तेन, अभ्युनुज्ञातः attracted the notice, वृक्षवाटिकाम् Ashoka grove, यथान्यायम् duly, सम्प्रविश्य entering, मृजया to clean, हीनाम् weak, सातङ्काम् with no bath, रोहिणीमिव like Rohini star, निरानन्दाम् cheerless, राक्षसीभिः Rakshasas also, परीवृताम् surrounded, वृक्षमूले at the foot of the tree, ददर्शसः he saw, अभिगम्य after reaching, अभिवाद्य च greeted, प्रणतः with folded palms, प्रह्वः stood, निभृतः motionless
explanation: The monkey, having sought the permission of Vibheeshana, entered Lanka city. Duly entering the Asoka grove, he attracted the attention of Sita, who was weak with no bath, cheerless, seated at the root of the tree, like Rohini star. After reaching the grove, he greeted Sita with folded palms and stood motionless.

explanation: The monkey, having sought the permission of Vibheeshana, entered Lanka city. Duly entering the Asoka grove, he attracted the attention of Sita, who was weak with no bath, cheerless, seated at the root of the tree, like Rohini star. After reaching the grove, he greeted Sita with folded palms and stood motionless.

shloka_text: दृष्टवासमागतंदेवीहनूमन्तंमहाबलम् । तूष्णीमास्ततदादृष्टवास्मृत्वासृष्टाभवत्तदा ।।6.116.5।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭavāsamāgataṃdevīhanūmantaṃmahābalam | tūṣṇīmāstatadādṛṣṭavāsmṛtvāsṛṣṭābhavattadā
translation: देवी Devi, तदा then, समागतम् arrived, महाबलम् mighty, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टवा seeing, तूष्णीम् quiet, अस्त first, तदा then, दृष्टवा seeing, स्मृत्वा recognizing, हृष्टा joy, अभवत् experienced
explanation: Seeing the mighty Hanuman, who arrived quietly, she was quiet. Then she saw him and experienced joy on recognizing him

shloka_text: सौम्यंतस्यामुखंदृष्टवाहनुमान्प्लवगोत्तमः । रामस्यवचनंसर्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।।6.116.6।।
transliteration: saumyaṃtasyāmukhaṃdṛṣṭavāhanumānplavagottamaḥ | rāmasyavacanaṃsarvamākhyātumupacakrame
translation: प्लवगोत्तमः foremost monkey, हनूमान् Hanuman, सौम्यम् gentle, तस्याः his, मुखम् face, दृष्टवा seeing, रामस्य Rama's, सर्वम् everything, वचनम् words, आख्यातुम् to communicate, उपचक्रमे started
explanation: Gentle Hanuman, the foremost of the monkeys, seeing her started to communicate every word of Rama.

shloka_text: वैदेही कुशलीरामस्सहसुग्रीवलक्ष्मणः । वभीषणसहायश्चहरीणांसहितोबलैः ।।6.116.7।।
transliteration: vaidehī kuśalīrāmassahasugrīvalakṣmaṇaḥ | vabhīṣaṇasahāyaścaharīṇāṃsahitobalaiḥ
translation: वैदेहि Vaidehi, सहसुग्रवलक्ष्मणः and Sugriva, Lakshmana, विभीषणसहायश्च with the help of Vibheeshana, हरीणाम् and monkeys, बलैः army, सहितःaccompanied by, रामःRama, कुशली doing well
explanation: Hanuman said" O Vaidehi! Sri Rama accompanied by Sugriva and Lakshmana, with the help of Vibheeshana, is doing well."

shloka_text: कुशलंचाहसिद्धार्थोहतशत्रुरिमत्रजित् । विभीषणसहायेनरामेणहरिभिस्सह ।।6.116.8।। निहतोरावणोदेविलक्ष्मणेन च वीर्यवान् ।
transliteration: kuśalaṃcāhasiddhārthohataśatrurimatrajit | vibhīṣaṇasahāyenarāmeṇaharibhissaha  nihatorāvaṇodevilakṣmaṇena ca vīryavān |
translation: अमित्रजित् won the enemy, हतशत्रुः killed enemy, सिद्धार्थः accomplished the purpose, त्वा your, कुशलम् wellbeing, चाह to speak, देवि noble lady, विभीषणसहायेन with the help of Vibheeshana, हरिभिः monkeys also सह also, रामेण by Rama, लक्ष्मणेन Lakshmana, वीर्यवान् valiant, रावणः Ravana, निहतः killed
explanation: "Noble lady! Sri Rama killed Ravana and won the enemy. He accomplished the purpose with the help of Vibheeshana, the valiant Lakshmana and the monkeys also so to speak. He inquired of your wellbeing."

shloka_text: प्रियमाख्यामितेदेविभूयश्चत्वांसभाजये ।।6.116.9।। तवप्रभावाद्धर्मजेमहान् रामेणसंयुगे । लब्धोऽयंविजयस्सीतेस्वस्थाभवगतज्वरा ।।6.116.10।।
transliteration: priyamākhyāmitedevibhūyaścatvāṃsabhājaye  tavaprabhāvāddharmajemahān rāmeṇasaṃyuge | labdho'yaṃvijayassītesvasthābhavagatajvarā
translation: देवि noble lady, ते to you, प्रियम् delightful, आख्यामि communicated, भूयः telling, त्वाम् you, सभाजये respectable one, धर्मज्ञे knower of right knowledge, सीते Sita, तव to you, प्रभावात् strength, संयुगे in the combat, रामेण by Rama, महान् great self, अयम् this, विजयः victory, लब्दः attained, गतज्वरा freed from fear, स्वस्था strength, भव your
explanation: "O noble lady! I am communicating delightful news to you. O Sita, a respectable lady and knowledgeable one, the victory is attained in the combat by the great soul Rama, by virtue of your strength and devotion."

shloka_text: प्रियमाख्यामितेदेविभूयश्चत्वांसभाजये ।।6.116.9।। तवप्रभावाद्धर्मजेमहान् रामेणसंयुगे । लब्धोऽयंविजयस्सीतेस्वस्थाभवगतज्वरा ।।6.116.10।।
transliteration: priyamākhyāmitedevibhūyaścatvāṃsabhājaye  tavaprabhāvāddharmajemahān rāmeṇasaṃyuge | labdho'yaṃvijayassītesvasthābhavagatajvarā
translation: देवि noble lady, ते to you, प्रियम् delightful, आख्यामि communicated, भूयः telling, त्वाम् you, सभाजये respectable one, धर्मज्ञे knower of right knowledge, सीते Sita, तव to you, प्रभावात् strength, संयुगे in the combat, रामेण by Rama, महान् great self, अयम् this, विजयः victory, लब्दः attained, गतज्वरा freed from fear, स्वस्था strength, भव your
explanation: "O noble lady! I am communicating delightful news to you. O Sita, a respectable lady and knowledgeable one, the victory is attained in the combat by the great soul Rama, by virtue of your strength and devotion."

shloka_text: रावणश्चहतश्शत्रुर्लङ्कचैववशीकृता । मयाह्यलब्न्दिद्रेणधृतेनतवनिर्जये ।।6.116.11।। प्रतिज्ञैषाविनिस्तीर्णाबद्ध्वासेतुंमहोदधौ ।
transliteration: rāvaṇaścahataśśatrurlaṅkacaivavaśīkṛtā | mayāhyalabndidreṇadhṛtenatavanirjaye  pratijñaiṣāvinistīrṇābaddhvāsetuṃmahodadhau |
translation: शत्रुः enemy, रावणश्च Ravana, हतः killed, लङ्काचैव in Lanka also, वशीकृता under control, तव your, निर्जये vanquished completely, धृतेन forbearance, अलब्न्दिद्रेण without little sleep, मया by me, महोदधौ on the great ocean, सेतुम् bridge, बद्ध्वा constructed, एषा in that way, प्रतिज्ञा vow, विनिस्तीर्णा extensive
explanation: 'Ravana has been killed, Lanka is under our side vanquished completely. Without any sleep, with forbearance, building an extensive bridge on the great ocean, the vow has been redeemed', is Rama's message to you, said Hanuman.

shloka_text: सम्भ्रमश्च न कर्तव्योवर्तन्त्यारावणालये ।।6.116.12।। विभीषणविधेयंहिलङ्कैश्वर्यमिदंकृतम् ।
transliteration: sambhramaśca na kartavyovartantyārāvaṇālaye  vibhīṣaṇavidheyaṃhilaṅkaiśvaryamidaṃkṛtam |
translation: रावणालये Ravana's abode, वर्तन्त्या staying, सम्भ्रमः च perturbation, न कर्तव्यः not required, इदम् this, लङ्कैश्वर्यम् Lanka's Lord, विभीषणविधेयम् under Vibheeshana, कृतंहि has become
explanation: "This Lanka is under Vibheeshana, Lord of Lanka. There is no need for perturbation thinking that you are in Ravana's abode."

shloka_text: तदाश्वसिहिविस्रब्धंस्वगृहेपरिवर्तसे ।।6.116.13।। अयंचाभ्येतिसम्हृष्टस्त्वद्धर्शनसमुत्सुकः ।
transliteration: tadāśvasihivisrabdhaṃsvagṛheparivartase  ayaṃcābhyetisamhṛṣṭastvaddharśanasamutsukaḥ |
translation: तत् therefore, विस्रब्धम् be at ease, अश्वसिहि consoling, स्वगृहे own house, परिवर्तसे encompassed, अयंहि who is, सम्हृष्टः very happy, त्वद्धर्शनसमुत्सुकः eager to see you, अभ्येति favouring
explanation: "You be at ease, as you are living in your own abode", said Hanuman consoling Sita. 'Vibheeshana, who is very happy, is eager and favouring to see you."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तासमुत्पत्यसीताशशिनिभानना ।।6.116.14।। प्रहर्षेणावरुद्धासाव्याहर्तुं न शशाक ह ।
transliteration: evamuktāsamutpatyasītāśaśinibhānanā  praharṣeṇāvaruddhāsāvyāhartuṃ na śaśāka ha |
translation: एवम् that way, उक्ता having spoken, शशिनिभानना countenance of moon, समुत्पत्य got up, सीता Sita, प्रहर्षेण in joy, अवरुद्धा stopped, व्याहर्तुम् to speak, न शशाकह could not talk naturally.
explanation: Hanuman having spoken in that way, Sita got up in excessive joy and could not speak naturally.

shloka_text: ततोऽब्रवीद्धरिवरःसीतामप्रतिजल्पतीम् ।।6.116.15।। किंत्वंचिन्तयसेदेविकिं च मांनाभिभाषसे ।
transliteration: tato'bravīddharivaraḥsītāmapratijalpatīm  kiṃtvaṃcintayasedevikiṃ ca māṃnābhibhāṣase |
translation: ततः then, हरिवरः monkey chief, अप्रतिजल्पतीम् not replying, सीताम् Sita, अब्रवीत् spoke, देवि Devi, त्वम् you, किम् What चिन्तयसे thinking, माम् me, किम् why, नाभिभाषसे not answering
explanation: Then seeing Sita not answering him, the monkey chief asked her" Why are you not replying. What are you thinking?"

shloka_text: एवमुक्ताहनुमतासीताधर्मपथेस्थिता ।।6.116.16।। अब्रवीत्परमप्रीताबाष्पगद्गदयागिरा ।
transliteration: evamuktāhanumatāsītādharmapathesthitā  abravītparamaprītābāṣpagadgadayāgirā |
translation: हनुमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्ता spoken, धर्मपथे virtuous, स्थिता stood, सीता Sita, परमप्रीता very delighted, बाष्पगद्गदया voice choked with tears, गिरा speech, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: When Hanuman spoke in that way virtuous Sita was overwhelmed with joy and spoke with a voice choked with tears.

shloka_text: प्रियमेतदुपश्रुत्यभर्तुर्विजयसंश्रयम् ।।6.116.17।। प्रहर्षवशमापन्नानिर्वाक्यास्मिक्षणान्तरम् ।
transliteration: priyametadupaśrutyabharturvijayasaṃśrayam  praharṣavaśamāpannānirvākyāsmikṣaṇāntaram |
translation: भर्तुः husband, विजयसंश्रयम् victorious no doubt, एतत् all this, प्रियम् delighting, उपश्रुत्य hearing, प्रहर्षवशम् overcome with delight, आपन्ना having experienced, क्षणान्तरम् for a second, निर्वाक्या not able to speak, अस्मि I am
explanation: "No doubt that my husband is victorious is very delightful. Hearing this, I am overcome with delight and am unable to speak for a moment."

shloka_text: न हिपश्यामिसदृशंचिन्तयन्तीप्लवङ्गमा ।।6.116.18।। मप्रतियाब्यानकस्येहदातुंप्रत्यभिनन्दनम् ।
transliteration: na hipaśyāmisadṛśaṃcintayantīplavaṅgamā  mapratiyābyānakasyehadātuṃpratyabhinandanam |
translation: प्लवङ्गम monkey, चिन्तयन्ती however I think, इह here, मप्रतियाख्यानकस्य to please you, दातुम् to give, सदृशम् befitting, प्रत्यभिनन्दनम् for this happiness, न पश्यामिहि not able to see
explanation: "Hanuman! However, I think to give you a befitting gift for this happy news. I am not able to see any."

shloka_text: नहिपश्यामिततसौम्यपृथिव्यामपिवानर ।।6.116.19।। सदृशंयत्प्रियाख्यानेतवदत्त्वाभवेत्सुखम् ।
transliteration: nahipaśyāmitatasaumyapṛthivyāmapivānara  sadṛśaṃyatpriyākhyānetavadattvābhavetsukham |
translation: प्रियाख्यान value of your message, सदृशम् befitting, यत् such, तव to you, दत्त्वा gift, सुखम् happy, भवेत् make you, सदृशम् befitting, किञ्चन anything, पृथिव्याम् on this earth, न हिपश्यामि not able to see
explanation: "I am not able to see on this earth, a gift befitting the value of your message, which can be given to you to make you happy."

shloka_text: हिरण्यंवासुवर्णंवारत्नानिविविधानिच ।।6.116.20।। राज्यंवात्रिषुलोकेषुनैतदर्हतिभाषितम् ।
transliteration: hiraṇyaṃvāsuvarṇaṃvāratnānivividhānica  rājyaṃvātriṣulokeṣunaitadarhatibhāṣitam |
translation: हिरण्यंवा gold or, सुवर्णंवा silver, विविधानि several, रत्नानि gems, त्रिषुलोकेषु in the three worlds, राज्यंवा kingdom or, एतत् all this, भाषितम् spoken now, नार्हति not equal
explanation: "Neither gold or silver or gems, not even kingdom or the three worlds are equal to what you have spoken now."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तुवैदेह्याप्रत्युवाचप्लवङ्गमः ।।6.116.21।। प्रगृहीताञ्जलिर्हर्षासतीतायाःप्रमुखेस्थितः ।
transliteration: evamuktastuvaidehyāpratyuvācaplavaṅgamaḥ  pragṛhītāñjalirharṣāsatītāyāḥpramukhesthitaḥ |
translation: वैदेह्या by Vaidehi, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, प्लवङ्गमाः Hanuman, प्रगृहीताञ्जलिः in front with palms closed, सीतायाः Sita, प्रमुखे chief, स्थितः stood, हर्षात् delighted, प्रत्युवाच replied
explanation: Spoken in that way by Vaidehi, Hanuman stood with folded palms in front of Sita and replied in delight.

shloka_text: भर्तुःप्रियहितेयुक्तेभर्तुर्विजयकाङ्क्षिण: ।।6.116.22।। स्निग्धमेवंविधंवाक्यंत्वमेवार्हस्यनिन्दिते ।
transliteration: bhartuḥpriyahiteyuktebharturvijayakāṅkṣiṇa:  snigdhamevaṃvidhaṃvākyaṃtvamevārhasyanindite |
translation: भर्तुः husband, प्रियहिते welfare, युक्ते such loving, भर्तुः husband, विजयकाङ्क्षिण: wishing his victory, अनिन्दिते irreproachable, स्निग्धम् loving, एवंविधम् this manner, वाक्यम् words, त्वमेव you alone, अर्हसि can speak
explanation: "You alone can speak such affectionate words in this manner wishing victory and welfare of your dear husband. You are irreproachable."

shloka_text: तवैतद्वचनंसौम्येसारवत् स्निग्धमेव च ।।6.116.23।। रत्नौघाद्विविधाच्चापिदेवराज्याद्विशिष्यते ।
transliteration: tavaitadvacanaṃsaumyesāravat snigdhameva ca  ratnaughādvividhāccāpidevarājyādviśiṣyate |
translation: सौम्ये gentle, तव your, सारवत् meaningful, स्निग्धमेव full of affection, एतत् वचनम् such words, विविधात् many, रत्नौघात् cluster of gems, देवराज्यात् Lord of gods, विशिष्यते higher
explanation: "O gentle one! Your meaningful words full of affection are more valuable than clusters of gems or Indra, the Lord of gods."

shloka_text: अर्थतश्चमयाप्राप्तादेवरज्यादयोगुणाः ।।6.116.24।। हतशत्रुंविजयिनंरामंपश्यामिसुस्थितम् ।
transliteration: arthataścamayāprāptādevarajyādayoguṇāḥ  hataśatruṃvijayinaṃrāmaṃpaśyāmisusthitam |
translation: हतशत्रुम् enemy killed, विजयिनम् victorious, सुस्थितम् happy, रामम् Rama, पश्यामि see, अर्थतः meaningful, मया by me, देवराज्यादयः rulership of gods, गुणाः virtues, प्राप्ताः attained
explanation: "Now that the enemy is killed, Rama is happy, which means as if I have attained the rulership of gods."

shloka_text: तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वामैथिलीजनकात्मजा ।।6.116.25।। ततःशुभतरंवाक्यमुवाचपवनात्मजम् ।
transliteration: tasyatadvacanaṃśrutvāmaithilījanakātmajā  tataḥśubhataraṃvākyamuvācapavanātmajam |
translation: जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, मैथिली Mythili, तस्य her, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, ततः that, पवनात्मजम् son of wind god, शुभतरम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke
explanation: Hearing the words of Mythili, daughter of Janaka, Hanuman spoke these auspicious words.

shloka_text: अतिलक्षणसम्पन्नंमाधुर्यगुणभूषितम् ।।6.116.26।। बुद्ध्याह्यष्टाङ्गयायुक्तंत्वमेवार्हसिभाषितुम् ।
transliteration: atilakṣaṇasampannaṃmādhuryaguṇabhūṣitam  buddhyāhyaṣṭāṅgayāyuktaṃtvamevārhasibhāṣitum |
translation: अतिलक्षणसम्पन्नम् rich and full of virtuous qualities, माधुर्यगुणभूषितम् sweet and valuable, अष्टाङ्गया eight excellences, बुद्ध्या intellect, युक्तम् combined with, भाषितुम् language, त्वमेव always, अर्हसि you deserve
explanation: Continuing to pay tribute to Hanuman's words, Sita said" Your language and expression are always richly endowed with virtuous qualities, sweet and valuable, combined with eight excellences. (Eight excellences areKeenness to hear discourses, readiness to hear discourses, receptivity, retentive power, reasoning for a proposition, against a proposition, faculty of comprehension, realization of truth)."

shloka_text: श्लाघनीयोऽनिलस्यत्वंसुतःपरमधार्मिकः ।।6.116.27।। बलंशौर्यंश्रुतंसत्त्वंविक्रमोदाक्ष्यमुत्तमम् । तेजःक्षमाधृतिस्स्थैर्यंविनीतत्वं न संशयः ।।6.116.28।। एतेचान्ये च बहवोगुणास्त्वय्येवशोभनाः ।
transliteration: ślāghanīyo'nilasyatvaṃsutaḥparamadhārmikaḥ  balaṃśauryaṃśrutaṃsattvaṃvikramodākṣyamuttamam | tejaḥkṣamādhṛtissthairyaṃvinītatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  etecānye ca bahavoguṇāstvayyevaśobhanāḥ |
translation: अनिलस्य wind god's, श्लाघनीयः praise worthy, सुतः son, त्वम् you are, परमधार्मिकः very righteous, बलम् strength, शौर्यम् valour, श्रुतम् vigour, सत्त्वम् prowess, विक्रमः skill, उत्तमम् excellent, तेजः energy, क्षमा tolerance, धृतिः forbearance, स्थैर्यम् firmness, विनीतत्वम् humility, एते these, अन्ये other, बहवः many, शोभनाः brilliance, गुणाः qualities, त्वय्येव in you alone, संशयः doubt, न no
explanation: "You are a praiseworthy son of wind god. In strength, righteousness, valour, vigour, prowess, skill, you are excellent. You are energetic, endowed with tolerance, forbearance, firmness, brilliance, and humility. You alone have many more qualities, no doubt."

shloka_text: श्लाघनीयोऽनिलस्यत्वंसुतःपरमधार्मिकः ।।6.116.27।। बलंशौर्यंश्रुतंसत्त्वंविक्रमोदाक्ष्यमुत्तमम् । तेजःक्षमाधृतिस्स्थैर्यंविनीतत्वं न संशयः ।।6.116.28।। एतेचान्ये च बहवोगुणास्त्वय्येवशोभनाः ।
transliteration: ślāghanīyo'nilasyatvaṃsutaḥparamadhārmikaḥ  balaṃśauryaṃśrutaṃsattvaṃvikramodākṣyamuttamam | tejaḥkṣamādhṛtissthairyaṃvinītatvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ  etecānye ca bahavoguṇāstvayyevaśobhanāḥ |
translation: अनिलस्य wind god's, श्लाघनीयः praise worthy, सुतः son, त्वम् you are, परमधार्मिकः very righteous, बलम् strength, शौर्यम् valour, श्रुतम् vigour, सत्त्वम् prowess, विक्रमः skill, उत्तमम् excellent, तेजः energy, क्षमा tolerance, धृतिः forbearance, स्थैर्यम् firmness, विनीतत्वम् humility, एते these, अन्ये other, बहवः many, शोभनाः brilliance, गुणाः qualities, त्वय्येव in you alone, संशयः doubt, न no
explanation: "You are a praiseworthy son of wind god. In strength, righteousness, valour, vigour, prowess, skill, you are excellent. You are energetic, endowed with tolerance, forbearance, firmness, brilliance, and humility. You alone have many more qualities, no doubt."

shloka_text: अथोवाचपुनस्सीतामसम्भ्रान्तोविनीतवत् ।।6.116.29।। प्रगृहीताञ्चलिर्हर्षात्सीतायाःप्रमुखेस्थितः ।
transliteration: athovācapunassītāmasambhrāntovinītavat  pragṛhītāñcalirharṣātsītāyāḥpramukhesthitaḥ |
translation: अथ now, प्रगृहीताञ्जलिः with palms folded offering prayers, सीतायाः to Sita, पुरतः to city, स्थितः stood, असम्भ्रान्तः without any perturbation, विनीतवत् with all humility, पुनः again, सीताम् Sita, उवाच spoke
explanation: Now with folded palms offering prayers to Sita, Hanuman stood without perturbation, with all humility and again spoke to Sita.

shloka_text: इमास्तुखलुराक्षस्योयदित्वमनुमन्यसे ।।6.116.30।। हन्तुमिच्छामितास्सर्वायाभिस्त्वंतर्जितापुरा ।
transliteration: imāstukhalurākṣasyoyaditvamanumanyase  hantumicchāmitāssarvāyābhistvaṃtarjitāpurā |
translation: इमाः these, पुरा in the past, त्वम् you, याभिः whoever, तर्जिताः threatened, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, खलु indeed, त्वम् you, अनुमन्यसेयदि intimidated, ताःसर्वाः all those, हन्तुम् to kill, इच्छामि I desire
explanation: "I desire to kill all those Rakshasas who in the past have intimidated you indeed and whoever threatened you."

shloka_text: क्लिश्यन्तीम् पतिदेवांत्वामशोकवनिकांगताम् ।।6.116.31।। घोररूपसमाचाराःक्रूराःक्रूरतरेक्षणाः । इहश्रुतामयादेवि राक्षस्योविकृताननाः ।।6.116.32।। असकृत्परुषैर्वाक्यैर्वद्नत्योरावणाज्ञया ।
transliteration: kliśyantīm patidevāṃtvāmaśokavanikāṃgatām  ghorarūpasamācārāḥkrūrāḥkrūratarekṣaṇāḥ | ihaśrutāmayādevi rākṣasyovikṛtānanāḥ  asakṛtparuṣairvākyairvadnatyorāvaṇājñayā |
translation: देवि Devi, क्लिश्यन्तीम् tormented, पतिदेवाम् husband, अशोकवनिकाम् in Asoka grove, गताम् earlier, त्वाम् you, घोररूपसमाचाराः of fierce form, क्रूराः cruel, क्रूरतरेक्षणाः of terrible eyes, विकृताननाः distorted forms, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, रावणाज्ञया by Ravana's order, असकृत्प hideous conduct, परुषैः harshly, वाक्यैः words, र्वद्नत्यः addressing, इह here, मया by me, श्रुताः heard
explanation: "O Devi! You, who were so devoted to your husband, were tormented in Asoka grove earlier. These cruel Rakshasas of hideous conduct, of fierce and distorted forms with terrible eyes addressing you in harsh words by Ravana's order, were heard by me."

shloka_text: क्लिश्यन्तीम् पतिदेवांत्वामशोकवनिकांगताम् ।।6.116.31।। घोररूपसमाचाराःक्रूराःक्रूरतरेक्षणाः । इहश्रुतामयादेवि राक्षस्योविकृताननाः ।।6.116.32।। असकृत्परुषैर्वाक्यैर्वद्नत्योरावणाज्ञया ।
transliteration: kliśyantīm patidevāṃtvāmaśokavanikāṃgatām  ghorarūpasamācārāḥkrūrāḥkrūratarekṣaṇāḥ | ihaśrutāmayādevi rākṣasyovikṛtānanāḥ  asakṛtparuṣairvākyairvadnatyorāvaṇājñayā |
translation: देवि Devi, क्लिश्यन्तीम् tormented, पतिदेवाम् husband, अशोकवनिकाम् in Asoka grove, गताम् earlier, त्वाम् you, घोररूपसमाचाराः of fierce form, क्रूराः cruel, क्रूरतरेक्षणाः of terrible eyes, विकृताननाः distorted forms, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, रावणाज्ञया by Ravana's order, असकृत्प hideous conduct, परुषैः harshly, वाक्यैः words, र्वद्नत्यः addressing, इह here, मया by me, श्रुताः heard
explanation: "O Devi! You, who were so devoted to your husband, were tormented in Asoka grove earlier. These cruel Rakshasas of hideous conduct, of fierce and distorted forms with terrible eyes addressing you in harsh words by Ravana's order, were heard by me."

shloka_text: विकृताविकृताकाराःक्रूराःक्रूरकचेक्षणाः ।।6.116.33।। इच्छामिविविधैराघतैर्हन्तुमेतास्सुदारुणाः । राक्षस्योदारुणकथावरमेतत्प्रयच्छमे ।।6.116.34।।
transliteration: vikṛtāvikṛtākārāḥkrūrāḥkrūrakacekṣaṇāḥ  icchāmivividhairāghatairhantumetāssudāruṇāḥ | rākṣasyodāruṇakathāvarametatprayacchame
translation: विकृताः distorted, विकृताकाराः distorted forms, क्रूराः cruel, क्रूरकचेक्षणाः fierce eyes and terrible hair, सुदारुणाः terrific, दारुणकथाः not to mention, how violent, एताः these, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, विविधैः several, घातैः strokes, हन्तुम् to kill, इच्चामि desire, मे I, एतत् all kinds, वरम् description, प्रयच्छ permit
explanation: "I wish to kill by all kinds of strokes, these cruel distorted forms of Rakshasas having terrible hair and fierce eyes and not to mention their violence. Permit me."

shloka_text: विकृताविकृताकाराःक्रूराःक्रूरकचेक्षणाः ।।6.116.33।। इच्छामिविविधैराघतैर्हन्तुमेतास्सुदारुणाः । राक्षस्योदारुणकथावरमेतत्प्रयच्छमे ।।6.116.34।।
transliteration: vikṛtāvikṛtākārāḥkrūrāḥkrūrakacekṣaṇāḥ  icchāmivividhairāghatairhantumetāssudāruṇāḥ | rākṣasyodāruṇakathāvarametatprayacchame
translation: विकृताः distorted, विकृताकाराः distorted forms, क्रूराः cruel, क्रूरकचेक्षणाः fierce eyes and terrible hair, सुदारुणाः terrific, दारुणकथाः not to mention, how violent, एताः these, राक्षस्यः Rakshasas, विविधैः several, घातैः strokes, हन्तुम् to kill, इच्चामि desire, मे I, एतत् all kinds, वरम् description, प्रयच्छ permit
explanation: "I wish to kill by all kinds of strokes, these cruel distorted forms of Rakshasas having terrible hair and fierce eyes and not to mention their violence. Permit me."

shloka_text: मुष्टिभिःपर्षिणघातैश्चविशालैश्चैवबाहुभिः । जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्चदन्तानांचैवपीडनैः ।।6.116.35।। भक्षणैःकर्णनासानांकेशानांलुञ्चनैस्तथा । भृशंशुष्कमुखैश्चैवदारणैर्लङ्घनैर्हतैः ।।6.116.36।। विभिन्नशङ्कुग्रीवांशपार्श्वकैश्चकलेवरैः । निपात्यहन्तुमिच्छामितवविप्रियकारिणीः ।।6.116.37।।
transliteration: muṣṭibhiḥparṣiṇaghātaiścaviśālaiścaivabāhubhiḥ | jaṅghājānuprahāraiścadantānāṃcaivapīḍanaiḥ  bhakṣaṇaiḥkarṇanāsānāṃkeśānāṃluñcanaistathā | bhṛśaṃśuṣkamukhaiścaivadāraṇairlaṅghanairhataiḥ  vibhinnaśaṅkugrīvāṃśapārśvakaiścakalevaraiḥ | nipātyahantumicchāmitavavipriyakāriṇīḥ
translation: तव your, विप्रियकारिणी who have wronged to you, मुष्टिभिःfists, पाणिघातैश्च hit with feet, विशालैःspreading, बाहुभिःarms, जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्च with blows of shanks and knees, दन्तानाम् with teeth, पीडनैः tormenting, कर्णनासानाम् pulling out ears and nose, धक्षणैःgrant, तथा this, केशानाम् hair, लुञ्चनैःtearing off, भृशम् violently, शुष्कमुखैःचैव making their faces dry, दारणैः dreadful, लङ्घनैः throw uptoss, हतैः kill, विभिन्नशङ्कुग्रीवांसपार्श्वकैः tear with different sharp conches, कलेवरैः bodies broken necks, trunks, and heads, निपात्य throwing down, हन्तुम् kill, इच्छामि wish to do
explanation: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."

shloka_text: मुष्टिभिःपर्षिणघातैश्चविशालैश्चैवबाहुभिः । जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्चदन्तानांचैवपीडनैः ।।6.116.35।। भक्षणैःकर्णनासानांकेशानांलुञ्चनैस्तथा । भृशंशुष्कमुखैश्चैवदारणैर्लङ्घनैर्हतैः ।।6.116.36।। विभिन्नशङ्कुग्रीवांशपार्श्वकैश्चकलेवरैः । निपात्यहन्तुमिच्छामितवविप्रियकारिणीः ।।6.116.37।।
transliteration: muṣṭibhiḥparṣiṇaghātaiścaviśālaiścaivabāhubhiḥ | jaṅghājānuprahāraiścadantānāṃcaivapīḍanaiḥ  bhakṣaṇaiḥkarṇanāsānāṃkeśānāṃluñcanaistathā | bhṛśaṃśuṣkamukhaiścaivadāraṇairlaṅghanairhataiḥ  vibhinnaśaṅkugrīvāṃśapārśvakaiścakalevaraiḥ | nipātyahantumicchāmitavavipriyakāriṇīḥ
translation: तव your, विप्रियकारिणी who have wronged to you, मुष्टिभिःfists, पाणिघातैश्च hit with feet, विशालैःspreading, बाहुभिःarms, जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्च with blows of shanks and knees, दन्तानाम् with teeth, पीडनैः tormenting, कर्णनासानाम् pulling out ears and nose, धक्षणैःgrant, तथा this, केशानाम् hair, लुञ्चनैःtearing off, भृशम् violently, शुष्कमुखैःचैव making their faces dry, दारणैः dreadful, लङ्घनैः throw uptoss, हतैः kill, विभिन्नशङ्कुग्रीवांसपार्श्वकैः tear with different sharp conches, कलेवरैः bodies broken necks, trunks, and heads, निपात्य throwing down, हन्तुम् kill, इच्छामि wish to do
explanation: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."

shloka_text: मुष्टिभिःपर्षिणघातैश्चविशालैश्चैवबाहुभिः । जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्चदन्तानांचैवपीडनैः ।।6.116.35।। भक्षणैःकर्णनासानांकेशानांलुञ्चनैस्तथा । भृशंशुष्कमुखैश्चैवदारणैर्लङ्घनैर्हतैः ।।6.116.36।। विभिन्नशङ्कुग्रीवांशपार्श्वकैश्चकलेवरैः । निपात्यहन्तुमिच्छामितवविप्रियकारिणीः ।।6.116.37।।
transliteration: muṣṭibhiḥparṣiṇaghātaiścaviśālaiścaivabāhubhiḥ | jaṅghājānuprahāraiścadantānāṃcaivapīḍanaiḥ  bhakṣaṇaiḥkarṇanāsānāṃkeśānāṃluñcanaistathā | bhṛśaṃśuṣkamukhaiścaivadāraṇairlaṅghanairhataiḥ  vibhinnaśaṅkugrīvāṃśapārśvakaiścakalevaraiḥ | nipātyahantumicchāmitavavipriyakāriṇīḥ
translation: तव your, विप्रियकारिणी who have wronged to you, मुष्टिभिःfists, पाणिघातैश्च hit with feet, विशालैःspreading, बाहुभिःarms, जङ्घाजानुप्रहारैश्च with blows of shanks and knees, दन्तानाम् with teeth, पीडनैः tormenting, कर्णनासानाम् pulling out ears and nose, धक्षणैःgrant, तथा this, केशानाम् hair, लुञ्चनैःtearing off, भृशम् violently, शुष्कमुखैःचैव making their faces dry, दारणैः dreadful, लङ्घनैः throw uptoss, हतैः kill, विभिन्नशङ्कुग्रीवांसपार्श्वकैः tear with different sharp conches, कलेवरैः bodies broken necks, trunks, and heads, निपात्य throwing down, हन्तुम् kill, इच्छामि wish to do
explanation: "These Rakshasas who have wronged, who are of dreadful appearance, I wish to hit them with fists, with feet spreading long arms, strike with blows of shanks and knees, with teeth, and torment by pulling their ears and nose. Their hair will be torn off violently, their faces will be made dry, they will be tossed up, torn with different sharp conches. Their broken bodies, heads, necks, and trunks will be thrown down and killed. Grant this boon to me."

shloka_text: एवंप्रहारैर्बहुभिःसंप्प्रहार्ययशस्विनि । घातयेतीव्ररूपाभिर्याभिस्त्वंतर्जितापुरा ।।6.116.38।।
transliteration: evaṃprahārairbahubhiḥsaṃpprahāryayaśasvini | ghātayetīvrarūpābhiryābhistvaṃtarjitāpurā
translation: यशस्विनी illustrious lady, पुरा past, त्वम् you, तीव्ररूपाभिः terrible form, याभिः you too, तर्जिता threatened, एवम् in that way, बहुभिः many, प्रहारैः beating, सम्प्रहार्य striking, घातये destroy
explanation: "O Illustrious lady! I would like to kill the terrible forms of ogres who threatened you, in that way, I will be at and strike in many ways and destroy them", said Hanuman to Sita.

shloka_text: इत्युक्तासाहनुमताकृपणादीनवत्सला । हनूमन्तमुवाचेदंचिन्तयित्वाविमृश्य च ।।6.116.39।।
transliteration: ityuktāsāhanumatākṛpaṇādīnavatsalā | hanūmantamuvācedaṃcintayitvāvimṛśya ca
translation: इति thus, हनुमता Hanuman, उक्ता having said, दीनवत्सला who was fond of the desperate, कृपणा kindly, सा to him, चिन्तयित्वा thinking, विमृश्य च pondering, हनुमन्तम् to Hanuman, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke
explanation: Hanuman having spoken like that, Sita who was fond of the desperate, thus spoke to Hanuman thinking for a while.

shloka_text: राजसंश्रयवश्यानांकुर्वतीनांपराज्ञया । विधेयानां च दासीनांकःकुप्यद्वानरोत्तम ।।6.116.40।।
transliteration: rājasaṃśrayavaśyānāṃkurvatīnāṃparājñayā | vidheyānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃkaḥkupyadvānarottama
translation: वानरोत्तम foremost of Vanaras, राजसंश्रयवश्यानाम् being under the service of the king, पराज्ञया others command, कुर्वतीनाम् did as per his orders, विधेयानाम् obedient to, दासीनाम् maids, कः who, कुप्येत् will be angry
explanation: "Foremost of Vanaras! Who will be angry? Being under the command of the king and being obedient maids, they did so according to king's order.

shloka_text: भाग्यवैषम्यदोषेणपुरस्ताद्धुष्कृतेन च । मयैतत्प्राप्यसर्वंस्वकृतंह्युपभुज्यते ।।6.116.41।।
transliteration: bhāgyavaiṣamyadoṣeṇapurastāddhuṣkṛtena ca | mayaitatprāpyasarvaṃsvakṛtaṃhyupabhujyate
translation: भाग्यवैषम्यदेषेण adversary effect of my fate, पुरस्तात् reaped, दुष्कृतेन my own fault, मया by me, एतत् all this, सर्वम् everything, प्राप्यते happened, स्वकृतम् by my own deed, उपभुज्यतेहि have to experience the result
explanation: Through the adverse working of my fate and my own former misdeeds all this has befallen me; one must indeed experience the fruit of one's own deeds.

shloka_text: मैवंवदमहाबाहो दैवेह्येषापरागतिः । प्राप्तव्यंतुदशायोगान्मयैतदितिनिश्चितम् ।।6.116.42।। दासीनांरावणस्याहंमर्षयामीहदुर्बला ।
transliteration: maivaṃvadamahābāho daivehyeṣāparāgatiḥ | prāptavyaṃtudaśāyogānmayaitaditiniścitam  dāsīnāṃrāvaṇasyāhaṃmarṣayāmīhadurbalā |
translation: महाबाहो mighty armed, एवम् in this way, मावद do not speak, एषा in that way, दैवी divine, परा is supreme, गतिःहि fate, मया by me, दशयोगात् because of my predetermined circumstances, इदम् thus, प्राप्तव्यम् result, इति this, निश्चितम् surely, दुर्बला feeblehearted, अहम् I, इह here, रावणस्य Ravana's, दासीनाम् maid, मर्षयामि condone
explanation: "Mighty Armed Hanuman! Do not speak in this manner. It was my fate which was supreme. Because of my predetermined circumstances I reaped such a result. I am feeblehearted and condone the maids surely."

shloka_text: आज्ञप्ताराक्षसेनेहराक्षस्यस्तर्जयन्तिमाम् ।।6.116.43।। हतेतस्मिन्नकुर्वन्तितर्जनंमारुतात्मज ।
transliteration: ājñaptārākṣaseneharākṣasyastarjayantimām  hatetasminnakurvantitarjanaṃmārutātmaja |
translation: मारुतात्मज Maruti's son, इह here, राक्षसेन by Rakshasa, आज्ञप्ताः order, राक्षस्यः rakshsas, माम् me, तर्जयन्ति threatened, तस्मिन् with his, हते death, तर्जनम् threaten, न कुर्वन्ति not to be done
explanation: "By Ravana's order they threatened me so. Now with his death, they will not be threatening me."

shloka_text: अयंव्याघ्रसमीपेतुपुराणोधर्मसंहितः ।।6.116.44।। ऋक्षेणगीतःश्लोकोऽस्तितंनिबोधप्लवङ्गम ।
transliteration: ayaṃvyāghrasamīpetupurāṇodharmasaṃhitaḥ  ṛkṣeṇagītaḥśloko'stitaṃnibodhaplavaṅgama |
translation: प्लवङ्गम monkey, व्याघ्रसमीपे by the side of tiger, ऋक्षेण by a bear, गीतः verse, पुराणः old saying, धर्मसंहितः conformed with righteousness, श्लोकः verse, अस्ति now, तम् you, निबोध tell
explanation: "O Monkey! In olden days a bear had uttered a verse which conforms to righteousness. I shall tell you now."

shloka_text: न पर: पापमादत्तेपरेषांपापकर्मणाम् ।।6.116.45।। समयोरक्षितव्यस्तुसप्तश्चारित्रभूषणाः ।
transliteration: na para: pāpamādattepareṣāṃpāpakarmaṇām  samayorakṣitavyastusaptaścāritrabhūṣaṇāḥ |
translation: परेषाम् wise man, पापकर्मणाम् sinful actions, परः of enemy, पापम् offence, नादत्ते not say, समयःwhen time comes, रक्षितव्यःतु will protect, सन्तः always, चारित्रभूषणाः virtuous say 'good conduct as ornament '
explanation: A wise man does not take upon himself the offence of others' sinful deeds; when the occasion arises one's pledge must be guarded, for the virtuous ever wear good conduct as their ornament.

shloka_text: पापानांवाशुभानांवावधार्हाणांप्लवङ्गम ।।6.116.46।। कार्यंकरुण्यमार्येण न कश्चिन्नापराध्यति ।
transliteration: pāpānāṃvāśubhānāṃvāvadhārhāṇāṃplavaṅgama  kāryaṃkaruṇyamāryeṇa na kaścinnāparādhyati |
translation: पापनांवा sinners, शुभानांवा or noble, प्लवङ्गम monkey, वधार्हाणाम् those who deserve death, आर्येण by noble souls, कारुण्यम् compassion, कार्यम् action, कश्चित् indeed, नापराध्यतिइति न none commits harm
explanation: "Sinners or noble men, having done a wrong deed and deserve death. Also noble, will show compassion and not commit harm."

shloka_text: लोकहिंसाविहाराणांरक्षसांकामरूपिणाम् ।।6.116.47।। कुर्वतामपिपापानिनैवकार्यमशोभनम् ।
transliteration: lokahiṃsāvihārāṇāṃrakṣasāṃkāmarūpiṇām  kurvatāmapipāpāninaivakāryamaśobhanam |
translation: लोकहिंसाविहाराणाम् who do cruel deeds in the world, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, कामरूपिणाम् who assume form according their will, पापानि sinful, कुर्वतामपि even if they do sinful actions, अशोभम् sins, कार्यम् actions, न कार्यम् not to be done
explanation: "Rakshasas by nature are cruel in their deeds and can assume any form according to their will. No sinful actions to be done even if they do sinful actions."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तुहनुमान् सीतयावाक्यकोविदः ।।6.116.48।। प्रत्युवाचततस्सीतांरामपत्नीयशश्विनीम् ।
transliteration: evamuktastuhanumān sītayāvākyakovidaḥ  pratyuvācatatassītāṃrāmapatnīyaśaśvinīm |
translation: सीतया by Sita, एवम् in this way, उक्तःhaving spoken, वाक्यकोविदःone who is good at expression, हनुमान् Hanuman, ततः then, रामपत्नीम् Rama's consort, यशश्विनीम्irreproachable one, सीताम् to Sita, प्रत्युवाच replied as follows
explanation: Sita, having spoken that way to Hanuman, he, who was capable of good expression, replied as follows to Rama's consort, who was irreproachable.

shloka_text: युक्तारामस्यभवतीधर्मपत्नीयशश्विनी ।।6.116.49।। प्रतिसन्दिशमांदेवि गमिष्येयत्रराघवः ।
transliteration: yuktārāmasyabhavatīdharmapatnīyaśaśvinī  pratisandiśamāṃdevi gamiṣyeyatrarāghavaḥ |
translation: देवि Devi, यशश्विनी famous, भवती you are, रामस्यto Rama, युक्ता right, धर्मपत्नी righteous wife, माम् to me, प्रतिसन्दिश message in return, राघवःRaghava, यत्र there, गमिष्ये will go
explanation: "Devi! you are the righteous wife of Rama and earned fame. Give me the right message to Rama in return. I will go."

shloka_text: एवमुक्ताहनुमतावैदेहिजनकात्मजा ।।6.116.50।। साब्रवीद्ध्रष्टुमिच्छामिभर्तारंवानरोत्तम ।
transliteration: evamuktāhanumatāvaidehijanakātmajā  sābravīddhraṣṭumicchāmibhartāraṃvānarottama |
translation: हनुमताHanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्ता spoken, जनकात्मजा by Janaka's daughter, सा she, वैदेहिVaidehi, अब्रवीत् said, वानरोत्तम foremost of Vanaras, भर्तारम्to my husband, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I desire
explanation: Hanuman, having spoken that way to Vaidehi, daughter of Janaka, she said" I desire to see my husband."

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनंश्रुत्वाहनुमान्पवनात्मजः ।।6.116.51।। हर्षयन्मैथिलींवाक्यमुवाचेदंमहामतिः ।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃśrutvāhanumānpavanātmajaḥ  harṣayanmaithilīṃvākyamuvācedaṃmahāmatiḥ |
translation: मारुतात्मजःMaruti's son, महामतिः wise, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्याःhis, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, मैथिलीम् Mythili, हर्षयन् joy, इदंवाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke.
explanation: On hearing Mythili, wise Hanuman spoke these words to her bringing joy to her.

shloka_text: पूर्णचन्द्राननंरामंद्रक्ष्यस्यार्येसलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.116.52।। स्थिरमित्रंहतामित्रंशचीवत्रिदशेश्वरम् ।
transliteration: pūrṇacandrānanaṃrāmaṃdrakṣyasyāryesalakṣmaṇam  sthiramitraṃhatāmitraṃśacīvatridaśeśvaram |
translation: पूर्णचन्द्रमुखम् countenance resembles moon, सलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, स्थिरमित्रम् with friends who are alive, हतामित्रम् whose enemies are gone, रामम् Rama, शची Sachi, त्रिदशेश्वरम् इव like Indra the Lord of gods, अद्य now, द्रक्ष्यसि will see
explanation: "Now you will see Sri Rama whose countenance resembles the moon, with Lakshmana, with friends who are alive, with friends whose enemies are gone, just as Sachi, the consort of Indra, the Lord of gods saw."

shloka_text: तामेवमुक्त्वाराजन्तींसीतांसाक्षादिवश्रियम् ।।6.116.53।। आजगाममहावेगोहनूमान्यत्रराघवः ।
transliteration: tāmevamuktvārājantīṃsītāṃsākṣādivaśriyam  ājagāmamahāvegohanūmānyatrarāghavaḥ |
translation: महावेगो endowed with extraordinary speed, हनूमान् Hanuman, साक्षात् as it is, श्रियमिव like goddess Lakshmi, राजन्तीम् shining, ताम् him, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, राघवःRaghava, यत्र there, आजगाम reached
explanation: Hanuman reached Raghava with extraordinary speed assuring Sita, who shone like Lakshmi, goddess of prosperity, and had spoken like that.

shloka_text: स उवाचमहाप्रामस्सोऽभिवाद्यप्लवङ्गमः । रामंवचनमर्थज्ञोवरंसर्वधनुष्मताम् ।।6.117.1।।
transliteration: sa uvācamahāprāmasso'bhivādyaplavaṅgamaḥ | rāmaṃvacanamarthajñovaraṃsarvadhanuṣmatām
translation: महाप्राज्ञः highly learned, सःप्लवङ्गमः that monkey, वचनमर्थज्ञो meaningful, सर्वधनुष्मताम् foremost among the wielders of bow, वरम् choicest, तंरामम् Rama, अभिवाद्य greeted, उवाच spoke
explanation: Highly learned Hanuman greeted and spoke meaningfully to Rama, the foremost among the wielders of bow.
comments: At the command of Sri Rama, Vibheeshana escorts Sita to Rama's presence.

shloka_text: यन्निमित्तोऽयमारम्बःकर्मणांयःफलोदयः । तांदेवींशोकसन्तप्तांद्रष्टुमर्हसिमैथिलीम् ।।6.117.2।।
transliteration: yannimitto'yamārambaḥkarmaṇāṃyaḥphalodayaḥ | tāṃdevīṃśokasantaptāṃdraṣṭumarhasimaithilīm
translation: कर्मणाम् these actions, अयम् this, आरम्बः started, यन्निमित्तः for whose sake, यः he who, फलोदयः has borne fruit, ताम् her, शोकसन्तप्ताम् immersed in grief, देवीम् noble lady, मैथिलीम् Mythili, द्रष्टुम् to see, अर्हसि ought to
explanation: "You ought to see that noble lady Mythili, who was immersed in grief, for whose sake these actions were started and has borne fruit."

shloka_text: साहिशोकसमाविष्टाबाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा । मैथिलीविजयंश्रुत्वाद्रष्टुंत्वामभिकाङ्क्षति ।।6.117.3।।
transliteration: sāhiśokasamāviṣṭābāṣpaparyākulekṣaṇā | maithilīvijayaṃśrutvādraṣṭuṃtvāmabhikāṅkṣati
translation: शोकसमाविष्टाः who is overcome with grief, सामैथिली she, Mythili, विजयम् victory, श्रुत्वा hearing, बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणा eyes filled with tears, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभिकाङ्क्षति desired
explanation: "Mythili who is overcome with grief on hearing your victory, was filled with tears in her eyes and desired to see you."

shloka_text: पूर्वकात्प्रत्ययाच्चाहमुक्तोविश्वस्तयातया । भर्तारंद्रष्टुमिच्छामिकृतार्थंसहलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.117.4।।
transliteration: pūrvakātpratyayāccāhamuktoviśvastayātayā | bhartāraṃdraṣṭumicchāmikṛtārthaṃsahalakṣmaṇam
translation: पूर्वकात् earlier occasion, प्रत्ययात् expressed, विश्वस्तया trust, तया so also, अहम् I, उक्तः said, कृतार्थम् gratitude, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, भर्तारम् husband, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि desire
explanation: "In an earlier occasion having known me and trusting me expressed that she desires to see Rama with Lakshmana after victory and with gratitude."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तोहनुमतारामोधर्मभृतांवरः । आगच्छत्सहसाध्यानमीषद्भाष्पपरिप्लुतः ।।6.117.5।।
transliteration: evamuktohanumatārāmodharmabhṛtāṃvaraḥ | āgacchatsahasādhyānamīṣadbhāṣpapariplutaḥ
translation: हनुमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, धर्मभृताम् upholder of righteousness, वरः best, रामः Rama, ईषत् slightly, बाष्पपरिप्लुतः shed tears from eyes, सहसा suddenly, ध्यानम् thoughtful, आगच्छत् became
explanation: When Hanuman had spoken like that, Rama, the upholder of righteousness, shed tears slightly and suddenly became thoughtful.

shloka_text: दीर्घमुष्णंविनिःश्वस्यजगतीमवलोकयन् । उवाचमेघसङ्काशंविभीषणमुपस्थितम् ।।6.117.6।।
transliteration: dīrghamuṣṇaṃviniḥśvasyajagatīmavalokayan | uvācameghasaṅkāśaṃvibhīṣaṇamupasthitam
translation: दीर्घम् long, उष्णम् hot, विनिःश्वस्य drawing breath, जगतीम् on the world, अवलोकयन् looking at, उपस्थितम् standing, मेघसङ्काशम् resembling a cloud in colour, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, उवाच spoke
explanation: Drawing a long hot breath, looking at the ground, he spoke to Vibheeshana, who was like a cloud standing there.

shloka_text: दिव्याङ्गरागांवैदेहींदिव्याभरणभूषिताम् । इहसीतांशिरःस्नातामुपस्थापयमाचिरम् ।।6.117.7।।
transliteration: divyāṅgarāgāṃvaidehīṃdivyābharaṇabhūṣitām | ihasītāṃśiraḥsnātāmupasthāpayamāciram
translation: शिरःस्नाताम् after head bath, दिव्याङ्गरागाम् anointed with fragrance, दिव्यायभरणभूषिताम् decorated with wonderful ornaments, सीताम् Sita, इह here, उपस्थापय bring, चिरम् quickly, मा bring
explanation: Bring Sita here without delay, bathed, anointed with celestial fragrance and adorned with wonderful ornaments.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तुरामेणत्वरमाणोविभीषणः । प्रविश्यान्तःपुरंसीतांस्त्रीभिस्स्वाभिरोचदयत् ।।6.117.8।।
transliteration: evamuktasturāmeṇatvaramāṇovibhīṣaṇaḥ | praviśyāntaḥpuraṃsītāṃstrībhissvābhirocadayat
translation: एवम् in that manner, रामेण by Rama, उक्तः spoken, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, त्वरमाणः hastened, अन्तःपुरम् to the gynaeceum, प्रविश्य entered, स्वाभिः for his part, स्त्रीभिः women, सीताम् to Sita, अचोदयात् conveyed
explanation: When Rama had spoken in that manner, Vibheeeshana for his part hastened to the Gynaeceum and assigned through the women to convey to Sita.

shloka_text: ततस्सीतांमहाभागांदृष्टवोवाचविभीषणः । मूर्ध्निबद्धाञ्जलिश्रीमान्विनीतोराक्षसेश्वरः ।।6.117.9।।
transliteration: tatassītāṃmahābhāgāṃdṛṣṭavovācavibhīṣaṇaḥ | mūrdhnibaddhāñjaliśrīmānvinītorākṣaseśvaraḥ
translation: ततः then, श्रीमान् prosperous, राक्षसेश्वरःLord of Rakshasas, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, महाभागाम् the noble, सीताम् to Sita, दृष्टवा seeing, विनीतः his head, मूर्ध्निः head, बद्धाञ्जलिः with palms joined, उवाच spoke
explanation: Then Vibheeshana, the prosperous Lord of the Rakshasas seeing Sita greeted her with palms joined together lifted it over his head (as a sign of respect).

shloka_text: दिव्याङ्गरागावैदेहीदिव्याभरणभूषिता । यानमारोहभद्रंतेभर्तात्वांद्रष्टुमिच्छति ।।6.117.10।।
transliteration: divyāṅgarāgāvaidehīdivyābharaṇabhūṣitā | yānamārohabhadraṃtebhartātvāṃdraṣṭumicchati
translation: वैदेही Vaidehi, दिव्याङ्गरागा anointed with wonderful fragrance, दिव्याभरणभूषिता decked with beautiful ornaments, यानम् palanquin, आरोह ascending, ते you, भद्रम् auspicious, भर्ता husband, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छति desires
explanation: "Vaidehi! Anointed with a wonderful fragrance, decked with beautiful ornaments, auspicious and ascending the palanquin, your husband desires to see you."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तातुवैदेहीप्रत्युवाचविभीषणम् । अस्नात्वाद्रष्टुमिच्छामिभर्तारंराक्षसेश्वर ।।6.117.11।।
transliteration: evamuktātuvaidehīpratyuvācavibhīṣaṇam | asnātvādraṣṭumicchāmibhartāraṃrākṣaseśvara
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्ता spoken, वैदेही Vaidehi, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied, राक्षसेश्वर Lord of Rakshasas, अस्नात्वा without bath, भर्तारम् husband, द्रष्टुम् see, इच्छामि I desire
explanation: Vibheeshana, having spoken that way, Vaidehi said to the Lord of Rakshasas that she would like to see him without having a bath.

shloka_text: तस्यास्तद्वचनंश्रुत्वाप्रत्युवाचविभीषणः । यथाहरामोभहर्तातेतत्तथाकर्तुमार्हसिमार्हसि ।।6.117.12।।
transliteration: tasyāstadvacanaṃśrutvāpratyuvācavibhīṣaṇaḥ | yathāharāmobhahartātetattathākartumārhasimārhasi
translation: तस्याः her, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विभीषणःVibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied in turn, ते you, भर्ता  husband, रामःRam, यथा so, आह I, तत् that, तथआ that only, कर्तुम् will do, अर्हसि ought to
explanation: Hearing Sita's words Vibheeshana replied saying," You will and ought to do what your husband Rama has said."

shloka_text: तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वामैथिलीपतिदेवता । भर्तृभक्त्यावृतासाध्वीतथेतिप्रत्यभाषत ।।6.117.13।।
transliteration: tasyatadvacanaṃśrutvāmaithilīpatidevatā | bhartṛbhaktyāvṛtāsādhvītathetipratyabhāṣata
translation: पतिदेवता husband as god, साध्वी noble, मैथिली Mythili, तस्य her, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, भर्तृभक्त्या in devotion, वृता adorned, तथेति alright, प्रत्यभाषत replied in turn
explanation: Noble Mythili (on hearing Vibheeshana), who looked upon her husband as God, said in reply, 'Alright'.

shloka_text: ततस्सीतांशिरःस्नातांसंयुक्तांप्रतिकर्मणा । महार्हाभरणोपेतांमहार्हाम्बरधारिणीम् ।।6.117.14।। आरोप्यशिबिकांदीप्तांपरार्घ्याम्बरसम्वृताम् । राक्षसैर्भहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहारविभीषणः ।।6.117.15।।
transliteration: tatassītāṃśiraḥsnātāṃsaṃyuktāṃpratikarmaṇā | mahārhābharaṇopetāṃmahārhāmbaradhāriṇīm  āropyaśibikāṃdīptāṃparārghyāmbarasamvṛtām | rākṣasairbhahubhirguptāmājahāravibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, शिरःस्नाताम् head bath, प्रतिकर्मणा personal decoration, संयुक्ताम् together, महार्हाभरणोपेताम् best of ornaments, महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम् wonderful clothes, सीताम् Sita, दीप्ताम् glowing, परार्घ्याम्बरसंवृताम् covered with wonderful clothes, बहुभिः numerous, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, गुप्ताम् guarded by, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आरोप्य ascended, आजहार brought
explanation: Thereafter Vibheeshana, making Sita to ascend the palanquin, covered with valuable clothes and guarded by numerous Rakshasas after she adorned herself in the best of ornaments and put on glowing wonderful clothes brought to Rama.

shloka_text: ततस्सीतांशिरःस्नातांसंयुक्तांप्रतिकर्मणा । महार्हाभरणोपेतांमहार्हाम्बरधारिणीम् ।।6.117.14।। आरोप्यशिबिकांदीप्तांपरार्घ्याम्बरसम्वृताम् । राक्षसैर्भहुभिर्गुप्तामाजहारविभीषणः ।।6.117.15।।
transliteration: tatassītāṃśiraḥsnātāṃsaṃyuktāṃpratikarmaṇā | mahārhābharaṇopetāṃmahārhāmbaradhāriṇīm  āropyaśibikāṃdīptāṃparārghyāmbarasamvṛtām | rākṣasairbhahubhirguptāmājahāravibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: ततः thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, शिरःस्नाताम् head bath, प्रतिकर्मणा personal decoration, संयुक्ताम् together, महार्हाभरणोपेताम् best of ornaments, महार्हाम्बरधारिणीम् wonderful clothes, सीताम् Sita, दीप्ताम् glowing, परार्घ्याम्बरसंवृताम् covered with wonderful clothes, बहुभिः numerous, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, गुप्ताम् guarded by, शिबिकाम् palanquin, आरोप्य ascended, आजहार brought
explanation: Thereafter Vibheeshana, making Sita to ascend the palanquin, covered with valuable clothes and guarded by numerous Rakshasas after she adorned herself in the best of ornaments and put on glowing wonderful clothes brought to Rama.

shloka_text: सोऽभिगम्यमहात्मानंज्ञातावपिध्यानमास्थितम् । प्रणतश्चप्रहृष्टश्चप्राप्तांसीतांन्यवेदयत् ।।6.117.16।।
transliteration: so'bhigamyamahātmānaṃjñātāvapidhyānamāsthitam | praṇataścaprahṛṣṭaścaprāptāṃsītāṃnyavedayat
translation: सः he, ज्ञात्वापि after knowing, द्यानम् meditative mood, आस्थितम् absorbed in thought, महात्मानम् great, अभिगम्य having reached, प्रणतः च greeting with folded palms, प्रहृष्टश्च full of joy, सीताम् Sita, प्राप्ताम् arrived, न्यवेदयत् announced
explanation: Knowing that Sita reached also, great Rama was seen in a meditative mood absorbed in thought. Vibheeshana announced saying, 'Sita has been brought' and greeted with folded palms, full of joy.

shloka_text: तामागतामुपश्रुत्यरक्षोगृहचिरोषिताम् । हर्षोदैन्यंच रोषश्चत्रयंराघवमाविशत् ।।6.117.17।।
transliteration: tāmāgatāmupaśrutyarakṣogṛhaciroṣitām | harṣodainyaṃca roṣaścatrayaṃrāghavamāviśat
translation: रक्षोगृहचिरोषिताम् stayed in Rakshasa's abode for long, ताम् her, आगताम् reached, उपश्रुत्य having heard, राघवम् Raghava, हर्षः joyful, दैन्यम् indignation, रोषश्च anger, त्रयम् three, आविशत् experienced
explanation: On hearing that Sita had arrived, who stayed in Rakshasa's abode for long, Raghava had experienced joy, indignation, and anger, all the three at the same time.

shloka_text: ततःपार्श्वगतंदृष्टवासविमर्शंविचारयन् । विभीषणमिदंवाक्यमहृष्टोराघवोऽब्रवीत् ।।6.117.18।।
transliteration: tataḥpārśvagataṃdṛṣṭavāsavimarśaṃvicārayan | vibhīṣaṇamidaṃvākyamahṛṣṭorāghavo'bravīt
translation: ततः then, राघवःRaghava, अहृष्टःdistressed, सविमर्शम् analysing with in, विचारयन् thinking, पार्श्वगतम् who had come near, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवाseeing, इदम् these, वचःwords, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Raghava, analysed with in him, distressed and thinking deeply, seeing Vibheeshana close by, spoke these words.

shloka_text: राक्षसाधिपतेसौम्यनित्यंमद्विजयेरत । वैदेहीसंनिकर्षंमेशीघ्रंसमुपगच्छतु ।।6.117.19।।
transliteration: rākṣasādhipatesaumyanityaṃmadvijayerata | vaidehīsaṃnikarṣaṃmeśīghraṃsamupagacchatu
translation: नित्यम् always, मद्विजये my victory, रत sought, सौम्य gentle, राक्षसाधिपते Rakshasa king, वैदेहीVaidehi, शीघ्रम् quickly, मे my, सन्निकर्षम् near, समुपगच्छतु let her be brought
explanation: "O gentle Vibheeshana, let Sita who sought my victory always be quickly brought near me."

shloka_text: तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वाराघवस्यविभीषणः । तूर्णमुत्सारणंतत्रकारयामासधर्मवित् ।।6.117.20।।
transliteration: tasyatadvacanaṃśrutvārāghavasyavibhīṣaṇaḥ | tūrṇamutsāraṇaṃtatrakārayāmāsadharmavit
translation: तस्यराघवस्य Raghava's, तत् that, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, धर्मवित् faithful, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, तत्र there, तूर्णम् instantly, उत्सारणम् to disperse the people, कारयामास assigned
explanation: On hearing Raghava's words, faithful Vibheeshana instantly assigned people to disperse from there.

shloka_text: कञ्चुकोष्णीषिणस्तत्रवेत्रजर्जरपाणयः । उत्सारयन्तस्तान्योधान्समन्तात् परिचक्रमुः ।।6.117.21।।
transliteration: kañcukoṣṇīṣiṇastatravetrajarjarapāṇayaḥ | utsārayantastānyodhānsamantāt paricakramuḥ
translation: तत्र then, कञ्चुकोष्णीषिणःwearing coats and turbans, वेत्ररर्जरपाणयःholding staffs in hand, तान् them, योधान् warriors, उत्सारयन्तः dispersed, समन्तात् all of them moved, परिचक्रमुःstarted
explanation: Then those who were wearing coats and turbans, holding staffs in hand, warriors started moving and dispersed.

shloka_text: ऋक्षाणांवानराणां च राक्षसानां च सर्वशः । वृन्दान्युत्सार्यमाणानिदूरमुत्तस्थुरन्ततः ।।6.117.22।।
transliteration: ṛkṣāṇāṃvānarāṇāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ | vṛndānyutsāryamāṇānidūramuttasthurantataḥ
translation: ऋक्षाणाम् Bears, वानराणां च Vanaras, राक्षसानां च and Rakshasas, सर्वशःall over, उत्सार्यमाणानि moving about, वृन्दानि hordes, अन्ततः vicinity, दूरम् distance, उत्तस्थुः driven
explanation: The hordes of Bears, Vanaras and Rakshasas moving about all over there were driven away to a distance from the vicinity.

shloka_text: तेषामुत्सार्यमाणानांनिःस्वनःसुमहानभूत् । वायुनोद्धूयामानस्यसागरस्येवनिःस्वनः ।।6.117.23।।
transliteration: teṣāmutsāryamāṇānāṃniḥsvanaḥsumahānabhūt | vāyunoddhūyāmānasyasāgarasyevaniḥsvanaḥ
translation: तेषाम् their, उत्सार्यमाणानाम् being driven, वायुना wind, उद्धूयमानस्य sound generated सागरस्य ocean, निःस्वनःइव like the storm, सुमहान् great, स्वनः sound, अभूत् heard
explanation: The great sound heard there was like the uproar of an ocean lashed by a storm.

shloka_text: उत्सार्यमाणान् दृष्टवाथजगत्यांजातसम्भ्रमान् । दाक्षिण्यात्तदमर्षाच्चवारयामासराघवः ।।6.117.24।।
transliteration: utsāryamāṇān dṛṣṭavāthajagatyāṃjātasambhramān | dākṣiṇyāttadamarṣāccavārayāmāsarāghavaḥ
translation: अथ now, राघवः Raghava, उत्सार्यमाणान् dispersing, जगत्याम् moving, जातसम्भ्रमान् excited to know, दृष्टवा seeing, दाक्षिण्यात् out of kindness, अमर्षात् resented, तत् that, वारयामास stopped
explanation: Seeing them excited to know and dispersing, Raghava stopped them out of kindness.

shloka_text: संरम्बश्चाब्रवीद्रामश्चक्षुषाप्रदहन्निव । विभीषणंमहाप्राज्ञंसोपालम्बमिदंवचः ।।6.117.25।।
transliteration: saṃrambaścābravīdrāmaścakṣuṣāpradahanniva | vibhīṣaṇaṃmahāprājñaṃsopālambamidaṃvacaḥ
translation: रामः Rama, सम्रब्ध: च uproar, चक्षुषा with his gaze, प्रदहन्निव exhibiting anger, महाप्राज्ञम् highly intelligent, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, सोपालम्भम् resenting, इदंवचः these words, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Exhibiting anger with his gaze at the uproar, Rama addressed the highly intelligent Vibheeshana resenting their action.

shloka_text: किमर्थंमामनादृत्यक्लिश्यतेऽयंत्वयाजनः । निवर्तयैनमुद्योगंजनोऽयंस्वजनोमम ।।6.117.26।।
transliteration: kimarthaṃmāmanādṛtyakliśyate'yaṃtvayājanaḥ | nivartayainamudyogaṃjano'yaṃsvajanomama
translation: माम् me, अनादृत्य without regard, त्वया you, अयंजनः these people, किमर्थम् for what reason, क्लिश्यते troubling, उद्योगम् this excitement, निवर्तय stop, अयम् this, जनःpeople, मम my, स्वजनःown
explanation: "Why are these people being troubled without disregard for me? Stop this excitement. They are my own people."

shloka_text: न गृहाणि न वस्त्राणि न प्राकारास्तिरस्क्रिया । नेदृशाराजसत्कारावृत्तमावरणंस्त्रियाः ।।6.117.27।।
transliteration: na gṛhāṇi na vastrāṇi na prākārāstiraskriyā | nedṛśārājasatkārāvṛttamāvaraṇaṃstriyāḥ
translation: स्त्रियाः for women, गृहाणि houses, आवरणम् boundary wall, न not, वस्त्राणि clothes, न not, प्राकाराः protective wall, न not, तिरस्क्रिया screen of cloth, न not, ईदृशाः this kind of, राजसत्काराः royal treatment, न not, वृत्तम् surrounded
explanation: "For women it is not the house, boundary wall or clothes or protective wall or screen of cloth or even this kind of royal treatment or surrounding, is the protection."

shloka_text: व्यसनेषु न कृच्छ्रेषु न युद्धेषुस्वयंवरे । न क्रतौनोविवाहेवादर्शनंदूष्यतेस्त्रियाः ।।6.117.28।।
transliteration: vyasaneṣu na kṛcchreṣu na yuddheṣusvayaṃvare | na krataunovivāhevādarśanaṃdūṣyatestriyāḥ
translation: व्यसनेषु in times of difficulty, स्त्रियाः woman, दर्शनम् appearance, न दूष्यते not condemned, कृच्छ्रेषु in straits, युद्धेषु in conflicts, स्वयंवरे in selection of spouse, न not, क्रतौ sacrificial ceremony, न not, विवाहे वा marriage, न not
explanation: "The appearance of a woman in public is not condemned in times of difficulty, in straits, in conflicts, in the selection of a husband, or in sacrificial ceremonies or marriage ceremonies."

shloka_text: सैषाविपद्गताचैवकृच्छ्रेव च महतिस्थिता । दर्शनेनास्तिदोषोऽस्यामत्समीपेविशेषतः ।।6.117.29।।
transliteration: saiṣāvipadgatācaivakṛcchreva ca mahatisthitā | darśanenāstidoṣo'syāmatsamīpeviśeṣataḥ
translation: साएषा she now, विपद्गताचैव in distress, महति great, कृच्छ्रे miserable, स्थिता situation, अस्याः her, दर्शने appearance, दोषः fault, नास्ति not, विशेषतः especially, मत्समीपे my presence
explanation: "Sita is in distress and in a highly miserable situation. Her appearance is no fault especially in my presence."

shloka_text: विसृज्यशिबिकांतस्मात्पद्भ्यामेवोपसर्पतु । समीपेममवैदेहींपश्यन्त्वेतेवनौकसः ।।6.117.30।।
transliteration: visṛjyaśibikāṃtasmātpadbhyāmevopasarpatu | samīpemamavaidehīṃpaśyantvetevanaukasaḥ
translation: तस्मात् therefore, शिबिकाम् palanquin, विसृज्य leaving, पद्भ्यामेव on foot only, उपसर्पतु advance towards, एते with the help of these, वनौकसः Vanaras, मम my, समीपे presence, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, पश्यन्तु to see
explanation: "Therefore, leaving the palanquin let Vaidehi walk on foot only towards me with the help of these Vanaras."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तुरामेणसविमर्शोविभीषणम् । रामस्योपानयसतीतांसन्निकर्षंविनीतवत् ।।6.117.31।।
transliteration: evamuktasturāmeṇasavimarśovibhīṣaṇam | rāmasyopānayasatītāṃsannikarṣaṃvinītavat
translation: रामेण by Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्तःhaving spoken, सविमर्शःclearly, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, सीताम् Sita, विनीतवत् reverently, रामस्य to Rama, उपानयत्conducted
explanation: Rama having spoken clearly in that way, Vibheeshana reverently conducted Sita to Rama.

shloka_text: ततोलक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौहनूमांश्चप्लवङ्गमः । निशम्यवाक्यंरामस्यबभूवुर्व्यथिताभृशम् ।।6.117.32।।
transliteration: tatolakṣmaṇasugrīvauhanūmāṃścaplavaṅgamaḥ | niśamyavākyaṃrāmasyababhūvurvyathitābhṛśam
translation: ततः thereupon, लक्ष्मणसुग्रीवौ Lakshmana and Sugriva, प्लवङ्गमः monkey, हनूमांश्च Hanuman too, रामस्य Rama's, वाक्यम् statement, निशम्य astonished, भृशम् highly, व्यथिताःdistressed, बभूवुः became
explanation: There upon Lakshmana, Sugriva, and Vanara Hanuman, astonished at Rama's statement, became highly distressed.

shloka_text: कलत्रनिरपेक्ष्षैश्चइङ्गितैरस्यदारुणैः । अप्रीतमिवसीतायांतर्कयन्तिस्मराघवम् ।।6.117.33।।
transliteration: kalatranirapekṣṣaiścaiṅgitairasyadāruṇaiḥ | aprītamivasītāyāṃtarkayantismarāghavam
translation: कलत्रनिरपेक्ष्षैः no regard towards wife, अस्य his, दारुणैः harsh, इङ्गितैः gestures, राघवम् Raghava, सीतायाम् at Sita, अप्रीतम् displeased, तर्कयन्तिस्म discussed
explanation: Seeing Rama having no regard towards Sita, and his harsh gestures, Lakshmana and Sugriva discussed if Rama was displeased with Sita?

shloka_text: लज्जयात्ववलीयन्तीस्वेषुगात्रेषुमैथिली । विभीषणेनानुगताभर्तारंसाभ्यवर्तत ।।6.117.34।।
transliteration: lajjayātvavalīyantīsveṣugātreṣumaithilī | vibhīṣaṇenānugatābhartāraṃsābhyavartata
translation: सा he, मैथिलीतु Mythili also, लज्जया modesty, स्वेषु her own, गात्रेषु throat, अवलीयन्ती limbs shrinking, विभीषणेन by Vibheeshana, अनुगता followed by, भर्तारम् husband, अभ्यवर्तत approached
explanation: Mythili, also adopting modesty, shrinking into her own limbs, approached her husband followed by Vibheeshana.

shloka_text: विस्मयाच्छप्रहर्षाच्चस्नेहाच्चपतिदेवता । उदैक्षतमुखंभर्तुःसौम्यंसौम्यतरानना ।।6.117.35।।
transliteration: vismayācchapraharṣāccasnehāccapatidevatā | udaikṣatamukhaṃbhartuḥsaumyaṃsaumyatarānanā
translation: सौम्यतरानना gentle lady, पतिदेवता husband alone as god, विस्मयाश्च wondered, प्रहर्षाच्च joyful, स्नेहाच्च affectionately, भर्तुः husband, सौम्यम् gentle, मुकम् face, समुदैक्षत agreeable
explanation: Sita, a gentle lady, who considered her husband as God only wondered with a mixed feeling of joy and affection and looked at the gentle face of Rama.

shloka_text: तांतुपाश्वस्थितांप्रह्वांरामस्सम्प्रेक्ष्यमैथिलीम् । हृदयान्तर्गतंक्रोधव्याहर्तुमुपचक्रमे ।।6.118.1।।
transliteration: tāṃtupāśvasthitāṃprahvāṃrāmassamprekṣyamaithilīm | hṛdayāntargataṃkrodhavyāhartumupacakrame
translation: रामः Rama, पार्श्वे near, स्थिताम् stood, प्रह्वाम् shy, तांमैथिलीम् she, Mythili, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, हृदयान्तर्गतम् in his heart, क्रोधम् anger, व्याहर्तुम् expression, उपचक्रमे started
explanation: Observing Mythili who stood near him, Rama started to give expression to what was in his heart.
comments: Rama describes to Sita his efforts to succeed with a valiant friend and tells her in a discomforting manner to go wherever.

shloka_text: एषासिनिर्जिताभद्रेशत्रुंजित्वारणाजिरे । पौरुषाद्यदनुष्ठेयंमयैतदुपपादितम् ।।6.118.2।।
transliteration: eṣāsinirjitābhadreśatruṃjitvāraṇājire | pauruṣādyadanuṣṭheyaṃmayaitadupapāditam
translation: भद्रे auspicious, एषा this, रणाजिरे battlefield, शत्रुम् enemy, जित्वा won, निर्जिता destruction, असि I, पौरुषात् with effort, यत् that which, अनुष्ठेयम् worth doing, तत् that, मया by me, उपपादितम् has been done
explanation: "O Auspicious Sita! You are won by destruction of the enemy in the battlefield. What was worth doing has been done with all my effort."

shloka_text: गतोऽस्म्यन्तममर्षस्यधर्षणासम्प्रमार्जिता । अवमानश्चशत्रुश्चयुगपन्निहतौमया ।।6.118.3।।
transliteration: gato'smyantamamarṣasyadharṣaṇāsampramārjitā | avamānaścaśatruścayugapannihataumayā
translation: अमर्षस्य by indignation, अन्तम् put an end, गतःअस्मि I lost, धर्षणा insult, सम्प्रमार्जिता gained reward, मया by me, अवमानश्च indignity, शत्रुश्च enemy, युगपत् all at once, निहतौ by killing
explanation: "I have put an end to the indignity that I lost. I gained reward for the insult. The indignity offered by the enemy has been wiped out all at once."

shloka_text: अद्यमेपौरुषंदृष्टमद्यमेसफल्श्रमः । अद्यतीर्णप्रतिज्ञोऽत्वाप्रभवाम्यद्यचात्मनः ।।6.118.4।।
transliteration: adyamepauruṣaṃdṛṣṭamadyamesaphalśramaḥ | adyatīrṇapratijño'tvāprabhavāmyadyacātmanaḥ
translation: अद्य now, मे my, पौरुषम् effort, दृष्टम् see, अद्य today, मे my, श्रमः effort, सफलः successful, अद्य now, अहम् I, तीर्णप्रतिज्ञः vow fulfilled, अद्य today, आत्मनः I am, प्रभवामि independent
explanation: "Now you see the result of my effort. I am successful and fulfilled my vow. Today I am independent."

shloka_text: यात्वंविरहितानीताचलचित्तेनरक्षसा । दैवसम्पादितोदोषोमानुषेणमयाजितः ।।6.118.5।।
transliteration: yātvaṃvirahitānītācalacittenarakṣasā | daivasampāditodoṣomānuṣeṇamayājitaḥ
translation: यात्वम् when you, विरहिता were alone, चलचित्तेन fickle minded, रक्षसा Rakshasa, नीता abducted, दैवसम्पादितः by the will of god, दोषः fault, मानुषेण by a mortal, मया by me, जितः won
explanation: "When you were alone you were abducted by the fickle minded Rakshasa. The fault of destiny has been won by me, a mortal by the will of god।।"

shloka_text: सम्प्राप्तमवमानंयस्तेजसा न प्रमार्जति । कस्तस्यपुरुषार्थोमहताप्यल्पचेतसः ।।6.118.6।।
transliteration: samprāptamavamānaṃyastejasā na pramārjati | kastasyapuruṣārthomahatāpyalpacetasaḥ
translation: यः he who, सम्प्राप्तम् gets, अवमानम् insult, तेजसा might, न प्रमार्जति not, अल्पचेतसः petty minded, तस्य his, महतापि however great, पौरुषेण by the, कःअर्थः What is the purpose
explanation: "What is the purpose of might however great he might be, if he is petty minded and does not wipe off the insult?"

shloka_text: लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्यलङ्कायाश्चापिमर्धनम् । सफलंतस्य च श्लाघ्यमद्यकर्महनूमतः ।।6.118.7।।
transliteration: laṅghanaṃ ca samudrasyalaṅkāyāścāpimardhanam | saphalaṃtasya ca ślāghyamadyakarmahanūmataḥ
translation: तस्य his, हनूमतः Hanuman, समुद्रस्य ocean's, लङ्घनम् leaping across, लङ्कायाः of Lanka, मर्धनंच Devastation, श्लाघ्यम् laudable, कर्म action, अद्य now, सफलम् result
explanation: "Hanuman's leaping across the ocean and devastating action of Lanka has yielded results now."

shloka_text: युद्धेविक्रमतश्चैवहितंमन्त्रयतस्तथा । सुग्रीवस्यससैन्यस्यसफलोऽद्यपरिश्रमः ।।6.118.8।।
transliteration: yuddhevikramataścaivahitaṃmantrayatastathā | sugrīvasyasasainyasyasaphalo'dyapariśramaḥ
translation: युद्धे in the combat, विक्रमतः prowess, तथा so also, हितम् good advice, मन्त्रयतः tendered, ससैन्यस्य and his army, सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, परिश्रमः effort, अद्य now, सफलः successful
