translation: धर्मवत्सल a lover of rightful duty, मारीचदर्शनंचैव seen Maricha, सीतोन्मधनमेव च searching for Sita, कबन्ददर्शनंचैव appearance of Kabhanda, तथा so also, पम्पाभिगमनम् going to Pampa, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, ते your, सख्यम् friendship, त्वया by you, वाली Vali, यथा so also, हतः killing, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi, मार्गणम् search for, वातात्मजस्य by the son of wind god, कर्म action, वैदेह्याम् Vaidehi, विदितायाम् finding, नलसेतुः Nalasethu bridge, यथा similarly, कृतः construction, प्रहृष्टैः delighted, हरियूथपैः monkey troops, लङ्का Lanka, यथा so also, अदीपिता set on fire, सपुत्रबान्दवामात्यः sons and relatives, सहवाहनः and vehicles, बलदर्पितः proud, रावणः Ravana, सङ्ख्ये army, यथा so also, निहतः killed, देवकण्डके thorn in the eyes of gods, तस्मिन् your, रावणे Ravana, निहते killing, त्रिदशैः Brahma, all gods, समागमः coming together, यथा like that, ते you, वरः च boon, यथा like that, दत्तश्च bestowing, एतत् all this, सर्वम् everything, मया by me, तपसा through the power of penance, विदितम् is known, प्रवृत्ताख्याः lover of virtues, मेशिष्याः my disciples, इतः here, पुरीम् city, सम्पतन्ति communicated
explanation: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."

shloka_text: मारीचदर्शनंचैवसीतोन्मधनमेव च । कबन्धदर्शनंचैवसम्पाभिगमनंतथा ।।6.127.11।। सुग्रीवेण च तेसख्यंयथावालीहतस्त्वया । मार्गणंचैववैदेह्याःकर्मवातात्मजस्य च ।।6.127.12।। विदितायां च सीतायांनलसेतुर्यथाकृतः । यथाचादीपितालङ्काप्रहृष्टैर्हरियूथपैः ।।6.127.13।। सपुत्रबान्दवामात्यःसबलःसहावाहनः । यथा च निहतःसंख्येरावणोबलदर्पितः ।।6.127.14।। यथा च निहतेतस्मिन् रावणेदेवकण्टके । समागमश्चत्रिदशैर्यथादत्तश्चतेवरः ।।6.127.15।। सर्वंममैतद्विदितंतपसाधर्मवत्सल । सम्पतन्ति च मेशिष्याःप्रवृत्ताख्याःपुरीमितः ।।6.127.16।।
transliteration: mārīcadarśanaṃcaivasītonmadhanameva ca | kabandhadarśanaṃcaivasampābhigamanaṃtathā  sugrīveṇa ca tesakhyaṃyathāvālīhatastvayā | mārgaṇaṃcaivavaidehyāḥkarmavātātmajasya ca  viditāyāṃ ca sītāyāṃnalaseturyathākṛtaḥ | yathācādīpitālaṅkāprahṛṣṭairhariyūthapaiḥ  saputrabāndavāmātyaḥsabalaḥsahāvāhanaḥ | yathā ca nihataḥsaṃkhyerāvaṇobaladarpitaḥ  yathā ca nihatetasmin rāvaṇedevakaṇṭake | samāgamaścatridaśairyathādattaścatevaraḥ  sarvaṃmamaitadviditaṃtapasādharmavatsala | sampatanti ca meśiṣyāḥpravṛttākhyāḥpurīmitaḥ
translation: धर्मवत्सल a lover of rightful duty, मारीचदर्शनंचैव seen Maricha, सीतोन्मधनमेव च searching for Sita, कबन्ददर्शनंचैव appearance of Kabhanda, तथा so also, पम्पाभिगमनम् going to Pampa, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, ते your, सख्यम् friendship, त्वया by you, वाली Vali, यथा so also, हतः killing, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi, मार्गणम् search for, वातात्मजस्य by the son of wind god, कर्म action, वैदेह्याम् Vaidehi, विदितायाम् finding, नलसेतुः Nalasethu bridge, यथा similarly, कृतः construction, प्रहृष्टैः delighted, हरियूथपैः monkey troops, लङ्का Lanka, यथा so also, अदीपिता set on fire, सपुत्रबान्दवामात्यः sons and relatives, सहवाहनः and vehicles, बलदर्पितः proud, रावणः Ravana, सङ्ख्ये army, यथा so also, निहतः killed, देवकण्डके thorn in the eyes of gods, तस्मिन् your, रावणे Ravana, निहते killing, त्रिदशैः Brahma, all gods, समागमः coming together, यथा like that, ते you, वरः च boon, यथा like that, दत्तश्च bestowing, एतत् all this, सर्वम् everything, मया by me, तपसा through the power of penance, विदितम् is known, प्रवृत्ताख्याः lover of virtues, मेशिष्याः my disciples, इतः here, पुरीम् city, सम्पतन्ति communicated
explanation: "O, you are a lover of rightful duty, seeing Maricha, searching Sita, appearance of Kabhanda, your going to Pampa, making friendship with Sugriva, killing of Vali, searching for Vaidehi, finding of Sita by the son of wind god, and his action, setting fire to Lanka, finding of Nalasethu, construction of bridge, delighted Vanaras, destruction of sons, relatives and vehicles of Ravana's army, killing of Ravana who was a thorn in the eyes of god, coming of Brahma and gods, bestowing a boon and all that is known to me by the power of my penance. My disciples in Ayodhya communicated to me."

shloka_text: अहमप्यद्यतेदद्मिवरंशस्त्रभृतांवर । अर्घ्यंप्रतिगृहाणेदमयोध्यांश्वोगमिष्यसि ।।6.127.17।।
transliteration: ahamapyadyatedadmivaraṃśastrabhṛtāṃvara | arghyaṃpratigṛhāṇedamayodhyāṃśvogamiṣyasi
translation: शस्त्रभृताम् jewel among wielder of weapons, वर jewel, अद्य now, अहमपि I am also, ते to you, वरम् boon, दद्मि bestow, इदम् this, अर्घ्यम् water, प्रतिगृहाण after taking my blessings, श्वः you, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, गमिष्यसि proceed
explanation: "Jewel among the wielders of weapons! Now you take this water, and I shall bestow a boon to you. After taking my blessings you proceed to Ayodhya."

shloka_text: तस्यतच्छिरसावाक्यंप्रतिगृह्यनृपात्मजः । बाढमित्येवसम्हृष्टःश्रीमान्वरमयाचत ।।6.127.18।।
transliteration: tasyatacchirasāvākyaṃpratigṛhyanṛpātmajaḥ | bāḍhamityevasamhṛṣṭaḥśrīmānvaramayācata
translation: श्रीमान् glorious, नृपात्मजः son of emperor, सम्हृष्टः delighted, तस्य his, तत् that, वाक्यम् words, बाढम् इत्येव let you be auspicious, शिरसा bending head in reverence, प्रतिगृह्य taking, वरम् boon, अयाचतः requested
explanation: Glorious son of emperor obeying the words of Bharadwaja bending his head in reverence requested for that boon.

shloka_text: अकालफलिनोवृक्षास्सर्वेचापिमधुस्रवाः । फलान्यमृतगन्धीनिबहूनिविविधानि च ।।6.127.19।। भवन्तुमार्गेभगवन्नयोध्यांप्रतिगच्छतः ।
transliteration: akālaphalinovṛkṣāssarvecāpimadhusravāḥ | phalānyamṛtagandhīnibahūnivividhāni ca  bhavantumārgebhagavannayodhyāṃpratigacchataḥ |
translation: भगवन् divine sage, सर्वेचापि all, वृक्षाः trees, अकालफलिनः unseasonal fruits, मधुस्रवाः sweet and juicy, भवन्तु you, अमृतगन्धीनि tasting like nectar, बहूनि many, विविधानि च several kinds, फलानि fruits, अयोध्यांप्रति in Ayodhya, गच्छतः proceeding, मार्गे way
explanation: "O divine sage! Let all the trees bear fruits out of season of several kinds of many sweet and juicy, tasting nectar appear on our way as we proceed to Ayodhya."

shloka_text: तथेति च प्रतिज्ञातेवचनात्समनन्तरम् ।।6.127.20।। अभवन्पादपास्तत्रस्वर्गपादपसन्निभाः ।
transliteration: tatheti ca pratijñātevacanātsamanantaram  abhavanpādapāstatrasvargapādapasannibhāḥ |
translation: तथेति be it so, प्रतिज्ञाते having promised, वचनात् words, समनन्तरम् on all sides, तत्र there, पादपाः trees, स्वर्गपादपसन्निभाः grew to be like heavenly trees, अभवन् became
explanation: When Bharadwaja promised saying, 'Be it so' and the trees on all sides grew like heavenly trees.

shloka_text: पुष्फलाःफलिनश्चासवनिपुष्पाःपुष्पशालिनः ।।6.127.21।। शुष्कास्समग्रपत्रास्तेनगाश्चैवमधुस्रवाः । सर्वतोयोजनास्त्रिस्रोगच्छतामभवंस्तदा ।।6.127.22।।
transliteration: puṣphalāḥphalinaścāsavanipuṣpāḥpuṣpaśālinaḥ  śuṣkāssamagrapatrāstenagāścaivamadhusravāḥ | sarvatoyojanāstrisrogacchatāmabhavaṃstadā
translation: तदा then, गच्छताम् proceeding, तिस्त्रः three, योजनाः yojanas, सर्वतः all sides, नगाः trees, निष्फलाः that did not have fruits, फलिनश्च started bearing fruits, विपुष्पाः which had no blossoms, पुष्पशालिनः full of blossoms, शुष्काः dried, समग्रपत्राश्च filled with leaves, मधुस्रवाः shed honey, अभवन् became
explanation: "Then while we were proceeding for three yojanas on all sides the trees that did not have fruits started bearing fruits, trees that did not have blossoms started having blossoms and the trees that dried up developed leaves and began to shed honey."

shloka_text: अयोध्यांतुसमालोक्यचिन्तयामासराघवः । प्रियकामःप्रियंरामस्ततस्त्वरितविक्रमः ।।6.128.1।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṃtusamālokyacintayāmāsarāghavaḥ | priyakāmaḥpriyaṃrāmastatastvaritavikramaḥ
translation: ततः thereupon, राघवः Raghava, त्वरितविक्रमः quick in exhibiting prowess, रामः Rama, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, समालोक्य with friends प्रियकामः wished, प्रियम् dear, चिन्तयामास started thinking
explanation: There upon Raghava who was quick in exhibiting his prowess started thinking with his friends looking at Ayodhya (from Pushpaka).
comments: Instructed by Rama, Hanuman informs Guha and Bharata about Rama's arrival.

shloka_text: चिन्तयित्वाततोदृष्टिंवानरेषुन्यपातयत् । उवाचधीमांस्तेजस्वीहनूमन्तंप्लवङ्गमम् ।।6.128.2।।
transliteration: cintayitvātatodṛṣṭiṃvānareṣunyapātayat | uvācadhīmāṃstejasvīhanūmantaṃplavaṅgamam
translation: ततः then, धीमान् wise, तेजस्वी energetic, चिन्तयित्वा thinking, वानरेषु to Vanaras, दृष्टिम् mind, न्यपातयत् casting his attention, प्लवङ्गमम् monkeys, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, उवाच spoke
explanation: Then wise and energetic Rama, thinking, casting his attention on the Vanaras, spoke to Hanuman.

shloka_text: अयोध्यांत्वरितोगत्वाशीघ्रंप्लवगसत्तम । जानीहिकछचित्कुशलीजनोनृपतिमन्दिरे ।।6.128.3।।
transliteration: ayodhyāṃtvaritogatvāśīghraṃplavagasattama | jānīhikachacitkuśalījanonṛpatimandire
translation: प्लवगसत्तम chief of monkeys, त्वरितः going quickly, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, शीघ्रम् hastily, गत्वा going, नृपतिमन्दिरे king's mansion, जनः people, कुशलीकचचित् wellbeing, जानीहि try to know
explanation: "Chief of monkeys! Going quickly to the king's mansion in Ayodhya try to find out about the wellbeing of the people."

shloka_text: शृङ्गबेरिपुरंप्राप्यगुहंगहनगोचरम् । निषादाधिपतिंब्रूहिकुशलंवचनान्मम ।।6.128.4।।
transliteration: śṛṅgaberipuraṃprāpyaguhaṃgahanagocaram | niṣādādhipatiṃbrūhikuśalaṃvacanānmama
translation: शृङ्गबेरिपुरम् Sringaberipuram, गत्वा going, गहनगोचरम् seen from the sky, निषादाधिपतिम् leader of Nishadas, गुहम् Guha, मम my, वचनात् words of inquiry, कुशलम् wellbeing, ब्रूहि tell
explanation: "Go to Sringaberipuram which is seen from the sky, meet Guha the leader of Nishadas and tell him of my inquiry and wellbeing."

shloka_text: श्रुत्वातुमांकुशलिनमरोगंविगतज्वरम् । भविष्यतिगुहःप्रीतस्सममात्मसमस्सखा ।।6.128.5।।
transliteration: śrutvātumāṃkuśalinamarogaṃvigatajvaram | bhaviṣyatiguhaḥprītassamamātmasamassakhā
translation: माम् my, कुशलिनम् wellbeing, आरोगम् in good health, विगतज्वरम् free from anxiety, श्रुत्वा hearing, गुहः Guha, प्रीतः very happy, भविष्यति will feel, सः he, मम my, आत्मसमः equal to me, सखा friend
explanation: "He will be very happy to hear that I am in good health free from anxiety. He is equal to me and my friend."

shloka_text: अयोध्यायाश्चतेमार्गंप्रवृत्तिंभरतस्य च । निवेदयिष्यतिप्रीतोनिषादाधिपतिर्गुहः ।।6.128.6।।
transliteration: ayodhyāyāścatemārgaṃpravṛttiṃbharatasya ca | nivedayiṣyatiprītoniṣādādhipatirguhaḥ
translation: प्रीतः dear, निषादाधिपतिः king of Nishadas गुहः Guha, ते to you, अयोध्यायाः to Ayodhya मार्गम् way, भरतस्य Bharata's, प्रवृत्तिंचnature, निवेदयिष्यति will reveal you
explanation: "Dear Guha, the king of Nishadas will tell you the way to Ayodhya and Bharata's nature."

shloka_text: भरतस्तुत्वयावाच्यःकुशलंवचनान्मम । सिद्धार्थंशंसमांतस्मैसभार्यंसहलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.128.7।।
transliteration: bharatastutvayāvācyaḥkuśalaṃvacanānmama | siddhārthaṃśaṃsamāṃtasmaisabhāryaṃsahalakṣmaṇam
translation: भरतःतु Bharata also, मम my, वचनात् with my words, कुशलम् wellbeing, वाच्यः words of inquiry, सभार्यम् with wife, सहलक्ष्मणम् with Lakshmana, माम् me, सिद्धार्थम् accomplished, तस्मै your, शंस doubt
explanation: "Please tell Bharata my words of inquiry of his wellbeing and that having accomplished my purpose I returned with my wife and Lakshmana."

shloka_text: हरणंचापिवैदेह्यारावणेनबलीयसा । सुग्रीवेण च सम्वादंवालिनश्चवधंरणे ।।6.128.8।।
transliteration: haraṇaṃcāpivaidehyārāvaṇenabalīyasā | sugrīveṇa ca samvādaṃvālinaścavadhaṃraṇe
translation: बलीयसा strong, रावणेन by Ravana, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi, हरणम् abduction, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, संवादं च friendship, रणे in combat, वालिनः Vali, वधम् killing
explanation: "O powerful Hanuman! you may tell him of the abduction of Vaidehi by Ravana, my friendship with Sugriva and killing of Vali in combat."

shloka_text: मैथिल्यन्वेषणंचैवयथाचाधिगतात्वया । लङ्घयित्वामहातोयमापगापतिमव्ययम् ।।6.128.9।।
transliteration: maithilyanveṣaṇaṃcaivayathācādhigatātvayā | laṅghayitvāmahātoyamāpagāpatimavyayam
translation: मैथिल्यन्वेषणंचैव search for Mythili, त्वया by you, महातोयम् huge ocean, अव्ययम् never decreasing, आपगापतिम् vast stretch of water, लङ्घयित्वा leaping across, यथआ similarly, अधिगता finding Sita
explanation: "You may tell him of the search for Mythili by you, crossing the vast never decreasing stretch of water, leaping across and finding Sita."

shloka_text: उपयानंसमुद्रस्यसागरस्य च दर्शनम् । यथा च कारितस्सेतूरावणश्चयथाहतः ।।6.128.10।।
transliteration: upayānaṃsamudrasyasāgarasya ca darśanam | yathā ca kāritassetūrāvaṇaścayathāhataḥ
translation: समुद्रस्य ocean's, उपयानम् going near, सागरस्य ocean, दर्शनं च appearing before me, सेतुः, यथा so also, कारितः bridge, रावणश्च Ravana, यथा so also, हतः killed
explanation: " Also, about my going near ocean and his (Ocean god) appearance before me, construction of the bridge killing of Ravana."

shloka_text: वरदानंमहेन्द्रेणब्रह्मणावरुणेन च । महादेवप्रसादाच्छपित्राममसमागमम् ।।6.128.11।।
transliteration: varadānaṃmahendreṇabrahmaṇāvaruṇena ca | mahādevaprasādācchapitrāmamasamāgamam
translation: महेन्द्रेण by Mahendra, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, वरुणेन च by Varuna, वरदानम् bestowing boon, महादेवप्रसादेन by the grace of Mahadeva, पित्रा father, मम me, समागमम् meeting
explanation: " About Mahendra accompanied by Brahma and Varuna bestowing boon and by the grace of Mahadeva and meeting my father."

shloka_text: उपयातं च मांसौम्य भरतायनिवेदय । सहराक्षसराजेनहरीणामीश्वरेण च ।।6.128.12।।
transliteration: upayātaṃ ca māṃsaumya bharatāyanivedaya | saharākṣasarājenaharīṇāmīśvareṇa ca
translation: सौम्य Gentle, माम् me, राक्षसराजेनसह with Rakshasa king, हरीणाम् with Vanaras, ईश्वरेण Lord of, उपयातम् coming, भरताय Bharata, निवेदय tell him
explanation: "Gentle Hanuman! tell him about my coming with Sugriva the king of Vanaras, and king of Rakshasas, Vibheeshana."

shloka_text: जित्वाशत्रुगणान्रामःप्राप्यचानुत्तमंयशः । उपायानंसमृद्धार्थस्सहमित्रैर्महाबलैः ।।6.128.13।।
transliteration: jitvāśatrugaṇānrāmaḥprāpyacānuttamaṃyaśaḥ | upāyānaṃsamṛddhārthassahamitrairmahābalaiḥ
translation: रामः Rama, शत्रुगणान् hosts of enemies, जित्वा conquering, अनुत्तमाम् unsurpassed, यशः fame, प्राप्य च attained, समृद्धार्थः accomplished the purpose, महाबलैः mighty strong, मित्रैःसह with friends, उपायानं returned
explanation: "Tell him that Rama , after conquering hosts of enemies, attaining unsurpassed fame, accomplished his purpose, has returned with mighty friends."

shloka_text: एतच्छ्रुत्वायमाकारंभजतेभरतस्ततः । स च तेवेदितव्यःस्यात्सर्वंयच्छापिमांप्रति ।।6.128.14।।
transliteration: etacchrutvāyamākāraṃbhajatebharatastataḥ | sa ca teveditavyaḥsyātsarvaṃyacchāpimāṃprati
translation: एतत् all this, श्रुत्वा listening, ततः then, भरतःBharata, यम् his, आकारम् form, भजते appears, सः च true, ते you, वेदितव्यः knowing, मांप्रति to me in turn, यच्छापि his expression, स्यात् check, सर्वम् all
explanation: "Listening to Bharata, and seeing his form, expression on hearing this news and knowing his intent, checking all this you may return to me."

shloka_text: ज्ञेयाःसर्वे च वृत्तान्ताःभरतस्येङ्गितानि च । तत्त्वेनमुखवर्णेनदृष्ट्याव्याभाषितेन च ।।6.128.15।।
transliteration: jñeyāḥsarve ca vṛttāntāḥbharatasyeṅgitāni ca | tattvenamukhavarṇenadṛṣṭyāvyābhāṣitena ca
translation: सर्वे च everything, वृत्तान्ताः information, ज्ञेयाः knowing, मुखवर्णेन facial colour, दृष्ट्या expression, व्याभाषितेन च by his speech, भरतस्यBharata's, इङ्गितानि intention, तत्त्वतःtruly, ज्ञेयाः ascertained
explanation: " All the information, everything to be known by his facial colour, expression, by his speech, his intention to be ascertained truly."

shloka_text: सर्वकालसमृद्धंहिहस्त्यश्वरथसङ्कुलम् । पितृपैतामहंराज्यंकस्यनावर्तयेन्मनः ।।6.128.16।।
transliteration: sarvakālasamṛddhaṃhihastyaśvarathasaṅkulam | pitṛpaitāmahaṃrājyaṃkasyanāvartayenmanaḥ
translation: सर्वकालसमृद्धम् abundant in all seasons, हस्त्यश्वरथसङ्कुलम् hordes of elephants and horses, पितृपैतामहम् father and grandfathers, राज्यम् kingdom, कस्य whose, मनः mind, न आवर्तयेत् not tempt
explanation: "Whose mind will not be tempted at the abundance of elephants and horses of father's and grandfather's kingdom?"

shloka_text: सङ्गत्याभरत्श्रीमान् राज्येनार्थीस्वयंभवेत् । प्रशास्तुवसुधांसर्वामखिलांरघुनन्दनः ।।6.128.17।।
transliteration: saṅgatyābharatśrīmān rājyenārthīsvayaṃbhavet | praśāstuvasudhāṃsarvāmakhilāṃraghunandanaḥ
translation: श्रीमान् glorious, भरतः Bharata, सङ्गत्या meeting, राज्येन in the kingdom, अर्थी, स्वयम् by himself, भवेत् become, रघुनन्दनः enhancer of the joy of Raghus, सर्वाम् all, अखिलाम् entire, वसुधाम् on the earth, प्रशास्तु lauded
explanation: "If the glorious Bharata who is an enhancer of the joy of Raghus having enjoyed the kingdom for long himself, let him rule all the entire earth it is laudable."

shloka_text: तस्यबुद्धिं च विज्ञायव्यवसायं च वानर । यावन्नदूरंयाताःस्मक्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि ।।6.128.18।।
transliteration: tasyabuddhiṃ ca vijñāyavyavasāyaṃ ca vānara | yāvannadūraṃyātāḥsmakṣipramāgantumarhasi
translation: वानर Hanuman the Vanara, तस्य your, बुद्धिम् mind, व्यवसायं च making effort, विज्ञाय knowing, यावत् all, दूरम्distance, न याताःस्म before we go, क्षिप्रम् quickly, आगन्तुम् reach, अर्हसि ought to
explanation: "Hanuman, making an effort to know his mind you ought to come quickly before we go too far a distance."

shloka_text: इतिप्रतिसमादिष्टोहनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । मानुषःधारयनृपमयोध्यांत्वरितोययौ ।।6.128.19।।
transliteration: itipratisamādiṣṭohanūmānmārutātmajaḥ | mānuṣaḥdhārayanṛpamayodhyāṃtvaritoyayau
translation: इति thus, प्रतिसमादिष्टः commanded, मारुतात्मजः son of Maruti, हनुमान् Hanuman, त्वरितः speedily, मानुषंरूपम् human form, धारयन् taking, अयोध्याम् to Ayodhya, ययौ went
explanation: Commanded like that Hanuman went speedily taking human form to Ayodhya.

shloka_text: अतोत्पपातवेगेनहनूमान्मारुतात्मजः । गरुत्मानिववेगेनजिघृक्षन्पन्नगोत्तमम् ।।6.128.20।।
transliteration: atotpapātavegenahanūmānmārutātmajaḥ | garutmānivavegenajighṛkṣanpannagottamam
translation: अथ and then, मारुतात्मजंहनूमान् Hanuman, the son of Maruti, पन्नगोत्तमम् the best of serpents, वेगेन at great speed, जिघृक्षन् vanquish, गरुत्मानिव like Garuda, वेगेन speedily, उत्पपात rose
explanation: Then Hanuman rose up just like Garuda who goes at great speed to vanquish the best of serpents.

shloka_text: लङ्घयित्वापितृपथंविहगेन्द्रालयंशुभम् । गङ्गायमुनयोर्भीमंसमतीत्यसमागमम् ।।6.128.21।। शृङ्गबेरपुरंप्राप्यगुहमासाद्यवीर्यवान् । स वाचाशुभयाहृष्टोहनुमानिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.128.22।।
transliteration: laṅghayitvāpitṛpathaṃvihagendrālayaṃśubham | gaṅgāyamunayorbhīmaṃsamatītyasamāgamam  śṛṅgaberapuraṃprāpyaguhamāsādyavīryavān | sa vācāśubhayāhṛṣṭohanumānidamabravīt
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, विहगेन्द्रालयम् the course of the birds, शुभम् auspicious, पितृपथम् path of wind god, लङ्घयित्वा leaping, गङ्गायमुनयोः Ganga and Yamuna, भीमम् frightening, समागमम् confluence, समतीत्य reaching, शृङ्गबेरिपुरम् Sringaberipuram, प्राप्य attaining, गुहम् Guha, आसाद्य seeing, हृष्टः joyful, शुभया charming, वाचा words, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Valiant Hanuman, flying through the course of the birds, through the auspicious path of the wind god, leaping across Ganga and Yamuna, reached Sringaberipuram, saw Guha, rejoiced and thus spoke charming words.

shloka_text: लङ्घयित्वापितृपथंविहगेन्द्रालयंशुभम् । गङ्गायमुनयोर्भीमंसमतीत्यसमागमम् ।।6.128.21।। शृङ्गबेरपुरंप्राप्यगुहमासाद्यवीर्यवान् । स वाचाशुभयाहृष्टोहनुमानिदमब्रवीत् ।।6.128.22।।
transliteration: laṅghayitvāpitṛpathaṃvihagendrālayaṃśubham | gaṅgāyamunayorbhīmaṃsamatītyasamāgamam  śṛṅgaberapuraṃprāpyaguhamāsādyavīryavān | sa vācāśubhayāhṛṣṭohanumānidamabravīt
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, विहगेन्द्रालयम् the course of the birds, शुभम् auspicious, पितृपथम् path of wind god, लङ्घयित्वा leaping, गङ्गायमुनयोः Ganga and Yamuna, भीमम् frightening, समागमम् confluence, समतीत्य reaching, शृङ्गबेरिपुरम् Sringaberipuram, प्राप्य attaining, गुहम् Guha, आसाद्य seeing, हृष्टः joyful, शुभया charming, वाचा words, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Valiant Hanuman, flying through the course of the birds, through the auspicious path of the wind god, leaping across Ganga and Yamuna, reached Sringaberipuram, saw Guha, rejoiced and thus spoke charming words.

shloka_text: सखातुतवकाकुत्स्थोरामस्सत्यपराक्रमः । ससीतस्सहसौमित्रिस्सत्वांकुशलमब्रवीत् ।।6.128.23।।
transliteration: sakhātutavakākutsthorāmassatyaparākramaḥ | sasītassahasaumitrissatvāṃkuśalamabravīt
translation: तव your, सखा friend, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, सत्यपराक्रमः truly valiant, ससीतः with Sita, सहसौमित्रिः with Saumithri, सःरामः he, Rama, त्वाम् you, कुशलम् welfare, अब्रवीत् said
explanation: "Your friend Rama, truly valiant one, with his wife Sita, with Lakshmana conveys his welfare to you."

shloka_text: पञ्चमीमद्यरजनीमुषित्वावचनान्मुनेः । भरद्वाजाभ्यनुज्ञातंद्रक्ष्यस्यद्यैवराघवम् ।।6.128.24।।
transliteration: pañcamīmadyarajanīmuṣitvāvacanānmuneḥ | bharadvājābhyanujñātaṃdrakṣyasyadyaivarāghavam
translation: अद्य today, मुनेः sage, वचनात् by the words, पञ्चमीम् fifth, रजनीम् night, उषित्वा night, भरद्वाजाभ्यनुज्ञातम् with the permission of Bharadvaja, राघवम् Raghava, अद्यैव morning, द्रक्ष्यसि you will see
explanation: "Tomorrow that is the fifth lunar day, after spending the night at sage Bharadwaja's hermitage Raghava will see you."

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वामहातेजास्सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः । उत्पपातमहावेगाद्वेगवान्विचारयन् ।।6.128.25।।
transliteration: evamuktvāmahātejāssamprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ | utpapātamahāvegādvegavānvicārayan
translation: महातेजाः highly energetic, सम्प्रहृष्टतनूरुहः thrilled overcome by happiness, वेगवान् endowed with speed, अविचारयन् not caring for the fatigue, महावेगात् swift moving, उत्पपात went up
explanation: Highly energetic Hanuman, was thrilled, overcome with happiness (that he was able to communicate to Guha) and unmindful of the fatigue, being endowed with speed and swift movement, went up.

shloka_text: सोऽपश्यद्रामतीर्थं च नदींवालुकिनींतथा । वरूथींगोमतींचैवभीमंशालवनंतथा ।।6.128.26।। प्रजाश्चबहुसाहस्रीःस्फीतान्जनपदानपि ।
transliteration: so'paśyadrāmatīrthaṃ ca nadīṃvālukinīṃtathā | varūthīṃgomatīṃcaivabhīmaṃśālavanaṃtathā  prajāścabahusāhasrīḥsphītānjanapadānapi |
translation: सः he, रामतीर्थं च, Rama waters तथा so also, वालुकिनींनदीम् Valukini, वरूथीम् Varuthimi, गोमतींचैव Gomathi, तथा so also, भीमम् fearful, शालवनम् Sal woods, बहुसाहस्रीः many thousands, प्रजाश्च people, स्फीतान् numerous, जनपदानपि kingdoms, अपश्यत् saw
explanation: He saw waters associated with Parasurama, and rivers Valukini, Varuthini, and Gomathi so also fearful woods of Sala trees and thousands of people, numerous kingdoms on the way.

shloka_text: सःगत्वादूरमध्वानंत्वरितःकपिकुञ्जरः ।।6.128.27।। आससादद्रुमान् फुल्लान्नन्दिग्रामसमीपगान् । स्त्रीभिस्सपुत्रैर्वृद्धैश्चरममाणैःस्वलङ्कृतैः । सुराधिपस्योपवनेयथाचैत्ररथेद्रुमान् ।।6.128.28।।
transliteration: saḥgatvādūramadhvānaṃtvaritaḥkapikuñjaraḥ  āsasādadrumān phullānnandigrāmasamīpagān | strībhissaputrairvṛddhaiścaramamāṇaiḥsvalaṅkṛtaiḥ | surādhipasyopavaneyathācaitrarathedrumān
translation: सः he, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among monkeys, त्वरितः soon, दूरम् distance, अध्वानम् speeding on the journey, गत्वा going, स्त्रीभिः women, सपुत्रैः their sons, स्वलङ्कृतैः well decorated, रममाणैः sporting, वृद्धैश्चज old people, सुराधिपस्य like that of Indra, उपवने gardens, चैत्ररथे Chaitraratha, द्रुमान्यथा trees, नन्दिग्रामसमीपगान् close by Nandigrama, फुल्लान् blossoms, द्रुमान् trees, आससाद reached
explanation: Speeding on the journey for long distance Hanuman, the elephant among the monkeys saw women, their sons, grand sons and the old, well decorated, sporting in the gardens which were like the gardens of Indra and the gardens of Chaitraratha of Kubera with trees and close to Nandigrama, he saw trees full of blossoms.

shloka_text: सःगत्वादूरमध्वानंत्वरितःकपिकुञ्जरः ।।6.128.27।। आससादद्रुमान् फुल्लान्नन्दिग्रामसमीपगान् । स्त्रीभिस्सपुत्रैर्वृद्धैश्चरममाणैःस्वलङ्कृतैः । सुराधिपस्योपवनेयथाचैत्ररथेद्रुमान् ।।6.128.28।।
transliteration: saḥgatvādūramadhvānaṃtvaritaḥkapikuñjaraḥ  āsasādadrumān phullānnandigrāmasamīpagān | strībhissaputrairvṛddhaiścaramamāṇaiḥsvalaṅkṛtaiḥ | surādhipasyopavaneyathācaitrarathedrumān
translation: सः he, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among monkeys, त्वरितः soon, दूरम् distance, अध्वानम् speeding on the journey, गत्वा going, स्त्रीभिः women, सपुत्रैः their sons, स्वलङ्कृतैः well decorated, रममाणैः sporting, वृद्धैश्चज old people, सुराधिपस्य like that of Indra, उपवने gardens, चैत्ररथे Chaitraratha, द्रुमान्यथा trees, नन्दिग्रामसमीपगान् close by Nandigrama, फुल्लान् blossoms, द्रुमान् trees, आससाद reached
explanation: Speeding on the journey for long distance Hanuman, the elephant among the monkeys saw women, their sons, grand sons and the old, well decorated, sporting in the gardens which were like the gardens of Indra and the gardens of Chaitraratha of Kubera with trees and close to Nandigrama, he saw trees full of blossoms.

shloka_text: क्रोशमात्रेत्वयोध्यायाचशीरकृष्णाजिनम्बरम् ।।6.128.29।। ददर्शभरतंदीनंकृशमाश्रमवासिनम् । जटिलंमलदिग्धाङ्गंभ्रातृव्यसनकर्शितम् ।।6.128.30 । फलमूलाशिनंदान्तंतापसंधर्मचारिणम् । समुन्नतजटाभारंवल्कलाजिनवाससम् ।।6.128.31।। नियतंभावितात्मानंब्रह्मर्षिसमतेजसम् । पादुकेतेपुरस्कृत्यप्रशासन्तंवसुन्धराम् ।।6.128.32 । चातुर्वर्णस्यलोकस्यत्रातारंमहतोभयात् । उपस्थितममात्यैश्चशुचिभिश्चपुरोहितैः ।।6.128.33।। बलमुख्यैश्चयुक्तैश्चकाषायाम्बरदारिभिः ।

shloka_text: नहितेराजपुत्रंतंचीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम् ।।6.128.34।। परिभोक्तुंव्यवस्यन्तिपौरावैधर्मवत्सलाः ।
transliteration: nahiterājaputraṃtaṃcīrakṛṣṇājināmbaram  paribhoktuṃvyavasyantipaurāvaidharmavatsalāḥ |
translation: धर्मवत्सलाः lovers of virtues, तेपौराः those citizens, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरम् wore bark of trees and skin of antelope, राजपुत्रम् prince, तम् them, परिभोक्तुम् to enjoy luxuries, न व्यवस्यन्तिहि not inclined for pleasures
explanation: The citizens (of Ayodhya) who were lovers of virtues did not enjoy any luxuries, not inclined for pleasures as the prince himself was wearing bark of trees and skin of antelope.

shloka_text: तम्धर्ममिवधर्मज्ञंदेहवन्तमिवापरम् ।।6.128.35।। उवाचप्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यंहनूमान्मारुतात्मजः ।
transliteration: tamdharmamivadharmajñaṃdehavantamivāparam  uvācaprāñjalirvākyaṃhanūmānmārutātmajaḥ |
translation: मारुतात्मजः Maruti's son, हनुमान् Hanuman, धर्मज्ञम् righteous, देहवन्तम् body of dharma, अपरम् supreme, धर्ममिव dharma like, तम् him, प्राञ्जलिः offered salutations, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच spoke
explanation: Maruti's son Hanuman offered salutations to Bharata who was seen like a supreme body of dharma itself as if he was another form of dharma.

shloka_text: वसन्तंदण्डकारण्येयंत्वंचीरजटाधरम् ।।6.128.36।। अनुशोचसिकाकुत्स्थं स त्वांकौशलमब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: vasantaṃdaṇḍakāraṇyeyaṃtvaṃcīrajaṭādharam  anuśocasikākutsthaṃ sa tvāṃkauśalamabravīt |
translation: दण्डकारण्ये at Dandakaranya, वसन्तम् living, चीरजटाधरम् wearing bark of trees and with matted hair, यम् him, काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, अनुशोचसि you are worrying, सः he, त्वाम् you, कौशलम् welfare, अब्रवीत् sent to tell
explanation: "That Kakuthsa for whom you are worrying and living as he was at Dandaka forest with bark tree fabric, and matted hair sent me to tell you about his welfare."

shloka_text: प्रियमाख्यामितेदेवशोकंत्यजसुदारुणम् ।।6.128.37।। अस्मिन्मुहूर्तेभ्रात्रात्वंरामेणसहसङ्गतः ।
transliteration: priyamākhyāmitedevaśokaṃtyajasudāruṇam  asminmuhūrtebhrātrātvaṃrāmeṇasahasaṅgataḥ |
translation: देव O god, ते you, प्रियम् pleasant, आख्यामि will tell, सुदारुणम् terrible, शोकम् grief, त्यज give up, अस्मिन् your, मुहूर्ते moment, त्वम् your, भ्रात्रा brother, रामेण Rama and सह with, सङ्गतः reunited
explanation: "O God! I will tell you some pleasant news. Give up that terrible grief. You will be reunited with your brother this moment."

shloka_text: निहत्यरावणंरामःप्रतिलभ्य च मैथिलीम् ।।6.128.38।। उपयातिसमृद्धार्थःसहमित्रैर्महाबलैः ।
transliteration: nihatyarāvaṇaṃrāmaḥpratilabhya ca maithilīm  upayātisamṛddhārthaḥsahamitrairmahābalaiḥ |
translation: रामः Rama, रावणम् Ravana, निहत्य killed, मैथिलीम्Mythili, प्रतिलभ्य recovered, समृद्धार्थः having accomplished the purpose, महाबलैः mighty, मित्रैःसह with friends, उपयाति coming
explanation: "Rama killed Ravana and recovered Mythili. He, having accomplished the purpose, is coming with his mighty friends."

shloka_text: लक्ष्मणश्चमहातेजावैदेही च यशस्विनी ।।6.128.39।। सीतासमग्रारामेणमहेन्द्रेणशचीयथा ।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇaścamahātejāvaidehī ca yaśasvinī  sītāsamagrārāmeṇamahendreṇaśacīyathā |
translation: महातेजाः endowed with extraordinary energy, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana's, यशस्विनी illustrious, रामेण by Rama, समग्रा, सीता Sita, महेन्द्रेण by Mahendra, शचीयथा like Sachi
explanation: "Lakshmana who is endowed with extraordinary energy, and illustrious Sita accompanied by Rama will be coming as Sachi with Mahendra."

shloka_text: एवमुक्तोहनुमताभरतःकैकयीसुतः ।।6.128.40।। पपातसहसाहृष्टोहर्षान्मोहमुपागमत् ।
transliteration: evamuktohanumatābharataḥkaikayīsutaḥ  papātasahasāhṛṣṭoharṣānmohamupāgamat |
translation: हनुमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्तःsaid, कैकयीसुतःson of Kaikeyi, भरतः Bharata, हृष्टः delighted, सहसा instantly, भूमौ on the ground, पपात fell, हर्षात् in extreme joy, मोहम् lost senses, उपागमत् overtaken by
explanation: Hanuman having said that, the son of Kaikeyi was delighted and instantly fell on ground and lost senses by extreme joy.

shloka_text: ततोमुहूर्तादुत्थायप्रत्याश्वस्य च राघवः ।।6.128.41।। हनूमन्तमुवाचेदंभरतःप्रियवादिनम् ।
transliteration: tatomuhūrtādutthāyapratyāśvasya ca rāghavaḥ  hanūmantamuvācedaṃbharataḥpriyavādinam |
translation: ततः then, राघवः Raghava, भरतः Bharata, मुहूर्तात् in a moment, उत्थाय got up, प्रत्याश्वस्य च in person, प्रियवादिनम् sweet in speech, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke
explanation: Bharata got up in a moment and saw Hanuman, who is sweet in speech said this.

shloka_text: अशोकजैःप्रीतिमयैःकपिमालिङ्ग्यसम्भ्रमात् ।।6.128.42।। सिषेचभरतःश्रीमान्विपुलैरश्रुबिन्धुभिः ।
transliteration: aśokajaiḥprītimayaiḥkapimāliṅgyasambhramāt  siṣecabharataḥśrīmānvipulairaśrubindhubhiḥ |
translation: श्रीमान् glorious, भरतः Bharata, कपिम् monkey, सम्भ्रमात् overwhelmed, आलिङ्ग्य embraced, अशोकजैः born of joy, प्रीतिमयैः affectionately, विपुलैः copious, अश्रुबिन्दुभिः tears of joy, सिषेच shed
explanation: Glorious Bharata was overwhelmed with joy and embraced Hanuman and copious tears of joy born of joy.

shloka_text: देवोवामानुषोवात्वमनुक्रोशादिहागतः ।।6.128.43।। प्रियाख्यानस्यतेसौम्यददामिब्रुवतःप्रियम् । गवांशतसहस्रं च ग्रामाणां च शतंपरम् ।।6.128.44।। सकुण्डलाश्शुभाचाराभार्याःकन्यास्तुषोडश । हेमवर्णास्सुनासोरूश्शशिसौम्याननाःस्त्रियः ।।6.128.45।। सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नास्सम्पन्नाःकुलजातिभिः ।
transliteration: devovāmānuṣovātvamanukrośādihāgataḥ  priyākhyānasyatesaumyadadāmibruvataḥpriyam | gavāṃśatasahasraṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ ca śataṃparam  sakuṇḍalāśśubhācārābhāryāḥkanyāstuṣoḍaśa | hemavarṇāssunāsorūśśaśisaumyānanāḥstriyaḥ  sarvābharaṇasampannāssampannāḥkulajātibhiḥ |
translation: सौम्य gentle, अनुक्रोशात् with great compassion, इह here, आगतः come, त्वम् you, देवोवा god or, मानुषोवा human, प्रियम् happiness, ब्रुवतः spoke, ते you, प्रियाख्यानस्य for the sweet tidings, गवाम्cows, शतसहस्रं च hundred thousand, परम् best, ग्रामाणाम् villages, शतम् hundred, सकुण्डलाः earrings, शुभाचाराः of good conduct, षोडश sixteen, कन्याः virgin women, भार्याः as wives, हेमवर्णाः golden complexioned, सुनासोरूः shapely nose and thighs, शशिसौम्याननाः face like full moon, सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नाः decked with all kinds of ornaments, कुलजातिभिः of good race, सम्पन्नाः rich, स्त्रियः women, ददामि will bestow
explanation: "O Gentle Hanuman! You have come here with great compassion. Are you God or a human being? For the sweet tidings brought by you to me, I will bestow a hundred thousand cows, hundred best villages, sixteen virgin women of good conduct as wives with earrings, with shapely noses, full moon like face, golden complexioned, decked with ornaments and rich women."

shloka_text: देवोवामानुषोवात्वमनुक्रोशादिहागतः ।।6.128.43।। प्रियाख्यानस्यतेसौम्यददामिब्रुवतःप्रियम् । गवांशतसहस्रं च ग्रामाणां च शतंपरम् ।।6.128.44।। सकुण्डलाश्शुभाचाराभार्याःकन्यास्तुषोडश । हेमवर्णास्सुनासोरूश्शशिसौम्याननाःस्त्रियः ।।6.128.45।। सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नास्सम्पन्नाःकुलजातिभिः ।

translation: सौम्य gentle, अनुक्रोशात् with great compassion, इह here, आगतः come, त्वम् you, देवोवा god or, मानुषोवा human, प्रियम् happiness, ब्रुवतः spoke, ते you, प्रियाख्यानस्य for the sweet tidings, गवाम्cows, शतसहस्रं च hundred thousand, परम् best, ग्रामाणाम् villages, शतम् hundred, सकुण्डलाः earrings, शुभाचाराः of good conduct, षोडश sixteen, कन्याः virgin women, भार्याः as wives, हेमवर्णाः golden complexioned, सुनासोरूः shapely nose and thighs, शशिसौम्याननाः face like full moon, सर्वाभरणसम्पन्नाः decked with all kinds of ornaments, कुलजातिभिः of good race, सम्पन्नाः rich, स्त्रियः women, ददामि will bestow
explanation: "O Gentle Hanuman! You have come here with great compassion. Are you God or a human being? For the sweet tidings brought by you to me, I will bestow a hundred thousand cows, hundred best villages, sixteen virgin women of good conduct as wives with earrings, with shapely noses, full moon like face, golden complexioned, decked with ornaments and rich women."

explanation: "O Gentle Hanuman! You have come here with great compassion. Are you God or a human being? shloka_text: बहूनिनामवर्षाणिगतस्यसुमहद्वनम् । शृणोम्यहंप्रीतिकरंममनाथस्यकीर्तनम् ।।6.129.1।।
transliteration: bahūnināmavarṣāṇigatasyasumahadvanam | śṛṇomyahaṃprītikaraṃmamanāthasyakīrtanam
translation: बहूनि many, वर्षाणि years, सुमहत् great, वनम् forest, गतस्य living, ममनाधस्य my Lord, प्रीतिकरम् returning, कीर्तनम् news, अहम् I, शृणोमिनाम hearing his name
explanation: "I am hearing the good news of my Lord returning from the forest, who was living in the great forest for many years."
comments: Hanuman's description of the long journey of Sri Rama and the people he met.

shloka_text: कल्याणीबतगाथेयंलौकिकीप्रतिभातिमे । एतिजीवन्तमानन्दोनरंवर्षशतादपि ।।6.129.2।।
transliteration: kalyāṇībatagātheyaṃlaukikīpratibhātime | etijīvantamānandonaraṃvarṣaśatādapi
translation: जीवन्तम् living, नरम् humans, वर्षशतादपि for a hundred years, आनन्दः happy, एति such, इयम् this, लौकिकी saying, गाथा story, मे to me, कल्याणी auspicious, प्रतिभाति true
explanation: The saying that "If a human being lives (long), for a hundred years, he will experience joy" is true and auspicious.

shloka_text: राघवस्यहरीणां च कथमासीत्समागमः । कस्मिन् देशेकिमाश्रित्यतत्त्वमाख्याहिपृच्छतः ।।6.129.3।।
transliteration: rāghavasyaharīṇāṃ ca kathamāsītsamāgamaḥ | kasmin deśekimāśrityatattvamākhyāhipṛcchataḥ
translation: राघवस्य च Raghava's, कपीनां च with the monkeys, कस्मिन् देवे where with Rama, किम् why, आश्रित्य alliance, कथम् how, समागमः friendshipmeeting, आसीत् asking, पृच्छतः tell, तत्त्वम् truly आख्याहि please tell
explanation: "How did the alliance of monkeys happen with Rama? Where and why? I am asking you. Tell me truly."

shloka_text: स पृष्टोराजपुत्रेणबृश्यांसमुपवेशितः । आचचक्षेततस्सर्वंरामस्यचरितंवने ।।6.129.4।।
transliteration: sa pṛṣṭorājaputreṇabṛśyāṃsamupaveśitaḥ | ācacakṣetatassarvaṃrāmasyacaritaṃvane
translation: बृस्याम् on the kusa grass, समुपवेशितः seated comfortably, राजपुत्रेण prince, पृष्टः joy, सः he, ततः then, वने in the forest, रामस्य Rama's, सर्वम् all, चरितम् history, आचचक्षे wish to hear
explanation: Prince Bharata seated comfortably on kusa grass asked Hanuman for all the history that happened in the forest, wishing to hear from him.

shloka_text: यथाप्रव्राजितोरामोमातुर्दत्तौवरौतव । यथापुत्रशोकेनराजादशरथोमृतः ।।6.129.5।। यथादूतैस्त्वमानीतस्तूर्णंराजगृहात्प्रभो । त्वयायोध्यांप्रविष्टेनयथाराज्यं न चेप्सितम् ।।6.129.6।। चित्रकूटगिरिंगत्वाराज्येनामित्रकर्शनः । निमन्त्रितस्त्वयाभ्राताधर्ममाचरतासताम् ।।6.129.7।। स्थितेनराज्ञोवचनेयथाराज्यंविसर्जितम् । आर्यस्यमादुकेगृह्ययथासिपुनरागतः।।य6.129.8।। सर्वमेतन्महाबाहोयथावद्विदितंतव । त्वयिप्रतिप्रयातेतुयद्वृत्तंतन्निबोधमे ।।6.129.9।।
transliteration: yathāpravrājitorāmomāturdattauvarautava | yathāputraśokenarājādaśarathomṛtaḥ  yathādūtaistvamānītastūrṇaṃrājagṛhātprabho | tvayāyodhyāṃpraviṣṭenayathārājyaṃ na cepsitam  citrakūṭagiriṃgatvārājyenāmitrakarśanaḥ | nimantritastvayābhrātādharmamācaratāsatām  sthitenarājñovacaneyathārājyaṃvisarjitam | āryasyamādukegṛhyayathāsipunarāgataḥ||ya6.129.8|| sarvametanmahābāhoyathāvadviditaṃtava | tvayipratiprayātetuyadvṛttaṃtannibodhame
translation: प्रभो O Lord, महाबाहो mighty armed, तव your, मातुः mother, वरौ boons यथा so, दत्तौ bestowed, रामः Rama, प्रव्राजितः to exile, राजा king, दशरथः Dasharatha, पुत्रशोकेन grief of son, यथा so, मृतः mother, त्वम् your, दूतैः envoys, राजगृहात् to the kng's palace, तूर्णम् soon, यथा so, आनीतः brought, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रविष्टेन having entered, त्वया by you, राज्यम् sovereign, यथा so, न च ईप्सितम् not willing, सताम् all, धर्मम् right, आचरता not accepted, त्वया by you, चित्रकूटगिरिम् Chitrakuta mountain, गत्वा going, अमित्रकर्शनः scourge of his enemies, भ्राता brother, यथा so, राज्येन kingdom, निमन्त्रितः made you as tradition goes, राज्ञः king, वचने words, स्थितेन following, यथा like that, राज्यम् kingdom, विसर्जितम् renouncing, आर्यस्य noble Rama's, पादुके sandals, गृह्य taking, यथा so also, पुनः again, आगतःअसि returned here, एतत् all this, सर्वम् everything, तव to you, यथावत् as it is, विदितम् known, त्वयि to you, प्रतिप्रयाते returned, यत् that which, वृत्तम् details, मे by you, निबोध known
explanation: "O Lord, mighty armed Bharata! the boons bestowed on your mother, how Sri Rama went on exile, how king Dasharatha died out of grief of son, envoys bringing you to Ayodhya, entering the kingdom, your unwillingness to accept the sovereignty, going to Chitrakuta mountain, seeking your brother noble Rama, a scourge of enemies to accept the kingdom, renouncing the kingdom by Rama, taking his sandals, and again returning here, all this is known to you."

shloka_text: अपयातेत्वयितदासमुद्भ्रान्तमृगद्विजम् । परिध्युIनमिवात्यर्थंतद्वनंसमपद्यत ।।6.129.10।।
transliteration: apayātetvayitadāsamudbhrāntamṛgadvijam | paridhyuInamivātyarthaṃtadvanaṃsamapadyata
translation: त्वयि by you, तदा then, अपयाते gone away, समुद्भ्रान्तमृगद्विजम् beasts and birds scared of your army, अत्यर्थम् meaning, परिध्यIनम् agitated, इव like that, तत् then, वनम् forest, समपद्यत doleful appearance
explanation: "When you had gone away the beasts and birds scared of your army got agitated and had a doleful appearance."

shloka_text: तदथस्तिमृदितंघोरंसिंहव्याघ्रमृगाकुलम् । प्रविवेशाथविजनं स महद्दण्डकावनम् ।।6.129.11।।
transliteration: tadathastimṛditaṃghoraṃsiṃhavyāghramṛgākulam | praviveśāthavijanaṃ sa mahaddaṇḍakāvanam
translation: सः he, अथ and then, हस्तिमृदितम् trampled by elephants, सिंसव्याघ्रमृगाकुलम् crowded with lions, tigers and deer, घोरम् dreadful, विजनम् devoid of people, महत् huge, तत् that, दण्डकावनम्  Dandaka forest, प्रविवेश entered
explanation: "Then he entered into dreadful Dandaka forest that was devoid of people which was crowded with lions, tigers, and deer, and trampled by the elephants."

shloka_text: तेषांपुरस्ताद्भलवान् गच्छतांगहनेवने । विनदन् सुमहानादंविराधःप्रत्यदृश्यत ।।6.129.12।।
transliteration: teṣāṃpurastādbhalavān gacchatāṃgahanevane | vinadan sumahānādaṃvirādhaḥpratyadṛśyata
translation: गहने dense, वने forest, गच्छताम् on going, तेषाम् advancing that way, पुरस्तात् before them, सुमहानादम् loud noise, विनदन् roaring, विराधः Viradha, प्रत्यदृश्यत saw there
explanation: As they advanced through the dense forest, the mighty Viradha appeared before them, roaring with a tremendous noise.

shloka_text: तमुत्क्षिप्यमहानादमूर्ध्वबाहुमधोमुखम् । निखातेप्रक्षिपन्तिस्मवदन्तमिवकुञ्जरम् ।।6.129.13।।
transliteration: tamutkṣipyamahānādamūrdhvabāhumadhomukham | nikhāteprakṣipantismavadantamivakuñjaram
translation: ऊर्ध्वबाहुम् uplifted his arms, महानादम् huge noise, तम् him, उत्क्षिप्यनदन्तम् holding feet with hands, कुञ्जरमिव like an elephant, अधोमुखम् head bent low, निखाते dug up, प्रक्षिपन्तिस्म thrown into
explanation: "That Viradha uplifted his arms and bent his head low screamed like an elephant. The three dug up a pit and threw him into it."

shloka_text: तत्कृत्वादुष्करंकर्मभ्रातरौरामलक्ष्मणौ । सायाह्नेशरभङ्गस्यरम्यमाश्रममीयतुः ।।6.129.14।।
transliteration: tatkṛtvāduṣkaraṃkarmabhrātaraurāmalakṣmaṇau | sāyāhneśarabhaṅgasyaramyamāśramamīyatuḥ
translation: भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, दुष्करम् difficult, तत् that, कर्म do that task, कृत्वा having done, सायह्ने evening, शरभङ्गस्य Sarabhanga's, रम्यम् beautiful, आश्रमम् hermitage, ईयतुः reached
explanation: "Both the brothers Rama and Lakshmana encountered Viradha who was difficult to attack and having completed their task, reached the beautiful hermitage of Sarabhanga in the evening."

shloka_text: शरभङ्गेदिवंप्राप्तेरामस्सत्यपराक्रमः । अभिवाद्यमुनीन्सर्वान्जनस्थानमुपागमत् ।।6.129.15।।
transliteration: śarabhaṅgedivaṃprāpterāmassatyaparākramaḥ | abhivādyamunīnsarvānjanasthānamupāgamat
translation: शरभङ्गे Sarabhanga, दिवम् heaven, प्राप्ते attained, सत्यपराक्रमः of truthful valour, रामः Rama, सर्वान् all, मुनीन् sages, अभिवाद्य greeting, जनस्थानम् Janasthana, उपागमत् reached
explanation: When Sarabhanga had attained heaven, Rama of truthful valour, after saluting all the sages, reached Janasthana.

shloka_text: ततःपश्चाच्छूर्पणखानामरामपार्शमुपागता । ततोरामेणसन्दिष्टोलक्ष्मणस्सहसोत्थितः ।।6.129.16।। प्रगृह्यखङ्गंचिच्छेदकर्णनासेमहाबलः ।
transliteration: tataḥpaścācchūrpaṇakhānāmarāmapārśamupāgatā | tatorāmeṇasandiṣṭolakṣmaṇassahasotthitaḥ  pragṛhyakhaṅgaṃcicchedakarṇanāsemahābalaḥ |
translation: पश्चात् later, शूर्पणखानाम named Surpanakha, रामपार्श्वम् close by Rama, उपागता came, ततः then, रामेण to Rama, सन्दिष्टः indication, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, सहसा quickly, उत्थितः getting up, खङ्गम् sword, प्रगृह्य taking hold, कर्णवासे ears and nose, चिच्छेद cut off
explanation: "Later came an ogre called Surpanakha close by Rama. Rama indicated to mighty Lakshmana, who got up quickly and cut off her ears and nose with a sword."

shloka_text: चतुर्दशसहस्राणिजनस्तान्निवासिनाम् ।।6.129.17।। हतानिवसतातत्रराघवेणमहात्मना ।
transliteration: caturdaśasahasrāṇijanastānnivāsinām  hatānivasatātatrarāghaveṇamahātmanā |
translation: तत्र there, वसता lived, महात्मना great soul, राघवेण Raghava, जनस्थान्निवासिनाम् while living at Janasthana, चतुर्दश fourteen, सहस्राणि thousand, हतानि killed
explanation: "While the great soul Rama lived at Janasthana, he killed fourteen thousand ogres".

shloka_text: एकेनसहसङ्गम्यरामेणरणमूर्धनि ।।6.129.18।। अह्नश्चतुर्थभागेननिःशेषाराक्षसाःकृताः ।
transliteration: ekenasahasaṅgamyarāmeṇaraṇamūrdhani  ahnaścaturthabhāgenaniḥśeṣārākṣasāḥkṛtāḥ |
translation: एकेन alone, रामेण by Rama, रणमूर्धनि in forefront of combat, सहसङ्गम्य altogether, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, अह्नः in a day, चतुर्धभागेन fourteen thousands, निःशेषाः without leaving any one कृताः finished.
explanation: "Rama alone in a day finished fourteen thousand Rakshasas standing alone in the forefront of the combat".

shloka_text: मबलामहावीर्यास्तपसोविघ्नकारिणः ।।6.129.19।। निहताराघवेणाजौदण्डकारण्यवासिनः ।
transliteration: mabalāmahāvīryāstapasovighnakāriṇaḥ  nihatārāghaveṇājaudaṇḍakāraṇyavāsinaḥ |
translation: राघवेण by Raghava, आजौ in the battle, महाबलाः mighty strong, महावीर्याः great heroes, तपसः penance, विघ्नकारिणः obstructing, दण्डकारण्यवासिनः living in Dandakaranya, निहताः killed
explanation: "Mighty strong heroic ogres obstructing the penance of sages living in Dandakaranya were killed by Raghava in the combat."

shloka_text: राक्षसाश्चविनिष्पिष्टाःखरश्चनिहतोरणे ।।6.129.20।। दूषणंचाग्रतोहत्वात्रिशिरास्तदनन्तम् ।
transliteration: rākṣasāścaviniṣpiṣṭāḥkharaścanihatoraṇe  dūṣaṇaṃcāgratohatvātriśirāstadanantam |
translation: रणे in the battle, राक्षसाः च Rakshasas also, विनिष्पिष्टाः terminating, खरः च Khara, निहतः killed, अग्रतः elder brother, दूषणम् Dushana, हत्वा killed, तदनन्तरम् thereafter, त्रिशिराः Trisira
explanation: "In the battle Rama terminated Khara and killed his elder brother Dushana and also Trisira thereafter."

shloka_text: तस्तेनार्दिताबालारावणंसमुपागता ।।6.129.21।। रावणानुचरोघोरोमारीचोनामराक्षसः । लोभयामासवैदेहींभूत्वारत्नमयोमृगः ।।6.129.22।।
transliteration: tastenārditābālārāvaṇaṃsamupāgatā  rāvaṇānucaroghoromārīconāmarākṣasaḥ | lobhayāmāsavaidehīṃbhūtvāratnamayomṛgaḥ
translation: ततः then, तेन by that, अर्दिता afflicted, बाला Surpanakha, रावणम् Ravana, समुपागता returning to, रावणानुचरः Ravana, घोरःdreadful, मारीचोनाम Maricha by name, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रत्नमयः precious stones, मृगः deer, भूत्वा assuming, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, लोभयामास desire for
explanation: "Then Surpanakha afflicted by Rama returned to Ravana and informed. Ravana sent dreadful Rakshasa by name Maricha, who assumed the form of deer with precious stones (on body) created a desire for it in Vaidehi."

shloka_text: तस्तेनार्दिताबालारावणंसमुपागता ।।6.129.21।। रावणानुचरोघोरोमारीचोनामराक्षसः । लोभयामासवैदेहींभूत्वारत्नमयोमृगः ।।6.129.22।।
transliteration: tastenārditābālārāvaṇaṃsamupāgatā  rāvaṇānucaroghoromārīconāmarākṣasaḥ | lobhayāmāsavaidehīṃbhūtvāratnamayomṛgaḥ
translation: ततः then, तेन by that, अर्दिता afflicted, बाला Surpanakha, रावणम् Ravana, समुपागता returning to, रावणानुचरः Ravana, घोरःdreadful, मारीचोनाम Maricha by name, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रत्नमयः precious stones, मृगः deer, भूत्वा assuming, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, लोभयामास desire for
explanation: "Then Surpanakha afflicted by Rama returned to Ravana and informed. Ravana sent dreadful Rakshasa by name Maricha, who assumed the form of deer with precious stones (on body) created a desire for it in Vaidehi."

shloka_text: साराममब्रवीदृष्टवावैदेसीगृह्यतामिति । अयंमनोहरःकान्तआश्रमोनोभविष्यति ।।6.129.23।।
transliteration: sārāmamabravīdṛṣṭavāvaidesīgṛhyatāmiti | ayaṃmanoharaḥkāntaāśramonobhaviṣyati
translation: सावैदेही she, Vaidehi, दृष्टवा seeing नः requested, आश्रमः hermitage, मनोहरः beautiful, कान्तः desired, भविष्यति will, अयम् this, गृह्यताम् taking, इति this, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: "Seeing that deer Vaidehi spoke to Rama to capture it as she desired and that it was beautiful and will make the hermitage bright."

shloka_text: ततोरामोधनुष्पाणिर्मृगंतमनुधावति । स तंजघानधावन्तंशरेणानतपर्वणा ।।6.129.24।।
transliteration: tatorāmodhanuṣpāṇirmṛgaṃtamanudhāvati | sa taṃjaghānadhāvantaṃśareṇānataparvaṇā
translation: ततः then, रामःRama, धनुष्पाणिः wielder of bow, तंमृगम् that deer, अनुधावति chased, सः he, धावन्तम् chasing, तम् that, आपतपर्वणा followed, शरेण by arrow, जघान attacked
explanation: "Rama, wielder of bow, chased the deer and followed it chasing and attacked with his arrow."

shloka_text: अथसौम्य दशग्रीवोमृगंयातेतुराघवे । लक्ष्मणेचापिनिष्क्रान्तेप्रविवेशाश्रमंतदा ।।6.129.25।।
transliteration: athasaumya daśagrīvomṛgaṃyāteturāghave | lakṣmaṇecāpiniṣkrāntepraviveśāśramaṃtadā
translation: सौम्य gentle, राघवे Raghava, मृगम् deer, याते went, लक्ष्मणेचापि and Lakshmana too, निष्क्रान्ते went from there, अथ and then, दशग्रीवः ten headed, तदा then, आश्रमम् hermitage, प्रविवेश entered
explanation: "When gentle Raghava went after the deer and Lakshmana also went from there, the ten headed Ravana entered the hermitage."

shloka_text: जग्राहतरसासीतांग्रहःखेरोहिणीमिव । त्रातुकामंततोयुद्धेहत्वागृध्रंजटायुषम् ।।6.129.26।। प्रगृह्यसहसासीतांजगामाशु स राक्षसः ।
transliteration: jagrāhatarasāsītāṃgrahaḥkherohiṇīmiva | trātukāmaṃtatoyuddhehatvāgṛdhraṃjaṭāyuṣam  pragṛhyasahasāsītāṃjagāmāśu sa rākṣasaḥ |
translation: खे in the sky, ग्रहः planet, रोहिणीमिव like Rohini, तरसा forcibly, सीताम् Sita, जग्राह caught, ततः then, त्रातुकामम् forcibly desiring her, जटायुषम् Jatayu, गृध्रम् vulture, युद्धे in combat, हत्वा killed, सःराक्षसः that Rakshasa, सीताम् Sita, प्रगृह्य seizing, सहसा rashly, आशु immediately, जगाम went
explanation: Seizing Sita by force like the planet Saturn seizing Rohini in the sky, that demon, having slain in combat the vulture Jatayu who sought to rescue her, swiftly and rashly carried her off.

shloka_text: तस्त्वद्भुतसङ्काशास्स्थिताःपर्वतमूर्धनि ।।6.129.27।। सीतांगृहीत्वागच्छन्तंवानराःपर्वतोपमाः । ददृशुर्मिस्मिताकारारावणंराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.129.28।।
transliteration: tastvadbhutasaṅkāśāssthitāḥparvatamūrdhani  sītāṃgṛhītvāgacchantaṃvānarāḥparvatopamāḥ | dadṛśurmismitākārārāvaṇaṃrākṣasādhipam
translation: ततः then, अद्भुतसङ्काशाः wonderful feat, पर्वतमूर्धनि from the top of the mountain, स्थिताःstood, पर्वतोपमाः mountain like, वानराःVanara, सीताम् Sita, गृहीत्वा being taken, गच्छन्तम् going, राक्षसाधिपम् Lord of Rakshasas, रावणम् Ravana, विस्मिताकाराः of wonderful form, ददृशुः saw
explanation: "Standing on the mountain top, the Vanaras who were like mountains in size watched the wonderful feat of the king of Rakshasas of wonderful form taking Sita."

shloka_text: तस्त्वद्भुतसङ्काशास्स्थिताःपर्वतमूर्धनि ।।6.129.27।। सीतांगृहीत्वागच्छन्तंवानराःपर्वतोपमाः । ददृशुर्मिस्मिताकारारावणंराक्षसाधिपम् ।।6.129.28।।
transliteration: tastvadbhutasaṅkāśāssthitāḥparvatamūrdhani  sītāṃgṛhītvāgacchantaṃvānarāḥparvatopamāḥ | dadṛśurmismitākārārāvaṇaṃrākṣasādhipam
translation: ततः then, अद्भुतसङ्काशाः wonderful feat, पर्वतमूर्धनि from the top of the mountain, स्थिताःstood, पर्वतोपमाः mountain like, वानराःVanara, सीताम् Sita, गृहीत्वा being taken, गच्छन्तम् going, राक्षसाधिपम् Lord of Rakshasas, रावणम् Ravana, विस्मिताकाराः of wonderful form, ददृशुः saw
explanation: "Standing on the mountain top, the Vanaras who were like mountains in size watched the wonderful feat of the king of Rakshasas of wonderful form taking Sita."

shloka_text: ततशीघ्रतरंगत्वातद्विमानंमनोजवम् । आरुह्यसहवैदेह्यापुष्पकं स महाबलः ।।6.129.29।। प्रविवेशतदालङ्कांरावणोराक्षसेश्वरः ।
transliteration: tataśīghrataraṃgatvātadvimānaṃmanojavam | āruhyasahavaidehyāpuṣpakaṃ sa mahābalaḥ  praviveśatadālaṅkāṃrāvaṇorākṣaseśvaraḥ |
translation: ततः then, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, महाबलः mighty, रावणः Ravana, शीघ्रतरम् swiftly, गत्वा going, मनोजवम् at the speed of mind, तत् that, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka aerial car, वैदेह्यासह with Vaidehi, आरुह्य ascended, तदा then, लङ्काम् Lanka, प्रविवेश entered
explanation: "Then the king of Rakshasas, mighty Ravana ascended with Vaidehi into the Pushpaka, an aerial car that went swiftly at the speed of the mind and entered Lanka."

shloka_text: तांसुवर्णपरिष्कारेशुभेमहतिवेश्मनि ।।6.129.30।। प्रवेश्यमैथिलींवाक्यैस्सान्त्वयामासरावणः ।
transliteration: tāṃsuvarṇapariṣkāreśubhemahativeśmani  praveśyamaithilīṃvākyaissāntvayāmāsarāvaṇaḥ |
translation: सःरावणः that Ravana, तांमैथिलीम् that Mythili, सुवर्णपरिष्कारे mansion with golden walls, शुभे auspicious, महति huge, वेश्मनि mansion, मैथिलीम् Mythili, प्रवेश्य entered, वाक्यैः good words, सान्त्वयामास consoled
explanation: "Ravana kept Mythili in an auspicious huge mansion with golden walls and consoled her with good words."

shloka_text: तृणवद्भाषितंतस्यतं च नैरृतपुङ्गवम् ।।6.129.31।। अचिन्तयन्तीवैदेहीह्यशोकवनिकांगता ।
transliteration: tṛṇavadbhāṣitaṃtasyataṃ ca nairṛtapuṅgavam  acintayantīvaidehīhyaśokavanikāṃgatā |
translation: वैदेही Vaidehi, तस्य his, भाषितम् talk, तम् him, नैरृतपुङ्गवं च chief of Rakshasas, तृणवत् like a straw, अचिन्तयन्ती without caring him, अशोकवनिकाम् in the Ashoka grove, गता stayed
explanation: "Vaidehi did not care to talk to the chief of Rakshasas. She ignored him like a straw and stayed in the Ashoka grove."

shloka_text: न्यवर्तततदारामोमृगंहत्वातदावने ।।6.129.32।। निवर्तमानःकाकुत्स्थोदृष्टवागृध्रं स विव्यथे । गृध्रंहतंतदादृष्टवारामःप्रियतरंपितुः ।।6.129.33।।
transliteration: nyavartatatadārāmomṛgaṃhatvātadāvane  nivartamānaḥkākutsthodṛṣṭavāgṛdhraṃ sa vivyathe | gṛdhraṃhataṃtadādṛṣṭavārāmaḥpriyataraṃpituḥ
translation: तदा then, रामः Rama, मृगम् deer, हत्वा killing, न्यवर्तत returned, तदा then, निवर्तमानः on his return, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, वने in the forest, गृध्रम् vulture, दृष्टवा seeing, विव्यथे attacked, तदा then, रामः Rama, पितुः father, प्रियतरम् dearer, गृध्रम् vulture, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seen
explanation: "Rama returned after killing the deer. On his return Kakuthsa saw in the forest, the vulture, who was dearer than his own father, killed."

shloka_text: न्यवर्तततदारामोमृगंहत्वातदावने ।।6.129.32।। निवर्तमानःकाकुत्स्थोदृष्टवागृध्रं स विव्यथे । गृध्रंहतंतदादृष्टवारामःप्रियतरंपितुः ।।6.129.33।।
transliteration: nyavartatatadārāmomṛgaṃhatvātadāvane  nivartamānaḥkākutsthodṛṣṭavāgṛdhraṃ sa vivyathe | gṛdhraṃhataṃtadādṛṣṭavārāmaḥpriyataraṃpituḥ
translation: तदा then, रामः Rama, मृगम् deer, हत्वा killing, न्यवर्तत returned, तदा then, निवर्तमानः on his return, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, वने in the forest, गृध्रम् vulture, दृष्टवा seeing, विव्यथे attacked, तदा then, रामः Rama, पितुः father, प्रियतरम् dearer, गृध्रम् vulture, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seen
explanation: "Rama returned after killing the deer. On his return Kakuthsa saw in the forest, the vulture, who was dearer than his own father, killed."

shloka_text: मार्गमाणस्तुवैदेहींराघवंसहलक्ष्मणः । गोदावरीमन्वचरद्वनोद्धेशांश्चपुष्पितान् ।।6.129.34।।
transliteration: mārgamāṇastuvaidehīṃrāghavaṃsahalakṣmaṇaḥ | godāvarīmanvacaradvanoddheśāṃścapuṣpitān
translation: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, मार्गमाणः searching, सहलक्ष्मणः with Lakshmana, रामः Rama, गोदावरीम् Godavari, पुष्पितान् blossomed, वनोद्देशांश्च ranged along the forest, अन्वचरत् went about
explanation: "Rama with Lakshmana went about searching, ranging along the banks of Godavari among the blossomed woods."

shloka_text: आसेदतुर्महारण्येकबन्धंनामराक्षसम् । ततःकबन्दवचनाद्रामस्सत्यपराक्रमः ।।6.129.35।। ऋष्यमूकगिरिंगत्वासुग्रीवेणसमागतः ।
transliteration: āsedaturmahāraṇyekabandhaṃnāmarākṣasam | tataḥkabandavacanādrāmassatyaparākramaḥ  ṛṣyamūkagiriṃgatvāsugrīveṇasamāgataḥ |
translation: महारण्ये in the huge forest, कबन्धंनाम by name Kabhanda, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, आसेदतुः while going, ततः then, सत्यपराक्रमः righteous and valiant, रामः Rama, कबन्धवचनात् Kabhanda's words, ऋष्यमूकगिरिम् Rshyamuka mountain, गत्वा went, सुग्रीवेण with Sugriva, समागतः met
explanation: "While going in the huge forest the valiant and truthful Rama saw a Rakshasa by the name Kabhanda. According to Kabhanda's words of advice they went to Rshyamuka mountain and met Sugriva."

shloka_text: तयोस्समागमःपूर्वंप्रीत्यहार्दोव्यजायत ।।6.129.36।। भ्रात्रानिरस्तःक्रुद्धेनसुग्रीवोवालिनापुरा । इतरेतरसंवादात्प्रगाढःप्रणयस्तयोः ।।6.129.37।।
transliteration: tayossamāgamaḥpūrvaṃprītyahārdovyajāyata  bhrātrānirastaḥkruddhenasugrīvovālināpurā | itaretarasaṃvādātpragāḍhaḥpraṇayastayoḥ
translation: पूर्वम् before, तयोः both, समागमः met, प्रीत्या affectionately, हार्दः happy at heart, व्यजायत developed, पुरा earlier, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, क्रुद्धेन enraged, भ्रात्रा brother, वालिना Vali, निरस्तः banished, इतरेतरसंवादात् mutual discussion, तयोः both, प्रणयः affection, प्रगाढः was deep
explanation: "Even before they met, they had a happy feeling at heart towards each other. Earlier Sugriva was banished by his enraged brother (Vali). On mutual talk and discussion, they both developed deep friendship."

shloka_text: तयोस्समागमःपूर्वंप्रीत्यहार्दोव्यजायत ।।6.129.36।। भ्रात्रानिरस्तःक्रुद्धेनसुग्रीवोवालिनापुरा । इतरेतरसंवादात्प्रगाढःप्रणयस्तयोः ।।6.129.37।।
transliteration: tayossamāgamaḥpūrvaṃprītyahārdovyajāyata  bhrātrānirastaḥkruddhenasugrīvovālināpurā | itaretarasaṃvādātpragāḍhaḥpraṇayastayoḥ
translation: पूर्वम् before, तयोः both, समागमः met, प्रीत्या affectionately, हार्दः happy at heart, व्यजायत developed, पुरा earlier, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, क्रुद्धेन enraged, भ्रात्रा brother, वालिना Vali, निरस्तः banished, इतरेतरसंवादात् mutual discussion, तयोः both, प्रणयः affection, प्रगाढः was deep
explanation: "Even before they met, they had a happy feeling at heart towards each other. Earlier Sugriva was banished by his enraged brother (Vali). On mutual talk and discussion, they both developed deep friendship."

shloka_text: रामस्स्वबाहुवीर्येणस्वराज्यंप्रत्यपादयत् । वालिनंसमरेहत्वामहाकायंमहाबलम् ।।6.129.38।।
transliteration: rāmassvabāhuvīryeṇasvarājyaṃpratyapādayat | vālinaṃsamarehatvāmahākāyaṃmahābalam
translation: रामः Rama, स्वबाहुवीर्येण might of his arms, महाकायम् gigantic body, महाबलम् mighty prowess, वालिनम् Vali, समरे in combat, हत्वा killed, स्वराज्यम् his kingdom, प्रत्यपादयत् restored
explanation: "Rama of mighty arms killed Vali of gigantic body and mighty prowess and restored Sugriva's own kingdom to him."

shloka_text: सुग्रीवस्स्थापितोराज्येसहितस्सर्ववानरैः । रामायप्रतिजानीतेराजपुत्य्रास्तुमार्गणम् ।।6.129.39।।
transliteration: sugrīvassthāpitorājyesahitassarvavānaraiḥ | rāmāyapratijānīterājaputyrāstumārgaṇam
translation: राज्ये kingdom, स्थापितः established, सर्ववानरैःall Vanaras, सहितः together, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, रामाय Rama's, राजपुत्य्राः kingdom attained, मार्गणम् search, प्रतिजानीते promised to find
explanation: "Sugriva attained the kingdom and established. He promised to search with all Vanaras and promised to find Sita."

shloka_text: अदिष्टावानरेन्द्रेणसुग्रीवेणमहात्मना । दशकोट्यःप्लवङ्गानांसर्वाःप्रस्थापिताःदिशः ।।6.129.40।।
transliteration: adiṣṭāvānarendreṇasugrīveṇamahātmanā | daśakoṭyaḥplavaṅgānāṃsarvāḥprasthāpitāḥdiśaḥ
translation: महात्मना great soul, वानरेन्द्रेण Vanara Lord, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, आदिष्टाः ordered, प्लवङ्गनाम् the monkeys, दशकोट्यः all countries, सर्वाः all, दिशः directions, प्रस्थापिताः dispatched
explanation: "Vanara Lord Sugriva ordered the monkeys to go to all countries and all directions and dispatched them to find Sita."

shloka_text: तेषांनोविप्रनष्टानांविन्ध्येपर्वतसत्तमो । भृशंशोकानितप्तानांमहान्कालो त्यवर्तत ।।6.129.41।।
transliteration: teṣāṃnovipranaṣṭānāṃvindhyeparvatasattamo | bhṛśaṃśokānitaptānāṃmahānkālo tyavartata
translation: पर्वतसत्तमे foremost of mountains, विन्ध्ये Vindhya, विप्रनष्टानाम् lost way, भृशम् intense, शोकाभितप्तानाम् immersed in grief, तेषांनः their, महान् lot of, कालः time, अत्यवर्तत returned
explanation: "Monkeys that went to the foremost of mountains Vindhya lost their way and a lot of time and returned with intense grief."

shloka_text: भ्रातातुगृध्रराजस्यसम्पातिर्नामवीर्यवान् । समाख्यातिस्मवसतींसीतांरावणमन्दिरे ।।6.129.42।।
transliteration: bhrātātugṛdhrarājasyasampātirnāmavīryavān | samākhyātismavasatīṃsītāṃrāvaṇamandire
translation: गृध्रराजस्य vulture king's, भ्राता brother, वीर्यवान् valiant, सम्पातिर्नाम called Sampathi, सीताम् Sita, रावणमन्दिरे in Ravana's mansion, वसतीम् dwelling, समाख्यातिस्म told positively
explanation: "Vulture king's brother called Sampathi told the Vanaras positively that Sita is dwelling in Ravana's mansion."

shloka_text: सोहंदुःखपरीतानांदुःखंतद् ज्ञातीनांनुदन् । आत्मवीर्यंसमास्थाययोजनानांशतंप्लुतः ।।6.129.43।।
transliteration: sohaṃduḥkhaparītānāṃduḥkhaṃtad jñātīnāṃnudan | ātmavīryaṃsamāsthāyayojanānāṃśataṃplutaḥ
translation: सःअहम् I, दुःखपरीतानाम् to dispel their grief, ज्ञातीनाम् of the Vanaras, तत् that, दुःखम् grief, नुदन् to relieve, आत्मवीर्यम् selfvalour, समास्थाय resorting to, योजनानाम् yojanas, शतम् hundred, प्लुतः leapt
explanation: "To dispel the grief of the Vanaras and relieve them, I resorted to my valour and leapt a hundred yojanas."

shloka_text: तत्राहमेकामद्राक्षमशोकवनिकांगताम् । कौशेयवस्त्रांमलिनांनिरनन्दांदृढव्रताम् ।।6.129.44।।
transliteration: tatrāhamekāmadrākṣamaśokavanikāṃgatām | kauśeyavastrāṃmalināṃniranandāṃdṛḍhavratām
translation: तत्र there, अहम् I, अशोकवनिकाम् at Ashoka grove, गताम् having gone, कौशेयवस्त्राम् wearing unclean silk clothes, मलिनाम् dirty in body, निरानन्दाम् devoid of happiness, दृढव्रताम् determined, एकाम् alone, अद्राक्षम् saw
explanation: "There at Ashoka Grove, I saw her wearing unclean silk clothes, dirty in body, devoid of happiness, determined and staying alone."

shloka_text: तयासमेत्यविधिवत् पृष्टवासर्वमनिन्दिताम् । अभिज्ञानंमयादत्तंरामनामाङ्गुलीयकम् ।।6.129.45।।
transliteration: tayāsametyavidhivat pṛṣṭavāsarvamaninditām | abhijñānaṃmayādattaṃrāmanāmāṅgulīyakam
translation: तया like that, समेत्य meeting, अनिन्दिताम् irreproachable lady, सर्वम् all, विधिवत् duly enquiring, पृष्टवा delighted, रामनामाङ्गुलीयकम् ring with Rama's name, अभिज्ञानम् as a token, मया to me, दत्तम् gave
explanation: "Met that irreproachable lady like that and duly enquired everything, delighted Mythili gave me a ring with Rama's name as a token to be given to Sri Rama."

shloka_text: अभिज्ञानंमणिंलब्द्वाचरितार्धो हमागतः । मया च पुनरागम्यरामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः ।।6.129.46।। अभिज्ञानंमयादत्तमर्चिष्मान् स महामणिः ।
transliteration: abhijñānaṃmaṇiṃlabdvācaritārdho hamāgataḥ | mayā ca punarāgamyarāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ  abhijñānaṃmayādattamarciṣmān sa mahāmaṇiḥ |
translation: अहम् I, मणिम् jewel, अभिज्ञानम् knowing, लब्द्वा got, चरितार्थः accomplished, आगतः returned, मया me, पुनः again, आगम्य on return, अर्चिष्मान् valuable, सः he, महामणिः that great jewel, अभिज्ञानम् recognising, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः most difficult task, रामस्य to Rama, मया me, दत्तम् gave
explanation: "Knowing that the most difficult task has been accomplished, again I returned and gave the valuable jewel to Rama."

shloka_text: श्रुत्वातांमैथिलींरामस्त्वाशशंसे च जीवितम् ।।6.129.47।। जीवितान्तमनुप्राप्तःपीत्वामृतमिवातुरः ।
transliteration: śrutvātāṃmaithilīṃrāmastvāśaśaṃse ca jīvitam  jīvitāntamanuprāptaḥpītvāmṛtamivāturaḥ |
translation: रामस्तु Rama also, तांमैथिलीम् about Mythili, श्रुत्वा hearing, जीवितान्तम् end of life, अनुप्राप्तः having heard of Mythili, आतुरः ailing man, अमृतम् nectar, पीत्वेव as if drunk, जीवितम् life, आशशंसे regained hope of life
explanation: "Just as an ailing man at the end of life regains hope on drinking nectar, Sri Rama also gains hope on hearing about Mythili."

shloka_text: उद्योजयिष्यन्नुद्योगंदध्रेकामंवधेमनः ।।6.129.48।। जिघांसुरिवलोकान्तेसर्वान्लोकान्विभावसुः ।
transliteration: udyojayiṣyannudyogaṃdadhrekāmaṃvadhemanaḥ  jighāṃsurivalokāntesarvānlokānvibhāvasuḥ |
translation: उद्योगम् war effort, उद्योजयिष्यन् to win war, लोकान्ते at the end of dissolution of the world, सर्वान् all, लोकान् worlds, जिघांसुः to conquest, विभावसुःइव like the destruction of the worlds, लङ्कावधे for the destruction of Lanka, मनः mind, दध्रे to burn
explanation: "Rama made war efforts to win the war for the destruction of Lanka just as fire burns at the dissolution of the worlds and to conquer Ravana."

shloka_text: ततस्समुद्रमासाद्यनलंसेतुमकारयत् ।।6.129.49।। अतरत्कपिवीराणां वाहिनी तेन सेतुना ।
transliteration: tatassamudramāsādyanalaṃsetumakārayat  ataratkapivīrāṇāṃ vāhinī tena setunā |
translation: ततः then, समुद्रम् ocean, आसाद्य reached, नलम् Nala, सेतुम् bridge, अकारयत् constructed, कपिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, वाहिनी troops, तेनसेतुना by that bridge, अतरत् crossed
explanation: "Then Nala constructed the bridge, and the monkey heroes crossed the bridge."

shloka_text: प्रहस्तम्वधीन्नीलःकुम्भकर्णंतुराघवः ।।6.129.50।। लक्ष्मणोरावणसुतंस्वयंरामस्तुरावणम् ।
transliteration: prahastamvadhīnnīlaḥkumbhakarṇaṃturāghavaḥ  lakṣmaṇorāvaṇasutaṃsvayaṃrāmasturāvaṇam |
translation: नीलः Nila, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, अवधीत् killed, राघवः Raghava, रामः Rama, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, रावणम् Ravana, स्वयम् himself, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रावणसुतम् Ravana's son
explanation: "Prahastha was killed by Nila. Rama killed Kumbhakarna. Lakshmana killed Indrajith, the son of Ravana."

shloka_text: सशक्रेणसमागम्ययमेनवरुणेन च ।।6.129.51।। महेश्वरस्वयंभूभ्यां तथा दशरथेन च । तैश्चदत्तवर्श्रीमानृषिभिश्चसमागतैः ।।6.129.52।। सुरर्षिभिश्चकाकुत्स्थोवरान्लेभेपरन्तपः ।
transliteration: saśakreṇasamāgamyayamenavaruṇena ca  maheśvarasvayaṃbhūbhyāṃ tathā daśarathena ca | taiścadattavarśrīmānṛṣibhiścasamāgataiḥ  surarṣibhiścakākutsthovarānlebheparantapaḥ |
translation: परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, श्रीमान् glorious, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, शक्रेण by Indra, यमेन Yama, वरुणेन च and Varuna, महेश्वरस्वयंभूभ्याम् Maheswara, Brahma themselves, तथा so also, दशरथेन च Dasharatha, समागम्य reached, तैः they, दत्तवरः bestowed boon, समागतैः on reaching, ऋषिभिः sages, सुरर्षिभिशळ्च Ascetics and Suras, वरान् boons, लेभे conferred
explanation: "Then to the glorious Kakuthsa, the tormentor of enemies, Indra, Yama, and Varuna bestowed boons, so also Maheswara and Brahma, Dasharatha also reached and bestowed boons on Rama. Ascetics and suras also conferred boons."

shloka_text: सशक्रेणसमागम्ययमेनवरुणेन च ।।6.129.51।। महेश्वरस्वयंभूभ्यां तथा दशरथेन च । तैश्चदत्तवर्श्रीमानृषिभिश्चसमागतैः ।।6.129.52।। सुरर्षिभिश्चकाकुत्स्थोवरान्लेभेपरन्तपः ।
transliteration: saśakreṇasamāgamyayamenavaruṇena ca  maheśvarasvayaṃbhūbhyāṃ tathā daśarathena ca | taiścadattavarśrīmānṛṣibhiścasamāgataiḥ  surarṣibhiścakākutsthovarānlebheparantapaḥ |
translation: परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, श्रीमान् glorious, काकुत्स्थ: Kakuthsa, शक्रेण by Indra, यमेन Yama, वरुणेन च and Varuna, महेश्वरस्वयंभूभ्याम् Maheswara, Brahma themselves, तथा so also, दशरथेन च Dasharatha, समागम्य reached, तैः they, दत्तवरः bestowed boon, समागतैः on reaching, ऋषिभिः sages, सुरर्षिभिशळ्च Ascetics and Suras, वरान् boons, लेभे conferred
explanation: "Then to the glorious Kakuthsa, the tormentor of enemies, Indra, Yama, and Varuna bestowed boons, so also Maheswara and Brahma, Dasharatha also reached and bestowed boons on Rama. Ascetics and suras also conferred boons."

shloka_text: सतुदत्तवरःप्रीत्यावानरैश्चसमागतः ।।6.129.53।। पुष्पकेनविमानेनकिष्किनष्धामभ्युपागमत् ।
transliteration: satudattavaraḥprītyāvānaraiścasamāgataḥ  puṣpakenavimānenakiṣkinaṣdhāmabhyupāgamat |
translation: प्रीत्या affectionately, दत्तवरः having received boons, सःतु, he too वानरैः च and Vanaras, समागतः collected together, पुष्पकेनविमानेन by Pushpaka aerial car, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, अभ्युपागमत् reached
explanation: "Having received boons, Rama with the Vanaras collected together reached Kishkinda by Pushpaka aerial car."

shloka_text: तंगङ्गांपुनारासाद्यवसन्तंमुनिसन्निधौ ।।6.129.54।। अविघ्नंपुष्ययोगेनश्वोरामंद्रष्टुमर्हसि ।
transliteration: taṃgaṅgāṃpunārāsādyavasantaṃmunisannidhau  avighnaṃpuṣyayogenaśvorāmaṃdraṣṭumarhasi |
translation: गङ्गाम् Ganga, पुनः again, आसाद्य reached, मुनिसन्निधौ abode of sage, वसन्तम् staying, तंरामम् he, Rama, पुष्ययोगेन in the Pushya star is in union with moon, अविघ्नम् without any obstruction, श्वः yourself, द्रष्टुम् be able to see, अर्हसि ought to
explanation: "He reached the bank of Ganga and is staying at the hermitage of sage. Tomorrow at the time when Pushya star is in union with the moon you will be able to see Rama without any obstruction."

shloka_text: श्रुत्वातुपरमानन्दंभरतस्सत्यविक्रमः । हृष्टमाज्ञापयामासशत्रुघ्नंपरवीरहा ।।6.130.1।।
transliteration: śrutvātuparamānandaṃbharatassatyavikramaḥ | hṛṣṭamājñāpayāmāsaśatrughnaṃparavīrahā
translation: सत्यविक्रमः truthful prowess, परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, भरतः Bharata, परमानन्दम् very happy, श्रुत्वा hearingतु you, हृष्टम् delightful, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, आज्ञापयामास ordered
explanation: Hearing the delightful news, Bharata of truthful prowess, the destroyer of enemies, was very happy and ordered Shatrughna.
comments: Arrangements at Ayodhya to receive Sri Rama. Bharata goes to receive him.

shloka_text: दैवतानि च सर्वाणिचैत्यानिनगरस्य च । सुगन्धमाल्यैर्यादित्रैरर्चन्तु शुचयो नराः ।।6.130.2।।
transliteration: daivatāni ca sarvāṇicaityāninagarasya ca | sugandhamālyairyāditrairarcantu śucayo narāḥ
translation: सर्वाणि all, दैवतानि gods, नगरस्य in the capital, चैत्यानि च temples, शुचयः purifying, नराः people, सुगन्धमाल्यैः with fragrance and garlands, वादित्रैः musical instruments अर्चन्तु worship
explanation: "Let all gods in the temples of the capital be worshiped by people purifying themselves, duly adorned with fragrance and garlands."

shloka_text: सूतास्स्तुतिपुराणज्ञास्सर्वेवैतालिकास्तथा । सर्वेवादित्रकुशलागणिकाश्चैवसङ्घशः ।।6.130.3।। राजदारास्तथामात्यास्सैन्यास्सेनाङ्गनागणाः । ब्राह्मणाश्चसराजन्याश्रेणिमुख्यास्तथागणाः ।।6.130.4।। अभिनिर्यान्तुरामस्यद्रष्टुंशशिनिभंमुखम् ।
transliteration: sūtāsstutipurāṇajñāssarvevaitālikāstathā | sarvevāditrakuśalāgaṇikāścaivasaṅghaśaḥ  rājadārāstathāmātyāssainyāssenāṅganāgaṇāḥ | brāhmaṇāścasarājanyāśreṇimukhyāstathāgaṇāḥ  abhiniryānturāmasyadraṣṭuṃśaśinibhaṃmukham |
translation: स्तुतिपुराणज्ञाः bards well versed in singing, सूताः charioteers, तथा so also, सर्वे all, वैताळिकाः courtesans, सर्वे all, वादित्रकुशलाः experts in playing musical instruments, सङ्घशः, in groups गणिकाः traders, राजदाराः royal, तथा similarly, अमात्याः ministers, सैन्याः army, सेवाङ्गनागणाः service providers, सराजन्याः kshatriyas, ब्राह्मणाश्च brahmins, श्रेणीमुख्याः top people, तथा so also, गणाः troops, रामस्य Rama's, शशिनिभम् moon like countenance, मुखम् face, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभिनिर्यान्तु will proceed
explanation: "Let the bards well versed in singing praises, charioteers, all courtesans, in groups, artists who can play musical instruments, similarly ministers, army men, traders, service providers, Kshatriyas, brahmins so also top people, troops proceed to see the moon like face of Rama."

shloka_text: सूतास्स्तुतिपुराणज्ञास्सर्वेवैतालिकास्तथा । सर्वेवादित्रकुशलागणिकाश्चैवसङ्घशः ।।6.130.3।। राजदारास्तथामात्यास्सैन्यास्सेनाङ्गनागणाः । ब्राह्मणाश्चसराजन्याश्रेणिमुख्यास्तथागणाः ।।6.130.4।। अभिनिर्यान्तुरामस्यद्रष्टुंशशिनिभंमुखम् ।
transliteration: sūtāsstutipurāṇajñāssarvevaitālikāstathā | sarvevāditrakuśalāgaṇikāścaivasaṅghaśaḥ  rājadārāstathāmātyāssainyāssenāṅganāgaṇāḥ | brāhmaṇāścasarājanyāśreṇimukhyāstathāgaṇāḥ  abhiniryānturāmasyadraṣṭuṃśaśinibhaṃmukham |
translation: स्तुतिपुराणज्ञाः bards well versed in singing, सूताः charioteers, तथा so also, सर्वे all, वैताळिकाः courtesans, सर्वे all, वादित्रकुशलाः experts in playing musical instruments, सङ्घशः, in groups गणिकाः traders, राजदाराः royal, तथा similarly, अमात्याः ministers, सैन्याः army, सेवाङ्गनागणाः service providers, सराजन्याः kshatriyas, ब्राह्मणाश्च brahmins, श्रेणीमुख्याः top people, तथा so also, गणाः troops, रामस्य Rama's, शशिनिभम् moon like countenance, मुखम् face, द्रष्टुम् to see, अभिनिर्यान्तु will proceed
explanation: "Let the bards well versed in singing praises, charioteers, all courtesans, in groups, artists who can play musical instruments, similarly ministers, army men, traders, service providers, Kshatriyas, brahmins so also top people, troops proceed to see the moon like face of Rama."

shloka_text: भरतस्यवच्श्रुत्वाशत्रुघ्नःपरवीरहा ।।6.130.5।। विष्टीरनेकसाहस्रीश्चोदयामानभागशः ।
transliteration: bharatasyavacśrutvāśatrughnaḥparavīrahā  viṣṭīranekasāhasrīścodayāmānabhāgaśaḥ |
translation: परवीरहा destroyer of enemies, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, अनेकसाहस्रीः many courageous, विष्टीः labour, भागशः divisions, चोदयामास be also called
explanation: Shatrughna, a destroyer of enemies, hearing the words of Bharata, ordered for many divisions of labour and the courageous ones to come.

shloka_text: समीकुरुतनिम्नानिविषमानिसमानि च ।।6.130.6।। स्थानानितुनिरस्यन्तांनन्दिग्रामादितःपरम् ।
transliteration: samīkurutanimnāniviṣamānisamāni ca  sthānānitunirasyantāṃnandigrāmāditaḥparam |
translation: इतः from here, नन्दिग्रामात् from Nandigrama, परम् very, निम्नानि low lying, समीकुरुत equal, विषमाणि uneven, समानि च level, स्थानानि areas, निरस्यन्ताम् remove them.
explanation: From here (Nandigrama to Ayodhya) low lying areas are to be made even and uneven areas to be levelled.

shloka_text: सिञ्चस्तुपृथिवींकृत्स्नांहिवशीतेववारिणा ।।6.130.7।। ततोऽभ्यवकिरन्त्वन्येलाजैःपुष्पैश्चसर्वतः ।
transliteration: siñcastupṛthivīṃkṛtsnāṃhivaśītevavāriṇā  tato'bhyavakirantvanyelājaiḥpuṣpaiścasarvataḥ |
translation: कृत्स्नाम् in the ground, पृथिवीम् soil, हिमशीतेव with cold water, वारिणा water, सिञ्चस्तु sprinkle small drops, ततः then, अन्ये other, सर्वतः all over, लाजैः parched grain, पुष्पैश्च flowers, अभ्यवकिरन्तु strew
explanation: Let the ground be sprinkled with cold water and then parched grain and flowers to be sprinkled.

shloka_text: सुमुच्छ्रितपताकास्तुरथ्याःपुरवरोत्तमेः ।।6.130.8।। शोभयन्तु च वेश्मानिसूर्यस्योदयनंप्रति ।
transliteration: sumucchritapatākāsturathyāḥpuravarottameḥ  śobhayantu ca veśmānisūryasyodayanaṃprati |
translation: पुरवरोत्तमे best of the foremost cities, रथ्याः streets, समुच्छ्रितपताकाः with flags, सूर्यस्य sun's, उदयनंप्रति till the rise, वेश्मानि houses, शोभयन्तु decorate.
explanation: Let the streets of the foremost of the best cities (Ayodhya), be decorated with flags till the sun rises and houses be decorated.

shloka_text: स्रग्दाममुक्तपुष्पैश्चसुगन्धै: पञ्चवर्णकैः ।।6.130.9।। राजमार्गमसम्बाधंकिरन्तुशतशोनराः ।
transliteration: sragdāmamuktapuṣpaiścasugandhai: pañcavarṇakaiḥ  rājamārgamasambādhaṃkirantuśataśonarāḥ |
translation: शतशः hundreds, नराः people, सुगन्धैः fragrant, पञ्चवर्णकैः five colours, स्रग्दाममुक्तपुष्पैश्च garlands of fragrant flowers, असम्बाधम् closely, राजमार्गम् royal paths, किरन्तु decorate.
explanation: Let hundreds of people decorate with fragrant garlands of five colours closely tied and decorate the royal paths.

shloka_text: तस्तच्छासनंश्रुत्वाशत्रुघ्नस्यमुदान्विताः ।।6.130.10।। धृष्टिर्जयन्तोविजयस्सिद्धार्थश्चार्थसाधकः । अशोकोमन्त्रपालश्चसुमन्त्रश्चापिनिर्ययुः ।।6.130.11।।
transliteration: tastacchāsanaṃśrutvāśatrughnasyamudānvitāḥ  dhṛṣṭirjayantovijayassiddhārthaścārthasādhakaḥ | aśokomantrapālaścasumantraścāpiniryayuḥ
translation: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna's, तत् that, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा hearing, मुदा joy अन्विताः great, धृष्टिः Dhristi, जयन्तः Jayanta, विजयःVijaya, सिद्धार्थश्च Siddhartha, अर्थसाधकः Arthasadhaka, अशोकः Ashoka, मन्त्रपालश्च Mantrapala, समन्त्रश्चापि all over, निर्ययुः issued forth.
explanation: On hearing Shatrughna's command, all the eight ministers, Dhristi, Jayanta, Vijaya, Siddhartha, Arthasadhaka, Ashoka, and Mantrapala issued forth with great joy.

shloka_text: तस्तच्छासनंश्रुत्वाशत्रुघ्नस्यमुदान्विताः ।।6.130.10।। धृष्टिर्जयन्तोविजयस्सिद्धार्थश्चार्थसाधकः । अशोकोमन्त्रपालश्चसुमन्त्रश्चापिनिर्ययुः ।।6.130.11।।
transliteration: tastacchāsanaṃśrutvāśatrughnasyamudānvitāḥ  dhṛṣṭirjayantovijayassiddhārthaścārthasādhakaḥ | aśokomantrapālaścasumantraścāpiniryayuḥ
translation: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नस्य Shatrughna's, तत् that, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा hearing, मुदा joy अन्विताः great, धृष्टिः Dhristi, जयन्तः Jayanta, विजयःVijaya, सिद्धार्थश्च Siddhartha, अर्थसाधकः Arthasadhaka, अशोकः Ashoka, मन्त्रपालश्च Mantrapala, समन्त्रश्चापि all over, निर्ययुः issued forth.
explanation: On hearing Shatrughna's command, all the eight ministers, Dhristi, Jayanta, Vijaya, Siddhartha, Arthasadhaka, Ashoka, and Mantrapala issued forth with great joy.

shloka_text: मत्तैर्नागसहस्रैश्चसध्वजैस्सुविभूषितैः । अपरेहेमकक्षाभिस्सगजाभिःकरेणुभिः ।।6.130.12।। निर्ययुस्तुररथैश्चसुमहारथाः ।
transliteration: mattairnāgasahasraiścasadhvajaissuvibhūṣitaiḥ | aparehemakakṣābhissagajābhiḥkareṇubhiḥ  niryayusturarathaiścasumahārathāḥ |
translation: मत्स्सैः elephants in rut, सध्वजैः best horses, सुविभूषितैः well decorated, नागसहस्रैः thousand elephants, अपरेतु on the top, हेमकक्षाभिः golden girths on waist, सगजाभिः those elephants, करेणुभिः female elephants also, सुमहारथाः best charioteers, रथैश्च chariots, निर्ययुः proceeded.
explanation: Seated on top of thousands of well decorated elephants in rut, and on the best of horses, people went (to receive Rama). Female elephants had golden girths on their waist. Best charioteers on best chariots proceeded.

shloka_text: शक्त्यृष्टिपाशहस्तानांसध्वजानांपताकिनाम् ।।6.130.13।। तुरगाणांसहस्रैश्चमुख्यैर्मुख्यतरान्वितैः । पदातीनांसहस्रैश्चवीराःपरिवृताययुः ।।6.130.14।।
transliteration: śaktyṛṣṭipāśahastānāṃsadhvajānāṃpatākinām  turagāṇāṃsahasraiścamukhyairmukhyatarānvitaiḥ | padātīnāṃsahasraiścavīrāḥparivṛtāyayuḥ
translation: तुरगाणाम् horses, मुख्यैः chiefs, मुख्यतरान्वितैः champions, सहस्रैः in thousands, परिवृताः surrounded, वीराः heroes, ययुःwent, क्त्यृष्टिपाशहस्तानां with javelins, spears and nooses, सध्वजानां people, पताकिनाम् carrying flags, पदातीनां on foot, वीराः heroes,
explanation: Chiefs on horses, champions in thousands went surrounded by thousands of foot soldiers carrying javelins, spears, and nooses.

shloka_text: शक्त्यृष्टिपाशहस्तानांसध्वजानांपताकिनाम् ।।6.130.13।। तुरगाणांसहस्रैश्चमुख्यैर्मुख्यतरान्वितैः । पदातीनांसहस्रैश्चवीराःपरिवृताययुः ।।6.130.14।।
transliteration: śaktyṛṣṭipāśahastānāṃsadhvajānāṃpatākinām  turagāṇāṃsahasraiścamukhyairmukhyatarānvitaiḥ | padātīnāṃsahasraiścavīrāḥparivṛtāyayuḥ
translation: तुरगाणाम् horses, मुख्यैः chiefs, मुख्यतरान्वितैः champions, सहस्रैः in thousands, परिवृताः surrounded, वीराः heroes, ययुःwent, क्त्यृष्टिपाशहस्तानां with javelins, spears and nooses, सध्वजानां people, पताकिनाम् carrying flags, पदातीनां on foot, वीराः heroes,
explanation: Chiefs on horses, champions in thousands went surrounded by thousands of foot soldiers carrying javelins, spears, and nooses.

shloka_text: ततोयानान्युपारूढास्सर्वादशरथस्त्रियः । कौसल्यांप्रमुखेकृत्वासुमित्रांचापिनिर्ययुः ।।6.130.15।। कैकेय्यासहिताःसर्वानन्दिग्राममुपागमन् ।
transliteration: tatoyānānyupārūḍhāssarvādaśarathastriyaḥ | kausalyāṃpramukhekṛtvāsumitrāṃcāpiniryayuḥ  kaikeyyāsahitāḥsarvānandigrāmamupāgaman |
translation: ततः then, सर्वाःall, दशरथस्त्रियः women of Dasharatha, यानानि palanquins, उपारूढाः seated, कौसल्याम् Kausalya, सुमित्रांचापि Sumitra, प्रमुखेकृत्वा keeping in front, निर्ययुः started, सर्वाः all, कैकेय्या Kaikeyi, सहिताः accompanied by, नन्दिग्रामम् Nandigrama, उपाययुः went
explanation: Then all the consorts of Dasharatha, keeping Kausalya and Sumitra in front, seated in palanquin accompanied by Kaikeyi, started from Nandigram.

shloka_text: द्विजातिमुख्यैर्धर्मात्माश्रेणीमुख्यैस्सनैगमैः ।।6.130.16।। माल्यमोदकहस्तैश्चमन्त्रिभिर्भरतोवृतः । शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्चवन्दिभिश्चाभिवनन्दितः ।।6.130.17।। आर्यपादौगृहीत्वातौशिरसाधर्मकोविदः । पाण्डुरंछत्रमादायशुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम् ।।6.130.18।। शुक्ले च वालव्यजनेराजार्हेहेमभूषिते । उपवासकृशोदीनश्चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः ।।6.130.19।। भ्रातुरागमनंश्रुत्वातत्पूर्वंहर्षमागतः । प्रत्युद्ययौतदारामंमहात्मासचिवैस्सह ।।6.130.20।।
transliteration: dvijātimukhyairdharmātmāśreṇīmukhyaissanaigamaiḥ  mālyamodakahastaiścamantribhirbharatovṛtaḥ | śaṅkhabherīninādaiścavandibhiścābhivananditaḥ  āryapādaugṛhītvātauśirasādharmakovidaḥ | pāṇḍuraṃchatramādāyaśuklamālyopaśobhitam  śukle ca vālavyajanerājārhehemabhūṣite | upavāsakṛśodīnaścīrakṛṣṇājināmbaraḥ  bhrāturāgamanaṃśrutvātatpūrvaṃharṣamāgataḥ | pratyudyayautadārāmaṃmahātmāsacivaissaha
translation: द्विजातिमुख्यैः foremost of brahmins, सनैगमैः together, श्रेणीमुख्यैश्च foremost leaders, माल्यमोदकहस्तै: having garlands and Modakas (kind of sweet which is white in colour) in hand, मन्त्रिभिः ministers also, वृतः surrounded, धर्मात्मा righteous, शङ्खभेरीनिनादैश्च with sounds of conches and drums, वन्दिभिश्च with bards praising, अभिनन्तितः greeting, धर्मकोविदः knowledgeable of responsibilities, उपवासकृशः emaciated by fasting, दीनः desperate, चीरकृष्णाजिनाम्बरः wearing bark clothes and a skin of antelope, भ्रातुः brother, आगमनम् returning, श्रुत्वा hearing, तत्पूर्वम् before that, हर्षम् joy, आगतः experienced, महात्मा great soul, भरतः Bharata, आर्यपादौ sandals of noble Rama, शिरसा on head, गृहीत्वा taking, शुक्लमाल्योपशोभितम् decorated with white garlands, पाण्डुरम् yellow, छत्रम् umbrella, राजार्हे worthy of kings, हेमभूषिते adorned with gold, शुक्ले white, वालव्यजने whisks, आदाय taking, सचिवैःसह with friends, तदा then, प्रत्युद्ययौ went to receive
explanation: Then the foremost of brahmins, leaders with garlands and Modaka sweets in hand, surrounded by ministers went with righteous Bharata, accompanied by bards praising, accompanied by sounds of blowing conches and drums and greeting. Bharata was emaciated due to fastings, was desperate, wearing bark fabric and skin of antelope. The great soul Bharata, knower of righteous responsibilities, greeting, experienced great joy, on hearing about the returning of the brother. Decorated with white garlands, he carried Rama's sandals on his head. His friends accompanied him and took with him a yellow umbrella adorned with gold, worthy of kings and white whisks. Bharata went to receive Sri Rama.
