shloka_text: अश्वानांखुरशब्दैश्चरथनेमिस्वनेन च । शङ्खदुन्दुभिनादेनसञ्चचालेवमेदिनी ।।6.130.21।।
transliteration: aśvānāṃkhuraśabdaiścarathanemisvanena ca | śaṅkhadundubhinādenasañcacālevamedinī
translation: अश्वानाम् of the horses, खुरशब्देन by the sounds hoofs, रथनेमिस्वनेनच rattling of the chariots, शङ्खदुन्दुभिघोषेण by the sounds of drums and conches, मेदिनी earth, सञ्चचालेव shook
explanation: The earth shook by the sounds of hooves of the horses, sounds of conches and drums, and the rattling of the chariot wheels.

shloka_text: कृत्स्नंतुनगरंतत्तुनन्दिग्राममुपागमत् । समीक्ष्यभरतोवाक्यमुवाचपवनात्मजम् ।।6.130.22।।
transliteration: kṛtsnaṃtunagaraṃtattunandigrāmamupāgamat | samīkṣyabharatovākyamuvācapavanātmajam
translation: तत् then, कृत्स्नम् dark, नगरम् city, नन्दिग्रामम् Nandigramam, उपागमत् reached, भरतः Bharata, समीक्ष्य reviewed, पवनात्मजम् with wind god's son, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke
explanation: Reviewing the arrangements, Bharata spoke these words to wind god's son, Hanuman.

shloka_text: कच्चिन्नखलुकापेयीसेव्यतेचकचित्तता । न हिपश्यामिकाकुत्स्थंराममार्यंपरन्तपम् ।।6.130.23।।
transliteration: kaccinnakhalukāpeyīsevyatecakacittatā | na hipaśyāmikākutsthaṃrāmamāryaṃparantapam
translation: कापेयी O monkey, चलचित्तता fickle minded, न सेव्यतेखलु not resorted, कच्चित् indeed, काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, परन्तपम् tormentor of enemies, आर्यम् noble, रामम् Rama, न पश्यामिहि not see
explanation: "O monkey! Indeed, you monkey being fickle minded, hope you have not resorted to your nature. I am not seeing noble Rama, the tormentor of enemies."

shloka_text: अथैवमुक्तेवचनेहनूमानिदमब्रवीत् । अर्थ्यंविज्ञापयन्नेवभरतंसत्यविक्रमम् ।।6.130.24।।
transliteration: athaivamuktevacanehanūmānidamabravīt | arthyaṃvijñāpayannevabharataṃsatyavikramam
translation: अथ and then, एवम् in that way, वचने words, उक्ते spoken, हनूमान् by Hanuman, सत्यविक्रमम् righteous, भरतम् Bharata, विज्ञापयन्नेव knowing, अर्थ्यम् meaning, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: And then Bharata having spoken that way, Hanuman understood the meaning of his words and spoke thus.

shloka_text: सदाफलान्कुसुमितान्वृक्षान् प्राप्यमधुस्रवान् । भरद्वाजप्रसादेनमत्तभ्रमरनादितान् ।।6.130.25।। तस्यचैषवरोदत्तोवासवेनपरन्तप । ससैन्यस्यतवातिथ्यंकृतंसर्वगुणान्वितम् ।।6.130.26।। निस्स्वन्श्रूयतेभीमःप्रहृष्टानांवनौकसाम् । मन्येवानरसेनासानदींतरतिगोमतीम् ।।6.130.27।।
transliteration: sadāphalānkusumitānvṛkṣān prāpyamadhusravān | bharadvājaprasādenamattabhramaranāditān  tasyacaiṣavarodattovāsavenaparantapa | sasainyasyatavātithyaṃkṛtaṃsarvaguṇānvitam  nissvanśrūyatebhīmaḥprahṛṣṭānāṃvanaukasām | manyevānarasenāsānadīṃtaratigomatīm
translation: भरद्वाजप्रसादेन grace of Bharadwaja, सदाफलान् fruits all through, कुसुमितान् flowers, मधुस्रवान् shedding sweet juice, मत्तभ्रमरनादितान् noisy by the noisy bees, वृक्षान् trees, प्राप्य seen, प्रहृष्टानाम् very delighted, वनौकसाम् forest rangers, भीमः terrific, निःस्वनः sounds, श्रूयते is heard, परन्तप tormentor of enemies, तस्य his, एषः in that way, वरः boon, वासवेन, दत्तः given by Indra, ससैन्यस्य that army, तव your, सर्वगुणान्वितम् endowed with all virtues, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कृतम् done, सा they, वानरसेना Vanara army, गोमतींनदीम् Gomathi, तरति crossing, मन्ये I think
explanation: "By the grace of Bharadwaja, all the trees have fruits shedding sweet juice, and in bloom, the Vanaras are very delighted. The forest rangers are making terrific sounds. The tormentor of enemies, endowed with all virtues, by virtue of the boon given by Indra extended hospitality to the Vanara army. I think they are crossing the river Gomathi now."

shloka_text: सदाफलान्कुसुमितान्वृक्षान् प्राप्यमधुस्रवान् । भरद्वाजप्रसादेनमत्तभ्रमरनादितान् ।।6.130.25।। तस्यचैषवरोदत्तोवासवेनपरन्तप । ससैन्यस्यतवातिथ्यंकृतंसर्वगुणान्वितम् ।।6.130.26।। निस्स्वन्श्रूयतेभीमःप्रहृष्टानांवनौकसाम् । मन्येवानरसेनासानदींतरतिगोमतीम् ।।6.130.27।।
transliteration: sadāphalānkusumitānvṛkṣān prāpyamadhusravān | bharadvājaprasādenamattabhramaranāditān  tasyacaiṣavarodattovāsavenaparantapa | sasainyasyatavātithyaṃkṛtaṃsarvaguṇānvitam  nissvanśrūyatebhīmaḥprahṛṣṭānāṃvanaukasām | manyevānarasenāsānadīṃtaratigomatīm
translation: भरद्वाजप्रसादेन grace of Bharadwaja, सदाफलान् fruits all through, कुसुमितान् flowers, मधुस्रवान् shedding sweet juice, मत्तभ्रमरनादितान् noisy by the noisy bees, वृक्षान् trees, प्राप्य seen, प्रहृष्टानाम् very delighted, वनौकसाम् forest rangers, भीमः terrific, निःस्वनः sounds, श्रूयते is heard, परन्तप tormentor of enemies, तस्य his, एषः in that way, वरः boon, वासवेन, दत्तः given by Indra, ससैन्यस्य that army, तव your, सर्वगुणान्वितम् endowed with all virtues, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कृतम् done, सा they, वानरसेना Vanara army, गोमतींनदीम् Gomathi, तरति crossing, मन्ये I think
explanation: "By the grace of Bharadwaja, all the trees have fruits shedding sweet juice, and in bloom, the Vanaras are very delighted. The forest rangers are making terrific sounds. The tormentor of enemies, endowed with all virtues, by virtue of the boon given by Indra extended hospitality to the Vanara army. I think they are crossing the river Gomathi now."

shloka_text: सदाफलान्कुसुमितान्वृक्षान् प्राप्यमधुस्रवान् । भरद्वाजप्रसादेनमत्तभ्रमरनादितान् ।।6.130.25।। तस्यचैषवरोदत्तोवासवेनपरन्तप । ससैन्यस्यतवातिथ्यंकृतंसर्वगुणान्वितम् ।।6.130.26।। निस्स्वन्श्रूयतेभीमःप्रहृष्टानांवनौकसाम् । मन्येवानरसेनासानदींतरतिगोमतीम् ।।6.130.27।।
transliteration: sadāphalānkusumitānvṛkṣān prāpyamadhusravān | bharadvājaprasādenamattabhramaranāditān  tasyacaiṣavarodattovāsavenaparantapa | sasainyasyatavātithyaṃkṛtaṃsarvaguṇānvitam  nissvanśrūyatebhīmaḥprahṛṣṭānāṃvanaukasām | manyevānarasenāsānadīṃtaratigomatīm
translation: भरद्वाजप्रसादेन grace of Bharadwaja, सदाफलान् fruits all through, कुसुमितान् flowers, मधुस्रवान् shedding sweet juice, मत्तभ्रमरनादितान् noisy by the noisy bees, वृक्षान् trees, प्राप्य seen, प्रहृष्टानाम् very delighted, वनौकसाम् forest rangers, भीमः terrific, निःस्वनः sounds, श्रूयते is heard, परन्तप tormentor of enemies, तस्य his, एषः in that way, वरः boon, वासवेन, दत्तः given by Indra, ससैन्यस्य that army, तव your, सर्वगुणान्वितम् endowed with all virtues, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, कृतम् done, सा they, वानरसेना Vanara army, गोमतींनदीम् Gomathi, तरति crossing, मन्ये I think
explanation: "By the grace of Bharadwaja, all the trees have fruits shedding sweet juice, and in bloom, the Vanaras are very delighted. The forest rangers are making terrific sounds. The tormentor of enemies, endowed with all virtues, by virtue of the boon given by Indra extended hospitality to the Vanara army. I think they are crossing the river Gomathi now."

shloka_text: रजोवर्षंसमुद्भूतंपश्यसालवनंप्रति । मन्येसालवनंरम्यंलोपयन्तिप्लवङ्गमाः ।।6.130.28।।
transliteration: rajovarṣaṃsamudbhūtaṃpaśyasālavanaṃprati | manyesālavanaṃramyaṃlopayantiplavaṅgamāḥ
translation: सालवनंप्रति Sala forest, समुद्भूतम् started, रजोवर्षम् rain of dust, पश्य see, प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, रम्यम् beautiful, सालवनम् Sala grove, लोलयन्ति shaking, मन्ये I think
explanation: "See the rain of dust started at Sala Forest. Vanaras are shaking the beautiful Sala grove, I think."

shloka_text: तदेतद्दृश्यतेदूराद्विमानंचन्द्रसन्निभम् । विमानंपुष्पकंदिव्यंमनसाब्रह्मनिर्मितम् ।।6.130.29।।
transliteration: tadetaddṛśyatedūrādvimānaṃcandrasannibham | vimānaṃpuṣpakaṃdivyaṃmanasābrahmanirmitam
translation: चन्द्रसन्निभम् resembling the moon, तत् that, एतत् this, विमानम् aerial car, दूरात् at a distance, दृश्यते is seen, दिव्यम् wonderful, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, मनसा by his mind, निर्मितम् created
explanation: Pushpaka is seen at a distance, resembling the moon. This wonderful Pushpaka has been created through Brahma's mind.

shloka_text: रावणंबान्धवैःसार्थंहत्वालब्धंमहात्मना । तरुणादित्यसङ्काशंविमानंरामवाहनम् ।।6.130.30।। धनदस्यप्रसादेनदिव्यमेतन्मनोजवम् ।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṃbāndhavaiḥsārthaṃhatvālabdhaṃmahātmanā | taruṇādityasaṅkāśaṃvimānaṃrāmavāhanam  dhanadasyaprasādenadivyametanmanojavam |
translation: रावणम् Ravana, बान्दवैःसार्थम् relatives, हत्वा killed, महात्मना great, लब्दम् got, तरुणादित्यसङ्काशम् shines like the rising sun brightly, रामवाहनम् Rama's vehicle, एतत् this, दिव्यम् amazing, मनोजवम् speeds at mind thought, विमानम् aerial car, प्रसादेन by the grace, धनदस्य to Kubera
explanation: "Rama's vehicle is amazing, and he got it by killing Ravana and his relatives. It shines brightly like the rising sun, and it speeds at the thought of mind. Kubera got this aerial car by Brahma's grace."

shloka_text: एतस्मिन् भ्रातरौवीरौवैदेह्यासहराघवौ ।।6.130.31।। सुग्रीवश्चमहातेजाराक्षसश्चविभीषणः ।
transliteration: etasmin bhrātarauvīrauvaidehyāsaharāghavau  sugrīvaścamahātejārākṣasaścavibhīṣaṇaḥ |
translation: वीरौ heroes, भ्रातरौ brothers, वैदेह्यासह with Vaidehi, राघवौ Raghavas, महातेजाः highly energetic, सुग्रीवश्च Sugriva, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणश्च Vibheeshana too, एतस्मिन् all in that
explanation: "Heroic Raghava brothers are there with Vaidehi, that highly energetic Sugriva and Rakshasa Vibheeshana also."

shloka_text: एतोहर्षसमुद्भूतोनिःस्वनोदिवमस्पृशत् ।।6.130.32।। स्त्रीबालयुववृद्धानांरामोऽयमितिकीर्तिते ।
transliteration: etoharṣasamudbhūtoniḥsvanodivamaspṛśat  strībālayuvavṛddhānāṃrāmo'yamitikīrtite |
translation: तः then, अयम् this, रामःSri Rama, इति there, कीर्तिते uttered, स्त्रीबालयुववृद्धानाम् women, young, youth and aged, हर्षसमुद्भूतः fantastic expression of joy, निःस्वनःsky, दिवम् sky, अस्पृशत् indistinct
explanation: Then when "Sri Rama is here" was uttered a fantastic expression of joy of the women, young, youth and aged was heard, which reached the heaven.

shloka_text: रथकुञ्जरवाजिभ्यस्तेऽवतीर्यमहींगताः ।।6.130.33।। ददृशुस्तंविमानस्थंनरास्सोममिवाम्बरे ।
transliteration: rathakuñjaravājibhyaste'vatīryamahīṃgatāḥ  dadṛśustaṃvimānasthaṃnarāssomamivāmbare |
translation: रथकुञ्जरवाजिभ्यः chariots, elephants and horses, अवतीर्य got down, महीम् on ground, गताः went, तेनराः those people, विमानस्थम् in the Pushpaka, तम् them, अम्बरे sky, सोममिव like moon, ददृशुः saw
explanation: Those people on the chariots, elephants and horses got down and saw them on the moon like Pushpaka.

shloka_text: प्राज्ञलिर्भरतोभूत्वाप्रसृष्टोराघवोन्मुखः ।।6.130.34।। स्वागतेनयथार्हेणततोराममपूजयत् ।
transliteration: prājñalirbharatobhūtvāprasṛṣṭorāghavonmukhaḥ  svāgatenayathārheṇatatorāmamapūjayat |
translation: प्राञ्जलिः salutations, प्रहृष्टः highly rejoiced, भरतः Bharata, राघवोन्मुखः Raghava's face, भूत्वा standing, यथार्हेण as he ought to, स्वागतेन in himself, रामम् Sri Rama, अपूजयत् worshipped
explanation: Highly rejoiced, Bharata offered salutations standing as he ought to within himself and worshiped Sri Rama from a distance.

shloka_text: मनसाब्रह्मणासृष्टेविमानेभरताग्रजः ।।6.130.35।। रराजपृथुदीर्घाक्षोवज्रपाणिरिवापरः ।
transliteration: manasābrahmaṇāsṛṣṭevimānebharatāgrajaḥ  rarājapṛthudīrghākṣovajrapāṇirivāparaḥ |
translation: मनसा in his mind, ब्रह्मणा Brahmana, सृष्टे created, विमाने aerial car, पृथुदीर्घाक्षः broad eyed, भरताग्रजः Bharata's elder brother, अपरः another, वज्रपाणिरिव like Indra, रराज shone
explanation: Sri Rama, elder brother of Bharata shone in the aerial car created by Brahma like another Indra.

shloka_text: ततोविमानाग्रगतंभरतोभ्रातरंतदा ।।6.130.36।। ववन्देप्रणतोरामंमेरुस्थमिवभास्करम् ।
transliteration: tatovimānāgragataṃbharatobhrātaraṃtadā  vavandepraṇatorāmaṃmerusthamivabhāskaram |
translation: ततः then, भरतः Bharata, विमानाग्रगतम् peak of Pushpaka, मेरुस्थम् like Meru mountain, भास्करंयथा like the sun, रामम् Sri Rama, तदा then, प्रणतः salutations with joined palms, ववन्दे offered
explanation: Then Bharata offered salutations with joined palms to Sri Rama seated in the peak of Pushpaka like saluting Sun from the mountain Meru.

shloka_text: ततोरामाभ्यनुज्ञातंतद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।।6.130.37।। हंसयुक्तंमहावेगंनिपपातमहीतले ।
transliteration: tatorāmābhyanujñātaṃtadvimānamanuttamam  haṃsayuktaṃmahāvegaṃnipapātamahītale |
translation: ततः then, अनुत्तमम् excellent, हंसयुक्तम् with pictures of swan, महावेगम् high speed, तत् that विमानम् aerial car, रामाभ्यनुज्ञातम् Rama's permission, महीतले on the ground, निपपात came down
explanation: Then that excellent Pushpaka which had pictures of swans on it came down to the ground with Rama's permission.

shloka_text: आपितोविमानंतद्भरतस्सत्यविक्रमः ।।6.130.38।। राममासाद्यमुदितःपुनरेवाभ्यवादयत् ।
transliteration: āpitovimānaṃtadbharatassatyavikramaḥ  rāmamāsādyamuditaḥpunarevābhyavādayat |
translation: ततविमानम् that Pushpaka, आरोपितः lifted on, सत्यविक्रमः unfailing valour, भरतः Bharata, रामम् Rama, आसाद्य reached, पुनरेव once again, अभ्यवादयत् greeted
explanation: Bharata of unfailing valour duly permitted to ascend Pushpaka by Sri Rama, reached Rama and once again offered salutations to Rama.

shloka_text: तंसमुत्थाप्यकाकुत्स्थश्चिरस्याक्षिरथंगतम् ।।6.130.39।। अङ्केभरतमारोप्यमुदितःपरिषस्वजे ।
transliteration: taṃsamutthāpyakākutsthaścirasyākṣirathaṃgatam  aṅkebharatamāropyamuditaḥpariṣasvaje |
translation: काकुत्स्थः Kakuthsa, चिराय after long, अक्षिपथम् who came in his sight, गतम् arrived at, तम् him, भरतम् Bharata, समुत्थाप्य lifting up, अङ्कम् thigh, आरोप्य lifted to, मुदितःhappily, परिषस्वजे embraced
explanation: Kakuthsa Rama happily lifting up Bharata, who came into his sight after long, on to his thigh embraced him.

shloka_text: ततोलक्ष्मणमासाद्यवैदेहीं च परन्तपः ।।6.130.40।। अथाभ्यवादयप्रतीतोभरतोनामचाब्रवीत् ।
transliteration: tatolakṣmaṇamāsādyavaidehīṃ ca parantapaḥ  athābhyavādayapratītobharatonāmacābravīt |
translation: ततः then, परन्तपः tormentor of enemies, भरतः Bharata, प्रीतः lovingly, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, वैदेहीं च and Vaidehi, आसाद्य approached, अथ and then, अभ्यवादयत् greeted, नाम name, अब्रवीत् च announced
explanation: Then the tormentor of enemies, Bharata approached Lakshmana and then greeted Vaidehi and announced his name.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवंकेकयीपुत्रोजाम्बवन्तमथाङ्गदम् ।।6.130.41।। मैन्दं च द्विविदंनीलमृषभंपरिषस्वजे ।
transliteration: sugrīvaṃkekayīputrojāmbavantamathāṅgadam  maindaṃ ca dvividaṃnīlamṛṣabhaṃpariṣasvaje |
translation: अथ and then, केकयीपुत्रः Kaikeyi's son, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, अङ्गदम् Angada, मैन्दम् Mainda, द्विविदंचैव and Dwivivida, नीलम् Nila, ऋषभम् Rshaba, परषस्वजे embraced
explanation: Bharata, the son of Kaikeyi thereafter embraced Sugriva, Jambavantha, Angada, Mainda, Dwivivida, Nila and Rshaba.

shloka_text: सुषेणं च नलंचैवगवाक्षंगन्धमादनम् ।।6.130.42।। शरभंपनसंचैवपरितःपरिषस्वजे ।
transliteration: suṣeṇaṃ ca nalaṃcaivagavākṣaṃgandhamādanam  śarabhaṃpanasaṃcaivaparitaḥpariṣasvaje |
translation: सुषेणं च Sushena, नलंचैव Nala, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana, शरभम् Sarabha, पनसंचैव Panasa, परितः all around, परिषस्वजे embraced
explanation: He embraced Sushena, Nala, Gavaksha, Gandhamadana, Sarabha, Panasa who were around.

shloka_text: तेकृत्वामानुषंरूपंवानराःकामरूपिणः ।।6.130.43।। कुशलंपर्यपृच्छंस्तेप्रहृष्टाभरतंतदा ।
transliteration: tekṛtvāmānuṣaṃrūpaṃvānarāḥkāmarūpiṇaḥ  kuśalaṃparyapṛcchaṃsteprahṛṣṭābharataṃtadā |
translation: तदा then, कामरूपिणः who can take any form at will, तेवानराः those Vanaras, मानुषंरूपम् in human form, कृत्वा doing, प्रहृष्टाः delighted, भरतम् Bharata, कुशलम् welfare, पर्यपृच्छन् inquired
explanation: Then he inquired about the welfare of those Vanaras who can take any form at will, who were in human form and was delighted.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रस्सुग्रीवंवानरर्षभम् ।।6.130.44।। परिष्वज्यमहातेजाभरतोधर्मिणांवरः ।
transliteration: athābravīdrājaputrassugrīvaṃvānararṣabham  pariṣvajyamahātejābharatodharmiṇāṃvaraḥ |
translation: अथ and then, महातेजाः highly brilliant, धर्मिणाम् among the righteous, वरः foremost, राजपुत्रः prince, भरतः Bharata, वानरर्षभम् bull among Vanaras, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, परिष्वज्य, embraced, अब्रवीत् and spoke
explanation: And thereafter highly brilliant, foremost among the righteous, prince Bharata embraced Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras and spoke.

shloka_text: त्वम्स्माकंचतुर्णांवैभ्रातासुग्रीवपञ्चमः ।।6.130.45।। सौहार्दाज्जायतेमित्रमपकारोऽरिलक्षणम् ।
transliteration: tvamsmākaṃcaturṇāṃvaibhrātāsugrīvapañcamaḥ  sauhārdājjāyatemitramapakāro'rilakṣaṇam |
translation: सुग्रीव Sugriva, त्वम् you, अस्माकम् our, चतुर्णाम् fourth, पञ्चमः fifth, भ्राता brother, सौहार्दात् affectionately, मित्रम् friend, जायते born, अपकारः maleficence, अरिलक्षणम् sign of an enemy
explanation: "Sugriva, you are the fifth brother to four of us and should have been born like that" said Bharata. One who helps becomes friend and maleficence is a sign of an enemy.

shloka_text: विभीषणं च भरतःसान्त्ववाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।।6.130.46।। दिष्ट्यात्वयासहायेनकृतंकर्मसुदुष्करम् ।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇaṃ ca bharataḥsāntvavākyamathābravīt  diṣṭyātvayāsahāyenakṛtaṃkarmasuduṣkaram |
translation: अथ and then, भरतः Bharata, विभीषणं च Vibheeshana, सान्त्ववाक्यम् good word, अब्रवीत् spoke, दिष्ट्या luckily, सहायेन help, त्वया by you, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, कर्म task, कृतम् was done
explanation: And then Bharata spoke this good word. "Luckily with your help, the very difficult task was done."

shloka_text: शत्रुघ्नश्चतदाराममभिवाद्यसलक्ष्मणम् ।।6.130.47।। सीतायाश्चरणौवीरोविनयादभ्यवादयत् ।
transliteration: śatrughnaścatadārāmamabhivādyasalakṣmaṇam  sītāyāścaraṇauvīrovinayādabhyavādayat |
translation: तदा then, वीरः hero, शत्रुघ्नश्च Shatrughna also, सलक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana also, रामम् Rama, अभिवाद्य greeted, सीतायाः and Sita, चरणौ feet, विनयात् obediently, अभ्यवादयत् worshipped
explanation: Then hero Shatrughna and Lakshmana also greeted Rama and then worshipped Sita also.

shloka_text: रामोमातरमासाद्यविवर्णांशोककर्शिताम् ।।6.130.48।। जग्राहप्रणतःपादौमनोमातुःप्रहर्षयन् ।
transliteration: rāmomātaramāsādyavivarṇāṃśokakarśitām  jagrāhapraṇataḥpādaumanomātuḥpraharṣayan |
translation: रामः Rama, विवर्णाम् pale, शोककर्शिताम् emaciated by grief, मातरम् mother, आसाद्य reached, प्रणतः offered salutations, मातुः to mother, मनः in mind, प्रहर्षयन् delighted, पादौ feet, जग्राह clasped
explanation: Rama reached his mother who was pale and emaciated in grief and offered salutations clasping her feet in obedience and was delighted in his mind.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्यसुमित्रां च कैकेयीं च यशस्विनीम् ।।6.130.49।। स मात्रूश्चततस्सर्वापुरोहितमुपागमत् ।
transliteration: abhivādyasumitrāṃ ca kaikeyīṃ ca yaśasvinīm  sa mātrūścatatassarvāpurohitamupāgamat |
translation: सः he, सुमित्रां च Sumitra also, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, कैकेयीं च Kaikeyi also, अभिवाद्य greeted, सर्वाः all, मात्रूश्च mothers, ततः then, पुरोहितम् priests, उपागमत् had come
explanation: Then he greeted Sumitra, and illustrious Kaikeyi also and then all the mothers and the priests who had come.

shloka_text: स्वागतंतेमहाबाहोकौसल्यानन्दवर्धना ।।6.130.50।। इतिप्राञ्जलयःसर्वेनागराराममब्रुवन् ।
transliteration: svāgataṃtemahābāhokausalyānandavardhanā  itiprāñjalayaḥsarvenāgarārāmamabruvan |
translation: महाबाहो mightyarmed, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धन enhancer of Kausalya's joy, ते you, स्वागतम् welcome, सर्वे all, नागराः people of the city, प्राञ्जलयः with folded palms, अब्रुवन् spoke
explanation: "Welcome to you mighty armed Rama, enhancer of Kausalya's joy" saying so citizens of the city spoke with folded hand s greeting Rama.

shloka_text: तान्यञ्जलिसहस्राणिप्रगृहीतानिनागरैः ।।6.130.51।। व्याकोचानीवपद्मानिददर्शभरताग्रजः ।
transliteration: tānyañjalisahasrāṇipragṛhītānināgaraiḥ  vyākocānīvapadmānidadarśabharatāgrajaḥ |
translation: नागरैः citizens, प्रगृहीतानि taking up, तानि they, अञ्जलिसहस्राणि thousands greeting with folded palms, भरताग्रजः elder brother of Bharata, व्याकोचानि displayed, पद्मानीव like lotus buds, ददर्श seemed
explanation: The citizens in thousands greeting Rama, elder brother of Bharata lifting up their hand s with folded palms seemed like lotus buds.

shloka_text: पादुकेतेतुरामस्यगृहीत्वाभरतस्स्वयम् ।।6.130.52।। चरणाभ्यांनरेन्द्रस्ययोजयामासधर्मवित् ।
transliteration: pāduketeturāmasyagṛhītvābharatassvayam  caraṇābhyāṃnarendrasyayojayāmāsadharmavit |
translation: धर्मवित् knower of dharma, भरतः Bharata, रामस्य Rama's, ते you, पादुके sandals, गृहीत्वा taking, स्वयम् himself, नरेन्द्रस्य king's, चरणाभ्याम् to both feet, योजयामास placed
explanation: Taking the sandals given to Bharata, the knower of dharma put on the sandals on Rama's feet by himself.

shloka_text: अब्रवीच्चतदारामंभरतः स कृताञ्जलिः ।।6.130.53।। एतत्तेसकलंराज्यंन्यासंनिर्यातितंमया ।
transliteration: abravīccatadārāmaṃbharataḥ sa kṛtāñjaliḥ  etattesakalaṃrājyaṃnyāsaṃniryātitaṃmayā |
translation: सःभरतः he, Bharata, कृताञ्जलिः greeting with folded palms, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, अब्रवीच्च spoke, न्यासम् held in trust, ते to you, सकलम् everything, एतत् this, राज्यम् kingdom, मया by me, निर्यातितम् returned
explanation: Bharata then greeted Rama with folded palms, spoke saying, "this kingdom and everything held in trust by me is returned to you."

shloka_text: अद्यजन्मकृतार्थंमेसम्वृत्तश्चमनोरथः ।।6.130.54।। यत्त्वांपश्यामिराजानमयोध्यांपुनरागतम् ।
transliteration: adyajanmakṛtārthaṃmesamvṛttaścamanorathaḥ  yattvāṃpaśyāmirājānamayodhyāṃpunarāgatam |
translation: अद्य today, मे I, जन्म life, कृतार्थम् fulfilled, मनोरथः च my wish, सम्वृत्तः completed, यत् that, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, पुनः again, आगतम् have returned, त्वाम् you, राजानम् kingdom, पश्यामि seeing
explanation: Today my life is fulfilled, my wish is completed. I am seeing you returned to Ayodhya again as king of this kingdom.

shloka_text: अवेक्षतांभवान्शोकंकोष्ठागारंगृहंबलम् ।।6.130.55।। भवतस्तेजसासर्वंकृतंदशगुणंमया ।
transliteration: avekṣatāṃbhavānśokaṃkoṣṭhāgāraṃgṛhaṃbalam  bhavatastejasāsarvaṃkṛtaṃdaśaguṇaṃmayā |
translation: भवान् you, कोशम् treasury, कोष्ठागारम् granary, गृहम् palaces, बलम् army, अवेक्षताम् may see, भवतः by your, तेजसा brilliance, मया by me, सर्वम् all, दशगुणम् tenfold, कृतम् done
explanation: You may review your treasury, granary, palaces, army. Everything has increased tenfold by me by virtue of your brilliance.

shloka_text: तथाब्रुवाणंभरतंदृष्टवातंभ्रातृवत्सलम् ।।6.130.56।। मुमुचुर्वानराबाष्पंराक्षसश्चविभीषणः ।
transliteration: tathābruvāṇaṃbharataṃdṛṣṭavātaṃbhrātṛvatsalam  mumucurvānarābāṣpaṃrākṣasaścavibhīṣaṇaḥ |
translation: तथा so also, ब्रुवाणम् spoke, भ्रातृवत्सलम् lover of brother, तंभरतम् that Bharata, दृष्टवा seeing, वानराः Vanaras, बाष्पम् tears, मुमुचुः shed, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणं च Vibheeshana also
explanation: Seeing Bharata, the lover of his brother, who spoke like that, the Vanaras, Rakshasas, and Vibheeshana shed tears.

shloka_text: ततःप्रहर्षाद्भरतमङ्गमारोप्यराघवः ।।6.130.57।। ययौतेनविमानेनससैन्योभरताश्रमम् ।
transliteration: tataḥpraharṣādbharatamaṅgamāropyarāghavaḥ  yayautenavimānenasasainyobharatāśramam |
translation: ततः then, राघवः Raghava, प्रहर्षात् rejoiced, भरतम् Bharata, अङ्कम् thigh, आरोप्य lifted up, ससैन्यः that army, भरताश्रमम् from Bharata's hermitage, ययौ flew
explanation: Then rejoiced Raghava took Bharata on his lap and flew to Bharata's hermitage with the army.

shloka_text: भरताश्रममासाद्यससैन्योराघवस्तदा ।।6.130.58।। अवतीर्यविमानाग्रादवतस्थेमहीतले ।
transliteration: bharatāśramamāsādyasasainyorāghavastadā  avatīryavimānāgrādavatasthemahītale |
translation: तदा then, राघवः Raghava, भरताश्रमम् Bharata's hermitage, आसाद्य alighted, ससैन्यः that army, विमानाग्रात् top of Pushpaka, अवतीर्य landed, महीतले on ground, अवतस्थे stood
explanation: Raghava alighted from the top of the Pushpaka on reaching the hermitage of Bharata and stood on ground.

shloka_text: अब्रवीत्तुतदारामस्तद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।।6.130.59।। वहवैश्रवणंदेवमनुजानामिगम्यताम् ।
transliteration: abravīttutadārāmastadvimānamanuttamam  vahavaiśravaṇaṃdevamanujānāmigamyatām |
translation: तदा then, रामः Rama, अनुत्तमम् best, तत् that, विमानम् Pushpaka, अब्रवीत् told, देवम् god, वैश्रवणम् Vysravana, वह there अनुजानामि permit, गम्यताम् to go
explanation: Then Rama told Pushpaka that he was permitted to go to God Vysravana.

shloka_text: ततोरामाभ्यनुज्ञातंतद्विमानमनुत्तमम् ।।6.130.60।। उत्तरांदिशमुद्दिश्यजगामधनदालयम् ।
transliteration: tatorāmābhyanujñātaṃtadvimānamanuttamam  uttarāṃdiśamuddiśyajagāmadhanadālayam |
translation: ततः that, रामाभ्यनुज्ञातम् Rama's permission, अनुत्तमम् the best, तत् विमानम् that aerial car, धनदालयम् उद्धिश्य rose up to Kubera, उत्तरांदिशम् in the northern direction, जगाम went
explanation: That aerial car duly permitted by Rama rose up to go to Kubera and set out in the northern direction and flew.

shloka_text: विमानंपुष्पकंदिव्यंसम्गृहीतंतुरक्षसा ।।6.130.61।। अगमद्धनदंवेगाद्रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् ।
transliteration: vimānaṃpuṣpakaṃdivyaṃsamgṛhītaṃturakṣasā  agamaddhanadaṃvegādrāmavākyapracoditam |
translation: रक्षसा Rakshasa, सम्गृहीतम् received, दिव्यम् wonderful, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka aerial car, रामवाक्यप्रचोदितम् impelled by Rama's order, वेगात् speedily, धनदम् to Kubera, आगमत् went
explanation: That wonderful Pushpaka received from Rakshasa impelled by Rama's order speedily went to Kubera.

shloka_text: शिरस्यञ्जलिमाधायकैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनः । बभाषेभरतोज्येष्ठंरामंसत्यपराक्रमम् ।।6.131.1।।
transliteration: śirasyañjalimādhāyakaikeyyānandavardhanaḥ | babhāṣebharatojyeṣṭhaṃrāmaṃsatyaparākramam
translation: कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy, भरतः Bharata, शिरसि head, अञ्जलिम् folded hands, आधाय submitted, सत्यपराक्रमम् unfailing valour, ज्येष्ठम् to elder, रामम् Rama, बभाषे spoke
explanation: Bharata, the enhancer of Kaikeyi's joy, of unfailing valour, with folded palms on head submitted to his elder brother.
comments: Bharata requests Sri Rama to take over the kingdom. Celebration of Sri Rama's coronation on a grand scale. Sri Rama offers gifts to guests and bids farewell.

shloka_text: पूजितामामिकामातादत्तंराज्यमिदंमम । तद्ददामिपुनस्तुभ्यंयथात्वमददामम ।।6.131.2।।
transliteration: pūjitāmāmikāmātādattaṃrājyamidaṃmama | taddadāmipunastubhyaṃyathātvamadadāmama
translation: मामिका mine, माता mother, पूजिता worshipped, इदंराज्यम् this kingdom, मम myself, दत्तम् bestowed, तत् that, त्वम् to you, मम me, यथा as it is, आददाः returning, पुनः again, तुभ्यम् and now, ददामि giving
explanation: "This kingdom was bestowed on me and my mother. I return it back to you now again."

shloka_text: धुरमेकाकिनान्यस्तांवृषभेणबलीयसा । किशोरवद्गुरुंभारं न वोढुमहमुत्सहे ।।6.131.3।।
transliteration: dhuramekākinānyastāṃvṛṣabheṇabalīyasā | kiśoravadguruṃbhāraṃ na voḍhumahamutsahe
translation: बलीयसा strong, एकाकिना alone, वृषभेण young ox, न्यस्ताम् transferred to, धुरम् burden, किशोरवत् like young, गुरुम् heavy, भारम् burden, अहम् I, वोढुम् bull, न उत्सहे not able to bear
explanation: "I am not able to bear the heavy burden transferred to me any more like a young ox can't bear like a bull.

shloka_text: वारिवेगेनमहताभिन्नस्सेतुरिवक्षरन् । दुर्बन्धनमिदंमन्येराज्यच्छ्रिदमसम्वृतम् ।।6.131.4।।
transliteration: vārivegenamahatābhinnasseturivakṣaran | durbandhanamidaṃmanyerājyacchridamasamvṛtam
translation: महता great, वारिवेगेन strong rush of water, भिन्नः breached, क्षरन् have no effect, सेतुरिव like dam, इदम् this, राज्यच्छ्रिदम् kingdom containing vulnerable points, असम्वृतम् not protected well, दुर्बन्धम् difficult, मन्ये I think
explanation: "If the kingdom containing vulnerable points is not protected on all sides, it can't stand, just as a strong rush of water can be prevented from breach only by constructing a dam.

shloka_text: गतिंखरइवाश्वस्यहंसस्येव च वायसः । नान्वेतुमुत्सहेराम तवमार्गमरिन्दम ।।6.131.5।।
transliteration: gatiṃkharaivāśvasyahaṃsasyeva ca vāyasaḥ | nānvetumutsaherāma tavamārgamarindama
translation: खरइवा like donkey, गतिं not go, श्वस्य horse, हंसस्येव च and like swan च वायसः crow not run, अरिन्दम tormentor of enemies, तव your, मार्गम् way, अन्वेतुम्, राम Rama, न उत्सहे not able to नान्वेतु like you
explanation: "O Rama! Donkey can't run like horse crow can't run like swan. I am not able to bear the burden of kingdom like you, O tormentor of enemies."

shloka_text: यथाचारोपितोवृक्षोजातश्चार्न्न्तिवेशने । महांश्चसुदुरारोहोमहास्कन्दःप्रशाखवान् ।।6.131.6।। शीर्येतपुष्पितोभूत्वा न फलानिप्रदर्शयन् । तस्यनानुभवेदर्थंयस्यहेतोस्सरोपितः ।।6.131.7।। एषोपमामहाबाहोत्वमर्थंवेत्तुमर्हसि । यद्यस्मान्मनुजेन्द्रत्वंभर्ताभृत्यान्नशाधिहि ।।6.131.8।।
transliteration: yathācāropitovṛkṣojātaścārnntiveśane | mahāṃścasudurārohomahāskandaḥpraśākhavān  śīryetapuṣpitobhūtvā na phalānipradarśayan | tasyanānubhavedarthaṃyasyahetossaropitaḥ  eṣopamāmahābāhotvamarthaṃvettumarhasi | yadyasmānmanujendratvaṃbhartābhṛtyānnaśādhihi
translation: अन्नर्निवेशने your own house, आरोपितः to climb, वृक्षः tree, महान् huge, दुरारोहः difficult to climb, महास्कन्दः large trunk, प्रशाखवान् many branches, जातःअसि born, पुष्पितःभूत्वा after flowering, फलानि fruits, न प्रदर्शयन् not yield, यथा so also, शीर्येत withered, सः he, यस्यहेतोः the cause, रोपितः planted, तस्य his, अर्थम् meaning, नानुभवेत् will not enjoy, एषा in that way, उपमा example, महाबाहो mighty armed, मनुजेन्द्र ruler of the people, त्वम् you, भर्ता rule, भृत्यान् dependants, नः not, न शाधियदिहि not take care, त्वम् you, अर्थम् understand, वेत्तुम् solicit, अर्हसि ought
explanation: "If for example you have planted a tree in your own house, it becomes huge and difficult to climb in spite of a large trunk, many branches and after flowering does not yield fruits and is withered, the person who planted will not enjoy the fruit. In that way O mighty armed Rama, you are the ruler of the people, if you would not take care of us, your dependants, I solicit you ought to understand what I mean.

shloka_text: यथाचारोपितोवृक्षोजातश्चार्न्न्तिवेशने । महांश्चसुदुरारोहोमहास्कन्दःप्रशाखवान् ।।6.131.6।। शीर्येतपुष्पितोभूत्वा न फलानिप्रदर्शयन् । तस्यनानुभवेदर्थंयस्यहेतोस्सरोपितः ।।6.131.7।। एषोपमामहाबाहोत्वमर्थंवेत्तुमर्हसि । यद्यस्मान्मनुजेन्द्रत्वंभर्ताभृत्यान्नशाधिहि ।।6.131.8।।
transliteration: yathācāropitovṛkṣojātaścārnntiveśane | mahāṃścasudurārohomahāskandaḥpraśākhavān  śīryetapuṣpitobhūtvā na phalānipradarśayan | tasyanānubhavedarthaṃyasyahetossaropitaḥ  eṣopamāmahābāhotvamarthaṃvettumarhasi | yadyasmānmanujendratvaṃbhartābhṛtyānnaśādhihi
translation: अन्नर्निवेशने your own house, आरोपितः to climb, वृक्षः tree, महान् huge, दुरारोहः difficult to climb, महास्कन्दः large trunk, प्रशाखवान् many branches, जातःअसि born, पुष्पितःभूत्वा after flowering, फलानि fruits, न प्रदर्शयन् not yield, यथा so also, शीर्येत withered, सः he, यस्यहेतोः the cause, रोपितः planted, तस्य his, अर्थम् meaning, नानुभवेत् will not enjoy, एषा in that way, उपमा example, महाबाहो mighty armed, मनुजेन्द्र ruler of the people, त्वम् you, भर्ता rule, भृत्यान् dependants, नः not, न शाधियदिहि not take care, त्वम् you, अर्थम् understand, वेत्तुम् solicit, अर्हसि ought
explanation: "If for example you have planted a tree in your own house, it becomes huge and difficult to climb in spite of a large trunk, many branches and after flowering does not yield fruits and is withered, the person who planted will not enjoy the fruit. In that way O mighty armed Rama, you are the ruler of the people, if you would not take care of us, your dependants, I solicit you ought to understand what I mean.

shloka_text: यथाचारोपितोवृक्षोजातश्चार्न्न्तिवेशने । महांश्चसुदुरारोहोमहास्कन्दःप्रशाखवान् ।।6.131.6।। शीर्येतपुष्पितोभूत्वा न फलानिप्रदर्शयन् । तस्यनानुभवेदर्थंयस्यहेतोस्सरोपितः ।।6.131.7।। एषोपमामहाबाहोत्वमर्थंवेत्तुमर्हसि । यद्यस्मान्मनुजेन्द्रत्वंभर्ताभृत्यान्नशाधिहि ।।6.131.8।।
transliteration: yathācāropitovṛkṣojātaścārnntiveśane | mahāṃścasudurārohomahāskandaḥpraśākhavān  śīryetapuṣpitobhūtvā na phalānipradarśayan | tasyanānubhavedarthaṃyasyahetossaropitaḥ  eṣopamāmahābāhotvamarthaṃvettumarhasi | yadyasmānmanujendratvaṃbhartābhṛtyānnaśādhihi
translation: अन्नर्निवेशने your own house, आरोपितः to climb, वृक्षः tree, महान् huge, दुरारोहः difficult to climb, महास्कन्दः large trunk, प्रशाखवान् many branches, जातःअसि born, पुष्पितःभूत्वा after flowering, फलानि fruits, न प्रदर्शयन् not yield, यथा so also, शीर्येत withered, सः he, यस्यहेतोः the cause, रोपितः planted, तस्य his, अर्थम् meaning, नानुभवेत् will not enjoy, एषा in that way, उपमा example, महाबाहो mighty armed, मनुजेन्द्र ruler of the people, त्वम् you, भर्ता rule, भृत्यान् dependants, नः not, न शाधियदिहि not take care, त्वम् you, अर्थम् understand, वेत्तुम् solicit, अर्हसि ought
explanation: "If for example you have planted a tree in your own house, it becomes huge and difficult to climb in spite of a large trunk, many branches and after flowering does not yield fruits and is withered, the person who planted will not enjoy the fruit. In that way O mighty armed Rama, you are the ruler of the people, if you would not take care of us, your dependants, I solicit you ought to understand what I mean.

shloka_text: जगदद्याभिषिक्तंत्वामनुपश्यतुराघव । प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यंमध्याह्नेदीप्ततेजसम् ।।6.131.9।।
transliteration: jagadadyābhiṣiktaṃtvāmanupaśyaturāghava | pratapantamivādityaṃmadhyāhnedīptatejasam
translation: राघव Raghava, जगत् world, अद्य today, अभिषिक्तम् consecration, त्वाम् you, मध्याह्ने in the afternoon, प्रतपन्तम् dazzling, दीप्ततेजसम् in brilliance, आदित्यमिव like the sun, अनुपश्यतु see you
explanation: "Raghava, let you be consecrated in the afternoon and the world will see you dazzling in brilliance like the sun today."

shloka_text: तूर्यसङ्घान्तिर्घोषैःकाञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः । मधुरैर्गीतशब्दैश्चप्रतिबुध्यस्वशेष्व च ।।6.131.10।।
transliteration: tūryasaṅghāntirghoṣaiḥkāñcīnūpuraniḥsvanaiḥ | madhurairgītaśabdaiścapratibudhyasvaśeṣva ca
translation: तूर्यसङ्घान्तिर्घोषैः sounds of musical instruments, काञ्चीनूपुरनिःस्वनैः tinkling of ornaments strung with tiny bells, मधुरैः sweet, गीतशब्दैश्च sounds of singing, प्रतिबुध्यस्व worn around waist and anklets, शेष्व च and sweet
explanation: May you wake up to the sounds of musical instruments and the tinkling of ornaments worn around the waist and anklets and sweet sounds of singing.

shloka_text: यावदावर्ततेचक्रंयावती च वसुन्धरा । तावत्त्वमिहलोकस्यस्वामित्वमनुवर्तय ।।6.131.11।।
transliteration: yāvadāvartatecakraṃyāvatī ca vasundharā | tāvattvamihalokasyasvāmitvamanuvartaya
translation: चक्रम् stellar sphere, यावत् as long as, आवर्तते goes round, वसुन्धरा earth, यावत् that long, तावत् till then, इह here, लोकस्य in the world, स्वामित्वम् rulership, अनुवर्तय revolves
explanation: As long as the stellar sphere goes round, and as long as the earth revolves around that long you enjoy the rulership of the world."

shloka_text: भरतस्यवच्श्रुत्वारामःपरपुरञ्जयः । तथेतिप्रतिजग्राहनिषसादासनेशुभे ।।6.131.12।।
transliteration: bharatasyavacśrutvārāmaḥparapurañjayaḥ | tathetipratijagrāhaniṣasādāsaneśubhe
translation: परपुरञ्जयः conqueror of enemies, रामः Rama, भरतस्य Bharata's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, तथेति be it so, प्रतिजग्राह replied, शुभे auspicious, आसने seat, निषषाद seated
explanation: Hearing Bharata's words, the conqueror of enemies, Rama said 'Be it so'. Then Bharata took the auspicious seat.

shloka_text: ततश्शत्रुघ्नवचनान्निपुणाःश्मश्रुवर्धनाः । सुखहस्ताःसुशीघ्राश्चराघवंपर्यवारयन् ।।6.131.13।।
transliteration: tataśśatrughnavacanānnipuṇāḥśmaśruvardhanāḥ | sukhahastāḥsuśīghrāścarāghavaṃparyavārayan
translation: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नवचनात् Shatrughna's words, निपुणाः expert, सुखहस्ताः skilled at hand, सुशीघ्राश्च hastily, श्मश्रुवर्धनाः soft skilled, राघवम् Raghava, पर्यवारयन् surrounded
explanation: Then at the command of Shatrughna's words, experts with hand work (barbers) who had soft skills quickly surrounded Raghava.

shloka_text: पूर्वंतुभरतेस्नातेलक्ष्मणे च महाबले । सुग्रीवेवानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रेविभीषणे ।।6.131.14।। विशोधितजटस्स्नातश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः । महार्हवसनोपेतस्तस्थौतत्रश्रियाज्वलन् ।।6.131.15।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃtubharatesnātelakṣmaṇe ca mahābale | sugrīvevānarendre ca rākṣasendrevibhīṣaṇe  viśodhitajaṭassnātaścitramālyānulepanaḥ | mahārhavasanopetastasthautatraśriyājvalan
translation: पूर्वम् first, भरते Bharata, स्नाते had bath, महाबले mighty, लक्ष्मणे च Lakshmana also, वानरेन्द्रे Vanara king, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, राक्षसेन्द्रे Rakshasa king, विभीषणे Vibheeshana, विशोधितजटः removed the matted hair, स्नातः had bath, चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः adorned with colourful garlands and daubed with sandal paste, महार्हवसनोपेतः clothed in exquisite robes, तत्र then, श्रिया shining, ज्वलन् glowing, तस्थौ stood
explanation: Bharata had his bath first, and mighty Lakshmana, Sugriva the monkey king, and Vibheeshana the Rakshasa king followed him. Sri Rama removed the matted hair, had bath, adorned with colourful garlands, and daubed with sandal paste and clothed in exquisite robes stood glowing and shining.

shloka_text: पूर्वंतुभरतेस्नातेलक्ष्मणे च महाबले । सुग्रीवेवानरेन्द्रे च राक्षसेन्द्रेविभीषणे ।।6.131.14।। विशोधितजटस्स्नातश्चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः । महार्हवसनोपेतस्तस्थौतत्रश्रियाज्वलन् ।।6.131.15।।
transliteration: pūrvaṃtubharatesnātelakṣmaṇe ca mahābale | sugrīvevānarendre ca rākṣasendrevibhīṣaṇe  viśodhitajaṭassnātaścitramālyānulepanaḥ | mahārhavasanopetastasthautatraśriyājvalan
translation: पूर्वम् first, भरते Bharata, स्नाते had bath, महाबले mighty, लक्ष्मणे च Lakshmana also, वानरेन्द्रे Vanara king, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, राक्षसेन्द्रे Rakshasa king, विभीषणे Vibheeshana, विशोधितजटः removed the matted hair, स्नातः had bath, चित्रमाल्यानुलेपनः adorned with colourful garlands and daubed with sandal paste, महार्हवसनोपेतः clothed in exquisite robes, तत्र then, श्रिया shining, ज्वलन् glowing, तस्थौ stood
explanation: Bharata had his bath first, and mighty Lakshmana, Sugriva the monkey king, and Vibheeshana the Rakshasa king followed him. Sri Rama removed the matted hair, had bath, adorned with colourful garlands, and daubed with sandal paste and clothed in exquisite robes stood glowing and shining.

shloka_text: प्रतिकर्म च रामस्यकारयामासवीर्यवान । लक्ष्मणस्य च लक्ष्मीवानिक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः ।।6.131.16।।
transliteration: pratikarma ca rāmasyakārayāmāsavīryavāna | lakṣmaṇasya ca lakṣmīvānikṣvākukulavardhanaḥ
translation: वीर्यवान् valiant, लक्ष्मीवान् prosperous, इक्ष्वाकुकुलवर्धनः enhancer of the glory of Ikshvaku race, रामस्य Rama's, लक्ष्मणस्य च and Lakshmana's, प्रतिकर्म decorated, कारयामास did
explanation: Then valiant and prosperous, Shatrughna, who is an enhancer of the glory of Ikshvaku race decorated Sri Rama and Lakshmana (duly with ornaments).

shloka_text: प्रतिकर्मचसीतायास्सर्वादशरथस्त्रियः । आत्मनैवतदाचक्रुर्मनस्विन्योमनोहरम् ।।6.131.17।।
transliteration: pratikarmacasītāyāssarvādaśarathastriyaḥ | ātmanaivatadācakrurmanasvinyomanoharam
translation: तदा then, सर्वाः all, मनस्विन्यः nobleminded, दशरथस्त्रियः Dasharatha's wives, सीतायाः for Sita, मनोहरम् beautiful, प्रतिकर्म decoration, आत्मनैव themselves, चक्रुः did
explanation: Then all the nobleminded Dasharatha's wives themselves decorated Sita beautifully.

shloka_text: ततोवानरपत्नीनांसर्वासामेवशोभनम् । चकारयत्नात्कौसल्याप्रहृष्टापुत्रवत्सला ।।6.131.18।।
transliteration: tatovānarapatnīnāṃsarvāsāmevaśobhanam | cakārayatnātkausalyāprahṛṣṭāputravatsalā
translation: ततः then, प्रहृष्टाः very delighted, पुत्रवत्सला lover of her sons, कौसल्या Kausalya, सर्वासाम् all, वानरपत्नीनाम् for the wives of Vanaras, यत्नात् took effort, शोभनम् in splendid manner to decorate, चकार started
explanation: The very delighted Kausalya, lover of her sons started making effort to decorate the wives of all Vanaras in a splendid manner.

shloka_text: तत: श्शत्रुघ्नवचनात्सुमन्त्रोनामसारथिः । योजयित्वाभिचक्रामरथंसर्वाङ्गशोभनम् ।।6.131.19।।
transliteration: tata: śśatrughnavacanātsumantronāmasārathiḥ | yojayitvābhicakrāmarathaṃsarvāṅgaśobhanam
translation: ततः then, सुमन्त्रोनाम named Sumantra, सारथिःcharioteer, शत्रुघ्नवचनात् by the command of Shatrughna, सर्वाङ्गशोभनम् all parts of the body, रथम् chariot, योजयित्वा yoked, अभिचक्राम came there
explanation: Then Sumantra the charioteer, commanded by Shatrughna came there with all parts of the chariot decorated and yoked.

shloka_text: अर्कमण्डलसङ्काशंदिव्यंदृष्टवारथंस्थितम् । आरुरोहमहाबाहूरामःपरपुरंञ्जयः ।।6.131.20।।
transliteration: arkamaṇḍalasaṅkāśaṃdivyaṃdṛṣṭavārathaṃsthitam | ārurohamahābāhūrāmaḥparapuraṃñjayaḥ
translation: अर्कमण्डलसङ्काशम् like the radiance of the planet sun, स्थितम् stood, दिव्यम् wonderful, रथम् chariot, दृष्टवा seeing, महाबाहुः mighty armed, परपुरंञ्जयः the conqueror of hostile enemies, रामः Rama, आरुरोह ascended
explanation: Seeing the wonderful chariot like the radiance of the planet sun, mighty armed Rama the conqueror of hostile enemies ascended.

shloka_text: सुग्रीवोहनुमांश्चैवमहेन्द्रसदृशद्युती । स्नातौदिव्यनिभैर्वस्त्रैर्जग्मतुश्शुभकुण्डलौ ।।6.131.21।।
transliteration: sugrīvohanumāṃścaivamahendrasadṛśadyutī | snātaudivyanibhairvastrairjagmatuśśubhakuṇḍalau
translation: महेन्द्रसदृशद्युती vied with Mahendra in splendour, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, हनुमांश्चैव even Hanuman, स्नातौ having bathed, शुभकुण्डलौ wearing sparkling earrings, दिव्यनिभैः heavenly, वस्त्रः clothes, जग्मतुः started
explanation: Sugriva and Hanuman having bathed wore sparkling earrings, clothed in heavenly robes vied with Mahendra in splendour, started.

shloka_text: सर्वाभरणजुष्टाश्चयुयुस्तश्शुभकुण्डलाः । सुग्रीवपत्नयःसीता च द्रष्टुंनगरमुत्सुकाः ।।6.131.22।।
transliteration: sarvābharaṇajuṣṭāścayuyustaśśubhakuṇḍalāḥ | sugrīvapatnayaḥsītā ca draṣṭuṃnagaramutsukāḥ
translation: ताः they, सुग्रीवपत्नयाः Sugriva's wife, सीता च and Sita, सर्वाभरणजुष्टाः wearing all kinds of ornaments, शुभकुण्डलाः auspicious earrings, नगरम् city, द्रष्टुम् to see, उत्सुकाः enthused, ययुः departed
explanation: Sugriva's wife and Sita decked with all kinds of ornaments and earrings, enthused to see the city, started.

shloka_text: अयोध्यायांतुसचिवाराज्ञोदशरथस्य च । पुरोहितंपुरस्कृत्यमन्त्रयामासुरर्थवत् ।।6.131.23।।
transliteration: ayodhyāyāṃtusacivārājñodaśarathasya ca | purohitaṃpuraskṛtyamantrayāmāsurarthavat
translation: अयोध्यायातु at Ayodhya also राज्ञः king, दशरथस्य Dasharatha's, सचिवाः ministers, पुरोहितम् priests, पुरस्कृत्य started, अर्थवत् to Vasishta, मन्त्रयामासुः thought of the required arrangements
explanation: At Ayodhya also, king Dasharatha's ministers, priests started to Vasishta and thought of the required arrangements.

shloka_text: अशोकोविजयश्चैवसिद्धार्थश्चसमाहिताः । मन्त्रयन्रामवृध्यर्थंबुध्यर्थंनगरस्य च ।।6.131.24।।
transliteration: aśokovijayaścaivasiddhārthaścasamāhitāḥ | mantrayanrāmavṛdhyarthaṃbudhyarthaṃnagarasya ca
translation: अशोकः Ashoka, विजयश्चैव Vijaya, सिद्धार्थश्च Siddhartha, समाहिताः collected, रामवृद्ध्यर्थम् for the growth of Rama, नगरस्य and city, बुदद्यर्थम् consulting, मन्त्रयन् thought of
explanation: Ashoka, Vijaya, Siddhartha, collected together and started consulting with each other for the growth of Rama and the City.

shloka_text: सर्वमेवाभिषेकार्थंजयार्हस्यमहात्मनः । कर्तुमर्हथरामस्ययद्यन्मङ्गलपूर्वकम् ।।6.131.25।।
transliteration: sarvamevābhiṣekārthaṃjayārhasyamahātmanaḥ | kartumarhatharāmasyayadyanmaṅgalapūrvakam
translation: जयार्हस्य for the success, महात्मनः of great soul, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकार्थम् for the consecration, यद्यत् Whatever, सर्वम् all, मङ्गलपूर्वकम् auspicious, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हथ who deserves
explanation: For the success of the great soul Rama's consecration, whatever was auspicious, all that ought to be done as he deserves.

shloka_text: इतितेमन्त्रिणस्सर्वेसन्दिश्य च पुरोहितम् । नगरान्निर्ययुस्तूर्णंरामदर्शनबुद्धयः ।।6.131.26।।
transliteration: ititemantriṇassarvesandiśya ca purohitam | nagarānniryayustūrṇaṃrāmadarśanabuddhayaḥ
translation: ते they, सर्वे all, मत्रनिणःministers, पुरोहितम् priests, इति thus, सन्दिश्य communicating, रामदर्शनबुद्धयः for having a glance of Rama, तूर्णम् speedily, नगरात् from the city, निर्ययुः set forth
explanation: All those ministers, priests thus communicating with each other, speedily set forth to have a glance at Sri Rama.

shloka_text: हरियुक्तंसहस्राक्षोरथमिन्द्रइवानघः । प्रययौरथमास्थायरामोनगरमुत्तमम् ।।6.131.27।।
transliteration: hariyuktaṃsahasrākṣorathamindraivānaghaḥ | prayayaurathamāsthāyarāmonagaramuttamam
translation: सहस्राक्षः thousand eyed, इन्द्रः Indra, हरियुक्तम् green horses, रथमिव chariot like, अनघः sinless, रामः Rama, उत्तमम् excellent, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय seated, नगरम् to the city, प्रययौ departed
explanation: Like the thousand eyed Indra seated in the excellent chariot yoked to green horses, the sinless Rama departed to the city.

shloka_text: जग्राहभरतोरमशीन्शत्रुघ्नश्चत्रमाददे । लक्ष्मणोव्यजनंतस्यमूर्ध्निसम्पर्यवीजयत् ।।6.131.28।। श्वेतं च वालव्यजनंजगृहेपरितस्स्थितः । अपरंचन्द्रसङ्काशंराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः ।।6.131.29।।
transliteration: jagrāhabharatoramaśīnśatrughnaścatramādade | lakṣmaṇovyajanaṃtasyamūrdhnisamparyavījayat  śvetaṃ ca vālavyajanaṃjagṛheparitassthitaḥ | aparaṃcandrasaṅkāśaṃrākṣasendrovibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: भरतः Bharata, रमशीन् reins, जग्राह took hold, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, छत्रम् parasol, तस्य his, मूर्ध्नि in front, आददे took, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, व्यजनम् fan, सम्पर्यवीजयत् for fanning, परितः held, स्थितः stood, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् like the moon, श्वेतम् white, अपरम् whisk, वालव्यजनम् for driving the air, जगृहे took hold
explanation: Bharata held the reins, Shatrughna took hold of the parasol, Lakshmana standing in front held the fan, and the Rakshasa king Vibheeshana held a white whisk which was like a moon for driving the air.

shloka_text: जग्राहभरतोरमशीन्शत्रुघ्नश्चत्रमाददे । लक्ष्मणोव्यजनंतस्यमूर्ध्निसम्पर्यवीजयत् ।।6.131.28।। श्वेतं च वालव्यजनंजगृहेपरितस्स्थितः । अपरंचन्द्रसङ्काशंराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः ।।6.131.29।।
transliteration: jagrāhabharatoramaśīnśatrughnaścatramādade | lakṣmaṇovyajanaṃtasyamūrdhnisamparyavījayat  śvetaṃ ca vālavyajanaṃjagṛheparitassthitaḥ | aparaṃcandrasaṅkāśaṃrākṣasendrovibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: भरतः Bharata, रमशीन् reins, जग्राह took hold, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, छत्रम् parasol, तस्य his, मूर्ध्नि in front, आददे took, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, व्यजनम् fan, सम्पर्यवीजयत् for fanning, परितः held, स्थितः stood, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् like the moon, श्वेतम् white, अपरम् whisk, वालव्यजनम् for driving the air, जगृहे took hold
explanation: Bharata held the reins, Shatrughna took hold of the parasol, Lakshmana standing in front held the fan, and the Rakshasa king Vibheeshana held a white whisk which was like a moon for driving the air.

shloka_text: ऋषिसङ्घैस्तदाकाशेदेवैश्चसमरुद्गणैः । स्तूयमास्यरामस्यशुश्रुवमधुरध्वनिः ।।6.131.30।।
transliteration: ṛṣisaṅghaistadākāśedevaiścasamarudgaṇaiḥ | stūyamāsyarāmasyaśuśruvamadhuradhvaniḥ
translation: तदा then, रामस्य Rama's, ऋषिसङ्घैः host of sages, समरुद्गणैः Rudras, देवैश्च gods, आकाशे in the sky, स्तूयमानस्य started praising, मधुरध्वनिः sweet sounding, शुश्रुवे heard.
explanation: Then the host of sages, Rudras and gods from the heaven started praising Rama with sweet sounding chanting.

shloka_text: ततःशत्रुञ्जयंनामकुञ्जरंपर्वतोपमम् । आरुरोहमहातेजास्सुग्रीवःप्लवगर्षभः ।।6.131.31।।
transliteration: tataḥśatruñjayaṃnāmakuñjaraṃparvatopamam | ārurohamahātejāssugrīvaḥplavagarṣabhaḥ
translation: ततः then, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, महातेजाः resplendent, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, शत्रुञ्जयंनाम Satrumjaya by name, पर्वतोपमम् like a mountain, कुञ्जरम् elephant, आरुरोह ascended
explanation: Then resplendent Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, ascended the mountain like elephant by the name Satrumjaya.

shloka_text: नवनागसहस्राणिययुरास्थायवानराः । मानुषंविग्रहंकृत्वासर्वाभरणभूषिताः ।।6.131.32।।
transliteration: navanāgasahasrāṇiyayurāsthāyavānarāḥ | mānuṣaṃvigrahaṃkṛtvāsarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ
translation: वानराः Vanara, मानुषम् human, विग्रहम् semblance, कृत्वा assuming, सर्वाभरणभूषिताः adorned with ornaments, नवनागसहस्राणि nine thousand elephants, आस्थाय ascended, ययुः departed
explanation: Assuming human semblance, the Vanaras adorned with ornaments ascended nine thousand elephants and departed.

shloka_text: शङ्खशब्दप्रणादैश्चदुन्दुभीनां च निस्स्वनैः । प्रययौपुरुषव्याघ्रस्तांपुरींहर्म्यमालिनीम् ।।6.131.33।।
transliteration: śaṅkhaśabdapraṇādaiścadundubhīnāṃ ca nissvanaiḥ | prayayaupuruṣavyāghrastāṃpurīṃharmyamālinīm
translation: पुरुषव्याघ्रः tiger among men, शङ्खशब्दप्रणादैश्च sound of blasts of conches and shouts, दुन्दुभीनाम् roll of drums, निःस्वनैः च making noise, हर्म्यमालिनीम् rows of mansions, तांपुरीम् that city, प्रययौ went
explanation: Sri Rama the tiger among men went accompanied by sounds of blasts of conches and shouts and roll of drums along the rows of mansions in the city.

shloka_text: ददृशुस्तेसमायान्तंराघवंसपुरस्सरम् । विराजमानंवपुषारथेनातिरथंतदा ।।6.131.34।।
transliteration: dadṛśustesamāyāntaṃrāghavaṃsapurassaram | virājamānaṃvapuṣārathenātirathaṃtadā
translation: तदा then, ते they, सपुरःसरम् having gone to Ayodhya, वपुषा god, विराजमानम् shining brightly, रथेन by chariot, समायान्तम् coming with all in accordance with tradition, अतिरथम् great car warrior, राघवम् Raghava, ददृशुः saw
explanation: Then they saw all those who had gone to Ayodhya coming in advance in accordance with tradition, to receive Rama, the great car warrior, who was shining brightly advancing by the chariot.

shloka_text: तेवर्थयित्वाकाकुत्स्थंरामेणप्रतिनन्दिताः । अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानंभ्रातृभिःपरिवारितम् ।।6.131.35।।
transliteration: tevarthayitvākākutsthaṃrāmeṇapratinanditāḥ | anujagmurmahātmānaṃbhrātṛbhiḥparivāritam
translation: ते they, काकुत्स्थम् Kakuthsa, वर्धयित्वाblessing, रामेण Rama, प्रतिनन्दिताः in turn very happily responded, भ्रातृभिः brothers also, परिवारितम् surrounded, महात्मानम् great, अनुजग्मुःfollowed
explanation: They were blessing Sri Rama in turn and Rama responded to them very happily. Surrounded by brothers and all followed Rama the great soul.

shloka_text: अमात्यैर्ब्राह्मणैश्चैवतथाप्रकृतिभिर्ववृतः । श्रियाविरुरुचेरामोनक्षत्ररिवचन्द्रमाः ।।6.131.36।।
transliteration: amātyairbrāhmaṇaiścaivatathāprakṛtibhirvavṛtaḥ | śriyāvirurucerāmonakṣatrarivacandramāḥ
translation: अमात्यैः ministers, ब्राह्मणैश्चैव brahmins, तथा so also, प्रकृतिभिः common people, वृतः surrounded, रामः Rama, नक्षत्रैः star, चन्द्रमाःइव like moon, श्रिया glorious, विरुरुचे shone brightly.
explanation: Surrounded by ministers, brahmins and common people, glorious Rama shone brightly like the moon surrounded by stars.

shloka_text: स पुरोगामिभिस्तूर्यैस्तालस्वस्तिकपाणिभिः । प्रव्याहरद्भिर्मुदितैर्मङ्गलानिवृतोययौ ।।6.131.37।।
transliteration: sa purogāmibhistūryaistālasvastikapāṇibhiḥ | pravyāharadbhirmuditairmaṅgalānivṛtoyayau
translation: सः he, पुरोगामिभिः went forward, तूर्यैः bands, तालस्वस्तिकपाणिभिः with trumpets, wooden cymbals and swastikas, मङ्गलानि auspicious, प्रव्याहरद्भिः singing festive songs, मुदितैः very happily, वृतः covered, ययौ went
explanation: He went forward surrounded by bands, trumpets, wooden cymbals and swastikas and very happily singing auspicious festive songs.

shloka_text: अक्षतंजातरूपं च गावःकन्यास्सहद्विजाः । नरामोदकहस्ताश्चरामस्यपुरतोययुः ।।6.131.38।।
transliteration: akṣataṃjātarūpaṃ ca gāvaḥkanyāssahadvijāḥ | narāmodakahastāścarāmasyapuratoyayuḥ
translation: अक्षतम् yellow rice जातरूपं च appearing like gold, गावः cows, कन्याः virgin women, सहद्विजाः with brahmins, मोदकहस्ताः with Modakas in hand, नराः men, रामस्य Rama's, पुरतः before, ययुः went
explanation: Taking yellow rice (rice smeared with turmeric) appearing like gold, cows, virgin women, brahmins with Modakas in hand went before Rama.

shloka_text: सख्यं च रामस्सुग्रीवेप्रभावंचानिलात्मजे । वानराणां च तत्कर्मह्याचचक्षेऽऽथमन्त्रिणाम् ।।6.131.39।।
transliteration: sakhyaṃ ca rāmassugrīveprabhāvaṃcānilātmaje | vānarāṇāṃ ca tatkarmahyācacakṣe''thamantriṇām
translation: अथ and then, रामः Rama, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, सख्यं च friendship, अनिलात्मजे of the son of wind god, प्रभावं च distinct performance, वानराणाम् Vanaras, तत् that, कर्म च actions, मन्त्रिणाम् to ministers, आचचक्षे narrated
explanation: Rama narrated about his friendship with Sugriva and the distinct performance of Hanuman and Vanaras to the ministers.

shloka_text: श्रुत्वा च विस्मयंजग्मुरयोध्यापुरवासिनः । वानराणां च ततकर्मराक्षसानां च तद्बलम् ।।6.131.40।।
transliteration: śrutvā ca vismayaṃjagmurayodhyāpuravāsinaḥ | vānarāṇāṃ ca tatakarmarākṣasānāṃ ca tadbalam
translation: अयोध्यापुरवासिनः citizens of Ayodhya, वानराणाम् Vanaras, तत् that, कर्म action, राक्षसानाम् of Rakshasas, तत् their, बलं च strength, श्रुत्वा hearing, विस्मयम् astonished, जग्मुः became
explanation: Hearing about the action of Vanaras and the strength of Rakshasas, the citizens of Ayodhya were astonished.

shloka_text: विभीषणस्यसम्योगमाचचक्षेऽथमन्त्रिणाम् । द्युतिमानेतदाख्यायरामोवानरसम्युतः ।।6.131.41।। हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णमयोध्यांप्रविवेशसः ।
transliteration: vibhīṣaṇasyasamyogamācacakṣe'thamantriṇām | dyutimānetadākhyāyarāmovānarasamyutaḥ  hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanākīrṇamayodhyāṃpraviveśasaḥ |
translation: अथ and then, मन्त्रिणाम् ministers, विभीषणस्य Vibheeshana, संयोगम् friendship, आचचक्षे narrated, द्युतिमान् splendorous, सः he, रामःRama, एतत् all that, आख्याय told, वानरसंयुतः accompanied by Vanaras, हृष्टपुष्टजनाकीर्णाम् very happy filled with people, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, प्रविवेश entered
explanation: Sri Rama narrated about Vibheeshana's friendship to the ministers. Splendorous Rama then entered Ayodhya filled with very happy people accompanied by Vanaras.

shloka_text: ततोह्यभ्युच्छ्रयन्पौराःपताकाश्चगृहेगृहे ।।6.131.42।। ऐक्ष्वाकुध्युषितंरम्यमाससादपितुर्गृहम् ।
transliteration: tatohyabhyucchrayanpaurāḥpatākāścagṛhegṛhe  aikṣvākudhyuṣitaṃramyamāsasādapiturgṛham |
translation: ततः thereupon, पौराः citizens, गृहेगृहे every house, पताकाः flag, अभ्युच्छ्रयन् lifted up and held, ऐक्ष्वाकाध्युषितम् abode of Ikshvaku dynasty, पितुः father, रम्यम् beautiful, गृहम् home, आससाद reached.
explanation: The citizens of Ayodhya held the flags up in every house. Thereupon Rama reached the beautiful home of his father, the abode of the Ikshvaku dynasty.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रोभरतंधर्मिणांवरम् ।।6.131.43।। अर्धोपहितयावाचामधुरंरघुनन्दनः । पितुर्भवनमासाद्यप्रविश्य च महात्मनः ।।6.131.44।। कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीमभिवाद्य च ।
transliteration: athābravīdrājaputrobharataṃdharmiṇāṃvaram  ardhopahitayāvācāmadhuraṃraghunandanaḥ | piturbhavanamāsādyapraviśya ca mahātmanaḥ  kausalyāṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca kaikeyīmabhivādya ca |
translation: अथ and then, राजपुत्रः prince, रघुनन्दनः the joy of Raghus, महात्मनः great soul, पितुः father, भवनम् mansion, आसाद्य reached, कौसल्यां च and Kausalya's, सुमित्रां च and Sumitra's, कैकेयीं च and Kaikeyi's, अभिवाद्य च greeted them, धर्मिणाम् virtuous, परम् supreme, भरतम् Bharata, अर्थोपहितया meaningful, वाचा words, मधुरम् sweet tone, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: And thereafter prince Rama, the joy of Raghus, the great soul reached father's mansion and then to Kausalya's and to Sumitra, to Kaikeyi and greeted them. He then spoke meaningful words to virtuous Bharata in a sweet tone.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्राजपुत्रोभरतंधर्मिणांवरम् ।।6.131.43।। अर्धोपहितयावाचामधुरंरघुनन्दनः । पितुर्भवनमासाद्यप्रविश्य च महात्मनः ।।6.131.44।। कौसल्यां च सुमित्रां च कैकेयीमभिवाद्य च ।
transliteration: athābravīdrājaputrobharataṃdharmiṇāṃvaram  ardhopahitayāvācāmadhuraṃraghunandanaḥ | piturbhavanamāsādyapraviśya ca mahātmanaḥ  kausalyāṃ ca sumitrāṃ ca kaikeyīmabhivādya ca |
translation: अथ and then, राजपुत्रः prince, रघुनन्दनः the joy of Raghus, महात्मनः great soul, पितुः father, भवनम् mansion, आसाद्य reached, कौसल्यां च and Kausalya's, सुमित्रां च and Sumitra's, कैकेयीं च and Kaikeyi's, अभिवाद्य च greeted them, धर्मिणाम् virtuous, परम् supreme, भरतम् Bharata, अर्थोपहितया meaningful, वाचा words, मधुरम् sweet tone, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: And thereafter prince Rama, the joy of Raghus, the great soul reached father's mansion and then to Kausalya's and to Sumitra, to Kaikeyi and greeted them. He then spoke meaningful words to virtuous Bharata in a sweet tone.

shloka_text: यच्छमद्भवनंश्रेष्ठंसाशोकवनिकंमहत् ।।6.131.45।। मुक्तावैदूर्यसङ्कीर्णंसुग्रीवायनिवेदय ।
transliteration: yacchamadbhavanaṃśreṣṭhaṃsāśokavanikaṃmahat  muktāvaidūryasaṅkīrṇaṃsugrīvāyanivedaya |
translation: श्रेष्टं splendid, साशोकवनिकम् palace with Ashoka grove, मुक्तावैदूर्यसङ्कीर्णम् encrusted with pearls cat's eye gems, महत् excellent, तत् that, मद्भवनम् that mansion, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, निवेदय be place at his disposal
explanation: Let the splendid, excellent mansion attached to Ashoka grove, encrusted with cat's eye gems and pearls be placed at the disposal of Sugriva.

shloka_text: तस्यतद्वचनंश्रुत्वाभरतस्सत्यविक्रमः ।।6.131.46।। हस्तेगृहीत्वासुग्रीवंप्रविवेशतमालयम् ।
transliteration: tasyatadvacanaṃśrutvābharatassatyavikramaḥ  hastegṛhītvāsugrīvaṃpraviveśatamālayam |
translation: ततः then, सत्यविक्रमःupright, भरतःBharata, तस्य his, तत् वचनम् that words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, हस्ते hand, गृहीत्वा taking, तम् to him आलयम् that temple like abode, प्रविवेश entered
explanation: Then that upright Bharata hearing the words of Rama taking the hand of Sugriva led him to that temple like abode.

shloka_text: तत: स्स्सैलप्रदीपांश्चपर्यङ्कास्तरणानि च ।।6.131.47।। गृहीत्वाविविशुःक्षिप्रंशत्रुघ्नेप्रचोदिताः ।
transliteration: tata: sssailapradīpāṃścaparyaṅkāstaraṇāni ca  gṛhītvāviviśuḥkṣipraṃśatrughnepracoditāḥ |
translation: ततः then, शत्रुघ्नेन by Shatrughna, प्रचोदिताः commanded, तैलप्रदीप्तांश्च glowing oil lamps, पर्यङ्कास्तरणानि च coverlets for the couches, गृहीत्वा taking, क्षिप्रम् quickly, विविशुःentered
explanation: Then as commanded by Shatrughna, people taking glowing oil lamps and coverlets for the couches quickly entered the palace.

shloka_text: उवाच च महातेजास्सुग्रीवंराघवानुजः ।।6.131.48।। अभिषेकायरामस्यदूतानाज्ञापयप्रभो ।
transliteration: uvāca ca mahātejāssugrīvaṃrāghavānujaḥ  abhiṣekāyarāmasyadūtānājñāpayaprabho |
translation: महातेजाः highly brilliant, राघवानुजःRaghava's brother, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, उवाच च spoke, प्रभोking, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the consecration, दूतान्envoys, आज्ञापयmay be ordered
explanation: Highly brilliant Sugriva said to Bharata, "Let envoys be sent for the consecration of Rama."

shloka_text: सौवर्णान्वानरेन्द्राणांचतुर्णांचतुरोघटान् ।।6.131.49।। ददौक्षिप्रंससुग्रीवस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितान् ।
transliteration: sauvarṇānvānarendrāṇāṃcaturṇāṃcaturoghaṭān  dadaukṣipraṃsasugrīvassarvaratnavibhūṣitān |
translation: स: he, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, क्षिप्रम् instantly, चतुर्णाम् four, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara leaders, सौवर्णान् golden, सर्वरत्नविभूषितान् well decorated, चतुरः four, घटान् pots, ददौ gave
explanation: Sugriva instantly gave four golden pots decorated well to the four Vanara leaders.

shloka_text: यथाप्रत्यूषसमयेचतुर्णांसागराम्बसाम् ।।6.131.50।। पूर्णघटैःप्रतीक्षध्वंतथाकुरुतवानराः ।
transliteration: yathāpratyūṣasamayecaturṇāṃsāgarāmbasām  pūrṇaghaṭaiḥpratīkṣadhvaṃtathākurutavānarāḥ |
translation: वानराः Vanaras, चतुर्याम् four of them, सागराम्बसाम् waters from the ocean, पूर्णैःfilled, घटैःpots, प्रत्यूषसमये early morning time, यथा so, प्रतीक्षध्वम् wait for me, तथाकुरुतyou do
explanation: Sugriva gave four pots to the four of the Vanaras to get them filled with the water of the four oceans and get them by early morning and said to await for him.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तामहात्मानोवानरावारणोपमाः ।।6.131.51।। उत्पेतुर्गगनंशीघ्रंगरुडाइवशीघ्रगाः ।
transliteration: evamuktāmahātmānovānarāvāraṇopamāḥ  utpeturgaganaṃśīghraṃgaruḍāivaśīghragāḥ |
translation: एवम् in that way, उक्ताःspoken, वारणोपमाः like mountain in form, गरुडाःइव like Garuda, शीघ्रगाःsped, महात्मानःgreat souls, वानराः Vanaras, शीघ्रम् quickly, गगनम् into the sky, उत्पेतुःrose up
explanation: Having spoken like that by Sugriva, the Vanaras of mountainlike forms fled like Garuda into the sky quickly.

shloka_text: जाम्बवांश्चहनूमांश्चवेगदर्शी च वानरः ।।6.131.52।। ऋषभश्चैवकलशान्जलपूर्णानथानयन् । नदीशतानांपञ्चानांजलंकुम्भैरुपाहरन् ।।6.131.53।। पूर्वात्समुद्रात्कलशंजलपूर्णमथानयत् । सुषेणस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ।।6.131.54।।
transliteration: jāmbavāṃścahanūmāṃścavegadarśī ca vānaraḥ  ṛṣabhaścaivakalaśānjalapūrṇānathānayan | nadīśatānāṃpañcānāṃjalaṃkumbhairupāharan  pūrvātsamudrātkalaśaṃjalapūrṇamathānayat | suṣeṇassattvasampannassarvaratnavibhūṣitam
translation: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavantha, हनूमांश्च Hanuman, वेगदर्शी Vegadarsa, वानरः Vanara, ऋषभश्चैव Rshaba, कलशा pots, न्जलपूर्णा filled with sea water, नथानयन् different rivers, नदीशतानां a hundred rivers, पञ्चानां five, जलंwater, कुम्भैरुपाहरन् brought in pots, अथ and then, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with courage, सुषेणः Sushena, पूर्वात् eastern समुद्रात् ocean, सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, जलपूर्णम् pot filled with water, कलशम् pot, आनयत् brought
explanation: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

shloka_text: जाम्बवांश्चहनूमांश्चवेगदर्शी च वानरः ।।6.131.52।। ऋषभश्चैवकलशान्जलपूर्णानथानयन् । नदीशतानांपञ्चानांजलंकुम्भैरुपाहरन् ।।6.131.53।। पूर्वात्समुद्रात्कलशंजलपूर्णमथानयत् । सुषेणस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ।।6.131.54।।
transliteration: jāmbavāṃścahanūmāṃścavegadarśī ca vānaraḥ  ṛṣabhaścaivakalaśānjalapūrṇānathānayan | nadīśatānāṃpañcānāṃjalaṃkumbhairupāharan  pūrvātsamudrātkalaśaṃjalapūrṇamathānayat | suṣeṇassattvasampannassarvaratnavibhūṣitam
translation: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavantha, हनूमांश्च Hanuman, वेगदर्शी Vegadarsa, वानरः Vanara, ऋषभश्चैव Rshaba, कलशा pots, न्जलपूर्णा filled with sea water, नथानयन् different rivers, नदीशतानां a hundred rivers, पञ्चानां five, जलंwater, कुम्भैरुपाहरन् brought in pots, अथ and then, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with courage, सुषेणः Sushena, पूर्वात् eastern समुद्रात् ocean, सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, जलपूर्णम् pot filled with water, कलशम् pot, आनयत् brought
explanation: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

shloka_text: जाम्बवांश्चहनूमांश्चवेगदर्शी च वानरः ।।6.131.52।। ऋषभश्चैवकलशान्जलपूर्णानथानयन् । नदीशतानांपञ्चानांजलंकुम्भैरुपाहरन् ।।6.131.53।। पूर्वात्समुद्रात्कलशंजलपूर्णमथानयत् । सुषेणस्सत्त्वसम्पन्नस्सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् ।।6.131.54।।
transliteration: jāmbavāṃścahanūmāṃścavegadarśī ca vānaraḥ  ṛṣabhaścaivakalaśānjalapūrṇānathānayan | nadīśatānāṃpañcānāṃjalaṃkumbhairupāharan  pūrvātsamudrātkalaśaṃjalapūrṇamathānayat | suṣeṇassattvasampannassarvaratnavibhūṣitam
translation: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavantha, हनूमांश्च Hanuman, वेगदर्शी Vegadarsa, वानरः Vanara, ऋषभश्चैव Rshaba, कलशा pots, न्जलपूर्णा filled with sea water, नथानयन् different rivers, नदीशतानां a hundred rivers, पञ्चानां five, जलंwater, कुम्भैरुपाहरन् brought in pots, अथ and then, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with courage, सुषेणः Sushena, पूर्वात् eastern समुद्रात् ocean, सर्वरत्नविभूषितम् decorated with all kinds of gems, जलपूर्णम् pot filled with water, कलशम् pot, आनयत् brought
explanation: Jambavan, Hanuman, Vegadarsa and Rshaba brought pots of water from the seas. Another five hundred monkeys brought five hundred pots from five hundred rivers of the country. Jambavan richly endowed with courage brought in a pot encrusted with all kinds of gems. Sushena brought water from the eastern sea.

shloka_text: ऋषभोदक्षिणात्तूर्णंसमुद्राज्जलमानयत् । रक्तचन्दनशाखाभिस्सम्वृतंकाञ्चनंघटम् ।।6.131.55।।
transliteration: ṛṣabhodakṣiṇāttūrṇaṃsamudrājjalamānayat | raktacandanaśākhābhissamvṛtaṃkāñcanaṃghaṭam
translation: ऋषभः Rshaba, दक्षिणात् समुद्रात् from southern sea, रक्तचन्दनशाखाभिः covered with red sandal paste, संवृतम् covered, काञ्चनम् golden, घटम् pot, जलम् water, तूर्णम् quickly, आनयत् brought
explanation: Rshaba quickly brought water from the southern sea in a golden pot covered with sandal paste.

shloka_text: गवयःपश्चिमात्तोयमाजहारमहार्णवात् । रत्नकुम्भेनमहताशीतंमारुतविक्रमः ।।6.131.56।।
transliteration: gavayaḥpaścimāttoyamājahāramahārṇavāt | ratnakumbhenamahatāśītaṃmārutavikramaḥ
translation: मारुतविक्रमःexpert like wind god, गवयः Gavaya, महता great, रत्नकुम्भेन pot encrusted with gems, पश्चिमात् west sea, महार्णवात् great abode of varuna, शीतम् cold, तोयम् water, आजहार brought
explanation: Gavaya, an expert like WindGod brought cold water from the abode of Varuna in the west, in a pot encrusted with gems.

shloka_text: उत्तराच्चजलंशीघ्रंगरुडानिलविक्रमः । आजहार स धर्मात्मानलःसर्वगुणान्वितः ।।6.131.57।।
transliteration: uttarāccajalaṃśīghraṃgaruḍānilavikramaḥ | ājahāra sa dharmātmānalaḥsarvaguṇānvitaḥ
translation: गरुडानिलविक्रमःwho vied with Garuda in speed, धर्मात्मा righteous, सर्वगुणान्वितः endowed with all virtues, सः he, नलः Nala, उत्तरात् north, शीघ्रम् quickly, जलम् water, आजहार brought
explanation: Nala who vied with Garuda in speed, a righteous one, endowed with all virtues quickly brought water from the north.

shloka_text: ततस्तैर्वानरश्रेष्ठैरानीतंप्रेक्ष्यतज्जलम् । अभिषेकायरामस्यशत्रुघ्नस्सचिवैस्सह ।।6.131.58।। पुरोहितायश्रेष्ठायसुहृद्भ्यश्चन्यवेदयत् ।
transliteration: tatastairvānaraśreṣṭhairānītaṃprekṣyatajjalam | abhiṣekāyarāmasyaśatrughnassacivaissaha  purohitāyaśreṣṭhāyasuhṛdbhyaścanyavedayat |
translation: ततः then, सचिवैःसह along with ministers, शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेकाय for the consecration, तैः they, वानरश्रेष्ठैः foremost of Vanaras, आनीतम् brought by, तत् that, जलम् water, श्रेष्ठाय supreme, पुरोहिताय priest, सुहृद्भ्यः च friends, न्यवेदयत् placed
explanation: Then seeing the water brought by the monkeys for Rama's consecration Shatrugna along with ministers placed them at the disposal of the supreme priest along with friends.

shloka_text: ततस्सप्रयतोवृद्धोवसिष्ठोब्राह्मणैःसह ।।6.131.59।। रामंरत्नमयेपीठेससीतंसन्नयवेशयत् ।
transliteration: tatassaprayatovṛddhovasiṣṭhobrāhmaṇaiḥsaha  rāmaṃratnamayepīṭhesasītaṃsannayaveśayat |
translation: ततः then, ब्राह्मणैःसह with brahmins, वृद्धःaged, वसिष्ठः Vasishta, प्रयतः active, ससीतम् Sita, रामम्Rama, रत्नमये full of precious stones, पीठे plank, सन्नयवेशयत् to take seat.
explanation: Then accompanied by brahmins, sage Vasishta, active though aged, asked Sita and Sri Rama to occupy the plank made with full of precious stones.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठोवामदेवश्चजाबालिरथकाश्यपः ।।6.131.60।। कात्यायनोसुयज्ञश्चगौतमोविजयस्तथा । अभ्यषिञ्चन्नरव्याघ्रंप्रसन्नेनसुगन्धिना ।।6.131.61।। सलिलेनसहस्राक्षंवसवोवासवंयथा ।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhovāmadevaścajābālirathakāśyapaḥ  kātyāyanosuyajñaścagautamovijayastathā | abhyaṣiñcannaravyāghraṃprasannenasugandhinā  salilenasahasrākṣaṃvasavovāsavaṃyathā |
translation: वसिष्ठः Vasishta, वामदेवश्चजाबालिः VamaDeva, Jabali अथ and, काश्यपः Kasyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञः Suyajna, गौतमः Gautam, तथा so also, विजयः Vijaya, प्रसन्नेन pure, सुगन्धिभा fragrant, सलिलेन waters, वसवः Indra, सहस्राक्षम् thousand eyed, वासवंयथा like Vasus, नरव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecrated
explanation: Eight sages, Vasishta, Vama Deva, Jabali, Kasyapa, Katyayana, Suyajna, Gautama and Vijaya consecrated Sri Rama, the tiger among men, with pure fragrant waters as the Vasus consecrated the thousand eyed Indra.

shloka_text: वसिष्ठोवामदेवश्चजाबालिरथकाश्यपः ।।6.131.60।। कात्यायनोसुयज्ञश्चगौतमोविजयस्तथा । अभ्यषिञ्चन्नरव्याघ्रंप्रसन्नेनसुगन्धिना ।।6.131.61।। सलिलेनसहस्राक्षंवसवोवासवंयथा ।
transliteration: vasiṣṭhovāmadevaścajābālirathakāśyapaḥ  kātyāyanosuyajñaścagautamovijayastathā | abhyaṣiñcannaravyāghraṃprasannenasugandhinā  salilenasahasrākṣaṃvasavovāsavaṃyathā |
translation: वसिष्ठः Vasishta, वामदेवश्चजाबालिः VamaDeva, Jabali अथ and, काश्यपः Kasyapa, कात्यायनः Katyayana, सुयज्ञः Suyajna, गौतमः Gautam, तथा so also, विजयः Vijaya, प्रसन्नेन pure, सुगन्धिभा fragrant, सलिलेन waters, वसवः Indra, सहस्राक्षम् thousand eyed, वासवंयथा like Vasus, नरव्याघ्रम् tiger among men, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecrated
explanation: Eight sages, Vasishta, Vama Deva, Jabali, Kasyapa, Katyayana, Suyajna, Gautama and Vijaya consecrated Sri Rama, the tiger among men, with pure fragrant waters as the Vasus consecrated the thousand eyed Indra.

shloka_text: ऋग्भिर्भ्राह्मणैःपूर्वंकन्याभिर्मन्त्रिभिस्तथा ।।6.131.62।। योथौश्चैवाभ्यषिञ्चंस्तेसम्प्रहृष्टास्सनैगमैः । सर्वौषधीनसैश्चापिदैवतैर्नभसिस्थितैः ।।6.131.63।। चतुर्भिर्लोकपालैश्चसर्वैर्देवैश्चसङ्गतैः ।
transliteration: ṛgbhirbhrāhmaṇaiḥpūrvaṃkanyābhirmantribhistathā  yothauścaivābhyaṣiñcaṃstesamprahṛṣṭāssanaigamaiḥ | sarvauṣadhīnasaiścāpidaivatairnabhasisthitaiḥ  caturbhirlokapālaiścasarvairdevaiścasaṅgataiḥ |
translation: सम्प्रहृष्टाः very delighted, ते they, पूर्वम् first, ऋत्विग्भि: priests, ब्राह्मणैः brahmins, कन्याभिः virgin women, तथा so also, मन्त्रिभिः ministers, सनैगमैः merchants,, योथौश्च warriors, नभसि in the sky, स्थितैः stood, देवैः gods, चतुर्भिः four, लोकपालैश्च rulers of quarters, सङ्गतैः assembled, सर्वैः all, देवैश्च gods, सर्वौषथरसाश्चैपि all kinds of medicinal herbs, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecration
explanation: First by priests, followed by brahmins, virgin women, so also ministers, merchants, warriors consecrated. Those who stood in the sky, the gods, the rulers of the four quarters, and all gods consecrated by sprinkling water containing medicinal herbs. All were very delighted.

shloka_text: ऋग्भिर्भ्राह्मणैःपूर्वंकन्याभिर्मन्त्रिभिस्तथा ।।6.131.62।। योथौश्चैवाभ्यषिञ्चंस्तेसम्प्रहृष्टास्सनैगमैः । सर्वौषधीनसैश्चापिदैवतैर्नभसिस्थितैः ।।6.131.63।। चतुर्भिर्लोकपालैश्चसर्वैर्देवैश्चसङ्गतैः ।
transliteration: ṛgbhirbhrāhmaṇaiḥpūrvaṃkanyābhirmantribhistathā  yothauścaivābhyaṣiñcaṃstesamprahṛṣṭāssanaigamaiḥ | sarvauṣadhīnasaiścāpidaivatairnabhasisthitaiḥ  caturbhirlokapālaiścasarvairdevaiścasaṅgataiḥ |
translation: सम्प्रहृष्टाः very delighted, ते they, पूर्वम् first, ऋत्विग्भि: priests, ब्राह्मणैः brahmins, कन्याभिः virgin women, तथा so also, मन्त्रिभिः ministers, सनैगमैः merchants,, योथौश्च warriors, नभसि in the sky, स्थितैः stood, देवैः gods, चतुर्भिः four, लोकपालैश्च rulers of quarters, सङ्गतैः assembled, सर्वैः all, देवैश्च gods, सर्वौषथरसाश्चैपि all kinds of medicinal herbs, अभ्यषिञ्चन् consecration
explanation: First by priests, followed by brahmins, virgin women, so also ministers, merchants, warriors consecrated. Those who stood in the sky, the gods, the rulers of the four quarters, and all gods consecrated by sprinkling water containing medicinal herbs. All were very delighted.

shloka_text: ब्रह्मणानिर्मितंपूर्वंकिरीटंरत्नशोभितम् ।।6.131.64।। अभिषिक्तःपुरायेवमनुस्तंदीप्ततेजसम् । तस्यान्ववायेराजानःक्रमाद्येनाभिषेचिताः ।।6.131.65।। सभायांहेमक्लुप्तायांशोभितायांमहाधनैः । रत्नैर्नानाविधैश्चवचित्रितायांसुशोभनैः ।।6.131.66।। नानारत्नमयेपीठेकल्पयित्वायथाविधि । किरीटेनततःपश्चाद्वसिष्ठेनमहात्मना ।।6.131.67।। ऋत्विगिमभगिर्भूषणैश्चैवसमयोक्ष्यतराघवः ।
transliteration: brahmaṇānirmitaṃpūrvaṃkirīṭaṃratnaśobhitam  abhiṣiktaḥpurāyevamanustaṃdīptatejasam | tasyānvavāyerājānaḥkramādyenābhiṣecitāḥ  sabhāyāṃhemakluptāyāṃśobhitāyāṃmahādhanaiḥ | ratnairnānāvidhaiścavacitritāyāṃsuśobhanaiḥ  nānāratnamayepīṭhekalpayitvāyathāvidhi | kirīṭenatataḥpaścādvasiṣṭhenamahātmanā  ṛtvigimabhagirbhūṣaṇaiścaivasamayokṣyatarāghavaḥ |
translation: येन by whom, पुरा in the past, मनुः Manu, अभिषिक्तः consecrated, तस्य his, अन्ववाये followed, राजानः kings, येन whom, अभिषेचिताः consecration, तम् him, पूर्वम् earlier, ब्रह्मणा Brahma, निर्मितम् constructed, रत्नशोभितम् encrusted with gems, दीप्ततेजसम् dazzling, किरीटम् crown, हेमक्लुप्तायाम् made of gold, महाधनैः riches, शोभियाताम् splendid, नानाविधैः several kinds, सुशोभनैः charming, रत्नैः gems, चित्रितायाम् with wonderful pictures, सभायाम् council hall, नानारत्नमये with different gems, पीठे throne, यथाविधि as per tradition, कल्पयित्वा arranged, ततः then पश्चात् seeing that, महात्मना great soul, वसिष्ठेन by Vasishta, किरीटेन crown, ऋ त्विगिमभगिः priests also, भूषणैश्चैव ornaments also, राघवः Raghava,
explanation: In the past, Manu was consecrated with a crown encrusted with gems crafted by Brahma and it was adorned at consecration by successive kings. After the consecration, Rama was dazzling seated on a throne made of several kinds of gems as per tradition. The council hall was also made of gold with charming pictures and looked splendid. The great soul Raghava was crowned and adorned with ornaments by Vasishta and the priests.

shloka_text: छत्रंतस्य च जग्राहशत्रघ्नःपाण्डुरंशुभम् ।।6.131.68।। श्वेतं च वालव्यजनंसुग्रीवोवानरेश्वरः । अपरंचन्द्रसङ्काशंराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः ।।6.131.69।।
transliteration: chatraṃtasya ca jagrāhaśatraghnaḥpāṇḍuraṃśubham  śvetaṃ ca vālavyajanaṃsugrīvovānareśvaraḥ | aparaṃcandrasaṅkāśaṃrākṣasendrovibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तस्य his, पाण्डुरम् white, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् parasol, जग्राह held, वानरेश्वरः Vanara Lord, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, श्वेतम् white, वालव्यजनम् whisk, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् shining like moon, अपरंच white whisk
explanation: Shatrughna held white auspicious parasol, Sugriva the Vanara Lord held a white whisk, Vibheeshana the Lord of Rakshasas held a white whisk shining like the moon.

shloka_text: छत्रंतस्य च जग्राहशत्रघ्नःपाण्डुरंशुभम् ।।6.131.68।। श्वेतं च वालव्यजनंसुग्रीवोवानरेश्वरः । अपरंचन्द्रसङ्काशंराक्षसेन्द्रोविभीषणः ।।6.131.69।।
transliteration: chatraṃtasya ca jagrāhaśatraghnaḥpāṇḍuraṃśubham  śvetaṃ ca vālavyajanaṃsugrīvovānareśvaraḥ | aparaṃcandrasaṅkāśaṃrākṣasendrovibhīṣaṇaḥ
translation: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तस्य his, पाण्डुरम् white, शुभम् auspicious, छत्रम् parasol, जग्राह held, वानरेश्वरः Vanara Lord, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, श्वेतम् white, वालव्यजनम् whisk, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, चन्द्रसङ्काशम् shining like moon, अपरंच white whisk
explanation: Shatrughna held white auspicious parasol, Sugriva the Vanara Lord held a white whisk, Vibheeshana the Lord of Rakshasas held a white whisk shining like the moon.

shloka_text: मालांज्वलन्तींवपुषाकाञ्चनींशतपुष्कराम् । राघवायददौवायुर्वासवेनप्रचोदितः ।।6.131.70।।
transliteration: mālāṃjvalantīṃvapuṣākāñcanīṃśatapuṣkarām | rāghavāyadadauvāyurvāsavenapracoditaḥ
translation: वायुः wind god, वासवेन by Indra, प्रचोदितः prompted, वपुषा deity, ज्वलन्तीम् dazzling, मालां garland, शतपुष्कराम् of a hundred flowers, काञ्चनीम् gold राघवाय to Raghava, ददौ gave
explanation: The WindGod prompted by deity Indra presented a dazzling golden garland of hundred flowers to Raghava.

shloka_text: सर्वरत्नसमायुक्तंमणिभिश्चविभूषितम् । मुक्ताहारंनरेन्द्रायददौशक्रप्रचोदितः ।।6.131.71।।
transliteration: sarvaratnasamāyuktaṃmaṇibhiścavibhūṣitam | muktāhāraṃnarendrāyadadauśakrapracoditaḥ
translation: शक्रप्रचोदितः urged by Indra, सर्वरत्नसमायुत्तम् intercepted by several kinds of gems, मणिभिश्च precious stones, विभूषितम् dazzling, मुक्ताहारम् of pearls, नरेन्द्राय to the ruler of the world, ददौ gave
explanation: Urged by Indra the wind god gave a dazzling pearls chain intercepted by several kinds of gems and precious stones to the ruler of the world.

shloka_text: प्रजगुर्धेवगन्धर्वाननृतुश्चाप्सरोगणाः । अभिषेकेतदर्हस्यतदारामस्यधीमतः ।।6.131.72।।
transliteration: prajagurdhevagandharvānanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ | abhiṣeketadarhasyatadārāmasyadhīmataḥ
translation: तदा then, तदर्हस्य, रामस्य Rama's, अभिषेके consecration, देवगन्धर्वाः gods and Gandharvas, प्रजगुः sang, अप्सरोगणाः Apsara groups ननृतुः danced
explanation: The Gandharvas from among the gods sang and Apsara groups danced for Rama's consecration.

shloka_text: भूमिःसस्यवतीचैवफलवन्तश्चपादपाः । गन्धवन्ति च पुष्पाणिबभूवूराघवोत्सवे ।।6.131.73।।
transliteration: bhūmiḥsasyavatīcaivaphalavantaścapādapāḥ | gandhavanti ca puṣpāṇibabhūvūrāghavotsave
translation: राघवोत्सवे at the celebration of Rama, भूमिः earth, सस्यवती as green with crops, पादपाः trees, फलवन्तश्च filled with fruits, पुष्पाणि flowers, गन्धवन्ति च spread fragrance, बभूवुः became
explanation: At the time of celebration of Rama's coronation, earth became green with crops, trees bore fruits and filled with flowers which spread fragrance.

shloka_text: सहस्रशतमश्वानांधेनूनां च गवांतथा । ददौशतवृषान्पूर्वंद्विजेभ्योमनुजर्षभः ।।6.131.74।।
transliteration: sahasraśatamaśvānāṃdhenūnāṃ ca gavāṃtathā | dadauśatavṛṣānpūrvaṃdvijebhyomanujarṣabhaḥ
translation: मनुजर्षभः bull among men, पूर्वम् first, अश्वानाम् horses, सहस्रशतम् hundred thousand, तथा so also, धेनूनाम् calves, गवां च cows that just delivered, शतवृषान् hundred thousand, द्विजेभ्यः brahmins, ददौ gave
explanation: Sri Rama, the bull among men gave first, a hundred thousand cows with just born calves to hundred thousand brahmins.

shloka_text: त्रिंशत्कोटीर्हिरण्यस्यब्राह्मणेभ्योददौपुनः । नानाभरणवस्त्राणिमहार्हाणि च राघवः ।।6.131.75।।
transliteration: triṃśatkoṭīrhiraṇyasyabrāhmaṇebhyodadaupunaḥ | nānābharaṇavastrāṇimahārhāṇi ca rāghavaḥ
translation: राघवः Raghava, पुनः again, ब्राह्मणेभ्यः brahmins, हिरण्यस्य golden, त्रिशत्कोटीः thirty crores, महार्हाणि excellent, नानाभरणवस्त्राणि different kinds of ornaments and clothes, ददौ gave
explanation: Raghava again gave brahmins thirty crores of golden coins and different kinds of ornaments and clothes.

shloka_text: अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशांकाञ्चनींमणिविग्रहाम् । सुग्रीवायस्रजंदिव्यांप्रायच्छन्मनुजाधिपः ।।6.131.76।।
transliteration: arkaraśmipratīkāśāṃkāñcanīṃmaṇivigrahām | sugrīvāyasrajaṃdivyāṃprāyacchanmanujādhipaḥ
translation: मनुजाधिपः Lord of the people, सुग्रीवाय Sugriva, अर्करश्मिप्रतीकाशाम् dazzling like sun's rays, मणिविग्रहाम् stretch of gems, काञ्चनीम् golden, दिव्याम् wonderful, स्रजम् tied, सुग्रीवाय to Sugriva, प्रायच्छत् presented
explanation: Sri Rama gave a wonderful golden garland with a stretch of gems tied to it which was dazzling like the sun's rays to Sugriva.

shloka_text: वैदूर्यमयचित्रे च मणिरत्नविभूषिते । वालिपुत्रायधृतिमानङ्गदायाङ्गदेददौ ।।6.131.77।।
transliteration: vaidūryamayacitre ca maṇiratnavibhūṣite | vāliputrāyadhṛtimānaṅgadāyāṅgadedadau
translation: धृतिमान् very lovingly, वैदूर्यमयचित्रे च wonderful with cat's eyes stones, मणिरत्नविभूषिते fixed with gems and precious gems, अङ्गदे to Angada, वालिपुत्राय son of Vali, अङ्गदाय to Angada, ददौ gave
explanation: Very lovingly Rama gave Angada the son of Vali, wonderful armlets encrusted with cat's eye stones and precious gems.

shloka_text: मणिप्रवरजुष्टंतुमुक्ताहारमनुत्तमम् । सीतायैप्रददौरामश्चन्द्ररश्मिसमप्रभम् ।।6.131.78।। अरजेवाससीदिव्येशुभान्याभरणानि च । अवेक्षमाणावैदेहीप्रददौवायुसूनवे ।।6.131.79।।
transliteration: maṇipravarajuṣṭaṃtumuktāhāramanuttamam | sītāyaipradadaurāmaścandraraśmisamaprabham  arajevāsasīdivyeśubhānyābharaṇāni ca | avekṣamāṇāvaidehīpradadauvāyusūnave
translation: रामः Rama, मणिप्रवरजुष्टम् encrusted with gems and corals, अनुत्तमम् best, तम् them, चन्द्ररश्मि moon beams समप्रभम् unsurpassed, मुक्ताहारम् pearl chain, अरजे immaculate, दिव्ये wonderful, वाससी clothes, शुभानि splendid, आभरणानि च ornaments, सीतायै to Sita, प्रददौ presented अवेक्षमाणा looking at, वैदेही Vaidehi, प्रददौ gave, वायुसूनवे Hanuman
explanation: Rama gave Sita an unsurpassed pearl chain (given to him by the wind god) encrusted with the best of gems and corals wonderfully shining like moonbeams. And Sita looking at Rama presented that immaculate wonderful pearl chain, and splendid clothes with some ornaments to Hanuman.

shloka_text: मणिप्रवरजुष्टंतुमुक्ताहारमनुत्तमम् । सीतायैप्रददौरामश्चन्द्ररश्मिसमप्रभम् ।।6.131.78।। अरजेवाससीदिव्येशुभान्याभरणानि च । अवेक्षमाणावैदेहीप्रददौवायुसूनवे ।।6.131.79।।
transliteration: maṇipravarajuṣṭaṃtumuktāhāramanuttamam | sītāyaipradadaurāmaścandraraśmisamaprabham  arajevāsasīdivyeśubhānyābharaṇāni ca | avekṣamāṇāvaidehīpradadauvāyusūnave
translation: रामः Rama, मणिप्रवरजुष्टम् encrusted with gems and corals, अनुत्तमम् best, तम् them, चन्द्ररश्मि moon beams समप्रभम् unsurpassed, मुक्ताहारम् pearl chain, अरजे immaculate, दिव्ये wonderful, वाससी clothes, शुभानि splendid, आभरणानि च ornaments, सीतायै to Sita, प्रददौ presented अवेक्षमाणा looking at, वैदेही Vaidehi, प्रददौ gave, वायुसूनवे Hanuman
explanation: Rama gave Sita an unsurpassed pearl chain (given to him by the wind god) encrusted with the best of gems and corals wonderfully shining like moonbeams. And Sita looking at Rama presented that immaculate wonderful pearl chain, and splendid clothes with some ornaments to Hanuman.

shloka_text: अवमुच्यात्मनःकण्ठाद्दारंजनकनन्दिनी । अवैक्षतहरीन्सर्वान्भर्तारं च मुहुर्मुहुः ।।6.131.80।।
transliteration: avamucyātmanaḥkaṇṭhāddāraṃjanakanandinī | avaikṣataharīnsarvānbhartāraṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ
translation: जनकनन्दिनी enhancer of Janaka's joy, आत्मनः own, कण्ठात् from her neck, हारम् that chain, अवमुच्य to give away, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, भर्तारं च husband also, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अवैक्षत looking
